review_title: Highly recommended tour, we had a ball!
review_text:
We had a such a great day at the Grand Canyon! A full day…in the air and a 3 hour tour in the Wildbuck Hummer, 45 mins in the little town before we flew back to Phoenix. Our tour guide in the Hummer was Gerry, he was so friendly and knowledgeable, the only Native Indian Tour guide so was lucky to get him. 
Zac and Brandon, the Pilots were very professional, informative and friendly. 
We ended up on a private tour even though we booked in a group which we thoroughly enjoyed. Highly recommended tour.
tour_name: 33_71_Grand Canyon South Rim Signature Ground Tour with PJX_2025-03-04

review_title: Do this tour!! Cannot recommend enough!
review_text: This was by far one of the best tours I have ever been on. The experience was great from start to finish. Westwind was great to work with and Brandon took excellent care of us in the air. The ground tour through GC Nation Park was a lot of fun and filled with fun facts and knowledge. They take you to lots of spots where you can get lots of great pictures while learning about some of the history and geology. We loved this tour, would do it again in a heartbeat, and will be recommending this tour to anyone that will listen.

review_title: ONLY WAY TO SEE THE GRAND CANYON

review_text: Great way to see the Grand Canyon and get there quickly from the Phoenix area. We would highly recommend this to anyone visiting Arizona and would absolutely do again. This was well worth the price paid!

review_text: Just such an amazing experience...from Lindsey's warm welcome when we arrived to the pilots navigating the journey! Seeing the Grand Canyon from above, in all its wonder, will delight you and the learnings you will walk away with will leave you in awe! You will not be disappointed!

review_text: Our Grand Canyon Signature Tour - South Rim with Hummer Ground Tour was an absolutely amazing experience, flying over the desert from Phoenix to the Grand Canyon, passing over Sedona, Flagstaff, Mt Humphries (which still had snow on it). Once we landed at the Grand Canyon Airport the tour took us on a Hummer trip around the South Rim of the Canyon.  Photos don’t do this vista enough justice.  The rock formations, colours, size and sheer magnificence was simply awe inducing. Our guides,  both the pilot Nico and the Hummer driver Trey were fantastic; so knowledgeable and interesting and always helpful. We had such a fabulous time. Thanks Westwind for making this an amazing highlight.  Your communication, organisation and friendly guides were fantastic.
tour_name: 33_71_Grand Canyon South Rim Signature Ground Tour with PJX_2025-03-04

review_title: Great experience all around and very convenient
review_text: Great experience all around, can't beat it for doing a half-day tour! Airport was very convenient, pilot was awesome, and really fantastic views from the plane and at the canyon.

review_text: Absolutely blown away with this experience, everything was perfect form the flight to the hummer tour. We felt safe, and informed about the GC. The time flying in the canyon was amazing if we were the only people there.
tour_name: 33_71_Grand Canyon South Rim Signature Ground Tour with PJX_2025-03-04

review_text:
The folks at Westwind Air do it right. Top notch service. We were greeted with smiling professional people. Snacks and beverages all ready for us. Our pilot ( Doug) was fantastic. Skilled, thougtful, and informative. Even took pics for us and we had the plane to ourselves.
Once we landed at the South Rim our Hummer and guide were waiting for us. Jerry is a Navajo and knows the area he grew up in extensively.  He was also very patient as we travelled with two young ones. All the stops were awe inspiring and we were fed an excellent, personally made lunch right next to the canyon. 
I would personally recommend this means of seeing the Grand Canyon to be high on one's bucket list. Kudos to the Westwind Air team and thank you for a family memory we will cherish and never forget!
 Eric Riediger
tour_name: 33_71_Grand Canyon South Rim Signature Ground Tour with PJX_2025-03-04

review_title: Best Tour Ever! Don’t Miss It!
review_text:
A fantastic trip with views you will never get to see from the ground. Then when you do land at Grand Canyon Village and take the Humvee part of the tour you will be blown away again by the sheer beauty of the Grand Canyon and some of the lookout points where you stop.
One of the best parts of our trip was our pilot - Carla. She has 30 years experience flying, and a great sense of humor. The tour is pre-narrated which you hear through your headphones in the plane, but Carla cuts in from time to time to add some great tidbits. She also has a great sense of humor! WELL WORTH THE PRICE OF THE TICKET!
tour_name: 33_71_Grand Canyon South Rim Signature Ground Tour with PJX_2025-03-04

review_title: Spectacular Trip with stunning views of the Grand Canyon, as well as several other places along the way!
review_text: This was a phenomenal experience! Well worth the cost of the trip. When we checked in we were met by extremely friendly staff. Carla, our pilot, was absolutely terrific. Very informative and also a very experienced pilot who made us all feel very comfortable. The flight went over Sedona, and Flagstaff and then there it was - the Grand Canyon! Pictures will never do it justice. You have to see it with your own eyes to appreciate the raw beauty. After touring the Grand Canyon from the air we landed at the Grand Canyon airport and went into the Grand Canyon National Park through the East entrance. We were taken to several lookout points on the South Rim, and experienced several more moments of wow from the ground. The tour guide we had on the ground gave us some interesting facts along the way. We highly recommend this trip for anyone not wishing to take a helicopter, or not wishing to drive 4 hours one way, from the Scottsdale area. We reported at 7:30 am, took off at 8, and returned around 2:30 pm. The return flight took a more western route back so there were more places to see. Definitely one of those bucket list items!
tour_name: 33_71_Grand Canyon South Rim Signature Ground Tour with PJX_2025-03-04

review_text:

I recommend that anyone visiting the Phoenix area spend a day taking this trip, even if they have been to the Canyon before, as I was on a one week rafting trip. 
The views of Sedona are amazing also.

review_title: Westwind Signature Grand Canyon Tour Exceeds Expectations
review_text:
This was my anniversary gift for my wife and it exceeded every expectation. The staff, pilots and our tour guide on the ground (different company by Westwind coordinates for you) were all outstanding. 

The plane seats 10 (I think). You need to be comfortable in a small plane with minor turbulence. The narration was very informative. 

Make sure you order lunch beforehand. If you book through your hotel (like we did) make sure you tell them to order you lunch. Bring a lot of water. It isn’t a very physical tour but you will want to stay hydrated. If you go in the spring or fall don’t forget that it is noticeably cooler up at the Grand Canyon than it is in Phoenix. Caden our pilot and Gigi our tour guide did an outstanding job!

review_text: This was an experience and way more than imagined!  Such an easy day because Westwind Tours took care of everything. Easy flights thanks to Caden and Carla and an amazing experience with the Hummer Tour with Buckwild Tours and Tre Soule.  The right amount of time and expert commentary as we went to amazing overviews of the canyon with guidance of where we were in comparison to other areas of the canyon. The flyover of the canyon was simply spectacular.  We highly recommend this tour and Westwind alongside Buckwild Hummer Tours!!

review_text: My family of three had an amazing experience with Captain Carla on the Signature Tour! My son and I were very nervous, but Captain Carla was so kind and competent. review_title: Awe inspiring way to experience The Grand Canyon!
review_text:
We had a once in a lifetime experience on Westwind's Signature Grand Canyon South and Ground Tour. I have a terrible fear of flying but I was desperate to be able to do this tour. If not today, when, was part of my logic. 

My husband and I arrived at Sedona Airport and watched our plane arrive and I was happy to see the size of the plane. The captain came through the gate, introduced herself  and asked if I was her guest! I told her I was and I was scared Sh**less:) Captain Carla was so kind and professional and assured me I would have a wonderful day and would be able to enjoy the flight. I was comforted by her kindness and assurances. 

Upon boarding the plane with 8 wide comfortable seats for guests I knew if I sat and buckled up I would not turn back:) I did it!

The flight to the Grand Canyon was extremely calm and I found the guide information and soothing background music of the headset extremely calming! Captain Carla interupped the voice tour multiple times to point out various additional points of initerest! Captain even checked on how I was doing mid flight which was so kind!

The first view of the Grand Canyon in the distance is awesome! As we flew around the Canyon, the pictures and videos do not do it justice of the awe you feel viewing it from above! I am so very thankful I was able to complete the tour and feel I was able to do it because of Captain Carla. The Carla Touch:)

We were transferred to BuckWild Hummer Tour for the ground portion. I will review them on their page as well. Tom was our driver, the hummer was exceptionally comfortable, we traveled with a total of 12 guests. The rows of seats are stepped so the view from each row was great, not effected at all by persons in front of you! Great set up. Tom our driver was professional, and  extremely knowledgable of all things related to The Grand Canyon park. It was a pleasure to get to know him during our 3 hour tour. He obviously loves his job and shares that feeling with his guests!

Our return flight to Sedona was a not as calm as outgoing  but Captain Carla tried to find some smoother air but it was impossible. Even with the slight occassional bumps the flight was awesome, the views are just indescribable!

Thank you to Lindsey for arranging our reservation with kindness, and professionalism. Thank you to Captain Carla, without her calming, professionalism and expertise I don't know if I could have done it. Thank you to Tom for sharing his knowledge with us and his insights to The  Grand Canyon as well as his wife who arranged all the lunches for our gourp! 

I wish I could give this tour higher than a 5*!
tour_name: 33_71_Grand Canyon South Rim Signature Ground Tour with PJX_2025-03-04

review_text:
This was one of the best days of my life. I can’t say enough good things about this tour and the staff at Westwind. We would have skipped this tour after my mom broke her arm the day before and the doctor told us she had to keep ice on her arm the entire day. I called and talked to Destiny who told me they could help us still make this day happen by bringing a cooler of ice along in the plane. Then Max, our pilot, helped us strategize how to get her on the plane (which was challenging given her age and injury) and made sure we had a very smooth flight both ways even with all the wind on our return flight. Both Destiny and Max went out of their ways to make sure my mom and I got to the Grand Canyon so she could check that off her bucket list. It was a wonderful experience in every way. I highly recommend having Max as your pilot. He is extremely experienced, safe, kind, and helpful. I will be bringing my sons and my husband back to do this tour in the future. 
Side notes: the lunch was very simple but good. 
Hummer tour was a great way to see the canyon highlights. There was not a lot of time at each spot. It was kind of a quick way to get a once over tour. I’m glad I did it before coming with my kids to hike it.

review_text:
This was a once in a lifetime, amazing, beautiful experience. 

- the flight out of Scottsdale through the river valleys is beautiful.
- you get to see both north and south side of Grand Canyon. It’s as jaw dropping as everyone says!
- the service, staff is wonderful and super knowledgeable and accommodating.
- one note, (and this isn’t their fault), is the flight can get bumpy in a small plane, especially on the return (it gets windier as the day goes on). Our 2 younger children (6,4) both made use of the air sickness bags.

A few tips/feedback items:
- the hummer tour is really nice and interesting, but really loud. Couldn’t hear almost anything the driver was saying while driving.
- the lunch didn’t accommodate for allergies (the bread is multi grain, not sure what nuts and seeds) also no veggie option.
- overall seemed a bit rushed. Would love to stay in one place and just take it all in for like an hour or so, but most stops were like 15-30
Min.

review_text:
I hate to write a review in the midst of COVID for a small business, but unfortunately due to our experience I’m writing this in hopes that nobody else has the same experience. We booked a PRIVATE Grand Canyon tour. We spoke with someone over the phone on multiple occasions who explained it would be just us with the possibility of one other person (although they explained that wouldn’t be likely). When it came time for our flight, the pilot + others arrived 20 minutes late, not wearing masks and informed us there would a total of 10 of us on the tour. As you can imagine, we were pretty surprised given that wasn’t what we signed up or paid for. The pilot explained something happened with scheduling and to call Lindsey. We did so and she provided pretty awful customer service. In short she explained yes there were gonna be 10 people and if we didn’t want to go we didn’t have to but either way we weren’t getting a refund or rescheduled. 

Throughout the flight NOBODY including the guests or pilot wore a mask. Nobody suggested or asked for this to be done. This is unlawful in the state of Arizona and county of Sedona. Not only is this against the law, but put customers in great risk. I cannot believe they would allow this and be okay with this. 

I am so disappointed in the service. Highly recommend researching other options prior to booking with this company. I am sure there are other much better companies that would provide honest and safe services.
tour_name: 33_71_Grand Canyon South Rim Signature Ground Tour with PJX_2025-03-04

review_title: Misleading, overpriced and poor customer service
review_text:
My wife and I decided to spend Valentine’s Day in Sedona and booked an air tour of the Grand Canyon. I booked it over the phone with Lindsey whom seems to be the manager. She lead us to believe it would be just us on the plane and when we arrived we were grouped with 7 other passengers, many of which thought they were going alone as well.

When we reached out thinking there was confusion we were told they got booked on her day off. Keep in mind this is in the midst of Covid so flying on a plane with 7 strangers who NONE INCLUDING THE PILOT WERE WEARING MASKS is not ideal.

We were told we did not purchase the cancellation insurance which was never presented when I booked over the phone and we could only get 50% refunded.

So we paid $600+ to fly with a group of strangers who did not comply with any covid protocol.

The overall tour is alright although not nearly close to worth of the cost.

Extremely dissatisfied.

The trip also includes are few hours of driving between photo locations on the south rim. Got to see some of the great views and I really enjoyed our guide Jerry.

review_title: Flight from Hell over the Grand Canyon...
review_text:
I'm conflicted as to how to review Westwind as we had two different planes for our group of 16 family and friends (ages ranging from 25 - 60) who had completely different experiences on our flight over the Grand Canyon from Page Airport. My flight (which I'll refer to as plane 1), which was supposedly the NON-executive plane, had an awesome pilot named Mark, who communicated with us throughout the flight, pointing out where to look (and there's a lot you won't see/notice if you're not directed) and forewarning us of turbulence. His humor and constant, clear communication made a semi-scary extremely turbulent flight as comfortable as it could possibly be. A few of us threw up from the bumpiness, but we felt very safe in Mark's hands and were all happy with our experience.

Our other plane of 8 people however (plane 2), had an entirely different experience. This plane we were told was the "executive plane" - nicer seats, etc. However, unlike plane 1 which had secure shoulder straps and individual seats for each person, this plane only had waist belts, the last row of the plane was a bench, and their seats were not in a fixed position and so were aggressively sliding back and forth throughout the flight. This constant movement, paired with turbulence, resulted in everyone slamming their heads into the ceiling multiple times (confirmed by every passenger) and 5 of the 8 passengers vomiting throughout the flight (so much vomit that my mom (the guest of honor) had to clean out the plane after they landed while the pilot stood by watching).  One person got so sick they had to go to the hospital afterwards and 3 others were ill for the rest of the day and unable to participate in the activities we had planned. Of the 8 people on plane 2, only TWO people actually saw the Grand Canyon because the others were so sick, or scared that they couldn't look. 

To make matters worse, their captain, unlike ours, did not speak once throughout the entire flight. Not only did this mean they weren't getting told where to look (which you think would be a no-brainer for a tour like this), but it also made everyone incredibly nervous as they continued to hit worse and worse turbulence. Honestly, when I initially heard how terrible a time they had, I thought they were being dramatic, but when I heard THESE details (seats sliding around, heads slamming into the ceiling, and a captain who did not speak the entire 1.5 hour flight) and they were confirmed by every single passenger, I was furious. 

Upon landing, as the majority of our group was throwing up outside the airport, the captains told us that that was the worst conditions they've ever flown through and that they were cancelling the rest of the flights for that day. While I'm of course glad that I (and the lucky others on plane 1 were able to see the Grand Canyon, I'm also a little skeptical of Westwind's judgment to 1) fly us in such bad conditions and 2) fly half of our group on a plane that seems incredibly unsafe and with a pilot who apparently doesn't have basic communication skills.  That's not just "bad conditions," that is bad judgement and completely unacceptable and infuriating when lifes are on the line. And finally, it's really disappointing that a once in a lifetime experience was turned into a harrowing, sickening flight from hell.

review_title: Unforgettable Experience with an Exceptional Pilot
review_text: We had an incredible experience with Alaska Float Plane Company! Our pilot, Jason, was absolutely fantastic. He was knowledgeable, helpful, and clearly passionate about what he does. The tour he gave us was nothing short of amazing. Jason pointed out key landmarks, shared fascinating insights, and made sure we were comfortable throughout the flight. The views were breathtaking, and Jason’s expert piloting made the whole experience unforgettable. I highly recommend Alaska Float Plane Company and would definitely fly with them again!

The outfit was really laid-back, which was nice. They accommodated our schedule and shifted us around a couple times. It worked out. The pilot was nice, but not super-informative. Seemed like a new business. This was a wildlife viewing tour, but honestly, it’s really hard to see animals that far away at those speeds. Also, the pilot didn’t seem to know much about the patterns or movement of animals, although he had several trips before us. I would think he would have a better idea of where they are to spot them.
Beautiful views of the Talkeetna mountains and it was clear enough to see the Denali.
We had a beautiful day to fly out to Caribou Lodge.  Jason and his staff were great.  i recommend both Alaska Air and a visit to Caribou Lodge.
Our one hour float plane trip to Denali was an amazing experience. Jason, our pilot did an amazing job as the clouds broke to get us the best views. Wonderful trip!

We booked the 30 minute ride but decided to go on the longer one once there. Worth. Every. Penny!  You fly so close to the Moose Teeth mountain that you feel like you can touch it. Incredible views of Denali and other peaks. I’ve done lots of things over the years and don’t know how this one could be topped.

review_title: Wonderful customer service despite the disappointing weather
review_text:
Our family booked the 30 minute seaplane adventure as part of our cruisetour.  Due to rainy weather, we were not able to take the tour but I wanted to acknowledge the wonderful customer service provided.  The company reached out the day before to let us know the weather did not look good for our flight but they would keep us informed.  We had booked a morning flight.  They contacted us in the morning to confirm we would have to cancel but offered to postpone to another day.  Unfortunately we were leaving the next day to go to Denali so they offered to wait until afternoon and see if the weather cleared.  We were contacted again at noon time and weather was still not cooperating so they had to cancel.  Our payment was refunded in full with no headaches.  Although we obviously would have preferred to be able to take the seaplane flight, weather is the determining factor on adventures like these.  I was so grateful for the wonderful customer service.  I felt the company cared and really tried to find a way for us to enjoy our excursion.  
For anyone planning an Alaskan adventure, feel comfortable booking with this company knowing they try there best to fulfill their commitment and when they are not able to, you will be refunded quickly and without any hassles.
Jason, the pilot, was fabulous.  Super smooth flight, & the glacier views were unbelievable.  The guided hike was wonderful.  We spotted a black bear.  Lunch was delicious!

review_title: Awesome Hike but NOT at Denali National Park
review_text: This is a bit of a mixed experience for us.  The floatplane ride to Caribou lodge was wonderful - the guided hike from Caribou Lodge at Boomerang Lake was really awesome - Zack showed us amazing tundra plant life - his family at Caribou lodge opened our eyes with their lifestyle and their hospitality.  So full points to them for our delightful hiking experience.  But due to cloudy conditions  the flight service to view Denali National Park from the air was canceled (the float plane service reimbursed us very promptly for the missed portion of the trip).  Here's my issue - the blurb states "Experience Denali National Park from the air and at ground level"  The clouds made us miss the "from the air portion" and we accept with gratitude what Mother Nature grants us, but there was *never* a chance of experiencing Denali NP "at ground level."  So by following this ad, we missed out on visiting Denali National Park on a once in a lifetime trip to Alaska, and that was disappointing indeed.  The ad needs to be clear that there is NEVER a chance to experience Denali National Park *at ground level* with this service. If the weather permits, you see DNP from the air, but you never get to DNP at ground level, no matter what.

We used Alaska Bush to get to a remote camp. When we were due to leave, the area was under heavy fog and unflyable. The pilot went out of his way to stay on alert in case a small window cleared (which it finally did), and was able to get us out with only a few hours' delay. Solid bush pilot -- definitely recommend.

My son wanted to experience a float plane and a remote lake landing.  Alaska Bush Float Plane Service was just down the road from Talkeetna Alaskan Lodge.  They did not require any funds up front and were super flexible and accommodating the day of our ride.  Due to heavy cloud cover early on a Thursday, they suggested a ride out later that day or early the next day.  They also accommodated a late change from 2 in our party to the full family of 4 going to experience this.  I am so glad all 4 of us got to experience it together and the later start time afforded us better mountain conditions.  The remote lake landing was super cool.  It is a nice size lake up in the mountains with a small cabin that is on state land.  The actual lake landings were fun to experience and the take offs.  Of course riding up the through the mountains was a sight to see.  Also cool to see the little town of Talkeetna from the air.  Highly recommend.

review_title: If the clouds are to low for Denali, reserve a floatplane ride.
review_text: Truly and amazing flight! We loved it, The tundra landscape with its 100 shades of green. We were looking for wildlife but did not see any but it was still well worth it. The 30min was a perfect time for us.
Our pilot was wonderful. He was very professional, and knowledgeable about Alaska. The flight gave us breathtaking views.

review_title: A Amazing experience a must do.
review_text: The flight was amazing, over glaciers, between mountain peck’s. The wilderness hike was not in Denali National Park but we still had amazing views of Denali.

review_title: Beautiful Flight to Denali National Park  in a Floatplane
review_text: Taking off in a float plane has been something I have always wanted to do, and it was amazing flight to and around Denali. A MOST DO!

We had a great time sightseeing with Jason. He is a super competent pilot which made us all feel at ease. 
Unfortunately, we didn’t see any wildlife but that was beyond anyone’s control. Next time.
This was on my must do list and it was amazing.  They flew us to Caribou Lodge and we unloaded there.  Then returned to pick us up 3 days later.  Loved the experience.

I wanted my grandson to experience a float plane ride while we traveled in Alaska.  Alaska Bush Air arranged a 30-minute ride with another couple.  My grandson had a nice ride and the cost was reasonable.  Highly recommend.

We used their services to get in and out of caribou lodge as well as to fly up to Denali. The pilots were professional and friendly. The office staff was accommodating and easy to work with. The scenery of the destinations they flew us to was unforgettable. Highly recommend their services!!
Had a great trip back to Talkeetna from Caribou Lodge Alaska. The staff there were so friendly and helpful. The flight was very smooth and the pilot was friendly.

review_title: Fly is fishing trip was the highlight of our Alaska trip
review_text: We booked Jason and our guide Tim for a full fly-in fishing day at a high mountain lake.  The experience was one of a kind.  We were the first humans to touch this lake for at least 6 months. Just gorgeous scenery.  As for fishing, our group caught at least 400 fish during the day.  This is the stuff you dream off.  The staff was professional and well organized.  Tim was a great and patient guide at the lake.  Highly recommended

It was a nice calm day, like no wind at all so it went smoothly.  We did a shorter flight.  Our favorite thing was seeing a Momma black bear with her 2 baby cubs.  Only bad thing was we were higher than I wish we were.  No way to get a good picture.  Our poor son (10) was doing ok then we turned in the sky and it turned his tummy.  You never know what its like til you try it.  It was cool, just wish they flew lower so you could see the black bears better.  Nice pilot very friendly & kept us informed what areas we were seeing and how close we were back to try and calm our son down.  The area is beautiful, we were just driving by and turned around to take pictures and they said they had flights open and it seemed affordable, we paid $440 for the 4 of us for 30min I think........can't remember for sure.  It was a cool life experience. Our son will never do it again but our 13yr old daughter loved it.  They have a nice public restroom that is not a portapotty which is hard to come by as you will learn the longer you visit lol

review_title: Best part of my 1 month tour!
review_text: What an amazing excursion! The captain and employee was sweet/ friendly. Everything was clean and professional. Once we were in the air... it was magic. That is the best way to see the interior and the mountain. Our pilot was great. I told him that I would like to see a bear, he showed me 5 of them. I can't wait to do that again.

Absolutely breathtaking views of the scenery, Denali, and the surrounding mountains.  We love the lake landing, just us and a few swans, and since this was our first float plane landing, the takeoffs and landings were really cool.  Booking was a breeze, everyone was very pleasant to deal with, and the experience and views were unparalleled!  Great time!

review_title: Great views - not good for wildlife viewing!
review_text:
They sold me on flying low and being able to see lots of wildlife close up . . . 
We flew at about 500 - 650 feet above the grounds so any wildlife you see is minimum  600 fret away, more like 1000 feet away, basically not worth it for a wildlife viewing . . . 
People are very nice but not totally honest - over sold it big time  !
We saw 3 black bears or 3 black dots moving and Caribou. Again, it was very hard to see and we had an amazing clear sunny day. . . 
Better to go look at the Glaciers and the mountains which are 600 Feet away - looks like you are right there as they are massive  . . .

We took a Denali mountain tour and then were flown into a remote cabin.   Our pilots did a great job and were extremely professional.   The front desk help was very nice and helped us decide the best tour for us to take.   Would definitely use again

We own a small cabin on a remote (no roads) lake near Talkeetna.  Over the past 10 years we have used Alaska Floatplane Service to fly back and forth from our cabin 2 - 3 times a year.  We have gotten to know Jason and Elbert over that time and we appreciate them and their service very much.  They are safe, reliable, knowledgable, and friendly.  Flying with them is always a high point of our trips out there and we recommend Alaska Floatplane without hesitation. Excellent service!!

What an experience to see Alaska from the sky. Seeing glaciers and the back country from the air is amazing. I would definitely recommend Alaska Bush when you're in Talkeetna. It's something you'll remember the rest of your life. Don't forget your camera!

The  flight was more then anticipated, you don't experience Alaska unless you fly and they are a great company to fly with. Saw lots of wildlife, glaciers and much more.  Everyone was great to work with, you can tell when someone truly enjoys what they do.
There location is beautiful, like out of a picture book.

We saw that the weather was going to be clear for the several days that we were in Talkeetna (late August '16) and booked a flight-seeing tour with this company.  The weather was probably as good as could be hoped for-- blue skies, few clouds, little to no wind, temperatures in the upper 60's.  We departed at noon, with the sun overhead. My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed the experience.  The flight path took us thru some of the most spectacular vistas that we've ever seen.  We opted for the lake landing, and were not disappointed.  The aircraft had a smooth landing, and when it came to a stop the aircraft was pointed directly at Mt. Denali.  The pilot asked us if we wanted to get out of the aircraft and stand on the landing pontoons (which I did).  Took some video and photos from this location.  The pilot took a photo of me standing on the pontoon and holding onto the wing strut, with Denali in the background.  My wife and I both agree that this was the highlight of our Alaska trip.  The cost was a bit pricey, but we thought it was worth it (most likely a once in a lifetime experience).

While the flight was safe and we did see what was expected, we were really disappointed overall. When I asked to use the bathroom they explained their bathroom was out of service and I could use the woods behind the fuel truck filling up - um, okay. Next they strongly suggested I leave a tip on the $840 price tag - we opted to see how the flight went first. 
I understand a father and son own the plane company and we were sent out with the son as our pilot. While he was clean cut and appeared to be a good pilot he lacked personality. The entire flight was mostly spent in silence, he didn't provide any info about the area, history and briefly described what we saw. When I inquired about the history of Talkeenta he suggested I visit the history museum in town. 
Our friends flew on K2 Avaition next door and said they had a wonderful time and their pilot was super friendly and provided a ton of information. My suggestion would be to see if you can book with them first. We definitely wouldn't recommend this company if you're looking for more than just a plane ride. Oh, and we certainly didn't leave a tip.

Unfortunately, this was the one cloudy and overcast day on our trip to Denali.  Would have been so much better on a clear day!  That being said, it wasn't the fault of this company and they did a good job and we had a positive experience.  It is very easy to find - just turn right onto the road to Talkeetna, and it will soon be on your right side.  We selected Alaska Bush Float Plane over K2 or Talkeetna Air Taxi because we wanted to go in a float plane - taking off and landing on the water was a new experience for us!  We did the basic tour and thought that was just the right amount of time.  We did get to see the top of Denali when we got above the clouds, and were able to see glaciers.  Like others have said - the pilot (Jason, I think?) is not overly chatty.  We found him to be nice and pleasant - not rude at all - just a quite guy.  If you want a lot of personality in your pilot and lots of narration, this one probably isn't for you.  I weighed that against the float plane option and just went into it knowing what to expect.   He was very professional and we felt completely safe.

We booked a Denali flight and requested a pick-up from Talkeetna Alaskan Lodge in top Aug 2016. On that day, the flight has to be cancelled for bad weather but they still arrived the hotel in 5 minutes before pick-up time and asked us in person whether do we want to change the flight or we can just cancel it. We chose to cancel it for free. No deposit was required before which is different from other companies. Excellent service!

I had taken a family summer trip for a half hour seaplane with lake landing. The pilot had a terrible and rude attitude and was not willing to provide any conversation. He seemed to be more of the lets get it over with attitude. In addition he also seemed to be a bit racist (we are Indians) and insulting to our family.

 The tour was supposed to provide sighting of wildlife but we did not spot any. The lake landing was an added 65$ per person, but it was overcast and the pilot simply landed in a different lake than the conventional one without asking us first. The new lake hardly had any beach and the pilot did not provide us enough support to actually get to the beach from the plane without getting wet. 

In all the experience was very underwhelming with simply a take off and landing sequence. I would recommend trying some other activity since this isn't something you should rather do in Alaska. There are several other services that provide much more exciting experiences for a moderate higher cost.

We really enjoyed our flight with Alaska Bush Float plane service. Although Denali was clouded in, the pilot still took us as close as he could. He narrated the whole time and pointed out neat glaciers and lots of wildlife. His driving was smooth and we didn't feel motion sick at all! The tour lasted a full hour which was plenty of time to see the beautiful valley. We were bummed that we couldn't see Denali but the trip was well worth our time and money!

What a beautiful excursion, Elbert and Jason are real professionals. If you want an experience of a lifetime, don't pass up this opportunity to see the magnificent Alaskan mountain range and Denali, up close.

review_title: Scared to Death but WORTH IT!
review_text: I am a terrible flier. As in PETRIFIED.  Somehow, though, this clean, well kept little dock caught my eye as my husband and I drove into Talkeetna for one overnight. Despite my fear, I thought about it all night and when we pulled out the following afternoon, there it was, calling to me.  I would like to say that I got over my fear but I didn't... I pushed through and boarded the tiniest little float plane with my husband, another frightened lady, and the pilot who was in his early 20's and had been flying solo since he was 16.  I remained petrified and with my eyes closed for the first 10 minutes, he did offer to turn back (maybe he heard me hyperventilating?) but I stuck it out.  Wildlife didn't cooperate, no bears or eagles to be seen, but the 30 minute flight was handled safely and professionally, with beautiful scenery and a blue sky day.  I had faith in the pilot, who really was awesome, and he landed us down on the lake smooth as glass. I think I can cross this off my bucket list and am glad I had this experience with such a great organization...

The same group of us went on another Alaskan fly in hunt in 2015. We posted the review in August 2014 titled "Top Notch Service". If I could figure out how to remove the review from 2014 and drop this rating to "0" stars, I would. The lady's that work for them are still wonderful (Molly and another lady that I don't know her name). The two pilots I cannot say the same about. They are safe and competent at what they do, but they made it clear that they did not appreciate our business and tried to increase the agreed upon rate, once we were back at base camp (doubled it) and no extra flying was involved. If you want good service and honesty, then go with another flight service. There are several in the area to choose from. We will be flying with someone else in 2016.

Lieu d'activité de transport de voyageur et de fret par hydravion, accueil chaleur et lieux de décollage exception, la situation de Fish Lake permet de pouvoir accéder rapidement au différent Lac et rivière descendant des différents monts de la face Sud du Denali national park "Park du Mont McKinley".

review_title: Smooth Operators with a clear safety first mindset
review_text:
Great welcome in a superbly maintained office area. From the moment you come in to the landing you feel that safety is taken to  the upmost level. 

Everyone and every belonging are carefully weighed. We were a group of 11 going to Schneider lake and the rides were very smooth. 

We wish the pilot would have been more talkative and narrated the trip but we were not so lucky.  He was extremely quiet.  That made us focus on taking pictures and we got some great pictures.

Would definitely use this service again.  Highly recommended.

We ((4) 30-something adults) signed up for the Explore Denali 1.2, but were unable to do it due to weather. We ended up doing the 1.0 exploration plus the additional Glacier Lake Landing. 

I am giving this a 4 because it was a nice smooth ride for the most part and it was a really beautiful ride. 

However, we felt that the Glacier Lake Landing was a total up sell. We landed for 10minutes in what felt like a random area. There was no area to sit and enjoy for a bit or information provided about the area. I suggest totally skipping this.
 
Additionally, the operator was not overly friendly. He did not share information about the area or fun facts unless we asked him, and in some instances he would just ignore us.

This is our third time flying with this operation.  They are quality all the way.  Weighed everyone, figured out how to use two aircraft for our group of adults and children.  they own the aircraft and fly them like they own them.

Go to the mountain or wild life tours, both are amazing .  Love these guys and Lena.  Thank you guys.

review_title: Amazing Flight and Excellent Customer Service
review_text: We were driving to Talkeetna and saw the very nice dock area, well manicured and taken care of, and stopped by to look around.  We were able to book the one hour McKinley flight and had the most amazing flight.  Jason, the pilot, was very personable, knowledgeable and friendly, and the flight was the highlight of this trip to Denali.  Do not think twice, book your flight and enjoy some of the most beautiful scenery I have seen in my life.  Molly and Lena at the booking office were friendly and very nice.  The weather was mostly clear and the views of the mountain were fascinating.

We just finished our 1 hour float plane tour. We paid extra for a glacier lake landing and thought it was worth the extra cost. We had a cloudy day so Denali wasn't seen, but we were able to see moose, and many glaciers and of course lakes and rivers. This float plane is such an amazing experience,  to take off and land only on water surface. Our pilot was very good.

My daughter and I took the Wildlife flight along with 2 others in the plane.  The pilot was very informative without feeling like he needed to continually talk. We both appreciated that.  We did the remote lake landing as well.  It was a nice addition. We didn't see too many animals, some bears mostly, and attribute that to it being a little later in the afternoon and hotter than normal, so most animals may have been waiting out the heat.  All in all, a great experience.  We definitely recommend Alaska Bush Float Plane Service.

We stopped on our way out of Talkeetna AK.  The grounds, planes, houses all looked so beautiful and well kept we stopped more for a photo opp then to flightsee, we quickly changed our minds and decided to go for it. There were four of us we went for the 30 min. wildlife tour, which is priced right. They were very friendly and Jason our pilot did a wonderful job pointing out bears and other wild life as well as telling us about the area. It was one of the most awesome experiences we have had.

Molly, Elbert and Jason made the flight service of our Alaskan fly in hunt a wonderful experience, in and of itself! I'm from the southern part of the lower 48 and these folks at Alaska Bush Float Plane Service know good customer service, just like good ole southern hospitality!! From the very first phone call to Molly, my son commented that she was the only person he'd talked to that provided these types of services, that was willing to answer his questions and assist with a 1st time group of men going into the Alaskan bush to hunt caribou and bear. It was a successful trip to say the least and we are already planning another hunt in 2015. We will use their services again, without hesitation and recommend them 100%! Thanks again Molly, Elbert and Jason! You folks are awesome!!

We happened by this on the way to Talkeetna and pulled in. Due to the immaculate condition of the facilities and grounds, we decided on the spot to book a half hour wildlife viewing tour. The mountain was clouded over so that was not an option.
Molly was efficient and polite. It turned out that as there were only two of us we had to "charter" the plane as their minimum is three people per flight but it was reasonable so we did it.
Everything about the experience was excellent. There was never a moment that we did not feel 100% safe. We flew with owner Elwin who started out a bit taciturn but warmed up quickly and gave us a beautiful flight. He actually owns a cabin on a hilltop in the flight area and we flew over that! The landing was so smooth you literally couldn't tell when the plane had touched down on the water.
Could not recommend this company or the actual experience more highly.
Even if you don't use this company, take a flight from one of them. It is worth every penny.

Jason and Molly of AK Bush float plane were so accommodating to me and our family of four that it was truly one of the best experiences of our entire trip!!  We saw Mt. McKinley and the surrounding Talkeetna mountains, glaciers and wildlife.  I had researched other flight seeing trips and Jason was definitely the best choice for our family.  The weather was beautiful which was a bonus, making it a more fabulous flight.  I liked the fact that Jason was more than willing to change our plans if weather was not so great.  My children will never forget the best flight they had during their once in a lifetime trip to Alaska.  To make it even better, Jason even found me a local fly fishing expert that completed all of our family's fishing desires to include Fly Fishing for Rainbow trout.  That made for a full day in Talkeetna and was well worth the stop!!

We drove past Alaska Bush Plane on our way down to Talkeetna so came across them purely by chance as opposed to researching them first which is what we usually do but what a find they turned out to be! The weather was really changeable but we could be a bit flexible with our plans and Molly in the office was brilliant at keep us updated on the weather and what flight we could do. In the end, we did a 1 hour wildlife tour because it was too cloudy for Mount McKinley but the 1 hour was awesome despite the mountain staying hidden. Our pilot Jason was really knowledgable and an excellent spotter of wildlife! Black bears and a whole heap of moose on top of the mountains were the highlight. Great experience!

We called into the Alaska Bush Float plane office on the off chance that we could take a scenic flight, luck was with us because a pilot was on the spot and in no time we were up, up and away. It was such a magica experience , the colours of the foliage and the sighting of bears , plus Mt MacKinley looking majestic made our flight  extra special .
Another experience to cross of our bucket list.

Both my dad and I have experience flying single engine planes, and I can tell you that in every sense this was a spectacular tour.  Easily the highlight of the entire AK trip.  We opted for the longer tour of McKinley with the remote lake landing and loved every second of it.  Flying so close to base camp and getting such amazing views of Denali National Park was an unforgettable time. 

Jason was extremely knowledgeable and laid back, he didn't rattle on like an obnoxious tour guide, and I was most impressed by him encouraging us to reschedule our flight for later in the week when he suspected that the weather wouldn't provide the ideal experience.  

Subsequently, as a word of advice, book early on in your trip in case weather doesn't completely cooperate - then you can have some room to move things around if necessary.  

AK Bush Float Plane Service is family owned and operated, they clearly love what they do, and run a classy operation.  I wouldn't hesitate to go back and do it again.

My experience with Alaska Bush Float Plane Service was truly incredible!  Our pilot, Jason, took us deep into the Alaska Range, where we were able to view Mount McKinley, Mount Hunter, and Mount Foraker up close.  The mountains are truly majestic and awe-inspiring when viewed from the air - a once-in-a-lifetime experience!  I also loved seeing the glaciers and mountain lakes.  Although I was a bit apprehensive about flying in a small plane, Jason put me at ease with his flying expertise, friendly demeanor, and in-flight commentary on various points of interest along the way.  I would recommend Alaska Bush Float Plane Service to anyone who is seeking a truly unique flying experience!

The one hour flight to Mt. McKinley was truly an amazing adventure.  We also picked the perfect day - not a cloud in the sky.  It is amazing how different the mountains and glaciers look when flying between the mountain peaks.  It was also interesting to look at the flat terrain on the way to the mountains and see various remote cabins where the "bush" people live.  Our pilot, Jason, did a great job explaining the various points of interest along the way.  I must admit that the thought of flying in a small plane made me a little nervous, but once we were on our way I felt completely safe.  I would fly with Alaska Bush Floatplane again in a heartbeat and will be recommending it to others.

We booked our flight with Alaska Bush Float Plane Service months in advance but weren't sure what we wanted to see. Molly said not to worry, we could decide when we got there. Opted for a wildlife/nature flight rather than flying over Mt. mcKinley. Jason worked hard to spot moose, bears and sheep. He also gave us a very informative rundown on how Talkeetnans enjoy the Talkeetna mountains. He was also very patient with the questions from the kids.  We all enjoyed taking off from and landing on the water.

Wow talk about breath taking! Such an amazing experience and time we had with Jason. A true pro at navigating the mountains around Denali and being a subject matter expert on everything we asked! Group of 4 took the Mt McKinley tour with a water landing! Fantastic never forget type of adventure! Would love to go back and do it all over again! Don't forget your camera! Maybe even a GoPro Camera so you don't forget anything!

review_title: ¡Una de las mejores experiencias de la vida!
review_text: Esto es algo que no se pueden perder si están en Talkeetna. Jason, es el mejor piloto de Alaska! A pesar de tener un poco de miedo a las alturas, en ningún momento sentí temor de nada. Las vistas que se tienen desde arriba, son incomparables. Además de que tienes la opción de hacer preguntas durante el vuelo, en caso de que tengas alguna duda. La cabaña de la recepción es como de un cuento de hadas. Arlene, quien nos atendió antes y después del vuelo, fue muy amable. El lugar en sí es precioso, ¡me encantó! La próxima vez que esté en Alaska, no dudaré en regresar.

Best pilot  great plane ride .....saw some wild life...the staff  young lady from new jeresy was very helpful.
when we return we will fly the Talkeetna range again!

My cousin told us that the very best use of our money in Alaska would be on a scenic flight around Mt. McKinley. Even though they are expensive, she told us they are worth every penny. So, I went inside to check out K2 Aviation. There were so many options: the McKinley Experience, the McKinley Flyer, or as long as you're spending that much money, do you go all out for the Denali Grand Tour? And then should we add a glacier landing? There wasn't much of a discount for kids; they actually recommend having parents take turns and go one at a time while the other parent stays with the kids and plays on the playground. I didn't like that idea at all, and it was raining. And then I realized we had missed the first flight on the schedule and would have to wait for the next one, a few hours later in the afternoon. And if it was raining in Talkeetna, would we even be able to see Mt. McKinley? We drove away and started to leave Talkeetna. But then my husband spotted the float planes and decided we needed to stop and check them out. 

He has a thing for float planes (from watching Northern Exposure); he's also attracted to buildings with vegetation growing on the roof. The sign says Mt. McKinley Scenic, but the business is called The Alaska Bush Float Plane Service. 

My husband was sold with the idea of landing on a lake. And Molly, the woman who sets up the flights couldn't have been more accommodating. The planes only hold five passengers, but Molly quickly offered to babysit our youngest while the rest of us went on a flight. Perfect! (She told us kids under the age of five usually fell asleep anyway.) She went and talked to the pilot and came back with a reasonable discounted family price. I couldn't decide whether to take the Explore Denali 1.0 Tour or the Explore Denali 1.2 Tour. (The 1.2 Tour is about fifteen minutes longer, takes you over the Climber's Base Camp area, and offers a view of the West Buttress Route that is used by most climbers.) So Molly told me we could decide in the air. Perfect again! 

We flew over the Talkeetna airport, over some rivers, up and over the clouds, and then we were in the mountains. I could not believe the view! The glacier lakes were incredible. It looked like someone had dropped blue food coloring onto the snow. We flew right by the south face of Mt. McKinley. But without our pilot, we really wouldn't have been able to identify which one it was. All of the mountains were magnificent. And we were so close! 

It was probably ten minutes into our flight before I realized I had a two-way radio on my headset. Our three kids didn't know they had radios until the end of the flight; we didn't tell them because I didn't want them all trying to talk to the pilot at once. I had them raise their hands when they wanted to talk, and then I passed them my microphone. 

We should have prepped the kids with some information before the trip because they were full of curiosity. I tried to limit their questions to the pilot because I didn't want them to distract him. Jason, how deep is that snow? Jason, which one is Moose's Tooth? Jason, which one is a glacier?

Without an aerial tour, it is impossible to comprehended the staggering depth of the Alaska Range. There were so many things to see that it was hard to decide which direction to look. The view was surprisingly clear. (Mt. McKinley is so large that it creates its own localized weather.) We decided to fly over the Climber's Base Camp. We were also able to (barely) spot some climbers on the mountain.

The questions continued. Jason, how many people climb Mt. McKinley? (About 1200 per year; roughly half succeed.) Jason, how long does it take to climb Mt. McKinley? (About two or three weeks.) Jason, has anyone ever died trying to climb Mt. McKinley? (120. . . and counting. Four Japanese climbers died in an avalanche just one week after our visit.)

By the way, I just looked these answers up myself. I couldn't remember his responses because I was too busy trying to keep my girls quiet. Our pilot was nice, but he didn't seem accustomed  to endless questions from eight and nine-year-olds.

That is one thing they could have improved on. Also, they had my kids sit on life jackets to boost them up to be able to see out of the plane windows. Real booster seats would have been more comfortable. 

The views were breathtaking. It was another pinch-yourself-I-can't-believe-we-are-really-doing-this-moment. And then our landing on Fish Lake was fantastic. 

What an amazing experience! And how glad I am that we stopped to check out The Alaska Bush Float Plane Service. They are a small, family-owned business and were able to personalize the trip just for us. I'm pretty sure that was the most expensive "impulse purchase" I've ever made, but it was well worth the price.

We did a family trip into a great spot in the Talkeetnas. I had flown once before with Elbert for work and had felt really safe with him. That is really important to me, even more so when my kids are getting in the plane too. We had great flights in and out, relaxed, great info along the way, Elbert gave us great tips on the fishing (great grayling and lake trout fishing)  where were going, and ideas on other trips in the area for the future. I really like flying with a small service so I know beforehand who my pilot will be. Elbert and Jason have a great reputation and safety record, and we look forward doing more trips with them in the future.

There is no way to see Alaska as well as by air.  This was one of the highlights of our trip and we would recommend it to everyone.  This is a family owned business, maybe that is why the service was so nice.  Our pilot was awesome, he made sure to circle and let us all see from different angles.. The scenery was breathtaking and the flight was smooth and you could tell the pilot was excellent at his job.  We would recommend them to everyone.

We found a really nice fishing experiance in Talkeetna.Starting with Molly the office manager to the pilots and guides. All were friendly and accomodating. Yes we did catch many fish. We arrived on a full moon and and a front coming through. These two things combined with the guide's knowledge led to a wonderful fishing trip for my wife and I.The weather was challenging for the pilot,but he was smart and confident and overcome the winds on the lake.The office is located on a picturese Fish Lake just outside of Talkeetna. I would highly recoomend this compant to any interested in a float plane trip out of Talkeetna.

I enjoyed that Jason was a very relaxed and informative pilot.  We flew over the Talkeetna Mountains, the town of Talkeetna, and over Denali National Park and he provided information about what we were seeing along the way.  I felt great while in the plane, the flight was very smooth and we had great visability.  I became very emotional when viewing the snow covered mountains and I felt very close to God. I had tears of joy in my eyes and overall it was a great experience. I will do it again the next time I visit Alaska and I will choose this company for another great experience.

This was our second time flying with Jason. We took a family vacation last year to Alaska and we loved it so much that we came back this year. The one thing that we wanted to do again on this trip was fly with Alaska Bush Floatplane Service so we called them up and we scheduled another flight. The office staff was very friendly and making the reservation was simple. Our first flight with them last year was an hour tour of Mt. McKinley so this time we scheduled a one and a half hour tour which included Denali National park and the Talkeetna Mountains. We were able to see everything from glaciers to caribou and moose! We came a little later in the season last year so we were very impressed with all the flowers that were still in bloom at their office. The float plane base is very beautiful so make sure to bring your camera with a large card and plenty of battery. We highly recommend this business. Jason, thank you for this beautiful experience!
Beautiful viewing & wonderful personnel!  Had a fabulous time.  Be sure and bring your camera for some beautiful memories!  My 7 yr old son had a blast, as did my husband and I.

This was a brilliant afternoon. The setting is picturesque and a great deal of thought and work has gone into making it a pleasant experience overall. The on-site facilities are first rate and the staff are friendly and accomodating. The landscaping of the reception area is beautiful and makes the whole experience a pleasure.

We booked it a few days before and called to confirm the reservation.
In June 2023 we spent 164 euros each for the flight + 14 euros each for fuel surcharge, it's a lot but the excursion is worth it all.
Having arrived at the airport half an hour early, there was a terrible wind blowing and we were asked if we still wanted to fly as there would have been strong turbulence and if we preferred to cancel they would refund the cost of the tickets.
We asked if we would fly safely, in which case we would have preferred to fly now we were there and we couldn't postpone it as it was an itinerant trip.
It shook so much that you risked crashing your camera into the window, every now and then several driving alarms began to sound and several warning lights came on.
The flight lasts about 40 minutes and was quite challenging and towards the end we had become quiet and a tried...
But I guarantee it was worth it, if I could go back I would do it again without a doubt and I highly recommend it.
From above you have the perception of the earth's crust and the crack that passes through it, it is a completely different image from the one you get when seeing the grand canyon from the various panoramic points on the edge.
I don't want to diminish the beauty of the grand canyon from the views, but in my opinion the flight completes the experience, absolutely worth the money spent.
The plane is honestly dated and the headphone supports and the regulators for the audio guide are now falling to pieces, a little more maintenance could be done on the internal instruments, but I realize that it will always be in flight and the time available is not much, but given the expense one would expect better maintained instruments.
Our flight had 8 seats and we all sat at the window.

review_text:
We had originally thought about doing a helicopter trip of the Canyon, but several people who'd visited suggested the airplane tour was better. We decided to go for it and weren't disappointed.

We managed to book for 11am the following day which suited our schedule perfectly and arrived at their smart reception area at 10:20 as requested.

We were met by the pilot at 10:45 who showed us out to the waiting Cessna Grand Caravan. This is a perfect airplane for this type of trip since it is high-wing and affords an excellent view. Each of the comfortable seats was equipped with good-quality headsets so one could listen to the commentary throughout. The airplane was not too noisy, and it was still possible to hold a conversation with someone on the opposite side of the airplane (after removing the headset of course).

We were soon in the air and flying over the rim of the canyon. It takes a circular clockwise route and covers around 100 miles of the north and south sides of the canyon with excellent views including the Colorado river.

We returned for a very smooth landing around 40 minutes later.

Overall, this was an excellent experience at a reasonable price with plenty of opportunities to take great photos and videos. I would highly recommend it.

One minor gripe - we were asked to pay a $15 per person fuel surcharge at reception and I consider it would be better to incorporate this into the published price.

review_title: This is the way to tour the Grand Canyon
review_text:
Trip Reserved: Grand Canyon Deluxe with Hummer
Our Group: 2 families (4 adults, 2 teenage boys)

On a recent trip to Las Vegas, we wanted the views of the South Rim without the 9 hour round trip drive from Vegas.  After some searching I found this tour. It's not inexpensive, so we considered it for a while before booking.

I had been to the grand canyon twice. My husband and son never had. My husband's initial take was to simply do the 2.5 hour drive from Vegas to the West Rim, proclaiming "rocks are rocks." 

In the end, knowing that the south rim is much more spectacular, we ended up booking this trip. It's a full day, that started with pick up at our hotel, and transfer to the Boulder City airport west of LV. From there we boarded an 8 passenger plane  for a flight over the Hoover Dam, and part of the Grand Canyon before landing at the Grand Canyon Airport. The flight was narrated. Not by the pilot... there were headphones available and a pre-recorded narration in a few languages. It wasn't fantastic, but I appreciated that there was some narration to what we were seeing, and I did learn from it.

Once we landed, we transferred to open-air hummers for a several hour tour through several different vantage points in Grand Canyon National Park. Our tour guide was fantastic. His love of the GC is evident and comes through in his delivery.  We had a boxed lunch (turkey sandwich, apple, chips, cookie, water). He had some fun suggestions for photos. He was very willing to play the role of photographer and take photos. And he was so knowledgeable and just had so much enjoyment about sharing "his Grand Canyon with us"

We returned via the same plane and were dropped off back at our hotel.

I don't know what could possibly make this anything other than a 5-star experience. If you have the means to take this tour, it is a wonderful way to experience one of the Natural Wonders of the World.

PS. Two teens on the trip. Pretty sure the only time they used their phones for the entire day was to take photos!  You know that an experience that can accomplish that is a special one!

review_text:
This was not a bad experience - but it was a little pricey for what you get.

The hotel pick up was fine. The driver was late. I called - repeatedly. Nobody answered. I was worried that we had somehow miscommunicated. Fortunately he was just running late. But it's a little disheartening to discover that there is nobody there if a problem develops. 

They pick you up super early and drive you to the little airport. We sat there waiting for about 90 minutes before we boarded the plane. That's a lot of wasted time. 

The flight was fine. They have twin engine Otters (those are the ones in the pictures) and single engine Cessnas. The Otters hold about 20 and the Cessnas hold about 10 so which plane you get on depends on how many passengers are flying. I suspect that some of the flight delays might be related to consolidating trips to fill the planes.

The flight itself was fine. It felt safe enough and fun if you haven't been on a small plane before. But you wear a headset and listen to an audio recording that sounds like it was made in the 1960s. Ours started late so it wasn't synced with what we were flying over. Then it glitched and started playing the safety briefing again. Then the pilot caught on and restarted the audio - from the start - so we were now way out of sync. Then he tried to zoom forward and it was a little better. But you get the idea - it's pretty canned.

The views of the grand canyon are good. You are much lower than any commercial flight so you see the ground much better but don't get a high level perspective. It's a big loop out and back trip. Most of the people on our flight were dozing off. 

Bottom line, it wasn't bad, but it wasn't something I would do again.
