Amazing. Flying on the seaplane was awesome. The pilot was awesome and very informative. Loved it!!! We flew from Seattle to Friday Harbor.
Great customer service, reliable and safety minded operation.  Absolutely the best way to get to the San Juan’s.  50 minute flight compared to a 5 hour drive and ferry ride.  A very easy choice!

We had a wonderful experience with Friday Harbor Seaplane!  The check-in was easy and the flight was on time.  We flew from Renton to Friday Harbor in San Juan Island.  The flight was smooth and the pilot briefed us on the sights we passed by.  The plane was clean.  I would highly recommend them!

review_title: A great way to get to the San Juans!
review_text: I flew on a float plane from Seattle to Roche harbor.  This is a great way to get to the San Juan’s.  There is free parking and everyone is so nice.  The flight was perfect and the views were spectacular!  I highly recommend!

We loved everything about this! The seaplane company coordinated seamlessly with the whale watching tour company. It was easy to get to the Renton airport via Uber from downtown Seattle. Our pilot, Jim, was phenomenal! The hanger and plane were immaculate. This was an incredible experience!

What an amazing adventure! We booked the tour of the island, and it was a great time! Our pilot, Shane, was very knowledgeable and interesting. We would recommend this to anyone, but especially if you’ve never flown in a sea plane.

review_title: The only way to travel to the islands
review_text: What an amazing experience.  Great views and excellent service.  All of us southenders can avoid the Seattle traffic as you leave from Renton.  Tryley the only way to travel to the islands.

Flying with Northwest Seaplanes is always a treat and makes for a very manageable commute from Oregon all the way to Roche Harbor.  3 hour drive, leave the car in the secure parking lot and 50 minutes later you are on the dock on San Juan Island!  The scenery on the way up is unrivaled with beautiful views of Seattle and Puget Sound.  Curious what you are seeing below?  The pilots double as tour guides and are always willing to share what they know.
Best float plane service to Friday Harbor.  Great company with friendly staff and knowledgeable pilots.  Planes are well maintained.
Friday Harbor Sea Planes are always the highlight of my trip whether coming or going from the San Juan Islands! Love this company! The shuttle to SeaTac is so convenient as well.
Everyone that worked there was very pleasant and attentive they made the trip fun. We enloyed flying with Shane

review_title: Round trip flight to Friday Harbor
review_text: Friday Harbor Seaplanes was a great experience. We flew from Renton to Friday Harbor and back. Our two pilots were very knowledgeable about the area and answered any questions that we had during the flight. It essentially doubled as a tour of the area as well as a mode of transportation. Plane and hanger were very clean and they were on time.
Friday Harbor Air is AWESOME from pilot to office great experience always professional and our exclusive air transport!

I scheduled a solo trip with my dog to scatter my mother’s ashes over the Puget Sound as she requested.  I was coming from out of town.  We were delayed one day due to weather conditions.  Shane and Michelle were very amiable and kept open communication the whole time, thoroughly explaining the safety concerns and updating me.  We finally had an opening the next morning.  Shane was very respectful when we did the scattering.  I'm incredibly satisifed with the final results.  Highly recommend NW Seaplanes for whatever flying plans one may have.
It was a first for us but definitely want be our last! Jim, our pilot, was very professional and knowledgeable. Friday Harbor Seaplanes are top-notch and they seem to run a first class operation.
This was absolutely incredible, highly recommend! The sights were beautiful and it was 100% worth it
The condition of the aircraft is impeccable and the pilot was as professional as they come. This is an absolute must when in the Seattle area.

We have flown with several different services to Roche Harbor on San Juan Island
and we prefer Friday Harbor Seaplanes : the team are all very personable, helpful,
accomodative to our needs - its been a great comfort to work with them - from extra time flying over city highlights, to circling whales when they show up on our route, to scheduling times - we appreciate their personal, family approach  Todd

I traveled solo to the San Juan islands. Since this was my first visit to Friday harbor I was hesitant to take a bus and ferry to get there. I booked Friday Harbor Seaplanes-It was the HIGHLIGHT of my trip! They have Scheduled service throughout the islands and they also offer shuttle pick up at SeaTac making your transition to your seaplane seamless! I was greeted at the airport at 4 PM for my 5PM flight. It was a short 20 minute drive to Renton. You could check their website for scheduled service.  If you’re planning a trip and researching transportation options do not hesitate to enjoy this adventure! Special thanks to Captain Jim and Michelle for the ROCK STAR treatment!

Absolutely the best flight ever.

Our pilot was amazing putting all passengers at ease explaining the history of the islands and tell jokes along the way.

We were even able to view a naval submarine departing Puget Sound.

My wife and I enjoyed many activities on the island for our 20th anniversary, but the Seaplane flight was the highlight by far!  Our pilot was friendly and asked where we'd like to fly.  The flight was beautiful and the process was so easy.  We and our two daughters had the whole plane to ourselves which made the experience today personal.

This is a must during a trip to the Seattle area.  The operation and staff is excellent and very professional.  You cannot beat the view and it's amazing what you see just a few short minutes north of the city.  The San Juan Islands are magical and I wish we could have spent several days there (and you can).

New favorite way to travel to the San Juan Islands! Loved getting to see the islands from the air, and the convenience couldn't be beat. Just a quick 45-minute flight from Renton to Friday Harbor. 

Thanks so much for the beautiful flight! Definitely recommending this to friends and family :)

My son and I did a day roundtrip from Seattle to Friday Harbor on San Juan Island.  The experience was perfect from start to finish.  Great customer service and we were fortunate to have the plane to ourselves (probably due to COVID-19).  Our pilot was very good and helped point out some interesting places while in the sky.  Definately recommend it.

review_title: First time visit to the San Juan Islands
review_text: This was our first visit to San Juan Islands. Taking a seaplane was an awesome way to see Seattle and the islands. Our Captain was great pointing out all the different sites below. The entire staff was excellent!

We did a roundtrip day trip from Seattle to SJI. The team was awesome. We had great service at checkin and during both flights. Our family of 5 had a fantastic experience. The weather was great on the flight up and we had great views. A little overcast coming back but still very scenic. Each flight was right on time and very smooth. This was definitely one of the highlights of our trip. We would definitely do this again.
Shane flew three of us up to Roche Harbor for a three day visit. Everything was perfect and safe in all respects. The Renton base is excellent and the staff is great. Will fly again!

review_title: Customized Seaplane Pick-up off beach property on Lopez Island.
review_text:
Had an amazing customized experience! Shane was able to pick us up right off our beach property on Lopez Island. It was a lot of fun getting to see the sea plane land close to us. They were able to tie off to a buoy in Mud bay and pick us up from our Kayaks! It was an amazing escape!

Highly Recommend.

Flew to and back from Friday Harbor.  What a cool experience.  They give ya a tour as you go over the islands.  We were fortunate enough to see a Trident sub on the way back.  Very cool.  Sadly no whales.  Great flight - smoothest take off and landing we've ever experienced.  The fly low enough for great views.  They even went out of their way to mail back my hat!  They picked us up at Sea-Tac and took us back.  Well worth the little bit extra.  Definitely a great part of our trip out to Friday Harbor.

This was beyond fun and an extremely convenient way to get to the San Juan Islands. When you consider it as both transportation and an activity the price was quite reasonable for a truly memorable experience. Take off and landing were smoother then on land. We HIGHLY recommend using this service. Great Company!

review_title: Best way to get to the islands without a car
review_text: We found out that getting to the San Juan Islands without a car is not easy!  Transportation from SeaTac to the ferry at Anacortes is iffy - shuttle bus does not coordinate with ferry schedule.  We had a time crunch, so the Friday Harbor Seaplane was our best option and great fun.  Picked us up at SeaTac and brought us to their seaplane base in Renton for the 50 min. flight to Friday Harbor.  Made a brief stop at Roche Harbor first, so we got a tour of the entire San Juan Island.  Great service if you can afford a few extra dollars.
So much fun and the pilot was very informative.  The only way to travel to the Islands!  Love landing on the water and pulling up to the dock like a boat to our destination
We really enjoyed this trip and would recommend it to everyone . I thought that it might be a bit shaky but it was smooth and a fantastic ride.

Wanted to give a huge shout out to Charles at friday harbor seaplanes I was one of his last flights of the season and he was awesome had me laughing the whole time it was really a treat for my first experience in a seaplane plus I was the only passenger and got to sit co-pilot my return flight was great too 
So thank you very much when I return next year I will flying with you guys again

What an amazing experience. Totally worth the money. Safe flight and experienced pilot. Views were amazing from Friday Harbor to Seattle. Door to door excellent service. Even saw him back whales on our flight over. One of my top 10 experiences! ITS A MUST DO!
Loved it. Gorgeous scenery and felt totally safe.  Best to have a “plan B” as plane ( due to weather) was unable to pick us up for our return a few days later. Still, would do it again.

I always wanted to take a seaplane flight and I finally, at age 70, got my wish, even getting to sit in the co-pilot's seat. It was a beautiful day and the pilot, Charles, did a great job explaining what to expect and what we were seeing. Take-off and landing were smooth. The trip took about 50 minutes, but the land and sea ferry trip would have taken about 4 hours. Well worth the money!

What a great experience for us on our 25th anniversary!  Dave was our pilot and provided us a great tour from Seattle to the San Juan Islands and back.  Spent 1 1/2 hours in Friday Harbor on a sunny day, had lunch and walked around in a great little town.  Dave saw a couple pods of Orcas and circled back around to give us a great view of these Orca pods....it was an awesome experience and felt very customized.  Would definitely pursue this experience again.....great time!

review_title: Round trip flight to friday harbor.
review_text: Amazing flight! Pilot pointed out attractions. Very accommodating when I asked to change my flight from 930am to 230pm. I was the only one on the shuttle to Sea-Tac, where I was going to catch a shuttle to my hotel, they volunteered to just drive me to my hotel as it was nearby, a huge time saver and blessing. Definitely will fly with them again!!

My husband and I had a most amazing time on our seaplane ride! It actually was a last minute booking since the Clipper was sold out going to Friday Harbor and we already had hotel reservations on San Juan Island. Even though we were initially nervous because it was our first time and the plane is small the takeoff and landing were incredibly smooth! I would highly recommend booking with Friday Harbor Seaplanes. They were on time, friendly and very professional. We can’t wait to bring our kids to experience a seaplane ride! Thanks for such a wonderful first time experience!

review_title: Absolutely the easiest way to get to Roche Harbor and the San Juan's.
review_text: We have a cabin in the Roche Harbor area and have been going up multiple times a year.  During those years we have used every means of transport to get back and forth, boats, ferries, Wheeled planes and seaplanes.  By far the easiest is through Friday Harbor Sea Planes.  They are very reliable and outstanding customer service.

For the last two years, my dog and I (along with friends and family) have flown both regular scheduled flights and  chartered flights from Renton to/from Gulf Islands, Desolation Sound and Friday Harbor. This is an amazing company, and everyone you deal with from customer service for reservations/flight information to the pilots you fly with are 100% professional, friendly & fun and make your seaplane trip a truly pleasurable and super safe experience! The planes are meticulously maintained and love that they have headsets so that you can communicate with the pilot and other passengers (not to mention cut down on the engine noise)  and if requested they have a ramp to make boarding easier for your dog :). This week there were tourists on my flight back from Friday Harbor and Shane our pilot made a point of showing different sights and giving the history on quite a few places of interest along the way. Its the extra touches that makes Northwest Seaplanes my go to Seaplane company, and my number one referral for anyone needing a Seaplane flight. See you all next summer if not before, and Piper sends a big WOOF of approval too!

Great.   Super easy on reserving.  On time.  Very professional.   Great equipment and safety awareness.   Very nice in each interaction.   Made me feel I was with a first class operation.  Renton airport is very easy for SeaTac.
I’ve used their service several times from Renton to Roche Harbor and they have always exceeded my expectations. Highly recommend.
Both pilots (Andrew and Charles) were very friendly, helpful and competent which made the flight enjoyable!  The weather couldn't have been better!   Lets do it again next weekend!
Well done in every aspect from pickup at SEATAC to return. Pilots in both directions were knowledgeable friendly and just a pleasure to be with. A perfect transport to a truly amazing place.

review_title: Roche Harbor to Renton was a blast! Best way home from a family reunion on San Juan.
review_text: I have flown in small planes before, but never a seaplane.  The experience was as great as I had hoped. Taking off from the water was exhilarating. Terrific low altitude views of the islands and the vast Salish Sea.  Flight was super smooth. Almost too smooth; I’d hope for a little bit of small plane motion but only got that as we banked to make our approach into Renton. The young woman shuttle driver to SeaTac was personable, fun and professional. En route to SeaTac I asked her about flights to Alderbrook next summer. I am hooked!

The people at Western Prince Whale & Wildlife Tours connected us with Friday Harbor Seaplanes.  I had always been curious about flying in a seaplane, and the experience did not disappoint.  Our pilot, Andrew, was amazing.  He is very knowledgeable and  made it a fun and relaxing experience. All of the staff at Friday Harbor were friendly and professional. The plane ride up to the San Juan lslands is a smooth and beautiful ride -- a great trip for people of any age.  The ages in my family ranged from 9 to 70.

A short 20 minute flight around the island was wonderful. The whole flight was conducted at 600 feet so was quite easy to see the scenery. And to top it off we actually saw a pod of Orca. Excellent value

review_title: Most fun way to get from Seattle to Friday Harbor and back
review_text: My boat is located in the Islands for the summer and often receive guests for short stays and tours.  This is absolutely the best way to get from SeaTac to Friday Harbor and back...convenient to the airport, seaplane dock right at the Marina (steps from the boats), scenic ride over the Puget Sound with narrative description from the pilot; and best of all its usually in a deHavilland Beaver -- the best all around bush plane ever made (IHO).

We were visiting the area and wanted to stay at Friday Harbor for a few days but didn't want to take the ferry. I found Friday Harbor Seaplanes and what a gem they turned out to be! Fantastic experience - now I'm looking for seaplane trips to take where I live!

I have never flown in such a small plane, especially one that takes off from the water. This was such a cool experience and gave such a different view of the islands! The pilot was also super knowledgeable in pointing out specifics of the islands and giving the history of the island as well! This is something I will always remember and would definitely do again, if we revisit the islands!

My husband and I flew from Seattle to Friday Harbor. We shared a plane with a family of four with two 11ish year olds. We all had headsets and were able to communicate with each other throughout the flight. Our pilot 'Andrew' was very knowledgeable and really fun. The entire flight was smooth and we had a great time. We would definitely use Friday Harbor Seaplanes again.

review_title: Seattle to Friday Harbor and back....
review_text: Two years in a row I've had nothing but outstanding service. The employee's are all very kind, professional and 'fun'.  My pilot 'Charles' this year was outstanding and very knowledgeable of the area.  Plus the shuttle service they provide from Sea-Tac to their facility and back is GREAT!  Brandon will pick you up in a very nice van. The wait is minimal!!  Nothing is wrong with a ferry but time is important to me. A beautiful 50 minute plane ride over the Sound to Friday Harbor is the only way I'll ever travel--year after year.  Friday Harbor Sea Planes is the only way to go!!  Michael .

review_title: Can't imagine a better way to make this trip
review_text: Friday Harbor and San Juan Island are beautiful....but the ride with Friday Harbor Seaplanes will probably be what I remember most:)
I booked some clients with Friday Harbor Seaplanes to and from Seattle. Customer service was great and my clients said everything went well - a real highlight of their trip!
I have a tendency toward motion sickness. The ride was so smooth and awesome there was not a single queasy moment.  Pilot pointed out interesting things.  Best ride EVER.

Picked up on time at Sea-Tac by their shuttle. Matter of fact, our plane arrived late so he waited just for us. Just a short drive to the seaplane facility. Everyone for the flight was there so we left almost immediately. Nice, pretty, uneventful flight to Friday Harbor. Nothing could have been improved upon. WAY BETTER than taking the ferry to get to the island.
A great way to get back to the city while enjoying the views and luckily for us spotting a whale or two!

review_title: Seaplane from Seattle to Roche Harbor and back
review_text: We had a great experience with Friday Harbor Seaplanes. The pilots and staff were very friendly, informative and helpful. The flight was fun and we saved a lot of time.
Flew into work at floating lodge. Very professional and friendly. Very safety conscious.  Pilot informed us on emergency procedure

This was my first seaplane ride.  Im not fond of small planes, but it was actually a very enjoyable experience.  The pilot was great.  The scenery from above was fabulous.  And it was a far better option for me than the ferry.  Would absolutely travel with this company again on my next trip!
The flight was calm and view was beautiful.   The pilot gave us information about what we were seeing.  Free parking in a lot that is fenced in at night.

review_title: Great way to see the Puget Sound and beyond
review_text:
We chose to fly to an escape to Vancouver island and were impressed by the efficiency, hospitality and safety of this airline. We loved the views on the outbound trip - in fact they did a flyover of northern Mercer Island so that a passenger could photograph his house from the air. The views were exceptional and the landings smooth as silk.  In the face of worsening weather on the return they demonstrated great judgement about getting us back home by aborting the initial route, turning around and taking a safer route with better visibility. 
Comfort was also a factor. I have been on other seaplanes on which we were squeezed against the wall of the plane because so many people were on one bench style seat. On these de haviland planes we each had our own window seat - and no aisle mates. How civilized is that!
Flew Renton to Roche Harbor. Same pilot both trips. Timely, safe and extremely friendly. He made the trip great!  Thank you!
Great customer service, friendly staff, and more personalized. Highly recommend this company. Great experience!

Love to fly with Northwest Seaplane- they link us from remote Northern Vancouver Island right into Seattle for flights out of Seatac to our home in Sacramento.  Flight times vary depending on weather, routing, etc and Northwest Seaplanes works to keep us informed so we can adjust plans accordingly.  There is nothing like going from a pristine remote location right into the hussle and bustle of Seattle.  Thank you Northwest Seaplane

This was a fantastic experience.  The customer service was excellent and timely.   The high skill level of the pilots were evident.   Couldn't have been happier with this experience. We even got to see orcas from the plane!

Our family flew with Friday Harbor Seaplanes from Renton/Seattle to and from San Juan Island. The planes are beautifully maintained and the pilots we had were top notch.  This was my first seaplane flight and I was amazed by the smooth takeoff/landing (which makes sense because water is a bit more forgiving upon landing than a runway) as well as the smooth ride. 

My kids LOVED the experience; they were initially pretty nervous about flying in such a small plane but ended up completely loving the entire experience (including their use of the headsets over a radio channel).  My wife also was a big fan.  We all enjoyed the gorgeous views as we flew through the San Juan archipelago. 

Shane, the owner, is clearly passionate about what he does. We had a flight delay coming out of Chicago and really appreciated that Shane did what he could to help us get to San Juan Island given our late arrival.

We took this scenic flight from Friday Harbor.  The plane was great, the pilot was great, the views were great....except from the center seat where my wife wound up.  Her opinion is she should not have been charged the full fare for a seat where the scenic wonders were mostly unavailable.  Perhaps they should not sell that seat, or charge much less for it. Otherwise, I would highly recommend this little adventure.

review_title: Fishing Trip 2019 to Barkley Sound Eagle Nook Resort
review_text:
I have been to the same resort 8 years in a row and we have flew into Vancouver then flew in from there to the resort by float plane and we have had issues in the past with planes, times,or just not willing to fly in if the weather/cloud ceilings were low. So I decided to fly from Las Vegas into Seattle and float plane into BC from there. It was the best experience of all my trips, as Shane's staff greeted my party of 10 at the airport with a very nice van for the short ride to the Sea Port. The check in was very easy and the waiting room was decorated very nice with all kinds of memorabilia. The plane ride there was great and only took 1:55 minutes with stopping once in BC to check into customs and continue on to Eagle Nook Resort. The pilot was very good at his job and extremely nice. The return flight was great and it only took 1:15 Minutes to get back to Seattle. Overall I would highly suggest Northwest Seaplanes to all of my friends, customers, and clients for their travel to BC areas for Future fishing trips or sight seeing in Seattle.

Thanks Shane and your staff.
very worthwhile and smooth seaplane flight with a friendly and knowledgeable pilot, awesome views. most definitely recommend it.

review_title: Rewarding Way to go from Seattle to Friday Harbor
review_text: We saved driving 2 hours to Anacortes plus another hour ferry ride to go from Seattle to Friday Harbor.  Since we went only for the day, the seaplane was the best, most scenic and convenient way to go.  The pilot was gracious, fun and informative as we flew over what is, to us, a familiar landscape from Seattle to the San Juans. There is free parking at the seaplane terminal and a gracious waiting room.  Taking off from the base of Lake Washington provides arial views of waterfront estates that are rather impressive.

Loved my ride with Northwest Seaplanes! 

Check-in was easy, hangar staff was friendly and promptly answered any questions I had regarding the planes. Drinks along with merchandise items were available for purchase. Would love it if they carried tank tops for the hot summer months!

The seaplane base was easy to find and get to, as you don’t have to fight the fugly, steaming mess of traffic around Lake Union. 

The flight was absolutely gorgeous, smooth and afforded amazing views. The planes are smaller, and definitely loud, but you get a headset that allows you to both listen to the pilot talk to the tower and talk to the pilot. 

The landing in Friday Harbor is a treat and the entire town is fully walkable. I spent the day exploring the island with a moped (thanks Susie’s). Return was a similar, hassle-free affair. If and when I travel to the San Juans again, it’ll only be with NWS.
Another amazing time flying with you thank you so much for the professional service and attention to every detail.

It was a girlfriends weekend and we were visiting a friend who has a beautiful home on Shaw Island. We flew from San Jose to Seattle. In Seattle we boarded the sea plane which would take us to Friday Harbor and from Friday Harbor we would take a ferry to Shaw island. Everything was a wonderful experience but the most fun was the sea plane. The pilots were fabulous informative and the view was amazing. It was really a wonderful experience. I would highly recommend it to anyone

review_title: Breathtaking views, very nice staff, highlight of vacation!
review_text: I was overjoyed by this seaplane experience!  Breathtaking views, some of the prettiest scenery I have ever seen.  Our pilot, Shane, was very engaging and informative.  The landings were amazing, I didn't feel a thing...we glided very smoothly onto the water.  An experience I will never forget and very much look forward to enjoying again on my next trip to the northwest!

We had a worderful 3+ hour flight to Port McNeill two Saturdays ago.  Check in was easy; pilot friendly (although he would not allow my daughter to join him in the cockpit due to weight and balance -- too bad).  Neverthess the flight, with two take offhand landings were exciting and amazing on a very clear day.  This is the best way to get to some remote parts of BC withoiut the hassle of ferries and cars.  There is a 25 lb limit on luggage which caused some stress and forcing me to leave some things I need behind.

review_title: Best Way to Travel to San Juan Island
review_text: We flew from Seattle/Renton to Friday Harbor, San Juan Island, WA for a bike riding trip.  This is the best way to see Seattle skyline and all the islands & harbors.  The view was awesome; the staff were great - very helpful and accommodating.  We also traveled between islands using Washington State Ferries which was very convenient (and free for bikers!).

My husband and I used to fly our own plane so being back in the cockpit was a thrill. The trip to Friday Harbor from Renton Harbor is spectacular. Seeing the Olympic Peninsular mountains and the Cascade mountains  
 from the air provides a chance to understand the relationship between the two. I even saw Mt Ranier on the return trip to Seattle.

review_title: First time on a seaplane - great experience!
review_text: From start to finish this was a very professional experience.  The seaplane was a time saver for getting from Seattle area to Friday Harbor - less than an hour.  I was happy that headphones were provided as the plane was noisy but to be expected.  Both the take off and landing were not scary at all and a very soft landing at Friday Harbor.  I would highly recommend this experience.

review_title: Seaplane Charter to San Juan Islands
review_text: Part of our family vacation this year was an overnight trip to San Juan Islands, and what better way to get there and back than a seaplane!  This was awesome.  The flight is about 45 minutes and offers the best view in town of downtown Seattle, the Olympics, Mt Baker, and lots of other beautiful areas on the way up and back.  There was an error made in our reservation that had the wrong return date, which we didn't realize until they called us to see why we didn't show up.  Their office worked it out with no hassle to get us on a flight back the next day the way we wanted.  Absolutely worthwhile to travel this way.

I had a great experience with Friday Harbor Seaplanes. 
We arrived for our first flight 3hrs early and, without being asked, offered to move our flight up as soon as they were ready.  The captain of the flight was also very nice and professional.  It was a very comfortable and positive environment.  
On our departure flight, there was a lot of fog and many of the people around us waiting for other company flights were cancelled.  Friday Harbor Seaplanes was able to get to us after a short delay of waiting for the fog to clear and we were able to get our flight. I was very lucky to have chosen Friday Harbor over Kenmore air or else I would have missed my upcoming seatac flight.  
The captain on that flight was also very great. He was very experienced and kind.

We recently took a seaplane to and from Seattle Renton to Friday Harbor and it was one of the highlights of a trip to visit the San Juan Islands.  Everything about their operation is professional, courteous, and friendly.  Cannot recommend this highly enough.

review_title: Sure beats driving in traffic and ferry lines!
review_text: Needed to maximize my time in San Juan with family. It sure beats driving and waiting in ferry lines. also, only 15 minutes from my work.,so I didn't have to drive into Seattle to catch a seaplane! The south Lake Washington location is easy to get to.

review_title: Fantastic trip from Seattle to Friday Harbor
review_text:
Honestly, although we absolutely loved Friday Harbor, the trip to and from Seattle ended up being one of the highlights of our trip! The experience and the views are amazing, and we enjoyed every second of it!

I am thoroughly spoiled by the service and the flight itself, and now only want to travel by seaplane ;)

On the trip back to Seattle, we took advantage of their shuttle service and were dropped off at SEA-TAC 20 minutes after landing. 

Highly recommended!
This was our first float plane trip. We flew in to Roche Harbor for our 35th wedding anniversary. It was fantastic. We had the best time.
I fly to San Juan’s and BC frequently. I prefer NW to the others. Courteous, professional, punctual.

review_title: Best way to get to Roche
review_text: We only had two days to spend in Roche Harbor with family and didn’t want to spend the whole day driving and on a ferry. I’m so glad we did the sea plane. Staff are friendly and professional. I felt safe the whole time. Highly recommend !  We will be traveling this way from now on !

review_title: Great way to go to the San Juan islands!
review_text:
The views are spectacular,  The planes are safe and the pilots and all personnel were very friendly.  They even took my little luggage from plane to "airport".  The airport is spotless and a lovely spot to wait for the flight.  Did I mention free parking in gated area? 
It was perfect.
Easy flight , nice pilots, great views, good value wonderful smooth take off and landing I highly recommend this group

Flew to Friday Harbor from Renton. Checkin process was very smooth, flight was stunning and it was so m fun taking off and landing in the water. The plane was roomier than my commercial flight into SEA. Pilot pointed out lots of great history on the way. Plane was immaculately maintained and built. I wish I could travel this way everywhere.

Friday Harbor seaplanes was an exceptional way to travel into Friday Harbor.  They were friendly, helpful and made the whole experience great.  Getting to FH can be stressful and they made it feel like it was a bonus experience to See the San Juan Islands from such a beautiful view.  I will definitely be using them again next time I visit the island

Northwest Seaplanes was awesome! They flew us directly to Sund's Lodge on Malcolm Is. B.C. and dropped us off right at the dock.  We had a spectacular flight as even saw Killer whales as our pilot dipped a wing so we could get a better view.  We had a fantastic time fishing at Sund's Lodge and then got picked-up right at our dock.  I recommend Northwest Seaplanes for all destinations in the Salish Sea!

I booked a flight with Friday Harbor Seaplanes from San Juan Island to Seattle, I was excited for the adventure & thought a flight on a seaplane would be a fun way to end my trip to the San Juan Islands, it turned out to be 1 of the highlights of my trip! Hope to fly with FHS again 1 day!

We flew Friday Harbor Seaplanes from Friday Harbor to Seattle.  It was an amazing experience.  From the people in the office, the pilot to the shuttle driver!  Super friendly, helpful and courteous.  We originally were to fly round trip, but due to smoke the first flight was cancelled.  They helped us find the Belair shuttle so we could get to the Anacortes Ferry.  I would take sea plane over the ferry any day!!! Thank you Friday Harbor Seaplanes for an amazing experience!

review_title: Flight from Seattle to Friday Harbor.
review_text: Flawless service, prompt pickup at SeaTac early arrival. Who needs the unreliability of WSF when this service is available!

We flew on Friday Harbor Seaplanes from Renton (Seattle) to San Juan Island. Oh, the views were amazing! The flight was smooth, the arrangements were beyond smooth and the pilot was super-informative. Smooth flight and soft landing. I flew with 2 kids (9 and 14). They loved it also. I highly recommend these folks! -Chris

review_title: Twenty Minute Tour of Friday Harbor
review_text: This is definitely something worth doing.  We had a great time and our pilot not only showed us interesting data points about the various islands we were viewing but circled around some orcas he spotted from the air.  We had seen the orcas the day before from our whale watching water boat tour, but it was a kick to see them from the air.

When my Clipper boat ride from Friday Harbor to Seattle was canceled, I researched seaplane options to get me back to Seattle early enough to catch my flight out of SEATAC. Booking a ride with Friday Harbor Seaplanes online was very easy, and received confirmations and updates via email. The ride itself was SO COOL. Totally worth doing a tour or at least one leg of the journey to the San Juan islands. It's a truly unique vantage point and experience to take off and land in the water. The pilot was great. This company also offers very convenient van shuttle to/from SEATAC airport and Renton, which I happily took advantage of. I'm a happy customer, and recommend this team for your seaplane adventure!

We had enjoyable flights both directions, however, beware that smoke from forest fires up North or fog can delay your flights (especially in the a.m.)  We missed our SWA flight due to the latter, as we were delayed 4 hours on the return flight.

Took a noon flight to Friday harbor. Great flight great views!!  Smooth ride.  Friday harbor was lovely.  Quaint shops and restaurants. Took an afternoon flight back.  Also great flight great views and friendly pilots. 
The weather was cloudy and the flight times were changed but we were notified several times.  Terrific customer service.  Really wonderful way to spend a day and see the islands.
Our family, including two young adults loved our flight today. Friendly, nice, fun plane, great pilot! Highly recommend!

review_title: Great travel experience despite the forest fire smoke
review_text: The seaplane flight from Friday Harbor to Renton was the perfect way to cap off a great weekend and friend's wedding. Despite the smoky conditions the flight was beautiful and the vintage plane was very cool.  Our pilot was personable yet professional and clearly very experienced.  We then ook their very clean practically brand new shuttle van to SeaTac.  The whole process was super smooth.  These guys do it right!
Had a great time! Cool vintage plane! Perfect amount of time and narration. Oren was a clever guide. Highly recommend. Our teenager loved it.

review_title: Took the seaplane drom San Juan Island to the main land .
review_text:
Our flight was pleasant, even though I am usually afraid of flying- I was not scared at all. Our pilot was a gentleman who seemed like he really knew what he was doing.

We had to make 2 stops to pick up 2 more people. thus we got back to the mainland ( renton ) a bit later than scheduled, which we didnt mind at all as we were headed to Seatac after and we had over 3 hours of wait time.

Overal loved it and would do it again , I would choose this method of travel vs the ferry that took forever.

We took the plane from Renton to Friday Harbour and back. Originally, this was booked as a means to the island, but it ended up being one of the best parts of our trip. The pilot was very experienced and knowledgeable about the area. The views were breathtaking. I highly recommend!!

Este é um passeio imperdível, vale a pena fazer o voo completo, são 25min saindo de Renton até o Friday Harbor, com direito aos sobrevoos da cidade de Seattle, Friday Harbor é um lugar lindo, vc terá 90min para conhecer o lugar, antes da volta de mais 25min. Verifique a condição climática, dias com Sol são a melhor opção.

review_title: Great Way To Get To Friday Harbor
review_text: I've been taking the ferry from Anacortes to SJI for years. This year my friend and I decided to try a sea plane for the first time. While I love the ferry, this is such a great way to get to the islands- less travel time, convenient, beautiful, and a new view point. I've now flown with them twice and both pilots were excellent, friendly, and pointed out interesting landmarks on the way. I highly recommend giving this company a try if you are wanting to get from Seattle to the Islands.

We took Friday Harbor Seaplanes to and from Renton/San Juan Island. The flight was on time and the pilots seemed knowledgeable. Scenery was fantastic. My only complaint is that both pilots (to SJI and back) were looking at their personal cell phones multiple times during the flight. This was a bit disconcerting. The route may be routine for the pilots but as a passenger I think they could refrain from cell use for a flight that is less than an hour. I would have given a ‘5’ if not for cell phone use.

review_title: Flight to and from San Juan Islands with Friday Harbor Seaplanes
review_text: My family of four used this as the option to the long and challenging car and ferry ride to Friday Harbor. The planes took off and landed in the water; very cook experience for my teens. The trip was quite fantastic; only 50 minutes but with breathtaking views over Seattle and San Juan Islands. Experienced and friendly pilots. Recommend!

Flew from Friday Harbor to Seattle with our family of four. Very pleasant people to work with all the way through the experience. Smooth flight, great pilot/guide, fabulous low altitude views all the way. Absolutely worth it.

review_title: Seaplane Trip to the Hakai Lodge in central British Colombia
review_text:
We used Northwest Seaplanes for a rather large family trip to the Hakai Lodge along the Central British Columbia Coast. They were able to handle our group of 29 with absolute professionalism. They used 1 Otter and 3 Beaver seaplanes all at the same time to make the 400 mile trip. Shane runs a crew of pilots and airport employees that were absolute professionals and a joy to be around. Upon our return they had a special area set up with a group of young men who packaged our halibut and salmon fillets for our commercial airplane flight home. I cannot express how well trained, enthusiastic and informative the entire staff was from top to bottom.
They fly to many locations around Puget Sound, the San Juan Islands and areas up to Alaska.
Northwest Seaplanes can handle 1 person to large groups. They come with my highest recommendation.

The whole seaplane experience was great from Check-In to Check-out. Very nice staff, excellent and very professional pilot.
The airplane is very nice, clean and maintained to a very high standard.
Great day out.
Thank you to all of you.

review_title: Best way to get from Seattle to Friday Harbor!
review_text: Took a sea plane to and from the San Juan Islands (Friday Harbor) to Seattle and this trip didn't disappoint. It's a smooth, 50 min flight with beautiful scenery out every window. The pilot, Mark, was friendly and professional.  What a wonderful way to get back to Seattle.
The ride over to BC Canada was wonderful and scenic. Service was wonderful and the pilots were professionals.

review_title: Port McNeill to Seattle direct - who knew!!!
review_text: Gorgeous flight with a friendly, professional crew.  Got the opportunity to see close up the various northern coves that are now on our 'boating bucket list'. And we enjoyed our stay in Seattle and will do this trip again for sure.  Only improvement would be landing at Lake Union, but so thankful this scheduled flight exists - keep it growing!

review_title: Worth the price, and then some!
review_text: Took a sea plane to and from the San Juan Islands (Friday Harbor) to do some whale watching, and this trip didn't disappoint. It's a smooth, quick flight with some beautiful scenery out every window. My pilot, Brad, was low-key, friendly, and professional. I had questions; he had answers. He even showed us Bill Gates's house on the way back. If you book the whale watching tour, you get a discounted price, but you don't have to. Take a flight, see the islands or Friday Harbor and come back later in the day. A great day trip that was worth the price, and then some!

We flew round trip from Renton to San Juan Island.  Our pilots were experienced pros, very friendly and knowledgeable.  Views were stunning of course.  Such a memorable way to start and end my trip to this beautiful part of the world.

What a beautiful way to get the San Juan Islands! Great airplane, great pilot, great scenery and on top of that you get to take off and land in water! If you need to get to SEATAC they even have a shuttle. Thank you for a great trip and we will use Friday Harbor Seaplanes the next time we are headed to the San Juan Island.

review_title: Seaplane flight R/T to  Friday Harbor
review_text:
Excellent Adventure! We chose Friday Harbor Seaplanes for round trip flights during a five day visit to Friday Harbor. Top to bottom excellent experience with this company. Great communication during booking and subsequent phone calls, timely pickup and return service to SeaTac Airport, friendly ground staff, and first rate pilots. Loved flying in the vintage De Havilland seaplanes! Flight altitudes allows the pilot to easily maneuver airplane to view sights. Headphones provided to two-way communication. 

Things to be aware of for this flight: the seaplane dock at Friday Harbor Port is quite a walk from town (1/2 mile +/-), to our hotel at Bird Rock, and you must haul your own luggage. I am glad we heeded the advice to pack softside duffles with shoulder straps (and the correct weight: 30 LB per passenger includes carry on bags) as a roller bag would be rough going on the wood slat dock. Also small planes are buffeted by thermals and wind and can be 'interesting' for the motion sickness prone (me - no worries I was fortified with medication from 3 days on boat tours), air sick bags provided just in case. Mostly smooth flights and I made the pilot aware of my tendencies. 

At the time of our booking the R/T seaplane was a less expensive option than renting a car and taking the ferry, besides the stress of navigating Seattle traffic and the time involved. A car was not required for us at Friday Harbor as most of our activities were at the docks, and there were several rental options on the island.

All things considered an excellent company and experience, I would highly recommend!

We flew from Renton to Friday Harbor on Saturday 6/30.  The overcast weather meant we had to fly low and that gave us the opportunity to see a pair of Orcas from the sky. Our pilot was great and he circled around so everyone could see the whales.  

I wish every commercial jet landing was as smooth as with the seaplane, a perfect touchdown on both flights.

Highly recommended.

Allan P
Brilliant service even though we had a little too much luggage. Relaxed and caring pilot and a fabulous flight from Friday Harbor to Renton. Worth every cent....

This is my third flight with Friday Harbor Seaplanes and my favorite way to get back to the island. These flights never disappoint! I highly recommend this company if you have the opportunity to visit Friday Harbor or wherever they fly. The pilot, Jason, is the best! Everyone who works there is friendly and very efficient. They never disappoint. Treat yourself!

This flight was incredible! The views were spectacular! We were going whale watching from Friday Harbor. The dilemma was that we were in Seattle for only a short time. I didn't want to waste the whole day driving to Anacortes then taking the ferry to Friday Harbor. Since it was my birthday, I decided to splurge and fly there instead. Jason was our amazing pilot, he was very knowledgeable pointing out landmarks and giving us little history lessons along the way. He is such a skillful pilot that the only way we knew he landed the plane was when we saw water splashing on the floats; otherwise you couldn't even tell because the landing was so smooth. Getting to Friday Harbor was such a fun and memorable experience in itself! We flew there and back in the same day. When we got back to the dock in Renton, the shuttle was waiting at the dock to take us to SEA-TAC. The door-to-door service was amazing!

I fly back and forth often to the San Juan Islands and NW Seaplanes is my carrier of choice. Great staff, easy to book and always get the flight time I want. Love the pilots as they make the experience exceptional as they share their knowledge of the region in flight as you go. Also, best local rates!
We took the seaplane from Seattle to Friday Harbor and back. It was amazing!!! The views were incredible, the staff was friendly and knowledgable. Highly recommend it to everyone!

Round trip to Friday Harbor was awesome! Was pretty nervous initially about flying on a seaplane, but I forgot all about being nervous!  A great experience, awesome scenery both ways and the pilot pointed out cool points of interest.  Bonus was we circled a bit on the way back to take a better look at the orcas swimming below! Highly recommended!
Best way to get to and see the san juans, Very resonable and want an adventure with no stress just fun
AWESOME!    Shawn was great!   He could point out a little more of the "points of interest" though....other than that we will be rebooking for next year!!!!

review_title: What a great way to travel!
review_text: We spent a weekend on San Juan Islands, and the seaplane ride there was definitely a highlight of the trip! The plane is fantastic, and our pilot Shane was even better. Along with a smooth and scenic flight, he provided commentary on the landmarks and history of the area. Well worthwhile!

review_title: Excellent service from SeaTac to Friday harbor
review_text: We booked with Friday Harbor seaplanes to get us from Seattle to Friday Harbor.  The service was excellent.  They provided excellent briefing materials on how the shuttle service worked and contacted us upon our arrival to ensure we had good directions to the pick up location and refined the pick up time.  On the return trip, they had us to the airport in plently of time for our flight home.
We had a great trip over to San Juan Island! Our pilot was young energetic! From the time we took off and landed was a great experience! I definitely will use this company again

We flew roundtrip with Friday Harbor Seaplanes between Renton and Seattle and used the Sea-Tac shuttle service to get to the Renton airport.  Awesome experience and by far the easiest way to get to San Juan islands if flying in from out of town.   Both flights were on time with professional pilots.  

The plane fit 6 passengers plus the pilot although both of our flights only had 5 people.  There are window seats for 5 passengers.

My family and I (husband and three teenage boys) took a seaplane from Friday Harbor to Renton near Seattle. Amazing experience. Great views, smooth flight, and bonus bits of local information provided by our pilot. Definitely something everyone should experience!

review_title: Trip up to boat in British Columbia
review_text: Northwest seaplanes is a professional but also very flexible Flying Service that we just started using this year. They have been courteous, professional and very flexible and flying us to the destination nearest our boat. We will use them in the future as our go-to service.

review_title: Roche Harbor Round Trip with the Family
review_text:
Yes they have regularly scheduled service into Friday Harbor BUT can also run you to Roche Harbor direct which is awesome.
As always, super friendly pilots and staff, perfect safety record and flexible to meet your needs on where you need to go from the San Juans to Vancouver Island.  I love Northwest Seaplanes!

If you're considering this mode of transport- please go with these guys. Fantastic communication and service door to door. Experience is exceptional from views, to education through to delivery. Money well spent. Thank you. We'll be back.
From beginning to end this was a wonderful way to travel from Friday Harbor to Renton and Seattle. It combines a sightseeing flight with a method of transportation.
Flight to Renton was smooth, educational  and very interesting. Pilot Andrew very professional, capable and enthusiastic.  Highly recommend to all age groups.

We were on our boat near River's Inlet and headed South to collect my brother and nephew who we were flying in for my nephew's 16th birthday present.  He had never been on a float plane or  on our boat outside of Puget Sound, so we were hoping for a memorable experience and NW Seaplanes started it our right and ended it right as well. 

They loved the flight up to Port McNeil and after 5 days flew out of Kwatsi Bay, no dock just climbing aboard on the plane floats!  It was a wonderful trip for all of us, but the great people at NW Seaplanes made it effortless.  The booking was easy and about $90 less per person than Kenmore with no diminished service.  If anything, it was better for us due to the Renton location and that they would fly in to Kwatsi.

While they left Renton on time, they were delayed in Nanaimo so an hour late to Port McNeil. They were also an hour late at Kwatsi, but it really didn't seem to matter to my nephew and brother as they loved the ride up and were glad to be delayed leaving Kwatsi and their holiday.

We will use NE Seaplanes again for sure and will recommend them
To people in the boating community and suggest they check them out when they check Kenmore routes and prices.  Both seem to be great options, but one may be better located, have more destinations, and the prices seem to be leas on NW Seaplanes.  Of course these are all up to each traveler, but we are a customer for sure.

Thanks NW Seaplanes for making gus 16th memorable.

Kathi

Great way to see the beauty of the PNW.  Everyone we encountered at Northwest Seaplanes were accommodating and easy going.  Love the vintage feel and color of the planes. Would recommend to anyone wanting a unique way to travel.

This is a top-notch operation. Everyone who works for this company is professional and thorough from the desk personnel to the pilot. We took the seaplane's 40 minute ride from the Renton Municipal Airport to Friday Harbor in the San Juan Islands on August 12 to save time for the whale-watching portion of our short trip to Seattle. It was an amazing experience! In addition to seeing whales from our boat tour, we even spotted Orca whales from the air because the seaplane flew low enough for us to enjoy the views of Puget Sound. I highly recommend Northwest/Friday Harbor Seaplanes. (Side note: TripAdvisor doesn't have a "family" category that isn't for "young children" or "teens" so I was forced to select "teens" when, in fact, it was a flight for me and my adult son.)

review_title: Enjoyable flight to San Juan islands
review_text: Took this flight as part of whale watch package. Easy parking at Renton airport. Our pilot Sean was very friendly and capable. He clearly loves his job. Only issue was my headset didn't work in either direction.

Such a fun, and beautiful experience. the employees are great, service is on time. Views are unparalleled. We flew to and back. It was a highlight of our trip. The pilot was good enough to offer to take photos of each of us with the plane! Will do it again!

review_title: Best way to get to San Juan Islands!
review_text: We traveled to Friday Harbor and back to Seattle with Friday Harbor Seaplanes and they were accommodating and such a pleasure to deal with from start to finish. Before traveling to Friday Harbor, we were arriving at Seatac from the east coast, but our flight was seriously delayed.  When I called Friday Harbor Seaplanes, they were able to easily put us on a later flight out to Friday Harbor and cut our stress level down to zero! The flight to Friday Harbor on the seaplane was so much fun, and we even spotted a pod of whales playing along the way.  Our pilot circled for a few minutes so we could enjoy whale watching and then expertly landed us in Friday Harbor right at the docks.  This was such an easy and fun part of our trip that I wouldn't hesitate to use this company again!

review_title: A highlight of our trip to the Pavific Northwest
review_text: Not only is this the best way to travel from Seattle to the San Juans, it's fun, quicker, no more expensive and logistically the best option.  We don't get why anyone would opt for a six hour trek when you can have a private pilot take you tnere in fifty minutes.  We had a delightful pilot who gave us a private tour.  It was a highlight of our vacation.  We highly recommend San Juan Seaplanes for travel from Seattle to the San Juan Islands.

review_title: Best Way to get to Friday Harbor
review_text: When I decided to go the San Juan Islands I didn't have a clue where to start.  I wasn't pleased with any of the options to get to the ferry, then I saw an ad for Friday Harbor Sea planes.  They made it very simple.   Picked me up at the airport, put me on the plane and I was in Friday Harbor in no time.  I took the plane to and then back from the island.  Pilots were very nice and friendly.  Pointing out interesting tidbits along the way.  This was my first time in a seaplane and it was incredible.   I would do it again in a heart beat!

review_title: Convenient way to get to Friday Harbor
review_text: This was a wonderful way to reach San Juan Island from Seattle (Renton).  This cut lots of time off our travel, by avoiding going up to Anacortes and waiting for the ferry.  The planes are a bit old and rickety, but it got us there (and back), and the pilot could not have been nicer.

review_title: By far the BEST part of our Seattle vacation!!
review_text: My 10 year old nephew and I took a seaplane as part of an airfare / whale watching tour.  He hasn't stopped talking about it yet! It was our favorite part of the  vacation, and we would do it again in a heartbeat!  The plane was very nice - clean, obviously well cared for, and easy to get in and out of.  We wore headsets to protect our ears and to allow communication with the pilot.  Take-off was so smooth you couldn't even tell when we left the water.  The flight was smooth and visually amazing - lots of wildlife and beautiful views.  Landing was equally as smooth - one small bump and that was it.  We loved this adventure - if you have the option to do it don't miss out!! :)

review_title: Well organized trip to Haikai Lodge.
review_text:
A real treat! Our trip north was very informative and enjoyable. Our pilot Jimmy Howard gave an excellent dissertation on the beautiful mountains, rivers and glaciers along the way! He answered all questions and is indeed an outstanding pilot. Our return trip was flawless and we arrived as planned back at American Lake safe and sound a life time experience!
I would highly recommend NW Seaplanes to anyone who wants to fly safely and in comfort!

It was great fun and tremendous time saving!  I was in Friday Harbor and just over an hour I was back home.  It made the weekend in the San Juan's possible.
The DeHavilland Beaver is a lot of fun to fly!

review_title: The best way to see Vashon is with Northwest Seaplanes
review_text: The staff at Northwest was thorough, accommodating and ensured we had a magical experience from start to finish. The views of Vashon were incredible! Highly recommend you try it.

We had a Sea Plane ride yesterday from Friday Harbor, with Northwest Seaplanes for a tour of the San Juan Islands, it was so great. The pilot, Roger, was informative, fun and gave us a great tour. There were four of us, including my 5 year old grandson, who just loved the entire experience. I recommend you try this, and enjoy the ride!!!!

I had an amazing flight from Roche Harbor to SeaTac. Doug, my awesome pilot, was a treasure trove of information about everything we were seeing. Super interesting guy, he's been flying for 55 years so I felt completely safe. The flight was a wonderful adventure and I cannot recommend it highly enough.

Friday Harbor Seaplanes are awesome! The views up to Friday Harbor are breathtaking~and you experience this adventure in a famous de Havilland Single Propeller Seaplane. Landing by the rich & famous sailboats in the harbor! Walk out on the dock & enjoy kayaking & whale watching in an instant! The pilot gives a priceless narrative of flying thru these channels & up to Alaska for over thirty years! One of the most awesome experiences to take ~ real easy to video the ride!

review_title: charter flight to Stehekin with family
review_text: top notch customer service for an experience that was out of this world. Shane is a fantastic pilot and my kids, 10 and 12, were over the top thrilled with seeing the Cascades where we play from the air. I highly recommend any trip from NW Seaplanes but even more so encourage a flight to Stehekin for a nice weekend get away. thanks Shane and NW Seaplanes for a perfect family vacation!

review_title: Most fun way to travel from SeaTac to San Juans
review_text: My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed are seaplane flight from SeaTac to the San Juans! Are pilots, both there and back 4 days later, were informative, interesting and made the flight an adventure that won't soon be forgotten.

review_title: First time in a sea plane - didn't disappoint!
review_text: The folks at Friday Harbor Seaplanes were friendly, communicative, and easy peasy to book, board etc. I would absolutely use them again for a trip to the San Juan's ... no doubt about it!

We had a great flight.  Not only a beautiful view, but Doug, our pilot was very informative about the area.  It's like we had our own private tour from the air!  Would definitely recommend.  Ask for Doug!

My wife and I took the 20 mins ride from Friday Harbor. It was an experience different from the Helicopter rides in New York City. We rode over the entire San Juan Island. It is definitely worth trying once !

First time on a seaplane - couldn't have wished for a better experience than Northwest Seaplanes, from Renton to Friday Harbor, returning the next day.  So cool!!  Flights were smooth, amazing views and our pilot on the flight over knew so much about local history it was like a guided tour!  Unfussy, uncomplicated - its how I wish all air travel could be.

review_title: Sea Plan from San Juan to Seattle
review_text: My husband and I decided instead of taking the ferry to and from the islands, we wanted a different mode of transportation returning to Seattle. We took the sea plan from Friday Harbor to Seattle (Renton), and it was great! Our pilot was friendly, knowledgeable of the land and history, and told us facts and stories as we flew over different areas. It was a unique way to see the area, and we are very glad we did it. The trip was approximately 45 minutes; it was smooth taking off and landing and felt very safe. We loved it!

review_title: Sea Plane from Friday Harbor to Renton
review_text: I put my 17-year old daughter on a one-way home from Friday Harbor - she could not say enough wonderful compliments about her trip - gorgeous - and her pilot - "he told us about what we were seeing on the ground and gave us some history - really a great trip."
Amazing views of the San Juan Islands, Seattle and fun whale watching! The pilot was very kind and the shuttle to SEATAC is about as easy as it gets! Highly recommend, hope to go again someday!

I flew with these guys from Roche Harbor to Renton on Wednesday July 5th.  The other floaplane company had 7 planes stacked up and customers waiting okn the dock, and our pilot could not get to the dock because the other planes.  I called Friday harbor seaplanes and they patched me through to the pilot and he told me if I could get a dinghy ride out to him he would pick me up and we wouldn't have to wait for the other guys.  My buddy gave me a ride out and we were off in a flash.  It would have been a 45 minute wait otherwise.  Top notch.

review_title: Great way to get to the San Juan Islands
review_text:
Every employee was helpful and friendly. The pilot was engaging, friendly, and informative. We took the trip from Renton to Friday Harbor and got a great view of the University of Washington, several fancy houses along the edge of the lake, and several beautiful vistas as we flew out to the San Juan Islands. 

The whole trip took about 50 minutes and was a great way to get a beautiful overview of the whole area while making a quick trip. My wife thanked me several times for booking the float plane trip, and we have recommended it to many others.

review_title: Great way to start your holiday
review_text: Flying to San Juan with Friday Harbor Seaplanes is the best start to an island trip. From the booking, shuttle, reception and pilots, everyone is friendly efficient and helpful. Special thanks to Jen in the office for all her patience with a South African credit card! We flew both ways and loved every moment.

We traveled back to Seattle from Friday Harbor with Jake and it was such a wonderful experience.  Not just technical flying brilliance but also the local information and warmth he shared on the way.  It was a highlight of the week.  The pick up and shuttle to the airport showed the same excellent care and I would highly recommend this company an experience.

We had such a wonderful time.  Everyone loved taking off and landing on the water and the sights of Seattle are truly enjoyed from the air.  The kids all flooded their social media with their experience and their friends and other family really want to go now.  Thank you so much for a wonderful family adventure.  We have memories to last a lifetime

review_title: Entertaining, Quick, and worth every penny!
review_text: My daughter and I booked roundtrip tickets to the San Juan Islands for a day of whale watching.  The roundtrip experience on the sea plane was as awesome as our day on the water.  Doug made the experience priceless with his knowledge of the area, and expertise flying.  This is a "must do" for a true unforgettable Pacific North West experience

review_title: Easy and inexpensive way to get to Seattle from the Islands
review_text: I booked this flight online quick and easy to fly from Friday Harbor to Renton, close to the Sea-Tac airport. You are picked up at the Marina at Friday Harbor and take off pretty quickly.  Beautiful views and a great pilot that told us lots of great things about the areas we were flying over.  Much easier than dealing with the ferry schedule! I was also picked up by a friendly guy in Renton and whisked away to the airport 8 minutes away.  Shortened my travel day so much and very cool way to see Seattle and the islands from the air.

My Boyfriend and I used the seaplane to get to and from the San Juan Islands. The service and knowledge were impeccable! We were able to sit up front and learn about the plane as well as be provided with state knowledge from the pilot. We were even able to schedule a ride back to the airport through them.  It was a remarkable experience that I recommend to everyone!

review_title: Best way to get to San Juan!
review_text: We flew from Seattle to San Juan and it was by far one of the highlights of the trip. Not only was Doug an awesome pilot but he also pointed out interesting landmarks along the way. I would add this to my "must do" if you plan to visit the San Juan islands.
We had the most relaxing, scenic flight from Lake Washington to Friday Harbor. Shane, our pilot, was an exceptional aerial tour guide. Outstanding customer service!

We flew to San Juan Island and it was incredible.  We had a great aerial tour of the area with lots of fun facts from Jason and Brad (I think).  They both made it fun and we were all disappointed when it was time to land.  How often do you get to take off and land in the water???  Highly recommend them.

review_title: Friday Harbor Seaplanes aka Northwest Seaplanes
review_text: It's been my dream to see orcas in the wild (as it should be) so I figured the easiest way to San Juan islands was by plane. I couldn't have been happier.  Jason flew us to the island and Shane picked us up and both flights were easy/breezy and we got educated on what we were seeing around us as well.  Overall it was worth every dollar to fly with these guys and whenever we're back on this side of the country again we will definitely fly with them again.  I HIGHLY recommend this company!

The staff and the pilot were very accommodating to our schedule and went above and beyond to make the trip fantastic.  Ken, our pilot, is also a great tour guide.  Me pointed out some interesting facts along the way to Friday Harbor.

Booked a trip at Rodgers Fishing Lodge.  They set me up to fly NW Seaplanes from Seattle to their floating lodge outside Tahsis, BC.  What a fantastic flying experience!  I'd never flown in a Beaver float plane before and this was without a doubt one of the most amazing experiences I've had in my 67+ years.  Saw glaciers from what appeared to a few feet below the plane.  On the return trip the weather was drizzly and overcast so we flew back from the lodge to Seattle all the way along the Pacific coast at about 500 feet Saw amazing scenery from mountains to beaches to pods of Orcas.  As we passed over Seattle headed to our water landing, we flew by the needle and the waterfront of Seattle.  Very cool!  For a flatlander from Florida, this was an absolute joy of a trip and flight.  Highly recommend these folks for any flying excursions.

Once again Shane and his pro quiver of talented pilots arranged reliable and scenic travel between Renton and Desolation Sound.  It always feels like travel with friends rather than commercial flying and that is a nice way to be delivered to paradise.

-thanks

Loved it !!!!Just now finished my Seattle city and Cascades mountain tour.  Awesome experience.  Very courteous staff, very experienced pilot, reasonable price and wonderful experience.  Pilot was so considerate about the safety of the passengers, guided the tour with good narration.  All the four kids including my 7 year old enjoyed a lot. My 7 yr old enjoyed the flight to the maximum extent being the co-pilot. Would have been taken another trip if it's not the time to go back home. A must to do activity in Seattle.

review_title: Great seaplane service to British Columbia from Seattle
review_text: Excellent seaplane service with spotless planes, experienced pilots and very safety conscious. Shane, the manager, is very helpful and the whole operation is easy and professional.
Great classic planes, wonderful service.  Pilot Jim was great, and the scenery going to Zeballos was fantastic.  It was a great fishing trip, and the flights were a real highlight.

review_title: Trip to Hakai Lodge was incredible!
review_text: My dad and I booked a 4 day trip to their lodge up in the Queen Charlotte sound area, I cannot tell you how incredible everything was.  The staff, the seaplane trip the fishing was all world class.  We limited coho all in the 12 pound average and kings and even took home cod and black sea bass.  Super friendly people, everything was taken care of and you guide your own boat, really nice 17 foot whalers all stocked and ready every morning.  3 meals a day from a great chef and all our fish was packed and frozen for the ride home.  You owe it to yourself to book such a special adventure!

Our family took Northwest Seaplanes from Renton to Friday Harbor, then to Nootka Sound, and finally back to Renton.  Shane, our pilot from Renton to Friday Harbor, was excellent, pointing out landmarks and attractions during the flight.  The take off and landing were very soft and gentle.  Jason piloted us to and from Nootka Sound.  The flight across Vancouver Island was simply amazing, the views were almost surreal.  Finally, the flight from Nootka Sound back to Renton was just as enjoyable.  Jason pointed out whales, sea lions, and other sites during the flight.  The headphones were a great addition to the flight as they allowed us to talk among ourselves during the flight.  Definitely a great way to fly to Vancouver Island and Shane and Jason make sure that your flight is very comfortable.  We will definitely take Northwest Seaplanes in the future.

My husband, mother-in-law and sister-in-law and I enjoyed a wonderful air tour of Seattle aboard one of Northwest Seaplanes' de Havilland Beaver seaplanes. Our pilot, Ken, was gracious and thoughtful, pointing out landmarks and answering our questions as we flew on a beautiful blue-sky Seattle day. Thanks to Ken and NWS's Shane for a great, memorable experience during our visit to the Seattle area.

NW Seaplanes took my wife, my sister and mother, and myself on a 30-minute flight around the Seattle area in one of their vintage Dehavilland Beaver seaplanes. It was an amazing experience to both take off and land on the water! If you have never flown in a seaplane I highly recommend it. Both the owner (Shane) and our pilot (Ken) did everything they could to make our experience a great one. Next time we are in Seattle we will definitely do this again!!!

Awesome experience for myself and three teenagers, all visiting the Pacific Northwest from Florida, first time ever in a Seaplane. Northwest Seaplanes in Renton really delivered! We were enthusiastically greeted at the hangar, which houses very cool memorabilia, and is incredibly clean. Then we met our pilot Jason, who escorted us out to the plane, explained our trip and graciously photographed our group before we embarked. We enjoyed a fantastic ride around the Seattle area - as Jason patiently answered our questions and educated us to everything we were seeing. Super fun and we highly recommend the experience. Will do this again next year, want to book a longer excursion!!

A float plane flight was on my oldest son's bucket list, so we flew Saturday with Northwest Seaplanes from Renton to Friday Harbor in the San Juan Islands. We got to see a lot of beautiful sights along the way, enjoyed a nice dinner in Friday Harbor, and flew back. Everything went smoothly and they made it so easy--from booking and the flight itself to the on-time departure and return. Five green dots and two thumbs up!

NWS graciously accommodated me by dropping me off right at the dock of April Point Lodge on Quadra Island on its regular route from Renton to points farther west and north, picking me up at April Point 3 days later RIGHT ON TIME, returning me to Renton, and shuttling me to SeaTac Airport at no extra charge.  What a deal!  Pilots are gracious, friendly and professional.  Planes are immaculate. I'm a pilot and my Bonanza V-Tail never looked that good.  Plus the scenery was fantastic. Pilot pointed out some whales. A very fun and positive experience. Will do it again.

We flew NW Seaplanes from Renton (next to Seatac) to a fishing lodge in British Columbia, and then returned with them 4 days later. Friendly professional pilots and planes in excellent condition. For me, taking off and landing in a float plane is always fun and the B.C. mountain and ocean scenery is spectacular. The Beaver amphibian is a classic and a legend. The whole operation was smooth and well managed. I recommend them.

Northwest Seaplanes completely exceeded our expectations on our recent trip to Desolation Sound, BC. This is a very professional outfit that operates seamlessly. The seaplanes are gorgeous, stable, comfortable, and offer tremendous views of the Pacific Northwest. When weather became an issue for our return flight, they efficiently communicated with us and picked us up at the rescheduled time. The cost was less than a comparable seaplane outfit. No question, we will fly with Northwest Seaplanes again!

review_text:
Wow! Is what comes to mind when thinking about the experience we had with Grand Canyon Landmarks Tour by Airplane. Despite a very windy day, our pilot decided it was safe enough to take us up and informed us that our flight would be rocky, but still safe. Safe was all I needed to hear. 

The 45 minute flight was a tour of the entire South Rim and included an on-flight informative guide (via headphones) that turned out to be very insightful.

 Finding parking at the Grand Canyon airport was fairly easy and so was our check in. I would highly recommend bringing your own camera to take pictures of what will probably be the best vantage point into the canyon. I would also try my best to board the plane first. Although everyone will get a window seat, (on a smaller plane; 8-10 people) there are a few seats that have a wing blocking your shot, thus preventing you from capturing the perfect picture. If you are simply there to take in the sights, any seat will be fine. 

If you are prone to motion sickness, I would recommend bringing gum, or taking something for it before your flight departs. Keep in mind that if it is too windy and deemed unsafe your flight may be cancelled (check the weather). However, if there are high winds and it's safe to go, it will feel like a 45 minute roller-coaster ride. 

I am very pleased with this experience and would definitely do it again. The ticket price is well worth it and I am very thankful that our pilot turned out to be happy and experienced and landed us safely.

review_title: Highlight of our entire trip to the Grand Canyon
review_text: We booked a private Ecostar Imperial helicopter tour for 6 people (the 40-50 minute flight from Grand Canyon airport in Tusayan) and we are all in agreement that this was by far the highlight of our entire trip! We checked in 30 minutes before our flight and were all weighed to distribute our weight in the helicopter evenly. We all had a good view from the big windows in the Ecostar, even the two who were in the back/middle (2 people sit next to the pilot up front, and 4 in the back), although this was probably easier because we were a family group without issues leaning over each other or asking each people closer to a window to take a photo. The weather was perfect, with little cloud cover - we chose a morning flight because we heard the light is nice and there are fewer updrafts from the hot canyon floor, making for a smoother ride, and both points were true. The pilot was excellent (Tim) and told us about various sites as we passed them and answered our questions. It was magical flying over the Kaibab forest and hitting the rim of the canyon. This was my 4th trip to the Grand Canyon but my first helicopter trip, and it was definitely an experience entirely different from walking along both rims and hiking to the base of the canyon, with panoramic views above inaccessible viewpoints. We loved seeing the full range of the Colorado River, the confluence of the Little and main Colorado River, with the color change of the water, Imperial Point at the North Rim, the view of the canyon of the North Rim without the 4.5 hour drive from the South Rim, and the Dragon Corridor. It was certainly a pricey experience, but all of us felt that it was worth every penny and we would do it again if we ever returned to the Grand Canyon!

review_title: Det koster, men det er alle pengene værd
review_text:
Hvis man skal til Grand Canyon National Park, bør man overveje at investere i en helikoptertur. Det koster en del, men det er det hele værd. 
Der er flere udbydere, men Papillon kan bestemt anbefales.
Her er der topprofessionelle folk, der går meget op i, at det skal være en helstøbt oplevelse. Vi oplevede, at alle medarbejdere var utrolig service-mindede og høflige, og manden, der skulle hjælpe til med boarding forstod endda at joke med os gæster.
Vi blev vist hen til en af de mange helikoptere og hilste på vores venlige pilot. Han fortalte sikkert en del interessante ting undervejs, men jeg må indrømme, at når man først flyver ud over kløften - akkompagneret af temaet fra Jurassic Park i headsettet - hører man ikke meget efter.
Vores tur varede desværre kun en lille halv time, men til gengæld fik vi en oplevelse for livet.
