Beautiful views. The pilot gets so close to the mountains you feel like you could reach out and touch them. The glacier landing provides phenomenal views. Be aware... Flight is bumpy. Maybe consider some motion sickness meds and/or some vomit baggies.

The option to land was up in the air due to weather, but we were so happy to be the first flights all week to land on the Glacier. It was like being in the magazines you see, and the feeling was magical. I appreciate the professionalism, safety and knowledge of this well organized company! Well worth the money and trip. JUST DO IT!

review_title: Highly Recommend!  Was a family favorite experience!
review_text: We had a wonderful trip to Alaska and this adventure was one of our family's favorites.  We had a clear day so we felt very fortunate to be able to see Denali from various areas and especially while flying around it.  We had Connor as our pilot who was very knowledgeable, experienced and made us feel very safe throughout the entire experience.  Our flight was very smooth throughout and he made our trip very enjoyable.  Definitely recommend adding the glacier landing as it was unbelievably special to be in such a unique and remote area.

review_title: Grand Denali Flightseeing with Glacier Landing
review_text: This tour was amazing.  Absolutely Spectacular! Like nothing we have ever experienced.  We were fortunate to be able to do the entire fly over of Denali along with the glacier stop.  Don’t skip the glacier landing!  K2 was extremely professional, informative and made the trip very easy to book.  Our pilot Lou had been flying for 40 years and was a wealth of knowledge about Denali, the mountains, the glaciers and more.  He was very safe and made us feel comfortable and at ease the entire time.  We would highly recommend them for a flightseeing tour out of Talkeetna.

Just do it! Stunning views. We included the glacier landing and will never forget it. We flew with Wilbur, who was super thorough, calm and experienced. Loved every second, but the glacier experience Beats all! Wear the glacier boots!

Unbelievable lifetime experience! Our whole family had great time and we took a lot of photos at the top of the mountain.  
We do not see huge amounts of ice, but it is top of the mountain covered with snow.  Maybe there are ice under the snow.  We did see ice on the flights.

Flying among the magnificent peaks in Denali was the best part of our Alaska trip. It felt like you could reach out and touch the mountains. And landing on the glacier and walking on it was such a rush! 

Our pilot (who trains other pilots) did an excellent job. The flight was smooth and his commentary was informative and interesting.

We were lucky to be in Alaska during an unusual hot, dry time when Denali was visible every day. I also feel lucky to have chosen K2 for this experience. From the wonderful Ernie, to the bus driver, to the pilot everyone did their best to ensure I had a safe & enjoyable time. I rate them AWESOME!
Highlight of our trip!  I would highly recommend it if you can. Everyone was great!  Our pilot Riley was professional and personable!

review_title: The best decision we made was to use K2 Aviation. Very organized incredibly friendly .
review_text: I think the best part of our flight was our pilot Leon! So incredibly knowledgeable and entertaining. I truly had the best time. When we landed on the glacier he never rushed us we got to spend some time taking some incredible photos. I would highly highly highly recommend this organization for sightseeing and if you can request Leon you'll be golden! The whole experience was incredible!

Amazing!! Nothing like seeing the mountains that close and personal! Our pilot, Riley, was very entertaining and informative. It was such a great experience to land on the Ruth Glacier. A dream!! Definitely reccomend.

review_title: Add this to the Bucket List!
review_text: If you want to see Denali up close and personal this is a must do. Well worth the money we had awesome weather and visibility was close to perfect. Bucket List for sure.

The K2 Denali experience was fantastic! Our pilot, Dorothy, was experienced, professional, and knowledgeable. While in the air, the views were unbelievable! Then, we also had a glacier landing, which was even more spectacular! Do not miss the opportunity to go on the K2 flyer!

review_title: Wow!!! Do I have to say more?
review_text: Wow!!!! Is that enough?  This was the best small plane trip I’ve ever been on.  Our pilot, Leon, was fantastic, the landing on the glacier was in unbelievable experience, flying around Denali exceeded expectations!  I can’t say enough about this… just an amazing, memorable experience.
What an absolute breathtaking experience. Puts viewing the great Mt Denali in a completely different perspective. Awesome experience. The pilot was completely professional and informative.

Amazing Views of the surrounding area!! Found out at hotel pick up  we wouldn't be able to land on the glacier due to extreme fog.  Disappointed but understand they can't control the weather! Dorothy was our pilot and she was great! Made it a fun experience explaining fun facts of the area and for small plane, Very smooth take off and landing! :) Would highly recommend this company as we looked at another flightseeing company out of Denali, to attempt a Glacier landing, and it was considerably More $$ for the exact same experience!

Billy was our pilot and did a wonderful job explaining what we were passing. The flight was smooth and, most importantly, felt very safe. 

We landed on Rose Glacier and he took our photos. Billy was very friendly and courteous. 

This is a once-in-a-lifetime experience for many of us and our flight was taken on a perfect cloudless hour and day. 

The entire experience went smoothly from checkin to landing back at the airport.

review_title: Majestic bring you to tears experience!!
review_text: The view was majestic, literally brought me to tears, never could even imagine the beauty of Denali without this once in a lifetime flight experience, this is a must do!!!!

Flight of a lifetime.  Views were absolutely spectacular.  Seeing Denali from close up and from up high were so much more impressive than from the lodge.  The flight is a must to truly see the mountains.  Pilot was wonderful and so knowledgeable.  Plane was comfortable and smooth.  Glacier landing was a thrill.  Flight seeing is a must do if you come to Denali.
Being able to fly close to and land on Denali.  Chris was great with his knowledge and taking photos for everyone.  The day was beautiful, the flight perfect.
This is a fantastic experience and highly recommended for anyone!  Hard to describe and pictures just don't do it justice.  It's not that expensive, if the mountain is clear just go!!

review_title: Put this on your bucket list!
review_text:
All of the pictures, videos, and words can not  describe this magnificent trip. If you are going to be in Talkeetna take this flight!!
We arrived on the train the day before our scheduled flight. It was a clear day and you could see the whole mountain. Our cabin host suggested that we ask if K2 could take us up a day earlier...they did!!

There is not one favorite part......the trip was a memory I will think of for the rest of my life.  The pilot was a wealth of knowledge, the views looking at the mountains and various glaciers was just outstanding.  If the weather cooperates, don't think twice, do it.  The glacier landing.....what can I say, other than you have to do it if you have the opportunity.

K2 staff and pilot professional, facilities clean and all were accommodating.  Had to get a red K2 hat when leaving......with the plane we rode in on the top front.

Absolutely magnificent!! This is a must do and K2 is the way to go. Safe, knowledgeable, and friendly...K2 made this experience the best. Landing on the glacier,, seeing the peaks, and flying through the Great Gorge were the best parts.
Amazing experience! The view from the plane is gorgeous. I recommend doing it, it’s worth it! Thank you

Super friendly, and knowledgeable about the area. One of the more life changing experiences, to fly through such an amazing magical place. Even as a life long Alaskan, I am STILL in awe over the beauty  of the glaciers, mountains, and terrane.  I highly recommend K-2

Probably the best experience we had in Alaska. The crew at the office was super friendly, and the pilot provided a lot of informations. He was passionated about the flight, and about what he was seeing with us.
An incredible view (the weather was all clear, lucky us), a fabulous experience for people who know they will never get the chance to hike on those mountains. We had the feeling to touch them, such a great tour!!

My family of 5 ranging in ages of 18 to 73 embarked on this amazing flight in March 2022.  I admit I was a bit nervous as flying can bring anxiety sometimes but Billy - our pilot was GREAT!  He informed us about the flying experience before we headed outside to the plane.  Once outside by the plane, we had additional instructions and it made us all feel quite secure.  We were given headphones so Billy could talk to us, ask us questions, and let us know what we were seeing as we flew overhead.  
We were blessed with a cloudless and BEAUTIFUL day.  Seeing Denali up close was breathtaking.  The time went by so quickly and we are grateful we had the opportunity to experience these mountains upclose and see the glaciers from above.  
we highly recommend this tour.

This something everyone should do when coming to Alaska. You won’t find a better view of the Denali mountain range. I had initially booked k2 for the wrong dates they quickly and efficiently resolved my mistake and were able to reschedule me for the correct date. All in all I would definitely fly with them again

I am born and raised in Alaska and I have done this tour at least four times now. When we have friends and family visit, this is always our most recommended activity. The views are breathtaking. The pilots are always so kind, informative, and skilled. The staff are so helpful in booking trips, assisting with weather forecasts, and getting us ready for our flight. Thank you, KT Aviation, for such a wonderful service for visitors and residents!

A clear day gave us the most amazing views of Denali and glaciers that I could imagine!   Landing on and exploring the glacier was one of the highlights of our Alaskan adventure.  Please book this trip if you can, you will not regret it!!

The whole experience was fabulous from the convenience of short notice booking to the easy check in and ultimately with the flight and our pilot! The facility is welcoming and the staff is efficient and friendly. Any apprehension I felt was alleviated by Joe’s calm and professional nature. He was friendly, informative and patient as he flew us over the beautiful terrain of Alaska into the mountain region. Landing and getting to walk around on the glacier was thrilling in many ways. This was an unforgettable experience overall. I highly recommend this company and cannot wait to return again some day.

Denali is on the short-list of everybody's travel plans in Alaska. We decided to take this plane tour with glacier landing and although it was pricey, it was well worth it. You get to fly to the tallest mountain in North America and land on a glacier. Not many chances to experience something like that. The flight takes a total of 1.5-2 hours and is narrated by the pilot. You fly from Talkeetna into the mountain range. We had clear views of Denali as we approached the glacier. After we landed, we were able to get off the plane and walk around for 15 minutes in this truly magical place on top of a glacier. The flight to and from Denali was mostly smooth and our pilot did a great job avoiding the clouds and turbulence. This is an experience we will cherish forever. Thanks K2!!

An unbelievable experience! Fortunately, it was a sunny day with clear, blue skies making for a perfect excursion into Denali and glacier landing. Our pilot, Stan, was fantastic! Highly recommend for a spectacular time!

Flying near Denali on a sunny day with excellent pilot was a highlight of our Alaska tour.  The awesome ( in the true sense of the word) scenery took our breathbaway...the size of the mountain and surround crags and valleys, the long Ruth Glacier, Great Gorge and Amphitheater spectacular.
Chad was our pilot and made for an incredible experience! Seeing these beautiful mountains from this perspective was once in a lifetime experience. Stop reading reviews and just book already!

We did the shortest tour (not sure if I labeled correctly on review) and it was epic! We saw tons of nature and plenty of awesome landscapes with Denali. Our pilot was knowledgeable and friendly! Would recommend to anyone as a day trip on the way to or back from Denali!

What an awesome flight! Very professional company. Our pilot Joe was great, sharing a lot of information about the area.  Landing on the glacier and flying through and around the mountains was an incredible experience.
Landing on the glacier at the base camp of the Denali climbers. The pilot/narrator was very thorough and showed great piloting skills. Wow!

Professional operation from the front desk clerks to our incredibly experienced pilot. I’ve been an Alaskan resident for 45 years and this is at the top of my list. I will be sure to send all of my guests straight to K2.
All of it... and landing on the glacier was a once in a life time experience.  We had plenty of time on the glacier to take all in. Going around Denali was magic.

It was such a well run operation. The admin staff were terrific in helping us to select the right experience for us. The pilot was so professional and was a wealth of info on what we were seeing. The walk on the glacier was breath taking. Recommend this experience. Worth every penny!

review_title: Glacier Landing Perfect! We enjoyed the flight seeing with our pilot, Garret, on the De Havilland K2 Red airplane!!
review_text: A very special trip to Pica Glacier on a cool September sunny day. We flew ar 10:30am, and returned to airport 2 hours later, Threw snowballs on the glacier and even builf a snow man. Worth every penny.

By far the best day of our 11 days in Alaska!  Landing on the glacier and seeing the mountains up close is something we will never forget!  Our kids were able to take turns in the cockpit on the way out and back, and the pilot made our trip extremely memorable.  The flight was smooth and the headsets make it easy to talk.  Can't recommend this trip enough!  You won't be sorry you fly with them.

We originally signed up for the Denali Summit tour with the glacier landing. However, when we arrived they said the weather and visibility was too poor to go to higher elevations. Instead, they asked if we wanted to switch to the Denali Experience or reschedule. We went ahead and chose the Denali Experience for that day. Our pilot was very knowledgable about the area we were flying over. He gave clear instructions about the safety of the tour (both airplane related and COVID). He mentioned how we had a unique experience that showed us more of the lower mountains that you don't normally see. He did a great job accommodating the changes and still provided a wonderful tour.

I have thousands of flight hours, in both small General Aviation airplanes and in military aircraft, and have had some pretty amazing experiences, BUT….   nothing I have ever experienced in an aircraft has been more amazing and more enjoyable than this one hour flight!   I know you’re weighing the cost, but trust me - just do it!    You will never regret the money you have spent on this experience!

Yes you might hesitate to take a moment or more when considering the cost since it can be around the same as a domestic flight in the "lower 49" but PLEASE don't let that get in the way of you having one of the MOST incredible experiences during your visit to Alaska. The flights and proximity to the glaciers is unspeakably beautiful and worth every cent. We were unable to make a glacier landing that day because of weather but we were not disappointed as it was a spectacular experience. Joe was our pilot and incredibly professional and pleasant to talk with. Don't worry about the $$$ it is truly worth the cost.
K2 is so professional from their check in  ground crew to their flight staff! We experienced an awesome glacier landing. Thanks, Stan for making this trip unforgettable!

Experienced pilots and very  informed about the local geography. The trip was worth it because of the information that the pilot was able to share during the flight. 
Would highly recommend this tour for every one visiting Alaska.
They were absolutely great. They were very informative. Pointed out a lot of scenery. I will be back.

The flight to Denali and through the canyons around the other mountains was spectacular.  We had such a soft landing on the glacier.  We had tremendous sunny and blue skies which is uncommon for August and there had been snow two days earlier so it was a trip to be remembered forever.  The gods lined up and this was the best tour that we took during our 2 week trip to Alaska's interior. Our pilot, Chris was incredibly skilled and knowledgeable   I would highly recommend it and if you are coming in August please have time in your itinerary to do a reschedule if the weather does not cooperate for you.
Great experience. Wonderful weather and awesome views of Denali and the surrounding area. Pilot Maury was fantastic, with great commentary and a smooth flight.

Our trip to Alaska wouldn’t be the same if we hadn’t had the experience of flying over Denali National park and landing on a glacier at the foot of Mt. Denali.
Everything was top notch during registration and preflight, and Chip, our pilot, was a font of information.  He made sure we all enjoyed the trip, including a woman who couldn’t bend her knee.
Weather made landing on glacier be cancelled.  However, flight and pilot were great, and just as we got near, the clouds cleared, and we saw Mount Denali.  Got amazing photos.  Thank you.

review_title: Great sight seeing flight at K2 Aviation
review_text: Our pilot Morrie was a highly experienced professional and gave us a thorough safety and aircraft familiarization briefing, provided a very interesting and appropriate narration of the incredible terrain we were seeing, and made every effort to ensure we had great photo opportunities.   We were on a very tight schedule  to leave Talkeetna and at the conclusion of the tour  the helpful front desk people at K2 immediately whisked us back to our hotel to meet our bus.   You really don't want to miss this sight seeing experience!!

On two other trips to Alaska I have booked with K2 and had the flights cancelled due to weather.  Please note that this was no problem for me.  They are not going to fly if it is unsafe or they cannot provide you the experience you are paying for.  The money was promptly refunded.

On this trip we arrived in Talkeetna without a tour reservation.  As we drove in, I heard the planes taking off from the local airport.  I immediately rounded up the family and headed over to see if we could get on a flight.  It was no problem and 45 minutes later we were boarding a late afternoon tour.

I believe we were on the Denali Flyer.  My sense is the routes are a generalization of length and the areas they will try to show you.  I felt like the pilot adjusted the flight based on where things were clear and we could get the best views/experience for the time we had in the air.  It is unsafe and pointless to follow a route that is cloud-covered.  It was a great tour and I thought the pilot did an excellent job of allowing both sides of the plane to see the different sites.  He was informative about the area and things we were seeing.  This was the first activity we did in Alaska and set a great tone for the rest of the trip.  The family absolutely loved it.  We did not have the choice of a glacier landing due to the uncertain weather, so I cannot comment on whether that is a worthwhile addition.  I can say that, although expensive, you are not getting the most out of your Alaska trip without some flight seeing.  There is just too much of Alaska that is inaccessible from the ground.  You need to get into the air to truly get the full experience.  Highly recommend K2...take any trip you can afford.  If you have the option, I would take a cheaper trip and save money for a second trip of another kind...there is so much to see in this state.

What an incredible experience, my favorite thing to do in Alaska, but what brought this to a completely different level, was our pilot Wilbert, Not only did we feel safe, his passion for the history and the terrain of all of our sites made this an incredible experience, if he didn’t say one word to us we would’ve been blown away, but there was not one moment where he was not explaining a peek, a river, a glacier, and that’s what brought this to a completely different level, outstanding Wilbert thank you…

There are not many words that can actually describe this experience. It's one of those things that makes traveling so far, all worth it! Firstly, I have to say that our original tour (with glacier landing) had to be modified due to weather. Being in Denali for a few days prior, my family and I were already setting our expectations because it had been very rainy and cloudy. The staff picked us up and let us know that we would not be able to land, as we already figured. They were so so accommodating though and you could tell they really wanted to do as much as they could to still get you flying, in the safest way possible. We opted for a 1 hour flight over Denali National Park. It was AMAZING!! Denali itself was covered in clouds that afternoon, so we can't include ourselves in the exclusive 30% club - but we did see the most beautiful views of Ruth Glacier and surrounding mountains. Our pilot was great as well and spent the whole flight pointing things out and was very knowledgeable and open to any of our questions. Overall, this is a must-do while you're in AK!!!

review_title: Bad Business Practice - No Warning for Canceled Flight
review_text: Due to weather we were not able to do the flight we had booked, including landing on a glacier. I understand that the weather cannot be controlled. I do not understand however the thought process behind not informing us via email or call to let us know our options. We are in Alaska for 10 days with plans down to the minute each day. Had we known we wouldn’t be flying we wouldn’t have even stopped in Talkeetna. They want you to come to the office to check in anyways so they can try and sell you a different flight. Seems unethical. Let us know ahead of time so we can make our own decisions. It’s not like they just decided not to fly when we got there.
Pilot was wonderful and explained everything we saw. Went above and beyond to make it a memorable experience.
We had a lovely time flying with Dorothy. Though our original route into Denali was cancelled, going over the Talkeetna mountains was amazing, and the ride was completely smooth.

review_title: This incredible tour literally  and figuratively tops them all!
review_text:
When planning out my trip to Alaska. I decided to add a flight tour to my trip. I had heard a lot about flight tours being a very Alaskan experience and OMG the rumor are true. It's was honestly a very surreal and humbling experience.  

Our pilot Joe gently ushered our plane in and around some magnificent stream systems, lakes, foothills, mountains, and glaciers. He navigated all this while giving us all sorts of interesting geologic, historic, and ecologic details. He also basically landed us on the near tippy top of North America. 

I would absolutely recommend K2 to anyone who's considering this option while in Alaska. I promise you will not be disappointed!!

Had a wonderful with a very experience pilot and guide. He gave a great historical and biological narration. Would definitely recommend this tour to anyone.  Flew in a 1956 dehaviland Beaver.  Great fun with great photo ops.
What amazing up close views of the mountains!  Flying between the snow capped peaks with lots of glaciers.  Learned more about the glacier activity.  The K2 staff was pleasant & helpful.

The windows in the plane allowed for excellent viewing and the pilot adjusted the flight to get the best view from each side of the plane based on cloud conditions. One of the highlights of our vacation. First class operation.

review_title: I’d give it a “6” if I could!
review_text: First AK stop for a couple washed up AF Fighter guys and their boys….wow, it was incredible!  A bluebird day exposed Denali in all her glory, and landing on Ruth Glacier is an experience none of us will ever forget.  The Otter is a great way to fly and Joe was the perfect tour guide and pilot.  Driving through the valleys below the peaks was just incredible…staff was professional and even got some other recommendations from the Owner, Suzanne!  I was worried about the cost, but this experience and memory is priceless!!

One of our top experiences in Alaska! Staff at K2 were efficient and helpful and there was a spot to lock up our backpacks since we could not take them in the plane. They even have sunglasses you can borrow and snow boots that fit over your shoes. Our pilot was great (Joe?). The ride was smooth, he took great care to make sure we could see things from both sides of the plane, talked to us about what we were seeing, and then managed a remarkable landing on the Ruth glacier. How often in your life to do you get to land on a glacier? Truly remarkable and breath taking. Bring your camera and/or little binoculars. Well worth the price.

A must for anyone who stops into Talkenna. A total WOW factor of 10 from all 9 passengers on the plane. Everyone has their own window seat to adventure. Our pilot was very informative on the surrounding topography and answered any questions we had. A totally awesome experience walking on the glacier.  Sunny and 73 degrees the day we landed on Ruth Glacier.  Entire flight staff from Check in, Pilot and Ground Crew is very Professional.  Thanx K2 Aviation for a once in a lifetime adventure!!!

This is a great company.  The entire staff was friendly and helpful from our shuttle driver to the check-in staff and our pilot. The flight was fabulous! Beautiful sites and our pilot told us a lot about the area we saw! The flight was smooth and comfortable.  K2 takes care of everything!

I can't say enough positive things about this amazing experience. It was worth every penny and then some. Will(bur?) was an excellent pilot and a downright excellent human. He was extremely knowledgable, capable, fun, kind and cool. Check-in was easy and enjoyable (the office staff killed it). The 1956 Beaver was a beautiful and meticulously maintained aircraft. I can't imagine enjoying a flight as much as we did with K2 again in my life! Mount Denali and The Alaska Range ranks among the most beautiful and unique terrain in the world, and to be able to fly right next these majestic chunks of rock and ice was nothing less than spiritual ecstasy. A huge thumbs up and thanks to K2 Aviation!

My daughter and I had a great experience with our flight with Chad. He made sure that we are very comfortable during the flight, views that we saw from the plane were amazing and exceeded our expectations on every level.  We were hoping for a landing on glacier, but due to the weather conditions it was not possible. Despite this our flight was very memorable and we would definitely recommend K2 Aviation.

review_title: Great on the glacier family trip
review_text: Fun family trip that got our young family on the glacier and closer than we otherwise would have come to that part of Denali. Took the Park Connection bus 3+ hrs one way from Denali lodge across from Grizzly Bear lodge to Talkeetna and worked well!

What a unique and exciting experience for our entire family! The flight was amazing and we learned so much from our pilot. We were lucky enough to have great weather, so we could actually see Denali. The landing on Ruth Glacier was breathtaking. Our entire family loved the experience - including our teenagers!

This was the most amazing experience we have ever had. Leaving the earth in a beautiful, classic bush plane from the 1950’s. Our pilot, Maury, was clearly in love with the plane and his job. He could not have done a better job of safety orientation, or educating us about what we were getting ready to experience. He was also very good about preparing us for the possibility of turbulence, although we had almost none. There are no words to describe this flight - it was surreal. With headphones, it was amazingly quiet. We saw no other planes while in the sky. Maury did a great job of narration, but also gave us quiet time to just experience this remarkable adventure. We strongly recommend this magical trip to you.

This was a spectacular flight and glacier landing. We booked the day before for June 2 because the weather looked good. The skies were blue which made contrast with snow all the more scenic. We had done the same tour about 10 years ago and so happy to be able to do it again. The on ground facilities were much better and passengers did wear masks for Covid. Each of us had a window seat. The flight was smooth. Even my spouse who gets nervous on commercial flight landings was confident. Highly recommend this activity.

We did a LOT during our weeklong trip to Alaska, and this was, without a doubt, our favorite. Our group was still on a budget, and after much debate, decided to add on the glacier landing. It was WORTH IT. (Seriously - babysit a few times, get a job on the side for a few weeks, whatever you have to do for the $100 upgrade.) We were very lucky to have a clear day, but we were at peace knowing we could cancel if needed due to weather.

Incredible Denali Experience with Glacier Landing - we did it on July 1st - 7:30 pm flight.
Everyone from checkin crew and our fearless pilot (Derek or Erik?) made sure we had an awesome experience.
The landing was smooth and amazing experience. Pilot also let me sit on the copilot seat which was pretty cool.
Super happy and higly recommend K2 aviation

Dorothy was the best pilot we could have had!  She did a fantastic job.  It was my 19th heart transplant anniversary and she went out of her way to make our trip special for me!  I totally recommend the tour to anyone who comes to the area.  The view is just spectacular!

Breathtaking experience. The pilot was amazing & experience, he navigated the flight without any bumps.
Enjoyed it very much. Highly recommend it.

Fabulous experience and worth every penny!!!  We couldn't do our glacial walk, but trust the right decision was made and still over the moon by our experience.   Thanks for an epic fly over one of the most beautiful mountain ranges.  Denali was in full view.

This was one of the highlights of our trip. We had an amazing experience flying with K2. Our pilot, Will, made sure we were comfortable with the plane, safety procedures, and flight plans before boarding. We had amazing tour and were fortunate to be the only plane on the glacier towards the end of the day. We had questioned splurging for the glacier landing, but it was well worth it. The views are stunning!

Pilot was great!  He was very personable and gave us lots of information without interrupting our viewing/photographing of the topography.  Every site up to Denali and all surrounding areas was amazing.  I highly recommend this experience.
Awesome!!! Wilbur our pilot was extremely knowledgeable and helpful. We saw Mt McKinley clearly. Top of our bucket list.

This trip was excellent.  Stan, our pilot, was extremely knowlegeable of the topography and past history.  We weren't able to fly completely around Denali due to high winds, but the aerial views flying around the south side were spectacular.  The landing and takeoff on the glacier was particularly memorable as were the views of the Denali area.  Definitely worth doing,  a memorable experience.

review_title: Highlight of our trip to Alaska
review_text: A highlight of our trip to Alaska! Seeing Denali and landing on a glacier. The pilot was informative.

This was the highlight of my trip to Alaska, and my parents (who are in their 80s) felt the same way.  I'm sorry I don't remember our pilot's name.  He was topnotch.  Beyond that, flying through the mountains, softly landing on the glacier, being surrounded by mile-high granite walls and ice, seeing all of the high peaks--it was extraordinary.

Amazing flight over Denali that included an epic glacier landing. Well organized. Knowledgeable staff. 
We had an amazing time!!

OUTSTANDING!  Great pilots and excellent customer service.  A trip of lifetime! Highly recommend!!!!  The pilot was super on answering questions about what we were looking at and great at trying to provide us the most spectacular tour.
Great staff and our pilot, Stan, was very informative, friendly and safe.  The views cannot be adequately described in words or pictures- you have to see this for yourself.

This is a must do.  From the time they picked us up at our lodge to the time they returned us the people at K2 were wonderful at making us feel safe and welcome.  The pilot was very informative and knowledgeable, answering all our questions and not only was he able to show us Mount Denali but also other points of interest.  Again thank each and everyone at K2 Aviation for making our experience of viewing Denali so memorable.
Great staff and neat experience. I took my family off five and they were great with the kids. I enjoyed landing on the glacier and having a snowball fight with the kids

I had a flightseeing tour with glacier landing with K2 Aviation and it was AMAZING. That was the highlight of my Alaska trip. Seeing the mountains so close as if you could touch them and landing on the glacier was once in a lifetime experience—and the K2 Aviation delivers.

Patrick, our tour pilot, was very good. He was calm taking away any of my fear of flying in a small plane. It’s obvious that he is an experienced pilot, told us what to expect on the flight, will tell us in advance if he will make some turns and the time to
land. He also shared his knowledge about the area and Alaska mountain ranges. Thank you, Patrick, for a safe, smooth and once in a lifetime amazing tour.

The staff of K2 were courteous. I had my original scheduled tour cancelled due to weather, given a choice to be fully refunded or move to another day which I did and it turned out to be gloriously sunny the next day when the elusive Denali showing its glory.

The plane is clean and safety is well practiced. Their color red planes look so beautiful against the snow covered mountains and glacier on the pictures. Also, if you don’t have snow boots—they will provide any sizes that you can put over your footwear. Their facilities are clean too. I think their restrooms were the cleanest among all the public restrooms I used during my trip in Alaska.

The money I spent with this tour is all worth it. It’s a tour of a lifetime. I highly recommend K2 Aviation.

review_title: Glacier Landing and Denali Up Close
review_text: Many thanks to the Talkeetna team and Patrick our Super Pilot!  Great staff, equipment and an awesome once in a lifetime experience.  No promises made and yet the clouds parted above Denali just in time.  The glacier landing was stunning, a highlight of my life and for my wife and daughter as well!  Thanks much K2!
Patrick was an excellent pilot and provided us with a wonderful mountain experience and narrative and of course the glacier landing was the highlight of the experience. We are so glad we did this !!!
Awesome views. Smooth landing on Ruth Glacier.Pilot very knowledgeable. Blue sky day. Made great photos. We absolutely loved it.
Such a great experience! Pilot and staff were informative and helpful at every turn. A must do for anyone in Alaska.
Unforgettable experience. Felt safe the entire time, top notch operation and service. It's not cheap, but it's worth it and will create memories you will never forget.

Ok so i read the bad reviews. I don't understand them.

I arrived in Talkeetna and everything was closed. Sitting in Denial Brew house i needed something to do because everything was closed.  I called K2 and the lady was awesome. I thought about it and called back 5 minutes later to book the trip.  It left in 30 minutes. Stan our pilot introduced himself after an EASY check in with the front desk. I asked Stan if i could copilot and he said the seat was mine. 

Within minutes we were airborne.  10x smoother then and flight ive ever been on. Landing on Denali was crazy smooth. His knowledge was so amazing. 

The only thing that honestly made me upset was that the other 6 people on the flight didn't tip the pilot. That was terrible to witness. 

You can search my name on YouTube and watch our flight.

We had an Amazing trip with Joe flying over Alaska’s magnificent mountains! Our family really enjoyed the beauty and all of Joe’s helpful information and his expertise. The staff is super friendly and very helpful with little ones. This is a MUST experience for the entire family! 
Thank you K2! ❤️

We had a great flight! They were so kind in helping us when there was a weather hold on flights at our reservation time. They got us up later in the day. The pilot would point out features and answer questions during the flight. Was a highlight of our entire Alaska trip.
This was truly a once in a lifetime experience!  Stan was a great pilot and tour guide. Spending a little extra to land on the glacier was well worth the money.

review_title: Cancelled tour. No courtesy call from company ahead to inform
review_text: Didn’t inform me about tour cancellation until I drove 2.5 hrs from Anchorage to reach there.Still awaiting refund

review_title: Great trip - do the glacier landing!
review_text:
Sign up and do this now. I know it’s a little pricey. Just do it. You will not regret it and it will likely be the high point of your trip to Alaska. My family of four had so much fun. Stan, our pilot, was wonderful and provided a very smooth flight. Nice landing on the glacier!  The whole organization was first class, kind and polite. We felt very safe!
Book this and enjoy it!
JC

Plane was well maintained. 
Had a very memorable flight. 
Service was great. Staff worked through having to have an O2 generator. Very accommodating. 
No issues.

Our pilot (Chad) was very informative and friendly, learned a lot on the flight and we were very excited to see all three peaks! Flight was very smooth and the pilot took the time to talk about the airplane specifications with us after we landed.

We loved flightseeing with K2!  We booked the grand tour to do a glacier landing and we were bummed that the weather wasn't good enough to land on the glacier.... however, the flight around Denali without the landing was still AMAZING!  Our pilot was an awesome guide too!  I HIGHLY recommend K2!

The trip was on a classic Dehaviland Otter retrofitted with a turbo-prop engine.I hadn't booked a landing as part of the package, but other on the same excursion had, so I was able to land on the glacier too. This ended up being my favorite part of the trip. Standing on the glacier, there was a beautiful sense of quiet, and the views of the surrounding mountains were superb.  It was easy to get great photos. This is not to say the rest of the trip wasn't great as well. On the way up and back, the frozen ponds, lakes tundra and rivers were striking and otherworldy. From the vantage point of the airplane, we were able to see the flow of the glacier and the slight signs of melting water brought by spring. The pilot was an excellent and genial guide. Definitely worth the money.

From the office check-in,  to the end of trip landing, the whole experience was a 15 on a 1 - 10 scale.  Walking on the Ruth Glacier was surreal.

Bruce and Kathryn Jordan, Palmer, AK

Awesome flight experience! Added the glacier landing which was spectacular! The weather was perfect- 55 degrees and sunny! Our pilot was very knowledgeable and we got some fantastic pictures. Best way to see Denali National Park for sure.

review_title: A once in a lifetime experience
review_text: It was absolutely incredible and the folks at K2 were so good about working around the weather. We were in the area for three days and pushed the trip from the first day to the second because of visibility, pushed from the second to the third for the same reason. On the third day the sun came out and there wasn’t a cloud in the sky. It was beautiful. The staff were responsive, attentive and genuinely care about making sure their guests have a great time.

We did a winter tour and it was so beautiful. If you are in Alaska take a chance on seeing it from above! You take off from Talkeetna so it is a short trip to see Denali close up. They accommodated our two year old in his car seat so family friendly. 10/10 would recommend.
We enjoyed the beautiful scenery and landing on Ruth Glacier.  Our pilot was knowledgeable and informative.

review_title: Excellent exp would def do again!
review_text: Highly recommend. Pilot was very educated! The plane ride was extremely smooth. A definite must do! :)

Our Pilot Chris, was excellent.  He was a great guide, very knowledgeable, as well as a fine pilot.  Our flight was very comfortable and the views tremendous. Being Alaska residents for many I've done two other flight seeing trips near Denali, and K2 was my favorite.

I went on this tour for my birthday and couldn’t be happier I did. I am a larger person and they accommodated me with ease. The flight was smooth and Denali was out in all of its glory. 100% recommend this to anyone visiting Alaska!

As one might imagine, flightseeing in  Denali National Park is always breathtaking but what made our experience unique with K2 Aviation was their responsiveness.  It was a cold, clear, sunny morning on November 1.  We knew it was last minute but we took a chance anyway and called K2 to see if they could take our party of 3 out that same afternoon.  Sarah was most pleasant, helpful and accommodating on the phone. When we arrived in Talkeetna, we discovered a new, clean and welcoming facility.  Our pilot, Chad, was friendly, safe and very informative.  We were safely back on the ground within 5 hours of making our initial call.  This is a very safe and efficient operation offering spectacular flightseeing tours of Denali.

Our tour guide, Bryan (?) was incredible!
He made it a point to give us equal views of the mountain no matter what seat we were in :)
The flight was extrememly smooth, no turbulence! 
It was adventurous to wear the headset, like a real pilot and felt secure to have on board the survival gear...incase :) 
The pilot was also an excellent photographer who took exceptional photos of us outside the plane!
Don't forget to dress warm, especially in the fall time ;)
By the way, they offer warm shoes, incase you forgot yours!
On of the what things I’ve done! The people are sweetest and our pilot, Chris was amazing!! Highly recommend K2A!

This trip was jaw dropping to my son and myself 
We’re very excited and grateful for this opportunity and experience 
I certainly recommend everyone to go 
It’ll be best ever experience of your life

review_title: Flying over Denali with Kahiltna Glacier Landing
review_text: I highly recommend this flightseeing tour. Its the yellow tour offered on the K2 aviation tour brochure. The whole process from speaking to a person at the office, booking the tour, doing the tour and after tour service were all done professionally. Cris our pilot was very good at explaining everything we had to know prior to departure, explaining the sites we were seeing and most of all how to operate his aircraft. A once in a lifetime experience was landing on the Kahiltna glacier. Will do it again with Cris.

This was a fantastic experience!  To see the sheer beauty and majesty of Mt. Denali and Denali National Park from the air is unbelievable. Words and pictures don't do it justice. It was soooo much fun!  We had a great time!
We got very lucky and had a beautiful day. The prior day's flights were wiped out by a snowstorm on the mountain (while we enjoyed perfect weather on a lake below). Turns out K2 has a generous rescheduling policy. We had scheduled for the "good day" yet Erica called me directly to ask if we could shuffle a bit to help out with guests from the prior day. She gave me a few options and left the decision to alter our plans or not up to me. She and I talked and joked for a while then, in the end, we shifted our reservation by an hour. It was great to meet her in person in Talkeetna. She was super friendly and thanked us again and again for being flexible.
Before boarding the plane, our pilot, Chris, did a great job of putting everyone at ease with a few jokes while explaining how the flight would go and telling us about the plane's safety features. During the flight, he pointed out landmarks, gave us info on the area, and told stories about the mountains. He was very fun and personable and fielded questions from passengers during the flight.
We couldn't be happier with the service from K2. They made the entire experience very, very memorable.
We were fortunate to have good weather.  I'm sceptical of all tourist excursions, but this tour was amazing.

I surprised my mother with a flightseeing tour over Denali, and it was awesome!  We went on a beautiful, clear morning, and were able to cruise around so many mountain peaks and into infinity.  Stan, the pilot, was very kind and interesting, too!  I could not recommend this enough!  They offer a discount for Alaskan residents, too, which was really great!  Thank you so much, K2!

The entire flight was awesome!  They received snow the night before on the Glacier so we were not able to land on the glacier.  The views were amazing.
Chad our Pilot did a GREAT JOB!  Explained what we were looking at.
Everything was excellent! Great weather,  breathtaking views! Denali Park looks amazing from the sky! Definitely worth the money!
Chris was a great pilot, it was really a memorable experience. It is as cool and as impressive as we had hoped. Much cooler than the bus tour.

Very cool experience and one not to be missed!  If you're going to be near Denali take the trip!  Pilots and staff are super professional!  we have awesome pictures and memories of Denali and would go again

What an incredible experience - it is hard to put into words how it feels to be flying among the mountains of the park - we had incredible weather and saw Denali, mountains, glaciers, lakes, rivers, rainbows....the list goes on. 

Chad was a great pilot. He worked hard throughout the trip to take us to some really special places, constantly checking in about changes in weather so he could take us cooler and cooler places. The time went by so fast after looking at one amazing view after the next. His excitement about flying and being on the trip was contagious! We felt very confident and safe in his plane as well - he was a very attentive and skilled pilot. 

We also felt very safe and comfortable with the covid precautions K2 took all the way from the office building to the plane. 

We will definitely be back and I will send all my friends and family from in and out of state K2’s way!

review_title: Highlight of Our Trip to Alaska
review_text: Wow! This was an incredible experience. Our pilot was professional, informative, trustworthy, and fun. He provided interesting information along the route and checked in regularly. This was a highlight of our time in Alaska. The mountain peaks are brilliant and the glacier landing was definitely worth the extra money. I strongly recommend this adventure.
The whole trip was excellent. pilot narrated features throughout the flight, captured awesome pictures!
Chris was a great pilot, all the staff was friendly and the experience was fantastic. It was definitely worth it!
It was awesome! Our pilot was very informative and intelligent, and did great flying the plane. We never felt uncomfortable! We had a great time and would love to go again in the future.

review_title: Amazing trip! So worth the price!
review_text: Knowledgeable and friendly pilot who described all we were seeing. Smooth flight and easy landing. Just an amazing once in a lifetime experience to get so close to the mountain!

review_title: Beautiful day icing on cake of terrific flight
review_text: We did the glacier landing tour and some of the Denali Range. We had an exceptional day to fly and the landscape was breathtaking. We did a bus tour the previous day and it was wonderful to see the mountains from a different perspective. I had some trepidation’s about this flight but our pilot Chris was terrific and I am so glad I went. The plane held 10 people and we felt the sight lines were very good for all. Even sitting with the strut by my seat I was able to get some great pictures. Well worth doing and I highly recommend this company. Very professional in all aspects.

Absolutely one of the top highlights of my recent trip to Alaska. We had signed up for the glacier landing and at check in were told that it was going to be too foggy to land. While we were disappointed and were given the option to reschedule, we didn’t have the schedule flexibility so we agreed to fly without the landing, which we were still very excited about.  Once up in the air, our terrific pilot, Chris, had been eying the potential glacier landing field and decided that the conditions were much better than earlier and fog had cleared enough for a safe landing under the premise that we would need to be ready to leave should he sense the conditions changing once on the ground. Standing on the glacier in complete silence listening to rocks falling, glacial water rushing, was one of the most surreal experiences ever. Would 100% recommend this trip and the landing is absolutely worth it.  Honorable mention to the way that the bright red plane pops on the white snow in all of our amazing pictures. Thanks, Chris and K2 aviation for the unforgettable experience! 

Also, for anyone traveling in the current pandemic climate, K2’s COVID procedures felt very safe and clean and I feel they are doing a great job putting safety first.

review_title: One of the highlights of my 2-week trip
review_text: I was able to squeeze in a quick tour at the end of a two-week trip after my flight home was delayed a day, and I'm glad that it worked out - this tour was one of the highlights of my trip. Flying over and around the mountains was an almost surreal experience, even after having spent 8 days backpacking through the wilderness just north of the same mountains. My pilot and guide Chris was knowledgeable, accommodating, skilled, and very friendly - his steady piloting and narration throughout the trip added to an already amazing trip. I can't recommend this highly enough - I'll remember my flight for the rest of my life and am already looking forward to a future opportunity to re-live it.

Our flight with K2 Aviation was a wonderful experience! Our pilot was extremely friendly and knowledgeable. They were covid conscious. They called and gave us the option to shift our flight time based on the weather to give us the best views possible. They also gave us extra time in our flight to see Denali base camp. Definitely a great time!
Landing on the glacier was a first, even as a pilot myself. I sat in the ‘jump seat’. Stan was a superb pilot/guide. Stan knew they ridges and names.  I would recommend this adventure to anyone.

review_title: The red planes look amazing in photos!
review_text:
There are a few things that set this trip apart for us;
1.) Our pilot, Chris, gave us one of the smoothest flights I have ever been on (sorry Delta).  I wasn't necessarily expecting a bumpy ride but I also never expected it to be so flawless.  The take-off and landing were almost effortless.  I also appreciated the narration by Chris.
2.) You guys, the red plane looks absolutely stunning in every photo we took.  It's only August and I might as well start making the Holiday cards.  If you are torn between two companies, choose the one with the red planes as the color will simply pop in every picture you have.  And if you are really thinking ahead, throw some Santa hats into your luggage and stage the perfect Christmas photo right there in Alaska.
3.)  Do the glacier landing.  I struggled to bite the bullet on this with our family of 5 but after a week in Alaska and lots of spendy excursions, this is the one I truly don't regret. Worth every single dollar.  We did the most basic flight but added the glacier landing and it was everything we could've dreamed.

Enjoy this amazing part of the world.

Capitalized on a brief window of good weather on August 1st. We flew for about an hour and got to see the Great Gorge and the peak of Denali (from below). Absolutely MUST DO when visiting the Denali area. Our pilot and the ground staff were great.
What an incredable thing to do!  A must do if you are there. The views are amazing.  I just can't say enough about the knowledge of our pilot and the views.
Most scenic flight I have ever done. Flying with the plane in the mountain range was incredible. And the glacier landing was just unique. Pilot was also very knowledgeable.

review_title: Once in a life time experience
review_text: Pilot was fabulous with all of his knowledge of the mountains and surrounding area. Very professional!

Everyone at K2 was amazing! I had to shuffle a few things around (more than once, I might add) and they worked with me to make sure I was able to get up in the air when I would be there. 

Once up in the Stan, our pilot, was very knowledgeable and friendly and made sure we all got to see the good stuff!

This flyover was the highlight of our trip!  We had never been on a plane of that size before and we felt completely comfortable riding with Chris.  Five year old Frances felt so comfortable on the plane that she fell asleep towards the end of the trip.  🤗

AMAZING! Booked our tour for a brief break in our drive from Denali to Seward, hoping to see the mountain. We were told upon arrival that they would be willing to book us in a later date or give us a refund because of how cloudy it was, but since we were in a schedule we decided to just go for it and see what we could see. Our pilot was SUPER knowledgeable, we didn't expect a fully narrated flight! He also found an opening in the weather to get us a view of the three big mountains and got a beautiful flight up kahiltna glacier. He made sure we were comfortable the entire trip. Also had very good covid mitigation, masks required and plane disinfected between trips. 12/10 would recommend! I'm a local Alaskan and this was one of my favorite tourist things I've done

Absolutely one of the most incredible experience of our Alaskan vacation.   My family spent two weeks In Alaska & this was the highlight of our trip.    I highly recommend the glacier landing.   Minutes after our plane landed, we were able to experience an avalanche off in the distance.     

Absolutely the best way to experience Denali

This is one of the top 3 tourist activities I have ever done.  The entire flight and landing was so memorable.  The pilot was engaging.  The sites were incredible.  Landing on a glacier next to Denali was unforgettable.  Even Ernie, who was our driver from our hotel, was amazing.  This is a MUST DO while in Talkeetna;  spare no expense, it is worth every penny.

review_title: Glacier Landing was a once in a lifetime experience!
review_text: K2 has a very professional and engaging staff from the minute you enter the building to the minute you leave the airplane doing everything they can to make your trip enjoyable and memorable.

If you are in the Talkeenta area, you need to do this! We had an amazing - like best thing we've done in our life, experience. Flying into the mountains and being able to land on the glacier and see the beauty of everything was breathtaking! Everyone we worked with was also very nice, helpful, and knowledgeable!
Ryan was a superior pilot.  Great experience!  A must-do AK experience.  Staff helpful, kind.  Would recommend for sure!

Absolutely amazing experience!  Truly a once in a lifetime opportunity!  Our flight time had to be re-scheduled due to weather and K2 was proactive and professional in making the change.  We flew up to and around the Denali peak, landed in a glacier field at the base of the mountain and got to explore the ice field.  The flight back was fantastic as we came off the snow and back into the green forested fields.
Amazing experience!  The glacier landing is worth every penny!  Add it to your trip, you won't regret it!

Not enough stars to rate our experience!! Went to Alaska on a limited budget so was very leery about what I spent my money on. Came back with an experience we will never forget!! Don't hesitate to think about it, just do it!!!

it was an amazing experience. Staff was really nice and welcoming. Pilot was really experienced, he warned us before every bumps, it was really smooth. On the other side, the tour was breathtakingly amazing. I don't think I can compare what I saw with anything I have seen before. I highly suggest everyone to take this tour. again thanks to everyone who works there.
Plus; there was a receptionist lady gave me a poster with the painting of Denali. That was really nice of her.

review_title: Spellbinding experience words don't do justice
review_text: From the moment we took off to the moment we landed back at the airport we were all spellbound!  The ride was amazing and I would highly recommend it.  We landed on Ruth Glacier and it was a smooth and comfortable take off and landing.  The view from the sky is spectacular.  From the ground Denali is beautiful but from the air you get a better understanding of the size, scope and vastness of the mountain.  We definitely thought this was the highlight of our 10 day visit to Alaska.
Our Pilot was so professional and made the whole experience fun! Even got shuttled to and from the train station. One of the best things I could’ve done while in Alaska. Thank you so much K2!
This experience was by far the highlight of my trip to Alaska! I got to ride co-polit which was awesome and the guide was very knowledgeable. The family that was along for the ride was nice as well!

Our experience was awesome! 

They waterproof shoes that slipped over our own boots for the glacier landing. Our experience was during Covid-19 and the whole staff took extra precautions to ensure our safety and the cleanliness of their airport and planes along with other equipment we came into contact with. 

There was some questionable weather in the amphitheater (where they land the plane on the glacier) but our pilot said we would fly in and see how it was when we got there. Luckily, it cleared up and we were able to land. The landing was flawless - which I imagine is not an easy feat on snow and skis. Our pilot took photos of us, taught us so much about glaciers and the surrounding mountains, and was pretty funny as well. He turned the plane a lot to make sure everyone on both sides could see the same things. I have never seen anything more beautiful in my life and I am so happy we sprung for the glacier landing. He also gave us some local tips for places to eat and things to see. I even got to sit copilot on the way back - which was super cool. 

On the way back, the landing into Talkeetna airport was just as perfect as the one on the glacier. I was shocked at how smooth both landings were. I would do this again in a heartbeat - it was worth every penny.

review_title: Tour of Denali with glacier landing
review_text: Fly towards Denali and landing on the glacier. Excellent trip, weather was perfect, Chris the pilot was a professional at all times and had detail knowledge of being a tour guide and still have the professional skills to maintain discipline needed as a professional pilot to get around the unforgiving terrain of Denali. The flight was supper safe, o couldn’t even tell when we landed on the glacier, it was that smooth.

Flying over Denali Park is an incredible experience and K2 runs a first class operation making it happen. Weather can always be a factor in changing your flight path or cancelling altogether and K2 keeps you posted on all changes that arise. It's apparent that safety is their top priority. Really enjoyed the experience - highly recommend K2 for flightseeing!
The flight tour was amazing I would highly recommend it for all ages.  It was very easy to get signed up and they really have a top notch facility and planes.

Stunning !!! Best way to experience Denali !!! The staffs were so friendly and accommodating. We had a wonderful pilot. He was funny, friendly and very knowledgeable. At that height, if you don't have confidence on the pilot - you lose it..LOL. The landing experience was out of the world and we were given sufficient time to experience the vastness of it. If you can afford it and have time, please don't miss it. They have a wonderful team and tours.

review_title: 5/5 An experience you could won’t soon forget.
review_text: Great Safe professional experience. Definitely recommending to friends and family. The K2 staff was very accommodating and helpful.

We decided to go on a flightseeing tour, last minute.  K2 Aviation was able to accommodate us.  We went up, and our pilot pointed out fun stuff as we headed toward Denali.  He took us over Hunter Mountain and flew around so we could look for the two hikers ascending the mountain.  We had spectacular views and our pilot told us everything.  It was an incredible experience and well worth the money.  I felt safe and had a great time!!!!  I strongly recommend K2 Aviation!!

Wow, this was a great experience.  You really don't grasp the size of this mountain until you get up there in it, an awesome perspective that you can't get from the ground.  Our guide was Dallas, he was very personable, informative, and made us feel completely safe during the entire flight.  This flight was easily worth the price, I would do it again and Highly Recommend.
Our tour guide was informative and would double up on particularly great views. I would highly recommend.

As part of our overall Alaska experience, our vacation group (2 couples) did the Denali Experience Flightseeing Tour.  We loved every minute of it!  Our pilot, Ryan, was very personable, knowledgeable and fun during the trip.  He offered lots of information during the flight and explained what mountains/glaciers we were seeing.  I would recommend this tour to anyone interested.  Well worth the money!!

We decided to go with K2 and drive ourselves to Talkeetna from Anchorage--it saved us money and in the end they were great! We enjoyed the amazing views. Our pilot talked and informed us all along the way in local history, geology facts, etc. Would recommend to anyone. I even tend to get a little sick on small planes and I did okay. Pilot was kind to me and made gentle turns :).

The views of the mountains, glaciers, rivers, and valleys was incredible. This was so much better than just seeing Denali from the ground.  The birds eye view was amazing. I highly recommend a tour with K2 Aviation for your Alaska trip.

review_title: Experience the very best of Alaska
review_text: Jst got off the plane and I could not wait to review K2. We had a wonderful experience today flying over Denali. The flight felt very safe and warm. I did not even have to wear my gloves. Doug, our pilot was very friendly and an amazing guide. During the flight, I noticed some ice caves and Doug was kind enough to help us get a closer look at the caves. We also saw so many mooses. Special thanks to Ernie at the desk, she was very helpful and gave us a lot of information about things to do around Talkeetna and Anchorage. Wonderful experience!! 10/10

This was the high of our trip! The views were stunning and the pilot was very nice and knowledgeable. Absolutely loved this experience and would highly recommend to anyone! I am even afraid of heights but you forget it all when viewing the mountains.

This was an amazing trip. Our pilot was excellent and the views we got were incredible. 
Would highly recommend this to anyone who is interested.
Amazing smooth, fun experience. Had great close up views and a great pilot Billy. This is a definite to do when visiting Denali

If you are looking for an experience you will never forget, go on a tour with K2! We were lucky to have a beautiful day with spectacular fall colors and mostly clear skies. Our pilot was friendly and knowledgable. He provided narration about Denali National Park as we flew and was open to questions. He also made sure to maneuver the plane so both sides had the best views possible! It was surreal seeing Denali, especially from such an unique vantage point. The tour would have been worth it for this, but to top it off, we also landed on a glacier! Our pilot made the landing look easy and we got to exit the plane and walk around a little. It was serene and magical. We will forever be grateful for the memories we made on this trip. Thank you K2!!

Our pilot, Mark, was excellent.  He was very personable, and gave us lots of information about what we were seeing.  The views of Denali and its glaciers were amazing.  I would absolutely do this again!  This was the highlight of our trip to Alaska.

My wife and I booked the Denali Experience with Glacier Landing for August 29.
  
K2 arranged pick-up and drop off service for us at the Talkeetna Lodge.  The transfers were completed smoothly.   We were informed that since Alaska experienced one of the warmest summers on records the snow on Denali was too soft to conduct the glacier landing.   I had been following the latest Tripadvisor reviews and anticipated this situation, disappointing, but totally understandable.  Since the tour was prepaid our credit card was reimbursed in a timely manner.

The plane has a capacity of 10 or 11 passengers and we had seven clients on this trip.   You are provided with headphones which permit the pilot to narrate information during the flight.   The headphones also contained a microphone which allows you to ask questions during the experience.

Each customers has a window seat which provides excellent views and an opportunity for unobstructed photography.  Frequently the pilot would maneuver the plane so the passengers on the right side would have a view of a glacier/mountain/point of interest and then adjust the route so the passengers on the left side would have a similar view.

Due to the Swan Lake fire the visibility directly after take-off was less than ideal.   The pilot indicated this would clear up as we gained altitude and approached the mountain range.   He was 100% correct as visibility was excellent as we approached Denali.

The day before we were fortunate to observe  Denali as we exited the park.   K2 provided an entirely different visual experience.  The excursion is definitely on the expensive side, but since this was likely our one and only trip to Alaska it was totally worth it.  

The Denali Experience is the basic of the three tours that K2 offers, for us the length of time in the air was satisfactory.

K2 did an outstanding job for us. We are now in the 10% club who have actually seen the summit thanks to K2. Safety was a top priority and the pilot did a great job narrating and ensuring everyone got a good view. We saw Denali, Hunter and the Ruth glacier. 

Not to be missed.

I spent 10 days in Alaska with a friend,and our flightseeing tour was a definite highlight! Our pilot was very personable, knowledgeable, and safety conscious. We were supposed to do the slightly longer tour, but due to clouds it was shortened to the one hour flight. It was breathtaking. My friend asked if she could sit in the co-pilot seat and enjoyed it so much (She said it was "not for the faint-of-heart" lol) I've included a picture she took that has the propeller showing as we approached Denali. The glaciers were incredible to view and we were lucky to have blue skies at Denali's summit. It was Sept 5th and the fall colors were beautiful. We were still awestruck for several hours after the flight. I wish I could remember our pilot's name (I think Daniel?) because he was great.  Thanks K2!

Our flight could have been a disappointment: clouds kept us from seeing Denali up close and the lack of fresh snow prevented the glacier landing. Despite all that, it was still an astonishing and beautiful experience. The flight was smooth and the relatively slow speed meant you could really take in the view...and what a view. This landscape is part of what makes Alaska such a remarkable place and there is just no other way to get this perspective. One of the highlights of our trip.

I had a blast flying around Denali and looking at the mountains and glaciers up close. It was stunning.  The K2 facilities and the plane were clean and well kept.  The staff was pleasant and professional.

Excellent customer service, I love Ericka, she attended me in spanish, my languaje, and  made me feel comfortable,   The plane works perfect and the pilot was incredible skilled, I don't know his name but he drives the two engine plane. Me and my friend, we felt totally safe and enjoyed the whole trip

We had the best pilot,Steve, and he was so knowledgeable about the area. The views were amazing! They were so accommodating with my husbands limited mobility (he has a fractured ankle). The weather was not good the day we planned so we moved it to another day and they were so helpful and willing to change.

Fabulous! Our pilot, Dan was excellent in narrating the 1+ hour flight around Denali and the surrounding areas. Excellent views from both sides of the plane. 
Even though we had partly cloudy skies, he took advantage to vary the elevations and slight turning of the plane for the best views. We could not do the Glacier landing as the weather did not cooperate for a safe landing and takeoff but other than that, the experience should be on everyone's bucket list.

We made a last minute decision to fly. We were rewarded with an outstanding part of our visit to Denali area. We were blessed with incredible views of Denali and the surrounding peaks. Our pilot Jeff was awesome and the staff at their headquarters friendly and professional. Once in a lifetime experience worth the investment. Highly recommend.

review_title: This tour was the highlight of our trip to Alaska!
review_text:
We decided at the last moment to splurge and take this tour. After all, how often does one go to Denali? The weather was spectacular (we were told by many locals that it was unusual to have a clear day).  Our pilot, Stan, was excellent & entertaining.  But Denali was breathtaking. Even now, nearly a month after our trip, words can't describe how incredible it all was.  Check out my photos.

If you're on the fence about whether or not to spend to money to do this, I say do it. It's the opportunity of a lifetime!

We booked this tour at the last minute and are so glad we did.   It was one of the coolest things we've done. Even though it was overcast the pilot was able to climb up and we got a beautiful view of Denali above the clouds.  It's hard to find the words to describe the enormity of the glaciers.   So glad we got to experience this! We definitely would recommend this tour.

review_title: Don’t miss out on beautiful views!!!
review_text: Very awesome company!! Would recommend to anyone! Really exciting way to see Alaska! Very cool view of Denali! Everyone wears headphones to hear and talk to the pilot which is a nice touch. He answers questions and tells some interesting facts! Very fun! Worth every penny.

Despite the wildfire smoke and limited visibility, this was still absolutely breathtaking. Our pilot was excellent - soft spoken, knowledgeable, I couldn't have felt like I was in safer hands. Everything was just perfect.

We took the Denali Experience flightseeing tour from Talkeetna.  It was a safe and beautiful flight. Originally we had booked the Grand Tour, but weather conditions prevented the two hour flight. K2 Aviation was very good in keeping us informed of weather, our options to select another tour, reschedule and/or cancel.  All the staff was welcoming and friendly. The pilot was knowledgeable and did a good job of pointing out highlights of scenery and answering questions.  Great tour. We definitely recommend.

My flying was cancelled twice due to no fly days because of high winds. Finally good weather & great time. Pilot Billy very friendly & provided narration for entire trip. Unable to have glacier landing but csr service very prompt on crediting my credit card. They also keep you up to date on flying status & weather via email. Well worth the wait. Did have bit of headache afterwards due to vibration & noise but would do it 
again (& again)

From the moment we signed up for our flight tour, K2 clearly communicated with us about payment, the flight, etc.  The flight itself was tremendous: I got the feeling that they had really thought through the best flight path for the tour.  And, we landed on a glacier!  I liked that we were able to spend some time on the glacier itself.  Our pilot was excellent!  Overall, a great company and experience.

review_title: Once In A Life Time Trip
review_text: Highly recomend the flightseeing tour with glazier landing. Was one of most exciting things I have ever done

What an awesome experience! Our plane had 9 passengers. You can ask the pilot to ride shot gun to have a front row seat. We opted for the Denali Experience with Glacier Landing. They provided snow boots that you put over your shoes and shades in case you forget. Pilot is experienced in doing the glacier landing. You spend around 15 minutes on the glacier. View is just breathtaking. We were the only ones on the glacier. Flight was smooth but it smelled of diesel fuel. Highly recommended. Price is expensive but if you have extra cash the experience is worth it.

This tour was a once in a lifetime experience! We were able to see the most beautiful views of Denali. All the employees were friendly, courteous, and extremely knowledgeable about the park. It was absolutely incredible!

review_title: A once in a lifetime experience.  WOW
review_text: This was a once in a lifetime experience.  The higlight of our trip to Alaska.  Staff was courtious and well informed.   Helped us thru the process step by step.  Felt very safe throughout the flight, pilot was friendly answering questions and interacting with the attendees.

We thought we were going to be disappointed because the weather stopped us from seeing Denali mountain and we couldn't land on the glacier.
We were wrong, it was the highlight of our trip to Alaska! 
Everything looked so different from the air and the pilot was so knowledgeable and went out of his way to make sure it was so special.

While the glaciers do not disappoint the reason most people want to take the tours is to see Denali. 
Since the weather OFTEN prevents you from seeing the mountain but allows you to fly below the clouds to see the glaciers this is the most common tour.  
Are the views amazing?  Yes!   Is it worth the cost to not see Denali?   Debatable.

We gave it a shot and picked a day with 20% rain, turned out fine with cloud surrounding Mckinley but got to see the summit. TIp 1. Don't pick flight with the twin engine, if you are unlucky to sit on the wing that will ruin the view. Looks like there is only one such plane at K2. Tip 2. Request seat with the pilot, the bonus panoramic front view is awesome but picure will show the prop. There is seat pocket on the door to keep cell or extra lens, bino. 

My family w 3 teenagers were absolutely thrilled. It's the highlight of our Alaskan trip. If you can affort the extra 100 bucks for glacier landing do it. Even if just flying through the park and see the rugged terrain up cloase is quite an experience. Our flight path was different from advertised, I guess was due to cloud. We landed on Kahiltna Glacier and didn't fly to Ruth or Tokositna Glaciers.

Class A operation from start to finish.  Beautiful new office facility with a video of what we were going to experience.  Great pilot Will was very informative and[professional. Overall a must do attraction in Alaska.  One you will never forget!
Wonderful flight. Heavy smoke meant no view of Denali from the ground or in the park. But a couple of thousand feet up and the view was perfect! Totally clear day. Great pilot and experience!

The K2 Aviation team went above and beyond tommake sure we were able to have the full experience, even though we booked a little last minute. The flightseeing tour was awesome and they made sure we made it back to our hotel shuttle on time! Great outfit and we endorse them 100%.

review_title: Our pilot was great! Very personable and knowledgeable with out having to fill every second with talking.
review_text: The operation was professional from start to finish! Check in, pre-flight, boarding, the tour and de-planing.  The plane and all facilities were clean and well maintained.  And, of course, nothing can match the majesty of Denali. Highly recommend!
Fantastic experience!  The fly-in/hiking was the best experience that we had during our Alaska vacation.

The plane and pilot were first rate. We only saw the tip of Denali because of clouds (disappointing because k-2 reports said otherwise that morning). The trip was expensive for the results. The glaciers were impressive.

review_title: AMAZING!!!!!!  A must do to truly experience Alaska!
review_text: You can’t experience Alaska without doing this.  It was the highlight of our trip.  Words can not describe the incredible views that will be imprinted in my mind forever.  Our pilot was awesome!!!!  Bring your camera!  You’re  sure to take hundreds of unbelievable photos!!!!!!

Decided to spend the money on a flight tour of Denali. For a family of 5, it’s quite expensive...but...
worth every penny.  My God, the scenery from above cannot be out matched. Sooooo beautiful!! Captain Wilbur ensured a safe and smooth flight, pointing out all the highlights along the way . My kids ( 16,14 & 12 ) were a little nervous at start, but after the first 10 minutes got used to the small plane and couldn’t stop taking pictures. Thanks captain Will and K2 for an amazing, unforgettable experience!
Stan was an amazing pilot and an even better tour guide!  I would definitely recommend this experience to everyone!!  Thank you K2!

So incredible. We did the Denali summit tour and landed on the glacier.Our family of 4 went and it exceeded everyone's expectations which is hard to with us, ranging from 16-48 yrs old. We had clear views and beautiful weather. The staff at K2 were great to work with from the very beginning and we loved out pilot. Highly recommend!!
A beautiful tour. Our pilot Jeff was perfect for this excursion. Very knowledgeable about the area and terrain. Breathtaking views.

review_title: Great time and even better pilot
review_text: Although the weather curtailed our flight the sites were still incredible and the pilot was the absolute best. First class service!
