It was easier and better than expected!! 6 of us flew evening of July 30 and luckily we had clear views of all mountain peaks!  Super smooth ride, incredible close up views! So glad we went! Great experience.

It has been a amazing experience. Landing on the glacier and view this unique surroundings was special. The K2 flight company offered a great service with a reasonable price.
Recommended.

review_title: Best Flightseeing Tour and Company I’ve Ever Seen
review_text: Absolutely amazing experience all around. I was hesitant at first because it was my first time on a small plane, but the pilot was so personable and really perfected the experience. Stunning views that you can’t get anywhere else in Alaska and I also learned so much about the area. Definitely a must for anyone traveling that wants an experience of a lifetime.

Originally signed up for the Summit Tour with Glacier landing but due to clouds, couldn't be done. But thankfully, the Denali Experience could happen. Something was better than nothing. We were able to see the top of Denali which pictures don't do this justice. Our pilot was so knowledgeable and had a blast flying around in a tiny plane. All the staff of K2 is very friendly. Definitely recommend for sure!

Our family took this tour last week (my husband, kids aged 15, 11, and 11, and me). It was fantastic. The views of the mountains were terrific. Landing on the glacier was a lifetime highlight. The amphitheater where we landed is so beautiful. We were initially scheduled to go on a Saturday. The weather wasn't cooperating, and we would have had to do a different tour. They let us reschedule to the following Tuesday when we would be driving back through Talkeetna on our way back from Denali. It worked out great. Chris, our pilot, was a wealth of information and handled the plane extremely well. We would definitely do this again, and the kids loved it too.

Outstanding!  Even though we could not fly all the way around Denali due to weather, the glacier landing and viewing was breathtaking.  Must do.  They discounted our package as the weather restricted the flight path.  Landed near Sheldon homestead.  Entire K-2 team was great.

review_title: Astounding beauty, One of a kind experience
review_text: I literally cried a little - it was so awesome and breathtaking! Landing on the glacier (though I have been on many) was thrilling and stunningly beautiful - don't miss it. Stan was a knowledgeable, interesting guide and a great pilot. If you feel nervous - you are in safe hands. Also there is a lot of working around the weather - so be patient. The tour group really is trying to get you the best view and keep you safe. This is one of the best tours I have ever taken!

Wonderful! We had originally signed up for the glacier experience, but the weather wasn't cooperating. The staff was willing to let us switch and let any members of our party back out with a full refund....that never happens! We did the flight seeing tour instead and it was amazing. Our pilot, Wilbur, is now my favorite person in Talkeetna. He was calming and informative and fabulous!
We very much enjoyed the trip to the glacier. An experienced and knowledgeable pilot.We would highly recommend the excursion.

review_title: Landing on a glacier is awesome!
review_text: We had a fantastic experience! Chris is an excellent pilot and guide. He shared personal experiences with us and is a wealth of knowledge.  We got a beautiful view of the area. Landing on a glacier is incredible! We laid on it and even threw a couple of ice balls at each other.  We highly recommend

I had seen these flight advertised before and was tempted to book a flight but wasn’t totally sure. My husband and I did end up booking a flight and it was the best decision ever. The weather was perfect in fact so great that our pilot gave us extra 15 minutes because he himself enjoyed it so much and the weTher isn’t always so nice. The landing on the glacier was smooth and standing there on the ice was a wonderful experience I will never forget. The flight was expensive but worth every single penny.

We did the "Denali Experience" without the glacier landing.
Seeing Mt Denali was on my Mom's bucket list but at the time we visited the national park the visibility was poor.  We called a couple of flight tour companies to see if we could get closer.  We quickly dismissed the idea once we got prices from a couple of companies in Denali!  We had to drive to Anchorage so I decided to see if there were any options on the way and found K2.  Their price was half as much, they had an aircraft that could accommodate our large party of 8 adults, and I made the reservation just the day before!  All the staff we dealt with over the phone and in person were great.  The pilot was fantastic and did an amazing job getting us a view of Mt Denali and knew everything about the glacial and geological history of the area. 
 Totally worth the drive to Talkeetna, especially if you're headed to Anchorage anyway.  I wouldn't hesitate to use K2 again.
We were not able to fly due to weather and they were gracious to book us the next day and we had a wonderful time. Beautiful sights and fun to land in the glacier!
Within 30 minutes of asking "Have You Got a Flight Available?" we were wheels up. Caught a peak of the Denali summit through the skill and passion of pilot Doug.

Flight was cancelled due to wildfire smoke and ultimately for safety reasons. I’m leaving this review as a testament that K2 Aviation only flies when it’s safe and will cancel flights for safety reasons.  Although disappointed about having trip canceled, it’s better to be safe than sorry.

review_title: Wonderful experience of the Denali Experience With Glacier Landing via K2
review_text:
That is a Wonderful experience of the Denali Experience With Glacier Landing via K2. It's amazing feeling to view the Denaly and the Glaciers from sky. The pilot tried his best to make sure everyone in the plane could see the viewpoints. During landing the glacier, the pilot helped to take picture for all of us. 

If you travel to Alaska, don't miss the activity -- Denali Experience With Glacier Landing via K2.

We missed this tour on our previous trip and were so glad to take it this time.  Beautiful views of the mountains and glaciers!  Our pilot did a great job with narration and keeping us informed of distances and other planes.  We even got a look at Denali which we missed the previous day in the park.  This was the highlight of our trip!!!

review_title: Breathtaking experience you just have to do!
review_text: K2 was our favorite experience of our entire week in Alaska! Though we couldn’t land on the glacier due to poor weather conditions, the flight experience was breathtaking! The staff and pilot were all exceptional and skilled. No matter where you sat on the plane you couldn’t get a bad picture because the pilot took you to a little slice of heaven! It was an unforgettable experience and I highly recommend it! It is a must in AK!

This was a fabulous excursion!  The pilot made sure everyone on the plane could see the sights as he was pointing things out.  Such a beautiful view of Denali and the glaciers!  Highly worth it!!  It was the highlight of our Alaska trip.

We’re from Anchorage and spent the 4th of July camping in Talkeetna. We woke up and meandered into K2, not expecting to go flying that day. They made us an offer we couldn’t refuse and that afternoon all 6 of us were up in the air flying around Denali!
Our kids 7,5,3 and 9months did great. Car seats were provided for the youngest two. The pilot was so attentive about every detail and explained the process and safety to us. He was so welcoming to our children! 
Seeing this mountain up close after having lived near it for over 10 years was breathtaking. The different amphitheaters with hanging glaciers were simply amazing. The range of mountains - the Alaskan Range - just keeps going on and on and on!! 
It was an epic flight. If you’re hesitant about flying, like I initially was, K2 will take care of you with their experience and expertise.
I’d do it again in a heartbeat as long as I could land on the mountain and hike around for the afternoon or even stay at the Sheldon cabin.
Don’t hesitate. Just fly!

Taking this flightseeing trip was one of the most spectacular things we did on a fantastic trip to Alaska! We took the tour out of Talkeetna. Everyone we met associated with K2 was friendly, enthusiastic and helpful. Our pilot, Billy, was awesome- provided a wonderful narration during the flight & made the smoothest landing I have ever experienced. 
I highly recommend K2 and thought it was a great value for an incredible experience.

We did the Summit Tour w/o a glacier landing. It was incredible and has been the highlight of our trip so far..We planned a 2 week trip to AK and this was the first bucket list item we did. It will be the most recommended tour we tell people about.. Now having seen Denali from the national park, highway and a lodge deck, the view from the top can’t be compared to anything else. It’s a must do and K2 is the greatest! Safe & professional & worth every penny!

review_title: the only way to experience Denali, Foraker, and Hunter
review_text:
Everyone in our party thought this was the highlight of our trip to Talkeetna. Our guide, Patrick, was very knowledgeable and willing to answer any question we asked. 
We got lucky that there was no rain but weren’t able to do the glacier landing due to the clouds.  Even without that, this experience was breathtaking.

My wife and I were very pleased with the air tour of the big mountain!  Unfortunately, smoke and clouds had moved in so we could not get as close as we would have liked but still a great experience.  Very impressed with the knowledge of our pilot.  I highly recommend this tour!

review_title: Awesome flying get and Glacier landing
review_text: I booked this months in advance and they did a great job holding our reservation. K2 is quite a large operation in Talkeetna, but the staff treats you well. Our pilot, Chris, was very personable. He came from a family of Alaskan pilots. My wife got to sit in the copilot seat. If they ask who wants to sit there, raise your hand quickly. Flying between peaks was awesome. Landing in the snow in July, wow. It’s pricy...but probably our best experience in our first two weeks in Alaska. And tip your pilot! Don’t be like the majority of passengers on our flight and just shake his hand.

We loved the flightseeing tour of the Alaska Range with a landing on Ruth Glacier. It was an awesome experience!

We made our reservation through Alaska Tour and Travel, just because of some other stuff we were bundling, but you can go straight to the K2 site. They have a nice facility at the airport (soon to be even bigger and nicer with a new facility). Check-in was very organized, and you can enjoy some free coffee while looking at their gift items. They provide overboots for the glacier, so you can just wear your street shoes no problem. We were called by name, introduced to our pilot, and walked to the plane for a quick safety briefing. After takeoff, it is a short flight to get up to the mountains. Our pilot provided interesting information on the area over our headsets. Then you are in the mountains...

We were lucky to have a clear day, and it was specatcular! We flew up the Great Gorge, surrounded by peaks, then by Denali and the other large mountains in the range. Both sides of the airplane get the views. The glacier landing was very cool, and we spent 20 minutes walking around the plane in the huge Sheldon Ampitheater. It is just an incredlble place! The flight back included more awesome views as we zig-zagged down through the peaks (I was sitting up front with the pilot for this part). It was hard to believe we did all this in just 1 1/2 hours.

I highly recommend a flightseeing tour of the Alaska Range and the glacier landing.

review_title: A RARE NATIONAL PARK  FOR FLYING FAIRLY CLOSE TO THE MOUNTAIN PEAKS WITH POSSIBILITY OF LANDING ON THE GLACIER
review_text: Talkeetna is the only commercial airport in Denali National Park from where commercial flights are available for viewing Denali mountain range fairly closely. Weather permitting, the fights also land on the Glaciers for 45 mins. grand view and walking on the glacier. At least 2 days are recommended to explore the park with glacier flight & Jet boat.
These people not only delivered an unforgettable experience but they were also considerate, competent, and knowledgeable -- a thoroughly safe set of hands. Our pilot Chris was exemplary

My husband and I had the pleasure of taking a flight around Denali with Chad from K2Aviation. It was a wonderful experience. Chad was very competent and made us feel very comfortable with his skills and ability We were lucky enough to be the only two passengers in the plane. Chad was a very knowledgeable guide of the area and we learned a great deal during our flight. Safety was a priority throughout our flight. One of the most exhilarating experiences of my life!

I traveled to Alaska for a marathon & brought my 82 year young Mom with me to show her the beauty of Alaska. Seeing Denali is a must see because of its sheer size & beauty. Traveling with Mom is a challenge because she is wheelchair bound but this posed no problem with K2 Aviation. They allowed me to park as close as possible to help getting Mom out of the car & provided tremendous help in getting her into the plane. Actually, they placed Mom into the plane just like it was an everyday experience. I believe that it would have been impossible for Mom to see to see Denali without K2 going above & beyond in their assistance. Thanks so much to K2 for making this possible!

It was an awesome experience, a once-in-a-lifetime event. Kevin, the pilot, was wonderful. He explained everything and took pictures of us. The weather was perfect, which enhanced our experience. I would definitely recommend the glacier landing tour. It is worth the extra hundred dollars.

Our pilot Doug went above and beyond to make our flight so wonderful. He was very knowledgeable and even made sure we joined the 30% club. Will definitely recommend you to all. Thank you for a wonderful experience.
Informative,exciting. Wonderful clear flying day with excellent views of glaciers and areas surrounding Talkeetna😁
Garrett our pilot did a great job explaining Denali and the how the glaciers worked. Very friendly at checkin and check.  A big highlight on out trip.

We absolutely loved our flight around Denali! The pilot was excellent and shared lots of information with us. We felt very safe and secure during the flight. We loved seeing the glaciers and had a great view of Mount Denali! The day that our flight occurred, the sun was shining and the view was crystal clear. We even had the opportunity to see, and take pictures of, a moose on the runway. I would strongly recommend this attraction to anyone visiting Alaska.  It was one the of best activities we did while visiting Alaska!
This was an amazing experience. Billy was our pilot and that was the smoothest takeoff and landing I have ever experienced. The views are the best you will ever see!

review_title: Weather affected our trip but still awesome!
review_text: We had originally booked the Denali Grand tour with glacier landing. Unfortunately, this was the only day of our trip it rained. We received an email early morning explaining our trip details might be affected by weather. Upon arrival at scheduled time, they could only do the most basic Denali Experience flight. We were promptly refunded the difference. A much shorter flight but still awesome. Our pilot cruised around, looking for a break in the clouds to get us above them for more of a few. He was very knowledgeable and a lot of fun. Overall it was a great experience! Keep in mind, this company can't control the weather and if they cancel certain flights, it's for everyone's safety. Don't blame them for bad weather!

Our flight seeing tour was fabulous! Because of some weather over the usual landing spots, our pilot opted to land at Denali Base Camp instead. The scenery was incredible, and it was an experience we will never forget. We had our kids with us (youngest age 9) and our parents (age 70), and the flight was perfect for all.

Exceptional sights, very appealing experience
One of the best during our trip in Alaska.
You will be amazed , and to do it K2 is the company

We had a wonderful experience with K2 and our pilot, Justin.  It was a little pricey, but we figured being on a once-in-a-lifetime trip like we were, we should go all out. 

We did!  And I am so glad.  Being eye-to-eye with the summit of The Great One was incredible!

Thank you K2 and Justin!!!
Took a flight seeing tour. We were able to see the peak of Denali and landed on Ruth Glacier! An experience we will never forget. Would highly recommend!

review_title: Incredible trip on a beautiful Alaskan day!
review_text:
I got this trip for a birthday present for a friend.  I had cancelled 2x's because of the weather, it was no problem with K2, they just rescheduled for when I wanted to go.  The morning of the flight I called at 8am to check on weather.  Even though it was overcast where i live 30 miles to the SW of Talkeetna, they assured me the weather on Denali was picture perfect, and it WAS!
Our pilot, Will was very knowledgeable of Denali, the mountains surrounding it, the glaciers and rocks.  He made the trip educational and interesting.  Great host and representative of K2.
I have flown to Denali before, and have flown with K2 on a private trip in the early 2000's.  I have been in the area for 20 years now and have never heard anything bad about K2.
If I ever decide to go again, it will be with K2 and will request pilot Will.
THANK YOU K2

We originally planned the Summit tour although weather didn ´t allow us to. K2 aviation team offered to us shorter experience flight with was available. We are glad we decided to listen to them and accept shorter flight too. It was amazing, views were breathtaking and at the end we saw also the top of Denali and many rainbows around our plane. I would recommend this flight to everyone, it was worth every penny and our pilot Doug was perfect, talked during whole flight about all mountains we ha seen and many stories too. He made the tour special for us.
The flight was awesome, and the glacier landing is a must do!!!  Perhaps one of the best experiences of my life.  Our pilot Chip, was great, very informative, and friendly.  Thank you K2 Aviation.

review_title: Denali Flightseeing with Glacier Landing on K2 Aviation Plane
review_text: On the morning of May 25, 2019 we were blessed with beautiful weather. We had perfectly clear blue skys except for a few clouds at around 10000 feet.  We were able to see the peak of the "Great One" (Denali) from all sides!  The airplane, a DeHaviland Otter on skies, was perfectly suited for the mission!  Our pilot was excellent both as a pilot and a guide.  Being a pilot myself I could appreciate his communications skills as well as piloting skills. We were able to land on the glacier and that was exciting! We were picked up for the flight at our hotel by a K2aviation shuttle and were also returned by the shuttle. The shuttle drivers were young ladies whom we enjoyed talking with and the vans seemed to be new and were perfectly clean.  The three people in our party, aged 22, 77 and 79, thouroughly enjoyed the whole experience and felt perfectly safe at all times.

What a wonderful treat to see all Denali and the other two mountains and see base campers as well as land on the glacier on skis - super safe no nausea and they had boots to walk on glacier - operation is run so professionally - they are building a beautiful new building to move into because businesses and planes have grown  - so glad I splurged and saw something rare and soul fulfilling .
Our pilot was wonderful. He helped everyone feel comfortable about the experience. I learned so much about Alaska on this trip.  The glacier landing was incredible.

review_title: Excellent Customer Service, but still weather dependent
review_text: We had a good trip.  The pilot was terrific, providing explanations along the way.  And we were able to land on the glacier - very neat.  But the cloud cover was low, making it very difficult to see Denali.

We did the K2 Flightseeing Tour and landing on a glacier. It was so incredible and highly recommend this tour. We purchased the Alaskan Tour book and got $62.50 off each person (up to 4 people).  Worth every penny.

First glacier landing since my Navy assignment in Antarctica. Nice for the memory bank. 
My mate was beyond excited. 
Fairly expensive, but well worth it.
Don’t miss the opportunity if you have it.
Nothing compares with landing on a glacier in the middle of a mountain range. You’ll probably never get another shot at!!

The K2 Glacier landing tour was awesome flying to Denali. Even though we had an overcast day, the sun frequently peeked out between the clouds and presented us with great photos. It averages only 10 degrees cooler on the mountaintop than the town of Talkeetna. (On June 4, it was 50 up there around 1pm.) A light sweater was plenty. The sun is bright so wear sunglasses and a hat. They provide boots that cover your shoes. I have bad knees and took a hiking stick for stability in the snow. It is fairly level and just like walking in snow but you are on a Glacier! Very cool!

This experience was totally insane, once in a lifetime.  The K2 staff was so friendly and enthusiastic, and we don't have enough good things to say about our pilot, Doug.  He was enthusiastic, incredibly knowledgeable about the terrain and history of the area, and very attentive in regards to flight safety, potential motion sickness (which never reared its head), and making sure we had a great tour.  The views were out of this world, and we hoped the tour would never end.  Definitely a must!

Kimberly set us up for our 50th anniversary flight and it was something very special.  We chose a clear day when the mountain stood tall and clear and beautiful.  We took the 8:30 flight and Mark was our pilot.  He made sure both sides of the plane had an opportunity to take the pictures of one of the most spectacular sights you will ever see. Mark's narration of the sights we were seeing and his piloting skills were outstanding. We are so happy that we chose K2 aviation for our once in a lifetime experience.  Thank you Kimberly and Mark!

We took this tour as an excursion on a Princess Off the Beaten Track land/sea tour, and it was beyond belief.  Our pilot, Chris, took us right between the summit of Denali and Mt. Hunter and on to the the gorge of Ruth Glacier, where we landed.  We lucked out with gorgeous weather and were able to clearly see the entire Alaskan range...Chris provided fantastic info about what we were seeing and pointed out all the amazing sites, including base camps of hikers attempting to summit Denali.  Everyone at K2 was wonderful! This was a trip we will always cherish!
Very friendly staff, great pilot!  Excellent views and experience! Pilot explained everything we were seeing and the locations around, pointed out various sights along the way.

Completely dependant on pilot and weather, but Kevin (pilot) was awesome and shared a lot of information with us. The weather prevented us from landing on their "normal" glacier spot, so we got to land at the base camp glacier that is usually restricted. We saw the climbers and their camps a few hundred yards away, and while we were there, a couple of groups left on their trek to the next campsite. When we took off again, we could see the groups that left base camp while we were there. Saw a few climbers at other camps on other glaciers during our flight. Can't describe how fulfilling this experience was and give it the highest recommendation.

We booked the Summit Flight with Glacier Landing, but it was cancelled due to bad weather. We were kept informed at all times which we appreciated, and they phoned to inform of the cancellation. The following day we were able to get a base flight in, again due to weather, there was no going too high and no Glacier Landing. We enjoyed the 1hr flight with a very knowledgable pilot who provided lots of information and commentary. It was worth it to see the mountains and glaciers and puts into perspective the immense size of Denali. We would definitely reccomend K2 for flight-seeing, they are very good and safety aware. Had a great time and would do it again.

Excellent flight around the Denali National Park including a Glacier landing and  30 to 45 minutes in the snow in May 2019.

If you are taking the flight, you will NOT want to miss the Glacier Landing experience.

Very SAFE team..

Awesome once in a lifetime experience ! We upgraded to the glacier landing and it was totally worth it! Breath taking views of the mountains! Pilot was great and flight was smooth. This is a must do in Talkeetna M

Our flightseeing tour included walking on a glacier. I'm so happy we chose to add that because it was amazing! Daniel was a very knowledgeable and fun pilot. All of the people K2 Aviation are very professional, nice, helpful and organized. If I get the opportunity to visit Alaska and see Denali again, I will definitely fly with K2 Aviation.

Our tour included the glacier landing and it was incredible! Our pilot was business like and professional when it came to safety instructions, yet fun and personable in relating with our group. It has been the highlight of our vacation so far!

Words are not enough to describe the views. All the care of the staff and pilot. Besides a good flight on taking off and landing. Amazing experience. And one of the best decisions we have done on the trip while choosing where to take the flight. Very reliable. Besides the weather today was also very favorable

We flew with Will from K2 Aviation, and it was an awesome experience! Even though we weren’t able to safely land on the glacier, we still got to see a lot of amazing landscapes, including Mt. Denali! 
I would highly recommend this to everyone!

review_title: Amazing Experience and Great Pilots and Staff!
review_text: We were debating on whether or not to do it due to the price, but ended up feeling like we'd regret it if we did not.  It was an unforgettable experience and so worthwhile! There were two pilots with us (one was learning the terrain) and the other had 40 yrs. Of experience along with teaching, and it definitely showed! He was very knowledgable and conscientuous about the flight and terrain, was more than willing to answer any and all questions, and I felt like he went above and beyond as far as customer service is concerned.  They were also willing to do a later flight which other companies said no to, which is impressive as well.  We were able to see multiple glaciers, a glimpse of the peak of Denali (as weather permitted), and felt like it was an amazing experience that we will definitely recommend!

The experience was the most amazing time we have had traveling.very organized in what they do. The pilot was very personable . The flight was on a perfect day . We were told it was one of the few times that year that the mountain was (uncovered) .we flew between two mountain peaks wondered at the views of the Glaciers and then landed going up hill on the glacier itself .. getting out I made a snowball of the powder and threw it at my wife (she wasn’t amused) but it was still fun .. taking off you could hear the skis squeaking. Over all it was the highlight off our Alaskan adventures.

I'd like to start with the fact that each and every member of the staff was professional, nice and very knowledgeable.  They were unsure of the ability to do this tour as advertised due to weather conditions in the area, but instead of changing the route or even cancelling they decided to go up and see how things looked and it turned out that we were able to not only get to the mountains we went a little further to make the experience even more amazing.  i would highly recommend checking them out! i am definitely planning to head back in the future and will try another experience.

review_title: The experience of a lifetime !  Ken J
review_text: The K2 team handled us perfectly from our first call to the end of our Flightseeing tour. They also managed the weather in a way that gave us complete confidence. Our pilot was an incredible communicator explaining everything we were going to do route and maneuver wise from takeoff to flying to landing. His decision making put us at ease and allowed us to focus on the awesome spectacle of flying among some of the most special parts of the Alaska Range to include MT. Hunter, Foraker and McKinley. Seeing the Sheldon Chalet was  also a special moment. I and my group will all be back for another adventure and it will be the first thing we recommend to our friends and guests. I have lived in Alaska for almost 50 years and I am still compelled to say, thank you very much K2 for the experience of a life time.

review_title: Absolute must if you are visiting Alaska
review_text: My girlfriend came up for a week in February to visit Alaska, and this was the highlight of our trip for sure. The whole experience was about an hour and a half, and the views were unbelievable. The flight itself was very smooth, and our pilot Ryan was a great guide. We'd highly recommend going with K2 to schedule your flight!
Original plan was flight around Denali but weather was foggy so did glacier fly by toward Valdez. Glaciers everywhere! Our pilot got us in very close, almost two hours of siteseeing, very worthwhile!

The trip was amazing! Our pilot, Chris Wilson, was super nice. The view was amazing! Everything was super clear and it looked like we were in a movie. We did not even notice we were off the ground at take off. I would do this 1 million times and still not get tired of it. The trip was spectacular!

Ian McGrath from Belford New Jersey
This one-hour tour was amazing! Everyone at K2 was really nice. I would absolutely recommend this tour to anyone coming to Talkeetna!

Was an experience of a lifetime.  Had an up close view of Mount Denali and landed on a glacier.  The view from the plane was awesome and the pilot was very knowledgeable of the area.  Would highly recommend it as a must do.

Breathtaking, amazing experience.  Our pilot, Rosemarie, was fantastic.  Very knowledgable and friendly.  How can you miss seeing Denali?  K2 has great customer service, very accommodating.  This is what I talk about the most from our Alaska trip!!

review_title: What an amazing experience- and top rate customer service!
review_text: All I can say is, WOW!!! What an absolutely amazing experience. We were blessed with clear weather and gorgeous views right from takeoff. Our pilot, Billy, was so knowledgeable and personable, that he allayed any fears we might have had (we don't fly much and these are no jetliners!). The flight was smooth, and did I mention the views were spectacular? On top of the wondrousness of the trip, we experienced excellent customer service. Our reservation had been made through a travel agency, and they mistakenly booked the wrong type of flightseeing tour. We didn't realize it until we were being escorted to the plane by the pilot, and realized that it had no skis. We had been looking forward to the glacier landing, but clearly, the travel agency had their wires crossed. Not a problem, though! The pilot of that plane took us back into the office, where, after looking at their schedules for a couple of minutes, the staff rectified the situation and put us on the tour we had been hoping for. They didn't even charge us! I believe the other couple who went with us also got a free upgrade, to make it a full flight. I truly expected to have to pay the upgrade then and there, but no. They just fixed it all for us, and off we went! Thanks to the A+ customer service, we had the full experience of flying around Denali AND getting to land on the glacier, where there were more magnificent views awaiting us. I can't say enough good things about this company and this tour. It was definitely one of the big highlights of our trip to Alaska- truly unforgettable!!!

I hate when people hype things up, but this was easily one of the coolest things I've ever done!Full Disclosure: It's expensive, and highly weather dependent. We weren't able to fly due to weather the first day, came back the next day, and it was beautiful, so keep a couple days free in case!Even so, I think it was totally worth it. Our pilot Chris P. was knowledgeable, friendly and really tailored the experience to our preferences as much as he could. I could go on and on, so just trust me, you can make more money, but how often can you fly around the tallest mountain in North America and land on a glacier?! Do it, enough said.

The pilot's narration was fabulous along with the majestic views of Denali and many other   glaciers along the mountain tops.  The highlight of the flight was the landing at the amphitheater of Ruth Mountain and glacier.  We we're able to walk on the snow and capture many pictures.  Weather was perfect, thankfully!

What a fabulous trip....friendly staff, perfect weather, first rate pilot (Chip) with stories and facts of relevance and historical interest.  What a fine way to spend an afternoon!  We'll be back another time, and will definitely recommend this flight both to visitors and locals. By all means, take some pictures!

I am not a big fan of flying. My fear of heights and motion sickness are the biggest factors. My wife and I were doing a Princess Cruise and she really wanted to see Denali up close and personal. We went out to the airport at Talkeetna and looked at the various different operations offering a flightseeing of Mt. Denali. K2 Aviation seemed to have the best aircraft and most professional facility. We opted for the air tour which included a landing on a glacier near the mountain itself. 

We were issued boots and then greeted by our pilot, Stan. Our aircraft was a vintage de Havilland Otter that had been upgraded with modern avionics and a turbine engine. It appeared to be a very well maintained aircraft. After a short safety briefing, we were  in the air, heading for the mountain. 

There really is no better way to see Denali up close. Weather plays a big factor in determining how close you can get to the mountain and what you can see, but we got lucky with our trip. The views were truly amazing and I managed to get numerous pictures as our pilot wound his way around the numerous mountain peaks. .  

Landing on the glacier was fun and the view of the mountain from that location was the best. One minute the peak was covered with clouds and then it was out in the clear.  

Soon we were all loaded up and heading off the glacier. After a little more canyon flightseeing, we were on our way back to the airport. 

We saw many interesting and wonderful sights on our 12 day Alaska cruise. Without a doubt, the K2 experience was the highlight of the entire trip.

review_title: An amazing aircraft Glacier landing on the top of the mountain
review_text: It was an amazing experience to fly by a small airplane from Talkeetna to the Denali Park’s mountains top where we landed over the Glacier on the top of the mountains and walk over the beautiful snow in the middle of the summer watching this breath taking blue ice lakes

Initially we rejected the idea of a flightseeing tour due to the price.  At the last minute, we decided to book a tour and are so glad we did.  The weather completely cooperated and it was a once in lifetime experience.  The flight to the glacier had incredible views. Then we landed on the glacier and walked around.  Words fail to adequate describe it - just wow!  We are so glad we did this.  It was truly one of the most memorable things we have ever done.  The entire K-2 staff was wonderful.  Special thanks to our pilot Kevin.  His combination of knowledge and jokes made the adventure even more fun.
Great valley tour. Accommodated weather limitations. Worked with passengers. Safe informative beautiful flight.

We did the Denali Flyer Trip. This was an experience I will treasure for the rest of my life. Our pilot Chris was great. He showed us beautiful scenery and was a master with landing and take-off. We landed on Ruth Glacier and got to play for a few minutes. The weather was perfect and we saw God's amazing creation. It was so awesome it made me cry. While we were up there, my husband and I exchanged renewal vows. We felt like we were in heaven.

Simply exhilarating and blessed to be able to go on this flight and saw Denali up close along with the glacier landing on July 31st at 1.00 ... awesome.

K2 offered the best price (USD 310) that I had found when I was doing a search on the best flightseeing available options from Talkeetna. On top of that, this company has made it a point to make a refund on the portion paid for glacier landing if we are unable to do so due to poor weather condition, that's real good business etiquette in which rarely to be found nowadays.

Went on this flight with a great pilot and I believe that would make a difference too.

Denali was not an option the day we went because of bad weather so they offered us another tour.  We had a wonderful pilot and got to see a lot.  I was in the co-pilot seat which was amazing!  My girlfriend was in the back and was a bit disappointed that she was unable to see a lot of things that were being shown on the opposite side of the plane.  She was really underwhelmed when she got off the plane.  All in all though we felt it was cool to be able to see Alaska from that high though, despite not being able for her to see that much.

The day of our tour, we found out later, was the same day the plane crashed.  They left only a few hours after us.  I have no idea what the factors were that led to that, because there is not much information online still. I have to say that memory will live with us forever.  We are still in total shock that a few hours later the same tour we were on was never coming back.  Our hearts are heavy for everyone involved.  What an awful day.

review_title: Excellent investment if weather is good!
review_text: Seeing Denali up close and personal in a plane is an experience I'll never forget. Rose Marie, our pilot, made sure the 3 of us saw both peaks of the huge mountain, climbing routes, glaciers, and pointed out other peaks in the Alaska Range. She knew elevations, she explained how tundra grows on top of glaciers and pointed out an ice fall from a calving glacier. It was well worth the cost. I was lucky because it was a sunny, clear day.

We were scheduled to land on a glacier but the weather was too cloudy and it was not felt to be safe to land however we had a great pilot, Mark, who flew us around the mountain and showed us many great vistas! Wonderful tour.

This was an amazing experience as we left Talkeetna and flew over Denali.  As we  climbed high, we were in awe as the scenery all along the way kept getting better over U shaped valleys and snow covered pinnacles.  The views from the snow covered top were incredible and as we got off and walked around, it was just undesirable, An absolute MUST DO!

review_title: The flight was beautiful and Chris did an excellent job.
review_text: We were in Alaska for ten days and this flight was the best part of the trip. The scenery was awesome and the pilot was very informative. Thank you and we will be back.

K2 Aviation is a super friendly and well-run organization. Views were amazing. So glad my teenage kids got to really see a glacier for what it is. We'd talked about them so much on the rest of our trip but it was all talk until this tour made it real. Breathtakingly real.

K2 picked us up in a shuttle bus from Talkeetna Alaskan Lodge promptly 45 minutes before scheduled takeoff. Belongings you don't want to carry in the tight cabin of the plane are stored in locking bins at the office, one per aircraft. Some of my party are a little squeamish about small planes, but were put at ease by the pilot's safety talk and by the overall clean and competent feel of the place. Our plane had a 1 pilot and 6 passenger capacity, and there were bigger and smaller ones around the airfield. After the 90 minute narrated flight we walked about 5 minutes to downtown Talkeetna for lunch and shopping.

As others have said, weather is likely to mess with your plans. We couldn't do the glacier landing, but it was abundantly clear why. The clouds started at 4000 feet that day and the landing site is at 5000 feet. The front desk staff were super quick and friendly about adjusting the price to match what we actually got to do. Couldn't ask for more.

Highly recommended!

This was by far the most amazing experience of our Alaskan vacation. To land and walk on a glacier while looking up at Mt. Denali was beyond our expectations. We had a very friendly, knowledgeable pilot who guided us through the flight and answered our questions. If you can only do one thing while in Alaska, take the Denali Experience with Glacier Landing you won't be disappointed.

I am not a fan of small planes & was a little apprehensive about taking this trip which was an add on tour  to Danali after a cruise. We flew from Anchorage to Talkeeta and my nerves settled down with our competent pilot Kevin giving a wonderful commentary and pointing out interesting places of interest. When we reached the mountains I felt so close we could have touched them but my nerves gave way to awe at the magnificent scenery we were witnessing.  Definitely one to tick off the bucket list !!

review_title: One of the highlights of our Alaskan trip
review_text: If you only do one thing in Alaska....make sure it is this one. What an experience. Super organisation and fab pilot who was very knowledgeable about Mount Denali and its surroundings. We were very lucky to fly on a crystal clear sunny day when Mount Denali was visible from the bottom  right up to the top!

review_title: The highlight of our Alaska vacation!
review_text: It took a lot of back and forth for everyone to build up the courage to take this flight.  It was fantastic!  We all felt it was the best thing we did on the vacation.  The flight to the mountains and the landing on the glacier were amazing.  Our pilot, Billy, really made this fun.  He immediately put us at ease and was engaging with plenty of commentary along the way.  Definitely recommend it.

This was our 2nd time flying with K2 Aviation.  Same flight both times.  Mike the pilot from 2008 is still there.  We flew with Chris the chief pilot this time.  Both pilots were fantastic, extremely informative and very professional.  There is no way to describe the feeling of landing on a glacier.  The word "awesome" doesn't come close.  This is definitely one for the ole bucket list!!  The only suggestion I could make would be to add more chairs in the shade while you wait for your turn to go.

This was an amazing tour! Although we had signed up for the Denali Flyer trip the weather decided to move in and they switched us to the Denali Experience tour, with a refund of the cost difference. Once we got into the Alaska Range, the clouds had cleared up a bit since their previous flights so we had some unbelievable views of the range and the glaciers below. Our pilot, Daniel, gave us great narrative info throughout the flight and kept us safe and comfortable even with the clouds and changing weather. If you're considering a flight tour- it's definitely worth splurging on and K2 gives an awesome experience!

Great pilot and great tour.  Unfortunately weather was not cooperative and could only go 7,400 ft up rather than 20,000.  Saw a lot of ice and mountains.  K2 very accommodating for the required change.  Would highly recommend to anyone

This was an amazing tour! We originally signed up for the Denali Flyer trip but due to weather they decided to only run the Denali Experience tour. We were lucky that the clouds had cleared up a bit since their previous flights so we had some beautiful views of the Alaskan Range. Our pilot, Daniel, gave us great narrative info throughout the flight and kept us safe and comfortable even with the clouds and changing weather. If you're considering a flight tour- it's definitely worth splurging on and K2 gives an awesome experience!

Two major things you need to have a great flight seeing experience a good pilot and fantastic weather, we were fortunate to have both. 

The plane ride out to see Denali was smooth and the pilot was great making sure everyone was able to see the awesome sights in front and below us. The clouds cleared from the great mountain just as we got close which I guess makes us part of the 30% crowd that saw the mountain. 

He then took us through some valleys and we saw glaciers and some of the wonderful jewel like reflections of deep blue peaking through the snow. We did hit a bit of turbulence in one of the passes and the pilot handled it beautifully.

It was an awe inspiring experience and I'm so glad to call Alaska home.

Outstanding experience. The staff was friendly and the Pilot, Dan, was top notch. We benefited from a perfect day on the glacier and the competent, friendly, efficient team at K2 made our special day just Perfect!

We signed up on the "spur of the moment"
Called in the morning hoping to get on a flight and we were airborne by 1.
At $300/per it wasn't "cheap" but boy was it worth it.
Truly the only way to really "See" Denali park.
Our Pilot was Professional, Knowledgeable, Friendly and engaging.
We did not do the glacier landing but will try for that next time we get to AK.
If you have a chance, JUST DO IT....

Start off with Dillon. The young shuttle driver who was totally engaging and who checked us in.

Then Chris, our expert pilot who took off and landed with hardly a bump! He was amazingly awesome! Gave all the appropriate safety warnings. Told us of POI as we flew along. Spent more than enough time on the glacier.

My wife was hesitant when we booked, but thoroughly loved the experience in the end👍👍👍

I am recently retired, and a trip to Alaska was one of my 'bucket list' destinations.  This flightseeing tour over Denali was the crown jewel of the trip.  Truly amazing, and a lifetime memorable experience.  The clouds came and went, but, overall the weather cooperated the day we visited.  I would highly recommend this to anyone visiting Denali, even timid flyers, as the flight was as smooth as any commerical flight.

review_title: Denali Experience + Glacier Landing = Fabulous Adventure!
review_text: We did the Denali Experience tour + glacier landing.  Truly a bucket list experience!!  We highly recommend K2 and this trip.  Well worth the money.  And Craig was a great pilot, shared lots of info during flight, and happy to take group photos for us.  This is a must-do adventure!!

I can't say enough about this amazing flight seeing experience. The staff at K2 were wonderful, they did their best to manage expectations regarding the weather and possibility of a glacier landing and were very helpful in making sure all passengers were ready to go and comfortable (even let some of us borrow sunglasses!). Our pilot was very safety-minded and knowledgeable. This flight is so much more than seeing Denali, it's about being amidst the huge, wild, jagged mountains that surround it. Puffy clouds only made it all the more dramatic. Our glacier landing was such fun, and although we couldn't spend too much time on the glacier itself due to flight traffic, it was still such an adventure. You don't want to miss out on this experience, so plan some flexibility in your schedule in case your scheduled flight is delayed for weather.

review_title: Great Views but couldnt do Glacier Landing
review_text: Booked a glacier landing trip but when we reached the weather was bad . Good customer care , even when the weather was not allowing they gave options to change the booking to another day or refund or fly without landing. We changed to another day but the weather didnt allow us next time as well , so we had to choose not to land on glacier. So missed the landing , but they refunded the difference in cost and we did get to see denali from above :)

K2 Aviation is very friendly, but has no control over the weather.  If you can be flexible, book this for the first day of your trip and keep your options open to reschedule for the best weather.  We visited in mid-June.  There had been several days of rain just before, so they were not offering the glacier landing we had booked.  It was also cloudy, so they were not flying to Denali itself (the Denali Grand Tour).  They offered a complete refund, the chance to reschedule (warning that they had many flights to rebook), or the option to keep our reservation time and do the shorter, less expensive Denali Experience.  We had reservations at our next destination so we could not reschedule for a different day.  

Our pilot Daniel made us feel very safe and gave us some great views of several glaciers and smaller peaks.  It was a great experience, but we did not get to see The Big One on this flight.

We had a 9am reservation for the Grand Tour but were informed about postponment due to weather. K2 kept in touch via email about each change in plans.  We really wanted to see Denali so decided not to take other flightseeing destinations which were offered instead.  Finally, 24 hours later,  Denali was visible and we found out the tour was on BUT no glacier landing and a one hour instead of a two hour.  We were a little doubtful but so excited to be flying around Denali that we decided this was the best alternative.  We were definitely not disappointed!  The views were crystal clear and just incredible, Mike was a wonderful pilot and commentator..  The substitution turned out to be just a reason to try again another time.  Fabulous job K2!  What wonderful memories (and photographs) we have!

My husband and I enjoyed this as a part of celebration for our anniversary. The entire experience was wonderful with exception of having to wait over an hour for our take off time. When checking in, we were told they would be loading with in the next few minutes, an hour later, we were off?? Not sure, what happened, there was no explanation. That was a let down! We were scheduled for the 3:00 flight and departed a little after 4:00.

review_title: The Best Of Denali!  K2 Aviation!
review_text: If you want first hand joy from the seat of an airplane, K2 is your mandatory stop.  Our pilot, Chris, gave us such a special tour and went beyond the call of duty looking for critters.  It's no wonder Trip Advisor five star reviews steered us in the right direction, just like Capt. Chris did!  Bravo K2, we'll spread the good word!

The vast beauty of Denali park area is like no other.  Our pilot was very knowledgeable and experienced pilot.  The view was beyond words.  Seeing the back side of Denali was the greatest as a break in the clouds allowed us to look up to the top.  Would do it again and again  Cathedral Mountain was incredible.  I could have flown all day.
No words can describe this!!! The enormity of this mountain range is incredible. I cried from the shear beauty of the view. It’s absolutely worth every single penny.

review_title: Superb flight by very experienced pilot
review_text: My wife and I did the Denali Experience Flightseeing Tour on May 29, 2018. There were some clouds to contend with but K2 will not fly if it is not safe. So they delayed our flight about 30 minutes. I was very pleased to see that we were going in a turbine powered Otter aircraft; much safer than a piston as I just retired after 45 years of flying military and corporate. Chip our pilot gave us a good safety briefing before we got airborne. My wife sat in the copilot's seat as I wanted to just take photos. Chip gave us a nonstop tour and history of the area; it was like being in a college classroom as he really knows what he is talking about. Overall this was the highlight of the Alaska land tour that we did with Princess Cruises. If you want to see Mt Denali up close and personal and the surrounding area, don't miss this flight. K2 is an impressive company; check out their article on landing on glaciers in AOPA magazine, June or July 2018 issue if I remember correctly. This tour should not be missed....(skip the river rafting, boring; use that money to fly!!!). You won't be sorry you did. Don't forget your camera either.

review_title: Highlight of our week in Alaska
review_text: At first, a flightseeing trip seemed like a pricey add-on to our Alaska trip, but my son and I were so glad that we decided to go. Our pilot, Chris, was knowledgeable about the geology and history of the mountains in a conversational sort of way, without sounding  like he had memorized a script. Even though the weather didn't allow us to see Denali, it was a spectacular trip that was the highlight of our week in Alaska.

Readying to be picked up by the K-2 shuttle at our hotel (Grand Talkeetna Lodge) we were browsing the gift shop when several people mumbled and looked out the rear window to see Denali in all its great splendor. The mountain had been sort of "socked in" for a few days but was now gleaming in the early sunlight of a new day. So with anticipation we boarded the shuttle for the short ride to the K-2 facility, checked in and were assigned to a twin Cessna along with another couple and a family of four with two youngsters. Full cabin but what a great ride! The pilot was most knowledgeable, friendly and put everyone immediately at ease as he "ran up" the engines to check temps and pressures then off we went. The scenery is unimaginable and hard to fully describe in words to convey the full range of the vistas the eye is presented with. Slowly gaining altitude we were soon among the peaks and found ourselves amidst the summit faces of Denali itself. Alas, the experience lasted not long enough as we began our slow descent back down to Talkeetna. As we departed I shook the pilot's hand telling him while I know he had no control over the weather conditions, we were very appreciative of what he was able to show us (and tipped him handsomely for the effort). K-2 is a "cant' miss" deal.

K2 handled our last minute request perfectly. Chris was a great pilot and guide and went out of his way to show us a few extra things we wanted to see. On a windy day, our flight was very pleasant. The views, were, of course breathtaking! Thank you K2 for a view of adventures to come!

Take flight from a small air strip in Talkeetna, AK and soon you'll be looking down at ice fields and glaciers as far as you can see. Cliffs rising thousands of feet in front of you.  Then Denali, the highest mountain on the north American continent looms in front of your small four seater aircraft. The pilot makes a quick turn, dives down, and within a breath or two you're gliding on the snow covered surface of a glacier a mile wide. The plane slows, stops and you step out. Twenty minutes to fill your mind with memories that will last a lifetime before an exciting flight back to Talkeetna. You will never forget this excursion.

review_title: Great experience! Plane can use some upgrades.
review_text: Great experience of seeing Maui from the sky!! Eric was a terrific tour guide and was so patient. The plane needs upgrades but overall great experience.

I am rewriting this review, as my first review was softly forced.  The pilot stopped the golf cart near the hangars and asked us to click the links and do the review on the spot…and then he checked our phones to see that the reviews were completed with a thank you screen showing.  While I understand they need reviews as a small business, soft forcing and checking doesn’t feel like it’s the right way to do it.  I’ve been on other plane tours around a couple of the other Hawaiian Islands, so I have reference points for comparison.

Pros:  We did a custom tour, which is supposed to be a combination of two tours, with circumnavigation of Maui and a tour of the surrounding islands.  The views of Molokai and the surrounding area were fantastic.  The pilot, Eric, was skillful and we felt safe.  He was a nice guy and tried his best to be a good guide.

Cons:  (1) I feel like the price of our combined tour was a bit high (around 1250 for two people) especially considering the total time was only about 1.7 hours, which is about the time of just one tour.  I feel like more time could have been spent around west Maui , Molokai/Lanai and Molokini rather than Hanna, which is comparatively not that impressive.  I would not recommend our tour to others, based on my experience and at this price point.  (2)  They could use newer planes.  The current single engine plane (Piper Archer) is very old.  The exterior looks old and the interior is in rough shape.  Again, it was safe, but the plane could at least use a new coat of paint, the seats need to be re-upholstered and the interior needs a good cleaning/vacuuming and wipe down.  Also, the control pod of my headphones was coming apart with interior wires showing, and all the headphones had earmuff covers that were dirty and almost coming off…they could use disposable ear muff covers and mouthpiece covers…these things are very cheaply available on Amazon.  Finally, the pilot’s clothes looked like they were not washed for weeks.  Again, I think the pilot is a nice guy and I have nothing against him, but both my wife and I noticed this and thought it was strange.  Cleanliness is very important…it’s the first things people notice and experience.  These are simple things to fix.  (3) They really need a shared office or at least a hangar where customers can sit down and wait and get checked in etc.  It seems all they have is a parking spot on the tarmac and a golf cart that they use to get customers directly from their cars.  This is ok, but this is just a tip based on what I’ve seen with other tour operators.  

I would recommend this company over a helicopter tour because it is better for a small group.  However, I would like to see some of the things I mentioned to change.  They have been in business for 7 years.  So I feel like some of these things should be addressed for their benefit and that of future customers.  All they have to do is go experience some other airplane tours on other islands (like Kauai for example) to get more tips on how to improve.

review_title: Amazing, 1st Class, Unique and Brillant - 5 Islands Experience
review_text:
From the time we booked online - our 5 Islands Experience - to the end of the trip, it was nothing but an amazing experience.  Eric is passionate about his business, his dream, his customers and their experience, and that comes thru in everything he does to ensure the customer gets a unique perspective off the 5 islands of Maui county, and an amazing view and experience.  

Flying first up the Nakalele Coast to see the blowhole, around towards Kapalua and Honolua Bay, and then across to Molokai to see the sea-cliffs via “elephant island”, Eric ensured he eliminated the bumps and that everyone got the same view in one form or another.  His knowledge gained from flying seaplanes on the East River meant he read the wind on the sea, and judged perfectly where to position the plane to avoid unnecessary turbulence and maximise the customer experience.  

The sea-cliffs are awe inspiring... a sight to behold, you can see why Stephen Speilberg used them in the opening scene of Jurassic Park.  Again Eric using his local knowledge and experience positioned the plane in such a manner to give us a unique perspective that has imprinted those cliffs in my memory forever.  They tower above you and reach way below you to the water, the waterfalls are spectacular and add to the jurassic feel of the cliffs. 

Crossing Molokai, and heading across to Lanai we got to look back on Maui and enjoyed both a unique view of the Maui Valley, and a view of Haleakala - who graciously lifted her hat (poked her head thru the clouds) for us to see the observatory’s on the summit of the volcano).  Once over Lanai, Eric shared with us the beautiful coral reefs that protect Lanai and we got to enjoyed the “Grand Canyon” of Lanai, flying up and over the ancient river, before turning to head for Molokini. 

Eric’s passion for what he does and how he does it comes out here, as he circled Molokini, the beaches at Makena (big and small beach) and the lava fields at the end of Maui to ensure we both got to see and take it all in, before making a final few turns, travelling up the Wailea/Kuhei coastline, and down the valley to land us safely back where all the fun began.  

Eric, your energy, passion and desire to see your dream come alive is second to none. Thank you for an amazing experience, when we return to Maui, we will ensure we come flying again. Thank you for sharing the beauty of your Islands with us.

review_title: Avoid Being "Processed" by Heli Tours -- Book Maui Plane Rides
review_text: Having been to Maui twice before, we decided to finally spend the $$ and fly over Haleakala.  After researching the numerous heli tours, we opted to book with Eric and his new-ish company, Maui Plane Rides.  What a great choice we made.  Eric was willing to be flexible with our trip day, ensuring that we would see Haleakala in all her glory (she was clouded over the last time we drove aaaaaaall the way up....). On our appointed day, a magnificent view was provided by an experienced pilot who truly LOVES flying.  We appreciated the answers to our questions, but also the silence as Eric flew us around and around and around the crater.  If you appreciate being treated kindly and fairly and not "processed" as just another tourist, you will definitely want to book with Eric and Maui Plane Rides.
We enjoyed a delightful sunset flight which was replete with breaching whales under a sky of fire as the sun kissed the horizon. Highly highly enjoyed and recommend this incredible experience.

review_title: WOW --What views on our guided flight over beautiful Maui!
review_text:
We were so lucky to find this newish company in This Week Maui, among the free booklets from the airport.
 Excellent value and exactly what we'd hoped for as we prefer a plane over a noisy helicopter which we'd taken on the Big Island.
 This was perfect for the 3 of us (including 2 seniors citizens) and is smaller and more comfortable with easier access than planes we'd taken with a Seattle company around Puget Sound --we had very personalized and clear communication with the experienced pilot, Eric, who explained what we were seeing and answered all our questions.
 It was so interesting to listen in on the frequent conversations with ground control as the competent and careful Eric checked in with each one.
We were only about 1000 feet up so had great views everything, including Humped Backed Whale families, the Road to Hana, kite-boarders, details of various beaches, Haleakala, W. Maui Mountain, resorts N of Lahaina, and also the island Kahoolawe, which is inaccessible since it still contains unexploded bombs used for practice during WW 2 and afterward.
It was so much fun for our son --and amazing for us to see details of the many places he'd bicycled to.
A bonus was that Eric had taken some photos of us and the views during and before the flight and promptly emailed them. Our photos turned out great and are a wonderful memory of fun visiting our son.
 Just can't recommend this highly enough and we plan to repeat this experience when we visit again!

This was the most amazing experience of my life! The flight was amazing! The views beyond imagination! Eric has amazing flying skills (coming from my husband CFI gold seal) and he is a very carrying and knowledgeable person. He knows everything about Hawaii and he did everything in his power to make us feel comfortable and enjoy it. I wished I could do this every day!!! Highly recommended.

My boyfriend and I visit Hawaii every year in March for our birthday’s and this year I decided to surprise him with a plane ride around Maui with Maui Plane Rides! review_title: Great Aerials of Maui and CLIFFS
review_text: Incredible experience soaring above Maui in my private plane. The flight was longer and the price was right. The pilot was amazing. He let me fly which was a lifetime dream come true. HIGHLY HIGHLY HIGHLY RECOMMEND.
Definitely a highlight of our trip! Our 6 year old became a pilot just like daddy, my wife and I enjoyed so much that we are recommending this to all our friends!!!

Don't pass this opportunity up.

review_title: Our BEST excursion of the entire Holiday

review_title: Amazing views with an amazing instructor!
review_text: We had a wonderful time on this plane tour. We chose this tour specifically because it would be small and my husband really wanted to personally fly the plane. We were the only two people in the plane besides Eric, our instructor. We flew to the sea cliffs on the north side of Molokai and it was breathtakingly beautiful. Eric was friendly, professional, and accommodating. He knew a lot about the history of the island and we learned just as much about Molokai as we did about aviation. At first we were nervous, but Eric was great about giving instructions and made us feel comfortable with both flying the plane and enjoying the ride. We highly recommend this plane tour if you’re visiting Maui! One of the highlights of our entire trip.

This was just amazing to ride up above Maui with such a great pilot who picked us up and we sat do it. Great experience

review_title: Forget the helicopter ride, take a Maui Plane Ride.
review_text: This was the absolute highlight of our trip. We booked with Eric through our condo concierge. As soon as we arrived we knew we were in for an amazing experience. Eric, the owner/operator shared with us that this was his dream and it totally shows. We got our preflight safety instruction and we're off the ground in less than 10 minutes. My husband who was sitting next to Eric even got to help take off and fly!  You can't say that with a helicopter tour. Eric was super knowledgeable about everything we were seeing, from the valley's to the breathtaking sea cliffs and even the last active leper colony! He checked with us frequently to make sure we were comfortable throughout the flight. This truly an unforgettable experience and something we will be telling everyone about. Thank you Eric for memories that will truly last a lifetime and thank you for sharing your passion and dream with us.

Such a unique way to see the islands! The pilot was super cool and gave control of the plane to add to the experience. He also had good commentary and history of the islands as we passed. Definitely recommended and will come back again.

review_title: Brilliant service and incredible tour of the island
review_text:
Must see if you want a better alternative to the otherwise really commoditized helicopters flying around. Much personalized service and Erik really takes care of you. We saw incredible sights around the island , craters, lava fields and beautiful beaches from above. Entire process was highly efficient- Erik welcomed and engaged with our family and within 10 mins we were wheels up after a thorough safety briefing. Flight was mostly smooth but wherever it was rough, Erik took us through it well. We have been to chopper flights and it takes way too long to check in and board and of course you have more company. This was ideal for us as a three pax group. Erik spent good amount of time showing us everything that was to be seen around our chosen flight path. 

Must do if you want to avoid the cost and hassle of chipper flight. Also highly customizable and wonderful pilot.

Eric owns and operates the flight. That makes a big difference because he genuinely cares you enjoy your time on the plane. He helped me take off from the runway and fly it a bit but the views are too much to ignore, so I was happy to let him do the rest of the flying. We covered the exact route as expected and saw amazing views of the islands. The total time in the air was just a tad over 60 minutes. But of course safety is the primary concern so we had to go through various safety protocols before taking off and the total time was more than 90 minutes.

He narrates as you go and likes to make a lot of jokes. The only thing you might want to consider is that gratuities are not included in the fee. This is normal for almost every tour and we pay gratuities at every tour we do as the employees aren't as well compensated as the captains. But this was just Eric so think ahead about how you would "tip" the captain on this one. I hadn't even thought about it until the end.

We had booked the Molokai sea cliffs tour but the wrath did not look good that way so the pilot proposed to go to the volcano crater . He was able to fly around the clouds to fly us over the crater twice. Amazing view from there. 
He was also very attentive to our comfort. 
Great experience with great pilot.

review_title: Unforgettable experience the private tour in air!

Being elevated 1500ft puts things into perspective. Eric was knowledgeable and gave us commentary as we flew. The views were amazing and we were comfortable throughout. Would certainly recommend this tour!
Eric made the flight fun and informative. I even had the chance to pilot the plane on take-off and then some. Highly recommend this as a great 'Value' Maui activity.

Great day! Would do it again! A hundred times! Highlight of my trip! Volcanoes Galore! Loved the trip and the pilot was extra special, went above and beyond!

Outstanding trip! Well worth the time and effort! Experienced and knowledgeable pilot! Great way to see this part of Hawaii !!!
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!
Eric was amazing. He was a great tour guide. Was so knowledgeable about all the islands.  I would definitely recommend this.

review_title: Best of the Best Island Tours
review_text: I've never done a small plane tour of any area; it's always been helicopter tours. Glad I stepped up and out of my comfort zone and decided to give Eric's Maui Plane Rides company a chance. Our in air host, pilot and tour guide (Eric) made the experience an epic sightseeing adventure not possible by helicopter, land or sea (the 3 latter which would all have access and tour length issues that a small plane flying slowly does not). The very Personable, Knowledgeable and Accommodatingly Lovable Eric makes this one experience you DO NOT WANT TO MISS while visiting Maui.

Eric was masterful, a confident and smooth pilot, a well informed and enthusiastic guide, reverent of our experience and my husband’s 50th, flexible and accommodating, a great listener. It was magical!  It was the best gift I’ve ever given my husband of 21 years!

My wife and I been to this Island numerous amout of times, this is our new favorite activity ! Eric teached us how to take off the runway and helped us fly the plane to hana and back . We felt very safe and comfortable at all time! 
We already planning to do it again next time with friends :)

Eric was so accommodating, he met up with us very last minute as we were heading back to Kaanapali from watching the sunrise at Haleakala. At first we wanted to do a helicopter tour but since it was last minute planning (full accountability here!) on our part, there weren't many options available. Amazing!!! So glad we did this!! Eric, the pilot was great on explaining and showing us how the plane works and when we got up in the air the view was breathtaking!! Loved every minute of it!!

This was the highlight of our Anniversary.  Thank you so much, Eric!!
Awesome experience!  Must do when you visit maui Eric was super helpful and awesome!  Would recommend a hop over to Molokai island to see the sea cliffs. Spectacular!

I have flown over Maui many times, in both helicopters and fixed wing craft, but I have never had an experience like this one. Had a great time exploring the Hawaiian islands with Maui plane rides. Eric is a great and fun guy. Got a great flight experience with my hands on the controls. 5/5 rating, would recommend!

This is a great experience I highly recommend. We scheduled on short notice for a next day early morning flight that met our schedule and Eric the pilot was super accommodating.
