review_title: Amazing plane ride experience with Eric on our Honeymoon
review_text: We had a fantastic experience flying with Eric to see the wonders of Maui, Hawaii. Eric is very entertaining and fun and provided water and drinks and took pictures of us for amazing memories. It was a lifelong experience. Thx Eric!
It was awesome views and Eric was an excellent pilot! The weather was pleasant, minimal turbulence and views amazing!

review_title: Amazing Flight over Islands and the Sea!
review_text: Eric loves to fly- and to share this amazing experience with the rest of us! We had the experience of a lifetime flying low over cliffs, coral, small towns, and big open spaces. Make this a Definite on your list! Call Eric.
Awesome trip. 10/10 would recommend. Eric is an awesome guy and great tour guide! Once in a lifetime experience that was breathtaking

review_title: SOOO much better than a helicopter!
review_text: SUPERB!  For my money MPR is much better than a helicopter tour.  Capt. Eric is an awesome host, both informative and professional.  There is the option to customize your route and time of day during your confirming phone call.   It is evident he is a very skilled pilot and at no time did we ever feel unsafe, in fact he had us focused on the sights because we knew we were in good hands.  We choose the tour all around Maui which truly does take you over all the coastlines, and if you have never seen the 'backside' of Haleakala you are missing out on a rarely seen part of Maui.  The aircraft is a 4-seat Piper Cherokee which has new electronics - and you can sit in the 2nd front seat right next to the pilot if you choose.  We all had headphones so communication was not a problem, and during the flight there was commentary and narration.  You should carefully consider if you want your aerial tour to be brief and heavy on pollution (helicopters put out far more exhaust) or more in-depth and welcoming like Maui Plane Rides - we will be sure to call Eric on our next visit to Maui.

Had a once in a lifetime experience with Eric flying to Hawaii to see the lava flow. 
The flight was spectacular, Eric was a true professional and the whole experience was incredible. I highly recommend Maui Plane Rides.
This was a Phenomenal experience! Eric our piolet was very accomadating and made sure everyone had a good view of valcano! Highly recommend this plane ride.

If you like a thrill, this is the trip for you.  It is an amazing experience and you will get incredible pictures. Eric, our pilot, was friendly and very thorough.  He even let me drive the plane. If you want great views, this is the experience of a life time!!

Such an amazing experience! Eric was awesome.  He was friendly & very thorough. He greeted us with leis, had sparkling waters on ice, & checked in to make sure we were good and happy. Eric will even let you drive the plane. How cool is that! If you want to experience the islands of Hawaii from up above, this is for you!
Personal and perfect plane ride! Customized to what we wanted. Highly recommend!! Excellent experience. Highlight of our trip. We will be back to take another flight.

Eric was highly recommended by the Ritz-Carlton concierge team and the experience with him lived up to the hype. My two sons and I circled Maui with Eric and the experience was truly one of a kind. One of my sons is taking flying lessons and Eric let him fly a good bit and gave great pilot-to-pilot tips along the way. Eric added an entry into my son's flight log book giving him credit for earned flight time and that simply made his trip. Great pilot, outstanding views and best way hands down to see the beauty of Maui!

Our 13 year old was not excited about a helicopter , so we found Eric on here and it was amazing!!!!! So much better than the helicopter my husband and I had taken in Oahu....Not only were the sights amazing from that aerial view, but my teenager was never scared!!!! Eric is extremely knowledge and made sure every second of the trip we were all comfortable and having fun!!! You will be amazed at the things you see you could never view from the ground .....our highlight  were the Moloka’i cliffs !!!! Spectacular!!!!!! Thanks to Eric for An amazing experience for our family of 3!!!

We had a wonderful experience with Eric. We learned a great deal about flying and enjoyed a trip across the channel dodging clouds all the way to see lava erupting, cliffs, waterfalls, and beautiful lush green forest. I highly recommend this very safe and yet thrilling experience.

review_title: Maui Plane Rides delivers an experience of a lifetime
review_text: It was the most amazing experience. My 13 year old daughter got to fly the plane and we were able to circle around the active volcano on the Big Island!! We got fantastic pictures of the lava flowing and all of the wonderful waterfalls along the way! Eric even flew us a little out of the way so we could view different sites along the way. We flew from Maui to the Big Island and landed and changed seats so everyone could have the opportunity to fly the plane.

review_title: Super FUN trip! 我这次MAUI之旅的最大惊喜了
review_text: 超级开心的第一次驾驶飞机! 其实就是在于一个体验 因为在中国是不可能有这样一个机会的。我和好朋友选了环游五个岛的套餐 价格是799刀加税加小费!飞了真的很久很久，飞过了Maui的五个岛屿 景色无比的美丽 很多地方是不能用其他交通工具看到的 但是非常壮丽!飞机一共可以坐三个游客 所以平分一下价格真的很划算 因为以前在其他州 仅仅直升机tour一下也要快这个价格了！反正是我这次旅行最棒的一次体验了！飞行员ERIC 人超级赞 我和我朋友各开了四十多分钟的飞机 当然我们只是辅助的玩玩 控制控制方向 高度 和速度哈哈。在kalaupapa停靠的时候Eric还给我们讲了这个机场的历史！反正是个非常有意义的旅途~

Eric is an amazing person and guide. Do not spend your money on the guided helicopter tours - instead have Eric fly you over the active volcano and see more than you can imagine.  He’s a a great guide and pilot. And my son got to fly the plane during the trip. I will call Eric every time we are back in Maui   Don’t miss this opportunity 

Jim Meier

Was lucky enough to get a flight lesson with ERIC! Took off from Maui,(amazing feeling), and flew across the Chanel to the 
big island ! His instruction was straightforward and easy to understand… I learned a lot. 

Drop down low to get a great look at the waterfalls along the Hamakua coast then continued south and witnessed the lava flowing from a giant fissure
(epic) and a river of lava entering the sea!!!

We then stopped in Hilo for lunch, flew back to Maui and were back in Lahaina for dinner. Truly an unforgettable day thank you so much ERIC!
 
Aloha and happy flying!, I think I’m hooked!!

Brian N Warren

Took my 11 year old son for a 30 min flight with Eric (pilot) this morning.  He had the time of his life sitting next to the pilot and getting a chance to feel what it was like to fly a Piper Cherokee with Eric. This is an awesome father/son or mother/daughter thing to do.  Sit in the back seat and watch while Eric makes your child feel special.. and be able to communicate over headsets the entire time... 5 stars all the way! And the views are amazing...

review_title: First Flight Lesson / Big Island Navigation Flight Lesson
review_text: Maui Plane Rides provides a top notch experience.  Customer service was excellent from the start.  This is the most efficient way to see the beauty of multiple Hawaii islands.  Words fail to describe the views of Haleakalā, and Molokini crater on the way out to Hawai’i Volcanoes National Park on the big island.  There you will see Mauna Kea and Kīlauea in addition to multiple waterfalls on the seaside cliffs of the Hamakua coast. It’s a fun breath taking adventure from a professional flight instructor. This was my introductory flight lesson and I feel I have a firm foundation on which to add more navigation and aviation skills.  I had complete confidence in my pilot who has years of experience flying seaplanes.

review_title: My daughter’s first hour of dual-given flight time.
review_text: My husband and I are both pilots. My original idea was to get checked out, rent a plane, and fly ourselves. Crazily, we bumped into Eric in Kihei near the beach on our first night of vacation. We went with the much easier, and better, option to have Eric fly the 3 of us around. :) Our daughter is 12 and we thought it would be a blast if she could get her first hour of instruction ever, flying around Maui. Her only request was to see where Jurassic Park was filmed.  We did an hour round-trip flight to Moloka’i and back. All I can say is, DO THIS. My daughter was instructed and shadowed through the takeoff and flight. We did some sightseeing outbound and inbound to Kahului, and were able to fly over the eastern tip, and northern cliffs, of Molokai (absolutely stunning). We went out as far as the leper colony (Kalaupapa National Historic Park) before returning.  During the flight were able to get a close-up view of Moloka’i’s 2-3000’ cliffs and falls, canyons, beaches, and a cliffside grass strip/private airport too. We received a short history lesson and update on the leper colony and airport there. Eric talked my daughter through the flying, while making radio calls, and also giving us local history and information. We would totally do this again!  Eric is safe, courteous, and conscientious, and I highly recommend him for flights and instruction!

All I can say is wow! I have taken helicopter trips and it was no comparison to Maui Plane Rides! Eric (captain pilot) was extremely kind, knowledgeable, fun to be around, and knows the islands extremely well. We spent 3-4 hrs with Eric in the air and I can honestly say I had the best time of my life. We flew over the volcano and it was life changing to say the least. Eric worked hard to get us the best photo shots, he was amazing. Eric is a great instructor and will allow YOU to fly (only if you want too) and I chose to fly! Unbelievable!!!

We also finished the day by flying straight into the sunset - and that too was amazing and breathtaking!

You must do this! In my opinion and others, much safer than a helicopter ride.

We will definitely be flying with Eric again on our next trip to Maui!

A MUST DO! Beats a helicopter ride all to pieces!

Wow!! This is my 9th trip to Maui, and we have done it all. From helicopter rides, biking down Haleakala, zip lining, driving the back side and exploring the Olivine Pools and this is by far the most exhilarating experience!  Erik flew us to the Big Island to see the volcano activity and the beautiful sunset!! He was such a great pilot and gave great service!! A must do!!

review_title: Cross Country Flight Lesson to Big Island
review_text: My wife and I took a flying lesson with Eric yesterday from Maui to the Big Island.  It was an awesome experience.  We were even able to see the eruption and river of lava.  Truly a once in a lifetime experience!!

My husband and I booked a private plane tour and was paired with pilot, Eric.  Eric was awesome!  He was very knowledgeable, friendly and provided a tour that was without issue.  From scheduling (last minute) to taking and completing the tour, the entire experience was well worth every penny!  The trip took us by the big island and we also were fortunate to witness an active volcano!  (Very cool!)  I definitely recommend booking a tour with Maui Plane Rides!

Eric was friendly and fun to fly with. He is super knowledgeable about Hawaii and its history, so it wasn't just ooh-ing and aah-ing with the different sights; we learned a lot about what we were ooh-ing at! The best part was learning a bit about the controls, and getting a turn at the take-off as well as some steering action. Didn't want it to end.

What an awesome time!
We flew from Kahului over to the Molokai Sea Cliffs for spectacular views. Our 12 year old daughter operated the aircraft from takeoff and climb and throughout the cruise along the coast. 
Very professionally run, we were in great hands with Eric as PIC/CFI. 
A once-in-a-lifetime MUST!

What an awesome experience!  Eric calmed the fears of my daughter and sister; so they could really enjoy the experience.  My son had a blast learning to maneuver the plane in high winds over the mountains.  We can't wait to do it, again!

Eric is an awesome pilot. He know that i did not want to get on that plane because i am Afraid of heights. So what he did was in courage me to over my fears. So got on that plane and i over that fear. I high Recommend if you come here for vacation to do this tour to see the beautiful Maui. Eric thanks for being so awesome.

review_title: Best thing to while in Maui

review_title: The best way to see Maui

review_title: Amazing Views and a Smooth Ride
review_text: What a wonderful way to see the island! The whole experience was amazing. Eric even let my wife take the controls - surreal experience! Eric made the flight even more special by completing a touch down on the runway of Kalaupapa as we had got married! Thank you Eric! Maui Plane Rides is awesome!!

review_title: beautiful and exciting experience in the sky
review_text: We went along the north shore of Maui, to Hana and back with a few circles over the gorgeous green landscapes. I got to sit up front with the pilot, who let me steer the plane when I was ready, which was very exciting.  The views are incredible, you can't see that side of Maui any other way.  So many waterfalls and beautiful tucked away gulches, beaches, and cliffs.  The headphones make it easy to talk without any noise from the plane, and you can opt to listen to the pilot's communication with the airport or just have silence.  I was so relieved that the ride was smooth because I tend to get motion sickness, but never once did I feel anything like that. The pilot was very nice and very knowledgeable.
The Maui Plane Rides team we’re truly amazing and very professional.  We saw some amazing waterfall along the road to HANA route.

What an amazing way to see Maui... Through The Valley to Molokini crater..  I could see the ocean floor; five islands at one time!!!  Such wonderful customer service and nothing better then the kāmaina rate.
Next trip big island!!!

I highly recommended this for locals and visitors,what an incredible way to view Maui and surrounding islands. Taking the kids up when they come in July. Thank you again Eric for a great day.

My best friend and I were in Maui from New York City for a wedding and when all of the wedding activities were over, we decided to extend our trip and keep the excitement going with a private plane tour over the island as we had heard about Maui Plane Rides from our friends back home. what an amazing experience! the views were breath taking, the plane was comfortable,Eric the pilot was just a pleasure to be around.

My husband & I were in Maui celebrating our 25th wedding anniversary. Of course we had our must see and do list. One of things we have enjoyed on every Hawaiian island are helicopter tours, that being said this time we wanted to try something different. 

We called Maui Plane rides and spoke with Eric. He was so informative and personalable. He  went over everything and we decided to book our tour with him. And OMG!!! My husband who use to fly airplanes himself was incrediblely impressed by our tour and experience.

This was the best part of our trip!  Eric the pilot was smooth on take off & landing!  I worry about nausea & was NOT a problem!  This was simply incredible sights and the knowledge he shared with us was history we will always have!  I wanted to do the helicopter and was told several times this plane was a must!  After taking the trip I know why!!  Memories for a life time!!  Thanks so much!!
Awesome plane ride to the Molokai sea cliffs. Such beautiful views. Learned some history about the area from the pilot. Got to experience  this trip with my sister.

We had an amazing experience with Maui Planes while vacationing in Maui. Eric, the pilot and owner, was an excellent instructor and guide! Our hotel concierge provided us directions that got us exactly to Eric with no problems. He greeted us with two colorful leis and waived us into the parking area. Eric was easy to get along with and made sure to snap a picture of us before taking flight. We spent two hours touring Maui, Molokai and Lanai from the air. My fiancé co-piloted the airplane and was really flying the plane- including take off! He was very knowledgeable about flying and the sights below us. We saw numerous waterfalls on Maui, the road to Hana, Haleakala, worlds largest sea cliffs on Molokai, Molokai Leper Colony, Retired War Ship, Coral Reefs, and MORE! 

This will be a trip we always remember and recommend to friends! By far the best way to experience Maui. Highly recommend Maui Plane rides!

review_title: Flying High... to see the Sea Cliffs of Molokai
review_text:
Yesterday we took off from Maui to Molokai on a wonderful trip with pilot Eric. Eric was kind and informative. The flight was amazing despite a little wind. We saw amazing views, waterfalls and beautiful landscapes.

We landed at the leper colony and read all about the history of Father Damien. Such an amazing place!

I highly recommend the Maui County flight. It is the same rate as being in a helicopter, but not as many people and you see so much more!!! 

Fabulous way to see Maui and Eric is a great guy! 

Mahalo Eric!

Wow. What an experience! Thank you Eric for this once in a lifetime opportunity to see Maui and Molokai from such an incredible vantage point. We got to see the tallest sea cliffs in the world with cascading waterfalls and heard about the history of the Leper colony. Fascinating and exhilarating and my husband got to help fly.. How awesome is that?

From the beginning to end the whole experience was highly enjoyable. One of the people in the group can actually take control and fly the plane into the air! We saw the molakai sea cliffs and they were breathtaking. Our pilot informed our group about interesting details of what we were seeing. We even got to see the leper peninsula! Refinery will recommend to my friends and family

You get into this light, small plane, and before you know it, you're in the air feeling like a tiny bird flying in space. The pilot was amazing, and me being the co-pilot was just a very memorable moment. 
We got to see the tallest Sea Clips in the world and hang between heaven an earth. 
Definitely a MUST DO activity on Maui for everybody. Can't wait to do this again and fly to see Lava flowing on the Big Island...

review_title: Excellent Maui County Five Island Experience
review_text:
Our five island tour started out overlooking West Maui and then we set across the channel to the Molokai sea cliffs...just beautiful.  We then circled around for a 180-degree view of cliffs/waterfalls with fluffy clouds capping the top of the escarpment.  Then off over to the high grounds of rural Molokai.  After that it was over water for some whale viewing and side viewing Lanai.  Next we were across the water again to Kaha'ovlawe (excellent view of the Maui from this segment).  A quick jaunt over to Molokini with a few 180 degree circles and then we turned to Big and Little Beaches and final S turns over south Maui and some S turns over our resort. We approached the airport and saw the original airport (now a drag racing venue).  

We weren't able to go around the northwest side due to weather but our pilot Eric modified the final moments to include more viewing over the resorts and central valley.  
I highly recommend this experience as it was private and on a leisurely pace with more time to soak in the area.  We left exhilarated ready to enjoy the sun and fun at the beach. Looking forward to a future visit and flight to the Big Island of Hawaii or O'ahu. 

Pick your most adventurous person to sit up front and practice flying a single engine plane along with the pilot and take the best photos out of the window port.  Super fun!!

My wife and I went on the plane together with Eric (the pilot) who took us on a fantastic ride overlooking the beautiful Maui valley. I even got to fly the plane! It was a great experience and I highly recommend this to anyone. This a must do.

My husband and I flew this morning with Eric and it was amazing! My husband even got to copilot the plane! We got to see aerial views of the crater and whales! We also got to fly over all of Maui seeing the valleys and Haleakala! Spectacular. Mahalo Eric!

This was my first time on a flight tour.  It was well worth the money to see the islands.  The pilot was very professional and courteous.  I felt very comfortable with his expertise and skill of flying.

We called Maui Plane Rides at the start of our breakfast, our call was answered by a person and we were on our private flight within the hour, my husband sat in front and flew a little and we HIGHLY RECOMMEND MAUI PLANE RIDES! We snapped hundreds of awesome pictures.

review_title: New perspective for a local resident
review_text: I flew with some of my best friends over my childhood neighborhood in Waiehu and then we went to see massive Humpback whales and it was an incredible experience everyone should be a part of it.

Our best friend,  Stan, got to fly us into the great blue sky to see our home and the whales from above!!!! So very cool, and Eric was amazing as a guide. I highly recommend this tour to visitors and locals!!

All very comfortable and fun.

My husband and I️ took a  private plane ride with Eric it was the most beautiful experience ever. I️ highly recommend this experience. It was our first time and it was life changing and we got to see the lava too and the whole island...
My friends and I had an amazing flight with Maui Plane Rides. Highly recommended and highlight of our visit!

Our flight Over Maui, Molokai, Lanai, Kaho'olawe was great. Whales were also around and flight guide Eric was great and flew back around so we could see them closer and get pics. He was very good at explaining everything. We had a wonderful time.

Eric of Maui Plane Rides gave us the opportunity of a life time to see Maui from a bird's eye perspective and actually fly the plane. He had the second steering wheel of course, and he's an experienced flight instructor but still I could feel the wings and the balance and the movement. Being a copilot is a zen experience. I will never forget seeing a huge forty-foot humpback diving just beneath the water at 800 feet. We coasted by the Molokai sea-cliffs and landed on the remote peninsula of Kalaupapa where a single runway extends almost to the splashing waves and the entire airport is run by one hyper-energetic guy on a walkie talkie. On the way back we switched seats to give my wife and our friend a chance to fly the plane. Eric was a great guide with lots of Aloha and lots of pride in his craft. We flew back to Maui and felt we had been in another world for an hour. Highly recommend.

I needed to have my flight currency updated as a pilot. Eric did a great job as a flight instructor. Normally he is providing "Inroductory Flights" for visitors to Maui. If you are a pilot or a non pilot wanting to enjoy the best of the islands you should contact Eric

I had never been in a small aircraft, but this was amazingly smooth take off and landing. Eric was very informative and he was game to fly us where we wanted. Saw whales this Friday. the whales were very cool, breaching and we saw 3 different areas of them. Definitely would recommend this tour.

I went on my first aerial tour of maui with Eric and we had such an amazing time checking out the coastline and many waterfalls around the island. It is such a special perspective to see the island from the sky in a small private plane with your closest friends. The price is the most affordable on the island and Eric flies the plane like a dream.. it was such a smooth flight! Thank u! Will be back! 
-Colette

This was easily the best experience we had on the island!  Eric was and incredible instructor and really did a great job teaching my kids how to take off, land and fly the plane. This is a must if you are in Maui!!!

review_title: Amazing thing to do on maui
review_text:
Ive been wanting to take a flight lesson forever... my wife got me a lesson with eric for my birthday and im so glad she did! 
Aside from the ecstatic experience of flying above the islands of maui and molokai, Eric was amazing. Very knowledgeable and patient. I can honestly say that this is a must do adventure on maui, even if you don’t plan on becoming a pilot :)

review_title: Spectacular Views from Up High in the HI Sky
review_text: We had the time of our life and we also learned to fly, triple bonus !!! I will recommend to anyone who would like to get a spectacular adventure on Maui!

My husband and I flew with Eric today to see the Molokai sea cliffs and west Maui. It was awesome and beautiful. Highly recommend Maui Plane Rides. Eric can customize your flight to see what you want.  He does a spectacular job making sure you see the beauty of Maui from the sky.  Mahalo Eric😎

review_title: Tour of the Big Islland Volcano
review_text: This is the longest flight offered but well worth the trip.  We flew over along the North shore /Hana side of Maui. Zipped over the blue Pacific for 45 minutes or so to the Big Island.  Saw hot lava pots, but nothing was flowing into the sea that day.  Very exciting to see how large the area is and how the volcano had changed the country side.  Enjoyed a stop over in Hilo and bought Eric breakfast for all his kindness and concern about our trip.   Would do it again.

My friend and I took a trip with Mauiplanerides and we saw a side of Hana that we will never forget! :) Our pilot was amazing, and it was a smooth easy process. We feel so grateful and happy to have done it.

review_title: Every seat is a window seat!
review_text: For my husband’s 60th birthday, I surprised him with several wonderful, once in a lifetime experiences. But none were as spectacular as the surprise to fly an airplane! He was beyond thrilled to have this amazing and unique opportunity! Eric, our flight instructor was very personable & professional; and was just fabulous from start to finish! He greeted us with leis at the parking area, and quickly and efficiently got us loaded & up in the air to view the magnificent Molokai sea cliffs. The plane was very clean & comfortable; with every seat being a window seat. And although Eric was informative, he allowed for us to simply enjoy the magnificent sites, without over communicating while in the air. My husband thoroughly enjoyed this experience, and we made memories to last a lifetime! We enjoyed it so much so, that we are planning to take the champagne  sunset flight for our wedding anniversary celebration! Highly, highly recommend!
Wonderful scenery, great instruction and the kids loved every minute. I highly encourage anyone to take a flight with Eric while visiting Maui!!!

My friends and I went on the Sunset flight last night and I’m glad we did this! Eric the pilot is very nice, professional, and wants to make this the best trip!

Right away we had fun with the boarding of the plane because you must step onto the wing, has a real Indiana Jones feel to it. My friend in the front seat was able to Fly the Plane! Seriously, at the start of the runway my friend controlled the cockpit and took off down the runway and put the plane into flight, Eric the pilot coached him through it. Super cool to watch and be a part of!

The famous Maui sunset was spectacular by air. The plane is cozy and the windows are big so seeing the coastline from either side was easy! Great views of Maui’s cliffs, water, rainforest and waterfalls. We had Champagne and wine while watching the sun set!

When we went in for landing the sky was very dark and we could see the lights of Maui; however, seeing the runway from the cockpit and pilot’s perspective was very impressive. I had never seen that and it was very cool. Also, a super smooth landing. 

This is an exceptional way to enjoy a private plane ride and air tour of Maui as only three people + the pilot can fly at one time.
Smoothest ride.  Very professional guide. Very knowledgable about the island. Amazing views. Highly recommended.
Do yourself a favor and don't even think twice about this. The tour is fantastic, the views are gorgeous, and the pilot/guide makes the whole experience even better.

review_title: Heavenly views of Maui, Molokai Sea Cliffs
review_text: A must do while on Maui! If you are a pilot wanna be, and want to see some of the most incredible natural coastline views, Maui Plane Rides is the one! Eric our pilot was friendly, helpful and a great pilot instructor. I would recommend them to anyone!

BEST EXPERIENCE EVER!! No BS when it comes to this tour. Worth every single penny! And this is coming from someone who does regular aerial tours (usually helicopters) but this one beats them ALL hands down! I was able to fly a plane for the first time in my life. Something I always wanted to do and never thought I would be able to do it on my first lesson! Eric is the MAN, very easy instructions to follow and the views are to die for. Ecstatic that I was able to fly us there. Would absolutely do it again next time I'm in Maui. Mahalo Eric!

Amazing, Incredible, worth every penny! If you have ever considered flying a plane this company allows you to do so 😱 Went on a 1 hour tour of Molokai to see the sea cliffs and my boyfriend flew the plane!!! His dreams came true and I witnessed every moment of it 😍 Eric was great and I was totally comfortable and felt completely safe while he taught my boyfriend how to land and take off. Truly life changing and breath taking!!! You haven't done Maui if you haven't flown with Eric, Mahalo 👍🏽

The business was easy to find. The directions were clear and precise. Eric, the pilot, was friendly and on-time. We were given a detailed safety lesson, and a life preserver per FAA rules. The flight itself was over-all satisfying. Bumpy at times but Eric handled the plane with expertise, exactly what you expect from a seasoned pilot with over 15yrs experience. We flew over the island of Molokini, and took some amazing photos. A decent camera is a definite must! You don't want to miss capturing your experience of a lifetime! Total in-air time was about 35min, taking the entirety of our trip to 1.5 hrs from start to finish. I recommend this to everyone who is looking for adventure, photos, and the ride of your life, that doesn't cost an arm and a leg! lol

I wanted to do something special with my girl, and the truth is they had me at "Champagne".  Picture ice cold bubbly, my girl cuddled next to me, the Maui Sunset, her growing smile that became plastered permanently for the hour...WIN-WIN!  Highly recommended - DO IT!  Great pilot, amazing experience, worth it! We WILL remember this hour for the rest of our lives! Thanks so much MauiPlaneRides.com

My friends and I were on Maui for a bridal party and we had a great time flying with these guys,  we went on a sight seeing air tour and loved it.  We were all laughing the whole time!  Definitely do this! Thanks to our pilot for such a smooth flight.   Oh,  and it was so much cheaper than the other helicopter tours, and we really saw it all!  Do it!

review_title: PLEASE ADD TO YOUR TO DO LIST IN MAUI  !!!
review_text:
Me,my wife and my 10 year old daughter booked a plane ride with Maui Plane Rides from New York for the second leg of our Hawaii trip.The plan was that my daughter could learn how to fly the plane.
I booked with Martin who was our flight instructor and what an amazing guy is he.He was so patient with my daughter,he gave my daughter instructions and helped her fly the plane most of the time.My daughter enjoyed flying the plane over the beautiful islands and blue pacific ocean.We circled over Maui,Molokai,Lanai
Martin is a very good guide,he explained each and every story behind the islands.
We had a great experience as a family ,specially my daughter who was happy and ecstatic and actually hugged Martin post our tour.
I highly recommend flying with Martin and Maui Plane Rides.It was money well spent and we had a great time.Last but not the least i want to thank our Flight Instructor who is a amazing person and was so patient with my daughter.
My wife and I took a flight with Maui Plane Rides and we really enjoyed it!  We circled the entire island of Maui and the views were spectacular!   Pilot was a pro.
Oh my gosh-WHAT A THRILL!  The flight was so smooth, and we saw the most beautiful things that we had no idea about!  Our pilot was so friendly kind and very professional!  DO IT!!

We had a fabulous trip circumnavigating Maui and Molokai with Captain Bill Wolf yesterday. It was the highlight of our month long visit to Maui! We would highly recommend using their service as we found flying in a fixed wing plane allowed for a longer, yet more economical and private experience  as compared to helicopter tours. It was a magnificent, delightful and memorable trip! Thank you Captain Bill!
My wife and I really enjoyed our flight. The views were stunning. We highly recommend Maui Plane Rides, and we are very happy that we found them.
I've really enjoyed many flights with the pilots! Very friendly, very curtious. Highly recommend flying with these guys!

My Wife's and I, by far highlight of our aniversary trip to Maui was maui plane rides! It was so exciting! My Wife was a bit nervous since she's scared of flying, but she had a blast! I will definitely do it again, can't wait!
Flying with these guys was amazing.  They totally know their stuff and took such good care of us.  I would highly recommend flying with them.

These guys are pros!  I had a great flight, saw all that was promised and more.  The flight was smooth, the plane was clean and the pictures I got were wonderful.  I would recommend this activity for couples or families.  Try it...

This is a truly once in a lifetime experience. I've always wanted to fly and I got a Maui Plane Ride as a birthday present. 
We took a tour of West Maui and Molokai and saw things that just couldn't be seen from the ground. I hike all over the Maui , but see it from the sky was totally amazing. The pilot actually let me ride the plane for a while and that was the best b-day present. Thank you Maui Plane Rides for making my special day unforgettable.

review_title: Amazing plane ride, learnt how to fly by myself!!
review_text:
My girlfriend and I have always wanted to learn how to fly a plane. We just never pulled the trigger on a lesson back home. On our trip to Maui, we came across Maui Plane Rides and boy was it an amazing ride. We have never flown in a small single engine plane but we were immediately put at easy by our instructor. He explained how the plane flies, what makes it turn, descend, and climb and also all the instruments on the dashboard. From the very beginning, I was able to be on the controls and with the help of the instructor I took off and made a left turn for Molokai. We flew along the highest cliffs in the world on north shore Molokai - it is totally deserted and reminds you of Jurassic Park. We landed on the small airport of Kalaupapa where the Leper colony was established in 1860'. The tiny airport has a lot of information on the history of the colony and after taking a brief brake, we swapped seats and my girlfriend flew this time. We took off and crossed the cliffs onwards to the shipwrecks of Lanai. 
Lanai is privately owned by Larry Ellison and we managed to fly over the Manele Bay where Bill Gates got married. We then continued to Molokini where we were going to go snorkel the next day and it was great to see the tiny semi-submerged crater from the air the day before. Then we turned the Makena corner and flew to Hana, passing the oceanfront church where Charles Lindbergh is buried. We also saw the Seven Secret Pools from the air, the Jurassic Rock, the Liberty Rock and a ton of waterfalls.... truly spectacular. 
By the time we were on final approach, my girlfriend was flying on her own under the guidance of our instructor. 
This was a truly spectacular ride that finally pushed us and we decided to continue with flight lessons back home.... mahalo Maui Plane Rides!!!

review_title: Amazing Maui air tour experience, incredible photos, heart-pounding thrills, saved lots of $$$
review_text:
My fiance and I had a breathtaking experience here, a smooth flight with a super friendly and easy going pilot. 

We wanted to see the Sea Cliffs of Molokai island, as we had heard they're the tallest in the world, with waterfalls that fall 3000 feet from the top, straight down into the ocean! We looked around at some other options, the usual thing there everybody does, all were double the price for the both of us, and they couldn't guarantee window seats, it was shorter flight time, and we'd be flying with a group of strangers. 

The Maui plane ride was way less, a longer flight, a private experience, and we were the only ones. I even was able to fly the plane, which was thrilling, and easier and more fun than I ever thought it could be! 

We met at the airport, using the driving directions on the website and then we were taking off a few minutes later. We flew above the coast of Maui, which was rugged and looked beautiful from the air. The Maui plane rides was smooth, and flew at a slower pace which let us take in the views as I was coached by the pilot on how to keep the wings level- It was so much fun! The sensation of lifting up into the sky and then driving the plane was something I'll remember for the rest of my life! My fiance loved every minute of it, and it was a highlight of our time on Maui, without a doubt. 

If you're on Maui, and want something easy, fun, and comparably affordable among air activities, Maui plane rides is highly recommended. I think maybe they're a newer business, because I see this is the first review(?).    The pilots who fly  are professional pilots and flight instructors who make the flight and lesson so much fun, from start to finish. I really do wish them well and we want to support them, because they clearly love what they do, they do it well, and they do it for, honestly, a lot less than anyone else we saw. 

We were really impressed and totally thrilled by our Maui plane rides flight and lesson.

review_title: Good time on land and in the air
review_text: The plane ride was beautiful and the staff was so kind and welcoming. I specifically want to shout out Gavin who was very accommodating towards my family and went above and beyond to make sure they had a great experience. Thanks Gavin!

Lucky for me, the day was absolutely gorgeous.
It is so cool to see all these lakes from above. You wouldn't even know they were there from below. Totally enjoyed this excursion! The pilot was very nice, took us over some of her favorite places and told a bit about the different sites. 
The crew were really helpful too. My cruise ship was anchored far away from town and I would have no way to get a shuttle after our return. They had a driver take me to our cruise ship tender location, rather than back to town. That's great service.
Booked through Alaska Shore Tours - great experience

July 12, 2024, took a "Misty Fjords Flighseeing". Pilot, Clark, did not have a welcome word when we took off and either a  thank you for us when we left.  Very little talk about what we were flying over.  Clark should have a better personality when dealing with that type of work.   I don't recommend a tour with him.

We took the "MistyFjords Flightseeing"on July 12,2024.  Thought it has been a while, we are still upset of the way we were taken care of for this tour.  Pilot, Clark, did not have a welcome word before the plane took off and either a thank you for us when we left.  He only had a few words during the flight and did not try to  make it a fun experience for us by letting us know of the areas we were flying over.  This  poor personality pilot should not be in that type of work to  deal with people on vacation.

review_title: Do not trust these people!!! What a disappointment!!
review_text: During my trip to Alaska, the most important thing to me was to take a tour on a float plane. I booked this the last day of our cruise, which was in Ketchikan Alaska. On our way into the port, I watched excitedly as one float plane after another left and flew in front of our balcony. I couldn't wait and told several friends and family members how excited I was to take this flight  that was scheduled for 4 PM. I got to the meeting place 15 minutes early when I received a phone call that the flight was canceled. When I inquired why it was canceled there was a pause and then the woman on the other end of the line told me there was a mechanical issue that they thought would be fixed in time for the flight, but they couldn't fix it. I found out shortly after from a person in the business that they called to try and help fill the plane that a mechanical wasn't the case at all. The plane wasn't full so they canceled it. On top of a HUGE disappointment. I was even more disappointed that they flat out lied to me. Had they been honest I might have even paid for the empty seats for this experience, but they never even gave me the chance. I called their number back and it went right to voicemail. I left 2 messages asking if perhaps they knew another pilot that could take me on a flight  but of course never heard back from them.  It's obvious  they care much more about how much money is in their pocket than they do about customer service or even honesty. I would never trust these people. They lost a lot more money by not even offering to let me pay for the empty seats and more importantly, lost respect, which is the one and only thing people in business have. What a total disappointment.

This tour was so unique. We went with pilot Max, who was a great pilot. The staff took precautions in getting us up in the air. There was quite a bit of wind at our originally scheduled time, so they called to ask if we could reschedule to later in the day when the wind has died down, which we could. The views were breathtaking from the air. This was a unique experience & I'm so glad we did it! I would recommend it to a friend.
Thank you!

myself and 3 friends boarded the plane, strapped in and got the safety instructions. when the pilot went to start the plane there was mechanical failure. we were told 15-30 minutes and they could take us up. 45 minutes later the pilot said almost done, staff inside were letting us know we could go up in a few. a group of 6 people then walked in and the staff said we can no longer take you. the whole plane, other than the 4 of us were willing to go up for 1/2 the time with no refund of dollar adjustment wanted. the staff refused to let us go when 5 minutes earlier they were willing to send us up for the whole hour. they refunded our money and sent us on our way, ruining a whole day of excursions for us and the chance to see the Fjords.
I would not recommend this company to anyone.

review_title: 100% effort given by company and they WILL get you to your cruise ship in time 🙂
review_text:
Taquan Air created a highlight of our whole cruise.  My in-laws said "we didn't like it, we LOVED it!"  Booking was simple. Had a few questions so I called and were very helpful and professional.   The pilot was so friendly, talkative, and knowledgeable about the area.  The flight lasted the whole hour advertised and we flew over so much breathtaking scenery - my in-laws favorite was the high up mountain lakes.  The shuttle bus that took us back to our cruise ship was awesome..... our ship was at the end of the line of ships in Port that day and a decent walk from the pickup point but Taquan Air dropped us off right in front of our cruise ship.  We had been a bit stressed about it because we only had about a half hour from the end of the tour time until all aboard for our ship but, all stress was taken away when they said they could drop us right in front of our ship at the end. We were back on the ship well before our deadline time.
Thank you all so much and we will find you for another flight next time we're there!

We booked this tour through Disney Cruise. We were transported from our ship to the sea planes by shuttle, just a short ride. We were loaded in the plane by size for balance. My son was in the co-pilot seat. Can't take very good pictures in this seat, though. The plane is hard to get in for us big people, but we managed. Everyone is friendly and the pilot informative of what we were seeing. We were provided headphones for communication. The flight was fun but a little bumpy. This is a unique experience we will not forget. I would recommend taking a bottle of water with you. The hour long tour was just the right amount of time. The tight quarters makes it hard to see out other windows.

I found this rather expensive for what it was. Yes, it was great taking off and landing on the water.
Once in the air, there was not really that much to see. The pilot gave us some commentary on the history of the area where you get views of the wooded hills and fjords. If you are lucky, you might see some whales.

On 7/25/2023 we took the Misty Fjords flight seeing tour.   There were a total of 8 passengers on a well maintained DHC-3.  

The best I can say is that Taquan Air completely mailed it in.  For the price it should have been significantly better.  Buyer beware and spend your valuable money on other activities. 

The total cost for all 8 was close to $3,000 for which we got a seaplane flight that fell well short of how it was hyped by the cruise line or on Taiwan Air’s site.  

We expected that there would be narration by the pilot pointing out landmarks and notable features.  The pilot didn’t utter a single word after boarding.  Instead there was a cheesy pre-recorded narration that was spotty and difficult to understand.  Passengers shouldn’t ask, “ are we at the Misty Fjords”.  

The pilot, although clearly proficient, was going through the motions and was clearly disinterested in anything except for talking to his fellow pilots in the radio. 

This was the only regrettable experience of the 2-week Alaskan experience. Don’t do it!!!

The take off and landing from the water was different and the sites were ok. BUT, no pilot narration… in fact he didn’t speak after takeoff once. There was a bogus recorded voice that intermittently cam I’ve the headphones to point out a couple things about a few areas. TOTAL RIP-OFF.  We should have asked for a refund. There were four of us. 1500+ for a quick hour tour of some ok mountains. Research before paying.

The views were fabulous. The pilot did a great job of personalizing locations with explanations of his own experiences at different spots. He also answered questions clearly and succinctly. Takeoff and landing were each well done.
We had a great trip. The fjords are beautiful! The trip was exactly 60 minutes. The scenery is amazing! Highly recommend Taquan air!

review_title: Immer ein Besuch wert, jeder Zeit wieder!
review_text: Mit dem Wasserflugzeug fliegen eine neue Erfahrung. Das Starten u. Landen ist sehr speziell und macht den Flug mit einem Wasserflugzeug unvergesslich.

Schöner Ausflug zu einer Staatlichen-Lachsaufzuchtfarm, wo es auf Grund der extrem vielen Lachse im dortigen Fjord, entsprechend Bären, Seelöwen, Seeadler, Krähen, Möven usw. hat.
Der Hin- u. Rückflug mit dem Wasserflugzeug der Taquan Air Tours war ein geniales Erlebnis! 
Im Fjord wurden wir von einer Rangerin in Empfang genommen und sofort über das Verhalten hier informiert. Vom ersten Moment an war klar, dass es hier Bären hat und zwar ohne Zaun dazwischen, eine neue Erfahrung!
Keine 20 Minuten durch den Wald marschiert und immer wieder mit Informationen über die Flora und Fauna gespiesen, gelangen wir zu einem Bach, an dem sich drei Bären mit Lachs vollstopften. Lange konnten wir diese beobachten u. fotografieren, Adler, Seelöwen, Krähen, Möven usw. liessen sich ebenfalls sehr fotogen ablichten.
Für Fotografen ein lohnender Ausflug ohne grosse Ansprüche zu haben.

We went in October fully knowing the weather is not great this time of year, we were blessed with sunshine and had an amazing time. Felt safe at all times and the 1 hour flight was very informative. Definitely a must!

Wir haben kurzentschlossen bei der Bronzestatue gebucht. Mit einem Transporter wurden wir zum Flughafen gefahren, wo wir bestens empfangen wurden. Nachdem wir die Formalitäten geklärt hatten, wurden wir nach Gewicht in das Flugzeug gesetzt. 10 Gäste und ein Pilot. Jeder Gast sitzt am Fenster und hat ein Headset zum mithören. Unser Pilot hat beste Musik abspielen lassen, was die grandiose Flugzeit und die Natur bestens untermalte. Hinflug über dem Wasser, Rückflug über einen Pass und die Wälder.
Am Zielort wurden wir von einer Frau empfangen, welche unsere Führerin auf der Tour war. Via einem gut ausgebauten Wanderweg dem Wasser entlang, liessen die Spuren der anwesenden Bären nicht lange auf sich warten. Gut informiert kamen wir bei den Aussichtsplattformen an. Bereits auf dem Weg zu diesen Plattformen, konnten wir in einiger Entfernung den ersten Bären beim Fischfang beobachten. Bei den Plattformen waren es diverse Bären, welche sich an der Vielzahl von Lachsen vollfrassen. Ebenfalls hatte es Weisskopfadler, Raben, Möven, Robben usw. zum beobachten. 
Unsere Tour war in dieser Jahreszeit ein voller Erfolg!
Abflugszeit 1330 Uhr.

Booked through Ruby Princess and was not disappointed.  The flight over was amazingly beautiful.  When we arrived at the landing point in Neets Bay we had a greeting committee of a mama and her cub and another bear scavenging for salmon on the beach.  We were able to watch them for a bit before walking a short distance on a forest trail past the salmon hatchery to the main viewing platforms.  At the viewing platforms we were able to view 2 different bears fishing in the river for salmon.    We were also able to see a couple of eagles.

review_title: Great Tour, meeting location a trek
review_text: Very professional & accommodating staff. The only down side was the meeting place was downtown & my ship docked at the NCL terminal which was a 20 minute shuttle & 10 minute walk away. They did drop me and a couple others off at the NCL dock after the flight so that was good. Our flight did not land in the middle of it, as some reviewers have noted. The pilot told me this is an extra cost & they try to avoid doing it due to the dangers involved. My pro tip: sit in the co-pilot’s seat, it has the best view.

review_title: Wait on hot shuttle to be cancelled.
review_text: Cancelled after waiting in hot shuttle bus.  Arrived at dock at 10am. Did extended checkin on shuttle bus with no ventilation, drove to terminal, sat on hot bus again to find flight canceled due to mechanical problems. Another ride on hot bus back to the boat.  Understand they can have mechanical problems but they should have been able to tell us at the ship where we had a chance to make an alternative arrangement. Instead, whole day is blown.

The views were absolutely gorgeous!  So glad I got to do this.  Only regret is that while we landed on the water, we didn't actually get to step foot on land as the description suggested.  Great otherwise. Thanks

Wow what a ride! Not only do we get to see the beautiful waterfalls and waterfalls and pools of water among the mountains and the snow, we landed on a tiny Little Rock formation where the pilot let us get out and take pictures. The views were amazing and  the tour was so fun! Talk about photo opportunities!

I took a Float trip to Thorne Bay on Prince of Wales Island for business. Due to poor weather, this was my fourth attempt. Taquan very graciously rescheduled 3-times without charging me. The pilots are experienced, and the de Havilland  plane float planes are in great condition. No white knuckles here.

Super fun plane ride today with pilot Chuck. He’s been flying this route for over 25 years. He provided local commentary to enhance the company audio and music. We felt very safe. Wonderful scenery and our touch down in the middle of a fjord lake was just so great. We do recommend.

We had a great trip out on the floatplane. We had to reschedule due to cloudy weather. I appreciate that they really wanted us to be safe and have an enjoyable experience.  Our pilot was great and was able to give us informational commentary on the trip. We flew over amazing landscapes and mountains and landed on the water near Misty Fjord. We were able to get out there and take pictures of the amazing scenery.

So good this tour deserves 10 stars!  This was one of the best tours we have ever done.  We felt safe and secure.  Michelle shared lots of information about the area and history.  This is a must do tour!

I have always wanted to take a float plane and experience a takeoff and landing on the water.  I asked Chuck our pilot where the best seat was and he said beside him, so i got to experience this from the co-pilots seat!  The weather was beautiful and it was truly an experience i will always remember, and that is what vacations are all about.  this is definitely something i would do again!  Thank you Chuck for the wonderful day flying!

We did a 7 day cruise down the coast of Alaska which was breathtaking throughout, but this was one of the highlights.  Cruising over the mountains, you look down at beautiful lakes and fjords, and see glaciers in the distance.  The fact that you take off and land on water in a wonderful old plane just enhances it further.  When the pilot let me sit in the co-pilots seat for the flight back, I was in heaven!

review_title: Float Plane ride over the Misty Fjords
review_text: Nice flight, but difficulty hearing the pilot's narration as the headphones did not work well, but the views are always breathtaking....we were fortunate for good weather.

We took the flight to the Tongas rainforest to see bears fishing for salmon. The flight was great and our guide to the viewing platform was knowledgeable and friendly. We came across a bear on the path, Mark calmly made sure we stayed safe. The sight of a bear with a salmon was truly wonderful.

review_title: 想像以上に素晴らしいフライトでした
review_text:
プリンセスクルーズのケチカンでのエクスカーションで参加しました。水上飛行機は乗客６人で、快適な飛行をしてミスティフィヨルドを上空から観光しました。
現地に着くと１０分ほど着水して周りの風景を楽しめます。飛行機のフロートの上に降りてパイロットが写真を撮ってくれます。
素晴らしい景色を堪能しました。

review_title: Best trip of entire land trip and cruise
review_text:
We took the floatplane to see the black bears catching salmon in the Tongass National Forest early September 2019. We had already done a similar trip to the Misty Fjords eight years previously.

I just want to say how great Ed, the pilot and Mark, the guide were when we took the float plane to see the bears catching salmon this time.

Mark spotted three whales and pointed them out - he made the flight a real adventure both ways and was polite but funny. We took different routes each way. 

Mark was great, especially when there were no bears at the site when we arrived. He spotted them arriving so we could watch their progress to the river. He was Enthusiastic and informative, even at the end of the season.

This was our favourite trip after 9 days travelling around Alaskan lodges (including Denali) and a week on the ship. 

Thanks guys!

Nice, gentle flight above the misty fjords with lakes and waterfalls and mist making it magical.  Our pilot performed a smooth landing on the fjord and we were able to get out and stand on the pontoons to take pictures.  Lovely day!

We booked this tour through our cruise ship at the last minute and we re all so glad we did.  We were nervous about being on a small plane, but the pilot was reassuring and we did something we will probably never get a chance to do again.  Thrilling!  It was worth the money.
Muy recomendable, el piloto muy bueno , te ponen música clásica, mientras recorres los fiordos, al final ameniza en un lago
Short trip to the heart of misty fiords and land in middle fiord, calm and relax to come back the airfloting base
Fantastic from start to finish. Smooth take off and landing and our pilot gave us a good commentary of the environment we were flying over.

We had a beautiful day which helped.  Our pilot, Jake, was fantastic.  Take off and landing was very smooth and the sites were breathtaking.  Totally worth the money and our time.  Would do it again in a heartbeat!!

Amazing tour over Misty Fjords. You get a bird’s eye view (literally!) of the fjords. The plane takes you close enough where you can make out some details from ground below. We had a sunny, clear day which helped. Well worth it!
Awesome experience.  Larry Conrad, our pilot, made us feel comfortable and safe. We were very happy with this company and employees.

We visited Ketchikan and did the seaplane excursion with Taquan Air Tours only about a month after a couple of highly publicized accidents involving the company in the summer of 2019. Even though the accidents occurred in close succession, it is important to understand how many of these excursions the company flies each day, each month, each year when no such accidents occur, and to consider how many automobile accidents happen daily on the interstate within just a few miles of ones home, or even at a nearby intersection, I think that the excursions do come with an element of danger, but not a ton more than driving to work each day. It seemed to me that our pilot knew his job very well, and that the plane was well-maintained, and that every precaution was taken to ensure a safe flight and landings. Having said that, this was, of course Ketchikan, Alaska, and the estuary/bay where we took off did have a small number of logs floating around that posed a potential danger during take off and landing, due to sometimes being visible only at the last moment. In fact, out of concern whether we may possibly have clipped one such log during take off, our pilot requested another pilot who took off shortly after us to fly by our right side to visually affirm that that the pontoon on that side had not taken any damage that might affect landing, which in fact it had not.
During the flight to Misty Fjords, the scenery was beautiful, and it was fun to land in one of the bays there and step out onto one of the pontoons for photos, which the pilot happily took for us.
In my opinion, all of the best adventures involve at least an element of danger, and the choice taken to avoid one perceived danger is all too often the choice that leads to a different totally unexpected accident, due to an overly-comfortable illusion of safety/security.  This excursion was one of our trips highlights. We enjoyed it a lot, and believe most visitors would, too.

My husband is a pilot and we love flying no matter the type or size of the airplane. This was our first floatplane flight ever and it totally exceeded our expectations. We were with four other passengers and were comfortable and secure. Our pilot was a retired air line pilot so anyone who worries about the experience of the pilot-relax, he had thousands of hours of flight time. We took off and flew right past our cruise ship and then headed for Misty Fjords National Monument. Our pilot had a perfect balance of commentary and quiet, accompanied by a great playlist for our time aloft. The scenery was beautiful-rugged mountains, pristine lakes, lush forests, and waterfalls. We flew past an eagle soaring-amazing! We landed on a lake in the middle of the mountains, stood out on the pontoons for a bit, reboarded and then took-off again. Our flight was about an hour and we would have been happy to stay up longer! We look forward to returning to Ketchikan and doing this again and maybe staying in a cabin for a week or so!! Thank you Taquan Air!

Our family was on the Holland America cruise ship.  We BOOKED For All 6 of us!  Larry was our pilot.  He was awesome! Very knowledgeable and a PRO.  We had a great time and he landed like a PRO.  We would highly recommend this trip and Larry gets 5 Stars!   Thanks for a great float plane experience.  I was nervous at first but felt very comfortable and at ease as we flew around and took lots of pictures.

our flight was canceled due to the weather. We certainly understand the safety concern, the problem was that no one bothered to let us know. We based our whole day on that excursion and would have tried to do something else had we known.

review_title: Amazing Seaplane ride and breathtaking views of Misty Fjords
review_text: My wife and I  booked our tour to Misty Fjords through Princess Cruise. I had mixed feeling about the tour because we could only get space on the first flight out of the day and I was not sure if we would be able to see much in Misty Fjords. There is a reason it is called MISTY Fjords. Ketchikan is surrounded by rain forest and it rains there all the time. We were told that if there are clouds our flight might not happen. When our cruise ship reached Ketchikan it was party cloudy. The forecast had slight chance of showers. Well by the time we boarded the small 6 seater seaplane sun had come out. It was our first time in a  seaplane. Taking off from  water was an interesting experience. Our pilot was experienced and knowledgeable about the area and shared interesting information through the whole flight. However, there were no microphones in our headset. so we could only hear our pilot but could not ask him questions. The headset were old also and at times there were lot of noise. The experience would have been much better if we had better (newer) headphones with microphones.  By the time we reached the fjords, the clouds and mist had cleared and the views were breathtaking. Our pilot flew the plane low enough through the fjords to really enjoy the spectacular scenery. We landed at a remote spot in the fjords and stepped out of the seaplane for about 5 to 10 mins. On the way back, our flight path was different than the one we took flying in to the Misty Fjords. We saw many bald eagles. Overall an enjoyable experience in a seaplane.

Our pilot, Larry, was great. Of course very skilled, but also personable and knowledgeable. Scenery phenomenal, combined with recorded and live dialogue made flight memorable. Would highly recommend while in Ketchikan.

review_title: Neets Bay Bears - Experience of a lifetime!
review_text: What an amazing experience!  I will admit I was more than a little nervous about this excursion.  My husband and I were on an Alaskan cruise to celebrate our 20th anniversary.  We decided to splurge and purchased the excursion with Tiquan Air to take us to Neets Bay to view bears.  It was the hightlight of our trip for sure!!  Our pilot, Jake, took extra effort to make me feel comfortable and safe in the plane.  After a beautiful and smooth flight we landed at a remote location and was met by our guide Mark.  Mark was AWESOME!  He is the "perfect guide".  Mark obviouly has a gift for educating people about the Alaskan wilderness and bears, and no doubt he loves his job.  He took us to the most beautiful overlook so we could see bears feeding.  I noticed that Mark was constantly surveying the area and making sure we were safe.  At one point one of the bears came ONTO THE VIEWING PLATFORM with us!  I watched as Mark slowly positioned himself so that he stood between us and the bear all the while letting us know that he was going to keep us safe.   The bear trotted off up the trail that Mark led us on down to the platform. If one is traveling in this area of Alaska - this tour is a must!   It is amazing and worth every penny!

review_title: Fantastic Way to see a Beautiful Country
review_text: This was my first time in a seaplane but it was the most fantastic experience of my life. The plane is big enough for 6 passengers and the pilot, with good views out of the windows regardless of where you are sitting. Our pilot,Jake, was very courteous and helpful and explained everything to us in a relaxed manner which put me at ease. Music was played on our journey that enhanced the experience greatly. There was a stop off at a jetty in the middle of the fjords where we were lucky enough to see otters at play. Then we flew back on a different route.

Amazing experience. We saw several bears catching salmon and a mother bear with her two cubs very close to the viewing platform. Mark was our guide and he made sure to point out all of the bears in view. After the bear viewing he took us to Lake Margret--one of the most beautiful vistas I've ever seen. This is an expensive trip but well worth it. Because the number of flights is limited, no more than 6 passengers are allowed on the plane.

Perfect for the last stop on our cruise, the floatplane tour of remote Misty Fjords was a highlight for everyone in our family.  We'd been concerned because of recent accidents involving this company and cruise ship passengers, but we found our pilot to be safety conscious and trustworthy.  Views were spectacular and landing on pontoons on a pristine lake will be an unforgettable memory of Alaska.  Of note, we returned about an hour late from this tour because one group was late coming back, so we missed a pre-paid, non-refundable excursion.

review_title: Float Plane and hike to visit bears salmon feeding
review_text: This was the best part of our Alaskan cruise. The float plane trip was exceptional,  but the walk through the woods and viewing the bears from a platform was the most thrilling experience.  Our guide Mark knew about the local wildlife and forest plants and trees. Mark had extensive knowledge of bear behavior. I felt safe the entire trip. Only small groups are allowed to visit. Mark made sure we all were able to see the bears; pointing out bears in the woods, creek and waterfall. The trip was magical.

We were lucky enough to be included on a scenic tour of the Misty Fjords national park. It was a memorable experience in typical Alaskan weather. Our pilot, Larry, was very informative and skilled. We landed at Punchbowl Lake and had our pictures taken on the float. The scenery was spectacular and overall a memorable experience.

We did the Neet’s bay bear tour and really lucked out! Saw a momma bear with triplets and another bear fishing. Larry Conrad was a great pilot with a helpful pre-recorded narration. Nice flight and very good guide on shore too, Joshua. Thanks for amazing experience!

A great trip starting with a short float plane hop to Traitors Cove.   Mark met our flight and took us to the bear viewing platform where we saw half a dozen black bears fishing for salmon.  A couple of bald eagles joined in the eating.  Mark was an excellent guide, he's very knowledgeable about the the bears and the area.  A highly recommended trip and guide.

A complete waste of money.  we reschedule our trip based on their advice to be able to see Bears feeding on salmon. we wound up seeing one bear from about 200 yards away and no salmon. when we did see the one there the Guide made us leave immediately.  these people should not be advertising this. 
 especially with the pictures that they show. this is nothing but a big rip off

Beautiful scenery.  This is especially nice if you haven’t been on a float plane before.  We fortunately got to get out on the fjord itself on the fjord.  However, had the float dock not been full, we have just landed at another dock, and not had quite the experience we did.

Our pilot Larry was informative and fun.  He kept us entertained as well as did an excellent job piloting.  It was my first time in a floatplane and I was thrilled.  The take-off and landing were much smoother than expected.  I was disappointed we weren't returning by floatplane.  The appetizers, salad, drinks and dungeoness crab at the George Inlet lodge made for one of the best meals we had the whole cruise.

review_title: Awesome!  Would like to do it again !
review_text: We booked our flight from Celebrity cruise ship on July 5, 2019.  Larry was our pilot and it was everything as advertised and more.  We had a memorable experience.  Larry had music timed to enjoy as he took us over the terrain and described everything as needed.  We landed in the fjords and some of the group stood on the plane's floats.  We then took off and enjoyed the ride back.
Had an amazing float plane ride followed by Mady serving us heaps of crab at George's Inlet Lodge. Great time was had by all.

This was a great experience but if I had it to do over I would have done a float plane tour over the glaciers.  In any case, we had some gorgeous views, and touched down at a dock in the middle of nowhere in the middle of the trip.  The pilot allowed my son to guide the plane on the water over next to the deck.  Getting in and out of the plane is a bit interesting as it is over the water.  The planes are from the 1950's and everything is manual.  I was grateful we had good weather.  We had headphones so we could hear the things the pilot had to tell us.  He wasn't as knowledgeable or informative as I would have liked, but we still had a memorable experience.

I went on this tour with my dad & we both loved it! Larry was an excellent pilot and really made sure we got the full experience. He told us a lot of cool facts about the Misty Fjords and about Ketchikan in general. The sights in the air were truly breathtaking & being able to dock in the water was amazing! Best tour ever!

I was as facinated by the float plane as the magnificient views in Misty Fjords NM.  Dave was an excellent pilot.  Smooth takeoffs and landings. The weather was clear.  The water in we flew over was glass smooth in places.  The cascades were so beautiful.  I was a facinated by the plane, a six seat Beaver.  The controls were simple.  Dave explained them.  We flew about 80-85 knots.  Dave was often talking with other pilots in the area.  I did not want the flight to end.  I could have flown for hours at the slow pace and beautiful scenery.  This was one of the best flights of my life.

review_title: Gorgeous views and a bear sighting!
review_text: Our family took this excursion during our cruise stop to Ketchikan and on the recommendation of family.  Jim was our pilot, and was friendly with had eight (I believe) years of float plane experience, including prior experience in South Florida. The weather was gorgeous, and Jim took us up with upbeat tunes in our ears!  The scenery was stunning, with beautiful water and mountain views.  We literally flew over the mountain tops into the Misty Fjords National monument where we finally came down for a water landing (our first)... As the plane lowered towards the water, our pilot pointed out a brown bear and her cub at the water's edge, a wonderful thrill to see! Once safely landed, we got to exit the plane onto a dock where we could enjoy the stunning views and clean mountain air all around us.  Then it was back into the plane for further commentary about the various formations and other landmarks below.  This is a lovely trip and the Fjords a lovely sight to see!
Definitely one of the highlights of our honeymoon! Larry was an awesome pilot. Really entertaining, and we felt very safe. The scenery was beyond spectacular.

This is an awesome trip and I highly recommend!!    
Ask for Larry as your pilot he is great and great fun too!

My only regret is that we didn't get to spend longer at the fjord but I understand they book trip after trip and the pilots have to get back to pick up the next group.

The flight experience itself was amazing and I am so glad we did this.

review_title: Una experiencia que vale la pena
review_text: Volar sobre los Fiordos de Misty es una experiencia increíble que vale mucho la pena, nuestro piloto Larry fue muy amable con nosotros, una persona muy alegre y en general el equipo de personas te recibe con mucho entusiasmo. Me parece que la empresa ofrece un gran servicio y tienen una buena organización. Es importante valorar que cuando llegan 5 cruceros de 3 mil personas cada uno, a una ciudad de 8 mil habitantes, hay que saber manejar la situación y Taquan lo hace muy bien.

Short bus ride from our ship, the NCL Bliss, to the intercostal airport for Taquan. We received a safety briefing & then met our pilot. Our group of 5 included a young lady that has a fear of flying. The pilot assigned her the seat next to him so she could see first hand what he was doing which kept her very calm.  The flights were smooth, 2 flights as we landed in Misty Fjord. The scenery is majestic, pictures & video do not do it justice. I hope to take this tour again.

We took a flight seeing tour to the Misty Fjords and it was beautiful!  The pilot and staff we amazing!  The pilot was knowledgeable and gave lots of interesting info along the way.  Our tour went off without a hitch and as a photographer, I got some of the best photos on our entire trip to Alaska.

Came to Ketchikan on a cruise did the Flight and crab feast. Evan our pilot was fun knowledgable and had great taste in music.. Extremely enjoyable!! Crab feast was absolutely wonderful  would recommend this tour to everyone!!!

Horrible experience- stay away from company - Booked a 2 hour flight for family of 4 while docked for the day from a cruise ship. Wasted our time and then told us flights were cancelled due to mechanical failures of airplanes. Rude service staff.
Waste of time find a different company to use when in town.

Exceeded expectations!  The customer service was excellent.  Friendly and professional. The flight was so smooth, the views were stunning, our pilot, Evan, was great. He was a great pilot, very friendly and even offered to take photos of us and pointed out areas of interest. I highly recommend this adventure!

Larry flew us- outstanding service , piloting and memorable trip- thank you for safety , knowledge, the music ,education but mostly a fantastic life experience in one of nature’s awesome gift to all of us.

The weather was perfect, the planes fuelled and ready to go.  Everything about this flight was memorable - from the absolutely stunning scenery, the competence of our pilot and the interesting commentary.  We even landed on the water and walked along the float before resuming our tour.  Excellent value for money.

Went with my family -- travelled with kids ages from 12-23.   Loved the tour.   Our favorite part was when we landed on the water.   We were able to get out of the plane -- standing outside the plane and experiencing the quiet and beauty of nature.   It was fantastic.   This was one of our favorite excursions of our Alaskan cruise.
I absolutely loved flying over the mountains to a hidden lake. One of the best experiences ever. I likes it even better than the helicopter flight. Fabulous views.

These planes are such a great part of history and very well maintained- I loved the views and the pilots talks- the music in the headphones was great too- I would do this every chance I could- don't miss it!

review_title: What a great way to experience Misty Fjords...
review_text: Adam Weiland was my pilot on this fantantic scenic tour of the fjords....He is a skilled pilot and very informative, friendly and knowledgable.  It was a pleasure...be sure to ask for Adam...and tell him Victoria sent you...: )
This was the first excursion we did in Alaska and I thought it was a great way to start our Alaska experience.  Our pilot Harry was great, very interesting and thoughtful for our comfort and safety.

Booked through Holland America and well worth it. Our pilot, Larry, went out of his way to put a nervous passenger (me!) instantly at ease and provided an unforgettable two hour trip which my husband and I would highly recommend and would repeat in a heartbeat if ever in Ketchikan. Fabulous scenery, wonderful background narration by Larry (which included a great selection of music) plus great chat from Larry. Landing in the Fjord was so special and tranquil. (PS. Larry gives great hugs too!)

A must do once in your lifetime. Really gives a perspective of the Fjords and the Alaskan Wilderness. Trip logistics were great and Taquan Air was very professional. My wife is afraid of flying in small planes but she really enjoyed it. Especially enjoyed getting out on the pontoons and smelling the fresh Alaskan air and looking out over the water. Pilot was excellent and it was fun flying in the Beaver. Takeoff and landing was very smooth. Narration was excellent and the plane was very well maintained. 
The only glitch was that our party had tall people and the seats behind the pilot had less visibility of the horizon due to the lower windows. We had to sit there due to weight balancing and safety. My wife's view in the 3rd row was much better. However, it was still an incredible experience.
Did the floatplane tour to Misty Fjords as a cruise shore excursion. It was wonderful! Felt very safe in the plane and the views were phenomenal!!

Our pilot, Mike, and the fantastic folks at Taquan Air helped Scott and I plan our perfect wedding at the Misty Fjords!   The flight out was thrilling, especially from the copilot's seat, and Mike's narration was interesting and informative.  We landed out in Rudyerd Bay and taxied to a large floating dock.  In this beautiful setting, our pilot became our officiant and we exchanged vows (Mike helped with those too!)  We spent a little time celebrating and taking in the stunning views before heading back.  The return flight was equally amazing, ending much too soon with a perfectly smooth landing.  

I can't thank Taquan Air enough for all they did to make our event so perfect.  Special thanks to Forrest who did photos, Faith & Deandra, our witnesses, and Mike, our pilot/officiant/planner extraordinaire!

review_title: Floatplane tour of the Misy Fjords
review_text: We booked this tour through Holland America and it was the highlight of our trip.  Larry was excellent as a pilot and guide and his playlist was varied and awesome.  He broke through the music to point things out and was very considerate of the passengers who had a tendency toward air sickness.  Happy to say there were no incidences!  Never thought I would stand on water but he carefully guided this old lady onto the pontoon and I can check one more thing off my bucket list.

review_title: Bear Watching in Margaret Creek ab Ketchikan
review_text: Der Flug ab Ketchikan war interessant und gut, da ich mit einem Flugzeug noch nicht geflogen bin. Einmal als Bespaßung reicht es allerdings allemal. Der Zweck des Fluges war eindeutig, die Bären zu sehen. Nun, die Bären sind nicht gekommen! Und dadurch war auch der Sinn eines durch die Fliegerei sehr teuren Ausfluges absolut verfehlt. Beim Empfang durch den Naturalist war es ihm schon bewusst, dass er uns an der "Nase herumführt", als er so tat, dass uns bald etwas bäriges erwartet! Eine 3-köpfige Familie, die auch dabei war, war mehr als enttäuscht - da der Vater offensichtlich ein Fotograf war. Diese überteuerte Bear Watching sollte sich die Firma ersparen - es ist keine gute Werbung. Und die Piloten können leider nichts dafür, dass sie am Ende ohne Trinkgeld auskommen müssen! Ansonsten wäre sicherlich auch eine Angleichung an die Praxis bei Safaris möglich, wo sich die Fahrer gegenseitig per Funk informieren, wo welche Tiere sind und erst dann fahren sie in die Richtung los. Dieser Service müsste in dem Preis schon dabei sein!! Ich empfehle diese Art der Bear Watching nicht, und selber würde die Flugzeug-Variante auf keinen Fall wiederholen - da kann ich das Geld gleich aus dem Fenster werfen - und ohne Enttäuschung!

Our pilot was very competent and we had great confidence in his ability, especially since he informed us that he served in the Middle East and worked on his own plane. I was given the privilege of riding up front.

I had a confirmed booked through Alaska Shore Tours for the Neets Bay Floatplane bear watch tour. At the time I was not aware that Alaska Shore Tours had subcontracted the tour to Tarquan Air.
