As the instructions indicated I was at the Ketchikan meeting point but no representative of the tour! After about twenty minutes waiting a member of my cruise ship came by and when I explained the issue took me inside the Visitor Centre. There was no one at the Tarquan Air booth and a neighbouring tourist operator phoned them for me to be told that the tour had been cancelled. I received no notification of this and had waited for over 25 minutes for someone from the company to arrive. He came to his booth after 30 minutes to explain that there were skieners on the Bay and the plane was unable to land. 
That is not the fault of Tarquan Air but to have no representative at the designated meeting point on time nor to inform guests that the tour is cancelled is negligent.
On my complaint to both Alaska Shore Tours and Tarquan Air I was informed I should have phoned them to find out the situation! My complaint to the Ketchikan Tourist Authority met with a similar response and it appeared as though Tarquan Air and the local tourist authority are linked in some form.
Needless to say the highlight of my trip to Alaska, bear watching, was ruined. The failure to notify me of the cancellation meant that it was too late to organise another tour although I did manage to get a trip to Misty Fjord - not at all what I wanted.
Tarquan Air and Alaska Shore Tours gave an apology only after I emailed them both with my complaint and have given no compensation other than the refund of my bear watching tour cost.
I'm glad others had a good experience for their tours with this company. Mine was a waste of time and a huge frustration as well as very stressful.
To ensure that you are kept informed about a changing situation don't book with these companies but work through your cruise ship booking agency!!

Of all the things we looked forward to on our Alaska trip, the floatplane tour was in the top 3, actually #1 on my husband's list.  Larry, our pilot, did not disappoint.  What a great personality. He engaged each passenger with easy banter and his narration was perfect.   Loved the music and of course, the magnificant scenery you can only see this way.  My husband has a few mobility issues and Larry went out of his way to help him in and out of the plane. Great pilot, great tour.  Everyone should do this!

Larry, our pilot, did an excellent job from start to finish, very professional, friendly and informative. We had a sunny day, so the fjords were not misty, not his fault.  As we were taxiing back to the dock,  a humpback whale breached in front of us and then again off to the side, emerging with his mouth open, scooping up fish he had entrapped with curtains of air bubbles.  Stunning!

Despite a fear of heights and, therefore, a degree of pre flight nervousness this was an experience I would not have missed for the world. A sunny, clear day, magnificent scenery and a great pilot in John.

review_title: Fly me to the Moon, Larry
review_text:
I can see that Larry has already been mentioned in previous reviews, but I have to add another because he’s quite simply a lovely man and excellent pilot.

I wasn’t the most confident flyer in my group but Larry’s approach was reassuring, kind and courteous. All in all a tip top gentlemen.

Oh the sights were pretty awesome too.

Excellent tour to Neets Bay and salmon hatchery.  Saw bears, eagles, seals, and other wildlife in their natural habitat.  Beautiful scenery on flight and at tour location.  Knowledgeable friendly and professional staff, guides & pilot. Highly Recommend!

Great experience. We took a float plan to Neets Bay to a salmon hatchery. There were plenty of Bald Eagles to see and we got to see a Black Bear within about 25'-30' of us. S/he wasn't bothered by us and did some fishing before ambling off into the forest. The scenery was spectacular and the staff was knowledgeable and friendly. Our pilot was Mike O'Brien and our trail guide was Joshua. Both were great hosts and had a lot of knowledge. I recommend this tour.

review_title: Neets Bay Bear Watching by Float Plane
review_text: We took this excursion to see bears in the wild.  We were not disappointed.  The bear watching at Neet's Bay was great.  However, the flight to and from Ketchikan was amazing.  We had a clear day and the scenery was spectacular.  Our pilot, Adam, took us to the bay by one route and then back to Ketchikan by a more scenic route - spectacular views.  Highly recommend this excursion.
Our pilot Larry id an awesome job with the flight, narration, and landing in an isolated bay.  Getting out and standing on the pontoons in the bay was the best!

We booked this as a shore excursion on our Alaska cruise. The meeting instructions were clear and not far from the ship. Ketchikan has loads of jewelry shops and it is easy to be detained in one....luckily we kept our eye on the time. There were 4 passengers in our flight, the views were amazing, the plane landed in the lake briefly.....the whole thing flew by. Well it was our most expensive excursion but it created memories never to be forgotten

Tour of Misty Fjord by float plane (arranged through the cruise ship). Arrived at facility, received a safety briefing from the pilot. Recorded commentary provided on the flight as well as information from the pilot. Landed on a “lake” in the fjord. We were able to step out on the floats for a brief time (10 minutes) for pictures. Then we headed back to Ketchikan. Felt quite safe all of the time. Flight stayed at about 800 feet, good enough to see a flying eagle.

This flight was very interesting.  You get to see things that you could not see otherwise and from a different perspective.  We did the flight to Misty Fjords National Monument and boat back.  Highly recommend this flight as an excursion.

My husband likes to fly and so we made this one of our port excursions when we got to Ketchikan . 
I think it was about an hour or so minutes . 
Great View of the Fjords . 

My kids dozed off in the back when we were headed back :) 

Nice short excursion and Larry was our pilot at that time !

review_title: Misty Fjords Seaplane Excursion - Fantastic Experience
review_text:
We booked very last minute through our cruise ship (Norwegian) because we hadn't really planned anything for Ketchikan and boy are we glad we did! 
In reading the reviews I see a lot of complaints about waiting for the bus. I'll be honest and say that the tour had a "meetup" time of 10:30am, but the bus didn't show up until 10:45 or maybe even closer to 11, but I assumed that was deliberate to allow for stragglers/late-comers to make the pickup. 
Once we got to the docks it was a pretty quick and efficient process. We were broken up into groups and assigned a pilot and then loaded onto the planes within 15-30 minutes. Our pilot had been flying for 40 years and provided both music and commentary as he flew us from ketchikan through the mountains to their floating dock. We had a solid 15 minutes to admire the view and snap photos and then we loaded up and flew back.
My husband and I have both spent time in small planes working on our private pilot licenses and the pilot was quick to notice and offer us the front seat (one on the way out, one on the way back). Even though the plane is only rated for VFR, the pilot had the "glass cockpit" terrain/attitude and a collision avoidance TCAS (or something similar) displays as well which made me feel really good about the company's commitment to safety especially when flying so close to the terrain and with so much competing air traffic (there were 2 other planes that took off at the same time and another 2 to 4 in the area on our flight out).
The Havilland Beaver is the perfect aircraft for these sorts of tours given its capacity and they use the modified versions which include additional trapezoidal windows behind the rear windows so that everyone has a view. Such an incredible experience, hauntingly beautiful and very professional/safe. I recommend it!

This was an excursion booked through Holland America Cruise Lines and our first time on a floatplane.  Our pilot Jim was filling in for one of the regular pilots due to the increased demand... and now we know why:  Jim's timely narration combined with an awesome music selection provided the perfect backdrop for this wonder of nature.  Everyone on the plane has a perfect window view for the scenery and a headset for the audio. The take offs and landings are some of the smoothest and coolest you will ever experience.  We went on a warm and sunny day, so no special clothing needed.  A floatplane adventure is simply a "must do" in this area and Taquan Air is amazing.

review_title: Float Plane to Salmon Hatchery to watch bears
review_text: This excursion happened from Princess Cruise in Ketchikan on Aug 6th, 2018.  Our pilot, Chuck was awesome! My youngest daughter got to sit up front with him. On way out he made several passes to show us some bears on the beach and rthen on the way back, he made a couple detours to descend and show us some hard to see mountain goats. Great pilot and narrator!
Fabulous flight with Larry!  Incredible views and lots of laughs. Loved every minute of our tour from take off to landing!

This was a side trip from the Alaskan cruise in late August.  Larry our pilot was very knowledgable and asked if we had a veteran in our group of 6.  I'm a navy vet, female, and 74 and he invited me to sit in the co-pilot seat!  He had to help hoist me up there and down again and was extremely polite and respectful! I didn't take photos because I didn't want to miss any of the sights. The tour was exciting as I had never been in a seaplane before. Would definitely recommend it as a once in a lifetime experience.
Surpassed what we were expecting. A great way to see bears, bald eagles and the fiords from an aerial perspective. Well worth the money.

review_title: One of the Best Tours on our Alaskan Cruise
review_text: This was definitely a highlight of our Alaskan cruise....in fact, it was my wife's favorite excursion.  Our pilot Larry was a wonderful source of knowledge about the area and the de Havilland Beaver plane we were flying in.  He asked if anyone in our group had served in the military, and when he learned we had a veteran among us, he asked him to sit in the co-pilot's seat.  He immediately won my respect and admiration.  Tacquan Air does it right - they are friendly, organized, and safety-conscious.  DON'T MISS THIS OPPORTUNITY!

Fantastica esperienza! Si inizia con il trasferimento in pulman dalla nave alla sede di Taquan Air, e l'autista siccome eravamo in anticipo ci ha fatto fare un giro turistico della cittadina. Io che lavorando sulle navi da crociera ci sono stato centinaia di volte ho visto dei posti dove non sono mai stato.
Poi siamo arrivati alla Taquan Air, dove abbiamo conosciuto Adam, il nostro pilota di un De Havilland Otter. Grande personalita'. simpatico ed entusista del proprio mestiere.
Il volo e' stato grandioso, sia grazie al tempo che e' stato bellissimo che grazie ad Adam, che invece di mettere un nastro registrato ha commentato lui stesso il volo, con una musica soft rock di sottofondo.
Poi siamo arrivati a Neets' Bay, dove Neil (spero di ricordare il nome) ci ha fatto da guida, e ci ha portato per 15 minuti circa in una foresta dove c'erano molte testimonianze che gli orsi sono li', compresi alberi con i segni delle arrampicate o tane sotto le radici degli alberi.
Poi siamo arrivati dove i salmoni finiscono la loro corsa, ed ovviamente gli orsi vengono a cacciare i pesci. Subito c'era un orso, poi un altro, ma per un bel po' di tempo erano lontani. Quando mancavano 30 minuti al ritorno si sono avvicinati, ed au un certo punto erano a pochi metri da noi. Grandi opportunita' per foto e video!
Purtroppo poi siamo dovuti tornare, e Adam il nostro pilota ci ha fatto un regalo particolare, passando per un fiordo non famoso come Misty Fijord ma altrettanto bello. Un peccato che non sia piu' pubblicizzato, ma credo che i locals se lo vogliono tenere per loro, infatti Adam ci diceva che loro vanno sempre li' per camminate ed escursioni o hiking.
Un tour da non perdere con un tour operator fantastico!
Grazie mille!

review_title: Neets Bay Bear Watch by Floatplane
review_text: This was an amazing tour! We were picked up from our cruise ship in a bus and taken to the floatplane dock. The floatplane pilot was very professional and pointed out all the interesting view points along the way. On arrival to Neets Bay our guide walked us along a short track to the bear hide, where we sat and waited for the bears to come. There were plenty of eagles flying around and the salmon were swimming upstream but not a bear in sight! Everyone was very patient and just as we were about to leave a black bear appeared! It was a fair distance away however I was very happy to say I saw a bear. The floatplane pilot took us back a different way so we were able to see more of the beautiful landscape.

This trip to Neets Bay was WONDERFUL!! Beautiful views the pilot talked away as we flew about the sights and history of the planes. We saw all the bears, the jelly fish and sea stars are on the dock. We got so close to the bears! They got us back safely and on time to our cruise ship!

review_title: Float plane scenic flight to Misty Fjords with landing
review_text: This tour was really one of the best I have been on.  Chuck (the pilot) was exceptionally friendly and interacted well with the passengers.  We flew in an otter de havilland float plane to Rudyard Bay in Misty Fjords.  The views were just amazing and the plane was roomy.  After lading in the bay, we took a boat back to Ketchikan.  This is a must do tour.  And I would ask to fly with Chuck again.

review_title: Float plane to black bears tour !!!!
review_text: OMG !!!!!!!!!!!!  What a professional group, best excursion of our cruise trip.  The pilots, planes, bus driver and staff ... A+++++++   Allie our Bear guide was the best, very friendly and knowledgeable about Alaska and the bears.   Would highly recommend seeing Alaska via a sea plane.

review_title: Tacquan Air Seaplane Tour of Misty Fjords
review_text: This excursion was the highlight of our week long Alaska cruise!  Our pilot, Adam, was both entertaining and knowledgeable.  The scenery was absolutely breathtaking, and the flight was exhilarating.  We take a lot of photos and videos on trips, but eventually, we put down the cameras.  We wanted to take in the beautiful sights and we knew that pictures and videos could only capture a fraction of what we were seeing.  If you ever have opportunity to fly with Tacquan Air and take this tour, DO IT!

review_title: Float plane to black bears tour
review_text: Fantastic pilots, planes and the guide to the bears was great! Highly recommend this company and tour. Book early, limited number of people can go per day.
We had a great tour. The pilots were fabulous and Allie was a phenomenal bear guide. Thanks for a great tour and I would recommend to others.
I can't imagine visiting Ketchikan without seeing it by air.  1 senior, 1 adult, 1 child - 3 impressed visitors!

review_title: Floatplane from Ketchikan to Neets Bay Bearwatching
review_text:
Professional warm friendly set-up in a beautiful 1960 Classic De Havilland Otter aircraft. 
A friend didnt join us because of a fear of small aircraft. This aircraft was super smooth with an expert pilot Ron. Smoother than Commercial aircraft!
Video briefing on the coach so when you arrive at the Floatplane no time is wasted. Plenty of room in plane and a seat for everyone with a window! Great music by Steve Millar Band and Dire Straits and beautiful scenery. 

Then getting close up to plenty of brown bears feasting on salmon! What a trip..

review_title: The highlight of an amazing trip!
review_text:
It was a little disorganized and I was unhappy that they refused to transport my mother’s wheelchair on the bus. However, our pilot was just fantastic!!  This should not be missed.  The views are just incredible.  
I also left a cell phone behind and they retrieved it for me. A+

What a great experience flying on a clear day to Misty Fjord from Ketchikan. Booked through Holland America. It was so beautiful with stunning views (no wildlife in sight though). Highly reccomend this tour.

Weather was great, which provided a smooth ride. Loved the majestic views around every corner from our 6 seater seaplane, piloted by Harry, who was very personable and knowledgeable. We had never been in a small plane like this. It was a bit confining, so may not be a comfortable ride for a very tall or large person. We did have to disclose our weight and our party of 6 was split up between 2 planes to even out the load between planes, although they did keep couples together. Taquan Air was very accommodating, bringing a ramp to board the plane for my husband who wears a prosthetic leg. They also provided a golf cart ride for him back and forth to the plane, as it is a bit of a walk on inclined ramps, etc. Halfway through, we landed in the middle of the water and travelers could step out onto the pontoon!  We thought it was worth the money and was a once in a lifetime type of excursion!!

This was the highlight of my cruise to Alaska on Oceania Cruises!.Great flight, lots of bears feeding at the hatchery and the best flight back to the dock. Our pilot, CHUCK, was the best!!!  Thanks for making our trip to Alaska.

Wir sind mit der Gesellschaft von Ketchikan nach Neets Bay mit dem Wasserflugzeug geflogen. Jeder Passagier hatte einen Fensterplatz.
Der Flug war ruhig und die Aussicht vom Flieger auf die unter einem liegenden Wälder und Seen grandios.

review_title: Fantastic Seaplane tour of the Misty's
review_text:
Experienced a fantastic tour of the Misty Fjords.  Loved the Beaver aircraft!  Pilot Larry is a terrific pilot.  Good, trustworthy people at Taquan and a solid organization.  Thanks for a great and memory lasting experience!!
Scott

review_title: Nice fligth but limited things to see
review_text: We took Taquan Air at the back end of an excursion to George Inlet Lodge. It was only a 20 minute flight and they flew, most likely, what they had been contracted with for our crab tour. The flight was nice but fairly uneventful. Saw water, trees, more water, more trees, a water fall and shore line. Not much for narration from pilot and actually flew a loop so we saw some things twice - thrill. If we ever used their float plane again we would look at longer flight to see more things like we did the day before in Juneau.

The bears and Salmon ladder are amazing- nothing like it. The float plane ride was very authentic and our pilot was right out of Northern Exposure. I would absolutely do it again. Our guide to see the bears was dedicated and very knowledgeable.

Very disappointed to have our Misty Fjords seaplane tour cancelled after waiting for an hour after we checked in. It was a beautiful sunny day in Ketchikan, and no real reason was given for the cancellation. Unfortunately it was too late to book another excursion by the time they cancelled.

This was by far the best trip of our holiday!
After a short safety video, we were taken to meet our pilot Chuck. We were in a 10 seater plane and it was free seating, we could also take on our bags. Some aircraft you are asked to leave your large bags locked up, in a cupboard!
Chuck was very informative during the flight there and back. We saw sealions and mountain goats as well as the spectacular views. On the return trip Chuck made sure that both sides of the plane had the same phot opportunities to take photos of the group of mountain goats and sealions.
Once we had landed we met with Joshua, who was to be our guide. 
The group, that had just finished their trip were all grinning and said they had seen bears, good start!
It didn't take long, after our short walk, to reach the river that a bear came out of the woods, followed by a lot more, of all sizes and ages. We spent a good time just watching them catch and eat the salmon!
We saw bald headed eagles too!
There were four of us travelling together and we all agreed that this trip was the highlight of the holiday, so thank you Taquan Air, Chuck and Joshua, you are doing a great job!

This is a floatplane tour and it was so incredible!  Our Pilot(tour guide) Larry was very informative and had a sense of humor. It was a beautiful day and we saw no mist to get in the way of the beautiful views. We were supposed to land at a dock in the fjord, but it was full, so  I thought we were at another dock when he landed the plane. But no way, we got out to stretch our legs on the floats! What a great way to spend the morning! He kidded around with one of the  fearful passengers, and interacted with another about plane stats all along. He told us alot about the natural aspects and the history of the area. It was an informative and viewable tour. Thanks Taquan Air!

We had sketchy weather but it ended up clearing up..thankfully! Very smooth ride, beautiful views, very informative pilot. We have some great pics of us standing out on the pontoon, floating in a lake.

review_title: Neets Bay Bear Tours - great flight and we did see a couple of bears
review_text:
We were sailing Carnival and next to last port of call was Ketchikan.  We opted for the Neets Bay Bear Watch or tour... 
When we arrived to the float plane port, Taquan airlines was our carrier.  
Great pre-brief.  If you have a camera back pack.. they might ask you to leave it there.. locked up.  It will depend on type of airplane, amount and weight of passengers and ultimately the pilot.  I had been briefed prior to and didn't take mine but mounted the large lens on the camera and had the smaller lens in my coat.  
Pilot was great and described the flight and scenery the entire time we flew out and back.  
It was a very hot day.. and low tide.. .the group before us told us they didn't see any bears.. Our guide told us it was iffy.  We did see a few bear caves and marks where they climbed the trees. When we arrived at the fish hatchery... there were no bears and we waited and waited.. I did get a few good shots of eagles looking for a free lunch. Someone told our guide that there was a mother bear and cub on the way back down the trail. (short hike out and back by the way)... We found the bears and the guide made sure we stopped at 3 - 4 places to get good shots.  
No one can control the: weather, tide, and bears... so be prepared for anything or nothing.  Flight out and back was phenomenal.  The pilot even offered to take pictures of us beside the airplane.. Great time.. thank you..

My husband and I took the float plane ride with crab feast tour.  It could not have been better.  Our pilot, Chuck, was a great tour guide.  In addition, he made us feel safe as we flew along gazing at the spectacular scenery.  It was a bit sad to leave the float plane, but the delicious crab feast sure helped us feel better.  I highly recommend this tour!!!

My wife & I took the “bear tour”.  We flew in old DeHaviland Beaver float planes from Ketchikan to Traders Cove, about 20 minutes each way.  Our pilots (one for each direction) were excellent & experienced & provided helpful info.  We were met by a guide & taken to a stream full of salmon.  We saw 2 bears catching and eating & an eagle helping himself to leftovers. We had 45 minutes on the viewing platform which passed very quickly.  

The pilot took us on a different route going back.  Views were incredible- also a little scary!

Excellent, Amazing experience, your pilots will make you feel comfortable on your smooth ride to Neets Bay and we were blessed with an appearance of 6 bears and many eagles. Definitely worth the price! We booked through our cruise ship. Bring camera with telephoto lens, good walking/hiking shoes. We viewed the bears for about an hour. Approximately 25 minute fight to the area. Overall about 3-3.5 hours for excursion. They do have a salmon hatchery, which is the main operation for the site, it feeds the stream the bears search, so likely for bears to make an appearance but no promises are made. About 1/4 mile easy walk from floatplane dock to bear viewing. Bathrooms are available.

review_title: Beautiful way to see the fjords.
review_text: Pilot not very talkative but the view was spectacular. Would recommend if you want to see the beauty of Alaska.

review_title: Float Plane through the misty fjords
review_text:
What a super experience ! Our Pilot Larry Conrad, really made the trip exciting as he related all the history as flew through the fjords. Climbing up past snow-capped mountain tops, looking down into the valleys, simple amazing.
We landed on the water in a sort of lagoon, to get out, stand on the floats and take in the view and clean crisp air.

review_title: Tremendous float plane ride and crab feast
review_text: On a tour from a cruise ship we went to Taquan Air and got in a float plane for a,great ride looking at beautiful water and mountains. Landed at George Inlet Lodge for an all you can eat crab feast. Delicious!  Then picked up again by float plane for the ride back to town. As a pilot I got to sit up in the copilot seat and had a great view and loved the experience

We booked our round trip flight online and the people were great to work with very helpful and answered all questions repeatedly. We flew on a scheduled flight to Edna Bay Alaska and had the trip coordinated with the arrival of our flight in the morning so we did not have to sit around or spend the night in Ketchikan. I called when our flight was approaching the gate at the airport to let them know we had arrived and that they could come and pick us up from the dock below the airport. We got down to the dock immediately after getting off the plane and standing on the dock. I called again to let them know we were now on the dock and they said a boat would come pick us up. Their business is on the opposite side of the river from the airport.  We waited saw several Taquan float planes take off. I had to call again to let them know we where at the dock waiting and finally a boat came to pick us up. We we got to the desk and told them who we were we found out the plane that we were supposed to be on that was being held for us to get on after we had arrived had already left. There would be another flight in 2 hours. No one came to talk to use and explain why the plane had left, you could overhear a lady in the back state she had screwed up made a mistake. They were sorry but that was it. We waited and finally got on a Beaver float plane. The trip was pleasant. We flew out of our location two weeks later on an otter float plane. They had information about the plane printed up and it was interesting to find out about the history of the plane we were flying on. We made two stops before arriving in Ketchikan so we did get to see some sights.
Seaplane trip was awesome.  On time, great views, fantastic ride.  Landed and stepped out in the middle of Misty Fjord.  Great experience, perfect views.

review_title: Neets Bay float plane and bear watch
review_text: Brilliant trip to Neets Bay with Taquan Air tours! Booked as an excursion from celebrity cruise - not cheap but this one was worth it. Exhilarating flight in a float plane piloted by Harry, provided stunning scenery and gentle landing at Neets bay. Guide Joshua was interesting and informative leading a short walk to a viewing spot where 8 bears in total were playing in the water and fishing for salmon. Over a dozen bald eagles were there too. Not rushed and plenty of time to grab a photo-zoom recommended. Return flight equally as good over mountains wear you could make out mountain goats. Great trip.

O passeio de hidroavião pelo Misty Fjords é lindo, vale a pena. Eles não prometem que a gente vá ver vida marinha, li sobre passageiros que viram, mas nós não vimos nada e estava um lindo dia de sol com excelente visibilidade.
Nosso grupo chegou primeiro ao local de saída do passeio, mas o outro grupo foi o primeiro a embarcar.
Nosso avião atrasou e ficamos um pouco tensos no fim do passeio com a possibilidade de perdermos o navio. Ao desembarcarmos do avião, já tinham colocado todas as nossas mochilas na van e o motorista nos levou rapidamente até o navio. Deu tudo certo.
O passeio é caro e as crianças pequenas cansam logo. Meus dois filhos dormiram no voo.
The vistas were lovely, but my 11 year old was underwhelmed and fell asleep on the ride back. In the future, I might do this trip with my husband and leave the kids on the ship.

review_title: The Misty Fjords and Killer Music with Jim
review_text: Our family. three generations ranging in age from 10 to 75, spent an amazing couple of hours with our pilot, Jim, flying over the Misty Fjords, seeing breathtaking sites and learning much about the creation of the fjords and their history.  Our pilot, Jim, was both knowledgeable and entertaining, interspersing his informative narratives with an outstanding music selection.  In fact, it is worth noting, that despite the unparalleled beauty of the Misty Fjords from aloft, Jim's selection of tunes runs a very, very close second and really added to the intensity of the excursion.  Many thanks to Jim for his expert flying, his knowledge of the history, geology, and geography of the fjords and choices of MUSIC.  A memorable experience it was, to say the least.

review_title: Great flight in a float plane
review_text: We flew on a Beaver float plane to the Misty Lakes. We are in our 70's and shared the plane with a family including teenagers. Our pilot, John, provided a commentary while we flew over some beautiful countryside and eventually landed on a small lake. He helped us get out on to the pontoons, took our photographs so that this was just an amazing experience.

review_title: Do Yourself a Favor and Book on Your Own
review_text: We prepaid for this an excursion while on a Royal Caribbean Cruise and were notified the day before our flight that it was cancelled due "to a lack of participation". There actually had been an incident involving a crash landing, about 40 miles from Ketchikan, and while there were no injuries, the cruise cancelled. Not a problem-just be honest about it. Upon debarking to start the day, we found that we were able to sign up directly with the company who provided a shuttle to the office and the docks where the plane was. This was my this time to Alaska and one of the few things I hadn't done. It did not disappoint Weather was great--even a little sun---the scenery was stunning and when we did the water landing, the pilot let us climb out onto the floats ( I don't know what they're actually called) in the middle of this pristine lake and quiet wilderness. And, it was $50 less expensive than the cruise excursion with the same company. There was not one second that I felt unsafe. Of course, any activity like that comes with risk, but I didn't feel that the pilot was careless or anything like that.

We booked tour months ago for our first Alaskan  Cruise.  Had been told seaplane tour was incredible and not to be missed.  We arrived dockside at meeting place. Had to wait 15 minutes past scheduled pick up. Then when bus didn't arrive, operator liasion asked us to sit down it would be another 10 minutes. Then they asked us to walk to to different cruise terminal as the bus was still on way and it would be easier for driver to pick us up there. Someone asked about what if couldn't walk that far. Said could make the driver come, but would take longer.  We got to the next cruise ship and bus wasn't there yet. When it arrived, the bus unloaded some passengers. Driver was talkative but not about Ketchikan or Alaska. He said we were lucky because he had left passengers at station to come get us. Laughed about it and said they'd have to wait.  Arrived at station to find out that one plane was taken to the hangar due to mechanical issues. Asked for six volunteers.  After rearranging dinners for some passengers, we were told they would go on 5:30 flight.  Okay, then we were told by Tiger that he needed two more volunteers because if weight limitations.  We volunteered as other remaining passengers were celebrating or had second tours.  We were told we would go at 3:30. After group was called for boarding, Tiger said it was the 4:00 departure. Why he lied inexplainable. When I asked him why he lied, he said that was "tour" time.  He said he couldn't control the planes and he couldn't control the FAA safety regulations.  Said if we had booked directly, he would be able to do something, but since we booked with cruise line, he couldn't compensate us for the wasted day.   Still waiting for the tour. Will post if we ever make it to the seaplane.

review_title: Worst service, will not recommend since they discriminate
review_text: We were very much looking forward to this tour when we booked it from Holland America. When we took the tour, 3 other groups left at the same time. We were group of 5 and was only given 5 minutes once the seaplane docked at Misty Fjords whereas the rest of the groups got 15 minutes. When we asked the front desk of Taquan air why we were not given 15 minutes they did not have any answer and they told us that it was up to the pilot. If it was up to the pilot I am not sure why we were discriminated when we paid the same price. If I could give 0 stars I would. Avoid this tour operator, they will not treat you right and you wont get value for your money.

We were bused to Taquan Air from our ship. Not long after we were soaring over the cruise ships anchored for the day and off to see the Misty Fjords. It is truly spectacular with wonderful views on every side. The trees right down to the water line and so many big and small inlet bays to take in. Very picturesque. Our float plane landed on the water beside a small docking area. The pilot was great helping everyone out of the plane as you have to be sure footed or you could end up taking a chilly bath!! One of the party decided to hold her phone as she alighted - bad move - it is now at the bottom of the fjord!!  We then boarded the Princess Bay for our return back to land  -this takes a while but you can get hot chocolate/coffee/tea etc on board (self serve) which is great. Our commentator gave us a great commentary as we cruised along. A great trip.
We had a wonderful time. Our pilot Evan did a fantastic job showing us the Misty Fjords. We highly recommend Evan and Taquan Seaplane tours as part of your Alaskan trip.

Took a seaplane to get to a location known for black bears.  Excellent trip with our young pilot Trevor.  Wildlife sightings are never guaranteed, and the group before us didn’t see anything.  We were lucky!   Got to see two bears wandering along the river looking for salmon.  Thanks for an entertaining flight and for helping us fulfil a bucket list item.
We had the BEST flight with the BEST pilot, Evan. You are wonderful. Professional. Funny. Accommodating. Informative. Personable. Great music on board. An all around great pilot. Love him!

review_title: We had booked through TripAdvisor - then when we arrived we got an email with a time which was unworkable, then canceled
review_text:
It is true that it appears to be much more economical to book Shore excursions through TripAdvisor rather than though the cruise line - our booking for 2 people was several $00's cheaper directly rather than through Oceania.

However the time they gave us was too close to ship departure time to be safe particularly when Oceania advanced their departure time by one hour.... When we tried to reschedule earlier - we were told there was no availability earlier - and they offered to refund our money (which was all done very timely = Honorable!!) Later we heard on the grapevine that there had been a crash, and a Taquan Air floteplane had crashed into a mountain in bad visibility. On shore, there appeared to be still multiple floteplane trips leaving, but we had left it too late to reschedule. Understood the circumstances, and greatly relieved there were no fatalities - but this was a huge disappointment in our own plans as we probably will not be able to do such a trip again in this lifetime ....

review_title: Excellent Float Plane Tour Of Fjords And Crab Feast!
review_text:
We booked this excursion through the Celebrity Infinity's shore excursion staff. I always wanted to take-off and land on water in a seaplane.  What better place than Alaska?  The crab feast, truth be told, was simply an enticement to get my wife to agree to fly with me.  

The float plane was great fun and the views spectacular.  I was admittedly surprised to find the crab feast absolutely delightful.  It was located at a remote fjord-side lodge.  Two planes brought about 14 passengers to the lodge, and we were seated in a private room.  Our attentive and friendly server (Patrick), made sure that everyone ate as much freshly steamed crab as humanly possible. It was the best crab we ever tasted.  I found the Alaskan beer complimented the crab perfectly!

review_title: Best part of a great Alaskan Cruise!
review_text:
I had great expectations, and this experience far exceeded them! To me this was not only a fantastic nature tour, but a spiritual experience as well. The 70's classic rock mixed in with the graceful flying and commentaries by Chuck has me anticipating a return trip as soon as I can pull it off.
We went back on a high speed catamaran that was also amazing, especially getting up close to orcas.
Absolutely the best trip. Eric was our pilot and was wonderful.  Highly recommend for anyone.  Best way to see the beauty of Alaska.

My husband and I recently went on a float plane tour in Ketchikan Alaska with Taquan Air Tours.  Our pilot was Chuck!  He was amazing, knowledgeable and very personable.  He flew the plane beautifully and flew us over all the beautiful sights to see and played inspiring music for us to reflect.  We landed on a beautiful lake and were able to get out of the plane and stand on the floats.  How amazing the it was!  I highly recommend a float plane excursion! Fantastic choice we made!

Our pilot, Chuck, was very informative on our flight.  Played great music and spotted a whale and some Mountain Goats for us. Made sure both sides of plane had a look. Took us on one of the most breathtaking views ever.  His landings were the softest ever.  Highly recommend.

We love to fly but this was beyond our wildest expectation.  Would highly recommend to anyone that is on the fence about going.  Taking off and landing from the water is truly an amazing and fun experience.  Our pilot (Evan) was lots of fun and very knowledgeable about the area.  Had great music and commentary but told us if you just wanted to experience it in silence we could turn our head phones off.  I only did that once just to watch in wonder for a minute then listened to wonderful tunes and great commentary.  Going over mountains, lakes, over the town, waving at the cruise ship as we flew so close we could see people on the deck then landing along boats, ships and other planes was an experience we'll never forget.  Thanks Evan for the ride of our lives!

If you want an Alaskan float plane tour, do this one. I gave it 5* for many reasons...we pre booked it from our cruise line, Princess Star, that way we knew time wise we would be safe. Our bus arrived on time, after a short ride we were ushered into a quick safety chat then separated into groups of 6. We met our pilot who was very friendly and informative. Once we were loaded and ready to go, we coasted out and lifted off. We were very fortunate to have spectacular weather, which can make or break any vacation side trip. The views were breathless, I wasn’t scared at all lol. Our pilot chatted about the scenery and played awesome music in between. Music optional. We landed beside a new dock in the middle of an Alaskan dream backdrop, see pics, there were some sea lions lounging about and it was so peaceful. Our pilot took loads of pics and let us take any we wanted then we climbed back in and took off. It was my husbands bucket list tour so he got to sit up front with the pilot on the way back. Take off and landings were smooth and yet exciting. I highly recommend this side trip with this company!

review_title: A Highlight of our Alaskan Adventure
review_text:
My family and I took a float plane over the Misty Fjords during our cruise through the Inside Passage of Alaska. My parents, husband, kids (6 & 9) and I all agree that this experience was one of the best memories of our trip. 

The views are things that you only see on postcards. Evan, our pilot, was friendly and provided us a nice balance between telling us about the National Park and giving us time to take in the sights.  My 9-year-old son was thrilled that he got to sit in the “co-pilot’s” seat and Evan was very kind in making him feel important. 

We landed on a floating dock about half way through our flight and were able to get out and take in the beauty that surrounded us. Evan was nice enough to offer to take many pictures of our family that are now framed in our house. 

If you are lucky enough to spend some time in Ketchikan, I would absolutely recommend a Taquan Air Tour.

review_title: Anan Creek Bear Viewing Tour our of Ketchikan - Excellent Flight, Outstanding Guide
review_text:
Last year, Taquan (pilot Dave and guide Mark Phillips) did an excellent job at getting us to Anan Creek.  However, due to our ship's limited time in port last year, along with poor tidal conditions, we were not able to actually get to the trail head and take our tour.  This year, we again booked our Anan Creek tour with Taquan and we were not disappointed.  From the bus drive to their terminal, to their check-in and flight briefing process, to the flight itself, and to the tour guide - Taquan offers a safe, informative and exciting tour.

The checkin and safety briefing process was thorough, yet efficient (quick).  We met with our pilot, Eric, immediately after the safety briefing, and he walked us down the pier to our plane.  Eric got us situated on the plane, and then our tour guide arrived.  To our pleasant surprise, our guide from last year - Mark Phillips - was again our guide this year!  Within a few minutes we were skimming across the water and taking off from Ketchikan.  Eric provided some commentary on various landmarks while we were en route to Anan Creek, and Eric's 45 minute flight from Ketchikan to Anan Creek was smooth and comfortable.  At one point as we got near Anan Creek, we encountered a rain squall, and Mark and Eric communicated and made some adjustments which ultimately allowed us to safely land at the Anan Creek landing site.

For any tourists taking a float plane to Anan Creek, it is important to be aware that at low tide there can be significant logistics regarding where/how you get to the Anan Creek trailhead.  When we arrived at Anan Creek, it was low tide - and Eric brought the plane to a small dock that was far enough off shore to avoid grounding the plane.  Taquan had arranged a small boat to transport us from the dock to the shore, and that worked out very well.

If you remember any tip from this review, it is this:  if you want to avoid the potential hassles and delays of low-tide arrivals at Anan Creek by float plane, make sure ahead of time that your pilot knows to putter into the entrance of the creek where the water is deep enough (even at low tide) for any float plane to drop off passengers just below the ranger briefing station.  It is not worth your time, or the risk of grounding, to make land anywhere near the docks or the hut.

Let me say here that our guide, Mark Phillips, was awesome.  Mark was friendly, knowledgeable, and he has the experience of having flown out to Anan Creek multiple times in the past.  Mark was able to provide direct in-flight guidance to our pilot when weather conditions got a bit hairy.  And Mark takes safety seriously:  we were in bear country, and after we made land then Mark unpacked and holstered a weapon and bear spray - which made us feel safe on our hike. 

After we got on land, and after Mark made the preparations for our hike to the bear viewing area, we met with the ranger at the base of the trail and listened to a briefing.  We then set out on the approximately two-thirds of a mile hike up to the bear viewing area.  As we got underway, Mark guided us in the proper way to group ourselves in case we encountered a bear on the trail.  And Mark also provided expert commentary on plants and wildlife that we encountered on the hike.  When we arrived at the bear viewing area, Mark helped us get signed up quickly so that we could get a slot in the bear viewing blind, and Mark continued to provide awesome commentary about different bears and occurrences that we saw when we were up at the viewing platform.  I can't say enough great things about Mark; we highly recommend him if you can get him for your tour.

Taquan runs a great airline, they employ an enthusiastic and knowledgeable staff (including expert guides), and our safety was their priority from start to finish.  Taquan ultimately provided us with a fantastic and memorable tour, and we highly recommend them for anyone looking to take a flight/float plane tour out of Ketchikan.

This was the highlight of my trip, our pilot John was amazing, he really knew the area and made several attempts to find wildlife.  Sadly no bears were out but we did spot a few eagles and the flight was very smooth.

My husband and I booked a tour through the Celebrity ships for the day we were going to be in Ketchikan.  Our day was an absolutely perfect, sunny day.  We were assigned to Chuck, our pilot who took 7 others up with us.  We had a De Havilland DHC-3 Otter.  We toured the Misty Fjords and saw snow on the mountains.  Chuck landed our plane right in the middle of a lake next to a pontoon.  His landing was impressive.  We all got out of the plane and Chuck graciously took our pictures.  When he learned of my husband’s love of flying, he told him to climb into the pilot’s.  He did and I took my husband’s picture.  

Once we got back on the plane and airborne, it was  a thrill to see such beauty through the window of a plane.

If you are going to Ketchikan and want a float plane ride, go to Taquan Air Tours and ask for Chuck for your pilot.  You won’t regret it.

Trip was a good experience and would do it again.  The plane encountered an issue but pilot, Ed was exceptionally professional and calmly explained the issue after we arrived at our first 'stop' on the tour.  He was extremely knowledgeable of the area (grew up there) and the plane.  No cause for alarm.  We were rescued by another plane. However we did not complete the tour, only made it half way.  Full refund was given.

review_title: Flying  in a float and landing on the Fjords great experience.
review_text:
flightseeing experience was awesome!  pilot was a great tour guide, lots of  back round information,  He is a native.
landing the plane on the Fjords was a bonus.   They really take care of you from ship, plane, Fjords and back to ship!!

I signed us up for this excursion and was somewhat trepidation’s about whether I would enjoy it (this is where I confess I occasionally get motion sick). 

The plane was a 1955 de Havilland that seated 6 people. The weather that day was somewhat cloudy. Our pilot was a very experienced somewhat taciturn gentleman named John.

From the moment of takeoff it was stunning. John lead us through the beautiful and scenic sights - visual poetry. I got the impression that he loved the beauty and peace of flying in this area. We landed at a remote location (of course I cannot remember any of the names) and the silence was profound and the sights were extraordinary.

Both takeoffs and the landings were possibly the smoothest I had ever experienced.

This is a stunning way to experience this area.

My wife and I splurged to take this tour and I am so glad we did. I have traveled a bit, and this flight was one of the most breathtaking experiences I've ever had. I almost teared up at one point because of the majesty of the scenery and believe me, I am not a tearing up kind of guy. Lol Transportation from the ship was a breeze and the pilot was excellent, having flown professionally since 1970. If you have are considering an excursion, do this one, you won't regret it.

review_title: Beautiful tour of the misty fjords
review_text:
We visited the misty fjords today while on an Alaskan cruise.  We had a beautiful sunny day today.  We did the float plane tour this morning.

I really enjoyed the tour but I would have enjoyed a little more comments from the pilot but the beauty of the fjords mad up for his lack of communication.

This tour is definitely worth the money.

We visited Ketchikan on our cruise trip and had a awesome flight with our pilot Eric who gave a lot of helpful information. 
Recommended to do !

The views were awesome and our pilot mike was very informative and it was overall a very enjoyable experience. We even got to stand on the feet of the plane while it was on the water. It was a highlight of our trip.

This business is an absolute disgrace. They put us on a bus and drove us all the way to the docks where they prepped us for the flight. Once we were ready to board, the manager informed us that they were canceling our tour due to a single plane malfunctioning. They refused to accommodate us in any way, shape, or form. There was another group boarding right after us, and they had no problem getting on the plane. When asked why they refused to reschedule us or make us a priority over later tours, the manager had no answer. Again, they made absolutely no effort to accommodate us and told us we were out of luck.

There are plenty of other flight tours available in Ketchikan, so do yourself a favor and take your business elsewhere.

We recently visited Ketchikan and did a combined adventure with a Taquan Air floatplane and a catamaran ride called cruise & fly.  The plane ride was amazing.  Our pilot educated us about the floatplane and its history, and then he did everything he could to ensure we saw as much wildlife as possible.  The highlight of the flight was being able to see a small herd of mountain goats on the top of a mountain ridge.  We also saw mountain lakes and learned about the Misty Fjords during the flight.  The scenery you can see from this excursion is hard to describe because it is just stunning.  The floatplane trip was fun, especially for the first-time float plane riders in our plane.  Definitely worthwhile adventure in Ketchikan!

We did this excursion while in Ketchikan on a cruise on the Norwegian Pearl.  This excursion was a splurge for us, but it was the highlight of our cruise.  It was just our family (my aunt & uncle, and my husband, 9-year-old, and me) in the plane.  Our pilot was fantastic, allowing us to take in the views put providing some commentary about what we were seeing.  Enough commentary to be interesting, but not a steady stream, which allowed us to take in the beautiful scenery.  We landed in Misty Fjords National Park and stepped out onto the skids/floats to further experience the beauty of the region.  We loved every minute of this special trip and Taquan Air gave us an unforgettable experience.  We highly recommend this tour!

review_title: Incredible views over the Misty Fjords - Jim is the best!
review_text: We were lucky enough to come on a perfectly sunny day in Ketchikan, getting unobstructed views throughout the flight to the not-so-Misty Fjords. Everywhere we looked was beautiful - flying over the pristine lakes, passing right by New Eddystone Rock, even spotting a breaching humpback whale from above. Jim's water landings and take-offs were smoother than most commercial airliners, and his narration was fun and informative without being overwhelming. Overall, it was an amazing day, and we would definitely recommend this voyage to anyone.

review_title: Float plane to Misty Fiords/ Tongass Ntnl Park
review_text: We went on a family vacation to Alaska and decided to use Taquan Air Tours in Ketchikan. Our pilot was Harry. He was phenomenal. I have been on several small fixed wing planes and helicopters, but never a Float Plane. Harry took us on a fabulous tour through the mountains and landed in the water near a cove where we were able to watch 2 Grizzly Bears (mother and cub). This was definitely a big highlight of our trip. My 14 year old son was with me and he said it was “incredible”!!! I would highly recommend Taquan Air Tours and our pilot Harry!!!

We took the float plane back to Ketchikan a few days ago after the boat trip to the Misty Fjords. Absolutely marvellous. Stunning scenery, a great pilot and comfortable return. 
Chuck, our driver was very helpful, took photos of us and made the trip really enjoyable. Highly recommend the float plane back.

My husband and I truly enjoyed this Alaskan shore excursion during our stop in Ketchikan.  We were whisked from the port to the air facility in a comfortable passenger van and eventually joined there by passengers from several other cruise ships.  After a brief safety video, we shared a 6-seat deHavilland Beaver seaplane with another family.   Headsets allowed us to hear both the informative pilot and music which perfectly accented the stunning Misty Fjords scenery.  To say the least, it was both a breaktaking and awe-inspiring experience.  The highlight was landing softly in a quiet fjord and enjoying the landscape and wildlife that surrounded us until time to return to ship.  We highly recommend this trip!

review_title: The absolute best way to see Alaska!
review_text: My wife and I booked a float plane tour at the dock though a guy named Joey. He was great! Have us all the info and a discounted rate that day. The flight itself was truly amazing. Our pilot Jake was a true professional. The flight was really smooth and enjoyable. They played music over the head phones to help keep people comfortable and engaged in the flight. We landed out in the middle of the Misty's, it was beautiful. I would suggest this tour to anyone. It was great!
Fantastic, awesome! Adam was a genuinely nice person, great pilot, and has excellent taste in music. Thanks for taking us the "long way around"!

Wonderful, awe inspiring. Do It! Will be back next year. Love the boat tour of misty fiords also. Don’t miss the bear tour with Alaskan rainforest adventures. Ask for Allie as you tour guide. Outstanding guide.

The staff is very friendly and helpful. Our pilot, Chuck, was absolutely amazing. He truly loves showing off the beautiful places. His commentary was fantastic and, at points, verging on the poetic. His skills as a floatplane pilot was without question. So smooth and fun. I wish I could have spent a lot more time with him.
Awesome experience. Pilot Chuck was super! Thanks! Would highly recommend! The ride was smooth, narration informative, music so perfect! Thanks
Ed was our pilot- the flight was the highlight of our 14 day trip. In the air u can see the vastness of Alaska

Trip Advisor review

Our family group of 5 decided to take the Floatplane bear watching shore excursion.   It was a bit pricey but we expected it because you’re flying in a floatplane Believe me when I say we all agreed it was definitely worth the money. 

They picked us up where the cruise ships dock and took us where the floatplanes were. We were given our instructions and loaded on the plane. Our pilot was JR and he was wonderful and knowledgeable. The takeoffs and landings and even the flight itself were all smooth, actually smoother than we thought they’d be. We flew for 30-40 minutes and landed. We were met by our guide and we walked an easy trail for 10-15 minutes and arrived at a platform high up and next to a stream. Besides the mother bear and her cub that we walked by on the trail, there were at least 15 bears catching salmon. Oh and a bald eagle too.  The time we spent there was unbelievable watching the bears in the water fishing salmon out of the stream and some even fighting over their catches. Could have stayed there for hours as it was so fascinating. They allowed us 1-1 1/2 hrs before we headed back. Once again our pilot JR treated us well with a nice flight back. We were then taken back to the cruise ship. 

We all agreed if we ever come back to Ketchikan we are definitely doing this again. No doubt!

review_title: Our Misty Fjords flight was a thrill of a lifetime!
review_text: My husband and I always wanted to take this tour, and it was on our bucket list. While visiting family in Ketchikan, we were able to take this flight.  The pilot, Clark Hassle, was friendly, knowledgeable, and highly skilled.  His piloting skills were the best we ever experienced.  We hardly felt the plane land on the glassy, glacier lake.  The scenery was totally breathtaking.  This flight is worth every penny as you will see the beauty of Alaska from a viewpoint you cannot get any other way but by flight.  Taking a float plane is a fun experience as well.  My husband and I highly recommend this flight for all ages.  However, be sure you book with Taquan Air as they have the best safety record and best pilots in Ketchikan.

Tour started well with our bus driver, who was telling jokes while she described Ketchikan & pointed out the local attractions. Arrived at the Seaport, had the safety briefing & met our pilot Lew. He had a grey beard, which is a good thing for a pilot, shows he has some experience. Our 5 person companion was a bit scared of flying, so he put her in the front seat next to him & calmed her down. Part of the tour was landing the plane on the water in the middle of the Tongass National Forest. What a smooth landing. Words are inadequate to describe the scenery, so I encourage you to see it yourself.

review_title: Rock the Misty Fjords with Pilot Chuck!
review_text: WOW! What a great experience - just taking off and landing in a floatplane is cool, but doing it in the middle of the mountains on a pristine, glacial lake, was awesome! Chuck flew us all in a 10 seater Otter, which with the bigger, smoother engine is nicer than the Beaver plane which seats just 6. Chuck played some Tom Petty, Supertramp, U2, Bryan Adams and Led Zeppelin while we floated through the clouds and mountains east of Ketchikan. We saw eagles on the ground and in flight, too. If you’re in Ketchikan, head on over and ask for Chuck!!!

Just got off the 10 person plane tour with Chuck and we just wanted to leavd a public thank you to him! What a treat! The emotional explosions that such landscapes can provoke is hard to describe. But Chuck’s playlist enhances the experience thoroughly! Brought tears to our eyes. When we landed (perfectly and smoothly) in the middle of the fjord and were invites to step out a bit, we were greeted by a bunch of beautiful orange and crystal jellyfish, talk about unexpected. Loving Alaska already, and this excursion will be hard to top. Thanks Chuck! We were lucky to have you as our pilot and guide this beautiful sunny day.

review_title: What a great time, lets go again!
review_text: I have never been in a small airplane.  Ours was a 10-seat aircraft with one seat in the co-pilots spot.  This was exciting and interesting.  We flew over the lakes, rivers, and mountains then landed in a lake some 2,000 feet up in between two mountains.  We saw a grizzly bear and her cub by the shoreline.  The trip ended when we landed in the lake (this is a sea plane guys) at a remote lodge where we were given all-you-can-eat crap and an endless pint of Alaska beer.  On my God...  What a good time.  Worth the money.

Our family of four including two young children did the Misty fjords seaplane sightseeing tour.  Everything went perfectly well. From the bus pick up to the drop off at the Seaport to meeting with the pilot and getting on board, it was a fantastic experience.  Our pilot was Louis who is a fourth-generation pilot.  We flew in the Haviland Beaver.  The plane sat six passengers plus pilot.  My husband got to sit up front with the pilot and had a wonderful time.  The flight was perfect from take off and travel over the mountains to the fjord where we landed and were able to get off the plane at a floating dock.  The Misty fjords lake was beautiful and we were able to get out and take pictures of the family and look for wildlife.  After 10 to 15 minutes we re-boarded and took off for the return flight back to the Seaport. Louis was a great pilot and narrated during the entire flight.   If you are looking for a fun adventure for the family, I would highly recommend The flight tours..

Everything from booking, transportation, safety, boarding, etc, went very smoothly.  This is a well run operation with great people, facilities, and planes.  You will see amazing fjords, snow capped mtns, lakes and glaciers.  Whales and other wildlife are a possibility.  Our pilot Brentwood gave us a great narration, a smooth flight to a perfect landing on Punchbowl lake.  We climbed out onto the floats and tried to absorb the sights and (lack of) sounds of the incredible landscape.

Don't have any hesitation about floatplanes.  This flight was smoother than most airline trips.  Our family of 11-74yo all loved it.

review_title: Incredible Flight. Forrest is da PILOT
review_text:
First of all the scenery is an 11 out of 10. Just stunning. You fly through mountain passes with granite faces, waterfalls, thick forests, lakes and land in a pristine fjord. It’s like a dream. I’ll remember it forever. 

Forrest Carpenter was our pilot. He is a young man and a third gen commercial pilot. I have no doubt that some day he will be in the left seat of a big Boeing, but for now you get his superb flying talents in an ancient (but safe) DH Beaver float plane with a Pratt and Whitney R-985 radial piston engine. It is THE ultimate classic bush plane. It is to bush flying what the DC 3 was to commercial air travel. 

He LOVES flying this historic plane (usually N67667) and takes really good care of it. He is very attentive to mixture, throttle, manifold pressure and cylinder head temp which should please the plane’s owners. 

The landing he made in Misty Fjord was literally PERFECT. I have never seen better. Zero perceptible vertical deceleration. He just NAILED it. I’ve experienced really good float plane landings but this was a cut above. It just can’t get any better. 

Forrest knows the local area well and gives a personally narrated tour, not a canned sound track. He provides info on geology, geography, aviation and local history as he flies you through the most beautiful scenery on planet Earth.  

Take the Misty Fjord flight tour. Worth every penny. If you are lucky you’ll get Forrest as your pilot.

The tour pick up from the port getting us to the port where we took the seaplane out to misty fyords. Had a great pilot that gave us history of the areas that we flew over. Seeing the mountain range from a seaplane is breathtaking. Getting to see lakes on top of mountains was also unique. Unique experience with fantastic scenes

In a float plane which carried 5 passengers, 4 of us had a smooth flight viewing snow-capped mountains, we saw lakes sitting on different levels in gullies, landed on a lake midway of our flight, in beautiful clear weather.  I had booked this excursion before we left Australia and was pleased that I had.

My family and I went on the tour with two other people, on a six person plane. It was a short bus ride to the airport, where our bus was separated into groups, and introduced to our pilots. While waiting for our pilots, their was a waiting area with complimentary coffee and tea. My family's and I plot was Forrest Carpenter. Upon meeting him, he asked for our names and then walked us to the seaplane we would be on. We were in the sky for about an hour, where he pointed out to us sights and historical facts. Midway through the ride, we stopped on water and were allowed to exit the plane and stand on the floaters outside of the plane, which allowed for amazing pictures. After being on the water for about 15 minutes, we headed back. The landing was smooth, and done effortlessly. Upon leaving the plane, Forrest was more then happy to take pictures of guests and their family. This tour was definitely a 10/10, and I would recommend the trip, and pilot Forrest Carpenter to anyone!

Great group of people but may be suffering from their own success. The operation appears top notch like others I have reviewed. But they seem to lack the ability to easily manage the large groups they arrive with the cruise ships. They do have plenty of room, both inside and out, it seemed they simply needed a few more teammates to herd the tourists. 
Every person I met was professional and courteous, but often seemed busier than they may have been prepared to be. Our pilot, Ed, (I kept calling him Mike for some reason) was competent, and an Alaskan by birth so he was keenly knowlegible on the local info. However his music playlist interfered with some of his narration. 
The aircraft are like those many other operators use in AK, the venerable dehavilland Beaver and Turbo Otters.  Well maintained and comfortable. We arrived on the hottest day this summer so we were a bit toasty on our flight. The beaver offers good visibility and the headsets kept the wind and radial engine noise to a dull rumble. The flight lasted a little more than an hour and our pilot made a wide pattern over Annette Island, allowing my wife, who 20 years earlier landed with the Marines to assist in road building to see the fruits of those labors.
Well worth the time and money, you won’t be disappointed.

Tour was amazing, absolutely worth it! Adam was our pilot and he was very helpful with pointing out areas we flew over. Landing on the water and standing on the dock was breath taking. Bucket list for sure.

review_title: Ketchikan Float Plane To Misty Fjords
review_text:
Our awesome pilot was Clark Hassell on 01 June 2018 to Misty Fjords.
Breathtakingly beautiful flight. We saw 3 bears on shore when we landed 
for observation! We got gorgeous photos and videos.
Cool that each passenger had a window seat.
Clark played very good music in flight & I wish I could remember the
song titles. I've emailed Taquan Air twice about that with NO response so far.

We left from our cruise ship and took a boat charter into the Misty Fjords with Taquan Air (pilot: Van) brining is back. Great tour. The boat captain and crew were friendly and informative. We saw a whale, Brown Bear, harbor seals, and eagles on our 3.5 hr tour. It is a long boat ride out from Ketchikan, but again, the boat crew kept us interested and even served snacks. The return flight was our first on a floatplane and as hoped, it was not exciting :). Overall a great way to see the Fjords.

I am not the best flyer but I had heard this was a tour not to be missed! Adam was our pilot and he was amazing! I appreciated his playlist as we flew over the Tongass National Forest and into the Misty Fjords! Words and pictures cannot describe the beauty of this adventure...you'll have to experience this yourself! Although it was a three hour tour, the time "flew" by leaving us wanting to see more! If you have the time, take this tour...you will never forget it! Ask for Adam...he's the best!
This was a great excursion / beautiful scenery. Landing in the lake was very cool.  Pilot was knowledgeable and gave a great tour.

Like a previous reviewer, I booked this trip as part of my Alaska Inside Passage cruise and wasn't sure if I would really enjoy it. However the Tajuan Air and the team running this tour really did provide a fabulous experience and I'm pleased not to have missed it. You are allocated a float plane & pilot according to the weight / size distribution each float plane can carry, I shared the plane with 5 other people.

To participate in this tour you need to be able to independently get yourself onto the fabric float plane steps and up into your seat safely. Everyone receives a safety briefing and because there's no room for backpacks or bags on the plane, you're allocated a box with the float plane number to safely leave your belongings.

Before even setting off, I was a whale & large jelly fish in the harbour so I was hopeful of enjoying the flight. Our pilot was Mike, young & really laid back but  experienced and knowledgeable all the same. We flew across lakes and mountains and into the Misty Fjords monument on a gloriously sunny Alaskan day and the scenery was amazing, no wildlife but that's not the point of this tour. Mike landed our float plane in the most peaceful and beautiful location within the fjords for a 10-15 minute stop, it was really breathtaking and a real privilige.
I'm glad to have taken this tour despite my reservations and suggest you gove ot a go too!

review_title: Great flight, with beautiful scenery of the Misty Fjords!
review_text: The flight was excellent! Our pilot, Charlie, was knowledgeable, safety-conscious, and entertaining. He had to make adjustments to the flight due to weather conditions, but made sure we had a full flight experience. I highly recommend this adventure with Taquan Air.

I absolutely loved LOVED LOVED taking off from a lake, flying over snow covered mountains and landing in a tiny hidden lake in the wilderness! The views were spectacular!! SEE MY PIX. So there we were, silent... floating on a wilderness lake... then the pilot, Chuck says, "Anyone want to get out?" That memory will be seared in my mind forever!! What fun to literally step OUT of the plane and stand on a pontoon!! In the middle of the wilderness! Without any sounds whatsoever. 
"Chuck" the pilot played GREAT music on the flight. We all had headphones on. 
If you are going on a cruise and hesitant about a pontoon plane excursion... don't be!! Take off and landing was smooth as silk and goes down as probably the very top travel memory of all time! FIVE STAR! No, TEN STAR! (I've traveled all over Europe, done many cruises, river cruises, trains, etc. but doing this... was the best!!!)

Last week we did the seaplane tour of the Misty Fjords on Taquan Air Tours.  The views were spectacular.  However, breathing in diesel fumes while in-flight was not fun.  Anyway, after landing in the water in the fjords, we were allowed to get out of the plane onto one of its floats without life vests.  According to the pilot, the dark waters were about 300 feet deep.  Once we got out, the pilot asked us to scoot on over as much as possible to the front of the plane's float.  However, once you go past the pilot's cabin, there is nothing to hold onto and the float gets narrower.  Following the pilot's request, my teenage daughter, who was second in line from the front, decided to pass the girl in front of her who was holding on to the last piece of equipment on the front part of the fuselage.  So now my daughter, who is not a very good swimmer, ended up balancing herself without holding onto anything near the front of the float.  I asked her to get back so she could hold onto something as what she was doing was dangerous.  She said no because she was following the pilots instructions and practically could not get back because the float by now was packed with most of the 10 passengers and the pilot.  After about 5 minutes of standing on the front edge of the float where it is much narrower, I noticed her losing and then regaining her balance for a bit.  If she had fallen in the water, with her parka and heavy clothing, she would have definitely gone under.  I immediately yelled at her to get back in the plane which she did.  When we got back on land, apparently someone had already told the Taquan staff of this incident.  And when I brought it up with them, the answer I got was that the pilot will be given a talk about this. 

What surprises me is how can something like this get past the safety inspectors?  As a minimum, during all the pre-flight safety briefings, Taquan Air should address the safety of passengers while they are out of the plane on the float over deep dark waters and provide its passengers with life vests.  They also need to make sure passengers are not exposed to high levels of diesel fumes while in flight.

We had absolutely the best time ever! Our pilot was awesome, We landed on a lake on top of a mountain and were able to get out and walk on the pontoons. The views, the rainbows, the waterfalls....there are no words to describe the beauty. The pilot was the best, he even let the little boy in our group co pilot, what an experience he will remember for a lifetime, not to mention one of us left our sunglasses on the plane and they brought them back to our boat for us and they delivered to us after dinner! Class act!
Jim did a great job piloting and narrating our tour. Smooth flight and landing, just the right length of time. Bonus, Jim played an excellent soundtrack from the 70, like CCR and The Band!

My husband and I had the GREATEST time on a seaplane piloted by Charles Perkins on June 17, 2018.  It was our first trip to Alaska and this was our first excursion from the ship.  It set up our total week by being GREAT.  Charles is over the top with his knowledge of the FJORDS and total area.  His seaplane was skillfully piloted and, again, we had a great time.  Highly recommended!
We had Adam as our pilot and he was amazing! It was such a beautiful flight and Adam was great as a tour guide. Also, if you have the opportunity to be the copilot, it is a must do!

If you’re not afraid of flying or small planes, then you MUST take this cruise excursion or tour while in Ketchikan. It takes the full two hours allotted- no time is wasted. You get there, watch the FAA video, get on the plane and fly over the area and then get driven back. Misty Fjords is spectacular and there simply can’t be a better way to see it. (Air is superior to sea level if you really want to see mountains. Taquan has this trip down to an efficient but friendly science. I only spent 8 hours in Ketchikan, but I’m very glad that I spent two of them with these folks. Worth every penny, in exchange for which I got a lifetime of memories.

Great tour! The weather was perfect. The Glacier was the most beautiful thing I’d ever seen. The pilot was so attentive to us. Answered questions and provided the ride of our life. I’d do a helicopter tour again.

My family and I had a great time on the floatplane.The area is very scenic and we really enjoyed ourselves. Our pilot, Jimmy, was awesome and very knowledgeable! He really helped make the experience for us!

I had done a flightseeing tour in Anchorage that was the highlight of my cruise ship trip to Alaska, that when we stopped in Ketchikan I wanted to do a seaplane tour as well.  This activity has been highly rated by so many reviewers, I decided to do it with Taquan Air Tours.  It is impressive to see their facility as they appear to be running a very successful tour company,  I was disappointed to find out that the 2 hour tour, was not 2 hours flying, but rather 2 hours from the start of the shuttle at the port to return to the port.  Our flight ended up being an hour and five minutes.  I never saw the waterfall they said we would see.  The pilot did not allow us out of the plane when we landed stating it was too slippery.  Others taking the flight that day did so.  Our pilot didn't point out very much.  Misty Fjords was pretty much just forest and to make this flight even less enjoyable they were playing Credence Clearwater Revival music over the headphones!!!  Seriously?!?!?!  That is music from my era, but not what I want to hear when I am supposed to be viewing beautiful scenery.  I advise you to skip this expensive excursion.  Not worth it!
This was a wonderful excursion. Incredibly beautiful and our pilot Sheldon was a delight. Highly recommended.
Our pilot Mike was an excellent tour guide giving great detail behind the outstanding visual scenery.  The fjords are just unbelievably beautiful.

review_title: Touring the Misty Fjords with Taquan Air
review_text: While on the Crystal Symphony ship touring Alaska and while in Ketchikan we did an excursion to see the Fjords. We took the seaplane tour with Fjords. It s a an hour tour and fortunately had a rare good weather day. Since it rains most days, it was extraordinary to have a high ceiling with the clouds so we had a great view of the forests and waterways. Our Captain Ed was a local native and intimately familiar with the history of the area, the logging, the canneries, and the evolution of tourism in the area. The value of the excursion was good and we had a unique opportunity to see this great part of the country.

After being on the cruise ship it was definitely a change of view. The sights are worth all the money spent. Price was well worth the tour. Mike the pilot was great and got us all back safe and sound. The photo op standing on float of plane is a great picture. Thanks
What a great tour with our Pilot Chuck. We saw great views and interesting facts about the plane and the area. Highlight of our trip.

review_title: An amazing sky tour of God's Country
review_text: After cruising up from Seattle on  the Emerald Princess we didn't think that it could get any better. Our pilot Chuck took us all along Misty Fjords and we saw nature at it's best. To see this land untouched by what we humans have done to the rest of the country you have to marvel in it's majesty. Chuck made this trip an adventure that we will never forget and will definitely try to come back. If you have the opportunity to take a trip to Alaska take advantage of this amazing trip
Jim was our guide for our tour this morning and we had a really great time! The views were amazing and the playlist was on point. Definitely something you should do while you're here!

A perfectly sunny day to go see the beautiful Misty Fjords with our pilot Jim. We had a great time on our day off, he was very informative and friendly. Best of all he cranked some sick tunes (CCR) and pulled out his little hula skirt girl, all fitting for the ride into the mountains. Thankful for a one of a kind experience, would do again.

review_title: Thanks for a great Alaska excursion.  Love this trip
review_text: Chuck was our pilot and was great for info and was a lot of fun.  The Misti Fiords were fantastic.  This is a must excursion for anyone going to Ketchikan.

We stepped off our cruise ship and chose this tour as it sounded good and reasonably priced compared to price on board the ship where we had not booked earlier. We were immediately transported from there in a mini van to the Taquan flying area. After a very short wait where we could have coffee or use the restroom we were allotted a plane and pilot. We were a group of 9 all together and were allotted one of the larger seaplanes. Our pilot was Adam - an experienced flier who also gave us great commentary and had a great sense of humour! He landed on a fjord too and we got a great view and photos!
All in all it was a great experience - one not to be missed!

We did the Misty Fjords floatplane trip as part of a Princess cruise option package and it came with glowing recommendations. Conditions very wet with low cloud and storms but we did fly and pilot tried hard to get us some good views.
The worst part was my travelling companion and I were seated one seat behind pilot, the seats were high compared to the windows and you had to slide down on the seat to get any views (with your knees up around your ears).
