We did land on a fjord but it was too wet to get out to enjoy the scenery and silence. I appreciate they have to arrange seating to balance the plane however they need to account for height when arranging this . Or change the plane or seating to at least see the views.
Very expensive for what we got. Disappointing compared to other similar fixed wing or helicopter flights taken around the world.

Our pilot, Clark, is a lifetime resident of Ketchikan and was a wonderful guide with local knowledge of the area. The highlight was an isolated lake landing, stepping out onto the plane's pontoon and photographing a mama and baby brown bear munching on grass. We would do this all over again. Thanks

My wife and I took the seaplane flight to Misty Fjord as our Ketchikan shore excursion.  We were truly in awe of the views and the immense power and beauty of nature all around us.  Our guide was completely professional and offered interesting narration, not to mention a perfect music playlist! Our only regret was not being able to stay out longer.  An absolute must do, highly recommended.
Misty Fjords was Breathtakingly beautiful and our pilot Brentwood from Taquan Air was amazing! Such a personable guy and smooth piloting. Thoroughly enjoyed this tour!

My husband and I did the Misty Fjords Seaplane tour as part of a cruise excursion. Our pilot Louis was very knowledgeable and went above and beyond, no pun intended, to show us extra sights. We were able to land at a dock on a lake and snap a few photos. Overall, the experience was amazing and the views were incredible!

We got of our cruise ship early and were able to purchase our trip from one of the operators at the end of the dock.  Apparently they sell what the cruise lines have been unable to sell, so are able to sell unsold seats at a discount.  It’s a risk but if you are flexible this is a great option.  We were placed on an early tour and a shuttle took us to the Taquan office.  After a safety briefing we met our pilot and boarded our sea plane.  From here it was a magnificent early morning flight to a floating pontoon in the Tongrass National Forest.  Words cannot do justice to the scenery and the tranquility felt during our short stay on the pontoon.  Time on plane and short stop was about 90 min.  Our pilot Forest was extremely professional and provided a great commentary.  Definitely one of the highlights of our Alaska trip.

review_title: Better Than I Could Have Ever Expected
review_text: This is the number 1 excursion that my daughter wanted to do on our Alaskan cruise.  Though I was a little apprehensive when it comes to small planes, I was so glad she got me to do this.  I was the highlight of the cruise for me.  The views are spectacular, even on an overcast day.  Our pilot, Larry, was great and informative about explaining the sights. I would highly recommend this to anyone visiting Alaska.  If you have not seen it from the air, then you have not seen Alaska.

review_title: Misty fjords by seaplane is awesome!
review_text: The Misty Fjords by Sea Plane Adventure we booked through Holland America is awesome! Every aspect of this trip was just perfect. All staff members were courteous, professional, and safety conscious. From the exhilarating take off, to the spectacular views of fjords and waterfalls, to the smooth landing on water by our experienced pilot Brent - this trip was truly amazing! Highly recommend this trip!

We had a beautiful day. Unbelievable! Th flight from the dock to the crab feast was short. About 20 minutes. Our pilot did not talk during the flight although I understand some of the pilots do speak while in the air providing information about the area. Was fun but the flight was not the best part. The crab feast was.

Larry and Chuck were our pilots/tour guides on our Misty Fjords floatplane trip.  Both guys were friendly and made our experience even better.  The splurge for a flightseeing tour is worth it after taking in the scenery and landing in one of the lakes surrounded by the pristine quiet.  Our tour in May was a little early for wildlife spotting, but the geological formations of this area are truly awesome.  A great way to see wilder Alaska.

My family of 4 (kids age 17 & 12) booked the seaplane excursion for our last adventure in Alaska and we certainly saved the best for last. Our pilot, Van, was great. He made the whole experience exceptional. The kids were in complete awe the entire time and now my son wants to get his pilots license! Truly and amazing experience and so happy we spent the money.

I booked a tour to Misty Fjords. We were greeted by friendly staff and smiles all around. The process was easy and organized. We watched a simple video on plane safety then walked outside to meet our Pilot. We were paired with Jake who split us based on weight and seated us quickly and we took to the sky. I was in the co-pilot seat and Jake made us all feel comfortable with an awesome music selection. He told us about sights below but respectfully left space for quiet reflection. Every moment of this flight was beautiful and we will be flying with Taquan Air the next chance we have. When in Ketchikan, don't pass this up and go with Jake. 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

review_title: By mistake... but glad it happen
review_text: So on our recent Alaskan cruise, our White Pass train ride was canceled due to a rockslide so in rebooking our excursion my son and I chose to go on a seaplane ride of the Misty Fjords and we are glad we did. I will be honest I was a little nervous because it was raining when we arrived at Ketchikan, but the tour reassured us that they only fly if there is good visibility. The other thing I was nervous about was our pilot. He looked straight out of high school. The truth is he is 24 and very professional at this job.  The tour itself was breathtaking with our pilot pointing out areas of interest. Overall Taquan Air does an outstanding job making a memorial expereince.

Our pilot was simply brilliant.  The weather was ideal for taking in the splendour of the snow capped mountains, the bright blue water and the many islands.  Hubby snagged the co-pilot's seat and I had the rear seat to myself which was ideal for taking pictures from either side.  At times we flew between mountain peaks which seemed almost close enough to touch.  It was a great experience landing on the water and walking along the float before heading back.

A wonderful tour which I would highly recommend.

A visit to Alaska would be incomplete without this seaplane Ride. 75 minutes of Bliss. Breathtaking scenarios, mountains, lakes, sea, landing on water. The pilot keeps us enlightened with a witty commentary.

Very organized excursion, got there quick via coach bus, safety video, then off for what has become my #1 excursion of my life! Chuck was our pilot and he is so knowledgeable of the area and a great pilot! We saw lakes, waterfalls, white topped mountains and even landed in a lake! Got out on the pontoon to stretch and smell the clean crisp air. Beautiful day in Ketchikan! If you only do one thing it must be this float plane ride!
Una experiencia divertida con espectaculares vistas. En el paquete que contratamos incluida la comida de cangrejos!!! Excelente!!!!
This was my favorite thing of the whole trip. The day was well spent, our pilot Charles Perkins was the best.. good narration and music to go with it.

We had a great flight on our recent cruise stop in Ketchikan. Luckily, we had perfect weather and it was a smooth flight highlighted by a landing at Nooya lake to stretch our legs and a great landing back in the harbor with lots of traffic around us. Beautiful views throughout!

Forrest our pilot was a brilliant pilot and a wealth of knowledge.
I overcame my nerves and after 30 or 40 minutes we landed on a lake in the middle of the Ketchikan Misty Fjords.
Climbing onto the flotation thingies and photographing the surrounds was an unforgettable experience.
Ketchikan in springtime - Absolutely Fabulous.

One of the great travel adventures in a lifetime! Short, a bit costly, but a marvelous floatplane trip with 'landing' at Misty Fjords, even in drizzly weater. Magnificent scenery and info all the way there and back. Our pilot was Larry, who was extra helpful and knew all the answers.
Don't tour this part of Alaska and miss this!

We had a great experience on this tour of the Misty Fjords National Monument FloatPlane on May 20, 2018.  This was the first time we had flown in a floatplane and the experience was amazing.  We had excellent flying weather and was able to see many beautiful sites.  I would highly recommend this company as safety was their first priority and we felt very safe during this tour.  We even landed on the lake and was able to step out on the floats.  Love the entire experience!

Such an amazing experience with breathtaking views. Would definitely do again! From Sea takeoff to lake landing and takeoff the ride was incredibly smooth. We debated booking this or the flight and crab feed and are so happy we chose the linger flight to enjoy views otherwise missed.

review_title: Amazing Taquan Air trip to Misty Fjords
review_text: This was my favourite of all the excursions we did on our Alaskan cruise and we only booked it while on the ship because my friend liked the look of it. So very glad we did. The beauty of this place cannot be described - its vastness and silence, with nature laid out below and in beautiful action. The ice was just starting to melt in May so the waterfalls were still running, and we had a spectacular cloud-free sky. Glaciated valleys, forests and swamps - what an amazing landscape. I could have stayed in the plane for twice as long although the trip lasted over an hour in any case. At one point we landed in a fjord which was spectacular - I had never flown in a float plane before. The commentary was superb as well. All in all, what a superb way to feed your soul. Do not miss.

review_title: Thank you Larry. This was amazing. This was the highlight of my life. I wanted to do it again.
review_text: I never thought I could get up the courage to do this. When it was over I wanted to do it again. Larry was such a good pilot, I felt so safe and did something so spectacular I can't believe it. You can't imagine how exciting it was. I hope someday I get to do it again and Larry I will ask for you to be our pilot.  The entire excursion from beginning to end was wonderful.

Forrest and his Beaver - awesome!
We did the Misty Fjord flight - couldn’t have asked for more. Great company with fabulous team, especially Forrest

review_title: Exclusive flight and crab fest George Inlet Inn
review_text: The best excursion my husband and I have ever done!! Totally cool. Smooth take off and landing. Beautiful sight seeing. I would do it again and again.

We had an enjoyable flight even though I do not like highes our pilot  Larry was very reassuring and I felt safe... The scenary was amazing and we were very lucky with the weather we took some wonderful photos and landed on the Floyds and yes I did go out onto the float!

Though a white knuckle flyer on commercial flights, took the chance on an air tour of Mystic Fjord. Extraordinary views on a clear, sunny day of Ketchikan, mountains, lakes and fortunately a whale near a ship to be able to compare scale. Mike, our pilot, was very calm and competent and took great pride in the plane and its capabilities. The landing on a lake mid trip was an extraordinary highlight.

review_title: Great floatplane ride- wonderful scenery and narration
review_text: We enjoyed a float plane ride over the misty fjords.  The plane stopped on a dock so we could get out and take pictures,etc.the pilot Adam gave a great narration on the tour.

We were very lucky to have an excellent pilot who took us over the misty fjords.  We saw humpback whales, waterfalls, no bears I’m afraid, but it was a wonderful experience.  We were lucky as we were told other flights had to be cancelled.  So glad we picked early morning for our one hour flight.  Even had the chance to stand on the floats of the plane.  Thank you team!

Great Pilot with excellent commentary when it was required.  Very informative recording while we were flying, and we were so fortunate with the weather.  Views were amazing.
What a very professional company and I would highly recommend.
Said we’d be leaving by 8am and have been sitting here for over an hour. Complete joke. Can’t stand this place.
Teníamos ganas de observar los fiordos , nos pareció bonita la  experiencia . El personal muy amable , tomamos fotos hermosas

O passeio de hidroaviao pelos fiordes é fantastico. É bem caro, mas se tiver condicoes nao ira se arrepender. Fomos em um dia de ceu azul e da para ver muita coisa. Tem muitas montanhas, lagos, cachoeiras. O passeio inclui um pouso em um lago remoto. Bem legal.
This was a great flight.  Our pilot, John, was very informative.  We had beautiful weather and the scenery was amazing.  This is a great way to see the beauty of Alaska.
Not a fan of heights but this sure put me at ease. Landing on the lake at high altitude was unforgettable.

Ich lebe im Sommer auf Kosciusko Island und fliege mit Taquan Air, seit die Airline in  Ketchikan existiert. Noch nie gab es einen ernsten Zwischenfall, d.h. Taquan ist absolut sicher und zuverlässig. Das Bodenpersonal ist freundlich und auskunftsbereit und immer auf der Suche nach einer Lösung. Die Preise waren in den letzten Jahren erschwinglich und stabil. Alles in allem kann ich Taquan - für Charter und Scheduled Flights- nur empfehlen.

review_title: An experience we will never forget
review_text: Our flight was wonderful.  Beautiful Sunny day!  Magnificent scenery. Great music.  I can't put into words how inspiring being up there above the majestic mountains and beautiful blue waters made me feel.  Our pilot, Chuck, made us all feel at ease, answered all our questions and really made us feel at home.  When we landed on the water in the quiet little bay it was like slicing through butter.  No bumps at all.  Take off was just as smooth.  We will think of this day and Chuck fondly for the rest of our lives.

We were picked up by bus from our ship and driven to our destination. Our driver was also a tour guide along the way. After some brief instructions, we boarded the sea plane with 4 other people. My husband got to sit in the co-pilot's seat, which he loved. I was in the very back of the plane by myself and soon wished that I had taken some motion sickness medication!

The flight was awesome despite my slight discomfort. Stunning scenery! Landing in the fjord was breathtaking.

Not a very extensive tour. Dreadful loud tinny music through the headphones.
Definitely don’t buy the photographs - what a rip-off.
In fact, save your money. Very poor value.

review_title: Neets Bay bear watch and flight
review_text: The float plane trip was amazing as we stayed very low over the scenery. When we arrived at the Bay we went with a good guide to see the bears. We saw lots of bears feeding near the hatchery. Not sure it is worth the money, but to see black bears feeding in the wild was worth it.

Exciting adventure is what you seek? This is the one to book folks!  While on a cruise to Alaska in September, my husband and I chose the Taquan Air Misty Fjords Floatplane Tour.  Not a second of regret or fear as Chuck Perkins exudes calm confidence, exhibits expertise, and is a magnificent tour narrator.  The Misty Fjords are not to be missed--simply beautiful with so many different appeals--lakes on mountaintops, of course mist floating among the mountains, nanny goats and oh the reflections of the mountains in the lake that we landed on to climb out onto the pontoons for simply amazing views.  The music on the headphones matched perfectly to the essence of the flight.  My husband appreciated the placement of the Top Gun theme upon lake takeoff.  The pre-flight short video, Chuck's review of safety features, and magnificent untouched scenery made for a day we shall cherish--and the rainbow  was a bonus.

First time in a sea plane so worth it.  An amazing flight over the bay of Ketchikan to Neets Bay to see bears and yes we did black bears catching salmon just near the hatchery.  So incredible on the flight back over the mountains breath taking.

review_title: amazing dance with the fjords and Chuck Perkins
review_text: This was the THEE most amazing ever! Flying over the mountains in an 1950's military plane with the amazing Chuck Perkins, a true Alaskan bush pilot who told stories, shared his love of Alaska, and flew through the mountains with Springsteen on the head phones. He pointed out monuments, mountains goats and then landed in a fjord, and we climbed out onto the floats of the plane. It was amazing. My husband and I were lucky enough to each fly co-pilot with this true gentleman and pilot. I highly recommend - a 90 year old was celebrating his birthday, young and old would love this experience.
Booked the Misty Fjords Flightseeing tour through Oceania Cruise Line.  Tour was very nice, pilot was great.  Landed in a lake, wife and I got out on floats.

We booked this exertion through princess cruises! This was amazing and a must do! A big thanks to Kevin who was our pilot and was so enthusiastic and knowledgeable! Went over some absolutely beautiful sites and Misty Fjords and then a stop to George's inlet for a crab feast! Yummy! This is one exertion I will never forget and we really enjoyed! Ps we loved the music Kevin played while flying perfect match! Loved that us wife was from Long Island. A little bias hehe

Captain Chuck Perkins was our pilot and he went out of his way to ensure that everyone experienced all the wonders of the Fiords and mountains around us. He started by first explaining the aircraft and where to find the emergency beacon etc. in case we went down. I found that really reassuring. He personally did the narration - it was pre-recorded - and he pointed out sheep, whales, and other wildlife as he flew. He would then go around to ensure that the guests on the other side of the plane got to see it as well. As others have commented, we landed in a fiord and got to take pictures. I have been on other small planes and helicopters, and he was definitely an experienced pilot. It was a wonderful flight and I would definitely recommend it as a unique way to see all of the landscape.

The Floatplane was Fantastic!  Our pilot Chuck was SO talented.  I have been on many small planes and helicopters and it was very clear to me that Chuck was VERY experienced and a total boss.  
The views were stunning.  
We saw mountain goats. 
Chuck landed the plane on a totally isolated lake and let us get out and experience being outside the float plane. 
I LOVED it.  Only suggestion I would have is to provide some small waters on the plane.
The views from the air were amazing! Our pilot was knowledgeable and informative. Being able to get out of the plane when we landed on the water was incredible.

review_title: The vastness is amazing from the air
review_text: Picked us up on the dock and drove us to the seaplanes. Absolutely seamless take off and landing -- and the views from the air are amazing.  Our pilot landed us in one of the fjords and we walked off onto a pontoon.  So quiet, majestic and awe inspiring. The headset commentary had an unusual assortment of music; I would have preferred something classical, but that's perhaps just my taste. Worth every penny.  So glad we got up into the air to see a tiny portion of this vast wilderness of Alaska!

Our pilot , Clark was a native of Alaska he really knew his native home and took pride in explaining everything . It was kind of a cloudy day but that was ok, cause Clark explained as if you could actually see it. He knew how to fly a plane , has been doing it for years . He was polite and courteous to everyone helping them off the plane. I took this excursion off of princess cruise and I would certainly do it again . All the 5 stars you have read is all true! Or it was with my experience with Clark as our pilot .

review_title: One of the best tours of our cruise
review_text: This tour is much cheaper if you walk into town and book it yourself. We saved $150 over the price on the cruise ship.  We flew out to the Misty Fiords Monument.  Breathtaking scenery and it was exciting to land out there on a lake.   A must do if you are on a cruise!

Perfect from start to finish.   Friendly staff - well flown DH Otter (Mike) - responsible and considerate guides and wildlife in attendance.   How cute is a cub in a tree protected by mama bear?  Half as cute as the two we saw.    At least 5 bears plus blue heron, eagles, sealions etc and saw bears from minimum safe distance including from jetty.    Worth the money.

I know they don't control the weather but it was a huge plus!!  Plane was well maintained and the sight lines were good from every seat. Being able to land and step out onto the planes floats was a unique experience.  Saw some very beautiful country as well as some goats enjoying the sunshine! Thank you for more great memories!

Chuck the pilot was amazing!!!
We had a early flight and had an amazing day with clean sky . We where super Lucky

review_title: Very interesting trip in sea plane
review_text: First time we had been on a sea plane. It was well-organised and we each had a window seat and ear phone as very noisy. We flew to Neet Bay and saw two bears in the distance near the salmon hatchery. We were taken by a guide through the woods and saw bear droppings and a half-eaten salmon. A grey-blue heron was trying to catch fish and the bears had disappeared. However, we eventually saw one close up on the beach near the plane. Good rest rooms there! It really is a trip worth doing and we thoroughly enjoyed it (and I don't like small planes!)

We flew with Clark our pilot to Neets Bay. The take off, flight and landing was perfectly smooth and exceptionally breath taking. Clark pointed out whales as we flew over the fjords and bays. As soon as we landed there were bears roaming on the beach and eagles flying overhead. Joshua our guide was interesting, informative and knowledgable. This excursion/flightseeing is worth every penny and a nice souvenir when back at base. Highly recommended for wildlife viewing, breath taking scenery and a view of the real Alaska!

review_title: 推介給喜歡看動物的你
review_text: 參加了他們的水上飛機行程在Ketchikan 去Neets Bay睇黑熊. 我們的機司沿途作詳細解說，因天氣好又在山脈中飛翔，飛得也很稳定。neets bay 的導遊又很專業，見識廣博，遇到熊時又保護我們，讓我們拍照。十分推介給想坐水上飛機及看黑熊的人。

review_title: Misty Fjord with Eric and Taquan
review_text:
See my review of Misty Fjord, but I wanted to be sure to give 5 stars to Taquan and Eric. Amazing tour. Great group of people. Well organized and very professional. Highly recommend this group four this popular tour. I booked with Viator Tours and was very pleased with every aspect of the adventure. 

If you are going to see Misty Fjord, I highly recommend Taqian and Viator.

review_title: Misty Fjords floatplane tour was fantastic
review_text: Arrived at the dock, overcast, not looking good for flying. Went to the guy with the Misty Fjords nature trail sign. He tells me the flights are cancelled. Really bummed, figured we would try the lumberjack show then. Looking for that guy, found another Misty Fjords sign, he was the right guy, the other was not our tour. They said the pilots were checking the weather to see if it will happen. The guys ok'd it, we're flying! The people at Taquan were first rate and our pilot Chuck was the best! Friendly, excellent skills, has been flying for over 20 years. He told me the other guys were seasonal, that's why they wouldn't go. Great flight, the scenery was amazing. Chuck showed us numerous out of the way waterfalls and beautiful sights. Landed on the fjords, real soft touchdown. Had time on the floating dock to take in all the surroundings. Nice flight back and back on tera firma. Had to take a pic with Chuck. Oh did I mention, played different songs on our headphones that worked with what we were doing. Freefalling by Tom Petty and others..........LOL Highly recommend these guys!

Flew on a sightseeing and crab dinner combo.  The flight was great.  Top notch operation. Safety minded. The crab was delicious even though there was less room in the dining hall than there was in the float plane. The bus drive back from the dinner was also a lot a fun as the bus driver, a young lady from Arkansas, was something of a comedian.

review_title: Amazing bear viewing tour of Tongass National Forest
review_text: We had an amazing bear watching tour of the Tongass National Forest with our guide, Mark.  It was on September 4th, 2017, the weather was beautiful, the pilot was great and narrated our trip.  The departure/arrival area was very clean and everyone was very professional.  Mark greeted us at the dock at Tongass, we took a short drive to the trail where he gave us a safety briefing.  We walked down the trail to the viewing platform where there was already 1 bear fishing and along came several others.  One bear came up on the platform where we were standing, Mark did a great job quietly directing us to the corner, asked everyone to be quiet and he stood in front of us.  It was thrilling, yet I felt safe.  He also told us that the noise we heard was a cub crying for its mother and pretty soon a cub climbed down a tree!  It was wonderful.  I highly recommend this tour, Mark and Taquan Air.   Plan your trip to take this tour!

I was a little apprehensive about flying in a small float plane. I'm so glad that I did, because it was one of the most incredible experiences I've ever had!! My group of six were on Holland America's M.S. Noordam, and were unable to book through the cruise line, because there were no remaining spots. We went to the Visitor's Center and had no problem booking with the same air service that the cruise uses-at a substantially lower fare. Taquan's representative, Tim Cash, couldn't have been friendlier and more helpful! We were shuttled together to the marina , and we were able to travel together in the same floatplane. The pilot, Brentwood, was very experienced and knowledgeable. The fjords and mountains were breathtaking. An experience that all of us will never forget.  It was the highlight of our trip to Alaska.

Flight with "Sir" Captain Eric in May was enjoyable, entertaining and informative. We were well briefed before takeoff and were provided information about the Fjords and our flight status as we flew.   The views were amazing ! Our first Seaplane flight and we would do it again. We landed by a dock in the middle of the Misty Fjords and got to stretch our legs and take in the beautiful landscape all around. We took off again perfectly and relaxed to the music selection offered through our headsets. As we flew back to their Seaport, we passed our Cruise Ship moored in the bay. Great opportunity for Fabulous Pictures and wonderful memories.

Took the Alaska Bear tour into the Tongass National Forest.  Mark was our guide and it was absolutely AMAZING.  I could not recommend it more or recommend a better guide.  We saw about 11 bears, including one that walked up on the viewing platform with us.  Mark was so calm and experienced and told us exactly how to act if we did see a bear close up.  Mark spotted a cub climbing a tree and pointed him out in addition to all the bear in the stream below, and explained that the noise we were hearing from the forest was the cubs crying for Mama while she fished.  What a day...I will never forget it.  Probably the best adventure I've ever had while on a trip.  GO!  GO! GO! if you get a chance.   This tour only runs from July to Sept, so plan accordingly.

Beautiful flight to Misty Fjords!  Our pilot, Sam, was excellent and narrated all the sights expertly.  It was exciting to walk on the pontoons when we landed in the fjords.  All around a fabulous tour!  Highly recommend this company for your tours around Ketchikan.

review_title: We loved our Neets Bear Watch. The flight was fun and informative.
review_text: The flight over was fun and informative with music that drowned out the engine noise. The Bear Guide was knowledgeable and receptive to questions. We got some great pictures of a young Bear sleeping in a tree and then lots of pictures of bears fishing for salmon and eating the fish.

We were scheduled for a morning flight and was told by our Cruise that due to the weather, we can cancel and get a refund or wait for the 12:15pm if the weather got better. Well, we waited and it became sunny. Pilot said this was the clearest day on weeks so he took us to a lake that he hasn't been to in weeks. The view was spectacular and he narration was good. He not that of his 21 years of flying in the area, the mountains continued to have less snow coverage. This was the highlight of my vacation!

Really great flight with views of humpback one way and mountains the other. Ex navy pilot so in good hands. The bear watching was a short 10 min walk through the rain forest with Mark out guide. He was very handy when we met a mother and cubs on the path both times! The bear viewing was excellent on a raised platform overlooking the salmon run and falls. We saw 3-6 bears over an hour and they were catching the salmon below us. Great tour and informative and friendly guide who was handy for close to encounters of the bear kind!
Saw the misty fjords by floatplane. Great views. Water landing allowed for photos on the pontoons. And Chuck's playlist was awesome!

I surprised my girlfriend with this amazing flight to the Misty Fjords with Taquan Air and it was a once in a lifetime experience!  Our pilot Jim was friendly, genuine, made us feel safe and made us laugh and we had an amazing time while earning me boyfriend points!  The scenery and overall experience is absolutely breathtaking! You can't miss this excursion if you visit Ketchikan!

review_title: Black bear watching at Neets Bay. Thanks Taquan
review_text:
We were on the Princess Cruise-liner headed southbound from Whittier to Vancouver. As the ship docked in Ketchikan, we walked over to the visitor center to explore seaplane tour options. Two  tours which we were choosing between were "Bear watching" and "Misty Fjords".  We were told that that it was prime bear season and that the odds of seeing bears were very high. We are glad we listened and chose that tour. I am sure Misty Fjords is pretty as well, but there's always a next time!

We were  taken to Taquan in a van (Thanks Sandy). After the obligatory safety briefings, we were flown to Neets Bay. The aircraft flies reasonably low and offers awesome scenic views. The ride was great and not scary at all. The takeoff and landing were cool!. The pilot (sorry, forgot his name) was pretty good.

The guide who received us at Neets Bay Hatchery was incredible. He gave us tips on how to respond to a bear sighting. It was good we listened as a bear did cross us probably 25 feet from us.

Once we got to the viewing platform we waited anxiously for bears to show up. We saw numerous gulls as they devoured carcasses of salmon, but hey, we were there to see bears. And boy did they show. I think we saw about 5 bears at once, and one of them successfully caught salmon. Our guide also seemed to be a good photographer and gave me some tips. Yet to process my pictures, but I am sure I've got a few good ones.

Note that you only see black bears at Neets Bay. The trip itself is expensive, but in my opinion, totally worth it.

review_title: This was very nice, I got to sit in the back by myself. I was able to look out both sides of the plane.
review_text: great time, saw a lot even a bear. tale off and landing on the water was fun too. Would do it again if I had the $$

We booked an excursion through our cruise on Silverseas to take a float plan to an all you can eat crab feast on George inlet.  Was terrific. We had mike as our pilot.  Lucky for us, the day was sunny.  Views from the plane unbelievable!

review_title: Must do this if you're in Ketchikan!
review_text:
Ketchikan was the first shore stop on an Inside Passage cruise through Alaska and we had pre-booked the Neets Bay Bearwatch float plane with Taquan Air Tours. And we are so glad we did! It was a first class way to spend a morning. Great flight (lucky enough to have excellent conditions) and at the Neets Bay Hatchery there were about a dozen bears all grazing on salmon in their natural habitat. Close enough for us ti get some great photos.
The hatchery is a very short walk from the jetty where the float plane lands. There is also Bald Eagle, leaping salmon and sea lions to see. 
Definitely well worth doing.

The flight was part of a tour which was a crab feast at George Inlet Lodge.  This part of the tour was amazing.  We had done the same one in 2010 and when we knew we were coming to Ketchikan again we booked it again. It was just as amazing as the first time.  We felt it was great value for money and if in Ketchikan again would certainly do it again.  The pilots are very professional and they take you over some breathtaking scenery.

We were in town on a cruise and booked our excursion with Taquan through our cruise line. We went to Neets Bay Fish Hatchery to view bears. We loved the entire experience. It was expensive but definitely worth every penny. Luke was a good pilot and gave us info about the area during our flight out and back. Played great music over headphones when he wasn't talking. Smooth flight. Saw over a dozen bears at Neets Bay grabbing salmon out of stream just feet away from us. It was amazing. I will book them again next time we come to Ketchikan.

Hicimos el tour por Mystic Fjords con esta empresa, impresionante y debe hacerse sí o sí. Reservamos con antelación a través de Viator. Excelente trato durante la reserva para acoplar esta visita a nuestra parada del crucero ofreciendo los mejores horarios para estar a tiempo a bordo. Serios y puntuales en la recogida concertada en el puerto de Ketchikan, en las trámites de check in y en el embarque. El vuelo fue espectacular, se te corta la respiración, y muy seguro.

review_title: Great tour, if you can afford it.
review_text: The flight was not bumpy or scary--much smoother than anticipated.  The earphones with music and audio scenery description blocked out most of the engine noise.  It was a relaxing, pleasureful ride with 6 total passengers.  The Misty Fjords National Monument was magnificent.  The plane landed on the water to get close-up looks and photos.  $200+ cost will be pricey for some, but if you can afford it, go for it!

Jim is an excellent young pilot. He was a great at telling us the history. The national monument was originally proclaimed by President Jimmy Carter in December 1978 as Misty Fiords National Monument,[1] using the authorization of the Antiquities Act and became a part of an ongoing political struggle between the federal government and the State of Alaska over land use policy and authority that finally led to the Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act in 1980.

We took a floatplane to the fjords in Ketchikan and it was amazing.  Our pilot Jim told us all about the things we were seeing and played great music along the way.  Halfway through the flight we landed on the water next to a beautiful waterfall and got out of the plane.  It was so beautiful!  I am not usually a fan of small planes but the ride was smooth  and we were not that high off the ground so I felt very comfortable. I would highly recommend this - it was worth every penny.

We took a family of 4 on the seaplane and neets Bay bear watching tour. Mike was our Pilot and he was great. 1st time we landed you didn’t even know you were on the water. The guide on the short walk was great as well and he makes sure you’re well informed. Overall the entire tour was great and a must do in Ketchikan.

review_title: Flew to Prince of Whales Island
review_text:
Used this as an airline, not as a tour. For scheduled service this was a fun way to get around SE Alaska. Flights and schedules are dependent on the weather so our original destination had to be changed because of low clouds. There's no refund for something like this, but that's ok because part of the risk flying float planes is they rely on visibility to get around. If you don't have the flexibility, best book a wheeled aircraft. 
Our pilot was professional and friendly. The flight was brief and the views incredible! 

There's something very special about lifting off and touching down on water. Helping unload other cargo, like mail and shipping boxes, made it clear these guys provide an essential service to small AK communities.

I had the pleasure of going to Neets Bay to see bears on a floatplane through Taquan Air. It was an amazing experience. We saw at least 7 bears at close range catching salmon and our guide was very knowledgable and friendly. We also saw eagles and various other birds as our guide pointed them out to us. This was a first time for me on a floatplane and Tracy, our pilot, let me sit in the copilots seat on the way back, for me that was the highlight of the trip! I think they do a wonderful job and highly recommend them.

review_title: Float bush plane to see black bears at Neets Bay
review_text: I'd never been on a sea plane before so it was interesting to take off & land on water. The weather was very overcast - not great for flight seeing but excellent for bears we were told. We indeed saw many black bears at close range ambling around and fishing for salmon and it was absolutely magical!

A wonderful tour, our first time in a float plane and it was exhilarating.  Our pilot flew us to Neets Bay to see bears fishing for salmon.  The whole tour was great.  When we came back the weather had become a little windy but this was easily handled by our pilot Clark Hassell - great name and a great pilot. Recommended.

We went on the mail run which was a flight at the end of the day and it was fantastic! The pilot was very experienced and we saw some beautiful scenery visiting some bush towns delivering the mail. I would highly reccomend this group!

review_title: YES, YES YES!  Fly with Taquan
review_text: This was my favorite thing in Alaska.  Tip:  Save yourself some money and don't book on the ship.  Book on your own when you get off the ship.   The staff was friendly and efficient, the pilot was safe and knowledgeable.  The scenery, well, you really cannot describe with words how beautiful it is.  The lakes, rainforest and mountains are breath-taking.   The water take off and landings were smooth as silk.   Want to see untouched Alaska?  Take a float plane trip with Taquan Air.  You can purchase a photo package and shop in their gift shop.  The "beaver" and "otter" planes are well maintained and safe.  All 10 of us in the "otter" had window seats and my boyfriend got to sit in the co-pilots seat!   So fun.  A great photo opportunity of the natural side of Alaska.  This is a MUST_DO activity in Ketchikan.

My biggest issue with this tour is the staff (not the pilot).  Very disorganized.  Before we boarded the plane they took a group picture in front on of the plane (which I assumed they would want to sell us later). When we got back they were very quickly hustling us back out onto the bus.  I asked a couple employees about the group picture and they both looked at me like I was speaking a foreign language.  Having said all of that the views were beautiful but the pilot didn't tell us what we were seeing. There was a recording playing but it was difficult to hear.  It was fun when we landed and were able to step out onto the floats.

review_title: scenic flight Misty Fjords Ketchikan Alaska
review_text: The most scenic flight we ever did. Met een DeHavilland Beaver floatplane meevliegen door de fantastische Misty Fjords met zeer interessante uitleg door de piloot en af en toe een mooi begeleidend muziekfragment door je koptelefoon, samengevat: FABULOUS !

review_title: Excellent trip out to Neets Bay.
review_text: First trip in a float plane, very much hope to do it again. Well organised set-up, health and safety talk about the flight and about bears in the wild. Loved the flight and commentary, such impressive little planes (Otters), great views of Ketchikan, rivers, forests, mountains then a gentle landing in Neets Bay. Great time watching bears than back again - wish the flight shad been longer. Great fun.

We had such an amazing trip with Taquan Air in Ketchikan. The flight there was spectacular. Our pilot was knowledgeable and answered all our questions. The views were breathtaking. The forest is beautiful hike to see get to the main attraction. We were lucky enough to see 6 bears, including 1 mom and 2 cubs. I would highly recommend this tour! Its the best of both worlds - breathtaking views from the float plane and the opportunity to see all the stunning natural beauty of Alaska, including bears!!

Awesome experience,the views from the float plane were breathtaking and Trevor  our pilot's narration made the adventure all that much better. His passion for flying and knowledge of the Misty Fjords took our tour to the next level. We landed on a lake surrounded by cliffs and when we got out of the plane and stood on the floats it was totally quiet,just us and mother nature!

review_title: Neets Bay Bear Watch & Flightseeing - Incredible experience!
review_text:
The Neets Bay Bear Watch & Flightseeing tour was one of the highlights of our cruise on the Star Princess. The entire experience was well-organized and well-executed.

My wife and I started the tour by meeting a representative from Alaska Shore Tours (Taqan Air Tours) on the pier just a few steps from our cruise ship. She was holding a sign with the excursion code clearly visible so we knew without a doubt that we were in the right place.

We were directed to a waiting bus, which was a very short walk from where we met the first representative. Once everyone attending the tour was loaded, we were driven to the marina where the planes were docked.

They presented a safety video and then directed us down a ramp onto the dock where the plane was waiting. Our pilot helped us onto the plane, checked to make sure everyone was properly buckled in and showed us how to use the headsets. He started the plane, taxied into open water, and then we took off.

This was our first time flying in a float plane. Takeoff and landing were quite smooth compared to typical wheeled planes. Seeing such a beautiful area from a relatively low altitude (compared to commercial jets) was amazing! The area around Ketchikan is so beautiful.

After a 20 minute flight, we arrived at Neets Bay. Our guide met us on the dock and gave us a short safety talk about how to behave around bears - what to do and what not to do. Then he led us up a ramp to a woodsy area. We were immediately able to see a marshy area with at least 2 dozen eagles. 

The guide took us down a short trail and pointed out many signs of bear activity - scat (feces), claw markings on trees, and several plants that the bears had eaten. At the end of the trail (about 1/4 mile) was an open area with the fish hatchery.

Just as our group arrived at the fish hatchery, we heard muted "oos" and "ahhs" from another two groups that had arrived before us - bears! There were 2 bears within 50 yards, one was climbing into a spillway next to a waterfall and the other was a bit further downstream. We quickly grabbed our cameras and started making photos and videos. Just a few minutes later, we saw another adult bear and two cubs a bit further down. The bears picked several salmon out of the spillway and stream. (I'm sure people who see this every day may laugh at my amazement, but for someone who has never seen a bear outside of a zoo this was quite breathtaking!)

After quite a while of watching the bears and some nearby eagles, we (sadly) made our way back down the trail to the dock for our flight back the marina and bus ride back to the pier.

I'm sure you can tell from my description - we REALLY enjoyed our experience and would gladly do it again! Highly recommended!!

Experience of a lifetime!  It was a beautiful day, and an absolute delight to see a glacier from the sky. The views were spectacular, and landing on the lake was exceptional. We had so much fun going out on the pontoons, taking pictures and enjoying the majesty of the peaceful lake.
What made the trip an extra bonus was our pilot, Chuck! His narration of the sights was very helpful. He added some of his favorite music in between, with pertinent words to the experience. His love of his job & of flying, his awe of the scenery and respect for creation were all infectious.  I love to be with someone who enjoys his life so much. Thank you, Chuck!!

We live in a beautiful state, Colorado, but until you've seen Alaska by air, the scale is hard to imagine. It is amazing!  John, our pilot, and the entire staff at Taiwan Air were awesome.  Well worth doing!

review_title: Due to the weather, never did Tracy Arm Fjord but we were not given advance notice to cancel
review_text:
We booked two Magnificent Misty Fjords by Floatplane excursions but we didn’t even see the “Magnificent Misty Fjords.”  We were not advised that we will not be able to see the Misty Fjords before we left the dock for excursion.  We were told right before we left in the plane that due to fog that we will not be able to see up close, but so disappointed of not even be able to see how “magnificent” the Misty Fjords were as promised in the brochure.

We should have been advised so that we would have been given the opportunity to cancel and replace with another excursion.  

The pilot narration could not be clearly heard because of constant static in the headphone.

review_title: Misty Fjords seaplane and boat excursion
review_text: My wife and I took the Misty Fjord seaplane and boat excursion which we booked through Princess. We both thoroughly enjoyed it. If you have a tendency towards motion sickness, I suggest taking Dramamine before the flight (which I did). It's a small plane and is constantly going up and down, and turning every which way. It was one of the most amazing experiences we had on our trip but I wouldn't have enjoyed it nearly as much if I hadn't come prepared. The flight lasted 25 minutes and the boat portion was 2 1/2 hours. The boat ride was a bit long but the scenery was absolutely breathtaking, especially the first portion of the ride. We saw sea lions on an island and several porpoises playing at the side of our boat. Although it was a beautiful, sunny day, it does get chilly when you're on the upper deck which is not covered. So be sure to bring a jacket.

In a place where weather can change in an instant and weather reports aren't always accurate you want a pilot that is a confirmed Coward.   I grew up In Southeast Alaska and learned at an early age that if the pilot doesn't want to go I do t want to go either.  These are consummate professionals who exercise superior judgement in taking people to see some of the most remote and rugged scenery in the world.

A fantastic day all round.  Very well organised from pick up to drop off and a very professional organisation. Bears in abundance, including cubs feasting on salmon in their natural environment. Incredible. Bald eagles, humpback whales and orcas. An excellent adventure which did not disappoint.

review_title: Our family of five took the Misty Fjords seaplane tour...
review_text: Charles was our pilot and was a very friendly excellent pilot and extremely knowledgable about the area. Great selection of music played during our flight with the perfect amount of commentary. The float plane excursion was truly the highlight of our vacation. I strongly suggest everyone take this tour. Will not disappoint!!!!

review_title: Neets Bay is NEAT---Best bear watching ever!
review_text: We were impressed with the concern for safety as well as scenery.  Just a wonderful ride to and from on the sea plane.  Everyone at Taquan Air so friendly.  Loved seeing the bears  interact with the salmon and other bears.  Very memorable trip!!

Julie was our pilot for a wonderful flight to Neets Bay.  It had been raining earlier so we were the first tour of the day to go out.  Flight was great and landings smooth as glass.  Once we reached Neets Bay Amanda was our guide.  A short walk thru the woods and she pointed out bear dens (they were empty at the time thank goodness).  We got to the waters edge and within no time at all the bears appeared.  There were a couple of younger bears and a little further away a mother and her two cubs.  There were lots of eagles as well.  Amanda is a full time resident of Neets Bay and was very informative.  We had plenty of time to take in bears and eagles.  Terrific experience

review_title: Neets Bay Bear Watch by Floatplane
review_text: Great trip over in a Cessna Caravan float plane to see a couple of black bears. We also saw some immature and mature bald eagles in the trees and there were a dozen eagles circling in the sky. This was our first time in a float plane and the flight was awesome. Would highly recommend this excursion.

review_title: No less or more than advertised
review_text: Typically they do fly/cruise tour, we took the cruise/cruise. If you do take fly/cruise, cruise in and fly out, A lot more time spent viewing things on the way in, as they aren't rushing to get back, having to meet the sea planes at a specific time. Little as far as wildlife viewing, so pretty boring after a while, how many hours of trees on mountainside do you want to see?

This trip was taken during a Princess cruise to Alaska. 
Excellent trip, well organised. Flight was great. Saw some bears and bald eagles. Superb guide.
Great photos taken by Taquan Air downloaded from email link.
Came here part of a cruise package the 6 seater was an experience we went for a 20 minute journey to a crabshack, the pilot was great with great views.

Cool to ride in a float plane. Not something you get to do often. Our pilot, Tracy, did a great job! We had very beautiful weather, and we got to see the gorgeous views. Would recommend to anyone while in Ketchikan.

Even though we only flew a short flight (30min,) we enjoyed every minute. We were met at Taquan Air by friendly help and watched a safety film. Our pilot was very professional and helpful in both loading and unloading of passengers. Our flight to George Inlet Lodge was great. Fasten you seat belts and enjoy your flight.

Booked a flight excursion from a cruise line and ended up with this company.  Was impressed with their clean, modern flight facility and safety procedures. Excellent flight into Tongas National Forest.  Hats off to our pilot Chuck.  Gave us quite a show ..... and played some excellent tunes along the way!!  Would highly recommend the company and Chuck!

review_title: Amazing Float Plane Trip.  Very accomodating for handicapped person
review_text:
The float plane ride over the Misty Fjords was incredible.  One amazing view after another.  Our pilot/guide, Mike Hudgins, was very informative and executed a flawless water landing on a large lake, where several of us got out and walked on the plane floats.  A must do for anyone visiting Ketchikan.

I am handicapped. I walk with two crutches. Mike and his crew were very helpful and accommodating dealing with my handicap and enabling me to board and exit the plane, allowing me to enjoy this incredible experience.

Came to Ketchikan as stop on Royal  Caribbean cruise and booked float plane excursion to Misty Fjords.  Felt very safe with our excellent pilot (John).  My added bonus was getting to sit in the front seat.  Gorgeous views from the air, and loved the  take-offs and landings on water!!  Totally awesome excursion!!

A highlight of our visit to Ketchikan was a float plane flight to the misty fjords with Taquan Air Tours.  We had a very experienced pilot who gave us a wonderful air tour of the fjords near Ketchikan.  A highlight of the flight was when the pilot landed our float plane in the fjord a few hundred yards from a grizzly bear lazily relaxing on the shore.  We were able to watch the bear for about 10 minutes and observe it in its native habitat.  Binoculars or a telephoto lens are recommended for this trip.  Our entire flight was over beautiful country and we were able to get a good, close up view of the fjords.

I wish I remembered the name of our pilot. A young lady with a passion for flying float planes. Our trip was awesome. There were eleven of us in our group, we were split between two planes. Fantastic scenery. An excellent landing/stop on a mountain lake. It was the highlight of our 12 day Alaskan adventure. Ketchikan Misty Fjords Flightseeing via Floatplane

This particular excursion (Mystic Fjords) had been previously booked through Trailfinders and formed part of a weeks holiday aboard the Celebrity Cruise ship Infinity.  From our arrival at the Taquam Air Tours sight we were warmly greeted and made to feel at home.  Once an initial safety briefing had been completed we were introduced to our pilot Ken originally from Kentucky.  Once aboard the seaplane and in the air Ken treated his 6 passengers to an informed commentary as we fly over the mountains and fjords which also involved a landing on one stretch of water.  Ken's choice of music was worthy of note when he wasn't verbally explaining what we were seeing.  The flight lasted just over 75 minutes and compared to 10 - 15 minute helicopter flights was great value for money.  Highly recommended if you're in this part of the world!!

Jim was our pilot.  This flight is everything you read about.. but it is the way that Jim did it that made you feel like you were experiencing what Alaskans see and do every day.  He was relaxed and told of his experiences flying mail and even delivering pizza in Alaska by plane. We landed on the remote lake and on our return he asked what time we had to be back.  He added in a fantastic view of mountain goats high up on the mountains.  He tipped the plane (which did not freak me out even though I don't fancy flying) so I was looking right on them.   It was truly spectacular.  Thank you, Jim.

Excellent tour. Tremendous scenery. Chuck was a great pilot. Return boat ride to Ketchikan was excellent as well (although a little on the long side). The boat was very clean and comfortable. Dropped us off at the cruise ship pier rather than at the Taquan office which was very handy.

Found this trip off our cruise ship. It was an hour of eating all you can eat Dungeness crab and drinks. After "breakfast" we went on the seaplane which was a gorgeous ride. Landed and took a shuttle back to the ship. Highly recommend, they were great!

The minute our boys landed at the airport for our 1 week visit in Alaska, they saw the float planes landing and wanted to go on them.  Once in a lifetime opportunity, so we gave in and sent them on their way a couple of days later with Taquan Air.  excellent service and smooth from the girl answering the phone , checking in, to flying!!!

We went on the Magnificent Misty Fjords sea plane excursion while we were docked in Ketchikan.   It was spectacular to see the area.   You would never see this prestine area if you were not in a plane or a helicopter.   Our pilot, Trevor Smith, was awesome.   He gave us the history of the area and points of interest.  We would recommend this excursion!  Ask for Trevor to be your pilot.

My husband and I agree that this was the best experience of all the different activities we did at different ports on our Alaskan cruise. We highly recommend booking with Taquan Air. We had purchased the Alaska Tour Saver Inside Passage coupon book (we bought the app) and were able to use a buy one get one free coupon. Amazing deal!!
We took a seaplane flight to the Misty Fjords with Jim - it was a super smooth ride and we loved landing in the Fjords.

This was my wife and I's first cruise and float plane tour.  I have to tell you that the Misty Ford tour is spectacular!  This area is so remote that you need to take a boat, submarine, or float plane.  I recommend the float plane.  You fly by 3,000 foot cliffs and water falls and then you land on the ford and climb out onto the pontoon and take in what Alaska has to over.  What a blast and well worth the money.  Thank you pilot Jim the millennial.

Thank you Jim for the experience
Dave and Teresa
Beautiful, informative, breathtaking trip to Fjords in Ketchikan. Views only available by air. Having a native tour guide can't be beat. Highly recommend all staff with this company.

Chuck was our pilot and guide, he was WONDERFUL! I felt so assured with him in charge, very personable, professional, played great music, and balanced the information he shared along with just letting us enjoy the beautiful flight perfectly. I can't say enough about what a superb experience this was. Highly recommend asking for Chuck as your pilot/guide. Thanks Chuck and Taquan Air Tours!

review_title: Excellent service and just plain fun
review_text: Taquan's service is fabulous - great for sightseeing tours or simply to get from point a to point b.

The pilots are great and the views from your Beaver aircraft are beautiful!  The commentary is just enough to let you witness nature and the pilots are highly successful navigating the difficult weather of the Ketchikan area.  You can't go wrong and if you worry about air sickness, forget about it.  The view will cure anyone of it!
Came to Alaska on a cruise.  Did the seaplane tour for our excursion. Our wonderful tour guy Ken did a great job.

Had a great flight with Chuck Perkins as the pilot.  Definitely something to check off your bucket list.  I was lucky enough to sit in the co-pilot seat and had a fantastic view!  From staff on the ground to the flight itself everything went very smoothly.

I've always wanted to fly on a float plane so I was ready for this!  This tour company was efficient, friendly, and put safety first.  Then, we met our captain (Mike), who was an awesome pilot and tour guide for our flight through the misty fjords.  Stunning views you can't see any other way but flying low through them.  We did a water landing in the fjords and got to get out and walk along the floats of the plane.  The take-offs and landings were flawless as was the rest of this excursion. HIGHLY recommend!!

The smallest plane we had previously flown in was a Twin Otter, which landed on the beach at Barra in Scotland, so we were a little nervous about a smaller one that  also landed on water.

The weather was rather dull (Misty Fjords not possible) and Trevor said that he was choosing a route that he thought would provide the best sightseeing in the circumstances.

His commentaries regarding the route, the plane and other matters were interesting and not over the top.

He also said that he would be landing on a lake at the halfway point, where passengers could get out onto the floats to take photos.  C'mon Trevor.

But he wasn't kidding.

The flight was a smooth and memorable experience.

We had the pleasure of having Chuck as our pilot for our trip on our float plane, and it was fantastic!  He is a great pilot, with the smoothest take-offs and landings, especially considering you're landing on water!  We were blessed with clear skies so had a really magical trip.  He pointed out sites and even flew around so both sides of the plane could get a good look at some of the waterfalls.  Just an exquisite part of Southern Alaska - what a gift to see it!

This was my third time in Ketchikan, and the first 2 times the weather wasn't great for a float plane. This time it was sunny and beautiful.  Our pilot John Roberts was awesome.  If you are in Ketchikan take this tour. Absolutely stunning.
Love it.
Thanks John R.

review_title: Taquan Air does a great job
review_text: Pilot Chuck Perkins was great, professional and very skilled, and our flight was great fun, a wonderful experience, and one we would recommend again and again. Thanks Chuck and Taquan Air!

This is an absolute must-do in Ketchikan!  We absolutely loved our tour by Chuck!  This tour spent an hour in the air with some really great narration by our pilot.  He helped us understand what we were looking at both geographically as well as historically.  The flight was very smooth and enjoyable with every participant enjoying  a window view.  If you are in Ketchikan for the day on a cruise, it is great since you can do the early tour and still go on other excursions or just enjoy the day shopping.  We would highly recommend this tour and, if possible, get Chuck for a great narration and smooth flight!

review_title: Excellent Floatplane Tour in Ketchikan Misty Fjord
review_text:
I wanted to see it all in Ketchikan on my short stop on port while on a cruise. I researched an found that Tacquan Air had a 2 for 1 coupon available in Alaska Saver Tour Book I ordered online.
Too good to be true. I called an inquired before purchasing book and was told yes. They would honor coupon to call them after I received book at home and give them Your book number and not tear coupon and bring book on date of tour. I was also able to make a reservation which they held with time  and date after I received book and called back to give book number.
This was an experience beyond words. Our pilot was Mike a well mannered friendly man with a well kept beautiful plane. We had a sunny day in the early afternoon as luck would have in Ketchikan it rains mostly. He great commentary as we flew around the Misty Fjords.
He took of and my husband and I were the last to board the plane so my hubby got to sit next to the pilot. 
Highlight of his trip to Alaska.
I have never seen such beautiful mountains and lakes with snow covered peaks  so close.
Our pilot landed on a lake he chose and as he was landing a bear was crossing the mountain. Something he was amazed about having rarely seen. We got to stay at the lake after landing for quite a while trying to spot bear again and took many pictures.
But words cannot describe what you see. This gorgeous pristine land of Misty Fjords in Ketchikan.
They picked us up at the port on time and everything ran smoothly.
I would recommend this company without a doubt. Great pilot and tour. Thank you Mike for memorable trip. I hope you get to read this.

This was outstanding!  The beauty of Misty Fjords is amazing. It was truly a thrill to see this pristine area. A special shout out to our pilot Chuck.  He provided excellent commentary and, when he spotted mountain goats on a hillside, flew by, then made a U turn so that people on both sides of the plane could see them.

Indescribable beauty and experience, landed in a remote lake with waterfalls got out on the plane floats for pictures, it was awesome our pilot Chuck was a True Pro and a class act he had a great music play list and narration during our ad venture truly breathtaking scenery!

review_title: Must See Alaska via a Float Plane!
review_text: Very professional, expert pilot and the team was on point!  We really enjoyed our trip to George Inlet and our Crab Feed.  Treat yourself and take a longer tour, this is well worth the money and the way to see Alaska!

review_title: Stunning flight over the Misty Fjords, Ketchican. Alaska
review_text:
I booked this tour with Alaskan Shores. The float plane was operated by brilliantly by Taquan Air Tours.
The flight was breathtaking. The pilot gave a good commentary, with informative local knowledge. I had worried if it was crazy to book a tour for my husband and I in a place called Misty Mountains in case it would be too misty to see. Luckily it was a fabulous day.
How many times can we all say awesome? I wish the flight could have lasted hours I would not have been bored.
We landed on a fjord and joined a boat to return. We saw Orcas and Humback Whales.
So we had the best of both worlds, land seaand air.
We got on the mail plane and fly over Annette island first. Then returned to Taquan Air and flew out to Steamboat Bay. What a place southeast alaska is.

Our family (6 of us) took the sea plane tour out to the crab feast. Trevor was our pilot and he was awesome! He loved sharing facts about the area and pointing out interesting things! It was also fun to listen to him talk about growing up in Alaska. The fjords are absolutely beautiful and I can't imagine a better way to see them. Taking off and landing in the sea plane was so fun and learning about the history of the plane was great too. I'd recommend this tour to anyone!!

Ray was our pilot and the trip couldn't have been smoother.  He was extremely knowledgeable and a very capable pilot.  Throughly enjoyed the scenery and the flight.  The round-trip service to and from the cruise ship was exceptional, although I have forgotten the young woman's name who drove us.
Trevor Smith was our pilot.  He was excellent and very informative.  My husband had a fantastic, fun time.

Taguan picked my group of 4 right at the cruise ship berth and took us to their launching off point. Saw a safety film and was loaded into a small place. The take off was so smooth and gentle I never felt scared. The beauty of the Misty Fjords in the Tongas National Forest was awesome to see from sky: seeing waterfalls, lakes, carved granite cliffs and then we landed on the water and we all got out of the plane and stood on the floats. What an opportunity to   experience the silence, serenity and monumental beauty that surrounded us. So glad we did this excursion.

Trevor loves his plane and his job showing folks from the lower 48  what wilderness looks like.  When you land in the lake surrounded by fjords, it takes your breath away.  We were especially lucky to watch a brown bear swimming casually across the lake on our return trip.  I think Trevor was as excited as we were to catch such an unusual sight.

This was an amazing experience.  The day we were in Ketchikan was a beautiful clear day with the temperature in the low 70s.  Our pilot was Mike and he did a great job giving information and showing us some great scenery.  As we started to land on Lake Manzoni, there was a bear walking across the snow and Mike pointed it out to us.

My husband and I both enjoyed this trip, it was worth the money.

review_title: Very Professional and Knowledgeable and a Great Experience
review_text:
From the safety briefing, to the boarding of the plane, to the flight, and the water landing, all was excellent.

Our pilot was friendly, did not talk too much to allow us to experience the environment, and allowed us to stand on the pontoons in the middle of the lake.

This was a great experience.

I had the chance of a lifetime to go on this amazing adventure with my brother on 6/30/17. My brother had been trying to talk me into going on a float plane trip through the Misty Fjords but I wasn't convinced I'd be able to go or enjoy it. One reason, because I'm scared of heights and have an over active imagination of things that could go wrong and second, I tend to get motion sickness. However I agreed to go even though I was scared out of my mind. Let me just say how amazing this trip was and I'm forever grateful that my brother talked me into this! Our pilot Sam was awesome, very knowledgeable on the area and you could tell he was all about giving his passengers an experience they would remember forever. The weather was great and the sights were breathtaking. I would definitely recommend this tour and guide! Thank you Sam for the tour!
Tracey was an excellent pilot. Absolutely loved every second of our 2 hour tour of the Misty Fjords!

review_title: Float plane tour to Mist Fjords
review_text: The float plane takes you over some spectacular cliffs and gorgeous views. Our guide Jim knew everything there was to know and set us up with a great music playlist to enhance the viewing experience. The float planes are crucial to Alaskans and it was awesome to experience first hand!

We flew the Misty Fjords flight in June.  The scenery was spectacular!  What made the flight truly special was the pilot - Chuck.  He had a great balance of sharing information and also allowing for time just to take it in.  He also is very into sharing the music he enjoys with the flight and asks for suggestions - which I thought was fun!  I recommend he adds Blackbird by the Beatles to his playlist :)

We took the air tour of Misty Fjords since I was told this was the only way to see it.  It was a nice flight and we landed on the water and took off again.  I'm not sure that I would do it again.  It was expensive and we did other things on our trip to Alaska that we loved.  Our pilot didn't really say much, pointed out some locations but I would have liked to have heard some actual history, facts.  There was a boat tour that looked nice but I'm not sure if we had the time to go out on a boat.

Our pilot, Chuck Perkins, did an awesome job giving us an up close aerial view of the Fjords.  We took this from our Alaska cruise which was one of the options.  Highly recommended!!  We had a blast!!!

Reviewing our recent holiday in Alaska, I can honestly say one of the highlights for me was our seaplane flight. It is a must. Our trip with our pilot TREVOR SMITH was great. He gave lots of interesting information and made us feel at ease. Plus we were lucky enough that the weather was perfect. This meant some fantastic views. Landings were smoother then we thought they would be. Our trip has left us wanting to repeat the experience. Thank you.

We arrived in Ketchikan from our cruise sip on a rainy day with low hanging mists. We were told the flight might be cancelled but then they decided we could fly out. There are 3 routes over the Misty Fjords and the one our pilot took was more 'around' the main Fjord area and flew mostly over open water. So neither of us felt we saw what we were led to believe we would see and actually got a bit bored. There was no narration during the tour just regular music in our headphones. For what we paid, I feel we were ripped. IF they can't go over the fjords to let us really see the scenery then just don't go. I wish we had our $500 back.

We had a wonderful experience flying with Chuck when we were in Ketchikan. He calmed our nerves and we could tell he was very experienced. His plane was absolutely perfect. He gave us a lot of information about the area and was great with the kids. My son sat in the cockpit and got great footage on his go pro. His girlfriend was scared and Chuck was very attentive to her needs. She got passed it and had a great flight!! We highly recommend Chuck to fly anyone!!

We took this as our option for the shore excursion in Ketchikan while we were on a cruise. 

This is the pick of the shore excursions in Ketchikan as far as I am concerned. 

Even though the day was drizzly and overcast, the flight was brilliant. Don't let the weather deter you. It's called Misty Fjords for a reason. It adds to the romance of the place.

Well worth it! 

We really enjoyed our experience.

review_title: Great float plane trip to go fishing
review_text: Got to fly in a float plane to and from Waterfall Resort. The staff at Taquan was both friendly and helpful. I enjoyed getting to visit with them and they took excellent care of me.

review_title: Super Ausflug in den Misty Fjords National Park
review_text: Trevor Smith war unser Pilot, jung, sympathisch und kompetent. Mit dem Wasserflugzeug hatten wir die Möglichkeit viel von den Tälern und Fjorden zu sehen. Die Starts und Landungen von Trevor waren so sanft und sicher, dass man sich nur wundern konnte. Ein tolles Erlebnis im Wasser aus dem Flugzeug zu steigen und die Höhe der bewaldeten Berge zu betrachten. Jeder Gast hatte einen Sitz am Fenster. Ein super tolles Erlebnis, auf jeden Fall empfehlenswert. Preis / Leistung stimmte auch, wir waren 1 Stunde und 10 Minuten unterwegs.

The best experience as a new traveler is to take the advice of an experience traveler. We had such an occasion to hear and see the Misty Fjords through the eyes of an experienced Alaskan pilot, Chuck Perkins. His love for the land, nature, and how we as humans interact with this international treasure was fully displayed as we flew over mountainous,  and richly verdant landscape. We  landed in what seemed to be an uncharted lake for searingly clear views, at water level, of spectacular waterfalls and rock formations. Thank you, Chuck!

We took the excursion to the Misty Fjords.  It was wonderful!  I can highly recommend the trip.  At the cruise ship dock, there is a building where all of the local tour companies have a representative.  We booked our flight there, Taquan Air  had a shuttle van take us to their dock, we waited a little while in their building, and then, we were off.  It was easy!
      The flight was fun.  What really impressed me was how smooth the landing in the fjord was.  The scenery was spectacular.  I cannot imagine a better way of seeing the fjords.

This was a fantastic way to see Misty Fjords National Monument.  It started out with a brief safety orientation then we were led to the float plane by our pilot, Dave Watson.  After getting everyone on board Dave started the engine, navigated away from the pier, then smoothly lifted the plane out of the water getting us airborne.  During the flight from Ketchikan to Misty Fjords we listened to music and narrated information over the supplied headset while admiring the clear blue lakes and forests below, and the snow-capped mountains around us.  Dave pointed out several especially interesting landmarks during the journey.  Upon arriving at Misty Fjords, he effortlessly brought the plane down for a perfect water landing.  We were then allowed to exit the plane, stand on the plane's floats, and take photos while Dave answered any questions we had.  The return flight to Ketchikan was just as beautiful and exhilarating.  The landing approach was awesome since we followed the shore all the way through town giving everyone on board a great view of Ketchikan.  Well worth the two hours that the trip took.

This was a great flight to Misty Fjords National Monument with Trevor Smith, our knowledgable and professional pilot. He obviously loves flying and especially his DeHavilland Beaver. Our original date was cancelled due to poor weather, and we appreciate this organization's concern for safety--the make-up date was beautiful and our flight was inspiring and educational. A great trip for any age--gives you a real appreciation for the vastness and unspoiled nature of this part of the world.

review_title: Fun flight even for someone afraid to fly.
review_text: This was a great experience.  I was very afraid but our pilot was great, we had a 20 min flight. Landing at George inlet lodge for dungeness crab.  The views were amazing. The take off and landing was very smooth. They play music for you to listen and the pilot also narrates interesting facts and points out different landmarks and buildings. The music is appreciated because the plane can be somewhat loud.

I can't tell you the feeling I had flying with Chuck on the floatplane from Misty Fjords back to Ketchikan.  The scenery, the information, the amazing music.  Thank you for the most memorable 30 minutes of beauty I can ever remember!
een geweldige vlucht met een watervliegtuig om nooit te vergeten. Als je in de gelegenheid bent en je kan dit doen (tijd en geld) DOEN! Ik hoop dat de foto's de rest vertellen.

This was the last excursion we booked for our cruise and the weather was a bit testy that day. Lucky for us, Chuck Perkins was our very experienced pilot who made the fjord journey so memorable for everyone aboard. He explained the history of settlement and development of the Ketchikan area, the geographic points of interest, the history of the plane and how it operates, and all relevant landmarks out to the beautiful fjords and back. The headset music calmed all nerves between his thoughtful narratives. The beautiful waterfall setting he took us to out to visit reminded us of why we wanted to come and why we must come back. A stunning experience overall.

What a fantastic way to wrap up our Disney Alaskan Cruise!! Chuck was our pilot & he was wonderful, friendly, helpful, calming & extremely knowledgeable about the area we flew over! Seeing the Mystic Fjords from the air was incredible!! Air time was 75 min & worth every penny! We even got to walk out onto the floats of the plane & stood, admiring the serene waterfall & forests around us!
Just completed a Seaplane tour of Misty Fiords with Trevor Smith.  Beautiful scenery and very good pilot who offered lots of interesting facts about the region.  Highly recommended!

We booked a Misty fjord seaplane excursion through Princess. It was raining and I was a bit apprehensive about going up. But, the flight was phenomenal. Our Pilot Chuck Perkins was a fantastic pilot and host and we were thrilled with our experience. Great pilot/guide, great music and breathtaking scenery! I HIGHLY recommend it.

We recently traveled to Ketchikan by Cruise ship and booked an excursion which included all you can eat crab legs and the George inlet Lodge and then had the chance to fly back to town, over the mountains in one of these planes!  The scenery was beautiful!! We also had the Alaskan experience of a water landing which was really cool as well!  I would highly recommend this to anyone who has ever wanted to fly in a sea plane cause it truly is worth your time and money!

review_title: First Time - Fun and felt safe
review_text: We lined up a flight to the George Inlet Lodge for a crab-feast through our cruise line.  This was a short, fun trip - our first on a float plane and our pilot made us feel totally comfortable and safe.  Beautiful views and nice easy landings.  Loved it.

Taquan is situated across the channel from the Ketchikan Airport, a 5 minute ride on the ferry. With wheeled luggage an easy hop from the terminal. No taxi required. I showed up and had a couple hours to wait for my float plane to Pt. Baker, and needed to purchase a box of groceries to ship out with me. The guys nearby the desk overheard me asking which store packed in boxes to ship, and they volunteered to drive me to the store, maybe a mile or so down the road. They made it sound that they were going that way already. To my surprise, they not only were not, but waited for me in the parking lot and returned me to Taquan. Partially cloudy day, beautiful flight delivering me right to the float in "Baker". Two weeks later... pick up on time, again unusually clear weather and back in Ketchikan. I asked for a cab, the gal asked my destination and called the Inn at Creek Street for a shuttle. Taquan held my 50 pounds of King salmon and bear in their freezer overnight. When I returned they grabbed my luggage, the box of fish and took me in their skiff to the float plane dock across the channel to check in for my return flight. The lad even offered to schlep my box up the long steep incline! Not ready to admit 65 too old to heft a 50 pound box to my shoulder and pull a suitcase and rod up the ramp... I declined... I am astonished at how seamlessly and with such a generous spirit ALL the employees anticipated every move to make my transport a breeze. No worries, sit back and watch the amazing scenery that is SE!

We booked our tour through our Regent Mariner cruise.  We took the short bus ride to the seaplane dock where we met our pilot John. There were four adults and one small child on our plane.  I sat in the rear seat which gave great views out both sides of the plane.
