My wife took the co-pilot's seat which made picture taking a bit more difficult due to the high control panel, but we traded seats after our stop at a dock during the flight. The scenery was amazing and our pilot provided much good information about what we were viewing.  We were fortunate to have a beautifully clear day and thoroughly enjoyed this excursion.

We were picked up at the pier, exactly on their me. Driver was very professional and gave us information about Ketchikan on the way. Once arriving at Taquan Air Tours, we were greeted and watched a short video. Our pilot, was fun, informative and professional. This tour was so beautiful and was definitely the highlight of our trip! This is the one tour I would do again!!

We took the two hour door-to-door Misty fjords flight seeing tour. 

Our pilot, Trevor Smith, was a young man with excellent flying ability and gave a superb commentary during the flight.  Trevor had superb local knowledge and made everyone feel at ease. 

This tour saw us in the air for more than one hour with absolutely breathtaking views around the Ketchikan area. 

 A big thank you to Trevor and team for making this an absolutely memorable occasion and one of the highlights of our trip to Alaska.

review_title: Misty fjord seaplane excursion with Trevor Smith as pilot. Excellent tour from the time they picked us up at the pier.
review_text: Trevor was a great pilot and a great host.He was friendly and humorous as well as knowledgable  in regards to the terrain.

review_title: Amazing tour of the Fjords and great pilot! Loved it!
review_text: My husband and I wanted to do a flight over the Alaskan Fjords and this trip was amazing.  We had the BEST pilot, Trevor , he even landed in punchbowl cove and we got out on the floats and saw lots of humpback whales and bald eagles. Don't miss this great tour with Taquan Air- they are very professional and do a great job!

This was a fantastic excursion! Chuck was a knowledgeable guide, and a very smooth pilot (I am a licensed pilot and expected some turbulence around the mountains, but I could have balanced a wine glass on my leg while taking pictures out of the window and not spilled a drop!). We descended down into a fiord and landed on waters that were smooth as glass. Oh, Chuck has a great music playlist going over the headset, so that drop into the fiord was to the song "Born to be Wild." HA great stuff! To get out on the floats and take pictures of a nearby waterfall was very cool! Beautiful scenery I can't begin to describe - waterfalls, snow-capped mountain peaks, trees galore - majestic and breathtaking! If you do nothing else while in Alaska, you have to go flying with Chuck and Taquan Air.

Amazing tour! Quite the Alaskan experience. Spend the money and do it. You've come as far as Alaska and it would be a shame to miss out. Sam, our tour guide, was friendly, funny and quite knowledgeable. Best bush pilot ever. The plane ride allows you to see so much more of the landscape than you will see by boat or land.

This was a surprise birthday present for my daughter and it was a massive hit. Although one couple on the flight tried to ruin it for everyone by being difficult my amazing daughter stepped to the front and dealt with the situation.
Well, after that little hiccup it was a great flight over the mountains and lakes and actually landed on one lake for a short stop.
Totally recommend as a must do on the bucket list, a little expensive but hey you can't take it with you so go for it.

review_title: Super day for a super ride!
review_text: Kato was our pilot and he did a super job getting us from our crab feast back to Taquan Air for our short bus ride back to our cruise ship. Everyone was quite professional and the scenery was amazing in Ketchikan! We had a super day weather wise and really had a great time with this great company. We even purchased two silly T's that will bring a laugh to us when we get home.

Missed out on the boat tour but the extra flying time made up for it.
Chuck was great host and pilot. Did a few loops around some of the frozen lakes etc. it was good to get out on the skids when we landed on the lake.
Thanks guys really enjoyed the day.

De Misty fjords sightseeing tour met Taquan Air is echt een aanrader, het personeel is vriendelijk, behulpzaam en goed op de hoogte van alle lokale highlights. Het vliegtuig was een echte klassieker wat het helemaal afmaakte.
So so worth it!! We had a lot of fun with our great tour guide, chuck! The views were great and its an awesome way to see Ketchikan that couldn't any other way! 10/10 recommend!

My wife and I took this as an excursion on a Norwegian cruse to Alaska. Our pilot for the flight was Chuck, he is a very skilled and knowledgeable piot that is smooth on the controls and was a pleasure to fly with. The flight was beter than expeced, the views are fantastic. I would do this trip again based on the high level of customer service of the staff and our pilot. Also Chucks choice of music to play along the flight was perfect. As a side note,  never once did the staff or pilot make me feel uncomfortable due to our size and disability

A wonderful flight to the Misty Fjords! We were able to fly with Chuck Perkins, who eased my sons fear of flying and provided us a very fun time! We live in SE Alaska and even living here we forget what an amazing place we have all around us! Thank you Office Manager, Danita Scott for recommending this flight tour as a gift for my family and Pilot Chuck Perkins for allowing my family to have a fun, safe and memorable trip!

We cannot wait to book our next flight on Taquan Air!!!!

We were fortunate enough to have great weather when we arrived in Ketchikan. (The town gets more than 200 inches of rain per year.) So we opted to book a float plane tour. We did a little research to find a reputable firm and Taquan came through. They run the tours for tourists like us. But they also service the remote communities by delivering mail and other items. So you could say they have the experience.

The actual flight was pretty cool. Don't expect your typical jumbo jet flight. The planes are pretty small. Ours was an Otter that held 12 people so you felt the ebb and flow of the wind. Taquan provides headphones so you can hear the pilot as he provides commentary on the flight. (It also helps with the engine noise.) Several planes take off together but, surprisingly, we didn't see another plane while in the air. We toured back into Misty Fjords then landed in one of the remote arms. We hung out for a while. There really isn't anywhere to go other than climb down onto the pontoon. Or sit in the plane. But the act of landing and taking off in the distant lake is probably the quintessence of Alaska.

Myself and a few friends went on the tour to the Misty Fjords and it was an unbelievable experience! We had excellent weather and our guide, John, was very informative and nice. It was an amazing time and I highly highly recommend it to anyone!

The views are incredible on this tour

Had an absolute blast with our pilot John! He was super knowledgeable and fun.

We were scheduled to do the Misty Fjords tour, but weather prevented that. The pilot made alternate plans  for our trip.   The space inside the plane is tight. My husband (6 ft tall) was very uncomfortable. We made a brief water landing.  We could stand on the floats  to take photos.

An adventure, for sure. Several issues with the plane in the beginning. After 3 attempts, all issues were resolved, and the flight enabled us to view some of God's magnificent creation. We were disappointed that we didn't see wildlife. They told us August is the best month for wildlife.
On our Alaskan cruise i booked this tour on a whim as we were leaving the ship. It was simply beautiful up there. the pilot was great, i felt comfortable etc Very professional

We took the Misty Fjords Seaplane excursion. Trip left on time & the sights were amazing!!!! Small plane which made the trip very intimate. Pilot was very knowledgeable & flew over some of the most beautiful sights in Alaska. We did a water landing on one of the fjords & we're allowed out of the plane to stand on the landing gear. Exhilarating to say the least!!!!! 

Highly recommended!!!!!

We were picked up at our cruise ship dock by a driver with a van and taken to the take-off site.  Senior pilot Mike took us on an approximately 70 minute round-trip into the fiords, providing commentary on what we were seeing.  He set the plane down on the water and invited the passengers (the plane holds six maximum) to step out onto the airplane float.  Cameras were encouraged on the flight. The pilot was knowledgeable, friendly and willing to assist passengers into and out of the plane.  After the flight we each received a certificate attesting to our adventure.  The driver took us back to the cruise ship location.

My first trip in a seaplane and loved it. The staff were wonderful and pilot drove me out in a golf buggy to the seaplane as I had a broken ankle to save me hobbling down. We took off and had great views of Ketchikan and onto Misty Fjords. From the air you get a great idea of the remoteness and beauty of this area. Flying next huge sheer rockfaces was awesome. We landed on Punchbowl Lake and again the sheer size of the area was evident when we were buzzed by another seaplane it literally was a speck. We were able to hop out and stand on the floats but given my broken ankle I didn't think it was a great idea. I thoroughly recommend this trip.

Float plain sight seeing for black bear, crab fest, or eransport  at Ketchikan using bush plain. Not inexpensive but ran professionally. Will have special treat if your pilot happens to be the nice Ms. Tracy Hame.

Absolutely breathtaking, only way to see this magnificent scenery.

Weather was cloudy but Adam,our pilot, kept us informed of his Plan B, which was slightly longer than the normal route. And probably better.

The experience of standing on the aircraft pontoon, with only your fellow passengers in a very remote lake was mind blowing

This was a great shore excursion I booked from my cruise. The scenery was breathtaking and the pilot even landed on a beautiful waterway so we could take pictures of a great waterfall. He narrated everything that we were seeing and there really wasn't a bad seat in the plane. It was tight quarters for someone tall or with long legs but they should request a seat up next to the pilot. Money very well spent!

review_title: Wind up that Bush Beaver and Let's Rip
review_text: We dealt directly wit Taquan Air by email to book this rather than through our ship. Much cheaper and really easy to do, they are really easy to deal with directly and are happy to answer your email questions. They came picked us up and took us out to their base about ten minutes away where we got a short safety briefing and then we were off -Misty Fjords here we come. Apparently this company only do window seats except me, the solid one on the plane got to sit in the primo co pilot seat and was assigned the job of lowering the landing gear for landing! (pilot was kidding  - you land on water skis). They kind of look at you and tell you where to sit in the plane based on your size but everyone had a primo seat - that way the plane flies flat and straight, they say. We lucked in with a cracker of a day so we got emerald green fjords under an electric blue sky. We took off on Ketchican Harbour down the side of our ship before heading across mountains that are awesomely beautiful. I was having such an awesome time i have no idea how long we flew before we landed on a deep blue lake high in the mountains. A whole lake to ourselves with no other tourists. Absolute wilderness, absolute bliss. We stayed for about 20 minutes before taking off again and headed across more lakes and massive mountains for ages before heading back and landing on Ketchican Harbour. The trip was awesome, our pilot was awesome, the commentary was awesome, the service was awesome and I love the t-shirt i brought. Try and book in the morning as they look like they get busy later in the day. Thanks it was awesome and on top of that they drop you back to the boat for free!

The natural environment of Southeast Alaska is accessible in limited ways:  by foot, by boat and by air.  What the last loses in the way of intimacy is more than made up for in breadth.  Add a water landing in Punchbowl Lake and you even recover some of that intimacy.

We booked this tour on the dock, saving $50 over the price on the ship ($209 v. $259) Our group of four joined five others on an 11 passenger DHC Otter.  Everyone gets a window seat (and one lucky person gets the right hand seat in the cockpit).  Our pilot, Chuck, demonstrated excellent airmanship, local knowledge and humour (as well as strong DJ skills!)

If you aren't a regular float plane passenger, be aware that the plane is small and winds in the narrow inlets and fjords can be changeable.   Bumps are to be expected.  If you are a regular float plane passenger, be aware that these Otters carry only 11, whereas Harbour Air packs in 17 between Vancouver and Victoria.  You'll have plenty of space.

We booked this excursion on our cruise on Regent.  The reason I don't rate this as excellent is I think it should have been a longer flight.  Our pilot Evan was great -- very knowledgeable and friendly.  As the weather was mild he was able to land on a remote lake where we were able to get out of the plane and stand on the floats.  It was amazing that we were in such a beautiful, remote area. Ryan flew us around surrounding areas and described what we saw and told us about the Ketchikan area in general. This was a wonderful experience.

We took the Classic Misty Fjords Flightseeing Tour in August 2016. We were planning on taking a longer tour with a different tour company, but we wanted to use our on-board cruise credit so we booked with Taquan Air. The tour was two hours and the perfect amount of time to get some great views of the fjords.

I forgot our pilot's name, which is unfortunate because he was very knowledgable on the area and funny as well. The planes are pretty old, but well maintained and, according to our pilot, very reliable.

You set out over the cruise ships and Ketchikan towards the fjords. It takes about 20-30 minutes to get into the national park and the views are spectacular. We ended up landing on the water in the middle of the fjords and were able to get out onto the side of the plane to look around and take pictures. It's unbelievably beautiful and serene once you are on the water.

We expected more wildlife on the tour, but only saw a bunch of seals lying on a beach from a long distance. We asked our tour guide and he said that there are very rarely wildlife spottings on this tour. The tour is amazing nonetheless, but that's just an expectation to having going into the tour.

We had an amazing time and would highly recommend.

Chuck was a terrific pilot, sharing his knowledge and love of Alaska as he skilfully flew us close to glaciers and waterfalls and swooping back down to land on the fjord.I have landed in a Twin Otter on the beach on the Isle of Barra Scotland and landing in an Otter with floats on glassy fjord was every bit as good and just  a wee bit more 😊😊😊 one very happy person. Thank you Chuck, oh and we enjoyed your choice of music too😊👍

review_title: The highlight of three weeks in Canada and Alaska!
review_text:
Having travelled from Calgary to Vancouver on the Rocky Mountaineer, then spent a week,on Vancouver Island, followed by a cruise to the Hubbard glacier and nearly back we little thought that the undoubted highlight of the trip was to be found in Ketchican.
I mean the place has 160 inches of rain a year for starters and having had the float plane rides at Juneau cancelled due to low cloud we expected the same at Ketchican.
Luckily we were wrong and put ourselves down for the Taquan Air Tours trip to the Misty Valleys. Initially down to fly on a larger float plane with a taped commentary we were part of a group of four at this the fag end of the season.
Our plane then was a De Havilland Beaver manufactured in 1956 according to Tony or Orville our pilot for the day. Tony was great, a local chap with a wealth of local knowledge. The best way to describe him would be to try and imagine a mix of Henry Fonda and Hawkeye Pearce.
After warnMing up the engine we were off. To say the scenery was fab would do him an injustice, it was soul searching. Scale and magnificence were there in buckets. He told us the fire service let out cabins in the woods in the area for the ultimate get away from it experience. He even landed on a mountain lake and we got some great pictures.
The time came and went all too soon, but the memory will last a lifetime.
So many thanks to the self proclaimed antique plane and antique pilot ( not)!

The whole process was nice from the van ride to the checkin and especially the flight

Chuck the pilot seemed knowledgable and was friendly and informative. 

The take offs and landings were very smooth. 

He circled around so we could get a good look at a couple of whales

I would highly recommend flying with them
We were very fortunate to have Chuck as our pilot and his passion for Alaska and flying were inspiring.  It was a magical experience.

We went on a flightseeing tour of Misty Fjords.  Our pilot was great, plane seated 8.  The views were spectacular, and we would not have been able to see as much by sea.  We enjoyed the stop midway where we landed in the park, got to see seals swimming nearby, and the natural beauty of the park was overwhelming.  I lost count of how many waterfalls we saw. I had the back row to myself, and got a little motion sickness.  Dramamine would have been a good idea.  My husband did not have any issues with that.  This was an amazing experience, we felt safe - the aircraft felt very well maintained, and the Bush Plane Certificates we got at the end were the icing on the cake!  Money well spent, we would do this again in a heartbeat!

The flight itself is really scenic. I liked that we landed in the water about halfway through and could walk out on the sides of the plane to take in the view. Pilot was good but didn't talk much. I figured he might talk about the sights, etc. but he was very quiet. They had a recording that they played but even with the headphones at full volume, you could barely hear it.

We went through the Carnival cruise excursion and even though it says no bags/purses, they've got lockers for your stuff and you can bring a small purse with you. When you first get off the bus, be sure to go right in and sit down for the safety video and hold off on going to the restroom until after because they like to be efficient. They then split you up into smaller groups for the plane and sit you by weight but everyone gets a window.

Flight was also chilly, not that I expected it to be heated but there was a gap along the door that let in a ridiculous amount of cold air so be sure to bundle up.

We loved our day of flight seeing. Our pilot Sam was informative, funny and a pleasure to fly with. The bears, whales and the views were extodinary. My wife and I would highly recommend this excursion!

We had the most amazing day with Taquan air tour and our excursion to George Inlet Lodge.  The flight was so incredible and breathtaking.  We were fortunate to have blue, crystal clear skies so we could see everything for miles from the mountains and water to the sea lions near the shoreline.  Our pilot was fantastic and being that my husband is a private pilot himself, we were very impressed with every detail.  All of the staff is extremely friendly and professional.  I highly recommend this company for your float plane tour and will absolutely book them again should we return to Ketchikan.

I have been on small planes before, but never a Sea Plane. What a great time as we went skywards from the water. The Pilot was excellent and made sure we saw all of the sights. We flew high enough to know you were above it all, but low enough to see all of the beauty below. I got to sit in the co-pilot seat which allowed me to also look at my he instruments to see our height, speed and a wonderful view of takeoff and landing. 
This is a must do in Ketchikan.

Booked a tour via our cruise ship to visit Neets Bay and they used Taquan Air to fly us there. Great trip, felt safe on the flight. Loved Neets Bay watching the Bears close up in the capable hands of Puck.

After spending a week in Alaska viewing it from boat, train, helicopter, and float plane, I can honestly say, seeing Alaska from the air was THE way to go. From the air you can truly absorb the magnitude of its wild beauty. We had a great pilot, Chuck, and an uncommonly clear day for the flight which only heightened the trip. It was spectacular. Besides a helicopter ride to the top of a glacier, this was my favorite Alaskan experience.

I have to admit, I was very nervous to get on a very small plane as I am extremely claustrophobic. Thank goodness for our AMAZING pilot, Ethan, who helped get me  on the plane so I wouldn't miss out on one of the best experiences of my life. I don't think I could have gotten on that plane without his reassurance!

The flight was absolutely amazing. The scenery is just incredible and the water landing in Misty Fjord was unbelievable. I cannot recommend this experience enough. 

Thank you, Ethan!

Booked this excursion on Viator off for an afternoons flight off the cruise ship. Picked up in the middle of the town at the prescibed place and taken up to Tarquans Base.  A short safety briefing and we were introduced to our pilot Mike along with 6 other travellers. Great smooth flight up to the Misty Mountains what fantastic views as the mist cleared a smooth landing on to a small dock and then after a short stop returned via a different route. Not to be missed if you get the chance.

Great floatplane ride to Neets Bay - salmon hatchery and bear watching. Our guide Puck was informative and fun - a real character. Saw 4 or 5 bears - a couple of them catching and eating salmon. Best tour we took - an absolute treat!!

Taquan Air transported us to The George Inlet Crab feast.  This shore excursion thru Holland America was truly fabulous.  Our pilot was Dave, who gave us a mini tour of what we were seeing from the air as we traveled.  This was probably the best trip I have ever taken.

Took this trip Sept 3, 2016.  Chuck Perkins was the pilot, who had a very smooth touch operating the turbine powered otter among mountains and high lakes.  He pointed out mountain goats, and took time to go around so everyone could get good look.  The beauty of the area,  his knowledgeable narration, and his personally chosen music made this one of the most exhilarating experiences we have ever had.

The float plane over the fjords was AMAZING. Adam was an awesome pilot and the views were incredible. The issue was the boat. The first half hour was phenomenal, beautiful scenery, nice water. The remaining 2 PLUS hours on the boat was choppy and boring. I highly recommend the float, but definitely skip the boat.

This is the second time we flew with them. Staff  is professional and friendly and very knowledgeable. If facility is clean and well-maintained. The price is better if you get off the ship and pay for it on the dock. I know it's expensive however well worth it the only way to see the Misty fjords.

review_title: Wow! Can't miss the Misty Fjords!
review_text: I went on the Misty Fjords Floatplane tour with Taquan Air. It was such a fantastic experience seeing the beauty of nature from above. My favorite pictures from my Alaska trip were the ones I took on this tour. Everyone I encountered through the tour experience from the floatplane pilot, pick-up/drop off van drivers and other employees were so professional, pleasant and friendly. I highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Ketchikan!

I just got back from a cruise in Alaska & one of the highlights was my floatplane tour to Misty Fjords National Park. The park itself was an incredible sight and the floatplane experience was wonderful! The entire staff was great, but especially our pilot, Mike, who made us all feel very safe. He gave us a great flight full of insight about the area. He then landed the plane & allowed anyone who wanted to step out onto the floats of the plane and experience the serenity the park has to offer. This is an excursion not to be missed!

review_title: Misty Fjords flightseeing on a floatplane
review_text: We did this trip as a shore tour during an Alaska cruise. We booked through Alaska Shore Excursions before we left. Our pilot, Ethan, was amazing and the landing in the fjord was perfect. The scenery was beautiful and Ethan was very knowledgeable about the area and the role the floatplanes play for the community. He was happy to take photos of us out on the floats to help commemorate the trip. Our smaller size plane (6 passengers) was the perfect size because everyone had a window seat.

review_title: Float plane and salmon hatchery for bear viewing!
review_text: I was really looking forward to this trip, and I wasn't disappointed! The float plane flight was really smooth throughout (smoothest flight we've ever been on, and that includes the take off and landing!), pilot was great and very informative during the flight (we had music on when he wasn't talking). The guide at the hatchery was good and seeing the salmon hatchery was interesting! Obviously the other highlight of the trip was the bear viewing! We saw a few bears during our time there, only thing I would say is that we could have spent longer watching the bears!

review_title: A must go journey in Ketchikan
review_text: I visited Ketchikan in August during a cruise trip to Alaska.  My family took the flight by Tequan Air Tours to see Misty Fjords.  It is an amazing journey.  The float planes are extremely steady and the view from top is marvelous.  We had flied over the harbour and over the forest to Misty Fjords and landed on the quiet water.  We saw rainbow during our flight, which is different from the view from land and amazing.  Pilot are friendly.  Accompanied by the introduction and wonderfully music, we have a very good experience about Alaska forest.
The staff was excellent and the pilot was phenomenal! This is definitely how you should sightsee in Ketchikan, Alaska.

review_title: The view of the Misty Fjords Monument were outstanding!
review_text: This was a beautiful tour.  We were on a Beaver, seating 8 plus the captain.  The tour was lovely, but our captain really didn't add anything to the narrative part of the tour, as it was suggested by the recorded narrative.   Also, we had to leave early after landing because 4 of our group were on a cruise ship that was leaving early.   We really didn't get to thoroughly enjoy our landing in the fjord.   But, very nice staff and planes, and we enjoyed the tour.
Excellent service the pilot was very knowledgeable about the area. Pointed out a whale that was breaching took the time to circle the area

Tony was our pilot on our vintage aircraft!  He gave fantastic information about the areas history.  Flight was beautiful and so smooth.  Better than any commercial flight.  So close to everything, amazing views. Would go again tomorrow. This was the best excursion of our cruise!

review_title: Nice guys and a great tour
review_text: Everyone was so welcoming and patient. Our pilot was upbeat and knowledgeable. We were so satisfied we left a generous tip. It wasn't cheap but it was worth the price.

review_title: Beautiful scenery, smooth boat ride and flight.
review_text:
Our Misty Fjords tour was a boat ride from Ketchican to the fjords, with a return by small plane.  The guides on the boat were informative and nice.  

The pilot seemed highly skilled -- I wasn't sure we had taken off or landed, they were both so smooth.  A few air current bumps going around mountain peaks, which is normal.  We had a high degree of confidence in the pilot, who handle the plane superbly. 

Incredible scenery with a memorable boat ride and flight.  

Highly recommended.

Thanks, Taquan Air and staff!

review_title: A Great Seaplane Ride to the Misty Fjords
review_text:
Visiting Ketchikan on a Regent cruise from Vancouver to Seward, I signed up for the Misty Fjords Seaplane Adventure, operated by Taquan Air. A great decision on my part! Our pilot, Chuck, was very experienced, loved flying his plane, and really made this a special experience. We took off from the marina next to our cruise ship, flew over some amazing Alaskan scenery, often looking out at mountains towering on both sides of the plane. I spotted a bear and her cubs as we made our way into the Misty Fjords area. After we had been in the air about 25 minutes, Chuck made a sea landing and let us climb out onto the plane's pontoons. Several of our group opted to remain inside, but I got out and enjoyed the views. Once again, we took off for the ride back to the docks. All takeoffs and landings were very smooth. I don't think I've experienced a smoother takeoff or landing in similarly sized planes on ordinary runways.

The only complaint I had was the time we spent waiting for our ride. I guess that was only because this tour was so popular -- and rightly so.

We took a flight over Misty Fjords as a cruise ship excursion.  The scenery is incredibly beautiful. Our pilot was great, and his commentary over the headphones was very informative. The landing on a lake was smooth, and the quietness of the surroundings added to the majesty.
A couple of notes to be aware of, especially if you have kids: the plane gets pretty cramped, and so it gets stuffy prior to takeoff. And because it's a small plane, expect a few dips and drops as the plane hits pockets of cooler or warmer air. Prepare your kids, if they've never been in a smaller plane.

We (me and my mom) booked this tour while we were in port on a cruise in May. We had an afternoon flight so we wandered around the town for a bit before going to check in and get on the bus to get dropped off at the company. After checking in at the desk. We used a coupon from the Tour Saver book for a 2 for 1 price. This alone made the book worth purchasing but be sure to book early because I think they only accept a certain number of these coupons per day. After checking in we were offered water and coffee and use of lockers to store any larger bag (no backpacks allowed on the plane but i was able to bring a small cross-body bag and I saw some smaller camera bags). After storing our bags we watched a short safety video and assigned our pilots. We were with Tracey, she was full of facts and history about Misty Fjords. We landed on punch-bowl lake for a change to get out and stand on the floats of the plane. Landing and taking off from the water was so cool! Tracey was a wonderful pilot and this tour was amazing!

We took this tour while in port on a cruise.   We were greeted at the dock and driven to the company's shop where we got a short safety briefing, and then got underway.
There were six of us in the plane each with a good view out the windows.  Taking off on the water was so cool, a really unique way to see the town and the port.  

Flying out to over the wilderness with John, our pilot, was an experience I will never forget.  We flew past incredible waterfalls, wetlands, giant lakes, and the most incredible rock faces you could imagine.  John told us all about the area, and played great music throughout our trip.  The highlight was landing on a beautiful fjord and getting out on the pontoons to take in the breathtaking scenery.   

We had about an hour in the air and about a half hour on the water, where I had the chance to talk to John and learn how he came to Alaska.  This trip was a highlight of our Alaska trip and one that I will always remember.  Thank you John and Taquin Air!

Our family of 5 was excited to take this float-equipped bush plane excursion over the Misty Fjords, but we worried about the grey skies and mist over the area we were about to see.  Our pilot was calm and reassuring about our journey, and he was correct.  He flew low enough to skim the mountain tops and escape the fog in most places, so we had stunning views during a smooth flight accompanied by commentary and music over our headphones.  We also made a water landing and had time to get out of the plane, walk on the floats and take some photos.  It was an experience none of us had ever had before, and an awesome introduction to Alaska.

Had a great time on this adventure! Our pilot (forget his name) was very knowledgeable and we enjoyed listening to his commentary as we flew around the Fjord. Our meal at the lodge for crab legs was amazing and one of the highlights of our trip! Would definitely recommend.

Hicimos el viaje en hidroavión a los fiordos Mystic y Es un lugar maravilloso, sale un poco caro el paseo, pero no pueden dejar de hacerlo. Tiene unos paisajes espectaculares. Muy buen servicio, el piloto muy amable, nos sentimos seguros en todo tiempo y dan una buena explicación del lugar. Muy recomendable!

review_title: Clock our pilot and our plane was great the office needs to be more organized
review_text: We realize you always have to listen to the weather when you are in Alaska however this tour company kept us sitting in a bus for a very long time and then kept us sitting in their office area. And they weren't really super friendly and nice They were supposed to show as a safety film that they never did but that was fine with us. Clark our pilot, grew up in Ketchikan and was quite knowledgeable and we really enjoyed our floatplane tour and landing.

This excursion was memorable and worth the money. The best way to see Misty Fjords. The staff was friendly and prompt, and the pilot was experienced and knowledgable. We even landed in the water halfway through the trip and took pictures. Absolutely breathtaking. A once in a lifetime opportunity.

A group of us (5) decided last minute to do a float bush plane excursion.  We had an amazing day (a rare sunny day in Ketchikan) to fly around (some of our group got to even see some bald eagles flying).  One of members was even able to sit in the copilot seat.  Our pilot told us a ton of information as we flew over the different landmarks. We even landed in a Fjourd (lake) and able to go outside and stand on one of the floats and take some pictures.  We were given certificates of our flightseeing.  

One note it was warm inside the plane - note sure if due it being sunny or from the engine.

Took the Misty Fjords trip out of Ketchikan with Taquan Air Tours.  The scenery was spectacular as our pilot, Adam, narrated along the way.  Nothing like cruising just over sheer cliffs and following a waterfall as it descended.  Also got to experience a water landing!  Adam was an excellent pilot and was experienced at handling the aircraft as well as the questions of six passengers

Reserved a tour on a floatplane for Misty Arm Fjords. Tour took about 1 1/2 hours to complete. Our pilot, Tony, flew us over some beautiful country and narrated what we were seeing. Half way through our tour he landed on the water and we were able to exit the plane and walk on the pontoons. This was a bucket list item for me that I had delayed since I'm very claustrophobic. I will warn you that the cabin is very small but once you're in the air you're so enraptured by what you're seeing you don't think about it.  Not a budget tour but glad we had the opportunity to experience the takeoff and landing on water.

The seaplane trip over Misty Fjords national park was expensive but indeed worthwhile. Our pilot, Sam, was really knowledgeable, amicable and capable. The ride from the quay to Taquan Air was slightly unpleasant because the bus had no air circulating in it. Staff were friendly and efficient throughout. The breathtaking views over plunging cliffs, deep blue waters and miles of virgin forest will stay with me for the rest of my life.

케치칸 바로 옆에 위치하였으며, 스태프들이.매우 친절합니다.  폭포도 보기 좋으며, 중간에 물위에 랜딩하여, 사진 찍기 좋습니다. 
파일럿의.설명이 좋아요

review_title: Great Seaplane Ride with Bear Visit to Anan Creek
review_text:
Incredible seaplane ride with a great pilot (very informative).  The highlight was going to Anan Creek and seeing the bears feed on salmon.  They are literally 2-3 ft away (you are on a deck overlooking them).  
My kids (ages 22-28) wanted to see bears on our trip and we saw at least 10 of them.  It was early in the season,  so bears were not guaranteed.  We hoped to see brown and black bears, but only saw black ones (and no cubs) but still well worth the trip.  We booked on our own way ahead of the cruise as there are only so many permits issued a day in the area (6 on our day, and 2 were already taken). The seaplane ride takes about 30 min each way and is beautiful.  Then you get out with a guide and do a short hike (15-20 min) to the ranger station at Anan Creek--need to be able to walk a mile over rocky terrain.  You are there approx 2 hours seeing all the bears up close (approx 30 are there at a time when we went from other AK cities).  It was really a once in a lifetime experience.  Highly recommend!

review_title: Best way to see the Fjord!!
review_text: One must take the flight from Taquan Air and see Misty Fjord! They give exceptional service and the staff is very knowledgeable. They clicked pictures for us from our camera even when they were selling pictures clicked by them!

This aerial tour of the Ketchikan area and surrounding fjords was outstanding.  The flight contained pre-recorded audio that was informative but not intrusive.  We observed mountain goats atop mountains.  We even landed on a remote mountain lake and saw a mother bear with two cubs!  I cannot express how enjoyable this tour was.  We took the pure aerial tour (about 2 hours), but I understand there is a tour where you fly to a boat and cruise back (several hour tour).  If we had time, we would have done that.  Definitely check this out.

We were pn a cruise and decided not to book tnru the ship....stepped onto the dock and the chap said he could take us right away for 209 dollars rather than the 270 on the ship.

Boy....We have done a lot of things but this trip was the best....we did have great weather...( another reason to leave it till the day).... Landad on a lake up in the mountains and saw 2 bears....fab trip worth every penny for 2 hours.

This was our one big excursion we chose while cruising through Alaska.  If you purchase the Alaska coupon book ahead of time they have a buy one get one free offer.  Even after purchasing the coupon book for $99 you still save on the trip.  We were able to use one other coupon so it more than paid for itself.  We completed a flightseeing tour of Misty Fjord.  Incredible views!  It was a wonderful way to see these fjords.  I am not sure people who went by boat or other means could see or appreciate the views we had in and above the clouds.  Unforgettable!

Mike was our guide.  So friendly and informative.  Many times he'd turn the lady in our headphones off and narrate himself, which was better.  Other times he was just quiet and let us enjoy the incredible beauty that is Misty Fjords on our own.

For us this was definitely once in a lifetime and we enjoyed every minute.  The flight.  The water landing where we were allowed to stand on the pontoons and breathe in the beauty.  It was a wonderful experience and one we will never forget.

Had a great flight and great pilot.   We flew over the Fjords and it was unreal. Except for an obnoxious passenger whose whole family got on the floats, not allowing me to. Then he was soo loud....oh well, I didn't let him spoil our good time!

We had the most amazing experience with George our pilot on a Taquan Air floatplane excursion over the Misty Fjords, booked via a Royal Caribbean cruise on 6/30/16.  We were fortunate that we had a really beautiful day with blue skies, some clouds and little wind. Our flight was smooth from start to finish over the spectacular Misty Fjords National Monument, including our water landing on Punchbowl Lake. Truly the most beautiful landscape I have ever seen and it was certainly a highlight of our entire Alaskan vacation. I highly recommend his excursion and George and this wonderful little company. Professional, friendly and very simply spectacular!

Bill from Taquan Air was our pilot out to the Misty Fjords.  He was knowledgable and friendly and I wished we could have spent more time in the air and in the area. Beautiful country.

Whilst only short the opportunity to get out on the pontoon when you land for a look around is well worth while.

Our first time flying in a seaplane. Our pilot was awesome. He narrated the points of interest but didn't talk to much. We landed in a cove and stepped out onto the pontoons to take pictures. I was a great way to see the natural wonders of Alaska.

A friend and I flew out on a Plane to tour the Misty Fjords with Clark as our pilot. He was fantastic! He told us great information about the area, which was so appreciated! It was a great day to fly and having an excellent pilot just made our visit to Ketchikan perfect!! Highly recommended for anyone visiting Ketchikan, Alaska!

Superb outfit. Professional efficient and trustworthy.
They take the the passengers safety seriously and give an experience to enjoy.
We are still talking about it three months later.
Highly recommended!

The staff at Taquan air were nice and our pilot was very skilled (a flight instructor from Florida). 

The let down was the lack of interactive information during the flight. During the flight all information provided came from a recorded audio track, which provided general information about the area and some of its history. There was no information provided directly by the pilot about what we were flying over or what specific things we saw under the plane. 

Although the scenery was pretty, it was not spectacular. 

If you're going to book a flight while cruising in Alaska, I'd recommend a helicopter flight over a glacier, rather than a fixed wing flight over the fjords.

Incredible flight provided by Taquan Air!  This experience is definitely an Alaska "must do".  We saw lots of seaplanes during our 2 weeks in Alaska and we were so glad to finally get to experience this unique mode of transportation.  Taquan Air first showed us a fairly standard safety video and then we were allowed to finally take the flight.  Our pilot was professional - and even funny as he had the song "Learning to Fly" on when we first boarded the plane.  It was certainly a joke, as the pilot was an expert and both take off and landing were very smooth.  The pilot pointed out interesting features along the way and answered questions.  The landscape was beautiful, and we really enjoyed this experience.  If we ever return to Alaska, we would definitely fly with Taquan again.

review_title: Amazing flightseeing and all-you-can-eat crab feast
review_text: Our group ranged in age from 12-71 and everyone had a great time. Our pilot was knowledgeable and friendly, and the staff at the George Inlet Lodge were great. The flight was relatively short but we enjoyed stunning views. Lunch was delicious.

We rode a van to the crab feast, are our fill of crabs and then had the expectation of an aerial tour on the way back. Turned out more like an aerial taxi service with the kid flying us not saying much other than the safety briefing. He looked to be 18 at best. Nevertheless, it was very cool to fly over the Alaskan Bays and see it from the air! But I can't go over 3 stars for the air service.

We had an absolutely beautiful sunny day for our flight to the Mystic Fjords. Chuck was our pilot and was able to fly longer than usual due to the beautiful weather.  He provided great history and music. It was amazing. Not to be missed. Don't vote for the "standard tour". Go for the adventure!  Standing on the planes floats in the pristine fjord was fantastic.

review_title: Misty Fjords Seaplane Trip .... An amazing journey
review_text: Absolutely breathtakingly beautiful flying out of Ketchikan, Alaska on the seaplane over the fjords.  We'd never experienced that sort of beauty so close up before.  The pilot was excellent explaining everything to us, showing us waterfalls and trying to spot bears and mountain goats.  A wonderful experience if you get the chance.

Taquan Air Tours was the perfect place to book a Misty Fjords flightseeing trip. Where other than Alaska can you take the opportunity to tour via a float plane. The views were spectacular and takeoff and landing on the water was an experience not to be missed. I posted a few pictures as words can describe the experience. Also worth noting was office crew –they were incredibly organized from booking to drop off and even scheduled van pick up from my cruise ship.

The trip was organised through our ship and a bus collected us at the dock and took us out to the dock where the adventure began.  Unfortunately we had to drive around Ketchikan for a while due to parking problems, but we had a brilliant driver who gave us a guided tour.  I have some problems with mobility and our pilot Chuck was a real gentleman and walked with me to the plane and made sure I got in o.k. and was comfortable.  He then took off and gave us a fantastic trip over the misty fijords which were majestic.  He was full of information and everyone was helped out of the plane at the dock and photos taken.  Unfortunately the wildlife was not to hand, but you could imagine everything as Chuck described it being there in the big backwoods.  We travelled back wishing the flight would not end, but alas it did.  A truly magical experience and one that should be on everyone's bucket list.

We booked this as an excursion from our cruise.  We were picked up at the dock by a bus and got a tour of Ketchikan before arriving at the plane.  How wonderful to see Bald Eagles flying around and sitting on roofs of other buildings as we were walking towards the plane! We are so thankful it was a clear sunny day. There are not words to describe the beauty of Alaska from a top view!  Our pilot landed on a lake and we were allowed to step out on the float to take in the beauty and take pictures. Our pilot was very informative about the history of the area. The take off and landing were smooth. We would recommend this tour if you want to see Alaska from a different perspective.

review_title: enjoy the flight of your lifetime
review_text: These guys are professional and knowledgable.  Picked us up at our cruise ship, to go by bus to their docks.  Took the seaplane tour and landed in a lake.  Just spectacular.  Definitely worth it.

Esse embora caro, é o melhor passeio da cidade, com duração de aproximadamente 1 hora, sobrevoando os fyords, com pouso em um lago e 10 minutos para fotos. Experiencia única para voar em um hidroavião.

We just had an experience of a lifetime! Chuck is the only pilot you want! Over 20 years experience and he took us off the canned tour to awesome spots no one else sees. We landed in the middle of Walkers Cove (and not the usual dock) and got to see amazing waterfalls and snow capped mountains on the way. I was lucky enough to be his co-pilot to make the thrill even better. Chucks incredible knowledge made the tour much more interesting over a pre-recorded tape. He even flew us over an inlet where he knew orcas had been hanging and sure enough we saw 3 of them!! Definitely do this!! Ask for Chuck. Amazing bucket list adventure!! Thank you Chuck!! -Megan and TJ, Atlanta GA.

We had an excellent bush plane tour with Chuck as our pilot today! My husband and I were a little nervous because we've never flown in a plane that small. We booked this tour through Carnival and we were not disappointed! Our Otter plane was a 10 seater plane, everyone had great views through the windows. He flew us over Misty Fjords outside of Ketchikan and narrated the tour so we knew where we were. It was a nice day, good mix of sun and clouds at the tops of the mountains. We landed on a remote lake with a gorgeous view of a waterfall, stopped for about 15 minutes to get out and walk on the pontoons and take in the scenery. The flight was as smooth as can be expected, very similar (or better) to a commercial flight as far as takeoff and landing. If you want to see Alaska from the air, this is the tour for you! We had a fantastic time! Thanks Chuck and Taquan Air!

review_title: Loved it! Once in a lifetime experience.
review_text: She was really nervous but the headphones and music helped her relax. The sights and sounds were great. The best part was landing in the middle of the flight, into a small lake...getting out on the ski and just taking a few moments to breathe, reflect and be grateful. Air was fresh and crisp. We loved it. Our pilot was knowledgeable and great. We took tons of photos, videos and will remember it the rest of our lives. A photo taken will likely end up being our "Save the date" announcement photo for wedding. Do it, you'll think it's worth every dime.

Like most other reviewers, we were in Ketchikan on a cruise ship - Oceania's Regatta- and this flight was one of the ship's excursions. Luckily for us, we were booked on a later trip as the earlier ones were cancelled due to heavy overcast and rain. The ride was a bit bumpy at first but that was soon forgotten as the fjords came into view. Our pilot made sure our headsets worked and his commentary added a great deal to our experience. I loved hearing about the planes being used for delivering virtually everything to people in the bush, including pizza! My husband, who is 6 ft 5 in tall, rode in the co-pilot's seat, which required quite a bit of struggling into but he loved it. The weight of passengers requires balancing so while everyone (6) had window seats, couples were not necessarily seated together. We passed up standing on the pontoon due to our seats in the plane but enjoyed taking photos of our fellow passengers and the quiet pristine nature of our location. Our photos aren't sun-filled but they do represent an amazing experience, not to be missed!

My husband, son and myself purchased a sea plane trip to Misty Fiords in Ketchikan Alaska. We were to take off from the harbor and fly above all the scenery, land at Misty Fiords and exit the seaplane for a short time to hear the quiet and take pictures. Our pilot complained of a long day ahead and told us we could not exit for the pictures even though another seaplane was there and their passengers were out. Our pilot was pretty gruff with everyone. A lady sitting in the back couldn't get the seat belt to work and two of us had problems with the headphones fitting. Our pilot seemed not to care so I tried to just hold my headphones on my head while trying to take pictures with one hand. The lady in the back ended up attaching 2 belts from 2 seats together. This guy was a good pilot but not a people person. Try to get one of the younger pilots.

review_title: Float plance tour to Misty Fjords National Monument
review_text:
Words are inadequate to describe just how wonderful this experience is.   I was somewhat anxious that it would be hard to see but everyone got a window seat and the headset commentary was helpful too.

The views are beyond spectacular, mile after mile of the most beautiful, unspoilt forest and wilderness, rocks, lakes, water, birds, cliff faces

The water landing in the lake was not too scary

If you want to do so you can get out and stand on the floats - all of our party did so - can't quite believe I managed to do this as I have no sense of balance but you only live once!  Would not have wanted to fall in though I must admit....

If you get the chance go for it - it's a fabulous trip

Booked this in conjunction with a crab feast through Celebrity's website. Had a great but short flight. It was perfect despite the typical weather in Ketchikan. I would definitely recommend this excursion for anyone seeking a little adventure!

I went on this because my friend wanted to go.  I do not like to fly.  The plane ride was magnificent.  You got to see things from a different perspective and it was beautiful.  The take-off and landing was really smooth and not at all rough.  I would definitely do this again. Don't be afraid to take this plane ride it is a great ride.  The staff was very knowledgeable and friendly.

This was our first shore excursion while on a cruise, and it was a fantastic way to start our first day in Alaska.  The staff were extremely friendly and knowledgeable, the ride was comfortable and thrilling, and the scenery was beautiful.  Definitely would recommend this company to anyone with the time and money.

This was a Holland America Cruise Line shore excursion. A great experience all the way around: weather, sights, and dining. Our ground crew and pilot for Taquan Air were friendly, organized, and competent. Even if you're a tad nervous about flying in a small ( 6 Pax) float plane, you will soon be absorbed by the majesty of Alaska and will not feel unsafe. The crab dinner at the George Inlet Lodge exceeded expectations and redefined all you can eat. Our gracious hostess provided a short "how to" demo on how to eat a crab. She was friendly, knowledgeable, and most important, kept the crab coming! One note, we were the last tour of the day and to meet our cruise departure we felt a bit rushed toward the end of our dinner. If possible book an earlier tour.

review_title: We were lucky with the weather
review_text:
On the tour from the Brilliance of the Seas, there were three times to chose and we were on the last one.
So lucky as we heard that earlier flights were cancelled due to low cloud, which is not uncommon in Ketchikan.
A brief but important safety video was shown before we boarded the aircraft.
Michael was our pilot and he checked us all in according to our perceived weight, this had been given in before we started,
Once in, belted up and headphones on, off we went. He played music through the headphones throughout the journey which wasn't really needed. When he spoke, there was quite a bit of background noise so not much was heard, this was confirmed by all on the plane.
The experience was great, we flew out over the inlets around Ketchikan for about 30+ minutes, landed and were able to get out and walk on the planes floats for photos before getting back in. Two of us were allowed to be the co-pilot, one on the outbound flight and one in the return.
I would guess at about 1 1/4 hours flying.
Very smooth take off and landings with plenty of opportunities to take photos.
We were all given certificates when we finished, a nice touch.

My wife and I chose the floatplane trip to Misty Fjords as our excursion while docked in Katchikan. I must say that the experience was even better than I had expected. We boarded a bus at the pier for a 5 minute ride to the Taquan Air docks where we received a short safety briefing, then boarded a 10-passenger de Havilland DHC-3 Otter single engine floatplane. Everyone had their own headphones and a window seat with a great view for taking photos. The pilot was very personable and shared interesting information about the plane, the town and its history, and Misty Fjords. The scenery was AMAZING. The pilot took his time, allowing us ample opportunity to take photos and videos. About 45 minutes out, we landed near a floating dock and stretched our legs for a few minutes, then reboarded and flew back to the dock. Everyone received a complimentery photo/certificate and then we rode the bus back to the pier area. The Taquan Air staff were all very polite and accommodating. All in all I can't imagine a better way to see Misty Fjords.
What a fabulous experience to fly in a float plane in Alaska!!  Our pilot was great and the scenery was amazing.  So grateful for the opportunity to experience Alaska with this great company.

Very safety oriented and an awesome adventure. Highly recommended. I was in crutches and had a foot walking boot and had zero issues. Not recommended if you have motion sickness though. Great for ages 8 and up! Probably wouldn't take little kiddos.

Beautiful sunny day! Staff were amazing. Trip over fjords and landing at volcanic rock in water was great. Adam, our pilot, took great pictures for us from top of the plane. Well worth the trip. Once in a lifetime experience.

review_title: Beautiful ride no matter which direction
review_text: I have flown on Taquan dozens of times and never have I been disappointed. From the office staff, management, pilots, etc- you can't go wrong when choosing this aviation company/service/tours.

review_title: First below, now above...an amazing place from any angle!
review_text: We've done boat excursions through Misty Fjords before and it is an incredible experience. However, this time....unplanned, as we headed back to the ship we meandered through the excursion extravaganza and were interested in trying it by air this time. Scheduled a tour that allowed us time to head back to our stateroom and drop off our goodies and head back to the excursion desk. Much to our disappointment, we were the only two to sign up so they had to cancel however Taquan Air Tours was right next door and had a tour open for only one hour later. We were a little concerned about getting back for our 4:30 departure. Taquan explained if they didn't get us back in time, they would just have to fly us to our next port of call and they weren't really interested in getting into that. So with our fears extinguished, I took a deep breath and said Yes! (I never was a big fan of my feet being more that 25ft. above ground) And I have to say any fear of flying vanishes quickly once you get used to the tiny bouncing air currents (smoother than riding in car)...it was magical. Our very experienced pilot gave us to option of either listening to his live narration with his own mix tape...or the 'canned', pre-recorded voice over describing the area in general. Everyone on board voted for our pilot, (I believe it was Tim's) voice. His knowledge of the area and expertise in navigation assured us of the right choice. We landed on a lake high above sea level and was able to get out and breath in the pristine air, take photos and absorb the scenery. Upon take off, we lifted off right on top of the 1,000 foot waterfall....very impressive and dramatic! This really is a very different perspective of an incredible beautiful place on Earth....try not to miss it!

We took a tour over the Misty Fjords.  The business was well organized.  We had transfers to / from the cruise port.  The transfer drivers [I think Patty and ??] were professional and friendly and  provided local information.  Our pilot was Chuck and he was also very professional and knowledgable.  I did feel for him however when we returned and before we exited the aircraft another group, the last of the day, was ready to step onboard.

review_title: Shame about the commentary and safety aspects
review_text:
I know this goes against the other reviews but our trip was marred by a lack of commentary either by the pilot or the pre recorded...I mentioned it to the pilot but it fell on deaf ears literally. We landed in the lake and got out on to the floats which was quite exhilarating but I did fear for the safety of us as you could quite easily slip off the floats into the freezing water ,
I would like to do it again with commentary as the views and scenery are fantastic as is the experience of landing on water

I stopped into Taquan not knowing what to expect and was pleasantly surprised by friendly staff, skilled pilots and very nice offices! Their lobby has comfortable seating, coffee and a big screen while you wait and offers some souvenirs. The dock hands are very friendly and carry your luggage down to the dock. I flew with Adam whom was very friendly, knew the areas we flew well and gave narrated tours of the sites I saw. They fly a fleet of Beavers that are vintage and fun! Taquan also delivers mail to all the remote areas and are well liked by the locals.

review_title: Beautiful flight and great pilot/tour guide
review_text: Our pilot was a great tour guide also. The highlight of the flight was landing in a lake surrounded by mountains. We got out and walked on the floats to get a feeling of being in the middle of no where. Amazing all around.

Taquan Air is one of two airlines that offer service to Metlakatla. The waiting area in Ketchikan is beautiful and the staff is helpful. Flight times are always on schedule and company apparel for sale on site is a plus. Save a couple dollars by booking online.

review_title: Wonderful flight seeing of Misty Fjords
review_text: Since we were in Ketchikan on a sunny day, we decided at the last minute to book this flight.  The scenery was great, and the pilot experienced and competent.  The flight include a landing and take off from an inland lake.

review_title: An Amazing Trip Into Wilderness-Misty Fjords
review_text: We love to live in Smart, Modern cities, the concrete jungles but being in the Wilderness is truely Soul Touching. We were in Ketchikan, Alaska, in Jul 2015 and we heard of the Misty Fjords. There were sea planes which could take us there. So we chose Taquan Air Tour to Misty Fjords. Apart from the experience of being in a sea plane, what was breath-taking was the flight to the Fjords. Our Captain was Mike and he slowly descended onto the waters in the wilderness, after 45 minutes flight. We were surrounded by nature all around. With the engines switched off, it was a Pin-drop silence. We were allowed to step out of the plane and stand on the Floats of the aircraft for an All Round view. It was Awesome. We are told that there are cabins in this vast wilderness, that can be hired for overnight stays, where Taquan Air drops you and picks you up once your booked stay is over. But BE-WARE of a BEAR.

It was just a spur of the moment, we met a salesman in the info center and off we went.
A great ride to their headquarters and off we went with young female pilot, sorry can't recall her name.  She was a great guide for our trip very enjoyable and so much to see.  Ed

review_title: Amazing views! Friendly pilots and staff!
review_text: Our time in Ketchikan was limited due to our visit being a cruise stop. We got off the ship and immediately saw the booth for the floatplane tour. Price was slightly less than through cruise line. They provided transportation to the docks, showed us a safety video and quickly got us airborne! What a wonderful experience. The plane windows were bubbled out allowing for great views. We landed on a lake and were permitted to deplane and stand on the pontoon. We were given headsets with info about the area. The pilot, Mike, also gave us some information about what we were seeing. Very smooth take offs and landings. You do need to be agile enough to climb up and down the ladder (about 4 steps) to board and deplane. They will ask your weight so they can balance the plane. We were blessed with a sunny, clear day. They got us back to our ship on time. Wonderful staff! Highly recommend this flight for cruisers. Well worth the cost!

My husband & I were on a cruise that stopped in Ketchikan. We booked the Flightseeing and Crab Feast through the ships Excursion desk. So glad we picked this excursion. It was amazing. A bus was waiting at the pier to take us on a short drive (approx 30 minutes) to George Inlet Lodge. We were shown into our own private dining room (6 of us) and had a delicious Dungeness Crab feast (all you could possibly eat). The meal also included salad and potatoes and yummy raspberry cheesecake for dessert. After our meal we walked around the dock area taking photos while we waited for our plane to arrive. The plane ride was amazing with spectacular scenery. Our pilot, Luke, was very friendly and I felt completely safe. The ride lasted approx 30 minutes from the lodge, flying over the mountains (Luke pointed out some Mountain Goats on the side of a cliff) then we circled around our ship and landed up the river from the cruise port. There was a trolly that took us back to the ship. This was one of the highlights of our trip, we both enjoyed it very much. Definitely recommend this excursion if you are in Ketchikan.

review_title: Make sure you get what you pay for.
review_text: I booked this tour while I was on the  Holland America Volendam Alaska cruise.  We were told that the plane would land on the water and we would be able to get out and stand on the 'floats' or dangle our feet in the water.  This didn't happen.  Our pilot opened the doors and we sat in the plane. He was a bit nonplussed about the whole thing.  Gave the impression he had done this tour too many times to care.  We weren't allowed to get out even though we watched others do so and they had purchased their tickets for the same tour at the docks and not on the boat.  The views were great but just make sure you get what you pay for.  This was something that had been recommend to me to do and I left feeling very disappointed knowing I would never have the opportunity to do this again.

review_title: Great trip to see bears by plane!
review_text: My 11 yo daughter and I made this trip while our cruise ship was in Ketchikan and my husband and son were zip lining. We had a terrific adventure and we highly recommend it. Bears are our favorites and seeing them was a highlight of our trip! The bus picked us up at the ship, and we had a nice ride to a small airport right on the water. We boarded a de havilland with another family and our pilot, seven of us in all. Our pilot was great and gave us a wonderful narrated flight to prince of Wales island. We were nervous flying in the floatplane but the pilot was really wonderful and the flight and landings were incredibly smooth - better than most flights I have been on! When we landed, a naturalist met us and explained a great deal about the area and bears. We took a small van, and shortly arrived at a forest with a bustling river - with loads of salmon jumping out. We stood on a deck and waited for bears. Finally we saw a beauty who quickly grabbed a fish and waltzed off. A few minutes later we saw a second, and just before we headed out, a third. We would have been happy to stay all day looking for bears!  We probably only saw them for a total of a minute, but it was well worth it! All was terrific and we just loved the tour - especially the three bears!

review_title: Awesome views and FUN standing on floats!!
review_text: I'm not sure that I'd say "once in a lifetime," because we might do it again!!  It was perfect!  Great views, great pilot, but when he "parked" on the water and let us scramble out onto the floats, that was TOO cool!!  It's pricey, but worth it!

Our family of 7 took a sea plane tour while on a cruise in Alaska with Taquan Air and believe me, we all were so impressed!  The customer service, the pilot, the tour, everything and everyone was top notch!  This was by far one of the best tours we have ever taken!  You will not be disappointed!

Brentwood was our pilot of this 6 seater Dehavilland float plane.  All passangers had headphones to listen to Brentwood's interesting narrative and intervening music.

Flying for 75 minutes through fjords and mountains was the most exciting thing my wife has done in her life!  It probably helped that she got to sit in the co-pilot's seat after landing in Misty Fjord.  After a smooth lake landing, we exited the plane and stood on the pontoons to view and listen to the wilds.  Sheer granite cliffs, plunging waterfalls from an earlier rainstorm and pristine rivers and wilderness were breathtaking. This is a "don't miss" adventure.

We booked through the cruise ship and ended up with Taquan. It was our first sea plane experience and we loved it.  I thought the music and information they had going on the headset was great, the pilot was very nice and informative and pointed out little details to us like the sea lions and potential wild life and the guide that met us (we did bear watching at a little island) was really great as well.  We all got little certificates at the end too, which the kids loved.  All in all, we had a very pleasant experience and would do it again in a heartbeat

We had booked this excursion through our cruise and it  certainly came in as advertised. The people there were extremely helpful and considerate, especially when it came to our pilot friend being given the ''co-pilot'' seat. A treat for him and great scenery for everyone.

review_title: Amazing experience of a life time
review_text: We have just returned from a trip to Alaska and our float plane trip over the Misty Fiords was just magical a high light of our trip fantastic. We had a wonderful young lady pilot who was just brilliant . Highly recommend this company very professional.

Very professional and friendly staff. We had the Polk in tour, after a 20 minutes flight, We saw a black bear fishing salmon in Prince of Wales's Island. Amazing nature and Very good memory of Alaska. Around 600$ for 2. Booked directly to a booth near the visitor center.

review_title: Float Plane Trip to Misty Fjords
review_text: Our Cruise Line chose Taquan Air for our Misty Fjords float plane excursion.  The Misty Fjords were beautiful, and our pilot did get us there and back safely.  However, our pilot, Mike, was the most uninterested, disengaged, least helpful guide we had our entire trip.  His total lack of engagement with our party nearly ruined the beautiful scenery.

review_title: Alaskan bear adventure by seaplane- awesome!
review_text: Super smooth fascinating flight to prince of Wales island. Pilot was polite and friendly. Fantastic experience. Guide on the island was excellent too- so knowledgeable - and we saw bears in the wild!

We booked our trip (Private Floatplane Experience - Misty Fiords) through Holland America Cruise Line. I can't begin to describe how wonderful the experience was. The staff at terminal were very friendly. Our pilot, Brent, was very knowledgeable of the area and took us on a tour of where he liked to go sight seeing. He answered all of our questions and pointed out many points of interest along the route, describing where we were and showing us on a map. We landed on a lake and he shut the engine off. We were allowed to get out on the floats and take in the impeccable view with complete serenity. He took a number of photos of us while on the lake and gave us some fascinating insight of the aircraft we were flying in and the lake we were resting on. I, myself am an aircraft mechanic and a pilot in training so I personally appreciated him answering my questions along the way. My wife and I couldn't be more pleased and you have our highest recommendation!! Thank you so much!

review_title: You can fly... You can see... You can feel...
review_text:
You can fly... During more than an hour you can see beautiful places... Canions... glaciers... When the plane take off in a lake you can feel the wind on your faces...
You must do it once at life.

Living in Asia you don't often ( ever !! ) get the chance to write a review that includes float planes and black bears in the title but I'm so glad I get to ! Our Taquan Air Tour was one of the highlights of our time in Alaska. Beautifully well maintained planes, a wonderfully friendly pilot Roger and the most incredible flight out of Ketchikan with views of the unspoiled surrounds as we flew to Prince William Island. Once there we were met by our guide Joshua and he took us bear spotting. He was hugely knowledgeable on his subject and we were lucky enough to see some Black Bears in their natural habitat including a mother and her 2 Cubs which was the highlight of the day. Reminiscing on this trip I would say it was the most amazing experience and thank you Taquan for providing me the chance to fly in a float plane and see Black Bears. It was phenomenal.

This tour actually was our back-up choice, and I have to say I was very pleased. The views of practically virgin forest and mountains were breathtaking. Taking a ride in a piece of history was also fantastic. The DeHavilland Beaver is the workhorse of the Pacific Northwest, and the opportunity to take the tour in this plane was great. We took off and landed on the water. We were in the air for about an hour and got to enjoy an all-you-can-eat crab leg feast at the conclusion of this tour. Pricey, but would absolutely do again.

This tour was great fun, flying in a Float Plane is a brilliant experience.  Once at rain forest we had a superb guide Joshua he was incredibly well informed.  The day we arrived was the first day the salmon had come up river and we saw hundreds jumping.  Unfortunately the bears had not yet picked up the scent so we didn't see any.  It was still a brilliant trip.

Our pilot was great. The views were unbelievable and we just couldn't get enough!  The ride lasted 2+ hours and we could have gone all day!  The pilot did land the plane on the water once and we all had the option to get out & stand on the foats. I would go again in a heartbeat.

Our pilot was great. The tour was awesome with pilot narration. He was friendly and informative. The scenery is amazing .  We loved getting out of the plane and standing on the float plane on a beautiful lake. It was a great tour and I highly recommend it.

review_title: Amazing Float Plane and Bear Excursion
review_text:
What better way to go view bears feeding than by float plane?!!!

Awesome experience flying in a float plane. We were all very tentative at the experience. Our pilot had a great sense of humor and was very reassuring. The cabin itself is noisy, but the head phones help a lot. The take off and landings are very subtle and better than that of a commercial airliner.

Our pilot was awesome and even circled back when he saw a couple of humpback whales near the surface, giving us a very unique and awesome view of the whales.

The bear excursion to Tongass National Forest was amazing. The bears were in full feeding mode at the man made salmon ladder. There were several eagles around the area. On our walk down the path to the ladder, we spotted a bear on the edge of the path. We cautiously walked around to get to the viewing platform by the salmon ladder. FYI, these are all black bears. In total, there were five bears, and a mom with two cubs. Awesome family experience!

review_title: Incredible float plane and bear viewing experience!
review_text: We saw bears and more bears fishing for salmon straight out of the stream! We saw beautiful eagles soaring right over the bears interested in their salmon. The pilot was incredible! The scenery during the flight was fabulous! The guide, once we got to the island to see the bears was terrific, and the beautiful forest and scenery on our hike were great, too! This was a great excursion! Whole family loved it!

I was a little afraid of doing this, however our pilot was very reassuring and provided extremely smooth take offs and landings.  It was amazing to see our cruise ship from the air and then to fly into the Misty Fjords National Park was absolutely breathtaking.  I have to say that landing on a lake was probably the scariest part - but only because I chose to get out and stand on the floats.  It was very unstable and the water was ice cold, so I absolutely didn't want to fall in!  I wouldn't have missed it though and enjoyed every minute!!

Huge thanks to Pilot Dan and the wonderful conservationist for a once in a lifetime adventure. Great 20 minute flight in to the Tongass forest and a breathtaking time watching black bears catching salmon in their own habitat.

Taquan Air flying to the Misty Fjords was awesome.  The pilot does a little bit of talking but you put on headphones & most of it is pre-recorded.  It had rained earlier that day (no surprise for Ketchikan) so there were a lot of little waterfalls and as our pilot was coming around to the Misty Fjords the song playing through the headphones just gave me chills.  It is gorgeous.

Always felt safe (I got to sit up front, hubby in the back which he loved for taking beautiful pictures)

Best thing I did in Ketchikan. Amazing views with narration and music. Flight and landing were very smooth. Pilot did not say anything, but was friendly and courteous. He did land in a remote lake and let us get our and take photos. It was just breathtaking.

Such beautiful scenery!  Such a wonderful company - full of people who seem to love their jobs and take really good and friendly care of their customers.  Went up over Misty Fjords with "Captain Dan" who was fabulous and very knowledgeable and put us all (five women!) at ease.  I had the distinct pleasure of riding in the co-pilot's seat which was a genuine thrill.  I will never forget this adventure or the people who made it possible.  As much as I enjoyed my trip and (amazingly) was not afraid, I couldn't help but remember the lives lost on a similar expedition (different company) a few weeks before.  My thoughts were certainly with their families and loved ones, and I appreciated even more our pilot's care of us.

Adoramos este passeio, simplesmente incrível! Confesso que no começo estava com um pouco de medo mas quando terminou o briefing film e conhecemos o nosso piloto Dan, ele foi muito amável, mostrou ser bastante experiente e passou total segurança. Ele fez o vôo sobre os fjords bem confortável descrevendo cada parte com muitas informaçōes e detalhes pitorescos da região, enquanto tocava uma trilha sonora de fundo para vistas extasiantes. Foi excelente!

review_title: To fly or not to fly - after the accident a week before
review_text: Holland America had cancelled the booking we had made and paid for because of the accident a few days earlier which left 8 tourists and their pilot dead in a crash on a windy rainy day. Now we were offered a ride on a sea-plane (a float plane which we had never before experienced)  with a different company, Taquan Air Tours - and we decided to go on a breathtakingly beautiful day with not one wisp of mist on the misty fjord tour. We landed safely on a lake who knows where - my hubby and I did not get out for the daring photograph taken while balancing on the float planes frame. Although I heard not one word through the ear phones, I had a marvellous time all the while deeply conscious of the tragedy a week earlier. I have poured over the dozens of perfect photographs I took - not a bear in sight but we did see some mountain goats which I did not know counted as wild animals. And a bald eagle cruised by to check us out. Although my hubby has difficulty maneuvering in and out of such planes, he was given every assistance and shown great kindness by our fine pilot. This magnificent flight was one of the highlights of our two weeks in Alaska.

The pilot was wonderful. You could tell he loves his job!  Misty Fjords is a breathtaking excursion.  Would definitely recommend seeing this monument by seaplane.  Staff were accommodating.  Pilot landed the plane and let's you exit the plane while in "the cup."

We took a tour of the Misty Fjords area with a Taquan float plane expedition.  Our pilot clearly loved the area and gave us great views of the area before setting down for a brief float on a lovely mountain lake.  This is a terrific way to see the area.

Good value for the money. Spent a lot of time flying over the fjords. Pilot was outstanding. Smooth, smooth, smooth, liftoff and landings.
