I am not a flyer, but my husband is, and I knew he would enjoy this. I was green about 10 minutes into it, and was truly sad about that, but that is no fault of the pilot. He was really good about it and after the lake landing strapped me in the front seat and helped me get the window down. The company went out of their way to accommodate our other excursion and get us delivered where we needed to be on time. Highly recommend them.

Took the tour with my mom and dad.  Very professional folks.  Very knowledgable pilots and overall great experience.  I left my pricy sunglasses on the plane. I called and was fully prepared to pay for them to mail them to me They said don't worry about it.  Really nice touch guys. Thank you very much

We were thrilled with our flightseeing tour with Taquan Air Tours.  I am sorry I don't remember our pilot's name but he was a retired Navy pilot and he did a really great job.  He added his own special knowledge and flair to the narration and gave us a wonderful tour of the beautiful scenery.  One of our group was a first time flyer in a small plane, much less a floatplane and he gave her a great introduction to the adventure.  I would recommend this to everyone who wants an amazing view of some majestic Alaskan scenery.

We weren't with a cruise line (came in in the ferry) and Taquan went out of their way to pick us up and drop us off. Jim our pilot was great.   He explained and pointed out lots of interesting sights.   The weather was awesome.  Their office folks were well organized!   Thank you for being a professional organization!!

There is no real way to describe the majesty of Misty Fiords.  The views are absolutely stunning.  The pilot will point out certain things along the flight along with a pre-recording of a lady talking about Misty Fiords.  We also were able to listen to pre-arranged soundtracks that are a nice background music while you're getting lost in the surroundings.  The staff are friendly, facilities are clean and the airplane ride was smooth.  I would absolutely recommend this tour as a must do while you are in Ketchikan.  You are there to see Alaska after all, and how beautiful Alaska truly is.  Happy flightseeing!
The Pilot was amazing and the  views were incredible.  The ride in the float plane was safe and comfortable.  Highly recommended!
Had 8 total folks in our group, we rode in their Cessna Caravan aircraft and saw spectacular views of Tongass.  Crew was very friendly and professional.  A+ experience!!

review_title: Landing on a serene mountain lake
review_text: For my wife's special birthday celebration we decided to take a break from our Alaska Cruise and decided to take a tour of the fjords around Ketchikan with a small Otter seaplane.  What I wonderful experience, especially for me in the co-pilot seat.  Landing on the lovely lake in the mountains was a unique experience that we will not forget.  Although the weather was getting a little turbulent, the pilot was very accommodating and provided us with a scenic tour and accompanying narration.

review_title: WOW - WOW - WOW -  This was my #1 excursion during my 7-day Alaskan cruise
review_text:
We did the Misty Fjords tour.  Family of 5 (mother, father, kids - 11, 7 & 5).  We were fortunate and had the plane to ourselves (plus the pilot).  It looks like the plane would hold 7 people + pilot.  One passenger rides, "shotgun" in the co-pilot seat.  We had a large group go, and they even took a 1-year old up.

You meet at their, very comfortable, building, watch a safety video, then are escorted to the dock by your pilot to your plane.  Our pilot, Brentwood, was very experienced, safe, knowledgeable, and really engaging.  I felt incredibly safe.  I think the planes are powered by 9-cylinder engines.  LOTS of torque.  I couldn't believe how effortlessly the plane got airborne.

You fly about 30 minutes out, land in a remote lake, walk out onto the pontoons for about 15 minutes, then take off and fly back to the dock.

We flew at 3K feet.  The views were beyond words.  "Stunning, beautiful, breath-taking, spectacular", I could go on and on.  I will never forget this excursion.

Some of the views may make the queasy a little shaky, but the experience will be worth it.  Even though you're flying at 3K feet, some of the mountains you'll fly over will look like you're clearing them by only a couple hundred feet.  Flying into the valley to land on the lake made my wife a little uneasy, but she was happy to do it.

Our 5-year old son fell asleep ten minutes into the trip.  He never woke up for the landing/take-off on the lake, or the landing back by the dock.

review_title: Taquan Air Great Tour but don't appreciate the dishonesty
review_text:
When we arrived in Ketchikan on Tuesday, June 23, 2015, it was a beautiful day so we decided to book a seaplane excursion of the Misty Fjords.  We ended up at Taquan Air and everyone was friendly and they showed us a safety video and told us that Taquan Air had a 100% safety rating.  This eased my nerves. Due to the company overbooking, our group of 7 people had to go on the Cessna Caravan, a very nice plane, a little bigger than the DeHavilland Beaver (my husband was disappointed we didn't fly the Beaver but loved the Caravan), and our pilot, Kevin, was wonderful and gave us an amazing tour of the Misty Fjords and landed on a beautiful lake where we were able to get out on the pontoons.  This excursion was a highlight of our trip to Alaska until two days later when we heard about the tragic crash of a seaplane doing the exact same excursion where all 9 people on board perished.  I reassured myself that Taquan Air had a better safety record than ProMech Air, until I came across the below article.

The article made me feel betrayed by Taquan Air, and stupid for not doing more of my own research. The Cruise Lines and the tour companies seem to be too driven by profits that they may not cancel flights when necessary due to bad weather and are enticed into telling customers lies about their safety records so people won't back out of excursions.  I still would've taken the flight had Taquan told me about the 2007 incident, but now I'll never fly with them again.

I'm giving a rating of 3 (wish it could be 2 1/2) because the Pilot, Kevin, was amazing and he seemed like an excellent pilot and made everyone feel very comfortable and deserves 5 stars, but the companies dishonestly about the crash in 2007 deserves ZERO stars.

Alaska News
As Southeast Alaska plane crash victims' life stories emerge, so do echoes of 2007 accident
Nathaniel Herz
June 27, 2015
He cited the 2007 crash that also happened during a tour of Misty Fjords, which an NTSB report a year later blamed on pilot error and inadequate supervision of the Southeast Alaska tour industry by the Federal Aviation Administration. Subsequent recommendations by the NTSB included the installation of webcams in the area and special weather training for tour pilots. 

2007 Misty Fjords crash

Weather in Ketchikan the day of the crash was unsettled, with scattered showers and wind gusts hitting 26 mph.

“Equally impressive are the flight challenges posed by such dramatic terrain and volatile weather conditions,” the filing said.

In the 2007 crash, Ketchikan’s Taquan Air Service had sent three planes on Misty Fjords flight tours.

All three planes were flying through a shallow mountain pass known as “the cut.” The first plane made it through and the third plane’s pilot turned around and took a different route after running into what he described as a “wall of weather” — rain, fog and low clouds — according to news reports.

The second plane, a de Havilland Beaver, crashed in a box canyon and slid 250 feet down an embankment. All five people aboard were killed.

The pilot, 56-year-old Joseph Campbell, had 25 years of commercial aviation experience, but only seven hours of flying experience in Alaska when he was hired by Taquan to fly that summer.

We arrived by the Millenium cruiseship and booked this tour. We made a flight in a small floating airplane with total 6 including captain. We made a terrific flight over the mountaintops covered in snow. We landed on a beautifull lake and took pictures standing on the flooters. It was a super experience and worth the money!

This airline is truly exceptional.  Booked through Oceania Cruise, it couldn't have been better.  The pilot was very courteous, warm and explained details about the scenery as we passed over it.
He smoothly landed on a small lake and we were able to stand on the pontoons for a break.  When he again took off he excelled at quickly climbing the very high mountains, took us in over a ridge to see bears.

review_text:
First of all book with another airline ,there's lots.We booked our trip through the web and were told to meet at the sunshine sign outside the tourist information centre in Ketchikan at 3pm, flying at 3-30'we were sent a photo to clarify the place.
Our ship docked at 2.30 right next to an information centre,but there was no sunshine sign,so we walked 10 mins into the centre found another tourist information centre with the sunshine sign.the only problem been was the information centre photo was of a difference appearance.
We waited here to be picked up,as after making inquiries we were sure we had found the right place.at 3-25 we were becoming very anxious as no one had picked us up,and we were due to fly in 5 mins.we noticed other people been picked up from other companies and taken to a car park in the distance,so my husband walked over and found a mini bus with the name of the our  airline on it.

When we arrived even more worried at this point,my husband asked the girl on reception why we hadn't been collected ,she did not give us an answer,and my husband tried to explain why we were so anxious ,wrong time,apparently we didn't fly until 4pm not 3.30 pm, and incorrect photo provided,At this moment  another woman who we believe was called Patsy,stepped in and told us ,you have an old photo,we explained "that's the one we were sent, and the time" her reply ,"well that's your faults for booking through a 3rd party, but gave no explanation to why we weren't picked up,then she said ,well why didn't you phone us,but it was on answer phone ,was our answer ,so she replied "well what's your problem your here now , Go Fly!,, "in a very sarcastic,aggressive manner,then went into a glass office and starred at us,the young girl behind the reception did apologise and said she would ring the 3rd party and tell them that they had given us an old photo and the wrong time to meet.
We did have a lovely flight with a lovey pilot called Sam,his kindness and lovely personality made a terrible experience thanks to the rude, awful woman, into a great experience and to not spoilt the whole episode, which we' d had the privelidge of paying for ruined.
But the worse was then to come,she was waiting for us when we came back,and said "I will take these people back,"she never spoke to us just opened the van door and stared at us.It obviously wasn't her position to drive the mini bus ,but we soon found out why,she took us back to our ship,and not to the Sunshine shine sign where we were told to be at for collection,when we asked her why she'd done this, bearing in mind it's a 10mins walk back into the town,a disagreement broke out,where she held the door open told  us to get out and said " I'm done" .What a terrible woman,we had travelled all that way from England, only meeting lovely people like ourselves to have the most unfortunate experience of meeting this awful bully of a woman,well we "Are done "now and won't be reading your reply.
Oh and by the way Patsy the English  defination of nice is :pleasant,good natured or kind.that certainly was not you.You did your utmost to spoil it for us,but thanks to Sam you didn't .

We arrived at Ketchikan on a cruise. The flight (float plane) was pre-booked on the cruise and we couldn't have been happier. The service was wonderful, very efficient and they worked hard to make the 1 hour flight as seamless as possible. The flight included landing on the water in the fjords to appreciate the tranquillity and beauty from water level as well as from the air. All lovely and efficient. Highly recommended.

review_title: Cruise Excursion - Taquan Air - Misty Fjords - Spectacular views from a Seaplane!
review_text: We had a wonderful time on our cruise excursion flying to the Misty Fjords on Taquan Air.  The views from our seaplane were spectacular and we loved landing on a lake in the fjord.  It was so peaceful and the scenery was breathtaking...walking onto the pontoons to take photos was a lot of fun.  The only drawback was our pilot.  He was very competent but did not provide a lot of commentary on what we were seeing or where we were flying.  This is a highly recommended cruise excursion....if you can afford it!

Very professional pilot. It was a smooth ride. Our pilot gave us a wonderful tour. I'm a bit of a nervous flyer, height issues & I felt very comfortable in the beaver aircraft. I sat in the second seat behind the pilot. My son flew shotgun.

As first-time-and-maybe-only-time Alaska visitors (via cruise ship), we signed up for an excursion romantically called “Misty Fjords by Floatplane” at Ketchikan.  Wow, we are SO glad that fancy title materialized as Taquan Air on a day that was beautifully clear (duh, “misty” sounds really great, but you wouldn’t be able to see much if it were really misty…).

Anyway, we were loaded onto busses at the dock, had a short and well-narrated drive through Ketchikan, and delivered to the floatplane terminal. After the safety video we were divided into groups of (about) six, introduced to our pilot (Chad), and walked down to the waiting plane.  What happens next will probably vary, depending on your plane and pilot, but in our case the seating was: first row = pilot and one guest, second row = two guests; third row = two guests, back row = 1 guest. Chad asked who wanted to ride shotgun with him, and two guests, who happened to both be pilots themselves, asked for that seat. No problem: we made a planned stop halfway through the flight, and the two pilot-guests got to trade places. Actually any of us could have changed places, but there was no need; every seat is a window seat!

Our plane was equipped with two-way headphones, so we got to hear Chad’s enthusiastic and knowledgeable description of the pretty awesome scenery - and the bonus technical questions-and-answers between Chad and the two pilot-guests.  Not every flight would be that lucky. We had helicoptered in Skagway, taken the gondola in Juneau, but this scenery was the most spectacular of any that we had seen.

About halfway through the flight Chad spotted a nice landing spot on a lake with no other people, so we made a water landing and had the option of stepping out on the pontoons and/or trading places.  It’s perfectly safe,  but the idea of being surrounded by mountains and having nothing beneath you but a pontoon and sixty feet of water does give you a proper perspective on and appreciation of your wilderness environment.  I wish that we could have spent the day hopping through five or six more lakes - each one more beautiful than the last. MAJOR TIP: be sure to set your camera to movie mode for some shots; still shots are good, but movies, especially on smartphones that you’ll always have with you when you get back home, are the only way to capture the changes in the landscape - and of course your take-offs and landings. 

Happy landing back at the dock, back to the busses, and back to the cruise ship.

review_title: Great tour of the Misty Fjords
review_text: This was my second time taking a seaplane tour in Ketchikan. Being a pilot myself, I love getting a ride in a DeHavilland Beaver, great airplane! Our pilots name was Ryan, very personable, great knowledge of the area, and made the experience very pleasant. Be prepared to take alot of pictures, the plane flys snow enough to capture great shots of the monument. It is the cheapest cost in the area for aerial tours and they have a great fleet of aircraft. Make sure to go on a day when the weather is not too windy if you're not used to flying in a small plane.

If you have never experienced flying in an authentic, historic float plane (sea plane) then you should not miss this trip out to the misty fjords. Flying over the enormous Tangass national forest our pilot, Brentwood with 'just' 47 flying years, made us all feel completely at ease as he guided the plane up over snow topped mountains and eventually dropped down and landed on Nooya lake. Whilst sitting on the lake the tranquility left us with a lasting memory of a wonderful experience.

This was my second time on the Misty Fjords tour at Taquan. Being a pilot myself, I always enjoy flying on the DHC-2 Beavers, great airplanes! The flight around Ketchikan to the monument is such an amazing sight. Slow enough to grab alot of great pictures. Our pilot was Ryan, great guy, very familiar with the area. I would recommend this company for a sightseeing flight, and they have several to choose from. They are also the cheapest in the area price wise.

One of the best things I have ever done in my life. So amazing and so gorgeous of views. It makes the world seem so small. No matter the cost you must take this trip especially if it is the only time you will be there. Once in a lifetime. The people there were great. We booked thru a cruiseline and they were right to use them. Professional and organized. The pilot was nice and knowledgeable. I went by myself as others in my group were scared to take the flight. When I got back and told them the amazing sights and they all wished they went with me instead. MUST DO!!

We did a sea plane tour of the misty fjords during our Disney cruise recently, culminating in a crab feast at the George Inlet lodge. The float plane part of the experience with Taquan air was amazing, and felt completely one of a kind. Taking off and landing on water is an experience in itself (if you have never been on a floatplane before like my family). Scenery was amazing, the staff were friendly and every passenger on board throughly enjoyed the WHOLE experience.
The only thing that stopped this review getting 5 stars is the pilot did not really communicate with us during the flight. The headphones played music and a running commentary on board, which was fair enough and quite interesting. However when we landed and disembarked the pilot asked us "Did you say the family of bears on the ground??". None of us had (too much else to see)....so we all were thinking why didn't he point them out to us while flying.
Apart from that he was very professional and friendly and made my son feel very special helping on and off the plane (a big over the shoulder carry as he disembarked which brought a HUGE smile).
I would recommend Taquan air tours without question. A flight with them will definitely be a highlight of your Alaskan vacation.

review_title: Spectacular Scenery, Professional Guides & Outstanding Services
review_text: This is a must do excursion if you are in Ketchikan Alaska.  Outstanding service from the time you leave the cruise ship port to boarding the plane and back.  These guys will transport you and your group from the port to their office, present a short orientation and off you go.  Make sure you have fresh batteries and ample space in your camera and phone because the views are spectacular.  I left my camera in the plane and did not realize it until we arrived in Juneau.  Made a phone call to Taquan Air and the pilot recovered my camera and mailed it back to my home address.  This represents outstanding service, thank you guys very much!  I highly recommend this excursion as you will not be disappointed!!!  Thank You, Larson

Another great Alaskan experience this time by Taquan Air and I felt completely safe....they have a great safety introduction before the flight. Landing on the lake and walking on the floats was spectacular and an awesome experience. The serenity and beauty of the lake was unbelievable. I was waiting for a bear to come out of the forest near the plane while we were on the lake. It really does showcase the Alaskan wilderness and flying allows you to experience more of it and get a sense of the vastness and beauty of this spectacular area. Highly recommended.

We decided to take a sea plane tour of Misty Fjords National Monument during a recent cruise stop in Ketchikan. What a treat this was. So beautiful and so unique to see it from above. We did one additional landing and take-off from within the monument area which we enjoyed. I highly recommend Taquan Air Tours - friendly, professional, and honest.

We flew in a float plane over the mountains around Ketchikan and landed in a fjord. We got to get out of the plane and stand on the pontoon while in the water.  IT WAS SO COOL!!  The mountains and water is so beautiful. Our pilot, Jake, was professional and knowledgeable.  This is a once in a lifetime excursion and definite MUST DO!

As a nervous flyer I was reluctant to take this tour, but figuring I'd probably not be in Alaska anytime soon, I'd better do it. So glad I did! Taking off and landing in the float plane was not at all scary. The scenery at Misty Fjords was so breathtakingly beautiful. Our pilot was informative and nice. Do it---you'll be glad you did!

We were blessed with a beautiful clear sunny day. Staff very friendly and knowledgeable. We had a beautiful scenic flight and got to lake in a lake in the national monument. Well worth the cost. P.S. Check out the tour saver Alaska app. It saved us a bundle of quite a few tours

What a relaxing beautiful flight! We flew over waterfalls and landed on a gorgeous lake where we got out and stood on the pontoons. The pilot really knew what he was doing plus he was super hot! Too bad ladies he's married. :)

review_title: Fantastic Float Plane Aerial Tour of Misty Fjords
review_text: I flew in a small (6-8 people) Dehaviland Float Plane.  Absolutely fabulous experience, lasting about 90 minutes, including a water landing near a small island and chance to take photos. Not something to try if you don't like flying in a small plane or clambering over the floats to gain access to the plane, but the flight and landings were smooth and the views were great, including commentary from a friendly and knowledgable pilot. The best value and most enjoyable excursion I found in Ketchikan.

I had to temporarily restrain my wife and daughter in order to get load them aboard the small  Dehavilland Beaver, I appreciate the pilot and ground crew for their assistance in the matter. Once airborne we were able to remove the straight jackets and I believe they actually had a vey memorable time. I think they where in awe, as was I, by the unbelievable beautifully desolate and cold landscape unfolding before their eyes. There are no words to describe an experience like this. Taquan Air, loved the beautiful Beaver, professional outfit, great well seasoned pilots, no worries. If you can swing it, get off the Boat and bargain hunt, it won't be cheap (it's an airplane......in Alaska) but you can deal a little if your reasonable.
Had a great time. Great staff and pilot. The views were amazing. Well worth the money and time! If you're in the Ketchikan area please visit these folks. You'll have a blast!

This was the most expensive trip we took as a family of 4. It was well worth it though. We were referred by some friends who had cruised earlier in the summer. The fjords are amazing and the pilot spent extra time answering our kids' questions.

One of the most memorable tours in our travels over many years.  We boarded a DeHaviland Beaver (Floatplane) for our flight into the Misty Fjords of Ketchikan with incredible anticipation.  This particular aircraft has a capacity of 6 plus the pilot.  As there were six of us it was our own private tour.  The thrill of hearing the thump thump of  the big radial engine and then lifting off effortlessly into the sky from the water was a thrill in itself.  However when we flew over some sheep and then some bears and landed on a very small lake deep into the national forest where there were no people and no roads the majesty of it all started to sink in.  Our pilot Adam, explained in detail all that we were seeing and actually landed a second time to show us a particular site that most don't see.  The steep cliffs, narrow passes, pristine lakes and of course the clouds that make up the "mist" of the Misty Fjords was just plain awesome.  Though the trip is not inexpensive, worth every penny and then some.  The personality and non scripted narration from Adam and his extremely proficient skill had everyone very relaxed and thrilled all at the same time.

Again, a trip of a lifetime and not to be missed.  Would do it all over again in a heartbeat!
Excellent service and great views.  I hate flying but I was absolutely at ease in an aircraft that was older than I am!

As part of our Celebrity Cruise-tour we took a floatplane excursion to Misty-Fjords. Our pilot for our Taquan Air tour was a retired UPS pilot who retired from Louisvilleour home town. Though it was raining in Ketchikan, as usual, it was a great day to fly. He was right we flew out of the rain and the sights were breath-taking. We landed on a small body of water that was beautifully calm with a small waterfall empting into it. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and we highly recommend this tour.

Booked this excursions for my parents, husband and myself. We were picked up at pier and bussed  to location, watched a FAA emergency briefing , assigned to a pilot and we took off! Pilot was very knowledgeable and friendly. My husband is a pilot so I wasn't  " nervous" about this excursion....BUT even if you have never flown in a small plane DO THIS if you ever have a chance!!! View is unbelievable!! Pilots are very very VERY well trained, as they also deliver mail and supplies to the out laying villages... They have lots of time in these planes.... Do not be scared! Pictures are outstanding! Loved it!

How do you describe something that takes your words away and leaves you speechless?  This was meant to be a Floatplane and Alaskan Bear excursion.  We definitely saw the floatplane.  :)  If you ever read my reviews you know that heights aren't my favorite thing - so the idea of being in a small aircraft way up high in the sky was shall we say - intimidating.  However, the folks at Taquan seem on the ball when it comes to safety and preparing you for the experience.  Our pilot was fantastic - he has been flying since 1968!  It really gave you a boost of confidence that you were in good hands.  The views were breathtaking.  Sadly, our group didn't see a single bear.  I'm not sure if the location could have been better chosen and/or monitored and rerouted based on activity - but the floatplane views and experience alone were worth the time.  Here's what made this an Excellent! experience... when our pilot heard that we had not seen a single bear he made every effort to help us find one from the sky! And we did.  We saw a bear!!

After several rainy ports we finally arrived in sunny Kethcikan.  Our flight the previous day in Skgway had been cancelled and they referred us to Taquan Air.  I was able to book an online web special and for the 6 of us it was a great savings.  
It was very easy to get the shuttle from the cruise ship, and then everything was very efficient upon arrival at Taquan air.  Our pilot, Brentwood, was experienced, and friendly and made the trip wonderful for us.  It was a beautiful late afternoon flight and the scenic views did not disappoint.  We were able to land and get out mid way.  It was one of the hightlights of our whole trip!

we had a wonderful time, saw lots of bears and really appreciated the service.

naturalists was extremely knowledgeable and helpful.

It was our first trip to the Misty Fjords and we selected Taquan Air due to their coupon in the Tour Saver book.  We booked 9 months in advance and were able to fly for a 2 for 1 rate!  

The entire staff was very professional--from the guide who picked us up at the cruise dock to the workers in the lobby of the terminal to the pilot.  I am SOOOO happy we booked with Taquan Air.  

I will tell everyone I speak to about our trip to Alaska that this flight seeing excursion is a must-do.  The fact that I got great service for a great deal was just icing on the cake!!

We were fortunate to have wonderful weather for our trip--they say that the conditions in Ketchikan are no predictor for what it will be like in the Fjords and that was totally true for us.  It was cloudy near the ocean but incredible once we got there.
What a great experience.  I was so happy that I  overcame my fears of flying in the small plane and enjoyed the trip.  It was  the best travel experiences of my life. Our pilot was great.
Roger, former crop duster from Nebraska, was a wonderful pilot/guide. We enjoyed best views, wonderful landing on lake, as well as interesting history & geology of area.

I booked the the Alaska Bear Adventure on a Holland America cruise ship. They used this company. Everything was excellent. I do believe that the company is very safety conscious, the pilot was outstanding. The aircraft was an older plane: however, it appeared to be well maintained. It did have updated electronic displays on the dashboard, etc. The plane seats 7 counting the pilot, it had a 2-2-2-1 seat arrangement. FWIW, the lighter weight people were assigned the 3 seats in the rear.  Pickup from dock, safety orientation, flight to the "bear site", bear viewing, etc. were all excellent. I was a little worried at first, for the first 10 minutes or so we didn't see any bears; however, then they started coming down to feed. There was usually one or two at a time; however, one time there were three. They would continuously come, feed, and go. Sometimes a larger one would chase a smaller one away. Overall there were plenty of bears and lots of salmon in the water. Our guide (AJ) at the "bear site" was excellent too. In case you wondered, I didn't see any restroom facilities at the "bear viewing site".

Meravigliosa escursione con deltaplano a vedere gli orsi in cattività cacciare decine di tonni. La "pilotessa" talmente brava che non mi sono accorto del decollo mentre ammiravo il panorama fantastico.  La guida A.J. cortese e disponibile a parlare lentamente è veramente preparato e competente. Breve passeggiata in un bosco incantato che a momenti è carico di tensione per i resti dei salmoni lasciati dagli orsi.  Il luogo è spettacolare 5 min di attesa e sono arrivati 4 orsi a pescare e mangiare come pochi. Nel frattempo un'aquila che si guarda anche lei lo spettacolo. Ore meravigliose e soldi spesi benissimo. Da fare assolutamente.

review_title: They Went the Extra Mile - Thank You!
review_text:
My wife, myself plus another couple tried to book a trip to Anan a few months in advance of our trip this past July.  Every float plane company we called said that we were too late to book as there are only 60 visitor permits for this park issued for each day.  All except one company and one person.  A special SHOUT OUT to Danita Scott for convincing me to trust her and her going the extra mile to make this trip happen!!  She was the only one to contact me back and inform me that 48 or 72 hours prior to the day we wanted to go 12 more permits are released and she would do all she could to obtain four permits for us.  Our group committed money down to hold a float plane that would be refundable if the permits were not obtained.  Danita and our tour guide AJ came through for us and got the permits!  Now for the rest of the story.

A van picked us outside the cruise ship and took us to the Taquan Air offices.  There we met our lovely and talented pilot Amanda (I think my name memory if right) and A.J. our guide.  Our pilot could me a model but chose to be a pilot.  Our group was glad she was our pilot.  She took us and our guide on about a 45 minute float plane ride to Anan to see bears eat salmon from the stream.  

Once arriving to the site our guide A.J. took control.  A.J. had a pistol on his hip and a shotgun on his side.  Our group was guided on about a 3/4 mile hike to an area controlled by the park to observe the bears.  There are platforms at this site over the stream and also a blind that observers get 15 minutes at a time to watch the bears up close and personal.  While we were there for a couple hours we observed over 20 different black bears coming to the stream to fish.  Eagles flying all over too.  It was AMAZING!  It was like we were in the zoo cage (platform with only rails)  and the bears were out in the open. The stream was "black" with so many salmon.   A.J. did a great job explaining all the nature in the area and some of his past experiences.  Our pilot was waiting for us after we hiked back to the start of the trail.   

There are pictures attached.  This tour is not always available since the fish do not always run the stream.  Taquan Air Tours offer other options that can be purchased.  This was one of the two top tours our group took while in Alaska for twelve days.    We are so thankful Danita Scott talked me into trusting her and Taquan Air.  You just start to wonder when you are asked to pay half in advance to someone you have never met!  

THANK YOU to everyone involved from our Iowa group!

Amazing experience where we circled around the island. Sure it was a little rainy but the plane was safe and our pilot couldn't have made us feel more secure and comfortable. For someone with a fear of planes, this was extremely pleasant and it really helped that they took so many precautions and were so patient with myself. Great ride.

We booked a wonderful trip from when we got off the ship.  Sea plane that took us to the Majestic Forge.  We ended up saving $200 not using the cruise line.  However, this is the same agency that the cruise line uses.

Very friendly and knowledgeable staff.  Pilot was very professional. Well worth the time and money.

Our family of five, from teenager to grandparents, all loved our flight to the Misty Fjords National Monument. We did this as a cruise excursion through Holland America, which called it "Magnificent Misty Fjords by Floatplane." Everything went smoothly from start to finish.

review_title: Best Tour in Alaska with Top Notch Customer Service
review_text: My family of 5 had the most amazing time flightseeing the Misty Fjords National Park with Taquan Air on our recent RC Cruise.  When we first checked in with their representative she mentioned our family may have to be split up and go on separate airplanes.  When I expressed concern about this she said they would see what they could do.  They ended up putting all 5 of us on a plane that could have accommodated 6 so they lost out on one fare to make us happy (unlike Temsco Helicopters in Skagway - split us into 2 helicopters even though we asked to go in one - they even had a helicopter there that held 5 passengers but to accommodate 6 other guests they took 2 of our lighter family members to balance the 2nd helicopter - they knew all of the weights when booking - something wrong with that picture). Anyway, I do not want to take away from my review of Taquan Air but I did want to point out, how impressed I was in comparison with that other tour company!) So we had a private tour with our amazing pilot Jim who was very professional, knowledgeable and caring.  He had 33 years experience with the company and did an amazing job- even pointed out a brown bear and a black bear to us and made sure we could see them by pointing them out with the end of the planes wing!  He also pointed out a few bald eagles! The scenery was breathtaking and we had the smoothest landing on a remote bay where we all got out onto the pontoons and took pictures (my 10 year old, 16 & 20 year olds as well as myself and my husband).  It was surreal!  At the end of the tour they gave us each a free certificate with a picture of a floatplane certifying we all flew on a floatplane in Ketchikan.  My husband purchased a Taquan Air T-shirt for the reasonable price of $19.99 and he wears it proudly. A once in a lifetime experience!  Thank you Taquan Air for taking such good care of us and providing amazing customer service!

review_title: A highlight of our Alaska trip!
review_text: This excursion is worth the money!  We did not book it on the cruise.  It was a better deal to book off the ship.  Cost per person was advertised at $225.00.  We got it for 189.00  per person if all 4 of us went.  The ride is awesome!  It takes off in the water, makes a stop in the water and then heads back.  The views are amazing!  We were gone for about 2 hours.  Our plane seated 6 passengers.  Do it.  You won't be sorry.

We flew with the mail run for 3 hours for a close-up, hands-on experience.  It was great, and the pilot was great.  We were lucky to get on a run with 5 take-offs and landings over on Prince of Wales Island.  I would highly recommend this if you have the extra time to spend.

Booked this tour at the last minute and it was one of the best decisions we made.  They came and picked us up at the cruise ship to take us to the marina.  It was overcast but still beautiful.  Our pilot Ben was very friendly and gave us a great tour.  Got to land on the water and stand on the floats to take pictures.  It's not cheap but a once in a lifetime adventure!

I don't like small planes, but I love adventure so I signed up for a Sea plane tour and crab feed. The crab was amazing, but the flight was even better. We had a beautiful day, so safety was not a concern. We flew over beautiful mountains, lakes and streams, and very close to the cliffs. The sea landing was amazing. I loved this experience. GO!

review_title: Best Way to see Misty Fjords
review_text: We decided to splurge and see Misty Fjords by air.  The Taquan Air staff were exceptionally professional and their ternimal is very nice.  The pilot was very skilled and since we had a beautiful day we were able to fly a little higher and further.  It was a gorgeous trip and we thought landing on the lake and standing on the pontoons was a fun touch.

This was our favorite excursion of our cruise. Amanda, our pilot, was great and really is an excellent pilot. AJ the guide that showed us around the Tongass forest bear viewing is also very informative and you feel safe with him knowing he's a former law enforcement officer. The former bear habitat viewing site is located down river from some falls that is a bear feeding spot. We actually spotted a bear on the second leg of the trip up to a lake the rivers feed into. 
We lucked out in their only being us (2) on the flight so it felt like a customized trip and was very comfortable with great views. The shop in Ketchikan is also very comfortable and they have a small area to pick up gear. I bought a souvenir t-shirt. They drove us back to the ship in a bus in time to make the departure. Glad someone was keeping track. :-)

We took this excursion while sailing on the Sapphire Princess from Vancouver B.C. to Whittier Alaska. Either part (float plane or bear watching) of the tour would have been great but the two combined was more than we could hope for. The flight was around 20 minutes each way with a one hour bear watching in between. We landed in a beautiful cove area where we boarded a van for a five minute drive to a trailhead. Our guide led us on a leisure  five minute walk through a rain forest to a creek where bears were feeding on the salmon as they swam upstream. The pilots were very professional yet entertaining. Our bear guide was very knowledgeable and safety oriented. Not cheap but priceless.

I must admit I hate flying.  I told this to our pilot who promised me an enjoyable flight and he was right.  Our very experienced pilot made this an experience to remember.  Beautiful scenery and smooth flying.  Would recommend this tour to everyone, even those who do not like flying.

review_title: Loved this experience from George inlet lodge
review_text: This was part of our crab feast tour to George inlet. Our cruise ship offered a tour where you bused in to have a crab feast and then scenic floatplane out. Or vice versa.  We had a lovely female pilot who looked like she loved her job.  The flight was awesome, the scenery spectacular.  Highly recommend doing.

We took Misty Fjords float plane tour during our cruise ship stop over. The flight that we had booked was cancelled due to weather; but we were given the option to either get a refund or take the next flight. We opted for the later and had a blast. 
Their entire crew was very professional and made sure we felt really comfortable. Our pilot gave us an excellent tour of the Misty Fjords and on the way back to the ship, the van driver offered to give us a tour of the town. Overall, we are very satisfied with the whole experience and would highly recommend Taquan air to any one visiting Ketchikan.
This was a great tour of Misty Fjords in a DeHavilland Beaver floatplane.  Our pilot was excellent and such beautiful scenery.  I would highly recommend this tour!

I loved this seaplane experience.  Discounted to $200... We took off and flew over beautiful mountains before landing on a secluded lake.  After getting out and snapping a few pictures from the floats we climbed back in to take off and fly over a waterfall for a breathtaking photo opportunity and then glided over mountain peaks to see a flock of mountain goats before landing in Ketchikan.  Our pilot Adam was a great guide... Although he waited until the last ten minutes to tell us we were riding in a 62 year old plane.  It must be reliable if it is still being used for tours and to transport mail for the postal service which we learned during the flight.

I will admit I didn't know anything about fjords before our float plane trip. What and amazing thing to see.  Our pilot, Brian maybe I have forgotten his name was great.  He one of the four pilots that fly for Taquan year round.  We landed on a Fjord and got our of the plane and got to stand on one of the pontoons. AMAZING!!!!   I am really scared of heights but was surprised at how well I did.   We booked our tour from the visitor information bldg on the dock and got a really good deal.

We were shuttled from our cruise ship by small coach to the plane docks.  We watched a short safety video and were placed into small groups of 5 or 6 and led to the plane by the pilot.  Our group had 6 passengers.  We listened to mood-music in our headphones most of the time.  This pilot was not particularly a "people person" by any means but did mention a few tidbits of information.   We landed on a lake and had just enough time to step out on a pontoon, take one photo and get back in the plane.  The ride back to the dock offered beautiful scenery.

After being in Alaska for about a week, we were really looking forward to our float plane ride - as we had already seen so many fly by.  We had an absolutely perfect day for flying. We took a ride back from George's Inlet to the cruise boat.  Our pilot was grumpy and not personable.  He had the ability to communicate with us via headsets - but only told us a couple things.  I am not sure how long the ride typically is - but he certainly didn't make any detours.  It was a cool experience - but a bit disappointing.  Next time (I hope there is a next time) I am in Alaska, I will definitely take another float ride - but it won't be with Taquan.

This was a very well run trip. Felt very safe and well taken care of. Picked up from cruise ship and taken to office, given safety talk and off to the plane. We were kept waiting for a while and I was concerned that our trip would be shortened accordingly but that did not happen. Pilot was very knowledgeable, funny and interesting. The landing on the lake and standing on the pontoon was memorable. Didn't see any wildlife but the scenery was awesome and it was an unforgettable experience. The only way it could have been improved would have been to have a money off coupon!

We booked our flight independently and used the Alaska Tour Savers coupon book (buy one get one free) deal. It was great!! We saved so much money compared to those who booked from the cruise companies and we loved the flight. Our pilot was very informative, professional and funny! It was my first time on a smaller airplane but I had no issues with it. You are provided a headset to block out noise and there are narratives about the region played during your trip. We even landed on the water to listen to the waterfalls and took some pictures outside the plane. It was a great experience and the highlight of our cruise!

We booked this excursion from Celebrity Solstice.  The bus for Taquan Air met us at the dock.  The driver was funny and offered some narratives about the region as we made our way to Taquan Air.
Upon arrival within 3 minutes we were called and walking out to our plane. Our pilot was Amanda and she was great.  She was very informative and pointed out areas of interest then would bank (turn) the plane so that the passengers on the other side of the plane could see the landscape as well.  
Amanda then made a water landing and let each person get out of the plane and step out on the floats.  
We then made our way back to Taquan Air.  
My son, age 8 and my husband also enjoyed this experience.  We thought all the employees at Taquan Air were efficient, professional and personable.  I agree with others on Tripadvisor that say don't miss out on a seaplane trip while in Alaska-it truly is amazing.

We had a couple of days in Ketchikan and thought that our trip with Taquan would be cancelled for sure, due to the drizzle and low clouds. However, even with the less than ideal weather we thoroughly enjoy not only the ride in the Beaver but visiting the Misty Fyord. Yup, the pilot was a little jaded from countless trips like ours and the overcast that he had to deal with but still a great trip.  Maybe it was because we loved the Enya music that the pilot had playing in our headsets while he wasn't talking to us! We enjoyed ourselves and would recommend this trip and operator, especially if you interested in aircraft like I was (Peter) and hadn't ever ridden in a float plane before. 
Cheers, Peter and Amy

Love our float plane trip to the Misty Fjords. Very professional experience with Taquan Air. Our pilot was very informative and answered all our questions while we stood on the floats in the beautiful Misty Fjords. Don't miss out on a float plane trip and I highly recommend Taquan Air.

We chose the Taquan float plane tour of the misty fiords as an excursion on our Cruise on the Holland American Zuiderdam ship. Although one of the more expensive excursions it was money well spent. The day of our trip the weather was clear and warm which made it all the more spectacular. Our pilot and guide was very informative. Take off and landing was smooth, particularly on the Fiord, where we were able to get out and to stand on the float, taking in the views and solitude of the fiord. My wife who is not a good flier, loved it, a totally different experience from big aircraft. A fantastic trip and one which we would highly recommend.

We booked this trip through our Disney cruise.  The day we went the weather was beautiful.  But Ketchikan is in an artic rain forest so I understand these tours are often cancelled.  Our pilot was telling us the day before it was pouring rain, and all flights had been cancelled.  Wind and fog are also issues, so booking a Misty Fjords flight is a bit of a gamble.

The planes are small (we had 5 passengers in our plane, all with a window view).  They are also old (our pilot explained the Dehavilland Beavers aren't manufactured anymore), but apparently folks in Alaska rely upon these planes to get around.  The pilot was very friendly, and had logged a lot of hours.  They were careful to balance our weight out.  The view from the jump seat, where my brother sat, is the best.  The Fjords are beautiful.  We saw snow covered mountains, and beautiful forests.  We saw eagles and bears down below.  The ride at times could be bumpy but the pilot was careful to adjust, and we even got a fly by over our cruise ship.  My 5 year old travelled with us...I thought for sure he'd freak out and not go through with it but he did, and pilot was very friendly and even showed my enthusiastic son all about the controls.  So all in all, a wonderful trip.

There were a few things that suprised me in our litigious society-- the safety briefing was a little short and you don't have to sign a bunch of waivers....the docks had no safety railings and a bit of a steep incline which could get slippery...we stopped at a fjord and could get out on the pontoons to look around.  It was refreshing, however, that lawyering up hasn't come to Alaska yet, so enjoy it while you can.

Great service, wonderful views, and an excited 5 year old.  A wonderful trip.  I recommend, though there is a moderate possibility your trip may get cancelled due to weather concerns, and knowing such flights are not entirely risk free.

My family of 4 (wife and 2 sons age 12 and 10) loved the sightseeing of Misty Fjords!  I was a bit nervous to fly in a small plane for this but the pilot (James) was very sensitive to our needs.  He was an excellent pilot that made the most of this experience for us.  
The views were breathtaking.  Its difficult to describe how beautiful the Fjords were.  We were a little worried that the rain in Ketchikan would dampen our sightseeing.  Within 10 minutes of taking off we were surprised to see sunshine and spectacular views!
I highly encourage anyone traveling to Ketchikan to take this tour.

Vale a pena o vôo de 30 minutos sobre o misty fiords, com direito a pouso sobre o lago de 10 minutos. Não tenha medo do avião, é muito seguro, não registro de acidente há vários anos. Vou tentar postar algumas fotos quando for aprovada a avaliação.

review_title: Amazing tour, great guides and friendly pilot !!
review_text: We chose this tour as part of a cruise excursion, KE21 Misty Fjords Sightseeing, run by Taquan Air.  The excursion was well run, the bus transfer from the pier, the prep for the plane ride.  The pilot introduced himself and got us situated into the plane by size and weight.   Everyone had a window seat and the seat belts were long enough to accommodate pretty much everyone.   There was enough air flow in the cabin that it was not stuffy for those that may get airsick.  The take-off was right on the water by the ships and we flew right over downtown Ketchikan to the bogs and fjords.  We saw bald eagles flying and landing in their nests.  Seeing the land from the air was amazing.  The pilot showed us and explained a lot about the area - it was a little hard to hear over the headset sometimes but for the most part it was okay.  We landed in a large Fjord and were able to get out of the plane and stand on the float and look around.  It was awesome.   We loaded back up and flew back.  We had great weather there but hit a weather front on the way back so it was a bit rough.  The pilot got us through that and safely landed us to the dock.  A great trip and recommended!!

review_title: Great way to see the misty fjords
review_text: Bush pilot Mike in his Dehavilland Beaver took us for a 75 minute flight.  Lots of great pictures.  Please note the plane is not built for comfort.  It's accommodating but not luxurious.  I experienced nothing to complain about.

review_title: Classic Misty Fjords Flightseeing Taquan Air - Rude Pilot Behavior
review_text: I did this excursion today on 06/20/2013 and I had a bad experience on this ride which I would like to share especially from the pilot of of our float plane.  First of all he tried to accommodate 6 people on the plane and I was asked to sit all the way in the back where there was no cushion for your back.  My back is still hurting.  Taquan air says guaranteed window seats but they do not tell you that their back seats do not have cushions on it.  The reason I did not create a fuss on the spot was because that was the last tour and my ship was leaving in 1 hour and there was no other tour available so us it as an advice and if you book it through Taquan air make sure to ask at the counter that they are not asking you to sit in the back.  I forgot the name of the pilot but he was the oldest pilot in their team and it was my bad luck that I had to fly with him.

review_title: MUST SEE Misty Fjords by Taquan Air
review_text: If you had to pick one thing to experience while in Ketchikan Alaska you must see the Misty Fjords by float  plane!  Taquan Air is the place.  A warm welcome and big smile will welcome you at the docks.  A quick drive thru town brings you to the float plane docks.  As you enter the facility the office staff was welcoming, friendly and organized (no waiting!).  Brentwood was our pilot we felt at ease and safe immediately with his experience.  He had a quick wit and his knowledge of the area was appreciated.  Landing on the pristine lake was breathtaking, we didn't even feel the touch down on the water it was that smooth!  This experience is at the top of our travels list, a spectacular well spent couple of hours!

review_title: Great way to see the fjords
review_text: Had a great trip with Taquan air.  Our pilot was safe and showed us the wonderful beauty of the Misty Fjords.  Would do again, flight was safe but we did get queasy (forewarning) just from what it is.  What a great experience.  Great pictures fun took our kids would highly recommend.  People at Taquan were nice kind and safe
100% worth it. The Fjords were amazing and I really enjoyed the landing on the lake. I was afraid the fog would hinder the experience, but only made the photos even more mystical and Alaskan.

review_title: Our Crab Fest Flight was awesome!
review_text:
We (2 adults & 2 10 year old boys) did the crab feast on our Disney cruise last summer. We booked the crab fest flight through DCL for our excursion in Ketchikan.
So glad we did. We were picked up at the ship and taken to their "air port"/docks.
Our pilot (I REALLY wish I had written down his name Dave or Dan maybe) was just AWESOME!
The office staff was so friendly and helpful as well. 
My son still has the float planes he bought in the gift shop in his room.
We boarded our float plane and took off for the flight. Our son was even allowed to be the co-pilot!
Our pilot was so so knowledgeable during our flight and shared do much fantastic information on what we were seeing.
We arrived at George Inlet Lodge for our crab feast. (separate review)
If ever back in Alaska I would definitely book with these guys again for a tour!

review_title: Memory of a lifetime - Float Plane Bear Adventure
review_text:
What a great experience this 2-3 hour trip was.  In mid-August 2012, my wife and I went on a float plane trip with Taquan Air Tours to Prince of Wales island about 30 minutes from Ketichan.  It was a beautiful clear and calm day.  We then took a short ride and hike to see bears hunting for salmon swimming up stream.  

It was great to experience this in person after seeing it on TV many times.  What an incredible time this was.  Got lots of great pictures to re-live the memories.

The company was very professional.  Pilot answered all the questions we had during flight over and back. The bear expert was also interesting and knowledgable.

This was the best activity we did on our two week trip to Alaska.

We booked this excursion using the Alaska Tour Saver coupon and got a BOGO deal.  Awesome experience.  We were blessed with beautiful weather the day of our flight, which was great since most days in Ketchikan are rainy.  Shuttle was awaiting our cruise ship as promised and took us to the office.  Very professional and well organized.  Our pilot was great, we had a plane with one other couple.  Scenery was spectacular, much different than other spectacular scenery we had seen elsewhere in Alaska.  Landing on the lake was really cool.  I'm not a great flyer, but felt completely safe the entire trip.  Definitely recommended.

Booked through Carnival Spirit, September 2012.  This is a great tour and one of the highlights of my cruise.  Definitely worth the money to see Alaska from the air.  We had a beautiful sunny day in Ketchikan which is apparently somewhat rare.  It was really neat to land the floatplane on a remote lake and step out onto the floats.  Flight time was about 90 minutes.  My minor complaints are that the pilot did not say a word the whole tour (no explanation of bearings, etc) and the office staff were not overly friendly.  Overall, a great experience though.

Our private air excursion on Taquan Air in a DeHavilland Beaver was definitely a highlight of our Alaska trip.  We had a gorgeous day, and the views of Misty Fjords were terrific.  We landed in Walker Cove and had a chance to climb out on the floats and look around.  Our pilot, Dan, was excellent and provided just the right amount of commentary.  The music on the intercom was quite suitable and added to the viewing experience.  The take-offs and landings were very smooth.  Dan also took some great pictures of us at the side of the Beaver after we returned to the base.  It was a great trip!

I  flew Taquan Air on 7 August 2012 and found it an excellent experience.  The company is very professional.  We flew to a site about 50 miles north of their base and landed.  We were met at the dock with a van that took us about a mile to a path we would take to watch the bears.

Our guide knew the history of Alaska, its plants, and its animals.  I felt very safe with him around.  And, we saw bears eating at a waterfall.  I got some great movies of this experience, one I will always remember.

So, use them or not is the question.  I say use them.

These guys know what they're doing. We booked our trip through Princess Cruises and were very well cared for. The flight was very smooth; I understand it's usually raining here but we had a rare dry day. Our pilot was great.  Takeoffs and landings were incredibly smooth. I have a pilot's license and have some seaplane training so I really appreciated our pilot's skill. 

The views are astounding. This is a "must-see" flight!

Our flight seeing trip of Misty Fjord's National Monument was on a very drizzly, somewhat chilly day. We were picked up in a van at the cruise ship terminal and taken to where Taquan air has their planes take off. We watched a safety video and then boarded our plane. We had headsets on so that we could hear the pilot and hear a recorded commentary of the history and features of the area. Even though it was raining, it was beautiful and "misty". We landed on a lake and got to step out on the floats to take pictures. It was absolutely serene - quiet and gorgeous. I highly recommend this tour.

review_title: Even the rain didn't spoil it
review_text: A great trip by seaplane with Taquan. We flew over the mountains to the fjords, landed on the lake, walked on the floats.  Great commentary from our pilot & even though it drizzled & the clouds were low, the scenery was spectacular.  Pricey but worth every penny!

We had a great flight out over the Misty Fjords the  scenery was spectacular - Dave our pilot was very Knowlegable -we landed on a very scenic fjord,Dave took all our pictures then had a great flight back to base- all our group were very pleased with this operator. Recommended.
I have a debilitating fear of flying, but our pilot instilled a great sense of confidence before we took off. the flight was smooth and perfect. I would definitely do it again.

review_title: Great trip even through the mist
review_text: We booked this tour apart from the cruise (used the Tour Saver) and really enjoyed it.  The facility was very nice and I felt totally comfortable on the docks.  Our pilot, Mike, was very friendly and informative without being overly chatty.  Great tunes on the headset the whole way.  We were up on a very misty day but were lucky to avoid rain.  Mike landed us in a secluded cove and we were able to get out of the plane for a couple of pictures.  I would absolutely recommend this trip to anyone and wouldn't hesitate to use this company again.

review_title: Not a good pilot or company
review_text: The pilot was exceeding the  visibility requirements on our tour. I thought this was a safety concern.  I probably wouldn't recommend this company.

Taquan Air was a great choice. This is a big operation. Very Professional.They have 5 or 6 planes, a big dock and check in/waiting room. The flight was beautiful. We went to the Misty Fjords where he landed in a cove, we got out on the pontoons, took pics, & flew back a different route. There are alot of choices of planes that do this and I chose Taquan because I could use my 2  for 1 coupon from my Toursaver Book.But after seeing all the others, I think they have the best planes & biggest operation. We felt very safe with a competent pilot.

review_title: A Misty Day at the Fjords
review_text:
We recently took a flight seeing trip to Misty Fjords with Taquan Air.  We chose this company because of the B1G1 free coupon offered in the Toursaver coupon book.  I really didn't know what to expect but the company was very professional and well run.  We were picked up at the ship and driven to the office.  It was a really nice and professional looking office.  It looked like a pretty big scale operation (I think I was expecting a mom and pop type of office).  We watched a video and soon were on our way.  They had several planes running that day and we were with another couple on our plane (so just 4 of us).  We took off and headed past the town of Ketchikan (and our ship) to Misty Fjords.  It lived up to it's name.  It was misty but it was also beautiful.  There was turquoise water, steep granite cliffs, waterfalls and even a rainbow.  We landed on the water in the middle of one of the fjords and got out on the float for a few minutes. The pilot did a wonderful job on the take offs and landings.
The negatives for me were several.  Most were not a big deal but I want you to know what to expect.  
I was in the back of the plane and it was FREEZING, and I don't say that lightly.  The seals around the door were non-existant and it made for a very uncomfortable ride.  On the way back I rode in the front and it was warm up there.
My stomach was also revolting the entire way.....especially on the way back.  I would definitely take some dramamine.  It is better to be safe than sorry.  I was eyeing that sea sickness bag and praying I wouldn't have to reach for it.  I kept staring at the horizon and breathing really deep.  Kind of took a little away from the trip for me.
Lastly, (but also initially)...when we excited our cruise ship and went to meet them where the map indicated, we also called them and let them know we were there.  We waited and waited.  Finally, someone from the port came up and asked if we needed help.  We told him who we were waiting on and he indicated that they were in a different spot today.  We went over there and the driver told us it was a good thing we showed up because he was about to leave us.  When I shared with him that we were waiting in the correct spot and that we had even contacted the main office and let them know where we were he said that he didn't answer his cell phone so he couldn't have known this.  This irritated me and I would have been extremely upset if we had been left behind...but we weren't so bigones and all that.  Just be aware. (0therwise the company was really professional and I blame the driver, not the company)
I thought the fjords were very pretty.  They didn't blow me away like some of the reports I read.  I don't know if it is because we are from Colorado or if it is because we have seen some amazing places like this before (or because I was green to the gills :)) but it wasn't my favorite thing in Alaska we did.  Once again, not a reflection on the company (that I am reviewing) at all.  Except for the "mix up" (see how kind I can be) at the beginning, they were great.
Hope this helps!

We took a flightseeing tour (and all-you-can-eat crab feast) during our cruise on the Sapphire Princess.  The tour group met us at the bottom of the gangway, escorted us to the lodge for an early lunch, and then we traveled back to Ketchikan during a 30-minute flight on a DeHavilland Beaver.  I had always wanted to take a flight from the water and this was a great time.  Three couples were on-board and my wife and I volunteered to sit separately.  She sat in the back and I got to fly "right-seat" with the pilot.  WHAT A THRILL!  The price for the tour was a bit high, but what a great time.

review_title: Thrill of a Lifetime. Great Flight! HAL Bear Adventure
review_text:
This was one of the best things I have ever experienced in my 60+ years.
Ethan - from West Virginia - was our wonderful pilot of the Floatplane that took us to Paradise!  Ethan made us feel very comfortable and did an amazing job showing off the Alaskan scenery and looking for whales as we headed for the dock to take a van to where black bears were feasting on salmon.  We booked thru HAL weeks before our cruise, and I believe this tour was sold out.  Safety is a HUGE factor and we were told that Taquan Air prides itself on its safety measures.  We chose wisely, and had the adventure of our lives!

Let me first state that my wife doesn't like to fly in small planes, and she was very nervous about the water part.  But being the trooper she is she agreed to go for me.  We did book this through our cruise ship and upon leaving the ship immediately boarded their bus.  We had a great informative ride to the airport and learned a lot about Ketchikan.  After a short briefing about safety and so forth we were introduced to our pilot Adam.  

Adam led us out to our plane, the only float plane you should see Misty Fjords in a DeHavlland Beaver.  If you fly in anything else you are shortchanging yourself.  We strapped in and away we went.  

The scenery. The amazing awe inspiring scenery.  Words cannot describe what you will see.  Glass lakes, waterfalls everywhere, sheer cliffs and more beauty that the mind can process.  Adam took us close up to the rock faces and through mountain peaks for an unclose view.  We then landed on a lake of smooth glass and left the aircraft to stand on a pontoon and enjoy the most quiet majestic view I have ever seen.  We saw a brown bear at a stream which fed into the lake and many bald eagles.  Departing the lake I was able to sit in the right seat next to Adam which made the flight back even better.

I didn't want this flight to end but couldn't talk Adam into it.  Once out of the aircraft my wife gave Adam a big hug and thanked him for a wonderful flight.  I'm not sure if she loved the flight or just thought he was cute.  I am thinking about taking a trip back to Ketchikan with some friends to fish and I will definitely be flying with Taquan Air Again.  By the way I take my safety seriously and so does Taquan Air.  I check out all of the float plane tours before I left for Alaska and in my opinion Taquan Air is hands down the best.

My wife and I were celebrating our 10th anniversary. We choose to go on a cruise aboard the Sapphire Princess. We did not book our sea plane through the ship. We choose to book at the dock. We saved $100 Per person and we were able to book our experience with Taquan Air Tours one hour before flying. Steve was our pilot.  I was able to sit up in the co-pilots seat and enjoyed the views.  http://www.youtube.com/user/AlaskaCruiseJuly2011?feature=mhee is a link to my channel that I have created. http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j99lWMkArhQ this video shows our experience with the seaplane.  this was our first cruise and my wife and i were very happy with the pilot and all of the people that we came in contact with Taquan Air.We would recommend them if you want a safe and straightforward flight.

review_title: Great float plane experience and bear watching
review_text: We pre- booked this bear watching experience with Taquan Air for our Ketchikan port visit. We were picked up by the Taquan shuttle at the port then given a video briefing at the Taquan office. We were then greeted by our pilot and boarded the 6 passenger float plane. The weather was sunny and water was like glass so we had perfect conditions for viewing the spectacular scenery as we flew to Prince of Wales Island for our bear watching at Traitor's Cove. Our pilot provided commentary  through our headphones, describing the scenery and history. He is a seasoned local pilot so was very knowledgeable and informative. Upon arrival at Traitor's Cove, we were greeted by the bear viewing guide who transported us by van on the short ride to the creek. There was already a black bear busy fishing in the creek and throughout our stay at the creek there were 1-2 bears busy catching the plentiful salmon. On the flight back to Ketchikan our pilot spotted 2 Humpback Whales and circled overhead for us to get a great aerial view of these giants. This was my first float plane experience and it was fantastic....flight, scenery and bears!

So, first off, yes, this is a very expensive activity, but it is so worth it.  The Misty Fjords are practically indescribable, but I'll try.  They are some of the most dramatic scenery you will get to experience up close, and doing so in a float plane allows you to see the striking contrats and juxtapositions therein: mountains running right up to the water, placid saltwater fjords, freshwater lakes buried in the mountains, waterfalls everywhere.  It is the closest you will get to feeling like you can fly, and what a wonderful place to do so!
Talk to Wendy at Taquan Air she is awesome and will help you with your bear viewing experience!!!  Thank you Wendy!!!!

We took the Misty Fjords tour - spectacular scenery. The landing in the lake and sitting in the absolute stillness was sheer bliss. We just wanted to stay the place was so beautiful. It might be perceived as expensive but this tour is worth it - please don't miss this.

I took a HAL cruise in June 2010 and booked this excursion through the ship.  The bus was there to pick us up right on time but there was a bit of a traffic jam of buses, so we got to Taquan Air a few minutes late.  There they put us through a quick safety briefing and got us out to the floatplanes.   The experience of getting into a plane that was sitting in the water and then taking off and landing on water was really difference and interesting.  I'm glad I got to try it at least once.

My plane had the pilot and three passengers. I thought that was good, it looked like the plane could hold more.  We all got a window seat, however the same person sat in the front both there and back; I think that could have been rotated since we got out at Misty Fjords.

The beginning of the flight was kind of average but once we got into Misty Fjords it was just break taking!  This does not happen to me, but I literally teared up a bit as we flew through the area, past the solid walls of granite plunging to the water.  It was just so beautiful and pure, it was really amazing.  It's just about impossible to describe.  I don't want to oversell it, but for me, I've done a lot of traveling, and few natural wonders have hit me as hard as this one.

The pilot few around a bit and pointed out a brown bear on the ground.  That happened so fast I didn't get a picture. We landed in one of the lakes and got out and stood on the pontoons of the plane.  The pilot came around and took a picture of each of us standing outside of the plane.  We had a shorter stop since our bus had been late.  Then we got back in and flew back to Taquan Air.  My only issue was that I missed some stuff that was on the same side of the plane both times, with me on the wrong side. I thought possibly we could have switched or the pilot could have gone wide so both sides could see. 

Overall, I don't know how much of a difference it makes what company you fly with.  Taquan Air was fine and I have nothing to compare them to, my five star rating has more to do with the beauty of the Misty Fjords.  They did have a gift shop and I got a nice purple fleece with the Taquan Air logo.  At the end, we got back on the bus and were dropped back by the cruise dock.

Wow! There aren’t words for the views you get of Denali on this flight We were blessed to have a perfectly clear day so we had unbelievable views. Well worth your time and money.  Pilot was friendly, knowledgeable and concerned with the safety of the plane. We actually had to wait about 30 minutes to leave while he had maintenance checking a part on the plane. I appreciate all safety precautions . Definitely recommend!

One of the top experiences we had while in Alaska. Wow, to see this amazing mountain and the glaciers from the air is breath taking. You just cannot experience the scale the beauty same way from the ground. Would highly recommend over any land tour. Our K2 pilot did a great job. It was a little cloudy the day we flew, but he was able to get us up to a clear area and it was beautiful. Flew so that we all had great views and pointed out the major and interesting features. We did not do a glacier landing, but if you're really interested in that they offer those flights. I'm happy we choose just the flightseeing; feel we had more time in the air and were able to see more of this amazing area.
We didn’t get to go. It was canceled.   The did call. Offered options but being out of town we had time restrictions.  They are giving a full refund

This was by far our most amazing activity in Alaska for our family. Our pilot was very friendly and experienced and narrated our whole trip. We landed on a glacier and he took family pictures for us. This is an expensive activity but is so worth every dime we paid. Our check in was very easy and all flowed well.

This was a once-in-a-lifetime experience and was so amazing. It was a great way to see Alaska and the glaciers of Denali from the air. We took the flight that included the glacier landing and I could not recommend this trip any higher. It was an awesome experience. My husband and I took my parents who are in their 70s and our two children ages 11 and 8. The kids loved throwing snowballs made of glacier snow and ice! Our pilot, Doug, was great. He was super informative, funny, and super professional. If you're thinking of doing a flight, just do it. It is worth every penny!

I had an amazing birthday.  I got to land on a Glacier.. that's wild!! My pilot Riley was amazing and friendly; super helpful and even flew my over the property at MPL, where I work. I'd also add that he very attractive. So having a sexy guide on my bday has habds down been the best thus far.!! THANKS RILEY!!!

Can’t rave enough about this organization.
From start to finish, top notch crew.
To Greg who was our pick up/drop off guide - Thank you
Our Pilot Doug - you are an amazing pilot/tour guide. 
So worth every penny for this experience.
You guys ROCK!

K2 Aviation Pilot Chad Smith and his De Havilland DHC-2 Turbo Beaver delivered us an incredible aerial tour within one of Alaska's gems: Denali National Park. Our glacier landing was a once in a lifetime level experience. Incredible, awesome, wicked crazy good... insert your exceptional adjective here. This tour was absolutely and unquestionably worth its cost. We were very blessed to be able to take it and have Mr. Smith as our pilot. Thank you again for the unforgettable and safe flight and landing(s). The very best to you and K2 Aviation.

review_title: Just amazing. There flights and service are outstanding.
review_text:
These guys were amazing.
From the customer service to the actual tour, these guys just had it going on.
As the 1st day in Talkeetna was overcast and snowing, we rebooked our flight to our last day in Talkeetna. The team were very helpful in this.
As we had finished a dog mushing tour on our second day, the weather was superb and you could see the 3 mountains from town.
Luckily for us, we walked to airport and asked if we could get on the flight from our rebooked ticket the next day and they managed to get us on the flight that day. The team at the airport base were super helpful in this.
The flight was amazing. We were lucky enough to see all three mountains in the one flight and the scenery was spectacular. Its hard to put into words. The only issue we had was another companies plane was on the glacier runway and we couldn't land. Our pilot Jack tried to wait a few minutes and took a quick lap around the area to come back and see if we could get down but it wasn't safe so we couldn't land and then we flew back to base. When talking to the team at the airport, we said we had an amazing experience and a shame we missed the landing. You don't have to pay for that part as well if you didn't get it. As we were buying some merchandise from the shop, the staff came back to us and asked us if we wanted to jump on the next flight, for free, and only pay for the landing if we got it. We jumped at the chance. We got the same pilot Jack again for our next flight. He was excellent and explained and answers for questions when asked over the radio. Luckily, we got a glacier landing on this flight. 
It was an amazing experience and well worth the money. Luckily for us we got two flights for the price of the one.
I cant thank the team at K2 aviation for the help they gave us. There customer service was amazing, just like the service they provide.
I would thoroughly recommend K2 aviation for a Denali flight experience. Its a must do when in Talkeetna
I highly recommend seeing Denali and it was also awesome to see it so up close! I highly recommend this experience and K2 Aviation knows what they are doing.

Take a spectacular weather day, a seasoned pilot and state-of-the-art aircraft, and enjoy an incredible day flying around one of the most beautiful mountain ranges in the world.  Denali lived up to its reputation in every way.  Conditions permitted a landing on Ruth Glacier for a stroll in the nine-foot snowpack with all angles for photo opportunities.  K2 Aviation is tops all around.  Our knowledgeable pilot, Sean, gave us a smooth ride, detailed narration and even offered his services as photographer.  It was an adventure to treasure forever.

WE were blessed with open skies. I had no idea of the vastness of the area. We got very close to mountains, I thought I would be able to reach out and touch them. Great explanation of the glaciers and mountains by our pilot.  Landed on the Glacier. Epic experience.

Glacier landing tour was spectacular. Due to the weather, a landing was not an option. At the last minute, near the landing site, headquarters gave us the go ahead to land. Never seen anything like it.

What an incredible experience!  After 3 overcast days in Talkeetna we were not sure we were ever going to see Denali, but K2 fixed that!  On our final morning in Talkeetna it was, again, overcast with no mountain views. Once our flightsee emerged from the clouds it was a stunning visual display of the park and the mountain peak!  Our pilot was knowledgeable, friendly and gave us lots of great information about what we were seeing.  There is truly no better way to experience this amazing, vast park that via plane.  This was a highlight of our Alaska trip.  Highly recommended!!!

review_title: Great way to see Denali and surroundings
review_text: Excellent experience!
