(K2 Grand Tour, without glacier landing) The views were totally amazing + our pilot was skilled, knowledgeable, and provided just the right amount of narration/explanation during the flight. We were very lucky with particularly clear weather, but the terrain, and the altitudes at which you see it, are very varied, so I'd guess that it will be remarkable even in less-than-perfect conditions . The pilots have discretion about the exact route they fly, so they can take best advantage of whatever is happening on the day you fly. We recommend leaving an empty day the day after your scheduled flight, if that's possible, so that in the rare event that no flights can go out on your day, you can stay over and try again the next day. In any case, the train trip to Talkeetna is very pleasant and scenic, and the town itself is...cute. A highlight of our Alaska trip (tied with the Kenai fjords boat tour).
We had an awesome time!  Full view of Denali!  Riley, our pilot did an amazing job.  We had a perfect landing on Ruth Glacier.  Thank you, K2 Aviation!  Highly recommend the trip with the landing.

review_title: Beautiful Denali flight and Glacier landing
review_text: Such a beautiful and breath taking experience!  The flight was incredible and the Glacier landing on Ruth Glacier was such a thrilling event!

review_title: Outstanding, up close views of Mt Denali
review_text: Amazing grand tour around Mt Denali and some of the surrounding area! Our pilot, Joe, was very professional from start to finish!! My wife and I highly recommend this company and tour.  They were in communication with us several times to confirm that our first reservation time could not fly due to weather and were sucessful getting us a second time that worked.  Be persistent if your first time doesn't work out do to weather.

I’m not sure I have the right words to describe how amazing this trip was! K2 has been in business for a long time and was highly recommended by my brother who has climbed Mt. Denali. Upon walking in we were greeted by friendly staff who helped check us in. The facilities were nice and clean. Next we met our amazing pilot Dave. We went over safety. You can tell how hard K2 works to take good care of their planes. There are not that many Otters so it’s a special treat to fly in one! We lucked out with near perfect weather conditions and seeing Mt. Denali so up close is exhilarating. I got to sit up front with Dave and he made our experience extra special by pointing out things about my brothers climb. We landed on a glacier which that alone was exhilarating. I have the most incredible pictures and video of Mt. Denali and the mountain range!!! Thanks K2 and Dave for helping us make amazing memories and celebrate our Honeymoon in Alaska!

review_title: It's not expensive, for the value and the total cost of being here.
review_text:
Awesome in every way.  Courteous, competent, friendly, safety conscious and very informative pre, during and post trip.

Everything worked flawlessly.

They communicated clearly, factually.  Refunded when weather made part of the flight path unsafe.

This was the ABSOLUTE highlight of our trip to Alaska. Worth every penny! We had a perfect day (it was 80 degrees in Talkeetna. 65 degrees on the glacier) and the perfect pilot. Couldn't have had a better time. Once in a lifetime experience. You only live once. What are you waiting for?

review_title: No better way to recognize Denali summit expect climbing - PERFECT!
review_text: Weather forecast wasn´t so good, but finaly - excelent weather for such a amazing experince. So nice - to start from lowland and slowly fly closer and higher to Denali summit across great glaciers, around Denali´s daughter and wife....  Pilot, perfect boy in gumboots -)  ... was still exlpaining everything, joking and driving so calm, made some circles to both sides of plane can enjoy that monumental views - PERFECT! However very windy, almost silent landing with so smal plane.... and finaly pilot made nice pictures of group with plane after landing.

Second year taking ng the flight around Denali and landing on the glacier.  This is a once in a life time experience.  If you can do it then go.  Great pilot.  Company helpful and friendly.  Will do this again
AWESOME flight seeing trip around Denali! Our pilot was so knowledgeable and gave us us a smooth flight with fantastic views of the mountains and glaciers.

This was a special opportunity to see Denali up close and take in how massive it truly is and how small we are in the whole scheme of things. We were blessed with a beautiful blue sky day with lots of visibility. The Glacier landing is short but worth the extra money. Just to stand there and take in the scale and beauty of the glacier is amazing. Our pilot, Jeff Berstrand was excellent and narrated  what we were seeing and the history of the area. Highly recommend this excursion as a “must do” when in Alaska. 2 hour easy drive from Anchorage. The ladies at checkin were very friendly and helpful too.

review_title: Best excursion we did in Alaska!
review_text: This was one of the best things we did in Alaska on our two week vacation! We did the Denali Flyer with Glacier Landing. Although our original flight was cancelled due to weather we were able to reschedule. It was incredible! The views from the air were stunning and the flight was so smooth. Landing on the glacier was like landing on the moon! It was other-worldly. We loved every minute of this! Would definitely do it again!

review_title: Last minute booking.. greatest decision ever!
review_text: My mother and I decided to take this tour day if very last minute with weather being so perfect. We called around noon for a 4 o’clock tour. We were booked and ready to fly! It was the most amazing and beautiful experience. Would highly recommend! Once in a lifetime experience for sure! Joe was our tour guid and pilot. He took us so low towards the glacier for breath taking views!
The pilot was very knowledgeable. It was an excellent experience that I would highly recommend. The scenery was amazing!

This was by far our most enjoyable event in Alaska.  The flight was incredible.  The views were amazing.  The pilot was outstanding.  Landing on the glacier was something I will never forget.  I sat where a copilot would sit.  I believe I had the best views.  Raise your hand if they ask if you would like to sit next to the pilot!

The Denali grand tour with glacier landing was truly spectacular! Granted, we had a rare completely clear day, but even with partial clouds, it would be beautiful almost beyond description. Going though mountain passes and landing on the Ruth glacier were wonderful experiences.
Incredible! Pilot was great and let my daughter sit right seat. Felt like safety is their top priority. Such a great experience

The tour was amazing! We had a clear day and the views from the plane were stunning. Definitely recommend the glacier landing. Such a cool experience landing on a glacier. Riley was our pilot. He was great and felt safe the whole time. Highly recommend this tour!

This was amazing!  It felt like our wing tips were just a breath away from the mountain and yet, no fear!  Our pilot was great!  The landing on the glacier was so smooth!  A bucket list trip for sure. Flying between and around all the mountains was a view like no other!

review_title: Best trip you can do for  yourself!!
review_text: Our pilot Dorothy was fantastic.  This is a life changing experience. I lived in Alaska for 50 years and have hunted and fished all over.  This trip is still the most Awe Inspiring thing i have ever done!!  Well done!!!!!  And Thanks again Dorothy!!

This was one of lifetime plane trip realy memorable. I simply envy pilots they get to do this and get paid for it. Just seeing the wonderful mountain range up close is breathtaking and to walk upon one of glaciers is simply cherry on top.

Excellent customer service. We booked a Denali flight-seeing trip with a glacier landing. When we arrived, K2 provided us with a weather update & stated that due to fog, the glacier landing was cancelled for the day. Because we had specifically booked this tour, they allowed us to cancel with no penalty. So technically - we didn't take any tour but we really appreciated being able to cancel.

My husband Paul, took this trip today. He LOVED it! He has had this on his bucket list forever and it was everything that he had hoped for and more! The pilot was Jack and he was amazing! I highly recommend this company!

We arrived 45 minutes early and at this time we were told the flight we paid and signed for was unable to go cause of weather, however, we could go on a shorter flight or would refund money. We were in Alaska a limited time, so we choose the short flight they offered. This flight was not worth the trip. Really didn't see much. Family was disappointed. And Pilot spoke most time with a family from Alaska about careers. I will say the flight was safe and smooth.

We had an incredible experience  with K-2 Aviation!   Our pilot, Phil, made us feel extremely safe and was a superior pilot!  The views of the mountains were spectacular and the landing on Ruth Glacier was totally amazing!   This was the best part of our trip to Alaska (group of 5) for all us.  It is definitely worth the price.   I would do it all over again!!!

review_title: Eh, maybe book here, maybe don’t
review_text: Save yourself a drive and book a flight out of the Denali area itself where the weather has been much more fair. After telling me our flight was cancelled they wanted me to try to rebook a third time. We drove an hour from our hotel to K2 and received no phone call about a cancellation. The sun came out as we drove out of the parking lot… I’m sure it’s a great flight if you’re actually able to go.

This is an expensive activity, but it is worth the splurge! What a great way to see the Alaskan range and the awesome Denali! Our pilot, Ian, was fantastic, making sure everyone was comfortable, could be heard, and explaining a lot about the glaciers, the mountains and passes and of course the Great One! We had planned to do the longest summit tour, but the weather was good enough , As I guess they need ideal conditions as we had fairly clear weather. K2 quickly refunded the difference in cost between the two different tours.
Flight was amazing. Pilot was friendly and knowledgeable about the mountain and the glaciers. I felt safe at all times and would do it again. Especially the landing on the glacier was amazing.

It's worth every penny!!!! What a truly amazing experience. I was fortunate enough to sit in the co-pilot seat and had some of the best views ever on a flight I will never forget. We were also fortunate enough to get to see the peaks of Denali. The whole operation from booking to landing is excellent. These guys even helped us out with a slow puncture on a tyre on our rental and inflated it for us. Amazing experience and should be one for everyones bucket list.

This is a definite must see! You just can't compare to seeing these majestic mountains from up in a plane! We landed in the glacier and had some time up there. It is expensive but worth the cost! Our pilot was very knowledgeable and did an amazing job!

One of the best tours I have ever been on!  The pilot was Chad - very knowledgeable of the area, glaciers and just all around very pleasant personality.  The weather did allow for us to land on the glacier and was one of the 5% clear days allowing us to see all the way to the top of Denali!!  Awesome day!

This company is top notch. I called a few times with questions and they were always polite and helpful. The trip itself was spectacular. The pilot was so knowledgeable and flew the plane like an absolute pro. The landing was one of the best I have ever experienced. They give headsets so you can ask questions and everyone had a window seat on the plane we flew in.

review_title: see All of Denali National Park this way if you can
review_text:
I understand less than 5% of visitors get the day we had. Booked after seeing a clear day in the forcast and it was a perfect. Calm winds, amazing sun on a winter day in November. We were able to circle Denali, curve around all the main glaciers, even fly through 747 pass. The Sheldon resort gave us perspective to the immense mountains around us.
If possible, see Denali this way! We saw the entire park, experienced all the stunning beauty, dangerous peaks and saw the vast fields and rivers that make this National Park so striking.
Chad was calm, careful and an extremely good pilot.

What a perfect way to see the glaciers of Denali with a wonderful glacier landing.  It could not been more perfect.  Sunshine and could see Mt Denali in all its glory.  Not every day I can play in the snow in August as I live in South Carolina.  The beauty will give you a lump in your throat.  I am a travel agent and this is a must for all my clients.  It turned out to be the best tour while in Talkeetna.  I will be looking at the picutres and videos for many years to come. Take my advise and bite the bullet and GO!!

We had an awesome beautiful sunny day. We really saw how majestic Denali is. You get a chance to feel really small as you are close to the mountain. I was not happy with the type of pictures I was able to capture as they put us on the one and only low wing plane. The wing was in 90 percent of my pics. Maybe my expectations were too high since I have been in small planes before, but the wing in my pics really disappointed me, hence my lower rating. Currently my favorite Denali pic was taken in Talkeetna  on the Susitna River. On the same day as my flight.

This was an incredible adventure. I would do this again anytime I am in Alaska. My daughter and I spent a week hiking in Alaska. Going on the K2  Grand Tour of Denali with glacier landing was a great way to finish the week. We had booked to do this two days earlier, but could not because of the rain. They were great and rescheduled us for two days later. They run a very efficient and professional service. From the front office to Lou, our pilot everyone was great. My daughter loved this and we will both always remember our whole week in the mountains of Alaska, but flying over the and landing on a glacier was a nice addition to the whole week.

This is the most spectacular thing we've ever done.   Our pilot, Chris was very informative and made sure both sides of the plane got to see the sights.  Words cannot describe the views and pictures do not do them justice.  Landing on the glacier at Denali base camp was just the best.   DO THIS!!!!

What an amazing trip!
Our pilot.. can't remember his name but he was from Pennsylvania studying aerospace engineering was a great great guy!  Give that young man a raise.  K2 did an amazing job checking us in and getting us to Denali.  

Landing on the glacier was just truly amazing.  Really puts things in perspective about nature and all it's glory.

Truly remember this forever.

Signed
From Texas

The entire experience was amazing!!! Highly recommend! They are a very professional company from start to finish. We also paid extra for the glacier landing, and it was definitely worth it! Thanks K2 for such an awesome trip!

review_title: breathtaking experience of Denali mountains and glacier
review_text:
excellent flight through the denali mountain ranges and glacier landing. It's not cheap but worth doing it. The views of the mountains and glaciers are just breathtaking. 
One of the highlights so far of my Alaska trip.

My favorite excursion so far in Alaska! Pilot Lou flew a smooth flight and landing on the glacier. I learned so much about how the glaciers, mountains and waterways were formed. He's educated about the geology of the area and shared his knowledge with us, encouraging questions, and made sure both sides of the plane could view what he was describing.
Stepping onto a glacier was unreal! Stunning views, trip of a lifetime! And K2 Aviation even sent a shuttle to pick us up from our campground.
Very cool sweatshirts and tshirts in their gift shop too.

When asked what was my favorite part of this experience I would have to say, "The whole experience.".  From making reservations, too checking in, to the flight, to landing on Ruth Glacier all was wonderful.  Staff were all professional.  There is flexibility if you need to reschedule.  K2 Aviation wants to guarantee you a  excellent experience, and they did exceeding all of my expectations.  If you are visiting Talkeetna Alaska this is a must.

We went on 11am flight. The views were awesome. We saw so many glaciers, tents of hikers for Denali. We landed on Ruth Glacier. The only thing we didn't do was circle all around Denali due to weather on other side. My suggestion take as early flight as you can. The weather seems to change as day goes on. Another suggestion, ask to sit up front. I was co-pilot best experience I've ever had.

Just another glowing review for this experience.  Yes it’s expensive but it’s such a unique experience that you’ll talk about for the rest of your life.  The glacier landing is a must.  Don’t even hesitate.  Our pilot was Connor and he was excellent.  All staff were excellent and a top notch outfit.

review_title: Grand Flight Seeing tour from Talkeetna was amazing
review_text: We had taken the Grand Flight Seeing tour from Talkeetna. It was a magnificent experience. Our pilot was very good and professional. He gave us a very good tour of the Denali mountains, the glaciers and all other surrounding mountains. The weather was perfect and views were amazing. Definitely worth the price and an activity not to miss in Alaska !

This was a fantastic experience and K2 is absolutely top notch.  Landing on a glacier was so smooth and the beauty of glacier is overwhelming and breathtaking.  Air is so crisp and sky so clear that Denali was totally visible.  My photographs are. Fantastic thanks to K2.  I would do this tour again and again if I could.
Seeing the North side of Denali on a perfectly clear day and then walking on the Ruth Glacier. Our pilot was the best!

This was amazing!   At first I did not plan on going and was sending a family member.  

I am a larger person and just assumed this was not something I could do.      When checking in my family member the person asked if I was going and then asked me why not.  When I explained why - he was amazing.   Made me feel comfortable and assured me I was perfectly able to go. 

Despite. It planning on it - I joined my family member on a most amazing adventure!

Absolutely amazing sights.  I felt safe.  The staff was amazing.   This is a bucket list item - even if you don’t know it yet!!!

A totally AWESOME experience. One of the most beautiful flights and landing on a glacier was a trilling experience that everyone should have on their bucket list.
Captain Stan was polite, courteous, experienced and extremely professional.
He did an outstanding job explaining and informing passengers of the history and facts surrounding Denali. He was also funny and entertaining and a great tour guide.
I would highly recommend this experience to anyone and everyone, well worth the cost (which was my only hesitation) but now realize it as money well spent and a memory of a life time!!

This tour was incredible!! Everything about the operation was smooth and easy!! The pilot was very skilled, helpful, and knowledgeable! And the sights were out of this world!! It will be hard to top this experience!!

WOW! Spectacular day with a great flight. Smooth flight with great narration by the pilot telling us the Denali story. Glacier landing is a must if the weather allows it- be sure to wear the boots they provide because the fluffy snow on the glacier was above "normal" hiking boot level. Efficient check in process. Great facilities. With 4 days notice they allowed us to delay 1 day for a better weather forecast which turned out to be a great change. Not a cheap flight, but worth every penny.

K2 is THE flight service to take when in the area of Denali. All personnel are courteous and helpful is booking or rearranging your flight if the local weather does not accommodate your original flight. They all, want to make your flight an exceptional and extraordinary experience, and they succeed.

What a great sight seeing flight!  We had booked a 3 pm all around Denali, they picked us up at our hotel and drove us to K2 Aviation.  The check in process was quick and easy and after a 10 minute wait our names were called for the flight.  Our pilot (forgot her name) was very informative with the safety measures and soon we were in the air.  Wow, what an up close experience flying around the mountains on a perfectly clear day!  Our pilot was very informative (with out talkin too much), she flew both ways so that each side of the plane had a chance to get clear pictures.  This was just a fantastic experience it was the highlight of our trip!!!

review_title: Book it now you crazy fool!!
review_text: HOLY BALLS! WORTH EVERY CENT!! This was one of the most amazing things I’ve ever done. You have to add the glacier landing too. The whole thing was breathtaking. Chris was the best pilot! He shared lots of knowledge on the area as we flew. Do not pass up this opportunity. BOOK IT!!!

I did the flight seeing tour with Glacier Landing on our first full day in Alaska  It was also the highlight of our Alaska vacation.  This was a bucket list item that was well worth the price.  I waited till three days prior to arriving in Alaska to book the trip based on the weather forecast.  If you're visiting Alaska this is definitely a must.  The views and scenery were amazing.  The entire staff at K2 Aviation definitely made this a memorable experience.

Great service and highly professional staff. Unfortunately our initial flight to Denali Glacier got cancelled due to adverse weather conditions, but K2 team tried during all day to rebook us on another flight, in the hope that the weather conditions improved. Since that did not happened they proposed us an alternative tour to the Knick Glacier, which we accepted and that turned out amazing. Airplanes look in a perfect shape, pilots are highly professional and we felt totally safe. Highly recommended!

We did the Denali Grand flightseeing tour and had a wonderful time! We saw some really cool things - mountains, glaciers, rivers, lakes. Our pilot Dorothy was really amazing and made the flight smooth and a lot of fun! We unfortunately couldn’t see the summit of Denali because of weather but that didn’t take away a lot from the experience.

review_title: Amazing capstone to a summer Alaksan vacation
review_text: My wife and I were vacationing in Talkeetna at the beginning of Aug '21 and lucked upon several days of clear whether that gave spectacular views of Denali.  So we jumped at the chance of flying around Denali with K2 on our last morning in town.  It was phenomenal!  The K2 staff resolved a last-minute scheduling glitch (thanks again!) and got us on a flight at the appointed time.  Our pilot (Stan) was great both in terms of flying skill and sharing interesting information during the flight.  We got to fly among the soaring peaks, sheer cliffs, and beautiful glaciers.  Stan landed us on a glacier near the backcountry hut; this gave unparalleled views of Denali and other peaks, and a size/distance perspective that was awesome.  K2 really gave us the opportunity to take advantage of the good weather and end our trip with the highlight of the entire vacation.

The experience was amazing the views Of the mountains was spectacular the landing on the glacier was flawless and a once in a lifetime experience. I would  highly recommend  this to anyone  and everyone

review_title: A must do when in Talkeetna
review_text:
We hemmed and hawed about doing a flight seeing experience.  I was the most nervous in the bunch.  Agreed at the last minute to do a Denali fly around with a glacier landing.  

Arrived at K2 for our reservation only to find out that the experience would be a bit different due to the weather in Denali area.  There would be a Denali approach, a Ruth Glacier fly over but no landing.  We were given the choice of getting a full refund or a partial refund if we agreed to the new experience option.  

Decided to go for it because we'd likely never get another opportunity during our AK stay.  We are very glad we did.  Saw Denali's peak as we peeked above the clouds.  Then spent some time over the enormous, breathtaking glacier.  Never seen anything quite like it.  I also enjoyed seeing the ground as we traveled back to the airport.  It was amazing to see the trails we had been on from a different perspective.  

The staff went above and beyond with us as I am hearing impaired.  They realized I wouldn't be able to understand the pilot, especially with him and everyone else masked, so they gave me a several page print out with information of everything I would see on the flight.  It wasn't anything we asked for either so I was very much appreciative of that.  

The pilot was excellent and clear as he gave his flight instructions to his passengers.  And the flight itself gave me nothing to fear.  I was very comfortable from start to finish.  

Highly recommend!
Experienced pilot. Breathtaking views. We landed on a glacier! Pilot was very knowledgeable and personable.

review_title: K2 Aviation will take you to a place where your senses will be dazzled.
review_text:
K2 Aviation will take you to a place where your senses will be dazzled. 
Denali is Awesome, like Alaska; entirely beyond the scale of ordinary urban life. 
The ONLY way to see even part of Denali, is a flight-seeing air tour of this massive mountain, Denali.  An absolute must for those who seek an Alaskan adventure. 

K2 Aviation will take you there_  Up close in the air, Denali is amazing, breathtaking, exciting and yet still remote, completely humbling; visited briefly, but remembered always.

This flight was the high point of our 15 day Alaska trip, the experience is much more than these few words can say_  Our Pilot Chad made it a wonderful uplifting flight.

Do not be timid! K2 Aviation's pilots and equipment (planes); [especially their turbine powered de Havilland Otters] are tried & true, experienced and capable. 
Their pilot's local knowledge and skill making the flight a joy for everyone; it's a once in a lifetime experience.
Love the trip. Our pilot was great and very informative. We saw the top of the Mountain because it was a clear day. This is a must do for Denali Park.
Views were magnificent.  Standing on the glacier was so amazing its hard to describe.  Our pilot Jeff was really cool and had good knowledge of the area.

My group was so happy we booked this tour, especially the glacier landing - worth the money! Jeff was a great pilot who made all of us feel safe and comfortable. I loved hearing him tell about what we were seeing throughout the journey.

This is easily the best thing we did in Alaska while I was there. I actually proposed to my now-fiancee at Denali basecamp through K2, and they were so helpful and supportive!

You MUST do the glacier landing, and we'd highly recommend the entire experience over anything else you have to do in Alaska.
The Denali glacier landing was once in a lifetime opportunity!  We were in complete awe!  Highly recommend!

The staff was amazing trying to accommodate walk ins (Thank you) our pilot was awesome! We had a great group. Our pilot was very knowledgeable, experienced and made the entire experience exceptional..... He helped take pictures for our memories. We WOULD RECOMMEND this company to any one!!
Thank you to a GREAT team!!!

Incredible. This is the best part of our trip. From start to finish, the flying experience was fabulous, the views from the place were break taking. Spending time on the  glacier and views from the glaciers were experience of life time. The service was excellent. Thank you K2 team.

One of the coolest experiences I’ve ever had! We flew right up and around the mountains and it was surreal. I would definitely recommend this company. The pilot was extremely helpful and knowledgeable and encouraged us to ask lots of questions about the area, the wildlife, etc. He also told us to let him know if the wing was in the way of our photos so that he could adjust to give the best angles for photos of the region. It was an amazing experience all around!
Had an incredible time. Chris, our pilot, was a great dude with a chill demeanor. I felt safe the whole time.

We booked this flight on a last minute suggestion from our bed and breakfast host and we were so happy we did. They were able to get us in same day and at a time that worked for our schedule. Our pilot/tour guide Chad was very knowledgeable about the Talkeetna region and the immense Denali mountain area. We learned so much about the glaciers and mountains, and the formation of the region. Thank you K2, this was the cherry on top of a great 2 week Alaskan vacation.
This is an essential experience if you're visiting Denali. There's no better way to take in the mountains than these flight tours.

review_title: Grand Denali tour was simply mind blowing
review_text: Best experience that i will remember for a long time. Although, it is Corona time, the whole experience from booking to check out was great. We made the reservation over the phone and werent sure whether we were going to make it in Alaska due to Covid, but there were no worries because they would not charge until the day of the flight. Checking was very easy. Once we signed we headed outside where we were provided with covers for our boots and the meet and greet by the pilot. It was 5 of us flying that day. The weather was beautiful and the pilot said we had a 60 to 80 % chance of landing on the Glacier. The pilot was extremely knowledgeable and kept us engaged the whole flight. He knew the area well and told us some amazing stuff about Alaska and Denali. You also had a chance to sit upfront with the pilot and we decided who will with consensus. The views were amazing, the aircraft was excellent, well kept and comfortable. We could not have asked for a better experience. The take off and landing both on the glacier and on ground were smooth. It is so worth the money and i would recommend to anyone who would like to have a life time memory and experience something as amazing as flying near Denali and landing on the glacier.

review_title: The best part of going to Alaska!
review_text: We had the most incredible time and flight overseeing Deanli. It truly is the best way to see all the mountains! The photos came out incredible and I believe this was worth every penny. Definitely recommend splurging on the glacier landing. It was the best part of the trip to be able to land on the glacier and see it from a different perspective. Would definitely recommend!
This was a great experience. Our pilot Chris was very knowledgeable about Denali and the glaciers. We paid the extra $100 for the glacier landing. WORTH IT. Flight was smooth and lots of fun.
Incredible! Worth every penny! No other way to get so up close and personal with Denali unless you plan on climbing it yourself.

review_title: Glacier landing denali national park, base camp
review_text: Best trip EVER. Pilot was outstanding, photographs were amazing, and the pilots commentary was super interesting. We went to some glaciers on helicopters, but nothing came close to the 3 hours we spent flying around denali. Highlight of my entire 6 month stay all over alaska

We had an amazing time flying the Denali Grand Tour mid-Sept. We lucked out with an amazingly clear morning, and a small 3 person group. The tour was one of the highlights of our time in Alaska. It gives you amazing perspective on the Denali Range, and our pilot had lots of information to share about the mountains, glaciers, climbing expeditions, and history. We were showered with eye candy and lots of info throughout the journey. 

Our initial attempt at flying around Denali was cancelled due to weather, but we made the drive from Anchorage to Talkeetna on the early morning of the day we were flying home because we heard from fellow travelers it was well worth it. It did not disappoint.

Gorgeous sunny day with views for miles. Pilot was incredibly knowledgeable about the local area and made the once in a lifetime experience that much better. Glacier landing was a huge highlight. Being surrounded by such impressive peaks is not something we’ll forget any time soon.

It was an incredible experience, just indescriptible. All the personel was very profesional and kind. The pilot awesome, very attentive and friendly.

The experience worth all the effort.

The only thing I would add is more time after landing to enjoy the landscape.

We left out from Talkeetna on a sunny day and the experience was life changing! Denali was as beautiful as can be and the glacier landing was beyond words. All the pictures we took were beautiful but seeing the views in person is indescribable! I would encourage everyone to take this flight and enjoy the beauty of Gods country!

It is hard to pick to pick a favorite part of the tour as the whole experience was beyond words.
We would definitely pick the glacier landing as a must.  We could not have had a more perfect day as there was not a cloud anywhere.  Our pilot (Chris) was an encyclopedia of information  about the history of the area and the mountain.  As long time residents of Alaska  I don’t know how we could have had a better experience and would definitely recommend it to everyone and it should be on everyone’s bucket list.

review_title: Views like a James Bond movie
review_text: This is a very well run and professional company.  Our pilot provided a good explanation of what we were seeing and turned the plane around so passengers on both sides could get a good view of all of the sights.  The magnificent views were like flying through a James Bond movie.

This was an amazing trip for my wife and I.  The Glacier landing was beyond exciting.  Pilot was excellent, trip was A+++, views were exquisite, weather was perfect, etc..... No question a trip we will never forget!

review_title: A great adventure worth every penny
review_text:
K2 aviation is a great company
Our pilot/tour guide did an amazing job providing history, not only of Denali, but Alaska as well.  Landing on the Kahiltna Glacier was very exciting. The Turbo Otter is a well maintained, purposes built aircraft made for this type of flying. Our great adventure was worth every penny.

This adventure was the absolute highlight of our trip to Alaska. Although it is an expensive flight tour, it is worth every penny you will spend. We were fortunate enough to have a fairly calm and clear day, and the views of Denali and the mountains were outstanding. We were able to land on the glacier, and the views from the glacier were magnificent, and an experience I will never forget. If he is available, ask for Captain Stan. He was an incredible host who shared very interesting narration throughout the trip.

Wear warm winter clothes and comfortable boots or shoes, and K2 will provide special boots for walking on the glacier. The company is also really great about screening for COVID-19, and our negative test results were required in order to take the flight tour. Masks were also required when in the K2 buildings and throughout the flight.
An AK MUST! I always take visiting friends and family and it never disappoints!! Thank you for all that you do for your guests and you community.
Landing at base camp glacier by Mt. Hunter was outrageous and a once in a lifetime experience.   The pilot, Stan, was super experienced and a great host.  It was a glorious day.

My wife and I took a morning Denali Grand Air Tour with K2 Aviation and had a wonderful time. The weather was absolutely perfect; no clouds and very little wind. 
Our pilot Stan was very knowledgeable about the history of Denali, glaciology, geology, and the names of all the peaks and glaciers. He positioned the plane so all on board could get ample photographs of all the beautiful scenery. We were completely satisfied with our air tour and would definitely recommend this activity as a once in a lifetime experience. 

The Enrights

It was great to see the mountain close up! At first I was worried that it wouldn’t be worth it but it totally was. We were lucky to have a clear day but even if it didn’t work out I wasn’t concerned because the staff was so upfront that they weren’t going to charge you for the trip if you didn’t get the experience you signed up for. Super nice people. Perfect stop if you are going to/from Denali!

We are 'local' (Anchorage) and had scheduled a trip on Saturday. Friday's trip to Talkeetna was beautiful....Denali visible from our home all the way to Talkeetna. Sarah worked with us to change our reservation from Saturday to Friday. Chris was our pilot and it was an overall awesome experience. Their goal is to have you enjoy the trip...not take your money. What a refreshing change and what an amazing experience!!  Very "Covid Aware"! Most grateful! -Rick & Natalie

review_title: Words cannot describe how awesome this is!
review_text:
I've been to Talkeetna a number of times. It's always been overcast or rainy, and I've loved it anyway, even when I haven't been fortunate to see Denali. This time was incredible, and K2 aviation, and our pilot Chris, put our trip over the top. Literally. 

We'd been hesitant to do a Denali flight as it's so expensive. And the weather is so variable, we were afraid to commit. But after reading a number of reviews, it seemed worth doing if the weather seemed promising. We booked for one day, it turned out to be really hazy because of fires in Siberia (!) and K2 was great about allowing us to switch days.  Chris our pilot was phenomenal from the second we met him. Incredibly knowledgeable, personable and professional. The weather was clear, and we saw Denali and other mountains, SO close up. We did a glacier landing, and at one point our family and Chris were the only ones on the ice field. It was like being in a dream.

This is an expensive trip. It is dependent on weather and other factors, and we know we were very lucky. But K2 is so professional, and with pilots like Chris, really maximize the potential that this will be an unforgettable experience. If you are able to be flexible with the timing that helps, because the weather changes so much. 

Also, just have to say that we were nervous given Covid. But again, K2 was extremely professional, had exceptional hygiene practices both in and out of the aircraft, and  I would not Covid concerns stop you from doing this trip.

Chad, a fellow Minnesotan, was a fantastic pilot!  He made us feel safe, gave great details about the mountains and surrounding landscape, and we had so much fun!  We might have been quiet guests, but we were just taking it all in!  We even saw a rare avalanche!!  Couldn't have asked for a better trip!  Thank you!!

So worthwhile!!  We upgraded from the flight only to landing on the glacier and it was a surreal experience.   The flight to the Alaska Range was informative thanks to Chris's (pilot) commentary.  The mountains are majestic and flying along the paths of glaciers was breathtaking.  The weather was such that we didn't need a coat to walk on the glacier which was completely unexpected.  We flew way closer to mountains then I would've thought possible.  We would sign up again the next time we're in Talkeetna!!

K2 does a great job working with you and making sure you have the best possible experience. While they cannot control the weather do a good job staying in communication and helping to adjust when necessary. Cannot recommend the glacier landing enough as it was incredible.

Everyone at K2 was great to work with. They took the time to help us pick the best option for our flight, and they were very professional at check-in which showed that our safety came first. Due to covid, we wore our masks from the moment we walked in the door until the time we left. Our pilot told us all about the plane before we boarded: where the life vests were, where the radio was, where emergency supplies were stored... you know, in the event we didn't make it back as expected. On the flight out, he told us what we were seeing, and although we didn't get to land on the glacier due to weather, we still immensely enjoyed our time. Part of our payment was immediately refunded once we landed due to the cancellation of the glacier landing. We left elated and with LOTS of great pictures! Advice, you'll see more of Denali if you sit on the right side of the plane. Go- it's beautiful and unforgettable! Highly recommend!
This was the highlight of my trip. Fabulous scenery. Pilot was excellent and gave a great commentary, I felt totally safe the entire time. I plan on doing this again next year when I return.
Highlight of my experience... poor, flight canceled, poor explanation and a poor alternative suggested. No prior phone call and missing out on other items

The views were amazing! Pilot was excellent. A once in a lifetime experience landing on glacier. It felt very safe and in good hands. 

Two complaints: 
1.) we stepped off our bus after a 3 hour bus ride from Anchorage - we were two hours early for our trip - they rushed onto the 5 o’clock plane so fast I had to request they slow down so we could use the restroom and reorient - that felt... not good 
2.) we were scheduled for a longer tour around the mountain at sunset - it was canceled for “weather reasons“ - I’m no pilot, but the weather was amazing - my take: it was canceled and we were shuffled onto this other plane because they didn’t want to lose money sending another pilot up just for me and my son - so, that felt... not good as well

Still, once in a lifetime experience- worth the trip and money! Highly encourage the experience
Professional, clean, exceptional views and kind service. The whole package. The landing on the glacier was smoother than most commercial flights.

I have used K2 aviation about 16 years back when I visited Alaska and so I decided to use them again! the weather was perfect so we got to see the Mt Denali and also the surrounding mountains in the area.  We also were able to land on the glacier due to good weather conditions.  Our pilot Chris was an excellent pilot and landed the airplane with great ease on the glacier.  Chris also explained in great detail the history and other information as we flew along Denali national park.  It is worth every penny!
The entire experience was amazing!! The pilot was very knowledgeable and the flight took us through amazing terrain.
what an amazing adventure Chris was informative, could not have asked for more.   Will definitely spread the word
Excellent flight and very informative. Booked this as a surprise for my girlfriend and was super easy. Everyone was great. The pilot was very informative and helpful. I’d recommend this to anyone.

review_title: Had a great flight tour around Denali
review_text: My wife and I booked a K2 flight and it was a wonderful experience.  We'd picked a day when the weather was supposed to be reasonable clear and when the day came, there were clear blue skies.  Even though Denali was spectacular when we observed from a distance, it was wwwaaaayyyy more impressive up close.  Our pilot was very clear about how the flight would proceed and had a great sense of humor.  He kept a running commentary during the entire flight with interesting information about the National Park, climbing within the park, historical exploration, geology and other topics.

Incredible flight around Denali!  Our pilot, Ryan was great. He flew in a way that allowed both sides of the plane to see everything.  The views are out of this world!!  Ryan shared lots of information - the names of all the features, the routes made by climbers, history of the area, glacier geology.... Although a couple of us felt initially nervous about the flight in a small plane, once in the air, all fears melted away.

Staff were very attentive and accommodating when weather conditions for my scheduled flight weren't optimal, but we were cleared for a flight later in the afternoon. Be flexible with your time as Denali weather is unpredictable and know that safety comes first with flights over mountains. Views were SPECTACULAR!!! Unlike anything I've ever seen before. Pilots demonstrated excellent flying techniques and were knowledgeable with the topography below.

Experience the mountain in a brand new way with K2Aviation. Beginning with the informative pilot you take flight and explore everything from Denali, Hunter, and Forker. Let time stand still as you land on the glacier and look around at this gorgeous mountain! Take it from these newlyweds - we wouldn’t have wanted to miss it. 
Until next time!

review_title: Uno de mis mejores tours en avioneta
review_text:
La organización estupenda, se olvidaron de venirnos a buscar pero finalmente llegaron e hicimos el check-in con tiempo más que suficiente. Muy profesionales y amables, sin duda, avionetas pequeñas y el piloto genial. 
Lamentablemente y por razones que no vienen  al caso, no pudimos aterrizar en el glaciar como teníamos previsto pero el tour fue tan fantástico  que casi ni nos supo mal. Los glaciares y montañas estaban tan cerca que casi se podían tocar, fue una hora y media de vuelo tan repleta de paisajes y emociones que no se podía aprovechas más. No dejéis de hacerlo, además Talkeetna es el sitio ideal, como el objetivo principal es ver de cerca el monte Denali, nuestra primera idea fue hacer el vuelo desde Denali pero nos aconsejaron Talkeetna e hicimos caso, menos mal, por lo que pudimos observar la opción Denali es mucho peor por zona y recorrido. Animo a todo el mundo a hacer el tour, no es el primero ni el segundo que hago en avioneta sobre montañas y este fue soberbio

review_title: Awesome way to see Denali up close!
review_text: We had to adjust the tour a bit due to forest fire smoke - but was clear above 6000' and seemed we could have touched the mountains!  Glacier landing was not allowed due to low snowfall earlier in the year.  It still was a glorious view of the glaciers and mountains on such a clear day above the smoke. Pilot's explanation  of what we were seeing made the trip even more enjoyable.  Thanks for the great flight and experience!

Les vues étaient magnifiques ! Nous sommes partis de Talkeetna, et le temps étant un peu nuageux et venteux, nous n'avons pas fait le tour en entier. Mais le vol a quand même duré 1h. Le personnel est vraiment très aimable, et a été très arrangeant lorsque nous avons annulé la participation d'une personne (sur 4 inscriptions) au dernier moment (la personne étant malade). 
L'Alaska est vraiment impressionnant vu d'en haut !

review_title: Most amazing views in my life!
review_text:
We were only in Talkeetna for one day and knew that Denali weather has a mind of its own. But to our delight the rain cleared and the day was perfectly clear, resulting in one of the most spectacular things we have ever seen or done!

We originally booked the glacier landing but the glacier was not in a safe condition for landing so we changed to the Summit tour. Last minute the Summit tour was cancelled due to high winds, so we sort-of reluctantly rebooked to the Denali Grand Tour since it would be the best option we could get. The Grand Tour was utterly spectacular. I was lucky enough to ride copilot, our pilot was fantastic and answered all of my nerdy airplane questions, and for 90 minutes we got to see the staggering views of Denali and the surrounding rivers, glaciers, and sister mountains up close and personal with INSANE visibility. We climbed to a total of 12.3kft and could see each peak in an incredibly personal and in-your-face manner as we weaved in-and-out through the peaks and valleys. 

90 minutes came and went so fast. Yes this can seem expensive to most, but damnit, do it! You will not regret it for a minute and you’ll have unreal photos to reflect on for the rest of your life. 

We are still in awe. Thank for the mesmerizing experience, K2! Just keep flying!
A most do in Talkeetna. Worth every dollar that was spent. Pilot was very knowledgeable and very friendly

Booked this with my father who was up in Alaska visiting me. We originally booked the Grand Denali with glacier landing, and was told we'd be on a Turbine Otter-- which made sense, given they're the majority of K2 and every other Talkeetna tour operator's fleet, as they make excellent flight seeing planes due to their high wings and single engine. The booking was pricey, especially when an entire 185 could have been chartered for the same money (and we'd have had seats to spare), but being able to land on the glacier was worth it, we thought.

When we arrived we learned the glacier landing was scrubbed due to the warm weather. Not much to be done about that-- we were disappointed but in no way upset about K2 for it. And besides, the weather was as clear and sunny as I have ever seen Denali, and smoke from the local wildfires had shifted out of the area, setting up K2 with the opportunity to give an absolutely amazing trip.

Instead, they blew it. We were ushered not to an Otter but a Piper Navajo, whose twin engines and low wings make it utterly horrible for a flight seeing plane-- probably why neither Talkeetna Air Taxi nor Sheldon Air Service across the taxiway from K2 have anything like it in their fleet. It is, however, a bit cheaper to operate than an Otterof which there were about 4 on the ramp at K2 when we departed. The picture attached shows the view out my window. I spent the entire flight with them obstructing the views and making pictures more difficult.

I won't be bringing any other visitors back to K2. Taking a scenic around Denali is certainly an experience, but K2 absolutely blew it. I'll be taking future visitors elsewhere.

review_title: Sights amazing, K2 not so much
review_text: The experience was 5 stars but K2 was not the reason. Paid for flyer with landing. flight time was 70mintues not 100. Pilot was not engaging. Very quiet flight.  Answered some questions. Obversely in a hurry to go home as he was in parking lot before we took off boots. But it was a safe trip.

We were lucky enough to fly with the amazing pilot Chad. This was one of the most amazing excursions I have ever had. It was a beautiful sunny day with clear skies. The flight was very smooth. Chad pointed out all the highlights. If you want to see “it all”, join Chad on a once in a lifetime flight.

review_title: Our flight over Denali was Awesome!
review_text: Our K2 Denali Summit tour was an amazing experience not likely to be forgotten anytime soon. Our pilot was very helpful with the technical aspects of our flight such as safety and the operations of the aircraft, and he was also knowledgeable about Denali and its history and features. His narration was informative and he encouraged us to ask questions if we had any. We spent a good hour at and around the range and visited many of the most prominent features. I would highly recommend a K2 flight to the summit as there is no other way most of us will ever see Denali up close.

review_title: This was a pretty awesome trip!
review_text: We did the Grand Tour.  It was so awesome!  We got pretty close to Denali, above the clouds, like it was in our face!  Got some pretty awesome pictures.  Our pilot was very knowledgeable. I believe his name was Rick.  He was very good!

I need to reschedule the flight for 3 times because of Glacier Landing. When I asked a front desk person, when was the last glacier landing, she did not able to answer me which is quite awkward whereas K2 Aviation giving advertisement always with Glacier landing. So I need to choose only Denali Grand tour without Glacier landing which is fine cause they can not land on hard ice or weather contsraints. However, as a Company they should have keep the statistics or records when was the last glacier landing or the ideal time of Glacier landing chances so customer can plan accordingly.

The grand tour was good but it would be nicer if the pilot would narrate the navigation during fly as it was depicted on their website pages how would be the navigation and what mountains and peaks would be covered as well as an handly print out of this navigation so customer can enjoy the total journey fully instead of just seeing white glaciers from the top.

The K2 Denali Flightseeing tour is an absolute MUST for anyone visiting Alaska! The pilots are incredibly personable and knowledgeable of the area. The staff is incredibly professional and considerate. Our flight had to be cut short because of weather rolling in but before we had even landed, we were already refunded for the unused flight time. Landing on a glacier is a truly remarkable experience we won’t soon forget! Thank you K2 Aviation for an awesome trip!

This was hands down one of the most humbling experiences I’ve had of my many adventures.  Landing on the Kahiltna Glacier at Base Camp on the south west slopes of Denali makes you feel very small in the grand scheme of things.  Patrick, our pilot, was stellar.  What an awe inspiring scenery.  It was a blessing to experience it.  We originally intended to do the summit flight with glacier landing, however due to storms the attempt was too dangerous.  K2 happily quickly and happily offered to get us on the Grand Tour with the glacier landing with the promise of better views flying amongst the towering walls as opposed to above them.  They were beyond correct.  I would highly recommend this experience!!  Well done K2 Aviation, well done.

Get up close and personal with Denali with the Grand Tour to view one of the most dramatic sights in America. You get a totally different perspective and experience seeing the mountain in detail from the air. Our pilot was fantastic. Just do it, you will not regret taking this tour.
Bucket List activity that was amazing. K2 / Rust’s is a well oiled machine. Very informative and friendly pilot. Breathtaking scenery.

K2 are an excellent, professional and friendly company. If you have the opportunity to take one of their tours I would highly recommend it. As a pilot I appreciate the skill and experience it takes to fly members of the public around one of the world's great mountains and to land on a glacier with delicate precision. Stan (sorry buddy but I guess you'll get some stick from the rest of the gang), was ultra-professional while also being informative and entertaining. The whole process, from booking through pick-up and check in was easy and it made for a perfect day that will stick in our memories forever.

This was our second visit to K2 Aviation as we had guests with us that needed to have this amazing experience. This Denali Grand Tour with Glacier Landing was even better than our first trip (8 years ago)!  We had a perfect day for flying and Chris our pilot was excellent.  Chris gave us information about our flight that left us with very few questions.  He took the time to make sure both sides of the plane enjoyed the magnificent views of Denali.  He also was very accomodating and patient of a guest that had limited mobility as she entered and exited the plane (even at the glacier).

review_title: Mountains at epic scale and glacier landings. This one has it all.
review_text:
It's hard to imagine there are better views of Denali and the Alaska Range available unless you plan to climb the beast. The glacier landing was a really nice touch and added an element of scale to this remote range. The vastness of the valley we landed in was hard to capture in a picture, the only way to get it is to be there. 

Our pilot was top notch - my dad is a pilot and sat in the front seat on the return flight. He was impressed. 

Can't recommend this enough.

review_title: Wow!  That is what you'll be saying when your flying right up next to the mountain.
review_text: This is a once in a lifetime experience.  My wife and I were in awe and it was worth every penny.  Our pilot was great and made the flight very smooth.  Loved it!!!
There's really no comparison. You can't see Mt Denali like this any other way. It's sure to be one of the most beautiful and unique experiences you've ever had.

review_title: High above everything else, the mountains reign.
review_text: We had a wonderful flight with great visibility and our pilot guide was not only knowledgeable but fun and entertaining. The views were great and the landing on the glaciar was truly spectacular. The weather was so warm that we didn’t even need extra layers!
Really amazing experience, very nice professional people and great and experienced pilot. Stan we loved you :) Strongly recommended

We had a family (10) vacation and decided on K2 to take us on a glacier landing.  WOW what a trip.  Randy the pilot was super informative.  Glacier landing was so easy.  My grandkids loved it as well as the grown kids.  We capped off a 10 day vacation with this tour.  It was a great ending to a wonderful vacation.
This was one of the highlights of our trip k2 were awesome what an amazing thing to do was land on the glacier  thanks again mark and debora andrews
K2 was great. Terrific plane, pilot and trip. This flight with the glacier landing was the highlight of our 10 days in Alaska.

We had a great experience on this summit tour. The pilot made our tour a little longer than was scheduled which was really nice. My husband had just summited Denali which made it even more special.  Definitely recommend.

review_title: Sunny day - got to see all the mountains!
review_text: It was a perfect day to see the Denali mountain, and also the 2 smaller ones next to it (the "momma" and "baby"). Our pilot was Chad Smith. He said only 5% of people get to see all 3mountains at the same time, so it was our lucky day!  I was concerned about flying on such a small plane, but the ride was smooth, and I was so busy getting pictures of everything that I completely forgot I was on a small plane.  I would definitely recomment this tour for everyone!
The tour is well organized and professional. It brought me really close to Denali which is impossible to do by land.

The Denali Grand flight tour was incredible.  To be able to see this amazing mountain up close at 12000 feet was such an inspiring experience.  Our pilot Will was very informative.  My husband took wonderful photos that are just not obtainable any other way!

Was struggling with how to take in Denali on a short trip, and this is definitely the way to do it.  Saw so much of the Alaska range, up close and personal, and a knowledgeable and friendly guide.  Glacier landing a definite - do it!  It so crazy to set down in the middle of the snowfield with mountains all around you.  Flying out of the snowfield, you're flying through a glacial valley, with rock cliffs to either side.  It really is a must-do.  BTW, I'm jumpy on small planes, but I was enjoying myself so much I completely forgot about it.

This flight was a dream come true.  You get close enough to the summit that you can see the trails the climbers have made in their camps and to the summit!!!  Photo opportunities abound as the pilot turned the plane in every possible direction zigzagging all around the summit while flying at 22000 feet!!!  Words and pictures simply cannot describe this amazing experience. Highly recommended.

Incredible, as I thought it must be, to be that close to something so huge when stll 50 miles away on the ground. Chris was my excellent pilot, adding facts and figures, history and smiles throughout our 90 minutes in the air. DO NOT MISS this experience should the weather cooperate with your travel plans!
Great trip guide was knowledgeable and fun.  Turned the place many ways so each side could see.  Had a great time
Incredible experience, a must if you come al the way to Alaska. We had a great day and it is highly recommend.

Our tour with K2 exceeded our high expectations. It was an amazingly clear day and it felt like we could touch the mountains. When we landed on the glacier we had it ourselves and enjoyed the cooler temperatures and ice. Our guide Patrick was professional, knowledgeable and fun. I highly recommend this experience!

We had a wonderful experience flying around Denali and landing on the glacier. I highly recommend it. OUr pilot was very experienced, careful and assured. Ifelt confident in him throughout. But it was exciting! We were lucky to have a clear day.

Our family of 4 did this trip and it was absiluetly spectacular.  The pilot was great and shared a lot of info with us.  The glacier landing is a must.  Really cool.  Highly recoomend and worth the price!
We had an absolutely amazing flight. our pilot was terrific and very knowledgeable of the area. i highly recommend K2 Aviation. the flight was worth the price.

Our pilot, Chris, was an excellent guide. Knowledgeable about the mountains, AK history and flight. By far the smoothest take off, flight and landing ever. If you are nervous about the small plane fligtseeing, this is the place for you. Could not be easier. Also upgrade to the glacier landing, it’s worth it,

The reservation desk in town was very helpful.  The checkin was smooth and efficient.  Most importantly the pilot, Doug, was experienced and extremely knowledgeable of all the nine glaciers and numerous mountains.  He positioned the plane often so everyone had a clear view of Denali, Foraker, and Hunter as well as other fantastic sights.

Although we booked for the Grand tour and glacier landing, the weather didn't cooperate.  K2 clearly advised at the time of the reservation that this was a possibility so we were not surprised when advised of the change.  They did offer another flight option (refunding the difference) which allowed us to see the mountain, glaciers and surrounding area.  It was a great experience and we will return

review_title: Fantastic experience! A “must do” in Talkeetna!
review_text: The Denali grand tour will not disappoint! We opted in for the glacier landing and are so glad we did. The weather cooperated, the pilot and office staff were phenomenal. Special thanks to Larry and Arwin. They made our trip extra special by being so helpful, informative and kind. Captain Mark maneuvered that plane like nobody’s business. Took us up close and personal to multiple walls and faces, while providing explanations of everything we saw. He then played photographer on the glacier so we all got pictures next to the plane. Thank you all for making our trip to Talkeetna so special!
We had a great time. Even though the weather prevented us from landing on a glacier.  We would definitely do it again.

review_title: Great trip and top notch company.  Highly recommended
review_text:
My two young daughters and I had an amazing experience on this flight with Glacier landing.  Checked out numerous glaciers, base camp, Denali, and Don Shelton Amphitheater.
 
Smooth landing and flight. Great planes, experienced pilots, and very safe operation at K2. 

Trip of a lifetime and highly recommend!!

review_title: One of the highlights of our trip!
review_text: We booked the grand tour with the glacier landing, one of the highlights of our trip! From the initial check in, the entire experience was a once in lifetime trip. The pilot  was very knowledgeable, professional and a lot of fun. We had perfect weather which was a real bonus. Highly recommend K2,

Originally signed up for the Summit tour but unfortunately we did not get to do that one since they did not get the minimum amount of passengers. However, we did do the Denali Grand Tour which did not disappoint. I would recommend taking a plane ride to see Mount McKinley, you will get the most amazing views ever.

Yes a little pricey but worth it. It is Alaska everything is pricey.
Beautiful day to land on the glacier. So peaceful and overwhelming. It just proves how small we are in this beautiful planet.
Our pilot was knowledgeable with a great personality. I never felt uncomfortable.  He explained the different areas we flew over and what it meant in Alaska.
Highly recommend

We went on the grand tour with glacier landing and things couldn’t have gone better. From the gorgeous, clear weather, to the special landing at base camp, to the knowledgeable pilot - everything was too special to put into words. It was a once in a lifetime adventure and I feel blessed to have experienced it!!!

We flew around the grand mountain and then the best was landing on the glacier.
The pilot was so infomative . He made it very exciting. Looking out of the plane you could see the hikers going to the top! Start to finish was a wonderful time!

Denali is so massive that it makes its own weather systems, so it's hard to predict whether or not you'll be able to make a glacier landing. But I recommend K2Aviation and their tours to *everyone* visiting Alaska, even if you can't get a glacier landing that day. It's enough be able to approach these majestic mountains - Denali, Hunter, and Foraker - and get a close look with K2's terrific pilots - and Sarah and the other office folks are terrific - but if you're lucky enough to take one of the longer tours and to make a glacier landing in the Sheldon Amphitheater, I promise that you will never forget it. It truly is a bucket-list adventure.
Our pilot was very well informed and provided a nice commentary. We had a stunning day with beautiful views of Denali and the surrounding area.

This was one of the funnest things I’ve done. Went on a whim. Ended up getting on an earlier flight. We were the last one to land on the glacier as weather closed in. I always felt safe. We flew weeks BEFORE they had a fatal crash but I felt so good about my experience I’d do it again, with them, no problem. Plan to go again this summer.

Excellent customer service from the time we booked our flights a day in advance to the time we checked out.

Our Pilot Chris took the time to ask all of our names and our expectations, then proceeded to tell us a bit about his pilot experience.  

The flight tour was majestic.  We had blue bird skies.  Strong winds at the Kahiltna Cut prevented us from circling around the mountain however Chris took the time talk about all the different peaks, faces and glaciers we travelled around which was a real treat. 

I would recommend K2 to anyone.  

Great Job Team K2!

The pilote was really nice and great, gave us many facts about the history of Denali.
The plane is spacious and great as well.
The views on the mountains are breath taking.
My friend and I had a blast and definitely recommend it!

We researched tour companies prior to and chose K2 from all the recommendations.  So happy that we did.   It was beyond anything I ever experience.   I felt like my whole Alaskan vacation was like "Living in a Postcard", with our glacier flight and landing one of the top things that I enjoyed the most from all of our time in your great state.   Our pilot was wonderful and knowledgeable and a joy to spend the day with.  The whole process of getting schedule to finishing off the experience was so easy with no stress what so ever.   We registered in town at one of your store locations,  so easy and convenient.  Perfect directions and recommendations on how to dress and what to expect.   
Make sure you have plenty of battery for your camera as I took over 300 pictures from take off to landing.   
Dress warm, double socks as the glacier is cold, but not a lot of wind; (I went in Fall), warm jacket, hats and gloves for sure
I saw beautiful views, had great weather and memories to last a lifetime.  
Thank you K2 for the experience of a lifetime.

My husband and I lucked out to have a crystal clear day for flying.  Ryan took us up and gave us an incredible tour.  He was so knowledgeable about the mountain range, glaciers, surrounding area, and Alaska fun facts in general.  The weather cooperated and we were able to fly all the way around Denali and even see the north side.  It was a breathtaking, mind-blowing experience.  We highly recommend them - very professional and easy to communicate with.  They were honest about what we may or may not see, depending on weather.  Overall, fabulous company and experience.  Many thanks.

We were blessed with perfect weather to fly and land in the shadow of Denali. The flight was wonderful, I got to sit in the co-pilot seat on the ride to the glacier landing. We were the only plane on the glacier at that time. The weather was calm and quiet, this was September 11, we had a group minute or two of silence, very moving experience,

We had an exceptional grand tour.  The weather was spectacular, light wind, and low angle sun light resulted in magnificent views, shadows and resulting photographs.  We even witnessed a large avalanche cascading down a steep frozen rock surface.  
Chris, our Pilot, was well versed on the geology, and glacial descriptions.  He was very calm giving us warning when turbulence may occur.  During the flight he kept us informed about where we were relative to each peak, valley and glacier.    He showed us the various climber base camps and pointed out the favored ascent routes.  Truly a trip of a lifetime.

I was meant to do the Denali Flyer with glacier landing, but was the only one booked so I was upgraded to the Grand Tour. Unfortunately, the weather prevented us completing this, so I ended up getting what I paid for! It really was a once in a lifetime experience and, if you get a clear day, take the opportunity. I would suggest though that the Denali Experience (the cheapest flight) would be sufficient, but do the glacier landing!

We took the K-2 Aviation Denali Grand Tour based on recommendations from two of our friends.  Both of the friends said it was the highlight of their trip to Alaska.  We did the flight on a clear, sunny day in September, and it was absolutely fantastic.  In fact, I took so many pictures and can’t bring myself to delete any of them.  Our pilot, Kevin, was very, very knowledgeable.  He knew when to talk and when to let us enjoy the beauty and grandeur of the flight.  I would highly recommend paying the extra money to land on the glacier!  It was especially a highlight for these Floridians that never see snow!

We had always wanted to do the Ruth Glacier landing so we booked the Denali Grand Tour with the landing on the glacier. We had a great day of clear sky weather to do this and it was a great experience. K2 staff were very communicative both via email with alerts and in person when we got there. They explained very clearly the possibility of cancellation due to inclement weather (not a problem for us) and all safety information was thoroughly explained as well. Our pilot and the desk staff were friendly and knowledgeable. Overall wonderful experience! Definitely worth doing!!

Denali is awesome if all you get to do is see it from the road.  Having the chance to fly among the peaks and land on a glacier is a not-to-be-missed experience.  The weather was crystal clear the day we were there, but we were told that was rare and that only about 30% of visitors actually get to see the top of Denali.  It is usually shrouded in clouds.  It's an expensive venture but worth every cent.

This flight was great and our pilot Chip was very experienced and knowledgeable.   The   weather cooperated and were able to land on the glacier.  Highly recommend K2 and this very safe flight experience.

Beautiful blue sky day to take the Denali Grand Tour flight! Our pilot was so skillful and calm, she put all of us at ease, even while flying so close to the mountaintops! This is the experience of a lifetime and so worth the money! If you ever get the chance, just do it!

Will was a fantastic guide and made our trip exceptional! All of K2 were very friendly and professional. Had a picture perfect day and one of the most amazing experiences of our lives! Would recommend and will do it again when we get the chance!

This was one of the highlights of our Alaska trip. We did the grand tour plus landed on the glacier. The views were stunning! Our pilot Daniel was so informative and full of information. The people that worked there were helpful and nice.

review_title: Time of my life!, With a Glacier Landing.
review_text: My husband and I did the Grand Tour with glacier landing and it was spectacular!  I am so sorry that I did not get the tall guy at the counters name, but he was wonderful in helping us move up our timetable before a storm came in, so that we were able to see the mountain and do our landing.  Everyone there was great, and our pilot Kevin did an amazing job, letting us know when to expect a little bump and what we were looking at on the mountains.  I would go again with K2 in a heartbeat.

The staff at K2 were very friendly and accommodating.
The tour left on time and we had a picture perfect day for our flight with K2.
The scenery was spectacular, our pilot Rosemary was very skilled and informative, she threaded her way through mountain peaks while pointing out glaciers and peaks all by name. 
With over 20,000 flight hours of my own, this is a flight I will never forget........absolutely awesome.

This is the ultimate Alaska experience! You wont experience the majestic mountains until you've landed on a glacier surrounded by these tall peaks. From the very first contact with K2, everything went very smoothly. The flight to Denali was breathtaking and our pilot was very informative the entire trip out, explaining what we were seeing. And the landing on the glacier is a lifetime experience! I highly recommend this tour!

review_title: Thanking God for our good luck
review_text: My daughter, her husband and I were scheduled to fly with K2 to see Denali.  The reservations were for the day AFTER their plane crashed.  Although my husband and I were wanting our daughter to get a REAL good view/taste of Alaska.  Again, we said prayers after learning about the crash.  Condolences to the family of those who died.  Such a sad event.....

I was impressed by the company's willingness to issue refunds due to inclement weather, they went above and beyond to provide various options including a full refund. We got lucky and were able to view the peak of Denali, our pilot Chris was a great pilot, well informed and a good storyteller. While we didn't get to land on the glacier or see the foothills it was still a magical experience.

review_title: Wonderful way to see the mountains
review_text:
We had booked a trip with K2 for Sunday but when we arrived in Talkeetna on Saturday with blue skies, we stopped in to see if we could hop on a flight that day to take advantage of the weather. The K2 team encouraged us to do so we were on a plane within the next two hours (after a lunch in town). 

The trip was an amazing way to get close to the mountains. We included the glacier landing--super fun in a small plane! Our pilot was knowledgeable about the geology and history, as we as friendly.

Highly recommended. For a once-in-a-lifetime trip it was worth the cost!

This was on the top of our bucket list. While we were hoping to land on the glacier, the weather didn't let us. HOWEVER,,,,,,, we had a awsome time. We checked in several times and the staff was there for us. They knew how much we wanted this trip. We started by contacting them a couple of months prio with questions. They took the time to answer all of them. Then when we arrived, they were once again very helpful. The planes and equipment are 1st rate. We took off and we each had a headset. The interatction between all of us and the pilot was fun. The flight was like nothing we'd ever dreamed of. The views of the mountain made us just sit in owe.  Bottom line is that K2 was professional, they took our safety into account with everything. They provided a memory that we cherish. They treated us to a trip of a lifetime. Thank you for making our vacation.

review_title: Spectacular Denali flight-seeing. Don't miss the opportunity!
review_text:
Seeing Denali from the ground is awesone - seeing it from the air is inspiring, truly hard to find the right words.
K2 is a well oiled machine and works a process that leaves nothing out.  From the moment you make your reservation, to the time you get off the plane returning from your trip - everything is explained in detail, and handled expertly.  These guys are pros!
Seeing the "great one" up close with a panoramic view at 15,000 feet, looking down at the terrain and different glaciers provides a view of how this terrain was formed for eons, AND JUST MAKES YOU SIT IN AWE.
Kudos K2 - truly a highlight of our trip!

What an awesome experience with an awesome pilot that knew his stuff and answered questions throughout.  I never felt nervous or uneasy about the flight.  Landing and takeoff were smooth.  Can't wait to do it again!!!

review_title: Grand view of the Denali and neighboring peeks
review_text: Beautiful flight right close to the mountains with views you just don't get from anywhere else in the park. The glacier landing was fun and provided both a unique experience and also a chance to appreciate up close how big and glorious everything is. Having fantastic weather was surely a contributing factor.

review_title: Highlight of our vacation to Alaska.
review_text: Great fun and amazing views.  Pilot was very experienced and knowledgeable..If you want a view of the great expanse of the area, this is for you.  Earphones blocked the noise, and the flight was exhilarating but not scary.

The weather was too cloudy on our original date, so we ended up moving our trip multiple times and changing the tour that we had selected based on what K2 could accommodate.  We were SO appreciative of their flexibility, and the Grand Tour was amazing!  Rose Marie was a fantastic pilot, the views were incredible, and the experience of flying in this little plane was way different than anything we had experienced.  A highlight of our 2 week trip to Alaska!

review_title: Did the Grand Tour and Glacier Landing with Chris (Pilot) AWESOME Expierence
review_text: Blessed with a Beautiful Weather day and super flight plan to round the Denali mountains and slip into the pathway for Ruth Glacier Landing. Recommend for anyone that can make it.. a Bucket List item not to miss. Thank YOU!! Agree with my wife.. rating 1-10 this is a 10!

What a great experience to fly around the mountain, between the peaks, land on the glacier, etc..   It was amazing.  We were lucky to have perfect weather.  The flight was so smooth and the take off and landing were just as smooth.  It was fantastic and I recommend this trip to everyone.  Don't miss out, take the trip.  Originally two out of my group booked this trip, then one more the night before once he saw more information on it.  Then at check in I could tell my husband was getting more and more interested and we added him on at the last minute.  The office people were fantastic at accommodating all of our last minute plans.  No one had any regret after we landed.  It was a fantastic trip and I highly recommend using K2 Aviation.  They were fantastic.

We really enjoyed our flight and glacier landing. We lucked out and had beautiful weather so we had awesome views of Denali. Our pilot was excellent. He explained highlights during the flight but didn’t talk so much as to be intrusive. I would highly recommend during this tour, it was a wonderful experience.

review_title: K2 Flight around Denali and Glacier landing
