review_text: ABSOLUTELY JAW DROPPING!  Highlight of our trip to Alaska!  The flight was delayed due to morning fog, but definitely worth the wait!  Highly recommend this excursion!

From start to finish my mom and I were treated to an amazing experience thanks to K2 Aviation. We were greeted and checked in by the wonderful and friendly Dominick, who made sure we had everything we needed for our flight. We flew with Patrick as our pilot and he gave us amazing views of Denali and the glaciers all while answering all of our questions. Viewing Denali and the mountains from the plane and even landing on a glacier was truly an unforgettable and once in a lifetime experience. The glacier landing was the highlight as you're able to truly be surrounded by spectacular views of all the mountains in all their glory. Its definitely something worth doing for a truly unique view of Denali National Park. Cannot recommend enough!

review_title: 2 Hour Denali Tour with glacier landing
review_text: It was a fabulous time, one of the highlights of our vacation in Alaska. Everyone should do a tour like this when they come to Alaska, the absolute splendor of these mountains is just breathtaking.
Chris was our pilot and he was phenomenal!  Loved everything about this tour, including the glacier landing.  Would highly recommend!

We were a little nervous flying in a plane that lands on a glacier but this was incredible and well worth it. We landed on Pika Glacier in front of Foraker Mountain. 

The sights were amazing and a thrill we won’t forget. Spent around 30 minutes on the glacier and another 90 minutes touring the skies. 

FANTASTIC!!!

review_title: This was the best experience of our whole trip!
review_text:
We really enjoyed this experience.  Flying around Denali and landing on a glacier was so surreal.  The Grand Denali Tour with Glacier Landing will cost you $942 for two people, including all taxes and fees, but will definitely be worth it. 
The only reason that I did not give it 5 stars is because our pilot, Patrick, was a real jerk.  He did a great job of flying, but I would definitely request another pilot if I knew better.  
K2 Aviation did a great job.

review_title: Prepare to change plans and is AMAZING
review_text: It was the most expensive experience in Alaska and we had left half a day for the selected tour. After Memorial day they called the day of not enough people gathered for our tour so all our so they could only offer the Grand Tour. It only takes 4 people and the pilot to fill the small plane, choice of seats was arbitrary and of course the one next to the pilot is the best. I am writing this to warn you of this practice of switching times and tours without any prior notice and also the weather, the 30% rule. If there are clouds they admitted is good but not the same. If you can leave as many days open as possible, the mornings seemed clearer and supposedly more snow early season and sometimes less clouds, It was breathtaking and worth the expense. Did not do glacier landing. Just prepare to change plans if needed. The grand tour is the typical one for a reason.

review_title: The best, the very, very best experience with a glacier landing also!
review_text:
Mike who was our pilot, was a quiet guy, very knowledgeable and obviously a real professional. He shared all the important stuff along the way, pointed out all the must sees and a few more. He manoeuvres the plane to ensure that every gets the chance to see the same thing and in doing so it makes the trip a bit of fun with some of the turns! He made us feel really welcome and when we landed on the glacier it was such an awesome time for these two Aussies.

Thanks Mike and K2 for giving my wife an absolutely beautiful lifetime experience as this mountain and the flight with the glacier landing, was the reason behind our decision to go to Alaska, stay at Talkeetna and then someone ensured that Denali was totally cloud free on our trip. We could've reached out and touched the mountain it was so clear!

K2 booking online from Australia was easy and the staff we're fantastic when we arrived to check in for the flight.

My wife is now the proud owner of a K2 Denali zip jacket and when she wears it she relives her time of our flight around Denali!

Flying with K2 was the highlight of our trip.  We did the Denali Grand Tour with Glacier Landing, and it was worth every dollar.  Our original flight date had poor weather, so we rescheduled for two days later when we'd be back in Talkeetna.  When the weather was poor on our original date, K2 explained our options clearly and helped us reschedule.  The flight was incredible.  Once above the clouds, we had unobstructed views of Mt. Denali and surrounding peaks.  Our pilot did a wonderful job of pointing out prominent peaks, glaciers, and climbing routes within the Alaska Range.  It was all breathtaking and an amazing experience.

It’s hard to say enough about our flight.  We had the glacier landing and it was well worth the extra cost.  Got lots of great pictures from our landing spot just south of the Denali summit.  Our pilot, Chris, was great and I had absolutely no worries for our safety throughout the flight which made for a stress-free experience.  The total cost was a bit pricey, but the Alaska Tour Saver discount of $85 per person was a big help.  Also, our flight appeared to last a lot longer than originally advertised.  We seemed to spend way more time on the glacier than half an hour.  Also, Chris appeared to circle the summit more than once while waiting for an opportunity to land in the established landing zone with the other aircraft.  All and all, a great experience and well worth the money we paid; and that’s coming from someone that really knows how to stretch a dollar for value.  Don’t hesitate, “Just Do It”!!!

review_title: A Fantastic Aviation Experience with K2!
review_text: My son and I booked the K2 Denali Grand Tour with Glacier Landing and we were not disappointed with the experience! The weather was perfect and so was the flight. Our excellent and experienced pilot made sure both passenger sides of the plane saw everything and everyone has a window seat. This is the very best way to grasp the immenseness and beauty of Denali and combined with the landing on Ruth Glacier, it was an awesome experience we will never forget!

review_title: Seeing the mountains and glaciers up close was awe inspiring!
review_text: Denali makes its own weather. We had a total of 8 reservations over 3 days before it was finally the kind of weather that they could fly the Denali Grand Tour. We were able to wait it out, but if you are in Talkeetna for just a few hours, you may not be able to count on doing this tour. K2 is wonderful to work with and cheerfully rebooks your tour or gives a full refund if you can't rebook. They have loaner sunglasses if you forget yours, and everyone had a pair of loaner glacier boots to keep feet dry on the glacier. It was shirtsleeve weather the day we were on the glacier although we did bring along a sweatshirt just in case. My ears hurt intensely when we made a descent of about 7,000 feet for the glacier landing. Be aware of this if your ears readily respond to altitude changes. I had gum along and chewed it like mad, but the pain was real for several minutes. My only disappointment was that they do NOT record your actual flight for you to purchase a copy of. We were not informed of this until I went to purchase one after we landed, but they do offer a generic flight recording to purchase. Truly a once in a lifetime experience.
Other-worldly up on the glacier around Denali. Fantastic views from the plane and neat to land on the glacier. Have done this twice now. Still love it.

We were scheduled for the Summit Tour but the weather didn't permit it.  K2 gave us the Grand Tour AND added the glacier landing at no extra charge for 6 people for the inconvenience!  The tour was superior, our guide was great - so glad we did this.  Very much worth the money.
We found the staff very professional and communicative.  The weather did not allow a landing but they kept us in the loop at all times.
This trip was the highlight of our time in Alaska and so worth the money! We spent the litte bit extra on the glacier landing and are so glad we did.

review_title: Denali on a perfectly clear day
review_text:
We had an awesome experience.  Thank you to our pilot for giving us such a great view of the mountain range, the glaciers and an incredibly smooth landing and takeoff on the glacier.  One of our top 3 highlights of the trip.
K2-Aviation was fantastic from the moment they picked us up at the hotel, during prep time, flight and the return to the hotel.
Flying Denali is a much an everyone's agenda when visiting Alaska and K2 is the one to do it.  Thanks,

review_title: did the flight @ 4:30 pm ,took advantage of a fairly clear day
review_text: Pilot had a lot of additional info to relate about the climbers, camps & glaciers. gave us a great perspective of the true size of Denali & glaciers

review_title: Terrible views from K2 s Cherokee 6
review_text: While most of K2 sightseeing aircraft are high wing airplanes, which are excellent for sight seeing we were placed in a low wing Cherokee 6 airplane which was absolutely horrible for viewing and enjoying the mountains. I seriously considered asking for a refund, and would never sight see in this type airplane again.

review_title: Fantastic flight through the Alaska Range With Landing on a Glacier
review_text:
This was a spectacular flight! We had a sunny day and Denali was out in all it's glory.
Our pilot Stan started off with all the safety features and then after we were securely in our seats with head sets on he took off and narrated our flight with many interesting details about the area. It almost felt as if we could reach out and touch the mountains. Simply awesome and I couldn't stop taking pictures and videos. We had a smooth landing on the glacier and got to frolic around in the snow for awhile before heading back. I highly recommend this trip! K2 Avaition was efficient, friendly and I felt like I was in good hands with their very experienced pilot. The office is at the edge of downtown Talkeetna so you can walk to town and browse around or eat and drink before or after this trip. Also at their office is complimentary coffee and some nice hats and T-shirt souvenirs to choose from.
Loved every minute of this tour.  Our pilot was very knowledgeable ... we were lucky to see Denali "out".  Absolutely breathtaking sights.  Highly recommend this tour!

When we got to Talkeetna and it was a clear day, we upgraded out flight to the Grand Tour with a glacier landing. What an experience. To see the mountain up close and personal, and then land and get out and walk around. Just awesome and worth the cost...

You have to do this tour. It is truly phenomenal. Being up in the plane gives you a completely different view than being in the towns surrounded by mountains. I could not stop snapping pictures during this flight! Landing on the glacier also gave us spectacular views of Denali and mountains surrounding you. Everywhere you turned, your mouth would drop. Our pilot (whose name I forgot (sorry!) but he said he could be identified as the guy with all the tattoos) pointed out different peaks and views to look at throughout the flight. I expected a bumpy ride, but it was super smooth. The landing was smoother than a commercial flight! We had initially signed up for the Summit Tour with Glacier Landing, but when we arrived at the hangar they said the winds were causing unsafe travel conditions so we had to do the tour that was down one notch - the Grand Tour with Glacier Landing. They even refunded me the cost difference, as they said they would never charge for a tour they couldn't offer. I was pleased with the way they handled it, but I'm sure they have that happen a lot. I'm glad to hear they always put safety first and do not try to fly in unsafe conditions just to get more money.  We were concerned the tour wouldn't be as good since we had to "downgrade", but this one was absolutely beautiful and we don't think we missed out on too much because we were still able to see so much. I cannot recommend this tour to you enough - seriously, worth every single penny you pay!!! Just make sure you have a lot of memory on your camera for this!
Amazing views, great pilot, helpful staff! I highly recommend this company if you want an unforgettable experience :)

My second time flying with K2 and just as mind-blowing as the first time.  Everyone we dealt with was super nice and very helpful.  Pilots patiently answered all my dumb questions and all their suggestions for activities in town were spot on.  Would certainly recommend K2 and look forward to flying with them again!

review_title: Best Thing We Did in Alaska!!!
review_text: Stunning views, interesting and enjoyable pilot.  We also cruised the coast while there - but this was the highlight of our trip!!!

review_title: Stunning Views, Wonderful pilot, Smooth Flight
review_text:
I could not recommend taking a K2 flying tour more. It was the highlight of our trip to Alaska and one of the most unforgettable experiences I've ever had. 

K2 watched the weather carefully and made sure we went up at a time when the viewing would be good. We really appreciated their diligence about the weather to ensure a good viewing experience. Given the potentially flexible nature of the flight time, I would recommend planning only activities that can be rescheduled on the same day as your flight tour. We just did a local hike that day, so it was easy to flop our schedules to accommodate the flight time change. We also ended up on a better tour without paying extra since our rescheduled time was to go with others who had booked a longer tour.

The plane itself was comfortable and offered great views from every seat. Our pilot made the experience extra special by sharing information about everything we were seeing as well as happily answering any questions we had. He was also diligent about making sure everyone on both sides of the plane got to enjoy views of the best sights.

The one complaint I would have is that we were confused about being picked up for our flight. When we signed up, the form asked for a pick-up location and gave us a pickup time, but we were actually expected to get there ourselves. Getting there wasn't an issue, but the confusion about what we were supposed to do was frustrating. They also didn't call us when they knew our flight would be rescheduled. They were just going to wait for us to check in at the location to tell us. Luckily, our lodging owner called over there for some other customers and found out that they wouldn't be flying until the afternoon and let us know. We then called and we able to reschedule and clarify the pickup situation. This was frustrating at the time, but the experience was so wonderful, I am not docking them any rating points. I would just suggest that you call before you head there to check on the weather and pickup situation.

review_text:
We did the 45 minute tour and it was one of the best things we have ever done. It is by far the best way to appreciate the scale of the canyon. 

The seating in the chopper is set by the computer based on the weight of all passengers in order to achieve a good balance, so there is no point worrying about where you will sit (you simply can’t control it). All the views were good though. 

The seats are small so if you are on the larger side you may want to book two. I think they say the chopper technically seats 7 (with pilot) but it would be cramped with over 5 adults. 

Forrest our pilot did an excellent job pointing things out and giving us a bit of history/info. One of our party is very, very scared of heights (and a bit of flying) and so almost dropped out last minute. Thankfully he went and then afterward said he felt totally safe and relaxed the whole time. Someone else on the trip almost mentioned to the pilot afterwards that she too is a nervous flyer and felt good about the trip.

review_title: Amazing tour that shows the true grandeur of the Grand Canyon
review_text: Our helicopter tour was the BEST way to see the Grand Canyon.  Our tour started with photos with our pilot and proceeded to fly over the forest surrounding the Grand Canyon airport.  Our pilot warned us that we were flying about 50 ft above the forest as we approached the rim of the canyon and we’d soon be 5,000 ft above the base of the canyon.  Nothing prepared us for the grandeur that we’d see as we crossed the rim and entered the canyon.  The view was breathtaking and we got goose-bumps just seeing how massive the canyon was.  Our pilot was informative and maneuvered the helicopter so that we got awesome photos.  The tour went over to the Northern Rim and circled back to the airport.  I had visited the Southern Rim before and seen it from ground level, but this experience was completely different (and much better).  We didn’t even bother to enter the park and see it from the ground this trip.  Nothing beats seeing it from the air to appreciate the full scope of the Grand Canyon.

review_title: Another item checked off the bucket list

(he formerly worked at the Las Vegas location)  The journey was smooth and gentle – like a flying couch – which is critical to those of us who suffer from motion sickness.  The temperature inside the helicopter was perfect – having been baked on stifling flights over Niagara Falls, Ontario, Canada and Canmore, Alberta, Canada,  I was pleased the pilot confirmed our comfort level several times.  The views are spectacular:  full of colour and texture.  Some passengers are interested in photography, others are content to soak up the views.  The richness of any experience is determined by what you bring to it – asking a few questions of the pilot who flies tourists over the Canyon every day brought a whole different perspective to the Grand Canyon experience.  For those of us not paying in US dollars its pricey but as a once in a lifetime flight it was worth it.  (And for ‘balance’ reasons I got to sit next to the pilot – it was tough but someone had to do it)

review_title: Just WOW - An Experience Like No Other!
review_text: My family of 4 did this tour last week and were beyond impressed.  We opted for Maverick because of their fleet of newer helicopters with ample windows spanning down to the floor in the front.  Navigation to the airport and check in was so easy, with a relaxing space and gift shop to wait prior to the flight.  We chose the 45 minute flight because I don't know when my next opportunity will arise to take a helicopter tour, and I didn't regret this small upgrade in price.  We saw so much yet 45 minutes passed by quite quickly.  We travelled with our 7 and 10 year old children and were placed in a private tour with no others, which was wonderful and we all had a fantastic view, I was in front with the two kids and my husband was behind the pilot next to the window.  Our pilot Mark was phenomenal; very skilled in flying, knowledgeable on the geography of the Grand Canyon, and entertaining.  At no point were we nervous, even my 7 year old son, it was a very calm and amazing experience.  I was actually more nervous just walking on the trails into the canyon later that day rather than flying high over the canyon itself.  We never would have seen the Colorado River and some of the formations without taking this tour.  The only thing I would have prepped my kids with prior is that we were assigned seats once we got outside to the helicopter (they were happy and luckily we had no issues) and that once we're flying, we had to talk via the headsets.  I could tell my son started getting a little frustrated because he couldn't follow all of the pilot's information pointed out, but I was able to tell him to just relax and enjoy, there is no quiz afterwards, and he was much better after that just soaking in the sights.  You can't see the Grand Canyon like this any other way, it's such a unique experience and was well worth it.  It is an experience my family will remember forever.

Check-in process is simple and straight-forward - you need to arrive around 45 minutes in advance of the flight to check-in. There's a comfortable waiting area. You can't take any bags etc with you (you are able to take phones, cameras, water), but they check the bags in behind the front desk for you for no extra fee.

If you book through Trip Advisor they will need to see a 'payment voucher'. My email confirmation from TA sufficed.

Worth mentioning that you don't find out where you are sitting until you are there. We were lucky and ended up with front row seats. There are three front-row passenger seats, then four back-row passenger seats (two of which are window seats). I imagine this changes how much you are able to see. Our flight only had five people on it which we were told is the norm (it was peak time 12:45 in August).

review_text:
My husband and I booked the Canyon Spirit, 45-50min tour with Maverick Helicopters as part of a 3 week tour around the west of America. We booked it online a month before we went through the chat option on their website, where they gave us a bit of a discount and all the information we needed.
We were told to book in advance because it gets so busy and booked up and we were really glad we did. We did a lot of research on the different options of people to fly with and it paid off because there's nothing we'd change about the one we did. It cost $544 for both of us, which is a lot of money but we'd totally recommend it.

We flew at 8am on Thursday September 15, 2018. It was a perfect time and day. The weather was amazing and it was all perfect for the flight. You have to get there about 30 mins before the flight and you're weighed so they can allocate you in the helicopter according to weight, to spread it out. You can't choose or request a specific seat. Fortunately my husband and I got to sit in the front and it was spectacular. The helicopter is largely glass and from the front you can see right down to take in the view. However, there is a great view from every seat and I really wouldn't worry about where you sit.

Each helicopter took 6 passengers, plus the pilot. 

Everyone has headphones and a microphone so you can all communicate with one another during the flight and ask questions. We were fascinated by the number of helicopters that took off at similar times but yet once you're in the air and going over the canyon you can't see any at all. It felt like you were the only one in the air and it's very difficult to take in the sheer scale of the canyon even when you can see a lot of it.

There wasn't anything scary about it or unnerving, we absolutely loved our first trip in a helicopter. 

We would thoroughly recommend this trip.

review_title: This Should be on Your Bucket List
review_text:
A very professionally run tourist operation, and a wonderfully informed and expansive pilot who managed the dual tasks of successfully keeping us aloft while deciphering and answering our inane and long-winded questions. 
And coping with our infantile exclamations. 
Yes, we were excited. 
All of us. 
My partner and I, and the 3 other passengers - a generational trio of grandmother, mother and daughter, all on their first helicopter flight. 
We had a beautiful  blue sky crisp winter morning for our tour.
That moment the chopper passed from the forested plateau over the rim of the canyon was, alone, worth the cost of the flight. 
My mind was then scrambled by the sheer vastness of the canyon below and around us - the northern side is evidently higher than the southern side - and the breathtaking beauty of the canyon walls and formations, the colours, the light and the shadows. 
And the teal green of the serpentine Colorado way down at the very bottom. 
Time evaporated as we snaked along the river, rose above then flew over the northern rim - where we saw a herd of bison in a snow covered landscape - then re-entered the canyon further westward. I couldn't believe that we had been flying for as long as we had when we gently settled back on to the tarmac back at Maverick central.
Sensational, and a video of the flight available just in case you want to relive it.

We travelled from Scotland to the USA to ride down the famous Route 66. One of my most anticipated stops was to see the Grand Canyon. But it was also one of my most dreaded... perhaps the hype was all just hype... what if it was an anti-climax? What if it was a complete let down... 

Let me tell you it was much much more than I expected. From the ride north from Williams to the heliport, the treatment we received by Maverick Helicopters, the pilots attitude, the general experience and the Canyon itself... Wow. It wasn't a once in a lifetime, because I will go back again. And I will use Maverick Helicopters again. 

Our pilot (apologies as his name escapes me... possibly Pete??), set us at ease with his relaxed but professional demeanor, his interactions with his passengers and the revelation that he used to fly Black Hawk Helicopters... so we're in good hands then. Aaaand relax. I regularly use helicopters for my work offshore, but I know my wife was incredibly nervous, and the revelation of his flying experience really helped her to enjoy the flight. It also helped to lift off to the Top Gun soundtrack, followed by a quality "mix tape" of classic rock gently pumped into our headsets as we soared over the landscape. The pilots knowledge of the area and delivery of the facts was as enjoyable as the ride itself. Outdone only by the views we experienced... I have never in all my days seen a landscape so beautiful. 

Thank you Maverick Helicopters. 

Jamie and Lee-Ann

review_title: Dishonted. Unapologetic. I feel like i got scammed. Poor customer service.
review_text:
-Yes, the back seats have poor visibility when you are in the helicopter. The computer selects where everyone sits based on everyone's weights. If you are in front, you are lucky. If you are in the back, tough luck. 

-I am very disappointed by the staff's response and unapologetic behavior. I specifically called to confirm our reservation of the 45 min tour the morning of. They confirmed that all is fine. When we got to the reception after a 3 hours drive, we were told that there is smoke (that's been going on for 2 weeks) in the area and that they could only offer the 25min tour which flies through a different path. Maverick helicopters: WHY DID YOU NOT INFORM US THAT THERE WAS SMOKE FOR 2 WEEKS AND THAT ALL 45 MIN FLIGHTS WERE GROUNDED ON THE CALL? 

-We were given the following options: 
1. a full refund.
2. fly in the 25mins for a $30 discount. 
3. Try our luck the next day.

No compensation whatsoever for lost time, and a $30 discount is an insult when comparing a $300 45min flight to a $270 25 min flight. They save money on fuel like this. This is how they make money and none of the staff were apologetic. I will absolutely not recommend this company to anyone for their sheer dishonesty.  Maverick Helicopters: you expect your clients to call you 48 hours before to make a cancellation. Why can you not inform your customers in advance of any changes ? absolutely disgraceful and ruins people's plans that travel from far.

Know what you're signing up for before you commit.
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text: This was by far the most breathtaking thing we did at they Grand Canyon. We hiked down 3 miles and did the entire rim, but to see so much of the canyon with such a knowledgeable guide was wonderful. We got our pictures taken in front of the chopper with the pilot before take off, and then climbed aboard the air conditioned craft. We each got a head set so we could listen to their perfectly timed background music while we asked questions or pointed out things below. We flew over the forest then  into the canyon, across both the Colorado and Little Colorado Rivers with our pilot telling us why they look different based on geology, then across the canyon to the North Rim with information on rock layers, names of peaks, information on rafting and the rapids, explorers, Native Americans, and more. We looped behind the visitor center of the North Rim (a no fly zone) and got to see wild bison below. Then back across the canyon towards the south rim for more breath taking views and over town to the airport. Our pilot was great and leaned forward out of my shot every time I pointed my camera at his window. He knew everything and was very friendly. I wish I had brought a polarized lens, as there was a bit of reflection in my pictures from the glare on the windows. My only complaint is that because they need to balance their chopper, I was not able to sit with my boyfriend for the 50 min ride, but could talk to him over the radio and did get a selfy with him behind me. My view in the front was much better than his in the back. The craft only fits 8 people, and we had 5 plus the pilot so we all got windows. I would love to do this again. Save up and go for it!

review_title: A Once in a Lifetime - We Scored a Cracking Day!
review_text:
Straight up, this is the single most expensive activity we did on our whole honeymoon. We debated long and hard if we could justify the cost, and researched the other operators offering similar service. We decided to go with Maverick due to their air-time and route being the most appealing we found. With all the travel we want to do around the world it is likely this would be our only visit here so we dug deep and coughed up the money as we know we'd regret if we didn't do it. We were not disappointed! 

We knew there would be a few things that would have to go right for the best possible experience including the weather and our positions in the chopper. We came up trumps with both. We had a cracking day. No wind, so a smooth ride and excellent visibility. I can see people's frustration at being in the back row of the aircraft as you definitely get a better view up front and it is easier to take photos. (Though the bubble canopy makes photos without reflections tricky regardless of where you sit.) I had the good fortune of being the exact same weight as the pilot so I got a balancing seat opposite him with the little wifey sitting in the middle. The view from the back isn't terrible, but the front definitely gives the best experience. You just have to be lucky I suppose and I'm glad we were. 

The Canyon was everything we hoped for and a chopper flight is easily the best way to experience it in a short period of time. We headed to the lookouts afterwards and there is simply no comparison. The pilot was skilled and the commentary informative. Every twist and turn unveiled a jaw-dropping panorama of river, rock and plateau. You spend the whole flight with a huge grin on your face and wondering if it is all real. The 45-minute flight felt sufficient and immersive, I think the shorter one would leave you wanting more. Due to the cost, I don't think I'd do it again, but you'll kick yourself if you don't do it once when you have the opportunity! It is truly a once-in-a-lifetime experience I don't think you can replicate anywhere else in the world. I thought our heli-flight back home over the Great Barrier Reef was amazing, this takes it to another level.

review_title: Do it, don't regret not doing so!
review_text:
When arranging our trip to the Grand Canyon we considered the options for add ons. Ultimately the only one we organised in advance was a helicopter flight. We did so because it was our first visit to the Grand Canyon and possibly the only one given all of the other places we have on our list to visit.

Having done our research we decided on Maverick Helicopters and chose the Canyon Spirit flight. Although a little more expensive than some flights (there are shorter flights) the time in the air was approximately 45 minutes.

It was also ideal as Maverick have a base at Grand Canyon Airport, Hwy 64, Grand Canyon just 5 minutes from where we were staying at the Best Western Grand Canyon enabling us to make best use of every minute of or trip.

When first booking we were advised by our travel company that a flight time couldn't be guaranteed. Despite that we expressed a preference for an early flight to hopefully capture the views in a good light and to enable the rest of the day for other exploration of the area. Nearer our departure we made contact with Maverick and learned that weather and all else permitting our flight would be the first of the day at 08:00 am and that we needed to be there 30 minutes before. We also phoned as requested the day before our flight to check in.

We arrived early on the day at 07:20 am and checked in. We were weighed as part of the process and then waited with anticipation.

Shortly before our flight our pilot Daniel, called or name out along with the remaining passenger - 6 in total leaving one seat empty. We were escorted out onto the tarmac where we had our photographs taken by Maverick in our individual family groups with the pilot before being allocated our seats and given a safety briefing. We assume seats were allocated on the basis of balancing the weight of the group but it avoided a free for all over who would sit where.

The ECO-Star (EC130) helicopter made by Airbus Helicopters was a eight seater - the pilot plus six passengers i.e. two rows of four.

My wife sat in the front next to the pilot and me behind him next to the window. That said every seat had a great view. As wearing headphones is necessary in order to communicate we were all able to interact with the pilot who gave a great commentary. The whole flight including audio was recorded using a camera mounted on the front of the helicopter meaning that those of us who wanted to could purchase a copy along with a nice plaque including the pre-flight photograph.

Following take off we departed from the Grand Canyon South Rim over the Kaibab National Forest before reaching the rim of the Canyon that dropped away before us ....... this really was a spectacular view and incredible feeling. Flying over the Canyon we could see for miles. The North rim and eastern edge then cam into view something that many visitors don't see and nor would we if it hadn't been for the flight. We then followed the Colorado River and were able to see the water flowing at the foot of the Canyon. Flying through the widest and deepest part of the Canyon we were able to take as many photographs as we liked and in my case GoPro footage of almost the entire flight.

Crossing the Colorado River we left the Grand Canyon and returned to base.

On landing and once it was safe to alight we were able to take our own photographs around the helicopter including with our pilot.

We then returned to the terminal building where those of us who wanted could purchase a DVD recording of the flight and or plaque with our pre-flight photograph as a memento. We don't ordinarily purchase such things but this was a very special experience so we can now relive it with friends and family.

We have some amazing memories and great photographs. It was an incredible, beautiful and absolutely awesome experience that we would highly recommend.
 
If you want to do this don't wait until it's too late plan ahead to be sure you can get a flight.

Special thanks go to Daniel our pilot for making our experience so good.

review_text:
We decided on the Maverick Helicopter Tour as it seemed that they had newer equipment than the other tour companies in the area. You meet at the Tusayan Airport which is outside of the Grand Canyon National Park (It is just outside of Tusayan). They have a large parking lot and guest services building with a gift shop, vending machines and restrooms. Check-in is fast and easy. They do take your weight (no lying about your weight, as you actually stand on a scale) which they use to assign your seating on the helicopter to balance the weight. You can request a front seat but they cannot guarantee specific seating but will give you preference if you ask in advance. Once everyone is checked in the pilot will call out your name and give you a seat assignment. You are provided with a life preserver that you wear around your waist and are assisted in getting in the helicopter. Once in, you put on your headphones and get a quick safety check. (you should wear dark clothing without prints so that you don't get a reflection off the inside of the glass when you take photos). The flight is about 45 minutes and there are no restrooms on the helicopter and no stops until you get back to the airport (as my Mother always told me, go now or forever hold your pees). The seats are very comfortable (seating for 7 including the pilot) and the helicopter is surprisingly quiet from others I have flown in. The weather was clear and the flight very calm and smooth.

Once everyone is secure the pilot takes off and introduces himself and finds out a little bit about you. You initially fly over the pine forests and listen to a play list and commentary through your headphones. Then you fly out over the Canyon itself. The view is spectacular as the trees and land immediately end and fall away from view and you are now hovering 4,000 feet above the Canyon Floor! The pilot forewarned us just before we cleared the trees and got our first panoramic view of the Canyon but it is still breathtaking! The pilot describes the various areas of the Canyon and sights and flies along both the South and North Rims as well as along the Colorado River. You can ask questions through your headsets and the pilot is more than happy to respond and elaborate on his narration. Although we viewed the Canyon from the South Rim, the Rim Trails, the Bright Angel Trail and the West Rim, this is a unique "not to miss" way to see the Canyon if your budget allows.

After about 45 minutes we landed back at the airport and they took pictures of us by the helicopter (with or without the pilot) and using their camera and ours. Although not required or requested, we did give a small gratuity to the pilot which I'm sure he appreciated. When we got back into the gift shop they had photos on the wall that you could purchase as well as a dvd of your specific flight made during the actual flight. Unfortunately the camera on our helicopter malfunctioned on our flight so we couldn't purchase the dvd of our flight but because we had asked to buy the dvd they gave us a complimentary copy of their generic dvd of the helicopter flight (very considerate and professional). 

The price for the helicopter flight was about $300 per person for about 45 minutes but was well worth it. If you want to get a different perspective of the Grand Canyon, this is definitely not a tour to miss! I would highly recommend both the helicopter flight and Maverick Helicopters as the tour provider.

review_text:
This was my first ever ride in a helicopter and the best location to take the ride! I was fortunate to get a window seat where I made lots of pictures. Most of the pictures turned out great. The flight lasted 45 minutes and was well worth the time and $300 cost. 

This helicopter tour occurred during my first visit to Grand Canyon National Park. This tour was not included in Grand Canyon Railway Hotel "Rails to the Rim Plus" package and was purchased separately. If you're staying inside the park, keep in mind the heliport is located outside the park. Make sure you have your railway tickets (or other documentation) on hand so you can get back into the park without having to pay the entrance fee. 

Finally, when you make a reservation, you will be asked for your body weight. When you check in at the heliport, the agent will require you to "weigh in."

review_title: A must-do for lovers of views and vistas!
review_text: My husband and I, along with two other unrelated couples, had an excellent Grand Canyon Maverick Helicopters tour on Thanksgiving Day at noon, leaving from the Tusayan airport near the south rim. Our copter held 7 guests, so we had one extra space, which was nice. The seating arrangement is done by weight, so you may not get your optimum seat. (I would have picked next to the pilot looking ahead, but got a side window in the back row, which was fine. We didn't land again until the end, so no opportunity to change seats.) Our pilot, B.J., was calm, experienced, and personable. During the flight, he told us just the right amount of factoids about the canyon and the surrounding park while an apropos soft rock soundtrack, curated by B.J., played through our headphones, changing for each phase of the flight. The gray leather seats were comfortable (although not rotating) and there were excellent views available, both near and far as we flew in different directions over the sunny south rim and the snowy north rim and (mostly) in between them, looking down at the cliffs and Colorado River far below us. The 30+-minute canyon tour was a good length for appreciating the scope and grandeur of the canyon, although I could have spent all day out there gliding over those views! The take-off and landing couldn't have been smoother, and the spacious Maverick waiting room (with fireplace & restrooms) and gift-store are top notch. They took photos of us at the beginning and end standing by the copter, and then as we were leaving offered us an official photo and DVD to commemorate our flight. A memorable Thanksgiving Day, that's for sure! (One photo tip: Wear black if you don't want to see yourself reflected in the windows as you shoot your photos.)

review_title: Practice your "Wow"'s coz you're going to need them!

review_text: Highly recommend seeing the Grand Canyon from the air.  There are a couple of helicopter tours that leave out of the Tusayan airport. Our pilot was okay.  My impression is that he was newer to the area and didn't have much additional information outside the script. But I guess we all start somewhere. review_title: A genuine highlight, but not stress free! - July 11th 2015
review_text:
Sorry - this is a long review, but there is some constructive feedback at the end which needs reading. 

Having booked with Maverick airlines last year to fly from Vegas to the South Rim on a small plane tour, one regret was not taking up the option of a helicopter flight. This year my wife, daughter and I had planned another road trip but coming at the Canyon from a different direction - on the train from Williams.

My first interaction with Maverick was by live chat on their website in February '15. Spoke to a lady called Elaine who was helpful and informative. My big question: the train arrives at 11:45am and leaves at 3.15pm - what would be the best option for a 40 minute Canyon Spirit tour? She suggested the 12:45 flight, with 12:15 check in. It would be 20 minutes in a cab from the train depot so plenty of time. No they don't have their own transport but cabs would be readily available and she gave me the number to call one in advance.

I wanted more time to think it through before booking and it was May before I felt confident to reserve 3 seats on Saturday the 11th July at 12:45. Maverick advised me that we were the only 3 on the flight and that they'd need at least 3 more before they'd fly. Same instruction as last year - call the day before to check in and confirm the flight.

Our holiday itinerary meant we'd be on the road a lot during office hours. I called Maverick from San Diego 2 days before to confirm and they told me they had still not sold any other seats but not to worry, they usually do. 12 hours later we were in Williams with the train the next morning. Called again - yes they had enough seats sold so the flight would go ahead.

At this point I started worrying about the taxi. I called the phone number to book one. Unobtainable. I googled cabs in the Grand Canyon, but only Flagstaff numbers came up. Just have to wing it then.

Arrived at Grand Canyon depot at 11:45 - no cabs. Asked a park ranger who gave me a number for Xanterra who arrange cabs, but no service on the mobile. 20 minutes passed and we were panicking. We ran into the El Tovar and asked the concierge for help - she called Xanterra who said it would be 45 minutes…+ 20 to the airport = flight missed. She called Maverick for us and I spoke to a guy…he left me on hold a while and came back to tell me a car would be there in 9 minutes. 

We arrived at the airport at 12:35, sweating! From that point we relaxed. We got weighed and bags stored. Our pilot for the day was BJ, who took us out to the helicopter for quick introductions. 

There were 6 people on the flight, organised by weight. The helicopter has 2 banks of seats, with 3 available in front and 4 in rear. My wife and daughter were in the front row and I was rear left.  Views were exceptional in the front seats and excellent for me in the back. Not so sure how people in the middle of rear would have found it. But it's luck of the draw. If you are light and slim, you will likely be in the front. 

BJ was an entertaining and informative host and kept us all interested and engaged throughout the flight. The first 5 minutes of the flight took us over trees and scrub, towards the lip of the canyon. Then jaws literally dropped as BJ took us over the edge. Imagine sitting on  a rollercoaster as it attempts its vertical drop…now imagine that drop is 6,000 feet down! What a feeling! There was significant clutching going on as fingernails gripped seats.

For the rest of the flight we navigated from south to north and back. The colours, the lines of evolution, the difference in vegetation - its not something you can easily see just walking around the rim, but up in the air the stunning vista opens up magically. 

On return we found that Maverick had organised for us to share a cab back to the South Rim so we could get our return train. In summary, Maverick provided us with a genuine highlight of our holiday, rescued us from potential disaster and stopped up when they needed to. for that, it was a 5* experience.

However, I have some constructive criticism to make re the booking process:

Shuttle transport should be available to get clients from the South Rim to the airport. If you book as a package with the train company, or with Maverick airlines as part of a tour you do. As an independent booking you don't. It would take away the stress completely to know that you would be picked up and dropped off at the right time. Both trips cost us $22 + tip. I'd be happy to see this included in the overall price, just for peace of mind.

The on-line live chat team should be aware of the cab limitations from the train depot at GCSR. We were told that cabs would be readily available but on Saturday at peak time, only 3 cabs were running at one time. For the volume of visitors this seems destined for disaster. As the entire cab (and it's really a mini-bus) operation is operated by Xanterra there are no alternative options.

We highly recommend the Canyon Spirit Tour on Maverick helicopters. It gave us a fresh experience of the canyon. However, I would make sure you book either a package or have transport arranged for you before you arrive at the park.

review_text:
"Best hour of my life"--or at least that's how my daughter (not a little kid, but rather a highly accomplished and well travelled professional) described it.  While I trust her exclamation was hyperbolic, I certainly understand her sentiments, even if I don't share her newly acquired ambition to purchase a helicopter.  The Grand Canyon is vast, some 277 miles long.  Short of a couple of weeks on a raft on the Colorado river, or a very very long hike, it is impossible to appreciate fully the majesty and expanse of this natural wonder other than by air.  I'm a confirmed believer in enjoying landscapes slowly and under my own power and don't usually go in for this sort of thing, but the Maverick tour leaving from Tusayan left me breathless and  was worth every penny (and it takes a lot of pennies to fly with Maverick).  Maverick uses aircraft explicitly designed for sightseeing, which means extra glass, stadium seating, all seats facing forward and somewhat less noise and vibration (although you will certainly still need to wear the supplied noise cancelling headphones).  Other companies do not necessarily use these specially purposed copters. Since all companies follow the same route, your choice basically depends on the kind of aircraft they fly and the quality of the pilot.  Our pilot was tremendously knowledgeable, mixed a good deal of information with a bit of humor and made every effort to insure a pleasant and relaxed experience for all.  We happened to have the great good fortune to sit in the front row of seats which undoubtedly offer a superior experience--you can request the front row, but ultimately seating is determined by the need to distribute passenger weight.  We took the longer 45 minute tour (which actually lasted closer to an hour); there isn't much difference in price compared to shorter flights from Tusayan, and I can see no reason why anyone would opt for less time over the canyon, short of a fear of heights in which case they don't belong on this trip anyway.  I won't attempt to describe the sights you will see, since words can not do justice to the undulating otherworldly beauty of this place.  Its as simple as this:  If you are going to the trouble of visiting the Grand Canyon and can afford the fare, take this flight!  Economize if need be on accommodations or meals (you can eat anywhere) and take this flight!  (I've spent 8 years regretting not taking a helicopter over the Na-apali coast on Kauai--avoid my folly!)
Oh, there is one negative:  The staff at the terminal are unhelpful, borderline rude, our flight departed 30 minutes early, we were hustled aboard and were not informed until the last minute that you can't bring pretty much anything aboard other than a camera and a bottle of water, forcing us to make some rather hurried adjustments. (Do bring your camera rather than paying the outrageous fees they will charge you for a video of your flight or a family photo).  Bottom line:  Maverick ain't great on the ground, but once airborne, its a nearly transcendental experience.

review_title: Great way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text:
Let me start by mentioning that I have a serious fear of heights. But it has never bothered me on airplanes where I am completely enclosed.

The night before the flight (which was my first helicopter flight), we stayed at the Kachina Lodge in Grand Canyon National Park. review_title: Canyon Spirit Helicopter Tour: add this to your bucket list!
review_text:
Halfway through our 45-minute tour, our pilot, BJ, asked us to let him know as soon as he'd made it to the top of our "coolest thing ever done" list. I replied, "You hit that the second we headed over the edge of the canyon!" Truly, that moment 7 minutes into the flight when we shot off the plateau of Kaibab National Forest and the Grand Canyon opened up beneath us is something I'll never forget, not to mention the unbelievable views throughout the rest of the tour.

Maverick Helicopters offers several tours in Nevada and Arizona, and reviews of different ones are combined here on TA; make sure to focus on the reviews for the specific tour you're considering taking. My review applies only to the Canyon Spirit Helicopter Tour, which departs from the South Rim Helicopter Terminal, about 6 miles south of the Grand Canyon National Park entrance, perfect for people driving themselves. 

BJ was the ideal pilot: wicked sense of humour, very proactive about sharing interesting facts about the geology of the canyon, and able to answer every question thrown at him. I noted that he was also simply amazing at taking away the nervousness of the two little girls who, along with their dad, had the front seats, and he kept them engaged with jokes and questions throughout the flight.

My father and I were fortunate to each get window seats in the back row. A window seat is a must if you plan to take decent photos (a major goal for me) as you need to put your camera right against the glass to avoid reflections. Anyone stuck in a middle rear seat would not only miss photo ops but also have quite a restricted view. Currently, Maverick offers no way to reserve a specific seat position in advance, so you pays your money and you takes your chance. Since many of the negative reviews on TA reflect unhappiness with seat assignments, I'll bet that Maverick would find plenty of takers for special flights with reduced passenger numbers that avoid the need to stick anyone in a rear middle seat—I'd certainly have paid a lot more for that guarantee. This would still allow the pilot to assign the prime seating as needed to balance weight.

Be aware too that the pilots play music throughout the flight, and since musical tastes differ, you may not be keen on their choice. I wasn't (hard rock's not my scene), but honestly the Grand Canyon was so mind-blowing that BJ could have played an album of Inuit throat singing and I probably wouldn't have minded. I'll bet you find the same.

As mementos, you can purchase a photo of yourself with the pilot taken by a Maverick staff member at the start of the flight, and a DVD of your specific tour taken by the video camera mounted underneath the chopper, which includes the audio of all cockpit conversations and the background music. You are free to take photos to your heart's content during the flight (don't forget to pack extra memory cards), but not on the ground on the helipad, for legitimate safety reasons.

Check-in was quick and friendly. They need to weigh you for weight distribution on the chopper, but this is painless as the scale is built into the floor at the check-in desk; don't worry if you're not proud of your stats, as they don't broadcast your number to the room or even mention it to you. Note that you're not allowed to bring a backpack or handbag on board, so plan accordingly. I had my camera on a shoulder strap, and that was no problem.

My 80-year-old dad was grinning ear-to-ear throughout the flight, and hasn't stopped raving about it since. This tour is absolutely worth the $274 per person charge; I give it my highest recommendation. Heartfelt thanks to BJ and the Maverick ground crew for a priceless memory.

review_text:
The flight over the Grand Canyon is one of the most amazing things I have ever done and it something that I will remember for a very long time. It is ABSOLUTLEY BRILLIANT and I would highly recommend it to anyone. If there were a list of things that you simply must do before you die, this would have to be somewhere in the top ten. Seeing the Grand Canyon from the air enables you to appreciate it in a way which is just not possible from the ground. The pilot was extremely friendly and enthusiastic, ensuring that all the passengers were eager and excited before we have even taken off,  and his commentary and overall professionalism during the flight made the experience all the more enjoyable.

I took my flight from Maverick Helicopter’s base at Grand Canyon Airport, near Tusayan. They offer a pleasant waiting area and sell refreshments, t-shirts and souvenirs. The flight itself is recorded, and you have the option afterwards of buying a souvenir DVD of your own actual flight, together with a photograph of yourself standing next to the helicopter before take-off.

If you have previously taken a helicopter ride over a city, it is possible that you may have thought that it was good but not great, or that it was a lot of money to pay for quite a short experience and perhaps not worth the cost. If this is the case, do not let that put you off. Having also taken helicopter rides over cities, I can say that the Grand Canyon experience is in a completely different league, and whilst on a city flight you may get only around 15 or 20 minutes, here you get a good 40 minutes or more in the air. 

The flight currently costs $275 per person (plus tip, plus cost of souvenir photo, DVD, T-shirt etc.!) A common response I had in the days immediately afterwards when raving about the trip to other people and trying to persuade them to do it was “But it is very expensive”.  It is of course perfectly reasonable that any rational person will be apprehensive about spending such a large amount of money and question whether it is wise.

When it comes to this experience, my advice is this: Don’t dwell on it; if you possibly can, say to yourself ‘never mind the cost’, and just do it. Whether this is your first time in a helicopter or you have flown in one many times before, you are in for an amazing time and you will not regret it.

review_title: One of the highlights of my holiday
review_text:
We had booked this 45 minutes flight from the south rim before we left the UK. I am so glad that we did as the National Park was shut when we arrived there due to the Government shutdown.
The airport is easy to find, being on the main highway, and there is plenty of parking on arrival. The reception area is nice and large with a gift shop and plenty of seating area. We found the staff very friendly and helpful. What was a nice touch is that the pilot comes and calls you when he is ready to start loading the helicopter. This provides an opportunity for a chat and breaks the ice a bit. Following a brief safety chat you are taken outside to the helicopter where you have your photograph taken. These can be purchased at the end of the flight but there is no pressure to do so. The helicopters are very modern with good views from wherever you sit. Take note that seating is organised by weight to ensure the helicopter is balanced correctly. Once you get clearance you are ready to go!
The flight itself....well it was one of the most amazing trips I have ever taken. As we headed out over the National Park, the pilot pointed out all sorts of information along the way. He was witty and his commentary made the trip all the more enjoyable. Nothing any body says can prepare you for the sight of the Grand Canyon from the sky!
If you are worried about flying in a helicopter don't be, it is smoother than an aeroplane. A wonderful experience made all the more enjoyable by the effort made by Mavericks.

review_text:
We booked the South Rim tour plus helicopter flight and we were so glad we did because we had the most amazing 5 hours. We were picked up right on time from MGM Grand and then a 20 minute ride to the smaller airport in Vegas. A quick check-in (you will need photo ID) then onto a small 16ish seater propeller plane with our 2 excellent crew - straight out of Top Gun !!
The flight to the Grand Canyon airport was about 45 minutes and all passengers were encouraged to go to the flight deck (no doors here !!) and chat to the pilots who were very happy to also take photos. After landing we were met by a small coach who took us to the canyon rim - words and photos will never do it justice - the canyon is unbelievable - and with our packed lunch (included in the price) we sat for about an hour just staring at the views. The coach then took us back to the Maverick offices close to the airport where the best was yet to come. 
I have never been in a helicopter but there was no need for nerves as we smoothly took off and headed for the rim over the forest clad plateau. This was exhilerating enough but what followed as we flew across and around the Grand Canyon was incredible - I cannot put into words how fabulous it was and will never ever forget it. Back at base we then enjoyed another greta flight back to Vegas - a slightly different route with more amazing views and finally back to the hotel
If you do only 1 thing in Vegas - do this trip - worth every single cent of the price

Best experience I’ve had in Miami honestly. Pilot was awesome. Very informative on everything and was just all around a dope experience. Would recommend to anyone looking for something awesome to do

I’m really disappointed because I looked forward to this adventurous experience until I realized booking was a mistake. I booked for 7:30pm on 2/4 for my boyfriend & I. We get to Signature Flight Support on SW 129th street just for the planes engine to not work. I understand things happen, it’s life, however the way business was handled after the fact was by far the worst customer service ever. I may not be a celebrity but I am someone who obviously is interested enough to book with this company. The “boss man” did offer a reschedule and a refund at first but considering I was in MIAMI for a business trip, 7:30pm on 2/5 was just not going to work how I thought it would. I let them know plenty of hours in advance that I was interested in the refund due to the inconvenience and the first time I texted I did not get the response I thought was appropriate… please see pictures. Moral of the story I did not have a good experience and I would advise  those to reconsider this booking. Now I have to wait a full week to HOPE Groupon will issue my $150.
I loved it! My girlfriend and I had a safe, fun flight, and got to see amazing views. Our pilot was comforting and experienced!
Amazing trip!! 100% recommended, thank you for all Sergio!!👍🏻 They speak Spanish too, very communicative
Company double booked flight, delay in excursion. Pilot was nice enough, served juice not wine which was disappointing.
Leo, the pilot, is highly trained and was very courteous. The logistics and tour were very streamlined. The view from the plane is breathtaking.
A breath-taking experience. Really wonderful & totally recommend it. The pilot was very professional & friendly at the same time.
Very accommodating as we were running late due to traffic but they waited on us and under stood Book with them very professional

Awesome experience! Pilot was awesome and the coast is beautiful! 
Buttttttt the Champaign in sparkling cider. 🥴
Leider nicht das was versprochen wurde. Haben sonnenuntergang gebucht sind erst bei dunkelheit los und mussten 1,5h warten bis zum start.

Just amazing!!! Professional and communicative pilot (I think Sergio). I am a student pilot myself. It was a pleasure to observe great work and great views. The company changed time at my request very quickly. Thank you guys!!! You made my day. Jana
We flue for half an hour, all over south beach and N.Miami and over a nice island. The pilot was great! Everything was great!!
The staff very welcoming. Sergio was our pilot he was the best. The flight was everything We loved it

we had an awesome experience, the pilot welcomed us at the reception, gave a breif introduction about the tour, we then signed a waiver, and from there we went to the plane to start our beautiful tour, the view and the experience was awesome, I would definitely come back again and id highly recommend this tour to other.

once in a lifetime experience, I'm writing this review to thank our pilot Cristian, facilitated our tour, he was very professional and knowledgeable, i suggest you book the earliest time slot in the morning to enjoy the view, keep up the good work guys.
Such an amazing experience, we had booked it two days for our anniversary, the guys are very welcoming and the drink was delicious, thank you guys.
This tour was amazing! I booked it for my best friend's birthday and we had so much fun. The pilot was very experienced and showed us amazing views . I totally recommend this tour

Todo perfecto, una vista excelente, el piloto muy educado y atento, volveria otra vez
 A mi novia le encantó todo , y el champán riquísimo
It was my girlfriend’s birthday and I honestly didn’t how to come up with a new idea to surprise her until I have seen their tours, very nice service and very affordable, they made our day.

review_title: We have seen the sunset over the ocean flying :)
review_text: Such a priceless experience with an affordable price too, Seraj was our pilot he did a nice job too taking us in a nice view over Miami Beach in the sunset.
Awesome tour I’m so glad I booked it and it’s really worth it, the sunset view was really stunning I’m so glad we did it and will come back for sure
Super nice and the sunset view is amazing, the crew is very nice and Seraj is a very knowledgeable pilot, thank you all 😊

If you have not booked this tourist do it!
Everything is amazing, the sunset view is stunning its really worth it, me and my boyfriend had an amazing time, love you guys.
Never been on a flight tour  before. This was worth every penny. The view was beautiful and it was a wonderful experience.
Seraj was our pilot and a delight. This was our first flight tour and one of the best experiences we’ve had in Miami. He made us feel at ease at all times and also suggested places to visit.
We loved it, me and my wife celebrated our 3rd anniversary taking the Private Exotic Sunset Air Tour, it was such special anniversary.

review_title: what a fantastic tour epic experience!!!
review_text: my friend booked this as my birthday gift, and gosh we had an amazing time, by far the best birthday ever, the team even surprised us and extended the flight duration for us, thank you guys, much love!!
priceless experience with a nice price, love you guys, you made my anniversary so special Sergio is an experienced flight instructor he did a nice job with us :)

It was our anniversary, we booked the romantic tour. We showed up 15 min prior our flight. We waited at the reception, the owner welcomed us and dropped us to the plane. The view was amazing! They offer champagne with this tour
Fantastic experience! We did the Private Romantic Excursion Air Tour with Champagne tour with Sergio and it was magnificent! So relaxing
We loved it! This was the most fun experience I’ve done. We had an amazing trip from the beginning to the end, everything was smooth l. We booked our tickets directly from their website
Amazing tour! The view was just incredible and breathtaking! Highly recommended, we were very pleased and happy with this tour and glad we did it!

Omg it was such an amazing priceless experience! We took off during the sunset and the pilot extended our tour a bit more so we had extra time in the air. The owner and the pilot were extremely welcoming and friendly. I’m so glad I booked with them and their prices are very affordable. Definitely the best experience ever, completely worth it!

It was the best decision to take up this tour with them . Very experienced crew and very thorough planning for the flight keeping weather in mind and everyone’s safety . The pilot made sure we get the best views and pictures .
Absolutely beautiful views. Was originally to do a glacier landing but weather was not permitting. Our pilot, Josh, was awesome…. And looked a bit like Tom Cruise:)

review_title: A wow trip to the glaciers.
review_text: We booked this flight as soon as we arrived in Talkeetna as our excursions on the ship were cancelled.  What a wonderful surprise.  Riley was our pilot and we landed on the glacier and took photos for at least 20 minutes.  The flight and landing were amazing and surreal ! If you get a chance to go you should do it!

K2 Aviation provided several different tours to choose from, however, depending on weather conditions, will depend on whether or not that tour can fly. I had booked a tour with a glacier landing that had to be changed to a lower-level flying tour and the glacier landing was not possible because of weather. With that being said, the experience still was phenomenal! The entire staff at K-2 Aviation was professional, personable and helpful. Our pilot, Dorothy, was informative and friendly with superb flying skills. She would make sure passengers on both sides of the plane had fantastic views. She encouraged questions and answered all questions asked. I plan to come back to fly with K2 Aviation again, and hope the weather is cooperative for a glacier landing next time.

Unbelievable experience from Talkeetna flying to Denali summit and landing on glacier.  Our 9 passenger plane piloted by Phil was on the glacier alone for about 20 minutes experiencing the silence and  magnitude of this once in a lifetime experience.
Fantastic way to get true perspective of Denali !  Our pilot David was superb,  and a wealth of information. Highly recommend !
Very experienced pilot who also shared information with us. Gorgeous views and great experience landing on the glacier!

A very professional and friendly operation close to town. 
Phoned us back (to South Africa) to discuss our concerns with our bookings. 
Big, well appointed terminal which was well staffed to handle the people arriving for flights. Collect at accommodation was on time and friendly and stored our luggage even after the flight and took us to train depot for our late afternoon train journey.
Weather didn't allow the over Denali flight so only flew lower altitude but was still very good. Pilot's (Doug) explanations were really good and informative despite cloud. 
Refund details available on landing for lower level flight.
Flight spectacular -  as good as it gets!

review_title: Breathtaking spectacular overview of the Denali mountain range from Talkeetna
review_text: The K2 aviation experience was amazing. The flight was smooth, flying close to all the beautiful mountain scenery on an absolutely clear day. Our pilot was so informative, friendly and full of information about the area, the mountain climbing and the glacier landings as well as the scenery. We could have imagined a better experience and highly recommended to everyone.

Amazing unforgettable experience. Glacial landing is incredible and pilot is super capable and reliable. Would do this a million times. 
K2 has a long line checking in but were very helpful and rescheduled my flight for weather reasons a couple times. It does have a relatively small parking lot for RV so be mindful for parking there

Absolutely one of the best tours we've ever taken anywhere in the world.  Shuttle picked up promptly at the hotel.  We flew in a 1964 prop plane piloted by an expert pilot who was informative  guide over Denali.  Perfectly clear day so the views were outstanding.

I was a bit terrified of flying in a little plane, and so close to mountains, but our pilot, Tully, was wonderful and the ride was smooth and spectacular.  We also got lucky as the weather was pretty perfect.

review_title: Fantastic finish to an amazing day in Talkeetna
review_text: K2 Aviation is the best.  Our family of 7 decided to spend a day in Talkeetna doing a number of other tours but partially because we wanted to do our flightseeing with K2 Aviation based on all of the fantastic reviews they have received.  They do not disappoint.  Our tour was amazing and the glacier landing is spectacular and I highly recommend it.  Our pilot was wonderful giving us all kinds of information and willing taking pictures of our group during the glacier landing.  I highly recommend taking a tour with K2 Aviation.  The sights and view are breathtaking and absolutely amazing.

The entire experience was and will be unforgettable 
Josh was outstanding in his knowledge. Friendly and respectful 
Wonderful time

What an amazing experience!! We were referred to this company by friends and we weren't disappointed. They were very professional and friendly. We had the opportunity to fly around Denali and see all three peaks. We then landed on the glacier for a surreal experience--exhilarating! Doug, our pilot, kept us very informed and helped us feel completely safe. If in doubt, just do it! No regrets!

review_title: If you splurge on one thing do this!
review_text: We were so blessed with beautiful weather for this amazing experience! What a great way to end our Alaska 2 week adventure in Talkeetna. We did the glacier landing which was great. Our Pilot Chad was super! We did the 6:30 pm tour which was the last of the day and great light at that time and the last of the day so no rush for the pilot to get back! So, if you are hesitating on the time to choose, it can be good any time! I thought maybe the weather would be worse later in the day, but wasn’t necessarily the case. Tip- you can walk there from town. Everyone gets a window seat by the way!

Don’t miss this great tour. I highly recommend the glacier landing. It’s well worth the extra money. Dave our pilot was terrific.  He pointed out so many sites, answered questions and made the flight so much fun.

By far the best experience!!! Jack is a great pilot and we really enjoyed his flight. The glacier landing was fascinating, and the views were breathtaking. If you are wondering if this tour is worth the money, it absolutely is!!  They also provide sunglasses and glacier boots that fit over your shoes.

review_title: Such a great experience! Do it!
review_text: Absolutely fabulous experience! The staff at K2 aviation were so helpful in getting us a flight and landing on a glacier. Chad was our pilot and we loved his enthusiasm for the plane and the flight. Took great care of us. One of the best experiences of our life!

Our flight around Denali, including glacier landing, with K2 Aviation was amazing, and we would highly recommend them for anyone looking for a Denali flight tour.

Our pilot, Doug, was fantastic as he explained what we were seeing during the entire flight. He emphasized our safety throughout the experience.

This was such an amazing, once-in-a-lifetime experience! Our pilot was a rockstar and I felt zero fear with her in charge of our plane! She inspired a lot of confidence and I don’t even like planes in general, so I really expected this small plane to be a huge challenge for me. The views were absolutely breathtaking. I think I took over 300 photos. We did the glacier landing and it was such a unique and impactful experience. I cannot recommend it enough!

If you do only one thing in AK, put this at the top of the list. QA once in a lifetime "bucket list" item for sure. The landing on Ruth's Glacier was fantastic. The de Havilland  Otter was awesome! Our pilot David, was top notch! I can't say enough good things about K-2!

We were in Alaska in August and had reserved a flight around Denali with K2.
Unfortunately the weather did not cooperate. K2 kept us informed all day about the status of the weather. The made the safe decision to not fly. Yes we were disappointed, but when we return to Talkeetna we will try to fly with K2 again.

Without any questions they told us our funds would be promptly returned and they were. We had a confirmation email in minutes and the funds were posted in our account in 24 hrs.
Great safe service
Took the first flight out at 8. Pilot (Riley?) was skilled and very accommodating. It’s cold up there, so layer. The bowl we landed in was stunning!

review_title: Kinect glacier alternative - worth the ride!
review_text: The weather wasn’t conducive to view Denali so we were offered a tour to Kinect Glacier or a refund. We took the glacier tour and so glad we did!  Was well worth the money and our pilot, Ian, was great!

INCREDIBLE!!! We had booked the summit tour originally but it couldn't go because of clouds. They moved us (with our approval) to a Denali Flyer tour departing at the same time. It was probably one of the most amazing experiences of my life!! Truly breathtaking. Worth every single penny.

Beautifully efficient and satisfying organisation. 
Please be informed that the reliability of experiencing the glacier landing is not particularly strong; there is plenty of reliance on the weather at bay. 

Our pilot was advanced in his profession, and ensured that we were well informed of the history of the local environment. 
The views and atmosphere were remarkable- an excellent experience i would strongly recommend.

Totally worth the money. We are locals and did the trip with a glacier landing. Great customer service all around. Pilot did a great job pointing things out and giving local history. If you can do the glacier landing we highly recommend it.

K2 did a great job.  Very big operation but runs like a well-oiled machine.  We left on time, had a great trip, and saw amazing views.  I had to email them several times in advance and they always responded quickly and clearly.  The only thing I wanted was a bit more commentary as we flew but otherwise a perfect flight.  I highly recommend !!!
Dorothy, our pilot was amazing and did an amazing job flying us over the mountain. The visibility was good and we had a great view of moose tooth.

review_title: See Denali from the air if you're short on time!
review_text: We have a summer home in Alaska in the Mat-Su valley, and making the drive to Denali is a long trip. This Denali flight seeing tour out of Talkeetna is a good way to see Denali without making the long drive! I would highly recommend this. It was about 2 hours long, beautiful, breathtaking views, good commentary. A must do if you're in Talkeetna!

review_title: THE WAY to see Denali and experience a glacier landing
review_text: We booked a Glacier landing with K2 Aviation through Alaska Tour & Travel (which, by the way, I will give 5 stars in a review for them)An incredible experience, do not miss it! There is nothing like seeing Denali from the sky on the gorgeous day we had. Our pilot Dorothy was informative and awesome! Thanks again for this fabulous experience!

review_title: Thrilling!  I want to do it again!
review_text: This flight was easily one of the most thrilling experiences of my life!  Dorothy was our pilot, and she did a great job of explaining and narrating all we were seeing. And the flight was much smoother than I expected it to be.  I did not realize ahead of time how close we were going to land to Denali. We were extremely fortunate to have a very clear day, and the sights took my breath away!  I highly recommend this tour!  It seems a bit expensive at first but you will long long remember this experience, so it is well worth the money.
Excellent pilot and a nice operation. The flight was beautifully tailored to our photographer's needs and all around, it was a wonderful experience.

This tour was AMAZING! We caught a clear day so the views were phenomenal. There were 3 people in our group so we went up in one of the smaller planes and it was so cool. Our pilot was great and I felt like he had the perfect balance of sharing info on the mountains and also just letting us sit and take in the sights. I would absolutely recommend this to anyone.

review_title: Best adventure we had in Alaska!
review_text: Amazing! Life-changing! We had to reschedule due to bad weather, but the staff was incredibly helpful and responsive as we navigated around the weather and our travel schedule. They are fabulous! And the flight with Jack was everything we could have possibly asked for and more! The weather broke and we were able to see Denali in her full glory and Jack made sure every seat on the plane had the opportunity to see her fully and take photos. Landing on the glacier was breathtaking and smooth as silk. (Glad we had those waterproof boots that were provided!) The whole experience from start to finish was above and beyond any expectations we had. And to top it off, Jack was willing after our flight to show us the path we took on the topo map in the office.  Loved it all! Don’t miss this experience!

Wow!  Wow!  Wow!  This absolutely made my trip to Alaska complete.  The views and experience were humbly breathtaking.  

Jack, the pilot, was professional and easy going.  The plane setup was excellent.  Mt. Denali and the surrounding area from the air was SPECTACULAR!  Landing on a glacier was the cherry on top!
