Don't hesitate.  If you're here, do it!

We were able to do the Glacier Landing on Ruth Glacier!  We were in an eleven passenger Otter and the landing and take off were very smooth. Our Pilot, Dorothy, did an EXCELLENT job and was the first one to land on the day we went. Spectacular view and many photo ops. Our 40th wedding anniversary will always hold great memories of our Alaska experience and K2 Aviation made it even more special. Thanks so much!  Dale and Gail.
Jack was our amazing pilot and we enjoyed riding the Otter to a successful glacier landing. He was professional and helpful and made the trip special. Whatever you do, make this trip a reality.
This flight was the highlight of our trip to Denali.  We got up close to the mountains and we're lucky enough to see the Great One!

Unbelievable, once in a lifetime experience!! K2 was an excellent company to fly with. They were safe, professional, and friendly from the moment we booked. Weather can often change plans…we originally booked the summit tour but weather on the mountain had a different idea. K2 communicated with us the whole time and still made sure we got the best experience possible. Highly recommend paying extra for the glacier landing. It’s so amazing! Jack is a great pilot.

We were originally scheduled for the glacier landing but with the bad weather in the area they cancelled the glacier landing but we went on the hour flightseeing tour.  It was beautiful.  I am glad we did not cancel the entire adventure.  It was so nice seeing things from a different view.  Thank you to all for keeping us up to date on the weather, giving us the final say whether we wanted to cancel the entire tour are just part, I am so happy we chose to go through with just the flight.  
Thanks again,
Diane Cox

K2 ran a very professional flightseeing tour of the Denali mountain landing on a glacier and giving us an experience of a lifetime riding that small plane. I believe our pilot/guide was Dorothy and she did a fantastic job. highly recommend using K2, they seemed to be flying alot of people compared to the other companies.

review_title: No Denali due to weather; Knik was great
review_text:
We had such a great experience with K2 Aviation. We had initially signed up for the Denali glacier landing tour, but it was cancelled due to bad weather. The staff recommended the Knik Glacier trip, which had availability for later that same afternoon. We were bummed about missing the Denali flight, but figured we'd still do the flight that was available, and we are so glad we did!

The 1 hour and 45-minute flight was very enjoyable.  Phil was an amazing pilot and guide. We even got to do a landing near the glacier, which was a very pleasant surprise! Highly recommend booking with K2 Aviation.
This was one of our best expresses on our trip. This outfit is top notch and cares about your experience and safety. Great planes, great pilots and great service. Definitely recommend.
Thanks for your service. The pilot was very professional and shared great wisdom as we passed by important views. I highly recommend this experience.

This was an amazing experience. We were unable to do the glacier landing flight due to weather but the staff is so friendly and accommodating we got on this one and don't feel like we missed a thing. Flying through those mountains was breathtaking. Our pilot was so nice and informative. Truly a trip to make time for. A+

review_title: The best way to see Denali!
review_text: Well worth the cost! We didn’t walk on the glacier, but the trip through the mountains was truly awe inspiring! Pilot was great, smooth flight! Our pilot taught the owner how to fly! 40 years of experience. Loved every minute and got some great pics. The best way to see Denali and the Alaskan range.

review_title: Thank you for the experience K2
review_text: Our trip was spectacular!   Worth every dime we paid.   Our pilot Will was so informed and put one of our nervous travelers at ease.  K2 runs their business like a well oiled machine.  So much of what we have done and seen here in Alaska, seems like things have been MacGyvered or not top quality,  but not the case for K2. Their facilities were spotless and each employee we were in contact with was on top of their game.

My husband and I had a great time on our flight seeing tour! The pilot was super friendly and knowledgeable and did a wonderful job of pointing out various points of interest. Unfortunately the weather wasn't super cooperative (very cloudy/foggy) so we weren't able to do a glacier landing or go to the North side of the mountain, but we did get a glimpse of Denali peeking through the clouds, which was very cool. The pilot made sure that passengers on both sides of the plane had a chance to view the mountain. It was a beautiful tour and we're so glad we decided to do it.

Fantastic experience. Due to poor weather conditions on our originally scheduled day, we were able to reschedule for the following day when the weather was more optimal. Our pilot, Tom, was experienced and knowledgeable.

The views were amazing!  We took so many photos! Our pilot, Riley, was fantastic!  He kept trying to get a glacier landing for us and he did.  It was short but so worth it.  The group appreciated Riley's dedication to providing an enjoyable experience for all!  Would recommend K2 Aviation to anyone.

review_title: Weather dependent so keep expectations in check
review_text: Good trip to see Denali area but only average viewing due to the cloudy and rainy weather. Common opinion is that only 30% of people that visit the area actually get to see Denali. Glacier landing was canceled due to weather. They do adjust charges to reflect what you actually do since weather is such a factor. The route only covers part of Denali and flies up and around the Ruth Glacier. Pilot commentary was pretty average and nothing insightful.
Awesome!!! Don't debate whether or not to sign up....just do it!! Even with the clouds we saw so much and landed on the glacier. An experience of a lifetime!

We chose the Grand Denali Tour with a Glacier Landing and it did not disappoint--it was the highlight of our vacation! We departed at 8:30 am with sunshine and blue skies which gave us the perfect opportunity to clearly see all of Denali National Park's beauty. Our pilot, Ian, entertained us with Park history and interesting stories during our flight. It was a wonderful tour and we would definitely go again. Thank you to everyone at K2 Aviation for an unforgettable adventure and for putting safety first.

This was an awesome experience.   The staff were very helpful and friendly.  We were given overshoes to wear . It was a very warm day and didn't need coats or hats . The views were amazing from the plane and we saw a bear crossing the river as we came in to land, the weather was good enough for us to land on the glacier.  We heard and saw 3 small avalanches but there was never any danger .

My family of 6 went and it was amazing! Highlight of our 
Alaskan trip! Our pilot, Chad, was wonderful. We felt safe and very comfortable the entire time. Easy process checking in, getting gear we needed and getting loaded. Awesome!!

This was the highlight of our trip to Alaska!
The staff was friendly and helpful. The pilot was experienced and knowledgeable and provided a safe flight. Everything was top notch! I high recommend it … it’s worth every penny!

I was very apprehensive about flying on small aircraft in the mountains. Our pilot Chad was a great pilot. He told us he was going to be able to land on a glacier and he did. Great job. The weather turned out perfect for us. Once in a lifetime trip. Something I will remember the rest of my life. Would do it again in a heartbeat.

The sightseeing tour with K2 was fantastic! Our pilot was very knowledgeable and explained the entire preflight, expectations of weather, and pointed out landmarks. As a pilot myself, I appreciated the level of detail. Would highly recommend K2 and can’t wait to come back for another tour!

Highlight of are 10 day Alaska trip.  Phil was the pilot and exceptional.  A once and a lifetime experience.  As my wife has said many times, "Don't just see but make sure to see and DO".  
Thanks K2!

Worth every penny. We debated spending the money for our family of 5 for this excursion. My local friend highly recommended it and so glad we did it. Amazing views and actually watched an avalanche happen while we were flying about. Pilot Tom suggested the times to video as we traveled between peaks. Great video remembrance. Seeing and hearing about the glaciers was pretty cool. Can’t say enough about the excursion!

We highly recommend K2 Aviation.   They were very flexible on times/dates for us to see Denali and nearby mountains.   On our original time/date it was raining so the trip was moved a couple of days.     They still couldn't do the circle Denali that we'd booked on that final day, but gave us an amazing slightly shorter tour and refunded the difference.    K2 is wonderful, and this is a must do experience in the recommended town of Talkeetna.
K2 gave us a great experience!  Beautiful views of the mountains and Ruth Glacier.  Our pilot Tom gave us a smooth flight and tons of information about the glacier.
Josh was a great pilot! Never a worry flying alongside 5000' high cliffs. Or heading up a glacier valley. This was the number one highlight of our week in Alaska.

Was even better than I could have imagined.  Our pilot Dave was excellent and provided a lot of information.  He made sure it was safe to do the glacier landing which we did.  Appreciate that K2 seemed to be ultra safety conscience.  The views were specatacular.  If you are going to pay for one excusion while you are in Alaska, I would recommend one of the K2 tours.  We did lots of cool stuff while we were in Alaska and I'd say this by far was the best.  Thanks K2!
We had an amazing experience on this trip! Our pilot, Phil, was top notch and full of interesting information. Landing on a glacier runway is a one of a kind experience! Highly recommend!
This was amazing! You can’t beat the scenery from above! The pilot answers questions and gives insight on different mountains and landscape. This is a must on your trip.

The flight was awesome, great pilot, professional customer service. It was the best experience I had in Talkeetna, the views were truly amazing. We were able to land on the glacier at base camp, so cool! We saw the mountain climbers and their camps. Denali was in full view and clear. Would highly recommend this company.

review_title: K2 Flight and Glacier Landing - Do it!!!
review_text: The highlight of our 2 week cruise/land tour.  Views are breathtakingly beautiful.  Captain Dave was a great tour guide pointing out all of the sights.  The glacier landing was fantastic.  Worth every penny.
Step outside your comfort zone and spend the money and do this. Highlight of our trip. K2 was professional and First Class

The entire trip from the airport to the glacier and back to the airport was amazing. Standing on a glacier at the top of the world was a priceless experience.Chad, our pilot, gave us a running commentary along the way and answered every question.

review_title: Unforgettable and MUST-DO flightseeing and Glacier Landing!
review_text:
We took this tour last week while visiting Alaska, and included the Glacier Landing in our Denali Flightseeing Tour. Please trust me when I say you NEED to do the Glacier Landing!!! It is SO worth the extra money for the experience.

Booking Experience: Super easy and wonderful customer service. Unfortunately the weather was not cooperative and we had to rebook several times due to this. The ladies in the office were great to deal with and more than willing to refund if we couldn't get an alternate date (thankfully it worked for us another day!!). The day we were planned to go up, the weather started changing in the afternoon, and they got us up in the air about an hour early so that we could still do the Glacier Landing.

Pilot: Our Pilot for our flight was Jack and he was GREAT! Super friendly, funny and knowledgeable he made our experience a fun one. My son is 14 and wants to be a pilot someday. He got to sit in the Co-Pilot seat, so as you can imagine he was in his glory!! Jack did a great job of sharing history about Alaska, the mountains and the glaciers.

Glacier Landing: Again, you NEED to do this!! The landing and then taking back off were smooth. When you step out of the plane the complete SILENCE and STILLNESS are mind blowing! You feel like you're the only person in the world at that moment. It was a truly beautiful and mind-blowing experience. My son dropped down and did a snow angel in that perfectly undisturbed snow lol. 

Flight: The flight was smooth and we were able to get SO many amazing pictures while in flight.

This is an adventure we will cherish and remember always. Thank you K2!!

I had an amazing experience and the glacier landing was unforgettable! Planes are comfortable and their are amazing views the whole time. The flight was smooth and beautiful and we flew over the mountains and among the glaciers to our landing on Ruth Glacier. Our pilot explained everything that was happening and what we were looking at and did an incredible job flying the plane.

review_title: WORTH IT! (Pick pilot Joe, if you can)
review_text: Our trip was amazing. Well worth the time and money even if you have done that kind of thing before.  Our pilot, Joe was awesome. He made the trip. Not just giving a history lesson but really telling us what's it like to live and fly in Alaska. Thanks Joe.

review_title: Flew over Ruth’s glacier & grand views of Denali.
review_text: Absolutely breathtaking. Once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. Looking at glaciers. & granite peaks up closely changed my whole perspective on the majesty of Alaska. Had Joe as our pilot, he was fantastic! Felt very safe & learned a lot.

review_title: Unforgettable Once In A Lifetime Experience
review_text: Every detail of this trip was exceptional! We also got so lucky with the weather. From Pilot Ian’s expertise to being provided glacier boots for our landing to being able to sit in the co-pilot seat…. It all was so amazing!

We did a Denali flightsee and glacier landing tour on 4/27/23. It was incredible! Our pilots Sean and Jeff were excellent and funny! Very knowledgeable! Would definitely recommend this company! Very professional!
What an experience!  Pilot was knowledgeable and gave us a great overview of the plane.  Once we were flying around he pointed out many interesting facts.  Well worth it!

We had an amazing flight - I took my teenage son on a trip where he got to his 50th state! It was the perfect cap to all of our adventures. Everyone at the company was professional and nice. They picked us up, explained all that was going on, and took us on an incredible flight. A once in a lifetime experience.

review_title: First class operation to see Denali
review_text: GO AGAIN: YES! This is a first class operation that is flexible and willing to return your paid reservation if the weather is not cooperating. However, we chose to fly with them even though we could not see Denali and could not land on a glacier. We still were able to see glaciers, mountains and valleys.
The plane was the perfect size for our group. The pilot and co-pilot were very friendly and familiar with the aircraft and area. The flight was very smooth and the views were fantastic.
The weather cleared earlier in the day and our flight was late afternoon. The views were stunning. We got to see Denali.  Our pilot was great.
Beautiful scenery from the sky and landing on the glacier.  Amazing experience. Highly recommend. Experience of a lifetime.
It was a wonderful trip flying over. We were the only couple there so it ended up being just us and the pilot and so perfect!!

Its really important to note that the weather is a huge constraint on this activity. My boyfriend and I booked the flightseeing tour with glacier landing months in advance with of course no idea the weather. We got extremely lucky being the day of our flightseeing tour, was the only day of our entire trip that had clear skies. The flight was amazing, pilot Phillip was so nice and informative. He even took some amazing photos of us in front of the plane. I get motion sickness pretty easy but this was not an issue for me. Before boarding the flight, I asked if I could sit up front and the pilot said yes saying "its kind of a 'whoever asks first' can sit in the front". The front seat is most definitely the best view but they navigate the plane in a way where everyone gets a chance to see everything. K2 made our experience super relaxing and stress free. We stayed right in Talkeetna so we just simply walked to K2 aviation and essentially walks on the plane.

review_title: Great Flight w/ an Awesome Pilot
review_text: Our trip was a blast! The Pilot was knowledgeable about the area and made the whole experience fun! The flight was smooth and the scenes were beautiful! The office gals were friendly and the building was clean and very inviting! Looking forward to another flight with them in the future!
All around great experience.  Knowledgeable pilot.  Beautiful day!  Everyone was very polite and organized.

I would like to take this opportunity to thank you again for the wonderful flight experience with K2 Aviation on August 19 2022, around Denali. Soaring above the clouds with Leon was powerful and impressive at the same time. At the same time, a big thank you to the nice employee who made this magnificent flight possible for me despite the lack of capacity.
with all my heart Angelika Schauder
Germany

8/29/22
We were so blessed to have a beautiful day to feast our eyes on Denali.  Truly breathtaking. The ride was smooth and so memorable.  We even saw a rainbow.  Our pilot was amazing and very well informed.  Our flight went off without a hitch.  We would totally recommend K2 Aviation.

review_title: Canceled flight with VERY little notice
review_text: They canceled our flight 20 minutes before our check in time after driving over two hours. It would have been nice to get more of a heads up so we didn’t waste our time.

Absolutely the best way to experience Denali!   You can see all sides of the mountain and glaciers.  We were unable to land due to recent snowfall but they were great about creditong back a portion. Our pilot was professional and confident - exactly what you want in a small plane pilot.   I had never been on a smaller prop plane like this. It seats 11 and everyone gets a window seat.  Windows are bubble shaped so you can really see all around.   The ride was smoother than I expected.  Commuter flights bounce you more than this one did.  It's an unforgettable experience. Alaska is enormous and trying to drive everyone doesn't give you a chance to experience enough.  This flight was the perfect way to see Denali!

Originally booked flight over Denali w/glacier landing/walking. Due to weather/fresh snow, could only do foothills and no glacier. Got half refund. Courteous, helpful staff. Pilot let our pilot daughter be "co-pilot". VIEW WAS AMAZING!!! Can't imagine how much more awesome peak would have been! Great communication from booking in Jan - arrival Aug.

This was supposed to be the "cherry on top" for our family Alaska trip, since our daughter is a mountain girl and pilot. Due to weather, we weren't able to fly as high as planned, and fresh snow prevented landing/walking on glacier. (Sad!) 
Regardless, it was INCREDIBLE!!!! THE FOOTHILLS ALONE WERE MAGNIFICENT!! 
Pilot let our pilot girl be "co-pilot" (no controls, of course!) 
Great experience! Courteous, helpful staff. Half refund since couldn't do what booked. Great communication from 6 months out til trip.

When you only have one day to fly over Denali NP in Alaska and land on a glacier and the weather doesn't cooperate, you're out of luck.  However, we had scheduled our flight with K2 Aviation and they offered us an alternative flight.  It was spectacular!  Our very experienced and knowledgeable pilot, Lou, took us on the "friends and family tour" from Talkeetna south towards Prince William Sound.  He followed the sun and flew us over several glaciers and glacial lakes that most people will never see because there are no roads.  He found us a group of mountain goats on the side of a mountain, waterfalls, and stunning scenery.  His narration was fascinating as he not only gave us the history of the area but also the geographical/physical nature of the glacial construct.  We loved it.  K2 Aviation and Lou saved our day.  Thank you.

review_title: Incredible Views, Great Pilot and Guide.
review_text: Our K2 Denali Flight was best experience during our 20 day trip into Alaska and we did it all. Our pilot, Leon, was great.  He spent time going over all the safety issues and then took us up on an incredible flight around Denali.  Leon was very knowledgable and explained all about the many peaks of Denali along with the mountains nearby.  He showed us where the major climbing routes were and explained why the worked the best.  The staff at K2 were all great. Great flight, great day, great pictures and videos.  I would probably do it again.  The cost was well worth the trip. Dale M.

From start to finish was the best part of the trip. All the people I dealt with at K2 were friendly and professional. Our pilot was very knowledgeable about our plane and the area we flew over. If there was a down side it was that we didn't land on a glacier. But that was no fault of K2, it was weather related. K2 happily refunded that portion of the price. There was no fighting or hassle - it was in my bank within 2days.

I highly recommend flying with K2

review_title: flight was canceled but customer service was outstanding
review_text: Unfortunately, our flight was canceled due to weather.  we appreciate their commitment to safety.  and the staff was so professional.  they gave us options of rebooking or canceling but we had to cancel due to our plans to travel home the next day.  they were friendly and easy to work with and gave us tips on things to do in the area with our new found free time.

We were scheduled to do a tour of Denali but the weather was very bad.  They offered us a trip to the glaciers near Anchorage, which we did.  It was totally amazing.  I am so glad we didn’t cancel and went with this.  The weather was beautiful over the glaciers.

This was in the top two of our vacation experiences during our two-week stint in Alaska.
The glacier landing was awesome.  And the aerial views were amazing.

From pick up at the hotel to drop off at the train station, K2 provided outstanding and attentive service.  Pilot was most particular about the plane being in proper working order before take off.  Even though it was quite cloudy, it was a terrific flight and well worth it.  Highly recommend!

Had booked a flight around Mt. Denali with a glacier landing. Unfortunately weather did not cooperate. Cloud ceiling too low and too much snow on the glacier. K2 offered full refund or reduced trip with a partial refund. The latter still worth the chance to fly into the canyons and see the glaciers from above.

I highly recommend a flight tour with K2! Check in was a breeze, they have boots if needed, water refill, bathrooms, and a place to store excess items. We were told we had a 50/50 chance of getting to land on a glacier dependent on weather and clouds as we got closer....so I was keeping my expectations low...but we got lucky and Chad made it happen! Chad filled us in on various points and entertained our random questions. Again, highly recommend an outing with K2!

This tour was such a highlight to our Alaska trip. Beautiful and breathtaking views of Denali that you won’t likely see or experience any other way, and we felt very safe with our pilot Chad who was very professional. Thank you!

We really enjoyed the flight tour led by our pilot Mitchell. Originally we had booked the tour with the glacier landing but due to weather had to reschedule. Luckily we went the same day on a shortened 1 hr. tour. It was still amazing and he shared some interesting facts along the way. We felt very safe with him as our guide. Highly recommend!

review_title: Flight of a lifetime! Nothing else comes close.
review_text: This is the BEST way to see Denali, bar none! A trip you will cherish for the rest of your life. Very Professional and worth every penny. You will not regret it, I guarantee it!

Our entire experience was fabulous!  From Austin, our shuttle driver who took great care of us and our backpacks to and from their site (and had us laughing with his jokes), to our pilot Riley (also entertaining with his dry humor filled preflight briefing) to the folks at the desk, K2’s staff was professional and very courteous.  We did the glacier landing and we were awestruck by the peace and beauty up on the glacier.  Riley is a great pilot and we had a smooth and beautiful flight as we wove our way through the peaks. He also was great at answering questions and narrating the trip.  This was an experience we will remember!!  Thanks K2!
Super knowledgeable and funny guide made us feel safe and at ease for the entire trip. Amazing views and fabulous experience all round.

We booked a fly over and decided we would rather take a flight with the landing on a glacier.  K2 was very accommodating and allowed us to do this.  Wow !  This was a top three moment in our lives.  Flight was safe, secure and absolutely amazing.  So happy we were able to do this with the K2 flights.
It was a fabulous experience. Dorothy was our pilot & she was great! A smooth, safe flying experience with lots of information. The views are extraordinary and we loved it!!  We’ll worth the money.

Our K2 flight around Denali was incredible!  Our pilot was excellent and extremely knowledgeable about the area and the views were breathtaking!  We would highly recommend this company to anyone considering a once in a lifetime flightseeing experience!

review_title: Can truly only appreciate Alaska from the air
review_text: Our flight and glacier landing was incredible. Weather can be a factor, but our day happened to be clear and beautiful. There's almost no way to experience what we were able to see from the air, not to mention the glacier landing. Also very educational seeing glaciers from head to toe. K2's operation is first class.

review_title: Flight Around Denali is a MUST!
review_text:
K2 was amazing! Their wonderful reviews led me to them. Their competitive rates/discounts were a big factor as well. 

Our flight was canceled the morning of due to wildfire smoke but they worked with us , keeping us in the loop, and were able to get us booked for later the same day!

Absolutely stunning views!

We had the best experience with pilot Billy. Polite, detailed, and knowledgeable about his craft and the environment. Lucky to be a 30%er following rainy days. Thanks also to the young man who checked us in upon arrival. Articulate and friendly.
You may not get this chance in the future so take off with K2 Aviation it is a first class establishment. Kudos to all of the staff.

A flight seeing excursion around Denali was one of the things I most wanted to do on our “bucket list” trip to Alaska! And flying with K2 out of Talkeetna was wonderful. Our pilot did a great job, and the views were fantastic! I highly recommend making this as a part of any visit to the great state of Alaska!
Very capable team and smooth ride.  very special views of the mountains, glaciers, and glacier highways

Put this on your bucket list.  It was one of the coolest things we have ever done.  We will never forget this experience.  The pilot was amazing and provided a wealth of information regarding the glacier.

review_title: Tons of fun, friendly staff, very safe.
review_text: We really enjoyed our flight with Garrett. He had a ton of cool information to share with us and made us feel very safe during the flight.
My grandson and I went on this flight seeing trip and had a blast! We had a clear day it was absolutely beautiful. Our pilot was awesome too! Unforgettable experience!
Awesome experience.  If you are thinking of doing including a landing, do not hesitate.  It was a smooth ride both on landing and takeoff.  It is definitely a bucket list entry.
Even with less than perfect weather our pilot, Mitchell, was able to give us the perfect first time small airplane sightseeing experience. Thank you K2 for an unforgettable day!

Our family of 5 including 3 teenagers took the Denali Flyer trip with K2 Aviation this summer.  All 5 of us loved the experience!  We were worried about a bumpy ride in a small airplane, but the flight was so smooth.  To see the amazing Alaskan scenery from the sky was just breathtakingly beautiful.  We flew right next to the highest peaks we would have never seen without an airplane.  We flew over glaciers.  Denali was hidden by clouds that day, and we were initially disappointed but there we saw so much that we didn't feel "jipped" by the clouds hiding Denali in the slightest.  This experience was pricey for a family of 5 and we debated booking this - but we are so glad we did and we even think it was worth the cost of 5 adults!  It is in the top 5 experiences we've ever had, and we have traveled a lot as a family.  All 3 of our teenagers started hugging us and saying thank you for taking them on this flight once it was over.  We all agree this experience was priceless and are so grateful we were able to experience this together.

We were supposed to have the "Grand Denali" flight, but due to weather and the clouds around the mountain we were given an alternative. At first, we were saddened that our flight was changed, but after we got in the air and flew over this vast mountain range all was forgotten. And, we thought we were not going to be able to land and we did! A moment that we will always remember. 
So much depends on nature. Be patient.

An unforgettable experience. It doesn't feel real. We did this in early July 2022. When you get out of the plane on the glacier it doesn't even feel real. The wonder and beauty that you will see is unlike anything  else. The pilot did everything to make us feel safe and comfortable.
One of the best charters I've ever taken. Gorgeous views of Denali. Landing on glacier was spectacular. Most importantly, K2's emphasis on safety.

Our original evening flight canceled due to weather. We given option of money returned or reschedule. You rescheduled us for first thing next morning.  This allowed us to catch the 11:20 train back to Fairbanks. I can’t remember pilots name but he was wonderful and informative. It was a plane for 10. The people manning the front counter were very helpful.  Connor, the shuttle driver got us to the train station in time to catch our train after we landed. We were also allowed to store our luggage in locked room while flying.  K2 is a number one company in our opinion.

Absolutely amazing experience, impressive top notch organization. We were extremely impressed with K2, not just because we had a perfect day to fly, but because of the confidence I had in the company, pilot and operations, which were solidified at every touch point throughout. I think that we all feel a little vulnerable when going up in small planes (justifiably so), so the ‘trust’ factor is extremely important. These guys were the *real deal*. We flew with Joe Talbot. He’s got about 6k hours and multiple ratings as a pilot. He was a also great guide and we felt extremely safe and comforts the entire time. Like most, before we left for AK, I’d read the reviews on K2. Having seen a small handful of negative ones that seemed to blame them for weather and timing, and now having flown w them myself, those reviews remind me of when people slam a product in Amazon reviews because the UPS guy threw it over their fence:) 

Will 100% fly with K2 again. Thanks for an amazing experience!!!
Our pilot Billy was excellent. We had perfect weather and landed on the glacier. Without a doubt, the most spectacular flight of my life.

Denali only shows her face 30% of the time due to weather conditions. Flying around the peaks above clouds and landing on its famous glacier makes your denali experience unforgettable. Our pilot Joe took excellent photos of us. Thanks Joe!
It was one of the most amazing experiences we had. Our pilot went above and beyond to make this a great trip.
Great experience. Do it. Young kids had a blast and the views were incredible. Put at the top of your Alaska trip itinerary.
Top notch outfit and life changing trip.  I wanted to turn around and do it again immediately.  Highly recommend
Friendly people and incredible views.  I was hesitant because it's pricey, but it was totally worth the experience

We were told at check in we would likely not see the mountain but could cancel and receive a refund.  Weather related.  We said heck no.  We came a long way to take this flight and will just see what we see.  Half way between Talkeetna and the mountain the pilot got word from the flight that left before us that the weather had cleared!  Amazing to see Denali close up. Take the flight and ask for Billy for your pilot.  He was great!
Loved the ride & the service was excellent! We were treated very kindly and professionally. Wonderful!

review_title: Beautiful Scenic Flight to truly appreciate Mount Denali and the Alaskan Range
review_text: Phenomenal flight experience in a small Cessna 185. There were 4 of us and the pilot. The morning had perfect view of Denali. It was incredible how small the planes that had landed on Denali appeared from the sky. Due to a fire north of Denali, there has been a lot of smoke in the area, but it had cleared for the few days I was around Talkeetna! Would highly recommend on a clear day to go up!
Weather was perfect. Pilot was very skilled, professional, knowledgeable and friendly. This made for a relaxing and awesome trip. Beyond our expectations. Highly recommended!
Very nice flight, the pilot was professional and did a great job. I would recommend 10/10. I would also highly recommend the glacier landing.
Loved the glacier flight and our pilot Billy!  A must-do when in Alaska! So much to see and Denali, wow! The landing on the glacier was perfect and my photos turned out great!
Our guide was very knowledgeable and an amazing pilot. We got to see Denali and could even see the tents of the base camp for people trying to climb the mountain. It was a very cool experience.
We flew above the smoke and got up close and personal with Denali and the surrounding mountains. Smooth flight, comfortable, and a friendly pilot.

We made our reservations 2 months in advance not really knowing what to expect. The van picked us up in town and drove us out to the Talkeetna airstrip. The check-in process was quick but I did have to dig a little to find my size in (the provided) snow ‘over shoe’. The flight up provided amazing views of the Alaska Range and our pilot provided a lot of history and knowledge about the area, the mountains and of course, the Glaciers!  We saw several of them from the air and then landing was awesome, smooth flight and glacier landing, wish we could have stayed up there longer…it was breathtaking to be in the middle of the glacier surrounded by the granite peaks, it was hard to take in the scale of it all! We will be doing this tour again for sure with more of our family!

review_title: Mt. Denali National Park air tour
review_text: We had a very enjoyable 90-minute air tour of Mt. Denali National Park, seeing the peaks and glaciers up close. The pilot was informative and pleasant, making it a very enjoyable experience.
This was a fabulous experience!  You need to do this if the weather permits.  Leon was a great pilot, made us feel very comfortable

Let me begin by saying this is something I do almost every time I visit Alaska (at least yearly). The flightseeing over Denali is absolutely breathtaking! The views cannot be described and do them justice. On top of that, the pilot was extremely knowledgeable and accommodating.  I can't wait to go again!

We recently returned from a 13 day land & cruise tour of Alaska. We took this tour as part of the land portion of our trip. It was the highlight of the entire trip!! Not only was the weather gorgeous and Denali was in full view, we were very pleased with the plane, pilot, and professionalism of K Aviation. We were awed & sometimes speechless with the views. The landing on the glacier was fantastic! Will also mention that this excursion was booked through & recommended by Princess Cruises. They also place confidence in the quality of K Aviation.

My family and I booked the Mt. Denali flight with the glacier landing as part of our bucket list Alaska Adventure Vacation and it did not disappoint. The planes are well maintained and the pilots extremely knowledgeable of the area and conditions. Our pilots got us amazing views of the summit of Mt. Denali as well as stunning views of many glaciers in the surrounding area. The climax of this trip was landing on the

The glacier landing was the highlight of our trip! We had the opportunity to climb out of our airplane to walk out on the glacier. Safety was primary concern of K2 aviation on our adventure.  Highly recommend K2 aviation

The company was organized and the pilot was professional.  However the customer signs up for a package/flight and you are mostly likely not going to get what you signed up for due to weather and/or other glitches.  The company does not give you an option to consider another flight, rescheduling it or cancelling the flight.
This was an amazing day flying up onto the glacier, landing and being able to see for miles.  Couldn't ask for anything better.  Highly recommend - once in a lifetime experience.

review_title: K2 is on top of the World experience
review_text: The best part of our 2-week trip.  Of course, the weather cooperated, and we had a beautiful sky. Customer service was exceptional and people were very friendly.  We did a glacier landing and I highly recommend the adventure!
The flightseeing was suggested by my colleague. K2Aviation did a fabulous job. Wonderful scenery and overall experience
had a great flight with Leon. He shared a lot of details along the way to the glaciers and we got amazing photos.
Absolutely amazing experience, knowledgeable and experienced pilot, stunning views. We got to see Mt McKinley!!! Highly recommend

review_title: Rafting the Canyon Voyage with Denali Rafting Adventures.
review_text: On Friday, June 24, my wife and I did a whitewater rafting trip on the Nenana River near Denali National Park.  We did this with Denali Rafting Adventures with our guide Alfredo.  From top to bottom, this is a well-run experience that was not like anything we've ever done.  The Canyon Voyage was thrilling, beautiful, and challenging.  Alfredo is an experienced, engaging, and amazing person who gave us confidence on a trip that challenged my comfort zone.  The DRA team is fully engages with your comfort and safety in mind at all times.  i would do it again!

We absolutely loved the entire experience. We have one child who was VERY concerned with being on a small plane, and the pilot took the time to set her mind at ease by explaining how the flight would work. The visuals were STUNNING and landing on the glacier for an on-the-ground appreciation of the scale of the mountains and glaciers made livelong memories for our entire family.

review_title: Amazing!!! A must do while in Alaska
review_text: This was an amazing experience. The pilot was really great. The views were breathtaking. Highly recommend this to anyone.
There aren't enough words to praise the beauty of this part of the world! Add to that a compassionate & knowledgeable pilot. Truly a bucket list experience!

review_title: Doesn't get much better than this trip
review_text: I have read a lot about Denali mountaineering exploits, plus I love flying so this trip with K2 was a long-awaited highlight of our trip from the UK to Alaska.  I knew from TV programmes that it would be good but it certainly exceeded our every expectation.  We were lucky enough to have excellent weather and to get onto an earlier morning flight thanks to a very kind, helpful lady on reception who realised how important this trip was to us personally! The views as we flew in were extraordinary and the visibility so good we seemed to be in touching distance from so many majestic, snow-clad mountains, glaciers and rivers. Riley, our pilot, was great fun and very informative and we were very surprised just how stable and  comfortable the trusty Otter was amongst the huge mountains. My only regret was that I didn't make better us of my map of Denali to orientate myself better but I was so busy soaking in the views and experience.  This trip wasn't cheap but certainly worth every cent and the trip out to Alaska.  It doesn't get much better!

Luckily we staid in Denali more than one day. K2 were very co-operative and accepted our request, due to weather condition, to postpone our trip to the next day. It was a good decision and finally, in a very friendly and sunny afternoon we took off and enjoyed a great experience.
We will highly recommend it too our friends and colleagues.

Originally I booked the Grand Denali Tour but because of weather conditions it was cancelled. So instead the company offered me a shorter flight which included landing on a glacier on the same day and at the same time. It was magical! I'm grateful that I could experience this beautiful mountain from above.

review_title: The highlight of our Alaska vacation
review_text: Joe our pilot made us feel very safe and comfortable. He took us on the ride of a lifetime to see the spectacular scenery with our glacier landing. Thank you for the wonderful trip.

As a former fighter pilot this was a fantastic experience.  The flight to the glacier was beautiful and the landing on it was great.  We were very lucky that the weather was not an issue at all. Would do it again in a heartbeat!
Pilot Dorothy was incredible! Made us feel safe and comfortable. Highly recommend this adventure of a life time. You will never regret this one!

review_title: K2 is on top of the World experience
review_text:
Customer service was first rate.  The whole experience was perfect.  I will do this again!
Great views of the mountains and MckInley.  Glaciers were awesome!  Landing on the glacier was smooth and beautiful.  I am so glad we were given the option and chose yes,  Our pilot was an excellent guide.

review_title: Definitely worth the wait and money!
review_text: Although we had to wait an extra hour for our plane ride, our pilot, Joe, was friendly, knowledgeable, and understanding. Would recommend to anyone!

Excellent
I'm a pilot and everything was done with the best safety standards possible.
Professional pilot and staff
This flight and glacier landing was one of the highlights of our trip to Alaska. The pilot was enthusiastic and skilled. We were lucky to have wonderful weather.
Our pilot was great, very informative throughout the flight and did a wonderful job flying the plane. 10/10 would recommend this to others, very cool experience.

Pilot Matthew was great, & the trip was fantastic. The "Big  3" were glorious,  but Matthew made the rest of the flight even better.  More than just a thrill ride. God's majesties were underscored during this  trip.

review_title: An amazing flight to see one of the tallest mountains in the world!
review_text: I am really surprised by the comments about no narration during the flight?!? I wonder if his headset wasn't working because out pilot was telling us about the area the entire flight. Landing on a glacier is such a great experience. We were very lucky in that the skies parted and we got a nice sunny experience. I don't think we could have asked for better, other than spending even more time on the glacier than we did (and we got some bonus time being the last flight of the day). We lucked out and booked same day (in the morning) so if you suddenly find you have some time, you might check them out.

Landing on and take-off from as well as walking on the glacier were the most wonderful experiences during this excursion.  Lou was our pilot and a great guide.  He  allowed me to ride in co-pilot's seat and made my experience even more memorable.  All guests get a window seat.  Wings being over the windows did not block the beautiful views of mountains and glaciers.

The check-in center is beautiful and spacious with good seating inside and outside the building.  The staff is extremely helpful and courteous.  The restrooms are also very clean.

One tip to future guests:  If weather is expected to be bad, please call to find out whether glacier landing would be possible.  If not, they are very accommodating about changing your day, refunding, and adjusting the price.

We enjoyed the beautiful views of the glaciers. Was disappointed that our pilot didn't give us any narration or information about the history and geography of the land and we were unable to ask or communicate with him as mics were not active. He was a good pilot and friendly on the ground. His tour guiding skills had no interaction with the people after takeoff.

We did a 1 hour flight to see Denali through K2. This is a class operation well run with a clean, large and modern space, professional people behind the counter and first class pilots and aircraft. Our pilot was Joe who who professional  all the way. Handled his passengers and craft excellently. Denali can be frustrating, often not being able to be seen due to weather. K2 understands this and only flies when it's safe, and when it's not, makes a great effort to re-schedule or refund if necessary. All friendly and professional. On our day, the weather was iffy and they had pilots going up without passengers to scout out the weather. In our case the weather broke literally at the last minute and we had a great flight with wonderful views of Denali and the surrounding mountains. If the weather hadn't broken they would have cancelled the flight with either re-scheduling or a refund on the spot. I wish all businesses were run like this.

This flight was just fantastic. Chad was our pilot and we were able to land on the glacier. This is an unbelievable experience and a once in a lifetime experience. I can’t say enough about our pilot and K2. Thank you!

There are two reasons why we cannot rate this 5 stars.  First, one person in our party had a headset with a nonworking mic so they could not ask any questions during the flight.  Second, we thought the flight would be limited to six people (according to the website description).  There were 10 people  in our plane not counting the pilot.  Not sure why there was a difference.  The views on the right side were better than the left, but the views for all were incredible. Takeoff and landing were very smooth.   It's worth the trip, but be sure to check your mic and ask how many people will be in the plane before going.

This is a very popular service offering Air Taxis and flight tours. We booked the Denali flight tour to fly around Mt Denali, see wildlife and land on a glacier and actually walk on the glacier. What they don't tell you is that none of their pilots are instrument certified and can only fly by visual flight rules which means if it's rainy, foggy or has a lot of low clouds your trip will be canceled or greatly shortened. Our trip was shortened and we didn't get to se or do most of the highlights of the trip. We spent 15 minutes getting to the mountain and 15 minutes getting back and actually flew around the mountain for 30 minutes. No glacier landing and didn't spot a single bear, moose or any type of wildlife. We also didn't know how far it was from Fairbanks when we booked the tour, but that was our fault for not asking. We assumed the tour would start and end around or near Denali but after purchasing the package learned that we'd have to drive almost to Anchorage (way past the mountain)  take the tour and fly back almost to Anchorage and then drive back to Fairbanks. So it ended up being a 12 hour day for a 30 minute to 1 hour tour. We had also been told we had to each purchase a park pass in advance before taking the tour and we did, but we never needed it because we never landed inside the park. Once back home I called the tour operator (K2 Aviation) and complained to the owner, who after considering the facts agreed to give us a partial refund which I did appreciate.
This exhilarating 1-hour flight was one of the high points of our trip to Alaska. Getting to see Mt. Denali and the glaciers of the Alaskan Range made for a memory we will treasure
We had a trip of a lifetime and the pilot was very knowledgeable. The whole staff was friendly and the trip was safe.
Beautiful views of the Denali complex along with a landing on the Ruth Glacier.  The beauty and magnitude of Denali is best viewed from the air.

review_title: Fantastic, intimate views of Mt. Denali
review_text: This adventure was unlike any I've ever experienced! The excellent pilot of our small but mighty plane took us close to ridges, glaciers and peaks that were staggering in their beauty! This was a once in a lifetime adventure!

I don't know where to start. Everything was awesome, the staff, the experience. We were scheduled to fly at 6:30 on a Saturday. When we got there, there was bad weather on Denali so all flights were grounded. We were given a choice of getting a full refund or to go on a flight to a different mountain range or reschedule. Our hearts were set on landing on a glacier and seeing Denali so we rescheduled for the next day. On the second day there was smoke from forest fires in the area so we chose to reschedule again. Eventually on Monday we were able to land on the glacier and it was truly one of the best experiences and we have traveled all over the world. most importantly through all this, the staff was wonderful. We called a bunch of times to check the status and the staff was incredibly patient and gracious. When we actually got to fly, the pilot was great. If you want a great experience, this is it

review_title: Book a flight, you won't regret it! Amazing experience and staff!
review_text: Everyone at K2 was great! Our original booking date had bad weather, so we were offered a refund or a rescheduled flight. We ended up rescheduling twice after speaking with people at K2 trying to get the best chance for a good flying day. When we arrived, we were told it was a 50/50 chance to see Denali, so we knew there was a chance that we may not see the mountain or be able to land on the glacier. They offered us three chance to take another flight, or even a refund since conditions weren't the best. We took the chance and ended up being very lucky to have great views of the summit on Denali, and land on the glacier. Our pilot was very knowledgeable of the area and history, which made the flight more interesting. I had my 4 year old son with me, and everyone at K2 was great with him. Patiently answering questions and making sure he was okay before and during the flight. I couldn't have asked for a better experience. This was the experience a lifetime. If you're thinking about it, or just in the area, book a flight with K2. You won't regret it.

In all our research for Alaska, what stood out the most was the encouragement to see Alaska from as many perspectives as we could - land, sea, air. When we figured out that flightseeing out of Talkeetna would not only work great for our schedule, but allow us to experience the Alaska Range and Mount Denali, it wasn't a hard choice to go with K2 Aviation. The reviews were overwhelmingly positive, and we really appreciated the transparency on their website for the different routes available. From booking, to arrival, and check-in, the staff was very kind and helpful. I tend to be a bit of a nervous flyer ever since experiencing a super bumpy ride many years ago in a small 2 seater plane, but Lauren in the office was so encouraging and genuine in putting my mind at ease. We had booked the Denali Grand Tour, but due to weather conditions up there, we weren't going to be able to fly that route. Instead, we were offered the Denali Flyer and a refund for the price difference. For anyone wondering if a certain time of day is best, there really isn't, and all the staff confirmed this. Whatever time works best for you, is the best time to go! We were there for a 6:30 PM and it was an absolutely beautiful, sunny and clear day - and yet we still had changes because the cloud and/or wind conditions are always going to be completely different higher up and around the mountains. We had an absolutely fantastic time, and I felt great throughout the flight! I do recommend being on Dramamine or Bonine if you're prone to motion sickness and/or have some anxiety with flying - take one dose the night before to metabolize in your system, and one prior to your activity. Being prepared is key! Our pilot Mitch was very friendly, professional, and knowledgeable about anything and everything we saw from the air. The views were breathtaking, and we learned so much! It was an almost out of this world experience to feel like you're floating above and among the mountains. We were prepared to do a glacier landing, but some last minute cloud cover interfered. It was still an awesome experience though, and one we won't soon forget!
Flying around the mountains and landing on the glacier is something we will always remember! Our pilot and guide was very informative.

This tour was nothing short of amazing!   The crew at K2 Aviation made sure our experience was extraordinary.   Our tour was scheduled for 8:30am and the weather was not ideal due to clouds and smoke.   They made sure we were updated and aware of the situation.  We were able to reschedule on the 6:30pm tour.  We initially booked the Grand Denali Tour and weather was still not optimal to do that tour; however, we could do a the Denali Experience with a possible glacier landing. They gave us the option to cancel or go knowing we possibly wouldn't be able to see as much as we hoped.   Our pilot Lou, set our expectations low for the glacier landing as well as how well we would see.  We still wanted to try it and the whole tour far exceeded our expectations.   We were in awe of the mountains we saw and Lou was an excellent tour guide.   Once we were near the glacier the skies cleared and we were able to land.   Lou gave us plenty of time to enjoy this experience and loads of info on the mountains and surrounding area.  This is a once in a lifetime experience and worth every penny!   Thank you K2 Aviation!

The booking process was extremely easy and made the check in day of even easier. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and provided tons of fun facts throughout the flight. Even though Denali was in the clouds, it was still insane views!

My wife and I took the Denali Flyer tour with Glacier Landing and it was an awesome experience. Our pilot was friendly and explained everything to us clearly.  There was a certain euphoric feeling when we exited the plane at the glacier landing - the view and overall feeling was breathtaking.  We were also very fortunate that it was a mostly sunny day.  We highly recommend this trip to all, but please spend the extra money for the glacier landing in order to experience this to it's fullest.

If the weather permits a flight around Denali, and particularly if a landing on one of the glaciers is possible, DO NOT pass up this opportunity.  As a pilot who has flown in Alaska myself for 35 years, I can say that you will be awed by this experience.  Our pilot, Will, was the consummate professional from the preflight briefing to disembarking and the entire K2 staff was extremely helpful, polite and professional from the first phone call to the post flight review.  The K2 aircraft appeared to be very well maintained and I felt confident that any compromise of safety would never be tolerated at K2.  We took 8 family and friends on this flight in a turbine Otter and they all expressed that, of all the amazing things they saw and did during our 10 day visit, that the Denali flight, particularly the Ruth Glacier landing, was the absolute highlight of their Alaska experience.

We were not able to take the Denali flight due to weather but they arranged another flight south to a glacier. Our pilot Lou was fantastic flight was smooth hopefully one day we can get back and fly around Mt. Denali

The K2 flight to Denali was one of the highlights of our Alaskan tour. Our pilot was knowledgeable and flew us around the mountain to avoid weather. We landed on the glacier and views were spectacular! Highly recommend!

It is an incredible experience to see Denali up close. As someone who is not an alpine climber, I would have no way to do so if it weren’t for this team of pilots and crew at K2. My husband and I were booked to do a grand tour with glacier landing this week, and sadly due to the wildfires in the park and amount of smoke, our plans were altered a bit. But that did not stop the team from finding safe ways to get us up close to Denali. The pilots had been out scouting safe fly routes at higher altitudes and were able to take us up close, just without the glacier landing portion. Although that would have been fantastic, I can honestly say that being in such proximity to one of the worlds tallest peaks was such a highlight of our trip. I would certainly fly with K2 again. The plane was very comfortable, and each seat has a window so no worries about leaning over someone to get a view. Shoutout to our pilot Chris who let me ride in the co-pilot seat for our flight!

review_title: Amazing Experience, Accommodating Staff! Don't Miss out!
review_text: We had an amazing experience with K2 on our Denali Flyer Tour with Glacier Landing!!  I was hesitant to book because I am claustrophobic and my son is 6'7" tall.  I was worried about both of our comfort on the flight. I called in to book and spoke with the K2 staff and they told me they would put us on one of their "bigger" planes.  We ended up on a 10-seater (incl. pilot) and we were all comfortable!  I so appreciated the fact that they heard my concerns and didn't minimize them but found a perfect solution.  The flight itself was spectacular and the glacier landing was the highlight!  We had perfect weather and the views of Denali were amazing!  Highly recommend this activity and this company!  Was the highlight of our Alaskan adventure!

Our family agreed this was the highlight of our entire 2 weeks in Alaska.  Our pilot was knowledgeable, friendly and made us feel safe.  The views were incredible, like nothing we have ever seen. Landing on a glacier was like a dream. Beautiful mountains surrounded us, postcard views in all directions.  Highly Recommend K2 Aviation and will fly with them again!

This was the trip of a lifetime. We took my 85 year old grandmother, aunt, and 13 year old son and everyone was all smiles the whole time. What an experience to see such amazing views and then land on a glacier. My son loved playing in the snow. My grandmother couldn't wait to tell all her friends about it when she got home. I cannot recommend this trip enough! Worth every penny.

Great experience, would recommend it to everyone, impossible to describe the beauty, you have to see it in person. 
K2 did a great job, very professional, our pilot Wilbur was awesome.

We had booked for a Denali Glacier landing however due to bad weather it was cancelled.
They put us on another trip of the Talkeetna range.

I was bit disappointed with the service we were waiting for our flight but our name was never announced than we realised we were the only who were left to be allocated  so we reached out to them and It was sorted.
My issue is that they should be checking to see if the all the passengers have been allocated.
The flight was ok. The view from the top was great
Pick up and drop facility from the hotel was seamless
We had a Great day, Great flight, Great Pilot, Chad was awesome!  couldn't have asked for much more. We got to see Denali and land on the Glacier, it was a blast, Great Trip, Thanks!

Flying with K2 was a great experience.  The weather was perfect which helped, but all the staff we dealt with were fantastic and our pilot Chad was great!  I hope to fly with you guys again on a future Denali climb!

An experience not to be missed! Our very experienced and capable pilot Lou gave us an amazing flight over the Alaska Range and onto the Ruth Glacier - absolutely breath-taking! The highlight of our three-week tour!

review_title: Epic treat. Do it, even if only once in your life.
review_text: Besides being a fantastic pilot, Lou was incredibly knowledgeable regarding Glaciology and mountains. His tour gave us a deeper appreciation of what we were beholding.  I’ve been on many Denali flights and the majesty cannot be put into words. This was my first glacier landing and it was SO WORTH IT! Everyone at K2 was professional and accommodating.

review_title: An Experience You Will Never Forget
review_text: Our pilot Wilbur did a wonderful job, you can tell he loves what he does and sharing his knowledge and experience of the Denali area and glaciers. The landing was something I will remember for the rest of my life. The weather was perfect and it was actually warmer on the glacier than I expected. Great photo opportunity so be sure to bring your camera or phone.  There are not enough adjectives to describe the experience - fantastic, wonderful, awesome! Be sure to add the landing to your flight.

We flew with K2 30 years ago on our honeymoon. This was a 30th anniversary with our kids. The pilot, Phil, and the flight were over the top!  The staff gave us an anniversary gift basket!! Reim and everyone there make sure you have the tume of your life. Do the glacier landing. Unreal!!!  I love this place!!!!
Flying on K2 aviation to see Mount Denali and land on a glacier was my most memorable experience of my Alaska vacation.

Pilot was awesome, he made sure we enjoy to our fullest extent.He made sure we got enough time to have fun on the glaciers. He was very professional, personable and excellent communicator in explaining things. We would recommend k2 aviation team to everyone out there wanting to visit beautiful glaciers.

First rate pilot, landing on the glacier was amazing. Alaska is a land so awesomely grand, you just have to see it to believe it, there is no explaining it! Thank you for sharing it with us with such an incredible view! I would and will do this again, hopefully with my children someday.

Our pilot was reassuring and professional, with a smooth take off and landing. The thrilling views were recorded for endless painting possibilities and every family member agreed that this was a highlight of our trip to Alaska.

review_title: They know how to treat people
review_text:
This flight around Denali is one of the coolest things we did in Alaska. It was amazing being able to get so close to such a Majestic Mountain. We also joined the 20% club, meaning only 20% of people who visit see the three peaks at once. 

Our pilot, who has hikes several mountains in Denali, was a wealth of knowledge about the geology of the mountain and land surrounding it. We learned so much from this one hour tour. He was also good at flying. With the wind I was pretty sure I would get sick but was able to keep it all down. 

This tour also offers a glacier landing. Unfortunately we tried twice but Mount Denali creates its own weather and wasn’t as friendly to us as the rest of Alaska. Would have been nice to do that but we will save it for next time. 

I researched a few Denali flights and this one seemed to be the best price and definitely was the most friendly to speak with. They also treated us extra special being that we were on our honeymoon and we really appreciate the extra special treatment. We highly recommend this flight if you want a close up of Denali without the 20 hike. WE WILL BE BACK!

review_title: High point of any Alaskan vacation
review_text: The glacier landing flight is so far among the highlights of our Alaska vacation. Well, maybe, except for seeing the moose with her calves. 😀. Being on top of the glacier looked almost like being on another planet. The flight over was beyond words. And the time spent on the glacier was fantastic. Chad was a great pilot.

Our flight with Joe was a once in a lifetime experience. My son wants to be a future pilot and he allowed him to sit in the co-pilot seat. Not only did he explain the scenery of the areas we flew over, but he also explained everything he was doing as a pilot. Make sure to include the glacier landing as part of your trip. It was the best part and truly breathtaking!

review_title: Fantastic Company to Fly into the Alaska Range
review_text: Excellent Customer Service and very willing to work with our climbing team schedule. They also provided us with transportation around Talkeetna. The employees were very kind and showed interest in our endeavor. The flight staff was very professional and the ground crews were very accommodating and helpful.

AMAZING!!!  Definitely worth the money - and you MUST include glacier landing!!  Was the smoothest take offs, landings and flight of our entire vacation.  It's surreal to be so close to this magnificence!
Worth every dollar, only note is that I wish y’all had an ATM (unless I missed it) so I could pull cash to tip pilot. Other than that I loved it so much.

From beginning to end, the K2 team was top-notch!  They conveniently picked us up at the hotel, the aircraft was in pristine condition, the pilot was very knowledgeable and friendly - made sure everyone had fun - the sights were indescribable! Landing and standing on Ruth glacier was really once-in-a-lifetime

Took K2 Aviation for a flight seeing tour and glacier landing on Mt. McKinley in Denali National Park, WOW what an experience!! This is definitely a once in a lifetime trip. Our pilot was knowledgeable about the mountain.
Our pilot was supremely competent, knowledgeable, and helpful. The plane and facilities were clean, comfortable, and well maintained.

We travelled throughout Alaska for 17 days.  We did a glacier cruise in Prince William Sound - we travelled the entire Alaska Railway from Anchorage to Fairtbanks - we fished for halibut out of Valdez!  Nothing, absolutely nothing, could rival our flight out of Talkeetna onto a glacier.  Our pilot was exceptional and the process from registration to the actual flight was amazing. Highly recommend!

Our flight over Denali NP and landing on Ruth Glacier was amazing! Everyone at K2 was friendly and professional. Our pilot, Chad, was enthusiastic and obviously loves sharing Alaska with visitors. K2 is a very impressive, safety oriented business, which we would highly recommend! They have a large operation with numerous airplanes and experienced pilots. Book it!

We were so lucky to have a beautiful day for a flight tour....no clouds around Denali.
The airstrip is within a short walk from the train "station".  The office looked fairly new and everyone was very friendly and helpful, happy for us for the good weather.  We checked in (don't sweat the weigh-in) and after a short wait, our pilot came to collect us.  We were again fortunate in two ways:  we were the only 2 on the tour and Leon was our pilot.  Leon was a climbing guide for 12 years before transitioning to the air and he was incredible.  So much information and experience to share!  This is a very professional group and the tour was well worth the cost.  An unforgettable experience!!

Here for our anniversary, K2 service was absolutely excellent. Pick up at hotel, to the drivers professional demeanor, to the pilot, plane and flight. Pilot was excellent and knowledgeable. Everything was Superb!  Top tier operation.
Spectacular adventure flightseeing with glacier landing in Denali.  We knew nothing about what we were doing and K2 took care of it all.  Do not miss this adventure.

review_title: K2 is the BOMB! Amazing flight was FUNtastic! We flew with Chip on the way in and Billy out.
review_text: This was the trip of a lifetime! It is a trip I bought for my husbands 60th birthday since he met Don Sheldon when he was a kid and always wanted to go to his mountain house. The flights were beautiful and we appreciated the historical and informative narratives both ways. Amazing, inspiring, unforgettable and actually, words cannot describe the experience. We are blessed and awed! Thank you Sheldon family for sharing your family dream experience!!!

Flew the Denali flyer (N122KT) with friends. It was an unforgettable experience and something I would recommend to anyone wanting to get a bird's eye view of Denali. Our pilot (sorry i forgot your name! we rode the 4:00 pm 2022-06-01 tour) was courteous, cautious, and the flight was incredibly smooth. Will definitely be coming back to Talkeetna to experience again!

Remember when you travel that you may spend a few extra dollars as you are not coming back tomorrow!  Yes this may be more expensive, but the views and experience is worth every penny.  I took the option to land in the snow, get out to throw a snowball, and then take off with gliders in the snow.  I'll never forget the views and this amazing part of my vacation.

review_title: Ruth Glacier Mt Denali Glacier Landing Flight
review_text:
This was the highlight of my 26 day Canada/Alaska tour. Absolutely amazing.  
Easy check in and preflight instruction.  Window seat for everyone.  Plenty of time on the glacier and incredible views both at the glacier and through the mountain passes to get there and of course of Mt Denali. 

I recommend this flight and the staff I dealt with without any hesitation.

This was our first ever flightseeing tour and it was our favorite part of Alaska! Connor was a great pilot, very smooth take-off and landing. He assuaged all our fears about being in a small plane in a remote area and was available for questions. Throughout the flight he was very knowledgeable about the landmarks and gave both sides of the plane amazing views of Denali. During our glacier landing he continued to answer questions and got great pictures of all of us! I highly recommend K2 aviation for flightseeing!
Our flight with Garrett was spectacular. The mountains were showing themselves and I can’t imagine a better day in Denali.
My favorite part was seeing the immensity of the landscape.  The pilot was great at explaining what we were seeing and covering a lot of territory.  Everyone was so nice.

We booked the most popular flight w glacier landing. Billie our pilot was wonderful! He shared his extensive knowledge of Denali and had a great sense of humor too. There isn’t a bad seat on these planes…..lots of windows. This was such an amazing experience, I highly recommend.

Our pilot Dorothy was very friendly and personable and took an interest in each one of us.  She maneuvered the plane in such a way as to give everyone an incredible view of Denali and the glaciers. She was very knowledgeable about all the mountains, glaciers and geologic features of our trip.  I give K2 5 stars for a once in a life time experience

K2 Aviation made our trip! My wife had booked the flight around Denali, and due to excellent weather conditions we were able to upgrade to landing on the glacier! DO IT! This was by far the best part of our trip. EVERYONE we delt with at K2 were  professionals who understood customer service, and a little extra effort on their part made a huge difference for us. THANK YOU THANK YOU THANK YOU!!!

Cousins paid for me to join them to fly up and land on the Ruth Glacier. I couldn't believe the magic of the flight, the knowledge of the pilot (Mitch), and the vast landscape. I am not a nervous flyer, but even had I been, the sure hands and smooth flight would have made me feel comfortable. I'd try to explain, but words won't do the trip justice. I'm a lifelong Alaskan, and I was impressed. Just do it. Now I plan to cover the flights when my sister visits. It's expensive, but there's just no other way, and I would go again in a heartbeat.
The staff at K2 was awesome. The pilot was extremely informative and our trip was a bucket list experience. We had the luck of visiting on a perfect weather day too. I highly recommend!
Our trip to see the glaciers and land on one was the highlight of our Alaskan trip!  Wonderful pilot and wonderful view.  Highly recommend!

review_title: Great view of Denali & surrounding mountains
review_text: We loved our Denali Flightseeing tour with K2 Aviation! We had spectacular, clear weather and it was an amazing ride. Dorothy, our pilot, was informative and very professional. This was a highlight of our trip, for sure, and something we will not forget! Would definitely recommend this for anyone traveling to Alaska and Denali National Park....what a great way to see our National Park!

This was truly an exciting memorable experience. I, and my family, totally enjoyed the experience of flying over a glacier and being so close to the peaks it seemed as if one could touch them. The pilot was competent and pleasant. To become immersed (even for a short time) in the beauty and majesty of nature is something to be experienced.
We went on 5/22 and got to land on the Glacier.  Weather was beautiful and it was an awesome flight!  So peaceful and breathtaking. I enjoyed every minute and would definitely fly with K2 again.
The flight around Denali with the glacier landing was spectacular! The pilot was experienced and knowledgeable. A must do in Alaska!!!
Best day in Alaska thanks to Pilot Chad Smith of K2 Aviation! The glacier landing was flawless and the views were spectacular.

review_title: Simply a MUST DO Alaska activity....
review_text: Outstanding experience!  Our pilot (Wilber) was so professional and informative.  If you're in Alaska don't miss out on this once-in-a-lifetime experience!

Incredible!! Unlike anything we've done or seen! I was nervous for the small plane and had zero complaints or motion sickness throughout. This company knows what they're doing - the building, welcome staff, gear, planes, pilots - all professional, clean, and organized. We thought this was well worth the cost! Outside of just the amazing views our pilot provided TONS of interesting facts about Alaska, flying, the wildlife, the mountains, etc; took our pictures on the glacier landing; and even walked us through the flying techniques and process (I think this helped to calm anyone's nervous). I was on the fence in booking and now would HIGHLY recommend this to anyone visiting Alaska.
The weather was perfect, and the views were outstanding. The pilot was great ! She was well informed and funny.

Wow! The flight we took landed on a glacier and the weather couldn’t have been better. We were able to see every mountain range including those who were hiking Mt Denali. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and the flight was smooth. Highly recommend taking this tour when visiting.
Fantastic experience!! The pilot was amazing getting us up close and personal with the mountains.  The glacier landing topped it off wonderfully.. Such amazing views it doesn't even seem real.

Riley did an incredible job taking us on a flight-seeing tour and landing on Ruth Glacier. His demeanor was professional and I loved his dry sense of humor! I felt comfortable in his abilities as a pilot and the day couldn't have been more perfect! Thank you K2!

To my surprise, My wife decided last minute that she would fly Denali and do a Glacier landing. This was the most memorable adventure that we did in our Alaska vacation. These guys are highly recommended and the office staff was all great also. When they found out it was her birthday, they gave her a nice complementary gift upon our return. I can't recommend them enough!

This tour was one of the best experiences I could have done in Alaska! It was amazing to fly above the glaciers and see them from the plane-truly an Alaskan experience. The pilots were both polite and professional, the planes were safe and well-equipped with headsets and gear, and the entire process was enjoyable. Even when the weather prevented a glacier landing, the pilots gave us a great flight over and around the glaciers that this area is so famous for. Truly magical.

review_title: Awesome Denali Flight with Glacier Landing
review_text: Loved the trip and we managed to do a Glacier Landing and walk around. It is only from the air do you get a true appreciation of the scale and beauty of the various Mountain Ranges.
We were fortunate and lucky enough to see Denali on a clear spring day. It was breathtaking and the pilot was informative and friendly. We felt safe and looked after.

My family and I had a great scenic flight over Denali and landed on a glacier. It was an amazing experience us as a family and one I’d recommend. Our pilot Billy was excellent. Had a super clear day, so count ourselves very lucky!
Our pilot was very knowledgeable about the area, and we had a great time overall. Hands down best way to experience Denali, right behind climbing it.

This by far the greatest thing I have done on vacation. My Wife and I came up to look at sal me property and check out Talkeetna area. We didn’t even know about flight seeing tours till we drove through the downtown area. I told her I would like to check it out. So I did and she said do it it’s your birthday I want you to go. So I booked it for 1:30 Sunday April 10. It was fantastic the pilot was great and the Piper Super Cub was very cool. We couldn’t have asked for a better day. Sunny and clear a rare thing I am told by the locals who live here. Thanks K2 Aviation

My wife and I took the Denali Flyer tour as part of our 25th Anniversary trip to Alaska.  It was amazing!  We had perfect weather and the views of Denali were spectacular...officially part of the 30% club.  Our pilot, whose name I unfortunately don't remember, gave us a perfect flight and provided information on everything from the peaks and glaciers we flew past to the history of Denali...he made the experience even more enjoyable.  If we ever return to Alaska, we will definitely be taking another flight with K2 and I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a wonderful experience.

Best part was the flight and the staff, the views were amazing! The glacier landing was also amazing, a first for myself and the view on the glacier was top notch! Chad the pilot was terrific, very professional, accommodating, and knowledgeable! A must do on your state visit!
Fun, exciting and fact-filled. Excellent pilot. Great time on the glacier. They provided boots for the glacier.
Chip was great, he gave us a lot of great information, we had a wonderful experience!! I would highly recommend K2 Aviation!!

Certainly perfect weather helped make this an epic trip.  The close up view of Denali, the surrounding mountains and glaciers was stunning.  I did the trip mid March when everything was gleaming white with drifting snow.  Worth every penny in my opinion.

First off, the pilot was very informative about the tour throughout the entire flight.....The pictures and videos I took were amazing but they do no justice compared to the experience first hand...Thank you to the entire K2 Aviation staff for a memorable experience....

Family of 8 travel to Alaska in August 2021.  K2 was able to accommodate us all on the same flight.
Weather was perfect, clear and sunny.  We had the most amazing experience.
