As the pilot took us around, giving us information and making sure we all had a perfect view every time!  We came to see Denali and we were so lucky to see it very clearly and different viewpoints, only thing that made it even more fantastic was that  we were the lucky few to see all 3 peaks!!  Thank you for a memorable experience.

We were fortunate to have perfect weather for our flight around Denali. Our pilot/guide, Dorothy was terrific. She was knowledgeable about the mountains and did a great job of pointing out the peaks surrounding Denali. We were also able to get great views of glaciers. It truly was a breathtaking experience. Highly recommend!

review_title: It was overall a happy experience.
review_text: It was our first time doing flight seeing tour. Had a great time. My kids slept during the flight. We were doing the Denali experience. It was beautiful seeing the mountain views. Would recommend.

3 other friends and I came from TN, and we had the best experience. Our pilot was Chad and he could not be any nicer. The entire staff was so nice and we can't wait to come back. Do this flight tour, you won't regret it!

We couldn't have asked for a better experience with K2!! 

We were supposed to go on a flightseeing out of Anchorage, and it was canceled due to the weather (fog) down there. We hopped in our car and decided to take a day trip up to Talkeetna to see the mountains as best we could that way. 

But when we arrived without a reservation and they were able to fit us in the same day. We did the last flight of the day- and had the lighting and views as the sun was setting! We say all 3 peaks and it was absolutely breathtaking!! 

K2's staff and pilot were fantastic and I would highly recommend to anyone looking for a highlight on their Alaska vacation!!

review_title: Plane Ride Over the Mountain Ranges/Denali
review_text: The decision to see if we could fly that same day was not planned. K2 was very accommodating to include us on the trip. Chad our pilot was great.  The scenery was breath taking.  Would do it again but with a landing.
This plane tour is a must. You will see the mountains from another perspective and the pilot is amazing as well. I LOVE everything about it highly recommended to do it. 100% worth it

review_title: First time flyer and it was worth it!!
review_text: My husband and I celebrated our 25th in the skies over the glacier and through the snowy mountains.  Even though my husband can get motion sick, he didn't on this trip.  Our pilot was great at giving us plenty of info to keep us looking and learning.  Beautiful pictures and videos are available to all.  Thank you for a wonderful day and experience!!
Perfect day for a flight. Easy check-in procedure and availability of waivers online in advance. Excellent and courteous staff. Friendly steady and knowledgeable pilot.

I went with a group of four coworkers and we had an absolute blast! Our tour guide was great. We did the most expensive tour and we were glad we did! We were so close to Denali it was unbelievable! Each seat was a window seat in our 11 seater plane. Views were out of this world! Of note- even on a clear day, expect some turbulence. Due to the size of the plane and the high altitude, even a little wind gust will give the plane some movement. This is expected and the pilot warned us ahead of time. Just be cautious or premeditate with some anti nausea meds if you are more sensitive to motion sickness! Sooo glad we did this!!! BOOK. NOW. (:

I’d highly recommend a flight around Denali with K2 Aviation. Our pilot Chip was an awesome guide: knowledgeable, humorous and good natured. The whole experience was comfortable and safe from the well-appointed lodge to the seats in the plane. Our kids (5,11,12) were thoroughly entertained for the 1.5 hour flight around the mountain and glaciers. We got some great photos and stories from it. Would definitely fly with them again!

Our flight around Denali national park was one of the highlights of our trip. Our pilot was amazing and explained so much about the park, glaciers, etc and was quick to answer any and all questions we had. Check-in was effortless and the whole process was easy going. 100% worth the money!
A wonderful experience! The pilot was knowledgeable and put the whole family at ease. We all loved it!

This was an awesome experience. Only thing to add was we wished the pilot or have a co-pilot on board to tell us more about the area. He did explain some and it was fascinating. We lucked out and had great weather with hardly any clouds. We could see all 3 peaks.

Ground staff and pilots were very friendly, courteous and knowledgeable. Enjoyed fantastic aerial views of Denali and surrounding area. I felt comfortable and safe. The pilot was an interesting and fact filled color commentator. Would do it again in a New York minute.

I live in Utah, a state which takes pride in their mountains and scenery, but now, I will never be able to enjoy the mountains in Utah again without thinking that Denali and it's surrounding canyons, mountains and glaciers are just so much more fantastic and breathtaking. I went on this flight expecting a nice trip, something I would definitely remember, but I had no idea of just how monumental the view would be. Me and my friends had been stuck in a snowstorm in Fairbanks and went south to Talkeetna not knowing if there would even be any flights that day, but K2 Aviation was able to fit us into their tight schedule and we took off into what would be the highlight of the trip (and yes, we did see the northern lights twice during this trip). We bought the cheapest package and we felt like we should have bought the more expensive ones as soon as we landed. Worth every penny, every second.

Also, the pilot was very informative and friendly! We will most certainly fly with them again next time we visit Alaska!

review_title: Best part of our entire trip!
review_text: The plane ride was fantastic!! The pilot told us so much about the history of the area, the mountains, the trees, the wildlife - we learned so much! But the best part was landing on the glacier, it was the most spectacular thing we’ve ever done!!

First time I've taken a flightseeing tour it was amazing!  When I got to K2 they made the process super easy, and it included the glacier landing. We got on our snow boots (make sure you do this) and got into the De Havilland Otter.  If you have a choice sit on the right side because the view are slightly better. We landed on the glacier and the snow was powdery soft and two feet thick. This is where the snow boots help to keep your pants from getting wet. The quiet and beauty were breathtaking.  Chris the pilot did an great job  providing narration and safely guiding the plane up and back. The folks in the office were very helpful and answered all our questions. If you have a chance, you have to make time for this!

My boyfriend, a long-time small plane pilot himself, booked our K2 flight as a last-minute surprise for me when we visited Talkeetna at the end of September, 2021.  

We received excellent service from the first telephone call to stepping down from the plane, post-flight.  Every staff member we interacted with provided terrific service.

Our pilot was highly experienced, extremely competent, knowledgeable, communicated very well and flew with our safety and comfort as his first priority.  

He was an excellent guide and I would fly with him repeatedly.
My escort was highly impressed with his skills and called him "a pilot's pilot."  

I cannot rate this experience highly enough.  There are no words to express the grandeur of flying among the mountain peaks and over glaciers, rivers and the Alaskan tundra in the late afternoon sun.  It was stunningly beautiful.  Taking photos from a viewpoint simply cannot compare to seeing the mountain range in person.  Denali is "the great one" indeed!

It was a once in a lifetime experience that was gifted to me by a wonderful man...and yes, I will do it again just as soon as I can!

FYI, I don't normally post reviews, but this experience was so great that I had to write about it.  Go have your own grand adventure with K2.  You'll regret it if you don't!

We did one of the flights that went around Denali. It was incredible. I still couldn't get over the scale of what we saw. I couldn't believe it when our pilot/guide told us the Ruth Glacier was 3 miles wide. It felt like we were close to the top of Denali, but we were never higher than 12k feet. It was an amazing view that you can't get any other way. We had a guest who had reached the summit multiple times so his perspective was helpful. He was also blown away by the views he saw because you don't get that perspective as a hiker. The trip was expensive (more than my flight to and from Alaska) but having done it, it was well worth it.

review_title: K2 is the Denali (the Tall one) of aviation
review_text:
My son Charlie and I enjoyed a morning flight around Denali on a beautiful day.  Our pilot, Dorothy, was incredible.  She is a great pilot and is very well informed and willingly to share very interesting bits of history and geography.
We highly recommend K2 Aviation.

AMAZING
We actually loved our first trip so much we booked a 2nd trip on our way back through Talkeetna.
1st trip we just did a flightseeing tour around Denali - it was a little cloudy so didn't see the peak of Denali but the rest of the views were spectacular and the Pilot Chris was amazing and now my dad's new friend!
2nd trip we actually did a glacier landing and were able to land in fresh snow - it was absolutely beautiful and a great flight again.
HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!!

I have lived in Alaska since 1971 and have always appreciated everything thing it has to offer.  But this flight was absolutely amazing and left me in awe!  Thank you for providing us the opportunity to see Denali from the air.
Truly a breathtaking experience. K2 Aviation did a great job and we would highly recommend them! Smooth ride, fantastic views, Alaskan facts, overall a great time. We will do it again someday!

We were scheduled for the Grand Denali Tour w/ Glacier Landing. As luck would have it, and Alaska weather in September, we could not do that flight. We were given the option of a refund or the Denali Experience tour. We took the tour with low expectation. We were thrilled at our pilots knowledge of the history, wildlife, and heritage of the area around Talkeetna and Denali. We will return for the grand Tour and we will travel with K2!
The crew were very pleasant to work with and helpful. The pilot was very professional, informative, and a pleasure to be around.

I wanted for years to see the Alaskan range and the glaciers and a month ago I was able to do that . Booked a flight with K2 aviation and Chris - a great guy and pilot took us to the see those amazing mountains ! It was beautiful!

We got very lucky with the weather and got put on a longer flight that lasted for about two hours. The pilot was very nice and knowledgeable. It was such a great way to see Denali and the view was worth every minute and every penny. I highly recommend doing the glacier landing as it was an incredible experience. They also provide sunglasses and waterproof boots if you don't have your own.
It was amazing, the best experience in my life, awesome views from Denali Mountain, the pilot was great, he landed in a glacier, it was just amazing, I 100% recommended

I can't say enough good things about K2. We booked the flightseeing glacier landing tour but the weather was iffy, so we didn't land, which was fine. I had a little anxiety about the flight, having never been in such a small aircraft, but it was clear from the outset that this place is professional and I had no cause for concern. There were about 9 people on the plane. The pilot inspired complete confidence, and we flew over glaciers, between mountain peaks, were treated to informative commentary, were able to ask questions, and my traveling companion even got to ride in the cockpit. It was amazing.  Reasonably priced. Do not miss the opportunity.
I was both terrified and excited when we went up to see the glacier. The pilot was very knowledgeable about all the places we flew! Very happy

I have wanted to see Denali since I was a kid and it was still named Mt. McKinley. It took my breath away when I saw it from Talkeeta. But up close from the air it was sublime. Landing on a glacier was something I never even dreamt was possible. Thanks for the once in a lifetime thrills.

Amazing experience! Everything was so organized. Pilot was awesome friendly and informative! Landing was so smooth on glacier and regular!! Loved the view all the way! Spotted a few animals from the air 😍😍!! Loved the spot where we landed with the glacier! So much snow so beautiful!! Definitely worth it ! Thank you!!

This was an amazing trip and I would definitely recommend it. The pilot was very friendly and knowledgeable and made the trip so fun. The mountains were stunning and this was a great addition to our trip.

What a great side trip!  A must do if visiting Alaska.  Add the glacier landing, pay the additional fee and you won’t regret it.  Prepare to have your breath taken away for the entire 90 min of the ride.

This was our most memorable time from our visit.  My first time to fly in a small plane and it was so smooth.  It had been a cloudy, rainy day and we weren't able to do the Grand Tour or see the summit of Denali.  But the weather cleared enough that we were able to see spectacular views of the rugged mountains and do a glacier landing.  Loved it.
K2 Aviation was fabulous from booking to stepping out of the plane at the end of our flight! Everything was beyond our expectations!

This was AMAZING!!!!! We booked the Denali Grand Tour with Glacier Landing and were absolutely blown away. The views were unreal and our pilot, Chris, was so experienced and made us feel comfortable. He was knowledgeable about the area and provided an awesome tour. Our original flight got cancelled due to weather, and rescheduling was seamless. The K2 team was great to work with, and I highly recommend them to anyone who is considering doing a flightseeing tour. We also had a lot of fun, see pictures attached !!

This was definitely the highlight of our trip.  From booking to landing K2 was awesome.
Our pilot Chad was a phenomenal pilot and narrator.  Our flight was incredible and something we will never forget.  And of course Denali was beaming in the sunlight!!! 
If you think you would want to try this stop thinking and book with K2 they are amazing friendly, helpful, group of people.  And thank you Ernie for your help as well with the shirt!

We were all set to land on a glacier at Denali, however the weather would not co-operate.  Nothing K2 can do about that and I give them an excellent rating because they handled it like true professionals, giving us various options and when one just wouldn't work due to our schedule giving a prompt refund.  Hopefully next time we are in Alaska we can have said adventure with K2 but we appreciate safety first!
Great flight and narration of peak highlights, points of interest and mountain and glaciers. It was a spectacular flight!

We thoroughly enjoyed our Denali flight. Our pilot narrated well and we felt very safe! We were to drive 12 hrs the next day but this got cut back due to road closure. The flight was the high light of our Denali experuence

We had booked the 2 hour tour around the north side of Denali but because of weather they had to shorten the ride. It was still amazing views of mountains and glaciers. The ride was extremely smooth and comfortable. No problems with motion sickness although we were prepared. The best part was being on the glacier. Unforgettable! Well worth the time and money.

review_title: We would do it again in a heartbeat.
review_text: We could not have asked for a better experience.  It was a beautiful day.  Our pilot, Joe, made us feel comfortable and explained any instructions we needed.  The landing on the glacier was a highlight of our trip.  The office staff were also very helpful, friendly, and prepared. We decided late to include the glacier landing and they were ready to accommodate us.  Thank you all!
This was the best part of our trip!  Incredible is an understatement.  We had an incredible pilot and our flight was able to land on the Glacier : )
The was certainly one of the highlights of our trip to Alaska.  The glacier landing was great and our pilot was excellent in both skill and area info.  Would do this again should we come back.

Easy check-in, pilot was friendly and professional.  Pilot communicated throughout the flight.  Disappointed we didn't get to land on Glacier but glad pilot didn't take the risk of a safe landing.  Great flight!

We've flown with K2 in the past and loved the experience so much that we did it again! We are from AZ and decided to stay in Talkeetna one night during our stay. We popped in to K2 without a reservation to see if by chance we would be able to join a flight, same-day. The front desk was friendly and informative, our pilot (Stan) was engaging and also very friendly. The overall experience was absolutely positive. We'll continue to be returning customers with K2!
We had a great time! It was the most memorable thing we did on our entire trip! Garrett was an excellent pilot and guide. We would highly recommend K2 Aviation!

My husband and I took a K2 flight around Denali and landed on the Ruth Glacier back in September of 2019, and LOVED every minute of the flight.  Highly recommend taking a K2 flight to fill your senses with beauty that exceeds no other.  We cannot wait for COVID to allow us to get back in the air with them!

We rode with Dorothy and she was awesome, answered any questions we had and gave us lots of information and details about our trip and Denali. We had a great time and it was so beautiful! Absolutely would go again! Also rad to have a female pilot 🤘🏽
What a wonderful experience!  The ground staff was very friendly and professional.  The pilot was incredibly knowledgeable about the area and we had a wonderful flight.

review_title: Highly scenic, Highly safe, and Highly Recommend!
review_text: Chris leveraged beautiful flying weather to get us close to, around, and into the tight spaces surrounding Denali. Great airmanship and terrain commentary. We appreciated the novelty of the glacier landing, although the flight alone would've been worth it even if visibility would have precluded this short stopover. As a retired military tactical flyer, I can rate pilot Chris as "Exceptionally Qualified."  An impressive pre-flight facility and well-organized process.  This experience while in Talkeeetna was the highlight of our 10 days in inland Alaska!
Must Do. Add to your bucket list. It was the most memorable adventure on our trip and we had many to choose from.
Our pilot, Chris was entertaining and educational while keeping safety as a priority. Great experience! Highly recommend
I was very nervous about flying on a small plane but the plane ride was great and the entire trip was wonderful.  This was a once in a lifetime trip and everyone should do this.

Flying over the Alaska range in a de Havilland Otter was the most incredible experience I have ever had. I am terrified of flying but the pilot was so amazing explaining how the aircraft works by the time we took off I was fine. He flew us over glaciers, mountains and rivers explaining what we were looking at. He loved flying people and his enthusiasm was infectious. As soon as we landed I wanted to go up again. Everyone at K2 was so nice and well organized I will definitely fly with them again. Bonus, Phil the corgi is so much fun to play with! Thank you to everyone at K2.

Landing on the glacier was amazing!! We had beautiful clear weather and very little turbulence. There had also been fresh snow the day before.  This of course were ideal conditions but our pilot was great and very informative too!
What an spectacular experience! Smooth flight and landing with stunning views of the mountains and lake surrounded with all the greens from top. Knowledgeable pilot and great sunny day.

review_title: A fantastic day in the alpine!
review_text: The trip was great in every facet, but our guide was especially knowledgeable, warm, funny, and led us through an educational, open-ended path on the tundra.  Never-ending panoramas and impressive hills and landscapes.  One was a glowing red mushroom, and all kinds of intricate flora and fauna.  No bears.   Thank you,K2!

My husband and I went on the grand Denali flight w/ glacier landing and it was worth every penny. Our pilot was awesome and very knowledgeable. I was nervous about flying in a small plane but it was a better ride than any airline I’ve flew with.

Landing on the glacier was very exciting and special.  Chris, our pilot, did such a good job of landing us very gently.  And there we were on the glacier, looking at the mountains. Amazing! A once in a lifetime experience
Awe inspiring experience. We felt safe through the whole process and would highly recommend. Make sure to add the glacier landing

We did the flight around the south side of Denali with a glacier landing. Chris, our pilot, was excellent, both as a pilot and guide. He was so informative about what we were seeing and details about the area and the mountain. Plus his takeoffs and landings were very smooth. We would recommend K2 to anyone.

review_title: Amazing experience!! Must do when visiting Alaska
review_text: K2 provided us best experience for glacier landing. Everything from their booking to checking was smooth. Our pilot seemed very experienced and we had good flight. Its one unique experience of lifetime so I would recommend to anyone to book it from K2.

review_title: Must Have Activity in Denali Area
review_text: The view is amazing when you land and surrounded by ice covered mountains. This is much more fun than taking the bus tour, if you have to choose one, choose the air tour with landing.

The weather was prefect; The pilot was enthusiastic, informative and gave a great  narrative. Flight was smooth and windows large enough to see all.  My family all adults thought it was the highlight of our vacation.

The scenery was terrific, but the exciting aspect of our trip was actually landing on the glacier.  On September 8, 2021, the sun was playing tag with fluffy white clouds. When we landed on the glacier and exited the plane for a walk, we were entertained by the suns rays appearing behind huge black rock pinnacles. K2 furnished us with non-slip boots that were worn over our boots, and the footing was secure.  Our pilot was very talented and explained the terrain as we flew over varying vistas.

review_title: Highlight of my trip to Alaska
review_text: This was the highlight of my trip to Alaska. The flight was incredible and something I'll never forget. The staff was super helpful and our pilot was wonderful! They were accommodating and everything ran smoothly. Would highly recommend this to anyone who is up in Talkeetna!

This experience was amazing for our entire family, which includes three young boys (8, 5, 3). They were very accommodating of the kids. They had car seats installed for them and ready to go in the plane, and they had their own kids' ear protection. Landing on the glacier was SO COOL! These memories will last a lifetime. Thank you K2!

An absolutely breath taking flight. Worth every penny. The people, facility and the plane were awesome. No  pictures or words can describe the views of the mountain. My only advice is to do this the last day of your trip as all other views of the mountain are ruined after seeing it so close.

My wife and I did the Grand Tour. We had just about perfect weather. The views were breathtaking, and everyone got a window seat. The ride was very smooth. My wife was worried about getting nauseous but didn't have any problems. The pilot was very knowledgeable and had a good sense of humor.

We did the Denali flyer with Glacier landing trip today. What a 5-star trip it was. Everything from booking the trip, check in, the flight, the experience and the glacier landing was top notch. The Kahiltna Glacier is amazingly 44 miles long and we flew over it for a long time and then landed on the Pika glacier. 
I will say again, everything was top notch and I will do it again, in a heart beat. Everyone was very professional and it is totally worth the money, considering how high we flew and what all we saw. I would recommend the trip as a must for anyone visiting Alaska.

I did the Denali flight with a glacier landing on Labor Day and was fortunate to have clear weather. The company was very professional, on time, safety/COVID conscious, and provided good value for your money. Highly recommend.

review_title: Top Activity to do in Talkeetna
review_text: Great flight around Denali and glacier landing.  The pilot very informative and highly recommend doing the trip when in Talkeetna.

review_title: Beautiful flight to Denali and glacier landing!
review_text: My husband and I were so thrilled with this experience.  This company was very friendly and helpful, and were very professional in every process from booking to flight experience.  Our guide Joe did a great job, and we were absolutely so glad that we decided to do this flight.  Thank you for making it great!

The flight was wonderful and the mountain was beautiful. I would definitely do the tour again next time. The glacier landing was on a snowfield on the top of the mountain. Accessing the formattable Denali summit is a privilege and one we were glad to share with K2 Aviation. 

Their professionalism and Talkeetna base (great town) allowed us to simply enjoy the exhilaration of being close to this very special place on earth.

An awe inspiring experience and an absolute value in the context of what life is all about.  The integrity of K2 Aviation is equally impressive and exceeded our expectations.

Tab over to their website and book it today with the hopeful understanding that Denali is a very shy peak.  I hope you are one of the humble few given the privilege to connect with the Denali Summit and K2 Aviation.

This trip was absolutely amazing! My dad and I went on this flight and it was just incredible to fly through Denali National Park and to land on a Glacier! For two Florida boys it was just jaw dropping. My complaint would be that they said everyone needed to wear masks while in the plane but 6 of the 10 of us on the flight were not wearing their masks so I was disappointed in that for sure...

review_title: An experience even long time Alaskans value
review_text: We have lived in Alaska since 1982 and travelled extensively in remote areas of the state.  We typically stay away from touristy places like Talkeetna in the summer but decided to take a cousin from Texas on a flight seeing trip with K2. Our one hour flight on K2 into the mountain area near Denali will stay with us for the rest of our lives. The pilot was exceptional and the sites difficult to describe in the space available here but as one of the more expensive things you’ve ever done for an hour… Suffice to say we do it again if given the opportunity.

As soon as you walk in the door, you know you are in a professional setting.  This company looks out for everyone's safety in so many ways.  Our first excursion was canceled due to weather, but that's NOT uncommon in Alaska.  Our rescheduled event was perfect.  Our pilot, Stan, was THE BEST!

Everything about K2 inspires confidence, which is essential if you're planning to ride a small plane up thousands of feet for a closer look at mountains and glaciers. We were practically giddy with delight by the time we reached the landing point. He took great care of us and it was a truly outstanding experience for everyone.

We chose K2 for our adventure because they offer a landing on the glacier and are so happy we did!  The whole experience with them was very professional and our guide/pilot was very knowledgeable about the area. This was the highlight of our trip to Alaska and should not be missed!!!

Overall we had a great experience. They covered a lot of the interior parts of denali national park which is otherwise not accessible by road. The plane ride was very smooth, and they really care about their customers and accommodate all requests within their reach.

review_title: Highlight of our trip! Simply incredible!!

You, guys made my day! Great customer service! This is an experience of a lifetime! Above Denali, we also landed on the glacier. Was awesome to sunbathe on the snow for a bit. Thank you ❤️
We took the glacier walk tour. Words cannot describe the experience and beauty. Highly recommended. Our guide was extremely knowledgeable. A must do!!!

I was born and raised in Alaska and always wanted to make this trip.
It was amazing and I would recommend this to everyone
My husband and I had the BEST time, we will remember forever

We flew out of Talkeetna over Denali in a small plane. This is an experience of a lifetime. Words can not express the magnitude of this mountain range, experiencing it from above and so close. I would highly recommend K2 Aviation.

review_title: Amazing Experience with an Amazing Company!
review_text: What an amazing experience! Highly recommending flying with K2 and doing the glacier landing! It was worth every penny.

One of the highlights of our trip to Alaska--the weather was perfect, views were phenomenal, and the experience of landing on a glacier was breathtaking. Great friendly, professional staff. Pilots are helpful and provide great commentary as we fly.

review_title: Grand Tour with Glacier Landing - renew vows

Life is short!!!! Get out an experience all there is to see while you can. Thankful we could experience Mt Denali and the mountain range using K-2. An experience my husband and I will never forget. Thank You K-2

review_title: Don’t fly on an overcast day
review_text:
I don’t usually write reviews but K2 has sent me several emails asking for one and I searched for this info before our trip and didn’t really find anything. The weeks leading up to our trip bad weather was in the forecast. Now I know not to trust a forecast until you get close to the date and Denali is a big place and had different weather throughout. Apparently K2 hadn’t flown in weeks. I feel for them this is a tough business with Covid and the weather not to be able to generate revenue. I wasn’t sure what their weather policy was so I emailed them and got this response:

“The weather in Alaska is highly variable, and many factors do influence our ability to fly. We can fly in rain as long as visibility permits and the weather is conducive up in the mountain range, but we always prioritize safety. Our decision for your flight will be made right around your check-in time, as it allows us to use the most accurate weather updates and best predict the flight conditions”

Visibility and conditions were quickly dropping before our flight. We had booked the glacier landing and were told we could still go but the pilot would make the decision in the air for the landing or not. As soon as we were in the air it was clear we wouldn’t be landing. The flight was still an experience but visibility was terrible and my partner got sick due to the bumpiness and another passenger spent the entire flight hunched over. I believe we were the last flight of the day they allowed to take off.

I’ve heard from several other people if you can land on the glacier it is a once in a lifetime magical experience. I wouldn’t recommend going up in lower visibility or poor conditions. All the photos and videos you see from K2 are in perfect conditions. Which 100% look worth it but I wouldn’t pay the price again for a low visibility bumpy flight. They did promptly refund us the difference for not being able to do the glacier landing and only charged us for a regular flight tour.

review_title: Knik Glacier and Chugach Mountains flightseeing Trip
review_text:
We had signed up for the Denali - glacier landing trip. It was scheduled for Last Tuesday but the trip was cancelled for bad weather. Later in the day we checked back and because of time constraints we were able to take the Knik Glacier trip in lieu of our preferred trip. 

We had the good luck to have Dorothy as our pilot, and she took control of our 1 hour- 45 minute flight. She was personable, and a very good “explainer” of what we were seeing. She certainly gained our confidence and we had a wonderful flight to the Chugach Mountains and its environs with extra emphasis on the Knik Glacier. 

It was a great trip which we will remember forever. 

Dennis Ryan and Lili Chequer

DISCLAIMER: I’m a tour professional living and working here in Alaska and not compensated in any way for this review. I do it because these operators are my FELLOW ALASKANS. 

There are a handful of memory-making travel experiences around the world that are worth the extra expense after just “getting there”. When you come to South Central Alaska (the greater Anchorage area), a flight up into the Alaska Range is a must. Sure, it’s spendy. (But many worthwhile things in life aren’t easy or cheap.) Get a mountain-sized dose of amazement and humility flying among the mountains above glacier-covered gorges. The beauty is mesmerizing. Feeling so tiny against these giant peaks gives one the opportunity to take a breath and view life's hassles with a little humility and perspective.

I’ve been bringing guests to K2 Aviation for almost two decades because of their outstanding commitment to safety and hospitality. From nearly immaculate aircraft to the thoughtful considerations like a basket of “loaner” sunglasses, K2 has this thing figured out! With K2, everything from the patience of the folks on the phones explaining prices and weather, to the shuttle drivers and pilots who clearly LOVE what they do, these people care that guests have a genuinely amazing time. But it’s not just tour groups that get great service. I’ve seen independent travelers in rental cars walk away after a flight with the same joyful glow that my guests get after a great flight.

REAL TALK: The Alaska Range is tricky. The weather up here is tricky. Book the first available time slot that you can. Try to be in Talkeetna more than one night to increase your chances of a “try again” flight in case weather isn’t cooperative during your visit. What K2 tells you about weather and visibility comes from a deep tradition of transparency with their guests. They really desire that everyone has a great flight. They have been forthright with me in communication. I trust them when they advise me about weather and I know from years of successful flights and hundreds of happy clients that they want all fliers to come away with a mind-blowing, life-changing flight in the Alaska Range!

TIPS: Be on time. Wear a mask. Tip your pilot. If you’re in a group, one person takes a time-lapse video and others take photos to share later. Put down the cameras every few minutes and soak in the experience with your eyes and your imagination. Enjoy the moment and make some truly amazing memories!

Despite it being very busy the day we flew and did the glacier landing, we didn't feel rushed and had an incredible experience. It was sunny outside and the views were excellent. Our pilot was professional and even offered to take our photo. We would definitely recommend this experience with K2 Aviation.

K2 Aviation has provided service beyond my expectations. The complete trip was well maintained and well organized. The pilot is trained and provided complete information about the area while flying. K2 Aviation is ontime and schedule and Glacier Landing experience is awesome. 

Anyone taking this tour, I would recommend  to take the Glacier Landing for a different kind of experience all together.

The tour was great. Our pilot was really friendly and we had the best experience. We couldn't flight the day we booked because of the weather but the K2 team made a great work to re-schedule another day for us.

We had a glacier experience canceled due to weather!  There was no apology or attempt to rebook or even a voucher for a discount on a future flight!  It put a huge damper on our entire trip!  It was cloudy but never rained where we were!  Very disappointed!

Great customer experience with the whole crew at K2! They were quite accommodating given the weather challenges, but the second shot at a flight was fantastic as we danced around the clouds to capture some pics of Denali, surrounding mountains and glaciers. Top rate outfit with facilities and equipment. Our pilot, Chris made the how experience a once in a lifetime event.
My wife and I were very pleased with all of the employees of K2 and especially the pilot.  The pilot was very knowledge and I was confident in his abilities.

If you made it to the 49th state, one thing you must set aside is time to see Denali from the air!  Plan to do it first thing on your arrival, as the weather is unpredictable and you may need to reschedule.  From the moment you make your reservation to the time you step off your flight, you will find the people of K2 to be professional, experienced, safety minded, and service oriented.  

As a professional pilot with over 15,000 hours flying everything from a small Cessna to a B-747, I've seen much of the world.  Nothing compares to the experience of flying around the peaks of Denali.  It is awe inspiring to see the peaks, sheer cliffs, and glaciers, from such a short distance.

The planes are well kept, have some of the latest navigational technology, and are clean.  The pilots are very experienced, they know the terrain, and they have a grasp on what the weather can do in very short order.  I found the whole operation to be extremely well run and professional.

Highly recommend the morning tours as we had better luck seeing the mountain before clouds form around the peaks.

The staff at K2 is cheerful and kind.  While we couldn't take the Denali trip we booked due to weather they were happy suggest an alternative flight which we all enjoyed.  Our pilot was full of interesting information about the glaciers and the area and he showed a genuine love of flying and of sharing the beauty of Alaska with his guests.  What a memory!  It will last a lifetime!!
We landed on the Glacier and it was the most incredible experience and scenery I've ever seen. Photos don't do it it justice. A must do!
We had a flightseeing of Denali the past June. This is a great experience for us and we really enjoyed the flight trip.

We were lucky enough to have our flight booked on one of the clearest and calmest days. The pilot made a for a great guide telling us about the mountains and moving so everyone on the plane got a great view. This trip is one of my best memories of Alaska. Thank you all!!
Will, our pilot, was super! Counter folks were great as well! Views of the mountains were superb. Overall, so far, this flight was the highlight of our Alaskan adventure!

review_title: "Denali Experience" was a great (and safe) experirience
review_text: We made an ad-hoc reservation whil staying overnight in Talkeetna. The crew at K2 was professional, explained everything well pre-flight. We had booked the flight with a glacier landing. Our pilot did an excellent briefing and gave everybody a sense that this will be a safe experrience. We got to see some magnificent scenery with interesting and relevant explanations by the pilot. He had to cancel the glacier landing due to light conditions, which was the right and safe thing for him (as pilot-in-command) to do. Being a pilot myself I was impressed and felt reassured by the flight operations and pilots of K2. Highly recommended

This was a wonderful flight over the park and a sunny, clear view of the mountain! We were so lucky since our first flight six years ago was fogged out and no view at all! The pilot was knowledgeable and able to point out the interesting areas, including people who were climbing to the summit. We would do this flight again!
Maury and his wife made our experience at K2 sensational.  From our last minute purchase of tickets to the incredible flight, K2 does a sensational job.   Don't hesitate, just do it.

This experience was my favorite part of my Alaskan adventure. K2 aviation is excellent at their jobs. We were informed early that due to weather conditions and it not being safe, we would not land on the glacier that day.  The woman in charge was very calm, friendly, and confident about that announcement and even brought out Charlie the dog to interact with us. Pro-tip for delivering bad news in the future! Obviously, these folks are professionals and safety is the top priority.

We were checked in, weighed, signed our waivers quickly, and in a relatively short time frame were met by the pilot who thoroughly briefed us for our flight.  Joe was our pilot and he took us on a breathtaking tour of many of the glaciers that surround Denali.  Because the weather was moving in, he carefully directed us towards the open sky and showed us some of the most beautiful places I've ever seen.  He had a thorough knowledge of the area and answers my zillion questions about flying and the aircraft.  He also made it a point to check in on the passenger's comfort while we flew - everything from temperature to turbulence. 

I would absolutely recommend this group to anyone, and can't wait to get back to Alaska to fly with them again!

Every part of the activity was well planned and was an excellent experience. The plane ride took us over all the major spots around Denali National Park and we enjoyed stunning views of Mt. Denali and surrounding areas. The plane was in excellent condition and the pilot was professional and informative. Would definitely go again with K2!

Our group was lucky to have perfect weather for the tour which made it possible to do the whole tour and land on the glacier. The staff was very nice and made the experience more enjoyable.  Definitely recommend as this was our group’s favorite part of our week long Alaska trip.

I went on an air taxi tour of Denali with a landing, and it was absolutely incredible. When the weather is right, there's nothing that can compare. The staff is so kind, considerate, and capable that you really feel valued as a customer. I would highly recommend K2 Aviation for anyone interested in a once-in-a-lifetime experience that is worth the money.
This is nothing short of magical. Clip coupons, sell your jewelry, do whatever you have to do to find the funds to do this. It is THAT impactful and memorable. Trust me on this one.

K2 took us around Denali State Park and we landed on a glacier. We got lucky--the day was absolutely clear and sunny and our K2 pilot took full advantage of the beauty of the day and the stunning scenery. We couldn't have been happier with the experience we had with them--very professional, friendly, safety-conscious. We were a couple and an 80 year old granny and we all had a fantastic time. Our pilot, Chris, really made the whole thing special--a once in a lifetime experience
It was Awesome from the moment we walked through the door. The staff was friendly and helpful and the pilot was professional from start to finish.
Fantastic experience- beyond expectations- this was a once in a lifetime visit easily worth its price!
This flight definitely exceeded my expectations. It was breathtaking and Dorthy, our pilot, was amazing!  I would recommend K2 Aviation to anyone.

Everything about this adventure was fabulous.  From resort pick up to drop off the people at K2 are top notch.  The flight was perfect! Our pilot Stan was great.  I can not use words to describe the glacier landing, a definite must do for any Alaska trip.  K2 was safe, clean and FUN!

review_title: Mountain Climbing Service with a Smile
review_text: K2 aviation was an awesome operation through and through, especially if you are planning a trip to climb Denali! Everyone was very personable, the pilots were all spot on and detailed about everything. The best part was that we didn't wait at all getting back to basecamp! it took an hour for them to send two airplanes and off we went. Other teams were waiting there for hours before the other company came in to get them.

Professional and efficient staff got us amazing views on an especially clear day in Denali. We got some Nat Geo quality videos from the air, and I jumped at the chance to ride in the copilot seat. My wife is an iffy flier and she also felt safe throughout. Weather unfortunately kept us from landing on the glacier, but there was still plenty to see from altitude. Pricey but well worth the $
Great tour and fun with letting me sit in the copilot seat. Great service and people. Thanks again K2.

What a day to see Denali and friends via air. Our trip pilot was great. We learned a lots and had the time to go where the winds and weather allowed so he could show us even more. Totally a must in Alaska.

This was the highlight of our trip. We did the glacier landing. My husband is a pilot and recommends this particular service because of the known quality of their planes, maintenance, and superior pilots. Highly recommended!

My family booked the "Denali Flyer with glacier landing" flight this summer and loved it.  When surface weather made the glacier landing unsafe, K2 didn't charge us for it and we experienced just the flight, which was incredible.  The pilot was very knowledgeable about all aspects o the terrain and pointed out various features to us.  He was also a very experienced and safe pilot, who maneuvered the plane to give both sides excellent views of glaciers, peaks and valleys.

This was our favorite thing we did while in Alaska.  Getting to ride in a plane up to Denali Mountain was spectacular.  Views were gorgeous.  HIghlight was getting to land on the glacier and getting out of the plane and walking around.  It wasnt too cold either.  Our pilot was fantastic.  Very knowledgeable and very friendly.  This is a must do when in Alaska.

This was an amazing adventure! Staff was professional and informative as well as very knowledgeable about the area and terrain which only enhanced the experience while we took in the breath taking views! So much fun and we will always cherish the memories made! Highly recommend! Thank you K2
Amazing! The pilot was excellent. Perfect flight along with a wealth of information of Denali. Would recommend this trip to everyone.

Flight up to glacier was very scenic .
Landing on a glacier was an awesome experience.
Pilot was very knowledge and answered all questions
Words can’t describe what an amazing experience this was. The weather was perfect, and Garret was an Awesome pilot!

This was an amazing experience that none of us will ever forget!
Smooth flight and beautiful scenery

review_title: Flight Seeing tour of Mt Denali
review_text: We are a family of 4 enjoyed the tour inspite of the uncertainty due to changing weather conditions. We had planned for a trip incl Glacier landing, however, the Glacier landing could not be done due to bad weather. Our guide and pilot Maury (apologize in advance if misspelled) was amazing. We highly recommend K2 Aviation.

This flight was definitely worth the money.  The pilot was very knowledgeable about the area and flying over Denali and being so close to everything in the park was breathtaking.  The highlight of our trip!

This was a fantastic experience for our family! Such great views of the range from the air that will remain with us for a long time. Because of the weather we were not able to do the glacier landing but despite that it was breathtaking. The staff is professional and very friendly. Highly recommended.

I am a very anxious flyer and was having a hard time deciding if I would go on the flight trip.  The pilot, Patrick, came out to meet me, took me to the plane to show me everything, and really put me at ease.  He checked on me throughout the flight.  It was an amazing experience, and I am so glad that I decided to go through with it. One of the highlights of our vacation.

I was moved to tears by flying so close to the peak of Denali (and not because of fear).  It was a breathtaking experience and one I will never forget.  So incredibly beautiful and not something at our age we could have done on foot!  Our pilot said it best while he patted our airplane.  "I agree with you that this is a magical experience.  I think of these planes as our magic carpets."

We were scheduled to go four days earlier; however, due to the clouds we were told we could fly but not do the glacier landing.  Very upfront about the conditions.  Four days later, clear blue sky and spectacular flight.  Had plenty of time to hang out on the glacier with about six other planes.  The pilot made a point of ensuring both sides had great views.

What a unique and awe inspiring experience. K2 met all our expectations. The pilot's expertise was obvious and the planes had amazing views from every seat. While the weather wasn't as cooperative as we hoped, the pilot was able to navigate safely to give us amazing views of the glaciers, peaks and educated us on everything we were seeing. The glacier landing was incredible. Great landing and a once in a lifetime experience. This is a tour not to be missed!
Knowledgeable, kind, professional pilot took us on an unforgettable tour of Denali and the surrounding peaks. I would absolutely use this company again and highly recommend.
Everything was done in a professional manner and all employees were very courteous. Employees went to great length to make sure you understood everything.

We did the Glacier Experience.  Our pilot was terrific and knew so much about the area and what we were seeing. The views from the plane were amazing and so varied.
There was no way you could see how varied and stunning the terrain is unless you were in a plane. We would defiinitely do it again.  We really wanted to do the glacier landing, but are grateful that safety concerns are a priority.

Our trip was awesome! Very organized check in and our pilot was fantastic. We also had a rare sunny day and got to see so much. 

What set this place above all was their customer service weeks after our trip. I lost my sunglasses on the plane and thought they were a lost cause. However, 2 weeks after my vacation, they called me to tell me they found them! I can’t believe they still even had my name and phone number with all the people and lost items they deal with! Very impressed with this company, will definitely use in the future! Thank you K2!

review_title: Best experience of Denali and glacier
review_text: We were little worried about motion sickness. But our pilot assured us that we will be fine and he is the best. He made it an awesome experience for our family of 4. Pilot explained the terrain and the history down. The landing was smooth and glacier was beautiful. We had perfect clear weather. A big thank you to our pilot.

review_title: Please don’t miss doing this flight
review_text:
AMAZING !! BEYOND ALL EXPECTATIONS 
The views you will see from the aircraft can’t be described 
The service of the staff is unreal 
Our pilot JOE was so smooth so knowledgable felt so safe with him, I would request him if you decide to do this flight .

If in Kalkeetna  don’t miss this

review_title: Arguably the best thing to do in Alaska.
review_text: We did the flyer tour with the glacier landing. The trip is amazing and it was really cool landing in a massive glacier and being able to wear just a t shirt. We were lucky to do this on a day with 0 clouds in the sky too! We had to rebook because they weren't going out, and a call ahead would have been nice. Our pilot always seemed like he was in a rush, but everything about the trip was breathtaking. Just make sure if you book a glacier landing you call the day of to make sure they're going.
What a great time. Unfortunately we couldn't land on the glacier but the flight was amazing on it's own. Chris was a terrific pilot. Entertaining and professional.  Would recommend to anyone

review_title: The highlight of our trip to Alaska
review_text:
All I can say is...DO THIS! It was, hands down, the highlight of our trip to Alaska. The views were fantastic and our pilot, Will, was absolutely great. He clearly wanted to give us an unforgettable experience. We were very impressed with all the safety precautions taken by K2, not only within the plane itself, but also with their concern for the weather and what we would be able to see.  We were scheduled to fly around Denali on the Grand Denali Tour, but the winds on the north side of the mountain were too high to allow this so they rebooked us on the Denali Flyer tour and refunded the excess payment. We were the only two passengers with Will and we had gorgeous views. Yes, it is expensive, but so worth it. 

We had also done the flight out of Kantishna (which was also wonderful) after the six hour bus ride into Denali , but the flight out of Talkeetna was more spectacular because you fly directly toward Denali from a distance, seeing it come closer and closer.

Definitely one of the highlights if not THE highlight of our Alaska Trip. Great people, Amazing Views and Great Equipment. Our Pilot was excellent and knowledgeable and very engaging. 
Highly recommended.
Rick
Michigan

review_title: Intro to Ak for 2 grandsons both 18
review_text: I’d been there twice and wanted to share Alaska with two grandsons, they’re cousins.  This was their first experience and it was amazing.  Chris, our pilot was as excited to offer as great a time as I was.  He flew up close and around the peak of Denali and landed gently on a glacier for us to get pix and breathe in the high altitude.  It was the start to an amazing Alaskan vacation and a must do for anyone who is considering experiencing this wondrous state.
Best day in Alaska so far!! Whole experience was special from meeting the owners dog Charlie to our pilot Stan!! Highly recommend!!

We went back and forth on whether or not to splurge on this experience, and we are so glad we did. While we were in the air, my husband looked at me and said "Worth every penny!" My 3 kids (14-22) all agreed it was the best part of our trip which was filled with other incredible activities. Tip- add the glacier landing! We are so, so glad we did. Thank you to our pilot, Mike!
Pilot was very skilled and very informative. We were the "LUCKY 5%" where Denali and Mt McKinley were crystal clear-not a cloud in the sky. What a view! Touch down was perfect and the ride great!!

Jeff was a safe and energetic pilot, filled with personality and knowledge . Though it was a cloudier day we still viewed so much of God’s beautiful Alaska.  We were credited for time we were shorted.
Awesome experience. Great view of Denali the surrounding mountains and the glaciers. Excellent value for money. Highly recommend.
Our pilot Chad was a total pro. Professional, courteous and competent. Every thing you would want I a pilot.

We spent ten days in Alaska and the flight with glacier landing was incredible!!! We had three teenagers with us and they loved it as well. I would highly recommend anyone thinking of doing a glacier landing go with K2. They were extremely friendly and knowledgeable.

Exceptional sights of majestic peaks and valleys.  Weather conditions did not permit viewing of Denali or the glacier landing.  But the sights afforded by the Ruth Glacier were simply incredible.  Must do activity, even if weather does not permit sighting of Denali from up close.

The staff of the company were super nice and helpful.  Our pilot was fantastic -- superb flyer and provided knowledgeable commentary.  The owner is a gem of a person.  We got to know her a little bit when she stepped in to drop us off at our hotel as her staff was incredibly busy (short staffed due to current COVID related issues).

review_title: Flight Seeing of Denali from Talkeetna
review_text: On a trip to Alaska for a family wedding, we decided to spend extended time in the state exploring Talkeetna and Denali National Park.  We opted for a flight seeing excursion from Talkeetna to see Denali rather than a lengthy 10 hour bus trip within the National park as we had heard bus trippers made the effort but never saw Denali (even tho weather was clear earlier in the day). Made reservation with K2 several days before so we knew the forecast.  Our pilot, Chad, gave each side of the plane many opportunities to view Denali plus offered comments regarding climbers’ base camps, named glaciers, blue glacier pools, ski tracks from climbers, etc. Our flight landed on Ruth Glacier and allowed about 20 minutes to get out of the plane and walk on the glacier.  We took hundreds of photos as the day was clear with few clouds.  Although we dressed for warmth for higher elevations (thermal ski clothes liners), Chad was wearing a short sleeved Hawaiian shirt so needless to say, he expected fabulous weather which is exactly what we got.  Sunglasses were a must!  The biggest thrill for me was that I was allowed to sit in copilot seat on return to Talkeetna and able to video takeoff from glacier curving up and thru a canyon to save and re-experience this once in a lifetime event. Definitely a highlight of our Alaskan adventure!
This is an amazing experience. We saw so much and truly enjoyed the entire trip. Landing on a glacier and getting to walk on it is a treat.

K2 Aviation was outstanding! Viewing the bears in Lake Clark National Park was amazing. We landed on a beach got very close to the bears and got a lot of up close photos. Alex was a great pilot. Very informative and helpful. It was a perfect day. We even saw a bald eagle. Thank you so much for being the best!
Flying around the mountains & glaciers was amazing! Landing & taking off on a glacier up near Denali was awesome! It was a smooth, informative, comfortable ride & we had a great pilot!

review_title: It Is a Joy to Fly with K2 Aviation
review_text: You cannot go wrong with choosing to fly with K2 Aviation. Our flight experiences were extremely positive. The pilot was engaging, followed all safety protocols, and made the experience extremely fun and entertaining. I would definitely recommend K2 Aviation while you are in Alaska!

Reservations were straightforward and we were forewarned that the weather could compromise our views. The veteran pilot was excellent and personable, and let us know the plane manuevers ahead of time so you weren't anxious. Though we had really hoped to see Denali it was surrounded by weather, but the pilot narrated about all the other beautiful glacial landscapes we were seeing. We had time constraints and couldn't fly another time but I'm really glad we went. If you had the option to await better weather, it would be worth it

review_title: Great Experience, But Ease Up On the Face Masks!
review_text: Well worth the experience! Very friendly, professional and thorough staff and pilot!  The lounge, waiting area, restrooms and overall premises was exceptionally clean and comfortable!  Our only disappointment was the overly strict enforcement of the facemasks, which we felt was a little overboard, especially on board a well ventilated aircraft and all of us had been fully vaccinated against the Covid-19.  Many businesses in the Anchorage and Seward area have already eased up with the facemask restrictions, making for a more comfortable visit.  The federal government needs to get out of the way and let America get back to normal, using everyday common sense!

K2 is a top notch company.  They take safety seriously.  Masks were required for all passengers and crew.   I really appreciated this as I have 2 children who are too young to be vaccinated.  Our pilot was excellent (I wish I could remember his name!).  The weather on the day of our trip was not great, but our pilot managed to weave in and out of the clouds to find excellent  views. We even saw the peak of Denali! 

This trip is very weather dependent,  so try to leave some flexibility in your schedule in case you cannot go exactly on schedule.

review_title: Don't miss this tour with K-2!
review_text: K-2 is the way to go!  Very professional from the very start to end.  Our pilot in the Otter was knowledgeable with the geology and knew every canyon and glacier by name AND could multitask as a pilot, tour guide and flight attendant all at once!  At the very end of the flight Denali peak came out of the clouds and he made one more turn so that we could all see it- amazing!  Our tour had to be downgraded from the Grand Tour because of the weather on the back side of the mountain but it did not disappoint.  Don't miss this tour!

We did the Denali Flyer with glacier landing. The staff were very friendly and professional. Unfortunately, we had to reschedule our flight 3 times due to rainy weather, but glad we were able to fly towards the end of our trip. It was such an amazing experience flying around Denali.  The glacier landing is a must! It was absolutely beautiful. The sheer magnitude of those mountain ranges were unbelievable. We got to fly so close to them. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and experienced. We had an incredible experience and would HIGHLY recommend this experience to everyone!!!

review_title: I made reservations,  I arrived in Talkeetna, I was picked up at my guest house. I arrived at airport. I flew.
review_text: Joe, the pilot, was not just knowledgable and interesting, he put us all at ease with clear safety instructions,  very obvious attention to his task, and some needed comedic relief.. It was one of the most spectacular things I've ever done..and I've done a lot.
The plane was super smooth barely any turbulence. Our pilot was very informative about the topography. The scenery amazing! Landing on the glacier was super smooth

review_title: Fabulous and a Must Do in Alaska
review_text: This was the most exciting tour we did on our Alaska vacation. This is a definite  MUST DO. You won't regret it!! Worth every penny.

Fantastic flight.  It was a beautiful day so the views were tremendous.  The glacier landing was a memorable experience.  Our pilot (Chris - ?) was terrific - very personable and gave us good information along the way.

I had a great experience in my flight with K2.  We were lucky to have a great day with awesome visibility. The pilot started out by explaining the safety precautions and making sure everyone was comfortable with the plane and flight plans before getting on the plane.  Seating was comfortable and we all had window seats.  The views were amazing and the pilot kept us informed on what we were seeing as we all had headsets with microphones to communicate.

This was the highlight of our Alaskan Adventure.  A breathtaking experience that will leave you in awe of the beauty and majesty of Denali. Our pilot, Wilbur, was wonderful. He put any worry and anxiety at ease before we even left the ground. With 47 years experience, we were in the the best hands. The views are stunning and will leave you awestruck. Do not miss this wonderful experience!

My husband and I had such an amazing experience doing the Denali Grand Tour with Glacier Landing. It was an experience that we will never forget. The flight itself was so smooth and we were lucky to have good weather to get a good a view of Denali and the glaciers. We were even able to see an active avalanche from the air. I highly recommend this to everyone!
We had an amazing experience at K2. The flight was a once in a lifetime experience I will remember forever. Staff was friendly and helpful and the facility is very nice.
This was a fantastic outing!!!  The staff were great!!!  We had an unexpected surprise.  We were able to land at Denali base camp.  This was such a great experience.

Did the flyer with the glacier landing and it was worth every penny! I was admittedly scared for my life for a brief second but that’s because I’m a scaredy cat. The plane and pilot were top notch and I’ll tell everyone to do K2 at least once in their life.

got to sit in copilots seat and got some great shots with my DSLR, landed on the glacier and didn't fall into a fissue and die, which apparently can happen. Nobody puked, no turbulence, Chris I think was our pilot, he was super nice. The mask stuff was pretty dumb though since the plane isn't pressurized, its like being outside.

review_title: Clearly a highlight of the trip!
review_text: Do not miss landing on a glacier if you visit Alaska.  This was absolutely amazing.  K2 did an excellent job.

review_title: Beautiful day flying and landing on glacier
review_text: So thankful for a perfect day to fly and land on a glacier in beautiful Denali National Park. Everyone has a window seat and headset so you can hear the pilot describe all you’re seeing

Spectacular Flight in a small ski plane up close to Denali and through the surrounding Alaska Range.  Our Pilot Wilbur was experienced, calm and capable.  This was a highlight among many great Alaska experiences.  Highly recommend!

review_title: Glacier Landing Flight from Talkeetna - Well worth it!
review_text: We did the Denali Glacier Landing Flight from Talkeetna. It was a fantastic experience. This activity was our favorite and a must do if you visit. I highly recommend staying in Talkeetna and doing this flight option as the town is charming, the flight was unique and the pilot was top notch.

The flight tour of Denali and landing on Ruth Glacier was a spectacular trip and I highly recommend it to anyone interested in learning more about the Susitna river valley and Denali. Our pilot was informative about everything from the geography of the river valley to the geology of the mountains and colliding tectonic plates. Mountain flying is technical and requires great experience. As a private pilot I was impressed with the professionalism of our pilot - from the preflight safety briefing, to his awareness and avoidance of other traffic, radio communication skills, technical flying skills and decision making, his actions were exemplary and only made the flight more enjoyable.
Pilot was awesome, plane was well-maintained and spacious, flight took about 90 minutes and was a wonderful experience.
Great trip.  Thoroughly enjoyed sight seeing Denali.   Flying was excellent.   Pilot was very  knowledgeable.

Wonderful team to manage this lifetime opportunity!  We had booked the trip to go around Denali, but the weather was bad on the other side so they refunded the difference. The pilot, Patrick, was great and gave us our glacier landing first because of impending weather. Really great trip and company. I highly recommend!

review_title: Office lied to us consistently multiple times
review_text:
Office intentionally lied to us multiple times.

There were three levels of yours running - blue , yellow , green. We were booked for the highest tier - green on our way up to Denali. Due to bad weather we had to reschedule on our way back, cancelling our itinerary to see Anchorage instead. We called every 2-3 hours for 2 days to confirm that green tour is running. Every time they said, yes it is running. We tried to reschedule it to another convenient time - they said the green tour is full for all other slots. When we reached at our scheduled time, we were told green tour had not been running for few days, we can downgrade to yellow or get refund. 

Now that we had lost the opportunity to see Anchorage as originally planned, we did the yellow tour. But it was deceitful on their part to not tell us in the 6-8 calls we made that the tour we are booked for has not been running. I understand weather condition can change - the green tour may not be running in morning but might run at our scheduled time. But when we explicitly asked if green tour was running - they should have told us honestly. Instead they were telling us it is 'fully booked'. 

Had they honestly told us that green one was not running since morning, we would have not skipped seeing Anchorage for the 'possibility' of green tour . It was because of their false confirmation that green one is running, we changed our itinerary.

We took the K2 adventure and the green route around the park and lanes on a glacier.  While I enjoyed the Mendenhall glacier more this was still a bucket list adventure.  Second tallest mountain and the coldest in the world.  A must do, regardless of cost
The staff was very friendly and helpful from booking to flying. They even picked us up at the hotel. I cant describe the beauty of the mountains and glaciers.  We won't ever forget the experience.
We had a wonderful night to go up and see Mt. Denali, super clear!!  Sunny and warm.  Our pilot , Will was great with all the history and information about the plane and the mountain.
Hearing the pilot Chris point out various aspects of the mountains as well as the base camp. So cool!!
Incredible trip, organization, pilot, and memories.  Highly recommend K2.  Did the grand Denali tour and the trip was a big success.
The K2 flight with glacier landing was a once in a lifetime experience. The adventure was worth every penny. The staff was conscientious and courteous. Top notch experience.
Patrick was an amazing tour pilot! We landed at the base camp of Mt Denali and it was the most beautiful experience!
Although a bit costly, the Glacier Landing tour of K2 is the highlight of my trip to Alaska. Professional captain and staff. Beautiful red planes!

Excellent staff, very professional and knowledgeable of the site. Unique experience, I highly recommend to get a tour were you land on the glacier, you won't spend too much time on it, but enough to get some really good pictures.

For us, the weather was perfectly clear. Views of Denali and surrounding mountains were unobstructed and breathtaking. The pilot provided interesting information about the terrain during the flight. Landing on the glacier was smooth, and we were able to go out and walk on the surface. Overall, and excellent experience and one of the highlights of our vacation in Alaska.

Absolutely a MUST-DO - we stayed at the Talkeetna Alaskan Lodge. K2 was right on time with the pick up and dropped us off immediately after (no waiting). We were very fortunate for gorgeous weather. 70 outside and excellent visibility. The air in the plane in the mountains was cold but the pilot did his best to keep the heat turned on. 

The pilot was super friendly and knowledgeable. Gives heads up when bumps are coming which is great for those with anxiety flying. There was a slight hiccup and K2 said they couldn’t fly the route I booked due to winds that day but they happily refunded the difference in cost. 

Me and my husband lovedddd this adventure. What a way to see Denali

When the 5 of us arrived at K2 for our flight around Mt. Denali, we were asked if we would mind our tour changing and being upgraded to a Glacier Landing tour!!!  Obviously we accepted the upgrade and joined 5 other people on the trip.  We had excellent weather, a very knowledgeable pilot who answered all of our questions about the area and we thoroughly enjoyed the glacier landing at the base camp of climbers for Mt. Denali.

review_title: If you don’t do this tour then you didn’t really visit Alaska!
review_text:
If you are coming to Alaska you must do this!  Our trip was the third weekend in May and the weather was gorgeous.  The trip is once in a lifetime.  Glaciers, mountains, rivers, and amazing views of Denali and Denali National Park.  You feel like you are on a different planet.  The glacier landing is a must.  A truly unique experience.  Our pilot Jeff was super approachable and a great guide, knowledgeable in the history of the park, the mountains, and glaciers.  He made the trip even more enjoyable with his narration. 

K2 Aviation is a super professional operation.  Not one complaint. We originally booked the grand tour but because of weather they booked suit a different tour on the morning of and refunded the money automatically, no fuss.  When I come back to Alaska I’ll be visiting K2 once again.
Very professional and knowledgeable pilots and staff. Highly recommend if you want to see Denali! We had a great time.

This was the experience of a lifetime. By nature of their business, weather can play a role in their ability to provide their service. K2 was phenomenal at staying in communication with me when inclement conditions threatened our adventure. I am so thankful for the upfront, clear, and continued communication from the staff. Everyone was so professional and kind. Now, my flight tour of Denali was nothing short of amazing. Our pilot, Chris, was full of relevant facts and totally down to earth. It was a pleasure flying with him. Even though the planned flight couldn’t happen due to conditions, we we’re able to take an alternate flight, and Chris made sure it was worth our time and money. Seeing Denali from on top of the clouds was a once in a lifetime opportunity. I hope I get to go back someday, and if I don’t, no regrets. K2 and Chris gave us a phenomenal experience, so good that even my young adult children who are impossible to impress were blown away.

We were left in total exhilaration after our K-2 flight over Denali with the Glacier landing. Nothing compares to this trip in our opinion. We were so grateful for a sunny day. Our pilot, Chris, was experienced and confident!  Such a joy🌈

If you are thinking about taking this flight tour, take this review as your sign to do it. This experience was worth every penny. Be flexible though - we originally paid for a glacier landing and the conditions simply weren't right the day of our flight. The staff refunded the difference of what was initially booked and it was still an absolutely wonderful experience.

We had a wonderful time with Chad, our pilot. He was curteous and very informative throughout the flight.  We were told that we were in a rare group of the 5% to see all three large mountain tops of Mt Hunter, Denali and Foraker!  We loved the experience   as a unique celebration for our 40th anniversary.  The entire staff was curteous and very helpful.  If/when we return we would most likely take another flight with K2 Aviation. Thanks, Chad, you were the best!  Randy and Kathie Schwarz

My husband and I drove up to Talkeetna for our K2 Aviation Denali Experience Flightseeing tour and it was incredible! The staff was kind and knowledgeable, the tour itself was breathtaking, and the experience was a once in a lifetime opportunity. We also recommend the Denali Brewpub in Talkeetna that was very satisfying after our flight!

Friends and I looked into a flight seeing tour of Denali and the glaciers and we were not dissapointed. The pilot, Jeff, was a great tour guide. He was very informative and managed his flight to give everyone a pretty good view of attractions. The flight could not have been better from weather to views. A long time goal and now checked off the bucket list.  Wonderful day!

My wife and I went to Alaska in celebration of our 30th anniversary.  We wanted a special trip and every one at  K2 Aviation helped make that happen.  The experience was amazing with Chris our pilot narrating historical, geological, and other interesting facts along the way.  We flew up and landed on Ruth glacier and spent some time taking in the majesty of the surroundings.  Needless to say, we were awestruck.  We vowed to come back and experience Alaska in the Summer and Winter months and that includes coming back to K2 for another adventure into the last frontier.

Flight was scheduled for 1pm and we didn’t leave the ground until 2:30. They were very nice overall but that was a long wait for something that we scheduled ahead of time. It would have been nice to know they were running behind before we got there so we could eat or go look around town before

Absolutely great staff. Erica did everything possible to squeeze me in on a flight. Worked out great. Very knowledgeable staff and pilots. One of the coolest experiences I’ve ever had.
Thank you!
Excellent service and experience. Jeff and Chris were the best!! Our glacier landing wedding was amazing. My husband is a pilot and loved it so much, he wants to know if you are hiring.

review_title: Flight over Denali and Glacier Landing
review_text: Flight cancelled due to weather but rescheduled for next day.  Next day flight was delayed due to scheduling but K2 worked to make it right.  I think K2 understands this is a once in a lifetime trip for most people and do their best, and keep that in mind.
Great morning ride. Safe flight and very professional. Amazing way to see the Alaskan Range and Denali. Highly highly recommend.

We knew coming up to Alaska we wanted to do a flight tour but didn't know which company we were going to go with.  I can say that I was extremely happy with choosing K2. Chris, our pilot, was amazing and was so knowledgeable about the area and the mountains. We did the glacier landing and it just blew us away.  Thank you K2 and Chris and I will recommended them any chance I get

The trip was phenomenal! Everyone should experience it at least once. We originally booked glacier landing along with the fly tour, but the weather didn’t permit landing do we did the fly tour of the Denali. We had to postpone a few flight times due to weather. K2 was great in providing us with updates on fly conditions and let us chose our flight time. They were great to work with. 
For future reference give yourself a couple days, for weather is predictable, to schedule the best flight for you.

From take-off to landing this flight was filled with incredible views. From the birch forests to steep, sheer cliffs to the massiveness of the Ruth glacier, it was all breathtaking. Landing on the glacier was a bucket list item ticked off! This is a must do if you visit Alaska.
We absolutely LOVED our K2 Aviation adventure!! It was pretty much Bucket List Perfect!! We would definitely recommend!!
We flew with K2 twice 8 years apart. Amazing ride around Denali and landing on glacier. To me, its the best do to when in Alaska.
This was such an amazing experience! I can’t believe we were able to see the mountains so up close and personal. The pilot was amazing and we felt 100% safe the entire time!

review_title: 3 trips to Alaska, 3 generations of family, K2 Aviation flightseeing, 1st Class experience!
review_text: K2 and our pilot, Chris, were great about accommodating same-day booking and trip through the Denali range. After 3 visits to Alaska in 5 years, Denali finally opened up to us and K2 provided an outstanding experience!
