review_title: It was a highlight of our trip
review_text: My son and I did the Denali Flyer tour on April 13. It was such a treat and what a day to fly. It was a highlight of our trip. Thank you so very much. Mary Ott

i gave my wife a flight seeing trip of Denali with K-2 aviation for her birthday.  The day was spectacular and the mountain was beautiful.  K-2  and Stan our pilot did everything possible to make this a truly awesome adventure.  We weren't that interested in the glacier landing aspect of the trip but it turned out to be terrific.  Thanks again to K-2 and their great staff,
An absolutely amazing day touring Denali at eye level. Our pilot Chad gave us the ride of a lifetime.

My group had an action packed trip to Alaska with many activities to include fishing, whale watching, ATVing, and Dog Sledding.  However, the flight with K2 aviation was by far and away the best thing that we did all trip.  The sky was crystal clear and we had views of Denali and the surrounding areas for as far as the eye can see.  Landing on a glacier inside of the park has to be one of the coolest things I've ever done.  Our pilot was Chris Palm
Awesome experience Definitely a must do experience in Alaska. They go above and beyond for you to have a excellent experience with them.
Flew out with Stan, back with Chris.  Outstanding flights, outstanding pilots, outstanding outfit.  Fly with confidence.

An amazing experience. Stan was not only  a pilote but also a very knowledgeable guide. T.Ghacha

And the flight was just magical. There's no word to describe the feeling to see Denali, Foraker, Hunter, and other peeks up close.

My boyfriend and I recently did a Denali flight tour with K2 and found it to be incredible. We had a blue bird day and the entire Alaska Range was out. Chris was a wonderful pilot, knowledgeable and experiences. The glacier landing was totally worth it!

Definitely recommend taking tour with them

We almost didn’t get to land because of clouds and wind. But everything worked out in the end we were all safe on a bright sunny day. With no clouds.

The check-in process was smooth. The flight was great. We were very luck that it was a clear day and were able to see so much. Cloudy weather wouldn't change my review as they can't control the clouds. Our pilot, Chris, was so friendly and knowledgeable about Alaska. The flight was smooth and I felt safe throughout the experience.

We had an amazing flight with Chris today through Denali National Park to Ruth Glacier. We had the clearest, most beautiful day and Chris was an amazing pilot and tour guide. I was so impressed with his attention to making sure that everyone got the best views possible. We got to land on Ruth Glacier and that was a truly special experience. One of a kind day, would definitely recommend this tour.

review_title: Fantastic Trip, Ready to Book Again!

What a fantastic experience we had with K2. From the arrival process to the flight itself, it is easy to see the passion everyone shares at this company. Highly recommended.

We had a great experience with K2. The mountain was out, the sun was perfect, the pilot was experienced and friendly. Everyone followed the safety procedures and we had a great time. 10/10 would go again!

I thank Chris the Pilot for providing the most spectacular views and most entertaining history of formation of Denali National Park. review_title: Seeing what you could only see on National Geographic.
review_text:
Sitting in the co-pilots seat. Landing on Ruth's Glacier.

I never thought I would fly in a small plane, but I was very comfortable and have a great time seeing the sights!

We took a flightseeing trip on 3/28/21 with K2 out of Talkeetna.  What an awesome experience and views.  Well worth the cost and time.  I felt totally comfortable with our pilot Chris.  He provided us with lots of facts and information along with the awesome views which he made sure we got from both sides of the aircraft.  As this flight took place in the time of Covid I also felt very comfortable with the safety procedures in place both prior, during and after the flight.

I flew on a perfectly clear day and had the trip of a lifetime. K2 Aviation staff were very friendly and flexible about rescheduling around the weather, and they absolutely delivered with top notch customer service and knowledgeable pilots who are eager to share their enthusiasm for Alaska with all on board. 10/10 - would definitely go again!
Staff was professional and helpful. Car seats for infants were provided, and the pilot was knowledgeable and friendly.

K2 staff set expectations clearly about low clouds, and offered to reschedule. Me and one other tourist chose to fly anyway, and our pilot also set expectations, but the trip turned out better than we expected. Knowledgeable, friendly, safe pilot. WONDERFUL journey!

K2 aviations online booking and screening process made it extremely easy to book/showup and get right on with the tour. 

Pilot Chris was extremely knowledgable about the Alaska Range/Denali and everything in between. Sights like this can only be experienced from the Air!
Christopher was an awesome pilot and we absolutely loved our flight!! A trip of a lifetime! Thank you for being so nice, welcoming, and flexible. We hope to come back again!

K2 has the benefit of offering tours through some of the most astounding views you can possibly see. Even as an Alaskan who is used to amazing views, this was stunning. I was also grateful for K2's adherence to COVID guidelines, the great customer service, and a knowledgeable pilot who was able to share about his own adventures in the backcountry.

On our way back to Anchorage from Fairbanks, we got a chance to fly with K2 Aviation for the Denali Flyer tour. The experience is much better than what we had expected. The scenery is epic, especially at sunset. And thanks to our pilot's exceptional flying skill, the flight is smooth and comfortable. Glacier landing is not available during winter, but we'd definitely come back to try that as well if we got a chance to visit again in summer.

review_title: The Proposal Flight that was breathtaking!
review_text:
My favorite part of the tour was flying in and out of the gorges.  We were so close to the sheer cliffs and you can see the solid rock.  
Also, being able to view Mt. Foraker and Mt. Hunter was impressive. 
The view was spectacular and the weather was sunny and little wind.
The pilot described where we were and where we were going.  There is so many things about this venture that made it a memory forever.  The spectacular view, the sunny weather, experienced pilot, and gracious employees. 
I did propose to my future wife during the flight and with the Denali backdrop, it was fantastic.  
Post Script:  She said yes!

I don’t think I can find the words to explain how much I loved my experience with K2 but here goes nothing.

We took off (me and four other passengers) with Chris as our pilot in the DHC - 2 Beaver at 13:00 on Sunday, the 11th of October of 2020 when it was partly overcast with 2-5 mph winds, no precipitation and a low of 37° F. I was lucky, because the weather cleared up even more so while we were in the air and it gave us a great view of the peak of Denali. Despite losing a game of Rock Paper Scissors with another passenger over who gets shotgun, it was the most comfortable and smoothest flight  I’ve ever been on (yes even including the 10s of commercial airlines I have flown over the course of my life). Our pilot, Chris, is a wonderful person and a very humble pilot. Before we took off, he mentioned how the sound of the engine starting was like music to his ears, and I immediately knew I was in good hands. He is also incredibly knowledgeable about the geography, geology, and history of the park and Talkeetna area. Needless to say he is the best pilot / tour guide anyone could ask for. As for the views... The formations on the bedrock were outer-worldly, the Alaskan range looked vast and endless, the snow-kissed walls of the mountains were seemingly arms length away yet sensing the scale of such vistas became elusive, and the Kahiltna glacier became a grand pass over which our plane maneuvered and our eyes followed until we eventually landed on a bed of snow below. It was all phenomenal. However, you would just have to see it for yourself; words and photos don’t do much justice. After we landed on the glacier, we stood out on the range with a magnificent view of the Denali and it’s younger siblings and Chris suggested we take a moment to enjoy the quiet stillness of the environment which spurred a moment of pause that I think many of us could use. I got shotgun on the way back and the views were as incredible as the way in, with more unique views of the park. After landing back in talkeetna, I stepped off the plane with a newfound appreciation of our planet, Alaska, and it’s seemingly infinite wonders. I also never realized flying is so fun! All-in-all, I am very grateful for the kind and hardworking people at K2, their awesome aircrafts, and for giving me the gift of a unique experience I will never forget.

Best wishes,
Cez

review_title: K2 Aviation Denali Flight Seeing Tour
review_text: Our flight tour into Denali with K2 Aviation was the highlight of our trip to Alaska.  Our pilot was extremely skilled and knowledgeable and the views of the mountain range were breathtaking.  Upgrade to the glacier landing if you can afford it - that was the best part of the flight!  If you are going to Alaska, put this on the top of your list of things to see and do.  It’s one of those bucket list experiences that you will never forget!

I took my flight in August during the Pandemic.  Even though Denali was shy and we could only see part of it, our knowledgeable pilot made up for it.  As a geology major, he shared with us a geologist perspective of what we were seeing.  Everyone was masked, including him.

I have to say this was one of the most incredible things I have ever done. I wasn't sure if we were going to do it on our way to Denali but the weather was absolutely perfect. The bluebird day offered amazing views of the changing landscape and glaciers as we flew into the mountain range. I was speechless and in awe of what I was seeing. The vastness intimidating and when I saw a plane below us on the glacier it increased my perspective on just how small I was, lol. I will definitely do it again the next time I go up there!

I have flown with K2 several times over the years and all have been lifelong memorable experiences.  Great staff and pilots with good headsets and audio.  The pilots have always made the flight safe and awe inspiring with great talks about the mountains, glaciers, and history.  I hope I will get a chance to do another trip.

K2 kept us updated on what they thought we could do and luckily we were able to do the Denali Grand Tour with glacier landing and it was well worth it. Exceptional safety protocols in place, made us feel comfortable and safe. Outstanding tour and views, landing on the glacier was an Alaska bucket list dream come true.

I can’t thank our pilot Ryan Kerby enough for his knowledge and in depth tour of the beautiful Alaskan Range. Highly highly recommend to all!

review_title: A view well worth the price
review_text:
I’ve climbed glaciers and traveled around to see many more but despite plenty of time around some incredible mountains, the flight was absolutely worth it and k2 totally rocked it.

The red planes are awesome for photos too, added perks.

K2 Aviation is a class act all around. They are very professional and friendly, from the reservation staff to the pilot. Our experience was one of the highlights of our trip to Alaska.

review_title: This fly was an amazing and were expecting and more..My appreciation team K2 for opportunities
review_text: Fly was an amazing and were expecting and more . My appreciation to team K2 for opportunities exploring preserve.....

review_title: Fabulous, once in a lifetime, experience.
review_text: This was the BEST experience!  The flight was smooth, the pilot was great, the scenery was fabulous and we landed on the glacier, where without COVID, the base camp for climbers would be.  It was the most beautiful day on top of it all, cloudless and the sun was shining.  There is not one thing I can talk about because it was all so wonderful.
Fantastic adventure. Erika in the office made all our communications enjoyable. Stan made the flight interesting and exciting. So glad that we booked with K-2.

Incredible flight over Denali and surrounding mountains. A must-do in Alaska! Our pilot was incredibly knowledgeable and shared his passion and wisdom of the area throughout the flight. The staff was welcoming and walked us through the safety of the plane and the flight. Our flight was cut a bit short due to weather but was incredible none-the-less and we received a partial refund before we even left. Fantastic service and an experience we will never forget!
Very friendly pilot. Smooth ride and landing. Absolutely beautiful views. Well worth the price! We had the best time. This is the best way to see Denali.
Thus experience will forever be one of the highlights of my life! You can't even begin to understand Denali until you see it up close and personal!!! This is a definite MUST DO when you visit AK!
Captain Stan is super nice. The glacier is wonderful none to say the amazing experience of landing on the glacier!!!!!

The front desk recommended the Denali Flyer your with a glacier landing. We were not disappointed! Take-off and landings were so smooth we could not feel them. We felt safe and entertained the entire time!

This was a fantastic part of our Alaska trip.   The company focuses on safety but works with you if the weather does not cooperate.   The first day we left but could not get close...  second day we remained flexible and went over when they called...  unbelievable views of the mountains, glaciers, and sky.  Glacier landing is worth it.   Pilots are great guides as well, Stan was sure to give everyone a view.

They are practicing good COVID protocols, both at the terminal and in the air. Felt safe but not oppressed.  

Highly recommend them and the tour!

review_title: Be flexible and you will have a great experience
review_text: Safety is their #1 priority, and that’s a good thing. Therefore, you trip may be postponed or changed. Most of the negative reviews on here are because the company wouldn’t fly/land in bad weather, which is absurd that people would even be upset about that. We wanted to do the Summit Tour, but that was not available due to COVID. We booked the Grand Tour with a landing, but when we got there, we were only offered the Denali Flyer with a possible landing as the weather was fluctuating a lot. We decided to go ahead and do that and we had an amazing time, we were even able to land on the glacier! When coming I would recommend being flexible, not having your heart set or a particular tour, and if possible, stay in Talkeetka for a night to give even more options. One of the best things we did on our trip, highly recommended!

We had an amazing Denali Flyer Tour with the glacier landing. From our initial contact with Ernie we were impressed. Our pilot Stan was outstanding and highly informative. The following morning we had a little car trouble and Chad jumped right in to help us out. 

A flight tour around Denali is a must for any visitor to Alaska and K2 is the company to trust for an outstanding time.

review_title: The GREAT ONE... Was Definitely GREAT!
review_text: HAPPILY checked off an item on my Bucket List!  I have been blessed to get to fly to many areas in Alaska in small airplanes and to enjoy the float plane we have in Seward.  BUT, to get to fly near to Denali and do a glacier landing was outstanding!  Definitely, in my top 5 best Alaskan and International flights!  I’ve known for years that when time permits in the summer and the weather looked good.... it would be a go for me!  All good things came together (except for the COVID-19 giving all Alaskan’s time to explore our state .... ) made it work for us to do my dream flight.  Would be tough to be more PERFECT!

review_title: There is no better way to see the mountains.
review_text:
I had a great experience with K2 from the first phone call to the last purchase in the gift shop (and a great geocache out front). I called to make a same-day reservation due to slower than anticipated COVID test results and they were helpful, accommodating, and made a very wise suggestion as to when I should depart Denali National Park to be on time for my flight. 

Check-in was very efficient and I took the time between check-in and departure to go find the geocache out front. 

The flight was amazing! Our pilot was a fount of information on the area and had good stories. It is truly amazing to see the mountains from the air while having the peaks still above you instead of seeing them from thousands of feet above as you normally might see them in flight. They were truly breathtaking. 
Landing on the glacier was an unforgettable experience even though Denali was hiding in a cloud. Unfortunately, and as great as K2 is, they have not yet figured out how to control the weather. Despite Denali hiding from us, the trip was great and absolutely worth it. If you ever find yourself in the area you absolutely should take advantage of one of K2's tours.

review_title: Great experience and way to see amazing landscape
review_text: Did a flight tour with K2 recently and thought they were great. They were incredibly careful given COVID - we felt completely safe throughout. But they were also incredibly accomodating given the weather and made it a really great tour. People were great, pilot was great, and the experience was great. I highly recommend it!

A group of 6 family members took the 45-minute Denali Flyer tour in early August.  It was one of the most fabulously mind-blowing way to see Denali and the glaciers.  We cruised around the mountains and various glaciers and ended by flying low in the valley over the main glacier! This was the highlight for all 6 of us over the course of our 8-day Alaska adventure.  It's the best way to take in the scope of Denali park!
Stan was our pilot and gave us a fantastic tour around Denali with a glacier landing.  Would highly recommend.  Phenomenal experience!

I was lucky to fly with only two others in a small plane piloted by Doug. He gave us an excellent description of what to expect at each point in the flight. There were some clouds in front of Denali, but we got a partial view. We saw glaciers, canyons and stunning rock formations. The pilot enjoyed it as much as we did. I worked with the staff for several days off rescheduling for weather and always appreciated having the option of a full refund. I recommend K2 flights.

While we didn’t get to fly because of weather, the staff was extremely accommodating and were very willing to work with us to reschedule or refund our flight. After seeing their outstanding customer service, it’s clear why K2 Aviation is as successful as they are. While we missed the chance to fly this trip, we looking forward to coming back one day to fly with K2 Aviation!

review_title: K2 Aviation is a top notch professional flight seeing outfit.
review_text: This flightseeing tour is worth every penny. The pilot was a complete professional. K2 went the extra mile to ensure of our safety by mandating COVID testing within 14 days of flying. The entire experience from phone call to booked reservation to actual flight was incredibly efficient and professional. I highly K2 Aviation for your Denali flight experience.

Great trip with seasoned pilot, Chris. The scenery was breathtaking and I highly recommend spending the extra money on the glacier landing. Well worth the cost. This was such an epic trip we plan to do it again since we are locals!

review_title: Celebrating a Birthday at the Top of the World
review_text: Weather couldn't have been more perfect.  But until you've experienced it for yourself, there are no words!!

Very personable, friendly + knowledgeable pilot made us feel comfortable and no anxiety as we flew up the mountain foothills and glaciers to see Mt Denali. Wife + I have lived in Alaska over 30 years and she had never been up to see Denali, so we took advantage of no tourists here during Covid-19 summer and took the 1-hour tour! WOW, was a perfectly clear flying weather, even got to see a small snow/ice avalanche!  So incredible. This flight tour should be high priority on every Alaskans’ “to-do” list!!
Exceptional tour, with our pilot Doug being the absolute best! We had another tour the next day with a different company and that really made us appreciate Doug even more.

July 2020 - had a perfect flight - with a clear view of Denali - and an awesome glacier landing (highly recommend)! We originally had a morning flight scheduled and it was completely foggy - so K2 nicely moved us to an afternoon flight. By the afternoon, the fog had cleared and it was a sunny day. Do the glacier landing - it is worth it!!!

What a great experience! I believe our pilot's name was Chris. We felt completely safe with him.  He made sure that we had all the details we needed for a good flight and all the landings (both on the glacier and the tarmac) we smooth.

This is an excellent operation and the employees did a great job making sure all COVID protocols were followed.

5 Starts well earned!

review_title: Should be the only way to see Denali
review_text:
My coworkers highly recommended this company, so we booked for March. Unfortunately we got into a car accident right before the flight and couldn’t make it. They were so helpful and kind, gave us a full refund. 

We vowed to take the trip this year because people kept recommending it! And how happy we are that we did!!! I was awestruck the entire flight! (Even during the Glaciar Landing, which is a MUST!)

Worth every penny!

Must do!!! One of my most rememberable experiences while I was in Alaska. The staff was extremely flexible and understanding  due to rainy weather. We flew with Chris, who was very friendly and knowledgeable. The views were breathtaking!! Even though we were initially told we wouldn’t be able to take part in the glacier landing, the weather cleared up just in time and Chris was able to land the plane safely. I would definitely recommend this company and if I’ve ever back in Alaska I’ll be taking another flight myself!

Except me and friend think the time length of glacier landing is too short. We even didn't have the time to walk a little further to take some more photos using this costing chance. Other than that the flight is quite good.

Inexperienced pilots, lady at labby/desk so cute but she's lying straight in your face. Went on tour w landing on a glacier never happened.
Wasted 2days, can provide pictures cuz there excuse is of course weather. No wind etc clear sky. Thanks K2 
Place is well organized, clean restrooms.

We went up on a whim.  We drove up from Wasilla to explore Talkeetna sans tourists.  Now I love Talkeetna, and don’t favor what happened to our economy during C19 but this is a silver lining folks.  

The K2 facility is  beautiful.  All the mountains were out.   Our pilot, Chris experienced and knowledgeable. And with no other planes to check in with we had a private tour with all the history.  A week later and I’m still 2 miles high and enjoying my money’s worth.  Plus a great pick of all the wonderful gear with all sizing available. 

Not a plane in the sky!   No one mountaineers on the mountain.  No ski marks.   It’s a unique chance and there was a walk-in possibilities.  None of that edgy vibe that you sometimes get when the place is packed and walk-in availability. 

This Alaska fun hog doesn’t write about everything but I sure have to give them the best rating and if there was 100 stars  I’d give them 100 stars. 

Might just go back for another fix IF this one wears off.

Booked at the very last minute due to another operator cancelling and was so glad we did. Great flight with amazing scenery, we even caught an avalanche. Good knowledge from the pilot made the journey even more interesting. 

I’d highly recommend this company!

We picked a great day.  100 plus mile visibility.  Couldn’t get all the places we hoped to go due to strong winds off the mountain but our pilot Doug was amazing.  His flying skills and knowledge were excellent.  Well worth the cost.  Only negative is it will depend on which plane you go up on if you are a larger person.   The small planes it could be a tight squeeze (I’m 6’4 and just fit in the Piper 6 - keep that in mind if you are tall to ask about aircraft).  That’s a nit picking negative because overall was truly one of the next sightseeing trips of my life!   Thanks K2!!
The staff were all very helpful and courteous. Our pilot was also an excellent guide with plenty of knowledge of the glaciers and area to share.

We walked up on the Fourth of July and my husband spontaneously booked tickets for everyone in our family - there are six of us! It was glorious seeing the mountain up close. We did the short tour, not knowing how the boys would fare, ages 8,6,4 and 1. My 8-year-old still talks about seeing the Moose's Tooth and the Sheldon Amphitheater was priceless for me to see. We'd do it again and take the longer tour all the way around Denali and/or get dropped off and go hike around. It is spectacular! Just remembering the images of those mountains is PRICELESS!
One note about the baby: K2 provided a Britax car seat for him to sit in along with sound-canceling ear muffs. They were so accommodating for our crew! The pilot was super friendly and answered all the questions little people can ask. We'd do this again in a heartbeat and take the kids along - it was that great of an experience.

We took the grand tour around Denali.  This was spectacular!!  Beautiful sunny day.  Unfortunately, we were not able to land on the glacier, but was ok about that.  We took some extra time exploring the glacier valleys on the way back.  Beautiful wonderful ride. The pilot was very knowledgeable.
It was amazing flying thru the mountains and land on the glacier. We were also lacky finding a clear sky and a sunny day that pulled out beautiful colors from the nature.

We took the grand tour around Denali and it was totally awesome as heck!!!  Very cool!!  Tour was very in depth and we got to circle around Denali.  We were not able to land on the Glacier, but that was ok.  The views were phenomenal.

We were told when we arrived at K2's very nice facility at the Talkeetna airport that due to weather our tour would be scaled back from the trip that circled Mt Denali and landed on a glacier, to a flight plan that just covered the lower mountains. And the price was adjusted to suit with our deposit covering the shorter flight of a little over an hour.  K2 also offered a full refund.  Since we had driven some two hours from Anchorage we decided to do what we could and take the shorter flight.

The thing to keep in mind is that the flight time to the edge of the park is 15-20 minutes one way.  The pilot kept that interesting with discussions of rivers, the fall colors, and travel where there are no roads.  Still, the travel to/from Denali is over flat terrain and is not very dramatic; only about half the total flight time was over the mountains and glaciers.  

The weather was indeed cloudy at the park and the caution was appropriate because the pilot is flying visually.  We caught a couple of long range views of Denali through the clouds, and we saw a number of glaciers that the pilot ably described. It was interesting and fun, may be not thrilling like we hoped, hence the 'three' rating.  To their credit, K2 had provided email warnings about the weather conditions.

We were in the plane with a couple with a toddler who literally screamed the entire flight.  This was not a problem, for us, because we had earphones.  The parents were very distracted with the child so not sure the flight was a good idea for them.

About halfway thru the flight my wife's seat came un-pinned from its mount and we had about five exciting minutes locating the pin and doing an in-flight repair.  

Overall, K2 did a good job; the pilot was a good guide as well as an experienced aviator.  Given the travel time consideration it would be worth it to sign up for longer flights to get more out of the experience, with the understanding that the plan is ultimately determined by the weather.

An Alaskan trip is not complete without a flight tour! We took the glacier landing flight tour from Talkeetna. The tour would cost you ~$325 and takes about 2 hours. It was one of kind experience. You get a bird's eye view of the GREAT Denali standing in its all glory at 20,000 ft above sea level. We landed on the Ruth glacier which is 1.2 KM of thick ice and witnessed other flights land and take off on the glacier.

review_title: Only one day in Talkeetna? Just Do It!
review_text: We decided on this K2 Aviation tour via Alaska Tour and Travel Company. Nice to be up close and personal and walking on top of a glacier thousands of years old.. Flying though the clouds to reach this beautiful area was a great experience. Not bumpy or scary at all..
sobrevoar as geleiras, mesmo em dia de teto baixo e chuva fina é lindo, a equipe do K2 é bem competente e atenciosa

If you want to see Denali and the Ruth Glacier, K2 is the way to do it. We had a marvelous flight with an extremely knowledgeable and affable guide/pilot. He obviously loves showing people the breathtaking beauty of these mountains. We did not do a glacier landing, but that is available - weather permitting - at an additional charge.

We flew with K2 Aviation for my birthday, and it was a wonderful experience. We unfortunately were not able to do the glacier landing due to poor weather conditions, but it was still a memorable trip. Our pilot was wonderful, and we got to fly in a 1958 de Havilland Beaver, which was really cool. I sat up front in the co-pilot seat, which was pretty cool. I highly recommend K2!
Muy profesionales, todo muy bien organizado y el piloto excelente, se notaba su gran experiencia. Si a eso le añadimos un viaje con maravillosas vistas, se puede pedir mas?
It was amazing! The pilot was very nice and knowledgeable and the view were incredible. Highly recommended.

review_title: Amazing. Best way to view the park!
review_text:
The pilot was very knowledgeable and made the ride incredibly comfortable for it being a tiny plane in the mountains. 

All staff welcomed me with smiles and excitement even after a long summer of work. 

Not sure what else to say. The cost for this trip is easily forgotten after seeing the sights. I can't thank K2 enough for giving me this experience.
We had such a fantastic flight and tour of Denali from the air. Our pilot was extremely professional and knowledgeable, and I couldn’t have asked for a better tour or views!

Despite Denali having clouds around the summit, we had a wonderful flight through the mountains. Our pilot Garrett was very knowledgeable and shared much information. I have flown with K2 before and will always chose them.

The pilot was very confidente, nice and informative before, during and after the flight. 
The airplane offered a slow and smooth ride, and had a "private" window for every passenger.  The views are just fantastic.  My wife and I spent 2 weeks in Alaska, and this was 1 of the 4 top programmes we have done in the 49th State.

We ended up in Talkeetna on a clear day so we booked our flight as soon as we arrived to take advantage of the weather. The plane was awesome and so was the flightseeing. It was so much fun that I would do it again. If the cost seems high, please know that it's 100% worth it.

We were very impressed with K2Aviation from the website through the flight experience.  They email a reminder in advance and even one on the morning of our flight to update on visibility and weather conditions, giving the option to reschedule.  It turned out to be a good visibility day and our flight was amazing.  Even the facility and check-in was impressive and professional.  Within a few minutes, we were grouped with others on our flight and introduced to Billy, our pilot and guide.  He was amazing at explaining everything, answering questions and pointing out interesting sights along with history, geology information.  I highly recommend K2Aviation
We were supposed to take the Glacier Landing tour but lack of snow made that impossible.  The flight seeing tour we were able to do was wonderful.  Denali was a bit shrouded but still beautiful.

My wife and I enjoyed a spectacular flight to see the majesty of Denali on a clear day. Our pilot was very informative describing the mountains and glaciers during the flight. It was very smooth from takeoff to landing. We highly recommend K2!

Cannot begin to put in words this experience."the high one" showed her peak which is a rarity this time of the year. K2 is top notch, down to earth, go the extra mile to give us a once in a lifetime experience. We thought this was expensive, but Billy, our pilot got us so close to the mountain, yet completely safe. Thank you K2 for this service.
Did a 15 day tour around Alaska, an incredible state.  But must say flying with K2 was the highlight of the trip.
Our pilot Doug was amazing. Although he has flown this tour for years, he was excited as we were.  The whole process from reservation ,to check in , our flight and after was top notch

We flew with Dan in the Otter, the last flight of 
the day. His greeting to us was polite & he was an apparent plane guy from the get go. The safety briefing was easy to understand & t ime was given for questions. The take off was smooth & we leveled off & took off for the beautiful Alaska scenery which didnt disappoint. His narration was just enough & knowledgeable. The incessant other pilot chatter was a distraction & interruption. Plenty of perfect pic opportunities were made & the flight was smooth despite clouds & some wind. We landed perfectly with great pics and and an awesome time to sury repeat. He even asked if we were co le, checked our headsets, helped an elderly passenger in. The only pitfall or complaint would be price or some other snooty staff. Thanks K2 & Dan!!!!

review_title: Professional Operation & a Smooth, Beautiful Ride
review_text: Our pilot, Dan, took us for an excellent ride in the Denali mountain area.  One of the highlights of our cruise-tour.  Booked directly.

I’d flown with K2 a few years ago on the Grand Denali flight and was looking for a repeat this year. Unfortunately we awoke to heavy rain and a low ceiling; an email from K2 offered options from canceling with a full refund, re-scheduling, or staying in touch to see how the day developed. We opted for the latter and got a call mid-morning telling us that the clouds had lifted enough to make shorter flights up to the lower glaciers. We decided to go for it and even this limited tour didn’t disappoint. We spent about an hour with excellent pilot and guide Mark, who gave everyone a good view of the glaciers and spectacular terrain of southern Denali. Even on a gray day there were amazing sights and great photo opportunities. I’d fly with K2 any time and look forward to doing it again!

Chris our pilot was excellent! We had an incredibly clear day and that was HUGE! The booking, check in, and flight was easy and well organized! Easy to find and lovely new facility. 

We did book this while staying in Denali, I didn't realize it was a bit of a hike back down to Talkeenta (about 2.5 hours) but WELL worth the drive!

Unfortunately we had to cancel our tour with K2 Aviation due to the McKinley wild fires.  The wild fires caused the road to Talkeetna to close and we had to detour back to Anchorage.  Although we did not fly with this company, they refunded our money with no question.  They emphasized that we stay safe and understood 100% that we could not make our reservation.  I can't say we found the same attitude with other businesses.  and did lose money due to the wild fires in Alaska.  I would recommend this company and you can book a reservation knowing they put safety first.

We had a beautiful day to fly, and the views were amazing! Everyone had a window seat and could see well.  We weren't able to land on a glacier due to weather over the last few weeks.  But the pilot was very knowledgeable about Denali and people mountain climbing.  It was a great trip!

It's a pity that they cannot provide glacier landing due to the dry condition, but the trip is still gorgeous with wonderful views!! The sky looks smoky due to wild fire, it's very clear when flying on top of it. You can see clearly the peak of Mt. Denali, and various glaciers surrounding it. You will find keep taking pictures/videos the whole trip. Definitely recommended! 

The question is never about whether the trip worth the money; it's about whether the weather allows you to flight so that you can learn the true meaning of Denali Beauty.

Absolutely stunning. The pilot was very experienced and made everyone on board feel safe. My 6 year old boy loved being able to talk to the pilot through the headset. This is a must do if you plan on visiting the 49th state.

It was a great flying experience, with view of mountains, valleys, glaciers all over. The journey is scenic right away.I loved looking down at the color changing trees and deep blue lakes at the beginning and end and then just being swept away by the magic of the great mountain giants that is Denali and the surrounding peaks. Majestic scenery, stunning upclose views of a dramatic mountainous terrain, peaks rising from the clouds, with the sun playing different shades on everything, it was just beautiful. Something everyone should experience. I'm very grateful to K2 for the incredible 1 hour journey. Thank you!

I was supposed to do the flying tour with a glacier landing but was told when I arrived that they couldn't land on the glacier due to bad conditions. However they easily swapped ne onto a new tour, just flying, leaving at the same time. 

I can say it is the best thing I've done, I wasnt expecting to get so up close to the mountains but if felt we were within touching distance we were so close. 

Our pilot was fabulous, giving each side if the plane equal views and really good commentary.

We were in the air for a good hour and a half and it was well worth it. We were lucky with the weather I think and had amazing views but you could see how quickly the clouds come in. 

I would highly recommend K2, an incredibly professional operation.

review_title: Not to be missed! Breathtaking Summit views!
review_text:
Wow! What an experience. My husband and I took the Summit Tour. I will first say a bit about safety. When we arrived we were notified that the flight may have to cancel. Yes, it was disappointing but we knew that the company making money was secondary to our safety.  We got lucky and the weather lifted and we got to check this flight off of our bucket list.
 
I wish I could remember our pilot's name but we have been on a 2 week vacation. Names are running together. I will say that my husband and I are both pilots and in the aviation industry. The professionalism that our pilot and ground service (rampers) showed was wonderful. We had an older gentleman that urinated on himself during the last half of the flight. The gentleman was on the last row and was first to get off. He told the pilot and ground crew that he had an accident. As any of us could imagine this had to be terribly embarrassing for the gentlemen. The pilot and ground crew stayed professional and never made any negative comments. The pilot made sure attention was taken off of the man. They all should get a pat on the back. Everyone from registration people to the other pilots were very friendly!

Now, the flight was unbelievable! Many things you do once in a life but this is something we would do again! The summit tour was breathtaking. Our pilot made sure we were comfortable. He checked with us regularly for cabin temps, ears on decent etc. We all had a window seat. So, basically there is no bad seat. Everyone gets an equal chance to see. The only thing we would have done differently was add the glacier landing. At the time we went glacier landings was not safe because there was not enough snowfall during the night. Facilities were great! Coffee, tea and hot chocolate provided. The only thing you need is a pair of sunglasses and your camera!

We highly recommend this flight for any age!

We went on a Denali Flyer tour and Stan was our pilot.  Our aircraft was a deHavilland Otter, and our flight was breath-taking and well narrated bu Stan.  The lessons on Denali and the geographic events that formed it were amazing.  Not a single negative thing to say about this outstanding trip!

We took the Denali Experience with K2 Aviation and it was one of the key highlights of our 2 week Alaska trip in late July. 
The staff at K2 are a wonderful set of people. Professional and at the same time, so very personable. Because of uncertain weather, we had to change the date & timing of our flight a couple of times. They worked with us through several options to find something that would fit in with our schedule and provide us with a memorable viewing experience. 
We did the 90 min flight in a 6 seater. Our pilot was experienced, relaxed, safety conscious, highly knowledgeable and keenly observant of the weather and modified the route to ensure optimal viewing of the glacier, the surrounding mountains and Mt. Denali itself and all along, provided a rich commentary to enhance our experience. I still get goosebumps when I think about that incredible flight. A big shout out to K2 for making it such a once-in-a-lifetime flight.

review_title: A Rare Opportunity to See the Big One, Mt Denali
review_text:
An exqusite sightseeing opportunity with a knowledgable pilot. If you are fortunate, easiest way to see Mt. Denali, 
 and we were!  Great value .An excellent way to begin to comprehend the vastness of  6 million acres ( i.e., Denali National Park). .Flying in this very small plane felt safe and secure and I DO NOT like high places!! I also tend to be prone to motion sickness, that also, was NOT a problem.

Senza dubbio è un esperienza da fare. Accettazione e front office eccellente. costi abbastanza alti. Tour sempre legati al tempo che varia con molta facilità. Alla fine nonostante ci abbia provato un paio di volte non è semplice trovare le condizioni giuste per atterrare sui ghiacciai. L'aereo è sicur.o ma si balla. Sconsigliato per chi soffre di "mal d'aereo"

review_title: A once  in a life time experience
review_text: All the staff was frrienly and helpful  Felt safe at all times. Pilot was helpful. knowlegabe, apprroachable.  Answered questions in detail.  The highlight of our trip to alaska.
We ran into some weather the day of our flight (it happens) and K2 was excellent about keeping us informed and advising us of our options.  Much appreciated.

The weather didn't cooperate with our scheduled landing on Denali Glacier but the fall back trip exceeded our expectations of original trip. We flew through all the glacier valleys surrounding Denali resulting in some amazing photos. Reception center folks and pilot were warm and welcoming. This is a must if you want to see just how massive Alaska really is.

We really enjoyed this start to finish along with our 2 and 3 year old kids. K2 were very accomodating, allowing us to easily switch dates to accomodate the logistics of travelling with toddlers as well as have the peace of mind of a full refund even with late cancellation. Also the discounts for travelling with 2 year olds were significantly larger than at the other places we checked. It was great to be able to do a few swings around the glacier before landing and thus get good time to take in the details of Denali's south face. Chris was our pilot and excellent guide.

Awesome breathtaking flight. Flying in between and over mountains. excellent commentary from our pilot. The softest landing ever on a Denali glacier at 7000 feet. Never will forget such a fun experience thankyou K2

The only way to get up close to the mountains.  Pilot was good and competent.  The staff was friendly and informative so we knew what to expect.  Earphones on the plane make it easy to hear the pilot.  The one hour tour took us very close to Denali and the glaciers.  Breathtakingly beautiful.

We were given a certificate for a flight and to land on a glacier by a good friend in Anchorage. What a treat!! We flew out on a 8 passenger plane. Out around Denali and the other two mountains (sorry cant recall the names) and then down a valley over the Ruth glacier and got to see other glaciers. I feel so blessed to have been able to see that since glaciers seem to be melting away.

It not the only choice to get to base camp on McKinley or for flightseeing but it the most polished of the group. New building with the most used restrooms in town. The new building will give comfort to tourist who are a bit nervous about a flight but for climbers the original “packing” metal building will fit the bill.

We weren't able to do the tour we wanted to do due to clouds and wind at the summit, but K2 did everything they could to get us on another tour.  We weren't disappointed!  Pilot was awesome and the views were, of course, breathtaking.  Definitely something not to be missed.

Exceeded my sky-high expectations (no pun intended). Very professional, provided updates about weather and conditions before the trip. Pilot was very informed and safety-oriented. Route was perfect and allowed both sides of the plane to see everything (sometimes flying in 'S' patterns to allow that). Everyone had a window seat. Glacier landing was smooth, as was the whole flight. Highly recommended.

This was maybe the best experience we had during our three weeks in AK. We were concerned that the flight would be cancelled due to a heavy smoke haze from several fires. I emailed the day before and was told they were taking it hour by hour. When our driver picked us up at the lodge he gave us a couple of options.  We decided to ride over and wait on the pilot to decide. The pilot assured us once we reached a certain altitude we would be out of smoke, but safety first. I certainly questioned our decision until we reached about 9,000ft. We had a clear view of everything. Absolutely amazing, I’m sure my jaw was on the floor for at least 45 minutes. I have few words to describe the beauty and feeling of awe that we both experienced other than ‘do not miss this flight!’

There's nothing to say except this was breath- taking. Absolutely incredible.   It's expensive but.... for sure worth it.  The people were so very nice from pre booking through the flight.  One picture is worth a thousand words.  It's not every day you can make snow angels at the base camp of Denali. The 5seat plane was much better than the 10 seat.  Ask for a small plane it is apples and oranges.  We had a smaller plane the first time we did this. It was still wonderful.
         Thank you K2.

Because of the weather the Monday Grand Tout with landing on the glacier was cancelled. The Tuesday weather was slightly better but the grand tour was cancelled. The staff at the desk offered us another tour not so close of Denali because of the cloud. We finally accepted the offer and had the pleasure to fly with Chris in a Cessna just the four of us. The experience was amazing Chris very professional and friendly. We went above the cloud layer and against all expectations. we saw the Denali but also the plenty of others glaciers. In a nutshell great experience for all the family and it was the only way to see the Denali.  Of course we missed the landing on the glacier but we keep this for another visit.

review_title: Fun and safe way to enjoy Denali
review_text: We took the Grand Tour on July 5th and it was a bright and wonderful day. Our pilot was fun and gave thorough explanations, the weather was surprisingly warm and we got to land on the glacier and enjoyed the views wearing a simple long sleeve. Though there were many wildfires, we were lucky and experienced no smoke during our flight. There are so many mountains and glaciers that it is humbling to realize how small we are. The boots that K2 Aviation offers for people who might get cold or wet worked admirably well and they really looked clean. The check in process was very well organized.

We were scheduled for a "Denali Experience Flight" with K2 Aviation on July 19th.  Before the scheduled departure time, we were all huddled on the porch for what I thought was to be a safety review.  Sadly, an incident unrelated to K2 Aviation, forced the cancellation of our tour.  While disappointed, we fully understood K2's decision and reasoning for the loss in the aviation community.
This exemplified that the owners, Todd and Suzanne Rust, were more concerned about sharing the grief in the aviation community than in commercialism.
And I would absolutely have no qualms about flying with K2 if I am again in the Talkeetna area.

K2 is a top-notch organization.  The weather was bad on our originally scheduled tour date but they allowed us to move our flight to a different date of our choosing.  The weather was much better on that date so we were able to do the glacier landing.  They were very flexible and accommodating.  Thanks K2 for a once-in-a-lifetime experience.

This is a must do adventure! Very professionally run company, our flight was delayed due to weather, the staff were prompt at keeping us informed. Our pilot kept us informed throughout our flight, the landing on the glacier was a lot smoother than expected! I was at ease throughout the flight... I enjoyed every minute!

Unforgettable flight and tour we recently went on with K2. We booked the guided hike tour that K2 flies in a float plane up to a glacial lake in Denali National Park. Upon landing we were greeted by a guide who took us on a few miles of guided hike in the mountains around the glacial lake. The K2 staff was first class and very professional. Safety for the flight and guided hike were their number one priority. The float plane ride with our pilot Chip was incredible. His knowledge and experience of the aircraft, the alaskan wilderness, mountains, glaciers, etc was impressive. It was truly a guided flight as we learned so much on the flights to and from the lake. We even spotted some moose on the return flight and he circled around so we could get a better view of them. All in all, we highly recommend K2 for whatever adventure you are thinking of going on in Talkeetna.

This was a spectacular experience!  We were scheduled for the Grand Tour with glacier landing but had to step back to the Flyer tour (still with glacier landing) due to weather.  It was not the least bit disappointing.  We still flew up to the mountain Denali and got a close look at it.  Our pilot Stan was so knowledgeable and inspired much confidence (I was nervous taking this flight) because of his years and years of experience.  He knew so much about the area!  I would do this again in a heartbeat.
Phenomenal.  What a great flight with Daniel in an Otter, made even better with the glacier landing.  If you are in Alaska - DO IT!

We came for a flight seeing tour of Denali but due to weather weren’t able to fly that day. I wish I had known to check my email on the morning of the trip, it would have saved me a long drive as they had sent a message telling us of the less than desirable weather. It was overcast and so we wouldn’t have been able to see Denali. We were rescheduled for the next day but the same occurred and they offered a flight seeing excursion around the Talkeetna valley area (sheep mountain). Although it was a bummer that we didn’t get the full Denali viewing tour (not their fault) the Talkeetna valley tour was fun. The pilot was friendly and knowledgeable about the area. He took his time explaining the safety features and helped quell some other people’s fears of flying. We felt safe and comfortable the whole time. It’s a little awkward getting into the planes but there were was an older lady on our trip with a bad knee that the pilots and rampers were only too willing to help out. I would fly with this company again.

Matt was a great pilot and seemed to know the Otter we were flying in. The weather could have been better but I could still see how massive Denali was close up. It was a great experience and I'd definitely do it again. The hosting center at Tolkeetna airport is spacious, new, comfortable with plenty of bathrooms.
Great experience seeing Denali from the air and then landing on a glacier. Highlight of our Alaska trip. Highly recommend!

review_title: Breathtaking views of the Last Frontier
review_text: This flightseeing trip with K2 was the highlight of our land trip/cruise to Alaska.  Our pilot Chad made us feel completely safe and at ease in the plane, as if he was driving us around Denali in a limo!  We were blessed with a beautiful day as he flew us within a few miles of The Great One.  We were thrilled to have seen The Last Frontier in all its amazing beauty and awesome splendor.  This is a MUST DO excursion when you visit Alaska!

We decided we wanted more than a flight around Denali and a quick landing, so we opted for the 'day' hike/flight, where we felt we'd get a more immersive experience on the ground. This option sees you flown into the back country and although the scenery is very spectacular, you can't really see Denali from the landing site (is behind another mountain). The 'walk' takes you around the shoreline of a lake and back. The weather was on our side (Summer and no need for jackets) and we had an awesome experience of seeing varied landscapes on the flight there and back with great commentary the whole way. Chip (pilot) and Tom (hike guide) were very friendly and knowledgable. I'd like to have had a longer time on the ground though for the 'day hike'.

This trip was incredible. The glacier landing was definitely worth it. We had a wonderful pilot who provided interesting information and was very safe and knowledgeable. It was so worth it to take this flight tour!

Our one and half hour flight seeing experience was amazing beyond words. A thoroughly professional company. Very clear instructions and all questions answered. Our four seater tiny plane was piloted by Billy who constantly kept us updated about the wonderful scenery of mountains and massive glaciers unfolding under our wings. The glacier landing was super. A special pat on the back for Billy as he retrieved my cell phone inadvertently left behind on another plane. He also took a lot of pictures of us which will make amazing memories. Thumbs up for a very efficiently run company. Definitely recommend the experience.

On our land tour of Alaska, we booked a Flight Tour with K2 out of Talkeetna.  Not knowing what we were getting into, it turned out to be one of the highlights of our Alaska vacation.

They have multiple tour options on a variety of wonderful small aircraft.  We had booked an air tour only, but they upgraded us to a landing tour on a Denali glacier (Ruth Glacier).

That proved to be the absolute best!  Not only did we fly into, through and among the Alaska Range with spectacular aerial scenery and mindboggling swerves toward and around and over serious snow-covered peaks and valley glaciers, we actually landed on a Denali glacier.  How cool is that!

The weather was unseasonably warm and the glacier was a bit mushy.  We saw other planes landing to supply the amazing Sheldon Chalet.

But the best part of all was the amazing Alaska Range from the air. Don’t miss it, and  definitely choose the glacier landing option.  You will send amazing not-to-be-missed photos to your families and friends.

Just yesterday my wife and I enjoyed the spectacular beauty of Denali from the air with K2!  The pilot was excellent, explaining as we flew along and answering questions; the plane, an OTTER was perfect, the office folks were wonderful.  On a business trip 25 years ago I took this flight and have been looking for the occasion for my wife to share the experience with me - the occasion was our 50th anniversary vacation and she was appropriately delighted with the experience.
I could go on and on -- just do it!  You will forever be glad you did!

Altogether - great flight - captain - booking - plane 

Exceeded expectations - 
Well explained - quiet confident competent pilot - 
Yes ! In a safety critical environment to have friendly high professionalism!!

review_title: Not to be Missed!  Must see Denali from the air.
review_text: We loved our ride in the 12 passenger Otter.  The ability to see Denali from the air Incredibly beautiful.  I can't imagine a visit without the aerial view. You won't be disappointed.

review_title: Amazing experience, glacier landing totally worth it
review_text: An overall great experience, amazing views, very capable and experienced pilot. Landing on a glacier was truly incredible. Keep in mind that what you see will always depend on the weather patterns which are constantly changing. Highly recommend. A few in my group felt a little queasy so may want to take Dramamine or the patch if you are prone to motion sickness.

I got a wild idea and managed to talk my wife into a flight seeing excursion. We had looked at doing it while staying in Denali, but had heard that the rates were better out of Talkeetna and this would also give my wife (prone to motion sickness) a chance to let the scopolamine do its thing.

We had our tour guide book the excursion. We weren't really into landing on a glacier, but we wanted to see the summit of Denali. K2 had us booked in an older, but well-maintained Piper Navajo. Our pilot, Chad, went over all the safety briefings thoroughly. Even pointed out that there was survival gear in the back of the aircraft as well as a satellite phone.

We lifted off and were on our way. Since we would be around the summit of Denali and the aircraft is not pressurized, we had to don oxygen masks. This was everything I hoped for as I looked at my wife and said, "Talk to me, Goose."

The scenery is unparalleled. The rugged peaks of the Alaska Range are all around as you see glaciers, ice falls, and even the various climber camps. Chad took us around the area several times, gradually gaining altitude until we reached approximately 23,000 feet, about 2 miles from the summit. I looked around and pretty much everyone else just had this look of awe and wonder on their face. It's certainly a view you will never get from the ground.

I can't recommend this trip enough. All too soon, we headed back to a smooth landing at Talkeetna Airport and we were left with memories.

We were scheduled for the Denali Flyer with glacier landing. Clouds socked in few passes, but our pilot found alternates and got us some good sightseeing, even though we could not see Denali or complete the glacier landing. They credited us back a portion of the fare.   So, instead of a busted trip we had excellent glacier and mountain viewing.

Understandably, and as clarified on K2's website, the flight tours are dependent on the weather. While we were still able to fly, our route was adjusted (not sure to which one) from the Denali Grand Tour + landing (K2 did reduce the price). We did not get to actually see Denali, unfortunately, so that was definitely a disappointment though not the fault of K2; we appreciated how seriously they take safety, as wind conditions were a concern on our day. The pilot knew a lot about Alaska and its landscape and the views were incredible. Getting to step out on the glacier was an amazing experience. This is an expensive tour and while K2 is good about refunds and adjustments if you don't get to do what you signed up for, this tour is not necessarily a guaranteed way to see Denali if you don't build in an extra day or two.

There really aren't words to describe just how amazing the scenery and views on this experience were. We packed a ton of activities into two weeks in Alaska, and this is right at the very top of our favorites. 

We were scheduled for the Grand Tour, but when we arrived were told that while the weather where we were was great, it wasn't ideal on one side of the mountain, so we were downgraded to the Denali Flyer Tour (and given a refund for the price difference). The glacier landing portion of the trip would be a game-time decision made by the pilot. 

Flying over the mountains and glaciers was just unbelievable. The pilot was knowledgable with great commentary, and we felt very safe on the plane the entire time. Landing on the Ruth Glacier and being able to walk around for about 30 minutes was otherworldly. The clouds had been clearing all morning and we ended up with what the pilot said was one of the clearest days in weeks. We ended up with a perfect view of Denali! 

Excursions like this are expensive, but provide such a different point of view than you'll get from the ground or the water... I can't recommend it enough. It's truly a once in a lifetime experience, one I'll never forget. Thanks K2!
Was by far the best excursion of our land& sea CruiseTour! I highly recommend it. Our flight was smooth and the views were incredible.

We had a wonderful family flightseeing trip with K2. Much to our and our kids' disappointment, our morning flight was initially cancelled because of smoke from forest fires. But K2 managed to squeeze us in on a flightseeing tour with a glacier landing a few hours later, and it was the highlight of our trip for my teen and tween daughters! Our pilot patiently answered my nine-year-old's questions on the flight and took terrific pictures of us on the glacier. Great trip and great staff!

Our pilot was calm and professional.  I'm not going to lie,  I was nervous.  But the experience was incredible.  Even with the rampant fires, the views were beautiful once we got above the smoke. I felt like I could reach out and touch the mountains. The scale is so hard to grasp.
This flight to the glacier beneath Mt Denali was the highlight of my two-week Alaska trip. Highly recommended.
Wonderful experience!!!Will do it again!!!Pilot was superb!!He knew how to operate the plane very smoothly so we can enjoy the ride!!!Very exciting trip!!!

The flight was enjoyable but not earth shattering like promoted! Pilot Patrick was doing a job not actively enthusiastically participating so I’d rate that part as average. Without the glacier landing the flight would be Ho Hum! The bushfire smog affected visibility and it was obvious that we were unlucky flying in today’s conditions. Last point at approx A$500 for the experience I think time again I’d prefer a trip in winter when conditions were better for sight seeing

Fazer um voo ao redor do Denali já é incrível, imagina pousar nele. O passeio tem uma boa duração (+ ou - umas duas horas). O avião passa por vistas incríveis e, dependendo da época, faz um pouso bem no meio da cadeia de montanhas (há uma pista de gelo preparada pra isso). O pouso é seguro, mas com emoção. O avião é antigo, só que o motor é novo. Atendimento do capitão e do restante da equipe é muito bom.

review_title: Highlight of our Alaska Cruise & Land Trip
review_text: Wonderful smooth flight with Pilot Will!  He put my family of four at ease right away with brief safety information and instruction.  We went up in the piper plane which seated 6. The views from the air of Denali and surrounding mountains was beyond stunning and beautiful.  We had a clear day, but for a little haze from a large forrest fire raging in the Kenai Peninsula.  Once above the clouds, our visibility was excellent.  Ride was smooth with little turbulence.  Will was also the “tour guide” and pointed out interesting sights and facts about what we were seeing down below.  Would highly recommend K2 Aviation for this adventure!  We did the Denali experience without the glacier landing.

We originally booked the Grand Summit Tour, but due to weather we had to change the flight tour.  K2 was great to help us find a time slot and flight tour that would work with the weather and the time we had.  The pilot was incredible!  He flew us to surrounding mountain peaks, and shared a lot of information regarding the glaciers and geography.  The views were breath-taking!  Thank you K2 for providing such a memorable experience for us!

review_title: Outstanding! Summit Tour with Glacier Landing is highly recommended
review_text: I suppose we can't give K2 credit for the amazing weather, but besides the trip being spectacular, we were also very impressed with the professionalism, safety, and attentiveness of the staff. I am local and took visitors up for the tour and am thankful for K2 showing them an excellent time. I was even in awe!

It was definitely an unforgettable experience flying over the glaciers. We booked for the grand tour but was changed to the flyer tour due to weather condition that day. Except that, everything went very well. The staffs were very friendly and the pilot was, too, and also very professional. We learned more about the glaciers through pilot's narratives as we flew over the mountains. The view was astonishing. Then we came back safely. Liked it a lot. I do want to point out, however, that after we left and searched online we found that there was an accident which killed 5 people last year. Please do plan with all the risks that come with the tour.

review_title: One of the best experiences we had in Alaska
review_text: Decided to do a flight seeing trip while in a store in Talkeetna, Alaska. What a great flight with a great pilot. Please do yourself a favor if the weather is good and fly a few hours around the mountain!

We did the Summit Tour w/o glacier landing. We were hesitant to do this because of the cost, but it was worth every penny! This was by far one of the highlights of our time in Alaska, which was filled with awesome experiences. The staff at K2 are friendly, knowledgeable, and safety conscious. The only negative was that the tour had to end. :)  We will definitely do this again someday and won't even consider flying with anyone other than K2. This is a must do experience for anyone in the Denali/Talkeetna area!

Wilbur, in simple terms, was fabulous! He was very personable and was a great guide. His attention to detail in explaining the surroundings of the landscape was educational. Very courteous and professional throughout the flight. As far as being a pilot, Wilbur was very competent, detailed and professional. I would highly recommend K2 Aviation and Wilbur!

Pilot Randy was very friendly and knowledgeable created a smooth enjoyable flight. Everything from take off to landing was incredible, absolutely amazing. 
The chance to walk on a glacier and we even got to see an avalanche was so worth the money.

We were booked on the Denali Grand Tour.  When we showed up they said it was snowing on the other side of the mountain so the tour was cancelled.  They did offer to refund our money, change our time or put us on the Denali Flyer.  We had been looking forward to this for so long and wouldn't have been able to do it another time so we did the Denali Flyer.  It was cloudy and we didn't even get close to Denali.   In hindsight, I would advise you not to book ahead.  Then plan to stay in Talkeena 2-3 days and when the weather is good, just walk up and take a flight.  We wrongly assumed that when they cancelled the Denali Grand Tour because of weather that since they offered the Denali Flyer, the weather for it would have been better.  I'm sure the Denali would have been a nice flight in better weather.

It was leterally one of the coolest things i have ever done in my 59 years. I debated about spending the money and I am so happy that i decided to do it. It was well worth the money and I would do it again in a heartbeat. Chad was the pilot on the Piper Navajo for my trip. He gave good narration of the flight and executed one of the smoothest landings I have ever been on.

The trip with K2 Aviation was a wonderful experience for my family.  We opted to take the tour with the Glacier landing and enjoyed the trip very much.

It was a very clear day and we thoroughly enjoyed the trip back and forth.  The pilot was giving us good commentary all the way and provided us with some extra time on the glacier.  

Booking the tickets was also very easy and they honored the Toursaver coupon that we had.  We also had a national parks pass and they took that into consideration as well.

I would caution folks who are sensitive to the smell of gasoline as you are exposed to it throughout the duration of the trip.

All in all it was a wonderful once in a lifetime experience and I would like to thank K2 for making it memorable.

The flightseeing experience is great and was the highlight of our 2 week trip to Alaska. The pilot was experienced and knowledgeable and gave us lots of information as we were flying. Arranging the trip was a challenge, however. Our summit flight was cancelled due to last minute routine maintenance to our plane. Then it was rescheduled due to a last minute change to the maintenance date. Then it was downgraded to the Flyer Tour due to weather conditions. Overall, though, we had a good flight.

What a fantastic tour. We were signed up for the Denali Grand Tour with Glacier landing. Due to the wildfires near Fairbanks, the north side of the mountain was smokey. It was a beautiful clear day we flew very close to peaks and the glaciers. The pilot and the staff was very professional and informative. Landing on the glacier was impressive and we were able to appreciate the grandeur of the mountains. There even is a Chalet on the glacier that you can stay at for $2,300 a person a night. I highly recommend K2 Aviation.

Remarkable plane ride around Denali.  Our pilot Will explained everything and pointed out our altitudes, each peak, glaciers, interesting facts about climbers...even showed us a plane landing on the glacier below.  Felt like we could reach over and touch the mountains!

Wurden downgraded da an diesem Tag die Wetterbedingungen den grossen Rundflug nicht zuliessen.Bei vollem Kostenersatz wurde uns die kleinste Tour für 4 Personen( 240$ incl. taxes p/p.) als Ersatz angeboten,die sich dann als extended version der kleinen Tour herausstellte.Wir sind dann 1,5h mit einer legendären Beaver(Bj 1958) rumgepöttert und haben alles gesehen ausser dem Denali.Who cares? Unglaublich nettes und gutgelauntes Officepersonal und der Pilot aus Massachusetts,ein wahres Lexikon,der Vogel! Tx for experience K2.

We went on the flyer with glacier landing on Jul 1 - our 1pm flight was one of the firsts to be able to land on the glacier as the cloud cover cleared in time. We got the flyer deal with the TourAlaska coupon booklet so worked out reasonable (still expensive :)) The plane is a 10 seater cessna - a bit loud so they give you noise cancelling headphones. The views are incredible as the plane goes very close the mountains and the glaciers. The immensity of the glaciers cannot be fathomed until you go this close to them. The landing itself was awesome and it was unreal that we were sitting on a mile of ice on the Ruth Glacier. Overall about an hour and half for the trip - the glacier views and landing were increible. The flight was a bit bumpy on the return but nothing too bad. My kid was complaining of a headache from the flight (probably altitude) but otherwise enjoyed it. Dont forget to take the complementary goggles on the way in - the glacier is too blinding without extra pair of sunglasses (you will go snow blind if you dont use them). Highly recommend this tour!

Our seasoned pilot gave us a view of Mt Denali from above the clouds at over 11,000 feet before landing on a glacier.  It left us speechless with awe as the Alaskan beauty stretches endlessly to the horizon.  The plane is a no frills experience with excellent views as we flew through the peaks landing on the Ruth glacier. The K2 ground support was great at check in and follow up. If you don't have boots, they have over-boots for the glacier.  My son & I could not have been more pleased!

We took this excursion out of Talkeetna on a beautiful, bright afternoon at 7 pm, days before the summer solctice.  Billy was our pilot and took us to our plane, along with five other passengers.  Before we knew it, we were smoothly lifting up into the blue sky where the sweeping views were astounding.  As we approached the mountains, the sights grew more and more  dramatic!  We landed within a snowy canyon within the mountains, it was mesmerizing!  We were able to disembark into the snowy quiet and enjoy the magical sights around us, Denali towing up into it's own cloud!  We got to fly over base camp, up towards the peaks, and even saw a rainbow as we returned! What an amazing experience, we'll never forget!!

review_title: Best thing we did in Alaska
review_text: We spent 10 days in Alaska and this was everyone's favorite activity. The staff was professional, competent and knowledgeable.  The flight was just amazing and the glacier landing is a MUST!

review_title: Incredible views of mountains (Denali) and glaciers
review_text:
My family really wanted to go on a flight-seeing tour and land on a glacier, so we started searching for them while in Anchorage. We found several great options, but ended up going with K2 Aviation since their availability best matched our schedule. We chose the Denali Flyer Tour because we wanted to see multiple sides of Denali but didn't think the Grand Denali was quite worth the added cost.

We arrived really early since the drive from Denali to Talkeetna took less time than we anticipated. We hung out in the parking lot and on the picnic benches in front of K2. They provide water, tea, etc.There was also WiFi for guests but it didn't work for me.

We checked in 30-45 minutes before our flight. Each person weights themselves with everything they're taking onto the plane. You can also borrow sunglasses at this time if you need. They have a great selection with all sorts of styles and sizes. We also got our overboots at this time.

About 10 minutes before our flight, the pilot called us over and gave us a safety briefing. Then, we got on the plane. He took volunteers for co-pilot and everyone else sat wherever they wanted. Every seat has a headset and a window. The headset is a bit uncomfortable since it really closes in on your ears and head.

The flight itself was incredible! We flew over the park and soared through the mountains. Our pilot pointed out all the major landmarks from the summits to glaciers. He didn't provide much information besides that, which was fine with me. He did a good job of showing Denali to both sides of the plane so everyone was able to get photos. 

Near the end of the flight, we landed on Ruth Glacier. It was more like a field of snow than glacier ice, which was a little disappointing, but still a beautiful place. We had about 15 minutes on the glacier and then we got back on the plane and headed back.

Oh! One thing to note, it was rather hot when we were in Denali (highs of 75-80). It was also warm on the glacier and basically everyone wore short sleeves and jeans or shorts. No gloves, beanies, jackets, etc. were necessary.

Overall, I would recommend the flight to folks considering it. I wouldn't say it was the highlight of my trip, but it was definitely up there!

I live in Alaska and had family visiting from Virginia.  I have done this trip once before and that was incredible and now I am so glad to have done it again!  It's a jaw-dropping, awe-inspiring trip and one that you shouldn't overlook!  The views are simply incredible, beautiful, wild and amazing.  Our pilot was great- very informative and interesting.  It was 87 degrees on the ground when we left and everyone was feeling it, but getting up in the cool air cheered everyone up.  The tour is one I would do again and again!

My brother was visiting and we decided to do a flyover of Denali. The weather was great and the views were spectacular. Chad did a great job of pointing out the geology and features and giving both sides of the plane a good view. It was a beautiful trip for me and my brother.

We initially requested either the Summit Tour or Grand Denali Tour, but unfortunately the weather didn't allow us to be able to do that.  Knowing that our time in Alaska was limited and we didn't know whether the weather would cooperate we decided to take the Denali Flyer Tour that day instead.  It did not disappoint!  We were blown away at the vastness and grandeur of Denali, and we took many pics/videos during our trip.  It's definitely not one that we will ever forget.

This is a must-do!  The experience was awesome and the views were breath-taking.
We originally scheduled the Grand Tour but were unable to take that flight because of the decreased visibility due to the smoke from the wildfires on the Kenai Peninsula. We also did not opt for the glacier landing.  
Our pilot, Doug, was great.  He pointed out some things, like Boiling Springs, along the way and he was very friendly.
We would easily do this again. Well worth the price!

Pilot was fabulous, kudos to Kevin. Our photos were spectacular with this once in a lifetime experience. The weather was perfect for viewing all of the awesome sights. Definitely the highlight of our Alaskan journey.

Our flight over the mountains with the glacier landing was the highlight of a great two weeks in Alaska. It was a last-minute decision to go. I called K2 first thing in the morning and they could not have been more helpful, giving us a choice of trips going on the same day, picking us up from our hotel, and lending us snow shoes to wear over our normal footwear. Stan the pilot was thoroughly professional, giving us a comprehensive safety briefing and then taking us on the trip of a lifetime with expert commentary. We got to inspect the Alaska Range at close quarters, helped by excellent weather and smooth flying conditions, and then the ultimate bucket-list experience ... landing on the Ruth glacier. We had about 15min on the ice, then returned to Talkeetna. This is an expensive trip, but we thought it was worth every penny.

review_title: 100% worth it. Highlight of our Alaskan holiday
review_text:
We were tossing up between this, an ATV tour and a rafting tour. We were traveling on a pretty tight budget but I am so glad that we did the Denali experience. It was honestly one of the best things I have done in my entire life!!!! Not exaggerating. 

Our pilot Billy was great, our plane had 9 people in it and everyone got a window seat, and we saw some once in a lifetime breathtaking views. 

I would highly recommend to anyone and everyone regardless of your budget you will not regret it.

We took the last flight of the day, had beautiful weather and were rewarded with an Amazing experience. Billy, our pilot was not only a great pilot but also an excellent tour guide. In our opinion, money well spent. Unforgettable.

Due to weather we didn't get to fly all the way around Denali, but I don't think it mattered.  Our flight was amazing.  I spent the entire time with my face plastered to the window.  The views were breathtaking.  Landing on the glacier was a once in a lifetime experience.  Our pilot was cool and shared a lot about the area as we flew.   Loved every moment.  Everyone should do this!!!
