Jeff took us on the flight of our lives with up close scenes of Denali national park. Learned a lot about glaciers and their life cycle. We got lucky with a sunny day!

review_title: The peak of our Alaska trip
review_text: We were lucky in our private flight over Denali to have clear skies, and it was the most incredible experience of our Alaska vacation.  There’s no way to describe it in words.  Our pilot was very communicative and informative.

The entire experience was beyond our wildest expectations.  Stan, the pilot, and the K2 office staff were very kind and helpful.  The flight scenery is hard to convey with words...Spectacular, awesome, breath taking, larger than life are the first words that come to mind and I could go on forever. Landing on a glacier, high up on Denali itself was an unforgettable and immeasurable experience.  I assure you my review does not even come close to capturing the grandeur of the experience!
Great up close view of Denali. Very knowledgeable pilot/guide. K2 seemed very safety minded and well organized.

We were on a cruise tour with Princess that took us through Talkeetna. I like to book excursions independently, so we found K2 online and booked an afternoon flight over he Alaskan Range and around Denali. It was a beautiful day when we got there, but they said winds on the north side of Denali required a change to our flight plan. At first we were disappointed, but it turned out great! We got a refund because the new flight was less expensive, and I can’t imagine anything Better than what we got!  We had a beautiful clear flying over the mountains and saw Denali up close and personal in full sunlit view! It was an experience I’ll never forget. Chris was our pilot, and he was so friendly and personable. He did a great job telling us what we were flying over and gave us a smooth comfortable ride! I highly recommend flying with K2!

This is a " Bucket list" item !! The highlight of our vacation. The landing on the glacier is an extraordinary experience ! The views from the glacier and from the air are once in a lifetime views. If we are ever back in the area, this will definitely be a repeat adventure

review_title: Excelence flight with Glacier Landing and time in the snow.
review_text:
Flew in a 12 passenger Otter over Denali National Park . Wonderful views of the 600 mile mountain ranges.
Landed in 16' deep[ snow at a glacier base camp. Pilot was wearing Short Sleeve Shirt , but passengers were in coats with shoe covers.  Do not get too far from the plane as  snow is not compacted.

Thanks to K2 for providing us with a sensational flight experience. The staff was first class from reservations, to check-in through the flight. Their professionalism, competence and attention to safety gave us complete confidence that our flight would go as planned and we could focus our attention on the beauty of the scenery. It was truly an unforgettable experience that we will cherish forever.

review_title: Was Great Experience, but there was a BIG safety concern
review_text:
We had booked "Denali Flyer Tour with Glacier Landing". Glacier landing was the best. And "Denali Flyer" was good enough in terms of the length and the time of the tour. I wouldn't opt for for the other 3 tours. This is good enough.

Our tour was scheduled to start at 3:00 pm. We were a family of 6. We did a checkin at 2:30 pm. Be there 30 mins prior to boarding. There is a restroom at the office, clean. If you forget to get your sun glasses, no worries, the staff there are helpful and you can borrow sun glasses, and return them after the flight. You get to borrow the boots kind that you wear on top of your shoes. So keep in mind, you don't need to bring your boots. Just the regular shoes that you are wearing for your entire trip is good enough. You pick your size from their storage box, wear them, meet the pilot when called around 15 mins prior to flying. The pilot walks you to the 10 seater plane and you get seated.

You wear your headset. 
FEEDBACK: 
1. MY HEADSET WAS NOT CONNECTED TO THE SOCKET. AFTER FEW MINTS I HAD TO FIGURE OUT
2. THE WORST PART WAS: I WAS SITTING NEXT TO THE ENTRY DOOR AND THE FLIGHT STARTS MOVING, AND I'M SHOCKED THE DOOR IS NOT CLOSED. I REMOVED MY SEAT BELT AND RAN TO THE PILOT AND TAPPED ON HIS SHOULDER AND TOLD HIM THE DOOR IS NOT CLOSED. HE STOPPED THE PLANE AND CAME AND CLOSED/LOCKED THE DOOR.

That was terrible terrible mistake of the pilot not having a checklist. Had I taken a minute or more to inform the pilot, maybe we all wouldn't have been in the plane to even tell. I as a passenger don't know how to close and lock that plane door, and for sure I don't want to do it myself and feel safe.

Then we go over the mountain, which was beautiful to see the snow tip from areal view. Then we land on a 4000 ft glacier surrounded by snow mountains. It was "nature at it's best".. just gorgeous. Absolute beauty. Amazing. We get to spend more than 20 mins and then fly back. The pilot was a good narrator. We land back. Return our sun glasses, boots, and back to our car.

Oh, Talkeetna was cute little town, we had Ice Cream and coffee. Should try it. It was great. And there are lot of Thai Restaurants if that's a point to keep in mind

I love flying smaller planes and so I had to try K2.  This turned out to be one of the best flights I have ever taken!  We set off in an Otter plane with room for 8 or 10 passengers.  Our pilot was excellent.  We flew over the valley and then did a circle of Denali and landed on a glacier.  Getting out and walking around in this snow capped place was pure magic..  I will never forget this experience.. The K2 staff and crew are super friendly and will get you the experience you are looking for with the choices the offer....  Can't wait to do it again and do yourself a favor and do it too!
Kevin was awesome and we had a great trip around the mountains and a very cool glacier landing.  Helped that the weather was perfect.   Highly recommend K2

My husband has been a pilot for over 40 years, even before he got his driver's license. We are also both Aerospace Engineers. We can both say this was the most amazing flight of our life. Professionally run, the pilot was extremely experienced, the planes appeared to be excellently maintained. Worth EVERY penny. Do the Glacier landing for sure.
K2 thank you for an experience of a lifetime.

I've gone on flight seeing tours with K2 before and this again was a great time!
We did the Denali Flyer tour in June 2019 and had an amazing time.   Our pilot pointed out all the various glaciers and peaks and was really informative.   I highly recommend K2 if you want a wonderful flight seeing tour.

Had a fantastic flight over Denali during our visit to Talkeetna.
Despite our initial disappointment that our original booking was cancelled (the company offered an alternative or refund) the trip turned out to be everything we wanted. We were blessed with good weather but our pilot was professional and knowledgable.
A really good experience!

A great tour of Danali including a glacier landing.
Pilot described every phase of the trip and provide detail that enhanced the flight. We were blessed with wonderful weather. I would highly recommend K-2

I'll start by mentioning that I was beyond a nervous wreck. I was terrified of going on this tour but I tried to hold my composure as best as I could. Our pilot, Billy, made a point of checking on me a few times during the flight, asking if I was okay. Once we landed back on good ol' mother earth, safe and sound, I could barely keep myself upright. So I laid out on the lawn in front of the building. After his next and final flight, he came in to check on me and offered to walk me through the process of flying the plane. I accepted. He was so generous to share his time, passion, and knowledge with us. He was always very cheerful, while also taking my situation seriously, with care and kindness.This experience was definitely not a breeze for me, but I'm still grateful for every good thing that came of it. 

Forewarning: it is a rocky ride and weather is unpredictable (aka the reasons that unsettled me). Our glacier landing was canceled for this particular reason. Our reservations went from Grand Tour to Denali Flightseeing Tour. They cancel as need-be due to inclement weather. Which can only be known right before a flight due to ever changing weather.

We were hesitant to switch flights and take the one to the Alaska range, but are now very glad we did. We loved it! All the people we worked with were polite and very personable. The pilot, Chris Palm, did an amazing job with the flight, answering questions, and connecting with his passengers. Highly recommend any flight with this company.

review_title: Beautiful, Comfortable, Fun, We Would Do It Again!
review_text: My wife and I did this air tour and thoroughly enjoyed it.  In addition to the pilot, Randy, there were three others on the flight.  We flew in a very well maintained 1958 deHavilland Beaver which alone is worth the trip, but we also saw the beauty of Dinali and the glaciers from the air.  As described, each person has a headset so that they can hear the description offered by the pilot and so that they can ask questions.  K2 picked us up at our hotel at the designated time and returned us after the flight.  We had a fairly good day weather-wise and were able to take a lot of beautiful pictures; the flight itself was very relaxing with little to zero turbulence (this is weather dependent I suppose), and the pilot/guide was very informative.  We would certainly do this again in the future and recommend it to others.

We had a wonderful pilot (Billy) that was professional, knowledgeable of the history, geography, and very personable. He gave us the safety briefing and kept us informed of where we were flying and allowed us to ask pretty much any question during the flight and on the glacier.

Our flight was postponed due to iffy weather but better to be safe than sorry and as it turned out the following morning was GORGEOUS for flying.  

Our pilot had four decades of experience and handled the plane so perfectly that there was zero turbulence and we could simply sit back and enjoy the experience.

I actually didn't sit back because I had the seat beside the pilot, but also, I felt like a little girl flying over a magical land of glittery diamonds because the sun was reflecting off the snow on Dinali (and all around the mountain)…it literally took my breath away because I held my breath the whole time, not from nerves, but from sheer bewilderment at the beauty ahead and below me.

We landed on Ruth Glacier and had time to take photos, and just BE in all that natural beauty.

Flying back to base, we flew over more of the glacier and saw the turquoise ice through the snow, soooooo beautiful.

Sadly, we're damaging the environment so badly, that they say within 50 years what I saw could be gone....so if you have the opportunity to experience this, DO IT!  It was worth every penny and one of the best experiences of my life. 

P.S.  I'm a senior travel consultant with 30 years in the business, and have (been blessed to have) had MANY amazing experiences during my travels, so when I say that the flight-seeing to Denali was a highlight, believe it.

I took SO many photos and videos, these are just a few of them.

Best experience of my trip. Daniel was our pilot. He was just as excited as the rest of us. Before we took off, the whole staff was informing us that the clouds were coming in and we might not get to land on the glacier. On the flight up Daniel was telling us what we were seeing and saying he was still hopeful for a landing. Turns out the clouds weren't as bad as they thought and we got to land. He helped us take pictures, pointed out mountains and shared tales. Overall K2 is the only flight company I would trust flying with. Everyone we met seemed to love their job and it makes you feel relaxed seeing that.

Went on a flightseeing tour provided by K2 Aviation in Talkeetna Alaska.  The ground personnel and pilot were professional and courteous. Our pilot expertly landed on and took off from a glacier.  Flying over the beautiful snow covered mountains was breathtaking and landing on and walking on a glacier was one of the most exciting experiences of my life. I highly recommend K2 Aviation as a provider for a once in a lifetime experience.

Patrick was a great pilot. His knowledge and experience made our excursion perfect from the take off to the Ruth glacier landing to the return flight. This is a flight I would be glad to take again if I ever return to Alaska. If you fly K2 Aviation ask for Patrick he will do his best to provide a great glacier landing experience.

Although we signed up for the Denali Grand Tour, due to weather problems, we had to take the 1 hour tour instead. It was still a fantastic tour; all the staff and pilot were excellent. I would recommend this company to anyone who wants a first class experience.

We were amazed and awed by the sights and sounds once we landed on the ice.  The flight to and from the glacier was also very exciting.  Even after almost 10,000 hours aloft myself as both a military and civilian pilot, I couldn’t wait to make this flight.  My wife was equally excited.  Our pilot Mark was very professional and knowledgeable both about the aviation aspect as well as the mountaineering experiences he shared with us.  Outstanding experience.

My teenage son and I enjoyed a spectacular tour around the glaciers in Denali. Weather prevented us from seeing higher elevations but our pilot did a great job showing us what he could and adjusted the flight to see other features in the area. As a pilot myself, I found him to be professional, personable and well trained. Aircraft also seem well maintained. Definitely worth seeing that terrain from above.

We loved our flight with K2 pilot Wil. He was experienced and sensitive while providing interesting details about what we were seeing. The entire K2 staff was helfpul from the beginning, quick to respond to email and safety oriented. We nearly didn't get to fly because of the weather on the mountain but it cleared up by late afternoon and we enjoyed the trip of a lifetime! I highly recommend K2.

Our  Dehaviland Otter aircraft was First class! Our pilot Chris , was a consummate professional.One of the best things we have ever done!Landing on the glacier with a cobalt blue sky and Denali in all its glory!Unforgettable👍

review_title: Amazing, incredible way to see Denali
review_text: Earlier clouds in front of Denali had cleared by the time we took off from Talkeetna at 7 pm on K2’s last “Denali Flyer” of the day. Pilot Daniel was both an excellent pilot and knowledgeable commentator as we flew the face of the mountain. He made sure passengers on both sides of the plane were able to get good views and didn’t skimp on time of trouble. The weather was perfect for flying and especially for the unforgettable glacier landing. An amazing, incredible, never-to-be-forgotten way to see “The High One.”

Our pilot, Chris, gave us a thrilling 1.5 hour flight over Denali National Park. As we flew through steep canyons over sparkling glaciers, Chris beguiled us with interesting statistics and fascinating stories. We saw climbers below, snow caped mountains beside, and blue skies with puffy white clouds above us. Even Mt. Denali peeked out at us from time to time. We highly recommend this trip of a lifetime.

review_title: Drop off and pickup in the Amphitheater to stay at the historic mountain house.
review_text: We had a great experience, as always! Great pilots, great staff, reliable and flexible service, excellent communication!

review_title: Great Flight on a great day
review_text: The fight was a wonderful  experience and our pilot Mark was great. He made a extra turn so  we could see a avalanche in progress which just added to the flight. The office staff and ground crew also did a great job. The flight was the best start we could have asked for on a six day Alaska vacation.

the most amazing experience I ever had , the pilot very knowledgeable making the trip very enjoyable, an experience of a life time I will do it again ,and again.
 thank you for such an amazing time.

Mark was our pilot and the flight was flawless. Everyone was so nice and didn’t rush anyone. Airplanes are a little challenging for those with minor disabilities. In a perfect day like today the views were incredible.

My work team went on a team building trip. There were 9 of us. We were scheduled for a glacier landing. Due to the weather, we needed to change our plan. K2 offered a different flight with out the landing, and more weather friendly. 

AMAZING! We all were very happy to be able to still fly. Our pilot Mark, was very informative. Mark flew over glaciers, rivers, valleys. He taught us about the history of Denali, Talkeetna, The railroad, and more. 

Our team agreed that this was the best team building experience ever. 
If the weather is keeping you from the summit, or glacier landing.. Don't even hesitate to fly the lower scenic route.  It is worth your time and then some. Great flight! Thank you K2, and Mark!

Wow.  Where do I begin.  I had been up to Talkeetna on no fewer than three occasions before the opportunity was taken on trip #4 to hire a flight around the Alaska Range mountains (which includes Denali / Mt McKinley).  April 24 was a glorious day, and we had been anticipating a great adventure flying among the peaks and landing on a glacier.  The meticulously clean DeHaviland DHC-3 Otter was our bird and Chris was our pilot.  My husband and I were two of only three passengers on the plane, and the mountain peaks, the craggy cliffs we saw  and the glacier we landed on (Pika Glacier) -- Everything Was So Incredible!!   What was super special was that Chris would explain everything he knew about what we were seeing (and he knows a LOT!).  All of it was so interesting -- we both want to return for another flight in the spring or summer when the snow in the lower elevations has melted and the green has "returned" -- and we will ask for Chris to take us on yet another flight.  He's a great guy who is meticulous with everything (EVERYthing) he does, and we want more of his stories!!  Thanks, K2, for the amazing experience (I still think you should have a "Frequent Flyer" card... 6 flights and the 7th is free... or something like that.  I'd be game!).
Really friendly staff, great at making us feel safe and prepared for the journey. Stunning scenes that we would have had no other way to take in!

The day started out cloudy, so my first original flight was delayed until conditions cleared up. Which they did because they want you to have the best experience, and I was happy they did this for me! The experience was amazing and something I’ve never done before! It was a wicked blast that I booked another flight with a glacier landing for late May!

K2 dedication to fulfill your needs as a customer is beyond expectation. For years they have been helping me and my climbers get to the destinations we want in order to do our climbs. Their approach to safety, their professionalism and their warm treatment keep making my return to the Alaska Range special every spring.

Atendimento exemplar na loja e vôo magnífico!!!
Senti segurança durante o vôo e especialmente quando pousamos sobre o glaciar.
Magnífico poder andar sobre a neve fofa!
Passeio inesquecível!
We did the grand denali with glacier landing and it was perfect. Our pilot chris was great,and what a smooth ride! It was perfect and we will definitely be doing it again.

This was one of my top five life experiences. Everything about it was fantastic, starting with the details of the airplane itself, the flight, the information provided while viewing the scenery, through the landing. You just can't believe the enormity of the mountain and the glaciers around it until you are up there with the peaks beside you, seemingly so close you could reach out the window and touch the granite, and you find out that granite is over a mile away. If you can do only one thing while you visit Alaska, do this. I am so glad I did.I will never forget it.

An absolutely incredible experience. K2 facilitated a spur of the moment trip on an Alaskan ski touring vacation. We booked our 1030 AM flight with a glacier landing and they called to let us know a later time would offer better chances for the glacier landing. We highly recommend our pilot Chip. He inspired confidence and was essentially narrated a natural history lesson during the flight, as well as a history of the aircraft as an introduction. Excellent experience.

OMG. It was more than I expected the view was Spectacular, the comfort of the plane was very comfortable and most of all the guide we had was so very knowledgeable and friendly.  He made our trip one of the most exciting ones we have take. And believe me we have been all around the world. Thanks so much for a trip of a lifetime

review_title: So Fantastic and worth every penny!
review_text: The staff was super friendly and answered every question I had.  They had even given us a discount on the flight because they felt there was too much cloud coverage to see Mt. Denali.  When the pilot flew us out there the clouds had dissipated and it wound up being a perfect view of the mountains.  We were 500 Ft. away from the tallest Mountain in North America. it was amazing!  The pilot was awesome as well and he answered every question each of us had on the plane. it was such a fantastic experience and worth every penny!

review_title: Ceremony in the Alaska Range with K2!
review_text:
My fiance and I worked with K2 Aviation to plan our private ceremony in the Alaska Range. While the weather made us wait a few extra days, it was defintely worth it! 

Everyone from Jeremiah at the front counter to Chris Palm our pilot, provided an exceptional, once in a lifetime experience. The Alaska Range is a mind-numbing, indescribable place and K2 Aviation provides a world-class experience taking you there. We’ll never forget it! Thank you K2...you guys rock!!!

Amazing experience - The pilot, Chip, was fantastic - very passionate about the plane - loved the history and safety features - I felt very safe. Booking was great - everyone who I spoke with was knowledgeable and accommodating.

This was the highlight of our trip. The scenery was difficult to describe. Safety was a concern of ours because of the nature of the flight but our pilot never did anything to make us feel anything but safe. 100% satisfied with everything. Equipment was clean and modern. Staff was attentive to us and I would do the exact same trip again and with them with no fears.

Awesome experience!!!  This is the only way to see the true magnificence of the mountains and glaciers without being a professional climber or with all the hard work of actually hiking up the trails.  You see the mountains and glaciers from a perspective few get the chance to.  From the moment I arrived the Staff at K2 were wonderful, letting me know weather updates and options.  They even pulled up the live camera feeds on the mountain and glaciers to let me know exactly what I could and could not see.  No bait and switch here, they were up front about everything.  My pilot Chip was amazing, narrating the entire trip with aviation actions he was taking and then local and historic information about the area and what we were seeing.   Even gave me a flight map of exactly what we flew over and saw.  So much to see and learn, you will not be disappointed!!  Already booked a flight for my return trip this summer.  VETERANS- Don't forget to ask for the Military Discount!

My mom and I took the Denali flyer flight and we had THE BEST time. The staff was great and the views were amazing. The pilot answered all of our questions with in-depth knowledge and enthusiasm. I cannot remember his name (we flew March 12 at around noon) but he was fantastic. Highly recommend this tour!

review_title: This is the best activity we did in Alaska!
review_text: Wow! How fun! We did the Denali Flight Tour and Dallas was our pilot. Dallas was so cool and so informative. Both my husband and I were so worried about the flight - is it going to be super bumpy?? Are we going to get air sick?? Will the take off and landing be scary?? No, no and no. Dallas made sure that we were not scared and comfortable. If it would get bumpy at all, he just would get to a comfortable speed/altitude. The girl at the office was really nice too and even gave us two vintage posters! We loved the experience and we definitely agreed that this was the best thing that we did on our winter Alaska trip. The views from the flight are surreal! We hope to do it again another time and are now even considering taking some flight lessons!

The view and overall experience was simply amazing. Although the weather conditions were not perfect for our original flight time, K2 Aviation was flexible and allowed us to switch the flight time for later in the day.  Highly recommend it!!

One thing to do before you leave Alaska, land on the Denali ice field.  At 7,000 ft, the mountain is another 13,000 ft above you, sky is bright blue and air is SO fresh.  Go on a sunny day, when a High Pressure system is present and bring a bottle of Champagne!

I enjoyed the exciting flight, especially for the sake of my photography. We didn't get to hardly see the Denali peak due to the weather, and apparently it would have to be an absolutely perfect day to do the Denali Grand flight tour which I was planning to do. The only reason I got to see the peak of the mountain barely through the clouds is because the pilot turned the plane around to see a coyote down by a river. I got great pictures of the glaciers, but I wish the pilot would make sure everyone got a chance to see the top of the mountain when its visible when flying back to Talkeetna.

I had this experience twice but few years ago. Once we landed on the glacier. I must say that this was my first time with a pilot wearing boots, jeans  but he was great and we really enjoyed the adventure
Aviation has been our life so of course every place we visit we must make a trip to the airport!  So interesting to see all the planes and visit with the locals
My boyfriend and I had an amazing trip with K2's chief pilot! Incredible views, lots of information- worth every penny!

review_title: Don't let the weather get you down
review_text: We had booked a Denali Ground Tour for a 10am flight this past Sept. When we arrived, there were too many clouds and the flight was a no go. We thought our day was a loss. But the front desk suggested we reschedule for a 2:30 flight, so we did and hung around town. Afternoon arrived and the clouds parted. We're SO glad we re-booked and waited because the views were absolutely stunning. The highlight, as many here can attest, was the glacier landing. Chris, the pilot, is a lifetime resident with many years flying bush planes. He was a fount of knowledge and helped make the trip such a success. There were 8 of us in the plane and all had their own window.

review_title: Landing on the glacier was the best
review_text: The staff at K2 was very friendly and helpful.  Our pilot Ryan gave a knowledgeable and informative narrative during the flight.  Landing on the glacier was by far the highlight of the trip.

We were in Talkeetna in late September, 2018, and hadn't booked anything to do in advance, considering chances of unpredictable weather and visibility. When it turned out to be an amazingly clear and gorgeous Saturday, we started thinking it would be a great chance to do flightseeing. Our Airbnb host highly recommended K2. We called and they happened to have 2 seats available on an afternoon trip. Jeremiah and the office crew are very helpful!

Our pilot, Dallas, is their head of maintenance, and he made us very comfortable with the operation and safety before and during the flight. He was great with answering our questions and providing a lot of information about the area geography - mountains, glaciers, valley, and rivers, as well as our geeky plane questions. 

Highly recommended!

If you get a break in the weather put this at the top of your bucket list.  K2 is a great company to work with and you will never forget the experience.  Highly recommended whether you’re from AK or just visiting.

review_title: Excellent experience with a great team
review_text: Our experience with K2 Aviation was incredible, they were helpful and knowledgeable while providing us with an unbelievable experience. Our pilot Ryan was great at pointing out landmarks as we were in flight and made sure we were comfortable and enjoyed our trip. We will certainly fly with K2 again! Thank you for the unforgettable experience!
Loved the flight! The staff and pilot were amazing, and of course the views were incredible. I’m not usually one to pay for tourist activities, but this was definitely worth it!!

Great history shared on our flight to and from Denali. Chip, our pilot made sure we were safe and that we could here him in our headsets while we were in flight. He welcomed any questions and flies well. We really enjoyed our glacier landing experience and the tour around Denali. They also provide you shoes to wear over your existing shoes so that you don't get your pants wet. It's pretty cold for the end of September, make sure you have your gloves so your fingers don't freeze while you take pictures outside for about 15 minutes.

review_title: Denali Flyer Flight with glacier landing
review_text: Well when the weather is gorgeous this experience cannot be beat.  We had a fantastic day and the views were tremendous.  Landing n the glacier was an incredible experience.  We felt safe with our Pilot Mark who made the experience more enjoyable.  If you can find the funds to take the trip it is definitely worth it.
Totally awesome and amazing.  You have to see AK from the air to appreciate the size and beauty.   K2 folks were fantastic!

Our flight was the highlight to our entire Alaska Trip. The flight was very smooth and easy, no jerky turns at all. The grounds were very clean as well as the offices etc.The planes looked brand new. The staff was extreamly helpful. We made several phone calls from home long before our trip and K2 answered everything. They make us feel appreciated. Our pilot was just like a family member to all of us. There are many options for tours and we will be signing up for another flight when we return. 1st Class Flight, 1st Class Crew, 1st Class Equipment and 1st Class Operation. We are aware of the tragic crash that happend right after our flight. We will never believe that K2 had anything to do with the crash. I'll send my family and friends to K2 anytime.

Wow! What an amazing experience this was. My two friends and I decided to book this flight tour (based on reviews here) during our after-season trip to Alaska. We assumed it would be cool, but it exceeded our expectations. Our pilot, Ryan, was knowledgable and friendly, and the plane was a cool Vietnam era craft (called an Otter, I think). 

The weather for our tour was out of this world--totally clear sky and no clouds to be seen. They told us it was the best flying day they had seen in months! Getting to see Denali and the other peaks up close was breathtaking, and Ryan told us a lot of history and answered all of our questions expertly. 

Denali was obviously the main attraction, but there were a lot of other beautiful peaks in the range, as well as some glaciers. It was fun to loop through the peaks and see so much. 

I'm sure the tour would still have been great even if the weather wasn't so good, so I highly recommend this tour. Definitely book in advance. Also, volunteer for the copilot seat if they ask!

review_title: Booked the Summit Tour With Glacier Landing, But Winds Changed Things
review_text: We booked the Summit Tour with Glacier Landing.  It was a clear day so we were excited, but when we arrived, we were told the winds were too high so we would be taking the Grand Tour with Glacier Landing.  When we got into the air, Chris (pilot) received info from other pilots that the  winds were increasing, so we ended up taking the Denail Flyer with Glacier Landing.  You can read other reviews to see details on everyone's wonderful experiences; I will add that, even though we were disappointed we couldn't circle and climb the summit, I would highly recommend you take whatever tour you can get--even our tour was breathtaking!

review_title: Fantastic Experience - Denali Sightseeing and Glacier landing - Professional and seamless
review_text:
We flew up on a fixed wing plane to Mt. Denali on the glacier and had a fantastic time. The glacier landing went vey smoothly The views were incredible and the organisation of the whole experience was just easy. We were in a group of six and some that were a bit hesitant on flying. Steve is a young Pilot and took it all in his stride and explained the process and was very informative being a local. 
We asked him all kinds of questions and he was very helpful
We took coats and gloves but didn't really need them.Cameras are a must.
K2 provides over shoe covers and that made it easy walk on the glacier

The best days to go when there are no cloud cover

Denali was cloudless on Monday September 10,2018.  Perfect to experience what Denali is all about. Went to K2 Aviation and from beginning to end had the friendliest, kindest help in choosing what experience would be best for us.  the biggest plane was a must and we were shown each plane. Ground crew and the pilot were excellent helpful understanding people.
Flying next to Denali gives one a completely different perspective of what the mountain is all about.The grandios width of its base, with glaciers, moraines, in gullys and crevases and canyon walls.  And how the rivers form, the difference of terrain.  It is all unimaginable from afar.  A very worthwhile and fantastic experience.  Worth every $

My cousin and I flew to a remote lake with K2’s Beaver on floats. The weather wasn’t great at our scheduled departure time so we delayed our trip. Jen was very friendly in making sure we had enough food and fuel for our float out, despite the fact that they would not be picking us up or be responsible for our safe return. Chip, our pilot, inspired confidence and was friendly and helpful getting our gear in and out of the plane. He knows the area and gave us useful background on campsites in the area. K2 is a professional operator that I would book with again.

review_title: Not our First Choice but Definitely a Great Flight
review_text:
We were scheduled for the Denali Experience Flight tour with K-2.  We knew the weather conditions weren't optimal when we got up and couldn't see Denali from our hotel.  Some one came to pick us up for our flight and said they it wasn't safe to fly to Denali but offered to fly us to the glaciers to the south where conditions were much better for the same cost.  We agreed and off we went.  Our pilot (I wish I could remember his name) was very experienced and did his best to make the flight interesting and enjoyable  It was fantastic and we learned so much.  We were in the air for more than an hour and could really get a good view of  the land and just the enormity of these glaciers.

I do appreciate that K-2 puts safety first.  We could see for ourselves that the conditions on the mountain were not good and they offered us a safer alternative.  Everything we experienced with this company  was professional.  I would definitely fly with them anytime.

We had a wonderful experience flying around Denali on a cloudless September day with K2. Rose (the pilot) was very thorough, competent, professional and knowledgeable about the area. She really knows that mountain!  We did the 1 1/2 hour flight in the 6 place Piper and would highly recommend this once in a lifetime experience.
The pilot was very knowledgeable and careful a perfect landing on the glacier.  A once in a life time flight over mountains  and many glaciers.

review_title: Perfect day for a great ride!
review_text: This was a highlight of our trip! The pilot was knowledgeable and made it a great ride. We enjoyed the clear view of Denali, other mountains and glaciers, and how close we got to them. The glacier landing was exhilarating. The whole experience was great from check-in to our return to the airfield. Thank you so much!

We scheduled two flights that were canceled due to weather. We reallly wanted to see Denali from the air. However, they went Over the Top when we went to their office after the flight was canceled. They offered us other flights that, again because of weather, couldn’t go very far but we weren’t interested. But then the lady got on the computer, looking at allll possibilities of things we could do to see more of Alaska. The time she took, the effort she made was phenomenal especially considering that us doing those things would be of no benefit to K2....so I can only begin to imagine how awesome their flights would be, being that concerned for their clients enjoyment. I am sooo impressed!! Will definitely be back next year! Sooo nice!!!

K2 Aviation is very professional, safety-conscious, and exactly as advertised in its website.  It's expensive to see Denali via a flight, but it's the best way to experience it.  The weather was very clear the day we were there, but we're told that's rare.  The mountain is usually shrouded in clouds.  K2 had to cancel our grand tour that would have included circling the summit because the winds were too high for safety.  We were offered a tour one step down from there and received a lower price than the summit tour.  Everything about the way these people operate is professional.  We definitely got our money's worth.

The beauty of denali can not be complete  without flying over . Only wish the flight could be longer . 
Flight is really stable , almost feel nothing at all.

review_title: Sunny, clear day to see Denali in all her splendor!
review_text: My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed our flightseeing tour with the glacier landing.  The weather could not have been better, blue skies and sunny.  We could see Mt Denali from Talkeetna upon take off.  Randy, our pilot, is a delight person and very knowledgable about the area and flying this DeHavilland plane.  I strongly recommend doing this tour to anyone that wants to see the landscape from a bird's-eye view and be so close to the peak of Denali, you feel like you can reach out and touch it!  AMAZING experience!  Thanks K2 and Randy!

K2 is a very professional organization. We flew with them in 1994, and flew again in 2018. We took the flight-seeing tour of Denali with the glacier landing. I highly recommend doing the glacier landing. It’s a magical experience landing on Ruth glacier (at 5500 feet) and getting out and walking around while viewing Denali mountain, towering 15,000 feet above you. Both times we did this in early September, and both times we had perfect weather to land and view the mountain. It’s a bit pricey, but worth it!

review_title: Once in a lifetime flightseeing experience
review_text: Fortunately, we went on a perfect day -- clear skies, moderate wind. K2 is exceptionally well run. We were picked up at our hotel by K2 and the flight was well organized and perfectly executed. Pilot was professional and friendly with a clear focus on safety and the satisfaction of the passangers. We opted for the glacier landing and were glad we did so.

review_title: Fly in day hike was the best experience of our Alaskan trip
review_text: Not cheap, but worth every cent to fly in a classic Beaver float plane.  The flight was good with some excellent sightseeing followed by the excitement of landing on a small lake in Denali, where we did a shortish hike with a really knowledgeable guide.  The flight back to Talkeeta gave more opportunities to see moose and bears, as well as good views of the mountains and glaciers.  Hint:  the back seats in the Beaver gave us a better forward view than if we were in the second row.

My wife and I really enjoyed the flight. The weather was perfect and sunny. Our pilot/guide Mike navigated us to the mountain and showed us up close views of glaciers and the different faces of the mountain. He was very knowledgeable and was even able to point out base camp and the different climbing routes.
This was a great flight.  We had Zero complaints.  It was definitely worth it.  Our pilot, Mike, did a great job; very smooth ride.
The Denali flight with K2 Aviation was amazing. The views were spectacular.  Out pilot was very knowledgeable and explained every detail of Denali !!! Well worth the money.

My husband and I booked the tour that included landing on Ruth Glacier..  absolutely beautiful day, breathtaking scenery..  I was a little nervous about the landing, our pilot immediately turned when we experienced slight turbulence..  he was professional, friendly, I was never nervous after takeoff..  great experience, highly recommend..

We had a beautiful day to take our flight and it was well worth the time and investment. Our pilot was very professional and gave us a ton of info about Denali and the surrounding mountain area. He added in some interesting stories about various excursions from adventurers who have braved the Denali challenge which made the trip even more interesting. The up close look at Denali was amazing. It is hard to describe the immenseness of it. We loved the whole experience. Thanks k2

review_title: Amazing k2 flight around Denali with glacier landing
review_text: One of the most incredible experiences of my life. Unreal day flying over Denali with K2. Our pilot, Kevin, was extremely knowledgeable and very experienced. We took about two hours to fly all the way around the mountain and land on a glacier in the middle of the park. Denali itself was amazing and all the surrounding peaks and glaciers were outstanding as well. Would highly recommend. Thanks all for a great experience.

We were supposed to do the tour around the summit, but it was too windy above 12,000 feet so instead we did the one where it was a bit lower, but we did a glacier landing.  It was a great experience - so beautiful flying around the glaciers and out pilot, Daniel, was great. So knowledgeable!  Something to put on your bucket list for sure!

review_title: Breathtaking views of Alaska's majestic mountains, glaciers, and more
review_text: It wasn't just the views that were amazing on our flight with K2 Aviation in Talkeetna, Alaska.  Our pilot, Will, was as well.  He was actually a flight instructor with 40 years of experience and was very knowledgeable about Alaska.  He provided an ongoing commentary during our flight to let us know exactly what we were seeing.  So glad the sun came out that day and we were able to see Denali (the big one)!
The flight was fantastic. The pilot did a great job flying all around Mt Denali and narrated along the way. Don’t miss a chance to fly around Denali and then land on a glacier

review_title: Stunning bird's eye view of the and the mountains
review_text:
Our final stop before driving back to Anchorage from Fairbanks was the Denali Flight tour with Glacier Landing with K2 Aviation. We had checked off everything on our Alaska trip except the flight + glacier landing and we are so glad that we flew with K2 aviation. The overall experience was just brilliant and one to savor for years to come. 

The winds were rough near Mt Denali, so with some potential turbulence our Denali Grand tour was not possible but we were able to do the Denali Flyer. Our captain Mike with decades of experience was very nice to give us all the information about the Ruth glaciers and others. We got a good glimpse of Mt Denali from about 5 miles. The weather was so good when we landed on the glacier, we didnt even use our jackets. The view of all the other mountains was excellent and the glaciers especially was unreal. The formation, the journey and the final integration into the rivers of these glaciers was so exciting to see and fathom. 

I would recommend everyone to try this out with K2 aviation and rest assured you wont be disappointed. The staff is very friendly and flexible at K2 and please do get your Alaska Tour saver coupon book for a flat 20% discount !

Next time it'll be the Grand tour / summit tour !

Dan, our pilot was skilled, knowledgable, and friendly.  He provided great commentary the entire time.  And he was kind enough to take several pictures of us! We were late for our flight due to circumstances beyond our control.  They took all the sweat out of that situation, scheduling us into another flight only 1 hour later!  Terrific!

Wir hatten für unseren Flug ein traumhaftes Wetter erwischt. Wann kann man den Denali und die Alaska Range schon mal ohne Wolken sehen.
Mit K2 hatten wir einen optimalen Partner gefunden dies zu einem einmaligen Erlennis zu machen. Von der Beratung und Buchung im Office über das check in alles professionell, kompetent und freundlich. Flug und Pilot waren perfekt, die Erklärungen sehr gut, so dass wir immer informiert und orientiert waren. Die Gletscherlandung war perfekt.

Alaska era sonho de infância. Parte dele realizado pela K2Avuation. Pessoal super profissionalizado, desde contatos anteriores à viagem até a concretização dela. Durante o vôo o piloto demonstrou muito conhecimento da região tanto geográfica quanto historicamente! Tivemos um dia de sol radiante o que ajudou muito na viagem! Recomendo MUITO!!!

review_title: Amazing experience; could not have been better
review_text: Our flight around Denali was amazing and could not have been better.  Of course the gorgeous weather helped, but the pilot  Will made the trip truly memorable.  Will was an excellent guide pointing out all of the mountains, glaciers and their special stories.  His flying was amazing and it was as if we were floating, not even in a plane.  His calm and quiet confidence made this a very special experience.  Highly recommend!!  My adult daughter and I thoroughly enjoyed the flight.

review_title: Denali flyer tour with glacier landing.
review_text: Amazing, once in a life time view. We were lucky to get a sunny bright day and the sights of the mountain range from the plane are amazing, but the tour de force is the glacier landing and time spent on the glacier (this even after we had hiked on another glacier the day before).
Denali glacier landing from talkeetna was fantastic! Definitely a must do if you find yourself in the adorable Talkeetna tourist town or if you're looking for adventure!

We were lucky enough to have a perfect weather day with only a few clouds. Seeing Denali up close and personal was a thrill.  Landing on Ruth glacier and getting out and walking was a bucket list type experience
We took the tour Denali flyer with glacier landing! Wonderful trip and great memories! All the members of the company were very helpful and very professional!
今天天氣很好，飛行員Mike技術高超，帶我們近距離飽覽麥金利山及其附近山峰及冰河的狀觀風景。我們用Tour Saver免費升級降落冰川，非常值得！

We had a wonderful day the weather was great our pilot was very very nice and the sites were unavailable! if you can take this flight in a good day do not hesitate it is a ounce in a lifetime  experience.

Amazing, not to be missed tour. While we had to wait a day for the weather to clear, it was worth the wait. The pictures say it all, while they do not say enough about the awe-inducing power of Denali. Do not skip this tour.
Unbelievable trip!! Well worth every penny! No photo will do justice!! Found coupon in Alaska TourSaver.

review_title: Flight around Denali and glacier landing
review_text: I was on a K2 flight yesterday which was amazing. K2 is all about customer service and providing the best experience.  It was a trip of a lifetime and will worth the money.
Wonderful experience with knowledgeable pilot. The history of the plane, safety information, and glacial names and information were shared over an hours flight.
I did the Grand Tour with a glacier landing and it was the best part of my vacation to Alaska. The pilot was very knowledgeable and professional.

Ski plane trip around Denali mountain was fabulous then landed on Ruth Glacier. Scenery of mountains and multiple glaciers is vast, surreal & indescribable from above & close up. Took many photos. An experience of a lifetime that was pricey but worth every penny.  Quite awesome.

Had an absolutely wonderful trip with K2 and our awesome pilot Will.  As we were in the runway there was a break in the weather and we were actually able to go and view three mountain.   Will was so knowledgeable and he kept us informed there entire trip.  As a life long Alaskan, I would recommend to everyone, if you only do one thing in Alaska,  this is the trip to do.   Thank you Will and K2.

We were scheduled to fly around Denali but the weather would not allow it.  Instead we flew south to see the Knik Glacier.  Along the way we saw numerous mountain goats and moose.  Had a great time, would definitely recommend.

The folks at K-2 were awesome.  Garret was super and Adam the pilot was extremely knowledgeable.  Flightseeing may seem pricey, but it is worth ever penny!!  We wanted to see Denali, but the weather on the mountain was bad.  K-2 came up with a great alternative.

Absolutely a must do.  I would highly recommend including the glacier landing. What impressed us the most was there customer service. My son was very nervous about flying in a small plane.  He actually backed out right before we boarded so my wife stayed behind with him.  K2 gave us a refund, no questions asked.  They went the extra mile and offered to let my son come back the next day and tour the inside of the planes.  A worker took him out and let him sit in the cock pit of several planes to help ease his nerves if he wanted to attempt to fly again.  

I own my own small business.  I truly appreciate that K2 was honest, caring and truly wanted us to have a great experience.

Enjoyed our flight! We were originally going on the grand tour with a glacier landing but due to weather conditions could not do the landing. K2 refunded the difference and we were still able to see Denali from the air. Worth the money

Rose Marie, our very competent, entertaining pilot flew us up the Tokasitna Glacier near “the Great One”, pointing out climbing routes and even an icefall. We flew on a sunny, blue sky day and I highly recommend this unique perspective on North America’s highest peak. Rose Marie explained how humans freeze at -70 and how trees can grow on top of a glacier— fabulous trip!
Even though weather was not on our site we had an amazing time and saw beautiful glaciers and our pilot was so nice and told us many interesting facts about the area.

I didn't book our flight tour while planning the trip but it was on my bucket list. On our way to Denali we stopped in Talkeetna. Once I saw the k2 aviation building I pulled in the parking lot and asked if they had any flights available for 2 people. They quickly set us up with a trip that was leaving in 30 min. I said I wasn't interested in paying more to land on a glacier, but that was the trip that was going on. They gave us a nice discount and I was sold. Very friendly staff and great service. Our pilot Mike was great. He knew so much about the landscape. He also let me sit in the co-pilot seat. We flew around Denali and got to see the base camps. That was my favorite part because I plan on summiting Denali. It was around a 3.5 hour trip. It was great. My boyfriend and I are back country campers and wilderness EMT's.. we are a little more open to accidents happening so in our opinion always be prepared. Wear proper clothing and have supplies with you for the "just in case" moments.

review_title: Very accommodating staff and great flight
review_text:
The weather was not great and our original flight at 12 30 pmwas cancelled. We asked if it would be possible to get on a later one the same day and the staff did everything to accommodate. We ended up being the first one out to do a valley tour instead of the Denali experience. 
While flying up, Daniel, our pilot, spotted a break in the clouds and managed to break through. We spent almost an hour watching magnificent scenery and were able to go close to Denali.
What an amazing experience which was not supposed to happen that day...!
Thanks to all for making it possible!

K2 helped us out with a last minute charter to fly us up to Murder Lake was two kayaks for a Talkeetna River trip. Our pilot Stan was friendly, knowledgeable, and competent and helped us load our boats in the middle of the lake. We had a wonderful trip - thanks again to the staff at K2 for helping us out when our trip with another charter unexpectedly fell through. It wouldn't have happened without you!

review_title: Amazing flying experience over the glaciers
review_text: We had a knowledgeable pilot who checked in often with the base and showed us the main sights. We couldn't land on the glacier because of weather conditions, but better safe than sorry I say. The staff was friendly and accommodating.

We had eight people in our group, plus two more individuals on the plane, and it was a beautiful sunny day.  Our pilot was very knowledgeable about the area, a wonderful tour guide, and very experienced about the route, the weather, the plane, and answered every question thrown at him!  The glacier landing was fantastic.  To be surrounded by the glorious enormity of the mountains was breathtaking.  We loved every minute.

Flight onto Denali, it was truly amazing! Mike, our pilot was so accommodating, went in between the clouds for us to get a look at Denali and how many people can say they saw the very top of Denali up close and personal. It was a beautiful trip to and from the mountain with excellent commentary on the surrounding mountains, glaciers and rivers.

review_title: K2 Aviation Denali Grand Tour with Glacier Landin
review_text: Absolutely amazing. After 11 days of clouds, rain and even a little snow we woke up to a beautiful clear sky on tour day. We became one of the 30% of people that get to see Denali without clouds. Getting up close and personal with the mountain on the K2 flight made the experience even more amazing. The Glacier landing topped off the experience and made it one of the most awesome days of our lives. Our pilot Mark was great. Thank you Mark

Our family took the flight/hike trip to Moraine Lake! Flying on a float plane was fabulous and the hike provided us with more spectacular views! Our pilot and hiking guide were very friendly and knowledgeable. Seeing Ruth Glacier was truly amazing! We'd highly recommend this trip to anyone visiting Alaska! Thanks for such a special time!!

For a person who always wants the window seat when flying commercially, this is a dream come true! Everyone has a window seat and a view that is beyond imagination. Clouds won't block YOUR view of Denali, because you'll fly above the clouds.
The Summit Tour is at an altitude that makes it important for you to have oxygen, so everything you've ever heard by a flight attendant is put into action. The pilot tells you how to secure your oxygen mask at the right time during your flight. It's totally comfortable.
You do have to step on the scale when you check in at the office of K2, because they wisely balance the plane and give you assigned seats. This was a great time for my husband and me to weigh about the same (even though he's several inches taller than I am!) because there was no question about us getting to sit side-by-side. 
We were blessed with a beautiful, sunny day so making our reservation ahead of time worked out well. Taking this tour on a dreary day might not have been as glorious.
Planning your trip so that you're in Talkeetna for a couple of days could allow you to book a spontaneous flight when you have a perfect day for flying. There are plenty of interesting things to do in Talkeetna. My husband especially appreciated it when I spent more time down at the river taking pictures instead of in all of the sweet shops unloading cash.
Going the extra mile and taking the Summit Tour was worth every dollar that it cost.

I took the grand tour with K2, and was a highlight of my 3 week alaskan vacation.  The team at K2 went above and beyond to reshedule me 2 days early, as weather was coming in.  Not only did they fit me in, but also provided a refund for the difference without me having to ask. The pilot and airplane were top notch, and a detailed safety breifing and explanation of what to expect were given prior to take off, and the pilot was very knowledgable and entertaining during the flight.  The glacier landing was a once in a lifetime event.
This was an amazing tour! We loved seeing the glaciers and got the most amazing, personal view of Denali. We even got engaged up there!!! It was a beautiful experience in an exquisite place.

I have a been a multiple trip passenger with K2 and every trip was a different experience. I have checked their safety record way back in 2015 which is what made me go with them. In fact on of the trips was with my friends and it took 4 days to fly because K2 would not fly because of QUESTIONABLE weather. They finally did get to go on the 4 th day. 
I have been on 7 times going with friends and family who come up to visit because I love it so much and I feel very safe with this company. 
Thank K2 for all of my memories.

review_title: Great Alaska Adventure for the Family
review_text: From the moment we checked in everyone was awesome especially our pilot Chip. He was a great tour guide en route to our glacier landing and I love the PW powered Otter and its performance. The only thing that could have made this trip better was the weather, it was a high broken to overcast and we never got the chance to see Denali, but the glaciers and mountains we did see were amazing! My teenagers absolutely loved the trip.

review_title: Need at least 10 Stars to rate this tour
review_text: You simply MUST take this tour.  After incredible week in AK hiking, fishing, and soaking up breathtaking scenery our first day flying with K-2 was my favorite.  Staff was professional.  Really appreciated morning email alert to potential weather...(earlier in the day glacier landings were not possible) but weather cleared and we were able to land.  They also gave heads up alerting us to longer travel time due to some road construction in area.  Tour:  From the minute you lift off you are in for a treat.....and by the time you reach the peaks you will be spellbound.   Such an up close intimate look at the ridges, the glaciers and peaks.   Humbling to realize not many people ever get this opportunity unless you are part of hiking expedition being flown into base camp.

WOW! An experience of a lifetime. We were booked for the Denali Grand Tour however with limited visibility and weather moving into the area, we were offered the opportunity to do the Flyer Tour.  From the start to the end, I felt comfortable and confident I was flying with an experienced pilot and safety was their main concern. The flight and glacier landing was amazing!!! No words or photo can capture the beauty and grandeur of the area.

Our pilot, Chris, was terrific as were the people at the counter. Landing on the glacier and seeing Denali were the best part of the Alaskan experience. I felt safe and enjoyed that Chris was enthusiastic and knowledgeable. Everything is well run and I would say that this is a must for any trip to Alaska.

K2 was really accommodating. Weather was not flyable on our original date and K2 rebooked us for another date without any problems. Unfortunately on that date we could not do the tour we originally booked (Summit) as there were not enough people, but they tried to still accommodate us and have booked us on Denali Flyer instead, which was amazing. The pilot Adam was great and very skilled and knowledgable, flew us through some amazing spaces and taught us a lot. Totally enjoyed the whole experience, well worth every penny.

review_title: Great views but the weather put a dent in plans
review_text:
We were supposed to fly on to the glacier but the weather didn’t permit this to happen so we just did a flight seeing tour. The tour was fun!

We got a refund for the difference in price from the glacier landing and just the flight seeing tour. The August weather makes it harder for the planes to land on the glacier, due to the rain. It was still an awesome experience! (Make sure you sit in the passenger seat in the cockpit).

I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS!

review_title: Brothers meet for the first time in Alaska.
review_text:
Billy was our pilot on the1959 Bever, after explaining all the safety material we loaded up and were off on a glacier landing thanks to K2 Aviation.    This trip was absolutely beautiful, amazing and a once in a lifetime adventure for all of us.  Nothing compares to the beauty of Denali Park and this trip.   It was the best day of our two week trip and will be remembered forever.  Nate Ryan an EMT from Buffalo NY,  Senior Chief Nicholas Bradford from San Diego and Ian Bradford a laborer from Anchorage.    Snow ball fights and all, just the best of the best!!

Thank you K2 Aviation for making our trip so very special!!   Can’t wait to do this again with you’re company it’s just the best!!!

Susan Bradford 
Anchorage, Alaska

The entuK2 team was friendly and professional. Our pilot was an excellent guide . You can’t come to Alaska without seeing Denali from this view . The Glacier landing was incredible! Thanks for a great memory K2!
On a clear day, there is absolutely no better way to experience the size and scope of  Denali and the surrounding mountain range. It was spectacular!

Once in a lifetime opportunity.  Pilot was seasoned bush pilot. Explained everything we saw and history of area. Beautiful day and unlimited viewing. Landed on Ruth Glacier and spent time soaking in the experience. Well worth money.

I have travelled to a lot of places and done a lot of things (sky diving, white water rafting, bungee, etc) been to europe, asia and south america, I have to say this was the best thing Ive ever done.  Its well worth the money.  You will feel like you are in Star  Wars making a clearing through two 6000 ft mountains of granite before you land on a pristine glacier.  Im so happy the weather worked out for us, the highlight of our Alaska adventure!

I can't say enough good things about this experience. The flight around Denali was outstanding. The views were incredible. The glacier landing was spectacular. I would highly recommend adding the glacier landing to your flight, you won't regret it. Thank you K2 for such a wonderful experience and a lifetime of memories made.

Every seat was a great seat.  Pilot was knowledgeable and provided interesting  information.  We felt very safe and the views were beautiful.  This is great for any age.

This is a very professional organization.  We made a request to change our trip as some bad weather was coming in.  They were very accommodating.  We had elected to do a glacier landing. They provided clean boots for our use.  Unfortunately, the weather came in earlier than expected.  They came and found us to immediately inform us that a glacier landing wouldn't be able to be performed.  We were offered our choice of either a full refund, a partial refund for not being able to do the glacier landing, or opportunity to reschedule to another day.  This company really empowers their staff to provide excellent customer service!

Our pilot gave a really great tour and explanation as we flew. I really learned the most from him. The smaller mountains were beautiful as well and really varied in the flight back.  Well worth the money.
The weather didn't cooperate with the flight plan,  but our pilot, Bill, did a great job flying us around several glaciers and looking for wildlife.

review_title: A Highlight of of Our Alaska Vacation
review_text:
We were traveling with our two young teenage granddaughters and took a K2 Aviation flight through the glacier fields and then on to the airport in Anchorage.  The weather was not conducive to flying around Denali and so we had an up close view of the mountains and glaciers to the  southwest of Talkeetna.

Our plane was their Piper Apache six passenger 300 horsepower that made for a great flight for the four of us and our wonderful pilot Rosemary.  With their headphone set up for everyone, we got a description of what we were seeing and the chance to ask questions.  The girls had never flown in a small general aviation plane and loved the experience.  They had lots of questions for Rosemary about how she became a pilot.  We got a wonderful sightseeing experience and an empowering learning about the learning to be a pilot.

This flight was without a doubt the highlight of our Alaska trip.  The girls rated this better than the Husky puppies at Martin Buser’s and that is saying something.

The two of us did the Denali Experience with the landing.  The entire trip took about one and a half hours.  Luckily, we picked a clear, sunny day.  I had kept an eye on the weather for a few days.  The flight was pretty comfortable.  

During this flight, we flew over two different glaciers including the Ruth Glacier.  Flying between the mountains to get to the landing on Ruth Glacier was awesome.  You get to see the granite mountains up close.

The landing on the Ruth Glacier was surprisingly smooth.  Our pilot, Chris, landed the plane up the glacier and on take off, he went down the glacier.  The snow on the glacier was compact.  And the view of Denali and the other surrounding mountains was wonderful.  I think we spent about 20 minutes on the glacier.

At the beginning of the flight, Chris, asked for a volunteer for the co-pilot position.  Another man and I volunteered.  He took the co-pilot seat on the inbound and I on the outbound.  You may enjoy the seat up front.  I did.

I hope to do this again next year.  We were in Talkeetna for about half a day.  Enjoyable small town with good food and a river park where three glacial rivers come together.  Very enjoyable day!

We had a great time and got some great pictures.  Honestly, the pictures do not do it justice, you have to see it from the air!  Our pilot Billy was incredible and gave us a wonderful explaination of what we were seeing.  This was my families first time in a small plane and I was a little nervous, but it was perfect.

We were so blessed to have a beautiful, clear day to fly up to Denali, see it in all its glory and land on Ruth glacier. K2 was wonderful to work with in every way and we would highly recommend this trip to others.
Awesome experience! Felt safe and the pilot was very knowledgeable and friendly. Recommend this to anyone visiting the area. It’s worth the $!

We just returned from Alaska and our tour with K2 was wonderful.  Our pilot, Mark, did a fantastic job.  We were able to communicate with him and he was very good at explaining everything.  Being so close to Mt Denali was one of the highlights of the trip.  I certainly highly recommend K2!!😄👍👍

review_title: Denali Flying Tour with K2 Aviation
review_text:
Since we didn't see much at the Denali National Park bus tour, we decided to do the flying tour as we were staying in Talkeetna. Let me tell if you haven't done this don't miss the opportunity to do this it is one of the wonders of the world. The sheer beauty and awe inspiring nature so overpowering to see from air which you wouldn't get from walking or hiking. The magnitude of the size of glaciers and the mountains were just incredible. 
The K2 pilot was very knowledgeable and the service was great. Don't miss this opportunity if you can afford it will cost around 240/- USD pp without lading.

Take a flight, any flight over the glaciers and Denali.  My flight did not land, but there are no better views of this treasure of a landscape and National park. Lots of clouds on the mountain, but we saw a spectacular rainbow on our trip.  A little plane of less than 10 seats is the way to see everything.   Mark, our pilot was informative but not too chatty.  He let us just soak in the splendor but so good to answer any questions.  These folks are efficient and professional.

This was the pinnacle (pun intended) of our trip!  What an unexpected thrill!  To get to see the mountains at peak level and above, understand glaciers because you could fly their entire distance and view this Alaskan terrain which can't be accessed any other way....spectacular doesn't describe it.  Of course, weather plays a part and (full disclosure) we had sun and blue skies.
The ride felt safe and was comfortable.  Everyone has access to a window with a view!
This is how to spend your money!

We were disappointed that we didn’t get our flight in the Beaver but the little Piper was a blast. Our pilot, Rose Marie (or Rosemary) was a great guide. She made sure both sides of the plane had a chance to get photos and tried to get a good shot at Denali but the clouds just wouldn’t give up. If we had not had to leave the next day I’m sure we would have gone again. Thank you K2!

review_title: Views like you'll never see from the ground
review_text:
Couldn't have asked for better weather, better flight, or better air tour around Denali and onto the glacier.

The tour adjusts his flight path according to weather conditions.  Our day was sunny, warm, and very little wind.  Our pilot brought us through several passes and close to cliffs that he admitted he doesn't always get a chance to do.  

The pilot's commentary during the flight was excellent, blending in geography, pointing out names of the peaks, history, and details of climbing.  

If you're into photography, bring your wide angle lens for the scenery.  You won't spot wildlife on this tour, but you'll definitely get nice mountain and glacier shots.  All seats are window seats.  If you're traveling with a friend, get opposite sides of the aircraft because some circles of the mountain are better shot from one side of the plane than the other.

We had booked the longer tour but weather didn't permit it. The company was perfect in how they handled it. They were constantly updating us and at pickup we had the option of getting a refund, trying the next day (space available) or getting a refund between what we paid and experiencing what was available. We understood that the weather could have prevented ANY flight the next day so opted to go as scheduled. Patrick was our pilot and he was perfect. We were able to land on the glacier and, because I was on crutches and in an aircast, he lifted me off the plane so I could also experience standing on a glacier. We fly a lot and I honestly think his landings -on the glacier & back at the airport- were the the smoothest I've experienced in 50 years. Another plus was the great driver who picked us up from and returned us to our RV park. Synopsis: Great company, great pilot & shuttle driver, wonderful flight!

the 4 of us went on this   wow wow wow  our pilot  was fantastic   we had a trip we will never ever for get once in a life time trip.    it was a beautiful day.  seeing Denali   landing on glacier Ruth wow .   our pilot explained so much to us.  we stayed on it longer than the 1 1/4 they said we had.   wow it was just the icing on the cake of our trip.  with every thing we did  this was tops  loved it loved it.   do it  don't put it off because it is high price.  go for it  we can't stop telling people what we saw and the beauty from up there looking down.    thank  you  thank you

We scheduled this tour of Denali and upgraded to a glacier landing day before we arrived. They were very accommodating with our upgrade and got us on a later flight. Our pilot Bill was great. He mafe me feel very comfortable with safety measures provided in plane in case of emergency.  He was very informative and always made sure both sides of plane saw the sites. The flight was awesome and just took my breath away. Landing on the glacier was a once in a lifetime experience.  I look up at Denali and can't believe I was so close. I highly recommend this company. They were very attentive to your needs and made you feel safe. I would do it again.

The entire experience was professional, friendly, informative, and FUN. Our Captain, Bill, was informative, safety conscious, and easy to talk to. The deHavillian Beaver We were fortunate to take on our flight was a bonus. Great low and slow aircraft. Love it. Saw so much on our1 hour flight. Do not pass up the chance to take this trip or other services with J2 Aviation.

I never in a million years thought I would do this.  Thought I would cancel.  I put the flight out of my mind and went.  I am so glad I did not miss this completely awesome adventure.  K2 Aviation is so professional, so organized.  Loved the experience.  Loved the journey.  Our pilot Kevin was fantastic, His knowledge of Denali is superior and his calm demeanor is so professional and reassuring.  There were one or two scary moments, but I am so happy I went.  Flew all around the top of Denali and the mountain range and landed on a glacier. Just unbelievable!  Please do not miss this most fabulous of experience when you visit Alasaka!

We did this flight seeing tour and landed on a glacier with a long time friend who was visiting. Awesome experience and friendly staff!  Pilot was personable and weather was awesome!  Highly recommended.

review_title: Awesome glacier landing! Sit on right side for best views
review_text:
K2 was excellent from booking to checking in to the actual flight itself.  We took lots of awesome pictures and videos during the flight and on the glacier.  It was a truly out-of-the-world experience to see the mountains and mountain-top icy landscape up close.

Tips:
1. Volunteer for co-pilot seat for the most amazing experience!  

2. Sit on the right side of the plane for a grand view of Denali, Hunter and Foraker mountains while taking off and landing!

3. Take motion sickness pills before flight as winds at the peaks could be strong.

4. During hot summer days, you can wear shirt sleeve tops.

What can I say, brilliant brilliant activity- Chris amazing job thank you.
Fab service from all the staff and we experienced landing on a Glacier- which was spell binding - thank you

We awoke to cloudy drizzle, so feared we would not be able to do our Glacier Landing flight with K2.  Good news we did fly & Mike our pilot got us a beautiful view of the summit of Denali.  We did not get to land on the glacier, but with the fabulous view of the mountain we were not disappointed.  We spent 60 min. flying & got great views of the glacier with info provided by Mike.  Plane had 6 seats, including the pilot.  We were at 11,500 ft altitude, so it got very chilly.  Recommend wearing layers.  I had on a tank, long sleeved tee, long sleeved fleece & water proof jacket which kept me comfortable.  Also had light gloves, which I did put on at the higher altitudes.  Took pictures with my IPhone that turned out great.  They fly back & forth so both sides of the plane get good views, so you can sit on either side & be assured of good views.  After landing we checked in at the office & one of the staff drove us back to the Lodge to wait for our next trip.  Staff was friendly, welcoming & very efficient.  
Highly recommend K2!

I honestly don’t know where to start except if you’re considering booking or looking between other flights, look no further -Book K2! They were wonderful to work with, easy to set up and this was a once in a lifetime experience.

 I surprised my parents with this Grand Tour with Glacier Landing trip for their retirement and they said it was the best part of our trip. Chris was our pilot and wow! He’s a local Alaskan who’s been flying since he was 15. He knew all kinds of history, geography, made the flight fun and made sure everyone got the spectacular views! 

Our landing on the glacier was breathtaking! The trip was smooth and amazing! Please don’t miss out on this amazing crew and trip! You won’t regret it!

We appreciated the professional and thorough booking process; everything went smoothly for check-in too- very welcoming. The ride was great- worth doing the glacier landing. Our guide Daniel put us at ease and was informative. Thanks K2!

Can't say enough about how professional K2 aviation is.  The  trip up to Denali and views was breath taking. Do everything possible to make a landing on the glacier. A trip to always remember. K2 thumps up👍
What an awesome experience. The flight and views were amazing. Pilot was great and knowledge. Well worth the money.

Sweet little plane, great pilot, Craig, gave us a lot of information about the beautiful glacial patterns we were seeing. Highly recommend the glacial landing - you'll never have a chance like this one!

Words can't describe the experience of a flight seeing trip and glacier landing with K2 Aviation!  The views are something that can only be experienced from the air.  The time spent walking around on the glacier was awe-inspiring.  When you get off the plane, you can't help but be struck by the absolute quiet.  We were lucky enough to hear an avalanche happening somewhere in the mountains while we were on the glacier.  Our pilot, Chris, was great and the entire experience from start to finish was unforgettable.  Terminal is very convenient to everything in Talkeetna.  We wondered if the trip would be worth the money....the answer is a resounding ABSOLUTELY!!

We had a great flight with a great pilot on a beautiful day.  I would do it again in a heartbeat. We did the flight only, not the glacier landing.  Being from Minnesota we didn’t need to walk on more snow.  Great views and the pilot made sure with turns that all passengers got the views.

The flight was awesome and we were able to see some beautiful views! The only problem was our pilot/tour guide (Randy) didn't really tell us what we were looking at. He really seemed put out by having to have passengers. He just wanted to fly. Anyway, one tip I would give to people taking this trip: Bring a map of the flight path so you know what you are looking at.

review_title: Phenomenal Customer Service created the best lemonade out of lemons
review_text: We arrived in Talkeetna with a Summit tour with glacier landing booked. Unfortunately, Denali had other plans, weatherwise, so K2 allowed us to push our reservation to the following night in the hopes things would clear.  As that flight got closer, the mountain started to clear but not quickly enough, so they offered us a valley tour instead, so we could at least get up and see Talkeetna, the rivers, and the glacial landforms. This was our last night in Talkeetna area so we decided to take them up on the offer. The others booked for the flight did not, so it wound up being us and the pilot, Bill. We hopped into a Cesna 185 and after an extensive safety review, headed up. Bill said he wanted to fly and asked if we want to explore a bit - see what we might be able to see. we, of course, said yes, he told the office the flight might be a bit longer and off we went.  He took us up to see if Denali might be peeking out above the low clouds, but she wasn't, and so he went through the holes in the clouds to see what was clear. In the end, we made it all the way up the Ruth Glacier, almost to the amphitheater, and saw bears, moose, amazing glacial forms, and so much more.
