Becuase it was just us and no one else was up there, we were able to circle back when there was something interesting (ice cave, bear, giant ice fissures that have a technical name, ...) and overall just had an amazing personalized tour of the whole. it was far beyond what we expected and truly amazing. Bill was a great pilot - friendly and obviously incredibly competent - we never were nervous on this first small plane experience for both of us - never got sick... it was all in all an unbelievable experience - a memory we will cherish forever.

K2 aviation did an outstanding job on working a flight in during a questionable weather day. Rained the whole day before and part of the morning we wanted to fly. We wanted to do the summit tour but they had too much cloud cover to do that trip but suggested we do the grand circle tour as they were watching a clearing trend. We had a 6:30 pm flight scheduled and were to check in at 6:00 regarding the weather. The west side of the mountain was still too clouded in for them to want to book the grand circle tour as you would be in the clouds all the while on that side. We were given the option to cancel with a full refund, change to tomorrow in hopes of clearing or take the Denali flyer route which had a perfectly clear view of Mt. McKinley, Mt. Foraker and all the other surrounding peaks we opted for that one since you never know how the weather could change, tomorrow it could be totally clouded on. The amount charged was for that route which was less than what we originally signed up for. It’s awesome that a company does what’s best for the visitor not what’s best for the bottom line! 
Don’t go with anyone else these folks are the best we did not do the glacier landing and seeing where they land we do t feel we missed anything. We have been hiking on glaciers seen the blue pools up close and the landing area is not near any pronounced glacial features just a large snowfield.

This trip was my bucket list trip, and it did not disappoint. Our first flight was cancelled due to poor weather, but they found room for us the next day. Weather was great, pilot amazing and the mountains were breathtaking!  We paid extra for a glacier landing, and we're so glad we did. All in all it was an amazing experience.
The weather was great which made this whole experience one of its kind. We created memories for life!

This is mine and my husband's last summer in Alaska and the 15th was our anniversary. the glacier landing ended up being cancelled due to cloud cover but the one hour flight was AMAZING. our pilot was VERY knowledgeable, take off and landing were both smooth, and I couldn't believe how beautiful the mountains are all the way up there. thank you to the friendly staff and pilot.

We had a group of seven with 3 kids 12 and under. The kids got a bit scared (bumpier than they expected but certainly not bad). Kids are kids - it turns into a lot of crying. Our pilot Chris agreed to take us back after about 40 minutes of flying. The cool thing was, they only charged us half price and they fully refunded the poor couple who got stuck with us. Very customer friendly. I’m sure the flight would have been awesome but they knew how to treat a family.

We did the Summit Tour with a glacier landing at the beginning of the month. It was just amazing! I was not sure about the oxygen mask when we booked but there is nothing to worry about. The views of the Alaskan Range are crazy and the glacier landing is an unforgettable experience.

Our 1 hour flightseeing tour of Denali was a spectacular highlight of our trip to Alaska. Our pilot Bill was competent and professional which put us all at ease. And as we approached the mountain the clouds lifted and I think I heard angels singing. Truly a vision. I highly recommend the tour and K2. My only caution is that the airspace gets very crowded on nice days, so don't expect lots of narration as your pilot will need to focus on talking to the traffic to keep everyone safe.

We've done flight-seeing before, but this takes the cake.  This is a must-do if you want to really see Denali in your lifetime.  Nothing compares.  It's so hard to get a good view of Denali.  It's rare that all the conditions are just right.  K2 runs a very organized process and the pilot was extremely professional and knowledgeable.  We highly recommend this. We did the glacier landing and it was absolutely surreal.

Fantastic!
Felt very comfortable with the pilot and plane. Chip was very good about discussing all about the plane before we left. I could tell he was a very experienced pilot and educated person in short order.
The flight was comfortable and the views were spectacular. Chip did a phenomenal job explaining all about the glaciers and the history of the area.

review_title: Don't miss this opportunity to see Denali up close!
review_text:
In July, I did the glacier landing tour. My pilot was excellent. Weather was gorgeous - very clear day and resulting clear views of Denali mountain range. Their shuttle picked me up from my hotel. Very brief wait at the office and quickly got loaded into our 6 passenger plane (7 people, when counting the pilot).

I got to sit in the cockpit on the outbound and the views were simply stunning. Take offs and landings were all smooth and very routine. On the return flight, I swapped seats with another guest so she could enjoy the cockpit views.

Landing on the glacier was great fun and the scenery was unsurpassed for awesome-ness. 

We wore headsets where we could all talk to each other and it mitigated most of the engine noise.

You'll want to be (at least) moderately fit to climb into and off of the plane. If you're used to walking in snow, as I am, then you probably won't need their "loaner boots".

I'm a world traveler and I fly all the time, many types of planes. I felt completely safe in this plan and their pilot was extremely competent and a good narrator.

If you get the chance to take this amazing aero-tour - my strong advice to you is do it!

The staff and our pilot Mark were absolutely wonderful. As soon as we got there we were advised that due to weather we were not going to be able to do the landing portion of our tour. We were kindly offered a full refund or a refund for the landing part of our tour. Since this was our only day in Talkeetna we took the refund for landing and decided to go for the flight experience despite the clouds. Of course we were disappointed we couldn’t land but we understand being safe is more important and the over all flight experience and vistas were absolutely gorgeous!! If we are ever in the Talkeetna/Denali area again in the future we will definitely try for a glacier landing tour again.

Wow, wow, & wow. One of the most amazing experiences I have ever enjoyed.  Start to finish an exceptionally well run organization which resulted in a spectactar trip.  Easy reservation and check in process, our pilot Randy did an amazing job of explaining the route, what we were seeing, names of peaks, glacier history, and other points of interest. Of course I wasn’t surprised to know he was in the US Navy in his younger days as attention to detail was his strong suit.
K2 came well recommended and I can definitely second that opinion.

Our Family had the opportunity to travel with K-2 on a clear day in Alaska recently.  We were able to view the Alaska Range as we traveled towards the Ruth Glacier.  Made a successful landing on the Glacier to view Denali - up close and personal!!!  The reurn trip to Talkeetna gave us an incredible opportunity to view the Glacier as it wound its way back down .  Kevin, our pilot for the morning was extremely knowledgeable about the surrounding area and had excellent piloting skills.  A Bucket List Item that I can now cross off my list!

Highly recommend doing a flight tour with K2!  They were great to work with and have upstanding and fair business practices.  How they approached our tours and rearrangement of them said a lot about them and I would absolutely use them again in the future.  We booked 2 flight excursions with them for mid-June 2018.  One was a sea plane/hiking tour.  The other was the Grand Denali tour w/ glacier landing.  Unfortunately, the sea plane/hike tour was cancelled because of the long winter and the lake had not yet thawed so they could not land and get to the hiking trail.  K2 was excellent in communicating this cancellation to me, explaining why, and refunding our deposit.  The Grand Denali tour w/ glacier landing was also modified.  The weather around Mt. Denali was not ideal for seeing the mountain, surrounding area, or doing a landing.  K2 easily worked with us to reschedule for the next day hoping the weather would get better.  When there still was no change in weather, they offered to give us a full refund or book us on a different flight tour which would go south towards Anchorage/Seward and would include seeing glaciers (but no landing).  They adjusted the price for this modification. The weather was better south.  We opted to do this tour instead and it was fantastic!   Seeing glaciers from the air and flying close to huge mountains was incredible.  The pilot was extremely experienced and narrated our tour with some great information and pointed out landmarks.  On the way back, he managed to catch sight of the very peak of Mt. Denali which had cleared for a few moments and we could see the top!  

A few people in our crew felt a little nauseous during the flight.  If this happens to you, I recommend removing the headset.  You won't be able to hear the pilot, but I found that removing the headset also eliminated the queasy feeling.  I think the headsets push against your ears/temples and can cause some people to feel sick.

We love K2 and are looking forward to coming back to Talkeetna again to hopefully get in the Grand Denali Tour w/ glacier landing next time!

We had a trip  with them.I had such an experience in Nepal but I can not forget it in my life,it is a lifetime experience no doubt.From so near I visited the glacier,oh! amazing.I think it is worth to spend the dollar.The pilot was describing about the glacier very nicely.Many many thanks to my beloved son and daughter-in-law who planned it.

We took the K2 flight service to Ruth glacier landing  to Talkeetna and Denali  aerial tour. I selected K2 after careful research. We selected 11am slot, there was no delay. We had a very experienced Pilot. The landing site was very scenic. The pilot was very knowledgeable and explained everything regarding the mountains and glaciers.  I took about 2 hours overall and spent about 30 minutes on the glacier. It was a very memorable experience.

We definitely had a top 10 day for our flight. It was a beautiful, sunny, clear day and we could see for miles and miles. I also got to be the lucky one to sit in the cockpit! The views were spectacular. We did the Summit tour. Our pilot was laid back, friendly, and informative. This flight was a major highlight on our nearly 3 week visit to Alaska. I would highly recommend!
Even though it was cloudy we were still able to get up and close to a couple of glaciers. The pilot was great.

My wife and I were excited to schedule our air-tour of Denali with a glacier landing.  When we arrived at K2 on the morning of our flight, however, we were told that they could not fly over much of the park due to the weather and suggested that we re-book for that afternoon.  

We were not bothered by the rescheduling and found lots to do in Talkeetna to kill the time.  When we returned in the afternoon, the sales clerk told us that we could not land on the glacier due to weather conditions, but that we could see the "Matanuska Glacier."  Not knowing the area, we agreed to the flight.  We were disappointed not be able to do a glacier-landing, but understood that K2 does not control the weather.

Once in the air, however, we learned for the first time that the Matanuska Glacier was not even part of Denali National Park!  Instead, we made a heading towards Anchorage.  Had we been told that the Matanuska Glacier was not part of DNP, we would have rebooked for another day when we could have seen the park from the air!  My biggest disappoint from our three days in Talkeetna and three days outside of DNP was that we never saw that awesome place from the air, and K2 did a poor job explaining to us that we wouldn't be seeing the park from our flight.  Having spent a large wad of cash on this flight, we could not afford to book another flight over DNP later in our trip.

Moreover, our view from the plane was bad.  Our plane was a dual-engine plane, and we were seated over the engines.  We could not see an unobstructed view of the glacier below us and most of our time on the fight was spent look at the engines.  

In summary, this was a very expensive excursion and lacked the "bang for the buck."

Let me start by saying that our  K2 experience was amazing. The office staff  were pleasant, courteous and very helpful. Our pilot - Dan - I hope I remembered  correctly was the best ! 

My husband and I  were scheduled for a 9 am tour which included a landing on Ruth. Upon checking in the weather for our flight left a question as to whether a landing would be possible.  We were offered a rebooking for a 1 pm flight which we rebooked with ease. K2 kept us informed and updated on our flight status. The day turned out beautiful and off we went.

The flight  ~ Our pilot made certain that no matter where you were seated you got an up close in your face view of Denali - it takes your breath away. The glacier landing was smooth and the views were un matched . Our pilot made himself available to take photos of anyone who was interested - with Denali and the K2 plane as a backdrop - He also provided a great narrative throughout the flight - Important as well he provided a through safety overview before the  tour began.

If you can only do 1 tour this would be it - it was the cherry on the top ! You will never look at Denali the same...

K2 made our trip special. We viewed glaciers, rivers, and saw the big one. The plane was comfortable The glacier landing was much more fun than I imagined— don’t miss it. The pilot provided excellent narration  and answered all of our questions. Their generous refund policy (bad weather) & attention to safety made booking ahead easy. In phone and in person K2 is a delightful outfitter.

What an incredible experience! My husband and I were lucky enough to go on the 'Summit Tour with Glacier Landing,' and it was an experience we won't soon forget. The folks in the office were very knowledgeable in answering our questions. We were concerned about the weather, but they said it changes so frequently and to be patient. Sure enough, about 10 minutes before our check-in the skies opened up, and we were cleared to get up to the summit. Do understand that they can't control the weather but really try to work with you to get you the best option to see Denali. Our pilot (I forget his name) was great as well. Peppered in enough fasts so we knew what was going on but didn't chatter the whole time. He really let us soak in the moment. He also provided one of the smoothest rides!

Very experienced and very professional.  They work with you to get the best experience possible given the ever changing weather.  Book early in your stay as the flight may cancel due to weather and it will give you a chance the next day.

My hub and I signed up for the 1hr flight tour ride without the landing on the glacier. The flight was about an hour late, just like the airlines but the anticipation was overwhelming that we didn't mind it. We went with our friends and met the pilot who was very knowledgeable and gave us a safety briefing of the flight. The flight was amazing as the weather was clear except for a little haze from some fire we couldn't see. It was the best we've seen of Denali with the majestic mountains and glaciers. We liked that the flight was pretty much smooth that taking pictures and videos was easy. It was a great experience which we recommend that you have to see for yourself.

Can't say enough about the whole experience. Booking was easy, check in was fast and the flight was something we will never forget. The staff and Patrick who took us up flying was hands down something we will come back to do again,

Our pilot, Rosemarie, provided a wonderful flight and narration.   She was consistently focused on meeting our needs, answering questions with insightful responses, and proactively providing information about the geology, glacial activity, and history.  The scenery was completely awe-inspiring and captivating.  We're very glad that we did this!

What a great experience seeing the mountains at that altitude, seemingly within arm's reach.  While thick cloud cover on the glacier landing zone kept us from touching down, Pilot Stan had us glued to the windows with his flight route and commentary.  The K2 ground staff were equally proficient and had our accounts credited for the lack of landing, before we even landed back in Talkeetna.   Well worth the investment.

Had an amazing flight and glacier landing with K2 Aviation. Staff was very friendly and the pilot did a great job flying and narrating for us. Everyone gets a window seat and you can even ride in the co-pilot seat. Spectacular views from the glacier landing site.

We were treated well when we arrived and were told that the original tour planned would not be available due to weather moving in. Constantly monitoring the conditions made me feel safe. 
Wonderful views, good photos, narration was informative.  We loved the glacier landing. Just being in among the mountains was spectacular and realizing how large the mountains are. This excursion was worth every penny!

We’ve flown with K2 Aviation before so knew first hand what to expect and they did not disappoint us.  The office staff were pleasant and prompt, our pilot Mike put even the most nervous passenger at ease with a superior safety check prior to boarding and throughout the trip.  He was friendly and very knowledgeable about the history of the area and the mountain itself.  The weather and the memories made celebrating our 28th anniversary were altogether perfect.  Thanks K2 for another amazing flight visiting the Great One.   Elizabeth and Tom

We were so lucky with a wonderfully clear day and had amazing views of Denali. The glacier landing was our favorite part and was stunning! There were views of Denali. Our pilot was friendly and informative. The right side of the plane has better views of Denali if you have the option to choose your seat. We traveled with about ten other people. 

That being said, my husband and I have both decided we are not made to fly in tiny planes. If you have any anxiety around flying or have any propensity for motion sickness, this will not be the most enjoyable. We don’t regret booking this as the views were incredible and glacier landing was unforgettable, but we will never be going on such a tiny plane again.

review_title: Glacier Landing is a Once in a Lifetime Experience!
review_text: I really debated about paying for our family of four to do the flight & glacier landing, but I'm so very glad that we did!  The flight alone is amazing--soaring up into the mountains and seeing them up close is stunning, but landing on the glacier and walking around in the snow is being IN the mountains and it is simply incredible.  We lucked out with a sky blue day and Denali's summit being clearly visible, so it was a magical evening. Our pilot was fun and informative and made it a smooth ride with no airsickness.  We absolutely loved this family adventure & it was the highlight of our Alaska trip!

Sort of a bummer; felt ripped off. Had paid for the glacier landing flight but when we got up there it was too dangerous to land.

Totally understand weather and safety concerns, and appreciate playing it safe, but they only give you a small percentage of your money back, so you end up paying for this expensive flight without getting what you signed up for — the glacier landing.

My husband and I took the Denali Grand Tour flight. We did not do the glacier landing. The flight was awesome! Great views of the basecamps and glaciers. We really felt it was the best thing we had done while in Alaska. Well worth the money.

Fantastic tour and highly recommended! Our pilot (Chip) did an awesome job of flying us around the mountain, landing us on a glacier, and getting us back safe and sound...all while educating us on Denali Park!! Don’t forget you camera!

Our group of 4 booked a 2 hour flight around Mt. Denali with a glacier landing. Our hour of departure was moved from our original early flight to a later flight because of questionable flight conditions.  But then the sun came out and Denali burst out of the clouds! Picture an extraordinarily grand mountain covered with snow, surrounded by equally pretty but smaller snow clad mountains and a bright blue sky. Once in a lifetime experience--both the flight and the glacier landing.  Our guide was knowledgeable and funny, and added greatly to the whole experience.  Highly recommend.

We showed up at 6:15pm and asked if any flights were available. The next flight was at 6:30 and space was available on a piper. It was fantastic and the views were spectacular. Our pilot, Rosemary is a very knowledgeable of the area and an excellent pilot. 2 thumbs up!!

Awesome time. Most unbelievable thing you have ever seen. Pilot was awesome and had tons of knowledge about the area. Was a smooth process from start to finish. Will 100% fly with them again next time we are up this way.
Can’t say anything negative. Beautiful trip and pilot Road Marie was great. It is a must do if weather is clear

Due to bad weather, we couldn't do the Denali flight, but K-2 offered a wonderful substitute where we flew toward the Chugach Mountains and saw the glaciers from above in that beautiful mountain range.  The flight to and from was amazing and our pilot kept us informed of details to note along the way.  You don't fully see Alaska until you see it from above.  K-2 was excellent in all ways....I highly recommend!
The glacier flight was fantastic and our pilot Stan was funny and informative. Great service from beginning to end. A flight experience worth every penny!

Our pilot, Kevin, flew the smoothest flight of my life.  I’ve been a frequent flier on commercial and private jets for 20 years and this was the best flight I’ve ever been on.

The scenery was breathtaking and the glacier landing was amazing.

I was so nervous about this flight....but I had no reason to be.  Completely safe and under control the entire time.

My 3 year old loved it!  She won’t stop talking about it...

What a great experience for the whole family.

Don’t miss this.

The staff was great. The process for checking in seamless. We where able to lock up our backpacks on sight which was very handy. 

The pilot flew the plane in such a way to give both sides ample viewing opportunities. 

He really knew the mountain and was able to talk to us a lot about what we where seeing. 

I would definitely recommend people going to K2!

An Alaskan Must Do.  Stan is the pilot you want.  Even though Denali played peekaboo  with  us it was an awe filling trip.  Stan made every moment special.

thanks!

review_title: Never seen such a beautiful thing
review_text: We took the summit Tour with glacier landing. I have never seen such a beautiful thing. It is expensive but we never regretted it for one moment. What a beautiful sight. One thing is that when we booked this tour the website mentioned a free memorystick with video of the flight but the receptionist was not aware of anything like that.

The Denali Flyer Tour at K2 was rated one of our top activities in our 2 week Alaska adventure.  Once we left the airport in Talkeetna, our pilot was advised some weather was moving in so he modified his flight so we could land on the glacier.  Even though the time was cut short on the glacier, it was AWESOME!!!  To see this part of God's creation, watch other planes land and take off from the glacier was an amazing sight. After taking off from the glacier he tried to climb above the cloud cover to get a glimpse of Mt. Denali but couldn't get a view. You just can't put into words the views you can see from the glacier landing and from the flight around the mountains, it's just an experience you have to see for yourself.

Our pilot, Rosemary was incredible!  We felt great about the quality of the plane and she gave a fantastic history lesson  about the region, Climbers and everyone who supports climbing expeditions.  We highly recommend you use K2 Air to tour the Denali area and ask for Rosemary.  You will not be disappointed!  We had clear blue skies and all our photos are fantastic.  Our weather karma lives on!
Only see Denali 30% of the time because it makes its own weather and we couldn’t see but it was awesome still!!!

We loved our flight with K2 Aviation.   I was quite nervous at first but our Pilot Mark soon put all nerves to rest.    The company are so well organised and safety details explained.  Have no hesitation in recommending this company to see the most beautiful scenery in Denali.

I debated up until the last minute about paying for this excursion. Some friends in Alaska recommend K2 and so did the owner where we were staying so I decided we should give it a go. We wanted to do the glacier landing, but unfortunately the weather would not allow. It was still AMAZING!! I was not disappointed and it was absolutely worth the money. So if you're on the fence, go for it, you will not regret your decision.

It was so fun to fly up to Denali, land on a glacier, and walk around. The views of Denali were amazing, and we got to see the mountains up close, in a way that wouldn't be possible any other way. So cool. Would recommend highly.

Was an amazing experience! We were able to make the summit tour but weather conditions kept us from a glacier landing.The views were breathtaking. Pilot was very informative. A check off the bucket list for sure! Highly recommend K2 Aviation! Thanks!

review_title: Fantastic flight around Danali and Glacier landing
review_text:
We had a great flight around Danali and the other mountains plus a glacier landing and a bit of exploring. As a commercial pilot I appreciated the service and competency of the organization and our pilot. 

Highly recommended.

review_title: Once in a lifetime magnificent view
review_text: K2 offers reasonable price for their services. The staff are friendly and courteous. We booked the Denali Grand Tour with landing, but due to weather downgraded to the Denali Flyer Tour without landing. They also offered a different time/day or full refund as alternative options. Our pilot was easy going, knowledgeable, experienced, and you can tell she has a passion for nature. The glacier and mountain view were magnificent and unforgettable. I have lived in Alaska for several years, and I think flight tour is the best way to appreciate the vastness and power of the land. It's worth every penny. You will not regret this experience.

review_title: Excellent flight with a focus on safety
review_text: Not to be missed. This is the best way to see Denali. You can really appreciate the majesty of the mountain range and Denali from the air.
Breathtaking experience. Our pilot Will was amazing! An initial booking hiccup was handled expeditiously. A short wait and we were provided with an unforgettable view of the Alaskan mountains.

This was my first trip in the air around Denali, and it was really fabulous, not to mention all the breathtaking views.  I am a professional photographer and went up with 3 other photographers, and we all enjoyed it and got some great photos.  Craig the pilot was very informative and willing to turn around to get views on both sides or go back to get a view we missed.  If I am in Alaska again, I would definitely do this ride again, and I would recommend highly to other people

We were supposed to take the grand tour with glacier landing but due to weather conditions on the mountain we took the short blue tour. Our pilot was great. He told us great details about the city of Talkeetna, the three rivers area, the preserve and National Park. We flew over one of the many glaciers, the moose tooth and house mountain. We got to be part of the 30% of visitors to Denali that got to see the summit.  It was beautiful, almost beyond description. It was one of the best flying tours I have taken. It was an almost surreal experience.  I would recommend K2 Aviation and would definitely come back again for my glacier landing.

This tour was recommended by a friend and did not disappoint. Our guide and pilot was knowledgeable, friendly and most accommodating, it was an overall great experience- especially since it was a clear evening and one could actually see Denali.

Until you've experienced this with K2 Aviation you cannot comprehend what seeing and almost touching Denali is all about. K2 treats you as if you are royalty. I highly recommend you do this with K2 and if you're lucky enough to have Daniel as your pilot...BIG BONUS!

review_title: One of the best things we did in Alaska
review_text:
We originally booked the glacier landing and grand Denali tour. The day we were flying, there was a lot of cloud cover and rainy conditions. Coming to Alaska in May, it was about what you would expect. K2 called me immediately that morning and asked if we would like to do a different tour for a discount or try to wait out the weather. We decided to do the different tour (we were short on time). 
The views were still amazing, we did not see Denali, but seeing glaciers from above and the mountains that close was absolutely breathtaking.  We had and absolute blast, and I loved flying in the mountain ranges. It is the only time I'm probably going to be able to do this in my lifetime, and I would never let "not seeing Denali" ruin my fun! 

Thank you K2!

review_title: Best experience we've had in Alaska!
review_text: We come up every year just to hang out and relax.  Decided this year to take this flight.  We should have done it years ago.  Scheduling the flight was easy, the staff was professional and friendly, the facilities are top notch, Dan (our pilot), explained all things about the aircraft and the trip and did a great job telling us about the area over which we were flying.  All-in-all this was just awesome.  Of course it helped that we had an awesome look at Denali (thanks to the weather).  If you can only do one thing while you're here I'd highly recommend K2!!
The weather was great on the day of the tour. The view was breath taking. Unforgettable experience !

What an incredible experience! K2 did an awesome job of being organized, getting the trip going on time and making sure everyone was safe. Our pilot was very knowledgeable about the area and did a great job taking us to the summit of Denali and back safely. I would recommend doing a flight seeing trip over Denali to anyone who is traveling to Alaska!

This is one thing I have been wanting to do for years. After going over all the companies that offer this I selected K2. WOW- did I make the correct choice!  From my reservation (the same day as the flight) to the check-in to the actual flight experience I cannot  find any aspect of my experience that could be improved on. Our pilot (Dan) was perfect. I can’t say enough good things about him.  The company, the pilot and my overall experience rates a 10+

An incredible experience in every way. Our pilot, Kevin, was extremely competent and professional, but also very easygoing and enjoyable. In the top handful of things we've ever done and worth every penny. Highly, highly recommended!

The experience was absolutely amazing! Our pilot Billy was very friendly, funny, and informative! The entire staff was friendly. We had great luck with the weather and got to see Denali summit!... however, after we returned we did hear them cancel/refund a run (very professionally) due to clouds setting in, which in my opinion is good and honest.. rather than taking your money and not getting to see what you came to see. Definitely recommend it! It’s an experience of a lifetime!

review_title: Incredible Denali flight and glacier landing!
review_text: K2 Aviation was a top notch tour of Denali National Park and mountain.  Chris Palm was an excellent pilot and tour guide, extremely knowledgeable.  The views, glacier landing, and overall experience was amazing!

Our planned trip of the Grand Denali tour with glacier landing was canceled due to cloud cover but we were able to go on a shorter flight on the southern side of the range and still got to land on the glacier. Awesome experience to see the mountains so close, walk on a glacier and have Mike, our pilot, give us such great info about the terrain! The southern peak of Denali was above the clouds so we got to see her up close and the beautiful blue waters in the glaciers that we flew over. If you have the means and opportunity to do this, K2 is the way to go. Great staff, safe stable planes and excellent itineraries.

This experience is not to be missed! We were taken through the Alaska Mt range, over glaciers, close to Mt Denali. A wonderful 1 1/2 hr flight. Our pilot was very confident and gentle. We felt safe and were in total awe of the snow capped mountains, clouds, glaciers, etc. Shout out to our enthusiastic pilot, Will!

we booked this as part of our Princess land/sea tour (land portion). It was our first excursion and I was nervous about the small plane but it was wonderful. Our pilot gave a really great tour/explanation as we flew. I really learned the most from him than I did on any later excursions. We were lucky to have amazing clear views of Denali as we circled the summit. I also really enjoyed the flight back--the smaller mountains were beautiful as well and really varied.

Our pre-teen nephew was visiting for the first time. We planned a seaplane flight around Denali with a landing on a glacial lake and hiking,  but weather didn't cooperate.  K2 suggested several options for our limited timeframe and we opted for a 2.5 hr trip to Knik Glacier. It didn't disappoint.  Knowledgeable and skilled pilot, friendly staff. Loved that our nephew got to sit in the copilots seat! Amazing views.
一次精彩的空中体验飞行。阿拉斯加雪山，从塔基纳出发，乘坐观光小飞机飞越德纳里国家公园上空，可以俯瞰雪山冰原和冰川，阿拉斯加这遍神奇土地就在你的脚下，无限精彩在你眼前象一幅水墨画一样延伸展开。

Flying over Denali in a tiny plane was my husband’s dream - not mine! I was terrified but trying to support his dream trip. I have to say I was immediately put at ease when we walked in. The whole operation was super professional. 

You are weighed when you check in but no one sees your weight except the person behind the desk. It seemed clear and sunny but they told us that they couldn’t do a glacier landing, which we signed up for, bc the fresh snow made it too bright/hard to land. I appreciated that safety was clearly the number one priority, and bc this was our only day on Talkeetna they refunded us the glacier landing portion.

Our pilot was great. He went over safety precautions and was super knowledgeable. I learned even more about glaciers. The flight was smooth and the views were incredible.

I was nervous but K2 totally put me at ease and they were incredible professional. I highly recommend!

We had scheduled the grand tour with glacier landing, but weather was not cooperating.  They offered us a different route viewing glaciers.  Disappointed, we decided to give the alternate a try.  Very glad we did.  Our pilot, Dan was exceptional.  Awe inspiring views.  Very happy with flight.

We had an amazing time on the tour. Our pilot was great! She had vast knowledge of Denali and the surroundings. She was a excellent pilot and tour guide! If we ever make it back we will defiantly be taking the flight again!

The weather did not cooperate with the plans we made to have a glacier landing, but the staff worked with us to come up with another world class experience.  K2 is first class and provided my son and me with lifetime memories.

review_title: Tour chosen cancelled and unable to reschedule
review_text:
I booked this several months ago by calling because I had several questions and was worried about the weather. I was TOLD to make my tour at 11 because weather is usually good and if not they could reschedule us later that day. I explained this was our last day I. The area and she assured me that they would be able to move us to a later flight. Well today on this beautiful sunny day, we only could take the blue tour because of clouds and no glacier landing as we desired. We asked to book to later that day as I was told and the guy was like we have nothing because your a party of 5. I as well as the people with me were very aggravated that they did nothing to try and split us up or show any remorse or sorry nothing just willingly gave us a refund. I was later told by a local that 70% of those tours get cancelled because of weather so never bank on seeing Denali or the glacier. There were several groups with kids very upset. I think if they can send an email the night before as a reminder, an email to call because of weather or let you know in advance it was cancelled could have saved us 3 hrs to do something else beside driving there and back. 

I think what was the biggest aggravation it was ok the customers were not happy and just refund the money, as we were told while making reservations we could catch the later flights with no issues. Poor customer service

review_title: Denali!!! Glacier landing!!! What more is there to say?
review_text: K2 is professionally run, we had an amazing pilot and all around perfect experience.  Would like to thank K2 for ordering us a clear perfect day as well.  Felt 1000% safe and the experience was absolutely awesome!!!  I would give it a higher rating if I could.

My husband, myself and our friends took the K2 Flight Discovery Tour around Mt Denali.  It was the best thing we did in our 12 day cruise and land tour.  The beauty of what I saw brought tears to my eyes.  We all were in awe of the scenery.  I will never forget it.  Will, our pilot, was great in explaining where we were, what we were seeing and in flying the plane.  Our flight was so smooth, I was never scared.  It lasted a little over an hour.  I highly recommend doing this, you will not regret it.  Well worth the money.

well run, I am a former pilot, the briefing on flight safety & in air practice was detailed, The pilot had a wealth of range information on the Denali range , Took time to show the base camp as well as give some in depth information about the climbers & how camp functioned
Fantastic flight around Mt Denali. The pilot really knew his stuff both in skill and history. Great views of the glaciers and mountains, even saw bear tracks on the mountain. Awesome afternoon.

I had booked a flightseeing tour online, and contacted the company with a few questions first. They were very responsive and helpful, and the online booking was easy. Upon arrival, weather was uncooperative, and K2 kept me updated on changes to our flight plan... I had initially booked a 2 hour flight with glacier landing, but we had to cut that to a one-hour flight with no landing due to winds at elevation. Appreciated the safety concerns, and they immediately refunded a portion of my payment accordingly. The pilot was knowledgeable and friendly, and even though it was overcast, the views were great! Would highly recommend!

review_title: K2 Mt Denali flight and Glacier landing
review_text:
Great trip. Skillful pilot, gave lots of commentary. Showed us base camp and 11 000ft camp. The stillness of the glacier was only broken by the sound of an avalanche. Spectacular to see. 

Expensive but the rewards more than cover the cost. A MUST DO

user_location: Rapid City, South Dakota, United States
review_text: So glad I experienced this up close,unique view of Denali. Booked the Glacier landing tour but weather didn't allow a landing. Pilot extended the flight time to make up for it,plus company refunded us the extra amount paid for the Glacier landing.Wasntold they seldom are able to land on the glacier,but it was still amazing.

I must admit at first I was surprised at how much the flight cost but it was worth every penny. This is definitely a once in a lifetime experience. The views are unforgettable and we had perfect weather for our flight. Our pilot billy was very knowledgeable not only about Denali but all of Alaska. He could teach a college level course on the state. On our return flight we even saw a moose grazing in one of the pastures. One thing I would recommend if you buy something in the gift shop. I bought a T-shirt and hat combo and didn’t unwrap the shirt from the rubber band when I bought it. I went to put on the shirt today back here in Texas and the writing on the shirt is completely crooked and all the way to one side.

June 13th 2018 1pm  We were lucky to have a beautiful clear day. The pilot was Patrick, he was very down to earth. We felt safe, and the take off and landing were smooth as silk. It was unbelievable to fly so close to the mountaintop and well worth the cost to land on the glacier. It will be a wonderful memory, so glad we did this.Went with K2 because of yheir great reviews. An excellent experience!Thank you Patrick and K2!

My husband and I signed up for this flight seeing tour as part of our Alaskan tour/cruise vacation. It was recommended by others and the price was reasonable.
Pros: Clean, well maintained aircraft. Professional pilots and ground crew. Established flight routes offering unparalleled sights of some of the most remote areas in Denali National Park and Alaska Range. Flexibility to adjust tour based on constantly changing weather conditions (see cons). Well supplied gift shop with reasonably priced offerings of hats, shirts, pullovers, videos and patches/stickers. K2 offered us a refund for the flight we were unable to complete. They also offered an alternate tour operating at lower altitudes, refunding the difference from the original tour. We accepted the latter. 
Regardless of tour selected, it is difficult to imagine not having a phenomenal time. We really enjoyed the glacier tour since the Denali Flyer was cancelled due to bad weather up near the summit.
Cons: Constantly changing weather conditions may make your desired flight tour unavailable at times.
Small office/waiting room/gift shop. It’s Alaska, so Mosquitos...

Took a flight to land on the Ruth Glacier. It was absolutely BREATHTAKING. Our pilot Mike pointed out the landscape as he flew and helped ease my mind as I was admittedly a little nervous about flying in a small plane over the mountains! But it was amazing. Who can say they landed on a glacier?!? We can! My 14 year old daughter had a blast as Mike let her ride in the co-pilot seat on the way out. Highly recommend this company if you are in the Denali area and want to see beauty!!!!
Great flight. Denali stayed hidden but, what else is new. All the rest was nothing short of awesome.

The flight was very cool! Definitely a very humbling and awe inspiring experience. We flew with Daniel who was funny and well-versed in the art of flying as well as the Alaskan geography. The flight was smooth and safe and the pilot made sure both sides of the plane got excellent views of the majestic mountain! Definitely recommend this flight tour.

WAY AWESOME!!! Stan was a great pilot, fun and full of info! So cool to see the snow covered mountains, the climber's base camp and even an avalanche! Great service and #1 excursion we did. Highly recommend this company.

The view is glorious and the landing on the glacier is something we truly were amazed by  it. 
The pilot was very friendly and was able to tell you about the mountains with all their names.
Our first fight was cancelled but they were able to work us in an available one.
Everyone going that way should take one of these flights.
Next to seeing my kids born and marrying my wife,the most amazing thing I've ever done. Would definitely recommend and can't wait to go again when my kids get old enough

Viewing Denali this way is just remarkable, no way to explain what you see except to say you just need to experience it, with the glacier landing. You will never forget it. I'm now rating the tour experience with K2.  The office staff were friendly, and made sure all questions were answered before boarding. They were fully booked in the morning, if you go try an afternoon tour if you are able, most of the clouds will be burned away and your views will be incredible. The pilot and guide was patient with all of the questions and a fully loaded plane. His knowledge of landmarks and Denali were excellent, and he gave what I felt was a little extra in the way of making sure we were comfortable and safe. I would recommend them to anyone.
This is something everyone should do. K2 was the best! This is spectacular and we made some lifetime memories. I would highly recommend k2!

It was amazing! Our flight took us through the mountains and we were lucky enough to see Mt McKinley and land on Ruth Glacier! It was breathtaking and a must do if you are visiting Talkeetna! Suzanne, thank you so much for this experience, it was one I will never forget! Many thanks to our pilot Patrick as well, who was a fabulous tour guide!

We were very lucky that when we traveled to Denali we had clear sky's and a great view of the mountain.  Our reservation was for another day, but we called and the K2 staff were flexible to get us up early to see the mountain given the clear sky's.  Our pilot, Jason was great!  There are other aviation companies, but you will not be disappointed with K2! I even purchased a hoodie that I wore the entire trip to Alaska!

We decided to do this at the last minute through our cruise tour and we are so glad that we did!  Pick up and registration was quick and efficient. We were boarding our plane before the boys even finished their game of cornhole!  Our pilot, Craig, was fabulous. He was really knowledgeable about the geography and history of the area and passed on so much interesting information. We expected to simply fly over the mountains and glaciers but to our surprise and amazement, we flew much closer to the landscape. The views will forever be imprinted in our memories. We walked away feeling like we were able to view this mountain range is a special way. We are so glad we chose to do this!!

This was by far the most amazing excursion we have ever been on!  We did a flightseeing trip around Denali and then landed on the Ruth Glacier.  It didn’t hurt that Denali was showing all of her glory on the day we took this trip!  Our pilot was very professional, and the love he has for what he does came through resoundingly.  If you go to Talkeetna, make this a priority!
Fantastic! Our pilot Chris was very knowledgeable of mountains, wildlife, rivers, climbing trails etc. So much better then expected. Highly recommend. This is the only way to see Denali.

We arrived at McKinley resort and were greeted by an amazing sight of Denali with clear blue skies. So we took advantage of the opportunity to book a Denali flight experience with glacier landing. K2 was very accommodating and got us on an earlier flight than we booked. Dave, the pilot, was an excellent host and guide. Very informative commentary. The flight was amazing with panoramic views and close ups of the mountains and glaciers. We landed on a glacier and spent maybe 20 minutes taking in the incredible view. If you are lucky enough to have a clear day, then this is a MUST do!

If you go to Alaska and you don’t take a flightseeing tour of Denali and land on a glacier, you just missed the experience of a lifetime.  

K2 Aviation was a pleasure to deal with.  
Take the tour and land on a glacier.

We were booked for the Summit Flight to Denali (formerly Mt McKinley). When we arrived at K2 Aviation, we were told that Denali was cloudy and we could not go to the summit. The girl then said she would refund our tour money or we could go on another flight and be refunded the difference. Of course, we wanted to fly so we took the other tour. Well, it was excellent! We flew over mountains, in valleys and saw the beautiful scenery of Alaska from the air. Kevin was our excellent pilot/guide and he was great!! Very professional and explained everything in detail especially when we had questions. I would highly recommend K2 Aviation to see Alaska from the air!

review_title: Flight to Denali and Landing on a Glacier
review_text: Great flight provided by K2 and Randy our pilot. Very professional and an outstanding experience. Would highly recommend the trip and K2.
We had a beautiful, calm, sunny day to see Denali, and what a wonderful experience!! Our pilot Daniel was so skilled and personable! A must-do when in Alaska!!
We decided the day before to add this to our Alaskan Adventure. It was a wonderful trip, friendly informative pilot. Beautiful view!

K2 provided an amazing experience flying in Denali. Our pilot and guide, Daniel, was phenomenal! We flew around the many peaks of the Alaska range in comfort as Daniel pointed out many interesting features. The glacier landing tour is easily the highlight of any Alaska vacation and I am very happy that I chose to go with K2!

After  a rainy week in Alaska, we ended up in Talkeetna on a sunny and relatively clear day and decided to do a flight tour to take advantage of the weather.  We inquired about tours around 4 pm and they were able to get us on a flight at 6:30.  You simply cannot appreciate the scale of the Alaskan range from the viewpoints in Talkeetna or along the highway heading up to Denali NP. It's a whole new perspective from above and the views really are amazing.  We happened to get a clear view of Denali but even if you don't, you'll see many glaciers and peaks and the pilot was well informed and shared a lot of information about the park and what we were seeing.  After a week of rain and overcast skies, we finally felt like we saw Alaska on this tour.

The K2 Avaition flight was amazing! The weather was perfect and the skies were nearly clear. The views are the best I ever experienced. The pilot and staff were very professional and polite. I will recommend this to everyone I know visiting Alaska. Thanks for the great flight and glacier landing!
K2 out of Talkeetna is excellent. The glacier flight is top notch and the pilot, Billy, is friendly and very knowledgeable.

After having taken a Denali flight in 2001, I decided I wanted to do a repeat flight out of Talkeetna on my recent visit to Anchorage, Alaska for an airport conference.  With the low ceilings and limited visibility, I decided to wait it out a day for the weather to improve.  On day 2 of my visit to Talkeetna, I decided to sign up for a flight in the early afternoon.  The pilot on my flight was from Alaska and a seasoned pilot that knew the area very well and knew how to read the weather.  We departed Talkeetna in a turbine De Havilland Otter with low ceilings, limited visibility and showers.  This weather was in sharp contrast to my first experience.  The pilot did an exellent job navigating up some of the glacier valleys that were obscured by the limited visibility, but as a pilot myself, I always felt safe and comfortable.  He gave the other passengers and me a good sightseeing ride for about an hour plus fifteen minutes. The pilot also did a great job pointing out significant landmarks and telling us about the history of the area.  I'd highly recommend a flight with K2 Aviation!

We couldn't do the glacier landing due to the weather, so our pilot, Chris, decided showed us the spots that were well visible. Chris also told us a lot about the area and was it was an extremely smooth flight for such a small plane (10 people including pilot). All in all, a great experience even though not as planned and everything went very smooth and easy with K2, all very professional and super friendly.
We really enjoyed the experience, it was well worth the time and money.  Great experienced pilot :)  I enjoyed seeing Denali from a different view.  Thank you k2

review_title: Snow at 5K' but we still had a great tour
review_text:
Our Otter held 10 passengers and one pilot.   The Mountain began snowing at 5,000ft as we approached.  Our guide was excellent, taking us inside the Ruth Glacier until the snow began in earnest.   The pilot was careful to make sure everyone aboard saw the same significant features.  Because we were unable to complete the full tour K2 deeply discounted the price but the time aloft as about the same.  Interestingly, a bush pilot competition was going on that day and we watched an event to see who could make the shortest landing and takeoff.  Others in our group flew in a small plane that held three people.   Regardless, we all had seats that are able to get excellent views and photographs.  I'd fly with K2 again if in the area.  Our pilot had been flying since 1973 and the Otter was recently reconditioned.

As was our luck, we were able to get a clear view of Denali, sixty miles away, while touring Denali Ntl Prk. following morning.

review_title: Grand Tour around Denali with Glacier landing
review_text:
K2 is the very best.......they are honest, provide get service and put safety first. We were blessed with a very clear morning and saw everything Denali had to offer.
We landed on the Glacier and were starting to get off the plane. Patrick, our pilot told us to get back in the plane and that he did not like what he was starting to see. We were back in, belts on, Patrick had the hammer down to take off and with in seconds the fog rolled in and the visibility was 0. 
Treat yourself to a safe and beautiful flight.........
Doug and Rose

When we arrived at K2 we were disappointed to learn that because of low cloud and changeable weather conditions we would not be able to land on the glacier. We were given a range of options and decided to go on the Denali Flyer.
 It was the best decision we have made as the flight under pilot Randy was the smoothest ever and his expert skills enabled us to see all the major glaciers while flying above and below cloud and what seemed right next to sheer cliff faces. We even caught views of the mighty Mount Denali.

review_title: Great, eventhough the tour was shorter than planned
review_text:
because the weather wasn't complying, I did get the chance do to the whole tour I had signed up for. K2 told me to come back a bit later to see if the weather improved enough to be able to fly. When I came back the weather was slightly better but not enough to do the originally chosen tour. K2 offered a choice between a refund or taking another tour and refunding me the difference. I chose to fly and didn't regret it.

Pilot was good and funny.
The views eventhough the weather was not perfect were still absolutely spectacular.
Really worth it.

Worth every penny! We chose the “Denali flyer with glacier landing”. On our flight day, there wasn’t enough visibility to do the whole trip or the glacier landing, so they refunded us to the basic package, and we got a shorter flight. Our flight was amazing!! Truly a once in a lifetime experience. I was nervous beforehand but our pilot was so skilled, the take off and landing were so smooth. The was also a great tour guide and told us lots of interesting things. 

We were on a land tour with Princess, but we booked the flight directly with k2, which was much cheaper than booking through Princess.

We weren’t able to land or see Denali like we planned, because the weather wasn’t cooperating, but the tour we took was amazing!  Our pilot, Randy, was very informed on the glaciers, the topography, the climbers and the history.  The ride was smooth and the views stunning.  We saw a couple base camps, many of the climbers were in town waiting to get out...like the tours, problems to safely land.  The K2 staff was great to deal with, gave us the option of full refund if we didn’t want to go, or of course a reduced rate for trip we were able to take.  I’m glad we did!  Their office and airport is walking distance from Talkteeba town, where we stayed, but I also noticed K2 vans brining their customers back and forth too.

I have flown twice with K2, once in 2009 flying to and from Base Camp for a Denali climb, and a second time in May 2018 flight-seeing over the Ruth Glacier. Both trips provided outstanding views. During our recent trip the Pilot was very knowledgeable about glacial formation and features on the landscape. Denali is a unique mountain, and flight-seeing with K2 is a unique way to view it.

My father, my self and my nephew did a glacier landing tour while visiting Alaska this week.  We were completely blown away by how wonderful this experience was.  We expected it would be cool but we didn’t know how cool until we were standing on Ruth Glacier! It was awesome!! Our guide, Chris was a wealth of information which enhanced our experience that much more.  If you are visiting Alaska and you are at home on the good old internet doing your research and trying to decide if spending the money on this is worth it... the answer is yes!!! Eat noodles and sleep in a tent if you have to but do this adventure and definitely go all the way and land in the glacier!!! I promise you won’t regret it!
What a wonderful experience!  Everyone at K2 Aviation was friendly, helpful, and professional.  The views were amazing and we enjoyed every minute!
We visited K2 on a bad weather day but the staff is super nice and took our kids to see the flights. They are awesome staff. We will defiantly come back and fly with them. Thank you for your service

Spectacular memorable experience. K2 is top notch and everything smooth — and safety utmost concern. Our pilot Stan had over 25 years experience with this route and took us on breathtaking views of Denali and surrounding glaciers and mountains. Gave  us some history, geographical info, pointed out sights, answered all questions and gave us time for peaceful contemplation of the almost mystical landscape. All aspects of trip were seamless from booking, responsiveness to questions, check in, boarding and the trip itself. Never had a smoother take off and landing. Felt completely safe and if good hands. Not to be missed!!!

I use K2 professionally for work in the AK Range. And when it comes to outfitting my personal trips to climb in these mountains, K2 goes above and beyond to provide top notch service, an unmatched personal treatment and reassures my belief they're the best! Hands down the best choice for safety, professionalism, customer care... Oh, did l say their pilots are ALSO suuuuuper nice? Fly with K2!

review_title: Epic - The Highlight of our Alaska Trip
review_text:
Words hardly do justice to the surreal experience delivered by the K2 team. Our family of four absolutely rank our K2 Denali air tour to be our absolute best Alaska experience. 

We arrived in the mid afternoon and within 30 minutes, we were in the air. Our pilot was so friendly and professional - I had zero concerns about our safety. The tour itself was just so amazing! The views just can't be duplicated. I still can't wait to tell someone new about the experience.

I think if you're traveling all the way to Alaska (1,800 miles for us), why wouldn't you spend just a little more money to take a K2 scenic flight that you'll talk about forever? I am thrilled that my teenage kids get to reflect back on the incredible experience for the rest of their lives. Thanks, K2!!

This was a great experience from start to finish, starting with quick responses to initial enquiries, preflight contacts and information, safety briefing and the engagement of an experienced pilot with us all constantly explaining the scenic area and easing any concerns we may have had as we flew over the most daunting and majestic mountains and glaciers. 
The planes were very clean and well maintained, very powerful and ideal for the type of work expected of them to fly in mountain terrain.  Windows were very clean enabling surprisingly good photography.
The history of the area was well explained as we flew. Although we did not manage a glacial landing due to cloud conditions, the whole experience was exceptional.It would be one of the best experiences we had in our 3 weeks in Alaska. April, often seen as not a good time to be in Alaska due to the melting snow, actually was really good as the day light hours are long, the landscape is still well covered in snow, the lakes and rivers are largely still iced over, but thawing and there were no mosquitos yet to worry about!
Great experience and very much recommend.

All of the staff were very friendly including each and every office person.  The rampers were friendly and helpful in organizing our gear for a remote spring Alaska adventure in Denali Park.   Pilots were conservative, attentive, experienced, and took pride in their skill.  Staff was informative.  Need to improve on giving consistent, clear, and accurate information, for example we were given two different times for pickup in our remote location and confusing information about what to do if weather delayed our pickup.

In 2012 my family flew with K2. This was a life impacting flight. Yesterday I flew around Denali and landed on the Ruth Glacier.  Kevin, the pilot, everyone at the office, and the guests on the Otter made this an unforgettable experience.  K2 is the group to fly with every time!

review_title: A trip worthy of your bucket list!
review_text:
Absolutely impossible to describe the shear beauty and vastness of God's great creation!
Wow, wow, wow!!!!
Must do!
Great company, very mindful of safety (weather conditions rule!), awesome experience!

*Fun
*Friendly pilot and office staff
*Great views of the mountain ranges and surrounding areas
*informative and educational trip
Mt Denali (Mt McKinley) Glacier landing trip.  乘著小飛機在空中翱翔在冰河上盤旋。降落冰河後反而成了我的包機，其他乘客都下去（建房子去了）景觀秀麗雄偉，我個人是人生必遊之處。the view is gorgeous, I personally think this is a must do trip in our life.
Wow wow wow wow.  This is a North American bucket list item for sure.  Watched the weather all week and got a million dollar view.  So glad we did this!

review_title: Denali Flight!!  You won’t soon forget...😊
review_text: In May, I took the opportunity to take a flight up into the Alaska Range with K2 Aviation.  Wow!  We have some of the best pilots in the world here in Alaska and Barry (our pilot) surely didn’t disappoint us. These pilots here are consummate pros.  Words don’t do these flights justice, the way even great photographs don’t do Alaska justice.  About the best description I can think of is that you will NEVER forget the visual overload and truly  awesome views on the enjoyable (understated) flight.  This is a Must Do on your trip to Alaska. Again, a flight you won’t soon forget!!!

Did a tour in the winter. The crew prioritized safety and enjoyment by altering the tour as needed for wind/turbulence. They informed us as soon as we arrived of the conditions so we'd be prepared. Our pilot, Dallas, was clearly an expert at what he does, meticulous, and has a very enjoyable demeanor, explaining interesting things about the area during the flight. 100% satisfied.

We verbleven een nacht in deze plaats en kwamen langs het kleine schattige vliegveldje met de rode vliegtuigen. 
Er was weinig te doen in de vroege morgen, maar wat een leuke en fotogenieke omgeving. 
Er is een restaurant bij en een kleine speeltuin voor kinderen. 
Maar het leukste blijft natuurlijk om zelf op te stijgen...

While staying in Talkeetna wanted to make sure we were able to take advantage of an air tour.  Boy sure glad we did.  Our tour guide recommended this company.  From start to finish was beyond amazing experience.  Weather was perfect no clouds or heavy winds.  Can't even begin to describe the beautiful amazing vistas and views.  Truly the only way to see all of Denali is up in the air.  Loved our pilot he was very informative.  Expensive yes but the only way to see it all.  Trip of a life time.
Great time. Pilot was friendly knowledgeable  greatest his job. Flight was comfortable. Office staff was spot on with the pilot.  Highly recommended.

I will start with safety is very important to this company.  We origionally had a tour with a glacier landing booked, but the weather was not cooperative.  We had to reschedule for a different day.  When we did go on our tour, it was amazing.  Great pilot, very nice planes, wonderful views.  The flight was very smooth, no issue with motion sickness, as my husband can be prone to it.  The pilot was very informative, and explained what we were seeing.  If you truly would like to experience Denali, book a flight tour with this company.  Our time on this tour was definitely one of the highlights while on our trip in Alaska!

review_title: Pessoas simpáticas e voo tranquilo!! Profissionais!
review_text:
O voo foi extremamente tranquilo, as advertências e explicações foram dadas antes do embarque.
Durante todo voo o piloto nos dava explicação e respondia às perguntas feita.

review_title: Pilot was great, the way the seating was handled not so great
review_text: We booked this nearly a year in advance for 5 of us.  The pilot was top notch and the views were amazing.  My little one (very use to flying) had some ear issues and he tried his best to alleviate them on our decent.  I was a bit disappointed because we weren't able to land; however being safe is most important.  The one thing that I didn't like is that we rode with another family who made sure they got right in the front and when the pilot announced that someone could sit in the co-pilot seat, I spoke up stating that my husband would really love to do that, yet the man in the other family went straight up there and sat down- HOW RUDE!  Their child also kept looking back at my daughter who was having ear issues.  I don't know when they booked, but perhaps they should have some sort of policy based on when you book as to who gets to do something special like that, or, if it is safe, let one person do it going up and another going back down.  I felt really bad for my husband and wanted to tell the other people off, but of course, would never do so in front of my daughter.

No words or pictures can summarize just how amazing this experience was! If your visiting Alaska and looking for things to see/do don't hesitate on this one because of the price. This is an absolute must do and worth every penny!

review_title: Denali is an incredible sight and K2’s crew were excellent.
review_text: We had beautiful weather and a smooth flight. Chris, the pilot, was clear and informative. And the mountain is incredible.

review_title: To see Alaska from a whole new perspective...
review_text:
To be able to see and understand how big Alaska is, you need to go on a flightseeing tour. Up in the air you realize truly how small you are in this world and how Denali Park area’s landscape was formed is much better understood from the air. We were in a 1950s Havilland plane, total of 8 passengers. We all had headsets and our pilot gave us a nice overview of Talkeetna, Denali Park, how the Alaska Range and glaciers came to be, etc. Although we couldn’t see Denali or land on a glacier it was an awesome opportunity to see mountains and glaciers up close. It was awe inspiring. Do it, go, you won’t regret it. 
By the way, if you forget sunglasses there are some for you to borrow at the check in office. Also, don’t bring anything into the plane besides your camera and sunglasses. They are pretty strict about the quantity and weight of things you bring on board.

Very friendly staff and knowledgeable pilot.   Our original booking was cancelled due to fresh snow preventing the landing on the glacier.  The Cruise Line just canceled and offered us no explanation.    We were walking in town and saw the K2 sign.  Went in and asked a few questions.  They explained then booked us on a different flight.   Awesome time!!!   Saw peak of Denali, then down into valleys and followed the glaciers.   Well worth it and one of the highlights of our time in Alaska.

review_title: Awesome views, smooth ride, great guide
review_text: Chris clearly has some time under his belt. His flying was smooth even on a cloudy cold day. His knowledge of the area was impressive, and his commentary was great. The company was very fair on price and really looked out for us when it came to value.

We selected K2 for our Denali experience, and have no regrets at all. Chris was a great pilot, shared a lot of interesting information during the flight, and then gave us a smooth landing on Ruth Glacier. Spending time on the glacier was the absolute highlight of our trip and the best experience of my life. Everything about the trip with K2 was perfect. If you want to visit Denali, forget looking anywhere else and just book with K2!!!

review_title: The most exhilarating breathtaking experience ever!
review_text: Seeing Mt. Denali was an awe inspiring breathtaking experience.. I have seen many a places in my life time but seeing Mt. Denali with K2 aviation was the best ever! The folks from K2 were super friendly and they served coffee/tea to get us comfortable before the flight. Chris our pilot was super friendly and very knowledgeable about glaciers and the peaks around Mt. Denali. Every question that we asked was answered by Chris.. All in all a truly phenomenal experience!! K2 is highly recommended.

The pilot was nice and informative. However, I was bit disappointed because the weather was not that great. However, they showed us video of snow mountains that we would see   just before the flight. We purchased the trip and when we go up we didn't see any snow mountains at all. We saw green mountains of denali national park. This kind of view one can get from regular plan. We spent $200 to see this ? I would have appreciated if canceled the flight or told us upfront that we WON'T see snow mountains. When I talked to the lady there she was not responsive. I am sure they have good trips when whether is nice but there is no need to give us trips that are worth it.

This made the whole trip to Alaska worth it all ! It was the best time I have ever had, the staff at k2 was wonderful. Our pilot "chip" was very professional and extremely informative ! It was a pleasure flying next to him ! If you have the opportunity to ride co pilot , take it ! Recommend this for anyone wanting an up close view of a amazing mountain !

This was nice. We originally booked the longer, higher trip and added the landing at the glacier. However, due to  the weather they were only able to fly lower and were not able to land. The trip was still very nice and the pilot was excellent.

review_title: They cancelled the flight without notifying us
review_text: The flight was cancelled in a cloudy day, but K2 avaition never notified us about the cancellation even when I called them 2 hrs before the scheduled flight, after we arrived they told us they haven't been flying for quite a few days because of the weather, and gave us an option for 30 minutes flight in the valley for $180 (or so), which we were not interested in at all. It turns out a waste of a whole day in Talkeetna, we would have travelled to Fairbanks if they notified us about the cancellation beforehand.

We arrived on an overcast day and we could not see Denali from our hotel for the clouds so I was worried it would not be as good as intended. Then we took flight, I saw bald eagles at the top of the trees, the weather cleared and we followed the river/glacier up to Denali. Unlike anything we have ever experienced. Comparable if not better than the helicopter flights on Kauai. 

My wife and son saw grizzly bears and we all were treated to great views of the glacier and Denali's peak. The whole time the ride was smooth and enjoyable!  Awesome!
Chris our pilot did a Great job!! Amazing views and Great explanations!!  Very safe planes and courteous staff! Would recommend!

Amazing flight to mount Denali. There were some bad weather conditions so we could not do the flight we had previously booked but K2 made its best to rebook us in another flight. 

We enjoy it a lot!

A surprise trip to Alaska for my birthday from my wife and another couple, we arrived at K2 AVIATION the day I turned 60 years old. As luck would have it, I got to sit in the co-pilot seat.  Our pilot was excellent and we flew towards Denali mountain (I still can't get used to the name change from Mt. McKinnley) and passed close by to several tall snow covered mountains before reaching Denali. Incredible views as we got closer and closer to the summit, and circled the peak a few times. Hikers were seen descending the summit as we flew by. As we left the summit, we then landed on an ice glacier and spent the next hour or so there, which was near one of the base camps for the Denali hikers.  Pretty amazing landing on a glacier.  The whole tour was well worth the money and we would highly, highly recommend this tour to anyone.

They were awesome!!!!  When I called to confirm that a flight would go out they offered us an earlier flight as conditions were deteriorating pretty fast, of course I said yes.  :)  We waited there for about an hour and they offered us two seats on a the Ruth Glacier landing!!  Oh my goodness what a flight.  It was absolutely AMAZING!!!!  I have to admit that this was probably the highlight of my trip.  The flight and the landing were...  I have no words to describe the feeling.  It was incredible.   Thank you K2 for a ride we will never forget.  :)

Seeing Denali and the glaciers from their plane was unbelievable.  Just the majesty of nature up close is so humbling.  Mike did a great job pointing out various peaks and gave us interesting information about each one.  Who would believe there is even a house/hotel in the middle of it all?  We had registered for the glacier landing but we couldn't do it for safety sake and they had not done any since August (we were told) because of snow and crevices making landings dangerous.  They do take your safety very seriously!  We felt comfortable with our pilot and safe at all times.

review_title: GREAT WAY TO GET OVERVIEW OF THE DIFFERENT TERRAINS
review_text: We were a group flying from Denali to Anchorage to board a cruise ship.  We divided into 3 aircraft.  All were overhead wing Dehavilland bush planes.   We flew over the green valleys and rivers, up to the high mountain glaciers, where the pilots made sure we saw everything up close.   The ride was fairly smooth and nobody go airsick.  Not many people get to see Alaska this way.  The attached pictures say it all.

The flight experience was amazing and they were good with the trip, but we booked a Grand denali tour with glacier landing. we drove over 2.5 hrs to reach the place by 8:30 am only to be told that the weather will not permit the landing or grand denali tour they could only offer the smallest one or we had to come back at 3pm, as we had a different tour planned for afternoon we had to take what was offered. If only they had called and let us know about the weather situation we could have rearranged. i see the point of why they didn't call as everyone would choose a different time and the morning slot will be empty, but their greed caused us once in a life time experience.

review_title: Awesome experience! Still feels like a dream!
review_text:
It might seem pricey for people travelling on a budget! Don't miss it though! I would in fact postpone Alaska trip till I save up for this kind of tour. When we reached they said the weather is bit rough and they can't guarantee the glacier landing. However it turned out to be our lucky day. Our pilot was so cool and friendly, he even allowed our fellow passengers to be co-pilot :) The glacier landing was beautiful and walking on the glacier is a magical experience. Good thing is our pilot did not rush us and gave enough time for us to roam around, click pics and have fun. 
Tips for people:
1. Dress up in layers.
2. Wear snow boots. If you don't have it, you can use the ones they provide but wear small shoes as it would be easy to slip on those boots over your shoes
3. Show up on time.

Wir hatten den Flug mit Gletscherlandung lange im voraus gebucht. Als wir jedoch dort im Büro am Vormittag ankamen wurden wir informiert, dass die Gletscherlandung aufgrund der dichten Wolken nicht stattfinden kann. Da der Vormittag bewölkt war, gingen wir das Risiko ein, den Flug um drei Stunden auf den frühen Nachmittag zu verschieben. Bis dahin hatte sich das Wetter gebessert, doch leider konnte die Gletscherlandung immer noch nicht stattfinden. Aber auch so hatten wir einen wunderbaren Flug. Unser Pilot hat alles genau erklärt, wir hatten tolle Blicke auf die Landschaft, die Bergwelt, die Gletscher und auch einige Gipfel schauten aus den Wolken heraus. Das war wirklich ein beeindruckendes Erlebnis.
Breathtaking experience. Our pilot was so skilled and knowledgeable.  We felt like we were gliding around the mountain.

Spectacular views! We were lucky because the peak of Denali is not always visible. The clouds broke just in time for our flight. The pilot provided wonderful descriptions of the area and it's history, as well as a super-smooth ride.

We were in the Denali area for three days, but the cloud cover prevented us from see the full mountain.  On our last evening there, our host at the Airbnb provided us with some discount coupons and helped us arrange a last minute trip for the next morning.  We finally got to see the top.  Top notched pilots and friendly staff.

review_title: Great way to experience Denali National Park!
review_text: We booked the Denali Flyer tour without a glacier landing, and is was a once in a lifetime experience!  We originally had the tour booked for 8/25/17, but when we arrived at K2 from Palmer we noticed the weather was not really cooperating.  The summit was not visible, and because it was so cloudy out we could only do the Denali Experience route, and not the Flyer route.  We did have another day that we could do the trip so we took the gamble, and changed our flight date to 8/28/17.  We were so happy we took the gamble as it ended up being a beautiful sunny day.  We saw Denali clearly, and were able to fly within 5 miles of the mountain.  Our pilot, Patrick, was great.  He was extremely informative, and gave us a lot of excellent facts throughout the hour 15 min tour.  It was so cool to be able to see the park from the sky after spending 2 days exploring it by bus.  Seeing Denali that close was invaluable.  A flightseeing tour is pretty pricey so I was hesitant to book the tour at first, but as it was our first visit to Alaska we decided to splurge.  I am extremely happy that we did as we were able to get some great views with K2!

We did the flight with glacier landing on Friday August 25th,
We received an notification that the weather was not allowing the landing and they gave us options, to cancel the flight, or not do landing, well it was a beautiful day and we opt to do flight only.
Our pilot was excellent and he got as close to Mt McKinley as possible, took great time to rotate so that both sides of plane would get the same views and picture shots.
They also arranged pick up from our hotel 
We had great service, enjoyed the flight, can't say anything negative about the company or the experience

review_title: Great Experience - not to be missed!
