review_text: Our pilot took us up and around Mt. Denali and told us all about the mountain, expeditions, and the surrounding glaciers and peaks.  We lucked out because our flight was cancelled the day before due to weather, but when we woke up the next morning, the skies were totally clear and we could see Denali from our hotel lobby.  K2 was very cooperative in rescheduling our flight, and would have given us a full refund had we not been able to fly.  They stayed in contact with us throughout the 2 days, they kept our luggage while we were flying and got us to the train station on time.  They could communicate better with all the various people who answer the phone because we got different stories each time we spoke to a different person, but it all worked out.

Heads up for people booking with K2.  They are eager to book (W/ Glacier Landing) any one of 4 Denali flightseeing trips.  The problem is when you get there (in our case after a 2 1/2 hour drive from Anchorage) they tell you that the weather won't allow us to do the flight you scheduled but they can fit us on one we didn't schedule and, there will be no Glacier landing.  Upon further inspection we find out the real issue was.   1) our flight was not full and there were miraculously 2 seats left on the flight we were offered.  2) the pilot said it has been "over 2 weeks" since they did a Glacier landing.  I would have rated this a 4 if they would have told us at any point before arrival of the change.  I would have rated a 5 if they would have been truthful about Glacier landing.  Felt like bait and switch.
Thank you for the breathtaking view and the best experience in our lives.Professional pilots,enough information about Denali and glaciers.

K2 did a great job of finding us a less expensive flight when Denali got socked in with clouds. The pilot was experienced and the flight was breathtaking. I would give a 5 rating had the experience been a little better, but given the weather we really don't have much to complain about.

My husband and I had never been to Alaska.  We had an amazing trip. We drove up to Talkeetna, and flew to Denali with K2 aviation.  It was a fantastic experience. The pilot was very skilled and knowledgeable. We throughly enjoyed the flight around the south face.  We were suppose to land on a glacier but due to the weather we couldn't.  That was okay   It was amazing seeing all mountains and glaciers.  Everyone we met was friendly.

We had a great trip out to visit K2. We were supposed to do a glacier landing but the weather was not cooperating so instead we did the hour flight tour. It was amazing to see the glaciers from the sky and our pilot was just superb! Thanks for a great tour.

Hands down the best experience you can get in Talkeetna , the staff was more than helpful and so sweet. Especially miss Sierra Self, not to mention her sweet smile! Definitely will be back ! See you next time K2, (and sierra)

review_title: Not the plan, but still very good
review_text: We had booked the Denali flightseeing tour, but on arrival was informed the mountain was hiding today and not going to be flyable. Instead they offered the Knik Glacier tour (a bit of a longer flight) but for the same price. As we had no alternate plan, we took it - very beautiful flight and knowledgeable very young pilot. I only question the wisdom of giving the kids the ability to talk on the headsets -- they were with us and still annoying as heck!

The mountains and glaciers are  everywhere in Alaska and beautiful to see, but there is nothing like seeing  them out the window of a 9 seater bush plane! Amazing!
K2 aviation offers different flying experiences. Very safety conscious and reputable, pilots are excellent. We had a flight booked to land on a glacier, but did a fly around the mountains and glaciers only, as they felt the mountain was too unstable to land.  They adjust the price of your flight if changes, to your original tour, are made. They are also happy to give a full refund if you prefer. K2 keeps in touch through email the evening before and morning of your flight, with weather and flight updates. Washrooms available before your flight. Everyone is weighed before flight and  backpacks etc are locked in a container to be picked up once your flight is finished. Of course take your camera! The pilot takes pictures of you and your group with the plane you fly in. K2 is close and an easy walk  from the main street in Talkeetna, but they also offer a shuttle. 
An expensive tour, but well worth it!

review_title: Amazing, Informative, Don't miss this one!!!!
review_text: We had an outstanding tour of Denali and the surrounding area, and by some miracle, in spite of a cloudy day, the sun shone on Denali (McKinley) and we were able to even see the peak. It was a wonderful tour with a pilot who was not only an expert pilot but also an expert guide, explaining glaciers and everything we saw.  Most impressive was the safety aspect as it was a cloudy day and our original trip was cancelled and we were offered a refund with no pressure to take an alternate trip, but we asked if another one were available and are so glad we were able to have this excellent experience.  K2 has the best reputation and that is well deserved.
My original flight was unavailable due to weather, but a replacement flight was promptly arranged and the pilot was charming and informative.

review_title: Awesome sights in the sky!  Must do!
review_text: We had a wonderful flight seeing experience today on the Denali Flyer tour.  Kevin was our pilot and he made our time in the air worthwhile.  He was extremely knowledgeable about the area and pointed out noteworthy sights along the way.  We are so thankful to have had this chance to see the Alaska mountains from a different view!  Do not leave this out of your trip, if possible.  It was AMAZING!

review_title: Best part of our two week Alaska Vacation
review_text:
We booked a flight with K2 as part of our exploration of the great state of Alaska. This flight was the highlight of our trip. The staff was very professional and courteous. The plane was clean, comfortable and every seat has a great view. 

We were in the air for over 1.5 hours, flying at 11,000 feet and getting within 5 miles of Denali. The flight went around mountains, down through valleys and glacial paths. We were so close to the mountains, the views were tremendous and everlasting. 

I can not recommend K2 strong enough. It was by far the highlight of our vacation. If you want to experience Denali and the surrounding mountains, glaciers, valleys, rivers and fjords, take a trip with K2.

My wife and I went on a glacier landing with k 2 aviation, the highlight of our visit to Alaska. The majestic peaks were truly amazing. The pilot on our flight was Chris. It was unbelievable to see him maneuver through the glacier passes, a truly skilled pilot. Upon landing on the glacier the sights were so surreal. A unforgettable flight to  k2 aviation and Chris thank you! We hope we can do this again on our next trip to Alaska! I

I went on the glacier landing flight without hubby who had no desire to be in a small plane.  From the minute I met Chip, our pilot, to the minute we landed at the Talkeetna Airport I was truly amazed and was SO glad I did this!

The take off and landing at the glacier are as smooth as can be.  The views were stunning and indescribable. The whole experience makes me believe in God even more - how can such beauty exist in this world ?  

The plane is small but comfortable. There are headphones so you can hear the pilot narrate what you're seeing as you go, and you can ask questions along the way.  Chip was the quintessential Alaskan pilot  - young, handsome, confident  and a very talented pilot. Never felt uneasy once.  

If there's one thing that will stand out in my 15 days in Alaska this is it - wouldn't have missed it for the world!!

review_title: Our most amazing day in Alaska
review_text:
We were lucky to have reserved on the single sunny day of our two weeks vacation and it was the best day of our trip.
As the weather was great and we had come in early, they accommodated us with an earlier flight with another couple in a four passenger Cessna with a great pilot whose name I am sorry to have forgotten ( see the picture).
Our pilot had a constant interesting commentary and was able to answer all our questions. He flew us so close to the mountain peaks and up and down the glaciers valleys that my pictures turned out great. He made sure that both sides of the plane had great views and such a beautiful sunny day the white of the mountains was blinding. We really got a great view of all the features of the glaciers as well as the plains below. This experience made the price worth it

Took friends from Texas to K2 for a Denali Flight on 28-August-2017.   It was an outstanding experience in all aspects.  

The weather mostly cooperated, but the top 25% of the moutain was fogged out, so we had to choose a different route than originally scheduled.  The pilot went out of his way to show great vistas and scenery.  

While Denali / McKinley was somewhat clouded in, the surrounding peaks and area were crystal clear and the scenery was stunning.

My wife and I are in our 60's and have been fortunate enough to be  able to do quite a bit of traveling. We both agreed that our flight up to Denial was the neatest adventure we had ever experienced! We highly recommend it!

It helped it was a stunning day with just the perfect mix of clouds and incredibly blue sky, plus Denali and the whole range. It was also the service on the ground, in the air with Patrick explaining things,and the plane itself. Very comfortable and roomy. Well worth the money. Could not land on the glacier but that was nothing compared to the whole experience. I'll remember this for the rest of my life.

We took the flight to Denali and her sister mountains.  You get up to 9,500 feet after the plane climbs over glaciers and past massive upthrusts of stone that look like they arrived yesterday.  The cinematic attempts all fall short.  And then there is the mass of North America's tallest peak.  Nothing like it.

We did the Denali Flyer flight.  It was an awesome experience.  Our pilot Billy J was excellent and had a wealth of knowledge about Denali/Alaska past and present.  When we arrived, It was fairly overcast in Talkeetna so I was worried about the view from the plane.  K2 told me the viewing would still be good near and around Denali and they were correct!   Take one of K2s flights - you will be glad you did.  Also spend some time in Talkeetna after your flight.

We waited out four days for good weather to fly.  They were great with helping us understand what was going on and rolling our reservations.  Our patience was rewarded with 100% clear day and a trip of a lifetime! Our pilot Chip gave us a wonderful narrated tour (he voice is so soothing!).  We would do this flightseeing experience again in a heartbeat!  Only disappointment was not being able to land on the glacier due to it being too soft (not K2's fault), so some day we want to do this again to have this experience.  Definitely book with K2 Aviation!

Nous sommes arrivés au moment où la compagnie commençait les vols de la journée. Il était presque 17h, la météo n'ayant pas permis de vol plus tôt. Encore hésitant nous avons tout de même décidé de faire le tour en avion. Et nous n'avons pas été déçu! Malgré les nuages nous avons eu une superbe vue du denali ainsi que des glaciers aux alentours. Le pilote à également donné beaucoup d'informations sur les lieux ce qui a rendu la visite encore plus agreable. À faire absolument !

We (my wife and 17 years old son) visited Alaska from Japan and we found this tour in Talkeetna by chance.
We were so impressed with the beautiful sights. Highly recommended!!  

日本からアラスカへ旅行し現地でツアーを見つけて参加しましたが、素晴らしい景色で感動しました。お薦めです！

review_title: Amazing trip for pilot's birthday present
review_text: We took a father/son trip up to Alaska, with the full intention of taking a flight around Denali National Park. My dad's been a pilot for 40 years, and he loved every minute of the flight we had with Josh from K2. The location for the airport was conveniently located in Talkeetna; easy walking distance from most lodging in the area.

Mark was an excellent pilot.  Really showed us the beauty of the area.  This was definitely one of the highlights of our trip. We were lucky to have such a beautiful day and the flight took the best advantage of it!  Would do it again for sure.

review_title: Mountain and glacier viewing from a de Havilland Otter
review_text: We took a family trip with a broad age range (8-84) and took a flight tour with this company. The pilot was extremely knowledgeable about the region and we had a fantastic tour of the mountains and several glaciers. The plane was very comfortable for our group and I have to say the landing at the end of the tour was the smoothest I have ever experienced. Highly recommend a tour with this company.

When we visited Alaska four years ago, the only thing we missed out on was a flightsee of Denali.  With the mountain only visible 20-30% of the time I figured we'd schedule more time in Talkeetna this trip to make sure we had a better shot.  The day we came down from the park, it was beautifully clear.  We had a flight scheduled immediately after our arrival and were able to go this time.  Our timing was perfect as the mountain was fully visible.  Our Pilot, Barry, did an outstanding job showing us every part of the mountain and most of the glaciers, too.  We had a stupendous flight which will be in our memories for the rest of our lives!  I even showed our pictures to two other guys who asked if I could text it to them.  This really capped a wonderful trip!  Thank you K2 for the great show!!

if you're in Talkeetna, a flight seeing trip to Denali is a must.  We've used K2 twice now and both times had a lovely time. And if the tour you book can't happen due to weather they adjust your fees no problem. If you're determined to see Denali, give yourself a few days. Cloud cover is the norm not the exception and there are no guarantees you'll see the summit. But even without seeing the summit of Denali, a tour of the glaciers and ice fields from the air is breathtaking. These folks are professional and fairly priced.

Glacier landing was a "must do" on our Alaskan trip. K2 were superbly professional, and the organisation and flight couldn't have been better. We were very lucky with the weather and being able to land on the glacier was an experience we will never forget.
Had a great time even though we didn't get to land on glacier. Whole operation was top notch. Booked thru Princess cruise line but would recommend booking direct as was much cheaper.

My Girlfriend and I got a charter to a place in Denali NP called Backside Lake. As Alaskan Summers go, we got stuck in Talkeetna for 2 days waiting for the rain to stop. But when we finally flew it was incredible. The flight was beautiful, the pilots were friendly with great advice. Luckily we had a couple of spare days so they adjusted our flight back without a problem. We had the best self guided backpacking trip and we couldn't have done it without K2. The charters are on the pricer side of things but if you want to see Denali National Park without tons of  other travelers around, K2 is the way in.

We did not know what to expect when we showed up for our flight. Weather was not great and the trip was downgraded. Our pilot Chris searched for blue sky and delivered stunning views of Denali as well as Foraker and Hunter. Over all could not had been a better experience given the weather but we are taking home views and memories that will last forever. 

Thanks Chris and K2

My aunt visited and was disappointed The Mountain wasn't showing. I kept this a secret until we arrived in Talkeetna. Although weather had been troublesome, and the glacier landings were stopped due to softer conditions, going up with K2 made viewing Denali possible! The clouds cleared enough around Denali when we arrived to make it possible for her to see the summit. This was thanks to Daniel circling around for us and then getting in above much of the Alaska Range adjacent to Denali. Hunter and Foraker were viewable as well. Thanks so much to K2! I will share with everyone I meet that this is the way to go!

After two days of weather delays we were finally able to have our air tour. Like everyone else, we were hoping to see Denali, but it was not to be.  We were however treated to the amazing views of the Triumphant Glacier. Simply fantastic, well worth the wait and the slight re-route of our trip to take the tour.

review_title: Amazing, Unforgettable Flight with K2 Aviation
review_text: My family lives in Alaska and I have been a ranger at Denali. I have seen the mountain from hiking trips many times. However, my flight with K2 topped all sights! I highly recommend a flight with K2 if you are in Alaska. This flight needs to be on your list. Our pilot, Chip, provided a great amount of information on the human, cultural and natural history of the area. We flew near the summit seeing many glaciers and rock formations. The tundra views were spectacular too. This was a great memory with my son who is leaving for college this week. Thank you Suzanne and K2!

Daniel, our pilot, did a great job finding a couple of holes in the low-hanging clouds and getting us up to a point where we could see Denali and Foraker in the bright sunshine.  Then he descended to a much lower level where we could look for wildlife.  Daniel was an excellent pilot and a wealth of information about the local area.  We had a great time flying around the area.

We took the 1 hour glacier view trip. The clouds were low which made it difficult to get near the mountain. We did see one glacier. The pilot noticed a clearing in the cloud cover due west. He took us to the clearing and we ascended to 12000 feet. There we were able to see the tops of Denali and Foraker! We then proceeded back to the visible glacier and flew along it for some spectacular pictures. I believe the pilot went above and beyond to make sure we were satisfied! Good for him and the K2 Aviation company!

review_title: Denali Weather Socked - Knik a great option
review_text: Unfortunately Denali was socked in with weather. Also the glaciers had degraded to the point of no landings. We were very sad. K2 offered us an option to Knik. It was UNBELIEVABLE!!!!!  Clear skies and late day sun gave us spectacular views!  Mark was an amazing pilot and guide. Nobody can control Mother Nature but K2 will find you a memorable safe alternative. I highly recommend K2 and Mark!

The price might turn some away, but it is worth it and more the views of mountain range and almost neon blue water and ice if you are in the season fir glacier landings add that you won't be disappointed

Our recent trip with K2 was great. The week we were in the area there weather was not the greatest, lots of clouds and rain. K2 was sending us updates and advised they route we selected was not available due to the weather but they did have an alternate route we could take. Shuttle driver picked us up updated us to make sure we were still on board with the revised trip. Said we were since prior communication had informed us so well.

Got there, checked in and settled up paying only the amount for the new route, less deposits. Then we meet the pilot Mike. Will say Mike did a really great job. We had a pilot in the group and he said Mike was a very smooth flyer.

Anyway, got up in the air, managed to get above the clouds to see Denali. Then he dropped through an opening to below the clouds. Had some great glacier views and even sighted a mother grizzly and her cubs plus some moose. Mike flew around so both sides of the plane saw them.

Finished with a nice smooth landing.

We all agreed we would do it again.

This flight was the highlight of our trip to Alaska.  Stan was our pilot and he was very knowledgeable about the peak names, glacier names, explaining how the glaciers/mountains have evolved over the years.  We flew between peaks, down into valleys, we got beautiful pictures and a wonderful closeup view of the mountain.  We did not see "The Tall One" on this day due to cloud cover, but what we did see was truly magnificent.

We were travelling all over Alaska on our own and K2's flight from Talkeetna up by Denali and friends was spectacular! Our pilot, Chris maneuvered us around up in the mountains and landed us safely (and pretty darn smoothly) on the Pika glacier. Stunning!  Everyone we encountered at K2 was friendly and professional and knew their stuff. Absolutely amazing! Do not miss this trip!

review_title: If you're near Denali, it's a must-do.
review_text:
We had a great experience with K2 Aviation and our pilot, whose name I unfortunately don't remember. 

We did the Denali Experience Tour, their most basic, but hadn't planned to do that one. We chose K2 because they had great TA reviews and because they did glacier landings. We had originally booked the third most expensive trip with a glacier landing. But when we arrived, we were disappointed to learn we could not do the glacier landing because there wasn't enough snow to land. From what the pilot told us, there hasn't been enough snow to land for some time this year. So, I feel like they should have contacted us ahead of time so we could have adjusted to not be looking so forward to the landing experience. At best, it was a bad service move. At worst, it was a tactic to avoid potential cancelations because they probably know that people select their company because of the glacier landings. So, that set a bit of a negative tone for us. Instead, they recommended the basic tour with no landing. 

In the end, it worked out well. The tour was awesome. We had great weather. Knowing what we know now, I would recommend the basic tour for $220/person. Overall, I would recommend K2 to anyone and would fly with them again. But, I would strongly suggest they let people know ahead of time when their tours require a change. 

For photographers:
I found that my 70-200 mm lens was ideal. The 16-24mm was just too wide and captured parts of the aircraft and my 150-600 was way too cropped in for the aerial landscapes.

We took a flight to see Denali and it was amazing.  Chris, our pilot was fantastic and made us very comfortable the entire time.  Because of weather we were not able to take the longer tour we booked and K-2 was fantastic in making adjustments.  Up to the last minute they offered a complete refund if we did not wish to take the shorter flight.  They also picked us up at our hotel and took us back.  Great organization focused on true customer service and gives a great product.
This trip was phenomenal and we'll be talking about it for years! Our pilot was fantastic and so knowledgeable. It was well worth every penny spent!

review_title: Highly recommend K2 air tour of Mt Denali
review_text:
Had a beautiful day. Mark (our pilot) was extremely knowledgeable. My second flight on K2. My family enjoyed very much.
Had a mix up on flight time, my fault. They worked hard to get us up as soon as possible. Great customer service.

review_title: Better than I could have imagined
review_text: We booked the Denali Flyer with a glacier landing.   The sky was clear and the weather was warm.   Our pilot, Kevin, was great.  We got plenty of views of Denali and the glacier landing was unbelievable.   The experience was priceless.

review_title: Amazing - a once in a lifetime experience
review_text: The experience was like straight out of a movie - I really enjoyed it, the scenery, clouds, mountains, was surreal.  Definitely recommend.

review_title: glacier landing was so worth the extra bucks!!
review_text: My husband was a bit nervous -as he is not that big of a fan of flying, but turns out this was his favorite part of the trip!

We took this float plane to hike up in Denali National Park.  I'm terrified of small planes but this was too cool to be afraid of!   The flight was amazing!  It was just our four family members and the pilot on a dehavilland beaver plane.   We flew up the Ruth Glacier and saw the Backside Glacier.  We landed on Moraine Lake for a two hour hike.  The hike was not strenuous but the scenery was beautiful and unique.  It was very cool to be 15 nautical miles from the summit of Denali with no one around.  We hiked with a guide from Alaska Alpine Adventures, Andrew who was very knowledgeable.  On our flight back to Fish Lake our pilot (I think his name was Bryan ) flew us up into another valley and circled moose for us to see from both sides of the plane.  Each of our kids got to serve as 'co-pilot' sitting up front and it was a big hit for both kids.  We recommend this tour !

I have always been afraid of small planes, but, after reading so many raving reviews, I decided this was worth it.  And, i never felt any fear during the flight.  The scenery is beyond anything I can describe -- total awesomeness of G-d.  Unfortunately, our glacier landing was cancelled due to weather, but the flight still exceeded my expectations.
The weather kept us from doing the flight we wanted but they were able to give us an alternate or refund.  We chose the alternate and it was amazing.

We took the long trip, I think it was called the Summit rip that went up and around the summit of Denali. I felt like the only way we could get closer to her would be if we were climbers. I felt safe at all times even though I am a bit of a worrier. Chris was an excellent pilot. The oxygen masks we had to wear were not at all uncomfortable. It was a warm day so we were not cold, but blankets were available. Everyone had a window seat. The Glacier landing went smoothly and we had time to play on the snow. Loved every minute of it.

review_title: I touched the face of God....
review_text: I tood the K2 Denali flightseeing and glacier landing flight and it was by far the most exciting trip I have ever taken.  Flying over the Alaskan range and viewing the peaks, crevices, ice, snow, rocks brings one closer to God than you can imagine.  It is a very spiritual flight even if you are not spiritual.  Landing and then walking on the glacier waa incredible.  Sad to see that a hotel is being built there - it should be left to nature and sleeping in tents if you dare...K2 did a fabulous job with everything for orientation to take off and landings and I would highly recommend taking a K2 adventure if you want the trip of a lifetime.

Booked a last minute Denali Glacier Landing flight on K2 after being on an AK cruise. I spent a dozen summers in AK when I was younger, and have flown with many of the best and not-the-best, well-known and not so well-known air taxis in AK, and K2 is absolutely top notch. Their operations are down to a science and their pilots and crew are extremely well-versed in the area, the route, and the conditions (which can change on a dime around Denali, as it makes it own weather). Our pilot was a very experienced guy, had great information for us during the flight about Denali and the history of the area, a was a pleasure to ride with. 

We had crystal clear weather for Denali and got some amazing views, and we were able to land on a glacier. Epic day.

Amazing experience! Each passenger has their own window to view the most breathtaking scenery. The pilot Randy was also an excellent guide. We landed on Pika Glacier and were the only people there. It was so quiet and surreal. Definitely a life-long memorable experience.

While we missed our Summit Tour with Glacier Landing due to the weather conditions this company was great to work with - both before our trip and once we arrived.  They kept us informed about the status of the flight and we were so disappointed to miss it.  We will be make and make the highly anticipated flight.
Mind-blowing! Chris was great and we lucked out by going on the Flyer tour on a perfect weather day.

The tour options were easy to see, understand and book online. Everything was well explained online and in person. Our pilot was fun and very informative. He made the glacier landing fun and memorable for our children by participating in a snowball fight with them! The aerial views of the mountains, glaciers, and Denali were breathtaking. I would highly recommend this once in a lifetime experience!
We apparently fell into the lucky 30% that actually got to see Mt. Denali. The skies were clear and the views were absolutely incredible. Our pilot said he hasn't seen if this nice all season.

We had a terrific flight with K2.  Flying through the mountains was thrilling and landing on a glacier was an outstanding experience.  Our pilot was incredibly skilled and really good about communicating what he was doing and the geography and geology of the mountains.  Expensive, but worth the money.

Chris was wonderful. He was knowledgeable and so friendly.  Got to see the top of Mt. Denali....Spectacular!  Thanks Chris from some of us in PA, that you showed some of the wilds of Alaska.  Highly recommend K2 to anyone looking.

What a great flight tour! The weather was sunny and clear and Denali was magnificent! Our pilot was knowledgeable and friendly. I was hesitant to fly, but it was so smooth it was almost like we were hovering instead of flying. I would encourage everyone to try it. Worth every penny!!!

My daughter, Robin & I booked a last minute flight to see Denali by ai. Although the weather did not permit us to actually see Mt. Denali (McKinley) we were able to see and take fabulous pics of the southern range and the glaciers. Our pilot, Billy, was well informed and gave us a lot of trivia about the area. I highly recommend K-2 for touring Denali via air.

Flying with K2 was an orgasm for the mountain eyes; an not in the naughty variety.  Our pliot, "OE", was professional, skilled at flying, and most of all a great ambassador for a two hour air tour and glacier landing at Denali National Park.  If you are thinking about whether to do the Denali Tour, just go for it....and make sure you include a glacier landing.  While the cost of any air tour is not cheap; in thirty years you will remember the visual beauty of a Denali air tour more than the money spent.

One of the highlights of the trip! Encourage to spend a little more for glacier landing if available. Our pilot was knowledgeable about entire area, formations, history, planes, etc. Seeing Denali from the air and thinking about those who climb it just blows my mind.

review_title: My husband and I went on an Alaskan tour. Best trip ever!
review_text: Best event of our trip, and we had many special amazing events!  So special.  I loved the small plane.  I loved wearing the earphones and listening to the pilot talk as we flew over absolutely gorgeous mountains.  There was so much texture and colors above the mountains.  I was thinking "no doubt, there is a God."
We lucked out with the weather AND the best pilot, Kevin!! By far, the highlight of our trip to Alaska and the best value of everything we did. Highly recommend!

review_title: Off we go into the wild blue yonder!  Learned that from my Army Air Corps Dad.
review_text:
Chris, our pilot gave us that and more.  We learned and saw so much, three rivers, a glacier, Denali and landed on a glacier!  What a wonderful trip. Don't miss this one!

K2'Aviation gave us all we wanted.  Well worth it.
Sue from FL

This company made it that we could plan and if the weather did not cooperate - we could reschedule or get a refund.  They made as not only feel safe but it was an awesome experience all the way around. Due to our schedule we were able to reschedule and have perfect weather.

Wij werden er stil van, zó mooi ziet de besneeuwde bergwereld er uit vanuit de lucht! Snelwegen van gletschers, landen op  grote hoogte, ruig landschap, knalblauwe meertjes! Als je het kunt betalen: doen!!

We flew with K2 in Talkeetna on a cloudy afternoon with hopes of seeing the summit of Denali.  Our pilot, Stan, did a great job getting a view of it for us and put us right next to it.  By far the highlight of our trip!  The company was great to work with.  The weather during our trip to Alaska was very cloudy and rainy in the Denali area so we were really torn about spending the money to fly not knowing what we would get to see.  We really wanted to land on the glacier but weather did not permit that while we were there.  I called them several times and spoke with Noel who was so helpful.  We decided to book and loved the flight!  They definately go the extra mile to provide value for the money!

We were scheduled to fly over Denali, but weather did not cooperate and pilots had to regrettably cancel flights.  The folks at K2 were very apologetic and understood our disappointment.  Since we were in Talkeetna only one day, we had to move on.  The wonderful staff at Talkeetna made a suggestion, that ultimately took business away from them.  They recommended that we call a company in Denali to try and book from there, since that is where we were headed.  They didn't HAVE to make that suggestion.  K2 people are genuine and really care about folks like us who have a lifelong dream of seeing Denali.

If/when we revisit AK, we will definitely try K2 again!

BTW, we DID see The Great One 2 days later ...it is the most magnificent trip I've ever taken.  Highly recommend it.  Absolutely worth every penny! I still get chills when I tell about it.

Nice pilote and team. Beautiful views of the glaciers, the best way to see them! Despite the clouds and the reduction of time and a suitable tour (adapted price) we had a flight without too many turbulances.

This is the way to see Denali. 
We had the most wonderful day of sunshine. We had booked a flight first thing in the morning with a glacier landing but was unable to land because the glacier was too icy. Suggest perhaps the 2nd flight if the day but you risk the clouds coming in and blocking the view of Denali. 
This company is definitely safety first. I'm actually afraid of flying especially in smaller aircraft but felt very safe.  Smooth landing and take off. Our pilot, Mike shared so much information.
This trip was by far the best part of our Alaska trip. Just spend the money and do it!
Everything is so large and brilliant.  Hard to believe it is our planet earth.  A must see while in Alaska.

First off Daniel our pilot was amazing. My wife was a bit hesitant about the whole flight. But Daniel's smooth handling of the De Haveland Otter airplane soon had my wife at ease. We were supposed to land on a glacier on our flight, but because of snow conditions we had to give that up. But K2 Aviation gave us a refund voucher to present to the front desk at the McKinley lodge for a refund of the difference between the cost of a glacier landing flight and a non landing flight. The refund went smooth as silk and we had the refund posted to our credit card before we got home.

Our flight lasted about an hour and a half with Daniel getting us up close, well it seemed really close and personal with the mountains and glaciers. He took us both above and below the low hanging clouds for spectacular views that you could not get any other way. 

Thank you Daniel and K2 Aviation for a spectacular flight experience!

review_title: really fun - these folks are pros
review_text: Had a wonderful tour with a Glacier landing and highly recommend this to anyone who wants to see Denali as the views from the ground are fleeting.  Captain Chip was skillful and informative, everything about the K 2 operation was top flight - no pun intended,

The take off and landing in a glacier is an experience by itself. Strongly recommended if you want to have a memorable adventure. The whole activity was about an hour. Our pilot has been very knowledgeable and funny. He briefed us before the flight with all the safety features. We had a very pleasant cruise flight and fantastic take offs and landings. We learnt a lot about the glaciers (materials, colors, etc) and how they have been evoluted over the years. The views from the airplane are breathtaking.

The view were spectacular, Daniel did a great job with the flight showing us many unbelievable views. The landing and take off on Pika Glacier was very smooth. I come from an area that gets snow 5-6 months out of the year; however, I was still in awe at the glaciers and how they move. It is one of the excursions that we did that I would recommend to anyone going to Alaska. Two thumbs up and more. 

In regards to the recommendation - I would send anyone on this trip and all would have a good time.

A surreal experience landing on a Glacier!! 
Chris out pilot was knowledgeable and helpful.
The views are truely spectacular and can't be seen from the ground. The plane is comfortable and exciting!! 
Seats 9 & pilot. 
Glacier landing seems expensive but beyond beyond worth it! It's once in a lifetime so if u afford it do it you will remember it forever!!

review_title: Do not miss the K-2 flight and glacier landing - our return trip!
review_text: My husband and I had flown with K-2 and landed on the glacier a few years ago.  This time I brought my granddaughter and two sons.  Another terrific flight!!!  We were warned when we arrived that the smoke from the forest fires had been a problem all day and we might not be able to land.  The woman at the counter was very helpful and offered us another flight, but obviously couldn't guarantee it would be any clearer.  We decided to "go for it" and are we happy we did.  The landing was crystal clear and everyone had an exciting time walking on the glacier, building a snowman, and taking pictures of the beautiful mountains.  One of my sons is also a pilot and he was so impressed with ours.  As he said, "We hardly knew we had landed, he did it so smoothly, and really knew what he was doing!"  It was all-around a great flight that was a highlight of our vacation.  Don't miss it!

My Wife and I were very excited to land on the Ruth glacier. The plane flies around the Alaskan snow peaks and also hovers around the highest peak - Mt McKinley. The pilot was very knowledgeable and gave good overview of the place for different seasons and about glacier hiking. We were about 30 mins in the glacier. It was fun and totally worth the cost.

One of the highlights of our trip! We went on a day that seemed cloudy, but above the layer in talkeetna, it was incredible! The pilot was very knowledgeable and offered to take photos when we landed on the glacier! And they provided free boots to keep our feet warm! Worth the money!!

review_title: If you want to see Denali, DO IT!
review_text: My wife and I flew with them in 1995 and did a glacier landing.  We just returned to Alaska this year with our grandson and knew we wanted to do it again.  Conditions weren't suitable for a glacier landing this time, but the views were incredible.  After spending several days in Denali NP, hoping to see the mountain with no success, we were especially glad we had booked this flight.  These folks have been in this business a long time and they are the experts!

It all started with the check-in process and a knowledgeable person who clearly explained the process and what was going to happen on our flight.   Then, Pilot Steve took over and ensured that all of us knew we were in great hands with an experienced pilot.  Steve was also very knowledgeable about Denali, the glaciers, the science and history of the area.   Excellent experience!
awesome views great day, great information. would recommend to everyone wanting to get a real experience inside Denali.

We were scheduled to fly around Denali and have a glacier landing.  Unfortunately, the weather was not cooperative!  I was contacted the morning of our trip and we called and talked to the staff.  She gave us a few options and we rescheduled for a trip later in the day - heading to a different area.   The trip was EXCELLENT - Enjoyed Ruth Glacier and the Arena!  Flying above the clouds - seeing tops of mountains / between clouds / and below the clouds.    We were not charged (of course) for the original booked flight - very pleased with how this was all handled.

We signed up for the glacier landing and Grand Tour of Denali, but due to clouds and glaciers melting we didn't get to land and had to bump down to the Denali flyer. We were of course bummed about not being able to land, but understand. They did mention once we were there that as the season progresses it becomes harder and harder to do the landings and the places they land get ruts in them from earlier landings. They refunded us the difference in price which was nice. However, I wish we would have known about the possibility to land being less as the season goes on just to adjust our expectations. The views were great, pilot was nice and informative. The only complaint is that 2 of the 4 got sick from the jet fuel fumes which we smelled the entire trip. I wish they would have instructed everyone to keep the vents closed for the entire trip as by the end, one of our group got out the throw up bag cuz he was so sick from the smell of the fumes, vs motion sickness. We would do again, but maybe bring some Vicks to put under our noses.

review_title: Glacier landing is a must do!
review_text: We enjoyed our flight around Denali.  Even though it was a warm and sunny day in Talkeetna, you could not see the mountain due to haze.  We were able to see the summit on the Grand tour, but not until we were 5 miles away.  Views are best from the left side of the plane - pilot's side.  Co-pilot seat is poor - dash is too high.  The best part was the glacier landing.  It's a rather thrilling landing and take-off.   We all enjoyed the snowball fight on the glacier and got some fun pictures.  Worth doing once!

We recently returned from a land and sea vacation in Alaska. Our K2 flight to Mt. Denali with a landing on Pika Glacier was the highlight of our entire vacation! The views of the Alaskan Range as we flew between the mountain peaks, into the valleys, and over numerous glaciers was fantastic. Flying around the summit of Denali was breathtaking; unbelievable how awesome this mountain is. The weather cooperated and we were able to land on Pika Glacier and walk around on the snow covered glacier. What an experience! Chris, our pilot, was wonderful and gave us very informative commentary throughout our flight. Many, many thanks to K2 and to Chris for such a wonderful flight! Would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Alaska.

review_title: Soaring Like a Bird Over Glacier Fields
review_text: Our once in a lifetime experience left us with so many memories!  As we soared up and around the rocky snow covered cliffs and peaks, it gave me the feeling of what it would be like to be an eagle!  Upon landing on the glacier runway, I expected it to be much rougher.  Our experienced pilot landed it with ease and upon arrival to the glacier I couldn't even feel the chill of the cold air because I was so caught up in the moment.  You won't be disappointed if you take this trip, it's worth every cent to treat yourself.  Sit back, take the ride, soak up your memories with pictures and enjoy the adventure that awaits you!

review_title: Grand tour of Denali in a DeHavilland Beaver
review_text:
The flight was the highlight of our trip to Alaska- and that is saying something!

It was exciting but still safe.  The pilot was very informative and friendly.  The flight was everything promised and then some.
The pilot was wonderful, funny and informative. He was accommodating, if we needed heat, he turned it on. He talked just enough, then let us admire the view, without much commentary.

We were driving north from Anchorage on a sunny July day when we noticed Denali was free of clouds and fully visible. At about noon we called K2 to see if they had any openings and they had several! We booked for 3pm, drove over and had the flying tour of our dreams. We landed on a glacier and had a ball. 
The staff and pilot were fantastic and the photos have come out amazing. 
Key lesson? Don't be afraid to call and check at the last moment if there are openings. 

Don't talk yourself out if this experience!

Took the summit and glacier landing tour and it was great weather and superb flying.  Our pilot Chris was very informative and helpful. he made easy takeoffs and landing.  It required headsets to be worn and Oxygen above 12,000 feet.  We topped out at 20,000 ft with Denali.   Landed on Eldridge Glacier for 15 minutes and took some memorable photos.

review_title: Denali Flight Seeing & Glacier Landing Experience
review_text: I would just want to summarize our experience in one word "Awesome".   A must do activity, the experience is mind boggling and I bet you will not regret your decision.  Trained staff, courteous and knowledgeable about the place, facts and history.

My brother and nephew were visiting for a trip of a lifetime in Alaska. After a week of bear viewing, fishing, kayaking, hiking, and all kinds of adventures, we decided to end it with a Denali flightseeing trip with K2. We had a perfectly beautiful day to work with, which helped, but getting up close to Denali and its neighbors was near the top of Alaskan experiences I've had since moving here 32 years ago. The pilot was competent and very knowledgeable, and the K2 crew was friendly and helpful. A real class act. This needs to be on you must-do list for Alaska.
We took a morning flight with the glacier landing. Luckily the weather cooperated and we could land on the glacier. Our pilot was safe and provided great information while flying.

We spent a week in Alaska and experienced a number of great memories.  The K2 flight and landing on Denali was the best of all of them.  While the wildfires in Canada created hazy smoke at lower levels the flight gave us crystal clear views of Denali and once in a lifetime experience with landing on the glacier.  I would recommend this to everyone.

review_title: Best experience we had in Alaska!
review_text: We spent 10 days in Alaska and had a wonderful time. The flight experience was our favorite of all the things we did! They were very helpful in rescheduling when the weather didn't cooperate for the first trip we had planned. We did the glacier landing and I highly recommend it. Our pilot Daniel was even willing to take as many photos as we wanted. Thank you K-2 for a wonderful experience!

I've lived in AK for 18 years, and this was, by far, the best Alaskan experience I've had. We dealt with some weather delays, but were always given the option of rescheduling or cancelling with a full refund. We were determined to go, so rescheduled to a reasonable looking day. Despite the cloudy weather in Talkeetna, the flight went off as scheduled. The views were amazing - blue skies with scattered clouds, but we saw Denali in all its glory. Denali or not, the scenery is spectacular: jagged mountains, huge glaciers, and even a few moose! The highlight of the trip was the glacier landing - only a cool beer (or champagne) and picnic would have made it better.

Absolutely stunning views and our pilot, Chris, was very knowledgable about the area. We were fortunate enough that the weather played along and were able to land on the glacier, which was the highlight of the flight. 
Complimentary champagne and snacks on the glacier would have made the experience extra special...hint hint.

The trip we took on 7/21/2017 was good with a good aerial view and the view is awesome. I feel the price is bit pricey at 320 dollars. They have an ad that gives 20 dollars off per person but the guys refused to honor the discount per person since it was booked thru a travel agent guy. I never saw someone not honoring a discount no matter how I book it in almost all all the tours i did for several years across US. I understand one has to make money but greed should not be there.

review_title: Once in a lifetime experience - take it!
review_text: Unfortunately for us, the weather made it impossible to see Denali or land on a glacier.  However, our pilot flew us where he could and did a wonderful job explaining the geology of the mountain and glaciers.  The views were breath-taking. Those of us on the right side say a moose and those on the left side of the plane saw two bears.  It is an amazing flight.

review_title: Awesome, easiy the best thing we did in the week we were in alaska
review_text:
We went on the K2 fly and hike adventure, not the land on a glacier flight.  We are super glad that we did.  The fly and hike starts with a float plane take off from a local lake and about a 30 minute flight up glaciers to backside lake and another glacial lake landing.  The flight was incredible, the pilot amazingly smooth and the sights were wow.  People talk about going on a helicopter, which is cool, but the float plane is special.

At the lake a guide takes you on a two hour hike around the edges of a glacial lake. This is a glacial moraine and alpine environment so its rocky with great views.  We were lucky to have just the four of our family on the hike so the guide took us out a little farther and up a mountain stream.  It was amazing.

The hike is a real hike and we were very happy to have worn our hiking boots, pants and brought our poles.  Shorts are possible but not preferable.  The weather was yucky so we did not see Denali, but it was right there for us to see if it was clearer.

After the hike it was back to base camp for some box wine and snack -- a meat stick and potato chips.  Not the best, so if you are picky or want a bigger snack bring some Cliff or Granola bars along.  Bring your own water before you get on the plane at the lake side.

The float plane was immaculate, well serviced and the pilot a real pro.  On the way back we flew down a different glacier and were able to circle around some local attractions which was really neat.

The best of attractions, safe, unique, cool, amazing, fun, beautiful and an adventure.  Really glad we chose this rather than landing on a glacier -- which is something you can also do down in Girdwood.

Thanks K2 for making a really fantastic and lasting memory.

You can't go to Alaska and not experience a floatplane trip! Both K-2 and Rust's Flying Service are GREAT! Informative, friendly pilots and staff. They are very honest with people regarding flight conditions and visibility...so you don't have to worry about wasting your money because they won't fly if conditions are not good. Flightseeing can be expensive but it is lots of fun and very scenic...we loved our experience!

We wanted to do the Denali Grand Tour but due to weather had to settle for the Flyer Tour with glacier landing, but we realized we didn't "settle."  The whole flight and landing were amazing and a memory our family of 4 will never forget!!  Our pilot was Chris and he was amazing--very knowledgeable, great narrator, and most importantly a wonderful, experienced pilot!  The views took our breath away and the glacier landing made it extra special.  If you're going to Alaska, a trip to Talkeetna and a K2 flightseeing tour are a must!!!

Our flight over Denali National Park was wonderful. I was a little fearful of going into a small plane, but it was a 10-seater, driven by Randy. He was excellent!! No fears from me. Seeing the park from above was something I'm glad I didn't skip. If you have the opportunity, just do it. You will never regret it.
Glad I did it and would go again. Kevin was a fine pilot.  Stunning views and easy scheduling.  We did the flight without glacier landing.

review_title: K2 Glacier Landing Flight - Do It!
review_text: We took the Glacier Landing Flight.   Fantastic trip!  I was speechless at the beauty.  Walking on the glacier was a great experience.  Chip was our pilot and so knowledgeable about the areas and what we were seeing.  (See, Chip, I remembered your name ).

I highly recommend K2 aviation for a flight tour of Mt. Denali. I did a lot of research before booking K2 and they did not disappoint me. This was one of the highlights of our trip. We flew from Talkeetna and did the Grand Tour with glacier landing. For starters, the pilot was great and really knew the mountain. Seeing Mt. Denali up close and in the air was well worth the price. It was so cool to land on one of the glaciers in the Alaska range so don't skip out on the landing. We were informed that if weather prevented the glacier landing we would be refunded that amount of money, but luckily didn't need it as the clouds moved out of the way just in time. As our flight was at 11:00am, I wouldn't recommend earlier as the morning clouds may limit the landing and view of the mountain.

Beautiful town and wonderful experienced staff.  The pilot who flew us around Denali and showed us glaciers was very knowledgeable and expierced and it was a very informative tour. I had a great time and would do it again. We were in the air about and hour and it was a great time

This flight seeing trip was one of the highlight experiences we have ever had on a vacation, my husband and I agreed! It is worth the investment, just do it! We loved every minute of the scenic flight over countless snowy peaks, and felt very safe the entire, smooth journey! We landed on a glacier, too, and it was peaceful, and serene up there. Fascinating, beautiful trip of a lifetime!

The Denali Experience was the highlight of our Alaskan trip! Thank you Patrick for a smooth and informative flight! Seeing the glaciers, Denali, Mt Hunter, Mt Dickey, etc up close is second to none! Denali is so majestic!
Wonderful experience - the pilot was great - provided a lot of color and commentary.  Really enjoyed the incredible views

We were glad we did the K2 aviation flightseeing and glacier landing because once we were actually in Denali we never even could see the mountain! Our pilot was great and the flight was comfortable. They had to change our route due to weather conditions on the backside of the mountain, but adjusted our pricing easily for the shorter trip.

This flight checked off two items on my bucket list.  The first was a fabulous view of Denali and a magnificent landing on Pica Glacier.  This operation is professionally run and the best part is when they weigh you for the flight they don't call out the number on the scale!  All of our seats on the flight had a great view and the pilot made sure that both sides got equal time looking at the mountain.  Though our flight was one of the last that day, our pilot was enthusiastic and it never felt like he was just going through the motions.  A once in a lifetime experience that shouldn't be missed!

What a fantastic experience.  Soaring over glaciers and mountain tops and then landing on a glacier was a bucket list accomplishment!  The pilot Pat was great and informative.  The views were indescribably beautiful.  It was very cool to land on the glacier and get out and  experience the snow/ice.  I would highly recommend this trip.

review_title: Must do. You can never get such a view without taking a flight
review_text: This is a must do when you visit Alaska and this is the only way you can see the Denali peak. The view from the flight is one of it kind. It gives you an idea of how large the mountains and peaks are. But the most important thing in that you have good clear weather. We got lucky. Our captain was really good and gave us information during the flight. He also took photos for us after we landed on the glacier. The only downside was that we was there on the glacier only for few minutes. A little more time on the glacier would be good. I would recommend this to all tourists.

We flew with Mike on the Denali Flyer with glacier landing, and had an absolutely fantastic time!  What a great pilot and guy.  All of the staff at K2 were very helpful and pleasant, providing us with a once in a lifetime experience. Thanks so much!

I had a "reservation" to fly, but waited over a hour. I saw lightening and storm clouds- I was told by pilot that it was a small cell that we'd fly around. IMMEDIATELY after takeoff the pilot said there were forest fires north of us and there was a bad haze decreasing visibility, and the increasing cloud cover would not allow us to see Denali!! The pilot played music and rarely spoke! When he did it was impossible to decifer what he said. When we landed on the glacier, he told us he liked flying, but was an introvert and hated talking! Then why was he doing flightseeing?? I'd done this flight previously and loved it- this one not so much! I know there are no guarantees, but K2 KNEW  the visibility was poor! I'm in Denali now- friends are supposed to fly today with another company, that has postponed the flight due to poor visibility and will cancel if it doesn't clear! Now that's how it should be done! Not just grab the money!! Check visibility/ ask people getting back what they saw. Expensive lesson!!

You must take a tour over Denali with K2.  Excellent service, smiling friendly and helpful. Patrick was our pilot and he did a super job of pointing everything out and educating us about Denali and the glaciers, great sense of humor.  This is an experience we will never ever forget,thank you K2

review_title: Denali Flight Seeing Grand Tour with Glacier Landing
review_text: We did the Denali Flight Seeing Grand Tour with Glacier Landing on July 6th. This was an excellent trip in all aspects. The reservation process via telephone went very smoothly; the person I talked to was very informative and nice. The check-in process and pre-flight briefing was also smooth and informative. Our pilot was very good and experienced. He gave us a lot of information. The views were out of this world good and the glacier landing was incredible. It's a bit pricy as you would expect, but we were able to get a AAA discount. I would highly recommend this trip to other tourists.

The rule of thumb is that there is a 1 in 3 chance of seeing Denali (Mt. McKinley) without cloud cover. However, on those days that Denali is in the open a flight is a must if your budget can manage it.

One morning following a rainy day we saw that Denali was in view and immediately booked a flight with K2 Aviation, which has a menu of several flight options including landing and walking on a glacier, flying over the lower reaches of the mountain, or flying over and around the  entire mountain. We chose the least expensive flight, over the lower reaches of the mountain, because it was the least expensive, my wife is nervous about flying in small planes, and I saw that lenticular clouds were starting to form near the mountain, a sign of high winds and turbulence.

The booking over the phone went fairly quickly; the drive to K2 took about an hour. There was a bit of a wait for processing, and so many people had booked flights that  there was little room indoors to sit until departing on our six-passenger Piper Cherokee, which was small but comfortable in terms of seating space and cabin temperature. 

We had a capable and well-informed pilot who provided an ongoing narrative that covered the key points of the area and Denali; he also kept a sharp eye out for moose (we spotted several) and bear (no luck). It turned out that high winds cut short the trips of the planes slated to fly above and around the entire mountain, so we were glad we had not opted for that.

We could hear our pilot talking to the control tower from time to time throughout the flight, reporting our location at various key points along the way and keeping track of the numerous other planes in our vicinity (when Denali is visible, all the flight tour services in the area are heavily booked). It is clear that K2's safety protocol is rigorous and well-execute.

Bottom line:  A wonderful experience, would do it again, many thanks to K2.

review_title: Ruined One Day of Our Vacation
review_text: After spending $400 round trip to get to K2, we were told that our glacier walk / plane tour was cancelled when we got there. Why they could not tell us earlier was disappointing. There wasn't a lot to do in the town where they are located and we were stuck until our arranged transportation left. It was too late to book anything else. I get the weather can cancel flights; however, maybe be nicer about it and offer something more than a refund? To add insult to injury, while we were having dinner, we saw one of their planes that had the landing gear for ice pass over us.

This excursion was wonderful!!  The scenery was awesome and we got tons of great pictures. Although we were not able to land on the glacier, the experience was one that should not be missed. The pilot was very knowledgeable and answered any question that came up. Because we were not able to land on the glacier- the staff was quick to refund an amount back to my credit card - no problems. Would definitely use them again!
With weather moving in we opted for a shorter one hour flight. Billy was an awesome pilot, narrating glaciers, peaks, passes, flora and fauna. Don't miss this opportunity!

The clouds parted as we approached Denali and my jaw dropped. The glorious twin peaks came into view veiled with misty clouds and the sun drenched snow covered shear walls of granite blew my mind. We circle heaven for 30 minutes and then dropped down to follow Ruth glacier all the way back home. 

This was my second trip to Talkeetna. The first time it rained and I never saw the mountain so this time I allowed three days to stay flexible with flying times. Sure enough it rained on our scheduled flight time but K2 was very good about rescheduling for the next day and even suggested I call before my flight time to see if there was and opening for our group to land on the glacier. Unfortunately the rain made the glacier to soft for landing so K2 offered a one hour flight only tour. We all agreed it was an amazing experience anyway. 

My father was very afraid to fly on such a small plane. Our pilot took off and landed the Otter plane so quickly we could not even feel it. He gave us safety instructions before taking off and a good verbal tour of the mountain during the flight. 

Do it!

I had always wanted to fly around Denali but never wanted to spend the money & decided it was probably my last time visiting Alaska(my 7th visit) so we had a beautiful, clear day & on impulse we decided to go for it as they had a vacancy. Everything & everyone was very professional & friendly. The flight to the mountain was beautiful & our pilot was very informative. Seeing the mountain so close was spiritual. The glacier landing was so smooth & fun to get in the snow. You will not be disappointed in taking this excursion. Depending on your flight selection, sit on the right side of the plane to be closest to the mountain for pictures(glacier landing). They give you snow(wet) gear but not gloves or sunglasses.
A beautiful way to see Denali and the surrounding area. This trip is highly recommended. The pilot was knowledgeable about the area.

I had no idea what to expect.  We literally flew completely around the peaks of Denali.  The views were breathtaking and so surreal.  We were looking out and down at massive vertical rock walls, tons of snow, cornices, avalanched areas, mountain peaks and clouds everywhere, bright blue glacial pools and massive glaciers.  We followed one glacier that was twenty seven miles long.  From the snow and ice on the mountain down to the tundra where it changed from white to gray to green then finally into a river. Unbelievable experience.  One warning, it was very very bumpy on the north side of the summit and my husband got motion sickness.  The aircraft was the finest around and the pilot was very knowledgeable and experienced.  I'd recommend this trip to everyone.
did not get to land on the glacier but safety first and we were thrilled with the flight and they offer military discounts so don't forget to ask about that!

review_title: A beautiful smooth flight in capable hands.   Landings were perfect and fun!
review_text: Wonderful and memorable.  The highlight of my week in Alaska!  Pilot's narration was interesting and informative.

Superb from start to finish. Very professional outfit. Magnificent views, very knowledgeable pilot/guide. We were disappointed because the glacier landing was canceled but this was due to weather and showed how safety-conscious they were. Highly recommend this

review_title: cannot even put into words it's so beautiful
review_text: Our pilot, Chip, was extremely informative about his job, the surroundings and history. It was BY FAR one of the most exciting excursions I have ever taken. You just can't describe what it is like to stand on a glacier looking at the magnificence of the Denali mountain.It's a must see!

We had a beautiful, smooth flight over the glaciers and an incredible opportunity to land on the glacier!! The weather was beautiful with Denali completely visible which we know is rare! We were traveling with a friend who had climbed Denali in 1994! Can't say enough positive about the pilot (Mike) and K-2 experience!

review_title: Even better than expected - and our expectations were high!
review_text: We had scheduled a glacier landing but the weather precluded that.  As a pilot myself, I completely understood and, of course, agreed with the decision.  Instead, our pilot took us flying over glaciers, in between rock walls, and over fascinating terrain.  In spite of the change in plans, we were delighted with the experience.  Our pilot was more than just a proficient aviator; he was a knowledgeable and delightful guide, continuously pointing out items of interest and lingering at interesting locations. We were fortunate enough to observe another airplane about a mile away in one of the valleys to give us a scale of reference; without anything of known size below, it is easy to underestimate the size of the vistas.  Bring a camera.  I did, but never got it out; I was too busy enjoying the experience.  If you are unsure about whether or not to book a flight, stop wondering - DO IT.  My wife, who is interested in geology, asked that I add exclamation points throughout this review.  I am collecting them all here - ! ! ! ! ! !

review_title: Flightseeing and glacier landing on Mt. Denali
review_text: FAbulous flight over Denali and landing on a Glacier. Well informed pilot who eplained geology, weather, climbing, history, etc. in a comfortable safe 10 passenger plane. Everyone had his own window!

review_title: K2Aviation flight over and around Denali, Flightseeing, Glacier landing
review_text: Fabulous ride in comfortable and safe Otter, a ten passenger plane, which circled around Mt. Denali,  pilot gave wonderful monologue about area, geology, animal and plant life, history.  Had a 1/2 hour on top of the Ruth Glacier to play in the snow. A lucky clear bluy sky day, could even see climbers (looked like ants)
Flight around Denali. fantastic views and pilot, fantastic views and pilot, fantastic views and pilot

Wir waren schon letztes Jahr hier im Park und konnten den Denali nicht sehen. Dieses Jahr lautete die Wetterprognose günstiger und wir sprachen deshalb am Vorabend im Office von K2 vor. Wir erwarben die letzten zwei Tickets für die «Denali Grand Tour» ohne Gletscherlandung; ein absolutes Highlight wie sich am Folgetag heraus stellte.
Um 10:30 ging es mit einer leistungsstarken DHC-2 Mk III Turbo Beaver los. Unser Pilot Mike, ein Mittfünfziger, begleitete den Flug fundiert, kommentierte von Anbeginn an und beantwortete alle Fragen. 
Wir flogen über den Toksitna Glacier ein, kurvten ausgiebig vor Mount Foraker, Mount Hunter und dem Denali und gewannen dabei weiter an Höhe bis auf 12 000 Fuss. Mike steuerte die Maschine so, dass alle Passagiere links und rechts gleichermassen die eindrückliche Gletscherlandschaft geniessen konnten. Auf dem privilegiertem Sitz des Co-Piloten hatte ich dieses Problem allerdings nicht. Wir umrundeten den Denali auf der Westseite, flogen also im Uhrzeigersinn zur Ostseite, von da um den Mount Silverthrone, über den North Fork Glacier zum Sheldon Amphitheater und von da aus über The Great Gorge und den Ruth Glacier nach Talkeetna zurück. Der Flug verlief extrem ruhig und dauerte 1h 30min.
Das Gesehene lässt sich mit Worten nicht beschreiben: Es war unwahrscheinlich schön, ein einzigartiges Erlebnis und für uns wohl einmalig. 
Jetzt warte ich gespannt auf das Video, das Standardaufnahmen und zusätzlich 10min. individuellen Film von unserem Flug zeigen soll.

This was a highlight of our 16 day adventure in Alaska!  The staff is so friendly and experienced.  We were put at ease at once.  Shout out to Barry!!  The ride was scenic and breathtaking.  We landed on a glacier...SO COOL!!  The kids were awestruck! (not easy to do with teenagers...)  The pilots were great!  Everyone felt at ease.  This is a MUST SEE!!

We flew from Talkeetna to Anchorage with a fabulous detour over Denali and the Alaska Range. Our pilot took us through some amazing scenic passes over glaciers and around mountain tops with "the Great One" always in view. We were fortunate to have had a day of sun and high clouds creating spectacular views.
Our pilot was very informative and eagerly answered our questions and requests.

Ed Galenkamp

We took the K2 Denali Flyer with Glacier Landing a few days ago. Fortunately, Denali was mostly visible which we understand is not typical. K2 runs a very efficient and effective operation out of Talkeetna. We flew in a group of 9 in an Otter with an excellent pilot. Smooth as silk!

We took the Denali Flyer tour with K2. The day we'd booked for it wasn't possible to fly because of bad weather, but we got an email very early to say that was the case, and when I rang to follow up on that (at 7:30am) I spoke to someone immediately who talked me through the options really clearly. We ended up re-booking for 3 days later (when the weather was perfect). The flight was terrific, the pilot friendly and informative, the itinerary content and length were exactly what I was hoping for. I felt completely safe, and the overall quality of the experience was truly first class. I would highly recommend this tour and K2 in general.

review_title: Absolutely fantastic ride - worth the price!
review_text: Having made a reservation to do a flightseeing trip months before we arrived in Talkeetna, I had the very good fortunate to have the sun shining throughout this spectacular trip. My wife opted to not accompany me on this ride. After checking in at K2 Aviation, and then getting weighed, I and others waited a little while for the 4:30 p.m. flight. Finally, the five of us on this trip had our names called and we met our pilot, Craig. We chatted briefly and then walked with him to the airplane. Craig gave us a very thorough review of the plane, the safety features, where things were located, how things worked, etc. Then we climbed in. Since I was the only "single" person on the trip with two other couples, I got to sit in the co-pilot's seat. We put on our head-sets so we could talk with and hear each other during the flight. Craig did his pre-flight checklist, he started the engine, we taxied down the runway, and off we went. Oh, what a ride! Non-stop unbelievable views as we neared then flew into and around Mt. Foraker, Mt. Hunter, Denali itself, the other mountains. We saw gigantic glaciers below us. We saw sheer walls filled with snow pack. We saw mountains above us, below us, in front of us as far as the eye could see. Our pilot shared information about the names of various mountains and glaciers and geologic features. It was absolutely spectacular! Beyond description! After about 1.25 hours, we headed back to the airport. Even as we descended, the gorgeous views of the lakes and rivers below us were breathtaking. All of us marveled at the beauty that we saw during our ride. I took many minutes of videos during the trip which I showed my wife after we deplaned. This plane ride was a major highlight of my (our) trip to Alaska. If you can afford it, do it! It is nothing short of magnificent!

Very good experience. Pilot Randy was outstanding. Garrett at the desk was very courteous. Only beef was flight didnt depart till 320pm with a promised booked trip depart time of 230pm, so my next appointment was missed. Would definitely use again and highly recommend due to the level of service and good pricing.

My husband and I booked one of the Glacier landing flights and it was awesome.  The pilot was great and the views were breathtaking. It was the only time we got a clear photo of Mt. Denali while on vacation.  I didn't think the glacier looked big enough for us to land on.  Not only did we have a smooth landing but several other planes landed at the same time with plenty of room to spare.  It was an unforgettable experience.  Visiting Alaska was probably a once in a lifetime experience for us and I'm so glad that we included this flight.  I would definitely recommend adding a glacier landing flight to your vacation.  It was well worth the money it cost.

review_title: Fly-in Hike to Denali National Park
review_text: Booked the flight seeing and hiking tour through K2 on 6/27.  Our first trip to Alaska. Weather and cloud cover delayed our scheduled tour and bumped us back to later in the afternoon.  K2 was very accommodating and did their best to work alternatives with the forecasted weather.  The 2 hour hike in Denali had to be curtailed due to weather conditions that were approaching, but we had an awesome pilot, Chip, that made it a great experience nonetheless.  Chip was very knowledgeable and personable and provided a great narrated fly over of the Ruth Glacier. Landed on Moraine Lake and was able to walk around for about 25 minutes to take in the incredible and beautiful surroundings that very few get to even see.  Fantastic.  Chip also pointed out moose and other cool features to and from.  Highly recommend this tour option as a great way to see such an awesome place.

Our flight with K2 was a "peak" experience in every way. A few dramatic clouds framed the mountains against a deep blue sky and we had clear views of the rivers of ice flowing beneath us and the braided glacial rivers of the Solsitna valley. Our pilot, Kevin, narrated the flight with fascinating details. All in all, this will join my short list of most enduring travel memories. Thank you K2!

I had an excellent flight. The business is well organized and the aircraft are top notch. The pilot (Barry) was very enjoyable and skilled. I felt very comfortable in flight and the scenery is breathtaking. Schedule your flight so that you don't miss this.

Words cannot describe the magnificent beauty that can only be seen on an "up close and personal" trip such as this one!  Yeah, it costs a little, but it was definitely worth it for this once in a lifetime opportunity!  Our pilot, Randy, was very professional, capable, and knowledgeable, and the Otter aircraft was very suited for such an adventure...one that my wife and I will never forget!
The weather was bad when we took off. The weather cleared and we saw Denali. Our pilot did a great job of giving us the max view of the range. This is a top notch tour company.

review_title: Surreal views - do the glacier landing
review_text: My wife and I went on the Denali flyer tour and it was incredible. Our pilot Randy was wonderful and very informative. We landed on Pika glacier which was a one-of-a-kind experience. Walking on it and being in the middle of such enormous mountains was unforgettable.
We had a beautiful sunny day and the scenery was wonderful.  Couldn't believe how warm it was on the glacier and my goofy brother-in-law made a snow angel.

We booked the Denali Experience (1 hour flight, no glacier landing), but it was pretty cloudy on the day of our flight. Other passengers were rescheduling because K2 wasn’t doing any glacier landings that day, and K2 was offering refunds to some customers.  The staff showed us that our flight would be lower than usual, but there was still stuff to see, so we decided to go ahead with it. Our flight was a full one, 9 passengers in an Otter, because some of the customers who had originally booked a glacier landing decided to take the shorter flight instead.

Well overall, it was a great experience. My main goal for the flight was to get a good view of a glacier, and we spent a lot of time flying low over Ruth Glacier, which was awesome. Our pilot was a great tour guide and made us feel very safe. He made sure we all had a good view of the glacier, plus pointed out some bears and moose that we passed over. Every passenger had a window seat, and it was a smooth flight in spite of the clouds. I would definitely recommend flying with K2, but keep in mind that when you check in for your flight, you may need to make some immediate decisions based on the current weather.

We were very fortunate to have a clear day for our flight and glacier landing. We were awestruck by the closeup view of Denali and the glacier experience. Our pilot was professional and engaging with all the insiders' info that really make these types of adventures even more memorable. Highly recommend.

We waited til we got to Talkeetna to see how the weather would be. We went to K2 Aviation and we were able to book a flight and glacier landing. All I can say is "WOW"!!!! It was soooo beautiful up there. You can't imagine the scope of it til you're flying around the mountains and being so close to them. It seemed like you could reach out and touch them. We got some really excellent views of Denali and the other mountains. Then there was the glacier landing. It was super. You get out of the plane and it's so quiet and peaceful and just  awesome.  There was another plane there so we watched as they took off and when we were leaving another plane was just landing. It was fun to watch these other planes. Our pilot Randy did a great job of telling us about all the facts and highlights of the flight. This is an absolute " must do".  It was expensive for us, but so worth the money to experience  it. It is something we won't forget. Add it to your bucket list.!!!!!!!!!!
Most awesome!  Even though the weather wasn't good enough to land on the glacier we truly enjoyed the flight!

Easy to locate and get checked in for the flight. Unfortunately the weather wasn't good enough for the Grand Tour and glacier landing so we opted for the one hour flight over a closer glacier. My hubby, who is also a pilot, was lucky enough to fly in the "right seat" so he got the best views. Our pilot was very educational and had a good sense of humor. Would so love to have the opportunity for the Grand Tour but it won't be this year.

review_title: Fantastic views and a fun way to see the area!
review_text: We were booked on a flight seeing trip with a glacier landing.  Unfortunately do to snow conditions on the glacier we weren't able to land.  They immediately refunded that portion of our trip and sent us up on a regular sight seeing flight.  Unfortunately our plane experienced some mechanical issues and we had to turn back.  Our pilot handled the issue calmly and got us back safely.  K2 then promptly got us onto another flight and were able to see the beautiful mountains and glaciers from the plane.  While we would have rather had our glacier landing and a working plane, some things are out of the company's control and I feel like they did everything in their power to accommodate us.  I'd definitely recommend it!
