Take this trip with k2 aviation.  You will not regret it. We booked the Summit Tour (the Grand is similar) and were blown away by how close you get to everything within the Alaska Range and seeing the great one, Denali from 1000ft away.

Important things to know -- the weather on the mountain changes quickly, so book this for an early day in your vacation incase you need to bump it to another day. We were able to easily move another tour scheduled in another city (everyone was really nice all the way around).  If you book the Summit Tour, your plane will need 6 people at least (you and others) and perfect conditions, otherwise you'll get the Grand Tour which is also epic.  They will already offer you the difference so no hassle there.  If you need to bump to another day, bend over backwards to make it work because it is absolutely worth it.

K2 is a quality provider of a once in a lifetime experience and I cannot recommend them strongly enough!

Highly recommend..daniel, our pilot, was very knowledgeable. ..view of Denali was breathtaking, landing on the Pika Glacier was great.. our granddaughter wanted to take the snow home...time on glacier was to short....so beautiful

We pre-booked a flight-seeing tour with a glacier landing while visiting Talkeetna.  It was one of the highlights of our entire cruise-tour!  The flight was amazing and the glacier landing was unforgettable.  The whole crew at K2 was great, but our pilot/guide Chip was outstanding.  He was very knowledgeable and entertaining.  IMO, this is a MUST DO excursion and K2 is the perfect choice to do it.

review_title: The highlight of our Alaska trip!
review_text: We booked our flight & hike adventure with K2 back in January, and we lucked out on weather the day of our flight. It was bright and sunny, the only day of sun we had while in Alaska. Our pilot, Chip, was fantastic. His running commentary about the geology, wildlife, and natural history of the area was excellent. He gave us background info about our plane (the 1949 de Havilland Beaver) and a nice safety brief to start. Our hike guide from Alpine Adventures, Alex, was also excellent. We hiked a moderate 2 miles and he pointed out geological features, rocks, plants, and more. The glass of wine at the end of our hike was a nice touch. Our flight back was equally awesome, with a wing dip to view the moulin where the moraine lake dips under Ruth Glacier and a great view of the "bubbling pond" where it comes out again. We saw moose in the meadows and incredible views of the mountains! Having never flown in a small plane before, I was nervous until I saw how relaxed our pilot was. Take off and landing were smooth and it was a perfect day! If we ever get to return to Alaska, I will definitely hire K2 again!

I'll have to give a lot of credit to Mother Nature as well as K2, since the weather was nearly perfect for our flight around Denali. A sunny, nearly cloudless day is not typical, but I'll take it! We spent an hour and a half going over to Denali area, landing on Pika Glacier for 15 mins or so, and traversing through the peaks amidst the glaciers. Spectacular - it doesn't get any better. Although I got a lot of pix, I also gladly paid extra to get a video of our sojourn from K2. The pilot was very competent and provided lots of info. Definitely a once in a lifetime experience for us.

review_title: You are at the mercy of the weather on this adventure
review_text:
The K 2 sightseeing flight was part of a package which we booked thru our cruise line and we were supposed to board the plane(s) in Anchorage and have a fairly long sightseeing flight from Anchorage to the Summit airstrip near Denali NP. Well the weather didn't cooperate and not much of that day went according to plan, but it was not the fault of the dedicated professionals at K 2 Aviation. They are consummate professionals, but they cannot control the weather, especially in the area around Denali, so you simply don't know what you will encounter until the time for your flight arrives. Just be prepared for a 'change of plan'and be flexible and understanding, knowing that your pilot and the other K 2 staff have your safety and comfort as their primary consideration.
Even though we had a 1 1/2 hour flight in a vintage aircraft (DeHaviland Otter), we didn't get to see a lot other than low clouds, intermittent rain and a few glimpses of glaciers and rivers in the general vicinity of Denali and we landed at Talkeetna (K 2's home base and the locale of the old TV series 'Northern Exposure'), rather than at the Summit airstrip which then entailed a 3 hour+ bus ride to McKinley Village, but such happenings cannot be predicted nor forecast with any degree of certainty in Alaska.
Great tour.  Patrick the pilot was excellent.  Plane was clearly well maintained.  Price was reasonable.  Looking forward to the video.

review_title: Great tour, but you are at the mercy of the weather!
review_text: We originally signed up for the Summit tour, but the weather did not cooperate and we were only able to do the Experience. The office there really has their hands full trying to get everyone the best flight given the weather at the time. The pilot was very knowledgeable and friendly, and the views are awesome from the plane! If you want to see Denali, this is the way.

Our family of six adults took the Grand Denali Tour offered by K2  and it was worth every penny.   Stan was our pilot and we had a spectacular tour around Mt. Denali with the landing on Ruth Glacier.  Every aspect of this event was truly first-class--- we thank Stan (our pilot) and the K2 staff for such a memorable experience.  Truly one of the top things to do on your visit to Alaska.
This trip did not disappoint! The sky cleared and we got beautiful views of Denali! And what a view!! The only way to see the park, the mountain and the surroundings!

We had some weather, so didn't fly around the entire mountain as we originally booked. Staff was great in giving us a refund for not getting the full flight, and clarifying we may not get to land on the glacier if the pilot didn't see it was safe. They were honest and forthcoming about the conditions and possibility of not landing on the glacier. We got some awesome pics and had the experience of a lifetime. I wouldn't hesitate to book with k2 again!

review_title: Beautiful flight, confused office staff and dishonest pilot took away from what could've been an amazing experience!
review_text:
Beautiful flight, confused office staff and dishonest pilot took away from what could've been an amazing experience!  Doing a land tour on our own prior to a cruise, we decided we would include a sightseeing tour if time and weather permitted.  The day we left Denali NP I called K2 Aviation and was told we were doing flights and they would need to have me in the office at minimum 30 minutes prior to flight.  We planned a hike in Denali so decided to call after we left Denali and see if there were still seats available.  After we were on the road for a bit and I got a cell tower signal I called K2 Aviation.  I was told there was seats available to accommodate our family of 4 and I could either book it over the phone or just wait until we arrived.  We were still about an hour away so I was a bit concerned that the seats may be sold by the time we got there.  I was assured that was unlikely as it was an empty plane and they could do whatever tour we wanted.  I was told there were two flights we could choose either 6:30pm or 7:00pm.  I told the lady on the phone that it would be after 6pm so we would probably have to take the 7pm flight since she also said we would have to be in the office 30 minutes prior to our flight.  Since my cell service was not very good and getting worse I told her we would wait until we got there, as she had suggested, to reserve with our names.  We rushed to get there omitting a few stops/pullouts along the way (boo, as Denali was out in plain view).  

We get to the office and are inside by 6:20pm only to be told they weren't sure there were enough seats for us and the flight was at 6:30.  I told them I was told over the phone that there was another flight at 7pm.  The girl said that flight was moved up to 6:30 to accommodate guests who had to be back for a  "Princess" tour departure.  She said she would ask the dispatcher.  As I was waiting another person came up and asked if they could help.  I explained the other girl was checking on the flight.  Eventually one of them came back and said they could take us on the 6:30 flight.  I said that's only in 10 minutes, is there time?  She said she would check and then I was told there was actually two flights, but they were both at 6:30.  Then another person told me one would leave after the other and that there was indeed one at 7pm, but that all flights actually had to be in the air by 7pm.  We wanted the Denali summit with glacier landing since we had been told over the phone they could do any flight we wanted.  However, the girl said both flights were the Denali Experience flights.  I doubt we would have rushed there skipping pullouts/viewpoints with fabulous views of Denali for that flight, but since we were already there we decided to take that flight.  I said I would take the last flight as it would give us more time to fill out paperwork, go to the restroom, and it would not be rushed to get back due to the "Princess" tour people.  So while we were waiting we looked around at shirts and my husband asked the girl if the office would be open for us to buy shirts when we got back.  She said yes, so we proceeded outside to wait for our flight.

We all were excited and my son especially was excited.  He was first in line standing at the gate with my husband while everyone else sat in chairs and waited.  When the pilot came through he even made comment to my son and husband that they were ready to go waiting at the gate.  As we ventured out to the plane, the pilot went over some standard safety rules, etc.  Then he asked if anyone would like to be his "co-pilot".  My son raised his hand and another girl (not sure of age probably around 14-17) raised hers.  He told the girl to climb in and looked at my son and said we will switch when we land on the glacier that there would actually be two opportunities to "co-pilot".  Since we were at the front of the line we moved to the front seats of the plane so others would not have to be climbing around as they entered and were seated.  I didn't think much about it, but our seats had to be some of the worst.  I was second row and could not get a clear view for a photo without part of the plane in the photograph.  It wasn't great, but it was still beautiful  The weather was beautiful and the landscape is amazing!  We had a great flight and landing on the glacier.  Other planes were there and we were the last to leave since we were the last flight.  So at one point we were the only plane on the glacier, which was nice.  However, as we were getting ready to get back into the plane I overheard the pilot tell a woman to climb on up in the seat beside him.  I stopped and turned around and said I thought (I said my son's name) was going to get to co-pilot on the return.  The pilot kind of hemmed around and said well, you can't really see from there anyway.  I said well, I understood he would get that chance on the way back and he was looking forward to it.  The pilot looked at my 13 y/o son (who is small for his age) and said well you can't really see anything from there anyway.  He continued to say all of the controls would block his view from the front.  I said well he was looking forward to it.  The pilot told the lady to go ahead.  Needless to say my son was crushed!  My son is a bit reserved and doesn't speak up for himself much so he remained quiet, but I could see the look on his face he was obviously disappointed.  The pilot had basically told him he could co-pilot on the return, but then gave that opportunity to someone else.  The part that made my husband most upset was the fact that the pilot was condescending by saying the control panel would make it harder for him to see!  Actually there is a wall between the 1st row and the pilot cockpit area.  So the only view from the seat we were in was from the side window anyway!  The co-pilot still would have the side window to see out of!  So no, Mr. Pilot, that was a lie!  The view would not have been worse from the co-pilot seat!  

So when we landed he turned around and told my son that after he parked he could climb into the co-pilot seat and see what it was like if he wanted!  Seriously?!  When the plane came to a stop the lady in the co-pilot seat handed the pilot a tip.  I sure hope he got what he deserved from that tip, because he lost the $50 tip from us!  There were four of us (also have a 12 y/o daughter) so our plan was to tip $50.  When we exited the plane I asked my husband if he was going to stop by the office to get the shirts we picked out.  He said "nah, I don't want any".  He then looked at my son and asked if he wanted a shirt (we had all picked out shirts), but my son just shook his head no.  He was obviously crushed.  So we headed straight for the car and left.  After we left I reminded my husband I had wanted to purchase the video of our flight, but forgot because I was so upset over what had happened.  I honestly don't remember much about the return flight as I was so upset and disappointed for my son that I was distracted.  

I want to emphasize that it's not that I expect my son to have had the opportunity over anyone else, but it was the fact that the pilot and told him he could have that opportunity on the return flight and then gave it to someone else.  Then the pilot told my son he wouldn't be able see over the controls anyway.  Horrible!   My daughter is 12 y/o and the only reason she didn't raise her hand to co-pilot was because she knew it meant a lot to her brother and she wanted him to have that opportunity.  

So, why two stars?  I believe the experience could have been amazing!  The planes seem to be good condition, but I can't vouch for sure.  I deducted for the miscommunication from the office staff over the phone vs. when we got there.  Not to mention that I was getting different info from different people even after I was physically in the office.  Finally, the dishonesty of the pilot.  I believe a company is only as good as the people who work there.  So a confusing office staff and dishonest pilot takes away 3 stars!  I wish we had taken our time driving and experienced the beautiful scenery along our drive and skipped this tour.  I'd rather have not had the experience than to see my son treated so poorly!  With such beautiful landscape, this should have been nothing short of an amazing experience!

Oh, and I want to mention that although we were the last flight and the last to leave the glacier, our pilot had to slow down as he had caught up with the plane that left several minutes before us.  Apparently some of the Princess people were also on our plane and he was rushing to get them back!  So we landed right behind the other plane.  

Now to help those who plan to take this tour anyway here are the tips I'd offer:

Bring:  Camera, a jacket (wasn't terribly cold on the glacier), sunglasses, and extra cash for gratuities in the event you have a great experience and wish to tip the pilot.  

Make advance reservations and don't rely on the info given over the phone to wait until you get there.

If you have a glacier landing flight they have complimentary glacier boots that fit over your shoes prior to you taking the flight.  

Most importantly have no expectations!

If you want the best experience of flight seeing, then K2 is the place to fly from.  Seeing the summit of Denali and landing on Eldridge Glacier were absolutely stunning.  Chris was our pilot and he provided a great commentary about the mountain and the area.  We were the second plane to land that day.  We had great views of Denali and the landing was fantastic.  There were 6 in our group.  Chris provided a unique experience when he asked everyone to be quiet.  It was surreal to listen to the solitude.  If you ever get the chance to do this, I hope that you enjoy it as much as we did.

K2 Aviation promised a safe and breathtaking adventure with the air tour over Denali NP and Glacier landing and they definitely delivered!  Our pilot, Patrick, was great, experienced and provided in flight interpretation of what we were seeing and experiencing.  We really were blessed with great weather which made for a smooth flight and the bonus of being able to land on the Pica Glacier.  At times I felt like I could reach out and touch those mountains.  It was the thrill of a lifetime and the grand finale of our 10 day Alaska extravaganza!  Highly recommend as a must do for the ole bucket list!!

We were in a Cessna 185 with another couple who had never flown in a small airplane before this trip.  The pilot was excellent, he tolerated us, (2 critical pilots, as passengers) and provided us with a very well narrated tour.  I was taking photos from the rear jump seat and he made sure that I was able to get the good shots.  Wonderful local knowledge for an 'east coaster' and great mountain flying.  Highly recommend this company.  Thank you Billy!

We cannot say enough about our recent flight with pilot Dan this Fathers' Day. After the initial disappointment of technical difficulties on the plane that was to take us to the summit of Denali we were treated instead to a Glacier Landing that was probably the most exciting event in my life with the exception of course of marriage and childbirth. Yup. Right up there!. What a great time!  We are so thankful to your staff and of course grateful for the skill and professionalism of our pilot Dan. We will never forget this!  Thank you so much!
Super trip with pilot, Josh. Very impressive, rugged environment with climbers on the mountain. Glaciers galore up to 12,000 ft altitude.

We had an amazing experience on the glacier landing flight from Telkeetna flown by K2. Our pilot was super and so was the view. He explained all the details before and during the flight and seemed an incredible resource on glaciers.Never thought the landing on glacier would be so smooth. Take your camera along and shoot all the way. An experience to cherish life long.

review_title: Thank you for a wonderful time!
review_text: Thank you to Stan our pilot for taking us on his favorite flight since we couldn't do Mt. Denali. Stan made it all very enjoyable. And thank you to Kat for suggesting and shuttling us to The Roadhouse for breakfast after our flight. K2 has very friendly people that go the extra mile!

review_title: Amazing flight and views of Denali
review_text: We decided on the spur of the moment to take a flight to see Denali.  We had an 11:20 am train to catch back to Fairbanks but K2 was able to accommodate us on an 8:30 am flight, which was supposed to be for just an hour, but we stayed in the air a good hour and a half!  Denali was magical.  The flight couldn't have been any better!
Stan our pilot was not only an awesome pilot, he was very well versed on the mountains and glaciers and the geological aspects of the phenomenon. Highly recommend this trip

review_title: Cool views even on a cloudy day
review_text: We booked the Denali Grand tour but had to change to the Denali Flyer tour because of bad weather. It was kinda cloudy and rainy the day we went but we still had a great flight and still got up close and personal to the glaciers and parts of the mountain. Flight was a little choppy because of the winds but overall the pilot was excellent and we enjoyed our time. Just be willing to be flexible with your flight plan and sit back and enjoy the ride. The seats are roomier than the flight out to Alaska on Alaska Airlines too.

review_title: We nearly touched the Denali peak!!
review_text:
The flight exploration of the Denali National Park with K2 was amazing! We were *this* close to the Denali peak. Our pilot, Mike, was very good about giving us all kinds of facts and stories - like how many people attempt to summit the Denali, and how some of them have to be brought back by helicopters etc. 

He even showed us a black bear that was wandering through the forest. 

He was very good about making sure that people on both - left and right sides - got all the views. 

I totally recommend K2 and this excursion!
Our pilot Brian was knowledgeable and provided ample opportunity to see the mountains and glaciers up close from both sides of the aircraft.  Kudos K2!!

This is an experience my family and I will never forget. The glacier landing was smooth and the flight was easy 30 minute out with at least 20 minutes on the Glacier and 45 minute back. Snow was perfect and made you wonder if you were the first to see it . Simply beautiful. We were a party of four with two small children and they enjoyed it as much as the adults. Pilot was excellent and handled the plane perfectly. Thank you K2 Aviation for a wonderful memory of Alaska!!
Even though the weather had clouded up, our 5pm flight with Mark ended up being spectacular.  We were under the clouds and able to see all of the majestic scenary and Mt. Denali!  Really good time.

Cat was very knowledgeable and a hoot . Great person to have working for you . Pilot Chris Wilson took us on a totally fantastic flight. His easy going and reassuring professional style provided solace for my skittish friend who shall remain forever unarmed but claims to be an intrepid Alaskan!

review_title: One of our Top 5 Excursions Ever
review_text: The whole experience, from scheduling, to weather updates, to actually flying around Denali and a glacier landing was world class.  The flight exceeded our expectations and became one of our top 5 excursions ever.  The professionalism, expert narration, amazing scenery and first hand experience of standing on a glacier in the midst of the mountain majesty was awesome.

The experience was thrilling.  A modification had to be made to my flight plans, but I was not disappointed.  Despite the change in weather and being unsure about a Glacier landing, we were able to do it.

I had originally booked a flight to Denali NP, but because of the weather, no flights were going there that day. I was offered a flight to the Knik glacier, which I took. It was a nice flight, and a beautiful area for an alternative flight.

Our grand tour of Denali was magnificent. We enjoyed views of Denali from every possible angle as we completely circled the mountain. The landing on Ruth glacier was the capstone to a most enjoyable excursion.

review_title: My highlight of my Alaska trip
review_text: This was the amazing trip I ever had in my life. Once in a lifetime experience we couldn't land on a glacier because of the weather conditions, still loved every each moment of this tour. I was the copilot and got the chance to see most beautiful and breathtaking places the glaciers. The scenery was breathtaking would love to go back and experience this again. Thank you K2 Aviation for this unforgettable moments

From the moment we booked our flight at their location on Main St. all the way through to touch down, everything was very professional and well organized.  Our pilot, Daniel was the best, very knowledgeable about the area and glaciers, made us all feel comfortable in the plane and had a great sense of humor.  You can tell he loves his job and he's not a bad photographer. ;-)
We paid for the 1.25 hr. Grand Tour and were flying for nearly 2 hrs.  Safe and beautiful.  Also had a very comfortable facility, including picnic tables.

First rate operation! Safety is number 1 but is closely followed by making sure you have a great experience. We were fortunate to have "Perfect" weather the day of our trip. We were scheduled to go at 9:00 am with a glacier landing included but with clear sky's and very cold temps on the mountain they called early saying the glacier froze to hard for a landing. We went at 11:00 am instead. They were very accommodating and the sky's were clear and the glacier softened up so we landed. Unbelievable experience and views that only 30% of visitors see. Along with me was my wife and two friends. This was more than an activity, it was phenomenal! Spend the money, you won't regret it.
Great tour. Stan was our pilot and tour guide, he was outstanding, informative and professional. We ha a great flight and walk on the glacier. It was breathtaking, a must do in Alaska!
Not just a plane ride.  The most beautiful scenery delivered in a very comfortable plane, an extremely smooth ride and a very knowledgeable pilot. 5 star experience.

review_title: Fun flightseeing in a tiny airplane
review_text: We took off in the smallest plane in the fleet, which turned out to be perfect, as the day was cloudy and we were able to dart among the clouds until we were above them, with gorgeous views of Denali and the surrounding mountain range.  Our pilot was knowledgable and friendly.  He did everything possible to make our experience special, which it certainly was.  This is not a cheap activity, but if your budge can handle it, it's worth every cent.  Do it!

review_title: No Alaska Trip Complete Without This
review_text: My wife and I were flown by an excellent pilot to the Don Sheldon Amphitheater on the Ruth Glacier, experiencing stupendous views of glacier-carved granite mountainsides reminding one of a natural cathedral in all its beauty, and then tromping around on a 3800 feet thick glacier. Denali was shy that day - we couldn't quite see her, but had excellent views of Hunter, Mooses' Teeth, and part of Foraker. Our pilot pointed out many of the wonders along the way and invited questions, which he was happy to answer. It's one thing to see the Alaskan mountains - it's quite another thing to land in the midst of them! What a magnificent adventure! The K2 folks have it all figured out for you! Bring champagne and plastic cups for everyone!

Unbelievable experience!  We thoroughly enjoyed our flight.  Breathtaking views.  The highlight of our Alaskan trip.  Billy's an excellent pilot, making sure we got to see all there was.  Very knowledgeable about the area.  Thanks so much, Billy for making sure we had a memorable experience
What an amazing experience!  This should be on everyone's bucket list. The folks at K2 are very professional and they have excellent equipment. Don't hesitate, do this!

This was our first experience in Alaska and the first stop on our itenerary.  What an incredible experience-professional staff, experienced pilot.  Had the thrill of actually seeing the glaciers and Denali.  Our pilot was knowledgable and skilled and gave us an awesome tour.

This was the most amazing experience I've ever had in my life! We had a group of 17, in 2 planes and the views were amazing! We landed at base camp to pick up 2 climbers from Spain and their gear and that was definitely the highlight of the trip! The staff and pilots were awesome and even let my sister fly!

This trip with K2 and our pilot Mike was spectacular!! Our family of 17 were on two planes for our tour- at first the weather was not cooperating and we didn't think we were going to be able to land when we got to Denali. The flight was super smooth and the views- well there's no words to describe them! During our flight we got word 2 hikers needed picking up so we got to go to Kahiltna Pass where they have base camp set up for the climbers. Say what?!??? It was the most amazing thing to be able to land there and experience the beauty of the mountains around us and look up at the peak of Denali. So fantastic! As I said Mike was great- super knowledgeable and very safety conscious, I would highly recommend you fly with K2- you never know if you might end up at base camp!! Wooooohoooo!!

We scheduled ahead for a Denali tour with a glacier landing and an extended private tour. The weather didn't hold for the glacier landing but the private tour was wonderful. They will take you anywhere you want to go. Our pilot, Kevin, was very informative about everything we were seeing. He did a great job avoiding the weather and showing us Alaska. The plane was easy, everyone was comfortable and had a great view.

We had originally booked for a flight including a glacier landing, however on the day we arrived it had been snowing in Denali and the weather remained unfavorable.
First of all I was really impressed with the service and alternatives provided by K2, and they let us reschedule a couple of times in case the weather improved, and in the end we opted for a slightly different glacier tour being offered at a lower cost.
The tour itself was amazing and worth every penny. We were part of a group of 4, flying in a 6-seater Piper Cherokee and our pilot Craig was incredibly friendly, skilled and knowledgeable.
He kept up a running commentary for the whole duration and we learned a huge amount about the history of the area.
This was the smallest plane I have ever flown in, however I felt completely safe the whole time, and it was probably the smoothest take off and landing I have every experience.
On paper the flights look a bit expensive, but I think it is a must thing to do if you're in the area. I would definitely go back and fly with K2 again.

My family, including two small kids, just had the most amazing experience of our lives. 

Thanks to Chip, an amazing pilot/scientist/tour guide/naturalist/comedian/expert glacier navigator! 

Whatever your hesitation is about this tour, give it up and go. We saw Denali, landed on a glacier and had a snowball fight, and then spotted wildlife on the return trip. We learned so much, and we felt totally and completely safe, even with a 2nd and 5th grade passenger along. 

We can't thank Chip and the folks at K enough. Truly a life changing moment.

We postponed our flight a day to get more favorable weather so we could do the glacier landing. Randy was our Pilot and did a great job of narrating everything as we went. Was an amazing tour, a definite must while traveling through Talkeetna!
Great flight around the mountain with a nice airplane and Pilot.  Did this years ago with a but this was way better.  Took so many pictures and learned alot about Denali.

review_title: Denali flightseeing in all its glory!
review_text:
We arrived at K2 early.  The original 10:30 appointment time was not going to work, since the bus to the train to the cruise ship was leaving an hour earlier than scheduled.
Noel greeted us and was fantastic!  Yes we could go early, yes they had room and yes they would work it out.  Thank you K2!!  

Then off to fly with Billy the pilot.  There were 4 of us on the flight plus the pilot. Billy did a great job telling us all that we were seeing.  We flew out of Talkeetna and on to Denali to see the mountain up close and personal.  And boy did we see it!  Sunny, very few clouds and views for miles.  we flew around the mountain (no landing scheduled) and it was everything I could have hoped for.  

We landed, bought t-shirts and a video and made it back with plenty of time for the day.  Off to Talkeetna for lunch.  I would highly recommend K2.  They were personable and safe and we had a great flight.

review_title: I didn't know I could say WOW so many times in two hours.
review_text: We took the full tour of Denali with the glacier landing. My wife was a little apprehensive, but agreed to go. We have taken a lot of trips and we always have a great time, but this has to be one of the best. Alaska is fantastic and landing and walking on a glacier was beyond our expectations. Tom, our pilot kept us entertained with information about the surrounding  mountains. It is not cheap, but it is something you will never forget. K2 staff is excellent.

review_title: THE most AMAZING scenic flight seeing we have EVER had!
review_text: K-2 Aviation is the best.   They are friendly and fun, while being professional at the same time.  Making a reservation was easy, and I called back a couple of times to confirm, since I had made the reservations so early, and they cheerfully answered my questions.  The flight was amazing and our pilot, Chip, was not only an obviously experienced pilot, but also informative and friendly.  To top it off the good Lord gave us perfect weather to see Denali in all its glory!  A memorable experience that will last a lifetime!!!!

We flew with these people on a trip to land on Ruth Glacier.The preparations and briefing by the pilot was thorough and easily understood.We took off and flew towards the mountain range and then circled around various not points of interest the pilot was very informative and was able to answer any questions put to him. We eventually landed on the glacier and spent about half an hour there before taking off and travelling through the mountains and back to the airfield. This is a trip not to miss if you are visiting this area it is not cheap but is worth every penny

K2 aviation are the best!  My son and I went on a tour yesterday.  I've lived in Alaska for 4 years now and heard about the Denali tours and very glad we did it.  Chip was our pilot, very knowledgeable and great with people.  The views are spectacular and would do it again!   Once in a life time experience!

review_title: Great Experience and It is worth it!!
review_text: I took the tour with Glacier Landing. I was a great experience. I was co-pilot on the way back!! The overall experience and service is excellent. The staffs very friendly. The airplane is clean and well maintained. Highly recommended.

We recently went on the K2 flight seeing tour of Denali mountain.  It was an amazing, once in a lifetime experience.  You get up close and personal with Mt. Denali and nearby mountains, view glaciers and amazing rock formations as well as get a comprehensive view from the air of nearby sights. It's frightening to be in a tiny plane but well worth overcoming your fears. (I am not fond of flying.) but once over the mountains you forget everything else! One caution-- flying on a turbulent day is not for the delicate of stomachs. Half our plane used the bags provided in the seat backs...

review_title: Take a flight of Your Lifetime with K2!
review_text: Okay, all  lovers of scenic beauty, National Sites, flying, excitement, and memories to ingrain into your mind forever:  Get it all when you take a scenic flight over Mt. Denali with K2 Aviation.  This is not cheap, but it is one of the best trips you'll take I'll bet by far, on any vacation.  Fly amongst the glaciers, experience the grandeur of Mt. Denali, and land on a glacier at lower base camp, where hikers begin their sojourn to Mt. Denali.  The scenery is breathtaking, and your camera will get a serious workout.  Marvel at the overwhelming beauty of blue skies and snowy mountains that surround you, as you watch campers pitch tents or start their hikes with gear in tow.  Bring a filter for your camera that eliminates the prop washing in the photos from the front seat, and don't forget sunglasses.  My experience lasted about 2 hours, I wouldn't go any less.  You HAVE TO DO THIS, you may never be back here again.  Loved IT!

This was a fantastic experience and our Pilot Palm did a wonderful job!  My caution!  You need to understand how far from Denali National Park the airport is if you are planning to fly!   There are beautiful views on the drive from Denali to Talkeetna, AK.   It took us four hours to drive.   This is not a complaint just a caution so you allow enough time.  I think it is also good to know what trip you are interested in but early in the season be open to flying a different one due to the number of people needed to fill a flight.   Early in the season, do not be afraid to call and make a reservation... if they can fly they will return your deposit.  if you think you want to fly let them know!  Your call may make the difference.  The whole staff is extremely helpful.  Now the flight, it is into another world!  Do it you won't regret it.
Once again the staff at K2 and Perry the pilot were great.   Could not ask for any better accommodations.  Flight ov Denali was grand with perfect weather.  Thanks again

review_title: You have to do the glacier landing. It is an awesome experience. Once in a life time, you will never forget it.
review_text:
So easy to check in, they will never tell you your weight :-) even so everybody has to go on the scale. 
Fast, easy and very friendly before you even take off. Everything else is just pure pleasure. Don't miss it. It is a trip of a life time! Take off with K2 Aviation!

review_title: There is no better way to see Mount Denali!!
review_text:
K2 Aviation and our K2 pilot provided us with an excellent and unforgettable experience on our flightseeing tour of Mount Denali.   We saw it all as the pilot expertly wove his way around the mountains.  His knowledge of the area was excellent and he communicated it well.   The plane was superbly maintained and comfortable to ride it.   

Money well spent!!

An amazing experience to see Mt. Denali from just five miles away ! We originally booked the Grand Denali tour at 10.30am but the snow conditions were not suitable for a glacier landing and the planes couldn't circle the other face of Mt. Denali. But we really wanted to do a glacier landing so they offered us later flights in the day as snow conditions were improving. We finally went on the 3pm Mountain Explorer tour and we landed on the glacier. What an incredible sight ! You get about 15 minutes in the most exotic location you can imagine. The pilot was was very professional and clearly very experienced in handling such weather conditions. We were only charged for the shorter tour's cost, really appreciated their transparency in handling the weather limitations. Thank you K2 Aviation, you made our trip so memorable !

We had a crystal clear day and the views were unbelievable!  The pilot told us what mountains we were seeing and where to look to see the parties climbing Denali.  It is truly a unique and amazing experience.  Landing on the Ruth Glacier was so fun!  One of the best photo ops one can get.  Make sure you've got extra camera batteries, because you'll take a thousand pictures.  We are so glad we went.

I've been a pilot for 47 years and never had such a magnificent flight. Randy graciously granted me the right seat and I enjoyed every minute. The glacier landing and the flight around the mountains and through the passes was spectacular. Randy's commentary and answers to questions was appreciated by all on board. It was worth every cent to us.

We had two flights out of Healy cancelled due to weather and we were feeling quite bummed out as we made our way back to Anchorage on our last day. We stopped in Talkeetna and on a whim, inquired about their flights. They had availability on a 5:00 pm with a glacier landing and the weather looked good so we jumped on it.
Words cannot describe the experience!
The staff/pilot were extremely knowledgeable and very professional. The plane was comfortable but mother nature delivered on her best day ever. 
Denali was majestic and we made fresh tracks on the landing on Ruth glacier.
Don't even have second thoughts about booking with them. Just do it. You won't be disappointed.

review_title: After several weather delays, fabulous flight!
review_text: We were supposed to do a flight over Denali, but due to weather issues had to cancel that.  The next day we instead flew over another nearby glacier and it was fabulous.  The pilot was terrific, the plane was comfortable (a 10-seater) and the weather was magnificent so the sights were just glorious.

We had a wonderful flight with Thomas around Denali on a perfectly clear day, and he pointed out sights thru-out the trip.  His takeoff and landing were excellent, and the flight was smooth for me in co-pilot seat, but I think some in back felt queasy because they might not have heard as clearly that he was going to turn or rise. I don't have small plane experience so I can't brag that I can withstand motion but I prepared myself with Dramamine and wrist bands so maybe that helped but my wife sat behind me and we both loved the flight: Grand Tour!

review_title: Very friendly crew, super orgamisation, could not be better.
review_text: Our flights to the basecamp started like sheduled. For our flight back to Kalkeetna Earlier as sheduled because of the bad weather K2 has sendet a plane for is two climbers. It has been the last possibility to come down for many days. Thank you!
This by far was the coolest experience of my life. I did the Denail Grand Tour with a glacier landing and would highly recommend for anyone visiting the Talkeetna area.

It was very cloudy when we booked the flight, but they assured us there was good visibility on the mountain.  By the time we took off, the weather had completely cleared, and we had a spectacular flight under cloudless blue skies.  The glacier landings were all booked up for the day, so we did the larger of the two tours, which took us through several glacial valleys around Denali.  

Although, we didn't land, we flew close to both landing sites: the one where they stop to sight see, and the one where they drop off climbers.  We were able to see the long line of climbers starting their ascent up the mountain.  

I don't know if this is typical, but conditions on the mountain were remarkably smooth.  We had a couple of people in our group who were a bit nervous, but no one had any problems and everyone had a fantastic time.

Definitely not to be missed.

Plane was comfortable and pilot did a great job showing us everything and telling us about all the peaks, glaciers, rivers, etc. highly recommended. They even exchanged the under wing plane for an overhead wing for the sake of a whiny passenger. (Not me)

The experience was so well organized at all stages from the booking process to the actual flight.  Booked only the day before, and we had e'mails early in the morning reporting on the weather conditions around Mount Denali.   We were not able to fly as far into the mountain range as we had originally booked so accepted a shorter route, which we enjoyed so much.  A very good company to book with.
Absolut atemberaubend und toll, der Rundflug zum Denali! Unser Pilot Kevin war super, hat uns viel erzählt und uns auf dem Flug alles genau gezeigt, besser geht es nicht!
To view these mountains up close and personal is indescribable. K2 Aviation delivers an extremely professional experience and their customers safety is priority.

review_title: Fabulous Day Fling Denali and Landing on Ruth Glacirt
review_text: We had a wonderful flight with Patrick who landed us on Ruth glacier, 5 miles from Mt Denali peak.  Beautiful day, not a cloud in the sky.  Great flight through the mountains and seeing Base Camp and seeing the rock and granite formations. Thanks Patrick and K-2.

We originally wanted to take a trip landing on the glacier but the weather was kind of iffy in the morning.  By the time we got to our trip the weather had cleared and there were people allowed to do the glacier landing but due to our signing up later we were not able to have the landing.  It was not a disappointment however, because the flight was absolutely amazing.  Our pilot was able to get "up close and personal with Denali and the other mountains.  The view was breathtaking, the flight was uneventful even though he promised we would feel some bumps.  The hour and 15 minutes went by so fast but this was truly a trip of a lifetime.  We can now mark this off of our bucket list.  I've learned that I need to put fear of trying new things in the back of my mind and just take the plunge.  I won't be disappointed as I was not with this.  Great time was had by all!

I almost didn't book this because it was so expensive, I couldn't imagine it was worth it.  But if you are going to travel all the way to Alaska, it is difficult to appreciate everything from the ground.  The mountains and scenery are that huge, and there are not many roads.  We spent the extra on a glacier landing.
Although the weather seemed inclement at the airport, you are flying quite a ways and the weather cleared up fairly well.  But not enough to risk a landing.  K2 is very conservative, and won't take risks.
The views of the  huge peaks and glaciers, and the vast mountain cliffs were frankly breath-taking.  It can't be described until you experience it.  Took some incredible videos and pics which I will share with friends and family.
Strongly recommended.

review_title: A beautiful experience landing on that glacier.
review_text: The flight my wife and I took to and around Denali was beautiful but landing on the glacier and getting out and walking around and contemplating the beauty of that spot was exhilarating. It's one of the best experiences of our lives. We were surrounded by these beautiful peaks, gleaming white snow and bright sunshine. Be sure and bring a camera, sunglasses and your sense of wonder.

We had been scheduled to do a glacier landing but unfortunately, due to the weather, we were unable to land on the glacier. While this was disappointing, it's certainly no fault of K2. They refunded us that portion of our tour and we still had a great time getting an aerial view of the area.

review_title: A must do while in Alaska !
review_text:
Flying just above the snow capped Mountains is an experience not to be missed.

Due to unpredictable weather conditions , we could not do the glacier landing as initially signed for,however the efficiency & honesty with which they handled the situation is commendable ! Right from the Pilot to all their Staff  ,K2 ensures this aerial tour stays the experience of a lifetime .

The aerial views of snow covered Talkeetna mountain ranges are breath-taking. Photographs can never do justice to actual viewing. 

We did the activity with a 2 yr old toddler & its totally safe. He fell asleep within 20 mins in air &  had a comfortable nap.😁 The flight does get bumpy if its cloudy but nothing major so as to induce sickness. The temperature drops a few degrees inside the cabin midair so wear adequate layers, a beanie etc.

Do check out the magnets at the K2 office & sip on complimentary tea/coffee/hot cocoa once back from the cold ride.

Special Thanks to Stan(our Pilot ) & the Entire K2 family. Definitely want to come back !!
Unbelievable ruggedness awaited us as we flew over Denali...we couldn't have asked for more on this somewhat cloudy, rainy, snowy and clearing day.  It was wonderful

The views are amazing.  Barry did a fantastic job going around the clouds so we had amazing views.  We flew up a large glacier and saw the south side of Denali.  It was spectacular.  Barry was very knowledgeable and narrator everything we were seeing.  This is a must do if you  want to see Denali and the park.

My trip with K2 to the glacier was amazing!  Our pilot was very informative and lots of fun!  If you are visiting Alaska, be sure to check out K2 aviation and their air trips to the glaciers.  Great organization with very skilled pilots!

review_title: Great Tour but Snafu in Scheduling
review_text: The K2 Glacier Landing Flight on May 16 was easily the highlight of our Alaska vacation. I cannot compliment our wonderful pilot Chip enough for the great flight, explanations, pointing out various areas, the easy glacier landing, and his great attitude. He made the trip wonderful, although we happened to be in a situation that was not the best due to a scheduling error, for which K2 staff never took responsibility. We arrived two hours early, checked in, and then left for a few minutes, then came back an hour early. We were not put on the flight we had reserved at 5:00 pm, which was full with 10 passengers. There was some back and forth and we were told we would have a private tour; however, after waiting 1 hour and 15 minutes, another couple arrived who told us they were called to come early. The four of us were 'sandwiched' into a smaller plane with the wing overhead blocking some of our views. The office staff never explained, were defensive when we asked questions, and never apologized. We missed our dinner due to this and caused aggravation on an otherwise perfect day. We aren't too hard to please if you keep us informed. I will suggest this trip to anyone planning to go to Alaska, but would definitely double-check your time and space upon arrival.

While I get that they can't predict the weather, the pilots do talk to each other and have a little idea what they're up against.  Our pilot was really nice but didn't take us anywhere near Denali.  We should have been told before going up that Denali was not visible and we wouldn't get any closer to it than 30 or 40 miles. Don't give us hope if there is none, just so you can make your quota.

K2 was the fastest to respond to questions I had online, and also had a very easy booking process through their website - not all of the tour operators out there do. We decided to splurge and add the glacier landing and it was worth every cent. A once in a lifetime experience to add to your Alaska adventures. Our pilot was from a many-generation Alaskan family so he had interesting stories and historical facts about the area and Denali to share with us. The plane was comfortable and looked well-maintained. If you're contemplating if it's worth the cost and time, it is, do it!

This company was recommended by McKinley View B and B and it did not disappoint! It was an unforgettable experience and worth every penny. We were able to land and walk around on a glacier. There's nothing like it! The pilot was extremely knowledgeable and friendly and provided quite a bit of information.

review_title: Best way to see glaciers in Alaska
review_text: K2 was outstanding! Our pilot Stan, was so smooth on the flight and he gave great narration about the glaciers, Denali, and the surrounding mountains. There is no better way to get the glacier and mountain views than flying. K2 delivers

We stopped in Talkeetna for lunch on our way to Denali and our server recommended fightseeing with K2 aviation. Wow! It was fabulous! We saw Mt Denali up close, flew around mountains and glaciers and had a glacier landing. Our pilot Patrick was very knowledgeable. Ask if you can ride up front- my son loved it!  This is a must do for your trip to Alaska!

Hooray!  A chance to redeem a not so summit flight last year. 
K2 Aviation had connections with the weather, what a perfect day to fly!  The entire experience was perfectly inspiring!  I hope to get my wife up too!  Thanks K2 !😀

The entire process was perfect.  Making the reservation, discussing contingencies in the event of unfavorable weather and check-in were all a breeze. The flight was fantastic!  We cannot wait to do it again, soon.  Amazing experience!

review_title: Flight  up Denali to glacier landing
review_text: This is the second time I have made the trip..and it's an approxinately 1.50 hour trip of absolute wonder. We landed approx 11,000 ft. I really can't express the sheer joy of seeing the inside of  of the mountain and the many glaciers..not something you can see from the ground. So unless you are an extreme skier or mountaineer this is the best it gets.K2 pilots are fantastic and extremely knowledgeable

We were supposed to fly Denali with a glacier landing.  The weather socked in every thing above 7000 ft. They were able to revise the trip at the last minute and do a spectacular glacier tour on the lower slopes at a reduced price. They saved the day after a long drive from anchorage. The pilot/guide was very informative. Will be back for the landing.

I was a little worried about the cloudy weather but was so thrilled to have a smooth, beautiful flight and could see it all. Our pilot Chip was very informative and knowledgeable.  Would highly recommend K2 for your Alaska flight.

Even on a cloudy day flying over glaciers, lakes, braided rivers and the gorgeous terrain surrounding Denali park has a value far beyond the monetary.  Our pilot went above and beyond (pardon the pun) in explaining to us not only what we were looking at but also its geological background. This was truly a great experience !
Absolutely stunning!!! The ride was smooth, the guide gave us wonderful commentary, and the planes are comfortable.

review_title: flight was great... pilot was a little full of himself
review_text: This is a fantastic trip... would highly recommend it. However,there are several companies that offer these flights. While our pilot was clearly vary capable and did a good job, he was a little full of himself which made the experience less than it could have been.
Seeing the mountains in full view was magnificent.  The flight made me realize just how special Alaska is.

We did a 2 hour tour of Denali with a glacier landing. It was absolutely worth the extra money to land on the glacier. There is not another experience like it in the world. Our pilot was fabulous. It was obvious that this is his passion and not just a job. I would do it again in a heartbeat!

review_title: Once in a life time experiance
review_text: The K2 Aviation flight was my first time exploring over Denali. My Pawpaw and I took the Denali Grand Tour. This was my first experience with K2, but this was his second time. Even though I live in Anchorage, I had to experience the flight myself. The pilot was informative and extremely kind. It was a life time experience flying over beautiful glaciers and mountains. Since I graduate this Thursday, K2 Aviation employees gave me a sweet congratulations card (unexpectedly.) I would truly recommend this company to other friends, family, and tourists. We had such a wonderful time!

We did the Denali Flyer tour with glacier landing, and it was totally worth it! The weather hampered our plans in the morning for our original reservation, but K2 was great about working with us to reschedule later in the day. 

The experience with breathtaking views and an excellent guide was one of my favorite tourist activities I've ever done. I highly recommend the glacier landing as well.

review_title: Great flight and landing on a glacier!
review_text: Me, my husband, our daughter and her boyfriend took a flight Friday with K2Aviation out of Talkeena and it was wonderful!!  Daniel, our pilot, was very helpful and informative and showed us a great time!  The entire trip was excellent but we particularly enjoyed landing on the glacier!  Thanks so much for a very memorable trip!

Taylor was great in helping us to schedule our flight, and Kevin the pilot was awesome!  The ride was smooth and the views were breathtaking!  We had a great day with clear views!  It was definitely the highlight of our trip to Alaska!  Thanks K2!

We did a Denali Experience with a glacier landing. One of the most amazing things I have ever done!! 
Safe and professional with well maintained aircraft. Our pilot was friendly, informative and fun. 
If I had to rate on a scale of 1-10, I would give it a 12. It's that amazing!
This glacier landing was amazing!  Wonderful customer service.  The pilot was extremely knowledgeable about the area.  Once in lifetime experience.  Definitely add to your bucket list.

As a professional pilot for 35 years, I have seen a lot of flight operations. This is the most professional group I have ever met in the sight seeing business. YES, this is a once in a lifetime experience you MUST do if you are in Alaska, but more importantly, you are in the best hands in the business. 

Thank you, Susan, Garret, Chip and Patrick 

We had a blast! Lynn and Mick

I did the glacier landing tour and it was absolutely one of the most amazing experiences in my life. You get to fly through, see the mountains up close, and then land on a glacier. It is really bright on the glacier so sunglasses are highly recommended, and wear layers (including gloves).

it was an experience of a lifetime.  I never realized how beautiful Denali mountain ranges are.  Kudos to K2 for giving this amazing chance, to the pilot ... EXCELLENT!!!!!!  though i was scared for the first few minutes you let me feel comfortable by your words...to the staff thank you for entertaining us with food..it was sooooo good.. you all Professional!!!!!!!!!!!
The experience was incredible and our guide was knowledgeable as well as an excellent pilot. Definitely recommend this to anyone

review_title: One of the main goals on our bucket list for this trip!
review_text:
My husband and I traveled to Alaska mid-April planning to do as much as possible in the "shoulder season" - when winter activities have stopped & summer ones haven't started.  Two of the most important goals were to see the northern lights (more on that later) and to do a flightsee trip out of Fairbanks to Denali.  Though we weren't able to get a flight reservation made before we left home, our hostess at Meandering Moose Lodge in Fairbanks was quite helpful to get us onto a flight with just a little over an hour's notice!  The K2 staff were so friendly, accommodating, and thorough as they took our information and set us up for the flight. (There are several different types of flights available , and K2 will definitely work with you to get you on the flight of your choice.)
The short distance from the Lodge to K2 enabled us to get there quickly, and before we knew it we were boarding the bright red Beaver plane along with 4 others and our pilot, Patrick. The weather couldn't have been more perfect, there was no turbulence the entire trip, and Patrick did an excellent job of constantly informing us about the geography, geology, and history of what we were seeing.  All of us wore headphones & microphones, so were able to ask Patrick questions at any point.   
This was a fantastic once-in-a-lifetime experience for us, as we were able to see Denali and the other mountains from every direction.  Glaciers 3 miles wide, tectonic plate uplifts, two climbers who looked so tiny 1,000 feet below us, rock walls only 300-400 feet away, the top of beautiful Denali - these memories and so many more made our flight with K2 Aviation something we'll always treasure!
Oh, and about those Northern Lights - don't let anyone tell you that mid-April is too late.  We saw them one night at Healy, and 4 nights in a row in Fairbanks.  Spectacular!

Magical!  Awsome!  Breathtaking! Amazing!
There are no words that can capture the beauty of the AK mountain range!
More amazing than I even imagined! Beautiful scenery, smooth ride, knowledgeable and very friendly pilot and staff. I look forward to going again!

If you are looking for an amazing adventure join K2 for a landing With in Denali mountain. 
A once in a lifetime thrill.
Excellent trip, beautiful flight. Had a wonderful meal waiting for us. Landing at base camp was breath taking.

This trip is awesome! They know so much about what they are talking about and point out lots of interesting things! It's definitely a once in a lifetime chance that you definitely have to try at least once!

K2 aviation is great. I showed up in Talkeetna with two friends at the last minute during their shoulder season and the weather wasn't great. We were calling the office nonstop to try to get on a tour and despite our slight harassment they offered wonderful customer service the entire time. K2's staff is super friendly and I guess I should mention that the glacier flight wasn't too bad either! Wonderful views the entire time and a very experienced pilot. I am definitely going to do another tour with K2 in the future!

A wonderful experience!  Definitely something everyone should put on their bucket list.  It was a breathtaking view!  Absolutely beautiful!  Everyone there was so nice and welcoming.  I would definitely recommend this trip.

I have traveled the world and done some pretty amazing and out there experiences.. but the K2 aviation trip to Ruth Glacier blew my mind! It was the most beautiful day.. the pilot was really interesting and informative about the history of the Denali range and wildlife etc. Getting out on the glacier was something I will never forget! Breathtaking and stunning.. I would highly recommend you add this trip not only to your next Alaska trip but to your lifelong bucket list!!!

We took the Denali Grand tour and we were just speechless the entire flight. The views were out of this world. The entire experience from check in to landing was top notch! Completely worth the money!

review_title: The highlight activity of Alaska!!!  My pictures don't do it justice!
review_text:
There are a few places in the world where pictures just don't work.  The Grand Canyon, the Sistine Chapel, the Dancing House of Prague to name a few.  What you will see on a glacier landing flight might top any of your lists, it certainly tops mine.

The easiest way to explain just how MASSIVE these mountains and glaciers are can be summed up by a question we asked our pilot.  It appeared that he was flying extremely close to the mountains, so we asked him how far away we were from the mountains.  He said about 1/2 a mile.  The mountains are so huge that our normal perception of distance was off by a magnitude.

Landing on the glacier on the plane skis was phenomenal.  Getting outside, walking on some of the world's thickest ice, and realizing how tiny we all are to this expanse of nature was awe-inspiring.

I enjoyed every minute of this adventure.

A hint to those who want the best views...ask to sit in the co-pilots seat.  I did on the way back and being able to see out of the cockpit window was spectacular.

Now that I am writing this, my words are barely doing this activity justice.  Stop reading! Book it!

We selected K2 Aviation to take us up to the Ruth Glacier in Denali National Park for a couple nights' stay at the Sheldon Mountain House. From the very beginning of the experience, the K2 staff were eager to assist, friendly, and full of great information. When we showed up for our flight, they helped us to get all of our gear weighed and loaded in an expeditious manner. On the flight out and landing, the pilot was friendly, informative, accommodating to requests for help with taking aerial photos, and eager to help us have a good experience. Our pick up occurred exactly as scheduled, and our pilot (different pilot from before) was helpful and informative on the way out. Flying with K2 Aviation, you don't just get an air taxi service, you get a complete package from a company that wants to help you have a great Alaskan experience. I would highly recommend them to anyone.

The most amazing day ever! Chris, our pilot, made us feel comfortable and safe, he was very knowledgeable and calm.
We had a perfect day and could see all of the peaks on the Southern Flight path.
The Glacier landing was a highlight and the flight was unbelievably beautiful! 
Thank you Chris!
It was great flying thru the mountains and landing on the glacier.  I got some fantistic pictures sitting in the front seat.

Beyond the majestic peaks of Denali, Hunter and Foraker are the winding rivers leading to the vast canyons and glaciers. Looking at the Alaskan range from a far has its beauty and then you get closer and you see that not only is this range absolutely enormous, it is full of peaceful hideaways around every corner. It is amazing that you can get so far away from civilization so quickly and yet still be so close. The pilot and staff were very knowledgeable and they are concerned about our safety more then anything.

Thanks for an amazing flight!

This was my first time to Alaska and K2 aviation was hands down the highlight. We had clear views, blue skies, Patrick our pilot was awesome and the crew was friendly and accomadating. Would recommend to anyone and everyone visiting!

Great service and a extraordinaire  experience, a heart and mind blowing tour into the skies.

We can only recommend trying this if visting the Denali/Talkeetna area. You will not be disappointed! 

Best regards from the Danes!

We had a pretty unique flying need and they worked with us even in some rough conditions. They were clearly looking to make sure we were safe and enjoyed the experience. The pilot was not only a very good pilot but was extremely knowledgeable about the area. I would recommend them to anyone in the Denali area!
Crystal clear day,experienced and very knowledgeable pilot, and reliable Otter made for a great day!
We have never experienced anything like this before.  Highly recommend it to anyone.  A must do when someone visits Alaska.

Awsome flight! Pilot was cool and very knowledgeable about the mountains surrounding that area. I would highly recommend taking this flight tour. They land on the glacier right below Denali. I will definitely take this tour again when I'm in Alaska!!!😁😁😁😁✈️💯

review_title: BEST Dinali Tour - IF the weather is clear.
review_text: My wife and I walked into the K2 building at about 05:30 PM without reservations, and within 30 minutes were on our way to Denali.  We flew with another couple in a radial-engined K2 Beaver, which was worth the trip in itself.  Headset communications in flight were great.  There are several route/cost options for your flight, including an actual landing on the glacier.  Whichever option you pick, it is WORTH it.

If you have the opportunity to take a K2 Aviation flight, you definitely should! The views are breathtaking and it gives you a unique perspective on the massive expanse of Denali National Park.  Our pilot made us feel very safe and also provided interesting commentary as we flew.

review_title: A highlight of our Alaska Trip!
review_text: My husband talked me into doing this and I am so glad I did - even though the plane was small, once we were airborne, the scenery is so spectacular that you don't even think about the plane being small.  Mike was a very experienced pilot and a wonderful tour guide.  The glacier landing was a big thrill and we enjoyed having a snowball throwing contest, since we don't get snow where we live.  TIP:  if you are prone to motion sickness, ask to sit in the co-pilot's seat.  OTHER TIP:  make sure your phone and/or camera battery are well charged before you go so that you can take lots of video, especially if you get to see the peaks on Denali.

I am not afraid of flying but I have a fear of heights, which usually means commercial flight is OK but small aircraft flight is white knuckle.  We flew up to Denali in a DeHavilland Beaver that was two years younger than I am but meticulously maintained and flown beautifully.  Admittedly, my knuckles were white for 15 minutes, but the pilot's skill and the overall stability of the trip won me over and I greatly enjoyed my time in the air.  I would definitely do it again.  If you are an aviation buff, you will enjoy the ride in the Beaver.  A ride in the DeHavilland is like a ride on a Harley... not the fastest ride out there but it has a quality that is classic and as memorable as the scenery.  Make sure you take your earphones off for a bit while in flight to hear and feel the deep rumble only a radial piston engine can give you.  The pilot's narration was packed with great information that was interesting and well researched (unlike the mind numbing prattle of most Alaskan tour bus drivers who drone on for hours about their own idiotic reflections on life).  The views were beyond wonderful... transcendent, if you are lucky enough to have a clear day.  You will want to take stills and videos, so clear up your SDS camera card!  One other note, I noticed that the pilot was in constant communication with ground control and the other pilots in the air with us, regularly exchanging positions and headings.  It was a very reassuring, professional vigilance that characterized the whole experience.  Do this!!

We took a quick flight tour of Denali with K2 Aviation in October 2016. Our trip was absolutely amazing from start to finish. They were open and easy with question before we arrived and made every effort to familiarize us with what we would expect. They provided an FAA approved seat for our toddler who came with us on the trip (and slept the entire time). The guide was familiar with the area and struck a good balance between describing what we were seeing and letting us experience the mountain and the glaciers. Only regret was that the season we were there did not allow us to do a glacier landing.

As an FYI, if you sit tall in the saddle, talk to the pilot and get either the front seat or the rear row seat.  If I had, it would have been a great filight.

We flew over Denali the first of September, 2016.  Not a cloud in the royal blue sky, temperature in the 50's and a bit of wind that somewhat limited flight distance; however, the trip turned out to be an experience of a lifetime. I relate the following to show what an outstanding person our pilot Patrick Carter was, as well as the company K2 Aviation was in going above and beyond what is normally expected. While waiting in office area for flight takeoff, a very elderly gentleman with a cane walking extremely slowly and with carefully measured steps walked in alone.  He had great difficulty even stepping up on the scales to weigh in before takeoff.  I silently thought to myself that he would never have the ability to physically climb up the plane steps and certainly not into the plane.  We, along with the other passengers, were waiting to board the steps into the plane when Patrick started talking to the elderly gentleman.  Much to our surprise, the gentleman told us he was a WWII bomber pilot.  After helping him into the plane, Patrick asked him to sit in the seat beside him which he did. All the passengers had headphones and were able to hear him recount some of his WWII experiences as well as all his discussions about airplanes with Patrick. What an experience it was.  Not only were we viewing scenery that is almost beyond description, but we were transported back in time aboard that WWII bomber plane by listening to discussions between the elderly gentleman and Patrick.  When we arrived back to K2, some of the passengers took pictures of Patrick and the WWII pilot in front of the plane. The company even sent out a van to pick up the gentleman and drive him to his hotel.  These pictures will always remind me of our amazing pilot who was so well versed about Denali and the spectacular scenery, as well as the thoughtfulness and kindness exhibited not only by him, but also of this amazing company.  It truly turned out to be an experience of a lifetime.

review_title: Weather Cancellation? Ask For A Reschedule - TERRIFIC!
review_text:
My wife and I spent two weeks in Alaska. We booked/visited nearly a dozen tours/events/museums and this was by far our favorite. Read the other positive comments and look at the photos from other reviewers - they are spot on! 

We were scheduled for a fly-over Mt. Denali on Aug 25th, the 100th anniversary of the National Park Service. The fog socked in K2 and we were alerted that our noon-time flight had to be cancelled. Later in the afternoon we met a K2 rep in our hotel and found out that weather was very promising for an early morning flight the next day. We took it - it was great! We were lucky but lesson learned -ask for a re-schedule ASAP.

If you are concerned about motion sickness or a bumpy ride, don't be! This take-off and landing was much smoother than the commercial flights we took to and from Alaska. Our plane was an 8-seater Piper Cub (see my photo). Everybody had a window seat. However, if you sit next to the pilot, your view is slightly obstructed by the instrument panel. We were all supplied with noise reduction headphones so the pilot could keep us informed to the viewing highlights. It was also cool to hear the chatter between the pilots and ground control. Apparently not all flights supply headphones. A couple we talked to later said that their flight from Fairbanks to the Arctic Circle was extremely noisy.

If you plan to take photos, go with a wide to medium-angle telephoto lens WITHOUT the UV Haze filter. There is no need for a long lens and not much room for extra equipment on the plane. They supply a large, secure locker for items that you would like to leave on the ground. 

This is one Alaskan tour that we would surely do again!

We weren't lucky enough to get clear skies when we got to Talkeetna, all the more reason to take a flight seeing tour so we can see the great Denali. The plane took us above the clouds and the views were spectacular. The pilot was experienced and he negotiated the clouds so we could get to see the summit. To be so close to the ice capped slopes and summit was the experience of a life time. The pilot was very thorough with the safety procedures and the plane was well equipped with emergency provisions. I must say the ground staff weren't as friendly as they should be, but I'm glad that didn't stop us from going on the tour.

We were lucky with the weather, it was brilliant,. The flight was stunning, We were flying soo close to the peaks you felt you could touch them. The pilot's commentary was excellent and informative. We were glad to have taken the flight..

We took two different trips with K2, and both of them were the highlight of our trip! We went on the Summit tour, and we got to see hikers climbing Denali, their campsites, and other planes that were on tour. We also took a private trip on a float plane to go fishing for the day, which was the absolute best experience! We got to see several bears, moose, and other wildlife. The guides will gladly turn the plane around if you think you see wildlife, which was so awesome. They also let someone be the "co-pilot" and sit up front. The staff is SO friendly, their planes are clean, comfortable, and up to date, and their flights are worth it. I will never forget how awesome both flights were. Not a lot of people in the world can say that they got to see Denali from that perspective. I highly recommend this company over any other flight company in the area, and hope to take another flight when I return to Talkeetna!!! 
P.S. don't forget a jacket, socks (crucial lol), and other warm clothes, because it gets cold when you're that high up in elevation...especially when you are from Texas. :)

review_title: Don't use these guys, fly with someone else!
review_text: Extremely disappointed by the rudeness ( and I mean REALLY rude) of their employee when I asked a few questions. This guy was so bad I cancelled my Denali flight seeing tour, right then and there. Would never recommend them to anyone!!!

We traveled to Talkeetna, Alaska late this summer with the sole mission of completing the glacier landing on Denali.  Our trip last year was foiled by rain every day.  When we arrived, there was not a cloud in sight, so we immediately traveled to K2 Aviation in order to take full advantage of the beautiful weather.  The weather this year completely caught us off-guard for the good.  We hadn't made any advance reservations for this trip, but had planned to accomplish the flight, weather permitting.  What a pleasant surprise.  We were greeted by K2 personnel and the trip was outlined and priced for us and we immediately booked a flight within just a few minutes.  All aspects of the flight were explained and our questions answered thoroughly and completely.  We were soon introduced to our pilot, Patrick.  What a surprise to discover that he was from our home state.  With just a few pre-flight instructions, we were off to the wild blue yonder.  The scenery was absolutely breath-taking.  The glacier landing was smooth and awesome.  Our pilot got so close to the mountain on the flight over that it seemed that you could reach out and touch the mountain.  Patrick took some snap shot of us with the plane on the glacier and after a reasonable amount of time there, we were once again airborne to the vastness of the Denali range.  Upon return to K2, we learned that our flight had been recorded and we immediately ordered a copy.   The K2 video staff advised us that if we had any photos taken while on the glacier, to email them and they would incorporate them into the video for us to further personalize our project.  The hard part was limiting the number of photos.  When the USB video arrived, we have nearly worn it out showing it to family and friends.  What a treat to have them experience what we saw on our trip.  Thank you to the folks at K2 for a wonderful experience.  We are already planning a return trip with kids and grandkids and look forward to flying with K2 again.  The HD video is as close to the real thing as you can get.  I HIGHLY recommend this when you fly with K2.  Most folks don't realize that Denali is only viewable to visitors about 30% of the time.  And we can certainly attest to that from our trip there last year.  But to our good fortune, we saw it cloud-free for six consecutive days....something that even the locals were amazed to see. The K2 flight experience was something that I will cherish for many years to come.  And the flight video allows us to relive this near-miraculous feat over and over again.

The plane was a roomy Dehaviland Otter that fit me fine - and I am a very tall guy.  Took some great pictures and K2 also offers a video of your trip taken from cameras mounted on the plane. A bargain at $59.  I would recommend K2 for a great flight seeing experience.

What an awe-inspiring, gorgeous experience -- truly once in a lifetime.  And K2 is extremely professional and polished. The company declined to take us out when the weather was uncertain or when the conditions made it hard to see the mountain and very politely rescheduled the flight to match everyone's preferences. The customer experience is truly the main priority. Moreover, I never once felt unsafe. My pilot Nick led us on a perfectly smooth ride, while being informative, thoughtful, and polite throughout. His passion and knowledge shone through, alongside his utmost concern for the passengers' experience. We couldn't have been in better hands! If you're in Talkeetna (or anywhere near Denali), please treat yourself to this unique encounter with the mountain. 

Best way to see Denali / one of the best experiences PERIOD!

A once-in-a-lifetime adventure!  K2 Aviation is a professional company.  They provide all the information you need prior to the flight.  Check-in is efficient.  Skies were crystal clear on the day of my flight and to see Denali National Park, circle the summit of Denali, see glaciers and valleys was breathtaking.  Photos come out great through the plane's windows.  Our pilot, Patrick, was terrific, always trying to maintain a smooth ride and advising us of any potential bumpy areas.  Highly recommend this tour and company.
We had an amazing flight. It was a gorgeous day and landing on the glacier was so exciting. It was hard to take it all in. Our pilot was so interesting. Totally worth the price.

We were staying in Anchorage and decided to drive up to Talkeetna since it was a nice day. We had seen the ad for K2 Aviation and booked the flight. Kevin was our pilot and did a great job. The view of Denali was amazing and we felt so privileged to have seen the mountain that day. Thank you!
Don't remember pilots name but he was excellent with a great attitude and lots of info, my second visit and will recommend to my friends!

review_title: Wonderful experience-Denali flight seeing along with glacier landing
review_text:
Excellent knowledge of our pilot about the mountains and glaciers.
It was spectacular sight flying above the glaciers.The tour was worth the money.
