Okay.  Just do it.  I've no doubt this flight will be the highlight of our trip.  Professional, friendly pilot that went above and beyond for us (thank you Samuel.). While our experience was enhanced by beautiful weather,  Samuel did a great job narrating what he was showing us.  We were also fortunate to be in a 185, which allowed a really "personal" experience.  2 of the 4 of us are pilots, (although that was years ago.). We were impressed with everything!  We'll done, K2!

We arrived in Talkeetna on a beautiful day, left the bus and walked to K2 Aviation to see if they had any flights remaining that flew by Denali and that landed on a glacier.
They did have a flight.  Our pilot was young but confident and grown up around airplanes.  The flight was wonderful.  We saw the most amazing views of mountains and glaciers.  Landing on one glacier, we were 7000 feet above sea level and the peak behind us rose an additional 7000 feet.  There is no way to describe the scale of what you can see via an airplane and by landing and taking off from a glacier.  This was one of the highlights of our Alaskan adventure.
Don't miss this once in a lifetime experience, fly around Denali and land on a glacier at 7500 feet. Well done and worth the price.
This was awesome! We thought it was worth every dollar. Landing on the glacier was even more exciting than we thought it would be.

A once in a lifetime experience with a first class operation. Pilots are knowledgeable about Denali and the surroundings and land on the glacier as smoothly as any landing ever.  We did have exceptional weather which enhanced the experience.
We flew with our pilot, Chris and what an adventure! Spectacular views of the mountains and Denali! The landing on the glacier was flawless and beyond words of description.

Worked in AK for 6 months, scheduled a glacier landing for my birthday but had to reschedule 3x before it worked out. Everyone at K2 was great, friendly and helpful making suggetions. Finally got to fly in August which was lucky because it rained most of the month. Flying in to Denali was incredible but there are not enough adjectives to describe how amazing landing on the glacier was!! Getting out of the plane surrounded by snow covered mountains and sunshine was majestic!! Our pilot Chris was funny and family friendly, eager to answer questions the 3 kids on our flight had and teach them about Mt. McKinley. Great experience, worth the money and would definitely recommend it to anyone interested in flying while in AK. K2 was exceptional!!

review_title: Flight tour of a lifetime, beyond awesome.
review_text:
Wow. This is my 50th state visited and this is one of the top tours, if not the top, that I've taken in all of my travels. Lucky to have perfect fall weather today and took the last tour of the day to Denali along with a glacier landing.

The pilot was extremely friendly and knowledgeable, and the flights was one of the smoothest I've ever been on. Words can't begin to describe the awesomeness of the scenery and views from the plane on this 90 minute flight and glacier landing, just take it all in and take lots of photos.

For me personally, the highlight was being able to sit in the co-pilot seat for the entire flight. That was the opportunity of a lifetime for me. If you're interested in sitting in the co-pilot seat, get in line first and quickly accept the offer for a volunteer!

If you only have time for one activity in Alaska, choose this one. It will take a lot to top this for me!
Very friendly. Due to weather, could not do the originally scheduled tour around Mt. Denali. They were very helpful in finding an alternate with minimal co-pay. Just awesome experience!

This is a must do for Talkeetna. Awesome pilot and we felt so safe. We actually went on a search for another aircraft that made a distress call. We located it safely landed on the Park Highway. 
The most amazing experience flying over the mountains and landing on a glacier. I felt so small. It was Cold on the glacier so make sure you take a good jacket hat and gloves.

Although the weather did not allow us to go to Mt Denali, we were offered a different trip towards the south. (We were fortunate the day prior and got to see the mountain during Denali shuttle bus trip.) Flying over the numerous glaciers was breathtaking. Our pilot was very knowledgable, sharing so much information. He made sure we all were able to see the scenery no matter where we sat in the plane. The head sets we wore made it possible to hear the pilot as well as ask him any questions we had. Amazing trip in the air.
Well run operation and staff was great. We did the glacier landing and it was fantastic. Not inexpensive but well worth the cost

I recently traveled to Alaska with my sister, her son and daughter in law. Fortunately, my nephew wanted to go on this excursion and booked for all four of us. We had good luck with the weather, the wait time was reasonable and soon we were  loaded into a 1961 de Havilland Otter, ( a true Alaskan bush plane,equipped with a turbo prop).  Our pilot, Chip, was great-- he told us all about our plane, where we were going and what we would be seeing. The flight was breath-taking, the views unimaginable and we felt like explorers the entire time. The landing was a lot of fun and the views from the glacier floor were awesome.I would recommend this trip to any one traveling to Alaska- it is worth every penny and you learn so much. I definitely plan to come back and do this again, with my family in tow.
Was one of many best events experienced on our Alaskan Vacation, truely a must do to see the mountian in all the beauty as God created it.
This is a great short trip to see the Denali national park. The entire experience, especially the glacier landing, was full of amazement!

review_title: A bit of a wait but worth it!
review_text:
The only negative was the wait, which was 30 minutes past the time they said.

I was lucky enough to fly on a glorious day.  The pilot Chris gave us a briefing on the ground which unfortunately I missed a bit of because of other noise on the airfield-however, I have some hearing issues so you may not have that problem.  

I felt very safe during the flight and would recommend this place to anyone.
We did the tour with Ruth glacier landing. Landing experience was outstanding ! Our Captain (sorry forgot his name) was great and very informative.

We were reluctant to take this trip over the glaciers, but collectively the three of us decided that this might be a once in a lifetime opportunity. With marginalized enthusiasm we met Dan and away we went. I hasten to tell you that Dan was informative, enthusiastic, interested in what we were most interested in seeing and was the difference maker in a "should do" to advocates as a "must do" for everyone we meet, Dan was awesome; personable and professional, and the trip overlooking the glaciers was phenomenal. We even chose a pathway back through what we called the green passage...Just breathtaking. We are hoping to receive a video of our own trip. Just do it, you will have no regrets!!! Tip: You will not need to be bundled with lots of clothing.

I took a flight yesterday with Daniel. Oh boy, that was awesome!!!! Amazing views and deff worth it. I didn't do glacier landing because I'm a chicken but even without it, it's deff unforgettable. If you are scared of flying be advised it's an 8 sits propelled plane (including pilot) but even though I had my heart in my feet I enjoyed every second!

The aerial tour of Denali was beautiful and quite exciting.  The ability to maneuver the Otter aircraft close to the mountain and circle it at 12 thousand feet made for majestic scenery.  Our pilot, Mike, was very knowledgeable and gave very interesting commentary throughout the flight.

K2's equipment, staff, and processes looked excellent, making this a very comfortable experience.

A must experience for visitors to Alaska.

This excursion is a must if going to the Denali area.  We took the 2 hr excursion with a glacier landing but there are a couple of other choices that are a little longer flight and takes you closer to Denali mountain. They are also more expensive. I feel the 2 hr excursion including a 20 min glacier landing was enough to see a good portion of the mountain area, glaciers and a portion of Denali Mountain. Our pilot Stan was awesome. He gave us narration of what we were viewing and flew the plane around so everyone had a chance to see what was on either side.

review_title: Great Company Offering an Unforgettable Experience!
review_text:
This is one of the finest flightseeing Air Taxi operations I've ever flown on, and I've flown on quite a few.  Incredibly friendly staff, superb pilots, and some of the best airplane maintenance I've seen (I work in Aviation).  The planes are routinely painted, the ramp and main office are clean and well-maintained, and the service from start-to-finish is absolutely top-notch.  Prices are reasonable for what you're getting (and you have to realize that they have to pay for their planes, fuel, maintenance, insurance, payroll, glacier landing permits, etc., plus make a profit).  And once you are in the air and you see Denali ("Mt. McKinley") starting you in the face as you look out your window, you will forget how much you paid, quite frankly.  There is NOTHING like landing on a glacier in the shadow of Denali on a clear day!  They even offer "loaner" sunglasses for your flight if you don't have any of your own (and you WILL need them--the glare of light off the snow in the mountains will overwhelm your eyes)!

Zero complaints, I can't recommend this company enough!  Make sure you bring your camera and a decent jacket, it gets cold on the glaciers and you won't want to miss photographing the spectacular views that await you!

We flew  up to the "great one" Denali. We were fortunate and  lucky enough to be able to see the top of the mountain. ( according to the pilot,all other flights prior to ours that day were not as luck since clouds  block the view. The glaciers were amazing. Some of the views looked liked scenery out of the " Lord of the Rings".  We flew next to and through rain clouds and of course with the sun also out at times we saw a rainbow! We wanted to land on the glacier but were unable to due to the amount of rain in the past few days.. Its nice to know they care for the safety of all and kindly refunded our fee for the add'l part  since we had paid in advance. Our pilot was fantastic. Very knowledgeable and great at flying through the mountains not just way above them making the view and ride that much more dramatic. This was the highlight of our trip to Alaska and I advise taking the flight. Well worth the money!

review_title: Last minute side trip to view Denali
review_text: So if you have an extra 1/2 day while visiting Anchorage,  highly recommend driving north to hop on a K2 Aviation flight. The staff were excellent getting me on a flight with no wait and the views were incredible,  once in a lifetime.

I've done some good helicopter tours of amazing places and this topped them all. We were lucky to have good weather and could see Denali clearly. The plane was beautiful. The experience is breathtaking and will leave you speechless. I cannot recommend high enough.
We did this sorta of last minute and wow was it worth the money sights you will never see I would suggest this for everybody FANTASTIC FANTASTIC
One of the best things we did on our trip! Would highly recommend this to anyone that wants to see the beauty of the peaks of Denali!

review_title: Terrible ........  w a t c h - out !
review_text:
They switched our tour to a terrible worthless one. Had to wait 2 extra hours and ruin our schedule for the day. DO NOT LET THEM SWITCH YOUR FLIGHT.  Told us we would be on  the next plane ( it was a lie )........ 3 flights later got a bush leage pilot  that could not not land as we were told.   This was the reason they wanted us to switch from our better tour. WORSE PART OF OUR TRIP....go elsewhere!
  Wasted 3 hours for a crap tour we did not want.  GO ELSEWHERE........

review_title: First time and not the last
review_text: It was the best adventure I have been on in a long time. I've always wanted to go in a smaller plane. Such an amazing experience.

We had a flight booked in Denali but it was cancelled due to weather, but we were able to get on at K2 in Talkeetna.  The weather was great for flying, the pilot was great and made sure we say everything we wanted.  Would recommend if you get to to Talkeetna.
I would highly recommend K2 for flight seeing around Denali. It was a great experience, even our 14 year old had a great time throwing snowballs on the glacier. It was an epic adventure!

Lucky to fly after days of bad weather!  Fantastic views in 4-seater plane and great pilot who explained all we saw.  Very thorough safety instructions.  Headsets on all of us shared 
Lucky to fly after nearly a week of bad weather!  Great views from 4-seater plane with excellent pilot who explained all we were seeing.  Very thorough safety instructions before taking off.  We all had headsets so could hear each other's Q&A's as well as pilot.  We did "yellow" route, but as Denali was in quite dense cloud for awhile, we explored clear sky mountain peaks nearby.  Did get to see South and North Peaks for a few minutes.  Blue skies, amazing peaks and glaciers: impossible to grasp scale of mountains and depth of crevasses.  Excellent adventure!  Tip: try to video some of the flight as photos alone can't capture the experience.
The glacier landing was amazing.  Great photos of our family in an area remote and beautiful. Thank you for a smooth and enjoyable ride!

The trip was fabulous.  Flight was perfect as was the weather.  It is an awe-inspiring adventure. Pilot was a narrated the trip and made sure that those on both sides of the plane got to see things he was pointing out.

review_title: Clouds cleared and there it was, Denali!
review_text: A flight with K2Aviation was my 60th Birthday gift. It was incredible!  The pilot was thorough and went through all of the safety information. Then we boarded a Dehavilland Beaver and headed toward Denali.  We had awesome views as we flew up the Ruth Glacier and suddenly the clouds ahead cleared and there was Denali. Got some great pictures. Highly recommend this trip.

review_title: Most exciting thing we did in Alaska
review_text: They set us up for the best ride. Got to take float plane on a 1hour tour that ended up being 2 hours with a land on a lake up in the glaciers to pick up and drop of tour guides that had been there for a week in a tent. We saw bears and moose in there element and beautiful Glaciers. The scenery was amazing. What a treat we'll never forget
flight was smooth..pilot very informative and very scenic route, wife and i celebrated our anniversary and how many people can say they been to base camp on a glacier 41 miles long

After being cancelled in the morning due to weather, we were able to take our K2 flight in the afternoon and it was amazing! Our pilot was very knowledgeable in his narration and the scenery was breathtaking!  Mount McKinley (Denali) was out in all her glory clear to the summit! Highly recommend K2 Aviation.

review_title: The Clouds Tried To Hide Denali
review_text:
Our original flight around Denali and a glacier landing was not possible due to the weather conditions (they had only been able to fly minimally the previous two weeks), but  K2 offered us an alternate flight that would still allow us to see the lower mountains and the glaciers.  Somewhat disappointed we decided to take the alternate flight.  

The rugged peaks of the lower mountains and the huge glaciers were breathtaking even on this cloudy day.  We were not disappointed that we had taken the alternate flight.

Our pilot monitored the radio and listened to where other pilots in the area were able to see through the clouds and determined that if we climbed we may see Denali peeking through.  So up he went and on his final circle upwards we saw it, the peak of Denali briefly poked out of the clouds to reveal its beauty.  We wanted to see all of Denali in all her grandeur, however, being able to see the peak on a day where we did not expect to see her at all, made our day.

K2, despite the weather, was able to make our trip to Talkeetna and the Denali area worth the trip.  The company was professional and gave us a great experience while keeping us safe.

Look for the little red planes in Talkeetna, AK. What a great flight!! We were scheduled for a flight with landing on a glacier. The weather is very unstable when it comes to flying in Alaska and as luck would have it, it was not possible to land, BUT.. K2 gave us the option of a full refund, a partial refund with a shorter flight, or a special flight.. which it was!And they still gave us a partial refund. Got a chance to take really cook pics of the glaciers and the deep blue crevasses. Would highly recommend this highly reputable company.
Our experience w/K2 was top notch. Everyone was very friendly and helpful, and our pilot Mike was terrific.

review_title: All I can say is WOW!!!
review_text: I was a little skeptical of our plan to take a flight to land on a Glacier located at the base (7500 feet) of Mount Denali), but off we went in a vintage (built in the late 1950's) DeHavilland Otter equipped with skis.   After a delightful 40 minute flight, during which our excellent and very skilled pilot provided wonderful narration, we approached Denali.  Both impressive and imposing at 20,000+ feet.   He carefully wound his way thru towering peaks covered with snow and glaciers and landed on one of the massive glaciers that covers the Mountain.  Our group of 8 had a wonderful snowball fight, did snow angels and just stood in awe of the spectacle of massive glaciers and towering mountains all around us as we stood on over 1000 feet of ice.  This was a definite once in a lifetime BUCKET LIST experience.   It is not for the faint of heart, since you fly around some incredible terrain, but few experiences can match this!!!!

review_title: One of the best moments of our trip
review_text:
If you are debating whether the glacier landing is worth it, definitely DO IT!  I'm soooo glad I paid extra for the glacier landing.  While I enjoyed the flightseeing part of it, the glacier landing made it much more special.

You can't comprehend the scale and mass of the mountains without standing within them.

Tip: volunteer to sit next to the pilot, but don't be a jerk about it.  Let someone else sit up front on the way back.

Tip: if you get motion sickness, you might consider taking some medication.  I started feeling nauseas because the plane is small so you feel the movements more.

It isn't cheap, but I'll definitely never forget this experience.  Our pilot was friendly and laidback.

Our pilots name was Samuel. He did a great job describing where we where and answering any questions we had . 
 I had never been up in a small plane and I was nervous but we had a smooth take off and landing.
And we enjoyed every minute of the flight .

It was a amazing flight,
K2 aviation, have a fantastic staff, and the pilot, that flew was very nice with the explanation, about the the rivers, mountains glaciers, etc..
Also the landing in the galcier was espectacular.

Thanks for the ride K2 Aviation.

Greetings.

Alejandro Ferrara Quintanilla (mexico).
Everything from the booking to the trip itself was wonderful.  Our pilot was engaging and knowledgable. My son and I went and it will always be an incredible memory!

Absolutely wonderful experience - great customer service, amazing experience, personable and engaging pilot! So so so glad we took the opportunity to see Mt. Denali from the air and land on a glacier. Highly recommend K2!

Had a great time on the flight. Although we weren't able to make it to the backside of Denali Mountain, the pilot did such a great job. Most of the time the glacier landings are iffy just due to the fact that the mountains have their own weather pattern that is very unpredictable, but we were able to land, and it was absolutely amazing!!! Had a fantastic time and I suggest it to anyone who can fit it in your budget and schedules. :)

This tour was incredible.  The scenery is spectacular, and landing at base camp was very special - a once in a lifetime experience.  We've lived in Alaska for 30+ years and decided we needed to do this.  It truly brings perspective to our great state.  I would tell everyone to do this tour, whether they are a visitor to Alaska or a resident.  Our pilot, Patrick, was exceptional.  He narrated the entire tour, and knew so much about the area it was quite impressive.  I wish I had a recording of his voice along with the tour!

Unforgettable!  Views stunning, excellent pilot. We were captivated by all of it...views of Denali and surrounding mountains, glaciers, moose, sheep, trumpet swans. Landing on glacier was amazing. Loved it all! Thank you!!

Seeing snow mountain and glacier and even canyon from aircraft is a different experience.   The plane is small, which is capable for just ten persons.  Flight was smooth, Pilot showed key view to both sides by turning flight around.

this is a must do for visiting Alaska. Landing on one of the many glaciers on the mountain is worth the extra cost. my first flight was with my two sons, then my second flight was with my wife who was nervous to fly the first time. the planes were extremely smooth and stable. the pilots were knowledgeable and friendly. we were happy we bought the video recording of the flight. the staff was  helpful arranging the flight times around the ever changing weather, which they can not control unfortunately. if the sun is up, take this flight, you will not regret it. thankyou K2, it was awesome. I plan on doing it a third time.

By all means this company is the way to see the mountains and glaciers of Denali.  Our pilot, I believe was Daniel, was superb.  He maneuvered the place in and around the peaks and valleys with ease.  I definitely didn't show enough appreciation for the job he did.
Professionali e competenti. Splendido giro sotto la vetta del Mckinley, tour indimenticabile. Il costo è alto ma lo merita tutto!
1n 2015.I tried Summit twice. No luck.Denali decides. August 3 2016 morning rain subsided..Summit flight Bluebird perfect
Very nice staff and were very accommodating on the flight scheduling. We had a great pilot who showed us the awesome glaciers. Wish we had a clearer day
It was awesome experience riding with K2 plane at Mt McKinsey @ Talktina. pilot kept us informed about about Denali and Mt McKinsey
Excellent aircraft and the pilot was superb! Great views of Dena.i and the surrounding area. Most enjoyable

After driving for 4 hours for an adventure we thought would be amazing, we were informed when we got to the k2 office that our flight was cancelled. The very unfriendly and unapologetic staff mentioned that they did not have the man power to pick up the phone to inform us. They also put them blame on us saying that should have been mentioned in the confirmation we received. Unfortunately, we booked via phone the day before an no confirmation was sent to us. 

For a service that relies on weather and tourists traveling in from great distances, you would think customer service would be a top priority. From our experience, that was not the case. 

I can't vouch for the flight. If the weather is great and they are in a good mood at the front desk, your experience will hopefully be better that ours. 

We wasted an entire day of our once-in-a-lifetime trip to Alaska. 

Had we been informed ahead of time by a simple phone call or text, we could have saved the 8-hour round-trip and stayed on the Kenai fishing.

review_title: Highlight of our trip to Alaska
review_text: From explaining the different types of trip options to the adventure itself, nothing but top notch service!

My husband and I were on our honeymoon and took a tour with K2.  Chip was our pilot and was incredibly informative about the region, the glaciers and history of Denali.  Although the plane was small (and my first time in a small plane), I felt perfectly safe.  It was such a neat experience that I would recommend to anyone.  Bring warm clothes because it is cold up there. I wore pants, long jons, a long sleeve, a heavy flannel and an insulated jacket.  I would recommend wearing boots, but they have boots you can borrow for the flight if you do not have them.  Everyone at K2 was extremely pleasant and helpful.

They canceled the landing on the glacier for the low visibility and we took a ride to see some glaciers...  not the same experience obviously but the pilot did his best. The very bad experience we had it with the 2 girls at the front desk, they were very rude and unfriendly. We asked some information and they didn't care about us. We think they should provide all the information and be kind with customers since they bring money to the company! But this is my personal opinion and probably I'm wrong, but maybe not....

We had a very limited amount of time in Alaska and wanted to maximize it. I've never done a flight tour but thought it was our only chance to see Denali. We drove to talkeetna getting there late afternoon and stopped in and they were able to get us on the last flight of the day. The weather wasn't great and I know seeing Denali can be hit or miss.  The staff was super friendly and our pilot Stan was informative and funny. I'll be honest the first bit of the flight I found myself thinking "this is nice but we shouldn't have spent the money". I've flown over lots of mountains all over the world. THEN the Great  One  appeared over the clouds with sun beating down giving the snow a golden hue. OMG 💜😳 freaking amazing!!!!!!! Just unreal. Then landing on the glacier was like something off a documentary. Beyond words. There's nothing to give the mountains and glaciers perspective so it becomes incomprehensible to appreciate the size and scope. This was by far our favorite part of the trip. Don't miss this opportunity!

We flew over Knik Glacier as we were unable to fly the Denali trip due to weather.  Our pilot was superb.  He shared his knowledge of the area and was friendly.  He made sure both sides of the plane got to see the sheep and moose we flew over.  The trip was amazing.
Loved the flight but wouild pay the extra bucks and do summit trip next time. Also go in the morning . Our pilot was excellent. Chip was his nane I believe.

We loved our air tour above the beautiful environs of Mt McKinley/Denali & the glacier landing at the base camp where explorers begin their expeditions to the top of The Great One. This is definitely a FANTASTIC way to enjoy the nature this beautiful state has to offer!

I plucked up every ounce of courage and had the time of my life! It was simply breathtaking! 

We flew with K2 on the cloudy morning of 27th July and people were cancelling or postponing flights, but we had just one morning, it was now or never. It was simply magical to see the vast glaciers, the mountains, clouds and even a glimpse of the top of Denali! Flying through and between the clouds added to the adventure as while the pilots know what was behind each turn we didn't and it was a series of breathtaking surprises. 

If conditions look dubious, take their advice if they offer a shorter/different flight and remember that they can not predict the clouds!

We did this as a spur of the moment thing, and as it was a nice day we are glad that we did. The views and scenery were spectacular and the view to Mt McKinley was amazing. We booked it as a walk up and it was $180 pp. the pilot was fun and friendly and was a decision we are glad we made. Must do.

review_title: Great flight with outstanding pilot Chip.
review_text: My husband and I took the flight with glacier landing.I am afraid to fly but the flight and landings were so smooth. The pilot  CHIP SONN was so friendly and knowledgeable, he really took the whole experience to the next level.

review_title: Oh so lucky to see and land on the glacier at base camp for Mt Denali
review_text: Apparently only about once a week you see my Denali at this time of the year. We lucked out twice in one week! The flight on a de Haviland 10 seater with Barry as our pilot was awesome. We landed at base camp where the climbers start for the ascent of mt Denali. Sunshine and barely a cloud on the mountain. The commentary and knowledge imparted to us was great. First class experience.

Wasn't planning to do flight seeing but we just couldn't resist. Great setup. Friendly front desk help. The pilot was super informative and awesome. Flight was smooth and beautiful scenery. So worth it!!!

review_title: Superb trip to the glacier with an outstanding pilot
review_text:
We took a flight to see Mount Denali and, hopefully, to land on a glacier.  At the outset, our pilot, Chip, told us that the prospects for a glacier landing were not good, as the weather at the mountain landing site had been cloudy.  As someone with an aviation background, I was both disappointed and encouraged to hear that, as it shows an overriding concern with safety, something not always seen with aerial tour operators.

     The aircraft was a spotless and well-tuned Otter, one of the best-built and safest aircraft used for such tours.  I had the chance to sit in the co-pilot seat, and was very impressed with Chip's professionalism and expertise.

     Luckily, the weather cleared and allowed us to land on the glacier.  That is a thrilling and once-in-a-lifetime experience, and the awe in standing on the snow surrounded by steep, majestic peaks is hard to describe.

     If you want to see the glacier and the Alaska Range our of Talkeetna, we highly recommend K2 Aviation.

user_location: New York City, New York, USA
review_text:
Recently used K2 for our flight to Denali. Although we weren't able to land on the glacier because of the weather, our pilot Chris made it an enjoyable, informative and safe flight.
I was lucky enough to be in the co-pilots seat and watch Chris as he piloted his way through the mountains, as well as the extra views available up front!

We chose the 1.5 hour Denali flight seeing tour.  While the experience was nice our guide was less than desirable.  Not sure if he was just burnt out or not interested but the info he provided was limited.  When we approached Denali he basically said yeah there's Denali and we headed back?!?!?  At the beginning, he said he had been doing this for 18 years and could talk but wanted our questions.  We didn't have a lot of questions as we didn't really know what to ask - we were looking forward to receiving info but that just didn't happen like we expected.  This is an ok experience but a bit pricey for what we got, in my opinion anyway.

review_title: Excellent Experience-Glacier Landing is Worth It!
review_text: We had a full flight and everyone had a window. My husband was the co-pilot and had a great view, but couldn't take unobstructed pictures because of the propeller. The flight was amazing and our pictures are breathtaking. Our pilot was knowledgeable and explained to us what we were seeing. On the way to our landing strip, At least on our trip,The Denali Flyer, I sat on the left side of the plane and had a decent view. I recommend sitting on the right side of the plane because they have a better view of the mountain. Ask the pilot to see what they say. The glacier landing was amazing! We were fortunate that we went on a day that we could see Denali. It was definitely worth the extra money and we would do it again. We would definitely go again.

So first I was worried about getting air sick on such a small plane.  However Chris our pilot was awesome.  He did a great job on a very smooth take off and landing.  A few bumps in the air but the few times he came over the com sysytem to give a warning it may get bumpy.  

Due to weather we were unable to land on the glacier but they were wonderful with refunding the money before our flight.  We  were bummed but appreciate they put safety first.

The flight itself was amazing the views were beautiful and unforgettable.  This is the best way to see some of the most amazing sites Alaska has to offer.  Chris was very knowledgeable and made the entire time very informative and engaging.  This is definetly a bucket list item that must be done.

review_title: A Highlight of Our Trip - K2 Was Great
review_text:
Our flight-seeing trip was a great experience. After day after day of heavy overcast and rain during our week in Alaska, the day of our scheduled 4 hour Fly-Hike looked promising. 

Arriving at K2, they were very up-front about the fact that the weather for the afternoon in the mountains was expected to change dramatically - they were confident about getting us in, but might not be able to get us out!  They checked with several pilots and the weather reports and offered us 3 possibilities:  cancel with a refund, go for it and possibly spend the night camped at the destination (they're prepared for that) or switch to a flight-only trip.  We chose the flight-only option (1-1/4 hrs) and wound up as the only passengers on a 6-seater plane piloted by Daniel.

What a tremendous outing!  Daniel was enthusiastic, knowledgeable, and skillful.  We headed up over the clouds, over several glaciers, over fields and rivers viewing the landscape from multiple angles and altitudes. The photo opportunities never seemed to end and the knowledge we gained inestimable.

I can't say enough about how well we were treated - honest and forthright.  I've dealt with other tourist oriented companies that would do anything to hold on to their fees, but K2 did the right thing right out of the gate.

Thank you Daniel and K2 for a perfect end to our trip.

My husband and I had a wonderful flight over Mt. Denali with pilot, Chris Wilson!! He flew perfectly with a great landing and take off on the Ruth Glacier! The weather was perfect!  It was amazing and I would recommend this flight to anyone! The K2 Aviation ground crew, Taylor, in the office, was very helpful giving us information on how to obtain a video of the flight, in which we could email our personal photographs and they would place them in the video. PERFECT!
Barry our pilot, took us to Kahiltna Glacier.  It was a trip of a lifetime.  Don't hesitate if you have interest.  DO IT.  It is worth every penny.  Great time, thanks so much!

This was a dream come true.  The whole experience was amazing and breathtaking.  Patrick C. was our pilot and we felt completely safe as he guided us around the mountain range and seeing magnificent Denali.    The pictures that I was able to take while flying will be some of the most prized in my collections.  If you are doing a trip into Alaska and want to see Denali and the beautiful valley - do this flying trip with K2.

Our flight over the Alaskan range was awesome.  Our pilot Samuel was great.  He made sure we got to see Mt Denali (there was some cloud cover but he got us above it).  He knew the area very well and was a lot of fun.  Probably should have paid extra to land on the glacier but not everyone in my group wanted to do so.

review_title: Fly around and land on glacier at Denali
review_text: Great flight around Denali seeing all of the glaciers and how they have carved out the surface of the mountain topped only by the landing on Ruth's glacier.  I wasn't sure about landing on the glacier but it turned out to be an unbelievable experience and a highlight of our trip.  Great pilot - Chris.  Soft landings and lots of good info about the area we flew over.  He also give an excellent suggestion of were to eat lunch.

Our flight-seeing over Denali was definitely one of the highlights of our trip to Alaska. Magnificent views, awe inspiring. Our pilot navigated through breaks in the clouds to make sure we could see Denali, for both sides of the plane. Landing on a glacier and spending a few moments to appreciate the majesty was also definitely worth it.

My brother and I booked a flight tour with glacier landing through K2 and we were extremely happy with our decision. Our pilot, Stan, was professional and personable. He did a great job of describing the views and giving everyone a chance to see the awesome sights. If you are wondering if this tour is worth the investment, I can say YES! with total confidence.

We took our 6 year old son. The plane held about 10 people, I think? The pilot talked to us about the plane and the rules, etc. Everyone had a seat belt and a headset. I also had my "dizziness band" strapped on. My son got a little dizzy at one point, but he was okay. Landing and taking off was easy and smooth. I somehow didn't realize that glaciers would be SNOWY, so make sure you're wearing boots. We stepped out of the plane and into about a foot of snow, at least. Lots of amazing picture opportunities. Very well run business.

We did the Denali experience with a landing on the Eldridge Glacier and I can confidently say it was in the top 5 experiences of my life. I felt like a child again soaring past sheer granite cliff faces, and my little brain marvelled at the incomprehensible majesty of the landscape surrounding us. The landing was amazing, and I have loved re-living it with photos, videos, and the story of this amazing experience. The pilot was knowledgeable and made us feel very safe and I would highly recommend this trip.

Great experience with K-2 Aviation.  We did the fixed wing flight with landing on a glacier.  It was fantastic and the views of Denali and glaciers incredible.  I cannot say enough about our flight.  It was a great birthday present to my husband that he will always remember.  We flew in and out of the gorgeous mountains.  Landing on the glacier and walking on it was awesome.  Taking off from the glacier was quite an experience.  I would recommend doing it in Talkeetna rather than while in Denali.

This was a bucket-list flight for my husband and me and the centerpiece of our trip/cruise to Alaska. We were fortunate to have Patrick as our pilot. He was experienced and very knowledgeable about the area. The weather had been iffy, but cleared enough for him to take us above the clouds to see top of Mt. Denali. Our flight through the Alaska Range was truly spectacular, culminating in our glacier landing. Patrick explained the weather situation and landing procedure to us in advance, and we felt completely at ease. It was breathtaking, a once-in-a-lifetime experience! We knew we were in very good hands. As a result, we would highly recommend K-2 flights to anyone considering a flight-seeing tour of this area!

review_title: Super Experience even without seeing Denali
review_text: Recent rain and lingering overcast made flight doubtful as our scheduled 3:00 pm flight approached on July 26, but K2 and other companies started to fly again around 12 noon.  We were scheduled for the Grand Tour around the mountain with a glacier landing.  No flying around the mountain but a glacier landing was still possible.  So our flight was shortened and the balance refunded before take-off.  If the glacier landing was not to be, we would get a further refund.  Fortunately the cloud ceiling allowed our pilot to show us a great deal of the lower but still stunningly spectacular ridges and glaciers.  The landing on the Pika Glacier was one of the coolest (both senses of the word) aviation experiences I've had, and the time on the glacier and the take-off and return to Talkeetna were fabulous.  My wife and son were absolutely thrilled with the experience, which was the original objective.  Great pilot, great company, great time.

We enjoyed our flight tour and glacier landing very much.  Highlight of our family trip.  Our guide was knowledgeable and friendly.  Everything was professionally done.  They were very helpful in coordinating our shuttle back and forth and working with us to reschedule when the weather didn't cooperate.

Wonderful pilot!!! He was very informative of the glaciers and mountains we were viewing along the way.  Would do this again in a heartbeat.  Stunning vistas!  My husband said that this was the highlight of our trip to Alaska.  We went right over the top of Mt. Denali with the "Summit Tour".

K2 gave us the most incredible tour of Denali! The weather cooperated the evening of our tour to the summit. Our capable pilot took us to Mt. Forager, Mt. Hunter and Mt. Denali. We got very close to the summit of Denali. We were the last flight of the day which gave us a little advantage in that we flew several minutes longer than we normally would have. Very memorable, great photos, not to be missed!

review_title: Honest and Focused on a Safe, Quality Experience
review_text: The K2 Aviation management provides a very safe experience and commitment to satisfaction.  We wanted to fly to Denali and land on the glacier.  They downgraded our trip to a flightseeing offering because it was not safe to land on the glacier and eventually cancelled the trip because we would not be able to see very much.  Their impeccable reputation was spoken about by many people in the area.  We missed not seeing "the mountain," but felt it appropriate to write a review because of their honesty and attention to safety.
We loved landing on this glacier.  My husband and I got to take turns sitting in the co pilot seat.  quite an experience.  We were happy to land safely and enjoy a stroll on the glacier.

review_title: Amazing Trip to the Glacier Landing
review_text: We had a wonderful time and the pilot was awesome! He is commemorated in our pictures and we enjoyed his company.

review_title: If you only do one thing in Alaska, make it this
review_text: We had an absolutely fabulous time with K2.  Incredible views that left our jaws hanging open.  We saw things we wouldn't have seen any way other than by air.  We were bummed the weather didn't cooperate to see the North side of Denali but they happily accommodated us and lowered the price.  The glacier landing was awesome and made for a stunning photo opp. Stan our pilot was cool.  This is something we'll be talking about much in to the future.  Sleep in your car if you have to to make room in your budget, hands down the best thing we've done in any of our travels ever.

Although pricey, it is worth EVERY penny!!  If you are thinking about doing this, don't think any more - just do it!! You won't be disappointed.  The pilots are amazing, pointing out landmarks, glaciers, and mountain wildlife.  Landing on Kahiltna Glacier is an experience we will never forget.  This was definitely the highlight of our 14 day Alaska trip! One of the best sightseeing tours we have ever taken!

review_title: A Perfect flight despite imperfect weather
review_text: My wife and I did the full Denali circuit and had a wonderful smooth experience.   The pilot was top notch and the airplane and equipment in perfect working order and very well suited for this type of operation.   K2 has a sterling reputation in the local FAA world and we found out firsthand why.

Originally I was scheduled for the 9:00am Grand Denali tour but mother nature had other plans. Denali was still rained and fogged in but K2 was able to offer me the chance to instead fly over Knik Glacier. It was a beautiful flight and the views were gorgeous.  Our pilot was willing to answer any questions we had and it was a once in a lifetime experience I greatly enjoyed.

Breath taking, pilot was fantastic, best part of our vacation. Would recommend to everyone we talk too!
The pilot did everything to make the trip breath taking. The clouds were not helping but the pilot got under and around the clouds so we could see Denali clearly! Did not have a room only flight.

I arranged a flight to Mt McKinley (now called Denali) with a glacier landing for 25th July, 2016. I selected K2 after checking the NTSB site and reading their itinerary. Even during our check-in and safety briefing it was immediately apparent these guys were extremely professional, very well organised and our pilot was outstanding. As an ex-pilot, I was impressed. Their aircraft appear to be very well maintained and our DH single turbine Otter was immaculate. One of the best and smoothest flights I have ever had. The commentary was well informed, actually very interesting and professional. As for the scenery, simply stunning, very fortunate to have a perfect day with sunshine! You get to fly close by the peak of Denali with uninterrupted views. You also fly close to cliff faces during the glacier landing, but at no time do you feel unsafe. As for walking on the glacier, superb, never done anything like it before. Lots of opportunities for photos. We were in Alaska for 3 weeks, we had two definite highlights and this was one of them. If we return to Alaska, I know one of the things I will be doing! Very impressed with these guys.

review_title: Absolute Highlight of Our Alaska Trip
review_text:
This was the highlight of our land/sea Alaska trip. A beautiful sunny day, tremendous pilot (Randy), great scenery, landing on a glacier, nice views of Mt Denali. It just doesn't get any better. 
K2 is very professional organization. No need to worry about the experience level of their pilots as they are all first rate and very experienced flying in the Alaskan bush. 
Can't recommend this outfit highly enough.

We spent 2 weeks in Alaska - this was the highlight of the trip.  We were unable to see Denali because of the weather, but the landing on the glacier was really awe inspiring.  This was expensive, but well worth it - I highly recommend it.
Great tour..sights never able to see any other way..highly recommend..must see when in Alaska! Totally worth it...

My husband and I had contracted to take a flight for sightseeing with this company and sent in our deposit. Because of a sudden illness, we called them the morning of the flight and told them we were not going to make it. They refunded all our money. We didn't ask them for a refund, but they volunteered it. Wow!  We were totally impressed. We will recommend this company to anyone we know that is going to be traveling in this area.

Flights around Mt. Denali, a landing on a glacier and a hike around a remote glacier lake - those are a few tours offered by K2 Aviation. I joined the flight to a remote glacier lake where we did an easy hike around the lake. Since K2 Aviation is the only airline with the permission to land there, this is a really special trip.
To fly among such grandeur was awe inspiring. And to do so in such an ancient British aircraft doubly so.
Loved the scenery despite the weather.  Could not do the complete tour because of poor weather on the north side of Mt. Denail.

definitely worth doing once in your life!!!  it is a bit expensive but worth it.  the day we went we were not the only plane on the glaicer..but it was still fun..you dont stay very long, and the temperature was not very cold on the top of it. enjoyed this

From start to finish this was a great attraction.   Weather was bad at our scheduled time so K2 got us on another flight the next day.   Barry our pilot was great and knew Aton about the mountain.
We would do this again.

Everything from booking the flight to the actual flight itself was great.  Our pilot had a lot of great information to share with us about what we were flying over.  I would definitely fly with them again.  Next time I'd go for the glacier landing.

We took the glacier landing flight w our 20+ year old kids and our 80+ year old grand folks ~ the plane was large enough for all 7 of us and my 87 year old father  (ex-pilot) had the time of his life!  The K2 pilot was superior in skill and safety!  We chose to do this rather than Christmas presents this year!  Priceless memories!
We had the best pilot and the best narration! What an amazing adventure to land on a glacier and walk out and experience it!!!!!!!

The guys at K2 were fantastic. They were patient, helpful, and a joy on the flight. Easy going people. If you are thinking about a flight be sure to include a glacier landing. The extra cost us well worth it. We had a blast.

They were there waiting for us.  We walked there from the train station. And when it was over they willingly took us to our hostel.  The pilot was great and the service was fantastic.  I have no complaints at all.  Awesome experience.

I think this is a new tour for K2 this year and they might be the only operator who offers it.  We had a 45 min or so flightseeing tour around park (we had perfect weather, clear skies but a few puffy clouds) where we were able to see the peak of Denali.  We then landed at Moraine Lake (floatplane) and "hiked" for about 2 hours with a couple of guides who are based there at the lake for the season.  It's a pretty relaxed hike, would have preferred something a little more ambitious but that's just me, they make it accessible to all.  But the views and waterfalls and scenery, knowing that you're in the middle of the mountain range, where hardly anyone else can go, was really inspiring.  The guides were knowledgable and very personable.  We had a little snack and glass of wine while taking in the scenery and marveling at where we were at before the flight back, which covered new terrain.  Just an exceptional tour and incredible experience!!

Had beautiful but cloudy day- no Denali. Pilot James gave excellent description of land and rivers. Landing and taking off in float plane really smooth. Hike was all to short and may been limited by capabilities of flight party.

review_title: DENALI FLIGHT TOURS - K2 Aviation, Talkeekna
review_text: If your in Alaska, and do nothing else, take this flight around or above Denali. It is truly the ultimate mountain experience. We felt as if we were on another planet. The professionalism of the company, pilot and clearly the well maintained planes, surpassed all our of our expectations. It was the highlight of our 3 weeks in Alaska.

A great experience flying about Denali. The glacier landing was smooth and our pilot told many interesting stories to keep us informed and entertained. Would go back for a second tour on our next trip to Alaska.

review_title: Totally awesome! Landed on the Ruth Glacier!
review_text:
Sort of on the spur of the moment, we decided to take a Denali flight with K2 Aviation. (We actually booked our flight the night before.) We had basically been in Alaska for about 36 hours, on our way to Denali National Park, and spent the night in Talkeetna. 

We had a great aircraft and pilot with K2 Aviation and the weather was absolutely wonderful! (Yes, we were fortunate!) Our flight to Denali was pleasant and relatively uneventful. Once we got in the vicinity of Denali, the sheer size of the mountain is overwhelming. Our pilot flew us around Denali so that we could see it from all sides. We eventually landed on the Ruth Glacier and enjoyed several minutes of just standing there in awe of it all.

Lastly, I hope that this photograph is able to come through for your viewing pleasure:

https://theta360.com/s/kL0zIiwxbEO6HldNppNCMUZEW

The was my first time to Alaska and the friends I stayed recommended this experience since I wanted to see the mountains and glaciers.   I'm from Lubbock Texas and we don't see things like that here.  The views were beautiful and I was in told amazement the entire flight.
Our family loved our Ruth Glacier trip with our pilot Chip.  He was extremely informative and a thorough professional.  It was an exceptional experience.

Der Himmel reißt auf und vor uns liegt die beeindruckende Kulisse des Denali. Los geht's mit K2 in einem kleinen Flieger mit nur 4 Personen. Wir bewegen uns nach Norden bis wir in die Täler einfliegen und uns immer entlang der Gletscher bewegen. Fachkundig entpuppt sich der Pilot auch noch als Guide. Ein rundum gelungener Flug von fast 90 Minuten. Der Prei lässt einen zwar schlucken, aber er ist das Erlebnis wert.

My family and I flew with K2 out of Talkeetna in July 2016.  We originally signed up for the Grand Tour, but due to clouds on the far side of the mountain we had to shift to the Denali Flyer.  We were not disappointed in the least.  Mike, our pilot, gave us a fantastic tour or the mountains, and was able to find a break in the clouds to get us a great view of Denali.  We did a glacier landing at Denali basecamp which has always been on my bucket list.  My kids, ages 6 to 11, had a fantastic time through the whole trip.  I definitely recommend this flight for families with kids, and I highly recommend the glacier landing.  Thank you K2!  This was the crown jewel in our trip yo Alaska.
The flight was great. The pilot Mike is a hoot. My wife rode in the copilot seat...every part of the experience was top notch.

If you have a chance to go, definitely do it. I was able to do the glacier landing. Our weather that day was perfect. It is amazing to fly around the range and a great way to get a perspective of how big Denali actually is. We landed on the Ruth glacier. It was amazing to feel how warm it actually was up there. We were fine with just sweatshirts that day. We did here that it is always good to bring layers though. It is hard to describe what being on a glacier is like. It is just something that has to be experienced. The planes are small, so if you have claustrophobia that might be an issue. Also if you get motion sickness or can't stand turbulence, you might want to take something before your flight. When coming off the glacier and back to the airport, we encountered thermals which created a short period of turbulence. Still definitely worth every minute of it.

Although I was skeptical (and scared) about flying in a small plane, I had the most amazing flight.
The pilot was great and knowledgeable about the area, and of course the views were phenomenal, an exceptional experience.

Overcast day with a hint of sun! Pilot Samuel provided an awe inspiring trip through the mountains! With his expertise, I now have a new perspective of these mountains and Denali, which did make an appearance.

review_title: A check off of my bucket list!!
review_text: Wow, visited the wonderful town of Talkeetna, AK. My family and I took the glacier landing tour all we can say is, what an experience. It was awesome. The staff was great. Dominick set up our tour and the pilot, Chris took the time to point out the glaciers and give us some history about them and the surrounding areas. The landing was so smooth and as we stepped down from the plane we were all in awe of the view and couldn't believe we were standing on Pika Glacier.  Thank you K2 you made this an unforgettable experience.

This is a tour you cannot miss. We were scheduled on a landing tour but could not due to weather. We were given option of a full refund or a longer air tour for less money. Glad we took this flight. The views were just breathtaking and had views from all seats on plane. Flight lasted almost 2 hours and was well worth the money. Entire staff very friendly even though they were very busy due to the weather on the mountain.

Fantástico vuelo, con unas vistas increíbles del McKinley ( Denali ). El aterrizaje en el glaciar, impresionante, Excelentes profesionales y aviones muy modernos.
  Totalmente recomendables.

review_title: The highlight of our trip to Alaska
review_text: We decided to do the glacier landing excursion at the last minute and we were glad we did. Everyone was professional from the office staff to the pilot. The pilot, Randy, appeared to be very experienced and skilled, and was a wealth of information. What an unforgettable experience. This was an excursion we will talk about for years.

We have never done a small plane before and were blown away by the view our Pilot brought us to it was wonderful. He explained everything to us and where we were at all times and the landing on the Glacier was so smooth we never felt a bump I would recommend this trip to anyone and everyone it was beautiful. I do recommend that you take some air sickness med, it gets very warm in the plain on the return trip but I would still do it over again
The crew at K2 are amazing and make the whole experience easy and fun.  If you can plan to go when the sun is out, the trip is just that much more magnificent.

Bucket List Extreme!! Very professional but friendly pilot. He obviously loves what he does. And he was very skilled flying around Denali and in and out of the extreme valleys around it. He was knowledgeable about the many glaciers we flew over. And when we landed on a glacier in this magnificent setting, all I can say is "WOW"!!!!!!!  It took my breath away.
We enjoyed every minute of our tour. Views were spectacular. Thank goodness I had a digital camera with a lot of memory. Great time. Highly recommend.
The weather was perfect for mountain viewing. The staff in the office assisted us very well. The pilot was great and very informative. He was even taking pictures!

While we did not get yo land on a glacier because of weather conditions, this has truly been the highlight of our visit so far. Beautiful fly by's of the glaciers, lots of wonderful information and a terrific pilot named Daniel made this so very memorable!

Our pilot, Chip, was great. We felt safe the entire time and he was very informative. I know it's a bit pricey but splurge for the glacier landing. It's so worth it!  We've traveled many places but this was the coolest adventure yet.
This is a "must" if you are going to be in Alaska.  We were hesitate to spend the money, but so glad we did.
Our pilot was fabulous and even gave us an extra tour because the weather was so beautiful!! Highly recommend.

The flight to Denali and the glacier landing was fantastic.  The views from the plane and the photographs we took are truly breathtaking.  Our pilot Barry was informative and a very competent pilot as well as a great guide.  The trip was worth every dollar.
Amazing, we added the glacier stop and it was worth every penny. The views of Denali were beautiful. I had been in the park many times but seeing Denali from above was truly amazing.

We had a very enjoyable flight-seeing tour of Denali and the surrounding mountains and glaciers.  The pilot was very experienced and operated the aircraft very safely, which was a 1957 tail-dragger Beaver (a beautiful plane).  The only negative is that the mountains were clouded-in above 10,000 ft., so we only saw the lower elevations, which were still quite spectacular.  It was our second aerial tour of Denali; the first was 29 years ago during our 1st wedding anniversary.  I would fly with K2 Aviation again, when the mountains are out.

My husband and I took a flight with K2 Avation from Talkeetna into, around and through the Alaska Mtn Range that will forever be in our memories and our photo album and our screensavers and FB feed!  It was AWESOME!  We were blessed with very clear and smooth skies on 6/29/16, had amazing views like we have never seen anywhere before,and got so many photos.  K2 runs a great operation---nice plane, clean windows so we didn't miss a thing, and especially a great pilot who showed us and told us about the area, topography and history.  We would highly recommend a flight with K2 and from Talkeetna!

review_title: K2 Aviation Grand Tour Denali Flightseeing
review_text:
We are long time Alaskans and have viewed Denali from the air as well as the road system on several occasions.  Our K2 Aviation flightseeing trip topped them all. 

The phone reservation was quickly arranged, the agent worked to fit OUR schedule.  We receiving an email confirmation with all details including what to bring.

We used a gift certificate for this trip, the value was towards the "Denali Experience" a 1-hour flight.  However much to our delight we treated to the Grand Tour", a 2 hour flight that included a complete circle of Denali, Ruth Glacier, Wickersham Wall, Kahiltna Base Camp., basically a grand tour of the entire Denali National Park.  We were in the air for just under 2 hours!

Our pilot Samuel was well-versed in the history of the park and the geology that has formed this area.  He was obviously an experienced and professional Denali pilot.

I don't have a single complaint or recommendation for improvement.  K2 Aviation is professional from reservation to landing and they know how to do it right.

Flying over Denali with K2 Aviation was the highlight of our amazing trip to Alaska. Our morning slot for our flight was impacted by bad weather so we opted to change to afternoon flightseeing, so accommodating were the folks at K2... just friendly people! Our pilot was awesome, felt so safe. Landing on glacier thrilling!!

Fantastic.  This is one well oiled business.  From Dominic at the front desk, to Ryan our pilot we had nothing but top-notch service.  I would recommend one of these flights to anyone.  The Otter we flew in was the most beautiful plane I have ever been in, and I have flown F-16s for years.  We were looking around the retail area and one of the other pilots, Stan Steck came over and engaged us.  His enthusiasm was contagious as he explained the various trip options and how much he loved flying all the different planes.  The flight could not have been better, it was simply beautiful.  I am so glad we did this trip and am thankful for the outstanding staff and service we received.  Thank you.
Guides are experienced and well knowledged about the area, took us around the mountains for about 2 hours including the landing.

review_title: Flights from Talkeetna. It's worth the $!
review_text: Outstanding flight! Even though weather was not ideal (always a chance we take) staff was accommodating and helpful. Pilot was more than enthusiastic and smooth plane operator. Can't wait to show all my friends and family the amazing photos.!! Thanks again K2 Aviation.

K2 Aviation was fantastic, as we had a group of 8 - 4 kids ages 7 the 12 and my parents who are 80.  We all enjoyed the trip, the staff was super friendly, our pilot very informative and the glacier landing was breathtaking!

We couldn't have had better weather!! There were no clouds and minimal wind, it was an amazing flight and an even better experience. Thank you to K2 for getting us up there to share the beauty of Denali Nat'l Park! Definitely recommend to our friends and family.

Our early morning flight over Denali had been highly anticipated for many weeks. Our pilot Nick took us to our nicely maintained plane for a safety briefing and how to mind our in-flight manners. Sometimes it is hard to meet your expectations when you have been anticipating something for a long time. Well K2 and Nick fulfilled our expectations and then some. Mother Nature did a little too. We had a glorious cloudless day for this trip and Denali gave us her all! Even Nick was taking pictures!

Got to double check this bucket list item! Thanks K2.

Great flight, wonderful pilot/guide. It was a spectacularly beautiful day with just enough clouds to  give some depth to our photos.  I had been on a flight around Denali before, I think landing on the glacier was superior. Walking on the glacier was really a special experience.

Our pilot, Brian, gave us a smooth trip out to a lake on a float plane, and then we had a hike with our guide, Brian, (no, not the same one) was very informative about the glaciers and mountains in the area.  Nora also took my niece a little higher up the mountain, for a more involved hike.  I could tell that everyone we met absolutely loved what they were doing, and really care about the conservation of this beautiful place.

We drove from anchorage to Talkeetna  zi suggest the "Train" drive is long... But once there it is a great little town and the K2 Aviation is the the BEST.  T Hey fly these great "De Havilland" Airplanes 10 seater.  Our pilot has/had been flying since he was 14 and now he was 15 (no - kidding he was probably 36 or so)  Great young very social knowledgeable man from the area.  He took us on an "A"MAZING" journey through the mountains and glaciers explaining all the history of the land and of glaciers and of the colors and the "works" of the glaciers.  He gave us - you- ample opportunity for everyone in every seat of the plane to take plenty of photos.  Our luck was that we flew to the bottom and landed on a glacier - at the base of Mt. McKinley and were also picking up a hiker that had finally had her chance to hike th mt.  We landed at their "base camp".  We learned all about them and their attempt to climb the mt. and how they had been sleeping for days waiting for the winds to die down so that they could get the right day to climb the mt.  Our pilot never rushed us.  We had a lot of time to walk around the Glacier. I even fell into a soft spot and being, as you might of figured out my know and older gentleman took a  couple of guys to pull me out of the hole I got myself into. Never in danger. Just more humorous and embarrassing than anything. My wife looked at my like "Oh there he goes again!!"  

There are other airlines you can use. DON't  USE K2.  They are the best and most patient and knowledgeable and offer the best of the tours and times.  Everyone I talked to on other flights said the same thing.  This was a highlight of our AK trip.   I highly recommend going to this little town it is lovely and taking this airplane trip and landing on a glacier and seeing if you can arrange to land at one of the "base camps".  

Enjoy your AK trip.
Regards 
PK

The staff was friendly and helpful!  The flight was a visual stunner, views you can only get from a small aircraft!!  Our pilot was well informed, answered all of our questions and gave us a safe and wonderful experience!

I had an excellent experience flying around Denali and surrounding mountains with K2.  I had average expectations for just another "touristy" type event.  The trip far, far exceeded my expectations and was truly a highlight of my 10-day trip to AK.  Very grand.  Our pilot was a great guide.

review_title: Lucky to have a perfect day
review_text: Having been to Alaska before, you do not get to pick your weather, especially for viewing Denali.  K2 did a great job.  Very professional and a a perfect flight.  We took some outstanding photos.

review_title: Who? Me? Land on a glacier? SURE!
review_text: I'm older (60s) my friend is OLDER (72) and yet we really wanted to go--K2 has great staff, so kind and helpful in many ways. The biggest part of the trip is in the plane looking out over Denali and the glaciers, and understanding this is how Alaska has been formed, glacier after glacier, cutting rock after rock. Leaving silt upon silt--The views were magnificent and our guide/pilot very knowledgeable. He told us where he was moving and why, where he would land and how it would happen. He answered questions and pointed out highlights. The glacier landing itself was a wonder--how do you feel landing on the moon? looking around and seeing how small we are. Awe struck, astounded? Then we get back in the air and safely home. It has stayed with me though, the feelings. The beauty.

This activity was not on our list of planned tours. While signing up for a rafting trip the people there encouraged us to consider the air tour. Another customer agreed saying it was incredible. It was expensive-$350/person. My husband and the wife of the couple we traveled with are both fearful of flying. Amazingly , my husband was excited to go and sat in the front with the pilot. Our friend took a little encouragement , but she did fine. Our pilot was Chris, a  young man with 13 years of experience who taught snow skiing at Vail, CO in the winter. The weather had been clear all day but they were so busy we had to book at 7 pm. It was cloudy by then and actually started raining on our way back at 9:00.  WOW!!! What a way to view the Alaska Range and Denali. A smooth landing in the glacier, stayed about 30 minutes. We wore headphones to listen to the pilot explain what we were seeing and giving information about the mountain climbers. We saw their tents. We flew around Denali about 12,500 feet (it's 20,310 ft). It was a splurge, but worth it!

Thanks to K2 and pilot Chris, our evening flight and landing could not have been more perfect.   This was my first flight seeing experience in a small plane but it was perfect in every way.    We took amazing photos, the flight was smooth as silk, and it was the highlight of our stay in Talkeetna.  Very highly recommended.

review_title: Flight seeing around Denali with landing on Ruth Glacier
review_text: Chris was our pilot and what an awesome job he did!  He was patient, pleasant and fun while giving us all kinds of fun facts and thoroughly answering our questions. We had the perfect day for a flight around Denali!

My husband and I participated in the glacier landing flight and it was truly a once in a lifetime experience! We were scheduled for a Sunday flight and the weather was not good. Luckily, we were able to head up to Denali National Park & Preserve, spend a few days there and then complete our trip that Thursday on our way back. We were so happy K2 was so accommodating to us to make sure we got the best experience ever. 

It is truly hard to describe the experience of flying right next to the top of the Denali Mountain (which we saw clear!) and then landing on a glacier. The size of everything itself is so overwhelming on top of the pure beauty all around you. The flight was great.  I get motion sickness so I took a dramamine 30 minutes before take off and had no issues at all. 

If you are going to be in Alaska I highly recommend making this a part of your trip - you will not regret it!

One of the best parts of my trip to Alaska. This is a once-in-a-lifetime and must-do thing if you are visiting this beautiful state!! The views of the mountains, especially Denali, are breathtaking. Unbelievable experience. Pilot and plane ride were great too! I thought I would be scared but I wasn't at all once I got on the plane. And definitely do the glacier landing, it is the best part by far of the experience!

Wow! Definitely the pinnacle of our trip! When deciding what we liked best about our honeymoon, my wife and I both agreed we had to throw out the flightseeing tour because it was far and away the best part. Although it was pricey it was worth every penny! We took the green route and paid extra for the glacier landing. Again yes it was expensive but WOW the views of Alaska from the plane were breathe taking! Our pilot, Chris if I remember correctly, was very knowledgeable about the glaciers, the mountain, and the area.

HIGHLY RECOMMEND! We decided at 3:15pm to join the 3:30pm flight to the glacier. It was the highlight of our entire trip! We put on the provided boots and boarded the airplane with Mike for a breathtaking flight, landing and overall experience. Mt McKinley was clear and we could see it. Landing on the glacier was smooth and soft. We got out of the plane and made snowballs, yelled to listen to the echo and Mike made a snow angel for us! Such an amazing trip! DO IT ... YOU WILL LOVE IT!

This was my second time doing a flightsee of Denali and landing on the glacier.  Tales from the first time prompted some friends to come up from L48 and do one.  As with the first trip, it was epic, magnificent, and all-around spellbinding.  Our pilot was fantastic, very knowledgable about the mountain and the whole area, and just a great guy to have with us.  While the trip isn't cheap, I will continue to do it periodically in the future because I can't get enough of the whole experience.

If you are lucky enough to flightsee Denali when the mountain is "out" it's an adventure you will never forget. My wife and I had such an experience, and words can't really describe it. We took the 90 minute glacier landing tour, and I was so moved by the views I couldn't really talk for several hours afterwards. As for K2 Aviation, they are a top notch company from top to bottom and side to side. Everyone we dealt with from the shuttle driver to the front desk to the pilot were really cool people, the kind of folks you would want to make friends with. I would do this again with K2 Aviation in a heartbeat!

review_title: Don't miss the experience while in AK
review_text:
How often do you get to fly around north Americas tallest mountain, with you knowledgable pilot providing the history of the area, staring at the incredible beauty in the rocks followed by a quick turn through a narrow pass and then you land uphill on a glacier?

Probably never....unless you fly with K2. The company has several well quipped bush planes that were very comfortable for the trip. Registration is easy on their excellent web site. When you arrive at the beautiful town of Talkeetna, you will have no trouble finding them. 

All passengers had great headsets so communication in flight was very simple and easy. The glacier landing was a great experience, and seeing the mountains features up Foos really appealed to our Colorado family who as interested in the geology of Alaska.

We'll be back!
This was a wonderful thing to do, with lovely friendly and helpful staff and pilots. I would highly recommend it to anyone who is thinking to take this flight - all ages!

We had a great flight with Patrick.  Smooth takeoffs and landings, good narration but not too much talking.  Office was understaffed and very busy (we waited 20 minutes to buy a t-shirt after our flight).  Great overall experience and highly recommended.  Expensive, but worth it!

K2 has wonderful customer service and a flight of a lifetime!  Seeing the "Alaska Mountain Range" with Denali, Hunter and Foraker all up close was breathtaking!  Then landing on a glacier...unbelievably beautiful!!

review_title: Chip was our pilot and he was very professional and personable. My husband had many hours flying private planes
review_text: Personable and professional. Plus he is just a great guy. The experience was the best part of our trip. My husband has many many hours flying small planes and he had nothing but good things to say. The day was perfect nd the experience a thrill

review_title: K2 Flightseeing adventure to Denali and glaciers
review_text: Our pilot, Chip, was great!  He was very friendly and provided us with the history of the area, pointed out floral and fauna, gave us local/regional perspectives and, even better, gave a clear description of the glacial and geological movements and features in the area.  The landing, walk around and take-off from the glacier was a once-in-a-lifetime adventure.  Denali played hide-and-seek behind a <ploof> of cloud, yet you could easily feel its presence.  K2 did a great job!

Everything about this flight experience was fabulous, including the weather!  We would highly recommend this flight to anyone.  The pilot was professional and knowledgeable, and the aircraft, audio, etc., was just great.

Flew w/K2 and Kevin as pilot on 7/14/16.  One of the best adventures.  From Talkeetna, AK to fly near Mt. Denali and around local Ruth Glacier was fantastico!
Office handled registration quickly and efficiently and Pilot Kevin was a wealth of information and patient with guests.  Great adventure with very competent organization.

On a clear day, you can see forever.  We had a clear day.  Incredible, fantastic, wonderful, exciting.  I only regret that everyone who takes this trip won't be able to have the spectacular sun that we did.  Not a cloud anywhere.  We had a very skilled and knowledgeable pilot who had interesting history, stories, and pointed out everything we were seeing.  Couldn't have been more pleased.

review_title: Float Plane to Moraine Lake - Spectacular
review_text: The flight up Ruth Glacier to Moraine Lake was filled with breathtaking views, with the pilot taking advantage of them all in a safe, professional and spectacular way. When we arrived at the lake we were able to hike in two groups with two people staying on the flat grounds surrounding the lake to a waterfall, while my group of three hiked in alpine meadows and through snow fields to have awe-inspiring views of Denali and the surrounding peaks. Afterwards we took a second pass at Denali in the sea plane. I've never felt so close to such dramatic mountains. Heartfelt thanks to Brian the pilot and Nora and Brian the guides.

Just recently visited Alaska for the first time and took a K2 flight...what an amazing experience! Our pilot, Chris, was excellent not only at flying but narrating our tour with all of his knowledge and getting us as close as possible to the amazing sights (mountains and glaciers).  All the staff at K2 are wonderful, welcoming and knowledgable and I am so thankful for the amazing experience they provided!!

user_location: I was in Omaha Nebraska I live in Arizona
review_title: I would highly recommend the red tour around Mt McKinley. Our pilot was very knowledgeable.
review_text: We had great weather I recommend you try to get a seat as far forward as possible. I sat in the 4th row and it was difficult to see over the wings.
user_city: I was in Omaha Nebraska I live in Arizona

review_text: Hands down, best tour EVER! We took the Grand Denali tour with glacier landing from K2 Aviation with Ryan as our pilot last week. The scenery is spectacular and seriously life-changing. I'm so thankful that there is such a reputable and "on the ball" company that provides such tours. Yes it was expensive, but money was the furthest thing from our minds while we were enjoying this amazing experience. Well worth every penny!

I stayed in Talkeetna specifically to use K2 for my flight & glacier landing.  I am so glad I chose this company as they were professional, kind, courteous & knowledgeable from jump.  The pilot didn't "over" talk either, which was nice so we could enjoy looking at all of the lovely sights around.  Make sure to add the glacier landing...it's an experience you will never forget or regret!

Breathtaking, memorable, lasting memory, Wow! This is by far the best experience I had during my 11 day visit to Alaska.    I understand we were extraordinarily lucky to have conditions so perfect and I guess not everyone will be so lucky, but if they tell you you will see the mountain you just have to do this.   There is no price too much for the memory of the grandeur of this area.

We arrived on a day that was overcast - they had not been able to land on the glacier for 4 days.  They were very open with us up front and shared that they could at a minimum make the fly around Mt. Denali and the glacier floor.  As it turned out, we not only saw that but were able to land on the the glacier as well!  The views in the plane and on the glacier are simply fantastic.  It is worth the high price to experience this.
Our family of 9 did a Denali Grand Tour with glacier landing and it was awesome! Pricey but how often will you land on a glacier in front of the highest peak in North America?
Excellent flight with informative pilot.  Well worth the time & money!  Should be on everyone's bucket list!

K2 was fantastiv.  From my initial inquiry to exiting the plane they were great.  Our first flight was cancelled due to poor visibility.  They offered to rebook us but we had a firm itinerary over the next few days.  Once we moved things around we rebooked, no harm, no fuss and no mess.  The actual flight was phenomenal.  It was a Chamber of Commerce weather day, so much so, that even our pilot was taking pictures!  I heartily recommend this flightseeing adventure and K2
