As an Alaskan resident, I don't do many touristy things in our beautiful state. The other half and I went on the Denali Experience tour and it was AMAZING! The pilot was fun, interactive and very informative. The office staff were pleasant. I wished I had done this a long time ago! I have driven this area and by these mountains hundreds of times but nothing compares to the up close and personal view of a flight seeing tour!!

review_title: Spectacular view of the Denali, Galciers and Tundra
review_text: Our flight time was 10:30 AM,K2 Aviation bus took to their facility by 10 AM. We boarded Beaver Bush plane which can hold 8 passengers.The take of smooth, first we crossed the river, gorges, then we had spectacular views of the canyons, glaciers and  snow-clad mountain peaks before landed back into K2 Aviation port.

review_title: Awesome fly-in trip to a moraine lake
review_text: Flew with K2 on floatplane to land on a moraine lake beyond Ruth Glacier.  Landed and had a nice two hour hike around the eerie stones lifted up by the moraine glacier.  Great trip with family. Very professional pilot and check-in crew.  High focus on safety.

review_title: Glacier Landing - Bucket List checked off
review_text: Probably the best experience ever?  They promptly pick you up at your hotel and take you to the airstrip. It's a quick check in and grab some snow boot slip ins if you're doing the glacier landing. The flight was comfortable and expertly narrated. The glacier landing was perfect. You really won't find a better flight experience. If you go cheaper, you'll get what you pay for-less!  I'd do it again!!

Our K2 flight over Denali National park was unforgettable. We took off from Talkeetna and were supposed to land on the glacier. However the conditions didn't allow the landing. The flight scenery was incredible and well narrated by the pilot. I wouldn't hesitate to go again!

Original plan was to fly around Denali and land with glacier landing.  Weather did not cooperate and we had to take a shorter route and forgo the landing but, the trip was very well worth it.  Saw many at base camp getting a more intimate view of the mountain but I will leave that to them, not much on the climbing it just because it is there.  Our sites were absolutely outstanding and a testament to nature. The pilot was great and very informative.  Flying in a radial engine powered plane was an additional treat.  Staff was equally wonderful and efficient.  If we get the chance to go back we will be using them again.

Our flight through Denali was fantastic, one of if not my favorite part of visiting Alaska! Our pilot was knowledgeable and took on an incredible tour. We bought many souvenirs from K2 one of them being the $50 video of your flight. It arrived at our house two weeks later as promised on a very flimsy data card. The most disappointing part of it was the footage. It pulsated at times like the ground was going to erupt and it appeared to have a single camera viewpoint even though we were told there were six cameras. But here’s the real kicker, not a single second of footage of Mt. Denali in the 10-minute video!! I gave K2 a chance to reply to me when I wrote and asked them why there was no footage. Three weeks later no response I decided to share with others. Very disappointing, glad I shot some videos with my phone.

We took the flight in Talkeetna to land on a glacier.  Half way through our flight, the pilot said there was something unusual with the voltage and that we needed to return --their policy is to return to get the mechanics to check out the plane, no matter how small the issue.  We landed with no issues and were back on a new plane with Chip (our pilot) within 15 minutes.  Now that is service!  Not only was his knowledge of the area amazing, he was really great with my kids and we had the best time ever!  Thanks K2 for a very memorable and safe experience for our whole family!

We took the flight around Denali with a glacier landing. It was worth every penny. I couldn't imagine a greater view of Denali! Plus the pilot was very knowledgable. I was worried about motion sickness, but the flight was smooth. One of my favorite experiences in Alaska!

review_title: An experience we will never forget, more than just a bucket list item, AWESOME!
review_text: Our original plan was to do the Denali flight and glacier landing but due to weather the flight was postponed a day.  The staff was awesome in making sure we remained informed, they were honest about the forecast but it was clear they cared about making our experience happen, THANK YOU!  Everyone in the staff were cool, polite, and obviously very experienced.  Our pilot was Chip Sonn, the guy is a studd, felt extremely confident flying with him and the flight was smooth and breathtaking.  Chip is so knowledgeable about so many topics, from history of Alaska to vegetation, animals, industry, geography, weather and of course flying... he most definitely contributed to how great our experience was.  We will be taking about this experience for years to come.

The weather was iffy for landing on a glacier but in the end the weather gave us a window and we were able to land. So awesome to be surrounded by such majestic beauty. I even had to take a little bite to say I ate some of the glacier. Fabulous adventure... Indescribable beauty!

k 2 flight was superb a great pilot and narrator the sky was beautiful with scattered clouds and landing on glacier was fun had son and grandchildren with us and they got to see denali peak and play in snow

I was partof a group and there had been some mixupon changes by our group leader. They were quite busy and one of the fellas got quite snappy when one of our group questioned something about their flight. But our flight was fantastic, the rider was smooth, our pilot fantastic and landing on the glacier an incredible experience. I would highly recommend this.

Wow!  What a unique experience.  Visiting Backside glacier and lake via floatplane was a once in a lifetime event.  Landing and hiking around the base of the glacier you got the sense of just how few people had visited the place.  It would have taken a week's hike in the wilderness to experience the same.  The plane ride was very smooth and professional, and half the fun.
Loved this adventure.  We did 6 excursions in Alaska. Boating. Hiking. Glacier walking. This was the best.  Thank you!!!

K2 and Daniel, our pilot, provided an awesome experience!  The star of the show is, of course, Mt. Denali and the surrounding mountains.  We were fortunate to have mostly clear weather around the mountain for our flight.  Daniel was friendly, professional, and very knowledgeable about the mountain, landscape and glaciers.  The landing on the glacier with its closeup view of the mountain, was the cherry on top.  The flight certainly is not cheap, but was worth it for the (probably) once in a lifetime opportunity.

We wanted to take summit tour with K2 but unfortunately weather was not on our side and our tour was cancelled thrice. After third cancellation , I requested K2 to refund money and I received refund within 3 days.

review_title: Glacier landing - Amazing and fun - Top shelf operation.
review_text: Amazing - we couldn't have been happier.  First of all, an efficient operation that's professionally run - this is the top shelf provider for Denali.  Second, the pilot was informative and fun too - not to mention great at his job - a smooth landing on the glacier, beautiful flight around Mt. Denali.  Once in a lifetime - not to be missed.

review_title: K2 flight see and glacier landing
review_text: The staff was friendly, professional and knowledgable both on the phone and in person.  Our pilot was Stan- he gave excellent commentary throughout our flight as well as performing his technical duties with excellence.  Our experience was a definite highlight of our trip to Alaska- highly recommend!

We used the Air taxi service to get us on and off the glacier.  K2 did everything they could do to get us there and drop us off.  They even coordinated with local contacts in Talkeetna upon our return to get us a room for the night.  All in all a very open and busy company.  only one suggestion for the K2 folks.  When the pilot dropped us off on the glacier, we had no idea of where to go.  He was concerned with getting us off the plane and moving on.  There were a hundred other climbers there waiting to get off the glacier and I'm sure this amounted to his sense of urgency, but pointing us in the right direction would have been the icing on the cake.
A must do if you have a clear day. Best activity my wife and I did. Great customer care. The pilot was awesome as well.

It was a cloudy, iffy weather day. We arrived earlier than our slot and they offered to take us immediately as the weather was supposed to get worse. They could not do the bigger tour and so offered the next level at the lower price. They were very honest about that and even offered the lower price that existed when we originally booked the tour months back. It turned out to be a great day, after all as the weather turned to better!

review_title: Best $855 I ever spent (total for a couple plus a K2 sweatshirt
review_text: Almost didn't go because of the price tag but sure glad We did.  We got the Yellow route with Glacier landing.  The Best $855 I ever spent with my wife.  Do the landing tours your pictures will be worth it.  We did not plan ahead because weather can be so variable but we had a mostly clear day and called and they had space for 4.
Flight around Mt. Denali and walking over one of the icebergs there was one of the things I will remember forever!

Very good pilot, great photo ops, unbelievable scenery among the peaks and glaciers. The plane is the best sort of plane for that trip. I have been in a good many planes in Alaska, including Beavers, Cessnas, and a Grunman Goose (from Juneau to Skagway years ago), and this plane and this pilot are the best so far. I managed to get some pretty amazing photos, and that is part camera quality, part lens quality, and part pilot/plane quality. I dare say a professional photographer in that plane with  that pilot in the best seat would be well rewarded.

Very much enjoyed this activity.  The pilot (Patrick) was very friendly and informative about the area we were flightseeing (Denali National Park) and answered all our questions.  He flew in a pattern that ensured that people on both sides of the aircraft got a good view of the mountains and glaciers - stunning scenery.  Our activity originally included a landing and hike section which was not possible on the day due to weather conditions and safety conditions for landing. We were offered an alternative date (which we could not take up because of our itinerary) so were immediately given a substantial discount without question and enjoyed a very scenic and informative flight.  Would definitely use this company again.
This trip was great. But for the cost, I believe we should have more than just 10minutes on the glacier.
We have tried to take this flight twice before but got cancelled out by weather.  Chris, our pilot was great and the flight and glacier landing was outstanding!  We would recommend it to anyone.

Booked a flight with glacier landing in June.   Mountain was socked in, but pilot was able to find a hole and get us some great views of the Big Three.  He circled back and worked in close under the clouds, but did not feel safe attempting the glacial landing.  Office staff was very up-front about the situation and credited the difference back out.  Stayed with Denali Fireside and got a nice discount on the flight.  Everyone should experience Denali from the sky...K2 was a great pick.

Due to incoming weather, our tour was shortened, but we had a great flight and were able to land on Ruth Glacier. We had a smooth ride with Randy as our pilot and could not have been happier with the entire experience at K2.
Best excursion we took. Saw Denali summit, base camp and landed on Ruth glacier. If we hadn't taken this ride we never would have seen Denali since it was cloudy. Save your money and do this one.

Fantastic flight.  Great pilot.  Would do it again.  Standing on the glacier was like being in a cathedral.
Seeing Denali close up and without cloud cover was beautiful beyond words.  The length and cost of the flight was well worth the time and money.

K2 was a very good company to work with.  Our first scheduled flight was covered in clouds and rain so they easily let us reschedule to another day where the skies were clearer.  The pilot was very experienced and we felt very comfortable with our tour.  It was a wonderful experience and shouldn't be missed.  My only wish is that they would have made it known that there was a steep climb to get back into the plane if you do a glacier landing.  I have MS and letting people know about the level of activity required would have allowed me to plan better for re-entering the plane.  I don't like to advertise my disability so just a general statement on their glacier landing about being able to climb a short, steep ladder would have been helpful notice.
the flight was perfect !! Our pilot Chip was very informative and personable.This is the air service to use to see Denali!! Two thumbs up !!
I would recommend this excursion to anyone! It was the highlight of our trip! I would do it again in a heartbeat! Well worth the money!

review_title: Awesome isn't big enough to describe it!
review_text:
We booked the Grand Denali tour, but due to weather we could only do the Denali Flyer due to weather.  (We were charged appropriately.)  As a private pilot myself, I fully appreciated why the change was made.  The ticketing staff was open, informative and prompt.  We did get an email after we made our reservation that said another confirmation would be coming...which never arrived.  I called them a few days beforehand to confirm and everything was fine.

You get goretex over boots before your flight.  Excellent equipment.  Our aircraft was a DeHavilland Otter equipped with wheels and skis.  Turbine driven, seats 10 plus the pilot.  One passenger gets to sit in the right hand seat up front.  Everyone has a window with a good view, easy access and lots of leg room.  Head sets provided were excellent quality and connected to the intercom so we could hear the radio traffic and could converse with the pilot.

There are simply no words that fully capture and convey the size of not only Denali, but the entire Alaskan Range.  There is a reason over 700 photos have been posted to the K2 Aviation Trip Advisor page.

The pilot was 100% professional (Thanks Chris!) and gave a great description of each of the landmarks and maneuvered to move us away from turbulence smoothly and quickly.  The glacier landing was the highlight of our trip.  While on the ice we got to witness an avalanche that occurred way up the mountain.  (Which I uploaded a picture with an arrow pointing it out.)  

Their site says to bring sunglasses, jacket and a camera.  I'd suggest a second camera and spare batteries because you will be taking pictures non stop.

Once again, there is no way to fully capture the size and scale of Alaska in words.  You can only experience it, and K2 delivers big time.

(I bought one of their ball caps made from oilskin.  Heavy Duty and excellent quality also!)

review_title: Excellent plane ride through Denali national park
review_text: Fantastic plane soaring through Denali national park.  The pilot altered his flight path to accommodate my request to see the hikers base camp.  By far the top experience of my trip to Alaska!
We flew in a comfortable plane over the Denali range. Unbelievable how they look from the sky. A view like nothing else. The pilot did an an awesome job. We'll worth the money.

My family and I toured with K2 on a day that didn't have great weather. We were supposed to have a flightseeing tour and glacier landing at 1 pm, but because the weather was poor, the company worked with us to make sure we could still try to get up in the air later that day. The company, to my surprise, was adamant that we would not just eat the money if we could not do the flightseeing due to bad weather; instead, we would be reimbursed. But fortunately we were able to reschedule for 5 pm that day, and the weather had cleared somewhat by then. We couldn't do the glacier landing part, only the flightseeing part, but the company again stated that we would be reimbursed the difference. We were extremely grateful for this policy of theirs.

The tour itself was fabulous and truly the best experience of ours in Alaska. It was about an hour and a half, with us getting excellent views of Denali and especially Foraker. We were wowed by the experience. The entire reason my mother wanted to come to Alaska was to see the mountains, and boy did we see them. I cannot imagine coming to Alaska without seeing the mountains from the sky. 

Our pilot, Chris, was sure to explain to us which mountains were which, and did a great job at giving us information about what we were seeing while also giving us time to absorb the sublimity of it all. We certainly felt we were in capable hands up in the skies.

I am not one to write reviews, but this adventure prompted me to write my first one. This flighseeing tour was the highlight of our 3 day land / 7 day cruise tour of Alaska 2 weeks ago.  Our tour guide (Sam) was extremely knowledgeable  about this area and provided an excellent narration of the area that we saw.  We also bought the video (extra) of our flight seeing tour and glad we did - very good resolution and captured the highlights of the tour, including glaciers and the mountains.
K2 was recommended to us by another experienced Alaskan bush pilot. The company couldn't have done a better job, and the pilot we had was someone you could trust. Friendly too!

review_title: Thank you for the chance of a lifetime
review_text: The day before our flight we had toured Denali National Park but couldn't grasp the immensity of that beautiful place on the ground alone.  Seeing the mountains by air with our skilled and knowledgeable pilot helped us begin to understand its wonder. Thanks, K2!

The mountain was excellent, got a good feel as we flew close to the mountains wall.  Landing and throwing a snow ball was great

If you question the cost
I wished we could have stayed a little more on the mountain

You get a minute to take pictures of who your with by the plane

But you dont get enough time to actually  stand there and do a real 360 and actually look at the mountain close

K2 is a business 
The more people they fly, the more they make

If your wanting to see Denali
Spend your money on a flight and land on the mountian 
Dont waste money on bus

My group of 3 were signed up for the "fly over only" option that morning. K2 offered to let us go on the "fly over + glacial landing" tour at no extra cost. We opted to stay with the fly over only because of time constraints. They were great! Tour guide was safe, informative, and a very likable person. Mountains, snow and glaciers were amazing and the aerial perspective made it so much better. Would highly recommend. All staff were professional, courteous, and pleasant.
Highly recommend this activity. The views were spectacular and the landing was just awesome. Pilot narration was excellent as well.
Weather was perfect and the pilot was incredible. Definitely the flight of a lifetime for me and the highlight of my trip to Alaska. I would definitely fly with K2 again.
This was definitely the best excursion of our trip. The view was amazing and the staff was super friendly. A definite "must do" for anyone visiting Alaska.
Awesome! This flight was the highlight of our entire 2 week trip with our three teenagers.  It was a very smooth trip, only the slightest bit of wind between the two mountain ranges
Flew with Randy, who has flown for 41 years in Alaska. Landed at Pika Glacier. Smooth informative scenic flight through mountain passes. Moving experience.

review_title: Great Flight  These are the guys to use.
review_text: Barry couldn't have done a better job of flying us to every possible site they weather provided.  The glacier landing was spectacular, and we had a perfect weather window to see the mountains.

Great tour... Only recommendation would be to make sure the kids headsets are turned on. My son, age 11, didn't know how to use his and was too shy to mention it until the end... Other than that K2 did great! Tasha

review_title: Denali Air Tour with K2 Aviation
review_text: A great experience.  K2 aviation is first rate.  Flew out of Talkeetna with a remarkable view of the mountains.  The glacier landing is an experience not to forget!  The pilot was very informative and extremely professional.

Seeing Denali from a small Piper Cherokee is breathe taking and awe inspiring. We did this tour with K2 as an excursion through Princess, but whatever the circumstances that land you in Talkeena, this is a can't miss experience. We tend to use the once-in-a-life time experience a little willy-nilly, but this is the genuine thing. They say only 30% of visitors get to see Denali at all, so there is no telling what the weather will do when you get here, but unquestionably the odds go up when you fly with Kevin. He maneuvers through the clouds to get the best views available.  Ask as many questions as you can, he's super knowledgable and happy to share. Take advantage of this opportunity and fly K2, you won't be sorry.

review_title: A glimpse of the mountains and rivers of ice
review_text:
The tour was excellent and we had a great chance to see the mountains in their true glory.  And for the first time I could really understand how the glaciers are really a rivers of ice, you could really imagine them flowing from one place to the other.
Even though we were going to take the Grand Tour and try and land on the glacier, this was not feasible due to weather conditions, but the K2 people offered options which made the trip totally worth while.  Thanks it was great.

Thankfully, we had an absolutely beautiful day to fly over Denali! But just as perfect was the service we received from K2 Aviation. It was really seamless. We had a very nice airplane and very knowledgeable and friendly pilot who kept up a running narrative. Headphones and microphones were great. Easy to find in Talkeetna. We drove from Wasilla to Talkeetna for our morning flight, then went on to Denali for a few days. So glad we made our plans with K2!

Ok, so the mountain was clouded over.....otherwise, this was great!   Great views, wonderful pilot-with fascinating stories of his grandfather and his aviation and hiking experiences.  Saw bear and moose , glaciers and mountainsides.   And it was mostly a smooth ride!

We had a beautiful day for seeing the mountains & our pilot was so helpful in pointing out the highlights & answering our questions. We were able to take many pictures, as we each had our own window. What a great way to begin our trip!

Experiencing the vastness & the awesome Denali & the Alaska Range was one of the most incredible experiences ever! Our pilot, Samuel, was so professional & intelligent, & an excellent pilot! Enjoyed his stories of history, geology & answered our many questions with great patience. The flight was 1.5 hrs. & not long enough. My friends from United Kingdom, Montana & I recommend K2 Aviation wholeheartedly! It was an early 70th Birthday present for me! Want to go back & do the longer flight next time.

We were in luck- the weather was near perfect as we left the K2 airport in Talkeetna for a flight over Denali. 
We were 2 adults with our 2 grandkids, ages 8 and 10. 
Mark, the pilot explained everything that we were flying over and answered all our questions. 
The flight was smooth and exciting. 
Seeing Denali so close was breathtaking, to say the least. 
Don't miss the wonderful experience. You'll never forget it!!

review_title: Wonderful, beautiful, very well worth it!
review_text: We were rained out on our scheduled trip. Your team worked exceptionally, getting us in the next morning before our train. Daniel was the perfect pilot, very informative & great pilot. We didn't get to land on the glacier, but our trip was still worth going up. Thank you team & we'll tell everyone we know that your tour is a must see!

An exceptionally safe and exhillarating tour with information about what glaciers, mountains and landscapes we were observing.Chris is a knowledgeable and friendly pilot. Carey and other front line staff provided ample information to make informed decisions. Thank you.

review_title: My Favorite Part of our Alaskan Vacation
review_text: The days leading up to our flightseeing tour, the weather was uncooperative, and Denali was pretty much invisible. But on the morning of, the clouds parted and the entire Alaska Range came into view. The plane ride was nothing short of spectacular! Our pilot, Samuel was very good and knowledgeable. Once we got out to the mountains.... WOW! What amazing vistas we had. The deep gorges, shear granite walls, giant Ruth Glacier, and the surrounding snow covered peaks were breath taking. I felt as though I had died and gone to Heaven! This ride was anything but cheap, but worth every penny. I would do it again in a heartbeat.
The staff was friendly and informative.  It was an awesome experience.  I would recommend booking this trip.
This was an awesome trip! Wanting to do this for a long time. Michael did a great job! I would recommend this trip to anyone!

If you're on the fence about a flightseeing experience, you must take the plunge. This was, by far, the best part of our trip to Alaska. The glacier landing was the highlight of our tour. I thought I'd be scared on the small plane, but it wasn't scary at all. We had a smooth ride and the views were just surreal. Having the opportunity to see Denali up close was such a privilege. This is a must do! K2 Aviation is awesome!

We really enjoyed the beautiful scenic flight. Of course, having a sunny day helped. Our pilot Dan was very informative, he pointed out landmarks, glaciers and even moose!! I had a great time and highly recommend it!!

The day was perfect from the moment we checked in everyone was organized, ready to go, and on time. The staff were all professional and kind and the pilot was great. I could not say any more about our experience except it was AWESOME!! Thank you all for making our vacation one to remember!

Amazing experience. Professional & courteous staff. Pilot was excellent. If you like to make lasting memories land on a glacier & make a snow angel........This is the company to go with. I will certainly be back.....

review_title: K2 takes you to the top of the world!
review_text: Words cannot describe what we saw on the Denali flight with glacier landing. Years ago, I visited the Grand Canyon and thought nothing could top it. Well I was wrong. K2's flight to Denali is the most incredible landscape I have ever seen in my life. The vast size and majesty of Denali and the surrounding glaciers and mountains, cannot be described in words or photos. It is expensive, but you will understand why it is worth it when you land on the glacier. We flew in a magnificent, vintage 1957 de Havilland Beaver ski plane that looked like it has been built just yesterday.  Our pilot Daniel was a skilled professional and a top-notch knowledgeable tour guide. I'd spend the money to do this again. It was the absolute highlight of our trip to Alaska. Do it!

review_title: Beautiful flight seeing around Mt. Denali
review_text: I had read many other reviews and also telephoned the place to make sure that there would be a choice of a lesser expensive trip or refund if the weather were bad on our day, and it was all true, but fortunately we were blessed with a perfect sunny day!  The flight was glorious and our pilot made sure that both sides of the plane'as passengers had great views of all the hilights and pointed out different interesting places, mountain climbers, and moose!  The landing on the glacier with a great view of Mt. Denali  was also really a great experience!  I highly recommend K2 and the Grand Tour flight!

review_title: Amazing Trip to an Amazing Place
review_text: Our trip to Denali and landing on the Ruth Glacier was incredible.  Of course it helped that we had perfect weather (sunshine and no wind).  Our pilot Chip was great.  Well worth a visit.

A very fun experience!  We had a very good weather day and our pilot commented on what we were seeing which was very clear.  Might be scary on a very windy day.  We had a bathroom emergency and the pilot landed in Willow so the gentleman could take care of his problem.  Very good service!!
I enjoyed the flight. It was a beautiful blue sky morning and we were able to see Denali up close. I took lots of pictures and will remember this flight as the highlight of my trip to Alaska.

This was overall an excellent extremely well narrated trip. The pilot personally answered every question we had even providing a tremendous amount of details of the mountains, their structure and even their history. The trip had remarkable views. All in all a great pleasure.
Did the Glacier Landing and had high expectations. And they were met I highly recommend this flight was smooth landing like a helicopter just floated in. Have nothing negative.

review_title: Must Do!  The best part of our 14-day trip!
review_text: Our trip was filled with highlights including a 7-day cruise of the inland passage. Consensus is that our K-2 flight to Denali out of Talkeetna with a glacier landing was the boldest and best thing we experienced.  It was not scary at all.  No motion sickness among us who often have it.  K-2 provides over boots so you don't have to worry about getting your feet wet.  We were blessed with super clear weather.   I wore my newly acquired K-2 tee shirt on the glacier and needed no sweater in the land of the midnight sun.  Bring sun glasses as the snow and sun are blinding without.  The flight and landing were super smooth and exhilarating.   Do not come to Alaska and not do this.  All the K-2 staff are great.  Worth every penny.   These memories will last a lifetime!

What a great experience - and our pilot, Daniel, was so knowledgeable and made our trip very special!  He is an expert pilot! He gave us wonderful views of all the mountains for all who were aboard as well as great views of Denali!

What an exciting adventure a highlight of our trip.  Chip our pilot was great he narrated as we went.  The mountains are breathtaking.   We landed on a glacier at the base of Mt Denali. Very smooth comfortable flight. Don't miss this.
Im a local, but had never taken this trip before. It was absolutely breathtaking. Nothing like Alaska from the air. I recommend it to everyone, locals and visitors!

Took a shorter trip around Denali  in 2011 with K2 Aviation and was very impressed   This trip in 2016 was the grand tour aroud the mountain with glacier landing but the trip was not as good as the previous trip.  The pilot was not friendly and seemed to be in a bad mood,  The trip duration was a shorter duration than we were told it would be.  We left about 15 minutes late and came back 15 early, thus our trip was cut short for the trip we paid for.There was no explaination given. It was not due to bad  weather because it was a clear sunny day.  Just too many flights going out packed too close together to bring in maximum money.  The quality of the trip has decreased.  Disappointed

I have lived in Alaska for 3 years, hunted all over this state and this was hands down the best thing I have done since arriving here. This as an absolute amazing experience and our pilot was personable and down to earth, which just made the experience even better. If you are traveling through the area, or within a 3 hour drive, you must schedule a flight with a glacier landing. Thank you K2 for an absolutely beautiful experience.

The piolet was a very outgoing friendly man in a Hawaiian shirt!  He was a great piolet and super knowledge about the area, the topography and geology.  He answered all our groups questions with a clear, concise answers.  He was also personable and fun.  As a local he gave us a lot of information about the area as we flew.  This really was a great time.  

My husband was able to ride co-piolet and had an amazing one of a kind experience.  

The reason we did not give this a 5 is because we called ahead to see if the green route was flying.  They said yes and booked us but by the time we got there 3 hours later they were not flying this route and hadnt been all day.  While I understand it was because of weather I wished they had been a bit more upfront so I was able to make a fully informed decision.

Although expensive the experience is worth it.  If you go with K2 or another company it was amazing to see the park and mountains from the vantage point.  

Tips:
*Co-Piolet seat is AWESOME
*Ask a lot of questions 
*Be flexible as the weather determines flying. They may go up when you think they will not and vice versa.
Our pilot Barry was fantastic. Views were unbelievable. Don't miss out on this adventure of a lifetime.

I was a little nervous about this-especially since I am 62 and my husband is 73-
but I went ahead with it since it was something my husband was very excited to experience.
From the second the door closed, it was one of the best times of our lives.
To explain the colors or beauty to someone is almost impossible. Describing the peacefulness of being on a glacier that close to Denali is in explainable.  This is something that you have to experience for yourself.
The people at K2 were so helpful and kind-as well as everyone participating that day. Everyone is so excited to be there and I am so glad we went. It was pricey, not gonna lie, but it was an absolutely priceless experience. Do not pass this up.

I do not usually splurge on an expensive excursion, but a friend had advised that it was totally worth it. I asked around during my vacation and heard the same thing. I was nervous because I sometimes get motion sickness. My advise to anyone it to GO! It was no different flight/stomach wise than a regular plane so please do not let that stop you. The entire experience was exhilarating. The landing and the views were absolutely incredible and I'd do it again in a heartbeat! I had Barry who reassured us he would bring us back safely and he did. I wish we could have spent more time just basking in the beauty, but that's what the next time is for :)
The folks at K2 really care about showing you how profound Denali is! It was an amazing trip my husband and I will never forget!

The K2 folks were awesome and very accommodating. The Pilot was great, the sights were fantastic, the landing on the Glacier was cool as was the takeoff. We will definitely use K2 again when we revisit Denali/Talkeetna

review_title: Grand Tour with a Ruth Glacier Landing
review_text: Highly recommended to put on your bucket list. Our pilot was Patrick, and we flew in the turbine Otter. Words alone cannot express our experience. The weather Gods made it a picture perfect day - glorious sunshine and Denali was sparkling in it's light in glory. Thanks to the staff at K2 Aviation for making our experience one in which will never be forgotten. We'll definitely share our experience with others, so they can book a tour with you. High FIVES!!!  Job well done.
We got to see Denali on one of it's clearest days ever!  The tour was unforgettable, and Patrick, our pilot, was awesome!!

Great day on k-2. Full view of mountain, young energetic pilot. Did a great job of informing us, taking r pictures and being a gentleman. Such a great experience seen the mountain in full, beautiful day

We only had two precious days to spend in Talkeetna and when we left Anchorage to drive up it was totally cloudy and raining. It proceeded to rain for the next 30 hours so we were worried about seeing Denali. We called to inquire about a Flightseeing trip with k2 and they helped us book for a 6:30 flight with a backup the next day. I got the impression right away that they really wanted us to have the best experience possible - it was so different than a helicopter ride in Hawaii where when you book, you're completely locked in no matter the weather or what happens. Here, I got a sense there was flexibility to accommodate the client (go figure, huh?!). We stopped in around 2 to check on things - it was still looking cloudy but they said things were improving and to check back around 6 (for our 6:30 flight). We showed up close to 6 and agonized about what to do - there are no guarantees and things can change so rapidly. The staff were so helpful and were talking to pilots currently at the mountain. Again, at the last minute, we had the option to reschedule (without penalty) for the next day!  We decided to go for it, knowing we'd probably not see Denali but would see the area and the park. 

Our pilot was Michael - he's quiet with a great sense of humor and wit!  He really worked FOR us and was very knowledgable about the area!  He was literally turning from Denali because of the clouds when he saw a last minute opening, turned around back towards Denali, and found every opening he could to see the mountain. It was really everything and more we had hoped for!  He even spied a moose (one for each side of the plane) on the return back to Talkeetna. 

I would highly recommend - it was the highlight of our trip!

Your trip to Talkeetna is not complete without flying with K2 to Denali! We flew to and walked on a glacier. Amazing, everyone was professional and knowledgeable. Our guide answered every question and helped to make everyone comfortable. You must do this!!!

This is an experience of a lifetime.  We would fly anywhere with this company.  They are a 1st class outfit with beautifully restored aircraft. Our pilot was seasoned and made you  feel safe at all times.  You wear a head set with mike to hear and ask questions with the pilot.  We did the tour with the glacier landing.  It was the highlight of our trip.

review_title: Best thing to do in Alaska
review_text: Wow, this was the best. Do not miss this expierence. We had a beautiful sunny clear day and able to see the tip of Mt McKinley. The pilot took great pains to make it perfect for us and explained everything.

What can i say. ......unbelievable the plane ride was great they provided headphones and kept you informed.  The landing on the glacier was so cool. The views of the mountain could not get any better than this.

We strongly recommend this as one of three must do routes (sky, water and land) for Alaska tourists.   Swing by Aurora Dana to get Aurora info and a coupon for this flight.  
The sky view is gorgeous and magnificent.   Glacial landing is another new life experience.   To see is to believe, you need to do it yourself to fully understand how wonderful this trip is.

review_title: Surprise - Denali was covered in clouds!
review_text: I think these people try hard, but Denali is often under cloud cover as she was the day we visited.  It was unfortunate but our guide offered us a two hour ride looking at some other glaciers, lakes, etc., in another direction for a lesser place.  We had a good time and saw a lot of beautiful country and even some wildlife from the plane!  I was very disappointed we couldn't do the original tour to see Denali and have a glacier landing, but then man cannot control the weather!  Thanks!

GREAT experience.  Worth the price, as this is likely a once in a lifetime luxury.  The trip to the glacier provided amazing scenery that alone would have been worth the ride.  Then, the glacier itself--- magnificent.  Our pilot was knowledgeable and gracious, making this a fun and memorable experience.

review_title: Wonderful way to view Mount Denali
review_text: We booked the flight with glacier landing.  The views were incredible, the pilot was very knowledgeable.  The staff was friendly.

I took the 90-minute excursion with my sister and wife, and we had an amazing time. The planes K2 flies are mostly 11-person aircraft (including the pilot and a seat up front for a passenger), and though I was worried about a bumpy flight, it was anything but. Prior to departure, everyone has the opportunity to put what I would call a boot over their shoes so their feet did not get wet while on the glacier. Our flight took us to Ruth Glacier via a number of turns that brought us within 11 miles of Mt. McKinley (now called Denali) and several other high peaks before landing on Ruth Glacier. After about 15 minutes on the glacier, it was back to Talkeetna. On both legs, our pilot kept us informed via headphones (which are provided on the aircraft) of the altitude and geology of the region. 

TIP: Try to get a seat near the front or the back of the plane. Those sitting in the middle may find that the arm securing the wing to the fuselage will partially obstruct some views. That said, even if sitting in the middle (as I did) will not detract much from what is an amazing sightseeing opportunity.
Magnificent. Breath taking. Pilot was knowledgeable about the area and his experience as a pilot was evident throughout the flight as he explained weather conditions.

review_title: Highlight of the trip - A MUST DO!
review_text:
We took the flight seeing tour on June 9th.  They had to give us the lesser tour because of the weather, but the glacier landing was still a go.

Mike was our pilot- very informative, friendly.

It was the most amazing part of our trip to Alaska.  Words just do not describe the beauty of Denali by air.

The Pika Glacier landing was ultra cool.

We took the around Denali flight over an hour on a beautiful day. Perfect weather ,great pilot "Nick". When we got there there were some questions as to if we should take this more expensive option.  Take it if it is a clear day . Nine passenger piper chieftain and no one said a word we were so enthralled by the view. The turns into the passes between the peaks and glacier below said it all.

On June 15, 2016, my wife and I were driving back home to Fairbanks from Anchorage on a beautiful sunny summer day and Mt. Denali was just standing out against the blue sky. We decided to drive into Talkeetna to see if we could get on a flight seeing trip and land on the Ruth Glacier. We lucked out and were able to book a ride. We only had to wait around for about 1.5 hours. The experience flying up to the glacier is breath taking. It was really neat to land on the Ruth Glacier in the Sheldon Amphitheater. The whole trip with the time spent on the glacier was about 1.75 hours. You get relatively close to the mountain and the landing spot is at 5400 ft altitude. 

If you are in this area and the sky is clear and they are flying up to Denali, this trip is highly recommended. Do not pass it up. I am 69 years old, I was born and raised in Fairbanks, AK and after decades of flying by Mt. Denali on my way to or from Anchorage, I finally made the decision to experience this wonderful trip.

review_title: A once in a lifetime opportunity! DO IT!! :)
review_text: This was by far one of the coolest things I have ever done!! Pictures and words cannot adequately express how beautiful the view is from in the air, Mt. Denali is breathtaking! The glacier landing it icing on the cake-absolutely priceless.The people at K2 are so friendly and nice! The pilots and staff here are top-notch and very knowledgeable about the landscape they fly over. It is well worth it!! Thanks K2 for an experience of a lifetime!

You can best appreciate the majesty and grandeur of Mt. Denali and surroundings when viewing it from the air in a K2 Aviation plane! We recently took the Summit Tour and found our pilot Nick to be not only a very skilled pilot but also very knowledgeable about the terrain we flew over. It was a trip we will always remember, and was, quite literally, the high point of our entire Alaska trip. The staff was very professional, also, re-booking us to a day with perfect weather and offering a full refund if that weather had failed also. Worth absolutely every penny!!

Not sure how to describe an experience of a life time. Literally speechless! We had a sunny day, saw Denali up close and then landed on Ruth Glacier. Totally worth the price - don't hesitate if you have the opportunity. K2 team was great, professional and made the trip fun.

Had a flight seeing tour with K2. We couldn't do the glacier landing due to weather conditions but nevermind, we still very much enjoyed that our. We saw dramatic landscape, glaciers, waterfalls, campers/hikers on a glacier. We saw Denali but not quite the summit because the clouds were sittings top if it. The landscape was just mesmerizing. A shout out to our pilot Brian. Nice, friendly, informative. Altogether very rewarding experience.

I traveled to Alaska for my 50th birthday and my experience with K2 sits on the top of my list and we did ALOT. We flew around Denali Mtn. on the 2 hour glacier landing trip. I loved it so much i did two different flight tracks in the same day !!!  The 1st trip we were lucky enough to have a picture perfect clear day to go around the mountain. The 2nd trip had some cloud cover but it was still amazing and just as satisfying. Stan and Chip were my pilots, both great guys and extremely knowledgeable with the history of the area. You could ask them any questions glacier, Denali Mtn, you name it they had the answers. I would say this is a MUST do on everyones bucket list, worth every penny. And spending a couple of days in Talkeetna what could be better. Such a quant town with great food, the Roadhouse for breakfast is a must. Oh yes, the staff in the office very friendly and helpful guiding you on the trip thats right for you. Next time i want to do a drop off hiking trip !!!
The glacier landing tour is a trip of a life time. Our son got to fly in the co-pilots seat and had a ball! Awesome!

review_title: Fabulous alternative offered due bad flying conditions at Mt Denali
review_text: Due bad weather at Mt Denali, we were offered a flight to the Knik Glacier (or a refund) Approximately 30 flying minutes south east of Talkeetna we flew around this huge glacier. Captain Chris gave a great commentary. The scenery was awesome. While we really wanted to see Mt Denali we were not at all disapointed.

Was schedule to take the tour to Denali, unfortunately Mother Nature wanted me to see Knik Glacier instead!!  And that was OK with me!  The flight was smooth & the pilot was very confident in the ride.  The views were amazing, but try not to sit over the wing or all your pics will have the propeller in them..haha....but it's good!  This was definitely a high light of my trip!!

I had originally scheduled to take the Denali Grand Tour, but sadly the weather did not cooperate. Thankfully, K2 was able to reschedule me for a different tour to see several of the glaciers that were further south towards Wasilla and Anchorage. It was really beautiful!

this was one of a kind adventure, we have an incredible time, you are going to see Denali in a very special way, and when you land in the glacier, is something that you are going to remember forever, also when you are there, some other airplanes land in the same area, that was very cool

review_title: K2 glacier landing at sled-dog camp
review_text: Excellent trip - beautiful flight from Talkeetna and over an hour with 40+ Alaskan sled-dogs!   Once-in-a-lifetime thrill of mushing & loving on these great animals.  Justin & his dogs are simply terrific.
Flew around and landed below Denali.  It was an amazing adventure.  The people that work at K2 are great!  Worth every dime.  We even had a BBQ lunch on our return.

Made a reservation to tour Mt. McKinley but the weather wasn't good enough.  K2 offered to reschedule, do a different trip or give us a full refund.  Can't ask for more than that.  We chose an alternate trip to the Knik glacier and it was a lot of fun.  Landing on the glacier near McKinley would have been better but I have no regrets.  K2 is a totally professional organization, and I heartily recommend them.

If you are going to do one thing on your trip to Alaska, this would be it. Stephanie in the front office really took care of us and Patrick, our pilot, was perfect...made us feel comfortable and safe. K2 is a top tier, world-class tour company.

Em grupo de nove pessoas fizrmos um voo espetacular no rosso K2. Emocionante e inesquecivel. Recomendo a todos. Vale a pena. O voo faz pouso na neve e se pode baixar e caminhar, fazer fotos, correr, rir, voltar a ser criança jogando neve uns nos outros. Fantasticos momentos. Não deixe de voar.... É um passeio imperdivel...
We took the basic tour with the glacier landing. We debated about adding the glacier landing because of added expense but were so glad you did. This was the highlight of our trip to Denali!

A trip of a life time! Absolutely amazing, wonderful, beautiful and stunning.  I think I made my point....lol
Everything was wonderful, great pilot, very knowledgeable of the mountain range. A little pricey but where else are you going to be able to do this again?

review_title: You'll Never Stop Talking About this Trip
review_text: Flew around Mt. McKinley in a de Havilland Otter.  Then landed on a glacier.  Really.  What else can you say.  First class pilot, great plane.  Breathtaking ( over used but highly appropriate word ).  Do It!  No Buyer's remorse on this trip!

Not a typical I loved it review. But I was very impressed with K2 and the way they run their business. We were booked for a glacier landing tour today but unfortunately the weather was not ideal. They gave us the option of changing to a different flying location, postponing to another day or getting a full refund. We were very bummed about the weather and not being able to fly but it was so nice knowing they weren't going to take us up in unsafe conditions.... And they they would refund our money no questions asked. What a great way to keep people happy and safe. We will definitely be returning to K2 for a later flight and will recommend them to our family and friends.

review_title: Friendly, Fun, Fantastical Foray into the Alaska Range
review_text: Taking any of the flights offered by K2 Aviation will be a lifetime experience you will never forget. The pilots are not only seasoned and skilled in mountain flying, they also help transport you into a world you can't even conceive or imagine until you are completely finished with your flight.  Your eyes will not only feast on the spectacular ruggedness of the landscape but you will learn the history and landmarks of the area.  I took two flights with K2 while visiting Talkeetna.  My first flight was a scenic tour which included an expansive view of the eastern lowlands of Denali National Park area as well as up-close views in and around the Alaska Range.  My second flight included a landing on Ruth Glacier and gave me intimate views of Kahiltna base camp and other geological features directly under Denali.  Both of these flights were unique, informative and gave me different but complimentary perspectives on the area.  K2 is a class organization and I whole heartedly recommend them for anyone seeking to maximize their Denali adventure.

review_title: Wow, what a great landing on Ruth Glacier
review_text: This company is first class in every way. We loved or flight with Barry on the Otter, and landing at the top of the glacier was a unique experience. We had an extraordinary day with blue sky and smooth air. Checkin was quick and everything moved along on time. We even met a great young sales girl who found the t-shirts we wanted in the back room. I highly recommend this experience.

These guys are top notch!!!
I would fly again with them anytime, very helpful, very knowledgeable of the area and their awesome planes!!!
Thanks guys...see ya next year!!!
We loved this trip.  Safe, fun and the glacier landing was awesome.  You are really going to want this experience.

Pre-booked on our Princess Cruisetour, we went for the Denali summit flightseeing tour with K2 Aviation, located at the airport in Talkeetna. A shuttle bus goes from the Princess Lodge to Talkeetna on the hour, and from Talkeetna to the lodge on the ½ hour. We took the shuttle to K2, where we checked in and then were weighed (for weight distribution in the plane), with all clothes, camera, etc. you were taking with you. The plane was a Piper Navajo Chieftain with an unpressurized cabin. Our group had 8 passengers. The pilot gave us an extensive safety talk, including testing the oxygen masks we’d be using over 12,000 ft., and what to do in case we get stranded—an unlikely but real possibility up the mountain. 
		
We took off from Talkeetna, across the flats, between there & the mountain. As we neared the mountain, the view got more and more awesome by the minute. We also had on a headset and microphone so that we could talk and hear the driver and each other (very noisy propeller engines), and a snug seatbelt. The plane is equipped with big nice windows for viewing and picture taking. Everyone has a great view. While circling the mountain, the pilot said that we were within ½ mile of the rock faces and summit. It felt like you could reach your hand out and touch it. It was breathtaking, fantastic, and beyond words to describe. We were able to see several very long glaciers, the summit of the mountain, and the surrounding mountains. From the distance, you have no idea how much detail—valleys, crags, rock, etc. nor how immense and vast the mountain is. There is an unimaginable amount of ice, snow and rock up there. We were able to see where the base camps are for the mountain climbers. I took dozens of pictures trying to take it all in. 

K2 also has flights that land on a glacier, but do not go to the summit. The passengers are outfitted with appropriate gear. Those planes fly at a much lower altitude.

I had some trouble with the altitude, but the others in the group did fine. The pilot and other people at K2 very diligently made sure I was OK before letting us leave for the shuttle back to the hotel. If you have heart or respiratory issues, you may want to check with your doc before doing this tour, just in case. All in all this was an amazing experience, and I would do it again if I had the chance.

Awesome flight. Anyone coming to Denali owes it to themselves to to a glacier landing with K2. Our pilot Chip was great and he went above and beyond to make our flight great. He was very knowledgable about all aspects of the flight, history, geology of the area and our landing at Denali base camp was the highlight of the flight.

At first I did not want to go flying but I am so glad I did. The pilot was very skilled and I trusted his flying . We took so many amazing pictures of the mountains . It was an hour ride thst went by so fast . I recommend this to everyone .

I was scheduled to fly around Mt. Denali and land on the Ruth Glacier on May 18th.  Due to bad weather conditions, the flight I was scheduled for was canceled.  I elected not to go on a different flight, and the staff was most gracious about refunding my money.  

When getting into the van for a ride back to the bus stop, I experienced some difficulty.  This was my own fault, and not due to any other reason than my own clumsiness.  The staff immediately came to my aid, and did everything they could to help me out of this very awkward situation.  

The people of this company deserve some recognition for helping out this man with disabilities.

review_title: Flight seeing trip of Talkeetna Mountains
review_text: K2 Aviation offers the ultimate flight seeing experience of Denali and surrounding area.  I arrived with minutes to spare and with one seat to spare I was ushered on to one of K2's Otters. We followed the Talkeetna River north into the Talkeetna Mountains where spectacular views of glaciers awaited us. The Talkeetna Mountains are a mountain range in Alaska. The Matanuska and Susitna River valleys, with towns such as Trapper Creek, Talkeetna, Wasilla, Palmer, Sutton, and Chickaloon, roughly bound the Talkeetnas in the westerly parts of the range.  I accompanied a group of schoolgirls from Lafayette, Louisiana, who chatted constantly and kept me entertained throughout the flight.  The pilot (sorry, I forgot his name) was very friendly and approachable and answered the multitude of questions from the young women who were on their first and unforgettable visit to Alaska.  Everyone was very kind to me, and absolutely made my day.  I will next have some time off later in August and hope the weather will allow me to do the Denali flight seeing trip then
one of the most amazing things I,ve ever done. the pilot was excellent and very knowledgeable. Truly a must do while in Alaska.

Professional, friendly, down-to-earth staff. Knowledgeable, competent pilot. Even though there were clouds around, breathtaking scenery and numerous photo ops. Felt very safe and comfortable the entire time.

review_title: A MUST WHEN YOU VISIT ALASKA
review_text:
My experience with K2 Aviation was one that I will NEVER forget. It was complete perfection from start to finish. I was greeted with an exceptional group of employees that coordinate and ensure safety of all passengers on the flight. While it was my first trip to Alaska, they all treated me like we were longtime friends and offered to help me pick out places to grab coffee or a bite to eat later after the flight. 
Then there was the flight...Patrick Carter was my pilot and I would trust him with my life any day of the week in an airplane after learning his background in aviation...and I am a licensed pilot myself (sometimes we are the worst critics!) He greeted all of us with the same professional yet friendly manner as the other staff. He took us through a safety briefing and then helped us get seated AND everyone got a headset with the ability to talk back and forth with the pilot! I have participated in several "ride" flights and, in my experience, K2 makes certain to slow down the process and let you enjoy the moment vs rushing you in and out treating you more like a number. This is a feature that makes the trip far more memorable!
K2 opened my eyes to a breathtaking part of the US that I wish everyone could see first hand. With that being said, if you have a chance to get the video from your flight, do it!!! In the world of aviation, NFLIGHTCAM is one of the top notch creators of camera mounts in the US and K2 Aviation obviously only wants the best for your experience because this is the manufacturer they use for their video systems.
Speaking of videos/cameras, K2 flights are not like the airlines where you have poor viability and fly really high. Every passenger has the best seat in the house and the planes offer lots of windows for picture taking and they are actually quite roomy! Book your flight TODAY!!!

review_title: Mt Denali glacier landing made the flight extra special!
review_text: The glacier landing makes this excursion really special.  Booked flight last minute in May 2016 bc of the CLEAR skies and gorgeous weather.  The day before was partly cloudy.  Not cheap ($750 for 2 w 15%off)  - a once in a lifetime bucket list thing.  Chose K2 due to glacier landing tour availability.  Didn't want to chance clouds for a next day booking with Talkeetna Air (another good service at lower price).   Make sure to bring good sunglasses and a fully charged camera device.

The sightseeing by bush plane of Denali was the highlight of our trip to Alaska.  The glaciers,ice falls and views of Denali were beautiful.  The scenery was magnificent.  We landed on a glacier which was awesome.  Our pilot, Chris was very friendly and knowledgeable. This was an experience that is hard to top. A once in a lifetime must.

review_title: A family memory to last a lifetime!
review_text: This adventure is worth the costs because it provides a unique opportunity to really experience Alaska from the air.  My family of 4 had the flight to ourselves on a small 6 passenger plane and we felt so special to experience the flight.  We had reserved with a different flight company, but it was too cloudy all day and they refunded our deposit.  But, around 5:30 the clouds broke up and we saw K2 planes landing, so after a phone call they said they would take us on a sunset flight.  It worked out perfect because this was one of the top experiences we wanted to have while on our vacation in Alaska.  Thanks to K2 it happened!  The pilot was very friendly and answered any questions we had during the flight and about the airplane.  He made us feel very special and it did not seem just like another flight for him.  My children loved wearing the headphones and all of us were busy taking videos and photos on our devices.  I sat beside the pilot and felt honored that my family chose me to have this special seat.  I suggest getting that seat yourself if you get the chance!  After our flight, our pilot took photos of us with the plane and my kids bought souvenirs inside the office area.  My son has worn his K2 hat almost nonstop since returning to NC.  Please take this adventure-it will be a special memory that my family shared for a lifetime.  Awesome, breath-taking and spectacular!  P.S.-Don't forget to tip your pilot, too.  He deserved every $; great guy!

Title of my review doesn't even get close to describe this flight seeing adventure. We've heard about glaciers, we've seen them from a distance along the road and from a cruise ship, but actually walking on Ruth Glacier makes you appreciate and respect nature's vastness and  beauty so much more. Thank you K2 for this wonderful flight seeing tour. Our pilot Scott is a wealth of information. Geology, history and local stories, he covers it all while making our flight from/to Talkeetna comfortable and enjoyable. If you come to Alaska, flight seeing including glacier landing should be on your "must do list"

This was a trip of a lifetime! The pilot was extremely knowledgeable, the team in the office was kind and helpful, and of course the scenery was beyond spectacular. The office very generously accommodated my birthday and the trip truly exceeded our expectations. What a stunning way to see Denali! Thank you K2!

One of the many highlights of our trip to Alaska and well worth the money we spent. The weather was fabulous so the views were awesome. The pilot was very experienced and knowledgeable so we felt very safe. My only regret was that I didn't choose a flight that landed on the glacier. My fault. Absolutely awesome experience. Incredible.

We were shopping at the Mooses Tooth, and the sales clerk also helped us to choose a tour with K2. So helpful.We arrived at K2 and found all staff helpful and friendly. Our pilot, Brian, from Texas was laid back. While the weather did not allow us to all of Denali, or to land, he gave us a fantastic ride.

review_title: It was a last minute choice while in Talkeetna and I am sure glad we did it
review_text: Totally worth the money.  I love mountain climbing and this flight gave you views you don't get from down below.  I was doubtful at first because it isn't cheep but so worth the cost.  Great Pilot and very knowledgeable.  Plan on doing this again on our next trip to talkeetna.
The staff and the pilots were extremely knowledgeable very friendly and helpful. it was just an awesome experience to be landing up there on the glacier!!!

review_title: THEY TAKE YOU TO A GLACIER!!!
review_text:
I don't know what more to say to give this company a stellar review.. They take you to a glacier! Like hands down one of the coolest experiences of my life and will be talking about forever. 

As far as service, the lady at the front desk was extremely nice and got our group squared away quickly. 

Our pilot Chip, seemed very knowledgeable and calm. Gave us a lot of fun facts while flying to the glacier, and the flight was very smooth, and BEAUTIFUL.

Would definitely go back a second and third time

I took the grand tour with K2 Aviation around Mt. McKinley/Denali and landed on Ruth glacier. Our pilot/guide, Chris, was knowledgeable, professional, and had a good sense of humor.  I appreciated the information he provided as we flew over the mountains and glaciers.  It is well worth the price. If you don't live in Alaska, then why aren't you taking this tour?!!! It is a once in a lifetime adventure and I'd do it again if I ever get the chance to return to Alaska! Great job K2 Aviation!
Um voo de tirar o folego quanto a paisagem e o preço. Existem 4 rotas diferentes. A natureza é um expetaculo e o piloto super profissional.

Passeio maravilhoso. Fiz no inverno. Aviões seguros e pilotos muito bem treinados. Pousamos no meio do Glacial. Experiencia única e imperdível. Vale cada centavo do passeio. Opte pela opção de pousar no Glacial, vale muito.

Very close up view of the mountains...great pilots...something you won't soon forget! I was impressed with the knowledge that the pilot had about the mountain and the surrounding areas. The plane ride was extremely smooth, definitely not like other small plane rides I had been on.

Since I am student I thought really long about spending the money or not. Now I can say that it was totally worth it!
The staff and the pilot were very friendly and helpful. Furthermore the glacier landing is a cool extras, especially on a sunny day.

Great job!

...we got a 30% day (Denali is only fully visible 30% of the time) and had the most amazing clear and sunny skies. An unforgettable, exhilarating, breathtaking experience! From the start we felt we were in safe and calm hands with Stephanie, who greeted us, and pilot Dallas. We had a great flight with knowledgeable and timely commentary. Thanks again!

review_title: Breathtaking Flight over the Talkeetna Range
review_text: We were in Anchorage for a conference last week and at the end of it we were lucky enough to have time to take a wonderful flight-seeing trip over the Talkeetna mountain range and glaciers.  It was absolutely breathtaking scenery.  The staff at K2 were very friendly, helpful and informative.  Our pilot Ryan was first class, gave us a nice smooth flight over some of the most stunning mountain scenery I've ever seen in a very comfortable 10-seater plane with nice large windows to be able to clearly see everything around us.  I would highly recommend them for a tour - they're based in Talkeenta which is a really neat little truly Alaskan type of town - stay at the cozy Roadhouse in the heart of downtown to spend a couple of days exploring the area and enjoy their fantastic food while you're there!

Did a walk up and WOW glad we did. We paid ~$300 a piece for 2 for the flight. Seems like a lot but it was probably one of the greatest bargains I've ever come across. I was worried that the flight from the landing strip to Denali and back would eat up the time in the air but it seemed like we spent more than an hour on the mountain. Ryan, the pilot, knew all the answers to the questions we asked and was a great pilot. 

We flew on a cold February day but the plane was comfortable and warm so no worries there. 

Don't hesitate to do this as you will come back with some pretty amazing memories.

K2 really delivered.

Es una gran aventura, es la mejor forma para admirar la majestuosidad del Mckinley y del parque Denali.

El personal es muy amable y la empresa y los equipos dan tranquilidad, es un plan especial para aventureros.

review_title: Best way to see the mountain!
review_text: Denali is magnificent when seen from afar (especially during the rare occasions that it is fully visible).  However, there is nothing like getting up close and personal with the Great One on a flight-seeing trip.  K2's pilots are skilled and experienced.  The company closely monitors weather patterns around the mountain so that they don't disappoint customers by flying when clouds totally enshroud it.  But don't assume that because the mountain isn't visible from the ground that your trip will be cancelled... very often flight seeing trips can take you above the cloud cover where you can still see the best views of higher elevations.

We hike. We don't take flight tours. But our serious hiking friends strongly recommended we flight-see Denali. They recommended K2, so we gave it a try. Best part, there was no one attempting a January ascent this year so we weren't impinging on anyone's backcountry experience.
We are so glad we did this! Beautiful views of the mountain and its surrounding companions, plus a better understanding of the topography and the glaciers. The pilot was incredibly knowledgeable and extremely safety conscious. We recommend this to everyone from someone who can't walk into the mountains to the most hardcore backcountry freak.

review_title: If only the mountain had complied
review_text: Scheduled a glacier landing on a warm and sunny day but when we arrived at the landing site the pilot was leery of the local conditions. We are not faulting the experience or the pilot just bad luck. Pilot did treat us to lengthy flight around the mountain

My husband and I took the K2 Otter plane to Ruth Amphitheater on our 34th wedding anniversary. I got to sit copilot on the way there. What a thrilling experience. If you are in Alaska, this is something you have to do. 
Our pilot was professional and knowledgeable. Unbelievable view of Denali and surrounding peaks.

I returned to Denali with my wife and wanted some good and close-up pictures.  What an exceptional trip!  As a pilot, I was pleased with the safety and professionalism of the entire company while still finding the flying fun and exciting.  This is a must do excursion if you are visiting Alaska.

We flew with K2 in 2013 and enjoyed the lower glacial flight but had hoped to be able to fly around the summit of Denali.  On our return trip July 2015, the weather finally cooperated and we were able to check one more thing off our bucket list.  Truly a wonderful experience with extremely capable pilot, Patrick.

This was our second experience with K-2 Aviation, and I cannot find words to describe the amazing experiences we had both times. On both flights we got not only the opportunity to see the magnificent Denali, we got to land on Ruth Glacier. The pilots are friendly, experienced, and very informative. I felt extremely safe because earlier in the day our flight was cancelled due to weather issues. K-2 seems to take the business of safety very seriously. Thanks K-2 you provide an AMAZING experience.
K2 Aviation is top notch and the best way to see Wild Alaska.  As a pilot myself i can say that K2 is very professional and safe.  Theglaziers landing was fantastic.

review_title: Denali Views & Glacier Landing: What could be better?
review_text:
K2 Flightseeing & Glacier Landing Flight, K2 Aviation, Talkeetna.  We took K2's shuttle from Talkeetna Alaskan Lodge to the K2 facility near town. When I called the previous evening, the folks at K2 said we didn't need full winter gear, noting that they'd worn tee shirts and shorts earlier this week. 
It was a sunny, warm day, but since I'm cold natured, I packed the jacket, wore my boots and long jeans, but dispensed with hat, full-up gloves, thermal underwear & windpants.  After check-in, we donned their boots over ours; their boots had the advantage of also providing tight pant-locking closure. 
We rode with our pilot (Joe or Chuck??) in an 8-passenger red DeHaviland Beaver on 5 August 2015 from 1300-1430. The weather was perfect!  We flew up for a close up of the Denali Summit and rotated so everyone got good views of the Great One and adjacent peaks; then we climbed above the clouds to land on Ruth Glacier. 
The Glacier was soft--perfect snowman crafting material. It was much warmer on this glacier than near the glaciers on the Inside Passage and at Glacier Bay & College Fjord. It was such an amazing experience! After about 30 minutes on the Glacier, we flew back along the glacial valley and streams to Talkeetna. It was a superb outing, another totally different view & experience!  AND we clearly saw DENALI again!!!

review_title: Splurge a little and fly with K2!
review_text: Our flight with K2 around McKinley was indeed one of the highlights of our trip to Alaska. The pilot, whose name I unfortunately have forgotten, made us feel safe and confortable. His narration of what we were seeing below was great and very informative. We enjoyed a nice, smooth landing on the glacier, too.
Of course weather helped but total experience from begin to end has been memorable. Will certainly recommend (and yes, do not take chances with weather).

excellent staff,pilot and equipment. They took care to explain that the winds would not allow the trip to the back of the mountain and quickly credited our total $$. Nice location/shop and orderly departure -- felt safe and informed throughout -- would definitely recommend K2! THANK YOU ALL

review_title: A must do on the bucket list.
review_text: You want to see Alaska, FLY.. This was an amazing adventure, a bucket list for sure. They fly you right up to the mountains and bring you down the glaciers.

Took a one hour trip with a glacier landing - K2 McKinley Experience. Weather was mostly clear and we saw Denali, it snowed a little when we landed on glacier. Pilot was great and explained what glaciers and mountains we saw. Great trip

We took a flight around Denali and landed on one of the glaciers. It was so beautiful and amazing. I just get goose bumps thinking about it and God's work. It was an unusually warm day and just as clear as could be.

Our N2 Alaska experience was nothing short of extraordinary.  Our family of 4 was looking for a thrilling site seeing tour of Denali and the surrounding range. David Hicks, flying out of his sea plane in Talkeenta, gave us a truly remarkable experience. I highly recommend him if you want to see Denali from the sky.

During our vacation to Alaska one of our stop overs was the town of Talkeetna.  It is just below Denali National Park and is the home of K2 Aviation which is renown for its tour flights around Denali (Mt. McKinley) and glacier landings.  We went up on a Grand Tour of Denali along with the surrounding glaciers and lower peaks.  
It was, without any reservations, the most enjoyable and memorable part of the 1st. week we spent in Alaska.  The views were absolutely incredible.  We obtained over 50 beautiful photos that our friends continuously marvel over.  The flight was absolutely smooth.  A lot of the credit must go to our pilot Brian, however all the pilots are exceptionally experienced in negotiating mountainous terrain.
One of these flights is a must do if you plan on visiting Alaska.
really nice flight above the glacier, would recommend a smaller plane, we were in a 8 seat one. but anyway, great experience 😃

Our 2 hour McKinley fly-around was perfect! The two hours just flew bye! Our pilot was very friendly and super informative and put us as ease right away after he said he had 500 flights! The glacier landing was the 2nd best, only to the mountain peaks! Take in this K2 trip for a super memory of Alaska!

Flight into the Alaska Range and back with spectacular views. The highlight was landing on Ruth Glacier and getting out to walk around!  It was so peaceful high in the mountains.  The excursion was a total of two hours but felt like much less.  The scenery was spectacular!

We visited Alaska in August with another couple. Each person picked one thing they really wanted to do and mine was to see Denali by air. K2 had the best web site and offered different types of flights. I decided on the summit trip. My wife was a bit nervous about flying on such a small plane and having to breathe through a mask, but was willing to go. We prepaid to reserve the flight and I was really looking forward to it.
On the day of our flight, we got to Talkeetna early and stopped by to see the facility early. The three people I was flying with were all happy by how professional and well maintained everything looked. When we checked in later for the flight we were told we couldn't do the summit trip because of the weather. The person at the desk was apologetic and offered us a different trip that they could do. We were okay with that and she took care of everything very swiftly and refunded us the difference in the trip price. If you travel to Alaska, be prepared for this......weather changes quickly and plans may have to change.
The flight was fantastic. There are no words to describe how beautiful and majestic Denali is. The pilot was very knowledgeable and personable and told us what we were looking at all the time. He also told us that he was avoiding snow storms on the mountain and that due to it's size, Denali produces it's own weather. He and the other pilots were talking to each other about the weather conditions throughout the trip.
My apprehensive co-fliers soon forgot they were in a small plane and were as taken in by what we were seeing as I was. The four of us wound up taking over 400 pictures all together. It was the trip of a lifetime for all of us.
If you want a professional and knowledgeable company that does things the right way, then K2 is the way to go.
Jim
We own a plane and fly Idaho back country. Book with K 2! We fly K2 every time we come to Alaska. Nothing but the most professional crew!

Soaring over the Alaskan range and seeing Denali up close was one of the most exciting adventures we've ever had.  But then, to land on a glacier...Unbelievable joy!  We were amazed at the view and the experience!

We took their "McKinley Flyer" 'flightseeing' tour and we were very impressed.  This tour gets you as close a 1/4 mile to some of the formations and being in a 6 seat Piper, the views are incredible.  Our pilot, Dallas, was very knowledgeable and provided insight on the mountain, its glaciers, and its history.  He took good care of us, a very young man (3 years old), and his parents. We had an spectacularly clear morning for our trip and Denali / McKinley stood and welcomed us in all its glory.

We took the Grand Denali tour with glaciar landing.  We were fortunate enough to have a clear day in Sept.  and were cleared to land on Elderidge glacier.  This was the highlight of our 2 weekvacation in Alaska.  The pilot got us up close to the mountains and was sure to give both sides of the plane the beautiful sights.  And, the landing on the glacier was breath taking.  Definitely worth every penny!

O voo foi maravilhoso, piloto foi explicando cada parte das montanhas. O voo sai de um pequeno aeroporto atrás da própria loja, no centrinho de Talkeetna.  O atendimento na loja foi ótimo. São oferecidos 4 tipos de voos a diferentes preços. O voo que fiz deu a volta nas montanhas chegando pertinho delas e durou 1,5h. Foi fantástico ver as montanhas nevadas!

Happened to be passing through Talkeetna and decided to book a tour with K2. We called and asked if anything was going out and they told us to come right over; they put us on the last flight of the day with Daniel.

What a great flight; having driven by Denali Nat'l Park earlier in the day, in pretty cloudy conditions, we were quite happy to see sunshine and blue skies flying over Talkeetna. With late afternoon setting in, the airspace was empty and we pretty much had " The Great One" to ourselves. Daniel was informative and well traveled around the mesmerizing peaks and we felt totally at ease climbing amongst the clouds in his plane.
