Knowing that weather is not always accommodating for flight seeing, it was a risk worth taking. It was also better than any expensive helicopter tour I have done in previous locations and ports.

My husband and I spent the weekend in Talkeetna before heading out on a cruise out of Seward. We booked a flight seeing adventure with glacier landing with K2 and it was wonderful. The weather cleared up so we had spectacular views of Denali. Our guide/pilot was really informative and made sure everyone had great views for pictures. The landing was smooth and being on the glacier was pretty incredible. I would highly recommend taking the adventure.

We were absolutly lucky to be there on th best day of the year. The sky was blue, the air was clear. On our 90 minute flight in a twin turbo prop we saw lots of glaciers, mountains and most important Mt. Mc Konöey without clouds in the bright sunshine. The pilot gave good exülanations and showed everything to left and right seat passengers - perfect day!!

Absolutely fantastic! My wife had never flown in a small plane and loved it. Stan is a great pilot and narrator. We were supposed to have the Grand Tour with glacier landing, but weather conditions made it dicey, so they changed it to the next level down - and it was still one of the best things we did. I would recommend and early flight. The light was fantastic.

When I was in Talkeetna 5 years ago, I took a tour with K2 and it was one of the highlights of my trip.  Of course this trip I wanted to relive that.  Always sorta dangerous as one can't step in the same river twice.  Well, I did and it was awesome the second time!  We even had a friend who I had to talk into going up in a small plane and he felt safe and had a great time.  The views are awesome on a good day.  If the weather is decent go!

Taking a K2 flight to see the Denali area from the air may be expensive, but it is worth it.  While what you can see is weather dependent, the pilots will do their best to make sure you see as much as possible.  They are in constant contact with each other by radio, sharing the current visibility of various features to help each other provide the best views for the passengers.  We saw only a few glimpses of Denali itself, but the other sights, especially the glaciers, were excellent, making the flight worthwhile.

A few tips:  First, if you are interested in a glacier landing, be advised that this is never a sure thing and it depends on the weather and how firm the ice in the landing areas on the glaciers is on any given day.  The day we went, some glacier landings were cancelled (they refund a portion of the fare when that happens), and a few were able to be completed.

There is an advantage to a glacier landing that has nothing to do with glaciers.  The planes that are equipped for glacier landings (skis on the landing gear) have wings above the passenger area of the plane, making for unobstructed views down toward the ground.  Planes that are not scheduled for glacier landings have wings below the passenger area of the plane, which partially obstructs the view looking down.  So if you can afford it, you'll get a better view if you choose a glacier landing flight.

Another tip:  We chose a non-glacier landing, and the box beam supporting the wings passes through the passenger compartment right near the place where you'd put your feet, for one of the rows of seats, so if you can, avoid that row.  Also avoid riding with the pilot in the front; although that sounds cool, you don't see as well from there due to the instrument panel.  Surprisingly, the back seats in the plane might actually be the best for this type of plane.

Our flight was nominally an hour long, but we were in the air for about 90 minutes.   I think this was just a reflection of K2's desire to please customers, and not due to any flight restrictions.  Plan your day accordingly, for the flight to take longer than you might expect.

Wow. What a terrific experience. You can't beat the views! Mike, our pilot, was incredibly knowledgeable as a tour guide, as well as being an expert (and safety-conscious) pilot. We had a fantastic trip, and came back with some amazing photos.

Booked a glacier landing but not possible because of weather. They were still flying just not landing on the glacier. I wish they would have been more honest when telling us what we would actually be able to see. Shame on them for making us think it would be more then what it was. I would have skipped this.  Another note, I thought the pilot would be more informative.

review_title: The only way to see Mt. McKinley
review_text: A really great way to see Mt. McKinley.   We were blessed with clear skies and a great pilot.   Incredible views of one of God's greatest creations.

Got snowed out from K2 flight on July 18th, but woke up to clear blue skies on July 19th.  Had a tremendous flight up to Denali and landed upon Ruth Glacier.  The pilot also could play a banjo and played happy anniversary to a couple in our Group.
The flight, sights, and experience of landing upon Denali is a memory we will always cherish !!

My husband and I did the flight and hike adventure with K2 as part of our honeymoon. We had an amazing time! We chose to meet at the office, but were offered a pickup at our lodge. We were weighed in and our hiking guide met us early. We were then transported to Fish Lake where we met our pilot Brian and very well maintained Beaver float plane. We were blessed with a post card perfect, crystal clear day. We had an amazing flight out to Backside Lake. During the flight, our pilot pointed out many areas of interest and was knowledgeable. His landing on the lake was the smoothest landing I have ever experienced. Once we landed, our hiking guide led us on an amazing hike around the lake. Our flight back was just as incredible and we were able to spot several moose from the air. Our landing was again as smooth as could be. This was our favorite Alaskan adventure to date! It is worth every penny!!

I wasn't sure about thus excursion,but my husband and our best friend were very excited. As it turned out, it was awesome! The pilot was excellent, the,flight was smooth. We landed on a glacier, again a very smooth landing. I was so comfortable that I sat in the co-pilots seat on the return. If you get a chance, I highly recommend K2 Aviation. Everyone is very friendly.

This was an amazing adventure and could be the highlight of our trip. The weather was perfect with clear skies. We took off in a small airplane holding four of and the pilot. By the time we reached the Mt Denali Mt range we were roughly at 9500 feet flying between mountains. I felt that we could reach out touch each mountain. Our pilot was very knowledgeable which added to the spectacular flight. I'm sorry that I don't remember the pilots name but thanks for a wonderful experience.

review_title: Flying over the Denali mountain range combined with a  glacier landing
review_text: Our pilot was very knowledgeable, giving a wonderful history of the area.  We could not see Denali due to clouds and fog, but had no trouble landing on Ruth Glacier.  We spent the time admiring the ski lodge on one of the peaks, accessible only by plane and skis.  The trip was well worth the cost.

Landing on a glacier was the highlight of our trip to Alaska.  We went up in a ten passenger Otter.  The scenery to and from was fabulous.  Our pilot was very personable and competent.  We were given Goretex overboots to wear on the glacier.  It was like being in another world of splendor and isolation.

review_title: View of Mt McKinley and Glacier Landing
review_text: This was the highlight on our recent Alaska cruise and Land tour of Denali. Breathtaking scenery, smooth flight, view of Denali, and Glacier Landing made this one of the top things that we have ever done. It helped that it was a beautiful day with temperatures near 50 degree on the glacier. Light jacket and layers were the perfect attire. They provide foot attire over your boots. Take your camera and sunglasses and experience a moment on the top of North America.
bei traumhaftem Wetter flogen wir um Mount Denali und landeten auf dem Gletscher. Etwas besseres hätten wir an diesem tag nicht erleben können. Einfach unglaublich schön!!!

Unfortunately we had a total rain out on the day we were going to do the flight. So, although we can not speak to the experience they offer for flying, they were more then accommodating trying to give us the best option. They allowed us to 1) wait until later in the day to see if it cleared up, 2) reschedule the flight, or 3) give us a 100% refund. We chose the refund due to other travel plans.

Feel confident booking with them - if there is inclement weather, you won't get taken advantage of.

Even on an overcast day, this was a phenomenal experience.  We originally were going to pass on flightseeing as the price quoted by the cruise line was quite high.  However, we were able to save about 35% off that price (for the same tour) by just showing up at their office at the airfield and asking if they had any discounts.  Our plane went up about a half hour later and the views were unworldly.  Our guide was very informative with facts and figures and tuned for safety. Our trip to Alaska was fantastic and this was the highlight ! Do it !  You will view it as money well spent.

Best part of our Alaskan vacation,  our pilot was great, he told about the surroundings as we flew, landed on the glacier, we got out and walked around on the glacier-took photos-and then flew back.  One of the best memories we will ever have of Alaska

We took  a flightseeing tour of Mount McKinley at 9AM,  The tour is the Circle Denali Tour: This tour completely circumnavigates the grandeur of Mt. McKinley. We flew over the spectacular Ruth Glacier, going between the world's deepest cliffs and icefalls of the 2 mile deep Great Gorge. We flew over the Climber's Base Camp on the Kahiltna Glacier, as well as viewed the West Buttress and the Wickersham Wall.  the tour was 2 hours with glacier landing but the weather closed in and we aborted the landing - would have hated to spend the night in that little cabin!

If you are limited on time to see Denali State Park, take to the skies with K2 Aviation in Talkeetna! Our pilot took us up and over Denali and Eldridge Glacier, Moose's Tooth, Mt. Hunter, Mt. McKinley and others. Highlight of the trip to Alaska!

We (Auntie, Uncle and 10 y.o. nephew) took the float plane trip to the lake, got off and walked around for an hour, then home.  The scenery from plane just amazing.  All of us were in awe. Even the nephew was impressed with the scenery.  We got off the plane, and were met by our guide Joan.  She was fantastic!  Led us on a small hike around the area, told us of the glaciers we were right next to, loads of info, facts and figures.  Just great.  The reason for only 4 stars you ask?  The pilot refused to speak to us during the flight.  We would ask questions--no response--ever! Now my husband is also a pilot and he knew why this might be happening.  However, the pilot never announced he wouldn't/couldn't talk to us during the flight.  It was just very odd for a sightseeing flight. We have been on many sightseeing flights in different locales and this has never happened before.  Too bad, could have been a perfect trip.

This was on of the neatest experiences of my life. It was about $800ish for 2 people and worth every penny. This is a great aviation company and very professionally managed. Go there and book it.. many flights throughout the day. Plan on flying on your first day in Talkeetna because if you can't go up due to weather you can reschedule.

While traveling with my family in the Alaska area, we booked a last minute glacier landing flight with K2.

The staff was incredibly gracious and welcoming. Our pilot, Patrick, was extremely confident, helpful and friendly. We flew around Mt McKinley (Denali) and got to see breathtaking beautiful views. Landing on a glacier was absolutely unreal. Patrick took pictures for us and answered all of our random questions as if he had never been asked any of them before. Our flight and landing were smooth and comfortable. Patrick and Katie and the rest of the staff know how to take care of their customers.

This was an experience of a lifetime. Do not miss it. Absolutely worth your time.

review_title: Cloudy in Talkeetna but bright sunlight on Denali
review_text: We flew their first flight of the day with Daniel.  It was overcast and cloudy in Talkeetna.  We scheduled a glacier landing however with weather over the past several days, the glacier was too soft for us to land on.  They told us this up front and adjusted the cost accordingly.  On board, Daniel shared his knowledge of the area and glaciers - he definitely knew a lot.  As we flew toward the mountain, he managed to weave his way through the clouds and mountains and then, the summit appeared in full sunlight!!  We got several photos of the Eldgredge Glacier and the summit.  We came back beneath the clouds and checked out a few other glaciers (including Ruth) before heading back.  It was a fantastic time!!  Would love to fly with them again.

Daniel took the four of us and another person on a great flight around Denali.  He really knew his stuff about the mountains there and the glaciers, and was super friendly and fun.  The other staff was quite professional and everything went very smoothly.  Also very much appreciated their super clean facility and awesome playground facility right beside the building.  It's not cheap to do these kind of tours, but they are lifetime memories and definitely "worth it."

This was a fine trip, everything looked very good, safe, professional, our pilot had over ten years experience.  We loaded with no problem got going to our destination which was a Glacier with comment from the pilot of things we were seeing and opportunity to ask questions. Flew in a De Haviland Beaver for you airplane folks.    Landing on the Glacier was no problem and trip back was very good.  Would use this company on another visit.

review_title: The Undisputed Highlight Of The Trip
review_text:
We opted for a glacier landing flight on what was one of the warmest and sunniest days. The whole experience was a delight. Although the flight started 45 minutes late, this was clearly because they weren't hurrying people and the whole experience was truly amazing.

The pilot was helpful and there was a strong emphasis on safety.

We approached Mount McKinley  and the views were absolutely spectacular. One of us was selected to sit up front on the outward flight and the other on the return.

Views are absolutely spectactular.

The landing was a really good experience and that we shall never forget. On the glacier itself it was like being in a different world.

This adventure does not come cheap however it is worth every penny.  A 90 minute excursion was closer to 2 hours value.

review_title: One of the best things to do
review_text:
This may be a little pricey, but it's one of the most memorable experiences we have.  We did this 15 years ago, and made it a priority in this trip to Alaska.

Our family of 5 had our own plane and pilot.  We were in the air for around an hour, and on the glacier for maybe 20 mins.

It was comfortable in the plane.  Dress in layers for the glacier landing.  They give you boots to keep your shoes dry.

It's noisy in the plane, but you have headphones on an intercom so you can talk with the pilot, and hear other pilots as well,

review_title: Great experiance! Expensive, but you only do it once
review_text:
A great experience. The only was to get up close and personal with Denali mountain, unless you climb it. K2 was very professional. The check in went smoothly, and pretty soon we were boarding the airplane. Everyone gets a window seat. You fly for about 1:15 and then land on a glacier close to Denali Mountain. You hang for 15-20 min, and then fly back in about 20 min. 2h on the dot. The pilot does some explaining, but if you have a question about anything in particular, SHOUT IT OUT. don't be shy. It was great watching all that spectacular scenery glide by.

A word of advice to those sitting in the right seat of the cockpit. Just because the pilot put you up there does not mean you should be yapping with him the whole time!

review_title: You can't put a price on this memory!
review_text: We almost didn't do this trip. The price is a little daunting at first. But everyone we spoke to said we "had to do the glacier landing." It was a great decision. The views from the top are unforgettable. The down side was the company was so tbusy our flight was delayed over an hour. We then had to taxi back from the runway because some folks missed the call for their flight. I hate waiting! Within ten minutes on the plane, my frustration was gone and we were captivated by the panorama. Beautiful sunny day and memories we will hold dear always. Spent about 20 minutes on the glacier. I do think they should discourage men from  toileting up there, as one man did from our flight. Who wants to see that when enjoying such a view of the landscape?Had a great pilot named Patrick from Arkansas who was married on the glacier the year before. Now that's hard to top. Where does one go for a honeymoon after that!?

K2 Aviation has good pilots that are not only skilled in flying but are skilled in giving information of what visitors are seeing out the small plane's windows and are eager to see that their guests are pleased with their short stay on Ruth's Glacier in the shadow of Denali, a.k.a. Mt. McKinley.  Many are good photographers using the small cameras now popular with tourists.

Amazing, Surreal, Breath Taking....an adventure of a life time.  Took the 2 hour Denali Grand Tour with glacier Landing Ride around Mt McKinley and its surrounding areas.  Landed on Pika Glacier. Definitely a must if traveling through Talkeetna.

review_title: Denali and Glacier landing tour, worth every penny!
review_text: We booked as part of our Princess CruiseTour and we were NOT disappointed. Initially the cost seemed a little pricey but after going it certainly was worth it. They operation is low key but well organized. Our pilot was exceptional as the Ruth glacier was crowded with tours. So he radioed for a flight plan change and landed at Eldridge glacier instead. Absolutely fantastic tour, could be the single greatest part of our trip.

Just returned from a two week land and cruise package with Royal Caribbean. The highlight of my trip was our flight plane tour of Mt. McKinley. Our flight was about two hours leaving at about 7pm. The pilot wasn't sure if we would be able to land on the glacier because of weather conditions. In fact we were one of the first planes to land on Ruth Glacier that day. The whole experience was wonderful and the sights were the best I have ever seen in my lifetime. We had a very smooth plane ride with spectacular views. If you are thinking about this tour say yes, you won't be sorry. Simply put this tour was amazing

This was one of the highlights of our trip to Alaska.  We did the flightseeing over Mt. McKinley with a glacier landing.  DO NOT skip the glacier landing.  It was beyond words.  We were part of the 30% that gets to see Mt. McKinley.   We had a cloudless day.  Our guide, Rich, was very knowledgeable and friendly.

This is a must do. We did the Mt. McKinley tour and glacier landing and it was so amazing.  The views from the air are beyond words.  We had a beautiful, sunny day and could see "The great one" in all its glory so close.  The glacier landing was awesome as well.  So breathtaking to stand there and see the mountains around breathe the clean, fresh air.  our pilot was awesome as well and even entertaining, playing his banjo while we were on the glacier.

When I was thinking about booking this tour I could only find a couple of reviews so I was unsure but, in the end we booked it and it was worth every penny. A highlight of our trip for sure. Our initial trip was cancelled do to weather so we rescheduled for the following day. The flight to the lake and out was spectacular. Landing on the lake was a real treat. The pilot and our guide were helpful and interesting. The hike itself was moderately difficult, but I'm assuming they tailor it to the group and we are in decent shape. The experience of being that isolated was great. The scenery amazing. I could have stayed for days, but we did not feel rushed with only having a couple hours on the ground. Really, I can't say enough about it. Just fyi - the snack and glass of wine they advertise didn't happen. We were given a meat stick though. So you may want to pack a snack.

review_title: Flightseeing and landing on a glacier
review_text: The highlight of our 2 week Alaska vacation. Started out about 6pm. Still plenty of daylight in Alaska. I am a relunctant flyer and my husband comes from a family of pilots. Chris, our pilot from K2, is a natural and made all of us feel very safe and comfortable.  Amazing scenery, and then we got over the Alaska Range and the glaciers and the scenery were breathtaking. Landed on a glacier and saw 2 sets of camps for climbers. The silence and expanse of the glacier was awe inspiring.  It rained in Talkeetna while we were in the air and we saw multiple rainbows. Truly and unforgettable experience. Hope we will go back someday and do this again.

We did the McKinley Flyer with a glacier landing for our wedding anniversary. It was worth every penny, and left us speechless in awe of the Alaska Range. We had great weather, the pilot was extremely knowledgeable and nice, and overall, it was an experience that can't be beat. Thanks for making our anniversary adventure so memorable! It was truly first class.

We flew around the top of Mt. McKinley on a beautiful day then landed on a glacier.  We then got out, walked around and took pictures for about 15 minutes and the plane then took off from the glacier and brought us home.  The entire trip was done in a professional manner with the utmost concern for safety.
I will guarantee that this will be a highlight of your trip.

review_title: A highlight of our Alaska vacation!
review_text: Wow! What a great experience!  The staff was friendly and knowledgeable, the facility and airplanes were well kept, the pilot gave a great tour, and the views from the top of the glacier were spectacular.  This is a "must-do" for your Alaska experience.

review_title: Well worth the time and money!!!
review_text:
A first-class experience in every aspect.  The office staff was knowledgeable and efficient...and then, there was the flight up to the Ruth glacier.  OMG  It was spectacular.  The weather cooperated for great views of the valley leading up to the mountains and glaciers and the view of Denali and the surrounding peaks was indescribable.  I have lived a good part of my life in the mountains of Colorado and Northern California, skied a lot of big mountains, but the views on this trip were the best.  Our pilot, Barry, was certainly knowledgeable about the mountains and glaciers, and was also a great pilot.  Our landings and take-offs were both smooth.  Oh!  One more thing:  Barry brought his banjo along and serenaded a couple celebrating their anniversary.  It was the best!

Also the best selection of souvenir t-shirts and the like of any area here or in DNP.

My spouse and I enjoyed a fantastic experience flying in a small plane and landing on Ruth glacier. Both takeoff and landing were surprising smooth. Our pilot made sure both sides of the plane got great views of Denali and of base camp. Aw inspiring flying around the peaks. Service was awesome. I would book another adventure with K2.

Although it had snowed too much the previous couple of days to do a glacier landing, the K2 team gave us options for conducting the flights up the glacier valleys and made sure we were totally comfortable with our decision to fly or not.  Awesome experience for us and our pilot was great to point out all the various features of the landscape.

My fiance and I spent two days hiking the Kesugi Ridge, staring at Mt. McKinley and decided once we got off the trail, we wanted to see McKinley up close and personal. We're pretty frugal so it took a lot of debate on whether or not to invest in the flightseeing tour. At 6 pm in the evening, we finally decided IF we could still get on a flight that evening, we would take the financial plunge and do it. 

The first person I talked to on the phone at K2 was helpful, he explained what routes they were flying, the cost, etc. After hanging up and going over the information I learned with my fiance, I then called back to clarify a few things. The next person I spoke with, I believe her name was Stephanie, was not as friendly. When I questioned how she came up with the total price, she sounded put out and stated there were taxes and "other" fees. I wanted to know what the other fees were so pressed her a bit more and she finally said national park fees. Since we had been in Denali Park a few days ago, we had already paid these. Had I not pressed her, I wonder if we would have paid them twice. Aside from that interaction, everything else about the tour was wonderful.

We went on the blue route with a glacier landing. Our pilot was extremely informative and made sure both sides of the plane had great views of the various peaks, base camp areas, etc. We had plenty of time to spend on the glacier and luckily for us, had a nice, clear day. There are so many amazing things you see from the plane that you would never get to experience on foot, that even this frugal person (we tent camped most of our 10 day trip) highly suggests shelling out the bucks for this excursion.

I decided the day of to take this trip. My husband and son had a reservation but I was too scared. I changed my mind and went. The pilot was great. Very thorough going through safety before flight. He gave us good narrative of what we were looking at. I had a hard time hearing it at times cause I didn't turn up my headphones, my mistake. The view was spectacular. We saw Denali pretty well. We landed smoothly on Ruth Glacier and had fun standing on it and taking pictures. I'm so happy I did it. Yes, its a bit expensive but all of the companies are similar in price. Not sure when I'll be back to Alaska so I'm glad I did it. You should too!!

It took me 8 months in Alaska before I decided to splurge on taking a flight seeing tour of Denali. I paid more for this flight than it cost my company to fly me back to Chicago, but it was without a doubt worth it. If you are in Talkeetna on a clear day, do this! (If it is not clear in Talkeetna, ask them about the conditions nearer to Denali) My only regret about doing this in winter is that it was too cold that day do land in the glacier. Pro tip: be quick to raise your hand when the pilot asks for a volunteer.

My husband and 
I booked a flight with a glacier landing.  It was the most majestic views of Mt. McKinley.  The weather plays a huge factor whether you can view the top of the mountain.  Please make sure if you book a flight that the pilot has experience flying in Mt McKinley and not just flying in other locations.  Our pilot was Chris who had 11 years flying with K2.

This is my second flight seeing tour of Denali, and it was spectacular.  Our pilot flew us around to the west, north and south sides of the mountain.  The rock spires, glaciers and snow slides were amazing.  We were able to land on the Ruth glacier which is part of the amphitheater. We got to spend 15 minutes walking around and marveling at how small we as humans truly are in relation to nature.  I highly recommend this tour, it puts everything in perspective.

Bad luck. They were an hour late with our departure and the flights that left earlier were able to land on the glacier. We were not able to land due to reduced visibility. 

They reduced our cost to the cheapest flight but paying over $400 (2 people) and spending ~ 4 hours to do an hour flight with limited vis was a real disappointment. 

We rolled and lost....

We took the longest possible flight - from Talkeetna, around Mt. McKinley and landing on a glacier.  We had spectacular weather, which made the experience all the better.  (It was overcast down low on the north side of McKinley, so visitors to the park on the ground never saw the mountain that day.  But we had a fabulous view of it.)  

K2 has a variety of aircraft and they match the aircraft to the number of passengers for the particular flight.  It was well organized and smoothly run.  Not cheap, but good value for the experience.

Here's a video of landing on the glacier:

https://vimeo.com/134175532

Highly recommended!

This is a bit pricey, but it turned out to be worth every dollar.  The weather was iffy, but it cooperated and we got to see views of Mt McKinley/Denali from 10,000 feet.  We flew around all views except the north side, and our pilot did a great job of positioning the plane so passengers on each side got to take photos.  We did land on the Ruth glacier and had 15 minutes to walk around looking and taking photos.  On the way back to Talkeetna, our pilot told us lots about glaciers and their movement as we flew about 500 feet above them.  This flight was a highlight of our Alaska trip, and everyone at K2 contributed to our satisfaction.

review_title: Beautiful scenery and a good flight
review_text: We flew to a glacier with K2 Aviation and it was beautiful. The scenery was amazing and so serene. Pilot choose a spot for us away from the other planes and it felt like we were the only people in the world. Absolutely recommend taking this tour.

review_title: Spend the money and do this!
review_text: This was the highlight of our trip... though costly, the tour with the glacier landing is unforgettable. The views of the mountains and glaciers are stunning, making for some great photos. It's amazing to land on a glacier and have it be 60+ degrees. Save up a few dollars and do this, you won't regret it!

Our pilot was very knowledgeable about the area as we flew in and out of the glacier.  The landing on Ruth Glacier was an incredible experience.  There were places where the glacier was 4000 feet deep, truly amazing.

Just had a tour and landing with K2 for a business venture. Everyone was fantastic from check-in to wrap up. Patrick our pilot was great and the info he gave us was excellent. What a day! I will use them again when I am back for vacation with the family. They do everything to make your trip enjoyable. And landing on Pika Glacier was an experience I will never forget. 
Call them and ask for Suzanne. You won't regret it. Oh, just heck the weather first. The mountains change their mind all the time.

Great pilot took us around Denali, the other mountains, plus numerous glaciers.  We did peekaboo with the mountain, but the pilot hung in there.  Smooth flight with awesome views.  Seeing Denali/McKinley is always a crap shoot...good luck.

Awesome! Definitely add the glacier landing. We all enjoyed the flightseeing, and the glacier landing made it perfect. We had good weather, not perfect so didn't get to see Mt Denali, but the pilot tried hard, talking with other flyers in the area. This was a Big highlight for our trip and so glad we did this.

The highlight of an incredible trip! The weather was clear & we had a beautiful sight of Mt Mckinley the whole way there. We landed on a glacier & were able to spend time taking in the breathtaking view.

review_title: Great trip with a reliable  and experienced company
review_text: K2 Aviation s a first class company in every way. We were scheduled to go up on one of their tours over Denali on June 30th. We were told that it was clouded in and we would not see very much and were offered our money back or to wait for the next day to go up. The next day was a little better but we were told that we would only see the bottom part of the glaciers. We chose not to go up that day also and were refunded the money for two of the three who were going up.  was coming back trough Talkeenta the following week on the way  back to Anchorage. When we came through he weather was much better.  went upand saw a spectacular view of many of the glaciers and was very pleased with the overall experience. They are obviously a very ethical company who care about their customers safety and overall experience of a good trip for the money paid. Would do it again in a heartbeat.

The wife and I took this flight on our resent Alaskan vacation.  We had booked a trip completely around the mountain but weather prevented that.  But this flight was great and the glacier landing is well worth the extra money.  The pilot during the flight talked to us about the area and answered any questions.  K2 was top notch and we would do it again

review_title: The best way to see Denali and the glaciers
review_text: We took a flightseeing tour to see Denali and the glaciers.  Our pilot was very competent and provided much information about what we saw.  The staff in the office is  friendly and helpful.

While in Talkeetna we went on the K2 Glacier Landing Flight.  We highly recommend this experience.  Our pilot(patrick) was knowledgeable of the area and the glaciers.  We had beautiful weather and were able to safely land and walk around on the glacier. The flight out to the glacier was breathtaking! This was probably our favorite activity while visiting Alaska!  If you get the chance don't pass it up!

review_title: K2 MCKINLEY EXPERIENCE FLIGHT!  OMG!  THIS IS AWESOME!!
review_text: 60 minute flight around Mt. McKinley.  Spectacular views and incredible learning experience with our pilot, Nick. (So much knowledge and expertise!)  Absolutely breathtaking flight!  Don't skip this!!

review_title: By far the coolest thing we have ever done on a trip!!!
review_text: We took the flight seeing trip up to Mt. Mckinley and it was one of the neatest things we have ever done before.  You get to take this incredibly scenic flight to the mountain and then actually land on a glacier. We could then get out and walk around a bit. It was so beautiful and so incredible to see everything from that vantage point.  Our pilot was awesome and did such a great job of narrating and telling us about everything we were seeing. This company also prides themselves on safety which we really appreciated as well! I cannot say enough great things about this flight seeing trip!

I've been in Alaska a long time and never done this before, and I don't know why - it was amazing!  I plan on having all my visitors do this from now on.  The pilot was fantastic and knowledgeable, and while McKinley and the weather didn't cooperate fully, we were able to land on the glacier and seem some amazing things.  K2 was great and actually refunded us partially because the flight wasn't the full time.

I did a lot of research before booking a trip with K2 and was amazed by their friendly service. I called before booking to make sure I had everything ready to go. There was weather on the north side of the mountain so we were not able to do the full experience, but the difference in price was refunded after we landed. We did choose to do the glacier landing and I would highly recommend paying the extra money to do it as it was an amazing experience! Our pilot was great and it was the highlight of our trip!

review_title: The best part of our 10 day trip!
review_text: We went on the flight to see Mt McKinley and land on a glacier.  We were crazy enough to bring our 2 and 5 year old along.  We all loved the trip!  The staff was great with our kids!  The 2 year old was free and they gave a AAA discount.  My 5 year old cannot stop talking about the flight and playing in the snow on a glacier.  He loved wearing the headphones and feeling like a pilot.  Our pilot was wonderful and I have never experienced such smooth landings.  It costs a lot but is worth every penny!

review_title: Floatplane + Denali Hike - Not worth the money
review_text: My fiance and I signed up the floatplane trip into Denali park + the hike upon arrival. The floatplane trip was amazing, our pilot was very knowledgable and told us some great info on the way. The reason for the low rating is that the hiking guide we met up with in the park (which I don't think is run by K2 but is run by a diff. company but used by K2 for this package) was very nice, but not a great guide for actual hikers. We mentioned many times that we were avid hikers and would like to hike as much as possible, but our guide was unable to keep up. We had 2+ hours to hike and barely hiked far up the hill. It was much more of a gentle nature walk than an actual hike. K2 refunded us part of the money which was nice of them, but if you're looking to actual hike- this is not the trip for you.

We did the tour in early July 2015 and are very happy with our decision to have done the glacier landing with K2 aviation, one of the most memorable experiences one can ask for with a great company. The staff was very professional yet personal and friendly. Our pilot was really knowledgeable of the area and extremely experienced (landing was very smooth even with choppy weather). Definitely recommend !

We reached half an hour before the departure and checked in. The reception lady was welcoming and explained the details. After wearing the snow boot the otter aircraft took off. At the begining itself when you'll be introduced to the pilot, ask for co-pilot seat. For best photos take the rear seats. It was a lovely views of the snow covered mountains and glaciers from the aircraft. The landing on Glacier looks smooth and wow - what an awesome view of the glacier valley. Make sure you wear sunglass or otherwise the light was too much you can barely open your eyes. Take as many photos as you like and post. The pilot will give you the history & geography of the location. Here in Alaska, people first learn to fly than to drive. K2 aviation & Talkeetna Air Taxi - both are professional and will give their best to give a memorable experience of North America tallest peak.

We did the Grand Denali Tour with landing in early June '15.  Very happy with our decision.  This organization is professionally run.  Staff is very friendly, polite and capable.  BTW, if you are a Costco member stop in one of the two Anchorage stores for discounted  (20%) gift cards that can be used for your K2 flight.  A great value for members.

We flew with them for a McKinley experience and glacier landing. It was one of he most memorable travel experiences of my life. The pilot was great, the vistas dazzling. I cannot recommend this strongly enough.

This is a very special airline.  The staff are fantastic and they really know Alaska and the mountain aviation conditions yet they have a good sense of humour (which they need).  Our private flight to Denali Backcountry Lodge was delayed by bad weather for 24 hours and nothing was too much trouble for them.  

They looked after us really well and kept us fully informed.  It also meant we spent some time in their waiting area and got to see them at work.  I would be happy to fly with them any time.  Gerard is a master conductor of the orchestra of planes and keeps all his toys flying safe.
The K2 aviación was very good, the expierience was great landing on the glacier is nerve-racking. But It nerds a little more information.

What a great flight. This was a beautiful flight all around Mt McKinley. We were blessed with a cloudless day and the entire Range stretched out before us. Our Pilot did a great job of maneuvering the plane so everyone could see the views.
We also did the Glacier Landing, of which the actual Landing was the most exciting part. This is a nice addition to the trip and the views are fantastic!

we booked this through the Princess land tours group. We arrived at K2 aviation about 30 min before our flight, the very helpful and happy staff weighed us all and offered glacier boots, as well as allowed us to store our extra baggage before leaving. When our pilot arrived from his previous flight, everyone who got off the plane had huge smiles on their faces... after our flight, we all knew why! A MAZE ING is the only way I can describe this trip! One of the best things I've ever been able to do, and I travel frequently! I would recommend everyone take this flight if you're visiting Talkeetna, you won't be disappointed!

Went on a 2.5 hour fly over Denali National Park.  We had great weather and were able to land on Pika Glacier - Amazing experience.  Our pilot was very knowledgeable about the area and was handy with a camera. A must do if ever in Talkeetna.

This is a must when you visit Talkeetna.  The trip to Mt. McKinley is nothing short of amazing.  Landing on the glacier itself was breathtaking and just awesome.  Our pilot was Randy who was an excellent pilot.  So smooth we didn't even know we had taken off or landed. Do not skip this tour.  It gives you an incredible view of the mountain from different angles.

This was a great day with perfect weather for landing on a glacier.  We went before the Willow Fire really was a problem and it was clear until we spotted it on the way back.  I had made a reservation several months prior but we arrived in Talkeetna around noon.  They were able to move up our departure and we were so happy.  Every seat has a view.  Our pilot whom I think I recall his name was Brian was very good, cautious, and pointed out land and geographic marks.  Mt Denali was beautiful and we had plenty of time on the glacier.  We would highly recommend this company.

Flying over the Denali National Park and landing on the glacier close to highest mountain of North America is definitely a lifetime experience.

The trip is very expensive but worthful. We selected K2 because it is very friendly and flexible. We know sometime the weather could be bad and you could not flight out or see much over the cloud, and K2 gave us call about the weather and the choice for other flight. It is also very family friendly.

Although the flight is only 1 and half hour, you need prepare half day for the waiting and preparing. Please call them check the weather early.

We left Talkeetna on the Parks Highway before we knew of the Sockeye fire.  Met the fire and the traffic.  Our guide, Eric, knows Jeremiah of K2 and so called to see if we could get a flight to Anchorage.  Jeremiah was extremely helpful, professional and nice besides!
We took the  K2 flight to Ruth glacier with our 2 daughters.  It was spectacular.  Its a great way to get up close to Mt McKinley and then to get out and wander around on the glacier.
Took the flight seeing tour of Mt. McKinley.  Excellent tour.  Price was reasonable and we got up close to all sides of the mountain.  Pilot was very good - safety first.

review_title: A once in a lifetime experience
review_text: We took a flight that circled through the many peaks around mt McKinley   We flew over the climbers' base camp over several glaciers and got a view of the top of the mountain. The pilot was very experienced and knowledgable and took us through some pretty tight spots very smoothly.  We landed on the Ruth Glacier and were able to walk around for about half an hour. On the way back we saw moose and bears from the air.  It was absolutely breathtaking.  I am sometimes uncomfortable in high place and felt no anexity at all.  Do this if you do nothing else

We traveled to Talkeetna by motor coach and flew out by small plane from K2. These guys are very professional. Loved having Rich as our pilot for a flightseeing tour of Denali and the surrounding mountain range all the way down to McNeil Airport in Anchorage. Although it was really cloudy up high we got to see a lot of the glaciers and was able to take lots of pics. Rich was a great narrator for the trip and pointed out a lot of the highlights.

I lived here in Anchorage, Alaska and have never had a chance to fly up to Mt. McKinley and land on a glacier. What great service from the entire staff and the sales team.The sales team were great to deal with at the office in Anchorage and suggest the right type of trip for my family from West Virginia. The pilot on the plane took his time out to take pictures of the family and explain in detail of the fantastic views we were looking at. What a fantastic bunch of people to have a life time of memories.

review_title: Excellent flight operations, pilots, aircraft, routes, & customer service!
review_text: We walked up to the K2 desk in the morning & were offered choices of 3 flight times that day (clear weather, lots of people, but desk staff kept it going).  Amazing flight:  meeting w/ our pilot, flight safety briefing, flight thru the Alaska range to glacier landing, takeoff from the glacier to landing at Talkeetna.  Enjoyed the pilot's comments about the flight route and answering questions enroute (all have headsets/mikes). A flight above Denali National Park & glacier landing was #1 for our activities at Talkeetna.  K2 Aviation one of the largest operators of float/ski aircraft; solid safety record. PS  My husband & I are licensed private pilots.

review_title: A once in a lifetime opportunity
review_text:
A once in a lifetime experience and a MUST while touring in Alaska. This was the first activity during our 10-day Alaskan experience I booked (based on reviews from others), and it was also the activity I looked most forward to on our trip. K2 Aviation exceed my expectations in every way possible! I surprised my husband with this activity and he too, not only had a great experience but couldn't stop talking about (and neither of us can a month later)!

We originally booked the Denali Grand Tour (the package that flies around the North side of Denali) but due to weather were downgraded to the McKinley Flier. K2 Aviation was very accommodating and communicative, providing us with a refund between the two packages (in a very speedy time frame). Even with the downgraded package, we had an amazing time and still had an amazing experience in Denali National Park. It's something neither of us will ever forget!

In addition to the flight, we added in the glacial landing. While the views are out of this world, the glacial landing was unbelievable! Definitely bring a camera and sunglasses along, but if you do a glacial landing, lift up your sunglasses for a few seconds. I hail from a land of snow six months of the year and have never seen such a bright white, and it's something I will never forget.

In addition to our experience, and why we had such a great time, we had an amazing pilot at the helm. Our pilot, Patrick was absolutely amazing and very knowledgeable. He ensured all of us along for the ride had a great time and experience. Patrick is also an avid photographer and was more than happy to take amazing photos of everyone. 

If you are traveling to Alaska, what are you waiting for? Book a trip (and add a glacial landing) through K2 Aviation NOW!

The people booking the flights were rude. We were on standby for flights and waited. After an hours wait we asked for a status update and were told that the next possible flight was an hour and a half away. If we hadn't asked, we would have been left waiting, thinking that we had a shot. We asked if we could leave a phone number to be called and they said no. 

While we were waiting, a gentleman asked if he could wait to go up alone. Instead of giving him options regarding costs for a private flight, they very rudely told him that he had paid for a seat not a plane. 

We found a company that would take our phone number for standby, walked around town for awhile, and finally went up. My advice; find a less corporate outfit to experience the mountain!

Worth. Every. Penny. Recently did a tour with K2 Aviation, truly a once in a lifetime experience! K2 was excellent, professionally done. Don't think about the cost, splurge and just do it. YOLO: you only live once!

review_title: Drop everything when the sun comes out!!
review_text: If you are lucky enough to be near Mt McKinley when the sun comes out go flight seeing on K2.  If it looks like you might have a clear day make the reservation because if they can not fly it is a 100% refund.  Well worth the trip if you select the one that allows a walk on the glacier.

review_title: Peak experience in more ways than one ...
review_text: We took a floatplane trip from Talkeetna to Denali, flying through canyons and past sheer walls on a clear, blue sky day, and landing on a glacial lake in the park. Expensive but so worth it for this once in a lifetime experience. The folks at K-2 are super nice, and the flight is awesome beyond words.

review_title: This trip was highlight of vactaion
review_text: Our pilot Chip, took us near Denali and gave us the choice of landing by base camp or landing on glacier and having it to ourselves.  We chose the latter.  The magnificience of it is undescribable.   Very worth the cost.     Chip was very knowledgable and provided lots of info.   would do it again if I get back there.
Tried for 2 days to do a glacier landing but weather wouldn't,t allow,so we opted out for the 1 hr.tour. The weather really controls your trip. Was well worth the $.

review_title: Sunny Day Flight; once in a Lifetime Experience
review_text: A group of eight of us took the two hour Grand Tour. Thanks to the weather and the wonderful folks at K2, this was one of the most memorable things any of us had ever done. Our pilot Mike was very informative and professional. The trip included a flight around the entire mountain with momentous sights from glaciers to climbing camps to ridge lines zooming by seemingly within touch. We had nothing but great service from K2 from the time we booked last year until we checked in. Very fortunate to have a completely clear day but I am sure these tours are spectacular even with some clouds.

review_title: Stunning Views seeing Mt McKinley from all angles
review_text: We really enjoyed our one and a half hour flight in a bush plane up to and around Mt McKinley.  With five passengers on board, headphones on, we listened to interesting commentary from our pilot and flew over and around spectacular Alaskan scenery of glaciers, river beds, snow capped mountains, base camp, wispy clouds and forests.  We even saw a moose and her calf stirring up mud in a river bed.  We came home with wonderful photos

Months ago we reserved/paid for a McKinley flight for Wednesday this week. However, the weather didn't cooperate. We were offered an opportunity to reschedule or a full refund. We chose to reschedule to today.

 Today the weather around McKinley still wasn't allowing flights, but we were able to go up and fly over some glaciers. Once up, there was a fair amount of choppiness and cloud cover, and Rich our pilot, opted to cut the trip short in the interest of safety and because we really couldn't see anything of major interest. 

 Back on the ground, we were voluntarily offered partial and generous refunds. Great customer service, excellent professional and courteous staff. Thanks to all, including Rich, for a memorable flight nonetheless.

The highlight of my Alaska Vacation was a flight around the Mountain with K2 Aviation. A flight around Mount McKinley  or a landing on one of it's glazier is an unforgettable experience. Go to Talkeetna, stay at the Talkeetna Lodge and  take a flight.
We had a wonderful tour of McKinley and a once in a lifetime experience landing on a glacier. The pilot and staff were helpful and knowledgeable. I would definitely recommend them!!!

We were fortunate to be here during wonderful weather.  Our pilot Randy was just fabulous!  We truly enjoyed out Glacier landing and truly appreciated Randy's knowledge and expertise.  What an absolutely wonder tour.  High recommend it.

review_title: Lived here over 30 years, first flight-seeing trip.
review_text: My husband and I have seen Denali from many angles, but always from a road. We had a particular reason for going up to the mountain as our son was climbing it. Before making the final decision to book the  flight the owner talked with us at length about what we could expect to see. Though somewhat expensive, we were not disappointed. What a spectacular trip!  We took the Climber/Summit tour. Helps to have a blue-bird day and no winds to speak of. I was concerned during the first "circle" around the mountain that I was on the wrong side of the plane, but then the pilot made a U-turn and I could see the climbers' camps and the queue up for Headwall. Comfortable plane, good headsets with informative commentary by the pilot. Because of the altitude we did have oxygen, but no problems.  I would HIGHLY recommend K2 and ANY of their flight-seeing tours.

We took the Alaska railroad to Talkeetna where the k2 van picked us up and took us to the airfield. Beautiful place with a playground for the kids and a grassy area to sit while we waited. Everyone in the office was exceptional. Our pilot was very friendly and talked to us in detail throughout the flight. We flew to Mt McKinley and surrounding areas.  It was breathtaking. I highly recommend K2 aviation.

We did a 2 hour flight with glacier landing, and it was spectacular. The views were amazing, the pilot was friendly and informative, and we felt completely safe at all times. Don't miss this experience! K2 had been highly recommended to us, and they absolutely fulfilled our expectations and delivered a great experience.

review_title: The highlight of our trip to Alaska
review_text: While it was quite an investment to take this flight, it was the highlight of our trip.  We had a beautiful sunny day without a cloud in the sky.  Our experienced pilot, Captain Jeff, told us that having this type of weather was not common, sun and little wind.  His flying experience made the trip comfortable and he showed us so much in the 2 hour flying time.  Seeing Denali from above gives you a unique perspective.

We had a wonderful experience! Patrick was a charming and knowledgeable pilot.  Spectacular views! We were fortunate enough to see an avalanche in progress! The trip overall was outstanding and we had a perfect day for it!
Deserves a place one your Bucket list. Wonderful experience of the Denali up close.  Glacier landing was the Highlight.

review_title: Once in a life time experience!
review_text: Highly recommend K2 Aviation! We had a once in a life time experience soaring over Mount McKinley. This company really cares about customer service!

review_title: Great customer service for a trip to the Ruth Glacier Mountain House
review_text: We booked flights with K2 for a trip to the Ruth Glacier Mountain House for travel during the first week of May 2015. We are from Anchorage, and have a good understanding of Alaska weather. We were scheduled to fly to the glacier on a Thursday morning, but weather prevented K2 from flying us out until the following Saturday morning. Throughout the wait they were extremely communicative, updating us as often as they could on changing weather patterns, and keeping us informed of any possible windows. We spent two nights at the K2 Bunkhouse during our wait--the bunkhouse was clean and the staff was friendly. Being weathered out of the Mountain House was disappointing--for us it was a year in the planning and a high-cost vacation to have cut in half, but the attitude, communication, and courtesy of the K2 staff absolutely exceeded our expectations. And when we finally got up in the air, the flights were great! We would definitely book with them again. Thanks K2!
Exciting flight with great narration by pilot (when not busy flying) about the area, the moutains and glaciers.  Being on the Ruth glacier was awsome!

Wow...what a trip.  The staff was very helpful and courteous when booking.  Weather was up in the air and fortunately it cleared  Our pilot Jeff was great.  He knew EVERYTHING about the mountains, terrain and provided some great history lessons.  Views were spectacular and you felt like you were in a movie.  The plane was surprisingly smooth too.  It is only 2 hours north of Anchorage in the really cool town of Talkeetna.  Great places to eat after.  Don't miss this!!!

We took two K2 flights, one with a glacier landing and one without. View Alaska with a new lens! Take the glacier landing flight. It's spectacular and you will not be disappointed. Talkeetna is a quaint little town between Anchorage and Denali.

review_title: Never thought I would do this.
review_text: We booked this tour knowing there was a possibility we might not be able to fly.  We were some of the lucky few.  Our pilot was wonderful, but I am so sorry I can't remember his name.  There were 7 of us on the flight.  Fantastic views the entire way up & back.  But landing on the glacier was the best thing of our entire trip.  I have traveled the world & this was one of the top 5 things I have done.  Just Do It if you get the chance!

I was fortunate enough to get to visit the great state of Alaska in January 2015. One of the highlights of my vacation was flying up to Mt. McKinley with the people from K2aviation.  The people were warm, friendly, knowledgeable and very accommodating.  Our pilot that day, happens to be one of the mechanics for K2aviation.  Dillon is an excellent pilot and tour guide. While on our tour Dillon was filled with amazing facts and information about Denali National Forest, as well as about the state of Alaska.  His ability to position the plane for fantastic photo shots was extremely impressive. 

If you are thinking of going on a flight over the park, I would highly recommend K2aviation.  You will not be disappointed in their service, professionalism, knowledge, and the spectacular views that can only be seen via plane.

My wife and I took the "Grand Tour with glacier landing (Green Tour)" with K2 in mid-June 2014.  Everything about the trip was first rate.  The planes are in great condition, the staff was superb, the pilots are polite, friendly, and safety conscious, and the tour that they give is second to none.  Every aspect of the trip was outstanding.  Of the many things that we did during our walking tour of Alaska, this was the "Not to be Missed", absolutely best experience.  Well worth the money, as you will probably never have an experience like this the rest of your life (unless you climb mountains).

We took an old de Havilland Canada DHC-3 Otter that held around 8 passengers. Landing on a glacier was the highlight of our 16 day trip. The takeoff and landing on the glacier was a real experience. They land going uphill and takeoff going downhill.
The pilot was excellent. The plane was completely refurbished and had a new powerful motor.

Missed our evening flight time. Very gracious to get us out the next morning. Excellent pilot. Aircraft in great condition. Smooth operation. Glacial landing and views of the mountain are indescribable.   This flight cost us more than our flight to Alaska from Minnesota.........would do it again tomorrow!     Do not pass this up.   Once in a lifetime.

A dear friend shared an Alaska experience with me.  The highlight of our trip was our flight over the Mt. McKinley range. It was a rainy day when we booked the flight, the staff reassured us we would not be committed to the fee if it rained the next day.  As it turned out, we had a gorgeous day for our ride, seeing the mountains from above made them even more magnificent.  Our stop on the glacier was so much fun.  How can you not believe there is a God after seeing those glorious mountains. Thank you Dave for a memorable flight.  

Rose S

We had one day after a long business trip to Anchorage to get out and see more of Alaska.  I asked some local people for recommendations for what to do with our one day.  Several said to hope for a clear day and try and see Denali.  We were so fortunate.  We found a brochure for K2 aviation at the Visitor's Center.  The folks we spoke to were so helpful and got us booked on a flightseeing tour that would allow us to make our flights home that night.  Everything about K2 Aviation was professional and amazing.  The women who checked us in were friendly and helpful.  The folks on the phone even told us to buy sunglasses, which was essential in having a good trip.  Our pilot was friendly, professional and informative.  But all of that pales in comparison to the absolutely amazing views.  There are not enough words to describe the beauty of the landscape.  I truly was astounded at what we were seeing and how close I felt to the amazing mountains.  October is definitely off season for touring Alaska.  So we were the only plane in the sky.  This was a once in a lifetime opportunity, I am so glad I had!

Muy profesionales y te dan seguridad en todo el proceso. Es importante saber que el aterrizaje en el glaciar dependerá del clima (y en promedio es bastante malo), pero aún así no puedan aterrizar las vistas de los glaciares y del Monte McKinley son impresionantes!

Took one and a half hour flight to Mount McKinley and Glaciers early September. Highly recommend. Randy our pilot was excellent enhancing our experience with expert commentary. Office staff looked after our baggage and also drove us to the station at the end of the flight. Would do this again if in Alaska.

review_title: Once in a lifetime experience….Mt McKinley!
review_text: What an amazing ride!  We had booked our flight for a Saturday afternoon, however the weather was not at its  best so our flight was cancelled for that day.  We were a little disappointed and worried that we may not be able to fly.  We were booked again for Sunday morning and to our surprise it was the most gorgeous day ever!  That was what all the locals said.  It was cool and not a single cloud in the sky.  Our pilot Mike was very nice and talked to us throughout the whole trip and also answered  all our questions.  The flight was truly wonderful and to come so close to Mt McKinley was truly a once in a lifetime experience.  We highly recommend K2 Aviation because they are professionals and if your trip gets cancelled due to weather they will return your money.

My wife and I did a flight with K2 kind of on a whim.  We had planned to do lots of hiking in Denali, and along the Kesugi ridge in Denali State Park.  But 2 weeks before our visit I broke my leg -- so the hiking option was gone.  The morning we arrived in Talkeetna, the weather was nice, so we decided to try a sightseeing flight.  We did the short "McKinley Experience" flight, because I was concerned about the cost (and I am a pilot, so I've seen lots of mountains from the air).  The only option available for us on short notice that day was one with the glacier landing.  That turned out to be the BEST part of the entire flightseeing experience -- even though I probably would not otherwise had paid the extra cost.  In hindsight, we are really glad we did the glacier landing because it turned what would have been a nice tour into a great experience.  Even though I have a couple thousand hours of flight time as a pilot, the glacier landing and takeoff were a unique experience and well worth the expense.  So my personal advice would be that if you are trying to decide between a longer, more expensive flight -- or a shorter flight with a glacier landing, definitely choose the glacier landing!

We want to express our appreciation to Chip Sonn, our K2 pilot for our fantastic late afternoon/evening flight excursion while recently visiting Talkeetna, Alaska.  As part of our planned Land/Cruise tour, we did not want to miss this opportunity – and glad that we took the extra effort to reschedule through the cruise planning offices to get all 5 of us to be able to attend as a family together on this flight.  We flew across a varied array of physiographic regions in and around Denali Park while Chip extolled about a combination of historical/geological/topographical/mountain climbing/gold mining aspects related to this diverse region of Alaska.  Climbing in altitude up through the sinuous glacial flows between spired peaks for repeated glimpses of the great mountain – Denali was truly awe inspiring.  How many pictures is enough?  However, in all honesty, landing on the glacier with our wonderful pilot was truly the greatest event to remember as a family from our land/cruise tour from all of Alaska.  Standing together as a family in the quiet Pika Glacier valley with great spires around us and peacefully reflecting on family and life was truly one of those “Picture Perfect Moments” that we will treasure forever.  We all agreed during our ride back to the hotel, that this adventure would likely become our best family activity together for the entire 12 days of land and sea excursions – and now having completed our trip and returned home, we can confirm that this flight and landing on the glacier was indeed our best activity as a family together in Alaska.  The K2 planes are safely maintained and their staff and pilots are the greatest.  We had great peace of mind and felt very secure flying with Chip and the K2 family.  Thanks again for Chip’s time and talent for the great evening of flight together – one we will not forget!

review_title: Amazing and the highlight of our trip
review_text:
The K2 flight with glacier landing was the highlight of our Alaska visit.  We did it on our first day and if I would have gone home after the first day it would have been worth it!!!!  Jeff Babcock was our pilot and has 35 years experience.  He was so fun and nice and gave us great information.  I was fearful of flying into the mountains and landing but didn't want to miss the experience.  The entire staff was so professional and I felt very safe. We saw things you can only see by the plane and it was nothing short of amazing.  Everyone rushed to the front seats of the plane and my mom and I took the back two seats.  Those are the best seats and you have a lot of leg room :)  We got great pictures and had an amazing view.
This is a must do even if you have to take something else out.  I'm so looking forward to going again as soon as I can!!!!!

We are so grateful that we took our friends' recommendation to fly with K2 Aviation. The air tour truly was the highlight of our Alaskan vacation. A family business with decades of experience, K2 offers breathtaking views of snow-covered mountains and glaciers, narrated by knowledgeable pilots on various sizes of aircraft. We were on a 10-seater that flew around three mountains, including Mt. McKinley, and landed on a glacier where we got out and walked around  Absolutely majestic! So much fun! My apprehension about flying up there in a small plane quickly subsided as I was overtaken by the beauty and thrills. Dealing directly with K2 is cheaper than booking glacier flights through cruise and tour companies.

review_title: Exciting way to see a part of Alaska
review_text:
K2 Aviation provided our group of four with an awesome experience when in Alaska.  My husband is a private pilot and he was incredibly impressed with this outfit and with the experience.  For him to say this was the best flight experience he has EVER had, is saying something.

Our pilot was awesome - we saw great views of Denali (Mt. Everest), area glaciers and moose and bear in their natural habitat.  

It was absolutely breathtaking and so worth the money to create memories to last a lifetime.

We were lucky and got our plain ride. We heart that the majority of the trips are cancelled due to clouds and winds. Booked through travel agancy, had private transportation, so cant say anything about their own pick up service. We sat further back in the plain and made good pictures, u dont NEEEED to sit in the front.
This was the high light of our Alaska vacation.  It was breath taking from takeoff to landing.  We had a bright clear day for flying and it was a blast.  Do this if you don't do anything else !!!

We were hesitant to book the glacier landing because of cost and generally limited weather related opportunity to see Mt McKinley. The day we went was cloudy and McKinley was not viewable. This was a great trip nonetheless and photos are fantastic.

review_title: Mt McKinley Flight with glacier landing is worth it!!
review_text: A perfect day, flight and experience!!! Once in a lifetime!! Chris was our pilot and did a great job of getting us ready but nothing could prepare us for the landing or sight from the glacier. It is not cheap but how can you put a price on perfect?!

Through misinterpretation on their website, I screwed up our reservation and had booked us for a non-glacier landing although we wanted to do that on our flight.  When I told them what had happened, they managed to squeeze us on a glacier landing flight even though they were jam-packed that day since it was so clear and such wonderful weather.  Our pilot was fantastic, and the glacier landing is one of the coolest things I've done--being out in an almost inaccessible place, surrounded by mountains and snow.  The price tag can be a shocker but I'd say it was worth it!
Unfortunately due to weather, our original plans to see Mt. McKinley were cut short.  Good flight, very smooth takeoff / landing.

user_location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
review_text:
K2 gave us an absolutely fantastic tour of Mt. McKinley and the surrounding area.  I was very nervous - but the flight was smooth as glass and our pilot Chip did a great job!  Experience and photos - PRICELESS!

Plus, they picked us up at the hotel and everyone had a great attitude!
We went on the Ultimate Denali hike.  We flew out on a float plane, landed on Moraine lake and hiked up into the tundra!  Beautiful! and then we were served wine and cheese.

Our 9am trip was cancelled by K2, but they forgot to tell us. So we waited and waited for puck up no one came. So we called and then we were told the flight was cancelled due to weather. If the day is questionable or if K2 has cancelled flights due to rain and a refund is offered to you - take it.  I didn't and all I got was 40 minutes of pure nothing. The plane ride is supposed to be 60 minutes we got 40 minutes cuz of poor visibility. There was no refund for not seeing anything or cutting the time short.  The pilot showed us 3 gold mining camps for 420.00 for the 2 of us. That is money I will never get back and wasted time.  I could have gone back to the room or even had breakfast or zip lined. Do not make the same mistake.

review_title: On a blue bird day, there is nothing better than this flightsee!
review_text:
Over Labor Day weekend, we awoke to a blue bird day and decided to make the 2 hour drive to Talkeetna from Anchorage.  After perusing the K2 website, we chose the Denali/ McKinley tour with a glacier landing.  
Although the right side of the mountain began to form clouds by the time we departed, the left side was wide open and that's the route our experienced pilot flew.  We were treated to stunning views of Mtn McKinley's peak, as we all Forakers and Hunters.  THEN, we landed on Pika Glacier, which was OUT OF THIS WORLD!
The trip isn't cheap, but if it's in your budget AT ALL, then do it! You won't regret it!

On our recent trip to Alaska, we decided on K2 Aviation for our flightseeing of Mt. McKinley. We splurged and also included the glacier landing. It was a beautiful flight - seeing the untouched landscape from the sky was truly beautiful. We went on a semi-cloudy day and still had fabulous views. The glacier landing was cool, but not something that I feel is required. There were several other planes that landed on the same glacier (Ruth Glacier), and I would have preferred to feel like we were more in the middle of nowhere. I would definitely recommend this company. They are professional and will make sure you get to see everything that you can during your flight. My only recommendation would be that they have an age limit for passengers. We had a 3-4 year old on the flight who I got stuck sitting in front of and he cried most of the trip. Even with the headpiece, I could still hear him and it affected my experience negatively. Otherwise, everything was great.

We booked this on our own (not through cruise) with 2 other couples.  Rented a car from Anchorage and drove to Talkeetna which is a cute little village with a great brew-pub for lunch or dinner after your flight.
The flight was wonderful with great views of the mountains all around, including a view of McKinley above the cloud line.  Loved landing on the Glacier and walking around.  Our pilot was fantastic.
Much less expensive to book this yourselves than through cruise land tour from Denali.
Expensive, but well worth the money!

My sister and I took the flight seeing tour over Denali. My sister has some mobility issues and they were great about helping her. Our pilot/guide "Rick" was amazing.  The scenery was breathtaking.  I have been to Alaska more than 20 times and finally decided to take this tour.  I wish I had done it many years ago.  It is definitely worth the money!  I plan to do it again.  I'll be recommending this to my clients that visit Alaska!

What an adventure!   Our captain was Rick Anderson who we highly recommend.   He is such a professional pilot and sooooo knowledgeable of Denali and its surroundings.   We were there in early June and took off around 5pm.   Weather was clear and sunny with temps in the low 60's.   We were in a fixed wing plane that seated 8 people easily.   Capt Rick talked about Denali, provided interesting facts and figures along with the history of the area.   We joined our cruise in Seward, but consider this trip the highlight of our Alaska trip.   It was so worth the time and money.   My husband and I highly recommend K2 Aviation and Captain Rick Anderson.    Very safety oriented company too.   You will not be disappointed.

review_title: Best way to experience the vastness of Denali
review_text: The views were magnificent. The K2 staff was friendly and efficient. They were highly accommodating when the wether went bad. Our operator- Rich- was friendly and professional. He made this scared flier feel at ease during the entire trip.

So disappointing.  I reserved the flight far ahead and was so excited but to spend that much money only see the inside of a small plane was heartbreaking.  There were only 4 people on the flight in addition to the pilot so seat assignments were limited.  I'm 5'11 and my husband is 6'1 and so the windows were located below and behind our seats.  We could look down and back with a limited ability to try and lean down to see due to the seat belts.  The pilot did a fabulous job of explaining what we COULDN'T see.  The person in the front and his wife behind had a great view and I know with the small planes safety is most important consideration, but my once in a lifetime trip was a big let down.  I emailed the company....no response.  UPDATE - the owner did contact me!!!! Very gracious and anxious to resolve.  SO!!!!  Please speak up if you have a concern BEFORE your flight!!!  They are more than happy to please.  Thank YOU!!!

Two couples were on a Princess cruise/land trip. One member if the group wanted to take a flight that included landing on a glacier near Denali. The rest of us hesitatingly acquiesced. What a fabulous experience!! The scenery was on a par with the south rim if the Grand Canyon, hiking in the Austrian Alps or seeing the Taj Mahal. It's expensive, but worth every penny!!

review_title: They give you up close views of majestic Denali--it will take your breath away!
review_text:
We were blessed with great weather for our 90 min. FlightSeeing Tour with K2 Aviation. Our pilot, Jeff Babcock took us up in a Cessna 185. He was very knowledgable and experienced. We saw Denali in the best way possible-- from the air! 
Capt. Jeff invited me to be his co-pilot and sit up front with him after I sheepishly mentioned that I'm prone to motion sickness. I did have some candied ginger bought the night before from the Talkeetna store, but I didn't really need any help with that. I was too excited about what we were privileged to see! We took alot of photos and movie footage, but we're not professionals so our pictures couldn't do justice to the magnificent vistas. After our flight, we were happy to find the perfect memory book for sale back in the K2 giftshop-- "Mount McKinley-- a K2 adventure"... which was authored & photographed by our amazing pilot, Jeff!

Do not leave Alaska without going on a flightseeing tour with K2 Aviation!  We did a 7 day Alaskan Cruise followed by 4 additional days driving around Alaska and this was the highlight of our trip.  The McKinley Flyer with glacier landing was definitely a great choice, we got to see the famous mountains and walk in knee-deep snow on the glacier.  I am usually afraid of heights and didn’t have any problems or issues on this extremely smooth flight.  Our pilot narrated our entire flight so we knew where we were and what we were looking at.  Make sure to take lots of pictures and walk in the tracks of the plane’s skis if you don’t want to sink into the snow!

If you had one day in Alaska and had to pick one thing to do, flying with K2 Aviation to Denali National Park for a 3 hour hike (guided by Alaska Alpine Adventures) surrounded by glaciers would fit the bill very nicely. 

Upon early arrival at the K2 Aviation office we were greeted with smiles, filled out a simple form, "weighed in", and relaxed on their sunny deck. The facility and grounds were very nice; clean and well kept. A short time later we boarded a van that took us to the float plane dock a few miles away. The driver was pleasant and made sure we were comfortable. Once there we took a few pictures of the surrounding beauty while passengers deplaned and the aircraft was being topped off with fuel. Our pilot Jeff then introduced himself to us, gave us an easy to understand pre-flight safety briefing and made us feel very safe and welcome. 

We boarded the aircraft and were airborne in short order. Lift off from the water was imperceptible. I know many factors can contribute to the way an airplane performs in flight, weather, aircraft design, pilot's skills, etc. The de Havilland Beaver was solid and smooth flying. What a great comfortable ride from a great Alaskan bush plane classic. The views were nothing short of phenomenal. This is what those Alaskan nature shows dream of capturing on film. Nothing beats the experience of seeing Alaska from the air with your own two eyes. Our richly experienced and confident pilot kept us engaged by pointing out interesting geography and landmarks. The views of colossal glaciers and majestic Denali (Mt. McKinley) were magnificently surreal. Take plenty of memory for your digital cameras. 

We landed on Moraine Lake and touchdown was equally imperceptible. Our hiking guide Elliot greeted us, stored our day bag and gave us trekking poles to begin our three hour hike. He even stuffed our water bottles and our sweaters into his back pack so that our hands could be free to enjoy the hike and take pictures. Elliott was very knowledgeable about the terrain and surrounding beauty of the mountains. It's great to be educated while having fun. His pace matched our abilities and desires. Elliot delivered an enthusiastic and fun adventure.

Upon return to base camp, Elliot set out some chairs for my wife and I and we relaxing at water's edge while he catered crackers, cheese, smoked salmon, and red wine! We had pleasant conversations amid one of the most beautiful and secluded sub-arctic locations known to mankind.
