We were a bit saddened to leave so soon as the sound of Jeff's plane returned to fly us back to Talkeetna. The flight back was just as breathtaking. Once again we saw incredible glacier features, moose, and a some of the same sights as before but from a different angle...equally impressive.

A huge thanks to all involved in making our tour, safe, enjoyable, and the unforgettable highlight of our summer!

AK residents: get out and enjoy our state with K2 Aviation, (ask for pilot Jeff), and Alaska Alpine Adventures...don't let the tourists have all the fun!

If you want to see sights that only mountain climbers see and experience standing on a glacier on a mountain, this tour is the way to go! The pilot was very friendly and informative. We payed for the Denali Grand Tour, but the weather was not cooperating (they can't control that no matter how much you pay!) so they modified our flight and gave us a refund at the end. We flew over many stunning glaciers and landed on Ruth glacier, offering gorgeous views and the unique experience of standing on a glacier! They provide boots that slip on over your shoes, too, so you don't have to worry about bringing the right shoes for snow. The pilot pointed out and named the glaciers and peaks for us, too. Although Denali was mostly hidden in clouds (per usual), the pilot made attempts to find a view of the summit until we were finally able to get a glimpse. Wonderful experience, gorgeous views, interesting information, well worth the cost!!

We debated spending essentially the same amount as our tickets to AK, but decided to take the plunge.  And, man, was it worth it.   Unfortunately the loop around Denali was socked in but we landed on the glacier, took a couple of nicely-banked turns to see the glaciers and mountains.  The big Otter plan was really stable.   I was fortunate enough to volunteer first to ride as copilot on the way out, so had a great view / experience.   Wife and teenage daughter are still talking about this as their favorite part of our trip.  K2 flight folks we great.

I was lucky enough to go up on a crystal clear evening and the pilot took full advantage of that. Our pilot was really friendly and chatty and made us feel very comfortable. The view was spectacular and was well worth the money. The flight went over the hour as the he was trying to show us as much as possible and was able to provide us with commentary and interesting facts about the area. To be that close to the top of Mount McKinley is something I will never forget. Well worth the money for that experience.
This August we did a glacier landing with K2 Aviation pilot Jeff Babock. Once he started playing "North to Alaska" by Johnny Horton on his mini iPad I knew we had the right pilot. Awesome flight!

The pilot was not very friendly and discouraged us from talking for safety reasons but it also discouraged us from asking questions. The little he said was a  bit confusing so we were not sure what we were looking at except for the person sitting in the co-pilot seat who had a wonderful view. We had a very clear view of Denali when the plane did a sweep but as you fly straight on for most of the time you don't see much from a side window. We wanted to land on a glacier but they said it was not clear enough, we were discounted for not landing on the glacier so they are fair and clear on cost. The front desk people were very polite and helpful. So in summary the seat position is key. Closer to the front the better view. I actually thought that the panoramic view from the Talkeetna lodge was 10 times better, and I didn't have to stare through a pokey little window at an angle to see it. As the pilot didnt interact and droned like the engines two of the kids actually fell asleep. We have photos to proove it. Our friends had a friendlier pilot on a different plane and enjoyed the trip more. So make that a requirement is my advice.

Patrick, our pilot took us a flight over the flat marsh land and up to see spectacular up close views of many, many glaciers. The fact that it was cloudy and we could not see the top of Mt. McKinley did no spoil the trip. However, Patrick, one of many pilots of K2aviation, thrilled everyone with his trip up and down glaciers. He provided us with information about glaciers and the Denali region. I highly recommend K2aviation to anyone who enjoys seeing and knowing more about Alaska and in particular the Denali Park region.
 Gary Clarke

Great trip with a very professional pilot. Flew very close to walls surrounding glaciers and made a perfect landing on Ruth Glacier.  Couldn't stay long as the ceiling was dropping, but flew the length of the glacier on way out.  Would highly recommend.

review_title: Super Duper Once in a Lifetime Experience!
review_text: After several days of rain, we were driving into Talkeetna to take the Hurricane Turn train, but as we topped the hill leading down into town, we were stunned to see clear skies over the mountain range, with clouds moving in but not there yet.  We detoured to K2 to see when the next "round the mountain" flight was leaving, and it was in just 30 minutes, and they had room for us, so we signed up immediately.  We left about 20 minutes late, but still managed to beat the clouds.  Our pilot (Robert?) did a great job, taking us on several tracks that I don't think were usually done, just so we could make the most of the north side where the clouds hadn't reached.  It was fantastic to see the cloud cover move in, so gorgeous!  The trip lasted much longer than I thought it would, went around many more peaks than I expected, got closer to the Wickersham wall, to the point where it almost seemed like you could reach out and touch it, saw so many glaciers I stopped counting, absolutely fantastic!  Worth every penny!

If you are able to, book a flight see trip. We took off from Fish Lake in a Beaver float plane, and our captain Stan, flew us up to and through Backside Glacier. It was beautiful and exhilarating. We landed on a glacier lake and then hiked for about an hour before returning to Fish Lake in Talkeetna. This was the highlight of our trip
Whether you are an Alaska resident or visitor, this is an awesome experience! It is worth the money!

review_title: Best thing we did in Alaska!
review_text:
We were driving to Denali on a beautiful day and took the opportunity to do a flightseeing tour of McKinley from Talkeetna.  We simply stopped in town and found our way to K2 who could accommodate our last minute interest in taking the full McKinley tour (special thank you and shout out for Talkeetna Air Taxi who was already fully booked but checked with K2 for us).  

Our pilot was excellent and provided great commentary about the mountain and the area.  Flight was smooth and simply beautiful among clear skies and clear views around McKinley.  It was the highlight of our 2 week trip in Alaska.

The flight around Denali Park and the landing on the Ruth Glacier were a once in a lifetime experience. The scenery was indescribable.  Our pilot and guide was very professional and really added to the experience.  At the beginning I thought this was a lot to pay for a 2 hour airplane ride but at the conclusion the money spent was very well worth it.  It was a once in a lifetime experience

We took the 1 1/2 hr trip around Denali and it was breathtaking! So worth the money!!!
Only advice is to make sure your camera or phone is charged 100% because you will take tons of pics. K2 is the way to go!

What an incredible experience!  The team at K2 were wonderful.  They told us when checking in that the weather is unpredictable and views of the summit could not be guaranteed.  Well, luck and the weather were in our favor.  As we approached Denali, the skies were crystal clear.  To see this magnificent mountain against an incredible blue sky was an image we will not forget.  So worth the money.  Tip:  the flights to see Denali from Talkeetna are far less then taking the flight from Denali National Park.

review_title: Amazing experience, even for our third time
review_text:
K2 Aviation has the most amazing tour in all of Alaska in my opinion. We were on our third trip to Alaska from the mainland and have always flown K2. (2011,2012 and 2014). We made our reservations in advance (as we were coming from Seattle), but the weather is always a factor. The office staff @ K2 and the pilots are always great to keep us posted on how the weather is like and set the right expectations on what we could see, so that we are not disappointed.

Once you fly over McKinley and other peaks in Denali national park, words cannot describe the awesome scenery you would pass by. Again, the pilots always make sure that they you get the best view! We had a headset system, where we could hear the pilot talk and also to talk amongst ourselves. My wife and I flew in 2011, with her parents in 2012 and with my parents in 2014. We would always keep coming back to K2 aviation!

I am eagerly waiting for my next adventure with K2!

We took a flight tour of Denali with glacier landing on a recent trip to Talkeetna.  The excursion with our pilot Chris was excellent.  We enjoyed the glacier landing and superb flight to Denali.  The crew was professional and I felt very safe on the excursion.

review_title: Finally gor to see Mt. McKinley!!
review_text: This was my second time flying with K2 Aviantion. Both flights were amazing and totally different experiences. Our trip this year we finally got to see Mt. McKinley and it was breathtaking! Saw a ton of glaciers, some moose, mountians everywhere and a knowledgable pilot! Over all I highly recommend K2 Aviation and look forward to flying with them again on a return visit to Alaksa!

If your main goal is to see Denali from the air and do a glacier landing your experience will be dependent on the weather, which for Denali is very hit and miss.  Our pilot estimated only 30 percent of pre-booked passengers get to do it. My advice is to make sure it will be clear around the mountain and book on site at K-2 the day of your flight. We had booked the glacier landing months in advance but on the day of our flight Denali was clouded in. We decided to go up anyway when they told us there was still a chance to do the glacier landing, but my gut told me they already knew before the flight that it wasn't going to happen.  They refunded the difference, of course, but the experience was nothing like we expected and had read about.  If your schedule is flexible, don't book until the day of the flight! That said, K-2 is an efficient, organized, first-rate organization that I would fly with again given a clear day.

Talkeetna airfield is situated on the right hand side of the road, just before you enter town. As there is only one way into town, you have to pass it. It is a base for a number of operators offering flight sightseeing tours of Mt McKinley and the area. All the operators offer similar packages and prices for the various trips.

We chose K2 Aviation, having flown with Rusts Flying Services in Anchorage on a bear watching trip. K2 is a sister company to Rusts.

In high season it is probably best to book in advance to avoid disappointment. Though this has to be weighed up with the possibility of the weather not being too good.

We arrived at about 4PM on a Sunday and booked for a 7PM departure that evening. We opted for the 90 minute flight and glacier landing. We were not disappointed.

One of the attractions of K2 and some of the other operators are in the type of aircraft they use on the flights. A good number are on De Havilland DHc2 Beavers and DHc3 Otters. Some of these aircraft are around 50 years old and the type is still very common for bush flying in Alaska. This bit of aviation history often goes unnoticed by passengers and is something that should be a selling point. The operators don’t seem to make a big thing of it. (Or maybe passengers will be put off by the age?)

Our flight was on a six seater DHc2 Beaver N121KT, built in 1958. One passenger usually gets to sit up at the front with the pilot. A good safety demo was given prior to boarding. It was also pointed out to us that the aircraft carried overnight supplies etc, in the extreme case the weather turned and we couldn’t return!

The flight was excellent. Real close up views of the glacier, mountains etc. Stunning scenery. All passengers get a window seat.  On the Beaver, the rear seats are better than the middle as you don’t have a wing strut in front of you. The view from the middle is still excellent, but photos may get the odd strut in them. After landing you are allowed off the aircraft, as long as you keep nearby. The peace and tranquillity is only shattered for a moment when another aircraft lands or takes off. The evening we went it was a clear blue sky – perfect We had around 25 mins on the snow, watching a couple of other flights land and take off (tip – don’t stand downwind of one when it takes off, unless you want to experience a blizzard!)

The return flight is quicker and comes straight back to the airfield, as most of the sightseeing is done on the way up.

If you get the right weather, this trip will be one of the highlights, if not the highlight of your stay.

Dan our pilot made the flight enjoyable. Rather costly but I will say that after seeing Mt. McKinley and the mountain range it was worth it. The entire family is telling everyone that this was one of their memorable moments in Alaska. 

The weather conditions change regularly we were fortunate to have clear skies so we were privileged to yes the entire Mt. McKinley and the surrounding mountain range. 

K2 Aviation did a nice job at providing a clean and safe environment for everyone. The funny thing about it, unlike other attractions that once done no need to do again, that isn't the case here. Our next trip to Alaska will include another flight/glacier landing with K2 Aviation.

Hard to advise the best time of day, most important is the weather.

My wife and I took the glacier landing tour with my brother and his wife.  We flew in the workhorse of the Alaskan bush - De Haviland Beaver.   There were a total of 5 passengers and the pilot.  The flight was very comfortable and smooth.  Our pilot did an outstanding job of narrating our fight and giving all on board an angle to see the views.  It is so hard to describe flying through glacial valleys with walls and mountains above you.  At times it seems you can almost reach and touch the mountains.   We were very fortunate to have great weather on our flight.   We were able see Mt McKinley almost all the time.  We did do the Glacier landing and what an experience.   I will never forget this experience.  The personnel at K-2 were absolutely awesome in making this such a great experience.   One other thing, I was using more tham one camera and my cell phone to take pictures and I left my cell phone on the plane.   We were back early the next morning to eat breakfast in Talkeetna at the Talkeetna Roadhouse (did a review on it also.   Great experience also) and our pilot from the previous evening had just found the phone on the plane.  Great job!!!!  This is a must do in Alaska!!!!  The people at K-2 are the best!!!!  Highly recommend them!!!#

bove

review_title: Worth the money!  No disappointments here!
review_text: As with everything, the view by air provides a totally different perspective. We were hesitant to book a flight, but soon realized that it was worth it. If we would have left the area without taking this adventure, it would be our biggest regret. Chip was our pilot and was very informative about the area and the Alaskan way of life.  During our glacier landing, he opted for an alternate landing site.  With only one additional plane at this site, it gave our time on the glacier a more solitaire and special experience.  Please, if there is any question about this experience, go ahead and book a flight. You won't be disappointed.

It has always been my dream to take a flight seeing tour with a glacier landing and man-oh-man did K2 deliver!  We had a gorgeous clear day to see Mt McKinley in all its glory.  K2 is a top notch company.  Tour left on time, pilot was great- smooth sailing and smooth landings as well.  My sister was a little bit apprehensive about the flight in such a small plane but she was pleasantly surprised that it was not an issue at all.  Can't wait to go back and have this experience again.

review_title: The most knowledgeable & professional flight. Great value.
review_text: Our pilot ,Jeff Babcock made this flight unforgettable. His knowledge of every single landmark on the entire hour long flight added immeasurably to the already incredible views. His flight experience shown in the handling of the aircraft. We were captivated by the sight of mountain climbers at every point of their ascent. We circled the perimeter of Mt McKinley, viewing the in Denali park side; Wickersham wall,  Moose Meadows, numerous glaciers; lakes,rivers and outsounding views of the Alaska Range. If on a cruise-tour and only making one flight seeing adventure...this should be the one!

We took a flight seeing excursion with K2 as part of a tour so all the arrangements were made for us except for the weather, of course.  Poor weather conditions around Denali made it impossible for us to see "the great one" but K2 came up with a flight plan that included extensive aerial views of the fascinating forest growth patterns interspersed with glacial river routes, moose, bear and homestead habitat, and we still got to see amazing glaciers in the Alaska range.  It was a smooth flight from start to finish and our pilot, Chip, was very knowledgeable about the flora, fauna, glaciers and the importance of aviation in Alaska history.  If we ever have the chance and the weather is right, we'll be flying with K2 to see Denali someday.

Great experience with K2. Unfortunately we didn't see the mountain or get to have the glacier landing due to weather but that didn't ruin the trip at all. The pilot showed us a lot of areas which included a lot of bear and caribou sightings. Felt safe the entire time - great takeoff and landing. They even gave us a partial refund after the trip due to the weather.

Not only was the flight one of the most amazing experiences I've had, but the customer service was fantastic. I had called on the day I wanted to fly asking about availability. I was told there was space on the 2:30 pm 1 hour flight and I should just come in. I wasn't asked for a credit card. When I arrived I was told that the flight I wanted was full, that they didn't hold the spot because I didn't make a reservation. I explained that I wasn't told to and that I was told to just come in. They were able to accommodate me in the end, giving me a better flight for not much more $$. I was thrilled! Great company! I highly recommend them.

On the 6 of july  we made  our flight above the mountain and glaciers of the Daneli NP.
Our pilot  Patrick Dugan (k2 aviation )  was very proffesional  and show us different viewpoint  of the  stunning landscape., it was awesome /.

review_title: The Most Amazing View of Spaceship Earth
review_text:
Do not debate whether or not you should fork over $250-$300 for the McKinley flier. Just do it! This is a once-in-a-lifetime experience that you will never forget. It will move you emotionally and remind you how amazing this planet is. It sounds expensive...until you do it, and then it seems like a bargain.

If I were to do this again I would most definitely include the glacier landing. We could see planes on one of the glaciers and it looked amazing. We rode in a da Havilland Otter, retrofitted with a turbine engine. Super smooth flight, easy takeoff and landing.

review_title: SO VERY GLAD we did this. Here is a secret to save money too!
review_text: K2 was very professional, friendly organized. This was the highlight of our trip.  We would not have seen Denali if we had not taken this flight. The mountain from the ground was clouded in but once in the air we punched through the clouds and the angles started singing...it was crystal clear! Rick our pilot was very interesting and narrated as we flew along. He was a friend by the time we landed. We traveled with my elderly parents and they did not feel that they could afford the flight so we told them "Merry Christmas" and they climbed on board.  Of course we had this planned six months ahead. My mother was in tears when we got in the car and started talking about all that we saw. We saved enough money for the flight by simply purchasing a foam cooler at the Walmart in Anchorage and filled it with sandwich food for the next four days along with cereal and milk for breakfast. Find God in the big and small. Don't miss this opportunity.

review_title: K2 Denali Flightseeing Tour is definitely worthwhile
review_text: Even on a cloudy day that kept us from circumnavigating Denali, the flight was really great.  After taking in spectacular mountain and glacier tours, we landed on the Pika Glacier.   This was a great part of our Alaska vacation -- we would definitely repeat this tour.

Since Denali is only visible 30% of the time by local reports, you must must go on a clear day.
The staff was very helpful.  I was surprised how gentle the take off was and landing on the glacier was so soft.  The guide was outstanding in his knowledge of the mountain and the area. Everyone told us this was a must do while in Alaska and I would have to agree.

review_title: Turned a bad day into a terrific day
review_text: Our trip was scheduled to fly to Mt McKinley and to land on a glacier but weather would not permit it.  The staff at K2 was excellent in arranging an alternate flight at a reduced rate. Their service and hospitality was terrific. I hope to come back some day and fly with them again.

I was so impressed with these folks.  We were planning to go on a trip with them to Denali, but when all was said and done, we weren't able to go.  They worked with me and it ended up a really great experience - and we didn't even fly with them.
We just took a chance on a day we could see Denali..it worked out for us. A hint of occasional cloud and a sunny clear day made this a memorable experience. It was breath taking. Fun...fun..fun

K2 staff very helpful and relaxed...... The views were spectacular. Nova was especially helpful in getting us scheduled at the gift shop, where we got a 10% discount ! Not sure we would have gone  up if she hadn't talked with us about the flights. Fabulous experience.

review_title: A highlight of the trip, must-do
review_text: We had a great experience on our plane.  We were really nervous, because the day was very cloudy and overcast, and at K2 they allow you to cancel if you don't like the weather.  It is such an expensive trip and so we didn't want to pay that much to see nothing.  However, it was our last day in Talkeetna, so we decided to do it anyway.  We were so glad we did.  We didn't see much for the 30 minute ride to the mountains, but as soon as we came to the mountains, it was breathtaking.  We saw Denali, although not super clearly, but the other peaks were all in sight.  It was amazing and vertigo-inducing.  Definitely worth a trip out there.  We got great pictures!

We were a family of 12 traveling in Alaska (ages 10 to 65) and went up in 2 different planes meeting on the glacier for photos and a snowball fight.  What an incredible experience for all of us and I can't say enough about how beautiful it was up there!  It was absolutely breathtaking and we were so happy we saved our flight seeing for Talkeetna instead of doing it on the cruise at any our ports.  Just do it!

review_title: In the top 10 best things we have ever done!
review_text: My wife and I regretted not taking a flight seeing tour of Denali when we were in the area in 2007.  After doing our research we decided on K2 Aviation.  We were not disappointed.  We almost didn't book because of the cloud cover that morning.  After talking to them they told us about what was the situation and that they thought there would be some good viewing.  The plane was a 10 seat Piper Navajo.  The pilot provided a very smooth flight and provided great viewing angles and detailed descriptions.  Other than making the climb of the mountain K2 provided the best Denali experience ever. One can not appreciate the vastness of the mountains and glaciers without viewing it all from the air.  We will talk about this for years to come!  Thank you K2 for an awesome experience.

This was one of the biggest highlights of our trip to Alaska.  We flew up the mountain with pilot Mike.  He spoke of what we were seeing on the way up and down.  Being able to land on a glacier is a must do.  The staff at K2 is friendly and informative.  Would definitely do this again next time.

First of all, I have a huge fear of flying so this was not something I was excited about. However, as I did not plan the trip, I was forced to go. 
O M G, it was so amazing. One of the best experiences of my life. If you have a fear of flying I suggest sitting up front with the pilot as I did. It helped me relax and was also the best seat for photos. Our pilot (Chip?) was so great. He was polite, calm and very knowledgeable.

We took our trip with them and did the McKinley Grand Tour with glacier landing on Ruth Glacier.  This was the highlight of our 2 week trip.  The pilot was safe, friendly, and knowledgeable.  It was a clear day and each person had a window seat to view the beauty outside.  Highly recommend paying a little extra to do the grand tour.

This tour was wonderful. Every seat on the plane was good, and while I had brief moments of fear, that subsided quickly thanks to the great commentary by the pilot. Landing on the glacier was wonderful. We couldn't circle McKinley so they credited us $42. Which was fine by me, we saw the mountain as we approached, so not flying around it up close didn't seem like a loss. I took the 7 p.m. flight in early June and the light was great. I think it was better than if I had gone at midday with the full sun which would have blinded me.

review_title: The favorite Alaska activity for all 6 family members!
review_text: True Alaskan adventure- flying over the glaciers but landing on one takes it leaps and bounds further! We took the landing on Ruth glacier trip and everyone loved it- from the adults, 20 year olds and the 12 year olds- a favorite of everyone.  Flying was great but landing and playing on the glacier was over the top incredible.  Pay the extra to do the landing- you will not regret it.  Glaciers and the mountains are breathtaking from the air but intimidating and once in a life time adventure by landing on one.- Christmas picture for sure!!!

review_title: One of the highlights of our lives!
review_text: My husband, his father, and I took a flight with K2 around Mt. McKinnley.  The views were spectacular and our pilot was outstanding.  There were some clouds and he found the holes in order to stay safe.  He had to wear oxygen but the passengers didn't.  Guess that makes safety sense.  I go through my photos often to keep the experience fresh.  We saw mountain climbers, the glaciers, and beautiful peaks.  You never have a guarantee due to the weather.  It can cloud up to the point of not being safe.  We were lucky.  The town of Talkeetna is very nice also.  HIGHLY RECOMMEND this company.

review_title: superb flight even if the mountain was in the clouds
review_text: We were scheduled to fly to mount McKinley but the weather was rainy and the mountain top invisible.  We decided to go anyway giving up landing on a glacier.  Despite the weather our pilot made sure we got our money's worth and we certainly did.  The glaciers we flew over and had a chance to see close-up were just awesome.  The huge dimension of it all was just awesome.  The pilot was informative and discussed all aspects of life in the area.  Great trip! Highly recommended

review_title: A Surreal Trip with K2 Aviation!
review_text: This is a must adventure.  My husband and sister and sisters friend and I went on this great adventure around the Denali with an excellent pilot at K2.  I know it wasn't Barry but it was another totally professional pilot that flew us smoothly by the mountains and landed us on a glacier. I am serious when I say it was totally surreal to be in the middle of all those mountains standing on a glacier. We had a clear day with lots of sunshine so it felt about 70 when we were there. It was just AWESOME!

review_title: We never got our flight in but I would recommend them based on safety!!
review_text: We spent two days in Talkeetna hoping to do a flight around Mt. Mckinley and do the glacier landing.  From the time I made reservations (months in advance) I was completely impressed with the professionalism of this company.  Due to weather we were unable to make the flight and although they tried to reschedule us when the weather cleared we were unable to stay in the area another day.  We had a fully packed schedule while visiting multiple cities so our time in Talkeetna was limited.  Those that came off the plane while we were in the building had rave reviews of the flight.  We went through the check in process which was extremely easy and when our flight ended up not going out they refunded our deposit.  I can tell safety is there top concern and that says it all.  If planning a trip to Talkeetna put in enough time to be able to schedule another flight incase you don't get out on the originally scheduled one.

My wife and I are celebrating our 40th year anniversary.  I had a couple folks at home tell me that we should do that Mt McKinley fly by trip.  I contacted K2 and I cannot say in words what a wonderful job they did.  I am a GA pilot first of all with an instrument and commercial rating.  Barry our pilot was more than accommodating in letting me ride right seat (course the passenger were also comforted knowing that there were two pilots on board not just one!).  Barry was a fantastic guy, tremendously knowledgeable, and narrated the trip throughout.  On this trip, you fly around Mt McKinley and two adjoining peaks---the weather was spectacular.  At 12,000 feet all put on oxygen as to do this flight you go up to 21,000 feet in the Piper Navajo.  My recommendation--do this one--the other trips on their brochure are probably very nice but this is the crem de la crem!  Again, I cannot say in words how satisfied I was with K2 and their hospitality.  It was worth every dollar we spent on the flight.
Mark from Jupiter, FL

Chip was our guide and pilot. Great guy with a lot of information. We decided on the glacier tour where you land on a glacier. Absolutely stunning. Who can say they had a snowball fight on a glacier? Me, I can do that now. This is the number one tour that we took in Alaska. If you don't do this, you miss out on a lot. Plus It was a very smooth flight. Thanks K2 for a once in a lifetime opportunity!

The Denali flightseeing adventure was oustanding. Beautiful day, 10 passenger plane, smooth flight, great pilot and the most unbelievable views of the mountain and glaciers. In 40 + years of traveling I think this was the most outstanding excursion I have ever experienced. Some of our travel group was ambivalent about the flight but everybody came away from the experience in awe. You have to do this.

This company offers flights in small planes to Denali.  My wife and I flew on a 10 passenger flight to parts of the south side of the mountain, where we got some excellent views of the mountain and  landed on a glacier, which was an outstanding experience.  You get to get out of the plane on the glacier and walk a little on the mountain.  The company has several planes.  It stress safety.

excellant business and staff. due to time change problem we had to reschedule flight. staff was very helpful and courteous. pilot, capt greg, was also very friendly and knowledgible. would definately recommend them to anyone needing flying service or tours.

K2's staff were professional and you could tell they really cared about customer satisfaction. The flight tour was incredible and the views were epic; thank you for the amazing experience K2, I will never forget it!!

We were supposed to take the 2 hour Grand Tour around McKinley with a glacier landing but due to weather we were downgraded (and price adjusted) to the 1h 15 min McKinley Flyer tour, without a glacier landing.  Still worth it!!  Although we were disappointed about not landing on a glacier we were not disappointed with the tour we took.  The pilot was very nice--one person in our party was petrified and he did a terrific job of reassuring and calming her down.  When it was over she was thrilled she did it.   Take off and landing was so smooth, as was the entire trip.  Scenery was magnificent--McKinley was out when we got up there.  This isn't a cheap thing to do, but something you should seriously consider--a real Alaska experience.  I know there's other companies that do flight seeing and I can't speak to their services, but I can say that we thoroughly enjoyed using K2 Air.

We recommend this flight and glacier landing to everyone! It was a cloudy day and the pilot, Greg, made the decision to land when he actually saw conditions on the glacier.  Greg was very knowledgeable about the area and was very patient in answering ALL the questions that our son asked! K2 planes are outfitted with emergency situation supplies and alert systems which also made us feel safer.  Our family of 6 was able to fly in one plane which was also a bonus.

We were picked up at our hotel by the K2 shuttle and made it to the airstrip in just a few minutes.  My wife was a bit nervous about the flight but everyone at K2 was very friendly and helpful.  We had to weigh in, use the restroom and store some of our things in a lock-box.  Our flight was wonderful!  The ride was smooth, for the most part, and we had great views of rivers, forests, glaciers, mountains, lakes, and even our hotel.  Denali was only partly visible due to the clouds but we saw the Ruth Glacier very well and were delighted with our experience.  I would recommend K2 to anyone considering a flight-seeing tour and will do it again if we ever get back to Talkeetna.

We are very lucky that the weather is good during the flight. My son of 5-year old is very happy about this flight. When the plane landed on the glacier, he was so happy that he did not want to fly back. During the flight, we also saw an avalanche. The pilot is also knowledge and explained a lot about the things we saw. Nice trip.
The glacier landing was amazing! We were lucky for a very clear afternoon and being the last flight meant we were able to have the glacier all to ourselves. 100% recommend!

A MUST DO!!!!We were THRILLED With Kathrine, at the counter!!! She Was just awesome and so patient with us!!! Sad to read some of the negative reviews.  It took us 3 days before we could take our flight, as this was a once in a lifetime event and we insisted on a glacier landing.  Anyone who researches Alaska, and or mountains of such stature... Should know that the weather changes by the hour...K-2 can't make the weather!! We simply planned for and took advantage of other sights in the area while waiting for good weather, and it was soooo worth it! Our pilot, Randy, was almost tooo informative...I couldn't swivel my head fast enough to keep up with all the info he provided!! He too was terrific!!! We thought K-2 was very professional, in a business that has to deal with ever changing weather!  We were constantly reassured that we'd rec a full refund if we were unable to do the glacier landing.  We also missed flights because of the constant rescheduling due to weather, but K2 made EVERY EFFORT to accommodate everyone!! No complaints here.... We highly recommend these folks AND the glacier landing! Just be realistic and informed...
Great experience! It was too cloudy to see the mountain, but great views from above of the glaciers.  Highly recommended!

We found out about K2 Aviation and looked into the options.  Although pricey, we decided to take the Denali Grand tour with a glacier landing.  The weather didn't cooperate as well as we wanted but we got a good up close look at the mountain.  For the glacier landing, we got a great opportunity to land at Kahiltna Glacier, the base camp for those climbing Denali.  We picked up a couple climbers who had finished their climb.  It was really cool to walk around base camp and see how the whole thing works.  Our airplane was a turbo Otter, very nice.  The pilot provided interesting comments about what we were seeing.  All in all, tons of fun.  I would do this again if I ever get back to Talkeetna.

review_title: Just a great flight with lots to see
review_text: My wife, I and  friend took the K2 tour and enjoyed ourselves very much. We got there about 20 minutes early and were weighed in quickly. When you check in they weigh you because the plane needs the right amount of fuel. We took a 10 seat plane that was very well kept, it was clean and every seat had a head set. Our pilot talked about everything in the area prior to getting to the mountains. Once at the mountains we flew around in circles and "S" patterns so everyone on both sides of the plane could see very well. We got up close and personal with Denali (Mt McKinley) and had a perfect day for flying and seeing the mountain. We spent about an hour and three quarters in the air and were very pleased at what we saw and how K2 handled everything. We didn't do a Glacier landing because my wife didn't want to, but I heard that was awesome too.

review_title: Great glacier landing and view of Mt McKinley and surroundings
review_text: K-2 Aviation and their staff and pilots really love their jobs which makes our travels all that much better. For me the highlight of our 8 passenger single engine flight was the upclose view of the snow covered mountains and landing on a 13,000ft high glacier. A view of 20,237ft Mt McKinley up close was the best because frankly, we had the best clear skies you could want. Loved it. Recommend highly...

Flew over the glaciers of the Alaska Range in Talkeetna yesterday. Conditions not good to land on glacier but we flew over the glaciers and towards Mt. McKinley with spectacular views, and Greg our great pilot. Just an awe inspiring experience, the clouds, the light, the views, unbelievable.  Saw the top of the elusive McKinley…just a great trip. Would highly recommend it.

Thanks Katherine and Barry for a wonderful trip!  You guys made it happen and we had a spectacular time!!

Chuck and Cheryl

We had such an amazing trip. Experience of a lifetime. We were in Talkeetna just for lunch with a friend from Anchorage who works with the Rust family at their sister operation in Anchorage. We stopped into K2 to grab a hat as a souvenir. The office staff was extremely friendly. Garett talked us into taking a trip around the mountain. He constantly had a smile on his face. It was extremely inviting. They probably couldn't have a better person working behind the desk. Our pilot was retired State Trooper Jeff. We had the utmost confidence in his piloting. The trip was breathtaking. Beautiful views. This is definitely something to have on one's "bucket list" and K2 can deliver a trip of a lifetime. I can't wait to bring my family up and have them take a trip with K2 Aviation.

review_title: A MUST tour if nothing else
review_text:
We had a fantastic time even thou at the beginning we were informed that the weather would not allow us to land on the glacier. But after we were introduced to our pilot, Chip, we knew we would have a great time anyhow. Safety was paramount which made us all feel at ease.
Chop narrated the whole way and made our experience fantastic. The scenery was majestic if thats a big enough word.
We loved every minute and would recommend this tour to everyone of every size and every age.

I am not a good flyer. In fact, I'm a terrible flyer. But Chris Wilson (I hope I am remembering that name right) gave us a smooth flight and an unforgettable experience. We got to see Mt. McKinley and Chris was informative and,best of all, humorously and kind. It has been the highlight of our trip. I would recommend anyone that has an opportunity to go.

Also, if you're "big" like me, no worries. I fit in the seat and was able to buckle myself in with no problems.

Thanks, K2 and Chris for a wonderful trip!

review_title: A thrill of a life time.
review_text: K2 provided my wife and I an experience of a life time.  This is a must do for your bucket list. The sights, the flight, landing on the mountain and throwing snowballs.  We cant wait to do this again.  Many thanks to the staff, Mike our pilot for giving us a thrill of a life time.

review_title: One of the Most Breathtakingly Beautiful Things I've Ever Seen!!
review_text: If you can you should include this on your trip.  We were super lucky to see McKinley all three days we were in Talkeetna, but nothing could compare to flying and landing on the Glacier.  The staff was great and our Pilot Jeff was fantastic!!!!!  We flew in the Otter and I can't even put into words how amazing this was.  All I can see is - don't miss this opportunity!!!

The trip takes you around the peaks of the mountains specifically Mt. McKinley.   The pilot tips the plane gently so both sides can view the sites.  I felt I could reach out and touch the mountain but the pilot said it was1/4 mile away.  We landed on a glacier with 2 other planes.  The plane sits one on each side and is very uncomfortable, but for the short trip it is well worth it.

Is a flight tour expensive? yes.  Can it make you green with nausea?  yes.  But for those of us who never intend to climb a mountain this is by far the next best thing and shouldn't be missed.  Weaving betwixt the peaks, over miles of glaciers and the convergence of great rivers, a view of nature's wonder still untainted by development.  Our personal tour (just my husband and I as it was low season) was intended to land on Ruth Glacier and head to the north slope - but the weather is what it is and the clouds came heavy just before either could be accomplished.  With that said, our captain circled through the now rough sky for a safe trip with the best views and with detailed and honest commentary throughout.  Some would call that a fail - we disagree - not only was the time to McKinley amazing - but our experienced pilot and reliable plane made what could have been a harrowing trip into a SAFE and unforgettable one.  There are many flight companies around - our choice remains K2!

This was am awesome experience. My wife and I did the Denali Grand Tour with a glacier landing. If you are on the fence about whether to do the glacier landing or not, DO IT!!!! You won't be sorry. Tony was our pilot and did a GREAT job.

Lynn F.
Stopped in and took a flight around Denali and talked to the pilots a while before and after as I'm a pilot and they were very friendly!

We did the McKinley Summit tour and glacier landing and it was absolutely one of the most amazing experiences! Our pilot was great and makes sure everyone gets an awesome view and also the rest of the staff at k2 were so friendly and helpful. We were very lucky to have a bluebird day and the view was just spectacular! Would definitely recommend the glacier landing for the full experience!

We booked this excursion through our Princess Cruisetour, and it was excellent.  We were fortunate to have a beautiful, sunny day, and the scenery was just spectacular.  Our pilot, Michael, was very understanding and patient while we stored our backpacks.   We were initially told by the clerk to hang onto them until we were called, but in reality they should be stored away before your pilot calls you. Good to know for next time, because I definitely want to come back and do the summit tour in the future.

We flew on a DeHavilland Otter, a fixed-wing plane which has skis to land on Pika glacier!  These pilots are just amazing how they can land on this glacier.  The glacier scenery was beautiful and Michael took an awesome picture of my family (with my iPhone!) in front of the Otter, which later became our Christmas card.  My son is interested in becoming a pilot, so he let him sit in the cockpit--the best seat--on the flight back to K2.  We had gorgeous views of Denali from the plane--a truly wonderful experience.

There was actually a tent set up further away on this glacier--it amazed me to think people actually set up camp here.  This is also the place where mountain climbers start their trek up Denali, (although climbing season had ended when we were there) and it was very sobering to realize how unrealistic that would be for me!

K2 Aviation was great, our pilot Michael was wonderful (and a darn good photographer!), and we were fortunate to fly with them again on our next day's excursion.  The Summit Flight is now on my bucket list.

My friends, a married couple, came up from Florida to visit us. He's an Air Force pilot with a lot of flying time; we met in pilot training.  He came up with the idea of taking the tour and set it up.  We were going to fly around McKinley and land on the nearby glacier.

We saw the weather getting worse the day of our planned trip and were apprehensive.  When we got there, the desk person confirmed our fears.  We wouldn't be able to go on the entire planned route.  They were clear on what they expected to be able to do and gave us the option of cancelling all together.  We went for significantly cheaper than the entire amount we'd planned to spend.

Our pilot, Gregg, was awesome.  He got us closer to the mountain than I expected.  He had great airmanship, able to tell whether it was safe to go down a certain valley or not.  We got to see a lot more than I expected, but I never felt unsafe.  He was a great tour guide, relating the history of the area and pointing out landmarks very naturally.

I couldn't have enjoyed it more.  Their planes are well maintained.  The pilot we flew with was awesome.  Their location is great.  I couldn't recommend this more!

I live in Alaska and like a lot of us we tend not to go see the sights, but as a landscape photographer I could not pass up the chance to land on Ruth Glacier and did not hesitate to use K2.  from the get go the staff was courteous and helpful and our Pilot Greg was navigated through the ridges with ease and showed the greatest patience as my 9 yr old boy asked a bizzillion questions.  I look forward to using them again when I go "on assignment to capture Denali in Summer...btw, my pics  came out great thanks to a smooth flight and crystal clear blue skies

review_title: McKinley Summit Tour- a must to-do in Alaska
review_text: We originally scheduled the flight in Talkeetna. But due to the weather, our flight got cancelled. The people in the office were very patient and tried to help us to re-schedule. They have another office in Delani NP. We ended up being rescheduled to the next day in Denali NP office. So get prepared for the weather change and think of some back up plans in advance. The flight was awsome. I got a little bit dizziness toward to end. Maybe we were sitting at the back row seat. But the up-close view to the McKinley Summit outweights everything. This is a must to do in Alaska. You will never regret it.

We were flying in to do a video shoot and K2 was amazing to work with. I work on a program called Adventures in Odyssey and they bent over backwards to help us out, while making sure we were safe and got everything we needed. Garret and Greg were super friendly, impressively knowledgable and went the extra mile. I can't recommend them highly enough. If you are looking for a McKinley fly over and/or glacier landing, this is your best choice, hands down.

We had a few problems from my travel agent, but none of it was K2's fault and they went above and beyond to fix the problems and make us happy! Elaine especially was very helpful. I also thought before the flight- "eh, I've seen snow covered mountains, how exciting could this be?", But WOW I WAS WRONG! Flying over the glaciers was incredible, and our pilot Ryan made us feel like we could reach out and touch them. The glaciers were so different than looking at a regular mountain, just stunning. One of the top things in nature  I have ever seen (and I travel a lot). And while we were on the flight, before we lost cell service, I was able to use FaceTime to call a friend back in NY, and she was tutoring an autistic child and so they were able to "join us" for part of the flight, and then they spent the rest of his tutoring session using Google Earth and the internet for research since he had now "seen" the glaciers in person. K2 made my trip a success!

We had scheduled our flight for August 3 and hoped for a bright clear day.  But sorry to say the day was dreary and drizzly.  Since this was the only free day we would have we decided to at least check in with the K-2 crew.  These people were so nice, and so willing to do whatever you wanted.  Do you want to reschedue?  Wait and see what the day brings?  Or do you want a refund?  They were just so willing to do whatever the customer wanted.  It's nice to know that there are still companies like this!!  So even though it was a dreary day and our tour route  had to be adjusted,we would not have missed this for anything.
These folks are so down to earth & helpful.  The flight was everything it was reported to be.  Our pilot gave a very informative tour & the weather conditions were perfect.

review_title: wonderful trip up to Mt McKinley
review_text:
Thank you K2 aviation and a special thanks to our pilot Greg, you made the flight an unforgettable experience that will last a lifetime. Wonderful and professional team at K2. 
Thank you
John and Jennifer Davies

review_title: "Mt McKinley is unable to read the weather forecast - so it could be totally different"
review_text: I was very glad that they told us these words and we showed up. They were flexible we started a couple of hours earlier than originally booked. And we had luck: we could do the glacier landing and we had luck to have a great pilot: after we were on our way back he checked via radio with other pilots that the weather condition improved and we have a chance to see the summit of Mt McKinley. So he returned and so we had a chance to see everything. It was great that we had a tour just for us 2. So we had a great experience.

We had a beautiful day for the flight.  Had to wait a little bit for the temp to rise a few degrees but that was no problem.  Dallas took us up and we thoroughly enjoyed our 1 hr tour.  Truly a once in a lifetime experience that I'm so grateful we could do!

We had a great flightseeing tour with K2. We went around and over several peaks, flew down several glacial flows, and had a glacier landing. It was a great experience and was worth every penny. It is a memory that my husband, 8 year old daughter, and I will have forever. The pilot was very laid back but safety conscious and really augmented our experience with unobtrusive info and responses to questions. Highly recommended.

An absolutely amazing experience. My teenage son and I took this trip in July 2013, booked through Princess Cruises. Our pilot Mike was great and my son enjoyed sitting up front with him spotting moose! The views were outstanding and will never be forgotten. Our flight was at 7.30 in the evening, the skies were blue and the weather glorious - no coats needed!!  Thank you K2 Aviation for this brilliant experience.

review_title: Up close and personal with the mountain
review_text: Awesome experience with K2 Aviation. We booked this through Princess Cruises. We were only in Talkeetna for a short time and did not have time for a glacier landing, but the flight itself was well worth the experience. Views were awesome, sunny blue skies. Definitely the highlight of our time in Denali. And Mt. McKinley happened to be out in all its glory. Couldn't have been a better day.

I took a great trip with k2 aviation several years ago with some friends visiting Alaska and we had a great time even though the weather was marginal and they gave us an option to keep the reservation or schedule another day.  Since Denali is normally only visible from the ground 30% of the time it was a great trip to see Denali and all the surrounding glaciers plus we landed on the Glacier.  They fly out of the nice town of Talkeetna, over from hour from anchorage. As a local Alaskan I would definitely fly K2 again.

review_title: I highly recommend this company and their glacier landing tours
review_text: This tour company was wonderful-very professional, the planes look new, they were very stable, the pilot was excellent in his skill and descriptions of what we were seeing.  Of 10 full days in Alaska-this was my favorite activity. The scenery is unforgettable.

I booked the Denali Grand Tour with glacier landing 5 months before our September trip.  I booked it for the afternoon we arrived in Talkeetna so that we had 2 back-up days in case the weather prevented us from going.  This was a good move as our first day was solid clouds and rain.  We rescheduled for the next day and the weather cleared up enough for us to go, but not enough to do the tour we wanted or to do a landing.  The tour we took was less expensive than what we booked so we were only charged for the difference.  However, it seemed that everyone was charged a different rate, and walk-ins got the best rate.  We paid more because we booked in advance.  When we asked them about it we were told pretty much that this is the way it is.  It did not leave me with a positive feeling.

The ride itself was full of beautiful scenery.  We were there when the leaves were turning so the landscape was full of bright yellows and the dark green of the pine trees.  Our plane looked brand new and to be full of the latest technology.  We had the seats by the wing supports, so we could only get a clear view front and back, not straight out.  I was on the right side.  It seemed that all the scenery being described, and our main approach to Mt. McKinley was on the left.  The pilot's voice was a little monotone so I stopped listening after awhile since he was mainly describing views to the left.  The plane eventually turned so the right could see, but the narration was minimal so I really didn't know what I was looking at.  I'm sure I saw Mt. McKinley, but I had no idea at all which peak it was.

All in all, I would recommend taking one of these tours as the scenery is really spectacular, but if I go again I will book with someone else.

CHEAPER IF BOOKED DIRECTLY, but if there are scheduling problems with your cruise line and you're late, it's better to have booked thru the cruise line.  There is an option especially to book tours the day you disembark the ship.
The Princess hotel is 50 MILES from Talkeetna.  We got off the ship, took a 4.5 hour train to Talkeetna, did a glacier landing flight, then a one hour bus ride to the McKinley Lodge.  We were glad we took a flight the same day while in Talkeetna.   We had to spend an hour on a bus the next day (each direction) to take our second flight to circle McKinley.
Book early for the time you want.  Our train was to arrive at 12:15, but arrived about an hour late, so I was glad our flight wasn't until 3 pm.  (This is also why I'm glad I booked thru Princess.  The cost was higher, but we didn't have to worry about the time because it was the cruise line's fault if we were late.)  The clouds cleared just in time for our glacier landing, too.  If we'd booked earlier, we wouldn't have been able to land.  I checked online before we left home and by then, then next available tours were after 6 pm, so I was glad I booked ahead.  You may not want to spend five hours in Talkeetna unless you had another tour planned.  It's a small town and there isn't that much to see or do unless you're hiking or taking a tour.  You won't spend hours shopping like you would in a larger town.  Most Alaskan stores have pretty much the same things, anyway.

Some staff is not that knowledgeable and pilots are (understandably) seasonal- I caught ours lowering the visor for tips on landing the plane at the end of one of our flights.  
The pilots give commentary, but also have to stay in constant contact with the ground and each other for safety reasons.  There are a few planes in the air and you want your pilot concentrating on safety, not on some bratty kid kicking his seat or irritating passengers who don't shut up.  

We took two flights- Glacier Landing and the flight around McKinley summit.  
Honestly, the glacier landing was much more interesting.  Two planes landed within minutes of each other and we were the first landings in five days, so you may not get to land if it's too cloudy.  They said it isn't safe to take off again if it's cloudy above.  The pilots are in constant radio contact, though, so they know the location of each plane to prevent accidents.  We spent our time looking at the glaciers, mountains, etc.  The glaciers have amazing turquoise pools of water and the landscape is a myriad of colors you wouldn't believe.  When on the glacier, you can hear a river of water rushing beneath.  It was amazing.

The flight around McKinley the next day was novel, but somewhat boring after seeing the glaciers and colorful landscape the day before.  You go out to the mountain, circle around and around, then back to the airport.  My husband's window fogged, so he didn't see much of anything.  (Two rows behind the pilot.) The pilot repeatedly tilts the plane in each direction so both sides can see.  My husband was very disappointed in his flight and took only a couple of pictures because he couldn't see anything  His pictures were out the window on the OTHER side of the plane and that passenger had her oxygen tubing over the window.  For the cost, I feel badly for him, but my flight was good, just a little boring after the first few minutes at the summit.
Take the Glacier Landing Tour.  You won't be disappointed even if you don't land.  There is a price adjustment or longer flight if you can't land.
I loved our pilot- Rich:)

We were originally scheduled to fly around Denali, but due to poor weather we were given the option to either cancel and get a full refund, or we could take a tour of the Knik Glacier for the same price (the tour was about an hour longer than our original plan).  We really wanted to get in the air, so we took them up on option 2.  The flight was gorgeous (if a bit uncomfortable - we're not extremely tall people at 5'8/5'9, I can't imagine someone over 6 feet doing well as the seats left little to no leg room).  Our pilot was knowledgeable and really focused on ensuring that everyone in the plane got a good view of all the sights.  My husband got a little bit airsick, only due to the banking and slight turbulence.  It was definitely worth the price and a trip that we will never forget!

review_title: Thanks to K2 for another wonderful, world class mountain flight
review_text:
Thanks to K2 for another wonderful, world class mountain flight. Ever since we flew with K2 on our climb of Denali, we have been impressed with their friendliness, efficiency, can do attitude, safe operations, experienced pilots and the love of flight and nature they exude.
Without their help we could not have summited Denali back in 1998 as they were able to get a team member in at crucial time. Two years ago we flew with K2 again and the pilot was knowledgeable, the flight was beautiful, the ground staff exceptional.
We flew again last week on a perfect day, in a beautiful and powerful Beaver on skis. Suzzane, the owner of K2 Aviation and the K2 staff, as usual were awesome, flexible and helpful- a great team. Chris our pilot- is a world class aviator. He was also very well informed and shared the local history, flora , fauna, geology and geography with us.
We flew close by by towering cliffs, icefalls, around, above and below jagged peaks. We landed on Denali's Pika glacier and we all jumped out smiling and laughing, overcome by the raw and rare beauty. We walked around on fresh snow on the glacier, surrounded by sun sparkled peaks, with Denali rising above them all. In this grand amphitheater of multi- colored rock and  white ice, dark peak and blue sky, the sturdy but nimble looking K2 aircraft was like a small red jewel sitting there on its skis.  The kids had snow ball fights, made snow angels and chased each other,laughing and filled with delight.  We finished with a family race back to the plane-with Chris our pilot as the finish line.
This summer we have climbed many mountains, competed in rodeos, surfed, skied, skydived, raced, biked, canyoneered and may other things but the flight and landing on the ice was to me the most amazing and awe inspiring experience. Thank you K2 for that flight and for who you are- wonderful,  adventurous, kind, expert, and fun to fly with. We love you! God bless you, Dave Eubank, family and all the Free Burma Rangers

review_title: They give you the best trip they can for the weather.
review_text:
It is not easy to fly to a mountain that is too often shrouded in clouds.  The staff of K2 are very transparent about what can be seen that day/hour and their pilots fly the best route that they can considering the weather and safety factors.

Although it was fairly clear skies in Talkeetna the day we flew,  the Denali Ridge, and most of the Alaskan Range in that area were in a storm. We still decided to fly (should have Bonine-d!) and although we didn't even get close to Denali, we still saw glaciers, beautiful areas of tundra, kettle ponds, forests, braided rivers, and lonely cabins.  The flight gave us a better understanding of what Alaska is all about.

Very enjoyable in an 8-seater plane allowing everyone to have a window seat.  Views of McKinley and the Glacier were amazing.  The pilot did a great job providing information, which made the flight even more interesting.  This is a wonderful company (with shuttle service) to see the glaciers by air.

We were lucky to send two nights in Talkeetna recently with Mt McKinley in full view. We went early in the morning to see if we could get on any flights and were told, yes, come back in an hour ready to go. We were weighed in (gulp!!) and assigned to a group of 11. Our pilot then came along and took us over to the plane where we were given a safety talk. Half way into the talk we thought, hmmm this guy sounds bored, he was like a robot. Don't get me wrong, he was very professional and the issue of safety, of course, is of the utmost importance. We were then told where to sit, buckled up and off we went. We had an amazing flight in a beautiful blue sky and the pilot did a wonderful job but never once did he crack a smile or or be friendly in any way. We were given lots of really interesting information during the flight but it was like he was reading it off a script. We were told to ask any questions when we returned, when I did this he barked a one word answer at me then turned away. I think he had done this flight once too many times, that said however we had a great time but his attitude was off the mark for the money we paid.

review_title: Awesome flight to see Mt McKinley
review_text: What a great way to see the mountains and glaciers.  This is a great company with a history in Alaska aviation.  We had fog and clouds the morning of our scheduled flight but the K2 team was patient and by 11am the fog had lifted and the clouds cleared enough for a safe flight.  Greg did a wonderful job providing expert commentary on the geography below, while we passengers just soaked in the beauty of the Alaska range and surrounding glaciers.  This is a "must do" if you are near Talkeetna and I wouldn't fly with anyone else.

Great company who pride themselves in their air safety..which is a great thing around here as the weather changes so quick.  We enjoyed our flight..it was mind blowing seeing the mountains and glaciers from the air.  Do not hesitate to fly with this company.

These people are very busy and its easy to see why. Planes are well maintained and everybody professional. Plan ahead and yes the weather may be kind to you. If not they will refund you in the event of a no go. The glacier landing is a must - dont worry about it being cold, it was quite warm up there

Due to weather, we could not fly. I am writing this to tell everyone how hard K2 worked with us. We had to reschedule on a daily basis. The staff was friendly and professional. We were traveling all over the lower half and would have had to drive 4 hours to return for our flight. K2 talked to us every day about the conditions and rescheduled us every day until we left for home. We never got to fly but they were wonderful about our needs. In the end, they said they would mail us a refund due to the time passed since our booking. We wanted to fly and land on a glacier more than anything but they made the disappointment easier to take, We will try with them when we return. Thank you all for your help.

review_title: Coolest thing I did in my 2 weeks in Alaska
review_text: I was in Alaska for 2 weeks and this was the coolest thing I did AND I did a lot of cool things. This was incredible. I was there 5 years ago and took a flight around Mt. McKinley from Katishna and never thought anything could top that. I was wrong! Landing on a glacier added extra excitement to it. There is something to be said for standing in a place only a handful of other people ever had. K2 Aviation was great. Our initial flight was cancelled due to weather so we re-scheduled and it was worth the wait. Denali was clear and it doesn't get any better than that! The pilot was fantastic and gave narration during the flight. If you go to Alaska, DO THIS! Talkeetna is also a wonderful little town, worth staying.
Nunca pensé que sería tan apasionante el vuelo al Montse Mckinley Grandes vistas durante mas de una hora Lo recomiendo a pesar del precio

K2 runs a top notch operation. Very organized, polite, and professional. Tony was the Captain for our flight. He was very focused on details during our flight, but who wouldn't be if 7 of the pax spoke no English. He made sure everyone was paying attention. Exactly what you want. I would do it again for sure. Even my traveling companion, who is prone to get motion sick, could not stop talking about how enjoyable it was. She could not imagine missing that experience. Well done K2.

review_title: Flying High in Alaska with K2!
review_text: Our flightseeing trip with K2 Aviation was expected to be a highlight of our vacation trip, and it certainly was - even beyond all expectations! We had booked the "red" route from their website.  When we arrived there was very thick cloud cover, so that route was not available with the current weather conditions.  We were asked if we would be interested in joining another group on the "green" route, which was the same price with about 15 minutes additional flight time. Our backpacks were stowed at the office in locked bins.  (We wore coats onto the flight, but were not needed in the heated plane.)  The pilot quickly seated us in the 10-seat twin engine plane and we were on our way!  The tour information was educational and the views were exceptional.  We were still in and out of cloud cover but could see most of the other mountain ranges in the area and had good visibility for the glaciers and some rivers.  This is a highly recommended adventure tour and K2 Aviation is an excellent tour company for flightseeing.

I would definitely recommend K2 flightseeing. Our pilot was Stan. He was informative and made us feel comfortable. Our plane was a bright red de Havilland otter. It looked  beautiful against the mountains, snow and glaciers - our pictures turned out great. We landed on Ruth glacier and enjoyed every moment of this magnificent, majestic place.

review_title: K2 Aviation flight to Denali & Glacier landing
review_text:
Our flight to Denali with K2 is #1 in the many activities in our 15 day independent travel of Alaska.
The K2 staff was knowledgeable and friendly. Everything was according to schedule. We were of course very fortunate to have a clear day for flying!! Our pilot was Stan, once again very knowledgeable and friendly. He really cared that we got our money's worth. He pointed out all the sights we had eagerly been looking forward to and spent extra time so we could get the video we wanted. Our glacier landing was spectacular on Pika Glacier and Stan made sure we spent enough time to get pictures and also took some of us by the plane with some great background.
Our only regret is that we were on such a high from our trip that we totally forgot to give Stan a generous and much deserved tip. Please tip Stan extra if he is your pilot, he is great!!

I had a scheduled flight to glacier and landing for the day we were at the McKinley lodge near Talkeetna this August.  When we arrived we were advised that due to weather conditions that they would be unable to land on the glacier that day.  They offered a total refund or a discount on a routine scenic flight to MkKinley.  The Pilot was very nice.  I wish I could remember his name.  The flight was excellent.  It was the smoothest plane ride ever.  He took us all around and was an excellent tour guide.  We actually got a peak at McKinley/Denali for a little while when the clouds broke briefly.  We had some amazing views.  The landing was just as smooth as the take-off.  I would definitely recommend K2.
Our flight was cancelled because of bad weather. W revived a full refund. The crew was so kind and let us go into the air plain to have some pictures. Next time we will book them again.

review_title: An Awesome Flight to Mt. McKinley
review_text:
To:  Whom it May Concern
From:  Doug and Pat McMinds
RE:  Flight Experience with K2 to Mt. McKinley
	After being warmly welcomed, we were introduced to our experienced pilot.  Our skillful veteran pilot was also a great tour guide.  He took us on a breath taking flight to and from the mountain, through many passes, and a glacier landing.  The total package was worth every dime!  We recommend you to fly with K2.

Truly the only way to see the park. Pricey, but you have come this far,so it would be silly not to get into the park. Amazing experience. A clear day makes all the difference so watch the weather. A must do!

Wow, took tons of videos and pictures.  Paid for a glacier landing  but it was too dangerous to land so they refunded that part. The views of the mountain were absolutely beautiful.  We were so close it was amazing!! MUST GO!  MUST GO!  I have asthma and was nervous but I had no problems at all.  My husband has motion sickness but he had no problems either.  What a memory!

I recently did a glacier landing flight with K2 in their Turbine Otter on skis.  What makes it different for me is I have been an Air Force and commercial pilot for over 30 years.  Our pilot Chris Wilson is one of the most competent, skilled pilots I have flown with.  His skills and attitude made for a relaxing yet very adventurous flight next to Denali and the Ruth glacier, with a landing on the Eldridge glacier.  If you don't want to rope up and spend a week in the Alaska range and instead are looking for a hot tub and beer at the end of your day, I can imagine no better way to truly see this incredible mountain range, the most spectacular on earth.  And I know, I have seen them all!

Thanks Chris and the entire K2 team "I'll Be Back"

We just returned from our Alaskan vacation.  We had a large group and K2 was able to accommodate us without any issues.  Their pricing was very reasonable and the staff very friendly.  Our pilot had a great personality and handled all of the children and their fascination with the headsets in stride!  Thanks again for an experience our entire family will remember for the rest of our lives.

Words cannot describe how amazing this tour is.

From the office staff, to the ground crew, to the pilot; these people are fantastic.  The pilot went over all the emergency necessities before we took off; first aid kit, sleeping bags, signals.  I was a little leery about flying in such a small craft, but once we were in the air, I forgot all about it.  The views out both sides of the plane were just amazing.  The pilot pointed out different points of interest.  We took tons of pictures.  He maneuvered in/out of the mountains with the greatest of ease.  It felt like we could just reach out an touch the mountain.  If there was any turbulence, I never felt it.  

You HAVE to do this if you're in Talkeetna.

We had an all-around amazing trip to Alaska, but this flight was a highlight for our whole family.  My husband and I flew with our 9-year-old daughter as part of a small glacier-landing group.  The scenery was astonishing and our pilot was a true pro.  We had fun playing in the snow on an 80-degree day and got some of the best pictures of our trip to share and remember when we got back home.  The entire staff, in the air and on the ground, were great and we really enjoyed our experience.

I had a wonderful experience with K2. Our pilot, Tony, was super informative and made sure everyone in the plane got to see the views. The staff that I dealt with were kind and helpful. We were in a 10 passenger plane and got the chance to land on Pika Glacier. The whole trip lasted about 2 hours. It was some of the most beautiful country I have ever seen. The glacier landing was the neatest part. I was pleasantly surprised by how warm it was and had a good time romping around in the snow.

We took our family with kids age 13, 11, 8. I do not like flying and don't like small planes. But you only live once so I did it! It was amazing. The take off was so smooth. There was NO turbulence. It was the easiest non bumpy plane ride. We all loved it. We did the glacier landing and so glad we did. Totally worth the money!!! They have emergency supplies in the back of the plane with sleeping bags cooking equipment in case there is a problem. They tell you how to operate the emergency buttons on the plane. It freaks you out a little but you are flying into the middle of no where so its important. I cant recommend it enough!!!! GO GO GO!!!

This was a wonderful outing.  Rick was our pilot and was very informative and professional. 
 He allowed both sides of plane to get awesome views.  All the staff great.  The views will leave u awestruck. FYI- there is a coupon in alaska tour saver book for this as well.

We flew in a 10 passenger plane over Mt. McKinley and surrounding area and then we landed on a glacier.  Totally awesome as 3 other planes also landed while we were there.  A total of 4 planes and 40 people playing in the snow while the city of Talkeetna was experiencing record breaking temperatures in the 90's!

review_title: Excellent pilot, great tour landed on Glacier
review_text: Even though it was raining throughout the area, we were still able to land on the glacier.  Very cool. Good company, very customer orientated.  I would really recommend this company.

review_title: 2 hour Flightseeing Mt. McKinley & Glacier Landing
review_text: We flew in a 10 passenger plane, taking frequent S Turns to allow views from both sides of the plane.  Roughly one hour to the glacier, then roughly 20 minutes on the glacier, then a half hour back to Talkeetna airport.  A wonderful, once in a lifetime experience.

If in Alaska, you must make the trip to Talkeetna. The feeling one feels beneath the largest mountain in North America is overpowering. The K2 Aviation group are top notched and very informative. I have been to several locations around the world. This is tops to date. You owe yourself this humbling experience.

O passeio foi surpreendente! Sobrevoar aquelas montanhas de gelo é uma visão fantástica e emocionante. Até esquecemos que no aviãozinho só cabiam 6 pessoas! O pouso sobre a geleira foi sensacional e andar sobre ela deu a real dimensão daquela grandiosidade de gelo. Recomendo muito!

My wife and I used the toursaver 2 for 1 coupon which made this flight very reasonably priced.  Our pilot was very professional and informative.  Having never flown on a small plane before we were a little apprehensive, but from the moment we left the ground we knew this was an experience we'd never forget.  The views are simply breathtaking.  The pilot also did a great job of pointing out wildlife.  We saw numerous moose and a grizzly bear which we circled around.  I would do it again in a heartbeat.  I do have one piece of advise.  If you get motion sickness I would consider taking dramamine before the flight.  My wife forgot to take dramamine and she felt quite woozy on the way back to Talkeetna.  The plane does quite a bit of banking in order to see the various sights and wildlife.

Though we were able to see Mt. McKinley in full view from the park, you have no idea what seeing the mountain is really like unless you are up close.  Our pilot, Mike, was fantastic, answered all our questions and gave a wonderful narration.  It is expensive but truly work the cost.  Weather was perfect.
K2 Aviation guys are very honest and upfront about possible tours. If they can't make it due to weather they'll let you know about it in front desk. I would love to fly with them

They say that less than 30% of Alaskan visitors get to see Mount McKinley.  If you don’t, you’re missing a truly amazing natural spectacle.  There is no better way to see the mountain than with a flight-seeing tour like the one we took with K2.  (You can’t drive to Mt. McKinley, and if you hike, better plan to walk for weeks).  Tony was a fantastic pilot, getting us great views, gentle on the controls, and letting us know any time he was making a big turn.  We flew between the peaks of the mountains and over the glaciers, and were lucky enough to have one of those days where it looked like you could reach out and touch the mountain from the plane.  Incredible and very worth the price!

Great experience . We did the glacier landing tour with Mike as our pilot. Weather was a bit iffy but we managed to land on the Elridge glacier with no problem   Th views were FANTASTIC. Mike did his best to maneuver around the clouds and we were able to see just the tip of mt Denali . Tips. Don't bring binoculars as you don't need them . Also K2 has secure lockers so you can just bring what you need with you, which is essentially just a camera . We were in a10 sweater plane and best picture taking seats are the ones in the back. Boots provided but dress warm

What can I say about K2 aviation? Everything, from the buildings and grounds to the actual flying experience, was excellent. We were lucky that the weather cooperated during our visit to Talkeetna and K2 Aviation.  As licensed skydivers we understand that sometimes weather can ruin the best of plans.  

The place is immaculately clean, with a nicely manicured lawn to relax as you await your flight, a gift shop, clean restrooms, and a nice deck. You don't even mind waiting for your turn to fly.  The staff is extremely warm and welcoming.  The pilots mingle around between flights, chatting with the guests.  The office staff is well informed and happy to answer your questions. The staff at K2 obviously care about their airplanes and facilities. They take safety seriously and were often updating each other on the conditions of the landing sites.
