Our pilot, Chip, is highly experienced and knowledgeable.  The entire flight out to Eldridge he explained the history of the area and the science behind the landscape.  We saw breathtaking views of lakes, mountains, glaciers, and other natural landscapes. The airplane ride was comfortable and we were able to communicate with each other via the headsets. We landed on Eldridge glacier and had plenty of time to take in the scenery and take as many photos as we desired. The flight back was just as wonderful as the rest of the trip. 

I would recommend this trip to anyone who wants to see Alaska's natural beauty from a new perspective.

Spend the money and do it!  We chose the 90 minute flight with glacier landing.  We were in Alaska for 13 days doing a land tour and then a cruise.  The glacier landing was the best and we had lots of great experiences throughout the trip.  Our pilot Jeff was great.  He flies for the company year round and has lots of experience and gave our group a fabulous tour.  He did not control the weather but it was way above average.....beautiful day, sun was out, and we got pictures of the peak of Mt. McKinley. 

We used Alaska Tour and Travel  800-208-0200 Mike Montgomery for our land tour.  He was very helpful and we found him through this web site.

We did the fly and hike package. The trip of a lifetime. Be forewarned, if you do this specific flight, the weather has to be just right. They land the place on a lake inside Denali Park up Ruth Glacier near Mt. Huntington. If they can't see the lake, they can't fly. It took us 3 days for the weather to clear enough to fly. (Glad we had the time). K2 was great, professional, and I would recommend their services to anyone.

We wove between the peaks of the Alaskan Mountain range.  It felt like you were watching an IMAX movie.  Seeing Mt McKinley up close is really something to see.  Though our pilot said that we were 800-900 feet away from the sides of the mountain- it felt much closer than that.  Our pilot was Jeff.  Felt very safe and enjoyed his commentary as we flew.  I would give K2 Aviation a "5" rating except for the young girls staffing the check in counter.  They need some additional training on being pleasant to customers.
Glacier landing in Otter. Amazing!!!  Excellent pilot.  Perfect landing on the glacier.  i would highly recommend the glacier flight. Worth the money.

review_title: Flying with K2 to view Denali
review_text: Myself and wife, flew with K2 to see Denali, great professional trip.  Picked up at our hotel, easy interview and sign in.  Short wait to get in the air.  Pilot was very knowledgeable and answered our questions before asked and encouraged questions.  Fly out of his way to make sure we all had photo ops and saw all explaining what we were seeing.  One our best experiences.  Highly recommended.

review_title: Flight Around Denali with Glacier Landing
review_text:
After having lived in Alaska for many years I finely experienced Talkeetna and K2 Aviations flight around The Great One. 
It is very difficult for me to describe how absolutely fantastic this flight was. My husband and I were lucky enough to be there when there wasn't a cloud in the sky and the mountain was out in all its glory. I have had the opportunity to fly over a lot of wilderness Alaska and see places that many life-long Alaskans haven't had the chance to see. This experience was almost overwhelming. The magnitude of Denali up close and personal is something every person that visits Alaska, or lives here, should save up pennies for. It is not inexpensive but 100% worth every penny. Our pilot Stan was excellent, personable, funny, informative and a very skilled aviator. If you want one adventure that will forever be one of the top experiences you have this is it. Office staff, pilots everyone very friendly and professional.

Awesome trip!!  DO THIS!  If you don't youll regret it!  Do the glacier landing!  Coolest part of the whole trip. Our pilot Patrick was awesome, cool, and very informative.  Office staff was great.  All very friendly. Stephanie helped us a lot!  We can check this off the bucket list but we may come back in the future to do it again it was so much fun. Thanks K2!!!

review_title: Diappointed!  Don't book if you have a schedule to keep.
review_text:
Disappointed! 

K2 Aviation has the fancy sign, a prime spot in town, sweatshirts in the front of their office and even coffee, but they lack professional customer service.  Alaska has a unpredictable weather pattern and Talkeetna follows the same rules.  There are many travelers that come through looking for a flight experience to see Denali or Mt. McKinley.  Some on ships that only permit a day to experience.  K2 doesn't seem to care.  Their daily order of business is to look at the flight weather and then when people check in for the flight, schedule them on the next flight available.  They do not tell you to call the morning of or night before.  They simply reschedule first come first serve.  Therefore if your flight is at 10 and you are asked to reschedule, you might not get a flight until the next day when you go through the same order of events.  K2 also is very expensive for what you get.  Maybe it is to cover the coffee or the design of their shirts.   K2 also only has VFR or visual flight rules.  Meaning their pilots can only operate if the clouds are clear or good visibility.  This causes for many delays and rescheduled plans.

IFR however has extensively more training and can operate by instruments or instrumental flight rules.  IFR certification simply means much less cancelations.  After our flight was canceled and we were "rescheduled" to another day much less convieient , we found McKinley Flight Tours, or Fly Denali.  http://www.talkeetnaaero.com/about.htm

They were less expensive and we were able to have a reduced price lower than advertised as we were flying last minute.  No fancy shirts and their location was less prime, but I would recommend to anyone trying to take a tour.    Their company also has IFR pilots.  We were so happy with our choice.  
Don't waste your time with K2 especially if you are on a cruise.

review_title: Around McKinley and landing on a glacier
review_text: This was our first trip on a ski plane and we did not know what to expect.  First, the flight around Mt. McKinley was, by far, the best way to appreciate this massive mountain.  We had previously been in Denali National Park and were disappointed that the weather closed in on that side of the mountain precluding any view.  Flying around it gives the correct impression of its size and height.  Then we landed on a nearby snow (10' deep) covered glacier (1500' deep).  It was as smooth a landing as any jet we have been on.
They had little outfits for kids that we were wanting with Moose pictures on them.  The lady there was very nice to us and talked a while about where we live.

We spent two weeks traveling through Alaska and the Yukon.  By far, getting to see Denali from the air with K2 Aviation was the highlight.  Our pilot was experienced and knew so much about the area.  We chose not to do the glacier landing, which turned out to be the right decision, since the winds were too high for a landing.  This was a wonderful way for my husband to celebrate the year he turned 60!

We were flown by Mike to view Denali and landed on Pica Glacier.  The flight was amazing!  Mike was an excellent pilot and guide, it was well worth it!  The only negative was the busy (and seemingly disorganized) reception area.  It seemed to be run by college kids who were having a lot of fun, but not keeping people very organized in terms of when/where to gather for their flights.  I think that because it was such a beautiful day, with Denali so clearly visible, they were planning extra flights to try and meet demand.  Aside from that our trip with K2 was great!

I took my mom on a flight for her 71st birthday.  Right from the get-go, everything was perfect.  The staff at check-in were friendly and laid-back.  There was a lady in there with some worry about being in a small plane and they quickly set her mind at ease.  Our captain greeted us and was everything I would expect in a small plane Alaskan pilot: affable, knowledgable about what we were flying over and he just gave you a sense that if something were to go wrong (which did not happen at all), he'd be able to keep it together without breaking a sweat.  The plane itself was very well maintained and getting to wear the headphones with the microphone while flying makes you feel pretty cool.  
The flight itself was awesome!  Although the mountain was a bit cloudy, we managed to circle Denali for a full 360.  The captain pointed out the various "smaller" mountains and glaciers, as well as Base Camp and the routes taken by climbers up to the summit.  
We landed on Pika Glacier and stayed there about 20, 25 minutes.  The captain volunteered to take pictures for everyone in our group and let us wander around a bit to take it all in.  I checked my pictures after we landed and it's pretty clear that both my mom and I were very, very excited to be up there!
I cannot recommend this experience enough.  My mom has been in Alaska 47 years and she told me after she landed that this was one of the best things she's ever done in the state!  Thank you K2 for helping me earn Awesome Daughter status for a long time to come!

If you want to experience complete and utter awe, take a flightseeing glacier landing with K2.  We were only one of two flights that got to land on Ruth Glacier the day we were there, due to earlier fog.  Luck was on our side, the weather was clear and beautiful, perfect for viewing the Alaska Range (and Mt. McKinley) and a landing.  Equipped with overshoes, we sank a few inches into glacial snow after climbing out of the plane.  Our pilot, Greg, took a good variety of pictures of us, we now have our 2013 Christmas card pic.  Thanks Greg and K2 for everything, we will never forget our adventure with you!!
My son and I took a flight with pilot mike. Denali was nearly clear of clouds and was very pretty. I thought the trip out and back was beautiful, the glaciers were incredible. Well worth the the $.

Our flight was the most amazing thing we have ever done. I was a little apprehensive about going up in a small plane and even a little more apprehensive about landing on the glacier. Our trip was perfect in every way! We had super clear weather, no turbulence! Our pilot Stan was wonderful. Really it is not something that you can put into words but just know there is nothing like it. K2 has a great fleet of aircrafts, we were on an Otter but all of their planes were top notch. 

Great trip, thank you.

After a couple of flight cancellations and a few days of dreary weather, we finally managed to book with K2 and boy, what a ride it was! Our wonderful pilot Scott mentioned that only 1/3rd of flights see the summit of Denali and we got really lucky. Seeing the three peaks up close is an experience we would never forget. Although we could not land due to weather, the flight was awesome. Scott pointed out all the glaciers as well as the base camp. Truly a wonderful experience.

Our flight to see Denali and land on a glacier was a fantastic experience.  Our pilot Mike was cool and calm and did a wonderful job of making sure that people on both sides of the plane could see everything.  I really appreciated his warning us when he was going to change directions or altitude.  He told us what we were seeing and also warned us when to get our cameras ready for spectacular pictures.  The landing on the glacier was indescribable.  It was something I will never forget.  I highly recommend this excursion.  It is an special experience.

If you're thinking about doing this stop thinking.  

We ended our 8 day trip to Alaska with this adventure.  It is pricey I know and I pinch pennies where I can.  But I pinch those pennies so I can do things like this.  

It was totally worth the price.  Some discounts are available by using the coupons found in the Northern Lights and Tour Savers books.  

I'll never forget what we saw.  Never.

review_title: Amazing ending to a incredible trip
review_text:
Our stay in Talkeetna was the end of an incredible trip and the flight and glacier landing on Denali was an amazing way to end it.
We flew with K2 in June 2013.  
We contacted them via email in Jan/Feb 2012 to reserve the flight. All communication was quick and easy.
The day of our flight was cloudy, misty and pretty socked in.   Our flight was scheduled for 9 AM, there was no way we were going anywhere so we were asked to come back around noon and check in.  At noon we moved back to 2:30.  The ladies in the front office area were very helpful with weather updates and scheduling during this time.  They were friendly and very easy to work with.
Thankfully at 2:30 there was enough of a break to get some flights in.  The cloudy weather had actually helped.  It had been so sunny and warm the previous couple weeks that they had not been doing many landing.  
If you are hedging on whether to do the glacier landing or not.  DO it!!  You may never be there again, the cost is well worth the experience.  It was amazing, especially when you think only a few actually get to see the mountain, and fewer yet get to stand on it.

The only slightly negative experience of the day was the area to get the over boots and groups together to get out to the planes.  A tall gentleman with a pony tail was trying to heard all the humans in some resemblance of groups to get them to the correct pilots.  I thought his attitude and approach with getting some of the other flyer's booted up and to the pilots was rude.  May have been a long and hectic day but this area could be improved on.
Tony our pilot was not very talkative but is a very skilled pilot.  I thoroughly enjoyed flying with him.  The flight around the mountain, the landing on and views from the glacier were just spectacular.

With the ease of setting up the flights and the way the office staff helped get us on a flight I would fly with K2 again anytime.  They are a safe company that has well maintained planes and exceptional pilots.

This was the best thing we did on our Alaska trip!!!  Can't say enough good things about the flight seeing tour and this company. Jeff was our pilot and he was GREAT!!! We loved it so much we strongly considered doing it again the next day (even though we had already paid for a $600 bus tour).  It was that good!!! This is a must do!!

review_title: Patrick was a great pilot and guide
review_text: Had a wonderful experience flight seeing over Denali and Mt. McKinley.  Beautiful landscape- just awesome. and a glacier landing included.  Would recommend to everyone to take K2

Well, really both trips I took with K2 were for pleasure..  First, last summer (2012) I went to Alaska with my wife for 10 days and included a flight with K2 as one of our activities.  Unfortunately for us, Denali did not cooperate with us on our scheduled date.  K2, however, was extremely accomdating offering to reschedule us not only throughout the day, but also on another day.  They even went so far as to offer us 100% refund.  I was optimistic we would find a hole through, so we went for it.  We were treated to a very enjoyable trip up the Ruth glacier.  It was beautiful and incredible. 

This year, K2 transported me on a trip to the Kahiltna glacier to climb Denali.  K2 was very professional and did an excellent job in managing our gear and safely getting us onto the mountain on our scheduled time.  On the way out, K2 picked us up promptly and as soon as it was safe.  Our pilots Chris and Tony were both very skilled and professional at the glacier landings and take-offs.

K-2 aviation has several excellent air tours out of Talkeetna that go around 
Mt. McKinley and even provides a glacier landing.  I have been on well over 1000 
flights and this is one that is UNFORGETABLE.   The air option starts from 
Talkeetna.  k-2 aviation is recommended.  See the mountain up close and personal 
with a narrated guide/pilot and window seat. (The closest you can get to the mountain fromm the usual ground tour is probably at least 15 miles away)  You can see all of the Mountain's 
cracks, crevasses, hanging valleys, and other features.  From the air you also 
can view the glaciers and the resulting silty braided glacier streams  as they 
weave their way downward across a broad expanse.   The longest of many glaciers 
is 45 miles long and as much as 3,800' thick.  Due to the size of the plane, all 
seats are window seats.  Try and board first; you can ride in the copilot's 
seat.  Get the Northern Lights 2 for 1 coupon try the usual alternatives for a 
reduced fare.  I found k-2 very fair.  We were not able to do a glacier landing 
and they immediately refunded that portion of the tour.  They also tell you the 
likelihood of seeing the mountain and offer you a cancelation option.     Pricy, 
but well worth it.  
If there are four in your party, buy the Northern Lights coupon book in advance.  Save a couple of hundred as 1 person flies free with the coupon.

See my other posts of this area for meaningful tie-ins.  Have fun

First time - we had no idea what to expect.  Our only goal was to see Mt. McKinley up close and thought that would be fun.  We contemplated the glacier landing for the additional $$$'s thinking that is not a big deal and could do without.  Then we decided what the heck, probably going to do this once in our life-time, let's do it!  Besides, the additional cost equaled a couple rounds of golf - big deal.   

Experience:  It is hard to find the words to bring you into the experience when you get off that plane to stand on the glacier, breathe that air and try to take in the view.  Awe-inspiring, invigorating experience that just takes your breath away!  This is God's country and He is sharing it with us - oh how blessed we are!  My son starts making the tiniest snow man, snow angel and then three glacier balls and jugles on the glacier (first time done on a glacier....??) - free entertainment all caught on video! This was not on the bucket list and should have been!  When we landed my husband said, "I would have paid double for that!"  Thanks to Mike our pilot - we loved him!

review_title: The best part of my Alaska vacation
review_text: If you do nothing else in Alaska but go on one of these flights, your trip will be worth it! It was magnificent. we weren't the slightest bit ill at ease, the pilot was so calm and reassuring. Landing on a glacier was breathtaking! don't forget your camera.

Total trip of a lifetime!  We thought our pilot, Tony, was the kindest and, more importantly, best skilled pilot we've ever had in our small plane excursions we have done through the years.  At first, we were told the weather around Mt. McKinley might not be the best and we were a little disappointed, but five minutes later, we were roaring down the runway and toward the mountains.  My husband got to sit in the front and with our headphones on, we could all communicate with each other and Tony gave us a lot of information about what we were doing and where we were heading.  Landing on the glacier was as smooth as could be and we got to spend at least fifteen minutes walking around and snapping photos.  I am a scared flier, but this was even a relaxing time for me.  The whole staff at K2 made this a wonderful experience that will be remembered forever!

review_title: A Magnificent Flight onto Majestic Denali
review_text:
The price of the flight through Denali was well worth the experience with the glacier landing being the high point of the flight.  Pilot Jeff made it personal and most exciting!  The weather was spectacular and after telling 2 other couples our decision, they decided to join us.  Six of us took off on the flight of a lifetime.  Every minute was an adventure.  It was the high point of our 2 weeks in Alaska.

Frank & Kathy C.

review_title: The Best of our trip to Alaska
review_text: I wish you had more stars to rate out K2 Aviation experienced.  It was a once in lifetime experience.  We landed on Pica Glacier on a beautiful sunny day.  We even had a marriage proposal on our flight.  It was perfect.  We spent so much money on our trip we almost didn't book the flight.  No matter what else you do in Alaska book this flight.  To top it off there was a young moose crossing the airport runway.  How perfect is that!!!

review_title: The only way to see Denali
review_text: Expensive but worth it.  What an awesome way to experience Denali together as a family--from ages 82 - 12.  One of the few activities we could all do & make memories together.  If you are wondering if the glacier landing is worth the extra $, it is.  None of us will ever forget this experience; I can already see my kids will be sharing this story with their kids.

We had already taken the bus trip deep inside Denali National Park earlier in our trip but decided that we also wanted to see and experience it by air.  K2 came well recommended from several friends, so we chose them and are glad we did.

We did the Denali Grand Tour with a glacier landing (worth the extra money).

Our pilot, Chris, wasn't the most talkative, but most of us just gaped out the window as the majestic Denali kept looming larger in our windows.  When we had questions, Chris was knowledgeable in his responses and has been flying with K2 for about 10 years.

The closer we came to the mountains, the more unbelievable the views were.  I took many pictures, but none of them do justice to how incredible the actual views were.

We were fortunate that for most of the trip, the mountain was in mostly full view, but by the end of the tour, it was about 50% shouded in clouds.  Regardless, every banked turn showed other incredible vistas.

I asked for, and was granted the opportunity, to sit in the co-pilot's seat so I was able to look out both the front and side windows.  Be sure to find your pilot and ask early because it's first to ask that is granted that privilege.

Take advantage of the waterproof shoes.  You'll need them for a glacier landing.  Also, unless it's a particularly cold day, you don't have to bundle up too warmly for the glacier landing.  I just had on a long sleeved shirt and was comfortable.  But ... if you're cold natured, definitely bring a jacket.

Awesome excursion.

Also, be sure to check for coupons in the Northern Lights Coupon Book.  You can purchase them at any Barnes and Noble in AK and for $55 you will save much more than that on most adventures.

review_title: Amazing service on a bad day for flying
review_text: It was very overcasty and due to so, I was not able to take a glacial landing tour. However the crew was very cordial and did there best, efficiently organizing a 30 minute valley tour-which was fantastic.

We took the glacier landing flight, got a closeup view of McKinley and landed on the Ruth Glacier. Best part was flying over the length of glacier to see the crevases, the rubble, eskers, and the terminus pools and rivers. Nice, efficient operation, safe, expert. Talkeetna is a fun town to explore, great place to meet & chat with Alaskans.

We took the Grand Denali tour with a glacier landing on June 11, 2013.  The entire K2 Aviation staff, from my first contact in December, 2012 through our flight, was knowledgeable, responsive, courteous, and professional in every way.  Stan, our pilot, knew the park and was quite friendly while answering questions.  We had a beautiful day for flying and the flight was smooth coming and going.  I would highly recommend the glacier landing option as we found that to be quite a thrill.  It's hard to explain the feeling of standing outside the plane on a glacier in the middle of Denali National Park on a beautiful day.  We were treated to the extra added bonus of a small avalanche (or snow fall) from a near by cliff.  

The price seems a lot of the surface, but the experience provided great value for the money.  We aren't well off, but this flight was but a small part of the overall expense of our Alaskan vacation.  I'm glad we didn't cheat ourselves of this experience for the sake of a few dollars.

In summary, I highly recommend a flight seeing trip into Denali (including glacier landing) with K2 Aviation.

This company and their pilots are very concerned about safety and the well being of their customers.  The pilot was knowledgeable and friendly.  The views were amazing and he made sure everyone in the plane saw the mountain.  I opted for a glacier landing and that was the best part of the trip, in my opinion.  This company does go above and beyond to be certain you get a good flight and have a good experience.

That flight was amazing. More importantly, the pilot was professional, kind and informative.  It was the best combination for this type of guided tour. The price is a little steep, but after seeing the quality of the plane it made sense. Other companies had planes that were not as well maintained.

review_title: Flying around Denali is a pilot's dream
review_text:
I cannot recommend the K2 experience enough. Both the flying and the views were far beyond my expectations. I am a pilot myself and I have read about bush flying for years which gives me a great appreciation of the difficulty and the skill needed to do what K2's pilots do everyday with charm and grace. Their airplanes are in beautiful condition and several are bush plane "classics" including my favorite, the DeHavilland Beaver which they have on skis and on floats.

I was lucky enough to be able to experience several flights with the K2 team and each was a uniquely wonderful experience. My favorite was the flight around the mountains with the glacier landing in the Beaver but the most spectacular views were from the summit flight in the Navaho twin. 

My first flight was on a sunny, clear day so I chose the "McKinley Flyer with Landing" in the Beaver on skis. After flying over rivers and glaciers and through passes with incredible views our pilot landed smoothly on a glacier at a spot called "Mountain House". This landing spot has spectacular views of Mount McKinley and surrounding peaks. Standing on the glacier gives you a true appreciation of the immensity of the steep cliffs and granite walls. It was overwhelming! K2 also does this flight in the larger DeHavilland Otter which is also on skis and has windows at each seat. An Otter landed near us while I was on the glacier and one of my favorite photos is of this bright red plane against the clean white snow and blue skies of Mountain House.

The weather is very changeable in the mountains, going from low clouds and overcast to open sunny skies and back within a few hours so some flights will see more than others. My second flight was on a day with low clouds so I opted for a Summit flight in the Navaho. The Navaho has oxygen which allows the pilot to fly above the overcast to the same 20,300 ft. altitude as the top of McKinley. On my flight, the peak was poking up above the overcast into sunny skies and we were able to circle the peak several times at varying altitudes. We were close enough to see the climbing routes and high camps. It was amazing and my photos turned out beautifully! On our return the clouds broke up enough to allow the pilot to descend among the peaks and gorges at lower altitudes so we were able to see the Ruth glacier and Mount Hunter before we returned to the airport.

Whether you are a pilot or not, flying with K2 is a wonderful way to see the Alaska range. It is an experience I will never forget!

review_title: Pick your flight carefully if you want to do video or photography
review_text: While I have nothing but really good things to say about the company in general, the plane they chose for our flight left much to be desired as one of my main goals was to take pictures and video. I have never taken a small plane sightseeing flight before, I didn’t realize how critical positioning was if you wish to take photos and video. We flew in a small deHavilland single-engine propeller plane. There were five basic seats for passengers. The only seat that appeared to have good visual access for photography was the front seat on the right next to the pilot. Someone quickly decided he needed that seat because he had a tendency to get “airsick.” I later realized that he must’ve taken flights on this plane before and knew which seek to ask for. The second row of two seats was comfortable, but if you are tall (6 feet) your window is down and behind you. You do have access to see what’s going on through the front windows, but since there is a single propeller, the propeller artifact will be captured in all of your still and video footage. The people in the seats behind the second row seem to be trying to look out our windows so I must assume that their vision was limited too. In the future I would not fly a plane like this without being able to specifically handpick my seat. They had larger planes which seemed to offer individual windows for each passenger, but I assume since there were only five people taking the trip they chose not to take one. That may be the problem with signing up for a flight in advance and paying in advance – you don’t have much control over what plane they choose.  The pilot was great – he made it really easy with a very smooth takeoff, landing, and ride. In the future though I would not reserve a flight without knowing exactly what kind of plane I was going in, what kind of window access I had for photos and video, and see whether or not the propeller would be creating artifacts as well. Apparently we are told that you can only actually get to the top of Denali perhaps one third of the time no matter what type of flight you have signed up for. We had signed up for the Denali flyover and landing on a glacier, but wisely they declined as the weather did not permit it. We did get the proper refund since we had paid for the more expensive trip in advance.  Again, I have the highest regard both for the company and the pilot my complaint is that the plane they chose did not permit me to accomplish what I had wanted to do on the trip – not only see things but take pictures and video as well.  The reason for giving it only 2 stars is that for the price I expected not only to have an interesting flight but have good vision and be easily able to take pictures and video as well. I therefore was disappointed.

Flight was great.  Awesome views and great landing on glacier. Great weather. Would
 do it again. Worth the money.

I knew the first thing I wanted to do when I got to talketna was fly around Mt. Denali.  I had heard good things about k2 and they defiantly didn't disappoint.  There office was easy to find only about 2 blocks away from down town.  When we walked In the staff was very welcoming and accommodating.  We were lucky enough to get right on the next flight. The pilot was very professional and even though the plane was small we had a smooth flight and I felt completely safe the whole time.  It was very clear that day and views from the plane is one of the most incredible things I've  Seen. We flew over Mt. Hunter and the base camp for the climb of Denali we flew around the mountain getting very close to peaks and mountain walls.  Seeing beautiful glaciers and Ice fields.  I would definitely recommend this trip to anyone and would love to do it again with the glacier landing package.

Wow....we were one of the lucky ones to see Mt. McKinley on a clear day.  On Sunday, June 16th, the weather was beautiful and record highs were set, over 90-98 degrees in Talkeetna and clear!  The views of Mt. McKinley were more than awesome from our hotel and unbelievable flying around it and landing on the glacier.  We scheduled our flight and glacier landing for 3:00 pm that day.  Chris W. was our pilot and we felt very safe in his hands.  We took the train and I would suggest staying for 2 days just in case the weather is not cooperating so you have a second chance to fly up the next day.   I would highly recommend K2 Aviation.  The staff was fantastic to work with and we felt very safe in their hands.  It was the highlight of our trip to Alaska to see Mt. Danali on a clear clear day, something I will never forget!!

review_title: Must do! Only way to understand the size of Denali
review_text:
Fly with the best, book with K2 Aviation. This company is professional from general questions before booking to walking away after the flight. They are great people and VERY busy. You may as well be honest about your weight when booking- you will step on a scale prior to boarding for safe balancing of the aircraft.

One of the things I liked best was the flexibility of the operation. I wasn't sure when we were getting to Talkeetna since we were on a cruise ship land tour, so I had booked for 3PM and they happily moved me to the 1PM flight when I got there in the late morning. The weather was cloudy and I was trying to decide if I wanted to gamble on a later flight being better- I think Katie changed me back and forth several times before I settled on the 1PM with her advice (it got worse later so good thing!). Also, you only pay for what you fly- we wanted the glacier landing but the weather wouldn't allow it safely. Had it cleared up, he would have landed. We thought we were only going to get the shorter flight, but the clouds broke up a little and we got the full 1.25hr flight.

Some travelers were on the larger 7 person de Havilland Beaver aircraft, we were lucky enough to be on the small 4 person Cessna 185. I recommend the back seats for better views and photos. The entire fleet is extremely well maintained with all safety equipment and electronic navigation.

We flew over the glaciers and up through mountain passes up to about 6,000 feet; right at the bottom edge of the overcast. The views were amazing and truly the only way to understand the grandeur of Denali and the park. At one point for a few minutes, we could see the very top Denali- it was weird to be at 6,000 feet and be looking up another 15,000 feet at the mountain peak. I felt really small.

Our pilot, Scott, was great; knowledgeable about the area and very safe. It was an excellent day with K2 Aviation in every way.

Landing on Ruth glacier and viewing Mt. McKinley while standing on the glacier was the single greatest travel experience to date for me. The view of the mountains and glaciers from the 10 seat plane is second to none, words cannot describe it! Our pilot Jeff with 23 years experience flying in Alaska was an awesome narrator and host. If you go to Talkeetna, I highly recommend this trip and K2 Aviaton. First rate company and spectacular scenery.  It just doesn't get better than this! I also recommend booking directly with them. We booked through Princess and all we got were the tickets when we arrived at the lodge. We had to get on the shuttle ourselves and walk to K2 on our own. Had we booked directly we would only have had to pay $10 each for the shuttle, otherwise no Princess employee in sight.
We had an amazing flight toward Denali, next to the Moose's Tooth then up the Ruth glacier to land in the amphitheatre.  Very professional and informative. The flight of a lifetime.

One of the most memorable flights I have ever experienced! We flew through and around the mountains adjacent to Mt McKinley......now known by it's original name Denali! We landed on a glacier (smoothly gliding on skids) and were amazed by the spectaclar views from the suface of the glacier and then took off for another thrilling flight back!
Fabulous sights, fantastic service, seeing Mt. McKinley up close and personal was the highlight of our Alaska vacation.  Loved every moment from take off to landing.

We were lucky enough to be in Talkeetna with great weather over McKinley.  Fantastic experience. We did the glacier landing on Ruth Glacier and it was an awesome experience.  Definitely recommend this even though it was pricey. Our pilot, Tony, was really knowledgeable about the history of the mountain and the climbing attempts. One of the passengers, a young man from Turkey, said "This is the greatest thing that had ever happened in his life!"  Everyone on board seemed ecstatic about the flight. Weaving through the mountains was awe inspiring.  We felt very safe and at ease with K2 and Tony.  Thanks!

review_title: McKinley Flightseeing Trip of a Lifetime!!!
review_text:
WOW!!!!!  If you can, come to Alaska just to do this!!!  It will be a highlight of your vacation!!
We will never forget it!!!!!!!!!  Wow!!!  Wow!!!  Wow!!!

(If you can, plan to be in Talkeetna for the day in case an early morning flight is cancelled due to cloud cover)  We were able to fly at noon after the early morning flight was cancelled)

Amazing , one of those things you just have to do to appreciate it.  The flight out to the glacier is beautiful, the size of the mountain range cannot be appreciated from the ground,   As you approach you can see miles of glacier ice.  As you fly into the range you get amazing views.  I got some great video with my i phone on our approach and takeoff from the ruth glacier.
Tony was an extremely knowledgable pilot and gave  a great narrative during the flight.
Charlie

Took the McKinley Flyer tour on June 11. Was a beautiful sunny morning, and our pilot Barry did a great job. Our headset didn't work so well, but it didn't really detract much from the beauty of the scenery and the flight.

This was the biggest thing on my bucket list while in Talkeetna!  Our weather was unbelievable as confirmed by every local we encountered on our Alaskan vacation!!  Our pilot Greg did a great job telling us facts and pointing out hikers, glaciers, and which peaks and summits we were looking at!  My Hero GoPro video camera was suction cup mounted to the side window for most of our tour! Can't wait to get home and watch it again!  The glacier landing was the icing on the cake!  Make your reservation early in your stay and they'll work hard to get you up when the weather is not cooperating, however, we hit a perfectly clear day!!  Not a cloud in the sky!!  Our B&B had a coupon for $25 off.  Every little bit helps!!  Take the tour!  Be wowed the marvel of God's creation!!

The landing on Ruth Glacier and flight seeing around Denali should be on everyone's bucket list!  We had a beautiful day, smooth air, gorgeous views, and excellent pilot, Gregg.  K2 is an experienced company which looks out for its passengers comfort and safety.

Lifetime moments are few and far between.  Our K2Avaition flight seeing tour of Mt McKinley on 5/26/2013 was one of those moments for me and my wife.  The crew at K2 made us feel WELCOME & SAFE.  Thanks for the memory & photos I captured on our flight!

We did the flight seeing and glacier landing with Jeff as our pilot. Our flight was scheduled for 1:00. We got off to a late start only about 20 min delay. The weather was perfect, a bright sunny day with little to no winds once we got above 5000 feet. You could tell Jeff enjoys what he does from the enthusiasm in his narrative to making sure everyone got to see everything. The staff got me ski poles to use on the glacier since I walk with a cane but I didn't really need them. There was enough slush on the glacier to help keep my footing secure. We seemed to be so close to everything since we could see it so well. I highly recommend K2 and Jeff!

Wir haben die mittlere Tour, McKinley Flyer mit Gletscherlandung gebucht. Gegen 19 Uhr ging es bei strahlendem Sonnenschein in Richtung Mt. McKinley. Die Ausblicke waren absolut atemberaubend. Statt auf einem der üblichen Gletscher landeten wir auf dem Kahiltna Glacier, auf dem sich das Base Camp der Bergsteiger befindet. Eine Rangerin hatte ihre Zahnbürste vergessen, die der Pilot ihr brachte. Wir fanden es sehr spannend, das Camp mal aus der Nähe zu sehen und auch hier war die Aussicht wieder grandios. Es ist zwar ein teures Vergnügen, aber aus meiner Sicht jeden Cent wert.

I have a fear of heights and I'm not very interested in flying in a commercial aircraft let alone a 10-seater, but this was by far an amazing experience. The pilot had years of experience and it showed. Friendly staff that give you all the information you need before you fly, they were able to book us for an early afternoon trip the night before. We called an hour before they closed! 

Breath taking views that can only be experienced through a plane. Land on the glacier, its worth the extra fare and they give you the gear you need to keep your feet warm and dry in the snow!

review_title: Flight seeing and glacier landing with K2 Aviaton
review_text: In May 2013  my husband and I took  a flight seeing and glacier landing trip.  At first I was nervous about  flying in a small pane, but once in the air with Jeff,  our  pilot I lost all my  fear!  The  views  were breathtaking!  The  gacier landing  was so smooth and  beautiful, it left me speechless!  The views of Mt. McKinley were stunning!   All the staff were very helpful.  Needless to say we had a great time!

Nous avions réservé un vol avec tour du McKinley et atterrissage sur glacier.
Beau temps au RDV.
Très bon pilote.
A faire sans hésitation si le temps est dégagé.
Le spectacle est magique et l'arrivée sur le glacier reste un grand moment.
C'est une fois dans sa vie, n'hésitez pas.

We loved our flight and glacier landing!  Jeff was fantastic and made the flight a "trip of a lifetime" - he told us it was one of the 60 perfect days they have up by the mountain, and it truly was.  We saw a moose wandering around while waiting for our flight early in the morning, and it just kept getting better!  If you do nothing else in Alaska, do this!  The flight felt super safe, and the landings and take offs were so smooth you could miss it if you weren't watching out the window.  Wow.

review_title: Best Experience and Such Friendly People!!
review_text: Took a bush plane over Denali! The pilot was amazing and the entire staff were welcoming and helpful! I would go back in a heartbeat! The pilot was so good about informing everyone about safety features of the plane and he was a fantastic tour guide! I couldn't have asked for a more amazing experience! Words cannot describe this opportunity and there was no pressure to fly with them over another company! I would absolutely recommend flying with K2 over any other flight service! Prices were great and they have military discounts on flights and apparel! Highly recommended!

When I first reading reviews about a flight around Denali, K2 always seemed well reviewed.  I also struggled to justify the price for the tour.  It's expensive yes.  I must admit it was one of the highlights of my life. I can't imagine going all the way to Alaska and not experienced something so magical.  I know I was lucky with the weather as it was a perfect clear blue sky. Even the pilot was taking pictures when we landed on the glacier.  The whole ride and landing still stirs my emotion weeks later. The planes all seem well maintained and the check-in was quick and easy.  If you have a group of 4, buy the Northern Lights Coupon Book for a Buy 3 get one free.  Just go.

K2 does a great job!  they are profissional and flexible working with climbing teams.  Lots of space in the hanger to rig for an expedition.  friendly and knowledgeable staff.  safe and well maintained airplanes.  Thanks K2

I was in Alaska to celebrate my 70th Birthday and planned an overnight trip to Talkeetna just so I could take a flight to see Mt McKinley and the area around it. I had scheduled a minimal flight due to lack of funds, and at a discount thru K2 Aviation. However, when I arrived at K2’s office I was asked if I would like to join a group that would be landing on a glacier, and for no extra cost. I could hardly contain my excitement. The trip itself was amazing; the sun was shining though Mt McKinley was in a cloud so we could not go around it as planned. We landed on Ruth Glacier and it was just awe inspiring. Our pilot, Chris was a knowledgeable tour guide, and more importantly, a great pilot, and I felt perfectly safe flying over the peaks, ridges and valleys of glaciers. It was such a marvelous experience and it made my entire trip to Alaska. What a wonderful thing the people of K2 did for me, and I’ll certainly never forget them or the trip. I heartily recommend K2 as they definitely are professionals and wonderful people as well.
Great organization ...flights are expensive so go with the best...unbelievable views...great pilot...once in a lifetime experience

Took a flightseeing tour with K2 aviation and landed on Ruth glacier.  Our pilot, Jeff, was extremely knowledgeable and experienced and gave us great information about the mountains and Alaska in general.  Booked it as an excursion offered by our cruise ship and luckily had nice weather and Mt. McKinley was partially visible.  When we were getting off the plane, the on-coming group asked if it was worth it and the unanimous response was "absolutely".

After 5 days of trying to convince my husband to take a flight tour he finally agreed while at McKinley.  He was so happy. He loved every moment and came off the plane with a huge grin. He took the tour that landed on a glacier. Only advice I have is not to book ahead. Wait until you arrive and pick a clear day.  They have lots of flights to accommodate.  This is a definite trip to do. Save money by avoiding other cheesy tours and spend it on this one!

I stopped in a couple of years ago on the Ruth glacier and wanted to go back and camp there overnight. K2 got me up there and back. Very punctual and great pilots with a very comfortable laid back feel to them. All around it was a fantastic trip with nice equipment, and great pilots. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them or use them again. 

The weather could not have been any better but I don't think that K2 can claim the credit for that. We took snow shoes up and hiked over into the next little valley to set up camp. We spent a perfect night out there camped on the glacier and were picked up by K2 the next day. Dropped off in a Beaver and picked up in a C185.

We always take a flight tour when visiting Alaska and have never been disappointed.  K2 Aviation staff were so friendly and our pilot was really good and knowledgeable.  May 14 we were fortunate to be one of the few tourists to ever really see Mt. McKinley as the day was sunny and the weather cooperated beyond any expectation.  We landed on a glacier, got some great pictures, and highly recommend them for a flight tour.  They really want their customers to have a memorable experience and do everything they can to give you a great ride.

Had a great experience at this place. Shop is clean, staff is friendly, tour guide/pilot was knowledgeable. Views were fantastic, loved every minute of it and would recommend it to anyone going to Alaska. Costly but well worth it!

We were blessed with a clear blue sky and a unlimited viewing of the ice fields and mountains in Denali. The pilot was gracious and accomplished. We had a glacier landing which was smooth and memorable.  The pilot even took pictures of us and did a great job describing the mountains and glaciers we viewed. It was the highlight of a wonderful trip to Alaska and if you can fit in a flight seeing tour by every means, do so. It will never be forgotten.

review_title: An excellent way to experience the Alaska range
review_text: Great pilots and a friendly knowledgeable staff to get you in and out of the Alaska range. Ive flown with them for 3 years and always look forward to seeing the familiar friendly folks at K2. Whether its a sightseeing tour of Denali or a way to access the greatest mountain range in N. America, K2 will not disappoint.

review_title: Awesome flight and glacier landing on Mt. McKinley
review_text: The four of us took the McKinley tour and Ruth Glacier landing.  The pilot,Tony was skillful, friendly, informative and precise.  The mountains were awesome, the flight was smooth as the weather was ideal on May 19 2013.

review_title: Probably the Coolest Thing I've Ever Done!
review_text:
The title says it all, this experience was probably the coolest thing I've ever done.

My son and I went on the mid-level priced Denali/McKinley tour in late April of 2013.  The operation is clearly well run, and I never once worried about safety.

Our pilot, Scott, was fantastic and we both loved the experience.  It truly left me almost speechless.
Enjoyed this flight to McKinley and Denali. The pilot was an artist, he was so smooth. Everything about this flight-seeing trip was outstanding.

A must for Alaskians that have company from the lower 48.  We want to take everyone now.  Totally worth the cost!!!  We went on a very clear day in Early April.  Our pilot was professional and knowledgeable.  I have already recommended this to all my friends.

I had my 14 yr old daughter and 12yr old son in Alaska for spring break, adventure style. 
We used K2 Aviation on a recommendation.  They were extremely friendly and accommodating.  We did the Denali Grand Tour but the weather on the North Face side was a little iffy so they modified it slightly which turned out to be great.  The pilot, Randy, was awesome and informative about all the sites. Questions that my kids or I asked were all answered and he had great stories to tell during the flight. 
We were lucky in that there was minimal cloud coverage so we had a great view of McKinley and other places. The landing on Ruths glacier was fantastic and more than worth it. This experience was the highlight of the trip for the kids!

Two things I had to do in Alaska, travel to the Arctic Circle, check, and land on a glacier.  We used K2 Aviation and we so happy with them.  It is cloudy and we were worried the trip wouldn't happen but a break in the weather and we were off.  We only saw Denali through the clouds but Ruth Glacier was in the sun.  The landing was exciting and the views from the glacier are spectacular.  We were able to walk around some, take lots of pictures.  Even saw some hikers dropped off and they headed towards the mountains for a hike and mountain climbing.  There is a little hut on top of a peak near Ruth were they stay overnight apparently.  Flying back to Talkeetna you see the glacier go from total snow and ice to just dirt and little pools of water.  Don't ever go to Alaska without taking this magnificent trip!

It is no surprise that they got the Best Flightseeing Tour award for three years in row (from what I know, they might get more than three times!) from the Anchorage Daily News. They are customer-friendly business. The pilot is informative, and told us about the mountains, glaciers formation and many others. I will definitely recommend this activity to whoever that comes to Alaska. No regret!

Our party of 4 ended up in Talkeetna on a cloudy day in the winter. I was bummed that we wouldn't see McKinley. Garret was willing to work with us on the hourly rate to get us up in the air. Despite the miserable day (cloud cover at 2500 feet over talkeetna) , our pilot Randy found some spots of clear weather in the mountains that really opened up the view. The view is truly awe-inspiring. Randy pointed out the Don Sheldon mountain house and it gives a true sense of scale to the epic peaks surrounding it. It's easy to misjudge size and depth perception when you're in the valley of these giants. The Don Sheldon house certainly put it back in perspective.

Flight-seeing is definitely worth it and i would recommend K2 for willing to put us up there, not pushing us to go (we could have rolled our deposit to another day), and working with us on the rate.

Excellent and well worth the money.  Wonderful folks to deal with, very accommodating  and knowledgeable.  I thought it was a great deal for a well narrated tour, the pilot was great and easily answered any questions personably plus added in things like history, geology, etc.  Know when you go that the weather is unpredictable and changes rapidly so good communication is key.  I most wholeheartedly recommend this as a must do if in Alaska, you won't regret it or the money spent as you will remember this for the rest of your days.

review_title: Battesimo del volo in Alaska! / First flight in a small private plane in Alaska!
review_text:
Nel nostro soggiorno a Talkeetna abbiamo voluto prendere il K2AVIATION nonostante il tempo non permetteva di avvicinarsi alla montagna Mt McKinley e non avendo più giorni per aspettare le condizioni meteo favorevoli siamo saltati a bordo per un volo di battesimo sui piccoli aerei turistici in attesa del volo previsto ad Homer per il bear adventure... Abbiamo sorvolato la foresta ed una miriade di fiumi ad un prezzo ridotto ($90). Ci hanno fatto pesare prima per questioni di sicurezza e ci hanno dato tutte le informazioni sul volo che mi ha tranquillizzato. Esperienza positiva grazie al personale competente ed efficiente. Ma vale la pena solo se si è così fortunati da poter volare sulla montagna che sembra accada solo al 30% dei visitatori!....
----
During our stay in Talkeetna we decide to take a flight with K2AVIATION, even if it was too cloudy to see the famous Mt. McKinley; it seems that only 30% of visitors get to see the mountain!!!…. They emphasized safety, made us weigh in for the plane loading and explained everything necessary for a safe flight. So we felt pretty secure and got our first flight in a small private plane, for a special low price, over the town and the surrounding rivers and forest. It was a great adventure, the pilot talked about the area we were seeing but I still feel sorry about missing the great mountain… Next time!

review_title: It Rained But Still Had Fun
review_text: I booked the glacier landing flight for my husband and I. From all of the great reviews on Tripadvisor I was really looking forward to it. Unfortunately it was raining that day we had booked for. When we arrived for our flight the K2 staff was helpful, upbeat and they talked to us about the options that we had for the flight since the original plan to fly around Denali and glacier landing was a no-go due to the weather. We opted to still go up and fly. We took a shorter flight that went around the Talkeenta mountain range. K2 credited us for the original flight and charged us much less for the new flight. They were easy to work with due to the change that had to be made because of the weather. The plane was clean, easy to get in and out of, spacious and our pilot was great. He talked about the areas that we flew over and about the terrain that we were seeing. It was a great adventure to see what we did. Overall I was disappointed in mother nature - but not K2. They are a great group of people!

If you are in Alaska, K2 Aviation in Talkeetna is a "must go" excursion.  It begins with a visit with friendly and helpful staff on the ground and ends with an awe inspiring trip to the skies.  The planes are clean, comfortable, and easily accessible for everyone.  The knowledgeable pilots guide you as you glide over the heights and sights of majestic Mt. McKinley.  How many people do you know who have walked on a glacier!!!  It will be a trip you will never forget!!!

Just, ermuhgawd WOW. Our pilot flew us right up to McKinley. The pictures and memories I have are for a lifetime. GO! Pretty drive from Anchorage to Talkeetna, too. Seriously, there are no words. You just need to go.

review_title: K2:  Denali up close and personal
review_text:
While recently visiting Talkeetna from Venezuela, South America, we were privileged to contract the excellent aviation services of K2.  Our pilot Scott flew us up close and personal with the Athabaskan Great One and its granitic pluton court, landing us on the "windex blue and tic tac white"  Ruth Glacier where "the affairs of men never reach."  Crisp air and a clear view:  "everything so quiet and empty" and yet so suddenly full.  

Our return to Talkeetna was argued by poplars, lakes, muskeg, swans and bear.  Reason creates its own moraine and landscapes are forever changed.  Thank you Scott!  Thank you K2 for allowing us to fly with you!!

Let me preface this by stating that I am not a big fan of small planes.  I had a very uncomfortable close call experience while flightseeing over Angel Falls in Venezuela,  so I had some trepidation prior to our K2 tour to see the glaciers.  That trepidation was erased roughly 1 minute into the flight; once we were airborne, I got a sense for what a treat was in store.  The pre-flight safety precautions and impeccably maintained plane, coupled with our very knowledgeable and friendly pilot Scott put me at ease immediately.  Prior to our K2 flight, I thought I had already been awed by what AK had to offer, but Denali and surrounding areas are so much more breathtaking from the air.   The views were even more unforgettable thanks to Scott who answered all of our questions  and provided insightful information about the history, geology, and wildlife of the area.  
Thanks to K2 and our pilot Scott for an unforgettable experience!!!

We lucked out with a fabulously clear day. Chris, our pilot, was funny and receptive to guest concerns and the whole experience was easy and fun! We will never forget this magical ride to denali and around its jaw-droppingly beautiful peaks and glacial valleys. Thank you, K2, for a wonderful time out of Talkeetna!!

review_title: Absolutely the very best part of our Alaska trip!
review_text: You absolutely cannot visit Alaska and Denali National Park without taking a flightseeing tour -- and K2 is the BEST, bar none.  We talked to many others in the area and everyone raves about them because they specialize in the tour experience, not just ferrying climbers (though they are popular for doing that too).  The pilot who gave our tour was not only a skilled aviator but also extremely knowledgeable about the history and science of the area, telling great stories and pointing out fascinating points of interest through the pilot headsets we all wore. Takeoff and landing was smooth and we never felt nervous or airsick at all -- such a lovely flight!  The office staff was so friendly and helpful, and extremely flexible if you need to reschedule your tour due to weather as we did -- we found out that the summit of Mt. McKinley is only visible 30% of the time due to weather, but they are great about offering other options or rescheduling your flight, etc. And the aircraft is gorgeous, spotlessly maintained and comfortable. Even if you don't see the summit there is SO MUCH incredible stuff to see in the park on your flight.  There are things we saw on this tour that very few people will ever see and that will take your breath away -- 35-mile-long glaciers, sheer cliff amphitheaters, passes so dramatic it feels like your wingtips will scrape the sides (they're not even close, but it feels that way!), the Great Gorge that's deeper than the Grand Canyon, glacial pools that are literally Windex blue, ice crevasses and ice falls, on and on.  Of course if the weather is nice as it was for us, you'll see Mt McKinley (Denali), the highest summit in North America and and the rest of the range (Foraker-Denali's Wife and Hunter-Denali's child) and probably ask yourself who would be crazy enough to climb those things (a thousand try every spring, and less than half make it!).  Even my teenage kids were speechless and taking photos nonstop -- if you're a photographer you better bring an extra memory card!  And the optional glacier landing is a MUST -- we will never forget landing on skis and walking around on an actual glacier in the shadow of the most dramatic mountain scenery anywhere.  This is a trip of just a few hours that we will NEVER, never forget. Worth every penny and more!

This summer I was able to experience the K2 aviation staff, service, safety, and their desire to provide an excellent adventure.  The office was a pleasant experience as we checked in with good conversation about our upcoming flight which built on to the excitement.  There was great emphasis on safety as they made us weigh in for the plane loading and the pilot (Scott) explained everything necessary for a safe flight right as we stood around the plane.  I was impressed that this was a priority as I just expected to get on a plane and go.  The plane was very clean on the outside and inside which added to the assurance that K2 took care of their equipment meticulously.  We also were given a lot of information about the plane itself, when it was made, etc. which we all found interesting.  So before we even started the flight we felt safe and had a little history lesson.  The flight itself was absolutely amazing.  Our pilot gave us a ton of information as we watched in awe at the size of the rivers and mountains, the colors of the glaciers and glacier water, and marveled at the muskeg and forest in the area.  We flew through a  pass that had sheer cliffs on both sides which made me think of how small the mountains in my home state of Wyoming are compared to the Alaskan landscape.  We landed on a glacier which was really exciting and something that I will never forget.  We had a lot of time to take pictures and talk about the surrounding mountains and features which was great.  It wasn't just a land, take a pic, and leave type of thing.  We took a different route back to the airport than what we took on the way up to the glacier.  That was nice because we saw twice the country.  We saw a black bear that was dark as night on the return and learned that you can see moose and Dall sheep also.  The kids absolutely loved every single second of the experience.  If you are planning a flight tour you should not chance any service other than K2.  K2 is excellent in service, safety, and the experience.  Choose K2 and you won't be disappointed.

We booked a flight and glacier landing with K2 Aviation in early Septmeber.  The afternoon of our original reservation, we were surrounded by rain and fog.  When we contacted K2 that afternoon, they were very accomodating and allowed us to move the tour to the next morning.  What a difference!! The clouds parted and we had clear blue skies.  While they were not able to land on the glacier due to recent snowfall, they gave us the choice of adding time to the tour.

Jeff, our pilot was very friendly and professional.  He gave us sufficient time to take pictures before and after the trip.  Jeff and the DeHavilland Otter that we flew in gave us a wonderful, smooth flight that was simply breathtaking.

If you are ever in Talkeetna, you have got to try this!

We booked with K2 because of their availability of flights at different times during the day. With a 4yr old, flexibility is important for me. The first day we went, it was cloudy, but K2 offered us many options - we chose to reschedule to another day, taking a chance on our drive back from Denali NP. That was a wonderfully sunny day and the flight was superb! Our pilot never hurried us up, and we had an excellent time. The high one was happy and so was the 4yr old!

We were "in the clouds" both figuratively and in reality.  The day was less than ideal and we knew we would not see Mt Mckinley, so K2 gave us option to cancel.  Thankfully, we did not, as the flight was amazing and we are still talking about the blue ice pools, Ruth Glacier, the views, and the total excitement of the flight!!!  Greg, our pilot, was great:  informative, fun and obviously a qualified professional.  Truly, the entire group of employees, owners included,  were above reproach.  Pleasant, cooperative and dedicated to pleasing every customer, even one old grouch that had a problem (which was with his cruise line, not K2.)  The facility is upscale and beautiful.  Awesome experience.  We repeat:  TOTALLY AWESOME!!!  One of many happy memories of this South Carolina couple's trip to Alaska.    Thank you K2 of Talkeetna.  You have a super, well-run business.  Incidentally, we were fortunate to see Mt McKinley (we prefer "Denali") from MP 135, in all its glory.

review_title: Awesome flight, even more awesome staff and crew
review_text: We booked our McKinley Experience tour months before our vacation and planned a 3 day stay in Talkeetna.  The day of our arrival, it was raining, although K2 was still running flights.  They gave us the option of postponing for better weather (it was our first day in town) or going for it.  Originally, we decided to go for it.  We got into the plane (just us and the pilot) and made it all the way to the runway, when another pilot already out in the park called in to say that the visibility was worse due to low clouds.  Our pilot stopped the plane and gave us the option of coming back another day - this time we took them up on it.  We got back to the office and they advised us that Saturday's weather forecast was much better, and they were more than happy to reschedule us for that day.  Turned out to be a spectacular day.  We were with another couple this time, but we all had window seats and the views were out of this world.  Our pilot (wish I could remember his name) was wonderful - pointed out all the various mountains and points of interest.  The flight was very smooth and I never once felt sick (I'm not the greatest flyer).  I'd do it again in a heartbeat.  These people are truly professionals and care very much about providing a great experience.  Would definitely recommend.  In fact, I'd say it's a "must do" while in Alaska!

Well worth the money to enjoy this once in a lifetime experience.  We have done flightseeing tours in planes and helicopters elsewhere and enjoyed them immensely so this was an easy sell for us.  You cannot get the same experience without seeing it from the air.  We had some mechanical problems with our first plane but the staff were very accommodating and got us up in another plane ASAP.  Very professional, focused on safety and knowledgable about the terrain.  Have a good camera ready for some of the best scenary you'll see in Alaska.

Before my Princess Inside Passage Cruise I booked a flight for four around McKinley with K2. I told them specifically where I was staying and was told they provided transport to/ from my lodging to their facility.

Upon arriving in Talkeetna, the day before our flight with my wife, 83 year old father in law, and his 79 year old friend , I stopped into the K2 office to confirm our appointment and pick up. The weather was very rainy with a forecast for more rain and high wind on our flight day. They assure me all was confirmed and that they would pick us up half an hour before our scheduled time to fly.
When leaving Talkeetna by Princess bus to our accommodations ,I discovered we were staying about an hour away from K2, and became concerned about our pick up time for our flight the next morning.  I again contacted K2 again to confirm a time.  This time I mention my concern for the timing of their pickup and my distance away from them.
This time, however , K2 told me they only do pick ups within ten minutes of their facility and it was my responsibility to get all four people to their office by eight am.  
I asked for k2 to call us to let us know if the flight would occur to save us the expense ($10 each) and hassle of a early morning hour long shuttle ride.  They said we needed to physically be in their facility by 8 am....and we're unwavering .
  My understanding was that if we did not show our fee would be forfit regardless of the weather.

When we all showed up at 8 am , in pouring rain, they canceled our epic flight and offered a flight of the town instead , at the same price.  We were not interested in this and so they refunded our fee.  The atmosphere in the office was sullen and quite.

I'm a fairly easy going person but non the less found the staff at K2 to be unfriendly , unhelpful, and unconcerned with 
My needs as a customer.  We talked to friends in our tour group who had booked with other groups and had much clearer and better service.  
After our canceled flight we went to the Roadhouse for breakfast and coffee to warm our bones and were thrilled by the friendly staff there.

WOW!!!  What a wonderful flight we had with our pilot, Chris, as we explored the glaciers and mountains around Mt. McKinley with K-2 Aviation and then landed on a glacier.  It was breathtaking. We had one of those rare sunny days.  Chris made us all feel comfortable and safe and we each had a window seat.  It was truly amazing.  Thanks for the memory of a lifetime!

We scheduled this because reviewers said that if you don't take a flight you might not ever SEE the mountain.  We wound up with a gorgeous day, flying around glaciers,sheer peeks, and of course, the mountain top. Best part of our trip.

review_title: Thanks K2 for a great experience!
review_text: We flew with K2 on August 18th.  We were scheduled to circle the mountain and land on a glacier.  Although the weather in Talkeetna was nice, the mountain was surrounded with low clouds, eliminating the glacier landing and the views of surrounding peaks, valleys, and glaciers.  On their suggestion (with no pressure) we opted to fly south and that was a great choice!  Our pilot (Mike) was great and the scenery just spectacular.  Someday we will return to fly around Mt McKinely with K2, but the memories and photos from this first trip are amazing!  Thanks K2 for a great experience! This is a well run operation that really cares about their customers and works hard to give everyone an amazing adventure!

We really lucked out on the day we had planned to go flightseeing to Mt. McKinley with K-2 Aviation.  It was beautiful with sunshine and blue sky. The K-2 shuttle picked us up at our lodge and took us to the airport. They checked us in and we waited on the deck until our pilot came to get us. Remember how they asked your weight when you made your reservations for this? Well, they weigh you again when you get there and you have to hold everything you plan to take with you-like cameras or coats. There is a locked bin for folks to leave backpacks and so forth.  Our pilot was Tony and 3 other couples went with us. Tony did a great job of telling us about the flight and then of taking us up-very smooth-and telling us what we were seeing.  Words or my pictures do not do justice to what actually happened. It was the trip of a lifetime! It was not scary-it was awesome. Don't miss a chance to do this. And BTW, should I go back to Alaska again, I will do the glacier landing!

This was the highlight of our Alaska trip.  Well worth the money.  It was a beautiful clear day and we could see Mt.Mckinley from Anchorage, so my husband, my parents and I rented a car and drove  (approx 2 hours) back to Talkeetna just to do the flight and glacier landing. I am so glad we did. Our pilot "Doug" was amazing!!!  We took so many beautiful pictures and my husband shot some great videos as well. We would pay to do this again today, that is how much we loved it!

While visiting talkeetna, I took their 2 hour flight around the McKinley mountain. Landed on a glacier and took in breathtaking scenery. Very reliable company, great equipment, great pilots. Office staff was nice.
What a thrilling excursion!!! The sights, the pilot, the trip...were all outstanding. The weather was perfect and were were able to land on the glacier. Highly recommend.

We did the “Denali Grand Tour”, due to weather condition it was not clear till last moment if we can do this specific tour. However, the sky cleared a bit and we were able to do the tour. We went above the clouds and saw the top of the mountain floating above the clouds and then the clouds totally dissipated. The views were spectacular
The best part of my trip to Alaska was the k2 flightseeing with the glacier landing.  Everybody at k2 was so friendly and the flight was great, Can't say enough.
Did the flight seeing with glacier landing while in Talkeetna.  K2 was the best!  They are located right in town and run tours all day.  Fantastic views. A must do can't wait to go back.

We decided last minute to do a flightseeing tour, and I'm so glad we flew with K2. We chose the glacier landing, which I highly recommend. Our pilot (Mike) was great. I was nervous to be on such a small plane, but I felt very safe and relaxed the whole time. The views were breathtaking, and I will never forget the feeling of stepping foot on a glacier, surrounded by snow and mountains.

I booked this flight on my own after reading other reviews and travel books. This was the highlight of our vacation. The K2 staff was extremely friendly and helpful. We had a slight delay due to some bad weather earlier in the day but our views and our pilot were well worth the weight. We were impressed by our pilots experience and his commentary. The weather was great and the views were breathtaking. We got to land on a glacier and saw another plane land next to us! 
Talkeetna was a cute town. I wish we had spent more time there

review_title: Breathtaking Views not to be missed
review_text: When in Talkeetna, don't miss taking a plane ride over the mountains and over the glaciers.  I never knew there were so many beautiful glaciers and this plane ride gets you in touch with the world.  Never actually saw the top of McKinley because the clouds covered the top 4,000 feet, but we did see up to 16,000 feet.  Incredible!  We flew for 1 hour and 45 minutes and this flight was well worth the money.  Our pilot MIKE had a great sense of humor and gave us complete comfort in his flying skills.

We scheduled this with K2 through Alaska Tour and Travel at the beginning of the year and were glad we did. We were a little nervous about flying in a small 59 year old plane but were very impressed with our pilot's (Greg)experience/hours  of flying. The weather was not very good so we could not land on a glacier and we were so looking foward to it after seeing many from a distance by bus car and boat. Took more pictures on this flight than we did at any other time while in Alaska for 10 days. Worth the money

review_title: The best way to see Mt. McKinley!
review_text: My sister and I did this flight on our second day in Alaska and after traveling 1200 miles in one week, we are still very happy we spent the money to see Denali close up like this.  It was well worth the extra dollars to land on the glacier.  Taking off and landing that close to shear rock was very exciting.  The pilot was very safe and gave us a great flight making sure we had plenty of views of the mountain.  My sister even got to ride co-pilot on the way home.

What an adventure, a 2-hour flight trip from Talkeetna, about 185 miles around Mt. McKinley on August 6, with clear skies! It couldn't get any better! We had a very smooth ride in a 6-passenger plane, everyone with their own window. And the pilot made sure that both sides could see everything.

Just like the Grand Canyon, you have to get up close to experience it all fully! Taking the Denali Grand Tour all the way around Mt. McKinley with the Glacier Landing is definitely worth the extra cost! We took movies on our camera and glad we did!

This is a once-in-a-lifetime adventure we'll never forget!

My husband and I had a fabulous trip to Alaska and just got back few days ago. One of the highlights of our trip was the McKinley flightseeing tour. We had reservations to do the 8.30 am McKinley flyer but due to bad weather that trip was cancelled. The staff at K2 Aviation were amazing and rescheduled us for the 10.30 am trip. We checked in around 10 am and they said they were not sure if the trip would happen due to the bad weather, but around 10.25 they said they were going to do the McKinley Summit trip, and upgraded us to that trip. We were so thrilled about this and can't say enough of the staff, they were incredible and very helpful and wanted to make sure that we had an excellent experience. We highly recommend K2 Aviation for any flight seeing trips. They have excellent customer service and are very focused on the customer's experience. Very cordial and friendly too. Few weeks ago when I called to make reservations they were very helpful with not only information regarding the flight seeing but also general information about where to stay, eat etc in Talkeetna. Our pilot Barry was the best and we had the smoothest flight in the smallest airplane we've even been on...The flight seeing trip coincided with my birthday and I couldn't be happier to have enjoyed the majestic views of Mt. McKinley sandwiched between clouds! Thank you K2!

We recently spent 12 days in Alaska and the #1 highlight was a flight out of Talkeetna to view Mt. McKinley and a landing on a glacier with Jeff from K2 Aviation. The flight was simply awesome and a photographers dream come true. I took 50 pictures of some of the most amazing glaciers, mountains, a moose and of course Mt. McKinley. If you get to Talkeetna don't miss this opportunity. We flew in a 10 passenger De Haviland Otter which was very comfortable and safe for a great adventure.

We couldn't have asked for more....flight is life changing!!!  Weather was perfect for flight.  Our pilot, Ed, was so knowledgeable and friendly...if there were any doubts or nervousness about flying in a smaller plane, he erased all thoughts.  We flew  around Mt. McKinley and surrounding mountains; saw glaciers and all of Nature's mountain glories.  Company stored our packbacks etc. in a secure storage bin while we were on flight and also drove us to our hotel in Talkeetna.  Highly recommend this venture....this COMPANY.  Beatty Houston Texas
My whole family took the McKinley Experience August 13. It was the highlight of our trip! It is definitely worth landing on the glacier. K2 Aviation was an excellent company to fly with!

review_title: K2, No better way to see Denali!
review_text:
No matter how many bus trips you take or walking tours or ranger presentations you experience, you will never fully grasp the grandeur, the beauty, the breath-taking topography of Denali, until you fly up to the mountain with K2. You will not even scratch the surface of what is there to be seen.  The nearest road is miles away, and it would take you weeks to hike in, and then you would only see a very small portion of the mountain.
K2's outstanding bush pilots know every part of the mountain and will show you things you only read about like the "10,000 Foot Camp", the "West Butress", or "The Moose's Tooth". 
They have a trip for every level of adventurer and every budget.
Bring your camera, there is no better way to see Alaska.  This will be the highlight of your trip, the one thing you will remember always about your time in Alaska.

WOW! We had a great time flying up to a Glacier behind Mt. Duncan and land on it. The pilot Mike was very informative and knowledgable. 
We flew about 7:00 PM and Denali was visible the entire time. Truely beautiful views of the terain and mountains and Summit of Denali.
We had a great time! The flight was smoothe and lasted about 2 hours including the stay on the glacier.

You know fickle Alaska weather can be. Out flight-seeing trip (with glacier landing) was postponed 3 times before we were able to make the trip. After being cursed by bad weather, low clouds, and poor visibility for 3 days, my wife and I rescheduled one final time for first flight out of the morning we were supposed to leave Talkeetna. When we woke up, the entire area was blanketed in fog so we went back to bed. The a peek of blue sky appeared through the window and when I looked out...wham the sky was clearing fast.
