We scarfed down breakfast, loaded the car and headed to the airport to see if we could make the flight. By the time we reached the airport, the fog was gone and there wasn't a cloud in the sky. 

The flight went off as planned and we were in the first aircraft to land on the glacier that morning. The upper level winds were calm which permitted flight close to the snow-covered sheer mountain walls...what a sight to behold!

This tops one of the best adventures I've ever had and I highly recommend K2. Everyone was great, informative, and professional.

review_title: Viewing Mt. Mckinley in a spectacular way
review_text: It was a memorable flight over Mt. McKinley, surrounding mts and glaciers.  We took the Green Tour....a once in a lifetime experience. K2 is the Best!!  We highly recommend this company.

We booked the McKinley Flyer tour with glacier landing through K-2 Aviation in Talkeetna, AK.  Absolutely AMAZING!!  If you are debating the glacier landing - DO IT!  Yes, you see a lot of glaciers in Alaska, and people say if you've seen one, you've seen them all.  So not true!  Our pilot was great, telling us everything we were seeing!  The staff at K-2 was wonderful!  We actually had to reschedule because of weather and they were more than accommodating!  This also gave us another chance to "hang out" in Talkeetna ~ what a great little place.  We highly recommend any of K-2's flight seeing tours, and will do it again when we go back to Alaska!

A highlight of our week-long Alaska trip.  A K2 floatplane took us on an up-close tour of the glacier landscape on the south side of Denali with a very informative narrative by our pilot, Stan, of how the landscape was and still is forming.  We then landed on a lake at the terminus of Backside Glacier.  There, our group of four was turned over to two guides who led us on a beautiful one-hour hike in the glacier valley.  The guides were experts in the geology, flora, and fauna of the area and we learned a lot.

I highly recommend this adventure.

review_title: Great fly over and around McMckinley
review_text: The trip was much more than expected.  It was like a 360 panaramo show but real.  The ride included a total ride around the mountain thru the valleys and fjords, dropping down and along the mountain cliffs.  A great day!

Departed the McKinley Lodge @ 7:00 AM for the best breakfast @ the Roadhouse Cafe in
Talkeetna before walking over to K2 Aviation for the best excursion of our Alaskan vacation.
We had booked this tour online months before our arrival.  To our surprise we were offered
a float plane ride which took off from nearby Fish Lake (away from the airport) and carried only
six passengers plus the pilot.  Jeff Babcock was our experienced pilot and guide and he did a terrific job of narrating sights, points of interest, and our location at all times.  If you are the least bit nervous about flying small planes (I am scared of heights), this was safe and comfortable . . . plus the take off and landing was so smooth on the water.  This was our splurge tour of the trip . . . we knew we would never see God's beautiful, awesome creation unless we took to the skies.  It was AMAZING!!!  We flew over Moose Field, the Ruth Glacier,
the Great Gorge, the Don Sheldon Ampitheater, viewed the southern face of Mt. McKinley,
Mt. Foraker, Mt. Hunter, Mt. Silverthrone, Harper Glacier from the top, Kahitna Glacier,
Traleka Glacier, Mt. Dickey and Moose's Tooth before returning to Fish Lake.  We felt like National Geographic Explorers flying over ancient territory!  Don't forget your camera!!
We took this tour on July 24, 2012 and allotted approximately 2.45 hours.
K2 Aviation is welcoming, organized, accommodating, well-staffed, clean, provides indoor restrooms as locked storage for backpacks.  Thanks, Jeff, we would take this tour again!

The Glacier Landing Explorer land tour was everything we expected and MORE!  The people at the "little airport" were very courteous and accommodating -- when we arrived to check-in, we were two hours early, so as we were heading back to town, they offered to drive us there - and then come pick us up when we called.  The plane was wonderful - EVERYONE had his own window through which to take unencumbered pictures.  Our pilot was very accommodating - willing to make an extra pass beside certain views so that we could catch a scene we may have missed.  He was informative and entertaining, also.  And of course, the flight and the glacier landing itself was AWESOME!  This was the highlight "tour" of our 10-day Alaska visit.

I would advise anyone who visits Talkeetna to take a trip if a life time with K2 Aviation. I don't like to fly that much but I couldn't believe how smooth the ride was. The scenery can never be matched in your lifetime! Our pilot, Chip was amazing. Make the most of you visit and take a ride you'll never forget!

I was not sure when i booked the trip if this tour was for me. After the trip and 300 pics i think it was more then worth it. May have been the best part of my trip got to see more of alaska then i ever thought i would.

We had planned to take a flight trip months before our actual trip. Unfortunatly it was raining and cloudy the day of our trip. We talked to the people in the office and they let us move our reservation later in the day, in hopes that it would clear up. It did stop raining and the clouds cleared up a little. They were very professional and said they were still flying but we would not get to see the peak due to the remaining clouds. They showed us on a map the alternative route that they would take and were able to show us pictures of what we would be able to see. This was very helpful when making the decision since we had never done this before. Since we were only in Talkeetna that day, we decided to take the flight even though we knew we would not get to see the full moutain. We saw amazing glaciers and scenery. The pilot really wanted to give us a great experience, so he kept us up for 2 hours trying to get the best view for us (we only paid for the 1 hour tour). They were very professional and upfront about the weather and the experience we would have.  At any point we could have backed out and gotten a full refund due to the weather. Regardless of the weather, we had an amzing time! I was nervous about flying in such a small plane, but the ride was more smooth than a big plane, and not nearly as scary as I thought it would be.  It was a great experience!

We had a 9am flight on 7/18/12 and the weather was perfect. We could see Mt McKinely on our drive up. We choose the grand tour with a glacier landing and wow did things work out for us. We got some incredible photo's.

K2's pilot was expeienced and professional. He had flown since the 70's, I think he said. He narrated during the flight.

This trip was perfect and will be repeated in a future visit to Alaska.

My husband insisted on a flight seeing tour of Denali with a glacier landing. I was apprehensive until I met the staff and our pilot Chris at K2. He was charming and competent. The planes are clean, office staff great and the tour itself was amazing. I am so glad we chose K2 and would recommend this company to anyone. Be sure to take time to see Talkeetna while you are there.

We were very pleased with K2 Aviation.  We did not have a reservation, but they were able to fit us on a flight.  Our pilot Tony did an excellent job pointing things out.  He helped to make this wonderful trip even better.  The views, planes and staff were very professional.  The glacier landing was breathtaking!  Amazing!!!

review_title: A breathtaking view of Mt. McKinley/Denali
review_text: We had an amazingly clear day to take this one hour flight close to the mountain and over the nearby glaciers.  My husband was very leery about flying in an 8 passenger prop plane, but it was very smooth, he calmed down, and we had great views of the entire vista.  The pilot was friendly and informative.  For us, it was an incredible, breathtaking experience to get so close to Mt. McKinley, the other mountains ranges and Ruth Glacier.  Although this was fabulous for us, I am not sure that I would have had as incredible time had the weather been cloudy or rainy.

It was great that we were able to monitor the weather up to 2 hours before reserving our flight. It was amazing. Our pilot was courteous and resourceful. Most of all skilled. We picked the perfect clear day with minimal clouds. We flew around Denali and landed on a glacier. We spent about 20 minutes on the glacier. Fabulous views. Expensive but worth the experience.

Our K2 flight was booked through Alaska Tour and Travel.  When we got to Talkeetna and I called to confirm our flight, I made an upgrade for a glacier landing.  Down in Talkeetna, it was very cloudy and we weren't sure whether we can do a landing.  But i went ahead and put in for the upgrade.  We were picked up by the K2 van from our hotel and took us directly to their office.  We got Jeff Babcock as our Pilot.  While we were airborne, he explained the path that we took and pointed out a few interesting sites.  As we turned in the corner, wow, there was Mt. McKinley.  It was amazing!  Unfortunately, we didn't get to do the glacier landing due to the weather condition.  Cloud was starting to roll in.  Pilot Jeff said:  "safety first".  I totally understood what he meant.  My husband and I were very happy to do this flight.  Although it was cloudy down in the valley, it was very bright and sunny beyond the clouds.  The view from above was just MAJESTIC!  This is a highly recommended activity to try.  It was my first time in a tiny plane (4 passengers) and i was very comfortable.  Pilot Jeff took care of us.  Pilot Jeff, thank you for a memorable flight!!!

We had booked a grand tour with glacier landing a few months before we travelled. Unfortunately when we arrived in Talkeetna for our flight the weather was not the best. However we were very impressed with K2 Aviation, they explained the situation to us and we were given a choice of taking a different trip as no glacier landings were possible. We decided to fly as we preferred to see something then not go at all. We were refunded the difference between our tours without even asking and our refund was waiting for us when we returned from our flight. We were asked to wait until it was clear to fly. Our pilot was Chuck and he did a fabulous job, we were so glad we waited and went on the 2 hour flight, the snow capped mountains and glaciers were amazing, we even got a glimpse of Mt. Mckinley. This company is very professional and obviously concerned for the safety of their passengers. They do their best to provide you with the best flight possible to suit the weather conditions.

review_title: Tom and Beth's amazing Alaskan adventure - Talkeetna flightseeing
review_text: Our flight seeing tour was more limited than originally planned due to the visibility, but we saw beautiful glacial formations nonetheless. Staff was amazingly well-informed and well-prepared, and we enjoyed the experience start to finish.

Our week in Alaska was fantastic and the flight to Mt. McKinley was the highlight. Chris is a great pilot and very knowledgeable about the mountains and surrounding areas. Every one at K2 Aviation was welcoming and friendly. A truly great experience and we would do it again. We will definitely recommend this awesome excursion to friends and others planning a trip to Alaska.
Jim & Linda Colglazier

review_title: Flight was like a glorious dream; you MUST do this!
review_text:
Our pilot, Jeff B. provided us with an unforgettable experience!!! His vast knowledge of the geology/landscape, and the history of the area combined with his expert flying skills and love of great music made our flight spectacular. We all felt that this was the highlight of our Alaska trip and absolutely something everyone should splurge on while in the Denali area. We literally were stunned into a jaw-dropping, silence-inducing stupor on our flight-see. It was unlike anything we had ever experienced; like a magical dream!!!
Thank you, Jeff, for the Bob Marley, John Denver, and other great music. Now, whenever we hear the songs you played, we can visualize the beauty and the grandeur of the magnificent mountains and glaciers you flew us over...

I just got back from Alaska today and I wanted to write a review for K 2 aviation.  We had a great time flying up to Mt McKinley as our pilot informed us of several interesting things about the mountain and the glaciers running through it. The views are breathtaking and it is well worth the money for a once in a lifetime experience.  We had booked a flight landing, but due to weather we were unable to land but the pilot made sure that we still got great views and got all of the time that we were expecting.

Best view ever of Denali with running commentary on geography, climbers, nearby mountains, anything you wanted to know. It was super! Our pilot Chip was very professional and knowledgeable. The ride was smooth as silk and we had a beautiful clear day. We would do this again.

review_title: Did their best to give us a good experience
review_text: We had signed up and paid for the Denali Grand Tour with a glacier landing months in advance. I spoke by phone with K2 personnel who answered all my questions about their flight seeing trips and who explained that the trip we would actually get (especially the glacier landing) was dependent upon weather conditions the day of the scheduled flight - and these conditions could vary quickly.  When we arrived at K2's office in Talkeetna for our 11:00 tour, it was overcast with sporadic rain, and we were informed there would be no glacier landings that day - and the Grand Tour we had planned would have to be cut to a lower-level glacier tour.  As flights already in the air returned, the K2 people used the up-to-the-minute information provided by the pilots, as well as continuous monitoring of weather conditions, to decide exactly which trip they could offer us.  Our trip ended up leaving about 1/2 hour late, on a trial basis to see how far we could get - not very far, as it turned out, because fog started to encroach on the runway we would land on.  This 20-minute flight over the bogs at the foot of the glacier was free; we could abandon our flight seeing plans at that point with a full refund, or wait around to see if conditions would improve enough for a second try.  After an hour or so they did - and pilot Chris took us up again, showing us the Ruth Glacier and other ice fields, though he was unable to bring us into the "amphitheater" that is supposed to be most spectacular.  K2 promised to refund us for the tour portions it was unable to offer us. I was very impressed with K2's emphasis on safety and its efforts to accommodate our desire for a good experience within the possibilities that could be attempted safely.  They were flexible, offering us the alternative of taking another flight, at higher altitude, during which we would overfly no glaciers but might get to see Mount McKinley. We decided we would rather take a flight where we would definitely see SOMETHING, even if it wasn't the mountain.  Our time waiting in the K2 office was fairly pleasant. Their waiting area is quite comfortable, with free coffee. We left feeling satisfied despite the uncooperative weather.
Greg Sanowski was our pilot and he was fabulous. Took us to see the closest thing to heaven-- Denali mountain range. Beautiful sites.

Our trip was pre-booked for a glacier landing, but the weather wasn't cooperating.  K2 informed us tht we would likely not be able to land and gave us the option to cancel without charge.  Never mind though,  our pilot Jeff Babcock gave us the greatest flight.  I have some awesome pictures of the peaks and the valleys that you can only find in Denali.  Jeff was extremely knowledgeable of all the sites having been flying for over twenty years in Alaska. Although it was too cloudy to make the landing or even see the summit of Mt. McKinley, but we still feel this was a great flightseeing experience

review_title: Do it! Do it! Do it!
review_text:
We went on the 4th of July with K2 to do a "fly and hike."  The lady who was the owner drove us to the lake where we caught the water airplane.  She was really nie and personable.  We didn't know she was the owner till later.  Our pilot was Jeff Babcock.  He was really nice.  The flight was just my wife and I.  We went on a plance that they don't make anymore.  I think it was called a Haviland.  It sat 6 people.  I felt really safe.  The water take off and landing was smoother than a commercial jet.  Jeff took us around the mountains and we played peekaboo with Denali, the 20,000 foot mountain.  It would occasionally show itself from the clouds that surrounded it.  The flight around the mountains felt like some sort of National Geographic experience.  It seemed so beautiful and surreal to me.  Am I in the Himmalayas or in America?

We landed in this mountain lake and these two young hikers showed us around.  We felt safe and they were very knowledgable of all the flora and fauna.  We saw many plants and the Alaska state bird.  The birdt did not fly away when I took a picture of it.  We hiked uphill to a mountain stream.

At the end of our hike, they gave us wine, cheese, crackers, AND smoked salmon.  My wife thought they were kidding when the female hiking guide asked what kind of wine we wanted.  My wife had the Reisling and I had the Malbec.  This gourmet snack was included in the price of the fly and hike tour.

This flight was the highlight of our trip.  We had perfect weather, and our pilot, Jeff Babcock, was a great tour guide.  He knew every peak, pass and saddle in the range.  We landed on the Ruth Glacier (on skis) and walked around for a few minutes enjoying the spectacular scenery.  Though the flight was expensive, it was worth every penny.  And don't forget to ask to sit in the cockpit.  First one to ask gets the seat!

My fiance and I saw views of Mt.Mckinley and glaciers that we will never forget!  The glacier landing made the amazing trip even better. Our pilot was Mike and he was great! He was very informative and made sure everyone had a blast! Would definitely recommend a flight with K2 to anyone who's in the Talkeetna area.

No fault of K2 Aviation, we just went on the wrong day - wrong week - wrong year.  Cloud cover kept us from doing much more than seeing two glaciers.  No landing.  Awesome views of glaciers and moraine and the terrain to and from Talkeetna.  Kevin did the best he could in a shorter flight than planned.  We did see a black bear.  Limited photos.  Just unlucky, frustrated and disappointed on our once in a lifetime visit to Alaska.  We were in the Talkeetna and Denali N.P. area for five days and never saw Denali.  Maybe we will catch a glimpse when we return to Anchorage next week via the Glenn Highway.

Chose the Glacier landing with McKinley flight - were rained out 2 days, but they fit us in on the 3rd day and we flew the breath-taking route around McKinley and landed on Eldrige glacier - Mike did a superb job in the vintage Otter for the 9 of us - good narrative, safely operated, and well worth the cost for us.  K2 seems a well run and fairly large operation and seemed able to provide for a variety of tours.

There are some words that are used with such frequency that they lose their meaning when they are really needed.  I was fortunate enough to see Denali on a clear day and join K2 Aviation on their glacier landing tour.  Seeing the sun shining on the mountains, the snow, and the glaciers was awe inspiring and amazing.  I was so moved by the beauty of what we saw!  I would sincerely like to thank our pilot, Doug Geeting, for sharing his flying expertise with our group allowing us to see the wonder of the mountains and the glaciers up close.  His skill and ability to safely transport people to and from these places is a gift for all who are able to make the flight.  Though I was hesitant at first to spend the money to take the flight, I returned from the experience feeling that it was worth every cent.  Thank you Doug and K2 for a wonderful experience that has left a real impression.

review_title: One of those "take your breath away" moments
review_text: What a great flight we had with K2. Our pilot was professional and made us all feel safe. The views were magnificient to say the least. We did not get to land on the glacier due to cloudiness but it did little to deter us from enjoying this great flight. Thank you K2. If we ever get back to Alaska, we will be seeing you again.

We just returned from a two week vacation in Alaska and by far the most amazing experience we had was on a K2 Aviation flight around Mt McKinley.  The first morning we were booked for our Glacier tour the mountain range was socked in so the folks at K2 advised us to come back later in the day to see if conditions had improved. The K2 staff couldn't be more accommodating. They understand that you're there for a limited amount of time and they do everything in their power to get you up in the air, but safely. We were offered alternative tours, without the glacier landing, and at a lower altitude but we decided to wait a day to see if the weather cleared. Fortunately, the next morning was crystal clear! Our pilot, Greg Sanoski, is a pro and couldn't have made the experience any better. Ruth glacier wasn't very hospitable that day but he was able to land us on Eldridge Glacier which was the thrill of a lifetime. Our thanks to Greg and the staff at K2 for an unforgettable flight. It was the highlight of our trip and an experience we'll never forget!

Cloudy weather was no match for our pilot and his radio.  He was able to communicate with another pilot that found a hole to pop-up through and we found it.  We went through the hole and saw Denali in all her majestic beauty.  Sitting in the co-pilot seat, my view was one that I will never forget.  The view was so amazing as the Great One just rose from the clouds.  If that view was not enough, we were able to see several glaciers and gorges in the range that were stunning in their own right.  The kids had no problems with the flight and truly enjoyed their first small plan ride.

We did the summit tour on June 15, 2012. I preferred K2 because of their summit tour flight path that is posted on the website and recommendations on TA and Cruisecritic. We were fortunate to be able to book two seats on that morning when we saw that skies would be sunny and fairly clear over the Alaskan range. I liked K2's flightpath on the summit tour. We spiraled around Denali (McKinley) and flew around Mts. Foraker and Hunter. This is a must see tour when the skies are clear. Close up views of the mountains were awesome. We also enjoyed the flights over the glaciers. K2 uses a 7 passenger twin engine plane for the summit tour. My wife volunteered me to sit in the co-pilot seat, and I was very happy. Ed was our pilot. He was very thorough on the safey briefing especially on wearing the oxygen mask. He was very friendly and gave a good description of the terain. He was also good at picking out climbers on the mountains and showing us the location of base camps. Because of the good weather, Ed was able to stick to the planned flightpath. We loved this tour and given the opportunity would do it again with K2.

Amazing experience!! I would do it again!! It was such a beautiful view and breathtaking!! Riding in a smaller plane is better than the bigger ones. The pilot was awesome!! The people there are very nice and helpful!! I encourage people to check this place out!! You won't regret it!!

Our flightsee to McKinely was the highlight of our Alaskan vacation.  It was so exciting to see up close the McKinely and glaciers.  K2 and our pilot were well organized, professional and friendly and made you feel very safe.  An experience of a lifetime. I highly recommend K2 for your trip to Alaska.  You will love it!

We actually did this tour in June 2011 but I still thought it was worthwhile to post a review! We booked a summit flight with K2 but they didn't get the 6 person minimum so they booked us on the Denali Grand Tour "green route" instead. Even though we didn't get to see the summit the tour was fantastic! Our pilot was teriffic and would tilt the wings for better pictures. The scenery was stunning and the highlight of our Alaska trip! The office staff was also super helpful in booking our tour and we left all our luggage in their office since we just got off the train. Overall a great operation and I highly recommend K2!

review_title: Flight to Mt. McKinley & Glacier Landing
review_text: My Grandson & I took the flight around Mt. McKinley and the glacier landing. It was a wonderful experience and operated by a very professional pilot. The sights were beautiful and it was one of our most memorable experiences on our trip to Alaska. I would highly recommend K2 for a visit to Alaska.

I've been to Alaska twice and both times flew with K-2.  Excellent in both cases.  They were safe, efficient, professional and proficient.  I went on two different flights, one on each trip.  The first trip we were grounded due to clouds, but waited patiently.  About two hours later, at the first break in the clouds, they had us up for an awe-inspiring view of the Alaska range.  This was the green flight, I believe.  The next time the weather was overcast on the ground, but perfect in the mountains and we got cloudless views that felt almost like we could reach out and touch the mountain.  That was the red flight.  Couldn't make a glacier landing either time due to high temperatures the first time and a heavy snow that turned to slush the second time.  However, we were glad that safety was first.  I give them the highest recommendation.  Our pilot was a seasoned pilot and we felt perfectly safe in his plane.  We got great views of multiple base camps up the mountain - even could see them in our photographs.  Super flights.

I had the most amazing 'gob-smacking' (and English saying) flight with K2 in June around the Alaska range, Mt Denali and landing on Ruth Glacier. It was the best experience of my Alaska trip and I was constantly smiling watching all the glaciers, mt peaks floating in the clouds and brooding mt Denali peaks go past. We were lucky with the weather that day as not many planes landed on the glacier due to cloud. We even saw a bear and cub on the way back with good views of the Talkeetna rivers. Highly recommended!

We were so excited to be taking this flight and the first day was overcast. The planes were not flying. We were disappointed but all of our best interests/safety was number one. They refunded our money on the spot. We came the next day and were able fly with the greatest of ease. I took advantage of the co-pilot seat. Up close and amazing experience. The pilot was very experienced and guided us through each and every sight. Use the restroom before you leave, you want to enjoy every minute without wondering when we are going to be back? Everyone that works there answering the phones or standing at the desk is helpful and friendly. Wear the little over boots having dry feet is important. Experience Alaska in beautiful and exceptional way. Enjoy!

Although the weather did not cooperate with us for our first scheduled flight on 06/13, K2 was able to get us scheduled on the next morning.  When we arrived at K2 on the morning of our rescheduled flight, it was cloudy and we were sure we would not be able to take flight.  Were we surprised when the K2 guy (tall with long hair) behind the counter announced that "If you want to see the mountain, today is the day!"  We were a bit disappointed that a glacier landing was impossible due to unsafe landing conditions; however, our plane flew clear around McKinley....awesome! Besides the disappointment of not getting a glacier landing, we had a fantastic flight....McKinley was out in all her glory!  K2 made our Alaska trip even more memorable!  We found the K2 staff to be very thoughtful, accommodating, and willing to make our day wonderful.  I would recommend K2 Aviation to anyone who is interested in flying around McKinley!!

Great atmosphere and free coffee. Sat and chatted with a couple of the pilots.  Suggestion: buy GINGER GUM, which they sell for motion sickness. Didn't need it for flight but came in handy when taking a boat ride out of Seward.   Recommend you take the flight which lands on a glacier.  What a hoot,

Our family of 5 adults and 4 kids (ages 11 to 6) just returned from a 2 weeks Alaska cruisetour.  One of the highlights was flying to the glacier and landing with K2.

It was obvious that safety came first with this company and the pilot's knowledge of the area and the glacier was such an added bonus.

As to the cost, do not hesitate.  It is well worth every penny!

Our family and extended family just finished 12 days in Alaska and were blessed with many incredible experiences.  However, asking the other 10 members in the party what activity was the best and the K2 flight with glacier landing was an overwhelming winner.  The closeness to sheer mountain faces, the up-close views of glaciers, the interaction with the pilot--all of it combined to be a very remarkable experience.  If you are going to Alaska and prioritizing a 'to do' list, make this number one.  Seriously.

Highly recommend K2 Aviation.  We were scheduled to fly a day later, but woke up yesterday morning to sunny, blue skies so we called K2, and they got us on the first flight out on the McKinley Flyer tour with Ed as our pilot in a twin-engine Piper Chieftain plane.  We were even able to use our Alaska Tour Saver coupon!

It was amazing.  The view of Denali, Mt. Foraker, Mt. Hunter were gorgeous.  Sometimes we felt so close to the mountains that we could reach out and touch them.  We also flew over two climbers' base camps.  It was amazing to see the climbers and their tents below us, and even some of the climbers heading up the mountain.  

Our pilot, Ed, was very informative and kept us apprised of where we were, and what we were seeing.  

If you have a chance to do a flightseeing tour, by all means do it.  Once in a lifetime experience.  K2 Aviation was the best.

This was a trip not to many people take - especially Alaskans like us.  We had a wonderful pilot, Jeff Babcock, a neat little plane and some awesome scenery.  We flew over trees, lakes, rivers and streams, mining camps and cabins.  Then we came to the glaciers - it's a totally different view flying OVER one.  The weather, unfortunately, changed and we weren't able to land on a glacier, but the trip was wonderful and well worth the time and effort.  I wouldn't have missed it for the world now that I've done it!

The pilot was amazing and put everyone who was nervous about flying on our trip at ease.  Excellent flying and landing.  Super friendly and helpful staff.  Beautiful sights of the glacier and summit.  We had good weather and did the glacier landing, which was well worth the extra money.  By far the best tour of our trip!!  Everything about the tour was perfect!

review_title: You must do a flight over a glacier!
review_text: We took the one hour flight over Ruth Glacier and it was spectacular.  If you are in Talkeetna I highly recommend this.  We didn't land on the glacier, but just seeing it from a plane was a treat.  Our pilot was very experienced and gave us a great tour.

We were so fortunate to have taken this beautiful flight tour.  It was a trip of a life time.  We had a beautiful blue sky for our flight around Mt. Mckinely - could not have asked for a better day.  It is hard to describe how beautiful it was - I recommend that you experience it for yourself.  The only downfall I had was that I sat on the lefthand side behind the pilot, and I never got a great view of Mckinley myself (although I had a lot of beautiful scenery)- Mckinley was always on the right hand side (I thought maybe that at one point in trip the pilot might turn the plane so those of us on the left could see better, but it didn't happen).  But to make up for that my husband had a great view - he got to sit up next to the pilot and could see it all - he took some great pictures!  It was worth the money for this once in a life time opportunity!

review_title: Put this trip on your Bucket List!
review_text: We all have had times when we say, "we should of done this or that" when we were there. Flying up onto the glacier on Mt. Denali was one of the things we regreted not doung in times past when we visited the fun town of Talkeetna in June '12. This time we did it tho! After at first balking at the price, now we can say it was more than worth the price of admission! Our pilot, Jeff Babcock was not only agreat pilot and a friendly guy, but also quite knowledgeable in the geography of this most beautiful of area of Alaska. We took lots of photos on our trip, but the real thrill was looking out the window of the plane while Jeff pointed out details one would be clueless about without his narration .... the names of all the glaciers and mountain peaks as well as other interesting stories. He even pointed out small specks on the snow that proved to be climbers on the mountain. Once out of the plane and on the glacier itself, things really started to fall in place on the magnificence of the area. Of course, it didn't hurt that the mountain was crystal clear that day and we were dressed quite comfortably in t-shirts or a light wind breaker. I would strongly urge anyone even thinking about doing this trip to move ahead on it before there are any regrets. This is something that will always remain in our hearts and minds.

We recently did the flightseeing tour of McKinley with a glacier landing. I was a little nervous having never flown on a "bush" plane before. Our pilot started off by telling us he had over 37 years of experience which made me feel much better. The flight was amazing and the glacier landing is a must do! I could not have been more happy with K2 and I would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for a flight tour in Talkeetna.

For a flight that will be the trip of a life time K2 Aviation is the place to go. K2 Aviation was kind enough to donate a flight for 2 Special Forces Wounded Warriors. Stephanie Smothers and her staff took care of all the details and could not been more kind and helpfull. The pilot Doug had spent years flying around Mt McKinley and had wonderful stories about the mountain. The weather was great and the views beautiful. The glacier landing was the hilight of a wonderful day. For a GREAT tour of Mt McKinley K2 Aviation is the place to go. Thank You
June 20th, gorgeous weather, wonderful flight, great views, smooth ride, excellent pilot.This was a trip of a life time.
Our pilot was Barry, he took us on a very nice flight.  We saw lots of beautiful mountains, glaciers, and even a base camp for a McKinley expedition.  A must when visiting the Talkeetna area.

We had a great experience flying with K2.  The pilot was very knowledgeable providing informations information during the flight.  The customer service was great.  When I had a couple of issues, everything was quickly addressed and resolved.  If you are flying with children 2 and younger, I would recommend K2 as they provide seats for them at no additional charge, which was a big savings and allowed us to enjoy the flight a little more.  We weren't able to see much of McKinley, but thats just a roll of the dice based on the weather.  Everyone was very professional and it was our favorite tour over a 2 week trip in Alaska.

What an amazing and unforgettable experience.  I spent many hours planning our trip to Alaska and trying to decide what tours / where to go / what guides / and the "if possible" ideas.  We waited until the last minute deciding to see what the weather would bring.  The staff at K2 are fantastic. We booked this flight tour the day before we flew.  God was with us as the skies were blue and sunny on the mountain.  We landed on the glacier -- saw beautiful Mt. McKinley and worth every penny.  Our pilot was very skilled and provided tons of information on the flight.  We were able to fly in the morning and catch the train early that afternoon.  Be sure to stop at the restaurant/cafe across the street for some refreshments after -- great menu.    Don't hesitate to select K2.

What a thrilling experience!  We just came back from our scenic flight tour and glacier landing.  Words cannot describe the trip.  Definitely the highlight so far.  Our pilot, Doug, was professional and pleasant, as well as very skilled and knowledgeable.  If you get the opportunity to sit in the co-pilot seat take advantage!  The staff on the ground was awesome too.  Very organized and accommodating.  Thank you K2!!!!

A highlight of our Alaska trip!!  Spring for the few extra dollars and do the "grand tour".  The glacier landing is very cool, and the back side of McKinley (the Wickersham Wall) is breathtaking.  The folks at K2 really know their business and the conditions on the mountain.  It was cloudy on our flight day, but a call to the McKinley base camp by the K2 staff showed that the cloud cover was low and that the conditions on the mountain were perfect.  Jeff Babcock was an extremely knowledgable and entertaining flight guide.  Thanks K2!
Steve & Mary B.

review_title: Flightseeing with K2 Aviation was Fantastic
review_text: The flightseeing tour was one of the highlights from our trip to Alaska.The glaciers and mountains were beautiful. The pilot was very friendly and knowledgeable. He provided great commentary during the flight. You will see things that just cannot be seen any other way.
Excellent flight, we took the grand tour and ended up with two glacier landings as they needed to shuttle some climbers in addition to the regular flight seeing trip.

We recently took a flight seeing trip with K2 and had some questionable weather. It was fairly cloudy but were assured we would still see plenty. Although we could not go around Mt. McKinley, our pilot Stan piloted us in and out and around the peaks enabling us to see as much as possible. We landed on a glacier and the weather looked like it was going to break so Stan hung around longer in hopes of seeing the sun. Unfortunately it did not come out, but we were very appreciative of his and K2's flexibility for the extra time we spent on the adventure. I would definitely recommend K2 but plan on having some flexibility if the weather is not cooperating. Bruce & Gayle/Minneapolis

Four of our family members (spanning three generations) had signed up for the flightseeing tour with K2 through Princess Cruises.  We felt confident that Princess would select a solid company with a good safety record.  The Princess shuttle dropped us off in Talkeetna just a short walk from K2's office and airstrip.  Although the office seemed quite busy, they promptly took care of us (checked the reservation and weighed us).  We were told that Mt. McKinley might not be visible due to weather conditions and gave us the option to cancel.  Mountain or not, we weren't about to miss this experience.  A couple of us were just a bit hesitant when we saw that the 6-seat "Beaver" plane was older.  Our 87-year-old has had a pilot's license for many years and was ready to go.  It wasn't easy for him, but he scrambled up into the co-pilot's seat when told that whoever could get up there could sit in the front.  Our flight was smooth and quiet.  We all had headphones to hear the pilot's narration.  The flight path deviated from the normal tour because of varying weather conditions, but we were able to see some spectaular scenery.  Although the mountain never fully came out, we did get to see peaks of the south and the north sides.  The scenery was spectacular!  Although we took hundreds of photos and some video, there is no way to capture the grandeur and beauty of it all.  It was an experience of a lifetime!   Thank you tp K2 and our pilot (Did he say to call him Captain Greg?).  Our 87-year-old thought he did a great job flying us around, over, and through those mountains.

Being married to a hobby pilot, I have flown in small planes - 2 to 4 seaters - for 40 years.  The one thing I wanted to do on my Alaska Cruise was to land on a glacier and boy did I get the trip of a lifetime.  Capt Jeff made the trip comfortable and DID NOT give us a chance to get scared.  Flying in and out of the mountain peaks was beyond description.  The beauty of the whole scene was breathtaking but actually landing on the glacier and spending the time walking around gives you such a sense of how big and beautiful this is.  I don't fly with just anyone but from the moment we walked out on the tarmac until he brought us back to the real world, I did not have one moment of hesitation and would fly the Talketna just to take this flight again!!!!!

Fantastic flight, always felt safe. Stan, our pilot and guide was very knowedgable and informative. It is definately worth the "upgrade" to a glacier landing. If you are in the area and want a 'once-in-a-lifetime experience, this is it! I can't say enough good about Stan. At one point in the flight I had a view of six! different glaciers.

This company is the absolute best to fly McKinley (Denali) with.  Don't bother with your cruise booking.  Its always a dice roll whether McKinley will be "out" or what the weather will be but they handled it better than any expectations.  They met us at Grand Denali Lodge (where we were on a pre-cruise tour).  Immediately we were told the weather was not suitable for our 1:00PM time and we were offered a refund or a rebooking later in the day.  We chose to be transported to their office which was extremely busy, but very organized.  We chose to rebook for the next available, now at 5:00PM.  They would have returned us to the hotel but we chose to wander around town and take the shuttle back.  At 4:20PM we called them and the flight was on.  They picked us up again at 4:30PM and off we went, taking off at 5:00PM.  As we went above the clouds with our pilot (34 years experience)  the mountain was out.  The rest of the flight was unbelievable.  It felt as though we could touch the sheer walls at one point.  We were to have a glacier landing but the designated area was too foggy so that did not occur.  Although a bit of a disappointment at the time it did not take away from the trip.  On return to the office we asked how much was still due as we had prepaid 50%.  Immediately, without any prompting, we were told the price was reduced for no glacier landing and reduced flight time due to no landing.  What service!  The flight was superb, but we were also lucky the mountain showed, and the service was exemplary.  One suggestion:  book as early in the day as possible so you can rebook later in the day if needed (remember it doesn't get dark until about 11:00 PM).  What memories!!!

review_title: K2 Aviation Rocks...!!!  Flightseeing with the Best in the Business...!!!
review_text:
You know they say a picture speaks a1000 words, so as a professional photographer, I will let my pictures do all the talking.  I invite you to view a short 5 minute video collage that is posted on YouTube (http://youtu.be/RmQYfuVNC6U) that highlights the utterly "out of this world" experience that we had with K2 Aviation and our once in a lifetime adventure flightseeing around the highest mountain in all of North America.  

Denali (Mt. McKinley) is 20,320 feet of majestic beauty that was presented to us on a perfectly clear day.  We meet some of the owners of K2 the night before and they convinced us to stay over and take the opportunity to be amazed by what nature had in store for us the next day.  

From the moment we arrived at K2 Aviation, their whole team was so professional and had the same "spark" of excitement that we did.  Just knowing that it was a perfectly clear day and that we would have the chance to not only experience Denali "up close and personal", but that we would be privileged to land on a glacier, well, that had the adrenaline flowing.  

There are many choices when it comes to "flightseeing" operations, but K2 Aviation is by far, the "best in the business".  Top shelf facilities, knowledgeable and very friendly staff, experienced and professional pilots, modern and very comfortable planes...they do it right, day in and day out.

review_title: Glacier landing was the highlight of our trip!
review_text: We didn't know what to expect during our flight near Mt. McKinley.  We thought flying in a 6-seater plane might make us airsick and told our pilot about our extended bout of motion sickness on a boat tour of Kenai Fjords National Park.  He reassured us that we would be fine.  We had agreed to a glacier landing on Ruth Glacier and it was a fantastic experience!  The only things we needed were jacket, sunglasses, walking/hiking shoes and camera.  Our personal belongings were left in a locked bin at the office.  Our pilot, who had made the trip thousands of times, took us up 5000 feet smoothly, and it was very peaceful flying close to the mountains.  The glacier landing was similar to landing on deep snow.  We got out of the plane and were delighted to be stomping around on a glacier.  An amazing sight was a couple who were sitting on the glacier like they were at the beach.  The couple told us they had rented a house up there for a couple of days and had flown up with K2.  By the way, after the flight we learned that pilot Doug Geeting is also a musician who performs locally.  Unfortunately, we weren't around to catch his act.  We are so glad we made the glacier landing!  Go if you have the opportunity.

I had the pleasure of celebrating my birthday in Alaska. We took the flight seeing tour with the glacier landing. It was a once in a lifetime experience. The pilot/ tour guide was professional and very informative. I highly recommend this adventure.

review_title: Awesome views of the "Great One" - Denali/Mt.McKinley
review_text: Had a absolutely awesome flightseeing trip w/K2.  I know they can't take credit for the cloudless skies which made this trip PERFECT, but all aspects of what K2 did was spot-on.  Very friendly pilot and staff, solid aircraft, good headphone/microphone setup which allowed pilot's narrative to really add to the trip.  Thanks!
The views are breathtaking, landing on the Glacier mountain once in a life time fantastic highly recomended

I was driving up to Talkeetna Airport, looking for a flight to Mt. Mc Kinley. The first company I saw was K2 Aviation. I was alone, all by myself and nobody else was having a reservation. But they took me nevertheless. 30 minutes later I was in the air in a Cessna with Tony, a seasoned pilot.
He proved to be not only a good pilot but also a knowledgeable guide to the scenery below and above. I was looking to take pictures of Denali and Tony just knew how to get the best angles. I never had something to suggest, he knew what I wanted him to do. And Denali showed itself from the best, cloudless side.

Flew K2 out of Talkeetna in April.  It was worth every dollar.  Our pilot took us around Mt. McKinley and did a great job of explaining about the different mountains, glaciers, etc.  If you're in Alaska, flightseeing is a must do.

review_title: The Best Alaskan Experience Out There
review_text: Great professionalism and unsurpassed scenery.  Pay the extra fee for the glacier landing. I grew up in Alaska and have visited Denali Park at least 30 times. Nevertheless, I'd never seen it from the air.  The airplane was marvelously stable and smooth - takeoff and landing were more smooth than a commercial jet. The views make you feel so small as the pilots wends his way through glaciated valleys and snow bound peaks. A true adventure and worth every penny. Don't come all the way to Alaska and miss this!!!!

For three summers I have done this gig with family and friends. If you go in July during the mountain school training ask to land on Ruth's Glacier. This is an awesome event landing in the snow. If the weather is bad, just hang close and you will get to do the mountain sometimes. Fling around Denali is an amazing view. Usually they ask for reservations with a deposit, but I have found times when I did not have to do this. Just walk in and check their schedule compared to yours an let this be priority unless the fish are running. Kings run in July and reds about first week of August. K2 operates great equipment with very experienced pilots. Make this an attraction to do. Ask your pilot to for the seat up front for you of a kid. That is really special!!!

This is one of the top trips in Alaska. If you are visiting Alaska, you NEED to fit this into your vacation. The pilots and all the staff are great to work with. I send all of my clients to Talkeetna only to visit this fantastic operation. Very patient guest service..they addressed all of my concerns an questions immediately. Easily the most breathtaking trip in Alaska (that is easily accessible)! The weather didn't allow for a glacier landing this time, but I will keep trying! I can't wait to go back. A big thanks to all at K2 for making my family's visit one to remember! They want to come back too, to do the glacier landing..so maybe this summer!

review_title: Not to be missed when in Alaska!
review_text: This was no doubt one of the best highlights of our whole trip. The views were absolutely incredible and the weather was a balmy 80 degrees that warm June day in Talkeetna. Our Pilot's name was Doug and he let me and my best friend sit in the co pilots seat for our short flight out to land on Ruth Glacier and spectacular views of Mt. McKinley. We almost did just the hour flight but but decided to throw in the glacier landing....Absolutely do it! Especially if there is nice weather it was truly amazing. We are still bragging about this part of our trip 7 months later. Take tons of pictures as they seem to all come out great! We would surely do this again when in Alaska!

My husband surprised me with the Grand Denali Flightseeing tour for our 12th Anniversary. We couldn't have planned a better day. There was not a cloud in the sky and the Mountains were breath-taking. K2 Aviation has a great staff and our pilot was the best. I had never been on such a small plane before and after hearing of all his experience in flying I didn't think twice about it. He told us about all the areas and history that goes with it along our flight. I shot more than 200 photos and all of them look like you could reach out and touch the mountains. Thank you K2 for such a beautiful trip. We are looking forward to coming back in May for a glacier landing.
Everyone's pretty much said it.  I loved it too!  It was a fair bit of money but definately worth it.  One piece of advice, don't forget your sunglasses when you get out on the glacier.

review_title: OMG!  These guys are the best!
review_text: It was a cold and overcast day in Talkeetna.  It was 5 degrees outside.  K2 Aviation really didn't even have any flights to see Mt McKinney scheduled on Sunday because of the overcast condiitions. I was about to deploy to Afghanistan and I really wanted to see Mt. McKinley with my girlfriend before I did.  I called K2 and they arranged a flight and called in one of their best pilots.  They said that we probably wouldn't get to see the mountain much but that they would do their best in the overcast conditions.  Well, we took off and headed towards the mountain and by the time we got there the weather cleared out enough for us to get an amazing view of the Mountain and the glaciers.  It was clear on top!  We took the chance, but K2 made it happen.  Thanks guys for a wonderful trip! The flight was like a limosine ride and you have the best courteous and professional staff.  I will be back after deployment to see Denali in the summertime.  See you again too!  SPC David Wellman

review_title: The best experience of our lives!
review_text: We booked the Denali Grand Tour with a glacier landing and could not have been more pleased with our experience!  We had the first clear day in about a 3 week period and the weather was just perfect.  The customer service was excellent!  Our pilot Jeff was awesome and provided the perfect amount of narration.  He got so close to a few of the mountains we felt as if we could have reached out and touched them!  It was truly an unforgettable flight and the glacier landing was the icing on the cake.  I would not skip out on that...definitely worth the extra money!  I never thought I would get so close to Denali and would be walking around on a glacier.  The photo opportunities were endless and views just breathtaking.  My husband said it best, "I've done a lot of cool stuff in my life, but this was the coolest"!

K2 Aviation is great if the weather is right. We had reservations on a cloudy day and could not go up very far and of course did not get to see the Mountain or land on the glacier. It was not outstanding because of the weather conditions. They gave us a discounted rate which was good, but I would have asked for a total refund and not gone at all if I would have known we could not see much.

The pilot was great and we felt very safe in the small plane. I was able to sit in the passenger side next  to the pilot and would recommend asking for that seat! However, if you don't need to put on the snow boots it means the weather is not good, so get a full refund and spend the money on something else unless you just want to ride in a plane!

review_title: Worth every penny. Will go again.
review_text: We used the coupon book to get the buy one get one free deal. They picked us up from the lodge. The service is excellent. The Denali grand tour is the highlight of our Alaska vacation and an unforgettable experience. Highly recommended.

Our large Lifelong Alaskan family thoroughly enjoyed every aspect of our Denali fly in hike.  Many of us have been transplanted, so nice to come back and really enjoy the beauty The Greatland has to offer.

The front Desk team was warm and professional (and we all enjoyed the great retail area..quality items).  Our pilot was friendly, skilled and a great resource for information about the area and the fly in delivered exactly what we hoped for: a unique and memorable experience for all, ages 5 to 'more than just a little salt and pepper'.

Our guides in Denali enthusiastically shared information about the facinating flora and fauna of the area, and the return reception tent was a very welcome and fun bonus that we thoroughly enjoyed.

Can't wait for our next K2 adventure!

review_title: We touched a piece of heaven!"
review_text: We took a flight tour around Mt. McKinley with pilot Greg Sanoski. He gave us a great narrative and flew us almost all the way around "The Mountain". It was a fabulous trip - felt like we could reach out and touch The Mountain!!! Thanks, Greg!

A great experience to see the vast mountains, glaciers and Alaska area around Denali. I learned a lot about the formation of glaciers and how the active miners and outback people live in this vast region. The people of K2 were friendly, easy to work with and the pilot lived to fly and loved what he was doing, which helped make this a great “Bucket List “item to see Denali up close. Their price was the best we could find and very reasonable for Alaska travel. Do It! Omaha NE. Sept. 2011
Excellent glacier tour, excellent pilot, excellent plane (Otter) but I would check prices of competitors since the flights and routes they take are similar.

review_title: A glacier landing should be on your bucket list!
review_text: I have been to Rio, all 50 states, and Europe more than a dozen times and this has to be one of my Top 5 experiences! It was a crystal clear day, so the flight was extremely smooth, the pilot as good as any tour guide, we saw postcard shot after postcard shot, and were able to land on the glacier and play in the snow! The flightseeing is excellent, but spend the extra money and book the glacier landing. Also, go to K2's website for discount coupons -- it will wind up being much less expensive than booking a similar trip through a cruise line!

review_title: You Have Got To Do This!!
review_text: This was beyond words...AWESOME, FANTASTIC, AMAZING...!!!  Our pilot was Michael and we were on an Otter aircraft.  Michael was great...very calm, extremely knowledgable and really tried to answer all our questions.  We really wanted to see some wildlife and he flew all over trying to find an elusive moose!  The clouds had come in so we couldn't fly the whole route but we did get to land on the glacier which was stupendous!  You are on top of the world touching ice that has been there for hundreds of years.  He also took us around this little house up on one glacier that you can only fly to 2 months of the year and is owned by the family of one of the first guys to summit McKinley.  My 12 year old still talks about it and my 84 year old mother had the time of her life!!  Breathtaking.  And K-2 was fantastic to work with.  Oh yeah...use your Northern Light Coupon Book and pay for 3 get one free!!

review_title: Nice views of Mckinley however Rude Pilot
review_text:
In a nutshell, the views of Mckinley were stunning however the pilot, a gentleman from Pennsylvania, exhibited the height of rudeness. And no, I'm not misunderstood. He was blatantly rude. The flight itself was very nice and to his credit, he gave all information about the mountain and surroundings. However he didn't like being interrupted during the flight (hello.... we had booked the flight therefore within reason, we could ask questions if we wanted); He didn't like our kids interrupting him either. Basically he made us very uncomfortable during the flight to the point where we just wanted the flight to be over and done with.  Not sure whether the reason for this was our non-caucasian origin. At the end of the flight, he didn't even have the decency to say goodbye and went about doing his own stuff with the airplane. We could see other pilots escorting their customers right upto the office however our pilot was simply not interested. My wife also observed this behaviour. I will certainly not recommend K2 due to this extremely uncomfortable experience due to the pilot's very obvious rude behaviour. At one point during the flight our 6 year old daughter who was sitting behind the pilot's seat ACCIDENTLY kicked his chair and he gave her a nasty look. We were like "she's a kid for god sake". 

At the end of the trip, my wife and I kept asking ourselves what the reason for his rude behaviour could have been. Unfortunately we couldn't find an answer. We really couldn't have done anything to get him this upset. 

To summarize, Mckinley views were unbvelievable however K2 pilot certainly didn't have any people skills. He needs to be more patient and show more tolerance towards non-caucasian folks.

Upon conclusion of a conference in Anchorage, a co-worker and I drove to Talkeetna for flightseeing with K2!  Flightseeing is an amazing, unforgettable experience.  Mike, our knowledgeable pilot, shared interesting facts and information on our trip.  Our glacier landing flight actually landed at base camp to deliver water.  Nearing base camp, we saw an avalanche and Mike circled around so all passengers had a good view.  We lucked in to a fairly clear day and often had completely clear views of Denali.  Hint:  Ask to be the co-pilot!  Great views from the cockpit.  If you travel to Alaska, make K2 Flightseeing part of your experience!

review_title: A flight that I will never forget
review_text:
We were traveling in Alaska for about 1.5 weeks in September of 2011.  We knew that we would have to be flexible with the weather but we were hopeful things would work out.  At the start of the trip we had to cancel some water events on the coast due to rain and wind.  We had a chance to visit the Denali state park and had a great time on the Tundra Wilderness Tour.  We had not gotten a view of Mt. McKinley but also understood that only 30% of people get to see the mountain so we enjoyed our visit in the park and the animals that got to see.  Heading south to Talkeetna we were amazed to see the clouds clear up and Mount McKinley finally show.  We had a flight schedule with K2 Aviation the next morning but we knew that by then it might be back in the clouds.  We gave K2 Aviation a call and they were very helpful in letting us move our trip time.

They came to pick us up at the hotel and we found that four others were also scheduled for next day and moved their time.  As we now had a total of seven people going they sent us up in a twin prop plane.  The plane was in great shape and comfortable.  We took off and had the just the best flight.  The pilot gave us some great narrative on the mountain and what we were seeing.  The air was so smooth and the plan really quick.  We were at the mountain within 15 minutes and flew around the mountain for at least 35 minutes.  No matter which way you looked it was just amazing.  I consider this one of the best events of the trip.  If you are in the area and the weather breaks you really need to look K2 Aviation up and take a flight with them.  The memories will last a lifetime.

review_title: Grand Denali with glacier landing - What a view!
review_text:
Second visit to Alaska hoping to see Mt McKinley in it's full glory and I was lucky. Waking to a beautiful sunrise on Mt McKinley I arranged with the tour desk at Talkeetna Lodge to take a Grand Denali Tour with glacier landing (2hr tour) with K2 aviation on the 3pm flight. 

K2 aviation shuttle picked up 1/2hr prior to scheduled flight and returned to the lodge. Any clients with a glacier landing are offered overboots free of charge to cover their joggers or other light shoes. The Grand Denali tour with glacier landing had 10 passengers and so used a DeHaviland Otter with the pilot giving a safety talk and procedures for glacier walk prior to boarding. We were advised there may be some turbulence due to warm air over the mountains but we never had any. Seating was first in with a single seat at every window ensuring everyone had a stunning view, the back seat was low slung so I felt was really only suitable for tall people as you had to lean a little forward to see out the windows and one passenger was accommodated in the co-pilot seat. As an enthusiastic photographer I sat in the seat opposite the door and the downside was many images had the wing strut and wing tip in the left side of the photo. However, I was able to overcome this by using 'Live view' on my camera and pointing the lens backwards.  Probably would be better to try and get into the forward seats. It didn't matter which side you sat as the pilot and route allowed spectacular views from both. The landing onto Ruth Glacier was smooth and the 1/2hr was long enough to take photos of other planes arriving/departing and the surrounding mountains. It also allows you to appreciate the depth of the snow. 

I initially wanted the summit flight but was hesitant and decided on this as the day was glorious and we saw the summit along with numerous other mountains in the Alaskan range. The return flight and landing was excellent better than some commercial flights. Well worth the expense for the grandeur and appreciation of the mountain climbers tenacity and stamina. If you have taken the time to get to Talkeetna/Denali and the mountain is out spend the money for one of the highlights of Alaksa, it's the icing on top of the cake.

review_title: for those visiting on a time budget--just be aware to have a plan B
review_text: I specifically booked on K2 for their reviews. Flew 7+hrs from houston to anchorage and this was supposed to be my highlight for my trip. i was booked with K2 for sat 9/3 for a tour+landing (they charge 1/2 on your CC and rest when you show up). Before leaving Anchorage called them at 803am that day to verify landing and the lady on the phone said "yes, we're landing this morning". Drove the slightly over 2 hours to talkeetna and during checkin at 1015am, the gentleman that was there (tall slim guy) mentioned they would fly for the tour but <1% chance of landing. When asked about other landings told to me on the phone, they said they never even landed that morning due to weather and also that its bad to land in the summer time. Clearly this was an expectation bummer to me from the first call that am to the reality check at the counter since i'm one of those that hate surprises. All they had to do was tell me the same on the phone that chances were looking slim to land today and that would have been more than enough warning to me to be atleast have planned for plan B incase this did not work. I asked for why the discrepancy over the phone with what the lady said just 2hrs ago vs. now at the counter and got absolutely NO apology for that. Yes, i did get my refund but again my point is for those on a time crunch since i visited alaksa for just the labor day weekend, beware that even if you do not get to land (if thats what you want, like i did) you may be still told on the phone to come in. (i wish that same gentleman i spoke to in person had answered the phone that morning saving me this review. It would'nt have been frustrating at all, had both the messages on the phone+in person were in sync). But obvisouly keeping safety in mind, it was best to not land (i'm just a little frustrated that the same could have been communicated over the phone to either help a customer avoid the road trip or have a plan B to do in talkeetna---that's all). The actual problem is as with any airline making $ from tourists, they would NOT like to say NO on the phone to any customer and K2 is no exception. Just be careful for those on a time budget, pls. try to check prior to your roadtrip as best you can since they do offer re-scheduling or atleast keep something else in talkeetna to do as plan B (which is what i did in the end taking the rapids cruise on the talkeetna river. i was lucky to find this on the spot there but i would suggest you plan for a plan B).

review_title: Trip of a lifetime-You must do this!
review_text: I have to admit I was not looking forward to this trip, being a plane wimp, but this plane adventure was truly awesome!  The day we had scheduled was cold and rainy with very little visibility, but K2 rescheduled without any hesitation for later that week when the weather looked better.  This was our very last day in Alaska, so we were praying for the clouds to part, which they did.  Our pilot, Barry, was a fellow Hoosier and was a medvac in the past, which relaxed me a little.  It was just our family in the small plane and I sat in the back for photography reasons (he said) probably had to do more with weight distribution.  I was gearing myself up for a bumpy scary ride, but it never happened.  From the time we took off until we landed it was smooth, relaxing and spectacular.  Barry was very informative about the plane itself, the scenery and the glaciers, plus interesting humorous stories of past flights.  After the initial few seconds, I really wasn't scared at all, even with the glacier landing, which was a blast.  SOOOOO cool standing on a real glacier in the mountains of Alaska.  My two teenagers absolutely loved the trip also. Very few people get to even see Mount Denali, let alone fly around it and land on a glacier.  This was by far our favorite part of our two week vacation, and we had a great vacation.  It is expensive I not going to lie about that, but so worth every penny!!  Buy a Tour Saver coupon book and you can get a two for one offer.  Thanks so much, Barry!!  Have fun with those grandkids!!

review_title: K2 Sightseeing Flight to McKinley awesome and well worth it...a light-light of three month stay in Alaska!
review_text:
It was a bluebird day and we booked an afternoon flight to see Mt. McKinley from the air. We had pilot, Gary, who was a terrific guide and a fun trip. We went in a Beaver DeHaviland aircraft along with 7 other people. Could not have had a more spectacular view or trip.
Highy recommend K2 as this is our 3rd time flying with them and excellent each trip!

We flew with Chuck West as the pilot in Cessna 185. I was with my wife. The two other passengers were two women, probably friends.
We expected a standard sightseeing flight. To our delight, the pilot was also expalining the landscape on our way to and from Mount Denali. I hold a private pilot licence since 30 years and have a university formation in physical geography, so I could apprciate the flying skills and the geographical knowledge of Mr West. This was my first experience in mountain flying. Usually my wife does not like flying because she is prone to motion sickness. But she felt all right for the hole flight (1½ hour). In addition to geographic comments, Mr West was constantly explaining his manoeuvres and reassuring the passengers especially when apparently flying close to summits and explaining that things are farther than they appear. I have worked for 25 years on helicopters in the Air Force and experienced many interesting flights, but this one was THE flight of my life and for my wife as well.
I could also appreciate the kindness of other personnel. The young woman at the desk offered us a ride to the bus stop altough it was only a 2 minute walk. Further more, I forgot something in the aircraft. The day after the flight I telephoned to K2 and Michael (if I remember well) arranged thing so diligently that this item was sent to the company's office I was travelling with in time before I embarked on the train. Thank you very much by the way. 
Being the smallest guy I had to be in the back seat which is the best place for filming and photos.
My wife and me highly recommend K2 Aviation. Surely all the pilots there show great professionalism, but I can tell you if you fly with Chuck West you will have a great flight.

Robert Frenette
Québec, Canada

review_title: Exactly what we were looking for.
review_text: Given the weather was causing us trouble seeing local sites, we opted for flightseeing. We were comfortable and had the best seats in the house!!

Heather at the front desk did everything she could to get us a flight seeing trip to see Mt. McKinley. She was great! Also our pilot Greg Sanoski gave us a wonderful trip. We can't wait to do it again.

I'm a local, and I won this flight off of the radio.
Making reservations was a breeze, they had plenty of seats available. Their webcam made it easy for me to monitor the weather before driving up from Wasilla. When I called that morning, they were able to give me a weather report so we didn't have to drive up if the weather was bad.
Check in was a breeze. I was a little nervous that my weight would be an issue. I'm pretty fat. But it wasn't.
Our pilot gave us a briefing and we loaded up in the Otter. Take off was smooth and we headed towards the mountain. The flight was perfect. There's was some clouds around the mountain, but our pilot worked around them.
The pilot narrated as we went.  I was able to get a lot of great pictures.
I'd do this trip again in a heartbeat, and I would recommend it to others.

review_title: K2 Aviation & Rick the pilot gave us an unforgettable flight around Mt. McKinley!
review_text:
We had the 1 hr flight around Mt McKinley even though the clouds moved in somewhat, the views of the glaciers and mountains were breath-taking. And our 1 hr didn't start until we were in the air. Rick our pilot was very informative and friendly, as were all the staff. From the shuttle driver to the staff in the office. Everyone must be weighed to balance out the plane, but it was done very discreetly so as not to embarass anyone.
And when the clouds did move in heavily you were given the option to reschedule or cancel your flight and get a refund! Excellent friendly service from start to finish!

review_title: Priceless memory made during an INCREDIBLE Alaskan adventure!
review_text: We ended up taking 3 different planes and our entire family on the Denali Lake Moraine fly-in day hike this summer. What a truly incredible experience. We had people ranging in age from 8 to 79 and each and every person had such a wonderful time. It is pretty incredible with Alaska being so vast to get in one day a flight on a float plane, a hike in Denali that is only accessible by flying in and a tour from the air! Amazing!!  K2 aviation and the tour guides for the hike were so knowledgeable, nice and graciously accommodating. We felt truly at ease with the pilots who were so good about answering questions and pointing out sights during the flight. We will for sure be flying with K2 again and will make sure all our guests are aware of such a rare and wonderful Alaskan adventure. Since this was a new adventure offered just this summer, it felt like finding that hidden gemstone that hasn't yet been fully discovered. We are one of maybe only 100 people that have been to this part of Denali Park... now that is something to write home about!

What do you need?
A great weather (thats luck!)
A working aircraft and
A pilot,who explains and gives you the safe feeling from taxiing out to touch down, like Greg Sanoski.

Came w/o reservation - as it was a beautiful day. Got a flight within 30 min. and it was simply unbelievable.

review_title: Incredible Scenery, only exceeded by the professional service of K2.
review_text:
Our Flight Seeing adventure with K2 Aviation in Talkeetna, AK was the highlight of our 10 day Alaskan vacation.  Although we traveled to several other cities and participated in many other attractions, our Flight Seeing trip with K2 was by far the highlight of our family vacation.  The K2 employees were all personable, professional and welcoming from the gentleman fueling the planes, to the office staff who attended to every detail for our party to be sure we were prepared properly for our chosen flight. Selecting a flight was no easy task with all K2 had to offer, but after discussions with Trevor the very well informed Flight Scheduler we selected the Glacier Lake landing on a Dehaviland Beaver Float Plane.  
Our pilot Randy not only made my entire family feel safe and secure from the push off from the dock until our splash down back at Fish Lake the lake of departure. Randy's informative and humorous conversation quickly put anxious nerves at ease during the flight, taking time to point out interesting landmarks and educate us about the geologic formations and glacier dynamics.  His information turned this outing into as much a learning experience as it was an exciting family adventure.  After gliding deep into gorgeous mountain valleys above sky blue glaciers with glacier melt carving deep ravines forming frigid glacial rivers, we landed on a remote glacial lake deep in the heart of the glaciers.  Once we landed and the plane was secured, we disembarked and were introduced to two friendly professional and informative guides that continued to educate us to the beauty and unique features this area offers.  As we hiked up mountain paths the local wildlife and fauna was pointed out and discussed.  Flowing mountain streams were crossed and gorgeous photo ops abounded in a part of the world few human's feet ever get the chance to travel.  
At the completion of our hike we were treated to delicious locally produced products such as cheeses, sausages and salmon and a few different selections of wine.  It was a thoroughly well thought out excursion leaving nothing more we could ask for.
Upon our return to the float plane base on Fish Lake , I realized I had seen this picturesque location in a published photo somewhere in my past. I have attached my photo for you to compare.

It gets no better than this, thank you K2 for a full and wonderful Family Adventure!

review_title: #1 Go flightseeing #2 Go with K2 for an unparalleled experience
review_text:
There are so many flightseeing companies in Alaska but K2 is in a class all its own. This company is steeped in tradition and no one knows the area better than their pilots. This type of adventure is costly, but let me tell you, it is worth every penny. 
I'm an airline pilot and I thought, eh, I'm used to seeing the world from above, this will be nice, but it was unlike anything I've ever experienced! I am so glad I made this a priority! We were flying so close to the face of Denali, it was unbelievable. To see the details of the mountain up close like that was a once in a lifetime experience. The scenery just took your breath away. Go, you won't be disappointed!

We booked a glacier landing because K2 said it was their most popular package.  We fould out later at the Natl Park bldg. even professional climbers aren't allowed on Mt. McKinley after July because the weather is too iffy.  K2 doesn't tell you that when they take your $$$.  We rescheduled 3 times.  Finally the weather cleared & we were ready to go.  Should have know things weren't going to go well when we got to K2.  It was a chinese fire drill behind the counter.  We checked in with a teenager who talked to us with a mouthful of cereal she was eating at the counter.  I asked about a refund on the landing portion of the trip and she said it would be done after we got back.  As for the flight it was just so so.  The pilot didn't have much to say about what little we saw.  He was more concerned about the other air traffic.  Rightfully so.  It was like flys around a bag of trash up there.  Everyone was trying to get as many people up & back down as fast as possible.
When we got back the teenager "reversed" our original charge and recharged us for our flight.  What she didn't tell us was the orginial charge had already been paid!  We were charged over $1000.00 for the flight!  It's pointless to try and explain my phone calls to K2 trying to fix the problem.  Pretty much blew me off each time.  It's about 6 days later and the charges still aren't right.  Needless to say I wouldn't recommend K2 to anyone.  As a matter of fact there are lots of towns & cities where you can book flights & landings to Mt. McKinley.  You don't have to go to Talkeeetna.  Do yourself a favor aand check them out.

review_title: An Alaskan experience I will NEVER forget!
review_text:
I have lived in Alaska for over 20 years.  I see Mt. McKinley (Denali as we know it) on a daily basis.  I have always appreciated its magnificence and splendor, but I never knew how glorious it really was until yesterday, when I decided to fly with K2 to the Kahiltna Glacier.  The flight was easy, comfortable and smooth as silk.  The landing on the glacier was more like floating down and landing on a cloud.  Getting out, and walking around on the fresh snow in the middle of August was surreal.  Seeing the looks on the faces of the people around me was priceless.  Once we took off, and headed toward the peak of Denali, the skies became bluer, the sun shiner, and the mountain became the most spectacular sight I have ever seen.  Our pilot kept us informed about every little thing, from the history of the mountain and range, to the slight bump we might feel in the clouds.  I couldn't have imagined a more perfect way to see the world's tallest mountain!
I highly recommend this most amazing adventure.

review_title: I can't wait to do it again!
review_text:
My mom and I went on the most amazing flight tour/day hike. The pilot was friendly and answered  all of the questions I asked. We flew into the Ruth Glacier. WOW! What a beautiful place.
