Before I knew it we touched down on a glacier lake where guides met us and explained what we would be doing, giving a great description of the area and the history of Denali.

Waterfalls, Denali, tundra, glaciers, Mountain Ptarmigan, and tasty treats at the end of the hike. What a way to spend the day. I can't wait to go back.

Abigail

Pilot Greg Sanoski was outstanding making this flight the highlight of my trip to Alaska.
Donna Moore

We just returned home from Alaska. Sadly, it rained most of our 12 days but we still had a fabulous time. We were rescheduled 3 times for the K2 flight into the mountains and we actually thought it would not happened. On the day we left for home we were able to squeeze in this trip--the fog lifted and the sun came out for a short window of time. We had a fabulous flight. Got very close to the mountain. The people at K2 were fabulous; they did not leave us but kept coming back to give reports and encouragement. So glad it happened but if it hadn't, they promised a full refund. Glad we didn't get it! Thanks a bunch--a real highlight. (Phyllis from RI)

We booked this tour and had been told it would be the highlight of our trip to Alaska. The morning of the tour the weather changed and a storm was reported. We called K2 company and were told by the staff to still make the two and a half hour drive to Talkeetna from Anchorage. We were also told that if we if deciced to not take the tour due to weather and the plane left we would have to pay for the tour regardless. 

We called an hour into our drive out to check on the weather and were still told to come to the site. When we arrived we were immediately told that the flight would be canceled and we would not be able fly at all that day. The company informed us that there were afternoon flights that were full and we could not wait to see if the weather improved. They told us we could reschedule for the following day but that would be the best they could do. We were at least refunded our money but that was hardly worth it for wasting an entire day of our trip. 

Another disturbing fact we were told by one of the staff members was that frequently due to weather situations on Mt. Mckinley, the planes are unable to land on the glacers. That was not told to us when we booked this flight tour and we would not have spent the time had we known that fact. 

This company did a poor job of keeping the customers interests at heart and completely wasted our precious time during our trip in Alaska. I would not recommend using them in the future.

Nice scenery, horrible treatment by front desk staff. Wish we went with a different company, others had better prices and all fly from same space. Reserved summit tour over phone, but when we arrived were told that we may need to take a different tour because they need to make money and would not take a party of 3 on summit tour. We asked gentleman at front desk about alternate tour, but we were never given answers and treated like our experience did not matter. In addition, credit card information was taken over phone and charged half the fee completely unauthorized. The woman over the phone asked for information but did not say over 400 would be charged before I arrived. Guess we were not only ones dissatisfied, we heard over our headsets that someone else had issue and would receive a credit.

A memorable trip with Greg Sadoski to see Mt. McKinley.  We lucked out with a beautiful day but the flight was made much better by Greg's commentary and description (very patiently) of what we were seeing.  Sometimes it was hard to differentiate mountains and Greg was very helpful in getting us acclimated to the terrain. We even saw a bear on a hillside.  A great experience -- one that was a highlight of our 2 weeks in Alaska!

review_title: A highlight in a long trip
review_text: We had one and a half days in Talkeetna and decided on K2 to look over the Alaskan ranges. "incredible" and a not to be missed tour. The team at K2 were excellent and we have done many of these trips and this was our best experience. The planes were fantastic with large windows and a single seat down each side of the plane so everyone got a window and fantastic view. Plenty of leg room and very comfortable, would highly recommend this trip to anyone. We got to land on a glacier and this isn't a sure thing as weather conditions can change

review_title: Robotic pilot/guide made the trip boring.
review_text:
K2 did what they promised, did it on time, and was hassle-free.  I expect that on a trip, and that is why I gave them an average rating.  The only negative was that our pilot/guide was a robot.  From the safety briefing to the landing, he never said hello, good morning, or any other pleasantries.  We could have been martians and he would not have noticed.  We were his cattle, and he was herding us so that he could get back to the next group of waiting cattle.  

I would not go on this tour again.  

A week after this trip, we flew over to Katmai National Park with K-Bay.  The mountains we flew over were more scenic than what we saw on our trip with K2.

Great customer service! Very professional.  Had a chance to be part of a picnic they do for the town each spring and enjoyed the community spirit and GREAT weather.  Kind folks and very knowledgable.  I recommend their service to all our friends and visitors.

My husband and I had an amazing experience flying with K2.  Our flight was very smooth and our pilot was great at explaning the area and making us feel comfortable.  I would highly recommend flying with K2!

I took the McKinley Experience tour flight with K2 yesterday-  There are no adjectives to describe my experience; they all pale in comparison, there are LITERALLY no words that do any of it justice!

Our flight was piloted by Ed- he flew the plane with ease and as he narrated the trip, you got a feel for the love he has of this place.... it was more of a “sitting beside your grandpa’s knee” type of narration rather than a scribed tour guide experience.  At the end of the trip, I didn’t want to say goodbye to him; I felt like I had known him forever and wanted more! 

Last year, while stopping beside the highway to take a picture, a person driving a rental car pulled over behind my SUV.  As the occupant got out of the car and approached me, he said, “What do you see? I figure that if someone with an Alaskan license plate stops to take a photo, so should I.”  Well, the same thing applies here folks, if Alaskans choose K2 for their flight seeing experience, so should you!  

In the future, our family will bringing all our visitors for a K2 Experience!  Thank you again for an incredible experience.   

Sara Smith

review_title: Fantstic Glacier Landing by Mt. McKinley
review_text: Fantastic scenic tours by ski-plane around Mt. McKinley highlighted by a landing on a near-by glacier.  Very professional.  The experience of a lifetime!  Highly recommended when in Talkeetna, AK.

review_title: Amazing views of the Alaska Range
review_text:
Outstanding pilots and service!
Flying is the best way to see the Alaska Range and Mt McKinley (Denali). To top off this incredible experience only a landing at one of the glaciers. I did it all, and even leaving here in Talkeetna I don't take for granted the views of the mountains, and every time possible I fly with K2.

I chose K2 over the other flightseeing operators in Talkeetna because of the positive reviews on TripAdvisor and because they were a little less expensive than some of the competition (visit their web site and take the "quiz" for a discount).  I took the McKinley Flyer tour with a glacier landing. We went in a 10 passenger plane and every seat had a window view.  The pilot was great, providing narration throughout the trip and circling the most scenic areas in order to give passengers on both sides of the plane a good view.  There was almost no turbulence making for a very comfortable ride.  The company appears to put a priority on safety and maximizing the passenger experience; e.g., on the day I flew, glacier landings were rerouted to a more distant glacier because of the weather, so the flights were running a little behind schedule.  This was not a problem for me, but the staff would have been willing to put me on an earlier flight or refund my deposit entirely if this were not acceptable.

While in Talkteena, Alaska I did a tour with K2 Aviation to better see the Alaskan Mt Range... The service there was exceptional. The staff is so friendly and they really take the time to explain things to you. The pilot, Chad, was far better than any commerical pilot I have ever had. It was a very smooth and comfortable flight. He took time to point out views and tell us interseting facts about the range and Alaska, which made the experience even more enjoyable. The view form the plane is absolutely breathtaking. You will be in awe the entire time. K2 is an absolute must for anyone traveling to Alaska. A truely memorable experience.

review_title: Professional organization with a very liberal cancellation policy.
review_text: I flew with K2 aviation yesterday morning after several weather related delays. The staff patiently answered all of my questions over the phone ( thanks stephanie). Pilot Greg was great. Operated safely and his experience was obvious. The aircraft were clean and well maintained.

review_title: Fly with K2 and you will not be sorry! Thank You Greg Sanoski!!!!!!!!!!
review_text:
My wife and I flew with K2 on July 17th and we had the time of our lives!  As you may be aware of, In Alaska, there is no guaranteed view of the mountain with changing weather. This is why we opted to spend the bucks on a flight-seeing tour.  I made reservations for the glacier landing but upon arriving found that it was considered unsafe because timing put us in the later part of the season and the landing area was getting slushy.  There was no beating around the bush by Talkeetna. The desk attendant made the announcement that there would be no landings today and that a full refund would be given.  Since they have done this thousands of times, I trusted their decision and went for the alternate anyway. that's why I made this Journey.

Our pilot was Greg Sanoski.  He more than made up for the altered reservation.  I'm sure all of the pilots at K2 are great, but Greg showed us the times of our lives.  We were very lucky flying in from the East and got the most fantastic sunlit view of the top of Denali!!!!  He circled around and between the clouds taking time to give great narration as we viewed the great corridor, Ruth Glacier, Sheldon Amphitheater and many more of his favorite spots.  The flight from start to finish was very smooth. I got a kick out of his wish list for future landings.  We were shown grizzly bear and moose which I though were added extras because he took time circling around to ensure my wife got a good view as well. I especially liked the ability to talk back and forth.  (One quick lesson I found out was you got to have the mike close to your mouth and talk slow in order for it to work correctly) 

If you are contemplating whether or not you should do this trip because of cost, I hope you choose the flight.  You will talk about it for the rest of your life like me.  By the way, when I did get to Denali, it was overcast so this may be your only chance to see "The Great One"  I never met these people before and I feel they went out of their way to show me a great time.  If you want to e-mail me for more info, please do so rayberesh@gmail.com  I strongly recommend this service to those looking for a great time!!!!!!!!
THANK YOU GREG!  I WILL BE BACK SOMEDAY.  YAHOOOOOOOOO!!!!!!

PS.  By the time I arrived home from my trip, a message  was on my machine from the travel agent stating my refund for the difference was already there. Sooo with that said, It shows they are prompt at paperwork.

A visit to Talkeetna would not be complete without doing a flight with K-2. they have a number of options for flights, from a fly around the range to landing on the glacier. In the past, we have done the summit flight at 22,000 feet. To fly between the peaks of Denali and look down is something to remember the rest of your life. Their pilots are very professional and have a lot of flying time which is what you would what if flying in this area. This trip we chose the fly around with with Eddy as our pilot. He made us very comfortable from the start. He and Dale are very friendly and will make your trip even more memorable. 
John & Susan

review_title: Amazing flight into the Alaskan Range.
review_text: The flight at K2 was an exceptional way to see the Alaskan Rnage. The weather conditions were not optimal, but this doesn't take away from the one of a kind sights to see there. Furthermore it was a very smooth flight to and from the mountains. In my opinion it's the best tour you can take from Talkeetna.

As a semi-timid airplane flyer I was nervous before this flight.  Urged on by a native alaskan who ensured me of the safety and absolute beauty of K2 Aviation, I eventually decided that I would probably regret it for the rest of my life if I didn't go.  And I'm glad I did!  The pilot (Chris) was extremely personable, even after I told him that "I don't want to die today."  The take-off was extremely smooth and easy, and afterwards the rest was  a piece of cake.  We flew over glaciers, mountains, streams, and it was a truly beautiful and awe-inspiring experience that cannot be duplicated on anything except for a small aircraft.  I highly recommend it to anyone that wants to truly experience the extremes of alaska without perilously scaling a glacier or enduring an uncomfortable month-long hiking trip.  Spectacular.

If you ever come to Alaska, flying K-2 should be at the top of the list. They have the best pilots, that know the history of the area.  Why settle for less than the best. remember there is good, better and best and everyone deserves the best, fly K-2.
Absolutely amazing experience with excellent and friendly staff.  I would do this again in a heartbeat.  I've never seen anything so beautiful as the flight over the glacier!

review_title: Aboslutely out of this world experience.
review_text: Visited Talkeetna, AK for a short vacation.   Once the weather cleared up, K2 aviation came alive.   People just poured into the K2 office wanting to sign up for a trip to view Mt McKinley up close.    I was able to hitch a ride on one of the flights that lands on a glacier.   While I was waiting to board the plane, another passenger had just come back from the flight and all he kept saying over and over was "ABSOLUTELY AMAZING....JUST AMAZING....AMAZING...AMAZING...AMAZING."  I started laughing because he couldn't stop staying amazing.   Well..., trust me, after taking the trip, I understood why.    Don't miss this opportunity.  It is out of this world AMAZING.  K2 employees are exceptional.
I will never forget this experience! The flight and the pilot was amazing and glacier landing was definately something that cant be put in to words!!! Thank you so much!!!!!!

review_title: K2 is the best way to experience Mt. McKinley
review_text: You'll simply run out of superlatives talking about this breathtaking flight. K2 is a first rate operation; their airplanes are clean and scrupulously maintained (a good first sign). Their pilots are polite, professional, obviously well trained and experienced. Not just anyone can or should fly 'light' airplanes around McKinley and her minions, let alone land on the glaciers. These guys know their way around this mountain range. K2's the outfit I always reccommend.

30 yrs ago, my friends Kitty and Kimball started K2 Aviation.  I was climbing Denali.  This summer, I flew with K2 into the mountains.  A great Pilot.  He guided us threw history, geology, laughter, security, and the ever present wonder of it all.........Thank you K2 .

review_title: Safe, experienced, fun: K2 Aviation Is Locally Known to be best
review_text: We have a friend who is a bush pilot in Alaska who recommended we used K2, and we are grateful for the reference.  Denali was beautiful.  But our pilot Doug's love for flying, for the mountaineers, and for Denali was itself a treasure.

review_title: best experience out of 10 great days in Alaska
review_text: I booked K2 after looking at 100s of excursions and dozens of companies for a flightseeing tour. I decided on flightseeing Denali because I have a bad back which made the 4 hour drive from Anchorage to the Denali NP gates plus the additional at least 6 hour bus tour since private vehicles are not allowed in the park not a good option. During my review of companies K2 seemed very well priced for the amount of time spent in the air; basically it seemed like we got a lot of bang for our buck. I booked the plane for a group of 4 so it was just us and the pilot. The pilot was great, giving us a running commentary of Denali history and other facts. I chose the green route which was more than long enough for all of us. The windows on the plane were large enough so that our view wasn't obstructed. On the day we flew, there was a lot of cloud cover and I was concerned we wouldn't get to see much of the mountain however the pilot expertly navigated around the clouds and was able to get us stunning views amazingly close to the mountain. I have been to many national parks in my lifetime so I am getting pretty good at viewing mountains, wildlife, and all things natural but I have to say the view from the air completely different and mesmerizing. I have no complaints about the ride, the pilot, the plane, or anything. In fact everything was great and this experience ended up being the highlight of our trip. I highly recommend this company and this tour to anyone interested in seeing Denali and making it a once in the lifetime experience.

review_title: Smooth, scenic flight around Mt. McKinley - terrific adventure!
review_text: My husband booked K2 as he had purchased the Alaskan Tour Saver book, and we had a 2 for 1 coupon for a flight to view Mt. McKinley.  Our flight was booked for 8:30 AM, but conditions were not good enough for the flight, and we ended up postponing it 4 times over the course of a couple of days. The staff at K2 was very accommodating and allowed us to reschedule the flight according to our travel plans. ...and it was a very safe feeling for a white knuckle flyer, like me, to know that they would not take the plane up until the conditions were optimum. Or actual flight was terrific - smooth and enjoyable with great views of McKinley, a friendly and competent  pilot, Chris, who pointed everything out to us. It was an amazing adventure - and one I would definitely repeat.  We highly recommend K2!

Booked a flightseeing tour of Mount McKinley and staff was able to work with us when running late because of road construction.  Pilot showed points of interest and positioned the plane so all could have a good view.

review_title: Landing on a glacier was the experience of a lifetime.
review_text: Flying over the glaciers and landing on a glacier is a unique experience that has been on my "bucket list" for years.  I have done quite a bit of flying in small planes throughout Alaska, but flying over Ruth Glacier and being that close to Denali is an experience I will never forget.  The glacier landing was smooth, and our pilot, Chris, volunteered to take photos for everyone as we walked around on Ruth Glacier in the silence it took ages to create.  My 18 year old daughter and I took tons of pictures and videos, and now have a very special and unique memory to share together!  Thanks, K2 Aviation!

review_title: Nice people even when you can't fly
review_text:
The weather over Mt Denali doesn't always allow for flight seeing tours. I know because we spent three days last June trying to fly over Denali but in the end had to settle for a trip to Knik glacier.  Through the entire experience the staff at K2 were extremely pleasant and accommodating.  Every day they would squeeze us into the schedule only to have to try again the next day.  As I said we did eventually fly to Knik but couldn't get to Danali.  So this year we returned to Talkeetna again in June hoping to see Denali.  Well, once again, the weather did not cooperate.  Again everyone was extremely pleasant and helpful.  They again rescheduled us for the next day (our last in Talkeetna) and we all hoped for the best.  Hooray, the weather broke and we flew out at 1 pm with Ed.  Still the top of the mountain was shouted in cloulds but Ed persisted and we did get to see the summit - Finally!
You can find out a lot about an organization when things don't go as planned.  That's why I would recommend K2 above all others.

review_title: Great company and an amazing experience - GO!
review_text: Excellent customer service. Friendly and relaxed pilots.  The glacier landing is a must - truly breathtaking!  If you do anything while in Alaska, go to K2 and get on a plane!

review_title: K2 Aviation: "Wow" Is All We Can Say!
review_text:
All I can say is GO. And K2 is the company to GO with.
That's our experience. And what an experience it was...

If you have the means and the wherewithall to
afford this trip, it is worth every penny and K2
is the company to fly with. The trip is expensive for sure.
but what the heck... You only live once. You'll never have an experience
like this again. Denali at 20,000 feet. It is the grandest adventure beyond your wildest
dreams.

I don't have the luxury of comparing K2 Aviation with other
flight comapnies in the area.

But I can share with you, this IS the trip of a liftetime,
an incredible memory that you will always remember.

We selected the two hour Denali Grand Tour, and believe me, it was
worth it.

The K2 Staff is incredibly relaxed, courteous, and well organized.
They are certainly willing to spend time with you via email, over the phone,
or in person answering all your questions and addressing your concerns.
They are a great crew.

We traveled with them on Wednesday June 8, at 1PM. Tony was our pilot.
There were a lot of people flying that day at different times.

The weather in Alaska is tricky and constantly changing. The weather on Denali
even more so, as the mountain makes it's own weather. The pilots and the company itself, are very attuned to the constantly changing weather conditions. If in doubt, they simply won't fly. Period. The safety of their customers has the highest importance.

There had been rain in the area for several days prior to our trip, and the day we flew,
it was partly sunny with some low lying clouds. So weather was a possible concern.

We took off right on time. Once we got above the clouds our views were unimpeded and they were just stunning. Words simply cannot describe the jaw dropping majesty of this flight. You'd have to see our photos and High Definition videos to comprehend this.

The Glacier landing was spectacular! At that elevation the sun was very strong.  The air was cold, but not terribly so. Would suggest bringing gloves and some good sunblock.

Tony, our pilot, carefully watched an ominous low hanging cloud just over the peak. He stated that if he gave the signal, we had to board immediately and make a hasty retreat, adding to the drama of the trip. But that ominous cloud never brought any dramatic, sudden weather changes to our location. We spent probably 20-25 minutes on the Glacier and took tons of photos. It was incredible.

The return trip back to base was beautiful. The flight, smooth all the way, and not rushed.
Tony's narration throughout the flight was very complete and informative.

Yes, this is expensive. But you'll never have an opportunity like this again.

We loved our K2 experience!

review_title: Probably One of Your 5 Best Days
review_text: There are plenty of superlative reviews here that provide all of the information you need to choose K2. I'll add these points - we booked our flightseeing through Celebrity (cruise ship) Land Excursions -- so K2 is their provider in Talkeetna if you are visiting with Celebrity. K2's airstrip is within walking distance of just about anywhere in Talkeetna (a town of 2 streets!) so don't be concerned with getting there.  When we were planning our trip, I saw a flightseeing/glacier landing on U-Tube, which introduced me to the notion of flightseeing. I am terrified of being in small planes, but I couldn't forget those 5 minutes of U-Tube film. So I booked us and when the day arrived I kept my eyes tightly shut until we reached the mountain range and then ------ well, then came one of the happiest days of my life. We were fortunate to fly on a rare, 70-something sunny May day, but you could truly make your own sunshine for this experience. Our pilot, Al, gave us a smooth flight (smoother than anything I'd ever experienced on a commercial plane) and incredibly gentle landings on the glacier and back at the airstrip. There is no 'hot dogging' - all of the pilots seem to put safety first. Finally, if you can do it, the glacier landing is absolutely not to be missed.

review_title: Outstanding McKinley Flight Experience With Glacier Landing
review_text: This was a favorite of our group of 5. K2 has amazing customer service.  I was concerned because the conditions that day had been erratic for glacier landings.  I didn't want to do the flight without landing on the glacier.  They were very considerate and explained that it was of course a safety concern. We went and got to land on the glacier and had a great  time.  When I left and got to our next destination I realized I had accidentally thrown away an important file.  I called K2 and an amazing employee named David actually gloved up and WENT THROUGH THE GARBAGE and recovered the file  for me.  Customer service is very important to me and K2 definitely went above and beyond. I highly recommend K2.

It was so wonderful and really unbelievable (grand tour with landing) at Mt. McKinley. Yes, it is not cheap but it's worth of $400 on every second of two hours. The experience would not be completed without landing. Amazing, breath taking, heart falling, est...

I had a friend gift me a flight with the glacier landing for my birthday! This was an amazing experience. The pilot was wonderful, and pointed out numerous features that I had never seen before.   It was truly incredible. My face was pressed to the glass the entire way.  I had driven through on my way to Alaska, but even with that, I would never have guessed how much more magnificent the range is from above.  

Landing on the glacier was an experience, going from the middle of summer to a beautiful, sunny winter's day!  Remember to wear sneakers on your trip.  We had gotten to see the climbers from the air, and they were friendly and willing to talk about their experiences as well. It was a mix of cultures and nationalities, all in Alaska to admire the spectacular mountain range.  I have lived in Alaska since I was a little girl, but this was my first flight, and I would definitely recommend it!
I done a lot of cool things, but this was top 5!  K2 is a well run, accomodating, safe and fun company to use for a Glacier Landing @ McKinley!

Seeing Denali was on my list of things to do in Alaska.  It wasn't out during our trip into the park, and weather was not good the next day either.  We were supposed to go on a lower flight and do a glacier landing, but the weather was no cooperating, but K2 got us on a Summit Flight which still gave us great views of the mountain (just no landing), and I got to mark it off my list.

Very professional outfit with great customer service.

review_title: The most spectacular thing to do in Alaska, fantastic value for the experience of a lifetime.
review_text: Was such a beautiful, special experience, such a smooth ride that even a white knuckler like myself was inspired to wonder, maybe I should learn to fly like these pilots, so privleged to spend their days sharing the incredible grandeur of this pristine place. We were unable to see Denali or the mountains from town, but gentleman on the phone assured me that the sun was out! in the mountains and WAS HE RIGHT! Glorious glacier landing, like walking on the moon, an unforgettable, 'Peak' experience. Glad we did not give up based on what the visibility from the ground was, we would have missed the Alaska, we had come so far to experience.

They are running a great professional outfit. The pilot was excellent and very safe. The views are great. Other folks with us were taking the Grand tour and we by default got a free upgrade. Weather did not permit us to do a glacier landing and they gave us the option of backing out and taking a full refund. We decided to go ahead and even though the views are great couldnt help but feel that without the glacier landing maybe the flight is not worth the money spent. The flight seeing tour maybe worth it only if there is the glacier landing else one might as well give it a miss. Also they had medication for nausea at the counter but wish they had actively suggested taking that as one is bound to feel nausea and it would have made our flight much better if we had taken appropriate medication.

Not only was the flight amazing, but so were the K-2 employees.   Everyone behind the desk was helpful and friendly (and patient), the pilot was quite knowledgeable and had all the answers, the equipment was all well-maintained, and the scenery was breathtaking.   What more could anyone want?  I would definately recommend anyone looking for a great excursion............fly with K-2!!!   PS......  Safety first was definately what I noticed.  I can see where that company would not be risk-takers, yet did all they could to make our trip work with the weather.

review_title: One of the most awe inspiring experiences of my life!
review_text:
I'm visiting Alaska for the first time and have really been blown away by the scenery and wildlife, it is quite simply amazing. I'd been here a few days and caught some good looks at Mt. McKinley from Talkeetna, when I decided to take a flightseeing tour. There are a couple options in town, but after visiting the airport it was obvious to me that K2 had a top notch operation. Their facilities are well maintained, they've put a lot into their visitor's center and have some great people working there. Stephanie was super friendly (and patient!) as I got signed up asked a bunch of questions. Once our group was all ready, Chris (our pilot) got us all situated and we were off. In the air Chris explained the sights and made sure both sides of the plane got good views. I lucked out and happened to get the co-pilots seat, which gave me a great view. Just when I thought I had a grasp on the scale of the mountains Chris pointed out some climbers. My eyes struggled to find the tiny specks and I realized that these mountains were far larger than I thought! My flight landed at a base camp for climbers and I have to say that if you have the time you should definitely include that. It was great to get out and take pictures, but just walking around on snow at 7200 feet was an experience in itself. 

A couple that was in my group said it was their third trip and they loved it just as much as the first time. I can see why. I'd definitely like to visit Alaska again, and a trip with K2 will be at the top of my list.
Took a flightsee tour last September, incredible views. Here is Mt Denali

Our family vacation to Alaska in August 2010 was incredible.  We booked the Mt. McKinley flight with K2 Aviation and words can't express what we saw.  The company is great to deal with, the pilot informative, and spectacular views of God's creation.  We have never seen such magnificent scenery.  We landed on the glacier and walked on what felt like was the top of the world.  K2 Aviation is the way to go!  We were so glad we booked with them.  Everyone has a window seat.  They provided boots to go over our shoes so our feet stayed dry in the ice and snow.  Our sons were in awe as were we.  It is a "must do' when in Talkeetna!  Can't wait to go back and do it again!!

We visited Mt McKinley and Denali National park.  The pilot was experienced and informative, the flight balanced and the walk on the glacier exactly what we wanted.  Great boots available for forgetful people like us. Nervous guests should definitely fly with K2!

review_title: More beautiful than any picture can capture!
review_text: My boyfriend and I are not from Alaska and wanted to desperately make the most of our experience while we were exploring the great state.  When it came time to choose an aviation company to explore the mountains and glaciers we were lost.  We had heard good things from locals about K2 Aviation and decided to give it a shot. We are so happy we did!!  Every staff member, including pilots, were extremely friendly and happy to answer any questions.  I've traveled to 13 different countries and have seen some pretty amazing things, but what we saw and experienced with K2 is definitley one of the best!  I'm sure I will use them again when we return to Alaska. Thank you K2 Aviation!!!!

review_title: Great trip with super helpful staff
review_text: We signed up for one of their glacial landing tours, but there were many clouds at our appointed time.  The staff was super helpful in explaining the current situation and giving us plenty of options on alternative tours and times.  We decided to try to wait it out and returned a few hours later.  Conditions were better for the tour, but not good enough for the glacial landing. Again, they were super helpful in explaining the situation and giving us options.  We decided to go with the tour minus the glacial landing for fear that the weather might turn worse.  The tour was fantastic, super beautiful and well worth the price.  The great customer service all the folks at K2 provided puts this very high on my recommendation list.
My friend and I did the full 360 around Mt McKinley and it was a very memorable flight! We had a very good pilot and overall very professional service. Definitely recommend.
We were blessed with a crystal blue day and wonderful pilot Jeff. An experience of a lifetime!

review_title: Once in a lifetime experience - ethical & professional
review_text: Outstanding views of glaciers and mountains. Well mantained equipment. Our flight was a little short due to weather and they refunded part of our fee.  Great guys. Don't miss it.

I have been to Alaska twice and besides visiting my friends, this is easily the best experience I have had there.  The staff of K2 are very professional and pleasant.  The pilot was very informative with the sights and had a very good sense of humor as well.  There is no experience like seeing Alaska from above.  If you think the ground level is beautiful, multiple that by 10 and you have the flight experience.  Thank you K2 for a wonderful experience.  I am recommending this attraction to all of my family and friends who travel to Alaska.  This is a MUST DO experience.

At the last moment, I got talked into taking the flight tour around Mt McKinley. We had driven up to Talkeetna for the day and it was cloudy, so no views down here. Signed up. As we took off the clouds cleared and we had the most amazing views of this magnificent mountain. The pilot was great, gave us lots of info during the tour as we flew. Took about 90 min. Bring video and still camera. So glad I went. K2 Aviation does a terrific job. Nice folks, too.

review_title: Fantastic-the best part of my Alaskan vacation
review_text: I was very apprehensive about flying in a small plane, but this was awesome.  Pilot was very friendly and provided lots of information as we flew over Mt. McKinley.    After we landed, I was ready to go again!!!!

When we were heading for the Mt McKinley area, a friend who used to live there suggested that we book a flight with K2 Aviation in Talketena. We did so and were really pleased. We hit the clear skies of September 2010. We got to the airport earlier than our booking in case the weather changed. K2 staff were very accomodating and set us up for a trip (complete with boots that they supplied for a glacier landing).  The only concer was that their minimum number of passengers for a Beaver flight was 3 and we were only a couple. We would have had to pay for the third person but a couple who had lived in the area for 11 years decided that they would take advantage of the beautiful day and fly with us. So the four of us wwnt up with a very experienced pilot, had a great flight around Mt McKinley, landed on a glacier and then returned to Talketna, with lots of  photos.  
The K2 staff were extremely helpful, accomodating and any passenger would feel very confident with their operation (e.g. only landing on a glacier that they knew was safe to land on).
We highly recommend you consider K2 if you get to fly to see Mt MKinley. Located in Talketena, they are much closer to Mt McKinley than if you fly from Denali and also closer to Anchorage.

I took a glacier landing on K2 Aviation a couple of weeks ago and it was an absolute great experience to see the surrounding area of the Denali Park in Alaska. The pilot was named Al and he definitely knew what he was doing and what he was talking about during the flight. I highly recommend going with K2 and if I could do it again, I would. Thank you for the experience K2 Aviation.

Amazing views and great pilot. The entire flight the pilot was very accommodating and made sure that everyone could see and get pictures of every spectacular view. The glacier landing was smooth and we highly recommend this once in a lifetime experience. Everyone was friendly and helpful, would definitely come here again. Thanks K2!!!

This is an absolutely awesome sightseeing flight if the weather is good and Denali is out. We took the flightseeing tour with glacier landing and the views were spectacular. Our pilot Jeff was very experienced and did a great job. This was one of the highlights of our whole trip!

review_title: K2 Aviation Talkeetna was the highlight of our trip
review_text:
We just returned from two weeks in Alaska (one week cruise and one week on land). We had other opportunities along the way to take glacier landing flights but in Talkeetna we decided to go for it. K2 came highly recommended by Princess Cruises and by other passengers.
The weather looked promising so we took the shuttle from the lodge into Talkeetna and booked the flight directly with K2.
Our pilot was Al and he was wonderful! Smooth flight and takeoffs and landings. The mountains are spectacular and breathtaking (literally... they are amazing) but the highlight was landing on Eldridge Glacier. The landing and takeoff were so smooth. It was so silent on the glacier and the sun was shining. We seemed to be right next to high peaks.
The flight lasted at least 1 1/2 hours and was even extended because it was raining at the airport upon our return. We spent at least 30 minutes on the glacier (adrenalin makes the time go so fast... take time to sit on the glacier and take it all in).
They provide the boots that fit over your shoes or hiking boots. We wore layers... hoodie and coat. When we went in late August it was so sunny that no hat or gloves were required. There was no wind.
The plane was a de Havilland Otter with 10 seats. Everyone gets a window and my husband sat in the co-pilot seat on the way up!
I highly recommend this professional company.

My wife and I had the opportunity to fly K2 Aviation from Talkeetna around Denali.  Our pilot was experienced, courteous and fun to fly with.  The views of the mountain, glacier, cliffs and valley were spectacular.  Don't miss the opportunity.

This was our first trip to Alaska. We really had no plans other than hanging out with our grand children, daughter, and son-in-law and visit a friend’s home in Cooper Landing. 

Our daughter surprised us with a K2 flight seeing  tour of Mt. McKinley. We were thinking OK up and around the mountain and back to the air strip. But that was not the program. We actually toured the surrounding area including all mountains and learned the history of the area. We saw Mt. McKinley from every direction and then we landed on the mountain. Words cannot express the breathtaking beauty of it all and the hush of the mountain.

This is truly an adventure that each person has to experience at least once in their lifetime. Our K2 flight was the crème de la crème to a vacation that we have told everyone was the best ever.

review_title: K2 Aviation, Talkeetna, Alaska - Fabulous experience!
review_text: My husband and I just returned from a 2 week trip to Alaska and are now members of the 30% Club because we were one of the fortunate few who got to see Mt. McKinley in all its glory.  Because of this good fortune, we decided at the last minute to take a flight tour with K2 Aviation.  We were part of a Princess Cruisetour and the staff at McKinley Lodge assisted with the booking of the plane ride.  Upon our arrival at K2 Aviation we were greeted by friendly desk staff.  The 1-1/4 hour McKinley Flyer trip was absolutely fabulous!  Our experienced pilot, Jeff, was outstanding and made me, a reluctant small plane passenger, immediately comfortable.  The flight was incredibly smooth and the scenery unbelievable.  My husband and I must have taken well over 100 photos during the ride.  Next time we'll definitely do a glacier landing.  We would highly recommend this company which is run by the well-known Rust family as well worth your money and time.

This was such a neat experience! There are a variety of sizes of planes and not to worry, you won't get sick! The pilots are well trained and make the flight as smooth as possible. They also add commentary about the area and try to point out animals, glaciers, rivers, house, roads, etc. The most breathtaking views I have ever seen. They fly you right up next to and in and out of the mountains. It is really neat and I would definitely recommend doing this if you go to Alaska. There is no better way to see the land!

review_title: Do it! Fun and exciting, see Alaska in...
review_text: Do it! Fun and exciting, see Alaska in all its grandure. I had a great time, personable and knowledgable staff, worth every cent. You haven't seen Alaska unless you've glided over the mountain ridges, gaciers, open tundra in a small plane. Excellent Mnt McKinely views and picture opps.

This is the trip you won't want to miss and hands down the company you want to go with. They have the most friendly staff with the most experienced pilots. They do everything they can to make your trip the best it can be. The sights are breath taking and unforgettable. This will without doubt be one of the highlights of your trip if not the highlight.

My family and I went on the 1.5 hour Denali flightseeing trip last week with a  pilot named Randy. He flew us up in a Cessna that was just right for all four of us. He was really great and showed us the beauty of Denali, up close and personal. We saw the base camp for all of the climbers that scale the mountain and the massive glaciers and mountains of the Alaska range. The Ruth Amphitheater and the great Gorge of the Ruth Glacier were just two of the many highlights. My mom couldn't talk about it because she was too busy actually crying at the beauty of it all. Don't miss this trip, it's the experience of a lifetime.

review_title: We were another group that had planned to...
review_text:
We were another group that had planned to fly on August 12th, but conditions were bad and worsening as our flightsee time approached.  The office staff were extremely helpful and accomodating, offering us the choice of taking one of their non-Denali trips with a refund of the price difference or waiting a day to see if conditions improved.  We chose to postpone our trip for a day and are very glad that we did.

Friday the 13th actually proved to be a fantastic day.  The weather cleared up and Denali "came out", showing itself and allowing us to take the tour we signed up for.  We also got the added treat of a glacier landing, which we had been told the day before was likely out of the question for the remainder of the season.  All in all, I highly recommend K2 Aviation.

a must for all keenly alive adventurers! 
spiritual and humbling ....we must protect our natural world!

Lani, Marc and Kris

In June 2010 4 of us took the Grand Denali Tour.  Booking this tour on our own separate from the cruise line was a bit tricky but saved us a great deal.  Elaine from K2 was most pleasant & helpful.  The flight left right on time & we were fortunate enough to have the plane, a 4 seater to ourselves.  The pilot, Randy was excellent, very detailed & thoughtful . . .so much so that numerous times he would bank the plane so I could take better pictures.  Randy was also very informative in telling us what we were viewing at any given time.  While this was our first & only flightseeing experience in Alaska I cannot imagine how any operator could top K2!  Highly recommended!

Our K2 flight was a great way to see the mountain "up close".  Taking off from Talkeetna and heading towards the mountain, our pilot explained the geology of the area, pointed out the interesting sites, and soon we were climbing over glaciers and heading up Mt McKinley.  At some points, flying between 2 rock faces several thousand feet high, it seemed the wingtips were close enough to touch the rocks, though our pilot did let us know we had hundreds of feet of clearance.  The sights were amazing, and the landing on the glacier very much worth the extra charge.  K2 was professional all the way, the pilot did a great job of keeping up a running commentary and answering questions (and, of course, flying the plane), and I highly recommend the trip to anyone visiting the area.

review_title: K2 Flight was highlight of trip
review_text: K2 was extremely professional and when they couldn't fly us to our original destination (Mt. McKinley) due to weather conditions, they 1) offered us a refund if we wanted or 2) suggested another trip.  We opted for the trip.  Our pilot flew us to the Knik Glacier area and took us right above the glacier and the mountains (breathtaking).  He was very knowledgable about the area too.  We saw parts of Alaska we would never have been able to see by bus, train or foot.  It was definitely a highlight and I would recommend this company.

Talkeetna Alaska, K2 Aviation Grand tour of Denali - landing on the Ruth Glacier for a beautiful view of the summit.  I was born and raised here and had been in the park a million times BUT flying near around and landing on - I want to do it again and MORE.

Bring your camera, sunglasses and comfortable clothing.  We had great weather but be prepared.

Loved K2 staff - professional and very helpful - 

It's an all day event.  Drive time from Anchorage to Talkeetna - 2 - 3 hours, flight 2 hours and you want time in Talkeetna.

From start to finish, our flightseeing tour from Talkeetna to Mt. McKinley, landing on Ruth Glacier was jaw-droppingly wonderful. I've lived in Alaska for almost 40 years and thought I'd seen its beauty, but this trip showed me sights I hadn't even imagined. It was well worth every penny, and I'll remember it as long as I live. The best compliment I can give is to say that the minute we landed, I wanted to go right back and do it again. The staff at K2 was very helpful, and Al the pilot was very safety minded and also extremely knowledgeable about the terrain over which we were flying. And landing on the glacier. By all means, be sure and do this. Standing so near the peak of the highest mountain in North America was awe inspiring. Yes, I'm gushing, but you would be too if you'd taken this trip. I highly highly highly recomend it.
Had a great Pilot and service. K2 is worth the experience to take.Even though the weather was not the greatest the views were really great.

review_title: 1 of the top 10 best things I've done in my life"
review_text: After so many days of dreary weather, Friday greeted me with a spectacular sunny day. On a spur of the moment I decided to make a run up to Talkeetna to take advantage of K2's AK resident birthday discount. It was the best idea I ever had. It was awesome! The discount allowed me to experience breathtaking views of McKinely as pilot Mike took us around the mountain. Mike made sure that both sides of the plane got to see all the views. He pointed out all the different peaks and we even saw the climbers base camp. Then we landed on Ruth Glacier..so peaceful, serene, and just flat out awesome. We got to walk around the landing sight and just take in all of natures beauty. On the way back we were able to see some bull moose by the river. I would definitly recomment this to anyone, especially AK residents. I can't believe I never did this before in the last 24 yrs I've been in AK. AWESOME!!!!!!!!!!!!

We arrived for our scheduled K-2 flight around Denali (green route) and were told that the full trip was not possible due to weather conditions.   We opted for the offered "orange" route instead.  Once above the cloud cover we got some great views of the mountain and were able to land on the glacier, which was awesome.  We enjoyed every minute of it.  My only disappointment was that they charged us for the "orange" route, but the flight did not take us on the path of that route due to cloud cover.  Instead, the pilot made a few extra zig-zags along the "blue" route flight path to add some extra time to the trip.  Unfortunately, neither the pilot or anyone else asked us if this substitution was o.k. with us.  They assumed that adding a few extra minutes flight time was a fair substitute for seeing more of the mountain....in my opinion it wasn't.

We were originally scheduled to take an evening flightsee at 7pm including a glacier landing. Because of the weather, it was postponed until the next morning at 11am. At that time, the weather still weren't allowing them to fly to Mt. McKinley or do glacier landings. We tried pushing it back to 1230pm, but at that point, we figured we'd just go ahead and fly the alternate route (not seeing McKinley) and not doing a glacier landing. Everyone there was very friendly and they accommodated us as best they could. We got a 2 hour flight for the price of a 1 hour flight and were very happy with the views and the pilot. Would def recommend flying with K2 and hope you have better weather than us!

review_title: Bad weather but a good flight
review_text: We spent two days trying to get a flight to Denali and a glacier landing but the weather just wouldn't allow it.  So they offered to take us south to the Chugach mountains for a view of some very spectacular glaciers.  Our pilot, Chris, was very informative and e got to see some amazing views.  We could see the icebergs in Lake George up close.  This mountain range borders Prince WILLIAM SOUND and is younger than the Alaska range so the formations appear to be sharper and very interesting.  Overall a very good experience.

We did the Grand Denali Tour, though it had to be shortened due to poor visibility.  What we did see was fantastic and the glacier landing is really a must-do!  You get such a better perspective of the scale of the mountains and glaciers while standing on one.  Its totally worth the cost, staff very friendly, and the planes appeared pristinely maintained.

review_title: Bad weather but K2 is a great company.
review_text: Spring 2009 - We tried a Denali summit plane ride (3 of us) but the ceiling was low and we only were able to fly around Talkeetna. The company made great alternate plans for us. They were very accommadating and the pilot was very professional.  Prices are typical for the industry and they obviously want everyone to go away pleased.  Also, seems like they ferry climbers up to the mountain in the spring so it was cool to see the groups getting ready for an accent. Would definitely go back to this company again.

we arrived to find out the the weather would not permit the plane to do the glacier landing that we had planned we were offered a sight seeing tour at a discounted rate or a full refund, no problems, then even after we deceided not to go these guys gave us a ride to our next destination for no charge!! i was impressed

review_title: Amazing flight around Denali, Foraker and Hunter Peaks!
review_text: We flew with K2 after deciding to drive up to Talkeetna to see Denali for the first time this year. On a whim, we dropped by the K2 "downtown" office and signed up for a flight. I was reluctant to fly on a small plane, but my fears were alayed once we got in the air. The day was perfect. 100% visability and not a cloud in the sky! Tony was our pilot and he told us a lot we didn't know about the Alaska range, Foraker and Hunter Peaks, Ruth Glacier, etc... We even flew right over a plane landing on the glacier and a mountain climbing base camp on McKinley! I highly recommend this excursion to anyone visiting Alaska. My only regret: that it took us 3 trips to AK from MI to find out it was that easy to flightsee Denali!

Amazing views and great experience flying around Mt. McKinley and landing on a glacier.This is a pricey trip, but well worth trying to save elsewhere and do this. Definitely this was a highlight of our trip. I was very comfortable with the company as well as the pilot and the airplane. All seems to be very professional and the pilot was obviously very experienced.

This must be just only my missunderstanding, but worth noting that Talkeetna where this company is based (and majority of its competitors) are located some 2.5 hours driving from Denali National Park entrance.

review_title: The Most Awesome Place I've Seen
review_text: On a recent vacation to Talkeetna Alaska we took a flightseeing trip with K2 Aviation our pilot was Al . Al knew a lot about the area and when the weather did not cooperate on one side of McKinley he took us the other way. He showed us alot about the Mountains and surrounding glaciers. He brought us to an easy landing on one of these glaciers and when he opened the plane door, we were awestruck by the beauty and vastness of Denali and the park. K2 was knowledgeable, concerned with safety, and run a very classy operation. It was one of the highlights of our trip and if we ever go back  would fly with them in a minute

review_title: Waited two days to go but "WOW" what a View
review_text: The weather this summer was rain and clouds, but  when the sun did come out K2 was there to take us on the ride of our lives around Mt Mckinley. Took the Grand Tour ride and saw it all! Recommend  this to everyone the way to see the Mt. We had seen it the week before in Danali and was amazed. But from the air you get a better perspective of how BIG it is.  Thanks to the staff and pilot for moving us up with the weather the way it was in Aug. 2008

My partner and I are out in Alaska visiting my sister, her husband and my niece and were keen to do a flightseeing tour.

Our decision on which one to do, and whether to add a glacier landing, was much debated due to cost and desire to find a trip that felt personal. 

We opted for K2 tours (partly swayed by the 10% off voucher in a local magazine - the visitor guides also have $20 off vouchers) and booked the day before. 

Upon arrival at their base the glorious sunshine and friendliness of the reception staff made my sister and her husband decide that they too would like to fly. The staff were really helpful and able to arrange it so we could all do this together (despite the sunshine drawing in lots of visitors all wanting to fly!) and they were also great as they let their 8 month old daughter fly for free (in her car seat taking up a whole space - other companies say under 2's can fly for free on an adults lap).

The plane had the 5 of us and 1 other passenger in and felt small enough to be personal but large enough to feel safe. I didn't even realise that we had taken off and the baby slept through the landing!

Wow is all I can say really - it was so worth spending the additional money on the glacier landing and the pilot (Greg) was exceptional at pointing out things of interest and answering all our questions. 

My sister and her husband are now planning to take all their visitors to Talkeetna to do this trip with K2, and are looking forward to doing the trip again themselves!

An unmissable experience.

review_title: Incredible experience and views.  Add this to your Alaska bucket list.
review_text: This was a last minute decision and so glad we did it.  Cory was super helpful and the entire staff was incredibly friendly.  Our pilot Tim was great, offering just the right amount of narration and a great playlist.  The views were spectacular and the glacier landing was very cool.  All and all I would highly recommend this company and this experience.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: Worth every penny! Outside of major life events this is a highlight of our life experiences. Asa was a great pilot along with Danielle (pilot in training) and Corey was very friendly and helpful in the office. We wanted to go on another flight immediately. 😁
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_title: Don't Miss this Chance to See Denali
review_text: This is a very special experience, if the weather cooperates.  The team at TAT was great at finding a time to reschedule us so that we could make it happen.  The pilot was great, the ride felt safe at all times, and the chance to see Denali, the glaciers, and so on was fantastic.  That we landed in about a foot of fresh powder snow was a blast.  Did not anticipate being able to have a snowball fight in September.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text:
Amazing! I took tons of videos and photos. We went all in with the Grand Denali Tour with Glacier Landing, and it worth the extra money. I am not sure how many flight tours I will do in my life, paying the extra to maximize the experience was worth it to me. 

I took dramamine for the flight and still got motion sickness but not too bad, so if you are prone to motion sickness I would for sure take something. 

I dressed a little too warm for the flight (leggings, t-shirt, long sleeve, long jacket and beanie) but took the jacket and beanie off during the flight. It was actually warm on the glacier because the sun was out but the pilot told us it can get cold quick if a cloud blocks the sun so I was grateful I dressed warm, as you can always layer down. You are also only on the glacier for 15-20 minutes. 

If you are doing the glacier landing, I highly recommend wearing the boots they give you for over your shoes as the snow can be pretty deep on the glacier- some people that just wore their waterproof shoes ended up with snow inside their shoes and had wet feet for the flight back. 

Such an epic experience! We took my parents, who are in their early 70s and my mother is terrified of flying - she did great - she was pretty scared during the flight but now it's all she talks about, is so proud of herself, and is open to doing a flight tour again in the future. 

Our pilot Luke made us all feel comfortable - definitely in good hands! Everyone we encountered that worked there were kind and professional - highly recommend.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_title: Best activity of our Alaska trip

review_title: Surreal views and glacier landing was a  bonus!

review_title: On top of the world, once-in-a-lifetime experience
review_text:
Incredible experience! There's nothing else that can compare to seeing this landscape from the air. Truly awe inspiring. If you only do one thing when you visit Alaska- do this!! 

Everyone gets a window seat, which I think is great, and our pilot Daniel explained a lot of interesting things about the geography, climbing history, and what we were seeing. He also did turns specifically to make sure that both sides of the plane had good views of things. All seats are good views! He also offered to take pictures for people once we landed at base camp. Everyone has a headset so it's easy to hear why the pilot is saying, and the cabin is heated (though it can still be chilly).

The flights and views are weather dependent, but the staff does its best to keep people informed of the weather conditions and their top priority is to keep everyone safe (Of course, they can't control the weather and sometimes have to cancel flights, but safety is #1). The weather can be tricky but the pilots and rest of the team are experienced. We had some clouds in the area and the pilot explained some of how he was deciding where to fly and why based on that. 

There is a souvenir shop with sweatshirts and hats and stickers, and fantastic new restrooms with a water bottle station. Probably the best bathrooms in town!
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: It was a bit of a drive to get here from Anchorage (where we were staying) but it was worth it! review_text: Booked this tour as I thought landing a plane on a glacier was just something I had to see for myself. The tour was fantastic. 8:30 AM flight out of Talkeetna directly to the Alaskan Mountain Range. The morning was partly cloudy with the sun shining through and Denali standing out in all her glory. The flight over the mountains and around Denali was thrilling with breathtaking views. Our pilot, a young man from New Zealand, was professional and knowledgable providing lots of information about the region. We saw Base Camp 2 at 11,000ft with a group of climbers camping. We also had 2 climbers on board who were going to be dropped at Base Camp to begin their summit attempt. Te landing at Bases Camp, 7,000 ft, was incredible. Walking on the glacier and around the camp was a dream come true. One of the high points of our 3 weeks in Alaska. The price is steep, but to us the trip was worth the stretch. I highly recommend this excursion and would venture to say to should not be missed.

review_text: This trip was incredible.  The views are amazing and our pilot, Liam, gave an informative narration throughout the trip.  Highly recommend.

review_text:
What an experience. We took this flight seeing tour from Talkeetna. Our time was 8.30 AM and we reached as required, around 45 minutes before. We did some paper work and were given a briefing about plane and safety. We were also given some boots to wear on our shoes when we land on glacier on the snow. We were three plus a few other people, totally around 9 passenger and two crew. It was a bit scary when we started but the beautiful scenes made us forget our fear. we were soon soaring over the trees, rivers, mountains, clouds and a lot more. What a beautiful trip, it was just awesome. The views were unbelievable. We went around a lot of peaks including magnificent Denali. Then the climax of our trip—landing on a glacier. It was just too good to be true.  The pilot, a young chap from New Zealand landed very professionally. We got down on a fresh coat of snow. It was deep. We stayed there for around 20 minutes walking around and watching the scenery and taking pictures. Then it was time to take off again. Take off was also smooth and soon we’re up and circling the mountains again enjoying the ride and the views.  Soon it was time to return to base. Overall an awesome experience. 
Keep in mind this will be done if weather is clear. If not, then you get a full refund. We were lucky as last day it had snowed full day while our day was bright and sunny. This is an experience that is not to be missed.

review_text: We did a Denali explorer flight seeing tour with glacier landing on July 5.  I had originally had this excursion booked for three weeks prior to this date, but I came down with covid and couldn't go on the cruise. We moved the cruise to a later date and I called Talkeetna Air Taxi to tell them and to ask if I could switch the excursion to the new date on my cruise and they were so helpful and understanding and made the change with no problem. I really appreciate how flexible and accommodating they were in this uncertain travel time that we are living in with Covid. When we arrived in Talkeetna we were asked to wait in front of a store on Main Street until we were picked up by one of their shuttle vans and brought to their office at the airfield. Once there we checked in, got our boot covers and waited for our flight time. We could see the plane that we were going to go up in and they were doing a last minute cleaning to it. Wiping down the windows to make sure everyone had a perfect view for pictures, which I thought was a nice touch. Finally our group was called to head to our plane where we met our pilot (I can’t remember his name, but he was from New Zealand and he was fantastic!). He went over the necessary safety information and then asked if anyone wanted to sit in the cockpit seat and of course I volunteered. That was the best decision, I got such amazing photos from up there which were unobstructed by the wings of the plane. We had a surprisingly clear day, we had even seen the mountain in her entirety from the ground so the pilot said we would have exceptional views once up at the mountain and boy was he right. There’s nothing that can compare to seeing the enormity and majesty of the range and that mountain up close. The pilot flew all around and switched directions so that both sides of the plane could get views of everything. He kept up a nice steady commentary of what we were seeing and interesting facts. Then it was time to land on the glacier. Our pilot picked Ruth Glacier to land because he said he liked the views from there better and I have to agree after seeing some of the other glacier landing sites that other pilots were using he was right. We were on the glacier for about 20 minutes to take photos, have a snowball fight, and just appreciate the beauty around us. He took photos of each family group with the plane, the mountain etc. I’m usually really picky about my photos and end up deleting most of them but I was pleasantly surprised with how perfect the photos he took were! We loaded back up in the plane and headed back to the airport. The whole ride was smooth with very little turbulence. Everyone that we met at Talkeetna Air Taxi was friendly and helpful. They are extremely professional and most importantly safe. Their equipment is maintained nicely. I can’t recommend this company enough.

review_title: Flight and Glacier landing WORTH EVERY PENNY!
review_text:
Grand Denali Tour with Glacier Landing---

I have traveled up through Talkeetna on to Denali National Park numerous times over the last 10 years.   I had never, up until this trip, taken advantage of the Talkeetna Air Taxi service; and all I can say about that is "Shame on me!".   
First, know that I have tried to take the flight out of Denali in the past.   While I was not successful because of the weather, this trip I was advised that while the company out of the park is a great company, the flight into would potentially be better.  The flight out saved 6 hours of bus time, and weather permitting saw some cool sights, but the flight in, with glacier landing would amaze.   They were 100% right.   Second, know that I was thinking of saving some money and not doing the glacier landing.  I called Talkeetna Air and spoke with one of their employees.  That employee did not pressure sell me at all.  She explained what people like about the flight options, those with and without glacier landings, she gave me an honest account of the time in the air (15 minutes into the park, the a lot of time flying around the summit, then a landing if chosen, than a nice flight out) for a total time much longer than the flight out of the park (mind you).  She also explained what she thinks of landing on the glacier.  Explaining to me that while I have been to Alaska and hiked and seen glaciers, being on one in the Denali range in the mountains would amaze me with the vast openness and quite.  Again, she didn't try to sell me, she simply tried to explain pros and cons.  In the end, there weren't many cons other than a bit more money---and let's be honest, if you are forking out the money for the flight, you might as well not be cheap like I was going to be.  We settled on the flight and landing and it was worth EVERY PENNY!  I kid you not.  Everything about the flight was amazing.  Our pilot-- She was amazing.  There was a time when she said--ok, we are going to fly into the face of the mountain now to give you an idea of how big it is--but don't worry, we are at least a mile from the face.  It seemed like we were right next to it!!   She warned us when it might get a bit bumpy, and why, and then we were prepared and could still experience the sights that the bumpy air allowed us to see.  And the glacier landing was amazing.   To land in snow in a mountain and take off in snow on a mountain is a modern feat.  These planes they use are amazing.  And the pilots the best!  So there is that all by itself.  But to step  out and see it and listen and just exist was the best.  Every person on that flight was blown away.  Every person on that flight had a smile from ear to ear.   I am not going to lie to you--- we had perfect weather on August 21st---some of the best they had seen in a couple of weeks.  We saw Denali in all her beauty.  In fact, we saw her driving in to Talkeetna, on the flight and the next day on the bus tour (which I have done 4 times and it never gets old).  So we were blessed!  But Talkeetna air does not shy away from being honest with you about the weather.  They will not go up in the weather is bad.  And if the clouds are in but weather ok to fly, they will be open about that tour.  And they go out of their way to rebook you if necessary.  In fact, later that week while in Seward on a whale/glacier tour with Alaska Saltwater Lodge & Tours (who I highly recommend as well) we met a mother and daughter that tried to fly the day before us.  They could not because of weather.  And Talkeetna worked with them and their very busy trip (already planned) to accommodate another flight.    With that, what I recommend is you book your travel days (if going by car mind you) to Denali park a couple of days apart.  Plan the flight on the way up there.  If it doesn't work out, try to plan a reschedule for your day out of the area if going back towards Anchorage.   

Bottom line-- I will absolutely do this experience again.  I will absolutely use Talkeenta Air Taxi.   I will absolutely do the flight and glacier landing.   And I will absolutely love it.   

Oh, and one other thing.  I had my mom and dad with me.  Both in the mid 70s.  Mom a bit leery of small planes and nervous.   She did fine.  In fact, she did better than fine.  She was not once scared nor flight sick nor anything but amazed.  It was one of the highlights of her trip and it set the stage for more adventures.   

Thank you Talkeetna Air!

review_title: Fantastic Views - Denali up close and perssonal
review_text:
We took the Grand Denali tour with a Glacier Landing.    The plane held 9 passengers.   8 passengers each had a window seat, and the 9th passenger sat in the copilot seat.   Our pilot, LeAnn, did a fantastic job.   She would make turns to make sure each side of the plane got the great views and pictures.  Because of the size of the mountains, it looked like the plane was way to close to them, but LeAnn assured us that she was always at least a mile from them.   She pointed out places and told us what was going on (like before we turned).   She was in constant communication with the pilots on other tours checking in with the weather conditions,

The views were awe experiencing.  Make sure you bring a memory card with space for a lot of pictures!  The Glacier Landing was impressive.  We landed at Base Camp, which is the first camp that mountaineers use to climb Denali.   It is in the middle of the 3 highest mountains.   

We were lucky that the weather was great to allow us to fly around Denali and do the Glacier Landing (they provide pull over boots and sunglasses for the Glacier).   Be aware, that like most things with flying, mother nature controls where the plan can go.  Realize that the flight you reserved may be changed.  FOr example, you may not be able to fly all around Denali or do the Glacier Landing (they stopped doing Glacier Landings after ours).  If your trip is changed, the office will alter your charges, appropriately.  

One thing to note, if you are in an Otter with 9 passengers, I recommend that you do not jump for the copilot seat.   Unless you are really tall, the Otter flies in a nose up configuration, so it is actually harder to see things.   

It was a great trip.  I would highly recommend it.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: Flying around the tallest mountain in North America was an awesome experience. Flying with Talkeetna Air Taxi made it that much better. We met Michael at the airplane and he introduced us to our plane for the day. Flying with Michael was a peaceful a serene experience. From the moment we took off he was casually sharing history of the Talkeetna area and various details of the rivers and valley as we approached the mountain range. Once we got to Denali Michael's knowledge really came to light. It was almost as if he met every climber thorough the climbing history of Denali. review_title: Totally Amazing and worth every cent!
review_text: This was a spur of the moment side trip and was worth every cent. Mt Denali was view able but due to the wildfires, very hazy. We stopped in their office--no high pressure sales. The customer service rep explained the options. The views from the plane are indescribable,Nick our pilot was amazing! Smooth flight and landing, gets you up close with mountains,he was very knowledgeable about the scenes below. You have not seen Denali at all unless you see it from the air--words can not describe!
