review_text: This was our 3rd visit to Alaska, but it was unlike any other. It is hard to describe the amazing views from above Denali...I would highly recommend this flight!!  Views that you won't get from the Park floor!!
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: We did the Grand Denali Flightseeing tour with a glacier landing a couple of weeks ago. The staff here are very professional and attentive. Our pilot was Michael and we had a fabulous trip and were lucky to have had beautiful weather for a smooth and memorable glacier landing. This was definitely one of the highlights of our trip to Alaska. Not to be missed!
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: Absolutely stunning, we were lucky to have a relatively clear sunny day and the scenery was breathtaking.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text:
Leann gave us a memorable trip around Denali complete with a glacier landing in Don Sheldon Amphitheater.  Sunny, warm, awe inspiring trip!  Tasted some glacier ice.

The entire staff was extremely friendly, knowledgeable and helpful!  It is  a great team.  The entire experience was top notch!
Thank you for a memorable morning at the foot of Denali
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_title: Absolute MUST on your visit to Alaska list!!
review_text:
Alex piloted the plane and did a fantastic job pointing out and naming all the places we could see below. (we all had headphones and could hear the commentary very well)  We saw tents set up at base camp and those snow-capped peaks were amazing.The flight was smooth, including take-off and landing, and the view was amazing no matter where you sat. Best part was the actual landing on the glacier and having a chance to get out and play in all the snow and breathe that fresh, fresh air! Thanks Alex!
The road to Talkeetna is really well paved the whole way - I rode my motorcycle from Anchorage with no difficulty at all. Totally worth taking time to do this flightseeing "trip of a lifetime!"
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_title: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour with glacier landning
review_text:
Booked using Northern Lights Discount coupon for family of 4 (25% off). Worth every penny. Office staff very helpful. Flew on 10 Sept 2018, first deprture 8:30am. Pilot: Michael from California. Superbly skilled and professional pilot, sunny and clear weather, pitch perfect take offs and landings. Michael provided much commentary of history, geography and geology throughout. this was definitely the Highlight of our Alaska trip! Doesn't matter where you sit on the plane, you'll get equally good views of Mt Denali if the weather is good.
Remember to collect your 7 day National Park Access Pass which you can use in Denali National Park.
Don't forget to tip the pilot :)
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: Wow, what a great flight. We did the 2 hr round the mountain and land on the glacier trip, and as soon as you get into those snow capped mountains, it’s magical. This was a friendly, knowledgeable and reassuring group of people, so just DO IT. If you are obsessed with Denali, sit on the right side, but I was on the left and was happy to be awed by all of the other mountains around. And we did a 360 anyway so I did get a good view. Be good and give your pilot a tip at the end—it’s worth it.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_title: It adds Exponentially to your Alaska Visit
review_text: I did the same flight 11 years ago with the Dehaviland Beaver but on this trip my wife was with me along with 6 other passengers.  Our pilot was good and filled us in with a lot of what we were seeing and some of the geography as well.  Our plane was the larger Dehaviland Otter which handled well under his hand.  It was a clear day and we did circle Mt. Denali and land on Ruth Glacier.  Our pilot pointed our Don Sheldon's "Chalet" and pointed out that for a fee we could spend the weekend there (I don't know if this was said in jest or not).  This was experience that most people don't get to enjoy but maybe several times in their life. We saw glacier crevasses, stress bends, and the gentle turns that glaciers make as they meander to lower altitudes.  Before we took off from Ruth Glacier 5 other tour planes joined us on Ruth Glacier so it was a great day for flying.  Taking off on the downward glacier slope is always an experience.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: Our pilot Kris made us comfortable in the DHC-3 for an amazing flight that ultimately climbed to 20,000 feet.  We flew close to the buttresses of Denali, Wickersham Wall and through Denali Pass.  The view was incredible.  Without doubt the experience was the highlight of our Alaska trip.  We landed on Ruth Glacier and returned to Talkeetna after seeing so many peaks and glacier features that we will remain amazed for a long time!
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_title: Highlight of Our Trip - No Words for This Experience.
review_text: This experience was the highlight of our trip.  The views are so breathtaking that you feel that you're flying through a movie scene.  The glacier landing is something not to be missed.  Our pilot, Danielle, gave fantastic narrative throughout the flight, and when our group expressed interest in the controls she took the time after the flight to explain how the controls worked and talk more about flying.  It is clearly something she is passionate about and it shows in her work.  The entire staff was absolutely amazing!!!  Do not miss this experience when visiting Denali.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_title: Spectacular Views of Denali Range with Glacier Landing
review_text: Our pilot had 15 years of experience flying here and inspired confidence.  She had climbed Denali and summited 15 times!  Her narration was interesting.  Our flight was smooth and comfortable.  We had a bright, warm, sunny, clear day.  Landing on a glacier and tromping around in the snow beneath the Denali range was a thrill.  All 6 of us were so grateful to have experienced this flightseeing.  It was awesome and memorable!
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_title: Flight around Denali with glacier landing kids ages 4-16
review_text: It was beautiful.  The kids really enjoyed themselves.  Little ones were entertained for the 2 hours and enjoyed playing in the snow on the glacier.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: If you go to Denali, this is one of those things you have to do.  Hiking is not so much of a big deal at this park compared to other parks.  I believe Flightseeing and the bus ride offered by NPS are the two must things to do at Denali.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_title: Crystal clear flight around Mt Denali
review_text: We took the flight around Mt Denali and landed on the glacier.  We have a crystal-clear day which was beyond description for the beauty.  Our pilot was Alex and he was great.  Wonderful experience.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: We were in Alaska for two weeks and I think this was my favorite. The weather that day was fabulous so that really helped. Definitely worth the cost and the glacier landing was very cool. Once in a lifetime do not miss.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: This was truly the flight of a lifetime. The staff was friendly & helpful. Andy was our pilot and he gave us the Grand Tour. We felt safe, he gave warning if there were going to be "bumps", changed course a bit if needed for a smooth ride with the best views. This was a glacier landing flight & so glad we did...amazing! Andy was knowledgeable and encouraged questions about area history, mountains, climbers, etc. You will not be disappointed!
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: We loved our flight seeing trip! The flight over and around Denali was breath taking. We were lucky as the weather was perfect with excellent visibility.  The landing on the glacier was a very special experience we will remember for ever.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text:
My experience with Talkeetna Air Taxi was awesome! I booked short notice for the 4th of July holiday and the staff was extremely friendly and accommodating. Big kudos to Heidi for being so helpful and friendly during the check-in process. She made it a breeze and did so with a smile! The predeparture preparation was straightforward and efficient and the folks on the ground were awesome. Leighan was our pilot. She was knowledgeable, courteous, and friendly and her comments during the flight made it easy to track our location. Plus, her piloting skills were top notch both on and off the ice! 

This experience was nothing short of amazing. Landing on Ruth Glacier and seeing Denali in all her glory is indescribable. Our group was lucky enough to see the summit, which I hear is not always the norm. It was such a lovely day that many folks were wearing t-shirts on the glacier! 

If you do one thing while in Talkeetna, it should be seeing Denali with Talkeetna Air Taxi. It was one of the best travel experiences I’ve ever had.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: We had no intention of going flightseeing while in Talkeetna, as we already had a glacier landing scheduled elsewhere for another day. However, the skies were crystal clear & the perfect view of Denali had us scrambling for a flight. Luckily, we were able to get a flight within 2 hours with Talkeetna Air Taxi & even received 10% off for a family booking & another 30% off for kids under age 11. Our pilot, Matt, took our family up in a '61 DeHavilland Beaver. The scenery was spectacular - glaciers, rugged mountain peaks, massive granite walls, Denali...and the flight was expertly narrated by our pilot. Our headsets & mouthpieces allowed us to ask questions & converse during the flight as well. This was quite expensive for the whole family to do, but soaring amongst the jagged, snowy, granite peaks was an amazing experience.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: This flight was one of the most amazing experiences in my life.  Dave, our pilot, was very informative, friendly and did an excellent job.  The glacier landing was great and seeing Denali from 21000 feet is something I will never forget.

review_text: I cannot say enough how this is one thing a person should put on their bucket list! Amy in the office was so nice and knowledgeable, she truly enjoys her job. review_text: I tend to only review wonderful experiences, my apology.  But this was one of those "once-in-a-lifetime" experiences that exceeds description.  And Talkeetna Air Taxi exceeded all expectations.  Clean airplanes and facility, helpful and pleasant staff, and excellent pilot.  I just wish I could do this again tomorrow. review_title: The best thing I have done in Alaska
review_text:
The family and I took the Denali flight which landed on the glacier near the pilots house on the mountain. Stunning views of course and we got lucky with a beautiful sunny day. 

The rule of thumb is 1/3 get to see the mountain so try to schedule around the weather. The mountain is roughly 20,000ft above the town of Talkeetna, AK. 

Definately do the landing it is worth the extra charge. My 70 year old mother with limited mobility was able to get out and walk about a little too.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: Matt U was the most accommodating person as we prepped for our trip into Denali. We stayed three nights at kantishna roadhouse (which was lovely) but we might just stay at the KAT lodge next time given the friendliness of everyone there. Sean was our Pilot and made us comfortable right away. His knowledge of the mountain was incredible. We had to fly out early so we hung out with Matt U in the lodge as well as the owner’s dog named lucky. We were the lucky ones. There’s also a guy who looks like Jon Snow at TAT so you might as well go just for that reason. Lastly, if flying from talkeetna, bring them a few slabs of spinach bread as a treat—-they will be thrilled. Oh—and check out Matt U’s  art studio while you are there; amazing one of a kind pieces.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text:
We did the Grand Denali tour with a glacier landing on a cold, rainy Sunday morning. Getting to the airport is easy, checking in was quick, and the prep fort he trip was simple. I believe Andy was our pilot. He was calm, clear, and made sure everyone in my party was comfortable (including my 30 year old sister and was white as a ghost because she doesn't like flying). The plane felt safe, and the actual flying part was smooth and relaxing. After the first 10 mins over the flat lands before the park, we went into a cloudy mountain range. But, the second we got past the first row of mountain, it was breathtaking. He may not want me saying this, but my father actually cried during the flight because of the beauty. Words cannot do this justice. After flying around the range, we landed on a glacier (very smooth and easy landing and take-off). That experience of being on, taking a bathroom break on, and eating of the glacier was surreal. I would say it is a must if you're doing this tour. We then took off and flew back to Talkeetna with no issues at all.

This was out first day in Alaska out of 14 total days. And while everything in Alaska was amazing, nothing beat this (and that sentiment includes my sister who is fearful of flying). There is no way I would send someone to Alaska without forcing them to do this tour. If you do not do this, you are missing out on a truly once of a lifetime experience (unless you are one of the pilots, who get to do this amazing thing every single day).
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text:
We chose this company to do a flightseeing tour of Denali with glacier 
landing. They were very professsional, prompt in their responses when arranging the tour. I had no doubts as to the competence of our pilot. Plane was small and views were wonderful. I was disappointed at the overall blasé attitude of the pilot. I realize that these pilots probably do this four times a day and I am grateful for the technical expertise, but for us it was a “once in a lifetime trip” . It would have been awesome to have a briefing of what we were going to see in and in what order right before we took off. Since this experience was very foreign to us, a 3D ground model so we could orient and have perspective would have been perfect. Also, a  more animated clear narration while in the air would also have been good.  At the end of it all I was left with the impression that this company knows their stuff and is technically very good, but they did not show any level of enthusiasm for what they do. I would not use them again if another reliable option is available
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: The flight had beautiful views of the Alaskan mountains including Denali.  It really helped us to understand how massive the area is and how small we are in the grand skeem of things.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: Abbiamo riservato il tour grand Denali il giorno precedente. tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_title: Bet Way to See Denali and a Glacier
review_text:
We took the 11am flight around Denali and land on a glacier. I can’t imagine a better way to see the mountain and get a sense for how big it is!  

We had 5 total in our plane (including the pilot). The pilot did an excellent job describing the landscape and giving us a sense for the vast expanse we were flying over. 

We rose to about 12,000 feet on a party cloudy day. We saw incredible views the entire way, including the peak of Denali. We were also able to see one of the base camps of the mountain climbers who were about halfway to the top. 

As amazing as seeing Denali up close, landing on the glacier made the trip for us. After a smooth landing, we walked on untouched snow which sat on top of about 2,000 feet of ice. Because of how high the mountains are (granite walls rising 5,000 feet) I found it almost impossible to put anything into perspectives that my mind can comprehend. When we listened quietly, we could hear small landslides occurring on the granite shelves. 

We had some issues with our schedule and the folks at Talkeetna were extremely accommodating. Overall the service and experience were excellent from beginning to end!

Quick tips: we went on a warm day (70 degrees Fahrenheit) and were glad to have a decent jacket in the plane and on the glacier. Also we wore hiking boots and didn’t need to borrow the shoe covers. Sitting up front in the plane is terrific, but the curvature of the plane glass will limit some of the photo opportunities (at least straight on). You can still take photos through the side windows while sitting up front.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_title: The only way to truly experience Denali!
review_text: Alex was a great pilot/guide!  We did the tour with a glacier landing.  You don't want to miss landing on the glacier.  This company offered more bang for the buck and it did not disappoint.  We weren't sure we were going to be able to do this tour so we ended up having to schedule at the last minute and they were able to accommodate us.  The ladies in the office informed us due to the weather we may not be able to see all the sides of Denali and told us if we weren't able to they would refund that part of the trip.  Fortunately, the weather worked with us rather than against us and we got to do the whole tour. As a pilot, I can tell you the aircraft was well maintained and Alex was professional and proficient.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_title: Our Most Enjoyable Activity in Alaska
review_text: We had a beautiful sunny day to see Denali. The sky was clear and the flight was amazing. You could almost touch the mountains. They flew up 60 climbers that day and over 100 climbers were up there to climb Denali. The pics we made were great. We landed on the Glacier and it had over 80 ft of snow there. This Mississippi girl acted like a kid and loved every minute of this adventure. I would highly recommend this excursion. Tip - If you are riding bus to Mt McKinley Lodge, get off at Talkeetna to save time. We called on the road, booked the flight and got off. There are other buses that go back to the lodge every 30 minutes.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: There really ought to be a six-star rating for some experiences and this was one of them. TAT was so accommodating you'd think we were old friends. Do they act this way with everyone? I'll bet they do. Vikki and Amanda in the office and pilot Dave were all amazing. We were so disappointed in not getting to see the Great One the first day we drove to Talkeetna. Vikki explained to us just how much we would be able to see and offered to re-schedule us the next day if we wanted to make the effort and return. We did and she did. It was a beautiful day and turned out to be a staggeringly memorable one, enhanced by TAT's professionalism. If a 20,320-foot mountain can be framed in a proper perspective, Dave did it with his narration and flight skill. Bottom line--this isn't cheap but you've got to do it. Yes, really. Pawn your least favorite kid, if you have to but DO IT and do it with TAT.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_title: Right side rewards, left side regrets.
review_text: This sightseeing flight offered some beautiful views, but I found the experience heavily favored passengers on the right side of the aircraft. As a left-side passenger, my view was primarily of the shoreline, and I missed out on many of the central island's key attractions like the mountains, canyons, and waterfalls. To maximize your experience, I'd strongly recommend requesting a right-side seat. Additionally, strategically maneuvering the aircraft to provide brief, alternating views of key landmarks for both sides of the plane could help ensure a more equitable experience for all passengers.

Stunning views of all the coasts, mountains  & landscapes! Pilot Nic was great & made the trip more fun. Pointed out all the areas, waterfalls & gave us some local knowledge.  We each had a window seat as advertised  & was a very comfortable flight. The hour went by very quickly- lots to see including whales
Josh was an amazing although at the beginning I was pretty scared to get on the plane he did make me feel comfortable. The sites were amazing and definitely recommend this tour. It was fantastic.

review_title: We finally did the Kauai plane tour!
review_text: Had a great flight yesterday afternoon. Josh was a great guy and pilot. We’ve driven all over Kauai, boated around most of the island and did a helicopter tour years ago. The plane was a great experience and fun. Quite a bit less expensive than the helicopter tours also if you’re looking to save some money. I’d recommend Air Ventures if you want to see the island from above.

We were all very impressed with the entire experience, from our welcome greeting to our well wishes when leaving. Our pilot was amazing - he obviously loves Kauai and is excited to share the most beautiful areas.

review_title: Spectacular views! Great, knowledgeable pilot. pilot,
review_text: Excellent, knowledgeable, friendly pilot. The views were spectacular! Something you wouldn’t see any other way. Highly recommend! Love the carefully curated soundtrack.

review_title: The Best Tour in Hawaii (and we did a lot of exceptional tours)
review_text: Our tour was incredible. I have never seen such beauty and will remember it as one of the best tours I've ever taken (and we travel a lot). I think our pilot's name was Josh or Jacob (sorry forgot his name!) and he was wonderful. He knew so much about the island and was an excellent pilot who made the experience perfect. I hope we're able to travel to Hawaii again, and if we do we'll take this tour again. It's a must do for Kauai.
Josh our pilot was fantastic along with the staff!  Don't miss out on this tour! Excellent views and a great way to see Kauai!!
A great way to see the beauty of the Island. Our pilot Nick did a great job of narrating the trip and pointing out points of interest.  Highly recommend this excursion.

Excellent pilot,
Tour, and commentary!
Recommended to all who enjoy flying- ! You will love it-
A real education on the area!
Got stuck on LEFT side with wing support obstructing my view. Just the luck of the draw even though I requested right side with better views. All passengers were of similar weigh. Oh well....

I've been to many places around the world, and this was a bucket list item for me.  No exaggeration, this was one of the best experiences of my life so far.  Our pilot, Jesse, was so skilled - maneuvering around clouds to give us the smoothest ride and ensuring we got to see the sites from the best angles.  Your breath will be taken away.  No reflection on the tour itself, but AirVentures should know the radio was super static-y and there was trouble communicating with Jesse for most of the ride.  Otherwise, I loved it and can't wait to come back.  A couple of the other passengers are with me on the cruise ship and a week later, we still talk about what an amazing experience it was!!  Kauai is special and this fly over is a beautiful way to see it.  Do yourself a favor and go!!

Our plane tour of Kauai was incredible. We saw the entire island and took beautiful pictures while flying.  Our pilot, Josh Hak, shared specific information about the island and highlighted additional details to enhance our experience. I would highly recommend the tour when visiting Kauai. Josh was a fabulous pilot!!
Incredible experience for an amazing price! So much to see in just an hour and the pilots are incredible knowledgeable and accommodating

This is one of the best if not the best adventure we have ever had! We were speechless afterwards and felt amazing all day due to the experience! Our pilot Josh was the best and made the flight very enjoyable and knowledgeable! This is the greatest way to see Kauai. The ground crew also made our check-in very pleasant. Mahalo!!

Absolutely incredible experience flying over the stunning landscapes of Kauai! From breathtaking views of the Na Pali Coast to the vibrant greenery of Waimea Canyon, every moment of the flight felt like a dream. The pilot was knowledgeable and passionate, sharing fascinating insights about the island's history, geology, and culture, which added so much depth to the experience.

The flight was smooth, and the small plane allowed for amazing panoramic views—you truly see parts of Kauai that are otherwise unreachable. That said, I did feel a bit queasy during the flight, likely from a combination of motion and looking down at the dramatic scenery. But honestly, it didn’t detract from the overall experience—it was well worth it!

Despite a little motion sickness, this is a 5-star experience I’d recommend to anyone visiting Kauai. Just be prepared if you’re prone to getting queasy, and you’ll have an unforgettable adventure!

review_title: Save money and go with some other company
review_text: Worst experience compared to every other tour we did in Kauai and big islands, they started 30 minutes late than actual time which was 4.30 pm, thus it made us late for our plans after and due to sunset visibility was low, the tour was biased towards people sitting on right, i was on left side and hardly got views and that was for very short time and generally from far off, felt mislead by their advertising of all window seats, there was so much noise even with headphones on that one could hardly understand what pilot was saying.. not worth the money at all, the boat tour of napali was way better. review_title: great tour had a lot of fun. saw the whole island
review_text: Josh was great. Had a lot of fun, was very talkative and great with information. the ride went smooth and was overall a great experience.

We loved every minute of our tour.  The plane was comfortable, our pilot was friendly and very knowledgeable.  We saw so many exciting sites.  My favorite was when we were flying above a rainbow - amazing!!  The pilot was so good, that I did not even feel the plane touch the ground on our return!   GREAT TOUR, I highly recommend.
Amazing experience. Justin showed us amazing views of the entire island. Flight was smooth and weather was beautiful.  100% would do again.

review_title: Air Venures!! what a great way to the beautiful Kauai !! Highly recommended

The views were great. Josh was a great pilot and pointed out the important landmarks . We got a great tour of the island  and would recommend
The views were spectacular. Our Pilot Josh made the ride enjoyable and fun! The ground crew ladies were very welcoming.

What a great experience. We loved being able to take in the whole island. It gives you a sense of grounding. Our pilot was great. review_title: Great value for amazing flying experience
review_text: Brilliant flight over coast and mountain with commentary from Nick. Friendly and professional service, convenient to do as a cruise excursion as only 15 mins from port

Josh was our pilot.  I felt very safe with him and it was a smooth experience.  His commentary was informative and entertaining.  He was very empathetic to one of us who did not enjoy the experience because of a previously unknown fear. I had an amazing experience and highly recommend this experience. It is such a great and more affordable way to truly experience the full island of Kauai . DO NOT MISS THIS!

The whole experience was top notch from start to finish. The ladies that checked us in were very friendly, and our pilot,  Nick, was outstanding.  He was informative about the sights we were seeing and made sure we all got a good look at everything. You could tell he enjoyed his job because he commented how he wished we could keep flying. The views were phenomenal, and we got lucky with the weather. All in all, an A plus experience.

Our Kauai mid day helicopter tour with another company was canceled due to inclement weather, so we decided to book this AirVentures plane for the late afternoon flight hoping the weather would improve later in the day.  The weather, although still not great, did improve and we were able to go out on this magnificent aerial tour.   What an amazing experience!  We saw so many waterfalls and it seemed like rainbows followed us the entire way around the island. Josh was a fantastic pilot and made sure we saw all the beauty of the island while still keeping us safe from bad weather areas.  I highly recommend this tour and pilot.
Very good experience. Very motivated pilot, eager to show things and take good photos. Adapted at all times to the needs of passengers

Aside from the fact that we thought we had a helicopter the trip was amazing!  Our pilot Shaden was very thorough and did a great job of sharing the sites with us.  The headphones were not that great so it was a little hard to hear him over the plane noise.  Overall we were very satisfied with the trip over Kauai!
I would highly recommend this air tour. Nice was a great pilot and knowledgeable about the island and where we're flying over. Really cool experience  Even was blessed to see a Rainbow from the sky.

Our family did the 60 minute tour with Justin and it was our favorite part of the whole trip! The views were absolutely spectacular and everyone had a window seat so we could all see. Justin was extremely knowledgeable about the history of K'auai and had plenty of fun facts about the island that we really appreciated learning about. We all felt safe and comfortable in the plane and would do this again in a heartbeat!

We are so glad we decided to do this. The view of Kauai from the air is amazing, especially the Napali Coast. Our pilot, Nick, was born on the island, and he did a great job describing the sights. Highly recommended!

This was a fabulous trip. We took a million pictures….  Well almost. We saw beauty which can only be seen from the air. Josh was a very safe pilot who gave interesting commentary along the way.  100% recommend.

Josh was an excellent tour guide! Very knowledgeable and informative, as well as funny, which is most important. I have been on this tour before, but it was my daughter’s first time. She 17, took a LOT of unforgettable pictures! Thanks Josh, crew, and everyone who helped get us on this amazing experience!

My pilot Shaeden was simply amazing and as a local he offered great insight on what we were seeing throughout the entire tour. He was kind and ensured all guests were comfortable. It was great that the aircraft allowed everyone a window seat and was such a great way to see Kauai and all the beauty that exists. I had previously done a helicopter tour and would recommend this much more than that. You see more, it's more comfortable and it is significantly cheaper with an overall better experience.

We were a bit worried about the overcast weather and getting motion sickness but the pilot made sure to keep us from too much turbulence and the views were amazing!! Highly recommend doing this tour. The pilot Nic was professional and funny. The landings were smooth.
What a great way to see the beautiful island of Kauai and learn some history. Josh was very professional and created a wonderful experience for all onboard!

Pilot Nick led us on a wonderful air tour of the island. Our family of 6 had the plane to ourselves and enjoyed the dramatic cliffs, canyons, beaches and more of Kauai. We made a full loop around the island and Nick pointed out and explained many interesting locations. Thanks for a very memorable day!
The fly over Kauai was a spectacular experience. AirVenture planned everything very well.  It was very secure, the pilot was excellent and causius for his passenger.  The view was exceptional.
Josh was an amazing, knowledgeable and capable pilot - it was a perfect tour with absolutely stunning views! My husband said it was the best thing we did all week!
Josh was awesome. He knew so much about Kauai and was very engaging. My fam went for the 3 o’clock flight and the weather was perfect. We flew around the whole island!

The crew were amazing, professional, and respectful. The trip was exceptionally thrilling and views are amazing. The entire journey we felt very safe and our pilot pointed out the best views, beaches, and hiking areas around the Island. Overall, it is a must to do in this beautiful Island of Kauai. 
Thank you

Very friendly and helpful crew
Pilot Shaden was very professional and helpful
The windows of the plane were cleaned by the crew after each flight. Before the flight, the pilot took a group photo in front of the plane. Lots of in-flight info. Very relaxed. Nice quiet landing. We have Kauai completely from the sky to admire. Thank you for this lovely experience

review_title: Great value, awesome pilot and wonderful views
review_text:
I had been looking at this flight since we began planning our trip to Kauai,  but was still on the fence . We did a helicopter tour of the Big Island 20 years ago and kept wondering if it was worth double the price to go on a helicopter here.  On our first day we drove out to Waimea Canyon and there we made our choice.  We saw the plane and a helicopter pass over us and decided the plane looked great.

We booked the flight online 10:30 am (later we heard a pilot share this was the best time but honestly I don't think you could go wrong either time. )

Got to the airport and checked in a little later our pilot Nick came by and welcomed us. Walked out to the plane did a little safety brief, low door watch your head and so on, then loaded the plane for the typical over the water flight, loved the bit of humor with the air sickness bag and taxid out to the runway. 
Nick is a wonderful young pilot, those folks seem to be getting younger every year, or .aybe it's just me. Local guy, no doubt loves what he does and where he lives. Offered a great tour pointing out highlights and the coolest thing was making some left hand turns for those of us on the other side of the plane. Great pilot he banked us over so we could get some great pictures and did it so SMOOTHLY that we hardly noticed.
We took some incredible pictures and a few videos of the entire island. It was really cool having him point out places we had visited and see it from the air.
Wish there was a higher rating we could give. Highly recommend this trip 👌  best value and awesome views, what a combo!
Use my name when you get there they won't remember me just say little round guy big smile, grinned the rest of the day. Book it book it now
.  Can't wait to come back and do it again.

review_title: Beautiful way to seethe island Ina short amount of time.
review_text: Beautiful way to see the island in a short amount of time. We had limited time on the island and were able to see it's beauty with this 1 hour flight. We were given a lot of useful information about the sites, history, and interesting facts. It helped us decide where we would go for the rest of our time on Kauai. Josh was a great pilot. There wasn't a bad view of the island the entire flight.
Piper was a wonderful pilot! 11/10 experience, would highly recommend to anyone. Great value for the price in my opinion.
Piper was an excellent pilot and very informative.  We had taken 2 boat tours along the Na'Pali coast but the perspective of seeing it from the air is awesome.  Would definitely recommend.

review_title: Amazing way to view Kauai from the air
review_text: Totally excellent experience.  The pilot was also an excellent guide.  My wife gets motion sick and we saw reviews for this trip that mentioned it was much better than the helicopter rides for someone prone to motion sickness.  I very much agree as she had no problems with the flight.  The island is breathtaking from the view above it.  Seeing it from the plane was amazing.
Pur Pilot was amazing! The flight was smooth and beautiful. Amazing views of the whole Island. You must do this tour at least once.

We took to the air with our fabulous pilot Josh and it was a FANTASTIC experience from start to finish. (It was a smooth flight, but if you are prone to motion sickness, I suggest you take some Dramamine before takeoff. ) 

The views of Waimea Canyon, the Na Pali coast, Hanalei Bay and numerous waterfalls were breathtaking!! Our family of four (two boys 18 and 22) absolutely loved it and consider it ur most memorable experience from our 11 day trip to Hawaii (Oahu and Kauai).

Worth the time and money for sure!!

Though our experience didn't start out well, (if you read my first review), it ended wonderfully! 
Our situation was handled by their GD Isaac and he did an incredible job of getting it fixed. We went that following Sunday night and had a great time.
The views are incredible! if you're worried about getting photos, do not. We were able to get our best photos from here. The pilot even turned the plane so that Everyone could see and snap pictures. 

Allergen Alert: 1
They did an incredible job of placing me in front so the cologne of other passengers did not play an issue, and they were so kind about it. There is, as expected, a little pre-flight exhaust to cause some concern, but was very minimal. Pilot wore no obvious cologne.
Fantastic! Excellent pilot and experience. Was such a clear day and beautiful views. Perfect amount of time in the air for a tour! Highly recommend!!

The views were fantastic! I took so many pictures.
So much cheaper than a helicopter flight and yet the same experience!
Highly recommended! I might do it again!?

review_title: I did not book this tour unless you are assured that you will not travel behind the pilot, unless you only want to see sea
review_text: From the seat behind the pilot you can not see the island only the sea, they should not sell that seat, the passenger who touches the same does not care not to do the tour.

Great flight over Kauai! Beautiful!  Our pilot was fantastic!!! Super smooth flight! Our pilot was very knowledgeable about the island and the culture.  We were able to see things that you can really only see by air!! Incredible!  We highly recommend!

This was our favorite excusrion on our vacation.  Shadaen was an amazing flight guide.  We loved this tour.  It was so cool to see the entire island from the air.  It was a gorgeous flight and informative.
The views were amazing and interactions were interesting. Justin was a great pilot and pointed out many things during the flight.  We really enjoyed it!

The Air Ventures team is amazing. When we got caught in traffic, they worked with us to get our tour rescheduled when they really didn’t have too… it was our fault that we didn’t give ourselves enough travel time. The tour was great … we will definitely tour with Air Ventures again!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

review_title: Perfect way to see the island
review_text:
This was an amazing aerial tour of the island where we could see just how beautiful Kauai is.  Our pilot and guide, Justin, was kind and personable; he made every effort to make sure we were comfortable and gave us a lot of information about the different places.  The highlight of the tour was definitely N'apali Coast.  Out of all the modes of transportation that allowed a peek at this part of the island, I thought this would be the easiest for my family (kids and elders).  

I was expecting more turbulence, but it was a smooth flight with a few bumps that felt more like rolls.  Even though the flight was smooth, five out of the six of us felt a bit sick- most likely because of the closed space and movement of the plane.  I wasn't expecting to feel nauseous but felt uncomfortable near the end.  My 8 year old son who was sitting next to him as co-pilot, got sick but the pilot was very nice about it.  That said, I would advise you to take some kind of motion sickness medicine beforehand, just in case.

So happy we did this. Marcus was a fantastic pilot. The views were breathtaking. Perfect amount of time to not take up the whole day but to really appreciate the beauty of this island. I couldn't imagine leaving without seeing these views.

That was the best and beautiful thing I’ve ever seen in my life. So many different landscapes 😍😍. Our pilot Marcus was also a real air guide, he knows a lot of things and he tried his best to made this tour unforgettable.
Josh was super friendly. Kept the flight as smooth  as possible in a small plane. Knew his was around the island and knew where the interesting sights were.

😊🔥Amazing way to experience Kauai from the air. Unlike helicopters that could make you dizzy, flying in this small airplane was very smooth and steady, considering we went with a 7 year old and older parents. Our pilot Shaeden was absolutely fantastic! 🙌Knowledgeable and friendly! The views were something we will never forget! We took many photos and videos, it was easy to see everything as the airplane has large windows made especially for sightseeing! Highly recommend 👍
Our pilot, Shaeden, was great. Lots of great information along with beautiful views. The landing and ride was very smooth.
This hour long flight was awesome for our family of four! Great views all around the island of Kauai. They recorded the whole flight on my gopro. We'll worth it!

review_title: My best experience of my Kaua'i vacation (And I did it ALL)
review_text: What a great experience. Out pilot, Shaydin (sp) was great.  Lots of information about the island, and some good stories and lore.  Besides being a excellent pilot and providing not only a smooth flight but also great vantage points for seeing things from both sides of the aircraft. I would highly recommend this.  Even better than the boat charter around Napali.  Best tour I went on.
Piper was our pilot and she was so goooood! Not only experienced but knowledgeable about the island . It made our entire trip so much fun
Wonderful tour of the island and outstanding pilot!  We'd love to do this again.  Pilot is very knowledgeable and showed us a great tour!
Had a great flight with Josh Hak ... funny and informative ... we had great weather and 2 other really nice couples we'd never met before.
Piper was an incredible pilot! She made sure everyone had phenomenal views and shared so many facts about the island. I would definitely recommend doing this on your next trip to Kauai!

Wonderful experience for our family!  Mak was a great pilot, very friendly, and gave us great information about the island during our 1 Hr flight.  This turned out to be one of the many highlights of our trip to Kauai.  Definitely recommend!

Piper was awesome! She knew so much about the island, both its history and cool places to go. We took her advice on a few things afterwards, and everything was awesome. She was amazing and I’d give ten stars if I could! I highly recommend this adventure to anyone, but wish I had taken a Dramamine first! 🤣😍

Our pilot shaedon was really knowledgeable, incredibly easygoing and an all around great tour guide and pilot! He operated the plane beautifully and never once made me worry. The tour itself was extraordinary. The views were absolutely astounding and jaw dropping. It truly is a beautiful place. This tour had headsets so you can hear what everyone onboard was saying. Ultimately it was a perfect way to see the whole island.
Our pilot Piper was great. She knew a lot about the island.  Lots of waterfalls. Good view of a lot of the beaches.  Great overall experience.
Awesome views, great route over incredible scenery, Maka, our pilot, was brilliant. Very knowledgeable and had a great take off and landing, definitely recommend!

This tour exceeded our expectations! The ground crew were so friendly and helpful, the flight was smooth and comfortable, and the views were out-of-this-world! We saw the whole island and the pilot's commentary about what we were looking at was very interesting.

A really beautiful sightseeing flight around the island. Our pilot Marcus gave us a closer look at his home during the flight. We would recommend the sightseeing flight to anyone. We haven't found a better way to see (and photograph) all the sights and the country.
Compliments also to our pilot, who flew the flight so smoothly and provided us with excellent information and experiences

review_title: Awesome scenic plane ride at a reasonable price
review_text: Our pilot Marcus was great! Very knowledgeable and skilled. We felt safe and the views were breathtaking! We got to see the spectacular Napali coast, which can only be seen by plane or boat.
Absolutely amazing experience, with great views and perfect service. Can recommend this to any visitor of the island! Completely worth the money.
Worth every penny. The pilot Marcus was so good and we felt very safe the whole time during the flight.  I highly recommend this.
It was more worthwhile than all the other excursions on this vacation. Cool pilot, awesome experience. Definitely do it!!!
We flew with pilot Piper (named after a plane) she’s had great experience flying and loves to explain everything about the island and keeping us up to date on everything, definitely coming back!

Must do!  There were three retired couples in our group and the plane was the perfect size.  Viewed all the highlights of the island with an excellent pilot who provided an interesting, informative narrative of the the island.  All of us were delighted with the trip.  All of the tour's employees were attentive, knowledgeable, and friendly.  A great experience!

I had the best experience with Air Venture Hawaii! Everyone was so friendly and made me feel so safe and comfortable from start to finish. The views were absolutely stunning, I had been dreaming of seeing Nā Pali from above. So glad that I got such an awesome pilot. Mahalo nui Piper, you’re the best 😊✈️

review_title: A must do when you are on the Island!
review_text: Great views to give you an overall impression of the island without trying to drive/hike everywhere! Our pilot "Piper" was an amazing lady - bubbly,informative, wrote down some turtle spotting tips for us afterward, and yet still professional in all her dealings with other aircraft and air traffic control. We felt a fixed wing plane outing was a better dollar value than the helicopter rides but with similar great views!  Definitely, worth the time and money.
We were able to change our flight day, due to an itinerary change that was unavoidable. Josh the pilot was great he was helpful & informative, he had a good sense of humour & great music.

Justin was our pilot and was an adventure of a lifetime to see the beauty of the island of Kauai and him answering all the questions we had!  Seeing it from above was a photo opt like no other!  Well worth the price and was fun sitting in the co-pilot seat!

review_title: Amazing not to be missed experience!
review_text: We tried going to the Na Pali Coast in our car to see the beautiful views but it was not to be as the whole region was covered with clouds and rain. So to make sure we got to see it we booked a flight with Air Ventures and what a great idea it turned out to be. The plane was a small 6 seater and our pilot was the very young but brilliant, Piper. She did a great job narrating what we were about to see or seeing from the windows. Don't be wary of her age or how young she seems to be. Her flying was faultless and smooth all the way through. If you're looking for an amazing way to explore Kauai then do not hesitate booking with Air Ventures.

review_title: Great flight with a Hawaiian (from Kauai!) native
review_text: We had an actual pilot who is a local -Marcus! Even though he is younger than our kids :) he was awesome and knew the island well! The view from a plane is very different than a helicopter as you get more of the big picture but it was calm and scenic.

We had Captain Shaydon for our tour.  He was very knowledgeable of the island and pointed out a lot of sites. We left the airport and headed clockwise around the island past our resort in Poipu, the the west side, the canyon, Napali Coast, north shore and cut back across the east side back to the airport.

Absolutely fabulous!
Our pilot, Justin was spectacular.
He explained any turbulence we experienced well and we felt safe and comfortable.

The entire tour was incredibly beautiful!

Highly recommended!

We had a fantastic time. Friendly and accommodating employees.  Started with making sure the flight would be perfect so we delayed and rebooked to better weather.   Macha the pilot did a fantastic job explaining the flight process and did a wonderful job as an aviator.  

We saw so many cool things.  He just refused to take us over the
Military base and engage in a dog fight with the aircraft that would have prevented us from going over the base!
Amazing!  Piper was a great pilot and our family of 4 (ages 7 and 8) loved every minute.  When I asked them what their favorite part of vacation was they both agreed that this tour was the best!

The only thing we should’ve done differently is to book this tour at the beginning of our visit to Kauai. Our pilot, Piper, was extremely informative and great tour-guide of the island in addition to being a great pilot. The entire activity was very well organized and necessary details communicated in timely manner. Definitely recommend if you’re visiting Kauai.

Beautiful clear skies over the island to see that magnificent landscapes and costal areas of the island.  Great way to see the many canyons and waterfalls. 
Lucky to see some groups ot Humpback whales out to sea and pilot took us down for a closer look.  Excellent commentary from the pilot describing what we were seeing throughout the trip.
Highly recommend the tour and AirVentures.

Piper was an incredible pilot and showed us everything around the island. She was very informative and made sure both sides of the plane saw everything. She was mindful of how everyone was feeling and ensuring we all had a great experience. I would recommend this tour to anyone. It was a great way to see the entire island!
Great experience, our pilot Josh was excellent. He made you feel comfortable and maneuvered the plane to see sites. Highly recommend!

review_title: This is a must on your Kauai itinerary! You won’t regret it!
review_text: Had a blast! The views were awesome and much better in person than in any magazine. Our  guide was super fun! Even saw a whale breech! Added bonus!

On time, courteous, only 3 passengers which was great.  Piper was a Great pilot; she flew the plane in perfect positions to get us wonderful pictures. And she explained what we were seeing in a very understandable manner.  Would love to fly with her again.

We had a great time once we got off the ground and got used to flying in a small airplane. Justin our pilot did an amazing job of narrarating all the sites we flew over. Some were a bit hard take photos of as we had to be at a higher altitude to stay out of the turbulance. But Justin got everyone on board the best view possible of everything. We probably won't ever visit Kauai again, which is why we took the tour. From beginning to end the entire staff is very friendly and professional in every way.
The tour was amazing!  Piper was an awesome pilot and showed all the island!  An absolute amazing adventure. 10 Out of 5 stars.  Highly recommend.

James was an excellent pilot. A few bumps but that is expected. Lots of tremendous views. Great memories, was also nice James was able to share lots of local history and insight as a native Kauai resident. Moving onto the next chapter flying commercial airlines. Recommend it to anyone. Left early as well which was a pleasant surprise. Mahalo and Aloha 🌴😎

Nice way to see beautiful Kauai. Glad we chose these guys, the whole team was great. We will recommend this to our friends.

Our pilot, Josh was amazing. Friendly, experienced and easy-going  (melted some flying apprehensions)  while being informative, attentive, and fun. Also, his food recommendations were some of the best we had!

Seeing the island from the air helped us choose what areas we wanted to visit the following days. We would do it again. This tour was a highlight of our trip!

We booked AirVentures when our reservation was canceled unexpectedly by another plane company. I'm so glad we booked with this company instead! Their customer service is friendly and professional. My husband, daughter and I were very comfortable and the ride was smooth. Two of us get motion sickness, so the helicopter rides were never an option. This experience allowed us to see the highlights of Kauai and focus our time on other activities. Highly recommend!!
Great way to see the island. The pilot was very knowledgeable and it was a great experience. Would do it again in a heartbeat.

This was an amazing experience.  Very close to port ( on cruise).  Took Uber 

The pilot was Shaden and he was a host and gave us a fabulous commentary when on plane.

I was on a knee walker and it was no issue for me to get on and off the plane. They brought the walker back to plane on return.

Clean facilities.  

And the price was very competitive!
We enjoyed a beautiful trip around the entire island.  We were able to see humpback whales from the air.  The Napali coast is incredibly beautiful.

This may very well be the most beautiful place I have ever visited. We were in Oahu for one week and then Kauai.  Why did we not just go to Kauai for two weeks?
We had a small condo in Kapaa in the Coconut Beach area and that is where we will stay when we come again. I like the area and it is pretty easy to get everywhere from there.  There is a park nearby called Lydgate Park that would be great to take kids to or anyone leery of ocean swimming as it has 2 areas blocked off by big boulders so that there is no worry about getting in too deep or being knocked down by waves. It also has a huge playground.
We initially were holding a very expensive rental car but I kept checking and got it down to a reasonable amount. There is no charge to park anywhere we went.
Be prepared for bad roads if you go the scenic route.  Many of the scenic roads are rutted and have potholes the size of a VW bug.  When it rains on Kauai (it rains a lot), there are red mud puddles in areas that you will go to sightsee.  If you plan to hike, take it seriously.  Many of the hikes are considered to be for those more experienced hikers and you will need real hiking shoes. Also plan on slippery areas on the hike so a fall in the mud is possible. 
The rest of the island has good roads and no mud so you don’t have to engage with the mud if you don’t want to.
We paid for an app called the Shaka guide. They offer 4 GPS tours which covers the whole island and is definitely worth the money! 
This island has a slower pace than Oahu but you can still get into traffic in the morning and evening drive time if you are around Lihue.
The airport is adorable and very easy to get around.  Don’t be surprised to find chickens near the luggage carousel. i read that Kauai has about 75,000 people and 450,000 chickens.  Therefore don’t expect to sleep much past sunrise due to the roosters crowing. But then who would want to miss a sunrise in Kauai anyway?

No words are good enough to describe our experience flying over Kaua’i with Josh today. Excellent organization, friendly staff overall, impressive knowledge of the island given by pilot. 
Would 100% recommend doing this.

Our Air Venture Kaua’i tour on February 1, 2024 was amazing!  Our pilot, Josh, was so friendly and knowledgeable. He provided interesting insights to the many beautiful island landmarks and places of interest. He knew details about the island history, culture, weather, agriculture, and geography immersing us in the tour. When he spotted a couple of whales, he flew us over to see them…so cool!! We couldn’t have had a better flight/tour and highly recommend this wonderful experience wholeheartedly!!

We enjoyed this tour of the entire island. Different views than a previous helicopter tour. Higher and more expansive. The Napoli coast is breathtaking! Pilot narrated during tour and landed smoothly. Highly recommended!

Friendly, safe pilot showed us the amazing terrain of Kauai.
We only got a couple of glimpses of Waimea Canyon, thanks to the weather gods rolling in some heavy cloud cover. But we got lucky with sunshine on the Na Palu coastline....spectacular!
Was a great experience,  just wished we could have flown lower to get a more dramatic impact. All employees were top notch!

review_title: The Highlight of My Kauai Trip!!
review_text: Amazing experience and great way to see the entire island! I had been disappointed that the day before I couldn't see Waimea Canyon due to fog, and this tour made up for it. I was especially impressed with the Napali Coast, seeing those lush and steep mountainside cliffs next to crashing waves was ethereal. I would highly recommend this tour! It was the highlight of my trip to Kauai.

This was an amazing tour, the scenery was spectacular, the pilot, James was great. We saw everything that was advertised, and James was very knowledgeable.  We will do this tour again, and recommend it highly. 5 stars!!.

Breathtaking views of the entire Kauai Island! Our pilot, Mike10, did a great job of providing complete narration during the tour, including recommendations for hot spots to return to explore on the ground. This was an other worldly amazing tour that was well worth the ticket price! We took the first 8am tour to avoid the fog and rain that rolled in and was very happy we did, as we saw the Waimea Canyon, the waterfalls, and the NaPali coastline. Gorgeous!

We had the experience of flying around the island with Josh as our pilot. Being a family of 4, the plane was much more affordable than the helicopter for us. We greatly enjoyed our experience. The scenery is absolutely stunning and all passengers have excellent views. Our pilot was perfect and explained everything we saw with a few jokes to boot. The airline was professional and at no time did we fear for our safety. We recommend this plane tour with this company to appreciate the beauties of this island. Thank you Josh for this amazing experience 🤩
Great experience nice service. Everything is very smooth. We are a family of six, and we have the entire plane to ourselves.

review_title: Amazing Value & Great Tour Guide - Justin
review_text:
Booked Air Ventures Hawaii on Kauai for a same week excursion. We found them on Tinggly and saw their reviews on that site before booking. It was an amazing decision! I have been on a Kauai helicopter ride as well so I was able to experience both.

Air Ventures is definitely a value for the experience! Our pilot Justin was considerate and caring. He answered all my questions about the island and really made an effort to show the best of the island including pointing out a humpback whale off the Nepali coast!

A few notes on the services itself:
- $149 per person is a deal!
- The right side of the plane sees more of the best of the island including waterfalls and the Napali coast, but Justin did an amazing job making sure the left side got to see everything too with some awesome turns.
- The plane is not like a doors off helicopter. It's a smoother ride, and the views are less dramatic. For those who are prone to air sickness, I highly recommend over the helicopter.
- Parking and check-in is a breeze, it's right by the FedEx and has a designated parking lot
- Very organized operations and the staff are super friendly

I would highly recommend Air Ventures Hawaii in Kauai!

The pilot Piper is outstanding and the plane is great with good views and limited passengers (7). The tour was great until we reached  Hanelai Bay when all the sights were on the right and I sat on the left watching hundreds of miles of ocean. I was very interested in that area having not visited Kaui for 30 years (and could not believe all the changes--my last visit there was only 1 stoplight on the island). Allowances made for flight time and air traffic, understandable but disappointing.

One of the best experiences of my life. Stunning views of the island and James, our pilot, really added to the whole experience. I thought I'd feel a little vulnerable in a small plane but not at all. Breathtaking.

My husband and I just finished the one hour flight. Piper, our pilot and tour guide did a fabulous job answering questions and flying us where we wanted to go. We even saw some whales. You could not have seen the island if not by air. It was breathtakingly beautiful, just like the photos you see in magazines and online. This is a bargain price and a well run operation. I highly recommend you see Kauai by air. Be sure and ask for Piper.

Late flight from Lille, 1 hour to Tunis, and the same on the return 1h30 wait at Tunis airport, forced to change boarding lounge at the last minute, no explanation, oh yes! ! Bad weather conditions for the plane which came from Lille, we are looking for the cause of the so-called delay. We were taken for granted, when we called Lille, the weather was correct, no wind, no rain...This company is not serious...never again.

Due to weight restrictions, our flight was delayed until a smaller pilot could arrive. That was a blessing in disguise as both the weather improved, and we got Piper for our pilot. Piper was great! If you can have a choice of pilots, I'd choose her. Very knowledgeable. Very informative. Very fun. 
We saw the whole island and got great airel photos. 
The only complaint was an equipment issue with the headphones behind the pilots seat. It had a short, that made the narration cut in and out. 
Overall, I highly recommend this tour, and I can't say enough good things about our pilot, Piper.
Unreal experience. This is a must-do for anyone visiting Kauai. Justin was a fantastic pilot and aerial tour guide.

This was a quick way to see the whole island. I saw every site I wanted to see, and it was beautiful. The guide who was the pilot was very knowledgeable, and very professional. Highly recommend this air tour.

review_title: An exceptional tour of the beautiful island of Kauai, with an excellent pilot!
review_text: We had a great flight with James as our pilot. We some some incredible views of Waimea, the Na Pali coast, beautiful beaches and more! The plane was comfortable and the flight was very smooth. We would definitely recommend.

review_title: Great way to see the island
review_text: The trip was great - we got to see pretty much the entire island. Maka gave us a nice ride with very little turbulence. Be sure to get a starboard window seat, as my husband sat on the port side (we were in the last seats) and most of the views were on the starboard side. Luckily he could sort of lean over me to see. Overall a great experience and the photos and videos were terrific.

We had a wonderful time. Maka was our pilot and he was very kind and informative.

I was concerned at first that I wouldn’t be able to see well and I was very happy that I could see everything I wanted to

Had a wonderful time on the tour! Josh, our pilot, was great and handled the plane beautifully in some partially rainy weather. It was a wonderful way to see so much of the island and I very much recommend it!

On a Princess Cruise stop, Beautiful island, pleasant temperature, I took a excursion to the Waimea Canyon, walk to the nearby beach. There are three  free shuttle buses running taking people to different spots, bus drivers are extremely nice. Kauai is definitely recommended.
Justin was absolutely amazing. He was so friendly and easy to talk to.  Being also from Honolulu and now living in New York, thank you for treating me like family. I felt so welcomed.

WOW! I wish I could give this tour more stars! Our pilot Josh was outstanding! Between the incredible views, smooth flying and knowledge of the island, this is easily one of the best tours on the island. They fly over sights and views which are not accessible any other way. Staff were really accommodating and the grounds staff did an excellent job. HIGHLY RECOMMEND this tour AND requesting Josh as your pilot!

review_title: Outstanding tour and Piper is one of the best pilots
review_text: The clouds didn't cooperate as much as hoped but Piper our pilot did her very best to get us as much views as possible. She is a fantastic pilot and very friendly. We appreciate all she did and shared with us!

An amazing experience equal to helicopter at half the price. Pilot took us through 
Canyon and Coast and around the island. It was a remarkable experience

Views were not too much improved from driving the roads of Kauai. Honestly felt like a tourist trap. Spent most of the time looking at napali coast because of the weather over waimea canyon. 1 hour almost dragged. Pretty pricey for the experience in my opinion. Enjoyed driving a convertible through the island significantly more than the helicopter ride
I was on the right side of the plane and I loved it! My friend sat in the center of the plane and only saw water. She was extremely unhappy. The pilot was very experienced and the staff was friendly.

review_title: One of the best hour’s of my life.
review_text:
Flight left on time and every
Minute brought a new extraordinary view.  Could not believe the plethora of different terrains that were shown during the flight.  Tremendous number of differ shore lines shown around the island.  Was a truly fantastic experience I’d gladly pay double to do again.
Amazing flight and Shaden, our pilot, was great!  Very informative, and even pointed out other places to see on our trip

A little bit of history by the native Hawaiian pilot.  Amazing views we circled the entire island.  On the windward side a little rain and a rainbow with many waterfalls.  On the leeward side beautiful beaches.
Inexpensive.  Pilot was informative.  Plane comfortable.  Great views of the entire island.  Weather was clear.
This was an amazing way to see the island. Our pilot was wonderful and had a great sense of knowledge of the island. We had an amazing time. Highly recommend this experience with this company.

review_title: Awesome alternative to helicopter tour, in seeing Kauai from above
review_text:
Great way to see Kauai, via small plane (we already tried helicopter ride many years ago)…
Highly recommended.

Got lucky that we were the only ones so it became sorta private tour for us. Our pilot Josh was fun & awesome. Their ground crew (new hires) able to join us as well since seats were open.

Definitely one of the highlights on our trip.  We had limited time on Kauai and booked this so that we could see both the Waimea Canyon and the Na Pali coast and we were so pleased we did.  The views are absolutely spectacular, the seats were comfortable, and when we had some turbulence over the canyon and I saw the pilot was as cool as a cucumber and unfazed, I had complete trust that we were safe.   Every second of the flight is a scenic view, I was constantly snapping photos and they turned out amazing.....a few photos had a bit of my reflection (should have removed my white watch) and a lot have parts of the plane that couldn't be cropped out on editing without significantly reducing the size of the image but some of the pictures actually look better/cooler having the wing or wheel in them.
Views were amazing! You don’t fly as low as helicopters but u can’t beat the price! Everything run smoothly, on time…when u go solo u might even end up as a copilot like I did.

It was an amazing experience.  We would definitely do it again if we had the opportunity. 
But I recommend to take motion sickness medicine before the flight. It was (for me) to bumpy and I was feeling sick from very early in the flight. Nevertheless, it was really pretty to see Kauai from this point of view!
Beautiful views, just amazing. We flew much higher than the helicopters, so the vistas were Amazing!

review_title: The best experience of our trip!
review_text: The air tour was the best activity we did on our vacation! The views were stunning, seeing both rainbows over the canyon and the valleys of the Na Pali coast from above. We unfortunately had too much cloud cover to safely  get close to the falls from Jurassic Park, but it honestly didn't even phase us with how wonderful the rest of the tour was. It was also a cool way to orient ourselves to the island on our first day there. Our pilot Josh was great, we felt safe the whole time and his commentary was interesting. We really preferred the plane to any of the helicopter options, it felt secure and everyone got a great view from the windows. Highly recommend.
Wow really the best experience. From beginning to end the only way to see the full Kauai! We had great weather and even greater views

Great experience Josh was an awesome pilot and was a great narrator and picked us a great music playlist to cruise the sky and see the beauty of Kauai and a wonderful smooth landing! 
Highly recommend this very organized crew too!

What an amazing experience! James was our pilot. He was a fantastic host and guide. I was concerned that a plane would have to travel too fast and keep too great of a distance. That was not the case. The plane traveled at a seemly slow speed and was close enough to see details in the landscaping. The flight lasted for over an hour, which in much longer than a more expensive helicopter tour. James was knowledgable and provided a lot of great historical, as well as current, information. Our family of five enjoyed the tour and found that it exceeded our expecations. We highly rcommend it.
Amazing.  Highlight of our visit.  The pilot was personable & flew by best views.  Highly recommend.

It was a beautiful day, we saw so much of the island. The parts that we saw are there a hard, if not impossible to get to. As any time, weather permitting contributes to the turbulence. Most of the people on the plane did get some motion sickness. Our pilot mentioned there were earlier flights before the weather gets too warm could be better for not getting motion sickness. Just prepare yourself, but it was a beautiful, beautiful trip.

So amazing, had the best time ever!!!
Everything about the tour was fantastic. Would do it again. 
Josh made the trip unforgettable!!!

review_title: Spectacular aerial views of the Napoli Coast!
review_text: Spectacular tour of Kauai and the Napoli Coast with Isaac!  Isaac was really great!  The tour was fantastic and the scenery was incredible!
The flight was excellent. We were in the air more than one hour! You should see Kauai from above, it was amazing.

James was an amazing person and pilot!  He LOVES his job and was extremely informative as we toured the island.  He knows all the landscapes and knows the history of the Natives!  I would HIGHLY recommend taking a tour with this young man. We hope to see him in the near future piloting for a major airline!  GOOD LUCK JAMES!!

This was a great excursion.  Pilot James shared lots of little stories of the island and suggestions of what to do.  It was amazing how he could name off all the waterfalls, peaks and valleys with every turn he did.  
If anyone in your family is prone to any motion sickness, take motion sickness medication prior to. Two out of 3 kids couldn't enjoy the beautiful scenery as much as they would have if they had taken it.
Excellent flight and great pilot. Very smooth trip. Definitely worth the money. Great photos and memories.

review_title: Amazing view of Kauai from the air
review_text: Isaac was wonderful. He informed us ahead of time before the expected turbulence so we know what to expect and the entire crew was very friendly and helpful.
Had a wonderful tour of the Island. Our pilot was very knowledgeable, and made us feel incredibly safe. Views were amazing, highly recommend!

review_title: Great flight experience, beautiful views of Kauai
review_text:
They were on time, our pilot Josh was courteous, fun and knowledgable. The only drawback were the hostess who greet, weigh and welcome you back form the flight. They were unpleasant a bit stiff and definitely not matching the vibe of the company advertised as Fun adventure. Be advised that some parts might be a bit choppy and that it can get hot during the flight - totally normal for this type of aircraft.
The flight experience with Josh was awesome, just wish  Air Ventures could find someone with a smile and who feels like they want to work at this place for their front desk.

This was an amazing experience! Our pilot was informative and fun.  The scenery was fantastic! Our pilot welcomed questions and answered every one. Clear instructions were given about how to find flight. This was definitely the highlight of our trip. Thank you!
Amazing views from 3000 feet up. With the ship not doing the NA Pali coast it is a must, and reasonable.

Our experience with this company was far past amazing, from check in with a smile to boarding the plane was excellent customer service to the end. Our pilot Josh was super friendly and calm. When they found out it was our sons birthday, they went above and beyond about having him be co-pilot. We want to thank the entire crew and Josh for the great memories he gave us to take back! We highly recommend this company who's looking for the same experience we received. Thank you!

review_title: Don’t miss out on an opportunity of a lifetime!!!  Best way to see Kauai!!!
review_text: The views were breathtaking!!!!  We saw so many waterfalls and gorgeous lush mountains.  Josh was our pilot and he couldn’t have been better! Played music over the headsets and told all about the island. Smooth as silk landing and takeoff. We got to see each direction of the island and it lasted over an hour. Best deal you will find for an hour flight over Kauai!!
Pilot Josh was great and we had great views. Smooth ride for a smaller plane and the landing was smooth as silk

It was a good overall experience to be able to see the whole island including the canyons, waterfalls and coastline different from what I had seen in the last few days by car. Unfortunately, the plane is not able to do what a helicopter can do so it doesn’t go deep into the canyon or close to waterfalls, just more of a overall view. I thought our pilot Josh did a great job and I recommend him and this company to anyone looking for an affordable aerial experience.
We loved being able to see all the waterfalls and the Na Pali coast was breathtaking!! Our pilot, Bubz, was great gave lot of information. Thanks for the memories!!
Breathtaking views! Our pilot was Bubz and we had a great time seeing the island and the Napali Coast.

Our pilot was friendly, knowledgeable and professional. The sightseeing flight was the perfect way to see the highlights of Kauai in little more than an hour. We found this very good value compared to the helicopter tours. Highly recommended - an excellent company.

review_title: Great smooth way to see the island.
review_text: Excellent flight.  Great way to see the island and sights.  Very smooth and great pilot Harold.  Was less than an hour from start to finish.  Speed from 89-100.  Altitude between 3-5.5 thousand feet.

Our pilot did a wonderful job flying over the island (many times doing a second pass so both sides could see something). We enjoyed this more than the helicopter tour we had taken previously. Seeing the island from the air is a very special treat!

Great tour! Covered the whole island and saw views of Waimea canyon and the Nepali coast that can not be duplicated by land or sea (we did both). The expanse of coffee crops was way larger than I expected and of course, the beaches were endless strips of gorgeous. 
HIGHLY recommended.
Viewing the natural wonders of Kauai from the air is spectacular. The pilot and staff at Air Ventures make the experience very enjoyable. Highly recommended!

Booked day before, great communication and updates. Arrival at company’s terminal went very smoothly. Left on time and had a MAGNIFICENT 70 minute flight with great commentary by our pilot Mark. You could tell he had a love of the island. Got great pictures of everything and was an unforgettable adventure. Best value for your dollar on our whole trip!!
Our tour with Bubbs was amazing!  We got a wonderful overview of the island and it was the highlight of our trip to Kauai. Highly recommend!

My husband enjoyed being copilot on this airplane. I got to sit in the back of the plane, which allowed us to get different perspectives for videos and pictures that we took along the route. The pilot was very knowledgeable and kind. The highlight of the trip was feeling like we were in a double rainbow up in the sky over the Nepali coast. My husband and I don’t typically get carsick, but there were some rocky points over the Nepali coast. I highly recommend Dramamine ginger chews prior to the flight for anyone who has ever been carsick. Neither of us got sick, but felt nauseated afterwards and took some ginger juice when we landed, which helped a lot. This was a surreal experience for both of us, and we highly recommend it as a way to view Kauai from up above.
Great tour!!! Great pilot.  Smooth ride. Staff was super friendly. Totally worth the ride! Would recommend for fam!

review_title: Best way to see the Na Pali Coastline
review_text: We had such a great experience on our aerial tour with Kauai Aerial Tour and our pilot, Isaac. The tour office was a quick and easy walk from the main Kauai airport in Lihue—this was especially nice for us, as we were just over to Kauai on a day trip from Maui and didn’t have a rental car! This was a really great tour and a really good way to see the Na Pali Coastline and the canyons within the island without having to go by boat. I’m prone to sea sickness, so this was a perfect solution for me. Isaac was very knowledgeable and friendly and we felt very safe in his care. We were seated in the middle seats, unfortunately, so we had our views partially obstructed by the wings, so our views and photos weren’t great. I guess someone has to sit there, but for future flyers, try for the backseat or the front with the pilot for the best views!

It was a good way to see the entire Island.  But w e were a little disappointed with the narration.
Couldn't see much from our side of the plane

My husband and I are in Kauai for our honeymoon and booked this tour after seeing so many amazing reviews. Boy are we glad we did!!! Bubs was our pilot and we couldn’t have asked for a better time! Though there were some clouds, I believe this lead to some absolutely BEAUTIFUL pictures! If you have a GoPro, I HIGHLY recommend spending the $35 to have it mounted to the outside of the plane. The cherry on top of the cake was that I got to sit in the co-pilot seat. The plane was comfortable and was air conditioned. Bubs continually made sure all of us were comfortable. Do make sure to wear dark colored clothing to offset any potential glare/reflections off of the windows. You will not be disappointed!
