Prepare for a journey that will leave you breathless and yearning for more! Air Ventures' trip around Kauai is a mesmerizing adventure that combines the smoothest of rides with awe-inspiring vistas. It's an experience worth every penny, promising memories to cherish for a lifetime.

From the moment we boarded the aircraft, we knew we were in for something truly special. The pilot, with their expert skills and friendly demeanor, set the tone for an extraordinary flight. With each announcement, their passion for aviation and love for the island was palpable, putting us at ease and heightening our excitement.

As we took off, the aircraft glided seamlessly through the sky, showcasing the pilot's exceptional control and professionalism. The ride was unbelievably smooth, as if we were floating on a gentle breeze. Even those who typically experience anxiety while flying found themselves relaxed, thanks to the pilot's steady hand and reassuring presence.

But what truly stole the show were the breathtaking views that unfolded before our eyes. Kauai, with its lush green landscapes, rugged cliffs, cascading waterfalls, and pristine beaches, became our personal paradise. The pilot skillfully navigated us through the island's hidden gems, ensuring that we didn't miss a single moment of its natural wonders.

As we soared above the Na Pali Coast, the pilot expertly maneuvered the aircraft, allowing us to witness the sheer magnificence of the towering cliffs and crystal-clear turquoise waters. The Waimea Canyon, often called the "Grand Canyon of the Pacific," revealed its dramatic beauty from a vantage point that only a few are lucky to witness. And when we reached the stunning Hanalei Bay, its crescent-shaped shoreline and lush green mountains formed a postcard-perfect scene that will forever remain etched in our hearts.

Throughout the flight, the pilot shared captivating stories and fascinating facts about Kauai, adding depth and meaning to our aerial exploration. Their knowledge and passion for the island's history, culture, and ecology further enriched our experience, transforming it into an educational and enlightening journey.

Air Ventures' trip around Kauai is undoubtedly an investment in memories that will stand the test of time. With a pilot who exudes professionalism, a smooth ride that defies gravity, and views that will take your breath away, every penny spent is rewarded with an experience that transcends expectations. So, buckle up, let your spirit soar, and embark on a flight of a lifetime.
Great way to see the island. I was skeptical because I like to be in the water but it was well worth it!  Bubs the best!  Very calming and good pilot with skills and knowledge.
Amazing views of the island. I would recommend this to everyone. You are able to see places from a different angle. It’s just worth it to be able to see Napali Coast.

Overall worth the price for the experience.  It doesn’t compare to a helicopter ride, but price is right to get a good aerial view of Kauai. Good views all around with comfortable plane. Staff was prepared and friendly. Pilots know what they are doing obviously, on the younger side but felt safe up in air. Would recommend to anyone looking to get a birds eye view for sure.

The tour was amazing! The pilot/tour guide, Bubbs was awesome at flying the plane safely and giving amazing facts about the area around us. My favorite part was seeing the waterfalls! My husband and I are here on our honeymoon and it was just the most amazing time! We definitely recommend this to anyone!

review_title: A beautiful way to see Kauai!
review_text:
We were not able to appreciate the land excursion we took the day before to the Waimea Canyon because of a downpour, so was really looking forward to this. Our pilot, Mark, was fantastic. There was still cloud cover over the canyon so we had to go in a different direction, then another rain cloud snuck up on us, prompting Mark to turn back and cancel for the day. Despite that it was beautiful and we saw a rainbow
  Diane and Richard O'Boyle, Lansing, Mi
  .

review_title: Fantastic Air Tour of Kauai Island!
review_text: Our air tour of Kauai Island “The Garden Isle” gave us spectacular views of iconic Hawaii and its dramatic beauty! Seeing its lush landscape, spectacular Waimea Canyon "Grand Canyon of the Pacific", Opaekaa Falls, and Na Pali Coast from the air was the highlight of our visit to Hawaii! During our 70 minute flight, our fantastic pilot Bub made his six passengers feel comfortable and ensured both sides of the plane enjoyed all the views. We appreciated his informative narration on the sights below and knowledge of the landscape. Our Air Ventures experience was truly an amazing adventure!
我們兩人報了這團, 郵輪到達后打車到這里, 在柜檯chech in時才告知取消了這次行程,但沒有提前通知! 讓我無法及時補救, 我倆在島上無所事事, 沒有了觀光机會! 白白浪費了机票;船票;出租車費用, 這公司服務很差, 不負責任! 到現在等了一個多月,退款還沒收到.
Views are unbelievable!   Pilot was committed to give us a great experience. Very informative.  Definitely take this trip !

It was a phenomenal experience. I loved seeing the interior of the island from above. Being able to see the vast amounts of canyons, mountains, and greenery with so much untouched land. The waterfalls were beautiful!! Bryan was great at explaining each landmark and providing history! We chose this trip over the helicopters because you don’t get the wind and cold air and can always take amazing pictures.

review_title: Got our own private flight because the other passengers on our group flight were too fat! Awesome treat!
review_text:
My girlfriend and I booked a group flight around the Island. 

I have flying experience and when we arrived and it was time to go out to the plane, we were surprised to get a private flight for two on their Cessna 182T, instead of the group flight we booked on the ten seater. Observing the other passengers, half of them were overweight, and I suspect behind the scenes they arranged for us two to have our own plane because the other plane was too heavy to take-offf with their excessive weight! It was a real treat because the private flight should have been more like $700 instead of the $300 we paid for a one hour flight,

Our pilots name was Bud, I think?  He was a young guy, with only a few years flying experience.  I think I soloed before he was even born?   He was building hours and hoping to get hired by Hawaiian Airmon the Airbus 320Neo.  I wish him the best of luck because 20 years ago that was my plan to  for their lines. Plans changed though. 

It was an amazing flight.  Haven’t flown in a small Cessna for over twenty years. It was great to get back in the air in a small GA plane.

Gabe and Noe  were the best!!! They really took their time and explained all the history on the north side of the island! I learned a lot from them and had a blast!!! They were very informative and not to mention amazing captains!! These two men deserve a raise!! Thank you both for such a wonderful trip out on the water and a chance to learn about your home!! 
- Chris & Erica
Beautiful way to see the whole island by air. Safe and comfortable. Beautiful scenery that can only be seen from the sky.

Great tour, can only recommend! Good info about what can be seen by pilot, too. The welcome was a bit short, yet the view great. The fact that only two people sit in a row gives you the chance sitting near a window. Also, the pilot made sure that everybody could see everything.

review_title: Weather was bad and no refund
review_text: I was looking forward to going on this but due to weather two times we had to reschedule and not end up going.  The worst part is that Air Ventures stated they would refund our money but so far after 2 months, they have not done so and say its Expedia's fault.  No communication from them and won't return calls

Super professional communication before the flight (booked the week of) and at the airport. Very easy to find and check in. We knew the weather would be iffy for our flight, and the pilot allowed our group to decide to go for an altered route or get a reschedule/refund. We chose the altered route, and he did a great job getting us some great views of the coast and other parts of Kauai without ever sacrificing safety or comfort due to the weather - and there were lots of clouds and rain in the area. Like others have said, book early in your trip and early in the day to give yourself maximum flexibility, but highly recommend.

This was a great experience!! Breathtaking views from above. The pilot was very informative, and it was well worth it. Compared to helicopter tours, this is an affordable experience. Would definitely recommend

review_title: Adverse weather handled situation handled well
review_text: The weather did not cooperate, and we were only able to see half of the island due to cloudy conditions. But the pilot gave us the option to reschedule (pending availability), receive a full refund, or fly over the other half of the island twice. So we did not get to see Waimea Canyon.  But the pilot was great, and made the best of a situation outside his control. We were glad we went.

The weather was beautiful and the views were amazing.  Connor, our pilot, made us feel very at ease and was knowledgeable about the island.  Overall a fantastic experience and great value compared to a doors off helicopter tour.

The weather was beautiful, the pilot was awesome! He was very knowledgeable about the area, and made sure that those seated on each side of the plane got to see the scenery.
Something I would definitely do again, and I highly recommend!

See the island from the view of the Gods and you will know the Kauai IS the most beautiful place on Earth. Isaac the pilot is friendly, professional, and knowledgeable. This is a must do on your Kauai trip!!
Good pilot. Smooth flight. Good views. Flew around the entire island perimeter. Good value. Much cheaper than a helicopter.

The tour was well worth the money and a great time. The plane was a bit hot, and I can imagine it’s a lot worse in the summer closer to noon (we went at 9). We didn’t get to see everything because of clouds, but that is expected. It was a lot of fun and I’d go again for sure.

We had a superb experience with Airventures Tours.  We reserved our tour one day prior and were able to book exactly the day and time we wanted. However, on the day of our flight, 20 minutes after takeoff an unexpected and rapid deterioration of weather conditions along the north coast of Kauai (so normal/unavoidable for this time of year) forced our pilot, Isaac, to turn around and return to the airport.  Before we even landed we were given the option for a full refund or rebook for the day and time of our convenience.  We rebooked for the following morning.  No problems this time and Isaac gave us a superb ride.  His commentary on the history and geography of what we were seeing was very informative, he spotted some whales for us, knew how to avoid the bumps and find all the spectacular scenery that is Kauai.  Couldn't say enough about Isaac and Airventures!  Highest rating possible from me - hugest shout out and thank you!

review_title: The Best Way to See Kauai
review_text: Magical air tour of beautiful Kauai. Our pilot, Caden, was excellent.  Made sure both sides of the plane saw all the sights.  Six passengers plus Caden. Everyone had a large window to look out.

This was a fun experience. I would have rated it 5 had we not been 30 minutes behind schedule. No explanation given so we were just hanging out there wondering how late we’re gonna be up in the air. Pilot was very nice as well but there was a lot of silence during the air tour. Wish there were more info shared.

What a romantic way to start Valentine's day! Our Kauai tour was magical. We thoroughly enjoyed the small plane adventure over the Island of Kauai! Our pilot, Bub, was excellent. Smooth takeoff and landing!  We definitely recommend this tour!

Even though we showed up early and were within 2 lbs of the reported weights, they said there was a weight imbalance and rescheduled us for later that day. When we came later that day, we waited a bit, then ultimately cancelled due to low visibility. Our next rescheduled flight was cancelled due to weather. Wish we could have gone on that first flight, but instead just spent a few hours of our time in the waiting area. The customer service people were nice, and we received a full refund, but I'm still not sure as to why there was a weight problem for us when our reported weights were completely accurate.

Isaac was an excellent pilot and very thorough in explaining island sites, and comforting some first time jitters about flying in a small plane. Loved that it was just me, my husband and the pilot, made it really personal.
It was fabulous!  Had great view from window and it was so fun yo see the entire island. The pilot was very informative.
Bubs was our pilot, he was very knowledgeable, friendly and skilled. Even turned around a few times to help every see whales. 10/10 would recommend to anyone!

review_title: Highly recommend going with this professional company
review_text: So grateful for this tour. The company is incredibly professional. Due to weather conditions, our air tour was cut short and we didn’t see the Na Pali coast. However, what we did get to see was absolutely beautiful, and we are grateful for the experience. On top of that, the company give us a full refund because we didn’t see the Na Pali coast as advertised, which was so kind of them.

review_title: Unreliable, canceled a few hours before departure due to maintenance.
review_text: We had booked a tour, but had it canceled by them last minute(morning prior to departure at noon) due to unscheduled maintenance. Giving three stars because they did offer a refund, but it threw our vacation plans off and lost our opportunity to fly over Kauai....If I had known that it was an unreliable charter, probably would of booked a different company.

We had a good time observing the unreal beauty of Kauai from our airplane window with Air Ventures. The pilot was engaging, cracked some jokes, and did a great job explaining protocol and what we were seeing. We learned some fun facts along the way and even saw two humpback whales off the Na Pali coast. We only wish the plane circled back to spend some more time flying along Na Pali.

What we could see was very beautiful. Unfortunately, cloud cover prevented us from seeing any of the canyon as well as the "Jurassic Park" waterfalls. Since most of our family are huge Jurassic Park fans, seeing the falls was one of the main reasons I booked this tour. Our pilot, Mark, was excellent. He did his best to make sure we saw all that we could and that people on both sides of the plane could enjoy the views. Another drawback was the time issue. We arrived half an hour early as directed only to leave half an hour late. This tour is not something I would do again.

The experience itself was amazing. Beautiful views of the whole island, the pilot was knowledgeable and friendly. The pilot made sure both sides of the plane could see the views, too. Very thoughtful! Definitely worth the money! 

 The only drawback was that the flight was delayed about a half an hour and all we were told was it would be “soon.” If you go on this excursion, don’t book it back to back with another event. 

Photos taken through the glass window on an iPhone 14 pro

review_title: Smooth, Safe flight that was everything we wanted...and more
review_text: We felt like we had the "run of the island" during our air ride.  We got to see all the things we wanted to see plus some bonuses like two whale sightings and the ability to go over the top of the volcano because of the excellent weather.  Our pilot was very informative and also very safe in the conduct of the flight; for example, there was a magneto issue and he errored on the side of safety to have it completely checked out before our flight.

review_title: Do not miss out on this!!
review_text:
What an incredible experience!! I cannot recommend this air tour enough. The pilot was absolutely fantastic, gave a great overview of everything we saw and went out of his way to make everyone feel comfortable on the plane. I found this to be an outstanding value for the once in a lifetime experience!

I would give this excursion 862 stars out of 10!

What an amazing tour.  We had such a great time. It was the “High” point of our trip to Kauai. We saw the entire island from an amazing perspective. The pilot was professional, friendly and knowledgeable.  Definitely a great value for what you get. We had perfect weather, and even got to see a couple of whales.

This was an excellent experience, a great way to see all of the island.  Got some amazing shots from the sky of the coastline, the Jurassic Falls, the sun setting and o much more.  The flight was smooth and the pilot was very knowledgeable.  Highly recommend!

review_title: Airplane around Kauai shows the best parts of the island in just 60 minutes
review_text: Very good overview of the beautiful island with reasonable price (particularly compared with helicopters). Sensitive to low cloud coverage as it needs to fly higher than helicopters. We had a bit bad luck in a way that our flight took place in the most cloudy day of our visit… Good view out of the windows and helpful pilot trying to ensure there was a lot to see created a great experience nonetheless.

This is a great way to see the whole island. It was an amazing clear day and our pilot Maka(?) I’m sorry if that’s wrong was very nice and gave tips about all different areas of the island. We were lucky and even had a few whale sightings from the air. Definitely recommend especially when you know you may not make it to another part of the island again

review_title: Amazing experience, great customer service, value for money!
review_text:
Our experience with Air Ventures was great! There was some initial confusion about scheduling, and we ended up double booking with Air Ventures and Wings Over Kauai, but they were nice enough to work the issue between themselves and we didn't have to worry about anything. 
As for the tour itself, it was really amazing! Our pilot Justin was very knowledgable, skilful, and professional. He showed us pretty much the entire island - A pity we missed Napali Coast, due to the bad weather (Low clouds), but he tried his best to get us to see Napali from both the east and west sides. Not only did he describe each attraction, but he also provided historical background and context on a lot of things (Sugarcane fields, the anthropological history of the island, military base, etc.). All in all this tour was great value for money, and one of the highlights of our trip to Kauai (Which is a big deal, considering how, pretty much everything that we did / saw on the island took our breath away!). Wholeheartedly recommend this tour to anyone visiting the island.

review_title: Great way to see the whole island!
review_text: Our pilot Bubbs was fantastic he was very knowledgeable & friendly! We could tell he loves his island! The views were spectacular! We saw waterfalls & canyons & of course Napali Valley! The best way to see the whole island! Bubbs told us in advance when to expect a bumpy ride & they didn’t last long! He pointed out all the landmarks & gave information on each! I do have to say his landing had no bumps at all! We were sad when it was over but happy for the experience! Thanks Bubbs!

Incredible flight over a real-life Jurassic Park. Absolutely breathtaking views from the plane. It’s hard to describe, and the photos don’t do it justice. Our pilot was wonderful - he made every effort to get us comfortable from the get-go, and constantly affirmed how seriously the company took safety. He was also a great guide, with stories about the different landscapes, fauna and locations. We had a private tour and it was well worth the extra money. I would highly recommend!
Wonderful experience, great staff highly recommended our pilot was very engaging friendly and knowledgeable
my moms first helicopter ride was amazing. our pilot was knowledgeable, professional, and the communication was great. i highly recommend and couldn’t be more happy with the experience, thank you!

review_title: Unique way to see the island
review_text: This was a great experience to see the entire island from the air! So many great views! The pilot was great and told us unique things about the island. The plane was actually pretty quiet with the headsets on and seats 6 (not including pilot) so it gives a feel of more of a private ride. There is great views from everywhere in the plane but I would suggest sitting on the right side as you see more of the island going out. It was a smooth ride and would highly recommend for a unique way to see the island.
Fabulous experience!  We had a wonderful day and the pilot was excellent! We had excellent visibility and seeing Kauai from above was amazing!
This air tour was a great way to see the entire island. Our pilot was friendly and knowledgeable and gave us a very smooth flight over the island.
It was one of the most breathtaking experiences I have ever had. It was very beautiful and the pilot was a great tour guide😀

Was a great tour although I wasn’t paying attention and searched helicopter tours. This is actually a one prop plane. The pilot did a great job and landed the plane smoothly. I would recommend doing this at the beginning of your trip so you have time to drive to the places you see from above. This was a great experience.

We thoroughly enjoyed our air tour of the beautiful island of Kauai!
Our pilot Caden was very informative and safety conscious.. and enjoyable to talk with.
Highly recommend this tour!

review_title: Fabulous entire Kauai Island air tour
review_text: This was well worth it. I would highly recommend anyone who is thinking about seeing Kauai by air. Ride was smooth and our pilot Cayden was great. He was a good tour guide and explained everything very well. The flight has some spectacular views. You can attach a GoPro or they will rent you one. Be sure to bring your own micro SD card as they don't have any in stock. Price was very reasonable and well below other companies who offer air rides in Kauai. Bonus was to see a full rainbow from the air!

Thank you for an amazing way to see the island of Kauai.We got cancel for our initial day because of low visibility but lucky us we went the next day.The views were amazinggggg!!!The pilot was super nice and gave us an amazing tour.It was a little bumpy but just for a minute.The best part was that we were able to take our 14 months son with us.Any other tours I looked at were not accepting babies on board.I’m so grateful we could all go because we didn’t have a sitter or somebody to watch our son and we really wanted to see the island from up in the air;)
Our pilot, Dan, was so nice.  We had a great time enjoying the the high up views of Kauai and with Dan's help we got to see many waterfalls.

It was a stunning flight. Our captain Caden, a cool and young guy did a great job. He made sure, that the passengers on the right as well as the passengers on the left side could take pictures of the must sees. despite the quickli changing weather conditions the flight was stable and comfortable. I had the chance to sit in the front row, next to the captain. Thank you!

Makana was wonderful. 
 He was very informative and funny throughout the flight.  Took his time to show everyone on each side of the aircraft the all sights.
He definitely puts the customer service first and made sure we had a great day.  Cant wait to do it again soon and hopefully have Makana as out pilot again

It was a tremendously enjoyable and wonderful air tour. Our pilot was personable, knowledgeable, professional, and an excellent pilot. Both my wife and   I agree that we were very happy that we took this fantastic air tour. We would do this again.

Toller Flug mit erfahrenem und kommunikativen Pilot. Man fliegt um die ganze Insel und hat eine einmalige Perspektive auf tolle Spots. Man muss sich bewusst sein, dass das Wetter auf Kauai unberechenbar ist. Bei der Buchung zwei Tage vorab, sah es noch perfekt aus. Leider aber azur Flugzeit nicht mehr. Es war aber trotzdem schön. Grundsätzlich ist der Flug angenehm, es kann aber etwas ruppig werden wenns windig ist. Nichts für einen schwachen Magen. ;-)

review_title: Hands down the highlight of our Kauai trip!!
review_text: What an amazing flight! My wife, daughter and I got to take the 4 seat plane, what a treat! Makana was a great pilot and we enjoyed all his insights. He also did a great job of making sure all of us could see the sights by doing some extra passes. I would highly recommend this tour, definitely the highlight of our trip to Kauai!

Amazing views from the air - especially of the Napali coast. One thing to note, you will get an assigned seat on the plane to help distribute the weight, so one side will have a much better view of the coastline than the other. Still, overall my wife & I really enjoyed seeing Kauai by air as the island itself is absolutely beautiful.

review_title: It's worth every penny. Just book it now!
review_text:
This is an amazing tour and an excellent cost-effective alternative to a helicopter. 

We enjoy scenic flights and have been on many fixed wing and helicopter flights around the world.  We book one on just about every holiday but this one was definitely one of our favourites.

The scenery was just spectacular. Justin was a fabulous pilot who was incredibly knowledgeable about the area. He was very kind to our 16-year-old daughter who is attending an aviation high school. She got to sit in as "co-pilot" and he spent some time explaining some of the "technical information" as he was flying.

Kauia really needs to be seen from the air to be appreciated and if you can afford only one scenic flight this would be a great choice.  The views and service are both world class. 

Thank you for a wonderful experience. This was a highlight for us on our three week Hawaiian holiday!

review_title: Gorgeous views! A must see way to see the island
review_text: Breathtaking views and the pillow was very knowledgeable. Worth every penny. Perfect way to see the entire island

review_title: The very best way to experience Kauai
review_text:
The Na Pali Coast was the highlight of this 5-Star Aerial Tour.  

This was our 6th visit to Kauai, the first being in 1962.  We never before availed ourselves of the Air Tour.  Don't wait 60 years to do it  !!!

Zunächst wurde der Flug wegen schlechtem Wetter (Wind und Regen) verschoben. 
2 Tage später war dann das Wetter super.  Der Flug war atemberaubend. Der Pilot Nate war sehr infomativ, witzig, freundlich und hat sein Handwerk verstanden. Die Landschaft ist einfach unbeschreiblich schön. Da Kauai  in weiten Teilen nicht zugänglich ist, sieht man im Wesentlichen unberührte Natur.  Ohne einen Flug würde man dieses Paradiies einfach so niemals sehe oder erleben können. 
Damit alle Passagiere gleich gut sehen können, dreht Nate häufig noch mal um oder fliegt Kurven. Der Flug hat eine gute Stunde gedauert und ich habe jede einzelne Minute genossen.
The scenery was spectacular, and seeing it from the air was breathtaking. The pilot was very kind to circle around the major waterfalls do that both sides of the plane could see.

I loved hearing the history and seeing all the turtles. We even got lucky and saw a couple monk seals and dolphins. Christian and Captain Dayton were wonderful and very knowledgeable. Definitely would go again!!

review_title: Excellent value for First time Kauai visitors
review_text: This was as amazing as the reviews said it would be, and a fantastic value especially with the 10% discount for booking on the Travel Advisor app. (Like 1/2 the price of the helicopter tours)).  It  turned out that  just the 2 of us were taking the tour at 1:30  that day so ended up getting a private tour! Our pilot, Isaac was fabulous, grew up on the island and gave us great tips on things to do and places to go as well as giving historical info on points of interest.  Highly recommend doing the small plane flight around the island.  It was definitely a highlight and a great overview of all the wonderful things each side of the island had to offer, especially for first timers to Kauai like us.  Can’t wait to come back to Kauai again sometime soon!

I loved it.  Felt secure and enjoyed it very much.  Definitely do it again and
 again. Highly recommend 👌

review_title: Air Ventures Hawaii - awesome way to see Kauai
review_text: We really enjoyed the airplane tour of Kauai. Nate (pilot) was very informative and we had a lot of fun on the journey. Initially, there was a problem with the booking, but I very much appreciated the reach out by Keone who helped to accommodate our party.

It was super awesome! like the absolutely breathtaking. Highly recommend because it’s a very unique way to experience the Island. It felt totally safe. And our captain was wonderful at making us feel comfortable. He was born and raised on the Island and knew it all! 
Thank you!!

review_title: Highlight of our time on Kauai
review_text: Our trip with AirVentures was the highlight of our time on Kauai. The staff was extremely welcoming and helpful upon arrival. Perhaps the best part of the trip was our pilot, Nate. He was both friendly and professional, having a great sense of humor. He ensured that we were able to get a good look at some of the most important features by circling back around. His narration and knowledge of Kauai was outstanding and he made everything interesting, pointing out the most important landmarks. Every question we asked, he was happy to answer. He had all five of our names down and addressed questions to us by name. The flight was fun, informational, and an overall excellent experience. Thank you, AirVentures!

review_title: Best way to see the island
review_text: Such a wonderful time!!! Our pilot was awesome. We saw and learned so much. Smooth ride. Was able to get plenty of pictures. Loved that everyone had a window seat. HIGHLY HIGHLY recommend!!! 5 stars all the way.
Wonderful team of dynamic young people who want to make this excursion one to remember. Would recommend this to anyone and do this at the start of your vacation at Kauai.

review_title: A a n r a d e r !!
review_text: Tot onze verbazing kregen wij een upgrade naar een privé tour in een Cesna. Piloot Camden liet ons alle mooie plekken van het eiland zien. Hij nam alle tijd zodat we alles goed konden bekijken. Met mooie zachte landing konden we terug kijken op een mooi avontuur. Een echte aanrader dus! Bedankt Camden!!

review_title: Discover this garden island’s hidden treasures
review_text: Wonderful aerial tour of this beautiful island. Our pilot was great. My only issue was a faulty headset so I missed a lot of the in-flight narrative.

review_title: Awesome views of the Napali Coast and Waimea Canyon
review_text: The flight around the entire island of Kauai was awesome.  I've taken a helicopter tour of Hawaii before, and this tour gives you more of a birdseye view.  You can see the helicopters flying below you.  The views of the Napali Coast and Waimea Canyon were spectacular.  Keith, our pilot, made sure to fly the plane in both directions so both sides got a good view.  I highly recommend this tour.

review_title: Great way to see the Island!
review_text:
We really enjoyed our flight! Everyone there was super friendly and helpful. A little bumpy in a few spots but no big deal. Take some Dramamine beforehand, Our plane had 6 passenger seats and the view from each was great. No middle seats! 
At a few of the more scenic spots the pilot circled a couple of times to be sure everyone got a good 
view. Highly recommend!
My wife and I took a one hour private plane tour of Kauai. The pilot was excellent and the views were fantastic. We would highly recommend this adventure for future travelers.

review_title: Best Safety, Value, Professionalism, and Service
review_text:
Air Ventures Hawaii provided absolutely the highest levels of safety, friendliness, professionalism, reliability, and great communication. 
I have seen Air Ventures flying out of Lihue and looked forward to booking a tour with my family. We had a blast and it was one of the highlights of our visit to Kauai. From booking/reserving, payment, website, and communication everything was simple and direct. Our check-in with Trish was easy and we felt welcome immediately. Our pilot Nate introduced himself and was very friendly; he took the time to make sure he knew all of our names, took pictures, assisted with any questions, and conducted a comprehensive briefing. The airplane was clean, well equipped, and squared away. We had complete confidence in the operation. 
The tour itself was wide ranging, flexible, informative, and flat-out spectacular. We were able to see the entire island, and Nate took care to operate the airplane with smoothness and an aim to provide views to all passengers. He delivered on that and more. Nate was able answer all of our questions and we learned about Kauai, the land, the sea, the rivers, the mountains, and the people. Very knowledgeable! The views  that Air Ventures Hawaii provides are as good or perhaps much better than a helicopter tour at a great value for a family. I would give Air Ventures Hawaii my strongest recommendation. 
I am serving customers every day in my job, and I know the many challenges one can encounter when trying to deliver your best service. That said, our experience with Nate, Trish, and Air Ventures Hawaii was one of the best service experiences I’ve had the privilege of receiving. I know how hard they worked to get it done, and sincerely appreciate their efforts. It’s not easy. We appreciate the effort. 
Aloha, Mahalo, and can’t wait to fly with them again…..Cheers!

Excellent trip to look around and see the nature of Kauai that most people don’t get to see. It was a little cloudy that day but that made it even more awe striking. Young Caleb did an excellent job of keeping us safe while showing us the island.
Well worth the money.

We booked this for our Anniversary. Easy check in. Isaac was our pilot in a small private plane.  We got the Go Pro on the wing and it recorded the whole trip and we took pictures and Isaac was awesome by getting us all the right angles and even circling to get the best views.  Where a dark shirt to reduce the glare.  Phenomenal views and spectacular landscapes and waterfalls. We have seen Kauai by car, kayak, boat and now by air. Beautiful island. The cherry on top of the trip was Isaac’s landing…..10 out of 10, like landing on a pillow top mattress. 🤙🏼🌺🌴

review_title: Only way to truly see Kauai
review_text: Pilot Nate was great! Very informative. Ride itself was a little bumpy due to winds in the canyon but the beauty of it all outweighed the nausea.Good luck to him in his future piloting endeavors.
Great experience. Only way to see the island. If you get motion sickness take your Dramamine! Pilot, Nate, did his best for a smooth ride and very informative. Worth the motion sickness 👍🏼

review_title: Choose this plane, not a helicopter !
review_text: Choose this easy plane ride over the helicopters! You won't be sorry. Nate the Great captain was superb at making everyone feel safe and provide plenty of local knowledge.

The staff is great and views are spectacular!  I would recommend this trip. If you have motion sickness take something beforehand it can be rough at times but staff is great to help prevent it and if you do they are great to help you recovery.  But the view of the island is definitely worth the trip.
We had a wonderful time - amazing views of Kauai that you can't get from any other means of travel.  Our pilot was personable and knowledgeable.

Our experience was awesome. The ride was a lot smoother than we expected and it was an absolutely beautiful day. Our pilot was so friendly and knowledgeable of the island since he was born there.  It was very obvious that he loved his job. I highly recommend this adventure.

The views you get from the air cannot be obtained from a car or hiking. We went into canyons and a crater where the views were breathtaking. I did not realize there were that many waterfalls on the island!

The pilot was very pleasant and pointed out all of the landmarks and points of interest.

One thing to note is that it is a small plane and you feel a lot of bumps. This may affect some people with a weak stomach. 

They also rent a GoPro that is attached to the strut of the plane; I have a video of the entire flight and an additional 800 pictures!

review_title: I was a wonderful and breathtaking experience our words don’t fully describe what we saw and felt.
review_text: The pilot was very fun and enjoyable, he made the trip even more exciting and he took us places and we saw things that were just wonderful and words cannot describe.  I believe that all waterfalls is what really captivated us the most and the Hawaiian Grand Canyon.

I was on the island of Oahu, Hawaii when my plans to visit Pearl Harbor fell through.  I didn’t want to waste one day of our two week vacation and so I decided to research how I could visit Kauai for one day. You may think that is a ridiculous idea however, once I found Air Ventures Hawaii and spoke to a representative early Wednesday morning to secure the proper flight times for Thursday I decided to book a flight to Lihue via Southwest.  We arrived at noon and our Air Ventures flight was booked for 1:30pm.  The cost was $337.08 (two passengers) for one hour.  This flight was definitely longer, less expensive, and more beautiful than our helicopter tour that we took a few days prior to this adventure.  Trisha and her assistant greeted us with a warm Aloha and they were extremely professional and helpful.  I am happy that they informed us about paying $30.00 to capture the GoPro footage of our one hour flight.  The footage from the NaPali Coast was unbelievable yet stunning!   It is well worth the money.  
Prior to boarding we were weighed and seated in a nice open air waiting room.  I would suggest that a few hours prior to the flight that you take Dramamine to ensure you will not experience any motion sickness.  I always practiced this so I didn’t have any problems on the flight.  I believe only one passenger was somewhat ill.  I think this is important because the flight is absolutely breathtaking and you simply don’t want to be ill while enjoying such an unimaginable view.  Please be mindful that Air Ventures Hawaii has no control over Mother Nature and sometimes a few bumps might occur throughout the flight.  
Nate was our pilot.  I must admit that this guy was stellar!!!  First, he has the best personality.  He welcomed us aboard as guests, explained all safety precautions, told us exactly what would happen while in flight, and even explained what we would see while on the trip.  In addition, he was a skilled aviator that paid attention to the details of safety and also provided valuable information at the same time.  I am very happy that Air Ventures Hawaii takes passenger safety seriously.  
In addition to being a good aviator the pilot did an excellent job of explaining all the different sights that we saw during the flight.  I must admit that I love seeing the Grand Canyon of the Pacific and the waterfalls however, the NaPali Coast is a sight to behold.  Nate indicated that the NaPali Coast is considered one of the most beautiful coastlines in the world.  I agree with him unequivocally!! My eyes have not seen such natural uninhabited beauty like that since visiting Bora Bora in 2007.  The beauty of the NaPali Coast is the best reason to take this flight.  In addition, if you can only spend a day on the island it will take two hours to reach the NaPali Coast and I believe much of it cannot be reached by foot.  I believe seeing the coastline from the air is unexplainable in words and unimaginable even when you see it.  Bucket list for sure!!!!!
Our day trip to Kauai was stellar because my son and I had an opportunity to see all of the natural beauty of Kauai from the sky.  If you are in search of seeing unexplainable and breathtaking beauty I would suggest Air Ventures Hawaii.  Nate was an exceptional pilot and I feel I received everything that I paid for and more.  Thanks Nate for being a wonderful host and helping my son and I make beautiful memories.  We will forever remember the time we spent over the NaPali Coast because of you!  Mahalo for everything!!!! You represent Air Ventures Hawaii well!!! Keep up the great work!

I loved this ride with Cayden! I got to see all of Kauai in an hour and got to know more about Kauai's history and little secrets. The whole team was so welcoming and gave very clear instructions! I recommend this 100%!

Do not hesitate! The views were spectacular! I am so glad we did this air tour!  Even though I got sick toward the end, I’d do it again! and just not eat prior to the flight.  I got to be “co-pilot” and it was so cool to have that vantage point! 
We saw all the things you can’t see from the ground!
Great experience and amazing way to see the island. Definitely something to knock if the bucket list. Our pilot was so knowledgeable and made sure we got the best experience possible.
We had a family of 6 that went up.  Nate was our pilot.  He made everyone feel safe and comfortable.  He gave as soon much information about the island.  Truly a memorable experience!

review_title: Nervous to amazed and ready to go again!
review_text: My husband and I just did the private air tour with Nate, and it was phenomenal! I cannot overstate how amazing this tour is. Nate makes you feel right at home and is a great tour guide. I was a little nervous beforehand, but Nate and Jill helped calm my nerves and put me at ease. The flight was smooth and steady. I felt very safe the entire time. Hands down our favorite experience on the island thus far! Well worth the money and a great value.

Wonderful tour. I cannot thank our pilot, Caden, enough. He possesses all the qualities of a great tour guide: enthusiastic, engaging and communicative.
His presentation style gave a unique touch to the tour experience and an irreplaceable sense of authenticity!
Most importantly, he has the self confidence, outstanding flying skills and flight experience needed to put anyone at ease.
I would definitely fly with him again.
The views were breathtaking! The pilot explained everything in detail! It was an awesome adventure! Would definitely do it again!

review_title: Amazing experience - must do for kama'aina and tourists alike!
review_text: I took my father who is turning 82 and has lived on Kauai since the early 80s on this tour as he's never seen the Na Pali coast or the island from the air. The team at Air Ventures Hawaii were TOP NOTCH and made us feel like ohana. Jill took care of us on the ground and put my dad in the co-pilot seat and took the time to explain everything to him. Don't let his young looks fool you, our pilot Caden was professional, personable, funny and made the experience amazing. He even took us to fly over our family business in Hanapepe. He was also very accommodating to circle back to see things a second time. I was never worried about safety and felt very safe. I highly recommend ANY kama'aina to go on this tour to see Kauai from a totally new perspective.

review_title: Next level once in a lifetime experience!
review_text:
Epic experience which we will never forget. Efficient and good fin. Caden is an excellent pilot which knows his island. He will tell you all about the islands beautiful nature and use of the lands, but also highlight locations where famous Hollywood movie scenes are shot.

5 out of 5 easily.

The views were incredible. A really different perspective on many popular sites. Pilot Nate wa fantastic. Although he looks really young you can feel he knows what he is doing when  he is in the cockpit. The other where crew where amazing also. Super kind and helpful.
Had an excellent flight with local pilot Makana.  He was very knowledgeable about the island as he grew up there!  We felt safe and saw some awesome sites.  Great trip, highly recommend

I’ve been on helicopter and boat tours before around Hawaii, and this is my first time taking a flying tour on Kauai. I honestly say that this flight was amazing. Our pilot, Caden, was able to warn us about any turbulence and told us some cool stuff about the places we flew over. He was able to give us times to take amazing pictures of the scenery and could crack a good joke every now and then. He made sure to check if we were ok frequently and despite being a younger pilot, there was no obvious lack of experience and he knew what he was doing entirely. Combined with having an awesome pilot, the scenery was beautiful and even though I’ve seen glimpses of some of it and taken tours in those areas, it still felt like I was seeing it for the first time! I recommend this place 100%
The staff was incredible! Super friendly and knew what they were doing. Our pilot Nate was very knowledgeable about the island. We had the BEST time! This was a great way to spend the afternoon.

My husband and I loved our private plane tour with Caden as our pilot! We saw all of the highlights of the island and learned a lot of interesting information about what we were seeing and about the island in general. When we returned, we found that there had been an issue with our GoPro and it didn’t capture much footage. Jill graciously offered to put our GoPro on another flight later that day. We really appreciated that!! Also, the private plane has A/C, which helps reduce motion sickness. Such great people and an incredible experience!

review_title: I’d do it a second time
review_text: Do it.  Just book it and see the island differently than any other perspective.    The staff is excellent and pilots are professional yet fun.

review_title: WOW, what an amazing ride w/ Air Ventures Hawaii
review_text: As first time small airplane flyers, my girlfriend & I were in the best of hands with Caden. He made sure to call out any rough patches of air & was constantly calling out specific places from above to look at. The tour was by far the scariest thing we signed up for while on the island, but was by far the best experience we had & may ever have. Highly recommend this tour to all first time visitors of Kauai.

Caden was a great pilot! Everything went smoothly and on time. The perspective from the air is breathtakingly beautiful. I worried that I should have spent extra money for the helicopter tour but no need, I was totally satisfied! We were very comfortable and I was able to get spectacular photos. I would definitely repeat this experience if I have the opportunity in the future.

review_title: exciting and interesting way to see the island
review_text: This was a very exciting way to see the island - I was lucky to be able to sit in the co-pilot spot which seems to have the best view (but all seats were great I was told by family). You get to see some remarkable things and don't worry about it going too fast - it doesn't. You have plenty of time to study the terrain. Makana was our pilot and was incredibly good at his job, friendly, and fun. I highly recommend this if you need something in the 60-90 minute range.

Makana, our pilot, was great. We had a smooth and enjoyable trip and just sat back and listened to his narrative (not too little, not too much) describing what we were seeing. We have done the doors-off helicopter tours before, so this was a very welcome change of pace. I recommend it heartily. Remember to tip your pilot!

Nate, our pilot, was great!  He took his time showing our 4-person family (plus another couple) the entire island. 

This is an amazing way to see all of Kauai! Very smooth landing and memories to last a lifetime!
We had a very nice journey with our pilot. He told us a lot about the island and showed some very nice spots. Don't forget your camera :)

This was an amazing experience and everyone in the Blue Hawaiian team was absolutely wonderful! We had to reschedule the original booking due to bad weather and they even gave me a ride back to my hotel and hiking tips. Thankfully the second time around the weather was perfect and we got to epxerience every corner of this gorgeous island from above!

review_title: Professionelles Team, toller Flug trotz schlechtem Wetter
review_text:
Wir haben einen wunderbaren Flug über Kauai mit Air Ventures Hawaii gemacht. Das Wetter war auf einem Teil der Insel regnerisch, weshalb sie uns dies genau erklärt haben und uns die Wahl gelassen haben ob wir trotzdem fliegen oder verschieben wollen. Hier wird nicht einfach um jeden Preis geflogen.
Die Tour war dann trotzdem wundervoll, und ich würde diesen Flug jederzeit einem Helikopterflug vorziehen, da es so viel ruhiger und schöner ist. Die Aussichten über die Insel sind wunderschön, und es hat dank den speziellen Fenstern auch viele tolle Fotos gegeben. Zudem gab es viele spannende Hintergrundinfos vom Piloten während des Flugs.
Würde ich ohne Frage jedem empfehlen, Preis / Leistung stimmt!

The trip was excellent, our tour guide Nate was super knowledgeable, pointed out some amazing views and answered all questions we had. We really enjoyed our time and would highly recommend. I would suggest to do the earlier morning trips as clouds tend to show up in the afternoon.

review_title: Great way to see remote parts of Kauai
review_text: Nate did a great job showing us the highlights of Kauai. We got to see many parts of the island only visible by air including many waterfalls and sea caves. I would recommend it!

Booked an aerial tour as a surprise for my daughter and I (she just turned 21) while my husband played golf.  We could not have asked for a more perfect day!   It was absolutely gorgeous!   Our pilot, Nate was terrific.  I was fortunate enough to sit in the co-pilot seat during the trip and got some amazing shots with my wide angle lens.  Those haven’t been downloaded and edited yet though so those I’m sharing are from my daughter’s phone.  Very cool experience.  Highly recommend!  Oh, and Nate’s landing…… perfection!!!

Wir sind mit 6 Personen und dem Piloten Natt über Kauai geflogen. Das Wetter war ausgezeichnet und der Start und die Landung waren super. Es war ein sehr ruhiger Flug. Während des Flugs über die Insel hat Natt alles sehr gut erklärt und konnte alle Fragen beantworten. Wir sind 1995 schon mal mit dem Hubschrauber über die Insel geflogen und ich muss sagen es war dieses Mal genauso spektakulär. Kann man nur weiterempfehlen.
The staff and owners are the kindest and best. The flight itself is great value and the self proclaimed 'best pilot in the world' is awesome, as is his wife.

We had a great pilot in Nate. He built up on the history of the island as that we had been learning this week. He gave us an aerial view of many of the places we had visited or we were going to see later. Very friendly people and great communication. Would highly recommend this tour to anyone.
What a great flight! This is the only way to see the island! Unfortunately we missed seeing Waimea Canyon because of weather but that can’t be helped!
Our pilot Makana was fantastic. Very considerate and shared his love of Kauai. We definitely recommend this tour to see and learn more about the island.

review_title: Great day for an airplane ride!
review_text: The trip was great! Our pilot was very good at showing us everything and explaining everything that we saw. I would recommend.

review_title: Stunning Views of the Garden Isle
review_text: Beautiful views from a perspective we hadn’t seen before. Pilot was great, especially with the weird winds that day. Staff helpful and friendly.

review_title: Air Adventures was AWESOME…1st class operators!
review_text: We had an incredible experience with Ray as our pilot. Knowledgeable of the island and a great story teller.  We had a blast Ray!  Todd&Lori/OK

There is only one word to describe our Air Ventures, Private Tour:  Awesome!   It was truly amazing to see the beauty of the island of Kauai and some of the inaccessible areas from above. From the time we booked our air tour to the time we checked in, to take off and landing, we felt well cared for.  Special thanks to Trish for the communications, our check in, and to Nate, a skilled, professional pilot who provided a great narration during our tour.  Mahalo!

WOW!!!!! Ray was an amazing pilot and very entertaining. This was the highlight of my vacation. I felt safer in a plane than a helicopter and from talking to other travelers we made the right choice. HIGHLY recommend this.

Nate was a great pilot...full of friendliness and information.  He and Ray weren't sure it was a good enough day to fly in terms of views so they let us decide if we wanted to go which we did.  It turned out to be fabulous!  If this was a so-so day then I can't imagine what a good day would be.  The views were spectacular and we have memories to last a life time.  Thank you!

review_title: BEST air tour company on island
review_text: Small business that has your BEST experience in mind. Book with them! You will not be disappointed!!

Jill and Ray took great care of our family.  We appreciate your professionalism and fun environment.  We appreciated them taking pictures with our own phones and emailed us one too that they took.  Thank you again!

review_title: You only have to read my comments
review_text:
To be fair, I want to say upfront that this review focuses not only on the provider but also on Trip Advisor (based on the comments of the owner/vendor that Trip Advisor is horrible to dealt with on his end) . Sadly I did not get to revisit a great experience. I took this tour 10 years ago with my late wife and it was truly wonderful. Please note at that time I weighed in excess of 300 pounds. My late wife 175 pounds. We had no issue at the time because our combined average weight met the vendors parameters. Now to 2022.  I booked this latest tour 20 days before our arrival, entered all of the pertinent information, including body weight,  on the Trip Advisor booking page and paid my $368, expecting to again have a wonderful experience. 25 hours before our appointed excursion I receive an email from the Vendor thru the Trip Advisor platform that they are not able to accommodate us based on my weight being in excess of 300 pounds, the maximum PER SEAT, but if I wanted to buy an additional  seat on the next day....... I stated that my wife weighs 170 so our combined weight of 490 for two seats equated to 245 pounds per seat. Deaf Ears. OK I get it, please refund my booking. "NO, we are not able to refund your booking and it is Trip Advisors fault". OK, You, Air Venture, are the entity denying my booking, yet you cannot refund my money even though YOU are the entity who is refusing to provide the contracted service. "It is Trip Advisor's fault". OK I entered my correct weight on the Trip Advisor site when I  booked. Do YOU not communicate your parameters to Trip Advisor? "It is Trip Advisors fault". OK, Isn't Trip Advisor your Agent, therefore an extension of Air Ventures? "It is Trip Advisors fault". OK, you do realize Air Ventures that I will be leaving a negative review on the said "Trip Advisor" based on this interaction? "DON'T THREATEN ME" and hung up. So, if you decide to book a trip with Air Ventures, I suggest you stay away from Trip Advisor or any other third party booking site as the owner of Air Venture will not work with you if there is an issue, even if it is his fault. 

You will note that this is the only truly negative review I have ever left on Trip Advisor. God Bless Air Ventures. I hope you survive in business with your superb customer service.

review_title: Overall it was a very nice and positive experience for our family. I would highly recommend them.
review_text: From booking to completing our tour it was all great experience.  The staff are very friendly and professional. They ensured we have the best experience touring around the island. They provide you briefing before the flight and items to grab if you start getting sick during the flight. The pilot, Nate, make the conversation engaging.

review_title: Awesome air tour at a great price
review_text: Pilot Ray did a great job showing the beauty of Kauai with many interesting points of narration along the way.  Made extra pass by some more significant sights.  Plane designed for touring, travels about 75 MPH, slower than the helicopters, giving a bit more time to appreciate the sights.  Much less money than the helicopter, and equal to or better than the copters!

The service is excellent. There were only 2 slots available for our group of 4 but Jill made it possible for 4 of us to fly. She picked up the phone at 7.30am. We had magnificent views flying with funny and experienced Ray. Highly recommended

We both had an amazing experience doing this tour. It was the highlight of our honeymoon so far. The views from the plane were like nothing we’ve experienced before. We are both nervous flyers, however, Nate put us at ease and was a brilliant pilot. Would recommend this to everyone who wants to experience the whole of Kauai

review_title: Perfect way to see all KAUAI
review_text: Captivating views of multiple waterfalls and mountains of the Napali Coast.  Very thoughtful tour optimized viewing for all and of all Kauai's scenic spots. Very smooth ride! Owners Ray and Jill's approach will put the most reluctant passenger at ease.  The perfect way to see Kauia.
They camcelled 4 days before the flight was to happen. The other companies were already booked. Very disappointed!  😥

review_title: One of Best things to do on Kauai
review_text: Seeing the Na Pali coastline,  the canyons, waterfalls and beautiful full intense colored rainbow. Wear dark clothing and put smartphone almost against glass to get no glare. Ray, our pilot was fantastic and flew plane for best views. Jill sends perfect directions to terminal. Go! It's worth every penny.

We recently returned from our long awaited Hawaiian cruise, visiting 4 of the islands. 
While on Kauai, we did a plane tour with Air Ventures Hawaii.  What an AWESOME experience. You can't see most of this island except by air.  The colors of the water and the Napoli coast were absolutely breaktaking! 

Everyone at Air Ventures was extremely friendly and helpful.  Our pilot, Nate, was great and I was lucky enough to be his co-pilot during our flight.
I would highly recommend taking the plane tour with Air Ventures.  It was truly spectacular!  Definitely the highlight of our trip!
Unbelievable experience! I recommend to see Kauai from the sky and even more to do it with Rai. Amazing staff, very helpful and kind. I'd repeat if I come again!
The staff is amazing, friendly and super professional! They made us feel comfortable and welcome! Great experience and price!

review_title: The best way to see the entire island!!
review_text: Breathtaking trip around the island with the best views from the air, the only was to really see it! Our pilot Nate went the extra mile and took us by Wailua falls at the end of the flight. He was awesome. This made our vacation complete.

Our pilot was Nate. He was very informative, pointing out things to look at and providing lots of information and historical facts. I was concerned that my daughter who was seated on the left (ocean side) wouldn’t be able to see but Nate made sure that he circled all the points of interest so that everyone could get a good view from their seats. Most unlikely for me but I started to feel sick 20 mins into the flight. Cold bottles of water were provided along with individually packed wet cloths to put on your neck, this helped me a lot. The Napali coast scenery was amazing. We got to see everything of the Island including the condo we were staying at in Poipu! Upon landing Jill got us ginger ale to drink, which also helped me feel normal again. She and Nate were so kind, we felt well looked after in their capable hands. My husband and children loved the flight. A really great experience to get to see all of Kauai.

Jill and Ray are super friendly and awesome!! You can feel the warmth since it's their own business and not a corporate. I booked online for April 16 but it turned out to be a rainy day and our tour got cancelled. Spoke with Jill directly and she scheduled us for April 19 - turned out to be a beautiful day for air tour. The charm of seeing Kaua'i's beauty from air is unbeatable. We flew over hundreds of rainfalls, beautiful south, west and north coastline, Na'Pali coast, Waimea Canyons, Jurrasic Falls, Wailua Falls and so much more. Every penny was totally worth it and way cheaper than a Helicopter ride!

Word of caution: Do not eat at least for a couple of hours before flying. Daughter and I got motion sickness. Upon return, Jill was super sweet to make us comfortable - gave us ginger ale and that helped a lot!  Thank you Jill, you are the best!!
Ray & Jill were awesome. Highly recommend! We had a blast. Excellent view of the island.  Very knowledgeable. Thanks! Gregg and Debbie

Wonderful experience (with the company and the flight)!  I called during a very busy week looking for a flight when everything on the island was booked out and these lovely folks managed to make it happen (thanks Jill!)!  Our pilot Nate was terrific, he told us all about what we were seeing as we soared through the air over the incredible landscape.  Price was right too! I strongly recommend this tour/company!

review_title: Spectacular (and informative!) air tour over Kauai
review_text: What a cool experience! Ray and his wife were very welcoming, organized and attentive during the check-in process, and made sure everyone felt safe and informed before we took off (and made sure we left on schedule). The air tour itself was spectacular - we got lucky and went on a beautiful day with limited clouds, so had amazing views of the entire island. We started by flying over the south side of the island, into Waimea Canyon, then the Napali Coast, followed by a little bit of the North Shore and ended with flying over Wailua Falls. Ray was an expert pilot and shared his knowledge of the island’s history with us throughout the journey. 10/10 experience - I’d recommend this tour to anyone!

From our check in with Jill to the air tour with our pilot, Nate, this was a memorable adventure. Nate's commentary was very informative, the views were awesome, and the ride was smooth. This was the best part of our Kauai island journey. Such a beautiful island to experience and can only truly be appreciated from the air with Air Ventures.
Absolutely fabulous!!  10 stars. Exceeded our expectations!  If you are unsure, just book it. I promise you will love it!

review_title: This airplane tour is an absolute MUST!
review_text: My husband and I were in Kauai for our honeymoon and we were on the fence about doing an aerial tour.  We opted for the airplane tour with Air Ventures over a helicopter because it was less expensive and we also felt like it was safer.  To be honest I was a little concerned we wouldn’t be able to get close enough for good views of the canyons etc because helicopters can fly lower but I was 100% wrong!  We opted for the private tour which was really nice.  The air conditioned plane was very comfortable and we didn’t have to worry about other peoples’ kids bothering us.  As it turned out, our pilot was retired from the same major airline I have been working for as a flight attendant for the last 10 years.  Needless to say I felt very safe in his hands knowing how much experience he had.  We had a 1pm tour after a night/morning of heavy rainfall and I am not exaggerating when I say we saw at least 100 waterfalls.  The views were amazing and the entire experience was even better than we’d hoped for.  There is so much of the island that you can only see by air so don’t skip this experience!  It was truly the highlight of our trip.
This was an excellent tour with a FANTASTIC pilot and tour guide!  We have done a helicopter ride and also this flight.  Both are very different experiences!

Ah - maze - ING!  If you are even beginning to think about this trip - book it.  It will be everything you wish it to be.  Jill and Ray were so welcoming, so entertaining and you can tell they really enjoy their job and their island.  The trip was so informative and the views are breath taking.  Everyone felt very safe and they though of everything to make us all comfortable.

We had a fabulous flight with Nate on the Private Luxury Air Tour.  Nate showed us everything and even circled around when he spotted whales near the shore for us to get a good look.  It was a very special day and we truly appreciated Jill picking us up and driving us back to the ABC store near the port.  We had a wonderful time, I just wish my photos did it justice!
Absolutely amazing..... Money well spent. This was an incredible experience flying through the clouds, seeing many waterfalls and the coastline. This is a must do activity while you're on the island.
Ray and Jill were super welcoming and Ray was an awesome pilot; we had a blast.  Highly recommend for families; we wouldn't hesitate to go again.  Our 9 and 7 year old had a blast.

review_title: Best thing we have ever done! Amazing!!!
review_text: My husband and I wanted to do an air tour to be able to see the entire island of Kauai. It was the best decision we made for our honeymoon, also the best thing we have ever done! We arrived and Jill greeted us and checked us in.  Her husband Ray was our amazing pilot!  Ray showed us countless points of interest and is full of facts about the island. He gave us a beautiful flight and tour!  He made sure everyone felt comfortable and could see everything he was pointing out. When we left the tour we headed straight to a hiking spot and coffee shop he recommended! They were both wonderful! We learned about so many hikes and beaches we didnt know of before. Go visit Ray and Jill! We will absolutely be back to take another flight with them!!!

review_title: Excellent experience to watch The beautiful Kauai Island from above!!
review_text:
Excellent experience of watching the Napali Coastline from above!!

Pilot Ray was excellent in providing the information along with showing the island.
Excellent service provided by Ray and Jill !
Napali coast is beautiful to watch.

Tip for photography: The seats just behind the pilot, has the wings which obstructs the view for photos. Right side was facing the coast and the mountain and left side I could see Ocean and little bit of coast line. So for photographs make sure you are sitting on the right side but not just behind the pilot.
I would recommend Ray to make a run of Napali coast, keeping the right side facing it, and then turn back and make a run facing the left side facing the coast and mountains so that everyone sitting on the left side (behind Pilot) also get a chance to see and take photos of the coast line.
Otherwise we enjoyed the beautiful scenery of Kauai Island!!

We had a most beautiful flight with Nate . We were able to see the entire island from the sky. The weather cooperated and we had perfect views of many waterfalls,the canyon ,and the best sunny view of the Napali Coast one could have!Nate took us to the very top of the island and was able to fly into the actual crater that formed Kauia.We would HIGHLY suggest this plane tour to everyone !  Thanks to Jill for working with us and to Nate for his very enjoyable trip!  Definitely the highlight of our visit!  The OHIO group .
It’s a family run operation. And the excellent service reflects that. They treated me like an old friend.

My husband and I took the air tour during the spring break. The Napali coast is amazing, layer by layer. The weather is good but little wind. By the end of tour, I got motion sick. The lady in the front desk got cold towel and Jinger ale for me to come down my stomach. I real appreciate it. Hogh recommend this tour.

This was our favorite experience between our time on Kauai and Maui. The booking process was easy, pilot was friendly and informative, experience was safe and smooth, and the views were astounding. There's no better way to see Kauai
What can I say except great things. Ray, Jill, and Nate were an absolute delight to be around. The tour itself was breath taking and it was the best part of our entire trip. Highly recommend!
Great experience with Nate taking us around the island. Would definitely do again! Nate was entertaining and took us to see awesome sights

review_title: Best part of our entire vacation!
review_text: Best part of our entire trip! We haven't stopped talking about it since. Ray and Jill were amazing. The plane trip was so smooth. Kauai is STUNNING and its such a treat to see it from above. If you are going to only do 1 activity while in Kauai, do this one.

My wife is a nervous flyer, but before we loaded, they explained where the flight would be bumpy.  They actively engaged our kids (11& 13).  Such a great experience.   My entire family wants to do this again.   That's a win in any trip.  I've already recommended this to another friend, and absolutely would do this again in a first visit.

review_title: Incredible views. Awesome service. Would do again in a heart beat.
review_text:
My son and I did the nepali coast air tour in early March 2022. Joe was our pilot and there were 2 or 3 additional people that assisted in our check-in and check-out.

The staff was super friendly and professional and Joe was all of that and extremely knowledgeable to boot. He would answer our questions and give us a local perspective on things. The weather conditions were absolutely perfect, but even if we were socked in with fog (limiting the visibility), I still would've given him a top score. He did his best to make it a wonderful experience for all involved (there were 6 of us in addition to the pilot).

WOW!!! What a fun experience. We got to see the whole island. Our pilot, Nate, was a great tour guide. Nice smooth ride. We got to see up close the Jurassic Falls. Nate took the time to turn around at one point so we could watch a whale breaching and wagging tail. I would definitely recommend this tour. Hubby and I have done both helicopter tour and this one. If you want a relaxed tour of this beautiful island BOOK YOUR TOUR HERE!!!

review_title: Birds eye view of the unlimited beauty of kauai
review_text: We were able to see amazing scenery from above the entire island. Jill greated us and handed us over to Nate. He was awesome and informative with fun facts,history and serene beauty

Ray was THE BEST pilot ever! Knowledgeable and reassuring to those afraid to fly. Also, the tour was absolutely AMAZING. Best combination anyone could ask for in seeing Kauai!!! Ask Ray about seeing the "low rent housing" too!
Michael & Lynn Summers
Great tour.  Nice plane allowed great pictures.  Pilot was very informative as well.  The bes views of the island.  Highly recommend.

We had a wonderful experience right from Jill greetings us and Ray navigating us they the air. They are a wonderful couple and would definable chose to go with them again. 
During our your we rain I to some rain so Ray just detoured around it and found other sights to see. I’m

review_title: DONT LOOK ANYWHERE ELSE, THIS IS THE BEST AERIAL TOUR YOU CAN HAVE IN KAUAI !
review_text: Ray and Jill are the best tour guides/ pilot you can have. Thank you so much Ray and Jill and the rest of your people who made our tour an unforgettable one. Ray, our pilot is the best ! He  did the smoothest landing of a plane ever and  also got out of our normal flight path just to let us witness the whale breaching ! That was a very pleasant surprise !

Our plane tour with Ray was the highlight of our Hawaii trip. We booked it as a birthday surprise for my son who wants to be a pilot and Ray went above and beyond to make it a truly inspirational experience. Ray is not only a great pilot but an incredible tour guide who is passionate about sharing his love of flying and knowledge of the landscape and environment of Kauai. Jill and Trisha also went out of their way to make the experience really special for all of us. If you are thinking about booking an air tour, Air Ventures Hawaii will wow you.

We had a great experience with Air Ventures, it was such a fantastic and affordable way to see the beauty of Kauai.  All of the staff were personable and helpful.  Our pilot, Nate, was concientious, safe, and told us a lot about Kauai as we toured the island.  Every aspect of the flight was smooth and we just can't say enough good things about the experience.

Wow! What a great experience. Ray was our pilot, and you could tell he loves what he does. He loves this island and he knows all the details of the land formations and is excited to take you each breathtaking view. From the moment you walk in until your tour is over Ray and Jill are thrilled to make this memorable.

This is an absolute MUST do!!! Jill & Ray are the most wonderful hosts along with their team. Ray is a retired airline pilot, with decades of flight experience and has been living in Kauai for over 20 years flying folks around. He knows the area like the back of his hand and gave us a true bucket-list, one of a kind experience! I would recommend this to anyone!

If anyone looking to do this excursion is afraid of motion sickness in a smaller aircraft, I’d recommend taking something like dramamine before hand, it will certainly help, but don’t let that be what stops you. It is a once in a lifetime experience!

Captain Ray is a retired 747 captain from United, so I felt really safe. He is very knowledgeable about the landscape and you will learn a lot about Kauai.  I would think the afternoon flight will be better, as the sun will not get into the shots when the plane is on the west side of the island ( we took the morning flight).
Arrive early to get a parking space.

review_title: Perfect tour - the best part of our vacation!
review_text:
Absolutely the best activity while visiting Kauai! 

Our pilot was Nate and the person at the counter was Trish - the were both fantastic! 

My husband and I are pilots and my husband was able to sit left seat (not flying) while we were on the tour which he absolutely loved!

The weather was perfect on the day of our tour so we saw amazing sites including the walls of the extinct volcano.

Nate was VERY knowledgeable, friendly and professional. He made the tour very enjoyable! Many thanks to Nate and Trish for a wonderful experience!

review_title: Well worth it! Just go already!
review_text: Nick our pilot was very knowledgeable and made us all feel safe.  The trip was well worth it, this is highly recommended!  You see almost the whole island.

This owner/pilot Ray  is dangerous.  He told all passengers to remove their masks.  My patient is hard of hearing and immune suppressed.   I explained why we needed every one to wear masks and the pilot still instructed everyone to remove masks "because you can not hear with the microphone with masks on"  I spoke to my hearing impaired patient with a mask on and she stated she could hear just fine.  Regardless, all other passengers followed the instructions of the pilot and removed their masks.  Landing was done without instruction to fasted seat belts.  Some were not buckled in.  Pilot's wife Jill stated that masks do not prevent Coved.  I would not recommend any air tours with any company without checking about masking prior to reservations.   I have reported Airventures to multiple governmental agencies and will continue to do so to try to protect others from this awful experience.

Great experience. One of my all time favorite travel adventures. What a way to see Kauai. So informative and fun. Our Pilate Ray was great and he and his wife Jill are so personable. Highly highly. recommend

review_title: Amazing Tour for a Great Price
review_text: Our pilot, Nate, was very personable and provided an informative, thorough, and fun tour of the entire island.  He passed scenic landmarks in both directions so all passengers had a great view.  Absolutely beautiful.  I am a pilot myself, and I felt very safe after talking to Jill (owner) and while flying with Nate.  This is a top notch operation.  Price can't be beat.  Highly recommended.

Ray and his wife were wonderful to work with. They’re a sweet couple and Ray had the best attitude- especially if you have a fear of heights! The views were incredible, and Ray took his time to explain and show everything possible. He even went out of his way to try to get closer to a whale we spotted! 100 percent recommend.

review_title: Amazing from start to finish!  Best way to see All of Kauai.
review_text: Amazing from start to finish.  Our cruise line tour was cancelled and I'm so happy now since we did the Big Kahuna air tour instead.  The tour was easy to book and cost half as much as the cruise ship tour would've been.  We had excellent communication via email.  Air Ventures sent someone to pick us up at the shopping center that was an easy walk from the cruise ship.  He was super friendly... wish I could remember his name.  This worked great after our tour as well since he brought us back to the shopping center when we were done.  Jill greeted us with a smile at the airport and told us we had the best pilot on the island for our tour, her husband Ray.  She was correct that he is a Ray of sunshine.  So warm and knowledgeable about flying and the island we were flying over.  We were blessed with sunny skies for our tour, and I can't imagine there is a better way to see Kauai.  The plane holds 6 passengers and is a bit tight and the ride is a bit bumpy, but they do everything they can to ensure everyone has a good experience.  You can tell Ray loves to fly and loves the island.  We took pictures by the plane, and they emailed them to us free.   A super nice touch!  Truly hope to fly with Air Ventures again some day.  Mahalo

Our kids loved the entire experience.  (Ages 5, 9, and 13). From booking to getting on the plane the experience was easy and fun. 

Nate was an amazing pilot! So knowledgeable and skilled. I have a sensitive stomach. His flying was smooth so I enjoyed the entire thing and it was much smoother than expected. 

If you can do this early on your trip it helps you get ideas where to go next. 

These guys are experts. Don’t think about it, just go!

review_title: Kind and Knowledgeable Pilot; Beautiful Views; Do Not Miss
review_text: We thoroughly enjoyed our flight with Ray.  His wonderful wife Jill was very helpful before our flight, and kindly took several pictures.  Trish helped us to find a time that we could go, as our schedule was a bit tight.  There were 6 of us in total, and we each had our own spot and large window to take in the views.  Thanks so much for a wonderful afternoon!

The plane travels slowly so you have plenty of time to see everything. And I mean everything.  There is so much to see in Kauai and you get close up views that are breath taking.  It is safe as our trip was with a seasoned retired pilot who formerly flew 747’s for American Airlines.  Fun and informative!  Amazing value!!

Ray, our pilot, clearly loves his work. He gave us extra time....about 90 mins. Very knowledgeable with a great sense of humor. Well worth the cost. Kuaui is gorgeous from the air. Very enjoyable trip with a real Veteran. Thank you for your service, Ray, and a really nice morning trip!
