Outstanding. Exceeded my expectations. Personable, friendly, a blast overall. A great time and well worth the money!

review_title: A Once in a Lifetime Experience
review_text: We did this yesterday and we absolutely adored it . They took photos for us at the plane with. Nate our pilot which I liked. Nate was v welcoming and excellent at pointing out the places we were . He was a very good pilot and we felt safe in the plane . The scenery is out of this world . It’s a great way to see Kauai as the stunning Napali coast is not accessible by road .  We drove to lookouts for Napali coast and Waimea Canyon but nothing comes close to the views from this plane . This tour is a must do when in Kauai . We thought it was very good value for money too.

This was one of the most outstanding activities we’ve done! We had done a helicopter tour years ago and the plane ride far exceeded that experience. The plane ride being slower, gives more time to take in the beauty of the landscape. Ray, our pilot, customized the experience. We not only saw the whole island but caught a couple of whale flukes. He shared great commentary about everything we viewed. I would be remiss if I didn’t mention Jill, the woman behind the scenes, who not only handles reservations but does pre-flight prep and is extremely welcoming & gracious. Can’t say enough about the experience & the owners of this company.

This was a very cool way to see Kauai from the air.  Nate, our pilot, was very cool and knowledgeable.  No matter what side of the plane you sit on, you will get to see and take pictures of everything.  We strapped our GoPro ($30 fee) to the wing and got some additional epic videos and photos of the island.

Nate is a a great pilot and we barely knew we were flying.  The takeoff and landing was super smooth.  When in the air, the ride was smooth and refreshing.  This tour was very cost effective and we would do it again!

The views of Kauai from the air are absolutely breathtaking. This hour tour of the entire island was worth every penny. I highly recommend this tour for anyone. You will be able to truly appreciate and soak up all the beauty of the island.

Chartered a private flight to see Kauai from the top-view. It was one of the best experience in my life. Ray, our pilot is really nice and skillful. I’ll definitely do it again if I revisit the island.

There is so much of the beautiful island of Kaua’i that is inaccessible by road. So, you either have to take a boat trip or an airplane (or helicopter) ride.
The boat trip will reveal all the majestic beauty of the Na Pali Coast, but from the air you can see not only the craggy west coast, but also the beauty of the interior…the lush land, the waterfalls and Waimea Canyon (The Grand Canyon of the Pacific and so much more.
Air ventures is a great way to do this activity. The plane ride is much more keenly priced than the helicopters, and I venture (no pun intended) to suggest just as good.
On my trip, Pilot Nate was full of explanations of the history, the land and details of the rock formations. He skilfully guided over the many lovely waterfalls and after sn hour brought his charges safely back to Lihue.
I strongly recommend AirVentures to anyone eager to see and learn about Kaua’i.
Really excellent staff and experience.  Try to go early on in your trip in case the weather is bad.  Great way to get oriented to the island.

review_title: WOW!  An awesome way to see the whole island!
review_text: WOW!  Just stunning.  Felt completely safe in the hands of our pilot and got a truly stunning view of the island.  The staff on the ground too were super thoughtful and helpful, offering our daughter all kinds of nausea remedies upon landing.  Even though the weather wasn't totally perfect the day we flew, it was still a memorable and magical experience!  THANK YOU!!

It was an amazing, once-in-a-lifetime experience for me and my partner and we were so glad we chose to go with a plane instead of the helicopter tour. We were able to see all of the island on a cloudless day and the 1 hour spent in the air was just enough to go all the way around. Great pilot, very knowledgeable about the island and the ride was very smooth. If you are afraid of heights or prone to nausea, take a dramamine (gravol) tablet, but I was fine without it!

We loved the customer service. The pilot was very knowledgeable about Kauai . The flight was smooth and views we’re amazing. If you want to see Kauai from the air this is the company to take you up . I’d do it again .

review_title: We loved this round Kauai air tour!!
review_text: Exceptional all island air tour with a view from every seat, although the best views on this clockwise tour were on the right. Our pilot Nate was awesome and apart from flying the plane, he was a really great guide to what we could see over Kauai. Really enjoyed our experience with Air Ventures from checkin to take off, landing and goodbyes! Such a nice friendly and welcoming company. Would definitely do the same tour again. Highly recommended!

review_title: Wow, truly amazing and Ray is the best pilot on earth :)!
review_text: Wow, it was the best experience on Kauai! We had a private flight with Ray, and it was awesome and Ray is really the best pilot on earth ;)! We will definitely come back :) thanks for the amazing memory and see you again! Luca & Laura

This was definitely a highlight of our Kauai trip. It was excellent even on a rainy day. The views are simply spectacular! Ray & Jill are delightful. We loved supporting q local, small businesses on the island.

review_title: Absolutely gorgeous aerial views of Kauai
review_text: Absolutely fantastic experience from the start with Jill on phone to check in to onboarding and flying with the awesome pilot Nate. Our family of 3 enjoyed the amazing aerial views of Kauai. Pilot Nate was warm, friendly and gave a great tour of the island. Loved the experience! Great value for money and time well spent.

review_title: TAKE THIS TRIP DAY 1 OF YOUR VACATION
review_text:
Take this tour the first day you're on the island! Such a great tour and you can get an idea of all the places to visit. The pilot Nate is fantastic and really knows so much about the island. I get motion sick pretty easily and I managed this flight pretty well. 

Highly recommend!
Great people + great tour = Awesome Experience! Without a doubt the best experience on the island. We will be back :)

The pilot Nate was a superb flyer. He provided a beautiful tour of the island. It is the only way to really see Kaua'i. National Geographic was correct - it has the most beautiful coastline in the world. Mahalo to Air Ventures and to Nate!

review_title: Great tour to start your vacation
review_text:
By far the best air tour on the island. Me and my wife booked the tour in the first few days of our trip to Kauai to understand how should we plan our trip and we were not disappointed. 
The staff was very welcoming and the pilot did a great job of pointing out various beaches, valleys, waterfalls on the island. 
10/10 would definitely recommend.

What an amazing adventure. This company is top notch. The owner greats you warmly as you check in and makes you feel special from the moment you arrive. The pilot continues this and gives a fabulous tour of Kauai explaining everything along the way. He was even able to fly us through a volcano. The plane was clean and sanitized and all employees are fully vaccinated. I cannot recommend this enough. Splurge, it is so worth it.

Fantastic tour. Jill and Nate (the pilot) are very warm and friendly people. Nate is very knowledgable about the island and was a great guide. Got to witness some breathtaking aerial views of the island. Highly recommend flying with them.

The entire trip was just awesome. Air ventures are real friendly, and they are very warm, and make you feel comfortable. Our captain Nate was just amazing, it was an hour long trip, and we just kept talking, and he was very knowledgeable in explaining the various places. The Napali view was just beautiful, and weather was perfect when we flew. Jill was great with our Kids. She made sure that my little one had a good headset to cancel the noise out when we are flying. Please do not miss flying with Air ventures.

review_title: AMAZING, AWESOME, WONDERFUL, and UNFORGETTABLE EXPERIENCE!!!!!
review_text: AMAZING, AWESOME, WONDERFUL, and UNFORGETTABLE experience! Our large family of 9 had the Cesna 182 and the Airvan 8 aircraft. The booking was terrific with a very nice young lady.  The confirmation with Jill was great! Our pilots Ray and Nate, and they both made the experience a highlight of our vacation to Kauai! Ray and Jill, the owners, are two veterans of the airline industry when it was all about passenger service and comfort and it carries over to their business model. I had flown on helicopters on Kauai in the past and this was by far a way better value! The staff at this company instantly becomes your friend as they pull out all of the stops to make sure you have an amazing time both on the ground and in the air. Most of all, they are kind and personal.  Thank you to everyone for an outstanding expericence! We will definately see you again on our next trip to Kauai!!  Jill, many thanks for your kindness and help in making the end of our trip so wonderful, you are the BEST!!!

Most excellent! Owners, Jill & Ray, treated us like family. Pilot, Nate, was so pleasant. Nice, smooth ride. Allowed for great pictures and gave narrative. Excellent way to see this beautiful Island! Would definitely do, again.

We had a great scenic flight with AirVentures. As soon as we arrived, we were welcomed with a big smile as we ‘checked in’, and shortly after Jill gave us some info on what to expect. Then we met our pilot, Captain Ray, who is a very nice guy with loads of experience and just great fun to be around. A short safety demo and some pics later, we were on our way. We had perfect weather and had great views of the Na Pali coastline, the ‘Jurassic Park’ waterfall, Waimea Canyon and Tunnels Beach, just to name a few. It was simply stunning and a great experience. Ray was very informative, knew a lot about the island, it’s history and what we were looking at and made sure we were in the best spot to take photo’s. A great landing completed the trip and we couldn’t be happier with this activity. I would definitely recommend this flight and if you’re lucky enough to fly with Ray, you’ll enjoy it even more. Thank you Team AirVentures for making our visit to Kauai even better!

Book this tour now!!! We worked with Jill to book because we didn’t know if it would be a good idea for our 5 year old daughter (it was). Then we arrived and met Ray who is a Veteran and highly experienced former airline pilot who has flown all over the world. The plane is way more modern and comfortable than any small plane I’ve been on - and air conditioned.  I felt totally comfortable with my family with Ray piloting this aircraft.

The tour itself was fantastic. Great views of the coastal areas and then inland to the canyons. I was impressed how close you can get on a plane. If we missed something or wanted to see it again, Ray turned around and we saw it. He was also very knowledgeable about the island’s geography and history.

I highly recommend this tour for children and families.

Thanks Jill and Ray!

Vielleicht ist es wichtig zu sagen, dass viele der atemberaubenden Landschaften auf Kauai lediglich per Boot oder gar nicht zugänglich sind. Das erklärt, warum Kauai so paradiesisch ist… Denn hier kann die Natur in freien Bahnen wachsen und gedeihen. 

Da ich (fast) alleine reiste und beim besten Willen nicht alles zu Fuß oder Auto hätte sehen können, entschied ich mich für diese Tour.

Allen Liebhaber außergewöhnlicher Landschaften und der Natur insgesamt kann ich diesen Flug nur empfehlen. Hier ein paar Punkte, die mir wichtig waren und erfüllt bzw. übertroffen wurden:

TOUR: In der Tat handelt es sich um eine KOMPLETTE Tour. Wir umrundeten die Insel und haben alles gesehen, was in jedem Reiseführer empfohlen wird (wahrscheinlich) auch noch mehr.

FÜR ALLE: da ich allein war, durfte ich mich auf Nachfrage einfach neben den Piloten hinsetzen. Was natürlich mega war. Besonders charmant fand ich, dass der Pilot immer gedreht hat, damit nicht nur die Passagieren an der rechten sondern auch an der linken Seite alles sehen konnten.
Das habe ich selten bei vorherigen Rundflügen erlebt.

SICHERHEIT: Von der Buchung bis zur Durchführung hatte ich stets den Eindruck, dass das gesamte Personal an alles gedacht hat. Die Machine war sauber und flog problemlos, der Pilot hatte neben den üblichen Elementen auch ein iPad am Board und ging damit und mit dem Flugzeit selbstverständlich um.
Bevor wir einstiegen wurde unseren Impf/Teststatus erneut geprüft.

PILOT: Unser Pilot Nate ist extrem erfahren, ortskundig und sehr professionell. Die Kombi hat es möglich gemacht, dass er neben der kurzen und verständlichen Erklärungen auch Zeit für Witze gefunden hat.

PREIS-LEISTUNGSVERHÄLTNIS: Einfach Top. Wer schon mal in Deutschland einen Rundflug gemacht hat, weißt, dass 30-45 Minuten schon mal 170€ kosten können.
Für 130€ haben wir die ganze Insel gesehen, super Erklärungen und Insights bekommen, waren über 70 Minuten in der Luft und hatten eine butterweiche Landung. Mehr geht echt nicht. 

Die Krönung für mich war, dass ich danach gefragt habe, ob Jill (die super nette Amerikanerin an der Rezeption für mich ein Taxi rufen konnte). Nach ein paar Minuten kam Jill mit Ray (einem anderen Piloten), der mich gefragt hat, ob er mich zum Hotel fahren dürfte, da er 3 Stunden bis zur nächsten Tour frei hat. Ist das nicht traumhaft??? :)
Ray war über 40 Jahre Pilot bei einer amerikanischen Airline und setzte sich mit seiner Frau vor 20 Jahren hier ab. Es war super nett, bei ihm mitfahren zu dürfen und so viele coole Geschichten zu hören!

Es war tatsächlich der schönste Rundflug, den ich in meinem Leben gemacht habe.

Und für diesen Paradies würde ich die Tour als ein MUSS empfehlen.

Most awesome experience. Our honeymoon and I got to sit up front with the pilot. Our pilot Nate was amazing and the entire trip just beautiful. Highly recommend people do this tour. Totally worth it!!!

review_title: Best Highlight of My Kauai Trip
review_text:
This was the best highlight of my trip, and there were several highlights in Kauai overall. So that's saying something! Seeing all the beauty from above - the ocean, waterfalls, landscapes - is something I will cherish forever. Got some great photos too. The pilot was very friendly and nice, keeping us entertained with some great facts about the island and each part we flew over. He had some jokes too. Highly recommend doing this. Please don't leave the island without it!!!

Tip: should go without saying, but probably best to not eat directly before this flight. There was a little turbulence, which you feel more on this smaller plane than the big plane that got you to the island. It didn't bother me as it only happened a few times, but just an FYI. Also, maybe not best if you have motion sickness.
My friend and I did the Entire Kauai Island Air tour with Ray and had the best time. Highly recommend this tour to anyone looking to get a view of the island from the sky! Ray and Jill are the best!

review_title: Best way to see the island!
review_text: Prior to my recent plane tour around Kauai, I had done both helicopter tours on Kauai and the Big Island and a plane tour on the Big Island.  This was one of the best! Our pilot Nate was fun, personable, and knowledgeable.  The weather was perfect and our views were amazing! It was a great first experience for our kids! I highly recommend Air Ventures!

My husband and I spent our entire honeymoon on Kauai and we were overwhelmed by how much there was to do! This tour was perfect because we were able to see EVERYTHING from the skies above. The crew was also SO FRIENDLY:) They had great suggestions on land too!

I was really unsure if a plane or helicopter was the better way to tour the island. I can't speak to a helicopter but this was an amazing experience! Ray was a fabulous pilot and guide to the beautiful island of Kauai! 100% recommend!
No favourite part - the whole trip was fascinating.  Ray's knowledge of the island and it's weather (he avoided the rain) is quite amazing.  Check in was a breeze!

review_title: Enjoying the Majesty and Beauty of The Island of Kauai
review_text:
This is my second time taking the Island Air Tour; this time we brought friends with us.  To say that we had a memorable experience is an understatement.  The scenery from the air was breathtaking; everything from the Poipu Coast, Waimea Canyon, the amazing waterfalls, Hanalei Bay and the Islands beauty.  My favorite remains the Napali Coastline in all it's magnificent splendor; it truly is Bali Hai.

Ten years ago we flew with Ray Smith, a 34 year veteran flying Jumbo Jets for United Airlines.  Since then, Ray bought the company and still loves sharing this beautiful Island with all his guest.  Our pilot today was Nate who was not only friendly but very knowledgeable in sharing with us so much about Kauai that we had never heard on any other tour during our several visits to Kauai.  Nate also was  more than willing to fly back over parts of the Island that we wanted to see up close again.  Even though this is the middle of November with unpredictable weather we had beautiful sunshine and even the highest point on Kauai was fully visible.

The plane itself is unique, built in Australia to use by Bush pilots, the aircraft is steady and able to cruise much slower than the Helicopters that you can tour with on the Island.  The interior of the aircraft was comfortable even for me who is 6'1" and 230 lbs.  In fact I got to sit in the Co-Pilots seat!  Each seat however has a bubble window which gives excellent visibility and is perfect for your camera or I phone for picture taking.  Every guest has a headphone which keeps you in contact with the pilot and all the other guest.  The headphones also filter out excess engine noise which enables everyone to carry on a pleasant conversation and to ask any question they wish about the Island.

 Ray and his wife are truly customer oriented in answering questions and making this a great experience from beginning to end.  

We love coming to Kauai to go swimming on the amazing beaches; riding bicycles; go on Snorkeling and Dinner Cruises; tubing in the sugar cane canals; and of course the Luaus.  All of these are fun and have produced lasting memories with our children and now our grandchildren.  Having done all of this over the years I can honestly say, If there is only 1 tour that you must take on Kauai, Air Adventures is that tour.

review_title: Great unique experience only on Kauai
review_text: A much better experience than I expected. Nate ensured we had a safe comfortable flight despite my history of motion sickness on small plans. He narrated a tour that provided such detail, answered all of our questions, and even took requests. Will be recommending this tour to everyone I know who comes to Kauai!

Air Ventures provided a FANTASTIC tour.  We were extremely lucky that is was a clear day.  Nate (our pilot) did a fantastic job of banking the plane and making multiple passes so that we all got the beautiful views of the island.  I highly recommend this company!

Had a wonderful experience. Both the ground staff and pilot were very respectful and friendly. Can't beat the price either. The tour was about 1 hr and 15 min of airtime around every major part of the island. Learned a lot and saw pretty much everything you could want to see.

Nate was my pilot and he did an awesome job!
Wonderful trip. My pictures were great and the pilot and his wife were so gracious. I would do the trip again. Excellent!

The Air Ventures team was outstanding! I worked with Trish during the booking process - she made everything easy and handled all of my questions quickly & completely.  Even with a foot in a boot, Jill was friendly and efficient with a fast check in! Ray was an absolute Rock Star pilot - personable, knowledgeable & customer focused. It exceeded my expectations in every way & I highly recommend this tour - I see this as a must do to truly experience Kauai!!

We had a great flight with Eric covering the entire island of Kauai. He provided a wide variety of interesting information from the geology and formation of the island to movie filming locations.  We felt very safe and had a wonderful adventure.

Nate was not only a great pilot but also a very knowledgeable tour guide. The whole crew was very accomodating and nice. It was almost like a private tour because there were only a few people in the plane. My husband and I had a great experience.

Had a blast with Ray and the day was crystal clear so the views were spectacular. Would definitely recommend this tour.  We will absolutely never forget this experience. 

Ray was informative, funny, and professional all at the same time.  Being from Colorado it was such a neat coincidence that Ray and Jill were also long-time residents before moving to Kauai. 

Can’t give this one enough stars.

Flying over the Na Pali Coast and seeing hundreds of waterfalls and pristine beaches.
Ray was the perfect pilot and guide. We learned so much about the island and had great fun hearing it. He and his wife Jill run a wonderful tour that shouldn’t be missed!

review_title: One of the coolest experiences ever
review_text: Ray and his wife Jill were so kind and welcoming. A great way to see Kauai from the air. A once in a lifetime experience. Don’t miss this tour.

We booked a tour very last minute because it was something we've never experienced and we were absolutely blown away! Our pilot Ray was wonderful. Great pilot, and even better person. I don't think the trip would have been quite the same without him. He pointed out so many little details we wouldn't have noticed otherwise. Every minute of our tour was a delight. 100% recommend!
The experience I cannot put into words.  This is a must do. The owners and  the pilot were one of the kindest people I have met

review_title: Flight if a lifetime!!! TRUST ME!
review_text: This was absolutely amazing!!! Nate was an awesome pilot and guide for this flight. As of now, this is the highlight of the trip and it’s not even close. He was very accommodating for my wife and I along with our two friends and we got to see so much more than we ever imagined we would especially at such a reasonable price! If anyone reads this, I promise that you will not be disappointed! The photography and videos that I captured from above of the entire island were absolutely incredible! When we come back we will definitely be flying this tour again! Thank you guys so much for the hospitality and making my wife and I’s anniversary absolutely wonderful! 🤙🏽🤙🏽

Great your with Captain Nate. He was very informative and pleasant. Great views.
The ladies on the ground were so nice and helpful.

The Best!  Ray was outstanding and the weather as close to perfect as anyone could expect. After traveling as much by roadway and some hiking, the air tour made me realize that it is the only way to get the complete Kaua’i experience.

review_title: Definitely worth it. 6 passenger plane and everyone can see.
review_text:
This trip was awesome! Ray was so much fun to be in the plane with. Told us all about the island. Kept everyone engaged and told us before it was going to be a little bumpy, and it barely was. Awesome time. Ray is a wealth of knowledge about flying and about Kauai. 

Thank you for the flight! 

From the Blackwell family!
So thankful I was able to use this company.  Everything from start to finish was A+.  I would highly recommend this air tour to anyone.

Ray the pilot was an excellent host. I suffer from motion sickness and he took extra care to not have the flight be as bumpy to save me some discomfort. I appreciated that! The views were some of the best I've ever seen in my life. His wife Jill was kind & gracious as well. I highly recommend this tour/adventure.

Awesome experience, one of the most exciting of my life. Flying over Kauai Island has been amazing. You can see some fantastic places not reachable in any other way. Kauai is the garden island of the Hawaii and the view from the little aircraft has been so beautiful that my words cannot describe how fantastic it was.
The captain Ray and his wife Jill are two of the most kind and nice persons we have met in our honey moon.

review_title: Best part of our trip to Kauai!
review_text: This was the best part of our of trip to Kauai! We could not have asked for a better experience! Our pilot Ray gave us the best tour and had us laughing the entire trip!

Fantastic experience!  The scenery was breathtaking.  Ray got use in great position so that we got jawdropping views of the waterfalls, canyons, the Napali Coast, and mountains. Ray and Jill were delightful  and really went out of their way to make the trip special.

review_title: Flying like it was meant to be
review_text: This trip depends upon the weather, but the pilot did everything to get me all the shots safely.  And what a pilot-35,000 hours commercial experience.  He knew all the weather tricks, all the sites to see with the best perspectives for photographs.  I came back slamming my fist in the air, "Yes, another bucket list item done perfectly".

This morning I took a tour of Kauai with Air Ventures and it was better than I expected. JT took us so many places and made sure we all had great views for pictures. It was a wonderful adventure in the air. I even saw my resort from the plane. One of the bonuses was seeing a few whales swimming. After we landed I drove to one of the waterfalls for a more up close look. I especially appreciated the care and safety measures before and during the flight. It seemed like everyone in the plane had a great time. If you’re still on the fence about going...do it! Have a blast like we did.

The whole experience with AirVentures Hawaii inKuaii was positive.  Pick-up near the cruise port, assistance in boarding for my husband.  A very smooth flight around an unbelievable island.  Next time will do the BiPlane!

review_title: A great way to see Kauai!
review_text: We took the Big Kahuna Kauai Air Tour which was truly a great experience and the best way to see the entire island of Kauai.  The team were excellent, even calling us to recommend an earlier time so we could guarantee the best tour of the island avoiding bad weather which would be coming in later on in the day.  Makoa was a great pilot, helpful in answering our many questions as well as showing us some of the local spots since he knows the area so well.  A wonderful experience with jaw dropping views - would recommend to anyone who visits Kauai!

Outstanding and reasonably priced (compared to the helicopters). We saw all of Kauai, especially the Na Pali coast. Try morning tours, weather is always foremost. Only 6 people per plane so everyone gets a window seat. Approximately $170 per person which includes taxes.
Great friendly staff! Wonderful scenery! Well worth the memories of a lifetime! Mr. JT gave us a smooth flight from beginning to end! Ray, Jill, and Kevin were superb!!!

Voir Kauai depuis les airs est une expérience inoubliable.
J'ai choisi de le faire avec Air Ventures et je ne regrette absolument pas. Tout est fait pour que nous profitions au mieux de cette expérience. Au début, Jill est venue me chercher à mon hôtel. Elle a emprunté la route la plus agréable pour aller à l'aéroport. Ensuite, c'était Ray qui pilotait. Lui aussi est archi-sympathique. Il s'adapte aux désirs de ses passagers et agrémente la visite de commentaires instructifs. Bref, j'ai adoré et je recommande chaudement !

I have been on several Kauai air trips the last twelve years and this was the worst.  Not informative.  Kauai is an amazing place with a rich history and one-of-a-kind geology and natural sights.  The pilot seemed to know none of it. The only commentary was when every five minutes he would say “Isn’t this beautiful, guys?”   He DID point out the names of three towns and pointed out the airport.  (Thanks Captain Obvious.). 
Half way through I asked if he could provide some commentary on the sites that we were flying over. He started a comment about the Kauai king back in the days of Kamehameha, but never finished the story.  (In reality a fascinating story about how Kauai was seceded to Kamehameha, but he seemed to know none of it.)
Beautiful scenery.  It IS Kauai after all.  But if you want to see Kauai from the air and learn nothing in the process - save your money and watch YouTube videos of it.

The entire experience was amazing. Our pilot (JT, I think) was great with his narrative and of course with his flying. We did it with our 13 month baby in our lap and she loved it as well. All in all, a great, magical experience

review_title: Awesome whole island plane tour of Kaui
review_text: Our trip was spectacular!.. Makoa was an excellent pilot!.. the weather was very windy and Makoa flew us to an area that was as calm as he could find, with wonderful views. Safety was his first priority, and than we had the ride of our lives.  We saw a circular rainbow, a whale, and many amazing waterfalls! We started in a light rain and ended with a sunny, smooth as silk landing:).. it’s the only way to see the island!..I would highly recommend Air Ventures to everyone!

Air Ventures provides a safe, comfortable, and awesome view of this incredible piece of earth.  Our air tour of Kauai was the highlight of our recent week on the island.  Thank you Jill and JT (our pilot) for a great experience!! You are a great team, very professional, and also make things so fun!!  We appreciate what you do and thanks so much for the great memories!!

Air ventures are the best team on the island.They are a professional ,personable group.
Right down from the owner who is an active part of the team. Who was there and chatted  with us before the flight. The  tour was picturesque ,informative and provided us with some amazing views of the island.
We are going to fly in the by plane  next  time.

We did not get to do the scheduled tour due to technical problem but Jill made it happen, got us on another tour with another company.
Meanwhile while waiting for the other tour we got chauffeured RT to our hotel to get our luggage bt Tom, a wonderful young man, polite and friendly. Ray was ready to give us a tour by ourselves if we were not able to get on another tour that day.
They have that Hawaiian hospitality, made us feel very special that day.
We will fly with them again in a heartbeat. We have become an instant Ohana.
Thank you Jill, Ray and Tom

This is my second trip with AirVentures and I can’t say enough how nice they are. The outfit is very personable and knowledgeable about the island. This flight was amazing from the weather and the flight path. We went all over the island and canyon. I can’t recommend them enough.

review_title: Fantastic Kauai Air Tour in Cessna 182
review_text: My wife and I started our morning with a fun and informative flight around the complete Island. The owner is a calm and competent pilot who really knows the entire Island of Kauai. As a much lower hour pilot and previous plane owner, I really appreciated his flying experience and skills, and his plane is the nicest small plane I have ever flown in....it even has A/C! Highly recommend using Air Adventure for a couple's flight, group tour, or open cockpit bi-plane tour. Followed up our flight with a trip to the nearby Kauai Museum and a car trip to the north shore area we had flown over. A fantastic morning and must do for the best views of Kauai!

We took the one hour flight around the island of Kauai with Kevin from Air Ventures.  This was the final day of our Norwegian Pride of America cruise and the highlight of our trip.  Our fourth island and this was the best tour of all.  Kevin was a great pilot, host and tour guide.  We were blessed with a beautiful day, many learned facts about Kauai and Kevin even circled a couple of times when we spotted whales in the ocean off shore.  Everyone at Air Ventures was professional and took care of us like ohana, with much Aloha.  Maholo Air Ventures, so thankful for this beautiful adventure and your kind service.

review_title: Not the best, not worst either
review_text: They took us right on time to the flight. Offered to take few pictures with the flight. However, once we flew, it took us much higher than helicopters. We saw plenty of helicopters below us closer to the mountains and the costal areas. Our pilot didnt give us much details about the places either. There were occasional mentions of some of the popular sightings but no additional details about the place. We came back within 45 mins. The sightings were great though and would recommend taking atleast one air tour (even if its not this one)
We had a great pilot and saw so many sights that we would have missed otherwise.  Definitely would plan this excursion again!
Thanks to our awesome pilot JT for a wonderful tour of Kauai!  Such a magnificent island-and the your playlist was great too!
I loved this air tour. It shows all the great places in Kauai for over 20minutes. The pilot is very welcoming too.

Perfect way to check out this beautiful island. Now that we’re familiar with the layout we can enjoy finding these hidden gems from the ground. Our pilot JT was informative, an excellent flier and was able to answer all our questions. A must do for anyone first visiting this island.

Our pilot, Makoa, was texting several times and/or looking at his phone with no hands on the controls!!  And, I was the narrator for most of the tour, pointing things out to the other couple.  Turns were not made as well so that all seated could see the same thing.  Mostly what we heard from him numerous times was “Its gorgeous isn’t it?”  When asked a couple of times about hotels, he could not tell us which was which and honestly, was not informative of many things to see.  We had 4 friends on another plane and that pilots’s name was JT and everyone was impressed with him!  We flew with the same company 4 years ago and the pilot we had then was really great so it’s definitely not the company, just some of the pilots need to get some people skills!

We took the Air Venture tour with pilot JT and had a great experience.  The pilot gave information on the region and sights along the way, and the tour provided cool towels and water for passengers.  My husband and I are celebrating our honeymoon and wanted to do an air tour, and decided this one because it was an airplane and not a helicopter.  We thought this might be the safer approach and were happy that all passengers have a window seat so everyone gets a good view.  We would recommend this tour to everyone for a great way to see the beauty of Kauai.
JT our pilot was wonderful! Such an awesome experience and absolutely worth the price! Very informative and smooth take off and landing.

review_title: Lots of fun and a great value for scenic flying
review_text: Our pilot JT did a great job informing us about what to expect on our flight.  It was somewhat windy and cloudy with scattered showers, but the ride was smooth and the landing was very smooth.  We flew up and down the Napali coast so passengers on both sides could get a good view.  The plane we flew in had one window seat for all passengers so we could see well and take pictures.  We had headsets, but mine did not work as well for me as I would have liked, so check it out before the plane takes off.  I wore dark clothing and did not have a problem with reflection.  Less important here than it was in a helicopter. We had taken a helicopter flight on another island and for the money, this was definitely superior as the cost was nearly a third..
Been coming to Hawaii for 10 years definitely the best adventure we have been on JT the pilot was excellent.  with great knowledge of the island and one smooth ride great trip money well spent 👍👍

JT (23 yo pilot) managed the plane well during a few rough spots. He did 360s so both sides of the plane got their magic shots/videos. His narration was good and pointed out all the landmarks. Take off/landing was nice. 

We ended up being a little nauseous toward the end, which surprised us. The headgear was a little uncomfortable, but tolerable for the hour. If you have a tendency to be sensitive to motion sickness, be prepared. Great value and worth it!
Our pilot was great and he even let us make suggestions for going over certain sights! I would definitely recommend and will be doing it again when we return next year!
A beautiful way to experience the island from above. JT, our guide, was awesome and super informative.
JT was our pilot the morning of Nov. 1, 2019. We felt very comfortable during the flight as the ride was smooth and very informative. JT narrated the tour pointing out landmarks along the way.
JT was great, gave great narration throughout the trip. Longer and more affordable than a helicopter tour. I appreciated the Jurassic Park music while flying over the falls 😂

We flew in early afternoon on 8 Nov 2019.  We were a group of 4 adults.  Another couple also rode.  The plane holds 6 passengers and the pilot in the single engine aircraft.  I was lucky enough to fly in the copilots seat which had the best views, although all of the seats had great views.  The seating is based on weight and balance of the aircraft, as determined by the pilot, as each passenger is weighed at checkin.  This was part of the Best of Kauai package.  JT was our pilot  and did an excellent job of showing us the entire island and pointing out all of the landmarks, making sure to circle as necessary to ensure passengers on both sides saw all that was needed.  The flight  was smooth and visibility was near perfect at about 1500 feet above the ground.  We were able to see much more than a helicopter trip, wqhich I think is much better for this island.  JT pointed out all the sites and explained everything we needed to know.  An excellent pilot and very peersonable.

Makoa was our pilot and showed us all the highlights of Kauai. He encouraged us to let him know if we wanted to see anything again. We did and he circled back over so we're could get a better look.. The staff is very warm and made us feel like Ohana or family!! Such a great group of people we would do this again in a heartbeat...

Everyone that does the open door helicopter tour will tell you to DO IT. I am telling you try something different and do the BIPLANE. It was fantastic. The tour lasted longer than the helicopter at 1 hour 15 min. He narrates the entire time and provides plenty of time for questions. I NEVER felt unsafe. You are securely in but have the ability to feel the air and elements since it is an open cockpit. We went around the ENTIRE island and thru the canyon . Amazing pictures. PLUS once you do it people will be jealous and say, "wow, I wish I would have known about that!"

Tom picked us up exactly where stated, and JT then gave us an excellent plane ride.
Both Tom and JT were very informative, friendly, and just genuinely made the experience an excellent life memory. JT had recorded music that were timed perfectly to the flight tour, and it was a nice touch. We had done a helicopter tour on a different Island, but this was far better for pictures, and viewing. Highly recommend this tour.

Unkomplizierte Buchung,  sofortige Bestätigung, am Morgen gebucht, am Mittag geflogen!
Was dann folgte war traumhaft schön und ist nicht zu beschreiben. Man muss es ganz einfach erlebt haben. Die Ausführungen des Piloten waren sehr interessant und wir brachten bei so vielen Eindrücken kaum ein Wort hervor. 
Vielen Dank für das wunderschöne Erlebnis.
Really wonderful tour, Makoa is an excellent pilot and guide and made the tour wonderful. This was a special experience!Great price and great service.

My husband and I did the private Kauai tour today with Makoa as our pilot. The flight was the perfect beginning to our trip in Kauai. We got a great overview of what the island had to offer. The views were absolutely stunning, the flight was very comfortable and Makoa did an excellent job of narrating the entire trip.

The entire staff was very friendl,y and helpful from  beginning to end. Trish was very helpful during the booking process and we were welcomed by everyone when we arrived. Thank you for the great time.

The weather was perfect and we had a great pilot to show us the entire island. Fantastic views from the air and we were able to see another side of all the places we visited the day before. Well worth the visit and the photos are wonderful.

my daughter and me took this flight in sept 2015 is was a great flight pilot was friendly shows us water falls the coast so when we came back to hawaii with my son in sept 2019 we did it again we so many water falls the second time  any got an hour it is worth the money

If you are on the fence about taking this trip, hop off and hop on the plane. We did have to reschedule once due to the weather not cooperating...but I’m glad. Who want to just see rain clouds? We had the absolute best experience with JT as our pilot. 

The views were stunning to say the least. You truly get to see the entire island of Kauai and all it’s beauty during this trip. While only 23 years old, JT is a skilled pilot and was super knowledgeable about the island and its history. His calm demeanor helped to make this experience relaxing.  (I thought I might be nervous in such a small plane...but I wasn’t at all.)

I could go on and on but...trust me...this trip is worth the money. Just do it! 😊
We had an amazing experience.  We were lucky with the weather, but JT and Makoa were two great pilots that made our experience even more relaxing and enjoyable.

We contracted this excursion and it was really a great experience to fly over Kauai.
Perfect organization. We flew with Ray and his explanations were extremely accurate and interesting. We had a lot of fun.

A very reconmendable experience with a great team.

The flight was amazing! Very smooth flight under the capable hands of our pilot JT. JT was very knowledgable pointing out the island highlights and taking care to make sure passengers on both sides of the plane saw the sights. The entire crew was very professional in all aspects of the adventure.
We were treated to a fantastic mornng tour! Our pilot Justin(JT)  and crew Thomas were professional and efficient. Lots of fun. We would def do it again!

review_title: Amazing! Wonderful! One of top 3 highlights of our trip. Loved it!
review_text: Great staff. Nice young pilot. A little hot up there. We would have appreciated knowing that we didn't have to dress warm. Otherwise, just awesome.

review_title: Epic Kauai flight & customer service experience
review_text: My wife and I had the pleasure to enjoy the highest level of flight and customer experience with Jill and Ray from AirVentures. When the weather wasn‘t great on our first flight, they offered us a second flight for free to ensure we would get a great experience seeing Kauai from high above. They both were not only highly professional, but they were also very customer focussed, helpful and great fun. You can see from all the little details that they really do care about creating the best possible experience for you. At the end we had an unforgettable flight with Ray, for sure a highlight of our Hawaii holiday. We can highly recommend booking a flight with AirVentures, you will not regret it. Nadine & Daniel

This flight was amazing! We took a helicopter ride 25+ yrs ago, I had the middle back seat and was miserable! Ray and Jill's love of the island and history was inspiring. The sites were breath taking! Thanks for the fabulous tour!

Flying open air, low and slow is absolutely the best way to see Kauai. My wife and I drove the entire island and would have missed most of its beauty.as much of it is inaccessible. My wife is a bit of a nervous flier in small planes and the team at Air Ventures put her at ease all along the way - from the pre-flight briefing to a super smooth landing and the entire comfortable flight in-between. Most of the flight was flown at approx. 1,800-2,500 feet and between 80-90 kts. It was amazing how much we could see, how good the view was for both of us sitting side-by-side with our pilot in the cockpit behind us and with the high-end headsets we were provided our pilot gave us great information on what we were seeing, history and etc. We've been on helicopter tours and given they seat 4-6 people always get stuck in the middle and miss the best sight seeing... The 60 minute flight was certainly the highlight of our Kauai vacation and was definitely worth the money.

Wonderful experience! JT, our pilot, was top notch and very informative. Our best excursion of our 2 week vacation to the islands!!
Highly recommend.

Words cannot fully express the beauty of Kauai...thank you AirVentures for providing your excellent service!  JT is a great pilot, as well as tour guide!  Appreciated the music choice playing during the ride as well!

Wow, wow, wow!  Words can’t describe the incredible scenery of Kauai - the mountains, waterfalls, cliffs, reefs and beaches - and the scenic flight was the perfect way to see them all. We booked the one hour tour and really enjoyed the experience. Great warm welcome from Jill and the team and great flying from our friendly and knowledgable pilot JT.  We were lucky with the weather and able to get some great views from the sky.  I find it hard to believe anyone would not be blown away by the amazing landscapes and we were very happy with the experience with Air Ventures!  Thank you - highly recommend!

Even before we boarded AirVenture's Cessna Skylane for our private tour of the island, Jill's cheerful greeting & bubbly demeanor welcomed us as we arrived at the hangar. Her enthusiasm & genuine love for the island of Kauai was matched only by the passion of our pilot, Ray, to share it with us from the air. (Air Ventures also offers add-on options to record your flight.)  Although cloud-less skies are rare here, Ray maximized our time aloft by adjusting his course enroute to ensure  we had clear visibility & spectacular views.  His knowledge about the history of the island meshed nicely with the waypoints along the tour & the amount of narrative never overwhelmed our sense of awe at what we were seeing. I'm so glad opted to fly with Air Ventures instead of booking a helicopter tour.  Besides being much less expensive, the pace of the flight was more leisurely; we had time to identify & focus on points of interest as Ray pointed them out.  We saw a lot of helicopters flying around us during the tour & they looked frenetic & fast paced - I didn't see them hover for very long at any one place.   The price of our flight, the added value of the warm & welcoming staff & the quality of Ray's excellent airmanship & piloting skills made this an experience we would highly recommend for everyone!  Rebecca J.

What an awesome tour provided by JT! Both he and the owners are some of the friendliest people you will meet. My husband and I highly recommend using them for your next tour of the beautiful island of Kauai!

review_title: Great tour with excellent pilot guide
review_text:
I've done a helicopter tour and now this airplane tour. I like them both. But the air tour is less frantic, more calm, like the difference between a motorcycle and a car. This tour was all about the views with the pilot turning the plane so both sides get to see all the main attractions, like the Na Pali and waterfalls.

JT was the pilot and tour guide. He focused on providing only the information we wanted, not a bunch of silly jokes. So again, different than the helicopter tours in that it was quiet and relaxed.

If you're looking for a thrill ride, a helicopter is better. But if you're looking for the views, this is less than half the price of helicopter tours with the same views. I will be recommending Air Ventures at every opportunity.

My wife and I enjoyed very much this air tour above Kauai island. Our pilot Ray was fantastic: he is a very expert pilot and an excellent passionate guide! He told us a lot of interesting information about the island and the flight was very comfortable, we felt very safe. We had opportunity to take wonderful pictures from different prospective thanks to his ability to drive the airplane. With this tour is possible to see all the island and in particular the most inaccessible parts in other ways.
We really recommend this tour!

review_title: Am-Plane-Azing Experience overall in less than 90 Minutes
review_text: Initially we decided to skip the tour then we decided in the last minute. Called Air Ventures Hawaii and asked them availability they are amazing they give all possible choices that they can provide. Very responsive and very attentive (I think Trish). We took the private tour, Glad we took it. From the beginning our Pilot (Eric) was so amazing explaining everything about the island. Took us all over the island. He is really amazing went above and beyond the possibilities. Thank you Eric really appreciated for everything you showed us. I haven't been in helicopter ride, but glad we took this one. One more thing, we had one child and Eric was very attentive to everyone. Last but not least, you will have amazing view all around the plane.  100% would recommend.

I rented 2 helicopters for my family of 5. This is the only helicopter touring company in Kauai that I know offers window/door seat for every passengers. Most helicopter tours offer a back row that seats 4 and are assigned by weight distribution.

Mauna Loa allows for doors on or doors off experience. We chose doors off and loved it. I thought my wife, who is less daring than the children or I would opt to keep her door on, but she went doors off also. I highly recommend doors off. Pilots were great constantly checking to make sure everyone was doing well and we always were,  

They provide straps for phones and cameras in order to have them secured for doors off flights. Doors off allows for amazing views and picture opportunities. With doors off it can become chilly. A sweater or light jacket is needed.

review_title: Loved the depth of the flight into the Canyon spectacular
review_text: Young pilot very professional and qualified.We saw things we were unableto see in the helicopter tour we took. I would recommend this company toanyone wanting a great view of interior and exterior Kauai.

Never been to Kauai and who knows if we’ll be back. This was fantastic.  We flew with JT who flew the plane flawlessly and was nice and informative. Frankly, it was even smoother than most jet aircraft we’ve been on. 

Beautiful views and something we will remember for the rest of our lives.  An absolute must if you come. It only takes an hour.

review_title: Best money you will spend on the island!!!
review_text: This plane tour is literally the best money you will spend on the island. Amazing views mixed in with some knowledge and history. J.T.  Is an amazing pilot that made the entire family feel relaxed and entertained. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone!!

Seeing Kauai from a plane was wonderful. We had seen the na Pali coast by raft the previous day and seeing it from the air was a very different perspective. I personally am less anxious in a plane versus helicopter. And our pilot was very informative and we had a very smooth ride. Also was great to see Waimea canyon from above...a must do!

JT was our pilot on our 60 minute tour of Kauai. It greatly exceeded my already high expectations. Highly recommend to anyone visiting the island. Gives a great overall and history of the island without spending hours and days in your car.

We would like to thank  Capt Makoa for the wonderful memories. You showed us the beautiful island of Kauai up in the air. The sights were amazing. It was all breathtaking. It was great! Smooth take off and smooth landing. I was afraid of heights and you made me feel safe immediately you took off. I didnt feel the plane going up. I just realized when we were already up in the air. You should fly commercial soon. Stay humble and pleasant. Again, thank you to you and the rest of the staff

review_title: Don’t miss this outstanding island highlight
review_text: The Air Venture Kauai Air Tour is simply spectacular.  We took the tour at the end of our stay, and it was breathtaking to see all the sites we visited from the air. You can truly appreciate the beauty of the island during the flight.  Our pilot, JT, was friendly and very knowledgeable about the island.  His enthusiasm expressed how much loved the island and enjoyed his job.  He was a great ambassador for Air Ventures and the island of Kauai.  Very highly recommend this tour.

This was a surprise for my wife, neither of us had ever done anything like this before. She was a little nervous never having flown in a small plane but once in the air the view takes your mind off of everything else. We went around the entire island and were able to see everything. The weather was perfect. The pilot would go into an area so one side of the plane could see and then bank around so the other side could see. He would always ask if everybody got their pictures as he would go again if they had not. It was never an issue. We had already seen much of the island by the time we took this tour but totally different experience from the air.
Everyone loved the experience.  Highly recommended. Pilot and ground crew very welcoming and friendly from the time we arrived for the flight until we were done.

review_title: A must to do and must to see
review_text: Discovering Kauai from the air is a must to do. I think that the plane option is better than helicopter for many reasons. Sure helicopter is more spectacular, because it flyes in the canyon. However views are better with plane : only windows seats, more stable, large and clean windows... Moreover, the pilot flyes over the nicest sites 2 times, so that each side can discovers the best view, especially Waimea Canyon, Wailua falls and napali Coast. It's a wonderful and amazing scenic fly. Pictures and videos are perfect ! And all the Jill's team is kind and very professionnal. Very very good experience in Kauai.

This was our last stop of Hawaii and Kauai is the most amazing of our whole trip.
We seen all the differences Kauai has to offer and was way beond our expectation.
Even put the video i could make on youtube:
(Link not allowed here)
Thanks again for the experience.

JT was an awesome pilot with great information about all the different landmarks. There were places we saw that you could not see by car. Our kids loved the flight as well. It was an experience we’ll never forget. Must do!!
JT was very good at pointing out all the areas of interest and making the trip something we will remember for a lifetime!

Our Air Venture tour was terrific and JT was an excellent guide and pilot.  Even though the weather wasn't optimal JT got us to all the great spots he could and made sure every passenger got a good view out their window.  Highly recommend this tour.

Even though most of our trip consisted of heavy rainfall and cancelled/postponed tours, air ventures was easily the highlight of our trip! Trish was awesome in assisting with the scheduling of our tour (and my proposal)and the pilot was awesome as well. I definitely recommend setting up an air tour with air ventures if you’re visiting Kauai!

Short version: amateur, unprofessional, overpriced, uncomfortable, rude, terrible experience. Spend the extra money and take a he'll ride, or at least use a different plane ride provider! 

Long version: We arrived at 925 for our 10am departure, and after the counter employees spent ten minutes in what seemed like some kind of candid camera routine, they informed us that there was some kind of "system error" leaving us as the only two passengers for the flight, which they "couldn't do." They told us we had to come back at 11. 
 We returned at 11 and waited over an hour before we finally got in the air with a pilot who clearly had very little experience flying or in customer service. After informing us he "wasn't supposed to be here today" and that the pilots don't even get paid, and that one of these tour planes had just crash landed the other day, we proceeded on our unprofessional and abbreviated tour of the island.  After learning we were newlyweds he informed us that he was thinking of getting engaged so he could stop using condoms but that he had been a man whose so his girl wamts him to use them. This was one of the few statements he made that didn't begin with "I'm not supposed to tell you this, but..."
 I know that they cannot be held accountable for inclement weather but we deliberately booked the earliest flight available to get out before the weather turned. About the time the 10am flight landed the storm moved in and we were unable to see much of anything on our flight. 

Had we been on the flight we booked (both airbusses flew at 10am, despite the story that there were only two of us booked) we might have an entirely different review.
Had they just admitted it was their mistake we might have an entirely different review.
Had they just been honest before takeoff that due to weather we would not be able to see the napali coast, we might have an entirely different review. 

But the unprofessional pilot and the unprofessional gate staff and the unprofessional business model of this place left us wishing we had spent the extra money and taken a helicopter ride instead of what now feels like a tourist trap rip-off. Cannot even shrug this off as a "you get what you pay for" experience, as we paid for a 10am professionally piloted all-island tour. And got a short plane ride with a kid who didn't want to be there, and frankly, shouldn't have.

review_title: Bad customer service! Don’t waste your money here!
review_text: This was a very disappointing and frustrating experience to say the least. First, we scheduled a plane tour on Sunday. We were told the scheduling was an error and they didn’t have any pilots on Sunday. We agreed to reschedule on Thursday. We were not told that if you sit on the left hand side of the plane you will not see most of the sights. For more than 50% of the time I was just looking at the ocean. The headphones did not work and we could not hear anything that the pilot was saying. The pilot seemed very disinterested throughout the ride. The ride was bumpy. Clearly, they don’t care about customer satisfaction. I’d recommend choosing any other company or spending a little more and going for the helicopter ride. Don’t waste your money here!

The pilots here just want more flight hours, they are not at all interested to show you the beautiful island. 

They did not tell us that only the right hand side people will see all views. My wife was sitting on the left side and all she saw was the ocean! She missed the Napali coast views and she couldn’t say anything because the pilot couldn’t hear her at all. 

Don’t waste your money with them, the big windows and all are just false advertising. What’s the use if they don’t turn the plane around for half of the people?

We did this Tour on May 21st 2019. Initially, I was looking for helicopter tours but on discovering that they assign seats based on height and weight and that the helicopter has “middle seats” I decided to look into Air ventures. I am glad I did.
First off, there are no middle seats; everyone gets a window. I had booked the morning tour, but due to unforeseen circumstances, the tour had to be moved to the afternoon. They were kind enough to inform me 1 day before the trip. The change was done free of charge. If we could not make it, they were willing to rebook us on a different day that would work out. If we could not attend, I am sure they would have refunded us.
We had 4 people in total who took the same plane ride with us, so we all sat on the same side, but had there been more our pilot Justin T (not Timberlake! ) would have maneuvered the plane so all could get a good look.
The view of the NaPali coast from air was breathtaking. Justin also played some mild background music while he narrated the history of Kauai and pointed out interesting features. For me seeing the NaPali coast and the beautiful reefs from the sky was like the scene from Avatar where the protagonist sees the Floating Mountains of Pandora for the first time. Magnificent. We also saw the Waimea canyon (also known as Grand Canyon of the Pacific). It was lush green and had countless waterfalls. Justin was kind enough to fly the plane around slowly and more than once so we could truly take in the beauty. I was lucky enough to get to sit in the co-pilot’s seat, but all the seats are good. Do make sure you wear all black clothes, else your reflection will show up in the window and ruin your photos. The windows are large enough that you get a good view and squeaky clean too. Side note: Do not put your phone on the windowsill while recording, the vibration though not obvious when flying, will show up on your videos prominently.

Before we began our trip, they also took a photo of all of us and the pilot together and emailed it to us at no extra charge.
For an extra charge of $25, they will attach your GoPro to the exterior of the plane, just below the wing and you can get an uninterrupted video of the whole trip. We did purchase this, and it was completely worth it. You get to relive the experience all over again.

P.S: Ground Staff Jill was super helpful and friendly too. She mentioned must see places and helped us pick out nice restaurants for us to visit. 

TLDR; Awesome experience. An absolute must do. Staff were very courteous, fun and informative.

Amazing views of the island with a safety reassuring pilot.
Located at the end of the airport terminal, with free parking. Quick and easy check in process. Very quick boarding process and takeoff procedure to see the views of the island, narrated by the pilot.
Saw most parts of the island, doing a few 360 turns, to let all passengers view some attractions from all directions and both sides.

For professional or 'prosumers' photographers, be aware that while the windows are large and clean, reflection from them do creep up to the photos. Bring a wide lens. A telephoto lens will be hard to use/not useful. Try to block some reflections e.g. with your hand. For all other amateurs, bringing a good camera phone is sufficient :-) 
Consider enjoying the ride instead of taking too many photos.

The seats on the plane are low but otherwise comfortable. The flight felt safe and not at all scary or bumpy (though weather might impact your ride). I brought with me a water bottle and large camera with no issue. Water was available on board. headsets were available on board, to reduce flight noise and hear the pilot clearly.

This is a single prop plane, with 'just right' speed to enjoy the sights. It does not fly low or close to attractions nor make much changes in elevation while in flight, like helicopters can. IMHO this lets you get a grand view of the attractions, which is what is ride is about. 

Landing was safe and well executed. Getting off the plane was simple and quick.

Traveling with another couple for a 50th Birthday w did this fantastic flight over Kauai during our  Hawaii cruise. 
This flight was in a small but comfortable plane where everyone had a window view. The sights w flew over wee great! you really do get to see the fabulous coat and towns ok all coats plus the fabulous Na Pali coast (wow, what a site that is! ). Flying across the Waimea canyon was awesome, certainly a great easy to see the waterfalls and colours of this great area. 
I can highly recommend Air Ventures, a great organisation that ensures you get to see everything and in reasonable comfort.

This trip was fantastic. We were able to see the entire island by air. The flight on a small plane with windows for everyone to see all the sight was amazing. We would do this tour again. Professional and courteous staff was welcoming and helpful.

From reservations and email follow-ups with Jill, to checkin with Tom & Trish, and flight with TJ, this was a great experience. The views and commentary were perfect. I have worked in the tour company business for 15 years now . It is nice to deal with an outfit that gets what it is all about and provides great guest experiences. Mahalo.
It’s the most amazing view I have ever seen! JT &TOM did a wonderful job! It’s a must do in Kauai, super recomended! Thank you guys for having us!

review_title: This is an experience you should not miss!
review_text:
The entire process of the experience went flawless.  The pilot and staff were very knowlegeable, friendly, professional and especially made you feel welcome.  
The flight took you around the whole island so you felt you had a complete tour of Kauai.
JT (our pilot) was very informative and made the flight very enjoyable.

review_title: Great view of the Garden Isle
review_text: AirVentures island air tour of Kauai was a great way to see the beautiful island - the hour goes by too quickly but you really see the entire island.  The obligatory trip to the "Jurassic Park" falls, Waimea Canyon (which we had visited earlier that day, so it was cool to see where we had been from the air), and of course the Na Pali coast.  JT was an outstanding pilot and great guide.  Seats are a bit cramped as might be expected in a small plane, but you quickly forget about that when you're looking out at the island!  The entire staff was friendly, got me a seat last minute, and provided a seamless experience.  Highly recommended!

That was fantastic experience!!!!!
Unforgettable impression!!!!!
Pilot was experienced and very friendly as well as and the whole team!
Good job guys!!!!!
Thank you!!!!!

We have been on helicopter flights before, so thought a fixed wing plane would be a new adventure.  And sure enough, our Captain, Eric, made sure we had just that. It was a brilliant adventure, amazing views and great commentary. Eric kept us informed all through the flight, and circled around so everyone got the best views possible.
Eric our pilot was great.It was a perfect way to see the island you could not see any of what they showed us. Everyone from front desk to the pilot

review_title: Great pilot, talented beyond his years!
review_text:
Our young pilot was Makoa and he was awesome! He was very good at making sure everyone was having a great time and to share the views as best he could with both sides of the aircraft. He did everything in his power to give us a smooth ride. 

The views were exceptional and we had a nice cool morning. I work on the water around Kauai and would have to say that seeing both angles on our coast and canyon really enhanced my love for this place! Everyone should take a flight!

We left a little early than expected. Mokoa(our captain) did an awesome job giving us the pre flight instructions and getting us up to provide a really nice tour. The flight was very smooth and the views were just brilliant. He had a good eye and also helped us catch a glimpse of whales swimming by the nOrth shore.

We weer looking to do a cruise and everything was sold out. Out of a whim I booked this tour and am so happy we did it.

review_title: Best trip on Kauai (in my opinion)
review_text: This was a sharp outfit. Orgainized, on time, professional, All the safe stuff passed 100% AND our pilot, TJ was super! Narrative and accomodation for both sides of the plane made the flight interesting and just beautiful. You can interract with the pilot, ask questions, and get another view. To see this scenery from above it unbelievable. The Plane allowed window seats for everyone so no blocked views. I would recommend this to everyone.
Nice scenery, very cramped seating, headphones hurt to wear. Very smooth flight but was a little higher up than expected. Helicopters fly much lower.

J.T. was our pilot and was extremely good.  He made the flight even more special by his background music during the flight!  The beauty of the island is magnificent by air and being in a plane, you see a broader view.  
Do not be wary of booking this tour direct rather than through a cruise ship.  The service from the people was awesome.  The arrangements for pick up at Anchor Cove were simple because the ship provided a free shuttle. Our driver, Jill, drove us through the Marriott property on the way to the airport.  When we commented on the beauty, she offered to drop us off on the way back at the Marriott so we could walk through the grounds and enjoy their beach.  Personal service and great tour.  Would highly recommend!
The views were magnificent. It is a great way to see the island and our pilot, Eric, was phenomenal.

I am so grateful for this to her company. We just took an additional tour after 11 years to relive how I propose to my wife. Originally they were so happy and easy to deal with when I initially set up plans 11 years ago. I was even more grateful when after more than a decade the entire crew from the ground to the pilot was absolutely phenomenal and better than I remember. I would highly recommend this tour company for your next adventure.

review_title: If you're headed to Kauai, this is a must-do!
review_text: Yes, the pilots are young, but they are incredibly friendly and great at flying the small planes. The tour features incredible views and opportunities to ask any questions you may have about the land.  Every person on staff is incredibly nice and wants to assist you in any and every way possible- they even offered me a ride to my hotel after without me asking! They're the best! Amazing customer service and it really goes a long way.

You really appreciate Kauai when you are able to see the entire island from the sky.  Only experiencing a small area where you can drive and go to the beach is not enough.  Seeing all the waterfalls that start up high and go down from one to the other is truly beautiful.  We also get to see the Napili Coast and many areas where you would never, never be able to drive too.  It was a stunning experience.  My 11 year old and 8 year old both loved it.  She had a hard time hearing in the headphones but the views were good.  The windows are large.  I got to sit in the co-pilot seat because I normally get seasick.  I did not get any motion sickness!!  Ray was a pro pilot!!   He also let me put my hands on the wheel to steer.  That was AMAZING!!!  When is that ever going to happen??  The team here is very professional.  Completely worth it.  ALSO, just wear normal clothes -shorts and t shirt.  The weather is the same in the plane as it is on the ground.
pilot very young, and good narrator, incredible experience good job air ventures staff, all of them.

Aside from the opportunity to soak in some gorgeous and dramatic views of the island, the whole-island tour was an especially enjoyable trip for a pilot. I had originally wanted to fly in their C182, a private 4-seat Cessna, with an instructor, because it is the only way to fly around the island, at the controls, unless you take a checkout flight so you can rent further, solo (more of an option for residents). My wife and I decided this time to take the tour in the AirVan, with J.T. as our pilot and tour guide, along with a few other passengers. 

Even though we pilots are always itching to be at the controls, this was still a fine choice. The airspace is relatively busy with other air tours and traffic, there are several local VFR reference points you don’t know, and the terrain has unique properties which require attention, as well. I was simply able to sit back and enjoy the beauty of Kauai—without getting too antsy to fly, myself! 

Incidentally, with the varying terrain and ocean comes what’s called “uneven heating” which is one of the factors which creates turbulence. There’s only two things one can do to mitigate that: 1) fly early in the morning, or 2) get a pilot who knows how to soften the ride (there are a few ways). J.T. is just such a pilot. 

Highly recommend! (20 year, instrument pilot)

There is NO other way to see the island. Everyone at Airventures was very nice and helpful. Our pilot Eric was amazing! Humorous, knowledgeable and accommodating. Definitely an experience I would give the very highest recommendation.
Alles top organisiert,nette,hilfsbereite Leute und sehr informativ. Eine mega Erfahrung,die man auf Kauai gemacht haben sollte!

Flying with AirVentures over the island of Kauai was probably the coolest thing I have ever done!  As soon as I called and spoke to Jill on the phone, I knew I called the right place!  Instantly felt that personal connection.  We were flying to Kauai just for the day, as we were staying on Oahu.  Jill made sure we had enough time to get from the gate to their location and even made a note to get us to our rental car after our flight.  Jill greeted us upon arrival and did a great job prepping us for our flight.  JT was our pilot and he was amazing!  One of the smoothest flights I've been on.  Soon after take off, he spotted a humpback whale and did a 360 so everyone could see it!!  WOW!  His narration of the trip, coupled with the soundtrack was top notch!  Made for such an amazing experience!  Still in complete awe of things that we saw that morning!  Jill and Ray greeted us when we returned and we enjoyed talking with them.  We really felt like we spent the morning with old friends!  All at AirVentures really went above and beyond to make sure we had the best experience possible.  My company just went through a customer experience program, so I really look out for those extras that make companies stand out now.  I give AirVentures a full 100% A+ rating!

Ray and Jill and the entire staff were wonderful. When the weather didn't look like it would cooperate with our original flight time they did all they could to rebook us on a later flight. When there weren't any spaces available, they added in a private flight for us to ensure we got to see the island in this incredible way. The plane was nearly new and the tour was absolutely wonderful. My husband and I will always remember this experience and are very thankful to have this memory as part of our "babymoon." We definitely recommend Air Ventures!

Pilot Eric Johnson gave us an amazing overhead tour of the beautiful mountains, shoreline, canyons and waterfalls.  He was very attentive to each passenger’s well-being and was a great guide as to what we were seeing.  The pictures we took from the plane are awesome but viewing the island’s beauty bird’s eye view was amazing.  One hour flight, six of us onboard along with pilot.  Highly recommend.  Husband and wife owners.  Everyone was very kind.

Kevin was our pilot and we got to see the Na Pali coast as well as valleys, waterfalls, resorts, places where films were shot, and we even saw whales ( a mom, baby and a third). This plane could not get into the narrow valleys like the helicopters can, but we had a great trip and went right around Kauai! Loved it!

We loved this experience...a good smooth ride...lots of s turns so that both sides could see the sights.
Kevin, our pilot, a veteran pilot flying these Hawaiian airs for over 30 years! Good to know.
Great views of hidden, hard to get to places. Waterfalls, canyons. the tour covers the entire island.
Here’s a hint, they are located between Fed Ex and UPS, on the air cargo park of the Lihue airport.
Only down side, Keven grouses about solar energy. On every other topic, he’s knowledgeable.

We recently flew on the 3 passenger Cessna air tour and had the most amazing time! This was such a special and unique tour for us. The views of the coast/beaches, waterfalls, grottos, etc were breathtakingly beautiful... and easy to see because of the large, clean windows.  Our pilot, Ray, was fantastic - knowledgeable, professional, funny and smooth!  We saw where shows were filmed and learned so much about the island's culture, history, current happenings and more.  The airplane is pristine and the ride was comfortable. My family highly recommends AirVentures Hawaii!  Ray and Jill are wonderful, friendly and feel like family.  (The t-shirts are awesome, too!)

This was the best tour we have ever taken. From the first moment we arrived we were looked after in a friendly and efficient way. However, the majesty of the Kauai scenery just blew us away as we took off and toured the island. The 1 hour flight, with a pilot that made everything interesting was superb. Even down to the soundtrack he played during the flight that fitted the occasion. It was worth every penny and at significantly cheaper than the helicopter tours, I would highly recommend this as the way to see the island and make lasting memories.

Amazing way to cover a lot of amazing territory. Big view windows. Pilot Steve pointed out the sights and made sure both sides of the plane had ample photo opportunities. Waterfalls galore cascading over sky high cliffs, rugged coastal cliffs in green, brown and reds, aqua waves crashing ashore, deep inland valleys and wide grasslands-awe inspiring.

My family and I rented the Cessna 182. The plane was in great shape with G1000 avionics. The air conditioning in the plane was appreciated and made for a comfortable flight. As a certified pilot I was able to fly most of the flight. Our instructor Eric was great helping with local procedures. Eric was very knowledgeable about the island and local attractions. The views were beautiful. We were able to see the entire island as well as some whales which helicopter tours just can’t.

review_title: The only way to see the island
review_text: JT thanks for a great trip around the island. Enjoyed the beautiful view of the beaches  and waterfalls

Eric was an excellent pilot and commentator.  He learned our names and personally interacted with each of us during the flight. We had two children on our flight with whom he did a great job. I highly recommend flying with Eric.

Very smooth flight. Saw lots of Hawaii scenery and well known landmarks. Pilot was very knowledgeable and friend/y.  Napali coast was breathtaking! Best way to see the Island of Kauai. You can rent a Go-Pro and film your trip.

review_title: Incredible views with Ray - best money we’ve ever spent on a tour
review_text:
Had booked with another company but was cancelled last minute. While we were waiting Jill engaged us a couple of times in general conversation - she is a real sweetheart! Knowing we were in a bit of a predicament, she tracked down her pilot who happens to be her husband to take us up for our tour. Ray was awesome and the tour was even better - I don’t think you can possibly say you saw the island if you don’t see it from the air. We’ve done 4 hikes and while the scenery has been spectacular, what we saw from the air was priceless. 

We had contemplated a helicopter tour but so glad we went with Air Ventures - a small family company that really cares about your experience. The price is very reasonable for the experience and we will be sure to include this on our next visit with our sons.

Awesome Airvan tour.  The owners, Ray and Jill were a delight to work with.  Our original morning tour with another operator was cancelled yesterday and we hastily booked for an afternoon tour for today with Air Ventures.  Early this morning, I called to  see if we could change our tour time and Jill was very accommodating.
