The landing was very smooth.  Overall, the  the tour was immensely enjoyable and relaxing and I was able to take some good pictures.  I can honestly recommend Air Ventures!  Combine it with Lauau or the NaPali Cost dinner cruise to get the best deal.

review_title: Amazing way to see all of Kauai!
review_text:
We decided to celebrate my son's birthday and see the entire island by taking a flight with Air Ventures Hawaii.  We were very impressed by their presentation, given at our resort and decided to book with them.   

We were very impressed with, not only their professionalism, but also with the wealth of information they provided during the tour. Captain Harry gave a wonderful tour that gave a lot of insight into both the history of the island, as well as places we might want to tour by car. It was presented in a most enjoyable and humourous manner. 

I would suggest bringing your camera and a spare battery. One member of our party had his camera die after only a few shots. Fortunately, there were others able to take up the slack - but still a disappointment for him.  

In 1998, I had taken a helicopter tour of the island. While it was exciting to ride in a helicopter, I found that I had better views and a more far ranging tour of the island with the fixed wing. 

I can't wait for the opportunity to come back to Kauai. I would certainly take this tour again - it is breath taking.

review_title: Absolute best value after doing tons of research!  Incredible!
review_text: We did the combo tour of the one hour air and 3.5 hour boat.  We paid $189 for both which means we paid $110/p/p for the air.  It was a phenomenal tour and the best deal on Kauai!  Harry was our pilot and showed us more than you would get in the helicopter tours (our tour ran longer than an hour).  It was a smooth flight and we got to see the entire island.  Kauai is the most magical place on earth and this was the way to do it!

We took a wonderful  Air Ventures tour of the island of Kauai.  We circled the entire island.  The pilot was excellent, as was the plane's performance. The pilot shared his knowledge of the geography, and pointed out waterfalls and other attractions as we circled the island.  The views were incredible, with the highlights being the Waimea Canyon and the AWESOME Cathedrals at Na Pali.  Bring a camera!!!  There are many, many opportunities to take pjhotos of this beautiful and diverse island.

We were debating as to take an airplane or helicopter tour.  We had some one person in our group who was 83 so we opted for the Air Ventures based on other positive reviews that it wouldn't be as bumpy as a helicopter.  I would recommend Air Ventures.  The plane was not too small, the pilot very knowledgeable of the entire island and each person has a window seat.  If you are taking pictures, some seats in the plane are near the strut...which will end up in your pictures.  My inlaws were seated on the left and back a row and their pictures were fine.  There was some bumpyness but very, very minor.  If you get car sick easily you may want to take some dramomine

review_title: Best Way to View the Entire Island
review_text:
We did this on our third day and really were glad that we did. We did the 1-hour tour and got the free DVD for booking online. (By the way, the DVD is worth it if you book online and get it for free, but not for the $20 or whatever you had to pay for it, it's only like 20 min. long and doesn't have that great of quality, but was a nice gift for us since it was free!) This was something my husband was adamant about doing and since I get really motion sick, I wasn't originally too keen on it. In fact, he originally started wanting to do a doors-off helicopter ride and I was excited to find Air Ventures had such great reviews so that I could suggest this as an alternative to the helicopter, which went over well and I think he's very happy that we did it this way. 

You really get to see the entire island from above and get some of the history from your guide. Our guide/pilot wasn't as talkative as we would have liked, but really no one on the plane was asking questions or talking to him either, so I think it's understandable that it turned out that way. And most of the sights speak for themselves. You get to see the coffee fields, all of the fabulous/famous beaches of the island, waterfalls, Waimea Canyon, where Jurassic Park/Raiders of the Lost Ark was filmed, etc etc etc --- it is really all encompassing and I would recommend it. 

The people that run it and were the pilots were SUPER nice as well, which really makes for an awesome trip, especially because I was a little nervous about flying in such a small plane. 

As for the motion sickness, I did ok for a half hour and then was feeling really ill for the second half, but I never actually got sick and imagine it's MUCH better than a helicopter ride would have been. And they were very sweet about it as well, offering watering and where I could sit to cool off, so that was much appreciated. 

I think this is a must do for those on Kauai, it's so cool to see all of the places from above and then spend the rest of the week exploring from the ground or water, very cool!

review_title: Kauai, Hawaii Perfect Air Venture Tour
review_text: We just returned from a vacation week on the island of Kauai, Hawaii.  Our week was jam packed with activities such as kayaking, hiking, swimming, beach combing, etc.  But beyond a shadow of a doubt, the Air Venture Airvan plane tour of the entire island was the highlight of our adventures.  It was not only reasonably priced but was filled with the most spectacular views of this island, including the Waimea Canyon, lush tropical forests, coffee plantations, and the many, many beautiful beaches.  Paul (?), the pilot/guide, was very informative and courteous during the entire tour taking the time to point out whales splashing along one beach.  He advised us to turn off the camera flash to increase photographic quality.  Each of our party had their own window for observation and photos.  No details were omitted as the windows were freshly cleaned before each flight.

In November, my girlfriend and I visited Kauai for the first time.  We wanted to get a good "overview" of the Island and chose Air Ventures instead of helicopter tour.  I think we made the right choice!  The tour was inclusive of the entire island.  The pilot was very informative and pleasant.  We had a great flight around the island.  I would recommend this trip to anyone visiting Kauai.

JS Flinn
Moreno Valley, CA

Yesterday my wife, a friend, and I went on a flight over Kauai riding in a fixed wing aircraft flown by an experienced pilot from Air Ventures.  We debated flying in a helicopter instead of the fixed wing aircraft, because a helicopter can hover over a scenic location, but opted for the lower cost aircraft.  We had heard that the Air Van aircraft, which seats 7 passengers and flies at about 115 - 120 mph offers plenty of time to take pictures of waterfalls and other scenic spots.  Each passenger is seated next to an optically clear plastic window and is provided an opportunity to photograph locations of interest.  I was using my new digital SLR and got some great photos.  The flight takes an hour and the plane travels (at least our flight did) in a clockwise direction around the island, primarily along the coast line and over the Waimea Canyon (the Grand Canyon of the Pacific), traveling over the Hanalei Valley when returning to Lihue.  My wife and I had toured much of the island by vehicle on a trip to Kauai with two other friends just last January, but seeing the canyon and some of the waterfalls that we had seen from the road-side access was not nearly as exciting as the view from the aircraft.  We particularly enjoyed flying over the Napali coast (western shoreline) and seeing all of the waterfalls.  Our flight was on a relatively clear day after several days of intermittent heavy rainfall, so the waterfalls were spectacular and abundant.  The pilot was very good about pointing out the sites and telling us historical anecdotes about various scenic locations.  The noise-canceling headphones and microphones provided each passenger enabled us to hear him clearly and ask questions.  He was an excellent pilot, considerate about minimizing turbulence by flying above it or moving away from the cliffs, and very knowledgeable about Kauai.  In short, I would strongly recommend taking the Air Ventures aircraft flight as providing one of the best ways to see all of the major sites of interest on the entire island.  We all enjoyed the flight and felt it provided more than any other recreational experience during this vacation.

This was our first time experiencing a flight tour of Kauai and the staff at AIR VENTURES KAUAI was very friendly and professional. The tour is very affordable compared to the traditional helicopter tours and you are even in the air for more time. Our pilot was professional and knowledgable of the history and best tourist sights on the island. We would recommend this tour to anyone who would like to view the entire island by air at a very affordable rate compared to other air tour companies.

My wife and I took a one hour tour with Air Ventures Hawaii over Kuaui. We were taken for a tour of the entire island and saw sights that we could not have seen from anywhere by car. The plane was comfortable and provided for a very smooth ride. If you are a little bit daring you can get some great photos from above of the falls and the Wailua Canyon.

Air Ventures was great to work with; knowledgeable about the island; and provided a great value for money spent.

Take a tour with Air Ventures. It will be worth your time and money to see Kuaui from the air.

review_title: See Kauai from the air with Air Ventures
review_text:
Flying with Air Ventures is not just a cheaper alternative to taking the more expensive helicopter tours!

You get a full hour tour with a great guide and pilot (Joel) to tour all of the major sights of the island and see things you cannot see from the ground.

The plane is specially designed for low speed flying and much quieter than the helicopters.  You get a headset and microphone to enable two way communication with the pilot.

You will see the harbor, the entire western coast (NaPali), Kalalau Valley, Hanalei Bay, Princeville, numerous waterfalls, the Powerline Trail, Mt. Waialeale, coffee plantations, Wailua Falls, and many other sights.

This was our fourth trip to Kauai but our first time to see the island from the air and it is well worth the money spent.  Don't book with any other airplane or helicopter tour.  Then report your experiences back to this website!

What an amazing experience. This was definitely a top three if everything we have done all over the world. The whole operation was top notch.  Always felt safe. The pilot ,Andy, explained everything throughout the flight and landing.  He ga e both sides of the plane their own opportunities to see each view throughout the flight.  His approach and takeoff from the glacier was super smooth.  The time on the glacier was breathtaking. Every aspect of this flight spot on. Would highly recommend to everyone that comes to Talkeetna.

The glacier landing tour was hands-down THE best part of my Alaska trip. The pilot was very informative and explained in great detail about the various kinds of glaciers. The landing on the glacier was smooth. The views from the plane were surreal.

Denali was partially hidden by clouds. The scenery leading up to Denali and the glacier landing were breath taking. This is a must do to experience Denali. Shannon front desk lady was a delight. Flight crew Asa and Richard were top notch. We were rescheduled several times due to weather. They won’t fly unless it’s safe. So clear your calendar and make yourself available to better your chances. We plan to come back and do another flight seeing tour with this outfit on our next Alaska trip. Yes I highly recommend.

Unfortunately, it was cloudy and drizzling on our day of the scheduled ride and we couldn't do the glacier landing route.  I wanted to write a review and let those with potential air or car sickness, like my husband, you do not have to worry about it.  The plane is small and seats are tight but the takeoff, landing and ride itself is very smooth even with elevation changes.  We actually went through a snow squall during our flight which was interesting.  Although it was not our original plan, we were glad we decided to go up and fly over the tundra and the deepest ice in Alaska, a memory we always will have.

What a treat!   The flight over to Denali was a highlight of our short stay in Alaska.  Pilot Tim was knowledgeable and answered our many questions about Denali and the region.  The scenery is of course breath taking and the experience quite memorable.  If you can, take this flight.

We had a terrific time flying with Talkeetna Air Taxi. The views were spectacular, landing on the glacier was amazing. Our pilot, Richard did a great job flying and showing us the terrain. Very little turbulence during our trip and great landings both on the glacier and at the airport. Would highly recommend this excursion.

We had a fantastic time with Captain Daniel. He was very knowledgeable and made us feel very safe and taken care of on the trip. The views were spectacular and the glacier landing was amazing. 10/10 recommend the glacier landing with you tour.  The only unfortunate part was it was too cloudy to fly above the clouds to see Denali. Other than that, we had a fantastic time and we all agreed that it was the best way to view and experience Denali National Park.
Mesmerizing and breathtaking views. Never seen anything like it. It was sunny and a great day to fly and visit the Denali peaks and glaciers. Worth every penny.

review_title: Highly recommend this trip you won’t be disappointed!
review_text: South Side Explorer with Glacier Landing was the highlight of our trip. The pilot was exceptionally good, a great take off and landing, he was so informative.

This was by far the highlight of our Alaskan trip. Unbelievable views like nothing we had ever seen before. Our booked trip had to reschedule due to rain conditions and flew out later that day. We hung out in Talkeetna as this was one of the first flights in 4 days they were able to complete. So fortunate to make the trip …..above the rain the sun was shining on Denali😄

review_title: Incredible company, outstanding pilot, breathtaking experience!
review_text:
My husband and I visited Alaska for my first time in early August.  We knew we wanted to experience a fly over Denali National Park.  After researching the various tour operators offering this service, it was a no brainer to book with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Not only were their Trip Advisor and Google reviews great, but what sold me was their policy to rebook or refund their tours.  The other companies had a much more rigid refund policy.  For those who have never traveled to Alaska, the weather changes daily and can be dramatic as well.  

We originally booked the Mountain Explorer with a Glacier landing for the first tour time of the day.  There are multiple tour times offered throughout the day, so if the visibility or weather cancels an earlier tour, it’s possible to book a later tour if there is availability.  We left the rest of the day open in our planning just in case.  

Unfortunately, the weather was not great on the day of our tour so they called us to tell us it was cancelled.  The rest of the tour times were cancelled as well.  But they offered to rebook us on the Mountain Explorer tour the next day without the glacier landing with a refund of the difference in pricing, so we rebooked it.

When we arrived for the 4pm tour time the next day, they actually booked us on the South Side Explorer with glacier landing and we still received a refund on the difference in price.  We were happy because we did want to have a glacier landing and we didn’t even ask, it was automatically done!  

Our pilot was Luke.  He was fantastic!  Super chill and greeted us wearing jeans and a t-shirt.  I actually sat in the first passenger seat behind the cockpit and watched him fly the plane.  It was fascinating.  Each seat of the plane had a headset with volume knobs on each ear.   Luke pointed out the names of the mountain formations as we soared around them.  It was magical!  Ruth glacier is huge and glorious in the air.  Unfortunately, Denali was hiding in the clouds but the views of the other mountains was spectacular.

The glacier landing was smooth.  We had plenty of time to walk on the glacier and take pictures.  It was worth every penny to have had the opportunity to do so.

Since we sat in the same seats on our return, Luke made sure to fly back the opposite direction so we could see the views we missed on the way up.  As we left the Denali mountain range, we could see views of the Talkeetna valley and various rivers which were breathtaking!  Smooth landing back at the airport.

Talkeetna Air Taxi is the best company for a fly over to Denali Park, hands down!

You must experience flying to Mount Denali with Talkeetna Air Taxi. Pilot Andy is phenomenal! They take great care of your safety and provide the experience of a lifetime. It was truly other worldly to fly above such a majestic mountain range and then land in the middle of it. The mountains are so large and grand you feel like you can reach out and touch them. Landing right next to the summit is awe inspiring.

The company runs a first class business and all the staff is friendly and courteous as well as very professional! Luke, our pilot was excellent as he navigated the mountains and glaciers! He played relaxing music and he was very knowledgeable of the areas as he narrated the experience and kept us well informed of any maneuvers he was making so we would not be caught off guard.  Landing and stepping out onto a glacier was incredibly unbelievable with such magnificent views. This is a must do activity!!!

An amazing experience that's more than worth the money.  Experienced pilots in a comfortable plane show you sights only God could create.  Beautiful doesn't begin to describe the trip!  Have your camera ready...and spring for the glacier landing!  It was awesome!!

We had an earlier flight that was cancelled due to weather. Talkeetna Air was able to reschedule us to a flight at 6:30pm. Perfect. By the time of our flight, the weather had cleared and we flew to Denali and the glacier with Daniel as our pilot and guide. Daniel provided a lot of landscape information by pointing out how past glaciers molded the terrain below us. He pointed out the different peaks near Denali and talked about the history of climbing these peaks. We landed on Ruth Glacier and experienced some breathtaking scenery. The total flight was about 2 hours but we will have a lifetime to joyfully relive this experience.

I can’t say enough about Talkeetna Air’s customer service. They kept us abreast of what was happening with the weather. They were easy to talk to and there was never a point I felt uneasy about the upcoming flight. 

No matter who your pilot is (they are all great), you will have an amazing and memorable experience.

This was the highlight of our 2 week Alaskan vacation. Our pilot made us feel safe and was very interesting to listen too!  The support emplyees were very welcoming and kind! I would highly recommend this company!

review_title: Glacier Landing is a Must Do!
review_text: Our Denali flightseeing with TAT is a must do! We weren't sure whether to do a longer flight without a glacier landing, or a shorter one with a landing. They highly recommended the landing, and I am so glad they did! Highlight of our whole trip. The whole TAT team clearly knows what they're doing and are very service minded. We felt very safe and were lucky to get a clear day with gorgeous Denali views.

review_title: Outstanding Flight Viewing and Glacier Landing!!
review_text:
This was an incredible experience!  Last year we went to Alaska and when we were at Denali, we went on a helicopter and landed on a glacier.  I couldn’t get out because of knee issues because the first step was 2-3 feet high.  This year we took our grandson to Alaska (his choice) for his high school graduation gift.  After reviewing several options, I chose the small airplane flight to land on a glacier this year - the “Southside Explorer with Glacier Landing” tour.
I talked to Kayla several times when I was deciding on the best Glacier Landing tour and she was very helpful and answered a lot of questions.  She assured me that there were stairs and I could get off and back on the airplane at the glacier.  She was absolutely right!! I was so excited to get on the glacier. The glacier we landed on this year was much different than the one the helicopter landed on last year.  This was a beautiful glacier with lots of snow on it, instead of ice on the glacier we landed on last year for 10 minutes from the helicopter.  This year we got to play in the snow for 20 minutes and take awesome pictures of the glacier and mountains all around us.  The windows on the airplane were extra large so you could see so much and get great pictures too because there were a special plastic. Last year we just flew to the glacier and back and saw what we could.  On the airplane this year, we flew through Denali Park around the mountains and glaciers on the way to the glacier landing and back.  It was a beautiful scenic flight.  The entire tour was about 1 hr 30 minutes.
Everyone was so helpful and nice - including Kayla and the others at the desk where you check in, the people that help you get your glacier boots, the lady that kept everyone in order while waiting for our airplane, the guy that filled up the planes, the pilots that also provide information during the flight, and everyone else that helped in any way was just super nice!  They all did everything they could to make you comfortable and make it a great experience!
The other thing that said a lot about their business was their cancellation policy. They allow you to cancel at anytime, with a full refund, because they understand the “uncertainty of the issues facing us in the world today”.  Our flight was cancelled for 8:30 am due to fog. The pilots made the call on whether they felt it was safe. They were able to reschedule us for 1:00 pm that afternoon. When we checked in for the 1:00 flight, they talked to the group scheduled for that time and told us that the pilots weren’t sure if we would be able to land on the glacier because of the fog and questionable flight conditions.  They followed it up by telling us if we couldn’t land we would receive a partial refund.  We didn’t even have to ask!  It was clear that they were very thoughtful and considerate of the people that chose to fly with them. That meant a lot to me!!
I can highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi as a great choice for flight viewing Denali National Park and landing on a glacier!  My husband agreed that this was much better than the helicopter tour the year before and our 18 year old grandson loved it!!

This was by far the highlight of our trip! It was well worth it. We were given a wonderful tour and were able to get out and play in the  snow. If you’re debating whether it’s worth it, it totally is- just do it!

review_title: Incredible experience seeing Denali from a birds eye view!
review_text: Everything about our experience was 5 stars! Our pilot was incredibly kind and informative. both flight landings were so smooth. It was such a special unique experience and truly provides an unmatched view of Denali that you can’t get any other way.

review_title: Driver, take me to Denali please
review_text: If you have one activity to do in Talkeetna, do this. It was an amazing experience and well worth the price. Our pilot was very calming and did a beautiful job. The flight was smoother than a commercial airline flight. I think the only other way to see this is if you're actually climbing denali. Simply great.
AMAZING!  Glorious views.  Fun flight. Informative pilot. Getting to walk around on a glacier! Did this 10 years ago. Came back w/ my family.

Just spectacular! If you're undecided about doing this trip (like I was), just do it. I truly think it was a once in a lifetime opportunity for me. I mean, how often are you presented with the chance to ride a plane through mountaintops, then land on a glacier? Our pilot was great (sorry, I don't remember his name) and he narrated what we were seeing with great precision. The views from the plane were just amazing, especially when looping through mountaintops. We landed on the glacier when there were already a couple of planes there, so we were lucky to be able to watch them take off ahead of us. No seat on the plane is a bad seat -- every seat is both an aisle and a window, as the pilot pointed out. Tiny plane, but I felt completely safe. Amazing.
Best thing we experienced while in Alaska!  Yes, it's expensive but it was amazing and we had a fantastic pilot. I believe his name was Daniel.
Fantastic experience. The whole tour was very well organized & the Pilot (Andy) was really knowledgeable and friendly.

This tour was amazing! We chose the morning tour, the weather was perfect! The scenary was breathtaking, like in the pictures, I cannot describe in words- it is a memory for life! Luck, the pilot, is very skilled, everything is very well organised, including transport. We applied the Alaska Tour Saver coupon; the tour worth every penny!
Thank you!

Wonderful flight! The staff was friendly & professional. Safety is the first priority. The flight was very smooth, our pilot spoke with us through the provided headphones. He provided lots of information about Denali. Our plane touched down on Ruth glacier, it was beautiful. We were able to walk around the glacier and take in the breathtaking views. Then up again and back to the airstrip. Would highly recommend.

It's hard to put into words as eloquently and enthusiastically as so many other adventurers have expressed here!  Trust them, trust me -- you do NOT want to miss this opportunity to experience a bucket list item that you didn't know you needed! The office staff was courteous, friendly and well-organized. Our pilot, Liam, put all my small-plane fears to rest with his confidence and very specific commentary throughout the flight. The landing & take off on the glacier were ever so smoooooth! The scenery was something that is inexplicable and making snow angels on the glacier was exhilarating, to say the least! Book this adventure ASAP and enjoy your snowball fight with the whitest snow you've ever seen!
Dan was an excellent guide and pilot! What an awesome experience! The flight was smooth - the views and memories are priceless! By all means do this trip!!!

Very professional from booking by phone months earlier. We arrived, and everything went like clockwork. Our pilot, Luke, explained everything preflight and narrated our trip as we flew over glaciers and pointed out all the peaks and landmarks. Flying through Ruth Gorge was so cool. We were blessed with sunny weather and a great view of Denali. Landing on the glacier was smooth. Walking around on the glacier put everything in perspective. So worth the extra money. Once in a lifetime experience!!  Thank you Talkeetna Air Taxi.
We were able to book a trip within 24 hours of wanting to do this. Everyone was so helpful and nice. My family had the best time flying with them and we would highly recommend!

review_title: Best Trip Ever. Don’t miss this!
review_text: The Talkeetna Air taxi Denali trip with glacier Landing was absolutely fantastic! This was a spontaneous trip planned once we were there and one we will never forget. From the minute we signed up until the trip was over everyone was super professional and friendly. Landing on the glacier was phenomenal. I would highly recommend this to anyone going to Alaska. We spoke with several guides afterwards and they said  Talkeetna Air Taxi was the best company to book with.

What to say! This flight was amazing!! Liam, our pilot, did an amazing job! Very smooth flight and very knowledgeable. The take offs and landings were perfect! He made it so each side of the plane could get all the views he talked about. Speaking of views! They were breathtaking! If you’re afraid of flying… don’t be here! Just do it! This is something everyone should do and witness at least once in their lives!!

review_title: Glacier Landing so very worth it!
review_text:
We did the South Side Explorer with a Glacier Landing. It was the most amazing one and a half hour trip of our life! It is hard to describe the beauty and majesty of this adventure. We would highly recommend the glacier landing. Our pilot Daniel, was a great guide and made the adventure safe and informative. It was just wonderful. 
Two thumbs up!

Take the otter and land on the glacier. You will not be disappointed. It is so beautiful! No better way to see Denali. Our pilot was outstanding. Expensive but well worth the money! Highly recommended.
Fantastic experience, friendly and knowledgeable staff. A must do for all Alaska visitors. All the arrangements worked perfectly

review_title: Eat experience info an already incredible trip
review_text: This was the best experience of an already incredible trip.  The scenery, the experience, our Pilot Paul, all made it a lifetime memory.

Experience of a lifetime even with extreme fear and trepidation.  Bonded immediately w Shanny who checked us in.  She has such a sweet, calming, generous presence.  All the employees were very kind and welcoming.  Dan, the pilot, was very professional and interesting.  Book this adventure - you will not regret it!

Don’t second guess whether you should take this flight…you will regret it! So much more than we expected and Dan our pilot is so knowledgeable. Spectacular views and perspective than you can only grasp from the air. Great trip and staff!

review_title: Exciting is to say the least!
review_text: Wow! Just blew our minds.  Besides being a fabulous trip the employees were so very accommodating and mindful I will never go with any other company.

An experience you will never regret! If you are military ask for their discount! The pilot was very knowledgeable! And who knew all the activity happening IN the mountains! It is truly a once in a lifetime experience that you must do! Save/splurge the money and just do it, you will not regret it!
It was a spiritual and beautiful trip around and through the mountains. Our pilot was knowledgeable and friendly and flew beautifully!

review_title: Amazing experience, great service, highly recommended
review_text:
The tour was an amazing and thrilling experience. The touring company, their service and the pilot were all very professional and respectful.

The place was easy to find in Talkeetna. Talkeetna itself is on the way from Anchorage to Denali and is very picturesque just like everything else here.

Highly recommended. A++
Great time!  Pilot was amazing and really knew his stuff. Glacier was really cool, beautiful views from up above. I would highly recommend this excursion.

review_title: The only reason I gave them 5 stars was that 6 wasn't an option!
review_text: The professionalism of the staff, crew & pilots at Talkeetna Air Taxi is top notch. When the day before I inquired about the iffy weather, they accommodated me on the next day with an alternate tour & refunded the difference, no questions asked. It was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to fly on a sunny day to Denali & the glacier landing was the highlight of our Alaska trip. Do not hesitate to book with these guys & enjoy the magical experience they offer.

Perfect weather day made for a perfect trip! Asa was an excellent pilot and tour guide. Get super safe and comfortable in the plane (not always a thing for me!) Views were amazing and he made sure both sides of the plane saw all. Landing on the glacier was a highlight of the trip. If your flexible, check in frequently to get a good weather day!
The beautiful landscape that we saw.  Loved the glacier landing.  Pilot was very helpful and informative.
Perfect clear day (we got lucky), this was incredible. Pilot was fantastic, we felt safe the whole time, the views are awe-inspiring, and the glacier landing was a surprisingly cool touch.

What can i say…. Just mesmerizing and heavenly experience that everyone must experience in their lifetime. We were a party of 4 with 2 young boys under 11. 

The process of reservation was really easy with trip advisor, I just got to pick the dates and number of people and thats it. They also had a full refund policy within a certain time limit which i felt was super nice as sometime plans dont go as per schedule with young kids. 

Once the reservation is made then you just show up on time at their office in talkeetna which infact  was super clean with nice bathrooms amd front desk staff was super friendly as well.

The experience started on time, the flight took about 1 to 1.30 and laded us on the glacier and we had 15 mins to play around and click some pictures. I wish we had more time on the glacier that was the draw back i had. But anyways i was glad my boys got to experience their first small plane experience and also landing on the glacier experience at same time. Highly recommend to anyone visting Alaska to add this to their bucket list.

Top notch company in all aspects.  Great communication and advice during planning stages of trip including time of day for trip and type of camera lens to bring.

Unfortunately the weather prevented us from taking the original Grand Denali tour, but the customer service was outstanding with presenting various options and the pros and cons of each.

We are so happy that we opted for the shorter trip that still included the possibility of a glacier landing.  The pilot was great, the views incredible, and landing and walking on a glacier is phenomenal.

Excellent company..since weather was questionable they answered all our concerns and gave us the option to cancel the day of the flight if we felt uncomfortable flying.  However, we chose to fly and it was an awesome experience. We were able to see  Denali and the Alaskan mountain range. Alex, our pilot provided great narration and a smooth flight.
I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi.
.

This will go down in history as one of the most exciting things I have ever done. The views were just spectacular. Every twist and turn was jaw dropping. Our pilot, Asa, was great. Smooth take off and landing on the glacier. Don't skip out on landing on the glacier. It was so amazing, and something that I will never forget. Everything was smooth from arriving at the airport to our return. Friendly and helpful staff.  Do not miss out on the adventure of a lifetime.

My experience was awful. The pilot literally ignored every sentence I had spoken and pretended like we were invisible. He was only friendly to another family that were on the plane with us and offered to take pictures for them and held conversations with them. Meanwhile, the only time he has spoken to us was to check people off before boarding. Through the entire flight, he had treated me and my mother as if we were invisible, not responding to a single thing we said, and did not even look in our direction. Conveniently, my mother and I were the only people of color on the aircraft. I was extremely disappointed at this and had went to the office to file a complaint immediately after we got off. Interestingly, he walked past me as I was talking to someone in  the office and, again, acted like I did not exist. It was an extremely unprofessional and outrageously offensive behavior for a tour company. It was humiliating and degrading. I would not recommend it to anyone I know and certainly would not return. I cannot believe I paid a lot of money to be treated like this.

Loved the flight and glacier landing with Pilot Chris. The staff at TAT are very friendly and accommodating.  We had and awesome time. Great commentary as we were flying there and back. This is a must do.
Excellent company. All about safety. Great views. Smooth ride. Awesome pilot - Chris. We were unable to land on the glacier and a credit was already there.

This was an absolute blast! I had the benefit of riding in the co-pilot seat. Amazing view, a new experience, and nothing to complain about.
We didn't get to land on the glacier, but that was OK with me, since I didn't have to battle for the amazing co-pilot seat on the way back.  Worth every penny!

review_title: Nice views, but don't count on the glacier landing.
review_text: Nice flight. Easy take off and landing.  Viewed the  top of Denali. Disappointed that we could not land on glacier but safety first.
This was the best money I have spent for a vacation adventure! Every detail was top of the line and our pilot was outstanding!

review_title: Fun glacier landing trip with a great pilot
review_text:
Another lucky day. They canceled all morning flights because of the sky visibility, but we got lucky not only able to take off but also to land on a glacier. 
Our pilot 🧑‍✈️ Tim was excellent. He briefed us with some funny jokes and his fun character. Once onboard, he used an internal communication system to tell stories/history of the mountains 🗻. The whole trip was smooth and enjoyable. We landed on the glacier after going around two rounds; double checked the safety. On the way back, after knowing our desire to see moose and bear, he went around the Delina national pack to help us to get closer to finding the animals. (although, I was only able to see one or two moose from far away) it was a fun trip. ❤️

The program was highly recommended to us and we arranged our travel plans to plan for unexpected weather.
The experience was wonderful.
I have vertigo and by using my medicine (antivert), I was able to tolerate the ride and enjoy the experience. The staff was very reassuring and spent time on the phone as well as when I arrived. I felt safe.
Trip was a beautiful view of the Denali mountain range with a spectacular landing on the glacier. Melissa was an awesome pilot and guide. Would highly recommend the glacier landing.

We had a super calm and clear day, so this was a home run.  Company seems extremely well run and tour was perfectly executed.

I would recommend this if the weather is clear and calm -- you fly right by Denali with views you won't soon forget.

There isn't much to say here, except the experience was fantastic. Seeing the landscape from the air was breathtaking, and landing and taking off from the glacier was a hoot. Our pilot, Melissa was superbly qualified and a real pleasure to fly with.  We were fortunate to have exquisite weather. Do this!

review_title: If you have the money, this is a must
review_text: They were very accommodating and got us on a flight the next morning after our train was delayed and we missed our initial flight.  It was absolutely beautiful.  Definitely a high light of our trip.  I would do this again in a heartbeat.  We were so thankful that there were no clouds and we had a great look.

This is one of the best experiences my wife and I have ever done.  The sights were absolutely incredible. Our pilot, Leigh Ann was terrific. She put all of us at ease about flying through the mountains. The flight was as smooth as it could be. The glacier landing was so much fun. This was the highlight of the trip.

review_title: The best attraction during my visit in Alaska
review_text:
Absolutely number ONE of our all activities during the trip in Alaska.
The weather was great, which was the most important factor to have this flight.
Our pilot was a girl. She was a great pilot and great tourist guide! Thumbs up!
Her knowledge was deep. Hers pilot skills great too!
Landing on the glacier was as smooth as possible.
Every second of this flight was precious. Many pictures and many memories.
This is a "must do" attraction in Alaska!

RomanP

We had a party of 7 consisting of a 10, 11, and 12 year old, 2 40somethings, and 2 70 year olds.  We all had a great time with Tim, and had a fun snowball fight on the glacier.  Take note, they do require masks still, which irritated me a bit until I talked to them, and they explained that the staff was getting sick and then they were having to cancel flights.  They dropped the masks when the FAA told them they could, then brought them back.  This is understandable, and I gave them a pass because as a business owner, I get that it is difficult to keep a business staffed right now.  We were not in the lucky percentage that was able to see Denali, because it was cloudy, but overall, the views were still great.  One of the top excursions that we got to do.

Absolutely incredible!!!! This was a "must-do" for my husband. I was hesitant (don't love small planes), but my kids really wanted to go. I am so glad we went! The views were incredible and the glacier landing was unbelievable. The best part, though, was the people. Our pilot, Chris, was awesome as was the staff that got us ready to fly. One of my kids has a medical issue and we had some concerns. I called a few times with questions and they were wonderful. On the day of, they talked to me about it (obviously made a note on our booking) and even had us talk to the pilot before take-off!! They really went above and beyond to make sure we had a fantastic experience!
We are a family of 5. Kids are 16, 14, 11.

This is a must do. We were very fortunate to have a sunny day and were part of the lucky 30% that got to see Denali. Chris, our pilot was very knowledgeable and a great pilot. This was the best excursion of our entire trip.
Great time. We were lucky the weather cleared up.  The pilot was awesome and knowledgeable. The Glacier landing was a once in a lifetime experience.

Extraodinary!!!  We flew in late June and had the most memorable excursion. Our pilot, Leah,  was professional, knowledgeable and a lot of fun. It was somewhat cloudy and cool  when we took off but was crystal clear and mild when we landed on the glacier. The snow on the glacier was perfect for snowballs, we ended up with a friendly snowball fight with another planes passengers. Spectacular views at the base of Denali were awe-inspiring. Would definitely do this tour again!!
Really enjoyed the flight and landing on the glacier. Expensive but really beautiful. Stunning scenery, Plan held 10 each person has their own window for photos.

I was surprised and very pleased to land on a glacier.  It was late October; a fresh snow blanked the terrain the night before the flight.   On the return flight, I overheard our seasoned pilot express the trip saying, "lots of action", I completely agreed.  The sun illuminated freshly covered granite mountain peaks, after the snow fall with a few low-lying clouds.  Plus seeing a high overview of glacier details. Just fantastic!

I flew towards the end of September, very late season but it was really fun!  It was unfortunately a very gusty day in the valley, so we had a fair amount of bumps(which you really notice in a smaller plane) which caused another passenger to get sick.  Fortunately, they carry motion sick bags and things to clean up.  

The actual landing on the glacier was super smooth and it was calm inside.   So glad these were still offered while I was there.  Highly recommend!

The most exciting things we have ever experienced, flying to and landing on Ruth Glacier!!  The flight around and into where we landed was simply breathtaking.  We had great weather and a terrific pilot, who also served as our tour guide. Hope to make it back someday.  Thank for a once in a lifetime adventure, Talkeetna Air Taxi!!

review_title: The most exhilarating way to see Denali
review_text:
The flight to Denali was spectacular.  The mountians were so close you thought the wings might touch them - WRONG they were miles away but that mountain is a BEAST.  The pilot was knowledgeable and a delight to talk with.

Landing on Ruth Glacier at the Amphitheater was worth every penny.  It was a life time experience. Pro Tip - don't try to write your name in the snow.  ;  )

We were lucky enough to move our flight a couple days earlier, as they day we were booked was supposed to be cloudy. We did an 8 am flight, and it was completely worth the early morning. When we arrived they let us know that they upgraded up to a glacier landing. It was such an amazing experience. I'm normally a nervous flier, but our pilot was so calm and comforting throughout the flight. Landing on the glacier was truly an experience, but just the flight alone was breathtaking.

This was our 2nd trip with TAT this year.  We had more friends from the Lower 48 arrive in September and we took them on the South side Explorer w/Glacier Landing.  We had absolutely stunning weather, even clearer than in early June - not a cloud in the sky.  Denali was completely visible, even as we drove down the highway to Talkeetna.  There is no better outfit to experience this majestic mountain with than TAT.  Our pilot was terrific and it was obvious to everyone on board that she LOVES her job!

This was amazing! We were on a limited budget but decided this was a once in a lifetime 
activity, and we have no regrets about the cost. 
The woman on the ground who gave us our 
glacier boots was so nice, and the pilot Matt was a great tour guide. Landing on a glacier is amazing and an experience you won't regret. I had the opportunity to co-pilot on the way back, and got to see the take off of a glacier from the cockpit. It was an amazing experience, thank you!!

This is an unbelievable experience flying through glacier fields and mountain peaks. Landing on the glacier with a magnificent view of Mt. Denali is just amazing. We were fortunate enough to do this on a crystal clear Fall afternoon.
A fantastic memorable experience! They were so kind to hold our luggage while we were on the flight. Great customer service. Highly recommended!
Best time I have ever had on Vacation. Definitely worth the money and amazing views and amazing staff.

review_title: Breath taking views and amazing customer service
review_text:
The best experience was had by all in our group. 7 of us, flew with a few others to see Denali and experience a glacial landing.  The sights were beyond amazing and there were moments it felt you could reach right out and touch the mountain tops. Andy, our pilot was great at making sure both sides of the plane experienced the views. 

My son had the misfortune of losing his phone in the snow during the glacial landing (maybe because he was enjoying the snow so much with his cartwheels and power slides).  We didn't realize this until it was time to get back in the plane and there wasn't time for him to look for it.  Thankfully, this wasn't the end of the story.  When we got back to the terminal, we spoke to the ladies at the desk and were able to get them to give my son's watch to someone going out again to see if they could ping it.  My son waited, not to patiently, for the next hour or so to see if anyone was able to find his phone.  We received a call a little while later to inform us that Andy, our pilot, had gone back out with another group and was able to locate it!! Talk about amazing customer service. 

The whole experience with them was beyond our expectations. I wouldn't use any other company as I'm a loyal fan for life now. 

You won't regret booking with Talkeetna Air Taxi.

review_title: Ruth Glacier Landing Offering South Side View Of Mt. Denali & The Alaskan Range
review_text: This was the best adventure ever... you've got to do the glacier landing.  We landed on Ruth Glacier, which was so incredible that words cannot describe the experience! The spectacular views of Mt. Denali & the Alaskan Mtn Range were simply incredible... to be up there amongst the clouds, snow, beautiful peaks was beyond words... spectacular awesome experience!  Our pilot (Paul) was awesome... he explained what we were viewing all the way to the glacier, while on the glacier & en-route on the way back from Ruth Glacier.  You can tell Paul's heart & soul are into his job of piloting folks to make their dreams come true of landing on a glacier & viewing one of mother nature's most spectacular creations... the Alaskan Mountain Range with the highest peak in North America (Mt. Denali) to be enabled to have a spectacular view of it all.  THANKS Paul & Talkeetna Air for making one of my life-long dreams come true on this incredible flight & landing!  Oh yea... and also a sincere thanks for your incredible Alaskan Hospitality... all very much appreciated!  Keep on doing what you're doing... it is much appreciated!!!

Awesome experience! My group was scheduled for the grand Denali tour, however, due to weather  conditions we were only able to complete the south side explorer. The difference in price was automatically refunded. Our pilot, Leighan, was really great, knowledgeable, and safety conscious. If we’re ever back in Alaska I would 100% fly with Talkeetna Air Taxi again!

This excursion was amazing!  Beautiful views and the glacier landing was incredible!  Alex, our pilot, was informative and professional and we felt completely safe!  We would highly recommend this once in a lifetime experience!  It’s pricey but totally worth it!

WOW! Cust Svc!!
Call AM day: Come later? Clouds go. Best views. YES!
EZ pay, VALUE!””
Flght AMAZING!
This was an amazing activity to finish up our Alaska vacation! The views were incredible, the pilot was a great guide, and the glacier landing was a once in a lifetime experience.

review_title: Amazing!! Absolute MUST DO in Talkeetna!! Don't even think about it!
review_text:
Absolute Must do in Talkeetna. Don't even think about it. 
The glacier landing is awesome and I'm not sure why they have it as optional. It's worth every penny. The pilot was great and the flight smooth and gave everyone a great view of Denali so that no one was missed out. Landing on the glacier is once in a life time and it makes for a great experience. Surrounded by the mountains upclose makes you feel how tiny we all are.

Friendly staff, Great pilot.  Very enjoyable. 
Recommend TAT and the experience. 
Great close up of the mountains. Landing on a Glacier is a neat experience. 
The mountain was out (DENALI) , which made the flight great

review_title: Highly recommend. It’s all worth to what you pay.
review_text: I had a Life change experience yesterday. An Surreal experience with Air Taxi’s nicely systemized program and the experienced pilot , Shaun.  I am still processing….

We have travelled all over the world and without a doubt this is truly one of the most amazing things we have ever done.  The scenery was incredible.  We had a group of 17 people this activity and everyone of us were in awe.  The pilots were amazing .

review_title: Even Better than Expected Trip and Pictures
review_text:
Wow, fantastic Tour.  The views and photos are even better than expected (even from a phone). Every seat has a window which bubbles out to get great shots. The ride was smooth and not scary at all, like being in a national geographic movie.  Definitely bring a jacket as if land you will be walking in snow with a cool breeze even in August.

The staff was great, very friendly, but safety first and your satisfaction a close 2nd. If there is any doubt on the weather or even if the viewing will be great, they give you an option to reschedule or cancel if you can't. They also provided snow overboots and good narratives on the area during the flight.

Best part of our trip. Will do another trip with them when we come back.

review_title: Very Professional and an Amazing Experience!
review_text: Loved this! I highly recommend! Paul, Annie and crew were amazing! Flown with these guys several times and each time they have done an amazing job! Keep it up guys!

review_title: A Once In a Lifetime Experience
review_text: Absolutely Amazing!!!  While I was totally petrified to ride in a small plane, I am so happy  I went. Chris, our pilot, was very professional and a knowledgable tour guide. Being able to see vthe alley from the air was not only beautiful but provided insight into how people live in Alaska.  When will you ever get the chance to land a plane on a Glacier and be so close to Mount Denali?

The plane ride was an event of a lifetime! The pilot was very pleasurable, easy going, made everyone feel like family. The sites are so awesome, glaciers, clouds, mountains. The landing was so worth the extra expense.

What an experience! We were scheduled to fly on the 8/8 but due to the storm, TAT rescheduled our flight. Thanks to an amazing pilot, everybody in our party of ten were mesmerized by the views and the glacial landing. Thank you!
smooth flight from a bada@@ woman pilot.  Info on the mountain and amazing views. The flight was safe and clean.  Easy check-in and on time tour

At the time of booking, we were debating about the drive and cost. But believe me it was worth every penny. Topping that was the friendly staff, awesome pilot from Florida Prof. Melissa. She was an excellent guide and kept the trip lively. Smooth landing, history tour. Overall a great experience.
Enjoy the nature while you can.

The most incredible experience! The plane was comfortable, smooth ride and the landing was so fun! Some of the most beautiful sights I have ever seen. Highly recommend this to anyone. Thank you to Shaun who was our pilot that day - he was incredible and I felt extremely safe as a passenger.

Wow, we got very blessed with a break in the clouds that we could see Denali, most of the mountains and land on the glacier.  Our original day was canceled due to bad weather and they squeezed us in on our only other available time.  Even with getting up at 5am & droving back up from Anchorage, this experience was worth it! Pilot was great, views were amazing and standing on a glacier is priceless.

Wow!  What an incredible flight my daughters and I had with Paul.   He went out of his way to show us amazing views and even catch some sunshine on the glacier.   I'm a little afraid of small planes, but felt completely safe.   If you have the chance, take the time to do this!

review_title: Best way to see McKinley and visualize how glaciers move (suggestion - sit on the right side)
review_text: Absolutely excellent excursion! 10 starts! We were on our way to Denali park and found out about the air tours by Talkeetna air. Unfortunately the website showed that they were all booked, but when I called they were able to find seats for myself and two kids on a later flight. It was a beautiful clear day in the 70's - so the views were spectacular. They suggested to wear pants and a light jacket - but it was warm enough for a t-shirt even on the glacier. Kids loved playing snowballs and making snow angels. My only suggestion would be to sit on the right side if you can. I feel like our pilot was mostly pointing to views, mountains, rivers on that side. Although the views were beautiful everywhere. Everybody at the Talkeetna Air was very friendly and professional. Highly recommend! I also agree with some other reviews that it's the best way to see McKinley mountain and see glaciers and truly understand how glaciers move.
This was incredible. The sights are breathtaking, and the pilots are great, passionate about what they do, and very knowledgeable. The glacier landing is essential!!

review_title: Extremely cool way to spend a morning
review_text: An excellent experience. We had to cancel once because of weather, but they were able to reschedule us the next day. Once you get over the glaciers and into the mountains around Denali, the views and specatcle are jaw-dropping. There are some points where you are surrounded by sheer ice/snow walls. Then you land on a glacier in the shadow of the tallest mountain in North America. Simply amazing.

Views from the air were absolutely breathtaking
 Glacier landing was such a unique and fun experience!

review_title: A MUST DO and fun for kids
review_text:
I'm a planner. I planned and booked a kick @ss trip through Alaska with my partner and his kids (10, 14). However, as we headed toward Talkeetna, I realized that I hadn't planned much between staying there and then going to Denali, which is a pretty short drive. Our trip was going so great that I went online and saw that taking a plane tour with a glacier landing was a thing we could do from Talkeetna. On a whim, I checked to see the availability, thinking it would likely be a bust a most tours I booked I had to book MONTHS in advance and had slim pickings. 

Nope! Was able to book a flight for the next day. OMG-highlight of our trip. The 14 year old even got out his phone to... wait for it... take pictures!  We'd kayaked to a glacier and seen countless amazing things so far and this is the ONE time he actually took pics--that tells you how amazing it was. 

This is THE way to see what a glacier really is and to also get a terrific view of Denali. Every other way is just so chancy.

Anyway, maybe scrap a few other things and splurge for this--it's amazing.

Both my mom and I had a wonderful experience. I booked the trip very last minute, so glad I did. It was amazing to be alongside the snow-covered mountain. This is not cheap, but definitely worth every penny. The glacier landing was cool although it didn't feel much different from snow landing since the glacier is literally covered by the snow. I just wish we could have a bit more time on the glacier. The view was amazing, and the weather was perfect that day. Too bad we only got to spend 20 minutes there. Felt a bit rushed. We had a female pilot. She was very experienced. We felt really safe, no bumpy rides at all.

We did a lot of epic stuff during our two-week stay in Alaska -- halibut fishing, dog sledding, kayaking, fly fishing, wildlife tours. But this tops the list. I know it's a big chunk of change, but it truly is worth it. 

We were blessed with an extraordinarily clear day, so maybe I'm a bit biased. But getting to see Alaska up close and from above is something I just can't put into words.

TAT was great to work with, too. Our original tour was cancelled due to weather. They were able to accommodate us on another day. So if you book this, make sure you have flexibility in your itinerary for a backup day or two!

After our Friday morning trip was cancelled, we went on up to Denali NP as planned. But we only stayed 2 nights instead of 3. We instead spent that night in Talkeetna and were able to get up the next morning for an early flight tour.

Originally scheduled with another company, communication was lacking and flight was changed.  I called Talkeetna Air Taxi to see if they were glacier landing on the day of our flight, yes they were and had a same day opening within two hours!  The staff was super helpful and very accommodating for our last minute booking!  Had great conversations and laughs with Amanda while waiting for our flight. Our pilot Alex was great, very informative, smooth flight and landings! This special trip was made even better by everyone we interacted with, I would take this trip again in a heartbeat!
Well managed and friendly staff.  Pilot Timmy was very educational and provide a smooth flight and landings   Fantastic experience for the family that ranged from 18 to 75 years old.

review_title: A must do if your in alaska
review_text:
My favorite part? 
From beginning all the way to end.
AMAZING!!!
I will do this again,  if given the opportunity

Our trip was outstanding!! From the person who checked us in, the Gal who was handing out boots, and the people helping us on and off the plane. Everyone was pleasant.. Tim, our pilot was funny and engaging. He answered ALL of our questions. He was fabulous with the kids that were flying. I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi.

We visited Alaska last week and booked this Glacier landing tour just a day before. It turned out to be the best moments of our visit to Alaska, with mesmerising and spectacular views of the Denali Summit and ice clad mountain ranges. It looked like approaching heaven, as the flight approached the ranges. Landing on the Glacier was out of the world experience. If you are visiting Alaska, you can’t miss this experience.

Talkeetna Air taxi was very professional and made our entire experience very smooth and worth cherishing for entire life.

review_title: Don’t Miss Out When Visiting Alaska!
review_text: Our experience with Talkeetna Air Taxi was outstanding. Pilot Sean did a great job navigating us to the peaks of Denali and landing us on Ruth Glacier. Nonstop fantastic views. If you are visiting Alaska, just do this! Highly recommend.

Breathtaking views from the airplane, landing on the pristine Ruth glacier.  Our pilot was a capable fantastic gal who pointed out vistas & geological features.  She was full of information and enthusiasm, but most importantly, she was safe and smooth in every way. From take off to landing she displayed smooth, delicate flying skills. Those mountains are high. The crevices are deep and small planes are usually quite frightening for me. But, this pilot was so skilled that I enjoyed every minute. Bravo!

review_title: Highly recommended! Even without a glacier landing!!
review_text: TAT was so flexible when the weather was not so favorable. Offered to reschedule or get a complete refund. Flew later with hopes of a glacier landing, our pilot did all he could do to land, but all landing areas were socked in. We had a refund for the landing as soon as we landed.  Chris was an excellent pilot/guide. Very knowledgeable, entertaining and enthusiastic about flying in this incredible area. Our evening flight produced wonderful views of Denali and the other peaks after climbing through the clouds. A true highlight of our visit to the Denali area. Very much worth it, even without the landing!
Talkeetna Air Taxi personel, made our trip an experience we will remember. Our pilot Leighan was amazing and very knowledgeable. Office staff, was accommodating and friendly.

What a fantastic experience! You really want to see Denali NP as few ever will? Then do this. Worth every penny. 

I’ve spent time in Greenland and Antarctica, in places few can even get to unless there on science and if you want to see what the Arctic and the highest mountains in  the world look like, this is the easiest and safest way to do it. Plus, you get to ride in a Dehavilland Otter, a legendary aircraft. 

I’m an instrument rated pilot, and I was super impressed with their safety. They have the right equipment to do this and do it very safely. That does not come cheap, but as I said, it’s worth it.

review_title: This is a must do part of your Alaska trip!
review_text: Ever been on a hike and while in awe of the beauty of what you could see still wondered what was on the other side of the experience?  This is the solution.  This 90 minute trip provided an amazing perspective on ALL of Denali, and the enormity and beauty of how it all fits together.  Take the glacier landing if you can.  It is worth it.  I am a pilot, and I would add that the experience and skill of the pilot was both impressive and reassuring.  Whether you intend to hike and camp in the Park, or only have one day to see it, this is the essential first experience!

This is the 15th time taking my group for a glacier landing using Talkeetna Air Taxi and they do an excellent job.  The pilots are knowledgeable and very skillful in their flying ability and give a great deal of narration during the flight.  Always the highlight of traveling to Alaska is taking TAT for a glacier landing.

This experience was the best!  This was a smooth ride all the way to the snow-covered mountains and then landing on the glacier.  This was a huge highlight of my trip.  So
glad I could do this.
Absolutely superb adventure. You’ve never done anything like this. And the company was great and safe and enjoyable.Highly highly recommend it.
This was a great tour!  One of the highlights of our Alaska trip. Very professional company and pilot. Highly recommend!

It was the highlight of our trip!  Amazing views, and we were given 20 minutes or so to walk around on the glacier, which was incredible.  Plus, we got to see Denali right up close.  Phenomenal!  Also, great service overall too.  The day we had planned to go was cloudy, and Talkeetna Air Taxi called 3+ hours in advance to let us know we likely wouldn't be able to land on the glacier, so they gave us options to do just the flight or try to rebook the next day.  We had availability in our schedules the next day, so we booked for 6pm, although I had let them know it would be ideal if something opened up in their schedules for earlier in the day.  Fortunately, there was an opening that popped up at 3:30pm, and they called to get my group moved earlier to the ideal spot.  Great customer service and communication!  The ideal excursion and well worth the money.

The flight seeing and glacier landing was definitely the highlight and the best thing we did on our trip ! Staff at Talkeetna Air Taxi was helpful, all the way from checkin, boots fitting and not to mention the pilot who took us on the incredible flight. The close up views of the glaciers and Mt Denali were breathtaking and unbelievable. I highly recommend this tour and Talkeetna Air Taxi to anyone who wishes to explore the glaciers up close.

This was one of the best things we did during our two week Alaska vacation. We were blessed with a beautiful clear day and thoroughly enjoyed the trip from start to finish. Pilot was professional and informative and he made the trip a pleasure. Landing on the glacier was amazing and breathtakingly beautiful. Well worth it!

Went with Talkeetna Air for the South Side Explorer flight and wow! All the staff was super friendly and great. Our pilot was so informative and I felt safe with him in control. The flight itself was unreal. I'm a nervous flier and scared of heights, so it was a little nerve wrecking for me. But all of that was 100% worth it. We were able to see the summit and the pilot flew around several times to give us amazing views. We also did the glacier landing which was incredible. It was a once in a lifetime experience!

My 4th time flying onto the mountain with TAT for a Denali climb.  Simply the best.  The most experience, the most flights, the most planes, the nicest pilots, the best facility, the best staff. I love them all. Paul, Annie et al are just wonderful to work with.  Being a private trip, and not guided, I rely upon all my contacts, especially TAT. They shuttle my gear around town, they have a bunkhouse available if needed for climbers, they stay in touch in the months leading up to climbing season. The cost is roughly the same no matter who you choose; why wouldn't you fly in a large Otter capable of flying in adverse surface conditions?
Flying near Denali and glacier landing.  Very informative and beautiful views of Denali.  Would highly recommend

I was able to sign up for this at the last minute AND go on a day when Denali was not shrouded in cloud cover.  I volunteered to sit in the front seat, which is the place to be on this flight.  We all loved landing on the glacier and taking in that surreal and sunny world. The ground and air service were efficient, friendly and very professional.  Our pilot narrated what we were seeing, which was helpful, since it’s not easy to know what in the world you’re looking at when things look so new to you.  We flew very close to the mountains but I was never scared.  I feel very fortunate to have had the occasion to do this. Family and friends love those videos the best of everything I did in Alaska.
Good service.  Ask to sit shotgun.   Felt safe the whole time.   Even on cloudy day w limited viewing I enjoyed this big ticket item.

This experience is tough to put into words.  Amazing, fantastic, unbelievable, stunning, breathtaking, exciting and many others are all adjectives that can be used.  Just like when you take pictures of Denali and the surrounding area don’t do it justice, well neither do those adjectives in trying to describe what you see during this flight.  While it is a bit more money to add on the glacier landing, I guarantee you will not regret it afterwards.  Our pilot, LeAnn (a third generation pilot) was extremely warm and friendly.  Her narrative as we flew was educational and very insightful.  The supporting staff of Talkeetna Air Taxi were attentive and professional.  If you have come all this way to see the Mountain, take it to the next step and take advantage of what Talkeetna Air Taxi has to offer.

Stunning!  Beautiful day, great flight, great pilot.  I was a little hesitant to take this trip because I was very nervous.  The hesitancy was gone the minute we left.  The flight was smooth, the scenery breathtaking and the glacier landing magnificent.  I was blown away by the scenery.

Talkeetna Air Taxi has over a thousand glowingly positive reviews, and they're all true. This was one of the most amazing experiences of my life. The flying was smooth, the landing was smooth, the sights were incredible. Landing and walking on that glacier was one of the best tourist experiences I have ever had in the 47 states and 38 countries I've been to. 

Just note that like any domestic flight, they ask that you come 45 minutes before your departure time and masks are required in the terminal and on the plane. We could take our masks off on the glacier so long as we social distanced, which was not a problem as the glacier is massive.

This flight provided such beautiful views of the Alaska range, Denali, the Ruth glacier, and Talkeetna! Wonderful service from start to finish, they were very accommodating when we asked to change our flight times to better accommodate travel plans. Check in was easy, staff were very friendly, and the operation went smoothly. Our pilot was Alex, he made the small plane feel so steady and gave us great views of the peaks. The glacier landing was very smooth and the experience was unforgettable. Would definitely recommend. Thank you to Talkeetna Air Taxi!!

review_title: The best view of Denali with the best pilot.
review_text: The pilot, Leanne. She is phenomenal. Looking at her, all 90 lbs soaking wet, you won't believe she is a pilot. She made the flight an unforgetable experience. I would do it again in a heart beat.

This was a fantastic flight & landing on the glacier. The pilot was so good at taking off & landing smoothly. He was a sweet guy & gave us great information on the mountains & terrain. I highly recommend this tour company. We loved it!

review_title: Break the bank, but don't miss it.
review_text:
What can I say that others haven't already said.  We have spent 10 days in Alaska (first time) and this was the absolute highlight.  Flight was beautiful beyond belief.  I originally did not plan on the glacier landing, but it was really cool.  Our pilot was a great host and perfect flying through the mountains and did a really excellent job of making sure people on both sides of the plane got a good view.  Flight was smoother than expected.  I can't recommend it to highly.
Small tip:  make sure your ear phones do not come unplugged and you miss the commentary.

review_title: Mount Denali in all her glory shined bright!
review_text: This is truly a must-do!!!  Do not skimp, just do it -- try to find a sunny day and book!!!  The views, the landing smooth as glass --- the climbers look like ants from above ;-) Try and choose a sunny day without clouds.....We are part of the 30percent club to see Denali 3 days straight but close up by air is the way to go!  Clay our pilot made the trip extra special -- very knowledgeable, talkative, and we felt very safe!
Fantastic experience. Right from the check in desk to the flight landing the entire experience was great. Special shout out to Amanda for her patience and willingness to help. Highly recommend

This experience was the highlight of my trip to Alaska. The staff were so knowledgeable. Our pilot Alex did a phenomenal job flying and knew a lot about the area. I definitely recommend landing on the glacier, it’s a once in a life time experience.
Wonderful experience!! Must visit!! Friendly people!! Pilot has lot of knowledge about the glacier and its surroundings! Will be once in a life visit

This was absolutely the experience of a lifetime.  Talkeetna Air Taxi was wonderful and our pilot,  Clay, made the experience even better.  We really lucked out with the weather.  Not a cloud in the sky. Truly an amazing adventure.

review_title: A bucket list experience we didn't expect
review_text: We were hesitant to take this adventure because of the cost but OMG we are so glad that we did! It was truly an amazing adventure. There's no describing it- you just have to do it! Definitely a bucket list experience that we didn't expect.
Seeing the top of the mountain range was an incredible experience.  But landing on the glacier near Mt. Denali was magical.

Our party walked up last minute purely because we were interested in the plane. Leighan (the pilot) greeted us with a smile and sent us to Courtney. So glad these two convinced us to go on this adventure. Courtney went above and beyond for us and hooked us up with all the gear we didn't have. We were skeptical of the "coolest thing you'll ever see" but they absolutely delivered on that promise. Leighan is a total badass and the one of the nicest people you'll ever meet. She answered every question we had, from aviation to climbing and everything in-between, and it was one of the smoothest flights I've ever been on. Words and pictures do not do this tour justice. GO DO IT!!

My best friend and I booked a last minute tour and were absolutely amazed by the experience.

The staff were very friendly, professional, and trustworthy. Can't recommend this group enough!

Kind and enthusiastic and extremely helpful people are just the start -- Courtney in the office rocks! The flight was smooth and special, providing a memory a minute with jaw-dropping sites. A few locals in Talkeetna suggested TAT, and now we know why. They gave us an unforgettable experience.

review_title: Awesome - in the true sense of the word
review_text: No words to describe this spectacular 90 minutes into the Denali National Park, and onto the glacier for a super cool landing. Will, our pilot, was excellent, as were all the staff as we checked in and finished up. Highly recommended, once in a lifetime experience.
One of a kind experience! Despite all of the COVID restrictions, it was an incredible tour. The weather was on our side and we had a chance to see Denali.

review_title: Like an Eagle to Eagle Point
review_text:
Really enjoyed the trip with Scenic Airline to Grand Canyon West and Skywalk. Marvelous view from above on Hoover Dam and the desert. Flying with their Twin-Otter 19-seater is like in the good old days - personal greetings from the captain and then straight out to the aircraft. If passengers assemble earlier, the flight goes earlier. All electronics are allowed because “the plane is older than any of your electronic devices” 
 I recommend taking on of the later timed tours because the the sun is in your back (creating a fabulously colorful scenery and not blending you)

review_title: Best airplane ride with fantastic views!
review_text: The airplane tour was fantastic and the pilots super fun and friendly! We had a great time and awesome views! It was totally worth it! The little plane is less expensive than the helicopter and just can’t go as low but the ride is longer and views of the canyon just as stunning!
It was a great experience to see the Grand Canyon from the air, once in a lifetime experience.  The plane was a small 19 seater with panoramic window views.

review_title: Fabulous Full Day Trip - Air flight Over GC, Breath Taking Hike, Float Through Glen Canyon - Don't Miss It
review_text: The one hour plane flight over the Grand Canyon was the highlight of our 4 day Grand Canyon Trip. Captain Sam and First Officer Zach were incredible hosts and made the trip for my grand daughter very, very special. This was a my gift to her for her graduation from college. The views from the plane were fantastic. My second favorite part of the entire trip was this trip's hike through Lower Antelope Canyon - so unusual and beautiful. The guides for all three parts - air, hike and float - were outstanding. Don't miss this trip if you can afford it - it's well worth the price tag.

We had a fantastic time. The pilot was great! All of our tour guides were very informative. I'm glad we went on this trip and would definitely recommend it.  My 12 year old loved it!  Make sure to bring extra snacks, water,  sunscreen, clothes, and a phone charger. There are outlets on the bus but very little service.

review_title: Find another boat tour. Too much travel time.
review_text:
Be sure you realize that you will be on a bus for 9 plus hours. 
Be prepared that the ride on the boat has 47 degree water splashing on you.
Nice scenery if you have properly prepared. We had an awful time. 
Too much time setting on a Bus with crazy kids running the aisle.
We were so happy with this tour!! Lots of great views and informative guides. Guides were knowledgeable in great photo ops! Well worth the price!

This was amazing! Presley was great and super friendly! The flight over the Grand Canyon was beautiful, Antelope Canyon was like being in a different world and Trey was our guide through there….he showed us some of the best views to get great pictures…. Kelly took us out on the boat and let me just tell you, it was amazing! This was soooo worth it!

We added on extra on to the tour. The additional was a 45 minutes plane ride through the Grand Canyon, landing at Page, Arizona. While you have to meet the tour guides at the airport at 5:45, it was so worth it. At Page, we saw the massive Glen Canyon dam and Lake Powell followed by a walk through the otherworldly Upper Antelope Canyon sandstone that nature has carved. Then we took a 4 to 4 1/2 hours float trip down the Colorado River, seeing feral horses and petraglyhs carved by Indians in the canyon walls. The guides were all courteous and highly informative. Best day long tour ever!

I experienced the Grand Canyon many years ago so it was time to experience it again with my family. We were picked up at our hotel and driven to the airport. It was a short drive but gave us a chance to see the surrounding area. The flight was uneventful thankfully, it was about 30 minutes to the canyon but enabled us to see Lake Mead and the dam. The flight over the canyon was about 45 minutes. One side had the view going and the other on the way back. It was quite amazing but it was difficult to gauge the depth. Steven our pilot was excellent adding information to the pre recorded info. 
 It was not the least expensive activity we did but well worth the trip. 
  If you can make sure you are not in the second row from the front or all your photos will have the wing support in them. 
  If you can make time for something different.

We booked a flight for our family of 4. We were greeted kindly at check in, met our pilot Captain Jack and took off on a great adventure! 

My 16 yo daughter is about to venture into flight lessons, so when they offered her the seat up front she was giddy. Captain Jack made us all comfortable and took us on a very smooth and informative flight.

The rest of the fam had a great time too! The canyon is not to be missed from this pov!
