review_title: Full package worth hefty price tag
review_text: As probably a once in a lifetime visit we did the full package which although expensive we felt we got full value. Pick up from Las Vegas hotel  to Boulder City 30min or so then a small plane ride passing over Hoover dam. Great views and get to see the Canyon and the approach to it. Both had window seats for great views. Helicopter ride along Canyon then down into it for landing and a boat trip of 30 min or so. Spectacular views and felt we were the only ones there. Quiet season but most people at top of rim. Helicopter back  out then 2 hrs to explore viewpoints around the West Rim before plane trip back and drop off at hotel. Each bit of the package gave a different perspective but maybe river view with Indian boat guide gave the least touristy viewpoint

So we booked this through the Xanterra site that you get when you go to the Grand Canyon National Park site and look for activities. Right now it says that it's not available: what happened to us is that it was unavailable until spring, when they settle on the price etc. for the new tourist season. I asked to be put on an email notification so that it wouldn't sell out on the two days we had available in September, and that worked out. I was pretty persistent about checking on it with Xanterra. 
First of all, it's a really, really long day. Just be prepared for that. You get up super early to drive over and check in, then wait at the airport for the sun to rise. The plane ride over the canyon was amazing: views that were so beautiful they made me cry. I appreciated that we both got window seats with an empty middle seat between us. There are headphones with recorded narration. 
After flying over the canyon and Horseshoe Bend, you land at Lake Powell airport. We took pictures with the plane, had a bathroom break in the small airport, then met up with our Navajo nation guide for the trip to Antelope Canyon. She was very kind, patient,  and welcoming. The ride is in an open air truck  with two rows of bench seats. There is an overhead cover and there are seat belts. She took us into the area and then up to the canyon. I was a little worried because multiple buses pulled up and lots of people got out, but the guides handled it beautifully. Each group waited while the one ahead went into each area, took photos while listening to the guide, and then moved ahead. Very well organized. I had never been in a slot canyon and it was truly beautiful and very cool. The photos were amazing; our guide was full of tips about phone settings and positions in the canyon for various types of pictures. 
We were taken to a water sports/activities center where we could refill water bottles and use the restroom while we waited outside. It was a little awkward. There we met up with another group and went through metal detectors before boarding a bus to the Lake Powell dam. At the foot of the dam we got into small open boats and floated down the Colorado river and around Horseshoe Bend, stopping to look at rock formations, wild horses (!),  and views along the way. We got out of the boats once at a spot that had porta potties and amazingly clear Native American hieroglyphics. The water was too cold for swimming unless you were very hardy. The float trip was lovely, but a bit long since you couldn't move around very much on the boat and it was very sunny/hot. Also, the lunch provided was okay but not much....and they gave it to us while we were waiting for the bus and told us not to eat it on the bus, so we started eating before the bus and had to stop...it was strangely inefficient and not enough food for the day. Bring snacks and refill your water whenever you get the chance. 
Bus ride home was worst part; comfortable but long with only one stop. Those of us who had done the plane part of the trip had to wait as the bus wound its way through Grand Canyon Village and slowly disembarked the others, so very late getting back to our vehicle and a really long time between bathroom breaks! (Also, the airport is pretty much closed when you get back so don't expect a bathroom there.) 
All in all, a long day but so many great experiences!

review_title: It was so beautiful it made me cry!
review_text: We took a flight from the South Rim to Lake Powell as part of an all day package offered by Xanterra: flight, Antelope Canyon, float trip around Horseshoe Bend. This tour starts super early: an activities lady at Bright Angel Lodge told us to get there 15 minutes before the time on the tour, but that was really too early. We sat in the hangar and waited until after the sun came up before we left. Also, plan your breakfast: NOTHING is open in the village. Our pilots were Craig and Jacob, and they were great, very polite and personable. The small plane had rows of 3 seats, and I really appreciated that those of us in couples were both given window seats with an empty middle seat. There were headphones with narration. The views were really amazing, just awe-inspiring. I would do it again.

Absolutely fantastic, once in a lifetime experience. 18-seater airplane that flies over the Colorado River, Hoover Dam, Grand Canyon, two stops with shuttle and breathtaking views. The second stage of Guano is much more beautiful than that of Eagle. In addition to the cost of the ticket, we paid $20 each for fuel costs. Advised!

review_title: Sightseeing flight to Horseshoe Bend a great experience
review_text: The 30-minute flight to Horseshoe Bend, among other places, was a unique and wonderful experience. The crew was super nice and the flight was very pleasant.

review_title: Incredible sites all bundled for convenience.
review_text: Overall, it was very good. I loved it being bundled together so that the plans for the day was taken care of. The sites were really incredible. I'm giving a 4-star because I do wish there was a super knowledgeable guide with our group for the entire duration to answer questions and help with the transition between tours. I would have preferred an actual person giving the talking tour during the airplane as well. If you take this tour, be sure to bring your own snacks as the "lunch" isn't filling and is pretty early in the morning.

Sat at the door. Window too far to look down. In front of me were 2 XXXXL people who even blocked the aisle. Irresponsible . So I couldn't see anything through the right window. And to make matters worse, my headphones didn't work either. Paid $229 for this. Really wasted money. Seen more from the ground. So I couldn't take any photos either. So definitely not recommended. Couldn't file a complaint because it was the last flight of the day and the pilot had already left before anyone got off and the airport was closed. Went outside through a gate

Our tour guide and driver were really good. However, you have to pay extra $20 / person for the guided walking tour otherwise you go on a small bus with Native guides. The restaurant is not good the food was dry and just not even worth the extra money just buy lunch at the canyon.  Otherwise it's a great experience.

review_title: Plane, float trip  ... awesome; poor guide at Antelope Canyon
review_text:
Loved the airplane ride over the Grand Canyons and the float trip down the Glen Canyon. I was disappointed in the Antelope slot tour due to the poor guide. First, she was right rude when she picked us complaining we were late. Ahh, I didn't fly the plane nor did anyone n the group. Second, We had visited the Antelope Canyon previously and with a different tour group. This tour guide rushed us through the canyon and only took one photo, which was as poorly done. She did not get the wings like Leland. Leland took remarkable photos of everyone at multiple locations and knew how to set everyone's cameras just right. He played an instrument in one part f the canyon. Gave him a more stories and history. I recommend changing your partnership that does the tours in the nice van vs. the back of a pickup. 

Since I had done it before, I knew the difference. 

Loved Loved the plane and float trip, which is what I really wanted.

We took a morning flight over the canyon from Tusayan; Simply stunning; Our pilots were excellent, well informed, very friendly and the commentary was very clear; could not have asked for more, thankyou!

Amazing trip over the Canyon on a flight from Tusayan. It was a really smooth flight from our pilots Jeff and Jacob.  There was narration through headphones and the views were just stunning. The ground staff were lovely and helpful too. We’d definitely recommend this trip and was well worth the money.

We only had a short time in the Grand Canyon so we chose a multi level tour and so glad we did! This is the best way to see the canyon! Views were spectacular. The plane ride got amazing angles from different shots of the canyon. We really enjoyed the tour through Anyelope Canyon with the Navajo tour guide, Rosie. She is a second generation tour guide, and gave us so much interesting information about the formation of the slot canyon, was very helpful with setting up really cool photos in the slot canyon. Antelope Canyon is gorgeous and not to be missed! We also enjoyed the raft trip on the river, it puts in at the base of Glen Canyon Dam also with a Navajo guide, Kim. So much knowledge of the area. I loved hearing about Kim‘s family history, living on the reservation. It may have been a little long raft ride but all in all it was a great tour and highly recommend. The pictures you get from standing along the Rim don’t compare with pics you get from the air!
Fun and educational. The combination of wild life, horses, long horn sheep and blue heron and the folklore made it special.

review_title: 2nd Trip to GC, 2nd GCSA Air Tour Flt
review_text: Air tour in twin-engine, high-wing Otter was affordable, enjoyable and very worthwhile. Lends another perspective to rim, trail, valley, or river tours. Thanks, to staff & pilots Dan & Sam.

What an amazing trip! The bus driver was so sweet, nothing against him, but the drive was a little long and boring.  We only made 1 stop at the Grand Canyon and that just wasn't enough. I'd recommend the version of this trip where they fly you to Page.

The raft trip was incredible and our guide was so knowledgeable and fun. 

Great trip! Gorgeous views!
Beautiful, breathtaking. Knowledgeable guides. Pictures can not do it justice. I will be bringing back my husband, so that he can experience the same thing.

It was an amazing trip. The float boat was wonderful. We saw a baby egret, wild Navajo horses in the river, and big horned sheep! We also saw petroglyphs and went swimming!!!!!!!! We also went to Antelope Canyon and had the greatest guide, Cindy! A great day!

review_title: Good trip but not clear details
review_text: The actual tour while on the water was stunning! We saw wildlife and our guide, Tia, was amazing! She was friendly and very informative. I have to take one star due to your saying full day. We were picked up at our hotel, had a 3 1/2 bus ride to Page, AZ, then another bus ride to the boats. Then on the water just under 3 1/2 hours for another return bus ride. Had I been informed that the tour originated in Page, we would have stayed there and eliminated the bus ride, but it never gave me the information during the reservation process. When I did call prior to it, I admit I should have asked if staying in Grand Canyon Village was a good idea. But, the tour itself it great, just make sure you stay in Page for it to start. Oh, and you should know the picnic lunch isn’t out on the water, but given to you on the bus. Then you must go through Homeland Security before you can board the transfer to the boat.

review_title: Magnifique survol du lac Powell en avion
review_text:
Au niveau logistique, tout est très bien. L’avion est neuf est très propre. Les explications par le pilote au niveau de la sécurité et du survol sont très claires.
Le vol : nous avons eu de la chance, il faisait très très beau. Le survol du lac Powell, du fer à cheval et du barrage de Page, sont vraiment extraordinaires de plus les explications en français par des écouteurs permet de suivre en temps réel le vol.

This is absolutely worth the money & the full 12+ hours tour!! To see everything by air, 4x4 truck, hike, rafting & bus ride. Our Navajo Guide Ricky was outstanding! Explaining history & even taking pictures with everyone's phone for them!! So professional looking!! PRICELESS!! Liam was a terrific guide down the Glen Canyon Dam River! Answered everyone's questions!! Lesley our bus driver was very kind & provided a great lunch. The main guide for start of tour told us everything we needed to know to be safe!!! OUTSTANDING!!!

Fantastico volo sul Grand Ganyon con un piccolo DeHavilland, gita classica all'Antelope Canyon e bella e tranquilla discesa del Colorado, dalla base della diga, fino a Lees Ferry. L'unico neo della giornata è stato il caldo atroce durante la discesa del fiume, che dura ben 3 ore. Avevo già fatto altre gite in zona con Papillon, ma questa le straccia tutte

Everything went smoothly on this trip!  I was very impressed with the Antelope Canyon.  Our Tour Guide, Niko, really was knowledgeable and presented this magical place so well! The flight & rafting was equally nice.

It is difficult to pick a favorite activity.  The plane ride was an awesome way to see the Canyon and Lake Powell.  Antelope Canyon was magical and our guide Oscar did a phenomenal job helping us capture magical pictures.  The rafting trip was outstanding as well.  Being able to see the cliff walls from the water was very exciting.

review_title: 3RD VISIT TO GRAND CANYON -SPECTULAR VIEWS NOT SEEN BEFORE
review_text: The aerial views of the canyon are indescribable - what a treat.  We had visited Zion National Park and went to St. George to board the plane with seats directly behind the pilots.  We soared up and down the canyons following the river to get photos from both sides of the plane.  The senior pilot was very careful always looking to each side for other aircraft in the area.  We made several passes over the Hoover Dam.  We ended the tour at the North Las Vegas Airport where we had lunch.  Highly recommend Grand Canyon Scenic Airways.  This was definitely the highlight of our visits to the western national parks.

From start to finish it waa an outstanding experience. We took the flight to the west rim including the skywalk.  The flight was smooth and the views were amazing.  Narration was available in a variety of languages via headphones. Skywalk was really wonderful, and it was funny to watch the people who were really nervous about stepping on the glass. The photographers were very good for those who are interested in pictures. The 2nd stop on the shuttle bus was breathtaking and there was opportunity to do a little hiking.  This definitely was an experience and was worth every penny. Highly recommend
A fantastic flight to show just how unbelievably small we see compared to the canyon! Captain jack was excellent. The whole experience was seamless and fun. Definitely worth it

Flight tour of Grand Canyon; checked off the bucket list!  
I have ALS and Captain Jack and Grand Canyon Scenic Airlines were great and very accommodating. The flight was comfortable and truly amazing views.   My family and I are blessed to have Team Gleason @TeamGleason 
#nowhiteflags #teamgleason supporting us and making a difference in the lives of ALS families.
Every passenger has a window. Pilot is knowledgeable and interesting. The view from above is great. I would recommend this tour to anyone.

Terrible.  Beautiful day, clear sky’s and they cancelled our 10am flight because the plane had not arrived yet, even though there was a plane sitting outside.  We rescheduled for 1pm and an hour later they cancelled that flight.  I guess all the planes they show on the website are just photoshopped.  Totally undependable. I’m thinking since it was only 4 of us it wasn’t worth it for them to fly.

Wonderful!!  First timers and this was the trip if on a short time limit.  Pricey, but there’s a lot of logistics going on to get everything coordinated.  Perfect time of year to go.  No big crowds and no extreme heat.  Everyday at some point I thanked God for such a perfect day!!!  The Grand Canyon cannot be fully captured by photos.  Just breathtaking.  Same for Antelope Canyon!! Amazing natural canyon!  The float was so serene and peaceful.  Just take it in even if it seems a bit long.  On our journey back to airport, a movie was shown, which helped that leg of the day go quicker!  Overall a great day!!!

I have a fear of falling - so just getting on the plane was a LOT of work - once we were airborne, the flight was so smooth - I was completely relaxed and enjoyed the INCREDIBLE views of the Canyon and Page Arizona!  HIGHLY recomended!
We did a flight over the Grand Canyon- great experience, great views, great service-highly recommended

review_title: Great way to see/do multiple things in one day
review_text: This is four things stitched together seamlessly… airplane flight over the Grand Canyon, walking tour through Antelope Canyon, Colorado River raft trip (no rapids) on a motorized pontoon type of boat (with box lunch while on the river), and ride back (in a comfortable modern bus) to the starting point which is the airport at the Grand Canyon (located in the town of Tusayan, I believe). Very well done, and we really enjoyed it.

review_title: A can't miss experience that could be improved with a couple of tweaks.
review_text:
I was VERY nervous about the plane flight as I have a fear of falling.   Once the 16 passenger plane (including 2 captains) took off,  I was immediately at ease.   The small plane felt just as safe as much larger passenger planes.  The views were truly indescribable.   I didn't know which window to photograph and video out of as each had a more incredible view than the other.   Wish the airplane part of the tour was a bit longer.   As mentioned in other reviews the headset and recorded narration is due for an upgrade. 
Antelope canyon is a must see.   ESPECIALLY if you are into photography.   Our tour guide Rick was incredible!   He not only knew where to stop to capture the best images,  he actually borrowed different people's cameras and captured INCREDIBLE images for them!!  Another incredible highlight to the trip. 
The raft ride on the Colorado through Glen canyon was really nice,  though as others have mentioned,  would have been nicer at an hour shorter duration.   Our boat captain was quite knowledgeable and taught us a lot.   
Oscar our bus driver was amazing!   Friendly,  personable with lots of great information and suggestions and an excellent driver! 
A point of constructive criticism  - when I first booked the trip,  the booking agent told me to be sure to pack bathing suits for a dip in the Colorado River during the raft ride.   When grand canyon airlines called to confirm a day before the trip,  I tried to confirm the bathing suit need and asked about footwear for antelope canyon.   I was told to absolutely NOT bring a bathing suit as the river was way too cold to swim in.  I was very surprised when our raft captain offered the opportunity to take a dip in the river - which both my boys did in their clothes! 
That all said - sneakers are plenty adequate for antelope canyon (I wore hiking boots) and definitely bring a bathing suit for a potential dip in the Colorado River (yes it was cold,  but tolerable and refreshing in the shallows.)  Sunscreen, water and a good sun hat are highly recommended!

review_title: Thankful to see this beautiful area and learn it's place in history.
review_text: OMG I have lived in AZ since 1987, been to the Grand Canyon on several occasions and NEVER  seen it like this:  from the plane with Grand Canyon Scenic airways....views that have to be seen this way to be believed.  Then transport to Antelope Canyon for viewing the "slot canyons" which, with the incredible light and shadow seem like something "other worldly".  Dee was our Navajo guide and was fabulous and explained the history of the canyon, geologically and from the spiritual viewpoint of the Navajo culture. It gave me a deeper appreciation for the urgent need to care for Mother Earth.  Brandon was our bus driver (big guy, red beard :-) ) and was delightful and efficient getting us to the rafting on Lake Powell, and BACK to our hotel again.  I wish I could think of the name of our young raft pilot.  He was working here this summer before he goes to college.  SO enthusiastic and so knowledgeable about the area, the history and the importance of water conservation.  This is a trip I'd gladly do again.  So thankful our tour included these activities.

review_title: Grand Canyon by plane & raft Plus walk thru Antelope Canyon!
review_text: This was an amazing day! We started with an hour-long flight over the Grand Canyon, followed by a walk through Antelope Canyon - which was beautiful! The tour guides know how to get all the best pictures, and we even learned some photo tips along the way. After that, it was on to a 3-hour raft down the Colorado River. We even stopped a few times to see Petroglyphs and cool off in the 48-degree water. Our bus driver Oscar made the 3-hour drive home enjoyable by showing a great movie that had all ages entertained. Overall, one of the best travel experiences out there!!

review_title: Trip to Antelope canyon-plane, raft, bus
review_text:
Plane ride over canyon was breathtaking.  Pilot did wonderful job.
Our raft guide was so friendly and knowledgeable!  He pointed out wildlife as well as stopped for us to view the petroglyphs.  I couldn't possibly think of anything to change-trip was amazing!!
Tour through Antelope canyon with another friendly and knowledgeable guide who even told us how to get best photo shots!!
Bus tour driver also friendly and incredibly funny and knowledgeable.  Frequently stopped and made it possible to purchase items in Navajo areas.  Very prepared and made sure we understood and followed the covid regulations prior to entering this area.  Movie on way back in bus was good time to relax from full day of incredible activities.

This was REALLY fun - Just the plane ride over the Grand Canyon and surrounding area.  

Very professional and courteous staff.  Quick check in (and discreet weigh in to make sure the plane is balanced) at the Tusayan Airport.  Off to the plane (and didn't even have to use my TSA Pre) with both pilots.  Thorough pre-flight checks and telling us what we will be seeing.

And off into the sky.  A bit bouncy, but not terrible.  And the views are spectacular!  Especially with a high wing monoplane - no need to try and look over the wing, everything is easily viewed.  Flew all over the place with wonderful views of the surrounding forests, both rims, the river - everything.

Finally, back down to earth.  If you have the time, do this first and then go see the Canyon from the rims.  Excellent way to understand the granduer of it all and just how big the Grand Canyon is.

The flight was amazing! I’m terrified of heights but the pilot was very confident and was able to navigate the bumps with such ease. Truly an amazing experience to see the canyon from the flight. The Antelope Canyon was another amazing experience and the raft was a nice chill way to end the day.

Flying over one of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World is amazing and worth every penny spent.
Our pilot Andrew C. was amazing from pre-flight instruction and throughout our flight.
There are no words to describe the beauty of flying over the canyon and viewing all the amazing sights.

The Grand Canyon is an amazing place! Taking pictures at the scenic look outs is impressive. Taking the flight from the South Rim to the North Rim was amazing and it really gave you a great perspective on just how GRAND it is! Well worth taking the time to book the flight!

This is not actually a review of the airline, but of the car hire service offered by the general manager, Monty Parsons. We wanted to give Monty a double five star review.  He met us at the airport with a clean, cool car (he had run the a/c to cool it off) and was so wonderful - giving us directions, tips on local eateries and a warm, friendly welcome.  The rate for a day was very reasonable, and it made our stay so much better to not rely on the shuttles for everything. If you need a car to tour the area, please use Monty!

As we had hoped, this was the highlight of our entire trip, but you need some advance knowledge and preparation.  Read the cancellation policy closely when you book—no refunds for any reason.

This is a “Frankenstein” tour: 3 different tours by 3 different operators combined into a single package.  You need mobility to do all these things: climb into/out of the plane, onto/off trucks, walk across loose sand and over rocks, and down narrow steps.  The temperature can vary widely from dawn at the canyon rim to mid-day in Page to afternoon on the river.  Dress in layers, and check the forecast highs & lows for the Grand Canyon/Tusayan and Page, AZ to plan how many layers!

The flight is early in the morning, probably to avoid winds and turbulence as things warm up.  Check-in time was 6 a.m.  Expect a phone call if you’re not there by 6:05.  Their website says “2 meals included” but that is not the case--it’s BYOB (bring your own breakfast).  You’ll meet your bus driver for later in the day, and seats on the plane will be assigned as necessary to balance the weight of the airplane.
  
The flight lasts about an hour.  Headphones provide music and occasional narration in English, French, Spanish, and German.  The pilot will S-turn along the canyon so both sides get good views thru the enlarged windows of the Grand Canyon, Glen Canyon, the Vermillion Cliffs, and Lake Mead.  You’ll see Lee’s Ferry, Horseshoe Bend, and Glen Canyon Dam—all landmarks for your river trip.
After landing, we were met by our Antelope Canyon tour guide.  We traveled to the canyon on bench seats in open-bed trucks—plan for wind, dust, and hot/cold.  Masks are still required at all times on the Navajo reservation.  If you’re lucky enough to get Tori as your canyon guide, she will not only point out the great photo spots, but also advise/help you to adjust the settings on your smartphone camera to get the best shots!  The canyon tour lasts about an hour.  Time permitting, you may get to clamber thru a smaller slot canyon which is much less accessible than the main canyon.

Next you return to Page, to the Wilderness River Adventures office.  Don’t check in at their counter—your wristband shows you’re already processed and it will just confuse everybody.  Your bus/van driver will show up and give you a run-down of the afternoon.  You’ll be issued a box lunch, then process thru a TSA-like security check (You can leave non-compliant items and things you don’t want/need on the boating trip with your bus driver) prior to boarding a WRA bus to travel to the river. 
 
The raft trip is smooth and relaxing.  It lasts about 3 hours, with a stop after about 1.5 hours for lunch and to visit ancient pictograms.  Our guide ‘Tia was cheerful and informative.  At Lee’s Ferry, you’ll dock and meet your driver in the parking lot.

On the drive back to Tusayan (2-3 hrs), the bus will stop at Cameron Trading Post.  You’ll only have 20 minutes or so to browse, so you might feel pressured to choose hastily.  The selection seemed large (jewelry, pottery, blankets, leather, souvenirs), but prices seemed high.  If you’re looking to buy jewelry your best strategy is to check the stores in Williams, AZ first (they focus on jewelry, with much smaller selections of pottery and other crafts).  That way you can do a price/selection comparison.

review_title: You see a lot in a full day.
review_text: We took the plane tour from Grand Canyon airport, right outside of the South Rim, over Grand Canyon, landed in Page, Az, went by an open sided off road type vehicle to Antelope Canyon, then short bus ride to get on raft at Glen Canyon Damn and smooth raft ride through the entire canyon to Lee’s Ferry then bus ride to Cameron Trading Post then back to South Rim. I give plane ride 100%, Antelope Canyon 100% (our guide was FANTASTIC forgot her name 😩) the raft tour 90%. Loved seeing canyon from the water, but it could have been 30/45 minutes shorter, in my opinion. The lunch provided was very good. All guides were knowledgeable. It is an ALL day trip. If you can’t do it all, Antelope Canyon is a must!

Absolument pas fiable. Nous n'avons pas pu partir alors  que tout semblait ok pour nous. Nous avions reçu le sms de confirmation de tripadvisor mais une fois sur place, Gand Canyon scenic airlines que tripadvisor n'avait pas confirmé et que donc nous ne pouvons pas partir. Ils n'ont pas tenté de trouver une solution alors que tout était en ordre de notre côté et que nous étions même d'accord pour partir le lendemain.

review_title: Une excursion à 2000€ qui ne quittera pas le tarmac de l'aeroport
review_text: Après avoir effectué notre réservation pour 4 en janvier. Nous arrivons sur place le 7 avril à 6 heures du matin. Quelle ne fut pas notre surprise quand on nous annonce que notre réservation est fixée au 13. Nous contactons voator qui nous confirme que tout est en ordre et confirmé pour le 7 avril. Rien n'y fera, nous ne pourrons pas monter dans l'avion. Au téléphone Viator tente de nous revendre une solution beaucoup plus chère. Bref nous n'avons d'autres choix que de nous faire rembourser et passer notre journée à l'hôtel. En résumer, viator rejette la balle sur grand canyon scenic Airlines et grand Canyon scenic Airlines sur Viator. Résultat nous sommes les disons de la farce.

This was an amazing bucket list day!  Started with a 45 minute narrated flight with Capt Jack over the Grand Canyon.  We were picked up by a guide (unfortunately, he was not fitted for a people person job!), but the sheer beauty of Antelope Canyon made up for it.  Another plus, was the tour company had air conditioned vans.  If you show up at the Canyon, you will be able to hire a guide, but you will be riding over bumpy dirt roads for 10-15 minutes in the back of a truck with a canopy cover.  It is a dusty ride FYI.  Another FYI, is you must be accompanied by a Navajo guide to enter the canyon.  After that we were dropped off near Glen Canyon dam for a 3 hour float trip to Lee's Ferry.  The trip concluded with a bus ride back to Grand Canyon Village.  This trip packs in a lot in one day.

Great experience, had a group of 9 and we got window seats or in the middle seat with someone in our own group, all of the kids got windows.  Easy to board and the tour was nice.  Pilots were knowledgeable and friendly, kids loved it.  A little bumpy, had one in the group not feel great, but she has a history of motion sickness, everyone else was ok.

Completely worth the cost--everything about our 45 minute flight over the Grand Canyon was amazing. There isn't a bad seat in the plane--I think it was a 15-seater. The windows are large so you can see everything even if you are in the middle of three seats. We went all the way up to North Rim which was great since we weren't planning to travel there by car. A wonderful flight!

Simply unbelievable flying above the plateau, incredible views and our Captain Craig was informative thorough and extremely proffesional.  Would recommend as a must to see the canyon by fixed wing aircraft!

From the moment we walked into the building, we were treated as long lost friends by the staff.  Friendliness, knowledge and eagerness to make your trip the best it can be was their foremost goal!  Thank you so much!  

The flight was so unbelievable!  The beauty of the canyon, the smooth ride, and the narrative about the canyon were more than one could envision.  Perfection!

A Grand Canyon Must Do.  This perspective of the GC is unlike any other.  Late afternoon flight = shadowing that highlighted the grandness and vivid colors of the canyon walls.  Very professional staff (Capt Jack, Sherry, Howard), top quality airplane and facilities.

review_title: A must, words cannot express appropriately
review_text: We took this flight combined with “The Original Grand Canyon Jeep and Safari Tour.”  No words can appropriately describe this awe inspiring experience.  At one time I found myself with my hand over my heart or on my cheer just in amazement.  You listen to information and music with head phones, which adds to the experience.  The plane only holds 8 passengers, each with a phenomenal view.  Captain Jack was very friendly.   I cannot recommend this enough.  It is truly the best way to experience the Grand Canyon.
This is the best way to see the Grand Canyon!  The pilots were very knowledgeable about the Grand Canyon.

review_title: What a Memorable Day Over the Canyon!
review_text: This is the perfect way to see the Grand Canyon. The plane was comfortable, quiet and had a fantastic view from the large windows. The folks at GCSA were helpful and very nice. Thumbs up to the pilots for the info they were able to share with us and for making our day over the Canyon so memorable.

Super professional, friendly, an amazing experience and a really great value.

I was a little hesitant at first cause this seemed like a lot of $$$ for a tourist experience that was pretty quick. But after doing it, I’m so glad to have done it. Totally worth it to see how big the Grand Canyon is and to see it from a different POV. 

Recommend this to family and friends without hesitation!!

Fabulous way to see the vastness of the Grand Canyon. Check in was quick and easy. Staff was awesome. Enjoyed talking with Monte, Howard, and Sherri at the counter even though they made fun of my hillbilly accent. Would definitely recommend to anyone wanting a Grand view of the Grand Canyon!!! Loved it!!!!

This was a chance of a lifetime experience! Every part of the adventure was easy and so worth the money. To see the Grand Canyon from above was something that my kids will remember forever. We each had our own viewing window with great narration to enhance the experience. Captain Jack was awesome!
Such an awe-inspiring ride over and in the Grand Canyon! We saw many different points of interest from a view like no other!

We took the airplane tour of the Grand Canyon on a Friday morning and thoroughly enjoyed the trip.  The people were great and everything leading up to takeoff was very smooth.  The flight itself was wonderful...no better way to get the tremendous views of the Grand Canyon and see so much in a short period of time.  We would always recommend taking a flight earlier in the day as heating will tend to make the ride a little rougher later in the day.  We had a great time and would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting the Grand Canyon, especially if it is your first visit!

We discovered Lake Powell and surroundings by plane, allowing us to have fantastic scenic overviews. This allowed us to better understand the geology around Lake Powell.
Altogether, I highly recommend to visit Lake Powell by plane, with its dazzling red rocks at sunset!!! It's a magical landscape!!!

Can't get tired of seeing the stunning views of the Grand Canyon.  I felt safe.  I was confused, however, about why the pilot had us put headphones on and tune to Channel 1.  He hardly said a word the whole time.  I was expecting him to narrate the trip.
Amazing experience.  Crew and Captain jack are incredible! Better than helicopter,  more time in are, for less $

My Husband and I were very impressed with our pilot, the Staff and our flight. They allowed us to switch our day to an earlier day due to snow concerns, and thankfully we were able to go as the day we were scheduled, was a white out! Such a beautiful day & so happy that you actually get to fly over the North rim & into the canyon for quite a bit of time. Highly recommend!

We booked through viator.com and everything was amazing.  The gentleman who checked us in was extremely friendly and the pilot was great... he let our 16 year old sit up front with him.  I highly recommend this tour.
Could not recommend this company enough! Our family of four had a fantastic time!!! The whole experience was top notch!!
Professional, on time and a great tour. We took many photos and were amazed by the red colors of the canyon. Great value for the price.  Recommend!
Amazing experience with AWESOME views. Don't miss this opportunity of a lifetime. Staff was amazing with my 7 year old who had never flown before and the Captain was great.

First of all, Captain Jack was a great ambassador for flying and the airline. Talked at length with him before and after the flight.  A comfortable, quiet, scenic flight that went by way too fast. 40 minutes, worth every penny. Every seat, at least on the Caravan, is a window seat. No bad views.

review_title: Why go to Grand Canyon and not see it all?
review_text: We saw the signs in town and decided to take a plane in lieu of helicopter. Well worth it considering the difference in price. We have taken numerous heli tours in Hawaii and the Smokey's. Airplane covers a lot more ground and as big as the Grand Canyon is it was a good decision. Captain Jack was our pilot, he made the trip well worth it, he was knowledgeable, friendly and skilled. Our children had not flown in prop plane before, the ride was very smooth. This was my wife's idea, "if you are going to Grand Canyon you need to see it all". Pay the extra. it will build memories they will never forget.

Beautiful, scenic, mystical.
Host were absolutely most welcoming. Very interesting couple 
Would love to have had more time to hear about some of their experiences. They have done such a great job with their property.
Saw all kinds of wildlife.
This place is truly like a sanctuary for people as well as wildlife.
The meditation and yoga dome was an experience in itself, so peaceful and relaxing. Can't wait to return.
Travel Tip: Add an extra day or two if at all possible, you'll understand once there on property.

In my photos you can see the plane tire and wing.  The views were spectacular!!!  Captain Jack was an amazing pilot great visibility and the flight was narrated (in different languages)

Amazing and awesome. A must.  I would do this before the Pink Jeep-this tour was the best with the most sights.

Es war ein unvergessliches Erlebnis.

Die gesehenen Bilder lassen sich nicht in Worte fassen. 

Und es geht hier auch viel entspannter als nebenan bei den Helicopterflügen zu.
Preislich durchaus auch fairer.

Sehr netter Service vom Check in bis zum Foto nach dem Flug. Grosse Panoramafenster lassen 
die Eindrücke noch größer werden.

Nach unserem Flug hatte unser junger Copilot leider einen schweren Fahrradunfall im Ort, bei dem wir noch erste Hilfe geleistet haben.

Wir hoffen an dieser Stelle, dass es ihm wieder gut geht.

Nochmals vielen Dank für alles!

review_title: Enjoyed our Antelope Canyon & River Adventure
review_text:
Our family of 5 did the Antelope Canyon & River Adventure tour, a 12 hour tour that leaves just after sunrise from the Tusayan airport, flies over the canyon in a fixed wing aircraft for about 45 minutes, then arrives in Page AZ.  From there you do a guided tour of Antelope Canyon, and then take a smoothwater motorized river raft ride on the Colorado, followed by a bus ride back to the Canyon South Rim.  
We had a partly cloudy day but the flight over the canyon was awesome!  What a great way to see the Grand Canyon.  There were unfortunately a number of nicks and scratches on most of the windows so that made it a little more challenging to get great photos but the flight was smooth (we got lucky there as the currents were calm) and the views were terrific.
We then were met at the Page airport by our Native American guide for the Antelope Canyon tour, and that was a real highlight.  Our guide (unfortunately I forget her name) was terrific, not just sharing interesting information but also showing us how to get some spectacular photos that we would have never thought to take.  
We then went on to the raft ride, which was just under four hours.  Unfortunately we got there about an hour before the scheduled start time of the ride so we had to wait for a bit, but we were comfortable.  The ride itself is about a 15 mile ride that takes a bit less than four hours, with a stop to see some petroglyphs.  Saw some cool sights, as you can tell from the pace it's far from a thrill ride, but was a very laid back, casual ride down the Colorado, and our guide was excellent.
After that, it was a bus ride back with a 40 minute stop at a trading post.

A pretty laid back but enjoyable day.  Everything was done well.  If you're looking for more of a thrill just do one of the air tours, but if what I described sounds good then you'll enjoy this tour.

Fantastic flight over the Grand Canyon in a 10 seater Cessna Caravan. Only two of us on board with the pilot, Capt Jack. The other couple booked on the flight went to the wrong airport 3 hours away. Airline went anyway with just the 2 of us. Read the paperwork people! I got to sit next to the pilot and got absolutely fantastic views. That said everyone in Caravan  gets a window seat anyway. As a PPL it was great to see the pilot in action in a strong crosswind when taking off and landing. No problems at all. Got to say it again - fantastic!

review_title: What more can you say  - really it is after all THE Grand Canyon
review_text: No better way, to she vast expanse of the canyon if you do not have much time or can't walk very far or are just too darn old to float down the river. Great seats great view, excellant pilots

Vedere il lago Pawell dall'alto, è tutto un altra cosa, l'ideale per fare delle bellissime foto di un luogo fantastico anche se artificiale. L'Horseshoe Bend, invece rende molto di più dal luogo panoramico sopra il canyon che dall'alto, comunque nell'insieme un ottimo volo, che merita di essere fatto.

Another Bucket list item and nature wonder . It’s a bit of a walk although with some effort there was 4 people who took a guy with a wheel chair to see this .  We loved this , its only 10 minutes from Antelope canyon . Easy to do both in one day .

We didn’t know what to expect on this trip, but it was a fantastic day!  All 3 parts of the trip were beautiful and worth the price!  We had great guides and just a wonderful day!  Highly recommend splurging on this adventure!

review_title: See it all in one day!
review_text: Spendy but worth it.  Traveled with 14, 17 and 18 yr olds. They loved it!  Not recommended for young children; too long of a day. Day started out with a 515am pick up from our hotel in the South Rim to the airport.  Airport clean, well organized and in tip top shape.  Pilots super professional.  Beautiful scenic East Rim flyover to Page watching the sun rise. Pick up from the airport to the Navajo Nation was in open air trucks...bring scarves and eye protection as it is super dusty (and COLD!!! Our trip was in mid-October).  Our Navajo guide Dee was amazing, knew all the nooks and crannies if the Canyon as well as all the proper camera techniques to get the best shots.  Then on to the rafting trip down the Colorado with the starting point at the Glen Canyon Dam @ Lake Powell.  Had to go thru security as the Dam is part of Homeland Security.  The rafting trip is pretty long (3+ hrs) have to admit was getting pretty antsy by the end...but BEYOND beautiful: saw petroglyphs, wild horses and big horn sheep.  Lunch was a Subway bag (turkey sandwich loaded w veggies, chips, fruit and a kind bar).  Picked up at the end of the rafting trip by a clean modern bus that did a midway pitstop at the trading post in Cameron.  All guides were professional, knowledgeable  and passionate about the area.  Coordination between legs of the trip involved some waiting but overall seemless.  If you only have one day to see Northern AZ/Glen Canyon this is the way to do it!
giornata perfetta, zero nuvole, temperatura 30-31 gradi Celsius. volo perfetto. panorama spettacolare. tutto come nelle attese. suggerito !

We had a great trip with a very kind captain. Unfortunately,  all of our 3 kids feel asleep after a couple of minutes. That way we could enjoy the flight with less stress. However,  given how expensive the trip is also for the kids it was a bit disappointing...

Front desk was not informative. I was checking in and was not able to find the front desk lady and for a good 5 mins was nice t helped The lady had a non caring attitude. They split of my party and when asked they never gave me a reason. They said they don’t know what happened and left it like that. Gift shop is full of over priced snacks and cheap items but the staff was friendly. The pilots are fun and friendly the flight was amazing. I just didn’t care much for the attitude of the workers.

review_title: Grand Canyon flight & West Rim plus SkyWalk
review_text: We wanted to visit the Grand Canyon from Vegas and as a part of a big trip across California we were struggling to find a tour that would accommodate our requests - until we found Grand Canton Scenic Airlines! Great value for money, we flew over which took 45 mins in a little aircraft with big windows so we could see right out (no need to request a window seat, you can see from anywhere). We flew over the hoover dam (something we wanted to see on the ground but lack of time available but this was just as good!) the west rim tour was around 3 hours and 3 stops on a free bus this is plenty of time to take pictures, queue for the SkyWalk (hugely recommend if your not afraid of heights!) and have food if you fancied. Hugely recommend this trip! To top off a great day we got engaged!
The pilot was great and informative, nice flight, loved the presentation on the headphones. The views were amazing, we enjoyed the experience

I was one of 16 tourists on a Travalgar sponsored tour who signed up for a 45 minute airplane ride over the Grand Canyon with Grand Canyon Scenic Airlines. When we arrived at the airport check- in desk our tour director was informed that the plane we were to take on our excursion was grounded in Las Vegas with a maintenance issue. It is understandable that an excursion can be cancelled because of equipment problems but the issue here is the failure of the airline to inform the Travalgar tour director that the flight had been cancelled. Each of the 16 tourists wasted 3 hours of their vacation day that could have been directed to other activities because this airline didn’t think it was important to communicate with its customers. Very sad and disappointing!

We had a great 3 hour tour and drove through the Grand Canyon National Forest. They say it is the only Jeep tour authorized to do so. Our guide Werner was very knowledgeable. We saw the canyon from view pints that most tourists don’t get to.

Un accueil chaleureux par notre pilote. Casque dans l'avion avec traduction pour les explications. Et vous profitez d'une vue sur l'ensemble du lac Powell qui n'est pas possible en voiture.Le tarif est un peu élevé, mais bon c'est tellement beau vu du ciel.

My bf and I did the airplane, antelope canyon and river rafting trip September 3rd.  I had an amazing time.  The flight was the best part. It was comfy and had a breathtaking view.  Seeing antelope canyon was awesome and it was beautiful but very a busy touristy area.  The river trip was awesome and beautiful as well however, it lasted a little longer than I care for and the captain kept stopping the raft.  My back was hurting by the end of the trip. But the captain Castro was amazing, knowledgeable, and kept the trip entertaining.

Took the Canyon Adventure tour that consisted of a plane ride early AM over the canyon, walk into Antelope Slot, and float ride down the Colorado River.  Expensive, but hands down money well spent.  All 3 experiences were well guided and customer service was fantastic.  Light breakfast in the AM provided (yogurt, muffin, juice, apple, coffee) lunch in the afternoon (Subway turkey sandwich, orange, chips and kind bar).  Lynette, our Antelope Slot guide was AMAZING.  She was knowledgeable and showed us how to get the best photos of the canyon.  The river guide was also great but it was HOT and a little slow.  He made it interesting by pointing out neat shapes in the canyon and sharing history with us.  Went with a 10 year old and my 70 year old parents.  Everyone loved it.

Bring: 
Sunscreen
Bathing suit
Sneakers
Book or something for bus ride back
Water for AM

Ho prenotato dall’Italia con largo anticipo il volo sul Grand Canyon e devo dire che è stata davvero una bellissima sorpresa sia per la puntualità che per i meravigliosi scenari visti dall’alto. 
In un ora di volo un gran bel giro su tutta la parte sud del Grand Canyon.
Da provare assolutamente

If you want a good overview of the Grand Canyon this is a way to go. 

Nice smooth 45 min morning flight. Over the east part of the Grand Canyon. You’ll fly over South and Nort Rim in the area around Grand Canyon Village. 

High wing aircraft with large windows ensures great visibility. Flight offers completely different views from hikes and walks on rim.

review_title: Jolie balade mais coeur fragile s'abstenir.
review_text: Les ados ont adoré mais nous n'avons pas apprécié pleinement ce vol assez mouvementé. À priori les autres passagers se sont régalés... Nous avons tout de même pris de très jolies photos.

review_title: Grand Canyon Flight, Antelope Canyon Tour and Canyon River Float
review_text: This was a wonderful way to see the wonders of the Grand Canyon, Antelope Canyon and Glen Canyon. Everyone we encountered was truly professional and eager to make the experience wonderful. Sit on the left side behind the pilot for the best views over the Grand Canyon. I appreciated that our tour group was one of the ealiest at Antelope Canyon - there were no crowds until we left. The float on the river through Glen Canyon was an amazing experience. The scale is so different from the river and the guide was incredibly knowledgeable. Best part of our four day trip.

review_title: Scenic Canyon River Adventure - well worth the money!
review_text:
We recently went on the Scenic Canyon River Adventure and it was amazing.  It was an early start from the airport but breakfast was supplied.  Once up in the air there were some amazing views and throughout the flight we were given a commentary via headsets.  After landing it was off to Antelope Canyon.  It was stunning.  Hadn't really known what to expect but we were taken through by a guide who explained everything to us. We were then taken to Wilderness River Adventures base where we had to wait for the rest of the group for our raft trip.  Only bad comment would be that it would have been handy to have it explained what we were waiting for and how long.  The raft trip down the Colorado River was excellent but be aware it gets very hot down there although the guide on the raft had a good supply of water for us all. The views from the river was awe inspiring.  Our coach ride back from Lee Ferry could have been monotonous but our driver (GiGi) kept us entertained with stories.
An amazing day viewing the Grand Canyon from above and right down inside it.
Awesome trip... our Pilot Rick was terrific. Along with the tutorial on the headset, Rick clued us in on the many landmarks. Absolutely worth every penny (Dollar)

Tour was a part of a Road Scholar trip. Felt safe and the scenery was awesome. You really get a perspective of the vastness of the Grand Canyon. Only complaint was lack of narration. Played a tape of the sights that repeated itself and was not very instructional. It would seem that the co-pilot could point out some interesting landmarks or if they are going to use a recording the quality could be improved.

This was the most unbelievable experience! We did the plane, the raft, and antelope canyon! Antelope canyon was my favorite! I feel like we got a full dose of the Grand Canyon in such a short amount of time! 

It is totally worth the money!

What an awesome day! This was such a special way to experience the Grand Canyon from the sky, land, and by water. The day was so well organized and the simplicity of transitioning from one event to the next was so nice. The cost for this trip was the only thing that caused us pause, but ultimately we found it to be worth the investment.

review_title: A hot day in and on the canyon
review_text: Leaving from Boulder City was easy and the short flight gives a great view of lake mead and the local part of the grand canyon. The day was over 40 degrees but the Scenic team were very good and the helicopter ride down to the boat and the skywalk and eagle point were well worth it. It give you a perspective on the actual size of this natural wonder.
비싼 값을 그만큼 한것 같다. 그넓은 그랜드캐년의 구석구석을 주마간산이지만 이런 눈높이에서 즐길 수 있는 기회는 인생에 몇번 있겠는가 ? 꼭 한번 경험해 보시길 !

review_title: Airplane tour of the Grand Canyon
review_text:
With a family of four the helicopter tour was a bit too pricey so the airplane trip, while still the wrong side of reasonably priced, was a better alternative.

I have to say: this is the only way to see the Grand Canyon! There is simply no better way to fully grasp the entirety of it; the forces involved in its creation.
Stunningly beautiful. Humbling.
처음엔 가격이 만만치 않아 그랬지만, 경비행기에서 보는 그랜드캐년의 전망은 눈높이에서만 즐기는 수평의 세계에서 탈출하게 된다. 약 30-40분정도는 아무말이 필요없다. 일행이 있다면, 한 사람은 동영상으로, 또한사람은 사진으로 찍고, 한국어, 영어, 프랑스어, 등의 방송(해드셋)도 같이 설명 곁들어 들으면 최고 !

Was expecting my husband to be the scared one but instead it was me that suffered but the flight was amazing, the views spectacular, from the ground it's just not possible to appreciate  the size and beauty  of Lake Powell and horseshoe bend  be prepared for a few bumps during the flight and you will love every minute of it

review_title: A full Day by AIR, LAND, RIVER & BUS!
review_text: We wanted to see as much as possible with little time so we paid the extra $ to do this deluxe tour.  It started at the Grand Canyon airport and we promptly arrived at 6:00 a.m. Unfortunately, a party of 12 decided they wanted to also join the tour so we had to wait until they were all registered even tho we had made prior arrangements & had paid in full weeks before.  The receptionist was not at all engaging & would not allow us to at least get our breakfast until all 12 members were weighed & ticketed.  Very frustrating & a bit underwhelmed especially since we had arranged to be there on time by getting a room close by.  The pilot was good but it would have been nice had he introduced himself.  I did ask him his name.  But to me, I would prefer he introduce himself before we began.  The flight was nice & we saw the Grand Canyon from a mile above.  It was amazing. The Colorado river looks small from way up there. Later we arrived in Page, AZ & were picked up by Rosie, an American Indian tour guide who drove us to Antelope Canyon!  She was very nice, fun, engaging, helpful in showing us how to get the best pictures, & extremely professional & pleasant. She dropped us off at the River check in destination where we received lunch (Subway sandwiches & trimmings) along with a chance to clean up, use the facilities, learn about the Glen Canyon Dam, early explorers, etc.  Then we were bussed to a very long tunnel which we entered, pitch dark for about a minute or two, it was long & arrived at the opening of the stairs down to the river rafts.  Our guide was Daniel & he was very nice, engaging, professional, fun & made every effort to keep us cool on a very hot hot day.  We, about 16 of us on the boat, ate our lunch & listen to Daniel's talk about the river as well as the cliffs, petroglyphs, etc.  There was a couple of stops along the way which were welcomed along with a bathroom that was actually very clean and pleasant considering there actually large & basically out-houses. There was also an opportunity to swim and play in the very cold river, which was very refreshing. We finally made our way to the landing where we had another rest break before hopping on a very nice air conditioned plush seat bus (w/ a bathroom on board) to make the 3 hour journey back to the airport in Tusayan.  We saw extremely large Elk with huge racks & also babies and Does.  The driver was very nice, engaging & gave us lots of history & pertinent information. We liked the stop at  Cameron too!

We booked an all day multipart tour thru the operator
Day started with hour+ long overflight of the canyon area,
which in itself would be wonderful.
Part 2 was visit to "Antelope Canyon" - less canyon and more other-worldly rock formation to walk thru - this was amazing - a bit unexpected but beautiful (search for online photos - it is amazing)
Part 3 was multi hour rafting trip (smooth water) on the river which was very pleasant.

And then scenic bus ride on way back to Tusayan, with stop at interesting Native American run trading post which was actually a pretty good place for native area souvenirs of all sorts

review_title: Excellent plane ride over the Grand Canyon
review_text: The view was amazing from the airplane. The flight originated near the South Rim, but also flew over the North Rim. A definite “wow” moment ! There was a recording of information about the Grand Canyon that played in flight.

There are no words that can express the beauty and majesty of the Grand Canyon and the additional attractions of Antelope Canyon, Lake Powell, and Glen Canyon, other wonders of nature, just made the trip something to remember for the rest of your life... The well-organized tour also helped a lot for the enjoyment of the trip.

Wow what a day ... all the staff were amazing 

I don’t enjoy flying but this flight was different - such a great pilot and so very very enjoyable 

Antelope canyon left me in awe - amazing guide who showed us how to capture some amazing pictures - memories will stay with me forever 

Rafting was enjoyable but for me slightly too long with no shade 

The only negatives were inconsiderations of others ... turning up late to the bus - not following tour guides instructions - getting in the way with their selfie sticks etc !! 

There were children on our tour - to be honest they were bored lots of the time and became noisy so we couldn’t hear the guide - maybe not the best tour for less than teens - but that’s just my opinion !!!!

We opted for a 45 minute flight in a Twin Otter Vistaliner to see more of the GC instead of going on the Skywalk.  It cost a little more but was sure worth it.  At check in, be prepared to be weighed and then you are assigned a seat based upon weight and balance. You are assigned a colour coded boarding pass and wait until your flight is called.  You then stand in your assigned place indicated by painted footprints on the ground at the gate.  When it is safe to do so, you will be escorted to your plane and a professional photographer will offer to take your picture.  After a safety briefing and boarding is complete you can don your headphones and choose your language for the commentary.  Although the plane can hold 19 passengers, there is a very good chance you will be seated next to a window.  The flight itself was superb with spectacular views of the GC from another angle and there are many photo opportunities on either side of the plane through the large windows.  You also get to see some of the Northern Rim, something that is not easy to do in one day if travelling by road.  The flight does cross over the Canyon itself twice so it is possible to look straight down on the Colorado River and see the white water rafters doing their thing.  A lot of consideration is given to not disturbing the peace of those on the ground but this does not mean that the route flown is out of the way.   Highly recommended.

We were so fortunate to have Nate as our Navajo tour guide through Antelope Canyon today. He went out of his way to insure that each party in his group got great photos while we were in the canyon. He made a crowded situation ok by looking out for us while we were in his care. You should be very, very lucky to have him escort you through this magnificent structure!

Nous avons fait le 'Higlights Air Tour', c'était juste incroyable! 
Le vol a duré plus d'1h, donc nous avons bien eu le temps d'admirer le Grand Canyon (rive ouest), et franchement c'est top car chacun est assuré d'avoir une place côté fenêtre dans l'avion.
Tout était très bien organisé, depuis le pick up à l'hôtel jusqu'au drop off retour. 
Bref je recommande à 100%!
Assolutamente da fare panorami fantastici colori anche abbastanza lungo da farti sperare di arrivare sano e salvo ...aereo davvero caratteristico ..da film

review_title: All of these places are must sees!
review_text: Glen Canyon is so beautiful and Antelope Canyon is breathtaking!  Lake Powell is such a great place to spend a vacation with so much right in the area to see and do.  Highly recommend staying several days!

We did the airplane tour through the Grand Canyon. I believe it was somewhere between 45 minutes to an hour. This was an amazing excursion for the whole family. We chose the airplane over the helicopter, simply because of price. The airplane tour is about half the cost. We also had two families, so it was great that we all got to fly together. The plane is SMALL!!!  I was a little nervous when we first boarded but the flight was so smooth and the views are so amazing... you almost instantly forget all your fears. I highly recommend this flight. It was an experience that my boys will never forget!!
Great pilot.  Sorry, his name evades me.  Very entertaining.  My son was our very important co-pilot.  Great views.  Flight was 40 minutes.  Great option compared to a pricier helicopter tour.

A wonderful experience which is worth every penny, you get to see so much and really experience how vast the area is. The flight was smooth and was actually loner than what is advertised, the pilots were professional and informative. I would recommend this flight, you will not regret it.

We scheduled an airplane tour with these folks three weeks before visiting the Canyon.  On the day of our tour it was snowing and they called the hotel and told us they couldn't fly.  They offered later dates but we were leaving the next morning so they did a full refund to our credit card which posted the next day.

They were super professional and super easy to work with.
We took the 1 hour helicopter tour that included Lake Powell, Glen Canyon, Horseshoe Bend and walking on a butte.  It was well worth the cost and we thoroughly enjoyed it.

review_title: Best way to see the Grand Canyon/Colorado River
review_text: This is a must do, if you can! We enjoyed our tour over the Canyon and our Pilots! Very friendly and efficient. We learned a lot from the audio tour as well as our pilots. It is a compliment to a ground tour as well~

6 of us went on the scenic plane from the Grand Canyon airport and it was incredible! As we took off we were concerned as the first few minutes were spent quite far away from the actual canyon, but once we flew over the canyon it was amazing! It's difficult to get an idea of the scale of the canyon from the ground and this was an unforgettable trip! We visited in December 2018 and were treated to views of the canyon dusted with snow which added to the magic.  The only downside is that we could barely hear the recording that played through the headset during the flight so I'm not sure what info is shared, but it was still an awesome experience.

review_title: Floating Down the River, Drinking River Chilled Pop
review_text: My buddy and I took the Scenic Airlines tour that flew down into the Grand Canyon, winded through Antelope Canyon, and ended with a float down the Colorado River. The staff were knowledgeable and professional from start to finish. We got to take in majestic aerial views of the Grand Canyon, trek through beautiful canyon shells shaped by water, then relax as we discovered the ancient writings within the canyon walls along the Colorado River. My treat was drinking river chilled pop on our way home. I would recommend this business to other consumers.

review_title: Avion et marche au West Rim ! Wow!
review_text: Excellent pour ceux qui ne sont pas très alaises dans les petites avions ou les hélicos. Cette avion de 9 passagers est super stable. Chaque personne a une fenêtre donc pratique pour faire de la photo ! Gardez les mêmes places au retour afin que chacun puisse bénéficier de la bonne lumière. Ce forfait est parfait pour un mixte avion et marche, donc vue d'en haut et vue sur le terrain. Nous avons adoré! C'est organisé au quart de tour, les explications sont claires et c'est vous qui gérez votre temps une fois au sol ! Super !
It was definitely worth my money getting on plane and capture alot photos/video around Grand Canyon.  It was most fun experience and I will definitely go again

review_title: Fantastic views of the Grand Canyon
review_text: All people very friendly - We spent all day visiting also Antelope canyon and rafting on Colorado River

Vi gjorde en treveckors roadtrip genom sydvästra USA och vår knappt timmeslånga flygning över Grand Canyon var en av de absoluta höjdpunkterna. Här fick vi chansen att ta en noga titt på hur Coloradofloden grävt sig ned genom höglandet. Höjdpunkten var när vi flög ut över kanten, magnifikt! Vi var ett 10-tal personer som samsades i en Twin-Otter med norsk pilot och kvinnlig andrepilot som gjorde ett gediget jobb, blåsten gjorde starten och landningen något skumpig. Headset med guidning på svenska överraskade, även om den var ganska kortfattad.
Bolaget började sin verksamhet med en enmotorig Cessna redan 1967 och har vuxit till att varje dag flyga turer över Grand Canyon och Monument Valley med sammanlagt 16 st Twin-Otter (som man själva varit med om att modifiera med bl.a. större fönster) från Boulder City, Las Vegas och Grand Canyon Airport där vi klev på.
PS. Se upp med klockan om ni beställt en flight i förväg, särskilt om ni kommer från Coloradohållet. Grand Canyon ligger på andra sidan gränsen mellan PDT, Pacific Daylight Time, och MDT, Mountain Daylight Time.

Took the family for their first view of the Grand Canyon and started with this fly over. It was great! The pilots were extremely friendly, the plane was comfortable and all 5 of us got a window seat. Takeoff and landing was a little bumpy due to wind gusts vs small plane, but they pilots talked to us and had full control. 90% of the flight was smooth as silk. The headphones gave information during the tour telling us interesting facts about what we were seeing. At the end, the pilot took group photo as a keepsake. Great adventure! Highly recommend!
Great experience.   The flight over the Grand canyon was amazing.  It was a beautiful clear day and the views were fantastic.  Smooth  flight,  the pilot was great and  can thoroughly  recommend.....

Great value flight! We took a plane to the grand canyon, with the excellent pilot Kyle. He was very welcoming and informative. We would definetley go again. November was a great time to go as mild weather so could explore everything minus the extreme heat!

My family enjoyed the flight over the Grand Canyon and we were all able to go since the price was about half that of the helicopter tour. I have been on many small planes and this was definitely the best, smooth and great take-off/landing. It was a great way to get the most out of a short trip to the Grand Canyon.

This flight (7:00 - 8:00 am) was actually the first of 3 separate activities packaged together by Grand Canyon Scenic Airlines (Papillion Air) into a fantastic 11 1/2 hour thrilling day adventure ($399 per person total, and worth it).  Weather and crowds make all the difference. We had the first beautiful day in a week (others, our pilot said, were largely obscured by low clouds inside the canyon). Flight is over (not in) the Canyon, including great views of Grand Coulee Dam and Lake Powell before landing in Prescott by the Navajo Nation.  We paid $15 each extra for a guaranteed window seat—but unnecessary because we had only 11passengers and each had a window (24 passenger aircraft).  And most of them we learned were not part of our full day (their loss).    Crowds? Not in the plane. And this was the last two weeks of many seasonal tours, so none all day.      Second part was a gentle 1.5 mile Jeep Drive with an excellent, entertaining Navajo driver, our guide,to their Antelope Canyon.  A walking narrow slot canyon with other-worldly wind and water carved passages often so narrow you can touch both sides. Check google for some pictures. About 2 hours total.    Third, a 45 min. bus ride to Grand Coulee ending through a long tunnel ~8 mins) through the cliff side, down to the Colorado River as it exits base of the dam.  Boarded a motorized semi- rigid raft (actually aluminum, not an inflatable Avon) with 15 others. Started a 5 hour float, no rapids or white water, just spectacular views everywhere.  One stop, a picnic ground with toilets and 1/3 mile walk to petroglyphs on the low wall; and Subway box lunch provided.   Float ended at Lees Ferry, where we saw rafting groups starting out on 3-day runs through the rugged deep canyon river we all associate with Powell’s expedition.   From there a 2 hour bus ride back to our GC Airport start. That sounds boring, but not!    The bus driver, like our river guide, was entertaining and full of information all the way.  Driving into the park at late  sunset lots of elk were active, too.    DO NOT just settle for the fly over.

review_title: Get the seats on the left side
review_text: We took this tour as part of a package from our hotel and loved it. At least 50 minutes in the air with constant incredible views. My seat on the left side “as you look forward” was the best side only because as we flew over the Grand Canyon and Colorado river most of the views were out my large window. My wife was seated to my right and had nice views but nothing like mine. If they could alter their flight pattern then everyone could get a greater view. We both loved it and highly recommend this tour. Some have commented it was pricey, $400 each for the flight, antelope canyon tour, river cruise, and bus ride back, but for a 13 hour day it was priceless. We would seriously do all this again. They stop flying at the end of October as does the river cruise and we got the last tour in this format. Staff and pilots were great, both tiny airports were very clean and nice. Our flight was super smooth and relaxing. Highly recommend this especially if time is limited. You will see the Grand Canyon in a totally different and comprehensive way.
My husband and I took the all day tour flying over the grand canyon and going into antelope canyon was our favorite!

review_title: Nice and well done - but the thing itself is not a must-do
review_text: We did the plane 45 minute tour, i.e. not the helicopter one. It's a nice view and you can take lots of pics, however, it's not more overwhelming than, say, driving the 89A between Kanab and Flagstaff. It's not that the flying above stuff makes it even greater, or greater than anything else you would see by foot - but since that's what others say, it may be just me. PS it can get a bit shaky, so not for the super faint of heart (I didn't feel comfortable all the time and neither did my g/f, however, for the pilots this is total routine and 0 reason to worry)
Fantastic experience ticked all the boxes which we wanted. Flying put of Grand Canyon , was easy to find and park.
Stephen was our driver and our trip only had four people so he came with us and gave us a guided tour. He took our photos and pointed out things we wouldn’t have noticed.
A great experience to tour the Grand Canyon from the sky. Exhilarating and breath-taking. No one this is one of the Seven Wonders of the World.

Absolutely loved this flight! Flying over the Grand Canyon was the one thing I really, really wanted to do. This flight did not disappoint. I choose the airplane flight instead of a helicopter because it was half the price. I wondered if we would fly close enough to the canyon but again I was not disappointed. I got lots of great pics. We flew over areas that can only be seen from the air. Our pilot was friendly and helpful and the flight length was plenty sufficient. This is a must do when visiting the Grand Canyon.

Vuelo de unos 45min con espectaculares vistas del gran cañón en todo su esplendor. La elegimos porque nos pareció la mejor opción calidad precio, y acertamos.
Por ponerle un "pero", cuando estas en vuelo puedes escuchar con unos auriculares una cinta que te va explicando curiosidades del gran cañón. Estaba en varios idiomas, pero no en español. Teniendo en cuenta toda la cantidad de gente latina que vive en usa y los turistas que hablamos castellano que visitamos la costa oeste, no estaria de más que lo pusieran.

We chose plane due to size of the Grand Canyon. Very happy with the choice as plane gives better coverage. Yes you can get helicopter rides covering same distance, which are 2x the price and not as relaxed. Multiple language options are provided and we had a great pilot. We flew in the Cessna Caravan which is smaller and everyone has a window seat. Grand Canyon Scenic Airlines was well organised, punctual.Before booking I read some complaints regarding cost - which I don't think are fair. Pricing is competitive also compared with other locations / countries. People also complained about cancellations. Always book this kind of trips early in your stay. Weather and equipment can cause delays and cancellations, just like any flight you book. We were lucky as the day before the canyon was filled with smoke from a wild fire.So book early and enjoy your flight!

We booked the visit in advance to include hotel pick up, 1hr aeroplane flight, lunch and Hoover Dam tour. 
Definitely worth seeing this natural wonder from the air to appreciate its full beauty. 
An easy check in at the airstrip and a fab pilot named Kyle. Lovely simple lunch with a choice of sandwiches etc. 
Great value for money!! All in all a great day away from The Strip!
We have wonderful memories from the great plane trip we had over the grand canyon. Thank you so very much. We definitely advise everyone to do the same!

review_title: A must do trip but pick a day when it isn't windy
review_text: Very welcoming upon arrival and a couple of nice guys to pilot the fixed wing aircraft. The in-flight info was not relevant to this specific flight and gave general info about the grand canyon. I would have liked to know about which parts exactly of the canyon we were flying over.  The flight was very bumpy indeed and a couple of people threw up when we got back to the terminal.  Great once in a lifetime experience though.

very great day / one of the activity to be absolutly  done.For your foreign customers, ( german, french spanish etc ...) please ask to your guide to speak slow...Even if our english is more or less fluent, it is really better for us if guide take care to speak a undestand and clear english.into the plane,  audio comments are available in different language /  it is ok.for the rest  .. be concentrate!!!

review_title: Perfect way to see the Grand Canyon in one day
review_text: Excellent tour - everything went like clock work and all the guides were really friendly and knowledgeable.  Pilot was good to make sure passengers on both sides of the plane got great views.  Sonny, who showed us Antelope Canyon, was FABULOUS!  He was knowledgeable, and took the time to help each of us get awesome pictures.  The guide on the raft (his name escapes me) was also excellent and so much fun, as was the bus driver back to the airport.  We were able to see some great wildlife along the river as well.  I highly recommend this tour - see  the Grand Canyon from the air, land and water - more than most visitors experience.

Everything we did was well planned. The only waiting we had to do was beofre going to Glen Canyon Dan and the rafts was waiting for a supervisor before we could go through the security check beford getting on the bus. Weather was perfect....
I will never forget the Grand Canyon I saw from heaven. It was more interesting to see the history of the Grand Canyon. I'd like to recommend it sometime.
Really liked everything about it. A little costly but with the cost of running the place and all the people employed, I thought it was well worth the money.
One of the most beautiful things I have ever seen. Very good experience. I recommend taking the flight before entering the park.

Our flight over the Grand Canyon was unforgettable! It was 45 minutes with an interesting audio tour. We were flying over the whole Canyon, the length of our flight was absolutely ok. I would recommend this unforgettable experience to everybody who visits the Grand Canyon!!!
Great views over the Canyon be prepared for a little turbulence but well worth the trip. Very accommodating staff made it easy for my mom to get on and off

review_title: Glen Canyon smooth water raft trip
review_text: From Gigi, our bus driver to Cole, our tour guide - everything was perfect!  This was a 12 hour round trip excursion from our hotel in the Grand Canyon.  Would definitely recommend this trip for those who want to see the canyon from the base!  Breathtaking!
It was a beautiful, informative flight. Great highlights of the Grand Canyon and surrounding area. Courteous crew and comfortable flight. Large windows for taking photos.
Guide Stoney led us on about a two hour Hummer tour of all the highlights. Perfect trip for our first time visit.

the organisaton was perfect and having this flight before going to the grand canyon itself allowed us to give us a perfect view on the grand canyon. The airplane had big windows so there was no stress on missing any views on this magnificent landscape.

review_title: Beautiful views of the Grand Canyon
review_text: We took the 45 minute flight over the Grand Canyon. The terminal was easy to locate, the check in process was efficient and the waiting area comfortable. We had expected to be on a Twin Otter aircraft but instead flew on a Cessna Grand Caravan an 8 seat single engine aircraft. Our pilot was friendly and competent, and I felt at all times that we were under the care of a professional. The interior of the Caravan is a bit small but even at 6'7" I was able to fit relatively comfortable in the seat though I did have to crane my neck a bit to see out the window. The good news about this plane is every seat is a window seat and the windows are more than large enough to offer spectacular views of the Grand Canyon. The narration on the in flight head set was well done, and our pilot showed us some great views, even diverting a bit to give us a look at a heard of buffalo on the North Rim. The flight lived up to expectations as we saw all the points of interest they advertised and had some truly unique views you can't get from either rim. Do not expect this to be like a ride in a commercial jet, due to thermals and high winds the plane tends to get bounced around a lot, with plenty of ups and downs, with that being said our pilot was always in control and kept us right on course the whole flight. I would definitely recommend this tour, just don't eat a heavy meal before boarding.

Would recommend to everyone!  Friendly fast check in, in fact all staff were fantastic !  You are weighed upon check in but only the person behind the counter can see you weight.
