(It’s needed for seating map weight distribution on small plane). We loved our pilot - he was very personable and made us all feel relaxed. 

The views were incredible I had no idea what to expect, but it was far more amazing than I hoped for. They give you a set of headphones so you have some narration of what you are seeing below. This was the highlight of my trip to Vegas!

Wir haben mit GC Scenic Airlines einen Rundflug von 45 Min über den GC gemacht. Tolles Erlebnis den GC mal aus der Luft zu sehen und zu überfliegen. Beim nächsten Mal würden wir aber einen Heli vorziehen, weil der tiefer in den Canyon reinfliegt.
excellent pilot, excellent flight, excellent view. all in all the trip from vegas, which was a 6 hour drive was worth it .
Experience  excitante.....adrenaline at 1.000.I have been my first experienze on piper aeroplane, it has been funny.

review_title: Impresionante e imprescindible tour para apreciar el Gran Canyon
review_text: El Gran Canyon sólo puede apreciarse en su magnitud en un tour aéreo. Nosotros lo hicimos en avioneta en vez de en helicóptero, por el precio, algo más barato en avioneta. Desde el aire el paisaje es espectacular y la grabación que escuchas por los auriculares junto con las cosas que decía el copiloto hacen una experiencia única e imprescindible para conocer Grand Canyon

review_title: superbes paysages. Commentaires en français (bande enregistrée)
review_text: La meilleure façon de se rendre compte de la réalité du Grand Canyon (et son côté 3D). A éviter si vous êtes sujet au mal des transports (mon cas). Mis à part ce "détail", superbe balade, et accueil impeccable. Explications en français (bande enregistrée), très pratique

bellissima esperienza 
Gran Canyon spettacolare da questo punto di vista privilegiato. 
Organizzazione perfetta, personale molto gentile e disponibile, aeroporto vicinissimo a Tusayan.

Abbiamo preso un piccolo aereo, Cessna di 9 posti tutti con il finestrino accanto. consiglio di sedersi nella fila di sinistra guardando il guidatore! lo spettacolo visto dall'aereo È stupendo  Si capisce solo sorvolandolo la vastità del Canyon: si guarda il Colorado, si arriva alla parte Nord. 40 min di bellezza! la giornata era stupenda con un po' di vento ! 
può dar fastidio l'aereo a chi soffre il mal d'aereo, data la dimensione ridotta dell'apparecchio e i venti che potrebbero essere presenti, ma non spaventatevi eccessivamente: lo scenario ripagherà qualche malessere!

Both from the air and ground antelope canyon ,horse shoe bend and the air tour were awesome.The guides were very skilled, < buffalo and justice > they take great pride in there heritage, the pilots very good also. Any one who want to see the grand canyon should book this trip you will love it, I would do it again   Las Vegas to grand canyon    Jim and Tara S

Experiencia inolvidable. Vistas impresionantes del Grand Canyon. Nosotros hicimos el paseo en avioneta. Mi recomendación es que ya que la actividad la vamos a hacer solo una vez en la vida, seguro que merece la pena gastarse un poco más y vivir la experiencia en helicóptero y poder aterrizar en alguna parte del cañón. El personal de la compañia y la pilota muy agradables.

Did the fixed wing 40 min flight, so amazing! We didn’t have much time to spend at the Grand Canyon so this was the perfect way to see a lot of it in a short time. The staff were great, very friendly, the audio on the flight was good. My husband is very tall and they made sure to give him a seat with lots of leg room which he really appreciated. Would highly recommend this company. We really enjoyed it.

review_title: Terrific views of Canyon but not much explanation of what we saw
review_text:
We had a 35-40 minute flight in a small plane around parts of the canyon, which is spectacular.  Looking down from a small plane into the canyon provides incredible views.

It was a little hazy the day we visited because of forest fires.  We understand the airline can't control nature.

However, there was very little explanation of what we were seeing.  This would have been much better with more narration.

This All-day adventure is perfect to truly see everything! It starts with a flight above the Grand Canyon, continues with a tour of Antelope Canyon complete with a photography lesson from a Native American guide, and culminates with a 4 hours float down the Colorado River started at Glen Canyon Dam.  Brayden and Craig were our plane pilots and they were fabulous.  Highly recommend!

WOW - what an amazing 12 hour tour of the Grand Canyon, Navajo Reservation and Glen Canyon with this Canyon Smooth Water Boat Trip.  We were picked up by our hotel and had a wonderful guide, Eddie.  Eddie was very knowledgeable, enthusiastic and eager to show us as much as he could.  The boat tour was let by Kim, who is very passionate about the Colorado River and what she showed us.  The trip was very well organized and very pleasant.  Eddie and Kim made for the most perfect of days!   I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS TRIP.  On a scale of 1-5, this is a 10!

We had the 11 o'clock flight. The pilots were really friendly. We all had a windowseat. The views were amazing. The left side of the plane did get better views though.It was a fantastic experience to see the canyon from up above. Ik would reccommend this adventure.

Una delusione. Pur essendo andati a agosto, e’ capitata una sera fredda e con visibilita’ scarsa; a un certo punto e’ anche iniziato a piovere. Visto che tutti noi passeggeri avevamo freddo a rimanere fuori nei punti panoramici, il tour e’ finito mezz’ora prima senza che ci venisse offerta un’attivita’ alternativa (es. visione di un documentario) ne’ un parziale rimborso. Pessimo rapporto qualita’/prezzo. Guida preparata ma talvolta sgarbata. Mezzo attrezzato per pioggia e freddo ma pessima qualita’ dell’audio.

review_title: OMG - It’s grand from the air!
review_text: We loved our flight with GCSA - the staff were helpful with which ‘flight’ we should choose.  We decided to go on the fixed wing flight which suited our budget a bit better.  The Grand Canyon is amazing from the air and this flight was the perfect way to see it.

review_title: Just Wow. You won’t Be Disappointed!
review_text:
We booked this tour very last minute after stumbling upon a discounted brochure in the back of a taxi that offered an airplane ride over the GrandCanyon, Hoover dam and the Colorado river. This tour appealed to us as it only lasted approximately 4 hours where as bus tours to the Grand Canyon that we had previously quoted would last 12 hours +. We were not disappointed with this tour!!

What an experience and excellent value for money. This is not something that you are going to forget! 

Easy and smooth hotel pick up drop off service. Quick to board the plane within around 25 minutes of arrival which meant time for a restroom stop, a quick drink and photo opportunity.

The views are absolutely breathtaking and the Audio tour/music played is an added bonus. You will have many picture opportunities from the plane fitted with large windows so that you are able to see on both sides.

I would highly recommend this tour to anyone wanting to experience one of the 7 natural wonders of the world in a way you simply won’t forget.

review_title: Fabulous, easy way to see the best of the Grand Canyon
review_text:
would highly recommend this trip. Unless you are driving from Vegas (long long long drive), then you are going to have to spend $$$$ to get to see the best of the Canyon and this tour is no exception, but it’s well executed, good fun and professionally managed. the plane is small so not for anyone with claustrophobia or a fear of flying ! it’s bumpy at times (obvious). but has great windows and views are easy and breathtaking. part of the tour is on a bus - we had a super friendly passionate driver who we loved and who was extremely kind and patient when at one point we ‘lost’ half of our family ! lunch was provided - a perfect little packed lunch which we ate by one of the vista points. 
I felt for us the trip gave us everything we wanted in a day. we booked the 9.30 trip, we were collected at 7.30am from our hotel and were back before 5pm.
A faire pour se rendre compte de l’immensité du site. Quelques turbulences tout de même...les personnes ayant peur en avion de ligne, s’abstenir !!!

review_title: The only way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: We booked a 45min aeroplane ride from the south rim airport and it was fantastic, from the minute you arrive you are dealt with very professionally. The ride was out of this world it the only way to see the canyon. I would recommend this to everybody. Thank you to scenic airline for wonderful 45mins.
We loved every part of this trip and our guides were wonderful! Seeing the Grand Canyon from the air was beautiful? I highly recommend this!

We had booked a 45 min plane trip and the views were stunning. Best views on left of plane (if they always go that way round). Went over the canyon to the North rim and back round. I missed how to change my headphones to English commentary so had the first ten minutes in Spanish! The day before had been really windy and flights had been cancelled, so we were lucky as I wouldn't have wanted to miss it. But it was still windy and the flight was quite bumpy and quite scary. A couple of women on the plane (there were 8 of us) spent the whole flight consoling their two young children who were terrified. So be warned!

review_title: Amazing trip to the Grand Canyon
review_text: We wanted to visit the Grand Canyon from Las Vegas and chose the Connoisseur trip offered by Grand Canyon Scenic Airlines. We didn’t fancy a lengthy bus trip, so chose this option as it involved a 30 minute bus from our Vegas hotel to Boulder City airport and a 1 hour flight to the Grand Canyon airport at the South Rim. Not only was the flight quicker but we got some great views on the way flying over the Hoover Dam, Lake Mead and some of the Canyon. We then transferred to a bus where our excellent driver and guide Steve took us to two different viewpoints - Bright Angel and Mathers Point where we spent about an hour at each. We would have loved longer to absorb the amazing views, but it still gave us enough time to enjoy it. Overall spending about 3 hours at the Canyon is probably longer than the average tour coming from Vegas. The flight in terms of view and reduced travel time was worth the extra cost. Not cheap for a family of four but well worth it.

The trip down the Colorado River at  7am in the morning was very good.  15 mile trip, cost $93 each.  

Good cultural knowledge and cometary by Mick. The scenery changed rapidly with the rising of the sun on the rock walls of the canyon.

Most worthwhile trip.

review_title: Action packed adventure at the Grand Canyon
review_text: Our family had a great time on the combination tour including a flight over the Grand Canyon, a walk through Antelope Canyon, and a float trip down the Colorado River.  The trip was not cheap, but it was worth every penny.  We packed everything we wanted to see in to one day.  I recommend getting a seat on the port (left) hand side of the aircraft for best pictures.  We arrived at Antelope Canyon early before the crowds started to arrive.  Our native guide as fantastic.  I recommend giving your phone or camera to the guide throughout the canyon and ask them to help you with pictures.  The float trip down the river was very calm with no rapids.  You will not get wet so you don't need a bathing suit, unless you want to go swimming.  The river is only 50 degrees so it is not for the faint of heart.  Don't forget a hat, sunglasses, sunscreen, and lots of water.  It's hot out there.  Enjoy!
Awesome!!!  Great, personable, friendly and knowledgeable guides.  Extremely long day but the best way to see a lot in one day

review_title: Used them before, and would again
review_text:
On a previous trip to Vegas we've used this excellent company to visit the Grand Canyon, so we booked with them again as my son-in-law hadn't seen it. 
We weren't disappointed. As confirmed the previous day by telephone, the pick-up was prompt, the trip to the airport outside Vegas swift and smooth, and a very pleasant wait for our flight at a fascinating little airport, watching the planes and choppers depart and arrive. 
My pregnant daughter - who isn't a good traveller anyway - wasn't sick on the flight, which showed how smooth it was. We got great views of Lake Mead, the Hoover Dam, and the Grand Canyon as we came into Tusayon Airport. My daughter was a little sick after the landing, but soon recovered,
We viewed the safety video and boarded our chopper without too much delay, and the staff were brilliant - attentive and caring. Read the company timeline on the wall while you wait, it's fascinating.
The flight over the canyon was amazing, and the audio commentary was supplemented by interesting and insightful comments from our pilot. 
We returned to the airfield and were met by our driver, Eric, who drove us to Mather point for an hour's viewing, and then around the park a little, giving us interesting historical and personal facts about the area. He was really friendly, polite and pleasant to know.
The airplane flight back to Vegas was rougher than the trip in due to afternoon thermals, but all the passengers slept, apart from my son-in-law, who was rewarded with even better views of the canyon than on the flight in. 
My daughter benefitted from sleeping, as she wasn't ill at all. 
All the drivers, staff and pilots were fantastic, as were the aircraft - Twin Otter with HUGE viewing windows, choppers with larger than normal viewing windows and specially developed whisper jet engines and quiet rotors. 
Brilliant!

review_title: Excellent full day trip - well worth the money
review_text: This was a fantastic trip and left us exhausted but very happy. All the tour guides were excellent and made every effort to make the tours interesting and informative.  Big thanks to Dylan (and Channing) for the entertainment during the river trip.  They made sure we were safe and having lots of fun.  Sunscreen is definitely required for the river trip as it is so hot with very little shade on the river.

Abbiamo effettuato il sorvolo al mattino presto, cosa che consiglio perchè non è insolito che durante la giornata si alzi il vento.
Il volo non era pieno ed avevamo tutti un posto finestrino, vantaggio non da poco..
Spettacolare, da lacrima, l'esperienza più emozionante di tutto il viaggio.
Dai punti di osservazione non si riesce a percepire la vastità del Canyon che invece è visibilissima dall'alto.
Da non perdere, vale il viaggio, lo rifarei anche domani!

Started early inn the morning at Grand Canyon Scenic airlines. There we got coffee and breakfast. Had a beautiful flight over the canyon and Lake Powel, just enjoying the view. We visited Antelope cave and got some great pictures thanks to our guide. Made a short bus trip to the Glen canyon dam where we met our next guide, Dylan. Had a great boat trip thanks to him, who had his own humorous way to keep us going in the heat. Ate our box lunch on the way, and got limonade and water whenever we wanted. We also took a cooling bath on the way, it was lovely! The bus trip back "home" was nice and relaxing. All guides were informative and eagered to help along the way. Recomended, especiallly when short on time. 

Thanks for a great day 😊

We booked the full package through Grand Canyon Scenic Airlines: air flight to the Canyon, helicopter trip into the Canyon and river ride, bus tour and Skywalk. The company was constantly professional and helpful. I had to change the dates of our trip twice following a knee injury and the telephone staff handled this perfectly. Unfortunately on the day of our trip temperatures at the base of the Canyon hit 47 degrees and the helicopter and boat trip had to be cancelled as it was too hot for the copters to gain the lift needed to take off. The ground staff were exceptionally professional and courteous and we were given a full refund on the unused portion.

Come mai si chiama "Grand" Canyon?
Ebbene prendete uno di questi voli e lo scoprirete...
Da terra non si può apprezzare veramente bene la vastità del Grand Canyon ma da quassù potrete veramente scoprire che non si vede la fine di questo enorme parco naturale!
Onestamente non c'è altro modo!!! Purtroppo a causa dei vari cambi di altitudine è facile avere degli sbalzi di pressione e quindi un volo un po' turbolento...se soffrite di mal d'aria è sconsigliato, altrimenti non esitate e prenotate un volo!

review_title: Assolutamente da evitare per non avere sorprese
review_text:
Ho prenotato a marzo il tour per quattro persone da effettuare il 24 giugno. Pagato, sulla ricevuta c'era scritto di confermare telefonicamente almeno 24 ore prima, cosa che ho fatto quattro giorni prima. Mi hanno confermato la prenotazione, e mi hanno salutato dicendo  "ci vediamo domenica alle 9".
Alle 8,10 di domenica ci presentiamo in aeroporto, ben prima del richiesto ( report at the terminal 30' before flight ), e la signora del check in candidamente mi dice che il volo è stato cancellato e che siamo stati spostati sul volo delle 10. Mentre discuto sulla cosa, parlando anche telefonicamente col centro prenotazioni a Las Vegas, arriva un gruppo di cinesi che fanno il check in e si imbarcano sul nostro volo! Alle mie rimostranze, una sgarbatissima signorina del check in, tale Kecia Torivio, addirittura si è rifiutata di rispondermi. A quel punto, fuori di me, ho riparlato con le prenotazioni dicendo che non era vero che il volo era stato cancellato, ma evidentemente un gruppo più corposo del nostro era più remunerativo. Hanno detto di avermi chiamato al telefono, il che non è assolutamente vero, e di avermi mandato una mail, cosa che effettivamente avevano fatto la sera prima alle 22, ma chi guarda in continuazione le mail in vacanza? Risultato, ho chiesto il rimborso ( dovevamo assolutamente partire dopo il volo per un programma piuttosto impegnativo ), e mi sono riservato di scrivere una pessima recensione.

Very professional and great at their jobs. We took an Otter from Boulder to the Bar 10 Ranch.  What a smooth landing and a view of Hoover Dam. They also provided the helicopter from the Bar 10 to the bas of the Grand Canyon.  Excitement all the way.

We loved our flight over the Grand Canyon. We chose to drive to the South Rim and then take the tour from the airport there.

We thought the whole service was excellent. Had a plane with all window seats so didn't have to pay the upgrade. Views out both sides were great and the scenery really is breathtaking. It was a bit bumpy so if you are a nervous flyer then take this into consideration. The plane is small.
There is a pre-recorded audio commentary for certain parts along the route. But mainly you are staring out at the amazing scenery.

Can't compare the tour with a helicopter trip, but I can say that the value for money on the fixed wing flight was great. We thought about a heli trip but it was too expensive for us.

Good value for money - amazing experience - would do it again for sure.

review_title: Brilliant but only if you have the helicopter option
review_text:
This was a superb day out. They collected us from the hotel on time, took us to Boulder City airport and then onto a little plane to the Canyon. 

The plane ride was a little bumpy but we had great views from it. 

The helicopter ride was superb. It's a shame that it didn't go into the Canyon. If I did this again, I'd book one that did. However it was very smooth and the pilot played Marley's "Don't worry, bout a thing" as we took off. 

We then went on a bus to the Canyon itself. This was ok as an add on but if I'd gone all that way without the copter trip I'd be mightily pee'd off.

If you do this 90 minute flight in June make sure you have water ! Planes are pretty old so air conditioning failed for most of the flight - and it was over 💯 degrees- no warning from the flight company either.

review_title: This was a great day trip!
review_text:
This was a great day!   I do have a few suggestions to improve it.  

The airplane trip over the Grand Canyon started very early.  The box breakfast before the plane ride was nice.  I would suggest saying the fruit and granola bar for later because no snack or water will be offered you until the boat ride.  The plane was small but comfortable.  The plane had seen better days.  There was still trash in the seat pockets from the last riders.  Also, my headphones did not work to hear the recorded audio tour.  I had to reach to the seat in front of me to get headphones that worked.  If the plane had been full, I would not have been able to hear the recording.  The recording was boring.  Fortunately, the pilot gave a smooth ride and landing.  The scenery was, of course, spectacular.  

After, the plan ride we were dumped in a very small airport and loaded into jeeps for a tour of the antelope canyon.  The tour of the antelope canyon was really beautiful.  The guide was knowledgeable and friendly.  She had lots of good photographic tips.   

Between the plane ride and antelope tour, there was no offer of snacks or drinks.   It was a very long morning between the box breakfast and getting on the boat.   

At the raft headquarters, we were rudely pointed to some outhouses which did not have any toilet paper and were in bad need of being emptied.  The way we were treated at this part of the tour almost ruined the day for me.   We were handed our lunches and sent for a bag search.  I'm not sure why we were handed our lunches at this point.  It would make more sense to have the lunches at the boats already on board.  

The bus ride to the boat was extremely rough in the old school bus which needed shocks..   

The boat ride down Glen Canyon was spectacular!   Our guide, Jarod, was charming, entertaining, knowledgeable, and thoughtful.   This was a great part of the tour.  We stopped a couple of times to stretch legs and use the restrooms.  (The restrooms in the canyon were better than the restrooms at the rafting headquarters.)  There was water and lemonaid offered on the boat.  

We were not prepared for the loooonnnnnggg bus ride, 2 1/2 hours, back to the airport.   We stopped at a trading post which was very nice.    I would have liked to have a stop at a canyon overlook during this long ride back.  Then, the day could have included a view of the canyon from the sky, river, and edge.   

Overall, really a great day, however, the trip organizers need to be more considerate of the comfort of their patrons.

review_title: Scenic Tour of Grand Canyon, Antelope Canyon and Colorado River all in one day!!
review_text: Our family of 4 booked this trip due to limited time during our vacation to see the Grand Canyon.  I thought it would the perfect solution and sounded like fun.  I have two girls, 20 and 14. We all enjoyed the short plane ride over the Grand Canyon once we made it to the airport.  We received our box breakfast, which consisted of an apple, yogurt, muffin and a small orange juice.  Not too bad.  Got to Page AZ where they escorted us into the airport office to await our "jeep" ride to Antelope Canyon.  Well they loaded us in the back of a trailer attached to a pick up truck.  It was Memorial Day, and not quite warm enough for a 15 minute trip in an open trailer on the back of a truck but we made it.  Our tour guide was Rosie.  Very nice and knowledgeable about the Canyon.  It was amazing and a pleasant surprise for our tour.  Pictures we got were phenomenal.  Spent about 1-2 hours here.  It was hot once we got to Antelope Canyon but the temp inside was cool.  When this part of the tour was done, they loaded us again in the trailer and took us to the drop for the raft portion of the trip. It was around 12 noon now.  They gave us our box lunches that were decent; ham sandwich, chips, granola bar, apple and a cookie.  We got to the boat part and they once again loaded us on school bus and we road to a loading area near a dam.  I believe it was called Glen Canyon Dam.  It looks very similar to Hoover Dam and to see it close up was kinda cool.  They split the families up and escorted us to these large pontoon rafts like shown in the online pictures.  They are nice.  They are stocked with cans of lemonade and a big jug of water so you can refill your water bottles.  We did this several times due to the length of the trip and the heat.  Keep in mind it was only May 28th and temps were around 85-90 that day in the Canyon.  They raft ride was beautiful but a little too long.  We were on the boat for about 5 hours.  Could have done it 3 and that would have been enough for us all.  The scenery was beautiful, we stopped a couple of times to see different sights.  We put our feet in the Colorado River which was about 47 degrees.  We got back to the dock and they escorted us to a large motor coach for the 3 hours ride back to the Airport.  EVERYONE on the bus was exhausted.  I think everyone, including kids went to sleep.  That bus was as quite as a church.  We road about 1-1/2 hours and we stopped at a gift shop.  You could go to the restroom, get a snack or buy souvenirs.  We then drove to the Grand Canyon National Park to drop those who were staying there.  They took the rest of us to the airport right after.  We got back to our car around 6 I believe.  LONG day.   LOTS of great memories and pictures.  Glad we did it.  Would be a much better tour if the raft portion was continuous movement and a shorter time frame.

My husband and children (18,19) had a great time on this trip!  The early morning plane ride was terrific, and as we had read before, it’s best to sit on the left side of the plane for the best views!
  The off road driving in trucks to Antelope Canyon was pretty bumpy and dusty- but hey- you’re on an adventure! Our guide Patrick was amazing; a native to the area and extremely knowledgeable about every camera and phone camera! Got us the best pictures! A wonderful guide! 
 The boxed lunches came next, pretty good- only no specific time to eat them. We were starving since we’d been going since 6am and so we ate them on the bus ride to the raft place (even though they said no eating on the bus!) after the informal TSA check.      Our rafting guide, Jerod, was really terrific; super knowledgeable and kept all the younger kids on the boat engaged! The only thing I was disappointed in, was not wearing my bathing suit, as we had opportunity to get in the river, and I hadnt read it was going to be allowed. The rafting was super hot, but lemonade and water are provided, and he put the boat in the shady areas as much as possible when we were stationary hearing about the canyon. 
The walk up to the ptyroglyphs is eh, well, a few carvings on rock- not that impressive- but history I understand. Nice comfy AC  bus back.  Stop at gift store Ok too! Overall we loved the whole trip!

review_title: Air, Land and Water Tour. Poor Coordination and Management of Time.
review_text:
We were really looking forward to the 'Scenic Canyon River Adventure' tour that was offered through Grand Canyon Scenic Airlines.

To take you through the process, let us start at the beginning:

You arrive at the airport, where you were promised a breakfast prior to your plane flight. The breakfast was a box breakfast, made up of a muffin, yogurt, apple and an orange juice. If you wanted coffee, you had better arrive early, because they only had one coffee dispenser, which emptied quickly, and they were not going to refill it.

Once on the plane, if you were fortunate enough to sit on the left side, you had spectacular views of the South and North Rims. However, if like me, you sat on the right, you only had views of the dry, flat land. Occasionally, you caught a glimpse of the canyon itself.

When we returned to the airport, we were told to step outside to wait to be picked up by a vehicle to take us to Antelope Canyon. A pickup truck showed up, rather than the hummers they displayed on their booking website!. They started shuffling people in the bed of the truck, where they had tight bench seating. The kept telling us to 'Hurry, Hurry'. They tried to separate me and my husband, and we said we together and did not want to be separated on the tour. The driver was incredibly rude, and told us that there was only room for one, and we imay not fit on the next truck coming through. 

We took our chances and waited for the next vehicle. We got in that truck bed, and the truck raced away to a strip mall parking lot, where they were picking up additional people for the tour, who were running late. They yelled at the people to 'Hurry, Hurry, Hurry...you are making everyone late!'

When everyone was finally on board, the truck sped through streets and then on to a rough dirt road, where we were jostled and choking down dust and dirt from the road. 

We finally arrived at Antelope Canyon, our tour guide led us through as a group. This, quite honestly, was the best part of our tour. The guide was amazing and knowledgeable. She even helped us align our cameras to get the best photo ops. She pointed out not only the rock formations and nicknames for the formations, but also had great historic stories of floods through the canyon. Very enjoyable!!!

Following this tour, we were loaded back in to the trucks and taken to a bus pickup location, where we were given some instructions on the raft portion of our tour, and handed box lunches. These consisted of a good turkey sandwich, chips, cookies and an apple. 

We arrived at the raft launch, and boarded the raft. The guide on this tour spent much of the time talking about himself, but did manage to slip in a bit of history along the way. They did provide water and lemonade on the raft to keep everyone hydrated. This turned out to be a good thing, because it was not a 'fast' raft trip. Rather, most of the time, the raft sat stationary, while the guide talked and pointed out the rock formations and explained the reasons for the formations and colors. 

Unfortunately, we were almost always just sitting in the sun, and without any movement, we didn't even have the brief relief of a breeze. The raft ride was drawn out well beyond what was necessary. Everyone on board was so relieved to get off of the raft! The trip could have been done in less than half the time, and move along at a better pace. 

From there, we were place on a bus to take everyone back. The did drop some people off directly at their hotels/lodges, prior to taking everyone back to the airport where we started. Unfortunately, because everyone was on edge from the unnecessarily lengthy raft trip, people were very irritated that they had to wait to be taken back to the airport. Poor bus driver!

Overall, we would say to save your money, and not take this 'adventure' trip!!!

My hubby had never been to the Grand Canyon so we decided to see “everything” in one day. This trip surpassed our expectations—highly recommend it. Plane ride to Page was breathtaking and not scary (seats about 20 passengers and they weigh you before you get on) —smooth ride with great views over the canyon. The guides are very knowledgeable—our guide for Antelope Canyon showed us how to get the best photo angles. And Mick on the river raft was very entertaining with jokes, tricks and even a banjo/harmonica seranade as we drifted along the river. The river trip made 2 stops on small beaches for those brave enough to tip their toes in 48 degree water. The raft ride was about 4 hours—could’ve shortened it a bit. Otherwise a perfect day!

Der rundflug war klasse.  Alle sehr nett und freundlich.  Beim rundflug erhält man die infos via kopfhörer auf deutsch wenn man möchte.  Das flugzeug hat eigentlich nur fensterplätze - das garantiert atrmbrraunende aussichten

Steve was great captain. We had 9 passenger. Didn’t have to pay extra $15 for window seat. If you end up going into larger flight you will be asked if you want to. 
Ps. Thank you Steve for your story and sympathy!

The tour we took provided amazing views of the Grand Canyon, Antelope Canyon and the Colorado River. Jerod and Gigi were helpful, informative and humerous. Unfortunately the woman who provided the Antelope Canyon Tour and the woman who transported us to the Colorado River Raft tour were rude and put a damper on our experience. I understand the their jobs can be hectic, but that is no excuse for poor customer service.

This flight-seeing tour enabled us to see and photograph all the land feature highlights from above. The pilots were top notch skilled professionals and the flight was flawless. An interesting feature is the narration coordinated with the views from the windows that brought the experience home. 

The twin Otter plane is comfortable, the flight was smooth, and the ride was priceless.

review_title: Much better than 12 hours on a bus
review_text: I guess it depends on what you’re looking for, but I wanted to go to the Canyon and Hoover Dam whilst we were close by in Vegas. My first shock was how long it takes to get out to the South Rim and back and I just wasn’t prepared to do that with two young teenage girls. So after searching the internet for options (and trying a few companies who were all booked out because I had left it until the day before) I found what I wanted on Grand Canyon Scenic Tours website. They drive you out to their base near Hoover Dam and you take a 19 seater plane over the Dam and the West Rim. I know some people will say that the West Rim is not as spectacular as the South Rim, but spending 12 hours on a coach was not an option. After the plane ride we had lunch provided and then a bus picked us up to take us to the Dam where you do a tour and then have some free time to walk across the Dam and take photos. The trip is well organised and everyone is polite and helpful. It was still a long day and the temperatures were hit (100 degree out at the Dam). I took a shade umbrella which didn’t really make any difference when walking over the Dam. Glad we didn’t go out to South Rim and have to walk!

My partner and I are extremely disappointed in the tour.
From the pick up to drop off. Pick up driver was quite rude and agitated at the start. 
Flights, fixed wing and rotary wing were not informative. The rotary wing pilot did not even acknowledge we were in the air craft. 
Lunch consisted of a paper bag handed over the flight counter and told on your way, its self guided the bus is out the front, it has three drop off points, be back before 415.

Boat ride, the guide we had was the best experience of the trip, he actually acknowledged us, spoke of the area, answered some questions and was polite, informative and friendly.

I called the information/confirmation number to confirm the time duration of the “tour” prior to booking tickets in Las Vegas for a show. I was assured we would be back at our resort well in time prior to the show.

Check in to the bus ride home was awful. I politely asked if my partner and I could catch the earlier bus as have pre booked tickets for a show. He was rude, inconsiderate and unhelpful.
I asked the driver if we could come hop on his ride, he was very polite and said should be no problem. He asked the check in guy. He was rude to the driver and me again.

Certainly not a happy experience.

We were lucky enough to have this trip gifted to us by my sister as a thank you, after this trip we are the ones thanking her for such a great experience. Seeing the Grand Canyon in person is one thing you really need to do if you get the chance. But to see it from a low flying plane, getting to walk through a slot canyon then raft down the river from Glen Canyon is a truly memorable way to spend a full day.

We started the day at sunrise on a 9 seater plane taking off from Tusayan airport. We had a 30 minute flight over the canyon with the added excitement of some bad turbulence to wake everyone up. After landing we got in a jeep to the famous Antelope Canyon. We were given a great guided tour which included assistance on the best camera settings and vantage points to get the best photographs.

After that it was back on the jeep for a ride into the dam at the head of Glen Canyon. We then got on our rafts for a leisurely 2.5 hour float down the calm waters of Glen Canyon. Your sense of perspective is really fooled by the sheer scale of the canyon and the height of the walls towering above you. We got to float around horseshoe bend, stop for a picnic lunch, see ancient wall drawings and were even lucky enough to a see a family of horses drinking from the river edge near the end of the trip.

It was a truly wonderful day that won't be forgotten, we spent the next day driving along the south rim which was spectacular, but actually being down in the canyon was a special experience and something we highly recommend.

review_title: Tolles Erlebnis zu Wasser, Luft und zu Land
review_text:
Dieser Tagesausflug ist ein absolutes Highlight bei einem Besuch des Grand Canyons. Es geht sehr früh los mit einem Flug über den Grand Canyon mit tollen Eindrücken, vor allem wenn die Sonne gerade am Aufgehen ist. Horseshoe Bend von oben zu sehen und eigene Fotos zu schießen sind tausendmal besser als jede Postkarte.

Nach der Landung in Page wurden wir zum Antelope Canyon gebracht und genossen eine eher hektische Führung mit Photo-mach-Hinweisen. Der Antelope Canyon ist einfach zu eindrucksvoll um noch ein paar Worte über die hektische Führerin zu verlieren.

Die Fahrt ab dem späten Vormittag auf dem Colorado River ist nicht minder beeindruckend. Der Unterschied zum Flug ist die Sicht nun nach oben. Die eindrucksvollen Steilwände wirken nicht eintönig und wenn man dann beim Horseshoe Bend vorbeikommt, diesmal aber unten, werden die Dimensionen noch einmal vor Augen geführt. Der Bootsführer untermalte mehr oder weniger zu jeden Stein mit einer persönlichen Story, aber man muß ja nicht immer zuhören.

Der letzte Teil der Tour geht dann mit dem Bus zurück nach Tusayan. Der Fahrer weiß natürlich auch einiges zu erzählen und der obligatorische Stop an einer Trading Post lockert das ganze auf.

Der Tagesausflug war ein sehr tolles Erlebnis. Wer nicht so lange Zeit hat am Grand Canyon zu bleiben, sollte so etwas machen. Es ist auf jeden Fall ein Erlebnis und auch wenn es lange dauert, so schöne Eindrücke von oben und von unten des Colorado Rivers und der Canyons bekommt man anders nur sehr schwer.

Booked a day earlier, everything went well from booking to boarding. We could fly the 8 seats plane just me and my honey, it was great. View of the Grand Canyon by plane is just a Great and moving  experience.

A flight of about 45 minutes over the canyon in a small plane - a great way to get a feel for the sheer size of the canyon, and to see right down to the river below. Especially loved the view of the Little Colorado River feeding in to the Colorado River - the color of the water was beautiful.

Although only 45 minutes long this flight takes in some breathtaking views of the Grand Canyon including the confluence Colorado River and little Colorado River, the higher North Rim and the surrounding terrain. We spent just two days visiting the Canyon and this flight was definitely the highlight. We were on a 10 seater Cessna 208 so we all had window seats which was great. This may not be true of all their planes so it may be worth checking what planes are flying.

I would also add that the staff were tremendous as we were delayed in arriving and missed our scheduled flight which was the last of the day. They had no hesitation in offering us alternative flights the next day.

El viaje es para apreciar la magestuocidad del paisaje. El vuelo se realiza en aviones pequeños pero son vuelos suaves y tranquilos. Tomar fotos no permite apreciar lo que significa el lugar, hay que guardarlos en nuestra retina. La calidez del personal es inmejorable.

Who wouldn’t love to take a plane circling the Grand Canyon?  Our pilot was a younger, gorgeous professional lady who flew us around the perimeter. There is no better way to drink in the majestic natural wonder of the world than by this flight. Worth every penny! Do it for yourself!

review_title: See the canyon from the air as well
review_text: Great flight, professional team, well worth it. Great way to see the overall size of the canyon. 45 min flight is probably enough

review_title: I love the Colorado River - its an amazing place to visit a must do!
review_text: We were in Las Vegas and the 3 of decided we wanted to do a bit of local nature. After looking at all the options we selected to do a raft tour on the Colorado River, we booked via Viator and the vendor was on time at 815am to pick us up and start the journey below the Hoover Dam, it took a while to get there, but eventually we boarded the raft and off we went.  It’s an amazing river, the water is clean 98% for drinking and at some points its 30 feet deep. You know you in Nature floating down the river and looking at the rocky banks with some small “beaches” you can stop for swimming when the water is not below 50 degrees.  We enjoyed every moment of our 3 hour journey.  The lunch they offered sucked, we were starving by the time we got back to Vegas LOL.  The trip ends on the Arizona side where the clock/time never changes…weird and funny at the same time, two states separated by a river having different time zones.  A must do!  Next time we want to rent canoes and do it on our own.

We decided to take the airplane ride, about 40 minutes. Great views over the canyon, made possible by the huge windows on both sides of the airplane. We had our seats in the back of the plane, only two seats, which is better that the other seats in the front were you have 2x2 seats. Not so easy if you want to shoot movies or take pictures. But after having assessed the options you have in terms of sightseeing trips I highly recommend to take the helicopter tour. The airplane is staying above the rim, while helicopters go in the canyon, we could see them flying below us in the canyon.

review_title: Algo que não pode faltar no roteiro
review_text:
Fiz o passeio de helicóptero pelo Grand Canyon “Grand Celebration” 
Todo o staff foi muito amigável, o voo tem uma duração aproximada de 70minuto (ida e volta) incluindo uma parada no meio do Canyon para fotos, um lanche rápido e um brinde de espumante! 
Se você gosta de paisagens incríveis, faça esse passeio!
Peça um upgrade para os assentos na frente! REALMENTE VALE A EXPERIÊNCIA!

We took a flight over the Grand Canyon as part of an all day tour including a visit to Antelope Canyon, visiting the dam and then floating down the Colorado and ending in Navajo country with a drive back to the airport. I’m not sure if this tour was offered through scenic airlines but the page directed me here. The flight was beautiful-about one hour over the canyon at daybreak. The pilot was great and very professional, the views were breathtaking and the ride was smooth enough for this jittery passenger. Highly recommended (the whole entire tour was fantastic).

review_title: This is a good way to see the canyon from a new perspective
review_text:
The on line reservation process was pretty easy. 
The location is relatively easy to find.  

The check in was easy and they allowed us to change flight time when our plans changed.  
There is a waiting area, but on popular days it can be crowded. 
The operation seemed to be well run.  Pilots would come and call each group to the plane.  No one was allowed on the flight line unescorted.

We were on the Caravan, which is a somewhat smaller plane which seated 10 people.  The seats were not standard airline seats, but they were comfortable enough for a short flight.  Some seats would be tight for very tall folks.  The views were generally good, but some very tall or very short people might find some seats to have less than ideal views.  
Each seat had Bose headphones.  They played a prerecorded commentary which told a bit about the canyon and how it was formed.  Occasionally the pilot would come on and add a bit of commentary.  
I am a licensed pilot and to my eye, the aircraft appeared to be well maintained.  The pilots appeared to be very competent and took safety very seriously.  
The flight doesn’t go over the same part of the canyon as the visitor center, rather it appears the flights follow a set route to avoid the popular areas.  

The tour is not cheap at $150 or so, but it is cheaper than the helicopter tours and it allows you to see a great deal of the canyon from a perspective you can only get from the air.  
I would recommend this tour.

Tidlig morgen til den lille lufthavn, hvor der blev uddelt madpakker som morgenmad. Fløj med 19 personers fly ind over Grand Canyon i 50 minutter. Fik fortalt om turen via øretelefoner. Flottere kan det næsten ikke blive. Snyd ikke jer for den oplevelse, tilbage med bus fra lufthavnen i Page

I travelled with my family (3 of us) and had one full day to get to know the Grand Canyon in the most comprehensive way possible. We spent the prevoius late afternoon at the South Rim. After some research we came upon this tour. What a best way to spend a full day at the Grand Canyon than by air, land and river? The tour is expensive indeed, but worth it, specially if you have children. The three parts of the tour are led by very professional people. Oue pilots, Antelope Canyon Navajo guide and our river guide were all awesome.

Your day starts at 6 am at the Grand Canyon airport located in Tusayan. After checking in and geting a decent boxed breakfast you climb over the canyon with a group of no more than 20 people in a specially conditioned plane. Having viiews of the cnayon all the way to Page airport for an hour during the first light of the day is just incredible. Mind you...winds can pick up up there and you may have a bit of a bumpy ride for moments of the flight.

Next, after landing in Page, trucks will take you to Antelope Canyon early enough to beat the crowds (believe me, it makes a difference). Our guide was super and make magic with our phone cameras.

After that you are dropped off to pick up a packed lunch and get down to the river where you will raft for a few hours with a superb explanation of the formations, stop for a break, see petrogyphs, even swim in Colordao River if you want.

The vews from the river and the peace down there cannot be explained with words. It is a unique experience.

Later in the afternoon you have a 2 hour bus drive to Tusayan with a stop at Cameron Trading Post.

review_title: Ne pas hésiter à survoler le Grand Canyon en avion De Havilland
review_text: Ce grand canyon vu de l'avion De Havilland est un vrai bonheur malgré le bruit et les turbulences. Pilotes confirmés malgré l'âge des appareils!

review_title: Good airline to charter for your Grand Canyon float trip.
review_text: Our group (Tour West) chartered with Grand Canyon Airlines to fly our group from Boulder City to Marble Canyon for the put-in, and then we were picked up at the Bar Ten Ranch airstrip at the conclusion of our river trip.  Our group of 16 flew in a Twin Otter, and the flights were professionally operated by experienced pilots.  There was quite a bit of wind shear flying into Marble Canyon so we were diverted to Page to land on the larger strip.  The pilot landed the aircraft in a serious cross-wind but he landed the plane safely.  Our flights were also very scenic by the way!  We fly a lot in Alaska in some pretty marginal weather, and I would recommend this airline to anyone visiting the Grand Canyon.

review_title: Expected more of the Connoisseur tour
review_text:
My husband and i booked our Connoisseur tour to go to the Grand Canyon South on the 19th and below is are overall experience:
Pros: 
- Beautiful views as promised 
- Very friendly staff - the bus driver at the Grand Canyon South was amazing! He blew us all away with his happiness, assisted us with answers and took amazing pictures of us and people on the tour with us. 
Cons:
- The flight was delayed. Upon my complain they gave me a picture for free, but still sucks as you make plans for the day arrive there way earlier and have to wait an hour because the pilot is in training.
- The flight on our way there was AWFUL! We all thought we would not make it. The win was extremely strong, which I understand its not their fault. We were informed that we could face some turbulence and even signed a document for that, but that was not SOME that was the WHOLE flight which made us all very sick and because of that we were not able to enjoy the tour as much. So I wish the staff would have informed us of the extremely bad winds and offered to possibly reschedule the flight or something.
- The food they give us is not Connoisseur... it was just okay. So bring some snacks just in case. 
- The last big complain was the windows. They were not as big as i saw in the pictures and expected. So maybe they flew us in another plane that had small windows which i did not like it at all especially with my husband being 6.4.

With all that said it is a good company, we might have just chosen a bad day.

review_title: Bel tour, volo la scelta migliore
review_text:
GRAND CANYON CONNOISSEUR (Papillon - Scenic Airlines)
Volo + pullman al South Rim
Piano di viaggio:
7.40 navetta hotel
8 cambio navetta alla stazione navette e partenza per aeroporto Boulder City
9.15 partenza volo da Boulder City
10.15 atterraggio aeroporto South Rim
11 arrivo con pullman a Gran Canyon Village (Bright Angel Lodge)
12.30 dopo visita autonoma, partenza per Mather Point
13 dopo visita autonoma, partenza per aeroporto South Rim
13.30 arrivo in aeroporto
14 decollo volo
15 atterraggio volo a Boulder City
15.30 navetta per Las Vegas
16.30 navetta per hotel
16.35 arrivo hotel
Commento:
Per circa 300$, volo con aereo+autobus con 2 soste è forse la soluzione migliore per chi vuole visitare in giornata il Gran Canyon partendo e tornando a Las Vegas.
Il South Rim è forse una delle zone più spettacolari del Gran Canyon.
Le navette della Papillon ti vengono a prendere di fronte ai maggiori hotel della Strip. Con il volo (è un aereo da turismo, si vola relativamente bassi) si può ammirare il Canyon dall'alto e fare fotografie spettacolari (risparmiando sull'elicottero), oltre ad essere un mezzo veloce.
Sull'aereo c'è il commento in inglese, spagnolo e giapponese. Buona idea pagare i 15$ per il posto vicino al finestrino, per fare le foto dall'alto alla Diga di Hoover e al fiume Colorado.
Consiglio di scegliere un tour, come il Connoisseur, in cui si scende a terra, per immergersi veramente e percepire la grandezza del posto (sconsiglio i tour solo aerei). Le due soste dell'autobus Papillon sono sufficienti, il Canyon è simile nei vari punti.
Papillon professionale: quel giorno pioveva al mattino (rarissimo) e offrivano il rimborso a chi rinunciasse a partire, con riaccompagnamento a Las Vegas.
Viene fornito un pranzo con panino, 2 pacchetti di patatine, dolce e due bottigliette d'acqua a testa.
Prezzo non economico, ma è l'opzione migliore, sul pullman sarebbe stato un viaggio eterno, con l'elicottero si spendeva inutilmente troppo. Consigliatissimo.
This is the best way to see the Grand Canyon!!!  Our pilot, Ken, was very professional and friendly. The flight was wonderful.  This flight was the highlight of our visit to Grand Canyon.

We took the plane ride from Tusayan up to Page, followed by a visit to Antelope Canyon and finally a float trip down the Colorado River from Glenn Canyon Dam down to Lee's Ferry.  Final stage was a bus trip back to Tusayan.  All of the guides were very knowledgeable and professional.  Pilot did a great job of showing us all of the canyon despite low cloud cover.  Antelope Canyon guide was excellent at pointing out the best photo ops, and even showed people how to get the most out of their I Phone cameras by having them select the proper settings in the different light conditions.  River guide (Justin) did a great job of explaining the canyon and the geology.  Also had some fun along the way with the other boats.  Bus ride back was very comfortable, with a nice movie about the history of white water rafting through the canyon.  The driver was very courteous and professional.  Outing was a full day and well worth it.

Selected "Grand Canyon Connoisseur" tour after seeing the great reviews here and was really looking forward to it. 

Got off to a bad start as we had to wait an hour for the plane which was due to fly 9.15am (for the south rim) and there were no information/explanation whatsoever for the delay. Then the headphones on the plane was faulty. 

Next, we were grouped together with a Japanese tour group, with a scenic airlines guide who appeared to be dedicated to them. From the minute we landed in Grand Canyon, there were no instructions on where to head to and we had to find our own way and ask around. On the coach rides, other than a short introduction from the other English speaking guide, the Japanese guide hogged the microphone and everything conversed during the rides were in Japanese language. This was despite there were other English speaking people on the tour, who obviously doesn't understand Japanese.

For each of the 2 stops, 50 minutes were given for us to walk around. The tour ended around 2pm and then AGAIN, another long 50 minutes wait for the return flight with no information on delay. Would have thought there would be better planning and more seamless transfers for an established tour. 

Though the views of the Grand Canyon were fantastic, this tour really marred the whole experience.

review_title: Amazing day for everyone in the family
review_text: We just took a 2+ week vacation and this tour was unanimously the highlight of the whole vacation for everyone in our party (2 families, both with kids 13 and 11).  The plane ride over the Grand Canyon is incredible and Antelope Canyon is unspeakably beautiful.  The hand-off from one tour company to the next throughout the day was seamless -- they really handled a lot of moving pieces so well.  Definitely recommend bringing water shoes, water bottles, and a great camera. Can't say enough about this tour.

Line service guys were right there when we taxied in. Van came down from the FBO and took the passengers into Tusyan to catch a ground tour. FBO staff made my wait comfortable. Even the tower folks were extraordinary friendly and accommating. Was a great visit.

How do you make a Grand Canyon trip even better? From the air, that's how. 40 minutes or so doesn't seem a lot but I can assure you it seems to last an age. It is breathtaking, from the moment you step on board. A great crew and interesting recorded commentary, though I was too busy taking pics and looking open-mouthed at the sights below.

Do this. I promise you won't regret it.

Le survol du Grand Canyon est indispensable (même si écologiquement les rotations des avions et hélicoptères laissent songeur...).
Nous avons choisi le survol en avion (pour 4) qui est moins cher et plus long que l'hélico, et permet d'avoir une magnifique vue d'ensemble.

Compagnie très pro : respect des horaires - audiophones en français - explications complémentaires (en anglais, of course !).

Pensez à réserver à l'avance.

I read the negative reviews that call this company and tour a scam...it's not.  I read reviews that said the toll free number leads to a call centre.  When you call a hotel to book a room - you also read a call centre.  Not sure what he big deal is.  I booked a package over the phone with no problem - the tour was excellent and very informative. It's a great way to see thr Grand Canyon.

This 45-minute flight was amazing. At first we flew above the forest, but after a few minutes we were at the south Rim of the Canyon. During the flight the co-pilot told us something about the sights down below us. It was an amazing experience.

Bellissima esperienza, che permette una visita privilegiata del Grand Canyon. Vista spettacolare, con un tocco di fortuna: eravamo soltanto 8 persone su circa 20 posti quindi hanno assegnato a tutti un posto sl finestrino. Il volo era programmato per le 9 ma, causa pioggia e vento, è stato posticipato alle h9.45 per permettere un volo in sicurezza con una vista piacevole. Ottimo compromesso direi. Guida audio disponibile in diverse lingue, personale di terra e di volo gentilissimo. 40 minuti incantevoli!!!

review_title: Great way to see the Canyon from above!
review_text: Our family loved this tour of the grand canyon from the air. It our first view of the canyon and they had headsets to listen to music and information about the canyon. The pilots were nice and it was a great experience. Not as sexy as the helicopter ride but less money and for a family of 5 it was perfect.

My family and I had a great experience with Scenic Airlines. The staff was very professional and safety focused. The flight was awe-inspiring in the perspective it gave on the Grand Canyon. The pilots weren't just great at flying but were great guides. Seeing the Grand Canyon was absolutely astounding. I would highly recommend.

review_title: A must do day tour of the Grand Canyon & surrounds
review_text: This was a 12 hour adventure to remember - it started with a flight over the Grand Canyon to Page, Arizona where we were then taken to the amazing slot canyons of Antelope Canyon via 4WD where our Native American guide took us through the slot canyons, giving us some helpful hints on achieving the perfect photos.  Then back to Page; handed our lunch packs and on a bus to join Colorado River Discovery on the mighty Colorado - don't panic, it was a motor driven raft, no rapids, 15.5 miles floating down the river...  you even get to float through Horseshoe Bend.... Make sure you swim, no matter how cold the water is.  Stopped for viewing of ancient petroglyphs; bathrooms along the way; lunch, snacks and drinks.  Finish at Lee's Ferry, then board the bus for a 3.5 hour drive back to the airport; stopping for food or souvenirs at the Cameron Trading Post.

Obviously it's difficult to be disappointed by the views of The Grand Canyon, but we had booked a 'jeep' trip to the Canyon, which (by the sound of the vehicle) we thought would take us off the beaten track. Not so. We landed near the canyon, had a sandwich lunch and were then taken in a Pink Jeep to two viewpoints on the main road. No off-road, no unique vantage points. Misleading in all our views...

Simply the best way to see the Grand Canyon.Grand Canyon Airlines in a fixed wing twin prop aircraft provided a fantastic low level and at times rather bumpy and exhilarating flight over the Grand Canyon. What a truly amazing experience. Our two pilots were professional, calm, friendly and authoritative as they flew us over some incredible views of inaccessible areas in and around the Grand Canyon which could only be truly appreciated from the air. You get what you pay for. It isn't cheap but boy it's worth every cent.

I would strongly recommend this experience assuming you can handle riding in a small plane which can often be very bumpy! A few adults on the plane were quite sick and they obviously didn't enjoy it but the rest of us did!
The pilots were knowledgeable and polite and made sure we were comfortable. The views are incredible. This is truly one of the only ways to see so much of the Grand Canyon. I strongly recommend it!
We took the Grand Canyon tour and it was the experience of a lifetime, the pilot was great and great value for money..

Volo di un'ora circa da tusayan a page
Visita all'antelope canyon ( un po' troppo presto... non vi erano i magici fasci di luce)
Avventura sul Colorado river
Ritorno a casa : stanchi ma felici 
Negativo: la sosta obbligatoria di mezz'ora in un negozio

review_title: La seule façon d'apprécier totalement la majestuosité du site.
review_text:
Les points de vues le long du grand canyon sont tous superbes, mais le seul qui permet de montrer la grandeur et l'aspect totalement majestueux du site est par les airs.
Découvrir le plateau et la forêt ainsi que les immenses crevasses le long du Colorado est une expérience à part.
Il faut réserver à l'avance et y aller en début de matinée ou en fin d'après-midi pour avoir une belle luminosité pas trop agressive. 
L'avion dispose de grande baies vitrées qui permettent de faire des photos et surtout d'apprécier le paysage.
Des casques audio filtrent le bruit et délivrent des commentaires traduits en plusieurs langues.
Seul bémol, ça secoue pas mal, surtout à l'arrière, j'étais un brin malade à la fin ^^

This should have been one of the highlights of our trip. We booked well in advance and purposely selected Gran Canyon Airlines as they advertised "the largest flat, un-tinted panoramic windows on any air tour aircraft, perfect for sightseeing and photography!". Being a keen photographer, I wanted to ensure that I was able to take as many pictures as possible. Unfortunately, GCA are not true to their word and offered an alternate aircraft to the Vista Liner (Cessena Caravan) that has small tinted windows (blue tint) effectively ensuring all pictures are throw away. Once I had realised that we had been placed on an alternate aircraft, not ideal for photography I requested that we change to a different flight. Not interested, the team at the counter would just not accommodate. Their response was, "You are better off in the Caravan as they don't smell of oil, the Vista Liners stink of oil from the engines"... The trip is fantastic and it really is an experience that you will never forget, such a shame I have a set of blue pictures to remember the day. 

Tip; ensure that you are booked on the, as advertised, Vista Liner with a window seat if you want to take decent photos.
We flew over the Grand Canyon on our way to Page.  One of the most awesome days of my life!  Highly recommend it.

Grande volo aereo con questa bella compagnia di Tusayan e che abbiamo avuto la fortuna di utilizzare in mattinata nonostante non avessimo prenotato grazie anche alla disponibilità delle signorine al desk, le quali sono state in grado di sistemarci in 5 su un aereo facendo alcune modifiche con altri gruppi. Volo fantastico, al limite dell'emozione più profonda, vedute incomparabili e..... fatelo!!

Grand Canyon is too vast to cover in a few days. The air tour provides a glimpse of areas that are otherwise too remote and not easily accessible. We took the Grand Discovery tour, a 40 minute narrated tour that provides views of the East Rim including desert view, the Colorado river, North Rim, and of course the Canyon. All 3 in our group  were lucky to get window seats (upon request). The views were breathtaking and spectacular to say the least. Headphones, while providing the narration, also keep the noise out.

Wir haben uns zu 4. gegen Mittag zu einem Canyon-Rundflug entschieden. Im Hotel würde von der Rezeption amgerufen und wir bekamen schon für 16:00 einen Flug. Es ist zu erwähnen, dass wir uns für eine Flugzeug-Tour entschieden haben, da die Hubschrauber-Tour unser Budget überschritten hätte. Wir sind eine halbe Stunde vorher zum Check-In und haben unsere Tickets erhalten. Kurz vor dem Boarding kam die Schalterdame zu uns und hat uns neue Tickets gebracht, damit wir nicht mit einer asiatischen Gruppe, sondern mit gleichsprachigen ein Flugzeug bekamen. Der Pilot war jung, motiviert und wir konnten auch Fotos mit ihm machen. Im Flugzeug Audioguide in beliebiger Sprache (englischer Erzähler zu empfehlen), auch sehr informativ. Flugroute toll gewählt. Alles in allem sehr empfehlenswert und Tip-Top Preis-Leistung.

Fabulous and worth every penny.  We took this tour (which included the Antelope Canyon and a River float) and HIGHLY recommend it!  This is a perfect tour for the start of your trip so you get an overview of the area and can then decide what you want to see more in depth.  AWESOME!!  Bring your camera!!

review_title: Grand Canyon south rim tour with pink jeep
review_text:
Flight was a little bumping but the tour took us some great view points.
It was more expensive than bus tour but I think it is worth.

This day was simply the best day of our holiday. We arrived at the airport and was given a breakfast box before getting on the plane for our 1 hour flight over the canyon to page airport. It was simply breathtaking. My family of 6 was joined by another family of 3. My tip is to sit the side the pilot sits. I think you get the best views from that side especially of horseshoe bend. We then headed by jeep to the antelope canyon. Amazing!!!!  We then had the best raft trip along the colorant river. Our guide was fantastic and we had a couple of stops and the opportunity to dip our toes to cool off. If you bring swim wear you could swim but in april it wasn't nessecary although a dip in the water was refreshing. Altogether a really fantastic experience and we really felt we had experienced all the canyon has to offer if the one day.

review_title: グランドキャニオンへ一直線。
review_text: 双発のレシプロ小型機でボルダー飛行場から約一時間の飛行です。行きはフーバーダムの上空を飛びグランドキャニオンへひとっ飛び景色も最高でした。機内のヘッドホンからは、日本語アナウンスも有り良い旅でした。小型機ですから少し揺れます。

review_title: Experience the Grand Canyon in AWE
review_text: I took my elderly parents on this trip, given their age I figure an airplane ride would be a lot softer on their nerves. They would not stop admiring the greatness of nature, the ability of the pilot to maneuver and present both sides of the seventh wonder to either side of the plane. This is the only way to take what the Grand Canyon offer, I was so satisfied that I would do it all over again

We arrived early for our pre booked flight. This was not a problem and we were put on to an earlier flight. The reception area has a gift shop check in area and waiting area and restrooms.
You are given a color coded ticket at check in and the pilots come out and call the color and you line up ready to walk out to you aircraft. In our case we were yellow and there were 8 of us who lined up. We were guided to our Cessna Caravan by the pilot . This is a small aircraft and can be bumpy so don't overdo your breakfast!!!!. Before boarding we had an official photo taken and then boarded this small aircraft. After being strapped in everyone had a window seat my husband and I had the front row right behind the pilot what a view.! After safety instructions and putting our earphones on which you then choose your language we started to taxi down the runway. I have never been on this small an aircraft and was very nervous but wow I am so pleased I have done it, what an amazing experience and the views over the Grand Canyon are awesome. It was a little bumpy at times as it was windy but we new this would the case. The flight took 45 minutes and we saw the south rim and the north rim of the canyon.
After the flight we were able to purchase the official photo.
If you want to use the helicopter service this operates from the same place. They also have a twin otter aircraft which is larger than our Cessna . 
I would highly recommend this company to take you on this awesome experience of a lifetime.

We took the Fly, Jeep, Raft tour and it was great.  Well worth  the money and so well organized.  The Tour Guides were fun and interesting and the breakfast , lunch and snacks were good.  Everything was clean and well taken care of.  I would totally recommend this trip.

Wir haben das Flugzeug gewählt für eine Tour über den Grand Canyon da ein Helikopterflug doch fast das 3 fache kostet und bei 4 Personen zahlt sich das aus. Und wir wurden nicht enttäuscht, kleine Maschine, von jedem Platz gut zu sehen, einer darf sogar beim Piloten vorne sitzen, die Route ist interessant gewählt und man wird die ganze Zeit mit Informationen versorgt.

review_title: This is a MUST DO if you are headed to the Grand Canyon
review_text: I have been to the Canyon several times over the past 30 years.  This tour made the experience of the area come alive.  Fabulous guides, well organized and I can honestly say it was 10X better than I had envisioned.  Linda

review_title: Bucket List tour in one trip
review_text: I can't say enough positive things about this touring company. My family did the day trip. The trip started with an Airplane ride over the Grand Canyon. All the seats are window seats and the views where amazing. I actually sit in the co-pilot seat which made the trip even more memorable.  The second part of the trip was trip to the Antelope Canyon our guide Allene was amazing, she knew exactly where to take the pictures, she was patient with the entire group and made sure that they got the right angles. She was beyond helpful and nice. The third part of the leg was smooth water rafting. Viewing the Canyon from the river gives you a totally different perspective of how massive the Canyon. I would say this is an amazing company and an amazing tour with friendly guides that actually love their profession and Arizona. Bucket list day.

Met het vliegtuig over de Grand Canyon vliegen is een unieke ervaring. Prachtig zicht op heel de Grand Canyon plus de mogelijkheid om mooie en leuke foto's te trekken.
Enkel het op en neer bewegen van het vliegtuig was net als op een rollercoaster maar dat heb ik er met plezier bijgenomen!

One can visit the Grand Canyon South Rim by car or on foot, but, to get the real perspective and vastness of the Grand Canyon, I suggest the great flights offered by Grand Canyon Airlines, located in Tusayan, AZ.  Words are unable to give a proper explanation and the views you are presented with when taking an air tour.  People were friendly and helpful, we would do this again and also take the helicopter tour.
Quite bumpy and scary just after take off but once the plane evened out it became smoother and managed to get some excellent photos and videos. Well worth the money

Two of us took the plane flight over the Canyon, the staff were very efficient and friendly and made our flight extra special. We saw some amazing aerial views of the Colorado River running through the Canyon as well as the Canyon itself, and parts of Kaibab National Forest. We would never have seen so much on land, it was well worth paying for.

This tour was amazing! We did the plane ride, Antelope Canyon, Colorado River float trip tour! Starts with the plane ride over the canyon just as sun is coming up. Small plane with only room for 9 + pilot. My son got to sit up in cockpit with the pilot which was awesome! Every seat was Window seat. Awesome commentary during the flight. Lands in Page, Arizona where you are taken on a 4wheel drive trek to Antelope Canyon. This is the most beautiful cave/Canyon. Our tour guide was so great for this part. Next you are taken via bus through Glen Canyon Dam to the river. Meet up with your tour guide for an life changing float trip down the Colorado. Again our tour guide was incredible. Loved every minute of this trip and worth every penny!

I visited the Grand Canyon in March-it is still a bit chilly-bring your layers!  I highly recommend this tour.  Here is a bit of what to expect on this tour.

I had to be at the airport at 6:30 am for  check-in.  Be sure to go to the airport, not the heliport with the helicopters.   I was given a box with my breakfast-a muffin, apple, yogurt, and trial mix, and  there was coffee available.  They weighed me and my bag, and advised me not to bring any knives or weapons on board.  We boarded a little after 7 am and we were in a  small prop plane, there were three seats across and about 7 rows.   Headphones were used to give the audio tour, and there is a choice of language but everyone on my tour used English.  I am unsure of what the other language choices were.  We took off and were soon flying over the Grand Canyon.   My window seat was amazing!   It's a great way to see the canyon.  unforgettable!   Then we flew over Glen Canyon, and over Horseshoe bend, then the dam and then landed in Page AZ airport.  We then directly got into the tour jeeps for the Antelope Canyon Tour.   Be advised, these jeeps are very bumpy!!  Sitting in the back of essentially a cage with two benches welded on the back of a crew cab pickup.  If you have back or neck issues that could be flared by a bumpy ride, you could ask to sit up front with the driver in the crew cab.   It didn't seem the safest way to drive first on a hiway and then on a dirt road, using a single lap belt to two passengers.  but hey we did!   

After the scary ride, we arrived at Antelope Canyon and we were the first tour group of the day.  This makes for much better photo ops!  The guide told us how to set our phones or camera and where to take photos.  We really got some awesome photos and enjoyed the tour.  Then back in the jeep and they took us to the river tour company for our river tour.   

At the River raft tour company there is a coffee shop and some snacks.  We got our sack lunches for the raft trip there.  After a bag check to make sure we did not have any weapons (because in order to get to our raft, we had to go through a tunnel at the base of the dam that is controlled by Homeland Security) We took the bus to the base of Glen Canyon dam and go on our large rafts.  You won't get wet to any extreme.  You might get a little splash is all.   It was cold in the shade and I wished I had more layers, but then when in the full sun it was a lot warmer.  Again, wear layers!!  The sack lunch is good, you can eat it ant any time.   I had an apple, sandwich, trail mix, cookie, chips.  There was lemonade and water on the raft.   The raft trip was relaxing and awesome.   

After the trip, we took a tour bus back to the airport with a stop at the Cameron Trading Post to shop for 30 minutes. Lots of cool Indian made gifts there.   They dropped off the people staying at hotels in the park first followed by the Tusayan hotel and then back to the airport for those that had driven there.   A very long day but totally awesome.  Would do it again in a heartbeat.

We booked the air, land , and river all day package and it was wonderful! The Canyon was so beautiful to see from the air. Smooth flying and a great pilot. On our plane there was 1seat on each side of the plane so we all were able to view. Antelope Canyon was really neat. The river float was equally as beautiful as from the air. Our guide was a lot of fun and the lunch was a plenty to eat. The 3hour trip back to Grand Canyon airport was long-it's too bad there isn't an airport to fly out of to get back. It was a wonderful day and well worth the money!!

review_title: Know the facts, there are better options
review_text:
We were 24 minutes late leaving from the South Rim of the Grand Canyon and the plane did not have the touring windows as promised so my husband spent the flight bent over.  Please do not book with this company if you are over 6 feet tall.  

The narration includes lots of elevator music rather than telling us more about what we were seeing,  I would not recommend this option.  We really thought the longer flight (45 minutes) would be a better experience than the shorter helicopter flights (8 minutes).  Bad decision.  The pilot was very nice, the front desk staff not so much.  This is the least favorite tour we have ever taken.  Spend your time and money on the Hoover Dam, which was awesome or visit the west rim if you're coming from Vegas.  This was NOT worth the extra time, effort, or cost.
Foi muito bacana fazer esse passeio 👏🏻👏🏻 uma grandiosidade... vale muito a pena e é super tranquilo. E show!!!!!

review_title: Incredible experience best way to optimize your time
review_text: I had a great experience visiting Grand Canyon with this company. They took us to Guano Point and Eagle point (with skywalk) in one day, also the flight was around Colorado River and Hoover Dam with incredible views. Highly recommended because my friends who did this trip from Las Vegas by driving themselves told me they spent a lot of time driving in bad highways stressed and they had to book a hotel inside the park to have time to visit it, nevertheless if you go by plane or helicopter you will arrive faster and enjoy one entire day with the best views of Grand Canyon. I Loved it!!

Zoiets moet je echt doen als je in de grand canyon verblijft. Het is echt een geweldige ervaring. Wij hadden het kleinste vliegtuig en zaten heel dicht op de pilote, dat was spannend, maar ze was goed en het uitzicht was geweldig. We hebben bosbranden gezien, de canyon van verschillende kanten en de Colorado rivier. Echt geweldig!

You don't realize the grand vastness of this place until you see it for yourself. Pictures and videos can not to justice to this magnificent structure. It is truly incredible when you are looking over the canyon and realize this was nature's creation over millions of years. The colors reflected on each rock as the sun passes through are amazing. Definitely one of the wonders of the world and one to put on your bucket list. This is the kind of place you can visit and it will be etched in your mind forever.

This is one of the best way to discover the great canyon! We saw it for the sunrise and it was just awesome and so impressive!
The captain was very cool!
Do not hesitate to do it!It worth it!

Wonderful way to see the Canyon. Tour takes about 45 minutes and is breathtaking. You'll never get more excitement for your $159!! The aircraft was marked "Papillon Airlines" and held 16 passengers. Large windows, high wings, so a terrific view. Flew from the Grand Canyon airport on the South Rim.

Nous avons hésité entre avion et hélicoptère, mais à 4, nous avons opté pour l'avion ( financièrement moins coûteux).

Avion de petite taille permettant à tout le monde de profiter ds magnifiques panoramas 

Vues du ciel absolument splendides, à faire si vous pouvez

We loved the whole day--flight over Grand Canyon and Lake Powell was SPECTACULAR, a few turbulence but fantastic. Tour of Antelope Canyon was awesome, way better than expected.  Raft Trip was unbelievably beautiful.  Bus trip was restful.  Boxed breakfast and lunch were fine.  The guides were just great and really made the day an unforgettable trip.

Expensive at first blush but when you consider the experience - it worth every penny

Highly recommend it!!!!

En nuestro caso el grupo familiar estaba formado por ocho integrantes de tres generaciones, por lo que elegimos el vuelo en avioneta que nos permitió vivir la experiencia juntos, éramos los únicos pasajeros en ese vuelo. 
Tomamos el último vuelo de la tarde, a las 17.00 hs. 
Antes de subir a la avioneta nos tomaron una foto con nuestro piloto y la aeronave. Después de ocupar nuestros asientos, nos dieron las indicaciones para la la conexión de auriculares ya que el vuelo cuenta con un audio que hace las veces de guía del recorrido. 
Bellísimo!!! También desde el aire, el Gran Cañón te deja sin palabras!!!

review_title: No me han reembolsado el dinero, despues de una cancelacion suya
review_text:
Teníamos contratada la avioneta para el 21/09/2016.En el mismo bus de camino al helipuerto , nos dijeron que debido a una tormenta y vientos fuertes quedaba suspendida la excursión.Nos dieron una tarjeta para reclamar, llamamos y nos dijeron que nos reembolsarían el dinero en un plazo de 3 a 5 días.Desde ese mismo día esta reclamado el reembolso , pero todavía no nos lo han devuelto.
Hemos escrito varios correos y no hemos obtenido ninguna respuesta.
No nos parece serio tener que estar detrás de ellos , ya que es un problema de ellos.Esperemos que nos devuelvan el dinero.
