If you don't have much time to spend at grand canyon ...this is it...if you want to see north rim..this is it...they also have many language support...if you are not too healthy make sure bring a motion sickness pill like Dramamine...45min flight is beautiful...

review_title: The absolute best Grand Canyon Tour
review_text: If you have traveled to the Grand Canyon for seeing its beauty, splurge and take the 12 hour tour offered by Grand Canyon Airlines. About 1 hour of flight time over the Grand Canyon, Marble Canyon, and Glen Canyon to Page Arizona where you will be driven by Ford Trucks disguised as jeeps to a beautiful area of Antelope Canyon. Not much walking so most can go to see the beautiful slot canyon. The Indian guide was very knowledgeable about the area and in how to take the perfect photo. After this the same trucks take you to the river tour area where you are taken by bus to the Glen Canyon Dam. Here you board a large stable raft (again appropriate for most people, as long as you can climb one step). Take a breathtaking 3 hour raft ride through Glen Canyon. Bring your lunch, water is provided and don't forget sunscreen. If you like you can take a quick dip into the Colorado river at one or two spots on the river. The water is cold.

We were hesitant to spend the money on the Grand Canyon Experience package but this was one of the most memorable and amazing ways to really see the Canyon.  Grand Canyon Airlines begins your journey with giving you breakfast and then having you board a small plane to fly you over the Grand Canyon and the Colorado River.  While on board you listen to a recording about the geological history of the area.  Next you land in Page where you are picked up in an open air jeep for an exciting dusty and bumpy off road journey through the desert to Antelope Canyon.  You disembark and the guide takes you through the Canyon and explains its history while pointing out and helping you set up to take photographers that look like something out of a book.  Our guide was an amazing photographer.  After your photo session, you are taken to The Colorado River Rafting Company in Page and are given a bag lunch.  They take you to Glenn Canyon Dam where you descend to the Colorado River and board a raft which will slowly take you down the river while your river guide explains the history of Lake Powell, the river, and the geology.  You stop along the river to eat lunch and explore the ancient cliff drawings.  A bus picks you up at Lees Ferry and takes you to a Native trading Post in Cameron where you can purchase souvenirs before heading back to Grand Canyon airport.  There is no better way to experience every aspect of this breathtaking area.
Our tour group took this fixed wing tour of the canyon and it was worth every penny. The sights are amazing from the air.

Our party of 6 booked the Scenic Canyon Adventure Tour.  Our twin prop plane seated 2o and there were plenty of large windows to see the views.  Upon landing in Page we took a jeep to Antelope Canyon caverns.  Our guide, Lynette, was super.  The caverns were so impressive.  Next was a 4 hour float down the Colorado with our guide Frank.  He was super as well.  The only negative of the day, and really a minor one, was the bus driver that took us back to the airport.  We were seated near the front of the bus and she never stopped talking the entire three hours.  We wanted to nap because it had been a long day but couldn't with her continuous talking to one passenger.

Was looking forward to the view from the plane flight we booked for the first plane right out in the morning at 8am.

Received a call at 6:41am the day of the flight to say there was an hour delay, but unfortunately we were already on the way as our hotel was a 35 minutes drive away. No matter, we arrived at 7am knowing we were in for a 2 hour wait now that the flight was delayed till 9am.

At 8:42am, a staff member approached us while we were sitting in the waiting room to tell us there was a problem with the plane and the flight was cancelled. They could put us on a helicopter ride that was HALF THE TIME we booked for a MUCH SHORTER ROUTE. The reasoning was that the helicopter ride costs the same as our plane ride. 

After a discussion, we requested that they reimburse us 1 person's planet ticket cost and we will take the replacement helicopter ride. We were told that it wasn't possible.

So after a painful 2 hour wait, we decided to just get a refund and didn't get to see the Grand Canyon from the sky as we hoped. Leaving with a bitter feeling from the horrible experience was probably the worst start to the day. 

Would recommend that anyone else who wants to see Grand Canyon on a flight to go with another company even though they cost more. 

*Side note: Apparently I can't post this review without rating this terrible company at least one "circle", but just wanted everyone to know they deserve ZERO CIRCLES OF RATING!

We were in a twin prop plane, 3 seats per row, with massive windows so even in the middle seat (as I was) you have excellent views. You have a headset playing rather annoying music interspersed with commentary, which was not as informative as I'd hoped for! However the views are amazing and give you a real feeling for the astounding size of the Grand Canyon. There was a little bit of turbulence and in a small plane that can make your tummy feel a bit queezy, so be prepared. The flight was 40 minutes, but felt much shorter. It's worth the price - you may never pass this way again, so just go for it!

We went to the west rim and even though we got hit by unexpected storms it was great fun. The buses at the rim allow you to makes your own way between the different points and lunch stop. The Skywalk was closed but they organised a refund for this part of the trip with no hassle. Overall the staff were friendly, the flights good, we got to see everything and it was good value. Do it!

We did the full day tour on our first full day at the Grand Canyon, and I couldn't think of a better way to see some of the amazing beauty of the area. 

We started with the air tour over the Grand Canyon, which my daughters loved! It was so beautiful to see the sun rising over the canyon and we were really able to get a feel for it's vastness from the air. The flight was over way too soon - we would have loved to stay in the air and see more!! 

Then we moved to the Antelope Canyon tour. Our tour guide was knowledgeable, and we were there early enough that there was only one other group there, so we got some really amazing photos. Be aware, you must walk through the canyon, and then come back the same way to get back to the vehicles. It was very crowded when we came back through and it would have been more convenient to have our ride waiting on the other end, but given the terrain the other side may not be accessible. The canyon itself was really beautiful, and seeing the swirls and marking from the water rushing through was very cool.

The final portion of our tour was the river rafting. It was very cool to raft through Glen Canyon, and see the inside of the canyon from the river view. The downside of this portion of the day was that while there was plenty of cold water (and we were frequently encouraged to stay hydrated) there was no shade on the raft at all, and the river water was really really cold. So cold that standing in it for more than a minute was painful. This made for a very hot afternoon. The river trip felt a little too long. It was fun and our guide was really great, but the heat was really starting to get to us. We stopped several times and the pace of the raft was very slow. I would have enjoyed it more if we had gone a little faster (to get some breeze) and stopped fewer times. But it was lovely, and we all really enjoyed it.

We booked this trip as a party of 8 several weeks before and it has to be one of the highlights of our holiday.  The 8 of us were in our own plane and the service we got was amazing. Breakfast and lunch were both very good and the pilots were friendly and welcoming. A very smooth take off and landing and the commentary during the flight was interesting. The most beautiful views of Grand Canyon in the early morning truly amazing.

review_title: What an Amazing one day trip!!
review_text: We took our family of 4 (11 and 13 yr old) on the 12 hour fly, hike, float trip and what an amazing experience it was!  The flight over the Grand Canyon in the Cessna Caravan was amazing in the morning light and we managed to get some truly beautiful photos.  Next came the early morning guided walk through Antelope Canyon where the photographs we got were amazing.  What a beautiful place!  The local Indian guide was full of great information and helped us get some amazing pics.  Last and not least was the float trip down the river.  Our guide was amazing and funny and the trip was peaceful and beautiful.  We even swam in the colorado and froze but it was worth every chill.  One of the highlights of our trip.  Highly recommend.

Considering that we had 3 fifteen year old we definitely wanted to keep things exciting for them. We decided to book a helicopter ride but wanted something reasonably priced. The airplane was a good way to go. 9 people max capacity which still made it a private affair at a reasonable price. The full tour of 40-50 minutes was great. 

We got some great aerial shots and the teenagers were happy.

review_title: グランドキャニオンを空から展望
review_text: 約40-45分のセスナ機による遊覧飛行。色々な角度で見る事はできるが、一周飛行なので座席による見える風景が左右で違ったままで終わる。（左側はグランドキャニオンのvillage側を、右側は外側の景色）

review_title: enjoy the magnitude of the grand canyon
review_text: We did the grand discovery air tour. The tour lasted 45 min. We booked at viators. We booked a morning tour well in advance. When we arrived a day earlier it was very easy to reschedule the trip to that day in the afternoon. We preferred the airplane trip over the helicopter trip because of the costs and the duration. A little warning might be in place since 2 of our group of 5 got a bit airsick. We flew a rather small plan with 8 passengers with a great view for everyone. If you want to be sure of a window seat in a larger plane it is possible to reserve window seats in advance for additional costs of $10 per seat. My eldest son was very happy because he was allowed to sit in front next to the pilot. The staff was very friendly. And the most important thing: the views are amazing! You can hardly imagine the magnitude and size of the grand canyon till you have seen it. Enjoy your flight!

review_title: South Rim Tour:  The highlight of our Grand Canyon trip!
review_text:
The 45 min. airplane tour of the south rim was truly the highlight of our Grand Canyon trip.  The canyon is so vast that you can hardly begin to grasp the size without seeing it from the air. 

Prior to the trip, I was somewhat concerned that the plan would be required to fly considerably higher than a helicopter and that the views would be marginal as a consequence.  Although it did have to fly higher, we were very close to the canyon - at points seemingly level with the higher rim - and the views were amazing. However, for a 45 min. tour I was glad to cover more area in a airplane than I suspect we would have in a helicopter.  The airplane was also appreciably less expensive than a helicopter tour (albeit still expensive).  

Not sure if it was going to be worth the price.  It was!  Glad that we did it.  Once in a lifetime experience.

We started our day with a trip to the Grand Canyon airport, at which we were given our assigned plane seats (based on weight and time of arrival) and a boxed breakfast (which wasn't too bad). The left side of the plane definitely has the better views. 

After arriving at the Page airport, we got onto large Jeeps that took us to Antelope Canyon. We got there early, so we were able to get many beautiful pictures on our way through the canyon, but the return trip was extremely crowded. Oscar was our guide, and he was a funny and knowledgeable guide. 

We then got back onto the Jeep and went to the river tour stop. There was a twenty minute wait to go to the bathroom, sign in, have a quick safety program, and pick up lunches before getting on the bus to the river. 

The river tour was nothing short of AMAZING!! Our guide was Phil, and he was funny and smart. His knowledge of the canyon and the surrounding area was great. 

The return bus ride was long, but there was a 30 minute stop at Cameron Trade Post halfway back. 

All in all, it was a great trip! (I am writing this review as a teenager who went with her parents and two teenage siblings.)

Our family took a day/overnight trip from Vegas to South Rim of the GC and stayed in Valle.  We had booked the plane well in advance of our anticipated travel.  All I can say, is if you have been to the GC, but never viewed from air, this is a must do adventure!  A bird's eye view from above are just very inspiring.  Words/pictures can not explain how powerful.  The operators/pilots, etc. with Scenic Tours were awesome!  We all enjoyed the flight and learned a lot about the canyon as well.

review_title: A great way to see the Canyon area!!
review_text:
This was an absolutely amazing tour. We did the full day Adventure Tour. We saw the Grand Canyon from the air,and  flew over Lake Powell. We rafted down the river too. But the highlight for me was walking through Antelope Canyon. I didn't know this place existed, but it was well worth the trip. The rock formations were incredible. 

We had a number of bathroom stops and breakfast and lunch were provided. I would recommend taking plenty of water with you and don't forget the sunscreen and a hat!

Well worth the price.

review_title: SOUTH RIM 40 min - BETTER THAN NOTHING
review_text:
We took the regular 40 min tour from the South Rim Terminal. Installations, plane and staff are OK, but the Grat Canyon being so  biiiig, when the flight  ends you really need MORE. We strongly recommend to take a more complete air visit.

And of course, at least 2 days walking the different trails, and with time, go down to the river.

It is the only way to grasp a litle of this enormous place, and retain some of its grandeur.

review_title: Myself and seven-year-old daughter loved it
review_text: What a great way to see the canyon. We chose the extended route including the East rim, had a great time from start to finish. Could feel the wind blowing the helicopter, which is a little scary but overall felt secure and safe, our pilot was very nice and appeared very competent, played us music through headphones and then two separate presentations about the canyon. One in French for the other three passengers, and then in English for us. Everyone we had contact with there was nice.

Great tour. The whole journey was impressing, with enough time to visit all different locations and great scenery views by air and ground, this trip is defintely recommended and worth the price. Be sure to book the Grand Voyager tour for the best experience, this includes airplane, helicopter and boat.

review_title: Absolutely Amazing Trip End to End
review_text: We did the Grand Canyon Scenic Airlines "Scenic Canyon River Adventure" 12.5 hour full day tour with the entire family. The all day adventure from beginning to end was incredible. Our 9 year old son had a blast as did my father-in-law who commented it was the BEST tour he had ever done. It's a great way to see the Canyon by air, car, and boat without having to lift a finger (literally). The guides and facilitators do everything for you so that you can just sit back and relax. Only advice is that the complimentary breakfast is a bit lacking (too sweet for me) consisted of a muffin, yogurt, OJ and fruit cocktail. If you're not into that much sugar for breakfast maybe grab something like a breakfast sandwich on your own instead. The weather for us was great (98 degrees) but we heard that it does get brutally hot inside the canyon (on the River) so bring lots of sunscreen and make sure everyone wears a hat. They stop often at restrooms and you can get in the water to cool down (great experience!). Lunch was delicious. Turkey sandwich, chips, fruit. They also provide cold water along the way down the river. Antelope Canyon was magnificent and most importantly the tour gets you into the Canyon BEFORE all the other tourists come and it gets too crowded.

review_title: Seeing the Grand Canyon from the air is awesome
review_text: We were on the all day tour called Canyon River Adventure. This airline was top notch. The plane ride was spectacular and views unreal. Antelope Canyon was unreal to see in person (a bucket list item for me). Got great pictures and our Guide was really nice and helped us get better pics. He the exact angles to shoot. Since we got there a little early it was not too crowded. I could see there were more people when we were done.Next was the river ride. A slow ride through Glen Canyon. Very cool with the canyon walls on either side. The raft was comfortable but we got lucky with two less people on our raft. It was really HOT since it was July. A little long for that heat. You could swim if you are willing to jump in 45degree water. Our guide was really nice. Her engine was acting up so we all bonded. (no danger whatsoever). Only complaint is there really was not a jeep component. It was just the ride to Antelope Canyon on streets and sand. I did not expect the long bus ride to return. But it was a nice bus and the earlier part of the tour was worth it. The bus ride was 3 hours  with one stop at Indian trading store. I may not have taken tour if I understood this ahead of time. But I was really glad we did. The ride didn't see long at all. The bus driver was great.

The flight over the canyon provided a great opportunity to see the canyon, rapids and various key attractions (horseshoe bend, etc.).  The trip to antelope canyon was awesome.  The Navajo guide (Patrick) was awesome.  The pictures here were amazing.  The trip ended with a rafting trip down the Colorado river.  My girlfriend and I enjoyed this the most.  Beautiful sights, good conversation with other participants.  I would definitely suggest this for people to do.

Vi kom i luften i dag. Der var torden og regn kl. 13 og vi skulle flyve kl. 14. Vejrguderne var med os og sørgede for at det klarede op lige før . Jeg var nervøs, har højdeskræk, men det var en professionel kvindelig pilot, der sikkert førte flyet. Det hjalp også at der var hovedtelefoner med musik og information om Grand Canyon. 
Vi nød alle den helt igennem smukke tur. Sikke en oplevelse. 
En oplevelse for livet

The raftin was good but would have been glad to know that it was 6 hours at the bus. The bus trip there was ok but the same trip back was not good and just a couple of hours on the boat was not my expectation.

review_title: Wow! Canyon River Adventure was Amazing!
review_text:
We had an amazing time on our June 9 Canyon River Adventure. From our morning arrival at the airport to our late-afternoon return, we were in awe by the views, activities, and services of this great adventure. 

Flying over the Grand Canyon was breathtaking, and the flight crew did a great job pointing out what we were seeing. Additionally, there was a nice headset with music and some narration that kept interest and blocked "flight" noise often associated with smaller planes. There were about 20 of us on the plane and everyone had a great view, even from the middle seat, like me. Kudos to our pilots for a very smooth flight---including take-off and landing. 

The tour continued to Antelope Canyon in Page, AZ. Our guide Colby was great. We were in a group of about 12 people. Great size group. In addition to the history of the canyon, he gave us tips on how to get the best photographs. Kids and adults loved it. Easy walk. Didn't need hiking shoes. We weren't sure what to expect. 

Continued from there to gathering point with other groups to load up for ride to the Glen Canyon Dam and the Colorado River. Our smooth river ride with Brooke and Colorado River Discovery was great. She was a good boat captain, storyteller, historian, and entertainer. And the water was freezing, even in June. 47-degrees is the usual temperature. Splashing around felt good but you couldn't do it long.

Light breakfast and lunch were provided as well as water and lemonade. Definitely glad we had a couple water bottles to refill at the water stations along the way. Be sure to bring your cameras. Lots to photograph!! 

And our ride back to Tusayan with Gigi on the bus was great. Got in a nap before our stop at the trading post in Cameron. The Navajo Taco she recommended was delicious. One fed our family of four. Least expensive meal of our week-long vacation. And delicious!!

Loads of fun for the whole family! Highly recommend even though it's a little pricey. Definitely worth it! 

#iflyscenic #GrandCanyon #ColoradoRiverDiscovery #AntelopeCanyon #NavajoTaco

review_title: Fabulous way to see the Canyon
review_text: We did the full day tour, with the flight over the canyon, walking through Antelope Canyon and Cruising down the Canyon for a few hours, with a stop at the Cameron Post Office on the way home. Such a great introduction to the Grand Canyon

review_title: Perfect way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: We had originally booked a mule ride, but that was canceled because of a controlled burn. Wanting to replace it, we chose to fly over the canyon for $7 per person more. This was such a fun experience. I will warn that the ride can be bumpy, especially with wind. A couple people in our group were very nauseated. The pilots were so fun and friendly, which really added to the experience. Although I was bummed about not going on the mule ride, I am glad we got to do this.

Wat een enorme ervaring een vlucht boven de grand canyon. wegens het weer, er waren wat buien boven het gebied werd er besloten om een kleiner vliegtuig te nemen zodat we minder last hadden van turbulentie. Dat laatste was voor sommige passagiers wel iets minder, maar uitstekende piloot. En ondanks de turbulentie hebben wij in iedergeval genoten . Wat een natuur, zo mooi!! Een unieke ervaring

review_title: A must do at the Grand Canyon!
review_text:
We did the Scenic Canyon River Adventure today and it was amazing!  It's a really long day (13 hours, start to finish) and not cheap, but it was completely worth it.  
It started with our flight over the canyon on the way to Page, AZ.  Craig was our pilot and he did a great job.  They have a narration track you can listen to on the way which gives some of the history of the Grand Canyon and points out places of interest.  The views are just spectacular and if you can only do the plane ride, do it!
Then, we were picked up after a short restroom break at the Page airport for our Antelope Canyon tour.  Our driver/guide was really great and I really wish I could remember his name to mention here.  Antelope Canyon is amazingly beautiful.  We were there for around an hour, which was much longer than I expected, and had plenty of time to tour the entirety of Upper Antelope Canyon and take tons of photos.  Our guide even showed everyone how to set up their cameras and the best spots to take photos.
We were then dropped off at Colorado River Discovery for our smooth water float trip.  After about 30 minutes or so there to use the restroom, purchase snacks/souvenirs, we boarded a bus which took us to Glen Canyon Dam for our float trip.  (They pass out your bagged lunch there before you get on the bus.)  Make sure to let them know if you have any dietary restrictions when you make your reservation and they will accommodate you.  We're vegetarian, and the veggie sandwich was pretty good (several slices of cheese, lettuce and tomato on whole grain bread, with various condiment packets in the lunch bag). Nate was our tour guide/captain for the float trip and he was fantastic!  He was very knowledgeable and really seemed excited about taking us on this adventure.  I will say, I agree with some other reviews on here that say that the float trip is a bit on the long side.  There are a bunch of times when they cut the engine for you to get a look around you, but sometimes you're just drifting along for quite a while and you'd much rather have a breeze on your face and get on with it.  It is VERY HOT and sunny on the raft, so make sure you take lots of water and reapply sunscreen a few times.  A hat is a must!  Also, if you plan to take a dip in the river when you stop at the halfway point, you might want to wear your bathing suit, but the water is about 47 degrees even at the beginning of June. There are two restroom breaks on the float trip, which is nice.  In all, it was about 3.5 hours (including the two stops). I would have been happier with a brisker 2 hour tour.
Once the float trip is finished, you are picked up by bus at Lee's Ferry, after another short restroom break.  Then it's 1.5 hours to Cameron Trading Post on the Navajo Reservation.  You get 30 minutes to use the restroom, purchase snacks or souvenirs.  Then, it's back on the bus for another 1.5 to 2 hours (depending on where you're being dropped off).  Our bus driver, Gigi, was really friendly and had some interesting stories for us.  The drive was long, but considering how far we flew out there, it's not that surprising.  
All in all, it was a great day and we'd highly recommend it!

review_title: Package tour - flight, river ride and Slot canyon
review_text:
My two children (aged 8 and 11) took Scenic Airlines as part of a package tour involving a smooth ride along the Colorado River (Colorado Discovery) and Antelope Canyon tour; participants were returned to Tusyan by motor coach.

The plane ride was informative, smooth and impressive. Check in was easy and efficient.  The package deal included a continental breakfast, and boxed lunch.  Staff were friendly in every aspect of the tour.  

Participants should ensure that they have sunglasses and sunblock as the sun is hot while the air may be cool.  And, as the trip starts out in the early morning, a coat or sweater may be useful; our trip started out chilly but ended quite warm.  The coach ride back stops at the Cameron Trading Post - a delightful shop full of Native American souvenirs, there's also a restaurant and snacks available for purchase (the Indian Fry bread is very tasty).

review_title: Great River Tour of the Glen Canyon
review_text: We took the half day river tour that included a 6 hour round trip guided bus trip from the Grand Canyon to Page Arizona where we began our hour river tour. The bus picked us up at our hotel near the Grand Canyon at 6:15 and we returned around 5 pm.  The river guide provided expert insight into the history and landscape of the Glen Canyon and the Colorado River.  Lunch was fine. We ordered vegetarian meals the day before the trip.  The bus ride was long. We stopped at a tourist shop on the way back, but the guide gave us views of the Grand Canyon that we would have missed otherwise.

review_title: Best way to see the Canyon
review_text: The whole experience from booking through to boarding was seamless and easy. The price was excellent, and much lower than we expected, with an online discount that helped. We had the impression of a thoroughly professional outfit that has been serving customers for years. The otter twin-engine plane gave us an excellent view of the Canyon, and took around 50 mins for the South Rim tour. A bit of advice though, the trip goes anti-clockwise so make sure you have a seat on the left of the plane, as those in the middle had to peer through gaps to get a view, and those on the right saw expanses of ponderosa rather than the Canyon. Any seat with an A in it is best. We had 3A and 4A ... the best seats in the plane. I'm guessing, but if these are taken by large people or those who block the windows, others may not get a good view, so be nice.

We had a perfect day, a great pilot, and were fortunate it wasn't too bumpy. The view was fabulous!  We'd already been to the south rim to wet our whistle. The pilot's course was such to provide both sides of the plane spectacular views. It was truly awe inspiring- the colours, the formations! Cameras really can't capture the depth of what the human eye perceives--- hence, I'm so grateful to have had this opportunity. The price was fair. The people were friendly. Super outfit!!

You couldn't ask for more.  A perfect morning, perfect flight.  We took the fixed-wing "Discovery Tour" -- 45 minutes.  The staff were nothing but professional and considerate.  No hard sell of the photos - don't worry!  The plane has great windows that allow everyone a fine view.  Good value for money.  It's the Grand Canyon -- impossible to beat it.

If you think the view of the Grand Canyon is awesome from the rim, you have got to see it from one of these planes. AMAZING! It was the most beautiful thing I've ever seen. The Pilots and staff, were very friendly and professional. I was a little nervous as we had several rain storms roll through that day and some earlier flights were cancelled but they were very safety conscious and made sure it was clear before allowing us to take off. They give you headphones with narration of the tour but the views were so beautiful I don't remember much of it. One word of caution:  We hit a bit of turbulence and in these small planes it can make you very nauseous so if you get motion sickness, be sure to take a Dramamine or get those SeaBands to were before your flight. They have air-sick bags just in case but if your prepared you won't need it.

the trip was amazing but when we arrived home to find they had taken the full cost from my card and the deposit on top of it so ended up paying 160 more and they ignor requests for the payment info. and they keep your reciept when you check in. you have no prove and they dont respond what a disapointment to the trip. RIP OFF merchants 
my daughter is doing this in June and have advised her to travel with one of there competitors they are a disgrace

We took a tour of the Grand Canyon with these folks, and we very much enjoyed it. The weather was perfect the day we flew and the ride was so smooth. Our pilot was enthusiastic and friendly and did a great job. Love to try a helicopter ride next time!

review_title: 45 min plane ride over the Grand Canyon
review_text: An absolutely wonderful experience.  We were 2 couples and had the best pilot ever.  A 21 year old beautiful young lady.  There were 2 other couples and we all had window seats.  The young pilot was amazing and the flight was worth every single penny.  Can't wait to do it again next year

We did an all tour day that was a wonderful combination of things to see.  The flight over the Grand Canyon was in a small plane, the views were amazing and the flight was smooth.  When we landed at the airport in Page, AZ we were taken by big jeeps to see the Antelope Slot Canyon. Our guide was great, she told us the history of the place and gave us tips on how to get great photos.  After this we were driven to a place in town that had bathrooms and a snack bar for some free time before getting our bag lunches and loaded up in buses to go to the Grand Dam for river rafting.  The rafts were huge, motorized boats that the tour guide drove down the river while telling us the history of the Grand Canyon. We had a different tour guide for each leg of the trip and they were all professional, kind, and seemed to love their jobs and the topic.

We loved the airplane as opposed to helicopter. The airplane flies higher providing better views. The staff was very helpful and we loved the experience. Less glare on the windows and the price makes this the best option and we are so glad we took this flight.

As the Canyon is so large, it is impossible to fathom the size when walking along the rim. A bird's eye view gives a better impression, even though it's still impossibly big. Scenic airlines is easily accessible by car and booking through their website was pretty easy as well. We did have to call them to confirm our booking which was a little difficult from Grand Canyon Village as our cellphones did not function properly but we managed in the end. The airport is tiny so being there 30mins before departure was enough, there was no line and we were only 6 people on our flight. The airplane is tiny which was a new experience for me, but did not feel unsafe. Halfway through the flight we did get a bit nauseous though from the shaking/turns. Still greatly enjoyed the views and the things our pilot pointed out. Must do when visiting the Canyon!

Prenotammo da casa per tempo questo volo, affidandoci alle esperienze di chi già aveva provato. Non siamo stati delusi. Il giorno precedente, e la mattina stessa del volo avevamo visitato il Grand Canyon dalla sommità del bordo sud, lasciandoci stupefatti dallo spettacolo che si apriva sotto i nostri occhi. Il pomeriggio in volo è stato qualcosa di superlativo. Abbiamo visto scorci del Colorado e dei suoi affluenti, impossibili da vedere altrimenti. Esperienza, quella del sorvolo, che consiglio a tutti. La compagnia è affidabile, ed è la prima ad avere effettuato voli turistici. Il personale competente ed affabile. Abbiamo avuto un pilota oltremodo simpatico. Dimenticavo, durante il volo è possibile ascoltare le spiegazioni di ciò che state osservando in italiano. Grazie per la bellissima esperienza.

We picked this airline recommended by the concierge of our hotel. It was definitely a good decision since We were only half a mile away from the airport. Many tourists arrived after us but We were lucky enough to be only four in the plane. It was magic. We saw the Colorado river, the grand canyon mountains, the Kaibab forest and We were so disappointed when it finished. Definitely a must have to do once in a lifetime. It is cheaper on the Internet though if you fan book in advance once visiting the South Rim.

review_title: Worth the view for a lifetime of memories.
review_text: I combined this with the Navajo Tour of Antelope Slot Canyon and then the Float down the Colorado River - all in the same day. Two kids, 11 and 12, were eager to rise to watch the sunrise over the canyon - views from the plane were incredible - weather was cool but sunny skies added to the beauty. It was a long day but the three tours were incredible and it was hard for us to say which was the best part of the day. My iPhone photos are incredible - worth the money spent for a lifetime of memories.I recommend booking through the airlines as the tickets for the tours were cheapest that way. Water was available on the raft tour so no need to pack so much extra like we were told. A few extra snacks were good have along. Our river guide Aaron was excellent and made the canyon raft tour amazingly personal.

There were 8 of us on the plane. We all had window seats so great viewing. They provide an automated narration via headphones which is interesting  and informative. We were a group with kids and adults ranging from age 7-50. Everyone enjoyed the flight. However, be prepared for a little stomach uneasiness if it's windy. That goes for any airplane ride, really. For the most part this was very smooth.
사우스림에서 영업하는 그랜드캐니언 비행기, 헬기투어업체입니다. 150달러에 40분가량 운행하며, 그랜드캐니언 처음 방문했을때 권합니다. 이후 방문자라면 하이킹코스를 이용하며 캠핑을 해야겟죠. 비행기 매연 냄새가 매우 심합니다.

The staff at Grand Canyon airlines are all very welcoming. They will weigh you on check in for the weight at balance of the plane. There is a comfortable waiting area that looks out at the airplanes, while you wait for your flight. 
Our pilot was friendly and knowledgeable - and the plane was very comfortable. Each seat has a window seat and it does not feel cramped at all. 
You wear a headset that plays music and narrates information about the Canyon as you fly. 
The views are astounding. It's hard to describe the beauty - but certainly you will not be disappointed. I didn't know where to look at times and I had to remind myself to put the camera down and take in the views. Great way to see the Canyon from the air. If you have it in your budget to do this, or can stretch it - do it. You only live once!
Don't forget to sign the huge guestbook inside the terminal!

Rispetto alle altre compagnie in zona è quella che permette 45 minuti di volo al più "basso" prezzo e con buona qualità (comfort, visibilità). Abbiamo sorvolato il Canyon a lungo e nelle orecchie avevamo la spiegazione della storia della scoperta del Canyon. Staff gentile e disponibile, con possibilità di fare la foto all'uscita dal tour con il pilota (dietro pagamento di una cifra abordabile). Io soffro il mal di aereo quindi sono stata moolto male ma mio marito e la famiglia con due bambini che aveva preso l'areo con noi erano tutti entusiasti ( e hanno terminato il tour con un meraviglioso sorriso, a differenza di me). Lo raccomando. Inoltre nel negozio dei souvenir era pieno di belle cose a poco prezzo rispetto ai soliti.

review_title: Grand Views and Service on Grand Canyon Tour
review_text: Great value for the money. This was absolutely the best part of our Vegas Vacation. From the staff to the views....FABULOUS!

review_title: La mejor forma de ver el Gran Cañón
review_text: La experiencia fue inigualable, tomamos el vuelo en avioneta que dura 40-50 mins. Todo muy puntual, muy seguro. La vista es majestuosa, ninguna visita al gran cañón está completa sin un sobrevuelo. Se puede apreciar la inmensidad el gran cañón desde el aire. Y verlo con nieve en invierno le da un plus. Lo recomiendo al 100%.

My ten year old daughter and I chose the Indian adventure tour and it was the best part of our entire vacation. We got picked up from circus circus at 4:30am by a very nice shuttle driver and taken around to pick up other guests before getting put on a large bus to the airport. At the airport we got weighed, got a colored sticker and waited for our flight. Fifteen minutes later we were on our cute little plane. The pilots were very nice and the plane has huge Windows. We were given a headset to listen to information about the landmarks along the way. A very short and smooth 30 minutes later and we arrived. 
At the airport they give you a bracelet with a specific time written on it so you know what time to catch a shuttle back to the airport. All of the shuttle drivers were very friendly and the busses run quite often. The view from eagle point was spectacular. We didn't bother doing the skywalk because it's over priced and the view is just as good from the ground. We took the short hike at guano point and loved it as well. When we got done hiking we had a nice lunch next to the canyon at 9am. We had been up since 3:45 so lunch at 9 was just fine for us! The airline will tell you not to go to the western town at the ranch because you won't have time but we did. We had plenty of time to check out the horses and shoot a bow and arrow. We even had time to go back to eagle point one last time before going to the airport. After arriving back at Boulder city airport we hopped on a bus and were taken back to the hotel. We got back in our room at 1:30. 
Overall, it was well worth every penny we spent and I would love to do it again. The only part we didn't love was the very long wait while other guests were dropped off at their hotel- we were the very last stop. Otherwise it was a perfect trip. Even the souvenirs aren't horribly over priced. 
The only thing to keep in mind when traveling with young kids on this trip is there aren't any guard rails- none. So be very careful to keep them right next to you.

review_title: Best view of the Grand Canyon and North Rim - From Above!
review_text: I took my parents (65+) to the Grand Canyon after Christmas, and because they are older, an up close hike was out of the question, I chose the scenic air tour and we all loved it. The airport was easy to access (near park entrance) and the flight was on time. The small plan allowed us each to have our own window.  While the Bose headphones for the audio tour guide were nice, the connection had significant static, so it was difficult to hear. The views are amazing and the view of the remote North Rim cannot be beat. It was really windy the day we went, which resulted in significant turbulence, so not for the faint of heart!  Overall, I would definitely recommend for a one of a kind experience.

We chose a fixed-wing air tour over a helicopter flight because all of the 8 seats had a window and were all facing forward. The flight was about 50 minutes long which took us on a circular route out over the canyon, along the North Rim before returning over Tusayan. There was a little turbulence as we returned over the South Rim but for the most part it was a very smooth comfortable flight offering truly amazing views of the canyon that can only be obtained from the air.

Dit moet je met je eigen ogen gezien hebben 
Kan je niet op foto vast leggen een enige belevenis 
Als het kan zeker met de helicopter doen
Eu adorei o passeio, a empresa é bem organizada e conta com bons preços. Voei de monomotor sobre o parque.

We bought the Grand Canyon connoisseur through Scenic airlines, and in brief were not very satisfied with our trip, especially considering the cost. 
For 300$ USD pp, we expected better service, better food, and better quality guide/tour information. 
The day started with a very early pick up, at 715am from our Vegas hotel. After a lengthy drive to the boulder airport where we had breakfast, we were ready to fly. Our planned flight departure of 915 was delayed for unclear reasons until 10am. The flight was nice with impressive views down below, but very little information given. The headphones talk a little bit about Boulder City, Hoover Dam, and Mojave desert, but nothing about the Grand Canyon itself. The pilots don't say anything during the flight. 

Once we landed, we are herded onto a small tour bus where our driver just yelled, didn't use the microphone system. It was difficult to hear and chat with him. We saw 2 stop off points, and again no real tour or information, just being dropped off with instructions to return within one hour. 

We were expecting more knowledge/information about the beautiful Canyon, instead we were just dropped off without too much instruction. Again, for the cost and the way the website describes the tour, we expected much more. The boxed lunch is probably most representative of the quality of the tour. The website says you'll savour lunch.. it was a sandwich that everyone in our party of 6 couldn't finish, chips and cookies. No drink, but the driver did have mini bottles of water. 
Returning to the bus, we were told a little bit about the local birds at the Canyon before returning to the airport and flying home. The sound system didn't even work on the way home and pilots were silent, so no additional info. 

Definitely not worth the cost. Although flying does save time, I'm not sure how valuable this is. Our tour from take off to return was 6hrs, and became 9hrs as quoted on the website when you include the time to and from hotel. 

Overall a nice experience but should be done much better to give customers more value for their money. They charge for the photo you take with the pilot at the beginning of the day, but after complaining about the delays/short trip, we were given our photos for free. 

Don't get me wrong, the views are beautiful, but I would have preferred drive to the Canyon with a dedicated and engaging tour guide giving a lot of information.

review_title: Beautiful way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: We booked a 9am discovery flight which began a little late but the pilot and stuff were very friendly with a good sense of humour! Lots of photo opportunities and chances to be amazed.

It was a surprise from my wife Michaela during our holiday road trip in Arizona.  “A Scenic Canyon River Adventure”. I don’t particularly enjoy surprises but this one on October 9th 2015 was a blast.  From the beginning to the end.  A wonderful swoop on board of our Vistaliner aircraft into the Grand Canyon, Patrick’s guidance into the spectacular Antelope Canyon and entertaining bus ride back with our driver (Ed?) behind the wheel. And then there was Brad Newman, the troubadour river guide. Rarely do you meet a more engaging, knowledgeable and entertaining guide anywhere. His passion for the Colorado River was boundless and infectious. Thank you. 
Highly recommended. 
Tomas
Vancouver,  Canada

review_title: Words cannot describe how amazing this is !!!
review_text:
Seeing the majesty of the Grand Canyon from above is absolutely amazing.  it is one of those once in a lifetime experiences which I will never forget !  the 45 minute flight was beautifully narrated, and the view of the Grand Canyon and Colorado River is unmatched.  This is how the magnificent canyon is meant to be seen.  

the flight was not too bumpy and the pilot was very friendly, skilled and she put at as ease about flying over the Canyon.  

This is definitely a must do !!

review_title: Brilliant Day Tour of the Grand Canyon
review_text: We booked the Grand Voyager Expedition which was detailed as a 7 hour round trip.  It was in fact 12 hours.  Problem is the collecting and dropping off of other tourists, some who are not in fact doing the same tour.  It was very well organised and the small plane to the West Rim of The Grand Canyon was one of the few that had extra large windows so there is excellent visibility.  Helicopter was fantastic and the short boat trip also exciting to see the Canyon from a different perspective.  Overall not to be missed.  Expensive but a once in a lifetime opportunity

review_title: Put it on your bucket list!
review_text:
If your one of those crazy, high adventure people, this may not be for you but if you're interested in a day you'll always remember, you should consider doing this one. There are several tours offered but I'm talking about the Scenic Canyon River Adventure.  
The tour last 12 hours and starts EARLY! (ouch, but worth it). First you fly over the Grand Canyon (landing at Page AZ) then you board a 4 wheel drive vehicle (can be chilly - it's not enclosed) for a short drive to Antelope Canyon where you tour this amazingly beautiful rock formation (easy walk but has some tight places, be aware if you're bothered by tight spaces as I am). Then you board the same 4 wheel drive vehicle to be taken to where you will board a bus to be taken to the Glen Canyon dam area where you will get on a raft to raft down the Colorado. This is a smooth part of the river (no rapids) and is a peaceful, beautiful float. Here's where I think the tour is a little weak. The float lasted about 3 hours and I think it would have been just as good if they just went a little faster and turned it into 1 1/2 - 2 hours. Several of us felt this way even though we had a wonderful Navajo guide for the float. Kim was wonderful and this in no way reflects negatively on her, just saying they could pick up the pace without sacrificing any of the beauty of the float. The rafting trip ends at Lee's Ferry where you get on a bus that takes you back to the Tusayan area. It's a long day but when you consider the vantage points you achieve (above the Canyon, down in the Canyon (I don't want to ride a mule!), and floating down the Colorado) it's an amazing experience that you don't want to miss. We drove the Desertview portion of the South Rim the next day and felt like we were really able to see a lot of the Canyon in the two days we had there. There are plenty of stops for food (breakfast and lunch provided) and bathroom breaks. We booked online at the above link. It is rated the number 1 tour and we paid $788.00 for two (taxes, whatever all included). I also emailed this company before I booked with the questions I had and they responded quickly. Just do it!

had booked the scenic flight from home several weeks ago. glad I chose the 10 am one, allowing me to first rise early for south rim sunrise views, then back in hotel I could eat a bigger breakfast than at 6.10 and take a shower, before driving off to airport!
it was a rather bumpy ride, due to strong winds! however, thankful for dry weather and sun. as we had rain and clouds on Wednesday. also spectacular to see above the Grand canyon! I kept shooting when possible and sometimes impossible, so still have a nice number of very good pictures. and the experience was just lovely for me, unforgettable, above this natural phenomena. I am privileged to have taken planeflights in only 4 seater ones both in USA and my own country with pilot-friends.
can highly recommand it to you all!!!
An absolute fantastic tour.  The journey is about an hour long from getting on the plane to getting off.  Fantastic views with very informative commentary. Well worth doing as you'll never forget.

We took the airplane tour to the Grand Canyon south rim from Las Vegas. While being picked up at the hotel at 4:30 am wasn't ideal, I was pleasantly surprised to find the shuttle driver was waiting for us exactly where we were told he would be and was even a few minutes early. 

We were quickly transported to the airport terminal and checked in for our flight. About 15 min later, just enough time to grab a quick snack and browse the gift shop, our group was called and we boarded the plane. 

The flight to the canyon lasted about an hour and there were headphones provided which would play music and called at different points of interest on our way. I really appreciated this since I've flown over the Grand Canyon several times and have never been able to tell exactly what I'm looking at.

On arriving we were quickly transferred to a shuttle bus that drove us to two different lookout points, giving us a little over an hour at each to explore, before taking us back to the terminal. The sights we stopped at were both beautiful. And the bus driver was very friendly and informative, offering to take group photos for us and providing lots of details about the canyon and its history.

The trip back to the hotel was just as efficient, arriving back at the hotel shortly before 1:00 pm. I don't think we were kept waiting for more than 10-15 min at any point during our trip.

I would definitely choose this tour company again. It may seem a little pricy at first, but it was well worth it to see the Grand Canyon and still getting to spend the rest of our day enjoying Vegas.

review_title: Fun tour - Not vegitarian or vegan friendly
review_text: My wife and I took a tour this past week end and had a wonderful tour.  We made 5 phone calls and verified that a Vegan meal was available.   She told them she was allergic to dairy to make sure it was clear.   We were told yes, and even on the tour we asked if the vegan meal was confirmed before starting.  My wife received yogurt and a muffin made with milk for breakfast and a sandwich made with two slices of cheese, a slice of tomato and wilted lettuce  for lunch.  The full day tour is 12 hours long and 2 apples and a small bag of chips that came with lunch was not enough to fully enjoy the tour.  We emailed the company and have not received a response.  We do not recommend this company if you have any special requests for your diet.

review_title: Need some updating or newer airplanes !
review_text:
Scary aircraft from the start, paint standard  on some aircraft looks like it was painted with a brush. And the airplane interior was like something if you could imagine a taxicab in New Delhi India, if only they could invest more into upkeep of the aircraft and spend less on such a lavish air terminal and the airplanes windows are very scratch up making photographic opportunities very difficult.
Otherwise the Grand Canyon was beautiful !
I took my family to the Scenic Airlines and it was an amazing experience. i'll definitely recommend this tour to anyone!!!!.
Um belo passeio, dá uma visão geral do GrandCanyon. São 70 minutos de voo, paisagens belissimas, avião com janelas grandes.

Took the Grand Canyon Scenic Airlines flight and what an experience! The aircraft had 8 seat and provided great viewing of the canyon.  The 50 minute flight was one to remember.  Easy access to the terminal from the airport and Grand Canyon park.

It's quite a few years ago since my wife and I did this flight but it was so memorable that it seems like only yesterday. After being picked up around teatime and taken to the airport everything was looking good and we boarded the small plane on time and off we went. A bit of a storm was brewing as we took off and the turbulence was quite bad, worsening as we passed Lake Mead and drew near to the Canyon. The views outside were spectacular and there was an informative commentary about the history and culture of the Canyon via the earphones provided.
Sadly, because of the turbulence, many of the passengers were making good and frequent use of sick-bags, instead of marvelling at the incredible views. However, the turbulence could hardly be blamed on the company and both pilots were very sympathetic and trying to be comforting (though for some this was in vain). The general feeling was that if the airplane had landed at or near the Canyon, then no-one would have re-boarded for the flight back to Vegas, so bad was the ride.
That apart, the trip was amazing and the memories, of the entire trip, are priceless and timeless.

Four of us booked this tour expecting it to be the ultimate experience but we ended up feeling rushed but waiting around a lot. We were picked up at our hotel in a minibus, driven to another hotel to transfer to a coach and then driven 35/40 minutes to Boulder City to catch the flight. We waited around for approx 40 minutes to board the 30 minute flight to the canyon. The scenery was fantastic during the flight and the dam is amazing. When we landed we went to the terminal to again wait to be taken to the helicopter which took us on a short 5 minute flight to the canyon floor. We then went on a boat that travelled 5 minutes before stopping and the guide told us a bit of the history of the tribe that own that stretch of canyon and then took photos of us with our cameras. We then turned round and went back to board the helicopter for the 5 minute flight back to the terminal. We then boarded a bus to travel to the skywalk, where we queued for 15 minutes before being told it was closed and had been for a couple of hours due to lightning in the area. Back on the bus to the last stop for more photos and food, which we didn't have time to eat because we had been told to get back to the terminal to catch the flight back or we'd be stranded. We got back to the terminal and waited for 40 minutes to board the flight! Then, when we were back at the airport we waited 25 minutes for a bus to drive us to our hotel. Overall nothing can take away from the sheer scale and beauty of the canyon but I feel the tour that we booked tried to cram too much in (the tour is 7 hours long) so you were left feeling disappointed. I think it would be far better to do less and have more time to do it.

We just completed our first Grand Canyon visit and the Scenic River Canyon Tour was the absolute best part of the trip. The entire tour could not have ran smoother. We arrived at the airport at 5:45 am, about 15 minutes from the El Tovar Lodge at Grand Canyon Village. Easy check in. We were provided a light breakfast with muffins, fruit, juice and coffee. We gathered in a comfortable lounge while waiting for the departure. We boarded about 6:20 with departure at 6:30. There were 6 passengers on our plane, every seat a window seat. Our pilot was delightful and informative. Although the plane was small, the flight was super smooth and thrilling. No matter how long you look, you can not see the depth and detail of the canyon from the rim like you can from the air. It is something I will never forget. After about a 50 minute flight, we landed in Page. We were soon met at the airport by a Navajo guide that would take us via 4-wheel vehicle to Antelope Canyon, a 20 min drive. The truck was open-air, so a little cool, but not too bad. At the canyon, the guide took us through, stopping and explaining exactly what we were seeing and the science and history around it. She gave us all tips on how to photograph the canyon and made this part of the tour a highlight. I promise you it will be the most beautiful place that you never heard of. After completing this part of the tour, we boarded a bus for a 10-12 min ride, and were provided a boxed lunch. The next stop was the canyon river portion of the tour. There we boarded a raft with our river guide 'Jenny'. You can sit in the provided cushion seating or the large pontoons. I recommend sitting in the seats just forward of Jenny's console. Those seats have back rests. Most folks ate their lunch as we headed down the river. Iced water and lemonade was provided. The 3 hour ride was incredible! It was slow and smooth, just fast enough to create a gentle, and appreciated breeze. You find yourself looking in all directions. The vistas in front and behind you. And the massive walls of rock on each side. In many places the 46 degree water was crystal clear and fish are easily seen. Jenny was a compete joy. She was funny, informative, courteous and helpful. She constantly informed us as to what we were seeing, and added great stories along the way. We made a stop along the way on a small sandy beach. Bath rooms are provided. You're also able to check out some  petroglyphs on the  canyon walls. After about a 30 min break, we re-boarded and continued down the river. More incredible views were along the way to Lees Ferry, where our motor coach back to the airport was waiting. There are bathrooms here as well. The bus was very comfortable and most folks napped on the way back. We stopped at Cameron Trading Post for about 30 min to stretch our legs and purchase souvenirs if you're inclined. The bus driver also was courteous and informative as we drove past more vistas along Desert View Drive. We returned to where we started,12 hours earlier. I can't think of any better way to experience the canyon. From the air, the Colorado River at the base and the rim during the drive back. I highly recommend the tour. It's a little pricey but you won't regret it.

Without doubt this was the bit we were most looking forward to on our tour of South West USA. We were not disappointed. It is not cheap but worth every penny. Unfortunately were not staying in the Canyon area so had a 1hr drive to the Airport, we were given a boxed breakfast, gluten free for one of the group ordered in advance. An approx. 1hr flight in a Cessna Caravan (great fun) along the canyon with commentary on headphones, spectacular. Landed at Page, driven by antiquated 4x4 trucks partly off road India Jones style to Antelope Canyon, taken by guide through again spectacular, back to Page to Base of Glen Canyon Dam for a approx. 3hr plus trip down the Colorado River on a Rib Boat. Stopped a couple of times one to eat packed lunch provided (again gluten free for one of the party) and see some ancient rock carvings, second as a comfort stop. We disembarked at Lee's Crossing taking a coach back to the airport (about 4 hours with a stop at a Native American trading post).
As I said not cheap but thoroughly recommended. All Staff were great and informative

review_title: La manera de conocer el Gran Cañón que marca la diferencia
review_text:
Volamos con Scenic en un recorrido por el South y el North Rim de unos 45 minutos de duración en total.
El audio proporciona datos muy interesantes y enriquece la experiencia.
Pasamos algunos días en el Gran Cañón haciendo algún trekking de larga duración hacia el fondo del cañón y, definitivamente, las dimensiones de esta maravilla de la naturaleza son tales que, sin una visita aérea, no llegas a tener la sensación de conocerlo en profundidad.
100% recomendable.
Nuestro tour salió por menos de 140$, que creo que están más que amortizados y aprovechados. Una gran inversión!!!

review_title: If you have a full day - this is how you want to spend it!
review_text: Well coordinated day trip from South Rim to Page with lots of handoff from one tour company to another perfectly coordinated: 1 hr flight to Page with stunning views, 4 wheel drive to Antelope Canyon with amazing light play, bus ride to Colorado River for a 15 mile float (not white water at all) with incredible and constantly changing scenery, bus ride to trading post on the Reservation (mostly tourist crap with an overpriced gallery immediately adjacent), and bus ride back to airport where you left your car. Never an issue with food, water, bathrooms, etc. 12 plus hours with a small group.

review_title: Fantastic once or twice in a lifetime experience everyone should do!
review_text: I did a GC flight 26 years ago (can't remember who with) & it was amazing & 2nd time round with my wife, still amazing. The colours, light, shade, shadows, contours etc. change every second. The aeroplane was very good value & cheaper than a much shorter helicopter flight & we must have been in the air, excluding take off & landing for a good half an hour - well it seemed like it anyway. Fantastic experience & would definitely recommend.

We were picked up from our Hotel and taken to the airport where we caught a flight to the Grand Canyon. We then boarded a helicopter and flew down into the canyon. We were then guided down a short walk to the Colorado River where we jumped on a pontoon and made our way upstream. Wow, to see the canyon from this angle was really worth it. Fantastic. We were then helicoptered to the rim where we could walk around. This was amazing. Really a 'must do'

The canyon is truly amazing to see from above, and this trip brought us for long stretches over it giving us views that we could not imagine from the rim or inside it.  It's a once in a lifetime trip and deserves the birds eye view Grand Canyon Airlines offers.  The flight time and the cordial crew engagement with us was just fine.  One disappointment:  the taped commentary about the canyon that passengers can listen to by head phone did not work in English for much of the trip.  Ironically fellow passengers speaking other languages had their commentary functioning.

We booked the trip including drive, flight, helicopter and boat. The pickup was late in the morning then we had to wait another 20 minutes at another hotel for a transfer...so we got to the actual trip quite late. The worst part was on the return, when we were told to be at the airport at 2:00 pm. We were there at 1:40, checked in and were told the flight is scheduled for 2:30, so we waited for the flight back in the waiting room. At about 2:20 we were told that our plane just departed....and we will be scheduled for another later flight. How can this happen? How organized is this? 
The trip was an expensive trip and we spent a lot of time waiting....I guess we were lucky that the flight at 4:15 had 2 left seats and we returned with it. So instead of being back by 3 pm we got after 6 pm...and we did not have time to go to the show we had tickets to that evening.
What was supposed to be an amazing experience turned out to be a disappointment....waste of our money.
We tried reaching out to guestrelations@papilon.com but we got no answer back

We only had 1 day to explore the Grand Canyon and seeing it via airplane was the best idea! The airplane ride made it possible to see how vast, expansive and beautiful the Grand Canyon is-- no question why it is one of the 7 natural wonders of the world! 5 of us went and we're go glad we did. It was easy to book online (we booked it the night before), and helpful information for day-of was provided instantly. We were combined with other visitors with a total of approx. 15 people on the 3 seater plane. We flew across Kaibab National Forest and over the south and southwest of the canyon. So gorgeous!
The overall experience was great, however if you have any motion sickness issues I suggest taking precautions. Due to the plane size turns and movement had an increased effect. Also, there was air conditioning of sorts, but the plane was still moderately warm (I didn't expect a private, luxury jet), however the warm air adds to the nausea :(
I would definitely recommend this activity to anyone wanting a unique perspective on this natural beauty!

Excellently organised, from pick up, tour and drop off. Booked afternoon Delux tour 1055-2000! Pick up via bus to Bolder airport (30 mins), flight over Hoover Dam and west Rim (I think), then a bus to two spots on the south rim, Angel Bright and Matherson. For the flight book a window seat for one if you are traveling as a couple so you can sit together. I get air sick on small planes, I took some medication to assist with this and had no problem. As you are flying over the Canyons it can be a little bumpy however, well worth it when you see the amazing scenery. Seats 7A and 7C were the best for me right at the back plenty of leg room for my husband who is rather tall. Listen to the bus drivers for tips for the best photos. They provided a pack lunch consisting of salad roll, apples, water, cookies and Pringles. Please state if you have dietary requirements. Would do this again, but would like to stay over at the Grand Canyon.

The plane ride was very good and worth the money. The only thing that was not pleasent was that a family brought on a small child and he was crying the entire trip. That was not Scenic Airlines fault. Other wise it was. good. The woman in the shop at the end of the trip was not very nice either. We chose not to purchase the picture taken and she said if we didn't want the picture we shouldn't have wasted the paper. I did not think that was a nice thing to say.

review_title: No better way to experience the Grand Canyon!
review_text: We decided to do this vs standing on the edge of the Grand Canyon like Clark Griswold. The cost was $159 per person vs. +$200 for a shorter helicopter flight that wasn't as extensive. This tour covers most of the GC, is safe and there is a narrated voice over to listen to along the journey. Requested both of us have window seats which will cost you an additional $10 per person, but they were nice enough and waived the fee. The seating is 1 x 2 configuration with the exception of row 7, which is 1 x 1 with no 'B' seat, this is where we sat. Only downside was the tour was supposed to be 40 - 50 minutes, we were back at the terminal around 33 minutes.

An hours flight to and from Grand Canyon airport, then a 10/15 minute bus ride to the rim of the Grand Canyon itself. Amazing, breath taking views! Another 10/15 minute trip further round the rim to more outstanding views. Also get views of the Hoover dam as you take off and land from Boulder City.

Expensive trip but well worth it versus sitting on a coach/car for 9 hours.

Please note that it is a tiny plane that is subject to a lot of turbulence. If you are not a good flyer like me be warned that it may push you to your limits!

Cannot say enough about this crowd!!
Ran like clockwork !
Turn up get tickets
Wait until plane returns
Jump on
Be MESMERISED by the beauty of the canyon from the air.
Wife is ex pilot and said pilots were exceptional 

MUST DO item on your trip to the canyon

review_title: Amazing views, better value for money than helicopter flights
review_text: Check-in was smooth and departure was on time. Friendly pilot introduced us to the plane - I was expecting a twin otter that has very large windows (as per pictures on website) but ended up in a Cessna caravan. It was very comfortable on board but the windows are not as big. It was extremely turbulent, would be interested to know if the twin otter was more stable as it was a little uncomfortable at points. That said we almost had the plane to ourselves. This was a lot cheaper than the helicopter rides and in my mind worth the savings, you still get an absolutely amazing view - would recommend!

review_title: This is houw you see the canyon!
review_text: This was a wonderful way to see the canyon.  I had been here twice before and this was my third trip....this time with my family.  I promised that we'd make the most of our visit.  This tour was an aweseome way to keep my promise.  We did an early morning fly over the canyon, which was just breathtaking.  The tour of Antelope canyon was great.  I wish we had been able to actually take a tour of The Wave, but these rocks were so cool, and in fact, very similar.  The best part of the day was the river ride in Glen Canyon.  Our tour guide Brent was terrific.  It was so clear that he enjoyed what he was doing.  He was knowledgable, funny, kind and thoughtful.  My son was the only child on the tour and he made sure to pay extra special attention to him, so that he had a wonderful time.  I would recommend this tour over and over and over again.  We took our coach ride back to our hotel and kept on counting our blessings.  What a wonderful day.

review_title: Nice flight however flight time much shorter than promised
review_text:
We had a fairly good experience, the ground staff and pilots were really friendly, it was a good start.
However they advertised the south rim plane tour as 45-50 min flight time, we barely exceeded 30 mins.
It was still a great experience.

review_title: A must do at the Grand Canyon
review_text: The experience was amazing.  Great views of the Canyon.  You can't get the birds-eye view, except in the air.  Skip the touristy photo-op before you get on, just do a selfie on your own and save $20.00
A very interesting flying tour of the canyon. Shows you lakes, river, rocks, more rocks, and a wonderful informative. Great for family.
Got us there with no incident. Thank you very much. Everyone was very personable and all the instructions were received quickly and in full...........................

review_title: Scenic Canyon River Adventure vs Imperial Ecostar Helicopter Tour in Grand Canyon South Rim
review_text:
Both the tours left from Grand Canyon National Airport. Both I booked through Papillon, but Helicopter left from Papillon section of the airport whereas Scenic Canyon River Adventure left from the Grand Canyon Airlines section of the airport. 
Helicopter tour - lasts 45min, $294 (I would give two stars)
Grand Canyon River Adventure - lasts 15-16hours, $394 (I would give five stars)

Imperial Ecostar (Two stars out of five)- The first day I took a helicopter ride and booked "Imperial Star Helicopter Ride" by Papillon. The helicopter is well maintained and a smooth ride. It was advertised as 40-50minutes, but my tour lasted 35minutes and we spend approximately 10-13minutes seeing the Grand Canyon. My pilot was not friendly as she preferred not to talk much and didn't seem to know answers to simple questions about the Grand Canyon. I am not sure whether the pilot was interested to be there. I was disappointed that I wasted nearly $289 with limited time over the Canyons, so decided to do a different one the next day and I got it right the second time - the Scenic Canyon River Adventure.

Scenic Canyon River Adventure (Five out of five stars) - I booked it through Papillon website, but the tour left from Grand Canyon Airlines from Grand Canyon National Airport. I couldn't get enough of this tour as I enjoyed throughly every minute of it. It costed $394 for the whole day, breakfast and lunch included, it lasted 15 hours, we left at 6am. When we arrived at 6am in GC airport, our breakfast box was waiting.  We boarded on a small plane to fly over the Grand Canyon to Page Airport for an hour, our plane was an eight seater plane with brilliant views for everyone as all seats were window seats. We flew over Grand Canyon, saw Glen Canyon Dam and had beautiful views. In fact I enjoyed my views from this plane than the helicopter tour I did the previous day. We had a short break in Page airport where we could use toilets and was given a brief briefing on what the next tour would be - Antelope Canyon visit. We sat on back of trucks which were converted to be tour trucks with two rows of seats backing each other thereby all of us got good views of the town on the way to the Upper Antelope Canyon. It was an interesting unique rocky fun experience in this truck to the Antelope Canyon, I wouldn't want to trade it any other way. We spent some time visiting the Upper Antelope Canyon where our tour guide showed all the interesting views of Upper Antelope Canyon. I wish this tour had included the Lower Antelope Canyon also. We were then taken to Colorado River Discovery Office where we had 45 minutes to relax in the cafe and take a toilet break. We could fill up our water bottles in the cafe. Big buses came to pick us up to the Glen Canyon Dam site. We were given packed lunches when we boarded the bus.The long tunnel ride by bus was one of the most unique drives I have encountered - I would suggest to sit on the front seats as it has better view in the tunnel than the rear ones if you are interested in watching the dark tunnel drive. The tunnel was a two mile long dark tunnel dug through the canyon walls with small window of light dug out for ventilation. On the end of the tunnel was the base of Glen Canyon Dam and our motorized raft with our tour guide. Our guide Brian was knowledgable, interesting, interactive, fun and made our 4 1/2 hours ride as perfect as it could be! We had two toilet breaks, two brief swimming breaks, stopped at petroglyps, took several pictures, it was serene and beautiful in the Colorado river.  Interestingly, I couldn't picture the feel of Horseshoe bend while in the river as well as we could see it, since our view was limited by the Canyon walls. (So went the following day driving to see it from top of the Canyon). We had plenty of drinking water on board also. Our motorized raft ended in Historic Lees Ferry Port where buses were waiting to pick us up to drive back to Grand Canyon National Airport, it was a long drive for 3 1/2 hrs. We stopped at Cameron Trading Post where there were interesting Navajo Indian Reservation handicrafts, gifts, cafe, toilets and hotel. Our bus driver pointed out to the interesting tourist spots on the way back and stopped to drop some people off at the South Rim before getting back to Grand Canyon National Airport.

review_title: Excursión muy completa aunque un poco larga
review_text: Hicimos la excursión del Scenic River Adventure. Sales a las seis de la mañana del aeropuerto del Grand Canyon (pasan a recoger en distintos hoteles). Sobrevuelas el cañón mas o menos una hora y luego te llevan a Antilope Canyon (nuestro guía, buenísimo). Posteriomente, desciendes el rio unas dos horas, con un par de paradas para que los niños y los valientes puedan bañarse (el agua está bastante fria). Picnic para desayunar y comer (mas que aceptable). Para mi, el tramo del rio, demasiado largo y un poco tedioso, bajo un sol de justicia. No ayuda que mi inglés sea nefasto, porque el guía era excelente. Al final, vuelta al aeropuerto en autocar (más de tres horas). Muy bien organizado y profesionales excelentes (el conductor del autocar estvo explicando cosas interesantes del Grand Canyon durante las dos últimas horas del viaje. Se estropeó el aire acondicionado del autocar y nos trajeron otro. Cuesta un dinerito (unos 375 dólares) pero vale la pena porque ves el Canyon desde el aire y desde el agua. Eso sí, acabas reventado. No se os olvide sombrero y crema solar !! En la barca y en el autocar, dan agua gratis. La excursión dura aproximadamente 12,5 horas. Te dan la opción de pagar 10 dólares más por tener ventana grande en la avioneta. No vale la pena. Se ve igual en todos los sitios. (A no ser que vayas solo y te toque pasillo).

review_title: A good way to see above the canyon extending out a long way.
review_text: An enjoyable 45 minute flight showing the vast extent of the canyon. Pilots did their best to give both sides of the plane a good view but I wonder if those in the inner seats had a reasonable view. Try and obtain a single seat if possible.

review_title: Grand et majestueux mais pas autant que prévu
review_text:
Départ à l'heure de l'hôtel avec le bus de la compagnie. Nous voyageons 3/4h avant d'arriver à l'aéroport. Une attente longue car tous les bus arrivent en même temps pour décharger les touristes hélicoptère et avion.
J'avais réservé de France (139$) et payé un supplément pour être devant. Rien ne m'a été proposé. 
Dans l'avion nous sommes 15. Nous survolons le barrage et le lac avant d'arriver au Grand  Canyon. Il a plu la veille. Les couleurs sont vertes, décevantes. Le site est beau malgré tout.

review_title: Teníamos la impresión de estar mirando fotos por internet. Nos faltó vivirlo de cerca.
review_text: Mi marido y yo hicimos la excursión Gran Canyon Connoisseur con la empresa Papillon. La organización y servicio estuvo muy bien pero si pudiéramos repetir, no lo haríamos solo en avioneta. Verlo todo el tiempo a vista de pájaro, de tan lejos, nos supo a poco, tanto desde la avioneta como desde los dos miradores. Si pudiésemos repetir, haríamos la excursión en helicóptero, aterrizando en el fondo del Gran Cañón junto al río Colorado.

i booked a tour to see the grand canyon and i was really looking forward to it! however, i did everything which was needed (call the office the day befor the flight...), but they forgot to pick me up! i waited 30 minutes and called the office to hear that it was already too late to get the flight! i was at the right place in time (10 minutes earlier)!

In de ochtend om negen uur een rondvlucht gemaakt boven de Grand Canyon. Het was niet zo goed weer, veel bewolking en af en toe wat regen. De start en landing waren erg comfortabel en de piloot leek dus erg goed om te kunnen gaan met de wat slechtere weersomstandigheden.

Bij de Canyon hadden we een erg goed uitzicht. De ramen zijn groot genoeg om goed te kunnen fotograferen en te filmen. Ook de uitleg tijdens de vlucht is leuk die te horen is door de koptelefoons.

review_title: Good tour but not fully satisified.
review_text:
This tour was good but not excellent. We did a small aircraft flight to the grand canyon and then a helicopter flight over the canyon, followed by lunch at one of the viewpoints of the canyon. We felt that we never knew what was going to happen next, we were always getting off one mode of transport onto another with not much communication. The transfers were great and the staff were friendly. We just felt we were told go here do this, get on here, get off, run over here. Very rushed. The helicopter flight was disappointing, you actually fly on a Papillion helicopter. We were rushed through a safety briefing, then got told to go outside get on the aircraft. There was no commentary on the helicopter and was very quick. Probably only 10 or 15mins. My partner and I didn't have a great view from the helicopter either.  We didn't get the boxed lunch until 3.30pm. We were absolutely starving and thirsty. It was a great experience but just felt a bit rushed seeing as it was an all day tour.
If we were to do this again, we would try Papillion.

We did a combined trip of aeroplane flight, jeep tour and rafting. Friendly pilot and amazing views on flight.Great walk through antelope canyon and the rafting was fantastic.Rafting is a great way to see the canyon.Highly recommend

My husband and I did this excursion on our trip to the Grand Canyon.

It was an incredible day and we can not rate this trip highly enough. 

The trip started at 5am but was worth the early start.
