I felt a bit nervous going on the plane as I thought it maybe a rocky journey, I couldn't be more wrong the flight was smooth and calm and the pilots were great. The scenery was incredible and you see parts of the Canyon you would only see by air.

We then landed and took a jeep to the antelope canyons which was good and the tour guide advised us on the best pictures to take.

We then took a raft down the Colorado River which was incredible, our guide on the boat Sonnie  was very knowledgeable. We got to stop at some of the beach stop offs and cool off.

It was the best day of our 3 week trip to the US and I am so glad we did this. If you are thinking of booking do it!

Om 9:00 een vlucht gehad boven de Grand Canyon. Ondanks de bewolking een prachtig uitzicht gehad. Over de gehele Canyon gevlogen en dan ook heel veel gezien.

De piloot deed zijn werk heel goed. Een hele rustige goede vlucht gehad. Ondanks het wat slechtere weer geen last van turbulentie gehad en een goede landing gehad.

review_title: Não economize, para curtir melhor, vá de helicóptero.
review_text: O parque nacional do Grand Canyon fica a 4 horas de ônibus de Las Vegas e o passeio dura o dia todo. Você sai do Hotel as 6 e meia da manhã e volta as 10 da noite. Você também pode ir de helicóptero e o passeio dura 3h e meia. Acho que apesar de custar o triplo do preço o passeio de helicóptero vale mais a pena. Eu fui de ônibus e não gostei. Também não tive sorte, choveu quando chegamos lá e o tempo começou a fechar e quase não deu pra ver as belíssimas paisagens do local. É impressionante vendo nos pontos de maior circulação e acesso, imagino indo de helicóptero e mergulhando canyon adentro. Da próxima vez pago os US$ 356,00 de helicóptero, mas não pago os US$ 140,00 que paguei de ônibus. Me arrependi. São coisa que fazemos apenas uma vez na vida. Fui economizar, mas não gostei da experiência.

review_title: Grand Canyon was amazing, getting there not so much
review_text:
We did the connoisseur trip to the South Rim.  Our bus arrived exactly on time to take us to the airport.  The driver did seem like he was in a hurry & was short with some of the passengers but they were late so I guess that is to be expected.  We arrived at the airport & didn't have a long wait to check in.  Once checked in we had approx 30mins before our flight left which was enough time to get some food & water at the cafe in the airport.
Our pilot was nice & friendly.  The plane was very cramped which I guess is to be expected but if you are taller than 6 foot you will find it very cramped.  Also the day was very hot & the plane doesn't have aircon.  It was also a very turbulent flight which made my wife & I feel quite ill.  The upside to all this is the views from the aircraft are amazing from the Hover Damn through to different parts of the Canyon.  There is an audio tour of everything you are seeing which is great, however the music that goes with it is terrible.  
We arrived safely & then were directed to a bus to travel to the canyon.  The bus driver again was quite short with the other passengers who didn't speak a ton of english so I don't think they understand what was required anyway.  The driver was nice to us but I believe there should have been more direction on where to go once we arrived at the airport & how much time before we left on the bus, so people knew whether to rush to the toilet or not.  Once arriving at the canyon it was everything & more than we expected.  Our travel back on the bus was fine however the plane ride back (which is about 1hr) was very turbulent, after the rough flight we were made to wait on the tarmac for a couple of mins in the heat for no apparent reason which added to the sickness.  The bus ride back to our hotel was quick & we didn't need to wait long.
If I had to do it again, a helicopter ride would be my pick.

Después de un día muy nublado y lloviendo el personal nos re-agendó la salida y tuvimos un día excelente. Los guías de cada etapa tenían amplios conocimientos y nos hicieron pasar un día  muy agradable

Volar noe s apra cualqueira, y menos aviones de pequeño porte. El vuelo fue excelente, tiene toda la adrenalina de pasar por termicas generadas por la misma geografia... me encantó, pero no apto para impresionables!!!
This flight was one of the highlights of our trip to the US. Friendly staff, marvellous view through the large windows! We really enjoyed it.
Pilots were great and enthusiastic. Made the trip very comfortable.  Great perspective of the canyon. They even showed my want-to-be-pilot son the plane.

On our first visit to the Grand Canyon, my husband and I toured the canyon by helicopter. This being our second visit, we wanted to be on the canyon floor. We had one free day in the canyon and choose the Grand Canyon Adventure tour because it was 3 in 1 – aerial of the canyon, tour through Antelope Canyon, and smooth rafting down the Colorado River. An amazing, once-in-a-lifetime experience with spectacular sights and views!

Our Scenic Canyon River Adventure began at the Grand Canyon Airport with a flight to Page, AZ, flying along the southern and eastern rim of the GC. We arrived to the area late the previous night and I loved watching my husband's face as he saw the GC for the first time during this early morning flight. :) We then toured Antelope Canyon, another wonderful example of God's amazing creation. Next we boarded a motorized raft for a smooth water float trip from the base of the Lake Powell Dam to Lee's Ferry, about 15 miles. Brad was our captain and he provided much historical and geographical knowledge of the area and even serenaded us on his guitar. The ancient Indian petroglyphs were amazing, also.  We were blessed with cloudy skies and uncharacteristically mild temperatures, a nice surprise. I highly recommend this all-day trip as it was extremely enjoyable and informative!

review_title: Nice pilots but bothered that it was suggested we tip the pilots!
review_text: We took Grand Canyon Airlines at the end of our rafting trip down the Grand Canyon.  They transported us back to Las Vegas.  The plane was great and the pilots were very friendly.  The audio tour was a good idea but the quality of the sound and the stories was only ok.  What really bothered me was at the end of the flight, the pilots said that tips would be welcome.  I must say, it made me feel like they were demeaning their profession - pilots are highly skilled professionals who we are trusting our lives to - not a service provider or taxi driver.  Just left me with a negative feeling after a nice flight

Bus was clean n comfortable.  Driver was knowledgeable and friendly. The guided tour information on the bus was nice n interesting. The ride was smooth and we had plenty of time to see all of the canyon.  Heat was super depressing but there are plenty of accessibly for everyone. Lunch was include n was good. Take plenty of water n extra snacks! Dry heat can be difficult to beat.

Siamo arrivati con largo anticipo e ci hanno offerto di partire un'ora prima per il volo sul Grand Canyon. Così praticamente in un baleno eravano a bordo dell'aeroplano che ci ha fatto vivere emozioni indescrivibili. Avevamo due bambini che nonostante qualche inevitabile vuoto d'aria e scossone si sono divertiti alla grande, come i grandi. Panorami eccezionali. Personale gentile. Prezzi non bassi ma ne vale la pena. Consiglio l'aereo anche per realizzare le foto migliori. Dopo il volo, la visita al Grand Canyon via terra vi sembrerà quasi... poca cosa.

We flew with Scenic Airlines as part of a full-day adventure tour that also included a jeep ride into Antelope Canyon as well as smooth river rafting down the Colorado River. Flying over the Grand Canyon is a fantastic way to get an idea of the sheer size and beauty of it all.

Everything was well organised, a generous breakfast was offered and we were given plenty of time for photos in front of the plane when we landed.

Our family booked the Scenic Canyon River Adventure which included flying over the Eastern Rim of the Grand Canyon, Colorado River and Lake Powell.  I was most nervous about the flight and it was the most fun!!!  We were able to see areas that you can't see on foot or pull off spots in a car.  The pilots were friendly and very knowledgeable.  It was an experience of a lifetime!!!  The next tour was Antelope Canyon on an Indian Reservation.  The guide was outstanding and helped us take amazing pictures of the canyon.  The last part was taking a motorized raft down the Colorado River (very very tame part)  It was extremely hot so bring a cooling towel unless you go in the Spring or Fall.  We went really really slow so easy for anyone.  I wanted to go fast and we did a couple of times for fun.  Very knowledgeable guide and we learned a lot about the area.  I would highly recommend this tour!!!!

This was by far the best and most organized tour! A must do if visiting the Grand Canyon. First you fly over the canyon for spectacular views. Flight was smooth. Then jeep down to Antelope canyon with our Navajo guide giving us all the best photo tricks.  Thanks Rosie!  After that they drove us down to Glen Canyon dam where we boarded pontoon rafts for a very smooth and breathtaking trip on the Colorado River.  I can't express how great this tour was. Everything was perfect and can't imagine my vacation without it. Made it the best tour ever for me.

review_title: Excellent way to briefly view overall Grand Canyon before commencing real hiking
review_text:
Grand Canyon is so vast that it is literally impossible to grasp full scale on the ground. You need a bird view to visualize what you are looking at. I took the flight twice, once when I was 9 in 2002, and the other this Spring, when I am much older. The first time I have seen the grand canyon through air, it was breathtaking. I couldn't take my eyes off from the view I was seeing. Second time was less impressive than the first, due to facts that i already knew what I was expecting (no element of surprise) and that I was having a high expectation due to my first experience. 

But my first impression should be the correct way to judge this trip and I will say I recommend this flight. Its expensive, but really worth it. But be careful of monsoon season as weather can change stormy quickly.

review_title: Best way to do the south rim from Vegas
review_text:
Grand Canyon airlines picked us up from the hotel, and took us to the Boulder airport, the company is ridiculously well organized and every thing went flawless, once we landed at the Grand Canyon airport Jerry, the bus driver/tour guide was great, and more than willing to help out with pictures. 
The flight was rough, but not the pilots fault, just a little plane and hot weather makes for a bumpy flight.

We took the Indian Canyon Adventure tour with my husband. It was amazing! My husband even had the chance to sit next to the pilot. He really enjoyed it, he said it was on of his best experiences in his life. The windows are big,so you can have a great view. Just a tip: Before booking I saw that you can purchase window seat for an extra $10,we did not buy it, and I think that there is no point paying extra for that, as everyone has a window seat. The views were amazing,the ride is a bit bumpy sometimes, but nothing serious. :-) You have about 1 hour to spend at the Eagle point,and the rest (including lunch) at the Guano Point. You have enough time to explore the area. It was a well-organized tour with beautiful views. We can highly recommend the tour and Scenic Arilines.

review_title: Couldn't have asked for a better tour
review_text:
When we decided to visit the Grand Canyon, we were looking at different options for tours.  We decided to do the Grand Canyon Scenic River Adventure.  This tour was amazing.  We started off with the plane ride from the GC to Page, AZ.  Our flight was smooth and the pilots were courteous and helpful when answering questions.  The quick open-air "jeep" ride to Antelope Canyon was good.  The tour of Antelope Canyon was breath taking (definitely a must do on anyone's bucket list).  From there we took a short bus ride to the Glen Canyon dam where we boarded motorized rafts.  This was the highlight of trip.  My kids (10 & 7) loved the boat.  They were able to get  wet and play for a short time in the water (47 degree water though).  They provided a very tasty and fresh lunch while on the boat too.  

I would recommend this tour to anyone visiting the Grand Canyon.  Worth every penny!

My husband and I did this tour for our 35th Wedding Anniversary and just loved it.
We each had a window to view the canyon as we circled pretty well the whole canyon.
It was even more spectacular than what we had imagined. We were on vacation for 1 week stayed in Phoenix and Sedona saw some beautiful sights, but this was the highlight of our trip. Thanks Scenic and hats off to our pilot - really swell guy!!!

review_title: Make sure you let the Scenic staff know you're staying @ Kachina (if you are)
review_text: Dear Scenic booking staff. When we ask if you would consider picking us up @ our lodge and you ask where we're staying ... and it's the lodge next to where you pick up and drop off ... OFFER it to us. We loved everything about our tour. The flight (1st timers and a bit nervous) was amazing. Our highlight! The jeep tour amazing (including our guide Lena). The raft trip down the Colorado (so so ... our guide must have been new as he was awful ... boring ... on a hot day ... tootling down the river made for an even longer day. Luxe bus trip back to initial location so so as well. We would have given this excursion five stars except that after dropping everyone off at their desired hotels/lodges we had to end up back at the airport adding 2 hours to our day. Booking staff please note those of us staying near Bright Angel Lodge can easily walk there and wait to be picked up/dropped off. Wish you would have offered it.! The rest of the trip stellar!

Seeing the WHOLE canyon and Kaibab National Forest from the sky is amazing. The plane comfortably sat three people per row. There was a lot of turbulence during our flight and I admit I was praying at times but our pilots were totally cool. Since they do this for a living, if they weren't freaking out, I decided I shouldn't be either. Would not recommend for small children or those with "Weak" stomachs but definitely for the adventurous.

We decided to take the GC Airlines scenic tour and we are glad we did. The pilots were friendly, knowledgeable, and very safety-conscience. We enjoyed this tour and I highly recommend it when visiting the GC. The perspective of this awesome natural wonder is simply glorious from the air.

Our flight from the Bar 10 Ranch back to Marble Canyon with Grand Canyon Airlines was a great flight.  Evan, our pilot, went out of his way to show us the sights and even some extras on our flight after our rafting trip down the Grand Canyon with Tour West.

We took the Grand canyon Airlines scenic tours from the Papillon Helicopter rides.  We opted for the all day airplane ride vs the helicopter as we wanted to be able to walk around the Grand Canyon.  It is about a 1 hour plane ride there and an hour back.  They give you plenty of time to walk around at 2 different areas, and a boxed lunch that was pretty good.  We enjoyed the airplane (although a little cramped) if your a big person don't get on this plane.  They give you headsets to listen to music and info on the Grand Canyon.  The bus ride at the Grand Canyon was also good.  Big bus, holds over 30 people, with knowledgeable people.  The only thing we didn't like was the waiting!  After picking us up at 7:30am, it takes about 1 hour to get to their airport as you have to pick up many people.  Then wait in line to check in.  Then wait an hour for them to call your color (the helicopter rides run much faster).  At the Grand Canyon, wait for the bus, wait on the bus.  Coming home the same, more waiting around for buses, planes.  On return they don't tell you you have to check in with the man at a little desk to get a ride back to your hotel.  So, more waiting.  We are glad we did it, got some excellent pictures, & all in all did enjoy the day, although it is exhausting.

review_title: Best part of our short trip.
review_text: We only had a few days at the Grand Canyon. This flight which combined with a river float excursion was definitely a highlight. The staff was great, and the whole thing was so easy. We noticed all ages of travelers on the planes. It felt very safe and comfortable. We loved the trip.

Great plane, large windows so great views for everyone.
Just make sure when you check in that you get a boarding card. They told us they'd give it to us later & although asked a few times, they said they couldn't find us (Sat in waiting area!) However we did get b cards just in time & had a wonderful flight over the Grand Canyon. It is THE way to see it  if you haven't the time or energy to walk down into it or raft it.  The Pilot took a great route and ensured everyone got a great view of it all. If you only do one thing in the area, take a plane trip. Oh, and a very very smooth landing too😊

Très bon vol au dessus du grand canyon. La prestation vaut le coup tellement le canyon est grand. Nous avons embarqué à l'heure, siège coté vitre (Windows seat) comme demandé. Seul bémol la durée du vol très inférieur à celle annoncée : 30 mn au lieu des 50mn.

We booked this trip (Grand Canyon Scenic Tour) months in advance as recommended as it is quite popular. Now I know why. Our breakfast (and I know one of the reviewers felt she didn't have enough food--??) consisted of a large muffin, yogurt, orange juice, coffee, an apple, and a granola bar. The pilots gave us an overview of what we were to encounter and how to stay safe on the plane. The headsets provided a narration and classical music for what we saw from above. They also had 4 other languages available. There are two seats together and one individual across the tiny aisle. I read that you can pay an extra $10.00 for a window seat. But not to worry--the planes are outfitted with panoramic windows. It was a smooth ride and a view from every window. Well, worth the money.

We did the Tour Adventure (this company provides a wide variety of Grand Canyon tours-- you have a lot of options depending on how much time and money you want to spend. However, I do think this particular tour option gives you the most "bang for the buck".) which included a plane ride over the Grand Canyon, a visit to Antelope Canyon, and a rafting trip down the Colorado through Glen Canyon. It takes the whole day (we had to be at the airport near the South Rim by 6 am and were returned there at about 6:00 pm) and is well worth it-- you get a great sense of the whole area. You see the Grand Canyon from above (which is a vaster, more expansive view than you get hiking in it-- a different way to see it than we had the day before), see the canyon walls from below as you raft down the river (though, this is through Glen Canyon, not the Grand Canyon-- rafting waters through the Glen Canyon are really calm while the waters through the Grand Canyon are rougher. This is the relaxed, scenic way to raft the river.) and the breathtaking interior of Upper Antelope Canyon which is open only by reserved tour (you can't just walk in yourself-- you have to have a guide). 
Everyone on this tour, from the pilot to the river guide to the bus driver who took us to our car at the end of the day, was enthusiastic and friendly. It was well run and well organized (and, even had well-timed bathroom breaks to accommodate the long day and the fact that, if it's hot, you'll want to drink a lot of water). The food provided was good-- overall, this is a nicely comprehensive day and a great trio of ways to experience the Grand Canyon and around.

review_title: dramatic canyon, great way to see lots of it although a little rushed
review_text:
First i will cover the canyon, which is amazing and dramatic it is like nothing I have seen before with vivid colours, sheer drops, and scale.  It is a true stunning natural wonder.

The second thing i will cover is our 'tour' which more accurately would be described as a multiple experience bookings bundled together.  The way this provider achieves so much at its price is by not really offering a true personal tour.  e.g. our package was for airport transfer, a small public flight from bolder to canyon airport (via hover dam), helicopter transfer down, brief boat ride, helicopter transfer up, public shuttle bus to lookup, meal ticket, public shuttle bus back, public flight back to bolder, airport transfer.  As state it is great value but you are effectively on a semi public service so are waiting around for departure times, rather than being on a private tour.

The boat ride was a little disappointing, it was quite brief, didn't go particularly far, and simply went up the river and back down the river.  While it was a novelty i would have preferred being able to actually walk around a little which you are not allowed to do with strict paths between the helipad and the boat pontoon being marked.

The food provided was more than enough and quite tasty, we ate at guano point with brilliant views out over the canyon.
Small plane with pilot and copilot.  Has an audio track to walk you through the Grand Canyon.  Definite a great way to see the Grand Canyon.

Viagem muito legal 35 min de avião ate chegar ao Arizona. 6 horas no total, onde embarcamos no aeroporto de las vegas fomos com um 737 ate o arizona e de la o passeio seguiu em ônibus ate os 2 mirantes!

review_title: Grand Canyon was Great, Scenic Airlines not so much...
review_text:
The Scenic Airlines Grand Canyon Connoisseur Tour is a great way to see the south rim of the Grand Canyon if you are visiting from Las Vegas.  A bus tour is the least expensive but makes for a very long day.  Of the 14 hours slated for a bus tour, 10 hours of it is spent driving back and forth. Only about 3 hours of the time is spent actually viewing the canyon.  Driving it yourself is also tedious unless you plan on staying overnight.  The helicopter tours also look great, but are almost twice the price.  So the Grand Canyon Connoisseur airplane tour was a good option.  One hour of flying there, then transfer by bus to tour the canyon for 3 hours, and then a one hour ride back.  They will also pick you up and drop you off from your Las Vegas hotel.  

However you decide to see the canyon, scour the internet for the best price and tour to suit your needs.  There’s a ton of choices and different prices for the same types of tours, so shop around.

Scenic, Papillion and Grand Canyon Airlines are all the same company, departing from the Boulder City airport, located about 45 minutes from the strip.  We found the best price for the tour with Scenic.  Grand Canyon Airlines has the exact same tour, but was slightly more.  There was also a difference in price, depending on what time of day you book your tour.  Our 9:15AM tour was the most expensive, the 12:30PM was less, and the 6:15AM was the least expensive.  

Here are a few tips:  When you book, give an accurate weight and even overestimate your weight a little.  They weigh you before you get on the plane, and that includes your purse, camera, water bottle, etc., so keep that in mind.  If you get motion sickness, take dramamine or bonine beforehand.  The plane is small (about 19 passengers), and it got quite bumpy for a good portion of the flight.  Do not pay extra for a window seat.  Our plane had two seats on each side and the windows are very large.  If you are a couple they generally seat you together, so one of you should get a window seat.

Now the GOOD:  
Beautiful aerial view of the Hoover Dam, Lake Mead, the Colorado River and the Grand Canyon.
Bus tour took you to Bright Angel and Mather Point. This is the most impressive and the widest and deepest part of the canyon.  Plenty of time to souvenir shop too.
Gigi, our bus driver was fabulous!  She was a lot of fun and gave a  lot of interesting information.  They also had another guide to speak Japanese for part of our group.

And the BAD:
Our tour was scheduled to leave at 9:15am. The Boulder Terminal was very hectic, and had several groups all leaving around the same time for different plane and helicopter tours.  They “color coded” each group to make things simple.  Each of the groups were called, except for our “purple” group.  We were left sitting there well past the 9:15 departure time.   We went up and asked after it was a half hour late and was told they were waiting for the pilot.  20 more minutes went by and someone else asked the desk and was not given any more information.  When the pilot finally showed up he told our group that the audio portion of the tour wasn’t working and they were trying to fix it.  We finally started toward the gate a full HOUR past our original departure time.  No one told us we would be delayed, and were still not sure what the real problem was.  They just let us sit there and didn’t say a word.  We’ve been on several tours including helicopter tours so we know the general routine.  In our opinion, it was very unprofessional of Scenic not to inform us of a major delay.  When the pilot finally showed up he acted like nothing happened.  Everyone was fuming.  

We ended up having a great tour in spite of the bad start, but we really feel Scenic should review this incident and handle it more professionally in the future.

We set out from Scottsdale at 7:30 and got to the east  (64c) off of 89a N at about 11. We followed the speed limit and had little traffic to deal with. Our first stop was the Little Colorado viewpoint and was a great taste of what was to come. We drove up to the visitor centre after stopping at no less than 4 more viewpoints. Our last viewpoint was Maher at which time it was about 2 when we decided to start our journey back to Scottsdale. We did walk through the gift shoppe and picked up food at the village market. We elected to drive through Sedona ( a site to be viewed on its on at another time, we got their at 5:30 pm and had planned to have supper ) Eventually we arrived back at 8pm having a relaxing and memorable day

Der Flug War ein einzigartiges Erlebnis. 
Wunderschöne Aussicht auf alles was man sehen muss wenn man Richtung Grand Canyon fliegt. 

Der Sonnenuntergang War wunderschön. Wie bestellt. 
 
Und auch die Piloten waren heiße Feger.  :) :)

Although the view was awesome the flight was rough and half way through all passengers were feeling ill.The contract stated high wings & large windows for optimum viewing. Additionally it stated "window seat request $10 per seat". I requested this after reservations and was told decison would be day of. Day of I paid the extra money for 4 window seats. As it turns out the family of 5 on the plane with us paid nothing extra and they all has window seats because ALL seats were window seats! To make matters worse I had a seat that had the wing support right in front of my window. Also we were on a smaller plane with NO large windows. When I complained about the extra money it fell on deaf ears. No big deal about $40 but it's the point of it.

This tour was fab from start to finish!!! 
The breakfast and lunch they provided were absolutely lovely along with water all throughout the day. 
The airplane ride was fantastic and the pilot was sooooooo lovely!!
Antelope canyon felt rushed but it was still nice to see
The highlight of the day for us was the tour down the Colorado river which was simply stunning and Lauren our guide was amazing!!! 
Brilliant day would absolutely book this again and highly recommend the company - all staff from start to finish were SO nice and helpful too

Originally going to take the helicopter tour but changed our mind after seeing some of the review and glad we made the change. Airplane tour fly a lot high up for an overall stunning views and most important much more comfort seats. Recommend to go with early tour (we went for the first tour of the day) if possible that way it is less busy and guarantee a good view and lots of amazing pictures.

We had a wonderful day on the Scenic River Adventure. Our family loved the plane ride over the Canyon which gave us amazing views all the way up to Page.  The Antelope Canyon tour was worth the trip alone.  It was spectacular to see the formations, though we were a little rushed.  Our guide was focused on giving us tips for the best photos rather than much detail of the canyon.  While the photos are appreciated, a little more detail would have been nice.  The third part of the adventure, the raft ride, was an interesting and enjoyable way to see the Colorado close up.  This part of the trip could have been sped up a bit, but the guide was informative and views stunning.  There was a lot of downtime between each event which made the day a bit on the long side.  And be prepared for the long bus ride back to the South Rim.  We have two boys (10, 13) and all four of us say we would do the day again.

Flying is the only way. The whole experience was good. Dont worry about the trip to Boulder City to get the flight. It was reasonably short and the customer service was great on the buses and from the ground crew and pilots. Seeing the Grand Canyon doesn't need explanation. The way of doing it does. This outfit are good and know what they're doing.
My only negative is the amount of time at the Canyon. If you are not taking an additional flight in the Canyon it is about an hour too long, so you end up waiting for those who have. However, I would still recommend.

The Hoover Dam, Lake Mead, Mojave desert and Grand Canyon by air was spectacular, and we can only assume far better than trying to see far less of the same sights from the ground by bus or car. It was also fun to fly in a Cessna.

We actually got this on a $50 off per person promo, so it cost just about the same as the 8 hour bus trip from Las Vegas. Staff were friendly and professional, and the Boulder City airport was clean and modern. Highly recommended!

review_title: Fantastic trip and value for money
review_text: Unless you have the urge to go in a helicopter, I would suggest you take a plane flight over the South Rim of the Grand Canyon. Fantastic views and half the cost of the helicopter trips. Great service and a comfortable flight and some wonderful photos.

review_title: Great trip for reasonable amount of money
review_text: We enjoyed a wonderful trip with quite a bit of wind! It can get e a little rough during the ride;-) We loved the view from up there and are very happy we finally did the trip! A must see for adventurous people with a good stomach! We loved it!

review_title: Fantastic way to view the Grand Canyon
review_text: We spent a memorable hour flying in a small plane (be prepared for the odd bounce!). From start to finish the process was simple,welcoming and a pleasure. Staff were friendly and the audio interesting. Definitely recommended.

We get the very early morning flight and saw dawn rising over the amazing canyon and Hoover Dam. Flight was stunning and informative.
We then were bussed around in our own time i.e. you could go on each bus when you wanted. Bus stop 3 was our favourite when you could 'let the beauty of the canyon come to you.'
This was made extremely special by the two wonderful Canyon Rangers Marshall and Sol(Saul?) who led us on a walk and gave us lots of history and their love of the natives and the canyon.
Our sincere thanks to both of them.
For fun, don't miss stop 1 and meet Cowboy Steve doing Cowboy tricks.

My girlfriend always wanted to see the great canyon from above so we bite the bullet and did. Prices are very reasonable considering what your doing. We took off with a handful of other people and flew completely over the whole grand canyon. It was a breathtaking experience and should not be missed if you have the opportunity.

review_title: Lovely views and good day. Only wish it was longer!
review_text:
Toying between the coach tour and an air tour of some kind, we went on the Grand Canyon Connoisseur tour and I would recommend this tour above the coach tour any day. It takes a lot less time to get there and if you take the early tours you still have time in the day to do other stuff around Las Vegas. 

You do have to be ready 2 hours before your scheduled flight as they do a round up from all the hotels then put you on a bus to get to boulder city for the flight. If you are on the first am flight this can be very early! The tour takes you via a small propeller plane to the south rim and you get amazing views on the flight as you fly over the hoover dam, Lake mead and parts of the grand canyon itself. You also get to see the west rim including the skywalk. 

Once there you board a coach that takes you to the park which is about 15 mins. You stop at 2 spots which allows you about an hour free time each at of the 2 spots, them being bright angel lodge and mather point. You get provided a lunch but no choice for vegetarian options. It would be good if you put a request out as part of the booking process for dietary requirements. The driver is knowledgeable with a good sense of humour and provides some good info and places to take good photos from. 

Just wish there was more time and maybe another stop added to further enhance the experience. Yes it is more expensive than the coach tour but cheaper than a helicopter tour and you get good views and time at the park with half a day still remaining to do other stuff. All massive bonuses above the coach tour.

Preferi fazer o passeio pro Grand Canyon de avião do que de ônibus pra poder economizar tempo e chegar mais cedo de volta em Vegas. Excelente passeio. O avião é pequeno, mas show. E o Grand Canyon é um espetáculo a parte. Vale cada centavo. Tem várias atividades pra se fazer, escolha a sua preferida. SHOW !!!!

review_title: Amazing way to see the Canyon
review_text:
We booked our airplane tour online prior to travelling to America.  We arrived at the airstrip, checked in and waited for our plane in comfortable surroundings - it couldn't have been easier. 
Our flight was stunning - the views were awe-inspiring and the audio commentary was very informative.
A not to be missed trip at affordable prices.

Nous avons payé 175 dollars par personne pour découvrir  le lac Powell du ciel.
C'est cher mais nous ne l'avons pas regretté, car au point de vue du barrage même, on ne voit pas grand chose alors que les 45 minutes de vol en petit avion  de 10 places où chacun a un hublot, permettent de découvrir un site sublime avec les limites dentelées  des rives du lac, les couleurs ocres du relief , des eaux d'un bleu intense, le plateau du Colorado , la ville de Page et le barrage bien sûr : un grand moment !
Grand canyon airlines fait aussi le survol du Grand Canyon bien sur mais nous l'avons fait avec la compagnie concurrente West Wind

Un escursione da fare!!! Sorvolo del Gran Canyon con vista panoramica, atterraggio e visita a Eagle point e Guano point, quest'ultimo con panorama mozzafiato, il punto più bello di tutta l'escursione e il più bello x fare foto.

review_title: There is no better way to see the canyon!
review_text: OK, well, maybe a better way is to hike down to the bottom, or use a hang glider.  But for most of us, this is THE best way to go.  We rode in a 9-passenger plane for nearly an hour, at about 8,000 feed.  Everybody had a large window, and the canyon still completely filled the view.  The audio commentary wasn't much to listen to, just a bit of trivia and history.  But the flight was well worth the ticket price...and it was far less than you'll pay for any other airline ticket!  We will definitely do this again if we ever make it back to the Grand Canyon.

We booked the plane to the Grand Canyons in hopes of saving some time.

We were picked up from our hotel at 1030. After multiple stops on the strip and another shuttle transfer we arrived at the terminal around 1145. 

We then waited till about 1 to board our flight. 

The plane views were fantastic and provided pre recorded audio info on Hoover dam and canyon.

After landing we were transferred by bus to our viewing spots. We had a little over an hour at both spots. I felt this amount of time was sufficient with two young kids. 

Once back at the terminal we were asked to wait for less than 30 min. Not bad.

The bus ride back to hotel was again more than 1 hour itself. 

I realize issues with traffic, however they should have a better system for this portion of the trip. 

I feel with cost, the company should take care to upgrade their shuttle buses and employees! The buses looked so worn down, in my opinion that speaks volumes about the company. I did not feel the employees were prepared with guided information. Part of this adventure should be a guided information from employees. 

Part of the tour is the skywalk- not sure if this is very impressive. The glass on the bottom was not that clear and did not provide clear views.

Io e mio marito abbiamo prenotato il volo aereo sul gran canyon sulla strip a Las Vegas.
Ci sono venuti e prendere e riportati in hotel verso e dall'aeroporto di Boulder city.
Un Cessna da 8 posti con un bravissimo pilota, nonostante il vento, ci ha fatto sorvolare questa
meraviglia a bassa quota per 45 minuti circa. Nel nel ns viaggio California on the road non era previsto il gran canyon per la distanza e mancanza di tempo, invece: meraviglioso!
Assolutamente da non perdere!

We spent 3 full days at the GCNP over Christmas weekend and on the 3rd day it was perfectly sunny so we decided to go flying. We had been in a helicopter before and the people at the airline desk said the plane was cheaper and you'll get better views. Most people take the helicopter just for the ride but since we had been in a helicopter before we took the plane which had only 10 seats, each with their own window and it was a great way to see the canyon. The weather was clear, the flight was smooth and the views were amazing! We would definitely recommend seeing the GCNP this way. Flying in a plane is a lot cheaper than a helicopter too and its only 45 minutes so if you do it 1st thing in the day you have all day to explore by car.

The flight I took over the Grand Canyon was a fantastic experience. I would thoroughly recommend it. The plane trip was the cheapest option for seeing the canyon from the air. I was very happy with the experience and would recommend it to anyone who does not want to pay top dollar. As I did it do w helicopter flight, I can not compare it with this option. 
I was fortunate enought to sit up in the front next to the pilot. The plane I was in had only window seats so everyone should have had great views.

We went for the connoisseur package inc return transfer to Boulder Airport, return flight to the north rim, helicoper ride, coach to Bright Angel lookout point, packed lunch. It was expensive at $908 for the two uf us but it was a superb experience. 

We were blessed with a calm and sunny day (although bitterly cold) and there was some snow amongst the trees in certain places. The views from the plane and the helicopter were sensational.

I have wanted to visit the Grand Canyon for years and this was a dream that came true for me. No problems at all with the company and they delivered exactly as promised.

It was a real contrast seeing all this natural beauty before heading to the man-made Disneyland that is Las Vegas

We booked the Highlights Tour online, which offered 2 tours at discounted rates (saving 80 dollars per ticket - a saving for us of 320 dollars). The 9.00am tour meant a pick-up time of 6.30 at our hotel in Las Vegas, so we opted for the 3.00pm tour which had a pick-up time of 1.30. The 30-minute minibus ride out to the airfield in Boulder City was fast and comfortable. We were checked in immediately, and waited for about 45 minutes in the terminal building for our group to be called. The problem with booking the 3.00pm tour (the last tour of the day) is that if for any reason the plane gets delayed on its previous tour, there isn't much room for maneuver as daylight starts fading fast after 4.00pm. We were told at 3.00pm that the flight would be delayed by one hour and were offered an immediate full refund and return bus to Las Vegas or the option to rebook the tour. As it was the last day of our visit, we decided to chance it anyway as were told that we would see everything except the return 30 minutes of the tour. Unfortunately, the plane landed at 3.50pm, the obligatory photo with each passenger/couple/family still had to be taken with the pilot before boarding, and we then waited at the end of the runway for the returning planes to land before we could take off. We took off at 4.20 and the light was fading fast. It is a 70-minute round-trip, we actually got about 15 minutes of seeing the canyon before it was too dark to see anything. My advice would be don't book the 3.00pm Scenic Highlights Tour unless you have the possibility to rebook on another day - set the alarms and go for the 9.00 tour instead.

review_title: Amazing way to view the Grand Canyon!
review_text: My husband and I recently moved to the Phoenix area so everyone who visits usually wants to see the Grand Canyon!  So every time we have visitors we try out a different tour!  My parents came to visit and my mom wanted to go to the Grand Canyon but my dad has never really had the desire to go.  His mentality was "it's just a big hole I can look at pictures" so I really wanted to amaze him!  My husband and I had been before and did a day hike which was amazing but not something my parents would enjoy.  So I thought a plane ride would be perfect and I was definitely right!  Everyone had an amazing time and loved every minute of the ride!!  It's definitely pricey but worth every penny!  The tour was narrated and my dad is a history buff so it was perfect!  The pilot was absolutely amazing, the ride was so smooth!  I definitely recommend doing this at least once!!

Una experiencia que vale cada centavo!! Hicimos el Canyon River Adventure, y es indescriptible. Comenzamos muy temprano, sobrevolando el Gran Cañón, de allí a Antelope Canyon!! Excelente, el recorrido, el lugar... para terminar con el water float trip en el Río Colorado!! La guía  (Ashley) fue súper amable y se notaba que ama lo que hace. Vayan con ropa cómoda y fresca, ya que el agua es muy fría, pero llega a hacer muucho calor. Incluyen las comidas durante el viaje. Es caro, pero definitivamente lo repetiría!

review_title: Not the best use of time
review_text: We had a great time at the Canyon, but only wish, that out of a 9-hour tour, we could have had more than 1.5 hours at the Canyon itself. We were told to be ready at 4:40 for our hotel pick-up, and finally arrived at the air terminal around an hour later, after numerous hotel stops and one shuttle bus change. If we had driven our own rental car, we could have shaved about 35 minutes off that portion and gained another half-hour of much-needed sleep, LOL! The flight was beautiful, and we both got window seats. Note: the views and light in the morning are much nicer on the left side of the aircraft. Once at Grand Canyon airport, we were efficiently shuttled into a huge bus (very roomy, but about 3x bigger than our group of 15 actually needed). The driver was friendly and personable, and even went back to pick up stragglers from our first stop after delivering us to the second one. But, at 45 minutes for each of 2 stops, it was nowhere near enough time at the park. If we had flown back right away after driving back to the airport it would have been one thing, but we were made to wait about an hour and a half before our flight back -- which is time I would rather have spent at the park itself. To top it all off, we found it was the same tour we could have booked through Scenic for about a hundred dollars less; the only reason we booked through this company instead is that they actually explained the plane configuration and guaranteed one of us would get a window seat (Scenic told us it would be totally random whether we would get one or not).

La excursión al Gran Cañón del Colorado es una de la experiencias que uno siempre guardara en su memoria. Es por ello que nos desplazamos desde grandes distancia, en este caso desde España, para poder disfrutar de esta maravilla de la naturaleza. En nuestro caso escogimos la excursión más completa y más cara, con viaje en avioneta, helicóptero, barca por el río,....pero casi no tuvimos tiempo para poder ver lo que en realidad queríamos ver,.... las mejores vistas del Gran Cañón desde Guano Point. Es más no tuvimos tiempo ni para comer (incluido en el viaje) o tomar algo disfrutando de las vistas. En cambio estuvimos en el río (algo perfectamente prescindible desde mi punto de vista) dando vueltas y esperando a no se que. En definitiva una muy mala organización del tiempo !!!!
Les expresamos nuestro disgusto a los responsables de la empresa y eso sí, con gran amabilidad se disculparon e insistieron en devolver el importe de la comida (10 $ por persona) y regalar una foto........ Amables pero no conscientes de lo que hemos perdido en un viaje muy deseado y perfectamente mejor aprovechado. Es por ello que no lo califico como excelente que lo que en realidad se merecería

review_title: "So it's a little pricey ... but hey, you only live once!"
review_text:
This was the activity that I chose for mine and my husband's recent trip to Arizona - the 12 1/2 hour Scenic Canyon River Adventure that covered air, land and water. And if I don't say so myself, I chose well. 

Our excursion began at 6 am at the Grand Canyon Airport - less than a mile from The Grand Hotel where we were staying. At check-in we were weighed (this included anything we were carrying) and given a boxed breakfast (OJ, small yogurt, banana muffins, cheese stick and a granola bar). Color-coded wrist bands (green for our group) were affixed to our arm. At promptly 6:30 am approxiately 20 persons boarded the small aircraft with each one having their own window seat (we didn't have to pay extra for it). Take off was smooth (and uneventful) and after ten minutes or so the Canyon appeared in all of its splendor as the sun rose casting a myriad of colors - soft pinks, deep reds and warm golds wherever its rays touched ... simply breathtaking! There were headphones on the plane that provided info on the scenes unfolding below as the plane soared onward. A half hour into our flight the clear blue waters of Lake Powell emerged. All too soon we touched down (smoothly) on the other side of the Canyon in Page, AZ. 

After a fifteen minute wait at the small airport, our group was shuttled onto retro-fitted pick-up trucks for an often bumpy ride to Antelope Canyon where other tour groups were already gathered. I tend to be a bit claustrophobic so thankfully it wasn't very dark inside the narrow passageways. Light spilled from above creating some spectacular photo-op's. Upon reaching the end of the long tunnel we then turned around and retraced our steps back to where we started. Loaded back onto the pick-up's, we were then driven to the Colorado River Discovery building in Page, AZ.

It was another 30 or 45 minutes before several large coach buses pulled in front of the building. Dozens of people were assembled and wore a variety of colored coded wrist-bands. Each person was handed a boxed lunch (turkey sandwich, chips, chocolate chip cookies and an apple) as they boarded the buses. We were driven through a dark, 2-mile inclined tunnel that brought us down to the river basin at Glen Canyon Dam. Given hard-hats to wear as we were told it was mandatory due to its being a government run facility, we walked a short distance over to the large rafts. Each raft easily accommodated 18 - 20 people. My husband and I were fortunate to have been on the vessel led by Brett, an informative and often amusing guide who regaled us with many stories and folklore of the Colorado River. He also played a mean recorder! For fifteen miles we floated ever so slowly down the majestic river surrounded by massive stone walls that stretched upwards hundreds of feet. Twice Brett made two short stops where a few brave (or crazy) souls jumped into frigid 47 degree water and we trekked a short distance to spot ancient petroglyphs drawn on rock walls. Upon docking we were resorted according to wrist band colors and directed to the appropriate coach bus. Most, including myself, fell asleep during the two hour return trip back to the Grand Canyon Airport. 

To say that the entire excursion - plane, land and float was spectacular and incredibly humbling is an understatement. I highly recommend it! If you have the opportunity to take this tour, DO IT! It was money well spent for the experience of a life-time!

TIP: Wear a hat and bring and use plenty of sunscreen. The tour company provides water.

These Folk are very professional and adept at their tasks. The trip includes pick up and return from your LV accomodation and a bus trip out to Boulder City Airport. This trip in itself (approx 1 hour) was most interesting, climbing out of LV on a very busy motorway. The plane (a twin engined high wing Otter) was basic with each passenger (12) having individual windows, the Pilots were immediately in front of us and We could watch their every move. Beautiful sunny and hot day, the views and commentary were perfect and most memorable.
Well done GCA, a top flight organisation.

There were 8 of us aboard a small plane with one pilot, who did an admirable job ensuring a smooth ride and great views. The weather cooperated as well. We spent 40 minutes exactly from lift off to landing experiencing the wonder that is the Grand Canyon.

Se avete voglia di vedere il grand canyon da una prospettiva insolita ed affascinante allora non potete perdervi il tour in aereo. Nonostante la mia paura di volare il volo è stato tranquillo senza scossoni, nonostante fossimo in un Cessna caravan da soli 9 posti. Consigliatissimo!!!!!

review_title: great way to see the Canyon
review_text: Took late morning flight with Grand Canyon Airlines for 45 minutes sightseeing over the Canyon. Well run operation, easy friendly check in, good safety briefing from the copilot, very professionally flown, no cowboy turns and the smoothest landing! We were lucky with the weather, clear skies and almost no wind. Fantastic views out of huge vista windows and almost constant commentary ( could do without the dramatic music between comments) over individual headphones made it an interesting flight. I do like the idea that the commentary is recorded and the pilot is concentrating on flying the aeroplane! Well worth the money.

review_title: An expensive way to see the Canyon
review_text: This is not meant to be a negative review. The service is very well organized and operated. The flight is professional and if the weather allows smooth. However the visit to the Grand Canyon can be disappointing as you visit briefly to 2 viewpoints. If very limited time then this is a convenient option.

Booked this one on line, turned up, checked in and went for the 45 minute flight. The aircraft was a modern Cessna Caravan and affored great views of the canyon. The audio commentary was good and informative. 
Calm and clear on the day we went so good for those who worry about flying, one of our group was a very nervous flier but she loved it and said she felt very safe throughout.
Would certainly recommend this trip and was excellent value for money.

Посмотреть Гранд Каньон - вот была наша американская мечта! Ну а посмотреть на него с высоты птичьего полёта - это еще лучше! За скромную по американским меркам сумму 159 долларов с человека вы пролетите на сессне караван или аналогичном маленьком самолётике над лесами, скалами, каньонами, рекой Колорадо и другими примечательными местами национального парка. Билеты нужно покупать заранее по интернету, выбирайте самое раннее или самое позднее время полёта, так как днём слишком жёсткое солнце не позволит сделать хорошие снимки. В самолёте лучше садиться по левому борту - так больше увидите. Всего полёт длится 45-50 минут. Иногда маленькое воздушное судно слегка потряхивает - кто не в ладах со своим вестибулярным аппаратом, будьте к этому морально готовы. Впрочем, первые 40 минут полёта об этом не было и речи - настолько увлекательно было смотреть в иллюминатор и фотографировать!

At just over a thousand dollars for 2 for the day, it was packed full of adventure!  Flight from Vegas to the canyon, then into a helicopter to the bottom of the canyon.  Hop into a pontoon boat for a short ride along the Colorado river at the base of the Canyon, then the return trip to the top.  Hop on a coach and go to Eagles Point for the best photo opportunities (forget the Skywalk-total ripoff as you cannot take your camera with you)  but you can pay for a photo!  Then to the next point for lunch, more great shots...everywhere you look!
total day -9 hours

review_title: Esperienza unica vs. paura di volare
review_text: Non ho paura di volare quindi quando mi è capitata l'occasione di sorvolare il Grand Canyon su questi piccoli aeroplani non ho esistato nemmeno un attimo e ho subito accettato. Diciamo che i vuoti d'aria si sentono veramente tanto però guardare giù e vedere il panorama che regala il Grand Canyon secondo me fa passare la paura. Dei nostri compagni di viaggio erano titubanti perchè avevano paura di star male lassù, ma una volta scesi, anche se hanno detto di aver patito parecchio sono stati contenti di averlo fatto. Il tracciato del fiume Colorado lo si può vedere solo dall'alto perchè dal South Rim o dal North Rim resta coperto dalla roccia. Io sono stata contentissima di averlo fatto.

My friend and I book a "Canyon Connoisseur with Pink Jeep" package from Scenic Airlines. According to their website, it should have been a 9.5 hour tour between hotel pickup and drop off; it was actually 8.5. I would have liked a little more time at the Grand Canyon, but other than that I have no complaints. We were actually pretty tired from a late night and then getting up early for the tour, so we were ready to head back to our hotel for a nap anyway.

We were picked up right on time, the little plane was great (big windows, you can see in the cockpit a little) and our pilots were very personable. Not a super view of the Hoover Dam (it looks so small from the air) but the views of the terrain were phenomenal. The pink jeep tour is through another company, and it was also excellent. My friend and I got lucky and had a jeep all to ourselves. Our guide was fantastic, and a jeep lets you go to lookout spots that buses aren't allowed to stop at. We weren't particularly interested in the IMAX tour at the end, but actually it was pretty neat (and only about 30 minutes long). The packaged breakfast/lunch was good too - lots of little things to snack on.

This was the highlight of our trip and I will definitely be recommending this package to friends.

review_title: Value for money and oh what views.
review_text:
While planning our trip to the Grand Canyon,we felt this flight would be a highlight of the time there. We were not wrong - it is well worth adding this tour to your schedule. Grand Canyon Airlines offers an excellent experience with 9 and19 seater planes with every seat offering fantastic views. We went on a 9 seater , with 4 English people and 4 Belgians , and there were headsets for everyone with the relevant languages piped through so you had a running guide.
Excellent trip , value for money , and a friendly pilot.

review_title: A Memorable Experience That Everyone Can Participate IN
review_text:
If you are planning a trip to Grand Canyon, add this tour to your itinerary. Grand Canyon Air Tours offers a Smooth Water Bus Trip that is just amazing.  The tour bus picked me up at a local lodge inside the Grand Canyon Village.  The bus driver, Gee Gee was just wonderful!  She was very informative and personable.  Movies about the Grand Canyon were shown during the bus trip which really educates vacationers on the area. Upon arriving at Colorado River Discovery we were greeted and given instructions about the trip to the docking area. Great bunch of people! Our guide, Brent, was AMAZING! He was very informative, engaging with all the guests and an all-around great guy.   And, an added attraction was he also played the Indian Flute a few times during our tour. 
The tour is so very nice and relaxing. Glen Canyon is just beautiful. We saw wild mustangs, petroglyphs and amazing scenery.  I’m so glad that I took this trip! I may just do it again!

review_title: DO NOT DO THIS TOUR, SCENIC AIRLINES ARE LIERS
review_text:
I know this is a lot BUT PLEASE READ BEFORE BOOKING THIS TOUR!  
I booked this tour for two people at a cost of $646.00 bucks the Thursday before the trip.  I spent over an hour on the phone getting all the details about this 1 hour trip.  At no point did the booking Agent tell me there was a $100.00 up charge for any person weighing over 300lbs while holding all the gear (i.e. cloths, water, camera, food, bag) they are taking on the plane.  I received my Reservation Confirmation by email shortly after I booked, great no problem.  The next day without as much as a phone call I got a new reservation by email with a $100.00 “Comfort Seat” charge.  So I called the number on the new reservation, and asked what a “Comfort Seat” charge was.  The girl (Aliett Chavez) I spoke with said it was because I entered a weight of 310lbs when I first booked it.  I then when on to say if I have to pay an extra $100 dollars for my weight I want to cancel the trip. She then asked me to hold came back and said she would waive the fee.  She then stated “I don’t know why they put that on there”, and she said she was sending me a new reservation with that charge (which she did) removed.  Upon arrival at 5:45am, 45 minutes before the flight leaves they put you on a scale in front of everyone and let you know you’re over 300lbs and you have to pay the “COMFORT SEAT“ charge, SO HUMILIATING.  Let me clear the air now for anyone wondering, THERE’S NO SUCH THING AS A “COMFORT SEAT” on this plane.  This is their PC way of charging more money for overweight people.  They claim it’s a “Weight distribution issue” but I can assure you that’s not the reason in this case.  Our tour had 3 empty seats which were on the opposite side of the plane that I was sitting on; if it’s a “Weight distribution issue” wouldn’t the empty seats be on MY side???? I would say the tour was not fully booked, and I couldn’t cancel because it was within 24 hour departure time, and there’s NO REFUNDS, and they know that.
Upon arrival the Captain explains the tour is going to be an hour.  He then goes on to say because of some agreement with the Grand Canyon National Park we can’t fly directly to the GC.  Even though the airport is ONLY 8 miles directly south of the rim.  He says we have to travel for less than 10 minutes due east before dropping into the canyon.  Now I timed the due east time and it was almost 20 minutes before we reached the rim.  We went about 20 miles east then the 8 miles north to get to the south rim.  Once over the GC we only spend about 15 minutes on our way to Glenn Canyon and Lake Powell which is where we spent most of the flight time before landing in Page AZ.  The main reason I would not recommend doing this trip is because its focus is Glenn Canyon and Lake Powell, NOT the Grand Canyon.  It’s almost like they are flying through the GC as a short cut to get to Glenn Canyon & Page AZ.  Let me just say Glenn Canyon is EXTREMELY BORING compared to the Grand Canyon, almost to the point of a letdown.  You would be much better off paying a little more for the helicopter rides which focus ONLY on the Grand Canyon, which I would have done on the spot the morning of but as you know I would have lost my full fare.  Please do yourself a favor and save you money on the Scenic Airlines Company.  I hope this helps???

Très bonne journée bien remplie, trop peut être: il est difficile de garder les yeux ouverts dans le bus sur le retour
Départ à l aube en avion, survol du grand canyon avec audio en français pour atterrissage à page en bordure du lac Powell
Visite GENIALE de antilope canyon avec un guide par petit groupe, avant que la foule arrivdescente pépère de glenn canyon en bateau : un peu long mais très joli, guide sympa même si il semble que son principale intérêt soit de deviner des formes dans les roches...
Retour en bus avec aussi un chauffeur/guide très intéressant
Repas compris et très correct

This tour is definitely an experience worth spending on.
We took the grand voyager tour for the afternoon.  The airport pick up, airplane ride, helicopter ride, cruise on the Colorado river and the meal were all done smoothly and were a great experience.
The tour starts with a hotel pick up by bus, transfer to a 15 seater plane at boulder city airport, transfer to a helicopter at the Grand canyon airport, taking the helicopter over the canyon and into it, landing near the river, transfer to a small pontoon type boat, a very short boat cruise, back to the helicopter, getting off at the canyon airport and transferring to a bus for a tour of the canyon. The bus has two stops one of which is at the sky walk. We skipped this stop and got down at the second stop Guano point as you can hike around a bit and also the food here is better. We got a decent vegetarian meal.
There are lots of good photo op moments through out the tour.
Experiencing a small plane ride, helicopter ride and a boat cruise in the Colorado within a span of a few hours makes this tour worth spending the money.
The small plane ride felt a bit rough compared to the big planes we are used to but the view of the Hoover dam, the take off and landing are in fact quite smooth. There are chances of nausea due to altitude for some people as the cabin is not the pressurized kind. There are excellent photo opportunities from the flight.

Nonostante la mia paura di volare, ho voluto fare contento mio marito e mi sono decisa a prenotare questa escursione. E' stata davvero una giornata indimenticabile e tutto è andato benissimo!  La nostra escursione prevedeva volo da las vegas al grand canyon con l'aereo, discesa sul fondo del canyon in elicottero e risalita del colorado in barca. Risalita in elicottero e visita allo skywalk, pranzo leggero e ritorno a las vegas in aereo. Devo dire che è stata davvero la cosa più emozionante che abbia mai fatto! Al ritorno purtroppo c'era un po' di vento e l'aereo ballava parecchio,(si tratta di piccoli aerei..max 18 posti) ma il comandante ci ha rassicurato ed è andato tutto bene. Personalmente consiglio a tutti di provarlo...per noi è stata un'esperienza unica! Indimenticabile!

Nous etions tout excités de découvrir le grand canyon : le bus est passé à notre hotel à l'heure, puis nous nous sommes dirigés vers un autre bus plus grand, ou la conductrice était aussi sympa qu'une porte de prison…
Arrivés à l'aéroport, nous apprenons que notre tour est annulé et qu'il faut en choisir un autre bien plus court que celui pour lequel j'avais payé !! (J'ai quand même eu un remboursement de 90$…) imaginez la déception…
L'avion, en lui même très bien, avec le pilote beaucoup moins !! On se serait cru dans space mountain avec tous les hauts le coeur qu'on a eu…40mn de vol qui ont bien failli finir la tete dans le sac…
Et la visite, l'avion survole autour du grand canyon 2min mais jamais on ne rentre dedans, on nous pose dans un bus a touriste déjà rempli avec une heure de retour obligatoire…
On nous promet un repas complet qui est juste à vomir, servis dans des plateaux de prisonniers…
On a eu 2 pauvres sites pour prendre des photos, bien loin du programme idyllique annoncé, 3 photos en bord de falaise et merci rentrons à l'hotel…

Bref, on attendait cette experience avec impatience, on a des photos pas trop mal, mais on ne refera pas ce tour avec eux, sûrement pas !

We went for the Grand Celebration (PLW4) tour last week.  This picked us up in a limo, flew from Las Vegas airport to the canyon where we landed for 30 mins (having some champagne and a small snack) before flying back and being dropped off again by limo to our hotel on the strip.

It was quite expensive but definitely worth it!  The whole experience was very professional and was well organised.  Pilot (Andrew) was well informed on the whole area, giving us a commentary of the surroundings during the flight whilst also allowing us to soak in the experience.  Landing and waking around in the canyon right next door to the Colorado river was amazing, and the route there flew over the Hoover dam and the Lake Mead.

Just one recommendation - do not forget to confirm your booking at least 24 hrs prior to flying (it states this on the ticket but I nearly forgot!)

Also, this was one of the only tour operators which did NOT charge a fuel supplement - something a lot of the others charged (others charged something ridiculous as $50 each- check for yourself though in case this changes in the future!).  We had nothing at all extra to pay which is the way I like it!

All in all, the best trip we took all holiday!

We took the Grand Discovery Air Tour, a 45 minute narrated run (in a number of languages) round the Grand Canyon. Went over both the North and South rims in an anti clockwise direction. 
Seating is three across (two and one), all seats have good views. Parts of the aircraft can get in the pictures. Plane takes 20 passengers at a time.
Took the 8am flight as can get bumpy as it gets warmer during the day. 
Check in good and didn't have to wait long for flight. 
Even though we were on an early flight it was very bumpy on take-off and especially on landing. It was quite stuffy as there appeared to be no air circulating through the cabin. Sick-bags were provided and were needed by approximately half the passengers on board especially after that landing which was very bumpy. Bin next to where the aircraft taxied to full of used sick-bags so obviously a common theme.
But great views from the aircraft when you weren't being sick.

Siamo saliti su questo aeroplano con le gambe che tremavano per la paura e ne siamo scesi con le gambe che ancora tremavano...ma ne è valsa la pena. Dall'alto abbiamo potuto ammirare una meraviglia della natura in tutto il suo splendore! Sconsigliato se si ha paura di volare e a chi soffre di nausea. Per il resto tutto fantastico!!

We booked a scenic flight package that included a trip to Antelope Canyon and a smooth water float down the Colorado River in Glen Canyon. It was a really neat day! We were able to see a lot in one day. But, it was a very long day. The total tour/day was about 12 hours or so. But, it was worth it! I would recommend booking a trip through the company. 

My only tip, if you book a package with them be sure to do research on the other tours in the trip package. Scenic Airlines only gave the flight and then we were driven to the other locations/companies in charge of the two other tours. For example: if you book the same package as us, be sure to dress for the river trip. We stopped on the beach and were able to swim in the river if you wanted. If we had known, we could have packed swimsuits/sandals etc. 

But, overall a great company. The staff and pilots were very nice and everyone seemed to be concerned that we had an amazing day!

Abbiamo sorvolato il lago Powell per circa 30 minuti. Un'esperienza bellissima su piper comodissimi. In pratica 4 finestrini per parte in modo tale che tutte le persone potevano avere la possibilità di vedere fuori il panorama , inoltre sia il chek-in che l'imbarco sono stati velocissimi. Come organizzazione non posso dire niente e anche il costo di 175 dollari a persona è accettabile.

The views are superb, and the ride was relatively smooth.  The landing upon return was so easy I didn't even know we were back on the ground.  

Those are pluses, but there was one huge minus which so negatively impacted the trip for my daughter and me as to threaten to ruin it, as it did for sure for the young woman in the seat ahead of me, and probably others as well.

This big minus would be as follows:  despite the following description on the Grand Canyon Airlines web page, "The passenger cabin is climate controlled with heat and air conditioning to allow for the most comfortable ride," the cabin of our plane was NOT air conditioned, on a one hundred degree day in late August.  

In fact, the cabin started out very, very warm, continued to grow warmer still, and by the time our tour was up, it was unbearably stuffy and hot.

This made for one heck of an uncomfortable three quarters of an hour, with the view below taking second fiddle to faintness from the heat.  Any suggestion of airsickness was amplified by the oppressive atmosphere of the plane's cabin.  A cool flow of air would have made all the difference in the world.

As we walked from the plane to the building I asked one of the pilots why there had been no air conditioning.  He immediately said, "Because it wasn’t working."  

He then quickly collected himself and said, "We do run the air conditioning, but it can only reduce the temperature a certain amount."  Ah yes, I think, from his lips, the truth came first, and caution followed.

I told him that in my opinion it was not flying that had made people sick on his plane, but the heat.  Airsickness bags may be a necessary convenience, but how much better not to have to use them, especially on a flight that is so expensive and has been so eagerly anticipated by the sufferers, who now find themselves too ill to enjoy it.

I would have loved to be able to say this was a wonderful experience, but the heat and stuffiness in the cabin was literally sickening.  Any discomfort from the motion of the plane would easily have been counterbalanced by a flow of fresh, cool air, of which there was none.

I was very disappointed to have my daughter's and my experience--as well as that of the others on our plane--negatively impacted by an equipment malfunction which was never acknowledged, for which we received no apology, and certainly no suggestion of a voucher or even a partial refund.

Fizemos um passeio de avião saindo do aeroporto em Tusayan e sobrevoamos o Grand Canyon. Foi maravilhoso. Chegamos em Page e dali seguimos por terra para Antelope Canyon. Por fim, embarcamos em um bote flutuador (com motor) e seguimos pelo Rio Colorado até "Lee's Ferry", de onde voltamos de ônibus até o aeroporto. 
Os pontos negativos são: 
1- O passeio pelo rio é bonito mas longo demais.
2- Na volta, o ônibus para em um restaurante em Cameron. A guia estava muito apressada e mal deu tempo de ir ao banheiro e comer alguma coisa. 
O restante foi muito bom. Uma experiência maravilhosa.
Trato excelente y buena organización. Merece la pena a pesar de que no es barato. El avión está muy bien preparado y los 40 minutos que dura el vuelo son muy entretenidos.

Fiz o trajeto até o south rim no grand canyon ! altamente recomendado ! dura 1 dia inteiro, e vale totalmente a pena, cada centavo, vistas espetaculares, o voo no avião é bem seguro, conta com sistema de som individual. O passeio de helicoptero sobre o grand canyon foi épico !

review_title: Non siamo neanche partiti. Nessun piano B
review_text:
Puntata a Las Vegas esclusivamente per questo trip aereo prenotato (e pagato) con tre mesi di anticipo. Sveglia alle 6.00. Alle 6.30 passa all'Hotel un pulmino che carica solo i prenotati per elicottero. Dopo 10 minuti ritorna dicendo che si era sbagliato e ci carica (prima indicazione di dilettantismo). Vengono annunciati 20 minuti di marcia. In realtà diventano un'ora. Al terminal regna il caos (seconda indicazione di dilettantismo). Ci danno un adesivo colorato da apporre sul petto. La mia famiglia viene raggruppata con alcuni turisti orientali. Partono tutti i gruppi. Rimaniamo desolatamente soli e ci viene annunciato che l'aereo ha dei problemi tecnici. Nessun aereo di riserva. Nessuna alternativa se non un tour limitato in elicottero, ma nel pomeriggio. Nessuna possibilità per il giorno successivo. Richiedo il rimborso, che verrà effettuato entro tre giorni a mezzo bonifico. Offrono ad ogni membro un buono per un drink al bar del terminal. La sensazione è di una compagnia non molto professionale. Se questa è l'organizzazione, caratterizzata dalla mancanza di piani alternativi (a fronte di una clientela internazionale), è naturale chiedersi come possa essere l'efficienza di autovelivoli e piloti.
Da notare che questi signori esigono dalla clientela la massima precisione, come ad esempio chiamare telefonicamente (non basta una mail) il giorno prima per confermare, pena la cancellazione del volo. E poi ti pesano per vedere se superi la soglia per un supplemento di costo...

review_title: La meilleure façon de voir la grandeur du grand canyon
review_text:
Nous avons fait le tour de 45min depuis le South Rim, dans un avion qui peut accueillir jusqu'à 18 personnes: 6 rangées de 3 donc on peut se trouver au milieu mais on voit quand même tout très bien. On est placé en fonction de son poids sur un des 3 sièges.
Nous en gardons des magnifiques photos comme souvenir.
Et pourtant nous avons eu partiellement de la pluie et le ciel était en grand parti couvert de nuages. Le vol à failli être annulé pour risque d'orages.
Nous avions le vol de 14h et a 11h le ciel était tout bleu. Cela montre avec quelle rapidité le temps peut changer ici!
La prestation vaut largement son prix et on vient ici une fois dans sa vie, donc il faut en profiter.

review_title: Wow- what a nice way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: The planes are great with huge windows. With 3 in a row, everybody gets to see everything. The whole process of buying the tickets, "check in", boarding is super fast and efficient, you will not loose a lot of time and the flights are on time. The pilots are nice and fun. But most of all, 40 minutes of flying above the Canyon is absutely fabulous and unforgettable, We wanted to the get the helicopter tour but it was sold out. I guess however that the regular airplanes are at least as good - and a little cheaper.

Im Rahmen einer grösseren Tour flogen wir zum Sonnenaufgang vom Grand Canyon Airport nach Page. Dieser Flug dauert rund eine Stunde.

Die Grand Canyon Airlines setzt spezielle 2-motorige Hochdecker namens "Vistaliner" der Firma De Havilland ein. Der Name kommt daher, dass das Flugzeug nur Fensterplätze mit ausgezeichneter Sicht an grossen Fenstern bietet - und auch nur 17.

Der Flug entlang des Canyons wird von Kommentaren auf Band (via Kopfhörer in der gewünschten Sprache) begleitet. Diese sind ausgezeichnet redigiert und technisch perfekt (auch in perfektem Deutsch) aufgenommen.

Ein Erlebnis!

Noch ein kleiner Hinweis: Jeder Passagier wird vor dem Boarding und dem Ausstellen der Boarding Card mit Platz am Check-In-Schalter automatisch gewogen, damit später das Flugzeug schön austariert ist.

From the flight over The Grand Canyon,  to the jeep trip to Antelope Canyon, to the raft trip down Glen Canyon,  the whole experience was amazing. Our guides were friendly and well informed and the day ran really smoothly. Highly recommended.

review_title: Soaring at a Gentle Pace Over the Canyon
review_text:
We took the air tour on the STOL (short take off and landing) aircraft and were not disappointed.  We did the Grand Discovery Air Tour, a 45 minute narrated run about the Canyon that was just right. We saw immense parts of the Canyon, including the North Rim, from such a wonderful vantage point and without the crowds that swarm over the South Rim.  It was a real treat! 

Note on seating: the rows are two-by-two on the right side of the plane, but single seats on the left. We did not have advance reservations so we had what was available, which meant my boyfriend and I did not get to sit together.  I was not happy about this as the agent did not inform us of the seating arrangements when we purchased the tickets.  We naturally assumed the seats were together.  The company needs to stress to agents that they be clear about the seating so passengers know what to expect.  Hence I was frowning when they took the official photo of us just before boarding!  It worked out o.k., since we were behind each other and we both had window seats this way, but we should have been informed of the seating and choices on other flights. 

All in all, a great ride.  The plane only goes 100 mph, and it's altitude is low for sight-seeing, so you really get a great view and great ride.  The Colorado River is up pretty close that way, you can even see the rapids!

A great way to see the Canyon.  Thumbs up!

review_title: Bus Tour from Las Vargas ,national Park parking
review_text: The Buses are available of A.c. coat he's of two By to to Take you to round tour from to.These buses halts at all visitor points to take you to nearest attraction of cannon beauty and attractions.You will get rest room and other needs like foods at subside rates.We took water and other beverages for summer heat.The tour was so attractive that other missed places of great nature thrust of visiting has been in mind.

If you want to see the Grand Canyon from every possible angle, you must take this tour. Is worth every penny, plus guides are excellent. From the plane to the antelope to the raft, it was incredible. Our raft guide Brent was excellent. Full of energy, lots of info, funny, the guy knew his stuff. Thanks for this amazing experience.

I gave this 3 stars because if it weren't for my crying 1.5 year old, my screaming 3 year old and my vomiting 7 year old, it would have been great.  Oddly my 5 year old was cool as a cucumber.  We visited the weekend before the 4th of July and there were high wind advisories for the weekend.  I should have known better but my husband really wanted to go.  There was a lot of turbulence.  But if you can get over the turbulence the views were amazing!  The pilot did tell us, after we safely landed, that in the morning there is less wind.  We rode on the Vistaliner.  It had two seats on one side and and one seat on the other.  They offer headphones that are noise canceling and have a narration.  Windows were very large to take in the beautiful view.  You take your photo with the pilot before take off which is available for purchase after the flight for $20.  If we go again we are going to take the first flight in the morning!

We were a party of 3 and did the 45 mins plane flight from the South Rim. The plane was smaller than advertised as we had been told it was 3 seats across, (two plus one) however the plane we flew on had only one seat at each side so everyone had a window. The upside - everyone had a window, the downside, the windows were not as large as those shown on the website pictures.

In all though it was a great experience and I would consider this a must do if you are in the area. Great views, nothing like you will see from the rim. There were headphones and narration to highlight areas on interest.

Grand Canyon Airlines do a great job of a 40 minute flight over the Canyon. Booking is easy online, can pay with creditcard, make a phonecall to reconfirm your flight, and Bingo! We booked on the same day we flew. 

Pretty bumpy ride, did not bother us, easy opportunity to take glorious pictures, just switch off your flash and put focus on manual to infinite. Advantage over helicopter flight is that this takes longer and everybody has a window seat - and it is cheaper!
