The tour was the right balance of laid back and very organised (none of that hassled 'herded' feeling - and you didn't feel that they were continuously pushing you into over priced gift shops). I felt that we were given the opportunity to get a real flavour of the area - and the guides were very informative (some passengers took a free shuttle bus to see yet more viewing points - and were given the information to do so by Rick, the guide).

We managed to book the tour via a travel agent in the Planet Hollywood hotel - a kiosk right in the Miracle Mile shopping centre (just as you go through from the casino into the shopping centre).

(p.s. We managed to see plenty of wildlife at the Canyon - deer, wild pigs and chipmunks, and there were some nice gift shopping opportunities - but this was in no way shoved down your throat). We also managed to get a very nice evening meal from the Arizona Lodge amd a delicious breakfast from the Bright Angel hotel. The beers in the Bright Angel hotel were also very good... we sampled a few "Fat Tires" during our evening stay ;-)

We recently visited the Grand Canyon as our intended highlight on a three week USA West Coast trip. We researched Grand Canyon tours as thoroughly as possible, reading trip advisor, asking people etc. 

We opted for flying to the Grand Canyon for a South Rim Connoisseur tour with Scenic Airlines which advertised extended viewing for about two or three  hours-enough time to enjoy a meal, shops, see the Imax movie and ample time to explore the canyon! 

We booked online-for a dawn pickup-it said our booking was successful and that that time was available. NO E-ticket arrived within 48 hours as stated so we rang up and were told a confirmation number was fine. 

IN Las Vegas we realised that our time had been changed to a pickup at 11.40 for a 1.15 flight. We were then told that times are not guaranteed on the net!

We were picked up for our hotel-spent an hour waiting at Boulder airport before leaving with others -with same tour and other tour labels in all sorts of colours. On arrival at Canyon we were all on same bus-dropped off helicopter people who were then  all mixed up again with other tours for a helicopter ride. Fuel surcharge of $25 each for lightweights a ripoff. 

Meanwhile we were taken to a 45 minute Imax movie (meanwhile the real thing we want to see is there) .After that  we sat on the bus for about 50 minutes to wait for the last of the helicopter people to arrive back. 

We later discovered that we could have been driven to the Mather Point or another point to have a view but the driver felt we had to wait til all copter people had come back. A 30-40 minute look at Mather Point with a lot of people and then a brief 15 minute look from Bright Angel Point at about 6 pm at night. Had to take photos in a hurry before dark. Dark on thje way back and Japanese people got no view to match their commentary which had not been available on way up. Several of us were not happy at all-have asked for at least a partial refund with no success. 

Scenic even asked the driver to extend the tour -impossible to consider doing effectively in the dark. 

We felt like we were bandaids just to make up numbers for a tour that cost us $600 plus Aust  dollars. Scenic Airlines wasted at least two hours of our precious time-just waiting for things to happen. 
We came home disappointed with little feeling that we had even seen the Canyon-it would have been fine if no wasted time. 

.

Aviso de antemano que ésta es una crítica muy detallada, por lo que puede resultar un poco pesada de leer, pero si buscar información para contratar una excursión en avioneta al Gran Cañón, con descenso en helicóptero, paseo en barca y comida, yo que tú no me perdería detalle ;)

Considerando tanto las críticas buenas como las malas, y después de comparar precios con todos los operadores de excursiones al Gran Cañón desde Las Vegas, me decidí por contratar con Scenic Airlines su "Grand Voyager Tour" (http://www.scenic.com/saws1gc_grand_voyager.htm). 

Lo contraté con 1 mes de antelación desde su propia página web. En principio íbamos a ir 3 personas, y fue para los que reservé el viaje. Al tipo de cambio vigente en el momento de la compra (Junio 2008), las 3 personas salieron por 957$ = 616€, lo que son 205€ por persona, a lo que hay que sumar 20$ por persona en concepto de suplemento por combustible a pagar en destino. A los pocos minutos de realizar la compra recibes un correo electrónico con los detalles del pedido, y a las 24h aproximadamente envían el "e-ticket" con el número de confirmación, la hora y el lugar donde pasan a recogerte.

Destacar que el hecho de contratar en su web supone un ahorro mínimo aproximado de un 30% con respecto a los precios que ofrecen las mayoristas de viajes. Por ejemplo, Catai Tours ofrece esta excursión con Papillon Grand Canyon Helicopters por 302€ (página 21 folleto Estados Unidos y Canadá marzo 2007/marzo 2008)

Scenic deja clarísimo en su web y en los mails que envían tras la reserva, que es de vital importancia llamar el día antes del viaje a la central de reservas (número gratuito) para confirmar que por condiciones climáticas no se haya cancelado la excursión, la asistencia de los pasarejos y la hora y lugar de recogida el Las Vegas. Yo había solicitado hacer la excursión a primera hora de la mañana, de 6-8, para ver amanecer en el Gran Cañón, pero ya en el mail de confirmación me notificaron que nos recogerían a las 12:45pm para salir de Boulder City en avioneta al Gran Cañón a las 2:00pm. Ok, madrugón que nos ahorramos, cosa que nos vino genial para descansar de la paliza de ver hoteles la tarde/noche anterior. De no haberme convencido la hora, podía haber cancelado el viaje con la devolución del 100% del importe cobrado.

Por motivos laborales, uno de mis amigos tuvo que cambiar de planes en pleno viaje y no iba a poder llegar con nosotros a Las Vegas. Inmediatamente me puse en contacto con Scenic para cancelar la reserva de 1 de los 3 pasajeros que íbamos a ser. Tienen al menos una operadora que habla castellano. Aunque no sea la alegrái de la huerta, precisamente, fue muy profesional y resolvió todas mis dudas. Me dijeron que tardarían entre 2 y 3 semanas en realizar la devolución (reintegro en tarjeta de crédito), pero en vez de devolver el 100% descontaron 40$ en concepto de suplemento por carburante, 20$ por cada uno de los 2 pasajeros que sí íbamos a viajar. Como ya sabía que nos lo cobrarían al hacer el check-in, aceptamos sin problemas. Al cumplirse las 2 semanas comprobé que ya me habían hecho el reintegro en la tarjeta de crédito del importe indicado.

Ya en Las Vegas, un día antes de la excursión, llamé a Scenic para confirmar. Todo perfecto, pasajeros, horarios y excursión.

Nosotros nos alojamos en el Luxor Hotel & Casino, en el extremo sur de Las Vegas Blvd ("The Strip"). Como la furgoneta recorre de N-S el Strip recogiendo a los pasajeros en sus respectivos hoteles, cuanto más al sur estés, más tarde pasaran a recogerte, y menos tiempo pasarás en la furgoneta. Luxor y Excalibur fueron los 2 últimos hoteles de la ruta. De ahí al aeropuerto de donde sale la avioneta hay unos 35m, ya que salen desde el de Boulder City, no desde McCarran (el internacional que está frente al Luxor). 

Es curioso que la furgoneta que nos recogió tuviera la serigrafía de Papillon (http://www.papillon.com/) teóricamente competencia de Scenic. A la llegada a la terminal del aeropuerto de Boulder City, hicimos check-in. Allí pesan a los pasajeros que no facilitaron su peso (en libras) al hacer la reserva por internet. Según la excursión que hayas contratado te ponen una pegatina de un tipo y color u otro. Así van llamando a la gente por grupos según su pegatina para embarcar en distintas avionetas. Te recomiendan comprar agua en la tienda de recuerdos (ojo, está cara, pero fresca).

Con respecto a la seguridad, comentaros que en el check-in nos comentaron que debido a las altas temperaturas registradas en el interior del cañón, rondando los 45ºC, existía la posibilidad de que se cancelara el descenso en helicóptero, y por extensión el paseo en barca, debido a que a partir de los 46ºC los helicópteros no despegan por motivos de seguridad. Nos ofrecieron cancelar la excursión sin ningún costo, cambiar la excursión por otra sin helicóptero (con Skywalk y/o con visitas en autobus) o esperar a ver si se cancelaba o no, en cuyo caso nos devolverían un porcentaje del viaje. Hay una chica que habla castellano, por lo que el idioma no es problema. Informados, y firmado un documento donde nos dábamos por enterados, decidimos arriesgarnos y dejarlo como estaba, con tan buena suerte que cuando aterrizamos en el west rim vimos helicópteros despegando sin problemas.

El vuelo en avioneta fue bastante bueno. El aparato es un De Havilland Twin Otters DHC-6 (http://www.scenic.com/saws1twinotter.htm). Antes de embarcar hacen fotos a todos los pasajeros por grupos con el capitán. Sientan a los pasajeros por grupos y pesos. Según las nacionalidades de los mismos, ponen narraciones para escuchar durante el vuelo con unos cascos con selección de canales (para seleccionar el idioma) y el volúmen.

Las vistas sobre el lago Mead y la presa Hoover son impresionantes. Los juegos de sombras sobre el desierto de Mohave son espectaculares. Nada más aterrizar separan a la gente por grupos, según la peganita que lleven, y a los del helicóptero les ponen un video de seguridad para el vuelo. Los helicópteros son de "Papillon Grand Canyon Helicopters" con 6 plazas (3+3 enfrentadas) +1 delante junto al piloto. Como íbamos 8 personas para la excursión con helicóptero y barco, primero despegó uno con 6 personas y luego otro con 2, con tan buena suerte de que esas dos fuimos mi amigo y yo. Un helicóptero para nosotros solos. Fue una auténtica pasada y no da nada de impresión. Dan un pequeño rodeo desde el aeropuerto para bajar por el cañón hasta un pequeño claro cerca del río. Allí te reciben un par de indios (el West Rim está en la reserva de los indios Hualapai) que amablemente de indican por dónde bajar a la orilla para tomar el bote. En el chiringo donde se resguardaban del sol vimos un termómetro marcando 45ºC, pero no teníamos tal sensación de calor, de hecho el calor era más agobiante en Las Vegas que en el Gran Cañón.

El paseo en barca es cutrecillo. Las vistas muy guapas, pero el paseo escaso. Básicamente consta de remotar el río unos 400 metros, parar el motor y dejar que la corriente lleve de vuelta la barca al embarcadero. Total 15-20 min. Mientras, el amable capitán, en un perfecto inglés de Ohio, cuenta historias del Cañón. Vuelta al improvisado helipuerto para volar de regreso al aeropuerto. Allí tomamos un autobús que nos llevó a Guano Point, donde hay un merendero donde te sirven el bufet (carne, pechuga de pollo, fajitas, algo parecido a compota de melocotón, un bollito, bebida y café) y tienes relativo poco tiempo para comer y hacerte las fotos que puedas. Las vistas son impresionantes, y preciosas al atardecer. Por la zona rondan cuervos sobrealimentados de las sobras de los bufets. Recomiendo no darles de comer.

A la hora fijada, vuelta al autobús. Es importantísimo estar puntual, porque si el autobús se va sin tí perderás el vuelo de regreso a Las Vegas, lo que supondría volver en autobús (aproximadamente 3h de viaje). Asíque recomiendo comer poco y rapidito para tener tiempo para hacer fotos, videos y admirar el paisaje, y así estar a tiempo esperando el bus, que es terrorificamente puntual!!

Nada más llegar al aeropuerto nos montamos en la misma avioneta en la que venimos, en los mismos asientos, y en 30 minutos estábamos de vuelta en Boulder City. En la terminal se pueden comprar por 15$ la foto con el capitán que te hicieron antes del viaje de ida. Subida a un autobús con sillones supercómodos de cuero y con pantallas de tv. Nos pusieron una película, lo que permite hacerse una idea de lo que tardan en dejar a los pasajeros en los hoteles más alejados, al norte del Strip. A nosotros nos dejaron los primeros en el Excalibur, aprovechando que está al lado del Luxor, y que tenían que bajar a más pasajerons para llevarles a hoteles más alejados en un bus con otra ruta.

Un 10 para la excursión, un 10 para la organización, un 10 para los pilotos, justitos los helicópteros y las avionetas, un poco cascadas por dentro, aunque nos comentaron que iban a adquirir nuevos modelos en breve (blablabla). Lo cierto es que en el aeropuerto del West Rim están haciendo una nueva terminal y una pista mayor, para permitir el aterrizaje y despegue de jets mayores, ya que hasta ahora sólo pueden utilizarlo pequeñas aeronaves de, como mucho, 21 pasajeros. Esto quiere decir que cuando esté listo, llegarán cantidades ingentes de turistas al west rim, supongo que para descongestionar el South Rim, saturadísimo de gente.

Resumiendo, estupenda experiencia con Scenic Airlines, totalmente recomendable. Espero que te haya merecido la pena leerte este ladrillaco ;)

The tour itself is good, the Grand Canyon is definitely a sight to see - the problem is the company running the tour.

We had booked a Grand Canyon tour from Las Vegas. First problem was the pickup from our hotel - 45 minutes late, and after a phone call to see where they were. Then we arrive at Scenic, and are informed of another delay, this time over an hour. They blame the second delay on a traffic jam - of which there was no evidence on our commute to their offices. We suspect they forgot about us and shifted us on a later tour. The result of the above is that we missed the show that we had booked for the evening. 

Couple the above with their transportation managers unhelpful attitude and refusal to help us get a faster drop off, a tardy response to my written complaint (which seemed to be a standard response saying delays happen, but they take no responsibility), our overall impression is rather go with another company (and not Papillon as they are the same company)

review_title: Bad service and rude staff - Poorly organised and amateur
review_text:
A party of 4 of us took the Grand Voyager tour in June 2008. The cost for 4 people being nearly $1300. You would expect with that sort of price that your tour would be organise properly. The scenery was great but the tour was poorly organised. 

We enjoyed or scenic flight although the planes look very old and less than well kept. On arrival at the canyon rim we were delayed by 30 minutes on our helicopter tour to the base of the canyon and ended up standing in the 100 degree heat while we waited for the company to organise our flight to the base of the canyon. When we landed at the base of the canyon you are pointed in the general direction of the river and told to find your own way down to the boat which is about 500ft down a rock track - the whole way along people coming up were asking us the way back to the helicopter pad. No clear path or directions marked on the hazardous trail. 

The boat trip was not just that - no commentary to speak of - before returning you to the river bank and you are left to find your own way back up the hill. 

This part of tour was OK but it went all wrong when we returned to the canyon rim via helicopter. We were met at the heli pad by a young lady who passed us a ticket and told us to get on the bus and get off at the second stop - the ticket was our lunch ticket. Written on the top of the ticket was 12.30. No explanation was given that this was time we were to return from the canyon rim bus tour to catch our flight back. The ticket was our lunch ticket so we assumed it was our lunch time and had our lunch at 12.30 and returned to the airport by bus at 1.15. At this time we were told that we had missed our flight back and the next one was 4pm. We explained this would mean we would miss our shows that night and we were told in the shorted possible way by the company representative that was 'tough luck' and they would do nothing about. We explained we were not informed of our need to be back at 12.30pm and they could not care less - in fact the insolence and rudeness of the staff would have to be the worst i have ever encountered. It was not until we made quite a scene that the even tried to get us an earlier flight (to no avail) - customer service was sadly lacking. I have travelled all over the world and this is my 3rd time to the Grand Canyon and never have I enountered a poorly organised tour or service this bad - even in 3rd world countries. 

We were told that on our return on the 4pm flight that they would have a bus waiting to take us directly to our hotel so we could at least try to get to our show. When we returned on the flight this was not even organised. We were delayed another 30 minutes waiting for our bus. We missed our showtime  which meant we lost $520 worth of show tickets. 

On complaining to the company they simply refused to do anything about it  - I called customer service several times before I managed to get hold of them. When asked why they hadn't call back i was informed that as we were international tourists they were unable to call international cellular numbers. This meant that I wore the cost of the calls made to complain - a total of $67 worth of calls. So a tour that should have taken 6 to 8 hours actually took 11 hours and ended up costing us $587 more that the $1300 dollars it was supposed to.  A grand total of $1857 - I could have spent this is with another tour company who would provided us with personalised professional service. 

You would have to be insane to trust your money, time and safety to them to professionally conduct a tour. I am one very unhappy customer as are my travelling companions. Unfortunately the company have my money and I have no way of getting it back. Try a different company - not Papillon thats the same organisation.
It was amazing and the guide is the best for searching bears. We saw 5 bears!! Amazing experience!!! And the flight is nice!!
It was absolutely fantastic from start to finish. The flight was great and Drew, the bear guy, made the time very enjoyable. Highly recommend. I would do it again in a heart beat!

From beginning to end, this was an amazing trip.  The staff were super helpful and friendly.  The pilot Eric was knowledgable and helpful.  Drew our guide was outstanding!  He was funny, knowledgable and created a great experience.  Loved seeing the bears!  I would highly recommend this tour to anyone who wants to see bears!

Wow! What a great experience. They worked with us because the weather wasn’t good for our morning flight. Rearranged pilots so we could go in the afternoon with Lenny of time to return to ship. The scenery was so unbelievable. We landed on a lake and was able to stand on plane pylons. It was so serene and beautiful. Great company and people. We booked directly with them.

Totally awesome!!! Highly recommend seeing Alaska from another vantage point!!
We did a surprise trip with friends-who had never been to Alaska-they said it was the best trip ever!

Steve and Lesley are wonderful people and the utmost professionals. Their pilots and other staff are amazing. They make you feel comfortable while keeping your safety as the most important priority. We had the best charter experience to a remote lake outside of Ketchikan.  Can’t wait to fly with them again. 😊💙

This was the highlight of our Alaskan cruise vacation as far as I'm concerned. The entire staff could not have been more pleasant.   Flying over Misty Fjords was simply magical.  The landscape was so unique and IMHO is best appreciated from the air.  We even landed on a small lake and were allowed to stop outside of the plan on the pontoons.  The music just added to the experience.  Thank you all for such a great memory!

review_title: My fear of traveling by float plane is conquered!
review_text: We flew SeaWind Aviation to and from Ketchikan/Thorne Bay for a wonderful week of fishing!  The flights were smooth, the scenery beautiful, and our many fresh frozen fish boxes were expertly transported.  My fear of traveling by float plane is conquered!  Will definitely fly with SeaWind again!

review_title: Misfortune turned into a very happy day thanks to SeaWind
review_text:
After my cruise ship floatplane excursion, a long-awaited journey for a special birthday treat, was cancelled due 'high winds', something that wasn't apparent that warm and sunny afternoon, especially as the floatplanes kept taking off and landing right next to the ships, including the company that was doing my cancelled excursion, I then quickly shopped around onshore for a replacement flight with limited shore-time left.

Two attempted bookings failed - someone scored a last seat just before me, and another company couldn't find enough passengers to make it worthwhile. Thankfully the remaining one, SeaWind Aviation, had room for me on my preferred aircraft - an original radial engined DHC-2 Beaver. As a retired airline pilot, it was Beavers flying overhead as a small kid that helped seed my interest in aviation.

Not only was SeaWind less expensive than the cancelled cruise ship excursion, but I got picked up from the ship by co-owner Lesley, driven a very short distance to their terminal and dock facilities, and soon after was sitting up the front right behind that rumbling radial engine - marvellous!

The pilot, Mike, not only handled the Beaver on water and in the air like a maestro but removed all the bumps that had been responsible for the previous flight's 'cancellation'. I suspect overbooking was the real reason for that, but I was so fortunate to fall into the friendly care of Lesley and Mike from SeaWind, and that marvellous old, shiny and obviously well-maintained Beaver.

The flight not only took in the advertised sightseeing around Ketchikan harbour, but went well off along valleys, between forested mountains and across several islands to make ripples on a perfectly smooth isolated island lake, landing and taking off just for fun :) 

Headsets and an intercom allowed Mike to answer passengers' questions along the way. We returned to Ketchikan, landing right beside the cruise ships and tying up at the dock about 150m from my ship - an easy walk back, sporting a new 'Beaver' cap, rather than trouble Lesley for another ride :)

I'm still grinning at the memory of that ride and so proud of my 'birthday' hat :)

Sea Wind Aviation was a fantastic tour operator. They were able to accommodate our party of 5 when another company canceled our trip a week before the scheduled date.
Our pilot Nate was great. He informed us about the plane, history and importance of bush planes in Alaska, and told us about what we were seeing. 
The sights of the Fjords and mountains from our low altitude were breathtaking. He took us right past a beautiful waterfall and hugged the mountains so we felt like we could almost touch them.
Landing in a remote quiet lake and wandering around for a few minutes was fun and amazing to experience. I would say it is definitely a must do activity for a visit to Ketchikan and Sea Wind Aviation is the company to do it with!
Our guide Kim was excellent as was our pilot.  We had a great time and saw amazing bears and two Bald Eagles!   Eat part of our Alaskan cruise by far!

This flight was a highlight of our Alaskan adventure in many ways. As a retired pilot I enjoyed the flight in the Otter and envy our Pilot (Russ?) getting to fly around the fjords daily!. 
The scenery is spectacular and I would highly recommend taking the option of a landing on the fjord. Stepping out onto the float in the middle of the calm fjord, in near silence, was just amazing.

We used Seawind as transport to Boardwalk lodge. As excited as I was about taking a float plane, I thought it would be absolutely terrifying ( like a roller coaster would be) I WAS SO WRONG !  The flight was super smooth , I didn't even realize we had lifted off ! The views were absolutely breath taking . The pilot was super professional and so friendly.  He even spotted a whale and went in for a better look.  I would go out of my way to fly with this company again.

We flew with Eric on the DeHavilland Otter. Our group of 5 was joined by 5 others, which was fine with us. The bus was easy to find and the ride was short. Lesley got us checked in right away. Our larger bags were stored safely behind the desk.
The flight was absolutely breathtaking, it is hard to describe in words. The plane was well maintained and we felt very safe. This is a do not miss experience in Ketchikan!

Staff, organization and pilots/guide all excellent. We were able to see 3 bears and a bald eagle. 

I just wish there was an option to hike a bit more and explore the beautiful forest

We had an amazing time! The best excursion we’ve ever done. We were in awe the entire time of the natural beauty of Alaska and Ketchikan. Getting so close to the mountains and seeing goats grazing plus the lake landing was beyond words!

SeaWind Aviation was amazing.  They were able to find us a replacement pilot on short notice and he was a terrific pilot.  We landed at a remote lake that was the most beautiful and quietest place I have ever been.  I would highly recommend SeaWind Aviation for any flight.

Absolutely amazing. We truly felt like the goal was to make us happy every step of the way.  From really attentive customer service as we set things up to a wonderful pilot and flight route.  We didn’t know what to expect but there was nothing we were left wanting in the experience.  They also are very careful to ensure you are back before your boat so don’t worry about booking on your own - they will take care of you.
Great excursion! Saw bears and eagles! Guide on land was great. Flight was smooth and all went perfectly from booking help before our trip to suggestions after the trip. All was great!!

review_title: Amazing bear viewing & great seaplane adventure
review_text:
Amazing trip from start to finish. Seawind met us at our ship for transport to the office.  Great, friendly pilot and fun, beautiful seaplane ride to Traitor’s Cove where we met our guide Drew. Drew knew a ton about the area and bears and was a great guide. We saw 9 bears including a mama and cub who came back repeatedly and a bigger bear who caught a fish right in front of us and at the end Drew took us to a beautiful photo spot before our ride back to Ketchikan. Our group was the only one at the viewing point for about an hour before others started arriving (which was nice - so I recommend going as early as possible). 

We did several incredible excursions on this trip (including a helicopter glacier landing, a private whale watching tour, and a Yukon tour) but this was the favorite for most of our group of eight.

Amazing tour guide and Max the pilot were very nice and accommodating.
Loved how knowledgeable Kim was about the plants and animals native to the area. Both were very kind and helpful my friend who had issues walked!!
Loved the trip.

We thoroughly enjoyed this trip today! We had the tour to ourselves - two 60 year olds and our respective 22 year old kids. The seaplane ride was a once in a lifetime for us and so cool! Our pilot Max was so kind and pleasant. He helped me when I struggled to get up and into the plane as I recently had foot surgery. Our tour guide and naturalist was Kim and she was the highlight of our trip! What a ray of sunshine! You can tell she truly loves Ketchikan and she knew so much about the flora and fauna in the rain forest. She led us down the most beautiful path to Traitors Cove to the bear viewing platform. I moved a little slow and she was so supportive and kind. We unfortunately didn’t see any bears coming to eat the spawning salmon. She said this was very unusual. We had gorgeous weather and truly enjoyed our excursion! Thanks to Seawind for providing such a wonderful experience. We will always cherish it!

review_title: Great tour good experience on the float plane wife has trouble getting in and out they were patient
review_text: Kim was very friendly and knowledgeable to time to talk to everybody on our tour. Staff at office was friendly and helpful
The front desk staff, pilot, and the fuelman were fantastic! Smooth flight and beautiful scenery. Highly recommended.

We were lucky to have a beautiful day with great weather.  The trip was amazing.  The views were unbelievable.  One of the best parts was the water landing.  I had no idea that we would just land in the water and get out and stand on the plane in the middle of the water.  Very cool!  I highly recommend Sea Wind Aviation.  We were on a cruise and this was by far the best excursion we took.

Our experience with SeaWind was amazing!  We took the flight to the Misty Fjords and landed on a lake at very high elevation in the mountains.  We had a beautiful sunny day.  The pilot, Saul (sp?), was great and provided a lot of information on what we were seeing.  The area in Alaska is so remote and beautiful.  It was great to have this opportunity to see it from high up.  I would recommend taking a flight if you can afford it.  Kind of a once in a lifetime opportunity.

We were a family of three so were placed with another couple.  The plane held six total.  Scheduling was easy and they were in contact when we arrived in Ketchikan on our cruise.  It is noisy so we were given headsets and were able to talk through these.  We did not see any bears but one mountain goat made an appearance.  Overall, awesome time.

I was really looking forward to a trip on a float plane / seaplane, this totally exceeded my expectations. Steve the owner is an amazing pilot and all round nice guy. The take-offs and landings were smoother than on a runway which really surprised me, the views were absolutely mind blowing, and touching down in Misty Fjord to be greeted by a bear working his way along the bushes eating berries was made to order, and the along came a seal. I did some amazing trips on this tour, but this is the one I would not miss given a second chance. Thank you Steve and all the staff for memories made.

review_title: A wonderful trip to spectacular bear viewing location
review_text: Everything was perfect on this trip with Seawind to see bears at the Anan Creek Wildlife Observatory iin Tongass National Forest.  The ground staff were very friendly and we're in constant contact with us before the trip.  Our pilot, Sol, was excellent in all respects.   And our bear guide, Kim, was superb.  She was masterful in guiding us safely down the trail to the observing platform (and there were bears on the trail in both directions).  She provided great insights and information about the bears and their behavior.  She helped us keep track of (and keep occupied) our two young sons (ages 5 and 7).  And she constantly pointed out bear activity to us all around the platform to make sure we didn't miss any good viewing or photo opportunities.  And the  bear viewing at Anan Creek was spectacular, even in the rain.  There were bears constantly in view, fishing, moving up and down from the creek, and even a mother black bear and two cubs climbing a tree right next to the viewing platform.  This trip was the highlight of our trip to Alaska, and we are very thankful to Seawind and Kim for this great experience for ourselves and our children.

We went to the Anan Bear Observatory. Absolutely incredible experience! Not for the faint of heart with wild bears roaming around the trail, however it was such a unique experience. Our tour guide Kim was fabulous, highly recommend her! The flight was gorgeous and we were lucky to see all the wildlife at Anan :) Also, great customer service and timely responses when booking and coordinating!

It was truly a bucket list experience...the pilot was great and so helpful when I was a little fearful of getting out on the float.  The views were magnificent and everyone we dealt with at the office and in the transport to and from the meeting point were very friendly and courteous...highly recommend

review_title: Amazing Experience with Misty Fjords Flight Tour
review_text: Our Misty Fjords Flight Tour was incredible! Our pilot, Sol, was friendly and informative, making the experience even better. We were lucky to have clear skies, which allowed us to enjoy the amazing views fully. The highlight was spotting a mountain goat on one of the cliffs. Highly recommend this tour for anyone looking to experience the beauty of the Misty Fjords!

review_title: Up close with bears and fish
review_text: Seawind Air took us on the Anan Creek Wildlife Observation Tour, and it was amazing.  Salmon were coming into the creek so black and brown bears were on the water.  Aside from our helpful Seawind naturalist guide, the Forest Service staff did a great job with their new observation structure.  5+ stars with the bears in the creek.

The tour was breathtaking. We had to delay our 10 am trip because of low cloud coverage and rain. They were able to accommodate us on a later flight and an alternate path. We are so grateful for the experience and the flexibility of the entire team. We felt safe the whole time and enjoyed the music and history of the area. We would definitely recommend doing this tour!

Riding a seaplane for the first time was interesting.  The sights during the 90 minute flight were okay, not amazing.  Landing during the trip and getting out added a little to the experience, not much.

I would not recommend this tour because of the cost vs. the experience.

The administration and pilot were very good.

Terrific way to see Alaska. My 2 granddaughters, age 15 and 17, said it was their favorite excursion by far. The pilot gave us good insights on what we were seeing. He landed the plane and pulled up close enough to land that we could hop right off -no problem. I got to sit in the co-pilot seat which was awesome. Photos and videos were gorgeous. The take-offs and landings were smoother than on land flights. Don’t miss this chance of a lifetime. Sea Wind makes all the connections and tour easy. This is a local, Alaskan company that is top rated.

Excellent service
Amazing landscapes by the fjords with water stop
I highly recommend this tour of the Misty Fjords with Seawind

review_title: There’s a reason this is 5 star.
review_text:
I just want to echo the majority of these reviews. Communication/coordination was super easy and the trip itself was simply spectacular. We had an excursion cancel the day before in Skagway so we decided at the last minute to splurge on this tour for our last day in Alaska. Turns out this is the one excursion that should have been an absolute lock. Yeah, I was iffy on the price for such a short trip. I was wrong. This flight is what I will talk about for years when I recount my Alaska trip. Anthony was our pilot and he was super informative.  Leslie was the coordinator and I was big time nervous about making it back to the remote Norwegian dock on time.  They listened to my concerns and explained exactly what would happen, and it happened EXACTLY that way. We landed at 5:00 for a last shuttle at 5:30 and it was NO PROBLEM. Made it in plenty of time. (Note: non-Norwegian cruises dock right there nearby so they don’t have to worry about the shuttle back). 

Being greeted back by the golden retriever at the end of the tour is a pure bonus.

This company was Amazing from the time you enter their small building. They had a variety of stuffed animals on display. Extremely friendly and very professional outfit. They will pick you up from the downtown port area. And the experience of getting high up and "Flight seeing" was Bucket list worthy, Spectacular and Amazing. Then the pilot landed on a mountain lake and we got to stand on the pontune of the plane. I Just cannot say enough about the company and the experience. They also have two golden retrievers on property, one of which Loves to swim in the ocean.

review_title: DO IT!!! YOU WILL NEVER SEE THE MISTY FJORDS LIKE THIS ON A CRUISE SHIP!!
review_text:
DO IT!!! You will never see Alaska like this on a cruise ship!!! 

It's worth every penny you spend!!! 

Our pilot was a local native and has a vast mental library of knowledge that he freely shares!

 We took my mobilty and health-impaired moms on this excursion to which the staff were very understanding and accommodating. Leslie picked us up, not even an 8th of a mile from the cruise ship port. So convenient!

High quality plane with a high quality staff and pilot!!!

DO IT!!!!

review_title: Fantastic Flight, Fabulous Scenery, Great Operation.
review_text: Fantastic trip.  Very professional, but friendly too.  Picked us up and dropped us off from the cruise terminal.  Beautiful views that were out of this world.  Got to land on a remote lake and get out to take in the Natural Grandeur. Greeted by the two golden retrievers upon our return.  Highly recommend.

review_title: Thrilling view of the Misty Fjords National Monument.
review_text: A thrilling sight seeing tour. Our pilot was very professional and friendly. The views from the air (not very high) were amazing. We had a drizzly day and it actually made the fjords cool looking. The pickup and drop off were seamless. Right on time. We had to reschedule from an earlier date because of a conflict. They were super responsive of our needs and rescheduled at a time we could go.
My teen daughters and I had a wonderful flight!  We will remember the experience for years to come.  Wonderful people to do business with!

review_title: Misty Fjords with SeaWind Aviation - SPECTACULAR
review_text: Loved this tour!  We received a 'reminder' text the day before our tour and again the morning of the flight which gave us peace of mind knowing that our tour was on schedule.  Everyone at SeaWind were friendly and engaging.  Our flight captain provided commentary throughout the flight.  A highlight was the tight turn within a  mountain range in order to land on one of the lakes.  The scenery was spectacular.  Photo's don't do it justice.  We were fortunate that the weather cooperated as Juneau receives 12.5 feet of rain annually, but on this day, we had a mix of sun and cloud. The lakes were like glass.  Misty Fjords with SeaWind Aviation was top-notch.
Best part of our family Alaskan cruise.  The views were astounding!  Our pilot, Rick , was very experienced and informative. The staff was great. An amazing adventure.

The scenery and views from the plane were amazing. Max was a great pilot, and handled everything confidently. He did a great job of explaining some of the things we saw. Landing on the lake was incredible! What a great experience!

Lesley was amazing in emailing us details as they changed. We also called on the day of our trip and she kept us informed as to where they would pick us up for our tour. As they were down a plane due to issues they arranged for us to fly with Timber in his Cessna. It was the three of us with him and he had our grandson sit up front with him. He explained all the instruments to our grandson and have us a great tour. We landed on a beautiful lake, got out and walk around before the flight back. As we were flying back I seen a black bear on the ice, Timber turned the plane around so that everyone could see and the bear had moved to the rocks, but everyone else was able to see the bear. It was a very clear sunny day, so no mist but we loved every minute.

review_title: Disappointing Experience and Lack of Professionalism
review_text:
I had booked the Misty Fjords flightseeing tour for 1.5 hours with a landing, along with 8 other friends and family members, nearly 90 days in advance. However, my experience with SeaWind Aviation was a nightmare.

Less than 12 hours before my scheduled departure, I received an email informing me that my flight had been changed from 9:30 AM to 10:30 AM, and instead of the 1.5-hour tour with a landing that I had booked, it was now a 1-hour tour. To make matters worse, my friends were given different flight times, separating our group.

When I tried to contact Lesley, our point of contact, she was unhelpful and suggested canceling for a full refund instead of resolving the issue or providing a reasonable explanation for the changes.

I am extremely disappointed with SeaWind Aviation's lack of professionalism and their failure to honor the tour package I had booked and paid for well in advance. Changing the tour details at the last minute and separating our group without proper communication or justification is unacceptable.

I would not recommend SeaWind Aviation to anyone seeking a reliable and professional flightseeing experience in the Misty Fjords area.

This was a 10 out of 10 experience! Our pilot, Sol, is a native to the area, very experienced, and he had some great stories to tell while we were flying over the Misty Fjords. I can’t thank him enough for being a part of my family’s experience on a seaplane. ❤️
What an absolute AMAZING experience.  We booked this flight outing not with Princess.  We took a little gamble.  It paid off!  This was the high point of our trip, which was great!

The Misty Fjords flight tour was simply amazing! Great views and Max our pilot was great! He Took his time explaining the scenery and making sure we all had a great experience. I would highly recommend this tour! It’s some of the most beautiful scenery I have ever seen.
The flight was beautiful and the weather was a wonder. We landed in a remote area which was stunning to say the least. The pilot was skilled and informative. Best part of our trip

The ease of getting to the site from ship was VERY eas y (short walk).  The pilot and office were friendly and helpful.  The flight was AMAZING and the pilot did a great job telling history, sites and folktales...LOVED IT .... great views of cliffs, Fjords, lakes and forest.
We even landed on a small lake and had time to see the shore line and seclusion.
Best Excurion I have ever been on in my 30 years of cruising.  5+ stars

What an experience! We did 90 minutes with a stopover. Our pilot Sol was absolutely excellent. My favorite moment was passing up between mountains over a gushing waterfall and then over the lake above that flowed down. I also enjoyed circling over a whale, which gave a very different perspective on it and its size than seeing it from the side, and following goats up a hillside. Every moment was magical and unforgettable. I never stopped taking photos and vids because it was all so beautiful and I wanted these beautiful memories that would last longer. The stopover was well worth it, not because it was especially interesting, but because it broke up the experience and made it feel varied and longer.

review_title: Absolute best thing I did on my Alaska  cruise.
review_text:
Incredible !   This tour is a must do.  I’d give it 6 stars if I could.   Stunning up close view of the mountains  fjords and wildlife.   We landed at the base of a waterfall and were able to get out on shore for some great photos and a walk about.  
Highly highly recommend this tour and this company.   They were wonderful.
This was the best view of Alaska and an amazing experience.  So glad we did this. Breathtaking. Easy to book with our large group.

review_title: Seaplane to Misty Fjord's National Monument on SeaWind is a must do
review_text: SeaWind Aviation was an excellent tour out of Ketchikan, AK. Earlier we had taken a helicopter ride to a glacier that was a wonderful experience as well.  But to see Misty Fjords National Monument and be the only people there was something especial.  We did this as a stand-alone tour, not through the ship.  They were excellent. We all enjoyed it and said it was one of the highlights of our Alaska Adventure.
The views were absolutely stunning, and the staff was amazing as well. Definitely the highlight of our week in Ketchikan. Pilot has some fire aux skills as well!

review_title: Fantastic experience on our Misty Fjords flightseeing trip!
review_text:
We had a fantastic experience on our Misty Fjords flightseeing trip! 

Before we even booked our tour Lesley was so great at answering the many questions we had for our group of six. We were gifted a gorgeous sunny day for our flight and had a great trip with Pilot Steve. He was very knowledgeable about the area wildlife and their habitats. We each had a window seat, and my husband was even able to ride in the front with Steve. Landing on the fjord was incredible.

Do not hesitate to book this tour with SeaWind - one of the top highlights of our Alaska trip!

review_title: A Float-plane is great way to see Alaska.  Great experience
review_text:
The flight was high point of the entire cruise.  Absolutely stunning to be flying among a maze of 1000 foot cliffs.  Great landing on a mountain lake where the water was so clear you could see fish 15 feet down. 

The staff was friendly and the pilot very competent.  If you want to really see Alaska, a seaplane is one of the best ways to get a feel for the majesty of the land, and I highly recommend SeaWind

review_title: Fantastic family owned and operated, the best float plane tours in Ketchikan !
review_text: This was a fantastic flight and tour with a very professional pilot, I have flown with Seawind before and have had nothing but an amazing time. This is a local family-owned tour operation, and they will give you the best in personal attention and recommendations for a wonderful tour. As a pilot i highly recommend this wonderful experience with this family-owned adventure! Beautiful mountains and you maybe even will see a whale from below ! Tell them Len sent you !

review_title: Best Sea Plane tour in Ketchikan
review_text: This is a wonderful family owned operation and with  very professional pilots and fully inspected and well maintained aircraft   As a professional pilot myself I would not consider flying with anyone else , Sea Wind Avaition will provide you with a great flight and fun time , I have flown with them before and will continue to give them 5+ stars for a fantastic adventure flight , tell them Len sent you ! They are the best.

review_title: Best experience of our Alaskan cruise!
review_text: This was the highlight of our Alaska cruise! The pictures can't even do it justice. Steven, the pilot, shared lots of great info and took us over the most amazing sights. When we passed over a whale, he circled once so everyone could see it. Same thing when he spotted a black bear eating dandelions! Leanne, the shuttle driver, was sweet as can be. And their dog was so friendly and adorable. If you can only afford one shore excursion during your cruise, do this one!!!

review_title: Amazing views and great customer service
review_text: This was an excellent trip through the fjords, despite the cloudy, rainy day.  It does rain 200 days a year in Ketchikan, so we were not surprised. Lesley worked with us as we tried to sort out an itinerary conflict which she brought to our attention and made sure that we were able to enjoy this excursion and get back to the ship in time.

This was a very lovely relaxing experience 
I have severe motion sickness and somehow did not barf all over everyone 
The views were absolutely breathtaking 
The pilot was knowledgeable and safe and talked just enough to give you info but not distract your zen
The office was clean and new and their two dogs were icing on the cake- such sweet babies! 
I would absolutely recommend this company (over the others) because the others did not inspire confidence.. I kept thinking …
“That guy is taking people in a plane?!”
Ignore the weirdo guy and just book with these guys- there IS a difference

Highlight of our trip.  Everything you read in all the other positive reveiws is accurate.  Book this you will not regret it.   Bucket list flight.  Easy to get to, easy and smooth to get on and get off.  Beautiful!  Friendly staff

Amazing trip! Would definitely recommend and do again. Lovely pilot and perfect landing and cruising. Once he heard we were interested in wildlife it became a Find Waldo adventure in addition to taking in the breathtaking views. Wonderful!

This is a wonderful excursion. My grandson was allowed to ride "co-pilot"(a highlight of his Alaska trip) The plane ride to the viewing area was beautiful, our naturalist guide was most definitely an "original": knowledgeable, independent and just plain fun. Best of all, we saw fishing bears!! We recommend it highly
The views were unbelievable. The pilot and staff were extremely professional. One of the best experiences of our lives.

review_title: Alaska flight and two Golden Retrievers.
review_text: This was a great experience.  We were originally scheduled for the Bear Viewing trip but they called us and said it was getting too late for bears - would we like to cancel or switch to Misty Fjords, which is what we opted for. When we first arrived it was raining with low ceilings.  So we waited around for a bit with the owners two goldens.  After the weather cleared we had a terrific flight into the fjords are with a landing at a lake.  Got out and walked the pontoon for a while and then took off for more sightseeing through the fjord area.  Never knew seaplane takeoffs and landings could be so smooth.  Even my wife, who was a little apprehensive felt safe and had a great time. Flying that low over the landscape gave you a wonderful opportunity for sightseeing and pictures.  The owners are a husband and wife team that went the extra mile to make this an unforgettable Alaska experience.  Top that off with two Golden retrievers in the lobby!

We did the 1.5 hr Misty Fjords w/ landing at 8 am on 9/14. The trip start to finish was a once in a lifetime experience. This company is family run and it really shows! They take everything seriously so you feel safe. We had a bit of wind the morning of so we waited to make sure we were in the clear. They said if it starts to seem dangerous they were going to head right back. Turns out we had the best time! We landed in the middle of the fjords and bear watched. Our pilot was extremely informative and was happy being our photographer when we landed- he took the best pictures of us! Thank you so much. We’re going home and telling all our friends that they need to do this excursion while in Ketchikan- it was the trip of a lifetime! They even dropped us off right at creek street after our excursion ended so that we could enjoy walking around before heading back to our ship. Thank you!!

review_title: Seaplane and bears! Fantastic experience with Seawind Aviation.
review_text:
Fantastic trip from start to finish. All staff were fun, friendly and informative and I learnt so much from our guide while she took us to the place we would see the bears. 

I'd definitely receommend this tour, or any tour with Seawind - I felt very looked after from the moment I called to check that the tour would work with my cruise ship itinerary. 10/10 service!

My friend booked this as an excursion in Ketchikan for our cruise. There were 10 of us and it was amazing. Jackie picked us up and she was great ( also being a Buffalo Bills fan due to her nephew playing on the team and most of us were Bills fans made it fun and great conversation) Steve our pilot was awesome too. He was very knowledgeable. I highly recommend Sea Wind Aviation!
From start to finish, this Adventure was outstanding!   Staff, equipment and location was all 5 stars !   Would strongly recommend this excursion, the “ elevated lake landing” was a treat !

SeaWind Aviation - I'm not sure I can even give this company a good enough review!  I've never been more impressed by customer service, reliability and the excursion itself was just breathtaking.  I felt so taken care of with this company.  I traveled with my husband and our 8 year old daughter.  All three of us were very happy to have had such a unique experience.  Besides the easy sign up and communication with the company, they even made it seamless to get to their dock.  They picked us up right at our cruise ship and brought us to their very nice and comfortable facility that was complete with water station and beautiful, clean bathrooms.  We got onto the seaplane and the magic started before liftoff.  What a once in a lifetime experience!  We got a great tour of Misty Fjords and lots of information about the area.  You can see straight down through the convex windows - literally a bird's eye view.  We felt safe and it was exciting (although it was chilly in the seaplane - bring a sweater).  After the tour, we were driven right into town and told exactly how to get back to our cruise ship - it was really easy.  Touring with this company was seamless.  I'm not sure exactly, but it felt like a famliy run business that takes great pride in its company.

We had an amazing trip. This was a unplanned excursion for us on our cruise. We were concerned about accessibility for our daughter with special needs. Turned out to be not an issue, the staff were so helpful and accommodating. Wonderful experience, and would highly recommend.

We first flew with Sea Wind in 2019 and when we decided we were coming back for another vacation to Alaska I new I had to look them up again and book!  Love that it’s a family owned business and they always make sure you have the best flight… even if that means adjusting your flight time (due to weather).  We’ve been lucky enough to fly with the owner each time and as we fly he tells us about the areas we are passing by. Just an all around great experience!  We will always fly with Sea Wind and you should too!!

Allow a few hours for this, but it’s so worth it! Made our trip to Alaska. Max our pilot was fantastic, pointing out spots on the way and looking for animals on the flight, the scenery was absolutely incredible. If you are considering this it’s definitely worth the money and you will not regret it! Highlight of our trip for sure! The playlist as we were flying was awesome too. Thank you!
The flight was awesome and our guide was the most enthusiastic and knowledgeable person making it an around great experience!

This trip with Seawind Aviation was everything I hoped it would be and more. We are a family of 4 with two "kids" of 22 and 19. I booked this many months ago as part of an epic trip across the US culminating with a 10-day cruise to Alaska. Through the booking process, Lesley and her colleagues were fantastic and provided a view (not a recommendation) on which trip to book for the best chance to see bears. I booked the Prince of Wales trip but we ended up at Traitors Cove as the chances of seeing bears were better for us. Lesley met us in Ketchikan and helpfully hung around for a couple who were late getting off the ship due to a mix-up in timings. Lesley took us straight to the float plane and boarded us. I think we were the first of the day as our guide ( a lovely lady named Kim) also flew with us. The flight was fantastic and was the first time any of us had been on a floatplane. The landing was very smooth and we docked at the dock. Kim drove us to to the top of the trailhead and we talked us through some of the flora and fauna as we walked down to the viewing area. As soon as we got there we spotted a bald eagle in a tree and when we looked down at the creek we saw our first bear. We were lucky to 6 or 7 bears including a mum with two cubs. The whole thing was amazing. We did not feel rushed and we spent about an hour at the viewing platform. On the way back, Kim took us up to a scenic spot to see the lake where the Salmon were heading too - this in itself looked like something out of a Bob Ross painting.. Kim then took us back to the dock and we waited for our plane to come in and take us back. The whole thing was just fantastic. Everyone from Seawind were awesome and very friendly and, alhough they would have been busy all day, we never felt rushed at all... an absolutely outstanding trip and one I'd recommend to anyone.
So much fun!  Kim was a great bear spotter and the flight was great too!  Thanks for a great experience. Highly recommend Seawinds❤️

Great company!  There was a bit of a change in the schedule and the company did an amazing job communicating with us.  Now the trip itself was amazing, our pilot went above and beyond to get us some great views and memories. An unforgettable experience!
Highly recommend this tour. Our guide Kim was very knowledgeable and friendly. The whole tour was very well organized.

review_title: Bear Viewing by Float Plane--- Wow!
review_text: It was a great excursion.  There were two float planes so a group of only about 10 people.  The guide was great and knowledgeable and the pilot was great too.  We did see bears.  They were a little bit down the stream and we forgot our binoculars.  The viewing area is great and we spent plenty of time--didn't feel rushed.  If you want a more private type experience---do this one.

Anthony, our pilot, was amazing,  a real professional, and great to talk with.   Our stop by an island in the Fjords was amazing.   It was definitely a trip
Highlight among many.

review_title: Boring. Not as advertised. Pilot did. It narrate and we had no idea what we were looking at. Not as advertised.
review_text:
Very disappointing trip. I read all the reviews and was excited about the commentary. Our pilot maybe said 3 total sentences to us. We could not talk to each other via headphones. It was like flying through a forest with no commentary it was beautiful but very boring. I did reach out to Leslie and she said he was in the quiet side but very safe pilot. She offered a 200
Discount but I denied and would rather leave an honest review. I was disappointed how she handled this. We spend 1600 dollars to fly around with no talking or information. My mother actually fell asleep. They advertise that the pilot will narrate the entire trip. Our pilot Hardly said hello or goodbye. I was so looking forward to this trip and it was a splurge to be disappointed with the flight and customer service. There is another company another shipmate went on called wings she said the pilot narrated the entire time and it was wonderful. I am so disappointed. I would not recommend

It was wonderful!
The service from all the staff is first class, and the excursion was incredible, the landscapes, the plane and the bears eating in their habitat is simply unforgettable.
I highly recommend it.

review_title: Amazing views even more amazing staff and crew!
review_text: 10 out of 10 from start to finish!  The shuttle picked us up on time and the driver was a delight!  The staff was friendly and professional, helping my dad to, from, onto and off of the seaplane although he needs a walker to get around (slowly).  A shout out to Lesley for her kindness and patience.  A shout out to Max for piloting the seaplane with commentary of his own engagement and wedding events at various locations throughout our flight.  Loved those personal stories and your musical playlist! A shout out to the dock crew as well!  Thanks everyone (and the three sweet golden retrievers) at SeaWind Aviation!

review_title: Multiple flights over several days-all perfect!
review_text: Very friendly service, competent and safe pilots. Wonderful experiences over several flights. These folks really do treat you like family!

review_title: Disappointed that they changed our itinerary without telling us, but still an incredible view.
review_text:
A once-in-a-lifetime experience, and a chance to see the fjords from a bird's-eye-view. The experience was incredible and the pilot was incredibly informative and friendly. Only disappointment was that we had opted for the water-landing experience and weren't informed ahead of time that we wouldn't be able to do the water landing due to the tour operator running behind schedule. They refunded the difference and were apologetic, but that doesn't change the disappointment. The "once-in-a-lifetime" thing cuts both ways, because it's unlikely we'll get to do this tour again.

All that said, I recommend the tour and the incredible, unique view it provides.
Beautiful scenery. Excellent customer focused staff from booking to completion. A once in a lifetime experience well worth doing.

Gorgeous, amazing airplane ride to a secluded island. Make sure your camera has a fully charged battery! We saw so many bears, including a mama and her three cubs. Watching salmon, swim upstream, and the big bears fishing them out of the water was an experience we will never forget. Our guide was extremely knowledgeable and we learned a lot.  Rey professional. This is the second time we’ve taken this tour and would definitely recommend it again. The experience of a lifetime!

Our seaplane tour to Prince of Wales Island was incredibly special.  The pilot was friendly and very good at his job, and our bear guides were wonderful and informative.  The bear viewing was surreal and magical as we got up close and personal with a black bear as he feasted on salmon.  A once in a lifetime experience.

erfect in every way! The ride was phenomenal. The views and the experience is unmatched. Worth every penny. Bucket list experience. Service was perfect, despite a rocky beginning due to weather. Handled so well. Pilot was heat! Thank you.

We recently did the flight seeing & crab feast.  Our pilot was Solomon.  He was such a great pilot and narrator of our Ketchikan flight.  Solomon was super nice and we could tell he enjoys what he does.  We then went to George Inlet for an all you can eat crab feast.  WOW!  The food was incredible.

review_title: Watching the bears was the highlight of our holiday!
review_text: Fantastic excursion to see the bears. It was the first trip of the year they'd run (the salmon have just arrived) but regardless we had an amazing time watching the bears fishing. Great views from the open platform and the guide was superb! A small group meant a great viewing experience. This was the highlight of an already fantastic 2-week trip.

Flight into Misty Fjords with a landing on a lake and take off again!  Absolutely beautiful.  Smooth flight through the fjords, smooth landings and take-offs.  Did a little wildlife searching and saw mountain goats.  Great trip.  Well worth it.

review_title: Seawind tour of the Misty Fjords with a stop, too
review_text: Our experience end to end was perfect.  Booking was easy, checking in/logistics were great, and everyone was just a joy to interact with.  Sol was our pilot/guide, and he only added to the experience with great information and personality.  We also had a landing on Old Goat Lake which only makes us want to add stars to the rating :).  Cheers, Tim
Awesome views and experience.. We had a short time in port and they made it happen.. My only complaint is I wish we had more time for a longer flight..
Unbelievably terrific experience. Staff is so great, facility is nice with restrooms. Sol was our pilot. He's THE BEST! Alaska is beautiful and this the way to see it.

review_title: Der Schein hat uns getrogen, wir fühlen uns belogen!
review_text:
Unsere Buchung über Travelstart war: 
Hinflug         - Stuttgart – Zürich – Mumbai – GOA,
Rückflug	- GOA – Mumbai – München - Stuttgart

Wir waren sehr zufrieden mit der Abwicklung unserer Flugbuchung. 
Auch war die Information über die Flugzeiten und die Zeiten bis zu den nächsten Flügen so angegeben, das wir keine Probleme bei den Transfers zum jeweils nächsten Flug zu befürchten hatten. 
Am Flughafen Stuttgart wurde uns beim Aufgeben des Gepäcks gesagt, dass wir das Gepäck in Mumbai abholen und neu aufgeben müssten. 
Die dafür zur Verfügung stehende Zeit von dreieinhalb Stunden haben wir als ausreichend angesehen. 
In Mumbai angekommen hatten wir an der Immigration reichlich lange zu warten und nach der Immigration waren noch weitere zeitaufwändige Kontrollen . 
Die Abholung der Koffer ist nach der Immigration und wir waren so spät, das wir die Koffer nicht mehr vom Band holen konnten, sondern an der Stelle abholen mussten wo die nicht abgeholten Koffer deponiert waren. 
Als wir die Koffer wieder aufgeben wollten, war das Boarding bereits geschlossen. 
In der Folge waren wir gezwungen, einen anderen Flug nach GOA zu suchen.
Wir konnten dann einen Flug buchen, der erst am Abend stattfand, also mehr als 19 Stunden später, zusätzliche Kosten ca. 150 €. 
Natürlich war unser Taxifahrer, den wir bereits organisiert hatten, umsonst von Arambol nach Mumbai gefahren, Kosten 3.000 lNR, ca. 34 €. 

In den Statuten von Travelstart steht: 

„Wenn Sie ein Rückflugticket haben, ist es nicht möglich, den Hinflug verfallen zu lassen und nur den Rückflug zu nutzen.
Flugtickets müssen in chronologischer Reihenfolge verwendet werden, da die Fluggesellschaft ansonsten den verbleibenden Teil der Reise  storniert.“

Trotz stundenlanger Chats über mehrere Tage ist es uns nicht gelungen, Travelstart zu überzeugen, dass wir den Flug von Mumbai nach GOA ohne eigenes Verschulden versäumt hatten.

Organisation für den Rückflug: 
Den über Travelstart gebuchten Rückflug am 21.12. 2022 von GOI nach STR, 
Flugnummern 	UK 844 GOI - BOM, 
		                 LH 767 BOM - MUC, 
		                 LH 2144 MUC - STR 
konnten wir nicht antreten, da der Hinflug nicht komplett durchgeführt wurde - was nicht unser Verschulden war - und wir trotz wiederholtem Chat mit den Mitarbeitern von Travelstart keine Freigabe für den gebuchten und bezahlten Rückflug bekommen haben. 

Somit waren wir gezwungen, einen anderen Rückflug zu buchen. 
Die Daten: 	QR 523 GOI - DOH 22.12.2022 04:05 am 
		        QR 71 DOH - FRA 22.12.2022 02:00 pm 
Zusätzliche Kosten 90.030 lNR, ca. 1.028 € 

Die Strecke Frankfurt - Stuttgart wurde mittels privatem PKW organisiert. 

Die Summe der zusätzlichen obigen Kosten beträgt 1.213 € (ohne Berücksichtigung der Abholung durch privaten PKW aus Frankfurt). 

Ein Schreiben an Travelstart über die unbefriedigende Abwicklung der Buchung blieb bisher unbeantwortet!

user_location: Province of San Jose, Costa Rica
review_text: It was really fun and cool as an aviation enthusiast. Amazing views. Landed on a lake on accessible by seaplane. Parked on a tiny island in the middle which was cool.

review_title: Sea Wind Aviation is a great company with excellent service.  I highly recommend this company.
review_text: Landing on the lake. Such a beautiful day with a fantastic view. Pilot was very good at flying. It was very scenic flight and well wworth the money.

review_title: In the top 5 experiences of my life!
review_text: Booking and pickup was very smooth, friendly, and wasted no time being on the plane within 20 minutes. Pilot was experienced and had obviously done this more times than he could remember. Felt very safe and he gave name, descriptions and brief history of many geographical locations and even of animals we saw. Fjords we’re a one of a kind sight and I never expected to land on a lake in such a beautiful location, let alone be parked in the wilderness and let off the plane. The views on the way back were just as unique and beautiful, and the entire plane trip took no longer than a good hour and a half. For the price it takes to maintain and fuel the aircraft, I find the price of this booking greatly reasonable and worth every penny. Rarely do I have an experience that exceeds my inflated imaginary expectations, this one blew them out of the water.

It's all you could ask for. 
No words to explain the beauty.
Very nice people, awesome fleet!
So much fun.

review_title: Great Flight, Great Staff and Great Fun!!!!
review_text:
The tour was outstanding!  Amazing immense views that cannot be captured by a camera.
The staff made our trip extra special from the first call I made to Lesley to make arrangements, to our van driver, to the pilot, and office staff.  They were all so incredibly professional and kind.
Absolutely breathtaking. Gorgeous views throughout the trip. Best thing to do on a day in port. Best excursion of our entire Alaskan cruise.
The tour was awesome and worth every penny spent! Out guide Anthony was very friendly and offered great narrative throughout the trip! Highly recommended.

We took our six children on this flight, and Dan was not just a good pilot. He was knowledgeable, had a witty personality, and educated us a lot about the landscapes, logging, and just about everything we saw. This small family operation are just good folk. Their sweet teenage daughter picked us up, Lesly hosted us well and kept safe the personal items we didn't want to take on the ride. They work hard and are just the kind of people/business we love to support.

Tour was beautiful and everyone had their own window.  The landing was fun and we all got out to stand on the deck and enjoy the scenery.  We had great weather and both landings and takeoffs were smooth.  A special trip.

Amazing views and scenery!! Well worth the flight cost. 

The sky was overcast, which is the BEST time to fly as the air is smooth. 

Every window has a great view, and if something is on the right, and you are seated on the left, you get to see it on the return. 

Highly recommend them!!!

Staff very courteous and professional. Had a very trustworthy experienced pilot. Weather was perfect so the sights were amazing. Landing and taking off from a high mountain lake just added even more to the experience. Would absolutely recommend based on weather.

review_title: Misty Fjords 1.5 hr excursion with lake landing in Otter.
review_text: It was an amazing experience! Beautiful day for flying and our pilot Matt was top notch! We landed in Lake Nooyah and got an extra takeoff and landing to make for a perfect tour. Leslie and Steve are great people, we highly recommend!!
Awesome experience.  The views were amazing.  Professional and friendly.  Had a blast!  It was close to the cruise area and we walked there within 5 minutes.  Would highly recommend this business!

Spectacular trip. 1.5 hours was not enough... we loved it! Would highly recommend. We did the landing in the mountain lake which was incredible. Pilot was awesome. Some turbulence but not unexpected for a small plane. Otherwise smooth takeoff and landing, similar to riding in a boat, only less choppy. We had kids (6, 9, 12, 14) and they all LOVED it.
This was an incredible experience! Everything was perfect from the time we left our cruise ship until our return! Pilot was very informative and skilled. Highly recommend

review_title: Flight of a Life time - Misty Fjords by Seawind aviation!
review_text: We really enjoyed this excursion.  The entire was accommodating and friendly.  Our pilot Ed was exceptional.  Let me sit up front with him, and explained everything as we flew.  He shared a lot of history with us, his family has grown up there for  several generations.  He picked a beautiful spot to land the plane of a lake.  Great pictures with those gorgeous views.
This is a must do!  I have been 3 different times and would go again.  It is difficult to describe the stunning beauty of what you will see!!!

This was an awesome experience! I had to convince my husband to do this and it ended up being his favorite excursion we did on our trip to Alaska. This is a family ran business that was so friendly, professional and just all around good people. Our pilot did a fantasic job. The views were amazing so if you are on the fence just book it. You will not be disappointed.
This was an amazing tour!  One of the highlights of our trip to Alaska.  Thank you for an wonderful experience!!

review_title: Magical Morning soaring around the Misty Fjords!
review_text:
What an incredible tour! This was an absolute dream way to experience authentic Alaska - remote, breathtaking and majestic. While we were disappointed to miss the season for bear tours, the Misty Fjords tour was absolutely spectacular and well spent precious port time.

The office team did an excellent job sending all the detailed meet up/planning information in advance. And the morning of, they kept us updated on weather conditions. We were so relieved when the weather cleared enough to make this experience happen! And they mobilized quickly to load us in vans in a central meeting spot and get us to the dock and loaded up smoothly and quickly. 

The dock dogs were a welcome greeting - that sweet puppy, Murphy!!! And Anthony was an excellent pilot - always making sure we were comfortable, pointing out the sights, and playing the best assortment of music! And the tour - it’s breathtaking. Once in a lifetime kind of opportunity. We’re so very grateful.

Everything about this flight tour was excellent - Leah & Lesley were so helpful booking it and accommodating our schedule. Their customer service was outstanding!  The views from the plane were beautiful! Being so close to everything was just breath taking!  The pilot was great too - answering all of our questions and providing us with lots of fun information.  We would highly recommend this tour! Definitely a highlight of our trip to Alaska!

Awesome!! Family of 4.  Easy & on time pick-up at docks. Pilot Eric was great.  More than enough time on plane landing  in middle of mountain fjord. Totally worth every penny, wife’s highlight of Alaska cruise

This was an amazing experience! Lesley in the booking office was so kind and helpful, Jackie picked us up at the port right on time for a quick ride to the plane and then dropped us off after at Creek Street for some shopping. Ed, our pilot, was so great and has an awesome playlist for the flight! We had a spectacularly sunny day- which is rare in Alaska- and the sights were just gorgeous. I would highly recommend this excursion with Seawind. We booked the option with water landing and got to get out and stand on the pontoons! Well worth the extra money! Absolutely incredible!
Amazing views from up above! Pilot was friendly and knowledgeable, and pick up from the cruise dock was quick and easy.

Wow. What an incredible experience. Thanks to Seawind my wife and I had the most amazing experience flying and landing in the Misty Fjords. They picked up us at the dock and took us to there floatplane dock. Extremely nice, friendly, and appreciative for us being there. Loved their dons too… Murphy gave me a very warm welcome. I guess he knew I was missing my little dog back home.
Amazing time from start to finish!  I can't say enough about the  Pilot, full of information and made you feel very safe.  Very smooth flight.  We loved it!!!

My boyfriend lives here in Ketchikan and this is one of the tours he recommends the most. I am visiting from LA. If you are hesitating booking this tour I recommend you book it immediately. It is worth every single penny. This is a family owned business leslie and steve have been doing this a long time. They care about your experience and are always willing to work with you so you can get in and enjoy this your. You can tell it feels like home when entering the waiting room before you board. Being greeted by two lovely dogs Murphy was the cutest. The ride was so smooth. We got really lucky cause it was a nice day. Ketchikan weather can be unpredictable but you know you are safe with each pilot who are local and very good at what they do. The flight there was absolutely gorgeous we had noise canceling headphones that had an amazing playlist. We landed and got out of the plane to enjoy the beautiful scenery. The price is well worth the experience. If you book with other float planes that aren’t local you won’t be able to land and get out. I checked the price of a nonlocal and around 310 and 60 minute plane ride is not worth the experience your able to get here with a 360 90 minute plane ride and being able to exit and enjoy the scenery. The views are absolutely breathtaking and the pilots are very passionate and knowledgeable. thank you again leslie for squeezing me in this flight and for the wonderful experience. 
-martina
We had a wonderful time.  We landed on a lake and was to get out on the plane floats. I would definitely recommend.

Amazing views! Incredible experience for our family 
The pilot was great and showed us the most beautiful scenery’s

review_title: You should definitely book this excursion
review_text:
What a great experience! Seeing the area around Ketchikan by air was awesome. Our pilot was very informative and friendly. Landing in the fjord and experience the peacefulness was amazing. 

We definitely recommend doing this this Seawinds!

Excellent communication and service on excursion day. We were contacted about where they would pick us up at the dock, and updated about weather conditions that were creating a safety delay. We were brought into town and dropped off to explore while they monitored the weather. Once they were confident we could make the flight safely we were picked up in town and we departed about an hour later than scheduled.The flight was wonderful, flying close to areas man can not reach, landing on a lake within Misty Fjord, walking out on the floats and experiencing pure Alaska. The silence, the mist, the rain, the natural beauty, this is beyond what we were expecting!

review_title: Incredible once in a lifetime experience!
review_text: This was an incredible excursion! Breathtaking views and we even landed in the Fjords for photos. Leslie and her husband who is the Pilot were a pleasure to work with. It was worth every penny and would definitely do again! This was a bucket list trip for myself and my kids!

Ich habe über booking eine Flugreise zum Kölner Karneval für kommendes Jahr gebucht. Dummerweise wurde bei Abschluss nach lastminute weitergeleitet, was ich zu spät bemerkt habe. ich habe dann ein Anzahlung von 135,- geleistet und wollte jetzt stornieren. Jetzt bekomme ich eine Stornierungsstrafe von über 400,- aufs Auge gedrückt, und habe dann zusammen mit der Anzahlung Kosten gehabt für eine Reise, die gerade mal 1300,- gekostet hätte. Nicht nur das dies Betrug war, auch von booking eine ganz linke Nummer, denn ich konnte mich gegen die Weiterleitung nach lastmiunter gar nicht mal wehren.

Staff was great and knowledgeable.  Leslie even dropped us off wherever we wanted to go.  They even arranged for us to have a sunny trip.  I was a little worried about landing on water.  No need.  Smooth as can be.
This was a last minute booking when we arrived in Ketchikan on our cruise. It exceeded every expectation we had. Absolutely amazing and our pilot was fabulous. Loved the dogs at the dock too!

review_title: Needs to be on your bucket list!
review_text:
This is one experience you don't want to miss if you come to Ketchikan! It's on the top 3 adventures that I've ever done (the others being Running from the Bulls in Pamplona, and Hot Air Ballooning over the pyramids in Teotihuacan, Mexico). 

Steve (pilot) is so experienced and he knows the area like the back of his hand. He flies that float plane around the fjords like an eagle, knowing when to turn, rise and descend! His play list was pretty amazing too. I mean, you can't beat Africa (Toto) or Only Time (Enya) as you are overlooking a magnificent view! Then the landing in one of the lakes was breathtaking. 

Last but not least, Leslie (customer service) was so professional and sweet. They are a lovely couple (owners) and I wish them the very best.

Highly recommend!

Edgar

Great flight with a very experienced pilot, including a landing on one of the lakes. The scenery is awesome and it was a treat to ride in a classic Beaver floatplane. This trip followed the fjords, flying at eye level with the tops of the steep cliffs.
Amazing seaplane ride!  Views were amazing ride was so smooth.  Great people that run business, friendly and welcoming!!!  Highlight of our SE Alaska vacation!!!   Must do!!!

review_title: SeaWind Aviation will not let you down! Worth every penny.
