review_text: We had an incredible time on our flight through the Misty Fjords. We lucked out with a gorgeous sunny morning. I had no idea there are so many lakes! Waterfalls, rivers, everywhere you look the view is unbelievable. Absolutely beautiful. The take off and landing were so smooth we couldn’t tell if we’d landed on or left the water. The flight was smooth and comfortable. The noise canceling headsets with microphones were awesome and made it so easy to still interact with each other and the pilot during the flight. The lake landing was a treat to get out and wander nearby. We had a rough start realizing that the third party we had booked through hadn’t communicated with SeaWind and they didn’t have our reservation the morning of our flight! You can only imagine our panic! Leslie went above and beyond to find a way for us to get in a plane, even though they were fully booked for the day. She worked a miracle and we could not be more grateful! Don’t hesitate for a second to book a tour with SeaWind Aviation. They care about their customers, their prices are very competitive, the employees are friendly, welcoming, and put us right at ease. I can’t say enough good about our experience. We will definitely fly with them again. Thank you SeaWind for a marvelous time!
Beautiful scenery. Friendly people who were very flexible to our schedule and weather. Highly recommend!

Looking over the Misty Fjiords with green forest contrasted against the white snow. It was beautiful.  The pilot was experience, knowledgeable, and very personable. The entire experience was the highlight of our visit. Would do it again.

review_title: perfect flight from an outstanding team
review_text: had a brief delay only due to weather which is understandable since its a weather dependent excursion.  very nice and intimate plane ride although we rode with another cpl and gentleman me and the wife felt we were on a private flight.  i was impressed with the plane as it was built in 1956. It was very clean and well maintained. Our pilot did a perfect job of narrating enough as well as just letting us enjoy the vistas and scenery as when no one was talking we enjoyed the laid back songs he had on the headsets.  Not knowing when you actually leave the water and land again says a lot about the skills of our pilot.  The area had just recieved over 4 inches of rain in the previous days and we enjoyed every bit of the Tongass area with overspilling lakes and streams.  To say the flight was worth it after a while you just put down the iphone camera and just enjoy it because it was just too much to capture.  one thing that struck me was that the whole time as we boarded flew landed later on the mountain lake and headed back i never once felt like we were in a rush or that the pilot was on a strict timetable his intention was to allow us to see the area instead of it being on a stopwatch.  i would highly recommend this trip as it truly can be a once in a lifetime experience as theres no way to appreciate the area than by flying over it.  Would also like to thank the seawind team they let us at ease knowing that we could enjoy our trip and they would personally drive us back to our cruise ship since we had a shorter than normal port call.  so dont let a short port call dissuade you from booking , if they say you wont miss your ship ...you wont miss it.

review_title: Wonderful flight experience over Alaskan mountains!
review_text:
We booked a seaplane flight and water landing (for an extra fee)  with SeaWind directly after comparing to other similar opportunities online. Lesley and company did a fine job from the get-go, communicating with us throughout the process, to the morning of our flight, until we were dropped off just feet from our ship. Part of her difficult job was delaying our flight an hour, then telling us that we would not be able to fly over Misty Fjords and visit the monument due to cloud cover and flight conditions. Instead of cancelling the flight, we were offered another, sure to be beautiful, instead. We accepted. 

Our pilot Anthony was fantastic; a local who loved flying, was excited to take us over an area they rarely get to fly over with a group, and told personal stories along the way. The "lake landing" was the highlight, bending into a postcard-like scene to the (unplanned) song "Paradise". The landing was soft and serene, we were able to get off the plane (one in our party even took a icy swim) for an all-too-short but sweet visit. We saw mountains, valleys, peaks, waterfalls, and tried to spot animals, milking every moment. Headsets were used as my wife interviewed a patient and thoughtful Anthony from her shotgun seat. It was a smooth, beautiful flight we will remember forever. Thank you SeaWind for a great experience from start to finish. 

If we had to nit-pick, the only glitch may be that as we eagerly waited to board the plane, some in the other party we flew with still had to register and pay, perhaps delaying our flight, which, due to weather, was already an hour+ behind schedule. We still got a full tour as promised, but felt a bit rushed at the end due to a short 4 hour Ketchikan visit. 5 stars.

Great communication. They said the bear viewing was not good this time of year and offered a full refund or another trip. We took the Mist Fjord trip and it was excellent. Our pilot Anthony was awesome.

Amazing experience, great views. 
Highly recommend. 
Leslie was very accommodating and let us change tours when there was not much chance to see bears. Super friendly team, would book with this company again. Family loved the tour, even a very hard to please son.

Well organized. Flight was delayed because of weather. A+ for safety.
Guide was knowledgeable, great experience.

I chose to fly with Seawind Aviation on recommendation from my father who has had two previous tours with Steve Kamm.  The whole experience was fantastic. We flew in a vintage float plane which added to the overall ambiance. Steve and Leslie took great care of our needs and were so professional. They actually remembered my dad! What great people who obviously love there state and sharing it with others.

11 out of 10!  3 of us took a flight on a whim while our cruise docked in Ketchikan....couldn't have had a better experience from the booking to the flight to the return landing where the whales were jumping when we got off the plane.
If it seems pricy, know that this experience will never be forgotten.
Our pilot put us all at ease and talked about the beauty around us.  He seemed to enjoy the flight as much as us!!

It was a thrilling experience being up in a seaplane. The extra bonus of landing in the fjord was the smoothest landing I have ever experienced. Our pilot gave a great narration and had a keen eye for spotting black bears and mountain goats and then circling down for a closer view.  An amazing way to see God’s grandeur!!!

Our first float plane flight. The tour was great. The takeoff and landing was very smooth. Excellent pilot/tour guide. They picked us up at our ship and dropped us off at a restaurant that we wanted to go to. The owners and family were very outgoing and nice. They made us feel right at home. The tour was great. I would definitely do it again.
We had a wonderful experience with SeaWind Aviation.  The whole Staff was amazing.  It is such a beautiful flight.  I highly recommend it!

We booked the Traitor's Cove Bear view tour. The lady for pickup is super nice and friendly. The view from the flight is fantastic, but the pilot is silent throughout the flight, not a single word of introduction, which is quite different from my other tour experience.As of the bear view, it really depends on timing and luck. I heard from the guide that sometimes there are 5 bears at the creek eating salmon. But I only saw a bear for 1 minute during the hour we stay on the platform.

This was my favorite adventure on our Alaskan cruise. It was fabulous! The beauty of the fjords literally brought me to tears a couple of times. Anthony, our pilot, made us feel safe and in knowledgeable hands. I highly recommend Seaview Aviation and visiting the Misty Fjords. It’s one for the bucket list.

This was a great tour. The views were amazing! 
We booked with SeaWind Aviation after poor response from another company we found on TA. 
SeaWind correspondence was excellent. We booked our tour, and received an email detailing what to expect and what to do when we arrived. We actually got there early that day, called Lesley and they were able to take us on the tour then. Lesley and the rest of the staff were exceptionally nice and told us exactly what to do and where to be. It couldn’t have been easier. The pilot was really great, and full of knowledge about the area. Great company. Great employees. Highly recommend. We even got to see some seal on their dock. Bonus!
Absolutely fantastic. Highly recommend. It was the perfect ending to our trip to Alaska! The views were incredible and the pilot (and owner of the company) was friendly and accommodating.

Tour cancelled at the last minute apparently due to rain in the area - we were not informed and had to call (at £1.40 a minute) in panic, especially as our NCL ship had docked in a different port to where Seawind has advised us it would dock - we had to call them to say we would be a few minutes late but they said it was cancelled anyway. We saw other sea planes flying that morning and could not understand why we could not be offered an alternative such flying later, or to another area where bears were. We were refunded but that doesn’t make up for a trip we had been planning for 3 years being a 50th trip, and booked over a year in advance. It’s not as if we can get back to Alaska any time soon living in the UK. We have not been offered any good will gesture such as a future discount. We feel very let down by Seawind Aviation.

We booked a trip last minute. And if you think customer service is gone you need to book a trip with seawind aviation. Not only did Leslie try to find us another tour since they were booked she made some adjustments and got us a trip and she even picked us up herself. We had a great time what a experience. Even my wife enjoyed it and she is afraid of flying. We highly recommend this tour our pilot was very knowledgeable and kept us informed the entire flight.

review_title: Amazing encounter with bears in an isolated place
review_text:
Wonderful experience with Seawind aviation ! I contacted them because this type of excursion were fully booked on our cruise (NCL Encore0 and they answered right away with the right level of detail. On our excursion day, they were nice enough to drive us back to the deck when city shuttles were gone (wonderful, as it would have been an issue)
On top of that, the excursion was amazing. Our family of five and a couple only. We went to an isolated island, did a 10 minutes walk in the woods before getting to the plateform. We were alone, a bit scared as the bears were right around us, but felt very safe with our guide, who was also very knowledgeable and interesting. An amazing experience for us all
The views were breathtaking, flight gave a true perspective of the Alaska landscape, and touch down on the water was pure fun!

From the time we were conveniently picked up at the cruise dock til we were dropped off, the staff was exceedingly friendly and efficient. Anthony was our pilot and he was outstanding. The trip itself was incredible. Yes, it’s a bit pricey but what isn’t these days?  You will always have the opportunity to earn back the money. Will you have the opportunity to take a trip like this again?

This was our plan D. Literally we had 3 cancellations on our Alaska Trip. But what a plan D it was. They came through with very little advance notice, and we enjoyed every minute. Make this your plan A, save time.

This was a great trip!  It was a beautiful day and we had a wonderful seaplane ride and a beautiful short walk through part of a rain forest.  Our guide was great and very passionate about the rain forest.  I was bummed that we did not see any bears, but it was still a great and memorable trip!

Absolutely loved our Misty Fjords Flight!!  Beautiful views!! The entire Seawind staff, especially Leslie,  were very welcoming and friendly.  They were very accommodating with changing our flight,  when a few days before our cruise,  our Ship schedule changed and we visited Ketchikan on a different schedule.  Our pilot was awesome and very experienced!   Landing in the fjords and getting out on the pontoon was such a thrill!!   We loved everything about this and would definitely recommend Seawind Aviation to anyone going to Ketchikan!
The plane ride was sooo much fun. Landing on the water in the fjords was a fantastic experience. The views were unbelievable.

review_title: Great flight to the Fjords in Ketchikan! Highly Recommended
review_text: Outstanding experience with Sea Wind!  Flight and tour to Misty Fjords was spectacular.  Truly fun landing back up on the Fjord and getting some amazing photos. Our pilot and ground staff were friendly, welcoming, and helpful when making reservations and selecting a flight time that worked with our cruise ship schedule.  Great family run business who truly enjoy what they do.  The Beaver was in great shape, comfortable and the com system in aircraft was clear and worked well.  I would certainly fly with these folks again.

We absolutely loved our Misty Fjords Sightseeing tour run by SeaWind Aviation. Leslie and Steve run a wonderful business and are great hosts. The flight was super smooth and our pilot was friendly and knowledgeable. We are grateful to have visited the "Misties" and would recommend a sightseeing tour from SeaWind Aviation to anyone visiting Ketchikan!

There was "no" favorite part, the trip exceeded all expectations. Lindsey and her staff were very professional. Steve, our pilot, was informative with his narrations and provided answers to our questions when asked. Would highly recommend!

SeaWind Aviation was fabulous! The family owned company was friendly, responsive, and professional. Our flight over Misty Fjords was stunning! Owner and pilot Steve gave us a wonderful overview of the area with commentary, along with classic tunes playing in the background. Highly recommend it!

review_title: Great Floatplane Tour of Misty Fjords
review_text: Floatplane flying with Ed was fabulous. We hit a perfect blue bird day and smooth air. Could not have been better...unless it lasted longer. We saw a couple of brown bears, and so many beautiful lakes. So worth the time and fee to take in this adventure.

review_title: Spectacular mountains and cliffs in the misty fjords
review_text:
We had a great time from moment of the shuttle pick up at the hotel until being dropped off after the flight.
Everyone cared about us from the shuttle ride to the seaplane pilot. Answering questions about what we're seeing and things to do and see in town. 
We would highly recommend taking this flight and seeing the fjords.

Excellent. This Misty Fjords tour was absolutely the best part of our Alaskan cruise. Steve and Leslie were amazing. Ultra kind people and great communication. Leslie and Steve were great about helping my older parents on an off the plane. Steve is a great pilot. We will always remember this experience.

This is an experience you don't want to miss. Beautiful.

Thank you Seawind Aviation!

The Green Family
Pleasant, timely, comfortable, accommodating and safe.  Seawind  is the call you make when wanting or needing flights.  See you guys again in July and August with our groupst!!!!

Today was our first day ever in Alaska.  We docked in Ketchikan this morning, and we were scheduled to take a flight seeing tour aboard a seaplane in the Misty Fjord National Monument, BUT….we received a notice on our door last night that our flight had been canceled. Super sad, we decided to just spend the day walking around Ketchikan and I was going to drown my sorrows by eating King Crab. I mean sounded redeeming….anyways. We spent the morning wandering around town, and after about two hours found ourselves back at the visitor center. We went in to see if there were any tours and voila! Another flight seeing tour! We booked it. We then waited until the time to go, boarded the van, and then….cancelled. It’s windy apparently. 

Sadder than we were before, we just started walking across town. Full bags on camera gear in tow…we walked. And stopped and ate crab. And then we walked. And then!!!!  Haha We found an eagle!!! Just sitting there. Good sign right? And then we found more eagles, and so we just kept following the eagles, until we reached Seawind Aviation. It looked closed, but I walked in. No one was there. I jiggled the little bells on the door, and moments later the kindest people appeared. I asked if there were any seaplane tours, and they were like “sure!! We have one that can go at 13:30?” We jumped on it, and the rest was history! The third time really is the charm and saved us from leaving Ketichikan a little bit sadder.  We could not have asked for a better experience. 

We had a wonderful time! Highly, highly recommend them. Steve - our pilot - has been flying in this area for over 30 years. Could not have asked for a better experience. 

Oh. And those eagles we followed….all apparently hang out at Seawind Aviation. 🥰🤗 It was just meant to be for us, and we could not have had a better day. Sometimes things just work out as they should and birds always know the way. 😉

Amazing! Friendly staff and very accommodating. I was mid-cruise when I called to see availability. Knowing that I didn't have access to much communication being on a cruise they handled everything for me and when I got to my next port. I had an email confirmation waiting for me. Everyone was organized well and the flight was great. I was a bit scared but once we took off, all that fear was gone. Beautiful views all around and a very comfortable flight. The hour flew by, pun intended? Not intended? You decide.

Our tour was scheduled for 8AM but it was too windy when it was time to leave so they got us on the 11AM tour and we were able to still do the tour. It was an absolutely amazing experience. The BEST way to see Ketchikan. I would highly recommend this tour and Seawind Aviation.
We were looking forward to the our and we were nothing but impressed by the staff and beauty of the scenery. I will return in the future

SeaWinds was awesome and super personable! I went on my Misty flight with only two other guests so I got to sit co-pilot for some extra special views. 

The tour was great and sights were pointed out to us along the way, but our pilot also just let us take all the amazing scenery in. 

Bonus points for two adorable doggie mascots!
A glorious experience not to miss. Beautiful scenery you cannot see any other way. It might help to make plans a day in advance.

Can’t stop talking about the adventure. Staff was phenomenal, we had to change our tour due to weather and they went out of their way to give us a spectacular day. This was our first time in a float plane, could not believe how smooth the ride was. The scenery was spectacular from the air.  Dave guided us into the rainforest to the viewing platform where we were greeted by 3 bears feasting below.  He was very informative and answered all our questions. Just as we were gathering to leave another bear greeted us lumbering down the trail. Close enough to get our heart rate going, lingering a bit longer than I think anyone would have liked but our guide was prepared and after a long ponder the bear decided to move on and enjoy his salmon. We stop by a picture perfect site in the rainforest to punctuate the day. Thank you!

Steve and Leslie run a highly efficient, welcoming, safe and accommodating flight service.  They are some of the nicest people you'll meet, Steve has been flying for 30+ years in Alaska, and the location is easy to get to.  They have two DHC-2 Beavers, and a C-185, so the size of the group is not limited.  We very highly recommend this business, and these people, for your flight needs when in Ketchikan.  

Merritt Weisinger
Sparks, NV

review_title: Awesome….amazing…would go again in a heartbeat!
review_text: This was the highlight of our trip! What a great experience….Steve and Lesley are great to book with.  We had a beautiful day in Ketchikan and the views were spectacular!  When we climbed aboard they asked for a backseat volunteer….I jumped at it and boy was I glad I did.  I was the only one back there so I was able to take pics from both sides… not that you can’t upfront but I didn’t have to reach over anyone.  I had a lot of room..5”5.  …climbing in and out was pretty easy as well…slow an easy on the steps.  Landing on the lake was….so cool!… the lake was like glass, the pics we have show the reflection of the mtn & clouds on the lake…amazing.  I’m actually still smiling from the experience!   I would highly recommend you book with SeaWind Aviation.

It was a great great time! Dave was our guide when we got to the forest and it was INCREDIBLE! All of the staff was great and kind. Dave was super knowledgeable and you could tell he loved his job more the just the money, he had a true passion to love and show you bears. We went in late august in the morning. More people seemed to book the afternoon so if you’re willing to get up early you will probably have less people!

My first time in a De Havilland Beaver Aircraft. Boyhood dream. On my bucket list. My wife, Cindy, set up the tour for me. Lesley and Steve were great. The flying and tour far exceeded my expectations. Felt like a kid again and I am 66 years young. If you’re in Ketchikan, Alaska go fly with SeaWind Aviation. Great Company!

HIGHLY recommend this company!  Eric was an awesome pilot.  It was a smooth ride with a gentle water landing.  Leslie was so nice, knowledgeable & accommodating - even driving us to lunch in town after the tour.  Dave our Bear guide taught us so much about the bears & salmon run.  Best excursion of our trip!

review_title: The Highlight of our Alaska Cruise
review_text: Seaplane tour was an amazing way to experience the beauty of Misty Fjords! Scenery was stunning throughout the flight. Landing on a lake with the chance to get out on a small lake was a true highlight. Seawind also coordinated with us on our flight time since or cruise ship arrived late, picked us up at the NCL Ward Cove dock, dropped us in Ketchikan after the tour, and later took us back to the ship. They were also easy to get a hold of via phone.
Highly recommend!!! It was beautiful to see parts of Alaska only seen from the air 🙂 Getting to land on the water and get out was fun as well!!

Absolutely breath taking. We flew low enough to get a great view of everything. Our pilot circled the main features to make sure both sides of the plane got to see. The island stop was so beautiful and really gave us time to absorb everything around us.

Lesley, Steve and Dan provided top notch service as we explored Traitor's Cove Bear feeding site with their professionally run organization!

The experience is amazing, Dan's knowledge of the area and nature that surrounded us was superb, and Steve's flying confidence and sky-tour of Ketchikan and surrounding area was extraordinary. 

Per their plan, we were able to see a handful of bears feeding on the live salmon in the river leading inland...

We would do this again in a heartbeat!

PS Shelby was wonderful on the very personal shuttle service!!  :)

review_title: Customer Service left much to be desired!
review_text:
We had a truly beautiful flight out to Misty Fjords today with an excellent pilot but some very rude behavior by one of the employees at the office left us wishing we would have gone with a different operator. After our flight was over we asked if it would be okay to leave our luggage in the office while we grabbed lunch. We came back to pick it and paused on the gangway to admire a lovely group of seals who were hanging out on the dock. After a few minutes a dark haired man came out of the office and angrily yelled at us,  “You need to get out of here, you can’t be on the dock.” I told him we were there to pick up our luggage and he said “I know but you need to leave. If the FAA saw you on the dock it would be my ass”.  
If it’s an important rule, then put up a large sign and if you need to ask customers to move, ask in a friendly, polite way. Having an employee aggressively holler at me after spending $750 on plane tour tickets definitely left a bad taste in my mouth. It’s also worth noting that the free shuttle pick up advertised on the website seems to only applies to the cruise ship docks. We were in town on a sailboat and weren’t able to get a pick up at a marina that was 15 minutes down the road or a ride to the airport afterwards.

SeaWinds came to our rescue when I booked the wrong flight off POW island!  They responded very quickly, sent a 185 floatplane to pick us in time to meet our commercial flight in Ketchikan!  Mike was an excellent pilot and very engaging in conversation.  We will definitely use SeaWinds again and highly recommend them!

We flew with Eric on a Mistry Fjords floatplane and it’s beautiful. The whole flight was so beautiful and pictures don’t do justice. My daughter was given the co-pilot seat and that was special for her. We did it book in advance, and Danielle worked hard to make it happen for us. It’s expensive, but so worth it!!

This was a highlight of our Ketchikan visit. Owner and local pilot Steve is a personable and fun guide who gave us a great afternoon flying through the Misty Fjords. We put down on a little island in one of the lakes to enjoy the scenery and take photos. The Misty Fjords did not disappoint! Highly recommend!

We did a lot of things while in Ketchikan for the week including two days of fishing.  Of the 6 of us on this trip, all said that this flight tour was by far the best part of the entire trip.  This experience is truly once-in-a-lifetime and cannot be missed.  The professionalism and preparedness of the pilot and crew were outstanding.

We did not come off a cruise but were staying in town.  Staff was very helpful in coordinating pick-up and delivering us back.  It was a great flight and our pilot was fun and informative.  We were very lucky with the weather - clear beautiful (but warm) day

My preference was to book with Island Tours with Michelle but she had nothing going on for a solo.  She recommended calling Carlin or SeaWind. Carlin had nothing available. Carlin emailed SeaWind, called me back and said call Lesley, they have 2 openings. All 3 are local long term family operations that will be best to do a tour with.  SeaWind Aviation was AWESOME! Thank you to Jeff the pilot( spotting our several bears) and Leslie for great pick up, drop off and coordinating the whole experience.

review_title: A must do if in Alaska this is an absolute must
review_text: Amazing trip and knowledge by the pilot. The trip not just had amazing views but an amazing stop and so much knowledge and answering of questions. I would recommend to anyone!
Wonderful flight with Steve in the Beaver!  Staff was super kind and attentive, picked us up and dropped us off after. Saw bears too!! Can't miss out on this awesome experience!

What an amazing day due to the expertise of our pilot, Steve. So many gorgeous sights on such a clear day.  Our favorite part was landing ( seemed like we were gliding onto a lake with the clearest water. Were able to spend some time walking around for a bit. This experience was our favorite part of our entire trip..absolutely unforgettable! Would do it all over again and ask for Steve! His wife, Lesley was great too.
Excellent! Easy to work with and very flexible. We appreciate the friendly intetactionand and their willing to provide great service on short notice.  Wonderful people.

Will use this service to go bear watching in Alaska and we flew in by sea plane and were taken to a look out where we got to observe black bears catching salmon and eating them. It was a great experience that the the owners were great to work with.  We would definitely do it again.

We had a great time during our flight with Seawind Aviation seeing the Misty Fjord area.  The flight was wonderful - able to see the beautiful Fjord with the lakes and other scenery.  We were lucky to see sheep during out flight.  Everything was perfect during our time with them.  This is a great company and would highly recommend them when visiting the area.  We had arrived via cruise ship and this is not part of the cruise ship packages -but would still recommend it.  Will book this again when visiting the area.  Thanks Leslie and Steve for the great experience.

This was an absolute two thumbs up experience! We had the best time and were very well taken care of. The views were unreal. Getting the opportunity to land on a beautiful lake in Alaska was a wonderful experience that I won't forget!  These were super sweet and accommodating people and we really appreciated it!

Wow! Thank you all for an Amazing Adventure of a lifetime.  Thank you Leslie,Jill and Pilot Steve! We highly recommend this trip to everyone 
 You won't be disappointed.

Our group traveled to Alaska via cruise ship and I was a little nervous booking an excursion that was not offered by the cruise line. I had nothing to worry about...thank goodness for stand-up service, and a company that'll keep its word. Due to circumstances beyond anyones control our excursion had to be cancelled. Within hours of canceling our entire fee was refunded to my card. If I'm ever in Alaska again I will definitely book another excursion with SeaWind Aviation.

review_title: Excellent staff, highlight of our trip, absolutely breathtaking views!
review_text: Seawind was very professional and friendly!  What an amazing seaplane tour with breathtaking views!  Well worth the money spent, it was the highlight of our Alaskan cruise.

review_title: Best flight tour of my life, very professional, tops in flight safety!
review_text:
As a professional pilot, I am always pleased when seeing flight excellence and a very professional approach to giving the public a great and relaxing experience. All of staff were a joy to spend this time with, and the rates were very competitive. Our group of 8 all feel we had the experience of a lifetime! 
Will certainly do this again on next cruise, next season.  
John and Cathy Krings and family and friends
Organized, Informative, Gracious hosts. Our tour was brilliant. Highly recommend the gang at Seawind Aviation.
This was the highlight of our cruise to Alaska. The company is very professional and well organised. The pilot was outstanding. Highly recommended.

We had an great experience with Sea wind Aviation. We can highly recommend this company. They picked us up in the city and we had a great flight with an landing in a mystic sea. Pilot explained everything. Make this trip when you come to Ketchikan.

This was such an amazing day. It’s a family owned business and the owner Steve took us on our flight this day. The views were breathtaking. He had music playing but any questions we had he would answer as we were all on a two way radio. If we saw wildlife he would make a circle so all of us were able to see it. We landed half way through our flight and got our for pictures and to take it all in. Then loaded back up and headed back. This was definitely a highlight of our trip. We will definitely fly with SeaWind Aviation again and highly recommend them.

review_title: A Must do in Ketchikan. Highly reccomend
review_text: Am a local and took some friends to fly with Seawind last week they were so impressed that my wife and I went today. Absolutely awesome trip saw bears and mountain goats. and an incredible view of a humpback whale bubble feeding. Scenery was spectacular and Steve was very knowledgeable. Owners are local and know Kechikan. Thanks Lesley and Steve for an amazing time.

As with most people who make it to this area we arrived early morning via a cruise ship. I scheduled the tour same day online (much, much cheaper than any tour offered from the cruise ship) while waiting to get off the boat. We were a group of four and ended up with two extra for a total of six on the flight. SeaWind offered to pick us up from the pier which was awesome however we elected to walk which was an easy half mile from the peer. Our pilot was super knowledgable and also our tour guide. The tour hit all the highlights included a stop on one of the lakes to stretch our legs and enjoy the scenery. The total flight was an hour and half and an awesome experience I would recomment to anyone in the area. For anyone coming off a cruiseship, if you are looking to splurge this is it, you can only see the Fjord from sea or air and it is absolutely worth it.
I highly recommend this tour. We saw lots of bears and our guide even got closer to take some pictures for people in the group. We had really smooth landings too.

review_title: The beauty is astounding. A must do trip.
review_text: Eric was our pilot. He did a great job. He is a bit quiet at first but if you get him talking he is a very interesting man.

Great clear day to see the sites. Great Captain and tour guide pointing out all the sites including the mountain goats.
Would recommend this trip.
Ron Krawczyk

Steve and Leslie have a family owned and operated float plane operation.  They called promptly after the cruise ship disembarked and made arrangements to meet us. Steve explained a lot about the area that we flew over and set us down gently on a beautiful mountain lake. He pointed out a bear! 

Highly recommend. Please know those with mobility issues may have trouble getting in and out of the plane due to stepping on the pontoon then up into the plane. Also it’s a tight fit inside. If we are ever there again will look them up!

A true fabulous experience!
Well operated by an excellent staff.
The pilot Mike made the adventure unique.
Can’t wait to go back.
Thanks the opportunity of a lifetime.
See you next year...

We were a group of 12 and half of us did a bear tour and the other half did Misty Fjords and carb feast. Both groups agreed that the Seawind Aviation tours were highlight of our trip. From the moment of booking, customer service was impeccable... and we drove them crazy with last minute changes. They were able to accommodate all of our requests and communication was always timely. It was a pleasure working with them and we cannot recommend enough!!!

review_title: Soaring above the Misty Fjords & Ultimate Crab Feast
review_text: Outstanding adventure provided by Sea Wind Aviation. Started off mingling with seals on the dock, meeting our pilot Mike & soaring over alongside of docked cruise ships & town of Ketchikan on our way to the Misty Fjords. Mike noticed a bear on shore and circled around for us to get a closer look. He narrated a beautiful landscape for us pointing out numerous waterfalls and topography like no other. We landed half way at a dock to stretch our legs and see a few other sea planes. Then we were off again for more breathtaking scenery en route to George Inlet lodge for our ultimate all you can eat Dungeness crab feast. Succulent sweet, rich and delicious crab with unlimited beer, wine & soft drinks. If you go don’t wear anything fancy, it’s a bit messy but you won’t mind, best crab of my life, your plate & glass will never be empty. Jill, from Sea Wind provided extraordinary customer service as I called her several times with questions. This is a family owned business where safety and customer service is top priority.

This tour could not have been better. Float plane was excellent; Drew O'Kane our guide was incredible-he really knew his stuff; we saw about 8 bears in a safe relaxed setting as they searched for salmon.  Leslie and the other Sea Wind team members were wonderful.  Couldn't recommend them any more highly.

This was one of the best excursion ever experienced.  We booked though Alaska Shore Tours.  Kat @ AST was very helpful getting us on the right tours.
As far as the tour itself, Drew, the Bear Guide, was awesome.  The people from Seawind were very friendly.  We saw at least 5 bears, eating salmon right from the rapids.  I felt like I was a National Geographic photographer.

Besides the birth of my sons,  viewing 7 bears eating salmon at Traitors Cove was the best experience in my lifetime! It was so magical I even hugged the owner, Steve, who was our pilot after our trip. I simply couldn’t help myself!  Our very experienced and quite entertaining guide, Drew, was excellent! The walk through the Lord of the Rings land to get to the bears is beyond description. This experience is worth every cent including tipping Drew more than we have ever have before on any excursion. Enjoy!
I enjoyed my ride very much.  My pilot, I think Chris was his name, was very knowledgeable.  Pointed out landmarks and answered questions from all. The view was awesome.  I hated for it to end.
Last minute decision to take this flight.  Great service from fitting us in to providing transportation.  Flight was beautiful and informative.  Fun for any age.

review_title: Shuttled from Ketchikan to fishing camp and back;   excellent aircraft and pilot
review_text: Alaska is a magic land and Steve and Lesley are the best as are their staff;  helpful, smart, and dedicated
Excellent excursion. Beautiful sightseeing. Very friendly customer service. My 7 year old daughter enjoyed this tour very much.

Loved it!!
What a beautiful wilderness and what a lovely way to see it. From the air you get a feel for the vastness.
We landed on a tiny beautiful remote island. such a special way to experience nature.

Customer Service Outstanding! Experience was superb! Thank you Leslie, Naomi, Eric and Ilse. 

Joan & Duke

First time taking a seaplane and WOW!  We were a group of 3 and got the whole planes to ourselves and the pilot.  We spotted bears and landed in the water where we walked around a secluded shoreline.  Spotted bear tracks and even tried a salmon berry!  Our pilot graciously took our picture in front of the plane with the mountains in the background.  He was a better photographer and knew my camera better than me!  Thanks for making this a once in a lifetime experience.

My wife and I recently sailed on an Alaskan cruise and were disappointed when on the first day we learned that our previously booked float plane excursion had been cancelled. In port at Ketchikan we were able to find a tour through Seawind Aviation and couldn’t have been more pleased with our experience. 

Naomi met us at the terminal and drove us to the Seawind office and dock, where our pilot (Steve) and floatplane were waiting.  The plane seats six, and everyone has a window seat with a great view. We made our way through Ketchikan Harbor and into the unbelievable scenery of Misty Fjords. It was a foggy morning, but this didn’t hinder our views, and only added to the “Misty” environment.  We didn’t see a ton of wildlife but we did see a black bear searching for salmon. Steve was great mixing informative commentary with a little bit of humor. 

The whole operation is top-notch, and we are so glad that we were able to book a tour through Seawind.

This was an incredible trip and a "must do" while in Ketichikan.  Leslie at SeaWind is great to work with.  Steve our pilot was awesome.  The Crab Feast is off the charts.  The Crab was tremendous and the best I've ever had.

Our pilot had 30 years of experience flying in the area.  This company has 3 planes so they are not hard pressed to find experienced pilots.  We heard about the back to back deadly plane crashes in April 2018 and were very concerned about booking this tour.  After doing long research we found out the crashes were with a competing company and not Sea Winds Air.  The crashes were caused by pilot error.  When I booked this tour I asked many questions and found out that all the pilots that are at Sea Winds Air have many, many years experience.  We felt better about booking and did so.  Our flight was amazing.  Our pilot was knowledgeable and very friendly.  We saw a full humpback whale from the plane.  When we landed on the water in the Fjord we saw seals.  I highly recommend this tour.  It was fantastic.  Our ship was delayed getting into port and we thought our tour was cancelled but they were able to get everyone in and back to the ship on time.  It was very well organized with excellent, excellent communication.

Our fifth trip to Alaska, and we were so happy to find this combination of two of our favorite excursions.  Wonderful seaplane flight - landed on a lake and walked on the wings - then to the lodge and all that luscious crab.  Another great day in Alaska!
Super fun. Beautiful sights. No bears seen though a different group saw. Half way both us got nauseous. Take dramamine. Other than that it was great.

My family took this flight on a trip to celebrate my Mom’s 90th birthday.  What a ride!  The company treated her like a queen.  The pilot was professional and safe and even spotted a bear for us.  The booking and pick up were seamless.  The staff went out of their way to make everything perfect, even following up later by sending my mom’s photo to us.

review_title: Amazing morning flight in misty fjords
review_text:
Eric was our pilot. What a great experience. Would recommend to anyone
Very informative of area. Landed in the lake watched a brown bear.
Breathtaking flight with excellent views! Pilot and staff were friendly and personable, and gave great information on the scenery. Would definitely do again.

Took this flight two weeks after the two crashes on another air tour company.  I was apprehensive, though my husband was not.  Even though the weather wasn't the best, the whole flight was great.  The pilot was knowledgable and friendly.  He knew the area well and made the entire experience a delight.

Excellent trip from start to finish. Very friendly, courteous service, from the welcome, through the boarding and flight, to the transfer back to town. Super smooth take-off, flight and landing, including the one on the fjord. We had a long flight over the wonderful scenery and were blessed with good weather too. Couldn't always hear the commentary clearly, but otherwise can't fault it. Thank you.
We covered a lot of ground and really good visibility even though the windows seem small. Friendly staff and great facilities, also convenient to the dock.

It was my b day and i took this excursion woth my fiance 
We had a great time ! 
Very good pilot and the tour was fantastic!! 
The scenary is unbelievable and you can t forget the beauty of this place ! 
1 hoir and a half of joy peace and beauty !

A great flight over the Misty Fjords, with a pilot and 6 passengers.  Our pilot provided great information about the local lifestyle, the scenery, and answered all of our questions.  We landed on Lake Grace and had some time to walk around the coast and see some wolf tracks by the water.

The views, although a little hazy due to the weather, was well worth the trip.  You just can't see all the lakes and peaks from the water.

The pickup from the port was very simple, and they were even willing to drop me and my husband off near the trailhead we were hiking next.

review_title: Flight was okay,  Feast was awesome
review_text: The flight was smooth and beautiful.  It was a little on the short side though.   The crab feast at the lodge was great though.  If you didn't leave full and satisfied it was your own fault.   I also didn't realize that Beer/wine would be included.

I've wanted to take a float plane trip for a long time, this trip to Alaska was the ideal time.
We contacted Seawind and booked our trip. I love flying but have a problem with claustrophobia, so I contacted Steve and his wife and they very kindly saved the co pilots seat for me.
We were met at the cruise ship dock and taken to the sea plane base by a friendly member of staff who gave us information about how the trip would work.
The weather was a bit cloudy but our pilot took off and chose the best route to give us wonderful views and a great chat about the geology and formation of the mountains.
We saw a bear and made a landing up on a lake. The views of Misty Fjord were great, just a little rain.
We returned to base and had a drink and then took us back to the centre of town.
It was a great trip.
Wow what amazingly smooth & professional flight, So very friendly staff as well.We will definitely do this again.

My wife and I were in Ketchikan for a few hours (cruise stop) and had originally schedule a flight tour with another company.  They cancelled on us about 2 days prior!  But we were able to find Seawind on Viatour, and we salvaged our visit!  They couldn't have been nicer.  We were picked up just outside our ship and taken the short distance to the "airfield."  (And after, a different driver took us to Creek Street...both drivers were delightful and friendly).

The trip was amazing and beautiful.  When we spotted a bear, our pilot made sure to circle back around to give us another view.  And we landed on a lake for a chance to just stretch our legs and enjoy the scenery around us in relative quiet.  Our first experience with a float plane...what fun.  Smoothest landings ever!  Great experience, and a great business.
This floatplane ride was one of the highlights of our trip! Our pilot, Steve, was great! Beautiful flight, amazing sights and easy take off and landing. We loved it!

We were picked up at the Cruise Port and taken to the Seawind Flight Center. There were 6 of us in the group and we each got a window seat with noise reduction headphone that we can communicate with the pilot and other passengers.
The sceneries are breathtaking. We see waterfalls. rugged mountains and fjords.
There is a landing on a lake which is peaceful and tranquil.
Everything goes smoothly and we were dropped off at Creek Street for a stroll on our own.

We had a beautiful flight over the Misty Fjords with our flight captain Eric. Pickup at the harbour was easy and fast. We hopped on the plain and took off which brought us to a lake in the Misty fjords. It was a memorable experience and would definitely book then again and recommend them!

Even as a retired fighter pilot this was one of my favorite aviation experiences. Our pilot/guide was Steve, a true professional that clearly enjoys his work. His knowledge of the area, skill and aviation skills made the tour exceptional in every way. The weather cooperated and added even more to the breathtaking scenery. I would not miss this tour, it is a great value in time and money!
They cancelled on us at last minute stating the weather. At the same time three other companies were still selling the air tour including their agent. We ended up booking with a diffrent company.
Great trip!!!! Super nice family that owns and fly's the planes, Must see country that you can only see from the air!!!!

Excellent flight with a well experienced pilot who had lots of information about the local area. We couldn't have wished for a better trip. We even saw a bear on the mountain top. We would highly recommend Seawind flights.

Excellent service and very friendly family run business.  Well organised. Wonderful experience seeing the beautiful scenery and although it was early in the season and a hot day the pilot did his best to find us some wildlife. Excellent bald eagle spotting at the start point of this flight too.  Felt safe and confident. Highly recommend doing this tour with Seawind Aviation.

Steve our pilot was filled with knowledge of the area. We had an amazing ride through the fjords. We landed in one of the lakes and explored the area. We cruised the harbor on the way back to the dock. Excellent tour!!

review_title: To Leslie and steve and Drew and all the wonderful staff at Seawind aviation
review_text: My mother and i flew with you in September you treated us like royalty courteous friendly professional and yes even lovingly i thank you from the bottom of my heart we enjoyed our time with you so much a trip of a lifetime because of you truly Richard lessor and Dolores Ackley ocala Florida

review_title: Good bear viewing at Margaret Creek, Tongass National Forest
review_text:
Their driver was a little late picking us up but then it was only a 5 minute drive to the plane and after checking in we were able to depart on schedule. We were very lucky to have a fine day as all their flights were cancelled the previous day.

Both flights were very good with no problems at all. In fact we were the only 2 clients that day so it was just us and the pilot on the plane - a private tour for the group price which has to be great.

Our bear guide Drew was very friendly. We wondered if the platform would be crowded, well for most of the time we were the only people there although one group left soon after we arrived and another group arrived just before we left. Again we were very happy.

The viewing platform was quite high above the creek and it was rather dark with black bears in a dark creek for photos, but the experience of seeing the bears was excellent. We saw 5 or 6 bears all quite close to us so we were very happy.

We were returned promptly to our ship.

This was an excellent tour and we would recommend it.

Terrific excursion--the highlight of our vacation! Our seaplane pilot and bear guide were fantastic, and the SeaWind staff were so welcoming and enthusiastic. Although they do not guarantee a bear sighting, we were lucky enough to watch a bear catching salmon and lumbering around in the rapids. The seaplane journey was so beautiful, we would have been happy, even if we hadn't seen the bear. Well worth the cost. Also, crew very aware of cruise ship departure, and timing back to the port.

We took our trip in August 2018. It couldn't have been any better.  Our pilot was very knowledgeable  and the flight was smooth. We enjoyed landing on the water and stopping on the isolated land and walking around. We even saw animal tracks. The scenery was outstanding.

My wife and I had a great time with Seawind Aviation. Our pilot, Anthony, did a fantastic job and showed us some incredible sights. We landed in the middle of a small lake where there was a little rock island. We got to walk around and really take in the spectacular views. After that we headed back. Highly recommend!

A wonderful experience. From the online booking to being picked up by the super friendly shuttle service to an amazing flight, Seawind aviation were super friendly and professional. Would highly recommend this family business. Lesley, the owner, was so cheerful and happy to accommodate our needs. Mike provided a superb flight for us. Best decision to go with Seawind.

I didn’t have plans today and contacted Lesley who was able to get me in on one of the trips with an open seat. I’ve never been on a float plane before, but it could not have been any better. The pilot was confident and knowledgeable. Steve and Lesley are great. Take offs and landings were smooth and the fjords were beautiful. I highly recommend this professional company for a wonderful time.
The tour was awesome, great views of inner Alaska, the float plane was awesome, our pilot seemed bothered when we would ask a few questions, glad he knew how to fly the plane.

The Floatplane trip to Misty Fjords was smooth from takeoff to landing, with amazing views and a terrific pilot. All of the folks associated with Seawind, from the driver who picked us up and dropped us off (at our restaurant destination!) to the pilot and the owners were friendly, enthusiastic and a pleasure to meet. We strongly recommend Seawind to anyone interested in a Floatplane trip in Ketchikan!

review_title: The highlight of our Alaskian Cruise
review_text:
We booked Seawind at the last minute and were afraid to expect much from this experience...but they flew us to a out of the way cove and we got to experience bears fishing for salmon and interacting with each other. This was all behind a blind on a platform.  
I felt they were realistic in predicting bear encounters and were prepared for all eventualities.  The guide knew each bear by behavior and markings. The pilots were very experienced and their support staff was professional.  
As a tourist,  every once in a while you meet outstanding companies that do their job better than anyone else that you've worked with.  
I would come to these guys anytime i needed flights in SE Alaska.

The tour I booked from the cruise had gotten cancelled, so a bunch of us in the same predicament signed up last minute at the dock with Seawind Aviation, and what a stroke of luck that was! We took a comfy van to their office and arranged the group into two small aircraft.  One person in our aircraft became very claustrophobic as soon as the door closed and insisted on being let out, which the pilot did very graciously with no issue at all.  Once at the cove Drew our bear guide was fantastic, injecting fun in our group with antics like making us do a "bear dance", hokey but he put such a positive vibe on the tour we played along and had a great time and always felt safe.  Even though he must see hundreds of tourists each season, he knew that for each of us this was likely our first time seeing the bears like this, in their element eating salmon, and he helped make the tour live up to our expectations and then some.  We probably saw about 5 to 8 bears total.  Highly recommended!!

review_title: An expensive nap for our 4 year old!
review_text: Everyone was so friendly! I was a bit nervous about the flight, but we couldn't have asked for better weather and our pilot was confident, experienced, and informative. My 4 year old took a nap about 10 mins in, so leave the littles on the boat is my advice! ;) It was amazing to see and I did feel safe, albeit nervous, but that's just me. It was a once in a lifetime view and the folks who run this had smiling and reassuring faces to help. :)
Great trip. Expensive but worth it! The staff were professional and accommodating and we saw lots of bears.

GREAT trip. The owner and her husband were gracious and professional. The bear guide
was very knowledgeable and entertaining. The flights were smooth and fun and not scary at all . My family loved and highly recommend this!
This company is the best.  Pickup was as instructed and the check in was easy.  the plane trip was incredible and our pilot was great.  I would highly recommend this trip.

Pictures never can justify or convey this breathtaking experience. Our pilot Andy was very knowledgeable, skilled, and let us enjoy the views with the right balance of narration. The flight was safe and comfortable.We booked this trip directly on the website and not via the cruise line.Well worth the price and magnificent 1.5 hour actual flight time with a water landing nearby a dock.Would do this again. Highly recommended!

We wanted to buy our friend a special birthday treat so booked at seaplane companies in Ketchikan with the idea of a short sightseeing flight.
Most had pre-designated trips with a lot of them including a food stop etc.  This was more than we really wanted and bumped up the cost.   However Seawing agreed to take us for a 30 minute "flightseeing" jaunt by piggybacking onto another group of 3 who were going to a crab bake.  This meant that we had our required flight with 2 landing and takeoffs.
Our pilot was great and detoured to see humpback and orca whales as well as finding a black bear on the return journey.
Really friendly and accommodating enterprise.

review_title: Flug über Gebirge, statt zu den Bären
review_text: Gebucht war ein Flug zur Bärenbeobachtung westlich von Ketchikan auf einer Insel. Da leider wenig Waser, wenig Lachse und damit auch keine Bären am Zielort waren, wurde ein Flug über Gebirge vorgeschlagen und von uns angenommen. Das war schade, aber wohl nicht änderbar. Vielleicht ist die Zielstelle nicht so gut geeignet. Der Flug über das Gebirge bei Ketchikan war sehr schön. Beeindruckend war die Gewaltigkeit des Gebirges und es waren die teilweise senkrecht abfallenden Berghänge. Es gab auch eine Zwischenlandung an einem Fjord.

review_title: Great experience apart from last minute changes!
review_text: The overall experience was amazing. However, we had booked the 8am flight and were meant to be picked up from our ship at 7:30... at 7:15 I got a phone call saying they would pick us up at 8:45. We had another excursion booked for later that morning so this was a problem. We were able to do both but we no longer had time to explore the town and had to really rush lunch which was a shame.

review_title: Nice Float Flight in Misty Fiords
review_text: This was a great start to our tours in Alaska, a floatplane flight landing in Misty Fiords.  When our pilot spotted a whale along the way, we circled to have plenty of time to see it.  We had four tourists in the plane, and since I had a big camera he let me have the back seat alone so that I could shoot from both sides of the plane.  We landed in the fiord and had plenty of time for photos before returning.  The pickup gal called me when we got mixed up on the pickup time but made sure when we made the flight just fine, also back in plenty of time for our ship to board early.  Good day!

We just got home from an Alaskan cruise and the Misty Fjords Flight Tour was a highlight. From the moment we made the reservation, the Seawind staff was very friendly and helpful. Naomi met us promptly at the dock with a smile. It was super easy to find the van and the dock was only a short ride away. We were lucky enough to have the plane to ourself with a party of five. Eric was our pilot and he did a fantastic job narrating the things to see. We weren’t sure about going on a float plane, but it was worth every penny. We would be happy to do it again. We highly recommend SeaWind Aviation.
excelente servicio, una empresa familiar muy comprometida con la atencion, el viaje maravilloso unas visrtas ecepcionales

I booked a trip to Traitor's Cove directly from the website, which was pretty easy to navigate, and received confirmation of the booking within 24 hours (it might have been closer to 10 hours). 

The directions in terms of where to meet were very clear (by the berth next to our cruise ship's), and the vans were clearly marked and easy to find. It was a short drive to the Seawind office/dock.

We flew in one of the 7 passenger De Havillands. It was surprisingly comfortable. We spent a few minutes figuring out seating, which did worry me. (What if someone lied about their weight and they balanced the plane incorrectly?) However, the flight went very smoothly and we were able to see a lot of the Tongass National Forest on our way to Traitor's Cove. On the way back, one of the kids decided he wanted my seat (to be closer to his little brother), and so we switched with no discernible difference as to the smoothness of the flight. I guess the weight balancing didn't need to be that precise!

Our plane had two-way headsets which the kids tested out. The flight itself was somewhere between 20-30 minutes long. Our pilot provided commentary on the way out, but gave us time to just look out and relax on the way back.

After the flight, we took a short drive, and then a short walk to the viewing platform. Along the way, our guide reiterated the bear viewing/safety guidelines, and pointed out native plants and fresh bear scat.

We were the first group of the day to arrive at the viewing platform, where the USFS ranger pointed out a bear who was already fishing for salmon. In all, we saw 7 bears (or maybe 8?), including one who walked right under our platform, and a mama bear fishing with her two cubs. We also saw salmon jumping, and two bald eagles. We stayed for about 2 hours - one group arrived and left while we were there, and another arrived about 30 minutes before we left. During that time, the platform was never crowded, and there was plenty of space for everyone to get a good view. My binoculars were handy at times, but not necessary, as most of the bears were very close.

This was an incredible experience! That being said, I understand that it is heavily dependent on Mother Nature's cooperation and I was lucky. We were told all flights the previous day had been cancelled due to the weather, and that viewing in July had been poor as the lack of rain had affected the salmon run. However, the easy communication, the smooth and scenic flight, and the friendly and knowledgeable guides made all the parts under human control excellent (and the bears were great as well :-)

review_title: Seawind Aviation Misty Fjords Seaplane Flight
review_text: Great experience, a must do trip when in Ketchikan. Definitely a trip to remember. This company was very easy to deal with and very accommodating. They provided a very personalised experience and nothing was a problem. Will be recommending them to friends and colleagues.

The staff was very friendly, the pilot was experienced and knowledgeable and gave us an excellent review of the areas we flew over.  He went out of his way to make this an absolutely wonderful experience for us.

They say a picture is worth a thousand words, and I can honestly say the views were priceless! Our pilot was very informative and provided us with a thrill of a lifetime...thank you for a memorable experience!

Great Service!
We were picked up at the airport and driven to multiple locations so that we could pick up various items needed at our final destination which was Coffman Cove.  They gladly accommodated our needs saving us money on cab fare before our breathtaking flight across Southeast Alaska.  A special thank you to Lesley who's friendly smile and positive attitude made us feel like we were the only thing that mattered and we all appreciated that treatment.
Wonderful views and much cheaper than cruise ships.  The take off and landing on the water is a once in a life time opportunity. Steve was our pilot and a great tour guide

review_title: Extraordinary once in a lifetime adventure with a great company and expert pilots
review_text: The highlight of our cruise was our amazing flight tour of Misty Fjords out of Ketchican in June 2018 with this family owned business. Spectacular scenery flown over by an expert pilot with a stop at a mountain lake. We even got to see mountain goats from the air. An amazing adventure we will never forget!

Extremely scenic flight, and longer than I expected.  Our pilot was knowledgable and skilled.  We landed on a lake in the middle of the misty fjords- so serene and beautiful.  Definitely a great excursion!!

We had a great time on our tour.  Everything was perfect.  Great weather, clear skies and we even got to see a couple of whales.  A beautiful view of Alaska. Highly recommend this excursion while in Alaska.
The Misty Fjords flight seeing was incredible, well worth it. The staff and pilot were very knowledgeable and pleasant.

review_title: amazing seaplane flight and crab feast
review_text: The weather was a clear warm sunny day.  Could not have been more perfect flying conditions for seaplane flight to Misty Fjord.  Our pilot was clearly very experienced and all take offs and landings were smoother than in regular commercial flights.  The landscape was beautiful.  He landed us in a small inlet where we were able to get out of the plane walk around and explore for about 10 minutes.  Very idyllic and fairy tale.  We then were flown to George Inlet for all you can eat dungeness crab within less than an hr.  Eat fast!  Van ride back to cruise ship.  Guide pointed out a bear that no one else was able to spot.  Overall an amazing trip.
Awesome way to see the area. Pilot was amazing, landed so smoothly. We were greeted by a lovely young lady who took us to the area where we boarded the seaplane and everything was so smooth.

The flight was above and beyond all that I expected. To land on a prestine lake, step out Ona small island and experience the peace and tranquility was outstanding. The staff are to be commended on the service provided.

Once on the bus to go to the float plane dock, we were informed that our tour would be in reverse order, with the plane ride at the end. As it turned out we went both ways by bus due to bad weather. Just know that they will run this tour with or without the plane ride. We booked this through our cruise line, and they were kind enough to refund all but $99 because of this. Even with this discount it was an overpriced crab dinner with ZERO history of the lodge, (wouldn’t have even known the name of it except for the sign by the gift shop) ZERO smoked salmon, no fireplace (I think we were in a smaller overflow dinning room). The bus rides were Dull and uninformative. Highlight of this tour was the host at the lodge (friendly and accommodating) and the all you can eat crab which was excellent.

review_title: Float plane ride to free tops lodge
review_text: Awesome first experience in float plane. Mike,the pilot was great!! Fun, informative and safe!!!! Seawind very accommodating and customer focused

My family went on this as an excursion during our Alaskan cruise. I had called a few months before and the customer service is great! They helped us plan out the best times according to the cruise schedule and even gave us a discount for our large group (10).

They gave me a call before we got off the cruise and I had their phone number on hand, just in case. When we got there, everyone was super friendly. We split into two groups and took two planes.

The scenery is just gorgeous! We flew between mountains and over several bodies of water. In one area, the pilot spotted orcas and landed our plane near them so we could get a closer look. It was such a unique experience. My nephew was super happy during this part. We later landed on a dock for a break and took some pictures in the Alaskan wilderness. My cousin spotted jellyfish here! When we took off again, we spotted bald eagles but were unable to see any bears this time around. Still, I was so happy we got to see the orcas at such a close range in the wild!

The only thing I would caution anyone about is motion sickness. The planes are small and you feel a lot of movement (especially when the plane turns). My nephew got sick but the pilot was prepared with bags and paper towels. He was very nice and understanding. The rest of us were fine. So, please make sure to take medicine if you need it!

Overall, I would definitely recommend this activity to others. You always hear about lots of wildlife in Alaska but it still surprises you when you actually see it. We also had great weather, so it was a memorable and fun time.
Очень понравился тур на гидросамолете в Туманный фьорд. Непередаваемые эмоции от увиденного. Все было на высшем уровне.
This was an Amazing Excursion, totally worth it!!  The plane ride was surreal and the misty Fjords were Beautiful!!

There was a plane crash (not a Seawind Aviation plane) on Prince of Wales Island four days before we arrived by cruise ship in Ketchikan. The pilot of that plane, which had 10 passengers on board, safely landed on top of a mountain and nobody was seriously injured. However the accident made our cruise company, Regent, nervous and there must be of course some potential liability issues until the crash is fully investigated and the cause is determined. 

So our cruise line canceled any excursion in the Ketchikan area that had to do with flying. We did not want to miss the Misty Fjords so we got online and saw the great trip advisor reviews for Seawind Aviation and booked our tickets the night before for the next morning. A married couple owns and runs the company, and the husband, Steve, was our pilot. We liked everything about our experience with Seawind and the couple that run it, and we highly recommend!

By pure luck we booked this excursion for our cruise stop. The flight was the smoothest landings and take offs I have ever been on. Steve, our pilot, was informative yet also gave us time to take in the splendor that surrounded us! Landing in the lake at 300 ft above sea level to a place only available by sea plane was unreal. If I am ever in Ketchikan again, I will definitely be booking another flight with Steve! The whole crew was so sweet and genuine! Thanks for being the best part of our vacation!

review_title: Amazing Views and Experience with a Personal Touch
review_text: This company is friendly and very welcoming. Our pilot and his wife were delightful! We were loaded on a well kept plane with only 4 other people. Our pilot, Steve, was insightful but also let us just take in the awe and beauty that surrounded us. His take offs and landings were the smoothest I’ve ever experienced. The private stop on a lake was breathtaking! Highly recommend!!!

SeaWind Aviation was absolutely amazing to work with! From the moment I called to book our trip to the minute we stepped off our cruise ship, I had a great experience. They answered all my questions leading up to our float plane tour and the tour itself was incredible. There really are no words to describe the scenery we saw, nor do our pictures do the Misty Fjords justice. Oh and the crab...to die for!! Visiting George Inlet Lodge was an experience in itself. Our group consisted of my husband and I, our son with his wife and baby, our other son and our daughter. We loved it and enjoyed every minute of our adventure! Thank you SeaWind Aviation for an amazing family adventure we will never forget!

We had a great experience flying over the Ketchikan region, truly beautiful, Highly recommend this adventure. There was a last minute change of plans with the plan due to weather, so we were not able to land and experience landing and venturing back in the fjords, however, Seawind reasonably adjusted the price before we left. We recommend Seawind for a flight over Ketchikan, I would do it again if in Ketchikan!

We are a group of 21,  booked through Seawind Aviation for the Misty Fjords excursion. We got a discounted group rate , I called at least 6 different companies, before calling them, She gave me excellent price  and also the best service. She  had trouble with 2 of her planes, but able to manage to book us through her friends company as took all 21 of us at the same time, as promised. The Excursion itself is phenomenal ,breath taking views. the Pilots are so good. Over all 5 star rated company.

There were six of us getting off the cruise ship and after a short walk around the cute town we met our guide.  Also, they have a kiosk in the visitors center if you need to talk to someone.  It was very rainy so I was nervous about the flight, in general, and also being cancelled.  The staff was very nice and accommodating and after a safety talk, we were off!  The plane was comfortable and safe.  The pilot was great and played music when he wasn’t narrating which was very soothing to me.  The views were spectacular and this is one of those experiences I will never forget.  We all agree that we would do this again with this great company!
Take offs and landings were super smooth.  We saw lots of bald eagles, a bear, and lots of beautiful scenery.

review_title: Crab Feast and Float Plane Flight
review_text: Arriving at Ketchikan on the Oceania Regatta cruise ship, our tour took us on about a 15 mile, guided bus tour to the George Inlet Lodge, where Patrick continually filled our plates with delicious Dungeness crab until we said, “No more!”  Then he brought out the cheesecake with blueberry topping.  After lunch, we boarded a float plane that took on a tour over the local inlets and mountains before landing back in Ketchikan.  Fantastic!

Awesome misty fjords experience up close with experienced and wonderful crew. We were able to even spot multiple whales, landed in an awesome scenic place. One caution though is don't fly right after a meal, as some of us didn't do well with that. Overall we were welcomed and entertained very well.

So impressed with Lesley and her husband. Their hospitality was top notch!
Our flight to George Inlet Lodge included beautiful scenic views as well as whales, mountain goats, and bears...oh my!

This was my husband and my second trip - this time we took our daughter, son in law and 3 teenage granddaughters.  It was magical - everyone loved it.  Steve, our pilot was the a wonderful guide, as well as an experienced pilot and fun.  Lesley, his wife made this so special and Jill our van driver was fabulous.
Thank you Seawind for making this  such a special event.

review_title: An amazing excursion idea and fun for all....
review_text:
First.. I would like to thank Steve, the owner of SeaWind Aviation and also our pilot for the excursion.  He was full of fun fact and knowledge on the areas we flew over/through.  The background music he played couldn't have been more perfect for the duration of our flight.  The views were AMAZING!  I was with my fiancé, my Dad and my Aunt on this and we all were in awe of the beautiful scenery you get to take in from so far up.

When I knew my cruise ship was going to be doing a stop in this town and I asked online what was the best excursion to do in the area, several people on social media responded to check out SeaWind Aviation AND I'm so glad we did!  I highly recommend this to everyone, you wont be disappointed.
Awesome!!! Beautiful!! Great way to see Alaska!! Love our stop on the mountain top lake!!! Wonderful pilot and staff!!  Crabs were delicious!!! Friendly staff at the crab feast!!

review_title: Wonderful flight, breathtaking scenery, knowledgeable and friendly staff
review_text: We have flown with SeaWind Aviation before and always found them to be exceptional.  They are very safe and caring. Their pilots have extensive knowledge of the Ketchikan region.  They care about their customers. The pilot made sure we were able to capture the spectacular scenery and pointed out wild life along the way, even circling back to ensure we got a good view.  We enjoyed landing on a remote bay and stopping off at the dock. SeaWind are welcoming and very professional. They also pick up and return to your cruise-ship. We have complete confidence in their tours, and we will definitely fly with them again.  Their quality of service and extensive knowledge is what all companies should aspire to have.

review_title: Beautiful view and great service.....You will not be disappointed..
review_text: Great friendly service...  Great experience for the whole family.   They pick you up and return your to your ship or hotel.  During the flight the pilot pointed out wild life and circled back to make sure we all got to see.  We got to see a black bear, Orca Whales, Hump Back Whales, and eagles.

I made a last minute reservation online and SeaWind was able to accommodate me on the next flight within an hour. SeaWind went the extra mile to make sure I had a great experience. The flight was spectacular. Our pilot Adam was very knowledgeable and pointed out a ton of landmarks and wildlife including a humpback whale, a bear, and several bald eagles. The staff were all super friendly and helpful and Lesley and Terrie even drove us above the town to take pictures on the ride back. SeaWind provides a safe, professional, and fun experience. Didn’t disappoint!

Our pilot was fantastic, very couteous. The flight was fun and beyond beautiful! Then the crab feast, so very delicious! Our hostess/waitress at the crab feast was a total delight, the crab is wonderful, as is the cheesecake, so save some room for it! Just a wonderful excursion, I can't say enough!
This is a top quality company with excellent tours they will provide you with a great your no matter which one you choose

review_title: Stuff Your Face & Fly With The Eagles
review_text:
My trip began with a bus ride from the dock to the lodge (perhaps a half hour trip), then the crab feed, then a flight back to Ketchikan.  Depending on when you go, the order may be reversed.

The trip up was on a comfortable bus, with a fun driver.  Plenty of local color and stories.

Then the feast.  As many dungeness crab legs as you want, with all the butter you want.  Delicious.  And messy.  Dessert is cheesecake, but you can skip that and have more crab if you prefer.

The flight back was on a 1950s vintage Dehavilland Beaver with up to date avionics.  Surprisingly short take off run.  Then over the island to Ketchikan and a smooth landing.  My first flight in such a small aircraft and it's a very different sort of experience.  The trip is short, but fun with great views.  And if you you are lucky, as I was on this trip, you can find yourself soaring with Bald Eagles over the forest.

We arrived at Ketchikan, May 4, 2018 on Holland America and booked a seaplane tour of the Misty Fjords National Monument for four people, $239 each. 

When the weather looked like it was not going to work in our favor, I called Leslie to cancel. This was a same day cancellation, just hours before takeoff. I was afraid Leslie would not accept the cancellation or charge me a hefty fee, but she was incredibly helpful. She told me she understood and didn't want us to fly if we couldn't enjoy it. This is what customer service is all about! Often, we out-of-town folks get the short end of the stick, squeezed for our hard-earned dollars with overpriced activities. We also don't have control over the weather so we can be hesitant to book expensive activities dependent on good weather. But there are a few operators like SeaWind Aviation who will work with you. 

I appreciated immensely Leslie's help and professionalism, and though we sadly never did the tour, I highly recommend SeaWind Aviation based on their customer service and helpful cancellation policy. Book at ease, Leslie and her team will work with you even if the weather won't.

It’s been a life long dream to fly in a beaver over Alaskan fjords! Steve absolutely surpassed all our expectations! He was knowledgeable, easy going, safe, and had a great sense of humor. The weather turned out to be gorgeous the day we arrived in Ketchikan and Steve readily accommodated our last minute change of flight to an earlier one. My fiancé and I had the best beaver experience EVER! This is what I love about smaller companies—you’re not just another number. Seawind Aviation was warm, welcoming, and treated us like old friends!

Seawind Aviation will not only provide you with a great scenic trip their customer service goes beyond excellent this is one company you need to visit for a lifetime memory no matter which tour you reserve

review_title: At Least a 10 Star Amazing Trip
review_text: Can't say enough about this tour and staff.  Pilot Steve's love of Ketchikan was wonderful.  The vistas and sights while airborne were epic, We had a beautiful clear day and were able to view all of the amazing sights.  Was fun landing in the water and arrive at a large dock in an isolated area with again outstanding views.  Landing so soft you didn't even realize you landed.  This is a must do in Ketchikan only way to see is to go UP.  Thanks to Steve for a great trip.

Seawind arranged to pick us up from our hotel and to us to the dock where the plane was moored. After introductions and a friendly briefing we set out, skimming across the harbour, past the cruise ships. It was a morning flight and the low cloud was just clearing, giving periodic glimpses of the countryside. However, very soon, just as promised by our pilot Steve, the cloud cleared and the views were stunning.
