Steve pointed out mountain goats as we passed them close by and when he spotted whales, he circled around them, low down, to give us a good view. We landed in a remote and totally peaceful fjord and disembarked onto an island. The other couple on the plane with us were going to an organised 'crab feast', so we had an extra landing while they were dropped off. Everything was great - from booking to the flight itself. We would thoroughly recommend Seawind.

Sea Wind was a pleasure to work with on our excursion -- great communications and nice people.  The bear watching at Traitor's Cove with Sea Wind was one of the best Alaska excursions we had -- Leslie Kamm did a super job communicating .

We were met at the dock and taken to the SeaWind office for a safety video.  Then the adventure began. We had a superb flight and saw wonderful scenery and wildlife. It was a top-notch trip start to finish.

We highly recommend this excursion! Our flight to the bear oberservatory was over the top! We wanted to see bears & did we ever--10 to 12 to include a momma bear & her 2 cubs plus bears fighting over a salmon! It was thrilling to see the bears in their natural habitat! Thank you Seawind staff for this wonderful experience. You were all so kind, friendly & knowledgable!

Enjoyed this excursion very much. All staff were very friendly and welcoming. The floatplane ride from Ketchikan was smooth. Our guide made us feel safe and secure in the forests of Prince of Wales island. Immediately after arriving at the viewing platform, we saw several black bears. Throughout our two hour stay there were two bears fishing, and I got some good photos. My only comment about the flights is that they are mostly over water with not much time for sightseeing, but that's fine because the focus of this excursion is bears. On the way back to the ship we were dropped off in the city center to see a bit of the town, all part of the service.
This was a highlight of our trip!  The ride was smooth, the scenery amazing and the crab was delicious!
This was an excellent tour.  Probably as close to backwoods bush piloting you will ever get not living there.  Pilot was great an knowlegeable.  So beautiful!!!

We so enjoyed this adventure.  It was a partly cloudy day but once in the fjords, there was a beautiful mist of clouds running through them.  The pilot had great commentary on the fjords and the background music was very peaceful and perfect for the setting. The landings were so smooth we almost couldn't tell when the plane was on the water! There was a little turbulence in the air but not so much that it made anyone sick and one in our group was prone to the that. We all loved the views and the ride!
Our group of six took this tour yesterday and it was simply amazing. You can see why they call it Wild Alaska! Owner operated and very well maintained equipment.

Friends of ours had taken a trip with Seawind before so we were quite happy to go with their recommendation. We were on a cruise but booked this excursion privately. They picked us up and took us to their nearby office. I asked if we would need binoculars and they said it wouldn’t be much of a trip if you needed them. Whilst they do not guarantee bears they were pretty sure we would see some. The 20 minute flight is very smooth and we are met at Traitor Cove by our guide Drew and his very large gun. It is a quick drive to the sighting area and short walk in to a secluded “hide” to watch for bears. We knew they were around as there was some evidence. After a very short wait we saw bears coming down to the water to hunt for salmon, without much luck. However just watching the bears was a fantastic experience. Drew was an excellent guide, although the jokes he tells need some work. The flight back was great as well and the pilot even responded to a request to fly over a lodge owned by some friends. On arrival back at Ketchikan they were going to take us back to the ship but when we asked for a good place to eat they went out of their way to take us to a local restaurant. This was an epic journey. Seawind are a first class operation. Thanks guys.

Although the weather didn't allow us to do the flight we wanted, Lesley was able to get us  a shorter flight  that was still wonderful. They really make everything easy and the pilot was first class. I strongly recommend using Seawind if in town.

It was a quick flight and couldn't hear the captain to well because of static noise.  Not a lot of information about what we did see was given.  We were expecting to see more.  We probably would not do it again knowing this.

This excursion was booked after our helicopter/glacier tour got canceled due to weather...and I’m so glad we did it! The flight was stunning and smooth! The scenery was just spectacular, especially when we landed! Our guide was excellent...The treck  through the rain forest to the viewing platform was very smooth and absolutely gorgeous! We saw 5 black bears and a cub! They  fished  and ate - the mama fed her baby - we saw two of them get into a brief skirmish over their fishing spot!! It was one of our  favorite excursions!

This small family run company was excellent with a personal touch and great care to provide service that was warm, friendly and highly efficient. They went the extra mile to make sure we got a memorable experience. When the Misty Fiords trip was cancelled due to weather conditions they arranged for us to fly out to see bears instead. We flew to a remote area and were rewarded with close views of a mother and two babies on a salmon fishing walk. A Memorable moment of our Alaskan trip

We had a wonderful experience with SeaWind Aviation. Our family loved the flightseeing of the Misty Fijords on a beautiful Alaskan day. All of the personnel were friendly and helpful. Making reservations was easy and there was a savings from booking through the ship's excursion. We were also told that if the weather did not permit our flying that day, our deposit would be refunded. Our crabfest was so delicious and more than we could possibly eat. We would highly recommend this activity and company.

review_title: Bear watching on Prince of Wales Island via float plane !
review_text: Absolutely superb, fantastic flight, fantastic guide (Drew) and we saw black bears !! The bright blue sky and sun helped also !!

This group was awesome...
Great flight, but our guide Drew was awesome!  He was confident yet funny.
I would highly recommend this experience.

My friend and I was on Regent Seven Seas Cruise and could not get onto the cruise-offered Bear tours in Ketchikan as they were all full.  We then happened to try this Seawind Floatplane Bear Tour which was sold at the pier (by a gentleman called Terry Chandler).  It was a fantastic and well organised tour. Seawind is a family operated aviation service run by Steve and Lesley Kamm.  They were such nice people and you feel safe as well as being well taken care of at the same time.  Not the big commercial feel at all.  The guide, Drew, who went out with us to find bears was also extremely hospitable and professional at the same time.  I am actually very happy that I did not get onto one of the big Regent groups - I am sure the Regent Tour would have been good too - it is just that there is a caring and non-big-corporate feel to the Seawind Aviation Bear Tour.  My friend and I joined up with another family of three, which makes up a cosy 5-people group to go out on the floatplane to see bears!

AND WE SAW BLACK BEARS HUNTING SALMON ON THE RIVER AND WE WITNESSED A CATCH WHICH WAS FANTASTIC!!  Drew was helpful throughout the tour to look for more bears (we saw cubs on trees with their mother keeping watch, too!). Overall a most wonderful tour.

Thank you, Seawind Aviation, for looking after us well.

review_title: One of the best experiences in Alaska
review_text: This was our 2nd time in Ketchikan but we had never done any Sea plane trips that local companies advertised, however this time we decided to do it. We chose SeaWind Aviations bear trip. We had just came off the cruise and waited patiently for a Mini bus to pick us up. We got in the Mini bus and were greeted by a very pleasant local lady. It was about a 10 minute drive from the dock to where we were departing to see the bears. The Check in building was small and cosy there were to 2 sofas and an area in the back were you could keep large bulky bags because they were not allowed on the aircraft. We flew in a de havilland Beaver flown by a former carrier pilot Fred. It was a short but memorable flight lasting about 20 minutes. Once we landed our guide (Who was hilarious) asked us to follow him into the forest. I advise everyone to wear appropriate shoes and bring mosquito spray. He took us through the Forrest to a viewing platform were we saw the beautiful black bears and Bald eagles. it was an amazing experience and a must do.

review_title: Always my choice for floatplane service
review_text: I have flown with Seawind Aviation the last two trips to Ketchikan and wouldn't consider not using them for floatplane services.  Steve, the pilot is great, Leslie the manager is awesome and all of the employees seem to be trying to make my vacation as fun and rewarding as they can.  I trust them completely to get me and my friends to and from the airport and our destination with as little hassle as possible. They couldn't be more accommodating.  I would recommend them without hesitation to anyone travelling through Ketchikan.

Seawind Aviation was the perfect choice for our floatplane trip to Misty Fjords. The pilot was knowledgeable and shared a lot of information about the history and the flora and fauna of the area. We didn't see much wildlife, but we did see the beautiful, unspoiled fjord. It was breathtaking!  Taking off and landing on the water was smooth, yet exciting. I had the back single seat with perfect viewing on both sides. This was definitely a highlight of our trip to Alaska. We highly recommend Seawind Aviation.
Our flight from Thorne Bay was very pleasant. Pilot was professional and friendly. Staff in Ketchikan were very accommodating and friendly.

I booked the Misty Fjords trip in July 2017. The booking process was simple and efficient. We were in a plane that holds 6 customers; 1 in the front & back and 2 sets of seat together. I was in the front for the first part of the trip which was a great viewpoint. We had a 2:00 schedule that was moved up a couple of hours and this worked out as our cruise ship was already docked. They kept in touch with us to make sure we knew where to be picked up (right in front of the cruise ship). We took a 5 minute van ride to their dock and flew out from there. The flight and scenery were amazing ! Would highly recommend for all!

We booked the Misty Fjords trip in July 2017 and SeaWind was great.  The booking process was easy and efficient.  They accommodated our family of 11 in 2 planes so that we can go at the same time.  SeaWind made sure to get in touch with us before the trip and contacted us several times to make sure we knew where to be picked up.  Then the flight was spectacular!  Highly recommend for all ages!
Great family run outfit, great day and guide.  Float plane flight and seeing bears was a trip highlight.

I have the feeling that I chose the wrong tour. This was Traitors Cove and I wish I understood what it involved: 20 min each way in hydroplane (exciting) with 2 hours in the rain hoping to see something. I would not have paid $700 plus for 2 people. This is more than 20% of the cost of the whole cruise!

We saw no bears, just rain. But the guide (who spent a good part of the time protecting himself from the rain) made it worse: on our way out, wet and disappointed, he pretended that there was a bear on a tree, just to laugh at us for believing him. Inexcusable.

Save you money. Don't do this.. I thought the hydroplane was going to take us to a place where bears had been sighted. Here, you could more people going back to the plane looking disappointed. And no fish jumping in the water either. Just rain.

From the first contact the communication was great, they provided all the information we needed to find the collection location.  All of the staff were friendly and helpful and the trip itself was awesome!  The Pilot was very knowledgeable and chatty and we had a fantastic time.  Would highly recommend Seawind and encourage anybody going to Ketchikan to take the Misty Fjord Seaplane Trip!

SeaWind does an excellent tour.  Take this tour from your cruise ship.  They pick you up right at port.  No reason to pay excursion prices.  They were very professional.  Great flight and landing for wonderful picture opps.

The Misty Fjord flight was so awesome..   You feel that you can touch the mountains... Got to see Mountain Goats at top of snow caps mountain... The waterfalls were excellent to see coming down the side of the shear mountains..  I opinion that taken a floatplane  is lot better going by boat..  There is lots better of a view of what our Misty Fjords is all about.. Our pilot Fred is excellent pilot and knows his area... Taking off and landing was so smooth... We top off our tour with a crab feed.... We also flew into a lake and got out onto floats to take pictures... As a local I highly recommend taking SeaWind for a  tour of the Misty Fjords... Its breath taking flight...

review_title: A flight to the Misty Fjords Meadllion
review_text: We got a terrific flight and birds eye view of the Misty Fjords, landed, coasted into a beach, got out walked a round a bit and took off again and pilot was an excellent guide even spotting some bears and turning around so we could get a closer look

We had a wonderful flight with Seawind aviation. The views over the coast and fjords are stunning. Our pilot was knowledgeable and friendly, he landed on a beautiful Lake where the was an island that we could get out on. This was much more beautiful than the lake with dock that is usually used. He even pointed out a black bear and flew around so that everyone could see it. 
So very glad that we chose Seawind.

It was easy to deal with the owners. Seamless booking and confirmation.  Pickup and drop off were efficient. 

The actual ride was simply amazing. We lucked out with great weather. The pilot was great with commentary - not too much not too little just right amount. The Misty fjords are beautiful. The pilot also spotted a whale and a bear and did nice 360 to give everyone a chance to see.

The tour was for 1 hour but looks like the pilot never rushed us and may have spent more time.
I had a lovely time.  Family/company was wonderful to deal with.  Felt safe.  Piolet could answer most questions.

We originally booked Seaplane tour on our cruise which was cancelled due to the rain. 
We than walked to the Tourist information office where you can book several tours. 

We finally got to Seawing and they could take us. 
Price was even a lil cheaper than advertised on the cruise. 

Pick up was 20min late which was annoying as they postponed the flying time and we worried that we dont come back for the departure of the ship. 

Other couple had similar issue so at the office after pick up we mentioned it to the staff who called the manager. We cut the flight by 15minutes and also the price got reduced. We really appreciated it! 

The flight was long enough, the captain gave us information. The calm music in the headset made it super relaxing. Even it was raining in Ketchikan, there was clear and good visibilty and no rain over the fjords. 
Superb sites. 

Was our first sea plane, bit anxious about landing but it was fantastic. No bumps, very smooth.

Awesome tour. Fred our pilot was very knowledgeable, friendly and accommodating. Fred allowed time for family photos which I appreciated. He also landed on a remote lake instead of the typical lake with a dock and other float plane traffic. It was beautiful and peaceful where we landed.

review_title: Sunny and clear day flying excursion
review_text: Although we were told that Ketchikan was the rain capital of the world we came and had our very best day of our entire Alaska tour. So on this beautiful sunny day we booked a trip from this very friendly young man at the dock in Ketchikan and told us we would have a great flight. He was correct we had a beautiful flight over the entire area and everyone of the flight crew and their offices could not have been friendlier and helpful. We even saw Dall sheep as we flew over the mountains
Had a great time with Fred, he went the extra mile narrating the trip and did all sorts of turns in the mountains.
Unbelievable sights! Must do while in Ketchikan! Smooth flight. Landing on a remote lake was awesome!

review_title: Float Plane Tour of Misty Fjords
review_text: We had an outstanding tour of Misty Fjords with SeaWind Aviation.  Fred, our pilot, was fantastic...request him!  He was full of interesting info, history, and stories and he is quite entertaining.  The scenery was great and the thrill of taking off and landing on the water was one of the highlights of our entire cruise-tour to Alaska.  I highly recommend doing this, and I highly recommend SeaWind Aviation!

We decided to book a seaplane adventure and this was great.  It's a little pricey, but worth the trip.  Lesley worked with me and my family to accommodate the 10 of us.  When we arrived in Ketchican the weather was bad and the visibility was poor.  Lesley kept in contact with me until the circumstances changed and was able to eventually get us up in the air. 
Mike and Steve, our pilots, were great.  Upon seeing a black bear on shore they circled around to make sure we all saw it.

review_title: We loved Misty Fjords with SeaWind Aviation!
review_text: Seven years ago, we cruised to Alaska, visited Ketchikan, and picked SeaWind Aviation more or less at random for a flight-seeing trip to Misty Fjords National Monument. We were very happy with the trip--I was literally grinning the entire time, it was so fun! So this year, when we planned a return trip to Alaska, including Ketchikan, I looked them up and was pleased to see that they were still there and evidently thriving, with more planes and pilots. We had a different pilot this time, same plane, and loved the trip just as much if not more! I highly recommend them!
Pilots and staff are amazing. We were lucky enough to get a clear day and the views were breathtaking.

SeaWind Aviation was a pleasure to work with and provided a first class experience to me and my guests.  Fred the pilot was professional and did an excellent job as well as the SeaWind Aviation staff.  We landed on a beautiful lake and had the opportunity to see two bears.  Provided shuttle service from cruise port.  Highly recommend if you want to see Alaska from above!!!

We got into Ketchikan this morning and went on the float plane excursion to Misty Fiords. We really enjoyed it. The staff was friendly and met us on time by the visitor center, took us to their place and got us in the air quickly. I booked this a couple of months ago and saved some money. I do recommend them.
Most amazing experience of our lives.  Perfect weather for a perfect day.  Thank you so much for sharing your beautiful part of the country with us.  Pelley and Keller families.

SeaWind was awesome.  From the super convenient pick-up at the cruise ship, to the friendly staff at the office to the actual flight.  I witnessed the staff being super helpful and patient with customers that had mobility issues.  The flight was amazing and included actually getting out at the fjord on a dock to allow for photos.  The pilot was super friendly and knowledgeable.  We had the ability to actually talk via headsets while in flight to the pilot and the other passengers.  The value for the price was exceptional.  It was the highlight of our entire trip to Alaska and Canada.  The folks at SeaWind were genuine, warm and down to earth....not a corporate or cold experience.  Loved it!!!

It was beautiful! I would love to go again tomorrow. We had perfect weather so we were able to see clearly. The company was friendly, and made our trip enjoyable. Our pilot gave us interesting information while flying us over spectacular scenery. We landed on a pristine mountain lake. I would highly recommend this experience.

review_title: This is a great day trip!
review_text: We flew with Steve in a beautiful DeHavilland DH-2, and it was an excellent experience.  I had high hopes, and they were met and more.  From the moment we met Lesley in the van until the time we said goodbye, there were friendly, professional, and great to work with.  The flight itself had very smooth takeoffs and landings, and the scenery is out of this world.  We even saw a whale and a bear.  If you're on the fence, go for it.  These guys are great.

If you are looking for a great plane ride in Ketchikan ,AK., This business offers a great plane ride. Over mountains, water and seeing stuff from the air, Need to check this out. I went with several couples and  rate this a A+ A+ for  service and professional carefree experience.

Had a wonderful time with the whole family flying with Steve over Misty Fjords. Absolutely smooth flight by a pilot you can trust. His narration was spot on without being too chatty. Family owned business, so you guys need to book these nice folks. You even get to see Steve have his daughter fuel up the plane!
Enjoyed chatting about The Masters, Steve....hope to see you there some time! Great trip, very near the cruise ship dock, with pick up and drop off included. Thanks!

If you visit Ketchikan, this is a must do excursion. The scenery, the wildlife, and the excitement of small plane flying make this a wonderful experience. 90 minutes at a reasonable price!
TH - Rockwall TX

Customer service was top shelf and everyone was very personable. They picked us up on time and communicated well on the entire adventure. We booked directly with Seawind and saved some money. Pilot was skilled and knowledgeable. The only negative was limited visibility. One of the employees admitted 75% of flights had this problem. Seems like a great aviation company but understand Mother Nature will most likely lesson your experience even if humans are doing their best to battle her.

SeaWind Aviation provided a great trip to the Misty Fjords. It was a perfect weather day and Steve was a wonderful guide and pilot. Our first trip on a seaplane and it was all I could imagine. Jill is great to book your trip and very knowledgeable about the area. These are all local residents who know lots about the area. This is a must do!
You will not be disappointed!

This was an incredible trip over the misty fijord! Our pilot Mike was great; very knowledgeable, experienced, professional and fun to be with. Everything went smoothly and Naomi was delightful as she picked us up and dropped us off at the ship in a very timely way. I would highly recommend this trip. It was the highlight of our trip!!
This was a wonderful experience and the scenery was breathtaking. Best landing from a pilot I've ever had!

We had a wonderful time. Our pilot was very knowledgeable on Ketchikan and was very skilled in flying the float plane. I took some awesome pictures of the Misty Fjords! I would definitely recommend SeaWinds to anyone!

We flew Seawind Aviation on our Alaskan cruise stop to Ketchikan. It was the first flight of the day...bright, clear, sunny and gorgeous. Could not have been better! Easy to book on-line, find the Shuttle, and the terrific sights and views of Misty Fjords, would do this again in a heartbeat!
Great Excursion in Ketchikan! We booked on our own instead of through cruise ship. It was personalized, on time and an amazing flight!
Great fun!!  Just wish it would have been longer!  Our big splurge on the cruise.  Booked on line and not thru cruise ship.

We booked right on the pier from the cruise ship so we could ensure we had good weather.  SeaWind is locally and family owned and four of us in our party had a great time.  Steve the owner was our pilot for the DeHavilland Beaver (seats up to 8).  Everyone gets a window seat and the flight up to the Misty Fjords was fantastic.  Steve provided very informative narration on the way up and back.  We landed on a lake and had time to walk around on one of the islands there.  Highly recommend the trip and SeaWind!

My float plane trip with Seawind Aviation was definitely an experience of a lifetime! I couldn't think of a better way to enjoy the beauty and grandeur of SE Alaska. I was visiting after the tourist season but Lesley and Steve were very accommodating to make sure I got out on a tour. Lesley was great about staying in touch with me to make sure we could find a time that worked with my travel dates. I would recommend this as a definite "bucket list" item for anyone visiting SE Alaska.  I was a bit nervous about going up in a small aircraft but this was one of the smoothest flights I've ever experienced. Steve is an amazing pilot and I'd recommend their tours to anyone!

We took this excursion on a beautiful day in Alaska. We were able to see all kinds of wildlife, glaciers, and get some great pictures. Small family owned company that are very nice. I would definitely recommend this company since they were super down to Earth and very friendly.

Mike was our pilot, he is awesome!
We saw killer whales and were able to land in the water for a closer view. Saw humpback whales, bears, goats, flew over a Glacier, and saw seals...... I could go on and on. 
This is a must tour for Alaska. The price is nothing compared to the experience. Pick up at ship was easy, and the office experience, watch a safety video was good, because we dealt with great, happy employees. Thanks for the adventure.

A plane ride is the best way to see Alaska's spectacular scenery, and a seaplane ride is even better. We had the best of both worlds, seeing the beauty of the vast Tongass National Forest from the air, and then landing on a secluded alpine lake that made us feel like we were the only people within a hundred miles. 
Our pilot was great, and the flight was fun and well worth it. 
We highly recommend SeaWind Aviation to anyone who would like to get a bird's eye view of Alaska.

We took two planes up to Traitors' Cove to see the bears at the salmon ladder.  The day was grey, but still beautiful.  We were surprised how smooth the takeoff and landing was on water, never having ridden in a float-plane.  Our pilot was engaging and gave us lots of information.  Once we landed at the cove we were met by a guide who drove us a short distance to a walking path.  Our guide was very knowledgable about the area flora and fauna. The walk to the salmon ladder was incredibly beautiful.  We only saw 2 bears at the ladder, but they were very close to us.  Apparently, a couple more walked right across the path behind us as we were busy watching for them at the ladder.  We did see a couple more of them fishing on the walk back from the ladder.  The trip as a whole was worth it.  All of the people we met at SeaWind were very nice and helpful and the landscape was gorgeous.

From the minute my communications began, to the time our Fjords floatplane excursion ended, it was a delightful experience.  Leslie, the pilot's wife met us at the cruise ship dock in their new and comfortable van.  As we drove the short distance to the floatplane, we enjoyed learning more about Skagway.  Once we checked in, we were asked to watch a detailed safety video.  Following a few questions, we then walked outdoors to a ramp to meet the pilot and board our plane...but not before Leslie took individual and group pictures.  The plane was so smooth and comfortable for a party of 6, plus the pilot.  The scenery was breathtaking and the narration & music enhanced our experience.  Landing and floating up to a dock in the middle of nowhere...priceless.  Thank you Steve & Leslie for the wonderful experience.

review_title: Cool flight, Beautiful Bears and great Guide
review_text:
We were 8 people flying with 2 planes. The flight was very interesting to us, as this was the first time to take off from the water. The view were great, we saw deer, a bear and when we saw seals the pilot did a loop around them so we can see them clearly!  
We landed in a spectacular bay and were greeted by 2 Bold Eagles. We had a van waited for us to the start of a short trail. The guide was great – he explained a lot about the bears and how we would walk along the path. We felt safe and were happy to have him with us . The hike itself was easy, pretty level, on a good path. Our first bear was few feet below us eating a salmon very actively, in the stream next to it you were able to see the salmons swim and spawn by. The next 3 bears we saw from a little distance – they were in the middle of the stream fishing – unfortunately, the guide continue, and was not willing to go back so we can see it properly  - We were very close to the viewing ramp – and he probably thought that we will see many bears there – but there were none – we waited an hour in the viewing platform and headed back – we didn’t see any no the way back. 
In the viewing ramp we were able to see so many salmons jumping the water fall – it was amazing!

To conclude – if you can budget it – it is a great experience!!!
Notice! Bear viewing is not guarantee anywhere, so if you do see a bear, even from a distance, agree with your guide ahead of time that you would like to pause and watch…

(The bears photos and the jumping salmons i keep to myself...you should go and take them yourself ;-) )

This is the third time we have flown with Steve over a 7-year period; and we would do it again tomorrow.  His knowledge of the area and ability to find wildlife while flying is great!  We have had three different experiences, taking the same tour three times.  This year we went to Alaska with my sister and brother-in-law; and it was their first time visiting Alaska.  He wanted to experience the "majesty and grandeur" of Alaska, so we immediately booked a flight with Seawind.  They absolutely were thrilled and can't wait to go back.

We booked an excursion independently from our cruise and it was a pleasure to deal with Lesley, who answered all our questions and provided a customized itinerary.  Unfortunately the weather did not cooperate and the excursion was cancelled.  She called me early in the day to let us know and even said they would be flexible if the weather cleared.  There were no charges to my credit card.  I found her to be honest and am grateful they didn't try to give us an expensive tour of the clouds or risk our safety.  Locals confirmed that it was an unusually rainy day in Ketchikan.  If I get back to Alaska, I would try to work with SeaWind Aviation before any other outfits because of their honesty.

Must do this tour in Ketchikan!  Our cruise ship arrived at 7am and we caught the Seawind shuttle by 7:30 and were flying by 7:50!  The scenery of Ketchikan island and Misty Fjords is breathtaking.  The flight was very smooth.  The headsets blocked out the engine noise and allowed us to listen to music and pilot and even talk to the pilot.  We landed on a lake in Misty Fjords about half way through and spent some time at floating dock.  When I was there I saw some of the other company's planes and noticed that some planes have better windows.  Our windows were OK but they went from about waist level to nose level so we were straining our necks to get best view.  Seawind seems to be the best priced though so maybe that's how it works :).  Seeing the fjords was a highlight of the trip , they were very steep and blanketed in mist, just amazing.  We booked this about 1 - 2 weeks in advance to make sure we had a spot.  All the shopping in Ketch gets old fast for us so we're really glad we got out of town to see the sights .  Service was great from bus driver to pilot to office personnel.  Highly recommend

Generally had a wonderful time.  There was clearly a miscommunication with our pickup and I had to call them to see where they were, we were picked up about 30-45 min late and then had to wait a bit when we got to the dock so that got a little frustrating.  Fortunately we had enough time in port that it wasn't really an issue, just an inconvenience.  But the flight itself was wonderful, nice and smooth which was good because I'm a little nervous on small planes.  But Steve was an excellent pilot, he even banked and turned around so show us a bear on a logging road.  We landed on a dock in the middle of the one of the lakes which was very picturesque.  My daughter got a little airsick and Steve was even willing to fly us to another spot if needed so she could, uh, take care of business with no one else around.  Wasn't necessary but appreciated the thought!  We had "misty" weather which was very appropriate!  Overall a fantastic experience!

My husband and I were celebrating our anniversary aboard the Carnival Legend cruising around Alaska back in May.  One of our stops was Ketchikan and I wanted to make sure my husband, who loves to fish, got the chance to do so in such an incredible place.  I tried contacting a couple of other places who were booked, but one guy personally contacted Lesley to see if SeaWind was available.  Lesley immediately agreed to help plan an unforgettable trip for us with their trusted fishing guide Rick.  She was kind, easy to communicate with, and provided us with options so we could pick one that best suited us.  Steve was a wonderful pilot and executed an incredibly smooth take-off and landing on the water.  It was quite an experience seeing Ketchikan from above in the Beaver plane; I even had my best whale sighting on the way back!  Thank you Lesley for being so accommodative and providing us with a trip of a lifetime, and thank you Steve for your excellent piloting skills!
We did the misty fjords tour Steve was the pilot . Had a wonderful time it was beautiful we landed at a dock in the middle of nowhere got out and took pictures. Would do it again

Service was great! Everyone was very nice. Steve was our pilot. He apparently loves what he does, and genuinely cares that we have a good experience. He pointed to us two bears on the beach and turned the plane around so that passengers on each side can have a good view. The view of Ketchikan from the air is amazingly beautiful!

Another great trip with Seawind Aviation and Steve as pilot of our Beaver.  We had a picture perfect day landing on one of the many lakes.  The plane landed smoothly and backed right up against a mountain.  We were able to get out and hike up for some awesome pictures & picked some ripe berries. 
As we soared past the mountains he took us close up to view some mountain sheep on the return flight back to Ketchikan.  
A great family local owned business.  This was the second time we booked independently with Steve & Leslie Kamm.  Highly recommend this trip.

Staff and flight crew were very polite and professional. We booked this excursion through CostcoTravel.com and received no problems. Though at first we thought our flight was going to be cancelled due to acclimate weather in the area. Thankfully it was all clear by the time we got to the dock.
The pilot showed us around and trued his best to spot any animals, but we did not luck out.

We booked w Seawind based on previous reviews and on the price.  The website was also helpful and we appreciated being able to book online ahead of time.  Leslie called my husband to confirm and she also gave us another $10 off the price per person.  We originally booked a 1:30pm flight time but she asked us to call that morning when we got off the cruise ship to check on the weather.  We ended up flying that morning around 10am and it turned out to be a great time, the weather was beautiful and sunny.  We were picked up promptly in the parking lot behind the visitor's center near the Liquid Sunshine gauge.  It was very close to where our ship was docked.  It was just a short drive to the office and dock where the floatplanes are located.  We saw several eagles in the area.  My husband got to sit next to our pilot, Steve and he loved it.  We both enjoyed the trip so much and are so glad we got to experience it.  Incredible views, just breathtaking.  Happy to get some nice photos, too.  The plane is small and I was a little concerned but no problems at all, just a great experience that I highly recommend.  Much more reasonable pricewise than booking through the cruiseline.  Steve and Leslie are very professional and you should have no qualms booking with them.

We booked this independtly after reading all the positive reviews posted here. We were picked up promptly at the cruise dock and driven about 1 mile to the office and plane.  There were only 4 of us in the plane so everyone had a window and my husband sat next to Erik, the pilot.  He talked the whole time pointing out landmarks, history of the area, logging information,  etc.  We landed on a beautiful lake and spent enough time to take in all the wonder of this lovely place. We were very, very pleased with Sea Wind Aviation. Thank you, Leslie, for,the special favor you did for me.

review_title: Skip the Ship Excursion and Book This Trip!
review_text:
Don't book that shore excursion from the ship!  Go to the Seawind Aviation website and book directly through them: this is a the trip of a lifetime.  

A van will pick you up where you leave the ship and take you to Seawind Aviation.  Then, the next 90 minutes are spent in a seaplane, traveling over the Misty Fjords with the knowledgeable guide and pilot.  

Mike, our pilot, took time to point out where we might see whales, bears, bald eagles, or seals. Bald eagles and seals were the extent of what we got to see, but it was kind of him to look for the other animals for us.  He knew the area and could speak to how things in nature have changed over the last 15 years. 

I felt in good hands with our pilot.  Paying for the trip online was a breeze.  Communication was good and accurate.  We saved about $160 as a couple booking directly with Seawind over booking with our cruiseline.

We had a great time with Mike our pilot, and Laura one of the manager was great and nice with us. This a graet advundure going to the misty fiords that nobody can miss when coming to Ketchikan. We flew a small plane and got 1st to the sea platform. we saw another 3 planes landing and everyone was amazed with this tour. Trying flying with Mike, great pilot and great human being.

My family (5 adults) went up in a seaplane in Ketchikan Alaska and had the most amazing flight.  It was such an incredible way to see the area and our pilot was a wonderful tour guide.  It is something my family will remember forever!

review_title: Great flight through the Misty Fjords!
review_text: I booked this excursion through the Internet and immediately received confirmation and a phone number to call when we arrived in Ketchikan. Leslie, the owner, called me as soon as our cruise ship arrived and sent a van to pick us up. We were seated according to weight, since the plane is small. My husband was thrilled to be seated next to Steve, the pilot. Steve is extremely experienced and pointed out landmarks during our flight and also talked about the impact of logging and some of the severe storms. We flew to a small island in the fjords where we were able to get off the plane. We could hear the loud warning cry of a couple of loons who were guarding their nest with two green eggs. This was a great experience and I highly recommend Seawind Aviation.

review_title: Thank you for the time of my life!
review_text: I have always wanted to fly in a seaplane and seeing Misty Fjords seemed like a perfect fit.  Securing our reservations was a breeze.  Lesley couldn't be any nicer.  Our party of 3 was lucky enough to have a plane all to ourselves and I was luck enough to fly upfront with the pilot.  Yeah!  The views are spectacular - words cannot describe this wonderful experience.   It's like being transformed to another world. Thank you for the memory of a lifetime!

This was the best excursion my mom and I had taken during our cruise to Alaska!! I’m so happy that it all worked out perfectly. A few weeks before our cruise, I contacted Lesley to ask about their handicap accommodations as my mom had fallen a few years ago which left her with a broken shoulder and hurt foot so it’s a bit more difficult for her to get in and out of cars/planes/trains. Lesley assured me that they have ramps to the dock/onto the plane and was confident that my mom would be able to enjoy the flight. She also offered a great deal to my request of an AAA rate so I booked right away for our day in Ketchikan. When we arrived at the cruise port, Lesley picked us up in their van right by the port (no need to have to find our way to their dock). This excursion was a HUGE surprise for my mom’s birthday so I never actually let her know what I had planned for us until she saw the seaplane advertised on the side of the van. I knew she would never partake in such an adventurous excursion if I told her ahead of time. By looking at the shocked expression on my mom’s face, Lesley was so warm and comforting to my mom’s jitters of flying in a seaplane. Even the fellow passengers who would be flying along with us were so nice and friendly -- they tried their best to keep my mom’s mind off her nerves ☺ Once we got to the dock, we met our awesome pilot Peter who helped my mom into the seaplane with the use of the ramp. Easy peesy! We got to wear these great headsets where we could hear each other ask questions, the pilot provide feedback about what we’re seeing, and incredible music that fit the sights (ie. Jurassic Park soundtrack). It really made the entire flight enjoyable. BUT THE VIEWS! They were awe-inspiring and like nothing I’ve ever seen. We flew throughout a part of the Misty Fjords and even stopped at a lake dock for about 20 mins that had incredible views too. This flight was awesome and an once-in-a-lifetime experience! SO happy my mom got to experience this with me because by the time she got up in the air, her nerves settled and she loved every second of the flight. Big thank you to Lesley + team for a fabulous time in Ketchikan!

We were a group of six and had a wonderful flight with Steve.  We did not have reservations, but booked our flight in the Visitors Center when we got off our ship.  They were able to take us right away.  The weather was perfect for seeing the Fjords and they were beautiful!  We landed on a lake and we able to get out of the plane for a short time.  The lake was beautiful and serene.  We saw waterfalls and some Dall sheep.  We had a great time and highly recommend them.

The owners of this company our very nice and helpful.  We were able to see a lot from this flight, we even saw a brown bear.  The pilot pointed out lots of stuff for us to see.  We felt very safe the whole time we were flying.  It is a little noisy but that is typical with those types of planes.

We booked after we got off the ship and saved a bunch of money!!! The ship price was 280 and we got the trip for 230... Naomi took us to the plane and Mike took us flying. It was wonderful even on a rainy day. We saw a whale and felt very safe....family run business that makes you feel welcome.  If you want to be sure you get them I would call ahead. From the time we left the boat to in the air was 15 mins....

Booked online and got a better rate than the cruise ship offered. Picked us up and dropped us off right at the dock. Steve was our pilot and he was a great tour guide. Felt safe the entire time. Although it was cloudy and a little rainy, that did not take away from great views. Definitely go with Seawindaviation Aviation.

We booked the excursion directly with Sea Wind rather than going through the cruise line as we felt Sea Wind offered a better value. Everyone that we dealt with were very nice, helpful, and professional. The flight was awesome and very smooth. The views were more beautiful than we expected. Well worth the money. Thank you, Sea Wind!

This was an amazing experience, one of the highlights of our trip! We've never done float plane before and I was a little nervous going into it but it was worth every penny! The view you get is breathtaking! We flew over Misty Fjords National Monument and devoured all of its beauty from above: mountains, greens, waterfalls, and low hanging clouds. Now i really understand why they call it "Misty". We landed on a small water doc for a brief photo ops and were up in the air again. I really enjoyed the ride, the take off and landing were very smooth and barely noticeable. And we felt safe the entire time!

take a ride in a hidroplane and see killer whales jumping, fiords in all their splendor, humpback whales breathing, and going around them many times just to enjoy this moment, priceless.  We booked this trip in advance, so as soon as the cruise arrived we were picked up and it was significantly cheaper than a similar excursion organized by the cruise. Strongly recommended.

This was a top-notch experience from start to finish.
I had several questions before we left home and Lesley responded quickly and cheerfully.
Connecting with them in port went smoothly and before we knew it we were meeting Mike our pilot and climbing into the plane. I had never taken off from water before, but Mike is an excellent pilot and it was just like taking off from a runway.
The views were breathtaking and well worth the cost.
Definitely book direct from them rather than your cruise ship. You save big $$ and get to deal directly with them, which is a plus.

The service, from being picked up downtown to our pilot, was first class!

The booking process with Leslie was easy and she was a pleasure to email back and forth with, answering all questions and accommodating us!

Checking in once we arrived was easy and everyone was extremely friendly.

Steve, our pilot, was great and explained what we were looking out at. The playlist on the headphones was spot on! The landing was much smoother than I thought it would be. The plane seemed to be in good shape and I'd assume they take good care of it.

Thanks for a great trip!

Our shuttle driver was AJ he was great, our pilot Mike was awesome showed us so many things high low close and farther away he made our trip so great, Leslie in the office was so easy to deal with, got off the boat walked to tourist center man in the center called into the office for me, we shopped for a little bit, Leslie called us said AJ was coming then things went on from there so very easy and wonderful thanks guys

Despite the noise of a seaplane; this was the best excursion I have ever experienced. Book this excursion directly with SeaWind rather than the cruise ship.  Easy pickup and drop off at the cruise port.  The pictures speak for themselves.

We can not say enough good things about the SeaWind experience.  My husband booked this flight my myself, my mother and our adult children.  We were met at the visitor center and whisked off to their own private dock area.  We were then given a safety briefing and soon we were on our way.  We had a wonderful weather day and were able to see so much.  The flight was smooth and beautiful.  This was the best excursion of our entire trip and I would happily book with them again

review_title: Fantastic Misty Fjord National Monument with Steve
review_text: We booked our tour to Misty Fjord with SeaWind as we left our cruise ship. We were so glad we did. The whole experience was so professional right from the young man selling the tour from the dock to the ground information provided by Lesley and the very safe pilot Steve.  We had never been on a float plane before but felt totally comfortable and safe every moment with Steve.  He obviously loves what he does and he does it extremely well.  I was surprised that the takeoff and landing was so smooth. Misty Fjord was absolutely fantastic scenery and we were also able to land and spend some time on a wooden dock.  This was one of the highlights of our whole Alaskan holiday.

Seawind picks you up at the main Ketchikan Visitors Bureau and drives you to their seaplane dock where you meet your bush pilot.  We flew with Steve and had the most amazing experience.  We had never flown in a seaplane and it is really quite a capable plane with smoother takeoff and landing than you can imagine. The beauty of the Misty Fjords National Monument and the scenery along the way is something you have to experience for yourself.  This is nature untouched.  We saw the beautiful, sheer basalt cliffs, dozens and dozens of waterfalls, and more beautiful spruce than you can imagine.  The weather conditions allowed Steve to land us in the Misty Fjords and we got to stand on a dock and listen to the sounds of the waterfall and rain falling along with some great and unforgettable photos.  Highly highly recommend doing this as your choice in Ketchikan.

review_title: SeaWind folks provided excellent customer service
review_text: The folks at SeaWind were great! They provided us with local transportaion around Ketchikan as we stocked up on food, gas, and ice. We were going to stay one day in Ketchikan to get our shopping done, but SeaWind told us bad weather was coming the next day and recommended we fly later that day. Was great advice as we left under a blue sky and the next day was rain.  They promptly picked us back up from the cabin when they said they would. When it was time to leave for the airport to fly home, they gave us a ride there too. Steve and Lesly are really friendly and went out of their way to help us in all aspects of our trip. They get my highest recommendation (and thanks).

This was my first experience with Steve and Lesley and SeaWind Aviation.  The Fjords were beautiful.  Steve explained the area and the history.  We landed on an mountain lake and taxi up to an island.  It was exciting to land and take off from such a remote area.  Steve pointed out the waterfalls as we ascended into the sky.  It is amazing to me that a plane can be that close to the scenery and still be safe.  We also looked for brown bears and saw many species of birds. Coming into the rocky picturesque landing of Ketchikan was breath taking! What a wonderful way to view the Fjords.  Thank you SeaWind!

Steve and Lesly are great. We flew with them on two different days. Once to see the bears, where we were about 15ft from a mom and two cubs, and again for the Misty Fjords. Both times we flew with Steve and he can be pretty funny. He spotted a bear in the Misty Fjords and circle a couple times so everyone could see it. He even pointed out the mountain goats! I will fly with them again!

This was the 1st side tour that I booked for our Alaska land-cruise tour. I found a BIG difference when comparing what the cruise was offering with what other Misty Fjord floatplane tours were available. After reading the reviews for SeaWind Aviation, I knew this was the one to go with. All positives: small plane, family operated, everyone gets a headset and window seat, professionally run, plus early booking discount. On the day of our Ketchikan port visit, Lesley called a few hours before departure to say they were running late. I told her that we had another tour booked immediately after the float plane excursion with no wiggle room. She told us to come a little earlier & she would work things out. Not only did she keep us on schedule, she contacted our next tour (Tracy from Wild Wolf Tours) to let her know that we were running late. Because we were the only passengers for that tour, Tracy was waiting for us at SeaWind Aviation when we returned from the plane ride! Talk about excellent service! I must give credit to both Lesley and Tracy for pulling this off and giving me and my sister-in-law such personalized service for our short stay in Ketchikan. Hats off to you! And not to forget thanking Steve for his awesome piloting skills, narration during the breathtaking flight and answering all of our questions. I'll even give him credit for the warm, sunny day we had - unusual for rainy Ketchikan!

review_title: Second trip with SeaWind Aviation was even better!
review_text: This was the second time in three years that we have taken the flight to the Misty Fjords National Monument with SeaWind..  SeaWind is a family-owned business with outstanding service.  They picked us promptly at the pier and took us to their business site.  After a safety video we boarded the plane for a Great tour of Misty Fjords National Monument.  Our grandson was able to sit up front with the pilot (owner).  The take off & landing was super smooth, and we enjoyed terrific views of all the sights.  We were able to land in a fjord & enjoy the great sights & tranquility.  Slightly less expensive than purchasing the tour through the cruise company, but we'll-worth the money.

review_title: Fantastic seaplane journey and bear watching
review_text: Had an amazing day with Steve, our pilot and Drew our bear guide. We saw up to five bears at once in the river hunting for salmon. Absolutely fantastic. Can't recommend this company enough.

review_title: Great Flight and Bears on Pricne of Wales Island
review_text: My wife and I had booked a tour with one of SeaWind Aviation's competitors who had to cancel at the last minute. However, they did not leave us out in the cold.  They contacted SeaWind who scheduled us at the last minute and gave us a great tour.  Leslie made sure we were ready and comfortable when the plane arrived and the flights were some of the smoothest I have ever had. There were a total of five of us on the 8 passenger deHaviland Beaver.  We were met on the island by our guide named Diamond.  He is a long time Ketchikan resident (since the 30s) who was delightful.  His knowledge of the area is amazing.  We were able to see several black bears fishing including a mother and her twin cubs.  My last photo at the stream is of two bears fishing with  bald eagle sitting in a tree overhead.  Both on the way to the island and back we saw whales below us.  Each time the pilot circled so we could watch and take photos.Doesn't get much better than that!  Highly recommend this company.

review_title: Wonderful flight to and from some great fishing!
review_text:
Had a wonderful flight yesterday with Steve on our way to some epic fishing and scenery east of Ketchikan.  The airplane was clean and comfortable, headsets at every seat allowing us to communicate during the flight, and Steve is a first-class pilot.  As a local who lives here all year, I was glad to have him in the pilot's seat.  

In addition to the safe flight, Rick Collins of Explore Alaska Charters provided us with some fantastic fishing in an area that only gets fished a handful of times each year.  

You can't go wrong with these two!

I am a mother who was traveling with her husband and 3 boys (12,13, and 15) in Alaska, we did a cruise and a land tour and this was by far our favorite excursion. 
     We booked this tour privately and Leslie the owner was more than helpful at assisting us with our plans. She made sure our tour was great. Our pilot Mike was so smooth at both take off and landing, the whole tour he was explaining things to us and pointing out numerous things. He made sure to tell us where to keep our eyes peeled for wildlife, even though we did not see any bears :-(.  (but the tour before us did )The views from the plane were indescribable. He landed the plane in a lake and happily took pictures of our whole group (my in-laws also came with us, grandma-67 and grandpa-72). Although the weather in Ketchikan was rainy and yucky the views were still amazing in the fjord and throughout the whole flight. We saw several seals and eagles and Mike made sure to spin around the wildlife a couple of times so everyone could view it! The fjord with the fog coming off it was breathtaking. And the whole experience was perfect. I cannot think of a single complaint.

I visited Ketchikan at the beginning of July.  I was there for a very sentimental reason and tried to get in as much as possible during the 5 days that I was there.  I felt extremely lucky to go on a flight to the Misty Fjords with SeaWind the day before I left.  The flight could not have been any better.  Steve was the best pilot.  The take off and landing were incredibly smooth and I felt very safe the entire time.  Steve made it fun with an awesome playlist and pointing out different things along the way.  I felt like I could have flown all day and I never wanted it to stop.  If you're planning a trip to Ketchikan, I highly recommend booking a flight with SeaWind.  It will be the best thing you ever do!  Thank you so much Steve and Lesley!

I am so glad that we found SeaWind.  We opted to  book a shore excursion outside the cruise because it was less expensive and offered a better time.  The reservation process was very easy, and the confirmation letter included clear instructions where to meet.  

We called Lesley as soon as we docked, and she called back to confirm our time.  It was raining, and the time could have been adjusted due to the weather.  Thankfully, the tour was not canceled.  We were picked up by their staff and taken to their dock which happens to be near an eagle landing.  There were 4 eagles just sitting by the shore.

Our tour consisted of 4 passengers and our pilot Steve, the owner.  He had 30 years of flying experience all in Ketchikan.  I immediately felt like we were in good hands.  Take off and landing was smooth.  The flight though rainy at times was beautiful.  Steve included music in the background and spoke about the topography and animals when appropriate.  He said that rain was the best way to see how Misty Fjord got its name.  It was beautiful!  

Sadly the trip ended.  Leslie took us back to port and dropped us off where we liked.  She also offered a recommendation for a good place to eat.

We were happy that we went with this family-run operation.  Learning about the area from a true local is the way to go.  I know it feels like a risk booking outside the cruise, but these businesses know the cruise schedule as well.  Ketchikan is so small too.  It would be hard to miss your ship.

review_title: Our favorite activity on our trip
review_text: Steve did an excellent job of not only flying but pointing out sites and telling the history as well.  It is well worth the money compared to how much other activities cost.  We flew all through the surrounding mountains and landed in a secluded spot to better enjoy the  beautiful surroundings.  Both Steve and his wife Lesley were excellent hosts.

review_title: A highlight of our trip to Alaska
review_text:
We booked this seaplane trip to the Misty Fjords and although it was quite expensive due to poor exchange rate with our South African currency, it was well worth the trip and money spent.
I researched the Seaplane companies quite extensively and Seawind was superb. Leslie was so helpful and got us a great family rate as we were 11 people traveling together. We were collected at our cruise liner and taken to the plane. Half the family went in one plane and the other in the second plane. We all had window seats with great views. Steve was very informative and chatted with all of us about his time living in Ketchikan. WE all fell in love with this little peace of paradise.
The Mistys were beautiful. Still a bit of snow and ice on the mountain tops - just stunning.
We took some awesome photos of the Misty Fjords, Ketchikan our our ship.
The whole experience was truly memorable.

Seawind Aviation is a family owned business in Ketchikan that offers stellar service and wonderful local knowledge. My wife and I had the pleasure of flying to Misty Fjords with Steve on a beautiful day in southeast Alaska. The flight was smooth and Steve's knowledge of the local history and natural features was impeccable. Steve's wife Lesley handled our reservations with ease. When an earlier flight became available she contacted us and picked us up at another location in town without any trouble. She also gave us other detailed suggestions for things to do in Ketchikan as well as other places on our Alaska trip. Top notch and highly recommended!

We enjoyed a float-plane tour of Misty Fjords on Friday morning, June 26 with SeaWind.  We were on a Princess cruise, but booked directly with SeaWind as a result of the great reviews.  We weren't disappointed.  The pilot had many years of experience, and was an informative tour guide.  The landing in the fjord was so silky smooth that we didn't even realize we were back on the water.  My wife's Dramamine was likely unnecessary!  We were not expecting to see much wildlife, and that was indeed the case, other than the eagles at their dock in Ketchikan.

We were in port in Ketchikan for half a day on Friday 7/3 from the NCL Pearl and had booked an independent flightseeing excursion with Seawind based on the reviews on Trip Advisor.  SeaWind was excellent.  A week before the excursion, there was a horrible tragedy with another flightseeing company on an excursion near identical to ours in the Misty Fjords in Ketchikan that left the pilot and all 8 passengers aboard dead.  As you can imagine, this scared the heck out of my family and I, the news breaking the day before our flight to Seattle to board our Alaska cruise.  Well, we kept our reservation with SeaWind and am glad we did.  The owner Leslie picked us up from the port and she raised the issue of the accident and discussed it with us openly and candidly.  It really helped to set us at ease.  After we got to the office for our safety briefing, the mechanic reported the plane we were going to use needed a new starter.  Undeterred, Leslie had her employee drive us to Creek Street in Ketchikan to kill 45 mins so we didn't have to just sit there.  We probably would have missed the wonderfully quirky Creek Street otherwise, so this was an error that worked in our favor.  Once the plane was fixed, we were whisked back to Seawind (where we saw a bald eagle perched on the building in perfect view) and then taken to the plane.  While we were not able to do the full hour flight planned if we wanted to still do the crab feast (which we did), it was still an amazing and beautiful 25 min flight.   While our pilot Mike could have been a little more talkative in my opinion, he was still very good (albeit a little quiet).  My mom, son and I were the only 3 passengers so the ride was 100% private!  The weather was perfect -- around 70 with a gentle breeze and very few clouds.  The radio blared Tom Petty's Learning to Fly and some other really great tunes throughout the flight!  Leslie also discounted the price of the tour significantly to account for the delay and shorter flight, which was more than fair.  After we stuffed ourselves silly with Dungeness Crab at the George Inlet Lodge where the pilot dropped us, we took a bus with some other tourists back to town.  My mom couldn't bring her wheelchair on the plane, so Leslie met us back in town to bring it back to us.  Despite the little bumps in the road, Leslie and Seawind went the extra mile to keep us safe and make sure we were comfortable, satisfied and happy.  I can't recommend SeaWind highly enough!  Don't be scared -- just do it!  It is truly an experience of a lifetime.

review_title: Our Float Plane with Mike aka Susan (lol)
review_text: We highly recommend SeaWind!  They were awesome!  Our pilot Mike was a great pilot (and I didn't get sick once)!  He's also an excellent photographer so be sure to have him take your picture when he lands the plane at the floating dock.  Chris was awesome as well and made our trip to Alaska even better with the coffee creamer lol!  It was a wonderful vacation excursion and if you are going to be in Ketchikan, look up SeaWind Aviation!  Thank you to Brian when we got off the ship or we never would have given it a try!

review_title: The highlight of our Alaskan Adventure!
review_text: This was a spectacular tour.  Mike is an incredible pilot and very knowledgeable about the area.  He knows where to spot wild life, like the mama bear with her three cubs that we saw during our flight!  We were blessed with a warm sunny day and MIke took advantage of the weather by soaring us above the mountain tops for some spectacular views and then landing as smooth as silk on the lake for a chance to get out of the plane and snap some beautiful pictures of the majestic mountains and scenery around us.  This trip with SeaWind Aviation was a highlight of our Alaskan Cruise and I recommend it to those looking to see the beauty of Alaska and Misty Fjords.

review_title: A must do trip & with Seawind Aviation
review_text: Could not have been a better experience for our party of 6, including our father celebrating his 90th birthday. We enjoyed the personal touch of dealing with Steve & Lesley Kamm, owners of Seawind Aviation. Everything about the experience, from the van pickup to the flight, the pride taken in their business is very obvious. During our flight we landed on a mountain lake, were able to get out and take photos of incredible scenery and the only other residence, eagles. A must do trip.

review_title: Spectacular ride and an once in a lifetime experience!
review_text:
We took the classic Misty Fjords Tour and hoped on to the Beaver airplane. The beaver itself looked really nice, well maintained and looked after! Mike, the pilot gave us a security briefing and the flight began. It was breathtaking! A true once in a lifetime experience! The extra landing in a remote fjord was just amazing and we really enjoyed it! 
I can recommend Seawind Aviation beside all the other operators because they are family owned, family and customer orientated and willing to satisfy all the customer needs and requests. Dealing with them is really enjoyable! Thumbs up!
Great flight! Very professional flight with pilot Mike! Excellent safety protocols and wonderful views. I would go again in a heart beat!

I wrapped two weeks of shooting Alaskan tourist videos yesterday and decided to take the morning to do something that I wanted to do for myself and this was it.  The tour isn't cheap - but it was well worth it, in my opinion.  The experience didn't disappoint - I'd seen Misty Fjords from the water - but to see it from the air is something else.  Mike, our pilot, was great -- lightening the mood with jokes and 70s tunes.  When we saw Orca's on our way out he swooped down to check them out, and gave us colorful commentary along the way.  Our mid-trip touchdown in a lake atop the fjords was one of the most peaceful sites I've seen - we landed near a rock and all six of us got to get out, stretch our legs and take in the view.  My only regret is that we didn't see bears - but that's no fault of the tour.  That's for next time!  In the meantime,  I would recommend this tour in a heartbeat!

We flew to Misty Fjords this afternoon with 6 passengers and the pilot. We were impressed with the comfort of the plane and the experience of the pilot. Taking of and landing on the water was softer than any flight I've been on before. Our pilot gave us a history lesson about the area and then landed for us to get out and take some great photos. On our way back to Ketchikan he looped around to make sure we all saw the bear below us. All I can say is it was amazing. The flight is something we will do again on our next trip to Ketchikan.

review_title: Flying over the Alps and Harbor Amazing!
review_text:
My husband and I planned this tour months in advance with Lesley, Steve's wife. I like to do a lot of research before a trip and found these reviews very helpful. Lesley always wrote right back with answers to my questions and we formed a friendship via internet! Both are great people to meet and know. Another couple joined as four can be seated, as we had connected  through Cruise Critic. We had a half hour flight over Ketchikan but saw so much in about the 20 to 30 miles we covered. We didn't see bears or much wild life, except for lots of eagles, but that didn't really matter. The views were special and since Steve had grown up in the area, he knew exactly where to fly. He also gave us lots of history and personal stories. If we had more time we would have taken the Misty Fords flight but this was fine as were able to hike later in the Tongass National Forest. Steve flew over Ward Lake, which we knew we would be hiking later  so that was very special.
The service is great and the value, as someone noted, exceptional as well.  I truly recommend Lesley and Steve Kamm at Sea Wind Aviation!

review_title: Exceptional tour, exceptional customer service, exceptional value
review_text: This tour was amazing and Mike was a great pilot/guide.  He took the time to expain what we were seeing and when we saw something cool he would actually circle around a couple of times to help us get a good look.  The Misty Fjords were amazing to fly over.  Leslie back at the office was a joy to deas with as well.  This excursion was fairly priced and I would do it again in a second.  Thanks Seawind!

After doing little research for our half day in Ketchikan, I happened to find Seawind Aviation on an internet search.  Lesley was very accommodating to all of my questions and their dockside pickup service made it easy to get to/from the plane.  Being a pilot myself, I recommend a floatplane trip on the DHC-2 Beaver as it is the workhorse of Alaska's aviating fleet.  
Our pilot Mike commentated as he flew us up to Misty Fjord.  We spotted a few orcas during the excursion and i hear that bears and goats are also spotted on the flight, although we didn't see them on this run.  The highlight of the trip was a pit stop on a remote lake around the Fjord.  The 20 minute stop allowed for picture taking and just enjoying the quiet and serene surroundings.  
I definitely recommend this trip to any aviation/nature/history enthusiast.  You won't be disappointed.

review_title: Breath taking from start to finish
review_text: Want to take a floatplane trip to Misty Fjords? Seawind Aviation is the company to go with. From my first contact with Lesley requesting information and later making a reservation to the ride back to the cruise dock was most professional yet personal. I talked to both Steve and Lesley before making my reservation and I felt I was talking to a friend whom I could trust. I was so glad I made my reservation in advance. The day we arrived in Ketchikan was a beautiful dry day. As we arrived early in the morning it was foggy. As informed in advance I contacted Lesley and she said the weather in Misty Fjords was clear and we may be delayed a little bit while the fog cleared off in Ketchikan. The delay was only fifteen minutes which I would consider on time for Ketchikan. After a short ride to the office and a safety briefing we boarded our beautiful Beaver aircraft. Steve kept us informed as we made a smooth takeoff and flight to the Fjords. His knowledge of the area is amazing and made the experience that much more interesting. The landing on the lake was so smooth that I didn't know that we had touched down. The flight back took us over some peaks looking for bears. We didn't see any but we did see mountain goats which was a first for everyone on board. When we got back a whole group of people were waiting to take the next flight which was to continue all day with the perfect weather that day. On the ride back to the dock our driver took a round about way to show a family we that flown with the city park so their children could have a place to play. You don't get that from the big guys the cruise company uses. I highly recommend Seawind Aviation for a great excusion in Ketchikan.

The sea plane was one of the best parts of my Alaska trip, six of us were on the plane,
and to was a ride to remember, great  landing on the lake, plus shuttle from ship to the plane. These people work very hard to please their passengers. If you are going to
Ketchikan, hook up with them it was a blast.

We loved our seaplane ride. Steve our pilot was fantastic. It was so beautiful and the landing on the lake was a bonus. We saw eagles, bear, blue ice-what a view ! I would highly recommend a trip with Seawind to the Misty Fjords. Very professional, easy reservations, safety minded-love every minute of our trip!

We were on a cruise and chose to book on our own.  We were very happy with the communication ahead of time, the shuttle to and from the port, and the floatplane ride itself.   All of the staff were great and the view was amazing.  We were glad we had booked an early trip out as the day was sunny and warm and the plane heats up.

Writing from the balcony of the Solstice, just got back on board.

I was afraid of flying in a small plane like this - but my daughter mentioned that she wasn't afraid and she would like to do it, so I had to. The group on my roll-call was already full by that time, so I found Sea Winds just for the two of us on Trip Advisor.  

This cruise was her birthday gift.  

From take off to landing it was very smooth... a few gentle bumps but not at all what I was expecting from a small prop plane flying through spectacular mountains.  

The scenery is gorgeous, the music is perfect.  I will do this again.  Thank you, Steve and Lesley!

Superbe Ballade au dessus du Misty  Fjord  . Excellent accueil et Bonne Humeur  de toute l'équipe .
Découverte à faire absolument  lors de votre escale à Ketchikan .

review_title: Top notch flight in a De Havilland Beaver
review_text:
Owner Steve gave myself and my ailing brother the ride of our lives.
Excellent pilot and the plane of choice for our bucket list flight.
We chased Dall Sheep across a mountain top, saw a whale, albiet dead, but we saw a whale. We had a blast. Steve worked with another flight company to get us in the air as we only had a few hours left in Ketchikan to fulfill a lifes dream for my brother.
Excellent people, planes, music, and flight. The whole package, at a reasonable price.
Do it. !!!!!!

review_title: GREAT IS NOT EVEN A CLOSE WORD!!!!!!
review_text: I am very afraid of heights, Specially in a small setting. Once we begin our spectacular moment I completely forgot of the fear.  This journey must not be missed!!!!

review_title: The ultimate Alaska cruise excursion for Ketchikan
review_text: Captain Steve Kamm provided an amazing tour. It was so cool to take-off and fly past our cruise ship, the Holland America Westerdam, as we climbed out over Ketchikan Harbor. He was proud of being an Alaskan and a second generation bush pilot, it reflected in his narration and explanation of the Misty Fjord's we explored. Landing on a secluded lake and seeing nature in the pristine Alaskan wilderness really made my cruise so much more meaningful. Seawind Aviation's Dehavilland Beaver, although not a new aircraft, was extremely comfortable and safe. It had the most modern instrument equipment and safety gear. As an aviation professional myself, I felt at very much at ease after climbing in the airplane and throughout the journey. Capt. Kamm was very engaging and answered questions as well as pointing out interesting details that only an native Alaskan bush pilot could. I enjoyed the adventure so much that besides the wonderful picture memories, I also have a Seawind Aviation Polo and Cap to remember my flight. (BTW, I am not related to Steve - it was that good!!!)

review_title: Misty Fjord Flight is a must!
review_text: They picked me up at the cruise ship, did a quick safety briefing, and after a short taxi to the waterway, we were off!  Mike is a great pilot.  He told us about the fjord and landscape, and he played a fitting musical shuffle in the background during the trip.  The ride was smooth and relaxing as we meandered through the valleys, circled wildlife we spotted, and landed on a lake about half way through the trip.  It was personal; there was no script, and Mike had no problems maneuvering back for us to get another glimpse or photo of the spectacular landscape.  I still have a smile on my face - it was worth every penny!

review_title: Conhecendo Ketchikan por cima, lindo passeio!
review_text: Foi um lindo passeio, mesmo com o tempo fechado, conseguimos ver toda a beleza que o Alaska tem pra oferecer. Essa foi uma das melhores viagens que eu já fiz, a cidade é linda, e este passeio foi fenomenal, o piloto foi muito simpático e nos levou para conhecer lugares incríveis, deu até pra ver um urso. Muito lindo mesmo, vale muito a pena.

What an awesome flight we had!  The whole experience from first contact to de-planing was top notch!  I was concerned that my husband who is 6'8" would be able to fit and was told his height would not be a problem - he sat in the co-pilot seat and had the time of his life!  Lesley in the office was a delight to work with and Steve our pilot was so knowledgable and professional.  We had the flight of our lives!  To be able to soar above such pristine forests and lakes was a flight we will never forget!  Thank you Steve for an unbelievable flight and Lesley for your lovely kindness!

This is really the only way to see Alaska.  Our pilot knows his stuff and made the trip a true adventure.   He even buzzed our cruise ship a little!  Seeing so much of the wilderness from a sea plane was amazing and I wanted to again minutes after arriving back at the dock.   You folks are awesome...  Thanks

Had a beautiful flight aboard from Ketchikan, AK to Misty Fijords In a well cared for DeHaviland Beaver Airplane.  The entire staff at the Ketchikan office took very good care of us from pickup at our cruise ship to our return.  The pilot was extremely knowledgeable about his route of flight and gave us some beautiful scenic moments along to the route and return.  The takeoff and landings were so smooth it was as to make it difficult to know when we were actually on water on in the air. 
Thanks Seawind Aviation,   great job!

Traveled with my wife and mother-in-law. Not only was the flight and experience awesome, the care and personal service that Steve, Lesley and staff provided was top notch. Steve alleviated all of the concerns my mother-in-law had about climbing in an out of the plane. The flight was smith and the narrative so very interesting.  Words can't describe the beauty of the views. We landed on the lake and enjoyed the quiet there until another plane showed up. boo!  Didn't see much wildlife, only a few goats in the distance. Would recommend without hesitation.

I booked this excursion knowing I would be scared stiff and I was! BUT it was beautiful and  I enjoyed the trip so much...the scenery was breathtaking! I think I might even do it again! Thank you Steve!
Our group of 6 had the most amazing flightseeing trip with Rolf as our pilot and tour guide.  All went so smoothly and the weather fortunately cooperated!  I highly recommend this tour.

This was a last minute decision we made and we are "so happy" that we did fly with Seawind Aviation! The scenery and views were spectacular! The pilot was so nice and the staff including the shuttle driver went the extra mile in helpfulness and showed their generosity by celebrating our anniversary with complimentary "Alaska Beers" ! What a Great Time and Great Memories!
Thanks Seawind!

This is my second trip with Seawind - this time I took the family and charter the entire plane for our trip over the Misty Fjords in Ketchikan.  This family owned operation is all that you would hope for in an operation like this.
