We skipped the usual shore excursion offered by the ship and worked with Lesley to make this a memorable trip for all.  Of course, it wouldn't have been possible without the expertise of Steve.  Our day wasn't the best of conditions, but the stop on the lake, giving us an opportunity to step out onto a little island for a 360 view of the surrounding scenery was one the kids wont forget any time soon!  Thanks again Seawind - you guys are the best!!  We'll be back!

review_title: SeaWind Aviation trip to Traitors cove was awesome !
review_text:
Having done the trip to Traitors Cove recently I have no hestitaion in recommending SeaWind Aviation. I was made to feel welcome by Lesley right from the outset. A real family business with a great friendly atmosphere.
Despite it being a misty day the pilot did a great job managing to highlight things during our flight. Riding in the co pilots seat was a real buzz.
While the forest is not a zoo and bear sightings can't be guaranteed I was lucky enough to see 3 bears including one beautiful black bear who entertained us for 15 -20 minutes performing salmon catching duties. In a word the experience was awesome !
Coming from a country that has no large predators  (NZ) its something I will never forget. Thanks Lesley and SeaWind Aviation for being part of the experience.

review_title: Seawind Aviation, hidroavión y gran servicio en el agradable Ketchikan.
review_text:
Reservamos por Internet un par de semanas antes de viajar, ahorrando USD 100 sobre el precio de la naviera. La compañía es un negocio familiar, Lesley es la mar de amable y eficiente.  La contratación fue rápida y sencilla (cargó solo el 50% de adelanto y hasta terminado el tour a satisfacción  pagamos la otra mitad). Ella nos buscó en su van en el mismo muelle de Princess "para que no tuviéramos que caminar" y nos trasladó hasta el hidroavión (luego se fue a llevar sus niñas a la escuela). Desde allí su esposo Steve, experimentado piloto,  nos llevó a sobrevolar los bellos paisajes del Misty Fjord y sus alrededores.  

El tour es extenso y hermoso (aunque un hidroavión no es tan emocionante como un helicóptero). Lo más simpático fue acuatizar en un lago y bajar para caminar por la costa y los manchones de nieve. El único negativo es que su sistema de audio no resultó claro y perdimos gran parte de las explicaciones.  Al regresar nos dieron tiempo a los 6 pasajeros para utilizar el impecable bañito antes de que un asistente nos  transportara de regreso al centro. 

Yo consulté cómo llegar al Totem Heritage Center y Lesley coordinó para que a nosotros nos dejaran en la puerta del museo. Todo el proceso fue amigable, placentero y muy recomendable.
Our pilot was amazing.  He landed on a remote island where we were able to exit the plane and have a look around.   What an amazing experience!!

It was such a pleasure dealing with Lesley. We were group of 14 and the entire flightseeing tour of Misty Fjords was flawless. Everybody at SeaWind  Aviation are very friendly and accommodating. Special thanks to Steve, Ginger and of course Lesley.

review_title: Wonderfully friendly, personable, and two great flights!
review_text: We have done both the Misty Fjords and the Bear Viewing trips.  I highly recommend SeaWind Aviation! Leslie is wonderfully friendly, and the pilots are terrific.  Our bear guide was patient, kind, knowledgeable, and friendly.  We thoroughly enjoyed both our trips, the scenery is beautiful.  We were lucky enough to see several bears. Highly recommend this for a cruise excursion, or for a fun vacation activity!

review_title: Seawind Aviation trip to Traitor's Cove was an amazing experience
review_text: They are a great company to do a tour with.  Amazing Bear experience at Traitor's Cove.  The landscape view from the float plane was beautiful, the pilot was nice and accomodating.  The Bear guide was nice, informative, and helpful.  Must of seen 7 or 8 bears eating Salmon from the stream.  My kids were amazed and then they fell in the love with the dog Max at the office, they must of thrown the stick 20 times in the water for him to go fetch.  Awesome experience from the 1st minute to the last!

review_title: This is not a flightseeing review....
review_text:
We didn't charter Seawind for a flightseeing tour, nor were we cruise ship passengers.   We had something much more challenging for Seawind and the service and support we received was exceptional.  

My wife and I are wilderness campers - Alaska is our favorite place for this but we had never been to southeast Alaska or the Ketchikan area.   Planning a trip like this begins 9-12 months ahead, which is when Seawind first helped.   Once we decided on the general area we wanted to go to - I contacted several air charter companies in Ketchikan asking for advice and recommendations.  Steve and Lesley at Seawind were by far the most helpful and responsive.   I talked to both during the winter and with their recommendations reserved National Forest Service cabins in two different locations for a week each.   One in Misty Fjords National Monument and the other on Prince of Wales Island.   

Seawind's communication was excellent during the planning phase.  They recommended an outfitter, a satellite phone rental company, and even a saltwater fishing guide for the few days we had in Ketchikan between camping trips.   All worked out excellently.   

Once we arrived in Ketchikan, I hesitate to write how much Lesley and Steve helped us out, because they went so far above the expected I don't want to create the impression that everyone should expect the service we received.  Suffice it to say - they treated us more like family guests than customers.   

The actual trips went very well.  They loaded all of our gear in the plane, we left promptly when planned and the flight was smooth and enjoyable.  Steve explained scenic highlights along the way, helped us unload our gear and even provided fishing tips for our destination.   Pickup a week later was exactly as scheduled, although this time Rolf was our pilot.   Due to weather we had to take a different route than our trip in, but this was nice because we got to see different scenery, and Rolf took his time to explain highlights along the way.   Rolf even took the time to tell us about some of the wildlife to expect at our second cabin ;)  .  My wife especially appreciated this information.   

Our second trip out started as planned with the same great flight out, also with Rolf, to Prince of Wales Island.    Arrival and unloading was smooth and efficient.   On our day to leave the weather turned bad, with low fog and lots of rain.   We were in contact with Seawind via our rented satellite phone, and they tried to make it in to land but had to turn back.  Rolf waited in a nearby bay for three hours waiting hoping the weather would clear, but it didn't.  We heard him try to get in several times, but the fog and clouds were just too thick to make it into our lake.   We had a 9 am flight the next morning to Seattle.   In a last attempt to get us to our flight on time Rolf tried again - at 5:30 a.m. to once again make it in - but the weather hadn't improved so he had to turn back.   Finally in the middle of the afternoon, the weather cleared some, I called Seawind and Steve was on his way to get us.   He made it in OK, we packed up and left, and caught our rescheduled airline flight the next day.    I'm sure it was expensive to make three attempts for one pick up - but Seawind did not hesitate at all to try.    

We have traveled to wilderness Alaska lakes with several other air charter companies - I have to say Seawind is the best.  Their dedication to customers and safety is exemplary.   The planes are equipped with modern avionics, very clean and appear to be well maintained.  Both Steve and Rolf are excellent pilots, and know the area well.   Lesley is fantastic - she runs the office, is available day and night, and can help with any local support you may need.   

The next time we need a charter service in the Ketchikan area - Seawind will be our only choice.

review_title: Best Excursion We Didn't Even Get To Do
review_text: We arrived in Ketchikan by cruse ship on Sunday, August 10 to be greeted by cloudy skies and torrential downpours.  Our family of 10 booked this excursion several months prior and were really looking forward to it.  Unfortunately, the weather did not cooperate and it forced SeaWind to cancel our flight.  We were disappointed, but understood - they said it would be a very bumpy ride and visibility in the fjords was poor so we wouldn't see anything.  When we got back to our cruise ship and were discussing this with other people, they mentioned that their tour operators did fly to the Fjords, but the flights were bumpy and they didn't get to see anything!  They were impressed that SeaWind cancelled.  So, we saved a lot of money due to SeaWind's honesty and good business practices.  While we would have loved to see the Fjords, we were all glad that we didn't waste our money, and we were even able to do a helicopter tour in Juneau due to this savings.

we arrived on August 7, 2014 it was a rainy cloudy day. Didn't expect to do an excursion but I talked my husband into it :) best decision we could have made.  Despite the rain the view was spectacular I can only image what it would have been on a clear sunny day.  Our pilot Steve Kamm was great and really did his best to find us some wild life, although we didn't the view itself was awe inspiring. I would recommend this excursion highly! keep up the great job Seawind! thanks for making our 25th wedding anniversary something to remember. 

Sincerely,
chis and Jenny 
kansas

review_title: Perfect Way to See the Misty Fjords in Ketchikan
review_text:
Leslie and Steve Kamm are the owners of this Misty fjord flight seeing company. I booked directly with them. Leslie was extremely helpful and just a delight to deal with. We where picked up just steps from our cruise ship by another friendly staff member. After a short drive we arrived at their office where we were given our safety demonstration and were ready to go. Steve loaded us in and took us on just an amazing tour of the fjords. He is very knowledgeable about the area and educated us about life in Ketchikan. 
I would highly recommend this tour and thank Leslie and Steve for their professionalism and pleasant staff. Our experience was fantastic!

What an amazing experience...from booking with Leslie through our flight with Rolf, our family of 7 were totally wowed! We ranged in ages from 20 through 77 and everyone was totally comfortable with the flight, landings (fun!) and one of the most beautiful landscapes in the US. There are 12 different flight seeing companies...you can't go wrong with Seawind! Incredible value for our vacation!

Flew with SeaWind Aviation to breathtaking Misty Fjords on August 7, 2014. We arrived by cruise ship.  Booked directly with Lesley by phone/web.  Everything was wonderful, pickup, flight, and the scenery was amazing.  We did a close flyby at a waterfall, and saw sea lions or seals when we landed in a lake and walked on the float.  Even though it was misting, was still wonderful! Being a bush plane, had a few raindrops drip on our heads through the plane. We all had headsets to communicate, mine had an issue, and the pilot immediately helped me change mine out.  Would fly with them again!  Thank you SeaWind!

I highly recommend this excursion.  I was a bit apprehensive due to the cost for our family of four, but we all agreed that it was the best excursion that we have ever been on.  It was beautiful and I will never forget it--simply amazing!  I always felt safe and our pilot (Rolf) did a great job of explaining everything and answering questions.

This whole experience was as easy as they come and absolutely enjoyable.  Steve and Lesley (and their helper Ginger) were wonderfully friendly and the service was incredibly convenient with good communication beforehand and an absolutely stunning seaplane ride with the amazing views afforded by the Misty Fjords!  I can't say enough about the ease of this arrangement, the safety that I felt and the absolute beauty that was witnessed!  Thank you Seawind!

Took the Misty Fjords tour on Aug 1, 2014. First, the reservation information/communication was excellent. They were very informative and up front with fees and options when I booked through email/phone. 
The flight itself was amazing. Everyone had a voice-activated headset (through other reviews, I've read not everyone does). You could talk to each other and the pilot pretty easily. The pilot's narration was excellent. We sat down in a pretty large lake and could get out and stretch our legs on a small rock island - perfect photo-op. 
On the way back we flew around some mountain goats making some tight-ish turns - that was the only time I felt the smallness of the plane. Other than that it was surprisingly smooth. 
Tip: The early morning flights are less bumpy because the thermals in the mountains haven't started yet. Also, the plane has no air-conditioning, so it can get a little stuffy if it's a really hot day (our day was amazingly sunny)

This is a fantastic way to see the immensity of the Misty Fjords area. There is no way a land-based trip can give you the scope of the area that a small plane can, and SeaWind was a perfect company for my small family of three to go with to see the scenery. From pick-up to return, the entire process is very professional and friendly, with a true family feel to the experience. There were five people in our little sea plane, not counting the pilot, and we all had great views as all seats are alongside a window. We took off from the same harbor where our cruise ship was docked, and we flew over forests, mountains, lakes, waterfalls, and rivers. While we were in a plane, it was still easy for the pilot to get close to the areas he wanted us to see. For example, he circled around a waterfall a few times so we could all get a good view, and since the plane was so small and relatively slow moving, we all got up close and personal. It was amazing to see such pristine wilderness from the perfect vantage points. We took a ton of pictures out of the windows, and they looked really good. It's a great way to capture the sights.

Rolf, our pilot, gave us expert commentary as we went along, and he really knows his stuff after spending decades in the area. I was sitting in the front passenger seat, and he showed me the radar, communication equipment, and other cool cockpit stuff. It was really cool.

We landed on a beautiful lake for a short photo stop. I'm sure one of the pictures Rolf took of us will make it to our Christmas card this year. It was a gorgeous location and was about as peaceful as can be. Then we got back in the plane for the second half of the flight, which was as beautiful as the first. Rolf took us a different way back, which was great. We loved every minute of it.

The trip isn't cheap, but if you're in Ketchikan, do yourself a favor and splurge on a trip like this. If you do, go with SeaWind. They are great people who will give you a once-in-a-lifetime experience. You won't regret it for a minute.

We did an excursion to see the Misty Fjords while our cruise was in port. I am so thrilled that we did this trip. Our pilot, whose name unfortunately escapes me (it wasn't the owner), made us all feel incredibly safe the whole time. He played music, gave us information about the area, and let us ask any questions. We had a beautiful day and had tremendous views. Even my wife, who is scared of flying, felt comfortable the entire time. Everybody gets a window seat, and it is truly an unforgettable experience. They pick you up right from the port exactly when they say they will, and bring you back once the trip is over.

review_title: Best way to see Misty Fjords!
review_text: My husband and son booked this flight after getting off the ship.  From the booking through the flying experience everything was top notch!  There was an excellent view from the plane, the pilot knew the area very well and constantly pointed out sights and animals during the flight.  This is a highly recommended attraction is Ketchikan.

review_title: This is a "must do" in Ketchikan!
review_text: We didn't book an excursion via our cruise ship in advance and honestly were a bit leery of the on site offerings. Fortunately we came across this group- didn't have time to do any advance checking on TripAdvisor or other ; this was without a doubt one of the exceptional experiences of our trip and possibly of our lives! No kidding - the staff/ owners are all awesome, down to earth, friendly and helpful but the heart of it all is the sea plane excursion itself ( we did the fjords tour). Can't put into words the beauty and all that you will see; I kept saying to myself the whole time "oh my gosh!" and then it would keep getting more amazing. Also FYI it's very smooth flying including take off & landing. Truly exceptional!

We (4 adults) took a cruise to Alaska, and although a couple of the individuals have some fear of small planes, we decided to do the misty fjords excursion (we booked this directly, not through the ship). From beginning to end the experience was wonderful.  We were picked up on time and taken to their office, where 10-12 bald eagles were perched nearby.  After checking the radar and webcams (we were allowed to also view) we boarded the plane and took off.  Takeoff, landing and the flight it self was very peaceful and we were advised of all the different scenery (with nice music when people weren't talking). Communication is easy, and the scenery is beautiful.   We did not see any wildlife, but the experience and views made it all more than worthwhile!  This is a definite must do!

This was a wonderful excursion and an amazing way to see the Mystic Fiords.  The business is a small family run operation with personal, friendly service.  Flying through the Fiords gave breathtaking views of the habitat.  We saw Orcas and brown bears and landed near the latter to get a better view.  As a private pilot, I was impressed with the skill of Steve in flying through the Fiords, and felt quite comfortable with his ability.  And a bald eagle was waiting for us near the airplane dock when  we returned.  I highly recommend this excursion!

review_title: Create the memory of a lifetime
review_text: We could not have been happier or more impressed with this family-run company. Completely professional from the pick-up point at our cruise dock to dropping us off again at the restaurant of our choosing after the flight, Steve and Lesley also set our minds at ease with their friendly and personal attention prior to boarding the sea plane. The flight itself was spectacular with sights that pictures simply cannot do justice and the chance to spend some quiet moments on a small island in what must be one of the most pristine and beautiful places on the planet is beyond words. We would highly recommend using them to help create the memory of a lifetime!

This was the highlight of our trip to Alaska. Not only was the flight smooth but the scenery was amazing. Steve narrated everything and filled us in on everything we were seeing! He made the flight very personable for us. He circled around whales that were spotted and took us to see a mama bear and her three cubs. I took dozens of pictures. My only regret was that it didn't last longer!!!

My first seaplane experience and there are no words except WOW, and thanks Seawind. The scenery was breathtaking, the weather perfect, but the ground crew, the pilot and the plane made us feel comfortable, safe and valued... If we saw orcas, the pilot flew towards them. Bears, mountain goats, waterfalls and cruise ships all up close(&personal). Rolf is a top seaplane pilot and we can not wait to return and repeat this experience of a lifetime.

When people ask us what were the highlights of our Alaskan cruise (June of 2014) the trip into the Misty Fjords with Seawind is right at the top. We decided to try to save some money and work directly with the vendors, and Seawind had a representative right at the dock in Ketchikan that worked with us and set us up with a 2 hour flight that was significantly below the cruise line price. Their van picked us up at a pre-arranged destination, took us to the Seawind location, and next thing we new we were taking off. Our pilot Rolfe was really a pro - I never had a doubt about his ability to control the aircraft and make sound flight decisions. He was also very knowledgeable about the geography, wildlife, history, etc. of this area and quickly developed a good rapport with all of his passengers. he seemed to pick up on what was interesting to us and modified the scope of the tour accordingly. We got some awesome photos and just had a marvelous time. I would recommend this company in a heartbeat!

OMG this was the highlight of our Alaska cruise.
We had always wanted to go on a float plane and what a place to do it!
The Pilot was informative and helpful The scenery and even the weather was great and the whole experience awesome. We saw over a hundred eagles before we even started. When one of the customer saw bears,Rolf went back to get a better view.
The views of the waterfall, fjords, lakes were stunning.
Yes it costs a lot but worth doing even if it is once.
Can't wait to see the photos.

We took this sightseeing tour this morning. It's raining in Ketchikan, but once we took off and headed out we flew into cloudy, but dry weather. This is a small company, very well run. If you do one excursion in Ketchikan, make it this one.

review_title: Awesome {AFFORDABLE} Float Plane Flight with Lake Landing in Misty Fjords
review_text: There are lots of Misty Fjords float plane flight options to choose from in Ketchikan. We decided to save a little money by booking direct with Seawind Aviation avoiding the mark-up fees charged when reserving through the cruise lines.  We were not disappointed! Fantastic customer service! We called their toll free number in advance of our arrival and spoke with Leslie about flight options. She kept in touch with us via email and phone. We didn't actually reserve anything until the day we arrived in Ketchikan - we wanted to "see" the weather before committing. We were fortunate in that there were 5 of us, so they were willing to add another flight for the day. I don't recommend waiting until day of arrival to reserve but it did work for us (In late May, before the real heavy tourist season). They picked us up on the dock near the ship and drove us to there private pier departure dock (It was about a 5 minute ride away). There we checked in, got a safety briefing, and snapped a few photos of nearby eagles. Steve was our pilot. He is very familar with his aircraft, Ketchikan, and Misty Fjords. He provided narration during the flight and everyone could talk to each other via the headsets. When no one was talking, there is a great music sound track playing in the background. The flight heads out over the cruise ships, crosses the Ketchikan island, and proceeds into the monument. We enjoyed a fantastic clear, sunny day. The sights were phenomenal. After about 40 minutes of flight, Steve landed on a lake high above sea level where we were able to get out on a small island, stretch our legs, and enjoy a private paradise somewhere in the middle of the monument for about minutes. All in all, it was a great adventure, well worth the cost (especially considering the savings over the cruise ship options) with over an hour of flight time! If you are looking for float plane options in Ketchikan, I would recommend calling Seawind Aviation for sure! Top Notch!

review_title: Highlight excursion of our Alaskan Cruise
review_text: I don't wish to repeat what others have said but we debated doing the MIsty Fjords floatplane tour or holding off and doing the glacier flyover in Juneau. Now that the trip is done I can definitely say that this excursion was indeed the best we had on our trip... and we had many good ones. Steve was exceptional and the views were simply fantastic. Landing on the lake and getting out to enjoy the moment was wonderful. We were blessed with picture perfect weather and it will be long remembered. Thanks!

I cannot be more effusive about this excursion.  Steve (the pilot) and his wife run an absolutely first class service.  They rounded us up at our point of disembarkation, transported us to the aircraft and provided an unforgettable flight.  Steve's narration of the landmarks and terrain was unmatched and his responsiveness to each question thorough and accurate.  You just cannot miss this experience if the opportunity arises.

We flew in a 6 passenger seaplane to the Misty Fjord. Flight out took about 20 minutes. We landed in a small lake and walked on a deck in  a very remote area. Flight back takes 20 minutes. I had always wanted to fly in a seaplane so that part was very cool. Flying to the Misty Fjord is fair. All of Alaska is beautiful and amazing and the Fjord looked about the same as everything else. 

The staff and crew were excellent. Picked us up at the ship on time and returned us after the flight.

This is just what we were looking for in a sightseeing adventure. Not a big commercial outfit, but a small, personalized experience. Leslie was prompt and courteous. Steve was an amazing pilot(even for the standards of the two long-time pilots on our trip). A third generation Ketchikan native,  He knew the best things to show us and look for wildlife. We even saw a brown bear.  I would recommend this to everyone who wants to see and learn about the Misty Fjords and Ketchikan history.  If you had to choose one excursion on your trip, this would be the one to pick!

We booked this floatplane ride due to reviews on both tripadvisor and cruisecritc.  This is a family operation that goes above and beyond to make sure you have a good time.  They took great care of us and even helped us locate some binoculars we left in the van.  If you are trying to decide between this group and another outfit, choose this one!!

review_title: The Mystic Misty Fjords Experience with The Best Alaskan Team
review_text: Pilot Steve and His loving better Half Leslie and Pilot Ralph are not just very friendly great folks but also the finest in the Seaplane industry when it comes to Aerial Tours of Magical Majestic Misty Fjords of Alaska.It is reality Fairy tale.I have been coming to Alaska over ten years but until recent this year trip I never felt so enchanted and fresh at mind after long winter.What a weather with added warm hospitality from team Seawind Aviation......GR8 FOLKS CHEERS!!!

Sorry it has taken so long to do new to this ,from the moment terry picked us up in town to climbing out of the plane everything gets five stars what an experience can't describe can only say if you go to Alaska do this it is stunning Ralph the pilot what a nice guy really made it a great flight lots of knowledge landing in the middle of nowhere and just standing there looking round will stay forever super people to deal with if we go back will do it again thanks for making it a really special trip Linda and terry Sartain will try to send picture of surestart (the small teddy bear we take and photo on holiday) just working out new printer

Flight 11.30am September 12, 2013, Excellent Weather, very scenic, very personalized narration by Pilot/Owner of Business (Steve Kamm), very safe and pilot looked out for "Wildlife" and saw "goats"/sheep near snowline.Mountains/gorges Ideal for photography. This flight operation might be "small" in nature however far exceeds what you get from the larger operators.   Would go again, Cost/ Scenery : Excellent. Would go anywhere with this pilot. Next time would book longer flight.....We did this whilst on the "inside passage cruise". Organized prior to leaving AUSTRALIA. Pick up point easy to find with "Seawind Aviation, providing good directions to pick up point. (Saved heaps compared to Cruise Ship Prices). Family run BUSINESS VERY PROFESSIONAL.

Contratamos estos servicios por internet y la verdad es que resulto fabuloso. Nos recogieron en el muelle y en 5 minutos llegamos a un local frente al mar, tomamos nuestra platica de seguridad y nos subimos al hidroplano.  el vuelo consistió en un recorrido por Misty Fiords, observando a nuestro paso montañas, valles, lagos, arboles, cascadas y paisajes increíbles. Hicimos una escala y pudimos ver osos en su hábitat natural. Todo increíble, la atención, el hidroplano,  la ruta y la explicación. Nos vamos con una sonrisa de oreja a oreja.

We happened across SeaWind while doing a bit of dock walking... what a lucky break and fantastic introduction to this part Alaska.  Steve, the owner is a personable fellow with decades of experience flying aircraft that have that have proven themselves as the backbone of the bush for as long or longer (de Havilland Beaver).  His aircraft are updated, well maintained and about as comfortable as it gets for something this size.  Each passenger has a window seat and headset for communication with the pilot.  Steve knows the area well and provides a narrative on local flora, fauna and the rugged landscape which you can tune into as you wish.  His landings and take-offs were marshmallow smooth and the aircraft was very stable despite the mountainous terrain and related wind currents and thermos that they often bring. The weather was excellent and we spotted eagles and mountain sheep (cooling in patches of snow) in our mid-September trip.  Our flight lasted 90 minutes and included a landing and walkabout next to a remote mountain lake.

review_title: The one excursion you MUST take.
review_text:
It was Terrific! Amazing! The staff, Guide, Terry, and of course, Rick, the pilot, were wonderful !  The flight was safe. Rick's a great safe pilot. Terry knew how to find bears, eagles, other wildlife flora and fauna.  
No only would we recommend them and Seawind Aviation for Trip Advisor but to anyone who want a real Alaskan "outback adventure"
We'd do it again with a niño. Second of thought, without hesitation!
Thanks again to the staff and crew at SEAWIND AVIATION.
Skip and Dorothy 
Miami, Fl

review_title: No bears to be seen, but a Great Ride!
review_text:
We wanted to do something really special and different while on our recent cruise to Alaska and thought a ride on a small plane to see bears in their natural habitat would be perfect.  As luck would have it, we were blessed with a warm, sunny day for our flight-seeing trip with Seawind Aviation to observe bears at Traitor's Cove.  

We were picked up as scheduled on the dock, driven to the DeHavilland Beaver 6-passenger floatplane, shown a brief safety video while we all settled our accounts, and led to the plane.  I have to say that I had been nervously anticipating this small-plane ride since the day we booked months ago, but the ease of getting my arthritic legs up and into the aircraft and the silky smooth takeoff melted away all my fears.  

After about 20 minutes of beautiful scenery, with pilot Steve narrating as we flew, we landed effortlessly at the dock, where a short walk brought us to the van that would drive us into the rainforest to a trail.  With some preliminary instruction in the event of a confrontation with a bear, we walked along the half-mile trail to an observation deck overlooking a creek, where we all had our eyes peeled for bears coming to feast on spawning salmon.  

Unfortunately, the unseasonably warm, dry, sunny weather - while great for the tourists - had not been good for bear sightings.  The water level in the creek was low, with fewer salmon, resulting in fewer bears.  Sadly, no bears were seen on this trip.  On the upside, we did see a bald eagle or two in the area which occupied our time for a time at the creek.  

Although we were disappointed that the bears did not come out to play, we still enjoyed the ride immensely and marveled at both the experience and the beautiful views it provided.  Owners Steve and Leslie run a nice business.  Leslie welcomed us warmly on arrival, and Steve provided a smooth, safe ride.  I would highly recommend them and hope to return one day for a ride over Misty Fjord.

If you want a first-class, personal, one-of-a-kind, floatplane experience while in Ketchikan, then SeaWind Aviation should be your first call.

First, the service offered by Lesley.  Always so quick to respond to my e-mails.  Due to unfortunate circumstances, the Alaskan cruise my husband and I were originally booked on was cancelled one week prior to our embarkation.  We quickly got ourselves scheduled on a different cruiseship and cruiseline that would be in Ketchikan on a different day.  Lesley was extremely accomodating in sliding our existing reservation to our new day with such short notice.  Thank you for that!  We knew exactly where we would be picked up. The instructions were very good and detailed.  It is just a short drive from the cruise ship dock to their offices where the floatplanes wait.

We were fortunate to be in Ketchikan on one of the few days it does not rain.  The sun was shining and Alaska was showing us her beauty.  Our pilot seemed to genuinely enjoy this day for flying.  We all had our headphones and microphones and could talk to each other freely throughout the flight.  He gave us a wonderful tour of the Misty Fjords.  

About half-way thru our flight, we touched down on a floating dock in the middle of the Fjords.  We were joined by two other floatplanes.  To see these planes take off and land was so much fun.  Of course, it's even more fun to be in one as it takes off and lands.  So smooth.  It was nice to get out of the plane, stretch our legs, and take in the natural beauty that was surrounding us.  

The second half of our tour in the air was just as stunning as the first half.  It seemed we were being taken back to Ketchikan a different way so we could see more of the Misty Fjords. On our plane was a three-year-old.  Our pilot was so kind to take into consideration his little ears.  On our flight back to Ketchikan, he planned to gradually lower our flying elevation so that it would be easier for the pressure in the young child's ears.  What kindness!  

He also made sure we all had a good view of each of our cruiseships from the air.  There were three ships in port that day.  On our floatplane was the pilot, six adults and the three-year-old. We were passengers on two of the three ships so we each got a neat picture of our ship from the air.

If I have the opportunity to be in Ketchikan again, and I hope I do, my husband and I will book another excursion with SeaWind without hesitation.  They make you feel like you are a part of their family.  Because they are independent and do not have have contracts with the various cruise lines, you are guaranteed a more personal, tailored experience.

Thank you SeaWind for one of our top highlights of our 12-day vacation in Alaska and Canada!

My wife and I had the pleasure of enjoying a great Alaskan Cruise (inside passage) which involved stopping off at various ports such as Ketchikan, Icy Straight Point in Hoonah, Juneau, and Skagway, AK.     A lot of research and information was obtained for each location in order to plan our excursions.    There are many Aviation services in Ketchikan, however, one stood out above the rest and that was our experience with SeaWind Aviation, Inc.    This is very much a family run operation.   Our pilot, Steve, and his wife, Lesley, did a fantastic job of insuring our flight over the Misty Fjords was nothing less than spectacular.   From the very moment I contacted Lesley by e-mail, her rapid reply and insuring our reservations were intact (which included very detailed instructions as to where to find SeaWind's vehicle for pick up).......I had total confidence (prior to flight) that we were going to be in for a real treat.    Customer Service was priority #1 for these guys which I very much appreciated.

The flight itself was beyond words.    As a military retiree who has flown many times, it was quite evident that Steve, our pilot, was very experienced from take off to landing his aircraft.    Headphones and Microphones were provided to all of the passengers.   Beautiful music was playing in the background while Steve provided us with the history of the Misty Fjords.    It was SO MUCH fun!    

Please, as you research your excursions, give this company serious consideration.    You will not regret that you did.   I know that my wife and I will cherish this flight which enabled me to take some fantastic photographs!!

I choose to fly with Sea-Wind on my Alaska trip last year, they are a wonderful family run operation, Steve and Leslie are the best. As a former pilot myself, Steve is an excellent skilled pilot, I would fly with him anytime.the tour of the Fords  and landing on a mountain lake was exciting.smooth , Steve and Leslie do everything to accommodate you.Can't wait to go back next Year!

As soon as I knew I was going to Alaska, I wanted to book a float plane trip.  Lesley was easy to book with (even though she was on vacation!), and we had no problem finding them at the pier.  We had a great trip, with our pilot playing beautiful music and giving us facts and legends as we flew above the Fjords.  The flight was smooth, the scenery breathtaking!  They even dropped us off in town and answered our questions about the area.  Highly recommend it - you won't be sorry!  Have your camera(s) ready.

Steve was a wonderful pilot. The entire flight was smooth including all the landings. He provides excellent commentary, takes pictures for you, and even attempted to show us some wildlife by flying close to mountain tops. His wife, Leslie, who runs the office was extremely personable and handled all of the arrangements superbly via email. She was also kind enough to personally take our family back into town in her car since the van was being used for a large group. I believe taking a Misty Fjords floatplane is probably the most exciting excursion in Ketchikan and if you choose SeaWind Aviation you will not be disappointed.

Lesley, Steve and crew treat you more like family than just another customer.  They were cordial, professional, and went out of their way to offer my husband and I a wonderful flightseeing tour!  It's obvious they very much enjoy what they do.  We would definitely reserve through SeaWind Aviation again!

Lesley runs the show and does a great job at it!  From the time we booked and then through the flight itself everything was handled professionally.  BEAUTIFUL scenery, Misty Fjords is a must see. Got a little airsick but was able to keep it down thanks to the piece of gum handed to me by the pilot!  THANKS A MILLION, great experience!

review_title: the best part of our 11 nights in Alaska
review_text: We read all of the other reviews about SeaWind and all of the other flightseeing tours and are we ever glad that we went with SeaWind Aviation.  Steve (the owner) was our pilot,who was born and raised in Ketchikan. I would recommend the in a heartbeat.  Everyone on the plane felt about the same way as I did,  You can not find nicer or happier people.anywhere.  This is a first class operation the whole way. ,

What a wonderful experience we had on our floatplane excursion with Seawind  Aviation.

Instead of a taped narration Steve talked with us about where we were, the history, geography, wildlife  and highlights of the area.  The areas he took us to were breathtaking. They made us feel so at home.  This will be our first excursion we will book when we go there  again.
Best time ever!!!

We first met Terry at the dock and he was just so friendly and passionate about the tour and the company we signed up immediately for the excursion.

A exciting trip on a beautiful plane and the scenery was fantastic!

review_title: If you already cruised through Tracy Arm Fjord, I would skip this excursion.
review_text:
SeaWind Aviation itself is a good company. I would not hesitate to recommend them if you really insist on taking a seaplane ride to Misty Fjord from Ketchikan. However, my review and rating is more about whether it is worth spending the money to go on this excursion if you came in on a cruise through the inside passage. 

Like most people, we came on a cruise ship. I can't speak about the ship that cruised through Glacier National Park but if you cruised through Tracy Arm Fjord, the scenery is similar to that of Misty Fjord. With that said, I just don't see the value of going on this excursion. .

The take-off's and landing were very smooth. We didn't have a completely clear day but it wasn't terrible. Unfortunately, we did not see any wildlife that was mentioned on the website. We were really hoping to see some bears. I think that would have made the tour a bit more worthwhile. Of course, this is at no fault of the company. They have no control over weather or sighting of wildlife. Nevertheless, it was disappointing.

Tip: Leslie more or less runs the office by herself so I would recommend communicating with her via email rather than telephone. She is very busy and could be distracted on the phone especially during the day. She is very responsive and organize thou.

I went on this tour on July 15th-The pilot Ralph was excellent-very smooth ride in float plane over pristine vistas-loved the spectacular scenery!!! Never knew the Fiords were so majestic.Thanks so much for a wonderful safe smooth flight plane ride.

On our Alaska trip, one of the things I wanted to do more than anything else was to take a float-plane trip.  I looked at the recommendations on Trip Advisor and started making arrangements for a booking.

Well, here's a tip.  Don't wait until the last moment to book your float-plane trip.  Not a good idea, as a lot of other people are wanting to take one of these trips just like you do.  So, after finding one after the other companies being booked out I got a little disappointed.  But, two of the other companies recommended SeaWind Aviation to me.

When I called Lesley (the owner's wife) she told me that they would have room for my wife and I to join them on our trip!  Hooray!  I booked it right then and there.

When we got to the docks, the folks from SeaWind were waiting for us.  After a short trip to their base of operations, we headed to our plane with some new friends that we made on the docks.  Watching the other planes take off in front of us (competitors) was very cool.  We climbed into our DeHavilland aircraft and motored out into the bay.  In a flash, we were airborne as the plane followed behind the others that had taken off earlier!

What a site to behold.  Ketchikan from the air, the ships below, and the planes out ahead of us.  Pretty soon, we were out of sight from Ketchikan and making our way into the Tongass National Forrest.  

We had fantastic weather and every passenger had a seat with a window.  One of the passengers, an Army veteran got to fly co-pilot and he was really jazzed about that.  We all had head-sets to listen to our pilot Rolf narrate information about the sights below us.  He was very knowledgeable about the landscape, the sights, and put us all at ease with his flying skills.

We landed on a lake out in the mountains and got out of the plane to stretch.  While we were on the ground a bald eagle flew by and a small otter swam up to us looking for a treat.  We got back into the plane and took off from the lake with a smooth takeoff.  

I didn't want this trip to end, but alas, we made our way back toward Ketchikan and it was over.

The neat thing is that we were able to tour the town, since we took an early morning flight.  We were not rushed, we had a ball and my wife is now hooked on small plane flight!

Thanks so much, SeaWind Aviation for a fantastic trip.

We arrived on the Celebrity Solstice but booked this trip directly before leaving Seattle. It offers a better value, longer flying, and a nice landing in the national park that the cruise ship operators don't. The owners and pilots are friendly and very knowledgable of the area. I would certainly recommend doing this in Ketchikan and after take  a walk on Creek St.

review_title: Highlight of Our Trip to Alaska

review_title: Amazing! What beautiful scenery and a great family owned operation.
review_text:
We booked this at the last minute and are SO glad we did. They are a small operation and you feel it when you book and travel. The person who took the booking was one of the owners and our pilot was her husband! 

The views were out of this world and the journey is spectacular. Suitable for seniors and younger folk alike. 

Go to misty fjord and book with Seawind. You won't go wrong!

Thank you Yelp and Tripadvisor.com reviewers for recommending SeaWind Aviation!! What made this trip memorable:
1. Amazing views!!!
2. Very friendly, professional staff and reasonable prices.
3. Their planes offer EXCELLENT views from no matter where you sit. Their windows are clean and not scratched up, so pictures come out clear.
