Don't bring backpacks as there may not be enough room on the plane. If you do, you can store them at their office during your flight. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS TOUR!!!

review_title: Amazing Flight over the Misty Fjords!
review_text:
Normally, we would have booked the float plane tour through Holland America before we left.  However, we weren't certain the weather would be good for flying, so we waited until we arrived and arranged for the trip ourselves at the dock.
Our pilot Steve was very warm, welcoming, and an amazing pilot. He gave us a very smooth take off, landing, and flight over the mountains.  We had a beautiful blue sky day to enjoy the fjords, snow capped mountains, pristine lakes, and mountain goats.  While I enjoyed the views my wife, seated in the rear of the plane, was non-stop taking photos from both sides of the plane.  Tears were in her eyes as she was so thrilled to be able to see the marvelous sites and not get sick!  This was all due to the expertise pilot Steve showed while taking us on this tour.

Terry and Leslie were very accommodating as we had a large group of people. They were very prompt and picked us up directly from our cruise ship. They had very reasonable prices and were very hospitable. The views were amazing and our pilot did an amazing job flying the plane.

Lesley and Steve Kamm were the first locals that we met in Ketchikan.  They own SeaWind Aviation and offer float plane tours of the Misty Fjords.  Friendly, kind, and gracious.  Lesley was a welcomed personality from the other "salesmen" characters we encountered peddling other experiences.  Steve was our pilot and the next two hours were as amazing.  Unforgettable feeling of taking off and landing on the water.  Our plane fit 8 of us, and despite some breezy conditions, Steve kept us soaring stably through some of the most awe inspiring vistas we have seen during our time in Alaska. The fjords, dotted with natural lakes, tucked in valley after valley, flying below and above waterfalls was stunning...almost unbelievable.  We landed our float plane on a lake and wandered on a tiny little island to take pictures and have that glimpse of the float plane experience.  Our kids didn't get to come, but next time we will take them for sure.  We heard from others on our cruise that the 4-person or 6-person planes offered by other companies were more turbulent and those passengers vomited.  Seawind is top notch.  Highly recommended!

My husband and I planned a sea kayaking trip for our cruise ship stay in Ketchikan, but a week before I left for Alaska - I broke a rib.  No kayaking for me.  He had really been looking forward to it, so I told him to go without me.  When I exited the ship a little bit later, it was gray and drizzly.  I wandered into several shops - but nothing engaged me.  We had visited Ketchikan and seen many of the sights - the raptor center and salmon hatchery the last time we were in town, so nothing was talking to me.  I decided to stop in the Visitor Center to get some ideas.  I talked to a helicopter tour operator first, but they would charge me extra to fly alone and we had limited time in the port.  They referred me to SeaWind Aviation for a seaplane ride.  They quoted me a price that I knew was less expensive than the cruise ship's offerings.  I signed up.  A really nice high school teacher drove us to the dock.  When we got to the dock - the wife of the owner was really sweet as she collected the payment, provided water and a very clean bathroom and showed us a safety video that was recorded with their own equipment and people.  When the plane returned from the previous jaunt, it looked really well-maintained and clean.  Everything we saw was just amazingly beautiful.  We stopped once - landing on a lake and then going to a dock in the middle of the fjords to look around.  It also allowed us to get some shots with the plane.  The thing that really impressed me was that the pilot made it feel like we were friends he was taking out for a spin.  It didn't feel rushed or "canned".  It was a little warm so we only spotted one bear, but did see lots of eagles.  It was a great experience.

I was so impressed with how good this company was.  From the phone call I received as our ship arrived to the great job Steve did flying the plane, I could not have been happier.  The views are amazing!  I would get the front seat if at all possible. The view is definitely the beat from there.

We took the flight tour of the Misty Fjords Wilderness when our cruise ship was in Ketchikan.  Lesley and her husband who own the business are wonderful to deal with.  They are both so personable and accommodating.  Our flight was on a particularly clear and beautiful day so the scenery was incredible.  My most favorite moment of our entire Alaskan cruise experience was landing in a remote lake in Misty Fjords and being able to stand on the shore in such a wild and unspoiled place.  While we were there, a loon swam by and hummingbirds circled us.  Just incredible!  I had never been in a float plane before and truly enjoyed it.  Lesley carried us back to the ship and helped us choose a lunch spot and wound up dropping us off right in front of the restaurant.   All in all a terrific experience!

I have sent clients to Seawind ever since I've known them and they are fantastic to work with.  Leslie, who works in the office on booking, is incredibly organized and treats our guests like the special people that they are.  She also communicates well and returns calls promptly.  Steve is one heck of a pilot who is good at engaging the guests in conversation.  He knows the Misty Fiords and works his tale off trying to find wildlife and anything that will create a memorable experience for his passengers.  I have personally flown with him twice and both flights were awesome!!   I highly recommend this well run business with owners that "take care of business" with a positive attitude........and a sense of humor!   Philip Walker, John Hall's Alaska Tours
sadly our flight was cancelled because the weather was too bad (too bumpy to be comfortable). The cancellation was handled professionally and the refund of our deposit was prompt.

Took the Misty Fjords tour whilst in dock on a cruise. Loved it, loved it! The family run business has a great vibe about it. Friendly and professional. The flight was sensational and my husband and I still talk in wonder about the "infinity" lake high up in the mountains and the waterfall falling from it. Landing on the lake and taking in the beauty of the area was an experience we won't forget. In fact it's my dream now to come and stay in one those little remote cabins by the lake. I couldn't imagine a more unique holiday!

We really enjoyed our flight on the float plane.   It seemed like a dreary day but after we got up in the air it  cleared up beautifully.  The views were incredible.  Rolf, our pilot, was wonderful.  He was very informative about the area and gave us an amazing tour around the mountains and into the valley where we landed in a beautiful lake.  Leslie, who set up the tour was so sweet and met us at the port to take us to the plane. If you are prone to motion sickness I would recommend taking something for that before you go up in the air.  I am glad we splurged on this excursion as it was worth it seeing Alaska from above and within.  It really is the only way to see these areas as there are no roads for cars where we went. I would highly recommend SeaWind Aviation.

Words cannot do justice to this great tour and great family business!!

From first contact via phone, Lesley Kamm was fantastic in every way: gracious, patient, fun, accommodating, extremely helpful. Finding her in person at the cruise dock was like meeting an old friend.  Nothing seems to faze her.  
Steve, the company's owner, was our pilot. Again, nothing but positives: with the perfect amount and tone of narration, he is also very aware and attuned to the comfort of his passengers. My grandson had a bit of "motion sickness" and Steve--the understanding father of three --couldn't have been nicer or more helpful. (If you are prone to motion sickness/nausea, DO sit up front with the pilot, or pre-medicate with 25 mg meclizine/bonine.)

The plane trip itself...OMG!!!!! We had perfect weather, landed on a lake ( a bear hid from us at the lakeshore) saw mountain goats frolicking in the snow on a mountain peak. (Steve's experienced "eagle"eyes spotted them, camouflaged against the snow.)     What a privilege to see Misty Fjords' incredible beauty like this, with a skilled pilot taking us to the perfect spots from above! Speaking of wildlife--bald eagles love to hang out at Seawind's dockside office.

All six of our three generation family agreed: this was a phenomenal experience in our favorite port during the Inside Passage Cruise! Don't miss it!

Note: Seawind staff --probably Lesley--picks you up, and will shuttle you back to the ship, or wherever you want. They recommended a nearby gallery and coffee shop owned by a marvelous local artist. It is in the quite side of town, and is called The Point. Going here added to our day. The Point staff  will shuttle you (free)  back to the ship or Creek Street (great local shopping area)  or wherever, after ascertaining your interests

Family operated business, from the moment my family and I were picked up by Seawind Aviation we knew we were in great hands. Leslie, Steve and the rest of their staff do a phenomenal job taking care of their customers. The flight seeing in Ketchikan is absolutely priceless, all six of us had window seats and the flight was absolutely breathtaking. Pilot always checking on everyone through out the duration of the flight which was still a very smooth flying experience. It's a must do in Ketchikan, not only because of the views but also because of the customer service.

review_title: The kids rate this #1 of things that they did in Alaska!
review_text:
After we recently returned from our Alaskan trip, I asked our kids (ages 13 & 17) what they liked best about the week long cruise and by far, they said they enjoyed our seaplane excursion into the Misty Fjords with SeaWind Aviation.  We had a great experience with Leslie in the office and Steve as our pilot.  Because there could be several ships in port on the day when you arrive, make sure that you tell Leslie which ship you are on so that she's not waiting at the wrong dock!!

Steve knows his stuff and the things that he pointed out for us were truly breathtaking.  It's almost surreal what you are looking at.  If you get claustophobia or car sick, this may not be the best adventure for you.  I felt a little queasy at times (maybe because the trip was right after breakfast?!?!) because you do make turns and minor dips in the plane.

We would definetly recommend using SeaWind to anyone who asks.

This was one of the best things we did in Alaska. First, the customer service was excellent. I loved the family-run atmosphere.  Leslie is so friendly and really goes out of her way. Steve was a great pilot and we so enjoyed hearing a bit of local perspective. I was a little nervous about the small plane but as soon as we were in the air all that was forgotten because I was so in awe of the scenery. They have a great soundtrack that they play through the headset that really creates such a beautiful atmosphere - I definitely teared up a little. Steve landed us on a lake in the mountains and we were able to get out on a little island and take pictures.  We went in late May and were blessed with pretty good weather - not sunshine but the clouds were high so we could see a lot. I'm not sure how it would have been if it were raining. I would definitely recommend the float plane over a boat trip as the boats take a lot longer to get into the monument.

Lesley was a delight to work with throughout the process!  At first the plane appeared to quite small for 6 passengers and the pilot but once inside all of us could take photos easily and hear the pilot. the take offs and landings were extremely smooth - I hardly knew we had lifted off.  the views were spectacular.  landing on the lake we got off onto a dock and were able to take in the scenery and of course take photos.  we were the only plane there for most of the time, but it was interesting to watch another plane land knowing you had just completed your landing beforehand.
our pilot was experienced and willing to take pictures of us all.  I would definitely recommend booking with Sea Wind Aviation.

We book online for the Misty Fjords tour everything was perfect: Leslie came to pick us up at the pier, we had a wonderful tour to the fjords, even saw  2 bears walking near a lake on the way, mountain goats, eagles...it was magic ! We "landed " on a lake that was up a mountain, step off the seaplane for a while and continue our journey....The scenery was breathtaking ! Do not hesitate, you will love this tour with Seawind; Amazing experience, specially with the music in the headsets / micro when flying.... Thank you !

review_title: We were on the same trip
review_text: We were on the same trip as Altamira and " it doesn't get any better than this" sums it up perfectly.  I can't think of anything else to add other than a big thank you to Steve and Lesley , we enjoyed every minute of our trip. Janet and Ken

We took the Misty Fjord tour as part of our Alaska cruise.  Booked everything online and Leslie responded to a few emails I sent asking questions.  There was fog in the morning so they were running a bit late with the earlier tour.  My phone wasn't working so I wasn't able to call ahead, but Leslie met us at the port at the time she told us to let us know what was going on and to tell us there would be a 30 minute delay.  

The flight itself was great.  Steve had a music playlist which was a nice touch.  He had a great tour along the way, even circled back so that people on the other side of the plane would be able to see a mountain goat he spotted.  Landing on the lake was so smooth I could barely tell we were on the water.  

Overall this was a great tour and Steve/Leslie made the stop in Ketchikan a memorable one.

review_title: It does not get any better than this!
review_text: We booked a Misty Fjord aerial tour with Seawind Aviation, partly based on Trip Advisor ratings and, more importantly, with correspondence and interaction with Lesley, the co-owner of Seawind Aviation.  From her initial immediate response to my questions, subsequent follow-up questions, and meeting her at the cruise dock, I was certain the excellent Trip Advisor ratings were spot on.  After picking up another two couples, we made a short trip to their seaplane and office where we met Steve, our pilot, who is Lesley's husband and Seawind's co-owner.  As a retired Air Force pilot and retired airline pilot, I have always been a bit leery of small, single engine aircraft, but after a short conversation with Steve and listening to the rythmic beat of the aircraft's engine, I knew we were in very good hands for our aerial tour of Misty Fjords.  After getting briefed and strapped in, we took off on a magically warm and sunny day for a very smooth, unforgettable and fabulous tour of the Misty Fjords Monument.  During the entire flight, Steve gave us information of what we were seeing from the air.  He landed so smoothly on one of the pristine glacial lakes that it was hard to tell when we were on the water (a perfect 10), giving us the opportunity to get out of the plane and experience the monument's natural beauty from ground level. Wow!  Steve and Lesley are a perfect team for a seaplane tour operation.  Both are very friendly, professional, and extremely competent in their respective contributions to the success of thier business.  If we return to Ketchikan, flying with them again will be my top priority. It really does not get any better than this!

review_title: I didn't know a plane could land so smoothly.
review_text: Seawind's pilot, Steve, provides an impressive service. We were in Ketchikan outside of the regular tourist schedule.  Steve was happy to schedule a time that was convenient for us.  the Misty Fjords are majestic.  Steve freely shares his knowledge of the area. He and my teenagers talked comfortably.  I was a little nervous about the flying  but Steve handled the plane so smoothly, if i hadn't been watching the water I wouldn't have known we landed.

We booked Seawind on the cruise dock since we were uncertain about the weather.  We were assured the views would be good at Misty Fiords, so off we went!  The shuttle to and from the float dock was quick and easy.  Our flight was everything promised.  The views from the plane were almost unbelievable.  The pilot/owner, Steve did a great job telling us about the area and answering our questions along the way.  Our brief landing inside the park provided another fantastic viewpoint of the mountains and fjords as well as a look at some widlife from the ground.  The entire flight was smooth from takeoff to landing.  It just goes to show that a cloudy day at Ketchikan doesn't mean you can't enjoy a flight tour to Misty Fiords!

We found seawind on trip advisor as i figured it would be better to book a flightseeing tour independently rather than through the cruise line. We couldnt have been more happy with our experience. Steve and Leslie were very friendly and Steve obviously has a ton of experience having grown up in the area. Flying over Misty Fjords was superb. Steve spotted a black bear andcircled it a few times so we could all see it. We landed on a small lake with a little island and had the place to ourselves. Steve took pictures for us with our cameras that we will always treasure. We went at the first of June and even got a Christmas card from them. Prices were reasonable. If we go to Ketchikan again we will certainly take another trip with Seawind. Highly recommend them as well as Alaska in general.

review_title: No mist on the Fjord on our flight!
review_text: A truly amazing day!  The skies cleared after our ship docked and we had a to-the-horizon view over the mountains and pristine lakes below as well as a completely smooth flight.  Steve was great - as was his wife, Lesley, when I called to reserve.  Besides saving money compared to the cruise ship excursion cost, we felt we couldn't have been in better hands or with a nicer person than Steve.  He tried his best to find grizzlies for us and although there were none to be seen that day he did circle a mountaintop to show us mountain goats grazing on the grass.  Our excursion set the standard pretty high right at the start of our trip!

We were absolutely thrilled by the float plane experience afforded us by SeaWind!  We were also blessed with crystal blue skies and smooth air, something that does not come along every day and more than "doubled our fun!"  Over the magnificent scenery of Misty Fjords national monument we spotted orca whales, mountain goats, and hunters we spotted.  We most heartily recommend SeaWind to others.  The entire staff went out of their way to make our visit special.

Our family recently took a trip with Seawinds and were very impressed with not only the sights, but the customer service as well. Steve and Lesley were great to work with and very friendly. Steve was an amazing pilot who offered a lot of information about what we were seeing. We landed on a remote lake and were able to get out and take some incredible pictures. We can't say enough great things about this company and we thank them for a memorable trip!

review_title: How to Beat Cruise Line Costs for Shore Excursions!
review_text:
First, you need to be flexible.  We wanted to fly seaplane but not pay the big bucks charged by Holland American.  Their cost was $250 for 1 and 1/2 hour ride.  We waited till we docked and then saw it was sunny.  We went several blocks and a promoter asked if we wanted to fly.  The cost was $180 per person for same trip.  

We flew by SeaWind Aviation.  They were great and personable.  We will call them directly next time for even better deal (877-225-1203).  Ask for Steve's wife, Lesley.  She will book for you.  They were a great team.  Steve is a very knowledgable pilot and gives a great tour.  We saw whales, mountain goats, bald eagles, and bear tracks.  We landed on a remote lake and got priceless photos.

We haven't tried all excursions but this should be a no brainer way to save money.

review_title: Misty Fjords National Monument – Fabulous Flightseeing Tour!!
review_text:
Date Visited:  August 2012

I cannot say enough wonderful things about SeaWind Aviation and its owners, Steve and Lesley.  From my first phone conversation with Lesley, I knew this was going to be an incredible tour.  Their customer service and professionalism is unsurpassed.  

We were very fortunate that the weather was perfect the day of our tour.  When we arrived in Ketchikan, we were met at the designated location by the pier and driven to SeaWind’s office which was located about a mile from the port.  Steve was our pilot and his years of flying experience were obvious.  Our takeoff, landing and the flight itself was smoother than any of our past small plane experiences.  During the flight, Steve provided us with great commentary on the history of the many areas within the Fjords.  His extensive knowledge is quite impressive.

The Misty Fjords are incredible….  Truly a scenic wonder!!  We marveled at the many waterfalls, lakes, mountains, fauna and wildlife.  Landing the plane on a remote lake in the Fjords was awesome!  It provided us the opportunity to step out into some of the most beautiful surroundings imaginable.  

This trip was absolutely well worth the price.  A price, I might add, that is significantly less than the cost of tours offered by the cruise lines!

As part of our August 2012 Alaska cruise itinery, I booked a trip with Seawind Aviation in April after having read good reviews. 
Seawind arranged to pick us up when the cruise docked in Ketchikan. Although their office had our mobile tel. number and also knew which cruise ship we were on, they failed to give us advance warning that they had cancelled our trip because of an apparent 'last minute technical problem'. 
The first time we knew about being let down was when their van arrived at the dock and the lady driver gave us the bad news.  She did not seem too concerned and in my opinion could have been a bit more understanding and apologetic.  
She said that she would try to get us booked with an alternative provider.  After a short while, she managed to get us booked for a later trip that day with Mountainair.  This was the best thing that came out of this whole bad experience, as Mountainair certainly were a more professional company and I would have no hesitation in recommending them.

Our family of five booked this excursion 8 months prior to our Alaskan cruise.  We were able to get a discount booking so far in advance which made it feasible.  I emailed Leslie with numerous questions prior to booking this excursion, and Leslie couldn't have been more pleasant and patient to deal with.  We called from the pier after arriving in Ketchikan since our ship arrived over an hour later than expected.  Our tour time needed to be rescheduled which required several phone calls, but Leslie accommodated us within the hour after rearranging her schedule and we explored Creek St.  We were picked up at the Liquid Sunshine Guage, a short walk from the ship, and driven by van a short distance to their pier.  Leslie's husband, Steve, our private pilot greeted us there and assisted us to board the plane. He explained that he had been a commercial pilot for years before starting his own business.  Everyone had a window and we alternated the front seat.  Taking off and landing in the water was an awesome experience.  We all wore headphones which allowed Steve to point out sights along the way, and allowed us to ask him any questions we had.  We flew around beautiful Misty Fjord and landed in a valley where Steve took pictures of us and let us explore for approximately 15 minutes.  Steve was great at pointing out plenty of mountain goats on our return to Ketchikan.  It was wonderful to experience the difference of Misty Fjords from the air since we had experienced Tracy Arm Fjord from a ship while in Juneau.  We highly recommend this excursion.

Weather conditions were not favorable for our much anticipated flight into Misty Fjord.  Bright spot in our day was Seawinds ongoing communications in monitoring conditions.  While we waited Leslie provided a number of suggestions for making the most of our time in Ketchikan. Never got off the ground on that rainy, miserable day, but with her help it was not a total washout.  

Sorry to have missed out on this opportunity, but thankful to have booked with a responsible and professional company.

Steve and Lesley are everything everyone described before me.  It is worth every penny and I strongly encourage you to do this trip.    We booked directly with Lesley instead of the cruise ship and they exceeded our expectations. You feel like you are flying with family!

review_title: A great way to see the area - be aware of weather.
review_text:
Our family took the floatplan tour to the Misty Fjord and had a great time.  Booked this tour outside the Cruise and saved a lot of money.  Seawind and their pilot deserve the full 5 stars rating, but be aware of the impact weather conditions could have on your tour.  These are the Misty Fjords for a reason, and when there are low clouds and fog they can be a bit too misty.  The pilot took us to very pretty areas, but was limited to where we could go by the low cloud ceiling. 
  
We did have a great flight and would recommend Seawind tours to anyone who visits Ketchikan.  Just keep in mind that it rains a lot in Ketchikan (which makes the area beautiful) and the clear blue sky pictures in all the tour brochures may not be there the day you visit.  Either way the area is still beautiful by air.

A highlight of our trip to Alaska was flightseeing with Steve of SeaWind Aviation.  We chose SeaWind instead of the cruiseship's tour and were delighted with our decision.  Our family of 7 including 5 kids (ages 10-18) were given a flight of a lifetime and benefited greatly from Steve's years of experience and familiarity with the majestic Misty Fjords area.  We had close up views of a bear in the grass, numerous mountain goats in the snow, lakes, waterfalls and fauna.  Steve was an excellent pilot and guide and provided us with many interesting details or the geography and history of the area.  The landing on a pristine lake and view of a family of six furry friends playing in the water nearby will remain in our memories for years to come. Steve's wonderful wife Leslie who was so friendly and helpful on the phone led us to book with Seawind in the first place. She was an excellent ambassador not only for Seawind but also for Ketchikan and was incredibly kind and helpful to us for our other activities there.  We cannot say enough good things about Seawind.  The trip was worth every penny.

Great trip given by some fun guys! Our Bear guide was a cool dude who made our trip very fun! The bears cooperated and we saw many many bears!
The flight was awesome and Steve is a great pilot. Traitors Cove is very scenic and beautiful.

review_title: Misty Fjords + Seawind Aviation = Breathtaking Tour
review_text:
I took my wife on an Alaskan Cruise to celebrate her Big 5-0.  We've been on several cruises before, but this was hands down the best ever!  We took a helicopter out to the Mendenhall Glacier in Juneau, road the White Pass Summit and Yukon Railroad in Skagway, got rained on in Icy Strait Point (big surprise there!), and the highlight of the trip was the Misty Fjords National Monument flight with pilot Steve Kamm and Seawind Aviation!  What a SPECTACULAR flight...the scenery was absolutely breathtaking!  

I have to admit, I was a bit nervous...never been a fan of small planes...and to intentionally get into one that was going to take off and land in water was mind boggling!  However, Steve is a real pro...the takeoff and landing was smoother than any plane I've ever been on...and I would fly with him again without hesitation.

Misty Fjords is simply an incredible experience, and the only way to truly experience this scenic gem is by seaplane.  Steve provided great commentary and displayed his knowledge of the area, showed us all the sights including waterfalls and wildlife, and the water landing on the remote lake was just fantastic.  Steve spotted a brown bear from the air, and landed the plane on the lake, turned off the engines, and paddled the plane real close to shore to keep from scaring the bear away, and we got an up close and personal view of a brown bear in his natural environment.  Tremendous photo and video opportunity!

For those of you considering a Misty Fjords flightseeing tour, do yourself a favor...don't get ripped off by the cruise lines...book directly with Seawind.  I called one night while I was out taking my dog for his evening stroll and spoke to Steve's wife Lesley.  She answered all of my questions, and even gave me a military discount (I'm an Air Force vet).  Seawind's prices are lower than their competitors...and WAY cheaper than the cruise line rates...and the deal was sweetened by the additional military discount.  By the time I got back from the walk I had an email confirmation with all information, time, date, etc..  Once we arrived in Ketchikan, we were met at the pier and driven over to Seawind's office...less than 1 mile from the cruise ship dock...and before you knew it, we were zooming over the Misty Fjords National Monument!  What an adventure...the highlight of our trip...and absolutely worth every penny!!!

Planning for our July trip to Alaska we sought lots of advice from friends etc. A relative highly recommended that we take a seaplane ride over the Fjords. The company he recommended was sold out so I began my own research. Much thanks to Trip Advisor I was able to find this most professional company, SeaWind Aviation.  We loved dealing with this family run operation.  Leslie was so wonderful to work with i.e. returning calls even from her child's ball game!  Steve, her husband and pilot, is a class act. Professional, witty, skilled and informative. We saw beautiful scenery all around us and then to top it off Steve found a blond grizzly bear and circled a few times for us to see it.  Very cool.  This is an excursion you will remember forever.  Thank you SeaWind.

review_title: Breathtaking Tour, Highlight of our Trip!
review_text: When our friends and family ask us what the best part of our trip to Alaska was, we tell them the SeaWind float plane over Misty Fjords.  I was a little apprehensive about the tiny plane, so I took a small dose of Valium to help me remain calm.  There really isn't time to think about that because you board that plane quickly and immediately after, you take off!  The music soundtrack paralleled the unbelievable views. We had clear skies and a smooth flight.  Steve took us to a remote lake and then over some peaks to see mountain goats. It was just unreal and everyone should put this on their bucket list!  Also, take a video while you are up in the air.  What a keepsake!  We booked online without the Cruise ship's tour. We saved about $50 per person too. Do this and do it with SeaWind and you won't regret it!

Seawind Aviation is a family run seaplane operation in Ketchican.
We were a group of 6 friends that did their Misty Fjords Flight on 29 June 2012.
Adam spoiled us with spectacular views of the fjords, forests, water falls, lakes, etc.
The waterlanding on a remote lake and the scienery were awesome.
Steve joined us on the lake with another group of tourists in their  second Bear De Havilland sea plane.
These flights are suitable for young and old.
I can honestly recommend Seawind Aviation without hesitation.
Bookings and reservations as handled by Lesley was very professional and a pleasure.
Their shuttle service from the cruise port, office, sea plane dock and sea planes are immaculate.
Pilots Steve and Adam are excellent aviators and guides.
The cap, t-shirts and golf shirts on sale are very cool.
Take the plunge and fly the Misty Fjords!

Warm regards
Philip Henning
Cape Town  South Africa

On previous cruises, we always booked our excursions through the cruise line.  With sites like TripAdvisor, we felt comfortable discovering our own excursions.  All were great!

This was the most expensive excursion we've ever done.  It was a lot of money for us... but WORTH EVERY PENNY!!  As a previous reviewer mentioned, flying through the Misty Fjord was SUREAL... it's undescribable... beautiful!!

Adam was our pilot, and he was excellent.  We didn't even feel the take-off and the landing was very smooth.  He did a great job narrating the whole flight.  You can ask questions via the headsets.  The soundtrack/music in the background over the headset was perfect too.

Adam landed on a beautiful lake and we spent some time on a tiny island just surrounded by Alaskan beauty and majesty!

You simply must do this!

review_title: Awe inspiring flight of the Misty Fjord
review_text: I had booked this excursion prior to leaving for our Alaskan cruise.  Lesley was very helpful with planning and answering all of my questions.  Upon arriving at the port we were picked up and taken to the Seawind Aviation Office.  Lesley met us there and was very personable.  Adam was to be our pilot for this tour.  This was one of the best tours we did during the entire cruise.  Flying in the seaplane was surreal.  The beauty of the area and the Misty Fjord was awe inspiring. Adam was narrating the entire time about the fjord and various lakes.  We were able to land on a lake and get out for some pictures.  We then took off and headed back.  Scenery, scenery, scenery.  Do this tour you will not regret it.

3 weeks prior to our Alaskan cruise, realized we hadn't booked a flight seeing excursion. I called Seawind Aviation and booked Misty Fjords excursion. This was the highlight of our cruise. Steve & Lesly Kamm were very accomodating to arrange this flight on short notice and around their family Holiday plans. Steve, a 4th generation bush pilot, with 20,000 hrs. plus flight time; gave us an incredible flight to take in the scenery and wildlife (did see a bear and numerous mountain goats!)
Seawind is a definite must if considering float plane excursion in Ketchikan!

There are no words to describe how wonderful this trip was. Seeing the beauty of Alaska from this small floatplane was magical. Our pilot, Steve, is a native of Ketchikan and knows the area well. His wife, Lesley, was so friendly and helpful during our booking process. The entire experience is one my family will never forget. Hopefully Max, the family's golden retriever, will be out fetching logs in the water while you wait! Don't hesitate to go with SeaWind. We certainly will if we are able to make it back!

OK, so I was a big chicken....swore I would never, ever, ever get into such a small plane.  Well, I did not want to pass up such an opportunity and Lesley was a wonderful "guidance counseler"  :-) and helped me through the reservation and every step along the way (incl a can of ginger ale for the ride).

We got promptly picked up at the pier and were shuttled off to the dock.  I got a little queezy, but eventually all that settled and I was able to really enjoy the wonderful nature.  We saw a couple bears, had a landing on a lake and saw more eagles, too.

Our pilot was Captain Adam and he was very nice.  We wish sincerely that we can come back some time and have a longer visit.  We loved Ketchikan, rain and all.  Thank you Lesley and SeaWind Aviation!

We are a group of 6 and booked the float plane exclusively for our selves. Lesley was in contact with us from the day before and we did not have any doubts or hesitation regarding where and when we are going to be picked up. The flight to Misty Fjords was fabulous and we saw some wonderful sceneries.It was a feast to the eyes. We really enjoyed the float plane ride. The flight was smooth, comfortable and enjoyable.Steve is an excellent pilot and made us comfortable throughout the flight.

My husband, daughter and I booked Seawind Aviation after much searching on the web for excursions in Ketchikan. Tripadvisor reviews were all excellent for the Misty Fjords Tour.  We were looking forward to it and were extremely happy with our decision.  The experience exceeded our expectaions.  The scenery was incredible. Waterfalls galore!  
Steve and his wife were friendly, helpful, and honest.  They answered all my questions before I booked with them.

My wife, myself, and our two 11 yr. old granddaughters recently took the Misty Fjords Tour with SeaWind Aviation out of Ketchikan.  Steve Kamm, owner & pilot, provided a wonderful flight for us all.  The flight through Misty Fjords was breathtaking.  At on point, Steve spotted a mother bear & cub in a meadow near a lake in the wilderness.  We landed nearby and were able to take pictures & enjoy the experience.
Steve is a wonderful pilot; a family man with three daughters; and very knowledgeable of the area.  The float plane was well-maintained.  I highly recommend this company.

review_title: Wow!  The Highlight of Our Alaskan Trip
review_text: Family-owned and top notch in every way. Cannot say enough about the quality of the experience they offer. We had not planned on taking this tour but the guys on the dock told one of our companions they would make us a great deal if all 6 flew. My wife and I toured Ketchikan and kept saying we ought to do that.  Eventually, we decided to and just the two of ended up flying (so the deal wasn't quite as good but still better than the ship.)  This experience was truly the highlight of our trip (and we even used another flightseeing company to land at Base Camp in Deanli.)  Steve is firendly and seems knowledgeable.  When he spotted a couple of bears near a lake, he didn't hesitate to land closer for a better view.  Thanks!

We researched quite a few companies before deciding on SeaWind aviation for our Ketchikan excursion.  Steve and Lesley were awesome hosts and we had the most amazing day.  I'll admit I was pretty nervous about going up in a plane despite the company's excellent reputation and the fact that my pilot husband was along.  I couldn't believe how smooth the take off and landings were and how much fun I had.  Beautiful scenery and awesome customer service made this the tour of a lifetime.  You will not be sorry booking with this company, they are awesome!

This was a well organized expedition.  Lesley and Steve were very friendly.  After being picked up promptly by a van to go to the floatplane dock close by, we arrived to homemade pastry made by Lesley.  I am not a fan of small planes, but felt very safe in the plane and thoroughly enjoyed the flight with its magnificent views.  Steve is a native Alaskan and has been flying for years.  He is knowledgeable, but best of all has a great sense of humor.  I would highly recommend this tour.

review_title: Husband and wife team allow you to customize your trip
review_text:
Lesley and Steve Kamm run a wonderful operation with Leslie handling the reservations and Steve flying the plane.  The plane usually holds 6 passengers.  Lesley agreed for an upcharge for me to
book out the plane for my family of four.  

We were promptly picked up and taken on a 5 minute van ride to the plane. The plane took off right away.  No waiting time. 

Take off was smooth.  The plane ride was enjoyable.  Steve was knowledgeable.  We felt safe throughout the flight.  

I highly recommend this company.

review_title: Float plane ride to Misty Fjords
review_text:
The flight with Steve to Misty Fjords was the greatest experience a person could ever ask for. Steve and Lesley are the most gracious host we have ever had on our many trips.
If you are planning a trip to Ketchikan,Ak I would strongly recommend SeaWind aviation for my number one adventure.

We recently visited Ketchikan and opted for a floatplane excursion with Seawind Aviation. It was the best decision of our entire trip. Lesley met us as we got off our ship and took us to meet Rick  who they recommended for a bit of salmon fishing before our 11am flight. It was great. Rick took us out on his recently repowered boat and proceeded to take us where the salmon were to be found. He also handled taking our fish for processing and shipping. You couldn't ask for more as Rick told us about the history of Ketchikan and many important aspects of daily life there. 
We arrived for our flight right on time and met up with Steve, Lesley's husband. We were off for my wife's first flight in a smaller plane. She loved it. There were great photo op's with whales and bears not in short supply. The scenery was second to none with Steve providing us a very safe and exciting trip. My wife couldn't stop smiling. 
Forget the cruise line overpriced tours and contact Steve and Lesley. You won't regret the decision.

Ray and Carol    May 20, 2012

GREAT Float Plan excurision into the Misty Fiords.
Small Mom&Pop operation well worth the experience.

After a telephonic booking which linked us in South Africa with Lesley in Alaska, we had a gut feeling that booking a trip with SeaWind Aviation would be right.   We weren't wrong!   Lesley has to be one of the nicest people we have ever met.  Over the phone, she answered all our questions with such friendliness that when we finally got to meet her, I felt as if I knew her already.

We took the trip to Traitor's Cove early in the season and had been warned by Steve and Lesley that we may not see any bears.   Naturally, this was our main reason for the trip but we were also content to experience a floatplane trip, some amazing scenery and meet an Alaskian family.   The floatplane trip was as smooth as any other flight I've taken, the scenery was absolutely breathtaking, the Alaskian family didn't disappoint and nor did the bears who decided to come out of hiding during our particular trip and take a stroll up the river in search of the elusive Salmon.    Seeing these awesome creatures in their natural habitat was phenomenal and we felt fortunate to have had this experience - especially knowing that Steve and Lesley's only job was to get us there and as explained by them, they have little control over whether or not the bears would show.  But they did and Steve and Lesley were just as excited as we were.  I know that they would have shared our disappointment too had we not seen anything.   

I would highly highly recommend a trip with SeaWind Aviation.  The booking was 100% smooth, they provided us with clear instructions as to the procedure when we arrived in port and where prompt in collecting us.  In addition, we felt completely safe traveling with our 3 year old, 9 year old and 11 year old children.  And if I haven't already made the point, Steve and Lesley are the kind of people you would like to make friends with!

review_title: Sea Wind and Steve are your best bet for a fabulous ALASKA adventure!
review_text: In one amazing hour with Steve at SeaWind Aviation we saw more of Alaska than we did in a week onboard the ship.  Majestic fjords, beautiful lakes, soaring mountains, bears, sheep, deer, eagles - we saw it all in one fantastic flight!  All while Steve regaled us with great stories of  his many, many years flying in Alaska.  HIs cool plane is clean, comfortable and very, very safe inspiring confidence the moment you climb aboard - confidence that grows when that big ole radial engine roars to life!  Do not go to Alaska without experiencing ALASKA with SeaWind!

review_title: An experience not to be missed with a company you can trust.
review_text: My sister and I booked our flight to Misty Fjords with Steve and Leslie Kamm following the glowing reports we had read on Trip Advisor.  I would highly recommend them for their integrity and concern for their passengers' safety.  We arrived in Ketchikan by cruiseship on 26th August. The weather was overcast with light showers when we took off, but worsened as the flight continued.  After about 20 minutes Steve made the decision to turn back due to poor visibility, and whilst we were disappointed that the trip had to be aborted, we were also grateful that we had a pilot whose first concern was for our safety.  We were promised, and received, a full refund.  Steve even drove us to Creek Street so that we could at least do some sightseeing and shopping for the remainder of our time in Ketchikan.

We recently returned from an Alaskan Inside Passage Cruise. While in Ketchikan, we decided to take advantage of the seaplanes and booked a Misty Fjords flightseeing tour with Seawind Aviation. They are a small, family run business and their prices were much better than those offered by the cruise line. They even gave discounts for booking early and paying in cash. Lesley picked us up right by our ship and drove us to their office where Steve then took over with the flying. Misty Fjord was breathtaking and Steve gave a great tour on the area. I highly recommend seeing Misty Fjord but also Seawind Aviation. If we ever make it back, we'll be sure to book another tour with Steve and Lesley.

As part of our Alaska Inside Passage cruise, we were at Ketchikan during end of June 2011. We planned to do a 90 minutes float place flight into Misty Fiords but did not book anything in advance as Ketchikan weather can be very unpredictable. We booked our misty Fjords float plane trip when we arrived at Ketchikan. We booked with “SeaWind Aviation” which is a small family (husband & wife) run company. The name of the pilot was Steve and he is a cheerful kind of guy. 

The weather was cloudy which is quite normal for Ketchikan and made the Fjords even more mysterious.  I have never been to a float plane in the past and wasn’t sure what to expect. The take off was amazing and it took about 20 minutes to arrive at the Fjords. From air the area looked like a lost world. Steve, the pilot, spotted a bear and tried to show us the animal. But unfortunately I didn’t see any bear. Many people says a lot of good things about float planes but no one warned me about the fact that you will almost certainly get travel sickness and need to be prepared beforehand. I was feeling a bit sick after about 30 minutes and I was glad to be able to get out when the pilot landed the plane in a remote place within the Fjords. 

The landing spot was simply amazing. It was middle of no where near a large rock within lake surrounded by vertical mountain rocks and forest around. It was damp, drizzly and misty and I’ll never forget the scenery and the experience.  I must admit the Fjords looked much better from the ground; it was simply wonderful. 

After about 15 minutes our flight took off again for more aerial view of the Fjords and eventually returned back to the base well after 90 minutes.

I haven’t flown with other companies and can’t tell what they are like. 
However, I would strongly recommend this company for the way they made our experience truly memorable.

We just finished a bear watching tour. We saw four bears an amazing lake and Steve flew us into the mountains for a chance to see mountain goats. If Seawind is the company your cruise ship sends you to you will not be disappointed. If you are debating booking through your ship vs independenty, definately go with Seawind. Leslie, Steve and our guide Sarah rocked!

review_title: SeaWind Aviation, Ketchikan Alaska - Great Trip
review_text:
In August 2011, my husband and I had the opportunity to go on a float plane trip to Misty Fjords.  We chose SeaWind Aviation for our trip.  The company is family owned and do a 100% professional job.  
Steve and Lesley Kamm are the owners.  Lesley was great to work with over the phone when making our reservations.  Steve is the pilot and he took us on a wonderful trip to Misty Fjords.  He lands the plane on a lake and everyone gets out to spend some time in the middle of nowhere...with the most beautiful scenery you can imagine.  Steve is very knowledgeable and gives a great tour.
I was a little nervous about going on a small plane, but once we got started I forgot all that and enjoyed the ride.  There is so much to see and such beautiful landscape, pictures just  don't do it justice.
Steve and Lesley do a wonderful job and we highly recommend their company.
I've added a few photos of our trip.

review_title: Fantastic company to take you to the spectacular Misty Fjords
review_text:
Support the people who live in Alaska - fly local with Steve and Leslie. This is a one plane family operation with a spotless record and exceptional service. They are delightful people who take pride in their business and love what they do. I give it my highest recommendation.
 
We found SeaWind on the internet when we were looking for an excursion off the Holland America Zaandam when we docked in Ketchikan. Flightseeing is the best way to see the Misty Fjords. Everything was as described, and was provided with a smile and sincere friendliness.

review_title: Great Floadplane trip and wonderful couple
review_text: Took the Misty Fjords trip with my family in August 2011 from Ketchikan.  It was a beautiful sunny day and the trip was great.  Lesly and Steve(our pilot too) are a wonderful couple who are friendly and nice to deal with.  We got meet their kids too.   Highly recommend doing a trip with Seawind.

review_title: Nice family company provide a beautiful way to see Alaska that's a great value.
review_text:
Leslie was very helpful in setting up our reservation. I emailed her with my inquiries and she called me quickly to set everything up. 

Seawind is definitely the best value that I could find anywhere for this type of tour. Because I had 7 people in my group (just what the plane holds minus the pilot), I was able to reserve the whole plane for $1,200. That is a great deal.

Leslie picked us up right at our ship and drove us to Seawind's dock. She was really nice.

We were up in the air quick. It was a really neat experience. The float plane is tiny, but comfortable. We flew over Misty Fjords for 45 minutes or so, then Steve landed us on an alpine lake and let us get out on a little island. Very serene and very fun. We walked around and took pictures for 15 minutes or so, then got back in the plane and flee back. 

Steve spotted some mountain goats, so we flew right over them. Steve was a really nice guy. The only thing that would have been better would have been a little more commentary from him about what we were seeing.

Overall, though, it was a once in a lifetime kind of tour, and Seawind is cool family company that provides a great value.

I heard good things about Seawind aviation in Ketchikan from this site and I booked a flightseeing to Misty Fjord in June. 

The experience was unbelieveable. The scenary was great. It was rainy that day, but Ketchikan has more than 100feet of rain a year, so I guess I should not complaint.

One thing worth special mention is Leslie, who is the wife of the pilot. She is so friendly. We planed to visit Totem Park after the flight seeing, and she actually drove us to the park!!! It not only saved us money but also saved us valuable time, since the cruise ship we were on only stay for 8 hours (coral princess). 

I highly recommended trying Seawind. It is simply the best.

We went on our Alaska cruise this July.  The first stop was in Ketchikan.  The day was absolutly beautiful. It was 80 degrees, sunny and clear.  Leslie Kamm of SeaWind told us that we really had hit it on a beautiful day.  Usually it is a bit chilly or overcast.  The van was at the dock just as they said they would be to pick us up.  After a short ride we arrived at SeaWind Avaition and we were able to meet Leslie with whom I had been corresponding.  Her husband who was usually the pilot, taking a day for rest.  Instead we had a wonderful man who was also a med vac pilot so we felt very comfortable.  Once  inside our float plane, we put on head sets so we could hear the pilot and visa versa. The entire flight was amazing.  We soared thru Misty Fjord, landed on the water, were able to go onto Goat Island for a bit, then take off to see the rest of this marvelous countryside.  Our tour was about an hour and a half but it felt like fifteen minutes!  I couldn't get enough of this beautiful place.  Our pilot kept us informed of where we were, what we should be seeing and any other little tidbits he had for us.  Take a camera for sure!  I also took some video of our take off and landing.  Wonderful exsperience that I would recommend to anyone

We did the floatplane trip to Misty Fjords 7-21-11.  The views were spectacular, and commentary by Steve was informative.  The scenery lends itself to breath taking photography.  We are still talking about our adventure.  Steve and Lesley are great people, and we enjoyed chatting with them.

review_title: A "must-do" for those who want to see the Misty Fjords
review_text: Steve and Lesly did everything to make this excursion easy to book and all that we hoped it would be. We appreciated their honesty with the weather and willingness to cancel if conditions weren't at their best. But the weather turned out to be perfect! Steve's familiarity with the area allowed for wonderful narration during our flight. The highlight was landing on a dock in the middle of the fjords and just enjoying the beauty! Skip the cruise booking and book directly through SeaWind--much better price and you're working directly with the company owners.

review_title: The highlight of our visit to Ketchikan!
review_text: My husband and I and our 6 year old reserved this tour to Misty Fjord.  Leslie offered us a family discount.  She picked us up near the rain gauge in her white van clearly labeled SeaWind.  Our flight was excellent.  There was one other couple along and we all had window seats.   This area is so gorgeous from the air.  Lots of bodies of water, some waterfalls, and large granite cliffs.  Steve (pilot) landed on one of the lakes and pulled along side a flat rock and we all got out to enjoy the scenery and take pictures.  (by the way, there is a very nice restroom here at their office on their dock).   We were back in time for lunch.  Leslie suggested the Alaska Surf near the pier, but they were cash only.  So we went back to  Creek Street and rode the incline up to Cape Fox Lodge and had a nice lunch and then we walked the Married Man's Trail down.  Fun!

My mother, husband, and my 13 year old went on our tour with Seawind Aviation.  Leslie was great meeting us near the Ketchikan vistor center. She brought us to where the plane was and we boarded.  We were all very excited to experience take off on the water and landing on the water.  The flight was incredible seeing the beautiful mountains at Misty Fyords.  Steve was our pilot and on the way back he swung around so we could see a bear from the air.  Over all we had a great experience and a great memory to share.  IT is a little expensive for a  large family but I think it is worth it if you can afford it.

We splurged and did this with our kids ages 9, 13 and 13.  Leslie was great and offered a child discount which some of the others did not.  Steve did an awesome job and we really appreciated the beauty of Alaska.  I highly recommend this company.

I was so pleased with the way Lesley treated us from the first email and all the phone calls. She is warm and welcoming and very helpful. She met us on time and treated us so well. When we arrived at the dock, Steve was there to welcome us and explain the plane and the trip. We loaded up and taxied out to a gorgeous flight. The take off was so smooth, I didnt even realize we were in the air. The same goes for the landings. They were so smooth!! Breathtaking scenery and Steve was so informative of all the sites. We just missed seeing a bear, but we did circle pods of whales on the return flight. BEAUTIFUL!!!  We very highly recommend Seawind Avaition!

review_title: It will take your breath away !!!
review_text: We were on a cruise and wanted to book our own day trips.  Looking over the options for Ketchikan, this seemed to be a fantastic choice.  And it was !  After Leslie picked us up at the cruise ship dock, she drove us to the water's edge where we were greeted by her husband, Steve, the pilot.  He took us on a breathtaking trip in his sea plane over the area and we actually landed at the Misty Fjords so we could explore this national landmark.  Seeing the area by air actually gives you the unique perspective of how vast and gorgeous the area actually is. As we were going back to the cruise ship dock, I asked Leslie where she suggested we have lunch, and she actually dropped us off at the restaurant!   I would highly recommend Seawind Aviation for your trip to Alaska!

review_title: Best excursion of our alaska trip
review_text: We had the plaasure of flying with Steve on a misty fjords tour. His wife Leslie was our ride to the launch site. Leslie was an absolutly gracious host and welcomed us like old family. Once on site, Steve took over and loaded us into the plane for a very smotth and engagig flight. He continued the warm reception and made us feel as we were old freinds car pooling. His flying skils made for a relaxed and beutiful tour. Living Alaska all his life gave insights in the territory thsat other can only begin to scratch the surface of. Ireccomend this tour to everyone. Compaed notes to other passengers who contracted with the compition and Seawind wins hands down.

review_title: I don't understand what all the fuss is about....
review_text:
We loved all of Alaska and have absolutely no complaints about SeaWind Aviation.  Steve was a wonderful pilot, his wife Leslie who runs the office was extremely helpful and organized.  Steve's take-off's and landings were unbelievably smooth.  If you want to take this tour, you could not pick a better company or pilot.  Steve landed in one of the many lakes.  We were able to go onshore for at least 20 minutes.  Steve even took photos of us while explaining what we were seeing.  We watched beaver play and eagles fly.  

This is more about the trip itself.  I don't understand what all the fuss was about.  Flying over Misty Fjords; seeing the fog and the landscape below was exactly what we have been seeing throughout our trip without the expense of a seaplane ride.   Saying it is beautiful and unspoiled describes Alaska.  If you want to take a seaplane ride over an area that is larger than Connecticut than certainly use this top-notch company, but a seaplane trip into Misty Fjords  - I  don't get it.

Steve is such a wonderful guy and a great pilot.  He has a great sense of humor and you can tell that he loves what he does!  He takes time to get to know the people on the flight and really makes the experience that much more enjoyable.  
We took the Misty Fjords tours and found Steve through a mutual friend.  The views are amazing and he does a great job explaining everything.  He is very knowledgeable.  Any of his tours are a MUST DO when in town!!

review_title: The only way to see Ketchikan, AK
review_text: After reading all the reviews, I booked direct with Lesley and got an early bird discount.  I liked the family run business with Lesley and Steve.  They were great and easy to work with.  I was picked up from the visitor center on the dock by Lesley, Although I was staying in town, the docks were within walking distance of the visitor center. I was thrilled to get to ride in the co-pilot's seat.  The flight was phenomenal and well worth the money. The landing on the lake up in the mountains of Misty Fjiord was so smooth we did not realize that we had landed.  There were many photo opportunities of the beautiful Alaskan area. It was a warm, sunshiny day and we could see for miles.  The sights were all I expected and more.

My husband and I went on a float-plane with SeaWind Aviation to Misty Fjord.  The price was better than any other float-plane tours and I can't imagine that any would have been better.  Our pilot, Steve, was friendly and funny.  The views from the air were amazing.  We landed and were able to get out of the plane and look around the surrounding area but the real thrill was being up in the air.  If you are in Ketchikan, I would definitely put this on your "must do" list.

We recently returned from an Alaskan cruise and the Misty Fjords Floatplane Tour with Seawind was the highlight of our vacation.  We booked through SeaWind Aviation's web site.  Lesley called shortly after we booked online to personally confirm the details.  We were picked up right on the cruise ship dock, by Leslie and arrived at the SeaWind Aviation office/dock in minutes.  Steve, Leslie's husband is the pilot. The plane seats seven, everyone had a fantastic window view.  Passengers wear voice activated  headsets.  Steve gives a brief narrative during the flight and passengers can ask questions.  The views from the plane are so beautiful it's beyond words! The tour included a landing on an alpine lake and we got out on a tiny island to take pictures.  Upon return to the dock we were driven back to the ship. This tour was the experience of a lifetime and we highly recommend SeaWind Aviation.

We picked this airtour company because they gave an early bird discount. I was lucky enough to sit in the co-pilots seat. My first time in a small aircraft since I was a teenager. The pilot and owner was business like and friendly. The views were great and the landing on water was so smooth, you actually do not feel coming in. The spot we landed on the fjords was pristine. I got too close to a nesting mama bird and got buzzed by that bird. My wife thought that was hilarious. After the fjords we got the alpine views of the hills with snow. All around great experience. My wife got slightly airsick, but I felt great. This was our second Ketchikan trip and the plane ride made this trip memorable.

review_title: Gorgeous place when seen by air
review_text: My wife and I took Seawind Aviation [---------] to see Misty Fjords.  It was an awesome journey, even despite the fact that I got flight sick.  It wasn't that the plane was that shaky, its just that with the turns that you take combined with being slightly seasick already, I felt a little queasy.  But the vistas and views more than made up for it.  This is a small family run business and you get excellent value for what you pay for.  We got to land on a mountain lake and enjoy the incredible scenery and marvel at being the only people around for miles.  Pictures truly don't do justice to what we saw- it was like the Lord of the Rings or something.  Anyways, if you're planning on doing flightseeing, check out this outfit and these beautiful fjords!

Wow, where do I begin. Last week for Valentine’s Day I surprised my girlfriend with Miami Seaplane Island Adventure Tour to Islamorada and what an incredible experience! Tony, is a true gentleman and went above and beyond to help make this trip something my girlfriend will never forget (and myself). We’ve done a lot of cool stuff all over the world but this was one of the absolute coolest adventures we’ve been on. Starting off by seeing our neighborhood up close from an aerial view, then seeing the crystal blue waters on our way through the keys, to landing right up to the restaurant we had lunch at. Lunch was excellent, plenty of options and fresh seafood with live music! Tony’s flying was smooth and controlled, we felt safe and calm the entire time. We explored the island for a couple of hours before we got back on the plane to head home to Miami. Seeing our skyline again around sunset was also very special for us. Tony is sharp and I feel like I’ve made a new friend. I’m excited to plan another adventure very soon.
tour_name: 45_15_Seaplane Flight From Miami with Lunch in the florida keys _2025-03-06

review_text: The most memorable experience of my life. And I’ve saw a lot! The perspective you get from the air is remarkable. We saw Sharks, Dolphins, Sea Turtles… incredible.
tour_name: 45_15_Seaplane Flight From Miami with Lunch in the florida keys _2025-03-06

review_text: We can’t say enough about Miami Seaplane.  It was wonderful from start to finish. We felt safe and more than that our pilot Tony and boat captain Yanni were both delightful. They were incredibly sweet with our young children as well. We would definitely do this again and it was a memorable adventure !!
tour_name: 45_15_Seaplane Flight From Miami with Lunch in the florida keys _2025-03-06

review_title: A memorable trip by seaplane to Key West
review_text:
My husband and I did the Key West excursion with pilot Adrian at the helm.  It was fantastic!  Adrian was incredibly knowledgeable about the history and ecosystem of the Keys and an excellent pilot, too.  He seemed to have a deep connection to the area and it made the trip especially memorable.  We want to return and fly to another destination soon.  We will recommend this to all our friends far and wide.  Many thanks.

Christine and John Gordon
tour_name: 45_15_Seaplane Flight From Miami with Lunch in the florida keys _2025-03-06

review_text: WOW. Simply amazing. Our pilot’s enthusiasm was like a kid at Christmas. His knowledge of the history and current issues of the Keys was unlimited. We did the trip to Islamorado and wanted to do it again as soon as it ended. We were in expert hands with the local pilot with over 25 years of experience. His narrative was mesmerizing and gave us a whole new appreciation for the beauty of the area and how important it is to preserve it. Thanks for a day we will never forget!
tour_name: 45_15_Seaplane Flight From Miami with Lunch in the florida keys _2025-03-06

review_title: Great Waterplane Flight to the Florida Keys
review_text: Great flight over the Florida Keys with stopover and lunch on 'Loreley' Island. The trip starts and ends in Miami, a short motorboat ride through Miami Harbour to and from the seaplane is included. Overall a great experience and highly recommended!
tour_name: 45_15_Seaplane Flight From Miami with Lunch in the florida keys _2025-03-06

review_text: I LOVED Miami Seaplanes! They took us down from miami all the way to key west, with a bit of snorkeling thrown in. They were super professional, sweet, fun, and it was gorgeous! It's the only reasonable way to get down to the keys; I wouldn't travel any other way! From the sky you could see sharks, dolphins, rays and more, and it was an experience I'll never forget!
tour_name: 45_15_Seaplane Flight From Miami with Lunch in the florida keys _2025-03-06

review_text: If you think this looks fun at all you should definitely book it!! It was an absolute blast!! You can see everything from miles. Tony is a well experienced pilot who got his license in the 1970s. He was a joy to talk to while we were flying to the lunch. My wife loved it as well. Thanks for the memories for our 20 year anniversary!
tour_name: 45_15_Seaplane Flight From Miami with Lunch in the florida keys _2025-03-06

review_title: Birthday surprise flight for a friend.
review_text: Our wives put this awesome day- trip adventure together and I feel compelled to write an inspirational review of our experience. DO IT, Book the flight!!! The owner Tony and his Son Adriel, are incredibly talented, SAFE, and  passionate about flying and bringing this experience to you. They were consummate professional Pilots. Water flying is something everyone should experience. Four of us booked 2 planes, Cessna 172’s on floats. The father son team flew us to key west where we lunched at louie’s backyard, and then walked duval st. Before  returning to Miami at sunset. What a day! What an adventure! What a great experience and memory we have forever... like I said.... Do it!! Joe from Jupiter Florida told ya so.. say hello to Tony and Adriel for me.👍👍

review_text: Wonderful trip with a top pilot. He explained everything in detail and we had a fantastic experience. Top.

review_title: Great overview of the entire island
review_text:

review_title: The only way to see the whole Napali coast without walking.
review_text:
The trip was easy to book and also easy to find (at the Lihue Airport). The limo was ready at the gate but it was only a short walk to the plane, no limo required. The weather was perfect and we had the added excitement of seeing a passenger aircraft heading down the runway towards us before take-off. 
Because of weight distribution, I sat on the left side of the plane but throughout the flight our young pilot kept asking "did you get a good look, "and would turn the plane around so that I could also see the spectacular scenery of the Napali coastline.
This is a highly recommended tour as its the only way to really see this spectacular piece of Kauai.

I’m rating this so low because my husband, who’s generally upbeat and complains about nothing, was so disappointed! He is 240 lbs and about 6’ tall and was seated behind the copilot. He did not have enough leg room to sit properly so his entire trip was spent looking out the left side of the plane. He was unable to enjoy the stunning vistas and saw mostly ocean and clouds. Since he doesn’t like to cause a fuss, he said nothing but the ground crew and pilot should have clearly seen that the seat they assigned him was no good and switched him out with someone smaller. I enjoyed the experience and was truly amazed with the beauty of Kauai from above. Our pilot, Kamako(?) was wonderful! Very knowledgeable and obviously proud of the island where he was born and raised!
Stunning views of Kauai from the plane, Geoff our pilot was fantastic and very informative, staff were all very helpful and friendly. I would happily recommend to anyone.

We were fortunate to have good weather, so we saw awesome views of the Napali coast. The seats are assigned to balance the weight, but right-side seats have the better views. There are headsets to communicate with the pilot and other members of the tour.

review_title: Geoffrey our pilot a true legend!
review_text: Great value! Plane is very comfy! You really get close to the  canyon and Nepali coast , an image I’ll never forget . Geoffrey our pilot a true legend  behind the controls ensuring our safety at all times . Glad I chose this tour . I did the 9 am time nice visibility.

Absolutely wonderful experience! The flight itself is fantastic, and we loved the sights, the employees are where this tour really shines! 

We traveled with our baby son (2.5mo), and Eldridge at the check-in desk was incredible! The check-in and safety orientation process was incredibly easy, and Eldridge was very patient as my wife needed to step away to feed our son ahead of the flight. 

We were joined by another young family with a more mobile older child, and both Eldridge and the pilot, Kamaka, were hyper aware of where she was at as well as recommending someone hold her hand as another plane was coming in while we all loaded into our plane to ensure her safety. 

As for the flight itself, Kamaka was an amazing pilot and guid! They take passenger weights and plane balancing seriously, and they also do what they can to keep groups together. We were fortunate to have a beautiful day for sightseeing, and Kamaka even helped us spot a pod of dolphins as well as a couple different whales breaching. 

For young families, this is the tour to do, and while we brought our little guy his own hearing protection, it sounded like they had some available as well. 

We were debating between a plane and helicopter, and ended up going with the plane due to general safety considerations. We were a bit worried about the view from the plane vs a helicopter, but the windows on the plane were great, and Kamaka did a great job ensuring everyone had an equal opportunity for viewing everything. 

10/10 would do again in a heartbeat when we’re back (hopefully soon!), and this will be our top recommendation to family and friends visiting Kauai going forward!

Thank you Eldridge and Kamaka!!

review_text: Leave the noisy, vibrating helicopters and book this “Cadillac in the sky” for a tour of Kauai that you will never forget. Everything from check-in to landing was amazing. You fly around the entire island on this tour and I (we) will definitely do it again when we return to Kauai! Thank you, Wings over Kauai for an amazing experience!

review_title: Taking in all of Kauai's natural Beauty
review_text: I  highly recommend this excursion. Our pilot Marcus is a veteran pilot who moved his family to Hawaii 13 years ago, forgoing an airline career to be able to be with his family. We opted for the airplane over the helicopter, as the plane was more economical and a safer option to see Kauai. A video of your flight can be purchased for $50 and is a great way to remember your time in paradise. Our experience booking through TripAdvisor was seamless and easy. The cancellation policy made it easy for a change of plans outside the 24 hour cancellation window. If traveling to Kauai, I recommend booking early. They fill up the seats on plane days in advance. May Lono, the Hawaiian God associated with fertility, agriculture, rainfall, music and peace grant you a beautiful day for flying.

Our pilot was very competent and very knowledgeable - turning the aircraft to allow views of everything regardless of the side of the plane where you're seating. Highly recommended.

review_title: Simply the best, most memorable hour of our entire trip to Hawai'i.  We enthusiastically recommend Wings Over Kauai !
review_text: Our Wings Over Kauai Deluxe Sightseeing Flight was - without any doubt - the best and most memorable of all the excursions we did in Hawai'i. He made sure that he flew by or around areas of particular interest so that passengers on both sides of the small plane could get the very best views.  There are no bad seats on this flight!  Everyone had a big window and a quality headset that provided clear two-way communications.  It was much quieter than a helicopter ride and apparently uses only half the fuel of a helicopter flight of similar duration.  We were so amazed by what we saw that we said "WOW!" over and over again and took soooo many photos!  After the flight we bought the video that Marcus made of our flight using footage from the cameras underneath the wings of the plane.  We are so glad we did.  The quality of the video is excellent and includes the narration that we heard on our flight.  We cannot say enough good things about Marcus and this excellent sightseeing flight! review_title: Not to be missed experience on Kauai!
review_text:
WOW! Just WOW! Our flight with Wings Over Kauai is one of the activities I was most looking forward to on our trip, and it totally delivered! It was truly the most magical and breathtaking experience of my life.

I know there are many options for seeing Kauai by air, including both helicopters and small airplanes, but let me convince you that Wings Over Kauai is the way to go.

1) The tour lasts about 1 hour and allows you to see more of the island that the helicopters, which usually skip the south shore on their flights.
2) There are no middle seats! This guarantees that everyone on the plane will get a window seat, and if the plane isn't at full capacity (our plane was max 6 passengers), then everyone is seated on the right which is the best view on the tour.
3) The cost is about half the cost of the helicopters. Let me repeat that, it costs about half of what the helicopters charge!
4) They have GoPro cameras attached to each wing and one inside the plane which record the flight. You can purchase an edited video of your actual flight which is 100% worth it IMO!
5) Our pilot was Marcus and he was absolutely fantastic! He is a birder, like my sister, and before our flight he even wrote down tips on where to see birds on the island. He did an incredible job narrating throughout our flight, and the flight itself was incredibly smooth and comfortable. Marcus truly went above and beyond and made our experience even better than I could have imagined.
6) If you are prone to motion sickness, often times the small planes can provide a smoother flight with less rapid changes in motion than helicopters.
7) I actually prefer that the plane flies a bit higher and provides a better panorama and wider shots than helicopters that fly closer to the terrain. If you have a camera with a good zoom lens, you can still get really nice close up shots!
8) Did I mention it's about half the price of the helicopters?

This plane ride was absolutely amazing and our pilot was awesome! He was so helpful and knowledgeable about pointing out the different landmark like waterfalls, caves, cities, and the Napali Coast was so incredible. This was a once in a lifetime experience and the plane flew so calmly without any bumps and turbulence. My two grandkids went with us and they were mesmerized looking out the windows the entire time. Thanks you Wings over Kauai for making this experience so very special and memorable!

review_title: F A B U L O U S - a must do !
review_text:
- Found them online and chose them based on reviews. Booking process was easy.
- We went for the private 1h Cessna tour which was the perfect choice.
- Brooke and Matt welcomed us upon arrival and gave us precise and clear info as to how things would go (or rather fly).
- They also answered all our questions. They are actually a couple and moved here from Colorado. 
- Matt assisted us to board the plane and Brooke was our designated pilot = girl power 👊
- One needs to use a seatbelt and you get  headphones + a connected mike. You can speak to your co-passenger and also to the pilot.
- Besides a couple of short (announced) bumps during the whole 1h flight, it was really smooth.
- The tour really takes you around the island and time really flies (pun intented).
- Brooke is very knowledgeable and gives you info about what you see and you can ask questions.

When in Kauai, we can only recommend you to book this tour with WINGS OVER KAUAI 🤙

C'est une expérience qui vaut vraiment le coup. Ce fut notre gros coup de coeur lors des 5 jours passés à Kauai et pourtant cette île regorge de trésors.  Merci à notre pilote Marcus qui fait tout pour que cette heure soit extraordinaire: les commentaires, l'attention qu'il vous porte ( boissons fraîches par ex.) la musique. C'est un moment irréel, Kauai mérite d'être vu du ciel. L'avion est un excellent choix ( moins mouvementé que l'hélicoptère). Chacun des passagers a son propre hublot.  Nous le recommandons à 200%. Steeve, Isabelle, Arthur et Corentin.

Réservé pour découvrir en famille ( 2 adultes et 2 enfants) le Waimea canyon et la Napali Coast entre autre, nous avons été ravis de cette expérience; l'accueil fut parfait et  très gentil par Brooke avec conseils et recommandations; un grand merci à Marcus pour son pilotage et son atterrissage en douceur, ainsi que tout ses détails donnés sur les paysages observés; nous avons pu faire de très belles photos malgré le hublo; moitié moins cher que la même prestation en hélico, nous volons plus haut et avons plus de recul pour les prises de photos; nous recommandons à 100%; merci Brooke et Marcus qui font ce métier avec passion et gentillesse

Brilliant trip around Kauai Island, warm welcome and clear instructions provided, no problem taking pictures for us around the plane, very informative about the whole island and took time to make sure we got good views of everything.
