Highly recommend this to people to take a look at this beautiful island from above
The flight was great! Definitely less bumpy than helicopter flight for sure. Our pilot Brooke was very nice and considerate throughout the flight. Highly recommend!

The experience, the people and the sights were amazing.  Over an hour of wonderful landscapes and shorelines, with full descriptions by our pilot.
Cheaper than the helicopters and great views.

He’s so passionate about his job and very generous! We had a beautiful experience. The pilot was great too! If you want to do a plane tour, you definitely need to book here!

-Ariane et Lauriane
It was a great tour. Unfortunately, I got motion sickness and did not feel good. If u take this tour, I highly recommend taking Dramamine before you go.

This tour was amazing! It was everything we had hoped for! Seeing the Napali Coast and Waimea Canyon from the air is a spectacular experience! Matt was the best pilot! He made sure we saw all the waterfalls and valleys on our ride. This is a must do in Kauai! My husband and I highly recommend Wings over Kauai! Thanks Matt!!

We had an excellent flight over Kauai. Our young pilot Brooke did a perfect job and explained a lot  of interresting details about the island. We had perfect weather and saw all interresting parts of the island. The price is o.k. and we highly recommend to do this flight
Great tour. Loved the views. Marcus was wonderful and knowledgeable. You get some of the best views of Kauai this way. It was a clear day and I got some great pics !

Wings over Kauai was awesome, best aerial tour we’ve done. Super friendly and accommodating.  The private tour is great, super intimate. Marcus (pilot) was amazing. He even took time to show us live photos Ali the route as Waimea Canyon was clouded in & offered to reschedule to another day…..we went for it as Na Pali was clear/sunny.   Sweet, awesome, amazing, gorgeous scenery. Marcus was superb guide (& pilot).  A must do on Kauai! We’ll be back to do again with Wings!

Amazing!!!
If you are in Kauai make sure you do this flight. We were going to do the helicopter but changed our mind because of the price. We are so glad we found Wings over Kauai, our pilot was so informative and we got the best views of the island, it was stunning!
Thank you Wings over Kauai for a great experience :)

review_title: Great Value; Great Service, Great Tour
review_text: My wife and I appreciated this flight around Kauai.  But, we have to commend the customer care we were shown by the whole staff at Wings over Kauai.  The day we were scheduled to fly, the island was clouded in; they gave us the option of a refund or rebooking.  We gladly rebooked with them for the next day; and instead of the larger group flight we had booked, the provided deluxe two passenger flight piloted by the owner.  We were able to see the parts of the island we wanted to see, but for safety reasons we did not go into the cloudy interior.   We flew at a leisurely pace--slower than a helicopter; this allowed us to see everything close up--allowing time for photos, and getting lots of information from the pilot. He not only explained the islands geography and current history but also pointed out the spots where a number of movies had been made--including Pirates of the Caribbean, Jurrassic Park, and Gilligan's Island.  At half the cost of a helicopter ride and with customer satisfaction and customer safety as their first priorities, we highly recommend this often overlooked option for seeing Kauai from the air.
What a brilliant trip! Marcus, our pilot, was amazing - he gave us a lot of information / fun during the flight and answered all questions. We were thrilled!

My wife had to leave a couple of days early due to a family emergency. Ellen & Marcus(pilot) were very accommodating, made adjustments & went out of their way to make the tour possible for her the same day. Ellen also called us in advance & informed us about the weather conditions. Due to inclement weather, Marcus flew an alternate route to make sure Napali coast viewing was possible. She loved the stunning views of the Napali coast.

We had a party of four and wanted to fly over Kauai and see the different sites.  We selected Wings Over Kauai because of the description of the flight, and a more reasonbale price compared to booking a helicopter.  This flight was worth every penny!  We had a great pilot who shared a lot of information of the sites, and the history of Kauai through the use of headphones.  We saw the Na Pali Coast, Waimea Canyon, and could look down upon the many waterfalls over Kauai.  The sites of the mountains, canyons, waterfalls, mountain crater and the other spots just can't be described.  The flight was for 65 minute, and outstanding!   Overall, we are so glad we chose Wings Over Kauai!
Es war ein einmaliger Rundlug mit allen Facetten der Insel. Unser Pilot Marcus hat sehr ausführlich den Flug begleitet. Wir würden den Rundflug jederzeit wieder buchen. Danke für das tolle Erlebnis

Had no chance to fly, even fully paid in advance. Reasoning gave by operator was that speedometer not working in a plane, so it can not fly. It has been passed to us couple hours before departure. In the meantime extra message fom Wings Over Kauai manager was that they are working to find an alerative plane for us. Finally they cancelled our filght, even other passangers has been rescheduled. WOK proposed to us flight 3:30 pm when weather conditions was expected to be worst = raining. We had also other bookings made, so there was no chance to flight in the afternoon.
All in one, I do not recommend Wings Over Kauai for Island flights. It was really bad suprise for all our group.
They shall pay more attantion for plains maintenance and customer care to avoid flights cancellation.
Br
Wojciech

We highly recommend taking a flight with Wings Over Kauai.  Ellen and Captain Marcus changed our flight for us at very short notice as the day we had originally booked was due to rain. We  got clear skies and the most incredible views of the entire island. The scenery from the air is truly breathtaking.  We all agreed that our flight was definitely a highlight of our entire Hawaiian holiday.

review_title: The most amazing experience in Kauai !
review_text:
This flight was an unbelievable experience. 
Captain Bruce and Matt were very nice and patient with us.
We had a lot of amazing explanation during all the flight about the Kauai history and culture. We have seen some wonderful landscape, we highly recommend Wings Over Kauai, everything was perfect :)

Absolutely amazing pilot and trip around the island. Wonderful views! It was amazing to see a side of the island that helicopters don’t usually go. We flew lower than I thought we would too!! 

My one complaint is about the check in process. Our flight was at 9:30. We were told to check in at 9:00, but We arrived at 8:30 just in case… when I finally saw a face at the desk and checked in, I was shooed away for being too early and told they would come get us when they were ready. They grabbed us at 9:17 and rushed us out to the plane. She took a couple pictures and told us we would have time for pictures after. (This was not true.) she got extremely short with us and made us all very hurriedly get into the plane. Not a great way to start the experience… and we never got quality pictures as a family because the pictures sent by the company were very low quality.

However, that being said, it was a great experience, but I’m not sure if I would fully recommend.
We did an amazing tour, our seasoned experienced pilot Bruce and his small team was so kind, lovely and professional! I would recommend this tour and do it again without any hesitation.
The pilot and ground crew were friendly, informative and fun! The experience exceeded our expectations! We even saw whales in the water
Haben auf Fluggäste gewartet, die bekamen die besten Sitze. Die Kinder schliefen sofort ein und wir konnten wegen der schlechten Sitze fast nichts sehen. Nie wieder
Great tour of the whole island.  Our pilot, James was very friendly and knew so much about Kauai'  We saw beaches, mountains , and waterfalls.  beautiful way to see the island

Great views of the entire island of Kauai! Very smooth ride and beautiful scenery! We saw waterfalls, rugged mountains, sandy beaches, and even some whales. We'll worth the price, and super customer service.

review_title: Beautiful view of the island with superb staff and Pilot
review_text: The tour was comprehensive and we covered the whole island.  The pilot, Bruce, was a superb pilot and guide.  Each site had a detailed explanation.  He answered questions about the island and culture that weren't part of the tour, but we're responses to our questions.  We even saw whales, which was just as interesting as the whale tour.  The front desk people were attentive and pleasant.  We WERE TAKEN CARE OF.
What a great experience.  Marcus was an excellent pilot.  Views were amazing.  Well worth the money.  Great overview of the entire island.

review_title: The best choice of our week.
review_text: Marcus was an amazing pilot. Perfect showing of the island highlights with information about culture, history, and agriculture.

10/10 HIGHLY RECOMMEND 
Captain James was a fantastic host. 
The views are unbeatable. 
Amazing experience at a very affordable price for a private experience also 
Thank You
This was the highlight of the visit to Kauai. The pilot was great, everyone was very friendly. The tour is breathtaking! If you are thinking about doing this - do it!

This was fantastic. Our pilot was fantastic. We had already done a boat tour so see the coast so this really was cool to see the same area from above. It really gives you a good look at the island and its beauty.

I also have taken a helicopter tour on the Big Island and the boat tour, both which I got sick on. I get motion sickness easily. However, I DID NOT GET SICK on this tour. I actually got to really enjoy it.

I did take my own pictures but decided to go ahead and purchase the video they offer for something like $50. Totally worth it. I just got it today and you can only image how much better it was than anything I took. Highly recommend to spend the $50, sit back and not take any pictures.

Take this tour with this company - excellent!

As a pilot myself, I always enjoy taking a flight when I visit a scenic locale. The flight with James in the Cessna 172 did not disappoint. James was very professional and gave and excellent commentary on the various amazing sights on Kauai. The one hour tour allows for views of most of the island and gives a perspective you won't see from the land or sea. Highly recommended!

Had a great and personal experience with owner/pilot Bruce.  Bruce pointed out all the sights and engaged each member of the family by name in conversation.  We had a smooth and beautiful flight that enabled us to see parts of Kauai that we wouldn't be able to see by any other means..  Highly recommend Wings Over Kauai to any first time or repeat traveler to Kauai.
Very nice hour in the air over key features of the island. Our pilot Marcus was extremely nice and informative. Great way to get an overview of the island.

review_title: If your a pilot this is the tour for you
review_text: As a pilot a fantastic way to see the island and have some fun actually flying the plane : very good value for the money : we circumnavigated the whole island and we’re up for over an hour:

Moment magique dans les airs au dessus de Kauai. James nous a fait découvrir les merveilles de son île depuis le ciel, c’était magique. Une petite musique douce dans le casques et les explications de James rendent cette expérience absolument fabuleuse. Merci à toute l’équipe de Wings Over Kauai et leur flexibilité pour avoir rendu ce moment mémorable. Nous nous en souviendrons toute notre vie. Margot et Vincent

review_title: Great pilot; front desk check in/help not so great
review_text:
The plane ride was scenic and beautiful. Our pilot Marcus was personable and did an excellent job! He provided so much information with regard to the history and nature of the island as we toured.

I would give it a 5-star rating except for the fact we didn't get our pictures (taken by WOK) via email as promised when we were leaving the location. I had to email them the next day to ask for them. Also, we did not get pictures of us (daughter and I) taken in the plane with our headsets on: the other 3 passengers did get theirs taken. An oversight by the person taking these: we would have loved these for our vaca pic collection.

review_title: AMAZING!!! Marcus was so awesome! He did the best tour over Kauii.
review_text: Marcus is an amazing pilot…showing us what you can’t even put into words. Breathtaking views! Explained the views and history of Kauii. Absolutely amazing! Will take this tour every single time! Helen and Jill were also awesome and so friendly. Our best excursion ever!
Took the air van with the whole family and it was amazing.  Did it on the last day of our cruise.  Perfect way to end our vacation.

Beautiful circle trip around Kauai island. Our experience was wonderful and beautiful to see the island from the Air. The pilot made us feel comfortable and shared a lot of knowledge about Kauai. The only reason I am giving 4 stars instead of five is because my husband had an instructional flight booked and they failed to call us ahead to let us know that their instructor pilot had left the company.  They still aloud my husband to take control of the plane for a few minutes but it wasn't what we had originally planned and this could have been a better experience if we were pre-informed. However, the flight and friendliness of the staff was great and we do recommend this company if you are looking for an alternative to a helicopter.

Wings Over Kauai was a great tour of the island.  Check in was easy, our pilot was very friendly and knowledgeable of the different landmarks.  Definitely recommend to anyone looking for a bird’s eye view of Kauai.

Best experience ever! Better than every Helicopter-Flight I did! Thanks Ellen for the nice reception and Marcus for the wonderfull flight with all the very good information about Kauai and lovely music during the flight. Highly recommended!!!

Amazing experience! One of the highlights of our three weeks trip to four of the Hawaiian islands! The weather was beautiful with only a very few clouds and our pilot Marcus expertly explained to us what we saw below. All seats allowed for taking breathtaking pictures of the canyons and the coast. We would definitively recommend doing this and will do it again should we ever have the chance.

review_title: Survol de l’île de Kauai a couper le souffle
review_text:
Un magnifique survol de cette île splendide, pour mieux prendre la mesure de tous ses trésors cachés et surtout inaccessibles ! Le pilote, Marcus, était super sympa, il commente tout ce qu’on voit, on peut poser des questions et échanger. Chacun a sa fenêtre et voit parfaitement tout. En prime le tout est filmé par des GoPros (payant bien sûr mais on n’y va qu’une fois !), ça permet de profiter relaxes du moment sans être pendu à son appareil photo.
Une expérience inoubliable qui en vaut vraiment la peine.
The cessna tour is amazing ; this is one hour of real enjoying ! A special thanks to our pilot (James)

If I could sum up this excursion in one word- BREATHTAKING!   From the moment we checked in to the moment we left, we had the best experience.  Everyone was so friendly.  Jacob was our pilot and was so knowledgeable about the island.  You have headsets so you can listen and talk to the pilot.   I can’t sat enough about this tour other than it’s a MUST do.  You must see Kauai from the air and I would highly recommend Wings over Kauai.  We decided on the Cessna which can fit up to 3 based on weight.  We only had 2 people so it’s a private tour.    The flight was smooth and so enjoyable.
Very much worth it! Breathtaking views flying over the whole island, from south to north, with a very calm and experienced pilot. Can recommend fully!
Fabulous experience. Easy to find location. Friendly check in. Knowledgeable and engaging pilot. Beautiful views of the island.

A fantastic way to spend the morning with absolutely breathtaking views of the island! Pilot Marcus was phenomenal and provided great insights into the things we were seeing. This fun and unique activity is something the entire family can enjoy and should be a must-do as you plan your trip to Kauai.

Had a great time with hour long tour of Kauai.  Staff was friendly and very helpful.  Pilot was great and gave detailed overview of the island.  Got a little motion sickness at the end due to turbulence, but otherwise an excellent experience.  Relative to helicopter tours, much more bang for your buck.
Fabulous staff.  Fabulous vista.  Fabulous narration and circled around the Napali Coast a bit so we could enjoy it even more.  Seated everyone for maximum views.

LOVED it.  And I was nervous going into it (nervous flyer that gets motion sickness on boats).  But the flight was pretty smooth...and the views?  SPECTACULAR.  The music and pilot commentary were excellent, as well.   This was the best thing I did on the island (also the most bang for your buck!).

My husband & I flew two times with Wings Over Kauai.  Our adult kids gifted us a private tour one day, and we flew with Jacob, who was incredibly informative and a great pilot!  We saw SO MUCH of Kauai!  The flight was so great we had to have our kids join us the next day so we bought another flight for six of us, and the owners, Bruce and Ellen  (husband/wife team) made it happen for us with little advance notice; in fact, we had Bruce fly us on the second flight.  (The day before, at my request Ellen had texted me and called me to let me know that her husband Bruce was available to pilot us!)  We love supporting this company, owned by a hardworking couple who listen to their customers and provide an unforgettable adventure.  Our second flight was a little different from the first flight, and we saw EVEN MORE of STUNNING Kaua'i and learned even more from knowledgeable Bruce.  BOOK THIS company for your family - you will not regret it - you will leave with lifetime memories and learn so much about the beautiful island of Kaua'i.

Incredible trip that you cannot miss! We did the Cessna flight, with Jacob as our pilot. We were a bit nervous at first, as we hadn't ever flown in such a small plane, but Jacob's knowledge and expertise made us comfortable so quickly. And once we got over the nerves -- WOW! He was really knowledgeable about the island and made it a great trip. Highly recommend!
Amazing views, smooth flight, great experience overall. Bruce, Ellen, and Marcus (our pilot) are incredible all around. 100% recommended

We flew in a little Cessna plane with Jacob our pilot who was very professional and extremely competent. He explained everything landmark we flew over and gave us ideas on where to explore on land. The views were spectacular! Thank you Jacob!
A must do. Breath taking views great commentary from pilot. Highlight of our holiday. Excellent value. Professional and friendly.

If you want to do an excursion on Kauai, do yourself a favor and book a trip with Wings over Kauai!!!  Not only are the views incredible, working with Ellen and the staff was the most amazing experience I have had in booking any type of excursion.  Ellen worked so hard to get us on a flight…working between storms and the small window of time we had while on Kauai and our cruise ship’s departure.  Marcus was our pilot…again, amazing!  He was so knowledgeable of all the incredible things we saw and was very open to questions we had.  I never felt the plane land, it was so smooth.  Our Wings over Kauai was the highlight of our Hawaiian cruise.  We went 6 years ago too…again being the highlight of our trip back then too!  We loved every minute of it!!
Highly recommend seeing Kauai from the air with this awesome company. Best part of our trip and they even went the extra mile by offering us a list of recommendations of thing to do on the island!

Era la prima volta che salivo su un Cessna ed ero un po' titubante ma il nostro pilota e la signora al desk ci hanno messi subito a nostro agio, mentre facevamo un po' di small talk intanto che l'aereo veniva preparato.

Il volo in se è stato molto divertente, abbiamo fatto un milione di foto, il tempo è stato perfetto e abbiamo visto tutta Kauai dall'alto, mentre il nostro pilota ci spiegava cosa stavamo vedendo, accompagnati da un delizioso sottofondo musicale. Si vedono anche le cascate del film Jurassic Park.

Abbiamo fatto il tour privato in Cessna ed è durato circa un'ora e mezza.

Dire che merita è un eufemismo, è proprio una tappa obbligata.

Wings Over Kauai is a must do!  My husband and I were blown away by the scenery.  Our pilot Bruce was so personable and told us exactly what we were seeing. Our expectations were high to begin with and this experience exceeded them.  It was also a very smooth ride.  Bruce is very experienced and has been flying tourists on this route safely for decades.  Waimea Canyon, the Nepali coast, waterfalls…holy holy!  Just book this treat.  Nothing beats the views and perspectives from the air.

review_title: Wings Over Kaua’i is a MUST DO!!
review_text:
Hands down, exceeded all expectations! I wish there were 6 stars to rate here! 

Bruce was our pilot with over 17,000 hours (that’s a quote, not a typo!) flight time.  They took safety very seriously, including weight and balance.  I’m a pilot myself and would be looking out for safety.

My wife and I took the 65 min private tour in their Cessna and the views of the coast, inland valleys and Waimea canyons were astonishing!

Pricing is VERY reasonable considering what the helicopter tour charge, and was less than 50% less during our trip.

We would recommend, as we did, taking the flight toward the end of the trip as we got a different perspective of all the places we visited (and didn’t).

Wings Over Kaua’i was the best.
Great experience! Highly recommend. We flew around the entire island. Our favorite part was the Na Pali coast line!

The highlight of our trip to Kauai!  The pilot put us at ease. The flight was very smooth and comfortable. The views were amazing. The pilots knowledge of the island was great. Thank you for a safe and fun trip. If you are hesitant to book don’t be. You will love it!
Jacob was an wonderful pilot. He was reassuring for my pre-flight nerves. His knowledge of the island was great. It was an amazing flight!

Marcus is a great pilot and tour guide. He gave us so much info on everything we were seeing while up in the plane, plus a lot of history about the island. The route we took showed all the diversity and beauty of Kauai. I highly recommend this flight tour

We booked a private flight around Kauai. Had trouble finding transportation and they were extremely accomodating and helpful. 
Marcus, our pilot, was great in explaining everything we saw and kept our fligh smooth (wife gets motion sickness very easy and did not have a problem with this experience).
Were not sure to book a helicopter or a plane. Do not regret at all having chosen the plane (price, everyone had a window, longer flight and smoother).
Would definitely recommend!
Awesome pilot, awesome owners and incredible flight with incredible pictures! Couldn’t have been better unless it was free!

Extremely friendly hosts. The pilot was very kind and friendly. We werent able to fly by the Napali coast due to bad wether but they were super kind in refunding the amount promptly. Also helped me find another tour with another company to ensure my vacation wasnt ruined. Such kind and loving people!! Couldnt appreciate and thank them enough!

We, a group of 3, very enjoyed that amazing Cessna flight! You definitely should not miss this unforgettable experience!
Captain Jacob was very sympathetic and provided a lot of information about the island. The island itself is a must-see destination from above!
Thanks to Captain Jacob and see you in Vienna! ;-)

My boyfriend and i took the Cessna tour. It was a great deal for a private flight. Our pilot was very friendly and knowledgeable. We saw the whole island and even got to see some whales! Would definitely recommend this to anyone.

Wow! What a great way to see Kauai. I booked a discovery flight for my son($320) who is passionate about flying. Jacob was a great instructor and gave him an experience of a lifetime. The air is also a great way to spot whales. 

I sat on the back and he sat in the pilot position. Jacob was professional and I felt   confident on his training. We hope to be back someday to do it again.

review_title: Wings covers more of the island than helicopters
review_text: We had a flight in the air-van with the bubble windows. Each of of had great views. The plane flew over the southern portion of the island also which the helicopter tours skip, usually going straight to Waimea canyon. When a couple whales, calf, & tiger shark were spotted off the NaPali coast, the pilot had time to circle around to observe them for a bit longer. It was very enjoyable, half the cost of a helicopter tour. and smooth.

review_title: Great way to see the island
review_text: We flew in a Cessna 4 seater.  Great way to see the island of Kauai & Napali coast.  Our pilot Jacob was very informative.  This was one of our favorite excursions while visiting Hawaii.  Our tour was supposed to be in the morning but due to weather it was rescheduled for that afternoon.  The staff kept in good contact with us about what was going on.
We had a great time seeing the entire island in an hour long flight. I don’t like heights but the flight was totally enjoyable. I would highly recommend it.

My wife and I did a plane tour on our honeymoon and had a great experience.  We actually did the introduction to flight package (where I got to fly the plane part of the time) because it was the same price as a regular flight. Our pilot/instructor/tour guide was Jacob and he did a great job! Really cool way to get to see the whole island as well as parts you wouldn’t otherwise see and a little nicer price than the helicopter tours. Highly recommend!

Me and my wife had an excellent trip with the private cessna drive by Jacob. He was very kind and able and we highly enjoyed incredibile views over kauai and napali coast.
 Highly recommended.
For visiting pilots who won a part 91 experience flying around Kauai, this is the place to go. Jacob was a excellent CFI and guide in a well maintained, trusty 172S.

Super vol!!
superbe expérience, je recommande!
Je m'y suis prise très en retard (le matin même pour un vol en début d'aprem) et ils m'ont trouvé une place de dernière minute! Incroyable
Le pilote était super, il explique tout le parcours.
Vous longez tout le sud de l'ile jusqu'au Canyon que nous avons survoler un moment. Puis Napali Coast qui est juste époustouflant! où nous sommes restés un moment aussi.
Nous avons vu une baleine aussi et son bébé, d'en haut
Puis nous avons longez le nord de l'ile avec les belles plages et les géantes cascades d'eau....
Je n'avais pas un gros budget, mais croyez moi ça faut le coup! C'est la meilleure façon de voir Napali Coast et vous ne pourrez pas la voir aussi bien autrement. 153$ je trouve qu'en terme de qualité/prix ça les vaut large
ENJOY

We flew with Wings over Kauai the afternoon of 2/8/22. We had agreed on a tour showcasing the many beauties of Kauai, probably the most preserved island of the Hawaiian achipelago. They were accomodating enough to wait for us, since we landed at Lihue Airport that same afternoon. We were very friendly welcomed. We enjoyed the Cessna just for the 2 of us + our pilot. The pilot gave us (or me, since the First Lady of Love is less than fluent in English, and I translated in the onboard system) lots of information about what we were seeing, the history of Kauai, etc. During the whole flight (little over than 1 hr, IIRC), I did not look at my watch a single time. But I looked at the battery indicator on my phone, for I was taking truckloads of pics. Wings over Kauai is a family-owned business, human-size, and you bet they know their stuff ! Of course, it does not hurt that we left them with the impression that we more than got our bang for the buck. All in all, an experience that I strongly recommend.

review_title: No better way to see Kauai!
review_text:
What an amazing way to see the beautiful Garden Island! Our pilot/instructor/guide, Jacob, let me fly while my wife did the photos from the back seat. We explored the whole island from the air which gave us a great preview of all the fun activities we were going to do the rest of our visit. He even gave us some tips for beautiful hikes we could take and he was totally right!

A huge highlight was spotting humpbacks and flying over to see them up close. That was so cool!

Setting up the tour was easy and the customer support by Ellen was top notch. She was very communicative and helped me make sure we'd make the absolute most of our trip. I highly recommend this as a great way to start your Kauai visit, but really is excellent any time.

review_title: Fantastic experience for both children and adults
review_text:
A fantastic experience, which we highly can recommend.
You get an amazing overview of the Island and you can get unbelivable good pictures from the plane since all passengers are sitting next to a window.

Familienbusiness und total empfehlenswert.

Bruce und seine Frau sind beide total nett und bieten den Rundflug zu einem wirklich fairen Preis an! 

Desweiteren gibt Bruce local tips und eine geheime Liste nach dem Flug heraus :)

review_title: Yes, Yes, Yes.  The best experience on Kauai.
review_text: This was an exceptional experience.  Right from the start when Marcus introduced himself and explained that he grew up in Minnesota and went to UND for flight school.  We knew we were in great hands.  He provided an amazing tour, including a show from a couple whales off the north shore.  The was memorable.  Very happy with our decision to do this.  Have a wonderful vacation, Marcus, in MN and WI.

review_title: great economic choice for Kauai air tour
review_text:
Wings over Kauai provided an excellent air tour.  We debated between a helicopter and fixed wing air tour.  

We heard helicopters get closer to the terrain and can linger in front of specific features.  But, the airplane covers more ground and are generally more affordable.   Economics drove our decision but we have no regrets.  We chose the airvan tour.

Conditions were perfect which I am sure helps the experience.  We felt the airplane was close enough to the features we saw.  In fact, I am not sure we would want to be closer.  The pilot also flew two passes past key features.  And there are so many things to see we were always anxious to see what was next. The pilot made us feel safe and was an excellent narrator. The music which I expected to be a distraction added to the experience nicely.  The ride was surprisingly smooth but very sensitive people are likely to have some discomfort.

We did see helicopters closer to the ground  which might be fun for some.  But, anyway you can get into the air over Kauai.

Wow, wow, and wow! My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed our flight with our pilot, Marcus. Not only was he an excellent pilot, but also a superb tour guide. It was a beautiful and informative flight. We will be back to Kauai and we will fly with Wings Over Kauai again.

This was our favorite thing we did on Kauai! Marcus was a great captain and really cares about the island and its wildlife. We saw several humpback whales from the sky and I almost cried I was so excited. This is hands down the best way to see the island and appreciate how unspoiled it still is. Thank you!

review_title: Visual wonders and useful history and information
review_text:
The Cessna tour with Jacob couldn't have been more enjoyable.
On top of the usual sights, we were able to spot a few whales mother and calf over the coastal waters.
Jacob was very knowledgeable and helped us understand the history and current landmarks of Kauai.
He also provided good tips on how to enjoy what the island has to offer on the ground.
Go MSU!

What a spectacular flight with Marcus! We love that this company is family owned and so very friendly. The six of us took a private flight on their Air-van. (And, there was a much appreciated family discount:)

We were able to visit Kauai 4 years ago and at that time did a helicopter tour. It too was wonderful, but much more expensive and not quite as relaxing. We thought that we might be disappointed after that experience, but rather, this was thrilling in its own way! It was a gorgeous late morning flight and Marcus took us on a journey that highlighted the beauty of Kauai from the air. One of our very favorite parts, was viewing the whales from above…Marcus made sure that all of us were able to enjoy them!

Don’t hesitate for a moment to include "Wings Over Kauai" on your must do list…we are so very happy that we did!

Wow, what a great way to see Kauai!  This was an awesome experience for our family.  Bruce was a thoughtful and attentive pilot who has 30+ years of flying experience.  He shared lots of interesting Kauai facts  and details about the island as we went and really made the experience memorable.  (And of course, for our family of four, it was also a huge bonus that this tour costs about half what a helicopter would cost per person.)

We had an absolutely amazing experience with Wings Over Kauai. They were very prompt in their responses right from the time of booking till end of flight. The staff was warm and extremely friendly. 

We booked a van for 6 of us and it was like our own private charter. We also got discount for booking early. 

Their pilot was experienced, knowledgeable and did an awesome job with the flight take off, landing and also maneuvering flight during turbulence. We felt extremely safe during the entire time and got to know a lot about Kauai during the flight.  He was very patient and we never felt rushed during the entire flight.

I would definitely recommend Wings Over Kauai for best flight experience in Kauai. The flight was much better than helicopter, as each passenger had a window seat to enjoy breathtaking views of the beautiful island of Kauai.

Wings Over Kauai was an incredible and unforgettable experience! Bruce was incredibly kind, accommodating, and informative. My husband and I did Wings over Kauai as the first excursion of our honeymoon and couldn't have asked for a better way to kick off our trip! Would HIGHLY recommend to others!

My two friends and I had the most AMAZING experince ever! We visited the island for only a few days and they were rainy, but the flight with small Cessna plane more than made up for it, as it enabled us to see so much of the island in such a short time. The flight was absolutely AWESOME. The views were spectacular. It was my first time flying with a small plane but I am pretty sure that our pilot Jacob did a great job. The flight was very smooth, the pilot showed us as much of the island as the weather conditions allowed and he made sure to always turn the plane both ways so that people sitting on both sides could see all views. He was also very friendly and easygoing throughout and he told us interesting details about the island. We loved it and would totally come back to Kauai to repeat it withour families!

This was a nice flight, but it seemed like we kept crisscrossing the island, and it was hard to get an idea of which coast we were looking at.  I think the assumption was that we were all already aware of where the sites were located and didn't need to be reminded where they were in relation to the island. 
The pilot kept us informed of the major sites, but he was very involved in navigating the aircraft.  I don't know if there was a lot of air traffic on the day we went, or if the winds and weather conditions were an issue, but it seemed like the pilot was distracted.  That is a good thing for safety's sake but makes for an average airplane ride.  
I would have liked to have flown closer to the coastline, parallel to cliffs and ocean, but there may be air traffic rules against that.  Also, it is hard to see when you are seated over the wing, but someone has to sit there. 
Overall, it was a good flight, but next time I will invest in a helicopter ride, which seems to be able to get closer to actual island and go through canyons and around cliffs.

Our family had a fabulous time on the trip. The pilot did a fantastic job flying us over and providing information on the spots. The ride was so smooth and comfortable , very relaxing. The aerial view was spectacular. Amazing experience and an awesome family adventure.

One of the best air tours I have done. Jacob was a great pilot and very professional! As a fellow pilot and instructor, I was extremely impressed. 10 out of 10 with the experience and views. Way better than the helicopter tours.

It was amazing - everyone of us said it was the highlight of our 12 day trip.  Our Pilot was knowledgeable and very safe n smooth - Waimea Canyon was more beautiful in person than any of the pics I saw.  Thank you

review_title: Great views of Kauai from the air
review_text: The entire experience was great.  The cost was very reasonable for the flight and the pilot, Bruce, was excellent with his storytelling.  The desk staff was also great to work with.  If you are a photographer, don't sit next to the pilot, as there is more glare making the photos difficult (although there is a better view).  Bruce made sure everyone had a great view of Kauai from the air.  HIghly recommend this experience.

We did the Air Van tour at 2:30 and had a wonderful experience. You could see everything really well through the big windows and it was unbelievable.  Our pilot provided great commentary on what we were seeing and answered all our questions.  He has a lot of years of experience and I felt safe with him.  The Na Pali coast was completely covered in clouds on the day of our flight and they offered us a full refund but we still went and ended up seeing everything else on the island and I would recommend this tour to anyone!

Best thing we did all week. We were able to see the entire island and all of the highlights. Only problem. Was our air conditioner was not working making it very hot. The go pro cameras to film our trip did not work as well. Check on those things and all will be good.

review_title: Best Hour of Our Trip to Kauai
review_text: Excellent all around. Jacob, our instructor/tour guide, was the perfect combination of professional and mellow. The tour took us to all of the sights we wanted to see and several we hadn't been aware of. He provided great commentary on the sights and gave competent, gentle instruction on the ins and outs of flying in the local area. The aircraft is comfortable and well maintained and the whole operation seems very well run. This was the best hour of our trip to Kauai.

We found Wings Over Kauai through a family recommendation. My husband was weary about a helicopter ride so we decided to go go with the cessna tour instead. We are so pleased with our experience!! The views from the plane were absolutely breathtaking. Check in with Gina was easy and quick. We rode with Jacob who was an excellent pilot! His take off and landing were so smooth. We felt completely comfortable. He was so knowledgeable about the island and showed us so many cool spots on the island. We absolutely loved our experience with Wings Over Kauai and would recommend to anyone!!

review_title: Perfect Cessna Flight, your own personal flight.
review_text: The owner, Ellen, was great answering questions quickly before we flew. We flew on the Cessna. Chose this option as we were the only two passengers, like having our own private tour. Our pilot, Jason, was great. He was professional, smooth takeoff and landing, and lots of stories as we flew. My husband is not a fan of heights. He enjoyed the flight and views which is a huge testament in itself. We had a perfect day with almost no turbulence. We flew in the morning which left some of the waterfalls in the shadow of the mountains. Flying in the afternoon might make better photo opportunities.

review_title: Great tour, beautiful views, best value
review_text: My sister-in-law is visiting Kauai for a week, and it is her first time here.  Although we are taking her to many of the beaches and beautiful spots on Kauai; to put it all in perspective, I thought about taking her on a helicopter ride.  It had been a few years since I last toured Kauai by helicopter and had not realized how much more expensive, they now are then I remember.  My wife found online Wings Over Kauai Air Tour, and suggested I research.  I reviewed how much they cost for how much time in the air, and I think Wings Over Kauai is half the cost of a comparable helicopter air tour.   So, we booked an afternoon tour in their Air Van.  Huge windows, comfortable seats, and so much quieter than the helicopter tour my wife and I had earlier this year over the Big Island.  I got to sit in the co-pilot seat, my wife and sister-in law were in the row directly behind the pilot and me; there was a 4th passenger directly behind my wife.  Turns out the 4th passenger works for the Hawaii State Parks on Kauai, and he was treating himself to seeing some of what he can never see from the ground.  We lucked out with the weather, and had perfect visibility, and saw so much of the beauty of Kauai, many canyons and waterfalls that can only be seen by air.  The pilot was great, he was also very informative.  Our check-in process was flawless, and I was surprised that there were no upcharges for everyone getting a great view (seat) and perfect opportunities to take lots of pictures.  It was a super blast to sit in the co-pilot’s seat, I just had to remember that I had front and left windows to look through in addition to the large right window at my side.  I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai as a top activity to book while visiting Kauai and for residents too; you will love this.

review_title: Jaw-dropping visual delight! Safe, calm and professional experience, all at half the price of a helicopter ride!
review_text:
As a private pilot myself, I can testify that Bruce and Ellen provide an A-grade experience, with a strong foundation in safety and proper aviation protocols. 

Bruce gave us a detailed flight briefing for the Australian-made AirVan, which is a robust and spacious airplane. After a smooth takeoff, helped by a headwind, he took us on a lovely flight around Kuaui covering all the high points of this jewel of an island. 

We flew over the Pacific Ocean alongside the beautiful beaches of South Kuaui then turned inland to see the awesomeness of the Waimea Canyon. Then we were over the NāPali coast on the north side, appreciating the amazing rock formations winding down like spines into the ocean. After that, we turned inland again, this time to the south, and made our way back to Lihue just above the tall peaks of the highlands. 

All in all, an excellent experience, made sweeter by the knowledge that this trip was less than half the cost of a similar helicopter excursion!

Thanks Bruce and Ellen for a great time, and also for the amazing fruit :-)!

review_title: Best Birthday EVER!! Thank you to Gina and our pilot Jacob!
review_text: Thank you for an amazing tour! This was my first time in a Cessna as well as my mom’s. The sights were unforgettable. Jacob had prepared a great ensemble of theme songs that went well with the tour. I couldn’t get Hawaiian rollercoaster ride out of my head (first thing he played as we flew up). He was very knowledgeable and showed us his fave spots on the island and how to get there. I truly appreciated this day, it went down as the best birthday EVER.

Bruce was an amazing tour guide and pilot. Ellen and Bruce were so accommodating and helpful the whole time. We had an amazing flight around the island. I couldn't recommend it more! Super affordable, safe, and something my wife and I will never forget!! If your going to Kauai, check this out!

My wife and I flew with Jacob on our honeymoon, and it was a great experience. She isn't the biggest fan of flying, but Jacob (who is developing a well-deserved reputation as "the Bob Ross of flying") made it a relaxing and pleasant experience for the both of us. As a pilot, myself, I can definitely say he was as professional and safe as any pilot could be for a scenic tour over Kauai. The sights were absolutely incredible from the air; especially the Na Pali coast--truly one of the most beautiful sights we have seen. You get a lot of rainbows in the air, too (see the pic)! Thank you again Jacob!

We booked the C172 for a training flight on our first day in Kauai. My husband and I are both learning to fly so what’s cooler than logging some time in Kauai? It’s definitely a different experience flying in mountains. It was a slightly windy day with intermittent clouds/rain. Definitely different from what we typically fly in but the CFI was great and gave us a great tour along with more technical information about flying in the area. Even for a tour only, I’d highly recommend because they’re noting like seeing the countryside from the air.

My wife and I had a great time flying with Jacob, he was a knowledgeable and friendly pilot and host. He gave us some great recommendations and the bonus was his thoughtful soundtrack to the tour. Highly recommended!

Loved flying over Kauai and seeing all of the valleys we would not have seen otherwise. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and made sure to point out important scenic views.  Very smooth ride and loved riding in a Cessna for the first time!

Our private flight with Pilot Jacob was truly amazing and breathtaking! Jacob was extremely professional, calm, and knowledgeable, providing a wealth of information about Kauai and its unique & beautiful landscape. We covered the entire island in an hour, seeing features which were missed on previous helicopter flights. This was much more of an up close & personal trip and the quieter engine of the plane allowed us to hear clearly all that Jacob said. We could freely ask questions and Jacob was able to answer and provide insight about every one! Ellen, the owner, handled our reservation, answered our questions and made us feel quite at ease. It was obvious from start to finish, that this company had many years of experience, and we would highly recommend Wings Over Kauai to anyone wanting a truly unique & special experience!

We loved flying with Wings Over Kauai! Everyone was very nice and accommodating. They even took a picture for us with the plane before we left and emailed it to us! Jacob was our pilot and he gave a wonderful tour. Lots of interesting facts and knowledge about the island. The plane ride was so much fun and gave us a unique and beautiful view of Kauai. Highly recommend!
This trip was amazing and as advertised! Our pilot Marcus was a perfect guide...the entire staff from start to finish was super friendly 🤙🏽

review_title: Once in a lifetime experience - Highly recommend
review_text: Highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Kauai. This tour takes you along the coast of Kauai with spectacular views of the coast, island, mountains and the valleys. Some of the places are not accessible by land and their beauty can only be appreciated via the air tour. The tour is run by a family who were extremely friendly and made sure our flight was as comfortable as possible. Our tour was rescheduled due to inclement weather and we were immediately shifted to a new day and time without any issues. The pilot has 30+ years experience flying and all along the tour he pointed us to the important spots on the island with a background about it. This made the tour both personal and informative. Have added some views from our trip below.

Flying over the entire Mountains was an unforgettable experience in an 8 seater plane ( individual seats with windows) viewing Mountains, waterfalls & beaches with an impressive m. Informative documentary by pilot Marcus. By far the best way to experience the Island!

review_title: Most beautiful tour available, with the best people! Whether you're a pilot or just wish you were, flying with Wings Over Kauai
review_text: Whether you're a pilot of any level, or a non pilot, flying over Kauai with Wings Over Kauai is a great experience! Jacob was my instructor/ tour guide and was one of the best people I had the pleasure of meeting during my week on the island. He and Ellen met my wife and I with enthusiasm and professionalism and insured our flight was what we wanted and expected. The flight itself was beautiful from takeoff to landing(my 50th state), and although not inexpensive, was one of the best ways to spend a couple of hours on Kauai!

Great experience from booking all the way through the flight. Everyone was nice, helpful, and accommodating. Helen was great in helping us get booked and rebooked when weather cancelled our original booking. Marcus was phenomenal - incredibly knowledgeable and the flight was great. Amazing views and a very cool way to see the island and areas you can only see by air. Overall a great experience and awesome company.

Flew with the owner, a PhD agronomist, and saw all of Kauai as can only be done from the air and benefited from his knowledge of the environment. Flew our adult family of four in the van airplane and enjoyed a comfortable ride and panoramic views. Highly recommend!
Captain Marcus is beyond good in flying me over Kuaui.  He pointed out all interesting sight along the way.  The flight was very smooth.

review_title: BEST thing we did on Kauai!
review_text:
BEST THING WE DID IN HAWAII!!! 
Don’t hesitate, book this tour with this company. So professional, such a great pilot, great clear views out of the plane. Staff was friendly, welcoming, and it was seriously the best thing we did while in Kauai. I’d say it’s a can’t miss it thing here on the island.

This tour was fantastic! Marcus was very knowledgeable and pointed out everything as we went around the island. My husband was nervous to fly in a small plane but Marcus made him feel very comfortable. I highly recommend this tour.
The other company that did flight on planes canceled last minute. Wings was so professional & helpful. The fit us in. It was a small plane & i was nervous but it was great in the end.

review_title: An absolutely must do on Kauai!
review_text: This is a “can’t miss” experience!  Seeing Kauai from the air in a small plane is like nothing else!  We drove all around Kauai, and we saw the Na Pali coast by boat, but the beauty and majesty of Kauai can only be seen by air.  Marcus was a fantastic pilot, and a wonderful tour guide!  We learned so much about Kauai, and have pictures we will treasure forever!  I loved it, and my teenager who usually has very few words to say raved about this experience!  Thank you Marcus!!

This was by far the highlight of our two week visit to Kaua'i. Marcus gave us an interesting commentary, safe flying and a wonderful flight path.. 55 minutes of sheer bliss and we would recommend Wings over Kaua'i to everyone for a wonderful experience.

review_title: Great flight! Flying with old friends!
review_text:
Beautiful views with great insight of Kauai!  Great pilots safe and reliable. We love Bruce, Ellen and Capt Parker!
If you’re looking for adventure and beauty all in one this is a must every time!

We had a wonderful time! Staff was very friendly and welcoming. They were very considerate and made sure we had a comfortable flight. Our pilot, Bruce was a great tour guide, with lots of knowledge on the history and geography of Kauai. We enjoyed the unique birds-eye perspective of a small airplane. Definitely a must!
It was an excellent trip. Great views and a detailed commentary from an awesome pilot. Family had a great experience. We would highly recommend this to all who plan to visit Kauai.

Wings over Kauai view was stunning. Pilot's narration and way he engaged my 17 year old was amazing.

 The trip was worth it. I just wanted to see waterfalls, mountain tops and scenic views of Kauai after the 18 months of lockdowns.  All accomplished!
The check in and out teams were phenomenal as well. It was nice to know what to expect.

Mahalo! Highly recommended.

review_title: Amazing experience for less $ than helicopter!
review_text: We loved getting to see the island this way. The music playlist playing softly in the background of the headset was a really nice touch. I even got the fly the plane a little bit! Parker was a great pilot, ask for him if you can!

Wings Over Kauai and our Pilot, Marcus, gave us the best tour of Kauai. Being a little nervous on a small plane, the flight was comfortable, safe, and stunning. Marcus was so knowledgeable about everything about the island from plant life, animals, and history. When I heard the music from Jurassic Park over the falls it was fabulous !! This tour was well worth it and the staff we dealt with were great. Do
Yourself a favor and book this tour!!  More that 5 stars!!

We had a nice sunny day for our flight.  We scheduled a 9:30 a.m. flight.  We were greeted by Ellen, who checked us in and gave us a safety briefing.  Captain Bruce, the pilot, has extensive knowledge of things agricultural, which he shared in his explanation of vegetation and geology.  Points of interest were described and brought to our attention.  This was a great wrap up to our two weeks on Kauai, having visited most of the island from north to south, including Hanalei area, Kapaa, Waimea Canyon.  We have also taken helicopter flights in the past.  Fixed wing viewing is a different experience.  You see the island in overview and have a longer time to view the scenery as the plane seems to travel more slowly.    If you can, sit on the right hand side (starboard) of the aircraft for best views.  Wear dark clothing to avoid reflections from windows in your photos.  We felt very comfortable taking this flight, as safety and our comfort were emphasized. Would would repeat this tour.

review_title: Great island tour on Kauai with Wings over Kauai
review_text: Went on Wings Over Kauai airplane tour of kauai today.  Just myself and my wife so it was very private.   A must do since there's no other way to see most of the island.   Our pilot was very thorough and with minimal clouds we were able to see everything.   The airplane tour is half the price of the helicopter tours snd we were in the air longer.  Glad we chose this tour.    Recommend doing it early in your stay on the island because it will help you plan hiking and beach trips

review_title: Best way to see the “Garden Island”
review_text:
My wife and I had a fantastic private Cessna tour with pilot Parker. 
We flew over all the island highlights and Parker provided a great narrative. 
It was our first time on a small plane and we really enjoyed it!!

We flew around Kaua’i and it was incredible! The staff was friendly, efficient and knowledgeable. The pilot was very friendly and answered all our questions as we flew. A beautiful tour and efficient experience!
This was one of the highlights of our trip! Such a great way to see the beautiful island! We had a great experience with Marcus, he was very knowledgable and a good pilot!

review_title: GREAT bird's eye view of Kauai!
review_text:
We came in early November after Kauai reopened due to COVID.

We had a reservation for a 10:30 a.m. flight, but the winds were too strong. They called us and suggested that we push it back a few days, when the weather is better. I appreciate that they had our safety in mind.

We came back and did the 9:00 a.m. Cessna flight for 2 people on Saturday, Nov. 14th. Ellen in front was super nice and checked us in. Marcus was our pilot and he was super friendly and knowledgeable.

The flight was super smooth and very enjoyable. They play different music on an iPad that matches each part of the island. Marcus gave us great narration over each part of the island.

We saw lots of waterfall and the NaPali Coast was spectacular!

This was much cheaper than taking a helicopter flight and we were very happy with it!
From booking to the tour to landing Ellen and our pilot Parker were great! Very informative, safe and fun. For our family of four it was an affordable option to see island of Kaua'i.

Ellen fetched me from the designated pick up point for cruise ship passengers and brought me to the airport.  After details were explained we took off for our one-hour flight over Kauai.  Marcus was our pilot. His cool voice describing the landmarks with traditional Hawaiian music playing on the background will minimize any anxiety flying on a small plane. I felt relaxed during the whole flight.  The plane had an intercom system wherein passengers and pilot could talk to one another.

I went on a land tour of the coffee plantation and the Waimea canyon the day before.  Hence, I had a comparison of the sights to be seen.   Even if it was a bit cloudy on our morning flight, this is the best option for seeing Kauai. What I saw of the Waimea canyon park was only a fraction of the area on the lookout point.  On the air tour, you get to enjoy the whole canyon and its surrounding mountains.  This flight enables you to see the Na Pali coast, the most beautiful scenery of the Hawaiian Islands. The cathedral like spires were truly stunning.  We next flew over a tall dormant volcano with thick forest cover. Seeing numerous waterfalls was a bonus. 

Thank you for an unforgettable experience Ellen and Markus.

review_title: WINGS OVER KAUAI IS A "MUST DO"
review_text: Our entire experience with WINGS OVER KAUAI was amazing.  The people are receptive and easy to work with and the flight - well - there ARE NO WORDS!!!! Kauai is beautiful from land and sea but to  view the Island at her most breathtaking is to fly. I have flown over the Grand Canyon, hot air balloons over the Valley of the Kings in Egypt and the Bagan temples in Myanmar and many, many other airborne adventures and WNGS OVER KAUAI is at the top of my "must do" list for anyone coming to wonderful Kauai.  BIG MAHALO to ELLEN & CAPT. PARKER !!!

review_title: Beautiful way to see the island.
review_text: The whole crew was super friendly and the flight was wonderful. I highly recommend this a a must do. The views and the narration of the flight were unbeatable. Thanks for a great adventure.

Wir waren total begeistert über die Air Van Tour über Kauai. Die Tour war ein Geburstagsgeschenk an meine Freundin. Sie durfte als special guest sogar vorne auf dem Co-Pilot Sitz sitzen und hatte dadurch die beste Aussicht. 
Auch der Pilot Marcus war super freundlich und professionell. Wir haben uns zu jeder Zeit sicher und wohl gefühlt. 
Es war perfekt.

Wow, what a gift we were given through Wings Over Kauai. Starting with the friendliness of Ellen, onto the no safety care by Val and onto the great competency of Parker in the air, we were in great hands. The beauty and majesty of Kauai can only be experienced by the close views from the air. We knew we’d have some spectacular sights but hadn’t expected the valleys, waterfalls, and coastline to give us such stunning memories. We are humbled by the beauty of this island and thankful for the professionalism of these great folks. Everyone needs to experience a birds eye view of Kauai and Wings Over Kauai is the smart move to find your own memories.

Highlight of our trip, the pilot was very interactive putting the plane in a 360 so we could watch the Whales and explaining iconic views, land formations and cultural background of the Na"pali coastline. It was very helpful that everyone had headsets provided to interact with Pilot and other 3 people on board.   Highly recommend

review_title: Best way to see the island
review_text: My hubby and I did the private tour and Parker was our pilot. This tour is awesome and Parker is the absolute best! Not only is he knowledgeable about the area, he’s friendly and very professional. We had a blast!! I highly recommend taking this tour (the private tour is just a little more if it’s just the two of you) and hopefully you’ll be fortunate enough to have Parker fly you around. Thanks again Parker!! You rock!!
I highly recommend this tour! Our pilot was Marcus and he was amazing! He made us feel safe and gave us an excellent tour of the island. The views are unbeatable! We even saw whales!

Very windy day we scheduled.  Pilot, Parker, said we could go, but we'd have a better time next day.  He checked NOAA site.  They could have lost money, but valued our experience.
Parker sick the next day, so owner, Bruce, took us up in Cessna 172, (two maybe 3 small people max).  Best tour flight I've ever been on.  Bruce knew everything about the island.  Circled back so we could see a whale.  Lots of stories.   Answered all our questions.  Can't say enough good things about the company and the experience.  Would do it again.  Super friendly and safe.

review_title: Superb views in a safe family friendly plane!
review_text: Our flight on the Cessna was definitely the highlight of our trip to Kauai! We flew with friendly Bruce and he was extremely knowledgeable about the sights, biodiversity and culture on the island. We appreciated him sharing with us how the plane worked while we were flying, which is a rare experience! Strongly recommend taking a flight with Wings over Kauai to complete your trip to this beautiful island, especially since there are many picturesque views that are only accessible by air!

This is a fantastic trip and Marcus is a wonderful pilot/guide.  You see parts of Kauai that you would never see other than from the air.  We were surprised at how quiet it was once your headphones were on and Marcus had a great playlist that enhanced the entire trip.  We commented on how relaxing this was.  We would definitely do this again!

We were on the island for 3 weeks and went everywhere and did it all. Having the flight at the end to review all the place we went and things we saw was fantastic. Captain Marcus was an excellent pilot and the flight was especially smooth - we have flown in small planes like this one all over Africa so we know what we are talking about. His commentary and music just made it that much more spectacular. Thanks and if we get back to the island, we will do it again.

review_title: Amazing experience! Could not recommend enough!
review_text: My 70 year old mom, myself, and my 5 year old daughter all went on this tour today (February 2020) and we had the most amazing experience ever. The flight was so smooth, the views were beyond outstanding. We saw whales in the ocean and everything that the beautiful land of Kauai has to offer. We all felt so safe and had the best time. 10 out of 10. Don’t think about it. Just book it.

We were very appreciative of the accommodating staff and the availability to go up in the air! A couple days prior tours were closed due to winds. Marcus was our guide and did a wonderful job with the soundtrack of the ride along with his commentary explaining what we were seeing. Can’t wait to show family pictures of this trip, I would definitely recommend to anyone coming out here!

Nachdem wir nur 2 Nächte auf Kauai hatten, entschlossen wir uns ein Rundflug zu buchen. 
Aufgrund der guten Bewertungen sind wir auf Wings over Kauai gestoßen & haben dort unseren quasi privaten Rundflug gebucht! 
Es war eines der Highlights auf unserer Hawaiitour - ich kann es nur jedem empfehlen! 
Unser Pilot Parker gab sehr außerordentlich viel Mühe & erklärte uns alles!

We are in Kauai for Valentine’s Day and took a one hour private flight tour of the island.  Couldn’t have been done better.  Well organized, kept in touch, reasonable priced for a private flight.  Even got to see a whale. Would recommend highly.Parker, our pilot and “guide” was excellent.
This tour was our highlight of our trip.  The sights are spectacular.  The pilot was so informative.  Loved, loved it. use this company if you can.

We took the air tour aboard the Air Van with out pilot, Marcus. What an outstanding trip this was! We took off at about 9:30am, and the weather was perfect. Seeing Kauai from the air is really the only was to experience the majesty of this island in one fell swoop. Marcus is an excellent pilot, and is very adept at spotting things you will want to see...such as humpback whales just off the coast. We circled over several whales, including a couple that had calves in tow. Flying along the Na Pali coast, and through Waimea Canyon will take your breath away. It is quite easy to think you have been transported to Jurassic Park! The folks at Wings Over Kauai were superb, and gave us an experience we will never forget. This tour was worth every penny, and I encourage you to fly with them.
Best thing we did on our trip. Great pilot and beautiful views.  Our pilot was very friendly and knew so much about the Island. It was very educational and interestion.

review_title: A must do and a do over
review_text: Just off the plane with my wife and had the most amazing time.  Windy day but never felt any of it under the professional hands of Parker.  He was very knowledgeable of the sights below us and always kept us where we could see the landmarks.  My wife was a bit worried of motion sickness but never had any concerns.  It was so peaceful on our private tour and it definitely will be a do over with Wings Over Kauai.

Just a great ride....and at about $100-$150 less than a helicopter tour, and with a better safety record.  We flew in a small 4-seat Cessna, just the pilot, my wife and me and saw areas like the Napali Coast that you can't get to without a boat of some sort of aircraft.  Highly recommended!

review_title: Not gonna lie, I was nervous...
review_text: I was absolutely nervous to fly in a tiny plane, but our pilot Marcus was AMAZING! He absolutely put us at ease and showed us some incredible sights and breathtaking views. The ENTIRE experience was unforgettable and I loved every single minute of it!

Our experience with Wings from start to finish was amazing. They were clear about pickup, had a clean and reliable office and plane. The tour was unbelievable and our pilot was very knowledgeable about the island and did an amazing job of playing music and videoing while still providing ample information about what we saw. He even circled several times for all to see a mother and baby whale swimming. It was an unforgettable adventure.

We had the most amazing trip seeing Kaua’i thanks to our wonderful guide Parker. We couldn’t have imagined a better view of this beautiful island. Parker not only shared the island visually but also so many wonderful stories, facts and recommendations about the island and ideas for enjoying our time here. Flying with Wings Over Kaua’i was the highlight of our trip!

The checkin process was strained and tedious. The lady in charge of our checking in seemed to almost resent us being there. I was concerned!!! When we met our pilot, Marcus, I relaxed. He was outgoing and personable. He handled the controls and flying expertly and pointed out numerous things we would have missed. He swung around for another look at a whale he spotted so we could all see. The flight was dreaded by one of our group due to a previous bad experience but he was smiling throughout this one and we all enjoyed ourselves!! The takeoff and landing were both smooth and not at all scary. Would highly recommend. Would definitely do this again on any return trip.

Unsere Tour war einfach traumhaft und absolut empfehlenswert! Unser Captain Bruce war wirklich erfahren, witzig und hat tolle, interessante Sachen über Kauai erzählt! Wir waren wirklich sehr begeistert.

The Cessna tour was the highlight of our Hawaiian vacation!  Captain Cameron was very knowledgeable and flew the plane with ease.  We felt very comfortable as we soared over the mountains, Waimea Canyon, numerous waterfalls, and the breathtaking Na Pali Coast.  During the flight, we communicated with Cameron through headsets and he thoroughly explained the history of each sight.  This is a “don’t miss” experience. Mahalo Wings Over Kauai!!

This tour is a super value, half the cost of a helicopter tour and substantially the same views. The flight is smooth and comfortable, safely conducted by Captain Bruce. The views are spectacular, especially the Na Pali coast and traverse over the mountains back toward Lihue. Kauai is the prettiest place on the planet.

We really enjoyed our flight with Bruce, who knows all about Kauai and answered many questions as we flew around the island.  There's a lot of scenery that is difficult or impossible to see except by air, so I highly recommend taking this tour to appreciate Kauai as a whole and to get ideas for where you would like to visit by land.

My wife and I had never flown in a single engine light plane, but we felt extremely comfortable with Bruce.  He is an excellent pilot and great narrator of the magnificent island of Kauai.  This experience is not to be missed!  Thank you to Bruce and his wife who made sure we found the airport and didn’t miss our flight.

Before I discuss the actual tour, a bit about Wings Over Kauai... Due to no problem of theirs, I screwed up the booking of this tour about four times. I was constantly confused of the dates and times we were available. I was a real headache, I'm sure. I spoke with a Wings Over Kauai employee (Mary?) several times, and she put up with my constant mistakes like a pro. By the time I'd finally got things settled, I was already convinced this organization was excellent.

Now to the trip... Kauai weather is fickle and we had a morning flight. The staff showed us a map of the winds and live videos to completely prepare us for risks of partial visibility or turbulence. They offered to rebook us for a different time or day if we had any problems. We chose to go ahead with the flight.

Our pilot (Mark?) was funny and happy to take a minor detour when he saw whales breaching off the Na Pali coast. The views are absolutely outstanding, and due to our altitude and flghtplan, we were able to see more than we would have in a helicopter tour. We experienced turbulence (which we were warned about), but Mark was amazing at the helm.

Would definitely do again! We recommend doing this as early into your trip as possible to get a scenic overview (no pun intended) of Kauai!

review_title: Great way to start your visit and get to know beautiful Kauai
review_text: Everything about our flight was spectacular. Marcus is not only an excellent pilot, he shares information that is helpful in making your activities more informed. We highly recommend that you also purchase the dvd of your flight that is done very professionally to share with those you love and to revisit your experience. Gina was very kind and helpful in the office. Our flight was at 1 pm and it wasn’t the perfect time for photography of the Napali coast due to sun glare. A bit of Photoshopping” helped remedy. We saw some beautiful double rainbows. You can’t get as close to the falls as a helicopter would, but the lesser cost is something to consider.

What a beautiful way to see the island, especially, the jewel - the Na Pali Coast. If your budget allows, do it,  we were in the AirVan. Captain Marcus doesn’t miss a beat with every question we threw at him. He gave us extra time to watch some whales from above but circling around them. A very smooth ride. There were 5 of us but we could have had another person on the plane for the same price. Can’t say enough praise for the service. I highly recommend this company.

review_title: Best way to see the island
review_text: Amazing view and smooth flight! Really get close to the pristine canyons and forests that are not accessible by foot from a bird eye view!
Awesome! Bruce was great and knew a lot about the island. Same views as the helicopter for half the price and not scary.

Amazing views and wonderful experience!
Our pilot was very knowledgeable of the island and the sea life!  Would recommend highly!  The day was a bit rainy but did not take away from the trip!

review_title: Best part of our 2 week Hawaii tour for all 4 islands
review_text:
We were in Hawaii for 2 weeks splitting our time between 4 islands - Oahu, Big Island, Kauai and Maui. We took many tours including scenic flights and boats but this tour stands out as the best one overall. We took this on New years day this year and it is very memorable for many reasons. 

1. Scenery is breahtaking and you get to see upclose
2. Very thoughtful touches to tour - right from well planned route, superior customer service at check-in and in flight. We got a Hawaiian music CD and a nice follow-up email with our pic they took in start free of charge, that was a nice tough. 
3. Our Pilot Markus was awesome and made us feel tour was safe and pleasant. He took time to go through all nice landmarks, didn't miss a single spot, turned around the coast too, gave plenty of time for pics, and also lot of good information about Kauai as well. Take off and landing was very smooth. 
4. We didn't plan well in advance and luckily managed to get seats on this flight. Since weather was awesome during the day, we consider ourselves lucky that day. 
We felt there was no better way to start the new year ! this was a memorable trip for us and Kauai Deluxe Sightseeing Flight made it all happen for us. 

THANKS SO MUCH! Highly recommended.

Hands down one of my favorite experiences on my trip to Kauai! Had an absolutely lovely time flying with our pilot Bruce! He's lived on the island for about 25? years and is extremely knowledgeable about its history and landscape. Feel free to ask him questions! We definitely got a history lesson on our trip :) 

I had the added experience of being his co-pilot on this flight so that was just the cherry on top for this experience!! 

I would definitely recommend this tour for anyone looking for an aerial view of the island but doesn't want to spend all that extra money for a helicopter tour. This one is worth it :)

review_title: Great experience of Kauai Island flight sightseeing
review_text: My family had a great experience of sightseeing of Kauai island from sky. Captain Marcus was an experienced pilot who drove the plane very smoothly and safely. Also he explained the History and scenery of the island and was very patient with all of our questions. Additionally, The staff provided safety information and refreshments. Overall, the sightseeing trip was worth it and is a must if you are visiting Kauai.
Simply the best way to see the natural beauty of this island. Captain Marcus was an excellent pilot and host and the whole excursion was smooth, safe and enjoyable. An experience too good to miss.

Took the airvan tour with Marcus and it was the best decision ever! Kauai is absolutely gorgeous and we can’t traverse all the vistas on road making the air tour a must! Marcus was amazing with his calm voice explaining everything about the plane, route and Kauai’s history and tour details. The company overall gave me warm and genuine vibes which I loved. Even the check process was great.

review_title: Tour on November 22, 2019 with Wings over Kauai
review_text:
We had a great experience with the two seater Sessna plane tour with Bruce.
He made us feel extremely comfortable going on the tour . There was no sales pressure . Bruce and his wife are amazing and I will surely fly with them again.

A great excursion to see all of Kauai. Waterfalls, the dramatic Na'pali coast, the Waimea canyon and all the different beaches and coastal towns. Marcus narrated the entire tour and provided so much interesting information about the island. It was very enjoyable and I would recommend this trip to anyone visiting the island.

Que dire. Les paysages sont magnifiques, incroyables. La Napali Coast est vraiment à voir, des dizaines de chutes d’eau plus belles les unes que les autres, une forêt luxuriante et vierge.
Merci Bruce pour ce vol qui restera dans nos mémoires !

review_title: Amazing - Bruce and Crew were great!
review_text: My husband piloted with Bruce around the island and it was easily one of the best experiences we've had there. Bruce was knowledgable about Kauai without being the annoying tour guide - he gave us great places and pointed out wonderful scenery. He's beyond helpful and kind. The entire crew was super sweet and helpful during the process. The flight was easy, weather was great, and the plane was nice and clean. They are dedicated to the safety of people on the flights and without a doubt, we will go again when visiting.

From the reservation process through the flight, this was a professional and well run excursion. 

Everyone is so nice and they continually worked with us while we worried about rain and changing us from a private flight to a group tour so we could get the photographs we wanted. 

The fight itself was flawless. Marcus is an amazing pilot. His commentary was informative and his landing was impeccable! We didn’t even know we’d touched down. 

I would highly recommend Wings over Kaua’i!!

You’ll get your picture taken before you take off and receive a gift upon landing. 
I have motion sickness issues, but was perfectly fine until the very end of the flight. 

Mahalo to everyone involved, we had a great flight!!

What an experience!  Cameron was able to show us the beauty of the island and we could tell he loves what he does and where he does it.  Everyone was amazing.  We highly recommend this tour and do the private small plane.  Incredible and well worth it.

We had an amazing flight around Kauai with Bruce. This was our favorite active we did in Kauai. Unfortunately we didnt have the best weather, but Bruce navigated us around the island and gave us an amazing veiws.  We got so close to the mountains. They give you such a cute gift after your flight. I definitely recomend this family company.

review_title: Great Cessna air tour with Bruce
review_text: We booked a private tour in a Cessna with Wings Over Kauai.  We got an hour long tour of the beautiful island with Bruce....just my wife and I and the pilot.  The views were stunning and Bruce is very knowledgeable.  We chose the air tour due to the longer flight time and comfort with a plane (with wings!) rather than a helicopter.  My wife gets a little motion sick and had no issues.

An AMAZING plane tour !
Everything was perfect ..check in, the flight , the pilot , the post flight ...from the start they took our picture by our plane ..met our pilot Captain Marcus (who was outstanding ..the flight was smooth, he was very knowledgeable and accommodating ) flew around and above the island (Na Pali Coast , Waimea Canyon , etc ) must have seen over 3 dozen waterfalls !
Not sure if there is a prettier place on earth !
Marcus was very professional!
After the smoothest landing , they gave us a Hawaiian music cd with our photo on it !
And they even offered us a video (GoPro) of our flight!!
If I would give it 10 stars if I could!
Best tour ever!!
Had a great time flying the beautiful island of Kauai with Captain Bruce and great coordination from Val and the rest of the team!

My family of six took a flightseeing tour with Wings Over Kauai and had Marcus as our pilot.  It was the highlight of the vacation for everyone.
