Mr. Bruce inform us continuously about the location over where the air crafts were flying. We enjoyed that tour very much. We noticed one thing that views are better from the windows other side of pilot seat. Due to orientation of the route followed by the air plane. Though sometimes Mr. Bruce rotate the air plane such that everyone could get the best views. Time of the flight was about one hour. We enjoyed our tour very much. If we plan to visit Kauai, we will avail this tour again.

We had an epic experience with Doug! He was knowledgeable and fun! Words cannot express the beauty of Kauai as seen from the air! We highly recommend this company. Worth the money. Very professional and courteous staff.

review_title: Best way to see this beautiful island
review_text: Seeing all of the beauty Kauai has to offer is a challenge unless you go by air. After researching helicopters vs planes & then the best tour companies, we chose Wings over Kauai & are so glad we did. What an experience! Nick was a fantastic pilot & guide. This is a much less expensive alternative to taking a copter ride & our group felt it was just as good. We saw the Jurassic Park waterfall & (for those more experienced readers who can remember the show) the Fantasy Island waterfall (interject your de plane, de plane jokes here) among many other beautiful sites. If you want to see all the amazing views this island has to offer without breaking the bank to do it, book with these guys.

review_title: Wonderful experience; great way to see the Island
review_text: We absolutely enjoyed our plane ride with our pilot Doug.  A very personal tour for two people; like having your own private guide. Doug provided a narration of all the sights and the two-way communication system made it very easy to converse and ask questions.  We also got a very thorough safety review before the flight.  It's great that you are in a small plane; one person gets to sit in the co-pilot seat and I had the back seat to myself to see out both sides.  Saw some whales and lots of waterfalls.  Highly recommend this experience; well worth the price.  We even got a nice gift souvenir from Mist Air Tour.  Thanks Doug and Val!

review_title: I highly recommend this family-owned business for your next trip to Kauai
review_text:
This is a once in a lifetime experience to be able to see the beauty of the island from the air.
Bruce was a great pilot and a great teacher to understand how flying a Cessna works and to explain us everything about Kauai.

I highly recommend this tour, most amazing views of the island you can only get from above. Our pilot Marcus was great, very knowledgeable about the island and so calm which helped me since I hate flying, but the flight was so worth it. We saw a lot of whales and some dolphins. These pictures don’t do it justice. If you don’t do this tour you will be missing out big time.

During our visit to Kauai the trail to the NaPali Coast was closed so we decided seeing it by air was the next best option. We had done a helicopter tour in Maui a few years back but it was very expensive and if you get motion sickness at all that is probably not the best option. This plane ride is more than half the cost of a helicopter and we experienced zero motion sickness and felt so much safer. From the safety briefing with Val to the flight with our pilot Bruce everything was excellent! Bruce has done more than 7,000 flights so we felt very safe with him. He was very professional yet fun and has lived on Kauai for a long time so he was able to tell us a lot of fun facts about what we were flying over. I don’t normally write reviews but this flight was hands down the highlight of our trip and I would highly recommend to anyone planning on visiting Kauai. 
Thanks Val and Bruce! 
Chris & Amanda

As an aviation safety professional, I am always concerned about the safety of a sightseeing operation but this was top notch. Much better price then the helicopter flights and covered more ground. Good, informative spiel from the pilot. I highly recommend these guys.

Bruce is an amazone pilot en very lovely person. 
The flight was amazing! Kauai by air was gorgeous!
We learnd a lot of interesting things on te flight. 
A must do in Kauai!
Kauai and the Nas Pali Coast is great. Visit and enjoy as there is no better way to sight see the best Island in Hawaii.

I scheduled this tour for my two adult boys during a visit to Kauai while on the NCL cruise.  My husband and I had visited the island previously and done a helicopter tour.  I wanted them to have the chance to see the highlights of the island, but was put off by the high cost of the cruise helicopter tour excursions.  I was reading TripAdvisor reviews to look at other options when I saw this flight.  Having past experience in small planes, it made sense to me that this might be a better and more enjoyable way to see the beauty of Kauai from the air.  And then I was pleasantly pleased to find out the cost is about half of the cost of a helicopter tour.  Both kids said this experience was the highlight of our whole vacation and the video/pictures they took are amazing.  One texted me "One of the coolest things I've ever done in my life" and he's traveled Europe.  They said the crew and staff were great -- friendly and informative.  And they felt completely safe while fllying.  A great choice for anyone wanting an air tour in Kauai.  Also, if coming in on a cruise, they pick up for free from a shop just a 10 minute walk from the pier.

This was a must do activity!   Bruce the pilot and his wife Val are the best.   They went above and beyond to accommodate some last minute changes to our schedule.  So friendly and easy to work with.   The plane was very smooth and comfortable.   We have done helicopter tours in Kaua’i but much preferred our plane ride with Wings Over Kaua’i.  Bruce was so personable and knowledgeable and really made the flight memorable.   Top notch company and whole heartedly recommend!!

review_title: The best way to see Kauai
review_text:
If you splurge on one thing in your trip to Kauai, it should be on this. The very best parts of the island are not accessible by road, and flying is the only way to see it. 
We flew with Captain Bruce on a Sunday afternoon. We were lucky to have gorgeous weather during the flight, but Bruce's commentary and knowledge raised the experience to another level. He kept us entertained and informed with various facts about the island, and his background score (of the Jurassic Park theme) when flying over parts of the island used for filming will give you goosebumps, its just like you're in the movie!
Overall, I would highly recommend Wings over Kauai, they are a small family run business, highly professional and provide a great, personalized experience. Plus they are much cheaper than the equivalent helicopter ride, with you seeing the same scenery!

Der Flug über Kauai hält, was die Werbung verspricht. Persönliche Tour in der Cessna mit nur 2 Personen. Tolle Aussicht auf Canyon und Napali Coast. Der Flug war ruhig ohne grosses Schaukeln und man ist ähnlich nach dran, wie im Helikopter, zahlt aber die Hälfte. Zum Schluss gibt es noch ein Überraschungsgeschenk. Wings over Kauai ist ein kleines Familienunternehmen mit langjähriger Erfahrung! Man spricht sogar etwas Deutsch.

This is a great way to see Kauai by air and less than a helicopter. We went on an instructional flight since my son is getting his pilot certificate. The flight went great and Bruce, our CFI was really great with some good tips. Nice small company with good people. I would highly recommend these guys. They even gave us a little surprise at the end. Nice touch!

My husband and I decided to go on the Cessna flight over Kauai instead of a helicopter and boy was it a great decision! Bruce and Gina made  our experience one to remember.It was our wedding anniversary and
wonderful Bruce tailored the experience to suit our needs, as I sometimes suffer from motion sickness. We felt completely safe and comfortable.  I highly recommend Wings over Kauai for an amazing birds eye view of a spectacular island.

review_title: Amazing views, great way to see Kauai
review_text: This tour is a wonderful way to see the island.  We chose the private 2-person tour on the Cessna and thoroughly enjoyed our time in the sky.  The company provides excellent customer service and our pilot (Marcus) was full of information about the sights we saw. Highly recommend this company!

My husband and I were told to go on a helicopter ride by a concierge assistant, but I read the reviews for Wings over Kauai and decided to give them a try. I have to say I am glad that I did. Not only did we enjoy the ride but it was half the cost of what we would have paid. Not to mention it truly was a private flight. Bruce was our pilot and he was great!
We flew on the small plane with Bruce, we really enjoyed the one on one with him and his knowledge of the island was great. The plane was a great way to see the island, very relaxing

review_title: Beautiful Views and wonderful, friendly, and knowledgeable service
review_text: The trip takes an hour and our pilot (Bruce) was friendly and knowledgeable during our flight. You felt safe at all times.

review_title: Best time ever, cheaper than a chopper.
review_text:
You won't regret this tour! We did the 1 hour tour for two in the Cessna. When it comes to the friendly skies, Bruce is the friendliest. He was polite, interesting, and has a good sense of humor.  He pointed out all of the sights, told stories about the island, and flew however he needed to give us the best views and photo ops.  On our tour we were fortunate enough to see whales!
Another consideration for us was our honeymoon budget as this tour is half the cost of a helicopter tour. I would recommend this for anyone looking for an aerial tour of the garden island and it's beautiful coastline.

Our family of 5 took the 1 hour island tour today with Doug and had a great experience.  The ride was smooth, Doug was an excellent pilot (take off and landing was not bumpy at all) and he had interesting facts and stories to share. I was hesitant to book a helicopter as I had felt sick after the last time, so we booked a flight instead. Despite my slight fear of flying in small planes and motion sickness tendencies, this trip exceeded expectations. I highly recommend this trip- you can’t see the whole island any other way.

This is a MUST for anyone visiting Kauai! Our family of 4- mom, dad, sister (16) and I (19) have a range of motion sickness and fear of heights, so we opted to do this jet rather than a helicopter, and it was awesome! It ended up being a private tour for just the four of us, so we all got a window seat on the side where we saw everything. We each had fans in the seats, headphones with mics to talk to everyone, and water/ginger ale in a cooler. Our pilot, Doug, was very knowledgeable and personable, telling us all about the island’s ins and outs. It was a bit cloudy, so we weren’t able to take our normal route back, but we diverted to a scenic route around the coast. Regardless of the cloudiness, Doug navigated us to see everything we could. Overall, a great experience and well worth the price- do this!! I’ve attached some photos of the jaw-dropping views from the plane!

Bruce and Gina were great with our reservation and planning our trip.  Bruce is an amazing pilot and had a lot of interesting details to provide during the flight. The icing on the cake was getting to sit in the co-pilot seat and do a pre-flight checklist with him!

review_title: Best way to check the Scenic island of Kauai
review_text: Got lucky to be the copilot for our flight. The ride was smooth and the weather was perfect without much clouds. Great value for a 60 minute plus flight tour of the Kauai island. Great service and a very experienced Pilot. Highly recommend it!

review_title: Wings Over Kauai Air Van Tour
review_text:
It is wonderful trip to view beautiful island. 
Thank you for the pilot and staff. I think it is better than helicopter ride.

Highly recommend! We went on a windy afternoon- Marcus was a great pilot and kept the ride smooth and peaceful. Soaring above this beautiful island is a real treat. The hospitality from the time we arrived was top notch.

review_title: Fabulous fixed-wing tour of the Garden Island
review_text: We opted to take a fixed-wing plane tour of Kauai instead of the ‘regular’ helicopter tours due to a nervous flyer in our group and were not disappointed.  From check-in and safety briefing through to the 65-minute flight and complimentary group photo and CD of local tunes at the end, we highly recommend this experience for a quick way of seeing the entire island of Kauai including the Nepali coast and Waimea Canyon without having to drive for hours or take a boat.  Our pilot Doug provided fantastic, fact-filled commentary about the island, its people and history and what we were seeing.  Incredible views through the big, bubble windows of the Wings Over Kauai Air Van. Highly recommend.

review_title: Cessna flght with Bruce over Kauai
review_text: The only way to truly appreciate the beauty of nature and the island's landscape is to see it from the above. My private plane ride with Bruce was an amazing experience as he knows how to highlight the most beautiful island's places. The hour long ride felt like 10 minutes as Bruce keeps you entertained with stories, guided explanations and a mock co-pilot engaging. Makes me want to re-watch the Jurassic Park, Pirates of the Caribbean and many other movies as this ride took me over the landscape's featured in those movies. Great overall experience.
I don't like helicopters and was happy to see this as a great option to view the beautiful island of Kauai! Helpful staff and very competent pilot! Would definitely recommend!

review_title: Cessna ride over Na pali Kauai
review_text: The Cessna ride for couple with Bruce is more of a private fly time over the beautiful island of Kauai - subject to weather conditions. I’d recommend Wings over Kauai any day - it’s reasonably priced with some great insights from Bruce and team. And yes, one of you get to be the co-pilot ; I was complimented on the awesome (mock) landing :)! If you’re in Kauai, look them up.

Coming back to this review a few months after doing it because for some reason it didn't publish when I wrote it. Did a late afternoon flight and it was wonderful. There were only 4 of us on this flight (I suspect because two of the customers were very large it was probably a weight thing) and so we enjoyed a terrific flight and commentary over Kauai. I sat there in blissful ignorance for the first minute and a half until I realised that the pilot had already started talking and my headphones weren't working so once we sorted the new battery issue all was good. The  it only slight criticism is that as a single traveller, I wasn't able to book until the day before, presumably to see if there was a spot vacant on a flight, makes it a bit hard to plan things ahead - otherwise, everything was very efficient and well organised and it was a great way to see the island. Highly recommended.

review_title: Tour and check ride rolled into one
review_text:
We flew with Bruce in 2016 and I couldn’t wait to go again!
I’m a piolet but don’t get to fly any more because of the expense!
My instructoral air tour was amazing micro know I can still Handel a 172 and of course the sightseeing was top shelf!

review_title: Wow! Only way to see Kauai!
review_text: Just got back from your with Marcus. The most amazing way to see the Island! Guide was knowledgeable about the history and sound track accompanying flight could not have been more perfect. Indiana Jones and Jurassic Park tunes to go along with film locations, the most beautiful rainbow popped up, while ‘over the rainbow ‘played. Helped me because I was a bit nervous in this small 6 person plane. I had no reason to fear- flight was smooth and gentle. Wanted to go again! Not to be missed!

Eines der tollsten Erlebnisse in unseren Leben. Wir hatten einen unglaublich tollen Flug mit Bruce.
Er war super freundlich und liebevoll, als ob man sich schon 20 Jahre lang kennt.
Er hat alles super erklärt und man hat sich sehr wohl gefühlt.
Außerdem hat er für den einen oder anderen Gänsehaut Moment gesorgt.

Nachdem Rundflug hat er uns noch eine CD mit hawaiianischer Musik und eine Bucket List mit seinem Insel Favoriten geschenkt.

Wir würden diesen Flug jederzeit mit Bruce wiederholen.

Viel Besser und persönlicher als die „gewöhnlichen“ Heli Touren.

Vielen Dank Bruce !!!

Viele Grüße 
Sarah & Kevin

This was an amazing tour and worth every bit of the cost.  The only way to see this beautiful island!  Our pilot, Bruce was knowledgeable, friendly and professional.
Best part of our vacation so far!  This is a “must do”!

This is a two passenger tour.  Just us and our pilot.  We took this flight on a beautiful day recently.  The skies were mostly clear and conditions were smooth.  Our pilot, Bruce, was very informative and calming,  He has been doing this tour for many years and you can tell he loves doing it.  He has a great sense of humor too.  I would recommend this tour to everyone.

review_title: Great experience and views to be awed over.
review_text: Booked this company based on TripAdvisor reviews and was very happy with our decision.  Great customer service.  Our initial booking day proved to be very grey and dismal, lots of clouds, they offered to reschedule us to another day!  We gladly accepted.  Our check in and pilot, Captain Doug were great, personable people.   Flight was spectacular and narrated by Captain over headsets we all wore during the flight. Captain Doug's narrative of the Island was wonderful, very knowledgeable. Our pilot was highly experienced, comfortable flight and great landing. Would highly recommend this company if you are on the Island, worthy of the price.  The island is even more beautiful from the sky...verdant green!

We flew with Bruce on October 24, 2018. It was our first full day in Kauai. A must do. My husband cannot fly in helicopters so we decided to go on this flight in a Cessna. My husband had no problems what so ever with motion sickness. Just my husband, myself and the pilot. The scenery was amazing. Bruce was informative and entertaining. A very special way to see this beautiful Island.

review_title: Just as good the second time around!
review_text: Flew with Bruce in 2010 and Marcus in 2018 - aircraft and pilots are #1.Flew over spectacular countryside and enjoyed every minute.

Haven’t had wow moments like this in a while. Being able to see private land, Waimea Canyon and the Na Pali coast from the air was a great decision.

Marcus was brilliant in letting the scenery talk when needed but telling us about the island and it’s history at the right times.

The plane was really quite and super smooth and we got lucky with only a bit of rain coming back through the middle.

Would recommend it to anyone visiting the island as you don’t get to see this any other way.

Es war traumhaft. Die Piloten fliegen, anders als die Helis nur bei sicherem Wetter und auch einigermaßen Sicht und fragen euch vorher, notfalls buchen sie um. Ich habe auf einem Trail die Helis beobachtet, woe sie in die Schluchten stürzen, das wäre nix für mich. Das fliegen war super entspannt. Start und Landung kaum gemerkt und eine Hammer Sicht.

Highlight of our trip! Decided to do this activity in Kauai over Maui as there is so much that can’t be seen by foot in Kauai. Since there were 4 of us, we all got to sit on the right side (when seated) for the best views as we traveled clockwise around the island. Still can’t get over the beautiful scenery and would recommend everyone to do this activity (and it’s more affordable than the helicopter tours). We really enjoyed the experience given by our captain, Marcus.

review_title: Nice views, easy to work with
review_text: We took the plane ride on 11/12/18 and enjoyed it.  Their confirmation email made it easy to find them, checking in was a breeze nd then we were off to it.  Doug was a very good and experienced pilot, very friendly.  The views are to die for.  I have not done any other planes/helicopters to know how close you get to the waterfalls and such.  Seems like we were quite a ways away but still great views.

We visited all four Hawaiian islands via a cruise ship but this flight with Marcus was the highlight of our trip.  We debated on the helicopter version but so glad we decided on this option.  The prices were better and we felt like we were able to see just as much.  The views were amazing and the entire staff was so wonderful to work with.  They made you feel very welcome and put everyone at ease.  Marcus was a wonderful tour guide up in the air describing everything we saw on land.  The scenery was incredible and will be a memory we will take with us forever.  My husband by chance got to sit in the copilot's seat and he was in heaven.  Seating placement is based on the weight of each passenger (no worries for you females because they don't disclose your weight when you hop on the scales) so he just happened to be the lucky winner of that seat.  Would highly recommend this adventure because both me and my husband thought this was the best thing we did while we were in Hawaii.

We chose to do a Wings Over Kauai tour over a helicopter tour because it was quite a bit cheaper, and we have no regrets.  Yes, the helicopters can get a bit closer and can hover, but I felt we still saw everything they did.  It was absolutely amazing and we were below the clouds the whole time so you could see everything.  A great option for seeing the Napali coast during be rough winter months.  Our pilot Marcus was great and recited facts about the island as we flew over it which really brought the experience to life.  This was my husbands favourite part of the whole trip.  Highly recommend.

review_title: This is how you should see Kauai
review_text: What a wonderful way to see the island! We took the private 2-person tour on the Cessna and were treated like family. Capt. Bruce (he’s also Dr. Bruce, a retired research scientist!) and Val were very professional and took good care of us. We were unsure of this morning’s trip as the weather forecast was not looking good. Rain and clouds were about to roll in when we got to the airport. Val greeted us cheerfully, checked us in and went through the safety briefing with us thoroughly. I immediately knew that they took safety seriously. We then waited as we were early for our scheduled departure. It started to rain shortly thereafter and Bruce then called us into the office and showed us the big rain clouds over the Lihue & Hanalei area on the computer. He was very honest and told us that we will likely not have clear views over some areas. So he gave us a choice to reschedule, a refund or to go ahead with the tour (assuring us it was safe to do so). What an honest and professional business! We decided to go ahead and was prepared for a less than stellar experience. Boy, were we wrong! While it was cloudy, the sights were still wonderful as Bruce expertly navigated through the clouds and showed us the spectacular Na Pali Coast and the breathtaking Waimea Canyon. We had to turn around at Hanalei due to the storm clouds (again safety first!) while some other operators decided to go through the area. I knew this as I could hear all the chatter over the radio. A couple others did turn around and followed Bruce’s lead. He must be well respected by the flying community! We made it back to Lihue airport safely with full of wonderful memories. Thank you Bruce for your wonderful sense of humor and knowledge about the island. I enjoyed being your “co-pilot”!
Es war trotz etwas Nebel ein unvergessliches Erlebnis und Bruce war der beste Pilot&Guide den man sich wünschen kann! Wir können es jedem sehr empfehlen!

Ein tolles Flugerlebnis mit Bruce als Pilot, der gelichzeitig auch der Eigentümer des kleinen Unternehmens ist. Er hat uns viel erklärt, die Aussichten auf NaPali waren super und hätten mit dem Heli nicht besser sein können. Man hat tolle Perspektiven, am Ende gekrönt von einem Wasserfall. Wir würden jederzeit wieder hier buchen. DIe CD als Geschenk hat uns im Auto bis zum Ende der Reise beleitet, vielen Dank dafür!!!

review_title: A Different Place From the Air
review_text: We loved our air tour of the island with Wings Over Kauai.  We'd seen Waimea Canyon from the ground the day before; it was so nice to see it from the air.  We also saw our hotel, the biggest coffee plantation in Hawaii, the Na Pali coast, and the beautiful azure Pacific.  The views were absolutely amazing; a different perspective than anything you'll see from the ground.  Doug (our pilot) did a great job pointing out highlights.  We will definitely recommend this tour to any friends who visit Kauai.

Thanks to Doug and his team for this extremely special experience. We got so lccky with the weather and flew through all the gorgeous valleys, from Hanapepe to Waimea, Napali and Hanalei coast and canyons. It was fantastic!
Best thing to do in Kauai!!!

review_title: La mejor experiencia de mi vida
review_text: Increíble vuelo por kauai. El 80% de esta isla solo se puede observar desde el aire, la parte de la isla que se puede acceder en coche es, para mi, lo menos bonito de hawai, pero el 80% restante es simplemente impresionante. Experiencia que le recomendaría hacer a todo el mundo, el trato proporcionado es exquisito, Bruce fue nuestro piloto y es un auténtico crack, explicaciones detalladas acompañadas de la música adecuada, cuando empezamos a sobrevolar la costa de napali se me saltaban las lágrimas de la emoción por lo increible del paisaje que estaba viendo. Lo mejor de unas vacaciones en hawai increíbles.

impresionante! De lo mejor de nuestra luna de miel, unas vistas increíbles, fue un vuelo para nosotros 2 con el piloto, mi marido de copiloto y yo en la parte de atrás. El piloto brus de 10. Lo recomiendo

Our pilot, Doug, gave us a wonderful tour. He was very knowledgeable of the area and made sure we had a great experience.  I would recommend them highly.
KY family

This was a great day!
The combination of a sightseeing and instructional flight is perfect. You get to fly the plane and see the island. Bruce did the radios, pointed out where to fly to and also provided commentary for all the beautiful sights. 
Be sure to choose the right hand seat for a change, the views are much better.

Amazing experience, Marcus, our pilot, and Val were great. For those who are scared to fly on a small plane, It's better than a jumbo plane, take off and landing very, very smooth.
The scenery is breathtaking. Na Pali coast is a must must see when visiting Kauai, and the only way to understand the scale of this natural wonder is to see it from the air.
Guys, Thanks for the one-hour unforgettable experience.

We booked this tour after our catamaran trip was cancelled due to rough seas (we are here late October), and I am an extremely nervous flyer.  Let me tell you, firstly, the service was excellent.  The staff really cared that I was nervous and took every opportunity to make me comfortable, I so appreciated that.  As soon as we took off however - I had forgotten my nerves.  Holy wow.... Kaua'i, what a treasure.  Marcus was our guide, he was very knowledgeable and made us feel at home and comfortable straight away.  For those wanting to take images of Na Pali- I recommend you book the private tour - either on the cessna, or book out the entire air-van.  I can imagine if I was seated on the opposite side of the air-van, I wouldn't have had the unforgettable experience I had - we were lucky that the others booked in our tour did not show, and we had the air-van to ourselves.  From the beginning of the flight to the end, the scenery was like another world.  From lush green, untouched growth and waterfalls to the stunning Waimea Canyon, to the 5000ft vertical peaks of Na Pali and inner Kaua'i landscape beyond, it is truly a life changing experience to see.   When we landed, I wanted to get back in and do it again, and to top it all off, our amazing pilot played music from Skyrim when we entered the Na Pali area - LIFE MADE!  Don't hesitate, just book in!!!
We had such fun! Marcus was an excellent pilot and a wealth of knowledge. The view from the plane is astounding. 10/10 would recommend!

Booked an aerial excursion hoping to see and photograph the Napali coast. Unfortunately the approximately 1% of the trip we were over the famous Napali area was wasted. The first pass by the area we were seated on the wrong side of the plane. After a turn, the second pass we were directly above the spires and the beaches, so without have having windows in the floor of the plane it was impossible to see or get a photo. Since they had assigned both of us into seats on the same side of the plane neither of us got one single photo.

review_title: Best Plane Tour on the island !
review_text:
We LOVED our tour over Kauai ! We were there during our honeymoon last weekend and had a blast ! Our captain's name was Doug and he was AWESOME !! Very professional, very fun and outgoing and gave us great information about the island and everything that we were seeing while up in the air ! I highly recommend this company, this was pretty much the highlight of our trip. Thanks Gina and Captain Doug. 
P.s. Doug thanks for making me the Co-Pilot of the flight, best seat in the house 😁
From Celeste & Emil

review_title: 2 GUEST CESSNA TOUR - DO NOT MISS
review_text: Had an amazing flight on the Cessna with Bruce last month, words cannot describe the experience and I have to say that I couldn't recommend the company enough. they were very communicative from booking until the very end of the service, made us feel so comfortable and at ease throughout the whole journey and literally gave us one of the best experiences anyone could have - an private tour of Kauai from the sky. Bruce was so interesting to listen to and we had good fun while up in the air. If you are in Kauai and thinking of doing this - go ahead; you won't be disappointed.

We did the private 2 person Pali Mist Air tour and it was fantastic.  The best thing we did on our trip was to book this tour.  Bruce and Val are amazing.  Bruce was a wonderful pilot.  We had a great flight and learned so much about the island in the process- not to mention the views of the Napali Coast, Wemeia Canyon and all the wonderful waterfalls we would not have seen otherwise.
Skip the helicopter tours and go this route.  This is a smaller business and the price is  more economical than the commercial helicoptor rides.  You just feel more taken care of.  Val who is the front desk person got us checked in quickly and gave us an overview of our flight.  They are great people.  Please, please check them out!!  You won't be sorry.
Очень понравилось летать на самолёте вокруг острова 🌴. Очень хороший пилот и его помощница! Всем рекомендую!

This was a highlight of our trip, much better then helicopter ride and cheaper,Doug our pilot was the best,very knowledgeable and friendly,child friendly trip,got great pictures and learned a lot about the island.You have to experience Kaua by air to get whole picture,thank you Doug for a wonder experience

review_title: Das Beste, dass wir auf Hawaii gemacht haben
review_text: Wir sind am Morgen um 9:30h geflogen. Sicht war perfekt mit blauem Himmel. Haben der Eindruck je früher desto besser ? Es war vom Anfang bis Ende perfekt. Sehr sympathischer und warmherziger Check-in durch Gina. Super Flugzeug, komfortabel und im besten Zustand.. Wunderschöner Flug über Kaui ( die gewählte Route ist perfekt) mit sehr interessante Kommentare durch Captain Doug. Kaui ist einfach ein Paradies . Der Ausmass dieser unberühmten Natur kann nur von Oben wahrgenommen werden. Wir fanden diesen Flug mit diesem Flugzeug besser als unser Flug mit Helikopter über Big Island vielleicht weil man höher fliegt

Val and Bruce really care about your experience with them.  It started with Val giving all the info of what to expect, how to get them most out of your flight.  Bruce was our pilot who started out with info about the plane and how it worked which was very interesting.  Very smooth take off, flight and landing.  Bruce's knowledge regarding the island was very interesting and we learned a lot.  The views are absolutely breathtaking.  Hard to describe as there are so many different types of terrain in Kauai.  I would have to say that the NaPali coast is indescribable.  Would definitely recommend this for anyone visiting to Kauai.

review_title: Excellent pilot, beautiful views of the island
review_text: When my wife and I visited Kauai, we took a tour of the island with Bruce, who was a very friendly pilot and tour guide. He also offers flight instruction to those who are interested, which makes the experience even more amazing! We highly recommend doing an air tour (or even a flight lesson!) with them on your visit of the island.

Our flight was cancelled due to weather concerns, but I still wanted to give the company full stars, as they were wonderful to deal with. Very professional, friendly and helpful. They did their best to re-book us and really tried to make us happy. In the end it just couldn't work between the weather and our schedule, but we appreciated the effort!

This really was the best way to see Kauai. Our pilot Bruce was a real gentleman, and gave us a very personal experience with his great knowledge of the island. Price was much more reasonable than competitors I saw, and the quality was top drawer.  The flight itself was very smooth and peaceful. My wife and I enjoyed every minute and would recommend this to anyone as a 'must do'when in Kauai!

We chosed Wings Over Kauai to see all the island and it was a great choice.val helped us with everything and Doug was really nice and we enjoy all the flight with him. He explained us so many things and we had a lot of fun. If you visit Kauai you should book with them to have a different View of the island, we nearly cried with the amazing views we had. 
100% recommended

Nach einer sehr freundlichen Einführung von Val nahm uns Marcus in Empfang und erklärte uns während des Fluges alle wichtigen Sehenswürdigkeiten. Er sparte auch micht mit Zusatzinformationen und beantwortete alle unsere Fragen. 
Der Flug dauerte nahezu eine Stunde und es war einfach, gute Fotos zu machen, da jeder einen Fensterplatz hatte. 
Ausserdem war der Preis unschlagbar und im Internet auch von Anfang an fair mit allen Kosten und Steuern angegeben (ganz im Gegensatz zu IslandHelicopters, deren Internet-Preis Von 145USD auf 187USD im Office wg Fuel-Zuschlag, Taxes and fees stieg)
Zum Abschluss bekamen wir noch eine CD mit der Musik, die wir während des Fluges gehört hatten.
Ein rundherum gelungenes Event. Wir fühlten uns gut aufgehoben und können Wings ofver Kaua’i uneingeschränkt empfehlen.

The pilot Bruce and his wife, Val, greeted us at their office and gave us a first hand info on what to expect once we board the Cessna. My sister and I couldn’t believe how smooth the ride was throughout the duration of the tour. Kauai is so beautiful and we are so glad to have chosen Wings Over Kauai. Bruce has a passion with his Flying and proud of the island and it shows. You can tell he has the patience to show us every bit of the experience with flying. We were amazed of the island beauty and how fast time passed. Really was worth the price and more. Thank you, Bruce!

review_title: Best way to spend an afternoon!
review_text: Decided on a whim to do an air tour of Kauai, and we were so glad we did!  Bruce treated us like family and gave us the most amazing hour air tour of the island!  We had great weather which afforded us many amazing pictures!  We highly recommend Bruce and Wings Over Kauai!

Wir haben den Rundflug mit der Cessna direkt am zweiten Tag gemacht und konnten uns so einen wunderbaren Überblick über die Insel verschaffen und letztendlich entscheiden, welche Orte und Dougs (unser Pilot) Empfehlungen wir uns noch anschauen möchten.

Kurz gesagt: Der Rundflug über Kauai mit allem was uns Doug über die Insel berichten konnte war fantastisch!
Smooth flight, beautiful views, great commentary, see things you can't see any other way.  Totally worth it.  Much less air sickness than helicopter.

It's great to wrap up my 5 day Kauai trip with an airplane ride that let's me reminisce all the activities I've done on this island. 80% of the island is only viewable from the air. So you'll be able to find out what's in the middle of Kauai which you can't access by driving or sea.
Bruce our pilot was extremely pleasant to be with and steady with the plane throughout.

For half the price of the helicopter ride, I think airplane view of Kauai (1 hour) is a steal!

Thank you Bruce for an awesome flight instruction.  Emily felt comfortable learning with you today October 1 2018. We look forward to getting more hours on this magical island and experience. Definitely recommend a must do adventure when visiting Kauai!

review_title: Great tour for a great price!
review_text: We were very happy with our Wings Over Kauai Sightseeing flight! The staff were all super friendly and helpful and we even met the owner, who gave us a nice list of recommendations on the island. The scenery on this island is incredible, and our plane tour gave us a good view of pretty much everywhere! Our pilot, Captain Doug, was great! And the price for this tour is pretty unbeatable! Way cheaper than a helicopter tour, and a longer flight too. You can't get as close to the waterfalls as in a helicopter, but it is much easier to get nice photos from a plane than from the glare-y, curved windows on a helicopter. If you are on Kauai and want an amazing birds-eye view of the island, please check out this company!!

review_title: Wow, Great flight and well worth the price!
review_text:
Booked Wings over Kaui flight for 2 in their 6 passenger air van. A little apprehensive since it was not through Carnival and it was a small company. Not only a great 65 min  flight, but we were treated like family, received pics of us by the plane and got a cd from them. Marcus did a great job flying the plane. Kaui is a truly beautiful island. This was the highlight of our 4 island trip. Thanks to Ellen and Captain Marcus for a memorable experience at an insanely low price.

Jeff & Maryann Kay

I booked a flight over Kauai with this company and paid for it more than 3 months in advance. Only one evening (after 5 PM) before our scheduled flight the company write me that "AirVan is in the shop waiting for a part" and "It would be best if we canceled and refunded you" . They also recommended me to book on my own the tour with another companies. I don´t think it is  serious that I have received this information so late and that the company canceled the flight for us - who have bought this so much time in advance. I suppose they have another plane but because our flight supposed to be "private for 4" it was cancelled. They also did not offer help in finding another alternative until I have asked for help with this. They also didn´t offer us flight in their cessna. In the end we have to find an alternative company by ourselves and we have been divided because there was no more free 4 seats in one flight. This has left us in the bad mood for the whole evening and finally we have lost some money, because my card is in euros and I have not been refunded the same amount in EURO as I payed for this cancelled tour because of bank fees. I don´t recommend to book with this company any flight in advance.

Long over due review, my mom and i visited Kauai and decided to take this tour. Highly recommend for anyone who wants to see the Napoli Coast in all its glory. Captain Bruce was very friendly and knowledgeable, also made us feel very safe. It's a small family business, the entire experience was authentic and felt like I was flying with a family friend. They also gave us secret souvenirs after our trip :)
Everyone was FANTASTIC to deal with at Wings Over Kauai!  My wife and I loved it so much that our two kids and their friends also booked trips!  They also LOVED it!!!

What an awesome experience.  We did the Cessna flight and the views were just amazing.  Our pilot was great and everyone we met from the company were very nice.  This was the highlight of our visit to Kauai.  Highly recommended!

This was one of our best experiences on Kauai! First our flight was rescheduled because of bad weather, but pilot Bruce took care of us. He really took his time to explain that the conditions weren´t that good a still left us to decide whether we wanted to do it or not.
We came back some days later and the flight was just great! We were just 2 people plus pilot in the plane, so it was a really personal experience and we could ask all the questions we wanted. It was great to see all the Kauai island from above, the scenery was just so beautiful!
We would definitely recommend to do this flight!

I can only recommend this tour. It's a little family business. The flight was absolutely amazing and worth every penny. Captain Bruce is super friendly, a very experienced pilot and knows everything about the island. 100% recommendable. You won't regret it.

We went Saturday with our 3 year old. We decided with wings over kauai as we didn’t know how our kid would do on a 4 hour boat trip. Plus, if we did a helicopter tour, we would’ve had to pay full adult price for her. This airvan tour was just perfect for us. Due to my daughters age, she was free. So the price of the aerial tour is absolutely worth every penny. 
Marcus was our pilot and he was very friendly and informative. I found the flight to be very smooth, although my husband did get motion sick and threw up a little. The company is prepared for that and had a little cooler with ginger ale in it to assist him.

Bruce welcomed us as we got to the location and the woman who helped us (I didn’t catch her name) was super friendly and kind, especially with our daughter.

We had an amazing time seeing this beautiful island and I’ve been recommending it to all I know that are visiting Kauai, especially with small kids.

Excitement to see the raw natural scenery that Hawaii offers. Was surprised at what you could see from the skies. Little cloudy over Jurrasic falls. Enjoyed with friends. Id highly recommend taking to the heavens to see Kauai when the sunshine lights up a rainbow. The pilot made us very welcome. Jan 2015 was when our exploration of the 4 islands began. Loved each island and what they have to offer.

We’ve never seen Hawaii until we saw it from the air.  The pilot was amazing.  The staff friendly and accommodating.  The ride was so smooth, I didn’t have any motion sickness that I normally experience.

Such a cool experience!  You see the whole island, check out sites from various movies and learn about the history of Kauai.  Captain Doug was awesome.  Motion sickness is possible, but they have water, ginger snacks and other helpful aids ready to go.  The flight was at least an hour, so definitely worth the price tag.  Such a neat way to take in the island.  Definitely book ahead of time!

this was our no 1 attraction while visit hawaii island!
the service was great,the view is anazing,bruce is wonderfull pilot&guide.
afterthe flight we did the waimea vally by car-and u cant compare it to the view we saw from above.
we flew in the secna aircraft &it much mor  better then fly in the helicopter.
the flight was a hour long &for our poi t of view-must do while visit beautiful kawaii.
thanks a lot for the lovely couple.
udu&tal

review_title: Great way to see the island!
review_text: Wings over Kauai gave us an amazing tour around the island! The pilot was very knowledgeable and did an amazing job showing us the island!

review_title: Breathtaking views and phenomenal attention to detail
review_text: My friends and I had an amazing experience with Captain Marcus and Val!  We felt very comfortable from the beginning and very well taken care of through out.  Their attention to detail was phenomenal! Pictures in front of the plane prior to loading in, thorough instruction on how best to enjoy the flight, an awesome soundtrack timed with the flight played while we flew, very easy conversation with Captain Marcus and really interesting info about the landscape and the island, and finished with the smoothest landing any of us have ever experienced.  Even more of a personal touch with a sweet keepsake surprise at the end of the trip!

review_title: Great Experience as a Visiting Pilot!
review_text: Since I’m a pilot, I booked with Wings Over Kauai because I wanted to rent a plane. I was told that an instructor - Bruce - would have to go with my girlfriend and I due to limited aircraft availability.  It ended up working out great. The flight was amazing, even though ceilings were at about 2k. We got a great insider tour from Bruce as we flew around and I got to log the time in my flight log book (PHLI).  Bruce took care of all communications and just gave suggestions for altitude/speeds to maintain, so I was able to just fly and enjoy!  I highly recommend doing this for any visiting pilots!

We throughly enjoyed floating along in Captain Doug's Cessna.  We had done helicopter rides before, and if you don't get stuck in the middle seat, it's great.  Every seat on this flight has great views and the commentary was wonderful!

review_title: A great tour and a great company
review_text: We are so happy we took this tour! The person who checked us in, Val, was super friendly and smiling. Our pilot Marcus was also very nice and flew us over the entire island with great confidence and skill. When we flew over the Na Pali coast the view was so breathtaking I almost teared up! The entire experience was wonderful. This is so much better than a helicopter ride, the windows are bigger, everyone has a view and there is much less noise. We recommend this company 100% and would certainly take the tour again if we come back to Kauai. Mahalo!

Two years ago I did the helicopter. This was better. Smoothest pilot ever and the vistas were fabulous. Plus our pilot was sooo funny.  I’d come every time I come to Kauai.  Almost half the price of the helicopters as well.

What an amazing way to see the island. Our captain Marcus did an awesome job of giving us the detailed history of Kauai as well as hitting us with loads of factoids about each and every crevice. Get to see the island from a whole different perspective. Also had various island and movie music playing through headsets during the hour long tour. Amazing views of na’pali coast, Waimea canyon, Waimea falls, coffee fields etc. the airbus was great with its bubbled windows for pictures, they even had ginger treats, cold towels and drinks on flight for those who get motion sick. Couldn’t imagine coming to Kauai and not doing this.  For those who do get motion sick - can be a little bumpy at times, but also make it really energizing and exhilarating.

Thank you for a very memorable and awesome flight. We booked this for our 25 th wedding anniversary and we were not dissapointed. Booking on line went well, they kept us up to date on the booking and pre flight info was thorough. Our pilot did a fantastic job, steady flight, plenty of time to see all the sights and the commentary was very informative. We had a great time thank you

We decided to book this tour because we were traveling with our 3 yr old AND I am in my 3rd trimester of pregnancy. This was the easiest and BEST way to see the terrain of Kauai, given that hiking anywhere was out! The fact that my son slept the entire hour should tell you how smooth the ride was.  Our pilot was so engaging and informative. I tried to enjoy the views as much as taking pictures -- it seems unreal! Beautiful island,  beautiful people

What a wonderful experience.  Circumnavigating the beautiful island of Kauai from the air.  Our pilot Marcus was capable and confident and provided an insightful commentary during the 65 minute flight.  He was ably supported by the ground crew, Val and Bruce.  A most enjoyable experience and well worth doing.

We (2 of us) enjoyed a flight with Captain Doug mid-July while visiting Kauai for vacation and celebrating my birthday.  I discovered Wings Over Kauai reading Trip Advisor reviews.  We have been on several helicopters tours- over Oahu, Maui, and the big island as well as a tour in the Caribbean over Antigua.  We’ve always enjoyed being able to capture amazing photographs but considered the negative of helicopter tours being booked with other parties and not knowing what seat assignment you may get.  Flying with Wings Over Kauai, we had the advantage of not having to ride with other parties, he enjoyed sitting up front with Captain Doug, and I enjoyed having the back seat to myself to see and take pictures from both sides.  We were initially hesitant about reviews noting how fly higher than helicopter tours, but we didn’t think there was much difference and it didn’t at all effecting the view or taking pictures.  I think we actually captured better pictures.  We went on a boat tour along NaPali coast line the day prior and would agree with previous reviews that it’s so worth seeing the NaPali coastline by boat and by air.  Even after visiting the canyon, the views are so different flying over the canyon.  I experience motion sickness so I didn’t know if this experience would be different.  I took medication prior flying, ate the ginger chews offered, and thought I did better on this flight than helicopter tours.  The windows are closed so don’t have the breeze coming in the window like the helicopter but there was enough air and coolness that motion sickness wasn’t triggered.  I later too found the ginger chews are sold at the ABC stores.  We have learned from previous tours to wear dark colored clothes so there is no reflection in the windows when taking pictures.  Gina was efficient in checking us in and coordinating preparation for our flight.  We appreciated how in addition to the pictures we captured, Gina took our picture in front of the Cessna before departing, shared the pictures by e-mail, as well as gave us a CD of music during our flight afterward with our picture on the front cover.  During our flight time, a Hawaiian Airlines plane landed and there were many helicopters flying the same route around the island.  Captain Doug did a great job toggling back and forth communicating with the tower while letting us know where and what we were flying over.  He took extra time flying at different angles/circling around waterfalls and points of interest we pointed out.  Many reviews highlight a cost savings booking with Wings Over Kauai.  While this is true, I believe more importantly is having an individual, personalized tour experience.  We have no regrets not booking a helicopter tour and are so glad we stumbled upon learning about Wings Over Kauai through Trip Advisor.

My partner and I booked the Cessna flight in July. Unfortunately, the weather was misbehaving on the day we were supposed to go up and we had to reschedule - I would like to note that everyone at Wings Over Kauai went out of their way to explain the issues and to try and find a solution for us. We managed to fly the next day and it was magnificent! Bruce could have not been a more considerate pilot - I am prone to motion sickness and he told me a great tip which ensured I was fine for the whole flight. He was also great at checking in on me and making sure I was doing okay.

The flight was gorgeous and Bruce was super knowledgeable and friendly. We loved every minute of it - such a wonderful way to see the island.
Personal muy amable y el piloto nos facilitaba mucha información de los sitios que sobrevolábamos. Muy agradable el vuelo.

review_title: Ver Kauai desde el aire es una experiencia para no perderse.
review_text: Vuelo de una hora aprox. Muy buenas vistas y personal muy amable. El piloto muy simpático y nos explicó perfectamente todos los puntos visitados.

Très belle expérience ! Excellent accueil, Marcus, Val et Bruce sont très sympathiques et professionnels. Nous avions réservé pour 4, et nous étions seuls dans l'avion avec le pilote ! Ses commentaires nous ont permis d'avoir une multitude d'informations... le survol en avion est parfait pour découvrir l'ile en famille. Nous recommandons ce vol pour tous ! Chacun a un grand hublot, et a une belle vue.... vraiment satisfaits de notre choix !!!! Mahalo à toute l'équipe !

First thing we did on our first day in Kauia was to ride this small seater plane. Pilot was excellent, felt very safe and secure with him. Extremely smooth ride (only encounter turbulence once and he handled it like a pro). Best way to view this magnificent island is by air. You get a larger glimpse of the beauty. Helicopters get closer but not necessarily capture the whole perspective (not to mention the risk of dizziness with their swinging movements.) Plane trip felt relaxed and mesmerizing. The Napali coast line and the numerous waterfalls to observe on this trip were spectacular. The cost was very economical considering the once in a lifetime views and the memories that you will forever keep with you. Front desk staff friendly and the flight left on time. We had the plane all to ourselves so we got special attention. Go ahead and book this tour now... you will be you did.. if you don't.. you will regret this once in a lifetime opportunity

There is no better way to see Kauai than from the air! This was my first trip to this island but this tour was one that was highly recommended and our group of 3 was not dissapointed! The staff and our pilot were very professional and knowledgeable about all the sights to be seen and the history of the island.

Friends told me that is a must to take the air tour. We arrive at the airport, I was seating on the co-pilot seat, what a great view. Our guide nicely described the areas we were flying over. The view was spectacular nor clouds or rain, loved it.

We thoroughly enjoyed our airplane tour of Kauai. We flew in a Cessna, 2 seater plane. There was an amazing view of the mountains, valleys, waterfalls, beaches, and the Napali coastline. We took a lot of wonderful photos. Wings Over Kauai was a great company to work with. They were very caring and helpful. I would highly recommend them for an aerial view of Kauai.

We signed up this morning and were aloft with Bruce, the owner, before 12m. The pre-flight orientation was illuminating. The weigh-in was, as advertised, discreet. All of that was good, but, the flight was better! Bruce has been doing this for fourteen years and it shows. Passing over some agricultural fields, we heard briefly about his former career as a research agronomist. Bruce told about owners of great tracts of land, as well as cleverly mixing in movie references as we saw sites of ‘on location’ filming. Then it got even better as we saw the star of our trip — the geographic beauty of Kaua’i as highlighted by the Waimea canyon and Napali coast. Bruce skillfully navigated to give us excellent views down the canyon and all along the coast. He did this while simultaneously narrating with geological background information as well as news about the current state of road closures and personal vignettes from his thousands of hours of flying various versions of this tour. With his help, we were able to identify our particular resort as well as many more general interest sights. 
Overall, this was well worth our time and money!
logistical notes — we were seated both on the starboard side, one with the pilot in the front and one behind. This allowed Bruce to orient the craft so as to always give us both the best view. Also, the front seat adjusted downward so the taller passenger could easily see out the side window.

review_title: Beautiful way to see the island
review_text:
Plane vs. Helicopter seems to be a matter of thrill vs. camera shots. In the plane, it seems you can get better camera shots because you are further away from everything, but we saw helicopters underneath us who could go quite close to the waterfalls and craters, etc. I imagine it would be awesome to experience but even more difficult to capture. If money were no issue, I might opt for the helicopter but I have no regrets on our plane experience. 
My friend and I booked the slightly larger plane because we wanted the bubble windows for better visibility. Unfortunately because there were not four of us, they called us to switch to the private jet, which I was a bit bummed about due to less window visibility (which they at least admitted) even though they didn't charge extra. Regardless, views were nicer on the side than I was worried we'd get (if you're short, it is hard to see out the front even as co-pilot). Doug was super calm and very friendly, which helps if you get altitude sickness (so do their ginger candies and water). Getting there 30min early seemed unnecessary since they didn't see us til 10 min before, yet again were very friendly. Overall would highly recommend seeing Kauai by air, whatever way it is that best works for you and your schedule/budget.

review_title: Private Cessna is the only way to fly!
review_text:
We decided to splurge during our visit to Kauai and booked a private flight on Wings Over Kauai's Cessna 172.  It was a bit more expensive than the group flight on the Caravan, but so worth it.  Imagine having your own private chauffeured hour to fly around the island!
 
We were warmly welcomed to the flightline by Val.  She took our information and gave us a quick rundown of what to expect during our flight.  She also discreetly weighed us 
to ensure the weight and balance is set up properly for the flight.

We met Captain Bruce and after introductions were made all around, we all walked out to the plane.  So much nicer than boarding a commercial flight.  Yeah, the plane was smaller but no one was fighting you for overhead bin space! As an #AvGeek (read "plane nerd!") I called shotgun and my wife was nice enough to indulge me.  Bruce also teaches flying, so he took the time to explain flight dynamics and how the airplane respond to different inputs.  We both worked the pre-flight takeoff list and after waiting for a Hawaiian Airlines 717 to land and vacate the runway, we were off.

It was a beautiful day for flying.  Puffy white clouds dotted the sky and visibility was forever.  Mt. Waiʻaleʻale was almost totally visible, which is vary rare!  Bruce kept up a running commentary was we overflew Poipu Beach, the Waimea Canyon, the Napali Coast, then across Hanalei Bay and back down towards Lihue.  When we were halfway through our flight, my wife commenced the drink service with bottles and cans from the cooler under the back seat!

We were thrilled with our choice of Wings Over Kauai.  We highly recommend the private Cessna flight for a group of 2 or 3 people.  Even if you take the group flight on the Caravan, seeing the island from the air is a fantastic trip and should be considered a "Must Do!" during your visit to the Kauai.

very friendly staff, and a fantastic way to discover Kauai, most of it being inaccessible by land. Our pilot was very friendly and provided great info and context as he flew us over the island. Compared to an helicopter, a small aircraft definitely give a less noisy environment, our pilot even played some Hawaiian music during the flight!

It was an increíble flight! Breathtaking views, personalized experience, and Bruce our pilot and owner was delightful, it was like flying with a friend! I definetely recommend it! Small details like having gingerale on board or receiving the photo they took vía e-mail made it even betarragas!
Couldn't have asked for anything better from this company. Friendly staff, the pilot had lots of information for us, was a genuine nice guy. Great tour!

Took the private flight in the little Cessna.  I cannot say enough about the flight, and the company in general.  The landside ladies were personable and friendly.  Made us feel right at home.  A family run affair, complete with dog.  The pilot (owner of the company) did a fantastic job of narrating our tour.  Very informative without being too chatty or cheeky.  I would recommend taking this tour first thing when you get to Kauai, as the pilot will show you areas to visit during your stay.

Just to echo what most everyone else says, very affordable and high quality.  The only warning, it gets very warm in the plane, so I recommend taking a bottle of cold water to help keep yourself cool, and wear shorts and a dark color but lightweight shirt.

To me the biggest test of how good anything is, would you do it again.  A resounding YES!

What a great day of sightseeing. Everyone was great to us, and o my what a great day to fly with Marcus. Explained in detail every site we flew over. We had our 2 grandkids with us for their first time on the island. We also purchased the in flight video of our flight. Would highly recommend them for any of your future flights over this island.

review_title: Simply fantastic -  Affordable and high quality
review_text:
We chose to fly as a private tour. 

Gina and Captain Bruce took great care of us. 

Gina make checking in for the flight easy and Bruce, (pilot) put us at ease explaining everything we had questions about and ensuring we were comfortable.

The flight itself was exciting and generally smooth. The views were priceless of course and taking this particular option, meant we both had an uninterrupted view. Bruce's local knowledge added to the tour also.

Bottom line would I recommend this option to see Kauai?

A clear yes. 

Bang for buck (price) is unbeatable.
The ability and ease to take photos, especially for the person sitting in the back seat is excellent. (no competition for window seats as you are guaranteed one).
Time is the air is generous.

This was a fantastic way to get an appreciation of the Island.

Many thanks Gina & Bruce for a fantastic experience.

Jack

We had booked this trip as the highlight of our Kauai stay and were not disappointed.  The pilot Marcus was polite and very informative.   We mostly gazed at the beautiful island, completely awestruck. The journey was a good hour long and so we really felt we had our money's worth.

We just got back from our airplane tour with Marcus. It was absolutely breathtaking and Marcus was a fantastic tour guide.  We had our 10 and 13 year olds with us and my 80 year old mother in law and we all loved it!  His extensive knowledge of the island was amazing. He kept the plane nice a steady and gave us an amazing amount of information about the island. I would highly recommend this tour!! It was an experience of a lifetime!

Flying over Kauai is the only way to get a true picture of how stunning the island is from every viewpoint. We had a great flight and Captain Marcus answered our questions and showed us the highlights. Also, funny enough, he's from southern Minnesota and we were visting from the Twin Cities in Minnesota. Small world. I'd recommend a tour - it was a wonderful experience at a reasonable price.

I am a visiting student pilot and decided to do a flight instruction with Bruce. I did almost all the flying while Bruce did the radios. Learned a lot about flying around mountains! Bruce also provided helpful hints and tips prior to my check ride. He is a great instructor and highly professional. I would definitely do this again :)

review_title: FANTASTIC VFR Private Flying Lesson with Captain Bruce!
review_text:
I was lucky enough to take a private VFR flying lesson with Captain Bruce in his Cessna. Captain Bruce is an excellent pilot who taught me some really valuable must know info with regard to flying VFR flights in Kauai as well as a few new general things/tips that will help me before I solo.  His Cessna was clean and flew very smooth.  I suspect he takes excellent care of his planes.  I highly recommend taking a flight with Wings Over Kauai whether its a tour or a private lesson. It is truly the best place in the world to fly. Period.

-Joe Amar, Los Angeles, 7/1/18

We went on the two seater Cessna with Doug our pilot. Safety briefing before getting on the plane.Doug informed us that was light refreshments if we required.  Quickly took off and followed the coast for a while. Lovely scenery really captured the beauty of the island. Doug was very informative on the history of the area. We did attempt go into the valley but the weather was against us and we were buffeted a bit. Which was hair raising. Doug turned towards the coast and followed the land. Beautiful island.  Clothing for the trip was casual. After the trip we were given a photo and cd of the music that was playing in the background.  well worth the trip and thanks for making us feel so welcome

review_title: Visiting General Aviation pilot's flight with Bruce
review_text:
Today my wife & I went on a flight with  Bruce from "Wings Over Kauai".  Being a general aviation pilot I was not sure the weather would clear up enough to allow us to fly today.  After our pre-flight  briefing, the weather cleared up enough for us to safely fly around some clouds to do our island tour. Safety was a priority for Bruce as well as being a good neighbor and not disturbing those living below. We achieved both goals
and still had a chance to enjoy most of the beautiful scenery below. I had booked the flight so as to pilot the plane.  Bruce worked the radios & communications with others as I flew the Cessna 172.  He was very professional & easy to work with while flying around Kauai. This will probably be the highlight of our week's visit to Kauai. He even handed us a guide to some of his island favorites, an extra bonus from a local resident

Our family of six were in the air van with Captain Marcus.  Marcus was informative, friendly and did a fantastic job answering questions.  The views are just amazing!  To explain how amazing it was, our 14-year old, who never stops talking was speechless for over an hour.  Do this, you won't be disappointed!

Once again Wings Over Kauai was the BEST ever---anywhere!  Captain Doug has this tour mastered in the Cessna for 2. This was a repeat tour for us (toured with Capt. Bruce 6 years ago) and the first thing we booked when we knew we were returning to Kauai.  This time we saw the Na'Pali Coast 3 times---but by air was the best!  The whole island is so so beautiful and peaceful!   Val and Doug are super additions to the Wings family (O'hana!)  Mahalo for a funtastic adventure--again!

It was an amazing trip over the island of Kauai. Val was very friendly and informative. Captain Doug gave us personal tips and shared personal stories while in air. Kauai is beautiful and most of the island is privately owned and inaccessible - being in air was a big advantage. Luckily we were blessed with clear skies.

review_title: A Feast for the Eyes and Soul
review_text: By far the highlight of our recent trip, we could not believe the beauty our eyes and minds were absorbing, highlighted by some beautiful music, to boot. It was breathtaking, the pilot thoroughly answered all our questions, and he knows so much about the island.The young man made a brilliant move relocating from Minnesota, I’d say! We would love to go back, doing that same tour at least a couple times over a weeks vacation. They provided , along with a great experience, complimentary drinks and snacks, and a disc of the mostly instrumental music we heard while soaring above the island, an ongoing reminder of a fabulous time we had.

Der Rundflug war ein Geschenk von meinen Kumpels zu meinem Geburtstag. Was soll ich sagen außer WOW!!! Für alle die mal in Kauai sind und das nötige Kleingeld haben kann ich nur raten das auch zu machen. Bruce und seine Crew sind super nett und Bruce hat sehr viel Fachwissen über Kauai. Es war ein unvergesslicher Flug den ich jederzeit wieder machen würde. Ich vermisse Hawaii und seine schönen Ecken.

Danke Bruce für diesen unvergesslichen Trip!

review_title: Best views of Na Pali Coast!
review_text: This trip was absolutely breathtaking. Marcus did a great job and was very informative. My pictures all look like postcards and they even give you a free gift at the end. I would do this again in a heartbeat.

Truly a bucket list adventure.  My family of four along with my mother and stepfather had a blast exploring the island from the air.  I really got a good view of all the different landscapes this beautiful island has.  We saw lots of waterfalls.  We even saw the  "hush, hush" movie set off in the distance and that was pretty exciting.  My girls are 6yr and 9 yr and loved it.  We went out at 1pm, not sure if time of day matters.
This was a great experience and fantastic way to view the island! Friendly folks greet you and make the flight fun. I would highly recommend!

As we were preparing for our trip to Hawaii, we were focused on a helicopter tour, but we were afraid of getting middle seats, so we opted for Wings over Kauai’s plane tour instead.

It was a great flight (60-70 minutes) that provided beautiful views of the island.  You’re always dependent on the weather and we were unable to fly up Waimea Canyon, but that didn’t dim the overall experience.

Our pilot was knowledgeable and provided great commentary.

review_title: Best part of my 15 day Hawaii cruise on Princess
review_text:
My son wants to be a pilot and just happen to mention this to lady who took my reservation over the phone 2 months prior us to going there. They gave me an option to cancel as the weather was not great but we decided to go since we spent time getting there. They allowed my son to go in any fly side by side with the pilot which my was awesome! The weather wound  up clearing up and this was the best part of my Hawaii trip. I have bad feet and can't to any excursions that require hiking or difficulty.   This made my entire Hawaii trip great, would highly recommend for everyone!
.

I have done many of these type tours and this was one of the best.
the pilot was great . the plane ride was smooth and there was great seating.
The sites were amazing and i would highly recommend this company

It's something you should never miss in Kauai. Seeing all the island from the sky is something absolutely unforgettable. And while you have such a nature miracle in front of you, Doug explains you everything, and kindly answers all your questions. For me, that I grew up with jurassic Park, that I felt in love with diving many years ago, all this was absolutely the most wonderful thing I have ever seen. Thank you SO MUCH Doug and Ellen for your kindness - also with my little daughter-, for let our dream come true. If you come to Tuscany contact us!!!

review_title: Don’t miss this!  Worth every penny!
review_text:
You just can’t imagine the beauty of the island till you see it like this, a totally different perspective.
Well worth the money!
Very professional and friendly service.

I’m a large lady and did not have to pay extra that I would have had to, if I took a helicopter.

It’s not fun to get weighed but it was a very discrete process.

There is a surprise at the end, but don’t want to spoil it for you!

Go, you won’t be sorry!

review_title: Amazing Views with an amazing pilot!
review_text: This was an amazing experience that every person visiting Kauai should take part in. Our pilot Marcus was full of knowledge and was awesome at maintaining a smooth ride, which was greatly appreciated because I suffer from motion sickness. The views you see from the plane are like no other and it is totally worth the money. If you pass on this experience you are truly missing out.

This was in my top two favorite things that my family of four did while we were in Kauai (and we managed to do a LOT.) Every single thing about this tour, from check in to departure, was just great. Val checked us in, and she was friendly, efficient, and funny. Our pilot, Marcus, was perfect. He made us feel welcome and safe and did a great job narrating our trip and answering our many questions. He even provided a soundtrack during the flight which added so much. As I said, we really packed it all in on this vacation and viewed the island by boat, air, and trails. The aerial vantage point is a fantastic way to visualize the (almost) entire island, and it really complimented our other adventures on Kauai. Seriously, just do this tour. It is money well spent.

We had a great time on our air tour over Kauai! The views were gorgeous and our pilot Bruce was great and very knowledgeable! They even provided a nice picture of our group with the plane and beverages on board. All of the staff at Wings over Kauai were very nice & accomodating! Side note... if you get motion sick I would highly recommend taking some medication prior to this adventure.

Never done an aerial tour of any kind. Chose this because of the reviews and I thought it might be better for my stomach (I did take meclizine as a precaution) than a helicopter. Also, everyone has a window seat on the airvan, not true on a helicopter. I did a morning tour. The weather was perfect. Everything that could be clear of clouds was. There was very little turbulence, and my stomach was fine. It was not a full tour-just myself and couple from the cruise ship. I sat up front with the pilot, in the the copilot's seat. The headsets are two-way so, in addition to hearing the pilot give the tour, you are able to comment, ask questions or talk to the pilot or other passengers. Our very knowledgeable pilot was Marcus. He did a fantastic job! The ground crew is just as awesome! A beautiful, informative and enjoyable tour!! I highly recommend it!!!

This is a fantastic way to see Kauai and especially the Napali Coast and the waterfalls.  Our family of six loved this airplane ride.  This is definitely the highlight of our trip!  And Val and Captain Marcus were fabulous and so friendly. The special gift at the end of the air tour was a nice touch.  The kids and my parents all enjoyed this air tour!  Definitely a great way to spend our vacation time.  Highly recommend!

review_title: Amazing Impressions from the Landscape, great pilot and much background information
review_text:
Martina and I spend a few days on Kauai. We choose a flight by a small plane, because we wanted a private experience. Long story in short: It was fantastic. We had great views of the entire island. Bruce, our captain introduced us very dedicated.

Mahalo, Bruce!!!

We would recommend this experience to everyone especially our best friends.
We appriciated it.

Good Luck to all of U at "Wings over Kauai" and thank you again for your hospitality.
Josef

This was by far my favorite activity of a pretty awesome trip. Val was super nice. Our pilot was Doug. He was friendly and very knowledgeable. The flight views were spectacular beyond words. I cannot recommend this highly enough. Thanks for the amazing experience.

We have been on a small plane before and the ride has been a bit bumpy, so I was expecting about the same for this one.  Marcus was so great, the trip was smooth, the views were spectacular and we had a great time.  Totally worth doing if you want to really see Kauai.

review_title: Simply Amazing! A MUST do when in Kauai!
review_text: Ellen was great, she checked us in and gave us the safety briefing. Marcus the pilot was very informative and a great DJ too! My husband was in the co-pilot seat and thankfully didn't press or turn any of the knobs and switches in front of him! The ride was pretty smooth considering we were in a small plane and the landing was awesome, so smooth, Marcus is an exceptional pilot. The views were simply amazing, we now feel that we have seen pretty much all of the island, if not by air, by land or by sea. Some things we saw by air, land and sea!! Definitely a MUST do! The highlight of our vacation!

My wife and I booked the flight around Kauai with Wings over Kauai. Everything from start to finish was fantastic. Val checked us in and gave us the low down on what to expect. Our pilot Bruce was so friendly and accommodating on the flight. My wife sat in the co-pilot seat and got to help with the pre-flight check. The ride was smooth and spectacular. Bruce filled us in on all kinds of local landmarks and history during the flight. We couldn't have been more pleased. I highly recommend, you won't be disappointed.

Four of us took this sightseeing flight in April 2018. Ellen, Bruce and Doug (our pilot) were all so nice. Our flight over Kauai was awesome! The sights, falls, and canyons left us amazed! Doug was very informative and professional. We highly recommend this excursion.

review_title: Private flight for two in a Cessna 172.
review_text: Absolutely perfect.  Our pilot Bruce was an absolute expert (I know since I'm also a commercial pilot) and fun to be with.  Top notch operation without the attitude of others...  Don't hesitate to book now.

review_title: Wings over Kauai - Flight with Bruce
review_text: We booked the private flight in the Cesna and it was absolutely amazing! Definitely the best way to see the island, especially now after the flooding since many places are closed and you can only see them by plane. I would recommend booking an air tour with this company as Bruce (the pilot) was funny and knowledgable. You also get a CD with a picture of you by the plane and the music that you’ve listened to during the flight. Thank you Wings Over Kauai! :)

We’ve been visiting Kauai since 1990.  My husband and I have taken several helicopter tours over the years. We wanted to try something different and friends recommended Wings Over Kauai.  We had an amazing time!  We saw everything on the island including the Poipu coastline, Hanapepe Valley, Waimea Canyon, the Napali  Coast, town of Hanalei, Sleepiing Giant, Wailua Falls, etc.  Very smooth ride and Bruce was extremely friendly, knowledgeable and professional!  Every passenger had a large window view to thoroughly enjoy the views.  And it was half the price of most helicopter tours on Kauai.

Wir hatten einen sehr beeindruckenden Flug über die Insel. Das Personal ist aussordentlich nett und die Ausführungen von Bruce sind äußerst informativ und spaßig man merkt er ist mit Herzblut bei der Sache.
Jederzeit wieder und ein must.

We took the morning Air Van tour and it exceeded all of our expectations! Val met us at check-in with a warm welcome and explained our flight path. We were lucky enough to have Marcus as our skilled pilot and he was terrific! The flight was smooth, he described all of the sights and encouraged questions from the passengers. Everyone was seated on the right side of the aircraft in order to have optimal views. The scenery on Kauai is breathtaking from the air. Wings over Kauai is a “must do” activity when visiting this beautiful island. Thank you Marcus for a perfect and memorable day!

The views are SO AMAZING!  Definitely a must do!  The pilot talked about everything we flew over and there was great background music going on that was very fitting for the whole flight!  I can't express how much this is a MUST to do!

This is an absolute MUST!  You get to see everything, waterfalls, Waimea Canyon, coffee fields, all the middle of the island, mountain tops, coasts, Napali Coast (ABSOLUTELY STUNNING)!  DO NOT LEAVE KAUAI WITHOUT SEEING NAPALI COAST!  We didn't have the 7 hour super cruise planned, but after we saw Napali Coast with WINGS OVER KAUAI, we knew it was a must as well!

review_title: Best flight tour of the island!
