review_text: Captain Marcus was an excellent pilot and tour guide. My family and I enjoyed the trip very much! Marcus was very kind to offer suggestions on things to do to make my son feel better when he got a little airsick. A great way to see the beautiful Garden Isle and a must-do activity to orient yourself to the things you may want to do and see when you're there.

Our pilot Bruce was engaging with all 5 family members and it made us all very comfortable and feel safe.Its  gorgeous and gave us some idea of the places we would eventually go later in the week.;Bruce even gave us a nice soundtrack he played on the plane on disc for my bday with a photo of the family.My daughter hade motion sickness , so he ran over before we left and gave her a soothing cold towel to take.Beverages and ginger available on the flight. Check in wi9th Ellen went smooth and pleaasant. I do not know how different the helicopter is from the plane, but I felt the plane was a great choice.

review_title: Great bird's eye view of the beautiful island of Kauai
review_text: My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed our flight with Marcus and Wings Over Kauai.  The flight was so enjoyable on a clear day and the narration by Marcus was very informative.  It is the perfect way to see the beautiful island of Kauai.  I would highly recommend this trip to anyone who would like to see otherwise inaccessible parts of this beautiful place.

Met Bruce in the morning and he drove us to the airport. He's extremely personable and even tho he wasn't our pilot he put us in very capable hands.  That  of Marcus. My husband and I are both pilots so we knew what to expect flying wise. The scenery was exquisite and it was a very smooth ride. Clearly you have a little bumps because of the clouds but Marcus had full command of the situation. Also the smoothest takeoff and landing I've experienced in a very long time. Well worth the $$$ we even ordered the raw video that was shot. Would do it again. With this company in a heartbeat

My wife and I recently did the Cessna tour with Captain Doug.  This was an incredible air tour.  The check in was very easy to find with a nice introduction to our tour showing highlights of where we would be flying on a topographical map.  The plane was very comfortable for the 2 of us even though I am pushing 300 lbs.  My wife sat in copilot seat and I was in the back seat and there was plenty of room.  A cooler was provided with cold water and mints and ginger chews in the event of motion sickness they have everything covered.  Fortunately we did not require any of these amenities as the flight was very smooth.  The flight was a little over an hour and was amazing for every second of that time.  There are so many amazing views around every corner of Kauai that are not accessible on the ground, there is absolutely no other way to see some sights other than the air.  After our trip we both agreed that this was the highlight of our vacation hands down, cannot recommend enough.  The NaPali coast from the air is absolutely amazing.  The flight is low and slow and very smooth, giving plenty of time to take in all vistas.  Being that this is a private flight for 2 the trip is entirely yours.  Captain had nice information about sights and locales and was just a pleasure to chat with throughout the flight.

review_title: Perfect way to see the island.
review_text: This was the perfect way to kick off our trip. We were originally scheduled for the day we arrived on Kauai, but overcast/drizzly weather caused us to call the office, and they suggested we reschedule to the next day for clear flying. The next day was perfect, and our pilot, Doug, was super friendly, and shared all sorts of information about the island. I definitely recommend taking this tour as early as possible into your vacation, to see all the sights from above, and help determine what places you want to go explore more when back on the ground. We took the Cessna, so I can't speak to the views from the Airvan, but the postcard-quality photos that my wife got were great.

Less expensive than a helicopter tour, we'd highly recommend Wings Over Kauai and its pilot Bruce   Tour the island in a six-person airplane and learn loads from Bruce, who knows much about the island's history, people and geography.  He was personable, the sights were stunning and, at the end of the flight, he gave us two thoughtful gifts, in addition to the flight and his narration--a music CD of his favorite local music (complete with our family's photo on the cover!) and a list of his island favorites--from food to activities to beaches--as well as a map that locates each of those favorites.

My husband wanted to get more fixed wing hours, so we called Wings and was setup with CFI Bruce. He was awesome!!! So engaging and so very nice. He helped my husband with any flight questions and made sure to point out things to me about the island. We had an awesome time with Bruce and the entire team at Wings. We highly recommend this company to fly with.

We had a WONDERFUL times on our tour. We went on the "airbus" tour with our pilot Marcus! He was so great!  The views were the most beautiful I've ever seen, Marcus was interesting and funny! They sent us a video of our tour which I will force all of my family to watch! Such a great experience. We highly recommend!

review_title: Best thing we did on the 3 week vacation!!!
review_text: We did this as part of our honeymoon and it was absolutely brilliant. We did a 9am flight with Bruce, his lovely wife checked us in and told us what we would see on the flight and the route. Bruce then took us up, and it was amazing. Bruce was brilliant, talking to us for the whole flight, was very knowledgeable and was a great tour guide. We got to see so much of the island we wouldn't have otherwise seen, absolutely brilliant company, brilliant tour and lovely people. The best thing we did all holiday, cannot recommend enough, thank you for such a wonderful experience!

review_title: Highlight of our tour to Kauai
review_text: Terrific!  Great views, fun pilot. I liked the plane tour better than Helicopter tours. I'll do again when I return.

Definitely an awesome way to kick off a trip in Kauai! I highly recommend doing this on a plane over the helicopter. We did the 2 person tour in a Cessna 172 and it was fantastic. Price was very reasonable -- I heard it costs around $300 a person for helicopter tours and you're crammed with other people. They were super flexible and even let us reschedule to the next day because the weather was bad for the day we planned to fly. Only minor hiccup was we were delayed about a half hour because they needed to reload fuel in our plane. If we had something else planned it could've been a problem. 
Doug was our pilot and he was awesome! Very experienced and knowledgeable about the island, including the history and geography. He made us feel safe and was very fun to talk to. We got to see the most incredible views of the Na Pali coast and the island. It was nice they let us use our own go-pro too.
We got a nice picture at the end taken in front of the plane along with a CD and some good tour tips. Ultimately an incredible experience and I would highly recommend!

You can't beat the views you get for this price!  Kauai is beautiful, from the hiking trails to the small towns.  But the scenery from a Wings Over Kauai airplane - AMAZING!  Not to mention, very reasonably priced!
We went on the 11am tour.  It was a beautiful sunny day (no rain yet) and the wind wasn't too bad.  
They start out on the east side of the island (the airport), and we made our way south towards Poipu before veering north to see Waimea Canyon and the Na Pali coast. Before looping our way from the North Shore back down.  It takes slightly over an hour and the pilot Josh is an excellent guide.  Very friendly and knowledgeable between the history and the "movie sights".

Now, if you get the slightly motion sickness let the lady know when you check in.  I can get nauseous easily (see my review from HoloHolo Charters), so they put me in the front by the pilot.  I was told this was the best place for me; to try and keep my head and view on the right side of the plane and to give the camera to my husband.  Taking pictures and looking thru the viewfinder tends to make more sicker.  Oh and take dramemine, sea patches, whatever works for you.  I took the pills and although I was somewhat nauseous thru the flight, it wasn't near as bad as it could have been.

One of the highlights of our trip to Kauai. From initial booking to landing, Bruce and his team were absolutely wonderful. Bruce was our instructor for the flight lesson and was extremely knowledgeable, personable, funny and just cool!

The views of the island were indescribably beautiful and we learned a lot about the island.

If you want to experience a true gem of an activity and support a family-run business, please, please go see Bruce, Ellen and the team at Wings Over Kauai!

review_title: Excellent Smooth Flight Over Stunning Views of Kauai
review_text: We took the Cessna (up to 3 people weight depending) and there is also a small airvan (up to 6 people). Doug, our pilot was excellent and we had a really smooth ride and he was a great tour guide as well. You get to see the whole island and all it has to offer. If you had to choose between this and a bout tour of the Na Pali Coast, definitely choose this as you see the beautiful north coast as well as the rest of the island from a great vantage point. Well worth the money. Helicopters are more expensive but do get a little closer to the surrounding scenery for those who are wondering. Would recommend Wings over kauai for sure!

It all starts with a simple road trip to the airport were you meet the staff an pilot,after they go over safety rules on the plane, and how to enjoy the your trip throw the mountains and valleys of Kauai.
You board the plane and put your head phones on so the pilot and everybody can talk to each other while in the air,
Your off an in short time you start seeing breath taking views  of the island.
Me an my wife Janice,got take a lot of beautiful pics of the water and island and the pilot was very knowledgeable of facts of the history of the island.
We did hit a  few air bumps along the way throw the mountains  but that's part of the fun in a small aircraft riding the air waves, our pilot handled that with no problems and then we landed,the experience was great and me and my wife got a lot of great memories. We gives thanks to Wings Over Kauai, for the beautiful experience and how professional they are and safety is a no.1 priority to them,  If you love fun an Adventure this is how to do it in Kauai, Chuck an Janice Courtney.

We booked a plane tour but encountered less-than-ideal weather the day we were booked. Marcus suggested we do a different day to maximize our adventure, then worked carefully to fit the rescheduled flight into our itinerary. Man, was it worth it! Marcus was our pilot and was a wealth of knowledge about the island. He had many interesting stories and patiently and expertly answered our many questions. I don't think I ever heard the words "I don't know" as our family peppered him with inquiries throughout the flight. Great choice; would absolutely do it again!

review_title: Wonderful way to see the beauty of this island.
review_text: We took this plane ride when our cruise ship was in Kauai. It was fabulous! Our pilot was very knowledgable. The island has so much beautiful land and scenery that you can only see from the sky or the water. We saw so many waterfalls that I lost count. It was easy to take pictures through the windows and felt more secure than a helicopter. I highly recommend this tour.

Really enjoyed this experience, didn't fancy the helicopter tour - this was excellent. Small Cesna for the two of us piloted by Bruce the owner.  Great to see the island from above, we were on a cruise ship so only had a short day to see the island. Good value.
Pick up from easy location and returned to ship.  Thanks Bruce and the team.

We called the day before and were offered a private plane tour. Just the 2 of us and the pilot! Wonderful! So much more comfortable than the vibration and noise of a helicopter. We were up for over an hour and saw almost the entire island. Our pilot was great and informative. We will definitely do this again.

This was the best thing we did on our whole trip! I cannot recommend it enough. Our view was so much better than the helicopters that were below us darting in and out of canyons. We had a beautiful and peaceful ride and Bruce is entertaining and delightful. Every person on the plane had a window seat. There for 4 of us on the plane that can take 6 but they keep groups small for this reason. The plane is half the price of the helicopter which helped us make the choice but now I would go with the plane even if the price were equal. We went on a ocean cruise and while that was nice if you do one activity, do this! Thank you to the Wings Over Kauai family! Rick and Brooke from WI

review_title: Wings Over Kauai Better Than Helicopter
review_text: Wings Over Kauai is much better than a helicopter to flight see Kauai. My wife and I have done both and my wife got nauseous on the helicopter but not on Wings Over Kauai.  I like it more because you can see the amazing beauty of Kauai much better when you are not so close as you are on a helicopter.   We have visited Kauai more than 30 times and  Kings Over Kauai  is  more affordable and a better value than a helicopter.  We like it so much that we are repeat customers.  Wings Over Kauai is Mo Bettah!  Hang Loose!  G. Smith Redmond, WA

Captain Bruce gave us a great, smooth ride. We were able to see all of the beautiful sites of the island through the bubble windows of the plane. He also provided interesting information about Kauai as well. Very enjoyable experience.

From Amy who picked us up near the port, to Val who checked us in.  Both lovely and very professional.  But a special mention to our pilot Marcus, thank you for the awesome and unforgettable flight.  The views were amazing and breathtaking.  They record everything with GoPros attached everywhere on the plane and the audio of your flight which if you want you can buy.  We thoroughly enjoyed everything about this flight, this company, and we definitely would not hesitate to recommend you see this beautiful island with Wings over Kauai Air Tour.

My wife and I were looking for some sort of air tour on Kauai and looked at all the helicopter tours first and then finally settled on Wings over Kauai. It was a whole hour of breathtaking views of the whole island. Not just the falls and Nepali Coast but everything. Captain Marcus was our pilot and he did a fantastic and amazing job. The hour passes by quick before you know it it's over. They record your entire flight with GoPros and the audio from your flight which you can purchase. It is well worth it because the quality is just like taking the flight and reliving all the memories all over again. I would highly recommend this tour. The interactions with everyone in the company we had was the absolute best. Thank you!!!

review_title: Very professional company - beware any air tour if you're prone to motion sickness
review_text:
This company is outstanding and very professional, and I felt safe despite some initial concerns about safety in a small plane. 

We took this tour as a shortcut to dragging our hike averse toddlers to Waimea Canyon and because I was dying to see more of the Napali Coast. All in all, I'm glad we did it. But I did get very nauseous. I knew I was somewhat sensitive to motion sickness because I'm consistently nauseous on windy roads, but I'm pretty good on commercial flights so didn't expect to feel as sick as I did. The pilot noticed immediately and was great about taking measures to help, but I was super happy when the flight ended and, as a result, came away thinking this wasn't a must do. Many of the views you get you have seen if you've looked at pictures of Kauai. Personally, I can't say seeing it in person was much more awe inspiring for me. But my opinion is admittedly directly affected by my sickness, which of course was not the fault of the company. We had an excellent pilot.

There were a lot of helicopters buzzing in and out below. I think that experience would be amazing and more exciting than a plane tour, but I'll never do it now that I know how sick I can easily get. And I'm happy with the experience I had with Wings over Kauai.

review_title: The Best Way to Experience Kauai
review_text:
We had an awesome, unforgettable flight with Marcus. Marcus and the other people in the office were very professional. Our flight was great, and it was a bonus to get a photo of ourselves. Our own photos didn't come out so well, due to reflection, so you might want to consider the video or go-pro options offered. 

If I go back to Kauai, I will probably do this tour again. It was THAT GOOD.

We flew with Marcus today and throughly enjoyed the experience. 
It was fantastic trip and he made it a fun, informative and personalised tour.
We did the 1pm flight and we're initially concerned about clouds but the higher peaks of Kauai are usually shrouded in clouds anyway. 
All in all we throughly recommend this as an excellent way to see the Waimea canyon and the Na Pali coast in a short space of time. 
Also, everyone is guaranteed a window seat which is a big advantage over a helicopter and a lot cheaper too!

Overall, my husband and I had a fabulous experience with Wings over Kauai.  Here are some things to know. 

Pros: 
- higher weight allowance than helicopter tours 
- about half the cost of a helicopter tour 
- easier to afford a private tour 
- amazing, panoramic views of the island 
- charming staff and pilot 
- ability to attach a GoPro to the plane or purchase a video afterwards

Cons: 
- can't fly as close to the ground as some helicopter tours
- view partially obstructed by wing support

review_title: No luck getting into the air, but Wings is still the best!
review_text:
My husband and I were rained or otherwise "bad-weathered" out of every adventure we planned on Kauai.  Couldn't hike Kalalau due to the river crossing being flooded. 
Couldn't kayak or sail the coast due to 24 ft swells.  Never got to fly in the Cessna with Doug due to high winds the first day, and low cloud cover and/or rain the other three times we tried. Luckily, we had booked our flight through Wings over Kauai, and originally booked it for our first full day on the island, which ended up giving us the most shots on goal in terms of chances to reschedule and hopefully get up there.  Each time we arrived, Doug walked us through the weather, visibility, turbulence, and gave us the choice of getting up there with the limited visibility/bumpy ride or reschedule.  We rescheduled three times, and while it never worked out, we still appreciated the customer service and flexible policies of Wings.  Our last chance was the AM before our flight off island, and when it became clear the weather still wasn't going to cooperate, we were promptly issued a refund.  One thing both my husband and I noticed was that every time we went to the terminal to try to get into the air, the helicopter tours were still going out.  So, my guess is they have a limited refund policy and therefore people opt to take the flight even if you don't see anything and/or it's potentially dangerous.  Doug and the rest of Wings were incredibly helpful, friendly, and clearly interested in making sure everyone gets the best and safest experience flying over Kauai.  I can't wait to go back to Kauai again to accomplish all the adventures we were denied our first time out, and we will definitely be re-booking our tour with Wings over Kauai!  We've already passed on their info to three other people we know are heading to Kauai in the next few months.  It's so rare to encounter such amazing customer service in this day and age.  We can honestly say Wings was a highlight of our time in Kauai even though we didn't even get to fly!

With a young family we found our options for aerial tours was limited as most helicopter tours would not take a child under 2 years.  While we didn't take our young child on the tour in the end, the search for a aerial tour led us to Wings over Kauai. (incidently, they did indicate they could take a child under 2 yrs)  We took the private flight in the smaller plane and enjoyed the flight and knowledgeable  commentary of our pilot.  The only negative of the flight if you are a photo buff  was maybe the plane is not ideal if you wanted high quality photos through the  windows which are not ideal for photography.. but we dont see the world enough with our own eyes these days anyway! Good excuse to just enjoy the view and company instead of looking through a digital screen which we all tend to be guilty of more and more these days.

My husband and I just returned home from a 10 day stay in Hawaii, and our air tour with pilot Doug was the highlight of our entire trip! We booked the 3 person Cessna tour, and it was fabulous!! The weather was less than ideal, but Doug was able to show us a coastal view of the entire island. As we took off I became a little anxious about the flight, but Doug was so experienced and provided a very comfortable tour. The calming Hawaiian background music was a nice touch. Doug was very knowledgeable about the entire island and shared much about the sites we were able to see.  He really welcomed us to the island and gave great advice and offered recommendations for our stay. If you plan an air tour while in kauai, books with "wings over Kauai" and ask for pilot Doug!

My wife and I got a private tour from Doug in the small Cessna. He did a great job narrating as we flew across the island. 

The whole process was very relaxed, from checkin to the (smooth) landing. Our pilot even adjusted course based on how we were feeling, and what the weather was like to give us the best custom flight possible. 

The views were great- even sitting in the back seat I could see everything. Highly recommend this over a helicopter where you run the risk of getting stuck in the middle. 

Friendliest pilot in the world, and the whole experience was incredible!

Had a 4PM flight.  Light on the sea cliffs was very good and the view at 2200 Ft was probably better than lower down in a chopper.  Was cheaper with longer duration than the many choppers competing for customers.

I recommend Wings over Kauai wholeheartedly not just because it's about half the price of the others. But the personalized care is wonderful. I booked upon arriving and was first supposed to take a Cessna all on my own. But they were super gracious and allowed me to switch to an Airvan the next day and refunded my balance. I was a bit nervous about flying but Bruce, the agronomist pilot was very reassuring. He flew smooth and steady and when he landed it was like a gentle kiss. Great experience because the weather cooperated. The cliffs and coast line looked stunning and Bruce gave lots of warning before photo ops. And lots of tips for passengers afraid of getting air sick. I strongly recommend the experience.

I took a 70 minute flight instructional Kauai Air Tour with Wings Over Kauai, with my wife in the rear seat as the photographer. I do hold a Private Pilot's License and was able to fly the Cessna 172 for the entire tour over almost the entire island of Kauai. Bruce is an excellent flight instructor, and gave me several pointers on improving my flying skills. The small plane tour will not get you into the canyons or valleys like a helicopter tour will, but if you are looking for a tour in a small plane, this is the operator to choose.

We loved our plane ride, half  the cost of helicopter and so much better.  I was a helicopter nurse for twelve years and I knew this would be quieter. Bruce was so friendly and informative. We all loved it, weather looked iffy but we saw everything and got all the pics we wanted.  The company was very safety conscious which was a priority for me.  Mary and her Dad Bruce made us feel like friends within minutes.   Would definitely recommend it.

We were drawn to Wings Over Kauai because it is a family-owned business. Everything from making reservations with Ellen to being flown by Bruce was perfect. Ellen is warm, friendly, and most helpful. When the day came to fly, the winds were iffy, so she kept us apprised all morning as to our status. Luckily, the wind died down and we were off to see some of the most spectacular sights on the islands.
My husband and I were joined by two young ladies on a six-seater plane. We were awed by the Na Pali coast, something you can't see any other way except by boat, which isn't an option in winter with the heavier seas. Bruce pointed out all the landmarks, including celebrity homes. He did a great narration with historical information and included all of us in the discussion. It was a smooth and relaxing flight.
When we landed, we were presented with a CD of Hawaiian music with our picture, taken pre-flight, on the front of the CD case. Also, Bruce gave us a list of his favorite restaurants and spots on Kauai.   
This was a trip to remember!

What a great experience!  Not only is the island incredibly beautiful and unique from above but Wings Over Kauai really go out of their way to make you feel comfortable and safe.  Our pilot told us interesting facts about the island during the flight and Mary packed us a cooler full of cold beverages and towels.  I love that it is a small family ran company that makes you feel right at home from the beginning.  I would highly recommend this amazing experience!

Wings Over Kauai gets 5 stars in my 4P categories. 

We began planning our excursions for this vacation several months ago and decided to use independent third party operators in lieu of the expensive ones offered through the cruise line.  For Kauai nothing was booked in advance - not usually a good decision considering all the good tours on the ship were sold out.  

Professionalism:  Upon arriving in Kauai on 4/15, I decided to call Wings Over Kauai to see if they have any cancellations.  Using the local number, I did not reach them on the first try and figured I was out of luck.  Immediately after hanging up, I received a call from Ellen, she was very friendly and said they had some openings to accommodate one passenger and I booked a flight on their 8 seater for 11am.  I received email confirmation within minutes ... outstanding customer service and I was a happy camper.

Performance:  I read many of the Trip Advisor comments and let me tell you they do what is advertised, and more!  Ellen picked me up at precisely the right time and shuttled me from the ABC Store to the air terminal.  Her daughter Mary took care of the reservation paperwork along wth weigh-in to make sure they balance out the seating.  Mary said Marcus was our pilot and he would be arriving shortly, and sure enough, he was just landing from a previous flight.  Mary and Marcus escorted the 4 of us to the plane, photos were taken by Mary as a souvenir and she said she'd email them after the flight. I felt like the lucky one with the co-pilot seat (Marcus probably didn't feel as lucky)...guess they needed to put me up there for proper weight distribution.  Views were absolutely incredible -- from take off to landing, and it was great to fly over the harbor and see the cruise ship at the pier.  Marcus' narration of the landmarks, simply outstanding and his piloting skills phenomenal!  Very little turbulence, partly cloudy skies and a very smooth flight allowed for some spectacular photograph.  The beautiful island music playing through the headsets was a great touch!

Pride:  Upon landing we were greeted by Mary and she helped Marcus with getting us off the plane.  Bottled water or ginger ale was offered and it sure was appreciated.  Marcus asked us to come inside because he had a parting gift for us.  Each of us was presented a CD with the Hawaiian music played on our flight and a color picture that was taken at the beginning of the flight as the jewel case cover.  It was no charge!  A simple gesture that goes a long way in my book, and the kind of thing that will bring me back to them the next time I visit Kauai.

Price:  I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai should you want to take advantage of the spectacular Pali Coast scenery not viewable by land.  Their price is cheaper than several others I checked out, so please call the (808) local number to discuss your adventure of a lifetime.

I have taken many, many excursions through various cruise lines and bar none, this was the best ever in my opinion.  Many thanks to Ellen, Mary and Marcus - and Mary, thank you for bringing me all the way back to the terminal.

An amazing way to experience all the sights of the island. It was breathtaking! Especially the Na Paali coast line! It's a great way to make sure you see all the sights and the views are spectacular. The pilot Mark did a great job, explained everything so well and the ride was very smooth. The customer service was also great!

Friends of ours had recommended this excursion.  We decided to do it the last morning of our NCL cruise.This is a small plane that holds 5 or 6 people.  We took one of the free shuttle jitneys from the cruise port over to the Anchor Cove mini mall which took under 5 minutes. We were picked up there and taken to the airfield. We flew all over Kauai. Got to see the Na Pali coast,  This was such a wonderful experience. Captain Marcus explained everything that we saw.  Just great! Would definitely recommend this.

review_title: Super Flug - super Pilot - super Erlebnis
review_text: Wir haben heute den Rundflug in der Cessna mit unserem 16 Monate alten Mucki gemacht. Unser Pilot war Doug. Doug hat viele interessante Details erwähnt. Wir hatten gute Sicht, konnten unsere GoPro am Flügel für 25 USD montieren und es hat uns allen riesig gefallen! Wir sind etwas über eine Stunde unterwegs gewesen. Immer wieder gerne!! Coole Sache!

review_title: Fantastic way to see Kauai - great service!
review_text:
My wife and I were visiting overnight on the Pride of America cruise, and decided to book the flights based on other very positive Trip Advisor reviews. The views on the flight were spectacular and it was a great way to see the Na Pali coastline and the Grand Canyon of the Pacific! The flight was very smooth and the commentary from our Captain Marcus was great. Highly recommended and arguably better than the more expensive helicopter flights. I particularly enjoyed riding up the front in the co-pilot seat! We were very impressed with the service from the entire team, particularly Ellen on the ground and Marcus. Thank you once again.

Mahalo,

Rob & Silvia - Adelaide Australia

We have friends that now live in Hawaii and they strongly suggested that we take a plane tour of Kauai, rather than a helicopter tour. So we searched and found Wings over Kauai. The commuter terminal where they are located, is about a 5-6 minute walk from the regular airport and Val, who met us at the front desk, could not have been any nicer. She took pictures of us outside the plane before we left. Marcus was our amazing pilot and we got some amazing pictures! Many of these beaches and waterfalls we flew over, you could not reach by car and are not part of the helicopter tours. We were presented with CD's of pictures and a Hawaiian playlist which we really appreciated. I will DEFINITELY recommend this to other friends that are travelling to Hawaii later on this year!

We took the family (ages 2, 5, 8, and two adults) on an afternoon flight, and loved the whole experience. We enjoyed our flight, and the pricing was GREAT. I'm into photography, and got great shots, and the pilot was informational, knowledgeable, and helpful. We'd definitely do this again over a helicopter ride.

Captain Doug is the sweetest person ever. He was so informative and considerate. I have motion sickness and he did his best of avoid turbulence and provide the smoothest ride ever. Because of my motion sickness this was a much better option then a helicopter which I would have surely gotten sick on and it was much, much, more affordable. For the price of just one seat on a six passenger helicopter, my husband and I, both got a private ride on a 2 passenger Cessna. Captain Doug, spent a great amount of time afterwards showing us a map of Kauai and pointing out great hikes and beaches. I loved my experience there and would highly suggest it to anyone who is taking an flying tour of the island. ( And I have not proof of this, but I definitely think it is safer then the helicopters, I heard a lot of rumors on the island of there being tons of helicopters crashes because they take much greater risks then the planes)

We booked our tour for March 17th by calling them directly.  They were very helpful on the phone and gave us a great price.  As we exited the Pride of America cruise ship we walked the 2 blocks to the ABC store (or there is a free shuttle) where we were shuttled by an employee to the airport.  Our pilot, Marcus, was very informative and showed us all parts of the island.  The waterfalls were amazing, the canyons, the shoreline, the Na Pali coastline were easily viewed out the large windows.  Photos I took on my iPhone 6 turned out great!!  The flight was smooth and comfortable.  I highly recommend this excursion to see all the island, most beautifully seen by the air.  I preferred the small plane vs helicopter which we did in Hilo.  Much cheaper and great views.   Top notch and professional. Thank you for a great adventure. 

Mike and Colleen

We booked a private flight, one person in front next to the captain and one behind. Doug explained a lot about the island and it's nature and history. We had clear weather conditions, could see lots of beautiful country sides. We also watched a group of 8 whales, that where kindly spotted by our captain flying an extra round to get a better view. Totally awesome!

My husband and I decided to take a plane tour (as opposed to the many helicopter tours) and I'm so glad we did. This was a great way to see the whole island and the views were awesome. We flew with Captain Marcus and we felt extremely safe the whole time. I loved that we had headsets to be able to talk with everyone during the flight. Unfortunately, my husband got pretty motion sick (he was in the front passenger/co-pilot seat) but Marcus had cold drinks and cool damp towels in the plane for situations like these which helped a great deal. Before we left for our tour we talked with Mary (super sweet!) and Bruce and we absolutely loved them both. They were so personal and had so many great recommendations to offer. Bruce even provided us with a packet of information about his favorite things on the island (sites, trails, restaurants, beaches, etc.) as well as a map with the corresponding locations marked... this was AMAZING and so helpful. I can't say enough about how great everyone was. 

Another thing,... Mary, Bruce, and Marcus remembered our names throughout all of our interactions which really stood out to me. They called us by name any time they were talking with us and it was just a really great little touch :)

review_title: Logged an hour of dual, in paradise.
review_text:
I had the luxury of flying with my teenage son and Bruce this morning. There is NO better way to see the island than from a small plane. Our flight was smooth, well narrated, and the sights are absolutely amazing. Each person we interacted with was professional and fun.

If you are in Kauai, flying with this company specifically, would be a must do!

Ich habe mich intensiv befasst, ob wir einen Helikopter Flug oder einen Cesna machen. Wir haben uns schlussendlich für Wings Over Kauai Cesna Flug entschieden. Wir bereuen keine Sekunde ! Die Firma (Familienunternehmen) scheint seit über 20 Jahren im Business zu sein und die arbeiten mit Herzblut daran, besten Service zu bieten. Der grosse Vorteil zum Helikopterfliegen ist, dass man zu zweit oder zu dritt fliegen kann. die lästige Frage, sitzt man Vorne oder am Fester, erübrigt sich. Der Pilot ist ist sehr freundlich und bezieht eim in das Geschehen (lesen der Sicherheitsinstruktionen etc.) mit ein. Man fliegt etwas höher als der Helikopter, fliegt nich in die Täler rein, hat jedoch den besseren Blick zur Seite und nach unten. Im Helikopter kann es sein, dass man eine Person nebenan hat, die einem die Sicht versperrt oder sehr Massig ist. Wir sind mit unserem 4 Jährigen Sohn geflogen, das Unternehmen ist sehr kinderfreundlich und hilfsbereit. Zum Schluss gibt es noch eine kleine Überraschung ! 
Wir danken dem Team und wünschen alles Gute !!

+ Preis/Leistung 
+ Persönlichkeit
+ Kinderfreundlichkeit
+ gute Flugroute
+ Max. 3 Personen (Cesna)
+ Familienunternehmen 

Negatives gibt es nichts

review_title: Exhilarating plane tour around a beautiful island
review_text: My wife and I did a private tour with Captain Doug on their 3 seat Cessna and we had an awesome time. The 65 minute tour itself allows you to see things on the island of Kauai you just could not see otherwise. Captain Doug was friendly and very informative, giving us a lot of history and local color about the sites we were viewing. We flew over a number of humpback whales with their calves and that was an extra treat. The views of the Napali coast, the waterfalls, canyons and secluded beaches are just breathtaking; photos will not do them justice. We would thoroughly recommend this to anyone visiting Kuaui. You won't be disappointed.
This tour was wonderful. Amazing views of the Na Pali Coast. Saw a while breaching with its calf, etc. Pilot was a great guide. Highly recommended.

This company is first rate. We toured with them a couple of years ago. The pilot, Marcus, was extraordinary and extremely courteous. My young son had a giant hot chocolate right before the flight (not a great idea on my part). Anyway, the poor kid threw up on the flight, but the pilot was so professional and understanding. I wont forget that kindness. He and his assistant were so wonderful when we landed. They wouldn't even let us help clean up. The tour was excellent and took our breathe away. The island is so beautiful. We also learned quite a bit of history. I recommend this tour highly. Very memorable images of the island. They also sell a video of your flight. I recommend that too!

Great way to see Kauai. Marcus was our pilot and was very knowledgeable on all aspects of the island including the hiking, waterfalls, Na Pali coast, finding whales and dolphins. This helped us plan the rest of our stay on Kauai. 

It was easy to ask questions about the island with the headsets. Half the price of a helicopter ride.

It's best option to look around whole island within an hour. The staffs were very kind and everything went well. I have a motion sickness so boat tour is littlebit hard for me because it takes more than 4 hrs. Times fly~I highly recommend this tour to all of you.

Bruce, our pilot, took us on an amazing journey around the island while educating us on Kauai and making us feel safe. He was very professional and personalized the tour to his clients. He even gave us a super secret list of his favorite things to do in Kauai and a special gift at the end. We loved the whole experience from start  to finish and would do it again and again!
Danke an das ganze Team. Die so vorkommend und freundlich sind 👍Marry, Bruce und unserem Pilot Doug!!!!!👍 es war einfach Traumhaft schön. Die Aussicht war unvorstellbar atemberaubend 😊

review_title: Family run, super professional, breathtaking tour.
review_text: We immensely enjoyed our Wings Over Kauai tour. The owner Bruce Coulombe greeted us by name and his daughter Mary was equally friendly running the tour. The take off and landing were incredibly smooth. All passengers had a right sided window seat to enjoy the view.  All charter flights run clockwise around the island with views to your right. Captain Marcus was fantastic, an expert pilot, calm, very knowledgeable narrator. He is also an expert whale spotter and circled around for us to get a great look, very impressive to see groups of whales from above! The Waimea Canyon and Na Pali Coast views were heartbreakingly beautiful. My photos came out great. What a perfect way to see this beautiful island. I couldn't imagine a company doing a better job than Wings Over Kauai, it was a real pleasure.

We took this plane tour of the island and Captain Marcus was great!  He pointed out all the sights below and was very knowledgeable about the island and history.  Very smooth flight and a great way to see the geography of the island.

My husband and I did the Cessna tour today with Wings Over Kauai. This is an amazing trip - we saw waterfalls, canyons, coastline and parts of the island that you can't see from the car. Marcus, our pilot, explained what we were seeing and answered questions. The highlight was Na Pali Coast - it was so incredibly beautiful that I had tears in my eyes. Total thumbs up for Wings Over Kauai - this is a must do when you're on Kauai.

review_title: The Best way to begin a stay on Kauai
review_text:
We landed in Lihue with a good four hours before being able to check into our lodging and decided, upon the recommendation os friends, to spend a portion of that taking an airplane tour of the island. The receptionist at Wings over Kauai had called in sick that morning, so the founder, Bruce, checked us in. What a pleasant, unassuming, personable host. We then met our pilot, Marcus, who got us and one other party of three on board. The next 75 minutes were a dream come true! Immediately after take off, Marcus spotted a pod of five or six humpbacks and radioed for permission to circle the whales not once but three times, giving us a birds-eye view of a breaching humpback!

The rest of the trip was equally as thrilling and improvisatory, as Marcus pointed out major landmarks, filed in with interesting tidbits of ecology, economics, history, all to an evocative soundtrack. The whole experience was incredibly moving!

My husband and I, our two kids (age 8 and 10), and my parents did the airplane tour of Kauai. The woman who checked us in and the pilot were both very friendly. We enjoyed our flight. My daughter felt a little airsick but they had a cooler stocked with ginger ale,. mints, ginger candies, and cold towels which was very helpful. Thank you!

review_title: great views of kauai by air
review_text: We were on a small plane - 4 passengers but room for 6. Great views of the island and our pilot (Marcus) went out of his way to give us the best views. We saw humpback whales from the air and he circled a few times so we could get a great view. Also avoided the heaviest of clouds.  Wonderful trip and I'd highly recommend them.  Our kids did an open door helicopter tour with another company and really enjoyed that too - probably for the more adventurous.

review_title: Amazing tour, cruise and flight lesson too!
review_text: I am a student pilot with abouit 24 hours under the belt. I booked a tour/flight lesson with Capt. Bruce and was also able to bring my wife along in the Cessna 172. The tour aspect was wonderful and the views of the entire island were spectacular. I also enjoyed being able to fly the entire trip and appreciated Bruce's split between tour navigator and flight instructor. It was the best activity I've ever done on a vacation. Don't miss this tour and if you are a pilot or a student pilot, consider the trip in the 172 and you too can be the PIC! Aloha and Mahalo

I passed PPL last year and have been looking forward to coming to Kauai and fly.  Bruce and Wings over Kauai were great.  Bruce did radio work and let me do all the flying with some minor suggestions here and there.  It was an awesome experience and Bruce gave me some useful tips and instruction.  I highly recommend this. Awesome scenery and my wife flew in back seat and got great pictures. I can't wait to get the GoPro video of the flight

We thoroughly enjoyed our Wings Over Kauai flight.  The check-in process was smooth and the staff friendly.  The pilot, Doug, was personable and knowledgeable and, despite some clouds, found ways to show us key sites across Kauai.  Since fog and rain had prevented us from seeing Waimea Canyon the day before, we were especially pleased to see both the canyon as well as the Napali coast.

I don't think I have ever seen such old reviews for anything on TA, but believe me, Wings Over Kauai deserves them. Marcus did a fine job of piloting us around, describing what we saw, and making sure we were all comfortable. I loved seeing the Napali Coast and whales from the air. And thank you to Bruce and the crew for the free CD of Hawaiian music.

Aloha!! Gosh, I only have wonderful things to say about this experience! My brother and I were looking for something adventurous to do and, boy, this was it!! If you want to try something new, different, and adventurous, this is for you! Our pilot, Douglas was super sweet and informed us of so many interesting insights to Kauai's history and rich culture. I learned so much! His wife, Ellen was super sweet and chill as well. We even saw whales!! Yes, whales! And if photography is your thing, this is a great opportunity to get some great shots! Thanks again, Doug, Ellen, and Bruce! You guys are great! This was without a doubt the highlight of my trip! Thank you! Be well.

Wir haben uns für Wings over Kauai aus folgenden Gründen entschieden: super Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis, Kleinkinder/Babys können mit, sehr gute Bewertungen bei TripAdvisor :-) 
Die Entscheidung war sehr gut; Buchung vor Ort direkt nach Ankunft auf Kauai (Lihue ist ein sehr kleiner Flughafen, WoK haben ihre Base wie die meisten anderen Anbieter direkt vor Ort, Mietwagen geholt und schnell hingefahren). Sehr freundliche Mitarbeiter, die geholfen haben den richtigen Tag (abh. von Verfügbarkeit und Wetter) rauszusuchen und Fragen bzgl Kindern beantwortet haben (Tochter 4 Jahre, Sohn 6 Monate). 
Halbe Stunde vor Abflug dort, gewogen, raus zur Maschine, Familienfoto und rein in die Kiste. Der "Airvan" klingt größer als er ist :-) Pilot war Bruce, er ist der Gründer und mit mehr als 7000 Flügen über Kauai kennt er jeden Winkel, er hat dem Flug mit seiner sympathischen und humorvollen Art das i-Tüpfelchen aufgesetzt. 
Wir waren bei strahlendem Sonnenschein unterwegs, allerdings starker Wind, nichts für schwache Mägen. Meine Tochter hat ihr Frühstück in die "Aloha-Tüte" gespuckt und ist dann eingeschlafen. Bei der Landung wollte Sie aber gleich wieder los...Unser Baby hat den Flug übrigens komplett verpennt, hat aber auch nix gekostet. 
Ich kann Wings over Kauai uneingeschränkt empfehlen, wenn man nicht auf einen Heliflug mit offenen Türen besteht, mit kleinen Zwergen unterwegs ist und nicht ein kleines Vermögen für 60-70 Min zahlen möchte. 
Mahalo Mary und Bruce!
Nicolas mit Familie

The very BEST way to see the Na Pali coast! I was apprehensive about the small plane but as soon as we were airborne, I forgot all about it. The ride was smooth and quiet and our pilot was excellent. I highly recommend this trip over the more popular helicopter trips.

Flew with Bruce from the left seat.  Great orientation to a C-172.  Nice tour.  Having done the helicopters, it's a better value to do it with Wings over Kauai.  Got some flight time in my log book on Kauai!  My wife enjoyed the experience.

My husband and I recently flew in the Cessna with Bruce on day 2 of our vacation.  We took the afternoon flight and had amazing lighting on the Na Pali coast for photos.  Bruce was engaging, with plenty of interesting facts about Kaua'i delivered with a great sense of humor.  I would recommend doing this early during your stay, as you'll probably want to visit some of the spots viewed above by car/hike as well.  We liked the Cessna since we wanted a private flight, but know that the Airbus will give you better shots with the bubble windows (allowing you to aim your camera down).  Also, only the Airbus has a mounted camera, so you cannot purchase the video of your own tour if you choose the Cessna.  

They have a great website with online booking available, but Ellen will get back to you right away if you have other questions.  Definitely recommend!
I flew in the Cessna 172 with Bruce. He was great. The aircraft was safe. What more can I say? I didn't check out the helicopters but I'm sure this route is a much better value.

We had a great trip flown by Marcus. After seeing much of the island by hiking and sailing, it was great to so many places from the air. There is so much of the island only visible from the air. He even showed us whales! This is one of the best ways to appreciate how beautiful all of Kauai is. They were also very nice people. We were going to take this tour a few years ago but had a sudden family death. They cancelled without any problem. Thank you Wing over Kauai.

As an aeronautical geek this trip ticked all the boxes for me! Captain Marcus was both a great pilot and tour guide giving us lots of info as we flew around the island and it was fabulous to see views that are inaccessible by any other means.  He did his best to find us some whales but, apart from a very fleeting glance, we were unlucky - but lovely that he tried so hard.  

The whole experience from my initial email exchanges on was seamless.  Having drinks, sweets and cool towels available on the flight was a lovely touch.  As were the photos emailed to us after the flight and the CD of music played during the trip that we were given when we got back to Lihue.

Would I recommend Wings Over Kauai?  Most definitely!!

We hopped on this flight on our first full day on Kauai and it is the only way to do it! You get a great view of the whole island and Marcus, our pilot, was phenomenal. Do yourself a favor and book this tour.

We debated between the fixed wing and a helicopter tour. We are so glad we went with Wings Over Kauai. There were just 4 of us on the flight and it was beautiful. The pilot Marcus was informative and interesting. He flew over all parts of the island pointing out everything, did a few 360 views so everyone could see from all angles, we even saw  some whales. We would definitely recommend them to anyone trying to decide what to do in Kauai.

My husband and I took a tour with Wings over Kauai the day after we got to Kauai and loved it! We got to see some hidden gems, and got some great shots! It allowed us to experience the full island, and plan the rest of our trip accordingly.

review_title: GREAT way to see the island
review_text: We rented out the airbus for our tour and had a fantastic experience overall.  The staff was incredibly friendly from initial phone call through to the end of the flight, particularly our super-experienced and knowledgeable pilot Marcus (a fellow Midwesterner!) and our coordinator Val.  We learned a lot about the island, got to see whales breach up close (Marcus flew close to them whenever we saw them), and the scenery was just breath-taking.  We were waffling on whether or not to take an air tour since we had hiked/driven to see a lot of the island already, and are SO glad we did--it was the highlight of the trip!  Had family that paid 5x more to take a helicopter tour, and I'm not convinced via their stories or pictures that they had a better experience.  This is an activity that is WELL worth the $$ and time and I strongly recommend this company!  Thank you Marcus, Val, and Wings over Kauai!

What a treat!  According to Bruce, our pilot, the day was an 8 out of 10 (and he's never given any day a 10 )so we lucked out on a terriffic day. Gotta thank the Universe for that part.  Headsets made it so great to share info and what we were seeing.  The flight was smooth, and well, just what the doctor ordered.  It was really quiet as well, which I'm not sure the helicopters are.  And after we landed we were each handed a CD with Hawaiian music and on the front covers were photos of ourselves that were taken prior to take off.  Surprising touch and much appreciated.All in all just perfect

review_title: Enjoyable tour of a beautiful island!
review_text: We took this tour (2 of us in the smaller Cessna) a couple of weeks ago and thoroughly enjoyed every moment with our pilot, Bruce, who was very knowledgeable about the island.  We even saw a humpback whale breaching in the ocean below, which was a real treat.  We highly recommend Wings Over Kauai and will definitely take the tour again when we return to Kauai.

We took this tour today with my husband and 7 months&6 years old daughters. The stuff was so friendly, the pilot Bruce was so experienced. He showed every special places in Kauai, we also saw a whale in Napoli Coast ( it was a chance). They took our picture with the airvan and sent it by email which was really nice.

We landed at Lihue and called asking if they could fit us in, and they did.  Sabrina checked us in.  They are absolutely the nicest hosts.  Bruce, the owner and pilot, was of course very knowledgeable of the islands and pointed out all the amazing views and stories behind them.  Soaring over the Napali coast and Waimea Canyon were especially spectacular.  Later in the day we drove to Waimea canyon overlook and quite frankly we had much more incredible views in the plane.   We also saw whales, water falls, and even did a fly over of the other couple's hotel.  Bruce is a very safe and gentle pilot with literally thousands of hours flying around Kauai.   As a private pilot myself, I can attest to his skills.  We did this as soon as we landed which gave us a great overview of the island.  Bruce also gave us a sheet of his recommended places to go and things to see.  Real local knowledge that's gold.  I'm not going to tell you everything because I don't want to over hype it (any more than I already have).  It's a super value at half the price of the helicopter tours and a much more personable experience.  I don't normally write reviews but felt compelled to do so this time.  Highly recommended.

We shared a planeride with 2 others and Marcus (the pilot). The check-in is easy (at the commuter terminal) and very Kauai-like - completely laidback and you are told about the route you will be taking. The flight is about an hour and good value. The plane is small but you have a guaranteed window seat. A word of advice that came to us: don't spend all your time fretting about pictures as you want to be looking out as much as possible. Our pilot had a gentle, easy going manner and it came across in his commentary. It never felt like we were one of many he has done; it was genuine, interesting and through the headphones, felt authentic.
We wondered about when in our trip, to do this tour. We did it at the end and it tied things together nicely especially flying through Waimea to the overlooks, then dipping down to Na'pali and Hanalei. It was meaningful to see where we had driven and been. There are many highlights but the south coast beaches and the water clarity were exceptional. We had some vog that lessened the visibility higher up and then encountered some clouds over the highest mountains over the really wet parts of the island. Highly recommended and good value

We booked the flight over Kauai for my husband, myself and my mother (79 years)
This was a wonderful experience. The island is very pretty with waterfalls, mountains, beaches & the Na Pali coast. The flight lasts about 50 mins and covers a large part of the island including Waimea Canyon. We listened to music and a commentary from our pilot as we flew which added to the experience. He also pointed out specific locations from movies including Jurassic Park.

As we flew along the coast he was great at spotting whales and we even watched a breaching whale for a few minutes.

I cannot compare to the helicopter flight as we have not done this on Kauai but I found the fixed wing flight to be affordable and very enjoyable.

review_title: Great Flight Experience for Pilots Visiting Kauai!
review_text:
If you get a chance to visit Kauai and get the bug to go fly, please check out Wings over Kauai. They offer fixed wing tours of the island in their C-172 or G8 Airvan. Many areas of this island are not accessible by car and can best be seen from the air.
You can simply ride along, look out the windows, or be PIC (in the 172) with CFI-PHD Bruce Coulombe. He has accumulated 7,000 of his 17,000 hours flying around the island and he knows all the good spots to see.

We spent a little over an hour with Dr. Bruce and truly enjoyed the trip. Kauai is not that big. You can cruise along the tour route in the 172 and see everything in about an hour. Tours are operated out of Lihue airport (PHLI) which is class D. The tours are done under VFR. Considerable effort is expended to avoid the extensive air tour traffic by reporting positions at known checkpoints. Tours are also conducted with great sensitivity to minimizing noise to residents as there are extensive helicopter air tours of the island.
Our C-172 experience was 1/2 the price of a rotary wing tour. We got to see some spectacular scenery and it was a bonus to have 1.1 in the logbook as PIC in Kauai. We highly recommend Wings over Kauai.
Ted & Cindy

This was the most amazing trip ever! At one point I even got teary-eyed, just looking out at that amazing beauty!!  The pilot was amazing: the smoothest flying, takeoff & landing!  I had the 'barth' bag on my lap, just incase, but was pleasantly surprised that I didn't even get the slightest bit of motion sickness! This was definitely worth doing!!

review_title: Best tour we did in Kauai!
review_text:
My wife and I recently went to Kaua'i for our honeymoon.

We read about the air tours vs catamaran tours, and since they have a combo package we decided to do both. But, if I had to do one, I'd probably go for the air one.

Everything with them went smooth, they were super friendly and very professional.
They day of our tour the weather was not the best, and they gave us the option to reschedule, but we decided to do it anyway. After we took off, the clouds cleared up and we had spectacular views of the island, with the rainbow following during the entire trip!

Marcus our pilot was super cool and friendly, he was alway making sure we were all having the best views. Plus, he was super knowledgeable on Hawaiian history and its geology. 

We really enjoyed this tour, it was one of the highlights of our trip!
Bruce was our pilot and was very welcoming. It was a beautiful way to see the island.  Well worth it.  We saw the whole island.

review_title: Fantastic 1 hour air tour of the beautiful island of Kauai
review_text: I took this trip with my wife and 3 kids. We were met promptly by the friendly staff and taken to the airport for a safety briefing and weigh-in. We had the plane to ourselves, which meant there was one spare seat. One of my sons is a nervous flier, but he was totally relaxed by the calm confidence of our pilot, Marcus, who gave us a good commentary of everything we could see, which was a lot given that we all had great window seats. The views were stunning - no other word for it! Marcus explained everything through the headset system, and we could all use it to talk to each other which the kids loved. The hour passed very quickly, and I was surprised when we sighted the airport and were told it was time to land. All in all, a great trip and I would highly recommend it!!
I loved this flight. It was very relaxing, the scenery simply stunning, staff very relaxed and friendly and knowledgeable. We had great weather luckily and felt the flight was great value

My two sisters and I planned a lovely, activity filled Christmas in Kauai. We picked this company for our air tour because of the great reviews. Although the flight was nice (Marcus was our pilot) I must comment on the reception and behavior we encountered from Bruce and Abi. We arrived early to an empty lobby area, well over the 30 minutes you are instructed to arrive. We could see out the back windows to the tarmac and noticed that one of the company's planes had just landed. It was the smaller 4-seater plane; a couple had since arrived and told us they had a two o'clock flight. They ended up leaving without taking their flight tour after a conversation with Bruce. We knew another couple was with us which meant that we would be in the larger 6-seater plane at 2:30. I watched a lady (whom I now know as Abi) placing blocks under the wheels of the plane and the pilot climb out of the plane then I moved away from the window further into the lobby to talk to one of my sisters. As we stood talking, the pilot (whom I now know as Bruce) came in through the door and saw us standing there. The expression on his face was not only off-putting, his actions were the same. He didn't speak or say hello at all, just paused scowled and kept walking. In fact, his demeanor was such that both my sister and I looked at each other in askance. As African-Americans we are the both of us very aware, observant and sensitive to our surroundings and peoples' energy. I was glad that he was NOT our pilot. Later as Abi was explaining emergency in-flight procedures to us, correction, to my two sisters; it was as if I didn't exist. She didn't bother to look at me or include me in that conversation. I am 6 feet tall but I was standing directly behind them in a little huddle. It was incredibly rude and disrespectful of her to treat me in such a manner and I let her know. Later there was an issue of seating arrangements in the plane which I think could have been handled differently. I have extremely long legs and was put in a middle seat when the back row seat by the door had no middle seat in front of it. I had to stretch my left leg out across the aisle of the plane to even fit there. I have flown in many small airplanes before. My ex-husband was a private pilot and flight instructor so I am aware and understand how weight and balance works. I will say that Marcus was polite, professional and his landing was one of the softess I've ever experienced. he would do well to brush up on his knowledge of the pine tree was on the island...We're going back to Kauai again but we will not be giving these people our business. I did not feel at all welcome or like they wanted or appreciated our business, unfortunate but true....

We visited in early December and while the weather was not ideal we did manage to fit in a flight. We waited until the last day when the weather seemed like it might cooperate. No problem booking the flights online and we had excellent customer service when checking in. Bruce flew the two of us in the cessna. Visibility was low and we did have to reroute and not see the canyon but he still managed to take us out to Napali which is what we were most interested to see. Bruce was knowledgeable but still very easy going. You didn't feel like you were in a classroom. 
I tend to get motion sickness in cars but didn't have any issues with the plane even though their were some bumps and dips. They are very good about sharing tips with you to limit any discomfort. They even had little bottles of water and some essential oils in a cooler in the back that you can use. All in all, fun experience!

Did this tour with Brian our first day on the island and so glad we did.  He's very knowledgeable about everything island related.  Saw just about everything the island has to offer from the air.  Gave us great advice on what beaches to go to and what should be a "not miss" to visit while on the island.  If you are considering an aerial tour of the island, you should definitely check them out!

My wife and I definitely like to relax on vacation and aren't always up for tours and activities. After reading the great reviews we decided to book the Wings Over Kauai flight. We were a little nervous because we had never been in a small plane before, but as soon as we checked in and got set up in he plane with our pilot, all of that went out the door! Everything was great from start to finish. The whole process is really fun and exciting, and the views of the island from the air are insane. The pilot was great, and the tour guiding was informative and interesting. When we got to the Napali Coast, he noticed some humpback whales playing and he made a couple of loops around so we could see them. It was incredible! All in all it's definitely worth the time and price. We loved it.

review_title: Highly recommended sightseeing flight over Kauai
review_text: We do highly recommend this sightseeing flight over the island of Kauai. Bruce, the pilot, is highly skilled, very personable and experienced in his trade. We booked with Ellen, his wife, and the communication was great from the very beginning. We felt well taken care of before we even arrived on the island. It is a small, family-run company, and they go out of their way to show you a good time. We were there on a very windy day, and felt completely safe at all times. Bruce is very accommodating and responsive to the needs of his passengers. We had beautiful views of Kauai and saw the beautiful Napali Coast line which can only be seen like this from the air. Also, the price for the flight is highly competitive. Bruce is very klowledgeable about the island and his narration was very informative. All in all we highly recommend this tour. Do yourselves a favour, when you are in Kauai, and take a tour with this company. If we ever go back to Kauai, we would take this tour a second time, as we enjoyed it so much! Thank you, Ellen & Bruce for a very memorable experience.

review_title: Thrilling and Scenic Air Tour Company
review_text: We really enjoyed our experience with our pilot and tour guide (apologies forgot his name). The checkin process was simple. We could get good views of Napali coast, Jurassic Falls and other attractions around the island. Would definitely recommend this tour for families, couples and friends. We were also given a surprise gift at the end of the tour. Now I don't want to spoil it for you. But the gift is well worth the wait  !

review_title: Fantastic way to see the Island and a visiting pilot's dream flight!
review_text: A highlight of my time on Kauai! Whenever I travel, I like to explore new places from the air by grabbing a local flight instructor and plane and flying around. Wings Over Kauai was really easy to schedule a flight and get to. Upon arrival the staff and pilot were both very friendly. There was some rain on and off and the staff was happy to reschedule if we wanted. Our schedule was tight so we opted to do a modified flight. The pilot worked with us to put together a safe trip that worked around the weather and was still amazing. My wife--who does not always enjoy small plane rides--loved this trip and captured some fantastic photos. If not a pilot, small plane is a great way to sight see and more affordable than helicopters.

As I a student pilot, took the opportunity to take both a tour and instructional flight in one go around the island for me and my partner. 
Was great weather for it, got to be  see the garden island, and Bruce was great tour guide, pilot and instructor. 
Great value for money for a tour flight. 

Recommend it as both a tour flight, and also a student pilot on holiday.

user_location: Chapel Hill, North Carolina, United States
review_title: A brilliant way to see the Kauai
review_text:
While we were on vacation in Kauai we wanted to see as much of the island as possible and, as I’m a pilot, looked for an opportunity to fly and sight-see from a fixed wing aircraft. Helicopters are ok but they can be a bit of a nuisance for people on the ground. Plus Bruce’s Cessna 172 is a much less expensive way to do this.  We arranged (before we left home in North Carolina) to take an island tour via dual flight instruction from Bruce Coulombe of Wings Over Kauai. We met Bruce’s colleague at Lihue airport and she did a short briefing and the weight and balance. Bruce then showed us around the aircraft and we climbed aboard. After a thoroughly professional preflight and engine start/run up we were ready to go. My wife was in the back and I had the right seat – for a better view of the island. We were cleared for take off from runway 3 and immediately after lift-off could see the beautiful island spread out below, and as it happened the resort where we were staying.  We flew along the coast and Bruce – who has lived on the island for a long time, initially while working as a scientist for a big agriculture company and then for the next few thousand hours of flying around Kauai – pointed out the places we were flying over. Basically for the next 50 minutes this included all of the island highlights, and Bruce’s comments and background information made this a data-rich tour. When we were approaching Lihue airport, we had to do a 360 because of departing traffic, and then were cleared to land on runway 3. 
This was a brilliant way for us to see the island, as well as for me to get 1.1 hours unforgettable instruction for the logbook. The helicopter tours may be ok for passengers, but believe us, Bruce’s tour will stay with you – a pilot – as one of the best flights ever, and especially if you get the dvd of the flight for an accurate record with all the details. And with money you save flying with Bruce rather than doing a helicopter tour, you could have dinner for the next 3 nights at the Bamboo Grill and Sushi overlooking the bay at Lihue. What a great day!
Aloha and mahalo Bruce.

Thank you Abi and Captain Bruce for the amazing experience! We had a blast! Kauai is definitely one of the most beautiful places on Earth and it was such a pleasure to see it all from up above. Thank you for the great and smooth flight! Really made our day!

review_title: Schönstes Erlebnis auf den Hawaii- Inseln
review_text: Die Buchung, der Shuttle vom Schiff zum Flughafen und nicht zuletzt der Flug mit Bruce waren fantastisch. Wir können den Rundflug mit Wings over Kauai nur weiterempfehlen.

It was a fantastic experience- we had a private tour with the fantastic, wonderful and experienced pilot Douglas.

It was a pleasure flying with him and it was very pleasant

The price is also quite reasonable- security is important for them

Top recommendation

About a 70" trip around Kauai. Stunning and gorgeous views. Well narrated by our pilot Bruce. Family run business. Much cheaper than helicopter tours and more personal. Headphones to hear Pilots narrative and talk w/other passengers. Well worth the money-GO!!

review_title: Wings over Paradise, a must do on Kaui
review_text: Our first try at this tour was wisely rebooked by our pilot Doug due to wind conditions. A true statement Wings Over Kauai places safety first. Our second date was far from disappointing as conditions were fantastic. Doug was able to show us areas of picturesque beauty he stated he only views a few times each year. This is a great way to see all of Kauai not available by ground. Thanks Doug and Mary.
Super friendly pilot and staff. We had a lovely time with Bruce. The flight was very smooth. our pilot told us a lot about Kauai. Definitely recommend it!

Dehär är det flyg du vill boka om du är på Kauai. Wings over Kauai är ett litet familjeföretag med hjärtat på rätt plats. De gör allt för sina kunder så att flygturen verkligen blir till en speciell upplevelse, och det är värt sitt pris. Du kommer aldrig att uppleva och se samma saker enbart på land. Var försiktig med att boka flyg med andra företag, det är alltid lika svårt att veta vem man kan lita på speciellt som turist, men dehär företaget kan jag verkligen rekommendera varmt.

Doug,
Thank you for blessing us during two big occasions we celebrated while in Hawaii--anniversary and birthday. We had a great time and we appreciate your flawless piloting skills and for "steering" us in the right direction to capture the most breathtaking photos. "I can't breathe!"  
This is a must do while in Kauai. Excellent customer service--Mary!! Mary, Thank you for waiting for us and being reflexible with flight time! Thanks again for the memories

This was the best thing we did during our visit to Kauai. From the beginning to the end Wings over Kauai was a class act. Marcus our pilot was awesome and extremely careful with safety. Marcus is a very knowledgeable pilot.The viewfrom 4500 feet of the island is amazing.

What a treat this flight was!  Our pilot Marcus made all of us feel safe as he handled the plane expertly. He gave us a tour of the island and noted points of interest along the way.  It was fun having the earphones and microphones so we could talk easily in the plane.  Bruce and Ellen made us feel right at home as soon as we got there.  I would go back to Wings over Hawaii anytime!!!

review_title: My experience with these guys was 100% above par in every way!
review_text: Holy guacamole, Kauai is beautiful! But seeing it from the air takes it to a whole 'nother out of this world level! Heavenly, incredibly lush & so very green, all the waterfalls, the blue skies, the blue water, the incredible cliffs of the Na Pali, whales breaching ... just wow! I wanted to cry with all the beauty! Thank you Wings Over Kauai for an incredible, unforgettable, thoroughly enjoyable, & educational experience that I'll never forget! My experience with you guys was 100% above par!!

Always on my bucket list to go up in a helicoptor.  So glad I chose Blue Hawaiin and experienced this in Kauai. Customer service and pilot made me very comfortable.  With the ear muffs on, I felt like I was floating on air across paradise.

Ok so I'm visiting from the Uk and want to see as much as possible so. Flight it is now I've done helicopter trips sometimes a bit too quick so this was to be a flight in a small aircraft 8 seats only and if your picked your up front ( no you don't have to fly it ;-) ) 

We were picked up from the port as we arrived via Princess cruise around the Hawaii islands and taken to the airfield where we were weight as to be safe and a safety briefing before been taken out to our aircraft.

You may have seen this type of aircraft before as its used mainly in the Australian outback for short take off and landings think ( flying doctors) 

We greeted by our pilot a lovely youngish man about 30 ?? With quite a lot of experience who gave us a running commentary as to the island and very useful information.
The trip lasted about 1 hr and was breathtaking and worth every dollar.

Many thanks for the Emailed photos of our trip and the music CD I'm writing this while it plays so.

Mahalo  a hui hou 

Best wishes Kevin&Debbie Saddler

Bruce and Ellen, owners of the business, make sure you have a memorable experience.  On the morning we had originally scheduled, it was raining on the south and north ends of the route.  They gave us the option of rescheduling for better viewing, which we appreciated - thus the recommendation to schedule your flight early in your trip.  They have two planes.  We chose the Cessna, which had space just for the two of us and the pilot.  We went around the island, down the east side which included the locations for several movies, around the south, up near the Jurassic Park waterfalls which is on private property, up Waimea Canyon, then the Na Pali Coast on the east side.  I thought the Na Pali Coast would be the highlight, but actually enjoyed the final turn through the interior of the island best.  Up the Hanalei Valley and through the Volcano Crater than created this island - simply stunning.  So much of this beautiful island is inaccessible that seeing it by air is not only the preferable, but only way to see it.  There are numerous helicopter and plane companies that do this tour.  We chose a plane because my husband gets motion sickness and planes tend to be less bumpy.  We chose this company because of its reviews.  We were not disappointed.
Wir können den Rundflug nur empfehlen. Die Abwicklung war perfekt. Der Flug hat über eine Stunde gedauert und wir haben dabei die ganze Insel gesehen.....unbedingt machen !!
My husband and I did the "Cessna" tour.  It was really fun to see Kauai from above.  Our pilot and tour guide Marcus was very good and gave us a good overview of Kauai.  Highly recommended!

review_title: Absolutely breathtaking! Weather was amazing for us!
review_text: The flight was on a perfect day, with slight breeze, clouds at 2600' and it was smooth sailing at 2500'! What a beautiful flight with amazing scenes! A must do on Kauai!

We had a great time up in the air and the customer service is outstanding.  If you are thinking of looking at ariel views of Kauai this is your ride.  It was a smooth ride thought out our trip.  Give it a try and you will want to return for more......

We booked online day before our plane tour. It was very convenient. The owner, Bruce was very helpful & personally took care of everything for us to feel comfortable during our trip. They have water/cold towels & ginger ales aboard just in case some gets airsick. Luckily I'm used to riding small planes & i did not have use those. He gave us tips of things to do & where to eat around the island. Pilot Markus was our personal tour guide as well. He was very knowledgeable & answered my 100+ questions. The best part? Amazing birds eye view of the island! We'll do it again.

I've been going to the island for many years and have been on a number of aerial tours.  I brought my 80-year-old mother to the island this time and told her she could only truly see the island by air.  Though she was hesitant about flying in a small plane, she was absolutely delighted with this tour and she said it was the best part of her trip. Mahalo to our great pilot, Doug - very informative and a pleasure to fly with!

This was an incredible way to see the parts of Kauai only accessible by air. Our party of four had the plane to ourselves and it was a terrific flight. The weather was perfectly clear, which we were told was uncommon, making the scenery that much prettier!  Our pilot, Marcus, was so knowledgeable about the island. I have done the same trip by helicopter but this was far more enjoyable. Do yourself a favor and book this trip!

Wir wurden sehr herzlich empfangen und die nächste Stunde wurde durchgesprochen. 
Vom Flugplatz aus flogen wir über Kipu Kai, Na Pali coast, Waimea Canyon, tropical waterfalls and Hanalei Bay zurück zum Lihue Airport. Es war ein wunderbares Gefühl da oben zu schweben. 
Genug Möglichkeiten zum fotografieren und filmen.
Werden gerne wieder mit Kauai Air Tours mitfliegen.

Our flight over the island was AMAZING!!!  Are family of 6 had a great time including our 4 year old.  We saw so much in the hour plane ride.  We loved the beaches, mountains and especially the crater and waterfalls.  It was WELL WORTH every penny spent!!!

This was the most beautiful view of any land/water I've seen in my life! It was comfortable and informative throughout the ride but all that was overshadowed by the breathtaking images. I'm still in awe of the beauty.

Wings over Kauai is family owned and operated including the precious 4 legged family members☺️ They go the extra mile to make sure it is a fabulous experience!  I met two of the pilots and had Bruce as pilot for ours.   He was very knowledgeable about the island and very attentive to each and every passenger that was on the flight!  I Highly recommend Wings over Kauai if you are seeking an experience of a lifetime. The sweet gift from the pilot to all the ladies is precious!
