We we´re on Hawaii for our honeymoon and went down to kauai hoping to see it from the sky. We took the Cessna tour, which is a private tour for two. Bruce, the pilot, was very kind and knowledgeable!
We would recommend this tour to anybody visiting the island!!

Um Kauai erleben zu wollen, ist ein Rundflug unbedingt notwendig!
Wir haben uns für den Anbieter "Wings over Kauai" entschieden und nicht bereut! Mit der kleinen Cessna für 4 Personen ging es pünktlich 10:30 Uhr los. Bruce, der Inhaber, war unser Pilot und wir haben uns sehr wohl und aufgehoben gefühlt. 60 Minuten ging der Flug, der uns alle wichtigen Sehenswürdigkeiten von Kauai gezeigt hat. Mit witzigen Anekdoten, vielen Tipps und wundervollen Bildern ging der Flug viel zu schnell vorbei. Man merkt schnell das das Familienunternehmen die richtige Wahl war. Hier steht das persönliche Miteinander an erster Stelle. Wir können diesen Anbieter auf jeden Fall empfehlen!

review_title: Aerial tour worth your time and money!
review_text:
This is our first visit to Kauai.  My wife and I decided to take this aerial tour (two of us with Bruce as the pilot/tour guide) instead of helicopter tour for two reasons.  First, we have the Cessna 172 to ourselves, and it gives me the opportunity to fly the plane (I am a certificated commercial pilot) and learn about mountain flying from Bruce.  Second, it is considerably less expensive than a helicopter ride (and sharing the ride with several others) of the same duration (70 minutes).

The aerial tour goes through all the scenic spots, some of which are simply unreachable by car.  The majestic views of the mountains (especially the Waimea canyon) and the waterfalls are best appreciated from the air.  Bruce spent 7000 flight hours (out of his 13,000) flying around these islands.  No wonder he is so knowledgeable about Kauai.  He has this calm demeanor that would put non-flyers at ease.  I would fly with Bruce any day.  He is a first-rate pilot and tour guide.  We will no doubt drop by Wings Over Kauai and check in with Bruce the next time we come through Kauai!

If you are going to do just one thing in Kauai (apart from the beaches of course), book this!! This was our second excursion with wings over Kauai, this time with more family. Although the kids (3 and under 1) didn't fly so well and fell asleep the rest of us thought it was brilliant. Knowledgable pilot and very friendly staff. Excellent pre and post trip communications and very good value for money. Trip lasted just over an hour! Highly highly recommend!!

I am a very anxious flyer but wanted to see the Na Pali coast badly so I booked a private tour in the Cessna.  Bruce was our pilot and he was excellent at giving the tour and making me feel at ease.  I get very bad motion sickness and have a phobia of planes but I would do this again in a heartbeat.  Despite stronger than average winds the day of our flight, it was the smoothest flight (and landing)I have ever experienced thanks to Bruce flying a slightly altered route for us.

review_title: Great trip, lots of interesting info and views
review_text: Bruce was our pilot and guide. He put us at ease very quickly and was very informative. He made us feel like an old friend. He is also very knowledgeable about the island, it's attractions and it's crops. Thanks

I have been in a few helicopters and was keen to try a different way of experiencing Hawaii. I couldnt have chosen a better option than Wings Over Kauai. The whole outfit is family run. The daughter welcomed us at the airport and offered us local ginger candies for motion sickness.

The seats in the plane are comfortable. All seats are window seats in the Cessna which is great because with helicopters, you may not get a window seat due to weight distribution in a light aircraft (even though the price is the same for every passenger in a helicopter). You even get a selection of drinks in the plane from a little cooler box. 

Bruce did a great job of making everyone feel at ease while showing us the best of Kauai. I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai for a reasonably-priced, family-run and excellent experience!

Wir hatten uns für den Rundflug mit der kleinen Cessna entschieden und es war ein einmaliges Erlebnis! Pilot Bruce ist sehr erfahren (>6.000 Flüge), humorvoll, hat alles super erklärt und gab uns von anfang an ein gutes Gefühl. Als "Kopilot" durfte ich beim Precheck helfen und wurde am Ende für mein "magic landing without hands" gelobt, meine Frau übernahm hinten den "Bordservice" durch öffnen des Coolers für kleine Wasserflaschen. Die Cessna ist das mit Abstand kleinste Flugzeug mit dem wir jemals geflogen sind und wir waren erstaunt wie ruhig der Flug war, wenig Wackler, kein Sorge dass einem dabei schlecht wird. Warum man unbedingt Kauai von oben sehen sollte, dazu gibt es ja genügend Beschreibungen hier, es ist definitiv traumhaft schön. Und am besten mit WIngs over Kauai, zu einem sehr fairen Preis!

This is the most fun and professional experience you could expect from a small family-owned operation. It's an amazing value too. 

Bruce is as excellent a pilot as he is a tour narrator. He's understated and friendly, calm and interesting. No sham-wow blubbery. He made my family feel totally safe and comfortable so we could focus on the incredible scenery. We loved everything about it. 

If you need any more convincing, consider this: WOKAT is comprised of a family of four who are running a local business really well. They are good, friendly people who offer an awesome vacation experience at a fair price.

review_title: Highly recommend the instructional flight if your interested in flying at all
review_text: My first time in a light plane and Bruce did a great job with both the first time instruction as well as a tour of the island. You don't need any previous flying knowledge, and if you are interested in just having some fun steering an airplane I highly recommend booking an instructional flight. The views were great, and it was so cool flying into a tower controlled airport.

My wife and I were in Hawaii and decided to fly over the Napali coast while in Kauai on April 2nd. After researching our options we settled on  Wings Over Kauai Air Tours. It turned out to be the highlight of our entire trip. Josh was our pilot and he was not only a skillful, well-qualified pilot, but so knowledgeable on what everything was that we were seeing and telling us stories of what movies were filmed in different locations. We flew to the south toward Poipu then turned to the north and flew across Kauai toward Waimea Canyon. Josh described all the sights below. After passing Waimea we came across to the ocean at the top of the Napali coast and flew all along in amazement of the beauty that was passing below. We were all seated on the right side of the plane so it made viewing everything so easy. It was a very clear sunny day and words cannot describe the beauty of the coastline. The hour-long flight went by so quickly and we didn't want it to end. Everyone at Wings Over Kauai were so friendly whether making a reservation, getting our preflight orientation,  talking to the pilot, etc. We even met their dog who hangs out there. First class operation from the ground to the air. We highly recommend using them to see Kauai.

The air tour of Kauai was fantastic. I was initially a little hesitant flying in a small plane but that was quickly overcome. The pilot's commentary with interesting tidbits of information just made the sights even more spectacular. I would recommend this trip to anyone.

Awesome adventure! Family run business they were warm, welcoming & very knowledgable. If your looking @ options for flight tours hands down this is the one you want!! We did a private tour & Josh was our pilot he knows the island! Ellen & Caitlin were wonderful @ getting us set up & ready for take off. Thank ya'll very much for everything!!

We enjoyed our trip on 3/24/16 with our pilot Bruce.  He was very informative and provided us with a very scenic tour of Kauai.  The whole experience was very professional.  The trip took about an hour and we saw all of the island and Bruce was able to answer all our questions.  We both said later that this was our favorite part of our visit to Kauai.  You will not be disappointed!
Dan and Carie from Bentonville, AR

My husband is an experienced pilot with over 5000 hours. I thought he would not like being able to fly the plane on his own as another pilot from the tour must go with you.As it turned out he loved it! The tour guide pilot manned the radio while my husband flew the plane. It helped because the tour pilot knew where to go and pointed out the sites as we flew over. It was the highlight of our trip to Kauai. When and if we come back, we will be sure to do this again. 
    Since we have been back I have heard my husband talk about the trip with his pilot/students and I can tell he really enjoyed the flight
I really enjoyed being able to fly as a pilot with an excellent instructor and tour guide. Would do it again in a heartbeat. Thanks

There are so many reasons to go with WOK vs. a helicopter tour. But the top reasons are:

1. Personalized service!! We chose to do the small cessna tour for my husband and I, along with our 9 mo old daughter. We got a private tour with Capt. Bruce. If we had booked a helicopter tour, we would have been sitting on top of other strangers. We also received a FREE digital picture in front of the plane before the tour. Most companies would charge you for this type of thing. 

2. Price - for half the cost of a helicopter tour, WOK is really a great bang for your buck! We also appreciated the fact that we didn't have to pay for our daughter either.

I would without a doubt recommend this tour for anyone! Save your money and go with WOK. You won't regret it at all. 

Tip: Book this at the beginning of your time on Kauai just in case the weather is less than ideal to fly. We did this and I am glad we did because we had a lot of flexibility when the fog was really bad one day.

I want to congratulate Bruce and Carter for the exceptional customer service they provided my family and I. We did the tour on a day that wasn't best to fly because of some clouds, but Bruce still made sure we got the best views of the island. Great pilot and tour guide! Will def do this tour again with them!
I think that everything about this tour was amazing except there was high winds and at times I got nervous, which we were warned about previously, otherwise I would have given it 5 stars.

review_title: Highly Recommended. Serene view of Kauai
review_text: It was an wwesome experience. The whole crew was super friendly and very experienced. Its much cheaper than the helicopter ride and I would say a must have experience. It goes around the island through one of the most picturesque locations

I did a lot of shopping around before I booked with Wings Over Kauai, and I am so glad I booked with them! I really thought that the small place (we did the private 2 person Cessna flight) was the way to go over a crowded helicopter for double the price. The owner was our pilot and his daughter checked us in and got us ready...they were both nice as could be and very eay to deal with when deciding whether or not to go due to sketchy weather. We took his advice and went as scheduled and did not regret it. It is hard to find a day without some kind of weather (wind or some rain) in the winter, but he avoided the areas with low clouds and we saw everything that we wanted to see. We purchased the video for $50 and LOVE IT. They piece it together in house and we picked it up a couple fo days after the flight instead of having to pay $5 for shipping. It is over an hour of perfect footage from the wing and even some bits inside the plane--what a memory. You will not regret booking with this awesome family!

review_title: Wonderful flight and exceptional customer service
review_text: Our family of four (two adults, a toddler, an infant) thoroughly enjoyed our tour in the Cessna. Captain Bruce's insights made for a great commentary. Customer service was exceptional from the first email enquiry: they sent us detailed pictures of aircraft interiors to help us decide amongst the options, and did not charge us for the kids.

We were looking for things to do in Kauai and read an article about Wings Over Kauai. I have been on helo tours before but this "fixed wing" tour was highly rated. There were just the 4 of us on the plane (us and our traveling friends). Bruce the owner was also the pilot. It was a fantastic tour. Bruce has been in Kauai a long time and knew everything we asked him. We traveled over Waimea Canyon and the Na Pali coast......what spectacular views. We were going to drive the canyon the next day but cancelled that because we could not possibly see from the ground what we saw from the air!

Being a lifelong pilot, adding a new state with a landing & takeoff as PIC (Pilot-In-Command) is a big deal to me.
So when the wife and I decided to vacation in HI and specifically Kauai, I started researching the possibility of renting an aircraft to fly around the island.That is when I discovered Wings Over Kauai & owner Bruce Coulombe.
It turned out to be a great choice and when we finally got to fly (had to re-schedule due to very high winds on the original day we planned to fly) all went smoothly. Bruce handled the radio and acted as our guide while I did the piloting on our circumnavigation of the island in his Cessna 172.
In all we flew just over an hour, saw some breathtaking scenery and added the 35th state (and the hardest one to get) to my logbook.
If you're a pilot, go to Kauai and don't take the opportunity to fly around the island with Bruce and Wings Over Kauai well......your truly missing out on an experience of a lifetime.
Can't wait to see the movies from the Go-Pros attached to the airplane during our flight !!

review_title: Awesome experience - all the reviews are correct!
review_text: Very happy with our choice to go with Wings Over Kauai - the price is reasonable and the folks are friendly and knowledgable - these people clearly love what they do.  Ride was surprisingly smooth despite very windy conditions on the day we took our tour.  We certainly didn't regret choosing fixed wing over helo...  We thought about taking a land tour of the island, but didn't like the idea of being stuck in a bus for 10 hours… See it all from the air in an hour or so - highly recommended!

Wings Over Kaua'i gave us a wonderful view of the island. We liked flying over the whole island - not limited to just parts of it, as most helicopter tours do. Val checked us in and she was very helpful in explaining what to expect and where the tour would fly.  Bruce was our pilot, and made us very comfortable.  His knowledge of Kaua'i was a treat.  We're happy to recommend this tour.

We booked this from home as we wanted to be sure and get great views of Kauai since so much of it is not driveable.  Bruce was a great host for this terrific excursion- answering our questions and showing us the unique spots to Kauai.  Small plane and reasonable prices- more stable ride than a helicopter.  Would highly recommend
Marcus was our pilot- He did an amazing job. All the reviews are correct- best tour on Kauai. Definitely worth the time and money on your trip to Kauai.

It was such a great experience dealing with the Wings over Kauai team from the initial contact to the flight 6 months later. Bruce and his son Carter made the day of flight a memorable one, and as a pilot I appreciate their focus on safety and creating a memorable experience. 
This is a must do on Kauai. Forget the helicopters. Save some $ and call Wing Over Kauai. You will never forget the incredible experience in their well qualified hands.
We'll be back next year for a month, and I will be calling Bruce to  get some lessons on hi wind mountain flying  and another tour around the beautiful island of Kauai. Great job everyone!

review_title: You must take the Wings over Kauai sight seeing trip it's the best!
review_text:
Wings over Kauai are the friendliest and most professional company you can book your trip with. I emailed various companies which provide this service and Ellen was the first to respond back, she answered all my questions via email, so helpful friendly, and because of her personal touch I decided to book with Wings, I am so glad I did. I had a wonderful flight. Carter checked me in and Captain Marcus was our pilot, he was so knowledgable about the island and a great pilot, I felt quite safe, seeing the helicopters buzzing in out and about during the trip I am glad I went fixed wing! Wings do a DVD of your flight let them take the pictures and compile a DVD format of your choice, there is so much to see and the scenery is stunning, you will miss so much being behind your own lens! I would highly recommend wings and they deserve 5* plus. Thank you to everyone at 'Wings over  Kauai' for a great morning and for looking after me so well. 
You can even book with Wings and fly yourself over the island, check that option out, even if you haven't flown before! I wish I had done that!

FYI - and Nothing to do with wings! but If you are a solo traveller and/or not driving then the taxi fares to get out to this side of Lihue airport from Koloa are something to factor in $50 each way or thereabouts with tip! But it's worth every penny to see the island from a different perspective!

My husband and I (and our three year old) had a fantastic tour of the island with Wings Over Kauai.  At half the cost of a helicopter tour and much longer, we thought it was a great value.  But more important than the cost was the personal experience we got from Mary and Bruce.  Bruce (our pilot) gave us a great tour of the island, including a short side trip to find whales (which we did).  The Napali is simply breathtaking.  Words can't express just how beautiful this side of the island is.  If you're in Kauai, you must take an air tour and definitely consider taking one with Wings Over Kauai.  You won't be disappointed.

review_title: Bruce and his team are really great
review_text: We chose our flight with wings over kauai in the cessna because it promised to be a private experience for us as a couple - with great views for both of us (which with other offers was not guaranteed - neither in planes nor in helis). It indeed turned our to be the highlight of our visit, providing us with views that especially on Kauai are only accessible by air. Bruce's expertise and experience as a pilot allowed us to enjoy even the windy weather during the flight. He showed and explained to us all the places of interest and gave us worthwhile recommendations for our further journey and stay on Kauai. We certainly got great value for the price we paid. Our picture, taken in front of the plane was included and the video of the flight was 40$ (no pressure). We recommend Bruce and Wings over Kauai 100 %.

Bruce, the pilot, was very fun and nice! He told us so much about the Island and could answer every question we had. 
He also gives good advises how to be comfortable in the plane in case you are air sick.
It was absolutely fantastic, especially for this price! I paid 130 Dollar and did my flight at 1 pm. 
Would do it again!!
It's worth ist!

Simply no one could charge a price that is equal to the experience with these folks.  From the beginning of registering online and then my calling, "Wings Over Kauai," it has been so much more beneficial than I could have imagined. Ellen was full of spontaneous energy, responding with all kinds of additional help, photos and ideas beyond our flight booking!. At the check in desk is a really interesting and interested woman, Val and I am glad that she shared some of her personal story with the Island and her job, responding to our interests.  Bruce, the pilot is one of those exceptional, rare birds, who possesses so much life talent.  His flight skills are superb, narration is keyed to the folks in the plane, not a canned speech. We were so fortunate the time and date of our flight to have spectacular rare views of nature's phenomena and our pilot was thrilled too. If you are interested in people too, his story of the family journey to this endeavor is truly inspiring.

review_title: Soaring Spectacle with Kauai Air Tours
review_text: Just returned from a week on Kauai.  We began our week-long stay with an air tour with Wings Over Kauai.  Simply sensational!  The views are haunting and the ride peaceful as we soared along the Napali coast, the southern coast and into the interior of the island, including Waimea Canyon.  Great overview of the island.  Our guide and pilot, Marcus, was informative, entertaining without being intrusive, and always committed to our comfort and safety.  We are in our seventies and will do this again.  Thank you, Marcus and Kauai Air Tours.

This was a great flight.  It was slightly windy and bumpy that day but helicopters had the same issues.  We decided to do this flight instead of helicopters so everyone could have a window seat.  The price was better and the views were great.  I would highly recommend you do this sometime while you are on Kauai.  We purchased the video of our flight and it includes the entire flight including music and commentary.  You can re-live it over and over.

We debated  about a plane or helicopter and decided on the plane. With recent helicopter crashes on Kauai, we thought a plane was the safest option. We were delighted with our choice. We flew at 1500 feet and had wonderful view. Everyone had a window seat! We saw whales, waterfalls, mountains with shear cliffs falling into the sea and coffee plantations. Marcus, our pilot, gave an informative narration of our trip and piloted our plane with expert control.
Yes, you can whip through the canyons at five hundred feet in a helicopter but for my money take a plane! P.S. It is also less expensive.
excellent family run business, Bruce (pilot) was amazing and very knowledgable about the island. very friendly service and excellent pricing.

PLEASE PLEASE Schedule a flight with Bruce and his team the first day you are on Kauai!
His air tour and commentary are the perfect introduction to the Garden Island and you will spend the rest of your vacation thanking yourself (and Bruce) for the experience.
Lastly, be sure to buy the Blue Ray DVD of your flight!

We were trying to decide between a helicopter tour or a plane, but considering the prices and the fact we had two kiddos (8 & 14) with us, we went with Wings Over Kauai.  Bruce was very knowledgeable and laid back.  We got to see the Nepali Coastline, waterfalls, and the beautiful sites we could have never seen from the ground.  We all loved the trip!  Well worth the money!

Not much to add to the already awesome reviews.  The Wings over Kauai Air Tours was totally worth it.  We had a 3 year old and even though she took up a seat, they didn't charge us, which is way nice.  Do buy the video of the flight, we took some good pictures in the plane, but totally worth it to have the hour long video.  Totally wonderful!

review_title: It was the right way to start the week!!!
review_text: Caitlin and Captain Bruce made the entire Kauai vacation an awesome experience. We had great flight mates! Captain Bruce is very personable and engaging. He punctuated our clear and calm morning flight with humor, history, personal stories and a whale sighing. This flight experience was truly a value for dollar. Once we landed, they provided us with a personalized gift to remember the incredible event. Thank you Wings Over Kauai.    Mahalo A Hui Hou

I was afraid of flying and have resisted this kind of adventure for many years. So glad I decided to take the plunge with Wings Over Kauai. Val was so personable and friendly. She put me completely at ease and Bruce was such a warm, friendly, informative pilot and tour guide! I highly recommend this company. Half the cost of helicopter tours and I got such amazing photos of the island. Thanks so much for making this the highlight of our vacation! 
John and Jean

review_title: Spectacular Views Delivered by this Family-Run Business
review_text: Wings Over Kauai was one of the first tours we booked when planning for our stay on Kauai January 29, 2015. The cost was more than we usually spend for an excursion but we found out it was worth it. We walked a short distance from where our ship (Pride of America) was anchored to meet up with Mary from WOK. She drove us to the Lihue Airport where we met her brother, Carter. Carter made us feel at ease as we went through the registration process. He then took us out to meet the little Cessna that would take us to see spectacular sights, many untouched by man. We climbed into the plane after a quick photo shoot and were then introduced to our pilot, Bruce (Mary and Carter's dad). For the next 70 minutes, Bruce did an excellent job sharing his beautiful island with us. We flew over the Waimea Canyon, Na Pali Coastline and viewed many waterfalls, including the one from Jurassic Park. Our only complaint was that the flight ended too soon. As we exited the plane, Bruce handed us a very special gift (it's a secret, you'll have to take the tour to find out). We were lucky to have a clear, calm day for our flight so the use of motion medication was not necessary but WOK was prepared with ginger chews just in case. We were so pleased with this tour and thank each member of the WOK team for sharing their talents with us.

We had a great flight with Wings over Kauai.  Weather was fantastic, not a cloud in the sky.   Everyone is so friendly, and very personable.   Bruce the pilot gives you a narrative of the island as you fly by all the points of interest.   I found this to be a better value than a helicopter ride, and in my view felt safer.   You were not as close to the points, but I think this gave you a better panoramic view of the island.   This was definitely the best excursion we have been on.   If you do this trip, do it early in your stay, and you can plan the things that looked interesting from the flight.

My husband and I are visiting Kauai for the first time and think that Wings Over Kauai is the perfect way to see the stunning beauty of the island! The service was excellent from start to finish and our pilot, Bruce, provided lots of interesting and helpful information. We absolutely recommend this tour - a big thank you to Bruce and Mary for a fabulous start to our holiday!

My husband and I booked a tour with Wings Over Kauai during our honeymoon in the Cessna and it was way over our expectations! 
First, Bruce (the pilot) welcomed us and introduced himself, then his son, Carter, made the check-in and showed us the route.
Carter took a picture of us with the Cessna and the flight could begin!
Bruce truly loves his job and commented the flight with a lot of very interesting information about the island. We flew over the waimea canyon, the breathtaking Na Pali Coast, the best beaches like Poipu, Tunnels and Anini, the most amazing waterfalls and towns like Princeville. We even saw a whale !
And after this wonderfull time Carter surprised us with some gifts ! 
Wings over Kauai is a family business, every members' job is to offer you the best moment ever ! So don't hesitate, book with them, you won't be disappointed !
And to immortalize this amazing moment we bought the video for only 50$ !

review_title: Amazing views, great experience, reasonably priced.
review_text: I'm a big guy(255lbs) and the helicopter tours wanted to charge me extra. (I'm not that big  :<) It was already pretty expensive )  So, I looked into the fixed wing option and discovered we could rent the whole plane for less than sharing a copter.  It was a great flight with unbelievable scenery and an informative and friendly pilot. We flew from Lihuai along the southern coast, then across the island over looking waterfalls and canyons to the western  Na Pali coast.  Then along the north and eastern shores.  All in one hour. The scenery was absolutely magnificent. Another bonus was the total cost is about half of what you might pay for a similar helicopter ride.  We are ready to do it again!

Bruce was a very good pilot who was attentive to our needs and wishes.  He was knowledgeable and very informative of the island. Carter put together a great high definition DVD of our flight that they got from Go-Pros attached to the wings of the plane.  We would highly highly recommend this company. review_title: Warm & Personal Way to see The Gorgeous Island of Kauai
review_text:
My husband and I decided to take a tour with Wings Over Kauai after reading their great reviews. We are happy to report back all the good reviews were true. Bruce and his team were warm and inviting. My husband has had a private pilots license for over 20 years, I have never been up in a small plane. This was an exceptional way to see the full breath of this island, one where in so much of its most dramatic beauty is locked away by mountain terrain and best experienced from above. This first timer was thrilled and my husband was in flying heaven. The price
Of a plane tour is considerably lower then a helicopter tour, and the duo flight (just the two of us with one very knowledgable pilot)  was very personal and very informative. We'd do it again in a heartbeat, and couldn't recommend this experience more.

If you are nervous about motion sickness like my husband with Bruce took us on one of the most amazing views of Kauai!!! So happy we picked them over the helicopter ride..they were so knowledge and so kind we definitely will do this again with them when we return to Kauai!! So worth it!!

As I have my pilots license we did the instructional flight which meant I was able to fly the airplane while Marcus gave directions and a great commentary of the sights. It is an awesome place to fly and this was a highlight of our trip to the island. Next time we visit we will go for a fly again.

The aircraft was comfortable, and Captain Josh was professional and friendly in every respect. He obviously loves Kauai and knows a great deal about it.  My wife and I were very impressed in every respect.

This plan your of Kauai was the best tour I've been on. Bruce, the owner and our pilot for us newlyweds, was so friendly, humble, and fun to fly with! Informative of every landscape feature on the island, as well as a joy to talk with about life and our future endeavors as a newly married couple. We are here on honeymoon and we're thrilled to have spent an hour in the air with Bruce exploring Kauai.

He also gave us some material to look through famous spots on the island, as well has his favorite spots to spend his time on the island. Such a great time and truly appreciated Wings Over Kauai's service.

Before taking a helicopter, consider these plane tours as they are cheaper, see just as much if not more, and have a friendly and excellent level of service!

As a pilot with a student certificate, I wanted to take the controls myself and Wings over Kauai was the obvious choice. We booked an instructional flight in the 172 with Bruce, the owner of the company. Now, for all certified pilots out there: you will not be able to rent a plane by yourself in Kauai and neither should you. The tour traffic (especially helicopters) is busy, constant and organized. It is important to check in on the advisory frequency for position updates and if you don't know the informal landmarks, you'll be spending your flight trying to figure out which valley a chopper is going to pop out out of next. Additionally, you have to deal with mountain/ocean flying, comply with noise abatement rules and the Pacific Missile Range restricted area. Let Bruce handle the radio and big picture navigation so you can enjoy the flying and scenery. 

Since my flight was pre-checkride, Bruce threw in a few exam questions here and there, gave me general directions, offered some helpful tips that you can only get from an 11,000 hour pilot, and otherwise let me pick my path between the clouds. He pointed out landmarks and places of interest, and supplied some tour-guide type narration. 

We had a good weather day (there are always some clouds in Kauai) and the view was spectacular. We followed the established clockwise direction around the island which is flown by all tour aircraft. We saw whales, the steep cliffs of the Na'pali Coast, craters, beaches, reefs etc. 

The main difference to a helicopter tour (which we did the same day) is that helicopters can get into spaces the plane cannot. The two are different experiences. With the helo rides you're part of a group and get herded like cattle through the safety video and the tour. With the plane, you miss out on those tight canyons and close-up waterfalls, but you have your own plane and can pick your route. Plus, it's a lot cheaper AND YOU GET TO FLY YOURSELF. If you load the plane with 3 people the price is about $100 per person/hour. Compare that to $260/person on the choppy for the 55 min ride. Plus, if you're stuck in the back middle seats on the helo, your visibility is quite restricted. On the Cessna the windows might be smaller, but at least everyone has their own. 

Anyway, we returned to Lihue Airport, I made a nice-enough landing, and taxied back to the ramp in front of two Hawaiian Airlines Boeings. If you're a pilot, you know what I'm talking about. 

All in all, Wings over Kauai is a down-to-earth, family-run small business, and not a multi-island, slick and smooth helo operation. No memorabilia shop, t-shirts and upsells. They have GoPros mounted on the plane for those who like that sort of thing, but they don't push their video as much as the other outfits. Wings over Kauai is a more than viable alternative to the helicopter rides, especially if you don't want to spend $750 for a family of three. They also have a Cessna Caravan for larger groups (or mixed groups).

Our pilot Josh was amazing not only as a pilot but also as a guide as he told us a lot of interesting things about Kauai. This island from above is even more marvellous as it is already by land. This flight was definitly a highlight of our Hawaii-honeymoon! Thanks so much you guys for this great experience!

It was a perfect day for our flight tour - no wind, no cloud, crystal clear sky. Our pilot was Bruce - the boss of this small company, a very friendly and professional guy who also gave us a lot of great suggestions about food/ beach/trail on Kauai. Me and my boyfriend took the private couple flight with the smaller plane, which is a great choice as we were the only two passenger on the flight and we could ask Bruce whatever we want. Very amazing view on Kauai island - numerous waterfalls, red land and canyon, pretty coast line of Na Pali... Would highly recommend this tour to anyone, it's twice cheaper than a helicopter tour and can see literally everything on Kauai, just in a bigger distance than helicopter tour.

review_title: DO THIS !  Best Hour You'll Ever Spend on Kauai !
review_text:
Bruce, Ellen, Ellen's younger sister ;-) & our pilot Marcus are very professional and wonderfully friendly.  We had a fantastic experience, with Marcus narrating the entire trip describing points of interest, and saw essentially the entire island - Waimea Falls, Na Pali coast, Waimea Canyon, countless waterfalls, and even whales from above.

This is a must see for your upcoming trip.

Go Hokies!

Fomos muito felizes com este passeio. O dia estava bem claro, o que ajuda bastante. A ilha é linda vista de cima . Pessoal de terra e piloto muito simpáticos. 
Não percam este passeio, principalmente se o tempo estiver bom.

We took our 3 kids (8, 10 and 12) for a flight over Kauai.  It was amazing. We had the choice of rescheduling due to high winds and it was very easy to do and were able to get a good time that worked while we were on the island.  I do suggest if you are staying more than a few days on the island that you book your flight early so you have the option to reschedule due to weather.  My son loved the headphones and microphone so he talked almost the entire flight and Josh our pilot answered all his questions even the ones that were not related to anything we were seeing.  Josh was very informed, friendly and professional.  We all had a wonderful time.

The ride was smooth, informative and beautiful!  Unfortunately for me my headset didn't work but they really shined through with their customer service at the end.  Many companies these days no longer appreciate their customers or offer customer service and those who do are EXCEPTIONAL - like Wings Over Kauai.  Looking forward to seeing the DVD - which is another wonderful way to help their customers enjoy the ride for a long time!  Will certainly recommend them!

We were only in Kauai for two nights - this was a fantastic way to see the whole island in such a short period of time. The Wings Over Kauai team were very friendly and great to deal with, even when there was an issue with our booking due to a system error. My partner and I both enjoyed being up in the Cessna with Bruce, it was worth every cent.

review_title: Delighted with our choice of plane over helicopter
review_text:
We debated helicopter vs plane  and eventually decided on the plane because we would see more and have more time in the air for less money.  I was also motivated by the fact that planes are safer than helicopters and use less gas. 

We were delighted with our choice. We were made feel so welcome by Bruce and his daughter - charming people. Our pilot was Marcus. I was nervous because he is young but he has great credentials and inspires confidence.  He did a great job telling us about Kauai. 

 The weather wasn't good so I was nervous about a bumpy ride but Marcus knew exactly where the smooth spots were while still showing us everything.  We each had a big window and could talk to each other over the headsets. My husband loved being in the co-pilot seat. We had a great time and highly recommend.

review_title: Best way to see Kauai quickly
review_text:
We visited Kauai while cruising on the Pride of America, which provided a limited amount of time to see the island.  Fortunately for us, we researched flights and decided on Wings Over Kauai due to it being a family-owned business with excellent reviews.  Our decision was rewarded greatly, they are wonderful folks to work with and everything was as smooth as could be.

I was very surprised to have Bruce himself pick us up at the ABC store, he is a very nice man and shared a lot about how he started WOK as a "hobby" after retiring.  Check-in with Val was a breeze and soon Josh had us flying high above island, seeing all of the key sights during our one hour flight.  We saw more than could have ever been done with a bus tour, and the insights that Josh provided really made the trip special.  My wife was a bit apprehensive as she is not a fan of small planes, but she loved it and said she was more comfortable than on a larger plan.  

This flight was one of the highlights of our 11 day trip and should not be missed.

Best experience of our trip. Josh was a great pilot and tour guide. Worth every penny.
Anyone that comes to Kauai and doesn't take this flight is missing out. Josh stayed out of the turbulence and gave us a smooth and enjoyable ride.

review_title: The highlight of my Hawaiian holiday
review_text: This is a must do for anyone visiting the island of Kauai.  The scenery and views that you get from taking this small plane is spectacular.  My friend and I were travelling on the Pride of America cruise ship and we arranged to do this flight as it was a lot cheaper than the helicopter flights and excursions offered by the ship.  I'm so glad we did as everything was so professional from start to finish.  When we arrived at the airfield we were shown our flight path on a map.  We boarded the flight, adjusted our headsets and the music from Hawaii 5 0 started playing as we raced down the runway.  The whole event was spectacular with magnificent views only seen from the plane as there was no access by road to some of the landscapes we flew over.  We mentioned we hoped to see some whales and our very experienced pilotJosh managed to spot 3 whales in the water just off the coast.  What struck me most was that from the plane you could see the whole scale of the island whereas the helicopters flew so close to the canyon I can't help feeling you wouldn't be able to grasp the grandeur and scale of the canyon and surrounds.  Josh was very informative about the history of the island and its many characteristics.  The Napoli coastline, the canyons, the waterfalls etc it was all such a wonderful experience I would love to do it again but the next best thing is being able to buy the dvd which is edited to show the flight without any glare or reflection that my camera picked up. If you take this flight you'll also be able to meet Millie the sweetest, friendliest dog who sometimes likes to ride shotgun in the plane.

This was one of the highlights on our trip in Hawaii.  We were on a cruise Pride Of America and had booked this trip before we left home after careful research on what we wanted to do.  We read the reviews and it was exactly what everyone said.  Everyone was friendly and most helpful and the views were amazing considering before we started it had poured down with rain and wasn't looking hopeful. This wa a perfect way to see the island and all its beauty.  I would like to thank all the staff for a wonderful experience. After we left the airport and got back on the cruise I realised I had lost my camera so I emailed them when I got home to nz and asked them had they found one.  They hadn't but a few days later they emailed to say they had found it I sent them my address and a few weeks later it arrived safe and sound. It was very much appreciated.

Super profissionais a equipe da Wings! É um passeio imperdível pela Kauai Island. Do alto, se tem idéia do litoral maravilhoso da Ilha. As paisagens são diversas: praias paradisíacas que se tem acesso só por barco ( ou pelo ar); formacões rochosas cobertas por vegetaçāo que lembram catedral gótica; plantação de café - a maior dos EUA-; cachoeiras e mais cachoeiras. Um show! Inesquecível!!

We really had a great time with Wings Over Kauai.  We were in the area for a day and a half on the Pride Of America cruise ship.  I decided to schedule our flight for 930am the second day.  The first day we arrived it was pretty cloudy and rainy, so I was bummed that the weather was going to stay the same and we wouldn't see much.  Thankfully the second day it was totally clear and nice!  Even the top of Waialeale was clear!

The day of our trip we were picked up promptly near the cruise ship as arraigned.  We went over the basics- safety, weigh-in, and some pictures next to the plane.  Our pilot was Josh (a former American Airlines pilot), and he got us buckled in to our assigned seats.  I was in the copilot seat, and my wife was behind me.  Once in the air, Josh told us lots of facts about what we were seeing while music played.  The Na Pali coast was beautiful and we had great viewing weather.  I did get a bit of haze in my pictures, which looked worse on the camera's LCD than the final picture (I used a telephoto lens with a polarizing filter).  Before we knew it, it was time to land.  I really enjoyed getting to listen to air traffic control the whole time also.

Once back at the airport, they gave everyone a free gift (I won't ruin the surprise).  They also offered to sell us a DVD of the full flight, filmed by GoPros mounted under the wings and inside the cabin.  The price was very reasonable, and it arrived by the time we got home.  It was a great keepsake to have, and the views were so much better than what I captured on my camera.  They offered to drop us off back at the cruise ship or the mall, and gave my wife a flower for her hair.  Everyone we met was extremely nice and we really enjoyed the flight.

One note, if you have even the slightest problem with motion sickness, take a dramamine pill before you fly.  We were lucky to have a pretty smooth flight, but small slow planes like this are more prone to thermals and winds than large jets.  We experienced a few quick stomach-drops, that felt kind of a like a roller coaster hill.  My wife did feel a little airsick, but the dramamine stopped her from throwing up.  They do have a cooler on board with sprite and ginger chews, but better safe than sorry.

Don't hesitate to get a great view of Kauai, book a flight!

I am a return client with Wings Over Kauai. I took this air tour in December 2013 and again this December 2015. In my opinion, this is better than taking an open door helicopter tour. I did the open door helicopter air tour and this air tour both in 2013. I returned to do this one. It is the BEST deal on Kauai. 
The owners, Bruce and Ellen, were so nice and took excellent care of me with my reservation and flight. Be assured that you will have the time of your life on this air tour. Call ahead because they are in high demand, and their is a reason for it- Great Service and Price. Best Wishes and Thanks to you Ellen and Bruce

review_title: You must do it! It really worth it
review_text: I had read a lot about different companies that offer this tour and i was not sure about to do an helicopter or this tour, at the end i decided to do it. I booked the trip at 4pm and my husband was all day telling me that maybe was not a good idea that we will see the same things that we already visit lile the canyon were we did a Beautiful trail. So we started the fligth withr other 2 people evryone hadba window seat so we could see very wells, my husband was in the copilot seat, we didnt speak during the flight, but as soon we landed he told me thay i was so right that is a must this tour, is totally different to see this wonderful island by air, its really amazing, there are not enought words to describe it, you should do it. And regarding this company i must sau thay they did a great job, markus the pilot, bruce and her daughter, they tool us a picture and send it to us and they even gave us a cd with pictures and a with christmas music in hawaiian, small details that are so important!

review_title: A great way to see Kauai.
review_text: In a bit over an hour we got a wonderful all over view of the spectacular topography and scenery of Kauai from our very friendly, knowledgable and experienced pilot Bruce. This is probably the most memorable scenic flight we have been on.

We live on the island and have been on the helicopter tour a few times and decided to try the fixed wing flight. We thoroughly enjoyed the flight. We would now recommend this over the helicopter. We really liked the service, and the flight. Thanks so much for the tour. First rate all the way!

review_title: One of my best experience ever
review_text:
My only regret is that my English is not good enough to match my feelings towards those wonderful people on the ground and in the air. Thank you Ellen and Josh.
For a great day over Kauai. 
dvora and Naftali Sahar

The flight was magical! It's the best thing we did during our stay in Hawaii. The head of the company is a charming man and flying with him was a real pleasure. Much better and more interesting than a helicopter ride (we have a comparison). The flight is stable and calm, no shakes and no swings. Great for photographers. You can see the whole island from above, with all its natural wonders. We recommend it wholeheartedly!

review_title: Great Flight - friendly service - excellent value
review_text:
We very much enjoyed the flight with the air van of Wings over Kauai. We have long thought to take a helicopter flight instead, but after this experience we would always recommend to take the plane. It is slow enough so that you enjoy all sights long enough from every seat. And the flight with Wings over Kauai is more the 1 hour, so considering the speed of the aircraft it takes you to more of the Island than helicopters can, and all for half the money!
Crew and Pilot were very nice and professional. Together with the background Information provided by the Pilot and "on the spot" Music we can really recommend it!

review_title: Private Pilot - Do your own flight around the island
review_text:
As private pilot, I was able to rent a Cessna with one of the CFI instructors from the company, and do my own tour around the island, taking my family for the nice personal flight tour. 

Wings over Kauai office is located at the airport and you will depart and land at the same airport used by all airplanes that land on the island. The flight around the island, including flying over all local attractions will take up to 1 hour to complete. Because of the water (ASL to 3,500 feet AGL), you will experience clouds below, above and around you. The flight includes mountain flying as well as flying over the water, so get ready to polish your private pilot flying skills.

review_title: Classy outfit at an affordable price
review_text:
This was an unparalleled aerial experience of Kauai in a 6-passenger plane ... and we each got a window seat because "Wings Over Kauai" didn't fill the others on purpose. My wife, usually uncomfortable in helicopters, was enjoyed the 65 min small plane ride. 

They picked us up from our Cruise ship (Pride of America) in Kauai on a crystal clear Nov. day and drove us to the airstrip for safety brief and the flight. The main difference from a helicopter ride was we didn't come very close to the cliffs, yet got a spectacular aerial view of beautiful Kauai. Our young, handsome and personable pilot delighted my wife, and completed our 5 star experience. We recommend this highly to enjoy the picturesque Kauai because you can never experience this from land, and it did not break our bank either.

review_title: Don't miss this when in Kauai!
review_text: We LOVED this Amazing and affordable flight around the island. There are genuine, great folks running the company that truly care for your experience and don't just see you as another tourist. Very informative, professional, friendly and saftey-minded pilot.  It would be a shame to miss this, we are so glad we did it early to get a panorama of the whole island.

review_title: First time on Air tour and it was awesome!!
review_text: Josh our Pilot is knowledgeable and very friendly.  we changed our date once because of weather and staff on the phone was also friendly. on the day of flight,  it was clear sky on major part of island. my wife had aloha time on the flight but apart form that experience was nice!!

The crew were amazing, the flight outstanding.... I can not say enough about this crew/ company... Don't leave the island with out taking this flight!!!! 

They also pick you right up at the pier and return you...bonus!!! 
Thank you Josh, Bruse and Angel 

Paula and John Lawrence from NB Canada

review_title: This is a must for pilots
review_text: As I could not find a plane to just rent, I reverted to a flight instructor. While it is anyway a good idea to get a bit of introduction at a new place you fly, this was a particularly good choice. Bruce combined his hints for over water and windy mountain flying with wonderful tourist guide capabilities. Also reception and other services were first class.

review_title: The best way to see Kauai
review_text:
We were a couple visiting Kauai for just 1 day as part of a cruise from Los Angeles to Tahiti on Crown Princess and decided to book Wings Over Kauai well in advance. The flight came highly recommended and we thought the price of $125 per person was very good value for such a tour. Ellen, one of the company's owners was in contact with me via e-mail from the start and answered my many questions about the flight promptly. 
On the day of the flight we made our way to the meeting point close to the ship (the ABC store at Anchor Cove Mall) where we were transported to the airfield by a friendly lady in a van (sorry, I forget her name). We were briefed about the flight in advance and then Bruce, Ellen's husband, took us and another couple up in his plane. We wore a headset, so could ask questions and Bruce communicated with us as the flight progressed and gave us info about the island. The flight was fantastic and lasted around 1 hr 10 mins and we got to see all of Kauai and places that are inaccessible by vehicles. 
I would not hesitate to recommend Wings Over Kauai to everyone, as it's a very reliable and safe company to enjoy a short flight over this picturesque island.

Wings Over Kauai is a top notch company. Very professional, safe and friendly. The views are fantastic and is worth doing.

Thank you.

We booked with Wings Over Kauai because of the low price. We booked and paid online and built our schedule around it. We were scheduled for a Thursday.

Three days before the trip, they emailed us to reschedule for Friday, and said that because of the conflict they'd offer us a private tour on their two-seater plane. We agreed, changed our schedule around, and got the confirmation email. The next day, they emailed us to say that they were mistaken and the two-seater plane was not actually available. They asked if we'd mind switching back to Thursday afternoon on a four-seater plane (but a private tour). We were pretty frustrated, spent about two hours trying to find a different operator (ideally, a helicopter) and after finding that this was by far the cheapest option, agreed to switch our schedule around (again) to go on Thursday afternoon.

Besides the booking hiccup, the tour was great. Josh was our pilot and he was wonderful. We had a very clear day and the sights were incredible. You really do get a view of Kauai unlike anything else.

Though we had an incredible experience and could not have afforded the helicopter tour, we do feel like we missed out by not doing the helicopter tour. While we were circling well above the sights, we had a clear view of the helicopter tours zooming in, out, and around the canyons and other secluded areas. This is a tremendous tour for the value and the staff are wonderful, but if we go back we'd do a helicopter tour instead of a small plane tour. 

Overall, if you're too nervous for a helicopter or can't splurge for it, this is a FABULOUS alternative.

This was a huge highlight of our trip to Kauai. We booked online and  we met Bruce who made us feel very welcome.  Mary checked us in and we enjoyed her friendly manner and helpfulness. Josh our pilot, was awesome. We felt very comfortable with him and he was very informative and a very experienced pilot. We loved every part of the trip and we were amazed at the incredible scenery. Just do it, well worth it. Thank you guys for our wonderful flight. Looking forward to showing our family and friends in Australia  the Dvd that you recorded for us. Sue, Brenton, Taylah and Josh. 😁

What an excellent tour!!  Our pilot, Josh, was knowledgeable and professional, giving us plenty of information about the island. We considered a helicopter flight, but had concerns about motion sickness and the price.  All our expectations were exceeded.
Thanks again Val and Josh, for a great way to end our time on Kauai.

Check in was easy and our pilot Josh was professional and made us feel safe and secure. He provided a lot of information as we flew over Kauai/Napali Coat. We were thrilled when we flew over jurassic park waterfalls and the theme music played over our headphones - a childhood dream come true. It was also very affordable in comparison to the helicopters. The helicopters seemed to get lower/closer which we would love to do if we went back again. We just couldn't justify paying the price of the helicopter tours (especially since the Canadian dollar is not so hot right now). I would highly recommend this tour - great value for money and absolutely amazing views!!!!!!!!!!

We had an amazing time with Wings Over Kauai.  Our flight the afternoon before was cancelled because the winds were too strong.  We had the plane to ourselves the following afternoon because the other couple did not show up.  The pilot, Marcus, was great.  He explained and commented on everything we saw and more.  I took tons of photos!  One thing, if you are prone to motion sickness,  take some pills.  The wind was strong and so it was quite bumpy.  Fortunately they had drink and a cold towel so it helped my husband. I was fine.  A fantastic experience!  Highly recommended!

We booked this trip kind of last minute (the day before) after doing a little research into the best ways to view the Na'Pali Coast. We were trying to decide if we should fly with Wings Over Kauai or take a boat tour. Since it was November, and the waves had been pretty choppy, we decided not to take a several hour boat tour and booked a private morning flight with Wings. 
We were contacted by Wings the night before the trip, saying that the private tour had to be cancelled but that they could re-book us for a late afternoon flight with two other people. We re-booked the flight and were given a partial refund for the inconvenience (which was very nice of them). 
The afternoon flight was absolutely amazing!! The Wings Over Kauai staff were all very friendly and experienced. Our pilot, Josh, was very calm, confident, and he told us so many interesting facts about places on the island that we were flying over. The weather was beautiful and we saw everything that we wanted to see, including the Na'Pali Coast. The flight had a few bumps flying through a couple of light rain showers, but we never felt unsafe. It was such a great experience that I wish we could have been able to do one more lap around the island!!

review_title: Highlight of our visit to Kaua'i
review_text:
I found Wings Over Kaua'i through a Tripadvisor thread debating heli tours vs fixed wing. I am prone to motion sickness, plus we were treating my in-laws, so four tickets would be a little pricy. I was glad to see the good reviews of the plane tours and thought it would be easier on my stomach and wallet. I booked through their website just a few days before our tour. 

We took the early morning flight at 9am and it was a good thing because it was calm and clear but rainy later in the day. Everyone from Ellen picking us up, to Bruce and Angel taking care our prep, to Josh as pilot- just wonderfully nice and friendly people. Josh did the best job of keeping the flight as smooth as possible. The crew even  sent along a small cooler with ginger chews and sprite in case of motion sickness, something I really appreciated. The narration, music, and of course the views made this an absolutely wonderful experience. I recommend them highly.

I was supposed to go on this tour next week, but I chickened out in advance and ended up cancelling. But the customer service was so good that I wanted to write a review anyway. Ellen answered all of my questions and even after I decided to cancel she was so nice and professional. It's pretty rare that you find someone who can provide excellent customer service even when things don't work out. Hopefully when I get there I will find some courage and reschedule, but if not I didn't want to forget to write a review thanking Ellen for her fantastic attitude. :)

What a great way to see Kauai.  The experience was amazing.  What makes this  flight so special is that you really come away with seeing all of the Island.  I call it a geographical tour.  As the helicopter tours get you very close to the mountains, Wings Over Kauai gets you close enough.  You also fly around Black Mountain and along the Poipu Coast--The helicopter tours head from the Lihue Airport across the island to the canyon--no Poipu.    Instead of seeing a flight through your camera lens you can order a CD of your personalized tour for a minimal cost--all this and it still doesn't cost as much as a helicopter tour.  The pilots give a great commentary on what you are looking at and are happy to answer questions.  This tour really puts the Island of Kauai in perspective.
Wings over Kauai customer service was great!  The views were amazing and our pilot Marcus did a great job explaining all the sites we were seeing.  A must do while on Kauai.

review_title: We had a wonderful time on this tour!
review_text: We have been on a gazillion tours over the years and this was one of our favorite.  It was raining so they gave us the option of canceling with a full refund- so nice! But the pilot said that the weather for flying would be grand and so it was.  We trusted that he was telling us the truth and he definitely was.  If you are going to fly over any Hawaiian island, this is the one.  Kauai, which we have been to many times, is absolutely stunning from the air.  And the pilot knew so much about the island that we felt like it was ours by the time the tour was over.   Highly recommend!

review_title: Great way to view the Island
review_text: We had already done a great photo tour but had heard about this air tour from some friends who took it a few years ago.  Since I tend to have a little motion sickness I did not want to take the bumpier helicopter tour.  This was very smooth...and our pilot, Marcus, was very proficient in his piloting skills and we encountered only a few seconds of bumpiness.  The view was awesome.  Each participant wears a headset with a microphone to communicate with each other.  There was pleasant and very appropriate music during the flight as well.  We got some beautiful pictures and you really get a better perspective of the island and its distinct parts (beaches, mountains, waterfalls, etc.)  And don't let a few clouds deter your interest...the weather looked very sketchy at best but turned out to be great once we got up in the air (11:00 tour). I also saved a few bucks by calling directly to book.  It's well worth your time and money - highly recommend it!  And PS, they gave us a special gift - a DVD of the island (not our tour which you CAN purchase for an additional $35) but all in all a great unexpected keepsake including our picture in front of the plane as the cover of the disk.)

review_title: Can't do Kauai without an air tour
review_text: We heard so much about how beautiful Kauai was, but after driving around the entire island, we weren't that impressed. Mind you, we had just seen all the major sights of Maui, so we were a bit spoiled. Things finally clicked when we took the air tour. It can be seen as somewhat of a splurge for some, but it's necessary to experience Kauai to its fullest. Wings over Kauai is a more reasonably priced option, but the service and experience were great. My wife and I enjoyed it, but unfortunately my infant daughter and grandma couldn't really handle the motion sickness, so prepare yourself.

Wir haben den Rundflug um 11 Uhr im Voraus über die Homepage gebucht und wurden vor Ort dann wunderbar empfangen. Die vorherige Nervösität und Angst vor dem Flug (und vor allem der Übelkeit während dem Flug) war unbegründet. Unser Pilot Josh hat den Rundflug bestens und mit vielen Infos durchgeführt, mit weniger "Schwankungen" als erwartet. Ein sehr sympatisches und professionelles Team - absolut empfehlenswert!

review_title: Wings Over Kauai Recommended Air Tour
review_text:
We flew with Josh in late September, and were very happy that we chose Wings Over Kauai over a helicopter tour.   There's good reason why there's over 1800 excellent ratings for this company.  

We are in our early 50s and had concern about the helicopter tours, with the movement of the copter as well as potential motion sickness.  We chose the Wings Over Kauai tour with the 6 passenger Air Van, although they do have a 2 passenger Cessna.  We're posting a picture of us viewing the scenery out the window, and you can see that the window has plenty of viewing area.  Review their website, wingsoverkauai.com, as it contains all the information necessary to make the choice of the tour right for you.

Angel was working their front desk and was a really pleasant young man who went over the paperwork prior to the flight.  There is a restroom across from their check-in counter that you can use prior to the flight.  Josh was our pilot and he was outstanding.  Knowing that he does tours day in and day out, and it's bound to be tiring at times, he still made us feel as though this was his exclusive tour for us.

We saw Bruce dropping off individuals from the cruise ship for the tour following us, and he, too, had wonderful aloha considering all the people that cross his path on a daily basis.

We highly recommend Wings Over Kauai.

I had set up Wings Over Kauai several months prior to our trip to Kauai because I didn't want to miss out.  This was the most fantastic tour.  Josh was the pilot and he was awesome.  The entire flight was fantastic.  Josh made us feel like family and we learned so much from this tour. The weather was perfect and we able to see everything with clear skys.  I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai!!!!

Like many, I read TA a lot but don't often feel the need to post. Flew in their smaller plane, the Cessna 172, recently on the standard around-the-island tour. Excellent narration and as most everyone else has already said, wonderful scenery. All I have to add is that I was impressed at this operator's excellent attention to safety details. The aircraft was clean, well equipped and obviously well maintained. Pilot knew his stuff. No worries at all. Having retired after 40+ years flying for a major airline, I think I'm qualified to say "great job". Nice landing, too, 
The three Gopros on the aircraft are recording all flight and, yes, it is very well worth it to order the optional DVD or Blu-ray [or online download] to show your friends and family back home how great Kauai looks from above. No stock footage. It's all recorded on your flight.

Selbst wenn man die Na Pali Küste schon vom Boot oder per Trail gesehen hat, dann lohnt es trotzdem es noch einmal aus dieser Perspektive zu versuchen. Wir hatten lange überlegt ob wir einen Helikopter buchen sollte, der zwar etwas teurer ist dafür aber an die Wasserfälle dichter ranfliegen kann und auch in den Waimea Canyon hinein fliegt. Wir haben uns für die Tour mit dem Airvan entschieden, da man hier die beste Sicht hat und es keine Mittelplätze wie im Helikopter gibt. Letztendlich haben wir unsere Entscheidung nicht bereut. Ellen & Bruce sowie Ihr Team sind sehr professionell und man sieht für das gleiche Geld mehr. Besonders beeindruckend waren die unzähligen Wasserfälle im Hanalai Valley  (Awesome!). Ganz hinten war auch Klasse, da ich so auch zwischen linker und rechter Seite hin- und her springen konnte. Aufgrund der Route liegen die meisten Highlights auf der rechten Seite. Etwas störend waren die reflektierenden und vibrierenden Plexiglasscheiben, aber das ist ein kleines Detail am Rande. Insgesamt wirklich lohnenswert. Beim nächsten Besuch machen wir die Hubschrauber Tour zum Vergleich.

It was our second visit in Kauai. The first one, our boat ride to Na Pali was cancelled du to weather. This time, again! We looked for another way to see that wonder of Nature.

Chopper rides seemed interesting, but were pretty expensive. We came about Wings over Kauai.

What a wonderful tour of the island. Bruce, our pilot (and owner) was a great host and very knowledgeable. The tour lasted a bit over an hour. The views are simply breathtaking. We went all around the island and got a chance to see the Canyion as well as the Na Pali coast plus a multitude of other sites (Wailua falls). The ride was very smooth, we couldn't asked for more! 
We ended our tour with a very thoughtful gift (a surprise). 

Thanks again Bruce for communicating your love for this land.
Gilbert and Valerie 

P.S. If you get the chance we strongly recommend you get the hole tour in HD quality. It's only 50$ but well worth seeing it all again.

We debated fixed wing or helicopter ride over Kauai and decided on the fixed wing ride.  We had very good weather as there was very little cloud cover at the top of the mountains so we good views everywhere.  Josh did a good job narrating the flight.  I enjoyed listening in on radio communications during the flight.

Our flight on Wings Over Kauai was spectacular.  I can well see why this is TripAdvisor's top rated activity.  Markus our pilot, was super with great knowledge of the island features.  He was very engaging and entertaining and provided us with first hand experience for some of the activities we wanted to do..  The flight was smooth with indescribable views of the island from the air.  This is a beautiful island to visit and having an "over view" of the island gave us an opportunity to orient ourselves to where we wanted to go and what areas we definitely wanted to see. 

I cannot explain in words the beauty of the Hawaiian Islands and especially Kauai other than to say experience it for yourself.  When you do come to Kauai make sure you take this flight as it will provide you with the most spectacularly visual experience you have ever had.  I have been on Helicopter tours before and the fixed wing adventure provided by Wings Over Kauai, blows them away.

review_title: Fantastic tour!!  A must for Kauai!
review_text: We went in their small plane for the tour over Kauai, there were six of us including the pilot.  They picked us up at the ABC store, just up the street from the pier, where our ship docked.  If you don't want to take the ten minute walk you can jump on the free shuttle that takes you to the little mall where the ABC store located.  When I read all the previous comments about Wings Over Kauai we decided to go with them, and we're very happy we did!!  For $125.00 US we got a whole hour in the air.  If they keep that up they will continue to be busy and recommended by people like myself.  I've already told many people to go with them.  They were nice enough to offer us free water and pop during our flight, that was great!  The best part of the tour, is seeing Kauai, it's beautiful!!  For anyone sitting on the passenger side of the plane, you will see better.  If your on the pilots side, you will see everything but not as well and throughly as the others, but the pilot does try his best.  I think it's due to the time it takes to fly the plane around so everyone can see as well.  I would still recommend it anyways.  If price doesn't matter and you want a shorter ride then you can take a helicopter ride, which flies lower and takes you closer to the mountains.  Make sure to bring your camera!!  Go to the washroom and get in the plane!!  They do have good walk up steps to the plane, so even if you have some disabilities you shouldn't have a problem.  If you leave yourself three hours from getting to the mall, filling out the paperwork, getting weighed, get on the plane and the flight back, you should be good.  Ellen picked us up and was,so nice.  We met her husband and our pilot, Josh, along with Ellen's daughter, and they were all so nice and friendly.  Josh was an excellent,pilot, constantly talking to us all during the flight and answering any questions we had.  Can't lose taking this tour, especially as its the only way to see the canyon and the Na Pali coast without hiking and a boat, which would take days.  Kauai is so beautiful and you appreciate it more from the air.

A "fly over" of Kauai and the NaPali Coast is a must do... a lot of people go on a helicopter tour, but we did the Wings over Kauai Cessna option (which is also a great value).  We would highly recommend this tour!  Shout out to Markus who was our pilot and tour guide.  You don't end up close and personal with the waterfalls and coast, but you get a great view of all that Kauai has to offer.
Pilot Josh was excellent. Very knowledgeable and down to earth. Had a great time. Gorgeous. Can't see this by ground! Blown away.

Auch wir haben uns an diesem Wunderschönen Ort einen Inselrundflug gegönnt. Wir sind mit gemischten Gefühlen ins Flugzeug eingestiegen da es recht bewölkt war zu dieser Uhrzeit. Unser Pilot war Yosh. Er hat alles so toll erklärt und ist mit den Wolken geflogen so dass wir nur Sonne und klare Sicht hatten. Spektakuläre Bilder die man nicht mehr vergessen wird und ein Must-have in jedem Kauai Urlaub

This was such a blast.  We flew over the whole island of Kauai, which is the most beautiful place in the islands.  It is so rugged and we have never seen so many waterfalls in our lives.  We have done the Napali coast by catamaran (which was very fun) and driven up the canyon by car.  Hiked.  But we couldn't believe what it hidden from us until we flew over.  This is a must do if you think you have seen all of Kauai.

Kauai is our favorite island. There’s just something different about it. It has a different feel, a different vibe. Maybe it’s the chickens everywhere, or the cattle or the more mature landscape. Just not sure. From the air, it’s gorgeous. We flew Wings Over Kauai. Very, very nice people. We were very lucky in that the other people on our flight cancelled, so we had the entire Caravan to ourselves. Bruce, the owner, was our pilot. We took off on 30, NW, turned right and circled the island clockwise. Got great pictures during a flyover of the Crown at dock. The day was partly cloudy with clouds and rain over the center of the island. The water was pure aqua blue, the coastline just picture perfect rocks and white spray and the green of the trees contrasting with the red of the soil could not be done justice in a photo. We cut inland up Wameia Canyon, saw the Jurassic Park waterfall, flew inland of the Pacific Missile Test Range main base, but cut back out over the ocean just before we go to the northern most telemetry radars sitting on top of one giant cliff. 

Flew along the Napoli Coast. Saw the trail wind its way through the cliffs, on top of huge sea caves and along knife edge ridges of rock. Broke back over the northern coast over the resorts and golf courses and the locations they filmed Jurassic World. Cut around the NW part of the island, flew a circle around the Fantasy Island waterfall, saw the cattle grazing in almost chartreuse meadows, flew back over the ship and landed back on runway 30. The whole trip was about 70 minutes, at a ground speed of around 90mph. Judy filmed the whole thing with the action cam, and I took about 160+ stills. We also ordered a video of the flight. They had GoPro’s on each wing. 

This was one of the best value excursions we’ve ever had in Hawaii. Judy did get a little queasy coming around the hills to the NW of the airport. The air was a bit bumpy, but not bad at all. Nothing like the helicopter we took in Juneau in 2001.

We would highly recommend Wings over Kauai to anyone wanting to see Kauai from the air. Easy to book, the guys are enthusiastic and a delight to fly with. Our pilot Josh was very knowledgable about the island and the perfect tour guide. We are a family with two under-tens and the 60 minute flight time was no problem for them. Anyone looking for an aerial view of this amazing island should look no further than these guys.

We did this tour years ago and it was so amazing we came back and did it again.  I got so many pictures I'm going to blow up and print as gallery wraps.   Kauai is so beautiful and you can't see so many of the best things, except for from the air.   Josh was such a great guide and so knowledgable.

This was probably one of the most incredible experiences of our lives, but definitely a honeymoon highlight. Weather was clear so we were able to see the top of the highest mountain and had phenomenal views of Waimea canyon and Hanalei valley. There were four of us on our flight and we all had window seats. We managed to film most of the trip, just a couple of challenges with sun glare (we flew at 1 pm on a very sunny day). I had taken a motion sickness medication as a precaution and didn't experience any problems but also don't think I would have anyway based on how smooth the flight was. Very skilled and knowledgeable pilot!

Time constraints prevented us from seeing Weimea Canyon and other wonders from the ground, but this trip allowed us to feel like we still experienced Kauai.  Just wish we had done this first, as it would have helped us prioritize the rest of our stay particularly as to beaches. 

The Wings Over Kauai team made us feel comfortable from the start, and our pilot Josh maintained that Aloha vibe throughout the flight.  My wife wasn't entirely comfortable with the idea of a helicopter ride, but an airplane flight was more than acceptable as an alternative.  Excellent views, humorous and informative narration, and a smooth ride.  A highlight of our trip to Kauai.

review_title: Sheri and Gary wings over Kauai
review_text: This was the most amazing hour of my life.. What a wonderful tour company all the way from pickup by Ellen to the incredible flight by Captain Josh and his unbelievable expertise on the island of Kauai.. If you are looking for a true Hawaiian experience this is the tour company for you!!!  Mahalo from Sheri and Gary

review_title: Fantastic way to see the island!
review_text: We debated whether to see the Na Pali coastline from a boat or the air.  After many tripadvisor reviews, we decided to go by air and opted for a plane over a helicopter (again, based on review comments).  We think we made a great decision.  The ocean was pretty rough while we were there, which might have made a sea journey by catamaran less fun and probably would have eliminated the snorkel option those tours offer.  Besides, we got a great view of the coastline from the air and saw parts of the rest of the island that we would never have seen otherwise.  Val prepped us for our flight at the Wings over Kauai office and her pleasant demeanor put everyone at ease.  Captain Josh was a great pilot, maneuvering us in and out of canyons and over the ocean without a bump.  There really is no better way to get a sense of how much diversity and beauty there is on this island w/o seeing it from the air.  We have a number of vacation videos that go unwatched, but I'm sure we'll be watching the flight video from this trip several times.  Thank you Val and Josh (and Millie, the nicest dog you ever met)!  We had a great time and it was the highlight of our stay on  Kauai!

We were a party of 5 and took the private air van tour over Kauai on October 12th. It was an absolute pleasure with Captain Bruce and his daughter Mary was very lovely with check in and making sure we were comfortable.  
The flight was seamless and smooth and Captain Bruce had a wealth of knowledge over the island. I would definitely recommend this tour to anyone visiting Kauai because it was a great experience to see the the true beauty of the entire island by air.

y 2 friends and I took this tour on Sunday,  October 11th but our experience with this company began on the Friday evening before when I called after hours and was pleasantly surprised to be talking to a real live person! I expected to leave a message on an answering machine as I had done with every other tour company I had called before calling Wings Over Kauai but not only did a very pleasant lady answer the phone and all my questions but I was able to book our tour with her as well. I could tell this was truly a family business because I could hear children playing in the background! 😊 On the day of our tour we were greeted with a big welcoming smile from another young lady named Mary, who was Bruce's daughter. Bruce is the owner of the company and he was our pilot! Bruce was so warm and friendly that we immediately felt right at home in his plane.
