In addition some of the must see attractions you can get to from road or kayak/boat. I would highly recommend this trip.

GREAT customer service! My husband got sick the day before our tour and they didn't give me any hassle about canceling his seat. The other three of us went up in the airvan with a couple and our pilot, Josh. FANTASTIC views, very friendly and knowledgeable narration. The tour was over an hour and we felt like we really got our money's worth, especially since Wings Over Kauai is about $100 per person cheaper than Blue Hawaiian helicopters! We got really lucky with the weather and saw a ton of waterfalls and parts of the mountain we otherwise wouldn't have seen. They offer a DVD or bluray of your personal tour at the end, unlike some of the other companies that sell you a "stock tour" DVD. Unfortunately, they discovered after our trip that the audio was corrupted, so they gave me a 50% discount on the DVD - very fair. Overall, a extremely friendly, helpful, and highly affordable (comparatively, anyway) way to see Kauai by air!

review_title: A must do...if you even thinking about it - JUST DO IT!
review_text:
Today - May 20, 2015 we took this flight (the Cessna tour).  If you read any of the reviews they will tell you how this is a family run operation, that Bruce the owner is an excellent tour guide, the check in is smooth and effortless, they don't take payment until you actually are there to check in, and the price is SIGNIFICANTLY less than a helicopter tour.

What you might wonder is can this all really be true, Is this worth it and should I book this?

The resounding answer to all these questions is YES!

The bottom line is this was the highlight of our trip.  We did ATVs, got stand up paddle board lessons, went to the Missouri, ate like kings, drank like sailors, went to the canyon, visited the light house, and even bought chocolate macadamias.  Don't miss this opportunity!  Family run company that really has your best interest at heart.

review_title: Great flight on a perfect day!
review_text: Had a wonderful flight over Kauai with Josh. The weather could not have been better and Josh was a terrific pilot/tour guide. We got to see pretty much the entire island and I was very happy that the entire thing was recorded so that I can share it with my son when I get home.

review_title: This must be on your to do list!
review_text: We took the air tour this morning and it was incredible! Bruce and Mary could not be more welcoming, kind, thoughtful and knowledgeable. I've never flown in a small plane like theirs but they immediately put my mind at ease and consider and your comfort. The views are breathtaking and unforgettable. The time went by so quickly and when we landed all I could think of was saying, again! This has definitely been the highlight of our trip and we couldn't have enjoyed it more. It was beyond affordable compared to helicopter tours and very enjoyable. Don't miss out on a tour with Wings Over Kauai!

We arrived today at Wings Over Kauai Air to be greeted by Mary, nice young lady.   She told us everything we needed to know about the in's and out's of the Trip ... then she ask for payment. How unusal in this day and time, my husband made these reservations weeks ago and Wings didn't even ask for partial much less full payment.  
While we are meeting Josh our Pilot Mary is outside cleaning our headset, windows to see better and putting drinks in the plane for us. 
We get on board and Josh takes off. Excellent commentary on everything we were seeing. Josh was well spoken,  We would ask questions and He would have the answer.  Josh had excellent knowledge of this beautiful island that we flew over.  Beautiful weather, great flight, Thank you Guys!

So glad we took this flight.  Seeing Kauai from the air was fantastic.  Captain Josh was our pilot and was very friendly, interactive, and pointed out all of the island sights.  We were so lucky (late in the season) to see a pod of whales.  
Everyone at the company was friendly and very customer focused.  I am prone to motion sickness but wore my electronic device that controls it.  So I had no problem.
I highly recommend an air tour of Kauai and this company in particular!

After some careful planning we decided to go on The Wings over Kauai tour. We chose to fly in the small Cessna plane. We wanted to have guaranteed window seats and that is why we picked the airplane over the helicopter tour. When we arrived  we were checked in by Bruce's daughter. She was very nice and gave us an idea of what to expect and what we would be seeing. She also gave me a flower and a necklace. Then we met Bruce and his wife. I was a little apprehensive about getting on such a small plane but she assured me that we would have a great ride and it would be smoother than we thought. We then got on the plane with Bruce, my husband was seated in the front. I got in the back seat. Take off was smooth and once we were up it was just thrilling. Bruce was terrific and we loved that we could hold a conversation with him using headsets. A lot of the other tours only allow you to listen and not talk. This made it more personal and we enjoyed it more for this reason. Bruce took us all over Kauai pointing out different beaches, coffee fields and all kinds of interesting facts about the island. If you are worried about motion sickness it wasn't at all a problem for me. We loved the ride. You also get a dvd of a flight, which is nice for future memories. All and all this was a wow experience and now I can't wait to do a small plane flight again. Thanks to the entire family!

I would highly recommend this tour. We were fortunate to have the owner, Bruce, give us a highly personalized experience. It started off with a warm welcome at check-in. They even had welcome gifts for me, the new bride because they knew we were celebrating our honeymoon. Bruce was our pilot and was knowledgeable, intelligent, warm, funny, comforting (for nervous passengers), and also resourceful. The views were amazing. The plane we went in only had 3 passenger seats (one in front and two in back), so everyone could get a view (if you had three passengers, we were only two), where as on helicopters there are chances of getting stuck in middle seat :/  We had great views with helpful and personalized commentary from Bruce. Although you can't get as close to some sites as you would in helicopter, you feel safe and get a unique and magnificent vantage point  that is different from land or water. You must see the Napali coast from both water and air.... And wings over Kauai was an unforgettable experience offering unparalleled service .

Recently had the opportunity to fly with Wings over Kauai! Our pilot was Josh and he was awesome! A  true professional airman and very knowledgeable of the island! The flight was fantastic and his narration of the sights along the flight path was excellent. I can't say enough good things about this company! I will definitely do the flight again when I visit this awesome island again in the future! Small company, great folks, great aircraft, great experience! Can't go wrong with this outfit! Thanks for the awesome experience!

review_title: Wings Not Rotors Plus A 360-Degree Double Rainbow
review_text: This is an aerial tour by plane, not by helicopter.  Another couple went with us and one of our party becomes motion sick relatively easily.  The company's FAQ's address this issue and the information was accurate.  Our pilot was aware of the issue and tried to make the ride as gentle as possible for her.  We booked the 4:00 pm Grand Deluxe Tour in the G8 AirVan.  Because the fare for two couples ($125 per person, $500.00 for the two couples) equaled the "private charter" fare, we opted for that so only the four of us and, of course, the pilot were on the plane.  Upon arrival, we were greeted by Mary who was very friendly and accommodating.  Because the weather during the day had been rainy, she did not take our credit cards until she spoke to our pilot, Josh, about the weather.  Josh had just returned from a tour and gave the green light for our flight in that his opinion was that the weather was clearing and that this would be the best tour of the day.  His prophesy was correct. The ride was relatively smooth, although there were a few bumpy spots.  However, we were fortunate to see a 360-degree double rainbow (we didn't know a 360-degree rainbow existed, but it does and can only be seen from the air) along the Napali Coast.  Simply spectacular!  The views are all from the right side of the plane.  The windows are big so it is easy to take photos if you want.  But if you just want to sit back and enjoy the experience, the plane is equipped with several cameras and you can purchase a DVD, Blue-Ray or video download link at the end of the trip ($35 for the DVD and $50 for the Blue-Ray or video download link) that shows your trip and includes the pilot's commentary, music and the passengers' conversations (you wear a headset with a mike and can talk with the other passengers and pilot).  Before the plane took off, I noticed that Mary cleaned all of the windows on the plane -- nice touch.  The plane flies at a relatively slow speed of 90 mph and the tour lasts about 65 minutes.  Josh did a nice commentary and fielded the questions we had.  Josh was friendly and according to the women in our party, "not hard to look at."  He said that he had been doing this tour for four years and had been flying in the Hawaian Islands for seven years.  If you want a great overview (no pun intended) of the island's features, including numerous waterfalls and movie locations, and  some of its attractions, we highly recommend this tour.

review_title: Great aerial tour, Great Narration, Great Value!
review_text:
Josh was our pilot and did a fantastic job with his enthusiastic and knowledgable narration of the awesome island of Kauai. (He is a great pilot too.)  Val made us feel welcome and was helpful in selecting a good time for the tour based on the day's weather.  Highly recommended - would do it again!

Charles & Lise Brown

Great service.  Great ride.  What more can you ask for?  Outside of an awesome experience, the folks at Wings over Kauai made my vacation by allowing a reschedule due to bad weather.  I'm a photographer and this was to be a trip of a lifetime experience and my first aerial photography experience.  The day we were originally scheduled for, the visibility was practically non-existent for the majority of the island. I was so disappointed that I was going to be spending almost $300 on a flight where I'd get no decent photos.  You can imagine how overjoyed I was when they said yes to my request to reschedule as I know that's not done everywhere and can't possibly be done often because they'd go out of business if they do it too much. For that alone, they'd get a 10 star rating if I could give it to them.

review_title: Bruce is great!  One of the best tours on the island!
review_text: Would highly recommend Bruce and family for a great air tour of the island.  We took the 172 and it was a great one-hour flight.  I am a pilot and my wife and I fly a lot.  She wanted to do a helicopter tour, but I had read about Wings over Kauai and thought this would be a great trip.  Turns out, I was right and she said the flight was the highlight of her trip.  Even compared to Zip-lining, snorkeling and a bunch of other things.  So, needless to say, it was great and I highly recommend this to all.

A bit of hesitation about a flight in such a small (6 seater) plane was clearly unfounded as this was smoother than large passenger jet flights I've taken!  Fortunately the cloudy skies and light precipitation we had for the days leading up to the flight cleared and presumably the wind had substantially dropped off because it had no impact on the plane.  Our pilot, Josh, clearly knew his stuff and was really friendly and knowledgeable.  The views were just magnificent and we saw everything we were expecting and more.  The Na Pali coast was amazing and clearly best seen from the air.  I really recommend this experience and this tour.

Out of all my experiences during my stay on Kauai, this was by far the best investment. I would do it again in a heartbeat. Not one, not two, FIVE GoPros are mounted on the plane that capture every view and conversation between the pilot and passengers. The conversation piece didn’t seem as significant until I saw my video, heard the soundtrack from the flight, and basically wept. (Videos available for purchase for a very reasonable price via dvd or Vimeo link. - Thank you for offering streaming media!!) Their website is super informative, especially for scheduling. Their staff was accommodating and just a complete pleasure to interact with. This company goes above and beyond to personalize your experience and make you feel comfortable during the whole process. 9,000% recommend.

Wir sind zum ersten mal in einem kleinen Flugzeug geflogen und es war unvergesslich. Man erlebt die Insel aus einem völlig neuen Blickwinkel. Bruce gibt viele Infos über die Insel. Hinterher darf man noch Fotos von dem Flugzeug machen und man bekommt eine kostenlose DVD.

My husband and I just finished the private flight with Bruce and all we can say is WOW! What an amazing experience. A  must do for anyone coming to Kauai!! 

I was very nervous because I am prone to motion sickness but Bruce was amazing and I can honestly say it was one of the smoothest plane rides I have ever had! I was worried for nothing! 

Such a fun experience!!!!!

Vol inoubliable en compagnie de Captain Bruce. Si vous ne devez faire qu'une seule activité à Kauaï, allez sans hésiter chez wings over Kauaï. C'est une entreprise familiale, où l'on est accueilli chaleureusement, nous avons choisi de faire le tour privatisé en Cessna et franchement nous ne l'avons pas regretté!!! des paysages à couper le souffle et un super pilote qui aime son boulot et ça se sent!!! le rapport qualité/prix en comparaison avec les tours en hélice est sans appel, le tour en avion dure réellement 1H et on en prend plein les yeux!! sans aucun doute le meilleur moment de notre séjour! merci encore à la famille Coulombe.

My friend and I really wanted to do an air tour of Kauai and the weather was not cooperating most of the day.  It started to clear up after lunch and we LUCKILY stumbled across WINGS OVER KAUAI.  Ellen and Bruce are simply fantastic!  
It was just Bruce, my pal and me in the plane and Bruce is not only a solid pilot, but a knowledgeable and humorous tour guide.  
I cannot express how much fun this was!  I hope I have more visitors soon so I can justify doing this again.

Wir haben auf Grund der guten Rückmeldungen den Privatflug in der Cessna gebucht und wurden nicht enttäuscht! Da es recht windig war hatten wir bezüglich des kleinen Flugzeugs doch ein angespanntes Gefühl. Dies war nicht notwendig - Bruce hat uns Sicherheit vermittelt und uns zu Beginn toll abgelenkt, danach haben wir den Flug nur mehr genossen. Vielen Dank, das Erlebnis als Co-Pilotin ist unvergesslich :)

We had booked the 11 am tour online even before we reached Kauai. We called ahead and the person who answered told us we could come by 10:45 am or so. We reached round about then only to be told by Val that we were late & that the flight briefing etc. takes time. however, sensing our dismay and the fact that we had been misinformed, Val & Bruce agreed to conduct the tour for us.

Val weighed us and gave us a few tips while Bruce decided to brief us while we taxied. Soon we were in the tiny Cessna with seatbelts fastened and headphones on. My husband was on the copilot seat and Bruce almost made him believe that he was steering the flight :) As we took off after about five minutes of taxiing, I realised this was one of my once-in-a-lifetime experiences.

Bruce was exceptionally knowledgeable, friendly and funny. He soon put everybody at ease, even our friends who were a little afraid. He is clearly a master at flying. Not for a moment the small aircraft caused discomfort to us. He showed us many spots which he puts on his must-visit list. To make it even better, the sky was as clear and sunny as it could be. The tour lasted a little more than an hour. The best hour of our lives perhaps.

My husband rued that perhaps we should have taken the helicopter tour which takes closer to the waterfalls but after flying with Bruce, I am glad we took Wings Over Kauai. Great hospitality, great views, great infotainment. A gorgeous way to see a gorgeous island!

Capt. Bruce was simply awesome. It was my wife's first time in a Cessna and Bruce put her completely at ease. The fight was unbelievably spectacular. This is sooooo much better than a helo tour. We saw the entire island and Bruce is a fount of interesting history and contemporary happenings. We have been to Kauai many times, but I learned more from Bruce and found a much deeper appreciation of just how special this place is from Bruce than all my previous visits combined. This is a must-do.

For us everything went smooth from check in to the flight itself. The business is run by a superfriendly family, and they made us feel very welcomed. The flights itself was cool, with the awesome views. The pilot Bruce told us about everything we see. We really enjoyed it!

Btw, in the afternoon the werather became cloudy and rainy, and this happened during all of our Kauai trip, so we would recommend to book the morning flight (they have 4 flights per day).

Great customer service and a warm welcome from Val, Josh and Millie. Josh was very knowledgeable and experienced in the local sights and landmarks. We have some great pictures and even better memories. Would highly recommend, worth every penny!

The personal touch provided by these small business owners is superior to the commercial outfits.   Bruce and Ellen are incredibly friendly and are noticeably great with using your name in conversation.  
Our pilot,  Josh,  was first class.  He, too, referred to all passengers by name in conversation and provided a perfect narration to our flight.  I WILL come back and visit these folks and I strongly suggest anyone that appreciates first class service and attention spend their hard earned money with these good people.  
You may have noticed I haven't even mentioned the sights yet... well,  it's Kauai.  It's beautiful.  There's not much you can do to screw that up.  The sights are amazing. Jurassic Falls.  Napali Coast.  Wimea Canyon. Etc. 
This trip is worth every penny and then some.  The sights plus the first class service topped our trip.  A+++

review_title: My mind was in the clouds...
review_text:
I wanted to do something special for my girlfriend's birthday. I've been to Kauai a couple of times but she has not. What better way to see an island for the first time than seeing the entire island...and by air!

Of course I looked on TripAdvisor for help. I started with helicopter tours and trying to fit it in my budget. Then I noticed "Wings over Kauai" a couple attractions below and went to their website. Saw they used those small prop planes (good for those that get motion-sick) and then I saw they had a combo tour. Looked at the price and had to call to confirm....it was no joke! The price for both the air and sea tour was only a little more than the helicopter rides.

I called them to book the tours. The receptionist was very friendly and helpful. Helped me upgrade to a smaller plane (not much more) so we would have it all to ourselves. Emailed me the details and confirmation right away. Was no trouble at all.

When we arrived in Lihue, picked up our rental car and drove literally only 5 mins to arrive at the office/plane. Definitely recommend, if possible, to book your air tour the day you arrive because it's so close to the airport and you won't need to come back to the area if you plane to stay outside of Lihue.

The girl working in the office was very friendly and also the pilots daughter. We waited a few minutes for the pilot to get the plane ready and we were off. They let us take pictures in front of the plane and will even give you a CD copy of your our after.

The pilot was nice, friendly, funny and best of all knowledgeable. Told us some stories and history about places we were flying over. He interacted with us when we asked questions. He was so personable that he made us feel comfortable and relaxed (definitely helped me because I easily get motion-sickness).

If you're looking to do something different and you're on a budget (or if you easily get motion-sickness) then I highly recommend this company. It's family-owned so they take real good care of you and make sure that you have an awesome experience. Great way to see the entire island in an hour.

Everything about the tour exceeded our expectations. Josh was our pilot and he was very knowledgeable of the island history, the language, and the geography. He was very personable and a lot of fun to fly with. The weather was awesome and we got to see much more that most people do. I took lots of incredible pictures. The views were awesome and the ride was surprisingly smooth. Don't miss this!

review_title: awesome the best thing we ever did on a vacation
review_text: Best thing we ever did on a vacation,  they greeted me by name, had a special necklace for me  and treated us as special  customers. The flight was awesome, very smooth, pilot was knowledgeable and funny and called us all by name. We saw the whole island and enjoyed the trip . A must do when visiting the island of Kauai.

From recommendations from a friend my parents and I chose this company for our aerial tour of the island.  My mom couldn't do a helicopter but really wanted a view of the entire island.  She did amazing in the airplane and LOVED it! Our captain Josh was amazing! He talked to us the whole time telling us specifics about what we are seeing and answering all of our questions.  He was greatly experienced and it showed by his calm nature and appreciation for the beauty of the island.  I wasn't aware of the pictures and video footage they were going to give us...nice touch! and greatly appreciated! Amazing experience that my parents were still talking about when we went our separate ways back to the mainland.  If even in Kauai I highly recommend doing this tour..if we ever get the opportunity to return we will surely do this guide again!

My wife and I, along with another couple, had the tremendous experience of taking a flight with Wings Over Kauai. I took some time to look this group up-and I'm glad we found them! 

Growing up in a 'flying' family, I knew I wanted a trip in a fixed-wing plane. Our friends, who had experienced these types of trips in a helicopter, were skeptical, but they were really happy during and after our trip!

Our pilot, Josh, was excellent-both as a pilot and letting us know about all the sights! All of us were hooked up with headphones and microphones to communicate, which made the experience even better. Great views and a great ride.

When we finished, they even gave our wives a ride back to our Cruise Ship, while we returned the Rental Car.

If you have done the helicopter tour (or haven't), try this one, you'll be glad you did!!

Great overall experience! Reviews speak for themselves, these guys know how to do it! Personally, I'm an airline pilot and can say with confidence that SAFETY is there number one priority and execute it perfectly.  Friendliness, safety and attention to detail is all a perfect 10.

If you want to really see what Kauai has to offer, book this ASAP as it books up fast!

The plane trip we took was beyond spectacular!  The whole staff at Wings of Kauai was so friendly and knowledgeable about the island.  The flight was so smooth and enjoyable with music that matched some notable areas, that I didn't want the flight to end . We have done many excursions on many vacations but this probably topped them all.  We much preferred this to a helicopter.  And Josh, the pilot did such a great job of informing us of history and stories of the island.  He even circled around a whale that was surfacing for us to watch.  It was absolutely perfect.  The whole staff went out of their way to be sure everything was perfect!  We can't recommend this enough.....you will LOVE it!!  It is the only way to see all the glorious sights of Kauai.

review_title: Instructional Sightseeing Flight with Wings Over Kauai
review_text: Great family owned and run business. Greeted by Ellen at check-in. Very friendly. Met with Bruce and went to the plane. Great flight and great scenery during the flight. It was an even better flight because I learned some new techniques to use back home. Great operation, Highly recommend flying with this team.

Fantastic way to see the island!  We saw a 360 rainbow around the plane and a whale swimming below.  Perfect!  Thought it was great information about the island and with some music cues for areas that were used in films.

お天気に恵まれ素晴らしい体験でした。1日目、2日目とレンタカーてドライブしていましたが、空からしか見えないところが沢山ありました。島の中央には雲がかかっていたので、沢山虹も見ることができました。ホントに感動です。
スタッフの方もとても感じが良くて、フレンドリーでした。英語があまり理解できなかったので片言の日本語で話しかけてくれました。
ヘリコプターを最初は申し込みしたのですが、満席でエアーバンにしたのですが、料金も約半額という事もあり、こちらを選択してよかったです。

review_title: A Great Flight with Great Weather!!!
review_text: We had a great flight with Josh as our pilot.  Their shuttle picked us up on time at the ABC store and after a short drive we arrived at their facility at Lihue Airport.  After the preflight we boarded the plane and were off an an awesome air tour of Kauai. The skies were clear that day and we had a great view from the mountains to the sea. Waimea canyon was indescribable as was the Napali coast. We felt the trip exceeded our expectations!

review_title: A fantastic Fly over this wonderful island like a soaring bird.
review_text:
I love helicopters but I must say this fixed wing flight from this altitude was simply magical. It was a magnificent way to see the beauty of this island. We took the first flight of the day, Grand Deluxe tour on the Airvan.
 
Not being aware cloud cover early morning is suppose to be prevalent, we reached the airport basking in glorious sunshine to meet our wonderful pilot and tour guide Bruce. The tour was just over an hour of great pleasure with a surprise waiting for us when we returned.

Bruce with his wealth of knowledge of the island, the information was free flowing from the headsets, Bruce packed in refreshments and chocolate bars for the tour, a nice touch. Oh not to mention the Airvan was an Australian made plane, from Victoria, so we felt very comfortable after hearing that.

A must do in Kauai, a great, different and costeffective way to see whole of this magical island.
My first time flying in a small plane. Was pretty nervous at first, but the skill of the pilot, and the scenery below calmed me down.  Love it, only way to see the whole island.

Thanks Capt Josh for a wonderful flight.  We had a private charter for 4.  Weather was perfect for a 230pm flight.  Saw the island from a completely different perspective.  We felt much safer in a plane than in a helicopter, and more affordable.  We have so many awesome photos and a video too.  Staff and service is excellent and personable.  Must do!!!

We booked this flight as we were only in Kauai for one day of our cruise. The booking process was easy, no deposit or charges upfront, and excellent email communication throughout. We were picked up close to the cruise ship and taken to the airport. We were then told what the weather was like, shown pictures of the weather patterns, and given plenty of opportunity to decide what we wanted to see - we chose to stick to areas without much cloud/weather. The flight was our family only - a really huge perk given that we had 2 young children and didn't have to stress about them disturbing anyone! Bruce was amazing - totally put us all at ease, made the whole flight interactive, and genuinely seemed to enjoy every minute of it! We saw amazing coastline, beaches, canyon, mountains, even our ship! The kids were totally blown away and this was a highlight of our trip! The pictures and dvd made it even more special - I would definitely do this flight again!

We just flew with Capt Bruce this week...a wonderful experience.   Being fearful of flying, Bruce put me at ease and made me feel safe.   The views were phenomenal, the service was very friendly and professional and the tour vey informative.  Definitely recommend  Wings  over Kauai

We enjoyed a fun and beautiful tour of the island from Bruce who has lived in Kauai for 19 years.  He is not only an excellent pilot but full of information on everything we saw.  Everyone had a window seat and the plane was quiet and comfortable.  Definitely recommend this tour for a birds eye view of one of the most beautiful places we've visited.

We had an amazing time on our "Badger Flight 101" with Bruce.  Turned out the the other couple on our flight was also from Wisconsin and they knew a cousin of my partner.  Small world.  Bruce was so knowledgeable of the island.  It was a great idea to fly over the island early in our trip so we could see some hot spots that we wanted to get to.  Bruce was friendly and an amazing pilot.  We had a very difficult landing with windy conditions and he nailed it.  I would highly recommend Bruce and his "Wings over Kauai" team to anyone visiting the island.  We even got a bonus DVD of a shortened flight over the island.  Will definitely share that with our friends at home.  Great idea and great trip!!

On a whim, while visiting the island, I contacted wings over Kauai to see if I could get some mountain flying instruction. What I got was more than I could have hoped for. I flew with Bruce, who was a great host, tour guide and instructor. The experience was friendly, informative and beautiful! Whether you're a pilot looking to learn something new or just looking for a beautiful tour of the island, wings over Kauai is the best you'll find!
We had a private flight with Bruce and he was great, very friendly and chatty and so was his daughter who ckecked us in.Saw loads of gorgeous Kauai. Absolutely recommend it!

This is a fascinating way to see Kauai and with great pilots good narration and many fun facts it is absolutely worth it - not to mention that it is twice cheaper than the helicopter tours (we were 2 adults) . This was certainly money very well spent and I highly recommend it to everyone.  You have to remember if you have not seen Kauai from air - you have NOT seen Kauai. Wings over Kauai should be your top choice.
Loved every minute. Great way to see the interior of the island. Highly recommended. I only wish we had done it on the first day to better plan our stay after seeing where the best spots are.

review_title: Amazing way to see the island!
review_text: My mom, 4 year old son and I took the island tour with Wings over Kauai in mid March. We were only on the island for a few days and I wanted my mom to see as much of the island as she could with such a short trip. This was perfect! The company is so accommodating. When we checked in they gave us each a fresh flower, the booking party a kukui nut lei and pictures of us in front of the plane which were provided on a disc and via email after the flight concluded. The flight was great and Bruce, the pilot, so nice and informative. Would recommend this to anyone visiting the island to get a great overview of the island.

Four of us took the Wings over Kauai Air Tour around the Island last month.   I am a Commercial  Helicopter / Fixed Wing Pilot from Ohio but still chose the Wings over Kauai  Airplane over a helicopter for our tour.  The Wings over Kauai AirVan was the perfect airplane for the Island tour.  Bruce was great.

review_title: A great event with a perfect team!
review_text:
We booked the tour as a Birthday's event, being a group of four people. Not only was it an unforgettable trip over Kauai, but as well the whole team around Mary and in particular the pilot Bruce were very professional, polite and - in general - great guys! I write this as an Airbus Captain of Lufthansa German Airlines. As well the price had been in great relation to the 65 minutes flight time!
I can recommend this event without hesitation.

Ottima esperienza con questa compagnia, caratterizzata da organizzazione competenza e professionalità. Ottimo rapporto qualità/prezzo. Esperienza da non perdere.
Un grazie di cuore ad Ellen che ci ha organizzato il tutto on line e a Joshua che ci ha condotto in questa indimenticabile avventura. Grazie
Francesco, Roberta e Martina

We decided to get an overall view of Kauai our first day.  Choosing Wings Over Kauai was the ultimate experience!  After talking with others who took helicopter tours we know we made the best decision by going "fixed wing."  Bruce and his family are personally invested in the island and he filled the flight with information, personal experiences, and humor.  We couldn't have asked for a better introduction to the island.  And, the video received will enable us to share and recommend Wings to others.

This flight was a real highlight of our trip.  There were six of us, so we were able to have the six-passenger "Air-Van" all to ourselves at somewhat of a discount relative to the per person price. There were some schedule changes, but Dori in their office was very accommodating and made it work. We took the flight the first day after arriving.  The areal view really oriented us to the layout of the island.

The weather was exceptional. Visibility was great, very few clouds or haze; you could see entirely across the island as well as the mountain tops.  The water was flat and clear, so we could see the sand and the coral under the surface. Just after take-off we saw a whale swimming near the surface with its calf. The pilot, Captain Josh, made a 360 degree turn around this sight, so we could get a good view. We saw many other whales, but from a greater distance.

The take-offs and landings were extremely smooth, and turns were all gentle and even.  If you want more of a thrill ride, you might choose the helicopters, which fly much lower and closer to the sights. We had some nervous fliers who are prone to air sickness, so the plane ride was just right for us.  It was exhilarating due to the views, not the motion.

Captain Josh was friendly, knowledgeable and fun. We felt very safe and comfortable. He point out many sights, related many anecdotes and answered all our questions. We wore microphoned headsets and were all able to hear each other.  Josh ran a Hawaiian and movie themed sound tract that we enjoyed very much.  Since the route is primarily a clockwise circle of the island, he doubled back on a couple of occasions, so the the people on the left side of the plane would also get good views. He also navigated up canyons where both sides had good views.

The plane is equipped with about six GoPro cameras, including one wide-angle camera inside the cockpit.  They construct a video with a soundtrack of the entire trip and video that includes interior and exterior views.  We bought the 1080P copy of the video and are very happy we did. What a great memory!

I would happily take this same flight again.

user_location: Pearl River, New York, United States
review_title: This Private Pilot had the Time of Her Life!!
review_text: My husband and I just visited Hawaii for the first time,  and one of my ultimate dreams as a pilot was to fly over the Hawaiian Islands!! I found Wings Over Kauai and my ultimate dream became a reality!! This wonderful family owned tour company in Kauai, run by Bruce and Ellen Coulombe, gave me the most thrilling experience of my life! I was in the pilot's seat of a wonderful Cessna 172 flying over the most beautiful breathtaking sites I had ever seen,  accompanied by owner and chief pilot Bruce Coulombe! He was extremely experienced, described every beautiful part of the island in depth and an absolute joy to fly with! From the moment we took off, he gave me complete freedom to enjoy my flight to the fullest! Bruce is a wonderful, personable and experienced pilot who made my whole flying experience fantastic!! I had absolutely the most AWESOME time of my life....it was a dream come true!!  I cannot say enough good things about Wings Over Kauai!! These wonderful memories will stay with me forever!! Thank you Bruce & Ellen!

We decided to fly with Wings over Kauai as an alternative to a helicopter tour.  We are so glad we did as it was the best adventure we experienced during our vacation in Kauai.  The reception was terrific and we were made to feel very comfortable and safe.  Josh, our pilot/tour guide was very friendly and knew everyone’s names.  He pointed out all the landmarks along the way and which movies were filmed in each area. That morning we were worried about visibility, as it was a cloudy day, but Josh flew under the clouds the whole way around the island so we could easily see all the sights. While the helicopters actually go into the valleys of Na Pali, the plane provides a picture perfect “from a distance” view.  Highly recommended.

We cannot say enough good things about Wings.  From the moment you arrive until the moment you leave, everyone does everything they can to make the experience memorable.   

The greeting at the front desk was very warm (thanks Dori!), and each person we interacted with took time to learn our names (including correct pronunciation) and a bit about us.  There were also other personalized touches and mini-surprises throughout the trip, which made it even more enjoyable.

We flew with Captain Josh, and he was fantastic.  The take-off and landing were extremely smooth, and the flight itself was unexpectedly comfortable.  Josh showed us all the major sights, gave us as much information as we wanted throughout, and was overall a very knowledgeable guide.  He even pointed out a whale that was swimming and circled it so we could get a better view.  Music was playing throughout, which was perfectly coordinated with what we were seeing.   

Thanks so much for a wonderful experience!  We definitely appreciated all the small touches that you gave to each part of our visit.

My wife and I flew with Bruce in the Cessna. Immediately on takeoff, we saw a whale breach. The sights that followed were just awesome.  The price is about half the helicopter tour. Well worth the money to get to go through the canyons and Napali coast. Bruce and his wife were very friendly.

review_title: Cannot imagine what could have been better...
review_text: Flew with Bruce and my family of five, kids aged 12, 8 and 3.  All of the kids loved it, maybe not as much as my wife and I.  Bruce was very informative and genuine in his love for what he does - fly people to see some of the most stunning places on the island.  The ride was smooth, no sickness whatsoever even with a few bumps.  To see what we saw would have required a few days of trips around the island - all completed from the best view (some that you cannot see by hiking or by car) with a great captain.  And we got to choose a co-captain, would recommend to anyone.

My wife and I were on our honeymoon and we decided to finish our trip to Kauai by doing an aerial tour. We found Wings Over Kauai on Trip Advisor and we are very glad that we did. Bruce and Ellen were very nice and accommodating. Bruce (our pilot) was GREAT. He took us to all the great spots and made sure we had great pictures. My wife got to sit in the co-pilot seat and so she had a blast. Can't recommend it enough. They book up fast.

Excellent company and tour. Bruce the company owner and our pilot was very personable and knowledgeable. If safety is a concern, fly a fixed wing aircraft. The GA8 is an awesome plane for sightseeing.

This organization has it all together, from the owners down to the pet dogs. They are all user friendly and seem to all love their jobs. From the minute you step into the office until the time you step off the aircraft you immediately feel inclusive and a valued customer. Everyone showed us a high degree of professionalism and our pilot Josh was picture perfect with knowledge of the island and skill. Helecopters are fun but this is one step beyond that for sure if you've never tried it, and it's half the price. You won't be disappointed. GREAT JOB EVERYONE!!! We had a wonderful vacation and what a away to end it. Thank you and the great people from "Big C Island Tours" who arranged this for us.

Great way to see the island of Kauai. Booked this for the first day we got there, Bruce is a great host typical of Kauai hospitality. He shares his knowledge of the plane, places to eat and the best places on the island which keeps you entertained for the whole time you are on board. Considering it was a cloudy and windy day Bruce did a good job minimising bumps and dips so no need to worry about motion sickness. A good way to start or end your holiday on Kauai

Our family had the opportunity to fly with Josh around Kauai and it was THE highlight of our trip to the island.  From the time we booked the flight with Ellen until to the time we left, we were treated like royalty!  Everyone involved with Wing Over Kauai are completely professional, accommodating, and caring enough to ensure you experience the very best view and tour of Kauai.  We chose this company based on exceptional reviews, and personal discussions of aircraft v. helo rides.  
As an air force pilot, I'm very discriminating and selective with whom I place my family's safety and care during adventure trips such as this.  Relax and know that they are top-notch across the board; a very safe G8 aircraft and exceptional airmanship discipline by Josh.  We had a ball - thank you very much to the entire organization.  We will be back next year!

review_title: A must do when visiting Kauai
review_text:
My wife, little girl, and I went on a flight with Bruce (one of the owners) today and we had an extremely enjoyable time. I am a qualified pilot, so when the opportunity arose for me to do all of the flying Bruce was more than happy for me to do so as he is a qualified instructor. It goes without saying that the views are very different from the air, and although there are many different flying operators who offer this type of service I would highly recommend Wings Over Kauai. 

Not all of Kauai is accessible by vehicle, this was the best way to get up close and personal and see parts of the island, specifically the northern parts, that are largely untouched and extremely beautiful. Highly recommended, will definitely do again next time I come to Kauai.

There is so much of Kauai that you can only appreciate by air, so if you're putting in the effort to visit this beautiful island, an aerial tour is a must. 

And if you're going up, make sure to go with Wings Over Kauai. It's so clear why they have such high ratings: they love what they do, and work hard to take amazing care of their customers. We had such a wonderful time, it was truly the highlight of the trip!

Highly, highly recommended!

Dori and Captain Bruce are the best! We booked with Wings Over Kauai after reading the reviews on TripAdvisor and it was really an 'A' experience. We initially wanted to book only for the 2 of us but there were no dates available, so we took the Airvan Tour option. We were 4 plus Captain Bruce, and it still felt intimate and special. We really enjoyed all the stories and explanations of the different corners of Kauai that Bruce shared with us. Totally recommend it, book with Wings Over Kauai.

Picture perfect describes our tour!  Captain Bruce was fantastic and very informative.  We did this our first day on the island and it was great to get the layout of the land.  The views Captain Bruce showed us were unbelievable!  Kauai is "unreal" beautiful and Captain Bruce was a great host!

We had a wonderful experience with Wings Over Kaui. From the first phone call everyone we dealt with was pleasant and helpful. I don't really like to fly so I was nervous about being on a small plane. I'm so glad I was being brave for my husband's sake. It was fabulous! We had a beautiful clear morning and it was magical. Kaui is so beautiful and you must see it from the air. The flight was very smooth and Josh gave great commentary. It is obvious that he loves Kaui and by the end of the flight you will too.
Make sure you get the DVD. It will be a great reminder of paradise when you go back to the real world.

We booked this just before leaving the UK for our cruise around the Hawaiian Islands. We had not decided what we were going to do on this island and left it late to make the decision. The day was almost fully booked but we found an early flight with seats available. I would suggest booking early rather than later. This flight was taken on 12th March on my wife's birthday as a day to remember. Josh our pilot did an incredible job, the views were perfect and commentary excellent. I got to sit in the co-pilots seat with my wife directly behind. We all had good views through the windows as we each had our own and we returned with some great pictures as well. The weather was also perfect with sun and blue skies with some cloud over the higher mountains, which produced the rainbows. We decided a plane trip was the best way to see as much of Kauai island as possible as we were only there for a day and half. We purchased the video as a download and have watched this already as soon as we returned home and will look forward to sharing this with our family and friends.

Josh and Dori are fantastic host! We had an unforgettable ecoerience! We got to see parts of the island you can only see by plane. We considered taking a boat tour to see the coast, but decided to take the air tour. It was worth every penny😄

review_title: Great way to see Kauai from above
review_text: I can't say enough good things about the flight tour my wife and I took with Wings over Kauai.  We did the small plane so it was just my wife and I and Bruce, our pilot.  It was a really windy day in Kauai and that concerned us a little that our flight would be bumpy but it was actually very smooth, only hit a few little patches of roughness.  So if you get motion sickness there isn't a need to worry about it on this flight.  Bruce gave us top notch customer service from before we got on the flight to the end where he gave us a packet of recommendations of things to do on Kauai.  The flight was just over an hour and takes you around the entire island and Bruce gives you some history and insight on what you are looking at.  If you are going to see Kauai from the sky I would highly recommend taking a tour with Wings Over Kauai.

Had a great flight with Captain Josh. I sat in the co-pilot's seat, had great views of Kauai from the front and side windows. I was able to take many great photos, especially happy with the pics of Hanalei Bay, where you get to see many shades of blue water. The air was a bit rough, but Josh was able to find better air for us, no aloha bags needed. I told Josh I was a golfer, so he pointed out several courses for me to see, especially Kauai Lagoons, which I had just played. We bought the Blue Ray of our flight, very cool to see the trip again as well as some shots of us in the cabin. 
Highly recommended!

WOW! During our stay on Kauai, we managed to do a boat tour, a plane flight and we rented a car to drive around the island. I have to say that the flight with the plane provided by Wings Over Kauai was by far the most thrilling, adventurous and memorable experience! The trip was a little over an hour, the pilot was so experienced, talking to us about the sites we flew over, telling us stories and pointing out various points of interests. We landed on Kauai at 10am, and went for the tour at 12.30pm. BEST DECISION EVER! We saw Kauai and the Napali Coast for the first time and boy it was the best way to do it! I will never EVER forget this experience. 
Note: We also got a CD with a video of a similar trip to ours; they took a pic of us in front of the plane and emailed it to us within an hour (for those of you that cannot wait to instagram things) gave us lei and a hair flower upon arrival, and provided refreshments during the flight!
** The helicopter rides are more popular but also WAY shorter (15-20 min) and also WAY more expensive due to their  higher insurance policies.

We booked this flight as it was cheaper than many of the helicopter rides. Highly recommend seeing Kauai from the sky. What a spectacular part of the world. Bruce was knowledgeable and enthusiastic Bruce provides refreshments to help ease any stomach issues and warning after an hour you may be ready land. We were both feeling a bit queasy. Well worth it though.

review_title: Took My Grandma and she had a blast!
review_text:
I was worried it would be too short of a trip, with great conditions it was perfect length, not too short not too long.

Most important, my dream/goal/bucket list was to take my grandma on a flight around Kauai, she is elderly and did just fine even with few rollercoaster feel bumps. She fully enjoyed herself. So if you are elderly and are thinking about this you should prob be fine. I think its much easier to deal with compared to say helicopters for older folk. Blessings and Aloha!

WOW!  This was such an awesome experience.  It is a family run business and they know how to make you feel like family.  Captain Bruce took myself and another couple on the tour around the island.  We all had an incredible time.  Friendly, knowledgeable, affordable... I can't say enough good things about the experience.  I will be telling family and friends about Wings Over Kauai.

My family of 4 booked a Wings Over Kauai tour and had a fantastic time. The pilot was very friendly and knowledgeable, and it was a great way to see the island. Very smooth flight and we got a much better view of Waimea Canyon than we did by driving. After the flight they provide a short generic complimentary DVD, but you can also purchase a full-length DVD of your flight (includes all the conversations you had with the pilot and all the music) that you can pick up or they can mail to you. We were lucky and got to see a pod of whales the day we flew...it was so cool, we bought the DVD.

review_title: Great way to start our time
review_text:
Amazing value, great hospitality and service.

Safe, trustworthy and reliable.

Got to see Na'pali coast and Waimea Canyon at beginning of trip.

Pilot was nice enough to find and show us whales when we asked.

Best part of entire trip to Kaua'i.

Highly recommend, no question why they are number 1.

review_title: Feledhetetlen, csodálatos élmény mindenkinek látnia kellene :)
review_text: Nagyon szimpatikus kapitány Bruce és csapata olyan utánozhatatlanés felejthetetlen élményt nyújt, amivel átvészelhetőek a szürke hétköznapok is....

review_title: Better and smoother than helicopter tours
review_text: Helicopter tours, while fun, can be a bit of a thrill ride. The fixed wing plans used by this company offer a much smoother ride. You fly almost completely around Kauai. Visiting many sites including the Na Pali Coast and Waimea Canyon. We saw the Spouting Horn and several beaches. Very enjoyable, affordable way to see this magnificent island from a different vantage point. Pilot was very polite and informative. The company takes your photo in front of the plane and emails it to you. And they offer pick up if you are coming from the cruise ship. Excellent experience.

Wir hatten einen privaten Flug (2 Personen) gebucht. Gleich bei unserer Ankunft wurden wir mit einer hawaiianischen Halskette von einer Mitarbeiterin begrüsst. Sie gab uns ein kurzes Briefing über die geplante Flugroute und dann konnte es schon losgehen. 

Wir sind mit einer kleinen Cessna geflogen. Bruce, unser Pilot war wunderbar und hat uns immer wieder Informationen über die Insel gegeben. Er hat den Rundflug bereits über 6.000 Mal durchgeführt - das hat man auch gemerkt. Trotz nicht optimalem Wetter (sehr windig) war der Flug prima und wir haben viel gesehen.

Insgesamt waren wir 65 Minuten in der Luft. Wir können den Flug mit Wings over Kauai uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen. Es war ein einmaliges Erlebnis!

review_title: Skip the helicopter tour...this is a must!
review_text: We loved this trip! Josh was our pilot. The ride is amazing and we saw the whole island. He offered much more than just a tour. We were able to ask questions and he pointed out things to go see and best ways to do them! Owners are wonderful! Excellent small business. Great communication from reservation through photo sent by email. Attention to detail and still a fun experience!
This is a great way to see the island in an hour. Bruce was great and very experienced with over 6,000 flights. WOW!  Highly recommended.

review_title: A great option to see all of Kauai
review_text: The reviews for Wings over Kauai were spot on.  Dori and Captain Josh were awesome.   The original day we scheduled for the flight was very windy and they allowed us to reschedule which was a blessing as the skies were clear and the the ride was smooth as silk on the day we flew.  Josh is an excellent pilot and tour guide.  We were blessed to see and photograph whales from the air, many water falls and some of the most amazing views in the world.   This is the best way to see all of Kauai and highly reccomend wings over kauai.

review_title: Awesome way to see the island!!!
review_text: We had a great time on the flight!  The pilot Josh does an amazing job providing the tour along with an audio soundtrack while he flies the plane.  We got recommendations on beaches for snorkeling and the best places to eat from Josh along the way.  We would also recommend purchasing the DVD of your flight, at the time we weren't sure if we'd ever watch it, but it is so good that we have watched it multiple times with friends and family.

review_title: This is a MUST in your Kauai vacation plans, I'm so glad we did it!
review_text:
First, this business is one of the best examples of great customer service that I've ever seen.
They make the tour an amazing experience, from the very moment you step into their counter. The air ride is unbelievable, and Josh (our pilot) makes it super fun and informative. We are a family of four and we all loved it!!!
Hats off to Bruce and Ellen, you guys could do trainings on how to provide perfect customer service!

I have already traveled to many places, but I must say that was the best tour of my entire life.  Val and Josh make you feel like being home.
That was my first time on a small plane. I was a bit afraid, but Josh was so careful that it is impossible to be afraid of anything. For sure the smoothest flight of my life.
Flying over Kauai is like dreaming. You will see wonderful beaches, canyons, forests and even whales (depending on the season). It is a must do while in Hawaii.
Took a land tour by the morning up to 3 pm and then went to Wings Over Kauai Office to the 4 pm flight. I was on a day trip to Kauai from Oahu and can say the plane tour is far better than the land tour. 
At the end of the tour received some pictures and a DVD with no extra charge. Thanks Val and Josh!!

My family and I had a great time with Wings Over Kauai.  The plane was perfect for the 5 of us.  Josh was great and the music was a nice addition to the trip. Beautiful views of the Na Pali coast and we even saw a whale.

review_title: We did this on our first day on the Island...
review_text: Wings over Kauai is a family owned and operated business that hit the mark at every point. Great value vs. a Helicopter, about half of the cost and much more comfortable. Great customer service. They operate out of the Lihue Airport so we booked a flight on the afternoon of our arrival which gave us a "high level" view of the Island and helped us plan the rest of our visit.

Easily a 5-star experience!  If you are visiting Kauai, I highly recommend a Wings Over Kauai air tour.  I was really looking forward to this experience for months, and it didn't disappoint.  Why Wings Over Kauai?  First, sightseeing by air is the the best way to see the island.  You simply can't see the beauty of the island any other way.  Second, I like the idea of traveling via fixed-wing aircraft versus a helicopter.  The flight is smoother and quieter.  Third, when I saw Bruce's credentials, I was convinced the tour would be very educational (it was).  Fourth, it was approximately half the cost of a helicopter.  Who doesn't like saving a few bucks?  I found everyone associated with this company to be very friendly, informative, and professional.  We flew in the Cessna, and Bruce was our tour guide.  He was fantastic.  Bruce is highly educated and experienced.  He made my wife and I very comfortable, as though we were old friends.  He even shared some very personal experiences with us.  He's just that kind of guy.  Now, he did tell us that we were very lucky with the weather.  So I can't guarantee you'll have a great flying day weather-wise, but I am sure that you will be very pleased with how you are treated.  Please consider touring with Wings Over Kauai--you won't be disappointed.

review_title: Our final day in paradise, what a beautiful ending.
review_text: We had booked a air tour with "Wings" that had to be cancelled due to strong winds. Even though it looked as if the "airbus" tours were full on our final day, this company had an opening and we had a wonderful tour with the owner/pilot, Bruce. From the Kakau necklace presented before we boarded to the great desciptions while we flew, our flight was amazing and beautiful. Mahalo

review_title: Just amazing. By far the most fun excursion we booked.
review_text: If you have the opportunity to travel to Kauai the one "must thing" to do is book a tour of the island by air.  We chose the small plane versus the helicopter because it was much cheaper and you get to see the same sights.  Our pilot was great, full of information.  We flew out over the ocean and saw whales surfacing.  It was an experience you don't get from a boat whale watching tour.  The whole experience was hassle free.  My wife and I purchased the video recording as a souvenir.  I look forward to showing the beautiful scenery to family and friends.  We had perfect weather and ride was smooth with little turbulence.  I wholeheartedly recommend taking this trip.  Take into account the airplane only seats 6 and the cabin is a bit cramped but not unmanageable.  I brought my Canon T5i camera with 40mm wide angle pancake lense which worked out well.  I don't recommend bringing long telephoto lenses because of space limitations in the cabin.

This was our first visit to Kauai and with only four days on the island we wanted to see as much of the island as possible. We decided on a scenic flight and after careful deliberation chose Wings Over Kauai. From check-in to disembarkation this was a truly wonderful and very personal experience. Captain Josh and his team made us feel welcome right from the beginning. The check-in/weigh-in process was very friendly and informal and then it was time to fly. It was a windy day but Captain Josh was very competent and made us feel comfortable and safe. We took in all the sights of the Garden Isle to his commentary, accompanied by a tasteful selection of music. We even did a few extra loops above the sea to observe breaching whales. Josh remembered all our names, engaged with us individually over the intercom and answered our questions. This was what made our experience with Wings over Kauai so special and what sets the company apart from similar providers we had used in the past. Photos and a video of our flight were offered for sale but there was no pressure at all to buy anything. In fact, we came home to an email from the team with our group shot in front of the plane. I highly recommend Wings over Kauai and send a big Mahalo to Captain Josh and his crew.

I am a professional pilot from the main land. The only state i hadn't landed in was Hawai'i. I emailed months Wings Over Kauai, a family run business, before our trip and got a very friendly answer from Ellen. Since I am a pilot , Bruce let me do the flying and I flew the tour route. Kauai is absolutely beautiful from the air and Bruce is super knowledgeable of the entire area. Flying the Cessna 172 is half the cost of the helicopter tours. The flight was a blast. Worth every penny.

Bruce was amazing at making sure I was comfortable during the flight as I'm apprehensive of small aircraft. He made sure that we saw everything possible and provided so much local history and information. Amazing to see this beautiful island from the air. Would not hesitate to recommend Wings over Kauai!

My boyfriend and I wanted to do a helicopter ride, but they were so expensive. We read the great reviews about Wings Over Kauai and decided to give it a shot. 
Our experience was amazing! It was rainy, so we were worried that we wouldn't see anything, but the clouds made the view that much better!! We were low enough to still have great views and had such a great time. This company is SO thoughtful and helpful. We thoroughly enjoyed our experience and have recommended our family and friends to use than next time.

review_title: Wings Over Kauai was a fantastic value
review_text: Captain Bruce did a great job helping all in our group feel at ease before and during the flight.    Bruce's knowledge of Kauai was excellent and surely added to the enjoyment of our flight.  Bruce was very personable and humourous and helped us feel that he really cared that we had a good time.  The plane was very comfortable and stable and provided great views of the Best of Kauai...including the whales!

review_title: An affordable , but first rate experience
review_text: My husband and I very much wanted to take an flight over Kauai but could not justify the price of a helicopter. Ann at Tom Barefoot's Excursions helped us find Wings Over Kauai and we could not have been more pleased. Ellen , one of the owners, transported us to the clean modern little airport  and presented us with leis. We were briefed on our flight and it was very obvious that these are people very serious about safety.  No matter how you view the island from the air , it is spectacular and we were flown over all the memorable scenic locations. They even gave us a unexpected present- a dvd and a photo of our flight!

I can't say enough good things about our experience with Wings Over Kauai. Everyone we interacted with was so friendly and welcoming. Our pilot Josh was very knowledgeable about the geography and history of Kauai. The views are out-of-this-world and so much of the island, like the incredible Na Pali coast, can really only be appreciated by air. They take photos of you with the plane and email them to you. We were a little leery about motion-sickness but Josh was really skilled and they do have a cooler with soda and ginger candies if you are feeling queasy. Would do it again in a heartbeat.

We just arrived on the island a few days ago and decided to start our trip off with Wings Over Kauai....best decision yet! We flew with Josh who was a wonderful pilot and very informative. He did an excellent job including everyone in the tour and making it a personal experience. 
He made a few special loops around when we saw whales surfacing and again when we told him we'd be hiking the Kalalau Trail next week...so fun to see the beach we'll be hiking to! 
Our pilot's wife, Dori, was so sweet. She went over safety info at check-in and was kind enough to take our photo in front of the plane and then email it to us afterwards.
The tour provided so much amazing history and culture, not to mention the best views of the island! It truly is the greatest way to take it all in. A must-do in Kauai!

My husband and I are living in Oahu for a few months for work and took a weekend over to Kauai. With limited time we knew this was the thing to do! We went our last day and the weather was amazing! 230 flight time made for nice lighting! Bruce was so personable and involved everyone in the plane (all four of us) in the flight and in conversation. I would recommend this to anyone! HALF the cost of a helicopter AND can accommodate larger people! (330 lbs) Everyone has a window seat and gets a surprise at the end. Loved every second!

Flight 11.00 on 23 January. The whole experience couldn't have been better. Bruce owns the company and was our pilot. He is a very interesting,  personable man with an outstanding knowledge of his, obviously,  dearly beloved island. He was also great at interacting with his four passengers. The 65 minutes flight was terrific.  We went everywhere and gained an appreciation of Kauai which can only be achieved from the air. We were so glad we made this choice of company and that we did not opt for the helicopter option. Taking everything into account, including collection from the port which we specifically requested, it was very good value. If you are thinking about booking with Wings over Kauai, do it. You will be glad you did. Thanks Bruce.

review_title: Great experience with Wings Over Kauai - highly recommended
review_text: We took a flight around Kauai with Bruce (the owner/pilot) in the smaller Cessna 172 and had a great time.  I'm a student pilot and sought out WOK because Bruce is a certified flight instructor and they the Cessna is the same plane I'm training in.  We got two great experiences for the price of one - my daughter and a friend got a great aerial tour of the island and I got a flying lesson all in one package.  We visited in January so we had to wrestle with uneven weather.  We ended up rescheduling our flight twice (the right safety decision) with courteous ongoing communications with the staff.  I've taken the Blue Hawaiian helicopter tour in the past and thought it would be unlikely that we could cover the terrain in a light plane as well.  Bruce proved me wrong.

review_title: An excellent view of beautiful Kauai
review_text: Our tour on the Air Bus at Wings Over Kauai was a wonderful experience.  It was the last thing we did before leaving the island and it was cool to see all the places we'd driven around during the week from the air.  Bruce was a great pilot and seemed to know everything about the island.  We highly recommend this!

We have visited Kauai for a number of years but this was our first flight around the island - why did we wait so long! This was without a doubt one of the best tours that we have taken anywhere in the world. From the initial booking through check-in, the flight itself and the end of the tour everyone from the owners, Ellen and Bruce, through to our pilot Josh was friendly, informative and professional. The plane with individual headsets and communication between the passengers and with Josh was quiet and comfortable, and the views, including the Canyon, Hanalei Bay,  the whales and sharks below, and much more were spectacular. Josh was a great pilot, very informative and had a great sense of humour. As others have mentioned, the plane is equipped with multiple go-pro cameras and the extra $50 for the video of the flight enabled me to focus on the views without having to worry all the time about taking pictures - it was available for download when we arrived home 2 days later and was well worth it. The whole experience was great value for money!

review_title: Best way to see the island!
review_text: You definitely want this on your "To Do While in Kaui" list. This was a great way to see Kaui. Our pilot Bruce was a great tour guide as he flew us around the island of Kaui. We got a close up view of the Waimea Canyon, the Napli Coast, Wailua waterfall, whales in the ocean below and full range of

Als Flugschüler wählte ich den "Instructional Flight" und wir genossen eine wirklich gelungene Mischung aus Flugstunde & "Scenic Flight" (wie könnte das auf Deutsch heißen? Aussichts-Flug?).

Bruce war ein ebenso guter Fluglehrer wie Touristen-Führer. Man merkt ihm seine Tausende Flugstunden auf der Insel an, was nicht zuletzt den Eindruck der Sicherheit stärkt.

Besonders stolz ist er scheinbar auf die paar Brocken Deutsch, die er beherrscht. Die reichen immerhin, um in 2.500 ft über dem Drehort von "Jurassic Park" Ende Januar "Oh Tannenbaum" anzustimmen ;-). Aber auch ansonsten ist die Kommunikation, selbst mit eher bescheidenen Englisch-Kenntnissen, kein Problem.  

Nur eine Warnung: naturgemäß wird es in so einer kleinen Maschine bisweilen holpriger, als man das aus der gewerblichen Luftfahrt gewohnt ist. Wenn man dann noch krampfhaft versucht, alle Eindrücke, die auf einen einströmen, bildlich festzuhalten, kann dies schnell zum Gebrauch der Spucktüten führen.

Our party of 4 took this amazing tour on Jan 10, 2015.  Josh was absolutely great--very entertaining and knowledgeable.  We took a helicopter tour last year with another company and Wings over Kauai is by far superior!! The weather was perfect making our tour so awesome. I can't stress enough what a gem WOK is---the staff, the affordability of the tour, the safety of the aircraft. We purchased the CD of our tour and have viewed it several times already! It is truly an experience that will never be forgotten--an absolute must to view the most beautiful island from the air.  Again, thank you so much for such a wonderful experience.  Mahalo!!

We flew on Wings over Kauai today with three other guests and Josh as our pilot.  The weather was good - not too many clouds between us and unique views of paradise.  Josh was an excellent pilot and guide to the fabulous scenery - pointing out flora, fauna, points of interest, geological facts, many waterfalls, and historical facts.  We saw humpback whales, monk seals, large crashing waves on the north shore, Tow surfers, and glorious views of Mt. Wai'ale'ale.  Flightseeing is a wonderful way to see the beauty of this mostly pristine island (while providing an aerial view of other highlights).  Brilliant!

We were hesitant to book because they use a small plane, not a helicopter, but it worked out well for us coz my husband was on the copilot seat, me at the back. The left side was not all bad because there were things I didn't see from my side but right is still better than left.  The plane had multiple go-pros attached so if you can shell out $30-50 more ($30 dvd, $50 bluray/downloadable), you can just forget about taking pictures yourself and focus on looking out the window and soak it all in. 
I think this is the best deal in Lihue, but if there's only 2 of you and want to guarantee yourselves good seats, consider paying $20 extra for the private tour. Cheers WOK, we had a great time!
Supernette Leute, ausgezeichnete Sicherheit, machte Flug 30min. länger um uns noch Zusätzliches zu zeigen. Eindeutig bestes Preis-Leistungsverhältnis.

My friend and I visited Kauai with "Wings Over Kauai". We spent only one afternoon and one night on the island because of our flight and with this air trip we saw the entire island and more than we hopped see just with a car. For me it was the most beautiful trip in the Hawaiians islands. You can discover so many different landscapes such as a canyon, a mountain covers by a tropical forest where water falls take source. A part of the mountain finish on the ocean - you can acces there only with long and hard walking - this is beautiful ! If you go don't miss it, this is unforgettable !
This tour is managed by a family who is so kind and makes you confortable as much as possible. They offer you some surprises. They just make this trip because flying is their passion and never because of the money, they only share a wonderful trip with you. 
My friend and I will remember this afternoon forever !
PS : This is true that I never take the time to write about my travel but here I feel that I won't be nice to share what I felt because it will be selfish to save this amazing experience only for me. 
Please don't think more about it, do it ! You won't regret it !
Great experience, do not let this pass you by. Bruce does a fabulous job of piloting and offering information on this unforgettable flight. Felt very safe the whole time. Highly recommended.

My family and I visited the island of Kauai over Christmas break and decided to see Kauai by air with Wings Over Kauai.  The flight was one my family will not soon forget.  We had wonderfully clear weather the whole 65 minutes.  Therefore, we were able to see many things,even the tops of the mountains.  Val and Josh were very kind and knowledgeable.  I was able to take some awesome pictures and the DVD we purchased on our flight is amazing.  Thank you so much for a wonderful experience.  My daughter was hesitant to fly in such a small aircraft; but she so happy that she took the chance.  She loved it!

My wife and I were going to do a helicopter tour but after reading reviews went with Wings. No regrets. Bruce was great. He's incredibly nice and personable. His recommendations made the rest of our trip. My wife was also able to take some pretty amazing pictures. Go Wings!

My son and I recently went up in the small cessna with Bruce, who is an awesome pilot by the way.  Bruce was very friendly and explained everything.  I felt very safe in Bruce's hands.  The views are out of this world and Kauai must be seen from the air to truly appreciate this island of paradise.  On the ground, Ellen took pictures of us before the flight and soon thereafter even emailed us the pictures.   At the end of the flight, Bruce provided us with tips on where to visit on the island and we even got a DVD of some of the aerial sceneries of what we saw from the air and more.    Definitely a highlight of our trip to Kauai.

review_title: Absolutely wonderful plane tour! Loved it! THANK YOU!!!!
review_text: This was a truly unforgettable experience!  We took an AirVan tour - the windows are huge, stunning views! The flight was very smooth,  we saw whales in the water - Cpt. Josh flew right over them. We can not wait to go back again. Staff is very friendly - thank you Bruce, Josh and Dori, and, of course - Millie the dog :-)
This was a great experience for all the family. I was very nervous but the pilot did a good job of reassuring me and made the flight comfortable. Reasonable priced and friendly staff.

What an amazing experience! Everyone gets a window seat, and Bruce was so friendly and knowledgeable! He really took the time to get to know each of us in order to personalize the tour. Beautiful views, great info and suggestions on what to see and do, and I felt safe the whole time. 5/5 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

We had a wonderful time on our flight with Wings Over Kauai! I had looked at helicopter tours as well, but we chose a fixed-wing flight because it's far safer (check out Kauai Underground Guide's table of helicopter tour fatalities, also because it's an awesome guide), it's half the price, and I had read reviews that the view you get from the helicopter tours is a 'luck of the draw' situation. 

We booked a 4 person AirVan Private Charter, the flight takes a sort of clockwise tour of the island so we were all seated on the left to ensure we all had excellent views. And excellent views we had! Whales, canyons, Na Pali coast, waterfalls, extinct volcanoes, river valleys...you name it, we saw it, and it was stunning. The bubble windows allow you to see below and above the plane, in addition to out to the side.

Bruce, a retired agronomist and our guide to the skies, seemed almost as excited to be on our flight as we were. He proved to be an incredibly talented pilot and knowledgeable (and entertaining) guide to the Garden Isle. I love flying, but my boyfriend and sister were a bit nervous about being in a small plane--if you are, don't let this stop you from booking with Wings Over Kauai! That was probably the smoothest flight I've ever been on.

During our booking process Ellen was extremely accommodating and responsive to emails. Our original tour date wound up being incredibly stormy, and we were able to reschedule for a sunny day. Do bear in mind that Kauai is subject to changeable and sometimes stormy weather, if it is not safe to fly your tour will be cancelled. Ellen will do all she can to reschedule your tour in such an event, but if your stay is short this may be difficult. So make sure you stay for awhile, because Kauai is absolutely amazing and a Wings Over Kauai flight shouldn't be missed!!

I went on a 2:30pm ride with my mom and brother this past Christmas, and the experience couldn't have been more amazing. It was my favourite excursion of our vacation!

Everyone was so friendly! I am unsure of the lady's name who was working at the desk, but she was very kind and helpful. Our pilot, Josh, was so friendly and knowledgeable - it really was amazing. The views were unbelievable, he circled round so we could see some whales in the water, and the Napali coast was amazing (as was everything!). I am STILL thinking about it, because it was so unbelievable. I would 100% book this tour again, and the complimentary cd (and pictures taken beforehand!) were a lovely welcomed bonus. I can't recommend enough!!

My wife and I decided to take the Wings Over Kauai tour with just us and the pilot, Bruce. We flew for about 1hour and 15 minutes and enjoyed great views of the entire island. We can't say enough how much we enjoyed flying with Bruce and his informative narrative. We would both highly recommend flying with Wings Over Kauai.

review_title: Don't waste your time with the other guys!
review_text: Since we had read 80% of Kauai can only be seen by air we decided this was the island to do a tour. Review after review of helicopters and their crazy prices had me reluctant. I was afraid we would spend $500 or $600 and be stuck in the middle. There was no middle on the plane! Everyone on a window and my hubby sat copilot. Bruce did a great job explaining what we were seeing and the whale watching from the plane was fantastic. Favorite part was being blow away by intelligent conversation beyond name, where we were from and hotel. Easily the most pictures of all 4 islands we went to in that one hour. All around fantastic experience.

user_location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
review_text: The flight over Kauai was great. The scenery was spectacular. The pilot was very knowledgable and personable. Staff was great. We felt safe and well cared for. Highly recommend.

Our trip started with our ship coming in late , I had kept in touch with the office and they worked with me very well. We had to push back the tour time because we came into port late. Also it was a rainy/ foggy day so we could not see the whole island our pilot Josh gave us a wonderful tour of all the rest of the island pointing out different things as we went along. He had to alter the original route, thus his normal routine but he kept us informed and entertained for the whole flight. I recommend this company because of the customer service that I received. They remember that it's the customer who drives their business and they show you just how much they value that.

Un magnifique vol avec Bruce comme pilote. Nous avons apprécier la beauté des paysages, l'ile de Kauai est peut être la plus idéale à survoler car encore très sauvage et inaccessible. Bruce et la femme qui nous a reçu étaient vraiment agréable, nous avons eu beaucoup d'informations pendant le vol sur ce que nous pouvions voir. 
L'avion s'approche bien sur moins que les hélicoptères mais aucun regret car on ne loupe rien du paysage et c'est moins cher.
