Nous avons pris le vol privatif à 2. Vraiment pas beaucoup plus cher que le vol à plusieurs. Je conseille vivement cette entreprise et Bruce aux commandes.

Not a big fan of flying but Bruce made me feel at ease and I did relax enough to love the flight. Fiance and I did the Cessna flight, I sat next to Bruce which assuaged my inner control freak a little.  Lovely,  smooth flight, breathtaking scenery,  so glad I braved it.

Our flight with Bruce was fantastic in every way.  He was a great pilot and the flight was smooth from takeoff to landing.  

He was very personable, walking us through both aspects of the plane to different sights of the island as we passed over them.  He pointed out waterfalls, picnic spots, and even climates and what caused them.  He's really knowledgeable about this stuff and it really enriched our experience.  

Lastly, Bruce took us out despite the other family for the flight canceling last minute.  We've had other activities cancel on us when they had clients withdraw, so it was great to not only still go but get a private tour to boot.  This is a really admirable business practice.

The staff at family owned business is very friendly. Bruce, our pilot is very engaging and made sure to engage us all and check that we were all comfortable. The headsets allow us to listen in on the chatter, as well as talk to each other, while keeping the engine noise to a minimum.

We got a private tour in the Airvan for our party of four. My son got to sit in the co-pilot's seat and read of the flight checklist. the rest of us got the 3 seats on the right side, which is the view-side. If you can, try and get a group of 4 together.

The take-off and landing were smooth, and the weather was nice for us to have a smooth flight (although my daughter did get air-sick before the end).

The views are great. Bruce provided a steady flow of information and history of the various areas we flew over.

At the end of the flight, we got a DVD of the flight route, made by the pilot's son. The video is quite well made.
 
Now for the downsides: Apparently, the passengers are greeted with a lei - we were'nt. We saw several helicopters flying lower and closer to the Napali coast and in the Waimea Canyon. So, if your party can handle the bumpier ride and higher costs of helicopters tours, you may want to consider those too. The hour long ride does feel too short. I wish it were atleast another 20-30 minutes longer, so that we could have spent more time in Waimea and along the Napali coast.

Still, it was a good experience.

We were considering doing a helicopter tour, but were hesitant to spend that much money.  When we found Wings Over Kauai, we decided it was a good way to see the island from above without dropping almost $500 for 2 of us.  We were very pleased with the experience and didn't at all regret not going on a helicopter.  You may not get as close as you do in a helicopter, but you get a full hour on the plane, a very knowledgeable pilot, and a unique perspective.  I would recommend Wings Over Kauai to anyone looking to get in the air and would say it's a specially good choice for anyone wanting to save money for other excursions or someone who wants a smoother ride than you would have in a helicopter.

We decided to book this tour because of the great reviews and the fact that it was half the price of the helicopters. The trip exceeded expectations. Bruce and Mary were extremely nice. I am a little bit of a nervous flyer, and I felt completely at ease as it was obvious that Bruce has a ton of experience. He was talkative, funny, and engaged everyone on the flight in conversation. The views of the island were breathtaking and Bruce provided a lot of information and history on everything we saw. I totally recommend this tour to anyone looking for a unique experience on Kauai!

One of the activities we most looked forward to on our vacation. We were right on the money. The scenery is breathtaking from the air. There is simply no other way to fully enjoy the beauty of Kauai without an air tour. Wings Over Kauai was excellent! Josh was our pilot and was engaging, funny and informative. Check in was easy and quick. We felt completely safe throughout the entire flight. The equipment was in good repair and clean. My entire family had a blast. If I ever have the opportunity to visit Kauai again, these guys will be who I call for my next air tour. We were very satisfied and felt we received a great product for the money spent.

Bruce greeted us with a warm friendly smile right off the bat, not far behind was sweet Mili the dog.  The females are given a lei & a plumeria for behind the ear. There are GoPro cameras attached in the cockpit & to the wings of the plane. You can buy the DVD or BluRay of your flight, which is highly recommended. Captain Josh was fantastic. He includes everyone into the conversation throughout the entire flight. The views are phenomenal. There are no words to describe how beautiful Kauai is from the air.
My family loved it!  Josh was great and really set the scene.  The cued music made it even that much better.  Great job!

review_title: One of the best tour companyies i have taken
review_text: I booked the tickets looking at reviews in Tripadvisor. Bruce was so good and showed us the island with all details and keeping the trip alive with funny jokes. He was so good and so polite. I havent gone on any helicopter ride but why to was 250$ when u acn enjoy the same views with half the price with a nice tour guide like bruce who shows all the best locations on the island. Loved the tour and the tour guide.

Our family of 6 and a two year old had the pleasure of flying over Kauai for an incredibly memorable 65 minute flight last week. It was a highlight of our 10 day visit for sure. It was a picture perfect day. We were able to take some awesome pics and videos.
Thanks Josh!!

It appears either you love this service or customer service ruins it for you. For my group, the customer service really let us down... right down to not being able to go on the flight at all. We arrived on time for our check in, went through the payment and weigh ins etc and were told to wait in the waiting section. At this stage, things were pleasant, they were joking around with us and it was a nice environment. We sat in the waiting area for around 45 minutes before the pilot came over to us to tell us there was an issue with the plane. He wasn't sure if he could get it running but was happy to keep trying if we were happy to wait. Being that he assured us that it was just getting the plane started that was the issue but once it was running it would be fine; we said we were happy to wait. That was until the other person who was trying to solve the issue basically said they had been trying for over 4 hours to get it working and there was no chance it would work. That they had called a mechanic in from Oahu to check it out. While I can appreciate planes do have mechanical issues, what I can't appreciate is wasting our time! If they had called before we checked in to let us know there was an issue, I could accept it. If we were told as we were checking in, that there was an issue and it was up to us whether we waited on the off chance they could get it working, I could accept it. But to be told nothing even though it was a known situation until well after our flight time is pathetic. And we had really been looking forward to the flight.
Wowww!! what an awesome adventure! I cannot recommend this tour highly enough....staff were curteious informative and friendly and we had an amazing adventure

Ja, ich habe zwei Aloha Bags gefüllt und dennoch würde ich jeden Tag wieder mit Kapitän Bruce fliegen :-) Neben der einzigartigen Natur und dem Abenteuer Kleinflugzeug ist insbesondere der Humor des Chefs hervorzuheben, der die Tour besonders macht. 
Schön ist, wenn man die Insel vorher schon erkundet hat.
Wir sind mit Baby geflogen und es war kein Problem. Am Ende gibt es sogar ein Video vom Flug. Great Show! Aloha :-)

We've booked the grand deluxe tour for 2 before our vacation. originally we would like to book a helicopter tour but when I red that there are 8 people in one helicopter and you will be seated by weight I'm looking for an alternative and found wings over Kauai. It was the best decision we've made. The tour was a round trip and included all "must-see" places like waimea canyon, napali coast, waterfalls etc. Captain Bruce makes it to an absolutely highlight, explained all important places on Kauai and gave recommendations for places to eat and the best beaches. 
We really recommend that for people who want it a bit more private and individual. 
Thank you Bruce and Team for this great experience!!

If I can give them a rating of 6, I would, because they deserve it!

We did a lot of research on both the plane and helicopter tours over Kauai, and based on people's comments about safety records, customer service, and value, we finally decided on W.O.K.

They lived up to our expectations, and more. We called in to get info, and they assured us we would get a right-side seat (which gets better views). On the day of, Val did the orientation with us. She was hospitable and very courteous. Josh was our pilot and he did a great job of flying and narrating. Again the same hospitable spirit. We rode the AirVan, not the Cessna.

The plane ride itself was nothing short of spectacular. You fly higher than the helicopters, but it gave us a very good bird's eye view of the canyons and valleys, and on Kauai I think that's better then the close-up views.

Don't count on this, but a big bonus for me was, I got the co-pilot's seat, and that allowed me the perfect vantage point for some real nice photos and go-pro videos. Not sure how they decide on who sits there, but you can ask. On helicopters you pay extra for the front seats but that's not the case with the planes. My wife sat in the 'passenger' section, and the views there were amazing as well.

As one of the other reviewer said, you get a small momento after the flight, and we got the same. Really nice touch.

Recommendations: look at the forecast a couple days in advance and book accordingly. We had a nice sunny day and that made the ride. If it's cloudy, I'm sure it won't be the same. Ask for a right-side seat, or even the co-pilot seat if possible.

Needless to say, we would fly with them again if we visit in a few years' time, and would recommend these guys with out hesitation.

Kauai is beautiful from the air, and some kind of flight tour is well worth it. Wings Over Kauai was a comfortable, friendly way to see Kauai from the air. Everyone had the aloha spirit, the pilot was knowledgeable and informative without being intrusive, and the tour lasted just the right amount of time.

I agree with all the reviews it was one of the highlights of our cruise and a wonderful way to see the island.
However I booked the flight 6 months in advance and had confermation and turned up as arranged at 10 30 for the driver to turn up at 10 40 to say we had been bumped to the 13 00 flight they had tried to get in touch two days before but we were on a cruise ship it was upsetting as we felt we had little choice but to hang around and as we only had 8 hours on the island a great waste of time
Once we got to the airport the staff are all fabulous but no one mentioned our inconvenience or the time we lost ,if you wondered Bruce why there was no tip it cos we did feel done down

This was one of our best experiences ever while in Hawaii.  The plane ride was spectacular giving us a whole different perspective of the beautiful island of Kauai. Bruce, Ellen and Mary greeted us warmly when checking in for the flight and we immediately felt like we were friends not clients.  Josh, our pilot, took us on an amazing flight around the island.  He shared so much information about everything we were seeing as well and interesting historical information.  The whole experience was so much more than we were expecting and we would do it again without hesitation.  Be sure and bring a camera and be prepared to have a wonderful experience!

Our pilot Josh gave us a great tour of the island. Our family of 4 were given a private tour (if you pick 4 passengers they will not add anyone else to your trip). While not cheap, I consider this tour a good value. We saw great sights and Josh was very informative and personable. This tour is a great way to get an overview of Kaual and get oriented.

This is my first Trip advisor review, these folks deserve it!

Bruce, Ellen, Mary and Val were all very friendly. This is a family run business, which we love to support. 

The plane ride was fantastic! Great views, with Bruce sharing wonderful information throughout the ride. The headsets made the trip amazing as we could all chat , share and ask questions as we went.

I would highly recommend this trip as a fantastic way to see Kauai.

and the best part of all!

when the trip is over........

no sales pitch. no please buy this. 

These lovely folks handed us a great momento ( 2 actually) (I'm not wrecking their surprise) which made our day!

Very friendly down to earth people, which we got to share some time with.

Thanks to Bruce, Ellen, Mary and Val

We had a great time and we'll be back for another plane ride when we get back to Hawaii.

Brad and Chantelle

We did the 2 person flight with flying lesson.  My husband enjoyed the lesson very much since he has always wanted to fly.  It was a beautiful day and the scenery was unbelievably beautiful.  We have spent a lot of time on Kauai over the years but this view of Kauai was magnificent.  I would like to do the sightseeing version of this flight when my sister and brother-in-law come with us to Kauai next year.

This was the highlight of my 4 day trip to Kauai. Everyone we dealt with at the company were lovely ,even advising us to change our flight from 24 Nov to 25 Nov as they believed the  weather would be more favourable. The company supplied DVD was a great way to show family at home what we had seen. The pilot Bruce was very knowledgeable and provided a really good commentary with the flight. I would highly recommend this to anyone it was a great way to see the island. If I get the chance to return to Kauai I will certainly be doing this again.

We booked our Wings Over Kauai Tour after it being a highlight of a previous trip three years earlier.   The second flight was just as awesome as the first!  Service was wonderful, & Captain Josh answered all of my 8 year old's many questions! We had a chance to see and learn more about the garden Island.  Will definitely use again! !

Today I looked at the photos taken during my flight with Wings Over Kauai last year, reliving the experience through pictures and the company's video provided after the flight (on DVD).  (My visit was in fact in early December, 2013, not January 2014, but the date selector did not go quite that far back.)  What a fantastic experience!  I am a private pilot and was eager to see Kauai by air during my short stay there.  Due to some rain during my originally scheduled flight time (there's a reason Kauai is so lush with vegetation...), I finally got my chance on the last day of my stay.  I flew in the Cessna 172 with Bruce, and it certainly made for a memorable experience.  Bruce is an excellent pilot and instructor, and very knowledgeable about the island, so that made for an excellent flying and sightseeing experience.  I was at the controls while Bruce gave flying tips and guided me around the many points of interest that make Kauai so memorable, including views of Waimea Canyon and the Na Pali coast.  Bruce was even good enough to snap sevral photos with my camera while I flew.  I heartily recommend seeing Kauai by air, for pilots and non-pilots alike.  Thank you Bruce, and the Wings Over Kauai team!

The best and the most memorable experience I have ever had! Thank you so much! Seeing the garden isle from the air was just stunning. We also managed to spot some whales during our flight. Weather was perfect, Josh, our pilot, was very responsive and friendly.

First of all the people at Wings over Kauai are the best.  We had a flight scheduled on 11/29, the weather wasn't great, so we rescheduled for later in the week.  On Thursday 12/4 we flew and it was a beautiful clear day, one of the best days we had.  Pilot was so knowledgeable and friendly.  Talked about the history of the island and what places we had been.  The views were unbelievable and breathtaking.  I recommend Wings over Kauai to everyone that goes to Kauai.

This was definitely one of the major highlights of our trip to Hawaii.

Bruce was fantastic, very knowledgeable about Kauai, although is known to break out into movie theme songs whilst pointing out attractions!

The scenery was amazing,Waimea Canyon, Napali Coast, down through the middle of the island, waterfalls, mountain peaks .. an incredible way to see Kauai.
We had a great time. The flight is an excellent way to see the island. Capt Josh was very knowledgeable and pleasant. Highly recommend it.

We took the Wings Over Kauai tour on November 23, 2014 and had a wonderful experience. We booked the tour around the island in the 8 Seat Air Bus but they only use 4 seats. Everyone is on the right side of the plane so you see everything!. What a great way to see this beautiful island and the Na Pali coast. We thoroughly enjoyed our hour tour with Bruce. The flight was smooth, the day was very clear and the company great. Their operation is family owned and operated. And they give you a CD when you leave with a 10 minutes video of the island. Wonderful people, wonderful flight. Thanks Bruce and Ellen for your hospitality.

review_title: A truly Spectacular experience from a great family-run company
review_text:
First of all, rather than opting for the helicopter ride, these airplane tours are so much better!  I have terrible motion sickness issues on helicopters but the planes were so much more stable and easier to handle.  And they can go everywhere the helicopter can, so opt for the planes.  Also, we are bigger people, and the planes are so much more comfortable for bigger people than the helicopters

Then, we had scheduled a flight with a rival company which shall not be named.  They cancelled us because no one else scheduled a flight at the same time.  This is not stated on their website, but we found it it is standard practice.  Wings over Kauai doesn't do this.  We were the only couple on the flight and we still got the star experience!  They don't cancel flights because there is not as large of a demand. THIS IS HUGE.

Now, onto the flight.  We learned that this is a great little family company and they will do everything to address your concerns and interests.  First, because of my motion sickness, we were concerned with taking the smaller Cessna up rather than the larger Airvan.  Despite the cost, they flew the Airvan for us!  It was such a spectacular flight and Captain Bruce so informative about the islands. This is the only way to see the Waimea Canyon and oh my god, the Napali Coast needs to be viewed from the air.  We were overwhelmed. We loved it!

So this is the tour to take.  We look forward to coming back to Kauai and visiting them again.  Thank you to everyone at Wings for the most memorable part of our entire trip!

What an amazing experience.  My wife and I are in Kauai for our Honeymoon and wanted to do a tour of the island.  I read the reviews about Wings over Kauai and decided to book.  It was a great experience.  Kauai is the most beautiful place ive ever seen.  And seeing it from a small plane was definitely a unique experience.

I cant compare it to taking a helicopter tour, but I will say that i get motion sickness easily and think that the small plane is easier on the stomach than a helicopter.  It was windy but the pilot kept everything safe and clam up there.

Would definitely recommend this to a friend.

Bruce, Val and the whole WIngs Over Kauai experience were simply amazing. They add many special touches to make it even more memorablt.  The flight was perfection even on a windy day! There is no better way to experience the entire island. Bruce points out fabulous spots to visit on the island- every one we visited so far has been great! This is a tour we plan on doing again when we come back to Kauai the next time too!

Thanks for the perfect way to start our Hawaiian Vacation! - John and Katie

Superbe vol avec le pilote Bruce. Durée conforme (+1 heure) avec des paysages incroyables. Nombreuses petites attentions (gratuites !) et anecdotes lors de la visite. Petite entreprise très sympa, y compris lors de l'accueil. Nous avions une crainte par rapport a l'hélicoptère mais finalement nous avons bien eu le temps d'admirer ce que nous voulions voir pour beaucoup moins cher. On recommande vivement !!!

This flight is simply the best!! I will always remember incredible views of Kauai and give thanks to all of you!! I will be back when I return to Hawaii for another tour. Trust me listening to IZ while flying over the mountains and waterfalls really made me feel that I was in heaven.
Happy Thanksgiving 2014 from Loren in Minneapolis,MN

As newlyweds, we wanted to go somewhere romantic, off the beaten path, and where we could take in the nature around us. Kauai was definitely the perfect spot! We scheduled our Wings Over Kauai tour for our first day so we could get a good look at the entire island from above. I would highly recommend doing this tour early on in your stay because we altered some of our other plans after the plane ride. 
Bruce was a fantastic tour guide, beaming with knowledge about the island. He made conversation with each of the passengers and it made the flight very enjoyable. 
The views were nothing short of spectacular! I went back and forth between wanting to capture everything with my camera and just sitting back taking in the beauty. 
We don't know if we'll ever get back and wanted to make the most of our trip. This was definitely one of our favorite things about the week we spent! Enjoy!

Well.. I suppose we were really lucky ducks. ..
Booked month in advance from downunder..flew specially over from our holiday stay on Waikiki for this trip.
On arrival our booking was confirmed..and were welcomed by Mary that made us already feel so comfortable.
Had to wait anyway... but looked at the skies which might looks a tropical shower awaiting us... but a little  prayer to the local indigenous god Pele seemed to have averted the spoil ... 
We were comfortable seated on the right side of the (Aussie made) plane. .. and Bruce gave us those wings of excellence over Kauai to see the beautiful scenery while Pele opened up the blue skies...
Also it seems that we chose the right time to see the sun provided the nice lighting and shading...
All in all this trip is par excellence to us..

The minor problem is that something needs to be done with the audio system as it was hard to hear the conversation even that the volume was set to max.

Thanks Mary..Ellen and Bruce for the unforgettable wings you gave us..
Definitely worth an advisor...

Steph & Anton from poʍunupəɹ..

Best morning of my life.  Period.  I think our whole group (8 total) agree that Wings over Kauai was exceptional.  We kind of threw them a curve ball by booking both plans (Air Van and Cessna) under one name since there were 8 of us and only six fit in the Air Van.  Their shuttle van only holds 6 so they had to make 2 trips to get our whole group to the airport from the ABC store.  It went quickly and efficiently though.  When we arrived the staff was so warm and welcoming.  Even the dog was sweet.  They had a surprise for me that I will treasure forever for booking the group.  After going over all that we needed to know about the flight path and safety information they weighed each of us (no one can see the scale but them, thank goodness) so they could properly balance the plane.  Right before we got into the planes they took a photo of us which would end up being another surprise for the group.  The flight was phenomenal.  Captain Josh (for 6 of us) and Captain Bruce (flew the Cessna) gave personalized commentary throughout the flight.  They interacted with each one of us and got to know what we were interested in.  I was so overwhelmed with joy and awe when we flew over the Na Pali Coast I started to tear up.  I felt like such a sap but it really was something unique to see & experience.  Captain Josh took extra time to fly so we could see the Cessna that held the other 2 members of our group.  No worries about being in a small plane - the whole flight felt safer to me than commercial air travel.  I am too chicken to get into a helicopter so that is why our group ended up in the planes.  We were so lucky to experience such a beautiful and meaningful event.  As others have mentioned they offer the flight on DVD/Blu Ray or digital download that we all have been enjoying and sharing with anyone who will watch it since we got home.  The DVD cost $42 (had to add shipping for us cruise ship passengers…) and I think the digital download was $50.  Sorry, I can’t remember the Blu Ray $$$.  Thanks again to WoK – they are the best!!!

My husband and I took the two person tour of the island with Captain Bruce for exactly half the price of a helicopter trip. True you can't get as close to the cliffs and canyons as with a helicopter but we had a private tour and we could open the window to take photos. It was really a special event and highly recommended!

review_title: Lots of fun at a reasonable price
review_text: We has fun seeing Kauai from the air.  The plane was quiet and comfortable and the pilot was friendly and very knowledgeable.  We found this tour a better value than the helicopter tour.

The plane ride with Wings Over Kauai was one of the best parts of my trip to Hawaii.  The whole team was amazing from start to finish. Bruce very happily accommodated a last-minute addition to my reservation, Mary picked us up promptly at the meeting place, Val checked us in warmly and gave us all the information we needed for our flight, Ellen made sure I was securely seated in the co-pilot's seat and Josh gave us an incredible flight around Kauai. Not only was Josh an excellent pilot, he was also a fountain of information about Kauai. I really appreciated receiving the complimentary DVD with highlights of the flight and the photo of me and my companion.  I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai to anyone who wants to see Hawaii's most beautiful island.

We had a great time with our pilot Bruce who is also the owner of the company. He obviously loves his job and makes it real fun. The views are incredible. Like nothing you've ever seen before. If you are trying to decide whether to do a helicopter tour or this, choose Wings Over Kauai! It's more personal and much cheaper and in my opinion better than a helicopter tour.

review_title: Best way to see the island
review_text: Amazing! Definitely the highlight of the 4 islands we visited and the best way to see the geography of Kauai. I am a private pilot from the UK and so had a flying lesson with my wife as a passenger- I would recommend doing this to any pilots of anyone with an interest in flying.

I am a private pilot from Montreal Canada just wanting to brush up on flying hours in a great distinctive Kauai setting.   Do not hesitate to reserve now and while you are at it , why not start yourself a personal flying log book and reserved an instructional sightseiing flight at the same time!  What....yes, experience Kauai in a small and reliable airplane and keep the flying hours on record for you to keep and how to your family and friends!

Wings over Kauai is a family business that Monsieur Coulombe have a great respect for the environment, a PHD in agriculture---so imagine the briefing you will have during your flight while viewing the terrain below.    M. Bruce Coulombe flying instructor, owner and PHD in agriculture will provide you with a classy and very friendly experience.   You are important to them and you encourage a family with a respect for the environment and their customer's!   We had a most fun and memorable experience today!    Book yourself a memorable time now!   Norm Paquette, Montreal, Canada

We just took this tour today and enjoyed every moment of it. The whole experience was truly wonderful. From take off to a smooth landing, the knowledge and professionalism of Captain Bruce was great!  There is so much to see and appreciate on this airplane tour.  The cost is half of that of a Helicopter tour. Wings Over Kauai really personalize your adventure, add extra information of the island and give you many tips of their favorite spots.  We were surprised with a couple gifts that add a final touch.  (You'll have to go to see what they are.) :)   We truly recommend this to anybody considering taking an airplane tour, you will be extremely happy with Wings over Kauai.
This was a trip to remember!!!  Excellent family operated airplane ride.  You can't see over 70% of the island so this is excellent.  Not high priced - but the ride is awesome.  A must see!!!

This is my second time flying with Bruce.  First time back in 2012.   Both Bruce and Ellen are extremely friendly and are always helpful in providing you with any information you need on the islands.  Very good weather for today's flight.  Got some awesome photos of Waimea Canyon and the Napali Coast.  Would definately fly with them again.

We flew with Captain Josh on 17th October in the Grand Air Van tour on a morning flight. It was the absolute highlight of our trip. We were extremely fortunate with clear and sunny weather which meant that we could enjoy the full flight plan. From the confirmation phone call we made the day prior to when we touched down at the end of the flight the experience was flawless and so impressive. What sensational value for money.The Team was completely professional, efficient and very friendly. Captain Josh was wonderful -his warm hospitality put us at ease. I had contemplated cancelling the flight as I am a nervous flyer, claustrophic, scared of heights and  and get motion sickness- what a nightmare passenger! However once the Team was aware of my concerns they reassured me and in no time Josh's amazing skills put me at ease and my fears faded- the breath taking views a complete distraction and the spaciousness of the cabin made it so comfortable. He instilled absolute confidence. His commentary was very informative and he involved and engaged all the passengers. At no time did it sound like a spiel. My husband and I are so thrilled that I overcame my fears to experience this amazing flight. The air tour covers so much of the Island it made our drive touring so much more meaningful as we had seen the aerial perspective. Thanks so much Josh we can't recommend this WOK enough.

My family of four recently took a tour of Kauai with Wings Over Kauai. We all thoroughly enjoyed it! Josh, the pilot, pointed out the many sights and shared good info about the island. The background music was a little 'hokie' but fun. We did a helicopter tour on the Big Island a few years ago. This tour was better in that you could see more of the island at a time and still get up close to special sights. The Na Pali coast was so beautiful from the plane.

This was a great experience!  The views are beyond amazing. I was apprehensive to get on a small plane but, the pilot was wonderful, obviously experienced, and very knowledgeable about the island. It's a family owned business and they couldn't have done more to make the experience better. I highly recommend.

Bruce was excellent as a pilot, knowledgeable about Kauai and its culture. It's was absolutely thrilling for my 13 yr old and very safe. He and his wife were extremely helpful and open to our many questions of the area places to visit. Will be seeing you again.

review_title: The most amazing excursion!!!It made our trip
review_text: This is a family owned business and the care they show to their customers is unsurpassed. Josh was very informative and personalized the trip to the needs of all of us on the plane. This was a smooth ride like riding in a car not at all choppy and jerky which you may get on a helicopter. Josh's narrative was very interesting and he mad sure that we got plenty of "money" shots of the beautiful sights around the island. We were doing an inter-island cruise of Big Island, Honolulu, Maui,and Kauai and they picked us up at the ABC store by the ship and brought us back to the same ABC store before the ship left in plenty of time.  This was our favorite excursion by far. This is a MUST DO if you are on Kauai and it is half the price of a helicopter ride. They video tape your whole ride for you and you can buy it and have it sent to you. Just a tip confirm with them the day you are to be  picked up especially if you are on a cruise ship. They will take care of you!

review_title: Outstanding Cessna Private Plane Tour By Wings Over Kauai
review_text: After Val explained safety items, experienced Captain Bruce was our pilot for a private Cessna clockwise plane tour of Kauai. As of this writing he's done the tour 6,000+ times. Overall outstanding experience and a highlight of our first visit to Kauai.  Bruce's personalized commentary via bi-directional Bose noise canceling headsets was an added bonus to learning so much more about life on Kauai, both historically and in current day.  Of course as has been stated elsewhere, only approx. 20% of island is reachable via car so taking a tour from the air is the only way to truly experience all that Kauai has to offer. Wings Over Kauai treat you as a special member of their family wanting to make sure you enjoy where they call home. So when you book your flight, don't be bashful about asking for their recommendations on how you can best use your limited time on the garden island of Hawaii. We were glad we scheduled this day after arrival and later enjoyed recognizing places from rental car after viewing them from the air. This tour option for seeing Kauai should definitely make your list of activities.

We had taken a helicopter trip the last time we were in Kauai, but we were both pleasantly surprised that this plane trip was much more enjoyable. Josh, the captain, gave a great narration of all the beautiful sights we were seeing. We were able to see more of the island; the service and quality of the flight was excellent! Would highly recommend this company to travelers!

review_title: 信頼できるパイロットとカウアイ島の全部が見えます
review_text: ブルースとジョッシュが操縦するセスナで島を一周します。操縦が上手く島のことに関する知識が豊富で、安心して観光ができます。運が良かったら空から綺麗な虹を見ることもできます。私は、操縦の体験をさせてもらえる、インストラクション・フライトもしました。ブルースは、非常に上手で、全く飛行機を知らない私が、段々と操縦に慣れるように上手く指導してくれました。いつも落ち着いている尊敬できるパイロットです。白い雲に美しい虹が架かったのを２回も見ることができました。日本にいる時から、エレンとメールで連絡をとり、親切に説明を受けました。英語ができなければ、ホテルから電話をしてもらうと良いです。安全第一なので、天候が悪ければ、スケジュールを変更します。実際に飛行機に乗らなければ、料金を徴収されることはありません。誠実なツアーです。

I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai for your air tour of the island. A situation arose just before our scheduled tour and Bruce courteously and professionally provided a practical solution. Bruce is a very experienced pilot, is extremely knowledgeable about Kauai, and proceeded to provide us with the high point of our visit to Kauai. Don't miss out on this wonderful tour.

We had a great time on our flight. It was longer than usual and even though the military's activity in the area forced us to cut a part of the tour out, he more than made up for it and took us to see more than we imagined.
The tour is personalized and he gives advice on what you should do during your stay.
There are lots of little extras that you would never get in a more commercial business. This is family owned and it shows. There was even a free DVD with our picture as the front cover. It is a great experience. Highly recommended.

Selten so nette herzliche Besitzer getroffen. Vorab alles per email besprochen und trotzdem total flexibel vor Ort. Es wird auch geraten den Flug zu verschieben wenn das Wetter nicht mitspielen sollte. Der Flug selbst war unglaublich. Es wird alles super erklärt und alle fragen beantwortet. Können den Flug wärmstens weiterempfehlen.

My wife and I were on our honeymoon and we booked a two person Cessna flight.  We both had an amazing time and it was well worth the money.  Bruce was our pilot and he personalized his commentary to us, it didn't just sound like he was reading a script.  I would suggest getting the Cessna flight for couples, it is nice to be able to guarantee you will both have the best seats for all the scenery.  I would recommend this to anyone looking at sightseeing flights in Hawaii.

We travelled with Bruce on the smaller Cessna plane. Bruce was quick to put us at ease, and his fun filled and informative commentary kept our tour interesting throughout the 60-65 min we were air born. The best part was sitting in the co-pilot seat with bruce, with the airplane controls in front of you, and listening into the air traffic control talks. This definitely added another dimension to our trip, which made it even more memorable. Kauai island is of course very green and beautiful with some amazing vistas. I guess the unique personalized experience you get  with this tour, makes it a must have in Kauai. Highly recommended !!

O passeio que fiz pela Wings Over Hawaii foi sensacional. Tem duração de aproximadamente uma hora pelo preço de 125USD por pessoa. Eu e minha esposa fizemos dia 30/10/2014 no Air-Caravan, um avião maior que o Cessna, para até 6 passageiros. Como no tour estávamos em 4 passageiros no total, todo mundo conseguiu ficar na janela do lado direito do avião. Que é a melhor vista. O Piloto, Josh, conversava conosco o tempo todo, mostrando os pontos a serem visulizados e contando coisas interessantes sobre a paisagem. Meu vôo estava marcadi para as 1430h porém como o tempo estava meio chuvoso o pessoal me ligou e recomendou que eu fizesse o voo das 1300h. Bingo. O vôo foi perfeito e 20min após pousarmos desbaou uma tempestade.

Wings Over Kauai has a very well maintained Cessna 172 with a fuel injected 180 HP engine that you can take for a flight with Bruce, the instructor. Just a guess but I think he enjoys these trips more than flying the AirVan full of tourists. Fly right seat or left (view is better on the right). Bruce works the radios because he knows all the reporting points and helps you avoid the sensitive overflight areas.  You get to fly the plane.  

It's one thing to take a tour flight and enjoy the scenery from above but it's a whole 'nut her thing to be at the controls when you cross over knife-edge ridges a few hundred feet above ground level or flying along a sheer cliff past waterfalls. This is a great thing to do.

review_title: Do not miss this. The best attraction in the Hawaiian Islands.
review_text: My husband was so excited about this flight as he has his Pilot's License, but I have never had the nerve to fly with him in a light aircraft before now. Bruce, who flew the little Cessna was wonderful and put me at ease straight away, gave me confidence and allowed me to relax and enjoy the whole thing. The scenery over the Na Pali Coast was awesome and the weather was perfect with blue skies, very little cloud and not much wind. We flew over some amazing mountains, ridges and valleys, with numerous waterfalls, sandy beaches and deep blue sea. Seeing it all from the air was so much better than from offshore.  The whole experience was smoothly run from being picked up from the cruise ship and driven to the airport, signing in and boarding the aircraft, the personalized flight, photos and free DVD, and return to the ship. Bruce was so easy to get along with, was interested in our family and made this flight one we'll never forget. It was over much to soon but will remain as the highlight of our holiday in Hawaii. I can honestly say that this flight was real value for money and worth doing even for some-one who feels scared of flying in a small plane. My husband is still talking about it and wishes we could do it all again. He even said he'd love to take a few more lessons with Bruce as the instructor.  Pick this one if you are in Kauai you won't regret it.

If you are a licensed pilot, Wings Over Kauai offers an incredible deal for an airborne sightseeing tour of Kauai!!  For about the price of a helicopter tour for one person, you and a friend can tour Kauai in a Cessna 172, with you doing the flying.  Logged as a Dual Received flight from a Certified Flight Instructor, your flight will overfly the island, taking in all the exciting landmarks.  Each occupant has a hot mike headset, allowing for easy, fun conversation by all.  As is the trend in aerial tours, a recording of your personal flight is available for purchase following the tour.  Our Instructor was friendly, fun, obviously skilled, extremely knowledgeable of the Island and quite adept at knocking the rust off my flying skills.  A great experience that I will repeatedly relive with friends.

O tour é super organizado, os responsáveis muito receptivos e cuidadosos. O visual...é de chorar!! É muita beleza junta e o Bruce, que foi nosso piloto, vais nos explicando e contando as histórias do Kauai. O filme e as fotos que ganhamos de presente, fecharam com chave de ouro. Super indico!!!

Our family of four had a fabulous flight with Josh and it was definitely a highlight of our trip to Kauai.  I had struggled to decide whether we should try this or go with a helicopter flight and I clearly made the right choice.  The views far exceeded our expectations and I can't imagine what more we would have seen from a helicopter, at twice the price.  I also want to thank Wings Over Kauai for being so customer focused.  I had thought I'd booked the entire plane for our family but it turned out there were two other individuals who also had a reservation.  Because my husband and son had to sit on the left side of the plane which supposedly had less desirable views, they discounted our fare.  That being said, both my husband and son still saw 90% of what the rest of us did and the only downside is that they weren't in the best position to take photos.  My daughter and I took plenty of them so it wasn't an issue at all!  I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai!

What a great experience! From start to finish our Captain Bruce and his team took great care of us by flying over the entire island with detailed narrative of what we were seeing. Their rates are extremely affordable and they have great Personable service. My boyfriend and I took the private tour which added to the intimate experience.  A must see! They even give a free video of the tour at the end of he ride :)

My husband and I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai!  I sceduled our tour about six weeks prior to visiting the island.  Check in was simple and quick.  Our pilot Bruce is very knowledgeable about the island and so very friendly.  My husband and I were his only passengers so it made it even more special for us and my husband was thrilled to be Bruce's "copilot".  We felt very safe the entire trip and the flight was very smooth which made it possible to get some incredible pictures!   To top it off we received a free DVD of the island personalized with our picture on the cover...what a nice touch!  You won't be disappointed with this tour.

My husband and I booked with Wings over Kauai based on trip advisor reviews.  The reservation process was easy and quick. Bruce and his family made us feel like we were going up with a friend. He is a very experienced pilot who makes you very comfortable.  Everyone has a headset so you can speak with the pilot and he can explain the beautiful vistas. He is very knowledgeable. 
The flight itself was perfect.  Very smooth and relaxed & visibility from the plane was unobstructed. We went up in the small plane but I looked at the larger one and both planes have good passenger visibility.  
The morning we went up the weather cooperated and we were in for an amazing fantastic adventure. It is an awesome island!
If you want to see all of Kauai you need to go in the air as it is not all accessible by car. 
Book with Wings over Kauai I highly recommend them.

Full points to Josh (the pilot) and Val for their service and hospitality they show. What an awesome tour and indeed Kauai looks amazing from top. Josh indeed is very familiar from the whole island and we learnt a lot about the island. Highly recommended!!

I am not the best at doing reviews, but Wings Over Kauai was worth it! We debated on seeing Kauai by air or by sea, but the cost of this air tour along with their Blue Dolphin partner allowed us both! However, if I could only do one I for sure do the air tour. Pilot Josh was great, learned a lot about the whole island, and had a great time.

The way the pilot explains and makes you feel comfortable is just awesome... I have been to many Flight rides but this one stands out. Not just because of the beautiful views but also because of the courteous and super nice pilot and the management. I would definitely recommend Wings over Kauai to everybody...

We flew with them after being recommended by my family and thank god we flew with them. Our captain was very warm and friendly . He had great knowledge about the island. The staff was courteous and made us feel very comfortable. They were flexible and customized the fly for us to accommodate my 3 year old.

pros:  very enjoyable with good visibility from 4 seats/6 filled as per recommendation.  Spectacular scenery.  Complimentary DVD very nicely put together by the pilot's son included areas we did not visit, partly because of low cloud ceiling, with excellent resolution.

con:  mildly bumpy ride.

review_title: This will be your top Kauai / Hawaii experience!
review_text:
We went on the 4 p.m. Cessna ride on Thu, 10/9, the latest flight of the day.  This plane ride was phenomenal!  We visited the island as part of the Norwegian Cruise Line, Pride of America cruise.  This is not an excursion offered by NCL, we found it courtesy of Google and are so glad we did!  We originally were looking for a helicopter tour when we fortunately stumbled upon this incredible alternative.  Our homework paid off.  
     Riding in the Cessna with Wings over Kauai offered several great advantages.  1)  This was effectively a private tour - it was the pilot, my wife and me.  2)  I love photography.  The pilot allowed me to open the window to take glare-free photographs of the spectacular views offered by the plane.  (See several scaled down photos below) 3)  We spent a fraction of the cost of a helicopter tour.  4)  It's hard to imagine a helicopter tour topping this one.  5)  The pilot, Josh, was very skilled and professional, had a wealth of knowledge about the island and was extremely personable.  His easy going demeanor quickly put us at ease and set the tone for a an incredible flying experience.  6)  This is a family owned business.  The owner gave us a ride back to the cruise ship - a personal touch we wouldn't expect from the larger helicopter companies.  7)  The incredible Napali Coast is only accessible by air or water.  Since the cruise ship takes you by the coast, we were able to see the coast from both perspectives. Viewing it by air is much more dramatic and impactful.  If you are going to Hawaii, Kauai is a must-see island.  If you are going to Kauai, the Napali Coast is a must-see destination, so we recommend seeing it the best way possible - by air!  
     It's a shame NCL doesn't offer this as one of their shore excursions - so many cruise passengers are missing out.  On the other hand, if it was an NCL offering the price might be much higher, so it will pay great dividends for the traveller (cruiser or non-cruiser alike) who does their homework.
     If you are visiting the islands via NCL, you will arrive in Kauai on Thursday at 8:00 a.m. and leave on Friday at 2:00 p.m.  If you take this flight on Friday, do so earlier in the morning so you don't risk missing the boat that afternoon.  We chose to take the late Thursday afternoon flight in lieu of the only NCL offered luau Thursday night.  What a great decision!  Because half of the ship's cruisers were off-ship attending the luau, we returned to the ship, ate supper in a much quieter restaurant, then had the pool completely to ourselves for over an hour!

Found this place from all the wonderful reviews online. Was planning on doing another outing/adventure but price seemed a little steep for the activity. When I found this for the same price there was no hesitation in booking! We booked the 9:30 flight because after calling and talking to Ellen she suggested the time and day based on the weather over the weekend. Turned out to be perfect! Got there, chatted with Dori and Josh who were so welcoming and nice. We got checked in and waited only 15 or so minutes to board. They were knowledgable and kind, telling us about the plane and where to sit. We took pictures outside the plane and boarded. I have to say I was nervous prior to boarding because I hadn't been in such a small plane before but the fears were pretty much dissipated by the time I took my seat. Josh was so personable and kind, gave us clear instructions on the headsets and what to do. They even let my fiancée sit in the co pilots seat because it was her birthday--trip maker! We got into the air smoothly and easily and the hour long tour was great! Full of knowledge and fun tidbits, josh was an awesome tour guide. The scenerary was breathtaking and we got amazing photos! We only had one patch of some turbulence that felt a little roller coastery but Josh reassured us it was normal and it was smooth sailing then on. I was worried about air sickness but I felt nothing. They do provide "aloha" bags ;) and ginger candies and water should anyone need anything while in the air. The one thing I will say is that it was a warm day and I was pretty warm during the flight despite the air vent. So be prepared, I'd suggest layers. 

If your looking for a memorable adventure while on Kauai, I would suggest doing this because it was awesome, the customer service was beyond amazing and overall it was a fantastic trip! So happy we booked it. Go, you won't be disappointed!

review_title: Best dollars ever spent on our vacations!
review_text: Was the highlight of our trip.  Been to Kauai many times but first time seeing it by air.  A must do!  Have seen the Napali Coast by boat but seeing it by air was even more incredible.  Plane was comfortable, great visibility and gave us opportunity to take some great shots!  The host and pilot were the best!  Would do it again!

Wir hatten anlässlich unseres Honeymoons die Privattour für den  08. April 14 mit der Cessna etwa 2 Monate vorab gebucht. Angekommen vor Ort wurden wir herzlich empfangen und unser gebuchter Flug ging pünktlich los. Der einstündige Flug über Garden Island Kauai, wo viele Flecken der Insel vom Lande her nicht oder nur schwer zugänglich sind, war sehr beeindruckend und ist für jeden Kauai-Besucher ein Muss. Unser Captain Bruce Coulombe, der supernett war und uns über alle Sehenswürdigkeiten (und da gibts ne Menge auf Kauai) aufklärte, zeigte uns sogar wie man eine Cessna bedient. Es lief alles sehr freundlich und problemlos ab und am Ende des Fluges erhielten wir sogar eine Video-CD über den Rundflug, eine Halskette und eine Hawaiianische Blüte. Und auch die Bilder, die vor dem Flugstart gemacht wurden, erhielten wir bereits am nächsten Tag per Mail. Das Team von wingsoverkauai können wir absolut weiterempfehlen. Hier ist sowohl die Leistung, als auch der Preis Top! Thank You Bruce and greetings from Germany, Esther & Hakan

Wings Over Kauai has small airplanes that fly over Kauai.  It's a great alternative to a helicopter!  There were 6 of us so we chartered the plane as a group.  Bruce, the owner and pilot, made us very comfortable and was very professional.  The flight was smooth and the scenery was spectacular!

review_title: You Haven't Seen Kauai Unless You've Been on Wings
review_text:
This was our favorite experience on the island. Staying in Lihue, this was a very convenient pick-up location. Time wise, you get the biggest return on investment if your time on the island is limited. In one hour, you get to see so many amazing views of this island that are not feasable by foot, boat, or car. The center of the island is just so incredibly breathtaking. You will see miles of amazing vegitation and waterfalls with no human life... it's truly something I've never seen before.

I suffer from motion sickness (in fact, we took a boat ride/ snorkeling excursion on which I got queezy despite taking Dramamine) and had NO PROBLEMS AT ALL on Wings Over Kauai. My biggest challenge was nervousness which was much eased by Capt. Josh and Dori. The service is so friendly and personal. Dori gave us a great overview of our trip and made us feel so welcome. Capt. Josh made us feel comfortable, casually describing his experience as a pilot (having flown both large planes for major airlines and flying small planes as well) and often referring to us by name during our flight, often checking up on us and even wishing me a happy birthday!

I took Dramamine an hour before the flight. They offered ginger candy and water/soda on the plane. Views from the right we're better as many other reviewers mentioned. I have a small threshold for comfort when it comes to temperature and the ride was not too hot, not too cold but juuuuuust right. We went at 2:30pm and thought the lighting and views were beyond spectacular.

The ride may seem pricey to you but I promise, it's well worth it... You can't spend hundreds of dollars to fly and stay in Kauai and NOT spend another $100-200 to have this experience.

Everything was beautiful thank you! Val and Josh were so nice! It's a must do when you come to Kauai :) the views were spectacular and luckily the weather was perfect, wish I can just stay up there!! Thanks again

review_title: A  "Must Do" in a Winnebago with Wings
review_text: The Australian made AirVan Aircraft may look like a Winnebago with wings stuck on top, but it's an ideal plane for tourist viewing.  It's very stable (no bumpy ride at all on our tour)  and no wing obstruction between the windows and the ground.  Our pilot was Josh, and experienced American Airlines pilot with a great knowledge of the island.  All passengers have headsets with microphones so you can ask all the questions you want.  It takes more than an hour to cover the island, and you get to see the Waimea Canyon, Hanalei Bay,  and the spectacular Na Pali  coastline. A real highlight of our trip.

We wound up on a Wings Over Kauai tour when our originally planned Air Ventures tour was cancelled, rescheduled, and then redirected to this company. Lucky for us, this tour was great (and the plane looked to be much nicer and cleaner!). Our pilot was super nice, and the tour was informative and comfortable. My husband got to sit as co-pilot, so his day was made! I also enjoyed that the pilot had a pre-set playlist, which was themed depending on where in the tour you were (i.e., Jurassic Park soundtrack as we went by the infamous falls). Great experience overall!
Spectacular tour of Kauai and Bruce, the pilot, was very knowledgeable, professional, and friendly. I would highly recommend this tour.

We took a plane tour over Kauai with WOK in September. We have been to Hawaii seven times having visited Oahu, Big Island, Maui and Kauai. Easy to say Kauai is our favorite, as it is a very beautiful, restful island. We enjoy the beaches, swimming, snorkeling. We have seen more sea turtles, rays, dolphins, etc. here than anywhere else. We have been in awe of the Na Pali coast on catamaran trips (Capt Andy is the best), but this trip we tried another method of enjoying the beauty of the island. Yes, Wings Over Kauai.

The staff is super friendly. We flew with owner/pilot Bruce. Don't be concerned about flying in a comparatively small plane. I have been in several choppers, private seaplanes, small commercial planes, private jets, etc. over the years and my flight with WOK was probably the most relaxing, smoothest flight I have had. Credit to Bruce. We all agreed it was like floating on a pillow.

And Bruce's talents are just not as a pilot. As a professional biologist you can absorb an education on the island as you absorb the awesome beauty of the island. Words can't even come close to what your eyes will experience. I found myself quiet, unable to speak, and just trying to capture the moment.

Tripadvisor only has 1 - 5 stars, otherwise I would rate this higher. It is one of the best activities I have taken in all my trips. Be smart, call, make a reservation. Bring a camera, and you can continue to enjoy the beauty for the months after your feet (unfortunately) are back on the ground. But don't look thru the viewfinder, put the camera on automatic and snap away. Don't cheat either of your eyes from a direct view!!

Bruce & WOK, THANKS, I will see you on my next trip for another flight.

Bruce was such a pleasant guide! We had a great time viewing Kauai from up high with him. He accommodated our toddler, sang theme songs when we saw certain sights, and was generally entertaining and nice. It was such an intimate flight on his small Cessna; we really enjoyed the private tour. We also had fun watching him park his Cessna in his garage :)

What a great way to view the island.  We did it after we had explored by car much of it and it was very interesting to see the places we had actually been and to try and point them out.  Very knowledgeable staff, led by Bruce, but overall a truly great experience.  I dare say I liked it even better than my previous helicopter ride.
Thanks again

I booked this flight during the planning stages of our Hawaiian Island cruise on the NCL Pride of America.  Kauai was the final stop of our itinerary prior to disembarking in Honolulu, and I opted to fly with "Wings" as the last day in Port.

What an incredible experience it was to fly over this beautiful island and observe it from a totally different perspective. Words simply cannot describe the images and scenery as seen from the air... even my photos (over 200 taken) can't truly depict how breathtaking it is to see the island in this unique way.

Sadly, my wife passed on this experience, as did the other couple that was scheduled to fly... so it was just my pilot, Josh, and myself on board.  Josh asked if I would prefer to sit in the co-pilot seat instead of in back... really?  He had to ask?  Seriously, what a treat it was to sit "up front" and become an honorary member of the crew.  Unfortunately, that didn't entitle me to an employee discount :(  But it did offer me an awesome view :))

I'd like to share some of the details about the flight, unfortunately, my description wouldn't do justice to the experience... so you'll just have to book a trip for yourself.  I will say, we did get to see a helicopter on the ground near the north shore that had to land after experiencing mechanical difficulties, but that's another story.

I will say this; if I am fortunate enough to return to Kauai, I'm including some extra bucks in the budget for another flight with Wings Over Kauai... even if I don't get to be a member of the crew.  

So, if you find yourself on the Island of Kauai, book a flight with "Wings"... you won't be disappointed.

My wife and I booked this tour before our cruse ship left Vancouver for the Hawaiian Islands. We had considered a helicopter tour but decided on Wings Over Kauai based on the reviews or previous customers, the price and availability of flights at the time we needed during our day on the island.

This was undoubtedly one of the best tours we have ever booked! Ellen picked us up at a spot near the cruise ship terminal and Bruce was probably the most congenial tour operator we have ever run across. 
The flight itself was beautiful and Bruce was never at a loss for words when describing the wonders of Kauai. (The weather also cooperated making it a great flight).
If we decide to visit Kauai again, it will be because of our experience last Sunday.

Thank you  Bruce & Ellen...this was well worth the price and time.
Ken & Patty

It was my intention to extend my flight experience and to enjoy the beautiful island of Kauai. With Wings over Kauai I have found a great partner to achieve both targets. On the left seat of the C172 I had the chance to explore the airspace of Kauai and with Bruce on the right seat it was relaxing to enjoy the great scenery. I've liked the professional approach and the warm atmosphere at Wings over Kauai. Just perfect! It is highly recommended to enjoy the great services of Bruce and his team.

Last month my husband, daughter, son-in-law and I chose to take a tour of Kauai using Wings Over Kauai. What a good decision !  Fanny and Captain Bruce made us feel welcome from the start.  The flight was smooth and gave us some beautiful views of Kauai. Bruce was very informative about about what we were seeing, but he also gave us some wonderful suggestions of other things to do while in Kauai. We were all sad when the flight was over. I would highly recommend Wings Over Kauai to anyone who is thinking of taking an air tour of the island.

Josh was our pilot and the flight was amazing.  The views and scenery together with Josh commentary and music was wonderful.  Highly recommend this flight as there are many things on this beautiful island that you can only see by air

review_title: Smooth and Inexpensive way to view the best of Kauai!
review_text: We took the afternoon ride of WOK on 22nd of September and Bruce was our Pilot. The experience was amazing! Check-in was great and the whole experience from start to finish was wonderful! The plane ride was smoother than the helicopter ride we did in BI and much cheaper too. I would recommend WOK over a helicopter ride and plus it's a lot cheaper as well. We also got a short free DVD of the tour along with our picture on the DVD cover!

We had amazing weather for our flight hardly a cloud in the sky. The flight was smooth and Captain Josh was great, loved the music that went with all the different sites we saw and the informative commentary by Josh. Check in by Dori was great and loved getting a complimentary photo of us with the plane. Also purchased a HD video of our actual flight which was definitely worth it such a great memory to have. The scenery of the island has to be seen to be believed. Overall an awesome experience thanks Captain Josh and Dori.

Reservamos el Cesna privado, el vuelo es una experiencia inolvidable, y nuestro piloto Bruce hizo lo mejor para que nos sintiéramos a gusto. Yo iba delante y mi mujer atrás, y a mi me hizo sentir como si fuera su copiloto, me hizo leerle la checklist de antes de despegar y me expicó como funcionaba, muy amable en todo momento. Las vistas son increíbles y acerca el avión para verlo de cerca, espectacular. Durante el vuelo pone música como por ejemplo de Jurassic Park que hace el vuelo más espectacular aún. Cuando acabó el vuelo me dejó ayudarle a aparcar la avioneta en el hangar, un tío muy majo.

Totalmente recomendable, por unos 100€ tendréis una experiencia para recordar toda la vida.

Bruce was an amazing Pilot.  I must admit that I was afraid of flying in this type of plane but he made you feel at ease.  The staff was awesome and it was just a great experience.  Beautiful view.  Some spots of the island can only be seen by air.  Lots of pictures taken.  Wished we could have kept flying longer.

Bruce was our Pilot on our private Wings over Kauai trip and he was just awesome. The hospitality of him and his crew is excellent and we felt very comfortable prior, during and after the trip. With the roundtrip over the island you see spots you can't reach by car, foot or boat. We really recommend choosing Wings over Kauai for your flight, you will not regret!

Just a heads up for those of you thinking of booking.  We had reserved 4 months in advance and the day before we were supposed to fly, they said our pilot was going to be "off Island".  This was supposed to be the highlight of our Hawaiian vacation.

We were welcomed by Bruce and his team which was only the beginning of our wonderful island experience. The views were breathtaking and the knowledge Bruce had was outstanding. Many photos. Loved every minute of this flight. Would book this again over and over.

We did this tour on our last day of our Hawaiian cruise and by far it was the highlight of our trip. We had Josh as our pilot. He is experienced with many years of flying with Wings and commercial airplanes. I was a bit nervous but he quickly calmed any fears I was having with a smooth take off. The views we saw from the air are breath taking. This is one tour I will never forget.

review_title: Personal and Excellent view of the beautiful Island
review_text: I loved the fact that Wings over Kauai felt very personal. Bruce and his staff were very friendly, the complimentary picture was such a nice touch. With that said the flight was very smooth, windows were large and gave us excellent view. Bruce was an excellent guide and gave us so much information during the flight and the personal touch of showing where we were staying and pointing out some of the features were were interested in. I would strongly recommend wings over kauai!

We thoroughly enjoyed flying with Bruce over the island of Kauai during our vacation.  He was a wonderful guide and a great pilot!  We got a lot of beautiful pictures and learned much about the island! We highly recommend them!!

review_title: Outstanding Tour and Breathtaking View of Kauai!!!!!
review_text: We took this tour while in Kauai, and it was one of the best things we have EVER done!  The views are breathtaking and you feel like you are floating while seeing everything around the island.  You are able to see everything, big windows and the ride was 100% comfortable.  We took our 2 year old daughter on the tour, and she ate her breakfast and then fell asleep....that is how peaceful the whole tour is!  The pilot was super friendly, and pointed out very interesting facts about the island.  You truly get a completely different view of things with this company.  And they have the sweetest dog in the office that LOVED our daughter!  We are planning on flying with them when we come back to Kauai.  Very Highly Recommend them!!!!

review_title: Best thing we did on Kauai !
review_text:
We had an amazing flight with Bruce in the 2 seater Cessna. The views were spectacular, and It was much smoother and more scenic than I could have imagined. Not only was Bruce a great pilot, he was an excellent tour guide. My husband loved sitting in the front seat and doing the pre flight check ! what an experience. We couldn't have had a better view of the amazing Napali coast. 
Thanks Bruce for the tip about Fish Express. It was excellent. thank you !
Jen and Damien :)
A truly unforgettable trip. The small plane was a much smoother ride than I had expected. Beautiful views over the Waimea canyon, Na Pali coast and across the whole of the island.

This was one of the most fantastic experiences ever.  The whole process from booking, paying, reminders, actual flight to sending us our edited video of the flight, was very efficient.  We've previously done helicopter tours but this was the first time in a small plane, and I would say it was better - less noisy and more space to move about - I was moving from one seat to another to get better views.  Our party of 4 had the plane to ourselves, so it didn't seem as cramped as it does in a helicopter.  The views of the island were fantastic and we were very lucky to get a clear day, with just a bit of rain at the summit.  Our pilot Josh was very informative  and pointing out places of interest. The tour lasted about 65 minutes, but it didn't seem as long as that as we looked at the amazing scenery.

What a fantastic experience.  Bruce is a great pilot while being very informative and funny.  We took the flight on the first full day of our stay on Kauai and used it to plan where to visit by car, although most of the views are only visible by air, so make the most of them.  We now have an hour of video and many, many photographs to edit before we show our family and friends our amazing adventure.  Bruce also involves you in the whole experience, allowing me to help him with his pre-flight checks.  Free pictures of us standing by the plane and a short promotional DVD were also included.  All this and still cheaper than the big helicopter corporations.  We highly recommend Wings Over Kauai to anyone wanting to fly over the island.

review_title: Kaua'i is such a stunning island!
review_text:
And Wings Over Kaua'i will take you on a revealing bird's eye view to all of the island's glory! 
It was a thrilling experience!

Our pilot was Josh, he was very friendly and informative, very relax and easy going too. Take-off and landing on this small plane is very smooth, if you were to close your eyes you wouldn't be able to tell whether you are on the ground or not.

Our thrill was enhanced because we have been to Kaua'i a few times before, so we had seen a lot of the sights from the ground. It was fabulous to see them from another perspective. Flying close to Mount Waialeale is an inspiring moment, seeing the heart of what created the island millions of years ago. You can not feel anything else but respect for the forces of nature.

We chose this operator because it seems like the small airplanes are less noisy than helicopters, use less fuel and people are simply raving about Wings Over Kaua'i!

Word of advice: if you are a party of four, make sure you are booking the Grand Deluxe Tour, as you'll have the plane for yourselves and will be seated on the right side of the plane where 90% of the views are the best.

We bought the blu-ray version of our flight, the image quality is stunning, plus the recorded discussion really put you back on the mood you were when you took the flight!

This was the best experience we had during on stay on Kauai in August 2014! We had booked this flight many months in advance as this was high on our 'to do' list. It turned out that we were booked on the day that hurricane Iselle was to hit the island. As soon as I heard the timing of the hurricane, I called Wings Over Kauai to see if there was any possibility to be rescheduled. They were very understanding, and moved our flight up to 2 days earlier. We went up on a morning flight and fortunately it turned out to be a beautiful day! We saw incredible views of the island with its many waterfalls. The Napali coast was stunning. As it the summer, we were able to see many sandy beaches and entrances to caves. Our pilot, Josh (if my memory is correct) was extremely knowledgeable and pointed out the different places we were seeing along with some history of the island. The 3 falls of the 'Fantasy Island' falls can only be seen from the air. The aerial view of Waimea Canyon is just beautiful with its colorful red rock mixed with lush green vegetation. After seeing the entire island from an aerial view, it gave us a comparative perspective for seeing the island from a ground level view.

Several people that I have told about this experience have all said that they are 'afraid' to get on a small plane that seats 6-8 people. My husband, daughter (10) and I had never been on a small plane, but it was very smooth and it just felt like we were floating in the air. It was not scary  at all!  Our pilot had flown with American Airlines and was very experienced. We felt very safe! We purchased a video of our flight (cameras were mounted on the plane's wings) and had fun re-experiencing our adventure on DVD after returning home. You will not be disappointed!

review_title: The only way to see Kauai!
review_text: After reading reviews and safety records of the helicopter tours, my husband and I decided to take a plane tour with the Wings Over Kauai, and we were thrilled.  We took a private tour with Bruce on the Cessna and he did a great job checking in with us throughout the trip and pointing out many of the sights.  There is nothing like the views of Kauai from the air.  Driving the island (which we did), doesn't allow you to see half of the amazing landscape.  This was truly a highlight of our trip!  We'd highly recommend Wings Over Kauai to anyone visiting the island.

review_title: Highlight of our visit to this most beautiful island
review_text: Captain Bruce, a long time resident of Kauai, was most knowledgeable and entertaining. He had fascinating stories about places that otherwise would have just been another beautiful sight. Speaking of beautiful sights, you see them all. I took over 200 great photos, many of them of places you can't see any other way than from the air. My wife's concerns about flying in a small plane for the first time were quickly dissipated by the smooth ride and amazing views that started right after take off and ended right before landing. Bruce's scientific background adds a another dimension to his ability to answer questions which he happily did many times. He also personalized his commentary to his passengers' questions and backgrounds. The staff was also great leading to a totally wonderful experience that I would highly recommend.

I booked this trip last minute after arriving in Kauai. It turned out to be the highlight of our trip. I highly recommend this as a must do. The trip offered fantastic view of the island in parts that are not accessible otherwise. Our pilot Josh was great and checking in was easy. I like that they provided little surprises for the guests (you have to book it to experience it so I am not going to spoil your surprise here in the review). 

The only reason it is 4 stars was because they initially confirmed our booking at 2pm but somehow someone else was able to still book that time slot online and they called back a day later to change our reservation to 4pm. It worked out for us since we didn't plan something at that time but I can see how this can present problems for travelers with a tighter schedule. I am not sure why this would happen since we called to make the reservation so I would have thought that this means nobody else can book online in the same time slot that has been booked by phone.

But I have to say everyone (including the person on the reservation phone line) I met at this company was very polite and friendly so I think you should book it without any hesitations! This is the best $125 tour I did.

What a great way to see the Island We chartered the whole plane for our group of 6 youngest 8 oldest 85 everyone loved it. Pilot and company very professional. The views are breathtaking Highly recommend

review_title: Really nice flight for a family!!
review_text: We enjoyed the flight led by Bruce. Our small kids, 3 and 5, both enjoyed the one hour flight and are still talking about it every day. The views of Napali coast, water falls, valley are all beautiful. Will definitely return!

Hands down the best flight experience ever! Bruce is such a kind person and excellent pilot. Thanks to him and his staff we had gained a lot of geographical knowledge of the island, as well as of the flora.
Their price of the flight was really affordable as well; less than $300 for 2 people for a private flight in the cessna.

Highly recommended!

Fabulous experience flying with Bruce this week during our stay at my new favorite island. We booked "flight school" so my boyfriend learned to fly the Cessna plane while Bruce sat beside him and guided. I took great pics and videos from the back seat. Beautiful flight around the island. You can only see 20% by car so you have to tour by plane. Bruce added lots of fun tidbits during the hour flight and pointed out everything we were looking at. Great experience and very reasonable rates!!

review_title: Fantastic. So glad we did this!
review_text:
Took the air an tour and so very glad we did. It was a fabulous experience.

Check in and flight preparation was handled by Fanny and when it came time to board it was just the 4 of us, so a very private experience also.

Bruce was a great guide engaging with everyone and providing an entertaining commentary throughout.

The views are breathtaking and he was right about enjoying the flight and not worrying about photographs. I did get a few but the best memories are in my head.

If you are thinking of a trip like this then I can gladly recommend wings over Kauai. We have twice before used helicopters ( Grand Canyon and Big Island) which we all enjoyed but this really was so much better!

Am 26. März 2014 war zunächst der Himmel mit Regenwolken verhangen. Doch eine kurze Wartezeit hat sich gelohnt. Die herzliche Art, mit der wir empfangen wurden, stimmte uns in das überragende Erlebnis ein. Sollten Sie Kauai besuchen, gönnen Sie sich eine Stunde Augenschmaus aus dem Flugzeug. Ganz individuell wurde uns die Insel erklärt, auch Ziele genannt, die wir nicht verpassen sollten oder unerreichbare Gebiete überfolgen, die nur von oben sichtbar sind. Wir reisten mit zwei kleinen Kindern, die liebevoll versorgt wurden. Gern schauen wir uns unsere eigenen Fotos oder die CD an, die unseren Flug dokumentiert.

Una de las mejores opciones para ver toda la isla! 

Nos pareció mejor opcion que el helicóptero.  Mitad de precio y buen sitio garantizado! 

Escogimos la opción del vuelo privado en el Cessna. Merece la pena pagar unos 15 USD mas para poder ir solo con tu pareja. 

Brett, nuestro piloto, muy amable!

Very friendly, knowledgeable, and personal staff, Unbelievable views of the Island. Reasonably priced, especially compared to helicopter flights that can be almost twice the cost.
A must do while on the island.

wenn man nach Kauai reist sollte man unbedingt eine Air tour machen, da viele Orte nur aus der Luft oder per Boot zu besichtigen sind. Es gibt zahlreiche Angebote von Helikopter Flügen, doch wir habe uns für die Cessna entschieden. Wir haben die Privattour gebucht und es war einfach super! Bruce unser Pilot war super und hart alles schön erklärt und noch Tipps gegeben. Als wir am Abflugort ankamen wurden wir sofort herzlich in empfang genommen und begrüsst. Ich empfehle diese Tour jedem weiter! Es ist einfach ein einmaliges Erlebnis!!

Hatten heute Morgen einen Flug mit Bruce von Wings Over Kauai in der kleinen Cessna. Viel dazu brauche ich nicht zu sagen, da schon fast alles gesagt wurde. Eindrückliche Landschaften mit einem super Sympathischen Team. Würde ohne zu zögern sofort wieder mit Wings Over Kauai fliegen!

review_title: Don't hesitate--sign up for this tour!
review_text: One of our best experiences on a guided tour.  We were made to feel very welcome on arrival and throughout the tour.  The views were spectacular.  Loved the attention to detail--music that was synchronized to where you were on the tour including the theme to Hawaii 5-0 on takeoff.  The Na Pali coast was awesome and we saw many, many spectacular waterfalls.  Who could of thought one would start taking 3000 foot waterfalls for granted?  Loved the picture that was taken of our group in front of the plane and emailed to us and can't wait to get the video including our audio comments during the tour.  The tour was very reasonably priced.

My husband, our son and I took the Cessna up with Bruce on Aug 17 for the 70 minute aerial tour of Kauai.  It was a truly amazing flight. We saw parts of Kauai we had never seen before.
