The Na Pali coast views were spectacular and we learned about the extinct volcano at Poipu. We had never seen that crater before.  We also saw the Fantasy Island waterfall. All in all a great trip. I only have four stars because our son was the only one on the left side of the plane along with Bruce the pilot and he complained afterwards that he could not see most of the sights very well.  I felt really bad afterwards.  Had I known I would have switched seats with him. Almost all the views were on the right side of the plane so if you ever do this tour make sure you are on the right side.  We also felt a bit queasy after the flight but no one got sick thankfully. Also if you have long legs make sure you are in one of the two back seats. More legroom on those seats.  Big difference between the planes versus the helicopters is the planes are half the cost so if you are on a budget this is a great way to go. Also the helicopters fly into Waimea Canyon but our plane did not.  Bruce was a very informative and friendly your guide. Landing was smooth too.

review_title: The only way to see the Island
review_text:
Kauai is a stunning Island and there are parts of it that can only be appreciated from the Air.

Wings Over Kauai looked after us brilliantly and Captain Josh took us on a trip of a lifetime. Stunning views, great narration with humour (he even appreciated my English sarcasm regarding the in flight music, I think!) and terrific flying meant this was a highlight of our 3 week Hawaii trip. Thanks to everyone!

Josh was our pilot, and he was the absolute best we could have ever asked for.  His wife took care of all the preliminary/paperwork - she was so sweet and helpful.  Josh was so informative, educational, as well as entertaining.  He was a first rate pilot as well as tour guide, we couldn't have received a better one!  We are telling all of our California friends and neighbors about Wings Over Kauai, so when they go to this tropical paradise - they can receive the same amazing service that we did -as well as a breathtaking tour of this beautiful island.  THANK YOU WINGS OVER KAUAI!!

it was an absolutely amazing tour, the attitude to visitors is unbelievably friendly. This is one of the tours where a Family  business makes you feel really special. There were a couple of extra things, such as complimentary video CD branded with your picture, kukui necklace, live conversation on board of the airplane ... I absolutely enjoyed it when before taking off the captain asked "2nd pilot" (you) to read through a check-list before taking off. these guys definitely differentiate!
There is so much that can only be seen and appriecated by air in Kauai. As a private pilot I can attest to their attention to safety and professionalism.

This was the most amazing and beautiful thing I've ever seen and been a part of. Bruce, our captain, was amazing and his staff were as well. I cannot say enough about how beautiful it was to see Kauai from the air and Bruce made my husband and I feel very comfortable and safe. He even played music in our headphones that went with the scenery we were seeing. The entire trip was fantastic and I wish we could have stayed up there for hours. It went by so fast. The whole experience was amazing even though I thought I was frightened to death beforehand. You really must try it and don't be scared to do this. As far as the cost, I justified it after pricing helicopter tours and boat tours. We were given a lot of info about the island by our captain while flying over. It was just so beautiful and unforgettable. Must do!!!

review_title: You will fall in love with Kauai
review_text: What a fabulous way to view Kauai.  Don't spend unnecessary money on a helicopter ride, when you can FLY with WIngs Over Kauai.  We were picked up in their van at a nearby shopping center when our cruise ship was docked.  It was only a short walk for us to get there.  Super friendly staff and the most enjoyable flight and views of the Island.  They took photos of us before we boarded the plane and gave us a very lovely bead leis.  After our flight, they GAVE us a disc with our pics.  NICE surprise.  When I arrived home, I also received an email from them with more pics.  LOVE IT !   A MUST for your vacation.

If you only read the first sentence - This is a must adventure!  From the booking to the flight and afterwards, top notch service.  Josh not only kept us safe and gave us a wonderful flight, but also taught us much about the island's history.  This will be an excursion that we will never forget - for me it was the highlight of our trip (we visited Kauai and the Big Island on this vacation).  The views are spectacular and the ride was smooth.  A big Thank You to the entire crew at Wings over Kauai

Our experience with Wings Over Kauai was excellent.  This is the best way to see Kauai and the cost is much better than the helicopter or snorkel excursions.  We were able to take 6 of us for less than $100 apiece.  our pilot/tour guide Josh was outstanding - very informative.  We learned a lot about the island and the many movies filmed there.  The views were spectacular, waterfalls everywhere in the mountains.  If I'm ever in Kauai again, I know this is something I will definitely do again.  We visited both Kauai and the big island (Kona) and this was the highlight of our trip for me!

review_title: Top Notch - Must Do in Kauai
review_text: We were passengers on the cruise, Norwegian Pride of America, and chose to take this tour based on the reviews. We were not disappointed - it was spectacular, the #1 highlight of our trip. We had rented a car, so we drove directly to the air strip but they will conveniently pick you up near the cruise port if you do not rent a car. It was a beautiful, clear day and the views that you see are indescribable.We had a party of 7, so we took both planes up at the same time with both Bruce and Josh as pilots. This company did everything possible to meet our needs and make us comfortable. I could not imagine better guides - just a fabulous experience with a fantastic local company, do not hesitate to book this tour!
One of the best ways to see this stunning island. All the staff are wonderful. Highly recommend to anyone!

review_title: Fantastic way to see the island!
review_text: This was out first tour in an airplane (we've done helicopter rides before) and it was a great way to see the island.  Our pilot was Josh and went on the 65 minute tour of the island although we all would have enjoyed staying up even longer.  It was an amazing way to see Kauai and there was so much to see from the air, including a couple of isolated beaches that I would not mind going to visit (only accessible by boat).  In the 65 minutes, we had clear, cloudy and rainy skies so it was pretty amazing to see how the weather varies on the island.  The ride was fine although it was a bit bumpy at times but the views were just amazing and Kauai is one very beautiful island.  Josh was talkative throughout the tour (but not too much) and welcomed our questions, which made the trip that much better.  I would highly recommend the tour!

On the afternoon of June 27th my daughter, wife and me took the 4:00 pm tour with Wings Over Kauai air tours. It was the highlight of my fabulous trip to Kauai. Doctor Bruce was the pilot of the plane and he was perfect as a guide. The descriptions, detail information about Kauai was second to no one. He was a gentleman and very professional, his passion for flying and Kauai were evident. The treatment by his entire crew was also excellent. Needless to say his flying was great, smooth and sensational.

I highly recommend this company anytime.

Sincerely

Rene Tato

After reviewing advice online and the cost factor we chose "Wings Over Kauai" for our air-tour of the Island. Our pilot was Josh and he made the trip exciting. Also, my husband sat right next to him in the co-pilot seat which was awesome, It is true that if you sit on the left side of the plane you will not see exactly what the people on the right side see but you are in an "airplane" so come-on the flight was amazing. I leaned over to look out the right side window and then they leaned over to look out the left side when we flew down the center of the Island (Waimea Canyon).Something people may want to think about also is the size of the plane vs. a Helicopter; If you are a little bit fearful of flying for the first time I would choose the airplane over the helicopter. The airplane is equipped with GO-PRO Cameras so you can purchase the DVD from them after you complete the trip of the island. It has all your conversations that took place during the flight as you are all speaking and listening through head-phones during the whole ride. We actually saw the hotel were Elvis Presley stayed and filmed "Blue Hawaii" burn to the ground as we flew over, "that added some excitment to the audio and the trip".....Overall if you have never done something like this before and have nothing to compare it to; I give the trip a 5 star rating, Do your homework and check out the pricing for something like this. It is 1/2 of what the helicopter tour cost, it was a great exerience for our family of 6 adults.

review_title: A Great Way to See the Island
review_text: A whole hour of flying around the island seeing all of the attractions for only $150pp. The flight was great, with good headphones and excellent viewing out each window. You get a window per person, unlike the helicopters. The pilot, Josh, was well informed and easy to talk to. He showed us all the sights plus some. The takeoff  was great with the music in the headphones. I recommend this flight to see the beauty of the island.

We loved our flight! Josh was an amazing tour guide who flys Big aircraft when he's no doing this, his first love. We couldn't have asked for a better experience- it really is worth twice the price : )

We fit 6 people in the plane and had a great time. It was great to be able to talk to everyone the whole time. Beautiful views. The weather was cloudy, but the plane flew just under the clouds so we could still see everything. The best chair is the co-pilot. The seats on the left side of the plane are not as good. Pilot was great. I would say that it is less turbulence than a boat ride.

review_title: Right side awesome, left side lacking
review_text: We flew the hour tour on Wings Over Kauai last Saturday.  Josh was a personable and capable pilot, and the rest of my part (seated on right side of plane) had a great experience.  Sadly, I was on the left side, and had minimal views for much of the tour, had to lean over to attempt to see out (and shoot photos over my wife's shoulder).  I understand there's no way to only put guests on one side of the plane, but given the lack of views on the left side, I wish I hadn't gone, or at least hadn't paid the same as those on the right side.  Trip advertised as an hour, think the actual time from take off to landing was more like 50 minutes.  We bought the DVD of the trip afterwards, was somewhat surprised that we had to pay shipping for it, then found a pop up ad on a Kauai website for a free copy several days later.  Live and learn, I suppose.

Awesome service. Our pilot, Bruce, made a point to keep track of all our names and interacted with each of us by name throughout the flight. A very nice touch. We actually flew through some rain (as might be expected as you approach the rainiest mountain on earth) and turbulence didn't get uncomfortable. They had assured us that if they had to cancel due to weather that we would not be charged for the tour at all. It is true that everyone gets a window seat but the nature of an airplane is that it doesn't turn on a dime. They essentially have to choose to go around the island clockwise or counterclockwise. They choose clockwise, so those on the right hand side of the airplane get the best views. If you fill the plane, there will be 2 guests on the right and 4 on the left. They do fly across the middle of the island, turning inland over Poipu going up Waimea Canyon and then out over the ocean for the trip down Na Pali. He does do a full circle over the most beautiful section of Na Pali so everyone on the plane gets a view. He then flies to the left of Ke'e beach and Tunnels then turns inland over Princeville for a nice view of the waterfalls coming off the mountains there. They don't fly as low as helicopters do, but I wonder if helicopters take you over the entire island. (I think they may have to focus on one area or another.) 

Overall a great trip for a fraction of the cost of a helicopter trip. 

We chose airplane over a boat trip because we feared Captain Andy's from Port Allen would be too choppy and the risk of getting seasick was too high. Also we heard the Port Allen route gives you too short of a visit to the Na Pali coast.

Thanks, Bruce!

I'd recommend doing the tour as one of your first experiences on the island. The pilot was incredibly informative and personable and gives you a range of ideas/areas to explore during your time on the island. The views are amazing and you will love the experience.

My wife and I picked Kauai to celebrate our 40th anniversary, and our Wings Over Kauai air tour was a high lite of our trip.  My wife is not comfortable with heights, so we selected a fixed wing tour rather then a helicopter tour.  For a few extra $ we chose the Cessna 172 and had the plane to ourselves.  Our pilot Bruce was great and we had a wonderful adventure seeing Kauai from the air.  If your thinking of an Kauai air tour, you should seriously consider Wings Over Kauai.  We loved it!

We have nothing but good things to say about this outfit.

I tried to book online but everything looked full and I was working on my smartphone which made it difficult. I gave up and called, and Ellen was helpful and patient with me, and let me know how to go about booking.

We got our flight scheduled (for the next day!) and followed the specific driving directions provided on the email confirmation. They took us right where we needed to go, and we were met by a friendly and helpful Bruce, who showed us to the waiting area and gave us some interesting reading material about the island.

Josh, our pilot, then came out to greet us, point out our plane, and let us know they were almost ready for us.

Shortly thereafter Abi greeted us and got us all set up for our flight. She let us know exactly what to expect and answered all of our questions. It turned out I HAD done something wrong trying to book via smartphone but Abi made it no big deal and corrected my error. She was helpful and friendly and then took us out to the plane where she and Josh helped us board.

Josh was great. He was very personable, answered all of our questions, and clearly knows how to pilot a plane. He said he flies several times a day several days a week, but he never made us feel like we were just a number. He was friendly and helpful, answering our questions that weren't even related to the flight or the island -- like where to get the best steak -- but that will remain our little secret. :-)

We highly recommend Wings Over Kauai. Our 14 year old son thought it was "really cool" and our 16 year old daughter couldn't believe how quickly the 65-70 minute flight went by. My husband and I were simply stunned by the beauty and enjoyed learning more about the island.

We felt the length of the tour was perfect, and--although not mechanics--felt the plane was in great condition and it was clean and tidy. We didn't do a helicopter tour due to some motion sickness two of us experience sometimes and we think this was a good decision. One of us was fine and the other experienced mild discomfort which was helped by some ginger chews provided by Abi.

Oh! We did the Airvan charter so we didn't have to share our plane and it cost $500 for the 4 of us + a tip that was not required but we happily gave. Enjoy Kauai! Aloha!

review_title: Excellent Air Tour  for all ages! 1/2 the price of Helicopter Tours
review_text: This is the way to see Kauai! The air van is small (holds six and pilot), but everyone has a great view. Our pilot was super. He engaged everyone, had interesting facts to share and ensured everyone was comfortable and had a good time. This trip is about 1/2 the price of helicopter and was a great way to see everything.

This was a treat!  I've taken a helicopter tour, which was cool, but sometimes a little unnerving.  If you want a little more metal around your seat area, do this flight.  The ride was totally smooth, and personally narrated by the pilot...sitting right next to me.  To make the flight extra special, I got to help with the pre-flight check list!  I felt more involved in this flight than in a helicopter.  I was right there with the pilot, helping and seeing all flight prep right in front of me.  I am one of those window watchers in any flight I take, and this was the ultimate view.  My husband and I got the personal touch, not some canned audio presentation, showing us just the sights the flight company wants us to see.  My own personal pilot answered all my questions, and even shared some family hiking stories of his own.  We saw plenty of waterfalls, and traveled over miles of gorgeous coastline before heading through the middle of Kauai, and back to the airport.  I was greeted with a real Kukui nut lei, and a pre-flight photo of my husband and I was waiting in my email box the next day.  I'm only sorry I haven't written this review until now.  Dr. Bruce and his staff were very welcoming, and made sure we had a special experience we will always remember.

review_title: Flying as a student pilot with CFI Bruce was amazing.
review_text: Val and Bruce made the experience of my piloting the Cessna 172 a wonderful experience. Bruce's over all relaxed demeanor, knowledge of flying and information of the beautiful island of Kauai was priceless.

We have been to Hawaii several times and taken just as many helicopter tours over the islands. This time we decided to take to the air by fixed wing.  Man it was a great way to see the island and I got some phenomenal pictures. To be fair we also took a helicopter tour a few days later back around the island. We got in closer on the helicopter tour, but we got so much more of a view from the plane. The pilot is great and the info you get from him is very informative. I would strongly recommend this your to anyone considering seeing the island.

My husband, 4yo and I loved this flight - Bruce is funny, entertaining and extremely knowledgable about the island (and flying).  It was a terrific way to see Kauai and we are so happy we did this tour. Thank you!

We had the opportunity to tour Kauai 3 weeks ago. I knew we were off to a great start when I noticed the Virginia Tech decorations in the office. Bruce is able to combine Aloha spirit with Virginia hospitality. The flight was smooth and so relaxing that I almost forgot to take photos. His knowledge of the island is outstanding and the view from the plane was unbelievable. Thanks for a  memorable addition to our vacation.

review_title: A unique way to see Kauai
review_text: We organised a one day fly in/ out trip to Kauai from Honolulu and Wings Over Kauai helped make it an unforgettable experience. The flight covered some amazing landscapes, visibility form the plane was excellent, and the whole experience was very professionally managed. Everybody had a window seat, and the flight was a generous 65 minutes.

review_title: Highly recommended...  better than a sunset cruise
review_text:
So the BF and I were debating whether to view the Na Pali Coast by water or air.  I made the executive decision to do both.  We did the cheaper sunset cruise with Captain Andy's the night prior.  This by far, was a much better, unique experience.  

I know most people do the helicopter tours but those were much more expensive and I was wary about riding in a helicopter hovering over places like that and the loud noise.   Besides that, this place came highly rated on Trip Advisor so this was the choice for us.

The family that runs this company are very professional and courteous to a T.  Upon booking, I think I spoke with Bruce who was super friendly and helpful over the phone.  I hung up with a good feeling about them.

We were running slightly late because we took a wrong turn at the airport and had to circle around so they called us just as we were parking the car.   Dori was still very nice about it.  They called me to the back office and introduced themselves to me, each of the 3 people, shaking my hand.  I work in customer service so I make a note to commend them on that.

They gave me a kukui nut lei and a small white flower (I think it was a tuberose) to put in your hair.  It smelled wonderful but you can't really wear it on your ear since you have to wear the headphones on the plane so I ended up sticking it in my purse.  My boyfriend oddly enough, did not get any gift so I thought that was strange.  Another couple was there and the man was wearing the same kukui nut lei I had and the woman had on a different kind.  I suspected that they gave it to her but she may have already been wearing one.  Anyway, that was the only thing that bothered me about their service.  They should equally be accommodating to the males.

I agree with a prior review I read about doing this towards the end of your trip so you can see the places you have been to previously by land.  It gives you a better frame of reference and a greater appreciation of this beautiful island.  There are no bad seats on the air van.  Each seat has its own window.  They seat you by weight.  My boyfriend sat next to the pilot and I sat directly behind my boyfriend but I was fine with that.  They also provide drinks, at least mini water bottles and ginger candies in case you are prone to motion sickness.

The flight itself was outstanding.  Our pilot/guide, Josh, was super knowledgeable about everything and even answered all the curious questions we had about various things we saw.  The views were spectacularly awesome and they even had a soundtrack during the trip, sometimes corresponding to the view (i.e. - the Jurassic park music).  That was a GREAT, very much appreciated touch.  

They take photos of you in front of the airplane before you take off and email it to you for free.  Make sure the other passengers are not in the back photo-bombing your picture with their legs on the other side of the plane like ours had.  They have a video of your specific flight for sale if you want it but they gave us generic one for free!  :)

Loved it!  A must do!

What a great experience!  Our hosts for the day included pilot Josh, his lovely wife Dori, and their very cute dog Millie.  Josh was obviously very experienced and made everyone feel comfortable -he was engaging, shared many of his experiences and gave a great overview of the Kauai.  For me personally Josh ensured I felt safe and comfortable the entire flight.  Dori and Millie were the 'ground crew' and were very welcoming to us. We choose WOK as an affordable option for our family of 5 to see the island together and were not disappointed! We also decided to purchase the optional video and have enjoyed reliving the experience of the flight - 2 of us had GoPros on the flight but found the WOK video provided better footage and included the audio as well.  We would not hesitate to do this again and highly recommend it as a fun way to see Kauai from the air. Thanks again to Josh, Dori and Millie!

Wings over Kauai is an awesome group. We had a great time flying them on our recent trip. My husband made the reservation for us based mostly on how good the reviews were. We weren't totally on a budget but after spending 2 weeks island hopping between Maui, Oahu, and Kauai and paying for a wedding in Maui, we didn't need to spend any unnecessary money. We decided to see Kauai via plane instead of the slightly more expensive helicopter tours. Obviously we don't know if the helicopter tour would have gotten closer or whatever, but we definitely feel that we made the right choice. We took our tour with my dad, who's a pilot himself, and my mom. Our pilot was Josh. He was a lot of fun, as was everyone we talked to. It was a real casual, welcoming feel as we were getting checked in. We really enjoyed meeting Millie the dog. She's a really sweet dog they rescued. I fly a lot but I am a little nervous about smaller planes, so I was worried with how I would do on the trip. It ended up being okay. There were a few times I felt uncomfortable, but Josh did an excellent job flying us around and keeping us safe. The tour was awesome. We had been to Kauai once before, but there's no better way to see it than from the sky. The Napali Coast and Waimea Canyon were especially spectacular from above. We were really interested in waterfalls so Josh made sure to point out as many as he could. He was extremely knowledgeable of the island and we learned a lot as we flew around. This tour really is an excellent value for what you get out of it. We had a blast and it's one of my favorite things we did on the entire two week trip.

review_title: Wings Over Kauai, A Great Experience
review_text: Our group of five took the 9:30 am tour on Wings Over Kauai. Our Captain Bruce was very knowledgable and interesting. The flight was very smooth and the view was absolutely beautiful. The service and price can't be beat. I would highly recommend the Wings Over Kauai tour. I would definitely do it again if I am lucky enough to get back there!!

Great flight a week ago around Kauai with our pilot Bruce!  I am a private pilot with 450+ hours in single engine aircraft and know procedures and systems.  The Wings Over Kauai aircraft was in excellent condition and Bruce's attention to safety and procedures was performed at a very high level.  

The flight itself was excellent.  Smooth takeoff, flight, and landing.  We saw all the major sights and the narration of the flight by Bruce was informative and entertaining at the same time.  Incredible views every second of the flight.

I would not hesitate to recommend this flight for people who want a great view of the island, and the aircraft are a great way for people squeamish about helicopters to still see the island.

Wings Over Kauai made our honeymoon complete! We had been contemplating a helicopter ride which can be pricey.  We found Wings Over Kauai and this was a perfect solution! Bruce, our pilot, was well educated on island info.  He was able to point out so many fun facts about the island. The plan itself was a nice slow smooth ride.  We felt like we were floating.  I thought a helicopter would be better to see all the landscape, but this plane did a great job and flying slow and allowing us to see all the views/sites we wanted to see. This was an affordable solution to seeing beautiful Kauai by air!! I would definitely recommend!!

Ours was a great flight! The pilot, Bruce is an accomplished scientist. And Kauai is as geologically interesting as it is visually breathtaking. Bruce, scientist cum entertainer, had this physician tourist smiling from ear-to-ear both intra-and extra-cranially!

review_title: Amazing way to experience this beautiful island
review_text:
Our family booked a 4 pm flight seeing trip with Wings over Kauai for early July.  It was an amazing experience with all seats having a great viewpoint of this beautiful island - the commentary was informative and interesting and the flight showcased the many wonders of Kauai, from the cliffs of the Na Pali coast, the various formations and waterfalls, Waimea canyon and other parts of the island.
The booking and check in processes were seamless and the flight was very enjoyable. 
They also record the trip using a range of cameras with the option to purchase a DVD/digital recording after the fact to help with reliving the wonderful experience. 
As someone prone to travel sickness, I didn't have any problems with this flight and found it very comfortable (as an alternative to a helicopter trip).  There was also good air flow for all positions in the plane.
I would highly recommend this trip.    A great way to see the Na Pali Coast which is only accessible by air or boat (if you have the opportunity I would do both as they are both unique and excellent experiences!).

Aufgrund der umfangreichen und durchweg positiven Bewertungen können wir unsere sehr kurz halten, weil Alles schon geschrieben wurde. 
Wir wurden sehr freundlich empfangen und verabschiedet, fühlten uns zu jeder Zeit sehr wohl, hatten Spaß und jede Menge Wows. Der Flug war in der kleinen Cessna aufregend und überwältigend. Ich vermute (weil wir keinen Vergleich hatten) das es keine bessere Flug-Tour auf Kauaii gibt. Das Komplett-Paket, wie bereits von den anderen Urlaubern beschrieben ( CD, Getränk, Herzlichkeit!), kann sicher kaum übertroffen werden. Die familiäre Umgebung tat ihr Übriges. To Ellen und Bruce: Thank you very, very much for the beautiful and awesome time we had! Elke und Frank.

My husband and I took the 9 a.m. tour.  Abi checked us in she was very pleasant.  She presented me with a kukui nut lei before our flight and took a few pictures of  my husband and me.  Josh was our pilot for the day and he was wonderful!  He was so full of knowledge and interesting facts and he put both my husband and me at ease.  I would highly recommend this tour over a helicopter tour because of the price and the customer service.  If we ever return to Kauai, we will definitely visit Wings Over Kauai again!  Mahalo.

review_title: We loved the air tour of Kauai!
review_text: We booked Wings Over Kauai with a party of six and enjoyed a beautiful later afternoon (4:00 PM) flight with Bruce as our captain.  Although the day appeared to be cloudy he was able to fly low enough to provide us with beautiful views of the entire Island pointing out all the interesting features and sharing great stories and Island history.  He and his wife are delightful people, passionate to share their love of Hawaii with others and very helpful with all arrangements.  We loved the tour and would highly recommend this to anyone.  Book it for one of the first days you arrive, it is a great way to get orientated to the entire Island.

My wife and I took the tour and really enjoyed ourselves!  The pilot was very nice and knew so much about the island.  He took us over the majority of the island and especially the Nepali Coast where you can't drive to.  HIGHLY recommend this tour for anyone wanting to see the island from above.

We took our trip this past week on the Cesnna with Our Captain Bruce.
Bruce was outstanding, he was very informative about the landscape and history of Kauai.
The Flight was very smooth and photo's taken from the flight we will cherish forever.
I would highly recommend this to anyone who would like to see all the great sights Kauai has to offer. Thanks again to Abi, Ellen and Bruce !

review_title: A great way to see the 80% of Kauai that is inaccessible by road
review_text: Wings Over Kauai delivered an unforgettable flight over the otherwise inaccessible canyons, waterfalls and coastline of Kauai. The 65 minute flight was expertly narrated by the pilot, Bruce, who is obviously very experienced and has a passion for what he does. Customer service was excellent before, during and after the flight. We were presented with a DVD showing the flight highlights when we landed and we were also sent pre-flight photos via E mail.

We were very pleased with our air tour. First the team is very friendly, our captain (Josh) made this trip very enjoyable with a great narration throughout the trip.
The small plane can take 5-6 people. It is small but comfortable. You get to see the island through large windows that also allows you to take pictures and videos well.
The trip is about one hour but you get to see the best places around the island. It's so much better than any boat tour.
The plane is equipped with 4 GoPro cameras so if you like, you can order the video of your trip and you get to see everything back home again with the same music and comments than during the trip. It got the DVD and it is a nice souvenir.
Great tour, great team.

A small and very friendly company, with great pilots/guides! A great way tot experience Kaua'i. You see spots en beautiful views, that you can't see on land. The pilot is very experienced and also a great guide, who provide a lot of information over the island as well as the flight/plane. The have a passion for flying and Kaua'i. They don't fly just on the clock, but are glad to make an extra round to show you your hotel from above for example. We also received complementary pictures and a DVD. I would say, don't hesitate, JUST DO IT!

We visited Kauai in June 2014 and from research done prior to the trip, an aerial trip early in the vacation was suggested.  Wings Over Kauai was excellent at providing an overview of the island and it was fascinating to see the sights.  Our family did the Grand Deluxe Tour (three of us) and we flew with another couple.  Captain Josh was very personable and engaging, giving advice on several great things to do on the island as well as giving information about the islands flora and tidbits on Hollywood's influence here.  The flight was quite smooth and large windows give expansive views.  Communication with the pilot was provided through earphones and voice microphone so questions were answered and the background music was entertaining as well.  Our flight was at 9:30 and we had good weather lending to great photo ops.  Josh shared the Waimea Canyon area is usually best viewed in the AM flights but Kauai weather is quite unpredictable.  NaPali coastline is particularly beautiful as are the beaches, waterfalls, and the incredible lushness of the landscape there.

Following the tour, a DVD of the highlights given as a gift is nice.  We also purchased a blue ray copy of our tour complete with Captain Josh and his narration and interaction with us.  Highly recommend this trip, plan it early so you can see parts of the island you would like to explore and in case of weather issues, perhaps you can still reschedule.  Thanks for a great memory and keep up the great service provided, WOK!

review_title: Wonderful pilot and way to see the island
review_text: My husband and I took the 1 pm tour our first full day.  Two other people were with us.  The plane ride was very smooth and the pilot and his wife are just wonderful.  Very personable, full of helpful information and facts.  The headsets made it easy to hear and the views were great from the large windows.  They provided a cooler with drinks and ginger chews in case anyone felt ill.  Also gave us a photo in front of the plane and emailed it to us.  Definitely a great way to get both an overview of the island and see the parts inaccessible by car.

review_title: Great way to see all the beauty of Kauai
review_text: I did lots of research before our trip and debated a helicopter vs. fixed wing tour.  I'm glad we chose Wings Over Kauai!  It was very budget-friendly compared to the helicopter tours.  We did the Grand Circle Island tour, there were 6 people on our plane and the pilot.  Josh was an excellent guide, we learned a lot over the course of our flight.  We did the earliest one, and the skies were clear.  All the scenery was gorgeous!  We took lots of pictures and purchased the DVD afterwards.  That's nice because then you have the full narration from your flight.  We had driven around the island the day before, it was neat to see spots we had visited by air.  Great communication when setting up our tour.  We exchanged lots of emails and all my questions were answered promptly.  We were visiting Kauai as a cruise stop, and it was nice that they picked us up near port and brought us back with plenty of time to spare before our departure.  Everyone we dealt with was friendly and professional.  I would definitely recommend WOK!
Loved every moment and our 8 year old daughter really enjoyed it. Captain Josh was awesome! Wings Over Kauai is a must do!!

Our family of five booked a private tour.  The day was just perfect for flying and we were in good hands with Bruce.  My son is thru the AirForce ROTC program to become a pilot and Bruce let him co-pilot.  So fun.  Kauai is just beautiful and Wings Over Kauai was the perfect way to see it.  We loved it!
It's an amazing experience. Bruce is not only a good scientist but also a great pilot. I highly recommend Wings over Kauai, you will enjoy the tour.

We chose to fly in the Cessna on a two-person tour that also was an instructional flight. I'd never flown a plane before, but our pilot, Bruce, was a patient teacher explaining how to use the controls, and I felt safe the whole time despite being really nervous. My science teacher husband enjoyed getting to see the view and learn a little more about the endemic species on Kauai (Bruce really knows his stuff about plants!). I'd recommend doing this towards the end of your trip, since it's really fun to see all the places you've been from up above.

review_title: It was awsome or like we say "herrlich"
review_text:
Thank you very much for this great flight! Due to weather conditions we could not fly on the booked date. But we were upgraded to the private cessna the next day. Only the two of us and Bruce. Bruce speaks a bit German, so Sonja did a little school lesson and thaught him a new word. Awsome = herrlich. And it was!!! Great flight, great view and a real copilot experience fr me with jobs to do on that plane ;-) We had a blast and at the end we got a flight film an our pictures. Really nice family business. Everyone who has the chance should join them. 
Mahalo and Aloha to Bruce and Ellen and Kauai from Sonja and Melanie :-)
Hope we can come back sometime.....

review_title: Wings Over Kauai is a must do!!! Wonderful experience!
review_text: My wife and I flew around the island yesterday with our pilot Bruce in his Cessna airplane. Bruce is a terrific pilot and treated us like family. We saw so many beautiful sights of Kauai from up above with all of them being picture perfect. Fly with Wings Over Kauai you will not regret it. For those of you that might be nervous about flying in a small plane, don't be as you are in good hands with Bruce and his team. This was by far one of the best excursions we have ever been on and we look forward to doing it again when we come back to the island. Trust the reviews on Trip Advisor and take this trip, you will not regret it!

As a visiting pilot, I took two flight instruction flights and brought my family in the back seat of the Cessna 172, recently.  We all loved it!  Bruce is a great guy, host and instructor! The scenery was amazing and the flight experience invaluable.  The planes are much safer than the helicopter tours.  A big thank you from the Johnson family to Bruce and the Wings Over Kauai team.  Mahalo!

From start to finish, this was one of the best things we did during our recent stay on Kauai.  After researching air tours over Kauai (primarily helicopter companies) for weeks, I decided to give Wings Over Kauai a serious look...especially after all the glowing reviews here on TripAdvisor.  I'm so glad I didn't get caught up in the "helicopter is the only way to see the island" mentality, because from my initial phone conversation with Ellen, to check-in with Val, and finally our flight with Captain Josh, this could not have been a better experience.  Thanks to Ellen's recommendation, I booked a private charter for my family of 4 (two teen daughters) instead of sharing the plane with strangers, and was still $500 cheaper than a helicopter flight!  We were greeted with some of the best hospitality we received anywhere on the islands and our flight with Josh was unforgettable.  His island knowledge, piloting skills and easy-going demeanor made for a fantastic flight. I never once had second thoughts about the altitude difference between plane and chopper...once you see this paradise from the air you'll forget all about that.  We had a perfect day for flying and managed to take some amazing photos.  We mentioned to Josh that we were golfers and he even pointed out all the golf courses we saw below and had something to say about each of them. The highlights of the trip though are the Napali Coast and Waimea Canyon, without a doubt....WOW!  There's a reason that Bruce and Ellen's "Wings Over Kauai" is rated #1 in Kauai...from hospitality to total experience...they deliver!  Thanks for the great memories!

This was one of our favorite things that we did while we were in Kauai(and we did a lot!). The flight was beautiful! I can't even put into words how amazing this was. I was a little apprehensive about being in a plane versus the helicopter but I was happy with the decision we made. I saw helicopters along the tour and they do get a little closer to the waterfalls and mountains but there is something truly amazing about getting a zoomed out view of Kauai, I feel like I got to see more of the island this way. In addition to the scenery, the pilot was extremely nice and knowledgeable and made sure we were comfortable throughout the whole flight. Furthermore, the other staff at Wings over Kauai were AMAZING! They have a few surprises for their guests that I won't ruin here, but I will say that they are very generous! I HIGHLY recommend this activity to everyone!!!

We felt that the plane would be safer and less bumpy than a helicopter tour. The pilot kept the plane stable and his running commentary about the island was great. The views were spectacular, despite some fog. We had a great time and highly recommend this company

review_title: Thanks for the GREAT flight & Hospitality
review_text: An amazing way to see the island. I know what I want to see up close on my next visit. Bruce and Val were most lovely. Bruce is an 18 year resident of the island and shares his extensive knowledge which made the trip even more fascinating. Don't wait to do this.

Wir hatten nur wenig Zeit auf Kauai und waren daher auf der Suche nach einem guten Rundflug über die ganze Insel. Wieder einmal haben wir uns auf Tripadvisor verlassen und wurden nicht enttäuscht. Unglaublich private Atmosphäre, wir waren nur zu zweit mit unserem Piloten in der kleinen Cessna unterwegs, wodurch auch das Thema Platzauswahl sehr entspannt wird :-)
Bruce liebt es zu Fliegen, erklärt alles was passiert und wohin man gerade fliegt. Zudem gabs noch ein paar Tips für Sehenswürdigkeiten.
Außerdem kostete es nur die Hälfte eines Helicopterrundflugs, was ich ehrlich gesagt nicht verstehen kann, weil man genauso viel sieht und für die selbe Strecke genauso lang unterwegs ist. Nimmt man dann noch das bereits erwähnte "Privatcharter-Feeling" ist dieser Rundflug mehr als nur ein Schnäppchen.
Thanks to our pilot Bruce for a breathtaking experience!!
Agnes und Martin
The 9 of us took 2 planes to make these great flighst over NaPali coast and rest of Kauai. The pilots gave us a lot of information about what we were seeing.

My family and i were just in Kauai. We contemplated a helicopter ride but with a family of 5 it got a little expensive. We found Wings Over Kauai and for a fraction of the cost we decided on this. Totally amazing. Even my 7 year old granddaughter thought it was great. Altitude was a little higher than the helicopter but none the less spectacular. Was a 65 minute ride ending up being about 80 minutes. The pilot Bruce was so great. He gave us the history of the island along with his personal tips as he has been around this island about 6000 times. You have to try this cost less and was just breath taking

We were scheduled for a Memorial Day flight but after waiting at the terminal for quite a while, we ended up needing to be rescheduled due to battery issue  - not due to the weather.  They offered to have us wait another hour & take a tour with another company next door, but we didn't want to do that.  We were disappointed but luckily had plenty of days left in our trip to come back later in the week for a 2nd try.  They even gave us a partial refund (the full price for our 11 year old) as an inconvenience fee.  Josh took us up on an afternoon tour & it was a great tour with so much to see.   So beautiful to see the island from above & we are glad we were able to get rescheduled before the end of our vacation.  This is a great group of people - do not hesitate to book with them!

What a memorable experience going with Josh on the Air Tour in Kauai.  Josh is a first class professional and most engaging. 
We bought the DVD of our trip.  It was fun  to watch after we came home.  Thank you Josh and your staff for a memorable experience.

Winifred

review_title: Logging island time in a C172
review_text: As a newly minted private pilot I almost went nuts at the thought of being able to pilot a plane around Kauai. The island is so beautiful and diverse. Sitting in the left seat and taking off from Lihue right out over the Pacific was an amazing experience. Even better was listening to all the chatter of other pilots while constantly watching out for other planes and helicopters. There is a ridiculous amount of air traffic around Kauai. Bruce let me do just about everything except man the radio. He knows the island really well and knows the pattern of other aircraft, which is very important when there are so many of them. He also showed us where lots of movies were filmed and shared recent celebrity sightings with us. We loved it! Thanks Bruce.

review_title: There is a reason this is #1
review_text: What a fantastic day.  We took this tour mid-way through our time on the island.  It was the highlight of the trip.  Josh was a total professional and his knowledge about the island was vast. We took the entire family up and everyone had an amazing time.  We each had our own headsets and in addition to being able to talk to each other, music was playing during the flight. All of us agreed that it was definitely worth the money!

review_title: Great way to start a Kauai Vacation
review_text: We took the whole family on the tour and everyone loved it! We all agreed it was a great way to start the trip because we were able to get oriented with the islands layout. The views were amazing! Our pilot was super friendly and entertaining! Overall a great tour. They do an outstanding job!

We took this tour the first day on the island. Josh was a great pilot and tour guide. Taking this tour helped us get a better visual of Kauai and where we wanted to go. 
The office manager was very welcoming and personable. 
We highly recommend it.

review_title: An amazing experience with a small local company...
review_text: We visited Kauai on a cruise ship.  We were going to be there for basically a day and a half, so we wanted to see as much of the island as possible.  We decided the best way to do this would be to take a flight over the island to take in all of the sights.  We went with Wings Over Kauai and we are sure glad that we did.  I am a little fearful of flying, so I was a bit apprehensive of the helicopter tours and this tour was a better value for the money.  Bruce was our pilot, and is also the business owner of the 4 person (and 1 dog) operation.  He was very down to earth, friendly, and informative.  Despite my anxiety of flying we actually found the flight to be incredibly relaxing.  We always try to get away from the cruise docks and away from the crowds...and you can't get much more of an individual experience than this!  Let's talk about the views....simply amazing!  The pictures don't even seem to do it justice.  All of the colors, crevices, mountain peaks, and valleys.  Oh and waterfalls that seem to never end.  It was money well spent and truly the best way to see the island since so much of it is uninhabited.  They even gave us a video that had many of the sights along the flight on it to help us cherish the memories of our trip.

From start to finish, we had a great experience.  Dori, the pilots wife, checked us in(very friendly).  Josh is a very professional pilot with lots of knowledge of the island.  He gave us a few more great spots to snorkel along the way.  Having done the helicopter tour before,  I believe Wings over Kauai is a much better way to see the island.  Mahalo to Josh and Dori!

I stayed at Mahina Kai Ocean Villa, where the owner recommended Wings Over Kauai. I took the only space available today and boy was I glad I did! We were a bit concerned that we may not be able to fly as there were a lot of clouds over the island. But we did leave a little late and had some clouds, but were able to see everything quite well. Bruce, the owner and pilot, was not only very knowledgeable but a super friendly guy (as was his wife also).

Don't miss this amazing experience.

review_title: Amazing private flight on the Cessna!
review_text: Bruce was great. We really loved our personal flight. I was allowed to open the window to take photos. Added bonus. Tash loved her gifts and the DVD's(complimentary and the purchased) are awesome as well. A great family run business in Kauai.

review_title: Much better than the helicopter tours
review_text:
Josh and Dori were very nice and made the trip very enjoyable for me and my family. We have used the helicopter tours before in the past, which were ok and expensive, but I can say the airplane experience was much better. The flight was smoother, more window seats, longer and less expensive than the helicopters. Josh was very knowledgable, courteous, answered any questions we had and is a great pilot.
I recomend getting the DVD of your flight and not have to worry about filming it for yourself and just set back and enjoy the flight, still bring your camera for some amazing sites however.

review_title: Kauai from the air is Breathtaking
review_text: Thank you to Ellen and Bruce , my husband an myself had a wonderful time , Kauai from the air is breathtaking , Bruce's knowledge of this beautiful island was amazing. We were on the Pride of America cruise an booked this flight before we left for the cruise , Ellen picked us up from the ship an dropped us back , if you get a chance its a must do , just wonderful

We greatly enjoyed our trip with Wings Over Kauai.  Once you get to Kauai you will know why you have to take an air tour, you really can't see the island otherwise.  You definitely can't see it from the road!!  My husband and I did the 2 passenger Cessna and Bruce was our pilot.  Bruce has charm and knowledge to spare, we really enjoyed our time with him.  He gave us a great view of so many cool spots on the island - Na Pali Coast, Poipu, Waimea Canyon, Wailua Falls, Waipo'o Falls, Sleeping Giant, etc.  I had done a helicopter tour on the Big Island a few years ago and had some slight motion sickness.  Nothing like that on this smooth flight!  Wings Over Kauai is very professional yet I never felt like "just a customer" to them, I felt like a family friend.  Aloha is alive and well at Wings Over Kauai!  Mahalo Bruce and family for a very memorable day!  I hope to return to Kauai someday and I will definitely take your flight again.

My husband and I wanted to see Kauai from the air as every single website or book we had read said this is the one thing you should do if you can't do anything else.  We had never been in a small plane like this before, so we were very excited.

Our flight was originally booked for Sunday 5/25/14.  There were a lot of thunderstorms (more than usual) on the island, and Bruce did a little flight ahead of time to check out the conditions. He reported back to us that he would recommend rescheduling as we would only get to see about 10% of the island, and not even the good parts at that!  We were so thankful that he gave us this option; it made us feel like he truly cared about our experience.  

So, we arrived later in the week, on Wednesday, 5/28, and Josh was our pilot.  There were only three passengers on the plane (my husband and myself plus one other and then Josh of course), and it was a fantastic experience! The island is gorgeous while driving through, but even more breath-taking from above.  Josh and Dorie provided refreshments on the plane, which were useful as I got a tiny bit sick -- but not enough to not make the experience enjoyable.  Josh took the time to explain the history of parts of the island, even pointed out the tree from which me lei was created!  This was a highlight of our trip, and we were happy to recommend Wings Over Kauai to other travelers that we met throughout the rest of our travels.  I am going to sound like a broken record if you have done any research, but, if you only have one thing to do in Kauai -- THIS should be it.  Thank you!

We had a fantastic day and very much enjoyed our Wings Over Kauai Air Tour.  Our pilot was Josh whom we rate an A+.  He was knowledgeable, personable, engaging, used the names of those on the plane making the trip much more personal.  Despite the fact he does this trip all the time, you did not feel that he was making a speech - he was super interesting.  They take pictures of each couple before you leave and when you land you are handed a CD with your picture on the cover and a generic review of your trip over Kauai.  However, a CD of your trip is also available; there are two cameras on the wings so when you watch the CD back when you get home, you can easily reminisce about your day.  You see the scenes you actually saw and here the conversations that went on in the plane - very nice!  We are super glad we purchased the CD; we will share with family and watch next May upon the anniversary of the trip.  And then there's the flight itself and the awesome scenery.  Kauai is downright beautiful and seeing parts that can only be seen from above was fantastic.  If you are in Kauai, please, please, please visit Wings Over Kauai; they will not let you down.  The weather might but we were super lucky and had a great day.

Just Amazing. You are welcomed by a very friendly staff. It is a family owned business and they know how to do it right. Really enjoyed each and every moment of our flight. This is a must do activity in Kauai and Wings over Kauai is the go to company to see Kauai from above. Bruce was very friendly and an excellent pilot, very informative.

We enjoyed our experience with Wings Over Kauai. We didn't get a chance to do a helicopter tour (which have strict weight limits per person), but from what we could tell, the difference is that helicopters take you closer to land, whereas we were higher up. It didn't matter though since we still had a great time seeing the sights. The flight was an hour and cost half that of a helicopter tour. 

If you have any tendency for motion sickness, I highly recommend that you take Dramamine or some kind of anti-nausea medication beforehand, even if the skies are clear.

We chose this company based on the reviews we read on trip advisor - so glad we did. 
Our pilot was professional and informative and we truly enjoyed the aerial view of Kauai. 
This was one of the highlights of our vacation- don't miss out !

My mom and I had a wonderful experience overall with Wings Over Kauai.  Initially, we had some booking issues with Trip Advisor (this site) redirecting the "Book Now" button to Viatour.com.  Viatour (likely through no fault of their own) showed that morning reservations were available when in fact they were fully booked.

We ended up taking a 4:00 PM tour, which turned out perfect.  Great weather, unimaginable views, and a super pilot/tour guide had my mom speechless nearly the entire trip.  Only comment would be to communicate personal DVD pricing/availability ahead of time.  As the facility was closing, we were asked about the personal DVD option, but didn't hear about pricing or see any options.  As the guide provides a short (8 minute) overview of the experience, we felt it would be sufficient.  In hindsight, I would have strongly considered the personal DVD option.

You MUST make this trip a part of your experience - worth the cost and much cheaper than a helicopter tour.

We took our tour on Memorial Day and it did not disappoint!  Bruce and and staff are friendly, accommodating and well versed in what they do.  The island is beautiful and we never could have seen all the gorgeous waterfalls, canyons, beaches and the lushness that Kauai has to offer if not for Wings over Kauai.  Highly recommend!  (And the price is right too!!)

review_title: Fantastic flight, great people and the best bang for your buck
review_text:
We booked Wings Over Kauai as part of a package between them and Blue Dolphin Charters to see Kauai from both sea and air. We did them both the same day, which I'm not sure I'd try again, but we had limited time on the island. The boat tour went about an hour long, so while we did manage to stop by our hotel and change, we were rushing a bit to get to the airport. As it turned out, there was no need to do so. There were two friendly folks there who got us checked in and chit-chatted for a while until the rest of our group arrived. The pilot came out and talked to us, saying weather had come in over the Na Pali coast and that we probably were not going to be able to see it very well. They offered to cancel or re-book our tour, or gave us the option of seeing what we could. Since we had done the boat tour of the Na Pali coast that morning, we decided to go ahead and go up. 

It was just me, my husband and another couple (coincidentally also from our boat tour), along with the pilot in the tiny plane. They set us up with water, soda and ginger chews for motion sickness (just in case). We also had noise-canceling headsets and microphones to talk to each other and the pilot during the flight. We ended up seeing almost the entire island and only hit really heavy rain at the end. We were able to see most of the coast, amazing views of Waimea Canyon and the famous waterfall from Jurassic Park, along with lots of other things. The pilot's information was entertaining and interesting, and the musical background was a bit cheesy, but fun and added to the tour. 

Overall, I would HIGHLY recommend this. For $225 for the 6-hour boat tour and 90-minute flight it was well worth it. They took our photo in front of the plane before the trip and printed it on a DVD with highlights from the flight (generic, not our specific tour) and gave us that for free at the end of the flight. There was an option to purchase a Blu-ray or DVD of our specific flight, shot from several Go Pro cameras in and outside the plane, but we opted out of that. There was no hard sell. Great people and a great tour!

Our Wings Over Kauai trip was all it was hyped up to be. The views were incredible and geographic highlights added an extra layer of interesting to our tour. Our son enjoyed his first small airplane ride immensely. Incredible addition to our Kauai trip! Don't miss it!

I got to fly up front in the cockpit and it was amazing. It was a day of clouds and sun, and Na Pali was sort of cloudy, but still it was an amazing flight. The hour went by in the blink of an eye, I could have flown all day long looking at the beautiful island. Our pilot Josh did a 360 degree turn so we could have a look at one of the last humpback whales of the season. I felt safe and in good hands. The lei is a lovely touch as well. I also am glad I did the flight rather than a helicopter as I found the helicopters rather disruptive when I was out exploring the island's hiking trails, but never once did a plane cause me to look up at the sky due to noise.

This is the second air tour I have taken, the first being in Alaska, so I had something to compare with.  Our Wings Over Kauai Air Tour was every bit as exciting as the one in Alaska.  Kauai is such a beautiful island and most of it you cannot see, unless you fly over it.  In my opinion, touring by air is the highlight of a vacation.  It leaves such an impression on your mind.  The staff were all great and Bruce the pilot made the trip very interesting with all the facts he knew about the island.  So many movies have been filmed there and he knew about all the spots.  He even gave us details on how the airplane was operated as we were taxiing out.  The plane was great, everyone had a window seat.  I feel much safer on a small airplane, than I would in a helicopter.  Give Wings a try, I am sure you will love it.

My wife and I were very happy with every aspect of our morning with Wings Over Kauai.  The pickup location was convenient to our cruise ship, their greeting was pleasant and their professional, but relaxed attitude was great.  Our flight with Josh was well narrated and the viewing from the Air-Van was superb.  We were very happy to have chosen Wings Over Kauai for our experience on Kauai.

This is a great family owned business.  Everyone was friendly and relaxed and made us feel at home.  The airplane tour is nearly half the price of the helicopters and the plane can fly so slowly that you don't miss a thing.  In fact, the helicopter behind us kept gaining on us.  The views are incredible and the visibility from every seat is wonderful.  Cameras capture all the action and you can purchase a DVD or Blu-Ray afterward.  Put this on your bucket list.
This was the highlight of all my excursions.  Na'Pali Coast was breathtaking.  Staff was wonderful, friendly and professional.  A real DON'T MISS for anyone visiting the island of Kauai.

Wings Over Kauai was my husband's favorite part of our trip to Kauai! If you are looking for an air tour of the island that is reasonably priced and informative, this is your tour. Many of the helicopter tours are expensive (over priced), whereas Wings Over Kauai is reasonably priced and offers beautiful views of the island - Waimea Canyon, Hanalei Bay, Na Pali Coast and our pilot, Josh was very knowledgeable about the island. It was obvious by talking to Josh he wasn't trained as a tour guide, but instead shared his own passion about the island and answered any questions we had. Very authentic experience - didn't feel "touristy" at all!
Excellent service, knowledgeable staff and pilot and was highlight of our Hawaii vacation. Highly recommend trip and company to everyone!!!!!! You will love like we did.

Wings over kauai was the perfect way to end our vacation on the island. The views were amazing, our pilot Bruce gave us lots of interesting facts about the places we flew over. We saw the whole island pretty much, he took us over the places you can't get to by car. The staff really make it about the quality of your experience. I recommend it to everyone if your in kauai!

First off let me say that taking an air tour in a small airplane is much better than doing it in a helicopter. It's quieter, smoother and much less intrusive to the spirit of Mana. The Wings Over Kauai airplane tour of the island is an absolute must-do when visiting Kauai. The island is an absolute gem when viewed from the air, but it is the company that makes the experience special. The staff are exceedingly helpful and courteous and go out of their way to provide an intimate and fun experience. Bruce, our pilot, was informative and pleasant which made the trip memorable for us. We were the only two people in the small airplane and Bruce had my wife help him with the checklist before take-off, which she thoroughly enjoyed.  After the flight, the company provided us a free dvd, made by his son, that included the highlights of the tour. The dvd had a cover with a personalized photo of us that their photographer had taken prior to the flight. They also gave my wife a very nice everlasting lei and provided free soft drinks during the flight. The family run atmosphere created by Wings Over Kauai, and the extra little touches made for a wonderful experience that has provided us with what is sure to be lifelong memories of Kauai from the air. Thank you for helping to make our vacation a memorable one.

I am soooooo glad we booked our flight-seeing excursion with Wings Over Kauai!!!  Val and Bruce couldn't have been more accommodating, knowledgeable and hospitable.  Of all the islands we visited, Kauai was, by far, the most beautiful .. and we wouldn't have been able to enjoyed it to this extent without Wings Over Kauai!!  The pictures we took from our flight look like professional post cards or out of National Geographic.  And, all the additional commentary and insights from Bruce, our fearless pilot, made the experience just that much richer.  Plus, they offered nice little surprises that I'm not going to ruin by telling.  Just know that they're a first-rate organization.  Book with them.  You won't be disappointed!!  (Thank you, Val & Bruce - The Eyricks)

Booked via email from England on basis of excellent Trip Advisor reviews. Emails answered promptly and fully, the trip was extremely easy to arrange.  Ellen arranged everything, collecting us from the Cruise Port and delivering us back afterwards. All the team made us feel very welcome and special. The flight itself, and Captain Josh, were brilliant - it was just a shame there was no room for Millie the dog on board as she is gorgeous! I won't spoil the surprise but there are 'little extras' thrown in which make you feel valued :). The team obviously pride themselves on customer service. The best value and most enjoyable trip of our holiday! Thank you Ellen, Bruce and Captain Josh :)

Wings over Kauai is a great tour company. We got stuck in the traffic and they rescheduled us for the next day. Bruce, the owner, who was also the pilot is a great person. He made sure to talk to everyone on the flight. Also, he tried to tell as much as possible about the scenery. To go in the air and see Kauai was one of memorable experiences I had in Kauai. For the price you can't get any better than this. It was a very personal touch from Wings of Kauai to give us a CD of the tour as well as sending us the pictures they took before we boarded the airvan!! Truly awesome experience. I would rate them as Highly recommended if going to Kauai and willing to spend 125 dollar/person.

review_title: As good as reviews said it would be
review_text: I was a little tentative to get on a small plane but Bruce made this an unbelievable experience for my husband and I. The flight was much smoother than I anticipated. This is a must do while on Kauai!

review_title: Can't beat the amazing views of Kauai
review_text: We took a private trip with Wings over Kauai in late March of this year. It was my first time in a plane this size, so I was a little nervous before-hand. Once we met the Wings over Kauai staff, I was immediate put at ease. You could tell they loved their jobs and sharing the island with guests. Bruce was a great pilot, making sure we were comfortable during the whole flight and sharing interesting stories about his life on Kauai. But the real reason to go for the amazing views! There is so much of Kauai that you can’t see from the ground and this quiet, relaxing trip gives you a birds-eye view of the beautiful island. From the coast to the canyons to numerous waterfalls, we were not disappointed! I would highly recommend Wings of Kauai and hope to make it back for another trip soon ourselves!

After reading other reviews, and not wanting to spend nearly $800 to ride in a helicopter, our family booked a ride with Wings Over Kauai. We are so very glad we did! Bruce & Val are super warm and welcoming to their guests. Val gave me a very pretty lei made from kukui nuts and a fragrant flower that Bruce had picked. They were more than accommodating with our 16mo old daughter & 11yr old son.  We got a great air tour, some fantastic pictures we wouldn't have gotten

review_title: Probably the best part of our trip to Kaua'i!
review_text: The pilot was super friendly and knowledgeable, the flight was smooth and the views were amazing! The video of our flight was very reasonably priced! The staff was also very accommodating and willing to reschedule our tour to make sure we had the best time possible. Highly recommended!

review_title: Gorgeous scenery, see entire island in 60 minutes
review_text: We did this tour in May 2014 and not only was the value good, but it was something we would have paid even more to do.  It was $125 per person for me and my wife.  The tour takes you throughout the entire island and you see the parts of Kauai which are inaccessible by car and by foot.  You should do this and you should do one of the boat tours.  You won't regret it.  Maybe we got lucky with a clear day, but the views of the canyon, the coastline, the valleys, etc. were so gorgeous that it would be a shame to miss it.  Regarding flight vs helicopter, my wife was scared to do a helicopter for safety reasons, so we went with this.  I cannot compare the two but the helicopters were lower than us so maybe they had better close-up views.  In any case, we were pretty low too but also got a great wide-angle view of everything, as well as very informative instruction from the pilot, Josh, who told us about the history, answered any questions we had, and provided interesting commentary on the comfortable headsets.  There were just 4 of us on the flight so it's very intimate.  A great way to see the island in 60 minutes, and then decide later to hit up Waimea canyon, or Na Pali coastline, or Hanalei bay.

Great company based in Kauai I have a pilot licence in Australia the experience with Bruce was great safety first well maintained plane joy to fly over the most beautiful scenery I have see would recommend for all levels of experience

WOW! What an amazing experience! My husband and I were in Kauai for our honeymoon and found Wings Over Kauai from all the awesome reviews! They definitely did not disappoint! I surprised my husband with the flight lessons instructor tour. He loved it and learned so much from Bruce. Would 100% recommend Wings Over Kauai to anyone I know!

review_title: Great introductory flying lesson and views of Kauai
review_text: Bruce took me and my wife up for introductory flying lesson where I was able to fly the plane with him for about 1 hour. Great instructions from beginning to end. My wife was able to see great views of the island and got some amazing shots. For roughly the same price for each of us to do the 6-8 person tour, we got a private flight around the island. Would definitely recommend!

Amazing tour! The price is nothing compare to what you get! The crew is very friendly and very profesional. I had a smile on my face the whole 60 minutes of the flight. Once you're up in the air you just wish that the tour never ends!

This was the highlight of our Hawaiian vacation, that we continue to talk about over and over again!!  Fabulous flight, our pilot, Josh, was awesome and very informative.  Flight left us speechless!!  Everything from pickup to drop off and everything in between was just perfect!!  Can't say enough about Bruce, Ellen and their other staff.  Would definitely do this again and recommend it to all.  Phenomenal!!!!

What a great way to spend Easter Sunday, on a charter flight over Kauai .Booking the flight over the internet was a breeze.
  We were picked up from a pre-determine place ,to take us to the airport.The weather was rainy
and cloudy, but Bruce was able to take us up . What a great experience, the weather cleared enough, to enjoy the flight, and to get some great pictures.
  My husband forgot his" special" hat( from tour de france), we called , and they personally brought the hat back to him at the cruise terminal.What service!
  Thanks again for everything .Would highly recommend booking a flight with this company.

Had a great flight over Kauai on Apr. 24th.  We were met close to the cruise port and escorted to and from the airport ...  very convenient and professional.  The flight was terrific .   The scenery gorgeous.  Josh ( the pilot) gave us a great tour of the Garden Isle and told us all about the island .  We only had the one day on Kauai and the flightseeing tour was a great way to see the most of the island in the short time that we had.  No complaints !   Would definately recommend this tour company.  Thanks to you all for a great flight.

review_title: The personal touch makes the difference
review_text: My wife and I took the private tour in the Cessna with Bruce at the controls. Two things really make the private tour terrific - you're never on the wrong side of the aircraft for sightseeing, and the commentary and conversation is tailored to your interests. We didn't miss any of the beauty of Kauai while discussing agronomy, education, economics and the like. We'd asked if all of the humpbacks had headed back north; when Bruce spotted a trio off Na Pali he circled around so we could get a good look. The personalization of the tour really made it memorable.

My family of four (including two kids  aged 12 and 8) choose Wings Over Kauai after reading many positive reviews here, and boy, we were not disappointed. The captain Josh was very professional, safety oriented and extremely knowledgable about the local topography and history. For $450 for all 4 of us on a charter plane that could have accommodated 6,  it was worthwhile for the experience.

This was hands down, the most amazing, personalized, once in a lifetime tours we've ever been on. Captain Bruce and staff are the most accommodating and welcoming people we met on Kauai. We highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting, and would gladly go more than once!

Thank you for sharing your little piece of paradise with us!

Thank you! Gracias! Mahalo!
Korry & Lu

PS: The picture and the DVD were the cherry on the pie!

review_title: Amazing way to experience the island
review_text: Wonderful views, and amazing service from start to finish! Since you can only see 20% of Kauai by car, taking this tour will ensure you get to see all of its beauty!

Trust me, you won't be disappointed.  Captain Bruce and the staff are awesome.  You will hear everyone talk about the helicopter tours.  Don't be like everyone.  Wings over Kauai is like an insider's secret.  We had a private tour of the whole island and at less than what the cattle call helo company's charge.  They even throw in a clever and unique gift at the end.  Keep up the great work, Bruce.  We hope to visit again soon.  -k & k

Great way to see Kauai.   We had been on the helicopter tour before so decided we would try the airplane tour - it was wonderful and half the cost.   We made our reservation via the internet with no problem.  Ellen picked us up promptly at the local ABC store and returned us to the same location after the tour.  The entire staff were personable and thorough.  The weather was perfect so our views from above were unbelievable and our pilot Josh was very informative of what we were viewing.  Don't miss this experience on your visit to Lihue Kauai.

I have over two million miles in the air, so it takes a lot to get excited about the scenery unfolding beneath me.  Today, I was excited - very excited.  My wife and I flew with Bruce on the 172 and the flight was extraordinary.  Time might have flown by, but the scenery did not, as the leisurely trip took us over just about every square inch of Kauai .  Bruce has flown this route over 5,000 times and it shows - in a good way.  His narration is personable and thorough, just like the check-in and attention to safety.  The cost is about half what you would pay for a helicopter tour, and if a green planet matters to you, the fuel consumed is a pittance of what a copter uses.  I would highly recommend this trip to anyone visiting Kauai.  I researched them all before we booked with Wings Over Kauai, and I have no regrets.

We had questionable weather with heavy clouds and some rain, Josh gave us the option to cancel but also gave us some knowledgeable insights about what to expect, noting the cloud deck was high enough to ensure great visibility and numerous waterfalls due to the weather pattern. Boy were we glad to keep the flight! My wife and I, and two young boys had the absolute best experience, exceeding our already very high expectations. His knowledge of the island, insights that varied from Kauai history to agronomy to geological facts, just fantastic. Viewing what may be the most beautiful place on earth from above, was matched with the quality of the people we met with Wings Over Kauai. What a collection of expertise and character. We enjoyed meeting Bruce, Dori and Josh. If you are planning a trip to Kauai, this tour is a must. Everything else in your schedule will stop short of this experience. Mahalo Mahalo Mahalo!

April 11.2014
Best thing we did on our journey. Fantastic weather, our pilot Josh was awesome. We had the best weather conditions for the flight it was sooo fantastic. We bought the dvd of our flight , it arrived just the day after we went home. Now we're back home and can relieve this flight over and over again. 
Best thing you can do while your are in Kauai. Forget that helicopter flights and go by Wings. It's a pleasure frome the first contact over the flight and the fantastic dvd!!!!

review_title: Fantastic way to get some air time with awesome views and instruction
review_text: I purchased a flight with Bruce ( instructor) for a refresher for my husband who has not flown in years.  Bruce was fantastic. Great instruction, calm and great island commentary. We saw all the awesome stuff canyons na Pali  coast beaches waterfalls.  It was a fantastic tour and a great opportunity for my husband to fly again. A great company to deal with. We loved it and were very grateful for the customized free hi lites video as well.  Would highly recommend. Also FYI much more cost effective and smooth ride than a helicopter.

By far the highlight of our 17 day trip. From the time Ellen picked us up to the time to the time she dropped us back off, the service was first class. Josh was not only an extremely competent pilot but a first rate tour guide as well. Breath taking hour long tour that leaves you wanting for more. It would be a mistake to miss this tour
Steve & Juanita

Had a great flight with our pilot-owner Bruce.  Very informative and great time.  I have taken helicopter tours on different islands.  This was by far the best air tour!!  They also give, yes, give,  you a previously recorded DVD of the flight.  It is a great DVD.  Great views from the windows.  Highly recommend!!

review_title: Great value for money and very friendly
review_text: We flew on 8th April and have to say this was a real highlight of our trip. We chose the small plane instead of a helicopter tour as we wanted to fly with our 2 year old. Right from the off they were very helpful, provided ear defenders for our daughter and the service felt very personal without being intrusive. Extras like the free photo and lai were very much appreciated. We purchased the DVD and are now enjoying it all over again. Would definitely recommend.

review_title: Captivating views over the marvelous landscape of kauai!
review_text:
Best opportunity to explore kauai's island and to get an  overview of this gorgeous island!
 We really enjoyed the with wings of kauai!
 Heartly atmosphere and excellent personal guided tour by the pilot!
 Absolutely recommendable... Katharina + Josef

review_title: Good value option for aerial tour of Kauai
review_text:
On our recent family vacation to Kauai, we booked the 11am tour based on top reviews here.

Very friendly staff at the counter to start off.

We had a great experience with Bruce (owner) as the pilot. The AirVan plane was a very comfortable ride for the 4 of us, with full window views for everyone.
