It was a somewhat windy day, but Bruce did a great job of making sure we were not uncomfortable. Bruce flew a nice trip around the island, hitting all key spots including the Na pali coast, Waimea canyon, Wailua falls, and other landmarks. He was very helpful explaining not just the geography, but also adding some of the history behind some spots.

And at the end of the ride, a free highlight DVD is yours.

The plane ride does not obviously get as close as a helicopter ride, so you do miss on some of the close-up views. But you make up with a more comfortable and probably safer ride, and its certainly cheaper. All in all, great value for your money. Highly recommended.

My family of 5 recently took an AirVan ride touring the island of Kauai. We got there early, and were offered books to peruse while we waited. Josh was our pilot. He was very knowledgeable, educating/entertaining us the entire way, and we each had our own window seats! The ride was rocky, but that was not Josh's fault - It was a windy day. Besides, there are water and juices available onboard, as well as "bags" at each seat.  (At one point, I thought I would lose it, but it didn't happen! Thank goodness!) We got to see places we would not otherwise see by land -- the NaPali Coast, where our boat tour was cancelled because of rough seas -- and beautiful waterfalls everywhere! Seeing the island by air was fantastic! It gives you a whole new perspective. I highly recommend the owners and Wings Over Kauai. (Give Billie the dog a pat on the head from us! What a low-key, nice dog!)

As a pilot, I highly recommend Wings over Kauai. Bruce was an awesome guy to fly with, expert pilot and tour guide. Next time I'm booking off the hobbs meter, and spening more time in the air!
I think Bruce even had the weather changed just for us! Thanks for a memorable flight...Don
Very very good experience! If someone consider this tour, I recommend it 100%. The pilot was very kind and explained the landmarks easily.  My parents were satisfied with this great experience.

We love Kauai and have seen it by boat, bike and by lots of hiking.  We considered a helicopter ride but thought our kids (11 and 14) would enjoy seeing the island from the view a small plane could offer.  The weather was a bit cloudy and we were skeptical about whether we would be able to see the majority of the island.  Bruce and family were up front with us about how the weather might impact our views but we went ahead and experienced Kauai by air.  We were not disappointed in any way!  The island is beautiful close up.  We "chased" a rainbow as we passed over the Na Pali coast.  Bruce and family were very customer service focused and informative.  We loved every minute of our tour and felt very comfortable flying with Bruce.  Well worth our time and money!  Truly "Wings Over Kauai Air Tours" deserves all the positive ratings it receives.  Keep up the Aloha spirit!  We loved the extras...drinks, pictures and CD!
Josh gave us a wonderful private tour with great commentary on the history and the notable landmarks of Kauai.
If you're around the area, definitely go on this adventure and see the beautiful Kauai. Wonderful tour and the staff and pilot was very kind and insightful.

What can I say that hasn't already been said?? OMG.....it was so beautiful seeing the island. When we flew March 11th with Josh, it was such a clear day that we got to fly over the top of a mountain that gets like a zillion inches of rain each year.....Josh says the mountain generally is covered in clouds, but since it wasn't that morning, we went for it !! Over the top we went. Josh was not only a great pilot, but also an excellent narrator. Seeing whales "waving" to us from the air was so neat.....we got some great shots. They also video the whole trip, and if you're interested, they'll sell you the video......I would consider one if the price was not as steep as it was (just my opinion) You do get a nice "promo CD" after the flight with several minutes of generic video (not your trip)....the "label" of the CD comes with a nice touch though.....they take your picture by the plane before you go, and when you come back, they hand you this CD that has your picture as the "label"
I would do this trip again in a heartbeat. I will be recommending them to anybody I know going there. I thought about a helicopter, but after doing this trip, I don't what else I could have seen I didn't see on this trip.(and pay at least twice as much for the helicopter if I remember right)
Thanks Josh (and "Mrs Josh") for a great trip (<:

review_title: SUPERB TRIP - ONE OF THE HIGHLIGHTS OF OUR HOLIDAY
review_text:
What a great experience this was,we cannot recommend "Wings over Kauai" more highly - they were so friendly and helpful from our initial enquiry and from arriving at the airstrip , right through our trip and onto our departure-we couldn't stop talking about it.
So many of the adverts and guides push you towards the helicopter trips but these are much more expensive and we didn't feel they gave you so much time or comfort to take in the views.
We met a couple from Washington State who recommended "Wings over Kauai" and had enjoyed their trip so we booked this - it was brilliant!!
We thoroughly enjoyed it,our pilot , Josh , was extremely helpful and friendly and went out of his way to show us all aspects of the island and also detoured down when we saw some whales on the surface nothing was too much trouble and he really made out trip special.
Thanks very much again for a wonderful trip .

I am a student pilot from the mainland.  I came out on business/vacation and had the opportunity to fly with Wings Over Kauai.  Bruce is amazing!!!!  I wish I lived in Kauai.  It would be my pleasure to be instructed by him.  He was perfect.  His team made my trip very nice.  Thank you for allowing me to share a wonderful experience in Kauai.

review_title: Excellent aerial tour highlighting the best Kauai has to offer
review_text:
Our ohana flew with Wings Over Kauai on March 18 with Josh as our pilot. From the first views of Nawiliwili Harbor, we were enchanted. Josh was very nice and provided lots of interesting information on the sites that we flew over. Our 10 year old son was especially interested in hearing about where Indiana Jones escaped down the river in Raiders of the Lost Ark, where the dinosaur eggs were found in Jurassic Park, and where Captain Jack Sparrow was filmed in Pirates of the Caribbean. Another interesting story was how they came to be the owners of Millie, the friendly dog that greeted us when we were checking in. She had been abandoned by pig farmers in the wilderness and found by Josh (or was it the other way around) when he was out hiking. The views of the Waimea Canyon and the Na Pali Coast were outstanding, as was the rest of the scenery including towering waterfalls, craters, and shoreline. 

We highly recommend that you check them out if you are going to be in Kauai.

Shakas all around to Wings Over Kauai!

Mahalo!

This is by far the best way to explore Kauai! Captain Josh, Dori and Bruce were so welcoming that we started liking the experience even before we boarded the flight. They not only gave my wife a welcome gift bead necklace but also topped it up with some amazing pictures immediately after the trip. The flight itself was so amazing that it is difficult to explain in words - the weather was surprisingly great and we even got to see a rainbow! Captain Josh even followed a few whales off the coast of Napali for us to have a closer look..while we had booked the airvan, since we were the only ones in the morning flight, they got us to a smaller Cessna private plane which made the trip even more amazing..these guys are the best and would highly recommend everyone to definitely try them. Mahalo nui loa Captain Josh and Dori for such an amazing experience

We were so lucky!  It was a beautiful, sunny day.  Bruce and Ellen were very gracious.  We went up with one other couple.  Bruce described everything we were seeing.  We flew over beautiful waterfalls, the Waimea Canyon, and the Napili Coast.  It was gorgeous.  We even saw a pod of whales swimming. The flight lasted just over an hour and we got a DVD too.   I just loved it!

We were scheduled to do a different tour and ended up not being able to do it.  (Due to bad knees).  We came across a brochure for Wings Over Kauai Air Tours.  We decided to try it.  It was awesome!  So glad we did it.  The flight was excellent and Bruce was very informative about the island and everything we saw.  
We felt very safe during the flight and were able to take GREAT pictures!  A must do if you are in Kauai!  I am claustrophobic but did NOT have any problem in this plane.  It was just my husband and myself and the pilot.  An excellent tour!! 
We highly recommend Wings Over Kauai Air Tours!!

What a flight! I don't even have the words to describe how amazing this was. Most magical, jaw-dropping experience we've ever had. I also love that Wings Over Kauai is a family-owned company ... and from the moment we arrived for our flight, they made us feel like part of their family. I was nervous about riding in a small plane, but my worrying was all for nothing. It was incredibly smooth from take-off to landing. Our pilot was incredibly qualified, knowledgeable and friendly. This air tour was HALF the price of a helicopter ride and I'm so glad we decided to do this instead. I can't imagine a better experience AND we saved a couple hundred dollars. I would recommend booking Wings Over Kauai towards the beginning of your trip ... it gives you a great sense of the island and helps you plan what you want to see.

We use Tripadvisor as our  personal travel guide, and that is how we found Wings Over Kauai. Not comfortable with helicopters, we chose this method of seeing the Napali coast.  Wow! It was so nice to have such a personal touch. Bruce and Ellen made us feel comfortable from the minute we arrived.  The flight was excellent, Bruce was a terrific pilot and very knowledgable about the island. We were able to see the entire island, and it was a thrill all the way. We were surprised with a kukui lei for me, and at the end of the flight a 10 minute DVD with highlights of the tour taken by Bruce's videographer-son, plus a photo of us on the DVD case.  Booking online was easy.  I highly recommend this company!

review_title: Friendly family owned business, that is affordable.
review_text: We have seen the Napali coast via zodiac on the ocean, and hiked it part way in previous trips.  So our hotel activity desk suggested Wings over Kauai to experience by air.  So glad we did.   It was a fun experience and it did not break the bank to do it.  We saw all the island.   Amazing island no wonder why so many movies are filmed here.

review_title: Professionals offering a polished, delightful tour
review_text: Everyone told us we had to tour Kaua’i by air during our one week visit: A lot of the beautiful island isn’t accessible by rental car, and the views from up high offer a perspective that really helps you appreciate the tropical paradise found here.  They were right!  But I’ll add a strong suggestion: Go by fixed-wing aircraft using Wings Over Kaua’i.  We had an AMAZING 90-minute flight.  Josh, the lead pilot, is personable, friendly, knowledgeable & professional.  The airplane is a sightseer’s dream: small, cozy, safe, reliable, smooth flying, and every passenger (we had 4) has their own bubble window with an unimpeded view.  (My wife & I shot almost 300 pictures & ended up with 50 that are stunning.)  Everyone associated with the small company is courteous & friendly.  And the cost was a bargain when compared to the value we received & the prices of some helicopter tours.  We booked online for early in our trip, hoping to get the lay of the land before we explored by rental car, but Josh nixed the flight when rain clouds covered too much of the island; he wasn’t going to waste our time or money.  We really appreciated his experienced decision.  Our rescheduled tour at the end of our visit was perfect: We got to see where we HAD been during the week, plus all those hidden gems not visible from roads.  A great time, I assure you, no matter when you fly!  Tip: Schedule your ride early in your visit & early in the day in case the weather isn’t cooperative.  Josh & company will handle the rest.

Just got off a great flight with Wings Over Kauai!  The staff is very friendly, and Bruce gave entertaining and informative commentary.  I was lucky enough to be in the copilots seat (and helped pull off a perfect landing).  Bruce mentioned they had cancelled flights the day before (too windy) and will cancel if it is too cloudy, because they want people to have a fun and comfortable ride, with good visibility.  We had exactly that, and would recommend to anyone the tour!

My wife and I booked an air tour with Wings Over Kauai and had a great time.  If you are looking to see the islands best features this is the way to go.  The tour guide will show you all of the major scenery items on the island.  The staff was great and our tour guide was very informative.  I would do this tour all over again just to see the views that Kauai has to offer.  It was truly an amazing experience and highly recommended.

Should you do aerial tour of Kauai - absolutely ! The same day I had driven up to the kalalau lookout but the sight of the canyon from 3000ft above was something else. In fact, if you do an aerial tour, you can comfortably skip the land viewings. 

Why go with wings over kauai - service was great, josh was entertaining and very informative from the pilot's seat. The airvan looks small but wasn't too bumpy despite some clouds. While helicopter tours go pretty close to the mountains by the virtue of them being choppers, for photography purposes think a plane was better suited. Coupled with the fact that wings over Kauai is half the price of any of the helicopter tours I think it's worth every penny and more.

Our Pilot Josh was really well-versed and new his stuff.  The islands are amazing, but it's a whole other experience seeing it from the air.  Dori signed us in really easily when we first arrived and we were on our way within minutes.  We saw humpback whales from the air and it was priceless.  Thanks again Josh and Dori!

We were scheduled for a day with questionable weather.  Most of the flight rescheduled to wait for better weather and visibility of the Napali Coast.  However, since we were on our last day they were willing to take up just the two of us.  We know that they had to do this at a loss but since they knew we had to go then or we would miss out they put our experience before profits.

It shows that they really focus on the customer before all else.  

In addition, the flight itself was great and we even caught some decent weather over the coast. The views of the canyon and other areas of the island were amazing and flying in the plane was a super smooth and easy ride.  We really also enjoyed Josh's narration and the music that they paired with the flight. Definitely a great experience and really a value compared to other options for aerial tours on the island.
Thanks for a wonderful experience! We had a beautiful view of the island and great narration and music!

We took the tour with Wings over Kauai and had a wonderful time.  We got to see the whole island.  Bruce was a wonderful informative pilot.  I have been on a helicopter tour before and this was just as wonderful with a much more affordable price.  Thank you to all the staff who where so pleasant and helpful from the booking through the tour!

review_title: Didn't make it to Na Pali, due to weather, but Wings did everything possible to make it right
review_text:
We booked our flight a couple of days in advance, but on the flight date the weather turned bad. When we got to their office, the Wings staff was extremely accommodating, giving us the option of trying to reschedule (not possible due to our travel plans), canceling without penalty, or taking the flight, and hoping the weather would be clear at Na Pali. If we got airborne and Na Pali was not possible, we would not be charged for the flight. We decided to take the flight, and were able to view the waterfalls, parts of the island, and get a great whale sighting, before the pilot got word that Na Pali was fogged in.
On landing, we were again offered another flight, but because of our departure date, could not accept this. So Wings honored their commitment, and we did not pay for the flight.
Obviously the weather was beyond anyone's control, but under the circumstances, I feel Wings went above and beyond in customer service, something not as common as it should be in the tourism business.

After reading several reviews about Wings Over Kauai we opted for their service over the usual helicopter tour.  Great choice ! ! !     Ellen picked us up promptly and set the tone with her cheerful attitude.  Bruce and Ellen were extremely easy to deal with.  The flight itself was wonderful.  We saw whales surfacing below us as well as outstanding views of the canyons, coastline and other natural wonders Kauai has to offer.  You could probably find the same sights elsewhere but the pilot, Bruce, was the difference.  He was very knowledgeable and encouraged questions and comments during the flight.  Chat was cheery, informative and insightful.   He has a very good grasp of what we wanted to see and was able to answer any questions that arose.  It would be hard not to enjoy the experience.    We would recommend this aerial tour without any reservations,

review_title: The best in price and scenery.
review_text: Compared to other flights across Kauai, this is almost $100 dollars cheaper and you see the same stuff.  Also, Bryan, our pilot, was very friendly and informative about the island.  Highly recommend this.  There is a reason they are 5 stars and not 4 stars compared to the rest of the companies.

Bruce conducted a superb flight with appropriate and always interesting commentary. The cost was very reasonable considering what we saw and the experience we had. It was unforgettable and we're grateful to Bruce and Ellen for their professionalism and warm reception and at no time did we feel the slightest bit uneasy either in flight or at their terminal. Truly a great flight and Kauai will never look the same again. We would book again in a heartbeat
Oscar and Carol
Port Townsend, WA

The island of Kauai, HI is such a magical place with many things to see.  We had an amazing flight over the beautiful island and really enjoyed our tour guide/pilot, Bruce.  The staff is very personable and very friendly and makes sure you have an unforgettable time.  Thank you so much and when we come back to Kauai (it might be a while but we will be back), we will definitely be taking another flight with you.

So, this was my Valentine's present for my husband.
He love's to fly so I thought why not?
This was the coolest thing that we have done in Kauai.
Right from the started of my booking, Ellen was very friendly, she gave fast response due to my last minute booking.
We had a chat with Josh and Bruce the owner was our Pilot.
During the flight Bruce told us about so many informations and showed us the places that we have not seen during our stay in Kauai.
I normally afraid of flying, but Bruce, did a great job. I wasnt afraid at all, in fact i enjoyed every minutes and wish we could do it longer.
The landing was very very very smooth!! It was unbelievable.

If anyone looking for the best way to see the Island, this is it.
Cost of flying with them is cheapest compare to others.

So, we are planning to come back next year & we think we will do it all over again!

PS:
Taking photos with go pro is the best.

Thanks all team!

Josh is an amazing pilot who had answers for every question we asked.  He put the nervous passengers at ease.  Amazing beautiful and comfortable flight.  Well worth the cost.  Everything Goose and TandemCyclist said is true, I can't add anything else.  This is a must do!

We travel widely and have gone up in the air in many places including fixed wing in New Zealand (Milford Sound) and in Alaska (Denali, Homer, Ketchikan); rotary wing (helicopter) in New Zealand and Grand Canyon, and hot air balloon in Turkey (Cappadocia). 

All have been great experiences. 

We rate our trip with Wings over Kauai as one of the best. Our pilot, Josh, on leave from American Eagle, was terrific, as was his wife Dori, who is in the office. Owner Bruce was welcoming. 

Josh was knowledgable, caring, attentive, and safe. 

Remember, 80% of Kauai is inaccessible on the ground. The only way to see it is from the air. 

I realize that helicopters are now the rage, but we were the only passengers in the fixed wing Cessna 172; we burned 25% of the fuel; and both had window seats. Plus it costs half or less. 

Wings offers a tour for two that we took. They also offer a tour in a larger plane that costs slightly less. For us, the decision was easy. 

BTW, if you want the personalized video of your trip, make sure to order it before or immediately after the flight. We waited until the next day and the video files had been erased. NOTE: there are several GoPros in and around the plane that capture your experience.

My husband and I did this on the first day of our Kauai vacation so we could see an overview of the whole island. It was a perfect morning and Kauai was breathtaking. WOK was outstanding in their hospitality. The pilot was very knowledgeable of the island and made sure everyone on the flight felt at home. They made us all feel like part of their family and we will definitely fly with them again.

My wife and I had a fantastic time on our flight and it was one of the highlights of our trip to Hawaii. I booked this flight as an instructional flight because I have my license and wanted the experience of flying in Hawaii. Ellen helped me with the reservation and was extremely friendly and helpful. Bruce was our tour guide and flight instructor and allowed me to handle the controls on 99% of the flight. He made the flight relaxing and easy for me and provided some great information about flying in general and flying in the local environment. At the same time he provided my wife, who was riding in the back, with some great information about Kauai as we circumnavigated the island. We both had an outstanding time and would do it again in a heartbeat. I highly recommend this company as it is a family business and they provide excellent service and are very knowledgable. Thank you to Bruce, Ellen, and Allison for a great time!

review_title: The Best Air Tour in Kauai!
review_text: The air tour is an experience my husband and I will  truly cherish!  The entire team at WOK were very pleasant and professional - John, Ellen, Josh and Dori.  Josh did an "Amazing" job narrating the tour.  This is the best way to see all the beauty of the island.  It is breathtaking.  Josh even video taped our air tour which we purchased.  Now we have a DVD to remember our tour.  It was worth every penny we spent.  Thank you WOK for all the memories!   My husband and I will cherish them for years to come.

This was our high light of our trip, my husband's and mine first time and my mother-in-law's third time. Josh was very informative and made sure that everyone was involved with the trip. The views were great, since we have seen some from the roads, it was great to see them again from the sky. We were able to see about three whales too. The best to Josh and his crew. Thanks

Josh took us on an incredible tour of the island in a Cessna 172 and it was truly a memorable event. We couldn't be happier with the service, professionalism, and in depth knowledge of the island, ranging from geology, history, culture etc. The views are truly spectacular and the tour is definitely worth the money. It's a first rate outfit and you should put this tour on your do list. You will not be disappointed.

This adventure was fantastic. We were met by Ellen who escorted us to the airport. After check-in and a short briefing on the aircraft our pilot Bruce guided our adventure through the mountains, coastline and valleys if this beautiful Hawaiian island. The air tour was just over an hour and Bruce gave us a wonderful and detailed description of what was below. After the tour we were escorted back by Ellen to our cruise ship. This is a family business and they specialize in service. Give this a try you will not be disappointed and the cost is about one-half of the helicopter tours.

My son wants to become a pilot so for his 15th birthday we got him an intro flight.  What a better place to have your first small plane intro flight than in Kauai!  Bruce was so wonderful!  He was great about explaining what all the instruments were and their purposes.  He explained all the radio commands and had my son practice.  Daniel got to do a lot of the flying (way more than we had expected).  My husband and I tagged along in the backseat and got to see and hear about all the special landmarks/scenery.  What a great experience.

Bruce was wonderful in showing us some of the most spectacular scenery. He was very knowledgable and made the flight one to remember. If you only have time to do one thing while in Kauai but this on the top of your list. 
Each seat on the plane has an amazing view, they are all window seats.

review_title: This is the must do activity for Kauai
review_text:
There's a reason Wings Over Kauai Air Tours is the # 1 rated activity for Kauai. My wife and I recently returned from our 2nd visit to Kauai. Having been stationed on Oahu and trained on the Big Island, I can say Kauai is the most beautiful Hawaiian Island. Wings Over Kauai is the BEST method to see the landscape. During our most recent visit, we took my wife's parents and her older brother. The hour long air tour was the highlight of our group's excursions. 

We booked the one hour Air Van Private Charter, and Josh was our pilot / guide while airborne. Dori, Ellen and Millie (the owner's dog) greeted us at the hangar that is shared with several smaller air tour operators. The easiest route to their hangar is drive towards LIH (Lihue airport), pass the curbside pick up and drop off and you'll see the fixed wing hangar less than a mile on the right side. Keep LIH runways on your right side, and you'll see the Wings Over Kauai signage. Check-in consists of weigh-ins for aircraft balance, a model of Kauai to point out routes (each dependent on weather), and addressing any concerns passengers have pre-flight. Once check-in was complete, we had ample time to use restrooms on site and view aircraft departing and arriving into LIH.

Prior to boarding the aircraft, a group photo was taken plane side. GoPro cameras are mounted to each wing and at least one interior camera faces passengers. My wife was given a Kukui nut necklace for the photos and as a gift. Once on board, BOSE two-way headphones are given to each passenger for communication with your pilot and each other. For airplane enthusiasts such as myself, you'll enjoy hearing ATC and other aircraft in the area during the flight. I really liked this feature as you'll quickly notice all the aircraft circling Kauai are constantly in radio contact and sharing information regarding weather or terrain features. A cooler with refreshments and snacks is also provided in the cabin, a nice touch. Highlights of our flight included two whale pods sighted on windward side of the island, breathtaking views inside Waimea Canyon and the beach views from 5,000 feet. We even passed over our condo in Princeville and took photographs to share with future renters, review forthcoming. 

Total airtime was over 60 minutes, and the blend of Josh's commentary and background music was perfect. Everyone on board had questions for Josh, and he did a great job explaining the island's legends, culture and environment. As we taxied back to the hangar, a DVD or BluRay copy of your flight is offered. The 3 GoPro cameras capture everything you saw during the flight, and interior commentary is optional. Dori gave us a CD with their promotional video and the cover included one of our group's pre-flight photos. Ten minutes after we landed, my smartphone showed an e-mail from Wings Over Kauai with five group photographs Dori took. Customer service is above and beyond at Wings Over Kauai.

Why Wings Over Kauai Air Tours vs. helicopters or other guides? The seating is spacious, and you have more flexibility in where you can place passengers. All passengers have a port and starboard window. Driving into Waimea Canyon doesn't guarantee a view, we've made that drive before. My mother-in-law opted out of the flight just prior to departure. The ground crew never made her feel guilty and were supportive of her decision. You cover more airspace vs. the helicopter tours, and you literally fly above them. The tour is priced extremely well, and environmental impact is low. Don't hesitate to call or e-mail Wings Over Kauai for assistance in planning. This is the must do activity for Kauai! Mahalo Wings Over Kauai!

What a great experience.  We arrived on a cruise ship and took the short walk to the ABC store where we were picked up right out front by WOK.  They were even a few minutes early!  A short 5 minute drive to the airport.  Check in and then the weighing!  Fortunately no weights were displayed or discussed.  Nice bit of discretion there...two thumbs up!  We then met Bruce, our pilot (and the company owner). A short prep talk and off we went.  Dodging around the clouds we saw the most spectacular sights. "Look there's a waterfall" turned into a running joke after about the 8th one.  A beautiful island, a wonderful company and very, very nice people who work there.  Kauai is THE island to do an air tour and Wings Over Kauai the company to do it with.

We did the private tour in the Cessna and the most surprising aspect was that it was not at all bumpy...Thinking about it, us mainlanders are used to thermal bumps and bounces - but with a green canopy homogenous temperatures between land, water and air - they just don't seem to be there.  The whole ride was smooth as silk.  Maybe you'll be lucky like us and have the chance to see a humpback whale (the whole whale) while circling above it.  That was just one of MANY memorable sites that we saw....An experience that we hope we don't forget soon!!

We decided to take this tour after the rain during the early part of our vacation likely made it hard to hike the Na Pali coast. We looked at how pricey the helicopters were and settled on this option - but we soon found out that we didn't settle at all! We definitely feel like we got an amazing experience for much less than the helicopter tours.
The experience was great, check in was smooth, and we took our tour on the 2 person Cessna. You are involved in the flight from the beginning and they definitely do a good job of welcoming you - giving you flowers and leis and then taking good pictures of you with your plane. The pilot was great and calmed my nerves.
The views are amazing - we must have seen over a dozen waterfalls on our flight. It was so beautiful we can't even describe in this review - you have to see for yourself. You definitely get a more panoramic view of the island and a more personal experience doing this flight over the helicopter tours. We highly highly recommend it!

We booked the private tour for 2 in the Cessna. The flight was fantastic and the highlight of our trip. The Napali coastline is breathtaking. We highly recommend the flights with Wings Over Kauai as this is a small family owned business providing a very special and personal experience (from reservation contact to the flight itself) and price & value is great!
Mahalo Bruce & Val!

I found this tour via a google search for our Hawiian cruise through NCL. It was wonderful! It's the ONLY way to see everything on this island. Josh, our pilot was skilled and informative. It is a great value and you can get some gorgeous photos and purchase a video of your own flight. A must do!

My girlfriend and I had our Hawaii vacation planned for almost six months.  The #1 activity we wanted to do was a flight over the island.  Months of research, countless hours of reading reviews, and we both agreed on Wings Over Kauai.

We just completed our tour yesterday, February 18, 2014, and the experience was amazing.  My girlfriend described it as the single-most amazing experience she has ever had, so the bar is set very high now.  I have to agree with her too. 

Before I get into the actual flight experience, I need to mention to staff.  The staff was extremely kind, friendly, and helpful.  They answered all of our questions in a friendly manner each time we called.  Also, even after our flight, they told us to call for any questions we may have on anything we may have such where to eat, other activities, if we get lost etc.  Really? Who offers that anymore?  But they offered and you could see they genuinely cared.

Now for the flight...WOW.  That pretty much sums it up.  Every second something else just stood out as beautiful.  I cannot state if every flight is the same comfort level, but our flight was extremely smooth and very little bumbs.  Bruce was our pilot on the private two-person Cessna.  He was extremely informative and extremely courteous to our needs.  Besides seeing waterfalls everywhere, we happened to come across a whale.  I saw the whale and mentioned it, he then took a few moments to guide the plane closer to it so we could get a better picture.  As he did that, the whale breached, which apparently does not happen to often to see from the plane.  It looked just like a Pacific Life commercial, but it was all while flying.

So my recommendation is to go ahead and book this; you will be happy you did.  The cost of the trip is extremely reasonable and the memories are a lifetime.

I booked an instructional flight for my husband who is a private pilot. When I booked I let them know that myself and my two year old son would be there as well and they encouraged us to come along on the flight. Ellen and Bruce were very friendly and accomadating and Bruce was extremely informative during the flight pointing out different sights along the way. We even saw whales from overhead! They also took a picture of my family and provided that to us. Overall I would absolutely recommend this company for either instructional flight or island tour. Thank you Bruce and Ellen!

We visted Kauai during February, and it rained almost every day.  Wing's Over Kauai allowed us to reschedule the trip until the weather improved, and our trip was fantanstic!  We took the priviate flight in the Cessna. We flew over the most scenic portions of the island.  Our pilot, Bruce, was very knowledgeable of the island, and provided us with suggestions on places to visit on Kauai.  My husband was delighted to be the co-pilot for the trip, including assisting with the pre-flight check, and briefly was able to "fly" the plane.  Definitately the high point of our trip to Kauai!

review_title: Flight we will think of for the rest of our life!
review_text: When we arrived we were informed how we would fly over the island.  We were given the instructions of our seat belts and the other safety items you would experience before taking off.  We scheduled this flight on our second full day on Kauai so if we had to be rescheduled we would have options left while we were on the island.  Luckily we were blessed with a great flying day.  The two of us were with a very nice couple along with their young daughter.  Everyone on the plane had their own window seat.  Josh narrated so well during the flight and made the flight personalized to everyone on the flight.  The views over the Waimea Canyon we will never forget.  We saw so many waterfalls and a couple of whales.  When Josh spotted a whale he was able to maneuver so that all of us got the view.  We were all lucky to have a rare view of the tallest mountain on Kauai from the ground to the peak.  We did not expect that flying over the rainiest spot on Earth.  The take off and landing was smooth.  We purchased the video of our flight so we could remember this flight for the rest of our life.  All of us on the plane had smiles on our face!  Very impressed with the professionalism with this business.  If you book with them you will be in good hands.

This was going to be the highlight of our trip, we were really looking forward to taking this plane ride. When we got there, they took the money right away then had us wait for about 45 minutes. During that time we watched about 5 small planes and dozens of helicopters take off. When it came our turn for the ride they told us that the "clouds were too low" so they cancelled our flight. Normally I wouldn't have been upset because they can't control the weather. But to see a bunch of other planes taking off while the guy is explaining to us why we can't go up there really rubbed me the wrong way. Definitely won't be coming back here again. The other company's around them were still taking off as we were leaving so I guess we should have just gone with a different company

If you want the best, scenic overview of Kaua'i, especially Na Pali Coast, this is your tour.  I highly recommend you book early in your trip and book one of the first two tours in the morning.  We booked early in our vacation and because of weather, low ceilings (clouds), and winds, we had to reschedule.  The third time was the charm and it was well worth it.  We also purchased their video to remember our flight.  The cinematography is beautiful, but I was disappointed when we saw whales and their cameras didn't capture them.  I did better with my Lumix.

This was my first time in a small plane so I was very nervous but determined to see the Na Pali coastline.Our pilot Bruce was awesome  by putting me totally at ease with his narration of the island  and his constant checking in on each passenger.  He really personalized the whole experience and made us feel like old friends.  It really was the best thing we did on our trip. Everyone gets a window seat with Bose headphones so you can talk to each other thru the whole flight. The price was so much more reasonable than the helicopter tours !   A few token, secret gifts that make you feel special.  The scenery  just cannot  be described , you are in awe.  I can't say enough except Mahalo Bruce  and company and we will see you on our next trip!
By far the best thing we did on Kauai!  We did it on our first day, and it gave us a great overview of the island.  Can't say enough good things about Wings over Kauai.  Loved it!

review_title: One of the best days we've had on the island
review_text: Josh took us up on a beautiful day and absolutely loved seeing this beautiful island from the air.  We had spent 10 days hiking this island so we were able to see many of the hikes we had done from a different perspective.  As an added bonus, we were able to see whales breaching soon after takeoff, and this set the tone for the entire flight.  Thank you so much for a really memorable day!!

This flight was the highlight of our trip to Kauai. Josh  helped spot whales and even circled around so we could watch a small pod as they surfaced and moved.  Each passenger has a window seat and is able to take wonderful pictures. Sit on the right side of the plane for the best view. We appreciate the Bose headphones and all the GoPro cameras to record several views of the scenery. Josh pointed out different locations and shared a lot of interesting history about the Na Pali coast.  Great value for the cost, it is a 60 minute flight that goes by way too quickly. We were presented an 8 minute DVD with our picture on the front when we landed. It is a generic overview of the trip. We purchased the $30 DVD that was recorded from our trip that day, it will be edited from images from all the GoPro cameras and will contain Josh's description. A special thank you to Ellen and Ashley for their explanations preflight and the pickup and drop off near the cruise ship pier.  Smooth ride, great experience.

Had a great tour, we circled some whales even and saw a newly born calf. The sights were incredible with a great view of the coast. With 80 % of the island not visible by road a flight or helicopter tour is worth it and these guys were great and very accommodating. I believe they are also the more affordable way to go at about $125 per person.  Thanks Josh for a memorable flight!
Our flight with Bruce was everything it was advertised to be.  We'd definitely recommend it to visitors who want an air tour of Kauai!

review_title: Half the price of a Helicopter tour--you won't be disappointed!
review_text: I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this to anybody!  Bruce couldn't have been any nicer, he even offered an alternate route due to the windiness that day, and my reservations about motion sickness (which was not an issue at all--it was the smoothest flight I have ever been on.). He has tremendous knowledge about the island, and offers a very personal experience.  He likes for this to be a surprise, but I think it is a selling point, so I'll let the cat out of the bag--he gives you a free 10 minute DVD which reviews the special scenery of the flight.  Save your $ by doing this instead of the helicopter!

This operation is first class all the way. Bose headphones for all passengers really made a difference.  

Our email contact with  Ellen was professional and she picked us up exactly as planned in Lihue.  The flight was super with Josh as pilot and total of 4 passengers.   We had a wonderfully clear day, so that made it more spectacular. Ellen took our picture and gave us a free (generic)DVD with our personalized photo as a cover.  This is a family run operation and they were all wonderful.

Since Kauai is 77% uninhabited we were advised on our Island hopper going from the Big Island to our 10 day visit to Kauai Island that we must see ALL of Kauai and it is a "must" to go by air.  This  was absolutely the best advice. Wings Over Kauai was excellent.  Highly recommend.   BIG thank you.  Robertson & MacKenzie family.

review_title: Hands down best part of our Hawaiian vacation
review_text: From the moment I first emailed Ellen to the minute we stepped on the plane two months later in Kauai, my entire experience with Wings over Kauai was nothing short of fantastic. This is a class act, family-owned business with stellar customer service, attention to detail and a real bargain for the once in a lifetime experience of flying over Kauai. Our fantastic pilot, Josh, gave us so much history as we soared above beautiful sights. I would do this all over again in a heartbeat and recommend to anyone. Also, tip your pilots!! They deserve it!

I have a slight phobia of very small planes but am so glad I went on this excursion. I felt like the safety record of a small plane was much better than that of a helicopter and so we booked a private tour with Bruce. As soon as we got in the air, I completely forgot about my phobia because the sights were fantastic. Bruce and his company are a small company who genuinely work hard to provide the best experience for their customers and they exceeded all expectations.

review_title: One of my favorite things in Kauai
review_text: Great family owned air tour company.  There customer service is A+.  I went on this tour with 5 of my family members.  To be honest, the reason we chose Wings Over Kauai was the price was cheaper for us to do one private tour (to fit all of us) rather then each of us paying for a helicopter tour with another company.  But I am glad we did!  We had such a wonderful experience!  I would recommend to any of my family and friends.

Bruce and Josh are excellent pilots.  I'm a rated pilot and we were able to fly the 172 with Bruce along as tour guide and radio operator.  The team is very good at ensuring passenger comfort and are engaging with the passengers during the flight.  Bruce and Josh are not just "bus drivers." We were on a cruise ship and Ellen gave us a ride to/from.  Easy. Both aircraft are excellent sightseeing platforms.  Very good value.

review_title: Best tour we did in Hawaii
review_text: Great way to see all the highlights of Kauai in a short amount of time.  Views were amazing of coastline, canyon, mountains, waterfalls. We would never have seen some of these from the ground. We could see whales, even a mother and calf from the air.  Pilot Josh explained everything and always circled around to make sure everyone got the best views. Very accommodating company.  We were on a cruise ship and decided to book at the last minute and were only able to get a late in the day tour. We were on a tight schedule so they even took us back to the cruise port as opposed to their usual drop off/pick up spot.  Above and beyond!  Highly recommend!!  Great  job everyone!!  Thanks for making some great memories for us.
Stellar views you can only experience from the air! Absolutely a must when visiting Kauai. Very professional service

Don't know what else to say that hasn't been said here already.  Great experience.  Wonderful way to see this beautiful island.  Entire operation is a class act.  We saw a whale with its calf and the pilot made a point to circle around to make sure everyone could see it.  We booked the private tour for three of us.  Pilot was very nice/knowledgable.  Highly recommend.

The tour is awesome!! The views are breathtaking.. Must do for those who go to kauai..I would be given 5 star if they hadn't denied the private tour even though we booked it. We clearly booked private tour in the website n Ellen told us the website isn't working properly  so they don't know what we booked n she booked the grand deluxe tour. We booked a private tour n ended up going in 5 person flight. My husband was so disappointed. The worst part s she told me this problem exists for the past 2 months n we are the second person to get affected.. They don't seem to take any corrective action.. Seriously you knew this for 2 months n still haven't fixed it????? Guys, be careful when you wanna go for a private tour..

My husband and I decided that a Helicopter ride was too expensive.  When I jumped on Trip Advisor it showed that Wings over Kauai was the best airplane tour on Kauai and reasonably priced.  And we are very, very happy that we did the tour.  Captain Bruce Coulombe is an amazing pilot who is highly experienced, witty and super smart!  He made the trip exciting, informative and fun.  We Loved it!!!  We would highly recommend them over any of the air tours over Kauai!

This was our first trip to Hawaii and had heard the only way to see most of Kauai was from the air.  Wings over Kauai provided an excellent hour trip.  Ellen organized the flight and Josh was our pilot.  He pointed our many sights used in movies and many beautiful beaches and waterfalls.  Definitely recommend this flight!

We took our two kids (ages 4 and 6) on this tour and they loved it. Kauai is amazing to see from the air and it was a great experience - we would do it again. Bruce was super knowledgeable and we all learned a lot. The NaPali coast was my favourite and getting to see whales was an added bonus.

Wings over Kauai has excellent customer service and they've thought of all of the 'extras' to make everyone feel comfortable. We would highly recommend this tour.

Bruce and Ellen were fantastic, very warm and welcoming. Capt. Bruce is clearly conscious of the safety, comfort and enjoyment of his passengers and his commentary was very interesting. It was a terrific way to see and appreciate Kauai's unique geography and terrain.
I would unhesitatingly recommend this trip and will be a return customer on our next trip here.

My wife and I hired owner Bruce Coulombe and his Cessna for a two hour photo flight over and around this beautiful island.  This was our second flight with Wings Over Kauai and we couldn't recommend them enough!  We flew late in the afternoon, concentrating on the NaPali and enjoying the magical light of the setting sun.  From scheduling the flight with Ellen to sharing the cockpit with Bruce, this is an experience that visitors to Kauai should take the time to enjoy.  There is just an incredible amount of beauty on this island that can't be seen from the ground.

review_title: Well worth it! But buy the DVD and realize that the cabin is being recorded so have some fun! Make it your adventure vid
review_text: For our flight tour we selected Wings Over Kauai.  Absolutely recommend them to you, we got a good price, had lots of time in the air, circled some highlights including some whales, got lots of good photos and saw the whole island.  We also bought the DVD video ($30.00) of the flight as they use Go Pro cameras to capture the views as well as conversations inside the plane.  Using Bose headphones they play appropriate music for the different views and movie locations so you don’t get drowned out by the engine noise. It’s a great way to remember the trip. Pilots were super friendly, professional and know the islands history so make great tour guides.   *Buy the DVD - they do a great job with it!

review_title: A must-do in Kauai!! The highlight of our trip!!!
review_text: We HIGHLY RECOMMEND Wings Over Kauai! Starting with the reservation and emails with Ellen through the actual flight, our experience with Brue and Ellen was like none other! Bruce is an amazing pilot and showed us a great time.  We flew around the island (just three of us) and saw the beautiful mountains and waterfalls of Kauai.  The view of the Na Pali coast was breathtaking.  Bruce knows so much about the nature and history of the island owning to his scientific background in the field of agriculture, so the flight was just as educational as it was thrilling.  He also knows the weather patterns and will take you out at the best times, when the sky is clear and you can see everything.  Smooth ride, absolutely stunning views of the island, and an unbeatable price.  Definitely the highlight of our vacation!

review_title: Go do it. No second thoughts.
review_text: The view was great. The pilot, Bruce, was very informative and friendly. The price was right. And they surprised us with a FREE DVD of photographs at the end (not at a $10 or $20 charge as most tour operators in Hawaii do). Only downside was that while booking I was lead to believe we will be in a 2-passenger cessna plane, but we ended up in a 4 passenger air van with one other couple. Not a major issue. It was a great experience. Would highly recommend it.

On December 24th, 5 of our family members had a delightful flight over Kauai with Josh from Wings Over Kauai Air Tours.  Everyone we dealt with in relation to Wings was extremely welcoming and gracious.  The flight itself offered a spectacular view of the Island and its incredible landscape, and it was a nice way to get an overview of the Island before we traveled it in greater detail by car.  We felt safe and secure in the air and felt as if we had known Josh our pilot long before the ride.  He was engaging and very knowledgeable of the island, its many features, and even managed to find a  360 degree rainbow for our viewing.  Each of us thoroughly enjoyed the trip, would do it again in a heartbeat and highly recommend it to others.

I booked a flight lesson/tour in a Cessna 172 for my girlfriend and myself. I basically booked a flight lesson just so that I can fly myself (I’m a pilot), but the flight was essentially a tour. However, Bruce was great; he was patient, friendly and informative about flying in Hawaii, so I also learned quite a bit. I was on the controls from the time we started taxing for departure until we parked the plane, so in that respect the flight was a real lesson. My girlfriend, who was in the back seat and is not an aviation enthusiast at all, enjoyed the flight as much as I did. I highly recommend flying with Bruce if you are a pilot. The opportunity to fly in Hawaii is not something that us mainlanders get every day, and the cost is not much more than a flight lesson in a comparable airplane on the mainland. The views however are certainly something I don’t get while flying in Pennsylvania. If I ever make it back to Kauai, I will definitely book another flight. The flight was the highlight of my Hawaii trip (of course I’m biased, being a pilot) and I visited 4 islands over a 2 week period, so that says a lot.

We boarded this sight-seeing flight with the expectation that we would be treated with vistas along the lines of what the average air traveler would see from the average airplane window. What we came away with after seventy minutes were vibrantly hued up-close images that will stay with us for a lifetime, coupled with incisive and often witty commentary from our affable pilot and guide Josh that made the trip truly memorable.

There is a reason that this is the number one Trip Advisor activity on Kauai. This husband-and-wife team makes you feel welcome from the moment you enter the terminal and their love and enthusiasm for what they do and the island on which they they live shines through and makes you want to come back and do it all over again! Helicopter trips have their place, but none of them holds a candle to what Wings Over Kauai gives you.

review_title: Take this trip early in your visit!
review_text: Don't hesitate to do this! To see the island from above gives you such a new appreciation for Kauai - there is no way to see its beauty from the road or sea. This team is down to earth, friendly, & professional. Josh the pilot & Val are great!

Quick info about us: We are a family of four, husband and wife for 16+ years and twins (boy and girl born in 2001).  Our daughter is the social butterfly, our son has autism (he is non-verbal, but loving and happy).  Our travels are interesting because they always have the perspective of a family with a special needs child as a part of them.

Having been to Kauai twice before, we were debating what to do for our final hurrah of this trip with our kids.  The trip had been beyond fantastic for our family after a long and stressful year.  Since we have taken boat trips to tour the Na'pali Coast twice before, we wanted to do something different.  We narrowed it down to an ATV tour, a helicopter tour, or the Wings over Kauai tour.  I like to email companies before signing up to explain our son's autism and to share our uncertainties on how he will handle certain activities.  This helps me both get more information and also hear the heart of the company's response.  Wings over Kauai began to win hands down right off the bat with Ellen's thoughtful and kind emails.  You don't know how heart warming it is to have compassionate people communicate to you when you are vulnerable about your child's special needs!  Even though we doubted how good an hour flight could be, we decided to choose Wings over Kauai based on three things: 1. Ellen's emails. 2. Tripadvisor's reviews. 3. Affordable price.  It was the best decision we made amongst a two week string of great experiences!

When we arrived, the staff (Ellen, Ellen's daughter and a friend, and Bruce) all greeted us warmly and were delightfully personal and friendly.  After a review of procedures and our tour, we were raring to go.  By this point our son had seen the airplanes taking off and landing and was getting very happy and excited that we were going to go on one!  Josh, our pilot, talked with us before we boarded (we got the family photo as well), and we loaded up in a way that seemed to work best.  We left our son's microphone unplugged in case he got worked up, but left it to where he could hear us.  Again, to have people concerned about your son is a huge blessing, and we felt that they went above and beyond to care.  
The flight itself was everything people here have said.  It gave us a whole new perspective of the island and it's beauty and made us love it all the more.  Josh was the perfect host with lots of information and stories and insight that added great depth to the experience.  He was very personal and by the end of the tour it felt like we were lifelong friends.  The island itself is the most beautiful place I've been, and this tour showed off that beauty tremendously.

When the flight was over we felt that it was just the right amount of time, but also felt that we could take the tour over and over again just because it was so beautiful and informative.  We took one last picture and our boy had a huge grin on his face.  We were given the complimentary dvd and it was great to have such a personal touch of having our photo on it.

Since it has been 8 months since our adventure, I can still say this is a memory we are glad we made.  Our son (now thirteen) still often pulls up the picture of the Wings over Kauai plane and points to it (his way of asking to go again).  I agree buddy, I agree!

review_title: An unforgettable experience with so much personal touch and care
review_text:
Aufgrund der TOP Bewertungen auf tripadvisor haben wir als besonderes Highlight auf Kauai den Rundflug gebucht und Wings Over Kauai Air Tours ist zu Recht die Nr. 1 – auch für uns.
Ich könnte mir kein besseres Preis-Leistungsverhältnis vorstellen und oben drauf ein herzlicher und persönlicher Kontakt.
Schon die Buchung war völlig problemlos, ich bekam schnell die Bestätigung per E-Mail sowie alle wichtigen Informationen zu Treffpunkt, Transfer, exakter Flugzeit usw.
Wir wurden pünktlich am ABC Store abgeholt, was wirklich nur einen kurzen Spaziergang vom Hafen, wo unser Kreuzfahrtschiff lag, entfernt war, alternativ gibt es auch einen kostenfreien Shuttle bis dahin.
Bei Ankunft am Flughafen wurden wir auch sofort sehr herzlich und namentlich begrüßt. Wir wurden mit allen wichtigen Informationen für den Flug versorgt, bekamen noch ein kleines hawaiianisches Gastgeschenk und durften im Wartebereich Platz nehmen, bis es los ging.
Vor dem Einsteigen in den Flieger wurde ein Foto von uns gemacht, das wir noch am selben Tag per E-Mail kostenfrei gesendet bekamen und im Anschluss an den Flug abgedruckt auf einer CD mit tollen Impressionen – auch diese kostenfrei.
Außer uns 3 Erwachsenen war ein weiteres Ehepaar an Bord. Es gab eine Kühlbox an Bord mit verschiedenen Getränken, falls man durstig werden sollte – auch im Preis inklusive. Wir hatten gar keine Gelegenheit, Durst zu verspüren, da ein atemberaubender Flug über eine traumhafte Landschaft auf uns wartete. Jeder hatte Kopfhörer mit integriertem Mikrofon, so dass wir mit dem Piloten und allen anderen kommunizieren konnten. Das Wetter war SUPER und so hatten wir beste Sicht auf alles, was auf uns wartete, sogar Wale, die sich vor der Küste Kauais im Wasser tummelten. Wir bekamen sehr viele Informationen, Fragen wurden kompetent beantwortet und es war ein mehr als gelungener Ausflug.
Zurück am Boden begleitete uns der Pilot zurück zum Counter. Er informierte uns, dass der gesamte Flug dank der Videokameras aufgezeichnet wurde und wir uns auf Wunsch den Film auf DVD zusenden lassen könnten gegen einen wirklich geringen Aufpreis – selbstverständlich nahmen wir das Angebot an und der Versand – selbst hierher nach Deutschland – war kein Problem. So haben wir eine wundervolle Erinnerung, die wir jederzeit auffrischen und wieder und wieder die wundervolle Natur Kauai's aus der Vogelerspektive genießen können. 
Thank you SO much for an unforgettable experience Wings Over Kauai Air Tours – a perfect add to my mum's 60th birthday that day!
We had a really wonderful time!  The staff were very nice and accommodating, including with little kids, and the flight was a lot of fun.
This tour was amazing! Josh was a fabulous pilot and took us on a great tour of Kauai. It was definitely the highlight of our vacation.

Our family of 5 was offered the entire plane with a discount. It was the highlight of the trip. Staff and pilot are outstanding. We flew for an hour seeing the entire island. As a bonus, not expected, we were given a generic D.V.D. of the trip. It brought back wonderful memories.

Même si ça représente un budget c'est vraiment genial! On a décidé de faire le tour à la fin du séjour pour voir de haut tous ce qu'on avait fait! Le tour dure 1h, il n'y avait pas d'autre personnes dans l'avion (250dollars). Très bonne ambiance, très attentif avec les clients, sérieux!

review_title: The highlight of our trip to Kauai
review_text: We heard rave reviews about "Wings Over Kauai" while we in Maui, so we booked ahead...and the experience lived up to its billing.  We were in the 2 seat Cessna.  Bruce is very personable and incredibly knowledgeable about the island (topography, vegetation, wildlife, weather patterns, native culture....you name it) and encourages questions throughout the flight.  The view is spectacular and the cost is much cheaper than helicopter tours over Kauai.

Ich kann eigentlich nur nochmals repetieren was flowrider bereits geschrieben hat: "wirklich eine der bestern Touren die ich je gemacht habe und definitiv die beste Tour auf Hawaii bisher. Das ist wirklich eine der ganz wenigen Touren weltweit die gemacht werden weil es die Berufung und das größte Hobby des Veranstalters ist und nicht primär wegen dem Geld..."
Wir fühlten uns nicht wie Kunden sondern eher wie gute Freunde! Die machen da wirklich einen wunderbaren Job....jeden Franken mehr als Wert.

We had an excellent tour in their 6-seater plane. Check-in was ontime with lots of perks- free CD and necklace!  The tour was very smooth and the view is breath taking.  Their Bose Noise Cancellation headsets helped so much to reduce the noise and hear the pilot clearly.  Highly recommended!

review_title: Great service and comfortable way to see Kauai!
review_text: This was an awesome experience.  Bruce was the best pilot.  He was informative and entertaining!  We were impressed with the personal service.  He remembered our names throughout the flight and engaged each family member.

Kauai is a spectacular island and this flight is a wonderful way to see it. Booking was super easy, as was check in. 

We had brilliant weather and, in addition to the gorgeous landscape, we were able to see whales, dolphins, turtles and even a shark! Josh was a great pilot and tour guide. Our ages ranged from 11 to 80 and we all loved it. And I have to disagree about the music - thought it was a nice soundtrack to the sights (even though I've never even seen Jurassic Park).

review_title: What a great way to see ALL the scenery without the excessive cost of chopper
review_text:
The small 4 seater plan was great fun (good pilot helps) and was just so intimate and we could talk to the pilot as well as to each other with ease.  It was actuslly pretty cool being a le to hear the talk with other planes in the area and the watchtower as well - something quite educational as a bonus to the trip itself which was terrific in itself.  Other people in our party were on a 8 seater plan and though it was good as well.

Almost an hour in the air and therefore covered a lot of the island sights we wanted to see (waterfalls galore, the  grand canyonof the pacific, whales, beautiful beaches, extreme cliffs and structures beachside) but without the additional cost of a helecopter for a family of four was significant.

Would definately recommend... loved having the kids call me "captain" for the duration of the flight just because I was in the front seat next to the pilot.

I took my family on this flight and we really enjoyed the different aspect of the island. Easy check-in, pilot was very friendly and knowledgeable and the views were spectacular! Kids were given headsets to communicate with everyone during the flight (which can be a good and bad thing!) and also to listen to the pilot. Only not-so-positive was the cheesy movie music they played, a little weary hearing about Jurassic Park and having to listen to the theme music while on the flight.

review_title: Outstanding trip and service! Awesome way to experience Kauai from the air!
review_text: My family ( husband, 2 kids 7 and 11 and my parents) all took the trip recently and we're not disappointed. Ellen was great with the booking, Allison was amazing before and after the flight and Bruce was an awesome pilot and embassador of the island. They all took extra steps to make sure we had the best and most personalized experience dousing our trip. I would not hesitate to highly recommend this great family run operation to anyone looking for a "birds eye view" of Kauai.
Trip Advisor guided us to this great family run business.  Booking was easy and all aspects of the trip were wonderful.   I would highly recommend Wings and would gladly go on this trip again!

review_title: Spectacular views, outstanding service, friendly company. Do it - you know it makes sense!
review_text:
A friend recommended this company and I told my husband the name, then left him to book it. When I got back to our apartment he said he'd booked the flight. Great, I said. You did book the one I gave you the name of? No, he said. I forgot the name of it so I booked with the company that had 5 star ratings and the best reviews on TripAdvisor. And guess what - it was the same one!

The staff were so friendly. Bruce really knew his stuff, and the scenery was out of this world. We are so glad we did this trip, and it was a quarter of the price of a similar flight on the Big Island. 

Would highly recommend taking this trip to see the spectacular Na Pali coastline, especially in the winter months when doing it by sea is too rough. 

Thanks to Val and Bruce. Loved it!

We decided to try something new this last trip, when we visited the Big Island we took a helicopter ride over the island.  Are we ever happy we did!! Bruce is an AMAZING person and pilot.  This tour honestly blows the helicopter rides out of the water!
When we first arrived there I was greeted with a beautiful beaded lei necklace and a Hawaiian flower that Bruce picks himself every morning, what a lovely touch. Before getting on the plane they take a picture of you in front of it. About the tour, it was my husband, I, another couple and Captain Bruce...that was IT!! Bruce took his time during the tour and explained everything about the island.  The views were breathtaking and unforgettable. The only thing is I wish the tour would have never ended!   Afterwards we were handed a complimentary cd of a tour with our picture that we took in front of the plane.  I cannot say enough good things about Wings Over Kauai, they have outstanding customer service and it clearly shows that they do for this because they love the island of Kauai! Keep up the great work and we cannot wait to come visit you again!
Do not think twice about booking this, I promise you will not disappointed!

Thank you Bruce for a great trip around the island. Such a personal experience. Highly recommend Wings Over Kauai to anyone thinking about seeing the island by air. Smooth flight, two way radio with the pilot and great information shared during the journey. My husband and I really enjoyed our flight and feel we saw everything we could. :)

We booked the Wings Over Kauai tour based on their top rating on TripAdvisor.  We, too, give them a 5 star rating, although we were bribed to do so  --  bribed by excellent, friendly service (thanks, Ellen); a comfortable, well maintained plane; a knowledgeable, pleasant pilot (thanks, Josh); and several extras. Maybe that isn’t bribery, but just how a top-notch business should be run. In any case, this was one of the highlights of our tour, providing excellent views of the imposing Waimea Canyon, one of the only ways to see the Na Pali coast, and enough spectacular views of Kauai to make it obvious why they are known as the Garden Island. Overall, this was one of our best experiences in Hawaii.

We flew with Wings Over Kauai Air Tours on Sunday December 22, 2013. The views were fantastic, amazing and unforgettable. I was concerned I may get motion sickness in a small plane, but it was not the case at all. The staff was extremely friendly and our captain (Bruce) was very informative. I would highly recommend this tour.

What a great way to see Kauai from a different perspective. We were a bit nervous about small aircraft but Josh and Dori made us feel comfortable from the start. Josh shared lots of stories and history of the island as he pointed out the various sites. I would highly recommend this excursion to anyone that is at all hesitant about flying in a small craft. You get the best of both worlds; yes we didn't get as close to waterfalls as the helicopters but we were close enough for some great views; and without the turbulence.

This was a highlight of our trip! I would recommend this experience to any and all. Bruce and the crew were pleasant, helpful, and above all knowledgeable. My wife and I felt very comfortable and secure as we flew around the island. What a great perspective at 3000 feet!

review_title: Excellent customer service. Make you feel like family!
review_text: Bruce and crew are great.  They immediately welcome you and make you feel right at home.  Then they explain everything and get you ready for the flight.  The views from the plane are outstanding and Bruce makes comments and answers questions throughout the flight.

review_title: Highlight of our trip to Hawaii
review_text:
Just returned from a trip to Hawaii.  We did several amazing activities including swimming with sharks on the North Shore of Oahu with Hawaii Shark Encounters, driving the entire Road to Hana in a rental car using the Gypsy Guide Road to Hana app, and doing a whale watching tour on a raft with the Pacific Whale Foundation.  Each of those were great and could have been the highlight of our trip but the best thing we did was our flight with Wings Over Kauai.

Arranging the trip on line with Ellen was easy.  We were able to reserve the whole plane for our group at the internet rate.  Once at the airport, the check in process was quick and easy, even the dreaded weigh-in was handled with discretion and was painless.  Our pilot, Josh was incredible and very engaging.

The views were fantastic.  Much of what we saw was on private land and only viewable from the air.  Highlights included the Na Pali coast, Waimea Canyon and the valley and waterfall featured in Jurassic Park.  We had driven up through Waimea Canyon the day before and it was interesting to see the same views from the air that we saw from the ground.

The flight was smooth, everyone had an unobstructed view and headsets so we could hear Josh and each other's comments.  There was even a coordinated musical soundtrack.

We were on a cruise and Ellen picked us up from a shopping center near the cruise port and returned us to the ship.

We were offered a video of our flight for purchase and given a generic video and our photograph in front of the plane for free.

It was a first class experience the whole way.  Couldn't have been happier.  Big thanks to Ellen and Josh.

I am in the process of studying for my private pilots license and booked an hour with Bruce.
It was an exhilarating experience to say the least. I was able to practice my take off and landing technique on the island of Kauai with a pilot who has over 10,000 hours. Bruce was an excellent instructor with a calm and comforting style. He also narrated the island adventure for us as we flew over the most beautiful of all the Hawaiian islands. He takes such pride in his aircrafts and we watched the smiles on everyone who debarked from tours on the 6 passenger plane. 
The service is impeccable and they gift you a video of your flight to remember the island.
I would highly recommend this company for safety and service. It was also easy to book online before we left the mainland.
Kudos to Bruce and his family for running such a professional and organized company.

review_title: Views Above It All ~ Beautiful Kauai
review_text:
Wings Over Kauai is the BEST in every sense.  They were very easy to work with in setting up the flight well before we docked in Kauai.  They gave clear information on the "how to's" of pickup and drop off.  Since we arrived via cruise ship that information is very important.

The flight was wonderful....awesome....we could not have asked for more.  The pilot was great and very knowledgable about the island.  Everything was perfect.

Our thanks go out to everyone at Wings Over Kauai.  This was an exceptional tour and we were very happy to have discovered the true beauty of Kauai.....views from above.

We booked the trip though the concierge services at the hotel, initially we had to reschedule the flight twice due to weather and on our last day on the island we were fortunate enough to have the pleasure of viewing the island by air.  the views were great and the narration provided by the pilot were also very helpful, well worth the money to see the island by air.

review_title: One of the highlights of our Kauai visit
review_text: Wings over Kauai fits in very well with the overall Kauai scene.  It is very close to the airport and is easy to find.  The pilot, Bruce, was friendly, clear and had a good knowledge of the entire island.  The plane seemed very safe, and gave us all a good view of all the sights.  The whole tour was conducted without any sense of hurry, and we were shown all of the things that were to see within Kauai as shown in their site.  Although this flight will travel at an altitude higher than the helicopters, and may not get as close to every little landmark, it is the best value for the money.

Was für ein Abenteuer!!! Hatte extrem viel Spaß und  konnte unbeschreiblich schoene Bilder als Erinnerung mtnehmen. Das Team, allen voran Capitän Bruce ist wunderbar. Das Flugzeug bietet nur Fensterplätze somit bekommen alle Teilnehmer das gleiche. Unbedingt machen und sich nicht davon täuschen lassen,  dass man mit dem Heli mehr zu sehen bekommt.

We flew on Nov. 25th and had a great time. This was one of the first things we did when we got to Kauai and we were not disappointed. Ellen and Bruce are great people and made us feel very welcomed. Ellen quickly checked us in, and then Bruce flew us over the island. He was very knowledgeable about all parts of the island and pointed out notable things that we should check out. Definitely was a good idea to do it at the beginning of the trip, as we would have missed some things that were must sees!

review_title: Wow!  A wonderful way to see the beautiful island of Kauai
review_text: I had a wonderful flight over Kauai with Wings over Kauai.  It was wonderful to be able to see so many things while only paying $125.00 rather than $300+ for a helicopter.  Josh, our pilot, was very friendly and ensured that everyone got a good view.  However, I will say that I think that you are better off if you can be the co-pilot or be in the right hand side of the 'plane as there is more to see on that side.  We saw some wonderful waterfalls and the Napali Coast looked stunning.  Considering that later in the day when our cruise ship sailed past the Napali Coast, the clouds had come in, it was so nice to know that I had seen the Coast in all its' glory from the air.  I was then so surprised to receive a DVD of my adventure at the end of the flight.  What a wonderful memento of this wonderful experience.  I highly recommend Wings over Kauai flightseeing over Kauai for all visitors to Kauai.

The choice for our excursion on Kauai was either a plane ride or helicopter ride. My wife was a little unsure of the helicopter ride and I was actually leaning toward a plane ride thinking it might also be a little more leisurely. We decided to take the plane and we were not disappointed. Josh the pilot gave us beautiful views of the mountains and valleys as well as very interesting commentary all through the hour long ride. 
Everyone at the airport was a pleasure as they prepared us for our flight. The plane offered excellent views from every seat and Josh ensured all of us got the views we wanted while in the aIr. The flight was smooth/no bouncing around, the commentary interesting and the views were simply spectacular. We got several close up views of the waterfalls, valleys, coffee fields, etc.
The surprise at the end was a DVD of the ride with our pictures on the front making this one of our best excursions of the week!
We highly recommend this tour and commend all the staff at Wings Over Kauai for a most enjoyable time.

review_title: Amazing Aerial Views with Wings Over Kauai - Awesome!
review_text:
My husband & I were visiting Kauai from New York.  We were extremely fortunate to fly in a comfortable but small plane to view the luscious island of Kauai.  When we arrived for our flight Val was there to help us and handle all of our questions.  Our pilot Josh was extremely knowledgeable, friendly & provided us with a wonderful tour!  The enthusiasm Josh had definitely matched mine!  We had another couple on our flight & it took Josh much energy to get us speaking especially since the other couple was a little quiet. Flight skill was superb!  We noticed the little things, especially the coffee fields, & we came away feeling like it was such a worth while experience.

We highly recommend this trip!  You get a different view of Kauai, in that, while you don't hover over the valleys like you would in helicopters, you get up close to see the valleys and the surrounding lush island. In other words, a definite better perspective of the surrounding natural environment of Kauai. Wings Over Kauai really put in small touches to make it a better experience for your trip.  This trip is longer than most helicopter excursions in Hawaii & you don't bounce around as much.   This is a must do in Kauai!  :-)

My wife and I really enjoyed the tour. Our pilot, Josh, did an outstanding job of narration. The flight was extremely smooth and very interesting. We would highly recommend this tour to anyone who visits Kauai!!

My husband and myself decided to try this as we had a helicopter trip booked on another Island and I have to say I am glad we did. I was very nervous as I have not flown in such a small plane before.  From the off I was made to feel very relaxed and safe and once in the air the scenery completely took over. Would recommend and will do again next time I am over that way.

This was the first thing my wife and I did when we got on island.  We referred to it as our "orientation flight" because we could physically see everything and decide what we wanted to visit and what we didn't.  Best money we spent in Kauai.  We were able to see all the hot spots including but not limited to the Na Pali coast and of course Waimea Canyon.  Friendly staff.  Overall great experience.  Military discounts are available.

We were in a time share for most of our trip and we were debating on a helicopter ride or a plane ride knowing they were both great ways to see the island.  We decided to go with Wings over Kauai so we could see the Na Pali coast from the air and also be able to do a boat trip and see it from the water.   The plane ride was amazing and we did it at the end of our trip and we were able to see so many places that we had seen from the air.  We could not asked for better weather and decided to go in the afternoon based on a recommendation from where we were staying.  

Bruce and his wife were great from the beginning until the end. Just going through some of the photos and the shots that I took from the plane came out great.
