I am so happy that we decided to do it and it was worth the money spent - I guess the only thing that we could have had with the helicopter is the ability to hover but I am not sure if we would have seen more for the higher cost.

Well worth it!!!  Before we left they took a photo of us and when we got back we were presented with a CD that had our photo on it that they had taken along with highlights from the tour that were taken at another time - but still they were spots that we had seen on our tour.  They were so friendly and accommodating and even took photos with our camera that we could have from before and after the flight.

One tip is they do offer a AAA discount so make sure you ask if you have AAA.

review_title: Best way to see Napali Coast!
review_text: We wanted to visit the Napali Coast, but it's only available by air or boat.  We looked into the boat cruises.  The one we looked at started at 8am and would take 5 hours.  There were mixed reviews on TripAdvisor, and we decided we didn't want to spend that much time on a boat, especially since we both got sea sick on the last boat we were on.  Many people reported sea sickness in their reviews.  Also, the price was $150 per person.  We decided to go with the #1 choice on TripAdvisor---Wings Over Kauai.  It costs $125; you get to see the entire island; and it only lasts 1 hour...not an entire day event.  It's also much cheaper than a helicopter, and I'm not sure what the disadvantages are.  My husband and I went with 1 other couple that we didn't know and the pilot.  Booking the trip was easy.  I called Bruce and reserved over the phone.  He was very polite.  Our pilot was knowledgeable.  We absolutely loved the trip and agree with other reviewers on TripAdvisor that this is definitely the best way to see Napali Coast!  They also take a picture of you outside the plane and email it to you, and they gave the girls kukui leis.

This  trip is beautiful, educational , comfortable and well worth the cost. We toured the island by car for two days before this flight which helped us understand where we were and what we were seeing, We did a helicopter ride on Maui and this equals that trip at half the cost. This company is well informed,polite and professional .

While vacationing, for the 1st time on Kauai, I decided to get some "stick" time to add to my flight hours towards my private pilot's license.  After reviewing 4 flight schools on kauai, 2 of which didn't respond to my inquiry, I chose Wings Over Kauai located at the Lihue Airport.  Great decision!  Ellen kept in contact with me answering all my questions.  The best part was that my husband could be a part of the experience and snap photos, as well; all part of the package.  I even received a reminder text the day before my lesson.  Stellar customer/student pilot service.  Bruce was my CFI, he was patient, informative, a great tour guide, and knew his plane (Cessna 172).  Highly recommend Wings Over kauai!

review_title: Most bang for your buck, Wonderful Route, Great People and Beautiful Island
review_text:
We were on the Norwegian Cruise Line Hawaiian trip. The ship stopped at Kauai for two days. The helicopter ride ship was promoting costs around $350 per person. Since I have a group of 6 with varying budgets, I Tripadvisored and found Wings Over Kauai. For the whole 6-seater plane and an hour long tour, it costed us a little more than $500 after taxes in TOTAL. And it was basically a private tour.

The flying route will take you to all of the main attractions on the island of Kauai. Na Pali Coast, the Waimea Canyon and all the wonderful waterfalls, etc. We were very lucky with the weather, so the oldest of Hawaiian Islands, Kauai was completely revealed to us. After seeing most of the main islands, I have to say it is the most beautiful in my eyes. 

But, really it is the people of Wings Over Kauai that truly made this tour so special. Started from the booking, planning, pick-up and finally the tour itself, everyone involved was courteous and very helpful. Ellen handled most of the pre-flight arrangement, she knows about our ship better than I did. As it was to leave earlier than I thought I would on the day of the trip. And most of all, Josh our pilot, was really knowledgable and have this genuine friendliness about him that just made all of us enjoyed our trip so much more. The fact he speaks some Chinese and good looking just made my mom and all of her friends felt very much "at ease" (they were really worried about the size of the plane when I told them about the tour). They ended up spending all of the preflight time chatting and teasing Josh and totally forgot about their initial worries (it went so bad as one of them was asking if he'd like to be set up for a date with her daughter. at which point I had to intervene :). Since he use to be a commercial pilot for the American Airline, he handled our 6-seaters with ease and professional smoothness. Even my partner who usually gets really nauseated with a small plane, barely had any problems this time. And the landing was very smooth, I clapped. As a tour guide, Josh was equally up to the task. One thing I really loved, he had different the background music ready when flying over different locations. 

All in all I thoroughly enjoyed the tour, it was hands down the least expensive and the most exciting tour we did on the whole Hawaiian tour.  

Couple of tips: 
1)Book ahead, if possible with a group of 5-6 or 2 for the whole plane (they also have a two-seater). Otherwise, it's $125 per person as of Nov. 2013.
2)For pickup, ask for the Pier if possible. Although their pickup spot isn't too far from the Pier, it's about 5-10 mins walk and has a convenient store there that sells much cheaper items than the ship store.
3)The only downside with the plane tour is, maybe with a helicopter you can get closer to the scenic location. However at triple the price, I wonder it would be worth it any more.

The owner piloted the plane with a total of 4 passengers.  It was a wonderful flight and our pilot was knowledgeable, friendly and related interesting facts about the island (through headphones) as we saw gorgeous vistas.  The flight was smooth and the views out the windows exceptional.  This is a much better way of seeing the island than a helicopter flight, which is more turbulent.  We would do this trip again and again!

We were in Kauai the last week of September.  It just took me a while to do this review.  The day after we arrived we were on the Wings Over Kauai tour.  It was great.  Never having been here, it was nice to get an aerial view of the island.  From this, we were able to plan what we wanted to see for the week that we were here.  Josh was our pilot and guide.  He had loads of information about the island and he was a lot of fun.  We had done the helicopter tour on the Big Island 3 years ago so we knew we wanted to try something different on Kauai.  It was the best hour tour we had.  There was only one other couple on the plane so it really felt like we had the plane to ourselves.  I highly recommend this tour.

What a great experience.  Josh took us on an amazing adventure.  He is so knowledgeable regarding the island and made the whole time very entertaining and fun.  What gorgeous views!! We didn't want it to end.  Great meeting Dori and hearing about Mili's (their dog) story.  Very professional and awesome tour group.  Would highly recommend it!

review_title: The best hour we spent in Kauai
review_text:
WoK was super nice and professional, and the tour itself is our best memory in Kauai.

I was concerned that my 28 week pregnant wife might have motion sick for the flight, WoK was happy to rescheduled for me a morning flight with a bigger plane. It turns out to be only my family was there so we actually get a private tour.  Our pilot speaks Chinese which is a big plus as my wife & kids doesn't speaks much English, and the pilot introduced so many attractions in the flight. They gave my wife and daughter beautiful flowers which is the first surprise. 

The weather was very good for flight and we were lucky to see the Mount Waialeale, the wall of tears. Needless to say we go to the Na Pali coast, the waimea canyon, we even saw some dorphins. 

I would definitely do this again in next visit.

We enjoyed the aerial view of Kauai immensely!  We have been to Kauai many times but this was our first air time!  Wings over Kauai was amazing... Josh was our pilot and was fun, informative and professional. The entire group was a pleasure to work with and we highly recommend this experience to all! The pictures and video are an awesome memory...thank you again!

The tour was the highlight of our holiday. Being a family of five, we took up the whole plane and it was an experience we will never forget. My 3 boys all enjoyed using the headsets, and Bruce was very patient and reassuring with them, answering all their questions and going out of his way to make the tour even more entertaining for them.
The flight was smooth, spectacular, and seemed a lot longer than an hour. My advice is to not bother too much about photography, just soak in the views and the experience.

review_title: Fantastic views of Kauai from the air by a brilliant company!
review_text: Had a great time on our aerial tour of Kauai on Wings over Kauai.  We were booked on a Sunday but as it had been pouring rain the night before and strong winds on that morning we called to check whether the flight would proceed.  We were told that all flights were grounded and they could fit us in on Tuesday or we could cancel our booking with no penalty.  We went ahead with the tour on Tuesday which we thoroughly enjoyed.  To top it off we were given a free DVD with our photo on the front.  The service by Wings over Kauai was 100% and would gladly recommend this company to anybody interested in an aerial tour of Kauai. We believe that this tour is much better than a helicopter tour and we were happy that we made the choice to go with Wings over Kauai.  Thanks agains.

review_title: All that we expected and more
review_text: This is, and I'm sure will remain the highlight of our Hawaiian trip. Friendly, professional and very informative, Bruce was the ideal guide and made us feel very comfortable and safe. I would recommend this option of an island aerial tour without reservation.
Our pilot was very nice and friendly!  I liked that the whole tour had a soundtrack to go along with what we were seeing!  It was well thought out, and the people were very nice!

I booked the flight months in advance... and we received a perfect service from the team. Captain Bruce booked good weather and our flight was just an unforgettable experience. We would like to thank the team for this extraordinary highlight of our vacation. And if ever you would like to book a private flight - Wings Over Kauai Air Tours would be the one to choose - highly recommended. Bruce, Val and Ellen you made our day just perfect. Thank you very much.

review_title: Best thing we did in Kauai
review_text:
Me and my wife did the tour of island with Bruce and every second we spent in that plane was worth it!! we loved the way tour was designed and things he covered in the trip. Staff is very welcoming and overall it turned out to be best thing we did!!! 
I highly recommend this tour in early part of your stay so that you can decide what to see and what not to see during your remaining stay!

--Arpit

review_title: Wings Over Kauai is an amazing experience!
review_text: First time to Kauai and we were fortunate to get to do this amazing ride! We highly recommend Wings Over Kauai to anyone who is going to this beautiful island. Josh and Abi did a terrific job of taking care of us! It was definitely one of the best experiences we've ever had!  They picked us up  and dropped us off at the shops not too far from the cruise ship pier.

Josh the pilot was very friendly and explained a great deal about the island. The tour is a good way to scope out potential driving spots and hiking spots. Jurassic falls, and several other movie locations are covered. We went in a four person plane and everyone had a window seat.

review_title: A once in a lifetime experience
review_text:
Dori and Cap'n Josh and crew were so welcoming (And so was Milly! ). The entire flight from take off to landing was immaculate. Josh is extremely knowledgable and made the tour that much more exciting (The killer soundtrack that goes with the flight is PERFECT!). Words cannot describe the sights you will see! It is truly a once in a lifetime experience, and who better to give you that experience than Wings over Kauai?!? Thank you Josh , Dori and Crew!! You made our honeymoon that much more unforgettable! 

Andrew and Alisa Botello 
San Antonio, Texas

Josh, thank you. You kept your enthusiasm, and I'm sure that took a lot of energy especially because we were a very quiet group. Flight skill was great, from what I can tell. Noticed the little things and I came away feeling like you were both professional and personable.

I highly recommend this trip. You get a different view of Kauai in that while you don't hover over the valleys like you would in helicopters, but you get close to see the valley and the surrounding lush - in other words, a better perspective of the surrounding natural environment of Kauai. Plus they really put in small touches to make it a better experience for your trip. Apparently, this trip is also longer than most helicopter excursions in Hawaii.

review_title: Such great people and what a saving over Helicopters
review_text: I'm very late on this review because of work. But I still have a great memory of this tour. I am an aviation buff so Josh let me sit in the front seat. Sure brought back memories of my flight training and Josh knows his stuff about the island. He even has appropriate music coming through the headsets as he fly's from area to area. Dori could not have been nicer at accommodation. This is such a savings from a helicopter ride and don't believe the hype about views and where they can go. Josh flew right through the middle of the island and the canyon. If we are ever lucky enough to get back to the Island with our children this is the one tour I would book again. Sorry it took four months to tell you.

review_title: Wunderbar, Einzigartig! Ein Muss auf Kauai
review_text: Fantastische Tour, wirklich eine der bestern Touren die ich je gemacht habe und definitiv die beste Tour auf Hawaii bisher. Das ist wirklich eine der ganz wenigen Touren weltweit die gemacht werden weil es die Berufung und das größte Hobby des Veranstalters ist und nicht primär wegen dem Geld (davon hat Brue in seinem früheren Job deutlich mehr verdient). Daher auch der vergleichsweise so günstige Preis. Bereits am Boden wird man sehr herzlich von den Mitarbeitern des sehr kleinen Familienbetriebs willkommen geheißen. Dann hatten wir das Glück zu zweit in der kleinen Maschine mit Bruce zu fliegen und ich durfte am Co-Piloten Sessel sitzen. Bruce, der Eigentümer der Firma, hat uns mit seiner ruhigen, netten Art ein Wohlfühlgefühl und Sicherheit vermittelt. Der Flug selbst war fantastisch, der Ausblick atemberaubend, das ganze Erlebniss sehr persönlich. Zum Abschluss gab es dann sogar noch ein tolles Geschenk. Wenn man nach Kauai kommt ist diese Tour ein absolutes Muss!!

review_title: Birgit und Peter Böck aus Wien
review_text: Es war für uns ein einmaliges und unvergessliches Erlebnis, welches wir hoffentlich noch lange in Erinnerung behalten werden, Die Insel Kauai aus der Vogelperspektive zu sehen ist ein Muss für jeden Besucher, unseren Piloten Bruce können wir wirklich nur weiterempfehlen.

We had a most memorable flight provided by all at WOK, but the attention to service and detail was handled by Dori and Josh along with their sweet companion Millie (the dog).
There was six of us in the party that filled up their G8, and Dori and Josh had to work at weight and balance issues to makes this flight happen and they did it with enthusiasm and professionalism that made us all appreciate the effort. 
We will talk about this trip and share memories for years to come..

My fiance treated me to WOK for my 73rd birthday.  What a treat!!!  Josh is a great pilot, and his knowledge of Kauai culture, history, geology, and flora is phenomenal.  He and his wife Dori have hiked many of the ridges and other trails on the island, so he has first-hand experience of what we were seeing.  The views of the sea, mountains, canyons and agricultural areas are spectacular.  Today there was a lot of rain in the morning (Wai'ale'ale mountain gets 450 inches per year) so all the water falls were running - I lost count after about 50 different falls.

I loved this trip and think it was well worth the money.  Being given a DVD of a similar trip at the end was a very nice touch.  Definitely I would recommend this and I would probably do it again if I visit Kauai.  The pilot really positioned the plane beautifully so that we could take beautiful photos of the scenery.  The only point I would make is that the views for passengers sitting on the right hand side of the plane were definitely better than for those sitting on the lefthand side.  Everyone apart from my son was put on the righthand side and if I had realised this when we were being seated, I would have probably asked if I could have changed with him as he is a camera buff and would really have appreciated being on the good side.

review_title: Delightful flight with friendly and personal service.
review_text:
Ellen helped us to book our flight earlier in the day so that we could go on the flight as soon as we arrived on the island. Then, when we missed our Hawaiian Airlines flight between islands, Patricia was able to accomodate us with a later flight.  When we finally artived, Bruce (our pilot) and Patricia were very friendly.  
Before our flight, they took our picture with the plane.  The flight was fun and the sights were amazing.  We saw gorgeous waterfalls, coastlines, and the beautiful Waimea Canyon.  

After the flight, we were given a free DVD video.  Later, that emailed the pictures of us with the plane... again with no extra charge.  

I have been on a similar scenic helicopter flight before.  It was a great experience and I do recommend taking a helicopter flight at least once in your life.  But if you want to see Kauai from the air, at a great price, and with personal friendly service, take the Wings Over Kauai airplane flight.

This is a must do when in Kauai! It was a great way to see all of Kauai since much of the island is undeveloped and not accessible by car. Bruce is very professional and a great pilot who made the ride smooth and comfortable. He was funny and made the experience personal. You get to see incredible views from the plane while Bruce narrates about some fun facts and history. Truly amazing experience with a wonderful company.

review_title: Best part of our Kauai trip.
review_text:
Never did this before and been wanting to do this so other people's reviews led us to choose Wings Over Kauai over the helicopter tours. 

From the time Ellen acknowledged our reservation and Abi welcomed us at the counter and Capt Bruce flew us, it was just one warm and pleasant experience. It turned out to be the most exhilarating part of our trip to Kauai. No wonder it ranks #1 here. You must do it too.

Wir kommen gerade von dem Rundflug über Kauai zurück und liegen jetzt am Pool. Es war traumhaft schön. Der Service war klasse, der Pilot hat uns viel erklärt und gezeigt. Wir sind total begeistert. Wir haben viel auf der Insel unternommen, auch eine Catamarantour an der Na Pali Coast gemacht. Diese Tour als Abschluss war somit die Krönung. Wir überlegten zuerst die Helikoptertour zu buchen, haben jedoch auf Grund des Preises diese Tour gebucht. Sicherlich kommt man mit dem Helikopter nochmals näher ran. Wir haben jedoch alles fantastisch gesehen und wissen im Moment nicht, was besser hätte sein können. Wir können die Tour nur wärmstens empfehlen.

My husband and I were desperate to take a flight over Kauai but were concerned we wouldn't be able to because of our children being so young (3yrs and 1yr). We stumbled across Wings Over Kauai Air Tours on the net and were excited to see they would take young children up too. 
On arrival at the airport we were greeted very warmly by Bruce (the pilot) and his wife plus another colleague. Myself and another female passenger were given kukui beads as a gift and the children were given flowers. We were weighed and then we had our picture taken in front of the plane before setting off. Bruce warned us that our kids would probably fall asleep during the flight and he was right! Our kids nodded off pretty soon after being in the air which was great - it meant my husband and I could relax and enjoy the view in peace! Bruce was very knowledgable and went to great lengths to engage with each of us throughout the flight. The scenery was breathtaking and our photos don't do it justice. You just have to take the flight! Wings Over Kauai are about half the price of the helicopter tours on offer. At the end of our tour, we were given a DVD of the flight we took (complete with our picture on the cover). Very sweet.  A great little business. I would highly recommend these guys.

You need to book this tour! Wow, what an experience! We had such a great time and I think it was definitely better than a helicopter tour. Bruce and his wife were great and we had such a nice time. It was such a smooth ride even with a little rain. We did this the first day in Kauai and it was great to be able to get a visual of where everything was along with the great rec's from Bruce. Highly recommended!

We traveled to Kauai and flew with Bruce on Oct. 20. It was a super experience for us, especially since we both love flying. Certainly seems to be the best way to see pretty much of a beautiful island. Weather was perfect too. Thank you Bruce and Wings! Alan and Pam, Wyomissing, Pennsylvania

Mon mari et moi-même avons effectué un vol avec Wings Over Kauai en octobre 2013. Nous avons reçu un accueil très chaleureux de la part d'Allison et Bruce, le pilote. Nous avons reçu un lei et une fleur fraîche sentent bon Hawaii avant le départ. Après une photo souvenir, nous sommes montés dans l'avion et là, la magie à commencé. Nous avons eut la chance d'avoir un beau temps sans trop de turbulences et nous avons pu admirer des paysages plus que magnifique commentés par le super pilote Bruce ! Ce vol sera à jamais gravé dans notre mémoire. A la descente de l'avion une autre surprise nous attendais. Pendant le vol Allison avait imprimé notre photo et en avait fait la pochette du dvd souvenir du vol. Nous n'oublirons jamais cette superbe expérience !!!

The flight over Kauai is breathtaking.  The weather was perfect and Bruce, our pilot, did a great job describing what we were seeing and giving background on the island and the sites.

Viewing the Napali Coast from the air is spectacular, and we were able to see the hiking path we had taken the day previously down to the HANAKAPI'AI beach.

The service was excellent and we would definitely do this again.  We highly recommend.

review_title: Fly high with Wings of Kauai
review_text:
What an experience we had touring with WINGS. We were very fortunate to be taken for our hour long scenic tour by Bruce the owner/pilot in a Cessna plane, Let me start at the beginning... Tour was booked online, communication via email was spot on, we were picked up at the ABC shop in Kauai (up from our cruise ship terminal) by Ellen, we were made to feel welcome and comfortable by all staff. We were briefed on what to expect. Our pic was taken beside the plane and than it was time to fly WOW this was an amazing experience. We flew over the magnificent coast line, Hawaiian grand canyon, water falls, rainforest ( jurasic park movie area)This tour was very professionally done with Bruce informing us with all the information about this beautiful island. i have never felt so relaxed. Than just when we thought it was over on return to base we were presented with our own DVD along with our pic on the cover. ABSOLUTELY THE BEST TOUR EVER. DO NOT MISS IT.  REMEMBER WINGS OF KAUAI   Check out their website
landjdoyle   aussies

My husband and I traveled to Kauai one month at in Sept 2013. I have to say I was nervous about flying on such a small plane, but the flight was smoother than the massive commerical flights. Wings over Kauai was definately our favorite part of the trip. The desk staff was friendly and welcoming, and Bruce our pilot really made it a point to engage in conversation, get to know us, and tell us all of his fun facts about the island.  Until I saw it with my own eyes, I thought all the postcard pictures of the Napali Coast were digitally altered. It is truly breath-taking.  I would definately recommend this company, they were friendly, affordable, knowledgable, and so much fun!! Thanks for making our trip extra special, Wings Over Kauai!!!

Six of us from Australia decided to do this from our cruise ship. We booked online,early, which was great, because we were all a bit overweight. The staff accomodated us in two aircraft at the time we wanted.  They picked us up from the ABC store near the ship.  We were given beautiful nui nut leis.  The pilot for our plane wad Josh. He was terrific. His commentary was excellent. The views were incredible. The flight was 45 mins, but seemed to go forever. After the flight, we signed up for our DVD of the flight. This only took two weeks to get to us by mail.  It was very personalized, with us in the cabin,and the commentary. I would urge you to do this if you are in Kauai.

This is a MUST DO!!! for any pilot out there (and non-pilots as well).  Bruce and his crew are a first class operation and do whatever it takes to make this an excellent experience for everyone.  Wont even mention that this is an ex-ERAU aircraft...GO RIDDLE!!!  This is easily the best way to see the island and a not-to-miss experience on any Kauai vacation.

review_title: Beste Option um Kauai von Oben zu sehen!
review_text: Durch die guten Bewertungen sind wir auf Wings Over Kauai aufmerksam geworden. Bereits die Kommunikation per Mail war sehr persönlich und freundlich. Auch beim Einchecken hatte man das Gefühl sehr willkommen zu sein, super freundliche Mitarbeiter und ein Top Pilot der viel erklärt hat während des Flugs. Man sieht wirklich die gesamte Insel, ein riesen Vorteil gegenüber den vielen Helitouren. Wir können jedem nur wärmstens empfehlen diesen Flug zu machen wenn man auf Kauai ist. Wir kommen gerne wieder! Mahalo.
You can't go wrong with this tour. Loved it. Great crew of people too. We were here October of 12' and this tour was one of the highlights of the trip.

We greatly enjoyed our experience with Wings Over Kauai Air Tours. I had done a helicopter tour before of the Island and did not feel as though I got my money worth due to the fact that it speeds by everything so fast I felt like it was all a blur. With doing a plane tour I was able to enjoy every moment of the 70 minute tour. It felt relaxing, like taking deep breaths in and I could view the canyon the coast's and the mountains in all its splendor. Bruce and his team where amazing. Bruce was able to give insightful answers to all of our questions while on the tour. Plane tours are the way to go for both price and visual quality, and Wings Over Kauai exceeded my expectations.

I am so glad I booked this tour. It was the highlight of our first trip to Kauai. My son and I had a blast and would do it again in a minute! Bruce was very nice as was John and Ellen...very professional yet intimate tour. It was also very informative. Bruce was kind enough to request special approach just so we could fly over our hotel! I was able to snap lots of pictures and videos and will cherish the time spent up there. We were able to see lots of waterfalls, points of interest and the flight was very stable and pleasant. I highly recommend this tour, you'll love it and you'll save money that you could then use for other tours.

My husband and I knew we had to do a flight at some point during our honeymoon as this was the one thing we'd been advised to do by all friends and family who had been to Kauai.  We originally thought we'd go with a helicopter, but we soon realized that that would break the bank.  Wings Over Kauai was a much more reasonable price and allowed us to still see the island from the sky.  They put you at ease, provide water and ginger chews in case of air sickness, play an awesome soundtrack, and provide you with tons of knowledge about the island.  Great experience - definitely recommend!

Durch Zufall sind wir auf Wings over Kauai gekommen, da unsern Helikopterflug  wegen schlechten Wetters zum Teil im Nebel und Regen durchgeführt wurde, keine Chance, die Na Pali Küste zu sehen.

Auf der Suche nach einer preiswerten Alternative zu Helicopterflügen sind wir auf der Seite von Wings over Kauai gekommen, und dies war ein ausgesprochener Glücksgriff. Die Begrüßung durch Val war überaus freundlich, Bruce, unser Pilot und Eigentümer der Firma, hat uns auf seine ruhige und freundliche Art die Highlights  der Insel gezeigt, ist auf alle Fragen liebenswürdig eingegangen, hat uns als Freunde mitgenommen.

Wir haben jede Minute des Fluges genossen, der Flug war das Erlebnis unserer Hawaii-Reise. Zum Abschied gab es eine CD des Fluges mit einem Bild von uns gratis.

Der Flug mit Wings over Kauai stellt  eine absolute Alternative zu den relativ teuren Helicopterflügen dar. Jederzeit wieder, einfach unvergesslich und super !!

Mahloa Bruce und Team

We booked this trip based on the reviews on trip advisor and were not disappointed.  Josh was a great pilot and very knowledgeable.  The little extras were a nice surprise also.  We had intended to do a helicopter tour, but are glad we chose this instead.

Although my husband and I have been to Kauai a number of times, this was our first air tour.  It was very well done, and gave an entirely different and beautiful perspective of the island.  Josh was a great pilot and guide.  Plus there were a few nice unexpected extras:  a nut lei, they take your photo and send it to you, and a cd with a video.  

So the question we struggled with was airplane flight or helicopter tour.  This was 1. cheaper (about half the cost), 2. I think gave a better "perspective" on what you are seeing since the helo flies much lower I think you can lose track of where you are, 3. less air motion (if you are prone to air sickness at all, I think the helo would put your stomach in your mouth with all the ups and downs and tight turns).

Having said that, I imagine the helicopter is a thrill -- we could see them going right up to the walls of the canyons and close to the waterfalls.

We loved this experience in the Wings Over Kauai airplane.

review_title: Breathtaking, peaceful, non-intrusive, and... something you should do
review_text:
This is something I would recommend to anyone.  And the small plane experience is perfect for it.  We chose this instead of doing a helicopter tour because helicopters are so noisy and intrusive that they are called the "mosquitoes of the island" by some of the locals.  

But you should do this tour for more reasons than the above.  It's peaceful, breathtaking, and a wonderful experience.  You see parts of the island that are otherwise not viewable.  And they are as amazing.  i don't want to give anything away, but it's worth the time and the money, far and away.

The staff is great - courteous, friendly, and open.  Our pilot Josh was fantastic.  The flight was smooth despite what I assume to be challenging conditions with the island's particular geography.  He is very informed about the island itself, its history and significant landmarks and features, and imparts a great deal of interesting information throughout the tour, all while expertly managing the flight itself.

I highly recommend this to anyone.  If you have a tendency toward motion sickness, of course do take some dramamine or whatever works for you as you might for a boat ride or similar.
This is a great way to experience Kauai from a different perspective. The pilot and staff are outstanding, and the tour is spectacular.  It's about half the cost of a helicopter tour.

We've been in Kauai for a week and ended our tour with Wings Over Kauai.  Our pilot, Josh, was friendly and knowledgable.  The entire staff at Wings Over Kauai were super friendly and made us feel comfortable and confident...mom was a little nervous at first but would do it again!!!  We had a private tour with 4 family members with the cost below anything else we found.  If you find yourself in Kauai, book a trip with them, you will happy that you did.

review_title: Do this early in your trip!
review_text: What a thrill it was to fly Over Kauai with Josh.  Everybody was so nice and very knowledgeable.  We saw everything we wanted to see from the sir. Great trip, very safe and a good value too.

This experience was wonderful.  I am a repeat customer who couldn't resist the temptation to go up a second time a few years after my first flight with Bruce when I urged my fiance enjoy a flight on Kauai.

I researched all of our options for seeing Kauai by air, and chose Wings Over Kaui for their personalized service, safety record, and cost.  Bruce, Val, and Ellen were welcoming, friendly, concerned with our safety and comfort.  We booked the 2 person Cessna tour and Bruce did not disappoint. The views were amazing, the narration informational, and the fact that it was just my husband and I made it personal and enjoyable.  Thank you Bruce, Val and Ellen for making our tour an awesome experience!

TIP:  If you do the tour at the beginning of your trip to Kauai, it will give you ideas for things, hikes, activities you want to pursue on your visit.

Highly recommend the 2 person Cessna tour for couples!

I won't rehash everything everyone else said, but I will say that this was the highlight of our trip to Hawaii. Bruce was fantastic! Incredible views, great and interesting narration, and everything you could possible want from the experience. Very much worth it. Thank you Bruce! Do this, you will not be disappointed.

My husband and I reviewed trip advisor and yelp for the best possible view of Kauai by air.
Thank you Wings over Kauai for an awesome experience and making our anniversary and
birthday special!

review_title: Excellent personilized service! Best Way to See Kauai
review_text:
Thanks to Val, Ellen and Capitán Bruce for an excellent tour of Kauai. They took the time to memorize all our names before we arrived and greeted us by name. The flight was great and the views of Kauai and especially the Napali Coast are awesome.

Thanks,

Jesus Vazquez

Hi, 
We were absolutely pleased by this experience, which we booked in advance from Australia, Josh our pilot was personable and passionate about the fantastic sights and locations, we were so fortunate to see the highest wetland in the world when the normally clouded summit was on view, the interesting terrain in the valleys and the touching story of finding Millie in such a location made us feel like family.
We could have easily asked for another lap, hopefully on our return in the future.
We highly recommend Ellen and Bruce fine enterprise.
As a bonus, our plane is also Australian!

We wanted a flight that would offer a great overview of Kauai and we were not disappointed.  I personally am afraid of heights and was leery about going, but I truly enjoyed the experience and once we met the pilot all my fears "flew" away.  The scenery was awesome. There were six of us in our party and every one of us enjoyed this flight.  I would highly recommend it!

Service and flight were excellent, Bruce is a great pilot and guide.  A very personal and friendly family run operation and after deciding to book this rather than a helicopter ride we were really pleased we did - it's well priced compared to the helicopter rides too.  Book it!

My husband and I booked this flight the second day of our Kauai vacation.  Bruce was our pilot and it was just the three of us in the plane.  From the moment we entered their place of business, we were treated like old friends, we were greeted by our first names, I was given a beautiful necklace, we were given information about the flight.  I sat in the front seat and my husband in the back.  Bruce made me feel at ease, knowing I was a little nervous having not been in a small plane before.  He had me act as co pilot prior to take off - reading the flight check list.  As stated in other reviews, he gave us lots of information concerning the island.  We wanted to take the flight early in our vacation to give us ideas and help us make decisions on different parts of the island to visit.   We appreciated the individual attention we were given by Wings over Kauai and we defintely recommend as a must do.  Thank you so much for an enjoyable addition to our anniversary trip.  

Janelle and Todd

review_title: Wings Over Kauai only way to go
review_text: The pilot was so calm and knowledgeable and informative and the scenery so splendid that it really is the only way to go (to see Kauai). Inexpensive too (especially compared to helicopter tour). D it . You'll like it and want to do it again.

Oh my goodness! The Wings over Kauai tour was the best experience my husband and I had in Kauai. We decided to go with them instead of the helicopter tours for a few reasons. 1. It is less expensive. 2. We were recommended by a friend of ours who had taken this tour the year before. and 3. It felt like it would be a more personal tour. We were so incredibly pleased with the tour and with Captain Bruce and Val. When we arrived, Val presented me with a beautiful kukui necklace and fresh flower for my hair. So sweet! I am a nervous flyer and this was the smallest plane I had ever been on. Captain Bruce made me feel totally at ease and the flight was fairly smooth so I did ok. Throughout the flight Captain Bruce would check on all the passengers and make sure we were doing ok. He is incredibly knowledgeable and taught us a lot about the agriculture of Kauai and also added information about the history of the areas we flew over. The scenery was worth it. The air is the only way to see Kauai!! I can't say enough about Wings Over Kauai. Just simply amazing. We would recommend them to everyone. Thank you so much Captain Bruce and Val!!! - Nav & Chinh

Ellen and Bruce provided a fabulous experience for my husband, myself and our 2yr and 3yr old.  Bruce pointed out all of the great sites on the island and gave a great narration.  Our boys loved the plane ride.  Bruce was such a smooth rider the boys fell asleep at the end.  The plane was very comfortable and drinks were provided on the plane.  We also received some photos of us and the plane and a dvd. This was a great value!  Thank you so much for this awesome adventure!

My husband and I wanted to see the landscape from above but the helicopter tours were really too expensive so we went for this plane tour instead and it was fantastic!!! The pilot is really nice and makes comments on the island as we fly over the breathtaking mountains and seaside. 
This was one of our best moments of our trip to Hawaii, I definitely recommend it!

If you're considering booking with Wings over Kauai, do it now! Gorgeous views and excellent customer service. I am so glad I did the research and discovered this gem. We were so disappointed when the weather was gray and rainy on the day our flight was scheduled, but so impressed when we received the call that the pilot had decided to cancel the flight due to questionable weather and poor visibility and were offered the opportunity to reschedule. With only 2 days left in our trip we were able to get on a flight the next afternoon and it was incredible. Enjoy your trip and say hi to Bruce, owner and pilot extraordinaire.

We decided on Wings Over Kauai over a helicopter tour for two reasons. First, our 12 year old daughter was significantly more comfortable with a small plane over a helicopter. Second, the prices for a helicopter tour were substantially more. My husband has gone on a helicopter tour in Kauai and did say her enjoyed both. However, for really getting into the island and seeing it closer the helicopter tour was better. With that being said, we very much enjoyed our tour with Wings Over Kauai. It was amazing! My daughter was comfortable and we were able to see the entire island, waterfalls etc. I will say since I was taking pictures, I was able to use the zoom lens and get some fantastic shots, the windows were actually easier than in a helicopter. Additionally, we all were positioned on the side of the plane where we were able to see unobstructed. All passengers had a window. I don't believe that is the case in a helicopter. I would also like to mention that this was a little over 1 hour tour which I believe in my research most helicopter tours are quite a bit shorter.Therefore, with all of this information - I hope it helps you make the best decision for your family. There are pros/cons to each. Have a great time!

review_title: Yes, it is really THAT good
review_text:
I can't add a whole lot to what other reviewers have already said, but this place is the real deal. They are super friendly and seem to genuinely enjoy what they do. 

The plane ride is about 65 minutes long and every passenger receives noise-canceling headphones equipped with microphones that allow you to chat with other passengers on board. Our pilot, Josh, was very nice and offered interesting details about Kauai, while also answering any questions we had. He was helpful in pointing out the numerous waterfalls and beaches you'll fly over so you're not mindlessly scanning the island. 

Unfortunately I got sick towards the end of the flight and had to use the "aloha bag" as they call it. Helpful hint: if you're about to get sick, point the microphone AWAY from you before you hurl.   It was the first time I've ever gotten sick on a plane, but it was my fault because I had suffered heat exhaustion the day before and was still woozy heading into the flight. But the staff made me feel at ease and not ashamed at all. That was really nice. 

We paid about $250 total for two people, not including tip. There are definitely cheaper alternatives out there but remember, they are rated No. 1 on Trip Advisor for a reason. If you are looking to splurge on a single excursion, this is definitely it.

Having just returned from an amazing Hawaiian vacation, I have to say, this was a true highlight of my experience. The scenery from Kauai via the ground is stunning, and by air, it's absolutely breathtaking! The team at Wings Over Kauai is a joy to work with and they do such a good job of narrating the flight for you so that you understand what you're looking at (from how the landscape developed, to odd facts, to celebrity homes, etc.). Plus, while you can see certain things from the ground, parts of the island can only been seen by air or by boat. I cannot stop looking back at my photos from the flight. I guarantee that this hour will be one of the best of your vacation by far!

review_title: Highlight of our trip to Kauai!!
review_text:
From booking to the plane ride, the team at 'Wings Over Kauai' are professional, friendly, and make you feel like family.  I emailed Ellen a few times and she was very responsive with booking the tour.  I wanted to tour in the Cessna, as it was just my husband and I.  Unfortunately, due to our missed flight, we were delayed in reaching Kauai.  But Ellen was very understanding.  She gave me different options and booked me on the Cessna tour for a different day.  Very very accomodating.

On the day of our tour, we reached early and were welcomed by Doris.  She gave me a flower and lei (garland) as a gift.  Her husband Josh was our pilot.  We got on our Cessna, but not before she took a picture of us.  She took a few and emailed it to us right away.  The Cessna had water and ginger chews for us (in case we got motion sickness).

My husband sat in the front and was super excited.  The tour was amazing.  Kauai is a beautiful island and what better way to see the Na Pali coast, Waimea Canyon, and all the different beaches.  It did get a bit windy and Josh made sure we were comfortable.  I did get a bit queasy towards the end, but my husband had no problem at all.  I sucked on the ginger chews and was fine.  Once we landed, they gave us a DVD of the flight that this tour took as a gift.

I can totally understand why this tour is the number 1 thing to do in Kauai as per Trip Advisor.  Its cheaper than helicopters and provides the same scenic views.  Their customer service was top notch.  I highly recommend anyone going to Kauai to do this tour.  Definitely was one of the highlights of my trip.

review_title: カウアイの絶景に、ノックアウト!!!
review_text:
子供連れ(9才、7才、2才)でしたが、家族全員 大満足の体験でした。カウアイは切立った地形のため揺れが心配でしたが、さほど揺れることもなく快適なフライトでした。スタッフも皆、フレンドリーで親切、日本人でも問題なしです。
地上からは絶対見ることのできない絶景を、見ないで帰るなんてもったいない。一人約120ドル、格安です。ワイメアキャニオン、からナパリコーストに抜ける瞬間、気分は最高潮（≧∇≦）
是非お勧めです

Traveled to Kauai with my girlfriend for a week of relaxing. Being a pilot myself, Ive always wanted to fly myself around one of the Hawaiian Islands. Kauai was the perfect choice. Wings Over Kauai was the most professional operation one could hope for. Everyone was extremely nice, and the flight was spectacular. Flying with Bruce, whos knowledge of the island was great, was a real pleasure. We recommended this for all pilots and non pilots alike. Helicopter tours are cool, but flying the airplane yourself? EVEN COOLER.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S3NA4ZuwX3o

There are so many places on Kauai that you can only see from the air. Bruce and his family run a small family business that does a great job of showing you the entire island from above. They have extra personal touches like flowers from their backyard, a Kukui seed lei, drinks for the flight and an emailed group picture. We are so glad we booked this at the beginning of our trip so we could get a good feel for the island. We really enjoyed our flight and tour!

We have just returned from 3 weeks in Hawaii - 6 days on Kauai where we took a flight over Kauai. I was apprehensive when my friend booked the flight as I had only been on a small plane once when I encountered extreme motion sickness, but not on this flight, it was extremely smooth and it was definitely the highlight of our trip to Kauai. The entire staff put me at ease. Ellen was fantastic booking us in for the flight and our pilot, Josh, was awesome. We were very lucky as the day we went the visibility was 10 out of10. I would definitely recommend Wings over Kauai as the only way to see Kauai.

Pleasant staff and pilots. Really enjoyed the 1 hour tour in the Avro Van. Pilot "Josh" was professional and very informative. The plane is comfortable and quiet. Probably the best value tour on the island. I'm ready to go again.
Everyone at the office was wonderful, my wife enjoyed the flower, and we all enjoyed the views above Kauai. It is something that I will never forget!

Smooth ride, breathtaking views, much cheaper than a helicopter. This is definitely the way to go if you want a birds-eye view of Kauai. Bruce the pilot was a wonderful host and gave an interesting and informative tour of the island, including pointing out where scenes from various movies had been shot. I get motion sickness very easily, but I had no trouble at all on the flight. For my money, this is the best activity available on the island.

My husband and me were thinking in flying over Kauai by plane in our trip to this island. We tried this company because it was number one of tripadvisor. 

Now, I understand why!!! People very very friendly,and very professional.The pilot was also American Airlines pilot and he told us that he enjoyed doing this in his holidays. 

I recommend you strongly the company.

review_title: Great Family thing to do in Kauai
review_text: We took a family trip to Kauai at the end of July, beginning of August.  We had 22 people on the trip and some of us wanted to see Kauai from the air.  After searching for various options we settled on Wings Over Kauai and could not have been more pleased.  There were 12 of us total on 2 flights.  The staff was fantastic and friendly and our pilot really made a great flight experience for us.  My wife is not a big fan of small planes, but it was a smooth trip and our pilot, Bruce, made for a calm and pleasant ride.  We went with our 3 children (7,5, and 2) and my father.  For the price it was absolutely amazing.  A great way to see the island as a large family without having to go in pair or breaking the bank.  I hope to do it again some day.  The plane ride was about an hour, but if you are not in Lihue leave some time for travel.  We came from Princeville and it took almost an hour each way, but we did do some shopping in Lihue before we returned.

review_title: Can't miss this or you didn't REALLY visit Kauai!
review_text: Bruce and Ellen are amazing. I visited for my honeymoon over a year ago and frequently remember this aerial trip. That's how great it was! I also took a doors off helicopter tour. Both have much to offer and are totally different but if I had to pick only 1, definitely go with the plane tour with Bruce. Very safe, yet exciting. Great photo oops, was treated like family. Fantastic tour!!!!

review_title: AWESOME! You will not be disappointed!
review_text: Best experience in Kauai by far!  Captain Bruce not only knows all the sights on the island but is a wealth of knowledge about the plant life (his doctorate in agriculture might help). I took my elderly parents and young children on the flight and everyone loved it. Bruce took extra time to engage everyone on the flight to ensure they were having a great time. Ellen did yeoman's work getting our reservation made and we were fortunate to meet Val on her first day at "the office."  Bottom line: skip the helicopters, have a super smooth and safer flight, save half off the price of the whirlybirds, and let Bruce tell you everything you'd ever want to know about Kauai. A big Mahalo!

review_title: Magical flight over such a beautiful island
review_text: Excellent flight very informative and covered sooooo much of the island. Ellen and the crew at Wings Over Kauai are very professional, I would highly recommend this tour to people who wanted a great experience on the beautiful island of Kauai.

This was a great way to see other parts of Kauai u can not see by land. Staff was very freindly and answered ever questions we had prior to flying. Was worry about clouds and how bumpy it might be. Our pilot and Ellen assured us they wouldn't fly if it was not going to be a smooth ride be able to see sites. They were right, spectacular views. Pilot knew a lot of history and geography of island. He was a geologist on island for several years. He was also very understanding when my wife had to get out of plane just before take-off. She is claustrophobic and could not go. She missed a wonderful flight.  Thought about chopper, but after seeing where they go, glad we took wings over kauai.

We emailed back and forth to Ellen before our trip to Kauai, and she was always prompt to answer any of our questions. We decided to wait till  we arrived in Kauai before booking our flight to see what the weather was. That was no problem getting a flight for the following day at 1pm. We ended up flying in their smaller plane with just my wife and I and Bruce the pilot. A private flight tour was great. We wanted to do the flight early in our trip to Kauai, so we had an idea what the island looked like and places we wanted to visit while there.
Their daughter checked us in, Extremely friendly. She gave my wife a nut Lei and a flower for her hair and lots of helpful information about the flight and sightseeing ideas on the island
Bruce was great- very friendly and informative in showing us points of interest while flying over Kauai. It was a A-plus experience and the highlight of our Kauai vacation.
We had perfect weather with hardly a cloud in the sky.
My wife sometimes has issues with motion sickness. She had none on this flight-very smooth.
She sat in front seat next to Bruce and even helped with pre-flight checklist.
We saw many beautiful things during our flight. The flight lasted almost 90 minutes.
We picked the airplane over Helicopter and were completely satisfied with our decision.
We highly recommend taking a flight with Wings over Kauai. It is a great family run business.
They also include a CD of flying over Kauai with their flights. We took lots of great photos.

My husband and I took a private flight over Kauai on the first day of our honeymoon. It was a fantastic way to get accustomed to where things are on the island. Bruce provided personal commentary and helped us decide what we wanted to see during our week long stay. We loved the views and couldn't stop talking about the flight during our trip. I would definitely recommend this family oriented company for your flight around the island of Kauai!!!

what a great way to see kauai on my first day..it was simply breath taking. I would like to thank ellen ..dory and the pilot josh for making this trip memorable and being very accomodating.  Josh the pilot was very knowledgeable bout the island and i was very lucky because we had fabulous weather and the skies couldn't be any clearer that josh was able to fly to most parts of the island. As a bonus i even got to sit on the front seat. I was debating between this and the chopper ride and i'm glad i did this one. I'm sure that the chopper would have been a different experience but this was exciting enough for me. Highly recommended.

review_title: Wonderful way to see the Napali Coast!
review_text: Josh was very knowledgeable about the island.  The entire staff was very friendly.  We are definitely glad that we booked this trip.  The ride was smooth and the views were amazing.  This should not be missed!

C'est une expérience vraiment magique que nous a fait vivre Captain Bruce, qui a su contourner les nuages présents ce jour, et nous a commenté de façon très détaillée notre vol de 65 mn.
Cette entreprise familiale, (nous avons été accueillis par Mary, la fille de Bruce) respecte ses clients, et l'on ressent un vrai désir de partage, et de découverte de l'île de Kauai. 
Quant au choix de l'avion, plutôt que de l'hélicoptère, c'est à mon avis beaucoup moins bruyant et chaque passager à une très bonne vue près de la fenêtre, ce qui n'est pas le cas dans l'hélico....
Thank you so much Captain Bruce !!

review_title: Great way to finish a trip to Kauai
review_text: Can't add too much to what others have said. Bruce is very friendly, the ride was very smooth, and the sights were amazing.

Let me start by saying I was initially leery of taking this trip due to a fear of small planes.  It turned out to be the top highlight of our visit to Kauai.  From Ellen picking us up in the van, to Josh flying us around the island, we had a first class experience.  Josh's knowledge of the island and use of appropriate music enhanced our enjoyment of this excursion.  I heartily recommend Wings Over Kauai to everyone seeking a aerial view of this beautiful part of our 50th state.

This place doesn't not disappoint. They were very friendly, knowledgeable and courteous. I highly recommend doing this over the helicopter ride. It was a blast, the views were great and our tour guide was fun and upbeat. I highly recommend these guys as an air tour.

review_title: The best tour for our family
review_text: My family and I spent a great week on Kauai, and we finished our week with our air tour of Kauai.  After seeing the other reviews about Bruce and his team, I figured to call them. Let me stay by saying that doing an air tour with an airplane rather than a helicopter is, from what everyone tells me, a much smoother ride. What did it for my wife and I is that the cost of our air tour was HALF of what Blue Hawaiian Helicopters wanted for the same tour.  Call Bruce, schedule your tour, and you won't be dissapointed.

review_title: A wonderful and personal way to view Kauai
review_text: Taking a flight with Wings over Kauai is a wonderful way to see the beautiful and magnificently stunning island of Kauai. I was really pleasantly surprised by all the personal touches that Wings had included in their flight (from the warm and friendly greeting, to the really interesting information they had during the flight, and the lovely complimentary gifts they gave us) and I would highly recommend this if you are visiting this island. It is well worth the price. Thank you Bruce and Mary (and the rest of the gang) for offering this service and allowing me and many others to see this beautiful island that you live on :). Mahalo and Aloha!

review_title: Great air tour of Kauai, especially for pilots
review_text: My wife and I wanted to see Kauai from the air, and I wanted to get some flying time in while I was here. This was the best way to do both. We went up with Bruce in their Cessna 172 and got to see all of the sites including the Na Pali Coast and the Waimea Canyon. Bruce was a great pilot and guide, and gave us a unique perspective on the island with his agronomy background. Best of all, he let me do all of the flying and gave me some great tips on flying in the mountains. Highly recommended for pilots and non-pilots.

We vacationed on Kauai and wanted to tour the island, much of which is not accessible unless you go by water. I get sea sick easily and we did not want to go in a helicopter so we opted for an air tour via a fixed wing plane. We chose Wings Over Kauai and flew with Josh, our pilot. The trip was outstanding! We saw all parts of the island we wanted to see and it was narrated in great detail and with historical facts by Josh. He also played theme music timed to the points of interest...pretty cool. The views were incredible, as all passengers have window seats. Josh knows the terrain because he has hiked portions of it. It was well worth the reasonable cost and we also had the opportunity to purchase a full DVD of our trip filmed from the wings that includes all of our comments for a minimal cost. Lastly, before we took off, we spoke to Josh and any anxiety we had about flying a small aircraft was eliminated. Josh is a very experienced pilot and our entire flight was smooth and seemed effortless. This was one of the highlights of our vacation!

Nachdem wir die Rezensionen auf Tripadvisor gelesen haben, haben wir uns für diese Firma entschieden. Ursprünglich war ein Hubschrauberflug geplant. Wir haben es nicht bereut, im Gegenteil! Wir waren in einer Cessna zu zweit nur mit dem Piloten Bruce - er war sehr unterhaltsam, wir hatten tolle Ausblicke, und ein absolut sicheres Gefühl. Es war der tollste Ausflug während unserer dreiwöchigen Hawaii-Rundreise!

We visited Kauai for a few days in July/August from Australia.  Our travel agent suggested we take the helicopter tour but after reading the reviews we decided to go with Wings.  That was the best decision we made for our holiday in Hawaii.  The recent hurricane/tropical storm was around the area and Bruce (the owner/pilot) spoke to us individually prior to the trip and was very re-assuring.  He obviously has extensive experience and provides an entertaining and informative commentary during the trip.  The flight was smooth and all on board enjoyed it immensely.  As Bruce said, they are a mum and dad operation and rely on recommendations from their customers.  We have no hesitation in recommending Wings.  You will not regret it.

Bob and Ann

We took a 'Wings over Kauai' air tour today, which is half way through our trip to the island. Our family of four, including two teenagers, really enjoyed the experience and we were very well looked after by Bruce, our pilot. Bruce is very knowledgeable and personable - he engaged our teenagers in the discussion as he highlighted points of interest along the way. It's a family company, with Mary, Bruce's daughter, handling the pre-flight formalities - all very friendly and efficient. We had considered taking a helicopter tour, having taken one on Big Island last year to see the active volcano. We felt the tour by plane to see Kauai was a good choice as we really got the sense of the amazing scale of the landscape (with a shorter travel time from the airport). It also worked out as great value for money.

We really enjoyed our air tour from Wings over Kauai.  I highly recommend doing this.  It is one of the only ways to see this amazing island.  I was honestly apprehensive to take this tour as I became really sick the last time I flew in a small plane. I am so glad my husband talked me into it:) The flight was smooth and comfortable.  I felt great, not a hint of motion sickness. 

I can't think of anything that would improve this business. They thought of everything!  Starting from the warm welcome, which included a lei, flower & photo. The airplane was comfortable  and clean.  They had a cooler of water and sodas available during the flight. There were also blankets to keep us warm.  

Captain Josh was awesome.  He is an excellent, experience pilot who is also very knowledgeable about the island.  He is extremely patient--my son had like a million questions--he answered them all.  Thanks for a great experience!

review_title: Bruce is a great guide and flight instructure
review_text:
My wife and I took a tour today.
I am a private pilot and so Bruce let me take the left seat (pilot talk for pilot in command).
We taxied along with an Air Alaska 757 to the runway and were imidiately cleared for takeoff.

We took off with me at the controls, Bruce in the right seat and my wife in the back.

It was a wonderful flight with great instruction and sightseeing guidance from Bruce.
The views are incredible and for me the obvious plus was that I had the controls.

This familiy business makes things really special - there is even a surprize - but I am not telling.

We highly recommend this tour.  (Oh yes, bring your camera and make sure it is charged - ours ran out of juice.)

We got to see every part of Kauai. It was smooth and we had plenty of time to see all the sights.  The pilot educated us on history and geography of the area.  The personnel were very very friendly , courteous, and accommodating.  A highlight of the visit

We decided on the plane ride over the helicopter based on the reviews and we were not disappointed. Our pilot Josh explained the flight path before taking off and made it a point to get to know everybody on board. The views were breathtaking including the wettest area on Earth, waterfalls, places where movies have been filmed, towering cliffs, and the stunning Na Pali coastline. Throughout the flight Josh interacted with us while telling about the geological features and landmarks of Kauai. We appreciated him pointing out the different golf courses when he asked my husband about his hobbies. Josh told us about the public golf course and a miniature golf course located on the North Shore we're trying out today. We couldn't have had a better time.

review_title: Josh was great with our kids!
review_text: Not much to add-- as you can see this place gets great reviews!  Just wanted to add a note about Josh-- you will get him if you fly on a Saturday since it is Bruce's day off-- he is an American Airlines pilot (which made me feel very safe in such a small plane, especially since I was up front).  He was amazingly patient with our 5 year old.  She loved the headsets that we all wore and she decided to ask 100 questions so she could hear herself talk over the headsets.   She asked everything from "Is that a volcano?" to "How tall do the trees grow?" to "Are there sharks in Hawaii?"-- it was literally one question after the other.  Josh was super patient with her and actually answered most of her questions!  It was a great trip and we loved the experience!

Amazing tour of the island.  Very friendly and professional.  I felt safe and they constantly asked my sister how he was doing since she was nervous about flying.  Just know it is small plane so you will feel some turbulence.  I was find with it.  You will take some amazing pictures and at the end they give you a short video of your flight.  I highly recommend.

review_title: An amazing tour of this beautiful island!
review_text:
My wife and I recently selected to take a flight tour while here on our honeymoon, what an excellent experience we had!

Upon arrival we were recognized and warmly greeted by Tara and Bruce(our pilot) with hand picked flowers and a kukui nut lei. Great introductions and a good description of the upcomimg tour was appreciated.

I have flown in smaller planes before but my wife had not. No worries though! Our pilot Bruce, his comic wit and boundful knowledge was excellent at easing her down(she was even able todo some pre-flight checks!) 

The flight was beautiful, perfect path for great shots and Bruce kept things lively with his knowledge of the local flora and scenes from movies, not to mention he was very good at smoothing out the ride as much as possible.

Overall I would highly reccomend this as a "must do" for any trip to Kauai, from the warm welcome to the personal and professional tour it was defenitely a 5 star experience. All from a little family shop on this beautiful island.

Would do again? Yes.

Bruce was an excellent pilot and tour guide. It was very exciting. we got to see all of the beautiful parts of the island- even secret ones that aren't accessible otherwise! They are very friendly and answer all your questions. Not to be missed!

I booked this as a 50th birthday treat for my Husband, and we both enjoyed every minute. From being met at the ABC store (where our driver removed the WOK sign from the car, because it was a surprise for hubby) to the CD of highlights of the flight at the end, it was an absolute delight.

The island is truly beautiful and Josh, our pilot was well informed about the history and stories of the island. The 65 minute flight seemed to vanish much too soon, but we have many photos to remember it by. 

One of the highlights of our Hawaii visit!

Great experience. Wings over Kauai is a very professionally and friendly ran business. They were the best business we booked with. All the reviews are very accurate. This place picked us up at the airport, because we returned our rental car early, and from then on they made us feel very welcome. We pretty much met the entire staff, and everybody was very upbeat and positive. 

Its not too often you get to meet the owners of the company and converse with them like neighbors. It was such a refreshing feeling, after being on the island for over a week and getting cold shoulders with tour company's we just spent a lot of money on. Josh was our pilot and he is very experienced and knowledgable about the island. He is an airline pilot and does this job for fun! You can tell too, he is very passionate about Kauai and doesn't just go through the motions like many others do on the island. His attitude matches the company's reputation very well. Excellent pilot.

My wife was worried that we wouldn't get a great experience taking the airvan over a helicopter. We were both very satisfied at the end of the flight. The airvan is able to travel at very slow speeds and at altitudes great for sightseeing. The plane is very maneuverable and we were able to see all the nooks and crannies through the big windows! (clear skies helped too!) We never felt that our view was obstructed. It is a fantastic way to see the island and its a fraction of the price compared helicopters that frequent the air. 

Over all we were extremely impressed and very happy we spent the money. You will not be disappointed.

Wow!  What more can I say about this fabulous tour! My husband, two daughters (ages 9 and 13) and I took this tour on our last day of our Kauai vacation.  Talk about ending things with a bang!  We took the 4:00 tour (last flight of the day) on a day with a forecast of mostly cloudy, rain and wind gusts up to 23 mph.  After being on the islands (Maui and Kauai) for the past two weeks, we have finally learned to ignore the weather forecast.  We were a bit nervous, however, Ellen, Tara and our pilot Josh did a fabulous job of calming our nerves.  And it was so worth it!  There were only a couple of bumps, but nothing to worry about.  We did take one dramamine a few hours before the flight, not sure if this was needed at all, like I said, we were all fine, but you may want to take just in case you are also nervous.  No worries, you are in good hands. And the breathtaking views during our private tour were ... well...priceless!  The video, photo and free gift were all icing on the cake.  They emailed us pics that we received immediately before the flight was even complete.  We also met Bruce, the other owner and Ellen's other half.  What a lovely little find!  I have already uploaded our photos and they bring tears to my eyes.  We all wore Bose headphones and mics so we were able to communicate with each other and Josh, our pilot, during the entire flight.  We also listened to music which was very calming and relaxing. They also provided refreshments which was another nice touch.  Our daughters were so comfortable and took many pics as well.  My husband sat in the front next to Josh and served as copilot.  Can't say enough about this tour!  If you are on the fence, I say "Go for it!"

This my first flight with such a small plane, it is very smooth, not bumpy at all. My husband and I really enjoy it!  Thanks to Josh, he is very good pilot and guide. Also thanks to Dori for taking a really good picture for my family!

Whatever you do, don't miss this experience when visiting Kauai.  Our family of four were the only ones on the plane as we booked a private charter, so it was very personal and we got the best seats on the plane (right hand side).  Our pilot Josh was great, pointing out all sorts of things on the ground, telling some of the history of the island, even where some actors have bought holiday homes.  Flying over Waimea Canyon and along the Na Pali coast - words can't really describe how amazing the scenery is - you have to see it to get a feel of how amazing this island is.  The plane has several video cameras located on the wing etc, so at the end of the flight you have the option of buying a DVD of your full flight, which means you can enjoy the whole flight without worrying about getting the perfect shot or video.  The Kukui nut necklace gift before we boarded was a pleasant suprise as well.

My wife is not a good flyer, even on a 767, let alone a little Cessna or the like. There was no way I could get her on a helicopter tour, so the doors off experience wasn't going to happen. So I read to her very carefully, the reviews on the stability of WOK's Australian built plane, the safety etc, but she still wasn't having a bar of it. So I did what any good husband would, I booked it anyway.
So, one or two days prior, she began to go quiet and on the day of the flight, she couldn't even talk to our pilot, who was doing his best to appease her, but clearly failing. The only thing left was to just get her in the plane and do it. 
Well, the flight was faultless, hardly a bump, even when warned of certain areas that may cause a bit of turbulence. The scenery is spectacular, the commentary informative, with an open mic if you want to ask anything at all. 
I recommend you do this straight up, and then spend the rest of the time relaxing. We drove around a bit, hiked, but the view is unrivalled from the air. Don't miss this, as only 15 or 20% of Kauai is accessible by road. It is The best way to see the NaPali coastline. We hiked up the Kalalau trail from Ke'e Beach on a very calm day and watched as the Catamarans and Rafts bounced and bounced all the way down the coast. We were so glad we cancelled our plans to "sail" down the coastline. It looked liked a bumper car ride. And I really don't know how you could get the same perspective as from the air. A lot of bouncing to zip through a couple of sea caves I think. 
Plus, at the end, you can order a copy of your flight, recorded in 1080HD, complete with all your audio too, for $30. Great value. It costs about that for two digital photos off a Disneyland Ride doesn't it. And don't worry about the clouds. We went on a very cloudy day, which it always seems to be, but saw everything, but the top of the peak of course. Great value. Book it now.

After researching on the web and reading reviews on Trip Advisor we decided to book with Wings Over Kauai, and were very pleased with the decision. This was an excellent way to spend an afternoon. Ellen was easy to work with in setting up our reservations in advance. When we arrived, Tara was wonderful and put us at ease during our preflight check in. Then there was Bruce our pilot who was wonderful and really made the trip. He totally involved us in the flight even having me do the preflight checklist with him. His knowledge of the island and running commentary of what we were seeing as we flew over it really made the trip worthwhile. He even made circles so passengers on both side of the plane could easily see some of the more interesting sites more easily. Without a doubt this is a must do activity. Thank you Ellen, Bruce and Tara for making this a wonderful event during out stay in Kauai.

review_title: Amazing experience - not to be missed!
review_text:
My husband and I celebrated our 13th Anniversary with a flight over Kauai, and we're thrilled we chose "Wings Over Kauai."  

Bruce and the rest of the staff were incredible from the first email to our final goodbyes - they really made us feel like family!!  

When we arrived at their office, they were incredibly friendly, very professional, and their beautiful gifts were above and beyond what we expected (a gorgeous Koa nut necklace, a plumeria flower, and a complimentary video compilation of past flights with a beautiful picture of us in front of the plane on the cover).

We were thoroughly prepped for the flight (our first in a Cessna), and by the time we took off, we felt like we'd known Bruce for years.  As we soared over the Waimea Canyon, the Na Pali coast, and lush jungle scenery, he told us stories and information about Kauai that we would never have learned otherwise - and he exuded such genuine Aloha spirit.

It is obvious that all those who work at Wings Over Kauai are truly passionate about the gorgeous island on which they live as well as the joy of flying.   We'll never forget our flight over island, and we want to thank the team for making it so special.  Mahalo!!

My husband and I just got off the airplane after our flight over Kauai,  and I couldn't wait to write a glowing review!   From the aloha spirit of owners Bruce and Ellen (and Dori, too) to the exceptional professionalism and friendliness of our pilot Josh,  Wings Over Kauai was a once in a lifetime experience.   We saw the Napali coastline, Waimea Canyon the other typographic wonders.   We highly recommend Wings Over Kauai!

We knew before taking off that the island was a jewel. We also knew thanks to the reviews here we could not be wrong to book with Wings Over Kaui. We took a 4pm flight which will remain in our family's memories: gorgeous waterfalls, trees, sand beaches, river, clouds, canyon, lake, etc. ! A special thanks to Josh and Dori for their warm informal welcoming. Both of them are great professionals and the flight was first class. We highly recommend this flight, which also has the big advantage of being less bumpy than a chopper ride.

We have taken several helicopter tours in Kauai over the past several years on vacation.  I have to say that I was a bit unsure beforehand if a plane would be as good of an experience and worried about it being bumpy.   It was awesome and very smooth!  I would highly recommend it, we particularly loved being able to fly over the crater without cloud cover!  

Josh and Dory make a very personalized experience for each person on the flight.  I loved the little extras--the family picture, flowers, necklace, and gift at the end.  What a great value--we have already recommended the trip to people at our hotel!

Lisa, Jackson and I flew with Josh in early July.  We enjoyed every minute of the flight.  Josh provided us with a lot of valuable information and insight.  I have flown Harter's excellent helicopter tour but think this far better value with a similar experience.  Dori and Josh are great folks.

We went for a flight and absolutely loved our time with Bruce, who was super professional, informative and funny too. In the hour or so of flight time, we covered pretty much around the whole island and really got to see an amazing amount of the sights, many of which we couldn't have seen any other way. My wife and I took our five month old baby and they provided quality ear muffs for his protection (and no charge for the lap sitter).  The whole operation is small and family run and it's classy all the way...would most definitely recommend to anyone visiting Kauai!

Recently went on the Wings Over Kauai Air Tour which I would highly recommend as the icing on the cake for your trip to Kauai. Kauai is gorgeous and you simply cannot see all of the sights by car. The cost is very reasonable at $125 and you get a cute little picture as a souvenir. In addition, they give you a DVD of the experience-I'm not sure if that is an actual video of YOUR experience but it is everything that you will see on the trip. 
The pilot is extremely knowledgeable and able to tell you interesting tidbits that you would only get from one of the "natives".

Wir haben vor 18 Jahren einen Heli-Flug über Kauai gemacht. Nach einem sehr freundlichen und ehrlichen email-Kontakt mit Ellen, der Inhaberin, haben wir uns dieses Mal für Wings over Kauai entschieden, auch weil der Flug mit der Chessna um mehr als die Hälfte günstiger ist als mit einem Helikopter. Wir kommen gerade zurück und: es war fantastisch. Fam. Coulombe ist sehr freundlich, der Flug war sehr ruhig und wer empfindlich ist, braucht nichts zu befürchten. Man sieht wirklich alle Highlights der Insel. Unser Pilot Bruce war ein ausgezeichneter Gastgeber mit vielen Informationen zur Insel und z. B. zu Drehorten, die wir überflogen haben. Unsere Befürchtung war, dass derjenige, der "aussen" sitzt, weniger sieht. Das ist definitiv nicht so. Im Heli sitzen hinten 4 Personen nebeneinander, die in der Mitte sehen weitaus weniger. Jeder unserer Gruppe (5 Personen) hatte gute Sicht. Der Sprachkontakt im Flugzeug war sehr gut. Das Erlebnis ist unbeschreiblich. Wenn Ihr Kauai besucht, ist ein Flug mit Wings over Kauai ein absolutes Must-have!!! Wir sind völlig begeistert und wir würden jedesmal Wings over Kauai einem Heli-Flug vorziehen.
Mahalo Bruce, mahalo Allison and the rest of the Coulombe-Crew. Great experience! Fantastic service!

This was our 30th anniversary and we wanted to celebrate in style. We decided to try an air tour as we wanted first hand views of Kauai. Bruce was an amazing pilot and personal narrator on our tour. He made us feel special which you do not get with other companies. We were very impressed with not only the service we received but the affordability of the tour. We have amazing pictures to share with our family and friends and can't wait to come back and do it all over again!

review_title: The only way to see the island of Kauai
