review_text: I had heard so many great things about the island of Kauai, I wanted to see the whole island and not just a part of it. Researched the helicopter companies and all of them had basically a fixed route and you would be essentially a "passenger". As a pilot, I wanted to have more freedom and flexibility to see more of the island. The answer was Wings Over Kauai. Had the opportunity to fly with Bruce, the owner of Wings Over Kauai, in their Cessna 172 and it was an outstanding experience. For just a little more money than the cost of a "canned" helicopter flight, I was able to fly completely around the island and take the time to see more of the great sights. For the same rental price of the C172, you can bring a second person along as well. It was like having your own personal tour of the island by a local. The operation was safe and professional. I would fly with Bruce and Wings Over Kauai again in a heart beat. In fact, I am already planning another trip to Kauai!

We had booked a flight to celebrate my in-laws 50th wedding anniversary, and Ellen and John were very friendly from the get go. Josh, our pilot, was also congenial and offered an excellent narrative throughout our air tour. The views were remarkable, though Kauai is beautiful at any angle :) All that being said, be aware that the 6-seater plane is very cozy (read: I'm 5'3" and had no leg room) and could use a little sprucing up. Also, not all our headphones were in working order which made it difficult to ask questions of our guide as we flew over the various landscapes.

My boyfriend and I experienced more of Kaua'i during our hour with Bruce than in our four days on the island.  We took the Wings Over Kaua'i flight on our first day, so the overview gave us a good idea of how we wanted to spend our remaining time.

Pros follow:

*Private tour in a four-seater propeller plane (Bruce, the boyfriend, me)
*Boyfriend (as "co-pilot") ticked off pre-take-off checklist as we watched an American Airlines plane depart before us
*Bruce smoothly handled the plane, so we didn't experience any motion sickness
*As we circled the island, Bruce listed the places we could explore during our time on Kaua'i (e.g. Anini Beach, a lagoon like spot), which was materially more efficient than reading a travel guide 
*Views of waterfall after waterfall that are unaccessible except by air

This tour was really good value, and I appreciated the funds go to a mom-and-pop business operated by people passionate about Kaua'i.  Frankly, $125 per person is a steal, and I'd recommend this tour without reservation to any of my friends heading to the "Garden Island."

Just got back from Kauai - went on a 1 hour airplane tour over Kauai - very nice experience over the island of Kauai - pilot tells you the sites that you are going over; at the end of the tour, the owners hand you a cd of your experience - nice touch.  Only thing we did not like was that we had an appointment for 9:30 but did not board until a half hour later as they needed to prep the plane.  As we were with a tour guide, our time was precious so we were not happy with this delay.  My advice to Wings is to have your planes prepped before you book the times for your clients - have a more accurate boarding time.  Otherwise, nice experience if never been on an airplane ride.

review_title: This tour completed our Kauai vacation
review_text:
We went to Kauai on the 4th of July weekend for the first time. 
Sine most parts of the island are in accessible by car or even food. We decided on booking a flight to explore this paradise island from the air. 
The views from up there are just so amazing. 
We are glad that we choose Wings over Kauai for this tour. From the first contact at the booking through the arrival, the flight and till we left everyone was super friendly, helpful and made us feel welcome. 
Our whole family was super satisfied about the experience. 
It was great that we could take our 1 year old son on board as well, so no one had to stay behind. 
They even had small earmuffs for him. Just awesome. 
Bruce our caption gave us an excellent tour and never got tired explaining what we were seeing and answering questions. 
As soon as you have four adults in your group you get the whole airplane (that usually sits six) for yourself. So everyone was able to get a seat on the prime side. Just another small thing that for me makes Wings over Kauai so great. 
Highly recommended. 

Thanks Wings over Kauai for the great time.

We flew with Wings over Kauai today and it was awesome! The staff is very friendly and professional. Josh, "the captain" was giving lots of info during the flight and he was making you feel part of the crew! Highly recommended!

review_title: The best way to see the whole island! Do it!
review_text: You simply have to take to the air to see the whole island as only 20% can be seen from the land by car. The view is stunning as you fly over the island across the canyon and up past the Na Poli coast. Bruce was great with telling us stories as we enjoyed the view. I felt very safe and it was the smoothest landing ever. It's a small family business and they do everything to make your trip easy and enjoyable. We were collected by Ellen at the ABC Store by Kalipaki beach and driven to the airport. Dori checked us in and made us feel very relaxed. I was a little nervous about flying but I felt very safe with Bruce who has flown over the island over 5000 times! We couldn't have been in better hands. We were up in the air for just over an hour and then driven back to the Marriott hotel which Ellen told us to walk through to enjoy the gardens. Nice tip thank you! We went for this flight as so many reviews told us people fell ill in the helicopters. I'm so glad we did as it was a private tour for a fraction of the price. Well worth it. Enjoy.

We flew with Wings over Kauai in June 2013. As a family of 4 we had a private tour and everyone had a window seat (with our 16 year old son in the co-pilot seat)!  We were given headphones so we could communicate with each other too, We booked the flight about a month before our visit on NCL Pride of America. Reservation process was seamless with help from Ellen, Once at Kauai we were picked up by Ellen near the ship and driven to the airport for our flight. Once checked in by Dori, we went outside to see our plane. Our pilot, Josh, was a terrific as he pointed out several points of interest throughout the flight. The view of the Napali Coast was breathtaking and we saw several waterfalls as well. Josh also pointed out some locations that were used for movies such as Jurassic Park. The flight was about 65-70 minutes and very smooth compared to a helicopter ride that can be a little more bumpy, After the flight we were also given a DVD with our photo on the cover, We were also given the option to purchase a DVD that was from our personal flight. This was an amazing way to see Kauai and we would highly recommend this flight with Wings over Kauai. The cost is very reasonable for the experience we enjoyed. Aloha to the entire staff and Mahalo for a great morning in Kauai !!

We visited Kauai last week and flew with Wings Over Kauai Tours. It was a great time. We were met promptly at the ABC store in the Anchor shopping center (they give you directions and there is a free shuttle from the NCL Pride cruise ship). They drove us 5 minutes to the airport. We met the company dog Millie (you'll have to hear the heart warming story of how they rescued her). It was just the four of us flying so we could sit where ever we wanted. The trip lasted over 60 minutes, great trip, we saw everything on the island. It was a clear day too so we were very lucky and got to see the top of the highest mountain (it's usually covered in clouds).
We felt very safe with our pilot Josh.
I would highly recommend flying with them. Have fun.

From our first contact with Ellen, to the completion of our plane trip over the island with Bruce, we couldn't have asked for more!  Not being sure what time would give the best views, Ellen was quick with a response.  We booked well in advance and confirmed when we got on the island.  Upon arrival at the airport (very clear directions), we were warmly greeted and welcomed with a lei. Then we were weighed (for proper seat/weight distribution - very discretely done), and introduced to Bruce, our pilot. Before leaving the ground our picture was taken beside the plane. He took such care to make everyone feel at ease, and involved each of us in conversation during the flight.  His background in agronomy made for insightful commentary as he pointed out various points of interest and talked about the landscape as well.  Our time went quickly.  Upon landing we were given a DVD of the highlights of the typical flight over the island.  Money and time well spent! There are a number of helicopter and plane tours available, but Wings is very reasonable and educational.  Mahalo, Ellen and Bruce.

We had an amazing time on the tour! Both Josh and Dori went out of their way to get to know us as guests vs. paying customers. They provided beverages and at the end gave a cd with pictures from our flight, they were extremely accommodating. The narration was great (music too!) Josh told us great history and information about the island. I cannot express how wonderful they are, their dog (in the office) too! Highly recommended!

My wife and I had taken a helicopter ride around Kauai many years ago and although the scenery was beautiful it was a very bumpy and sometimes scary ride. We recently went back with our 5 and 11 year old boys and decided to see the island by airplane. The check in was seamless(all must step on a scale to record weights for the small Cessna so women beware!). Bruce the pilot was great with the kids and gave a smooth ride with lots of interesting facts about the island.He has a great sense of humor but did not try to ruin the trip with excess talking-sometimes it is just nice to soak in the view. It is also much cheaper than a helicopter ride!

Mahalo "Wings over Kauai" team, Cap'n Josh, Dori, Ellen and Bruce, for making the end of our Hawaiian adventure a highlight. The flight was fantastic with Josh providing lots of interesting snippets to add to the breathtaking scenery. My Mum and I totally enjoyed the experience and would definitely recommend this flight as a 'must do' in Kauai.

Bruce and his daughter were great. The tour was exciting and had great views of the island. I'm so glad we didn't pay over $300 for the helicopter tour.  I highly recommend this tour and the Na Pali Experience to get the the best of both land and sea on Kauai.

We ended our Cruise with a plane ride over Kauai.   This was  Amazing.  Everyone was amazing and our tour guide Josh was just wonderful.  Very informative.  I was a little nervous about flying in a smaller plane but the take off and landing were so smooth as was our time in the air.  We had to plane to ourselves and we had a great time.  I would recommend Wings over Kauai to Everyone.

review_title: You need to see the island from the air
review_text:
Much of Kauai is very difficult to reach and you see much more from the air.  We went with the airplane instead of the helicopter because it also included a number of land adventures that we were wanting include for about the same price.  This was the first air tour we had been on and really didn't know what to expect.  We were a little disappointed that we didn't get closer to the Napoli coast or deeper into the canyon (like I have seen pictures of) but my understanding is that we since we came in the winter the winds were much greater.  My disappointment was that we couldn't take pictures; we bought the DVD instead, but wasn't the same.  They were very nice and did a group picture in front of the plane before lift off and emailed to us.

Note:  We weren't told this until after we booked the tour (booked before we went to Hawaii) that the air tour depends on the weather (duh) but often the mists cover up a lot of the topography.  This wasn't the case for us and we didn't even have rain, but be forewarned. We booked early in the trip in case we had to reschedule.

We were going to book a helicopter tour as we we done that in Maui but definitely glad we choose Wings Over Kauai as this was an amazing experience and at a fraction of the cost! We were on our honeymoon and the staff were just great, from the moment we got collected outside the ABC Store to the check in process which was quick and easy. The pilot was great and had a lot of knowledge of the area; we had our very own private tour on a Cessna which is a smaller aircraft but perfect for the occasion, we would definitely recommend to use this service as you will not be disappointed. Helpful and friendly staff!

We would definitely use again if we are ever back in Kauai.

Thanks for an amazing experience.

Ash & Becs

review_title: If you do one excursion in Kauai, this should be it!!
review_text:
Our family had a wonderful time on this flight tour - and it was the highlight of our time in Kauai.  My husband and I flew with our two boys 9 and 14 and it was perfect for all of us and we got the whole plane to ourselves.  My youngest got seasick the day before on a boat tour, but was totally fine on the entire flight, so no need to worry about motion sickness on a small plane (or maybe we just had little turbulence to deal with!). 

Josh was a fantastic pilot and made the trip relaxing and interesting, engaging each of us throughout the flight through the noise canceling headsets, talking about the various sites on the island, things to do and asking the kids questions.  My oldest is interesting in flying, so he was great about answering questions about the plane and the basics of piloting too!

This family run business is well worth supporting - and they go out of their way to make the trip fun and unique for you.  It's half the cost of a helicopter tour, way more relaxing, you get to see the same parts of the island (not as close up, but that was more than fine for us) and it didn't at all feel like a tourist trap, by any means.

If you decide to do one thing during your time here, this should be it!

OMG what amazing scenery. We chose this tour over a helicopter trip, mainly on price. The flight far exceeded our expectations, right from the time you arrive at the airport. Pilot Josh was very professional and informative, The plane had large windows and everyone had a window seat on our trip. We loved the takeoff. This is a great way to see the island, we would recommend Wings over Kauai to anyone.

Wonderful experience!  Our trip was at the beginning of June.  We originally scheduled for the morning fly, but the weather wasn't good.  But they were very patient and professional in explaining to us about the conditions and willing to move the schedule back until the weather clears.  We finally had it around noon time.  They provide free drinks and ginger-candies, too, and also free photos and CD!  And of course, the view of Kauai was beautiful!  Thanks Ellen and Bruce!

My family and I had a great time on this air tour around Kauai.  The views were unbelievable.  Dori and Josh were GREAT too!  Dori checked us in, talked to us a little bit about the course our plane would be taking, and she took a few family photos of us in front of the plane prior to take off.  Dori also offered us complementary beverages and ginger snacks in case anyone got nausea during the tour (which none of us did).  Josh was an excellent pilot, and he was very knowledgeable about the island.  Probably the best landing I have ever had in a plane too!  Definitely the best tour and the price was great!  These air tours are much more affordable and environmentally friendly because the planes use less fuel than typical helicopters use.  Once the tour was over we meet with Dori again and she gave us a 10 minute DVD highlighting the sights we saw on our trip with one of our family photos on the front of the cover.  Overall had a great time and would do the tour again in a heartbeat.  Ohh and we also loved meeting Milly!!!

WOW, WOW, WOW, WOW... the phrase I kept repeating as one beautiful view after another unfolded!  Our Wings Over Kauai Air tour was just amazing!  Dori and John were soo friendly and helpful.  We have visited the island three times and this is by far the best tour we have experienced!  I can't wait to do it again on our next visit!

review_title: The Greatest experience in Hawaii (반드시 가보세요)
review_text:
여기에 한글로 리뷰를 남기는 이유는 더 많은 한국 사람들이 카우아이에 들렸을때

이곳을 통해서 멋진 카우아이 섬을 둘러볼 기회를 더 많이 갖길 바라기 때문입니다.

비행기로 둘러볼 생각 이라면 그냥 고민 하지 말고 Wings Over Kauai Air Tours 이용 하세요

브루스와 엘렌은 전화로 예약 할 때부터 우리의 한국 이름을 불러주고 기억하려고 애썼습니다.

당일날 찾아가니, 동양인의 모습을 보고 이름을 기억하며 저희를 불러 주더라구요.

우선 이런 모습에 너무 감동을 받았고, 저희가 운이 좋은지 조그마한 비행기로

브루스와 저희 커플 둘 이렇게 셋이 비행을 떠났습니다.(가격은 똑같았습니다)

완전 Private Tour 였고, 비행기 안에서는 3 Channel Boss 헤드폰셋을 통해(노이즈 캔슬링)

소음없이 우리 셋만의 대화를 생생히 할 수 있었고, 이륙하기전 체크 하는 것들 List를 주면서

저희가 파일럿인 부루스에게 얘기(지시)하고, 부르스는 체크(오일 온도, 바람 등)하고

마치 파일럿이 된 듯한 기분 이였습니다.

비행 내내 부루스는 친절히 섬 곳곳을 설명해 줬고, 그 멋진 모습이 아직도 눈에 선합니다.

이륙전에 비행기와 함께 사진도 찍어주고, 이메일로 그 사진도 보내주고

비행 후엔 자기들이 담은 영상물 DVD를 무료로 주고 간직 하라고 하고

정말 너무나 멋진 경험 이였습니다.

꼭 찾아가시고, 소중한 경험 저희처럼 만드시길 바랍니다.

Wings Over Kauai Air Tour was amazing!!!  Seeing Kauai by air is a whole new experience.  You see so much more than you can on land.  Bruce was our captain and he was great!! He made me feel at easy when he said he'd done this trip over 5,000 times!! (I think that was the number).  The trip was very smooth.  I got to be the "co-captain" and sit in the front, while my husband sat in the back to take pictures.  It was just the two of us on the tour.  So glad we got to experience this tour on our honeymoon.  Wish we could do it again.

Captain Bruce & his wife Ellen are super sweet & knowledgeable people.  The right side of the plane does have the best views as all tour companies tour with the right side of the plane toward the island & left side is ocean.  My family was a party of 5 & all of us had great views.  We got amazing pictures which we would have never gotten by driving alone.  Captain Bruce made the flight personal to each of us by addressing us continually by our first names.  He pointed out all the tourist hotspots, movies & TV shows filmed & famous peoples homes around the island.  We saw so many gorgeous waterfalls we lost count.  Ellen packed a small cooler full of drinks & life savers & ginger chews.  We could not have had a better time.  I hope your family chooses Wings Over Kauai Air Tours as it was our families' highlight of Kauai.

Dieser Flug wird unvergessen bleiben und bietet einen hervorragenden Blick auf die besten Highlights der Insel. Der Flug dauert 65min. und ist kein typischer Helikopter-Flug, da Wings over Kauai eine kleine Cessna benutzt. Die Mitarbeiter sind unheimlich freundlichen und zuvorkommend. Kann ich nur empfehlen und würde ich jeder Zeit wieder machen, wenn ich auf der Insel bin.

review_title: So much better than a chopper!
review_text:
Honestly, I don't really review things. Time is precious and with all the great reviews what could I possibly add? They're all true. But let me say this; I went back and forth a lot about plane vs. helicopter for hubby and I to get some great photography of Na Pali. This was definitely the right choice. Reasons?
a) PERSONAL  - a friendly and helpful pilot - I felt like I had personally chartered a plane under my command. :-) Bruce thought he was in charge, but no. (just kidding new-friend Bruce)
b) GREAT PHOTO SET UP - on the Cessna, the window opens so you can get a glare free shot. (the new hairdo is no charge. :-0)
c) VIEW - it's really a gorgeous experience with some of the most striking scenery on the planet earth
d) VALUE- price is unbeatable, easily worth more than what they ask for
e) TOUR - pilot talks about just the right amount of island features in a great conversational style 
f) RIDE - This was a very stable and comfortable ride. And sorry to be gross, but over the week in Kauai, I heard multiple times about people, or random people you had to ride with, losing their cookies in the helicopters because it's a more fluid and turbulent experience. Just know they definitely leave that detail out of the shiny helicopter brochure.

I don't know the best way to explain this experience - awesome, breathtaking, stunning. These words don't do justice to this tour and the wonderful people behind it.
This is a MUST DO tour and should be on top of anyone's bucket list.

I flew from Honolulu (Oahu) to Kauai just for this tour, and then flew back again that night.
When arranging your flights onto the island, allow 10 minutes walk (or shuttle) from the domestic terminal down to the Wings Over Kauai terminal, and 30 minutes check-in time for the actual flight.

The company is a small family business but is extremely professional in every aspect of the tour with wonderful ground staff and experienced knowledgeable pilots.

We did this flight in the morning and the scenery was breathtaking! I have been in helicopters before but this was a small plane and it is much more smoother and quieter. The pilot was great and I was the co-pilot, however he did not let me land the plane, lol. The staff was great, picked us up near the cruise ship. Highly recommend this, better than a helicopter and less expensive also.
One of the best things to do in Kauai.  Worth the money.  Pilot was amazing.  Made sure everyone got a view of everything, even went off the usual path because clouds opened up for better views.
Great customer service, exceptional value... you won't be disappointed!  This was one of the best experiences we had while visiting Kauai.  I would book again without hestitation.

review_title: Einer der schönsten Momente meines Lebens
review_text:
Wie immer vor einer Reise habe ich viel recherchiert. Zuerst wollte ich eigentlich einen Helikopter-Rundflug buchen. Dann bin ich auf Wings over Kauai gestoßen.

Ich nahm Kontakt auf, und Ellen, die Geschäftsführerin, hat mir sofort geantwortet, mir in mehreren Mails meine Fragen beantwortet und mir Tips gegeben,
Wir haben den Rundflug um 11:00 gebucht.
Und was soll ich sagen... Es war so traumhaft schön.
Josh, unser Pilot, hat uns während des Fluges alles genau erklärt, hat Fragen beantwortet und es war richtig lustig mit ihm.
Kaua´i von oben zu sehen, war eines der schönsten Dinge, die mir in meinem Leben passiert sind, und ich habe schon so einiges von der Welt gesehen.

Deswegen: Wenn einen Rundflug auf Kaua´i (und das sollte man machen), dann nur mit Wings over Kaua´i!

review_title: Great way to see the island!
review_text: We had a fabulous time on this tour. Everyone was so friendly and informative. We wanted to see the whole island but didn't want to spend a whole day at sea...this was perfect. The tour is just over an hour and we didn't feel like we missed anything. We definitely recommend it!

After reviewing a number of air charters, we chose Wings Over Kauai based primarily on the Number 1 rating here at TA, plus the excellent reviews from previous customers. It is also cheaper - by half, at least - than a helicopter tour (for the same 60-75 minute tour), and if you are eco-minded, apparently the fixed-wing aircraft of Wings uses much less fuel than a copter. Though it seems that all the companies offering air tours have terrific safety records, it is also my belief that fixed-wing aircraft are generally safer than helicopters. We are joining with all those who have given Wings an excellent rating with no hesitation, and provide our recommendation with great enthusiasm! 
From the moment we arrived at the airport, we were made to feel welcome and at ease, should we have had any anxiety. We conversed with the receptionist, who was the owner's daughter, and she was terrific. She handled the few administrative details with efficiency and again, made us feel extremely comfortable. She also took our photo before we boarded the plane, which was much appreciated.
Our flight had another couple, and all four of us had window seats (all the seats are window seats, but based on the flight of the aircraft, it appears that you may have better views of things by being seated on the right side of the airplane, as we all were able/instructed to do). Water and soda was available if you wanted it, as well as some remedies for motion sickness, if the need arose (my wife actually felt a little queasy during a portion of the flight and took one of the lozenges provided, which made her feel fine almost immediately).
I have flown in helicopters several times (all for work) and never in a small plane, so I was anxious to compare the distinctions between the experiences. I was immediately struck by the smoothness and quality of the flight, even in some mild turbulence. Our pilot was extremely knowledgeable and friendly, and something about his manner in the airplane exuded confidence (which is important in a pilot!). 
The views from the airplane were simply amazing. The mountains, beaches, canyons, waterfalls, and caves were astounding in their beauty and ruggedness. The view of developed properties (e.g., golf courses, plantations, hotels/resorts) was also outstanding. The flight path covered nearly the whole island (I am not sure why about 1/4 [-less? Generally, from east of Princeville to Lihue] of the island is not on the tour) and flew over all the spots you would care to see. Be prepared to take many, many photos, of course (One slight negative regarding this concerns the fact that you are taking your pictures out of a window - the views you get through the window are amazing, but some photos are subject to get a little glare - not the fault of Wings; just be aware of this).
Once we landed, we were given a copy of a DVD which highlighted the views we experienced during the flight (these are "stock" clips, but still provide a nice memento of the trip - the cover of the DVD is one of the photos taken of you before you board the plane). Later that evening, the owners contacted us via email to thank us and encourage our review on TA (a nice touch!).
We met another couple at a luau a couple days later who had flown with Wings a day after we did. They flew when there was much more rain in the mountains, so they shared how the pilot stated they were seeing more waterfalls than were present in the days beforehand. I mention this to say that I don't think weather will likely stop your flight (this is up to Wings, but I think it likely that you will encounter rain at some point during the flight - this was no problem and didn't really diminish the quality of photos that we took).
It seems that all the travel folks recommend seeing Kauai by air during your visit. I think this is a valid recommendation, and I can say with no reluctance that you will not be disappointed by booking with Wings Over Kauai.

This was one of te best things I have done on Kauai. The cost was one half of ahelicopter and the views were just as good. We were treated very well. The oilot was very good and the office lady was friendly and a as a couple they just fit well. The flight was over 1 hour. The views were awesum. The pilot was on with good commentary and backround on sites, movies, and the beauty of KauaiWe had driven all over the islad and seen all we could via car. This top view was greate. DVD after the flight was a nice touch it was a short stock of the high spots that we saw. Very good.
パイロットを含め6人乗りのセスナで、家族5人（4歳児1人含）が貸切で楽しめました。パイロットのジョシュさんも受付のドーリさんもとてもフレンドリーな人達で、安心してお任せできました。家族みんなの評判も良く、またカウアイに来たら再度乗りたい程気に入ったようです。ヘリコプターよりお勧めかも。

This was our first time to Kauai, and we had only just stepped off 'The Pride of America' cruise ship and hired a car to go to the airport. Easy to find and plenty of parking at 'Wings Over Kauai' 
We had our 'weigh in' (thought it would be more embarrassing after the buffets on the cruise ship) and safety briefing (and met Millie, the rescued 'favorite pet' of Josh and Ellen) and were away right on time.

Our pilot (Josh)was very cheerful and really knew his stuff, the equipment was really good and the plane ride was awesome, we saw this beautiful island from an amazing perspective!

If you want to see this beautiful place with a professional outfit and come away with amazing memories, then do not hesitate to do this, and take your camera!

I read about Wings Over Kauai on trip advisor. Based on the glowing reviews, I reserved a tour. We were on an Hawaiian cruise. Although we rented a car in port, we found that we  really did not need one. We could have taken a shuttle to the ABC store, and Wings would have picked us up! As it was, we drove to the airport for our flight. The airport was a little confusing. Once we arrived at the flight office, we were greeted by such friendly people. The flight exceeded our expectations. The plane was very small, that day we had 3 passengers plus the pilot. Every passenger had their own window. The flight was 65 minutes long. Each passenger wore a head set, so all could communicate. The pilot was excellent at narration, very interesting, but also knew when to just be quiet and let us take in the beauty of this experience. I was blown away by the views. You have to see it for yourself to understand. After the flight, they gave us a video of the flight, and emailed pics they had taken of us to our inbox. This was the best experience.  At $125 per person for a 65 minute flight, I felt this was well worth the money

review_title: Great Way to Start the Week!
review_text: Bruce took my wife and I on a private trip around the island. For $250 we had the plane to ourselves and we enjoyed every minute of it. He was informative but not overly so, and knew when to just keep quiet and let the awesome scenery speak for itself. The operation is a small family run business, and they are all down to earth and personable. We wholeheartedly recommend Wings Over Kauai. Thanks, guys!

We booked our flight in advance and talked to Ellen who was most pleasant on the phone when taking our information.  When we arrived at the office, we were greeted by Bruce, by name and introduced to the family.  The airport was sunny, however when we flew towards Mt Waiʻaleʻale the rains let loose.  It didn't dampen our spirits and I was able to get some dramatic photos of the clouds touching the peaks and filled waterfalls. Captain Josh knew the best vantage points to get great views.  As we continued toward the Na' Pali coast the skies lighten for more dramatic views contrasting the light and dark of the distant clouds.  Captain Josh gave a nice description and fun facts of what we were seeing too.  Thanks for great flight!

Wings over Kauai really made our first trip to Kauai very special.  My husband and I decided that instead of a boat ride to the Napali coast we would take a small plane.  We were not disappointed.  The trip from beginning to end was wonderful.  The pictures we took are really breathtaking.  Not only do we have our pictures of the trip, but Wings over Kauai gave us a CD of the entire trip.  Josh and Dori and their dog Millie were just the best!!

review_title: Der beste Weg die Insel zu erkunden
review_text:
Wir waren im Mai 2013 auf Kauai und haben den 65 minütigen Rundflug mit Josh gemacht, was ne Entscheidung war! Der Service vom "Check-in" über die sehr persönliche Betreuung bis hin zum Rundflug selbst waren spitze!
Alles machte einen sehr sicheren und kompetenten Eindruck und alle Mitarbeiter waren super motiviert und nett.
Also absolut sein Geld wert ein Muss wenn man auf Kauai ist!

Wir hatten am 14. Mai 2013 das Vergnügen von Bruce über die Insel geflogen zu werden. Das Wetter und die Sicht waren perfekt, ebenso wie der Service von Ellen. Natürlich ist man bei Bruce als Pilot sicher aufgehoben, denn er schafft es auch ängstliche Teilnehmer zu beruhigen und Flug zum Erlebnis werden zu lassen. Alle Teilnehmer (bis zu 6) werden über ein Intercom System miteinander verbunden und können nicht nur Bruce zuhören sondern sich mit ihm oder untereinander verständigen. Vor lauter Staunen steht der Mund allerdings meist offen und zum Reden bleibt da kaum Gelegenheit. Wer also einmalige Landschaften und dabei Drehorte von Jurassic Park, Descendants oder Fluch der Karibik sehen möchte ist bei "Wings over Kauai" genau richtig. Man spürt bei Ellen und Bruce die Passion, mit der sie bei der Sache sind. Zum Abschied gab´s noch eine Video DVD vom Flug! Mahalo, Ellen und Bruce!

We decided to book with Wings over Kauai after reading the great reviews on trip advisor. So glad that we did! We were picked up nearby to our cruise ship by the lovely Ellen, and taken to the nearby airport where we met Bruce, Dori and Josh (our pilot). We were absolutely overwhelmed by the spectacular views that we were treated to during what was a most pleasant and relaxing flight. The commentary and dramatic but oh-so-fitting music playlist was perfect and very informative. A fly-over really is the ONLY way to really see the beautiful island of Kauai! We have, and will continue to recommend this to everyone we know! The memories and photos that we have brought home are just wonderful!

For our afternoon Grand Deluxe Tour, Dori checked us in and prepared us for boarding.  Josh was our pilot and guide.  They are, quite simply, some of the nicest people you will ever meet.  From beginning to end, no detail was forgotten in providing a comfortable and memorable experience.  The airplane is clean, comfortable, and everyone has a window seat with a large window for taking photos.  The Bose headsets are lightweight and easy to use, with clarity of sound.  On the plane, there's a supply of water, peppermints and ginger, and an "aloha bag" (in the event of airsickness).  However, Josh's expert piloting skills ensured us a smooth and easy ride and no one on our tour needed it.  

The approximately 1 hour tour gave us a spectacular aerial view of the coastline and familiar sites of Kauai, including, among others, the Waimea Canyon, the Na Pali Coast, waterfalls, and a number of film locations.  On our tour, we also happened upon multiple rainbows from the air, including an almost 360 degree rainbow - quite the sight to see.  Josh provided friendly, informative, and interactive commentary that also catered to our individual interests.  At the end of the tour, we received complimentary photos that Dori had taken of us alongside the plane.

This tour is outstanding and great value.  We highly recommend it.

Wings over kauai, It has small office but it gave me a big big big impression. If you plan to flight tour at kauai island you'd better keep in mind that it is much economic and safe. Mr. Coulombe, the owner and pilot, was in charged of our flight tour. He was kindest pilot ever and he told us lot of informations about flight and the Kauai's features. 
He has privileged to approach hidden place too. Of course it has magical view and i felt like i was in primitive age but you should know that you can not see if you choose other company or helicopter tour..
Although the weather condition was not perfect (clody), it was enough to impressed by mountains and Na pali coast. Do not hesitate to go or not to go, even if the cloudy day.
If you look down the Na pali coast inside the airplane, you will know why..
Can you imagine how it was good?? it was the best!!
And the flight tour make this korean write down the review even i've got bad grammer skill..
I cried inside..

thanks..
Hae Joo Wi.

review_title: Must see at the beginning of your trip
review_text:
Josh and the girl at the desk are super friendly and making you feel taken care of us. They gave us a local neckles and dvd for free.
Josh was our pilot and he did great job explaining what's cool about Kauai as well as interesting history info about the island. 
Take the tour at the beginning of your trip as you will get a better idea of you should see while visiting Kauai.
Price is great and right seats are a must for good views.

We cannot say enough on what a wonderful time we had flying with "Wings Over Kauai" The staff was so friendly, Josh our pilot, was a fantastic guide in the air and an amazing pilot. Pointing out all the wonders of the island. The only way to see the many wonders of the island. This is something everyone that visits Kauai must do. From our pick up in town to our return all of our time was relaxing, informal, and fun. We received photos of our experience sent to out email, a video DVD, and brought home memories that only Wings Over Kauai could provide. Thanks to a wonderful experience.

What a wonderful morning we had  on Thursday. Everything turned out to perfection.
Bruce and Ellen and Josh and dori are, without a doubt,  the most amazing people
To deal with. Bruce was our pilot and  gave us the most amazing tour of this beautiful 
Paradise that only God could have created. Bruce gave a very descriptive rendering of
The many gorgeous sights that  are distinctly  Kauai.

Okay, so you already expect the scenery is going go be gorgeous from any aircraft, from any company.  Wow, it did not disappoint!  Breathtaking!  What impressed us, though, was that every detail, every perfect touch, was put into Wings over Kauai"s tour that they took us on. From how very friendly they were , pictures they took and emailed to us that same day, water and ginger candy pieces on the plane in case anyone needed it to the complimentary CD with our picture on the front!  They were informative and showed us so much in the air.  I think what impressed me the most, as a mom of an 11 year old, was that they were very discreet when they showed us the obligatory way to get out of the plane if needed and where life preserves were..  It was a very quick, light, and tactful conversation that did not raise our daughter's anxiousness  a bit.  I appreciated that!  From beginning to end, it couldn't have been more perfect!  We weren't sure how much to tip, but I had read 10 to 15 percent. Doublecheck that before you go.  They are worth it!

Wenn ihr etwas auf Kauai machen solltet, dann einen Flug mit Wings over Kauai. Für den Preis ein echtes Schnäppchen. Die ganzen Helitouren sind viel viel teurer. Wir hatten erst etwas Angst, dass wir nicht so tief wie die Helis fliegen und nicht so gut sehen können, dies hat sich jedoch in keinster Weise bestätigt. Tolle Sicht über ein wahres Paradies. Josh, der Pilot, hat sehr viel erklärt. Das ganze Team war sehr familiär und super nett. Wir wurden sogar an unserem Kreuzfahrthafen abgeholt und wieder zurückgebracht. Wir haben auf vielen Reisen schon viel erlebt, aber dieser Flug war ein absoluter Höhepunkt. VIelen vielen Dank an das Team für diesen tollen Tag!!

My husband is 6'4 and weighs a bit over 270 (just a big guy) and we struggled to find a helicopter that wouldn't charge us for an extra seat for him. I can understand if they were doing it for safety reasons, but when we asked the reason cited was for "his comfort".  We have taken a helicopter tour/ride before in Fiji and his size was not an issue , so were a bit annoyed at the extra seat charge.  Then we called Wings over Kauai and were thankful we didn't do a helicopter ride anyway. The small plane was awesome! We had Josh as our pilot and he gave us a great tour of the island. You really have to see the island from the air before you leave. It gives you an an entirely different view of the beauty of Kauai. We are a bit jealous of the job that these pilots get to do..it must be a dream come true to be in the air everyday looking at this amazing island. Truly great customer service...and extremely inexpensive! We highly recommend this company for your flight over Kauai.

My wife and I did this trip as part of a cruise.
   This company was easy to deal with as well as being efficient in responding to my e-mails.
They picked us up at the A.B.C. store at the Anchor Mall in Nawillwili. Our trip was on the 7th May.
    Our pilot was Josh, very knowlegable and informative.
It was 65mins of amazing views and everchanging breathaking scenery. Even though we had radio mikes I found it hard to utter a word. I was struck dumb by what I was seeing.
  Presented with a D.V.D. of the trip afterwards and we plan to sit down and watch it tonight now we are back in the U.K.
   This is well run operation, efficient, friendly and proffesional.
   Highly reccommended,
     AuroraUK

review_title: Perfect, if not for the mixup.
review_text:
We really enjoyed our flight with Cap'n Josh. He was a very nice guy, and great guide. We Had nice weather and the flight was relaxing and informative. The music that played on the Bose headphones was synchronized to the view with music from Jurassic Park to Raiders of the lost Arch. Josh answered all of our questions and knew lots about the island. 
The negative was that we were given the wrong day for our reservation and they transcribed our phone # wrong. We called on the way to say we were stuck in traffic in kapaa [be sure to use the bypass around kapaa every time you are traveling south] and was told that a mistake was made and that they couldn't contact us to reschedule. We rescheduled and was given 20 percent off. We didn't get too mad because they were very honest about the mistake and it is just hard to stay made in paradise. That said, we would do this tour again, but make sure to do it online.

review_title: This is the best way to see this beautiful island !!!
review_text:
When I booked a cruise from New Zealand to Vancouver  I started looking for small individual tours and activities rather than the Cruise company tours . One of our stops in April 2013 was Nawiliwili on the island of Kauai , Hawaii . Checking out Tripadvisor what the possibilities were on the top of the list was  " Wings over Kauwai " with an almost perfect record and feedbacks . I started emailing and asking questions about availabilityy and price , and got very fast and friendly responses from Ellen the owner together with Bruce . I placed my find on cruise critic and within a couple of days found five other passenger willing to share this flight . 
We were picked up by Ellen and processed at the airport by Captain Josh and his wife Dori , got our places on the plane after our weigh-in and soon took off after Josh had strapped us in and gave us our headsets so we could communicate with Josh , each other and it would dampen the sound of the engine . The flight was fantastic , what a way to see this beautiful island and go to places where no car could go for there are no roads in these most beautiful spots . Commentary by Josh was fantastic , he involved all of us in his talks and we were encouraged to asked questions . The weather was clear for the most part , we saw the coffee plantation flew through the Waimea Canyon , to the Na Pali Coast where we saw a few whales breaching the Ocean and Josh made a couple of circles around them so everybody was able to see this . The little more than an hour flight went so fast and once back at the airport we received each a picture with the plane and a DVD with the highlights of the flight . 
Compared to other flights at different locations in the world the price is extremely reasonable  and the little extras and personal touches by every one in this company were much appreciated by all . 

This is the BEST and ONLY way to see this beautiful place . We will long remember this . Thank you Josh , Dori and Ellen .

This was the highlight of our vacation. From the moment we checked in at the airport, to the moment we landed, Josh and Dori took care of us. The day we flew it was pretty cloudy so Josh was up front and honest with us that we may not get the best views and offer if we would like to reschedule. We took the chance and had the flight of our lives, especially for the price we paid. During the flight, Josh was very informative about Kauai and made the flight very enjoyable. We will definitely this flight as the highlight of our vacation to Kauai. Also recommend to anyone who is staying in Kauai to book a flight with this company.

review_title: A MUST do while in Kauai!
review_text:
This is a MUST do while in Kauai!!! It was our first trip to Kauai and this was a great way to check out the whole island. We did the plane trip at the end of our trip and Josh (our amazing pilot) showed us all the spots that we had hiked and traveled too! It was so cool to see them from the air. I get motion sickness so we passed on the helicopter and booked with "Wings over Kauai". I didn't even get sick one bit! Plus Josh kept the flight nice and smooth and I give him an A+ for his landing. Nothing like the landing I experienced in Costa Rica. My husband was the co-pilot and they sat us all on the right side so everyone had amazing views! Josh was very informative and answered all our questions along with his wife Dori. You even get a free dvd! Yes, I said "FREE" .  We will definitely recommend this tour to others. Not to mention they have a great dog named "Milly" who was absolutely adorable!! 

Mahalo, 

Lali & Robert

Our airplane tour was a great experience. I definitely recommend it for anyone who is looking for an air tour of Kauai. The ground staff and our pilot were very friendly and hospitable, they take an interest in making sure that your personal experience with them is the best possible. Views from every seat are optimal!

I dare to say that Wings Over Kauai is the best. Having flown in an uncomfortable helicopter in Maui, I experienced a most friendly and well narrated flight with Wings Over Kauai. Both Captain Josh  and Dori are one great team who looks  after their customers with respect and dignity. Highly recommended. Five Stars!

This was definitely the highlight of our trip to Kauai. The majority of the island is not navigable by land, so your only option is a boat tour or air tour. We didn't go on a boat tour, but I don't know if anything else could have compared to this. 

First off, the couple who runs this place is extremely nice. We had a reservation for an afternoon tour, got there, and they said that due to weather conditions, they could bring us on a short tour, but we wouldn't be able to see most of the island because the clouds were so low, so they let us reschedule and let us know that if things weren't better, they'd give us a call so we wouldn't have to make the trip out. 

The day of the tour, thankfully, was nice just when we were ready to go out and the views are seriously breathtaking.

Scared of getting into such a small plan? I kind of was. The pilot is also an American airlines pilot, and the flight was incredibly smooth. The take off and landing in the small plan were really fun, and the ride was pretty much turbulent free. They even provide drinks AND blankets to make the trip that much more enjoyable. 

You all get to wear headphones so that you can talk to one another over the sound of the engine and the pilot is super knowledgeable about a ton of fun facts about the island. There's also music in the background that will keep you entertained throughout the trip through paradise.

I know it's a pretty penny to be spending, but if you're going to Kauai, you don't want to miss this!

This was a special trip I planned for my fiance and I wanted everything to be perfect.  I knew the flight tours were going to be expensive so I wanted to shop around.  I found some places with low rates but they had all these hidden charges, which drive me crazy, the customer service was also lacking over the phone.  I then found this company on trip advisor and thought I would give them a call.  They had very competitive rates and no hidden charges.  The service was above and beyond from the initial phone call to the last email they sent us!

Now about the flight!  Josh the pilot was spectacular.  He was friendly and very knowledgeable.  He had a very sincere personality and had some good jokes!  He was also a very talented Pilot.  He played music on the flight; which correspond to all the sites we saw. ie Jurastic Park with the waterfalls!   The company had every based covered!  They gave us ginger to help with air sickness and even gave my Fiance a free Hawaiian necklace and even flew over the exact trees where it was made! They took pictures of us and even gave them to us for free, unlike most other tour companies which charge you a fortune.  And last of all, they gave us a FREE DVD with highlights of the flight.  I have traveled all over the world and own a tour company myself and Wings over Kauai is the BEST company I have ever encountered.

This was, by far, the best air tour we have ever done. Dori checked us in and gave us some reading material about the island as we waited for the plane to be ready. Josh gave a wonderful flight and info about what we were seeing. I would very highly recommend this tour to anyone! Mahalo Josh and Dori!

Dori checked us in efficiently and warmly.  Pilot, Josh, too, was friendly  and flew us over the island all the time commenting on what we were seeing.  At one point near the end of the tour we encountered some rain clouds that produced beautiful double rainbow rings!  It was a spectacular day.  Thank you Dori and Josh.

A scenic flight over Kauai was one of our must-do's in our two days on the island.  Based on TripAdvisor reviews we booked with Wings Over Kauai, and they were absolutely great. Sherry sorted everything out for us on the ground, thoroughly explained the flight procedures and route, and was all round a delight to deal with. Then Captain Josh looked after us in the air with a flight that took in the highlights of this beautiful island. Josh was incredibly knowledgeable about everything we saw, from the coffee plantations to the geological history to Jurassic Park movie locations! Josh encouraged us to ask questions during the flight and interacted with all four of us on the plane, which we appreciated. We felt completely safe the whole time.

There's so much of Kauai that you just cannot see from the ground or even the ocean. We were lucky that it was a clear day which gave us the most incredible views of Waimea Canyon, the Napali Coast, Hanalei Bay and much more. We felt the price for a 50 minute flight was very reasonable, especially given what the boat and helicopter tours cost. 

We would fully recommend Wings Over Kauai for anyone keen on this sort of experience - it's truly breathtaking and was the highlight of our visit to Kauai, if not our whole trip to the Hawaiian islands.

review_title: The best of all our excursions!
review_text: Our party of 4 all agree-this was the best excursion in our 7 days visiting the Hawaiian islands. The girls were unsure about flying until they experienced it-they loved it! We had a smooth ride and felt completely comfortable-they had water, sodas, even blankets on board for our use. Gave us the nicest leis, photos of us standing in front of the plane,  and a DVD at the end. Learned a lot about the island, filming various movies, and where the stars homes were. The view is unbelievable-totally different than by car!

review_title: Wings Over Kauai Grand Deluxe Flight Rocks!
review_text: Our flight with Wings Over Kauai on April 23rd was an unforgettable experience!  We couldn't decide whether to do a helicopter or plane tour.  I'm glad we chose the plane, because it was a very comfortable ride, we had unbelievable views of the island, and Captain Bruce was very knowledgable and safety minded. After seeing Kauai by air, it made us really appreciate the beauty of this garden isle.  Bruce, Dori, and Josh make an awesome team! This was by far the highlight of our vacation.

review_title: Wonderful Experience. A Must for Kauai.
review_text: We flew as a family group of five last Friday the 10th of May with Josh as our pilot and Dori helping on the ground. The experience was amazing. We flew entirely around Kauai and saw all of the major sights with excellent descriptions by Josh. The aircraft was comfortable, roomy and stable with excellent visibility from each seat.  You haven't seen Kauai unless you take this tour. And you won't find nicer people to take you.

My family and I have lived on Kauai for a year and a half now. We've been able to explore quite a bit but the one thing we have not experienced is a flying tour of the island. We had some family visiting and wanted to try something new. My husband found Wings Over Kauai Tours. This was such a wonderful tour! Our kids were thrilled (ages 9 and 4) to be on a small plane. Both Josh and Dori were super and we loved getting some island history as we flew. Plus, it was quite affordable for the whole family. This was definitely one of my favorite experiences on this island -- such beauty to see. Breathtaking!!

review_title: Fantastic value and a fantastic tour!
review_text:
We really can't speak highly enough of this tour. As a slightly nervous flyer, I was a little scared of the size of the plane (tiny) but I instantly liked and trusted both the pilot Josh and his wife Dori and they gave me a lot of confidence. The tour was fantastic - we saw all the amazing interior of the island that can't be seen by car, as well as the Waimea Canyon and the Na Pali coast which was just breathtaking.

This was a mothers' day treat for me but my husband (who booked it) told me that these guys were one of the cheapest operators out there, as well as the best reviewed, with a faultless safety record. We were also really impressed by the little touches - complimentary, emailed photos of us with the plane and a nut lei for me. They were also great with our little three year old boy - he was free if he could sit on our lap, and, as it happened, he got his own seat anyway. He did fall asleep within minutes so if your child never sleeps, this could be a great break for you!! 

Anyway...thank you Josh and Dori for a fantastic time. We loved every minute.

This air tour is a MUST when visiting Kauai. Our booking agent said Wings Over Kauai was one of the best kept secrets on the island and he was right. We thought an air tour was way out of our budget, but this one is reasonable and a phenomenal value. Great staff -- they are caring and give you a wonderful experience from pre-flight to landing. The sights will take your breath away and may make you tear up (not gonna lie, I did). My husband and I took several tours and booked a handful of activities on the island, but this was by far my favorite. Wings Over Kauai is passionate about what it does, and you won't be disappointed.

A gift for my 68th b-day. What a treat. My husband is an experienced fixed wing airplane pilot so our flight with the owner/pilot, Bruce, was designed to view Kauai from above AND to share with a fellow pilot, the joys of such an experience. Bruce and his Cessna 172 were more than up to the task. It was a very informative opportunity to learn about Kauai wonders with a career islander who loves what he does. The staff was very professional and the flight a highlight of our time on Kauai.

Anyone who visit's Kauai Island MUST take a trip with Wings. Skip the other company's and go with Wings! Our Pilot Josh was fantastic and Dori who helped us out before hand was great and even had her dog there for us to play with! The experience for myself and my wife from start to finish was beyond great. They go above and beyond to make you feel welcome, and Josh really showed us pretty much everything around the island with some great circles around the key spots on the island. The scenery from the air is insane, and the film and television sports we got to see were so cool to see. (Jurassic Park, Raiders of the Lost Ark, Jurassic Park 3, Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest, Fantasy Island just to name a few) We recommend this to everyone!

review_title: After 10 Years ... We Can Now Say : "We Have Really Seen Kauai"
review_text: We have come to Kauai every year since 2003 and thanks to the wonderful folks at Wings Over Kauai we have been able to view the island that we love so much in a spectacular way!!! All of the many wonders that make Kauai so famous are simply "jaw droopingly beautiful" when viewed from a fixed wing tour. Sherry checked us in and presented a great preview of what to expect. She made us feel very comfortable. As soon as we met our pilot, Josh, we knew we had selected the right tour company. His professionalism, enthusiasm, and friendly manner combined to make this the most entertaining thing that we had ever done on Kauai. The amazing views and history of the island that Josh provided exceeded all expectations. Our photos are gorgeous and the DVD will allow us to relive this incredible adventure.

Given the support already on TA, this may seem like piling on but...no problem, lets pile!  We have been not quite annual visitors to Kauai for many years and thought we knew the place pretty well.  One thing we had never done was a helicopter or fixed wing tour.  Should have done it way earlier, and this is definitely the way to do it.

We met Bruce the day before after a long day (his) but he was friendly and enthusiastic.  Happy to talk about what WOK had to offer and talk about how that fit in with our hopes and expectations.  We signed up for a C172 flight the next day.

Everyone has the same island to display (about which more later.)  What was truly wonderful about Bruce, Sherry and the team is that this was a personal thing that, within the limits of what was possible, was the product of getting what we wanted done.  I have spent a lot of time flying so I wanted to do a bit of hands on stuff but didn't want to miss all the sightseeing opportunities.  No problem.  Bruce was happy to fly the airplane when I wanted to sightsee and let me fly when I felt the itch.  He is an instructor as well as a tour pilot so he can give a lesson along with the tour if anyone wants that.

Since we had been to Kauai many times, we also didn't need the pitch about "on your right you can see Poipu" etc. but we were very interested in information about places that are hard or impossible to get to on the ground.  Bruce had all that at his fingertips along with a lot of fascinating stuff from his days as an agronomist on the island.

Bruce is fully capable of flying the standard tour and giving the standard spiel to first time, non-pilot visitors but he is also comfortable with adapting that baseline approach to whatever the customer actually would like.  And that is what is truly neat about WOK.  You don't feel like you are a participant in a script someone wrote ages ago and no one can vary from.  It's more like a nice plane trip with a friend.

Josh and Sherry are from the same mould.  They are friendly, helpful and anxious to do whatever they can to provide a memorable experience.  When we got there, they were trying to sort out the larger plane which had booked one couple that was going to be a few minutes late and another who had to get back to their cruise ship immediately after an on time flight.  They ended up moving the late couple to the next flight taking the time-constrained couple on a personal tour in the large airplane.  A lot of companies would not do that!

In the meantime, Bruce escorted us to our small, "personalized" Cessna and we took off.

The fact that Kauai is one of the world's truly beautiful places was not news to us but the flight allowed us to experience it in an entirely new way.  Trails we had hiked were now visible from above, as were dive sites that I had been to many times.  It is just amazing to see the reef formations from a different perspective.  They are beautiful up close but also beautiful in an entirely different way from 2,000 ft.  The Napali coast is spectacular from the trail and from the ocean but present a whole new aspect from above (and beside.)  Valleys that you basically can't get into at all on the ground are laid out below in awesome splendor.  This is an experience not to be missed and that is true if this is your twentieth or your first and only visit to Kauai.  We will add the memories to our Kauai databank and cherish them for a long time.

I have not done the helicopter tour so I can't really compare them but I was completely satisfied with the fixed wing experience.  That is without regard to the price difference, which I am told is considerable.  Since I would gladly have paid twice what we did for the experience, price was not a driver for us.  We saw everything that was there to see and did it in the context of a friendly, personalized experience that we will remember with great fondness.

The other 1100 reviewers are dead on!

I am not the biggest fan of small planes but our pilot Josh put me at ease and I was amazed at how spectacular the views were. We flew over the whole of Kauai seeing whales, canyons and waterfalls. We also flew over our cruise ship which was a spectacular sight.We purchased the DVD which is of really good quality and a constant reminder of our wonderful trip. We would not hesitate to recommend Wings over Kauai as they are also excellent value for money.

I really enjoyed the flight. The view was fantastic and Bruce is a great pilot/ island guide. We ended up on the smaller plane where my boyfriend and I were the only passengers. The price was the same as for the bigger plane. I would definitely recommend Wings Over Kauai.

First time in a small plane but wow! what an experience. Very friendly service right from the emails with Ellen that arranged the trip, through the free pick up and drop off service from and to the dockside (thanks again Ellen) to the reception from Bruce, Dori and Josh (not forgetting Millie). The flight was all we wished for and more. Magnificent scenery and expert pilot and commentary from Josh. this must be the best way to see all that Kauai has to offer. AND at the end of the flight we were given a free DVD of the flight highlights plus two photos taken by Dori before the flight were emailed to us. Excellent service from a company that really cares about its customers.
Highly recommended.

This was a fabulous experience. Josh and Dori were welcoming and friendly and were focused on  meeting our needs. In the air, Josh was an informative and entertaining pilot. We learned a lot about the island while viewing the amazing scenery. We would highly recommend Wings Over Kauai.

review_title: Wings Over Kauai - Book it for sure!
review_text:
Soaring over the island of Kauai with my boyfriend and Bruce, owner/pilot of Wing's Over Kauai, totally made my day.

We hit the jack pot -- we were the only ones who signed up for the 2:30 p. m. slot, so Bruce was our very own private tour guide.

Bruce took us up in his 4 seater Cessna.  I've never ridden in such a small plane, but Bruce made us feel comfortable right off the bat.

We were up in the air before we knew it.  What really impressed me about Bruce was his confidence and his concern for safety.  There happened to be another tour company flying at the same time as we were and that pilot flew dangerously close to the Na Pali Coast mountains.  Bruce made a comment that he would not do that, and that made me feel so much better.  

There is nothing like the colors that you see on the island from the air. You can see why Kauai is called the Garden Isle.  The hills and valleys were a vibrant green and the ocean shimmered a lovely turquoise.  The Na Pali coast and Waimea Canyon was a sight to see, it was beautiful.

What was really fun was seeing those sights we had driven to on previous days.  For us, Hanalei Beach was one of them.  There's no mistaking Hanalei Bay with the half moon stretch of beach.  Bruce pointed out many more pristine beaches to us that we will visit for sure the next time we are on Kauai.

Bruce was the best.  So informative, so funny (he told some corny jokes too) and so endearing.

By the way, I have taken the helicopter tour before (about 10 years ago), but I enjoyed the Wings Over Kauai flight much better.  The first reason is I got a little nauseous on the helicopter due to their quick maneuvers.  I didn't get sick at all with the plane ride with Bruce.  The second reason is the helicopter tour boasts about taking you closer to the action, but to me I'd rather fly with someone like Bruce who is concerned about the safety of his passengers.  

If you get the chance, do take the flight with Wings Over Kauai.  It made for a memorable end to our vacation.

A. Nakamura and M. Harris

review_title: Incredible Way to See the Whole Kauai
review_text:
We love this air charter tour company and have taken their tours several times while on Kauai. Most of Kauai is not viewable because of the terrain, so seeing the island by air is a must at least once while on the island. Wings Over Kauai offers a comfortable air tour of the entire island with spectacular views of the most popular and breathtaking sites the island has to offer, including: waterfalls, coastlines, Waimea Canyon, the inner island, sugar plantations, resort areas, and open sea.

On our last trip, we were thrilled to see several pods of whales swimming in the open sea from the air. Incredible! Throughout the ride, you'll hear about the island (including some history) from the friendly pilot through noise-cancelling headphones. The plane is small, carrying only about 8 passengers and they are always on time with their flights. Be aware that harsh weather will sometimes interrupt the tours, so it's a good idea to call ahead if the weather looks ominous. The flight leaves from the Lihue airport - very easy to find their hanger, just past the main terminal. 

The plane tours offer a much more affordable way to see the island, as opposed to the helicopter ventures. Wings Over Kauai also gifts you with a lovely DVD as a thank you gift for taking their flight. My spouse and I will be watching our videos (both theirs and those that we took in flight) many times to remember this special trip. Highly recommended.

Top notch service and a friendly and professional atmosphere.  I am an aspiring pilot and had the opportunity to enjoy the wonderful scenery with my wife and work on fly flying skills.  Bruce, Ellen and the whole team were great.  This is a must do when in Kauai!!
I am not the biggest fan of small planes but our pilot put me at ease. The views were spectacular and the ride was comfortable.

review_title: A highlight of our stay in Kauai
review_text: My husband and I flied with Bruce with Cessna, it was an amazing experience. Not only the astonishing bird view of Kauai island but also the flying experience Wings Over Kauai has brought us. From the first step into the site, a friendly welcome from Ellen and professional briefing from Sherry made us feel very comfortable. And the pilot also the owner Bruce was quite informative, he introduced to us different valleys, beaches, plants and fairy tales as well:):) Importantly during a short bumpy his confidence and professional skill conveyed us confidence and safty. We thank Ellen, Sherry and Bruce for bringing us this wonderful fly experience!

My husband and I took the flight on the Wings Over Kauai in March 2013.  It was wonderful.  One of those experiences that is sometimes difficut to see it all because of the tears in the eyes from how beautiful everything is.  I did a lot of research before we took our trip.  Hawaii has been a dream of mine all my life and I wanted to make sure I didn't miss a thing.  I would have to say out of our 2 1/2 weeks on three of the islands, this was the best of the best.  My husband and I have never been in a plane that small and were a little nervous, but it was an extremely smooth and comfortable flight.  Josh is an excellent pilot and shared a lot of information.  Unless you see the views from the air, you won't see them.  When we saw whales he flew in that direction so we could get a good view.  Bruce and Ellen are so kind and everything was so well organized.  There was also a special gift, but I won't ruin the surprise.  If I am ever blessed again to go to Hawaii, I will definitely take this amazing flight again.  Thank you Ellen, Bruce and Josh for the ride of  lifetime.

when my husband booked this i was very apprehensive.Small planes...high mountains. but the moment we met the staff @ WOK i felt safe and comfortable.
I was sitting next to Bruce, our pilot and owner he gave me the honorary position of co-pilot and we did the preflight check list while we put my husband in the  back in charge of photography.
The flight was smooth, comfortable and just the right amount of time to see the "garden island".
We also enjoyed Bruce's sense of humor and his knowledge of the island.
I recommend this to be at the TOP of your things to do when you visit Kauai.we have done the helicopter thing in Maui years ago. and they just don't compair. Book it!!!

review_title: My Bucket List just got shorter!
review_text: We just got back a 14 day Hawaii cruise to and around the islands onboard the Golden Princess.  When we started to plan our Hawaiian Cruise, I looked on Trip-Advisor for highly recommended Island Tours.  I found "Wings Over Kauai Tours" (WOK) and immediately determined this was for us.  The major selling points were: 1. Window Seats Only!  2. The flight was 23% longer than helicopter! 3. Great Prices!  We don't know if the tour could have been better!  It was simply outstanding! The sights that we saw were simply fantastic views. After seeing the Napa coastal area, I realized that it was better than I ever thought it would be!  I know, you have heard this before, but my wife stated after the flight, that she wanted to go again!  Our pilot was so knowledgeable about Kauai that there wasn't a question that he couldn't answer.  WOW is hardly exciting enough to exclaim our feelings!

On April 19 we took a flight with Bruce in his smallest plane. Neither one of us had ever been in such a small one before. Bruce and his team were so nice both on the phone and in person. They made us feel quite relaxed. It was a little cloudy so there was a small delay taking off, but once in the air it was clear and beautiful. If you want to see Kauai from the air, it's definitely worth it. We took a long time deciding between a helicopter and a plane, but having read the reviews on TA we decided this would be the one. Thanks again, TripAdvisor, for sending us to the right place.
Loved it!

We just got back from our trip to Hawaii where we did the 7 day cruise around the islands on the Pride of America. The highlight of our trip was the flight over Kauai. Kauai is called the garden island for good reasons. Seeing Waimai Canyon from the air was beautiful and what I thought was going to be the highlight of out flight. But after seeing the Napa area I realized i realized that it is even prettier than Waimai Canyon. Plus the waterfalls we saw from the air were wonderful. Another big plus is the excusion is much cheaper than a helichopter especially for someone over 250 pounds which the helichopter charge a 50% premium for. There is no premium for large people charged by the air plane. Many of the sights we saw could only be viewed from the air. This was the best excusion of our trip.

My husband and I took really enjoyed our flight.  Our pilot was great and very informative.  We flew with another couple and we were all able to sit on the right hand side of the plane which was very nice.

Great service - very personalized and they make you feel very welcome.  They were also very accommodating and responsive.  The weather was rather odd while we were there but they allowed us to be flexible and they were flexible - just in case we wanted to move our date.

This really is a great way to see the island.  Our flight was over an hour long.  We certainly did not feel it was rushed and we got to see it all.

One nice touch - Bruce took a photo of my husband and myself in front of the plane before we took off, then emailed it to us later.  It was a really good picture!

I have had the pleasure to fly with Bruce as a co-pilot in the company C172. It was the best activity I have done in Kauai. 
Wings Over Kauai has very friendly staff. The pilots are very professional and all aircraft are really well maintained. 

Great job! 100% recommended.

review_title: Very impressed with this tour! Left us speechless.
review_text:
I'll admit I booked this tour because it is the #1 activity to do in Kauai, and my husband and I were not disappointed at all. Great customer service, breathtaking scenery and plenty of information about the island and history. This was our first trip to this island so I knew the best way to see it was from the air. Clearly, much of the island cannot be reached by car, so this is the way to go! Seeing whales from the air last week was a huge bonus!

If you are prone to motion sickness, take a pill beforehand!

Captain Josh is excellent and experienced. We had time to kill after checking in before our flight, so we drove to the end of the street for an ocean view and we saw whales there too. I highly recommended this tour. With eight trips to Hawaii under my belt, this is definitely one of the best things I've experienced.

C'est dans une ambiance décontractée et familiale que nous avons été accueillis pour ce tour de Kaua'i. La famille Coulombe nous fait vraiment sentir comme un des leurs. Les vues sont incroyables et à couper le souffle. Il est très intéressant dans l'avion de pouvoir parler directement avec le pilote et d'entendre les autres occupants poser leurs questions grâce aux écouteurs munis de micro en réseau. 

  Un petit avertissement aux cœurs sensibles pour le mal des transport : étant donné que nous volons a basse altitude et que nous tournons souvent pour voir les attractions, il y a beaucoup de mouvement dans les airs. Ma conjointe a adoré la première demi-heure, mais a surtout vu le fond du sac de plastique blanc pour le reste de l'aventure !!!

  Nous recommandons cette compagnie à qui que ce soit sans hésitation.

I have been to Kauai 3 times now, and this was by far, the most amazing tour I've taken.  I've enjoyed all the tours I've taken so far, but nothing was quite as majestic as this - the most beautiful views (we even saw whales!). The company was professional, the captain was great and informative.  I love that we had noise-cancelling headphones and could speak to each other and easily hear.   This is definitely a don't miss!

review_title: The best tour in Kauai!!  You must try this tour!!
review_text: This was the best tour we did in Kauai.  This tour was cheaper than helicopter and you get to see everything.  I dont see why you need to spend more money for helicopter tour when you get to see everything with this tour.  Bruce is so friendly that he makes you feel so comfortable.  I wasn't sure how I was gonna do with little plane but ride  was pretty smooth and I felt fine.  What you get to see with this tour is pretty amazing and Bruce is willing to answer any questions you have.  They have water, ginger candies and wet towel for you just in case you get sick during ride.  They also take pictures of you and give it to you for free!!   If i had to pick the best tour I did it Kauai, it was this tour. I would definitely recommend this tour to anyone.

review_title: Personal and Educational experience with awesome views!
review_text: Thank you, Thank you, Bruce and Ellen from start to finish.  You welcomed us like family!  Since my husband is a pilot also this experience is one we will never forget!  The views were spectacular and it was interesting to learn of the dozens of famous and noteworthy films that were produced around the island. Na'Pali coastline is a definite favorite.  We would recommend Wings over Kauai  to anyone looking for a comfortable and personal experience.  We hope to visit again very soon.    Ron and Teri

Auch wir waren total begeistert von der professionellen und sehr persönlichen Betreuung von Ellen und Bruce, ebenfalls von der netten Dame, die uns eingecheckt hat, an deren Namen ich mich aber leider nicht mehr erinnere! Es war ein unvergessliches Flugerlebnis! Nachdem die Formalitäten erledigt waren, wurde uns alles ganz in Ruhe erklärt. Da ich nicht die Größte bin, hat Ellen dafür gesorgt, dass ich noch ein Sitzkissen bekomme, Bruce hat mich interaktiv am Start teilhaben lassen, indem ich die Checkliste mit ihm durchgegangen bin! Während des Flugs haben wir viel Interessantes über die Insel erfahren, was einem sicher auch bei anderen Unternehmen geboten wird. Letztendlich ist es aber wichtig, WIE man mit den Kunden umgeht und kommuniziert und das war in jeglicher Hinsicht PERFEKT! Ein Familienunternehmen, das man bedenkenlos weiterempfehlen kann! Vielen Dank, Ellen und Bruce!

review_title: Attention to Details - makes the difference
review_text: We have just returned from Hawaii and we really enjoyed our flight excursion in Kaua’i.  We opted for a plane ride through Waimea Canyon and around Napali Coast with Wings Over Kauai, versus a helicopter ride, and we made the right decision.  As I said, we flew with Wings Over Kauai and this family run company made all the difference to the enjoyment of our visit.  It was their attention to the details that enhanced the quality of the tour.  Ellen organizes the tours and personally responds to your emails, queries in a timely and friendly manner.  She ensures that the time slot is best for you and your family/group.  Moreover, I mixed up the dates and the time slots and she worked extra hard to fix my mistakes and made it seem like no trouble at all.  While on the flight the quality of the headsets made the real difference for me.  They were comfortable, I could hear the pilots commentary and they cancelled the engine noise which can be load and uncomfortable during an hour long flight.  Bruce, the pilot, personalized the tour and commentary based on our interests and it never felt like a cookie cutter tour.  We felt like he was enjoying himself too and that somehow made it feel special for us.   They took our picture with their camera and our camera and then made us a DVD that they gave to us.  They didn’t try and sell us anything before or after.  We have never been given a DVD for free.  Instead, we have always been “offered a way to capture our experience” at a hefty price.  Whether you are visiting for a day or a week I would take the time to contact Wings Over Kauai and take a tour of the island from a bird’s eye view.  The price for two was as stated no hidden or extra fuel surcharges charges.

My husband and I recently enjoyed a flight around Kauai with Bruce. He was extremely friendly and knowledgeable. The sights of Kauai are spectacular but having a wonderful pilot made the flight even more enjoyable. The Wings Over Kauai staff is also extremely helpful. My husband and I called the day before our tour to try and book a last minute tour before leaving for Maui. They were able to fit us in for a tour and also shuttled us over to the airport. We had a 1:00 tour with Bruce and then had a 3:20 plane to Maui. They were extremely conscientious of the narrow time window and fit us in with no problems to ensure we made our flight to Maui.  The whole experience with Wings Over Kauai was exceptional!

Because of reviews for Wings over Kauai, we took our flight and it was the best decision of the trip! Beautiful scenery in Kauai is spectacular when seen from the sky.  We had a wonderful flight and were able to get up close to the top of the wettest place on earth.  Captain Josh was full of information and willing to answer all of our questions as well as tell us things we never would have thought to ask.
