The hospitality and experience was fabulous...they make you feel like family..
This tour is best value for money too...Highly recommend this tour to everyone looking for a air tour of Kauai..

Bruce and his crew gave us a wonderful morning's flight over beautiful Kauai - one that will be long remembered.  Great people! and great value for money.  We saw much more in an hour than even a day's driving could achieve.  I was also very impressed with Wings Over Kauai's professionalism, commitment to their customer and high standards of operation and safety.  Highly recommended, should be on everyone's must-do list for Kauai.

review_title: You Must See Kauai by Plane with Wings Over Kauai
review_text: A family of 7 with ages ranging from 72 to 10 all wanting a front row seat to the best view of the Island of Kauai -- from the air.  Wings Over Kauai delivered.  We were all in the air at one time, which I did not think was possible.  We had two planes -- 5 in one and 2 in the other.  Bruce and Josh and great hosts, very knowledgable about the island and they make sure you get the picture you came for -- no worries.  I can't say enough about them except that if I am lucky enough to return to the Island, this is the FIRST reservation I will make.  We all agree this was the best way to see Kauai and worth the money.  When you look at the cost of a helicopter, this is far better and Bruce and his team will exceed your expectations.

As Honeymooners, my wife and I received a very personable and private tour! Everyone at "wings over Kauai" was amazing; they were super friendly and funny! And, the island views were spectacular. An Ariel tour of the island is a must. 

For those that want a closer Waimia Canyon/NaPali coast tour should opt for an helicopter because the helicopters can go to places the planes cannot not. 

Our tour, however, was simply amazing with "Wings over Kauai"

A wonderful experience! Even though at first the weather seemed to be not the best for flying (it was cloudy and it rained a little too) but our pilot Bruce made us realize it was even better that way as besides being able to witness breathtaking views of Kauai we could see the rainbow over the waterfall from the sky! Also thank you so much for a warm welcome from your great staff! Absolutely recommended as one of the best things to do while you're in Kauai!!!

As a flight intructor myself ,Bruce was kind enough to offer me either the right or left seat (right seat better views) in the Cessna 172. At the last minute I decided to fly from the left seat and Bruce immediately understood and shifted positions. 
The flight was extremely easy, especially when Bruce would do the radio call and keep me out of noise sensitive areas and restricted airspace. Bruce is so knowlegedable about the island. My wife Dawn is the photographer and was able to get many great shots, and views  that we would never have been possible from a helo or drive tour.
As a final recommendation to those pilots out there who are considering a flying tour of Kauai. Bring along Bruce, he will let you fly as much as you want, and has the personality and demanor that all flight instructors strive for, but rarely achieve. He also does great radio so all you have to do is fly and look out the window.

It was a great flight and we all had a super time.

Jim MacKay
CFI / ATP

Great ,great , great , I loved it soooooooo much I would like to do it again ,again and again.
 As you can only access 20% of Kauai by road its a must to fly  to see all the beauty of this island , specially with Wings were you have the best views in the cockpit and best service . 
Thanks to Ellen ,Sophia , Josh and Bruce for making me very comfortable and sharing all they know about  the island

My sister and I chose to fly with Wings Over Kauai as a end of trip treat - we are SO happy that we chose to do so! The trip was worth every penny we spent. From the kindness of e staff, the leis and flowers you are given when you check in, the enthusiasm of the pilot (Paul was sweet, a great pilot, and very knowledgeable of the island), and the DVD of a similar flight (with our photo on the cover of the DVD!!), we were so impressed. The flight was smooth and comfortable. And of course, the incredible scenery of this beautiful island is stunning! Thank you Wings Over Kauai!!

We were looking for a unique tour of Kauai and Wings Over Kauai delivered! Being a pilot, we were looking for something unique and more personalized. The Cessna 172 ended up being the perfect platform to explore the majestic beauty of the island. Captain Josh was not only a great aviator, but provided an excellent description as we traversed Kauai. We could not have asked for anything more and would recommend this for the first time visitor and those that have visited many times!

Everything about the experience with Wings Over Kauai was great.  The communication, and flexibility, booking our flight was fabulous.  Once we arrived at their location the customer service couldn't have been better.  They described the flight plan and asked if we had any concerns or questions about the tour.  Once in the air Bruce was a pro and we all envied his job.  He gave us lots of great information about Kauai and the history of the island.  I fly often so I found the small plane provided a very comfortable ride.  We can't thank the team at Wings Over Kauai enough for the amazing service they provide.

We had a helicopter tour in mind, but after researching on Trip Advisor, it was sounding like a flight with Wings Over Kauai was the way to go. I wouldn't even consider looking any further- you won't regret booking with this company! Great value, great experience, and a company that you feel good about supporting.  It was a highlight of our honeymoon- we just got home tonight and despite being up at 4 am, I'm already taking the time to spread the word about how great Bruce and the team were so that's saying something!

I booked the smaller plane. My husband was a bit nervous when we got outside and he saw how small it was, he was nervous that it would be a rougher ride, but he ended up loving it! 

Here's what we loved:
Half the price of a helicopter tour.
Much less fuel consumption than a helicopter (aka more environmentally friendly!)
A knowledgeable, capable and friendly pilot - Bruce, though we've only heard great things about Josh too.
A free ride from the Anchor Cove mall -which was a quick walk or free shuttle from the cruise ship.
Friendly staff (Jennifer and Sophia were great!).
No hidden costs.
Great communication- we inquired and booked online and Ellen emailed and happily answered all of my questions.

Really no downside. Not one complaint or concern.

Plan for 2 hours from pick up to return time.

There is no way to see the beauty of Kauai from the ground, we would do this trip again and again. Mahalo to the Wings Over Kauai team for such a special and personal experience.

~ Lance and Jessika, Mission BC
Amazing!  The best customer service ever!  Fun little extras they throw in.  Friendly staff.  Organized.

You can stop looking for your aerial tour company NOW.  Wings over Kauai  is first class, incredibly polite, and most of all genuine.  The detail in the fine "touches" of this very intimate experience is what took this tour for myself, my wife, and my 3 year old Keiki over the top!!  Cpt. Bruce is a must have!

review_title: Fantastic way to see Kauai, knowledgable pilot, great value!
review_text:
My girlfriend and I were on a cruise and decided to take a flight tour of Kauai the morning we arrived in port late November.  We called a couple helicopter tour companies that were full for the day and they recommended an airplane tour with Wings Over Kauai.  I'm a private fixed wing pilot so that was perfect for us, and it's also much more affordable than a helicopter tour.
I love the fact that they are a small family run business and Ellen came to pick us up free of charge from the cruise ship.  Checkin was simple, quick, and it was great talking with Ellen.

Josh, a former American Airlines pilot, flew us and another couple around the entire island on a glorious clear day with only a small portion of the mountain peak covered by the ever present cloud that makes this the wettest place in the US(or planet, I can't remember).  The flight lasted about an hour and was an incredible value, especially considering you can't get to most of the places we were able to see from the air, what a beautiful island!  

Josh is incredibly knowledgable about Kauai and the Hawaiian islands, in addition to being a terrific pilot.  All of the seats in their Gippsland G8 AirVan have active noise cancelling headsets, which made talking to each other and listening to Josh really easy(not the case in many small aircraft).  Although a fixed wing airplane can't fly quite as close to some of the canyons as the helicopters, everyone gets a window seat(many helicopters are 3-4 across).

Ellen took a beautiful photo of us next to the plane, emailed it too us, and gave us a DVD with a short video montage from previous flights set to music.  Overall a fantastic experience! 

FYI, although we didn't do it, if you're a pilot and want hands on flying they can do a lesson in their Cessna 172.
This was highly recommended & did not disappoint!   They treated us like friends & took extra care when we had concerns about motion sickness. Very informative trip.   EXCELLENT!!!!!!!!

The crew at Wings over Kauai (ground staff and the pilot) were so friendly and really invested in making sure we had a great time. They gave me a beautiful lei, took pictures before the flight and gave us a DVD of the tour. The tour itself was wonderful and the pilot gave us so much background info. about the island as we flew over it. 

I have a toddler and they were particularly attentive to her needs. This is what I call great customer service on top of a great service!! 

I will go back and would recommend anybody considering a flight option to pick Wings over Kauai.

review_title: A Must-Do for the Full Picture of Kauai
review_text:
Kauai is such a beautiful island and you need to see if from the air to experience all the island has to offer.   This is a great experience.  You'll see the entire island and will hear lots of interesting information while you tour from above in the comfort of the airbus.  Josh was a wonderful pilot and tour guide.  The entire flight is an opportunity to take fabulous photos.  We thoroughly enjoyed the experience.   The small touches make you feel very welcome - bottled water if you get thirsty and a blanket if you need it, a complimentary kukui nut lei and a DVD gift of a Wings Over Kauai tour comes with the price - very nice.  

For those who might experience motion sickness, Wing Over Kauai is actually the best choice for an air tour.  Much more comfortable and stable than a helicopter.  And if budget is an issue, Wings Over Kauai is a great value - you see more of the island at a more reasonable price.   

A "Must Do"

You really need to see Kauai by air to truly appreciate what a gem it is.  Wings Over Kauai makes this possible without breaking the bank.   We enjoyed our flight in the G8 Airvan in early November. There were three of us plus Josh the pilot so we all had a prime window seat on the right of the plane with space to spare.  Check in was easy, you have headsets to listen to pilot chatter plus you can talk between pilot and others in the cabin.  There is nice music playing in the background to give you that aloha feeling.

If you do have motion sickness definitely take something or use a PSI Band. Poor hubby gets seasick but never had problem in air before but I guess a small plane is similar to a boat...  Unfortunately we had not thought about it beforehand but he made it though a little worse for wear.  

We were surprised by the Kukui nut lei and DVD with images/music after the flight.  Really a nice touch.  This is a small family run business and you can tell they are passionate about what they do.

we flight with Wings Over Kauai because friends told us about it. It was simply great! Everybody was so friendly, even though we made first a mistake of the date. We felt very safe at the flight and we get a lot of informations. Everything was very personal, we felt like friends.

Best way to see the island for a reasonable price. Josh was our pilot and did a great job narrating the sites. The staff was professional and top-notch. Best value around and the tour was definitely the highlight of our trip!

Took the flightseeing tour with Wings Over Kauai today. What a wonderful experience. The business was both very friendly and very professoonal from the very first contact. Bruce was our pilot and he did a great job showing us Kauai from the air. The flight was very beautiful and we felt very safe. Highly recommend them.

What a amazing flight, thank you so much!! Bruce was wonderful, he was first of all a lot of fun to have as our pilot, but he didn't talk to much so we could enjoy the scenery, but mentioned all of the important info that we'd want to learn and know about. Lets just say this....there is a reason why this has a 5 rating for most of the people.....I would highly recommend, thank you for such an enjoyable flight!!!!

We typically fly in and drive to Hanalei without venturing out.  I thought maybe we could change it up a bit and after reading reviews here, we contacted Wings Over Kauai.  We loved it.  It was nice to get a view of "our little piece of heaven" from the air.  Great service, not "canned" tourist trap.  I highly suggest you take advantage of what this lovely family has to offer.

i had booked the flight tour based on review, for our anniversary. i was glad that i did. every seat is a window seat with only 4 passengers per flight. they also took our complimetary pics with the plane and mailed it to us. also got a dvd with some of the sights we saw.
pros
you get to see the best sights of the island
have an experienced pilot that knows alot about the island
see parts of the island that are not reachable otherwise.
its much cheaper than all other providers i could find.

cons
u may have to share the plane with another couple.

review_title: By far one of the best trips EVER
review_text: Having done a flight over the grand canyon and being a little disappointed, I was a bit aprehensive - no need - one of the highlights of our holiday (we did it during a day trip to Kauai from Oahu. Fab fab fab - these are genuinely LOVELY people and it was the best money we have spent on a trip EVER - anyone who goes to Kauai MUST do this trip - we have already told all our family and friends about it and would do it again in a heatbeat!

I am going to write a big review as Wings over Kauai deserves it.

Background:
This is a must for any trip to Kauai. Choices are either a chopper or an air tour. The air tour is by far the most bang for your buck. For air tour we were on smaller Cesna so we were the only ones with our pilot - Josh, this is a great option for privacy and you get personal attention from the Pilot - I got to be the co-pilot :-). You can also choose a big 6 seater Airvan, which has larger windows but more passengers with you. 
Tip: Sit on the right side of the plane.

Service:
Ellen was super courteous and made sure we had all the information about choices that we had. The lady at the reception (can't remember her name) was good too and did all the formalities. This process takes ~10minutes. 
Tip: Try to book at least 4 days in advance.
Our pilot - Josh was brilliant and made sure this was a perfect way to say "Mahalo!!" to Kauai. He is extremely courteous and knowledgeable about the island. He made sure that we had every opportunity to photographs amazing vistas - he did double rounds over some waterfalls. The good thing about Cesna is that you get undivided attention of the pilot. 
Many thanks to Josh.
They take your photos (and email them to you) before boarding on the plane and do a great job of tucking you nicely. I was the co-pilot, so i had an opportunity to see all the controls apart from enjoying the views. You get noise cancelling headphone so that you can communicate with each other and the pilot. They also give you a free pre-made DVD (not of your actual flight). It is a 5 minute DVD with music encapsulating the tour.
Tip: The photography buff should sit on the back seat as there is a bar blocking good photography over the front seat side windows.

Flight:
Our flight was around ~65 minutes. The flight started from Lihue commuter's airport terminal. The path started from the south-east corner of the island through Poipu beach, port Allen - into the center of the island Waimea canyon with all the waterfalls - into the north-west corner Napali coast and all amazing vistas - onto north-east side and finally back to the airport. The views are simply breath taking and no review can do justice for this experience. So you have to experience it yourself.

Bottom Line:
I would give A+ to Wings over Kauai for the price ($125/person) and the over all flight experience. You can choose a chopper ride that will cost you 2X ($250/person), the only plus on the chopper ride is that they can land you on some waterfalls which are otherwise inaccessible and can fly little close to the mountains. To me i wanted to get the big picture so flying close to mountains would make sense. However, both options are good.   

Thank you WINGS OVER KAUAI for making this a memorable trip.

My husband and I have spent 3 glorious weeks on the Hawaiian Islands - exploring, surfing, hiking, eating way too much food but we both agree that this was by far our best adventure!!!  We opted for the flight as oppose to a helicopter for 2 reasons - cost and the reviews and hey they were completely spot on!!!  The service that Ellen & Bruce, "Wings" provides has a family feel and full of the Aloha Spirit, we really can't thank them enough for a wonderful experience that we'll always treasure.  Josh our pilot was such a genuinely lovely guy and made me feel very comfortable and allayed my fears of the flight - the views are breath- taking and we were able to see the entire island cloud- free and if we missed something Josh would circle again.  During the flight you may come across some of the helicopter tours and what I realized is they go really close to the sights, deep into the valleys and so close to the cliffs but I wonder if being that close they lose the grandeur and sheer glorious-ness of the views.  We were completely blown- away, humbled even being surrounded by such beauty so if your worry is will I see everything - trust me you will and more.  Thank you Wings for everything and more!!

review_title: Spectacular, Friendly, Adaptive and Personal Experience,  The best part of our visit to Kawai!
review_text:
Jane and I had a wonderful experience with Wings Over Kauai, from the point of view of a visiting pilot and an amateur photographer. Before we flew, Bruce clarified the traffic patterns unique to the Island. We then did 1. familiarization / training session and  2. a photography session, both over 1 hour long. We did not want the flights to end.

Bruce kindly let me (the pilot) fly out of the left seat and guided me around the island traffic pattern, while we flew around the coast, the canyon and the mountains. Bruce pointed out interesting landmarks and locations where famous movies have been shot. We chatted about various issues related to mountain flying, strategies for monitoring traffic and bird avoidance. 

In the second flight Bruce kindly let us open the right window to get clear photo shots, free of reflections and distortions. He positioned the aircraft at an appropriate distance, and considered the direction of light for good shot opportunities. It is clear that he understands the needs of a photographer. He encouraged me to take control from the right seat (with which I did not have much experience) and all worked out well. 

Bruce is an excellent pilot and an excellent instructor and quickly finds the level at which his student functions, communicates and encourages at an appropriate level. Ellen runs the office professionally and in a personally attuned way. All aspects of the experience have been pleasant. We look forward to more flying with Wings Over Kauai in the future and highly recommend the experience as safe, educational and adaptive to individual likes, needs and skill levels (pilots).

Michael Krelina, M.D., Jane Barlow, M.D.
Canada

review_title: See the whole of Kauai one day!
review_text:
As cruise ship passengers we wanted to see as much as we could. This is the one and only way to  do Kauai!! Wings over Kauai are a fantastic outfit! Start to finish, Ellen met us near the ship and drove us out to the airport, a short ride. Maggie I think the girls name was that helped us fill out our paperwork was great,(forgive me if I got the name wrong, it was a few weeks ago that we did this!) her first week and it seemed like she had been with them forever!
We went out with Bruce with one other couple and had an absolutely fantastic time.
You cannot fault this tour. All the way first class.
Friendly, professional, totally safe, experienced,fun, the most unreal sights you can imagine, smooth ride , take off and landing, I actually forgot I was in a plane while we were up there I was so taken aback with the sights.
By far the best tour in Kauai and perfect for cruise passengers in for the day. Take the early tour.

review_title: Amazing a must do while in Kauai
review_text: Extremely memorable!!! Took this tour our first day on the island it was unbelievable!!! Absolutely magnificent. Our whole family did it which included our 4 and 9 year old children it was thoroughly enjoyed by the whole family. Bruce was amazing as well as all the office staff. Very personable and knowledgable about the island. They make you feel safe, comfortable, and welcome. I would recommend this tour without any reservation for all ages. Thank you wings over Kauai!!!

We booked a private airplane tour (just the two of us)) with Wings over Kauai and we don't regret it. Bruce and Ellen are very nice people and very proffesional. They welcomed us with a coconut lace and a fresh flower for the hair. Bruce involves you in the take off routine and  tells you about the plants,trees,canyons and anything else you see from the airplane. It was a great experience. We definetely recomend it!!

We went on our honeymoon and loved Wings Over Kauai. Not only was the price almost half of the helicopters - but we got to be in the air for a longer time and see the whole island.  They are the perfect size planes to feel like you are on an adventure ride - and the bubble windows are amazing!
The on site contact (Elaine?) was amazing and Josh the pilot was super informative and fun!

Thanks Wings over Kauai!

review_title: go for it - you won't regret it!
review_text:
Before coming to kauai - we were tempted to take a heli ride but after reading multiple reviews & recommendations we finally chose to book an airplane tour. Among those 2 available on Kauai
we decided for "Wings over Kauai" and while waiting for our plane ride at the general aviation terminal
(which by the way is much more comfortable incl. restrooms etc than the bare heli gateways)
we could notice the difference to their next door competitor loading their aircraft to capacity
while wings places only 4 passengers comfortably on their state of the art air van.  All 
tour participants enjoy a right hand side window seat with unobstructed views of the island. 
Captain Josh was an excellent
pilot and tour guide pointing out the most interesting spots and stories on and about the island.
We enjoyed excellent flight conditions with miracolous views over countless beaches, Waimea
Canyon and of course the Napali Cliffs.  
Booking this tour is not difficult either. Just call Ellen the managing co-owner at the back office.
She'll book you on a flight which will suit your needs perfectly.
At the terminal before the flight Ellen will receive you very warmly and address all you concerns if needed.
Top notch service at a very reasonable price.   
Go for it!
Mahalo from Gina & Gerhard, visiting from Austria

We had a fabulous experience both with Cpt Josh in the air and with Ellen on the ground. Our check in and orientation was efficient, and our experience in the air was unforgettable. Not only did we see the highlights othe tours include (Na Pali coast, waimea canyon, and a multitude of waterfalls), but Cpt Josh shared information about the local folliage, pertinent history of the island, and of the sights. Also, they provided a video (free of charge), not of our specific flight but of a similar flight - a very nice touch.

review_title: Great Customer Service, but Motion Sickness
review_text:
Because of these high reviews, we booked with Wings of Kauai Tours.  We wanted so much to enjoy the airplane tour just as all these reviewers have been boosting about.  Maybe it was just our unlucky day where it was too windy, not sure really.  However, our group total was 5 and all 5 of us experienced major motion sickness (some vomiting) due to so much turbulence on our tour at 11AM.  It surprised our group because we were not prone to motion sickness in the past.  Our pilot Bruce did give us suggestions on how to reduce motion sickness and it helped some.  

We don't blame the staff since they have no control over mother nature.  In fact, their customer service is excellent, so professional and friendly.  Our suggestions are to call the day of the tour to check weather conditions and to take ginger before/during the flight.

review_title: No anxiety, no motion sickness and awesome flight!
review_text:
I'm not going to repeat everything that the other reviewers have already mentioned but will say that I agree with all of them. 

Things I will add are: 1) I am a little anxious in small planes and am prone to motion sickness. The take off and landing were amazingly smooth. We were lucky to have a mild day so almost zero turbulence. Bruce gave me some tips on how to keep my motion sickness at bay and checked on me during the flight. 2) Tanya, Ellen and Bruce exude a homeyness that makes you feel at ease. They are so friendly and their service is personal. Just extraordinarily nice people. 3) Felt like a was in good hands with Bruce at the helm. Very peaceful and informative flight. 4) Post flight, Tanya handed us a dvd at no charge. This stunned me! FREE?? I imagine other companies are doing the same thing, but charging you for the dvd. When I got back to my condo and logged onto my computer there was a thank you note from Ellen and electronic files of photos they took of us in front of the plane. Stunned again! So sweet. That is genuine hospitality that will make you come back for in the future and tell all your friends about.

I booked this flight for my husband's birthday and it was a great gift. He loved it and I think he'll remember it as one of my better presents! It was so affordable and such a great value. I could still take my husband out for a nice birthday dinner, whereas if I went on a helicopter ride, it would have been 2x the price. Plus it just felt safer.

If you come to Kauai, you should really consider Wings Over Kauai. They love what they do and it shows. You won't be sorry.

I loved the personalized tour we received. The flight was smooth and gentle-it is what flying is supposed to be like.  We could see everything so clearly and Bruce narrated so we felt like we really knew what Kauai was.  Don't miss this!

We took the Wings Over Kauai flight in September whilst on the Golden Princess cruise to Hawaii.  We were looking for something different to celebrate our 48th wedding anniversary and came across Wings Over Kauai whilst trawling the internet.  Thank goodness we did.  
Thank you to all at Wings Over Kauai, especially Sherry in the office and Josh our pilot who was very caring and a good guide.  We were made to feel very special and we will remember it always.
The best complement we can give is to recommend Wings Over Kauai to everyone. 
Christine and Tony - Burnham on Sea, Somerset

Everything about this trip was terrific.  We pre-booked a few months ahead, the arrangements were easy.  We met the driver at a local shopping center and had a wonderful trip for a bit more than an hour.  The flight was so quiet and peaceful with a great explaination of the area while flying.  Definitely one of the greatest tours while in Hawaii.  We also were given a nice DVD upon the finish of the trip.  Thanks "Wings Over Kauai" for a super time in Kauai.

One of the best values on the island.  Bruce and Ellen are terrific people and making your flight the best ever is obviously their goal.  Bruce is a great pilot and with his agriculture background he was a wealth of information about island farming and has an abundance of knowledge about the island history. Little touches, like the photo they provide, involving you in pre-flight check and  the necklace presented on arrival, made this a special tour.  The island is truly a Garden Isle and the views seen during flight are ones you would never see otherwise.  This was actually the last thing we did before leaving the island and we saw the parts we were unable to see by car.  We had a truly memorable experience and one we would probably do again.  Thanks Bruce and Ellen for making our trip to Kauii complete.

From the time I booked this flight online this was the best experience. We were picked up near our cruise ship. Taken to Lihue airport to start our filight.The ground staff are friendly and make you feel welcome.Our pilot Josh was the best.We felt safe and in capable hands the whole flight.His narration of our flight was informed and interesting.Sights we saw were amazing. This flight was great value. We experienced much more expensive helicopter flights on the nearby islands but this was the best for both value and sightseeing.We couldn't give a higher recommendation.

This was one of our first activities on the island and gave us a great overview as to where we wanted to go. Staff was very good to deal with; they were all down-to-earth, welcoming and friendly people. Weather was good for a decent trip, albeit the wife got motion sickness. Very appreciative that Wings Over Kauai were able to get our trip started off nicely!

PROS

Comprehensive - see the whole island in under an hour. Bruce was very informative and skilled to maneuver the plane to avoid excess turbulence

"The little extras" - it was a pleasant experience to receive the extra little touches they offered. They gave us a DVD as well as a nice kukui necklace for the misses.

Excellent Staff - the company knows how to run a business and treat their customers well. We felt important, appreciated and most importantly safe. Arriving early, Ellen advised to take some pictures at a nearby bay. 

CONS

Possible motion sickness - my wife got ill during the flight, so keep this in mind or take any precautions beforehand.

Wished it was longer! - we saw pretty much the whole island, but though my wife wanted it to end sooner, I wished it was longer.

Don't expect great detailed shots - I was big on being a camera-wielding tourist, so I think I may have had expected a bit much. Don't expect too many close ups. Not a deal breaker though, the tour was fantastic

We had a wonderful tour with Bruce! Everyone with the company was incredibly friendly and for the price this experience could not be beat!!!
However if you are looking to explore all the nocks and crannies of the island I would probably recommend a helicopter. The airplane tours can't get into the canyon like helicopters can.

review_title: 航拍美丽景色，会说中文的飞行师
review_text: 如果你喜欢摄影，在可爱岛是一定需要走一次航拍的路程，因为这个岛上太多的地方是无法开车到达，除非你可以徒步大半天的时间去NaPali。作为中国人，有幸在这个小岛遇到会说中文的飞行师Joshua是极大的运气。我们早上自驾去Waimea大峡谷，大约10点左右，Ellen跟我们说下午4点还有一个班次，如果你们赶得及的话，可以上。其实去Waimea的时间差不多就是4-5个小时足够。山顶的Kalalau本是绝佳摄影点，但大雾封山，看见个屁。但4点上了螺旋桨飞机，才知道所有没有看见的东西，究竟是怎样的。在大雾封山的Kalalau峡谷，我们见到了2道彩虹，色泽极为浓郁。价格挺可以接受的，6个人包机500刀，比其他要合算很多，当然记得给飞行师小费，他的技术和导游实在太有价值了。

review_title: The best tour of our lives
review_text:
I have no words to thank all of Wings Over Kauai, which provided an unforgettable experience in our lives. Special thanks to Ellen and our pilot Josh. If you plan to go to Hawaii, you should go to Kauai, the most beautiful island and, being in Kauai you definitely need to do this tour with Wings Over Kauai, simply the best.
I need not give more details, just fly and see with your own eyes.

Thanks again, 
Alvaro and Vanessa

Our tour today was really wonderfull, best weather, best plane and best pilot! Our family enjoyed the flight very much. We saw everything and more... We would like to encourage everybody to do the same. Thanks again Josh, Ellen and Bruce.

review_title: Spectular, imformative and incrediably family friendly.
review_text:
We had such a great time on our recent flight with Wings Over Kauai that I just had to post this short review.

My husband and I took our 20 month old on his first small plane today and I couldn't have asked for a better experience. Ellen, Bruce and our pilot Josh were incredibly friendly, welcoming and informative. The plane set up was fantastic with every passenger getting a window set....and I just loved Ellen's genuine concern that the windows were not clean enough so she fixed them up herself before take off. I can't begin to explain how truly magical the flight is. Every turn and every corner had a new spectacular view. We tossed up getting a plane or helicopter and are so happy with our decision. Not only is it great value for money but I actually think the views are just as good if not better....giving us a broader view if the coast and canyon.

SO if you are considering a flight in Kauai I couldn't recommend this more highly...enjoy!!

review_title: My Favorite Activity While Visiting On A Cruise!
review_text: We had only one day in Kauai while visiting the islands on a cruise.  I had read these reviews and so booked the flight for our group of 4.  I am so glad I did!  They could not be friendlier, the flight was amazing and was truly the greatest way to get a good overview of the beautiful island of Kauai.  Our pilot, Josh, was personable and really just great to fly with.  They are cheaper than the helicopter tours and frankly, I think I prefer this whole experience.  I can't wait to visit Kauai again, and I would happily fly with WOK again.  THANKS for such a great and memorable experience!

review_title: Wings Over Kauai Saved the Day
review_text: The hotel booked a flight for my Husband and I through another plane carrier.  We arrived at 11 for our 11:30 departure to find out they had engine troubles at 8 that morning and couldn't fly until later that afternoon.  They did not bother to call and let us know so we drove an hour to get there to find this out.  We wanted to fly just not waste the whole day to do it.  We went to Wings Over Kauai and they made room for us.  Bruce brought out the small Plane just for us, they were $10 cheaper and we had an amazing experience.  He knew so much about the island and the things to look at.  They gave us a free CD of the Experience and a picture of us with the plane.  It was a fantastic experience and they saved the day!!  Thank you Bruce great operation!

Thank u so much for amazing adventure, we had so much fun and u made our trip unforgettable. Bruce is so much fun and so knowledgeable about island and Sophie in the office is just as sweet as she could be. Everyone from Wings over Kauai will make sure that u will get amazing experience for half a price of the helicopter ride, but with even more fun. Do yourself a favor and do not look any more ... this is it! Mahalo Bruce and everyone from Wings over Kauai.

Today we went on a Wings Over Kauai tour.  It was definitely one of the highlights of our stay on the island!  Sophia checked us in and made us feel comfortable and welcomed.  After a quick picture in front of the plane, we boarded and were shown how to use the headset that would allow us to talk with one another throughout the flight.  Josh, the pilot, was wonderful.  He gave us a lot of interesting information about the history and current events of Kauai.  He took us over the coast, Waiemea Canyon, the Napali Cliffs, and many waterfalls.  Being quite fearful of flying, I was surprised at how much I thoroughly LOVED this trip!  We highly recommend this experience to anyone visiting Kauai, both for the excellent views and the great customer service!

review_title: great way to get a different perspective of the island
review_text: We have driven and boated around the island the several times we have been here.  Seeing it from the air in a fixed wing aircraft was amazing.  Working with a company committed to a great customer experience and a knowledgeable pilot made this the perfect way to see Hau'ai in a whole new way.

review_title: Wings Over Kauai is a Lifetime Experience
review_text: If you come to Kauai, please make the most of your trip by taking an aerial plane tour with Wings Over Kauai. You'll find all sorts of offers for all sorts of helicopter and plane tours, but book with Wings. Josh, the pilot, and the rest of the staff are warm and friendly and very professional. Everything from the first email inquiry to getting secured on the plane was managed perfectly. I enjoyed Josh's descriptions of the geological formations and Kauaian history as we fly over the island. The beauty of the island just can't be described - and can't be viewed in any other way. It was relaxing and awe inspiring at the same time. We even saw a whale shark while flying over the ocean. After we landed and got off the plane, Josh gave us a DVD of the flight with our photo on the cover. That's the kind of attention to detail and friendliness that sets Wings Over Kauai above the others. I highly recommend them!

We wanted to do something special for our anniversary and decided to fly over Kauai.  We were on a cruise ship and were very limited in the time available to us.  Ellen picked us up close to the cruise ship terminal and explained the tour to us.  When we arrived at the airport the plane we were going to fly on had to have an adjustment and if we waited we would not have been able to get back to our ship in time.  Bruce made arrangements for my husband and I to fly in a Cessna for the tour and also gave us a DVD with some scenes from a fliht over Kauai and sent us a photo with the plane. Our pilot was very informative and you could tell he really love the island.  He explained history, a little about the geography and showed us were many films were shot.  It was an incredible tour and I am so glad that I was able to make the flight.  It was one of the highlights of our trip.

We had a great flight over Kauai taking in the spectacular scenery. I rang in the morning and was able to get a flight in the afternoon which was great. Their website is really easy to use and they were really helpful over the phone and when we went to check in. The pilot, Josh, was really friendly and pointed out all the points of interest.
I would highly recommend the flight to anyone going to Kauai and definitely fly with Wings Over Kauai.

I am a student pilot and my wife and I went up for a lesson in Bruce's Cessna 172. What an amazing experience!  Bruce is very knowledgable, both on many aspects of the island's natural and cultural history as well flight instructions!  His calm demeanor is very helpful with the flying instructions yet he kept my wife engaged in the tour. I highly recommend Wings over Kauai.
Mario and Dona.

review_title: One of the best parts of our honeymoon
review_text: My husband and I took a flight with Captain Josh at Wings Over Kauai, and it was an amazing experience.  We debated about whether to do a helicopter tour or this tour, and we are so glad we went with Wings Over Kauai.  The views were incredible, and we got a ton of great photos from the very large windows.  I really appreciated that they only booked one other couple on our flight, even though the plane could hold six passengers, in order to make the flight more comfortable and to allow everyone to see the views from the right side of the plane.  I had emailed Ellen before our trip with some questions, and she was extremely helpful.  Captain Josh was excellent, providing informative commentary without being cheesy.  We highly recommend Wings Over Kauai and would not hesitate to take another flight with them when we come back to Kauai.

As a family with three young children (all under 6) and another on the way, many of the exciting things to do in Kauai were not practical so we decided to take a plane tour. To be honest I was a little concerned that our kids would be a little scared, but they loved the adventure of wearing headphones and walking on the tarmac. The plane ride was smooth, and touch downs and take offs where much less jarring then the US Air flights we came and left on. Our pilot Josh, was excellent, he was good with the kids, showed us all the interesting things on the island, and as a result of some of the points of interest he recommended we explored some things we might not have otherwise done.  Not only did we get a wonderful flight, they gave us a beautiful DVD and even e-mailed us photos all before we were out of the parking lot, without the up sale. I know there are other operators on the island but if you want a truly personal and intimate experience this is the group for you.

Ellen and Bruce do a wonderful job tailoring the flight to fit your interests. My wife and I chose to take a Flight Instruction hour with Bruce which allowed myself the ability to fly and see the beautiful Island of Hawaii! Absolutely amazing experience. We also found it to be three times less expensive compared to the helicopter rides. Truly a must do if you hope to see the entire island during your stay in Kauai! Thank you for the cd of pictures, that was an extra special touch we really appreciated.

This was our second flight with Wings over Kauai and when we come back will do it again.  It's the best way to see the island and Ellen, Bruce and Josh make it such an enjoyable experience as well.  Highly recommend!

Acabamos escolhendo voar de avião porque não havia disponibilidade de helicópteros mas foi a melhor coisa que nos aconteceu.

O pequeno avião nos deu a verdadeira sensação de voar. Muito tranquilo e silencioso. A trilha sonora escolhida pelo piloto Bruce foi perfeita para fazer a experiencia ser marcante.

A vista é incrível e as paisagens inesquecíveis. A equipe da empresa realmente faz você se sentir bem.  

Recomendo a todos voar pela Wings Over Kauai.

This was my first experience of this kind. and I am glad it began with this operator.  The crew ( Capt Josh, Ellen and Ciera) was excellent. We arrived an hour early for the 11'o clock ride. The team checked us in and guided us to Wailua falls that was hardly 5 miles from their office which I covered in 40 min. Capt Josh was very informative and ensured that we all engaged in an interactive conversation. We especially liked the way he pointed out the scenes from Hollywood flicks that were shot in various spots in the island. Now about the view, I simply think even if you cover the spots by land or sea an aerial view is unmatched for. The hidden falls, canyon and Na'pali coast line are just few spots that are insanely beautiful that you should see from up in the sky! You will never regret the experience.

Fantastic experience! The staff was so friendly, welcoming and professional. We always felt at ease and very safe throughout. Captain Josh was a wealth of information. Even having been to Kauai 4 times, I learned things I didn't know before. Bring a camera and make sure it's charged and with plenty of space on the memory card - I had to delete about 100 old photos while flying over the Na Pali Coast... not my best move! 

Highly recommend!

review_title: Memorable experience and the best air tour for family with kids
review_text: I strongly recommend Wings over Kauai, it was a 65 min tour and the pilot ( I forget his name), was so friendly and gave us a thorough commentary of all the spots we saw. The plane ride itself was smooth. Me ( pregnant) with our 3 yr old son and my husband enjoyed it very much. Our son was a champ, he saw the mountains for a while and then fell asleep. The ride was not bumpy or nauseating for me. The headsets keep the noise off the engines... it was quite windy and it was nice that they had blankets. The airplane was small enough to hold 6 of us comfortably. We saw waterfalls, beautiful waimea canyon, sacred pool, Napali coast and the entire island covered with rocky and sandy beaches. This is a must do event, if you are planning to relax and not do anything else. We also recieved complimentary kukui shells lei and a very nice family photo infront of their plane. Thank you WOK for a memorable experience.

review_title: No wonder this consistently gets "excellent" reviews
review_text: The experience from end to end was excellent.  From the first email we received from Ellen to the hand shakes at the end, we always felt welcomed and appreciated.  What other tour guides remember everybody's names and asks about you and your family,  and really listens to your answers?  Who else makes you their friends from the first second you meet?  This is not a tour that gets you in and gets you out as if you were cattle.  It is customized, relaxed, and fun.  Pay half as much and get three times more than the helicopter tours, including the special touch at the end.  I was able to get fantastic photos.  Every seat is a good seat.  Even Bruce's rendition of tunes from South Pacific flying over Hanalei Bay was an unexpected bonus.  Mahalo Ellen and Bruce

This was a great alternative to the helicopters which we weren't crazy about using. The two of us were celebrating our 35th anniversary and booked a flight on the smaller of their two planes (a cessna).  It was a FANTASTIC  excursion, especially for those people like us who don't want to be packed into a noisy vibrating helicopter with a bunch of other people.  My husband and I ended up with a private tour at a much lower price than what the helicopters were charging.  Amazing!  From where we took off, we could see the helicopters loading and taking off non-stop and ours seemed to be a much more relaxed and peaceful trip.  We were in the air for abt 1 hr 15 mins. and even though we couldn't hover or go as slowly or fly as low as the copters, we were still "blown away" by the trip.  Both Ellen (one of the owners) who did a great job with the registration and the details, and Josh (our pilot) were terrific. He was personable, knowledgeable and made sure we were comfortable.  It was a great overview of the beautiful island of Kauai and a great idea to do early in your trip as you can see from the air many of the places that you will want to visit. When we landed I found myself crying- not sure if it was because I was sad the trip was over, or was just overcome by the whole experience.  We will always have special memories of this trip.

From the minute we arrived at the terminal and were greeted by Sherry and Capt. Bruce it was a wonderful experience. We felt that we came to see our good, old friends whom we haven’t seen for a long time. The check in took only a few minutes and we were ready to board the plane.  Bruce is an expert pilot who has flown over 5,000 flights over Kauai so you may feel extremely safe, relax and enjoy the flight.  The flight experience was out of this world; with the cost being very reasonable we recommend everyone visiting Kauai to take a flight. In addition to being an expert pilot Capt. Bruce has a vast knowledge of the island history, flora, fauna, etc., which he shared with us during the flight.  We highly recommend taking a flight with the “Wings over Kauai”!!!

Chamil and Tatiana, Colorado, USA

After much comparison, my wife and I chose to tour Kauai with Captain Bruce and "Wings Over Kauai".  Prior reviews said that "Wings Over Kauai" was a better value than helicopter tours based on cost and time in the air. They also said Captain Bruce was the best pilot and tour guide.  Sherry, Captain Bruce, and the whole "Wings Over Kauai" experience was amazing. The "Wings Over Kauai" experience lived up to and exceeded all of our expectations. Captain Bruce was knowledgeable, funny, personable, and experienced.  We're very pleased with our choice and would highly recommend this tour to others.

Do not miss this flight. Very friendly and super professional team at Wings Over Kauai. Incredible scenery and majestic views from the plane. Josh the pilot inspired confidence and was a great guide, very personable. Also a great value.

We flew with Capt Josh on the 5th of oct and couldn't have had a more wonderful experience!! Ellen and Josh treated us like family as soon as we walked up, even though we were late!!! Having said that, they didn't short change us on the time we were up in the air.  We were up for a solid hour and had a great flight.  Josh really knows the island and was able to take us to all the highlight spots and a few extra!! We had an over cast day so our pics didn't come out as sharp but that has nothing to do with the tour.  I thought that the excellent reviews might be overrated, but was pleasantly surprised that WoK REALLY lives up to the 5 star ratings!! We went with our 7 and 9 yr olds and they made it so fun for all of us.  Definitely take this tour for guaranteed views of Kauai.  Plus, its less than half the cost of helicopter!! Thanks all at Wings, even Millie!!! :)

My husband, 13-year-old daughter, and I took a tour with Wings Over Kauai and had a wonderful time. Definitely one of the major highlights of our trip. We had Captain Bruce and one other passenger with us. The plane was quite comfortable and we all sat by the window. I was glad we chose this over the helicopter tour. It's a small family-owned operation and every person we came into contact was wonderful. Very friendly and helpful. 

Bruce gave us a great tour. Very knowledgeable about the area and pretty entertaining. Great personality. 

You can't beat the price and the experience is wonderful. The best way to see Na Pali Coast and the Waimea Canyon. They also take pictures of your party and give you a dvd with the photos when you leave at no additional charge. Who does that? Nobody these days except Wings Over Kauai! They are just good people. Period. 

I highly recommend this activity to anyone spending time on Kauai. You won't regret it and I'll bet it will be the higlight of your trip.

After taking two helicopter tours of Kauai we decided to try something different.  Wings Over Kauai proved to be amazing.  It offers a totally different prospective and provided one of the most amazing experiences we have had on the islands.  We were fortunate enough to be able to fly in their Cessna which has seating only for two passengers and provided us with a very personal and private experience.  Captain Bruce is not only a great pilot - take off and landing smooth as can be - but a knowledgable guide who has a vast expertise of the flora and fauna of the island.  

The entire crew was outstanding making us feel welcome and part of their flying family.  From the time we arrived at the terminal until the time we left they called us by name, looked after our needs and answered any question thrown at them.  

While I am a photo buff and looked forward to getting some great pictures I found myself so preoccupied with the fantastic views that I really didn't take as many pictures as I though I would.  I would recommend this experience to anyone visiting Kauai and would book the trip again if I were to return.

This was definitely one of the highlights of our week in Kauai.  I have taken a helicopter tour in Kauai before and while it is definitely what you want to do if you have the extra cash and don't get motion sickness, this is an excellent (and significantly cheaper) alternative.  Ellen and Captain Josh could not have been more friendly during both the booking process and the flight itself.  We lucked out with amazing weather and the ride was incredibly smooth.  It will definitely be one of the best hours you spend in Kauai and I could not recommend Wings Over Kauai more strongly.  There is a reason they are ranked #1!

review_title: Awesome tour and definitely felt safe!
review_text:
I've never taken a small plane tour before so I didn't know what to expect, but it was a fantastic way to see the island and it wasn't scary at all!  I popped a Dramamine an hour before the flight, but I probably would have been fine without it since pur pilot, Bruce, flew and landed the plane super smoothly--all while giving us lots of trivia and facts about Kauai!  There were 4 passengers on the plane and we all had great views out our windows!!

I really enjoyed the experience, especially the unexpected ginger chews, kukui nut lei, and photographs they gave us! :)  And the $120 price point was much cheaper than the price point the helicopter tours were charging.

review_title: very nice flight - with some caveats
review_text:
I wanted to do the helicopter tour, but knowing that my wife couldn't handle it (motion sickness) and wasn't up to it, we decided to take the plane tour .. its a good alternative, although perhaps less thrilling. the flight felt safe and we all had nice window seats (2 other pax) .. the pilot was a new guy who had just started working for the owner .. he may not have been 100% familiar with Kauai (I think he mentioned he had just moved there) however he was friendly and informative enough. 

Towards the end, we did hit some bad weather and my wife felt nauseated but overall it was a great experience! (try to sit on the RHS.. for best views of Na Pali )

We booked with Wings Over Kauai while visiting on the Pride of America. Our flight was on 9/27/2012 and we had Cap't Josh. It was beyond amazing!!! We walked over to the ABC store- a very short walk from the ship- and Bruce picked us up. Sophia and Ciera got us all checked in and ready for our flight. And Ellen gave us a ride back to the Marriott by the ship when we were done, so we met all the staff and everybody was so nice and helpful! The flight itself was just stunning. Kauai was our favorite of the islands and this tour was our favorite tour by far! We all had mics so we could talk with Josh and ask questions and he did a great job of pointing things out and answering our questions. I would definitely do this tour again if I'm ever lucky enough to be back in Kauai!! Mahola, Stan and Mary- Texas

We are here on our honeymoon, and a friend of ours purchased these tickets for us. At first we were hesitant because we were thinking of doing the helicopter, but this by far exceeded our expectations. Not only was the staff helpful and friendly, our captain was very informative since he came from an agricultural background.  We got an in depth experience. Thanks wings over Kauai were definetly gonna spread the word about you guys! Aloha Chris and Jen

Eines der wichtigsten Dinge, die man(n) in Kauai machen sollte, ist ein Rundflug mit Wings Over Kauai Tours. Entgegen der unpersönlichen Massenabfertigung bei den Helicopter-Anbietern, bekommt man hier ein ganz persönliches Programm geboten. Das Team besteht aus Bruce (Owner, Pilot), Ellen und Josh (Pilot). Alle waren unwahrscheinlich nett und zuvorkommend. Josh flog mit uns (2+2) eine Stunde um die Insel und wir konnten alle Highlights von Kauai - liebvoll und sehr anschaulich kommentiert - anfliegen. Dazu gab es eine DVD mit persönlichem Foto, Getränke, eine Kette und eine frische Blume (alles im Preis inkludiert!). Es war wirklich ein fantastisches Erlebnis. Many Thanks to Josh and Team!

We took a flight with Bruce (the owner) on 10-2-12.
I am a licensed pilot and can tell you Bruce is extremely professional and we were very comfortable with his skills and local knowledge.
I have taken many helicopter tours of this beautiful island and I can tell you Wings over Kauai beats them all.
The aircraft is very comfortable, much less vibration and quieter than any helicopter I ever flew on.   The views from the wide, clean windows were spectacular.
I recommend this tour without hesitation.
10 thumbs up.

Me and my mom just got back from Hawaii. This flightseeing tour was by far, the best thing we did on our vacation!!!! I have a little bit of an anxiety when flying, I was in the copilot's seat, and the Capt.made me feel very comfortable! He kept talking to me and that relaxed me somewhat!! Felt safe and enjoyed it! Beautiful scenery and awesome tour!!! Couldn't have asked for anything better! Great value for the money also! We flew over an hour! The entire staff made this trip wonderful for me and my mom!!! Thank you!!!
Rhonda and Marie, from Texas

My husband and I, and our 6 year old daughter took a wonderful plane ride with Bruce, our very knowledgable and hospitable pilot. We flew in the Cessna which seats the pilot, co-pilot, and two passengers (my husband was the co-pilot).The island was gorgeous from the air, so I would highly recommend a tour by air. If you can afford the helicopter tour I would recommend that, but for those on a budget (like us) I would highly recommend Wings Over Kauai. I received a beautiful necklace at check-in, a free DVD at the end of the flight, and had wonderful photos of my family emailed to us within an hour of our flight. Excellent customer service, fun trip, and great free gifts to remember the trip.

review_title: A great way to see the island!
review_text: We were looking for a fun birds-eye tour of Kauai and we found it with this tour! Since we wanted a more intimate experience, Ellen recommended the two of us take the Cessna plane instead, which was a great choice! Bruce was an excellent and knowledgeable pilot, and we would certainly suggest this tour to people looking for a different Kauai experience.

My husband and I booked this tour separately while on the cruise ship "Pride of America."  Ellen responded quickly to each email.  We were met at the ABC store right outside the pier and driven at no additional cost to the airport.  This particular day four of us flew with Josh in the larger plane.  Two additional people flew with Bruce in the smaller plane.  The larger plane could have accomodated all of us.  However, Ellen and the staff wanted everyone to have the best possible seats to view everything.  Josh did an awesome job narrating everything we saw.  It really helped that we had driven the coast the day before in a rental car, so we had a better idea of what we were seeing.  In addition, Josh made a couple of extra passes, so we were able to get a closer shot with our cameras.  I was amazed at how smooth the flight was, particularly the take-off and landing.  When we landed, we were ready to pay and do it again.  When we returned to the cruise ship, we met several other people who flew with Wings Over Kauai.  Everyone agreed this was the best tour we could have possibly done.  We always try to book privately and not through the cruiseline.  It helps the independent small business owner.  This company goes above and beyond when it comes to customer service.  We will definitely do this tour again when we return to Kauai.  If you cruise on Norwegian's Pride of America, rent a car the first day in port and drive the island. (We started driving at 8:30 a.m. and returned the car at 8:00 p.m. and saw the entire island.) Fly with Wings Over Kauai on the second day, since day two is a shorter length of time.  Thanks Ellen, Bruce, and Josh for making this adventure the best anyone could hope for.

I booked this tour on-line a few months before leaving home. Ellen returned my inquiry Right away and gave me the directions for our pick up site at the Anchor Cove Mall which was just a short walk from where our cruise ship was docked.

We had a sunny clear day for our pilot Bruce to take us around the entire island. Much of the spectacular scenery on Kauai can only be easily seen from the air. The Napali coast and the waterfalls that appear on the side of luscious mountainsides was incredible. We were only in Kauai for one day, yet we're able to see the entire island on this tour. Everything was a-one, you can't find any better customer service than what is consistently provided by this family run business. I highly recommend this tour.
Their web site was clear and easy to understand, and their prices were absolutely unbeatable and the service was top notch, best experience by far.

This tour is an awesome and exciting way to see the island. Our pilot did a great job of telling us facts about the island while we enjoyed the sights/took pictures. Also they setup the plane (only 4 people instead of 8) so that everyone has a right side view.They accommodated us the next day and overall excellent experience from start to finish.

We went with Josh for an afternoon tour. From the moment we arrived the staff was extremely friendly and helpful.  The Lady ( sorry forgot her name) at reception was super helpful and outgoing. We were greeted with flowers and a kukui nut lei. They were kind enough to give my 15 month old daughter a little stuffed bear :) The flight was very smooth, and Josh was very informative and friendly. You can see many stops on the island not accessible by car. Upon our return the staff provided us with a video and a photo taken of our family pre flight. I don't think you will find better value for your money on Kauai, even if they doubled their prices. This is a great sight seeing adventure for anyone interested in seeing Kauai from the air.

Bruce was a wonderful pilot who made our tour of the island a memorable experience.  He was very knowledgeable and was very friendly.  The views from the plane were amazing!  And Ellen was very nice and helpful as well.  My brother, nephew and I had a great time and would highly recommend Wings Over Kauai to all of our friends and family.

I am a very bad flier.  Very nervous, can't handle turbulence, etc. So when my husband asked if I wanted to go on a flight on a very small plane through Wings Over Kauai I wasn't exactly sold...

Having now done it (and survived!!) all I can say is, wow.  This is such an amazing experience and I'm so happy we chose Wings Over Kauai.  

Booking a flight was easy and Ellen responded quickly to all of our emails.  She also sent perfect directions so we arrived at the terminal and parked with no issues.

When we arrived Ellen prepped us for the flight by giving us some tips and asking if we have issues with motion sickness (I do), then she gave me a beautiful kukui nut lei and took a picture of us in front of the plane.

She helped me get situated in the front of the plane and gave me peppermint and ginger chews to help with motion sickness. They also have small bottles of water on the plane.

Bruce was our pilot and he was amazing. He's very calm and knows absolutely everything about Kauai so kept up a soothing commentary throughout the flight. I had a bit of a death grip on my chair every time we hit a bump in the air but as Bruce was so calm and in control it really helped me enjoy the flight much more than I thought possible.  Takeoff and landing were very smooth and we were lucky to have a pretty smooth flight. The views are stunning and you get to see parts of the island you'd never easily be able to access otherwise, this is a must do on Kauai!

A warm and personable staff - and friendly, experienced pilot, Josh - made for a very memorable experience. The flight was smooth and beautiful and we got some pretty amazing photos of the NaPali coast, waterfalls, the majestic mountains, Waimea Canyon, Hanalei Bay...
Mahalo, Wings Over Kauai!

First of all, Kauai is an awesome place. Above all, it's the people that make it even more awesome. Ellen and Bruce are among those people. 

The tour takes a little over an hour. You park directly at the private terminal. If you are prone to motion sickness then it is advisable to take care of it before you begin the tour. Don't forget to bring the camera because the views from above are gorgeous. In retrospect, I think that it should have been the first thing that we should have done because Bruce is very knowledgeable about the island and not averse to a lot of questions. In fact he welcomes them and keeps checking in on you throughout the flight. By the end of the tour, you are able to plan your itinerary and know about the spots to hit according to your time on the island. 

When you check in, Ellen is a great host and very personable. She followed up with us with a couple of photos through email and even gave us separate DVDs of the beautiful video shot by their son who is an aspiring cinematographer in Hollywood. My only suggestion would be to upgrade it to HD video. 

Great people, great tour, great island. Thanks Ellen and Bruce. Don't do air or water, do both, especially, for Na Pali. I am still not done with Kauai.

Donna and I were looking for a quality aerial view of the island and we decided to take the plane instead of a helicopter tour. Wings Over Kauai Tours had a nice website and Ellen got back with us thru email very quickly.

Once we got there, we were so warmly greeted by Bruce, Sherry, Sofia, and Josh that you would have thought we were long time friends. Bruce showed us the controls and talked us thru the whole takeoff and where we flying. Donna was a little nervous since she never had flown in a small aircraft.

Once we were airborne, she was so excited with the views and Bruce was so good at describing the scenery and the history of Kauai. We were blown away with the island and the many scenic points of interest.

Anyone who wants a great view of the island should consider Wings Over Kauai first. You won't be disappointed...

Mark and Donna Hawley
Knoxville, TN

review_title: The best flight charters in Kauai!
review_text: Having seen the positive reviews from fellow travelers on Trip Advisor, we decided to take an aerial trip of Kauai with Wings Over Kauai. Thanks to Ellen and Bruce for making this experience great. Our flight in charge was Capt Josh, who is also a full time pilot with American Airlines. He gave us a great aerial trip of Kauai and shared lot of facts of Kauai that we would not have known otherwise. I must say that we were impressed by quality of the customer service received, personal attention, and got good value for money. Front desk person, Sofia, was polite and handled our requests very well since we were traveling with a 6 month old and they treated us well.

Everything about this trip was enjoyable, from friendly check in to breathtaking flight. Went with my wife and 2 boys (age 8 and 6) and we all loved it. The views are spectacular and Capt. Bruce was informative and professional. We HIGHLY recommend taking this excursion!

review_title: Excellent tour- a must do in Kauai
review_text: My family of four adults went on a tour with Wings over Kauai. It was one of the best things on our trip to Kauai. What a beauty it was to look at Kauai from the sky.  The tour was detailed with friendly descriptions throughout the tour by our pilot Josh. Ellen is a very friendly and professional person, so was Josh, our pilot. On the whole, Wings over Kauai tour was safe and enjoyable at the same time with the professional and  friendly arrangements made by Ellen and her team! A definite 5 star and a must- do in Kauai.

user_location: New York, New York, United States
review_text: This was an excellent tour over the Kauai island. The all experience was amazing !! Sophia takes care of the reservations and to get all set up in the plane. She is very friendly and really takes care of you. You are in a small airplane with only three other people plus the pilot and get a right side seat which is where you want to be. Customer Service is top notch. Josh the pilot is very friendly and knows the island very well. You get headphones and Josh describes the sights in great detail. You can ask questions through the headset.  You get a photo and an email after that with an electronic copy. This is by far a highly recommended service. Fantastic overall experience.

We had a perfect time with the folks at Wings over Kauai. Our pilot for the day was Josh, who made it a memorable ride with his little insights, friendly interactions and a perfect flight. The guys are extremely friendly, make it very personal and don't pack the flight to keep it that way. One memorable ride, will definitely recommend!

Booked the trip ahead of time based on everyone reviews. It definately did not disappoint. Josh was fabulous and they really took care of us. They ask if anyone gets motion sickness or queasy and if you do they ensure that the little cooler on the plane has water, a cold compress and ginger chews. Unfortunately our teenage daughter got sick, nothing to do with the flight since it was smooth. Josh and the staff were so nice to her when they found out, she sufffers in silence this one. They were reasonable priced for a family of four, we didn't have to worry about getting window seats since everyone did and we were the only ones on the plane. Husband and son loved that we had to line up on the tarmack like the regular commercial planes, for them that was part of the thrill. Josh was super knowledgeable and pleasant. Would not hesitate to go back on them again and would highly recommend them to anyone who wanted a flight.

The staff at Wings over Kauai are very nice and friendly. It is a pleasant experience from making the reservation to check in to the tour itself.  We have four passengers on a six-passenger plane and we all seat on the right-side window seats with great view during the flight.   The lady gets a flower, each group gets a photo taken with the plane, then after flight we get a DVD which contains a short version of the flight.   

It is a great way to see Na Pali coast and many waterfalls.  Add it to your Kauai must-do list.

review_title: Best Air Value on the Island!
review_text: My family of 4 had a personal plane ride over Kauai with Capt. Josh, a very comfortable and confident pilot for the most amazing views of the island.  Sandy and Josh made us feel extremely at home and comfortable at the airport and on the plane.  The views are so gorgeous that you forget you're in a small plane and the natural nervousness that goes with it.  Josh knew everything about the island, answered all our questions and our pictures turned out fantastic.  So happy my husband pushed this ride!

There is no other way to see many parts of the island.  Bruce and crew make it a very personable and warm experience.  Bruce has insights to share that most guides would not think of and his local life and experience make it an entirely interesting trip.  Thank you so much for a fantastic Hawaii experience!

To see Kauai you need a plane tour. Wings over Kauai doesn't use helicopters which fly lower but cost $50-$100 more per person. Being family run its very personal. There are 4 window seats to the right and you get one of them without any surcharges. The first one next to the pilot requires helping the pilot a bit but is probably the best one specially if you are tall enough to see thru the front window as well. The last one is the smallest but its easier to avoid the wings in your photos from that seat. In the 1hr trip you see everything worth seeing including Jurassic falls from a distance. They gave us a DVD of the trip free in the $120 price. Overall it was 4.5 stars not 5 as the plane was old - you could tell from the seats, wing nuts, fuel leaks, scratches on the window etc. Also the DVD wasn't filmed with a high def, even my pocket camera could do better. With some upgrades they would be 5 stars.

Wings Over Kauai was an excellent tour of the beautiful island of Kauai. It was also at a reasonable price. It was definitely one of our highlights of our trip. Bruce the pilot was very friendly and landed the plane so smoothly. We saw breathtaking views and really didn't feel like we missed ouit on a helicopter ride at all. They gave me a beautiful lei necklace, a flower for my hair, and a wonderful DVD of Kauai as a gift. I would highly recommend this tour!!!!

[---]Qué gente más fantástica y que increible tour. Todo fue perecfecto, desde el principio hasta el final. Es evidente que disfrutan de su trabajo. Todo el mundo tiene perfectas vistas (lado derecho de la avioneta). No puedo comparar la experiencia con hacerla en helicóptero porque no la hice, pero no cambiaría mi elección.

review_title: Outstanding value compared to helicopter tours, especially for passengers in the 250+ weight class
review_text:
Our goals were simple: find an air tour of the Napili coast of Kauai for a party of five that included a Samoan sized gentleman (well north of the 250 lbs. weight class but well loved), preferably a private charter, that was stable enough to allow all to see from the right side windows.

WHat a relief to find Wings over Kauai. They were perfect.  From the moment we met Josh, we knew we were in capable hands.  For $500 we booked a private tour of the entire island where the only weight restriction was an 1,100 pound total passenger load. No extra charges for empty seats for the larger passenger as demanded by the helicopter operators.

All in,  we paid less than half the cost demanded by the helicopter tours and know we enjoyed a smooth private flight with more than enough excitement for all.

My husband and I traveled to Kauai for our 25th anniversary and scheduled a couple of things based on reviews that I read on Tripadvisor.  Everything positive we read about Wings Over Kauai was absolutely true.  From the beginning stages of booking online they were very personable in their communication.  When we arrived we were greeted with enthusiasm.  The ladies get a lovely necklace and flower as a welcome gift.  The plane was very comfortable and they included a small cooler with drinks, wet towels in case you got a little queasy and mints to help as well. Bruce was so informative and you can tell he loves what he does.  The views were absolutely breathtaking.  When we landed we were given a very nice DVD of the sights we had seen with our picture on the cover.  It was a super day.  As my husband and I waited for our flight another group from a different tour company returned from a flight and they were very quiet and no real interaction with each other...when the group from Wings Over Kauai returned you would have thought they were all old friends.  The laughter and ease with this group and the crew spoke volumes and told me right away that we had chosen well.  Thank you to Ellen, Bruce and Kathy for a wonderful wonderful day!!

review_title: Du suchst nach einer besonderen Erfahrung? Dann bist du hier richtig.
review_text:
Wir haben uns gestern kurzfristig entschlossen einen Rundflug zu buchen. Fernab der Massenabfertigung. Aufgrund der Empfehlungen auf tripadvisor haben wir uns für "Wings over Kauai" entschieden und wurden nicht enttäuscht. 
Wir wurden herzlich empfangen und fühlten uns sofort richtig gut aufgehoben. Nach einer kurzen Einweisung starteten wir mit unserer Cessna. Außer Bruce, unserem Piloten, waren nur wir beide an Bord. Wir hatten trotz nicht optimalem Wetter eine herrliche Aussicht und konnten tolle Photos machen. Bruce erklärte uns viel und machte so einige Scherze, die uns zum lachen brachten. Am Ende gabs eine DVD mit Flugaufnahmen von Kauai und per Email erhielten wir noch ein Foto von uns, das vor dem Flug mit der Cessna aufgenommen wurde.

Wer abseits vom Massentourismus ein eher familäres Flugerlebnis sucht, ist hier wunderbar aufgehoben. Highly recommended :-)

I wanted to let you know how great our experience with Wings of Kauai was.  Our party consisted of 4 teachers from New Jersey.  From the moment we were picked up bu Sophie we realized that we were on a great adventure.  Our pilot Josh was very knowledgeable of the island and made the ride enjoyable for us.  Some of us were a little nervous on the idea o flying in a plane.  However, Josh made us comfortable with the ride.  The sights he pointed out and the information he gave us made the trip extremely enjoyable.  We saw things on this trip that we don't get to see in our little state of New Jersey!  The customer service on this tour was absolutely fantastic.  We truly enjoyed the trip over the island and will be recommending this tour to everyone we know that is heading to Hawaii.  Thank you so much for the wonderful experience!

I've had in the past many experiences with other companies but this was is faaar on the top pf my list:
Few things that place them in top of my experience:
- easy to book, flexible and friendly
- Ellen and Josh (the pilot) make us feel like in familly, extraordinary people, I wish all business in the world be like this one...than no more recession :-)
-flight was smooth, lots of info from Josh, really unforgatable experience, if you'll go in Kauai this is a must, only 10% of the island can be seen from the road.
-pricewise is better than other competitors, flight time is longer than with other companies and Cessna 172 is best you can get in this airplane class. 
Thanks you guys and big kiss to Millie (Josh's dog, a pure beauty, so cute)

Julie and Daniel

From making reservations to the flight itself, nothing but compliments!  Customer service was excellent and what a great experience. We highly recommend Wings Over Kauai.  We have flown on a float plane before and that was so cramped.  This plane was very comfortable and they didn't try to squeeze people in.  The views were unbelievable.  Ellen and crew are AWESOME!
Wonderful, friendly people!  Our pilot Bruce was so knowledgable!  Enjoyed this so much!  Better than a helicopter if you get queasy and reasonably priced!

My husband and I immensely enjoyed our entire experience with Wings Over Kauai!  It was a pleasure from start to finish.  Ellen was so welcoming when we checked in and Bruce was an excellent pilot and tour guide.  He is knowledgeable about Kauai and provides great commentary during the flight.  I was able to take lots of great photos and loved seeing Kauai from the sky.  I highly recommend choosing Wings Over Kauai if you are considering a sightseeing flight.

A family run business, that thrives on excellent customer service and great value.  Bruce, the owner is a great guide and a steady pilot, with a wealth of knowledge about the island, history, and (because it might come up) agronomy.  The tour is personalized, and the furthest thing from a cookie cutter type tour that is done by rote for everyone.  The pland flies very slowly and is very very stable so no worries about airsickness.  The tour is full of nice touches like a personalized DVD, people who learn your name and remember it, and many many others.

The trip is a great value compared with helicopters, and I highly reccomend it!

We were on Kauai during our honeymoon and decided to take an airplane tour over the island, as we knew that the northern part of it is very beautiful but not accessible by car or on foot. We googled out Wings over Kauai and chose them, as they had the best prices on the island. Elaine was so kind to pick us up at the hotel and to give us a ride to the runaway free of charge, as we did'n have a car. Bruce was our pilot for the tour and made the flight very interesting.
