We at a family of 5 that flies weekly in our own airplane. Bruce did an amazing job and is a very competent pilot. (As his flying was critiqued by 2 other pilots)

Their operation is ran very openly, there is no guess work of what to expect and all questions are answered promptly with actual answers. Black and white!

We would highly recommend this adventure to all, especially aviation types as Bruce lets you help out in the cockpit.

We might have found a job during the winter months while we are in Kauai, if Bruce needs a few more pilots!

Mahalo

Visitors cannot grasp the full beauty of Kaua'i without an aerial tour. If your budget, health, and stomach are not obstacles, go with the helicopter tour. If you are nervous about flying in a small plane or are prone to motion sickness Wings Over Kauai is a perfect choice. Ellen and Bruce own this small business and understand that people need reassurance for air travel in a plane that seems so small and fragile. You can trust that Bruce will not fly if conditions are not right and he will get you off and back safe and sound. Ellen provides ginger candies that really help with queasiness. 
Our preference was  to take the helicopter flight but our budget is limited and we found this tour the best choice. The competitor was doing a brisk business, but I know ours was a superior trip because of the accurate description of everything we saw by Bruce who is  very knowledgeable. Because we chose the airplane trip instead of the helicopter, we were able to afford a boat cruise with Holo-holo that gave us an up close  vantage of the Naal Pali coast. In addition, we rented a car and drove around to see all the views from ground level. 
One of the other reviewers noted a delay in starting due to flooding the engine on take off. This happened at the start of our flight, too--and it was nerve wracking. However, Bruce is calm and reassuring so we didn't feel uneasy about possible problems while in flight.
I had a seat to the left and missed many sights but had a beautifull view of the ocean and saw a whale during the flight.

review_title: Lots of great views.  Able to see the whole island in about an hour
review_text: The views were incredible.  You don't get as close as you would in a helicopter, but views are still impressive.  Since I never took a helicopter cruise I can't say which is better.

Absolutely the best way to see Kauai.  Personable and friendly, from Ellen on the phone to check in with son Carter and Ellen's husband Bruce piloting the plane.  Very knowledgable of the Island.  Having a really nice  sunny day complimented the trip.  Would definately do this trip again.  May next time my camera won't break.  We did get a really nice DVD of the trip as a gift.  Many mahalos to Wings over Kauai for a wonderful day!!!

review_title: this was a highlight of our trip!!!!!
review_text: What a great experience!! This outfit was very professional and helpful. We booked a  morning flight from our cruise ship. They arranged for our transportation to and from the airport. The flight itself was magnificent! If we were to return to Kauai we would definitely do this again.

Sophia welcomed us as we arrived with a warm smile. She was pleasant, informative and prepared us for the flight. We had our picture taken by Carter in front of plane and met our pilot Bruce shortly thereafter. Bruce put everyone at ease from the get go and gave us details about himself, the plane and the tour. THe hour went by too quickly and we were awed by the beauty of the island seen from a different view/perspective. Bruce added anecdotes and trivia along the way. All in all, a wonderful experience. I would HIGHLY recommend this tour to everyone. At the end...we were impressed and surprised with a gift- a DVD of tour with our picture on it. WOW!  Class act from beginning to end!

review_title: Ellen trully made our vacation that much better
review_text: We called Ellen super last minute and she was able to accommodate my wife and I on a flight. We truly recommend heir service, it is personal and friendly and lacks nothing in professionalism , a hard task to achieve. give them a Call, you wont be disappointed .

review_title: A great way to see the entire island
review_text: The staff is great and it's a great way to see the entire Island which you can't do with a car... However, if you are at all uneasy about flying, you should think twice about going up in a small plane. Also, I would suggest bringing a "real" camera and not just using an iPhone camera as you the plane doesn't really get close enough to many of the sites to get quality pictures.

My husband and I took a Wings over Kauai tour in early March 2012.  Bruce and his crew went above and beyond to provide us with an excellent tour- from welcoming us at the door on a first name basis, providing us with reading materials while we waited for the pilot to ready the plane, to opening the door for us as we landed asking us how our flight was.  The plane was able to hold 8 passengers, we only had 3 passengers, my husband and myself and one other.  While many other companies might consider rescheduling or canceling with so few passengers in order to maximize their profit, it appeared Wings over Kauai was interested in providing an exceptional tour and customer experience- big or small profit.  I would recommend this tour to anyone who is considering an air tour in Kauai!

THANK YOU to Ellen, Carter, Sophie and Joel for a truly amazing experience.  The service from my first email was warm and friendly.  The flight itself was spectacular - a gorgeous sunny day after some heavy rains so the waterfalls were really flowing.  I caught myself with an ear to ear grin several times.

I have already recommended Wings Over Kauai to a friend - they are phenomenal.

review_title: Not as good when it's Bruce's day off
review_text: My husband and I visited Kauai in February 2012 with out toddler son and my parents. While there, my parents wanted to do something adventurous and saw Wings Over Kauai was the top attraction on TripAdvisor. My father called to see if any time was available during our last few days on the island and he was able to book a time for himself and my mother to go the next day. They went on the tour and came back to our hotel and just raved about the experience! They had a blast and thought that Capt. Bruce was wonderful and everyone there was so nice. They had such a good time that, even though I was scared to fly in a small plane, talked my husband and I into calling to see if there was any other times available for us to go. There was an opening two days later they were able to fit us in and while excited to go, I was very nervous too. Our flight time arrived and my parents dropped us off at the airport. I was still very nervous about the flight. Carter greeted us and checked us in, he was very nice. The flight before ours arrived back and my father quickly noticed it was not Bruce flying. Carter mentioned it was Bruce's day off. We were sad we didn't get to meet Bruce, whom my parents just raved about, but figured it would still be great. After checking in, we watched out the window as the pilot messed around with the plane hood up. It was not comforting to see that. Then we were taken out to the plane and seated. We met the substitute pilot (and now I can't even recall his name because I was too nervous) and got settled in the plane. The pilot then tried to start the plane and it wouldn't start. Now, I know nothing about planes so as a clueless passenger when a plane won't start, it is a little nerve-wracking. The pilot would try to start it and then we would have to wait about 5 mins and then he would try again. This went on for about 5 times and it finally started on what he said was his final try. I was about ready to demand to get off the plane when it started. And I noticed my parents and son looking out the window in concern as well when were weren't moving. Then I questioned the reliability of the plane for our flight and was basically laughed at by the pilot and another passenger. The flight itself was just OK. The pilot talked a bit about the sights below but really didn't have a conversation with us like my parents (and all the other TripAdvisor reviewers) said Bruce did. He knew I was clearly nervous but did nothing to make sure we felt relaxed. The views were beautiful and it was a nice time but I don't think it was even close to the same experience my parents had. The pilot was friendly but just didn't make it amazing like others mention when they talk about going with Bruce. I would recommend this tour to others but  would say to make sure Bruce isn't off the day they go. I completely understand that he needs a day off, just like everyone else, but they may need to teach the substitute pilot to offer a similar experience to the one Bruce gives. It was just night and day differences between two different tours in two days. I am still giving this a Very Good rating because I know how good it was for my parents and do think it was worth doing.

Ellen, Carter, and Shane were great through the entire process and provided a truly memorable experience.  Kauai had some rough weather and Ellen did a great job of being flexible to allow us to reschedule our flight to when the weather cooperated (helicopters usually will fly in any conditions even if the view is limited and the flight rough).  The plane flight was smooth (in strong winds) and provided a great view of all the key island sights including the Na Pali coast.  I was pleasantly surprised how slow we flew which really helped with enjoying the view and taking pictures.  I would strongly recommend WOK.

JK60

review_title: Best Way to see KAUAI's Napali Coast and Waimea Canyon
review_text: In Feb/Mar 2012, we spent 2 weeks in Hawaii, including 1 week in Waikiki and 1 week on the Pride of America.  We had decided that the best way to see Kauai would be by air, since most of the island is inaccessible by road.  And we didn't want to spend 4 hours on a bus in order to see Waimea Canyon for 20 minutes.  What a great choice we made to fly with "Wings Over Kauai" instead of the ship-sponsored Helicopter flights.  It turned out to be the highlight of our cruise. We were 3 couples.   We hadn't flown before on a small plane.  This is a small family-run company operating out of the Kauai airport.  Our pilot was Bruce Coulombe; the office matters are taken care of by wife Ellen and son Carter.  What a treat they were to deal with.  The plane is maintained by the airport mechanics.  They were very relaxed, friendly, informative, and helpful.  We booked the whole airplane.  The plane is much quieter than the helicopter and MUCH cheaper.  The views were fantastic.  We've got photos to last a lifetime !!!
We had to change the time twice because of weather condition. At last it was just fantastic. We would do it again. Just try it.

review_title: Best views ran by friendly people!!!
review_text:
The moment we got to the airport  Bruce and Carter greeted us with great hospitality.  They're just such nice, inviting people that you can really be comfortable with.  Bruce was our pilot.  He gave us a run down on the plane, the basics on how it works, and how the radio system works.  He remembered all our names and talked to us through the radio mic piece.  He gave us great info on the beaches that we passed by and exactly what they're good for - snorkeling, swimming, etc.  The whole ride was breathtaking.  Especially the Napali Coast.  We were there during whale watching season and could see the whales on the left and the island on the right.  It's definitely worth the money and I would recommend it to anyone that visits.  And I would recommend Wings over Kauai since the people behind it are so personable and warm.  

It was the beginning of a great day that ended in a wedding proposal!  We'll be back in October to get married and maybe we'll fly again with Capt Bruce!
Bruce and Ellen were wonderful!  Went out with Bruce and the flight was so smooth!  We were able to see the entire island!  Excellent tour guide by air.

Bruce and Ellen and very personable and engaging.  What a terrific job of making you feel a part of the process!  For those who have not flown on a small plane, Bruce does an excellent job of involving you in why and what he does from taxi to return.  Not hard to see why they are #1.  We have done both fixed and rotor wing tours and this was the friendliest and best priced yet.
The time will fly by...no pun intended (well maybe).

We were in port with the Pride of America and had our flight scheduled for the last day we were there.  We woke to very cloudy skies which worried us about our flight.  While we were waiting for Wings to pick us up Ellen called and said that they were checking the weather report to see if it was going to be safe to fly...a few minutes later Ellen and Carter showed up to take us to the plane - they explained that it was our choice if we wanted to go up or not but that it was safe flying conditions.  There were us and another couple - we decided to go and at the last minute they decided not to so we had the plane to ourselves.  Our pilot Shane was awesome...made us feel completely at ease and showed us a wonderful time...we saw all kinds of things while we were up.

If you plan on being in Kauai I would HIGHLY recommend taking this flight.

review_title: WIngs Are Better Value Than a Helicopter
review_text: Kauai is stunningly beautiful, yet 80% is inaccessible by car. The best way to see it is by air. We chose Wings over Kauai and it was a great choice. Bruce is a very experienced pilot who shares his passion for this amazing island. Highly recommend.

My girlfriend and I took the trip this week, we flew up with Bruce.  I have to echo other comments on WOK that it is a family business and that really gives you a better feeling when dealing with them.  They're super friendly, they give you cute free stuff both before and after the trip (I don't want to tell you what for the spoiler alert factor).  The trip itself was a little over an hour but frankly I didnt look at my watch once, it was just so enjoyable.  I sat in the co-pilot seat and helped Bruce go through the check list with air traffic control, and he took great care to remember everyones names and where we were from so as to ask questions during the flight.  We went all over the major highlights, everybody has a window seat and I think the plane sat 8-9 people so it could never be packed at the best of times.  Everyone has a radio headset so you can hear and talk to each other, plus hear Bruce chatting with ATC.  It was fun, educational, interesting, honestly, it was just really great and it's about half the price of the helicopter tours and not to sound cheap but, why would you pay more when you can go with WOK.

What a wonderful way to see beautiful Kauai!  We saw the Napali coast, waimea canyon and much more.  Our pilot, Bruce, was excellent.  He and his son, Carter, were very friendly and gave the whole experience a warm, personal touch.  The views were breath taking.  My husband and I couldn't decide between this tour and one on a helicopter.  We're both very happy we chose Wings Over Kauai!  We were concerned that we wouldn't get the dramatic views of a helicopter tour.  We were very pleasantly surprised.  I think we got more panoramic views and the ride was more comfortable.  We highly recommend flying with Bruce!

This tour was perfect in every way. Ellen was wonderful! Pilot Shane was outstanding! And there is nothing to compare to seeing the beauty of Kauai from the air. We paid a little extra for three of us to have the plane to ourselves. It was really worth it because we had prime seats on the plane. We found an overwhelming number of excursions to choose from on Kauai.  This one was worth every penny.
My wife and I are on our honeymoon and we took the Wings over Kauai tour. It was an excellent value and the staff was knowledgable and fun. Great tour! Thanks!

As two retired couples, we looked forward to our scenic flight over the island of Kauai as part of our Hawaii vacation aboard the NCL cruise ship "Pride of America" - and we were very happy with the entire experience. We were picked up near the pier by our friendly host Bruce and taken to the airport to register with another friendly staff member - Sophia. Although our foursome turned into a threesome due to an illness, we had the plane to ourselves  - with Paul, our pilot, showing us the sights of this beautiful island throughout the 65 minute ride. From the southern beaches to the coffee plantations to the gorgeous Waimea Canyon to the breathtakingly impressive Na Pali coast to the numerous waterfalls of the Hanalei Valley, our trip was an amazing experience. Upon returning, we received an unexpected gift - a DVD containing a video recap of our flight itinerary. We were then personally driven back to the ship by our gracious hostess Ellen. It was a truly wonderful morning!  I heartily recommend "Wings Over Kauai" as a great way to see the sights of the island at a very reasonable price.

Highly recommend this tour.  Captain Bruce did a great job.  I normally suffer from air sickness but this ride was so smooth, I felt nothing.  Unfortunately the weather changes quickly so we were unable to fly over the Napali Coast but Bruce still gave us a fantastic tour.
We flew with Capt Bruce in his plane and really enjoyed seeing Kauai from the air.  he did a great job explaining everything we were seeing.

My wife, Carol, and I had the good fortune of finding Bruce and Ellen and took a great flight to sight see from the air the beauty that is Kauai.  Both of them are easy going and down to earth.  Bruce is extremely knowledgeable about the island and a cracker-jack pilot.  The views from the air were wonderful and the aircraft gave a comfortable ride with very good visibility regardless of where you sit. The cost is very reasonable, especially compared with helicopters.  We're going back this November (12) and anticipate flying with Bruce again.

My husband and I booked a flight with Wings Over Kauai for a few reasons: a friend’s recommendation, price (half the cost of a helicopter), online reviews.  We had some trouble booking online but eventually called and got a hold of Ellen, the very nice owner.  We didn’t have to put down a deposit, which I found rare.  A couple of days before our trip, Ellen called because they had double-booked our tour.  Luckily, our schedule was flexible and we could accommodate.  Come the day of the tour, we had pretty good weather, only slightly cloudy, but you could still see everything you needed to see.  Rewinding a bit, when we checked in, Ellen gave me one of those Hawaiian kukui nut necklaces to wear, which was really fun!  As for the tour itself, we saw EVERYTHING.  Our pilot was great and pointed out everything there is to see on Kauai.  The ride itself was relatively smooth.  I got to sit in the front, since I get motion sickness, and this added to the neat experience.  Overall we had a GREAT time.  Afterward, we received a dvd, which I honestly haven’t watched yet; also, a photo of us (taken by Ellen) was emailed to us—great souvenirs!  Above and beyond!  As far as a plane vs. a helicopter tour, we truly saw just as much.  Sure we might not have been able to get as close, but that never took away from the experience.  In short, go with this—it’s cheaper and just as awesome.

Capt. Bruce is actually, Doctor Bruce - a Ph.D in Agronomy who is now living his second life.  This man is a pilot, a flight instruc tor and a tour guide.  The business is run by him, his wife, Ellen and son, Carter.  These are extremely talented, intelligent, caring and knowlegeable people and I would encorage you to engage them via email before your visit.  They are responsive and flexible in meeting your needs.
The fixed wing tour is about half the price of the helicoper tour, but what we were looking for was a complete overview of the island during our first 24 hours here - so we knew what we really wanted to go see.    These folks were professionals in every respect and we enjoyed every aspect of this tour.  Capt. Bruce is a very soft-spoken person with a calming demeanor.  He is extremely knowlgeable about the history of the island, the flora and fauna (in detail, if desired) and ready to point out all of the Hollywood film sites, etc.
If you are looking for freindly service, with a family touch, that is extremely competent on every front - this is the tour for you.  If this does not appeal to you, there are lessor services on the island.  We would book with no one else in the future.

review_title: Really enjoyed the ride. Folks running the company are great as well.
review_text: We had a great time flying with these folks. Ellen was great with the booking process. Her son Carter was good with prepping us for the flight. Dr. Bruce the pilot was great and very knowledgeable. If you need to see Kauai from the air at a very reasonable price and deal with really nice people then this is your place. We were lucky to have the entire plane to ourselves so that was an added bonus. They offered us complementary drinks but we were busy enjoying the view and did not use any. The flight was pretty stable, so much so that my two year daughter slept throughout the hour or so we were flying. Oh and yes parking was free and very convenient.

review_title: So fun and a great  value
review_text:
Bruce (our pilot) was awesome! His assistant was great at prepping us and telling us what we were in for - do's and don'ts, things to look out for, how to use the head sets, etc.

It's truly a great value and you get to see SO MUCH of the island! I would highly recommend this adventure for everyone.

Everyone gets a window view on this 6 seater airplane.  And it's a great way to see the entire island--we did this on our first day in Kauai, a great introduction.  Bruce, the pilot, is very capable  and knowledgable and his wife Ellen gave us some good tips for sightseeing.

Just be aware that this is NOT a helicopter tour. (I know the title says Wings, but I didn't catch that).  So you ride a bit higher in the sky.  The plane ride is more ecological than the helicopter. And you're not contributing to the noise pollution on Kauai!

We went on this tour early January 2012 and what a way to start the new year. The tour covered most of kauai and the views were spectacular.  Bruce is a friendly guy and he does tailor the tour to interests of the party. When we told him that we were originally from India , he took us over the Hindu monastry in kauai, which in itself spellbinding and worth a visit.

Best value for money.

I had been emailing back and forth with Ellen for a couple months prior to our visit to get times figured out - we were on a cruise ship and had limited time. She was so helpful and accommodating. When we actually got there, it was like meeting a long lost friend!  

The flight itself was wonderful. I'd never been in a small plane and Bruce mentioned there was some turbulence - I sure didn't notice it. The views were spectacular, Bruce was full of information and we got to see the breathtaking NaPali coast without doing a lengthy and strenuous hike!

Yeah, you get closer with a helicopter, but knowing my luck, I would have been the one squished in the middle of the back seat. Here I had my very own window - yay!

I surprised my husband by booking a flight tour with Wings Over Kauai and it was the best part of our vacation!  Ellen was quick to answer any questions and I was comfortable with them before even meeting them.  Even though I don't really like to fly (and my husband is a private pilot) Bruce made the trip so enjoyable that I never minded it at all.  We saw parts of the island you could only see from the air.  We haven't stopped talking about this part of our trip ever since the flight and if we ever get back to Kauai, the first thing we'll do is book another flight with them!

Experiencing the Na Pali Coast of Kauai from the air was on my "Bucket List" -- now I can cross it off!!!  It is awe-inspiring!  Do it, do it, do it...you will not regret it.  We also fully enjoyed seeing Waimea Canyon from the air, which gave us a different perspective -- we had seen it on a ground tour the day prior.  Just flying all over the island was fantastic.  (Now we know where Puff the Magic Dragon who frolicks in the ocean mist in a land called Hanaleigh lives!)  

Ellen, (owner,) was so warm & accomodating.  Our pilot was also exemplary (Shane?)  Not only do you get an air tour as long as the helicopter companies, but you'll get it at a MUCH more reasonable price.  A couple of very nice additions -- you'll leave with a lei & a beautiful CD of your flying experience to evoke special memories the rest of your life.  

Flying with Wings Over Kauai is absolutely incredible.  We visited four islands on our vacation & saw amazing things.  My mother & I both agree -- this was the pinnacle of our Hawaiian Islands vacation!

We were looking for a helicopter tour when I saw the Wings Over Kauai on Tripadvisor.  After reading all the great reviews I decided to book the tour.  Boy, we are glad we did.  Bruce is very informative and was very personable.  Saw some whales just after taking off and then some amazing scenery.  He told us about the various trees and plants and a little about the people that first came to the island.  Definitely the highlight of our vacation.  Highly recommended.

review_title: Best air tour on the Island
review_text:
If you go to Kauai you have got to contact Ellen and Bruce at Wings over Kauai.
Family run business and you are treated like a new member of that family.
Best 70 minutes that we spent while on Kauai. The views and attention to detail can't be beat.
Bruce gave us a breathtaking tour of the Island with a ton of local knowledge that resulted in a spectacular morning!

review_title: Great personal service - the only way to see NaPali Coast.
review_text: Family owned business with a personal touch. They have a general route but tailored it to fit our tastes so we saw whales from the air, circled Kilauea Point Lighthouse and we could take a picture of our condo from the air!  Flew over Tunnels Beach and decided we wanted to go and snorkeling there was our favorite thing we did.

The island of Kauai should be experienced from above.  It is to beautiful an opportunity to pass up, and Wings over Kauai is an excellent, economical choice to see the whole island.  Bruce even flew out over the sea, and we saw four whales so we checked whale watching off our list as well.

review_title: Words can't descibe the views- Everyone should do this
review_text: What a great experience. Carter met us at the counter and got us acquainted with what to expect. We also received a couple gifts that were unexpected and sweet. We were lucky enough to be the only 2 people on the tour so we got to go in the smaller plane with Bruce as our guide. Bruce was full of information about Kauai and wanted us to ask as many questions as we could think of. The trip over the island was amazing, and as both Carter and Bruce said, its the only way to see most of this Garden Isle. Thank you so much Wings Over Kauai! We had a blast and it is definitely not going to be forgotten. My mom and I thank you for your kindness and the personal touches that made us feel special. Mahalo and Cheers from our family to yours!

review_title: Breathtaking flight memories with an awesome Pilot
review_text: Our Cruiseship Dock on this beautiful Island and the best way to see this isle tru  Air .Wings over Kauai is the most affordable company I found in the area and  Bruce the adorable Pilot has wealth of information about the wonders of Kauai island.ellen & Sophia are the beautiful ladies who welcomes us and able to pick us up from the nearest mall and take us to airport.there are free drinks lollies and necklaces which I think  a bonus.taking photos and video is welcome too.

review_title: A great part of our trip to Kauai
review_text:
I would highly recommend this tour.  A very competent, accommodating family-run operation.

We waited till we got to the island and saw what the weather was like, then phoned Wings over Kauai directly.  They were very helpful and gave us a number of options for times over the next several days.

When we arrived at Lihue Airport, check-in was fast and friendly.  As they promised, all four of us got seats on the right-hand side of the plane, which gives everyone a nice view of the various coastlines, especially the Na Pali coast.  The pilot Bruce engaged everyone on the two-way conversation, and included very informative commentary without making it seem like he had given the same patter on each of the 5000 or more times he has flown the circuit.

Sure, you don't get as close to the scenery as you do in the helicopters, but it's still a great view.  Very comfortable plane, no weight restrictions like the helicopters have, and a guarantee of a view out the right side.   Good value for the money.

Captain Doctor Bruce piloted our 70 minute flight around Kauai, providing deep knowledge, great stories, and of course, stunning views.  It is half the cost of a helicopter tours, quieter, and everyone gets a window seat! We had multiple changes due to weather; Wings Over Kauai was very flexible and accommodating. Highly recommended!

review_title: Great price, nice people ... don't miss it!
review_text: This is definitely a must for your trip to Kaui. Carter & Captain Bruce are the best! My son fell asleep during the flight it was so smooth. Bruce is really fun and knows a lot about the island and best of all he loves what he does! His son Carter is so thoughtful and kind. I would recommend them to everyone! Don't miss out!!! GO!

review_title: Great budget tour, Bruce was very knowledgeable
review_text: My wife and I had a great time on this tour, I would recommend it to anyone!

review_title: Phenomenal tour - with a personal touch
review_text:
Personal and educative experience. I booked the air tour after a lot of deliberation over the helicopter tour vs airplane tour. I am ecstatic we did this air tour. We were greeted with a kukui nut necklace ,which i will wear in the future.
 Even though it is an 8 seater plane  they take on only 4 people at a time so everyone gets a right side window view. they are probably the only tour company which guarantee a right side window seat.  
The noise of the small plane is drowned out by bose speakers which at the same time allow for communication between the passengers.
Dr. Bruce is doing this in his retirement. You can clearly see he loves the place and knows a lot about it. He tailors his commentary to the tastes of the passengers. If you have Qs about the flora/topography etc you get  good educative answers which are at the same time fun. The plane has these bubble glass windows which offer a very clear view of the napali coast. The pics i took came out very well.
i did not actually do the helicopter tour but considering how good this was i do not feel i missed anything.

My husband and I choose to fly with Wings over Kauai on January 3rd. It was an anniversary surprise for my husband and Ellen helped me execute it perfectly.  The flight experience was exceptional right from the start. Pat and Bruce gave us a warm welcome.  It was an hour-long flight and we flew over some of the most beautiful and untouched parts of Kauai. The ride was smooth and Captain Bruce regaled us with his knowledge of the island and stories from his past experience. I usually have motion sickness but I followed his advice and did not feel a thing throughout the ride. At the end of the flight we were so surprised to receive a complimentary dvd with our picture on the cover.  Amazing experience from start to finish!  I highly recommend flying with Wings over Kauai - You will definitely not be disappointed!

We were so impressed from booking to completion. Bruce and Ellen were very friendly and welcoming while also professional and knowledgeable. The scenery was spectacular - from whales to rugged coastline, beautiful valleys and waterfalls. An exceptional value.

I can't add much to the (very accurate and high) reviews already on this site.  But I will add this:  I fly as a professional pilot for a living and also own my own plane so am very familiar with General Aviation;  Bruce and Ellen run a first class operation.  The well maintained and clean aircraft, the Bose headsets, the scheduling, the greeting, the follow-up email complete with your picture (no extra charge like a lot of those other places), Bruce's professional use of the checklists, his knowledge of the island as well as the traffic patterns of the helicopters  . . . all add up to a safe and very enjoyable flight.  Well done Bruce and Ellen!!  Thank you, this was a highlight of our trip!!  I highly recommend it - you will be glad you went!  MW

We loved the entire experience.  They were very professional.  Good briefing on the ground and thorough briefing once on the plane.  Such a great way to see the majesty of Kauai!  Were so happy we took the plane over the helicopter, much more comfortable and I think we saw alot more too!  A must for Kauai!

review_title: Who needs a chopper when you can fly in style!
review_text:
Ellen and Bruce are fantastic hosts and made this a memorable trip. From scheduling through the flight, everything was incredible and we can't wait to go again.

Bruce's experience as a pilot, combined with his easy going personality and knowledge of the island, it's history and the sights made it very enjoyable. We were fortunate to have sailed the Na Pali coast the day before (with Captain Andy) and then seeing it again from the air made it one of the most memorable things we've done in our travels to exotic locations.

Thanks guys, we'll definitely recommend your tour to our friends.  Troy and JoAnn

Wir flogen am 26.10.2011 mit Wings over Kauai (Lihue Airport).
Den Rundflug über Kauai mit Wings over Kauai können wir jedem bestens empfehlen -
bestes und freundlichstes Service - wunderschöner Rundflug mit 
herrlicher Aussicht aus dem Flugzeug, auch zum Fotografieren ! 
Unbedingt zu bevorzugen gegenüber einem Hubschrauber-Rundflug !!
Wir hatten einen Hubschrauber-Rundflug 3 Wochen später auf Big Island, 
das war ein völliger Reinfall (Safari-Helicopters Hilo). 
Service nicht sehr entgegenkommend, gegenüber dem Flugzeug starke Vibrationen, Durchführung trotz ungeigneter Wetterlage, und man hatte 
den Eindruck dass es eben nur ums Geschäft = Geld ging. 
Ganz anders war das bei Wings over Kauai !!
Drum nochmals - Dringende Empfehlung und DANKE an Wings over Kauai !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Franz+Inge / Österreich/Austria

My husband and I found this tour via Trip Advisor. It was rated #1 by a lot of people, so we decided to book this trip via the internet while on a cruise ship. The price for two people was the price of one person offered on the cruise ship!
Ellen and our pilot Shane were great. Shane was very friendly and informative. They gave us a free DVD of an aerial trip around the island. We had a great time. I would recommend this to anyone.

review_title: Amazing tour and friendly, informative staff!
review_text: This was a great tour of the beautiful island of Kauai.  Bruce is an excellent pilot and very informative.  All of the staff members were incredibly friendly, efficient, and helpful.  Would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Kauai.

review_title: Outstanding ride, Breathtaking scenery and worth every penny
review_text:
We were looking to accommodate a plane ride in our trip during  the busy Christmas week in Kauai.  After reading TripAdvisor reviews, we decided to go with either Air ventures or Wings over Kauai.  Ellen was very helpful and we were able to get a flight that suited our itinerary.   On the day of the flight, Sophia and Captain Bruce patiently went over the flight plan, made sure we were comfortable flying with our kid and answered all our queries.
The best part was the smooth take off, excellent narration and the humor in the cabin.  Captain Bruce ( where can you get a pilot who is PhD) is an expert Pilot, very well versed with Kauai and an equally deft at  making you at ease, we felt as if we have known him for years.  The plane ride was one of the best part of out Kauai trip and we'll come back for sure.  At the end of the trip, we are blown away by the "surprise token gift".   The professional treatment at Wings over Kauai exceeded our expectations and you will not go wrong to fly with Captain Bruce.  "Mahalo Wings over Kauai".

Sachin

As pilot, I decided to make a flight with Bruce. He was a great instructor and gave us very interesting informations about the Island and the landscape. I was with my girlfriend who enjoyed the flight and the very beautifull scenery. I am sure that the flight would be also great for any passenger who is not a pilot, as Bruce is a great pilot and guide. Thank you also to Ellen, that was very friendly also. Thanks for the trip !!

review_title: Incredible, best tour I have been on, would definitely do again!
review_text: Bruce and Patti offer incredible service, an extraordinary experience at a very reasonable price.  My family had 3 adults a 3 year old and a 6 month old on our flight.  Bruce and Patti made all,of us feel comfortable and made the experience great for the kids.  The flight is over 60 minutes of airtime and gives you a view you could never get by driving.  I would recommend doing this early in your trip as Bruce will point out different areas you will want to hit on your trip.  This is definitely worth doing!

We signed up by email using the honor system. They did not ask for credit card, only for our phone, just in case, so we knew we were dealing with individuals. And the flight is indeed up close and personal. There were 5 passengers on our flight. Bruce's calm, steady voice was an excellent guide, especially during the more bumpy sections of the ride (there were a few of those on that December day.) I would not miss it!

The Wings over Kauai tour is simply fabulous! We were doubtful about being able to get a good view due to winter rains - but luckily it was nice and sunny. Bruce and Ellen really go the extra mile to make the experience pleasant and memorable!! For those with flying jitters, Bruce makes every attempt to put everyone at ease with tips on how to combat air sickness and what to do to avoid it. This is definitely a must-do in Kauai!!

We have been to Kauai a couple of times in the past and had tried to book helicopter tours, but they always got cancelled due to weather.  We finally got a helicopter tour out of Maui the last time we were in Hawaii a few years ago.  While it was good, we decide we really did not like helicopters that much.  So on this trip, which was a cruise that gave us just one day on each island, we decided to try Wings Over Kauai based on the reviews on Tripadvisor.   We are glad we checked this out..  Everything that has been said about this family owned operation is true.  They give an excellent overview of the island and the cost was considerably lower than the helicopter tours.  We found helicopters noisier and more uncomfortable.  We found the fixed wing tour preferable.

review_title: Best fixed wing flight over Kauai.
review_text: All I can say is “ditto” to all the other 5 star remarks.  That’s why it is #1 tour on Trip Advisor for Kauai. Would go again if I was in the area. The free DVD and Kakui Nut Lei Necklace was a added bonus.

review_title: Best flight-seeing we have ever done.
review_text: We have been on two helicopter flights over Maui and a fixed wing flight over the Grand Canyon.  This is the best yet, and most affordable.  The free DVD was a nice bonus.  Awsome scenery!  A must do on Kuai.  Loren and Queeta Winter - Dec 2011.

review_title: You could pay for a helicopter tour or if your a pilot, you can fly.
review_text: I flew WOKTs 2001 injected Skyhawk from takeoff to landing around the island of Kauai. Luckily, I had a BFR 2 months earlier in an old Skyhawk flying 4 hours with an instructor. I'm a 250 hour private pilot.  Bruce, the owner and flight instructor was very user friendly. I few the aircraft 95% of the time. If your a pilot, you got to do this! The views were spectacular.

review_title: The Best Way to See Kauai
review_text:
I would highly recommend this flightseeing tour.   We thought the pilot was amazing in that he had terrific knowledge of the Island, and was informative.    He seemed to know what would interest his passengers.   There is only room for 3 in this plane, but the views were amazing, and the windows were clean, so the photos turned out great.

I have been on other flightseeing tours elsewhere, and this pilot (Bruce Coulombe) had more personality and knowledge which made the flight very enjoyable.  We also felt the cost was low compared to so many others.

I would recommend doing this early in your trip to Kauai, that way you can see what you want to go see on the Island at ground level.   I loved the mini grand canyon views, the Napali Coastal views and the Fantasy Island Waterfalls.

review_title: The Best Tour. Period. Just Do It.
review_text: My wife and I had an amazing "Deluxe Tour"  trip with Captain Bruce. Bruce was the consummate professional, hitting all the top sites on the island, and ensuring we felt safe the entire time.  Stunning vistas of the Na Pali coast that one can only see by air or by boat and buzzing over countless waterfalls and beautiful deserted beaches. Wings Over Kauai is a top notch operation and offers great value for money.  Just book it.

> Great Service – email, phone, pre-boarding, on-flight and free flight-DVD with our photo on cover
> Experienced pilot and island-expert: Bruce
> Fair price – great value

I recommend to see the beauty of Kauai by Wings Over Kauai !
We had a wonderful time onboard with great views of the island.
Detlef & Karin

review_title: The Best View from the Air is with Wings over Kauai!!!!!
review_text:
excellent plane ride
highly organized, friendly staff
Shane - a great pilot
convenient for NCL cruise passengers
beautiful island, See it with Wings Over Kauai.

review_title: A great way to see Kuaui.
review_text: This was an excellent flight tour of the island. The tour was professionally handled and very informative. Our pilot was great. The entire staff made the trip memorable. A great experience.  Go Hokies.

review_title: Bruce was a great narrator, and thankfully a conservative pilot
review_text: This was the third time we have flown with "Wings" having exhausted our interest in the standard helicopter tours years ago.  This service, especially in the Cessna, is a made to order tour of the island, and Bruce accomodates requests if they are close to his flight plan, and is just wonderful  for the two of us.  I normally don't do small planes well, but as evidenced by this being our third flight, have learned to really enjoy the flight with Bruce at the controls.  Every time we have flown we have gained an even more fantastic perspective of Kauai during our yearly visits.  The prices are reasonable, especially when compared to the helicopter tours, and although Bruce doesn't fly into the canyons and scare the heck out of me like the helicopter tour did, the views are still stunning.  We would highly recommend "Wings", especially if you want a lifetime memory without your blood pressure "skying".
What a wonderful way to see the island! The views were spectacular. Really enjoyed the service and care given by Bruce and Ellen the owners. Highly recommended!

My husband and I decided on this flight after reading all of the positive reviews.  The team didn't disappoint.  Captain Bruce did a great job engaging everyone on the flight, and we have a lot of respect for small business owners like he and his wife.  He was a brilliant pilot, and very personable at the same time.  We were able to get great pictures without having an open window and without putting our camera against the glass.  We were a little disappointed to see a baby on the plane as we thought it might ruin the trip. But once we got in the air with our headphones, the crying was less noticeable and the baby finally fell asleep.

review_title: Great air tour of the island
review_text: Love the service, loved that we could take my 3 and 6 year olds, and loved the price compared to other air tours! Even got some pilot lessons since I sat in the co-pilot seat.

My husband and I flew with Bruce of Wings Over Kauai during our honeymoon in Novemer 2011. It was all around an amazing experience! Ellen coordinated everything for us and made the whole process very easy. Bruce was an excellent pilot and made everyone feel very comfortable. He talked about the history of the island, the types of trees/plants we were looking at, all of the different areas we flew over, and even pointed out some "star's" homes. We had some clouds and a little rain that morning before the flight (as is to be expected in Kauai - that's why it's so green!), but it turned out to be beautiful! This is definitely the way to go if you want to see Kauai from the air! Thank you to Bruce and Ellen for a wonderful and memorable experience in Kauai!
We had such a great time flying with Capt. Bruce! It was very informative and interesting. He and the ground team were very warm, kind and helpful. Lovely views, great experience! A must do!

If you want to be treated good. Stop here and don't think about anybody else. Captain Bruce, Ellen and Jeanie are a great team. They took picture and sent it for free, never even asked for money. This what customer service is all about. Captain makes you feel at home and he is a humble person because he is a doctorate but he treats others with so much respect.

We loved our trip with seven month old daughter.

Great service and great value for the money.

More than that they have the Aloha spirit and money can't buy that spirit.

review_title: Amazing flight with even more amazing service!
review_text:
We just went on this tour the other day and it was one of those once in a lifetime journeys.  We took our two year old with us and he slept through most of the flight. Bruce was super accomodating - giving us ginger candy (which my tot gobbled up) to help with air sickness and navigated us through the island.

The views are to die for - especially the cliffs on Napali coast and the Waimea Canyon.

This is so much better than a helicopter tour - you pay less, get more grandeous/wider views (helicopters were much lower), and get a PhD to navigate you through the island.

Must do for anyone coming to the magical isle of Kauai!

review_title: I loved my Wings Over Kauai flight!
review_text: It was a wonderful experience, and I recommend it to anyone visiting Kauai.

review_title: Fabulous Views, with a great tour guide and pilot
review_text: Kauai is beautiful and I'm really glad we listened to all the great reviews for this tour and booked it. We took it the day after we landed, phoned up in the morning and they managed to fit us in that afternoon. It was a beautiful sunny day and there was myself, my husband, another couple and the pilot on the small plane. My husband isn't a great flyer and wasn't really looking forward to it, but even he enjoyed it and found the flight fine. Great commentary by the pilot, he really knows the island well and told us so much as we flew around all the sights. Thoroughly recommend it.

My family and I had the great pleasure of taking this flight this past October.  Bruce and Ellen made us feel truly welcomeas soon as we arrived.  The flight itself was perfect.  Bruce is extremely knowledgeable about the island and it's history.  The pictures I was able to get were beautiful.  The cost of this was less than half of the price for the helicopter tours.  The surprise gifts at the beginning and end were just icing on the cake.  I have told all my friends back home that after that tour in the air I spent the rest of my time looking for a job in Kauai.

I saw recommendations for this company everywhere which is why we chose them. Super friendly and accommodating family running this tour. It was a great way to get a birds eye view of the island. You won't get down as close as the helicopters do, but you will still see plenty in a safe, reasonably priced way.

My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed our Wings of Kauai flight this morning.  From the initial response to our online reservation to the final post-flight goodbye as we walked back to our car, eveyone we encountered was delightful, helpful and thorough.  Bruce makes the flight educational and fun. Safety is stressed, and once airborne all we could concentrate on were the incredible views we had.  We flew to Kauai Sunday afternoon and took our WOK flight first thing Monday morning. It was a great way to not only start our vacation, but also get an overall feel for the island.  We made a big difference as we took the rest of the afternoon driving around on the NE side.  While I haven't taken a helicopter flight, so can't offer a direct comparison, what I can say is that we didn't feel we missed a thing in our fixed-wing tour. We strongly recommend it.

review_title: I second all the other excellent reviews
review_text: As Capt. Bruce says, it's half the price of a helicopter tour, and probably a little longer ( a good hour +), so great value for money.  All of the other reviewers have stated the obvious features of this trip, and I just wanted to second those opinions.  I had a great time, and got lots of terrific pictures.  Can't wait to see the DVD that they throw in as an extra freebie at the end of the trip (shot by Bruce's film school college son, when they flew a special trip with the doors off).

Bruce and Ellen run a fantastic friendly safe fixed wing air tour service! My Son and I thoroughly enjoyed the flight around Kauai! Beautiful sights that can only be seen from the air. Bruce the pilot expertly knows the area and takes you on a fantastic senic voyage! Ellen and the ground crew are nice friendly folks that make sure your experience is the best! Thanks Ellen and Bruce for an extraordinary experience!

review_title: The highlight of our stay in Kauai
review_text: Ellen and Bruce are charming, and they have put together an excellent air tour of the island. We saw a wide range of magnificent scenery.  Bruce's commentary was clear and informative and there were excellent extra touches, such as a DVD of Kauai scenery from the air with our picture on the cover, presented at the end of the trip at no extra charge. We were concerned that we would miss things by taking a plane instead of a helicopter, and indeed the plane cannot get into the individual valleys, nor go over Mt. Waialeale. However, we had nice views of the mountain as we went around part of it, while the peak was in the clouds.  We felt safer and more comfortable, and saw a great deal at a lower price than a helicopter tour. We agree with the many positive reviews we see here.

review_title: great adventure, for a fabuous price
review_text: we found that we saw as much in the small plane(felt very safe) than the heliopter which we took several years ago. in the plane you coud hear capt bruces extensivre comentary. they give you a dvd and a picture with the plane at no additional charge

We called them on 11/16/11 and Ellen said be there @ 1:00 she was busy so she said we could just pay when we arrived. Very easy to find Shane was great pilot very knowledgeable had a wonderful time. Two of us had the plane to ourselves because someone canceled

In my opinion the reviews for Wings Over Kauai aren't over-hyped. Ellen and Bruce are some of the friendliest people we met during our trip to Kauai. They were so kind and eager to share everything they knew about their island. Bruce let me sit up front and taught me a ton about flying planes. He also had the smoothest landing for a plane I've ever witnessed. 

The time definitely went by too quickly. I wish I could have stayed in the air all day as there is so much to see and Bruce had so many interesting stories. They were even kind enough to take a picture of my girlfriend and I and they emailed it to us later. I definitely recommend it. Other than getting engaged this was the highlight of our trip.

We just returned from a wonderful Hawaiian vacation which included a cruise. We packed our days with many things but the best of them all was our flight over Kauai with Shane.  If you only schedule one thing to do this is the one.  We were warmly greeted and cared for and accommodated by Ellen. Wings Over Kauai Tours has the best people. The island itself can only be appreciated from the sky.  Trust me!  Do this!!!!                Jo Quinlan

review_title: Beautiful, Fun, Tour of the Island!
review_text:
After reading so many positive reviews of this tour and the experience, we decided to give this a try since I am a little prone to motion sickness and I was a little scared to do the helicopter tour. Great experience from beginning to end. Made reservations with Ellen, who was very friendly and even offered advice on what day to try and book because of the weather being rainy on some days. It was sunny but a little windy on the morning of our tour, and Ellen called us that morning to let us know of the wind factor and gave us the opportunity to reschedule. I appreciated her honesty and the warning. In the end, she said to come on in and we could get an idea of how windy the tour was from the earlier tour that went before us. We checked in with Bruce and Ellen, and everything was easy and fast. They even gave us reading material on the island while we waited. I especially enjoyed the book about movies filmed on Kauai. Bruce and Ellen run this great family-run business and they do everything right, right down to making everything feel personal. Ellen even offered us all some ginger candy before the flight to help with any motion sickness.

We decided to go ahead with the tour, and flew with Pilot Shane, who was fun, energetic, and very informative. Despite the wind,  the flight was very comfortable, allowed us to all see a great view of the island. Everyone gets a window seat so everyone gets a great view of the island to take pictures & video. We all got a microphoned headset so we can communicate with each other during the tour. Overall a great experience and a MUST DO on your trip to Kauai. Mahalo to Bruce, Ellen, and Shane for making us feel so welcome and for a great time!

review_title: great way to tour the island
review_text:
my wife and i originally planned on taking a heli tour on our honeymoon, but there are three things that turned me off from the helis:

1. the cost (much more expensive than this plane tour)
2. assigned seating in heli's based upon weight and the possibility that you could be seated in the middle of the heli with a terrible view, but you'd still have to pay full price.
3. i'm a bit weary of helicopter safety. they just seem to be unsafe in my opinion and coincidentally there was a tragic crash in maui several days ago. 

all that being said, everything about the tour was great. ellen who is the travel coordinator was very helpful with booking the tour and graciously answering questions i had about things to do in kauai. the plane was piloted by captain shane who is putting in his hours on his way to hawaiin airlines. he's very knowledgeable about the island and gives a very laid back tour of the island. 

my expectations were that we would fly way to fast past all the sights on the island because we were in a plane, but that was not the case. in fact there were times that we did a 360 loop so that we could survey certain areas for longer periods of time. good stuff.

the only minor complaint i have is that because you're in a plane, your pictures have to be taken beyond the glass. depending on the conditions, the sun can create a lot of glare against the glass. i didn't mind too much though, because honestly our camera wasn't high quality enough to really capture the beauty of what we say anyway.

review_title: Amazing Tour - I have no idea why this is not listed in the 'Blue Book'
review_text: The 'Blue Book' can't tell you everything, now can it? Don't be afraid to try something that isn't listed - TAKE this tour.  The tour price is reasonable, about half the price of helicopter tours, the flight was incredible, the service was far above our expectations.  The weather was perfect, all of the remote areas of the island were visable, spectacular canyon and waterfall views.  Our condo on the North Shore was easy to pick out, even the condo's little private beach was easily visable.  The views of the cliffs and shoreline just take your breath away.  Bruce and his staff know how to make an air tour of the island into a highlight of your trip.  Not to be missed!

We had rather rainy days on or recent 10 stay on Kauai - first time visit.  We booked before we left  with Wings Over Kauai based on great reviews on TripAdvisor and the owner of the condo where we stayed. Ellen was very accommodating when we asked to change the day of our flight due to lots of overcast....and it was a real treat to see this paradise from the air a few days later.  Ellen was professional in the check in procedure - took a great photo with the plane and Sean, the pilot gave a great tour despite some blustery winds. Definitely recommend this experience.

review_title: Amazing experience at an affordable price
review_text: Our flight with Bruce was easily the most memorable activity during our time in beautiful Kauai. We loved all the little gifts that came with the trip, as well as Jeanne's and Bruce's wonderful hospitality. Kauai's beauty basically speaks for itself, but our experience was definitely enhanced by Bruce's extensive knowledge of the island, and his love for Kauai was pretty contagious =D. We would highly recommend Wings Over Kauai to anyone who plans to visit this beautiful island.

review_title: Das sollte Sie sich nicht entgehen lassen!
review_text:
Wir haben Anfang November bei Ellen & Bruce eingecheckt und haben es nicht bereut. Von Ellen habe ich meine erste und einzige Lei erhalten, was mich sehr gerührt hat. Die Begrüßung war  unkompliziert und sehr herzlich. Leider hatten wir nicht das perfekte Flugwetter und es gab ein paar Turbulenzen, aber ich hatte nie Angst, denn wenn der Pilot mit ruhiger und sonniger Art von der Insel erzählt, dann bin auch ich ruhig. Wir würden es immer und immer wieder tun. Wir können nur jedem empfehlen Kauai unbedingt bei einem Rundflug mit "Wings over Kauai" zu entdecken. Wir haben noch von der lieben Ellen eine DVD mit Eindrücken von Kauai erhalten, diese habe ich gleich zuhause meinen Kollegen gezeigt, welche die Insel ebenfalls traumhaft schön fanden. Leider konnte ich mich nicht perönlich für den Rundflug und der lieben Aufnahme bedanken und will dies hiermit gerne nachholen!

DANKE, DANKE & liebe Grüße,
Kathleen

review_title: Awesome views and really worth it!!!
review_text: Capt. Bruce really knows Kauai and with his background in agriculture he adds insights you won't get anywhere else.

Bruce and Ellen were so great! We feel so special! The DVD included with flight is great! And with our picture on the front will be cherished!  Don't miss this flight!  Would highly recommend. Thanks so much, Mishelle and Shirley

review_title: The Highlight of our Hawaiian Vacation
review_text:
What can I say that hasn't already been said?  Fabulous! Breathtaking! Wonderful!  
     After reading the reviews on Trip Advisor, I decided to look no more.  Wings over Kauai was an excellent decision; always to be remembered.
      We were picked up near our cruise ship and brought to the airport (no extra charge).   Bruce and Ellen provided a very, personal experience by making us welcomed. Ellen by making us feel like old friends and easing my fears and Bruce by addressing each one of us during the flight by name and sharing personal experiences.   We were offered a delicious Hawaiian pastry & I was presented with a Kukui nut lei, & native flower (no extra charge).  We were assured a fantastic experience and that it was.   
       In the air, Bruce points out the breathtaking sights:  Waimea Canyon, valleys, waterfalls, the Na Pali coast etc.    The magnificent beauty of the island is from the air and seeing it on this plane with Bruce as the pilot was just great!       We were able to communicate to each other through a state-of-the-art headphone system.  Noise and vibration was almost non-existent in comparison to past helicopter rides.    The total experience was superb!     
       Before departing, we were presented with a DVD of the sights we saw  and still photos of us  were taken and sent to us via email (no extra charge).  Ellen planned on driving us back to the ship, but when we asked if the shopping center was near by, she pleasantly agreed to take us there instead (again- no extra charge). It was a great experience and a great value ($250 TOTAL!).
 Mahalo Ellen and Bruce!

review_title: Seeing Kauai as the birds see it!
review_text: My wife and I just returned from a wonderful trip to "the Garden Isle".  As its name suggests Kauai is a tropical paradise whose treasures can really only be seen from the air.  We chose "Wings Over Kauai" as our air tour.  My wife is a bit skittish about flying in helicopters but was more than willing to fly in a winged airplane as she has flown with me before.  (I hold a private pilot license.)  We made the right decision!  The pilot/owner, Bruce Coulombe (who holds a PhD as well as being a wonderful pilot) and his staff made this experience the most memorable of our entire stay.  The magnificence of the Island's interior, jagged cliffs, fern covered landscapes, waterfalls (with rainbows), the Na Pali coast and of course, the turquoise water  and coral reefs  fronting the beaches can only be truly appreciated from above.  The flight was smooth and gentle.  Bruce, using noise canceling headphones and microphones, gave a running commentary of what we were seeing.  This was, by far, the best experience of our trip.  Please, if you do go to Kauai, call Bruce at "Wings over Kauai" and see for yourself.

this is a must when you are at this island we found this on this site.and were met of the ship by a very friendly young lady who drove us to the flight centre.(wok).we were very impressed with bruce our pilot he is a fountain of knowleadge a very informative,the flight was fantastic  and veiws out of this world,we have done helicopter flights but this exceeded them.we would like to thank everyone for giving us a wonderful experience.if you take a cruise to this island i suggest you book early to avoid dissappointment.a lot cheaper than the helicopter tour you get on the cruise ships.

review_title: "A Must" for seeing the Kaua'i you can't see by car
review_text:
We had a most wonderful experience today with the "Wings over Kauai"  (WOK) tour.  We have opted in the past to take helicopter tours, but this peaked our interest after reading reviews on Trip Advisor.  

We were not disappointed.  Ellen took our reservation and Captain Bruce, our pilot, was friendly, knowledgeable and engaging as he took us around the island in his Cesna airplane and showed us sights on Kaua'i that one ONLY gets to see by plane or by boat.  He had a lot of information about the island, its history, its flora and fauna.  We got to ask questions of the captain, as we wore the Bose noise canceling headphones with microphones, provided to each person on the trip..  

The flight lasted a whole hour.  When we returned, we were given a gift - a CD of the journey that was produced by the son of Bruce and Ellen.   It was a lovely parting gift that will provide memories of the trip whenever we watch.  What a nice surprise that was after such a beautiful experience.  

Thanks again to WOK, We HIGHLY recommend this tour if you are traveling to Kaua'i.

We just got back from Kauai and had the best experience with Wings Over Kauai. Bruce the pilot was informative and had a very calm soothing voice. Ellen tried to get us in their busy schedule and the call back to confirm could not have been more prompt. They give you a thorough and detailed prep and you are off! 
Everyone gets a first class view and seat. 
Upon return there was an added surprise. 
This was worth every penny and we both felt very good value for the service you get. 
Absolutely not one thing I would change. Great, Great experience.

review_title: Great views of the Island and excellent customer service
review_text:
Our experience with WOK was so personable and inviting that we felt like we were the only customers they had.  Of course they were booked and had plenty of customers but we felt very welcomed.  We lucked out with the weather and had excellent views of the coastline, valleys and the many water falls.  
The aircraft fit the 5 of us comfortably but it was difficult for the people on the left of the plane to see some of the sights on the right. 
Bruce was a great pilot and tour guide.  He had lots of info on the island and TV and Movie scene locations.  It made it all very interesting.  Although we were flying higher than the helicopters, we were still able to get a good look at the landscape of the island.  
WOK gave us some nice freebees such as a DVD with some video shots of the island that we just visited and a kukui seed necklace for my mom .  
This was our 3rd trip to Kauai but first time seeing it by air.  We would highly recommend this company and plan to use WOK again on our next trip.

review_title: Wings Over Kaua'i Simply the best
review_text: Couldn't praise them highly enough.Quieter than the helicopter and cheaper.Put you at ease. Water and snacks if you can tear yourself away from the views - We couldn't.Communication with the pilot and ther passengers (Only 4 in total on our trip) for any questions.When we landed we wanted to go back again.

The people who run this place are extremely nice, helpful and accomodating.  I'm glad we chose the small plane rather than the helicopter.  The price was reasonable.  The ride was comfortable so you can relax and enjoy the views.  You will not regret spending you money on this trip.

review_title: Awesome experience for a wallet-friendly price!
review_text:
My boyfriend and I have been to Kauai 4 times, but this was our first time going with another couple.  One of our friends wanted to do a helicopter tour, but her partner was too scared.  When they found out the price of a helicopter tour, it quickly put a damper on the idea.  (My boyfriend and I had done a helicopter tour a few years ago, and had the "been there, done that" attitude about it.)  That's when we found out about WIngs over Kauai.  It gave us the  best of everything: an aerial tour of the island (every seat has a great view!), a non-helicopter option for our friend, and a very budget-friendly price.  The icing on the coconut cake was the super friendly staff!  Ellen was so friendly over the phone and very patient with all of our questions.  When we arrived we were greeted by Jeannie's sweet smile and welcoming personality as she explained the tour, some history of the island, and the safety features of the aircraft (including the "aloha bag" for those who get motion sickness LOL)  and of course Captain Bruce did a fantastic job giving us a safe flight along with some great information and stories about the areas we flew over.  They also take  pictures of your group in front of the plane and email them to you for free! 
All in all, I highly recommend Wings over Kauai to anyone and everyone who visits the island!!

For a great experience we recommend this adventure. Our pilot Bruce was very friendly and informative. We recommend you start your experience of Kauai with "Wings over Kauai" flight. You will have a good feel for the island and places you will want to visit. 1/2 the price of helicopter tours and smooth as silk.

review_title: The most incredible views of Kauai at a reasonable rate!!!
review_text: This 70 minute air tour around the beautiful island of Kauai was one of the highlights of my life.  Truly.  I called and talked to Ellen to make the reservations based on a recomendation from one of my co-workers who flew with them back in 2007.  They could confirm us for the following day on their last flight of the day at 2 PM.  We got checked in by very friendly Jeanie.  Bruce was our pilot for the flight.  He was very friendly and had a very calming voice.  He has flown that flight upwards of 5000 times!  Bruce was a agronomist research scientist before retiring early to do this.  He gave us great information about the island interspersed with singing little theme songs from the movies that were shot in the places we were seeing.  The plane was comfortable with big windows to see and snap photos of everything.  The Na Pali coast was absolutely spectacular and a "must see".   A very intimate tour with only my wife and I and one other couple.  Well sat on the right side of the plane so we could see all there was to see.  Not like the helicopter rides where someone has to sit on the ocean side.

My friend and I went on the Wings Over Kauai tour - thanks to the reviews on tripadvisor - it was fantastic.     Bruce and Ellen were easy-going hosts, the ride was fear free, the views were first rate - and the price was so much better than the helicopters.   I cannot recommend this trip highly enough.  It has been the high point of our trip.  Loved every minute.

review_title: 2 WEEKS, 3 ISLANDS AND THIS WAS BY FAR OUR FAVORITE MEMORY!!
review_text:
If you're in Kauai do not miss this awesome experience!!  If you're looking to see the island then this is the way to do it.  For half the price of a helicopter ride you can take an exquisite tour of Kauai in a plane with an extremely experienced and knowledgeable pilot Bruce.  He and his wife Ellen and their staff were nothing short of amazing.  I'm prone to motion sickness and also have a slight fear of flying so to say I was a little nervous is an understatement.  Bruce did an amazing job of explaining everything about the plane, how it functions and what areas we may expect some slight turbulence.  Bruce engages with his passengers the entire flight making sure that everyone sees all the sights and that all the passengers are feeling safe and comfortable.  I doubt that anyone could find a comparable pilot with as much knowledge about the island, the plants, the vegetation as Bruce.  He is more than happy to share with you everything he knows and answer all your questions.  Views of the Napali coast and the canyon are spectacular.

Thank you Bruce and Ellen for making this tour an unforgettable memory of a lifetime.  Next time we're in Kauai we'll be back for a visit and will undoubtedly refer you to anyone that is headed your way.  Mahalo!!

Bruce and Ellen were amazing!  This really was one of the highlights of an incredible trip!  I was a little nervous as I am prone to motion sickness, but Bruce gave me some pointers, Ellen sent us off with ginger chews and Bruce kept it smooth sailing!  I sat up in the co-pilot seat and it was truly one of the most memorable hours of my life!  The views of the island are spectacular, Bruce was so knowledgeable and friendly.  A nice touch - before we got on the plane Bruce took a picture of us in front of the plane - by the time we landed, Ellen has printed it out and used it as the cover for a 5-10 mins DVD of the plane ride set to music!  Most other places would try and charge you more for this but it was our gift and it is truly appreciated!  I don't know what else to say except don't leave Kauai without doing this!!!

Four of us did the Pride of America cruise and on our last day which was in Kauai we took the Wings Over Kauai plane tour. It was not only the best way to see this island it was breathtaking.Bruce and Ellen made us feel like family.They went over everything in great detail.I'm prone to motion sickness and thought this would be easier on me than the helicopter. I had no issues.The ride was smooth and I sat in the copilot seat which was a blast.It's the best place for the least amount of motion.All four of us had a great view.This is a very professional top notch local company and the fee is very affordable.If you decide to splurge on one big thing in HAWAII this is the one must do !
Ma halo Ellen & Bruce

Bruce and Ellen provide an unsurpassed customer experience.  They were extremely flexible and customized our tour to fit our schedule.  Everything was great from the booking to the setup to the flight.  Wings Over Kauai's safety record, Bruce's touch at the controls, and his knowledge of island history, geology, and flora made for a very interesting flight with breathtaking views.  They took care of us every step of the way.  What an experience! What a value!  Highly recommended.

Bruce and Ellen run an exceptionally personal, friendly, but professional business.  Ellen was responsive to email inquiries and let us add an additional passenger last-minute.  This was also one of the only flight options that allowed us to bring our 1 year old and hold him in a lap rather than purchasing an additional seat.  Bruce was a great pilot and really induced our confidence.  Overall a terrific experience, and one of our favorite memories from Kauai ... glad we didn't miss it!

Abbiamo seguito le recensioni di altri  viaggiatori e siamo soddisfatti!Il Tour e' un'esprienza davvero unica, e consente di vedere delle zone non raggiungibili via terra,come la Na Pali Coast, o di godere del bellissimo spettacolo del Waimea Canyon dall'alto. Abbiamo prenotato l'escursione al costo di $125 comprese le tasse, e l'accoglienza e la cordialita' di Ellen (Bruce non c'era quel giorno) e' stata davvero notevole.Ci ha regalato la collana fatta con noci macadamia, e fatto la foto davanti all'aereo prima della partenza, che poi ci ha inviato via mail con calorosi saluti.Sull'aereo eravamo solo in due, e abbiamo scelto i posti che volevamo, mio marito si e' seduto accanto al pilota. Durante il volo, della durata di un'ora, si utilizzano cuffie che consentono di parlare tra i passeggeri e il pilota, e di ascoltare tutte le spiegazione che questi fornisce sui luoghi sorvolati, la vegetazione, le spiagge e tutto cio' che questa meravigliosa isola offre.Una esperienza davvero emozionante, resa ancora piu' piacevole dalla gentilezza e dalla competenza di tutto lo staff.Mahalo Ellen& Bruce!

The weather was too bad to go out on a boat to see the Napali coast. We waited everyday to see if today would be the day we could go out, but the captain said no each time. So, coming to the end of our vacation we decided to book a flight. Wings Over Kauai was rated #1 so we signed up, plus it was cheaper then the cruise. (Bonus!) The weather was cloudy and high winds, but we went up. I am so glad we did, what a breath taking view! Every seat is a window seat with an awesome view.We got to see the whole island. It was a cool perspective seeing all the areas you had already been to on land from that view. Lots of people said go at the beginning of your vacation, but I say in the end you are more familiar with the island and you can take better pictures. The only place we had not seen yet was the Napali coast.  Bruce is an excellent pilot! They give you the royal treatment the whole way, like they really appreciated you and your business. They were all so personable. I would recommend them any day of the week!!!

This was a wonderful flight and a great value.  Bruce and Ellen make the experience very personal.  Bruce added interesting and colorful information and background during the flight which added even more value and fun to our flight.  I would hightly recommend Wings over Kauai for a fabulous experience.

review_title: One of the best parts of my vacation!!!
review_text: I was in Kauai first week of Sept. with my wife for her 30th birthday!!!  Wanted to do a fly over of island.  Everyone suggested a helicopter, but I found it hard to pay $175 to $250 per person. Decided to go with Wings over Kauai for $125 pp and couldn't be happier!!!  The couple that owns it Ellen and Capt. Bruce are simply the best! Very nice and personable, much more of a intimate experience!! Capt. Bruce was very soft spoken and knowledgeable of the island and views you would see!! The flight pattern he takes you on really gives you a look of the complete island. It was about an hour, maybe little more, a smooth flight, smooth take off and landing!! It was one of the best things and or hours of our trip! Hard to say what is number one, because the island is so beautiful!!! Ellen and Bruce would definitely tie for the number one spot though! You get a picture of you in front of the plane, a dvd of the air tour, and the ladies get a little present too!!!  Ellen and Bruce we could not Thank You enough for making are last day on the "Best" island any better then you did!!!  So glad we did this!  Thanks again..

The flight with Wings Over Kauai was a highlight. Do it as early in your vacation as possible, so you can get a feel for the layout of the island. We missed Ellen as she was gone, but Jeanne was delightful and Bruce was an excellent pilot and guide. The sky was clear and we saw awesome sights.  The little gifts you receive are just a wonderful bonus. So glad we did this. Jeff & Jan
Bruce and Ellen were excellent hosts. Very reasonable price and a great tour. Must see in Kauai.

review_title: Most Memorable Activity of our Vacation - Bruce - Pilot - Randy - Co-Pilot
review_text:
Do one thing in Kauai and Wings Over Kauai is It!!  Forget the Hellicopters Fly First Class!Bruce, Ellen and Jeannie are the best and truly make you feel like family.  Jen and I had a great trip with Bruce Flying and YES i did Co-Pilot.  That was Awesome!  I did not do to much since Bruce is the best pilot you can have.  He is soooo smooth and professional! 
Seeing Kauai from his First class airplane is truly amazing!  We took some great pictures!
Jen and I were on our honeymoon and Wings Over Kauai made it very memorable!  Look at all the reveiws and there is good reason why there are so many positive ones.  Bruce, Ellen and Jeannie know how to treat you and that is "First Class"

review_title: Fly First...tan later...don't miss this wonderful expericence.......
review_text: Everything you read about this company is upfront and worth repeating...Ellen, Shane and Bruce are truely accomadating in all areas.  This quiet, smooth and attactive aircraft (I am also a pilot) cruises about 80mph...just the right speed to see the island but not miss any of the attractions or highlights..at between 1000 and 1500 feet above the spectacular scenery...Shane, our pilot, gave a very personal, professional and informative ongoing narrative of the sights...he also gave a preview of any possible "bumps" or course changes while in the air which I have found always helps the non-pilots to enjoy the ride.  In all.....a HIGHLY recommended tour of Kauai....I need not mention the cost difference compared to the helicopters...oh, I just did!!  Relax and enjoy the added treats Ellen is always happy to share....what a great group....And to Shane, my wife and I wish all the best future with your career at Hawaiian Airlines...it will arrive....Mahalo....

review_title: Simply, it's a must-do activity on Kauai.
