review_text: When you live on Kauai, you have the ability to pick and choose. One of our best choices (other than making the decision to move here) was picking to take a Wings Over Kauai flight! Ellen was a great booking agent, very accommodating at the beginning of our check-in (our daughter was super stoked at receiving a stuffed animal to 'comfort/accompany' her on the flight was very thoughtful) and Ellen was amazing through the follow up e-mail and photo we received at the conclusion. The flight itself was awesome because we were able to fly over the Poipu area (not many helicopter tours do this) where we live, and we captured a lot of valuable photos that will always remain cherished by us! Our captain was amazing, he made us feel comfortable, reaffirmed our safety and took care of answering every question we had for him. A lot of people ask us ... airplane or helicopter tour of Kauai? ... my only answer is "Go do Wings over Kauai, it's a better feeling, better entertainment and better service." A+ experience, A+ tour, and an A+ company.

From our phone call with Ellen to check in with Jeannie and Bruce everything was too easy. Try some other activities and you know what I'm talking about.  Personable,friendly,
courteous, professional....you get the picture. 
 
 Then the tour.....oh boy!  This was my first time to Kauai so I thought a flight around the
island would be a great way to get started. We were blessed with a cloudless morning
and Bruce worked his magic for longer than I could have imagined or hoped for. I can't 
say enough about a tour with someone with the knowledge and joy of what they do.

 We were laughing on the short walk to our car about taking the next tour. We did a number of other things including a boat tour of the Na Pali Coast, all great on their own
but Wings Over Kauai was the most memorable of our visit. Will see them again for sure.

                  Aloha,
                            Joe and Luana
                             Haiku,Maui

review_title: Excellent way to see the island!!!
review_text: Bruce is fabulous!  My boyfriend and I were with one other couple and we all had a fabulous plane ride!!  Very smooth, lots of history and tidbits about the island that we otherwise wouldn't have learned.  Gorgeous!!

There are not enough complimentary words to express the absolute wonder of this experience. DO NOT miss this opportunity, as Bruce is spectacular and soooo knowledgable and down to earth. The view was unbelievable and the personal commentary to go along with it pushed the 'awesome' factor over the edge.GO DO THIS! it was soo worth it!

review_title: Very happy that Bruce decided to retire!
review_text:
Ellen and Bruce provided my most glorious spousal unit and I will a flight we'll remember for the rest of our lives. From the moment Ellen came out to pick us up (exactly on time!), we knew we had chosen perfectly.  We got through all the paperwork, weigh-ins, and such very smoothly and had a short chat with the just-married couple with whom we were flying.  Since the Hawaii trip was our 20th anniversary "honeymoon" this worked out quite nicely.

I had the run of the back two seats of the plane to myself and it came in really handy since I was shooting pictures out of windows to either side. Bruce was a very caring pilot, checking in with everyone individually (by name I might add) to ensure none of us were succumbing to motion sickness (we didn't).

Bruce is also very knowledgeable about the island, both in topography and fun touristy facts, and provided a wonderfully soft-spoken narrative through the noise-cancelling Bose headsets (a really nice touch!).  He also allowed enough "quiet time" so we could just commune with the sites!  It was just one absolutely spectacular view after another. He knows the island well and positioned us nicely when particularly notable vistas came up.

Ending the flight, Bruce's landing was spot on.  Though the flight was over, the exceptional service didn't end: Ellen was kind enough to drop us back off at our pick-up point (we didn't have a rental car that day).

Quite simply, I can't say enough good things about the folks at Wings Over Kauai!

Luckily I read a review of Wings Over Kauai while planning our Hawaii cruise.  We did not want to spend $500 a couple for the helicopter ride, not to mention my trepidation and tendency for motion sickness.  All six of our party booked the entire plane, and planning the trip with Ellen was a pleasure (when asking what people weigh you have to have a sense of humor!)  Ellen did not even require us to post a deposit.  They were a friendly and class act all the way.  We had a beautiful sunny day and our pilot Shane talked us through the entire flight, putting those of us with nerves at ease and always checking to make sure we were comfortable.  There was soda, ginger chews, and water on board.  The ride was smooth and the views spectacular.  Ellen took a photo of us by the plane beforehand, with their camera and ours as well.  After the flight we were given a DVD with our group photo on it, no "extra charge".  I would highly recommend this tour.  It was one of the highlights of our trip.

We thoroughly enjoyed our adventure with Captain Bruce as our pilot/tour guide & teacher! He was informative, attentive to our needs and wonderful at pointing out the beautiful sights. We had a spectacular flight with minimal turbulence and a ton of great vistas! Bruce was very concerned for our comfort and they provided 'in flight beverage service' to ease any queasiness or thirst we may have. No other tour ever did that for us - what a thoughtful gesture! If we ever choose to do another arial tour of Kauai, you can bet it will be with Bruce and Wings Over Kauai - hands down the best choice!

review_title: This review is a long time coming! (visited 9/2010)
review_text:
So, let me begin by saying that our trip to Hawaii was over a year ago (September 3-11, 2010), and I should have written this review a long time ago. I was 6 months pregnant when I went to Hawaii, and "pregnancy brain" was really getting to me, so it took me this long to get my mind back. (Well, not really, it's still gone considering I have a 9 month old!). 
We started to plan our trip to Hawaii in March 2010, and actually didn't even think we could have children at the time!  Then, lo and behold, found out I was pregant in April 2010. Many aspects of our trip had to change as a result. We could not do the cruise we had booked, because I would be too far along for them to let me sail. And we had a catamaran tour planned, that also suggested I not take their tour. 
But we still wanted to see the beauty of Kauai!  
My husband found Wings Over Kauai, and we read reviews and decided this would be a great way to see it! 
I am SO happy we took this tour! 
Unfortunately, the first day we tried to go it started pouring down rain and rained for hours. Bruce's main concern was our safety and enjoyment, so he suggested we come back the next day. There was no way we could have seen anything from the plane because of the clouds. We noticed that the helicoptors were still doing their tours, despite the bad weather. I would imagine those tourists were disappointed! 
But luckily, we had a professional like Bruce who actually cared more about his customers having a wonderful time, and also about their safety, than money.
So we came back the next day, and it was definitely worth the wait!
We took the larger plane. My husband is 6'10", so he never would have fit in the smaller plane. He sat in the very back so he would have leg room. There was one other couple with us. 
I can't say enough about how much we enjoyed this tour. Bruce was so friendly, and knew everything about Kauai, and all the different plants. He taught us so much. We loved his commentary along the way.  
He had great suggestions for dealing with motion sickness. He also had water and mints to help if we did get motion sick. Neither my husband nor I had ever had a problem with this, but I must say, near the end of the trip, my husband was white as a sheet, and I wasn't feeling so great myself, lol. If it hadn't been for Bruce's suggestions, it could have been a lot worse!  
The tour was BEAUTIFUL, and words just can't describe it. It was definitely one of the highlights of our trip.  The absolute best thing about it was the people. Bruce is terrific, and the lady helping him, Marin, was so friendly and helpful. 
We will always remember our trip to Hawaii. It was my dream come true to go there, and this tour made it even more special! 
Mahalo Bruce! 

Aloha!

review_title: The best Kaua'i investment after plane the ticket there!
review_text: A very personalized, professional, exhilarating plane ride over the entire island of Kaua'i. Everyone gets a island-side seat to view some of the most formidable terrain on the planet.  Bruce and Ellen take care of every detail imaginable,  you leave feeling like family and in awe of this tourist friendly island paradise. Much better, less expensive (and safer) experience than the helicopter rides, well worth twice the price.  We will be back...

review_title: An incomparable birds-eye view of paradise!
review_text: The best way to see 80% of Kauai is by air in an airplane piloted by a seasoned pilot who has an MBA in agronomy! Bruce has a friendly outgoing manner and engages his passengers when they are not asking him questions. I loved that all passengers have guaranteed window seats with a flight that lasts a bit longer than the copters offer. Getting the full story of the sights below made for a very interesting trip. Wings over Kauai is an exceptional value and will give you memories for years to come. It was definitely the highlight of our vacation.

On our first day in Kauai, my friend and I took the Wings Over Kauai tour.  With great apprehensions, I agreed to get on the beautiful 6 seater plane.  I have a great fear of heights and was worried that I would have a panic attack and consequently make the plane return to the airport.
Upon our arrival Bruce, the owner and pilot, made us feel so at ease and welcome with true Aloha spirit.  After they took our pictures in front of the plane we boarded I was lucky enough to sit in the co-pilot's seat and help with the pre-flight checklist.  I am sure that was designed to reduce my anxiety, it worked, and we began the amazing journey.
Even though seconds after take-off I experienced a severe panic attack, Bruce's calming voice allowed me to breathe through the problem and within minutes I was able to enjoy the scenery and the beautiful Kauai landscape.
Bruce's knowledge of the island is tremendous added so much more value to the tour than I could have hoped for.
The tour was a little more than 1 hour and we got to see Wai Ale Ale cloud freef or a few minutes.  Flying over the most important landmarks of the island helped us orient ourselves for later road trips across the island.
Thank you Bruce for a special time.

review_title: Fun Trip and Bruce is Awesome
review_text:
First time in Kauai -- went on Wings over Kauai with my wife (newlyweds!). We basically landed and headed straight over -- Ellen had emailed us the day before saying there was space on the mid-morning flight, which was shortly after our flight in to Kauai. Gorgeous views and gave us a great overview of the island. Bruce was one-of-a-kind, very friendly, fun to listen to, professional  and he definitely know his stuff (having a background in crop science and such). Overall, very worth it! Only downside was that it was a bit cloudy on the way back, but still we got to see A LOT.  

(By the way, I recommend you do one of the Na'pali coast tours to see the coast up close and personal -- also not to be missed!)

Bruce and Ellen were very welcoming and engaging when we arrived. Once we got signed in and prepared for our flight, Ellen took our photo in front of the plane and introduced us to Shane, our pilot.  Shane was great!  We saw incredible sights from the plane that we never would have seen any other way and had a very smooth ride to boot.  Shane was informative and took great care of us.  There were 4 of us and we all had a great view!  A must do!!

Where do you start? We were fortunate to have Bruce as our Pilot and Guide for our flight over Kauai, We chose a plane because the better half has a issue with motion sickness, Bruce was very attentive to her needs as we flew over Kauai, the cost is about 1/2 of  a helicopter and worth the savings if you want to see the island from the air but done have the 300.00 + to pop for a helicopter then this is the way to go. We also had pictures taken before the trip and sent to us via E-mail as well as a video on CD of the flight we took.Every part of the process from Reservations, questions asked via E-mail were all handled promptly and professionally, I also got to be the Co-pilot, what a blast!!!!. The information Bruce gives during the flight on the history of the Island, the flora and Fauna is out standing to say the least, I highly recommend taking this tour while on Kauai.

review_title: A must do tour if you are on Kauai
review_text: Upon reviewing many plane and helicopter tour options I decided to go with Wings over Kauai. The tour was very reasonable in price compared to the others and the crew did a great job of making the tour interesting and informative. The flight covered the whole island and the pilot had a lot of knowledge about the history of the island. The Bose headphones was also a nice feature

review_title: This is the way to get the whole view.
review_text: Ellen was truly a terrific help to arrange our trip.  She was prompt in her responses.  She gave us options on flights.  Shawn, our pilot, was a true gentleman, and gave us a first class ride, keeping us informed throughout, especially since we were delayed a little at the beginning due to some rain and then some rain once we were in flight.  He made things great.  We saw everything we wanted to see.  They gave a DVD afterwards of a prerecording of aerials which was a very pleasant surprise that included pics that Ellen had taken of us prior to boarding the plane.  You do have to check in a half hour ahead of time to actually weigh in.  She needs that from all passengers in order to balance the plane.  The cost is less than the helicopter rides and being older I don't think I would like all the up and down (think roller coaster) on the copters.  We had some turbulence even with the plane but what do you expect?

Just read the last review and have to agree with every recommendation made. 
Book this first or a helicopter tour before you start the rest of the vacation so u  know what to do. We did and it was the best idea i had. Carry a light jacket. Its funny how cold it gets up there. 

Bruce and Jennie are lovely. We were late because of the kids and cause we got lost. They were super nice about it. We did get lovely surprises from them. They do go the extra mile. 

I will say that you will be flying higher than the helicopters so keep that in mind. They cannot get you as close and dont have the ability to hover (obviously). The view is still breath taking and Bruse is really knowledgeable. I loved the tour. My husband has a fear of small planes so he was not so thrilled. He loved the view just not the plane. Bruce is an amazing pilot. I felt safer with him than on my Delta flight into Kauai. The windows are wide and you do get  great view especially if you are sitting on the right side of the plane.

For those with young children under 4: I wish i knew this so i am telling you. I chose the airplane tour because i was concerned about the noise factor with my 2 1/2 yr olds. Helicopters are loud and I was concerned that my kids would get scared so  chose the plane. Well the plane is also loud but  the kids got this sound reducing ear muffs which for some reason my kids liked and kept on. (God was on my side cause normally they would never have worn them) When you go up the plane needs to be balanced and no one is allowed to move from their seats so this can be hard on the kids. My daughter had to sit by her self in the middle row and it was not easy. Not Bruces fault just kids being kids. If you can, get a babysitter and leave them at the hotel/resort. It will cost less and you can enjoy the sights better. if you cant. I recommend you get they tired enough that the plane noise will lull them to sleep (mine did in 10 mins of being in the air)

First Jeanie greets you, gives you a surprise, I won't spoil, and explains everything with real genuine kindness. The plane is perfect, you each get a window seat on the right side so you get the best view, and they only take about 5 people. Bruce is the pilot, he has flown about 5000 times this route.
He explains everything you see, and answers every question with great knowledge.
The view doesn't have words, awesome, spectacular, breath taking only come close.
YOU have to do this, and this company is half the price of the helicopters.
We flew almost 1 1/2 hrs, for $125 each, TRY TO COME CLOSE TO THAT, YOU WON'T.
We did our homework, this is the flight you want to take, I would suggest a light
sweater, if you are the type to get cold in restaurants. They provide drinks, water,
mints, and ginger chews if you have a queezy stomach. When we landed I wanted to
go again, and then Bruce had another surprise, I won't spoil, besides all that,
he gives you a picture of yourself next to the plane FOR FREE, as you leave.
I can't talk this up enough, this is THE BEST!!!!!!

review_title: Still by far the best deal to see Kauai !!!
review_text: This was our 3th trip with Wings over Kauai , and we enjoyed it as much as the previous ones ! Guess we soon  will qualify for a  frequent  flyer's deal ! It was a pleasure to meet Bruce and Ellen again, and there was  another  couple  from Denmark on our flight , which made it rather  fun. We have  flown both with their Cessna 172 and twice  with the Caravan and they were all very enjoyable. You could not meet nicer people , and the flight was as  awsome as ever, it was a perfect day weather wise and Bruce even managed  to show us  some things we had not seen on our previous flights. Napali coast and the North coast views were breathtaking ! Take my word for it, you  cannot  find a better  deal to see Kauai ! Mahalo for another incredible trip , and  we  will see  you again next year !!!

review_title: Wings over Kaua'i is a must do
review_text: I loved this air ride over Kaua'i in a plane that holds only about 6 passengers.  Our plane had 3 passengers and I had the thrill of being in the co-pilot's seat.  Captain Bruce called me the day before the flight to confirm that I had a seat.  The next day, he greeted me very cordially in the parking lot like I was a long time friend.  Becca presented me with a Pua Kini Kini (fragrant flower of Kaua'i) and a Kukui nut necklace before my flight.  After my flight, Becca emailed me with pictures that she had taken before I boarded and presented me with a CD showing aerial views of the island.  We had a very informative pilot who showed us the bird's eye view of Kaua'i.  I am glad this was the first thing I did after landing in Kaua'i as it acquainted me sufficiently well with the island.   They don't ask for credit card information or deposit to reserve the flight.  When I was booking the flight, Ellen advised me, in their experience, people who really want to do it show up.  I did get a little motion sick and disoriented after the flight.  Take the ginger chews they have in the plane if you tend to get motion sick.  Wings over Kaua'i is very resourceful and helpful.  They make you feel like part of their Hawaiian Ohana.  We had great flying weather and rare views of Mt. Waialeale which is typically covered in clouds.

My wife booked up this trip and I must say at first I'm like "ah, wouldn't a helicopter trip be more fun since we can hover over the mountains, water falls, ocean.... Etc etc?" but then we met Jeannie and then Bruce. Ah, what a treat to meet them both. We didn't catch Ellen (wife) till the end but she was a gem too. They made this trip so seamless and personable that we almost forgot it was a tour. We felt like we were among family/friends. 
Bruce kept us all engaged throughout the ride making sure every single person was awake and above all... OK. (ie: air sick or nervous). Also his expertise of not startling anyone, notice his strategically timed narrating on where to look and/or focus as he makes a turn thus not letting the passengers switching views left or right as he was steering a sharp turn. Any hard sudden movements can alter the balance of the lil plane and cause the otherwise smooth ride to a jumpy one. 
Oh the views... Oh gawd it's breath taking. You think you've seen it all because you've taken every ground tour,  hiked every possible trail, swam every possible beach and watched every tour videos. Uh no. The views of the reefs, to the farms to the canyons are all magnified and the colors of the beautiful island is what we all came here to see. Can we switch it into reverse and go back again going counter clockwise? Hehe.Trust the 570 or more reviewers on this one. Once you're done Oohing and Aahing over your own pictures or videos that you took, then you look at the complimentary DVD that they provide with your picture in the front and that's when you get the sensation that you are at peace with the world and you have gotten your money's worth. Add this to your itinerary on your stay here in Kauai. Next thing you'll notice yourself writing up a 5 star review like I just did.

Though I had some trouble reaching Ellen by email with some questions about booking, we got everything worked out and I booked the flight time of my choice. The tour left about 20 minutes late, but we still got the full 60+ minutes in the air with Bruce. He is so knowledgable about the island and its sights, and the whole experience was incredible. They took our photo in front of the airplane before we left, and when we got back, they provided us with a complimentary photo and video of some of the sights we had seen, done by Bruce's son, a videographer.

There were so many personal touches to this tour, and I'd do it again if possible. Tip: bring some cash to tip the pilot if you'd like - we didn't have any and wish we had brought cash, as it was well worth a tip.

während unseres Aufenthaltes auf Kauai haben wir uns spontan zu einem Rundflug mit "Wings over Kauai" entschieden. Es war einfach unbeschreiblich schön. Schon beim Einchecken mit Ellen fühlten wir uns richtig wohl. Es war noch unbeschreiblicher als wir uns mit Bruce und seiner Maschine in die Lüfte erhoben. Er beschrieb sehr informativ während des Fluges alle Details, Film-Locations und Landschaften unter uns.  Der Flug war sehr ruhig, seine Konversation mit uns (mit den 1000 USD teueren High-Tech Bose-Kopfhörern) sehr informativ! Während des Fluges mussten wir keine Knöpfe drücken um Ihm zu antworten. Die Sicht war vom Flugzeug aus ebenfalls toll, dank der großen Panorama-Fenster (vor jedem Flug liebevoll von Ellen gesäuberten Fenster). So konnten wir herrliche Luftaufnahmen von dieser einzigartigen Insel machen. Zum Abschied gab es sogar noch eine kostenlose Flug-CD von Wings over Kaui.
Meine Frau, ich und unser Sohn waren noch Tage danach tief beeindruckt von diesem Erlebnis! Von uns eine klare(für einen Kauai-Rundflug preiswerte!) Empfehlung für "Wings over Kauai"

We decided on "Wings Over Kauai" after reading all the positive reviews on Tripadvisor, and we weren't disappointed. This was our second time on the island, and the tour was a great way to bring it all together from a different perspective. Great sights, great information and details from Bruce, and very comfortable ride -- much less bumpy and quieter than helicopters. Our family of 4 had the plane to ourselves which was even nicer. We definitely recommend the tour and the customer focused attitude that Bruce and his team demonstrated throughout, including Bruce's patience and understanding with the frequent interruptions and questions from a (very) curious 7 year old. Bruce gave us a short DVD at the end of the trip with highlights from the flight and our family picture on the cover. A nice touch we weren't expecting. Thank you all for a great time.

We flew with Bruce in August for the morning flight.  We loved every minute of it - from the personal check-in, the photos taken while boarding, and of course, the amazing view from the air!  Bruce is a wonderful pilot and I never felt unsafe while on the plane. Wings over Kauai was recommended by a good friend of mine, and I would highly recommend it to anyone reading this!
Better than the other tours on the island.  Must do!

review_title: You can't find nicer people to do business with!
review_text:
Often one reads or hears great reviews and then can't help but be let down.  Such was not the case with Wings Over Kauai unless you count being let down gently at the end of the flight.  Before the flight, we were sent a map showing us how to walk from where our ship docked to the ABC store, and Ellen (one of the owners of the business) promptly picked us up at 9 AM in a nice van so all six of us in our group could travel to the airport together. 

Our pilot Shaun couldn’t have been kinder.  We were expecting Bruce, as we didn't realize the company had two pilots and had only read about Bruce, but Shaun was very competent and cordial and welcomed questions and also was cool about others pointing out nearby planes or helicopters, which is important for a pilot to be good about making people feel free to do.

Ellen also couldn't have been kinder.  She gave me a kakua nut necklace for booking the trip (at least one woman from another plane tour booked by our group also got a lei) and gave all the females flowers for their hair, and took our photo by the plane and had that as a cover to a DVD on the highlights of their tour, which she gave for free to each party in our party of six who didn’t live with another party member (which meant 4 DVDs for our group!).   She also supplied a ginger candy to each passenger to help with motion sickness in case anyone was susceptible to that (none in out plane were, but in one of our other two groups to go up, I think two or three were), and also gave us free waters.

The sights on this tour were amazing and made us feel like we need not bother driving to Waimea Canyon, so we scratched that from what to do after the tour and headed to Hanalei at Shaun's suggestion.  Shaun doubled back over some spots to be sure people on both sides of the plane got to view things like a blow hole.  The only drawback I saw of this tour was that the plane can’t dip into places like a helicopter can, so keep that in mind if you really want to get down into places (up close to falls and such). But also keep in mind that the Wings Over Kauai flight is far less expensive than a helicopter ride (it’s $520 with tax for a plane, so if you have only 4 people, it’s $130 with tax, but if you have six like we did, it was only $86.67/person, and the helicopter on Kauai will likely run you over $210/person) and the people simply couldn’t have been nicer, so I was pleased to do business with them.  

Maren, their office worker, is also sweet as molasses and a pleasure to correspond with both via email and phone; she was also quite cute in making a typo and writing "vowel renewal ceremony" in an email, which resulted in my husband and I starting off our 25th anniversary vow renewal ceremony with a joke about how our ceremony was not a vowel renewal, even with how almost half the Hawaiian alphabet is comprised of vowels, as it's not about I or U, but about Aaaa and Eee and sometimes "WHY?"  And I forgot "Oh" there, and oh, I also forgot that Ellen also allowed us to get a photo behind her counter at the airport (so we could pretend we were airport personnel and say, "May I have your boarding pass, please?") and once she got our second group of people up in the air, dropped us off at Alamo for us to pick up our rental.  She also let us sit on the plane where we wished (though she will need to weigh each of you, she won't tell you your weight if you don't want to know) - we just had to make out a diagram showing where we each should be.  Blue Hawaii Helicopters decide for people where they will sit.  Another oh...Ellen also sent us our photos that she took in email with a nice thank you note.  It's little touches like these which really make a business.  None of the people in our group that went up on three planes in a row that day had anything but positive comments to make about the tour's views, service, etc. (just some sadly got a little motion sick, and that was not at all due to the pilot).

review_title: Amazing experience for less than half the cost of a helicopter ride
review_text: For a family of 5, a helicopter ride around the island can be over a thousand dollars! Wings over Kauai offers an alternative experience that is not only cheaper but also more informative. The pilot is the owner and he holds a PhD in agriculture and he is a wealth of knowledge when it comes to plant life on the island. My wife and son get motion sickness easily but the flight was amazingly smooth. Our kids range from 4 thru 13 and we all enjoyed the ride and amazing tour of the island. They take photos of your family in front of the plane and email it to you for free.

Locally owned by a husband (pilot) and wife duo who were very down to earth and in my opinion went above and beyond. I opeted to go with them initially due to the price compared with the other tours (we are young honeymooners and wanted to save some money!) Since it was our honeymoon I was given a complimentary lei they gave us a few waters and sodas for the plane along with ginger candy in case we got air sick. The pilot was very well-informed and kept all of us engaged in conversation as we travelled over the breathtaking coast. He gave us great pointers on how to get the best pictures without missing any scenery ourselves. We also recieved a complimentary CD and photo of us infront of the plane!! We were thrilled with tour, the photos we took actually look like postcards, and I would highly recommend this tour to anyone including family and friends.

We are so glad we did a tour with Wings Over Kauai.  Our photos are absolutely incredible.  The moment you are in the air, it's just breathtaking.  We did some other great tours, but there's really nothing like seeing the island from the air.  On top of that, the staff is great.  Ellen was so friendly and gave the girls kukui necklaces.  Our pilot Shane was also awesome.  He had a ton of knowledge about the island and made us feel very safe.  I would recommend Wings Over Kauai to anyone visiting the island.

I'm not sure what was more exciting -- the wonderful views or riding in a small plane.  Definitely worth the views of Kauai, which are unique.  Our pilot (Shane?) did a great job of piloting the plane and providing useful information at the same time.  While the touring helicopters were able to go closer to cliffs and the like, we had a better overall view.  Ellen, who picked us up and readied us for the flight, was friendly and helpful and took the attached picture of our family.  We also received a CD of the views (not our flight but a similar one).  A caveat: If coming from the cruise ship, you must take a short walk beyond the terminal building to meet Ellen or whoever picks you up.  We would consider doing Wings Over Kauai again if we journey to Kauai again.

review_title: Highly Recommended - Awesome Views of Kauai
review_text: Helicopter flights over Kauai seemed a little expensive and my wife wasn't so hot with the idea of flying in a glass dome with propellers (she's afraid of heights).  We opted with Wings Over Kauai and it was definitely the right choice.  Ellen and Shane (the pilot) were extremely hospitable and our family had the entire plane to ourselves.  My wife told me that she wasn't scared at all during the flight.  We probably paid half of what would have been necessary for a helicopter tour, and our kids (12 and 15) weren't designated as "adults" which made the tour even more reasonable.  They provide you with a DVD at the end as well - all in all, an impeccable tour.  Highly recommended.

After reading other Trip Adviser reviews, we decided to take a chance on Wings Over Kauai.  We were on the NCL-Pride of America 7/30 – 8/6.  Ellen was great (and patient) as we swapped e-mails to work out a schedule that worked well for us and our itinerary.  

We met Ellen at the designated location (ABC Store) and were quickly transported to the hangar where my wife was presented with a lei and a nice flower (a very nice touch).  Paper work, a couple complementary pictures with the aircraft, a pre-flight check and we were off!

The inland area of the island was fairly overcast.  Keeping safety first, Bruce did what he could to get us in the best places for the best views.  As we traveled around the leeward side of the island, the clouds parted and the view of the Na Pali Coast opened up.  It is hard to find words that can accurately describe the beauty of the Na Pali Coast—especially from the air.  Breathtaking!  The clouds started to subside as we headed inland.  In one picture we can count 14 waterfalls (I’ll share it so you can see for yourself).  Bruce answered every question asked of him and did a fantastic job keeping everyone engaged.  

After landing, we were promptly presented with a DVD that had our picture on the cover (taken before we took off).  It contained a video of the tour (previously filmed and produced to music).  Ellen dropped us off at the shopping center where we met her (a short walk from the ship), but offered to take us back to the ship.  We opted to grab a bottle of water at the ABC Store and walk back to the ship (with plenty of time to spare before the ship’s departure).  On the walk back to the ship, I received an e-mail from Ellen that contained the pre-flight pictures (the same ones on the DVD) and a nice “thank you” note.  Again, a very nice touch!

Bottom line, Captain Bruce, Ellen and Jeanne were great!  Their #1 Rated Tour is not hype, it is for real!  Courteous, professional, knowledgeable and safe!  Treat yourself to this tour….you won’t regret it!

review_title: Great tour!  Professional, knowledgeable, and informative!
review_text: Bruce, Ellen, and staff provide a fun and entertaining tour of the beautiful island of Kauai. Bruce previously was an academic and provided detailed and very interesting information (including scientific detail) about the island. I highly recommend Wings OVer Kauai Tours!

My family and I had a great time with Bruce on our flight over Kauai.  He made us feel so at home and was very knowledgeable about the island.  He was also great about pointing out great photo ops to my husband.  My two kids (ages 8 and 11) loved the flight and I would recommend this tour to anyone!
Everyone here was really nice and that made the experience much better. Captain Shane was really fun and informative. I'd easily rate this as the highlight of me and my wife's trip. Thanks guys!

review_title: Excellent customer service at 1/2 cost of other air tours!
review_text: We were hesitant about booking an airplane tour since my husband really wanted a helicopter tour, but I experience some motion sickness. After reading some of the "Wings over Kauai" reviews, we heard others proclaim this tour was just as good as a helicopter tour. Although we have nothing to compare it to, this company knows how to treat their customers & were extremely friendly. The tour was excellent and the pilot had a great landing. We both got a little motion sickness at the very end of the flight, but we would do it again. It is an awesome way to see the sights at less than 1/2 the price of a helicopter tour.

Fantastic and scenic view of the island from air.  The ride was smooth and the view around the island great.  Took some good pictures from the air.  You have to be careful not to bang your camera lens against the window of the plane and at the same time avoid any glare of the airplane window from showing up in your pictures.  Staff was very friendly and knowledgeable.  Only 4 passengers on the trip.  The cost of the trip was very affordable for us.  Helicopters seem to go lower, but our view from the plane was fine and the plane was not noisy when wearing the radio headsets.  The length of the trip allowed for total trip around the island and was short enough to be comfortable and allowed us to plan other activities for the day.

Well, there really is a reason that this is rated number 1 for attractions and activities...there really is no downside.  Firstly, making a reservation by phone or online via their website is easy, painless, and Ellen replies promptly with the most polite and genuine response.  
For us, on the day of our planned tour, the skies from Princeville looked gloomy and there were scattered showers, so I called Ellen because I was concerned.  She immediately gave me the option to go later in the day which we chose to do, but the skies cleared beautifully anyway shortly thereafter.  As an aside though, I saw several helicopters flying through rainy and gloomy skies that morning, which would have really stunk for the money they charge.
Bruce greeted us at the airport and everything ran so smoothly.  The only issue is that we waited for another couple who had also reserved the flight, and they never showed, which held us up.  In addition, they could have allowed someone else to reserve those seats, so if you aren't going to show, please provide common courtesy and make a simple phone call.
You will always get a window seat on this flight, and you will get to see everything there is to see in Kauai on a very comfortable, easy flight.  There are fantastic photo ops, which is beneficial because the flight is slower and steady, and you are up in the air for around 70 minutes.  Bruce is well informed about the island and points everything out there is to see--he's done the flight over 5,000 times.
This truly is a steal for the price, and turned out to be the highlight of our trip.  Seeing the Napali coast by air turned out to be far better than by water, and having gracious, genuine hosts for our tour made it that much better...

What a tremendous one hour flight over Kauai.  Thank you Bruce for your explanations during this flight!

I chose Wings over Kauai instead of paying more than the double price for a helicopter ride for me and my 9-year son.  And I chose well!  I recommend Wings over Kauai!l  

What an overview of Kauai, like Bruce told you see only 20% by car and the other 80% you can only see by air!

Way to go Wings over Kauai!

PS: you receive a nice cd with movie and cover picture of yourself and your companions.

Big Mahalo to Bruce and Ellen!!

Prior to visiting Kauai we decided to book a small plane flight over the island.  We were were a little nervous with having our 15-month old son to go along but it was no to worry.  Ellen and Bruce are very nice and made the whole experience great.  The entire flight took about an hour and Captain Bruce told us about the island.  It was truly amazing and the island is breathtaking.  My son slept through the entire flight giving us a chance to take in the island.

review_title: The highlight of our trip...and affordable too!
review_text: My husband and I went for a flight with Bruce and another couple at 4 in the afternoon. For the two of us it came to just under $250...roughly half of what a helicopter trip would be. The views were spectacular, Bruce was so informative about the island, and it was a relatively smooth flight.  There was so much to see and learn about that I hardly felt the few bumps that we went through. Bruce and Ellen were great.  A must do for anyone on Kauai!

I choosed this just due to my wife's motion sickness. This was absolutely amazing. It provided longer flight time than normal helicopter one and Bruce told us a lot of stuff regardig the island. The people were so kind. 
I just found out that this gave us good view to take picture. This is must to do.

review_title: great way to see the island, but not for everyone...
review_text: my husband and i were in kauai for vacation in may and june.  we really wanted to see all the island had to offer, so we booked the flight tour with wings.  the flight staff were great.   we felt really comfortable with the booking experience and checkin.  the pilot told us it was rough today, but neither my husband or i get sick on flights.  my uncle has a small private plane, and ive probably been up with him 15+ times.  but this had alot of turbulance and was really rough.  needless to say, i got sick a few times on the flight, and we both felt horrible after we got finished.  all i wanted to do was go back to the hotel, take some meds, eat a few crackers and lay down.  then after a little bit, go back out and enjoy the sun.  overall im really glad we did it, but it was definitely a one time thing.  if i knew i wouldve gotten sick like we did, id say i still wouldve done it because it was so beautiful and a great way to see the island, i just personally think its a one time thing for us :) hope that helps - but i do recommend it!!

My brother and I wanted to do something amazing for mom's bday. We originally looked at helicopter tours, but they are over priced and shorter- after discovering wings over kauaii, which by the way is also more eco-friendly then the helicopter option, we were all set. 
We had our mom blindfolded till she got to the plane and Ellen helped us put up a banner that said happy birthday. Needless to say mom absolutely adored it, as we all did!
Also, all seats have a window except for one- a great plus!!
Pilot was sweet and knowledgeable- we loved it!

Great way to see the napali coast and other highlights from the island. Bruce does a great job explaining the history of the island and answering any questions you may have. He has a very calm,  pleasant, comforting demeanor

Pros:
Half the cost of a helicopter ride
Guaranteed a window seat
Minimal turbulence - which is great for someone that gets motion sick on helicopters or boats
Runs on time
Friendly service

My husband and I had done a helicopter, but decided to try the small plane with our kids.  The captain was very knowledgeable and nice - plus he gives the women flowers picked fresh from his garden.  Beautiful views of Waimea Canyon, Napoli, etc., even if there were a few bumps.  The plane is less expensive than the helicopter and just as good.

review_title: Brilliant!  A wonderful tour with a friendly and accomodating company.
review_text:
I thought this flight-seeing tour was a great experience and the highlight of my visit. Our pilot, Bruce, is most knowledgeable about Kaua`i and the terrain we overflew. He was most personable and professional in showing us the beauty of his island home. The ground crew was no less gracious and accommodating. I highly recommend their service.

The aircraft used is well-suited to giving passengers a good view and a stable platform for taking photos. Every passenger on my flight had a window seat on the landward side of the aircraft. The windows are well-maintained for photographic purposes. We all had good Bose noise-cancelling headsets with microphones for conversing with each other and our pilot. At the end of our flight each party was presented with a souvenir DVD with their photo on the cover.  All in all, an excellent value!

review_title: Fantastic Experience - a Definite number 1 attraction, great value...
review_text:
Did the Wings Over Kauai tour earlier today, and what a fabulous experience! We did a last minute booking and we were very lucky to get space... Having done helicopter tours in Las Vegas/NYC before, this was my first fixed wing aircraft tour -  it was brilliant... Much better than helicopter tours - longer duration, and easier to take photographs etc.... Ellen and crew were so friendly..

Would definitely recommend this to anyone visiting Kauai to see the beautiful landscape which is only visible from air. 

The plane only takes 4-5 people I believe, so it's a much more personalised experience. 

Highly recommended.

Just flew the Wings this afternoon with my wife and it was a wonderful to have the very personable pilot Bruce have an interactive informative chat over the spectacular visuals of Kawaii ... Big Bang for the buck with a family friendly atmosphere when Chopper tours charge twice as much.. Wish Ellen and Bruce the very best and we highly recommend their Wings Over Kawaii!
This was amazing! I would do it again in a heart beat! But I do recommend if you get motion sickness that you have Dramamine patches or pills!! They help so much!

review_title: Awesome views and super friendly staff
review_text:
My wife and I did the island tour as our last big thing of our honeymoon.  The tour did not disappoint as our last memory.  

Ellen and Bruce were very friendly.  They are great people and we loved talking to them.  

When I originally e-mailed to book they were responsive and very friendly.  

When we arrived to tour Ellen took our picture and chatted with us.  Then we met Bruce (our pilot) and he was just as nice.  Bruce even walked over to a flower bush and picked a flower for my wife to put behind her ear.  A small thing, but a nice gesture.

Bruce then took us up in the plane (luckily for us we were the only people to book for the flight so the plane was all ours).  Bruce was a great tour guide.  He knew a ton about the island and was also quite funny.  The 70 minutes flew by and we were left mostly speechless by the views.  

Upon returning Ellen gave us a nice DVD with our picture on the front.  The DVD highlights what it's like to go on the tour and shows some of the amazing views.  

I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai!

Ellen & Bruce are over the top hosts of the best experience of our vacation.  Pictures cannot do justice to the awesome views provided by this tour.  Personally, I am not fond of heights, Bruce has the right personality & professionalism to put me at ease. By far the best bargain of the island.  Very enjoyable experience, will reccomend to everyone I talk to visiting Hawaii.

review_title: mahalo from Shanghai, China for superb experience
review_text:
It's undoubtedly the smartest decision that we have made during our first two-week trip in Hawaii!! We booked almost everything online while "Wings Over Kauai Tours" is the only company that responds to our request so personally and warmly(mahalo ellen!). We were even not asked to provide our credit card information...Travelling all the way from Shanghai, China, we are treated like long-time-no-see family members instead of just tourists for the first time. 
Our following experiences have further proved that: warm reception by Ellen and Bruce, nice aloha gifts, detailed introduction of flight route in advance...Needless to say how fantastic the scenic flight tour is, most important thing is that we are treated again like family members by Captain Bruce during the full course of flight...So knowledgable and so patient to share with us a lot of interesting stories behind the beauty underneath.
Jiong&Lin

review_title: Amazing, the best flight on the Island
review_text:
This was the best flight around the island hands down! They are the most friendly, professional crew around from booking with Ellen and working with Marren we couldn’t have had a better experience. I was nervous about getting motion sick (like I did on a helicopter tour) and Marren stocked the plane with lots of things to cure motion sickness. Our five year old also had an amazing time she loved talking into the microphone and the pilot was awesome! 
I would highly recommend this to anyone who wants to see the island by air!
The best part was getting off the plane and Marren had already printed a photo, email us and had a dvd for us. Best customer service experience.

Thank you all!

My husband and I wanted to take a plane flight that would give us an overview of Kauai.  After reading so many reviews, we decided to book a flight with Wings Over Kauai.  After submittting our request, Ellen did such a wonderful job in calling us and confirming our flight. On the day of our flight Maren called to confirm our flight again and told us that if we wanted to fly earlier we could since it happened to be we the only ones that booked for the 2:30 flight.  I was so happy that didn't cancel us to put us with another group, but Maren said that they would never do such a thing.  SO WE HAD THE HAD THE WHOLE PLANE TO OURSELVES!!
       Once we arrived, we met Captain Bruce and Maren.  Maren took pictures of us with the plane and took several pictures of the husband being the co-captain!   Refreshments were also available provided for us.  Then the moment finally came, and we were flying over Kauai!! Captain Bruce was so knowledgable that it made the experience even better.  The pictures that I took thought on the flight were breathtaking.
     When we arrived back to the office, Maren greeted us with a CD(of an overview of Kauai) with our picture on it. Maren also told us that all the pictures that she took of us were already sent to my email.
      Thank you again Captain Bruce, Ellen, and Maren for making our honeymoon so wonderful and amazing!!!!

review_title: Spectacular view, Great price, Great People
review_text:
Bruce and Ellen make you feel at ease and at home. Extremely courteous and welcoming.
Bruce was very personable in the plane and gave a lot of info about the island, it's vegetation and culture. His flying skills are top notch and you immediately feel safe and secure upon take off. A bonus for the person seated in front, you act as his co-pilot before take off going through his required checklist. You basically go where the helicopters go so why pay extra..?
Thx for a great time!!
Rocky and Anna from Montreal, Canada
PS: Inside joke to Ellen from Anna, Francisco is cute!...:-)

review_title: Excellent tour - great value for money
review_text: I agree with everyone else's reviews. We did this tour on recommendation from Trip Advisor as a better value for money than the helicopter tours. We booked the morning of the tour and from the first phone call, to check in and the flight, we received personal attention and were thrilled with the flight. We shared the flight with another couple  and all of us had great views from the window seats. Bruce was great, informative and inclusive. Maren was friendly and helpful. This was a great alternative to the helicopter and would thoroughly recommend!

Trying to be different between islands, we decide to take a small plane to discover Kauai, instead of the helicopter we booked on the Big Island.  This is a top notch outfit, as well, especially for those helicopter averse!  As with the helicopter, the views were breathtaking and the tour was complete in every manner.  It is a bit more difficult to rotate the plane, showing all passengers the same view, but in all, I feel there was not a bad seat in the house.  I still prefer the helicopters.  The staff was like family; they were fantastic.

Copter comparison:  the ride on the airplane is smoother and a bit quieter (although we had great headsets for each).  For a small plane, this was an incredibly smooth ride! The copter can and will go deep into valleys and circle for incredible views for all.  

Especially for those with motion sickness issues, helicopter fear, or those that want to see the same stuff for much cheaper, I wholeheartedly recommend Wings Over Kauai.  For those of you with deep pockets, a sense of adventure, and no motion issue, I would choose Blue Hawaiian Helicopter tours!.

This outfit is the best.  Try them, I say!

Bottom line, don't pay $250-300 to go on a helicopter tour.  This much more personalized tour is great and Bruce is very knowledgeable of the island.  He does a good job with the plane and with his explanations.  He always make sure you are included in all of the conversations and the whole crew makes you feel right at home from the first moment you walk up.  We really enjoyed it, although my wife got a little nauseous in the air...not to fret, they have peppermint and other things that help with that once you're in the air.  I would definitely recommend Wings Over Kauai - the island is beautiful!

Bruce is a fantastic, knowledgeable, and passionate pilot dedicated to giving you a memorable flight around Kauai.  Rainy weather almost prevented this trip, but we are very glad things turned around -- the island is packed with beautiful vistas you can only take in from the air.  We got great pictures, and Bruce was informative and conversational the whole time.  Maren was also extremely cheerful and helpful in organizing our trip.  Highly recommended tour around the island!

review_title: Exceeded my expectations...and my expectations were high!
review_text: My wife and I celebrated our 47th anniversary by spending a week on Kauai. Probably our most remarkable activity was touring the island by airplane. The airplane was comfortable, and the pilot's running narrative was exceptionally interesting and educational. Don't even hesitate to schedule your own tour!

review_title: The best way to see Kauai!
review_text:
Bruce, Ellen, and Marin are truly the best!  They make you feel so welcome and comfortable.  They are accomodating to your needs and very helpful.  Bruce takes you on an amazing flight and gives you a Lot of history of Kauai and the trees and plants found all over the island.  I have some of the best pictures of Kauai from the plane.  The ride was smooth and really put me at ease considering I'm afraid of heights!  Thanks Wings Over Kauai team for making our honeymoon absolutely memorable with this tour!  Til we meet again because we will be back and bring others on this tour!

Javier and Tess Vazquez
6-16-2011

review_title: Learn so much, see even more
review_text: Our family of 4 flew with Bruce last week and loved it.  A great way to see the island - we did this early in our trip and were glad we did.  We expected to see a lot of beautiful sights, which we did - but were happily surprised with how much we learned from Bruce!  Very customer focused, highly recommend this educational/sightseeing trip!

review_title: Great Tour of Kauai - Great Staff - Excellent Experience
review_text:
From the moment we called Wings over Kauai we were immediately greeted with a warm/friendly voice.  Maren was wonderful and provided us with great information.  They were very accomodating and she relieved any anxiety I had regarding flying (I'm 5 1/2 mos pregnant).  It was a very simple reservation process and in less than 10 minutes we were booked.  We arrived the morning of our flight (we took the 9:30am) and found that we had the plane all to ourselves! bonus! We met with Ellen and Capt'n Bruce (owners) who were extremely friendly that provided a warm welcome.  Ellen reviewed the tour map with us (which covers the entire island) and as we boarded Bruce made us feel extremely comfortable. Ellen also provided refreshments for the flight.  The tour was awesome and the views were absolutely gorgeous (it was approx 65-70 mins long).  Bruce made sure to point out all of the "must see" areas and was very well-versed in the island's history. (He also has a great sense of humor!) Overall this tour is a must.  They provide a very personal experience and their rates are extremely reasonable (compared to the other pricey companies).  
Thank you Bruce, Ellen and Maren!

This was one of the favorite parts of our trip to Hawaii.  It was beautiful and seeing all the waterfalls was amazing.  The plane was comfortable and our pilot, Bruce, was great.  He and Ellen were very helpful since our flight into Kauai was delayed, and they stayed late to make sure we got to do the trip.

review_title: fantastic airplane tour of Kaua'i Very reasonable rates and friendly people.
review_text: Highy recommend this trip.Tthe pilot Dr. Bruce was also most informative about the sites, anecdotes and history. Knew good places to visit or to eat at. Great time! Don't miss it.

This was a great aerial tour of Kauai.  There is a certain quality to a fixed wing flight, and I would highly recommend it even to those who have already taken a helicopter tour.  Despite the fact that it was a cloudy day, Wings assured us that we would be able to enjoy all the highlights, and they were spot on.  Waimea canyon was spectacular, with a fantastic array of colors and impressions, and it was thrilling to fly over the Na Pali cliffs bathed in brilliant sunshine, with blue and turquoise waters below.  My wife, daughter an I had the aircraft to ourselves, which made for a very special experience.  Our captain, Shane, provided excellent and well-informed comment throughout.  An excellent experience, highly recommend Wings over Kauai.

We flew with Wings Over Kauai last week and had such a wonderful experience!  Last year we did the helicopter tour with Blue Hawaiian and a good trip, but not great because we were seated in the middle which made it hard to see.  This year we decided to try Wings Over Kauai and was very happy with our decision.  We thought that the flight was way better than the helicopters in what we saw and our experience.  We got a much more individualized experience than the helicopters and the price was much cheaper!  If you are trying to decide over the two experiences, I would definitely go this way!

Our flight was thursday 13th May and it was a little overcast early in the morning.
Unfornuately Ellen wasaway on family business but Maren and Cpt'n Shane looked after
us perfectly.  I;m not the best flyer  so of course wa selected  to sit as Co Pilot.
But from the moment we took of I was fine, so overawed by the beautiful  scenery and the waterfalls were magniicent only outdone by the beautiful coastline. This was the highlight of our Honeymoon to the Hawaian Islands for sure. Haven't stoppe draving about it and showing the video sinc ewe got home.
 Well done Wings Over Kauai.

Dave and Grace

We took the same flight as nb0525 and her boyfriend. And I agree with every single word of her review (Reviewed May 31, 2011) . Maren was extremely nice and friendly (in fact, I don't know if I have ever met nicer person), as well as our captain Shane. (I had also a very pleasant e-mail conversation with Ellen when booking the flight).
The flight itself was a wonderful experience and the views of the beautiful island of Kauai are simply amazing!
When we returned to the hotel, a personal e-mail was already awaiting us with our photos that Maren had taken.
Totally recommendable!!!

review_title: Wings Over Kauai was so memorable!
review_text: What a wonderful experience!  I purchased tickets for my parents for their birthdays and my brother and I decided to join them and were so glad we did.  Maren made us feel so special and is so nice!  Bruce was a great pilot and very knowledgeable about the Island, and took the time to point out all of the sites.  What a great way to see the beautiful island of Kauai - a lot of which you can't see otherwise!  The views were breathtaking! We loved every minute of it and highly recommend Wings over Kauai to anyone contemplating an air tour.  You will not be disappointed!  Thanks Maren and Bruce - you are awesome!

review_title: What a way to celebrate an anniversary!
review_text: Bruce and his staff were fabulous from the start of the reservation right to the very end of the flight.  Everyone was so personable and enthusiastic.  They were very anxious to make sure we had an enjoyable time.  The narrative that Bruce provides during the flight is informative and entertaining.  It was one of the highlights of our trip.  If you don't do anything else, make sure you do this trip!.  Cindy and Dave

My boyfriend and I just returned from a trip to Kauai and taking a flight around the island with Wings Over Kauai was the best part of our trip! We did it on our first full day there and that was perfect, we got a great tour of the whole island.  After arriving at the airport Maren checked us in and showed us exactly where we would be flying, etc.  She was super nice and answered all our questions. Shane was our captain and he did a great job flying us around and was also very nice and friendly.  The best part was that everyone got a window seat on the right side of the plane (the tour is mostly right turns --  a clockwise circle around the island), so everyone got amazing views the whole time.
There is absolutely no better way to see the island and especially the Napali coast than from the air and I would highly recommend taking a tour with Wings Over Kauai.

At first we heard about the helicopter rides, but decided to go with the plane tour due to the drastic cost and  fuel savings (1/3 of the fuel used per hour). 

I am happy to say it was not a bad decision, in fact it was a great decision! Our flight with Bruce was fantastic. We got great views of the island and interesting/informative commentary from Bruce. Bruce has an interesting perspective of the island with his background in agrology (branch of soil science dealing with the production of crops). 

A Big thanks to Bruce, Maren and Ellen!

My husband and I had a terrific time.  Bruce seemed to know everything about the island and showed us all the most beautiful places.  The flight itself was wonderful as well.  Bruce and Ellen are the best and we'd recommend Wings Over Kauai to anyone who is vacationing here!

review_title: Great way to start your vacation on Kauai
review_text: Seeing Kauai from the air is a great way to start your vacation and Wings Over Kauai is a fun, safe, and (relatively) inexpensive way to do it. Like many reviewers, I was somewhat apprehensive about flying in a small plane, but Bruce's calm demeanor, relaxed yet professional approach, and piloting skills quickly put those fears to rest. The hour-long flight provided plenty of photo opportunities and Bruce provided just the right amount of commentary. There are a couple of other nice touches that also add to the experience and value.

Like many others, we decided on our flight with Wings over kauai based on previous reviews.  I'm not crazy about flying in small aircraft (or large ones for that matter), but the flight was awsome and I highly recommend it.  Bruce and Ellen were out of town on the day of our flight, but Maren and Shane took excellent care of us.   We are telling our friends, "If you go to Kauai - book a flight with' Wings over Kauai' !"

Recently took a Wings Over Kauai flight and it was one of the highlights of our vacation on the Garden Island. Maren, at the Front Desk,  and Shane, our pilot, were simply the best! Maren kept calling  to update us on the weather and tried valiantly to accomodate us over several days to get the best flying conditions for our tour. She was so nice when we met her in person. Shane was very informative and flew over the most beautiful parts of the island. Maren gave my wife a kukui nut lei before our flight. There were soft drinks on board and mints to prevent air sickness. Maren also took photos of us with our plane before our flight and had them ready along with a CD of the highlights of Kauai when we returned. 

My wife tends to get air sick but had no problems on our flight. This tour was half the cost of the helicopter tours and we highly recommned it unequivocably.

I got to sit in the co-pilot seat, and read off the pre flight check list, an honor I will not forget. Nothing I did the other six days I was in Kauai, topped the experience of a guide tour by air in the front seat of an airplane. This tour let's you take pictures of waterfalls you would not otherwise see, and Capt Bruce's narration and phraseology of the islands history,events and unique qualities is amazing, with some humor and jest added. 
I'll stop here, so "You" can have your own surprises and discovery on the tour.
Cliff (PALI) Anderson

review_title: Great way to see the most beautiful Hawaiian island.
review_text:
We booked this tour over the Internet and Ellen picked us up as planned.  We took the free shuttle from the dock to the ABC Store.  The kids fell asleep half way through the flight but my wife and I enjoyed the breath-taking views of waterfalls, beaches, mountains and valleys, etc.  Bruce shared a great deal of information and history throughout the flight.  One highlight for me was sitting in the cockpit and helping Bruce with the pre-flight check list!

I definitely recommend this tour.

I have flown over Kauai twice now - once with a helicopter company and just this week we flew with Bruce and Ellen (airplane) with Wings over Kauai.  The plane ride was the better of the two.  First, the price was significantly less than a helicopter, but the ride was great.  It was calmer and less turbulent.  Second, the views were very similar.  And third, Ellen and Bruce were such great, friendly, caring people.  We really enjoyed the time we spent with them.  Right from the start, Ellen made us feel very welcome and really took care of us.  She took some pictures and emailed them to us without any additional charge. Captain Bruce was very knowledgeable and a great narrator.  All in all, this was a great choice, and one of the highlights of our week stay on Kauai.

As veterans of Kauai travel, Wings Over Kauai ranks very high on our list for personal touch, competitive at 1/2 the price of the competition; you feel like you are flying with old friends who've welcomed you home!  Your flight is a wealth of information on island plantlife, history, folklore and a great way to learn.....flying high!
This was our anniversary and wouldn't have spent it any other way!!
We give Wings Over Kauai as perfect 10

The Beck's

This was a highlight of our trip. When we talk about the fun we had on Kauai, the plane ride is always part of the conversation. The pilot and owner, Bruce, was very accommodating. Since all of the passangers were taking pictures, he insured that we all had good views of the landmarks. The owner limited the number of passangers to our party of four even   though the plane had six seats; therefore we basically had our own private plane ride. And the office girl was very delightful who added to the fun. At the end of the trip, we were given a free disc showing the areas that we had seen on the trip and included a picture of us on the front cover. Also, great pictures of our group were e-mailed to us. This trip is a Great Value.

Flying with Wings over Kauai was definitely the highlight of our week-long family vacation in Kauai.  As our family was too large to accommodate on one trip, we chartered one flight and purchased some individual tickets on the next flight.  Everything was professional and prompt - from our initial inquiry to checking in for/boarding the flight itself.  Maren and Captain Bruce were great with our kids and were quite patient in answering their (and our) numerous questions.  Maren was especially attentive with our 3 year-old daughter, who loved the pink headphones.  My father-in-law enjoyed his informal role as "copilot" in reading off the preflight checklist.  The plane felt very safe and comfortable and the views were spectacular.  In my opinion, it was much better having the panoramic view from the plane window than the close-up that we would have had in a helicopter (plus we saw lots of close-ups the next day during our boat trip to the Na Pali coast).   Our photos and videos of the 1 hour trip turned out very well.  Overall, most highly recommended.  Wings over Kauai set a very high standard and it will be difficult to find a comparable experience on our next vacation.

review_title: worth every penny and every minute!
review_text: Ellen and Bruce treated us like family by giving us a private office orientation and a kukui nut lei to me! Bruce gave us a mini flying lesson and a detailed description of not only the topography but the plants and trees we were seeing as well. He was very careful to give us the best photo ops and able to pinpoint specific locations by dipping his wing tip over the site.  When we had a chance to review our photos at home, we were amazed at the quality and clarity we got. And what can I say about seeing Kauai from the air! Words can't express how beautiful it is. We drove all over the island and did some hikes after our air tour and doing the air tour first helped us better appreciate what we were seeing. Do this first!

I went on this adventure with my girlfriend a little over a week and a half ago.  We both kind of have the jitters about flying, especially with this being the first time in a small plane for both of us.  Captain Bruce and his crew, Ellen and Maren who were awesome at getting us situated, made the flight very easy and comfortable.  We learned a little about flying from Captain Bruce who is also a flight instructor which was a very cool part of this adventure.  The flight was about an hour and we circled the whole island while Captain Bruce, who I think is a genius, pointed out all kinds of land marks and told us facts and neat things about the area.  The views of the Na'Pali Coast and the Waimea Canyon are spectacular.  One of the best things about this tour was when he showed us where they shot different clips from shows like Fantasy Island, Jurassic Park, Raiders of the Lost Ark, Six Days Seven Nights, and he even would help us so that we could get a nice photos.   I got a really good shot of The Fantasy Island Falls from the opening scene when Tattoo was yelling "The plane, the plane."  You see a lot of stuff that you normally would not see because you can not get to it by car.   Hands down, this was one of the best things we did our whole trip.  I would highly recommend it to anyone, especially if you can't afford the helicopter ride.  I am so happy we did this.  Thanks again Captain Bruce, Ellen, and Maren for this incredible adventure!

Mahalo,
Rob

review_title: Do it! You'll thank us later.
review_text:
My wife was initially uncertain about the small plane, and I wanted to take a powered hang glider instead, but our innkeeper (Lorna at the beautiful Kauai Banyan Inn) highly recommended Bruce and his team at Wings Over Kauai. We are so glad that we listened to her advice. 

Our hour-long tour, which was a very smooth ride, gave us amazing views of the island, including the Waimea Canyon, several waterfalls, the breathtaking Na'Pali coast, and we even saw several whales. Bruce was a phenomenal tour guide and he is so knowledgeable about the island. He answered any questions that we had and provided a great commentary as we flew. His staff greeted us with flowers and snacks and took our picture. They gave us a DVD with highlights of a typical tour, which we've greatly enjoyed.  

Apparently,  the hang gliders are more limited in their views of the island, and Bruce's expert flying put my wife at ease. So our Wings Over Kauai tour ended up being a highlight of our trip.

review_title: Great deal for families with little kids
review_text:
we were visting kauai for the first time with little kids. everyone told us to see the NaPali cost but most of the cruises dont allow kids under 4 and the helicopter rides can be a)very expensive and b)too loud and potentially scary for very little ones. So we opted for the small plane ride. we looked around and got a great deal with WOK. we were two families so we booked the whole plane. we got a great deal money-wise and view-wise. Plus the hubby who is a wannabe-pilot loved getting to sit in the co-pilot seat! our welcome was with kukui nut garlands and soft toys for the little kids (everyone loves unexpected gifts!). Bruce gave us a wonderful guided tour and answered all our misc Qs about the area. We loved it. and when we got off, there was a dvd with a group photo on it. we had a marvellous time in kauai and this was one of the most memorable parts of it.
my only word of caution is that if you have a weak stomach and are uncomfortable

I have extreme tendancy to motion sickness, so after hearing about helicopter tours from my friends, I was afraid I would have to pass on seeing Kauai from the air. Then I read these reviews in Trip Advisor. There is a reason Wings Over Kauai is the number 1 attraction listed.
  The pace is friendly and relaxing. The flight is awe inspiring and informative, and the experience is a great way to start your time on Kauai, not to mention much less expensive than the helicopter tours.
  You don't get as up close and personal as the helicopters do, but I was fine with that. The special windows on Captain Bruce's plane were great -- all of our pictures turned out perfectly. The service by Maren and Ellen before we even got off the ground made this a special memory of Kauai. Don't hesitiate to book Wings Over Kauai for your aerial tour.

Wings Over Kauai was the best tour we took during our week long stay in Kauai.  Ellen and Capt Bruce were the best tour guides to the island.  There is so much that you can only see by air on Kauai and Capt Bruce made the tour around the island very interesting.  We chose the Wings Over Kauai air tour over the island instead of a helicopter because of my two daughters, who are 11 and 14.  The ride was so smooth and they did not get airsick! Plus, they are much cheaper than a helicopter tour and they offered a discount for my children.  With four people booked on the flight, Ellen gave us the entire plane and we were all able to sit on one side of the airplane for the best view of the island,  We are still talking about the flight and the fantastic views that we saw.  I flew in the Air Force for 23 years and Capt Bruce is one of the best pilots I have seen.  I definitely recommend this tour!

review_title: Excellent Way To Fly Over Kauai
review_text: We took this air tour as part of our recent visit to Kauai.  Wings Over Kauai uses a fixed-wing aircraft, which we preferred over a helicopter.  Captain Bruce was the best host, explaining in great detail the various sites we flew over, giving many personal touches along the way.  A great flight tour with very competent and friendly folks. This tour was so excellent, we plan on taking it again when we visit Kauai

My wife and I went on the Wings over Kauai flight on a recent vacation and we absolutely loved it.   Helpful directions from Ellen made it easy to find the location and check in was informative but relaxed and made us both very comfortable with the flight ahead. 

The flight itself was a great experience and the aircraft windows were kept spotlessly clean which allows for perfect photo taking.  Bruce (the pilot) arranged everyone on the right hand side of the aircraft and orientates the flight so that all the best sights are on this side which made for a clear viewing experience.  

Sights were breathtaking and the narration by the pilot was spot on.  

Price was right and the customer service was perfect.  DVD of the flight with a photo of us boarding the plane was a nice touch at no additional cost.

Bring your camera, other than that I had shorts, t-shirt and flip-flops on and I has fine.  Cold sodas are on the plane.

Likes: Views, narration, customer service.

Dislikes: I only wish the flight could have been longer than the 60/70 minutes as I didn't want it to end.

This is one absolute highlight of our trip.  Ellen Colombe met us at the ABC store in the Anchor Cove Mall (walking 10 min. from the cruise ship; shuttle available) then drove us to the airport where we were guided through the safety procedures then boarded our 6 seater plane.  Bruce Colombe expertly flew us around the perimeter of the island of Kauai also flying inland over famous waterfalls, through Waimea Canyon and basically to show us all of the sites.  During the 65 min. together he pointed out where the rich and famous are as well as describing life on Kauai, meanwhile checking we were all safe and comfortable.  The DVD they gave us at the end, captured the key highlights of our flight and will be a great momento when our minds forget!  This is one fantastic trip!

review_title: Das muss man in Kauai gemacht haben...
review_text: Es war einfach super. Ich bin in Kauai gelandet und direkt zum Office gelaufen. Ich durfte meine Sachen dort lassen und ein Flug wurde innerhalb von einer Stunde organisiert. Und die Aussicht - super. Es war zwar manchmal ganz schoen Wacklig, aber die Ausblicke besonders von der Kueste atemberaubend. Einer der besten Sightseeingfluege, die ich jemals hatte! Danke!

Bruce & Maren are wonderful. My dad & I felt right at home. The flight was the best we have had on Kauai. We have been on a helicopter & bi plane but this was the best. It was so enjoyable that we hope to fly again tomorrow with Bruce. My dad is a pilot from Idaho & he got to be the co-pilot.

review_title: Great for families, better than helicopter
review_text:
We flew with owner and pilot Bruce of "Wings over Kauai", after he was recommended to us by our B&B the day before. It was fantastic, to say the least! Highly recommendable, especially for families of 3-6 who can have the plane to themselves (we went with my in-laws and our baby girl).
Guaranteed window seats also. I won't go into describing the views, they were truly amazing and hard to described with words.

Bruce and his wife Ellen have lived on the island for long and know it really well, they both have PhDs in agriculture and so we got to hear  a lot of interesting stuff on the vegetation and history about Kauai. They are friendly and relaxed and run the small family show as a 'retirement' hobby, so its far from the expensive, highly commercialized and high-throughput tourist ripoffs you are likely to get with the helicopter operators. 

We got a proper safety briefing before the flight, and could not have felt more comfortable before and during the flight. Free soda's and ginger chews were available against flight sickness, but we didn't need them. 
Excellent in-flight communication system with Bose noise cancellation headsets, our 9-moth old daughter got soft baby earplugs and earmuffs on top, and slept straight through the 65 minute flight. 
   
Discounts available or Hawaii residents or if you bring in a coupon.
Wings over Kauai Tours was very nice and helpful.  They were not expensive and the tour and piolt was excellent.

The ride was worth every second, more informative and personal with Bruce, as we were only 4 people in the tour - we were greeted by Ellen and Bruce and were given a quick brief out of what the tour would be like - i was seated beside Bruce and my wife behind me along with 2 other people from Scotland, Bruce was calm and with a distinct humor gave us the details of the landscape - the tour itself was breathtaking and Bruce was kind enough to be calm and took the situation in control while my wife was experiencing motion sickness.

Thanks Ellen and Bruce

review_title: Flexible in accommodating the weather changes
review_text:
If you ever consider to take a plane tour over Kauai (which you should do), this is THE company to go for. We really enjoyed their service, not only because their customized and friendly service, but also because their flexibility and consideration for the customers. 

We called them on our second day morning to book the tour, as we tot the weather was pretty good then. But they said the tour was booked until 4pm, and asked if we would like to take that.
