Before getting into the plane we had our picture taken with the aircraft that Ellen then emailed us before we were even done with our tour!  We met with Bruce, the pilot, to discuss weather conditions and where our tour would be going and then we hopped in the plane.

For someone who has never been in such a small aircraft I was a little nervous about flying but this uneasiness quickly disappeared when we took off without jolt or bump.  Once in the air we were treated to a great narrative by Bruce who has his PhD in agriculture and has lived on the island for over 15 years.  We saw the beautiful southern beaches, flew over Waimea Canyon, continued around to the Na'pali Coast, and around Hanalei Bay before returning to the airport.  We were also lucky enough to see many waterfalls deep in the mountains and get great pictures of Wailua Falls with the sun shining right on it.

Overall, a great experience with a skilled pilot.  The excellent and friendly customer service (complete with free DVD with your picture on the cover) was great bonus.  The price of the flight was well worth it and we both highly recommend you join Bruce on his next flight with Wings of Kauai!

We have been to wings over kauai up recently, the flight was quite fun, scenery amazing and the Bruce was very helpfull with explaining anything of what was arround, also he circled quite a few times when we wanted to take extra pictures of the spot.
We did it as a trio and had much fun.

Would recommend them for anyone!
Thanks Wings over Kauai for an amazing adventure!

After reading many of the reviews of Wings Over Kauai, we took a tour during our trip to Kauai in August. An excellent decision. It was indeed a chance to fly over more or less the entire island and see everything. The weather was perfect and Bruce provided an informative narrative. The whole ride was very smooth and visibility from the larger aircraft was good for all, resulting in a delightful hour or more of sightseeing (and education). The cost of the trip was good too, around half a helicopter flight and a bargain. 

By the way, we had booked well in advance and were pleased to see that Ellen and Bruce had assessed the weather conditions on "our" day, recommending a small change in time to give us the best conditions. We enjoyed our trip to the maximum -- highly recommended, a very professional company.

We had a flight over Big Island, which was so good, that we decided to do it again by plane over Kauai.
And we were not deceived ! Bruce showed us the love he has for HIS island, he was so patient with the kids, he made them read all the check-ups before take off, and they just loved to be part of it. For those of you who hesitate between plane and helicopter, choode the plane ! It is more safe, almost half the price of the copter, and it is much easyer to get a good view of the nature below. And if you missed it, Bruce will make a special loop to show again the right spot.
Thanks again Bruce and Ellen, also for your personalized CD with pics.
Daniel (from far away Israel)

review_title: The highlight of our trip to Kauai.
review_text: This is a breathtaking trip with many beautiful views.  Bruce and Ellen were most enjoyable as hosts and Bruce was very good as Pilot and Tour Guide.

review_title: Just as good as the helicopter for half price
review_text: My family truly enjoyed our experience with Wings.  Bruce and Ellen made us feel welcome, comfortable and safe.  Bruce involved the entire family thru the trip and made every effort to ensure everyone on board was enjoying there experience.  I would highly recommend this experience to anyone!

This was the best excursion that we have ever taken!  The flight was smooth, the pilot and his wife and assistant were superb and friendly, the sites were gorgeous and it was an all round wonderful experience!  My husband, sister and I arranged for our Wings over Kauai trip after reading the great reviews here on Trip Advisor and we were so happy and amazed with our experience!  We are still pinching ourselves-did we really just do this?  Treat yourselves to Wings over Kauai!  You will not be disappointed!

review_title: Wings over Kauai- Don't miss this tour!
review_text:
What a wonderful tour!  We were on our honeymoon and looking at the Helicopter tours but the price was over $200. pp and could not justify the cost of $400+. So we decided to book "Wings over Kauai" @ $120 pp. They have everyone sit on the one side of the plane so no one has a bad seat. The views where incredible and should not be missed! Don't believe me: Check out my pictures! Ellen and Bruce where wonderful hosts and made you feel welcome. They took a picture of us and gave us a DVD with the picture on the front of a prerecorded flight (included on the price).
Don't miss this tour!

I'm so glad I stumbled upon Wings Over Kauai during my internet search for things to do while on vacation in Aug 2010.  Not only did I enjoy the flight but Capt Bruce and Ellen were such wonderful people to deal with and meet.  I can't stop talking about them and Wings to people who have been asking me what to do when they go to Kauai.

review_title: The NICEST, SAFEST, MOST AMAZING way to see Kauai!
review_text:
Everyone at Wings Over Kauai are absolutely wonderful! My husband and I were greeted at their office at the airport with smiles and congrats (we were on our honeymoon) and treated like family immediately! It was an unbelievably personal experience. You can really tell that these people care about their services, their customers and the experience they are providing. They seem to follow the motto "Treat others how you would like to be treated". 
First off, they took pictures of my husband and I in front of the plane and with Bruce, the pilot, and emailed them to us immediately. They also gave us a DVD of the tour (not the exact tour we took, but a video of one just like it). And they did this all for FREE! My husband and I were expecting to be asked if we would like to buy the pictures they took at the end of the tour (like they do at amusement parks and stuff) but we were totally shocked when they just emailed them right away. It was a really, nice unexpected perk. 
Second, everyone we dealt with was so accommodating and friendly. We received great instructions on everything and felt really tended to. This is what a Mom and Pop operation is all about!
Third, Bruce is a very, very good pilot. My husband was very nervous about going up in a plane that small but the ride was smoother than the rides we took on the jumbo jets to get to Hawaii. There was never a moment -from take off to landing - where I had any bit of nerves or felt unsafe. Bruce really knows what he's doing. 
Fourth, Bruce is very knowledgeable of the island. He has a Ph.D. in agriculture-something or other and was able to tell us all about the environment on Kauai, which made the tour way better!
Overall, DO THIS TOUR!!! I saw the helicopters and they were loud, wobbley and unsafe looking. This private tour - it was just me, my husband and Bruce - is THE ONLY WAY to see Kauai. You can focus on all the beauty and not be worried about safety, other people, or an uptight "commercial" tour company. 
All the things you are looking for in a tour are here - great price, extremely safe, WONDERFUL customer service! I took over 100 pictures in the plane because it was THAT GREAT!!
I read the review here and choose this service. It make my mom and husband very happy. Bruce are very nice and introduce us to Kauai from the sky,

review_title: Impeccable service and what a view from the air
review_text:
We chose WOK over helicopter tours because (1) the reviews here (2) able to request a private flight for my family of 4 on GA-8 Airvan (3) everyone get window seat (4) the significant cost saving. Our objectives were met 100%.

Based on the reviews here, we decided to go on WOK as early as we could. However, it was cloudy on our first morning in Kauai. Since this was our first trip to Kauai, I didn’t know whether that was weather as usual (since it often rains in Kauai) or just a cloudy day. We arrived at the airport on time. Ellen’s first reaction was “you didn’t get my message”. Guess what, Ellen had called to suggest flying on other time. The cloud cleared up in the afternoon. I called again to check with Ellen. Ellen suggested if we went on the afternoon flight, we won’t get the flight for my own and the children would need to sit on the left side of the plane since she had rearranged other morning flight passengers to afternoon already. To make the long story short, Ellen keeps customer’s best interest in mind. That’s something very commendable.

We finally got on the flight on our last day. It was a beautiful day with blue sky. Kauai is as advertised as beautiful from the sky. You truly need to take a flight to see the mountain, valley, waterfalls and coastline. Since we had been to a few places already in Kauai, able to recognize places like Wailua Fall in the air was fun. 

We all felt dizzy to different degree in the flight. The flight was smooth so it’s more due to our physical condition than anything else. Another thing, my video and pictures captured quite a bit of cockpit reflection. If you plan to take a lot of pictures and videos, beware of the reflection or don’t sit on the right co-pilot seat. The complementary DVD with our photo on the cover made up some from the glare. A follow up email is also a nice touch. WOK does not need to do any of these, but they do!

Overall, it is a wonderful experience and I will suggest taking this flight to anyone else.

review_title: Would do it again in a heartbeat.
review_text: Could not have been more impressed with this tour.  My wife and I were on our honeymoon in Kauai and they found a way to truly make the experience memorable.  Bruce and Ellen seemed genuinely excited to have us as guests for their company.  Bruce is a retired research scientist and can tell you more than any other tour guide we had on the island about some of the science behind Kauai, yet make it interesting and witty at the same time.  Bruce truly makes you feel comfortable throughout the entire flight, and having a three seat Cessna for a private tour is quite the exquisite way to see the island.  At the end of the tour they present you with a complimentary DVD of the flight they do complete with a picture they take just prior to the flight of you with the plane.  Could not have been a more personable couple and they obviously really love what they do.  We would definitely do this flight again and would recommend it to everyone we know who is going to Kauai.

Just to start off, my wife and I picked all of our excursions, hotels, and restaurants for our honeymoon off of TripAdvisor (and Yelp) and were not steered wrong once.  Wings Over Kauai is a prime example.  Ellen and Bruce provided a memorable experience with a beautiful flight over this gorgeous island. There were two other couples on the plane in addition to us, but Bruce (the pilot) made sure to give everyone personalized attention and service. Bruce is extremely focused on safety (they've been doing this for over 20 years I believe) and is a very knowledgeable and interesting tour guide in addition to being a pilot. The aircraft was new and comfortable, with some minor bumps but nothing major. My wife tends to get air/car/seasick, so the fact that she was completely fine on this trip is a testament to the aircraft and the pilot.  While we didn't get as close to some of the waterfalls and sights as a helicopter would have, we still got to see everything for a fraction of the price. We must have seen about 50 waterfalls because it had just rained earlier in the day, and we had some beautiful views over the Waimea Canyon.  I had the Jurassic Park song playing in my head the whole time.  As a little extra bonus, we were given a DVD (with our picture on the cover) at the end of the flight and received an email with our pictures from Ellen just the other day. A+ company and service, would highly recommend.

I spent alot of time reviewing different ways to see Kauai by air and Im glad I went with Wings Over Kauai.  Bruce and Ellen make you feel right at home.  The flight itself is fantastic - amazing views and alot of Island knowledge from Bruce.  I highly recommend Wings of Kauai!

review_title: Breathtaking Once in a Lifetime Experience
review_text: We recently went to Kauai for much needed R&R.  As we have never been privileged to visit this beautiful island before, we decided to take an air tour of the island to "scope out" the areas we wanted to visit by land.  We were not disappointed!!  After contemplating multiple helicopter tours, we chose to go the fixed wing route based on previous reviews.  Wings over Kauai was the perfect decision.  Bruce and Ellen were gracious, lending their highly knowledgeable, personalized touch, making our experience unforgettable.  I have to admit, I'm a little nervous of small planes, however, their years of experience both on and off the ground (and impeccable flight record), made for an exceptionally amazing flight!  I can't believe I ever hesitated, even for a second!  Their attention to the little details made the experience that much more incredible- the lei and fragrant flowers, personalized CD of the flight experience, soda, water, and ginger candy.   I would definitely book another air tour with Wings over Kauai.  Kauai is a hold-your-breath beautiful island and is appreciated so much more when experiencing it in it's untouched raw beauty- only accessible by air.

Ellen and Bruce are the nicest people I met in Kauai. They were so adorable both over the phone and in person. The flight then was amazing. I was a little worried at the beginning but Bruce was very reassuring and kept talking to us through the headset. He gives a thorough account of all that goes/went on on the island. He also gives you the so called "movie tour" so that you don't have to do it or pay extra for it. I guy that was on the plane with us had flown helicopters before and said that flying in a plane with an experienced and friendly pilot like Bruce was a lot better. Not only it is a lot more personal but it is also longer, less noisy, and half the price of a helicopter tour. I'd do this again a million times.

My wife and I just returned from a Hawaiian Cruise aboard the NCl Pride of America.  We chose to do our own excursions rather than go with the on-board overpriced choices.  One of our best selections was Wings Over Kauai Tours.  Ellen was so kind and helpful about picking us up and then delivering us back after the tour.  Bruce, the pilot was also great and really made my nervous wife much more comfortable about flying.  She almost chickened out the morning of the flight.  She was so glad she didn't because as soon as we were in the air all of her fears went away and we both really enjoyed the ride and the views were spectacular.  We had already done a helicopter tour on the island of Hilo and it was okay but this plane ride was more comfortable and everyone had a great view out of the large windows.  I am enthusiastically giving them another 5 star review and recommending them to everyone!!  Thanks again Ellen and Bruce for a great flight!!

Wir haben unseren Rundflug über Kauai auf Empfehlung unserer Vermieterin (www.nanakai.com) bei Wings over Kauai gebucht. Es war ein tolles Erlebnis. Wir sind nur zu zweit mit dem Piloten geflogen. Mein Mann durfte Co-Pilot sein. Die Insel ist von oben wirklich sehr sehenswert und abwechslungreich. 

Bruce und seine Frau sind ein Familienbetrieb und betreuen die Gäste wirklich sehr gut. Beim Empfang gab es eine Blume für mich und nach dem Flug eine DVD mit den Eindrücken vom Flug. Eine sehr schöne Erinnerung und wirklich emfpehlenswert!

review_title: Very good experience - shame we didn't get the private flight.
review_text: I echo the general positive comments about the Wings Over Kauai tour itself. Very informative and efficient friendly service, with great sight seeing and narration by the pilot, Bruce. We had booked the private flight option but unfortunately on the date of our flight we were told that the smaller Cessna aircraft that they do the private flights in was being serviced. We had booked  the private flight option in this plane several months in advance, so we feel we should say that we were naturally disappointed with this news. However, they did try to contact us a couple of days before the flight but we did not get the message. It was still a lovely flight in the bigger airvan, with another couple along for the ride as well. I have to say that it was definitely a great way to see the island at a good price and with a friendly company. Little extras like the lei and the DVD were very nice!

review_title: Great Experience...Would Definitely Do It Again!
review_text:
We were considering doing a heli tour, but I came across Wings on here and saw how well-rated and how much cheaper it was.  Well, I'm soooo glad I went with Wings (flew on 8/19).  It's a small family-run operation and there's such a personal touch to it.  Bruce and Ellen are so nice and accommodating.  They even took our picture before we took off and used it for the cover of the CD they gave us (didn't check it out yet to see exactly what's on it yet).

They provide some water and ginger candies which are supposed to help with any air sickness.  During the taxi to the runway, Bruce goes over the checklist with the co-pilot (whichever passenger gets the lucky seat) which is a nice little lesson on the different buttons in the cockpit and how things work with the plane...my engineering mind was content.  We had a nice, rather smooth ride.  Bruce did a great bit of narration throughout the entire ride and engaged us as well...he knew all of our names right off the bat too.  There are some things you just can't see from a car or a hike which makes the plane right  all the more worthwhile.

I've never done a helicopter ride, but the family members I was with said that it was definitely better than a heli ride.  I'm sure having Bruce as the pilot surely helped with that assessment.  Go ahead and give Wings Over Kauai a try...you won't regret it!!

For our 25th wedding anniversary, we really wanted to book a helicopter tour of Kauai. Steve and Lori from Tom Barefoot Tours TomBarefoot.com highly recommended booking a fixed wing flight on a Cessna from Wings Over Kauai. We're glad we took their advice. We flew with Wings Over Kaui on Thursday, July 15, 2010.

It's a true "mom and pop" operation run by Ellen and Bruce Coulombe. Both are very friendly, warm and accommodating. Ellen picked us up in town (we were on the NCL cruise ship Pride of America) and drove us to the airport. Flight check in was very smooth. She answered all our questions, even giving my wife a welcome gift and taking our photos in front of the Cessna.

My wife Maria was a bit hesitant to fly in a small 4 seat airplane. She told Bruce our pilot that she might feel queasy. Bruce put both of at ease with his wonderful suggestions for avoiding motion sickness. He also had on hand some ginger candies which his lovely wife Ellen told us were very effective in settling any upset stomachs.

Maria sat up in front, while I had the back all to myself. One great advantage of a fixed wing airplane is that you're guaranteed a window seat! Maria helped Bruce with the pre flight checklist. 

This is a great way to see the island since you can't see it by car. Bruce pointed out all the must see sights and giving us his personal anecdotes as well. Bruce has a great sense of humour, a wealth of information and knowledge of Kauai, (he has a PhD in agronomy) and a masterful way of telling great stories.
 
It went by way too fast! This was a real personal tour. We highly recommend Wings Over Kauai for their unbeatable prices, longer flight time, and pickup and return if you're on a cruise or without a car.

review_title: Bruce you were the best and provided a truly memorable experience.
review_text:
My wife and I had a wonderful trip with Wings Over Kauai on Aug 13 during our honeymoon. Bruce, the pilot and owner, provided a first class tour with narration second to none. He involved all in the plane in the discussion and provided expert insight about Kauai, and its flora, that no one else could match.

Earlier in our trip we took a helicopter ride while on Maui and enjoyed that too. But after reading all the positive reviews in Tripadvisor about Wings Over Kauai, we thought a plane ride would be worth a try. Boy was it ever! I felt the plane was superior to the helicopter in that we had more time to look at the individual sights, but it was Bruce and his knowledge, wit, and care for his clients that made the trip a true experience.

I got to sit in the co-pilot's seat and go over the pre-flight check off list. As an engineer, that was really cool and Bruce explained some of the controls that I didn't fully understand.

It's the little touches that make Wings Over Kauai so exceptional. My wife received a shell lei and a flower from Bruce's home garden upon arrival. At the conclusion of the trip a CD of Kauai was waiting for us and it had a picture of the two of us on the CD cover.

If you are looking for an attraction in Kauai that will leave you very pleased, visit Bruce and company at Wings Over Kauai.

review_title: On top of the world (or heaven)
review_text:
For starters, I really must compliment Capt (and Dr) Bruce and his daughter Ellen for making my family and I feel comfortable and at home before our flight.  That really helps when you’re stepping on a small plane.

Seeing Kauai from above is one of those things that you need to do even if you've been to the island before.  In fact, I wish I took this trip first so that I could really appreciate Kauai before I saw it by land and sea.  

The flight itself is very cool and fairly calm given the mountains and breezes above.  We were able to take excellent videos and photos during the flight without any issues at all.  Also, we only had the three of us on the plane (plus Capt Bruce), so it’s like you’re getting your own personal tour. 

Finally, you really do get to see many nice things that you normally wouldn't see without flying and I would recommend you take advantage of this opportunity if you can.  

Aloha!

Book this flight right away....very personable company with an aim to please....smooth ride...great points of interest thanks to our pilot Bruce!...This is probably our best memory of our Kauai vacation. My wife received a lei before boarding and we received a DVD (previously recorded footage) with a personalized DVD cover (very nice touch!) Highly recommended!

Bruce is a personable individual and genuinely solicitous of the guests on his airplane.  He narrates thoroughly,interstingly, and with authority.  The views of Kauai are splendid. The viewing windows are spacious and excellent for photography.  Having experienced helicopter fight previously, I can say Wings offers the same viewing quality with greater safety at approximately half the cost.

I had researched things to do in Kauai on Tripadvisor and everyone was raving about Wings Over Kaua'i. I didn't initially think that it would be something i would want to do, but when i got to Kaua'i I realized that most of the island is unaccessible (there is a road that runs 3/4 of the circumference of the island, and a road that runs into Waimea canyon, and the rest of the island is forests and mountains with little or no access)...I really wanted to see the Na Pali coastline, and i knew i wouldn't get to unless I took a flight. It was really a wonderful experience, and well worth the money. Ellen was very helpful and accommodating, working with me to find the right time slot in my busy schedule.  The views were awesome, and Brian, my pilot, was lovely, very professional and informed. The take off and landing were smooth as could be. I got some brilliant photos! Thanks to you Wings over Kaua'i!! ;o)

review_title: Wings Over Kauai - a great way to experience the island AND the aloha spirit
review_text:
We were on Kauai in 1988 and took a helicopter tour.  We went back to Kauai this year, 2010, and booked all of our excursions with Tom's Barefoot Tours.  Lori, our booking agent, was amazing.  She advised us on everything and led us to enjoy an incredible experience on Kauai.  She told us that Wings Over Kauai provided a wonderful service with a small plane and a personalized tour.  My husband and I brought our boys, aged 21 and 17, along with us.
Mary greeted us at the Wings Over Kauai desk.  She presented me with a beautiful Hawaiian lei.  Bruce, her dad, was our pilot.  He made sure that we were all happy and comfortable.  The views are spectacular, you will not see anything like this.  Your pictures will be incredibly awesome.  As we were leaving they gave us a DVD of the trip in case we missed anything.  It had this great picture of us on the cover.
I would highly recommend Wings Over Kauai and Tom's Barefoot Tours.  They truly demonstrate the aloha spirit and you will walk away with a smile and incredible and unforgettable memories.

review_title: Wonderful flight with a top notch company
review_text:
Ellen and Bruce, the owners of Wings over Kauai are two of the nicest people that you’ll ever meet.  The reservation process with Ellen was smooth and enjoyable and she is very personable.

We had received a phone call from Ellen yesterday letting us know that they had an unexpected inspection of their larger plane (GA-8 Airvan) scheduled for today so we wouldn’t all be able to fly together on our scheduled sightseeing flight.  She had offered us the option to take two separate flights on their smaller aircraft (Cessna 172) or to take their competitor Air Venture (she had even talked to Air Venture about available flight times with them).  We decided to stick with Wings over Kauai and were glad we did.   

We decided that my step son and I would take the first flight at 11 am and that my wife and step daughter would take the later flight at 12:30 pm.  Ellen picked us up at the ABC store near the ship (it’s about a 10 minute walk or a free shuttle ride) and we headed to the airport where we weighed in and waited until Bruce was ready.  I sat up front with Bruce and my step son sat in the back.  The Cessna was definitely small and was by far the smallest aircraft that I’ve ever been in, and I was a bit nervous at first.  Bruce’s calm manner and professionalism quickly put me at ease though.  We both had on headphones so we could hear Bruce’s narration and converse with him.  As we taxied out, he had me read off his preflight check list which was fun.   He is very methodical and safety conscious so I felt like we were in very good hands.  Soon we were cleared for takeoff and  it didn’t take long for us to be airborne.  We flew over Waimea Canyon, the Na Pali coast, the waterfall from Fantasy Island, and even saw the summit of Mount Waialeale which Bruce said was rare (it’s one of the rainiest spots on earth with an average of 426 inches of rain per year).  We saw numerous mountains, waterfalls, beaches, and beautiful coastline on our flight and Bruce is a veritable encyclopedia of knowledge.  I haven’t done any helicopter flights but couldn’t imagine it being any better than this, and at a much cheaper price than a helicopter too.  We flew over the Pride of America on our way back to the airport and all too soon were coming in for a smooth, smooth landing.   

My wife and step daughter were waiting at the airport for their flight so Ellen took a picture of all four of us in front of the plane.  That picture ended up on the cover of the free dvd that they gave us (which features footage from what we saw on the flight but not from our specific flight).   Ellen drove us back to the ABC store (she offered to take us to the ship but we wanted to buy a few t-shirts) and bid us a fond farewell.  Later, when my wife returned, her and my step daughter raved about their flight and we all compared notes.  What a wonderful experience.

All the raves about Wings over Kauai that we read on Tripadvisor are definitely deserved.
The whole experience was very personable and unforgettably beautiful.
Bruce is a great guy and being copilot was pretty neat!
Sorry that we didn't get to meet the rest of the family.

Indeed. There is no better way; excellent personal service given by the Coulombe family, from the kind e-mails sent by Ellen, the welcoming smile by Mary, to the professional and expert captain Bruce, the whole experience is unsurpassable, and of course, reasonably priced.
A must!

review_title: Aloha Spirit ! Fantastic Wings over Kauai !!
review_text:
This  was  our  second trip with Wings over Kauai , having  flown on their Cessna 172 with Bruce  last year, we  enjoyed it  so much ,that we  decided to fly again with them and  try their new Airvan. We were lucky with the weather , it  was simply amazing  to be  able  to see this beautiful island  again  on the  confort of the Airvan with the noise  reduction headphones, that also allowed us to communicate freely during the entire flight. I can only recommend everyone to have the thrill of their vacation flying  with Wings over Kauai instead of  going  on one of the many helicopter tours available . Bruce  and their  family  are outstanding , mahalo for another  unforgettable flight , wish you guys blue skies until we meet again !!! 
Pedro & Ulla from Denmark.

review_title: A truly amazing way to see Kauai! An exceptional value offered by GREAT people!
review_text:
We recently visited Kauai and our first stop was with Bruce, Ellen and Mary. I first contacted them by email and set up our tour. Ellen was so pleasant via email and immediately put any fears I had to rest (I am pregnant and was worried about the flight).  

We were greeted like family when we arrived and recieved a lei in traditional Hawaiian style. We flew in the 4 seater as it was just my husband and I. He got to be the co-pilot while I was the photographer.

Bruce was informative and provided us a GREAT tour of the island. I did end up a bit sick (I am blaming it on being pregnant and looking out my camera lens most of the time and not the window) and Bruce was so great about making me feel better. 

The DVD that they put together for you is another bonus!

It really is one the best values on the island! I can't say enough great things about the Wings Over Kauai people. We will certainly fly with them on our next visit!

Das Team von "Wings over Kauai" ist sehr freundlich und hat auf Anfragen per e-Mail sehr schnell reagiert. Nach persönlichem Kontakt wurde ein Termin vereinbart und hat auch alles tadellos funktioniert, auch der Preis war wirklich ok. Wir flogen mit einer Cessna, wo man am Beifahrersitz das Fenster öffnen konnte und somit gute Bilder schiessen konnte. Pilot Bruce war kompetent, freundlich und erklärte alles Interessante. 
Immer wieder!!

Thank you Bruce and Ellen for a wonderful tour of Kauai from the sky.  It was not overcrowded or rushed, we got some great information about the island and felt welcomed and safe at all times.  Highly recommended tour!

review_title: The best way to see Kauai "Wings Over Kauai"!
review_text: Our son took us to Kauai for vacation and when he checked out the ratings on Trip Advisor for an aerial tour we took note of the highly recommended and great reviews for Wings Over Kauai. This was a great decision as there were 5 in our group, so I booked the AirVan which can carry 6 people instead of the Cessna so that we could all ride together.   One of the members of our group was a bit  apprehensive to take the tour with us, but she did anyway and survived the wonderful trip without losing it.   Upon arrival at WOK, Bruce graciously greeted us and shortly there after Ellen warmly welcomed us, too.   She presented me with a Kukui Nut necklace and a small flower, too.  They were so hospitable and treated us like family which made our Katie feel so much better about joining us on the tour.  We took the tour at 12:30 pm and had beautiful weather for our flight.  Bruce assisted us with taking our picture in front of the Air Van before our takeoff.   We had bottled drinks available and some ginger candy to assist us with flight sickness if we needed it.  Then he helped us strap in and showed us how to use the headsets.  They allowed us to converse with him and ask questions during the flight which was really neat.  Bruce was our pilot and our son, Jeff was his co-pilot and had the job of assisting Bruce with the pre-flight checklist as we made our way down the run way.  We chartered the whole plane for our group of 5 and paid a total of $520 including tax since it was less expensive that paying the $130 per person + tax for the flight.   What a deal!  Our view of the Waimea Canyon, the Na Pali Coast, Wailua Falls and many other breathtaking sights was just awesome.   I took about 150 pictures and the majority of them came out great!  We highly recommend using Wings Over Kauai for your aerial view of the island.   Mahalo,  Ellen and Bruce for a wonderful adventure!

review_title: One of the best ways to see the Garden Island
review_text: Thanks Ellen for arranging a lovely flight.  We enjoyed having Capt Bruce as our pilot.  He has a very calm and comforting voice for anyone who is not used to flying in a small prop-plane.  Plus, my wife got a kick out of being his co-pilot.  Added to the lovely scenery of Kauai was Capt Bruce's expert knowledge of the ecosystem.  The only advice....don't miss the beauty of the island by looking through the lens of your camera.

review_title: Best Family Oriented TOUR on the kauai.
review_text: We LOVED it! Capt. Bruce and "Aunt Ellen" were great. They took care of us so well. A lot of companies treat you bad when you get a "deal", because they say, "YOU GET WHAT YOU PAY FOR".  Well, they did not, they were still so caring, kind, and understanding. We had 3 kids under 11 yrs. old. (a 4 and 5 yrs. old ). Any one with young ones, know  how tough this be.  This family was great, before, during and after the tour.  BTW, the tour itself was phenomenal. It was truly a great way to see the island. Thank you so very much!! Highly recommended for families with young ones. If you want to be treated like family rather than just a number!! MAHALO, HOPE TO BE BACK AGAIN!!!

Plane tour (versus helicopter tour) over Kauai. Owner/operator picked us up and dropped us back off within a very short walking distance from Pride of America Cruise ship. Airport is less than 10 miles from Cruise ship. Tour is done in small airplane. Myr tour was done in smaller 4 seater airplane - I rode upfront with pilot with wife and child in back seat. Took lots of pictures from both front and the back - so definately bring camera. Tour lasted a little over an hour in the air.

Owner operators are very customer focused and make you feel like you are their most important client. 

Price is  approximately 1/2 the price of a helicopter tour.

Highly recommended !!!!!

We were in Kauai for a week and thought we had seen all of the island by car until we took this trip.  It is just hard to express in words how this flight surpassed all of our expectations and showed us how much we would have missed.  Mary, Ellen, & Bruce made us feel welcome and were professional in every sense and we felt safe at all times.  We will return to the island some day and when we do this will be number one on our list to do.  As a former middle school science teacher I had lots of questions regarding the plant life and it was great to have a pilot (Bruce) who was able to answer everything I asked.

I recently went to Kauai and did the tour with my family. We all had a great time. It was amazing!!!! Friendly service and outstanding tour. Bruce did a great job!! Mary was very nice and courteous!  Even though I missed Ellen on her day off I spoke to her via email and she was very helpful as well.I would recommend this tour ,its for everyone must see!!!!
Thanks 
Liz,Manny,Taina and Ismael

review_title: Wings of Kauai was a great experience
review_text:
We had a great time on this trip. Our pilot Bruce was very friendly and knowledgeable.
We all had a great view from the plane.  We recommend this trip to others.  Our photos turned out very well and the views are amazing.

review_title: Fantastic flight and highly recommended activity in Kauai!
review_text:
After reading reviews on trip advisor, we chose Wings Over Kauai as our "air" activity in Kauai and had a GREAT trip!    Both Bruce and Ellen made us feel welcome and comfortable... before, during and after our trip.   They provided a personal touch to our experience that will remain with us forever.

Bruce provided us with a great narration of the island on our two way head sets as we got an amazing ariel view of the island.   Doing this trip early in our vacation was good as we could plan for what we would see in the days ahead.

We researched air options for a long time before making a decision.   We definitely made the right choice in going with Wings Over Kauai!   This was a highlight of our stay on Kauai!

My sister bought us tickets for Wings Over Kauai for our honeymoon and I am so glad she did! My husband and I had the best time. Ellen greets you and is extremely friendly and she gives the ladies a lei and a flower. Bruce, her husband, is also so friendly and makes everyone feel very comfortable going for a ride in his plane. He had another passenger go through a checklist before he took off and it was interesting to see what pilots have to do before takeoff. He was very personable and knowledgeable of the island. He even made a special fly over a temple for the other couple on board. I asked him may questions throughout the flight and he was happy to answer them. We saw the island from the most spectacular view. I would do this everytime I go to kauai and would recommend it to anyone. thank you Bruce and Ellen!!!

review_title: Best deal and a great flight!
review_text:
Great, long flight.  Very friendly and accommodating staff.  They made us feel very special.
Complimentary drinks, video, photo and lei.
What more could you ask for?
Well worth the price!

review_title: Really great experience, incredible views of the island
review_text: Wow!  We loved Bruce, the pilot, and his family.  His wife, Ellen, and daughter were all a part of the operation.  They were very easygoing, and accommodating when the date of our flight didn't have great weather.  We rescheduled for the following day, on Bruce's advice, which was the right choice.  As we floated off into the sky, Bruce narrated the trip to us in a lovely, soothing voice to soft Hawaiian music in the background, and if we were nervous, all of our fears went away.  It is hard to believe there can be so much beauty on one island, and I feel like we got to see most of it from our plane window.  What we weren't expecting, however, is to get so motion sick.  It really took me and my daughter by surprise.  It was such a smooth and relaxing ride that I never would have expected to feel so badly.  Bruce had bottled waters, which helped the two of us, along with peppermints and ginger candy.  It didn't ruin the experience at all, but we were not prepared, since we don't normally get motion sick.  We still highly recommend this adventure.

My husband and I enjoyed our honeymoon in Kauai this April and really arrived with out any plans at all. We knew what we wanted to do, but had no idea where to do it when we got there. After hearing about helicopter flights and how they herd people like cattle into them; we opted for the private flight by Bruce and Ellen's Wings over Kauai. And boy were we happy.  We had a personal flight over the island and Bruce shared with us all that he knows about the island, allowed us to take pictures through an open window! Swooped in over the canyons and really let us be a part of the flight.  Ellen greeted us with a lei made of nuts and gave us a DVD of our tour! 

We are so sorry we took so long to post here, our life took a crazy turn when we arrived back home after our trip to Kauai and we didnt get a chance. Thank you for such a wonderful flight. We are coming back to see you guys next year!!!

Don't do a helicopter ride if Wings over Kauai is available...you will miss out on the charm of an inflight chauffer!

we enjoyed all aspects of this tour.  This is definitely a family business which we always try to support.  Ellen was very patient, answering my numerous emails as I was setting up the tour for a large group of people.  Bruce was a wonderful, informative pilot.  Carter, their son, was very patient in transporting all of us to and from the port.  The views were just awesome.  We enjoyed chatting with everyone and would highly recommend this company.  I especially enjoyed the fact that you were able to take in all of the scenery and didn't feel rushed in any way.

This is  not just a review of the Wings Over Kauai marvelous circle island flight, but also  about the aloha of their family, Bruce, Ellen and daughter Mary.

Reservations were easy, happy and fun, when I talked with Ellen, to reserve two seats for us.  We talked story, and just had a ball.  Ellen is so full of life and aloha, and infectious happy laughter makes a person feel like you are talking to a long time friend.

On the day we were sheduled, Ellen calls and reminds us of the flight, and says everything is a " go".   She also says that she will not be there, but her daughter Mary will be running the office.

Kidding around, I say "  Well , just how am I going to give you an aloha hug ? "  Ellen replys "  Give the hug to my daughter, and she can pass it on ! "  How cool is that. I love this island and the people.

We are excited about flying in their brand new G-8  Aerovan.  That puppy has room for 6, but generally they  just fly four.   Huge windows for photo opportunities, and plenty of leg room.  Seats run along each side seperated by an isle in the center.

Each passenger has a headseat and mic, and Bruce , the owner, and pilot, visits and talks with each individual, calling them by their first names.   The naration of the flight is excellent, as Bruce has years and years of experience flying the tour in his Cessna 172, plus he has many, many years as a resident on Kauai.  Knows his stuff.

Prior to departure we weigh in and sign in....Mary escorts us out to the G-8, to the ladder leading into the main cabin.  She will take pre boarding photos with your camera , as well as hers.

Also the ladies all receive a kukui nut lei...which I placed over Erica's shoulders and gave her the traditional kiss.    The fun had already begun and we were still on the ground.

Take off was smooth, and I rode up in the right seat, ( co-pilot seat ) next to Bruce.  Not sure if it makes any difference, but I was a professional pilot for nearly 40 years.  No stick time in the G-8, but it was great fun helping read off the check list, and feeling a bit like part of the aircrew.

Take off was smooth and we gently banked to the right, and began our climb out for the Circle Island Tour.   The passengers in the back had their cameras ready.

Bruce flys slow and at an altitude that is superb for photos as we were treated to marvelous panoramic views of the garden island.   Seems like we fly about the same routes as the helo companies,  with thoughtful attention to noise abatement in certain areas.  

Roughly, we cruised past Kalapaki Beach, and  Nawiliwili Harbor.  On our right the cameras clicked with shots of Kipu Kai,  Maha'ulepu, The Hyatt and Poipu. Turning inland we crossed over the coffee fields of Kalaheo,  and then to some of the canyons in the Hanapepe Valley.

Wonderful vistas of Waimea Canyon opened up, and then flew over the ridge and waimea canyon road,  and the deep valleys that lead to the Napali Coast.  Soon we were cruising along the Napali Coast . Banking inland about Hanalei, the interior beauty, lush valleys, water falls and rivers were marvelous.   More natural tresures passed beneath us, as we circled Wialua Falls.....

That is just part of the flying experience, you will be seeing much more, and even though we live on Kauai,  learned all kinds of new information about the island.  

Flight time is nearly up, and we fly  very near our condo, at Banyon Harbor, which is on the approach to runway 3.   

We have a cross wind, and Bruce landed so sofly that I could not feel the wheel touch down. Maybe jus a slight kiss as he rolled it on.   I kidded him  "  You had better call the tower and confirm that we are on the ground ! "    Bruce just smiled.

Now remember when Mary took photos of both couples prior to departure.  Well, we taxi up to the Commuter Terminal and shut down.  Mary brings out the steps for easy exiting of the aircraft.  

Everyone is happy and smiling,   Mary presents us with WOK's  professional DVD of the  route of flight.  Back ground  music is by IZ.  And, on the front of the DVD plastic holder is the picture of each individual couple.  Yep,  Erica and I are pictured just below the WINGS OVER KAUAI  name on the top.   

Will just finish by saying that the G-8,  is a product of Australia, and flown as a tour aircraft down under.  It can  haul the weight.  Which, is great for those who weigh more than the max limit to fly a helo tour without purchasing an extra seat, or a percentage of an extra seat.

No extra charge. There is plenty of leg and shoulder  room, and I belive the cost is about $  249.00 for two people.  That is pretty reasonable and about  half the cost of some of the helo tours give or take a few bucks.   Not bad !

We looked out our DVD this morning,  now this is professionally done. It is not a dvd of our particular flight, and is outstanding.  Perfect for showing friends and family upon returning to your home base.  And it is also included.  No extra charge.

The Wings Over Kauai cirdle island tour,  was most outstanding. Bruce, Ellen and Mary were wonderful, and make each individual passenger feel like they are the only people that exist on the planet.  Lots of individual customer service and aloha.

Denny and Erica
Lihue, Hawaii

review_title: Excellent flight instruction while getting awesome flightseeing
review_text: I am a pilot, and my wife and I were interested in flying while on Kauai.  I found Wings Over Kauai and met Bruce Coulombe, the pilot/instructor.  I was impressed by Bruce and his operation.  Bruce is very professional but friendly, the two qualities you want in a pilot.  My wife and I were impressed by his thoroughness as he prepared us for the flight.  I have my own plane and over 800 hours, but Bruce gave me advice and instruction that made me a better pilot.  But the great thing about the flight was that he not only gave good flight instruction,, but also gave us a great tour of Kauai at the same time.  Bruce would point out things to see, and then would give great explanations about the features as my wife shot lots of great photos from the backseat.  With the high-wing Cessna, the photo opportunities seemed endless.  The canyon, the coast and the volcano were spectacular on the day of our flight.  The flight seemed to take 10 minutes, but when we landed, we had been flying for 75 minutes.   Bruce was very hospitable and gave us nice gifts to help us remember our trip, as if we would ever forget it.  We will definitely fly with Bruce again on our next trip to Kauai.

review_title: Kauai is even more beautiful from the air
review_text: First time to see Kauai from the air and we so enjoyed the breathtaking views of this beautiful island. Carter (Bruce's son), & Thomas (friend) got us all checked in & prepared for our flight. Also took pictures of our family.  So very nice! Then we were off on our flight with Bruce, our outstanding pilot and so very knowledgeable about the island. He made us feel so comfortable. I got some outstanding pictures. Thanks Bruce and we hope to fly again with you someday!

review_title: Great people and wonderful tour at a great price!
review_text: The family that runs Wings Over Kauai are the nicest people. They made the entire experience enjoyable. Captain Bruce was extra informative about the island since he has a different perspective from his past (and current) work on Kauai. For what you get on this tour it is WELL worth the price. Less than a helicopter ride around the island and perhaps more comfortable. I was able to get some fantastic shots from the window. We had 4 people in our group which was perfect since there are 4 windows on the right side of the plane where all the scenery is. My brother is a tall guy (6ft+) so it was a little tight for him, but he said he saw everything fine and was quite happy with the entire experience as well. My mom gets motion sickness and they were so great with her to make sure everything was done to mitigate the chances of her getting ill. (ginger and drinks) Bruce always made sure everyone was enjoying themselves, answered questions like a champ, and gave tid bits and pointers of how to maximize your enjoyment. I was VERY happy that we did this activity when the trip was over!

review_title: Money well spent on the best flight of our trip
review_text: Bruce, the pilot, gave a wonderful explanation of the sites but did not over talk.  Due to the slow speed of the plane we were able to have ample time for viewing the scenery and taking awesome photos. With much af Kauai's beauty inaccessible by other means the flight gave us the opportunity to see the hidden treasures of Kauai. My wife and I took the flight on the last day of our stay and agree that it was the highlight of our trip. It gave us a whole new perspective of Kauai and another view of Kauai's incredible beauty.

review_title: Best way to start your Kauai stay in Paradise
review_text:
Wings over Kauai is personal and friendly and first class!  From the Email correspondence, to the check-in and welcome before the flight, you feel in good hands, and with a Air Tour company that cares about your needs and your expectations.  Bruce expains everything as you taxi out to the runway, with your Bose comfortable headsets with mics, you are part of the flight!
As you fly around the Island, your questions are answered about almost anything you see or can think of, The view from inside is fabulous, take as many pictues as you like, you will see everything you came here for!  When you gently touch down and taxi back to there office, they have a keepsake DVD with your picture in front of the plane, so you have a movie of the highlights of Kauia to share. We loved our tour, thanks so much.and low cost too!

review_title: Wings over Kauai is the best!
review_text: My wife and I just got home from our hawaiian cruise and I have to say that the best part of our trip was our flight with bruce and ellen.  Their flight is half the price of the chopper rides and they are so friendly.  They go out of their way to make sure you are comfortable and enjoying yourself.  You really get a personal experience with them.  Ellen picked us up at the abc store near the pier in her car and drove us to the airport.  My wife gets motion-sick and they even offered her ginger, and let her ride in the front seat so that she wouldnt get sick.  I learned so much about Kauai on our flight.  Bruce does a great job of narrating the trip and even explains a little bit about how the plane works.   I got some great pictures on our flight, and I will submit them on their website in the near future.  If you are going to fly over one of the hawaiian islands, fly over kauai, and do it through wings over kauai.

review_title: Highlight Of Any Stay In Kauai
review_text: The highlight of our stay on the beautiful island of Kauai. Helen and Bruce are lovely, friendly people and Bruce (the pilot) will ease the nerves of anyone not sure about flying in such a small plane. He cleverly involves everyone in the actual flying procedures, short of taking control of course. Some advantages of a fixed-wing flight over helicopters are the price, quieter and you don't have to share the flight with anyone else - if there are 2 of you, the plane is all yours. Bruce will also reschedule if the weather is not good. The views cannot be any better in a helicopter, they were superb, particularly over the otherwise inaccessible parts of the island. I can thoroughly recommend Wings Over Kauai.

My wife and I flew with Bruce in June of 2010 and had a great time.  His wife and son were very helpfu.  Bruce did a great job telling us about what we were seeing.  We went on a 75 minute flight and saw everything we wanted.  It was somewhat overcast but we were still happy with our photos and the experience. The flight was smooth and I would recommend it to those on the fence.  The price is a little steep but compared to helicopters, it is a no brainer.

review_title: half of helicopter ride and awesome service
review_text: Probability of Helicopter crashes in Kauai was too great. I did not want to take risks by taking my family on a Helicopter ride. I did some research and I found Bruce and Ellen. Bruce is a pilot instructor/PhD in agriculture and that made me comfortable enough to trust him. Bruce took us on a 1 hour and 45 minute tour of Kauai. Weather did not permit us to adventure into North Shore of Kauai but he made up by taking us for a detail and educational ride. Normal ride is 65 minutes and he added a bonus 40 minutes. Bruce and Ellen are awesome and I give 5 stars. Give them a try because I am so glad I did!!!

Bruce & Ellen Coulombe made this a great experience for our family, and we are so glad we chose to fly with them. Bruce has such a passion for flying and makes the whole trip worth it just to fly with him. We were able to get great pictures and video of the island along with commentary from Bruce. When we got off the plane they gave us their own DVD of the island flight. We want to thank you for the memories you helped our family to create while on vacation last week.

review_title: Don't leave Kauai without flying with Bruce
review_text: The flight and view of Kauai was wonderful.  Our pilot, Bruce, gave lots of interesting information along with the most spectacular views of the island.  He clearly loves what he does and makes you feel right at home on his plane.  Everyone is assured a window seat with the best view.  I only wish comercial flights could be so smooth and easy.  The price makes it very affordable for a family versus other flight opportunites on the island.

review_title: Best idea we had in Kauai
review_text: my girlfriend an i had plans to do a helicopter excursion but found it a bit pricey.  after flipping through one of the tourist guides we found Wings Over Kauai was more reasonably priced.  though skeptical because you often get what you pay for, we went through with making the reservation. securing the reservation was easy and the staff was friendly.  the size of the plane, a 4 seater,  was intimidating but it made for a very intimate and personal flight.  I found the pilot/tour-guide to be very personable and incredibly knowledgeable of the island.  although it's probably not protocol, we only paid for an hour tour but the pilot extended the tour by another half hour at no cost allowing us to enjoy the beautiful scenery all the longer.  I rate this at 5 star.  well worth the money for an unforgettable experience.  i have and will recommend to all my friends. Mahalo!

review_title: If you do only one thing on Kaua'i, do Wings Over Kaua'i
review_text:
Wings Over Kaua'i has 320 reviews on TripAdvisor.  Of those, well over 300 were 5 stars, the rest four.  Any time an attraction manages to please everybody, they're doing something right.

The 70 minute Grand Tour is perfect for anyone daytripping from another island, and if you have only time for one thing on Kaua'i this should be it.  Pilot Dr. Bruce Columbe and his charming wife run the show, and all their efforts are devoted to safety first, then a superb experience for their passengers.  

The plane has all passenger seats on the right side, so everyone gets a window view of the clockwise tour.  Noise-cancelling headphones with microphones enable all to hear the pilot's narration (amusing and informative) and to ask questions or make comments to all.

And what a tour!  Kaua'i is among the most beautiful places on the planet, and the aerial views of the Na Pali Coast, Waimea Canyon, and the extinct volcano at the center of the island, the wettest spot on earth with waterfalls everywhere, were breathtaking!

Fixed-wing tours are less than half the cost of helicopter tours, and use less than half the fuel.  For reasons I can't explain, Fodor's guide doesn't even mention their existence (though I did send an email to the Hawai'i editor to amend future editions).  This was the highlight of our trip (that included Big Island), and the competition for that title was quite intense.

Bruce, Ellen, and Thomas were all very friendly and helpful.  Bruce did his best to avoid bumpy air the day we flew, but alas, my travel companion still got a little queezy (she used wrist bands, but no other medication, for motion sickness).  The views were gorgeous; I just wish we'd been able to fly over Waimea Canyon instead of near it (didn't see much of it), but the bumpy air prevented our doing so.

Bruce is very knowledgeable about the island, which made the flight educational.  I would also have liked him to give more of a running narrative of the names of the areas, beaches, towns, etc. that we were flying over along the way to provide a better orientation to the island. We took the flight on the first day of our stay; it would be helpful to know the names of the places we saw so we could find them to explore from the ground later.

All in all, flying with WOK is a great value and I'd recommend it to anyone.

review_title: Wings Over Kaua'i Soars High Above
review_text: If you can only do one thing while on the isle of Kaua'i this should be it! There is no better way to see Kaua'i then by air, and there is no better company to do it with then Wings Over Kaua'i. Bruce, Ellen, and Carter deliver exemplary service with a personalized midas touch. Bruce is a wonderful pilot who shares a tremendous amount of information about the island as you tour it. The views are breathtaking and the Coulombe's are genuinely nice folks that care about delivering a superior experience. Of all the adventures we did, in our two weeks on the Big Island and Kaua'i, this far exceeds all the others put together. If you are considering an air tour of Kaua'i don't go anywhere else or you will be disappointed. This is the BEST - high above the rest!!!

We took the Wings Over Kauai tour rather than a helicopter tour because of all the great reviews on tripadvisor.  I'll try to not repeat the other reviews too much, but I wanted to add how warm and friendly Bruce and Ellen were from the very beginning, when I called for reservations.  They were also very organized and tried to get a sense of what we were interested in.  Bruce tried to involve each one of us in conversation, and in discussion of what we were seeing.  It was a beautiful day and a wonderful ride---DH said it was his favorite part of our entire vacation!

My husband was very nervous about taking an air tour of Kauai.  He gets very motion sick, he can barely sit in the backseat of a car. Bruce and Carter were very attentive to this and made sure he was comfortable.  However, there was no need- the ride was so smooth and beautiful that he felt great.  There is no other way to see the island! It is amazing from the air.  Bruce, Carter, and Thomas were so friendly and fun.  I would recommend this to anyone, especially if you want to support a wonderful family that loves Kauai and exhibits the aloha spirit.

review_title: Absolute awesome view! Very nice hosts!
review_text: We booked a tour for April 11th 2010 many month in advance! Both owners were very nice and helpfull, because I wanted to surprise my fiance-to-be to ask her over the Island of Kauai to marry me. So I came up 2 days in advance to talk to the owners about this and they gave me tips at what place over the island would be the best etc. - Definitvely Na Pali Coast!!! AMAZING spot! the plane is in very good shape and Bruce the pilot and owner is a very good and friendly pilot with many many years of experience! And most important: The plane trip is by far cheaper than all the helicopter tours - with same time in the air! I would do it again any time! JUST PERFECT! Thanks for the experience! (.... and: yes, she said YES! ;-)

review_title: Absolutely wonderful!! Great way to see Kauai
review_text:
Thanks to everyone especially Ellen and Bruce in Wings over Kauai for making the tour a wonderful experience for both my husband and I!  We were in Kauai for one day and WOK was definitely a great way to see Kauai. For us, it was an awesome way to start our trip. Bruce is very knowledgeable of the island (agriculture, legends, movies filmed on the island, etc..). He also gave us and others in the airvan a brief lesson of the plane controls before take-off. Both Ellen and Bruce gave excellent tips to ease any motion sickness. Overall, the tour was nice and smooth. My husband and I loved it :D  I also got to take home a Kukui necklace and a CD with our photo on the cover. 

Side note:
As Kauai was our first trip and since it was one day, Ellen offered great suggestions to do in Kauai. One of suggestions was St. Regis and we are so glad we went there. The food and views were great! 
      
Mahalo nui loa!

review_title: Great Ride with Wings Over Kauai
review_text: Kauai is such a magical place, and a great way to see it is with Wings Over Kauai. Customer service was great, and they have a perfect safety rating. I have some issues with motion sickness so I took one dramamine 30 min. before we went up and had no problems at all. Bruce (the pilot) gave me some great tips on helping avoid motion sickness. It was a very smooth ride and we were lucky enough to have perfect weather. The views were unbelievable and we would recommend doing this to see the island. Also, the noise cancelling headphones made for such a peaceful ride, they were worth every penny!

Well organized flight with an excellent overview of Kauai. The pilot gave good snippets of information about all the highlights and also personalized the tour to give an aerial view of a temple we were planning to visit.

review_title: Bruce and Ellen were genuine and helpful...
review_text: Bruce and Ellen were genuine and helpful. Would reccomend to anyone.

review_title: The best day for many years / the best event I've ever had
review_text:
My girlfriend made me a surprise - booked flight with WOK. The company is owned by Bruce and Ellen C. - very friendly and nice people. No any pre-paid for booking, just book, come and FLY! Bruce took us over Kauai and showed everything from the different angle. We had seen most of areas before, but flying over it was worth it! I even dod not make a picture - it cannot tell even a part of that beautifil views. During the flight Bruce told us many interesting things about the island, about the aviation, he's just very interesting and attentive interlocutor.
But all this is nothing. In about 30 minutes, Bruce let me steer his Cessna, and autopilot was turned off (I checked:)) 5-10 minutes of flight - that was the most beautiful thing during this and many others vacatins i had...

That's not advertising, guys...if you're just tourist - you will like the view. If you are mad about  flight - that's main thing for you

review_title: Traumflug zu den Sehenswürdigkeiten von Kauai
review_text: Meine Frau und ich unternahmen am 11.April 2010 einen sehr günstigen 70 minütigen Flug zu den Sehenswürdigkeiten von Kauai mit einem Tragflächenflugzeug des Flugunternehemens "Wings over Kauai" mit Captain Bruce Coulombe. Es war ein unvergessliches Erlebnis. Captain Bruce kommentierte den Flug bzw. die Sehenswürdigkeiten ausgezeichnet und erklärte manches auch in Deutsch. Wir fühlten uns wie auf einem Sofa im Wohnzimmer, so sicher und gekonnt steuerte Bruce seine Maschine. Wir haben schon einige Rundflüge hinter uns, aber dieser Rundflug war sicher der beste von allen. Wir können dieses Familienflugunternehemen nur wärmstens empfehlen. Meine Gattin erhielt eine Nußkette und ich bzw. wir noch eine DVD über den Rundflug, sowie ein Foto mittels E-Mail als Zugabe. Herzlichen Dank an Ellen und Bruce.

I visited Wings over Kauai back in February, I was Refered there by a local after my current flight plans had got canceled. I would have to say that it was the best thing that could have happened. Ellen and Bruce were very welcoming and friendly, they helped me decide how to customize my flight the way I wanted it and then Bruce and I went up for a flight lesson. Bruce was amazing as he was very patient and informative both about the Island itself and with my flight lesson. I kinda got the tour and lesson all in one it was truly one of the best expeirences in my life. thank you both. if your looking for a great sight seeing tour or looking for  flight lessons on one of the most beautiful places on earth. Wings over Kauai is the number one spot to go.

review_title: If you want a personalized trip to see Kauai from the air this is the one.
review_text: If you want a personalized trip to see Kauai from the air this is the one.  Bruce, the pilot and COO is very personable and knows a lot about the island and its plants.  Most of Kauai can only be seen from the air.  My wife and I really enjoyed the trip and the price was quite reasonable.  We will do this again.

review_title: Awesome Airplane tour for two May 12,2010
review_text: I never took an airplane tour of any island in HI, but I am so glad I flew with the Wings over Kauai.  Owner Bruce Coulombe was a great guide, knowlegeable of the different vegetation in  Kauai , flew over the the canyons, Napali coastline, a lots of waer falls and  went out of his way to fly over the Resort we were staying to see the ocean front to see if we could snorkle. How can you beat this personal narrated tour...Love Kauai

My wife and I decided on an airplane tour before arriving on Kauai. Wings over Kauai was at the top of our list. Once on the island a number of people also recommended this company, so we made a reservation. Bruce and his crew were great! The young lady working the office was very friendly and we enjoyed talking to her while waiting for Bruce to return from his previous tour. My wife and I booked the smaller plane so that we would have it all to ourselves. Bruce was an excellent guide. He's very knowledgeable about the island history as well as the geography. We even received a tour video with our photo on the cover at the end of the tour. Would definitely do this again!

review_title: One of the best things we did while in Hawaii--we loved it!
review_text: My husband and I only had one day in Kauai while on our honeymoon (cruise stop).  We decided that doing an air tour was the best bet to see the most in a short amount of time.  Booking with Wings Over Kauai was so easy and Ellen wrote me a very nice email right after I booked, giving me directions, and even a map of where to walk from the cruise pier to meet our ride.  We were picked up at a shopping center near the cruise pier and taken to the airport where I was given a lei necklace, and flower for my hair, and then we met Bruce and went for our air tour.  It was really cool going up in our own "private" plane with just us and Bruce.  My husband got to sit up front and be "co-pilot" haha!  So much more personal than the helicopter rides.  Bruce was super friendly and smart, knew so much about the island.  The views were just incredible and I got so many awesome pictures.  It's a once in a lifetime experience (more if you are lucky!) and we are so glad that we did it.  It was more affordable compared to the helicopter rides, and the customer service just cannot be beat.  Wings Over Kauai really cares about their customers.  At the end we were given a DVD with our picture on the front (that was taken before the plane ride) and highlights of the tour.  We were on vacation for 17 days total, and of everything that we saw and did, this was probably our favorite!

Don't bother looking for a helicopter ride! This is the way to see Kauai! We were so totally impressed with the professionalism and warmth given by Pilot Bruce and Christie (Ellen was in Flagstaff :( that we can't thank them enough for such an unforgettable experience. This is what true customer service is all about! The DVD of our trip was such a perfect reminder of the places we visited in air.  Again our many thanks for such a wonderful ride!!! Rosemary and Mike

review_title: Wings Over Kauai was one of our best activities for the value.
review_text:
We just returned from a fabulous vacation in Kauai.  Bruce and Ellen made us feel like old friends that were visiting them for a tour of the island.  We enjoyed incredible views of Kauai that cannot be seen by driving or hiking.  Bruce was calm, personable, and very professional.   He also patiently answered numerous questions we asked, as well as, gave us plenty of photo opportunities.  Ellen has a joyful spirit and outgoing personality.  Hopefully we will visit them again in the near future.  GREAT TOUR! 

Cathy & Keith  (Austin, Texas)

This was a wonderful experience and worth every penny.  Bruce and Ellen are so gracious and friendly.  The entire experience was personalized for my wife and me and they made sure we felt comfortable during the flight.  Bruce is a great pilot and knows a lot about the Kauai island and is able to sure interesting information throughout the flight.  Before the we took off, Bruce gave a flight "checklist" to my wife to call out (rudder check, fuel tank full, etc).  It was fun, made us feel safe, and is a great example of how Bruce and Ellen went above and beyond to make the experience unforgetable.

While on a cruise through the Hawaii Islands, I was looking for an alternative to heliocopter  flights over Kauai and happened upon Wings Over Kauai. And was I ever lucky that I did. Bruce & Ellen are extremely gracious and helpful. Ellen even drove to where I was on another land excursion to pick me up since  timing of the flight was crucial to my getting back to the ship on time. The flight itself is very informative as Bruce certainly know the island. There are a lot of places on Kauai that cannot be accessed by automobile or even 4 wheel drive vehicles and Wings Over Kauai is the way to see these locations. I would suggest  it to everyone.

review_title: I have done the helicopters - skip them and take Wings over Kauai Tours.
review_text:
My dad is 83 and used to pilot a small plane before he got married 61 years ago.  he had the time of his life today flying with Bruce.  
We have done the helicopters over Kauai several times but this was wonderful - personal, great views for everyone, and we felt very safe.
Thank you to Ellen for booking us, Kristen (sp?) for logging us in and taking our picture and Bruce our pilot for a wonderful time.

the owners were absolutely fan-fun-tastic!!! MUCH SAFER then copters and much MORE info -hx. ENVIRONMENTAL - and fun entertaining facts , the views were awesome!! VERY PERSONNAL !!! LOVED their dog in the office and the personal touches on board...drinks, etc... Can't wait to fly again!!! the picures and dvd of flight made it even more special

review_title: Good service, great price, pleasant people.
review_text: Captain Bruce, Ellen, and Christen went out of their way to make my family comfortable. We have three children and this is definitely a family friendly business.The plane we flew in had window views for everyone in the family. We are all very pleased with the service we received and definitely recommend anyone considering an air tour in Kauai to fly "Wings over Kauai". While others are in business for profit only this family shows they have a passion for their business. The price is affordable and the experience is rewarding. They offer a complementary CD which captures the beauty of Kauai in the air incase you miss a shot.

This was a great experience for us ... they were so nice and helpful and considerate of motion sickness issues.  Bruce made this so special it's something I will always remember .. our pictures are great but none can capture the vastness and beauty of the islands forests, coast and water falls. I highly recommend ..  it was cheaper than helicopters and we didn't like our odds of being stuck jammed in between several people. being in a crowded helicopter would have sucked if your were in the middle and worse for motion sickness.

review_title: Amazing, breathtaking views of Kauai not to be missed!
review_text: We thoroughly enjoyed every moment of our tour from the minute we met Ellen to the final aloha to both Capt Bruce and Ellen as we left Wings-words cannot express the elation we felt seeing the beautiful island from the air with the expertise of Bruce's narration during our flight. We did this early during our week on Kauai and found it was a wonderful introduction to the many island sights which we later visited in person. The views of the Waimea Canyon and the Na Pali coast were absolutely marvelous from the air and not to be missed by anyone visiting the island. We would highly recommend this flight to anyone visiting Kauai-a tour we would rate 6 stars out of 5!!!

review_title: Great Views and welcoming, private tour.  Awesome alternative to helicopter tours.
review_text: The airplane had very large windows.  The owners were welcoming and friendly and very knowledgeable.  This is a great alternative to the helicopter tour as it is more sedate, much more comfortable, safer, and about half the cost, with a longer airborne time.  The picture taking opportunities were wonderful, and you can actually move around in your seat to look at different angles and views.  The owners treated us like old friends.  We would recommend this tour to everyone.

My husband and I flew with  Bruce this afternoon over what has to be one of the most diverse islands in the world! The trip was unbelievably awesome and will be a lifetime memory to treasure. Bruce and his wife, Ellen were a pleasure to work with. When we arrived, Ellen presented a beautiful lei to  me. Our 70 minute flight was amazing. We saw everything we wanted to see and more. Bruce was a wonderful tour guide as well as pilot (with a perfect safety record!!!--loved that!) and pointed out every detail as we soared over the lush landscape. It was amazing! When we landed,  Ellen presented us with a DVD of the trip with our picture on it. We have already watched it and were amazed again at the beauty we had just seen. Having seen the poor quality  of  one done by a local helicopter company  after my brother's trip, we were amazed at the professionalism of this DVD. The bonus was that it was not as expensive as a helicopter tour and was at least as good and quite possibly even better!!  We highly recommend Wings over Kauai to anyone thinking about flying over this gorgeous island! You won't be disappointed! Thanks again to Bruce and Ellen for a lifetime memory!!! If I could give it more than 5 stars, I would give it 10!!

Concur with the other reviewers that this is a great bargain and that Ellen and Bruce are very warm and professional. One thing to add is that they seem not to have updated the photos on their website. They actually have a new plane which seats 6 passengers and has much larger windows than the smaller plane depicted on their site. You will enjoy the sweeping views!

review_title: You HAVE to see the whole Island, the best and affordable way is this!
review_text: These guys are a hidden gem on Kauai! Bruce and Ellen have a smaller operation than the competition and add a personal touch to your flight. Ellen gave my wife a flower for her hair, and a stuffed animal for my little girl. They also have the exact same plane as the other guys (7 seater I think), though you won't see it in any of the advertisements (that I saw). They also have a 4 seater as well. We flew the entire island for half as much it would've cost to go in a helicopter. Ellen took a picture of the family before our departure and emailed it to us and gave us a DVD of a flight around the island so you can share the highlights with your friends and family later! During the flight Bruce had everyone pitch in to be a part of the crew-checklists and what-not. Bruce has a PHD in agronomics, and knows tons about the plants in Hawaii. We even swung out a little wider than usual to see a whale Bruce spotted. (It was March)  If you want to see ALL of Kauai, go see these guys!

This was our first tour on a small aircraft and it was awesome. Bruce and Ellen were so friendly and made us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. The flight itself was incredible. The plane ride was smooth and with the great headsets provided by Bruce there was no distracting noises. Bruce really does a great job in explaing about the islands agriculture and history. It really was an intimate feel with my wife and I being the only people on board. We were free to talk about personal experiences or even joke around with Bruce. I have already recommended this trip to two couples heading to Kauai this summer. This is a must do and I would definately fly with Bruce and Ellen again.  Mike and Pauline

review_title: Safe and fun way to tour the island of Kauai
review_text: When we visited the island of Kauai recently we had unfortunate windy overcast conditions for most of our stay and were worried we would not be able to see an aerial view of the island.  We decided to go with Wings Over Kauai because of the many excellent reviews and recommendations and were not disappointed.  At first I was a little nervous about flying in a small plane in windy conditions and feared motion sickness.  But Bruce is an excellent pilot and he eased my nervousness from the beginning and we felt very little turbulence.  Bruce is very knowledgeable about the island and the sights you will see from above.  We would recommend this tour.

review_title: Why would you want to take a helicopter???
review_text:
It appears that the key choice in chosing an air tour is to go by helicopter or by airplane.  The hotels always seem to recommend the helicopter tour, but why?  Could it be that they just recommend the most expensive option?  Take the airplane!  It's half the cost, and you see the same places.

Captain Bruce of Wings of Kauai has been flying for years, and his skill sets proved it to me.  As a commercial pilot myself, I notice things that most people don't.  I VALUE SAFETY ABOVE ALL ELSE.  Case in point.  There was another aircraft within sight that decided to fly up a canyon, one where the clouds were very low.  As I sat in the seat, I wondered if our captain was going to follow him.  My concern was that the clouds were too low to remain legally VFR (visual flight reference), a standard that tour planes must adhere to for safety sake because no IFR (Instrument Flight Rules) plan had been filed.  Flying into or too close to those clouds can spell trouble, after all, where are the sides of the canyon if you can't see them?  Draw your own conclusions.

Captain Bruce made a consciencous decision to take a different route, and we saw the same sights.  Later I asked him why he took that route, and he replied, "Safety comes first, and I did not want to risk my passengers".
