I would highly recommend Wings Over Kauai without reservation, as the best overall air tour operation on the island.

review_title: The BEST way to shoot aerial photos of Kauai
review_text: My wife and I went back to Kauai this summer and flew Wings Over Kauai for the second time.  I am an avid landscape photographer, and an airplane provides a better platform than a helicopter for shooting sharp aerial landscape photos due to the vibration of a helicopter.   Wings Over Kauai is a top-notch operation.  Scheduling a flight is easy - just call and choose a time.  We chose a custom tour where you tell Bruce where you want to go, and that's where he flies.  We spent most of our time over the Na Pali coast.  Bruce flew back and forth at our direction, circled the coast 3 times, and even tipped the wings of the airplane when we signaled so we could be sure that the wings would not show up in our photos.  We had absolutely beautiful lighting the day we flew, and I snapped over 400 photos in 1.5 hours.  Overall, our Wings Over Kauai tour was the highlight of our trip.

After reading the review about Bruce and Ellen, I decided to book the deluxe tour during my recent trip to Kauai. On my previous trip, I booked a helicopter ride that was great albeit a bit impersonal, and was going to do the same this trip until I read about Wings Over Kauai!  What a trip!! I actually decided to make the ride an instructional one and was able to actually fly the plane!!! What a thrill.  Bruce shared his incredible base of knowledge about the island, agriculture, you name it. I think my IQ went up a few points during the ride! What an expected gift that Bruce shared his passion so freely.

Bruce loves what he does, loves to fly, loves the land, and loves to share his passion with others and all that comes through. I will remember this trip for the rest of my life, and as soon as I get back to Kauai, I will be booking again - for 2hrs this time!!

When I think of Bruce, I think of this quote by Howard Thurman

“Don’t ask what the world needs. Ask what makes you come alive, and go do it. Because what the world needs is people who have come alive.”

Mahalo and much aloha Bruce and Ellen.

Our second time to Kauai.  Should have done it the first time.  And the second time.  The company is a husband and wife team.  Ellen takes care of the office and Bruce does the dirty work.  Bruce is a professional botanist as well as an experienced pilot and he's knowledgeable about the many movies with segments that were shot on Kauai and he can show you where it all happened.  As anyone knows Kauai is a beautiful place but from the air we saw a lot more of it.  We got out of the airplane with a new perspective on the island.  It's awesome.  Seeing it from the air with Bruce’s oration was the highlight of our trip.  The ride was smooth and airplane comfortable.  Noise cancelling headsets kept noise down and allowed two way conversation between everyone in the airplane.  Just go do it.

We highly recommend the very personable experience we had with Wings Over Kauai.
Bruce and Ellen were very accomodating to us - allowing us to change flight day and time.  
Captain Bruce is a wealth of knowledge as he flies you over the island.
Our family really enjoyed it because they add so many personal touches.

Thanks Bruce and Ellen!

Toronto, Ontario

review_title: The BEST In-Flight Tour You'll Ever Take
review_text: We are SO glad we took time for Wings Over Kauai!  Don't leave Kauai without flying with them!!  We hiked the Kalalau Trail before the flight - what an AMAZING VIEW seeing what we hiked from the air!  Your Captain is extremely knowledgeable of the area & full of interesting stories & facts we never would have learned otherwise.  DONT WASTE YOUR TIME ON A HELICOPTER OR OTHER PLANE TOUR.  We are telling you - Wings Over Kauai is the ONLY way to go.  We can't wait to go back!!

My wife, her sister and I went to Kauai and flew with "Wings Over Kauai".  I'm not ever too impressed but Bruce gave us a fantastic flight and history and overall tour of the island in his plane.  We felt safe and never worried about a thing.  It was an awesome experience and very light on the pocket book.  I will do it again when we go back.

review_title: Cheaper than helicopters, and way better in my opinion!
review_text:
Their pitch is half the price, with a more personalised experience. You are also riding in a safer plane than a helicopter. The helicopter is rumbly, my friend threw up on it, but it does get in the nooks and crannies. However, to me, this was perfect enough. You get to see everything in a comfortable seating with your own window seating and audio gear. The views are amazing and totally worth the cost! Even if it's a little misty out.
The best part is the people. They are probably the nicest people I've ever met, haha. Also, they are incredibly knowledgeable about EVERYTHING on the island from history, people, agriculture, even politics I'd say. I learned more on this adventure than in my entire 4 years of high school history class.
You get free drinks on the plane, ladies get the free flower that Bruce grows himself, and a Hawaiian necklace made out of.... I'm not going to even try to spell it. Also with lots of opportunities for photos (and they don't try to charge you for them like all the other tours!)
Overall excellent experience!!

We had a wonderful experience flying with Wings Over Kauai.  We booked it to basically see the whole island from the air but as airplane enthusiasts we decided to go for the flight instruction option.  It was definitely the highlight of our whole trip to Kauai.  
What a fun time we had!!!  We went around the entire island and my husband got to actually fly the plane through most of the trip.  We had such a great time that we booked another day where we each got flying lessons.  It was an experience that we both will never forget and will always look back on fondly.  What a beautiful place to fly for the first time!

Wings Over Kauai was very professional, and if you choose to take a tour with them you will definitely get a wonderful experience without having to be with a larger group of folks you don't know.  Its designed to be more intimate and I believe you get more out of your tour of Kauai this way.  
All I know is that they are very professional and we had a fantastic time with Wings Over Kauai.

review_title: awesome trip with wings over kauai tours
review_text:
I would like to take this opportunity to thank Captain Bruce and his wife Ellen for a awesome plane trip over the Island of Kauai it was breathtaking.   Ellen collected us from the cruise ship and dropped us back again at no additional cost.   WE found this couple to be extremely courteous, and professional and would highly recommend flying with Wings over kauai.

Regards from Ailish & Pat from Ireland.,.

we had a fantastic flight with Wings Over Kauai. Bruce & Ellen are both genuinely lovely people who take the extra step to enhance the experience wherever they can. Bruce is a very knowledgable guide with interesting insights about the island, and he's funny! The flight was very smooth, and the views are of course amazing. Considering this costs a third of the price of a helicopter tour, it's amazing value!

We were lucky enough to book a trip with 'Wings over Kauai ' on the one day we had in Kauai. We were immediately  made to  feel welcome and comfortable by both Ellen and Bruce. They must have had hundreds of visitors but  because of the very personal  approach we felt like friends who were being treated to an afternoon out . Bruce's commentary was informal but informative. I can't think of a better way to experience  this beautiful island.

My wife and I were in Kauai in July and we set up a flight with Wings Over Kauai based on comments here on Trip Advisor .  We didn't want to spend as much as a helicopter ride would cost, but we wanted to see Kauai from the air.  The filight was a teriffic way to see the island!  The customer service was wonderful, and Captian Bruce was a teriffic tour gide, giving us lots of great information as we flew around Kauai.  I would highly reccomend this service to anyone interested in seeing the majestic beauty of Kauai from the air.  Thanks Ellen and Bruce!

review_title: Wonderful People, Wonderful Trip, Wonderful Island
review_text: Bruce and Ellen are wonderful people.  I would very much recommend them to anyone.  They are the cutest, sweetest couple we met, and we have been able to continue communication with them by email.  They are the only people on the island that we have spoken to since we returned.  This tour finally provided us with a private tour, since the plane can only hold 2-3 people.  Bruce is a wonderful tour guide, and he makes the tour interactive and interesting to each and every person.  He likes to know your interests so he can talk about them on the tour.  He pointed out all the important sites and let my wife help him with the start up procedures.  The sound system in the plane made it easy to communicate with each other and the earmuffs did an excellent job of muffling the plane noise.  They even provide drinks and mints for the plane ride. Excellent beyond excellent!!!!

review_title: The Best Thing I Did in Hawaii
review_text:
I booked a sightseeing flight with Wing over Kauai a couple of days in advance. Ellen and Bruce provide very friendly service, and they were very flexible to accomodate things like my schedule and peculiarities of weather in Kauai.

I had the most beautiful flight around the entire island of Kauai with great narrations by Bruce. 

In addition, Bruce is a certified flight instructor. As a student pilot, I was able to fly the plane myself under his supervision and picked up a lot of invaluable "pearls" specifically operating a plane over terrain (mountains and canyons), open water, and in ever changing tropical weather.

My experience was great! Still sending pictures and telling stories to my friends. 

This is a MUST for anybody visiting Kauai!!!

See for you self: http://www.everytrail.com/view_trip.php?trip_id=301395

We had an excellent experience with Pilot Bruce and his wife, Ellen!  It was easy to book, reasonably priced, and our one-hour tour took us to all of the major sites in Kauai, including the Na'Pali Coast, the "wettest spot on Earth," the major waterfalls, and even Pierce Brosnan's house :)

I am terrified of flying, but Bruce made the experience pleasant and rewarding.  From start to finish, he kept a running narrative of what we were seeing, to make sure we didn't miss any whales, corn fields, waterfalls, mountain ranges, and beaches.  Our flight was smooth and calm, and Bruce quickly adjusted his flight path when my knuckles got white.  Bruce also encouraged us to take photos, and we did: about 100 clear, panoramic shots of Kauai, as you can only see it from the sky.

I strongly recommend Wings Over Kauai to everyone who visits Kauai!

This is the first review I have made the effort to write for a vacation experience, but this trip warrants it. Bruce and Ellen organize this very well, with every minute of the experience being fun, from the pre-flight checks to final landing. Bruce does a great commentary and is an excellent pilot. We felt very safe the whole time.
You will not be disappointed with this trip, and you could almost do two trips for the price of one helicopter ride. We will certainly go again next time we are in Kauai.

I had booked this way in advance after reading here about the excellent time folks have had and we were not disappointed. Both Ellen and Bruce are very friendly and made us feel very comfortable. The day of our original appointment it was quite cloudy and seemed to get worse and even though it was not windy or stormy Bruce very readily agreed to postpone the flight for another day. Another day turned out the very next day and when I saw the sun come out I immediately called Bruce and he was ready to take us up at the first available time slot. Went up with my wife and 18 month daughter who loved the idea of sitting in a small cessna. 

     The flight itself was very comfortable with Bruce being an excellent pilot. My wife who is generally quite scared of small commuter jets says she felt very comfortable within a couple of minutes of take off. Bruce's knowledge about the area is excellent and he can tell you a lot about the flora/vegetation of the region. He also sings for you every now and then. We are looking forward to doing this ride again next year. I would strongly recommend this for anyone over the helicopter rides.
Thanks Ellen and Bruce for a wonderful time.

review_title: Wings over Hawaii is a must do
review_text:
My husband and I traveled to Kauai for our honeymoon and visited Wings over Hawaii with Bruce and Ellen. It was such a personal and romantic trip and Bruce was very friendy during the ride. It was our first ride but we will definately do it again! We hope to go back to Hawaii soon. They provided a flower, necklace and even took pictures of us that they printed when we arrived back. They do an excellent job of customer service and are honest people. In Hawaii you have to place a reservation and provide your credit card info when booking anything. If you cancel within 24 hours you will get charged anyway. Ellen and Bruce didn't require this and were not pushy for business. It was a pleasant experience and you can't beat it for the price. I definately recommend it for your trip

Mahalo!

review_title: Fantastic Flight !  It has  to be the best way to see Kauai from the air !!!
review_text:
Our  flight was one of the highlights of our  vacation in Kauai. 
It was a pleasure  to fly with Bruce and meet his wife Ellen , he is an excelent pilot  and an excelent  communicator . It  was  fun to  hear him comment  on what we  saw  trough the  amazing Bose headphones, he sure knows his  Kauai inside out !! Aloha and mahalo for an unforgetable trip !!!

review_title: Best thing ever to do in Hawaii
review_text: Okay so if you go to any of the Hawaiin Islands and you do not make the time for a tour with Wings for Kauai, you are missing out.  Bruce & Ellen were the nicest people that you could ever ask for when dealing with a tour company.  Right from making the booking, to meeting them at the terminal, the awesome tour with Bruce in his Cessna with Bose Noise cancelling headphones, the souvienger and Bruce calling me after I left a personal belonging on his plane, these two make a person enjoy the tour and island like no other tour that my wife & I have ever been one.  I almost forgot to mentioned the island is beautiful when seen and narraited by Bruce  !  Thanks guys for a great experience on Canada Day, July 1, 2009.

If you want to experience not only the most breath-taking views of Kauai, but also the warm and wonderful welcome of the islands, then Wings Over Kauai is for you.  Ellen and Bruce are truly very special people.  Their passion for the island and its beauty enhance the entire experience.  From the moment Ellen greets you with a flower and a kukui nut lei, you just know you're in the right place.  And Bruce, with his knack for ease of conversation and broad knowledge of the island and its environs, makes you feel right at home.  There are dozens of organizations that are willing to take you around the island, but how many can wrap it up in a warm and fuzzy package and make you feel like you just took a spin around this beautiful island with an old friend?  Priceless.

review_title: Great way to see the Island!
review_text:
We booked our trip online, and received a nice personal email from Ellen (Bruce, the pilot's wife) almost immediately.  I had explained to her that my husband was also a private pilot and was really looking forward to the tour and meeting Bruce.

We met with Ellen in the office; she is so friendly and personable.  Bruce was just coming in from another tour.  The little touches that they do before, during and after the trip are so fun and make the trip even more special.  I won't spoil it by sharing them with you!

I sat up front, as I am a bit more prone to motion sickness, but I felt fine during the trip.  Bruce is an excellent pilot.  He is so well versed on the Island and has a wealth of fun information to share with you during the flight.  Our pictures came out great.  

We are glad we chose Wings Over Kauai!  We highly recommend this family run, professional tour.  Thanks Bruce and Ellen!

review_title: Wonderful Experience! Not to be missed!
review_text: We took the best tour (grand deluxe?) last week -- Ellen was so helpful and welcoming, and Bruce (the pilot) was exactly what you'd want in a pilot: knowledgeable, competent, alert, wonderfully soothing voice, and kept us informed about what we were seeing from the interesting perspective of one who knows what's on and in the ground. This is a wonderful way to see sights you would miss regardless of how into hiking or boating you are as some of it just can't be accessed on the ground.  We could see a helicopter which also looked to be great fun, but if your stomach or your nerves or your wallet  won't permit all that swooping, I can't say enough great things about Wings Over Kauai. The highlight of our already fabulous trip!

This is a late review but we took a flight with WIngs over Kauai during our honeymoon in October 2008.  Bruce, the pilot, is very knowledgable about the island and the views are amazing.  A benefit of Wings over Kauai is that it is personalized service since only 3 people can fly with the pilot and there is not a body weight restriction as there is with the helicopter tours.  We are coming back to Kauai this October 2009 with our parents and plan to have them take a flight with Wings over Kauai.

On June 4th,2009 our family of three took the tour.  We loved the view over the Kauai and it was very comfortable.  Eleven years ago when we took a similar flight from Maui to Big Island I was sick to my stomach.  This time I did not feel sick at all.  Bruce and Ellen are very nice and Bruce is very knowledgeable about the island.  We enjoyed every minute of the tour and may go back next year.

My partner and I travelled to Kauai in June as part of a three island tour of Hawaii.  I'd booked the Wings over Kauai 'Grand Deluxe' tour over the Internet based on positive reviews and we were not disappointed.  The hospitality shown by Bruce and Ellen was fantastic and we felt more like family guests than customers.  The flight was perfect - even though it was a small aircraft it was perfectly smooth and the scenery.....   If you want to really see Kauai then it has to be by air and if you have to go by air then I'd recommend 'Wings'.  As a Scot, I also have to mention that the cost is far lower than the helicopter prices we saw.  And I must also mention Bruce's Bose noise-cancelling headphones - having suffered trying to hear other narratives in other places over the background engine noise these were fantastic.

review_title: Once In A Lifetime Experience... Unbelievable!
review_text:
My wife and I had the trip of a lifetime with Wings Over Kaua'i on our recent trip to the island. We went to three different islands over the span of 12 days and saw many different things, however, this was the unquestionable highlight of our trip.

The company is a true family affair with Bruce, Ellen and their children, and they made us immediately feel welcome and a part of their extended family.

Bruce is an exceptional pilot and perhaps an even better tour guide. His knowledge of the island -- traditions, culture, geography, etc. -- is made even better by his knowledge of the climate and agriculture that you see during the flight.

We boarded his plane at the Lihu'e airport and took off on a route that followed the Eastern Coast south. We then turned West near Poi'pu and saw many things along the shore. During that part, and the entire trip, Bruce mixed in good conversation with fun facts and information about the island. It was as much of a learning experience as it was a sightseeing tour for us.

He then turned the plane northwest so that we could see the views of Waimea Canyon and eventually the dramatic Napili Coast. Words and photos do not do justice when describing these areas. It is truly an awesome sight and something that is hard to fathom. However, seeing it from the air adds an incredible dimension that you can't tell from land.

Bruce then took us along the Northern Coast of the island and inland to see Wailua Falls and other waterfalls. Again, an awe-inspiring experience.

When we booked the flight, Ellen warned us that the day we were going up could be a bit bumpy because of the tradewinds, but other than a few minor air pockets, it did not bother us at all. The entire flight was very comfortable for both of us.

Bruce also gave us the opportunity to open the window and take photos through that. We were amazed at the photo quality with the window both open and closed.

Overall, you cannot go wrong with booking this flight. It is unquestionable one of the best things I have experienced in our life. The price was very reasonable, and the quality of the experience was second-to-none.

review_title: The absolutely best way to see the island from the air.
review_text: This is an aerial tour from a Cessna 172 4-seater airplane. Very stable, very safe and FAR less bumpy than a helicopter. The pilot also has a PhD so you'll get a narration that is more detailed and informative than the usual canned speech from a flying tour guide. As a bonus, he's a flight instructor so when he learned that I am also a pilot, he was very happy to let me fly "left seat" which was a thrill for me and freed him up to narrate for us. Also, this is a fraction of the price of a helicopter. I'd do it again in a heartbeat.

My wife and I took a Grand Deluxe Tour of the Island on Sunday, June 7th during our honeymoon. This flight added to the many favorable memories we have of Kaua'i. We were greeted by Ailana during check-in. My wife was surprised to have been given a flower and a lei. The flight tour is definitely very personal and interactive, both with the take-off run-down check and the awesome noise cancelling headphones to communicate with each other. Bruce is not only a very experienced pilot, he was also a PhD in Agronomy (i think) in his former life. This made the flight quite interesting since he could talk about the plants and climate with ease. We saw wonderful rainbows, waterfalls, Waimea Canyon (which we didn't get a chance to drive to when we were in Kaua'i), and the wondrous Na Pali Coast. The lighting during our afternoon flight was majestic and the lush green mountain ridges were heavenly to see. We also saw many of the beaches we toured and famous movie/TV backdrops were pointed out to us. This was definitely a flight to remember!

My wife surprised me with this aerial tour as a birthday present. It was fantastic. I'm a pilot and was able to log the ride as dual time. Great "island flying" tips even for the most seasoned pilot. Bruce is a personable, professional pilot who goes out of his way to make all aboard feel comfortable. The aerial tour is second to none with some of the most spectacular scenery we've ever seen.

What a great time we had with Bruce+Ellen, my wife was a bit nervous about flying in a small plane but Bruce put her at ease and we had a great flight round the island. I would  recommend this trip to anyone

review_title: One of the top three events of a phenomenal vacation!
review_text: Few of the many wonderful things my wife and I did on our recent vacation to Kauai could top the experience of our Wings Over Kauai tour, and I can't imagine having had the vacation without it.  Bruce & Ellen are friendly, enjoyable, personal and professional, and know how to create an unforgettable time.  Don't visit Kauai without seeing it from the air, and try seeing it from the air with Bruce as your pilot.  You'll love it!

review_title: Awesome, even for a scardy cat
review_text: I was so afraid to fly!  So when my husband booked a flight on a teeny tiny plane, I was less than thrilled.  However, the staff was so sweet and patient and reassuring that the experience started out just fine.  They answered all my scardy cat questions before hand.  Once on the run way, it was very comforting to do the flight checklist.  The take off and landing was really smooth.  Though there was a little turbulance, around the West Side of the island, I found that I wasn't scared (well just a little bit:).  The beauty of the island and all of the information that we learned about the spots was well worth it.  We recommend that you book the flight for your first day there.  We did that, and really appreciated having the background knowledge of the places we saw from the sky once we were visiting the places on the ground.  It was an all wound wonderful experience!  The kind of experience you put on your top 20 list of  "cool things I did in life".

This is a once in a lifetime experience.  Kauai is a beautiful island.  Flying over this island in a Cessna 172 provides an awesome panoramic view of all the beautiful places.  Bruce (the pilot) is very knowledgeable and provides a verbal commentary throughout the entire flight.  There are so many waterfalls that counting the waterfalls is a real challenge.  Many of them are unreachable by land so flying over is the only way to see them and really appreciate them.  Bring a good camera along!

The entire staff at Wings Over Kauai is friendly and helpful.  They make this a truly special experience.  The spirit of Aloha is alive and well at Wings Over Kauai!

We just went on this flight today and the whole experience was amazing. It was our first year wedding anniversary and Ellen, Carter, and Bruce were extremely friendly and welcoming. The flight was not bumpy at all and I couldn't believe all the sites that Bruce showed us. We would definitely recommend this to anyone coming to Kauai.

Wings over Kauai was a wonderful experience to see all of Kauai. My husband and I took the entire island tour in 70 min. Bruce, the pilot, was wonderful. He made sure we had a great time learning and seeing the beautiful sites. We have gorgeous pictures because of him. This plane ride gave us the opportunity to see the entire beauty of Kauai , places that can only be seen by air. We would definitly use them again.

review_title: Captain Bruce and Ellen are the best!
review_text: Tuesday, June 2nd - My husband and I went on an air tour with Wings Over Kauai. First of all, Ellen's warmth was so welcoming and she gave us the best customer service i have received in a really long time. I love the fact that she is always cheerful and picks up the phone when you call. The plane was so nice and cozy and there wasnt too much noise at all. Captain Bruce was awesome and showed us all around Kauai...even flexible enough to take a detour to the Wailua Falls. His knowledge of the area and passion for Kauai was so heartwarming. Overall, a fantastic and unforgettable trip. Would definitely use them again when next I am in Kauai. BTW, you want to see what a happy couple looks like - check out Captain Bruce and Ellen. Complimentary personalities and there is just so much love between them...

This was a last minute activity my b/f and I decided to do on our last day in Kauai. Initially we thought all the helicopter tours were overpriced but being the brat that I am, I hunted down a cheaper option and found Wings Over Kauai as well as a $20 off coupon (per couple). So, it was just me, the b/f and Captain Bruce the pilot. While he didnt go really indepth about the sites, it was a peaceful tour, definitely beautiful and definitely personal. We got to know his staff pretty well in the short time we were there. They were all super friendly and super imformative and we were pleasantly surprised by the beverages offered on the flight and the ginger candy to calm our nervous tummies (except we weren't nervous, we just like free sweets). I have already recommended this tour to friends who are expecting to visit Hawaii (and I just got back last night.)

review_title: Absolutely fantastic start to our Kauai trip!
review_text:
We LOVED Captain Bruce and the entire staff at Wings Over Kauai!! They were so nice, and very knowledgeable. I was concerned about motion sickness, so I got hooked up with some ginger candies to help just in case...I also got a little Kukui nut necklace and a flower, and they took a couple of pictures of my husband and I before the flight. They really understand how exciting these things are for island newbies, and they totally embrace it!

As for Captain Bruce - he was great! He has a total love for what he does, and it shows big time! He points out everything, answers all your questions on the tour, and has little tidbits about just about everything! Flying with him was a total pleasure.

The flight was great - very safe and little turbulence. We saw some absolutely BEAUTIFUL sights and took some fantastic pictures. Captain Bruce opened up the windows a few times to let my husband take a few glare-free pictures of the highlights: Waimea Canyon, the Na Pali coast, and Wailua Falls. We have some gorgeous pictures as a result! Again, they understand how much these tours mean to us tourists, and they totally go with it!

Seriously - consider this as an option to your WAY overpriced helicopter tours. For $100 a person, instead of $160-$350, we got a fantastic, personalized tour of this beautiful island. I also recommend starting your trip with this so that you can decide what you want to see up-close later. We will definitely fly with Wings Over Kauai again on our next trip.

Bob and I had a wonderful tour of the "Garden Island".  We were warmly greated by Ellen and Bruce, my flower and lei were an unexpected surprise, as was being included in the pre-flight checks.  The depth of Bruce's knowledge of the island was very appreciated.  We were able to see things in a totally new perspective from the air than from the ground.
We would recommend Wings over Kauai to everyone and anyone that is interested in taking an air tour.  (We did actually give out a couple of cards)

Bob and Teia Strong, Harrisburg, Pa

My husband and I flew with Wings over Kauai on June 5. We came in on the Pride of America cruise ship and took a free shuttle to the nearby strip mall and then Elaina from WOK picked us up and brought us to the airport. After we were done we were dropped off at the same place and went to the beach next door for the afternoon. Very easy! Both Elaina and Bruce, the pilot, were very friendly. My husband really enjoyed sitting next to Bruce and learning about the airplane. We picked WOK because it would only be the two of us in the plane so we would get a private tour and because of all of the good reviews on Trip Advisor. The flight was a great experience. The views from the air were amazing and all of the pictures we took turned out great even through the plane window. Bruce also let us open the window a few times to get some pictures as we flew over Waimea Canyon and the Napali Coast. We felt very safe and Bruce made sure we were doing ok and were comfortable. After we were done they gave us a DVD of some of the views you see from the plane. The cover was a picture they took of us before the flight. It was a nice touch. We also appreciate Bruce taking time for us since his daughter was graduating high school that afternoon. We would definitely recommend Wings over Kauai!!

Bruce and Ellen from Wings over Kauai are an excellent team. Their hospitality makes one feel welcome and well taken care of. Being a small buisness they provide excellent service and they go out of their way to make their customers feel comfortable. Not to mention the view of Kauai from above is spectacular. If you are looking for an affordable yet worthwhile tour in the sky Wings over Kauai is the choice.  While the plane ride is very smooth and comfortable, meclazine may still be recommended for those with weak stomachs!! Aloha and Mahalo Bruce and Ellen!

You have to do this!!! The reviews are "spot on". My wife and I just got back from a 2.5 week trip to Oahu and Kauai, and this has to be the highlight of our trip. It's hard to add to all the positive things others have already said. From the time we were greeted by Bruce's (the pilot) wife, son, and daughter to the end of the flight, it was a very positive experience. 

It was just Bruce, myself, and my wife in the plane. My wife rode shotgun and had a good time going through the checklist with Bruce as he explained a bit about all the gauges. That was interesting to both of us, as neither of us are pilots. 

Just to give you some background, I only fly when I have to, and I'm not at all a fan of small planes. In spite of that, I had no problems with the flight. Bruce kept it nice and smooth. He did a great job of keeping us engaged in conversation the entire flight, and as someone else noted, he will position the plane to give you clear views of the Na Pali Coast. He's a funny guy too (he entertained us with a short rendition of a couple of songs from the musical South Pacific! haha).  

We really can't say enough about this "mom and pop" operation. Don't waste your money on the chopper rides. Wings Over Kauai is MUCH more personal than any chopper ride and you'll see amazing scenery the whole time. And I believe a small plane is safer than a chopper (if a chopper rotor goes, that's it. If a plane's engine goes, you at least have a chance of gliding back down to the nearest clearing, or glide into the water). 

A BIG thanks to Bruce and his family for giving us the experience of a lifetime!!!

Andy and Stephanie

When we arrived to check for our tour, I realized that I had left my credit card at the restaurant when we had lunch.  I used my wife's card to pay for the tour, but was very surprised when we got back to find that Ellen had called the restaurant and drove there during our tour and had retrieved my missing credit card.

Bruce gave us a fantastic personalized tour of Kauai, most of it over places that nobody ever gets to see.

We were impressed with the excellent service and HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS TOUR.

My wife and I had a very good time on this flight. The veiws were beautiful, the flight was smooth, Bruse is a very knowledgable guy and is a wonderful tour guide/ pilot.  Eleen was also very freindly and was even nice enough to drive us to our hotel.  Extremely nice couple and a very well run business. I would most definatly go back to them and recomend them to anyone.

The opportunity to fly a plane and see Kauai from the birds eye viewpoint is a rare treasure -- thank you Wings Over Kauai for the flight of a lifetime!  You made two pilots' dreams come true -- Scott and Ruth, Phoenix, Arizona

review_title: Go to "Wings Over Kauai" before you do anything else on the island,
review_text:
Flying with Bruce was an incredibly pleasant and informative experience. Everyone who visits Kauai should fly over the island with "Wings" early during your stay. You get to see the whole island and then you can plan to explore the areas that you liked. If you are looking for the two nicest people in the world, you will find them "Wings over Kauai". Bruce and Ellen are the best.
Don't waste time looking for a better place. There is done better than "Wings over Kauai.

review_title: A highlight of our visit on Kauai.
review_text:
We really enjoyed our flight with Bruce, as well as, our visit with Ellen and Carter.  We couldn't have asked for anything more or to be treated with more personal attention.  We highly recommend this family operation to anyone wanting to get an overall view of this beautiful island.  It is much lower priced that a helicopter flight and with only 4 passengers on board you have a window seat for better visability.  Noise quietening headphones are a definitely plus allowing you to communicate with the pilot.
Stan and Patsy Alexander
Hamilton, Texas

review_title: Thrill of a lifetime-The Bob Ross of the Air
review_text: Since you are reading this review you most likely are in Kauai or contemplating a trip to Kauai, and you are wondering whether you should you take the plane or the helicopter. For our family the choice was clear: Wings over Kauai. Pilot Bruce at WOK was not only super professional but an amazing tour guide. I will not repeat what the other reviewers have already said but I will say that we had a great experience. At half the price of Helo rides we were able to see some great sights over the island. It was obvious that Bruce has a wealth of knowledge about the Island...from trees and vegetation to star homes......WOKT is the way to go. We loved our tour so much that we not only booked for the next day to go whale searching but we also invited my sister to go up on her own flight with Bruce. Bruce is an extreme professional (Agronomy PHD.) who is not only safety conscious but one of those rare souls that truly do what they love...He reminded me of mild mannered Bob Ross with his Afro painting back in the early eighties, except Bruce paints with flying.. The next time we are in the Kauai area..we just have to go and stop in and fly with Bruce...

Lovely family! Awesome flight just like giding over paradise. We have taken several helo flights over the island, dh wasnt too thrilled about this flight. He is and was very happy about the price, experience,photos. Total experience a TEN!!!!!!!!!!  Hi Ellen ,Bruce, Carter and daughter of Bruce and Ellen.

If you are planning to do any flightseeing in Kauai, this is the ticket.  Bruce and his son Carter are a lot of fun and very hospitable.  My wife and I have been on helicopter tours and they are nice, but you don't get the personal treatment from them that you do with WOK.  Bruce is very knowledgable about the island's history and the agriculture on the island.  We got phenominal pics on our ride.  Would definitely go again if we go back to Kauai, which we hope to.

review_title: Highlight of our trip....Wings over Kauai.
review_text: A must do on Kauai!   It is amazing!  The plane seats the pilot plus three other people.  My daughter and her boyfriend went first, they told us it was wonderful, so, my husband and I went, yes, it was wonderful, so, my other daughter and her husband went....and they loved it!   The pilot is so knowledgeable, he answered all our questions.   To see the beauty of  the  island from the air is breathtaking.   Wings over Kauai is a must when visiting Kauai.

We made our second trip to the beautiful island of Kauai this spring.  And, one of the highlights of our trip was our tour of the island on Wings Over Kauai Tours.  The first time we were on the island, we took a helicoptor ride over the island.   And, it is both of our opinion the next time we visit the island we will choose Wings Over Kauai again.  You almost feel like you are floating in the air, and you really get the opportunity to view the terrain instead of just zipping by it in the helicoptor.  And, an added benefit was the information that the pilot and "tour guide" was able to give.  Bruce had excellent knowledge of the vegetation of the island which made it all the more interesting.  So, we would hightly recommend this to everyone. . .it would be our first choice regardless of the price. . .but with the price compared with the actual flight time . .this is the way to go
Sisters from Omaha, NE .

review_title: The Best Way  to See Kauai
review_text:
When you get to Kauai you will see all sorts of ads for helicopter rides. I'm sure they're nice, but they are expensive. Wings over Kauai is a ride in a small airplane for about half the price, and it is great, personalized tour for you and your family.  The tour takes about 70 minutes.  Be sure to bring your camera.  (The operator e-mail souvenir pictures and video of your family.)

The owner operator gives you a wonderful guided tour of what may be the most beautiful place in the world. There are scores of waterfalls; misty mountains, green, green valleys; remote, multi-blue beaches; surf and sand; in all a tropical mountain paradise.  There is no way you can see all of of Kauai without taking flight, and there is no better way to fly than in a small plane.

Helicoptors rides are cool in themselves, but for this you don't need the distraction of a thrill ride. The plane is simple, smooth and prefect for Kauai. Wings Over Kauai is a family buisness where you will ride with the owner, Bruce, meet his wife, and maybe even one of their kids. It's a warm safe feeling. Bruce is a easy going, knowlegable guide with a gentle sense of humor. He will show and tell everything about Kauai, where the movies were filmed, where the stars live, how agriculture works; he may even tell you the down side of the cost of living or the public schools. And he will show you the tail of Puff  the Magic Dragon in the town called Hanelei. I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai.

review_title: Hate Flying & Heights, But Loved This!
review_text:
I detest flying and heights, am a "safety nut", and add to all that, I'm cheap, which is why I was so reluctant to book an aerial tour of Kauai.  However, I just had to get my eyes on the aerial views I kept seeing pictures of so I took the plunge with Wings Over Kauai.  Reasons I chose them over a helicopter ride (and why it was the right choice!):
1.  Cheaper---this tour is literally half the cost of a copter ride.  The value is unbelievable.
2.  Personal---we would have been on the copter with 4 other people plus the pilot.  This tour is limited to 3 persons plus Bruce, the pilot, so my husband and I were able to go it alone and have a very tailored, personal experience.  Bruce was so knowledgeable about the island and sites he pointed out.  We asked lots of questions, and had a wonderful, personal experience. 
3.  Safety---I kept reading about recent helicopter crashes on aerial tours.  WOK has a perfect safety record.  I was shocked at how comfortable Bruce made me feel on the fight.  I felt completely safe.
4.  Stability---the small plane provides a more stable riding experience, and I am really susceptible to motion sickness.  Bruce helped me with some "tricks", and I didn't feel badly or get sick the entire flight.  I was truly amazed by this.  

If you are considering an aerial tour of Kauai (and you should---the views did not disappoint), you should choose WOK.  Bruce and Ellen are kind, helpful, considerate, and extremely accommodating.   

Thanks a million, Bruce and Ellen!

review_title: Absolutely the best thing we did on our whole vacation!
review_text: I was blown away by how spectacular this flight was! I am very nervous about small planes but Bruce is simply the best. The flight was so smooth and I actually felt very safe. His altitude is low and I think that makes it so much better. I wish I had done this sooner. Photos I got out the window were the best photos on our trip. This is a must for photographers.

review_title: Don't blink, every second is filled with awe inspiring landscapes!
review_text: This activity was the highlight of our trip.  We (my two teenage children and I) thoroughly enjoyed ourselves.  Bruce, Ellen and their son Carter were helpful, friendly and relaxed making this a delightful experience.  Kauai is a beautiful island and the beauty is highlighted from on high.  Most of Kauai is inaccessible by car so one cannot truly appreciate all it has to offer until you get an aerial view.  Bruce was informative and entertaining, educating us about the geography and history of Kauai and a little about flying.  Ellen and Carter made sure all the arrangements went smoothly and presented us with a great DVD that allows us to relive this great ride.  We felt safe the entire time.  This was a wonderful and fun way to scope out the island.  Mahalo Bruce, Ellen and Carter--Go Hokies!

review_title: Highlight of our vacation celebrating our 40th anniversary!!
review_text: What a wonderful experience my husband and I had flying with Bruce over the beautiful island of Kauai on April 17.  I have a tendency for motion sickness; however, Bruce gave me tips to avoid this potential problem.  He was very reassuring and an excellent pilot.  We were fortunate to have a sunny, and almost windless day. The sights were amazing.  Bruce's narration explaining the topography of Kauai was very informative.  We took some amazing pictures from the plane.  Ellen and their son Carter were very welcoming.  Carter gave us a CD of Wings Over Kauai, which we have shared this with many of our friends and family members.  The entire family contributed to make our day quite memorable.   AMP, New Jersey

Wings Over Kauai was one of the highlights from our entire trip! This is a must do in Kauai and will allow you to see beautiful views of terrain you would never see from the ground! Wings Over Kauai was affordable, exciting, and fun; our pilot Bruce, was very informative and pleasant to fly with. He knew a lot about the various locations and history throughout Kauai and played relaxing Hawaiian tunes while we flew.

This was our second viist to Kauai and we just had to return for another flight with Wings Over Kauai. We were travelling with our parents who had opted for a helicopter tour - big mistake for them! While we were waiting, my husband went for a spontaneous flight with Wings Over Kauai. Bruce and Ellen were gracious enough to accommodate us and we had a wonderful flight. Bruce always has something interesting and intelligent to share about the island and he's such an experienced and conscientious pilot that wants to give you his best personal attention. You can't be in better hands. My parents, meanwhile, returned from their harrowing helicopter ride that turned out to be crowded, noisy, and so bumpy that many passengers has to use their 'aloha bags' (i.e. motion sickness). They won't make that mistake again!

review_title: What a way to start our vacation!
review_text:
Our first morning in kauai we chose to see the entire island by plane and our time with Wings was terrific.  We felt welcome, safe, and delighted at the time spent with Bruce and the island.
Having later seen the helicopters zip up and down the canyons I am sure that I would have not survived that kind of tour - and we really did enjoy touring around the entire island.

I had reserved a tour with Wings Over Kauai.  Ellen in the office was very informative and extremely helpful when I called (not just about their services but for any questions I had about things to do on Kauai).
Unfortunately, weather prevented our cruise ship from docking on the island. 
Wings Over Kauai was very understanding and took our last minute cancellation without penalty.  I hope we make it there another time!!

review_title: I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai!
review_text: We skipped the helicopter tours because of their cost and motion sickness problems.  Wings Over Kauai uses a small 4-seater plane that gives you fantastic views of the whole perimeter of  the island (Na Pali coast, Waimea Canyon, waterfalls, lush fields, etc)  and when the weather is good can get in close to the interior as well.  It avoids the swooping and sharp turns that the helicopters make.  And it wasn't a bit scary!  Ellen was very friendly, accomodating, and reassuring when we talked on the phone before the trip, even more so in person!  She even handed out ginger capsules which really seemed to work to prevent motion sickness, and she took our pictures before the flight.  Bruce the pilot was also friendly and calm, made us feel safe, and narrated the entire trip.  The flight was exciting and gorgeous!  And the price was right -- $100 per person for the 60-minute trip,and a discount for the 3rd passenger.   They're a lovely couple and the trip was fantastic!

I am a private pilot and had the pleasure to fly with Bruce from Wings over Kauaii.  Bruce has a very nice 172 and he was nice enough to let me sit in the left seat for our flight.  Bruce was an excellent guide of the Kauaii scenery and was extremely dilligent to ensure a safe and fun flight.  Bruce was great showing the sites and since I have a vineyard took me to a vineyard experiment in Kauaii and also was a wealth of knowledge on the rest of the agriculture in Kauaii.

As a private pilot, this was the best way to see Kauaii.  For those who want a window seat to the most beautiful island in the world, do yourself a favor and book a trip with Bruce and Ellen.  I would say this is an absolute must do when in Kauaii.

My wife Cindy and I traveled to Kauai in early March.  Since the Napali coastline is only accessible by air or sea, we planned to take a flight over the Island.
The first day we scheduled a flight turned out to be cloudy with very low visibiltiy; so, Bruce and Ellen were able to reschedule our trip.
The morning of the trip turned out bright and sunny.  Bruce prepared us for the trip with all the pre-flight info.  We took the 70 minute flight to be able to view everything.  Bruce did an excellent job of pointing out the numerous highlights.  The waterfalls are simply spectacular!!!  We saw the Waimea Canyon from the ground; however, the flight over the Canyon was awesome!
Then, we flew along and over the Napali Coastline which is simply magnificent.  All the while, Bruce is continuing to point out places and areas of interest.  Great Job Bruce!!
I highly recommend the flight and consider it an absolute must for any visitor to Kauai!
Again, thanks for the wonderful trip and experience!
Roger & Cindy Thompson
Council Bluffs, IA

As a pilot I look for every opportunity to fly in new and exotic places.  Having flown in Maui,  I looked forward to flying in Kauai, however there were no airplanes to rent on Kauai.  Bruce,  as it turns out is a CFI and was very gracious in allowing me to fly form the right seat.  He offered the left seat but since the plane took all left turns it was easier for me to see the sights from the right seat.  I took off from Lihue airport and climed out over Poipu and headed for the grand canyons of Wiamea.  Bruce allowed me to fly as much as I wanted and when I needed to take pictures he was there to take the controls.  Both Bruce and Ellen were superb hosts.  My group had an excellent flight wtih great nariation and insights of the island.  I had tken a helecopter flight years ago but the plane ride was for me more enjoyable.  Especially for me taking off and landing at Lihue airport.  I have and will continue to recommend their service to anyone wishing to see the beauitful island of Kauai with an exellent host and pilot.
I can't add much to what has already been said.  Bruce and his family are great.  I saw a whale from the plane, and we both appreciated the safety the plane provides.

review_title: Half the price of helicopter tours
review_text:
At first I thought we wouldn't be able to afford a trip like this but then I realized how much cheaper it was than the helicopter tours. And that's just one of the pros. This family-operated business makes you think you are their most important customer, since only 4 people can fly (including the pilot) at a time. First of all the communication is so easy with them, we kind of booked a trip last minute, they responded immediately. Bruce is a really experienced pilot and we loved his narration during our tour. He is into agriculture so you can ask him about stuff like that.  Ellen was so nice and helpful with the check-in and everything. We had a wonderful time!

Mahalo!
Veronika and Akos

Please, please do yourself a favor and book a ride with Captain Bruce on Wings Over Kauai Tours!  My new husband and I were recently in Kauai for our honeymoon and we knew that we wanted to see Kauai by air.  My husband tends to get seasick/airsick/carsick, so I knew I wanted a quiet, uncrowded experience for him.  We called on a Tuesday morning to inquire about possible reservations and were able to fly that afternoon!  

Here are the POSITIVES:
(1) You get to meet Captain Bruce's wife, Ellen, at the private terminal and learn all about the family (even the kids!).  Ladies are presented with a special lei and a flower (which smelled so delicious, I spent the rest of the week trying to track down in perfume form only to find out nobody makes it!).  We also met their son, Carter, who was really sweet to us, took photos of us before we got in the airplane and in the airplane, and provided our pre-flight entertainment.
(2) Captain Bruce: Bruce is REALLY nice and knowledgeable; he makes you feel incredibly welcomed and safe.  We laughed when he offered us "in flight" service before our flight by giving us each a mint and collecting our wrappers!  (They also provide drinks.)  My husband got to sit in front with Bruce and do the pre-flight checklist, which made us both feel like we understood the plane better and was really interesting!  
(3) You are the only ones on your flight!  We were so glad we booked with WOKT after we saw all the noisy helicopters buzz in and out across the way from the private plane terminal, dropping off and picking up hoards of people.  Also, other small planes had numerous people on them.  On the WOKT plane, only three passengers are allowed at a time, so everyone has a window seat and everyone knows each other.  
(4) The flight is not noisy and you get to talk to the pilot whenever you want.  There was nice background music in our ear sets, but we were more interested in talking to Bruce about the island.
(5) Flights are affordable and almost custom.  We found the WOKT pricing to be extremely reasonable and affordable, especially compared with our experience before with helicopters and other small plane tours.  Because Bruce took time to get to know us before and during our flight, he made sure to point out or spend extra time on sights that would be of interest to us.  I am a huge fan of the Harrison Ford movie "Six Days, Seven Nights," which was filmed on Kauai, and so is Bruce, so he took special care to point out movie locales for me and we quoted our favorite movie lines.  He also dipped in for a closer view of whales breeching and our hotel.

Negatives?  Absolutely none!  We talked about our flight the rest of the week and the photos we took were the best of our trip.  After we got home, there was a nice email for us from Ellen with a photo they took of us before our flight, a great reminder of an awesome time!  Thanks Bruce and Ellen!
Let me add my 5 star comment to those before me, if you are going to see Kauai by air, this is the way to do so!  Everything about the experience was top notch, from check-in to goodbyes.

My husband and I just did a flight with Wings Over Kauai today.  Bruce and his wife, Ellen, run an amazing business and we could not have been happier with our decision to choose to fly with them.

Originally we were planning on doing the traditional helicoptor tour of the Island, but after seeing how high the prices were, we just couldn't justify spending that much money with a baby on the way.  I then read about Wings Over Kauai on a Trip Advisor post.  The price was over HALF of what helicoptor tours charged, AND you had the entire Cesna plane to yourself.  A completly personalized, private tour!

From the moment we were checked in by Ellen and their son to the moment we were finished, we could not have been happier.  The customer service was outstanding, with then taking a special interest in my safety and possibility of nausea with my pregancy.  

Bruce was an amazing pilot and the flight on the little Cesna was incredibly smooth.  The views were outstanding and we saw more than you would get to see if you did a boat tour.  We felt so incredibly safe, and Bruce was a great tour guide!  

I would highly recommend Wings Over Kauai to ANYONE coming to the island.  Skip the over priced Helicoptor tour and take this tour instead.  It was well worth the money and you won't get a better look at the entire Island.

We did this air tour on our 2nd day on Kauai. It allowed us a look at what we wnated to visit on the rest of our trip. Bruce and Co are a small family owned business with a very personal touch. The plane is quiet and smooth. I was worried about air sickness and had not a trace. Take this trip-----you will love it!!!

review_title: The best way to see Kauai is with Capt. Bruce & his family.
review_text:
This is the best way to see Kauai.  On a previous trip to Kauai I took a helicopter trip.  This blows that tour away.  Bruce's airplane is the way to see Kauai - every flight is a private flight so you get the entire airplane to yourself.  And it's cheaper too.  Especially if you are a bit on the heavy side, as Bruce and Ellen don't make you buy an extra seat as long as your entire group is under 580 pounds. 

Bruce and Ellen run an amazing little family operation out of Lihue airport. 

I called at 9am this morning because the weather looked great and my wife and I wanted to do some sort of aerial tour of Kauai during our visit.  Ellen answered the phone and was able to fit us in to the schedule at 11am.  We got there a little early and decided to take the slightly longer 70 minute flight tour that included more waterfalls. Totally worth it!

Capt. Bruce spotted some whales right after take off and so we went off shore a little bit and got some amazing aerial views of whales before heading back along the coast and through the mountains to see Kauai.

From welcoming us in the back office and going over the safety briefing to explaining the flight operations, we felt safe and in good hands the entire time.

The views area amazing from Bruce's Cessna airplane.  The windows are huge and clear and even though I'm an airplane geek I spent all my time staring out the windows at the awesome views.  Bruce knows his stuff and has lots of info about the island and plant life.

review_title: Our favorite part of Kauai?  All of it from above!
review_text:
Our 1-hour on board of "Wings over Kauai" was the best part of our Paradise vacation in Kauai!

Flying is the best way to see all the wonders the island has to offer, the canyons, the waterfalls, the Napaali coast, the hidden secret beaches etc etc.

For a much better price than Helicopter Tours, you get the same stunning views of the Island, but without the Air Sickness! It's also much more environment-friendly, which really mattered to us.

Stepping in their Airport Location was like meeting friends. We loved that Wings over Kauai is a Family business and all members of the family were so friendly!

Bruce, the Pilot, is very knowledgable about the island and gave us tons of great info about the plants, the trees, the volcanoes and the movies that were shot on Kauai.

He also positionned the plane for us to get the best picture angles :)

Hawaiian music and the fresh air breeze gave the tour such a relaxed atmosphere... It was truly wonderful and we will definitly go back on our next visit to the island!

Thanks again for a magical experience!

Bruce's plane tour of the island was 5 star+.  We did the 70 min tour and got to see virtually the entire coast of Kauai.  After living here 10 years, I'd say this is the best tourist activity I've ever done by far.  We had perfect weather with the top of Wai'ailiali visible from the air and ground (maybe 15 days a year can you see the top).

It's a very stable ride.  Good for those of us with motion sickness.  Beautiful views, paced nicely.  

Can't recommend this tour or the operators highly enough.

review_title: The best part of our trip!
review_text:
The airplane tour was the first official thing we did once on the island, and it was by far our favorite activity the whole time! The pilot was wonderful! Would definitely recommend to others!! I can't say enough good things about the tour!

Lauren K., Memphis TN

Actually it was the best part of the entire trip (Oct 9,2008). This family is great. Very friendly and overall wonderful people. We loved the experience the sights were beautiful and Bruce took his time for us to get the most out of the experience.
Thank you for everything
Miami

Captain Bruce was a wonderful, intelligent, informed pilot and guide as well as a high quality personable individual.  Ellen was very warm and friendly as well as efficient from the time we arrived.  These people truly love what they do and it comes through in the close personal service they provide.  The ride was smooth and we always felt safe.  The headsets were quite comfotable and eliminated the background noise of the airplane.  They were voice activated so we could have regular conversation.  We saw and learned about many details of beautiful Kauai, geographically and historically.  These fine folks have done their homework and put great effort into providing a memorable experience.

Wings Over Kauai provided us with a marvelous overview of the island upon our visit to Kauai. We opted for the Grand Tour and we were satisfied in very aspect. Capt. Bruce provided a spectacular sunny day and a very calm ride. His extensive information on history, geography, botany, films made here, etc. kept us tuned in and glued to the windows. My special request to see whales was treated seriously and sure enough, from the air we spotted two of them! 

The plane was comfortable and Bruce proved to be an able, competent and confidence-inspiring pilot. His wife and son were wonderful complements on land to the entire program. We give the company our heartiest recommendation!

My husband, son, and I visited Kauai last month, and after reading all the wonderful reviews here, we decided to go "flightseeing" with Bruce and Ellen and their Wings over Kauai.  What a great idea that was!  Bruce really made us feel comfortable and he also made the trip very personal by incorporating things he learned about us into his description of what we were seeing.  We had checked out some of the helicopter tours, but for 3 people, the price was prohibitive to say the least.  The 3 of us had a wonderful experience for under $300.  Also, the airplane uses much less fuel than a helicopter so it is more eco-friendly.  I would definitely recommend Wings over Kauai for a very fun and informative tour of this beautiful island.

As other reviews mention, Wings Over Kauai provides an excellent and reasonably affordable experience.  Bruce and Ellen are very committed to delivering a high quality service.  We didn't have the greatest weather the week we were in Kauai and they were very flexible in rescheduling it for a time that would be better.

The ride was comfortable and the views spectacular.  I've never done a helicopter tour, so I can't compare, but I can't imagine it's worth twice as much as this tour.

Highly recommended.

review_title: The most affordable must do in Kauai
review_text:
Simply the best tour money can buy! We really enjoyed our flight on Tuesday, March 3rd 2009! For anyone considering an air tour of Kauai you should do yourself a favor and call or e-mail Ellen about Wings Over Kauai - you will not be displeased!

We booked our tour based on the flawless feedback here on TripAdvisor. Our original schedule was to fly on Monday afternoon but that afternoon stormed and was way too windy for my wife and I. A quick phone call to Ellen and we rescheduled for the next morning and it was perfect!

The flight was a little bumpy as can be expected from any aircraft of this size (helicopter or plane) but it was worth it. The views were unforgettable. Bruce is a fountain of knowledge about the island and was so calm and polite to us. He shared with us details about what was planted (farmed) and what was natural - explaining the soil and why we were seeing the colors that we were. It was awesome! Better than watching Discovery or Science channels and so personal to what we wanted to know.

Do it. You'll love it!

Thank you, Ellen & Bruce!
-Brian & Garyann

Wings Over Kauai Tours was one of the highlights of our Kauai stay.  Bruce and Ellen were thoughtful and informative.  Their attention to details really shows.  The flight was spectacular.  When it was all over we felt we had friends we have known forever.  Thanks Bruce and Ellen for letting this old rusty pilot fly your beautiful plane and the Bose headsets were the icing on the cake.

Thanks again for making our stay more memorable.

Mike and Evelyn Parson
Portland Or

We took the Pali Mist tour with WOK today (Friday). Making the reservation was very easy. I called their # on Thursday morning and Ellen took our information (name, hotel, weight, when we would like the tour). We were concerned about the weather as it has been windy the whole week and my husband was prone to motion sickness. She said that the ride can get bumpy at times and most people were able to tolerate without getting sick. 

The morning of the flight, it was overcast and windy. On our way to the airport, it even rained a little. We were greeted by Ellen 30 min before the tour at the commuter terminal. She was very friendly and gave me a flower from her garden to put in my hair and a lei. She then got us ready in the plane (cooler with drinks, seat belt, window etc). Take-off was nice and smooth and we were on our way to some fantastic views. We hiked a few trials and saw some of the sights earlier during the week and it was really neat to see the same sights from air: the Na Pali coast (via Kalalau trail), the Hanalei bay (via Alaka'i Swamp trail), the Waipo'o falls (via canyon trail). The most amazing was we saw many sights that could only been seen by air. That made the trip really worthwhile. Bruce gave excellent narratives throughout the tour and pointed out the sights for photographs. Overall it was a wonderful trip. I would have given a five-star if the weather were more cooperative. We did not get sick but the flight was bumpy at times due to the wind. I would highly recommend the trip. After all, it was only $220 for two and we got the plane, the pilot, and the beautiful sights all to ourselves.

review_title: Highlight of our Visit to Paradise
review_text: We visited four islands over two weeks in mid-February.  It’s true: Hawaii is paradise.  On our first day, we took flight with Bruce over Kauai and it was the highlight of our entire trip.  Both Ellen and Bruce prepared us well for the flight and, once in the air, Bruce was the perfect pilot/host.  He explained precisely everything we saw, pointed out subtle things we might have missed, and made sure our money had been well spent.  Speaking of money, the price for the deluxe flight was significantly less than even the special rates now available for helicopter tours.  We both had window seats because the plane only seats four (including Bruce), and my window opened for perfect picture taking.  It would be difficult to imagine a better way of being introduced to paradise.

We arrived by cruise ship early on Feb 12th.  Ellen and I had been in  communication since I originally inquired about Bruce's Kauai flights since reading fellow "Trippers" reviews.
Both Ellen and Bruce made this both painless in connecting up with them but just a supremely pleasurable experience in all respects.
Bruce makes no bones about being ultra-safe and taking his time in checking everything out prior to taking anyone in the air. Just to keep me busy (I'm sure) he handed me his partially completed pre-flight check list for me to call out.  He explained things as we went through those final steps.  Then it was our time to take to the air.  The views experienced simply can not be put into words.  Photographs don't do justice to what the eyes absorb and fills one's spirit.
Bruce, explains points of interest through-out.  The noise-canceling headsets everyone is equipped with make for a wonderful experience.  Not having to deal with the drone of the engine throughout the flight is just one more of the many small details Ellen and Bruce thought through to make this nothing less than a top-notch experience.
Mom received a kukui lai upon the completion of the flight.  I felt left out :-(  I had it planned that both mom and I would be "lai'd" twice during our visit to the islands.  Sadly, due to circumstances caused by mother nature, our next stop (in Maui) was cut short and our luau was missed due having to return to ship before the afternoon was over.
One last note concerning Wings Over Kauai...
BIG thanks go out to Mary, Bruce & Ellen's progeny chauffeur.  She was tasked with returning us back to the pick-up point.  We inquired about eateries for afternoon lunch.  After picking our brains about our tastes (I tend to be a bit more willing to experiment than mom)  Mary recommended "Duke's Canoe Club" along with the sage advice of "you MUST try their HULA PIE" (she also warned that one slice would be enough for two)... Mary was wrong on that point.  One piece is enough for a small army.  LOL
Thanks again to Ellen, Bruce and Mary Columbe  
You made mom's "dream vacation" that much brighter and special.  
Many, MANY Mahalos

review_title: WINGS  OVER  KAUAI  --  Excellent   Airplane  Tour
review_text:
**   **  In late January - early February, 2009, my wife and I visited Hawaii (to see Kauai and Ohau --  plus an Hawaiian cruise) for a first time trip.    
**  **  We wanted to see / photograph the "Garden Island" -- but knew we had to get up into the air to  REALLY  see this island.
 ** **      We selected Wings Over Kauai as it is essentially a private charter for up to 3 people plus pilot --  with a reasonable cost ($100 for 1 hour -1 person).   Both of us had window seats !!
 **  **     Ellen & Bruce  (a married couple) made a very enjoyable & safe trip.  In the air, Bruce provided ample information about many topics. WOK has a very effective sound system to reduce  airpland engine noise and permit talking among passengers and pilot.  The trip produced many pictures taken by both of us.
  **  **    Actually we scheduled a one-hour airplane flight  --  and followed up with a second one-hour flight several days later.   
 **  **  During our two week vacation we saw and did many things - all where new to us.  The WOK flights certainly are extremely high on our list of wonderful experiences.  WOK is a first rate & safe operation.
 **   **    Would we take a third flight with WOK ?  YES !!!  We highly recommend WOK.   But probably a different month so photography conditions (light, clouds, etc) are different  --  for  us.
 **    **   Once you have seen Kauai from both the air and from the ground  --  --  you will understand why Kauai NEEDS to be seen from the air.  Steep mountains limit roads; much of the land probably has never been walked upon - - -  it is wilderness, waterfalls, abundant plants and trees, mountains, coast, and ocean waves.

        Gary    --      Arizona   --          February, 2009

I came to TripAdvisor looking for a Kauai helicopter tour recommendation and stumbled onto the superlative reviews for "Wings Over Kauai".  Changed our plans and REALLY glad we did.......the experience was the BEST ever and really was the highlight of our 25th anniversary trip to Kauai and the Big Island.

Here's why:

1.)  Bruce is an excellent pilot and the flight was extremely smooth.  Even though he gave tips to avoid motion sickness I felt nothing but glee and delight on being aboard and seeing the sights.......couldn't get enough.  The avoidance of symptoms was I'm sure in large part due to Bruce's flying abilities.  

2.)  Ellen and Bruce were VERY VERY accomodating in rescheduling our flight due to overcast and cloudy conditions which plagued us during the majority of our trip.  We were rescheduled from Tuesday to Wed to Thursday AM (right before we left Kauai) in order to allow the best viewing conditions possible.  I seriously doubt many copter tours would have done the same.  Ellen and Bruce knew how special our trip was to us and wanted us to have the same experience with our Kauai flight. As a result, we actually saw Waimea Canyon and several North shore beaches in bright sunshine vs. our road trips earlier in the week.  Saw the NaPali coast in all its glory and admired all the named and unamed waterfalls gracing this magnificent island.  

3.)  Ellen and Bruce are the friendliest folks ever.  They are wonderful proprietors of their family-run business and treat you like they would a friend or neighbor.  They even loaned us one of their guidebooks and gave us suggestions on the North shore when we mentioned we would be driving there.

I could go on and on but suffice it to say that taking a flight with "Wings Over Kauai" will be one of the  most enjoyable and memorable experiences ever  (ono ono).

Mahalo Ellen and Bruce!  :-)

-Sandra and Phil C.

review_title: Best trip ever ... just loved it... highly recommended
review_text:
The WOK experience was really great. AWESOME !! It was way better than I had expected. 
The flight was excellent. The hosts very hospitable and friendly. 
The flight was pretty stable unlike I had expected. I thought I'd be sick and feel queasy but did very well. The pilot Bruce he is excellent and fun to be with. 
All in all a great way to get a personalized tour of the famed Napali coast and Kauai without the huge price tag

review_title: Highlight of the vacation; once in a lifetime experience!
review_text:
I've traveled all over the world, spent 26 years in the Navy and flown on many aircraft but never in my life have I seen such beauty. This is a tour that is worth every penny, and is very affordable when compaired to other tours. Bruce is a safe pilot, and the ride is super smooth. Its not easy to discribe but I would be safe to say its near heavenly up there. 
Donnie

review_title: Wings Over Kauai - A Cut Above
review_text: Knowing that my wife, Valerie, wouldn't consider a helicopter experience over the island, (neither would I) I researched WOK and talked her into the flight.  WOW!  We totally enjoyed the kindness and trust in Bruce and Ellen.  We were going to fly a day earlier, but the weather conditions weren't the best so they rescheduled us for the following day.  Val was the copilot and helped Bruce with the checklist.  After checking for birds, we were off.  At half the price of a chopper and so personalized, just the three of us, you couldn't ask for more.  Make sure Bruce demonstrates the Bose noise cancelling headset.  Incredible!This flight was the highlight of our week on Kauai.

Wings Over Kauai was recommended to my husband and I by the owner of the Inn where we stayed (Lorna at Kauai Banyan Inn) and after reading the reviews here at TripAdvisor, we decided to book a flight-seeing tour with them. 

We went on Superbowl Sunday, which was an absolutely perfect day to fly. The clouds were minimal, the lighting was fantastic, and the photo ops were amazing! 

Bruce was a wealth of information - pointing out specific locations, and sharing his knowledge and love of Kauai with us as we made our way over Waimea Canyon and along the Na Pali Coast.

My husband and I loved that it was just the two of us on the tour! As a passionate photographer, I was thrilled to be able to open the window and shoot  without the obstruction of window glass in front of my lens. 

My husband and I give this tour - and Bruce and Ellen - four thumbs up! This was not only a great value, but our most memorable experience during our visit to Kauai. We wouldn't hesitate to do it again the next time we visit.

Our entire experience from the initial phone call to our landing was extraordinary.  Ellen, thank you for making us feel like family over the phone and Bruce is just as fabulous.  It was the best vacation experience and value you could ask for.  Having previously experienced a vacation helicopter tour we weren't sure if this would afford the same experience.  It went above and beyond and was worth every penny. Not as expensive as helicopter tours and what a personal experience.  Ellen puts you at ease on the phone and on the ground and I can assure you Bruce does the same pre-takeoff and during the flight.  You know you are in good hands from start to finish.  Bruce's knowledge of what you are viewing is phenomenal.  He is a plethora of information and a seasoned pilot.  You cannot ask for a more personal experience.  If you are a nervous flyer, I can assure you that you will feel safe and comfortable with him.  And so much of Kauai you cannot view on foot or by car, this affords you the experience of a lifetime.   Thanks to Bruce and Ellen of Wings over Kauai for great memories made!

My husband and I took the one-hour tour with Wings Over Kauai on Jan. 22, 2009, and would recommend it to everyone. We did the helicopter tour 4 years ago and enjoyed it, but this tour is so much better. Bruce and Ellen make it special is why. Ellen checks in the guests and gives each lady a kukui nut lei. Once in the little Cessna, Bruce had my husband "help" him ready the plane for flight. The lift-off was so effortless and light, I didn't realize we had left the tarpac at first. Once airborne, I felt like a dragonfly zipping along in the air. Bruce was very friendly and knowledgeable about the island, pointing out lots of points of interest including the roofs of celebrities' homes. We felt we were out with a friend instead of someone we had just met. The motto of Wings Over Kauai is "Twice the fun for half the price," and that's absolutely true.

review_title: Wings Over Kauai is the Best for Kauai Flightseeing!
review_text: We loved our flight with Bruce!  He showed us so much of gorgeous Kauai, we learned a great deal about the island from him, we felt so welcomed by both Bruce and Ellen, and we appreciated having our own personal tour.  The price can't be beaten, and Bruce is an excellent pilot.  We'd highly recommend this tour.  You really haven't seen Kauai until you see it from the air!  This is a family owned business, you get lots of personal attention, and you won't be sorry you tried Wings Over Kauai.

The flight with Wings Over Kauai two weeks ago was fantastic! It was a windy day but Bruce did such a good job taking off and landing that my husband and I didn’t feel the turbulence. Despite the strong wind, Bruce kindly allowed my husband take open-window photos after getting my permission (hint: let the “photographer” be the co-pilot, and prepare for strong wind flow at the back seat during open-window shooting). Also thanks to the Bose noise-cancelling headsets, we were able to enjoy Bruce’s delightful narrative of Kauai: its legend, history, agriculture and more without the disturbance of the engine noise. The views were breathtaking! The Wings Over Kauai is the highlight of our Kauai trip. I give the highest recommendation.

This was the best of the best to see the island's beauty.  My husband even got to fly the plane for a while. Truely a must do on the island of Kauai. You just can't see everything driving around in a car like you can from the sky. Bruce & Ellen made this trip a personal venture for us. They focus on what "you" really want to see and will spend extra time doing so. We received a warm welcome with a kukui nut necklace and a fresh flower. Ellen also took a photo of us in front of the Cessna before take off and emailed it to us later. 
This was much safer and less than half the price of a helicopter ride.

review_title: where else would you get a custom charter for $100!!
review_text: what a brilliant trip!!excellent value so glad we did this instead of the helicopter!bruce and ellen were lovely so friendly and knowledgable.bruce had us totally relaxed for a superb smooth scenic flight i wouldnt hesitate in recommending them for your trip. where else would you get a custom charter for $100!!!
