review_title: A must-do for all Kauai trips!
review_text:
My new husband and I were in Kauai for the second half of our honeymoon. My one thing that I had to do was go on an air-tour of the Island. Honestly what initially drew me to Wings Over Kauai was the price...most helicopter trips were almost $250 per person! I called up this co and Ellen was so sweet and helpful, the instant I talked to her I told my husband that I really felt comfortable & that we weren't going to regret going with them (being a tourist you never really know what you are paying for). When we arrived we felt so welcomed and at ease. I even got presents from them! The ride was amazing! Smooth, wonderful views, comfy seats, and we could all talk to eachother on our awesome headsets (Bruce did a good job on buying top of the line headsets!) 

Bruce was a great guide. He gave us tons of history & info we didn't know from the typical 'tourist' books we read, which made the flight even more enjoyable for us. We shared stories (and  tons of jokes) the whole way.

Another plus to consider...if you or another person in your party are afraid of flying, this is the plane to take! My husband is terribly afraid to fly (you practically have to knock him out to get him on a plane!) But Bruce handled the flight so smooth and was always checking to make sure my husband was ok and feeling alright. That little touch meant so much. 

In the end, I can't say enough about this company. They really made our vacation. I said that the price is what drew me in, but honestly after the service we got, I would have paid 3x the amount they charge to get such a wonderful experience again!!!   Mahalo Bruce & Ellen!

My husband and I chose Wings Over Kauai (WOK) because we wanted to see the island in a way that was affordable, economical and fun. When we discovered that flying with WOK was less than half the cost of going the helicopter route, our minds were made up.

WOK is run by a family of the nicest people on Kauai. Bruce, our pilot, was warm, friendly, funny and informative. His background in agronomics gives him keen insight into Kauai's flora and fauna. During the flight, we had on Bose noise-reduction headphones and got to listen to a wonderful selection of Hawaiian music that Bruce had compiled.

The flight itself was smooth and exhilarating. We saw four pods of humback whales as well as the entire island, including many famous spots such as the waterfall in Jurassic Park, the Waimea Canyon, the breathtaking Na Pali coastline and Mt. Waialeale.

We loved our flight and would definitely recommend flying with WOK to anyone interested seeing the island from above in a comfortable, relaxed and personal setting.

Tiffany & Ian Beliveau
January 2009

I have been to Hawaii approx 40-50 times and flying with Wings Over Kauai rates in my top 5 of fun things I have ever done in Hawaii.Flying with Bruce was a blast and dealing with Ellen was painless.When I called Ellen for information, you could tell she had the true "Aloha Spirit". When I informed her that I was a private pilot and asked if I could do the flying she said that would not be a problem, as Bruce is a FAA certified flight instructor. Bruce was extremely safety oriented and has a wealth of knowlege about Kauai. His aircraft is in great shape, has Bose noise cancelling headsets, and is a pleasure to fly.
 I have previously taken 3 helicopter tours on Kauai. Flying with Wings Over Kauai takes you basically everywhere the helicopters go at half the cost. I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai. Thanks Bruce and Ellen, it was really fun.We will be back.
Al and Eric

WOW!!! What am amazing experience. It was such a treat meeting Bruce and Ellen. They were so kind, welcoming, and relaxing to be around. We could have spent all day with both of them. We were so fortunate to have a clear day that we could see for miles. The hills were so green and the waters were so blue. We will never forget our flight. It was a longer flight than helicopter and WAY cheaper. We recommend Wings Over Kauai to EVERYONE!!!

review_title: Great for those of us who get queezy
review_text:
We found this attraction on Trip Advisor and were happy we did. Bruce and Ellen are very genuine, warm people. Both my daughter and I tend to get car-sick quite easily, which made us reluctant to do a helicopter trip. Bruce is an awesome pilot, though, and even on the landing, where I could feel the pull of the wind, it ended up being extremely smooth. The price can't be beat. 
Now, if you're looking to get "into" the canyons, etc, then this is not the trip for you. But, if you want an excellent look around the island, with just the right amount of background information, then this is the tour for you.

review_title: Our great experience of kauai air tour
review_text: This is the best air tour. Bruce the pilot is great and he is  an excellent guide though our tour was 60 min he took us with his interest for 80 min and then he was also training us about flying techs.........its was overall great experience.

We took the Wings Over Kauai flight tour and it was a wonderful experience at about half the price of the helicopter tours.
The flight was as smooth as glass and the views were to die for!
The narrative during the flight was most informative and the hospitality of Bruce and Ellen could not have been better.
When overcast weather was an issue they rebooked our tour and we ended up with the beautiful sunset tour over Kauai.
A 40th anniversary trip to remember!
We can not wait to return the beautiful Hawaiian Islands, the paradise of Kauai and another island flight.
Mahalo Bruce and Ellen!
Marilyn & Jim
from Texas

If you can only do one thing in all Hawaii islands, then it is taking the flight tour over Kauai. The tour was our best experience in Kauai, and Ellen and Bruce are the most friendly and warm person we met in this island. It was a very personal and thoughtful service. Bruce gave me a fragrant flower and a nice Lei and explained everything about the flight very clearly. Ellen cleaned the windows specially for us so we could take clear pictures. The view was more than spectacular, beyond imagination. The flight was very safe and Bruce did an excellent landing, very very smooth. What's more, the price is half of the helicoptor tour!

My wife and I just completed a wonderful tour of the island with Bruce and the Wings Over Kauai outfit.  It was all great - from the work that Ellen did to ensure that we were booked properly on a clear and beautiful day to the fabulous commentary Bruce provided along the way.

I'm a private pilot myself and confidently state that Bruce is a terrific and capable pilot.  Via plane is a wonderful way to see Kauai and Bruce knows so much about the island that it really is a front-row seat around paradise.

Yeah, the chopper thing is always kind of cool - doing the Magnum P.I. bit certainly has cachet.  But the best way to see the island is with Wings Over Kauai.  You won't be disappointed!

Our review is being posted a bit late, but I wanted to make sure I added our review.  We did the Wings Over Kauai tour the last week of October.  As many of the other reviews have mentioned, Bruce and Ellen were wonderful, courteous, genuine and professional.  

We were afforded a wonderful and educational view of Kauai - we were able to take some fantastic photos, but most of all, we were able to view a large portion of Kauai - most of which is not accessible to most travelers on the ground.  

We highly recommend this tour.  it was half the price of a helicopter tour and we felt we got our money's worth and more.  Bruce and Ellen were wonderful to work with.

review_title: Don't even consider flying with anyone else!!
review_text: Simply the very best in visibility from the aircraft, the very best in safety and comfort considerations, and the very best in Bruce's knowledge of the entire island, it's features, and character.  Even though the location of this business is shown to be in Kalaheo, rest assured, that the actual flights take off and depart at the Lihue airport -- turn left at the three flagpoles.  I've been on a number of Hawaii helicopter tours (Maui and Hawaii), and this flying experience with Bruce tops them all.  This family-run operation deserves your consideration, as this flying experience is not only safer than a helicopter, but offers a slower, less harried and more personal experience.  Try the extended 70-minute tour of the entire island and experience the flight of your life!  Return with a fatter wallet as compared to a helicopter or even other fixed-wing airplane tours.    This is the very best "bang for the buck" experience on all of Kauai.  Next time we're here, we'll do it again!

review_title: The best thing we did all week
review_text: I want to echo all the wonderful reviews this company is getting...they are all well deserved. Bruce and Ellen are great folks, and the tour was my all time favorite air tour, as well as the most talked-about part of our vacation. If you are in Kauai, you owe it to yourself to take this flight.

After living in the islands and visiting all the major ones, this was our most exciting time!  My wife Susan and myself were treated like family by Bruce and Ellen.  They are gracious and caring people who make your trip unforgettable.  Bruce is a wealth of knowledge regarding Kauai.  The flight was interactive and flew over the most amazing country I have ever seen.  It was the smoothest most satisfying flight we have ever experienced. We are coming back next year and I will look up Bruce and Ellen again.  Do not pass up the opportunity to fly with them.  It was incredible !!!

review_title: The best way to see Kauai from above
review_text: We had a wonderful experience seeing this spectacular island from the air with our pilot Bruce Coulombe.  Bruce and Ellen add a personal touch to their business and really care that you get the best possible experience.  The weather was iffy while we were there, and they were very helpful in re-scheduling us so we would get a flight in good weather - and we did.  We got some truly breathtaking views of the island, and especially the Napali Coast, of course.  Bruce's narration was interesting shows how much he knows about the island.  The pricing was very fair compared to competitors.  We highly recommend them and would fly with them again!

review_title: Trust me. After your tour you'll be writing great comments, too!
review_text:
Absolutely superb!  Believe me, you won't find anything this good, this thorough, this friendly and this convenient for anywhere near this cost.  We flew all over the island, saw virtually everything during their highest-level tour and the price was more than reasonable; it was easily the best value of all the excursions/tours we took during our 32-day HAL cruise.

Bruce, your pilot,  is a wonderful cordial host..  He doesn't just deliver a constant spiel... he engages you in friendly conversation, answers your questions and will conduct the tour according to your wishes.

We were very, very impressed with our tour and can recommend it without the slightest reservation.

Thank you, Bruce & Ellen!

Joe & Michael

WOW, this was so fun! My wife and I were on our honeymoon and took the tour on 10/14. The weather wasn't the best that day, but Bruce definitely made the best of it. He and Ellen were so sweet and accommodating. You get views and a tour that is so fantastic. Beats a helicopter any day!  

We were on a cruise, so our time on Kauai was quite limited, this is the perfect way to see the island!

We've only been home one week and our memories of our 2 weeks in Kauai are fresh.  One of the fondest memories will be of the air tour we took with Bruce, pilot and owner of  "Wings Over Kauai."  He was a great narrator and so knowledgeable about the Napali coastline and Waimea Canyon and other areas on the tour.
   We felt safe with Bruce as our pilot and  we were very comfortable in his plane.   The Bose headset system made for a quiet ride and we were able to hear Bruce as he told us what we were seeing.
  He and his wife Ellen made us feel comfortable and like old friends coming for a flight. They were very attentive to detail and  they had several nice and unexpected surprises for their passengers.
  If and when we return we will certainly do take this flight again and highly recommend their business!

  Bill & Marsha Hastings
  Creswell, Oregon

Great service, amazing views of lush cliffs, breathtaking waterfalls, blue-green ocean and gliding tropic birds.  I hate flying - the turbulence was uncomfortable for me as we went over Waimea canyon, but as someone who generally freaks out over turbulence I still found this trip bearable.  Captain Bruce has a nice, soothing voice and kept me distracted by pointing out sights complete with scientific and historic details.  My fiance loved it all.

Wings over Kauai is the best value way to see the beautiful sites of Kauai such as the Napali coast by air. 

The plane used is a small 4 seat Cessna (1 seat for the pilot) so all passengers have a perfect window seat to take in the amazing views. Bruce, who runs the company is a great guide providing interesting insights into every aspect of the trip. The island of Kauai has some of the most dramatic scenery of anywhere in the world and seeing it by air is a real must if you visit Hawaii and Wings over Kauai is a really great way to do it. Highly recommended!

We agree with previous reviewers that this is an absolutely wonderful tour!  We only had a few hours to spend on Kauai since we were there on a cruise ship, and I can't think of a better way we could have spent our time there.  I talked to Ellen on the phone before we went to Hawaii and she gave me alot of great ideas of  things to do before and after our tour.  She even picked us up near our ship and drove us to the tour and back again afterwards.  The flight was amazing!  It was smooth and the views were just beautiful, and Bruce's knowledge of agriculture and the island made the trip all the more interesting.  The price was very reasonable too.

We booked our trip as a result of the reviews on Trip Advisor. From the very first contact, Ellen Coulombe was friendly, informative and responsive. The web site, wingsoverkauai.com was also helpful and well designed.

The safety record was excellent. Bruce and Ellen briefed us fully and made us all feel like we were completely informed as we prepared for the flight. They got us involved in aspects of the safety checks prior to take-off. 

We headed along the coast toward Poipu followed by the Waimea Canyon. We were able to see the canyon beautifully. It was absolutely stunning. Next we headed to the Na Pali Coast. Unfortunately it was mostly obscured by some showers that sprung up. Bruce pointed out points of interest including movie sites and homes. He was able to fly us over Kilohana Crater and the Wailua Falls.

All in all we were so pleased with our trip and would highly recommend it as part of your stay on the Island. You will not be disappointed.

I decided to book a flightseeing tour with Wings over Kauai after reading the rave reviews on this site.  I must say that we can now add our recommendation to the long list of satisfied customers.
We were only in Kauai for one day as part of a Hawaii cruise, Ellen met us as arranged and gave us the option to cancel our flight as it was an overcast day, however as we had nothing else planned we decided to do the flight. Boy were we glad we did! 
We felt very safe with Bruce the pilot and once we were airborne we saw spectacular views of the Kauai coastline and waterfalls. Bruce gave a very informative commentary and pointed out various film locations along the way.
It was one of the highlights of our Hawaii cruise and at half the price of the helicopter tours, plus everyone gets a window seat, I wouldn't hesitate to recommend Wings over Kauai to anyone looking for a special experience along with personal service that is so rare these days.

We agree with everything that has been said previously on TripAdvisor.  A fantastic fun tour that was a definite highlight of our trip.  Bruce and Ellen provide that great customer service that has you walking away, going "wow".  Very affordable, enjoyable, and Wings Over Kauai deserve every superlative that has been said on this website.  We can't wait to do it again some time in the future!

review_title: What a way to see the island!
review_text:
We took the 1 hour tour while on our honeymoon and greatly enjoyed every minute of it!  First, I was given a traditional lei and fresh flower for my hair and then we were even offered waters, soda & mints for the plane ride.  They are nothing but nice here!

Bruce even flew over the cottage we were staying at so we could see it from the air.  While on the flight the front passenger is even allowed to open the window for some great photo opportunities.  This was by far one of the highlights from our honeymoon.  I recommend Wings Over kauai to any and every body!

My husband and I just got back from Kaua'i where we went on an aerial tour of the island with Wings over Kaua'i. As others have said, it was just fabulous! I was a bit nervous as I've never flown on a small plane, but we just loved it. We were originally scheduled for Monday the 13th, but close to the scheduled time, it was pouring out, so I called Ellen to cancel. She was very gracious and very willing to reschedule, which I am so glad we did! Since Bruce recently received his Instructor license, my husband was even able to fly the plane for a few minutes, which he loved! We chose this over a helicopter tour, so I can't compare the two but we loved this. Also, although there's not much view with a biplane, in this plane the wing is above you so the views were awesome.

review_title: Your Kauai trip is not complete without Wings!
review_text: Our one-hour tour with bruce was the highlight of our visit to beautiful Kauai. The flight was very smooth, narrated with knowledge, humor, and personality, and the views were breathtaking. Don't jam yourself into a pricey helicopter ride...try Wings Over Kauai instead. Bruce and Ellen are just fabulous and the price is definitely right! We'd rate them as "super-excellent!" Phil & Vicki

review_title: Fun personal tour of the island
review_text: For a family of 3 this was a great alternative to more expensive and less personal helicopter tours.  The 3 of us squeezed into Bruce's plane and he gave us a very friendly overview of the island he's called home for many years.  He obviously loves it and makes for a very good guide.  It's fun to see how the plane works too.  I wished we had flown a little bit lower for better views in a few places, but overall had a great time.  We also got a great recommendation from Bruce on where to buy a ukelele: Costco (we would never have guessed)!

review_title: The only way to see the entire island of Kauai
review_text: This was a great, affordable way to see the entire island including those places you can’t get to on the ground --which is most of the island. Their service was more personal with Bruce and just the two of us and yet is very professional and very safety oriented. It was terrific meeting Bruce and Ellen. They are a wonderful and interesting couple and really do make you feel like friends. Bruce’s commentary about his and Ellen’s years and experiences on Kauai made our air tour complete. The photos we have from the air of so many of the places we enjoyed on the ground are now an amazing part of the memories we brought home. We did the air tour first and will have to go back to get photos from the air of the other places we found interesting that we missed shooting from the air that first time around the island.

Wings Over Kauai was such a great start to our Kauai trip.   

First off, seeing the island by air was an beautiful experience that you just can't match by driving alone. I almost didn't book an air tour  because the helicopters were out of our price range, but WOK's price was right.  I'm so glad that we didn't miss out on this view of the island!   With all the personal touches at WOK, I'm glad we stuck with them!

WOK was very responsive via email and friendly in person.   Bruce and Ellen clearly enjoy what they do.  Little touches included  double checking the correct pronunciation of my husband's name, a kukui lei for me, and drinks inflight.  Bruce's narration inflight was informative and interesting.  The plane was small, but comfortable, even for my 6'5" husband.  

Undoubtedly, the highlight was the views.  Fantastic.  Highly recommend.  

We love Wings Over Kauai!

We decided to fly with Wings Over Kauai as opposed to any of the helicopter tours. All three of us couldn't have been happier with our decision. Customer service was excellent and the flight was incredible. We had perfect weather and we ended up with some amazing photos, better than I could have expected.
We also loved the fact that our money was going to a small family business than a large impersonal corporation such as all those helicopter touring companies. Everything was very friendly and personal. You're not put together with strangers and the pilot makes you feel very comfortable. The pilot was very knowledgable and shared some very interesting facts with us.
It was simply perfect.

Beate

This is a must thing to do while you are visiting the island of Kauai......
Bruce was so proficient in the flying of his aircraft and the narrative he gave about the land.
Ellen his wife was so nice and calmed all my fears before we flew..........
Don't miss out on the spectacular Beauty Of Kauai by flying Wings Over Kauai with Bruce.........

Bruce & Ellen, Thanks for the memories that will stay with us forever..........

Fran & Phil

Although flying is not my favorite activity (it is one of my spouse's favorite activities), both of us  really enjoyed our flight over KAUAI with Bruce.  He honestly did "WOW" US with his knowledge of Kauai, the flora, the fauna and the physical attritudes of possibly the oldest and undoubedly the most beautiful of the Hawaiian Islands.  Ellen, his wife and partner, was very engaging and extremely helpful and courteous. Even though we had to reschedule our attempt at flying due to cloudy weather, Ellen accomodated us , even advising us of the weather as we traveled to the airport.  Some of our pictures, taken during the flight with Bruce were really fantastic; i.e., Bruce kept the plane masterfully under control.  By far the BEST ACTIVITY that we experienced during our 2 weeks on Kauai! Thanks guys for a wonderful 40th Anniversary adventure. F & R
Sept, 2008

This was a great experience.  Like others, we were considering to do the helicopter or the plane tour for our trip.  Having done a helicopter tour before, I was a bit worried about the plane going too fast or not having good views.  Actually, I think the plane was better than the helicopter -- you move at a nice clip but not too fast, Bruce circles particularly good spots which is great, you go across the whole island, and I enjoyed the views better (while it's nice to be right next to the scenery in the helicopter, it doesn't make for great pictures).  The other thing that's nice about the plane is that you can open the passenger side window to take photos without glass distortions (fyi the wing and wing strut can obscure wide-angle pictures looking forward, but it works out pretty well for side/backwards pictures, and Bruce will tilt the plane to help).  Overall a fantastic experience we would highly recommend.

We took the Grand Circle Istand flight yesterday in Kauai with Wings Over Kauai. It was the highlight of our vacation so far.  They use a single engine plane which seats four including the pilot.  We were a little apprehensive in the beginning when booked the tour but the owner- pilot, Bruce,   put us at ease from the very beginning.  He and his wife run a very professional operation and are pleasure to talk and deal with.  

Bruce treated us as if we his best customer ever in which I'm sure he does with all.  They where not in a rush to get us in and  out like most of the helicopters companies do.  Safety was foremost and they spent plenty of time preparing you for the flight.  The flight was spectacular from the smoothness of it to the scenery itself.  I don't think I've ever seen more beautiful scenery than Kauai from the air.  Bruce narrated during the whole flight.  No only did he demonstrate his vass knowledge of the island and it's eco-system, but he took the time to point perfect photo opportunities and even turned the plane to make sure you had an opportunity to capture the best shots.

During the flight, I was allowed to open the window to even get better shots.  The photos were undescribeable and will be great screensavers.

The best part of all is that the price of the tour is less than half of a comparable helicopter tour.  We have taken helicopter tours in Kauai before, but they were pale in comparison to Bruce's service.

I would highly recommend it to anyone who is considering a helicopter flight.  You'll be amazed by how much more you will see and by the expertise as well as professionalism demonstrated by Bruce and his wife.

Ron Brannon
Orland, Park, Illinois

review_title: Hands Down the Best Way to See Kauai
review_text:
I agree with all the positive comments made by others so far and will add the perspective of those cruising on NCL's 7-day Hawaiian cruise. We booked our tour with Wings online before arriving in Kauai, and it couldn't have been easier. Ellen emailed us detailed directions to their plane and it is just up the road from the ship and easy to find (by car though, not walking distance...I think Bruce and Ellen will also pick you up if you need a ride). 

The plane ride itself is amazing, with Bruce pointing out lots of fun details and with views you just do not get from the ground. I must say, I expected a slightly larger plane and had a moment of hesitation  when I first saw the plane because it's a small Cessna with only four seats (one for pilot plus three passengers). But, I relaxed right away because Bruce is a great pilot and we had no bumps and no turbulence - just amazing  views and a wonderful trip. Bruce has the latest Bose headphones which are really great at keeping out white noise. All you hear are his tour-related remarks and nice Hawaiian tunes in the background. 

Bruce and Ellen provide wonderful, personalized service with lots of little extra touches. This was the last activity my husband and I did on our Hawaiian vacation and this was a great way to end our stay in Hawaii...also definitely the best way to get acquiainted with Kauai. 

Mahalo, Ellen and Bruce!

P.S. - the plane ride is about half the cost of a helicopter tour.

I wasn't sure at first if flying over Kauai was for me, but with encouragement from my friend Sheila I signed up. It turned out to be one of the best things I did on the Island...after hiking, and visiting much on the ground it was truly great to see it all from a different perspective in the air.  Bruce is a seasoned pilot that make you feel very safe, and does a great job in narrating the overall experience with his extensive knowledge. If I only had one word to describe the experience....awesome.

Dan
Huntsville, Alabama

review_title: a must to do on Kauai
review_text:
I wanted to make a present for my husband's birthday and I decided to book a flight with Wings Over Kauai.
It was a great idea and both my husband and I are enthusiastic about it.
Bruce and Ellen were very professional and explained us a lot of things; Bruce was wonderful, he gave us a lot of information and details during our flight which we enjoyed thoroughly.
The price is very competitive for a 60 minutes flight and I would recommend it to everyone, also to people who might be afraid of being sick on small planes (I am one of those and I hadn't any problem at all).
Wonderful experience.

We wanted to fly a bi-plane individually but the Tropical Biplanes were not operating when we were in Kauai this Sep. So we took Wings Over Kauai because of the popularity and price. It is undoubtedly the best way to see Kauai and best value for money. Bruce and Ellen were very friendly and knowledgeable. After we booked the tour we also happened to see the update on their website that Bruce has recently received a certificate, so I got the opportunity to fly the plane myself for a while. Wow! What an experience to fly above the Pacific Ocean. If you are visiting Kauai this tour is a must and the best way to see the most beautiful part of the island, the Na Pali coast which is not accessible by road. When you can see it for a lesser price why pay more? We are sure to take this tour again when we visit Kauai.

We debated about doing this tour vs a helicopter tour in Kauai and went with this because of the price.  It was absolutely worth it!!!!  Very reasonable price, amazing service, breathtaking scenery...overall a fantastic experience.  Would do it again a million times over.  I did not do a helicopter tour so I cannot directly compare the two, but I don't think I would do a helicopter tour after this - I would just do Wings Over Kauai again!

Awesome, awesome experience!!

Flying over Kauai is the best way to take in the entire island. Only about 25% of the island is reachable by foot or car.

With 2 young kids (10 and 7) and my in-lwas who had not taken small plane or helicopter rides before we were debating between helicopter and air plane tour and we are glad we went with the airplane tour. And we are especially glad we chose "Wings Over Kauai".

While any air tour will allow one to see the beauty and scenery that nature has bestowed upon this Garden Island; what made our trip unforgettable was the great professionalism of Bruce, the pilot and co-owner of Wings of Kauai and the warm and personal treatment by Ellen, Bruce wife and co-owner who drives the land operations. 

Burce's intimate knowledge of the island was very evident in the narration he gave throughout the flight. His tidbits and sense of humor made the commentary very informative and fun. He clearly is an expert pilot and the flight was very safe and smooth. 
He was very patient, especially with our young sons, who asked a lot of questions and he added to their excitement. Sitting in the co-pilot seat in the front was the highlight of the trip for my 10 year old.

We were very touched with the warmth and kindness of Ellen, Bruce's wife and co-owner and clearly the two of them form a great team and run an excellent operation with high regards to customer satisfaction. Their personal touches made us feel at home and like family and it greatly enhanced our experience. They are very courteous and very accomodating and flexible. In deciding the timing of the flights we had questions about the fog which we had seen roll in, in the afternoon, on our drive up the Waimea Canyon the previous day. We took the noon flight and enjoyed a clear sky and Bruce was careful to fly beneath the clouds to allow us to get clear views and get great pictures and video.

The noise-free Bose headphones made the flight very enjoyable (Playing back the video we took told us how noisy it would've been without the headphones. I edited out the noise from my home vidoe when I transferred it to DVD). We were able to take several great pictures and the configuration of the aircraft allowed us to take steady and clear shots. 

We are very glad we went with Wings Over Kauai. Surely this was one of the top highlights of our trip to Kauai and we look forward to visiting the island in future. We highly recommend them and it will be time and money well spent.

review_title: This is the BEST air tour operator on Kauai
review_text: My wife and I took the custom flight on 8/23/08.  We were scheduled for an 1100 flight but the conditions were less the perfect so Captain Bruce suggested we come back later in the afternoon.  We arrived back at 1500 and went on a spectacular flight.  It lasted just over an hour and was the highlight of our seven days in Kauai.  This tour is much better then any of the air tour operators on the island and much more reasonable.

Based on the excellent reviews in Trip Advisor,  I picked this company for our air tour of Kauai. 
It was absolutely brilliant. Ellen and Bruce were very friendly and helpful. I booked for myself, husband and 10 year old son and we all loved it. They tailor the tour to your requirements  - In our case this included flying over parts of the Island where Jurassic park was filmed, and also over our hotel. 

I would definately recommend this to everyone and if I ever get back to Kauaui will do the tour again

I love the flight and the owners were more than accommodating.  The flight even lasted than they stated. WONDERFUL.  This is a highly recommended agency to use.  They take last min. reservations and as struggling students, we found the price to be GREAT compared to some other companies.

This is the best activity you can do in Kauai.  Going up in the air lends you access to places people cannot set foot onto otherwise.  I am so glad we booked with Wings Over Kauai.  This small company is run by husband and wife, Bruce and Ellen.  Ellen was so incredibly helpful during the booking of the trip and once we got there, she was so friendly with all smiles.  The flight was so unbelievable personal!  It was Bruce the pilot, myself, and my husband.  We each got headphones to hear Bruce's narration and to ask questions.  We learned SO much from Bruce - he was an agriculturalist-turned-pilot so we learned so much about plant life and planes that I felt smarter when the flight was over.  The other helicopter  companies are VERY obnoxious and overly glitzy.  Go with the real deal!

We had a fantastic time with Bruce and Ellen on our tour of Kauai.  We received a warm, friendly greeting upon our arrival, and Bruce's good sense of humor and knowledge of the island made the in-flight experience both fun and educational.  After considering the helicopter option, we are SO glad we chose Wings over Kauai.  We had a personal experience and it was a great value!  Next time we are in Kauai, we will definitely go back.

Based on the excellent reviews in Trip Advisor, we picked this company for our air tour of Kauai - it was fabulous, we were not disspaointed!  The experience was very good from start to finish, both Bruce and Ellen put the emphasis on a personal experince and this comes through at all times, from the pre flight chat, inlcuding gifts for the ladies, to the after flight review.  The Cessna aircraft holds up to 3 passengers plus Bruce, the pilot, so the tour is very intimate.  Bruce does a great job with the inflight narration, his knowledge of the island is evident.  The package comes with a pre-flight photo and the aircraft has posh bose headphones which make the flight extremely comfortable.  My advice would be to avoid the over priced helicopter tours and go for this, a great hour spent of your holiday.

Bruce and Ellen are warm and welcoming!  Bruce begins the plane ride with an interesting check-off list for the plane which simply educates the passengers about the plane and sets the stage for an amazing ride over the island of Kauai.  My 10 year old daughter and I had a fabulous experience and felt very safe, and Bruce's commentary on the island was enlightening.  The plane ride was quiet (Bruce has top-of-the-line headsets which we used to communicate with) and the plane ride was very smooth.  Mahalo to Wings over Kauai for adding to our love of this island!  Gina and Sophia, Aloha from the Garden State to the Garden Island!

review_title: Start Your Kauai Island Visit with this Tour!
review_text: Bruce and Ellen Coulombe offer a great experience with their aerial tours of Kauai. I booked the flight online for a friend and me. I thought it best to do this early on in our 2wk stay so it would help us understand the layout of the island. Boy, did it ever. You can't even imagine the beauty of the island and there is so much to see. Ellen and Bruce are very warm and friendly and made us feel very special - we weren't just another couple of tourists.  At the start of the flight, before take-off, Bruce assigns you your role as part of the flight crew! Very fun. For those who may be a bit nervous to be in a small plane - don't worry.  You are in very safe and capable hands with Bruce at the controls. We had a fabulous day, clear skies & knock-out views! Next trip to Kauai, I will definitely do this again!!!!

My husband and I were on our honeymoon in Kauai, and this airplane tour was our favorite experience on the island. Bruce and Ellen are extremely friendly and knowledgable, and Bruce gives a personalized, informative tour of the island from the plane. He will even open the window and adjust the plane in order to allow you to get the best photographs. The scenery is breathtaking... we had a wonderful experience. The flight was not bumpy or noisy. Bruce has expensive headsets that block out noise and allow you to talk with each other. We highly recommend this experience.

After reading the reviews on Trip Advisor decided to book with Wings over Kauai. Must say what an excellent decision. Bruce and Ellen provide a superb personal and very professional service, would highly recommend.

Bruce and Ellen really make you welcome and feel special,once in the aeroplane Bruce puts you at ease if you are abit unsure,he involves you in the take off routine,i was in control of the ventilation system(i held the window open abit)my wife read out the pre-flight check list,after that just a great time was had by all,Bruce tells you all about the plants,trees,canyons and anything else you can think of,plus you get to see parts of the island that can only be seen from the air,the only problem with the flight is it`s over to quick it just fly`s by,once again thanks to Bruce and Ellen for a great trip.

review_title: Skip the Helicopter Ride for Wings Over Kauai!
review_text: Because of the stellar TripAdvisor ratings, my husband and I booked a flightseeing tour with Wings Over Kauai (W.O.K.). This is a great alternative to a helicopter ride. Upon arrivial at W.O.K., Ellen warmly welcomed us and presented me witha kukui nut necklace and a fresh flower. For our flight, we were particularly blessed with a clear and sunny sky. The 1 hour Pali Mist tour led by pilot Bruce was fantastic! It costs $100 per person plus tax. We saw Waimea Canyon, several valleys and waterfalls, the Na Pali coast, Wailua Falls, and many other breathtaking sights. Bruce would turn the plane for us so we could get some awesome pictures! Take the noon flight if available. Since the helicopter tours are at lunch, you don't have to share the air space! Mahalo Ellen and Bruce!

review_title: Best value for an aerial tour of Kauai - bar none
review_text:
We did considerable research on aerial tours of Kauai, and we kept seeing strongly positive buzz about Wings Over Kauai. Their web site was clear and easy to understand, and their prices were absolutely unbeatable. Also, the reliable Cessna aircraft they use is dramatically safer than any helicopter, so we decided to give them a shot. And what a payoff that decision was. It was our best day on Kauai.

Bruce and Ellen were warm and friendly when we arrived, and went to great lengths to make sure we were comfortable. Ellen took pictures of us in front of and inside their clean, late-model Cessna 172.

Bruce helped us strap in and showed us how to use the top-quality Bose noise-cancelling headsets. These headsets allowed us to converse wtih him and ask questions during the flight - unlike some helicopter tours that only let you listen.

Bruce is a nice guy with an agri-science background. Want to know anything about crops in Hawaii? Bruce knows the answer.  As soon as the Cessna's engine fired up, Bruce came alive with a delightful narrative of Kauai, its history, its agriculture, and its stunning scenery. We got a full-hour tour, and it was worth every cent. And was considerably cheaper than a helicopter tour.

I give Wings Over Kauai my highest possible recommentation. The views of Waimea Canyon and the Na Pali coast were amazing, the narration was informative, interactive, and interesting, and we were treated like friends rather than customers. The experience was better than anything else we did on the island.

Words cannot express how awesome our flight over Kauai with Bruce was. It definitely was the highlight of our vacation in Kauai. At half the price of the helicopter tours, our Wings Over Kauai flight was first class from start to finish. Bruce and Ellen are a special couple running a family business with all the right touches from the fragrant gardenia flower, the beaded lei, their friendliness, their genuine concern for your comfort, to Bruce's professionalism in his flying and expertise in telling us all about the island. The authentic Hawaiian music and great sound system on his plane made the tour exceptional. Top of the line, Bose noise-reducing headphones were awesome. We could hear Bruce's wonderful narration of the island tour without the noise of the airplane and, we could converse with him as well. Ellen is so nice and friendly, too. She really gives  a welcomed, homey feeling to the tour. Taking a photo of us and then e-mailing it to us is an extra nice touch. I highly recommend this tour to anyone who wants the experience of a lifetime. Thanks again Bruce and Ellen!

Wings Over Kauai is not only an amazing value but an experience of a lifetime!  My husband and I both felt that it was the best part of our trip.  A family business, great value, exceptional customer service and amazing views - you can't beat it!  Bruce provided historical insight and melodious Hawaiian music, which made the flight that much more enjoyable.  The privacy of being able to share this memorable experience with my husband and not 8 or 10 additional visitors was great.  Thanks for the amazing flight Bruce and Ellen!  We will see you next time we are in Kauai!!!

I am an Instrument rated Private Pilot (haven't flown since we started having kids) and decided to take my 10 and 12 year old boys on the Na Pali Mist tour last week.  I read many reviews and not only felt excited about the flight, but also very comfortable taking my kids.  They had never been in a light plane and never got nauseous on this flight.

The experience was great.  It started with a preflight discussion about where we were going to go, what we would see, as well as flight safety.  Then we were introduced to the Pilot who provided more in-plane information on safety and the flight.  The condition of the plane was excellent.  Very airworthy aircraft.  

We took off and headed toward the Southeast corner of the island.  He maintained an excellent viewing altitude and knew where to fly the airplane and how to bank it to allow all the passengers to see the many highlights of the island.  His knowledge of the agriculture, history, and geology of the land is amazing.

As we headed up the canyons, the pilot used care to avoid the clouds to maintain good visual contact with the ground and with other aircraft (many helicopters).  He allowed me to put the window in the up position (the wind around the wing keeps it up once it's opened) to take some amazing photographs of the Na Pali coast.

All in all, it was a great flight.  Couldn’t have asked for more. 
I hate to mention it because it I didn't go on it because of the reduced cost, but the flight for the three of us was a quarter of what a helicopter ride would have cost.

The pilot was very safe and knowledgeable.  The aircraft is well maintained and in great condition.  You won't regret it.  Below is a sample of a picture from our flight....

We did the helicopter tour, catamaran tour, and finaly Wings over Kauai. By far if you have to choose take this tour. We saw everything we saw on the other tours and more. Bruce gives a great perspective of the island and wonderful photo opportunities. 
Ellen called to reschedule our day due to weather and wanted to give us the best tour possible.
They are great to work with, we would do it again.
Steve and Jean
Fond du Lac, WI

A friend and I booked a flight with Bruce and it was one of the highlights of our two week trip to Kauai.  From the minute we walked up to the counter to the offer upon departing to give directions, we felt temporarily part of the family.  This is an intimate, family run operation and we couldn't have felt more welcome.  We felt totally safe in the aircraft, had a beautiful day and took amazing pictures.  This is definitely the most fabulous, low-cost activity on the island.

I don't know what I can say about Wings Over Kauai that hasn't been said over and over, and I have to agree with everyone.  This is a great experience.  I, too, read some of the reviews and just couldn't find anything negative, so I decided this was the trip for us.  We did the helicopter tour before, and while I did greatly enjoy it, I didn't feel nearly as comfortable as in the airplane.  I've flown a lot with my husband and my dad, but it was a little different with someone else in the pilot's seat.  Bruce certainly put me at ease, though, and is a highly competent, very experienced pilot, with lots of years fliying over Kauai.  His narration made the trip even more interesting.  He and his wife, Ellen are such nice people and so very friendly and helpful.  I half expected them to invite us to their house for dinner. (Just kidding!)  It was a completely positive experience, completely relaxing and enjoyable.

review_title: Donot Leave Kauai without taking this tour
review_text:
I was about to confirm my reservation on a helicopter tour when I came across the reviews on tripadvisor about Wings over Kauai. It has a 5 star rating with not a single negative or mediocre review so i though it had to be GREAT! 

We called and booked the same day and it turned out to be the highlight of my trip to Hawaii so much so that i am still thinking about it and want to write my first review ever on Tripadvisor about it. 

I wont go into details about my trip since a lot of travelleres have already written a lot of accurate stuff but I will say that you will definitely miss out on something if you donot take this tour. It is indeed the best $100/person you will ever spend on Hawaii.  Without giving details on the trip, spend that money and experience a flight of a lifetime.

My wife and I, along with our 10-yr. old daughter Alana, took this wonderful tour on June 13th.  The whole family at Wings Over Kauai was great - including Bruce and Ellen's daughter who checked us in.  The personal touch was really great and we recommend this tour to everyone!  Our flight was 70 minutes long and Bruce's commentary was thorough and never boring.  Of course, the tour is also much cheaper than the helicopter offered on the island.  The plane is perfect for taking pictures and the noise-canceling headsets with Hawaiian music in the background is a nice touch.  Most of all, of course, Kauai is breathtaking from the air.  The island had just experienced some heavy rainfall and we must have seen 100 waterfalls that day.  The highlight of the tour is the Napali coast and we flew over Napali for quite some time.  What a place!   After the trip with Bruce, we would never take a tour with anyone else.  Bruce really involves you with the tour and the plane was comfortable and perfect for the 3 of us.  Use Wings Over Kauai to get acquainted with Kauai - you won't regret it.
Rick from Ohio

review_title: Totally wonderful .. no need to splurge on a heli tour ...
review_text: Very nice little family run outfit ... Ellen and Bruce are extremely pleasant in every way ... Ellen was very helpful on the phone and in person even for travel tips around Kauai .. The price of the ride is so much more affordable than a helicopter tour .. And I cannot imagine that it can be all that better to be worth double the price ... Kauai is Kauai from the air .. It is still just as incredibly beautiful ... Bruce was wonderful as a pilot ... It was a very enjoyable experience and he makes it a very personal one by teaching you a bit about flying too .. They were also very accomodating to our special situation of having a 2.5 year old with us ... My Mom and I flew on one flight and my husband by himself on another flight ... Ellen even called us and had us reschedule when they were a little doubtful about the weather ... instead of just letting us go in the okay weather and let us deal with it .. I thought that that was very professional and very nice of them ... The flight itself was very comfortable ... Overall Highly recommended ...

review_title: Wonderful Welcome to the Garden Isle
review_text:
I booked Wings Over Kauai after reading several positive reviews and wanting something my entire family, including our infant, could enjoy.  I knew I wanted an aerial tour of Kauai, but was as leery of the helicopter tours as they were of my little one.  Because we were planning on flying with an infant, I wanted to make sure we wouldn't disturb or ruin anyone else's flight, so I was looking for a tour that was smaller, more personal and unique.  With Wings Over Kauai, we got that and more!
  When I called to reserve the tour, I spoke with Ellen who was both knowledgeable and VERY friendly.  She answered all my questions and was more than willing to work to help accommodate our little one.  The plane they fly is a 4-seater, so there wouldn't be anyone else to disturb, and she asked if there was anyplace specific we were looking to fly over so that they could try to work that into the flight plan.
  The day of the tour, we showed up early and both Ellen and Bruce (the pilot) greeted us and even presented a gift to our little 'keiki'.  When it came time to check-in and go over all of the preflight information, Ellen was helpful and made sure to answer all of our questions and concerns.  They even offered us a car seat so that my husband wouldn't have to hold our little one the whole flight, as well as small ear plugs to help with the noise.  They also offer a children's-sized headset, but we figured 10 months was a little young to enjoy or even keep it on.
  From take-off until landing, the flight was amazing!  Bruce was both professional and personable.  He explained all of the piloting jargon and information that was passing over the radio, and he also provided a narrative that gave information and details about what we were currently flying over.  He did his best to allow me ample opportunity to take photos and also informed me of potential photo ops that would be coming up.  Our little one had such a good time that she spent most of the flight laughing, cooing and just enjoying the air from the car seat.  My husband enjoyed himself and had a great view even from the rear seat.
  One warning for those not used to flying in small aircraft:  even on a clear day, it can get a bit bumpy and the nature of the island (mountains and valleys) make for some air pockets.  By the end of the flight, my stomach was definitely feeling a bit rough.  It had nothing to do with the plane or how it was being piloted, but it is something to keep in mind for those who might not have stomachs of steel.  Bruce was very helpful and prepared for any problems - he carried the obligatory air sickness bags but also had ginger candy, water, and a cold cloth that came in VERY handy as we got ready to land.

  Overall, I would HIGHLY recommend Wings Over Kauai.  Bruce and Ellen were very friendly and the ride itself worth EVERY penny.  For both my husband and myself, it was almost half the cost of a helicopter tour, and being able to bring our little one and fly a personal tour made it an even greater value.  Anyone looking for a fun and unique way to tour Kauai should definitely consider flying on Wings Over Kauai!

My wife, Annita, and I took this tour during our recent May visit to Kauai and had an absolutly great experience. We wanted to see the island from above but were hesitant to take a helicopter tour. The Wings tour was perfect for us. What a beautiful island as seen from the clouds. 
     In addition to being a wonderful pilot, Bruce was also an informed guide and provided us with a lot of info about what we were viewing. The vistas were spectacular. Certainly, the price was right, as well--almost half as much as a copter tour for 70 minutes of air time.
     We highly recommend this tour to anyone who comes to Kauai and wants to see this beautiful  island from above.

If you only do one thing on the fabulous island of Kauai, this is it. Bruce and Ellen were fantastic hosts and made the tour a memorable one for all of us. Fantastic sceneries on this clear and sunny day, even saw a whale from the air, thanks to Bruce our pilot who took the time to circle over the spot a few times. For us it was the perfect option, with 3 adults and our 14 month old boy, it worked out way cheaper than any chopper ride. We have great memories from this plane ride, definitely the best way to discover the hidden side of Kauai, the Pali, movie locations and many waterfalls.

review_title: Best way to see the entire Island of Kauai!
review_text:
This family run company tour is the most affordable and efficient way to see one of the most beautiful of the Hawaiian Islands.  Because most of Kauai in undeveloped the best way to see its natural beauty is from the skies.  Bruce and Ellen were great hosts and tour guides!!  Being my first time on a small plane the ride was way smoother than I expected.  I would definitely recommend Wings Over Kauai to anyone who really wants to see the true beauty of island!

Absolutely breathe-taking!

Thanks!
Joey & Juliana

This is a family run operation that provides personal service.  Maximum seating for three passengers.  Better value than the many helicopter tours.  Little or no engine noise to put up with.  The pilot Bruce, will fly you to locations you are interested in and you have a clear view from the windows without obstruction.  It is economical and well worth your time and money.

Time share presentations offer vouchers, certificates or discount cards.  Utilize them for 90 minutes and enjoy your discounted trip.

We provided Wings over Kauai as a source to be used by Wyndham Resorts as a reference for their guests.  We hope they take our advice.

My husband and I had a great time on our flightseeing trip with Wings Over Kauai. The captain, Bruce, makes you feel completely comfortable and it helps tremendously that he is so friendly and at ease himself. 

There were three main reasons that we chose to do an airplane tour instead of the helicopter: 1. The price, Wings OVer Kauai was less than half the price of helicopter tours. 2. The plane tours were recommended to us by people we spoke to while in Kauai. 3. My husband gets motion sickness which helicopters aggravate badly. Ellen gave my husband some ginger candies to help his nausea before we left and Bruce was extremely good about checking to make sure he was still doing good. 

Our tour with Wings Over Kauai was definately one of the highlights of our trip!

review_title: To Ride a Helicopter in Kauai or Not
review_text:
Definitely not!  I took a tour with Wings Over Kauai and my experience was fantastic.  I chose Wings Over Kauai because I felt like I was chartering my own private plane.  Wings Over Kauai has a four-seater airplane, so it will only be Captain Bruce and your party (2-3 people).  Wings Over Kauai also has the option to customize your tour to allow you to fly over the sites you want to see.  I wanted to see all the waterfalls on Kauai and Captain Bruce, the friendliest Captain you will ever fly with, flew us around the entire island and took us, as he jokingly told his wife afterwards, "to every [--] waterfall on the island".  If you think that helicopters have a better view than an airplane, think again.  The airplane Wings Over Kauai uses is engulfed with windows and I never noticed the wings my entire flight.  I guaranteed that a flight with Wings Over Kauai will be a highlight of your trip!  

If cost is a concern, it shouldn't be.  You should visit an Activity World booth, one is conveniently located at Coconut Coast Market.  You will need to attend a timeshare presentation.  Timeshare presentations are incredibly lame, but well worth your time.  My tour should have been $260, 70 min. for two people, but it was drastically reduced to $96.

I chose Wings Over Kauai over the many Helicoptor options for two reasons.  The price (1/2 of the Helicoptor tours) and the fact that they allowed us to bring aboard our 5-month old infant.  I was very pleased with my choice!
Ellen is the office manager and she is great.  Friendly and happy to be living in paradise as she supports her husband's lifelong dream to be a pilot.  She offered a lei to my wife and a plush doll for my son.  My son is now attached with the doll who we call "Wing."
Bruce is the pilot and he is a supurb tour guide.  I felt very safe and the trip was very interesting.  He is very informative being a PHD is agronomy.  The trip around the island was the best 70 minutes of our vacation.
The tour is very interactive.  I participated in the ground check list as my wife lead the service crew with drink service.  We all had headsets with microphones to participate in the dialog as soft Hawaiian music played in the background.
The Island is beautiful.  There are many breathtaking views that can only be seen from the air.  I highly recommend Wings for a safe and personal tour.

This tour was the biggest bang for the buck! Bruce(the pilot)
made us feel as if we had known him for years. This is a must do if you want to do an air tour!

review_title: The Most Amazing Flightseeing Tours of Kauai
review_text:
Just recently returned from a trip on Kauai, Hawaii.  Had the most amazing flightseeing experience with Wings Over Kauai.
Before leaving the ground, the flight operator/pilot's main focus was safety and comfort.  He was well prepared for flight, made everyone feel at ease, and was extremely knowledgeable about the different land forms, mountains, canyons, coastline, different areas/neighborhoods, and yes, even whale watching.  His  courteous and easy going style made this trip enjoyable, interesting, and fun.   What a great experience!!!
Put this one at the top of your list of things to do on Kauai.

Linda & Donovan
New York

review_title: FANTASTIC!!! Why take a helicopter when you can take Wings Over Kauai?!
review_text:
WINGS OVER KAUAI: A 70-minute flight around the entire island in a 3-passenger Cessna plane. Owner-operated by Bruce & Ellen Coulombe, this was a wonderful alternative to viewing Kauai from above without being in a helicopter. 

We chose Wings Over Kauai because Bruce came highly recommended on numerous trip web sites – and Bruce has a lot of experience – not just flying in general, but specifically flying over Kauai (that was important to us). There was another plane outfit that had 2 pilots – one with a lot of experience flying over Kauai, the other with only about 2 years – and we could not get a guarantee of getting the one with the more experience. 

We were so happy we went with Wings Over Kauai!!! Bruce was very professional and we couldn’t have felt safer… he’s a very intelligent & contientious pilot, to be sure!! The plane is a 3-passenger Cessna – which gives everyone a window – and creates for a very tailor-made, personal flight experience!

Another wonderful aspect of going with Wings Over Kauai is the fact that it was about half the price of a helicopter tour, yet just as spectacular…. And I have the photos to prove it!

review_title: Excellant way to end Anniversary in the Islands!
review_text: My husband decided at the last minute to book a flight over Kaui while we were in Kona.  THe Blue Shak on Kona booked it for us 2 days before we arrived.  The weather was so clear and even it wasn't raining on the wettest place on earth.  Ellen and Bruce are down to earth folks that truly want to ensure you have the best experience every.  Bruce is an experienced with the plants and fomation of the island.  I felt MUCH safer with his plane that the small helicoptors that kept going in and out of the mountains.  We were able to take a nice photo and I have some clear photos of Mt. Walielie and the water falls and coastlines.  I felt the price was very reasonable for a 70 minute flight.  Please think about using Wings over Kaui for a truly unique experience.  Make sure you battery is charged on your camera and you have PLENTY of space on your memory card if you have a digital camera.. You are going to need it.

this by far was the greatest flying experience  i have ever had  and i have flown around the world.
  the beauty of the island was shown to us in a quiet  well maintained  plane with the best pilot and tour guide you will ever find. everyone who is thinking of flying over the island should  make sure they fly with wings over kauai  you will not find a more affordable price anywhere for the excellent adventure you will have . 

the whole crew  will do everything in there power to make this a memorable  tour for you

review_title: skip the helicopters: take a Wings Over Kauai flight!
review_text: We wanted to see Kauai from the air without the rapid motion, daredevil atmosphere, and vertiginous flying patterns used by the many helicopter tour companies. Our innkeeper recommended Bruce and Ellen Coulombe's Wings Over Kauai. Bruce, a very experienced pilot, flies up to three passengers at a time in a small fixed-wing plane. Every attention is paid to safety and comfort. I don't like enclosed spaces and was a bit nervous about the size of the plane, but Bruce's professional and friendly demeanor quickly had me at ease. He is a wonderful narrator as well and the noise-excluding Bose headphones and mics let us speak normally and enjoy his extensive commentary. Ellen runs the reservation desk at the Lihue airport commuter terminal. The Coulombes are delightful, warm, and welcoming people. We were accommodated the same day we called, and had a fantastic flight. Photography was easy and convenient, with great results! We signed up for the 70-minute flight and saw the entire island, including the crater of Mt. Wai'ale'ale, the Na Pali coast, and also the northeastern area, which most aerial tours skip. I highly recommend Wings over Kauai for an enjoyable, safe, and fascinating experience!

review_title: The only way to really see the island in 70 minutes
review_text: If you are planning this in your itinerary, note the tour is based at the Lihue (LIH) airport general aviation facilites.  The 70 minute flight ties for the best memory we have of our five days in Kauai (with a catamaran tour of the Na Pali coast).  Two years ago we took a helicopter tour of Maui, and we just feel more comfortable in flying something with wings on it, plus the cost is about one-half of an equally long helicopter flight and covers more of the island.  Bruce, the owner-operator and chief pilot has a prior professional agronomy background (on Kauai).  He was very knowledgeable during his interesting narration of ground features.

We just returned from Kauai, HI and must tell you that the most incredible trip was with Bruce Coulombe and his Cessna 172 plane.  First of all I am afraid to fly!  This was a hugh event in my 65 years and I must say one of the most exciting.  We were seated and given Bose headsets which only let us hear Bruce telling us about the sights and soft Hawaiian music playing in the background.  Our photos were excellent.  We returned to the ground much too soon for us.  It was so peaceful we would have liked it to go on all afternoon!

This is the best way to see Kauai!  During our 10 days we traveled around the island and visited all the sites and enjoyed them all but nothing could compare to Wings Over Kauai

Roger & Connie.

Amazing helicopter trip and we were upgraded because there were insufficient people for our original flight time.  6 passenger seats but only 4 on our trip so plenty of space.  The pilot, James, was friendly and knowledgeable. An excellent 40 minute trip

Awful experience. We had booked a 45 minute tour for myself, my daughter and my two grandsons. 
When we arrived at the airfield to check in on the date and time given, we were told that the weather would not allow for the 45min flight but we could have a 25 min flight instead for a refund of $30 per person ( $30 refund on $499 for a flight only half as long!) 
As we were boarding another customer started shouting hysterically that she wanted to sit in front and as we all sat there with this woman screaming, we became more and more nervous that she would lose her temper and attack the pilot once we were in flight. 
Needless to say we were petrified as we took off , we flew for approx 7 minutes over trees and the helicopter was being buffeted about by the wind and it was a rough uncomfortable ride. We then reached the canyon and spent about another 7 minutes over the canyon itself again swaying and being buffeted about by the wind, and soon were on the way back for another 7 minute trip over the trees!

Thankfully the hysterical woman was silent throughout the flight but the trip I had planned as a surprise for my grandsons was an unmitigated disaster- we could not wait to get off the helicopter and leave the airfield. 
How Maverick could have had the audacity to take us up in that weather is just unforgivable - it was in no way a comfortable and enjoyable experience.  I have flown in several helicopters around the world- none of which were anywhere near as costly as this flight ($499 for 10 minutes over the canyon) and undertaken in such entirely unsuitable weather. 

Total rip off. 

PS: additionally a sticker I bought in the shop was charged at $130 when it should have been $13!!
We had a great tour with a very profesional staff, from beginning to end. They told us a lot about the area we flew over. Thanks for a great tour
Great way to see the expanse of the Grand Canyon. Maverick was very professional, safe, courteous. Highly recommend!
Pilot was fabulous. Views spectacular. Worth every penny. Easy access and staff were very accommodating.

One of the truly memorable experiences of my life. Up there with snorkelling on the Great Barrier Reef and safari in South Africa. The moment the pilot said “We are currently at about 1,000 feet and now it’s 4,000 feet” as we went over the edge of the canyon will never leave me.

I had never flown in a helicopter before and was slightly apprehensive but I needn’t have worried. Everybody at Maverick was excellent and the pilot was very through about the safety procedures. He was also very informative about what we were seeing and how the canyon had developed over the eons. From the moment we took off to the second we landed was enjoyable.

You think you can see quite a lot from the edge of the canyon but it’s as nothing compared to what you see from the helicopter. We hope to visit the canyon again sometime and if we do we’ll be booking another flight with Maverick.

Located at the Grand Canyon Airport which is in Tusayan  Maverick Helicopters is ideally situated for sightseeing tours of the South Rim of the Grand Canyon as it takes only perhaps 5 minutes from take off to be actually in the air over the canyon. The journey to the airport from Grand Canyon Village which is where the train from Williams brought us to tak es 15 to 20 minutes by taxi and cost around $30 each way. The cab firm also stipulated payment in cash. That may change as time goes on but at the moment it seems that for them cash is the only lingua franca.  Anyway we were not aware of this until the day before our flight which is when passengers have to re confirm their bookings with the chopper company. Another possible problem that you may have to overcome is the fact that the cell phone network in the area of the canyon is very poor and we had to seek help from the staff at the rail terminal to make the necessary calls. I say calls because on our day the winds were very strong and so we also wanted to check if the flight would be going ahead. 
After getting to the Maverick helicopter terminal we found the staff to be excellent and after checking in and weighing in too we were looked after very well until departure. Our helicopter and another both returned from the tours that they were engaged on at that time and then after reports from their pilots as to the weather conditions for flying that day. The winds being rather strong and so it was decided that it was not wise to take the longer 45 minute flight that we had originally booked  and  we were given an option of a full refund or we could take the shorter 25 minute flight which we gladly accepted. I must say that although we missed out on the extra time and distance we still had a wonderful experience flying a mile up over the Colorado river and round  the dragon in the hands of a very highly skilled pilot and in a lovely, comfortable modern helicopter. I think that whichever option suits your budget or your desire this is a great way to experience the magnificence of this wonderful place. Full marks to both the ground and air crew at Maverick.

I did not want to do the 45 minute flight over the Grand Canyon but went along as my husband was looking forward to it. I'm terrified of flying in anything! Our pilot, Justin, was very friendly and welcoming. He told us about the scenery below, pointing out different sights, as well as keeping us informed about flying conditions for that afternoon. I felt bad as he really tried to put me at ease but that just didn't happen. Full marks to Justin for making the trip everything my husband had been looking forward to. The terminal building was clean, comfortable and the staff helpful and professional. I highly recommend this company. There is nothing negative to say. Fantastic!

Booked the 45 minute helicopter tour for my daughter and myself to the Grand Canyon south rim. It was just OK. The 45 minutes is from when they group you together in the lobby until you get back to the lobby. So maybe 25-30 minutes in the air. Pictures all had glare and reflections on them. Really didn’t get that close. Walking was a much, much better choice. Saw things up close and personal. Very easy walk with restrooms and water along the way. Save your money!

review_title: Unfair experience - not good value for money
review_text: Everyone paid the same price but the experiences were vastly different depending on where in the helicopter you sat.  I sat in the back in the middle and had a very restricted view compared with those sitting in the front or next to the windows.  Also the pilot did some manoeuvres to show aspects of the Grand Canyon but he did not do these equally on both sides so my daughter missed a lot of views and experiences even though she had a window seat.  I realise that weight has to be balanced and that not everyone can have the same view, but then don't charge everyone the same price! It is highly unfair that the people at the front had panoramic views and I had to try to see past the people either side of me and look through their windows.  This excursion is a once in a lifetime event and should have been a wonderful memory, instead it was an expensive and poor experience.  My advice is don't bother  - there is no guarantee that you will get a good view.

I wasn’t sure about taking our scheduled flight tour due to the windy weather conditions but we decided to trust the Maverick pilot and we were so glad that we did. The views are just beautiful and the experience was once in a lifetime!

Totally changes your perspective of the scale of the canyon.  This particular company was very professional, easy, and informative tour.  100% from start to finish.  Would do again, but would do longer than 25 min (which we did) -- maybe more than a wow factor, as a good part of the flight is over trees to canyon, so saw a relatively quick cross-canyon ride and fly around dragon.  Captain and ground crew excellent.

I'm giving them 5 stars for good customer service. We didn't get to do our helicopter tour as it got too windy to go out. They let us know there was nothing they could do. So the point of the review is to plan accordingly. Be careful making something like the the highpoint of the trip as it's weather dependent. Our trip wasn't canceled due to a hurricane, just a very windy day. Maybe plan this early in your stay to have a slight chance at rescheduling (unlikely an option as them seem pretty well booked up).

review_title: Fun, informative, a memory you’ll treasure
review_text: So glad we had this one-hour flight over the South and North Rims of the Grand Canyon. It was a windy day, but our pilot did a masterful job. Great insights into the geology and history of the area.  We had a great time.

We chose Maverick for our flight over the Grand Canyon because of the good reviews on TA and we were glad we did. There were only six passengers in a small helicopter with excellent visibility all round. There was a little buffeting (to be expected with the changing thermals over the Canyon) but the pilot, Eddie, kept these to a minimum. The view over the Canyon was spectacular and it was great to get see the Colorado River wending its way through the rock formation. 

FYI the helicopters aren't allowed to fly over the main section of the Canyon or down into it (we wondered why we hadn't seen or heard them during our visits to the rim) so you fly over the higher Northern side.
Fantastic experience, breathtaking scenery. Jesse was our pilot, very knowledgeable and informative. Was the highlight of our trip!

review_title: Magnificent way to see the canyon
review_text: We had walked the rim and taken a Pink Jeep sunset tour but this was the highlight of our visit.  Our pilot, Vern, did an excellent job of narrating the flight.  If you are able to do this,  you will be rewarded with an unforgettable experience that you will never forget.

What an experience! I was worried it would be too touristy and a let down to see the Grand Canyon by helicopter but it was amazing. Our pilot/guide was Jesse and he was so knowledgeable and interesting. It was a splurge expense but worth every penny. We were not sure 45 minutes would be long enough but we truly did see so much and the time was perfect. It was our third visit to the Grand Canyon and by far the best way to see the magnitude of the terrain.
This was the best part of the trip besides the company that we went with.  Pilot Daniel was great. The views were amazing & only seen this way.

I participated in a helicopter tour my last day in the area. Maverick helicopters provided a very fun and safe experience. In my opinion, it was the best way to end my trip to the Grand Canyon area. Due to coronavirus restrictions, only the south rim entrance was open at the time that I went. So it makes it a lot harder if you were limited on time to see the north rim and other areas. The helicopter tour shows you a variety of areas of the park and provides a breathtaking view of the Colorado River. Highly recommend. I was a Solo Traveler, and the company and my flight mates we're incredibly welcoming and friendly.

review_title: First trip to Grand Canyon for Kids
review_text: Extremely well organized.  Extremely safe.  Staff at terminal were most helpful.  Pilot went above and beyond to point out features and discuss the Canyon’s history.  A must if you get the opportunity!!!

We went up with Vern- we were lucky and it was just our family of four. We have flown in an Eco Star before and we knew we would be ok whatever seat we had- however us adults are quite tall. (We were in the middle back last time) This time the kids were seated upfront with Vern and we were on the outside windows. We did the 45 min flight- I don’t think the shorter flights I found would have done it justice. We saw a great amount of the canyon and Vern gave us great commentary. They took a picture at the beginning of the flight and it was for sale after - we also took a family selfie afterwards, they let you take plenty of pictures after the flight. We went in scared to hear the price of the video and picture- oh my gosh were we happy! It was super expensive in Hawaii (with a different company 😜) it was like $50 for picture and flight video - affordable, compared to what we’ve paid for in the past. Thank you Maverick for a great flight and affordable lifetime souvenirs! The only thing that would make it better is having working microphones to ask questions- but we totally understand with the crazy world right now!
Amazing 50 minutes helicopter ride over the Grand Canyon. You definitely get the best views flying over it.

Det er virkelig en god måde at se Grand Canyon på, her får man bedre overblik over hvor stort området egentlig er.
Det er så flot særlig der hvor man også kan se floden.
Det er også lidt syret at flyve “ud over kanten”.
Vi følte os i trygge hænder med vores pilot og modtagelsen inden vi skulle op at flyve var også god.

This is the best way to see the Grand Canyon! My husband and I have visited the South Rim a couple of times but actually taking a helicopter ride over the canyon was phenomenal! Starting with a fly over the Kaibab Forest and then the East Rim was fun. We got to see the snow-covered North Rim and fly over many rock formations that are barely visible from the rim.

Our pilot and guide was Mark. He did a great job pointing out the sites and I loved the accompanying play list of music. The helicopter was comfortable and made it easy to see the sites. Highly recommend it!
Great flight- good information from our pilot - very smooth enjoyable flight over Grand Canyon. Everyone should do this- spectacular .  Wonderful service , nice facility

Whether you are short on time or want a birds eye view of the Grand Canyon and Las Vegas this is a must do trip.  The flight was smooth and we had great views on an amazingly clear day.  Landing in the canyon at our own picnic table overlooking the Colorado River with several other choppers was a sight to behold.

review_title: The Best in Grand Canyon Helicopter Tours
review_text: We looked  into other tours, but chose  Maverick Helicopters because they offered the most for the cost and flight time.

This was an outstanding and breathtaking way to tour the Grand Canyon.  We did not book this tour when we booked the bus tour but so happy we did go when it was offered to add. Yes, it is pricy, but if you are in a bus type tour this will give the best opportunity to see the Grand Canyon!  We decided to go because we don’t know if we will ever have the opportunity to return to the area.  The staff are all very friendly and professional.  We had fun music during the flight and the pilot explained everything with just enough information that was not too overwhelming.   The others on the trip were also very enjoyable and fun. You do not want to miss this opportunity.!

If anyone gets the chance to do the Grand Canyon, please do it. I took the family over this year and was simply amazing. To have my wife and kids there was simply incredible to say that we have sat and had lunch in the Canyon is out if this world. 
Make sure you go with Maverick as they are great. Our pilot was tremendous and full of great knowledge in historical information. Yes it is not cheap but is something you will remember all your life.
