Staff at check in very polite, pilot gave good safety instructions and pointed out rock formations of interest. Cool music, too!

Very professional company, easy check-in and a friendly pilot who explained everything clearly beforehand (I think he was called Quincy?)We had a 45 minute flight and we got to find out lots from our pilot who spoke to us throughout the flight - we could also ask him questions too. At all times I felt totally safe. We had a great view from the front and side window and the helicopter glides gently around so you can get really good pictures/film. It was a really unforgettable experience. I would highly recommend Maverick.

Before we left for our Grand Canyon trip, I was talking about it with a co-worker.  She suggested we take the helicopter trip as it was the best experience of her life.  When I asked her she used, she mentioned Maverick Helicopters.  It wasn't until we were already on our trip, and after exhaustive research, we decided at the last minute to call Maverick.  BEST DECISION EVER!!  Our pilot explained everything to us very clearly and also told us what to expect (if you get motion sickness, vertigo, etc).  He also played a various selection of music (ZZ Top was the best!!).  Getting down into the canyon was just so cool!!  Seeing the fading light, different colors and the shadows made for an awesome experience.  I think this definitely lands at the top of my all time favorites!!

Friendly service and well worth it. The best way to see the canyon. Try and get a window seat if possible or the front row.
Would recommend this to anyone

Wouw wat een schitterende ervaring. Na een korte vlucht over vlak land naar de rim en daarna over de canyon. Prachtig. Piloot Nathan vertelde veel over de geschiedenis van het land en hoe het tot stand was gekomen. Erg interessant. Nadien konden we een usb stickie kopen met daarop ONZE vlucht met alles wat verteld was. Geweldig om deze thuis weer te beleven.

review_title: Take the Tour & Buy the Video
review_text: Visiting the Grand Canyon National Park has been a bucket list item forever, so once we knew we were going we immediately decided on taking the Canyon Spirit helicopter tour. We are so glad we did! Flying from the south rim to the north rim was thrilling and exceeded all expectations. From the jaw dropping scenery to the excitement of it all, it was a true once-in-a lifetime experience. The staff at Maverick were very accommodating every step of the way. Our first scheduled tour had to be canceled because of bad weather. But gladly so, because safety is obviously paramount. Luckily we had one more day in the park, so we were able to reschedule our tour for the following morning, which turned out to be beautiful, rather than take the refund that was offered. Our pilot, Jesse, was awesome too, and to include very experienced, as he was a former pilot in the service. He was relaxed and personable, knowledgeable about the Grand Canyon and its surroundings, and focused on us enjoying the tour. This was our second helicopter ride (first was years ago in NYC; very cool/different), and by far our favorite between the two. The moment you first fly out over the canyon after traversing several miles over land and trees is simply breathtaking, as is when you fly over the confluence of the Colorado and Little Colorado rivers. Do not hesitate to take the tour. You will not be disappointed. And make sure to purchase the video of your tour. It’s a great keepsake.
First time on a helicopter and it was great. The pilot was knowledgeable and exuded confidence. The trip over Grand Canyon was amazing

We had a great time and our pilot, Quincy, was informative and a patient pilot.  Even when we had to turn back to the tower for one passenger who could not “fly”. The views were spectacular and Quincy pointed out the various peaks and provided some of the history.

Wir haben zusammen mit Freunden den Rundflug von Flughafen Tusayan gemacht, und alle waren begeistert.
Der an diesem Tag etwas böige Wind hat den Hubschrauber zwar einige Male ganz schön durchgeschüttelt, aber das tat der Sache keinen Abbruch. 
Der Pilot, ein ehemaliger Polizei-Hubschrauberpilot, war sehr freundlich, und hat uns viel über die Entstehung und die Geologie des Grand Canyon berichtet.  
Ein Erinnerungsfoto mit Pilot und Hubschrauber gab es auch noch zu einem vernünftigen Preis.

Leider konnten wir wegen des starken Windes nur den kleinen Rundflug machen, aber es hat sich definitiv gelohnt! Super nettes Personal, toller Pilot. Alles wurde gut erklärt und man hatte auch nachher genug Zeit für Fotos mit dem Helikopter!
Sehr zu empfehlen!

Wir buchten sehr spontan und alles ging ganz unkompliziert. Die Crew war sehr sympathisch und unser Pilot freundlich und witzig. Mein Partner war vorne und ich hinten am Fenster, beides waren super Plätze, auch von hinten gab es genug zu sehen und wir konnten den Flug geniessen. 
Alex unser Pilot erzählte uns wärend dem Flug Details zum GC. Alles in allem ein unvergessliches Erlebnis.

My hubby and I couldn't be more happy with the helicopter tour we took of the Grand Canyon! Maverick Helicopters' staff were extremely professional and attentive to us, making sure we enjoyed our tour! We chose this company based on their many 5 star reviews, and now we see why they are so highly rated. Thank you Maverick for creating us a wonderful memory for us!

David was our pilot. He was very good the view from the air are something else. We went up to the North rim which was totally different from the South rim. The trip went far to quick. Had photos taken and got the whole trip on USB brilliant idea. Good moments to watch at home.

review_title: Don't miss a ride over the Grand Canyon
review_text: We visited the Grand Canyon in May and had previously booked to go on a Maverick Helicopter.  When we woke up there was a thick fog which made driving to the base very difficult. We were told that they couldn't fly but to come back at midday. This we did and they said we could have a shortened flight if we desired.  It was wonderful to be able to gaze down at the Colorado River far below us. What an amazing ride and our pilot was very communicative explaining about the Canyon. This company has very new helicopters with experienced pilots and our pilot used to fly for the military. If you can afford to do it, don't miss a ride over the Canyon,
1h de survol du Grand canyon. Magnifique expérience avec un personnel sympathique et  très professionnel. Parfait !

If you can do this trip. Flying over and through the canyon really helped us gain more perspective on the vastness of the Canyon. And we got to see more of the Kaibab forest so that was neat. The pilot was nice and explained about the area and geology.

This really was a delux experience, we were not disappointed. 
From the moment we were collected at our hotel by the shuttle bus, to the amazing pilots that flew us over to the Canyon, to the extraordinary helicopter flight over the South Rim, ending with a leisurely stroll around the Grand Canyon on foot with a delicious packed lunch - this tour was so well organised, so professional and a memory we will have for years to come. 
Could not have experienced the Canyon in a better way. Thank you to all maverick Staff. We were very impressive with your service and skill.

Alle sind wirklich freundlich.  Der Pilot war souverän. Erzählte während des Fluges einiges. 

Genial trotz der Kosten. Jederzeit wieder.

Fabuleux !
Vivez cette expérience une fois dans votre vie...nous étions assises à l’avant avec ma fille, pilote charmant et très sympathique !!!

No sé cuál será tu presupuesto de viaje al cañón del ColorDo pero la experiencia de ver el Parque Nacional desde el aire no tiene comparación con cualquier otra vista del cañón . Te recomiendo esta compañía para esta experiencia pues son muy atentos y profesionales. El piloto será quien te reciba en el hall y será también quien te dé todas las explicaciones en el aire. Hay cuatro asientos detrás y dos delante. Obviamente la experiencia no tiene nada que es si vas en el centro o delante por lo que nosotros pedimos los de delante para nuestras parejas y nos los concedieron aunque la colocación la hacen por peso. Cuando termines el tour el piloto te hace fotos si se lo pides. Una gran experiencia!
Worth every penny! Take the long trip, you will not regret it😁very inspiring pilot who knew all the good details about Grand Canyon.

Première fois pour toute la famille (avec fille de 7 ans et garçon de 12 ans) dans un helico qui permet de voir ma grandeur et l'étendue de ce merveilleux site.
50 mn à couper le souffle sans la sensation de vertige que nous redoutions grâce à notre suoer pilote David !!!
300$ par personne que nous n'avons pas regrettés...

Très bonne expérience, pilote expérimenté et sympathique, beau parcours (45 mn south rim) ! 
Je conseille vivement pour avoir une belle vue sur le Grand Canyon

Très belle expérience , à couper le souffle. La traversée du Canyon du Sud au Nord et le survol du Colorado resteront un souvenir fort de notre périple dans l'ouest américain. Si vous pouvez vous le permettre financièrement c'est vraiment quelque chose a faire....

The views from the helicopter were awe inspiring. Our guide Quincy was a capable pilot, however, as a guide, he spoke very rapidly and was therefore very hard to understand. Our only other objection was with the expectation that we tip the pilot. Charge more and do not put your customers in the awkward position of feeling obligated to pay out more money.

review_title: À faire pour vraiment voir le grand canyon
review_text: On avait fait le tour en voiture la veille mais pour vraiment voir le grand canyon l’hélicoptère s’impose. Vue, grandeur, c’est exceptionnel. Quel panorama... ! On est très bien installé mais on avait pris l’hélicoptère en privé pour être seul , ça augmente la note mais c’est plus agréable

review_title: The Best Way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: This was such a cool experience. Friendly and safe pilot. Stunning views you won't see elsewhere. Very organized. If you are considering this activity, do it! You won't regret it.

I forbindelse med vores Road Trip i Californien, Nevada og Arizona besøgte vi Mavericks ved Grand Canyon.
En helt fantastisk oplevelse for hele familien - bestemt ALLE pengene værd.
Een helikoptervlucht boven de Grand Canyon is zeker niet goedkoop maar wel een belevenis voor het leven. Onze vlucht duurde ongeveer 50 minuten.

Even getwijfeld of we de vlucht zouden maken want er hangt toch een behoorlijk prijskaartje aan. Onze oudste dochter heeft ons uiteindelijk over weten te halen. Bij aankomst hadden we meteen een goed gevoel. Het zag er allemaal picobello uit en de uitleg was ook duidelijk.
Over de vlucht kunnen we kort zijn nl. geweldig. Als je eenmaal vanaf boven de canyon hangt zie je pas hoe enorm en hoe mooi de grand canyon is. 
Ik heb geen ervearing met andere maatschappijen maar voor ons was dit een overgetelijke tocht.
캐년을 한 눈에 바라볼 수 있었던 멋진 투어입니다. 파일럿께서 전반적인 그랜드캐년을 소개해주시면서 좋은 모습을 보여줍니다. 사진과 비디오 구입도 가능합니다.

I have flown in several helicopters in various places around the world and have to say that the equipment here was top notch, one of the best I have flown.  And the pilot was professional and informative.  But I was a little disappointed as a solo traveler paired with a family of 4 that they placed 3 of the 4 family members in the front seat and put me in a back (albeit window) seat.  Although view was still good, lack of panoramic window made for much more limited photo opportunities.  I know they say that “the computer does it by weight” but I do not think there was enough difference between me and one family member seated up front to have created any safety issues and switching us would have only been fair IMHO and made experience much better for me.  Oh, and I bought the $20 picture at the end....luckily I looked at it before we got too far down the road as they had given me a photo of a different family on a completely different helicopter🤦‍♀️!  I still recommend the experience but these are the reasons I cannot do so unequivocally.

We flew with another outfit a few years ago and it was OK but we heard somewhere Maverick was better. It was. We paid in advance online and made an appointment. We arrived a few minutes early and were greeted cheerfully and professionally. We waited about 10 minutes and our pilot came and escorted us to the helicopter. My wife, grandson and I were joined by two other people in the 7 passenger helicopter. Pilot and three in the front, and four seat in the back. The other guy in the back and I each had a window seat with two empty seats between us. Plenty of visibility and all seats face forward. The competition has helicopters with all passenger seats in the back with half facing forward the other half facing backward.
We all had phones and my grandson had a GoPro camera so we took lots of photos and videos. Everyone had headphones and the pilot narrated the whole trip and told us the names of various features in the canyon. It was a thrilling ride and we are very pleased. We would definitely ride with Maverick again over the competition.

The perfect way to see the South rim of the Grand Canyon. 45 minute flight, 2 gorgeous vantage point stops. We had a friendly, knowledgeable guide. Great trip, another beautiful natural beauty to have enjoyed.

review_title: Helicopter flight over the Grand Canyon
review_text: An amazing experience with a knowledgeable and entertaining pilot. Our pilot pointed out areas of interest and also let us chat while we enjoyed the fantastic views. I would recommend this trip.

review_title: Awesome! You've got to do this!
review_text: Wow! So glad we did this! It was a spectacular experience! There were 6 in our group, ages 7, 9, 19, 22, 44 and 51, and we all LOVED it! Flying over the canyon and seeing it from this perspective was indescribable. Our pilot, Mark, interacted with us and provided a plethora of information about the Canyon. Make sure you book this as part of your Grand Canyon experience!

review_title: Experiencia única. Una vez en la vida hay que concretarla.
review_text: Es un espectáculo genial. Las vistas y la sensación de estar flotando sobre esa inmensa muestra de la naturaleza es increíble. El servicio fue muy bueno y no le colocó un “perfecto” por un detalle, debería tener un traductor simultáneo de lo que explica el piloto como creo que posee la compañía competidora en este sitio (Papillon) ya que si no dominas el inglés fluidamente quedas excluido de los comentarios del piloto.

Nos montamos al helicoptero al día siguiente de haber pasado el día entero en el Grand Canyon y fue espectacular, las vistas desde arriba son una pasada. Te quedas igual de sorprendido que cuando ves el canyon por primera vez. No sé el precio de la excursión ya que fue un regalo, tuvimos el tour de 45minutos y fue muy bonito. Es 100%recomendable, el piloto muy simpático.

review_title: Great way to see the Canyon!
review_text: We went on the 4:40 Spirit of the sky’s tour and it didn’t disappoint! We loved seeing the whole canyon this way. There were 5 ppl total and my husband and I had the whole back row to ourselves. I was on the right, husband on the left, and he def had the better holistic views of the canyon! Our pilot was very knowledgeable and because our whole group was there we left a little early, which was nice in not having to wait around. They let you take pics w the helicopter and not have to buy them as well! Easy and efficient to get boarded and deplaned. Felt very safe! Would highly recommend!

One of the best things we have ever done. Simply jaw dropping views of the Canyon. Maverick were totally professional and we felt very safe at all times. Ex US army pilot was great and knowledgable about all aspects of the Canyon. Check in easy and close to the local town. DVD and other mementoes available afterwards.
Great job guys👍

We had booked our flight over the Grand Canyon before we left Australia. On the morning of our flight there was thick fog and sleet falling so was quite hairy driving to the airport. Needless to say, helicopters could not fly because of no visibility. They asked us to come back at noon to see if the weather had improved.  Maverick offered a shortened flight so off we went. Our pilot was very experienced and we felt very safe.
It was a wonderful flight looking down into the canyon and seeing the Colorado River far below. 

Don't miss a flight with Maverick as they have excellent pilots and very new helicopters.
Great place, clean and efficient. Arnie was a fantastic host - went out of his way to make our experience great. 45-minute tour is the right amount of time. Thanks for a great experience.

Nos pareció una experiencia que superó nuestras expectativas, escogimos Maverick porque nos habían hablado muy bien de sus helicópteros y la seguridad , y así fue.
Lo único que no recomiendo es comprar la foto Antes de subir, porque luego te haces fotos con tu cámara 

Por lo demás, una compañía estupenda, con unos helicópteros muy nuevos y nos dio mucha seguridad, además de disfrutar de la experiencia

This was one of the best experiences of my life. It was so amazing to fly over the Grand Canyon. The pilot was so awesome and informative. 
Would definitely recommend!

We did the 45 minute helicopter tour of the Grand Canyon with Joe the pilot. He was really good and entertaining. He also quickly clocked that i don’t like flying and relaxed me. Definitely worth doing.

We took a 45 minute flight over the canyon in the afternoon.  Our pilot Jesse was very friendly and professional and made us all feel very comfortable as none of us had flown in a helicopter before.  The views of the canyon are absolutely stunning and I can easily say this was one of the coolest things I have ever done.

The facility is very clean with friendly staff and they even took us out early because everyone arrived on time.  Highly recommend this experience.

To think that I nearly didn’t book this flight because of my nervousness about flying in a helicopter. I am so glad I went. From the minute you arrive the professionalism and the whole set up gives you confidence. It was the most incredible experience. 
Our pilot was very knowledgeable, friendly and extremely helpful, taking photos of us all together and giving us as much time as we needed. The flight itself was just amazing. From the minute you take off to the jaw dropping moment that you fly over the edge of the Canyon and see the incredible view of the Colorado, a long, long way down, it just gets better and better. 
It is hard to put in to words but a wonderful experience with a great company who did everything they promised and some more. 
Don’t miss out and use Maverick Helicopters.

I did my homework before booking this experience for my family. Maverick have a great safety record and have won awards for their maintenance etc.

We made our own way to Henderson Executive terminal as we had the car. Approx. 20 minutes from the main Las Vegas strip - also have us an extra 45 minutes in bed !

Our pilot was Hank and his safety briefing was comprehensive and professional. Very comfortable seating and a full tour commentary throughout. Everyone got to ride in the front of the helicopter - they all seat 7 ( 3 in the front and 4 in the back)

We had a 45 minute flight to the West Rim and enjoyed a snack and a glass of champagne. Lots of opportunities for photos here and whilst on board.

Very professional, punctual service and cannot praise enough!

Get booking on a tour!!

I was talked into going with my dad on this trip. And my mom joined us. Our Pilot Joe, was kind and caring, he helped my parents who are older. He showed us so much. And my terror of helicopters is over thanks to him. His knowledge and skill was second to none.
Do yourself a favor and let Maverick Helicopters take you for a breath taking ride over the Grand Canyon...from the rainbow of rock colors to the snow covered North Rim...this was a must do! AMAZING!

Joe was fantastic!  Can’t even express how much fun we had in words.  Everything from the general area information that our pilot Joe shared to the history of the Grand Canyon... all incredible!  Huge thanks to Joe and the Maverick Helicopter team.  Tip your pilots.

This is probably the only way you will want to view the Grand Canyon. We were there when it was still covered in some snow so the viewing had more depth. However, if you're seated between 2 people you can forget about taking photos as they will be in your way.
Découvrir le Grand Canyon en hélicoptère est magique en passant près des falaises vous en aurez plein les yeux

Surprise birthday trip and experience for my husband included a Maverick Helicopter ride.

We liked the music during the ride and our pilot, Daniel was very informative.

Nothing quite like the first sight flying over the canyon.  Honestly, breathtaking and so glad that we did it!

Had an amazing experience taking a helicopter tour over the Grand Canyon.  Even after our first three flights earlier in the day being cancelled due to weather.  The staff was friendly and tried to accommodate as much as they could, but just be prepared for unexpected changes during weird weather days. Either way with the trip!

Do to adverse weather conditions, our tour was downgraded from the 45 min tour to the 25 min.tour.   We loved every minute!  The operation was very professional and friendly.  Their building was very cozy and the gift shop was great!  Our pilot was very experienced and knowledgeable about his aircraft and the Grand Canyon.  If you have limited time, or are visiting the Grand Canyon during unpleasant climate months, the helicopter tour is a great option! Its an experience you will never forget!!

Revisiting with a friend who had never been before we used Maverick Helicopters.
We just walked in as we had no idea when we would arrive so couldn't book.
I cannot believe the wonderful way we were treated. Staff all of them were kind  polite,friendly,accommodating.
You feel that safety is their no one factor.
My friend had a wonderful experience and came back from the flight enthralled.
My flight years ago was with them and this is the 7th friend I have shown the Canyon to. Maverick have never let me down. And if I return with another first timer they will be on our agenda.
Well done to a superb company
Vj

Our pilot was BJ, and he provided an excellent tour of the of the Grand Canyon. The flight was very comfortable and the view was amazing with the helicopters Maverick use. I would most certainly do this again and are out of town guests were very impressed

Passeio de 25 minutos em um helicóptero para 7 pessoas que vale muito a pena. A vista do Grand Canyon é lindíssima e a visão aérea da paisagem é de tirar o fôlego. Equipe responsável com todos os itens de segurança a bordo, além de ser um helicóptero moderno e confiável. Apesar de caro vale cada centavo.

review_title: Top Rating for a Helicopter Tour We Never Went On
review_text:
We booked a helicopter tour of the Grand Canyon for our family.  Making the reservation was easy and painless.  We arrived in the Grand Canyon Village the day before our scheduled 50 minute helicopter tour.

I had chosen Maverick Helicopter Tours because of their safety rating and because of the type of helicopters they use that have maximum visibility for all passengers.  

We awoke to heavy snow on the day of our helicopter tour.  Although our tour was not scheduled to begin until 3 PM, Maverick Helicopters called us around 9:30 AM to inform that the tour was cancelled due to the heavy snow and the forecast for more snow to come during the afternoon.  They said that even if they had elected to fly, we would be unable to see the canyon below us due to the very limited visibility.  

They offered to reschedule us for another day or provide a full refund.  We would have liked to fly with them another day but we had a full schedule of other plans and bookings that we could not cancel without loss of our deposits.  

Whenever we have another opportunity, we will surely book with Maverick Helicopter Tours and, with a little luck, we won’t have a snowstorm on the day of our helicopter tour of the Grand Canyon.

review_title: Incredible way to see the Grand Canyon!
review_text: The Grand Canyon is so vast that the best way to see it is from above. If you can splurge for the helicopter ride, do it! This was one of the highlights of our week-long trip through the national parks. Our pilot, Patrick, explained what we were seeing and answered all of our questions. The helicopter was comfortable with room for 7 passengers - 3 up front with the pilot and 4 in the second row so everyone had a great view. Since Maverick needs to balance the weight of the helicopter, they assign seats. They asked us for estimates when we made the reservation, then weighed us when we checked in. For those who are sensitive about their weight, no worries - only the person behind the desk sees how much you weigh. :)

This trip was one of the best things we have ever done!!
Helicopter was huge. It’s climate controlled , big comfy seat (5 people and pilot). You wear nice  headphone w/mic to talk to pilot. Also awesome music is piped in .  So very 😎 cool.  I couldn’t possibly describe the Grand Canyon or how awesome it was   It is definitely a must-see if it’s not on your bucket list it needs to be   Well worth the price
Bon accueil du personnel- Une expérience inoubliable- grand professionnalisme du pilote - tout à fait exceptionnel- le seul regret :pas de commentaires en français

I was initially terrified, but had always wanted to fly over the Grand Canyon.  Thanks to the amazing pilot, I had the time of my life.  He reassured me, made me feel comfortable, and was incredibly knowledgeable. I would highly recommend
My son and I visited 2 weeks ago, we both LOVED it.  Smooth flight, no concern for air sickness, comfortable seats, knowledgeable pilot.  Strongly recommend.

Well worth paying the $$$ for.

The drop off as you fly into the Grand Canyon is breath taking.

Pilot was well educated on various points and aspects of the Grand Canyon.

First up, a highly professional set up with state of the art helicopters and excellent pilot/guides. The flight was comfortable, the views were awe-inspiring and the commentary illuminating. Plus some iconic sound tracks to accompany the scenes below.
We've done one similar flight recently over Victoria Falls....and this company's approach was sooo much better.
Worth every penny (cent!).

Our original booking got cancelled twice due to the thunderstorm and heavy cloud at the Grand Canyon (safety first). Their front desk staff was very helpful to reschedule for us to two days later when the weather was sunny. We had a smooth check in and everything was great. Our pilot, BJ, a very funny guy and yet very professional. He answered my questions about how often they service the helicopters and safety precautions. It was a great experience to fly with Maverick and I highly recommend them to everyone.

Accueil charmant, pilote au top. Dommage que tous les commentaires soient donnés en américain.. On aurait pu encore plus profiter de ce survol unique au dessus du Colorado, de la rive droite plus végétalisée et de lieux inaccessibles ou invisibles autrement. À recommander.
sorvolando con la compagnia Maverick ho constato un professionalità e competenza da parta del pilota che ci ha accompagnato in questa bellissima avventura , disponibilità al massimo !!! consiglio

L'équipe des Hélicoptères Maverick est sympathique. Une attention spéciale pour Robert notre pilote, il nous a pris spontanément en photo avec notre smartphone devant l'hélicoptère. Nous étions à l'arrière dans l'hélico mais nous avons tout de même très bien vu les paysages. Après le survol de la forêt au départ de l'aérodrome et lorsque vous entrer dans le Grand Canyon, un "WAOW" est sorti spontanément de ma bouche. (on avait pris le vol de 40 minutes).

review_title: Eco Star Helicopter Grand Canyon 45 minute tour
review_text: Very disappointed, my husband & I were both seated in back. Viewing back of people’s head and their seats

The helicopter tour was an amazing experience. The pilot was very knowledgeable about the geology of the canyon and provided a lot of interesting information. Since there were wild fires, we couldn't do the long tour, which we booked initially, but they switched us without problems to a smaller tour and refunded the difference back to my credit card. I highly recommend you book a flight with Maverick if you intend to visit the Grand Canyon. You won’t get those views from the rims or skywalk!

We chose Maverick on the basis of reviews, and their safety record. It was the most amazing experience. . Flying over the canyon rim was just incredible. Our pilot, BJ, was very reassuring and professional in his manner, and also good fun.
Worth every penny, would encourage everyone to do this.

review_title: The best experience in life to date
review_text:
This is a must do . From the ground the canyon is amazing from the air spectacular . 

This company is the only one i’d go with , because of their safety record . I found them professional and friendly . 

Our pilot BJ was fabulous his manner calmed my nerves  . I was extremely nervous to the point my legs were shaking , I’m a seasoned flyer but i’ve never been on a helicopter . 

I was petrified ( i’m scared on kids rides at Disney! ) but knew I had to push myself as I would have regretted not taking this opportunity to see this wonder. 

I was not disappointed, it was the most amazing experience of my life and I’ve been blessed to have ticked some bucket list experiences already . 

Please please don’t miss out on this because of fears , you will not be disappointed . 

It will give you the confidence to help overcome life’s challenges and you will look  back on it and pat yourself on the back because you overcame your fears . 

The ride was exciting started with rain , lightening in the distance . We were delayed slightly in the building to ensure it was safe to fly. We were kept informed and told only when safe would we go . 

The initial part of the flight took us high above the forest where on our return we saw a herd of bison . 

Then we waited to go over the edge , no updraft no downdraft just smooth flying and over we went , writing this my body is reminded of the nervous exhilaration I felt . 

The most wonderous views of the canyon and Colorado river miles below . 

Remember to stop taking pictures and video and soak up the experience through your own eyes and not a lens. 

I can’t wait to do it again with my partner . 

 A dream come true . 

Thank you BJ and Maverick 10/10

Nous avons réservé un tour de 45 min au dessus du Grand Canyon au départ de Tusayan. Organisation parfaite, pilote très sympa et que dire du vol.. juste merveilleux, incroyable... on se sent tellement petit ! 
A faire absolument !!
Maverik . Molto attenti alla sicurezza, elicotteri nuovi, il nostro pilota era molto disponibile a spiegare ciò che vedavamo. Costa parecchio ma ne vale la pena
This was an excellent trip.  We thoroughly enjoyed every minute of it. Definitely worth every penny!!

Did this in March 2018 and was a have to do experience. The helicopter seats 6 and if you get middle back seat as I did it does distract from views. The rest of the seating is very good. The pilot however was knowledgeable and fun to visit with.

review_title: Exciting way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: Our family took a family reunion trip to the Grand Canyon. A highlight of this trip was taking a helicopter tour with Maverick Helicoptors. There are other alternatives available but I feel Maverick is #1. They greet you as soon as you walk in to their terminal. You are quickly introduced to your pilot who takes time to explain what will take place. Throughout the helicoptor ride in the canyon the pilot does an excellent job pointing out the various rock formations. When the ride is over you are given the opportunity to purchase a DVD of the entire trip. This experience experience was a major part of our trip and I highly recommend it.

Flight was excellent.had been postponed at 8am due to forest fires but we got in the air at 3pm.only 30 mins but still worth it.i had bought a maverick hat that morning and after the flight I got staff discounts on 2 posters and a photo from the staff when they saw my hat!Very generous and friendly people!

Super Vol 30mn de Grand Plaisir
Décollage à l’heure Plein les yeux au dessus du Grand Canyon
Hélicoptère Très stable
Grand Moment avec dans le casque de la bonne musique qui accompagne notre vol (Sting Christopher Cross John Williams...)

review_title: Buen trato y servicio. La experiencia no vale lo que cuesta
review_text:
La experiencia debería ser. Por desgracia, si tienes la mala suerte de que te toque sentarte atrás, como fue mi caso, la cosa cambia bastante. Mientras que los pasajeros de la primera fila tienen una vista de casi 180º, con una cabina que se extiende prácticamente hasta sus pies, si te toca atrás y en el centro, tienes que andar torciendo la cabeza para poder ver algo por las ventanas laterales o por encima de las cabezas de los de delante

El problema es que la distribución la hacen por pesos, y no te la dicen hasta el momento de montarte en el helicóptero. Y pagas lo mismo que el resto.

En mi opinión, deberían evitar asignar asientos en la parte trasera, y en caso de asignarlos, ofrecer al menos 50$ de descuento. 

En resumen, salí de el viaje sintiéndome estafado. Y las vistas son bonitas, pero no mucho mejores de las que puedes ver caminando. Lo más importante es la sensación de sobrevolar los cañones, y esa no la tuve

Maverick were a little bit hard to find and there is limited parking but the helicopter ride was great. The pilot was a nice young man, the helicopter was clean and tidy, the views are amazing and the commentary was good. My wife and I both loved it. It was a 6 seat helicopter ( including the pilot) but there was only 2 other passengers with us so there was plenty of room and we were all comfortable. We booked our tickets online a day or 2 prior. We drove up from Flagstaff in the morning, had a look at the Grand Canyon from the paths around the edge of the south rim and then did the 50 minute helicopter tour which gave us a good understanding of how big the Canyon really is. Well worth a visit and Maverick were very good.
Erg mooie helicopters en vakkundige piloten. Gewoon een perfecte en veilige ervaring. Gaan we zeker nog een keer herhalen.

review_title: Fly with Maverick Airlines! Fly the Canyon Dream!
review_text: The Grand Canyon National Park is 18 miles wide and one mile deep and one of the 7 Natural Wonders of The World! I brought my 15 yr old granddaughter on the Canyon Dream trip with Maverick Airlines in their executive style, 2-pilot Beachcraft 1900 airplane, and I am really struggling to find the words to describe this amazing trip, but I have to share! First of all, the plane was airconditioned, comfortable and most of the seats have windows. The views were amazing too! When we got there, we boarded the quaint Maverick trolly that took us thru a darling little town called Tusayan, Arizona. Along the way we saw, a lot of beautiful wildlife, including the biggest Elk I've ever seen, mule deer and smaller elk! We arrived at the Maverick Helicopter terminal in a beautifully treed setting and that's where we boarded the chopper, and flew over this awe-inspiring canyon for about 20 minutes! Glorious! Stunning! Spetacular! When we got back we 'trollied' to the Bright Angel Lodge, next to the famous El Tovar Lodge where Teddy Roosavelt stayed many times in the late 1800's. We had a lunch provided by Maverick and walked around enjoying the views, got a few goodies at the gift shops, had an ice cream cone. Sat there taking it all in! A MUST SEE ~ MUST DO TRIP! Thanks to Maverick Airlines, and all the wonderful pilots and staff for the truly unforgettable Canyon Dream! By airplane, helicoper and foot!

We reserved our helicopter tour through Maverick. I originally thought that $299.00 per person was expensive,  but quickly realized that it was worth every penny spent. Our pilot BJ was professional, friendly and knowledgeable. He immediately put us all at ease and made what was already a memorable experience a step above. I highly recommend this to be put on everyone's bucket list.

We did the 45 minutes tour. Fantastic! Pilot was very professional and caring. He made everyone feel at ease and we had an awsome view of grand canyon colorado rivers the north and the south rim and  the
desert.

This was our first trip to the Grand Canyon as a family, and we figured going up was the best way to see it! Took the 45-minute tour with Michael as our pilot and he was awesome! Our kids, ages 9 and 11, were a little apprehensive at first but our pilot’s demeanor and knowledge of the park made the whole experience fun as well as educational for the entire family! Truly a breathtaking and surreal experience and I would highly recommend Maverick to anyone!

Une excursion à ne pas manquer au départ de Los Angelès. Première partie du vol au Nevada au dessus du désert jusqu'au Hoover ( Boulder ) Dam et le lac Mead, puis en Arizona au-dessus et dans le  Grand Canyon. Une merveille.Pilote très sympathique. On se sent en sécurité.
Fantastisk flyvetur over Grand Canyon, hvor vi oplevede både solskin og regnvejr. God service og introduktion på jorden og BJ var en super pilot i luften - kan varmt anbefales!

Nous sommes une famille de 4 personnes dont une fille de 17 ans et une de 8 ans. Tout le monde a été émerveillé du professionnalisme de Maverick : le pilote très pro, la qualité des appareils, le respect de la sécurité, la qualité de l’accueil...
En ce qui concerne le vol au dessus du grand canyon c’est magnifique et inoubliable. Certes c’est un budget conséquent mais c’est inimaginable de ne pas faire cette activité.
Je recommande vivement car vous ne serez pas déçu.
Un seul point d.amélioration, ce serait une traduction en French 😊
Merci Maverick !

Wij hadden de trip van 45 minuten geboekt en dit is zeker een aanrader. Ondanks de hoge prijs hadden we het niet willen missen. Tijdens de vlucht kregen we veel informatie van de piloot en konden we veel foto's maken. Daarna ook nog met de heli op de foto

review_title: The best experience of Grand Canyon
review_text: Thank you very much. We loved the flight, the views and the commentary. This is the best way to do Grand Canyon. We highly recommend it, very professional company.

Esperienza fantastica! 
Un'emozione indescrivibile,  mi sono davvero emozionata quando mi si è aperto il Grand canyon davanti a me!
Unica cosa un po' costoso... potrebbero almeno regalarla la foto invece di farla pagare...

We took the 45 min Grand Canyon flight from Tusayan.  Our pilot was BJ and he was awesome.  He made my nervous child totally comfortable, gave us a great tour, and was extremely professional.  It was an expensive trip for a family but BJ and Maverick made it feel like money well spent!  Highly recommend!
Beautiful scenery and lots of time above the canyon in the 40-minute flight.  Our pilot was excellent and had formerly flown Blackhawks in the military.  We had a wonderful time.

This was the best way to view the Grand Canyon, particularly for the first time. We took off on time with a very knowledgable pilot and were treated to breathtaking views of the Canyon from the air. I would highly recommend this to any tourists visiting the Canyon.

A First Class operation, the building is modern and very well appointed with leather sofas to relax on while you wait your turn. Friendly and welcoming staff. Helicopters are spotless and look brand new. Safety briefing are concise and to the point. The pilot was Extremely professional but also very personable and approachable. He gave us a great deal of information about the Grand Canyon during our flight. Would highly recommend this experience, there is nothing like it when you drop over the edge of the Canyon!!!!

review_title: You haven’t seen the canyon unless it’s from the sky.
review_text:
We visited 4 years ago and were in awe of the canyons size and beauty. On return we booked a helicopter flight and it was worth every cent. Don’t Baulk at the price it give you an amazing perspective.
Just do it!!

We did the Canyon Dream airplane and helicopter tour in May. A truly fabulous experience with the most professional and friendly staff from start to end.  Collection from our hotel and a full day of pure enjoyment (Seven hours).   No photographs can project the beauty and sheer grandness of the canyon.  

My sister is an extremely nervous flyer but what a supberb flying experience this was.  The pilots taking us out to meet the helicopter were charming, enthusiastic and had a great sense of humour which all  made for an extremely positive  exerpience.    The pilot invited us up to the cockpit and took photographs for us.  Nothing was too much trouble and lots of interesting facts relayed throughout the plane trip. 

The helicopter trip itself over the south rim of the canyon was just breathtaking.   Again a great pilot, lots of chat and tremendous knowledge of the canyon.

There is also a driven tour through thre National Park taking you to scenic viewpoints to enjoy the  packed lunch provided.  We had a fabulous guide called Mike who was extremely knowledgeable and had a great sense of humour.  It is apparent that lots of care and thought is put into Mike’s tour.

We also did the evening flight down the Las Vegas strip, breathtaking! 

Can’t recommend this company highly enough. Each and every one of the people we met came across as enthusiastic, with an absolute passion to provide an unforgettable experience.

review_title: The Grandeur of the Grand Canyon
review_text:
One of the highlights of our trip to the US was our helicopter flight with Maverick into the Grand Canyon and it simply blew our minds.  We chose Maverick due to their safety record and the reviews on Trip Advisor. 
The booking process was easy, the staff friendly and willing to answer all my questions (I have never been in a helicopter before so there were many) and our pilot and tour guide was fantastic.

Après avoir longuement comparé les différentes offres nous avons opté pour le Wind Dancer Tour proposé par Maverick Helicopters. Ce n'est pas l'offre la moins chère mais au moins vous êtes sur de décoller de l'aéroport Mac Carran de Las Vegas et les avis étaient plutôt bons.

Nous n'avons pas été déçus. Prise en charge  et décollage à l'heure. Départ en formation patrouille avec 3 autres hélicoptères. Survol du lac Mead, Hoover Dam, puis entrée dans le Grand Canyon, atterrissage, champagne.

Pilote professionnel et charmant.

3 places à l'avant à côté du pilote et 4 derrière.

Un conseil : faire le vol aller devant c'est plus impressionnant qu' au retour.
We took the Grand Canyon tour on Maverick Helicopters and it was amazing. We went during the middle of the day when there were no shadows. The pilot was energetic, knowledgeable and engaging.

Amazing views over the Canyon with new helicopters and company has great safety record. Can highly recommend this tour company. We did the Grand Canyon spirit tour and the experience was awesome! Pilot commentary was also super so worthwhile best way to see the Canyon and flight does circle round whole canyon. I get motion sickness but had no problems at all

We flew with them in Maui and knew they were the best!  Took the kids and knew we had to do this! These people are top notch and you can tell they take their business serious.  The weather did;t allow us to do the 45 min tour but we were able to do the 25 min flight...thank goodness!  pilots and all staff are great!!  you won't regret it
I don't know what i was ever concerned about. Amazing flight that was of no concern at all. Smooth as silk.

review_title: Awesome way to see Grand Canyon
review_text: We did the 45 minute tour around the Canyon and it was amazing. Chris was our Pilot and he was ver knowledgeable, pointed out specific landmarks and gave us wonderful historical and scientific background. My kids loved it and will be something we all remember! We had the 10:00 tour in the morning and it was perfect timing.

We did the Canyon Spirit tour which took us around the Canyon for 45 minutes. BJ, the pilot, was extremely  friendly and professional. The views of the Canyon are simply breathtaking and truly the only way to get a sense of its vastness. We came back with plenty of incredible memories and the certainty that the money was well spent.

review_title: A must do if you really want to see the GC
review_text: All services were 1st class, from check-in, to safety review, to our knowledgable pilot.  Safety was their first priority.  Would recommend this outfit to anyone interested in heli tour.

review_title: The only way to appreciate the Grand Canyon
review_text: Whilst travelling Route 66 in April/May 2013 we took a detour to the Grand Canyon. At the last minute we decided to take a helicopter flight. From arriving at the Maverick flight centre we felt at ease - everything was clearly explained to us preflight. Our pilot was so knowledgeable and made us feel right at ease - we also enjoyed his in flight soundtrack (when he was busy with ATC etc). Thoroughly recommend them and look forward to taking a trip with them from Vegas in May 2018!

Nos costó decidirnos porque mi seóra ha tenido malas experiencias con paseos en vuelos ...   Pero este nos los recomendaron en las Vegas en el Cesar Palace y la verdad que tenían razón.  Es una empresa grande con montón de opciones, los vi donde lo tomamos en la zona oeste, y también en el sur. Acá se lo toma en el aeropuerto de la zona oeste, esta ideal para combinar con la visita al Sky y el paseo por los miradores.  El nuestro duró 50 minutos con bajada dentro del gran Canyon. el Helicóptero era muy lindo, cómodo y el piloto un Sr.   serio responsable pero amable. caro si, pero vale la pena.  A tiene 6 lugares, dos adelantes y 4 atrás  La parada es de unos 15 o 20 intuís, ideal para fotos

review_title: Horrible experience. BEWARE! Bait N Switch
review_text:
Maverick Helicopter is run by very dishonest uncaring management.  I would like to warn fellow travelers to NOT spend your hard earned money with this company.  My wife, infant, and I were excited to take this helicopter tour when we arrived at their facility.  As we are getting ready to board, we noticed they put us in the back seats.  In the front row, there were 4 tall adults, including the helicopter pilot.  When we looked up, we are literally staring at the back of shoulders/necks and we cannot see anything.  Naturally, after spending $600 we were pretty upset, so I asked the ground crew nicely to escort us back to the main counter to speak with a supervisor.  We were greeted rudely by LISA COFFEE.  First words out of her mouth were, "sorry there are no refunds, I could have sold those seats to someone else".  My jaw dropped.  My wife and I tried to explain, we could not see anything and were not happy with the service.  Lisa, instead of offering to put us on another flight or find some type of resolution, unempathetically handed me the general managers card and says "Call him, if you have a problem, but you are not getting your money back". So no helicopter ride and robbed $600, we left the building for our first experience at the Grand Canyon Maverick Tours.  I called the GM shortly after (Ted Yasuda) and got his voice recorder.  I left him a detailed message, with what just happened with an optimistic spirit that somehow this would get resolved.  I never received a call back from Ted Yasuda, I left several messages and still no call back, when I got back home from our Grand Canyon trip I emailed him twice, then he finally responded with an even more arrogant demeanor than his colleague Lisa Coffey.  After a few email exchanges,  I summarize "I will not be issuing a refund" with no apologies or attempts to bring light to a dissatisfied customer robbed of their money and experience they will never get back.   

Bottom line, we planned and saved months to take our first trip to the Grand Canyon, a lifelong dream of my wife.  I surprised her with these helicopter tour tickets, after much sacrifice at work to be robbed blind and completely disregarded by Maverick Helicopters.  This is not how you treat any customer when you are running a business and providing a public service.   As many of you read, there are many complaints from other passengers with similar stories, and yet, they still do nothing.  This should have been disclosed on their trip advisor advertisement or when we called to make the reservations.  It is understandable, that not everyone can ride in the front, but don't charge the same fees and be upfront with customers.  This way it is the consumers, that choose what experience they want to purchase.
I wish every reader, a great journey and safe trip to the Grand Canyon, but do yourself a favor and stay far away from this company.

review_title: Good way to see the GC but not all equal seats
review_text: We were a group of four friends (2 couples) and were assigned seating in the helicopter according to our weight. We had booked this tour because the Maverick helicopters are advertised as having large windows and great views. Our friends were luck and placed in the front row (3 seats + pilot) so they had amazing front views 180 degrees of the Canyon and they loved it. I was on the left side by the window and go to see only one side of the views as the pilot’s chair blocked my front view. My husband who sat next to me had even worse views as he had to stretch to see above/between the front seats or to the sides to get a glimpse of the Canyon. The tour should take the seat assignment into consideration with a gradual pricing. Our pilot was great and his music playlist was fun. Overall we liked it but felt a little disappointed.

Vuelo de 50 minutos desde el aeropuerto de Tusayan. Son muy puntuales, los helicópteros excelentes, el piloto muy amable y atento a todas nuestras necesidades y consultas. Durante el vuelo no permiten bolsos ni mochilas, solo cámaras fotográficas, celulares y agua embotellada.
No habíamos visto nada del paisaje hasta ese momento, fue asombroso cuando finalizó el bosque y el piloto nos dijo “bienvenidos al Gran Cañón”
Si pueden... sorpréndase, vale la pena.

Vedere il Gran Canyon è una cosa, fare il tour in elicottero...beh le parole non renderebbero! Noi lo consigliamo SENZA OMBRA DI DUBBIO! Tutto estremamente organizzato, pilota gentilissimo, in cuffia musiche da film e narrazione in italiano! Un consiglio? Non guardate il costo (che comunque è sempre un fattore relativo), cogliete l’occasione e fatelo! Avrete ricordi impressi nella memoria che non dimenticherete mai!
This was one the best things I’ve ever done in my life to date. Would 100% recommend & our pilot was also amazing. Expensive but worth it.

One of the 2 highlights of our 15-day road trip in October, (the other being a flight in a WWII trainer biplane at Falcon Field, Az), expectations of the Maverick trip were high - and easily exceeded.
Nothing prepared us - thankfully! - for the wonderful 45min flight over the Grand Canyon.
Professional and thorough check-in at Maverick's base, on the approach road to Grand Canyon's South Rim. 
The views, the views, the views!
Like most commercial helicopter flights, our seats were allocated by our weight. No matter...we all enjoyed superb views of the Grand Canyon...I was seated in the middle of the rear row. Amazing.
The flight is just wonderful, with our pilot giving a fascinating commentary on what we were flying by and above. You can see the helicopters in front, with all aircraft following a strict, pre-determined course. So well-organised.
There was a massive choice of reasonably-priced souvenirs back at Maverick's modern base/shop, enough selection for anyone's budget.
100% I would recommend this flight if you can afford it...and even if you can't!

I could not dream about how fantastic the Grand Canyon would be from the air! Maverick was very professional, the pilot explained everything before take off. Our pilot told us exactly what to look for and what we would see, where we were going, and about different altitudes. It was fantastic. From his knowledge you would have thought he had grown up in the area but discovered he flew in Alaska last summer. He pointed everything out and was just a wealth of information. It didn’t hurt that we flew on a beautiful winter day that was crisp and clear. Also, love that they took individual group pictures with their cameras and ours, plus a video was available for purchase of our specific flight.
Everything about this was relaxed and fantastic. Yes, they book flights all day but do not make you feel like you have to hurry.

Een helicoptervlucht boven de Grand Canyon is een belevenis. Het is een behoorlijk bedrag wat je moet betalen maar het geld volledig waard. Je krijgt zo'n mooi zicht op de Grand Canyon. Ook degene met hoogtevrees hadden het niet willen missen. Alleen na eerst even over bomen te hebben gevlogen en toen de geweldige diepte voor je was even goed slikken.  De aardige  pilot vertelde allerlei wetenswaardigheden en gaf ons een veilig gevoel. We hadden de vlucht van 08.00uur maar zeker met de ochtendzon was dat een geweldig tijdstip voor mooie foto's maken.
Kortom een aanrader.
Anbefalelsesværdig helikoptertur over Grand Canyon. Fin tur hvor der er nok tid til at nyde Grand Canyon fra toppen.

Taking a helicopter ride was on our bucket list. Being afraid of heights, there was some trepidation in taking this tour.  As soon as we met our pilot BJ, he put us all at ease. His genuine personality and knowledge of the Grand Canyon made this trip priceless. I was surprised that I wasn’t afraid, I actually felt very safe and secure. I would do it again in a heart beat.

We bought the tickets at the hotel ,  full instructions where to go, and how to get there ( 5 mins from hotel ) 
On arrival we were greeted , all checks done , weight ! Very important as to where you sit in helicopter , please note no handbags or luggage allowed , cameras , phones etc are. 
Our  pilot  Ross, very calm and patient , explained all what we were going to experience , with  just the right amount of humour. He was very knowledgable about the Grand Canyon, answered questions , and had lots of information regarding the area . The flight was amazing and would recommend it 100%. It’s a must if you visit .
Da non perdere assolutamente! Il modo migliore per godersi il Grand Canyon. Competenza, professionalità e puntualità: bravissimi!

Appena arrivati in hotel vedo elicotteri passare e istantaneamente decidiamo di fare un giro sul Gran  Canyon. Mai scelta è stata più azzeccata! Ci fanno attendere 60 min circa e poi via!
Grazie al pilota Patrick per la disponibilità, cortesia e professionalità: ha reso il nostro viaggio indimenticabile!

Gut organisiert, ansprechend gestaltete Warte- und 'Check in'-Halle, sehr pünktlich und auf Sicherheit bedacht. Mit BJ haben wir tmzudem einen super Piloten erwischt, der neben seinen beruflichen Fähigkeiten auch über ausgeprägte soziale Kompetenzen verfügt. Der Flug war ein Riesenerlebnis und natürlich ein absolutes Highlight unserer Rundreise. Sicher, ganz günstig ist das Ganze nicht, aber es lohnt sich jeder Cent!

We were so excited about our inaugural helicopter flight and what better place to do it. Our pilot, Fred, was great - giving a running commentary and telling jokes as we took off to the music of "Top Gun" - the flight was amazing and will long live in the memory.

Our flight drifted over the scheduled time but still felt over all too quickly - so much to take in in such a short time.

At the end of the flight photographs and DVD's of the flight are available to buy if you choose.

Loved it !

My first helicopter ride and first time seeing the Grand Canyon in one incredible experience. It was everything I hoped it would be and more. Our pilot Joel did a great job of describing what we were seeing. Highly recommend this tour

I have taken a helicopter tour before and this was by far the better experience. The Canyon is amazing and this is the best way to experience it.  The entire process was smooth.  Our pilot was very personable and knowledgeable without appearing to have a memorized spiel. Watch out for the first dip into the canyon. It’s a doozy!

Een helikoptervlucht van 45 min over de grand canyon...onwezenlijk mooi. Je vliegt over een sparrenbos, krijgt een koptelefoon op, de juiste muziek wordt gespeeld en dan opeens ben je boven de canyon, een kippenvel moment. Een heel andere beleving als bij de vieuwpoints en de wandelingen.
Je krijgt ook de nodige info in uw eigen taal.
De plaatsen in de helicopter zijn wel niet gelijkwaardig. Het gaat volgens gewicht maar ik denk toch dat er uitzonderingen gemaakt worden. 
Ik eerste instantie zat ik langs de piloot, opeens moest ik in een andere helicopter en daar waren de 2 voorste plaatsen al bezet. 
Ik zat dus op de 2de rij en dan ook in het midden. 
Tarieven zouden dan ook verschillend moeten zijn.
Must be the best tour I ever have taken. Unbelivable views and amazing experience. Great pilot with good sense of humor
BJ our pilot was terrific and the views of the Canyon were amazing. Very professional and a once in a lifetime experience. If you are making the trip to the Canyon this is a must with Maverick

review_title: Nicht billig, aber wer's versäumt ist selber schuld
review_text: Wir haben die große 45 Minuten Runde gleich in der Früh um 8 gebucht und waren total begeistert. Parken konnte man direkt vor der Tür, von Tusayan sinds keine 5 Minuten mit dem Auto. 3 Hubschrauber von Maverick sind im Convoy geflogen. Unser Pilot war echt nett und hat uns die Gegend erklärt. Wir hatten mit dem Wetter Glück, es war fast windstill, aber nicht durchgehend sonnig. Der Flug war total ruhig. Die Plätze wurden angeblich nach Gewicht nach vorhergehender diskreter Waage eingeteilt. Eine saß neben dem Piloten, einer direkt dahinter am Fenster. Je 4 Plätze in 2 Reihen. Die 2 Innenplätze hinten haben vielleicht etwas weniger Sicht, den Nachbarn hat es aber trotzdem sehr gut gefallen. Wir sind froh, den Flug gemacht zu haben. Es gab unvergessliche Bilder und Eindrücke. Wir würden wieder den Flug um 8 Uhr nehmen.

review_title: The Only Way to See the Grand Canyon
review_text: I cannot recommend Maverick Helicopter tours enough. The views were spectacular and our pilot was very knowledgable of the canyon and its history. Easily the best way to see the Grand Canyon and understand the sheer scale of it.
I highly recommend Maverick Helicopter tours. The views were breathtakingly beautiful! I cannot imagine there is a better way to view this majestic canyon. Worth every penny.

review_title: Outstanding must do Grand Canyon experience
review_text: I screwed up the booking through an online agent which had automatically done next day but they were very helpful in changing it to put me on a tour that day with no fuss. Check in and waiting area are good. Travelling alone can often be awkward with tours and stuff as they hook you up with other people but they put me on a flight with a lovely family of four with whom there was great rapport with the fabulous pilot too. 3 were in the front & two of us either side at the back so we all had great views. Two middle seats at back were left empty & other flights were taking off at the same time so five passengers is the optimum maximum if you want a direct window view for everyone. I was glad it was the end of my month tour & final experience as it was so mind blowing everything else would have paled to insignificance afterwards.

Excellent trip a must do to see the Canyon, BJ our pilot was very knowledgeable about the Canyon. Take off and landing also the smoothest I've ever had 👍
Thanks for the memory

I took the Canyon Spirit, 45 min tour with our awesome pilot Barclay.  It was an amazing experience that I thoroughly recommend.  Forget about the price, this is a once in a lifetime experience you will not regret! We started with a safety briefing followed by individual group photos with Barclay & the helicopter (which you can purchase following - but no pressure was put on you to do so).  Then it was off, the scenery was amazing & Barclay's commentary was great, keeping us well informed & pointing out sights of interest, and sharing history of the area.  We all had headsets on so could talk & ask questions at anytime.  If you've seen the Grand Canyon from the ground you will know the difficulty in explaining its grandeur and sheer awesomeness - now times that by 100 (or more) and you'll get close to how amazing it is to view from the air! The experience of flying over the edge and having the earth drop away from you so dramatically is awe inspiring! Once we returned to the ground there was more time to have group photos taken with our own cameras.  They also have DVD's you can purchase that are taken during your flight.  Ohh and I mustn't forget Barclay's great eclectic music mix which played in the background when conversation was not happening! Thank you Barclay & Maverick for an experience I will never forget!

review_title: Wow! The best views of the Canyon!
review_text:
We had an awesome ride on a Maverick Helicopter with our pilot Todd! 
It was a beautiful, calm day and the views were spectacular! It was well worth the price for the two of us! 
Although the copter could seat 6, there were only 4 of us so each person had a window view!

Was a bit put off at the price in the beginning, but THEN . . .  Would have paid twice the amount for it. Our pilot, JC Maynard, was just the BEST. The view was so impressive that I wasn't even able to take pictures as my eyes were tear-laden the whole trip. Absolutely THE best bit of my visit to Grand Canyon. Yes, Just do it!

The 45 min flight through the grand canyon is mind blowing. After a 5 minutes flight over the kaibab forest you enter the cliffs of the canyon and its just fantastic. The pilot explains background and names of the various rock formation. 
Bad Luck: My friend and I catched the seats on the back which did not provide an ideal view - I wished this would have been mentioned in advance and would have been taken into acaount in the pricing. Anyway: great experience

Wow, is all I can say but I'll go on!! Maverick delayed us, rightfully so, due to weather but we got off a bit later and it was worth the wait. 
Loved it!! Spencer, our pilot, was wonderful! We were speechless and my husband is never speechless!! Would do this again in a heartbeat!! Best ride ever!!

Having only flown for the first time the week before this was the most amazing trip I've ever had. The flight was very smooth and the pilot very knowledgable about the canyon. If you're nervous about going in a helicopter, don't be it's great.

Wonderful morning flight which was just as well as thunderstorms in the afternoon!!
Knowledgeable (and skillful!) pilot gave interesting historical information as well as pointing out features.
If you have the time (50 mins), book a flight.
IT'S AWESOME!
Went on a weekend getaway and found this brochure at the Hotel,MAVERICK helicopter tours.WOW what polite and professional staff,our Pilot Vern was so knowledgeable of the area and formations

Super moment passé avec notre pilote Olsen, il nous a bien tout expliqué !
Super cool le mec  avec sa playlist oldschool dans l'hélico, j'ai vraiment apprécié !

Wonderful experience from beginning to end.  Thanks to Arnie for being a great ambassador for Maverick!  He took care of us in an royal way at the counter and the trip only got better and better.  Well worth your time and money.  We took the 9 am Canyon Spirit trip today.  The perfect way to see the vastness of this beautiful canyon.  The ride was very smooth with great visibility and good headphones to block the noise.  Easy to hear our great pilot, (his name escapes me, but it started with a B...).  Definitely the company to choose for a 5 star experience.

I booked this 45 minute helicopter ride thru Trip Advisor. This was the BEST thing we did at the Grand Canyon!! Our pilot was BJ. He was awesome!! He was very friendly, fun, and answered all our questions. When we first entered the canyon, it was breathtaking. Every second after that was just as breathtaking. I highly recommend Maverick Helicopters for your ride over the Grand Canyon!! And, we got a free t-shirt!! Thank you BJ for a trip of a lifetime!!! I can check that one off my bucket list!!

review_title: Best way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: We booked our helicopter tour thru Viator (they had a great deal). Our guide was super friendly and informative. He tells you about the different points in the Canyon and explains a bit about the Canyon. It's neat because one minute you're low to the ground and the next, the Canyon appears below you. After the tour is over and you return, they will take your picture with your camera (they use their camera before you take off). If you choose, you can purchase the photo they too (with or without the frame) and there's a DVD for purchase if your tour (you can hear the conversation in the chopper). We purchased the entire package so we can watch our tour over and over again.

So amazing. We did this with our children ages 11 and 12. So organized and punctual. The ride was smooth, our pilot Patrick was SUPER nice and fun and informative. The helicopers are very nice and you feel safe.

When we landed our kids said, can we do that again. Worth every penny.

review_title: Would not have missed this for the world
review_text: Our pilot BJ was brilliant and funny. The trip took us over the forest before taking us over the edge! The colours of the canyon were spectacular and ever changing. Good views of the Colorado River and you could see rafts running the rapids. Spectacular view of the North Rim and when we flew over the forest it opened up into open grassland where we saw herds of Bison just to cap off our trip.

review_title: Amazing experience and top notch service
review_text: We stopped at Maverick on our way to the Grand Canyon on the off chance they had some space for a trip that day. Lucky for us they did and the booking process was smooth and simple. Our pilot was BJ and he was absolutely brilliant. Putting us at ease before take off and giving us a brilliant commentary on the flight over the Grand Canyon. The flight itself is an amazing experience and by far the best way to see the Grand Canyon. The moment you fly over the south rim and see it below you is absolutely breath taking. Would definitely recommend Maverick Helicopters and thanks to BJ for a wonderful flight.

My husband and I did a Grand Canyon flight by plane many years ago and decided to go for the helicopter flight this time and we loved it!  We had a super friendly pilot and the moment you come over the ridge of the canyon is just 'wow'.  Our pilot offered to take photos of everyone in front of the helicopter after the flight.  We still bought the picture from Maverick as it was very good and is a wonderful memento of our trip.

I would definitely recommend this to anyone wanting to see the Grand Canyon.

Super souvenir ! Merci à Daniel d'avoir été un super pilote avec musique et anecdotes ! 

Je recommande à 100% !!!

Not cheap, but what a great experience. We went for the 45 minute flight over the canyon, which felt just about right. The whole set up from arrival onwards was very professional, whilst our pilot was friendly and knowledgeable.

arrived for our prebooked early flight and were surprised at the high quality buildings and professionalism of the staff...very helpful ground personnel...pilot BJ friendly and pleasant and put on a great experience...made the difference between a good and great trip to GC

review_title: Fantastic flight over the Grand Canyon
review_text: Best way to really see and appreciate the enormity and varied landscapes within the canyon and around its rim. The pilot we had, Sean was fantastic. He was a trained pilot prior to serving in the Army and told us what to expect technically and also gave us great information about the sights we were seeing from the air. The flight was one of the highlights of our vacation. Maverick is a very professional outfit!

Le survol du Grand Canyon en hélicoptère... On en avait tant rêvé ! Il n'avait pas été possible lors de notre 1ère visite il y a 6 ans suite au mauvais temps. Quelle déception ! Cette fois, c'était la bonne ! C'est une expérience à faire une fois dans sa vie. Et pour être sûr de ne rien regretter, il faut casser sa tirelire et s'offrir le long survol (environ 50mn) : un quart d'heure au dessus de la Kaibab National Forest... et puis soudain, le Grand Canyon se présente à vous ; c'est le meilleur moment ; et avec le tour de 50mn, vous y aurez droit 2 fois ; car vous survolerez de nouveau un peu la forêt, mais sur l'autre rive cette fois, puis de nouveau le trou béant du Grand Canyon !! Génial !
Le survol en hélicoptère permet de découvrir le Grand Canyon autrement et de prendre la mesure de son immensité.
Maverick Helicopters est une compagnie très sérieuse. Notre pilote, Sean, était vraiment très sympa et nous a donné plein d'infos tout le long du vol. C'était TOP !

Wat een belevenis!! Vanuit Nederland de vlucht naar de Nord en Zuid Rim geboekt. Helder e-mailverkeer. Vriendelijke piloot nam ons mee en vertelde geanimeerd over de Grand Canyon. Deze trip is zeker de moeite waard.

This is an absolute must if you are going to the Canyon.  Maverick Heliopters were outstanding and out pilot Matt was amazing.  We had Celine Dion played into our headsets as we descended into the Canyon.  Once on the ground we moved around and took photos and Matt became our personal pool boy who sprayed us with a mister as it was only about 90F down on the ground, very dry heat.  Wonderful cacti for photography and amazing landscapes.
If you are going to do a helicopter flight my suggestion is only do one that just keeps flying around.  Ours was 10min flight into the bottom of the canyon 300mtrs above the Colorado River and then 10 min back.  I would do 20-30 mins flying only as the photos on the ground are very much like the photos that you can take yourself around the rim of the canyon.
Maverick are the best!

review_title: Great way to experience the grand canyon
review_text:
We booked a helicopter tour over the grand canyon for a family of 4.
There are allot of choices but eventually I chose Maverick due to high number of positive reviews as well as that you can see the designated route of the tour in their website.
It was my son's birthday, and we wanted to have this tour as a special event for the family.
The tour was booked to 14:00 and we arrived at 13:15 as required.
Unfortunately during that day there was a lightning storm, which caused some of the flights to be canceled that day, including our 14:00 tour.
Maverick did the effort of trying to book us on the next tour at 15:15 which they eventually could get only 3 of us, on that tour rather the entire family, so my wife had to stay on ground.
Maverick did immediately refunded us, on 1 person, but it still affected our experience somewhat.
I have to state and acknowledge that the reason for the flight cancellation was safety, and the fact that Maverick takes this seriously is important!
The helicopter tour itself was great, with great views and we managed to get it right in a break of the storm, so we did manage to get good experience overall.

Bottom line, it I DO recommend this tour, but check the weather conditions, and perhaps the best is to call Maverick in the morning and check, especially on days with storms possibilities...

Via de website een vlucht geboekt. Onmiddellijk daarna werd telefonisch contact opgenomen om alles te checken. Ter plaatse werden we gewogen om het gewicht in de helicopters goed te verdelen. Piloot B.J. Was supervriendelijk en heeft ons professioneel over de geweldige Grand Canyon gevlogen. Super ervaring!

This is an absolute must do activity! Get a loan if you have to life is about memories and wow just amazing, our pilot was very friendly and informative, we got to sit in the front and it really is the only way to view and experience the Grand Canyon , you won't regret it

review_title: il modo migliore di godersi il Grand Canyon
review_text:
Vero, l'esperienza non è per niente regalata, ma la considero un vero must si si vuol vedere il Grand Canyon nel migliore dei modi. Nessun'altro punto di osservazione potrà mai competere con la vista dall'elicottero e questa compagnia si distingue per la puntualità, cortesia e bravura dei propri piloti, davvero prodighi di raccontare, in inglese, un sacco di aneddoti.
L'esperienza in sè è lunga (50 minuti circa) ed è comprensiva di un bel giro anche radente alla bellissima foresta che circonda tutta la zona (mai vista una foresta così estesa) e possibilità di ammirare branchi di animali allo stato selvatico (bisonti per esempio). L'arrivo al Grand Canyon è emozionante, quasi commovente.
A differenza di altre visite, più brevi, qua ogni tanto qualche piccola turbolenza si avvertiva. Ma non si ha mai la sensazione di pericolo.
Con un pò di precauzioni anche per un portatore di handicap motorio grave è possibile vivere questa esperienza che io personalmente considero un must se arrivate fino qua.

review_title: Best option to fly Grand Canyon
review_text: We did the canyon spirit tour from south rim. The building is easily accessible, you can see from the road. Traffic is light, so you can get there from rim in 10 minutes. We were lucky because we could sit on the front. This was my first helicopter ride. For me it was a bit neutral, no sharp movement, no any excitement. We were just very slowly hovering over the unexpectedly nice forest, than out to the canyon. The switch from rim to the deep was very exiting but over the canyon the distance is too big to feel the deepness and distances, for me it was a little bit like a painting down below. 50 min was long enough, I think 30 min would be too short. Overall I think to see a helicopter flying from close is more exiting than sitting inside :)

Fantastic experience! Absolutely loved it and well worth it. A perfect way to see the Grand Canyon, the abutting Kaibab Forest, and the Colorado River. Our guide, Tyler, was fantastic. Highly recommend!

review_title: Pro et efficace, bref un régal
review_text:
Survol du Grand Canyon grandiose. En 45 minutes, on a le temps de savourer. Sécurité maximum, accueil rapide. Pilote cool et pro.
On voudrait plus de sensations mais sécurité oblige ... c'est pas possible.
Un vrai plaisir et sans doute le meilleur moyen de visiter le Canyon

If you have never flown a helicopter before, this is the place to experience it! Okay it costs, but the experience is truly overwhelming. We felt super safe and well taken care of. Relatively new helicopters which can take up to 7 (ex pilot). During the flight our pilot talked us through the Canyon and presented us postcard pictures. 45 minutes of wow. Just a must do!

We took the 45 minute plane ride from Las Vegas - great pilot and smooth ride over to the Grand Canyon.  Then we took the 25 minute helicopter ride over the north rim - our pilot was BJ who was great, very funny and with great knowledge of the Canyon - my daughter and I were lucky enough to get the 2 front seats next to BJ so had fabulous, simply breathtaking views.  We would thoroughly recommend this fabulous tour - very well organised and worth the money.

This is expensive, but worth every penny. If you visit the Grand Canyon and can afford it, we recommend you do it. For us it was one, if not the, highlight on our extended US trip which brought us to places like New York, Yosemite, San Francisco etc. You get fantastic vistas of the Grand Canyon. For our kids the Heli ride was in itself an experience they will long remember.  Maverick stands out as a provider. Security: we get the expression of a well run undertaking with very experienced pilots. Contrary to the local competition, they completely shut down helicopters between flights so that the helicopters can be refueled and briefly checked and the pilots can take a short break from flying. We find this is a great plus for security. Entertainment: Our pilot was motivated and contributed a lot to the overall experience. In flight we could talk and ask questions over the inflight system. We even saw some Bisons on the ground over at the north rim during flight.

Nunca había subido a un helicóptero y la experiencia es totalmente recomendable.
El mejor momento es cuando acaba el bosque y te encuentras volando sobre una de las maravillas de la naturaleza.
Es una excursión cara pero creo que lo vale.

review_title: You will later regret if you do not do this
review_text: I booked this helicopter ride directly Tripadvisor after having a few online chats with Maverick Helicopter. I think it may have been slightly cheaper through TripAdvisor (which went through a company called Viator). I got a confirmation of my 10:00am flight time, but later that evening (7 hrs later), I got an email from Viator saying that time was booked and I had to be moved to 11:30am. I was a little annoyed at this. I am not sure if Viator held my purchase for a while before passing it on to Maverick and the slot got filled in the meantime, or a larger group came in and they decided to bump me to accommodate the bigger group. I called Maverick directly saying this was a big inconvenience because I was only at the GC for two days and changing my time impacted  the other activities I had planned on my brief stay. Maverick was very understanding and said they would be able to work me in and I could keep my desired 10am slot. The flight was very, very smooth. Not one ounce of turbulence. If you had your eyes closed the whole time you would hardly be able to tell you left the ground. Our helicopter seated eight people including the pilot. Four seats up front, four in the back. They weigh each person when you check in and the computer balances out the copter. So, me and my oldest son were in the back middle, while my two younger/smaller sons had outside window views. I still had a perfect view from where I was sitting. When you take pictures from the middle you sometimes have to be careful how you aim the camera if you don't want part of the helicopter in the pic, but it's not a big issue. It did start raining while we were up, but after a minute or so it cleared up perfectly.Nice music plays gently in the background (mainly to add ambiance to the DVD should you purchase the in-flight recording), and with your headsets you can hear the pilot and talk to other people on the helicopter. The flight time was perfect and quite sufficient. I really felt I got my money's worth. The lobby of the facility is a very nice place to wait while you are awaiting your scheduled flight. I have no regrets and I know I have created an unforgettable family memory. I did the flight on 7-21-2017.

vol en hélicoptère de 45 minutes. Passage au-dessus de la forêt nationale Kaibab et ensuite survol du Grand Canyon où la vue est incroyable.
Conforme à la présentation de l'activité.

review_title: The son says it was DOPE
review_text: booked this in England so only went on trip advisors comments and was pleasantly surprised.
