Nice welcome when we booked in,  just a warning, they weigh you! !, pilot calls out your name when its time to board.   The pilot gave a good safety talk and told us where to sit,  you may not be next to your family as weight is distributed.  Pilot, Alex, gave us some brilliant information about the area and was obviously knowledgeable about the canyon,  the ride was smooth.  A WOW from us all.

We are so glad we toured the Grand Canyon with Maverick.  They were very professional.  Our pilot, Tyler, was awesome.  The whole experience from check-in, pictures, tour, etc. was just first class.  Note: I can't speak to being in the back row, middle seat but it sure seems like it would be a good view no matter what.

Magnifique journée avec survol du grand canyon en famille.
Excellente accueil avec bonne prise en charge des clients de la part de Maverick.
Les hélicoptères sont prévus pour 6 passagers + le pilote ( 2 devant et 4 derrière) et sont très confortables ( climatisation ).
Pendant le vol, une douce musique qui sort de votre casque vous accompagne.
Nous avions pris le vol qui dure 45 mn. 30 mn sont destinées au survol du GC.
Le matin est conseillé pour éviter les orages de l'après midi.
Compter 300$ par personne
À faire sans modération. Moment inoubliable.

This is expensive but it is really quite an experience.  We were very fortunate in being allocated to 2 of the 3 front seats and therefore got unrestricted views.  It was my first time in a helicopter so it was somewhat unnerving being buffeted about in a fairly strong wind, but any apprehension was soon forgotten when we first flew over the rim and could get a all round perspective of the sheer scale of the canyon. 

The pilot was very chatty and informative and we spent an enthralling 45 minutes looking down over where the Little Colarado joins the main river then up to and over the Noth Rim before crossing back over the South Rim close to Hermit's rest.  A wonderful experience and highly recommended.

Maybe the best for heli trips around the grand canyon
Good pilot and well maintained and clean heli s

My wife and I took a 45-minute morning tour from Tusayan airport.  The weather was perfect: sunny, clear blue sky, and no wind.  It was a fantastic trip.  Our pilot put my apprehensive wife at ease by making her his "co-pilot" and having her sit next to him.  He hovered to allow us to take pictures and videos from several different angles and provided an educational narrative about the canyon.  He had a great background music track and answered questions while in flight.  This was the high point of a 24-day road trip that covered four Western states and took us into British Columbia.  Initially hesitant to take the flight, my wife hasn't stopped telling friends and family how great it was.

Via chat met Maverick een helitocht geboekt.
Super service!!
Bel een dag ervoor, wij hebben geen standaard vluchten.
Onze piloot Sean was goed, gaf op alle vragen een goed antwoord, verklaarde wat we zagen en was trots op de zero problem status van zijn werkgever. Er wordt enorm veel aandacht besteed aan het onderhoud van de heli's.
Een dikke vette aanrader!

Een puntje van aandacht de eenvoudige shop Vwb eren en drinken. Je hangt er toch een uur van te voren rond en behalve veel drank is er niet veel eetbaars te vinden.

Het is best even een aanslag op je budget voor een gezin met 4 maar het was het geld meer dan waard. Het is goed georganiseerd en de vlucht boven de Grand Canyon is overweldigend. We hadden een leuke piloot die veel vertelde tijdens de vlucht. Wat wel een heel groot nadeel is als je niet voorin zit of bij een raam zoals ik. Ik werd achterin midden ingedeeld en heb geluk dat ik lang ben anders zie je zeer weinig. Als ik dat van te voren had geweten had ik alleen gegaan met garantie van plek voorin of bij raam. Je wordt op gewicht ingedeeld en dat had ik graag geweten. MIjn vrouw en 2 kids hadden plek voorin en bij raam en die hebben genoten. Ik ook maar toch beetje jammer van het dure geld.
Our pilot, B.J. was amazing!! He was so nice. My grandmother, Kathy, was scared. B.J. was so comforting to her. He was so funny and knew a lot about the Grand Canyon.

This company has a high safety rating and customer ratings.  I was afraid to go on the helicopter tour, because I know the area has air streams that are tricky to negotiate.  The pilots are very experienced, all have years of experience--that's one reason we vise this company.  Also the helicopters are in good shape,they appear new and are reportedly thoroughly checked Checked.  Our pilot, BJ, was very friendly, knowledgeable and empathetical.  He was also humorous we really enjoyed our tour!!!!  I highly recommend Maverick Tour through Grand Canyon!

Man ist wirklich 45-50 Minuten geflogen! Pilot war gut und war auch sehr persönlich zu den Gästen. 
Route war 30 Minuten genau über dem Grand Canyon an jeder Seite! Fenster für alle Fliegenden :) 

Ein Muss für jeden Besucher! :)

De Grand Canyon bekijken vanuit een helikopter, dat is een ervaring die ik niet had willen missen. Het moment dat tijdens het vliegen het bos onder je wegvalt en je ineens de Canyon ziet is adembenemend, bijna emotioneel. Vervolgens maak je een mooie ronde over de Grand Canyon waarbij de piloot vertelt over wat we zien. Het is niet goedkoop, maar echt een bijzondere aanrader (45 minuten vlucht).
Excellente promenade en Helicopter au dessus du Grand canyon. souvenir memorable, et pour une premiere nous avons tous adoré. Je recommande absolument.

We hadden een rondvlucht van 45 minuten. Gewoonweg geweldig. Wat is dit mooi en groot. Echt overdonderend. 
We hadden een toppiloot IN die ons ook nog e.e.a.  vertelde.
Nu heggen pas echt de GRAND CANYON gezien🖒🖒🖒🖒

Was in the GC area for a few days on a cross country trip and obviously figured I had to do a helicopter ride. There are several tour companies that provide this, but Maverick came up consistently as the best. 

The views are spectacular and I'm glad I did it. The pilot did a great job and had good information about the canyon and areas we flew over which was nice. My enjoyment took a small hit due to the weather. The day of my ride was overcast and very windy. I was informed we may not even be able to fly. After a 10-15 minute wait they decided it was safe. I've never been on a helicopter so I do not know what the norm is, but it seemed pretty bumpy. 

Customer service at all points was friendly and solid. They made it very clear that safety was number one priority and kept everyone informed. They may be pricier than some of the other services, but personally I don't feel a helicopter ride into a massive, dangerous canyon is the time to be a penny pincher. Their helicopters are nicer and newer than most I saw at the other companies.

review_title: GO TO OTHER COMPANIES TO SAVE SOME $$
review_text:
GO TO OTHER COMPANIES TO SAVE SOME $$ 
I had really short time in GC and I wanted to see the view from above. This company is the first when you turn to the GC airport. So I asked what are their prices and whether there were any other companies. They lied straight to my face and told they are the only one for heli tours. They have wifi but it does not work (probably intentional)  and you don't have cell network in GC. Because of my limited time, I had to took it, but from the starting I felt there was something wrong. So I drove around the airport and discovered that one company does the very same tour $ 10 cheaper and another one does $50 cheaper with kinda old heli models, which I would do it certainly that since I was on a budget. After that I went back and faced with them, of course they didn't admitted that they misguided me and refund, at the end of the day I'm there for only once and they thought they could get me. But guess what, this is digital age, you can share your experience with people ;) So GO TO OTHER COMPANIES TO SAVE SOME $$ and probably a decent customer experience.

Excellent! Wonderful experience definitely worth the price.
Staff and pilot very friendly and knowledgeable.
Best way to see the Canyon.

review_title: Helicopter flight over the Grand Canyon
review_text: Highly recommended, new helicopter, really clean and comfortable, air-conditioned. Good vision and adequate window access to take lots of great photos. Our pilot kept it smooth and gave an informative commentary as we flew. Even my wife enjoyed the flight and she is a normally a nervous flyer. Expensive but well worth it, good value.

review_title: Breathtaking tour and view of the Grand Canyon
review_text: The whole process of making the reservations with Maverick was wonderful - multiple chats, emails, and calls - all were very well handled and helpful. The check-in was very smooth and efficient with nice representatives. The pilots (we had to take two helicopters for our group) were very nice and professional. The helicopters appeared brand new, and functioned flawlessly. Everything in the interaction with Maverick was great. The flight itself? Beyond words in every way! The flight above the trees of the forest and then to come flying out over the rim of the Grand Canyon was breathtaking! The vistas, the grandeur, the beauty - it was like seeing the Grand Canyon for the first time again and left us breathless. From start to finish, the whole experience was wonderful and seeing the Grand Canyon from the air was a once in a lifetime opportunity.
Breathtaking view from the helicopter it was worth the price. Our pilot JC had so much information about the Grand Canyon a great tour guide in the sky.

Wow just wow , look no further this is the company you e been looking for ! absolutely amazing and so glad we took the opportunity to do it and especially with Maverick, exceptional service with a call the previous day to adjust our flight time due to booking numbers but we arrived early and some people came along bespoke so still managed our original time flight, with no fuss or delay. 

We took the 45 min trip and was simply breathtaking , informative smooth flight, considering I'm afraid of heights I'd never let that get in the way of such an experience. We researched other options which meant the west rim but we wanted to view the canyon at the best spot the south rim so well worth the road trip. 

Thankyou so much Maverick and to all those looking , book now and enjoy the flight 
Matthew & Joanne UK

We rode with BJ for a 45 min tour of the Grand Canyon on July 4th.  It was me, my husband and our 10 yr old grandson.  It was Brady's first time in a helicopter so he was a little anxious.  BJ quickly put him at ease by telling jokes and chatting with him throughout the flight.  We all thoroughly enjoyed the experience from beginning to end.  We bought our photo AND the DVD of our flight.  We just watched our flight tonight and it was a memorable once in a lifetime experience.  100% worth the money.  Thanks BJ for the memories!

Our pilot John was excellent, while expensive $1495 for 5... it's an absolute must try. The views from above are breathtaking, you know what you are looking at but at the same time find it hard to comprehend 
My wife suffers from motion sickness, she took Dramamine and for the most part it worked

Nous avons fait un vol de 45 minutes à 8h du matin et ce n'était que du bonheur! Nous étions trois, mon mari, ma fille et moi-même, tous assis devant à côté du pilote qui était adorable! Des vues grandioses, des explications intéressantes, une expérience à faire ! C'est vrai que c'est cher, mais ça en vaut la peine. Nous avions déjà fait un survol en avion qui n'est pas mal, mais en hélico, c'est autre chose ! Très bon service chez Maverick, réponses rapides et claires lors de la réservation, très bon accueil le jour du vol, tout était impeccable!
First visit to Grand Canyon and first time on a helicopter. From the rim the GC is amazing, seeing it from a helicopter takes it to another level, literally!

review_title: A bit expensive, but how often do you get to the Grand Canyon?
review_text: Upon arriving at the South Rim with several hours before check-in, we decided to check out the helicopter rides over the Grand Canyon.  Wow…what an experience.  The Maverick helicopters were clean, looked to be well maintained and the entire staff operated very efficiently.  We took the one hour ride (about $600 for two).  There is nothing like seeing the Grand Canyon from the air.  We were about 500 feet off the ground and suddenly 5500 feet off the ground, flying right over the canyon.  For some reason, our helicopter story resonates more than any other story we tell about our three week Southwest trip.  A bit expensive, but how often do you get to the Grand Canyon?

review_title: Just do it! Grand Canyon South Rim Canyon Spirit Tour
review_text:
From our check in with Lisa to our service from Arnie to our pilot Sean, this was a first class experience. Words cannot describe the awe of seeing the Grand Canyon from a helicopter. Your first 10 minutes will be flying over the Kaibab forest but when you reach the edge of the canyon and fly over it, it leaves you speechless....well I think I said "Oh my god!"
The flight is so smooth and breathtaking, and I hate heights, but I never felt nervous at all. Sean is a former Blackhawk pilot so we knew we were in good hands. It is a good long flight and worth every penny. It is something you have to experience once in your life and I can't say enough good things about Maverick. Arnie made a fantastic day amazing!

review_title: Birds Eye view of the Grand Canyon
review_text: Have you ever wished you could fly?  To see what it looked like from above.  I know most people have flown in passenger jets.  A few in helicopters or fixed wing aircraft. But over the Grand Canyon.  There is not a better way to experience the 277 mile circumference of the GC than on a Maverick Helicopter. I read the reviews of a few that were not trilled with the position they had in the air craft, and I get that.  I was fortune to have a window seat behind the pilot and my wife and two older teenagers had the front seats looking out over the ride the entire trip.  I would say the helicopter is the only way to really enjoy and see the canyon.  We had a 2:00 Flight.   It was really nice.  I understand the early morning or late evening is best but 2:00 was not disappointing.  It's expensive but if you are going to take the time and expense to go plan on taking the copter ride you will not be disappointed.   And I must give our pilot, B.J. credit for a fun,  informative, and safe ride.  He was great and made the passengers very comfortable.   I'm sure all the pilots are great.  B.J. was super!!

Absolutely brilliant.  This was a special treat for our Silver Wedding anniversary.  Very informative, comfortable, very expert pilot "B J" was the best. Highly recommended if you want a better perspective of the Grand Canyon.  Thanks again B J.
Steve & Lynda

We had Alex as our pilot. He was very good. Check in fellow was not as friendly. Acted as if my booking through a "third party=trip advisor" made my business less valuable to them. If you don't want third party bookings don't make the deal. Anyway, flight was good.  Helicopter had a lot of vibration that was a little disconcerting. Views were beautiful. Would recommend.

review_title: A wow eperience for my wife...
review_text: The intention to do it was 6 months ago, however the booking was made only a few days ahead. The previous few days of bad weather incorporated snow, and it appears that may have put on extra flights at 8 AM. There were 5 helicopters flying out at that time! The skies were blue without a cloud. Although I am quite light, I got the rear window seat, however my wife had the most amazing experience of her life being on the opposite side of the pilot, the best seat in the “house”, window in front and below. This was the 45-50 minute Spirit flight, with ample time to take in the canyon and photographs, avoiding the no-fly zone across the main part of the canyon, going east, then across to the north rim, and then crossing back to the south beyond Hermit’s rest. The commentary could have been better avoiding cheesy jokes.

We were picked up from our hotel as planned and driven to the airport. The weather was cold and some people had to buy extra clothing so ...... be prepared for any weather as we had left sunshine in Las Vegas!  The flight there was in a 16 seater plane. We landed and were transported in a bus to 2 different sights with instructions where to go to see the best views. Michael, our tour guide was great and said he was the best!  The views were spectacular and like paintings (almost unreal!)  The flight back was very bumpy as it was extremely windy - all the helicopters had been grounded. What an experience! Very professional company.

Organisation parfaite: accueil, preparation du vol.
Hélicoptère EC 130 avec 8 passagers. Bien sur il vaut mieux Peter devant mais les places sont imposées pour des raisons de centrage. L'ordinateur a mis les belles billes à coté du pilote, il doit y avoir de l'intelligence artificielle...
Le vol est fantastique avec de très bonne explications du pilote. Il nous montre de nombreuses particularités du Canyon.
Le pilote est là pour vous faire plaisir. La durée est suffisante
C'est unique et n'hésitez pas à vous l'offrir .

Seeing the Grand Canyon from the rim is awesome enough, but flying over it adds another dimension. 25 minutes for $245, but worth it to see the folds and colours of the rocks in the morning light. Our pilot was very pleasant, putting a nervous passenger at ease, and informative but never intrusive. A 'once in a lifetime' experience indeed. Do it if you can.

Went on the Maverick 45 minute Helicopter Tour over the North, South, East Rim of the Grand Canyon. The pilot was professional and knew a lot about the area, which was very impressive. I would highly recommend this guide service because as a pilot myself, you can't past up this professionalism!
Booked the flight as a birthday treat for a 70 year old. From the minute we arrived staff were great. A fantastic way to view the canyon and get some idea of how huge and stunning it is.

Must-Do-Experience.
284$ are worth every single cent. 
Pilot (and Entertainer) BJ greatly added to this amazing experience in his own right...still musing about Olaf jokes and his hiking shoes...
Great helis too as compared with other tour provider. 
A once in a lifetime one you shouldn't miss out next time😉.

review_title: Full potential of flight spoiled on Maverick Helicopter
review_text: Some adventures are a once in a lifetime experience. This is true of our helicopter tour of the Grand Canyon. Unfortunately, we were randomly placed with a pilot whose playlist for background music was abrasive and, in light of the spiritual/sacred area, was offensive. Each pilot at Maverick chooses his/her own music. Ours chose heavy metal which blasted into our headphones. We could adjust the volume, but not the content even after mentioning the inappropriate nature of the sound track to the pilot. The only relief from the loud guitar twanging and drum beating came from Huey Lewis and the News. Really?  Huey Lewis while soaring above the Grand Canyon? Four of the six passengers were retired seniors. Why this music? The gift shops at the Canyon sell CDs of native music. I would like to suggest to Maverick , because music heightens or detracts from all experiences, that they use something more Zen-like as background. We saw the IMAX movie, Secrets of the Grand Canyon, excellent! The soundtrack provided appropriate emotional layering while viewing the vastness of the canyon in the IMAX setting. We highly recommend the helicopter tour of the canyon; it is something which defies description. Don't let the cost keep you from the experience. However, if you like a total experience, check your Maverick pilot's play list or work with a company (there are several) who understand the spirituality of our native people and do not insult it. No one at Maverick seemed interested in fielding our concern which was hugely disappointing. Please don't let this review keep you from the helicopter tour. Do it! But choose the company or pilot that will give you a total experience, not just incredible views of the canyon.

We took the 45 minute tour.  SO awesome.  Splurge for this one.  Arnie checked us in.  He was super friendly and great to talk with.  Alex was our pilot.  He was a great tour guide.   There are no words for how incredible this ride is.  Find a way to afford it.

review_title: 2nd time for myself/ 1st for my adult daughter
review_text:
Went on the Canyon Spirit tour.. my daughter was in a good spot, got great pics & enjoyed every minute!! 
This was my second time with Maverick & I was a bit disappointed... the mikes on our headsets weren't working & the pilot got in, decided it was too warm & blasted the air con... I was not dressed for 50 mins of freezing air blowing on me & when asked if it could be adjusted, we had no reply.. I was also subjected to 50 mins of country music.. I don't hate country music, but it was loud, twangy & there was no choice given, headphones had to stay on. I enjoyed the actual flight & scenery, but was happy to get back, get warm & give my non country ears a break! Lol.

We did the helicopter ride over the canyon with Maverick. I must say that for me this was my highlight of our travels for the past 4 weeks. I had not been in a helicopter before but once we were in the air it was awesome and that first view of the canyon was just awesome. You travel over the canyon before making your way back to the base. The views are just breathtaking. A must do.

We pre booked this months in advance as it is a once in a lifetime trip. When we checked in the service was second to non. All my questions were answered and we were told that due to strong wind our flight may be cancelled, you can't argue with nature. As luck had it we were able to fly and what an experience it was, I thoroughly enjoyed it my wife however is not the best of flying travellers was slightly ill. This was in no way any fault of the company or the pilot it was as said my wife not being a good flyer.
The views we got were spectacular much better than watching it on TV, the commentary by the pilot was very informative and he answered all of the questions asked.
All in all a very professional company offering a once in a lifetime trip.

review_title: Una experiencia que no se debe perder nadie!!!
review_text:
Le dí muchas vueltas por el tema del precio, sin embargo he de decir que ha merecido mucho la pena. No es una excursión barata pero os recomiendo que la hagáis. 
En nuestro caso hicimos avioneta desde Las Vegas al Cañón (te quitas unas cuantas horas de autobús y las vistas son espectaculares), después te montas en los autobuses que te llevan por los distintos puntos del parque nacional. Para terminar, la bajada en Helicóptero al fondo del cañón... Espectacular!!!! Si tenéis opción de elegir y no os dan miedo las alturas... asiento delantero!!! 
La vuelta igualmente en avioneta hasta las vegas. La empresa se ocupa de todo incluido los traslados (puerta a puerta del hotel).
Gran piloto el que nos tocó, que aunque hubo algo de turbulencias lo llevo muy bien. 
Sin duda volvería a repetir.
Schöner Rundflug über den Canyon, die Heli sind neuwertig und sehen gut gepflegt aus. Ein Rundflug ist beeindruckend.

From the initial contact and reservation through every detail of the preflight briefing and flight, the entire Maverick team was professional and friendly. My initial contact was via chat, where the operator suggested the type of flight that would best meet our needs and price. No pressure, totally knowledgeable and courteous from start to finish.

Their facility at the Grand Canyon Airport is recently renovated and spotless. The staff there is friendly and efficient. The flight was perfect, with great narration and the helicopter is designed so that everyone has a great view. The interior of the helicopter is heated and air conditioned, and each person has a comfortable headset, so the narration and conversation is clear.

Don't bother with lesser providers - this is the company to book with, you won't be sorry.

We booked the Canyon Spirit 45 minute trip with Maverick direct in advance, they were very helpful.
We were supposed to check in at the South Rim terminal 45 minutes prior to departure. I got delayed slightly on the drive, so we called them on route and they were again very helpful.
The experience was awesome – well worth the cost. The pilot was very competent and provided a really good commentary. The flight was a bit bumpy but once in the Canyon all of the focus was on the amazing scenery. 
My wife and I got seat in the front of the helicopter and whilst my wife was nervous of being in a helicopter she absolutely loved the trip.

I am so please d that we made the effort to get to the South Rim rather than settling for a visit to the West Rim.

This was our first trip in a helicopter so we were a little anxious but the staff at Maverick were the best our pilot was Danny and he was very knowledgeable and the take off was so smooth it felt like we were riding on a cloud. then after a short trip over the forest we came over the east rim and it was breath taking. The hole trip lasted 47 minutes but what a great trip it was! We would highly recommend Maverick for a once in a life time flight over the Grand Canyon

La petite aérogare est nickel, le personnel compétent et aimable. Tout est fait pour mettre le passager à l'aise avec des consignes claires et paisibles. L'hélicoptère semble juste sorti de son emballage tellement il est bichonné. Le confort à bord est impeccable et les casques filtrent bien le bruit des hélices. Et le spectacle qui se déroule sous les yeux est juste IMPRESSIONNANT !

review_title: You HAVE to take a tour!
review_text: The entire staff is kind and gentle with visitors.  They all WANT you to have a safe and memorable flight.  Safety is first ... you have to listen and cooperate ... which they make easy.  The seating is by weight so they can balance the helicopter.  Our pilot was Luke ... who played gentle music in the background ... and taught us as we flew.  I am afraid of heights ... but this did not bother me at all.  The sights you see from above are even more amazing than standing on the rim of the canyon.  You can purchase a DVD of YOUR flight when you are done, but it is not pressured purchases.  You just HAVE to do this!

A well organized experience, from booking through to disseminating.. Everything ran to time. Our pilot was knowledgeable, enthusiastic. He made sure everyone had the best photo opportunities. We were made to feel this experience was just for us.

This is a bucket list experience and should not be missed.   Day Tour from Phoenix.  The driver on the bus was so knowledgeable, learned so much and he had a great sense of humor.  Photo stops on the way. the lunch which was picked up in Sedona was very tasty.  The 50 Minute helicopter ride over the Grand Canyon was breath taking.  
The pilot professional and answered everyone's questions without​ hesitation. 
This experience was worth every penny.

Our pilot was so nice and accommodating to us and my elderly mother who requires a little assistance moving in and out of spaces. The flight was spectacular. Great lobby waiting area. Highly recommend this company, they deliver.

I have one thing to say JUST DO IT! I was pondering over the cost and whether it was worth it, but when you start on the journey up in the air and fly over the forests before getting to the edge... Wow, getting over that edge... Simply breathtaking!! A moment I will never forget. A stunning view of the canyon from a completely different view point and perspective. Don't let anyone tell you it's the same experience on the ground! Get up in a chopper if you can. The pilot was very kind and good humoured.

review_title: Canyon Dream Tour - Worth Every Penny!
review_text:
We took the Canyon Dream tour from the Vegas Strip offered by Maverick Airlines. We were picked up on time at our hotel by a courteous driver. After a stop or two to collect other passengers, we made the short drive to Henderson Executive airport. There we waited a short time before check-in. There was a snack bar and gift shop available at the terminal. 

We were greeted by our friendly pilots who doubled (tripled?) as knowledgeable tour guides and  expert photographers. Plenty of photo opportunities on this tour! There was also a professional photographer who got a great family shot of us which we purchased after the trip.

The plane flight was approximately 45 min in each direction. The plane was comfortable and offered a great perspective of the landscape below. It was a treat to move around the cabin mid-flight, Our teens enjoyed visiting the cockpit for a front row view. 

The most thrilling portion of the trip was the 25 min helicopter flight over the canyon. This part is not to be missed! Our pilot Luke was amazing. There's not a bad seat in the house and the views are breathtaking.

The trolley ride was fun, our tour guide Bruce was polite, funny and offered interesting commentary. Your time on the ground is short but more than enough to appreciate the vastness and beauty of the canyon.  Even the boxed lunch was better than expected. 

If you are considering it, go for it. Worth every penny. It was the highlight of our trip!

We booked the trip on a Helicopter to the Grand Canyon also landing in the Canyon for 30 minutes. My wife wasn't sure of going by Helicopter thinking she wouldn't enjoy the Flight. eventually she agreed to go so we quickly booked the trip with a seller near the Paris Hotel. The lady was very pleasant and not pushy at all. Im sure we could have got the trip cheaper elsewhere, but I don't like the "flash" sellers that try and push you to get things you don't need. On the morning of the trip we were picked up outside the hotel by minibus. There were two other couples on the trip as well. The Driver of the bus was the only negative of the whole trip, quite rude and surly. We went to a small airfield near Henderson, the Maverick HQ. We had to weigh in which was very amusing and then had to wait about 40 minutes in the comfortable lounge for the flight. We then went to the Helicopter with the Pilot named Corbin. He was very pleasant and informative. My wife initially didn't want to sit in the front so he picked between the other two couples. We set off on the 40 minute flight to the Canyon and flew over Lake Mead and then into the Canyon where we landed and had a small picnic. My wife had thoroughly enjoyed the experience so Corbin arranged to get Gas in the middle of nowhere which enabled us to move seats around and we able to sit up front which was amazing. The driver on the way back to the Hotels was the polar opposite of the first driver, very chatty informative and dropped us wherever we wanted to go, a real asset to the company. Amazing experience well worth the money. YOU HAVE TO TRY IT

BJ pilot did a wonderful job. This was just an absolutely fabulous experience. You got a great aerial view of the area. He took us over the north rim and we saw a lot of the canyon you do not see on the south rim. The view from the helicopter is amazing.

review_title: Grand Canyon south rim or west rim?
review_text: On a recent trip to Las Vegas, our trip to the Grand Canyon was a must do! I did a bit of research and decided that the south rim was the ideal. Maverick had a trip that involved a short plane flight to the Grand Canyon airport where we were met by an outstanding bus driver Michael, who took us up through the national park to the lodges. This is where we were supplied a basket lunch and was able to walk along the path to the various scenic lookouts. The bus then took us back to airport and we boarded the helicopter which was piloted by Dan and we flew around the south rim and through the canyon for about 20 mins. Back to airport and on the plane bound for Las Vegas. Absolutely fantastic experience that was made more special by the 4 inches of snow that had fallen the day before we went. The staff at maverick were so professional, courteous and helpful that only made the trip more special.  Not cheap ( with the Aussie dollar convertion)  but Definitely worth every cent. Of course we were lucky to go since the two days prior had been cancelled because of the snow/weather, so maybe suggest that you book early in your stay so that if it is cancelled then there is the chance that you can go another day.

This company at least needs to train there employees to have some compassion or emotion for a helicopter ride that needs to be cancelled because of the weather (high winds).  Yes, I'm all for safety first (who isn't?) however maybe the big jerk behind the counter could have a bit more sympathy for those people with children that have booked this attraction 2 months out and maybe come to realize that this was to be the high-lite of there trip out West.  You don't simply need to yell out loud that we are cancelled for the day and see you later!!!  How about a bit more explanation.  Hey buddy... work on your delivery!   It really doesn't matter... it pretty obvious that this company doesn't get it.  Maybe you're the only helicopter service out there so you can have that pompous attitude!  Sorry, it's rude!!!!

My son and I took our first trip to the Grand Canyon for spring break and we were both excited to see the Canyon from a helicopter.  After reviewing all of the nearby helicopter tours, I selected Maverick (Spirit Tour) because of their professional image, emphasis on safety, and price.  We were not dissappointed, at all!  Booking was simple, no hidden fees, no gimmicks... everything as advertised.  Sean was our pilot... experienced former Army aviator who knew the landscape and kept the whole tour group entertained, informed, and engaged.  I asked for my son to sit up front and that request was granted... so just ask.  No guarantees due to having to balance the weight of the other passengers (safety).  They also offer a DVD of your tour as well as a commemorative plaque for purchase.  Great ride... we'd definitely do it again!

My kids and I were only going to be in the Grand Canyon for a short while and I wanted to make this part of the trip really special.  I agonized over the cost for weeks and then just did it.  

I'm so very glad that I did!

The entire operation is of the highest quality (which I want when I'm entrusting my children's lives to a helicopter tour).

The representative at the check in counter explained the helicopter maintenance process, in detail, to another customer while we were waiting.  The helicopters were either brand new or very young and meticulously cared for.

The flight was very smooth and our pilot was a true professional.  He remembered my daughter's name and said "Sarah you'll be getting a great view of this in just a second".

My kids are still talking about it days later.

They only give me 5 dots or I'd give these guys 6.  I won't post any of the hundreds of pictures we took because you need to see these views for yourself.  My photos won't do them justice!

Go for it!  You won't regret it!

Nous avons"visiter" le grand canyon avec cette compagnie. C'est tout simplement parfait, grandiose. Je n'est pas de mots pour décrire la beauté du site. 
Certes c'est un budget mais c'est un moment inoubliable

review_title: The best way to see the Grand Canyon is in a Helicopter with Maverick Helicopters
review_text:
In March 2017, we took the Colors and Canyon tour offered with Maverick Tours. It was an extremely long day (13 hours) as we were picked up by Detours (a company that provided the transportation from Scottsdale to the Grand Canyon and return). 

The helicopter portion of the day was 45 minutes long and we were able to see both the south and the north rims of this beautiful, breathtaking National Park. We were fortunate that the weather cooperated as it was bright and clear. 
I am envious of the pilots that get to see the Grand Canyon every day, no words will ever accurately describe the beauty of this place. 

It is expensive (around $500.00 per person) to combine the tour to the Grand Canyon and the helicopter ride but it is one that I would not have missed for any reason. Definitely a location that should be on your bucket list to see and do in your lifetime.

We have nothing but good things to say about this company,  from the very first call we felt we were in good hands. The place was immaculate, staff very informative and professional. Barclay our pilot was excellent, he had so much information and answered all of our questions, he also had a degree in Hydro Geology which helps when you're looking at the Canyon.
The helicopter holds 7 people in two rows plus the pilot, and on a sunny day can be very warm so keep that in mind as it's like flying in a green house, fortunately they have air-conditioning. It was about 60 degrees outside I was in Shorts and a long sleeved shirt and quite comfortable others in our party dressed in long pants, fleeces and hikers and were very warm. The best seat on the helicopter is the front row by the door but unfortunately you have no choice on seating because it's all done by weight and balance ( they weigh you when you get there including your camera and water, you can't bring anything else )  so they tell you where you will sit.
I would definitely recommend this company to anyone looking to fly over the Grand Canyon. My husband who flies for a major airline grilled them extensively on their safety record, training, maintenance, and safety briefings and was satisfied with their responses.

We paid for a 45-50 minute for our family and from the instructions to landing back on the pad was 27 mins. Not good, especially when you ask them about it and they get very defensive. Would recommend that you make them promise a full ride or refund it. Otherwise I would give my business to another tour company.

review_title: Maverick helicopter  tour of the Grand Canyon
review_text: If you are looking for an amazing experience and the best way to see the Grand Canyon book with Maverick.  Easy booking by phone. Courteous and efficient check-in process. Our pilot- Barclay was great. He provided enough commentary without being over the top. Jaw dropping!!!

If you are visiting the Grand Canyon, the only way to take in it's full majesty is to do it by Helicopter. Maverick Helicopter were fantastic. You must take a flight with them, well worth the cost.
Booked from the UK whichI think is the cheaper option.
Totally agree with all the glowing comments on previous reviews.

Drove from Las Vegas to be here for an 11am flight. Info before flight not great, ie  didn't know about the small coffee shop, roaring fires, at the airport.  Weather a bit iffy and we nearly didn't fly but in the end we did a shortened trip missing out the north ridge ($60 was reimbursed).  I love helicopters and this is probably the ultimate place to fly in one. Flying up to the edge and then suddenly.... WOW!  Our pilot was very experienced - ex-army, and very interesting.  Just the right amount of chat, without spoiling that awe inspiring moment.  Expensive at $538 for 2 with taxes, but once in a lifetime.  Still don't understand the whole American tipping thing. At that cost I want a 'free' photo, coffee while I wait.... Not to have to tip the pilot as well, but it's expected.

It may be a little steep for some but this trip is soooo worth the money!!!  It was awesome from start to finish!! The people here are so nice and accommodating!!  Our pilot was awesome and fun!!  He was an incredible tour guide!!  You can talk to each other while you are in the helicopter so you should ask questions!!  They have the answers! It was breathtaking and exhilarating!!   Best way to see the Grand Canyon!  These guys were awesome!!!

review_title: Fun for Families and Not Family Travelers
review_text: We have done a helicopter tour as a family before, but this was by far the best. From the start the check in was great. We got non-alcohol drinks at the waiting office. The ladies were happy to make chocolate milk for our child even though its not on the menu. The gentleman at check in (Brian) was so personable and friendly. Our pilot, Sean Beal, was awesome. I am sure all the pilots are great, but he rules. Its a great tour no matter your family status, and there weren't a lot of kids there, but everyone was very nice to our eight year old as well as us. We didn't think about it until later, but we should have tipped out pilot. Great views, all questions answered, very easy flight even for someone afraid of heights.

I am very frugal and normally would not spend this amount of money. My wife being both wise and beautiful convinced me to go. It was amazing!!! If the opportunity presents itself, get your wallet out and go. You will not be disappointed. Very good staff and pilot. If coming from Vegas beware the time changes crossing the state line. Thought we were an hour early and almost missed the reservation time.

Drove our rental car from Vegas. It is not so far away but a good portion of the drive was 25 to 45 miles per hour speed limiit so it took awhile. To us it was perfect because we could turn up the radio and be mesmerized by the beauty of it all.  We paid for the whole adventure because you had to (included helicopter ride, bus tour and lunch and trip to sky walk). It was around 200 a piece. We ended up only going on the helicopter ride ( just our personal preference) and it was AMAZING!  I wish I could remember our pilots name, he was so friendly  knowledge and just wonderful to fly with ( he had lived in Michigan for awhile if that helps)!  The flight was nothing short of spectacular. We will be returning for another flight.  Thank you Maverick for great service and a wonderful experience.

It is a great experience.  I took the 4 hour excursion and definitely was worth the extra cost. The pick up from the hotel was on time, there were 2 other stops and then to a small airport.  For me the awesome part was the landing In the canyon, 3500 feet below the rim and appreciate the unspoiled formations.  The pictures definitely look clearer than those taken in the helicopter.  The helicopter is "tight". We seat 4 in the front -including the pilot, and 4 in the back, shoulder to shoulder. I was in the front, next to the pilot, and those mountains do come close to you.  The seats are rotated on the way back, but fortunately for me, nobody wanted to move to the front on the way back.   Strongly recommended for curious nature lovers.

My wife and I drove up from Sedona, and this was one of the highlights of our trip to Arizona.  Maverick is extremely well run, and everyone there was great.  It was easy to check in, the helicopter (seats 6) left on time, and our pilot was great.  Flying directly over various parts of the Grand Canyon was amazing.  The helicopter hovers throughout different parts of the Canyon, which gave us great opportunities to take multiple pictures.  Loved every part of the experience.

review_title: One of the best days of our holiday!
review_text: We booked our flight from the UK the whole process was easy. We arrived at the heliport on a fantastic blue sky morning. The check in process was seamless, the staff friendly and informative. We were lucky enough to sit at the front of the helicopter with the pilot and had the best views ever. The trip was amazing, interesting and everything that we had hoped it would be. My husband is not the best traveller but he was put at ease and thoroughly enjoyed his flight. It was very expensive but worth every penny and we would not have missed it and would recommend it to everyone.

review_title: The first time Awesome was correctly used in USA
review_text: This was a great experience; professional pilot, doubling as tour guide, amazing seats (felt like I might be asked to fly!) the views of the canyon were just breathtaking, Its not a cheap attraction, but ask yourself if you will be here again and will you regret not doing it.

Wir haben aufgrund des hohen Preises gezögert, den eigentlich schon lange vorher geplanten Helikopter-Flug über den Grand Canyon tatsächlich zu buchen. Zum Glück haben wir uns dann doch dafür entschieden und es keine Sekunde bereut! Ein einmaliges Erlebnis - alles lief sehr professionell ab, unser Pilot war sehr nett und bemüht und die Ausblicke über den Canyon atemberaubend. Klare Empfehlung!

review_title: Viaje a Grand Canyon en helicóptero
review_text: Excelente experiencia. Es maravillosa la sensación al entrar al gran cañón en helicóptero. Se ve majestuoso.

review_title: The BEST way to see the Grand Canyon!
review_text: Maverick Helicopter Tours were top notch all the way! It was a magnificent way to see the Grand Canyon and all its glory! Our pilot BJ was fantastic and had a great song playlist! Our kids enjoyed the experience and it will be something I won't soon forget. Definitely in the top ten experiences of my life! Ground staff was friendly and accomodating to our large group. Thank you Maverick Helicopter Tours!
I would highly recommend a helicopter ride over the Grand Canyon, it was worth every penny. Breathtaking views and brilliant staff.

A perfect way to have the Grand Canyon and all its awe inspiring beauty burst into your life.The is very well run organisation with excellent equipment and personnel. It delights the tourist. We returned to earth overwhelmed with the whole deal. Well done the Mavericks on ground and in the air.

review_title: Yes, it's expensive, but it's totally worth it
review_text: Listen, you come to the Grand Canyon how often?  Splurge and do this.  It is totally worth it.  Great captain and had an amazing time.  The views are irreplaceable.  We did the 45 minute trip and it was full and awesome the whole time.  Buy the DVD of YOUR trip afterward too.  Really cool.  You'll never forget it.  My pre-teens loved it.  Especially the moment you cross over the rim.  Wow!

Préférez le vol de 45 min pour 300USD au petit circuit de 25 min pour 270$. ça vaut le prix. Magnifique survol. Hélicoptère confortable, vision excellente. Personnel sympathique qui prend le temps de regarder les prévisions météo pour choisir le meilleur créneau. Une formidable façon de revoir d'en haut les points de vue ou les randos vécues  en bas !! Hors saison, réservation la veille pour le lendemain.

Close to best western hotel.
Early morning beats the crowds and great for calmer air and great light for photos.
Our pilot was really knowledgeable about the Canyon and genuinely loved what he was doing.
A great experience all round from stepping into the reception to leaving. Worth getting the video of the flight (how many times will you fly over the Canyon)!
Did this as part of our road trip so bought as part of package.
Yes, it cost a bit but as one of those once in a lifetime experiences it had to be done.

Wir hatten einen fantastischen, angenehmen und kurzweiligen Flug mit dem sehr gut gelaunten und unterhaltsamen Piloten BJ inklusive passender Musik-Einspielung ins Intercom (also im Kopfhörer)

Die Längere Tour ist nur ein klein wenig teurer, aber dafür viel länger als die kürzere Tour.

Wir hatten uns schon vorher die verschiedenen Anbieter etwas angesehen und uns dann für Maverick entscheiden, was sich vor Ort auch als die richtige Wahl herausstellte. Ohne behaupten zu wollen, dass die anderen es schlecht machen, gibt sich Maverick m.E. noch ein klein wenig mehr Mühe und achtet noch ein klein wenig mehr auf einen sicheren Ablauf und Flug. So tankt Maverick z.B. (anders als andere) die Helis nicht bei laufendem Motor auf und die Passagiere steigen nur ein und aus, wenn die Rotorblätter komplett still stehen. Kleinigkeiten, die nicht viel ausmachen mögen und die einem wahrscheinlich kaum auffallen, wenn man sich nicht generell bissi mit Luftfahrt beschäftigt, m.E. aber ein wenig für die Abläufe und Gedanken im Hintergrund sprechen. Bei schlechtem Wetter und zu tief hängenden Wolken wird nicht geflogen (darf auch nicht, da Sichtflug und man ist immerhin auf über 1600m Höhe), bei zu viel Wind bleiben die Helis am Boden und dann wird auch nichts berechnet. Generell buchen die erst direkt vor dem Flug ab.

Maverick achtet schon darauf, dass der Kunde etwas für sein Geld bekommt und nicht mit gefüllter K…tüte aus dem Fluggerät aussteigt. Storno (bis 48h vorher) oder kurzfristige Verlegung sind kein Problem – wir hatten wegen durchziehendem Tiefdruck-Trog und vorhersehbar viel Wind zunächst storniert, sind dann aber einen Tag später doch geflogen und haben es ganz sicher nicht bereut.

Die Sitze in den geflogenen EC-130 Helis haben alle Sicht nach vorne, so dass man auch von den Mittelsitzen auf der Rückbank noch gut sehen kann. Fensterplätze sind natürlich besser. Die Sitzzuweisung erfolgt nach Computerberechnung gemäß optimaler Balance des Fluggerätes, d.h. man sitzt ggf. auch nicht nebeneinander, selbst wenn man zu zweit bucht

 

Ein einmaliges Erlebnis und auch den sicher nicht ganz geringen Preis wert. Für Maverick 100% Empfehlung

review_title: Best way to see the Canyon
review_text: Well organized and safe operation.  Incredible birdseye views with interesting commentary from our pilot, Luke.

A true bucket list adventure.   Everyone should have the opportunity to do this.  Maverick Air was amazing. The pilot flew smooth and was extremely knowledgeable about the canyon and surrounding area.   The helicopter was fairly new, in great shape, and well maintained.  The whole ground crew was very professional and left me feeling confident about flying with them.   Go early morning or late afternoon for most dramatic views and shadows in the canyon.

I really enjoyed this helicopter ride over the Grand Canyon, although if you are placed in the middle of the back row, you will not have a good view. You do not know what seat, nor do you get to seat yourself, since the seating is calculated depending on the weight of all riders to even the load. I sat luckily in the front so I had outstanding views.

We wanted to do a helicopter tour over the canyon while staying in the national park and were fortunate to get a spot without an advanced reservation.  Our pilot Luke was very knowledgeable about the canyon.  The copters seat 7 and assign seating to balance weight.  We were in the back but at most you look over one person.  Great views of the canyon.  Feels like your standing still due to the grandeur of the canyon.  45 minute ride for $299 per person but worth the splurge to experience the canyon in a different way.

We arrived relatively early after departing the Grand Canyon Village and the new airport was nice and quiet.
Our group was split into 2 and we made our way through weigh-in and safety briefing without any issues or delay.
Our pilot was Benton - very knowledgeable of the area and pointed out so much to us, not to mention being easy going and a great dj!  his choice of flying music was absolutely perfect!!
It has been snowing so the views were that bit more defined (in my opinion) and just stunning no matter which way you looked.  I'm not a good flyer but felt very safe and secure and wouldn't hesitate to do it all again!
Thank you for one of the most amazing experiences of my life - memories to treasure x

Just got back from spectacular helicopter tour with Felix as our pilot. He was very knowledgeable about the canyon, the helicopter,  and aviation in the area. Plus the music accompaniment was great! Sounds like Felix is heading to Maui for his next assignment - best of luck!

Our Pilot Danny was WONDERFUL.  He told us about everything we were seeing. He was friendly, knowledgable, made everyone comfortable, and played us some great tunes too! Seemed like he loved what he was doing which made our tour all that much more enjoyable. Our flight was smooth - I was worried I might get motion sickness but I was fine. We saw buffalo too! It was such an unbelievable way to see experience the Grand Canyon. I would do it again.

The views from the helicopter were absolutely amazing, and our pilot was very knowledgeable of the canyon. The only complaint I have is the woman who was helping his before we flew. She was extremely rude and might have seemed aggravated she had to work on a Sunday. She rudely told us we probably wouldn't fly because it was too windy. She was not very welcoming or friendly, which should be expected when some people have never flown before. I do not know the woman's name but she was a middle aged woman with very short brownish hair. We were there October 16 2016.

We took the Canyon Spirit tour, which leaves in the late afternoon and catches the sun's rays slanting into the Canyon. Helicopter tours are not cheap for most of us, but there is no doubt that it is a trip to remember. We flew in great weather, found the office check-in smooth and professional, and our pilot Danny was friendly and engaging and pointed out many a spectacular sight during our trip. 

I was sandwiched in the back without a direct window seat (they seat you appropriately to balance the aircraft), so I could not snap the kinds of pics I would have liked (though my partner had a window seat and was able to do so). Nevertheless, the trip reminded me of the original timbre of that over-used Americanism "awesome".

Make sure your cellphones/cameras are completely charged up. Mine ran out of juice toward the end of the 45-minute tour, as did another passenger's.

The entire flight is video-recorded (camera faces straight out the aircraft nose), and you can purchase a copy (complete with music and passenger "oohs" and ahhs") after the trip for about $40. Here is my only criticism of the tour. Not only do I think that $40 is gouging the customer, but I found the quality of the video to be quite low. Add to this that the lens had some kind of smear on it from beginning to end, and it shows up quite obviously in the final product. The current camera set up also does not compensate well for situations in which the canyon walls are in relative shadow compared to the sun's rays slanting over the canyon rim; this results in not being able to see much of anything in the final product for extended stretches. If you are taking the evening or morning tours, keep this in mind.

Overall, though, a fantastic experience and one I would happily repeat some day.

Awesome.  Simply awesome.  We rode over the Grand Canyon.  We were seated by weight distribution and I was lucky to be seated next to the pilot.  I was very scared before we took off and truthfully, it was a bit scary since I could see straight down the front window, but I am so glad I did this ride.  You cannot see how large the canyon is from the ground.  It was a 45 minute ride and was enough time to see much of the canyon.  The pilot gave us lots of information as we rode over the canyon.  We were given a talk before we took off to explain safety measures.  Very professional staff.  If you can afford it, I recommend this experience.  You will never forget it - I know I won't.

Fantastic!
The Grand Canyon is mind blowing sight but the helicopter ride take it to another level.
The team at Tusayan were brilliant and the pilot was friendly and knowledgeable while giving very interesting commentary during the flight. 
For anyone nervous of doing a flight, these guys make you feel very safe and flights are much smoother than many people expect.
Highly recommend these guys if you are thinking of taking a ride.

Felt very safe and an amazing experience over the Grand Canyon. Just the right length. I was concerned about being able to take photos but my seat in the back right was absolutely fine and my husband was happy in the middle back seat, so no complaints. However, I would have been unhappy in that seat. I looked at many reviews for this kind of detail which is why I feel it is important for me to say this today. I totally understand that safety has to come first but if you are going to take photos, this isn't a good seat. I imagine all operators have this problem. An excellent experience. Thank you.

The pilot was really informative and friendly. Made you feel really safe. Was great that you could ask questions during the flight and take photos after with the pilot and helicopter. Would highly recommend them

I have been to the Grand Canyon before and yet nothing prepares you each time for the sheer majesty of the views but this was the first time I had flown into the Canyon  ...  Expensive yes but worth every single penny for you are left with the most amazing memories to last a lifetime  ...  You absolutely HAVE to do this  ...  !!! Now I understand the true English meaning of  " awesome " not the over used American one

I've been to the Grand Canyon a couple of times in my life and it is awesome but the real icing on the cake is the helicopter ride. Nothing can compare to it. Maverick did a great job. They were very professional, friendly and knowledgeable. A bit pricey but, ohhh the memories!

review_title: Highlight of my Grand Canyon tour- US ROADTRIP 2016
review_text: I had the most amazing time, front row seat next to the efficient pilot Danny. I'm glad they seat you according to your weight it was brilliant! It was well worth every cent, a once in a lifetime experience it was magical, breathtaking eve. The ride was so smooth and I was so apprehensive at first but no sweat the motion is very soothing and calm. I highly recommend it.

Ein absolutes Muss am Grand Canyon. Professioneller Kontakt, am besten den Online-Chat nutzen, alle Fragen werden sehr gut beantwortet. 

Im Vergleich zur Konkurrenz gibt es keine bezahlte Garantie, um vorne sitzen zu können. Wir konnten den Wunsch aber vorher hinterlegen und für den Fall, dass dies sonst niemand macht und die Gewichtsverteilung dies zulässt, sitzt man dann vorne. Hat bestens geklappt. 

Wir hatten aus Gründen des Wetters den Flug sogar noch einen Tag vorher um 1-2 Stunden vorverlegen können. Wir wurden von Alex mit coolem Soundtrack über die Rims geflogen (das erste Rim bleibt allen in Erinnerung - ein toller Kick).

Trotz Wind war der Flug ruhig, der Heli sprang nicht, sondern die Piloten wissen den Wind gut mit der Flugbewegung auszugleichen. Ich bin da recht empfindlich und hatte keine Probleme.

Das Video vom Flug lohnt sich, da die Kamera unter dem Heli befestigt ist - das schlägt alle Aufnahmen vom Sitz aus, wenn auch die Auflösung und Farbtiefe des Videos besser sein könnten (DVD).

Maverick fliegt auch ausschließlich mit Eurocoptern im Vergleich zur meisten Konkurrenz. Die paar Dollar mehr haben sich echt gelohnt, wir haben das aber erst vor Ort mit Blick auf die Anbieter richtig verstanden, warum.

We were both very nervous but our pilot BJ was relaxed, friendly and knowledgeable. Nothing can prepare you for the majesty of the canyon - no words or photos can do it justice. This trip is worth every penny/cent, cannot recommend Maverick and BJ highly enough!

We did the 45 min flight over the Grand Canyon it was amazing. Drove to the airport but i noticed there were shuttle busses there. The flight took us over noth the north and south areas of the canyon and we also saw the colorado river amd rapids. The pilot provided information about the canyon and river which was interesting. We sat at the front so i took lots of photos and video. I booked through viator and got a good price. Very professionally run. I think you need to book in advance.

Un vol sympa avec un pilote à l'écoute
Plus globalement, personnel très sympa
Un photo souvenir top
et la possibilité de prendre des photos devant l'hélico à la fin du vol
Je recommande

Super survol du Grand Canyon : une très belle façon de découvrir les splendeurs du Grand Canyon. Vues magnifiques quelque soit la place dans l'hélicoptère, expérience magique pour tous : du pur bonheur.
Personnel à l'accueil sympa. Pilote donnant de nombreuses explications et se proposant à nous prendre en photos devant l'hélicoptère à la fin du survol.
Réservation à l'avance fortement conseillée, et confirmation du vol réalisée via le chat du site Internet de la compagnie : bien pratique.

Loved this tour.  It is so worth the money to see the Grand Canyon this way.  The flight is only about 40 minutes and the ride in the helicopter is just amazing.   Everything ran very smoothly.  You even get lunch.  We did the early tour so there were no crowds and it wasn't terribly hot.  I would highly recommend this tour.

review_title: Wow! What a way to see the Grand Canyon!
review_text: We booked Maverick Helicopters as a result of looking at other people's comments. So glad we did as they were fantastic. What a professional set up from the reception through to our pilot, everything was so professional. The helicopter ride was amazing with excellent visibility as the windows were large. Breathtaking views. So pleased we booked with them.

We did the most complete flight through the South Rim Grand Canyon, the 45 min. It's really great, with soundtrack and all!!! Just perfect! It's breath taking when you flight over the trees and, suddenly, you're flighting over the canyon!!!

I know it's expensive, but take the longest helicopter ride you can afford.  It's well worth the money to see the astonishing canyon views from the air.  A really wonderful experience & highly recommended.

I'd spent the day hiking in the Grand Canyon and topped an already fantastic day off with a helicopter ride over / through the Grand Canyon With Maverick Helicopters.

We had pre-booked the trip and when we arrived they were unsure if we'd be able to fly because of the weather - we could see the storms in the distance.  After about 20 minutes we were told the storm was heading in the opposite direction and we could fly - it was pretty obvious that our safety was paramount.

Our Pilot was BJ and he was great - very friendly, informative and good fun.

The Grand Canyon is mesmerizingly beautiful and huge from the ground but flying over it gives another fabulous perspective.

The helicopter ride isn't particularly cheap but is well worth it - will you ever come to Grand Canyon again??  Go on treat yourself!

Impresionante las vista desde el aire, yo iba con mi mujer que creía que le daría miedo, el vuelo es comercial y tranquilo nada de Top Gun, no te lo pierdas, son serios y todo en horario y perfecto según anuncian. Fácil de localizar en Tusayan.

review_title: Helicopter trip over the grand canyon
review_text: Absolutely excellent trip. ! Our guide was great and gave a load of information during the ride. Some of our party had used papillon before and they said this trip was better. Everything was done to make us feel comfortable and safe. Definitely something to do, but maybe worth booking in advance.

review_title: de los 30 publicidados son solo 10 de vuelo....
review_text: "viaje de 30 minutos"....estos se traducen en 5 de ida , hasta descender cerca del rio colorado, 20 de descando del piloto( el cual aprovecho para almorzar....) y luego los siguientes 5 minutos restantes que conforman los 20 de "vuelo" ofrecido. El lugar lo vale, claro esta !!. Pero tomando en cuenta que al precio del tour hay que pagar $47 por el ingreso a territorio Navajo ( como un impuesto propio) La averdad se hace demasiado caro. NO LO JUSTIFICA. Publicidad engañosa en el primier mundo !!

The GCNP is amazingly breathtaking. You can spend hours just taking it all in. Every angle from every scenic overlook is priceless. This helicopter tour puts you right in it all. You cannot truly grasp the enormity, the beauty etc. any other way. This tour only covers part of the canyon that's how massive it is! There were six of us including the pilot. We all had excellent views we did not miss a thing!! The pilot was very informative and made sure we were always comfortable. The best money we ever spent!!  Now we look forward to seeing many other places this way!! Btw, I have anxiety, panic attacks and I was fine! I took anothers travelers tip...YOLO! Even on windy day, slightly bumpy, the serenity of the canyon puts you at ease. A MUST DO for everyone, an unforgettable experience!

What a fantastic way to see the Grand Canyon! A 45 min flight with BJ (Maverick helicopters), over the forest then a breathtaking arrival over the canyon. Very informative and some lovely views.  We followed this with a 25 mile bike ride along the south rim.  Both trips are a must do when you visit the Grand Canyon.

So, this was a fun and amazing adventure!! The pilot was nice and informative. 

So, I booked a 45 minute tour for my father and I. The day we we t our 45 minute tour was bumped to a 25 minute tour, because clouds were obscuring some of the view. What I don't understaffed is why they could not just take more time over the portion we did fly over or fly it twice instead of bumping 20 minutes and only refunding $30.00. So, that's my only complaint, but it was kind of a big deal.

What a great experience and worth every single penny.  Very well done and top notch organization.  Our pilot (Fred) was excellent - informative on the flight but not overly chatty -- he gave us adequate opportunity to enjoy and absorb the whole experience.  45 minutes goes quickly but the memory stays with you!  Do it!
Wow! what a great experience, very informative pilot. First helicopter flight for C, now she's hooked.

Wij werden netjes opgehaald bij ons hotel en met een busje naar het vliegveld gebracht.
Tijdens de tour vlogen wij over Hooverdam, Lake Maed en de Colorado River. Waarna wij op 1 van de laagste punten van de Grand Canyon landen en een glas met bubbels kregen aangeboden. Hier hadden we ook even de tijd om wat rond te lopen en foto te maken. Als je de mogelijkheid hebt om dit prachtige natuur wonder van uit de lucht te bekijken moet je het echt doen.

Just Wahou...!
Personnel et pilote très sympas. Les hélicoptères sont tout neufs et confortables.
Inutile d'en dire plus, si vous voulez vraiment ne pas passer à côté de votre visite du grand canyon, allez y!
Le tour canyon spirit est suffisamment long pour tout voir.
the whole experience was memorable beyond belief.. especially going over the rim.... if you can afford it DO IT

It was a great choice to buy a heli trip to Great Canion. We started at 8 am, so weather, light, panoramic views and morning sun were amazing. Pilot was very kind and well prepared to say something about environment and history of that place. What's more during trip we could ask and listening to special music which was an additional experience for us. Fantastic moments!

Wer schon die weite Reise zum Grand Canyon auf sich nimmt, sollte hier nicht sparen. Es ist ein einmaliges Erlebnis, die wahre Größe dieses Canyons aus der Luft zu erleben. Maverick Helicopters ist hier sehr professionell im Umgang mit den Kunden. Kann der Flug aufgrund widriger Wetterverhältnisse nicht stattfinden, gibt es einen neuen Termin oder Geld zurück. Auch unser Pilot konnte durch Professionalität überzeugen.

I won't write too much as I don't wish to spoil your enjoyment.

All I will say is this is a MUST, if you wish to see the Grand Canyon from a birds eye view with a friendly, knowledgable pilot don't think about the price and go ahead and book.

This is an experience I will treasure for life

Expérience magique et tout simplement superbe. Le survol du Grand Canyon en hélico est incontournable. L'accueil est très sympathique, le pilote était adorable. Nous étions 5 (dont 3 ados) et nous garderons un merveilleux souvenir de cette activité. Le paysage est grandiose, c'est magnifique. A faire au moins 1 fois dans sa vie !

We booked through our koa site in Williams  the day before.  It was 299$ each for 45-50 flight in a helicopter over the supposedly most amazing scenery on the planet and believe me. ........worth every penny.  We drove 60 miles to the canyon airport  facilities.  Booked in and was weighed.   This is so they can distribute the weight around the aircraft properly.  We boarded and I am incredibly afraid of heights so the pilot tool off carefully.  My husband suffers with balance problems but this flight was no problem at all.  Yes, I was very apprehensive especially when we flew over the edge.  I had to adjust myself to the height but eventually was taking photos and filming same as the other 5 people.  Definitely a wonder of this planet.  Would do again.  A memory  worth having and I thank Maverick for making it possible and the free t-shirt!

review_title: Ein MUSS, wenn man das nötige Kleingeld hat!
review_text:
Wir hatten schon Monate vorher den 45 minütigen Flug über den Grand Canyon gebucht. Hat alles tadellos geklappt, freundlicher Service, modernste Hubschrauber und kompetente Piloten!

Die Sitzplätze im Helikopter werden vom Computer anhand des Gewichtes der einzelnen Passagiere berechnet bzw. vergeben. Dadurch kann es keine Streitigkeiten hinsichtlich der Platzwahl geben. Sehr gut und elegant clever!

Der Flug selbst ist ein Traum. Steht man am South Rim inmitten der Touristenmassen, hat man eher das Gefühl in Disneyland zu sein. Außerdem sieht man sich schnell an der Szenerie satt. Anders dagegen der Flug im Hubschrauber!!!! Man genießt jede Minute, staunt und lauscht den interessanten Erzählungen des Piloten. 

Bei Maverick wird der Flug und die Unterhaltung über die Headsets mitgefilmt bzw. aufgenommen und kann auf DVD/Blueray käuflich erworben werden. Eine schöne Erinnerung für Zuhause.

Fazit:
Wenn man das nötige Kleingeld hat, ist der Hubschrauber DIE beste Variante den Grand Canyon zu bestaunen, zumal die Helikopter von Maverick von jedem Sitzplatz aus einen tollen Ausblick gestatten (ich saß in der Mitte hinten). Well done, Maverick!

review_title: Unforgettable flight over the Grand Canyon
review_text: We had a helicopter trip over the Grand Canyon in mind when we booked our holiday to USA. Although we were nervous, seeing the Grand Canyon from the air is an absolute must. We booked the trip the same morning and on arrival the pilot helped calm our nerves; creating a relaxed atmosphere and speaking to us throughout. It was a beautiful flight and we felt safe the whole time. This excursion is worth every penny and I'd recommend Maverick to everyone.

Découvrir le Grand Canyon en hélicoptère restera une sensation extraordinaire ...
L'accueil et l'organisation sont irréprochables .
Certes le prix élevé mais bon on n'a qu'une vie et on n'est pas à Grand Canyon tous les jours!

review_title: Amazing flight over the Grand Canyon
review_text:
We booked a 45 min flight over the Grand Canyon and it was amazing! In fact the whole family (kids aged 8 & 6) voted it the highlight of our whole 3 week road trip.

Danny the pilot was friendly and told us some interesting information about the Grand Canyon and chatted to us over the headphones but the views of this incredible natural wonder really spoke for themselves and this was a perfect way to see them from above and below the rim.

review_title: 45 min over Grand Canyon with a great pilot
review_text: We hesitated taking another company which was a little less expensive but believe me, this is worth your money.  I am glad we choose Maverick, for the service, pilot (very experienced !) and the amazing flight. Once in a life time !

This was an unforgettable experience. The helicopter was very comfortable and our pilot (sorry, but I can't remember his name) was an excellent tour guide. If you are visiting the Grand Canyon there is no reason why you should not make this part of your experience. Trust me... You will not regret it :)

I highly recommend to take an early morning flight over the Grand Canyon as it will give you an idea of how huge it actually is. The pilot was German (Martin) and he was very nice and told us some interesting facts. They are well organised and everything went smoothly, the flight too.

We did the 45 flight tour and I thought it was really great
Not cheap but definitely worth doing
Pilot was very chatty and played good music on the trip
This 45 minute ride is not to be missed.  Sure it is expensive, but best value in the Canyon.  Everyone from reservations to departure was awesome.  Pilot was great- Bucket list worthy event!

Me comunique a través del chat de la pagina con mi teléfono movil y en 5 minutos cerramos todo.
Consegui para el mismo dia llamando en la mañana y agendado para el mismo dia en la tarde.
Paseo de 45 mins. Helicopteros Eco Star en totalidad de flota los que tienen ( no asi la competencia).
Solicite ir en el frontis del helicoptero cuando llame para reservar y asi fue asignado.
Puntual. No hay wifi en el aeropuerto. No se puede llevar mochila o bolso a bordo,solo una botella de agua y telefono.
Muy profesional.
299 dolares cerrado.

review_title: It's like nothing I've seen before!
review_text:
My family of four ages 52 to 15 booked a maverick helicopter journey over the Grand Canyon.  

Martin our pilot took us out on their weather route as the heavens had opened over the north rim.  That moment when we hovered above the trees and then glided slowly over the canyon will stay with all of us for the rest of our lives.

Martin was extremely knowledgeable and you knew he loved his job due to the passion of the commentary.  

This isn't an expensive experience and I know we will do this again.

Nous n avions pas réservé , nous avons été très bien accueilli et nous avons choisi un grand tour . Vraiment époustouflant , un pilote très pro , nous étions 5  dans l hélico donc tous bien placé. Un survol en musique génial , j ai le vertige mais cela vaut vraiment la peine de prendre sur soi . Inoubliable .

My wife, 8 year old granddaughter and I experienced the Grand Canyon on a 45 minute Maverick helicopter tour with our pilot Greg.  Seeing the Grand Canyon from the sky was simply jaw dropping spectacular.  Greg patiently answered every question that was thrown at him and had a great deal of knowledge.  It was a memorable experience.

Nice trip 
Great views 
Educational and inspirational conversations with the pilot 
My wife and I really enjoyed our flight with Maverick

review_title: An unforgettable  special birthday celebration - Fantastic
review_text:
Awesome, stunning, jaw-dropping, spectacular, exhilarating.
A must do experience. You have seen photos, films, there can be nothing like flying into the Canyon. Booked helicopter prior to departure from UK for 6 persons so had helicopter to ourselves. Highly professional company, excellent commentary. Pilot very knowledgeable. Take lots of pictures.

EL vuelo y las vistas son inolvidables, Maverick cobra aparte el combustible, y en lugar de hacer el vuelo programado de 50 minutos hicimos solo el de 20 minutos por incendios en un sector del cañon. No nos devolvieron el dinero de diferencia.

The helicopters are modern and inspire confidence. The whole operation looks very professional. Our pilot was Irish and his commentary was very informative and interesting. The flight was smooth and showed us a totally different perspective, especially when the helicopter banks to turn. Almost as interesting was travelling over the forest to get to the canyon rim. 
If you are visiting Grand Canyon this is an essential trip and worth every penny.
Simply great, on time as promised and exceptional pleasure for the family. Thanks to BJ a great pilot and Shawn who organized!

Maverick helicopters operate out of the Grand Canyon airport close to the South rim visitors center. A 30 minutes flight takes you over the canyon from the South to the North rim and lets you see its vastness from above. This doesn't come cheap, but I cannot recommend it enough- you simply get a much better impression this way and it is a once in your lifetime experience. And for those who worry about helicopter flights Maverick has a top notch fleet and the pilots are extremely experienced: Ours was Felix, a former Navy pilot who can land a helicopter so you don't even realize you are touching ground again!
Wonderful way to experience the awe of the canyon while covering the south and north rim in one flight. Do the long flight and get the flight video. Nice job guys.

review_title: Grand Canyon West Tour - Tribal Spirit Grand Canyon Sightseeing Tour with Skywalk
review_text: Perfect day! We were collected from our hotel at 5.10am, the driver arrived exactly on time. It was an early start but worth it as we were first at the skywalk and guano point which meant we could walk straight on. Flight to canyon was very smooth. Our pilot Lindsay was lovely, explained everything and really put us all at ease. It was a bit hazy so Lindsay skipped flying over the Hoover dam and lake mead and took us there on the flight back instead so we had a better view. The plane seated 8 and our family of 4 shared with another family of 4. Once landed we boarded buses to the sky walk and guano point. We had a choice of eating our meal at either location. We chose guano point which is a barbecue type meal. It was a bit weird to be eating mash potatoes and chicken at 9am but we were hungry being up so early and the food was delicious. Next we boarded the helicopter and landed down in the canyon. It was hot but an amazing experience. Another great pilot called Jerry. We were then met by Lindsay again and flown back to Vegas. All in all a fantastic day, expensive but so worth it. Maverick Helicopters are a professional company who treat you like VIPs. You can tell safety is a priority. Everything ran like clockwork. We heard other people complain about the other tour operators on the day saying they were late which meant they did not have enough time. We had plenty of time at each location. Would defiantly reccomend this tour and Maverick.

An amazing flying view of the canyon which provides a totally unique way of viewing from above. Our pilot was incredibly informative and friendly and took care of us the whole time. The helicopter was comfy and the ride smooth, and took us around and over the best parts of the canyon and landscape.
This trip is totally worth the money and I highly recommend if you're in the area. Do not miss it.

Great tour - worth the $$$ We did the long tour.   Stunning views, amazing beauty, but you have heard that before...it is true.  My favorite part of our trip!!!  Would do it again and again...such a great experience!!

review_title: Superb in every way. Not to be missed
review_text: I had never been in a helicopter before and was nervous about taking a 45 minute flight. However the check in at Tusayan was friendly and even though we all had to be weighed, the weights were not discussed or displayed. We had five of us in the helicopter plus Patrick the pilot and we were told where to sit so that the weight was distributed evenly. Take off was smooth and the moment the ground dropped away into the canyon was breathtaking.  Patrick's commentary was excellent. He pointed out just the right amount of features, answered any questions and made us feel safe at all times. This trip was worth every penny.

Au départ de l'aéroport du Grand Canyon National Park Airport. Pris en charge par Felix notre pilote, nous avons eu la chance d'être placé idéalement placé sur les 3 places à l'avant de l’hélico à coté du pilote.
et puis c'est le départ, confortablement installés sur nos sièges, coiffés d'un superbe casque qui fait très pro.
l'hélico décolle, c'est parti pour 40min de rêve et 160km de balade en hélico.le casque atténue le bruit du moteur et nous permet d'entre correctement tout ce qui se dit dans l'habitacle
