très pro et très sympa, Felix nous explique la visite en anglais en faisant l'effort de se mettre à la hauteur de mon niveau d'anglais de touriste de base. 
au bout d 10min de survol de la foret, Felix nous dit d'allumer nos caméras et là.......
c'est le grand saut!!!!!! fabuleux magique grandiose exceptionnel, le grand Canyon est à nos pieds pour nous tout seul. On est bien loin de la foule des piétons et on profite d'un paysage aux couleurs fabuleuses et aux formes vertigineuses.
Felix nous gratifie d'un "joli plogeon" avec son hélico dans un petit canyon... sensations garanties. on appercois quelques bisons sauvages.
le temps passe vite mais les sensations resterons à jamais dans nos mémoires
le tarif est un peu élevé (300$ par personne) mais l’exceptionnel n'a pas de prix à ce niveau de bonheur.
Merci FELIX

I was in Vegas with my 2 kids (age 10 and 14) - we wanted to get Grand Canyon crossed of our list.
To avoid too much desert driving we took the Heli option.

We got the biggest package, introduced to us by the concierge at Bellagio.

The pilot was great and had a PERFECT play list for the flight. (top gun ofcourse)

The aircraft was perfect and we had a good ride - the food was a disgrace and the reason for not five stars.

We could easily have spent more time at the different activities out there - SKYWALK not that great - but still do it at least one time.

Best safety record in the region. They have  the very latest helicopters, very quiet, very smooth ride and highly experienced pilots.Very professionally run. A great once in a lifetime exoerience.. Not to be missed. We had 45 minutes of amazing scenery with a great commentary by our pilot. Took heaps of photos from above.

We went for the ride with a stop for lunch in the canyon. I have done the plane trip before years ago but this was much better. Yes it's expensive but well worth it.  Views incredible. Our pilot Zach was friendly and gave us lots of info. Champagne was nice in the canyon too. At each of the 3 stops we rotated seats so everyone got a chance at the best views. But all can see in every seat. 7 people on the helicopter  plus the pilot.

Definitely the best way to see the Grand Canyon. No other view will ever compare to flying over the Grand Canyon. We are not rich or well off by any means but it was 100% well worth the money spent. Our pilot, Vern, was awesome and pointed out a lot of cool sights, like rafters on the river who were so tiny they looked like Legos. We will never forgot our helicopter tour over the Grand Canyon. Simply breathtaking!

With our family of four including a 10 and 5 year old, a helicopter ride was perceived as a luxury experience to accompany our once in a lifetime visit. Make no mistake, this is an expensive exercise, a very expensive exercise and we are lucky enough to be even able to consider it. 

Maverick were exceptional. Not only did we get a 45 minute ride when we only paid for a 25 minute ride (I think our numbers and weight perfectly filled a flight) but the pilot Felix was warm and exceptionally informative. The flight itself was a life-long memory.

If you are in any doubt I would say that a helicopter ride should accompany not replace a walk inside the rim (if you are capable of it - our 5 year old made a good fist of it) but together they give you an unbelievable experience of one of the most amazing things on our planet. Of that there is very little doubt.

review_title: BEST Way to view the Canyon
review_text: Yes, it's a splurge, but totally worth it. Martin, our guide/pilot was wonderful. He shared just the right amount of information while giving us time to just take in the views. There were five of us on this flight, in addition to Martin. We did the 45 minute tour and could not be more pleased!

Maverik Helicopters ist auf dem Flugplatz der zum Grand Canyon gehört untergebracht. Die Räumlichkeiten sind ansprechend und man wir freundlich und kompetent bedient. Wie fast immer kann man noch viele mehr oder weniger sinnvolle Dinge während der etwas einstündigen Wartezeit kaufen. Vorher reservieren muss man nicht wirklich, da in der Regel genug Helikopter und Piloten im Einsatz sind. Alle sind sehr nett und die Erklärungen kurz und prägnant. Dann geht es auch schon los. 
Der Komfort im Helikopter ist ok und wenn man etwas "Glück" hat, dann ist er auch nicht zu voll gepackt. Wenn man vorne sitzt, ist das deutlich besser als hinten in der Mitte. Nach etwa 10 Minuten Flug ist man über dem Grand Canyon und offensichtlich liegt die Route fest. Die Erklärungen durch den Piloten sind kurz und hilfreich. Ansonsten ist man ohnehin von der absolut einzigartigen Aussicht fasziniert. Der Rundflug dauert etwa 45 Minuten ist nicht gerade billig, aber ein echtes Highlight. Kann ich nur empfehlen und wird auch von den einheimischen Tourgides empfohlen.
Maverik Helicopters sind nicht die Einzigen mit diesem Angebot und machen das alles ziemlich professionell und ohne große Emotion. Ich denk, das gibt sich nicht viel mit den anderen Anbietern.

Second time I've been with maverick and excellent service and flight pilot very knowledgeable and witty good views from every seat and does a seat rotation when we stopped for refueling  flew nice and low through canyon good overall experience

Researched safety records and read on a pilot job site this company requires more flight hours, so picked them. When the very heavy cross winds hit up close to the North Rim, was very glad we had . Felix our pilot did a great job holding it steady and never missed a beat describing the grandeur below us! We did the longer flight and really enjoyed the time up over the very different northern area. We've always found helicopter tours to offer the best views and to be able to see place we could not otherwise and the Grand Canyon is certainly such a place to tour this way!

We took the 45 minute canyon tour with the whole family (including grandpa, grandma, 2 kids aged 9 and 14 months). From beginning to end so professional and a tour of a lifetime. Our guide was knowledgable, great with kids and the airlines so accommodating. Best adventure we could have hoped for!!

review_title: THE WAY to see the Grand Canyon
review_text:
The Grand Canyon is a true bucket list destination - a world class, top ten natural attraction. You should see it up close as well as riding a helicopter, but the helicopter adds a perspective to really help you grasp the majestic scale and beauty of the canyon.

I've been in a lot of helicopters, and this one was probably the most comfortable - air conditioned and (relatively) quiet. 

Check in was fast and easy. The pilot was full of useful facts, but he didn't babble on and allowed us plenty of quiet time to soak up the scenery in peace.

It's expensive, but if its on your bucket list, you should do it right !

Wir sind vorher noch nie Hubschrauber geflogen und waren allein darauf schon total gespannt. 

Aber, wenn der Hubschrauber das erste Mal die Grenze zum Grand Canyon überfliegt, steht einem einfach nur der Mund sperrangelweit offen.

Maverick Helicopter sind gut organisiert, machen einen professionellen Eindruck und die Hubschrauber sind ausreichend geräumig. Die Piloten sind alle sehr smart und erzählen einem über die Sprechanlange was man wo sieht.

Der Rundflug verging buchstäblich wie im Flug.

This is a great company for Grand Canyon hellicopter rides. They cancel what won't be safe, and don't charge you for what you booked & couldn't get. I'm scared of heights, and they made sure I was fine. You get headphones with microphnes attached, so you can hear the pilot & talk amongst each other. When the pilot had to do some techy talk, he announced that he'd turn off your earphones & micrphones, so it didn't come as a surprise / concern.
I saw some hellicopters ty & do unsafe things in dangerous weather, but these people seemed to be on top of things, safety wise.
The ride in itself is spectacular, and, if you could, you'd do again & again!
A Hellicopter ride over the Grand Canyon is on the DON'T MISS list.

review_title: Best money I've spent all year!
review_text:
My buddy and I did the 45 minute helicopter tour and it was simply amazing. The pilot (Danny) was knowledgable and super nice. From the Tusayan Airport, it's less than 10 minutes at 300 feet before you go over the edge....wow! Then one photo op after another. Very near a spiritual experience for me. 

One thing that I saw mentioned in other posts is the middle seats. We had 5 passengers; 3 in front with the pilot, 2 in the back, 2 empty middle seats in the back. Sitting in those seats would definitely not be ideal.
Very professional outfit. Made us feel very comfortable with small kids. Of course the actual tour was amazing as well.

This was an experience well worth $284! Even from the helicopter it is still difficult to comprehend the sheer size & depth of the Canyons. We were on the helicopter straight after paying, the pilot was very knowledgable & informative & took a picture for all of us with our own cameras in front of the heli after the flight (whereas they take an "official" photo at the beginning that costs money!). The flight was 50mins. 
Flying fast just above the trees & out over the rim as the ground suddenly drops thousands of feet below you is an incredible feeling!

review_title: Grand Canyon, Tour of a lifetime
review_text: We booked this 45 min helicopter tour with our travel company in the UK and we were really looking forward to it, the wait was worth it, we arrived at the airport prior to departure and we were weighed and sorted out with the other passengers it was all very professional done our pilot BJ met us and took us to the helicopter and safety briefed us and we were all set to go, on the way to the canyon our pilot told us all about the canyon he was very knowledgeable as we approached the edge of the canyon we went from 300 feet to 5000 feet it was the most amazing rush and the view was incredible we spent at least 35 mins going all around the canyon with our pilot telling us all about how it was formed etc, i would highly recommend this tour and Maverick helicopter tours, I've seen the canyon from a couple of different places around the rim but this is the ultimate way to do it, i don't know if it was expensive for a helicopter tour or not but whatever the cost give these guys a go they are really good, thank you Maverick

We chose not to do the West Rim direct from Las Vegas, but an extended tour with Maverick.  We went by bus to an out of town "executive" airport and went on a Maverick turbprop (19 seats) for about an hour to their heliport near the South Rim.  That was special - boarding cards with just your first name on, an invite to,see the cockpit since no turbulence and even got a photo off the flight dexk.  At the heliport we got in a helicopter, three passengers in front row and four in the back, and went at low level over the scrub / trees,, suddenly  being a mile up as we went over the edge.  We flew to the North Rim and a bit of a tour round.  Great youg pilot who put Jimi Hendrix in the headphones - just perfect.
After, we had a trolley tour to the rim and had a relaxing view into the "hole".  Not a lot of time there and we went back to the plane for the return to Vegas.  What we bought in the shop was waiting on our seats..

I contacted Maverick Helicopter Tours for an aerial tour of the Grand Canyon.  It was an amazing experience.  Their prices were slightly less expensive than their competitor.  The tour lasts for a little under an hour.  The helicopter seats 7 people and our tour as comprised of 6 people.  The lightest passengers usually sit in front (i.e. children or skinny people) with heavier passengers in the back soon.  All of the seating provides great views, I was able to get fabulous photos and video footage from my back middle seat.  I highly recommend this experience if you are visiting the Grand Canyon.,

We had a fabulous helicopter ride over the Canyon with Patrick as our pilot and commentator. Patrick had a thorough knowledge of the area. The view from the helicopter was breathtaking. Would recommend this option to visit the Grand Canyon if you are short on time. Two passengers were physically sick and we were impressed when we landed that Patrick had obviously discreetly signalled to ground staff who upon landing brought hot towels and water to the ill passengers. Top job Patrick! We also got ferried around in a trolley bus from the airport to the helicopter and to a lodge (spectacular views!) to have our lunch by Bruce - a real character. Bruce was very entertaining. Enjoyable tour.
Hermoso paseo para recorrer y observar el Gran Cañón y Las Vegas desde las alturas, en paseo de helicóptero. Si podés pagarlo vale la pena. Algo caro, pero increíble. Lo volvería a hacer.

AWESOME WORTH EVERY PENNY! Make sure to ask to sit in the front of the helicopter it will make all the difference.  Get there early and talk to the pilot about it.  I cried while i was up there it was so life changing- Don't think about the money and just do it!!!

I was very unsure about taking a helicopter flight and when I saw the tiny helicopters I wasn't reassured but this was a truly unforgettable experience for wonderful views of the magnificent scenery, and worth every penny of the cost.

During May 2016 my wife and I spent 21 days driving Route 66 (Chicago to Los Angeles).  We had a 2 night stop in Flagstaff so a visit to the Grand Canyon was in order. There was no doubt the views from the rim and visitors centre would be amazing, but we realised the 'icing on the cake' would be an aerial view.  Enter Maverick Helicopters. We booked a 50 minute flight with them over the Grand Canyon.  The amazing views became awesome.  Comfortable flight in a modern helicopter with an experienced pilot, Jake in our case.  You can see so much more from 'up there'.  Plus Jake also acted as a guide with an excellent knowledge of the terrain and history (going back billions of years) of the Canyon (p.s. He wasn't that old!!!).  Each occupant has a headset and microphone so you can talk to the pilot as well as hear his description and info, with background music in-between lulls in conversation.  THIS IS A MUST DO if ever you get the chance to visit the Canyon.  At the end of the flight we had photo opportunities alongside the aircraft.  ALSO your flight is videoed so you can relive it and hear all the history again.  Maverick Helicopters are a very professional outfit who I would fully recommend.  Many, many thanks to Jake for a very professional and informative flight.  We've nearly worn the DVD out reliving it.  What a memory.

The best possible views over the beautiful Grand Canyon. 
Maverick were great throughout. Easy booking, efficient communications and great service.
Plenty of helpful commentary on the 50 minute South Rim tour.
A must-do experience.

This was my first helicopter trip and I must say what a trip!! The staff here is very friendly and organized which helps your initial fears. Each pilot gets to pick the soundtrack to your flight as well. Our pilot Justin was great! Very knowledgeable. From alpine flats to dramatic peaks of the canyons, this is a trip worth while to take!

This was an absolutely fabulous experience.  Best way to see the canyon.  Our pilot BJ Belnap was fantastic.  He took us well into the canyon with excellent information.  He was fun and very knowledgeable.  Recommend this to everyone!!

review_title: Wonderful experience not to be missed
review_text: What an excellent trip.  Firstly the plane flight over Hoover Dam, then the helicopter flight right down into the Grand Canyon.  The pilots were very professional, and really made this such a great experience.  Well worth the money.

I know its expensive to do the helicopter tour but my suggestion is to save some money because its so worthy. You cant carry anything but your cell phone on flight mode and a water bottle. Ask for the front seat, they accommodate everyone based on weight but if you ask they can give you preference.

review_title: Vale la pena cada dolar que sale!!
review_text: Eramos cuatro para volar y no es barato,pero valio la pena! esas vistas obviamente no las ves desde tierra,lo unico malo fue la antipatia del piloto!! bastante amargo,le saque una foto pilotenado y casi me come con la mirada,era uno pelado de unos 30 años,y volamos en uno de los eurocopters negro

This was my first time in a helicopter AND my first time at the Grand Canyon. My pilot was professional, funny, engaging, and knew a lot about the canyon and surrounding.  He was great about letting is know what to expect as far as the flight was concerned - which as a first time helicopter passenger I greatly appreciated! The flight was about an hour and we got to spend most of that over the canyon seeing the amazing beauty of it. Take off and landing were easy. I will definitely go on another helicopter tour - and most assuredly with these guys!

This was an excellent trip - our whole family really enjoyed it. We took our young children on the flight 9 and 6 and the pilot was great at putting them at ease when there was a little turbulence. I really enjoyed the commentary and the relaxing music. They were great at spending time taking photos with us too. Highly recommend!

The Maverick helicopter ride over the Grand Canyon...Amazing. Fabulous. Wonderful. Phenomenal. What an incredible way to end our trip. Our pilot, B.J., was great...very informative and a lot of fun for the children!

This was once in a lifetime experience. We were terrified to do it and thought an hour was going to creep by and instead it felt like 10 minutes .There is not another way to really see the Grand Canyon ,you fly back-and-forth over it a few times and it seems like the helicopter is taking it's time. You've got beautiful music in d your headphones when the pilot is not talking to you about everything concerning the Grand Canyon ,the native cultures ,the geology ,and the fauna. We did the hour tour of the south rim which is said to be the whitest the deepest and most beautiful we were not disappointed, I highly recommend this particular company over the others based on many locals opinions as well. I have no pictures because my hands were sweating too much😀
Brilliant trip with extensive commentary from the pilot. If there is only one treat available to you go on this one. The longer tour is worth the extra.
我们是从拉斯维加斯直飞大峡谷的，第一次坐直升机飞行，因此整个直升机给我们很震撼的体验，其实直升机多少有些颠簸，但是我感觉驾驶员的技术很不错，因此整个旅程还是相对很完美的。在大峡谷只呆了半个小时，他们提供香槟和小食品，感觉是很好。只是全程没有厕所，最好不要喝太多水。。。

We had a wonderful experience with these guys.  Checkin and the lobby was nice, clean, relaxing.  The pilot and tour guide were awesome. (Paul and BJ)  We were flying on a pretty windy day and it was clear Paul definitely knew how to fly that bird.  BJ gave a great tour and it was just a wonderful experience all around. Highly recommend.

We had the good fortune to take a 40 minute helicopter tour with Maverick over the Grand canyon in April. It certainly was the highlight of our US trip. We departed from Grand canyon South rim airport, which does not show up on a GPS so just direct your GPS to Tusayan. Tusayan is only about 10 minutes from the Grand Canyon entrance.  Maverick are very professional and had no hesitation taking our 3 kids up with them. Their helicopters are amazing and everyone has a great view no matter where you sit. The pilot will tell you where to sit based on weight. 

I have also taken a Maverick tour leaving from Las Vegas over the West rim, and I found both experiences amazing for different reasons. The trip over the South rim and the National Park was spectacular and the views, colours and depth of the Grand canyon where breathtaking. A highlight was the Colorado river and its amazing turquoise colour. While the trip leaving Las Vegas was also amazing, going over Hoover dam, travelling over the strip then landing in  the Hualapai Reservation for a champagne lunch. The actual depth of West rim is not as deep as the views over  the National park South rim.   

 Many people will go on about how the trips leaving from Las Vegas is not actually over Grand Canyon National park, while this is completely true the experience in my opinion is no less of a thrill and no less breathtaking. I have to say I like them both for different reasons. I would have no hesitation in recommending either trip as both are amazing and you certainly do not miss out on breathtaking views doing either of them.

review_title: Do It You Won't Regret It
review_text:
The Grand Canyon---
6 of us showed up, they split us into two groups, & both groups had a fantastic time.  Really it's hard for me to describe how great it was.  All the staff were friendly & professional. We had 3 generations ages 25 to 75.  Maverick's ground crew & pilot were great with the "oldsters", helping them in & out of the copter.  
The pilots were great about pointing out the different features of the canyon, & educating us on the river, the Native American tribes, history, etc.  IT WAS AMAZING.

Did our 3rd helicopter tour (spirit). It's a 50 minute tour. Felix was our Pilot, Brian (a pilot in training) joined us, so we heard a little explanation from Felix to Brian, what we really liked. We loved it again. Worth every penny!

I did the Canyon Spirit Trip from the South Rim and it was a truly amazing experience. Our original flight was cancelled due to bad weather but with no hassle at all they rebooked us onto another trip the following morning. The whole set up at Maverick is very slick and professional and would put anyone who was slightly apprehensive at ease. It is an absolute must do when visiting the Grand Canyon and is worth every penny.

We took the 45 minute Canyon Spirit tour, and it was absolutely incredible. The pilot was great. I know it is a lot of money but it is worth it. That moment when you are flying over the forest and then all of sudden dip down into the canyon is simply amazing. We booked this as part of a package with the Grand Canyon Railway Hotel. Someone picked us up from our hotel at the Canyon to take us to the airport and returned us to Grand Canyon Village in plenty of time to catch the train back to Williams. This was definitely a highlight of our trip and we even bought the dvd that they record of your flight.
Just finished doing this today and we loved it. We chose the 40-50 minute tour which was $300 US. Our pilot was great and the views were amazing. This is definitely worth the money!

Yes, $280 is a lot of money. Aviation is expensive, it's just one of those unchangeable things. Bear in mind though, a ten minute helicopter flight in the UK will cost you around £70 ($100). $280 for forty five minutes - at the Grand Canyon, no less! - is an absolute bargain.

The helicopters are ECO-Star EC-130s and are flown by ex-military pilots, if the chap who flew us was to be believed. The helis will seat eight people in two rows and the seating arrangement is determined by the pilot according to weight. I was assigned to the front, second from the right. The view was excellent, albeit slightly disconcerting as it's pretty much just glass in every direction, including underfoot. Another member of my party was seated in a central seat in the back row and I imagine that her view was not particularly good. Unfortunately, it's just pot luck as to which seat you get.

Our pilot wasn't the most friendly person, but he got us around safely and that's really what matters. One small niggle that I had was that I'm a light aircraft pilot myself and I wasn't entirely comfortable with how close we were flying to the peaks and pinnacles sometimes, nor with how much traffic was in certain areas. However, this may have just been a "control freak" issue because I couldn't hear the radio and was acutely aware of the presence of the other aircraft. I'm the same when I'm a passenger in someone else's car, so... yeah.

A few final pointers: make sure you budget for it, make sure you book in advance, make sure you take photo ID with you, bear in mind that flights may be cancelled if the weather is unfit for flying or if there are too few passengers for the flight to be viable - always call a few hours before your flight to check.

Good points: HELICOPTER! AT THE GRAND CANYON!

Bad points: a bit impersonal.

Pilot was first class, knowledgeable and friendly. Took 45 min trip, could not have been more pleased with the entire experience. If you can, take the trip, you will be glad you did. The only way to truly experience the majesty of the Canyon.

Took the nearly one hour Canyon Spirit flight with a totally great pilot (Felix). The helicopter was modern and compact, with excellent views for all the passengers (looked a lot newer than some other companies). Felix was ex-Navy, a really great pilot and entertaining guide, who put us completely at our ease whilst giving us one of the most spectacular and memorable experiences ever. There were 6 passengers on the flight, all of us delighted, and happy squeals of enjoyment and excitement as we flew around were common. It cost a bit, but made the Canyon an exceptional experience.

Passeio imperdível!!! Helicóptero super seguro, pilotos experientes e super atenciosos!!! Meu filho tem pânico de voar em aviões pequenos, mas ficou super tranquilo pela segurança que eles nos passaram!!!

We were booked on a 45 minute sky experiencing tour with Meverick Helicopters as a part of our itinerary with Vegas Insider Tours visiting the Grand Canyon.. and the experience was worth it all the way..

From check in, the staff were very friendly, taking our ID's, weight and explaining the entire process. We were very lucky that the winds were more calm when it was time for our tour as they had cancelled a few heli tours due to the strong winds. We were very lucky!

Our pilot - young, handsome and very knowledgeable (Rivers), was very pleasant during the entire tour, from explaining details pre-flight to being in the air, he knew everything one needed to know about the Grand Canyon, even the sights that formed a dragon to the names of each temple shaped grounds. The flight was very interesting and we felt immediately that safety was on their top priority as Rivers explained about the winds and the turbulence we would be  experiencing during flight.

We all filled the special bags during the flight, and amazingly on arrival we were greeted with cool towels and bottles of water as Rivers radioed in the request before arrival. His attention was amazing and a true asset to the company.

We would have loved to have our trip on the DVD but unfortunately they had technical problems but they provided us with a generic DVD of a heli tour on the Grand Canyon. Not as special, as it was a lifetime experience and our very first heli ride, but better than nothing.

If you are planning to see the beauty of the Grand Canyon from the air, the best way to go is with Meverick Helicopters, they know their stuff and their hospitality is excellent. Well worth the monies spent!

The Canyon Spirit tour takes a circular path over the Grand Canyon. Our pilot Patrick was great! It was our first helicopter flight and was nothing like we thought it would be, It felt like your sitting in a noisy massage chair for the entire flight. The view from the Ecostar 130 was great. 1 pilot, 7 passengers. Fantastic views, it gives you a totally different perspective of the Grand Canyon. The huge expanse of the canyon is better seen from the air. You can't go wrong with this flight tour. The other tour is like a train, it goes out and comes back on the same path. Well worth the money, it was the highlight of our Grand Canyon sightseeing.

review_title: Used money from my retirement for this...AND IT WAS WORTH IT!!!
review_text:
So, it's been on my bucket list for years to visit the Grand Canyon. My cousin went and told me she took a helicopter ride into the Canyon. I looked at her like she was crazy and she simply explained, "I don't know when I'll ever go back, so I did it big." When I found out my husband was going to Vegas for business and we would have a free day, I decided that it was worth it to use some of our retirement money that had recently been cashed in and to make it big. I may never go back. I may die before retirement age. It was a once in a lifetime trip for me to cross off the item at the top of my bucket list. IT WAS WORTH IT!!

So here is what we did. A van picked us up at our hotel. We stopped to pick up another couple at another hotel. They drove us to the airport. We took a small plane with 3 other couples and flew over the Hoover Dam. We took tons of photos. We landed and went over immediately to our Helicopter. We took off and we all had on ear phones and could hear each other. The pilot meant to play music but forgot to, I'm glad he did. He flew towards the Canyon and then took a dip into it and you could hear the other passengers gasping and saying Wow. It literally took your breathe away. The front of the helicopter was all glass so it was like we were floating in the Canyon. I literally had tears in my eyes. 

We landed in the Canyon and got out and were able to spend a decent amount of time in the Canyon walking around and taking pictures, for about 20 minutes. Then we boarded the helicopter in different seats and flew back to where we took off. Then we boarded a bus and went to two different look out areas on the Canyon. One has the glass floor you walk out on. The view was amazing. The second look out area included a huge delicious meal served to us by the friendly local native Americans. 

On the way back to get back to our plane to go back, I realized I lost my iphone. The employees at Maverick went out of their way, along with one of the park staff members to help me find and retrieve my phone. We boarded the plane and flew back over the Hoover Dam and people on the other side of the plane got great pictures this time. We landed at the airport and the shuttle van took us back to our hotel.

The pilot was AMAZING. The whole trip was worth EVERY SINGLE PENNY. I CAN NOT RECOMMEND THIS ENOUGH. My husband made video of the helicopter flight and showed it to all his co-workers and that was all it took for them to want to do this.

We spent a considerable time researching and opted for the South rim plus Helicopter trip and paid over $1000. We were collected from the Cosmopolitan hotel at 6:30 and made another couple of stops to collect others. We drove to Maverick air strip at Henderson about 45 mins away where we were weighed and allocated seats on the Beechcraft airplane. Shortly after take off we couldn't see anything from the windows for the 50 min flight to the South Rim Grand Canyon because of rain clouds / fog. There were 14 of us and we transferred to a Maverick bus and went to x2 viewpoints on the canyon rim but there was nothing to see it was completely enveloped in thick swirling fog. When we returned to the bus the guide informed us that the helicopter flights had been cancelled. So we boarded the plane and transferred back to Henderson. 
It was here that we were informed that we would be partially refunded the portion of the Helicopter flight.  But all of us refused to accept a part refund because they must have had prior knowledge and up to date awareness of the weather forecasts. They wouldn't return all of our money and wanted us all to leave to be contacted by a more senior manager who would negotiate a partial refund. We all refused and asked to speak to the manager but he wouldn't answer our calls. Our group wouldn't give way and eventually they refunded the monies!

review_title: An Amazing Experience. Well worth the purchase.
review_text:
This was always going to rate highly for me. I love flying, I love nature, so I had high expectations. All of them were met and exceeded. 

Rivers, the pilot, was a professional through and through. It was a beautiful smooth ride, with a great narration of the canyon.  His music choices perfectly complimented the trip as well. 

The staff from Maverick at the airport were amazing too. Super friendly and helpful, and added greatly to the pleasant experience. 

I will, without any hesitation, recommend all family and friends to use Maverick Helicopters from here on. 

Thanks for a great flight.

Was very much looking forward to the giddy heights & adrenalin rush of the scenic helicopter tour over the canyon. Was booked & ready to go the following morning before departing the south rim after a really enjoyable stay. Even at just short of $300 each for my wife and myself, the operator cancelled our flight. He wanted to make more money by bumping us to a flight time we just could not make with our schedule. Rather than take the $600 from us and a smaller profit, he got squat & we missed out. Very disappointing really & I must say a very greedy attitude. Just don't pin your hopes on a flight even if you book in advance, this greedy operator is more of interested in profits than happy customers. If you are flexible with your times you should be ok, but don't bank on it.

Words cannot describe how incredible it was to fly over the Grand Canyon.  Our pilot Felix was amazing and kept us informed all the way with interesting information about the Grand Canyon. One more thing crossed off our bucket list. Thanks to everyone at Maverick.
Maverick Helicopters und der Pilot BJ haben uns einen einmaliges Erlebnis mit dem 50minütigen Flug über den Grand Canyon beschert - Spitze !

Was nice to see the Grand Canyon and the mighty Colorado river , all I feel it for the price the flight was short and only one place to stop, I truly don't mind one stop but I wish the flew a little longer

50th birthday treat. It was amazing. The Canyon has to be seen to be believed. This is a wonderful way to see it. Missed the previous day because too windy. So glad we went back to do it. The pilot was very knowledgeable and we felt completely safe. The views are indescribable - a must do!

This tour was absolutely fantastic and one of the best experiences I have ever had. The pilot was knowledgable and friendly; he talked the whole way through the flight pointing out bits of interest and explaining some of the geological history. We did the half hour day flight and both enjoyed it immensely. 
Cannot recommend this tour or Maverick enough.

review_title: Helicopter ride over the Grand Canyon is safe, fun yet breath taking.
review_text:
We started with an excellent safety briefing, our helicopter seemed to be new and in top condition and we had a personable, safe and knowledgeable pilot who made our trip over the Grand Canyon really engaging, fun and most memorable.

We were lucky enough to sit in the front and I sat by the window which consistently had a great view.  

Even though the windows were perfectly clean, which was really helpful, it is extremely difficult to get great pictures.  Most notably as you go from the airport, over the forest and to the Grand Canyon the view is breathtaking (see attached picture).  I used a wide angle lens with a polarizing filter which helped but there is still a lot of reflection on the windows.  Additionally the wide angle lens allowed me to get a few nice pictures of my family inside the helicopter.

Our pilot, Justin, took us on a 45 minute flight above and around the Grand Canyon, from the airport right outside the southern rim entrance, to the north rim, and back.  A really unbelievable experience, worth the splurge.

review_title: Birds eye view of Grand Canyon
review_text:
We took a shuttle bus from our Las Vegas hotel to Maverick Air in Henderson and flew to the western edge of the Grand Canyon. The western side is where the sky walk is located. We took a shuttle bus to the sky walk and it was awesome! Sadly you can't bring any phone or camera out on the walk, but it really is quite breathtaking! They give you booties to wear on your feet so the glass doesn't get scratched. This is a short walk out and you can look straight down! Very cool!!! 

We then went to an overlook trail which was an easy walk with spectacular views of the Canyon. 

Finally, we took the helicopter ride to the bottom of the Canyon. The ride down was again, breathtaking! It was amazing to look up from near the bottom of the canyon! 

The airplane pilot and the helicopter pilot were both very good pilots and gave lots of information along the way. Very professional and skilled. At no time was I afraid (I had thought I would be scared silly!)  Bring a camera, extra batteries and try and take it all in. This is a great way to get a "taste" of the beauty of Grand Canyon!

review_title: Amazing way to see Grand Canyon!
review_text: What a way to experience Grand Canyon for the first time!  The vastness of this spectacular national treasure cannot be experienced any other way.  Truly breathtaking.  And the pilot and folks at Maverick were fantastic, professional was well organized.  This experience was worth every penny!

Maverick is very professional. A truly amazing ride touring most of the Grand Canyon. The pilot answered questions in flight and gave us an insightful description of the sights before us. Great playlist too! A must do experience!
We did the 45-50 minute Grand Canyon tour with a great pilot (Jake-?). We flew in a comfy "Eco" helicopter on a beautiful day. Our pilot was knowledgeable, fun and friendly. Great trip!

The helicopter ride was amazing! Minimal wait at Maverick helicopter center, and we saw breathtaking views of the Grand Canyon that were even better than on land. It was quite an expensive splurge but it truly was the best part of our trip to the Grand Canyon.

review_title: Great Way to See the Canyon
review_text: Tour was booked through Viator with Maverick.  It was a deluxe tour and price was $310per person.  My husband and I are in our 50's and wanted to spend the day at the canyon, but didn't really feel like a long day in the car.  It was really worth it! Be aware that an 8:00am tour means shuttle pick up at 6:30am, we were back to our hotel before 2:00.  Our tour took a small jet that seated about 14 passengers - the pilots did a good job pointing out the sites.  Then offloaded to a shuttle bus that took us to the canyon inside the national park.  This is one of the deepest and most scenic parts of the canyon - 6,000 feet deep.  The two stops were each about an hour long and we had plenty of time for pictures and to take a nice walk.  Glad to have checked it off the bucket list in such a fun way.

We drove in from Sedona and this was our first stop into the Grand Canyon. We had never seen the GC before so you can imagine how exciting it was for our 9 & 11 year olds to lay eyes for the first time on the GC via a helicopter ride.... It was incredible and after the initial fear leaves you it is a breath taking experience! Maverick was beyond professional and I felt the pilot was safe and alert at all times while providing great details and information about the GC. Well done Maverick for running such a great company!

We took the 50 min ride through the canyon and it was a fantastic experience. Our pilot was very experienced, added great information and we felt very safe at any stage. If you go to the south rim, you've got to treat yourself to that helicopter tour...

For our first trip to the Grand Canyon my girlfriend booked us a tour with Maverick Helicopter and we took off around 10 am. We had visited the Canyon the previous day but the experience of seeing it from the air was absolutely incredible! The pilot/tour guide was outstanding too so we had to purchase a DVD of our flight afterwards. You gotta do this if you can swing it.

Defines the word AWESOME!! Our pilot was Felix and he was fun, confident and very informative. The experience is a must see. Worth every penny. Seeing the Grand Canyon from the edge is amazing...but seeing it from this tour...there really aren't words....back to awesome! So glad we choose Maverick as their pilots give the tour personally. Tons of fun and excitement.

review_title: Soar with the Canyon Spirt at the South Rim
review_text: The high desert in late February was the perfect time to fly the Canyon Spirit Tour with Maverick Helicopters departing from the South Rim. Being a solo female traveler for many years, feeling safe and comfortable is important, and Maverick’s provided that for me. My flight was very smooth from lift-off to landing, and included a breathtaking first glimpse of the magnificent Grand Canyon, as well as incredible views of the snowcapped rim. Scoping out the Canyon from the air, prior to the actual park visit, gave me a better sense and overall picture of the Park in its entirety.  Our pilot’s sense of humor combined with his knowledge of the natural landscape, the wildlife, and of the Park itself, made the experience both enjoyable and enlightening. From the reception area staff, to the helpful crew, and especially to my terrific pilot, Fred, many thanks for an amazing and positive experience!
Top piloten en helicopters.  Correct  vriendelijk  en dan de grand canyon  zelf  is  ongelooflijk.  Gewoon doen

We booked the Canyon Spirit tour from the Grand Canyon Airport. Check-in was quick and easy and the staff were really friendly. Lovely facilities with a coffee shop and comfortable sofas while waiting for the flight. We were then called for our flight by our pilot BJ. A really friendly guy who made you relax and explained that he would walk us to the aircraft and carry out the safety briefing. Your seats are worked out by the staff so the aircraft is balanced. A few minutes later and we were airborne. We flew for about six or seven minutes over the Kaibab forest and then BJ accelerated the helicopter over the rim of the Grand Canyon. I am afraid that I don't have the words to describe the feeling of seeing such a staggering sight spreading out for miles and miles all around us. Quite simply this is the most astounding thing I have ever seen. All the while this tour was made better by the fantastic commentary of BJ and a great soundtrack gently playing through the earphones. The flight continued at a good pace, we never felt it was rushed and that we had time to take in all the sights. 50 minutes later we arrived back at the airport where you are able to purchase a DVD of your flight and soundtrack which is better than a generic DVD. This tour isn't cheap at $299 per person, however the memories are priceless. If you are struggling to make up your mind whether to spend the money, think no more, simply brilliant run by a top class company.

This is a must see tour of the canyon. Our pilot, Fred, made us all feel safe and comfortable. God's beautiful creation is on display at the canyon. Don't miss out on the wonderful helicopter experience. Maverick employees are very professional and accommodating. Highly recommend.

I wish there were 10 stars...then I would give this trip an 11! An absolutely amazing experience. Flying over the forest to drop into the Grand Canyon literally took our breath away. This flight is a marvelous way to see the Grand Canyon. BJ was a great pilot/tour guide. He was knowledgeable, funny and made the flight extra memorable. We felt very secure with Maverick Helicopters. We had originally scheduled this trip for the day prior. Maverick cancelled after sending pilots to check out the route and determining it was too windy to fly. We appreciated Maverick's caution and happily drove 2 hours the next day to check this item off our Bucket List. Bring your sun glasses and camera and don't forget to take video. We did the 50 minute flight and could have flown longer. There is a 30 minute flight available too but we were very happy with the longer flight. We loved every minute of this experience and our 11-year old will never forget it. Neither will we.

This is an amazing way to see the canyon in all its glory. DJ our pilot pointed out the main points of interest (without talking non-stop) and provided a nice smooth ride. It's temping to take lots of pictures but I'd suggest that you put the camera away and enjoy the experience. Any photos couldn't possibly do it justice!
Muy recomendable!!!! Nos buscaron por el hotel. Súper puntuales. Todos los choferes muy amables y explicaban todo lo que veíamos. El cañón impresionante!! Caro pero vale la pena.

Every rave review for a helicopter tour of the Grand Canyon is an understatement. Words cannot describe the experience. I chose Maverick because of the name, and I suppose all the helicopter tours of the GC are about the same price and professionalism. Our pilot certainly was professional. We took the long trip, nearly an hour. It was expensive and worth every penny for such a once in a lifetime adventure. We also bought the video or our tour, with our soundtrack, in the gift shop afterwards. Yes, it's expensive, but yes, it's worth it.

review_title: Best Way to See the Grand Canyon
review_text: Of course there is something to be said about walking the south rim or journeying down the bright angel trail, but if you want to see the ALL of the Grand Canyon and not just a snippet, you should take a helicopter ride. We picked Maverick because of their safety and their windows and it was the best thing we did all week. Ben, our pilot, was knowledgeable and fun without being obnoxious or cheesy. The views are spectacular. My husband in the middle seat could easily still see because of the sizable windows. It's definitely pricey and when you realize you need to tip, it's definitely an investment for 45 minutes. They weigh you so they can balance the helicopter but it's a gentle and private experience - you don't even see your own weight, just the receptionist checking you in.  I'd definitely recommend if you can afford and you're not afraid of heights. :)

review_title: Execelente voo, excelente vista, para jamais esquecer.
review_text: Lugar lindo, visto de cima é impressionante.O voo foi excelente , o piloto explica todos os detalhes  do trajeto. Na metade do caminho paramos numa pequena colina e nos serviram um pequeno lanche onde pudemos também tirar fotos. Vale a pena!

Pricey but worth it!!!  This is an amazing way to experience the Grand Canyon.  The views and ability to truly feel the vastness can be experienced in no other way.  The breathtaking beauty as you come over the south rim truly brought tears to my eyes.  Our pilot, Felix, gave us the need to know information about the canyon with some facts and history.  Can't say enough good things about this ride.
Our pilot, BJ made the flight over the Grand Canyon fun and exciting.  He seemed extremely capable and confident while very upbeat and even humorous.  Highly recommended.

Muy buen servicio! Excelente tour! La experiencia y vistas de gran cañón son insuperables! Nuestro tour incluía un parada en un lugar para tomar champaña, con una vista genial. Hasta la parada para recargar gasolina en la mitad del desierto fue entretenida. Recomiendo hacer el tour en la mañana para no toparse con toparse con tanto tráfico de helicópteros.
Ich dachte, der Blick von North Rim ist das Beste - aber der Flug mit Helicopter schlägt alles! Unvergesslich.

My boyfriend and I did the 45 minute tour which flew over the South and North rim of the Canyon. The views were amazing and our pilot (Felix) was great- the entire experience was perfect! We had a great time on our vacation in the Canyon but the experience on this ride definitely was most memorable. It also happened to be New Years Eve, definitely one that will never be forgotten. :) 

Recommend purchasing the video of your ride. We have watched it quite a few times since returning home just 2 weeks ago.
I loved this there are no other words to describe this must see must do adventure.  The views are far above anything you will experience.  The pilot was so friendly and knowledgeable.

this made the long drive to the grand canyon worth it . the views from the helicopter were spectacular . the pilot was very nice and made it fun . well worth the cost to see the views from this perspective

What can I say - we booked the trip through the travel agent at home and can only say that you get superb value for your money. The flight was amazing - the pilot was so full of amazing information about the locality, culture and was really fun and friendly. The flight lasted 45 minutes but felt like longer. Have no doubt about booking with this company, the experience was brilliant. And the views you get of the Grand Canyon were to die for!!!! The chopper was well heated so we didn't need the thick coats we we took.

review_title: Amazing view with best pilot - BJ!
review_text: This was my first helicopter ride and to enjoy it viewing the Grand Canyon was amazing. BJ gave us history, commentary, and awesome music to inspire our tour. The price is average when compared to helicopter tours. We checked in early, weighed in and got our instructions. BJ, thanks for the memories!

If you are here reading reviews, you should stop wasting your time and just book a reservation with Maverick right now. Viewing the Grand Canyon by helicopter is an amazing and unforgettable experience. It is evident Maverick puts in effort to make themselves a tier above the other companies and the standard for Grand Canyon helicopter tours. From the time we arrived everyone was professional and kind. The safety instructions were clear and concise. The helicopter was roomy and comfortable. BJ was our pilot and was extremely knowledgeable and fun to listen to along the flight. I'd request to ride with him again. I'm scared of flying and was never once nervous during the duration of the flight. The only concern I have is finding a time in my schedule to get back to the area to do it again!

Family vacations are meant to be memorable and special. Having included Maverick as a part of our Grand Canyon experience was exactly the right thing for us to have done. The 4 of us will never forget the wonderful sights of this amazing place and to experience the Grand Canyon by helicopter is something that everyone visiting the Grand Canyon do at least once. The family could not stop talking about the tour and Vern made every moment special with personal narration and flying that really makes the entire experience enjoyable. This will be a lifetime memory for my family.

This was the most amazing experience of our entire holiday. 45 minutes of thrilling helicopter ride over this most amazing breathtaking natural wonder. Take your camera , however unless you are sitting on the outside (near a door) it might be a little difficult taking photos. The pilot gives a running commentary during the trip and answers any questions you may have (every passenger has a head set). There is a video package available which captures the flight from under the helicopter and includes the commentary. Bugger the expense, for us it is a once in a lifetime experience so we did the whole deal. Thanks to the Maverick crew for making it such a great experience.

A great experience from the pickup  at hotel by our driver Mike to the flight from Las Vegas to Grand Canyon. The best was the ground bus trip again with driver/guide Mike to the South Rim and then the helicopter tour with pilot Luke over the snow covered canyon. Highly recommended.

Don't go for ant other tour except a full helicopter experience!! Picked up from hotel and then taken to airport to meet pilot.  You fly to the canyon no stupid 2hr coach trip there and same back! The pilot was funny and knowledgeable.  He really made the trip for us!  The views are stunning and the views from the helicopter are enhanced with so much glass!! 

There is no other way to see the canyon and the total experience we had with Maverick was 10/10 !

Every aspect of this experience was outstanding. The knowledge and detail of information shared by our pilot plus the wondrous experience of the view. We had a full 45 min in the air compared ot the 7 min. in the air from other providers which are located on the rim and just take passengers to the floor to stand in line to take a 15 min. boat ride. So glad I read the details and selected this experience. Thrilling but never a sense of danger. Would likely think twice about doing this in months with quick moving thunderstorms. Recommend booking early in your stay so as to provide options for rescheduling should inclement weather occur. You do not want to miss this opportunity!
We really enjoyed our helicopter ride over the Grand Canyon.  Beautiful views.  Our pilot was knowledgeable and friendly.  Loved it.

review_title: The best way to get introduced to the Canyon
review_text: We selected Maverick for the type of helicopter they fly:  lots of glass, everybody has a good view.  If you're sensitive to motion sickness try to get the early morning flight, definitely on a warm sunny day ( less turbulence).  We had a veeeery smooth flight.

Recently traveled to Phoenix and had to see the Grand Canyon while I was there. Scheduled a flight with Maverick. If it weren't for the scheduler I would have given 5 stars. There was some disinformation that caused me to be way too early for my flight based on earlier flights being already filled and seating arrangements which I discussed in detail with Karen at the South Rim location. BJ our pilot was knowledgeable and friendly. Flying over the trees and then entering the Canyon was breathtaking. Going from tree top level to a mile down is a memorable sight. We viewed a good portion of the Canyon and then later went to the park to take in the spectacle from ground level. Don't miss it. It's worth the trip.

I had never flown in a helicopter so was a bit nervous, but the pilot came over as being in charge and professional. As soon as we took off I was totally comfortable with the feeling. It was awesome. I had been picked up at my hotel at the precise time agreed and driven to the helicopter base to be matched with a group of others, with everyone being weighed to ensure the flight was not overloaded and the weight was spread evenly. There was a total wait of about 30 minutes before we were called to our helicopter. First we headed toward Hoover Dam and the pilot gave us some background details  before heading off to Grand Canyon, pointing out various points of interest along the way. There was a refuelling strop halfway and then we swopped seats to give everyone a chance of a good view. on the way back the pilot went a slightly different route back to Vegas so we saw as much of the area as possible, again what we were seeing and how the landscape was changing due to the low water level. We had a chance to buy a video of the flight and they presented us with a photo taken with the pilot just prior to take off as a memento. Not that I am likely to forget the experience in a hurry
An incredible way to see the Canyon. Thoroughly enjoyed our flight, all staff friendly and helpful. Would recommend.

I've read several reviews and after going on the tour myself some ppl do have good points. If you sit in the front the view is way better than if you sit in the back middle seats. I sat on the left window and my wife sat right window so we didn't have any issues at all. Our pilot was Robert and he was excellent! He was really nice and patient in everything. The views are spectacular and it was beautiful when you land inside the canyon. Only thing I wish is that the flight would be longer.

Every part of our trip was great. We were collected from our hotel and taken out to the Maverick base station. Our pilot was super friendly and really funny and the view of the canyon is just amazing. I couldn't recommend this experience highly enough.
We took a flight out to the Canyon prior to taking a helicopter ride into the canyon. Then taken on a bus into the park. All very professional. Well worth the money.

Would thoroughly recommend this tour with maverick if you go to Vegas 
The helicopters ( and I'm a nervous flyer) are beautiful and the pilots really make you fee settled and comfortable 
The views are breath taking the canyon itself truly peaceful and picture perfect 
We had a great time and flew back over he strip which really brought the tour to a brilliant ending 
Amazing !!!!

This was the best Bday gift my wife could have ever given me!!! Our pilot BJ, was cool, the helicopters were perfect, every seat is a great view, the tour was not to long but certainly not to short either. We got an incredible view of the canyon, so much so that we decided not to spend the extra cash to hit the park. I've been in many helos and if I could afford one I'd copy the Maverick style. I was afraid it was going to be a cheese ball 15 min run with a 30min preflight check,,, not so. It was the best money I've seen spent on tour to date.

review_title: What a way to see the Grand Canyon!
review_text:
My husband and I recently took a tour of the Grand Canyon via Mavericks Helicopter Tours.  Seeing the Grand Canyon this way was simply stunning!  If it is in the budget you should really do this.  However, I am not sure if it matters which company you choose.  I found out later that they all fly in the same path, as the air space is very restricted.  
I only gave Mavericks a very good, as opposed to excellent for two reasons.  The first was the knowledge of the pilot.  Technically he knew what he was doing.  Some of the tour information he gave was incorrect.  The second reason was the fuel surcharge.  Gas was around $2.15.  Why were we still getting a surcharge?

If you have such a thing as a Bucket List then this tour should be on it. Its something we quite fancied before we got to Las Vegas, so it wasn't hard to make that final choice to do the tour to the Grand Canyon with Maverick Helicopters.
We decided in the end to go for the champagne lunch tour which was 45 minutes flying, which included a fly past of Lake Mead, the Hoover Dam, then down into the Grand Canyon for a spot of lunch accompanied by the said champagne...which was delicious :-)
We had a group of six, so we all fitted into one chopper, flown by Brandon, who was excellent throughout. If I was to pick a fault in the trip then it would be that it was too short a day, we loved every second of it. Thanks Marvericks, a life-long memory for our whole group!.

We were on a group holiday and had the pleasure of using Mavericks Helicopter tours over the Grand Canyon.

The staff were very friendly and helpful. Chatting away with everyone, to kill time while they got used to the 'new' chip & pin system slowing down their computers!

Our pilot was B.J (well this is an ongoing debate. Some of our group think it was P.J others say B.J - so if you are reading this. I apologise for possibly getting your name wrong) He was a pleasure to fly with. Kept us all laughing the whole flight. While explaining all the breath taking views we were saying. Tried to answer our ridiculous questions! Which was very appreciated. He even didn't mind while we all wanted an individual picture with him in front of the helicopter. He even played photographer for us all!

I highly recommend this company if you are thinking of a helicopter flight over Grand Canyon. You wont be disappointed!

If you have time, please do a Grand Canyon Helicopter flight. We chose Maverick as we had heard of its excellent reputation.

We were picked up from our hotel taken to the airstrip and given a short briefing. Then it was strap in and up up and away. 

The pilot was very competent and knowledgeable, pointing out all the sights as we flew over them.

We landed down in the canyon to refuel, then up again to continue

This guy sure knew hoq to fly that helo.

All too soon we were flying back over the Las Vegas Strip and back to the airstrip to land.

Well worth a good if you can, and we would recommend these flights to everyone.

There are a number of different tours - choose one that suits you time wise, and your budget of course. This isn't a cheap outing..

review_title: A must do ... if your budget allows!
review_text: This was amazing! The pilot was friendly and flew the aircraft very well. The view from the air was something that can't really be described, you just have to experience it for yourself. Once on the ground in the Grand Canyon, it was amazing to look up to the top, and the sense of peace & calm (even though there are helicopters flying around), is again something I can't really describe (sorry), but it was womderful. The tour is only about 4 hours or so, but it's a fantastic 4 hours and beats sitting on a bus for 4 hours one way! :) The only 'downside' of this tour is that we only had about 30 minutes on the ground, and that time went way too fast... We did the Dream Catcher Sunset, which was beautiful, flying over the Grand Canyon at Sunset and back over Las Vegas as it was lighting up for the night, but if there is an option to have the sunset and a little longer on the ground, I would suggest that.. If not, do this one for sure!!!

Having always wanted to see the grand canyon we decided on this helicopter trip. Although quite expensive we thought it well worth the money. We were picked up from our LV hotel and taken by minibus to the take off point where we were given a safety briefing and met our co- flyers and pilot, Joe. The trip to the canyon took 45 min and was very smooth, which my husband appreciated as he hates flying!. A 15 min flight in and around the canyon followed before we headed back. As the flight was full ( 7 passengers plus pilot) we had a re-fuelling stop en route. At this point we changed seats so everyone could get a window seat during the trip. I would advise taking water with you before hand as they were charging $10 per bottle (in LV you can get 6 bottles/ $2.50 from local CVS store). The pilot was very informative and you could ask any questions. We finished by flying down the strip which was a sight to behold. The whole thing was videod (price extra) but there was no hard sell pressure to buy. Only snag was the US use a different DVD system to us so we had to get it re-formatted back home! Even so my land loving husband called it the best part of our holiday.

We took the Mavericks helicopter tour on Monday Oct. 19th. We were a little concerned about the weather at first, but the clouds and rain went away early that day. Our pilot, Vern, was amazing. He gave us an ultra smooth flight that was amazing and awesome. The sights are incredible. We took the 50 minute tour that flew us from the South Rim across the Canyon to the North rim and back. He was very engaging as our pilot/host. He gave us very useful info about the park ,as  well as the history of the Canyon and different formations that can only be seen by air. The views are simply the best. I would definitely recommend Maverick to anyone wanting to do a helicopter tour of the Grand Canyon. It was simply the best way to see the Grand Canyon.

Truly an awesome experience (such an overused word but, for once, the appropriate one.) Ben was our pilot and was great, very pleasant and informative. The moment we flew over the rim of the Canyon was unforgettable, as was the whole flight. Forty five minutes just whizzed by. Awesome!

My partner and I had never been in a helicopter before, and she is scared of heights, but BJ our pilot was excellent, he talked us through the journey and was informative about what we were seeing, he gave some background and history of the area, and put us totally at ease.  It is expensive but well worth the money as it is a once in a lifetime experience, would recommend it to anyone.  We flew from the Grand Canyon airport and everything went like clockwork, BJ checked if he had anyone on board that was afraid of heights, and the trip was incredibly smooth, the helicopter had good visibility and seated 7 passengers though we only had 5 on our trip, an excellent insight into the canyon for our first glimpse.

This is definitely the way to do a Grand Canyon tour from Las Vegas! Obviously much quicker than a bus tour if you're on a tight schedule and get great views of Lake Las Vegas, Hoover Dam, Lake Mead, The Grand Canyon, and also the Strip. 

Very professional company and pilot was very knowledgable and entertaining. The Grand canyon is truly spectacular.

As my first helicopter flight i was nervous, but the staff and our pilot Keith put me at complete ease.  The helicopter was a 6 seater with good all round views.  The ride was incredible, and the views equally so..

Travelled to the Grand Canyon Skywalk (platform over the edge) which was spectacular then flight back over the Strip.  Private transfers arranged by Mavericks to and from the hotel.

A complete must !!

i enjoyed the views obviously well worth doing if you are in vegas picked up early from the hotel no big delays. Very professional pilot would definitely recommend to anyone only drawback is the price its expensive

review_title: Take 3 things off your bucket list
review_text: in one word,AWESOME.4 hour tour that takes you to the Hover dam and the Grand canyon.Helicopter ride,Hover dam and Grand canyon are now off my bucket list.very professional pilots.felt totally safe all the time.we took about a thousand pictures.It is a little expensive,but totally worth it.our pilot was Kevin very friendly guy.This was a highlite of our trip to vegas.
Took the early morning flight with champagne breakfast in the Canyon included.  Totally professional company.  Our pilot (Matt ) was great.  Just do it!  Worth every dollar!!

review_title: Beautiful Canyon Tour, but disappointing middle back seat
review_text: This tour was one of the highlights of the Grand Canyon trip and the first time either of the two of us was in a helicopter. One of us was seating in a window seat in back and I was seated in a middle seat in back. I'm not sure I would have booked if I had known I was going to be the only person of the six guests sitting in the back row in the middle (one seat was left empty)...a 45 minute ride for $300 bucks is worth it unless you don't have any clear view of the canyon. My travel partner was thrilled and got some great photos, but I was disappointed.

We booked prior to departing for the USA.  Upon arrival at Grand Canyon the hotel phoned Maverick to confirm our arrival and details as requested.  You need a car to get to the 'airport' and from Grand Canyon City it is the 2nd entry road.  I mention this as there were people booked to come on the same trip we did but never made it in time due to going to the wrong place. We give Maverick 100% for waiting until the exact time that we were meant to depart, thus giving them all the time needed to catch the helicopter. 
For us it was a win as our flight had 4 people, so we  got front row seats.  Seating is decided by the pilot on he basis of weight distribution.

The views are beyond expectation once you are reach the canyon.  Words are inadequate to describe what your eyes are taking in, so I am not going to attempt to do it.

The helicopter trip is awesome as well, and much better than a small aeroplane in my opinion.  It has made me quite a fan of helicopters.

What an experience ,not to be missed . This is not a cheap day out but you cannot miss this opportunity to witness such a fantastic experience it is an unbelievable sight . We were promptly picked up from hotel reception and then taken to heliport ,given a safety brief then off to the helicopter ,pilot was fantastic very informative throughout the trip ,very very professional .Flew over hoover dam into the Grand Canyon landed in the canyon, champagne picnic flew back  over the strip what an unbelievable day AMAZING

review_title: Try not to sit in the middle back seat
review_text: We took the flight from Tusayan airport. Our pilot Ben was great – informative and amusing. The views are spectacular of course. But one of us was seated in the middle back seat and had a limited view. They say seating is determined automatically based on your weight but as helicopter veterans I know there's always a place for "tuning". So talk to them to make sure you don't get that seat.

From start to finish an awesome trip to a natural wonder of the world. Good flight to the canyon and wonderful helicopter ride over it. Very informative from all staff and guides made this a fantastic trip. Only criticism was an advertised gourmet lunch turned out to be an average sandwich,crisps cookies and water! Notwithstanding a wonderful day out well worth the cost.

review_title: AMAZING! You can't get this experience any other way!
review_text:
The team of staff at Maverick run an efficient service! They are welcoming and guide you through the helicopter experience, regardless if you are a first time or an experienced flyer. 

Our pilot was fantastic! Thanks Jake. He was a wealth of knowledge and took the time with each insidiously guest to make sure everyone enjoyed themselves! 

Absolutely amazing experience! I'd do it again and again!

Wir hatten die Canyon-Spirit Tour mit Maverick um 9 Uhr morgends gebucht. EIne halbe Stunde vorab checkt man ein, unterschreibt die Sicherheitsunterweisung und gibt Rucksack etc. ab. Mitnehmen darf man nur eine Flasche Wasser und die Kamera. Wir hatten die beiden Plätze vorne neben dem Piluten, der uns nett begrüßte. Zuerst fliegt man 10 MInuten über den Wald, schaut nach Tieren und gewöhnt sich an das Tempo und den Helikopter, bevor es mit über 300 km/h knapp über die Kante des Canyons geht - dieser Moment ist unglaublich und man unvergesslich. Die nächste halbe Stunde verging wie im "Flug" , wir querten einmal den Canyon, sahen und den Zusammenfluss vom Colorado und little Colorado an und der Pilot erzählte etwas über den Gran Canyon. Dies ist auch meine einziger Kritikpunkt - der Enthusiasmus des Piloten und die Ausführungen zum Canyon waren eher mager und Massenabfertigung. Abschliessend konntenoch jeder schnell ein Bild mit dem Piloten zusammen machen - that's it!

We took the Canyon Spirit flight at 9am September 18.  We had great weather and a great flight.  Winds were calm and there was no turbulence.  I booked the flight for four people a couple of weeks before our trip.  The Maverick helicopters on this route seat seven passengers (3 in the front, four in the back seat).  I figured that this gave of a five out of seven chance of getting a good seat for my wife who is 5' 1".  I did not want her to be stuck in a middle set in the back due to her height.  We checked in the morning of the flight and had to be weighed.  A person's weight is only visible to the person working behind the counter, so one need not feel embarrassed.  As luck turned out only one other person was scheduled for our flight so everyone got either a front or window seat.  Ben, our pilot, was knowledgeable about the area and spoke to us over the headsets throughout the flight, pointing out features and discussing history of the park.  He had a great sense of humor which made the flight more enjoyable.  He also paid attention to each passenger so that no one felt left out.  The views of the canyon were breathtaking especially when we first flew over the edge and the canyon floor fell away.  While the flight was not cheap, it was well worth the money.  It was the highlight of our 2 week vacation to Arches and Grand Canyon National Parks.  After the flight while purchasing photos and a DVD of OUR flight, my sister asked if they had a military discount since she and he husband were serving.  We were told no for the merchandise but were told the flight did.  After verifying the military ID, the staff went out of their way to manually reverse the charges for the already paid for flight and then charged the rate with a ten percent discount.  
Kudos to Maverick.

review_title: Maverick Helicopters is a great grand canyon experience - must do in Las Vegas
review_text: We got there, checked in, they were very polite and the Helicopters were very comfortable. Please be punctual, otherwise your transfer will leave without you. 5 stars for Maverick

review_title: Worth every penny and many more!
review_text: a thrill of a life time! One of the few things in life that you'd pay more than the asking price if they had you pay afterwards. The pilot was very professional and an excellent guide.

Celebrated my 60th birthday with a helicopter tour to the floor of the Grand Canyon with a friend. Our pilot Justin made it a pleasant and safe flight pointing out the scenic spots to take photos.  When we landed about 3500 ft above the floor of the canyon we were treated to champagne and nibbles.  Had time to take some more pics and flew on for a brief stop to take pics of Joshua tree.  We rotated seats which was great so everyone got to sit in front.  This was my first time  in a helicopter and I thoroughly enjoyed  the flight.

review_title: Not a Bump in the Sky!
review_text:
We did pre-book (via Titan tours UK) and flew at 9 am, weighed and put into groups so you will fly with other people, 6 in our helicopter. You get pre-flight notes to read and a small life preserver to wear (scary) in case you ditch into the Colorado river!

The take off was so smooth, straight up and you skim above the trees. They pipe music into your headphones like from 'Top Gun' and your pilot also talks you through everything, landmarks, speed etc. It takes a good 5 minutes to get to the rim of the grand canyon and I was very nervous about this part as I had heard that the 'up draft' will make it bumpy or push you upwards but no absolutely no change in our flight.

You think you are hovering but get told your speed is 200 kph. The view from up top is unbelievable, you just do not grasp the size of this place otherwise.

I would say to anyone put a helicopter flight on your list of 'Must do's' for the Grand Canyon.

I would also mention that when we later visited the rim in the afternoon by bus it was quite windy, is morning the best time for a flight?

review_title: Professional, Stunning and an AMAZING EXPERIENCE!
review_text: We went with Maverick Helicopters after seeing the video on you tube. They were above and beyond anything we had expected and trust me our expectations were high for the price we paid. WORTH EVERY CENT and more. They organised a pick up and drop off from our hotel door. We had an amazing pilot who was very informative and gave each one of us a turn up the front. We landed in the middle of the Grand Canyon Valley to be surrounded by absolute beauty. To top it off we relaxed with a delightful afternoon tea and Champaign. This was an amazing experience made even better because of Maverick. I would use them again and again and have recommended them to everyone I know that has gone over. Best way to see the Grand Canyon and with a professional and classy touch. The helicopters are spacious clean and very comfortable and with great views wherever you sit in the helicopter. Thy are a bit pricey but worth it. Best money I have spent on the best experience they provided me with.

review_title: Your "MUST DO" tour for the Grand Canyon
review_text:
Amazing experience! Unforgetable. The pilot was so friendly and made my first helicopter ride as easy and fun as he could.

The views are beautiful and landing in 2 different points gives you the oportunity to take better pictures than you can take in a normal tour.

If you are looking for a tour to exceed your expectations, try Mavericks Helicopter one!

This was my first helicopter ride and I was a little nervous.  Our pilot, Fred, put me at ease and it was a wonderful experience.  I can't even describe how breath taking the views of the Grand Canyon were.  Everyone we dealt with was very professional and friendly.  It was definitely worth the money and I can't recommend it highly enough.

review_title: Grand Canyon South Rim Tour & Helicopter Tour
review_text: What a great trip to the Grand Canyon! Everyone at Maverick was wonderful! Bruce was our tour guide & did a great job…fun & very informative! I was a little hesitant when booking to spend the extra $$ to take the helicopter ride in the Canyon. So happy we did it all! Views were breathtaking…you cannot fully experience the Grand Canyon unless you see it by helicopter! Our pilot was great. Maverick has this down to a science! So well organized! If you are considering this trip, do it all! You will not regret it!

review_title: Awesome - a MUST when you visit Grand Canyon.
review_text:
The Maverick Helicopter Tours is a very smoothly and professionally run business. Great staff in the reception building. You have restrooms here, a gift shop and a cafeteria.
The helicopters look brand new. They are specifically designed for sightseeing tours and offer excellent views for the three passengers in the front row and the two passengers in the back row seated by the windows. The two passengers in the middle seats of the back row have somewhat less good views.
I went on the 45 minute Weather Route, which gives you the longest time over the Canyon. Our pilot Justin was very nice, knowledgable and a really professional pilot.
This is really the best way to truly appreciate the grandness and beauty of the Grand Canyon. I highly recommend this tour. It is a bit pricey, but that goes for all helicopter sightseeing tours around the world.

review_title: Great way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: I looked at a lot of options before coming to the conclusion that Mavrick was probably the best rated helicopter ride over the canyon. There are longer rides, but truthfully a 40-50 minute ride is enough. The pilot was knowledgable and did a great job flying, even with a little bit of wind. The one thing I regret was being one of the interior passengers in the second row of the helicopter. The two interior seats of the back row have the worst views. The pilot assigns the seating, theoretically by weight distribution, but our flight was all about the same and I got the middle by luck of the draw. Still a great experience, just not as great as anyone in the front or the side two seats in the back.

My husband and I went on a Maverick Helicopter tour to the Grand Canyon.  It was a brilliant experience definitely is a bucket list thing to do.

The only criticism I would say is it was advertised picnic with Champagne when we reached the Grand Canyon and this consisted of plastic containers that had a few sliced celery and carrot sticks which were not fresh, cheese and cracker snack packet and one plastic cup of bubbly.  This could have been much better.

Excelente paseo, muy buena calidad en todos los aspectos.
Hicimos el paseo de la tarde que incluye aterrizar en el cañón con hermosas vistas, una mesa con champagne, quesos y unas frutas que sirve el propio piloto. Al regreso se sobrevuela Las Vegas con la caída del sol y las luces de ciudad.
La única contra es su costo un poco elevado pero no hay que olvidar que requiere una infraestructura importante y costosa

review_title: Great way to see the Canyon
review_text:
I have flown with them twice- very professional and a stellar view of the canyon. I will say though a lot depends on your pilot. My first trip was exciting and the pilot had great music to accentuate the trip.The second time the pilot was playing Yani and it did not add to the experience
I would recommend though as there is no other way to appreciate the immensity of the cnayon.

Booked this from the hotel. It was expensive but then driving would take 4 hours each way. The plane offered great views from the air and we had a few hours to explore once we landed. The bus and lunch were included so we went to Eagle Point first and then Guano Point. We didn't do the skywalk but then there was no point.
