You can easily stand on the edge (which appears to be further out) and still great the great views. Words cannot explain how amazing it looked. The staff were great and the pilot was very helpful with tips! Works just don't do this place justice!!

Booked this as a surprise for the family... it's a bit pricey, but well worth it. Great staff very friendly, they helped me via chat when booking it, answered all my question. if you are in the area THIS IS A MUST DO !

review_title: An amazing experience, I hope to do it again.
review_text: Our pilot was Brett - We came with a tour group and had pre-booked this flight over the canyon. We had been the the GCanyon earlier in the day but you cannot truly get the scale of it until you are in the air above it. The flight was exciting and Brett was a wealth of information, telling us every name of every butte and mesa we could see. On arrival you are weighed (Discreetly) and then you are called up by your pilot and giving a safety briefing. Then you are told where you are sitting - I was fortunate enough to be sitting co-pilot at the front so excellent views but my friends in the back also said could see fantastically so don't worry about where you are sitting. I strongly recommend dong the 45 minute flight over the 25 minute flight as it passes quickly and I can't imagine you'd see much in 25 minutes. Strongly recommended, a great way to view the canyon.

review_title: Disappointing Maverick Champagne Picnic Attraction to Grand Canyon
review_text:
Very disappointed with the tour. We got picked up from the cosmopolitan hotel and taken by minibus to the airport. we were the last the airport. We had a pleasant informative flight to the Canyon via the Hoover Dam. 
Arrived at the Canyon, had 1 1/2 glasses of champagne served in plastic beakers. Had no picnic and spent a short time in the canyon. Had a second stop on the way back to refuel.
Very disappointed from what was anticipate to what we got.

review_title: Grand Canyon from the air - Breathtaking
review_text: Our pilot Jake was amazing very knowledgeable put up with us 6 Ladies and kept us entertained for the 40-50 min flight. Got to see all the amazing sights, memories I will never forget. This was a once in a lifetime experience and worth every penny.

review_title: Breathtaking trip over top natural world wonder.
review_text: Chose maverick helicopters as they offered a 50 mins flight over the south  and North rims  and along and around the canyon. Seeing a lot more than the 15-20 min trips.     We weren't disappointed , visually. Stunning.........just as important maverick are  a very professional outfit , with  safety being of paramount importance.  Our pilot Patrick was equally professional but also very informative .    All in all an unforgettable experience. M&P

review_title: Best way to see the Canyon
review_text:
There is no better way to view the Grand Canyon than by helicopter. This company has a tremendous safety rating and well trained guides. We enjoyed our tour thoroughly. 

If you take the train to the Grand Canyon then you will have to arrange for a taxi to get you to the airport for this tour. We had no trouble accomplishing this, and it seemed to be a common occurrence. Just be aware that the helicopters are off-site and that there is no public transportation available.

My family and I chose the combined Canyon Dreamer and Canyon Dancer trip with Maverick. We flew from Las Vegas to Grand Canyon where we then took a helicopter tour.
After the helicopter tour we were taken by bus to Bright Angel at the rim of the Grand Canyon where we had time to enjoy a late lunch (provided by Maverick) and explore a little of the Canyon before returning to the airport and flying back to Vegas.
The whole trip was brilliant from start to finish and was even enjoyed by my wife who hates flying.  

All the staff were fantastic.  Our pilots Travis & Steven and our driver Darryl could not have done more to make this a trip to remember, however special thanks must go to Ben our helicopter pilot (I didn't know that a helicopter trip could be so smooth).  Everyone constantly made sure that we were ok and provided a stream of information about the Grand Canyon.

The only - very minor - hiccup was that our trip had to be moved from the morning to the afternoon but Maverick contacted me as soon as possible by phone and email to make sure that I received the message and offered a choice of alternative dates and times.

Overall a fantastic trip and a helicopter tour of the Grand Canyon is highly recommended!!
If you're going to the Grand Canyon, spend the money and do a helicopter tour. It's absolutely amazing. The views can't be replicated on land. I highly recommend it!

Non c'è modo migliore a mio avviso di vedere il Grand Canyon. Era la prima volta per me in elicottero ed è stata an Amazing Adventure come direbbero loro, abbiamo scelto il Canyon spirit tour della durata di 50 minuti circa e, sebbene il prezzo non sia proprio economico, vi assicuro che ne è decisamente valsa la pena. Il nostro Pilota Patrick è stato anche una guida eccezionale, molto disponibile e professionale. Gli elicotteri della Mavericks sono molto belli e recenti, l'organizzazione di tutto è stata perfetta, lo staff è molto cortese e attento al cliente, dal ragazzo al Desk dell'aeroporto a quello che ci ha aiutato a indossare cinture/giubbottino e cuffie per salire sull'elicottero. Il tour è completo, parti dal South Rim in direzione East poi si prosegue verso la parte North e chiudono con un passaggio in direzione West. Fantastico!! Assolutamente da provare almeno una volta nella vita!!

Well organised company with great helicopters in very good order, lovely guides and personal service. Totally recommend Maverick.
Refreshingly not commercialised in the canyon stop, rugged and bare as expected!
Good shop and facilities at the take off point.
If you purchase the photo and live outside the US be aware you will get charged tax on delivery!

Lo que pudo haber sido algo maravilloso resultó ser frustrante.
El pilotó no nos informó bien del trayecto y pudimos hacer bien sólo la mitad de fotos desde el helicóptero.
La visita al mirador fue demasiado corta.
SO worth it. My only complaint is that the trip was too short. I could have easily stayed up for another 30 minutes. Great, personable pilot. Good tour. So beautiful.

We booked the Canyon Spirit, Grand Canyon helicopter tour. It was truly amazing. The view from the helicopter is magnificent and really shows you how vast the canyon is. The helicopter tours do not fly over any of the public lookout areas, but covers all the canyon that is virtually not accessible to the public. The Maverick helicopters are very nice. They seat 5 passengers (excluding the pilot). The ride is very smooth and the seats are very comfortable. Every seat has an amazing view. I highly recommend the Maverick Helicopter Tour of the Grand Canyon.
Great experience, very friendly and informative pilot. Took the first flight in the morning at 7am. It was very quiet and peaceful when we landed in the Canyon. Highly recommended.

review_title: Highlight of our Grand Canyon trip!
review_text: This has been a bucket list item for me and it did not disappoint! My husband and I booked the tour for ourselves and our 2 boys (ages 9 & 11). It was pricey, but worth every penny. Maverick was well-organized and our pilot was experienced and knowledgeable. I'll never forget the experience of hovering over the tree tops, then "dropping" into the canyon. Truly breathtaking!

We booked this trip through Viator and are glad that we did. The pilot was friendly and knowledgeable and the flight was 'awesome'. The North rim is very different to the South rim and you got to see both on this 45 minute flight.

Everything is very well organized at Maverick's. Be sure to arrive 1/2 hour in advance !
The pilots are really professional. The music list on the craft is perfect and the overview over the canyon is breathtaking despite the rainy weather (August 25, 2015) we had during the flight).
It's a great experience you should not miss even it's a bit expensive. You can join two great pleasures : flying on a helicopter and discovering one of the most exceptional natural place in the world. For sure, enjoy this experience!

review_title: Loved landing inside the canyon! Like a slo-mo of Thelma and Louise going off the cliff but without the sad ending.
review_text:
Loved this tour. This was my first time in a helicopter and it was amazing! all the staff from the shuttle driver to the pilot were really knowledgeable and friendly. The hanger where you wait is great - lots of souvenirs, photos of the area and a little cafe. It's a nice, big open space to wait for your flight.

The flight out to the Grand Canyon was I'd guess just over twenty minutes and you pass over Lake Mead and the Hoover Dam. The pilot will give you lots of information about the area sprinkled with some little know facts and some humour. flying into the Grand Canyon and landing was amazing. The only downside is they don't give you enough time inside the canyon. We were landed and back out within half an hour - I could've spent a couple hours walking around the area. But they have a great landing spot with an amazing view for photos. The snack is not much more than what you would get on a standard airplane ride but you could bring your own snack and they give you some champagne!

On the flight back they stop for fuel (or at least they did on our trip) so you get another experience with landing and taking off. The stop is all of five minutes so not much waiting around but if I were the company I'd set up something at the landing spot just to give the tourists something to do...even if it's just some cheesy photo boards with those face holes cut in them for personal photos...or plant some different species of desert cactus or something. Although they probably want to discourage guests from venturing too far from their helicopter while it's refueling. 

Overall this was an extravagant tour for us but it was totally worth it and we had such a good time. But...we got engaged on the tour so we might be a little biased to how awesome it was.

wow a must do item. Great we were worried about air sickness there was none. A really professional outfit. Pilot jerry could have been more chatty but guy in gift shop made up for that. This was a superb experience

Nous avons choisi ce tour car nous souhaitions profiter du grand canyon au maximum. Quelle magnifique ballade. 
Encadrés par un pilote très pro, Matt, nous avons vécu une expérience hors du commun. 
Les paysages sont sublimes, à couper le souffle. 
De plus, ce parcours nous éloigne de la foule, nous avions l'impression d'être seuls au monde. Un luxe dans ce coin extrêmement fréquenté. 
Nous recommandons vivement cette promenade à tous les aventuriers en herbe.

We were advised by our hotel the Monte Carolo in Las Vegas of the options of Grand Canyon tours, we decided on maverick as it was only a short ride from our hotel. We were picked up in Ircondironed co for and whisked to the very professional offices of maverick... After a safety video we were greeted by our pilot Aaron, who was exceptional .  We had the most awe inspiring flight over the hoovered am and then on to the Grand Canyon he gave us lots of great and interesting info on the canyon and the surrounds including stories about  the Indians and the settlement of the area, his handling of the helicopter was fabulous and not once did we have any concerns!!! It was our first ever flight on a helicopter and it was fantastic... Landed on the side of the gorge for a champers and snack !!!! Pure heaven .. We all got to sit in the front which was great... Back to Vegas and a flight down the strip !!!! Wow... Perfect could not fault !!!

review_title: An amazing introduction to the Grand Canyon
review_text: We booked our helicopter tour on-line so were slightly anxious as to what it would be like. We arrived at the airfield, signed in and waited to be called by our pilot. We had BJ who was welcoming and reassuring to those of us who were less sure about getting into a machine powered by spinning planks of metal! Very quickly relaxed as we flew way from the airfield and approached the Canyon. Wow what a spectacular way to see this incredible place! The pilot gave us information about the Canyon and the helicopter as well as his flying experience. It was all very interesting. Thank you to all at Maverick helicopters.

The best view you can get of the Grand Canyon, the location lays on the way and is therefore super easy to find. They started a few minutes earlier and flew a little longer for that matter. Definitely the right company to choose, everything was very organized. Beautiful view and beautiful tour
We truly enjoyed the experience. Flying over the national park and finding yourself all of a sudden out the canyon is breathtaking. The experience is worth the price, from the moment you check in.

Area di decollo a pochi minuti in auto da Tusayan. Ben segnalato. Cortesia ed organizzazione già al check-in. In base al peso dei passeggeri assegnano il posto sull'elicottero. Noi fortunatamente eravamo il prima fila col pilota!! Lascia senza fiato l'attimo in cui sorvoli la foresta ed un secondo dopo sei sullo strapiombo mozzafiato del canyon! Luci, colori, forme, il Colorado river che ti scorre sotto i piedi.... Adrenalinico! Certo un pò costoso...ma é la dimensione giusta per "capire" davvero il Grand Canyon!

Professional company. They fly the EC130's which are comfortable (and reliable :)). I had one of the two middle seats on the backrow which limits the view a bit. Wife and daughters had window / front seats and thoroughly enjoyed their first helicopter tour. We were lucky with the weather, bright blue skies and great visibility. I can imagine you feel ripped off if it's cloudy.
The pilot was good, very informative.

I so nervous booking this trip as I am terrified of heights so booked and paid months before!  On the day I felt ill with nerves but I really wanted to do it, you only live once! As soon as we were up in the air I felt slightly better as it wasn't as scary as I thought it would be.  The trip itself was amazing with breath taking views although I was a bit disappointed when we landed as that area didn't show the Canyon's best bits!  For the time we had (less than a day) it was a great way to see it but if you have time I would say to do the drive if you can and it will be worth it (did it when I was 15 with parents) and the memory is still with me 20 years later!

Sin duda una experiencia única e interesante para visitar el majestuoso cañon del colorado. Helicópteros en excelente estado y los pilotos muy amables y respetuosos. Vale cada penny y tienes diferentes opciones de paseo incluyendo descenso al cañon.

what an experience! Fabulous views, felt surreal! Still can't believe the beauty of the place. We were lucky to go with Maverick Tours.  They were informative and determined to give the best views pointing out key features during the trip. My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed the trip and regularly talk about this tour as a highlight of our Route 66 road trip.
Excelente serviço, pontualidade, pilotos educados, helicópteros novos. Pssam bastante segurança. Hangar Marverick bem amplo e agradável.

This was the highlight of our trip to Vegas.  It was quite expensive but well worth it.  The view of the canyon and Hoover dam was spectacular and landing on the bottom of the canyon with a bottle of champagne was great.  The trip up the Strip on our return gave us a fantastic look at the Strip from the air.

Seeing Grand Canyon from a helicopter was without a doubt one of the most amazing things I did during my month in America! Come to think of it, it's probably one of the coolest things I've done in my entire life. The staff at Mavericks were very professional, especially our fantastic pilot BJ that gave us a very pleasant trip. This was my first time in a helicopter and Mavericks made it into a very pleasurable experience. I was on the 50 min tour and it was worth every cent!

Esperienza unica, eravamo al grand canyon village e abbiamo deciso di fare il giro in elicottero. Servizio ben gestito e puntuale. Giro di 45 minuti con sorvolo è spiegazione del canyon. Vista unica e scenari indimenticabili, indescrivibili. I posti sul l'elicottero vengono pre assegnati e noi siamo stati fortunati ad essere davanti di fronte al pilota.
Vengono trasportati 7 passeggeri e oltre alla musica vengono fornite spiegazioni dal pilota. In generale ottima esperienza.

“Maverick helikopter tur fra Grand Canyon”

5 af 5 stjerner Anmeldt 29 juli 2015   

Mellem mange andre gode oplevelser i U.S.A var denne 45 min flyvning over Grand Canyon en af de største. Vores pilot, B.J, var fantastisk. Og ja - denne tur er faktisk pengene værd.

Booked the Grand Canyon Discovery Tour and very unimpressed with how short the flight time was (less than ten minutes total) with a short photo op stop on a ridge in the canyon.  Our pilot appeared more interested in 'chatting up' his previous guests which he was flying back to Las Vegas after our tour.  He left us waiting 15 minutes at the gate with a very embarrassed hostess trying to get his attention, and then was abrupt and rushed us along, presumably to return to his previous guests.  We are a family of five, all adults, and were quite excited looking forward to what we thought would be a highlight of our trip.  Save your money and tour the rim.  Photos just as good.  As a comparison, we recently took a scenic flight over the Whistler Glaciers that was advertised as a 30 minute flight.  Our flight time was almost double and the pilot was engaged, providing an amazing narrative of what we were seeing.  So much better!

review_title: Fantastic way to finish off a Grand Canyon visit
review_text:
I decided to go "all in" and book this tour, and was NOT disappointed!  Our pilot was fantastic and the entire process was seamless and well orchestrated.  The entire flight was captured on a DVD which we purchased.  Maverick seems to understand what people want out of this sort of trip and do their best to accommodate it (selfies with the pilot, for instance) while maintaining efficient and safe operations, and I really appreciated it.  The pilot narrated the trip, telling us when to get our cameras ready (for instance that first ground drop when we fly over the rim).  

Highly recommended bucket list item.  Just do it (the advice given to me)
We had an enjoyable ride and saw spectacular sights of the Grand Canyon.  Well informed tour.  Only downside it was half an hour rather than the 40 to 50 minutes suggested on booking.

fantastic experience flying over the grand canyon in a small plane that sits only 6 passengers. pilots were awesome in their knowledge of the canyon as well as friendly and welcoming. (p.s they were spunky looking too!) didnt take the helicopter tour  and regret it. would have been awesome to take one.

BJ's amusing comentary put eveyone on the flight at ease aswe cruised over the plateau but all were stunned as the ground fell away as we crossed the South Rim and looked down into the Grand Canyon. The views were stunning and the knowledgeable pilot made it a great trip for all.

review_title: The best experience of my life!
review_text: We did the Silver Cloud helicopter tour - this was a helicopter trip out to the Grand Canyon, past the Hoover Dam, and a quick stop to refuel. I would HIGHLY recommend this trip. It meant you still saw everything without having to go outside in 45 degree weather in the middle of the desert. Our pilot was amazing and gave us a great tour. I hope to do this helicopter trip again one day. The views were breath-taking.

This is a must do for anyone visiting Las Vegas. I researched all the companies that do helicopter tours to the Grand Canyon and decided to go with Mavericks because of the positive reviews on trip adviser, and I'm glad I did. It was a little more expensive than others but it was so worth it. 
Mavericks goes down into the canyon a tiny bit further than the other companies and the photos we got were great. Make sure you pay a little extra and do the sunset tour, definitely the way to go!

only booked the basic canyon flight NO LANDING,but what a fantastic experience.
We flew over the Mojave desert ,then the Hoover dam and dropped over the west rim of the canyon unable to take in the vast size of this natural phenomena.
If you are thinking about doing the same Please Land and stand at the base of the canyon,
would recommend this travel firm to all professional welcoming service.

We booked this trip for my brother's 50th birthday what an amazing day it was we were picked up from hotel and driven to airport where we were weighed, as there were 5 of us we shared trip with two others. Our pilot Tony put us at ease and gave us great commentary and jokes on the flight over, we landed in the canyon where we had a snack and drink and we all sang happy birthday! We changed seats for the flight back so everyone had a great view. Yes this trip is expensive but worth it for the experience it was out of this world and we still talk about it now and watch DVD which we purchased highly recommended couldn't think of a better way to celebrate your 50th if you go to Vegas make sure you do this trip,
One of the nicest helicopters I've ever been in. Our 50 minute flight enabled us to see views that would be unable from any other method. Highly recommend this.

I booked the 45 min. Grand Canyon tour for our family (2 adults, 2 daughters 19 and 13).  I had to confirm the flight 48h beforehand and was reminded of things to prepare (be in time, bring your ID, etc.).  Reception was very professional and super friendly.  This company is well organized!
Our pilot Felix was super nice, gave clear instructions before take-off and was a perfect guide during the flight.  He was very understanding and kind when our youngest one got motion sick.
The 45min. flight was really 45 min. and not less as I read about other companies.  We were lucky to be just 4 in helicopter with 7 passenger seats so we all had perfect vision.  I wonder though how the vision would be for the 2 middle passengers in the back seat.
You haven't seen the Grand Canyon if you haven't done this ride!

We had the helicopter tour on the Grand Canyon. Great experience due to the fantastic place. Addizionally check-in and flight preparation with Maverick absolutely smooth.
Our pilot, BJ was an additional plus, with good explanations, jokes to get a relaxed atmosphere (for all 6 persons was the first helicopter flight).
To make a long story short: a perfect day at Grand Canyon. Thanks Mavericks and BJ!

We took a Grand Canyon Helicopter ride and rafting trip booked with Maverick Helicopters - it was fantastic - When we booked I had seen the comments on tripadvisor and I tried not to be put off by the price. I am so glad I wasn't - it is expensive but this trip was worth every penny - it was amazing. Our pilot Joe was so knowledgeable about the area and was so professional.  Our Rafting Guide Scotty (not with an 'H') was so passionate about the Colorado River and made the trip lively and fun. Truly a trip to remember.

Буря эмоций, подготовка к полету, взвешивание, вводная инструкция - так начиналось наше маленькое путешествие. Экскурсия длилась около 4 часов, с посадкой в каньоне и маленьким пикником. Предложили фрукты и шампанское, 
к которым мне совсем не хотелось притрагиваться после перелета и всего увиденного. А увидели мы за это время немало! Нас окружали завораживающие виды дикой природы Гранд Каньона, мы пролетали над озером Лас Вегас, видели озеро Мид,  потрясающее сооружение - плотину Гувера, под нами была Огненная  долина, которая пылала в солнечных лучах, в завершение нам показали Вегас сверху, посмотрели на Downtown и Стрип. Конечно же сувениры, фотографии на память об улетно-вертолетной экскурсии. Обошлось на человека 500$.
Justin was a great pilot and we had the best time. Totally unique way to see the Canyon and highly recommend!

My wife and I took this tour earlier today and there just aren't enough words to describe how incredible this was, I don't think we'll ever forget this. The pilot did a great job and really added to the trip. If your not sure who to book with with maverick, an easy 5 star review

It was the first time on a helicopter tour!  The pilot is extremely friendly.  Depending on the type of tour your choose you will hear a recording of the sites in your headset.  When you first lift off it takes a minute or two for the cool air to kick in.  Other than that the view is magnificent.

I felt this was a definite highlight of our visit to the Grand Canyon! Our pilot, Brett, was professional and knowledgable. I was concerned that I might struggle with motion sickness since I do not enjoy amusement park rides, etc. but there were no worries as it was a very smooth ride. Of course the scenery speaks for itself, and Brett did a great job highlighting the many unique geological and botanical anomalies to the GC. I encourage anyone to trust Maverick for this once in a lifetime ride.

review_title: Fantastic Experience with a Great Company
review_text:
Maverick had been recommended to us, but we had been researching on the internet and had decided Maverick was the company for us.
We did have to call them in our arrival in Vegas, as on leaving the UK , it was uncertain whether the trip would run, due to numbers.
Everyone was helpful and professional from start to finish.
We opted for the fixed being plans to the Canyon itself, then the helicopter to the bottom.
Once at the Canyon you can hop off and on the buses to take you to the different points, we had a good look around the traditional homes and houses. Lunch albeit at around 9.15 in the morning was very nice and filling. We had been up around 4 am, for the pick up before 5am. We visited in April and the temperature in the Canyon early in the morning was -1 , so need to dress for that.
An amazing trip, and can't speak highly enough of the Maverick team.Thank you

review_title: Amazing Experience with an Amazing Company
review_text: This was one of the attractions i most wanted to do - i put a lot of research into this and spoke to a number of friends in my home town about going by helicopter to the canyon - each time Maverick was recommended.  I started to look into their website for the different tour options - i then had a live conversation with one of the staff who was very patient and helpful with me on the other side of the world.  I could not speak highly enough of the assistance given to me with the options that i wanted - it ended up being quite easy to choose once i was talked through the various tours.  The tour was more than what i expected - it was absolutely fantastic.  Connor was our pilot - one of the nicest tour guides i had during my 6 week holiday in US/Canada.  Do yourself a favour and look no further than Maverick Helicopters for an amazing experience in flying to the Grand Canyon - worth every US $$$$ that i paid.

Au départ de l'aéroport de Tusayan, il  ne faut que 10mn de survol au dessus de la forêt pour atteindre notre but. nous avons donc largement eu le temps de survoler de long en travers le grand canyon. Sa dimension est encore plus impressionnante . Notre pilote fournissait toutes les explication souhaitées et s'est montré très vigilant à notre confort. Tout le vol s'est fait en musique, un moment inoubliable.

We booked with Maverick because of the reviews and my conversations with them when booking - very professional and we are very Happy with our experience.  Our pilot, Patrick, did a great job and gave us memories to last a Lifetime!!!

review_title: What a great way to see the canyon!
review_text: Took a tour in the morning for about 50 minutes. This is an excellent way to see the canyon and to learn about its history. I would definitely recommend it. It isn't cheap but it is worth it. We had head phones on and could talk to each other as we flew.

We wanted to go to the Grand Canyon whilst we were in Las Vegas.  There are a lot of tour companies to the Grand Canyon, but 4 hours worth of travelling in one day was not appealing, so we decided to go with Maverick Helicopters.  
They take off from Vegas airport (15mins from Vegas Strip) fly to the Grand Canyon which is about 30mins with an amazing scenic flight over the desert, land into the Canyon, have a lovely champagne lunch, time for pics and marvel at the wonder of the Grand Canyon, then jump back in your helicopter and make the 30min flight back to Vegas which is amazing coming back over the strip.  
Maverick are a professional and safe operator with friendly and informative crew.  
I would highly recommend this experience!

Toured the Grand Canyon with my 2 adult daughters and 6 month old grand daughter. We were a bit hesitant putting my grand daughter on a helicopter but the employees eased our fear and we all had a great time. Our pilot BJ was very informative and a ton of fun! Highly recommend this tour and this company. Thanks for the memories!!

Plan ahead.  We originally made reservations for a late afternoon flight.  However, early in the morning we received a call advising they could not confirm our late flight because they lacked enough bookings.  They moved us up and confirmed an earlier flight.  Fortunately, we were already close to the airport.  Note:  They do disclose this possibility.  The staff was wonderful, the pilot was extremely friendly and went out of his way to answer all our questions and explain the canyon's many features.  He even remembered everyone's names.  The helicopter was quiet and you can freely talk to everyone on board through the provided headsets.  Don't miss this exemplary opportunity to view the grand canyon.  You can also buy a video of your flight, complete with audio.

Five of us had a chopper to ourselves for our tour of the Grand Canyon - what an experience!!  This excursion was doubly exciting for us, as it was the first time we had been in a helicopter AND the first time we had seen the Grand Canyon.  We came straight to the airfield from Sedona, checked in quickly and were soon escorted to our copter by our pilot.  After a brief safety talk we were strapped in, put our headsets on and we were off!

The pilot was a lot of fun, making some good jokes along the way.  Of course the real star was the Canyon itself, which is beyond description.  Nothing can prepare you for its grandeur - and flying along at 200 feet off the ground en route makes for a staggering experience as the ground drops out from under you and you are over a mile above the Colorado River in a blink of an eye!  Lots of gasps from everyone!!

This trip comes highly recommended, and Maverick did a great job showing us the sights and making us all feel safe and secure.

We booked a trip before we headed to Vegas with Maverick Tours and it turned out to be one of the highlights. We choose an early tour (5:20am hotel pickup) but it was well worth it because we were back in Vegas for 11:30am. From the hotel pick up to the drop off the staff were great but a special mention to Chris our pilot. He was very informative, laid back and good laugh. He gave a good running commentary on the way out and told us what to see and do. And being so early we had the Skywalk to ourselves which was a real bonus. Overall a great day out and would highly recommend

review_title: Great experience for my son in wheelchair
review_text: Most of the people can hike, walk,explore The Grand Canyon. But people with disabilities can not do a lot of things to really know this wonderful place. Flying over the Canyon was the best experience ever for my son in wheelchair and the whole family. All the seats are great. Expensive but definitely worth it!

This flight was a revelation and even if one visits all the overlooks along both rims of the canyon  you cannot comprehend the immense magnificence before you but on this flight this wonder unfolds as one is taken on the flight and we took the 45 min option (pre -booked ) . There is before the flight procedures to go through which  involve waiting and might irritate some people but this is to do with safety especially on weight distribution within the helicopter. As for the flight itself it was as one would expect carried out in a very professional manner with a commentary by our great pilot Jake (no sudden moves,very smooth ride). We as part of the M/bike group could talk to each other and Jake during the trip.I also felt the same sense of exhilaration within the "copter as riding my motorcycle.All praise to Maverick Helicopters.

This is a MUST DO if you ever go to the Grand Canyon!  Although we didn't make prior reservations, Patty worked her magic with the other team members and was able to get us a flight that same day.  She rocked!!  Felix, our pilot, was wonderful!  He was friendly, attentive and very knowledgeable; most importantly, he made us feel very comfortable and explained each part of the canyon as we flew over it.  I was fortunate to have the front passenger seat which gave me the most unobstructed views; however, there isn't a bad seat as the helicopter has stadium seating.  After landing back at their terminal, Felix offered to take photos of us in front of the helicopter even though they had their own photographer who took photos prior to take-off which you can purchase in their gift shop, as well as a CD of your flight.  Overall, our experience was exhilarating and well worth the price.  We HIGHLY recommend choosing Mavericks Helicopter Tours!

We took the Grand Canyon landing tour for our anniversary and it was a fantastic experience. They are a quality company using modern helicopters. This tour takes you over the Hoover Dam en route to the Canyon before working its way back. There are 3 legs in total but the first leg is the hero of the tour and if you can be up front for this segment you will be well rewarded.
Das hat sich gelohnt. Hubschrauber, Pilot und das was wir sehen durften.....eine klare Empfehlung. Die frühe Tour ist zu empfehlen. Alles professionelle.

We were hesitant when quoted the price, but bit the bullet and are glad out from Vegas for the skywalk. Pay a bit more and do it properly.

The pilot we had was a straight-up-and-down guy, didn't say much and left us to do our thing. Staff were a bit salesy when in the lobby but you get that everywhere in Vegas.

Overall, awesome. Do it.

I waited fifty years to see the Grand Canyon and my husband treated me to the Maverick Helicopter ride.  Being frugal all my life I have to admit it was money well spent.  We hope to fly with Maverick again, except next time it will be out of Las Vegas and landing in the Grand Canyon for lunch!  Our tour guide was wonderful.  He was knowledgeable of the geological significance of the area as well as the historical background.  We loved his choice of flying music as well;-)

Fantastisk tur med en pilot som hjälpte mig attkomma över skräcken! Mycket vacker tur med lagom information. Jag är mycket nöjd med turen, bemötandet och allt. Tyvärr blev vår video inte lyckad men jag fick i stället en annan. Tack

I've been to the Grand Canyon a few times - always to the South Rim, like most people.  When my wife said she'd never been and it was on her bucket list, I started planning.  I figured this would be a once in a lifetime trip, so I planned big.  Maverick came highly recommended by our Sedona concierge (see L'auberge de Sedona) and I'm so glad!  Maverick was excellent.  Even on a breezy day, the whole crew made us comfortable.  The tour was amazing and there is simply NOTHING like coming over the trees on the North Rim to the wide open view of the Canyon - NOTHING.

review_title: We went in a plane - what a day!
review_text:
Organised, well timed and worth the money. Our hotel pick up was at 10.30am and we were back by around 5.30pm so much quicker than the coach! At lunch there were some people who had come on the coach (we heard them talking before) fast asleep on the benches!

We paid the extra and went on the Skywalk - this is the stop we got off at first. We didn't have time to fit in the first stop at the ranch. It was worth the experience of being so high up. There was lockers for your things. You can't take photographs from the Skywalk but there are photographers there who will take your photograph if you ask them. We purchased our photos (I think they were about $16 each). In a way this annoyed me as I hate feeling that I am being forced to spend more money but it did mean that everyone flowed nicely around the Skywalk and you just weren't dodging everyone taking a selfie!

We then stopped at the third stop on the bus for lunch - a BBQ lunch with salad and a drink which was more than suitable sat by the Grand Canyon. Can't really complain! We then took the walk (they said 15 minutes it was probably that as we climbed to the highest point to have views to the bottom of the canyon.

A great day out!

Maverick Helicopter Tours were professional from beginning to end. We called from Canada and they answered any questions we had. My wife's first experience so she was very nervous and didn't sleep much the night before or eat much before going but the staff was very reassuring and our pilot Billy was very caring and informative he was so knowlegable. The Grand Canyon tour experience was a once in a lifetime and Maverick tours made it a very enjoyable one. We would recommend this company to anyone even remotely thinking they could not do it, they will make the experience easy for you.

To take a helicopter trip over the Grand Canyon was high on my bucket list and the trip with Maverick did not disappoint. The attention given by the pilot and all the ground crew was first class and added to the trip. Of course, the star of the show is the canyon. Well worth it.

Let's face it, the Grand Canyon is one of the most spectacular sites in the world. So seeing it by flying over it and into it is going to be amazing no matter what.

Maverick did a great job on the phone, in the facility before the flight, and in the air. I had a great time and felt confident in their safety and security and comfort.

This is a bucket lister for sure. We called one day ahead and made the reservation with ease. I must say the young men who answered the phone had some of the nicest manners I have heard in a while.  The reservation was easy, and although they couldn't provide transport to the airport, we got a cab through the front desk at the Maswik. It was 27 bucks each way for 4 adults to be driven out of the park and into the little town of Tusayan where the airport was located.  The office is very nice with comfortable seating, gift shop, snack bar, clean restrooms.  They weigh you, and then you wait til your pilot comes and calls your group. We were a family of four, plus 2 singles, and the pilot, with one empty seat. They tell you where to sit according to weight distribution, so no fights about getting the front or back row.  Our pilot was BJ. and he was very clean cut and personable and prfessional. He also cracked a few jokes and posed for a pre flight pic. He tells you all the rules, is very calm and reassuring. This was my second heli flight so I knew what to expect, but nothing can prepare you for the moment the craft flies over the edge of the canyon. What a freakin thrill. We flew over the canyon for about half an hour before heading back over the rim and back to the airport. The whole time B.J. pointed out landmarks and answered questions and cracked jokes.  This trip provides you with unparalleled views. They also video tape the whole flight so you can enjoy it later without having to worry about a viewfinder. Highly recommend it if you can swing it moneywise, you will not be sorry.

El Grand Canyon es un maravilla de la naturaleza. Pero volar en helicóptero sobre el cañón es una maravilla de la tecnologia. El que pueda pagarlo, no debería dudar de volar con Maverick... Sus modernos Eurocopteros son muy silenciosos, cómodos y seguros. Sus pilotos y guías son de primera... Volar fue impresionante... La belleza y grandeza del cañon es indescriptible ... Muy recomendable

What can I say, AMAZING. Our pilot Matt was brill and made everyone feel at ease, he gave us an amazing trip. A must if you going to Vegas, you won't believe how beautiful it is until your standing at the bottom and looking up towards the sky, then you see how big it is.

Nous avons pris le grand tour: transport de l'hôtel au bureau Maverick à l'aéroport. Une quarantaine de minutes de vol pour arriver au grand Canyon, des vues à couper le souffle. Arrêt dans le canyon avec collation et champagne. Arrêt au Skywalk. Dîner. Retour en Hélicoptère mais pas par le même chemin. Hallucinant! C'est dispendieux mais ça vaut vraiment la peine!
Notre pilote Matt a été d'une très grande gentillesse et très agréable.

Maverick Helicopter Tours are an extremely professional outfit. It was a slick check in service. BJ (our pilot) was fantastic. He was knowledgeable and patient with our 2 young kids. 
The actual experience was brilliant and will stay with me forever.

Nous avons pris le circuit de 40 mn comportant un temps de 20mn au fond du canyon. Le temps était beau et nous avons bien vu par les vitres.  Par contre, nous avons été déçus du temps de vol. Celui-ci est amputé de tout le temps avant et après le vol (préparation, ...). Nous avons donc eu vraiment 12 mn de vol pour 165$ par personne. Le temps de descendre de la plateforme du haut pour aller à celle d'en bas et inversement.

The helicopter tour was so memorable and such a good experience that it is definitely worth the price! Words can describe the whole experience, but I guess it really did make a deep impression!

Went on the helicopter with just my family, and we just toured around the Grand Canyon! Not sure whether we saw everything, but it was enough already for sure! The staff were friendly, and explained clearly what we were going to do etc...

This was by far the most exciting thing my husband and I have ever done! The terminal is beautiful and staff very friendly and professional. We took pics with the pilot next to the helicopter prior to flying. We boarded with several others and belted up and put on headphones so we could hear the pilot. My husband and I were in the back but had great views. The helicopter took off and flew over the forest and it was great. All of the sudden, we flew over the edge of the canyon and it felt like we went off the edge, but we weren't falling. It's literally breathtaking. It was so surreal, there really are no words. We flew over the majestic beauty of the Grand Canyon about 40 minutes while our pilot pointed out all the landmarks. It is 
something you have to see to believe. We returned to the terminal, took more pics, then had the opportunity to buy the ones taken with the pilot for $19, and you could also buy a DVD  if you wanted. We drove off in awe! This was expensive, about $545 for both of us, but worth every single penny! Do this for yourself!

review_title: WOW what more can I say!
review_text: This was without a doubt the highlight of our visit  to the Grand Canyon National Park. Our pilot BJ was personable, and a proficient and able pilot. He took us effortlessly over the edge and beyond, explaining what we were seeing. The Canyon was stunning and we took loads of pictures. We even saw the few remaining bison from a herd someone tried to introduce high on the plains on the north rim. It was a beautiful day in every sense of the word. If you have the chance you should definitely do this. We have seen some amazing sights and seen some incredible things on our travels and this rates alongside the very best.

review_title: Awsome helicopter trip to the Grand Canyon
review_text: One of those things that should be on your bucket list. The Maverick helicopter ride to the Grand Canyon. What a friendly professional company and our pilot, Kevin, was fantastic. The experience of a lifetime. We highly recommedn it.

From the time you ring to confirm your booking for the Grand Canyon flight up to the time you are back at your hotel, this is a superbly smooth, well organised experience. Everything is done extremely well, and of course, landing in the Canyon is wonderful. We have had lots of interesting experiences around the world, but tis was the absolute tops. Thank you.

The moto for our trip was just say yes and do it so when the chance to ride in a helicopter over the canyon we jumped at the chance and wow was it worth it :D 

The pilots are all really friendly helping you get ready for the tour and then make excellent tour guides over the canyon the views were stunning a completely different perspective from hiking the canyon. That first moment when you fly over the edge and the canyon drops beneath you is amazing. 

You can take as many photos as you wish and even make videos if you wish, the tour last approx 45min and if you are considering it then just go for it u will love it :)

We booked this company through Via-tor in order to see the Grand Canyon.We wasn't disappointed. Although the we had to reschedule due to the weather( by one day) it is certainly worth it Our pilot Mark (think that was his name) did us proud. We saw as much of the canyon as is possible(we had the 45/50 minute tour).Any questions that any of us asked he answered with the knowledge and knowing what he was talking about. When you fly out over the pine trees is something but then you can see the edge of the canyon then suddenly the ground drops away and you are over the canyon in all it's glory.Really would recommend this experience.

This is one of the great aerial trips the world has to offer.  We flew from Grand Canyon Airport and out over the park and it blew our minds. We had a personable, funny young pilot by the name of Ben and we opted for the longer (45-50 mins) flight. Yes it's expensive (about USD 275/pp) but worth every penny. The Mavericks ground staff were friendly, smart and informative. All in all a great experience and highly recommended.

I did the 45(?) minute flight in September and was lucky enough to be sat in the front (they take everyone's weight and distribute people to seats accordingly)! Views from the front were fantastic and my friends in the back didn't complain about their view so I am sure they experienced the great views too.

Our pilot was fantastic and answered all our questions and was humorous at the same time, providing us with an experience that I am sure none of us will ever forget. He even flew us right up to a huge rock within the Grand Canyon and gave my friend the power to decide when to turn! 

Possibly one of the greatest experiences of my life and very thankful to have been able to do it!

review_title: The only way to really see the Grand Canyon!
review_text: My husband, I and our 11 year old daughter took the Grand Canyon tour this spring. Before our scheduled flight we rode up to the park overlook and spent some time seeing the Canyon by foot at the overlooks.  However, once we got in the helicopter and dropped over the rim and into the canyon, I knew that the helicopter view was the only way to really experience the canyon. Our pilot Fred made us feel very comfortable and made our daughter's day by pointing out different aspects and features of the canyon. He pointed out the earthquake fault line and we were all amazed!  To be a mile up over the Colorado river was amazing! This was a trip none of us will soon forget.

review_title: Fantastic way to travel to the Canyon!
review_text:
Fantastic experience and the best way to travel to the Grand Canyon from Vegas. Todd and Eddie our pilots to and from the North Rim were so friendly/enthusiastic and
made the trip even more enjoyable. Our helicopter pilot for the Grand Canyon, sorry name escapes me, was also very friendly and knowledgeable. The views form the helicopter will live with me for a long long time and plenty of opportunities for photos too! Glynn our guide for the day was great company, with in depth knowledge of the area, mixed up with some humour and jokes along the way. Thanks Glynn!  This is the only way to see the highlights of the of the Grand Canyon.

Pense numa das coisas mais incríveis que você vai fazer na sua vida.Entrar no Grand Canyon de helicóptero certamente será uma delas.Tomamos  café ,pousamos perto do rio e depois voltamos.Não é um passeio dos mais baratos,mas valeu muito.Faria novamente

Proffsigt trevligt bemötande redan när man skulle checka in för att få följa med.
Mycket fräscha lokaler att vänta i innan turen började.
Vi hade en mycket ung, fantastiskt trevlig kille pilot.
Turen var angenäm redan från det man gick från vänthall ut till helikoptern sen var allt väldigt bra uppstyrt och man kände sig väldigt välkommen som gäst.
Flygningen tog ungefär 45 minuter och förutom den hissnande upplevelsen att flyga ut över canyonen för att se vyerna så var piloten påläst och förklarade det mesta om historien bakom samt pekade ut speciella landmärken.
Har ni du/ni möjlighet så är detta en fantastisk grej att göra, helt klart ett minne för livet

Great trip with Pilot Marcus.  The best and with great music.  Thanks again for Detours travel and Montana for taking us to Maverick for the best helicopter tour of the Gran Canyon.  We traveled from PHX with Detours travel.  Pilot Marcus was the best.

My Husband had secretly booked a helicopter flight over Grand Canyon, and knowing I'm afraid of heights didn't tell me till the night before, so to say I was a little apprehensive was an understatement!
Beside the pilot there where seven of us in the helicopter, once we had all our safety briefing and where well and truly "belted" in we had our headphones and mikes and where chatting to each other, I didn't know we was of the ground!
Our pilot BJ was talking to us all with little comic comments that had us all relaxed, when we reached the grand canyon and you fly over the edge you go from 50 feet up to 5000feet up and it was an "Oh my God" moment because the views where unbelievable,
BJ was very informative we spent the best part of 45mins actually flying over the canyon an hour in total, but it felt like no time at all.
If you are going to the Grand Canyon you MUST do this tour with Maverick it's once in a lifetime and it's the only way to see the beauty that is "The Grand Canyon".

Used this company for our Grand Canyon Experience...WOW.  Very professional company..picked us up from our hotel and returned us in a limousine type vehicle.  The staff at the airfield were lovely...our pilot Robert again was lovely.  He was very knowledgable about the entire area and he was very interesting to listen to......all the helicopters were brand new, very comfortable and wherever you sat you had a fantastic view.   We paid extra to land in the Grand Canyon for bubbly and snacks (well worth it)...would highly recommend this company.

I had never been in a helicopter before and was a bit nervous.  However from the second we lifted off I had no problems.   The pilot, BJ, clearly knew what he was doing and expertly piloted us to the most breathtaking scenery I've ever seen, all the while giving humorous and knowledgeable commentary about where we were and what we were seeing.  If you can justify the expense this is entirely worth it and the most amazing way to see the canyon. 

Amazing!!!

review_title: South rim Grand Canyon helicopter tour with Maverick
review_text: Recently did a helicopter tour over the south rim of the Grand Canyon. Great chopper with great views for all 6 passengers, we travelled in their 7 seater Eco craft which had great wrap around windows enabling fabulous views. We had a lovely pilot who was extremely professional & careful. All  flights are a tad expensive but definitely worth it. We spent €526 in total for 2 people for a 50 minute trip, recommend this company.

We did the airplane tour only and had a great time. The planes were smart and the staff wonderful from the pilots to cabin crew, to the characters driving the bus which took us to the canyon hotspots.

I would recommend Maverick Wholeheartedly.

The day tour is full and enjoyable but not taxing.

We chose the tour which included champagne lunch, first time for us all in helicopter but pilot made us feel very safe he was brilliant. He answered all the questions with confidence and knew what he was talking about. The flight was absolutely breath taking and the view was superb, Shame we never got to do the skywalk!

review_title: How do I begin to describe it?!
review_text:
This was, by far, the most memorable experience of my life. Saved up for quite a while to do it and had the last bit covered as my 21st Birthday present. 

Came over from the UK with a group and this was the highlight! The pilot was great and very funny, he picked a perfect playlist for the flight, pointed out interesting points along the route and we even spotted a wildfire! 

You just haven't lived until you've flown along side Condors and Eagles, over Buffalo and Pumas, down into the canyon and along the rivers. Absolutely incredible experience, truly a once in a lifetime trip, would recommend to anyone.

You can see the whole Canyon from the helicopter tour.  The guide does a great job giving details.  It is unbelievable to get to see the canyon from this viewpoint.

We highly  recommend  taking this helicopter tour it's an experience you and your family will not forget although it is pricey. 

Took a 45 minute one,

Visiting the Grand Canyon was on my mums life bucket list. We (my mum and sister) spent two nights in Vegas with the sole purpose of doing the helicopter tour. We paid for our flights months in advance and gave our weights as requested a few weeks before departing Australia. On arrival in Vegas we rang to confirm our flights for the following day. Long story cut short, we were told on two occasions that we couldn't fly on the day we had paid for as we hadn't given our weights. After stressing to Maverick that we could not change the flight day they then said that the only solution was to spilt our family into 2 helicopters. My mum was devastated. After the flight was over we shared our experiences. My mum and I had very little commentary from our pilot so we learned nothing about the canyon whereas my sister on the other helicopter learned a wealth of knowledge as her pilot played a recorded commentary to his passengers. Shouldn't there be consistency? Regardless of where the mix up with weights happened (agent or maverick) you pay a lot of money so would expect more consideration.

My husband and I took a 45 minute helicopter ride. Money well spent!
Maverick are friendly and very professional with an excellent safety record. The pilot was friendly but authoritative and throughout the flight, very knowledgeable. We managed to see some buffalo, wild turkeys and elk on our return trip to boot.
My husband and I were lucky enough to sit at the front of the helicopter next to the pilot. It seated 7 (including the pilot) so two could sit up front with 4 behind. You wear ear defenders with attached microphone so you can hear and speak to the pilot and all other passengers. I should stress that we didn't choose to sit upfront - you have to be weighed beforehand and then passengers are placed in the helicopter to distribute the total weight equally. You can't request a seat.
All in all a fantastic experience. The only tiny word of advice however - maybe remove the "broken" helicopters from the trees adjacent to the road! I'm sure this is no reflection on safety but it doesn't look great!!

We enjoyed our flight and feel there is no better way to fully see the Canyon. The staff was professional and seemed highly skilled (Jake was our pilot). The 50-minute tour is worth the small additional cost.

review_title: First time flyer - took my breath away
review_text:
The whole tour was amazing.  My family and I were picked up at our hotel and taken to the airport to be flown to the Grand Canyon in the 10 seater plane.  Our pilot was lovely and gave us an interesting tour of all the Nevada landmarks along the way.

Upon our arrival we were transferred to our helicopter and flown down to the base of the Canyon.  I have never flown in a helicopter before and was a little frightened but from the moment I was strapped in, our pilot put my worries at ease and I loved every moment of the experience.

The views simply take your breath away and once you are standing on the base of the Canyon, you suddenly feel so small as the walls of the Canyon tower above you.

Once back at the top of the Canyon, we had plenty of time to travel to other parts of the Western Rim to view the Canyon before heading back to Vegas on the plane.

I cannot recommend this tour highly enough.  I loved the whole experience from start to finish.

Wow it was a great experience. First the service is magnificent, the pilot was great, funny,explained all the security procedures, was very good at explaining us everything during the excursion. The ride was smooth and you could see the pilot know what he was doing very profesional. The views of the Grand Canyon were amazing and unforgettable. Don't miss this ride!

There are two rows of 4 seats (total of 8 people can be fitted) inside the helicopter. In my tour, there were total of 5 people (including the pilot). The pilot said the seating chart is already decided by the tour. So he told each one of us where to sit. Three people were seated in front tow next to the pilot.  One person was seated on the right side window. I end up being on the left side window. The whole 45 minutes of tour the pilot was describing the sceneries on the right side, where I could not even see. He completely ignored me who was the only person sitting on the left. I tried to talk over the microphone to ask him to explain the left side sceneries, as well. But the microphone was not working. The experience was not an enjoyable one. I think the pilots should be instructed to describe the sceneries on both sides and do not ignore the people sitting in the back.

Very professional. All on time scheduled. Be careful not to put on weight from the time you book to the time you get there as there is a penalty for extra weight.
40 minutes minimum is a must. The pilot BJ was very confident and expert. We did not  buy the photo as we took so many ourselves. 
The computer will allocate where you sit so you might not sit next to your friend but it is worth it anyway.

Please be warned you spend 2 hours before you leave picking up guests from other hotels and then the same in return, so a 7.5 hour tour is really only 3. Tour is average and a lot of waiting around. The 30 minute helicopter tour (out of 7.5 hours) is fantastic and pilot excellent. All staff are very friendly. Generally I would suggest ask questions before you book - all sounds great but a lot of wasted time picking and dropping people off

Thrilled to be able to go up in the helicopter and see the Grand Canyon from the air, this is totally different from the view points around the park and I will never forget it, The pilot was full of knowledge and had a answer for every question thrown at him, well done Maverick Air Tours

This was an awesome experience. We flew about 40 minutes to the Grand Canyon where we had a champagne toast, looked around for a half hour and flew back. We were 300 feet above the Colorado River. The colors of the desert, from vibrant to gentle pastels was breathtaking. This was my daughter's first time in a helicopter and it was comfortable and smooth. Our pilot Brian was fun and well informed. The return flight down the strip was a lot of fun. I strongly recommend Maverick!
We did this a couple of weeks ago and it was brilliant, my first time up in a helicopter and was nervous but our pilot Andrew put me at ease. Very professional and polite.

great tours, we did the land and have snacks and champagne one,leaving from Henderson, they pick you up and drop you off with a helpful shuttle service all tour operators seem similar price, these people have very new and shiny helicopters with helpful and knowledgeable staff, the pilot was fantastic giving us commentary and apart from being very good looking !(always a bonus) was informative and friendly, thumbs up to pilot Jason and the company

Fizemos uma viagem de helicóptero ao Grand   Canion com sky walk, o passeio de helicóptero foi ótimo,o atendimento excelente, mas o sky walk foi frustrante, rápido e sem graça, não voltaria,, mas ver o Grand Canion do alto e imperdivel.

review_title: Definitely the Highlight of our Trip!
review_text:
Our pilot was friendly and knowledgeable, and it was the perfect way to get our first glimpse of the Canyon!  It was outrageously expensive for 4 of us to ride ($1100) so I wondered if it would really be worth it, and it truly was I can't recommend it enough.  Arnie Rodriguez, one of the employees there, made our visit extra special by going out of his way to share with us some highlights of the park that we shouldn't miss.
Loved it!

I would highly recommend taking a helicopter tour - wonderful views! 
Staff were very friendly and helpful, took pictures of us and didn't push to buy their photos and DVDs

We took our boys, ages 13 & 11, to the Grand Canyon and decided to splurge and get the best view we could! I was actually surprised at their prices. I was expecting more! :) It was AMAZING! We did the 40-45 minute flight, which I would highly recommend, if you can. Our pilot was BJ. (No, he didn't have a chimp named Bear. We asked.) LOL! BJ was so nice and he did a great job of narrating the specific areas we were looking at. The best part was that first moment when we cleared the trees and the ground just dropped out from under us and we were over the canyon. It literally took my breath away! I would say this is THE BEST way to see this enormous site. So worth it and my kids loved it!

i booked this tour ahead of time using Viator. We have never done a tour like this and my wife is quite afraid of small craft. I knew the best way to see the Grand Canyon was by air so...The building and surroundings were new. The staff was extremely professional and courteous. This made things a bit more comforting for my wife. Their fleet are newer and look well maintained. Our pilot (B.J.) was awesome. Very professional and knowledgable. A little bit funny at the right times and kept the passengers engaged. And my god what an awesome sight. I'm telling you, I was right. No better way to see the Grand Canyon. I'm certain there are other tours out there and are just as good as this one.  Just saying this one was great and would not hesitate to do it again or recommend to others. WORTH EVERY PENNY!!!

We saw the most awesome sights today on our Mavericks helicopter flight!   

Our 17 year old son had never seen the canyon and we are on a short trip.  We figured an overhead perspective might be his best introduction to this awesome US landmark.   

We booked the tour by phone. Arriving at Grand Canyon airport, we found Maverick to be well organized and professional.  We were weighed and paid.   Then we waited a few minutes before meeting our pilot, Brett. 

We got a quick safety lesson and were fitted with flotation devices.  Then we were seated according to weight.   Brett is very experienced so we were following a less experienced pilot for training.   Soon,  we were airborne. 

Helicopter rides are always special.   But there's nothing like flying over a ponderosa pine/juniper forest a few hundred feet over the land and abruptly being 5000 feet ( 1 mile) above the awesome Grand Canyon! 

The mighty Colorado river was beautiful.   Brett pointed out lots of geological formations and types of strata in the canyon walls. He also pointed out some sacred native locations.   The whole experience was fabulous!

The tour lasted about 1 1/2 hours.   You can buy dvds of your flight for 39.95 and photos of you for 19.95.  

Tip about tips:  pilot school is expensive and the pilots appreciate gratuities.
The helicopter was brand new and our pilot Jake was amazing! The ride over the canyon was stunning, breathtaking and an unforgettable experience!  I would do it a hundred times!  The kids loved it!

This is a great way to view the grand canyon. We saw both the north and the south rim. The pilot was realy kind and explained a lot. The helicopter flew a couple of times in the canyon. This flight makes you realize te enormus scale of the canyon. Although expensive, I believe it is worth the money.

Though expensive, this was a wonderful way to experience the Grand Canyon. After sending two days hiking around this tour have us a completely different perspective. Our pilot was great with our two kids and they had a ball.

This is definitely the way to see the canyons. What an awesome journey flying into the canyons. The pilot tells you a bit of history and explains what you are flying over. Hoover dam was quite a sight from the skies. We were quite lucky to be seated next to the pilot as we has almost a 180 degree view. As we enter the Grand Canyons, an air-wolf type of music was played and it really jives with the flight path. Upon landing in the middle of the Canyons, snacks and champange was served. Though it was about 40 degrees when we went, we were too blown by the beauty to feel the heat. Definitely a must try!!

Do not miss the opportunity to see the Grand Canyon from the air. BJ, our pilot took us on a 50 min tour of the Canyon where you get breathtaking views from a different perspective. We did this on day 1 and it gave us a good persective to the size and scale of the Canyon. Worth every penny! At the end you will have the option to purchase the video of your trip. Good video, but the Canyon Colors were not as vibrant as my iPhone 6 or naked eye, but it was a fun souvenier to have. BJ was awesome and the entire operation was quality through and through.

review_title: This great planet you must see from this perspective
review_text:
A truly exceptional experience to fly above one of out planet's greatest wonders.
They are a highly professional team and courteous to boot.
With trepidation I embarked on the journey on my own and it took a good 30 minutes to adapt to being buoyant over the vastness below.
Helicopters accelerate with their nose downward and that was like the most difficult part as well as the turns! Be forewarned  but do not be dissuaded. It was a fantastic experience and I can't wait to do it again. Especially with Toon at the helm, an experienced and knowledgable pilot who made our tour all the richer. Also the friends you meet will warm your heart.
Tip: Leave a tip to the pilot, he goes beyond his duty to make your visit memorable and safe.
Tip 2: if possible choose the 9.5 hour helicopter / river tour or the Sunset ride. I was left wanting more! 
I've not posted pics because the ones here are formidable.

review_title: Fantastic trip and great customer service
review_text: We did the airplane tour over the west rim. We had heard that the south rim was better but the views from the plane were spectacular. An incredible experience! Our pilot Chris was funny and knowledgeable, we felt in very safe hands. We did have a bit of a mix up with the pickup location and missed our transfer but Kevin dealt with this very professionally when we got there and didn't make us feel stupid (when perhaps we had been a little stupid!) Brilliant customer service and meant that the miscommunication didn't ruin our experience in the slightest. Thank you!

Had the pleasure of sharing this wonderful experience with family, 2 others and BJ our pilot.  The 45 minute experience was unbelievable.  This is a must do while visiting the Grand Canyon ... one cannot grasp the vastness from the ground.  BJ was both knowledge and professional.  I highly recommend Maverick, all aspects of the experience were top notch!

I am a senior citizen and this is by far the most exciting, worthwhile adventure I have had.  Both my son and my sister agree with me and I am already planning a return trip.  Greg was our pilot and he was both knowledgeable and full of facts about the canyon.  I am afraid of heights - as is my son - and neither of us had an ounce of fear during this ride.  The beauty of the Grand Canyon needs to be experienced this way - you will leave in awe!!!  Already planning a return trip with grandchildren and will definitely take this ride again.

A must do when visiting the Grand Canyon.  We chose to do a plane tour rather than helicopter.  The 45 minute tour was excellent, we traveling from end to end.  It hard to grasp the vastness of the canyon standing on the rim or hiking, but in the air, its incredible.
This must have ben the most breathtaking experience ever, very professional and funny pilot, wonderful scenaries, a memorable experience.

review_title: Melhor forma de conhecer o Grand Canyon West!
review_text: Esta é a melhor e mais rápida forma de conhecer o Grand Canyon West e skywalk!! A partir de Las Vegas, a Van passa no hotel e leva até o aeroporto!! A viagem de helicóptero que dura 1 hora apróx., passa pelo lago Las Vegas, Hoover Dam e chega no aeroporto do grand canyon! Lá outra van leva até o skywalk, ficando por quase mais 1 hora! Prefira o início da semana (seg. ou ter.) e no inverno, época com menos turistas! A Mavericks é uma excelente empresa, com pilotos bem qualificados e equipamentos aparentemente novos e bem cuidados!
EXCELLENT, from hotel pick up, to flight, to bus ride to the Grand Canyon everything was extremely professional,, BRUCE the tour guide was wonderful.

review_title: BEST way to experience the Grand Canyon
review_text: This was my first time to the Grand Canyon and my first helicopter ride. It was a great way to experience the canyon from a birds eye view! The colors were beautiful! The pilot was extremely knowledgeable and I was able to get some great pictures! If you get car sick easily I would recommend taking some motion sickness medication before the ride...I happened to get very sick towards the end of the ride. You do not get to choose where you sit on the helicopter. Some people were forced to sit in the middle back row due to weight distribution. You may also not be seated by your family. Well worth the money if you want to experience the canyon.

Visit my blog to see the pictures of my helicopter ride !!
http://wp.me/p5Lw9a-1g

When you visit the Grand Canyon, consider a helicopter ride. Trust me, it would be a smart decision to make...

Maravilha de passeio, fizemos o tour para ir na Sky walk ... que vista!!! o Grand Canyon é lindo. Almoçamos lá com aquele visual maravilhoso... o tour pela Mavericks é caro mais vale cada centavo,  o profissionalismo e a sensação segurança é muito grande. Amei.

We took off quite early (7am) for a 45 mins ride to the Grand Canyon. I had never been in a helicopter before, but the pilot made us feel really at ease and did an excellent commentary as we were travelling. We landed on the Grand Canyon for a champagne picnic, which was provided for 30 mins before travelling back. Would definitely recommend this as a must if you go to Vegas.

First helicopter ride for us and we liked it.

We departed from the Grand Canyon airport, and be aware that Maverick is the second airport turn after the turnaround, not the first.

The reception area is very modern and nice.  You have to pay, show ID, get weighed (done very discreetly), and read an advisory page before meeting the pilot (who will call your name when he is ready to roll).

There were 3 other people sharing our flight.  The pilot does introductions, provides a short trip and safety briefing, and then takes you out to the machine.  They snap pictures of you with the helicopter and pilot (to sell upon return), do a few more safety briefing things, have you snap on an inflatable flotation device around your waist, and then place you inside the machine.  They use your weight to determine where you should sit and you may not sit next to your party.  We soon understood that isn't a big deal as you also must wear headphones and speak into a microphone so everyone hears everything said for the entire trip so it's not like you can be whispering to your spouse anyway.  You also get belted in via a 3 point system that is pretty robust.  You have to sort of climb in, and there is a guy to help.  It is no harder than getting into a mini-van.  The cabin is heated/cooled so you don't need a coat.  It seemed like the back row seats were a bit more spacious--but they all may be the same.  One of us sat in front, and one in back, and we thought the views were equally good.

The pilot is very good at describing both the aspects of the ride, and also the Canyon below.  The best "buzz" feeling is when the helicopter first goes over the canyon after the run over the woods--it is pretty thrilling.

The entire ride was smooth as glass and we never had a whiff of fear.  It was really both thrilling and calming.

This is a fairly expensive attraction, but we thought it was worth the money.  Upon landing there is opportunity to ask more questions and take more pictures, and they also offer to sell you their professional-taken picture just before take-off, and also a CD.  The pilot lingers to see if anyone is going to tip him and that is a bit awkward but there is zero pressure.

We were glad we went.

Took a tour to the Grand Canyon with a small group of colleagues during a recent visit to Las Vegas. I'd highly recommend the trip as it provides a tremendous opportunity to sense the size and isolation of the desert and the mountains as well as the splendour of the Grand Canyon. We landed on a ledge above the river and were able to get out of the aircraft and walk around...amazing!

Our group was split between 2 helicopters. The pilots, Connor and Brad, were highly skilled, professional and very knowledgeable. In addition, they're great people to spend some time with!!

What an amazing experience, we did the tour that landed in the canyon, it was breathtaking. So glad we chose Maverick they were professional, clean, safety oriented and on time.  Jesse our pilot was awesome, fun, energetic and knowledgeable.  Everyone that helped us was great!  We can't wait to come back and try another tour.

review_title: We booked the Canyon Dream with Maverick  helicopters.  Well worth the money
review_text: Brilliant staff and very knowledgeable.  Combining a plane and helicopter ride with a great drive to the national park where you get to see the South Rim of the grand canyon before flying out to the South Rim. A great day out.

Our second visit to the Grand Canyon we decided to see it from a different vantage point...via helicopter. I am scared of heights, but this was an amazing adventure. Our pilot was fun and very knowledgable about the Canyon. The view and the thrill is like nothing you will ever experience from the rim! I highly recommend it!

Booked this trip through our hotel and it is very expensive but worth every penny they collected us from our hotel with a very nice driver and took as to the airport. Our helicopter had six of us and the pilot explained all about the helicopter and what we would do on the tour it goes out over the Hoover damp and lands at the airport at Grand Canyon were we were met but a bus to take us down to the Skywall with a Canyon Indian and she was very nice. Went onto the skywalk and had our photos taken and were then given two free photos. On the way back you get to fly down the strip which is great and the pilot is on the radio all the time explaining all the facts a great tour yes expensive but worth it

We actually did the air plane trip out to the south rim of the grand canyon with my husband, mum, and three children.LOVED, every minute of this tour! We got on the plane, the pilots were very informative, and let us come down to the cockpit for a look and a photo. Once we landed at the canyon airport, a trolly took us out to Bright Angel Lodge. It was lovely to have a different change of scenery from the big city. The views were spectacular! Half the group then went on to do a helicopter ride through the canyon, but we went on to visit Mather Point, which had different views, and also spectacular. We had a lunch box given to us with a drink, cookie, and sandwich, which was lovely. Really loved this place, definitely the highlight of our trip

Il y a rien a rajouter par rapport aux autres avis... Meilleure façon de visiter le gand canyon. On a fait les 25 min avec l helico de luxe. Si c est une question de prix choisir un helico de luxe complement vitré et faire 25 min que faire 45 min dans un helico standard!

After much research decided that Maverick Tours would accommodate what we wanted to do best, that being a one day tour of the Grand Canyon. They certainly lived up to our expectations and we had an awesome trip to the South Rim. Even though we were at the wrong location for pick up the driver still found us and that was the start of the adventure. Everyone was so professional and seemed to genuinely enjoy their job. The pilots on the plane invited the passengers up to the cockpit and then took pictures out the front window and then obliged with selfies. The transition to helicopter was smooth and the 1/2 hour flight was amazing including the pilots music choices. The one day tour allowed for a couple of stops at iconic vantage points and we had sufficient time(as much as a one day tour allows) to view and explore the Grand Canyon. Thank you Maverick we had an absolutely amazing, exhilarating and awesome day!

Après avoir visité de pied ferme le grand canyon j'ai fais un baptême de l'air en hélicoptère au dessus du canyon. Ce fut incroyable! J'ai fais le tour de 45 minutes un matin de juillet avec un ciel tout bleu et quelques cumulus. C'est cher certes mais c'est un de mes plus beau souvenir. Vous volez environ 10 minutes au dessus d'une foret et la le choc! Le pilote de l'hélicoptère commente, dit des histoires sur le grand canyon. Si vous hésitez niveau budget foncé sinon vous allez regretter à votre retour en France.

review_title: Cancelled on us with no warning
review_text:
We booked our Grand Canyon flight with Maverick several weeks in advance.  We called the morning of our flight to confirm that we would be there, and Maverick thanked us for confirming.  When we arrived, we were told that an earlier flight had been cancelled due to weather/clouds in the Grand Canyon (no one mentioned this when we called to confirm).  When it was time for our flight, we were told ours was cancelled as well.  

We scrambled to find another helicopter tour company.  We called three, and all of them were carrying out their tours as scheduled (which indicated to us that the weather was fine, which we also observed on our own, since it was pretty much beautiful outside).  Unfortunately, since Maverick gave us absolutely no warning, we were too late-- all three other companies were booked.  Maverick did not offer to reschedule us or even apologize at all; just acted like this was business as usual.

Trusting Maverick was simply heartbreaking.  We may never make it back to the Grand Canyon, and our opportunity to take a helicopter tour over the canyon was lost, maybe forever.  Book with anyone, literally anyone else, besides Maverick.

We booked the West Rim airplane tour with Skywalk. Pick up was on time and transit time was roughly 20 minutes to the airfield.
