Upon arrival our driver explained the check in process and everything ran like clockwork from there on in. Our Pilot was Ron and he gave us a very informative commentary the entire 30 minute flight. Likewise, upon arrival Ron gave us all the information we needed to know about our tour to the Skywalk. 

Overall, Maverick were everything I hoped they would be and we have no complaints whatsoever. 

Thank you Maverick for an enjoyable excursion to Grand Canyon West.

review_title: I hope everything else on my bucket list is this great
review_text: Terrific excursion, safe, exhilarating, awesome experience. Would have liked in flight narration to be more audible.

We arrived for our pre booked flight to be told that the weather coming in would effect the hour tour we had arranged and that our flight would have to be reduced from an hour to 30 minutes, Maverick agreed to let us wait for an hour to see whether it would clear but when the weather become worse (in fact it made the press here in the UK as a weather phenomenon) they swiftly got us up in the air to view the Grand Canyon and we are so grateful that we got to experience the Canyon from this angle.  The weather is obviously out of their control but they kept us posted on the progress and ensured that we got to see as much as possible.  There really is no other way to view the Canyon, you don’t get an idea of scale on foot.  Mavericks helicopters are far superior to their competitors and well worth the money, our pilot was lots of fun and taught us lots about the Canyon too, an excellent way to end our trip.

review_title: Check it off your bucket list!
review_text:
We did the 50 min aerial tour with Mavericks, even though we had to drive 2.25 hours each way from Sedona to get there. Wow! Are we glad we did it!  Our pilot, BJ, was funny and informative, and the views were - well - honestly, so amazing, that there's no way words can describe them.

This is a once-in-a-lifetime thing we took advantage of, and it was worth every penny.  As we got back on the road post the trip, my hubby said, "Well, we can check that off the bucket list!"  And, that's exactly the kind of experience it was.

Thanks, Mavericks!

review_title: Dissappointing end to what was a great flight.
review_text:
Hats off to Greg for a great flight and never forget experience!!
We had spent the day before walking all over the Grand Canyon but nothing can prepare you for the view you get from the chopper.
The checkin staff were great, Greg our pilot was awesome, he really makes the trip worth the money because it is expensive to fly out to the canyon.
We decided before leaving on the flight we would buy the whole package which includes a photo, plaque and DVD of video taken from the bottom of the chopper and the conversations, music between you and the pilot. We made a point of talking and asking lots of questions of the pilot.
Upon our rerun we bought the package and headed back to the hotel.
There was no DVD player in our room so we didn't watch the movie.
There was one in our car so we started watching the DVD on our way to Los Vegas the next day, to our horror the DVD wasn't us. It was of a trip with lots of Japanese people and with different music and a different pilot.
The highlight of our Grand Canyon trip had just been soured slightly by someone's incompetentance!!!!! My daughter was devastated.
The company were good enough to,give our Money back and let us keep the DVD of not us but it still was very disappointing!!!!

Полет длится около 40 минут.  Вертолеты обычно 7-местные (в первом ряду - пилот + 2 пассажира, во втором - четыре пассажира). 
Перед полетом производится взвешивание. Внимание - самых тяжелых сажают по центру второго ряда.
Когда вертолет влетает в каньон, его даже немного подбрасывает:) - будьте готовы! Виды каньона из вертолета - просто фантастика!
Пилот молодой и симпатичный:) На обратном пути он снизился над лесом и втопил педаль, чтобы мы почувствовали ощущение скорости. 
Недешево, но абсолютно стоит потраченных денег!

An amazing view of the Grand Canyon in all its glory!...we even landed on the rim and enjoyed a glass of champagne!
Our pilot was knowledgeable and articulate, pointing out the Hoover Dam and many other geographical points of interest along the way..
We travelled on a slightly foggy/ light drizzle but still managed a great view.
We took a mid afternoon flight affording us the opportunity to view the Las Vegas strip and those famous lights as the sun set, highly recommend this!
Helicopter trip was comfortable, safety was paramount at all times, well worth the cost for a once in a lifetime experience...

review_title: El mejor paseo de mi vida!
review_text: La mejor experiencia que he vivido en  la vida!!!!! Una vista espectacular!!! Nuestro piloto BJ hizo de nuestro primer vuelo toda una aventura maravillosa!!!! Definitivamente volveremos pronto!!!!!!

Expensive?  I guess it depends on your income and perspective.  I've paid more (much more) than this for a single night in a hotel.  This was my first ride in a helicopter, which made it especially interesting.  The weather was perfect the day we went out.  Pretty smooth ride; no one got sick.  Our uniformed pilot was very professional and attentive to everyone's needs.  They equip you with headphones and microphones that allow you to communicate with others.  They also play some theme music over the headphones that helps to set the mood.  We started out flying low over some flat wooded areas, and they played that Wagner composition from Apocalypse Now.  It was kind of like heading out for an attack mission in 'Nam!  Then suddenly the bottom drops and you are over the Grand Canyon.  Then they play music from Star Wars and 2001.  You don't just hover high above, they also take you in close to many rock formations so they are right next to you or right below you.  The length was just right.  I certainly did not feel like it was over too soon.  I went the day after Thanksgiving when it was really busy at the park, but still didn't see many other aircraft in the area.  Then we returned with some Indiana Jones music. 

Life-altering?  I wouldn't go that far.  But for me, it definitely fit into the category of "show me something I haven't seen before".  One more thing to cross off my bucket list.

Was the helicopter ride expensive? More than two nights' hotel accommodation (Best Western, Tusayan) and meals! But for an unparalleled perspective of the canyon, including the surprise of your life when your get to the canyon, you can't buy the experience anywhere else. The round trip from lift off to touch down was about 55 min, and the route (because of FAA rules) traverses parts of the canyon one normally sees. Go late in the day, when the later afternoon sun helps reveal the rocks' colors and shadows accentuate the topography. Expect a wait, even if you have reservations: flights are filled in order booked, but these have to be mitigated by passenger weights so the load is safe and balanced. In our case, we arrived after some others but because our weights (we're lighter than the average North American) were within the range they needed to fill up a load (typically 6 passengers), we kind of jumped the queue (to the vocal displeasure of one couple). Other than that, you'll get a supremely capable pilot who has a broad knowledge of local nature and geology. Don't look upon the cost as a luxury - look upon it as adding a third dimension to your otherwise level perspective.

We had done a lot of research before arriving in Las Vegas on what tours were available and what tour company to use, Maverick came out top and with health and safety also after speaking to people they came highly recommended. 
We chose to do this on my 40th Birthday as I wanted to do something that I wouldn't forget, wow wow wow this trip from the beginning to the end was amazing.  We decided to do the canyon dream which was a 45 min flight on a small aeroplane to the south rim with views of the Hoover Dam then a 25 min helicopter flight over the canyon, we then got taken to the national park where we had a picnic lunch and was able to walk around the park and take in the most amazing views of the canyon. From the moment we were picked up from the hotel to the moment we were dropped back off every single member of staff we spoke to or travelled with very friendly and helpful, the funniest guy was Bruce who drove the bus, I can't remember the names of the pilots but I do remember one was very handsome and your typical maverick (top gun) thank you all at Maverick helicopters for such an amazing day.

user_location: Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
review_text: Otima empresa, super confiavel!! Fiz o passeio de helicóptero sobrevoando o grand canyon e las vegas! Foi perfeito! Não é barato, gira em torno de 3oo dolares, mas vale!

We had researched the various tours in Vegas and these came out on top for safety, latest helicopters and reviews, and proved to be exceptional.

You travel six to a helicopter and all get the chance to fly up front with the pilot, not all companies do this, which was great for all. Although even if in the rear seats get spectacular views.

Went out on the sunrise tour, so included the flight down the strip, worth paying those extra few dollars. 

Concerned about booking before in UK or in Vegas, we left it until we were out there. Made a bit of a saving, and whilst you could get it cheaper with other firms, Maverick are worth the money. You will get people all trying to sell tours, we brought from with the shopping Mall across from the Bellagio and next to the Cabo Waco restaurant with an assistant named Russ, who was very helpful.

Price we paid was $418 per person for the champagne picnic, landing in the Grand Canyon, next to the Collarado River, great experience. Only bit is that the picnic is only a Danish pastrie! Get couple of glasses of Champagne. 

Overall this was a great experience and you can ask the pilot as many questions during the flight etc. as you talk through the headphones so all can hear. Pilot very informative too.

Worth every penny. Great professional service with fantastic views. I had a the longer trip and could have stayed for even more time. Everything great, don't bother with the skywalk, poor views and no cameras allowed anymore.

Whilst the Grand Canyon helicopter tour may appear pricey on first glance (>$500 pp) it is worth it as a once-in-a-lifetime experience. My partner and I took one of the sunset flights which involved close up views over the Hoover dam, the Grand Canyon and surrounds with a nice stop inside the canyon by the river for a champagne or two. Breathtaking views from wonderful vantage points. Tour concluded with a fly pass of the lights of the Vegas trip. All in all almost 3 hours from take off to landing and you're in a state of wonder for every minute. If you get the chance, do it, we'd be regretting it if we didn't.

Sesta volta che mi reco al Grand Canyon ma la prima volta che ci vado in elicottero. Scegliamo di partire con il tour del mattino, la Mavericks ci raccoglie direttamente in Hotel, l'organizzazione è perfetta, gli elicotteri ottimamente tenuti ed i piloti con un'esperienza che rende tutto il viaggio molto piacevole... Il panorama poi è fantastico. Bellissimo anche il rientro sorvolando la Strip!

When my mom and I planned Vegas, we knew we wanted to go do a helicopter trip to the Grand Canyon. My daughter was in Vegas with some friends, leaving the night we arrived. I was able to call directly to Maverick and book a sundown ride for the 3 of us. Our copter mates were from Brazil, they talked all during the flight, but the captain made sure he told us, what we needed to know. The landing during the flight was great, near the river. great photo ops!! My camera died :(. It was great to share with my mom and daughter!1

Amazing!  This is the #1 way to see The Grand Canyon!! The service was exceptional..from the pick up at the hotel, the check in procedure and the pilot were very efficient. The view is amazing and the snacks were great too! I will be recommending Mavericks Tours to others. Thanks for making this a highlight of my first trip to Vegas!

Took a tour with the above company recently. We were picked up from our hotel and taken to a small airfield outside Vegas. Flew to the Grand Canyon in a small but very comfortable plane going over the Hoover Dam etc. Once at the Grand Canyon we were transferred into helicopters for a flight over and through the Canyon, also landed at the bottom. Did the skywalk and had a meal which were all included. All in all, a great trip, about 5 hrs in total so were back at our hotel by midday.

review_title: This is a Must Do.....Amazing Trip
review_text: Wow, wow, wow! Thank you Maverick and our pilot BJ for the most exhilarating flight of my life. We had thought this flight over the Grand Canyon would be way too expensive for us to consider. But no!! It was less than we expected, so how could we not do it.  The great choice of music was playing, BJ was giving us a brilliant commetary as we skimmed over the pine forest towards the Canyon rim. Then .....there it was we were over this amazingly vast Canyon. It was so vast that it felt like we were suspended in the air and barely moving. How can you get a true perspective from standing on the Rim looking from there. Awestruck...is a word that I would use to describe this experience. BJ did a good job at trying to give us an appreciation of the size by giving us scales in terms of the height of Empire State building. Still hard to comprehend.....This is one of the best experiences of my and my husband's life. Go do it!!

we did the 'canyon dream' tour on oct 31.as well as being completely overawed by the canyon,i was very impressed with the professional approach of maverick tours from pick up to drop off. our helicopter pilot was Marcus who was a very nice young guy and knowledgable.i rate this tour as the number 1 of all the tours we did.well worth the money

review_title: Too little time above the canyon
review_text: I was disappointed in the time we spent over the canyon itself.  Over half of our time was spent flying over forest land and flat lands.  I expected to see more of the canyon from the air, so it was too expensive for the amount of time over the canyon.  I have had better experiences in helicopters over other fascinating land forms making them far better for the money spent.

What an awesome experience to fly over the Grand Canyon in a helicopter. Our pilot was Brad. He was excellent!!!  Really wouldn't want to see the Grand Canyon any other way!!  Worth the money!!  Take the canyon spirit and you won't be disappointed. My children got the thrill of their life but my daughter did fall asleep the last ten minutes. A very expensive nap but what a memory!

after numerous researching hubbie and I opted for the airplane and heli tour we were picked up by Mavericks from our hotel for the transfer to henderson airport we waited for half hour before boarding out plane  and I have to say I was very wary about the flying bit due to a small plane and not looking forward to the helicopter but it was hubbies birthday and I had to share his day, to my amazement on the flight to Grand Canyon it was informative pointing out places of interest on way having visited the skywalk canyon side by bus on a previous visit  to how quick we flew past this area  we were  now on our way to the GCNP wow then the pilots are inviting passengers up to look out at the cockpit I thought I gotta get this fear outta my head before getting on the helicopter  wow fear over they were so calming and reassuring thank you so much for the confidence boost  after landing we were taken up to blue angel lodge had a walk about and visited the small museum their  wish we had more time to take this in we were now on our way to go for our Heli trip  and wow gave reassurance again by the pilot i am so glad I did this trip and overcome  my fear to share this experience with my hubbie we have both saId next time in vegas we want to do it again next time landing in the GC

Excursión espectacular, nos pasaron a buscar por el hotel estabamos alojados en el Wynn y nos llevaron hasta la la pista, nos dieron una charla y partimos. Las vistas son soñadas volas sobre el cañon, la represa de Hoover y más. La empresa tiene todo preparado para aterrizar en una zona especial donde bajan con neveras con refrigerios, tomas fotos panorámicas. Realmente vale la pena hacer esta excursión para mi llena de adrenalina ya que nunca habíamos tomamos un vuelo en helicóptero.

My wife and I flew with Maverick October 28th. The helicopter was very comfortable and the pilot was very good and informative. We have taken other tours with different operators and nothing compares to Maverick. They have a camera mounted on the aircraft that will record the trip, both video and audio that is available for a reasonable price. Can't go wrong if you want to fly the Grand Canyon.

We arrived in good time and after  paying and being weighed for the correct distribution within the helicopter, we sat and waited for the 3 other passengers. The area you sit and wait has a variety of tshirts, baseball caps and other souvenirs, the seating is comfortable and the whole area clean and spacious. The staff were all very friendly and accommodating. I explained that as I can suffer with claustrophobia, if possible could they place me near the side not in the middle. The other three passengers only just made it in time. As we were on the 4pm flight and they have to clear the canyon by 5pm, the staff told us if they hadn't been on time, they would have taken off without them. We were relieved as it is expensive and we wouldn't have wanted to have our experience, which we had looked forward to for so long, cut short. Our pilot was Brad, a lovely person who we felt completely comfortable and confident with. We were given the safety briefing and got on board. I was thrilled to find that I was seated at the front next to the door, fabulous views. Not sure if this was after my request or just luck :-) We took off and flew over the pine forest. As I have never been in a helicopter before I wasn't sure what to expect. It was a lot smoother than I thought it would be, I felt comfortable and safe. We approached the canyon with Brad saying that if we had a camera, turn it on now. I took a video with my phone. As we approached and then flew out over the canyon everyone just said ....WWWOOOOAHHHHH. It was like the bottom just dropped out of your world, incredible. no amount of words can describe it really, no amount of looking at photos, you just have to see it for yourself. Brad was excellent, giving commentary on points of interest and answering our questions, which he encouraged us to do. As I just couldn't get perspective on the immensity of it all, I pointed out a particular elevation and asked Brad how tall it was. He answered, 3 Empire State buildings. That gave us all perspective and helped us understand the size of the canyon, just amazing. The whole flight was just fantastic. My only minus point was that as we had opted for the 4pm flight, the sun was low (we wanted a later flight to get the shades and colours) and at times washed out the colours on the way back, but by no means diluted the experience. Brad flew a couple of times into shade to give us the best possible experience. We landed and photos were taken with the copter. All in all an unforgettable experience and what a way to spend my 50th birthday. I would heartily recommend this company to anyone wanting this flight over the Canyon. Just wonderful!

We were a party of 4 and were the only passengers.  Our pilot was great, pointing out landmarks and telling us about the landscape.  Well worth the trip - not for anyone with vertigo as I was in the front with the pilot and it's a bit disconcerting to have nothing between you and the ground but the windscreen.

Simply the best day in my trip to Vegas - by far!
The Canyon is utterly awesome and the whole Maverick helicopter experience to the South rim truly professional A day to remember for a lifetime

Hélicoptères ultra-modernes, pilotes chevronnés, ponctualité et professionnalisme. Ensuite, que dire.... 10 minutes de vol au-dessus de la forêt, puis LE CHOC ! Vous passez de cent mètres au-dessus du sol à 1500 mètres d.un coup et le Grand Canyon s'étale sous vos yeux... S'ils sont encore ouverts ! 
Moment inoubliable et magique que même la découverte à pieds ou la vision de films et documentaires ne peut vous faire imaginer.
Je conseille donc très fortement et même aux personnes souffrant de vertige (ce qui est mon cas).

We booked this flight as an upgrade with another company that was taking us to the South Rim by mini van.
We were dropped off at Grand Canyon airport about 12.00 for our flight at half past.
First they weigh you, so they know how to distribute the weight in the helicopter.
Obviously this means you don't have a choice of where you sit on the helicopter. 2 of us were in the front, & 2 of us in the back by the window, & the next seat in.
The front seats are best, but you can still see well from the back.
Our pilot Marcus was great, & gives you the usual safety advice, shows you how to buckle the seat belt, & helps with your life jacket.
He encourages you to speak over the headset that you wear, & ask questions, as this comes out on the DVD that you can buy afterwards.
You fly low over the tree's for a while, & then you reach the edge of the Canyon, & it was amazing. As none of us had seen it from the edge yet, it was probably better for us.
The pilot explained everything on the flight, pointing out the names of rock formations, & a herd of Buffalo over on the North Rim. Also the Little Colorado river, & some rafters on the Colorado river.
All in all, it was about a 50 minute flight, & it made the long drive out there worth it.
The DVD is great, & we believe worth the money.
We will do it again one day, & would highly recommend it.

A fantastic experience.  We flew from Henderson in a small plane, flying over Lake Mead and the Hoover Dam over the Mojave Desert.  Our pilots were fantastic, allowing us to visit them in the cockpit and get a birds eye view.  Transfer to the chopper was seamless, with a short wait in a very comfortable lounge.  After safety briefing, off we went.  This was the most amazing flight and I must say that once we caught our first glimpse of the canyon, I started to sob and was unable to stop.
The beauty and immensity of this place in indescribable.  After our 25minute flight, we bussed to the Grand Canyon National Park and had a very nice boxed lunch.  Plenty of time here to wander about and some great photo opportunities and viewing points to enjoy.
A must do experience.

Went for the 1000 morning tour. Collected from hotel promptly then taken to there base about 5 minutes south of the strip. A quick induction with a safety video then onto the helicopter with six other customers. 

Helicopter pilot was named Rob and a real gent and full of knowledge. It was a pleasure flying with Rob. 

The trip out we went over the damn and into the canyon and even though it was slightly overcast the views were spectacular. 

We had been a little apprehensive of being travel sick but it was a smooth journey with good and appropriate music played through the headset during the journey. 

Absolutely fantastic and we were glad we took the opportunity to do this trip. There and back in 4 hours by helicopter sure beats a whole day by bus. 

Expensive but well worth doing. If we were doing it again we would maybe do the evening trip coming back over the strip once it is dark to see it light up. 

A very enjoyable half day.
Our pilot, Fred, was wonderfully informative and considerate.  This is the ONLY to see the Grand Canyon.

First time I've visited Grand Canyon and what a way to do it :) With a helicopter. We flew out from Henderson and over Boulder City and Mojave Desert before entering Grand Canyon. There we landed in the bottom of the canyon and had champagne and fruit salad.Really nice. The copter pilot was really something else. Very funny and gave us a good history lesson while flying us safely over this magnificent landscape. If I ever visit Las Vegas again I'll without a doubt will fly with Maverick again. Thanks a lot for this fantastic ride guys. // Juha with family

We took the 45 minute helicopter ride out over the Grand Canyon with Maverick helicopters.
This is one of the best things I have ever done in my life, the pilot was so professional, he didn't just take us there, but showed us a lot of interesting things along the way, we did the early tour and had a champagne breakfast when we arrived, there were 6 of us in the helicopter and going out we were able to sit in the front which was awesome. I would recommend this trip.

I stayed with a group of friends in Vegas and decided to do a trip to the Grand Canyon. After checking out all the options we decided to book with Maverick.
The tour included a flight by plane to Grand Canyon airport, a helicopter tour over the canyon, lunch and you get free time to do a short hike and take pictures at the viewing points. Everybody was very friendly and helpful. One of my friends was terrified of flying the small plane and helicopter but the maverick pilotes did everything they could to make her feel safe. Organisation was very good and would definitely recommend to book with Maverick!

We did the 45 minute tour with BJ.  He was a great guide,and full of information.   We had our 23 year olds kids with us.  They got the front seat and loved every minute of it.  They said this was the best part of our vacation.  I did not want to be up front, and was very happy in the middle.  I did not  have any problem seeing anything.  This was our first time on a helicopter and I was quite nervous.  That disappeared once we were in the air.  I was amazed how beautiful the trip was, and was very happy my family enjoyed it so much.  Would definitely recommend as a must do.  It is pricey but well worth the $.    They record a dvd of the trip and take a picture before you leave in front of the helicopter.  Our picture came out blurry and I really wanted the picture.  So they got the pilot and we all went back and retook the picture.  Everyone in the office was super nice and  friendly.  I booked the tour before we left for vacation and called to see if we could change for an earlier time slot , they had the space and switched our tour no problem.

Took the 45 minute Canyon Spirit Tour. I was lucky enough to get the front seat next to the pilot -  but all the seats had excellent views. 
Before I booked, I  wasn't sure about which company to use, but didn't like the extra charges for front seats, charged by other companies so decided to use Maverick. 
Booking was simple and had excellent communications via websites 'virtual assistant' who patiently answered all my questions. 
Service at the airport also excellent and our pilot was entertaining and knowledgeable and informative throughout the flight.
Fantastic trip.
UM dos melhores e mais seguros passeios em las Vegas. Equipe extremamente profissional e competente. Deixam as pessoas muito seguras. Passeio maravilhoso!!!

My daughter and I did the tour Oct 3rd with Brad who was an excellent guide/pilot. The Canyon was stunning from the air and his narration of the terrain we were viewing was fantastic. We would recommend this tour and Maverick Helicopter Tours in particular to anyone and have told many people about our wonderful experience. Thank you so much for the amazing views!!

Had a brilliant sunset tour to the canyon courtesy of Jarred our pilot. Would definitely recommend paying extra to go by helicopter than plane. We know a couple of people that went by plane and they were disappointed. Would also recommend the sunset tour - the different colours in the canyon were amazing and the flight back over the 'Strip' was just superb. We found Maverick were efficient and good value for money. Thank you to Jarred you were great fun!

My family and I shared a 45-minute Canyon overflight with 4 other guests plus the Billy the pilot (8 total), starting about 4PM. These folks were great from check-in to reluctant good-byes. The desk staffers were friendly and very helpful. Billy gave us a quick but thorough safety talk and we were under way. The helicopter looked brand-new and Billy handled it expertly. This is definitely a family-friendly experience in every way, but in particular for anyone nervous about flying: Billy kept it smooth with absolutely no tricks or stunts. In my opinion, Billy also has just the right touch with inflight commentary: he's very knowledgeable and shares interesting facts but leaves enough quiet time to let the Canyon speak for itself. To sum it up, we all wanted to go back and do it again. Without exageration, this is possibly the best thing we've ever done on a family trip.

review_title: Canyon Spirit was over in no time
review_text:
Comfortable helicopter, accomplished pilot (Brett) and a seamless check in procedure. It does take a few minutes to get to the south rim and back (bear this in mind if you opt for the shorter flight) but you are greater by stunning views around the park. Good commentary as well. What it does show you is the extent of the caverns, we covered only a small part of it and gives us an appetite to come back to the park to see some more. 45$ for a DVD might seem a lot but I would recommend it, we opted to decline the photo as my ever increasing waistline was disturbingly apparent in the photo, if you have a belly and want a photo just do what I didn't do and breath in...

Trip definitely recommended.

Breathtaking experience with no complaints!! Skilled, knowledgeable pilot, amazing scenery, great view -- doesn't get much better than that! Loved that you could buy a video of your ride, complete with comments made by the pilot and passengers. Nice gift shop. Staff was welcoming and friendly. Totally worth the money!!

We arrived late one evening and had booked an early helicopter flight for the following morning several months ago
Maverick were easy to find, very friendly and delivered a wonderful service. 
It's worth noting you need a passport on arrival but all you can take on the flight is water and a camera, so lock the rest in the car!
The pilot was excellent, full of knowledge and with a sense of humour too. 
The first time you go over the rim is so awesome it is almost indescribable! The views from up there are just fantastic and you get to see quite a lot of the canyon. I didn't want it to end! Would recommend to anyone...

We booked the full trip , Grand Canyon , lake mead , Hoover dam , Las Vegas strip  etc . Got picked up at our hotel taken to the heliport and brought back to the hotel , we arranged this through our concierge at our hotel as they could get it cheaper than the booths on the strip . We paid  about £ 550  for two of us and it was worth every penny , it's just something you have to do . Our pilot was brilliant , really funny but knowledgable guy , great memories .

Booked with maverick on the recommendation of the concierge at out hotel and having heard mixed reviews about Sundance!

What an experience! Our pilot was great and made the trip and the Grand Canyon is unmissable!

If I had one criticism it was the cost. The cost for my wife and I worked out at about £680 which I thought was a tad steep.

That aside the company are very professional and the trip really is a once in a lifetime experience!

Nos habian recomendado hacer esta excursion si o si y nos dieron a elegir BUS o Helicopteros. SIN DUDAS, no nos equivocamos al elegir esta opcion (mas cara por supuesto). El precio, realmente lo vale y es algo que nunca vamos a olvidar.
Las vistas son geniales, y te llevan a recorrer alrededores y un paseo por encima de la ciudad.

Consejo: pedirle al piloto que te deje ir adelante, aumenta la adrenalina.

review_title: Unbelievable helicopter trip over the Grand Canyon
review_text: We were first in the air the day we went - it was a beautifully sunny morning and the ride was so smooth.  Our pilot was great fun and pointed out all the sights to us.  The views are truly breathtaking.

review_title: South Rim Grand Canyon with Maverick
review_text: We signed up for a plane tour - 19 seat plane. The flight to South Rim from LV took 30 minutes plus 10 circling around to take pictures. Well organized. We had families from Australia and Korea on our flight. Cameron and Todd (our 2 pilots) were very professional and friendly. Beautiful views! The tour was very well organized and our tour guide Bruce, very knowledgeable and friendly. Grand Canyon is even bigger than you imagine! Excellent experience! Thank you Eric (our trip advisor)

Well organized with personable and highly skilled pilots, this is a must to really experience the Grand Canyon. The special equipment cuts heli noise but let's everyone communicate with one another and hear music. The entire flight is video recorded and a DVD available for purchase.

You feel safe and exhilarated at the same time. Nothing compares to the first time you go over the edge into the canyon. The flight takes you to places impossible to otherwise see and experience.

Thanks to our wonderful pilot, Marcus for this special experience at one of the seven natural wonders of the world!
Expensive but has to be done. Flying over the edge and seeing the canyon disappear in front of you is awesome. Brilliant experience.

realmente ver  el cañon del colorado desde un helicóptero fue realmente una experiencia maravillosa, y volver a las vegas y verla con todas sus luces fue lo mejor. nos toco un piloto muy simpatico, lastima que eramos  6 argentinos y no teníamos manejo del idioma por lo que no pudimos entender nada de la explicación.,  es lo único que critico dado que la excursión es muy cara ( por lo menos para los argentinos ) ( 570 Dolares por persona)  que no cuenten con un piloto que maneje otro idioma. 
igual exelente.

review_title: WINDANCER TOUR- HANDS DOWN BEST TOUR I'VE DONE OF CANYON
review_text:
I have been to the Canyon now 3 times, once with Pink Jeep (great land option), I drove once and stayed overnight and then I did this tour operated by Maverick. I took a group out for my 40th birthday. I love helicopters. IT was my Mum's first time.
Our pilot and guide was incredible. The helicopter amazing. Safety first with this company. The chopper holds 7 and everyone gets a chance to sit in the front. You each get a set of headphones and a microphone to chat. We flew over the dam and then across a magnificent landscape and then to the Canyon floor near the mighty Colorado River where we had champagne, soft drinks and snacks. Was just lovely. We spent about 30 mins or so there? IT was time to go but that was ok. Helicopter back with a cruise down the Las Vegas strip from the air!!! Just amazing.
They take photos of you in front of the chopper, and I bought one- and for me the price was ok. You can also get a video, but we didn't bother with that.
Totally worth the money. I am an agent and had been selling this for quite a few years as THE TOUR to do. Now I've done it, I know I was right in saying that to them. 
Do it- you won't regret it.
Note when booking: Do not leave this until your last day, sometimes weather prevents the choppers going up or if the President is in town, the airspace can sometimes be closed. Book it for your first available day/time, so if you do have to change, you can.

En Las Vegas, uno de los paseos más espectaculares que se puede hacer es volar en helicóptero sobre el Gran Cañón del Colorado. La experiencia con Mavericks Helicopter Tours fue muy agradable, desde el momento en que lo recogen a uno en el hotel. Nuestro piloto fue muy amable y tuvimos la fortuna de contar con un día despejado que nos permitió disfrutar la vista y conseguir fotografías maravillosas de la Presa Hoover y el Gran Cañón. Lo único que no es muy recomendable es comprar el video que le ofrece la compañía a uno. Esperábamos que fuera un video de nuestra excursión y resultó ser un video muy largo sobre el trayecto y algunas panorámicas aéreas desactualizadas de Las Vegas.

We had seen the Grand Canyon before, and wanted to do something different this time. We took our two young kids and did the 45 minute ride. What a thrill! It was scary, beautiful, informative, and a ton of fun. Our pilot knew a lot about the canyon and told us a frightful story about having to land on a rock formation in the canyon during a lightening storm. He also "took requests" when my son begged for tricks and free falls (with everyone's consent). I felt surprisingly safe even through I was in a small craft hovering over a huge canyon on a stormy day. Highly recommend!!

Booked a sunset flight to the Grand Canyon a few months before our trip to Vegas. The weather forecast was showing a storm on the day we were supposed to go and we called up Maverick the day before who were happy to move the flight to a couple of days later for us and we did the trip on our last day. Absolutely the best thing we did in Vegas and one of the most amazing experiences of our lives! Would highly recommend maverick for the comfort and enjoyment of the flight. Not a bad place to sit in the helicopter. We got to sit in the front on the way and then in the back on the way back and had good views as the wrap around windows are brilliant for seeing out of. Our pilot  was Matthew, he is a credit to Maverick! A lovely guy and made us feel really relaxed and was very informative. His customer service was exceptional and we enjoyed the music he had chosen for the journey. This was the first time to the Grand Canyon and Vegas so can't compare to other companies but from my experience couldn't recommend this company more and would also recommend the sunset flight and the valley of fire was gorgeous. Loved every minute and think it is worth every penny.. Thank you to Matthew and the maverick team for the whole experience you have us. One we will never forget :) very happy customers! Hannah and Mike x

review_title: Føjer en ekstra dimension til Grand Canyon besøg
review_text:
Vi syntes egentlig, at en helikoptertur var for dyr, men besluttede i sidste øjeblik at ofre pengene på Maverick's 45 minutters Grand Spirit Tour alligevel - heldigvis, for det er alle pengene værd !

Helikopterturen gav et helt nyt syn på, hvor stor og sammensat Grand Canyon egentlig er, og pilotens forklaringer undervejs gav indblik i mange ting, som man ikke tænker over, når man besøger parken i bil. Faktisk kan man udtrykke det som et skifte fra 2D- til 3/4D View over Grand Canyon.

Der tilbydes 25 minutters helikopterture over GC, men merprisen til den store tur opvejes helt sikkert af den større oplevelse ved også at se den østlige del af kløften.

Hvis du har muligheden, bør du absolut unde dig denne oplevelse for livet.

The ride is incredible with a great tour of the Grand Canyon with a very knowledgeable and informative pilot.  The helicopter holds 7 passengers and the pilot with 3 seats in the front.  Everyone has a headset with a microphone which allows passengers to communicate with each other and the pilot.

Did the Canyon Dream and Land Tour . We were picked up on time from our Hotel, check in at the airport was smooth, the 2 two pilots who took us out to the grand canyon in a very small plane were great fun. We did not have to wait long at the Canyon before being taken by Helicopter over South Rim, it was an informative and lovely trip, we were then bused to another location for another view from land and given a packed lunch , the only complaint was the bus we had or rather a trolley type vehicle to this location was not the most comfortable ride but it wasn't for long. Overall well run, professional, informative and a great day out

review_title: Best way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: A helicopter trip is the best way to really appreciate the scale of the Grand Canyon and Maverick are a very professional outfit. Our pilot, Mike, was friendly, amusing, knowledgable and of course highly competent. You need to take the 50' trip to get a decent amount of time over the canyon itself. It is not always the case that heavier people sit next to the windows as claimed by a previous reviewer - it depends on the mix.

We were picked from the hotel by a shuttle bus, taken to the airport, Thankyou to Eric and Travis, our pilots on the plane to the canyon, they were very informative and have a great sense of humour. We then caught the helicopter flown by Jake. Amazing experience flying over the southern and northern rims. Well worth the money. Bruce the "trolley driver" was also helpful and thanks for the "handmade sandwiches" 5stars!!!

review_title: Great view but don't expect action
review_text: The views are great but I expected to get more action for the cash. Ask if the helicopter is fully booked, if you get a seat in the back in the middle you probably won't enjoy it very much. Heavy people have to sit at the windows. Try to be the heaviest in the group and you will be lucky ;-)

review_title: What a view of the canyon!!
review_text: We took a helicopter flight over the GC in Aug 2014 and loved it.  Our pilot was knowledgable but didn't talk the whole time which let us enjoy the scenery.  We could communicate on the headsets with microphones but once we got over the canyon it was mostly quiet in awe of the view.  We chose the longer tour as you can see a lot more of the canyon and it may be the only time we visit.  After the flight the pilot offered to take our photo by the aircraft which was a nice surprise--most places would use their own photographer and charge an arm and a leg.  I definitely recommend this tour!

We were 3 friends that took the sunset trip - we left at 6pm with our pilot - Justin.  The helicopter seats 8 people and there was another family of 3 with us as well. The nice thing was that they allowed the family of 3 to sit in the front seats for the first part of the trip and when we stopped to refuel, we got to swap over to the front seats.  The flight was very smooth and I enjoyed the pilots selection of music during the flight and the interesting facts and stories about the area.  The sunset trip was great as we got to see Hoover dam, Lake Mead and the Grand Canyon by the light but by the time the sun went down, we had returned to the strip and we got to see the lights of Vegas.  Mavericks were very professional and offered a complementary shuttle service to the airport and back again to your hotel.  I would highly recommend using this company for a flight through the Canyon and over the strip.

We went on a family trip to Grand Canyon in April and took the Canyon Spirit Tour with Maverick. It's a lot of money and I did wonder whether it would be worth it but we had a fantastic time, and would thoroughly recommend it to anyone. Maverick is a very slick and efficient operation with modern helicopters in pristine condition and our pilot was very friendly and knowledgeable. One small thing to be aware of is that their "Grand Canyon South Rim terminal" isn't actually at the South Rim but at Tusayan a few miles south. Not a big deal, but Maverick seem to be a bit shy about their actual location!

Great trip, takes 12 hours by bus and you don't see anything compared to the helicopters, friendly and informative staff and very professional set up
Would do again

Although quite pricey, this was the most incredible experience. Worth every cent.  It is a very professional outfit and our pilot was informative and interesting.  The views are incredible and you see so much more and experience the Canyon very differently.  Mavericks helicopters have staggered seating so everyone gets a good view and the "windscreen" extends round to the floor of the helicopter which gives an even better sensation.  Truly memorable.

We were picked up at Bellagio hotel at 7am (beware it is at the parking downstairs), driven in a shuttle to the Maverick helicopter base in Las Vegas, and after a briefing we went aboard an EC-130 helicopter which seems to be made for sightseeing. We got into the helicopter half an hour after our arrival and flew over the  Hoover dam and several other places in the Grand Canyon. We landed and had a light brunch at mid journey at about 70 miles from the base, and then we returned back to the base by another path. There we could change place with the two passengers who had the front seats, and we changed another time after the refueling. Everybody (we were 6 passengers) could experience the front seats. We ended the tour with an overflight of the Las Vegas Strip. The pilot was very kind, he answered to all the silly questions we had with lots of patience. Around 12pm we were back at the Bellagio. We paid around $2100 for a family of 4 in August 2014. This tour deserves to be recommended. This was certainly the best part of our travel across the US.

Het kost een rib uit je lijf maar wij vonden het waard. Wat een ervaring! De airport is makkelijk te vinden. Inchecken is zo gebeurd. Je vliegt eerst 5 minuten over bos en dan ineens valt de grond weg en hang je boven de canyon. Waanzinnig! Wij hadden de vlucht van 45 minuten. Had langer mogen duren. De canyon is zo enorm groot. Je ziet dat pas als je eroverheen vliegt. En dan nog is het moeilijk inschatten hoever het diepte ingaat. Had het niet willen missen.

review_title: Amazing experience but some slight disappointments
review_text:
It is an amazing experience to fly out over the Grand Canyon but it is also an expensive excursion to take. We were really glad that we took the opportunity as it really gives you much more a sense of the scale and majesty of the canyon that you can get from standing in the edge.

The slight disappointments were that the windows of the helicopter were marked and so this affected the quality of photographs we could take and that the pilot commented on landing that tips were "not expected but were appreciated". If they are not expected then don't mention it!

Be aware that:
As you are seated to balance the weight in the helicopter you are not necessarily placed near the person or people you are travelling with.
You are not allowed handbags or purses in the helicopter.

The tour we had from Maverick was very amazing. The team working at Mavericks are highly professional, not to mention knowledgeable. We learned allot about Las Vegas flying over and around on our way to Grand Canyon. They have different packages for what you want to do. We got the one with the landing and serving of chilled whine and some cheese and fruit. Superb!
I must mention the reason giving them "Excellent" is the way they rescheduled our flight after our first landing, because of broken clouds over the canyon. Being told that we could have another trip the same day but later was amazing!

Flying in a helicopter over the Grand Canyon was on our bucket list and based on reviews, we felt it was a must do. We are glad we took the trip. This is most fabulous experience. Standing on the rim of the Grand Canyon gives you some perspective of the massive size of this natural wonder, but it is no comparison to flying over it in the helicopter. The Maverick staff was wonderful and the facilities are excellent. I strongly urge you to consider booking a tour with them, they were awesome!

This was by far one of the highlights of our holiday.  Heli flight over Hoover Dam to the Grand Canyon and into the Canyon for a light lunch and champagne.  What more could you ask for.  Amazing scenery and the shear size of the Canyon is breathtaking.  Tour guides were awesome!!  Loved it!!

Met een helikopter vliegen over de grand Canyon is een zeer bijzondere ervaring die ik iedereen kan aanraden. De wijsheid van het landschap en wilde stroming van de rivier komen bij deze vlucht veel beter tot z'n recht dan de normale bezichtiging vanaf de rand.

review_title: The highlight of our USA holiday!
review_text: We chose Maverick as we were staying at the Grand Canyon South Rim and the airport was a five minute drive from our hotel. We had booked a morning flight and the weather couldn't have been better, clear blue sky, perfect conditions for our helicopter tour.  Cory our pilot was fantastic, he was incredibly knowledgeable about the Canyon, the forests that we flew over and the area generally.  We had the most amazing 50 minute flight, we would certainly do it again!

review_title: Une vue du Grand Canyon incroyable
review_text:
A une minute de notre hôtel à Tusayan, nous avons donc survolé pendant 30 minutes le Grand Canyon par un temps superbe (c'est le seul aléas qui peut faire basculer cette expérience).
Nous avons "perdu" 20 minutes de vol avant d'arriver au-dessus du Grand Canyon proprement dit mais l'attente valait le coup. Durée du vol complète: +/- 45/50 minutes.
La vue du Grand Canyon depuis un hélico n'a rien à voir avec celle que l'on peut avoir depuis les différents points de vue dans le parc. Et nous les avons tous faits !
C'est un très très grand moment tant pour nous que pour nos trois enfants. Ceux-ci étaient assis à côté du pilote avec une vue saisissante.
Nous étions derrière avec une vue très bonne aussi.
L'hélicoptère est très bon (Eurocopter, cocorico c'est européen !) et le pilote (Brett) était impeccable. Très professionnel, il a distillé ses commentaires à bon escient et a répondu à toutes les questions avec beaucoup de gentillesse. Attention, il ne parle qu'anglais. Pour les enfants ce fut donc un peu difficile. Mais le spectacle se passe de commentaires.
Le prix: c'est cher (1.370 $ pour 5) mais c'est une petite folie qu'on doit s'offrir.
A la fin du vol, la traditionnelle photo et le dvd du vol sont bien sûr payants (50 $ pour les deux) mais encore une fois c'est une très belle expérience et nous avons pris le "combo" photo/dvd.
Ils proposent aussi, à l'américaine, tout un tas de t-shirt, casquettes et produits dérivés en tout genre.
A noter le grand professionnalisme de tous les intervenants dans cette compagnie. Nickel !
Experiencia imperdible. La mejor vista del Cañón del Colorado. Helicópteros  aptos para no perderse ni  un detalle. Pilotos experimentados.
This was well worth the money.  Took the 45 minute tour, and it was fantastic!  You really get a new perspective of the Canyon when your 5000 ft above it!  Great experience!!!

review_title: the ONLY way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: Flying over the rim into the canyon is like nothing else: our pilot was very knowledgeable and informative and there seemed to be very good safety checks etc before we took off, which was reassuring. Quite expensive but definitely one of the highlights of a fantastic trip.

Prise en charge à l'hôtel, transfert à l'aéroport (privé), un peu d'attente, mais bon... Survol du Grand Canyon, re-prise en charge par un bus au charme désuet (mais avec air conditionné et vitesses automatiques, faut pas pousser !), pilote, co-pilote et bus driver très agréables (mention spéciale au pilote, "cats in pyjamas" :), deux heures en tout pour profiter de la vue, et des écureuils (ne pas les toucher : danger !), boutique souvenir (business business), mais on était là pour ça aussi ! Ne pas hésiter, compagnie sure. Excellente organisation. Merci !

review_title: My first helicopter tour ever - absolutely worth it
review_text:
I was slightly worried how will I react to my first helicopter tour but it was absolutely amazing.
When flying to the Grand Canyon we saw the Hoover dam.
It was breathtaking when we were flying over the Grand Canyon.

We decided for the skywalk tour and it was absolutely stunning.

On the way back we flew over the strip.
Best pictures ever.

Staff was very friendly.
Would absolutely recommend it !

Awesome experience flying from Las Vegas over the Hoover dam on route to the Grand Canyon 
Something I will never forget & the return trip back to Vegas flying down the Strip taking in all the views,worth doing no doubt.

Pilot Jake took us on a flight which even exceeded our very high expectations. Interesting guiding to fabulous views and the feeling when you "tip" over the rim beats everything. Whole flight accompanied with great music (when silent on the intercom).

Memory of lifetime!

review_title: Sobrevoo + ou - de helicóptero sobre o Grand Canyon south rhim
review_text:
Fizemos o voo com a Maverick em Tusayan na borda sul do Grand Canyon. O dia estava nublado e chuvoso o que atrapalhou muito o passeio. A beleza do Grand Canyon está nas dimensões e cores das camadas no paredões. Neste dia estava tudo cinza. 
A voo com a Maverick parece bem seguro, mas o sobrevoo se dá a uma altura considerável acima do Canyon e isso tornou o passeio um tanto monótono. Somente no final o piloto desceu um pouco mais perto das montanhas. 
Se o tempo estiver nublado ou sem sol, não faça o passeio. Melhor fazer no amanhecer ou entardecer, mas com sol e visibilidade.

We took two trips with Maverick Helicopters. One to the Grand Canyon and one over the Las Vegas strip at night. Both trips were outstanding! The views of the strip, Hoover Dam and the Grand Canyon were amazing. We also landed at the Grand Canyon and I would highly recommend this option for your trip. Staff were very friendly and professional.

D'accord, c'est cher (très cher) : comptez 800 euros pour un peu moins d'une heure à trois, mais vous ne le regretterez pas. La vue est exceptionnelle, le pilote et le parcours rassurant pour ceux qui flippent, c'est un TRÈS GRAND moment.

My daughter has always wanted to do this and it was her surprise birthday present. We chose Maverick as they had excellent reviews and the tour was longer. It was well worth the price - as was the souvenir DVD and photo at the end. The place was easy to find, extremly well laid out, clean and welcoming. There was a reception desk, lounge and souvenir shop, with a cafe and toilets. The girls were told about safety and were escorted to the helicopter by their pilot. They had front seat views and a totally amazing trip. They saw bison, rock formations, the colorado and the north and south rims. It was most definately worth the extra money compared to other operators and I am so glad and happy I chose Maverick. I would totally recommend them.

review_title: This is how to see Grand Canyon
review_text:
From the lookouts at ground level you get a sense of scale but only by taking the helicopter do you begin to appreciate the Grand Canyon. Took 45 minute ride which was expensive but well worth it. We even bought DVD of our trip as it shows a much wider view than sitting on one side of the helicopter. 

Great fun and a must do. Hovering over the Southern Rim of the Canyon was jaw dropping.

The base for Maverick is best approached from Southern entrance to airport.

We did a lot of research before we went and ended up booking with Maverick due to the trip advisor reviews. So glad we did. It was amazing and whilst the Grand Canyon would be amazing with any of the tour companies, Maverick were faultless. Great pilot and very knowledgable, took off on time, super helicopter and all round great customer service.

review_title: Sensational and time effective way to visit Grand Canyon
review_text: Having only one day to visit the Grand Canyon, this gave a perfect overview, worth the 'investment'. Book the night before, we recommend an early flight before noon, so that there is time left for a visit afterwards of the Grand Canyon Visitors Center and its amazing viewpoints.

After having said for years I would love to see the Grand Canyon, I was finally able to realise my dream and take my two teenage sons along for the ride. We decided on the sunset tour which meant we got a wonderful view of the lights on the strip on the way back in. We were shown a safety video before meeting our pilot and having photos taken, then boarding the helicopter.
I am not too good with heights and found myself seated in the front next to the pilot! Ryan was extremely competent and knowledgeable putting me at ease immediately. It was great to start In the front  but we were also happy to switch with the other party in the back when we made a quick stop to refuel. This was a bonus, as we didn't expect to be able to get out and stretch our legs and get photos on the ground. 
Ryan's commentary was informative and interesting and he was more than happy to answer any questions put to him. Not sure if the soundtrack/playlist was provided by the company or the pilot, but we all really enjoyed that too.
The trip back provided even more wonderful photographic opportunities, the landscape is just amazing. 
Well organised shuttle buses are provided by Maverick, so no problem getting to and from.
I would have got on that helicopter and gone out again and again! 
Definitely won't disappoint!!

The helicopter tour was absolutely amazing. It was the first time I've ever been in a helicopter and I was not disappointed. This is definitely the best way to see the grand canyon for the first time, the view is out of this world. The pilot was fantastic and made a brilliant soundtrack as we flew over the canyon and was very informative about the sight. The trip wasn't  too long and we saw everything that we wanted.

The helicopter takes seven passengers, three in the front, four in the book. A computer algorithm assigns passengers to seats based on weight. If you show up obese, you will definitely be in the back row with a less expansive view than if you are in front. Overweight in the back please. Based on my observation, the charming pilots run their own algorithm which always, purely by chance,  places the most attractive young lady in your group in the seat next to them.

My wife and I were teamed up with a family of four and we were both sent to the back of the bus. This seemed unfair but we are now determined to lose the weight necessary to be promoted to the front row next time.

Another slight problem is that you wear a headset throughout the flight and may have to listen to others in your party chit-chatting in a foreign language throughout the flight...slightly annoying.

Our pilot was both professional and pleasant. You will receive a pitch about the cost of flight school....and tips are therefore expected and gratefully accepted.

But even if you are in the second row and paired up with non-English speakers,this is a great experience. A tour of the GC is simply not complete without the helicopter ride.

review_title: The best way to see the Canyon
review_text: Mavericks tours were well organised, friendly, experienced and above all very knowledgeable! We flew with them in the morning and our pilot was fantastic. I was nervous about going up in a helicopter but he really put me at ease. You cannot describe how mind-blowing it is to fly over the Canyon in a helicopter, you just have to experience it for yourself and I can highly recommend Mavericks for this.

Organised a trip to see the Hoover Dam and also the Grand Canyon and really enjoyable. Landed in the Grand Canyon and had a small snack and refreshments will taking photos. Excellent pilot and cant fault anything with this company. Very organised and felt very comfortable every step of the way. Well Done!!

We took my fiance's grandfather on this trip because he has always wanted to see the Grand Canyon. Well this was certainly the way to do it! The pilot was very nice, he made us so comfortable that I never even felt nervous. When we asked if it would be possible for Grandpa to sit next to the pilot they even accommodated us and rearranged the seating. The minute we flew over the canyon, I was breathless! Before this trip, I did not know what it meant to have your breath taken away and I will never forget it!

I absolutely loved my helicopter trip over the Grand Canyon! Our pilot was really nice and gave us loads of interesting facts about the canyon.

We had booked the 50 minute flight, check in was quick and pleasant, all the staff were friendly, he shop was good but a little expensive but I wouldn't expect anything different.

The flight was amazing, we flew over the canyon for at least 40 mins (rest of the time was getting to the canyon and back) after the flight the pilot was happy to let us take photos with him and our group.

While pricey at $400 per person which included a glass of cheap champagne and a plastic wrapped pastry, the flight and scenery are to die for. The whole time I was amazed, I sat next to the pilot on the way out, it was perfect, hard to explain how good it is to see something so amazing, the only down side if you could find one was the really bad champagne and pastry, for an extra $10 they could of made a slightly better choice but its not like you go on it for the food and champagne... Definitely do it, I wouldnt book through Qantas hilidays again though as we figured out we paid about 30% more than other people in our same chopper which is not that great when the flight for both if us was $800 and some people paid less than $600 as a couple

Amazing sights. Did helicopter tour and went to all the spots. Amazing. Ask for Chris Wiley as he is the best and most informed helicopter and plane pilot. Problem was that with the ticket you get free lunch and get to choose off an entire menu. But when you order you are only allowed a hotdog or nachos... Not the entire menu even though it's printed on the wall.

review_title: Husbands to do list checked off
review_text:
My husband and i took our second trip to grand canyon one of the things he wished to do was see the canyon from up above. May 26 @1015am one of his life goals came true. He rode up front with the pilot . I sat in the back.  Greeted at counter by young lady. Our trip began by being flown over pine trees 5 minutes than the aaahh wows began!

Pros 
see south rim of canyon
 Jade blue river
narrated history of native tribes and the land
see my husband excited and excited at samr time 
see Gods wonders
Get pair of audiophones speak to pilot ask questions 
Courteous staff

Maverick Helicopters faz muitos passeios diferentes, partindo de Las Vegas até o Grand Canyon.
Fomos na que mostrava o entardecer.
Não decepciona. O piloto era experiente e simpático, os helicópteros modernos e seguros.
A volta, já a noite, é sobre a Strip de Las Vegas, uma atração sem a beleza natural do canyon, é claro, mas que tem seu interesse.

My wife and I booked the 7 hour Grand Canyon Tour and it was one of the greatest things we have ever done.  Our Pilot (Matt) was absolutely brilliant.  He acted as pilot, server, photographer, tour guide and comedian.  

It is a fantastic way of seeing the Canyon, and the flight there takes only 45 minutes - much better than the 4 hour bus ride!  We landed on the bottom of the Canyon to enjoy some champagne, we then went to the SkyWalk (a must do) before visiting another location to enjoy lunch.

Maverick were extremely professional, well organised and definitely worth the money.  We would highly recommend Maverick.

A superb way to see the Grand Canyon, knowledgeable pilot, and had a lovely picnic when we landed, i was a bit worried about the reviews of not being able to see from certain seats but i needn't have worried you can see from all seats, and have the opportunity's to swap seats at different legs of the journey - well worth the money

review_title: Excellent way to see the canyon
review_text:
We had an early morning flight on a clear day. We were concerned as some reviewers had complained about the seating (which is done by weight) however my husband and I were in the back and I was in one of the middle seats and I don't understand how people could complain because my view was absolutely fantastic, granted the front seats may be better but i didn't feel like I'd missed out at all. 

Very informative tour and landed so smoothly that I hadn't noticed we'd touched down. Got full time in the air and was swift boarding and departing too. 

Excellent experience and best way to see such a beautiful sight.

There are 3 Helicopter companies operating flights out of the Grand Canyon airport. We had researched the alternatives and saw that there are essentially two flight paths that they all use. The short flight is 10 / 15minute across the forest and then up the western end of the Grand Canyon Park section of the canyon, and the longer 40 / 50 minute flight heads out east to the far end  of the canyon then back along the canyon before returning to the airport along the route used by the shorter flight. We made our choice of company based upon the helicopters used and price. Maverick use the Eco-Star helicopters which have 7 passenger seats, all forward facing, in a cabin with big wrap around glass windows. The longer flight is only $30 more than the short flight at $249 + fees and taxes ($274 in total) but there is probably 10 times as much time spent flying over the canyon itself. 
Brenton, our pilot, was brilliant. The flight starts off with a low flight over the Ponderosa Pine forest and then the forest suddenly vanishes from below you as you launch out over the canyon with the vertical drop of the chasm below you. Everyone on our flight gave an instant cheer as we suddenly encountered the thrill of the flight. 
Yes, the cost is significant...but how often are you going to visit the Grand Canyon? We will remember the experience forever!

review_title: Great experience, a must when in Vegas!
review_text: It's got to be done! We took the plane with Mavericks to the Grand Canyon. They did not disappoint! A very professional and fun tour. If you're in Vegas you must do this! I didn't think it would be possible to feel like a teenager again! But I really did! What fun we had! Highly recommended.

review_title: Excellent service and all round great experience
review_text:
Bruce was our tour guide and was great, funny and efficient and had a good knowledge of the canyon and surrounding areas.
Benson was our helicopter pilot and was excellent, calm and informative and the whole trip was a highlight at the end of our holiday - thank you :)

Spectacular views of the Hoover Dam, lake Las Vegas, lake Mead but nothing like flying inside the Grand Canyon and land at the side of the river...

Simply the best.

My husband and I made an expensive detour to Las Vegas, especially to see the Grand Canyon.
He had never been there and we flew in from Washington late at night, spending a total of 31.5hrs in our hotel (2nights). But what a great experience and well worth the detour in our holiday.
The ground staff were timely in their hotel pickup and courteous. Mike our pilot was friendly, knowledgeable and clearly good at what he does as he is also the company pilot assessment officer.The company has a well maintained fleet.
We shared our five hours with two young couples and we all got to spend time in the front seats. 

A spectacular experience. Thank you Mike. Thank you Maverick!

My 14 year old daughter and I took the 50 minute GC tour from the South Rim Airport this morning. 
From the phone call to make the reservation until we departed we were treated very well by super nice and experienced people.  Patti at the check-in was the sweetest lady who took time with us and made every effort to insure our enjoyment.  Our pilot, Jake, was very knowledgeable and engaging.  There were 4 family members from Italy and my daughter and I from Texas.  Jake made sure everyone was engaged and had a good time.  The view, the detailed tour, the people and the equipment made this a first class experience.   The Ecostar was amazing.  It was comfortable and we felt very safe.  My daughter loved it.  She had a front window seat which made it very memorable.

Thank u Patti!  Thank u Jake!  

We highly recommend Maverick!

review_title: Mit Fensterplatz fantastisch; hinten in der Mitte: spart das Geld!
review_text:
Personal und Pilot sind sehr freundlich, nett und professionell. Wir haben einen Abend vorher die "Canyon Spirit Tour" vor Ort gebucht und wurden sehr freundlich über alles informiert. Bei uns zwei Personen wurde ein Fensterplatz garantiert, den wir auch bekommen haben. 
Der Helicopter hat vorne vier Plätze (1 für den Piloten :-)  ) und hinten 4 erhöhte Sitzplätze. Die Fensterplätze sind ohne Frage prima. Somit bekommt alles von einer Person die Bewertung ausgezeichnet. Der Pilot hat informativ erzählt, alle Fragen beantwortet und ist die Maschine sehr umsichtig geflogen.
Wer allerdings hinten die zwei Plätze in der Mitte nehmen muss (keine Wahl, da die Plätze nach Gewicht verteilt werden), kann sein Geld lieber sparen! Die Leute am Fenster verdecken mit ihren Armen beim fotografieren jede Sichtmöglichkeit. Auch nach vorne hin verdecken entweder die Köpfe die Sicht oder die Fensterstreben schränken das Blickfeld ein. Wer fotografieren möchte, hat überhaupt keine Chance, da die rechte hintere Scheibe auch noch stark zerkratzt war. Wir fühlen uns für den einen Betrag von 250 $ schlichtweg betrogen.
Dass das Fliegen und das Erlebnis an sich fantastisch ist, versteht sich von selbst.
Wir würden es aber nur empfehlen mit einem garantierten Fensterplatz!!
Kommt nicht in Versuchung, die DVD anschließend zu kaufen! Die DVD vom Flug ist überflüssig und blanke Abzocke. Der überdimensionale Weitwinkel verzerrt die Wirklichkeit. Die Farben sind dürftig bis mangelhaft bzw. nicht vorhanden, und die Aufnahme ist sehr pixelig.

We knew this would be good but it exceeded our expectations. Maverick Helicopters is a very professional company and our pilot Billy was friendly and welcoming. He shared an enormous amount of information about the Grand Canyon and surrounding areas. I felt rather emotional as we flew over the rim for the first time - the canyon is unimaginably vast and incredibly beautiful. It was our first helicopter flight but, surprisingly, I did not feel at all nervous. Do not hesitate to take this trip, it was worth it!

Absolut genial! Wir hatten einen 90min Flug, 2 Landungen - eine mit Picknick und Prosecco😉einen sehr erfahrenen Piloten, der viele interessante Infos gab. Der Transfer vom Hotel zum Heliport war ca. 20min und folgte direkt und ohne grosse Umwege über andere Hotels etc - dies trotz Memorial-day-WE. Der Preis ist hoch - aber wo ist Heli fliegen nicht teuer?!? Wir haben einige Anbieter gecheckt und sind mit den Leistungen und dem Service von Maverick Helicopters sehr zufrieden!

I had planned my trip to vegas within an inch of my life. I had taken my partner for her birthday and this was her first visit to the USA   I had planned concerts,shows,hot air balloon rides,buying an engagement ring from Tiffany and ultimately a trip to the Grand Canyon to ask a very special lady a very big question !
I chose maverick not because they were the cheapest, because they are not that, but because of their professional approach, the standard of aircraft, their fantastic safety record and they are the ONLY company that actually land inside the Grand Canyon 
Our first flight was canceled due to high winds, we expected this as we had been at the pool that day and it sure was windy that day 
Our second trip the next day was also canceled due to high winds, again we were expecting it because lying round the pool in 40* temperatures a strong breeze is very welcome and we fully understand that it's not great for helicopters flying around a canyon
Third time lucky we were greater by our pilot taken outside given a good safety briefing and off we go the trip was fantastic the narration funny but very informative from our enchanting pilot 
The landing into the canyon smooth and without a hitch. The pilot then gets out some 
Asti Spumante ............ Point of note to all American tour companies this is NOT champagne,not even close !  And a small plastic carton of a couple of grapes,slice of celery, a small carrot 
I wish they hadn't bothered, it's the only let down to the whole experience. They let themselves and their clients down with this 
However Maverick helicopter tours of Las Vegas I would fly with again I would recommend anyone who might be nervous to pay the extra dollars and go with the company that would rather cancel your trip than take you up when it's not safe it was a truly fantastic flight with a breathtakingly beautiful flight down the strip at night on the way back to the terminal 
Our next planned trip is to Hawaii where maverick are in the process of setting up a new operation and we will definitely do the Islands tour with them there 
Thank you to all that made our trip very magical 
Sincere thanks Stephen & Jan Milton Keynes England

review_title: The only way to do it!
review_text: Took a flight over the Grand Canyon and found it totally stunning! On arrival at check in we found the staff very courteous and helpful. We had a pilot named Patrick, very appropriate for us Disney fans of Soarin', and he was brilliant. The in flight commentary was very informative and amusing at times. I was nervous initially of feeling motion sick but I needn't have worried - it was exceptionally smooth. Purchased the "team photo" and DVD of our flight although not had chance to view it yet. Highly recommended although not cheap but what an experience!

This was our first helicopter ride but not our last, it was great.  And to see the Grand Canyon for the first time this way was amazing.  The staff were great, we just stop in and they had us on the next trip out.  The pilots were great.  Will do again.

Zero complaints on this service.  Everything was as advertised and the staff was professional and entertaining while airborne.  We hesitated doing this due to the cost, but was so glad we did it after it was done.  If you can afford to do it without foreclosing on the house do it!!!

Après avoir réservé le vol, une pluie battante est tombée.nous avons voulu décalé le vol, mais impossible car tant qu'il n'y a pas d'orage, l'hélicoptère peut voler !!!! Nous n'avons pas profité du paysage car nous n'avions aucune visibilité et nous n'avons pris aucune photos. C'est une honte sachant le prix qu'il faut payer. Je déconseille fortement c'est une boîte à fric et il ne respecte pas les clients.

La experiencia de ver el Cañón del Colorado desde el aire es maravillosa, el paisaje es imponente. Vale la pena el tour, es muy seguro y la gente de Maverick muy profesional, el piloto nos tranquilizó pues era la primera vez que volábamos en helicóptero pero el viaje estuvo muy tranquilo y lo disfrutamos mucho. Estuvimos en el tour por la tarde, la hora fue perfecta, de regreso se ve el atardecer y las luces de Las Vegas, es muy bonito. Inicialmente queriamos el tour que iba al Skywalk pero me parece que lo que se puede ver desde el aire y la experiencia de bajar a una parte del cañón a la que solo se puede ir en helicóptero y hacer un pequeño picnic allí, fue lo mejor!

The customer service staff are less than helpful. We were given the wrong time to turn up so had to wait over an hour; and instead of being greeted with a friendly welcome we got a "give me your credit card" which tainted the experience somewhat. But when we eventually got to meet the pilot, Rivers, he was friendly. His tour narration was excellent - not irritating and egotistical as many of the other tours have been - and the flight was excellent. We went right into the canyon, 45 min tour and it truly is the best way to see the Grand Canyon (we flew from Tusayan airport). We were both sat in the front and had excellent views. Highly recommend this tour but hope the counter staff sharpen their customer service.

review_title: The best thing I have EVER done
review_text: My partner bought me this experience for my birthday as part of our USA road trip and it is quite literally the best thing I've ever done. The Maverick team were so friendly and professional and our pilot, Brett, made every effort to make our trip special, chatting to us, telling us anecdotes and explaining what we were seeing. There were some kiddies on our flight and he was great with them too. When you arrive they will take your photo with the helicopter, which you can buy (the photo not the helicopter) but we were also allowed to take our own photos with Brett after the flight so chose to give him a bigger tip instead of buying the photo. The flight itself was incredible - when we first flew over the rim into the canyon I burst in to tears - it was just the most beautiful, breathtaking sight ever.  The windows are really clean so you can take decent photos. We spent loads of time in the canyon and flew right across to the North Rim and back (although we were lucky as it's not always possible to get over there, depending on the weather). In total we were up for around an hour. A couple of things - (1) yes, seating is allocated by weight so you might not get a front or window seat. I was lucky, I had the front/side window, but my partner was at back/side window and he said it was still great. (2) sometimes the weather makes it unsafe to fly. Maverick cannot be held responsible for the weather! If you're undecided about making this trip DO IT, DO IT, DO IT! And I would definitively recommend Maverick as the people to fly with.

I took the Indian Territory tour which included being picked up from our hotel, taken to Maverick, flown to the Grand Canyon, where we landed inside and had champagne and pastries (20 mins) on our way we flew over the hoover dam, then we were flown to the Glass Walk (be warned though tickets not included in price of tour, extra $35 which i was a bit annoyed about, why fly there is you are going to go on it. Anyway after we went on the glass bridge which is amazing but you aren't allowed camera by the way we hopped on a bus and went to Guano point which is a great viewing point and we had lunch (included). We were then flown back from the Grand Canyon, back down the Vegas Strip and then returned to our hotel. The pilot was very nice and very informative and i felt in safe hands. I had a great time and would definitely recommend.

Wir buchten die Canyon Spirit Tour.
Sehr gute Abwicklung beim telefonischen Buchen, für einen Flug am selben Tag. Beim Check in kam schon Professionalität durch, Gewichtsprüfung, Tips etc.. 
Der junge Pilot war gut, hatte den Heli trotz Thermik  vom Start bis zur Landung voll im Griff. 
Erst nach so einem Flug kann man die Größe des Grand Canyon wirklich ermessen.
Absolute Empfehlung!
You fly for approx 10 miles over forest and then suddenly, wow - you fly over the rim above the Canyon. Worth every penny for that moment alone....... Do it people!

I highly recommend taking the helicopter over the grand Canyon. It is worth every dollar. It is all over in 4 hours but we did it in the morning at 8am and we had the entire day to enjoy. The views were amazing. We enjoyed snacks and champagne on the edge of the canyon and that is an experience to treasure. The pilot Leith was very informative and educated on history. I even purchased the dvd as a keepsake.

review_title: The best way to see the Grand Canyon !
review_text:
My wife and I recently took a flight across the Grand Canyon with Mavericks Helicopter Tours. Upon arrival we were welcomed and weighed and given a flight time. My wife was particularly nervous never having flown in a helicopter before, but the staff were excellent and everything was explained clearly to put her mind at rest. Our pilot, Mike, was simply awesome. Totally professional (as you'd expect), he explained about the helicopter and gave a fantastic commentary as we flew across the canyon.
