He obviously loves his job (who wouldn't ?!) and it showed from the minute we were introduced, to spending several minutes after the flight taking photos in front of his Eurocopter.

It was over all too soon, but we had a fantastic time and got some excellent video footage from within the aircraft.

I wouldn't hesitate to use Mavericks Helicopter Tours again, should we ever return to the Grand Canyon.

Our travel agent in the UK recommended this company as I was struggling online to find the best. We were picked up on time from our hotel and taken to the airport. After the standard safety talks, we were met by our pilot. He was called Sean. What a super bloke! Put me at ease straight away as I was a bit nervous. He gave us so much information on all the places we flew over, We landed in the Canyon and had 2 glasses of champagne and a little snack. We the flew back over The Strip at night. A wonderful sight.

Hicimos esta excursion en la mañana (ellos nos recomendaron este horario proque se ve mejor el cañon).
La verdad que teniamos un poco de miedo cuando contratamos la excursion, pero finalmente no nos dio absolutamente nada de miedo ni vertigo.
Los helicopteros son super modernos (tienen costo de entre 2 y 3 millones de dolares), tienen una capacidad de 8 personas y cuando haces el check in en el aeropuerto (hay uo para Maverick y otro para Papillion) te pesan y la computadora automaticamente te asigna el mejor lugar dentro del helicoptero de acuerdo a tu peso. Antes de sentarte te dan las instrucciones de seguridad que son minimas. Al sentarte te colocan auriculares y todos los pasajeros, incluido el piloto, quedan comunicados entre si y se pueden hacer comentarios. El piloto que nos toco, Brent, super macanudo nos relato paso a paso todos los detalles del cañon.
Lo unico es que es todo en ingles; el piloto solo habla este idioma. Pero si no hablas ingles, igualmente el paseo vale la pena!!! Se los super recomiendo!
El paseo tiene una duracion de unos 50 minutos.

La meilleure façon de découvrir le Grand Canyon est de faire un tour en hélicoptère. C'est exceptionnel !!!
Nous avons choisis la formule dans laquelle "Pink  jeep" nous amène jusqu au Grand canyon puis le tour en hélicoptère avec Maverick puis stop à 2 points de vue magnifique, déjeuner (simple mais le panorama est à couper le souffle) et retour a Las Vegas. 
Maverick est une compagnie sérieuse et très bien organisée. Nous avons très peu attendu et nous avons été très bien accueilli. 
Le skywalk be vaut pas le coup par contre car le situation de la passerelle n'est pas intéressante et n'offre pas un panorama terrible car on n'y voit pas le Colorado. 
Il fait bien étudier les formules car certaines sont chères et comprennent des choses inutiles. Mon conseil aller a l'essentiel en prenant juste le tour en hélicoptère.

review_title: Almost no views from rear 4 seats - no seating option
review_text:
FAIR WARNING!!!!!!!! 

Very disappointing!! Please note: THERE ARE 8 SEATS ON THE HELICOPTER, 1 FOR THE PILOT. IF YOU DON"T GET ONE OF THE REMAINING 3 FRONT SEATS, YOU WILL NOT SEE MUCH.

You have no choice in seating. The rear seats are advertised as 'stadium seating'. I am 6'3" and could not see over the people's heads in the front seats. I could see out one side, only. My wife was put in a middle rear seat, and could see even less. 

Don't waster your money, unless you are a gambler willing to take a chance on getting a seat with decent visibility.

THERE IS NO WAY THIS TRIP IS WORTH $500+ dollars to get occasional glimpses of the Grand Canyon.

review_title: Excellent experience with a great company
review_text: We did the South Rim tour, which included flying to the South Rim in a small plane, then a 25 minute helicopter ride around the Canyon. We booked quite late and could only get a 2pm slot, which I was slightly worried about but there was no need to worry, and it was lovely to see the sun setting as we flew back to the base. The whole tour went extremely smoothly with no waiting around and the pilots (both plane and heli), coach driver (Bruce - Hilarious!) and all other staff members were very knowledgable and helpful. Well worth the money!

I had a great tour over the Hoover Dam, Lake Mead, and the Grand Canyon . The pilot was very professional and also very friendly, giving us some information about the things we saw. The landing in the Canyon is spectacular and well worth the money.

This tour is undoubtably one of the most memorable experiences of my life! The pilots were very knowledgable and provided a fantastic tour of the Hoover damn and Grand Canyon. Don't let the price put you off as it is worth every penny and I would pay it again if I ever get to go back. Excellent tour of one of the natural wonders of the world. Well worth it.

Maverick tours are a very slick and professional company. There was 8 in our party and we had a great day. We couldn't fault any part of the tour and Bruce our guide was informative and made sure we all knew our schedule and drop off and pick up points along the journey. Although he probably had done this in the morning he was enthusiastic as if we were his first party of the day. He also allowed us to take some wonderful photos of the wild life by driving very very slow. The pilots were very, very lovely and allowed the passengers to go to the cockpit to take photos as we were flying over the amazing landscape. They were very patient with our 13 yr old who was more interested in flying than the views and although he took more time chatting they happily accommodated him. Great day had by all and well worth the price. 

Thank you everyone, specially the pilots and Bruce

Quando alguem visita Las Vegas, a viagem FICA incompleta se nao for ao canyon. A melhor maneira ( para mim a unica) e de helicoptero. De todos os tours, apresentacoes e comentarios, a Mavericks foi o melhor. Supera as espectativas. Eficiencia, qualidade das maquinas, local especificos para aterrar no meio do parque, diversidade de tour.
Piloto excelente e com qualidade superior no contacto com pessoas que normalmente tem terror em voar. E beber um flute de espumante no meio do Canyon..... Sublime
Sem hesitar que voltaria.
Escolha dia sem vento e ao nascer dia ou ao final?

I was a bit hesitant to do this, because I have never been in a helicopter. But I am SO glad I did! These $3 million plus machines are amazing and feel so safe. Our pilot was very professional and gave us facts about everything we flew over. What a way to see the strip, Grand Canyon and everything in between.  It was very very windy but the flying was always steady. Not a cheap thrill but we and our 2 children will never forget it!

Fizemos este passeio de helicóptero pelo Grand Canyon que foi sensacional. Visual surpreendente e um friozinho na barriga quando passamos dentro do canyon. Fizemos o circuito mais curto, 30 minutos aproximadamente, devido ao vento um pouco forte. Mas o piloto passou muita segurança. Faria novamente, com certeza.

We took the Spirit helicopter tour over the Grand Canyon - it was excellent and I do not regret spending a grand for the 4 of us for this. We were two adults and two kids. The kids sat on the front along with another grown up. My husband was in the middle on the second row. I was concerned that he might not have a great view, but was OK, but he was not taking any pictures. I was on the side behind the pilot and saw a lot, but on the way back could not take any pictures because there were too many reflections in the window and there way no way to avoid them. I ended giving the camera to the kids on the front row to take pictures. The pilot was good. He was narrating well and had a sense of humor. We saw bison and turkeys too. They record a video of your flight and it includes any conversation you have. Despite the second row seats not being as good as the front, I would recommend this tour.
Our helicopter tour with maverick was impeccable there was a good tour before before with Bruce (very good) and the helicopter ride after was thank you :)

review_title: This is a two-for-one experience if you haven't ridden a helicopter and you havent been to the Grand Danyon
review_text:
We bought this tour through Viator for around $300 plus $49 fuel surcharge.  They picked us up from our hotel 1.5hrs before our scheduled flight since they also picked up other passengers from other hotels. We were weighed and were told the pilot will be the one to make the seating arrangements on board the helicopter. The ride was enjoyable and the picnic was passable (they served champagne in plastic dups and commercially-bought muffins. My family of four liked it except for the fact that our trip was supposed to include a pass over the LA strip and our pilot didn't do this. I felt short-changed because of this.. 
P.S. it was very difficult to converse on board as we had to wear headsets and talk through a mic that didn't seem to work properly..

review_title: The only way to see the canyon
review_text: Yesit is costly but if you have spent money to come to Vegas then you might as well do it properly. You will never see the canyon like this any other way. Pick up was efficient, staff informative and polite and the ride itself is something you will never forget. we chose to include the skywalk rather than a champagne picnic and that was definitely the right decision. we initially  were going to do the coach tour  but Ithink when we got home we would have thought that we had missed out on a unique experience. Very good company do not miss out

This was awesome!  Had a blast!  Everyone was so helpful and full of information.  Well worth the money!   I highly recommend this company for your helicopter ride!  The pilot was great.  Loved the DVD for our memories!

Very courteous staff.  Quick and efficient Shuttle supplied from and to hotel.  Clear, concise safety instructions with experienced staff.  45 minute ride to spectacular Grand Canyon, passing over Hoover Dam and other sights.  Very good overall.

The service was amazing. Pilots were super friendly and very talkative. Mr. Eric and Mr. Cameron thank you very much! The bus shuttle arrived on time and dropped us off on time as well. The views were breathtaking. The little snack provided was appropriate for the situation and quite yummy. I think the overall price was a tad steep but I felt safe and taken care of. I would definitely use their services again if the opportunity arises.

Booked 3 people for the spirit tour ; $822.  50 min trip over the Grand Canyon

The views are amazing but beware there is restricted view from the rear middle seats and restricted legroom if you have long legs ( I am 6'2")
I was allocated a seat with restricted legroom and had to argue with the ground crew in order to swap for the other middle rear seat with more space
Despite paying for 3 out of 7 seats we weren't offered one of the 3 front seats
There is allocated seating ; so if you want the best view you will need to insist at the time of booking
The pilot ( Billy) though was excellent with his commentary

They cancelled our trip due to wind.  I would normally be OK with this except that the other local company (Papillon) was running their trips without pause.  If you're looking to actually fly, you're probably better off going with Papillon.

I had the most amazing experience during this trip with Maverick Helicopter tours. Bring your cameras and prepare to be amazed. I highly recommend this tour for anyone looking to add the cherry on top of your Nevada experience. The pilots make it even more memorable and fun. The only caution is, make sure you verify the exact time of pick up from your hotel room or you'll be looking at $50 in taxi fare.

We went for the aeroplane tour, where you fly without stopping off over the Grand Canyon, passing the Hoover Dam and the rim of the Canyon - overall an amazing experience. Maverick picked us up from the hotel where we arrived at their airport location - really professional and well organised business. Our pilot Adam was very friendly and posed for pictures. Great experience less expensive than the helicopter trips but never the less a great way to see the Canyon.
Spectacular. Take the longest flight you can afford. The pilot was professional and interesting. Bring your camera and an extra memory card. Or, buy a DVD of your actual flight. Highly recommended.

review_title: Fantastic views of the Grand Canyon & helpful commentary
review_text: Booked this as a birthday present for my husband.  Not disappointed.  50 minute flight over the Grand Canyon with fantastic views and good commentary.  6 of us on the flight.  Good weather helped.  Just down the road from Tusayan hotel and easy parking. Group photo taken before flight and individual photos taken after flight.  Chance to get a DVD of the flight if required.  Once in a lifetime experience.

Simply They are both the same. Great quality. Great Pilot Thanks JIm. The bit that got me was as we were taking off from Henderson airport over the PA System was the music for "Top Gun"Hence I believe Maverick Helicopters. Go you Good thing a wonderful experience Yes expensive But how many chances does one get to do this? Whilst in Vegas DO IT!! You will regret it thinking as the years pass by golly should've done it. Yeap DO IT>!!!!!!!!
Un esperienza fantastica ......partenza las vegas durata volo circa 20 minuti elicottero bellissimo ritorno con sosta nel deserto a fare rifornimento.....500 dollari davvero ben spesi....

First time in vegas and we were told it was a must do. Very pleased with the trip only thing was we thought we were coming back through the canyon again on way back to base but we didnt and it was disappointing as one of us hadnt a great view on the way to canyon. Otherwise great experience

Its not too much of a price difference to take the longer tour. The Helicopters are in very good condition with big windows. You cannot see the from the rim of the Canyon what you can see from the Helicopter. If you get a choice of one tour at the Canyon do this one it is amazing.

review_title: Best way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: Don't drive 4 hours from Las Vegas to see the Grand Canyon,  go with Maverick and you can see it all and be back to your Vegas hotel in a few hours.  Great staff,  incredible experience.

For our annual holiday my boyfriend and I went to Las Vegas with the intention of visiting the Grand Canyon.  We had looked at various options and we eventually decided on visiting by doing something we've never done, that is to visit by helicopter.

We had booked the tour through our hotel and had decided on the Grand Canyon West Tour - Tribal Spirit.  If you go on to their website and look for this tour you'll be able to get a more detailed breakdown of what the tour entails.

The plane ride to the Canyon was amazing and equally amazing was the helicopter ride into the Canyon itself.  It really is difficult to get a perspective of how massive the Canyon is but going in by helicopter makes you see just why it's so impressive.  We got to spend about 20 minutes in the Canyon which really is just enough time to take a few pictures.  It's worth noting that when we transferred from the plane to the helicopter we had to wait around 20 minutes for the helicopter to arrive from Las Vegas as it had left after the plane.

After the helicopter into the Canyon you can take the shuttle bus to three different areas; Guano Point, Eagle Point (where the Skywalk is) and Hualapai Indian Village.  The tour gives you only 1.5 hours to do all three of the sites.  The shuttle is a bit hit and miss.  When we went it was very busy owing to the government shut down making it a 30 minute wait for the shuttle bus so we went straight to Guano Point for some amazing views.  The tour was included a lunch voucher for the cafe that is at Guano Point but you really don't have time for it and we didn't use it.  We spent 15 minutes there before having to get on the shuttle back to the plane.  There was another couple with us who had bought the Skywalk tour with the package to save time but they were unable to use it either.  

Even with it not being busy I would say that 1.5 hours is not enough time to enjoy both Guano Point and Eagle Point with the Skywalk when you factor in the travel times.  You've paid a lot of money of money for the tour to enjoy the view and take it all in but found most of my time seeing it behind the lens of my camera just to make sure I had something to remember it by.  With the time available you have to decide on doing Guano Point or the Skywalk at Eagle Point and not both.  If you've done the helicopter ride into the Canyon itself then I wouldn't bother with the Skywalk and just go straight to Guano Point, unless you really like the idea of seeing the Canyon right under your feet.  If you are intending to do the Skywalk then purchase your ticket through Maverick Helicopters as it will save time queuing when you're there.

I did mention to the pilot on our return that there was not enough time to get lunch at Guano Point, but there was no offer of refunding or telling us to ask when we got back to the airfield for a refund.  It's a use it or loose it.  Not good enough.  I would advise taking a sandwich or something as it's a long time without food and the pick up from the hotel is 06:30am.  

All in all I felt that the company should be more realistic about the time you will actually have to enjoy the views.  The tours look like you get to do lots of things but you don't.  Prioritise what you want to do.

I'm glad we did it though!

Several friends from England recommended that we take this helicopter tour if we were going to visit the Grand Canyon, and we are sure glad we did.  It is fairly pricey, but we can't imagine there's any other way to get an overview of the vastness and beauty of the Grand Canyon.  We did a 3pm tour, so the sun was not directly overhead but the shadows were not so long as to hide parts of the canyon.  Make sure you do the 50 minute/1 hour tour and not a shorter one -- it's hardly enough time to take it all in.

review_title: Outstanding experience with Maverick, and one piece of information to know
review_text:
Apologies for the lateness of this review, but I was reviewing photos for a family Christmas letter and realized I had not posted a comment following our May 2013 helicopter tour of the Grand Canyon. Our helicopter tour was the absolute highlight of our Grand Canyon vacation this past summer. Read and believe all the 5-star ratings. We enjoyed it so much, that we did it twice in this vacation. The Maverick people, facility and helicopters are all top notch.

The one bit of information I wanted to share that I haven't seen posted elsewhere concerns seating arrangements in the helicopters. We flew in the EcoStar helicopters which have two rows of four-abreast seating. Prior to your flight, you will be weighed and this will feed into a weight-and-balance calculation that defines where you will be seated in the helicopter. (All aircraft deal with weight-and-balance, particularly small planes and helicopters.) The point is, you do not choose your seats. You could be seated behind a larger person and have a somewhat less expansive view. Obviously the front seat passengers have the best view. I rode in the front seat and loved it. I also rode in a rear side seat and loved it. I didn't experience a rear center seat. So my comments are just to alert you to the seating possibilities and implications.

While we flew with Maverick (and would again in a heartbeat), I expect the same weight-and-balance considerations and seating decisions would apply to all the tour providers.

I hope you choose to do a helicopter tour of the Canyon, and that your experience is as fun as ours.

review_title: incredible manner to enjoy the canyon!
review_text:
The tour was amazing and it left us breathless!

It is a great way to get the idea of how huge the Canyon is! 

The pilot was extremely nice and helpful and everything was explained to us! 

It is def. worth the money!

Nous avons effectué le tour de 3/4 d'heure et ce fut un des moments les + extraordinaires de notre vie !
Génial pour découvrir le grand canyon

review_title: Incredible views and shows you the true scale!
review_text: A must do for viewing the Grand Canyon. From the helicopter you get such better views of the Grand Canyon and Colorado river! You do not get the feel for the true scale of the Canyon from the ground. Mavericks seemed the best value for a 50 minute tour from Tuscan which is 5 minutes outside the National Park entrance. The helicopter can take 7 passengers, we had 6 and seats are assigned by weight ratios, we were lucky and got 2 seats at the front - however I think all seats have a great view with this helicopter. The pilot was very informative during the tour in the headphones! Recommend to anyone going to Grand Canyon, or look at there tours from Vegas!

Had a fabulous tour.  The scenery was breathtaking.  The jet helicopters were smooth.  Our pilot, Laith was very professional and "Looked real good"...an added bonus.  We all thoroughly enjoyed the trip and the Grand Canyon was impressive.  Was worth the money.   Would do it again next trip to Vegas.

This was awesome!!  We scheduled the 50 minute tour.  The views from the air are breathtaking.  I had never flown in anything before (plane, helicopter...).  Our pilot Adam was wonderful.  He made sure we all had a great time.  He pointed out all the points of interest, answered any questions we had, and encouraged us to all talk to each other and have a good time.    Very inspirational.  In my opinion everyone needs to add this to their Grand Canyon Trip!!!  Loved every minute of it!!!

review_title: The best way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: We booked a 45-min tour departing from the Southern Rim (Helpful hint: there is a AAA discount).  I wasn't too thrilled about going in a helicopter (motion sickness?, safety?, price?)—but by the end I was a total convert.  Our pilot had a background playlist for our ride (perfectly timed, too) piping into our headphones.  It definitely enhanced my viewing experience.  He answered our questions and told us some interesting tidbits but I didn't think of our pilot as a tour guide... I wouldn't want someone talking the entire time (or even a lot) while I am taking in the breathtaking views.  We also hiked a rim trail, an inner rim trail, and visited several view points (on our own) but you really can't see the Canyon as well as this!

review_title: Wonderful way to see more of the Grand Canyon
review_text: Booking process was easy.  We felt very safe with the pilot.  Although the route of the flight must be strictly followed by all tour operators, it is a great way to see more of the Grand Canyon that you can from the rim views.  It's pricey, but worth it for a one time excursion.

Our flight was supposed to include Hoover Dam, Lake mead, and the sky walk n flight to private bluff in the canyon. Our pilot was busy adjusting his instrument and talking to other pilots because of heavy traffic I guess. No narrations. Hardly see Hoover Dam. The Grand Canyon was nice. We had flights in Kawaii and Maui in Hawaii before and this is nothing like those. We both fell asleep on the way back because it was so boring. If you never seen the desert then maybe it would be worth it to you. Again, this is about the flight and not about the Grand Canyon, we see other helicopters flying low between the canyon to get a better view, and this was how our flights were in Maui and Kawaii. I felt bad for the other couple because their trip did not include landing at the bluff which was way better. Not sure why our pilot did not fly low like other company. He certainly can do it because he took us down to the bluffs and certainly flew between the walls. We were told that our company was the only one that can land in the canyon. Other helicopters that we saw had Grand Canyon on their helicopters. The way they fly looks more fun. In my humble opinion, if you can see the canyon by flying low then you don't need to and and at extra money unless you want some pictures. This is the first time we took a ride in a helicopter tour without narration from a pilot whom I also consider a tour guide.  I guess we should be greatful for getting back in one piece. It kinds of sting paying over $569/ person and learn very little about our tour. Sorry, I am just comparing to my past flight experiences. Staffs were nice. Pilot was nice but not as informative as we would like. He was concentrating on his instrument and traffics because it was a new helicopter. Nice and funny guy. We did tip him even though we didn't enjoy as much. He was doing his job making sure that we are safe.

My husband & I chose this tour following reviews on TA and booked via BA before we left the UK. Booking before we left saved us quite a bit & we were contacted by the tour operator to arrange the flight time & hotel pick up details.

We were picked up on time at our hotel & checked in for the flight quickly. As everyone was ready we actually left for the Canyon early.

I was a bit nervous about the flight, but after being in the air for a few minutes I was fine.

The scale of the canyon is amazing & you just can't describe it. Our pilot gave us a narrative of what we were flying over, giving us chance to get shots of the Hoover dam & Canyon Skywalk.

We landed near the bottom of the Canyon & had some fizz & snacks, what a beautiful picnic backdrop!

We then took flight again, stopping for re-fuelling before heading back.  The pilot ensured we swapped seats at both stops so we all got a go upfront: although you didn't gave to. Although the helicopter is weight balanced so swapping over isn't always an option, luckily the 6 passengers were all about the same size/weight for us.

It was a fantastic few hours and I would highly recommend! But if you're in the UK look at booking before you leave and save some cash.

If you do nothing else do a tour of the GC with Maverick. These guys are profesional and trustworthg. Booked a tour for my 50th birthday on 10th Oct unfortunatly it decided to snow and be very foggy and the shutdown did not help. So the only way we were going to see the GC was by this tour. On the day the weather was bad so the office rearranged for the 12th at a time to suit us. It worked out perfect as the park reopened that day too and it was our last day in the area. Check in was smooth and hastle free, pilot called us up, feeling a bit nervous now, you get assigned your seat so they can distribute the weight. We were lucky as we got to sit at front next to our lovely pilot Mike.He was great made us feel comfortable and confident in his abilities as a pilot. I can not discribe the take off but to say What a thrill. I am not one for rollercoasters & this is nothing like that. This was great, great views of the Canyon and a great pilot. No pressure to buy photos and will allow you to take your own. Can use cameras and video eqpt on flight. Well worth the money.. you must do it. And do it with confidence with this company. No worries no stress. Dont forget to confirm 48hrs prior.

Wir hatten bei Maverick die Canyon Spirit Tour gebucht. Es hat alles reibungslos geklappt. Der Flug selber war atemberaubend. Die Erklärungen durch unseren sehr netten Piloten und die Musik machten den Flug zu einem unvergesslichen Erlebnis.

review_title: It was not real Grand Canyon
review_text: We original booked Grand Canyon national Park air /Helicopter tour from Vegas, due to the government shut down, so we were luck to re booked with Mavericks tour. They pick up us at the hotel on time, the pilot was very nice and the flight was bumpy and I through out several times. The grand Canyon - Indian reservations (south Rim) is not as grand as the National Park, we landed not they can call the bottom of the canyon, had little picnic, and stop one more time refilling . and get back total time was about two and half hours. The nice point was the terminal right at Las Vegas airport instead outside of Vegas. It is an average tour and I guess this what you choose to go for. The organize very well and everything went smoothly.

review_title: Knowledgeable and friendly staff, and great views - highly recommend!
review_text:
With hotel pickup, and departure from McCarran Airport helicopter area, it's a convenient location for anyone staying on the strip. The journey takes you over the Hoover Dam, Lake Mead, and the glass bottom viewing area in the west of the Grand  Canyon (45 mins). The helicopter then lands on a cliff top for champagne and snacks, before a further 15min flight to refuel, then a 30min flight back to Vegas via downtown and the strip.

As of Oct 2013, the price was $504 (DVD with visual and audio of the flight can be purchased for an additional fee).

review_title: Add the Maverick Helicopter Grand Canyon Tour to you Bucket List
review_text: We live in Arizona so we’ve been to the Grand Canyon before.  After taking several helicopter tours in Hawaii, it made us realize that the best way to see the Grand Canyon would be by helicopter. So, several years ago I added that to my Bucket List. We finally got around to making it happen. I did the research online and reviewed all the Tripadvisor reviews for helicopter tours out of the Grand Canyon Airport. We choose to go with the Maverick ECO Star Helicopter. We were not disappointed!  The entire experience was great. The location at the airport is easy to find. The check-in was fast and efficient. The customer service was good. The pilot was friendly and knowledgeable. The ECO Star helicopter was absolutely awesome !  It was comfortable, quiet, and provided excellent visibility. It was much better than the helicopters we flew on in Hawaii. If you haven’t seen the Grand Canyon from a helicopter you haven’t seen the Grand Canyon. Take the 50 minute tour in a Maverick ECO Star helicopter for a lifelong memory.

Taking a flight over the Grand Canyon was incredible!!!! 
It was a hassle free, enjoyable and safe experience from start to finish! 
Our pilot, Travis, was really professional and funny and was happy to answer all of our questions.
If you are in two minds, don't be...you won't regret it!

review_title: Picnic in the depths of the Grand Canyon
review_text: Wonderful experience! Our pilot was very nice and funny. the picnic fare, however, left much to be desired: danish breads, juice, water and champagne. It was quite a sight watching the helicopters land and take off in staggered succession; there must have been four or five of them at the picnic site. Just a few tips...1) don't even bother to lie when they ask you for your weight at the time of booking; they will find out anyway when you check in for the flight. 2) try to charm your pilot into allowing you to sit in front during the first leg of the flight; that way, you get more minutes of spectacular views of the Hoover Dam, Fortification Hill,Lake Mead,.and the Colorado River; 3) if you;re a non-drinker like me, go easy on the champagne or you'll doze off on the return trip, like I did..
the staff is pleasant and professional.  the waiting area is very accommodating.  the ride was the best high without drugs.  what else can be said.

Ok, let me say right off the bat I simply do not understand people who are afraid or hesitant to fly in a copter.  After all, the Army used to pay me to jump out of them.  Even riding in an open door with my feet on the skids never brought fear out in me.  So the chance to fly in a $3 million Eco-Star over the most beautiful (and elusive for us) national treasure was a no-brainer.  The closing of the federal government – and all the National parks – meant that the only way we were going to see this wonder is from the air.  Thank heavens the tea-bagger congressmen had not restricted air space.

Arriving at the heliport, Hubby and I encountered very nice staff who took our weight in a most confidential fashion.  Point:  One must load a helicopter evenly or the thing either won’t get off the ground, or will be very hard to fly straight.  Our pilot introduced himself, posed for photos and loaded us up after a safety briefing.  As I had lost a great deal of weight this year, I was pleased to find myself with the window seat.  Take off as smooth and easy as can be – and off we set.  And my!  What a view.  I had to MAKE myself put the Nikon down to just gaze out the windows.  We all had headsets and listened as our pilot pointed out landmarks.  Less than an hour later, it was time to return to earth and our Detours guide, Chad.

Very unusual for me, I readily bought the photo with the pilot and also sprang for the video of our flight.  Both very reasonably priced and quite good.  Be prepared to pay a fuel surcharge of $15 per person. I do wonder though, if the fuel is getting more expensive or tourists are getting heavier?

Great experience – well worth the money!

review_title: Canyon Spirt Grand Canyon Helicopter Tour, departing from the South Rim
review_text:
We are not 'happy fliers' but we drew on every ounce of bravery we had and took this trip...the only way to see the full majesty of the Grand Canyon. We took the 45 minute trip from the South Rim (no landing as that is a different section of the Canyon) and we were taken along the set flight path as permitted by the aviation authorities.  It was completely amazing and would recommend to everyone, to go all that way and not see it from the air and fly through its vast trenches is like going to The Magic Kingdom and not going on Space Mountain! 
I had been looking forward to the trip for months and it did not disappoint, I was so excited I didn't realise we had taken off! 
If you get travel sickness, take a travel tablet before hand just to make sure your stomach does not spoil your trip.

With the government shutdown in progress my husband and I decided to spend the money for a grand tour.  Our pilot did an excellent tour filled with information and humor.   The site hovering over the canyon was breathtaking - about an hour.  Plenty of explanation and picture/videos were excellent.   Several times we were in direct alignment with another copter - very exciting.   I've seen the view on two previous driving adventures but none compares with a  view from the top.

review_title: Helicopter ride over the Canyon was AWESOME!
review_text:
We booked the helicopter ride with Maverick because it got the best reviews here, and we were not disappointed. After being warned I might get motion sick, I was a little apprehensive. Our pilot, Matt, was so smooth and gave us the best ride! The moment when you leave the forest area and first go out over the canyon just can't be described - it really just takes your breath away. 

He spent time hovering in several spots, and explained what all the different peaks were called and where the names originated. He also rotated the helicopter so that every person got a clear view of everything. He was so nice, as were all the other people we interacted with at Maverick. The helicopter was brand new, and very comfortable. 

I would definitely recommend this activity - even for those who are afraid of heights or might be afraid of motion sickness - it was the best!!!

If you get the chance to go on a maverick helicopter trip over the gran canyon then it is a must do.
The staff are very helpful on arrival and the pilots are brilliant. Nothing is too much trouble and they are happy to take your picture by the helicopter although they do take an official one too. Anyone who has been to the states knows they love taking the photos so you buy them, and to be honest at $20 they are not bad value.
The trip over the canyon is amazing and no wonder it is one of the 7 wonders of the world. Our pilot never rushed and encouraged us to take photos and videos of the experience informing us on all the details of the rock formation and how high we were, and why the rocks were different colours.
This without a doubt is a trip not to be missed. You can't go to the canyon without experiencing in my view the best way to see this amazing place. Well worth the money.

review_title: Fantastic - Grand Canyon wind dancer tour
review_text: Vegas from the air, Lake Mead, The Hoover Dam, and of course the Grand Canyon and absolutely superb tour albeit a very expensive one. Very professional and informative pilot/ guide. A highlight was the low altitude race to the edge of the Canyon and the sudden fall into the precipice. Landing at the bottom and taking the scenery was also amazing. A first class experience.

review_title: Good, but very dependent on where you get seated
review_text:
I did the 'dream catcher sunset tour' and overall it was an amazing experience visiting the Grand Canyon. Booking process, hotel pickup, check-in etc were all very professional. The flight itself was very cool, however very dependent on where you were seated. I was allocated a window seat in the back, so views were pretty good, although couldn't see much out the front. 
When I booked, I was told that the seating would be rotated (between the front and the back) for the flight back (after we landed in the GC). When I asked the pilot about rotating (Travis) he said that this wasn't possible due to different weights of the passengers. There was a spare seat up the front (next to the pilot) that wasn't used during the whole flight which I thought was a bit of a waste. The English lass seated next to me (back middle) was pretty pssed off as you can't see much from that seat. Due to my position I didn't see much of The Strip when we flew past it on the way home.
Good experience overall but marked down for not rotating seats (to give all passengers a decent view) especially when they said they would. A lot of money to pay considering you don't know whether or not you'll get a decent seat and views.

Booked this trip as a once in a lifetime experience and well worth every penny(cent). Pilot well knowledgeable about the area and flew over Hoover Dam & road bridge before heading off to the west rim of the Grand Canyon.  Scenery spectular from the air, as you do not naturally get the true scale from walking the west rim/north rim.  The width and majesty of the area cannot be fully described, only to say... wow!!  We had a refuelling stop and changed our seats for the return journey to Las Vegas late afternoon, so you got a chance to see another view of the canyons before flying over the Strip.  Pick-up and return included in the price and a flight to remember.  Thank you Maverick Helicopters.

A great day out to the grand canyon it all started with our pilot jarod . A really nice guy who went out of his way to make our trip interesting and funny, (even though his flying is better than his comedy ) everyone was encouraged to join in and all questions answered even though he must have answered them all hundreds of times he still managed to keep it fresh and interesting. Also special thanks for taking the time to do some comedy photos with my wifes work mascot they have been the source of amusement at her work place .also enjoyed the explanation of how you fly  a helicopter thanks all at maverick

En septembre dernier, nous avons effectué le " Skywalk Odyssey" de Maverick Helicopter Tours.
Tout est parfaitement organisé, aussi bien concernant les transferts à partir de l 'hôtel que la visite sur place ou l'on est pris totalement en charge, avec de surcroit, un petit déjeuner impromptu !
Si,le Skywalk offre une vision magnifique du Grand Canyon, le vol en hélicoptère est un vrai régal, grâce à  un pilote prévenant et intéressant, et surtout du fait des paysages somptueux que l'on survole pendant près des 90 minutes que durent l'aller et le retour.
Un seul mot : parfait !

We did the Spirit Tour of the Grand Canyon.  FANTASTIC.  It was a first time for my wife and she loved it.  She was sittting on the front seat next to the pilot.  
During the flight, the pilot gave plenty of explanations (in english).  The tour took 50 minutes that will last in our memory for the rest of our life.  Do not hesitate to spent the money for this.

No bags allowed in the helicopter
Your need ID pieces with photographs
No need for coat... the helicopters are air conditionned.
They will weight you at the counter in order to equiibrate the chopter !!

Bring your camera and some money to buy nice souvenirs.

Accueil très sympathique, ponctualité du RDV, nous étions placés à côté du pilote qui lui était très sympa et commentait beaucoup (dommage que notre anglais soit peu développé...!) Comptez 200€ par personne pour 50 minutes inoubliables!

During our recent US holiday we decided, with some trepidation, to take a helicopter flight of the Grand Canyon. We did all the research and decided to book with Maverick and do the wind dancer tour. We had never been in a helicopter before so we had some reservations but were quickly put at ease by our pilot Matt before we left the ground. Matt was very professional explaining all the pre flight briefings and made us feel at ease. The flight was fantastic with all our questions answered by Matt and really the highlight of our holiday, it was something we will never forget, I know it's expensive but it's worth every cent. Thankyou Maverick and our pilot Matt for a magical few hours.

review_title: Maverick Helicopters the way to go
review_text:
Our original booking with Sun Dance was semi cancelled due to bad weather or something. Re booked with Maverick and had an awesome time. Right on time with the pick up from our hotel in clean and modern coach. Arrival at the air strip was warm and welcoming. What a great experience so far and we haven't left the ground yet. Our pilot was very informative and most of the time somewhat comical which added to the vibe. Perfectly smooth flight, great morning tea with with a cup of bubbly by the Colorado river about 1.6 klms down into the canyon.
These guys are so professional and know their business so well. I recommend MAVERICK HELICOPTER tours very highly.

Yes, it's going to be the most expensive hour you probably spend on your trip, but it is worth every single penny!!!  Our pilot, Dave was amazing.  He was fabulous with the kids and answered every single question that they had.  He took pictures of us with the helicopter after our flight even though they had taken a photo of us before to sell to us.  I will say that we did buy the dvd because the kids loved it and wanted to see and hear it all over again.  I really researched all of the helicopter companies in the area and am so glad that we chose Maverick!!!

review_title: Waste of money for the people that get the back seats
review_text:
The way the helicopter is set up is that there are 3 passenger seats in the front 4 and four in the back - everyone pays the same price. If you are one of the lucky ones in the front (seats determined by weight balance), then the $250+ price tag is completely worth it. Unfortunately, I was one of the ones in the back and felt COMPLETELY RIPPED OFF. I saw nothing from the front window (seats are too high), and the side window (at least I got a window seat... two people were not next to any window) was small. Plus, the pilot did not turn the helicopter 360 degrees, so I only saw the right side of things (meaning I missed half the tour). 

On top of all this, the pilot we had was not good. He spent the majority of the time talking to the girl next to him and played music very loudly, so if you had any questions or concerns, they were not heard during the duration of the flight. 

I've been on great helicopter tours before, so I know that it doesn't have to be this way. Save yourself the money.

Maverick Helicopers is amazing! I wasn't sure if I should invest in this experience. It was my first trip to the Grand Canyon. All I can say is you should definitely do this! This was the most awe-inspiring, breathtaking view of the Grand Canyon. Every minute was exhilerating! 

The staff were outstanding. Dennis was so helpful with my reservationand with answering my questions. He was so nice and welcoming, that he is the reason I came back for a second helicopter ride two days later. He even gave me advice on which trails to hike later that day. Aaron, the pilot, was outgoing, fun, and extremely knowledgable about the Grand Canyon, geology, and history. 

I felt safe and the helicopter seemed brand new! I can't say enough good things. If you're not sure abotu this, just book it. You'll thank me later!!

Didn't want to do the Grand Canyon at all but figured...if I'm gonna do it, I may as well do it right.

We did the hour long tour and it was brilliant.

I've been in helicopters before - in London, and over Iguazu Falls in Brazil, and this Grand Canyon trip completely smashed the other two. There were five or six of us in the helicopter plus the pilot, and we flew very low at first, which puzzled me. Then I realised. As the pilot asked 'are you ready', and we flew over the edge, everyone let out a gasp and a 'oh my god'! I can't explain to you the feeling that I felt. It was humbling, awesome, a mixture of terror and complete unadulterated surprise and ecstasy. I've never felt like that before in my life. Truly once-in-a-lifetime. Great feeling, amazing views.

If you're reading this thinking 'but I couldn't fly in a helicopter, it's too scary' - it's actually surprising how little you feel it move. It's smooth, and it's a great feeling, so if you're considering doing it at the GC you should definitely just go for it.

I would give this six stars if I could. Thank you Maverick for such an awesome flight.

[It seems expensive but in comparison to other flights I've done it's actually really good value for the time you get and for the sheer raw emotion you'll feel.]

We confirmed our trip several times by email asked for pick up details for hotel, not given clear instructions we called 3 times around time of pick up.  Miss transport to Maverick took a cab and arrived on time, check in staff really were not very helpful.  Pilot of helicopter was good talking on trip.  Trip and safety briefing and procedures very good.  When staying at the Venetian hotel some pick ups are at the Palazzo Ground transportation not the lobby by the time we inquired further at reception it was too late.

review_title: Paid but never seen a helicopter
review_text:
We booked a one day trip to Grand Canyon at the Luxor hotel in Las Vegas, paid Maverick £207 (314 USD). Considering that the Canyon is 4 hours drive away, we had to rent a car which costed us another £64 (103 USD). Our booking slot was at 2pm so we decided to leave early to avoid being late. 
Arizona here we come... Having been already one hour on the road, my wife received a call from Maverick informing us about our trip being cancelled due to a weather conditions. Nice. What a waste of money.. 
9 days after, we still haven't received our money refunded!! My wife manage to get trough someone on the other side of the ocean, having tried to call several times. Surprise surprise someone picked up our call today. A gentlemen explained that the system went off during the refund attempt. Interesting! 
Simply, if we didn't call we would never get them to UNDERSTAND they still have to refund the 314 USD. 
Very disappointing!!

I cannot speak highly enough of this company and their services to their patrons.
very professional,entire staff from pick up at the hotel,arriving at helipad,flight and return to hotel by their professional staff made our day complete.
Again well done maverick stasnd up and take a bow,and the video of the flight was excellent

What a perfect way to see the Grand Canyon! The 55 minute heli ride is well worth the money; and definitely a once in a lifetime opportunity and must do. I was impressed with the entire staff from booking, to staff on the ground, to the pilot. The heli was clean and relatively new. Our first flight was cancelled and we were rescheduled for another time due to weather, but what impressed me from the very beginning was mavericks perfect safety record in their 15 years! If postponing my flight keeps me safe, I'm all for it and they made it clear that their guests safety was a priority. Our pilot was extremely knowledgeable and had a great combination of answering all the questions asked of him and providing some information that had not been asked. I would highly recommend maverick to anyone going to Grand Canyon

Nachdem wir im Internet die verschiedenen Anbieter angeschaut hatten, entschieden wir uns für Mavericks Helicopter Tours (Canyon Spirit Helicopter Tour) und waren mit dieser Entscheidung sehr glücklich. Die Organisation war perfekt von der Buchung an. 
Der Himmel sah am 19.7.2013 recht gut aus und wir hatten 9:00 schönes Fotolicht und sehr viel Spaß mit unserem Piloten Mike! :-)
Es war für uns alle der erste Flug in einem Helicopter und dank des ruhigen Wetters wurde es zu einer grandiosen Erfahrung.

review_title: Maverick Grand canyon Late Arvo Tour
review_text: What a great tour - about 7 helicopters took off around 4.30pm and headed out to the Grand Canyon via Hoover Dam.  Pilot was excellent and the soundtrack of music he had was great!  Of course the obligatory Wagner's (best remembered from Apocalypse Now) was played as we headed into the landing area of the Canyon for champagne and cheese and bickies!  Refuelled in the middle of nowhere and then headed back to the airport adjacent over the strip at early evening - really good views!  Highly recommend them - only had 5 plus pilot in the chopper so it was a really good mix and not cramped or overwhelmed by too many!  Highly recommend Maverick - very slick operation!

What an experience! Pilot was great, experienced flyer and knew all about the GC. Price was not that expensive and the difference between 20 minute and 40 minute flight wasn't great. DVD taken during flight was a great touch.

Took our trip with Maverick Helicopters and had an amazing time. The pilot (Aaron) came and sat with us before the flight and handled a mixed group of Germans, Italians and us Brits well. He asked what aspects of the canyon we were interested to hear about - history, archaeology etc and was happy to answer questions. The view is draw-dropping, particularly as you go over the edge. It certainly doesn't feel as if you're flying at 120 miles an hour. Yes, it's expensive but definitely worth it.

We booked a helicopter trip with Maverick the day before we went as we were staying in the Grand Canyon and had a great experience. The service was excellent and our pilot was great. He gave us a brilliant description of everything we were seeing and seemed really happy to be sharing such an amazing experience with us. We had never been in a helicopter before but felt really comfortable with this company.

This was one of the most beautiful tours we have taken in our 70+ years. I would highly recommend taking a helicopter and to go with the Maverick helicopter Co. You will not get better views anywhere of the Canyon and the picture opportunities do not stop. You will also fly over the Hoover Dam and Lake Mead. Trip is approximately 4 hrs. from your hotel and back to your hotel. the tour itself approximately 21/2 hours. It includes a landing in the canyon with a lite brunch .  The flight we took was from 8:00 AM to 12;00 pm. The helicopter held six of us, my wife and i and a family of two adults and 2 teen age daughters from Australia. We all loved the trip and were glad we decided to see canyon in this manner.,

review_title: Helicopter Ride Over The Grand Canyon
review_text: I booked last year a VIP Grand Canyon Helicopter ride, landing in the Grand Canon with Maverick.  What an experience.  My husband was 60 on the 31st March 2013 and there we were going over the Grand Canyon.  From start to finish it was just excellent.  We were picked up at our hotel and dropped off afterwards.  We got a lovely photo with the pilot and the helicopter.  We will never forget that trip.  Everyone must do the helicopter ride you will remember it for the rest of your life.  Our pilot was great, we landed in the Grand Canyon for champagne and snacks and then flew back over the strip.  I have to say that was the highlight of our week in Las Vegas.  If we weren't coming back the next day we would have wanted to have done it again.  Well done Maverick.

We did the helicopter tour over the canyon leaving from Tucson. The overall tour was ok, but I don't think it is worth the money. Pilot was great, view was ok but the tour was boring. Once you see it, it is just more of the same. DVD of the trip which you can purchase at an extra cost is differently on worth the money. I personally think you can get just as good a view of the canyons from view points at ground level. The canyon itself is still amazing and worth visiting, just choose which way you want to see it.

My husband and I flew with maverick helicopter tours from las Vegas to grand canyon in January 2013.
We were picked up by tour bus 8am from our hotel. We made a few stops at other hotels, before we arrived at maverick tours. By 10 am we were in the air on a small plane heading to the grand canyon. We arrived there in less than an hour. (south point) We all boarded a coach and before we knew it we had enter the grand canyon park, eating our packed lunch which was provided. We had an hour to look around before we boarded our helicopters ( 6 people per helicopter plus pilot). We had paid extra for the helicopter tour. It was worth every penny. The views were fabulous !!!
If you choose not to do the helicopter ride the coach went to another view point, with more 
amazing views.
Everyone looked after us. Before we knew it we were back in las Vegas at 3.30 pm heading back to our hotels. What an amazing day.
The company was organised and so helpful. We would recommend them to anyone.
It was an amazing experience. Thanks to maverick tours.

We chose Maverick Helicopters because of reviews I'd read on Trip Advisor.  We flew from Tusayan, the town outside the park so we just went to the local airport which we could have walked to while staying at the Best Western.  I thought they were extremely professional, great helicopters, very solid and in great shape, with large windows so everyone gets a great view.  The waiting room was also very nice which was great because we waited a while to get on the flight but that's not a big deal.  My brother has flown helicopters for over 30 years and told me never to fly with anyone who wasn't Navy trained.  I laugh because it's not like I could check their credentials.  But there's a certain way of flying that I've noticed when with my brother that is hard to put into words.  They have a certain way of controlling the helicopter and of being aware of everything around them.  I have to say that I felt that certain something from Maverick, even though the pilot looked like he just graduated high school (he was a bit annoyed when I asked him where he trained but I promised my brother I would always do that, not that I could change anything at that point).  We took our flight in March and it was a bit misty in the canyon, so I can't say it was a breathtaking view, it really wasn't, but it was pretty amazing anyway. It was a treat to see the north side of the Grand Canyon, too.  When I returned home to tell my brother I'd flown with Maverick, his first response was "at least you chose a good company".  (whew!).  I would go with Maverick again if I make it back to the Grand Canyon mostly because they seem to be a first class operation that maintains their helicopters and you really want that when you're flying.

review_title: Maverick helicopter tour was the highlight of our trip to Las Vegas
review_text: I'm surprised by some of the negative comments about this tour on Tripadvisor - we had a fantastic trip and it was the highlight of our holiday to Las Vegas.  The helicopter is expensive but we thought well worth it - and there are other cheaper ways of seeing the canyon if you are on a budget.  Maverick pick you up from your hotel (by mini-bus, rather than the advertised limo) and take you to their helicopter terminal at the airport.  You get to ride in a small helicopter (maximum 7 passengers plus the pilot, atlhough our trip only had 6 passengers) and get excellent views.  Our pilot swapped us around so we all got a chance to sit in the front.  On the way to the canyon we flew over Hoover Dam, Lake Mead and Boulder City - the views were spectacular and at times the helicopter takes you along the course of the Colorado river within the walls of the canyon.  You stop at a spot within the canyon and have their "champagne breakfast" - or rather, more accurately, sparkling white wine and cheese and fruit - and from the picnic spot there are amazing views.  On the way back we flew by the Valley of Fire - an amazing outcrop of fire red rocks to the NE of Las Vegas.  Our pilot did give us a commentary and a music sound track (including "Come fly with me" and the "Ride of the Valkyries"!).  I got the impression Maverick work the pilots quite hard and don't pay them a great deal - from what our pilot said - but this is a very efficient operation and an amazing way to see one of the great natural wonders of the world.

review_title: 45 min tour from Tusayan airport - Great !!!
review_text:
It was great. 
I read quite a few bad things about Maverick in tripadvisor. but as I read quite a few bad things about every single company, so I decided to book it. I chose the best chopper, that is eurocopter or something like this. After putting the headphones it was quite quiet and the windows were good. There were no seats facing the back, I intentionally booked a more expensive tour. If you book the cheaper one it might be not as good. 
The pilot was just great. It was so much fun. After I read about flying too long over a forest and not THE CANYON I was a bit suspicious, but decided to book it. I would recommend it to everyone. The forest was nice and you cannot take off right from the edge. Obviously you need some time to fly from the airport to the canyon. All the staff ware friendly, the views were great. The only thing I did not like was the price of the pics. The trip itself is not way too cheap. After that you pay a fuel surcharge. And then you tip the pilot (he did a great job). And at the end you need to spend almost 50 USD for pics - DVD and a frames pic. It is too much. If it was 20 it would have been OK. But you are allowed to take your own pics, so I was happy with that. 
i am afraid of heights, but it was not scary. I could even say that he could have done something more fun, but I guess he did not want to as we had a girl that was a bit afraid. 
Overall - book it, you will never feel sorry.

review_title: Helicopter view of Grand Canyon absolutely fantastic
review_text:
Having read some of the reviews, we were not sure whether to splash out on a helicopter tour for three of us, but we're so glad we did.  We booked a 25 minute ride with Maverick, from the little airport south of Tuseyan near the Canyon's South Rim.   We got there half an hour early.  The terminal building is bright, clean and very efficient.  We checked in and were weighed (no, they don't tell you how much you weigh - you just stand on a plate and nobody is any the wiser!).  We then waited til we were called by the pilot.  Ours was called Cory and not only was he the most handsome pilot there, he was also a really great tour guide.   

We had a thorough safety briefing and were then seated according to the plan they have, which I guess is based on the weight of each passenger to better balance the aircraft.   We donned life jackets (as we fly over the Colorado River, it's a legal requirement), our safety belts, our head phones and microphones, and then we were off.   First, we flew over the ponderosa forest toward the canyon.  My husband and I hate heights but we were absolutely fine.  My son and I were in the front and the helicopter was the type that meant we could see right down to the floor all round - great visibility.  Even in the back, the seats are higher than the front to aid visibility.   We spent about five minutes getting to the canyon and then we flew right over it.  Oh, what an amazing view!   We flew around the canyon for 15-20 minutes, over to the north rim, right over the Colorado river which looked like a stream below but which was 350 feet wide.  We could see the rapids.   Cory, the pilot, gave us great information and we were all able to ask questions - we could all hear through the headphones what everyone was saying.   He clearly has a love for the Canyon and was a really interesting guide.  He named the various peaks, talked about wildlife, pointed out the nearby 
San Francisco mountain peaks, etc.   We were very happy with the time we were over the Canyon - we'd feared we'd only fly over for 5 mnutes but we saw such alot.   We all agreed it was one of, if not THE, best experiences of our lives.  It cost quite alot but it was absolutely worth it.   If you think the view from the Rim is incredible, just fly over it - you'll be stunned.

review_title: Maverick helicopter tour of Grand Canyon
review_text: Took the Grand Canyon sunset helicopter tour with Maverick and was disappointed,  Here's why.  Even though our pilot was a nice young man, he offered no information about the Canyon or trip other than " to your left is Lake Mead"  or " We are now going over Hoover Dam"  He  was not enthusiastic and we had to pull information  out of him.  I understand it was the end of the day and he informed us he had been working since 5:30 am and was ready to go home.  Too bad as the sunset tour is the most expensive tour and  for alot of folks this was a once in a lifetime trip.  On the way back, we had to stop, get out of the helicopter for him to get more fuel.  I felt this was a waste and would have preferred seeing a little more of the Grand Canyon.  All in all, we only saw a fraction of the canyon, landed, the pilots talkied amongst themselves and we all just stood around for 30 minutes.  I would say you get what you pay for, but for 2 of us it was $1000.00 for less than 3 hrs. I would recommend a tour that has a  audio tape to listen to as you are flying- you will get more info than we did.

Josh was our handsome pilot who took us on a bucket-list experience over the island of Kauai. Words and photos can not describe the awe that we saw that day. It was a spectacular view of all the island has to offer - mountains, canyons, beaches, plantations and waterfalls!!!

Quick Lyft ride from cruise ship, checked in and started right on time . The best thing is that my wife and I were the only one . For the price this is a great value. Weather was perfect and our pilot was great. He took us all over the island and narrated the whole trip. We took a ton of incredible photos and videos. This is one of the best ways to see the island since you can’t access most it by ground.
Highly recommended

This was one of the highlights of our visit to Kauai. We booked a private plane tour. Our pilot was friendly and knowledgeable, sharing information about the different sites we visited. We traveled to all of the important and gorgeous areas of the island. The plane was comfortable, spacious and the ride was so smooth. I think this was a better choice than a helicopter because there was no middle seat and did not feel claustrophobic. So glad I went on this tour!!

We had an excellent private tour of Kaua'i with Nick as our pilot. He was very knowledgeable of the island and flew the plane safely for us. The experience was fantastic and the value of the tour was excellent. We would highly recommend this tour to anyone of our family member.

review_title: The best way to experience Kauai from the air!
review_text: We had an amazing flight over Kauai! The views from the plane were better than expected! Our pilot Justin was fantastic and provided us a smooth flight for picture taking! He was very knowledgeable about the island and the culture.  We saw many waterfalls that you can really only see by air!! Incredible!  I’m so glad we flew in a plane than in a helicopter. We spent more time over natural wonders this way which was more memorable. We highly recommend Airventures!

Great experience with Air Ventures. Justin was our pilot and he was easy going and informative and we felt safe on the flight.  It was a great weather day and we got to see everything clearly. Highly recommend a private airplane tour vs. a helicopter tour.
The views were amazing and our pilot Nick did an excellent job giving us the highlights and adding his personal touch since he grew up in Kauai.

review_title: Life long amazing experience over Kauai
review_text:
We booked the private tour with a C182, but as the plane was not available, got the much bigger Airvan for 2 of us. Justin our pilot made an amazing job, took over the most iconic and scenic sights including all the famous film shooting places. Got lucky with weather, also amazing views with rainbows! The booking went super smooth, the check in is easy and the whole team is super helpful.

The airplanes are in good condition and well maintained, our pilot did all the pre-flight checks that was needed, so we felt super safe during the whole flight. Thank you!
Such a great experience, I highly recommend doing this tour… you see places you can’t see by car! The pilot was great! Super friendly and very knowledgeable!

review_title: Great views and a lot cheaper than the Helicopter tours.
review_text: This was such a great experience. our pilot Nick was very professional and made everyone feel at ease.  They do weigh you and tell you what seat you will be sitting in as this is for safety.  The views of the island were amazing. I think one of my favorite parts was taking off on the same runway as the commercial jets and getting to listen to ATC.

My hour long tour was the "Big Kahuna Air Tour" and I was in the company of my wife.
The plane had room for 6 passengers in addition to the pilot, I was very eager to have this experience not only to see Kauai from above, but also to take photographs and video footage, which I am very passionate about.
Unfortunately, the pilot, without asking anything, placed both me and my wife in the second row, where on the side there is the bar that holds the wing of the plane.
I was on the left side, immediately behind the pilot.
During the flight, those on the right were greatly privileged. Traveling on the left you were always too close to the mountain without having an overall view, while on the right side you were always a little further away, allowing you to see much better.
I practically didn't see well the Napali Coast because we were very close to the mountain while when we went back, from the right side they could see well both the mountain and the sea below.
Not to mention the great annoyance that the bar caused when taking photos and videos..
Considerations:
A truly very interesting tour, however during the booking phase, as is done with all commercial flights, the possibility of choosing seats should be given, possibly also offering differentiated prices because whoever is in front or without any annoying impediment is certainly very advantaged.
Furthermore, if there are two of you, it seems really mean to me to put both of you in the worst places!!
In my opinion Air Ventures should care more about customer satisfaction, which, unfortunately, they don't.

We had an awesome private flight! We loved every minute, and our pilot, Justin, was a great tour guide. We really enjoyed chatting with him during our flight. We got to see some beautiful areas of Kauai that we wouldn’t otherwise have seen. I took so many photos! And we noticed as we were waiting to board the plane that the workers go and clean the inside and outside of the windows on the planes to make sure you can take great photos. Definitely worth the price, and a must-do if you’re on the island! Just a note: if the parking lot is full, go to the desk and they’ll give you a parking pass for the lot next door.
The views were spectacular! It’s so interesting to see the island from the air. The pilot was very knowledgeable about the island and very friendly. He was very kind when I got a little airsick.

review_title: They cancel last minute and leave you with nothing to do!
review_text:
I booked a private luxury air tour of Kauai with Air Ventures, attracted by the promise of an exclusive experience for up to six passengers with a weight limit of 1100 pounds. My husband and I, both tall and muscular men weighing a total of 600 pounds, were looking forward to this unique opportunity to see the island from above. 
Unfortunately, our anticipation turned to disappointment when Air Ventures canceled our flight less than 15 hours before the scheduled departure. The reason provided was “weight and balance” issues, despite our combined weight being well within the stated limit on their website.
The last-minute cancellation left us with no viable alternatives to fill our day, as it was too late to make other arrangements. This was particularly disheartening as the booking was made a month in advance, and we had no prior indication that there would be any issue with our flight.
While I understand that safety must come first, the timing of the cancellation and the lack of a satisfactory explanation or compensation have left a negative impression on our experience. It is my hope that Air Ventures will address these communication issues to prevent future disappointments for other customers.
You had a great time and the pilot was excellent! Views are different from the helicopter!! But I had amazing pictures and videos. We really enjoyed our trip.
Stunning way to see the island!  So glad we did it by airplane. Josh explained what we were seeing and even pointed out whales off the cost!
Amazing trip. Such beautiful views. Great friendly pilot. Well worth cost. Felt very safe in small plane
Great, fun way to see most of the island, including lots of places that are inaccessible any other way. We had great weather and visibility. We also had Isaac as our pilot… no ka oi!

review_title: Just go for it! You’ll be glad you did
review_text: It was a great time and unique opportunity. I have tried many other land based services, and this is the first air base service I’ve tried. It’s worth every penny!

This was an amazing tour. James, our pilot was professional, personable and very knowledgeable. We had a spectacular tour, the weather was beautiful, the scenery was gorgeous, almost a sensory overload. I can  recommend Air Ventures whole heartedly.  You will have a wonderful time. Everyone at Air Ventures were great. 5 stars.

review_title: Well worth it. Book them now!
review_text:
Communication prior to our arrival was great. 

We started out the afternoon arriving at the designated location.  A small booth is there to greet you.  Sign in and weights are done there.

We had Josh as our pilot. He greets us inside and introduced himself and gave us a quick rundown of our flight. We were walked out to our plane and staff were available for photo op with the pilot. We were helped into the plane and given more safety instructions. The take off was nice and smooth. 

We started our flight over the ocean looking for groups of turtles and whales.  Josh had some jokes along the way to keep us laughing. We would circle areas of interest for lots of photo opportunities.  We had some cloud cover here and there he would avoid and circle back if he seen the clouds would be gone shortly. 

We received a lot of commentary on island history and each location we were over. 

Our trip ended just in time as a weather front was hitting. Timing for our flight was perfect. 

I have zero complaints about our trip. Well worth every penny and Josh was fantastic!

Everything was great. Totally recommend this tour if you’re looking for a cheaper option compared to the helicopter tour. Saw so many amazing things, the Na poli coast is breathtaking. Pilot was calm and very informative.

Piper was competent and knowledgeable.  The plane seemed to be well maintained.  Piper started with a thorough safety check and ended with a nice landing with some cross wind. Will recommend to family and friends.

review_title: Good but could have been better
review_text: Piper was a great pilot and the plane was well maintained. Tour  was great but once we reached Hanelei  Bay I saw nothing but water as I was on the left side. I wanted to see that area as my last visit was the first year of Tahiti Nui,

What a fantastic way to see Kauai!! We are a family of five so too many for a helicopter tour. We decided to go with AirVentures and it did not disappoint. Some of us were a little nervous but our pilot, Shaeden, put us all at ease and we had an incredibly smooth flight and saw so many amazing things! It’s hard to describe the beauty of the island from above! Highly recommend this tour!

Our flight was canceled twice due to weather. I am glad that the pilot was safety, conscious, and did not want to take any chances but this was obviously very disappointing. My main complaint was the way this was handled and how disorganized the operation seemed. First of all, they did not notify us of the cancellation until we arrived on site. That meant that we had to pay for a taxi ride from the cruise terminal to the airport and back, which was $20 each way. And then there was a significant delay in getting our refund. I had to call them several times. My refund didn’t actually appear on my statement until one month after the cancellation. They were very nice on the phone, but it seemed like they were not well organized.

The check-in was simple and staff was very friendly! Josh was our pilot and he was awesome! I highly recommend Air Ventures if you are in Kauai! Thank you all for a wonderful flight and great memories! 
-The Crow's

What a great way to view the entire island of Kauai in an hour.  James, our pilot, took us on a safe ride and gave exceptional guides on the island.  As a native, he is well familiar with all the key spots and items of interests along the flight.  We were rather worried about the weather but that’s how Kauai is…unpredictable.  But James was able to maneuver for better views which included great views of Napali Coastline, Waimea Canyon, Kauai Coffee Plantation and sites where they filmed Jurassic Park and Fantasy Island.  The checkin process was rather simple and hassle free as the staff organized it well.  We had some flexibility on the dates of flight as our original day was rather rainy.  All in all, it was well worth the experience!

This was one of the highlights of our Hawaii vacation.  Highly recommend.  We were not sure about a helicopter ride, so we chose this instead and it was EXCELLENT!  Shaeden was our pilot, and he was AWESOME!  He is native to Kauai and shared so much history.  He was enthusiastic and fun but not corny like so many tour guides.  He gave good information.   The views were amazing!  We were only on Kauai for three days so this was the perfect way to see a lot of the island.

review_title: Nice roundtrip at an reasonable price
review_text:
Easy start and landing, relaxed pilot. You get a good overview about many places around the island (Kauai), which is really beautiful. 

Cheaper than the heli tours and not that loud. I think thasts good for the environment. Maybe by helicopter you can go a little bit closer to some spots and even do a stop in between but I liked the constant flying. We went close enough to everything. 

In preparation every thing when well. Friendly and professional team, fast response.

review_title: Enjoyed plane ride of Kauai island
review_text: We have taken a helicopter ride before with another company and decided this time to do airplane this time. It was great. Only thing is my ears popped toward the end. I would love to have had the left seat behind the pilot. The girl in the set got pretty sick. You don't get as closed as a helicopter but I felt a lot safer. It was worth it. Got great photos with phone and camera.
We booked a Kauai island tour. It was fantastic! The bird’s eye view of the Na Pali coast was spectacular! Lots of opportunities for photos.

I highly recommend taking a tour of Kauai by air! It's the best (only) way to see everything. I hate helicopters and I love airplanes, so that was an easy pick. I chose Air Ventures based on reviews. I highly recommend their air tour of Kauai. It is a VERY well run business. From checking in to finishing up, the experience was top notch!
I went alone, so I got the copilot seat, which was amazing!
The pilot, Josh, was awesome. Great pilot, great tour guide!
I only wish I could have a transcript or recording of the tour information to go with all my fantastic pictures!

Our trip was excellent! We saw so much of the island, and the flight was so smooth. That was partly due to the wonderful weather but also our awesome pilot Bubs. Highly recommend this tour company. The very best way to see the Island in my opinion.

An invaluable experience, seeing virtually the entire Island from above. Plenty of beautiful, awe-inspiring sites to be seen. The entire experience was made that much better by the welcoming staff, flight crew and pilot. Well worth your time.
This was my second flight with Air Ventures and hopefully not my last.    This trip was with my sister, she was so joyful and enjoyed the ride.  Great value. The only way to enjoy Kauai from the sky.
Extremely enjoyable island tour flight with Maka. As a pilot, great to get to fly the Cessna Skylane, thanks to Maka for your confidence!

We received a text canceling our trip the day before  our booking, making it impossible to find something last minute on the island. I was promised a refund 3-7 business days from their cancellation back on 9/01 and now here we are on 9/19 waiting on our refund. Regret picking this company to have my business with.

review_title: Highlight of our trip to Kauai!
review_text: Outstanding views of the Garden Isle!  Our guide, Isaac, was knowledgeable and friendly, giving us some history as he pointed out highlights along the way.  We really enjoyed our tour and highly recommend AirVentures!

My husband and I had a fabulous time touring Kauia by air with Air Ventures Hawaii.  All the staff including our pilot, were pleasant, accommodating, professional, caring and just a breath of fresh air!  The price that we paid for this tour was also reasonable!  Consider flying with them on your next visit to Kauai!  Cheers!

We had a blast going on the Big Kahuna Kauai Air Tour.  It was fantastic to see the island this way and gave us a different way of appreciating the beauty of Kauai.  Our pilot was informative, nice, and friendly.  It was easy to arrange the tour and everyone with whom we met from this company was respectful and had smiles on their faces (it makes a big difference when communicating with someone with a friendly smile and demeanor!).  I highly recommend this company and the tours they provide  We will be back again someday!

Wahou, it is something to do.
The tour is great, all passengers see perfectly well as each one have is own window.
The pilot explains perfectly well what we see and turn around to allow each side of the plane to see falls, mountains, reef...
To sum-up, you can go eyes closed, but don't forget to open them during the tour.
Enjoy
