Took a flight with Josh. (I think that was our pilot) it couldn’t have been smoother and more beautiful. I ha e also done the biplane which I recommend this time we were 5 so we needed the full
Plane. What makes this better than helicopter is you get to see the whole island. Maui is great for helicopter but kauia has so much beauty it’s impossible to
Cover it all without the plane. Absolutely a MUST do. Felt extremely safe and he gave a great tour over the island. Spend the money and do it!!!

We really enjoyed this aerial tour!  Our pilot,  Bubbs, was personable and attentive and the views were amazing!  We also appreciate the reasonable cost from Air Ventures as compared with other companies.   It gets a li
Great tour.  Bubs was our pilot and lots of fun!  Great way to see the island from above.  Would do this again on our next visit.
What an amazing adventure we had flying around the island! 150% hands down the best experience ever and fully encourage everyone to do it! Our Pilot Bubs was awesome!!!!!

The Air Ventures Hawaii staff were professional and made us feel like they valued their customers. When we arrived for our scheduled flight, the weather was clouding in and they offered to give us the best tour they could then, or reschedule at our convenience. We chose to reschedule and ended up with an awesome day for flying. James was our pilot he was fun and made it a relaxing trip with our 10 month old.

We flew with the helicopter before and flying on an airplane feels like a better value for the money. It feels much safer. Isaac our pilot is extremely knowledgeable as he is local. This was our 6 trip, and we highly recommend this company. If you want a great vacation on Kauai this is a must. Thank you Isaac and Air Ventures. You are awesome!
Nice job seeing the Island overall so I had an idea of where to hike and things I might want to see up close. Very knowledgeable and fun pilot/ tour guide.
This was our first time in a small plane.  Our pilot was excellent!  Very informative and the scenery was stunning.  Very enjoyable and breathtaking views of Kauai.

Had an amazing time with our pilot (Bubbs). 

Got to see the entire island during our flight.  Bubbs was a great tour guide and an even better pilot. Smooth take-off, flight, and landing. 

Last time we were in Kauai, we booked a heli tour of the island. It was fun, but I found this tour to be more fun and personal. I’d definitely recommend it to anyone and will be back to do it again!
Bought this for my husband for our 40th anniversary, he loved every minute of it.  He still talks about it being the best gift ever!

We had a wonderful time.  The pilot and helper were very nice.
The pilot explained what we were seeing and because it was such a nice day he showed us a few areas that are not usually seen due to clouds.
We enjoyed the view and would definately do it again
had to cancel because of weather but was rescheduled for the next day.  Everyone was helpful and friendly and professional

It was a memorable experience celebrating my wife's birthday. The private plane tour was great and exceptional. Our pilot was just perfect in flying and an excellent tour guide too. We covered the entire island and got wonderful videos and photos. Highly recommended and will be back next time.

This was a fabulous tour and highly recommend for an aerial view of the entire island. Our pilot pointed out lots of landmarks including beautiful waterfalls, Waimea Canyon, beaches and other spots. Highly recommend.

Truly the best way to see all the island has to offer! And much more affordable than the helicopters! Our pilot was very knowledgeable and flexible in terms of focusing on certain things we wanted to see. I was pretty nervous but the ride was smooth and the 1 hour tour was the perfect amount of time. They even have frozen towels on board which came in handy when I got a little hot and claustrophobic toward the end— the planes are very small! Also, you may not be sitting next to your partner/group due to weight distribution. Just something to be aware of!

Definitely recommend booking early on in your trip in case there is bad weather and you need to reschedule. That was the case for us but it was not a problem to rebook a few days later. However the woman checking us in the day we rescheduled gave us an amazing food recommendation that ended to being our favorite meal on our trip, so it was definitely worth our time ;)

i can completely recommend the flight. great experience. it may be a few euros more expensive than other providers, but a charming family business. warm welcome. photos are taken at the beginning if you like. you can also express wishes for the route. just great

review_title: See the whole island and whales
review_text: Our pilot Bubs was great. He told us a lot and showed us more. My wife and I highly recommend this tour

Quality and affordable. It was more than we expected. FYI: the crawl into the plane may be difficult for anyone when bad joints. Mom just had a hip replacement and it was a little hard. But she still loved the ride! Great views for everyone. You get your own window. Two to a row.

review_title: Great, less expensive way to see Kauai
review_text: We felt very secure in the airplane and were able to see all parts of the island, including Waimea canyon, the Nepali coast, Wailua, river and waterfalls, and many beautiful beaches. We also saw a few different groups of humpback whales. We had considered a helicopter tour, but it was at least double as much and we are so glad we did the airplane tour because we were able to see everything we wanted for half the price. Our pilot was very nice but didn’t share a whole lot of information about the island unless we specifically asked him.
The flight was smooth and felt safe. It was very interesting and fun to see the island in a bird’s eye view. Our pilot answered our questions well.
The flight around Kauai gave us outstanding views of the whole island, allowed for questions and answers during the flight and was impeccably executed. We did benefit from very good  weather,

Had a blast on the tour of the island. Isaac was a very good pilot, gave us a heads up before turbulence and was very knowledgable about the island. You don’t get to choose where to sit, but I despite that the right side gets to see a bit more, Isaac would spin around so everyone on the left got to see the same views. The flight is very slow, so you get plenty of time for photos or video.

One word of warning, take Dramamine. I forgot and got so motion sick with the turbulence. But Isaac was helpful afterwards and gave me some mints and ginger ale to settle my stomach. Overall I’d do it again.

The flight was good.  The pilot was excellent.  All of us enjoyed the tour.  I recommend it for anyone. 
 Thank you.

review_title: AirVentures showed us a great time!
review_text: My partner and I took the Big Kahuna aerial tour of Kauai. Our captain, Makana, took us on a smooth flight, showed us all the highlights of Kauai, making sure both sides of the plane got to see everything. He brought us down in the smoothest landing I have ever experienced. I highly recommend AirVentures!
Makana was not only an excellent pilot, he was an amazing DJ and help my brother with motion sickness! I would highly recommend this company to anyone considering flying over Kauai!

This was the best thing I did on my trip to Hawaii by far! Absolutely recommend it not only for the flying experience, but for the breathtaking views!!
Well worth the money - hands down. If you are debating doing this, I truly recommend just booking- you won’t regret this experience!!!

A great flight over the island canyon and coast 
With brilliant commentary from our pilot and lovely music . An exiting and great way to view the island and a problem free experience.
Thank you Isaac for a wonderful tour of the island of Kauai!  We will always treasure the tour you gave us of the island!

5 family members did this amazing trip with Mark as our pilot. My son Scott got to sit up front with Mark and enjoyed a great view having been in a middle seat situation on a helicopter 10 years ago. My wife and I did this trip 5 years ago and loved this trip once more as it is far better than a bumpy copter ride not to mention less money and a longer duration. Forget the copter and go for the plane as everyone has a window seat.
Our pilot Makana was just great, he told us a lot about everything we saw and had great music on while doing so ;) also, the flight was incredibly smooth!

We booked a private charter through Air Ventures.  The pilot, Issac, as well as the rest of the staff were great, attentive to our needs.  Issac provided information concerning the island as well as making sure we had the best angles for photographs.  We really enjoyed our tour, but most of all the fact that the pilot was a native born son and his love for his home showed through in his conversation.
Amazing aerial experience to get all of Kauais beauty in 1 hour. May not go low as helicopters, but still stunning views! Our pilot Justin was amazing at explaining all geographies and details too!

review_title: No better way to see island
review_text: I should have taken motion sickness meds but our pilot did a great job making the ride smooth as possible.  Beautiful views!!

55 years ago while I was pregnant with my second child I got my pilot's license. I flew Cessna 150s, 172s, and 182s. I flew for about 14 years then I got a divorce and had to stop.Climbing into the cockpit was like going into the past, but there were new things of today as well. The pilot -Nate - was wonderful. The trip was  incredibly beautiful. My wife had never been in a small plane and fell in love with the experience. Worth so much in memories both current and long ago. Thank you for making it possible. And a special thanks to Nate!
Our pilot Caden, was informative & friendly! The ride was amazing! We had a private plane. the views can’t be beat absolutely breathtaking scenery

I'm an airplane nut, and let the young man know that he could take us in some spots that the average tourists might not appreciate. And as luck would have it the weather was a little socked in with low visability. Not only was I confident in our pilot's skil level, but I was impressed with his use of several devices that gave us information on weather and air traffic. Caden was friendly and knowelegable and we enjoyed our experience greatly.
It’s a great tour. Beautiful views of the Island Unique experience!! The pilot was very kind and explained in detail each place we visited.
We enjoyed the plane ride and our pilot did an awesome job, he showed us the whole island and made an effort to show us all the places that you can't see from hiking or traveling by car.
We had Nate as our pilot and he was awesome! Very smooth flight and he knew everything about the island from movie sets to history to various waterfalls in the mountains!

review_title: Fantastic way to view the island
review_text: Highly recommended for people who wants to look at Kauai from the bird's eye view. The plane ride was not bumpy or rocking at all which was my initial concern for my 5yr old. It was a great experience with breathtaking view of the coastal lines and canyons.
It was wonderful to this island from above! And the pilot was great! It was a really good flight! Thank you

review_title: Views of Kauai That You Can't See From the Ground
review_text: Air Ventures was very professional from start to finish. Our pilot gave us a wonderful tour and pointed out waterfalls and other beautiful sights. Motion sickness was a problem for some in our party, even though they had taken Dramamine, so know ahead of time that this can happen. But the views are spectacular, and we all felt very safe.
We had a wonderful air tour of Kauai and would highly recommend! Makoa was an excellent pilot and guide.

Mahalo Air Venture for a great experience. The flight was one hour and you were taken to all the major sites on Kauai. The Pilot is very knowledgeable about the history of the area.  At times bumpy but what do you expect when you are in a six-pack aircraft. All the time I felt safe and confident in our pilot.  I would encourage everyone to try it once, you will enjoy yourself.

The plan was for a fly-over of Kauai. The plane was small, with the passenger space limited. In the air, the plane was buffeted. Nausea ensued. The canyon views were marred by circling with more nausea. The passengers asked few questions and the pilot offered limited information.

review_title: The FLIGHT was the HIGHLIGHT of our Kauai Vacation
review_text:
We were married in the Fern Grotto many years ago and Kauai is a Very Special place for us. The FLIGHT with Air Ventures Hawaii was the HIGHLIGHT of our Kauai Vacation. Jill and Ray did a great job in providing us this experience. We look forward to flying with them again!
Lois & Gary

Pilot Nate was great! His air tour was informative and interactive yet not overbearing or scripted like some other tour guides. The views from the sky looking down at the island was breathtaking. I did get a bit queasy from the ride but at no fault to Nate. It was the breakfast I ate before the flight. Overall a great experience and affordable too!

review_title: The only way to see all the beauty of Kauai
review_text: We had a group of 9 split into two planes. Just an unbelievable epic flight of beauty. I cannot say enough that this is the best most memorable thing we did in Kauai. Do not forget your go pro so you have an hour long memory of the flight.  Staff was amazing. They even called to see how one child in our group was feeling after we had left as she had a bit of motion sickness.  Top notch team and top notch excursion of a lifetime.   Our pilots were so friendly and welcoming and gave us such a history of the island.
We had a great experience! Loved how he told us history and all about the island. So pretty from above too!

Me and my friend got the private flight for 2 people, I cannot tell you how much the extra 50 dollars per person is worth it. Ray was the best pilot and person I have ever been around the 2 person experience was awesome and we were much more comfortable and in the air. Views were amazing and they cater to you excellently. Service was fantastic and the people were more than happy do help.

I believe our guide’s name was Nate and he was excellent.  He was knowledgeable and made a point to circle in areas of interest so both sides of the plane got a good view.  Excellent experience!  Thank you!

review_title: Very friendly and a great experience
review_text: It was the best choice to flight with AirVentures! Very frequently and a great experience to see the island from above.

Einfach nur woooow, das Team ist super nett man fühlt sich sofort willkommen. 
Der Pilot ist mit Herz und Selle dabei er hat alles super erklärt, habe mich sehr sicher gefühlt.
Die Tour ist ein Traum, man hat genügend Zeit Fotos und Videos zu machen und auch den Ausblick zu genießen.Bin sehr glücklich so kurzfristig noch einen Platz bekommen zu haben um dieses Erlebniss in meine Erinnerungen speichern zu können.
Jeder Dollar$ hat sich gelohnt. DANKE an das Team♡.

Had a wonderful flight, pilot was very friendly and a great guide.  We went out after a hard morning rain and the number of waterfalls we say was amazing.  Would highly recommend this to anyone wanting to see the sights of the island.

My flight around Island was excellent, our pilot Ray was very experienced in both flying and the Island below. going on an airplane ride and not helicopter is a good choice airplane flies much slower so you get to spend more time flying around. I was running a little late getting back to cruise ship, Ray gave me a ride back in his personal vehicle. Great Folks highly recommend

Flying with Air Ventures Hawaii over Kauai was just the best things we did in Kauai ! Overfly this Island is just the best way to see how paradise look ! 
Thanks again to Jill for everything she did for us to have a place on one flight as we came a bit late and all the attention made to my girlfriend who is afraid of the plane.
And a big thanks to the pilot for this amazing flight and his attention as well to my girlfriend !
Mahalo !

This whole operation is super chill! Rescheduled us with no problems when they suggested the weather was about 50%. We came back and had some awesome waterfall views, despite some passengers using the “aloha” bags. I would recommend this versus a helicopter tour, these people really seem to care about your experience. Trish and Ray were great too, btw! If you can fly co-pilot seat, that is the best view in the plane.

Fantastic! The stunning views were exceeded only by Ray's great narration and experienced piloting!  The large glass windows and Ray's skill in getting us close to Kauai's terrain that is not accessible any other way afforded a priceless experience. The cabin air was comfortable and they even provided cold towels and water bottles for each to ease any motion sickness.  This is SO MUCH LESS than helicopter rides and you see every bit as much, possibly more!  Strongly recommend this outfit.  We'll come again!
Best scenic flight ever. Friendly and informative best ever better than a Helicopter got up close and personal.

review_title: Excellent views and guided 120 minutes flight
review_text: Ray, the pilot was excellent and flyed through many views of the entire Kauai island - many water falls, Canyons, Napali Coast. The views on Napali coast in North-West were awesome. I highly recommend anyone visiting Kauai to view Napali coast views either through air or boat or hike (permit needed). Canyons can be visited by car.

This was the best thing we did on Kauai. The trip gives you a good overview of the island and our pilot Nate did an amazing job showing us the sights. Everyone in the office was just as nice as they could be, you can really tell they enjoy what they do. You will be glad you flew Kauai with Air Ventures!
Mahalo, John

review_title: Amazing air tour of the whole Island!
review_text:
Air Ventures air tour is excellent. If you are looking for photo graphing make sure that you are sitting in the 3rd row as 2nd row has the wing as obstruction. 
Rey is very nice , ask him prior to flight so that he can show the Na Pali beach from both side.

The flight was the highlight of our trip! The scenery was amazing and you have enough time to appreciate the entire island. We were able to bring our 1 year old son on the flight and he loved looking out the window until he fell asleep! Everyone at the company was great. Highly recommend!
Great experience.  Thank you nate for the ride and Jill for your hospitality .  Great view of the entire island
When you arrive they make you feel like family. Nate was a amazing pilot, keep us informed on all land marks and the various waterfalls. Well worth you time and money.

This is the best way to see all the beautiful sites of Kauai, as many of them are not accessible by car. Our pilot Nate narrated the tour and shared background and history for the sites along the way. It was a clear day with very little wind, so Nate was able to get us close to waterfalls and canyon views. This tour was the highlight of our trip to Kauai!

Air ventures are really good at this touring services. Both Jill and Ray are extremely helpful in making customers happy, comfortable with the flight etc., Absolutely I would recommend for anyone who wants to take an aerial tour of Kauai.
Jill was awesome, she really helpful and good caretaker; Pilot was knowledge and friendly; One of a kind and shouldn't be missed

We booked this flight 6 months prior and my husband was denied boarding due to increase of weight. We prepaid and we were unable to be refunded by the owner of the company after she agreed to refund, but did not have the correct credit card information. We called with the correct credit card and she was reluctant to refund us. Not even a check could be issued even thou they OWNED the company. It wasn’t a cancellation, but a denial of service, so the 48hr cancellation policy did not apply in this circumstance.  Bad costumer relations in our opinion. My husband sat and waited while the rest of us flew. SAD!! The flight was awesome for the rest of us, but tainted by the poor customer service, or lack of. Potential passengers beware…be prepared for them to also add 15lbs to your current weight! Very disappointed. By the way, we gave them a week to rectify this before leaving this review.

Did this flight with my wife and our oldest son (26).  Had a great time with great views and overview from our pilot.  Felt very safe throughout the flight - good to do early in your visit to get an overview and recommendations of the whole island.  Highly recommend and more affordable than helicopter tours.
To really appreciate  this beautiful island you must see it from above as well as by car as well as the water. We had a great guide with the island touch of a native🥰
Have done a couple of helocopter tours and this airplane tour was better. Better price and able to see more.

review_title: We saw everything I wanted to and more!
review_text:
This plane ride was so much fun and the captain made sure that we got to see everything we wanted to. He even asked us if we wanted to take a short detour to circle around some whales he spotted in the water! He provided interesting commentary the whole time so that we would know what we were looking at. 
Note: I do recommend pre-medicating with nausea/ motion sickness medicine even if you are not expecting to feel dizzy. Everyone in our group felt a little nauseous, even those of us who had never experienced motion sickness before. The plane is hot and the combination of turbulence and looking down the whole time was the cause of the nausea/dizziness. The company keeps ginger tablets in the cabinet behind the check-in desk and they gave us some afterwards and the ginger helped tremendously. I would recommend asking for a couple of ginger tablets ahead of time to try to get ahead of the motion sickness. We had a blast though and would totally go again! (Pre-medicated with ginger/dramamine first though)

Hawaii is a long flight that I've taken on other airlines... never again, when I go back it will be Hawaiian for sure.  Plenty of leg room, free TV,  cell phone charger on every seat, free carry on, complementary meal and blankets.   They make sitting on a plane for 8 hrs as comfortable as humanly possible as you can!
Great scenery & great, informative pilot tour guide.  Flew all around the canyons, could see several waterfalls.  Also flew over the sea just a bit, very pretty sight!

Ray and Jill were excellent hosts - even when I got sick on the flight.  It was so amazing - I would even go again!  We saw rainbows, waterfalls, gorgeous canyons, and a whale!  We took this tour the first day we were on Kauai and it really helped us get a lay of the land. Definitely recommend!
Our air tour was amazing, knowledgeable and professional pilot, comfortable aircraft, check in was simple. Glad we did the airplane tour instead of the helicopter.

Ray and Jill were the most amazing, helpful people. They made the whole adventure worthwhile with their jokes and warm personalities. I couldn't have asked for a better experience and I would HIGHLY recommend them. You will not be sorry!

We had the most beautiful rainbow filled trip. The captain of the plane was showing us pods of hunting dolphins, waterfalls and rainbows. He did take few extra minutes to see our enthusiasm and we had the most memorable experience. Me and my husband can highly recommend this nice in a lifetime experience.

review_title: Best air tour ever in my life
review_text: Awesome pilot, very knowledgeable about the Kauia island, we saw like 20 water falls, i will take the same tour next year around june. Thanks air kauai travel ylu guys are awesome..

The flight over Kauai piloted by Ray was the highlight of our time on the island! We first had hoped for the less expensive option with four other travelers, but are so happy to have gone on the private trip, just the two of us with Ray. He was super fun, shared lots of information during the flight, & kept us laughing, too! Jill was wonderfully welcoming, both on the phone and in person. We couldn’t have asked for anything better & highly recommend Air Ventures!

Ray and Jill were wonderful! Ray was our pilot and he was very entertaining and knowledgeable. We did a private tour, just my husband, Ray and myself. Ray took us around Kauai, the Na Pali coast is so beautiful from the air! I’m so thankful we added the GoPro pictures! When we come back to Kauai, we will visit Ray and Jill for another tour.

From the first contact through the flight we couldn't have been happier with the decision to choose Air Ventures Hawaii to tour Kauai by air!  We saw online that everything was booked but decided to call just in case.  Good that we did.  Although there was not an opening, Jill worked hard to figure out how they could accommodate our schedule!  What a gem she is!  Eventually we scheduled with her Husband Ray to take the 2 of us up in a Cessna for a private tour.  Turns out Ray was a career pilot for United who started this company in retirement.  We were blown away by the level of service, attention to safety and thoughtfulness to make sure we felt comfortable and had an amazing experience.  Our flight exceeded all of our expectations.  Ray provided so much insight on the island and specifically highlighted details.  Like so many days on Kauai there was a bit of rain but we successfully kept one step ahead of it and were chased by rainbows!!  It was just incredible.  We were able to view the whole island including waterfalls, Napali Coast (we now know were the best paths, beaches and sea caves are), Waimea Canyon North Shore and gardens.  But the best thing is that the whole experience seemed like we were being guided by a good friend.  It was really a rare experience!
Great experience, my wife and I loved it a lot. We had a great pilot named Ray, if you get a chance make sure you get into a plane with him. Great place overall.

Loved the ride. It was so beautiful to see the island that this way. Makes you want to explore the island more on foot to try and get closer to all the beauty you see from the air. 

It was a wonderful tour with beautiful sights and lots of information.

review_title: Fly over Kauai with Air Adventures
review_text: Everyone at Air Adventures was extremely professional and fun to talk with.Our pilot Nate was very smooth on both takeoff and landing as well very knowledgeable in the locations and history of the island. I would absolutely recommend flying with them and hope I can have an opportunity to use them in the future!!
Well worth the money spent! Such a beautiful way to see the whole island. The pilot (and his wife) were very friendly and informative. What a great memory of Kauai!
The trip was excellent. The staff was great. Our pilot was very capable and informative. We had excellent views of the island.

Nate was our pilot in the gorgeous 2007 Cessna 182. My wife was anxious about flying in a small plane for the first time and found it easy and enjoyable with views that can't be beat. I was stoked since I just got my pilot's license and I'm used to flying clapped-out old junkers. This aircraft was top notch and even has air-conditioning which is a massive upgrade. Nate was engaging and funny, had plenty of knowledge to share but it wasn't the boring tour guide sort of situation. More like flying with a buddy who really knows the area and his airplane. We saw the entire island during the 1 hour flight and it never felt rushed. We did this at the beginning of our trip since it was our first time in Kauai and after the flight I felt like we really had our bearings – we knew the north shore from Poipu, the differences in terrain and weather and got a few cultural history lessons along the way. Nate, Ray and the crew on the ground setting the whole flight up were all sincerely friendly and obviously enjoy their jobs. A+ all around, thanks, guys!

We loved everything about our plane tour. Our pilot and guide Nate was amazing, the welcome from the front desk was great as well. Being able to strap our go pro to the wing was worth every penny. I seriously can’t recommend this tour enough.

this was one of the highlights of our kauai trip. ray (our pilot) was awesome. the ride was the best way to see the beauty of the island. staff was outstanding! thank you and see you again soon. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!

This was our first visit to Kauai, and being larger beings, we booked this plane tour instead of a Helo trip.  We were not disappointed! Ray, our pilot was very knowledgeable and accommodating, and the sights were outstanding! Everyone had a birds eye view.  Being able to mount our GoPro camera on the plane was a plus as well! Definitely recommend them as an alternative if you are too heavy for a Helo! (I'm 6'2" and 340lbs)

The best of the best Nate was our polite he did very well. Ray and his family and coworkers made everyone feel like family. If there was something extra that you wanted to see Nate made sure that you saw it again,They are the best of THE BEST!!!!!!

review_title: One of the most incredible experiences of my life!
review_text: Captain Ray, Jill and her employees were incredible. It felt like a family-run operation with decades of experience in the aviation industry, so it felt personalized and safe. I can’t even begin to describe how beautiful the views were. Captain Ray knew so much about the island and was so skillful. We got to see tons of waterfalls, hidden beaches, cliffs, canyons and places we would never see via land. Jill was also wonderful. She made sure everyone felt comfortable and answered any questions we had. This flight was such a deal in my opinion. I’ve done similar tours in other places and this was the absolute bang for your buck. I can’t wait to go back and do this tour with my boyfriend, family and friends. I’m recommending this to everyone!

AirVentures provided a great tour from start to finish.  We were greeted warmly by the staff when we arrived.  Our pilot, Ray, was awesome.  It helped that we had perfect weather!  Ray pointed out all sorts of things to look at with background information.  We had read reviews recommending an air tour over helicopter because it's less noisy.  That was good advice. I would recommend this tour to anyone.

After the Covid virus shutdown of 2020 and some of 2021, Air Ventures is flying high again. We were excited to be able to take to the skies during our last day on Kauai. We highly recommend this company. 
Don’t pay twice as much elsewhere. 
You will be in very good hands with Ray who has many many years of experience.
This is a must do! It was the best part of a weeklong stay in Kauai. The views are breathtaking and we were able to see whales while over the water.

We had spent 2 weeks on the island and decided to try the flight on one of the last days.  It was really excellent rapidly seeing so many of the places we had visited from a whole different point of view.  The mountain valley, the W side cliffs, Southern coffee plantation and North Side storm damaged town + many other points of interest.  The pilot was considerate of all passengers questions and the challenges of seeing things from one side or the other side of the plane.  Visit was March 2019.

The tour is awesome and complete. 
The team is friendly and the planes are good.

Very nice time!! We enjoyed so much!!

Happy birthday Pilot Kevin Melanie and I had a great flight. You have awesome knowledge and skills.

You made our Kauai....

Mahalo

We were fortunate to have a good weather day. Staff and pilots highly professional, first class, but extremely personable: loved answering questions and telling stories. Saw the entire island, with extra loops off the northerlies coast to see a number of humpback whales. Fantastic value compared to chopper tours. Highly ecommended.

The company is friendly, talented and interactive throughout the experience.  They are focused on making this a comfortable/pleasant experience.  This is the only way to get closer views of the full variety of gorgeous features that Kauai has to offer, throughout the island.
The Waco is a beautiful airplane, a piece of art as well as a piece of aviation history. Kevin gave us a great tour of Kauai and reassured my nervous partner. We’re still grinning!
Ray is a great pilot that showed us lots of waterfalls and good commentary. It was a good ride. We thoroughly enjoyed the sites he flew over.

Three of us took 1 hour flight to see Kauai from the air! It was a great flight and the crew did everything possible to make it so. The weather was a little ify when we arrived and they waited to leave until some rain passed to make it the best possible. Ray told great stories and kept us entertained and informed the entire flight. It is really something to see the island from the air. I chose a plane rather than a helicopter because I don't like how noisy copters are and because of the price. I stand by my choice 100%. The plane went  at a slower pace, allowing us more time to see the sites, and was not obnoxiously loud and was much more cost effective. I felt safe at all times. Thanks Air Ventures for a memory not soon forgotten.
We had a great trip with our pilot Dal. It was a great day to view all the falls of the island, and the coasts.

review_title: Wonderful way to see the island!
review_text: We had a group of 12 and another tour company wouldn't take us all together because of their weight limits.  Air Ventures had no problems with taking our group. We also saved money by booking the luau package deal with them. Jill told us to book early in our trip so we would be able to reschedule if weather was bad.  That turned out to be great advice.  We re-booked twice and were finally able to go out on our last morning for a beautiful tour with perfect weather on our last morning on Kauai and easily made our departing flights.  Ray was the perfect tour guide/pilot. Jill and Ray were wonderful! It was the perfect finale for a great week in Kauai.

if its your first time and you are adventurous, you will love it. Service at the counter by Jill was good and Kevin our pilot  cool as a cucumber. Great way to see Kuai, the Napali coastline, Wilua falls, the coastlines etc..

review_title: An amazing experience and the best way to see the island of Kauai
review_text: We had scheduled a tour on one of their regular 4 seater planes all enclosed and protected from the elements viewing the island though windows.  When we arrived, I noticed a poster with a beautiful yellow bi-plane. Upon being greeted by owner, Jill, who by the way was terrific, I related my memories of decades ago with my uncle, flying with him in an very small open airplane. Jill said the bi-plane was available right away and would switch us to that if we wanted. Of course we said yes. During the flight, I must have said 50 times ‘simply amazing’.  Out in the elements, even rained on a little WAS absolutely amazing. Many thanks to Kevin for a terrific tour.

review_title: First rate air tour on Kaua'i
review_text:
My wife and I went on the one hour air tour in a Cessna with our pilot, Ray. Ray is the most professional, fun and seasoned pilot you will ever meet and he really put us at ease and helped us have a fantastic time.
They were kind enough to pick us up at our hotel (the Marriott in Lihue) as we did not have a car yet and dropped us off at the airport to pick up our rental after!
The tour gave us an excellent view of the beautiful island of Kaua'i and the pilot took us to a couple extra places of interest for use which was great. (a benefit of having a private tour). Since we were first time fliers on a small plane he tested out our ability to withstand some turbulence by taking us to certain areas and once he was satisfied we were 'good' he took us everywhere and we saw some awesome sights.
I was able to mount my GoPro on the outside of the plane (for a small fee) and got some great footage of the Napali coast and other areas. The staff was experienced with handling GoPro's and got it all set up nicely for me as I was a new user.
Everyone raves about the helicopter tours but I would say that the private Cessna tour is another thing not to be missed, both for the views and for the personal, fun experience with this amazing company.
Thanks!

review_title: Bi-Plane was best experience on Kauai
review_text: Kevin was a great pilot.  Felt the experience was better than a helicopter tour.  The views were awsome, but the fact you have this panoramic viewpoint and can sit side by side as a couple made it so much more personal and intimate.

Air Ventures Hawaii is absolutely the best way to see all of the best parts of the island, from the Na Pali coast, the Waimea valley, and multiple waterfalls. Our pilot was great and setting up the tour was low-stress and hassle free. The price for an hour's trip was very reasonable. I recommend going after you've spent a few days on the island, as you can pick out places you've already been but from a totally different perspective.

review_title: Une magnifique expérience... c'était vraiment top :o) !!!!
review_text:
Une expérience atypique à vivre.
Vous embarquez à 2 en plus du pilote qui se trouve derrière vous.
Vous n'êtes pas aussi proche que dans un hélicoptère mais suffisamment proche pour observer les magnifiques paysages de l'île.
Belle balade à vivre en couple.
Super accueil et très bonne prise en charge.
Pour les français que nous sommes, les explications en anglais ne sont pas toujours simples à comprendre.

This will be my best memory of our trip to Hawaii. Found the info online while planning our trip. Called to talk to someone and got a real person. They answered all my questions thoroughly and I felt really good about it.  They took care of every detail, picked us up at the shuttle stop from the cruise ship, very personable and accommodating, and made it a great experience. They were keeping abreast of the weather reports.  It was very cost effective compared to helicopters, which we had decided we didn't feel comfortable doing. They also hooked us up with a great luau that evening that we were wanting to do.  We would do it again if we ever return to Hawaii, but this time in their bi-plane.

We have done helicopter tours in the past but wanted to try something new and unique. The biplane ride over the island and through the canyon certainly fit the bill. We will do it again the next time we are in Kauai. Much fun.

This was the sir portion of our "Best of Kauai" tour.  J.T. our pilot was wonderful and very knowledgable. It was a one hour flight around most of the island with emphasis on Wimea Canyon an the Na Pali coast.  He made sure that both sides of the plane got to see all the sights.  We had a beautiful day for our morning flight. I might suggest a later flight for picture taking.

Kevin took us up in Snoopy II yesterday for a beautiful flight around the island. Had perfect weather. He has thirty one years on the island and very knowledgeable.  Wonderful open air cockpit and the sound of a radial engine is like nothing else. Saw many whales and about every waterfall on the island. Can’t wait to do it again next year!

review_title: Air Ventures Hawaii was completely fantastic!
review_text: My husband and I visited Kauai in February and opted for their Big Kahuna tour, which is the most popular. We opted to do it on our last day on the island, which was actually really nice as we were flying over many landmarks, hikes, etc, that we had already seen from the ground and it was fascinating to get a different view while still having some understanding of the geography. I would definitely recommend doing it this way. Tom, who we called to ask a few questions, couldn't have been more helpful and he even picked us up from dropping off our rental car, then drove us to the terminal after the flight. Talk about door to door service! We were in a 7-seater plane with the pilot, Justin, and two other couples. Justin was wonderful! Personable, informative, entertaining, and seemed to be making a true effort to keep the ride as smooth as possible. I usually have trouble with motion sickness in small vehicles but had no trouble here. The views of the island are stunning beyond belief. Words cannot describe what it is like to see Kauai from this view. Highly recommend this tour and company!
We absolutely loved this tour of the island.  Riding in a biplane over beautiful Kauai is an experience we will remember forever.  Make your reservation today, you won't regret it.

We arrived very early and because of a customers' error in booking the Biplane was available immediately.   Wind was to get rough later, so everything turned out on time.    Keven was our pilot/guide.  He was very personable and knowledgeable as was the greeting and support staff.   The flight was very smooth and the biplane was almost new , very clean and smooth running.  Keven provided much information, This is our 4th visit to Kauai so we knew some of it, yet learned so much more.  We have a favorite beach that was not on the route, Keven rerouted a little and gave us some great Arial views.  Confident that we were in good hands, we loved everything about it!

From the minute Jill picked us up at our meeting point we knew this would be an adventure. She was so kind and gave us a little tour of the Hilton grounds, telling us some history. Ray was comical and serious at the same time, explaining how they train their pilots who usually move on to a commercial pilot career. My husband chose to be the co-pilot, a dream come true! The views were breath taking and we totally agreed that there is no better way to see Kauai than from the air. The waterfalls, the Napali Coast, the Waimea Canyon, the beautiful ocean, where we saw a whale from above and the overall tour was just perfect! I would highly recommend the Big Kahuna Air Tour. Our pilot would turn the plane frequently so we could all see the views that he was explaining. We will never forget this adventurous experience!!

review_title: best experience out of a loaded trip
review_text: Mark and his wife had my girl friend and myself laughing and smiling long before we where even in the air.  They are an awesome company and truly made this experience special.

Our experience at AirVentures was very definitely the highlight of our trip to Kauai.  Ray was both a great pilot and an outstanding tour guide, and we enjoyed every minute!  We were able to see parts of the island that we couldn't have seen any other way.  Thanks for a great time!
Tour was highlight of vacation.  Counter, flight line, and pilot were knowledgeable, friendly, and very helpful in meeting all my needs.
This was an amazing excursion.  Our pilot was J.T. and he was very friendly and provided us with a great experience.  I would highly recommend this to others.  It is well worth the time and money!!
Highly recommend the private Cessna 182 tour. Ray is an awesome pilot and showed us everything you could want to see.

Our pilot JT was great. He is very knowledgeable about the history and people of the island, which made the tour even more interesting.
We had a nervous flier on our trip. JT was aware and constantly checked to make sure she was doing ok. Also warned her when it would be a little bumpy.  He took very good care of all of us.
I would certainly recommend Air Ventures to anyone

We had the open cockpit biplane flight beginning of February after booking online from the UK.  Jill kindly offered to collect/shuttle us from the ABC Store at Anchor Cove Shopping Mall which is very close to the Cruise terminal.  She gave us a scenic ride to the airport via some scenic gardens which was unexpected.  The small office was very friendly and efficient with space for bulky belongings.
  There we met Kevin, our pilot who immediately put Jane's mind at ease as she was very apprehensive of small aircraft and open cockpit.  He assured her that the flight would have no 'aerobatics', just relax & enjoy it. An extra cushion was provided so as to help look out.
  After putting on a vintage style cloth helmet with noise cancelling earphones we were ready for take off.  It was warm in the cockpit, just a tee shirt is enough even in February as you have the radial engine just forward of your feet.  We flew a circle over the cruise ship and all the way down the westerly coast including the spectacular Na-Pali coastline overflying white surf and coral reefs.  Turning inland the Waimea Canyon was laid out beneath us on our return to the airport.  Kevin gave a superb commentary.  A big advantage of the open cockpit was that you don't get window reflections in your photographs - or having to look through scratched or milky plexiglass.
    80% of Kauai is inaccessible so the only way to appreciate its majesty is from the air on this 65 minute flight.  We hired a car for the rest of the day and drove to the end of the Canyon road as well - not much to see from the tree lined road so you would need to walk the trails so glad we had the flight.
On our return we were also shuttled to the Avis car depot.
  At first sight the trip sounded expensive at 500USD (£390) for us both but for the experience of a vintage style aircraft in such an exotic place it most definitely was not.  Putting it in perspective, the previous day we paid 300USD for us to have a minibus sightseeing excursion on Big Island.  No contest!!
  To those hesitant of the aircraft - don't be.  Open cockpit is exhilarating and all that fresh air and immersion in the experience blows away any concerns of nausia.  Jane was Cock-a Hoot afterwards with absolutely no regrets.
We are very well travelled seniors and this flight is surely one of our highlights.

My husband and I booked a plane tour with Air Ventures for Kauai,Hawaii when we were on a cruise to Hawaii.. .  From the very beginning the website and staff answered all my questions.  The plane tour was better than we ever could have hoped for.  Our pilot was informative, fun and made sure we were always comfortable and happy.  This is the ONLY WAY to see all that Kauai has to offer.  .We will 100% go on this tour again as it is by far the best excursion we have ever done.  I highly recommend Air Ventures!!!
The bi-plane ride over Kauai was fantastic.  Never scary just an amazing experience.  Wonderful views while learning great information. I want to do it again!!

review_title: Fantastic way to get acquainted with the island.
review_text: Started with a one hour plane ride (7 seater). Some wind, but the pilot handled the plane nicely and avoided bad bumpiness for a pleasant ride.  The colorful views of Waimea Canyon and Na Pali were exquisite!  We also enjoyed the views of the south side as much as we did on a catamaran tour.  The flight ended a bit late to meet the boat trip to the Fern Garden which we did the next day.  After a very tasty lunch at the Kountry Kitchen In Kapaa, Steve took us on a drive of the area and showed us some of the highlights, especially those that the passengers inquired about.  He is pleasant, humorous and knowledgeable.  Well worth going!!

I would highly recommend an Air Ventures tour of Kauai. Our pilot was very knowledgeable about all the locations we flew over and made sure to show us all the beautiful and exciting locations on the island. Our pilot was very experienced and made everyone feel comfortable. It was a wonderful way to see the beauty and ruggedness of the island and a really great experience, One of the best things we did while on the island.

review_title: A highlight of our stay on Kauai
review_text: We had a wonderful morning flight, saw the entire perimeter of the island, and learned a lot from JT (our pilot) about the island and its features. A beautiful way to see the Na Pali coast, especially if the sea is too rough for the boats to visit (which was the case during our trip).
Great tour. This company really takes care of their customers and goes above and beyond to make sure you have a great experience. I liked it so much i wanted to go a second time

review_title: Superb team and a once-ina-lifetime experience
review_text: From the emails and chats with Trish, to the outstanding skills and charm of Kevin: this is a great and highly recommended experience!
Flight was great for the most part. Because of the side of the plane I was on I was not able to see the waterfalls let alone photograph them.

On our recent rip to Kauai we had the pleasure of taking a trip over the island with Air Ventures Hawaii. Our pilot Makoa was friendly, professional and knowledgable about the island. A great experience and time well spent!

Ray and Jill who own this company are absolutely wonderful people and it was a great time touring the beautiful island.  My wife did not do so well and as soon as Ray landed the plane, Jill came out and gave excellent care to my wife !!!

Weather didn’t permit us to get at all close to the waterfall we wanted to see but the flight was cool and seeing whales from above was neat. We enjoyed getting to see the Island from above and it was well worth the money!
Our Pilot JT was amazing and I had so much fun. Had amazing views. A definite must for everyone to check out!

Six hours of sights and sound of Kaua'i by airplane, boat, and van. By van, viewed the north and central shores of the island with a variety of beach, restaurant, and cultural information (included a stop for lunch). By boat, traveled up the Wailua River for a quick visit to Fern Grotto. By plane, saw the entire island including whales in the ocean.

Our honeymoon trip was in Kauai.  Of all the attractions, events, and adventures we did - this plane tour was the BEST one of all.  Had a great time on our Private Kauai Airplane Tour.  The guide was fabulous!  This is a MUST event for all newlyweds, and other couples wanting a memorable view (with lots of photos) of Kauai.

review_title: Best money I spent on Kuaui
review_text: What a wonderful event.  The sights were simply stunning.  The view from the air is completely different from the ground views, and so much better.  We felt safe and secure throughout.  Our pilot was friendly and informative.
Great way to discover the island or see it from an other angle. Smooth take off and landing. Plane is not the youngest, but ok
My teens loved this adventure!   Enough said, teens are hard to please.   It was awesome.  Staff was awesome.   Absolutely beautiful.  We did this as part of the Best of Kauai tour.
The views from the plane were stunning. No bad seat on the plane and the pilot provided wonderful information about the Island during the ride
This flight around Kaua'i was spectacular. The pilot was knowledgeable, safe, and made sure both sides of the aircraft attendees saw all of the views. I would reccommend this aerial tour.

Kevin is amazing. He is instrument trained btw. If you don’t know what I am talking about don’t worry about it, just know you’re in good hands. Wife described the flight as a spiritual experience :) Will do it again.
It was truly amazing experience and safe !! JT took time to explain everything and both side of the helicopter seat was covered 100%

Na Pali coast was a main target for me to see in this trip. However, with an infant, it was hard to take a boat or hike. Thus, the air was the safest and best option. I tried the air ventures and it was simply awesome. It made my day even more amazing. Imagine exiting a rainbow and entering another one. Doesn't make since right? You need to try this trip so you understand what I mean. The staff and the pilot were so great. They offer using my Gopro on the wing of the airplane and video tape all the beauty of this amazing trip.

We took the Biplane ride and the experience was just unbelievable. The views are breathtaking and the ride pretty much covers everything you need to see in Kauai. Also, the staff are very nice and helpful, which made our experience even more memorable.

Our pilot was very knowledgeable regarding the island and it was an exceptionally smooth
ride. We are recommending it to family and friends.
This was an excellent tour. Everything from the reservation to the flight was first class. Our awesome pilot,Eric,was very friendly and knowledgeable about the island and it’s history
This was a fantastic adventure! JT was awesome, he was informative and entertaining. The views were breathtaking and I felt very safe, affordable too. We'll be back for this adventure again!

Absolutely fantastic the view of Kauai from the air as amazing. Our pilot was super narrative, super accommodating treated us with utmost respect. Quite commical as well. I will recommend it highly  o my friends and relativ s.

I decided to book an airplane trip rather than a helicopter trip purely on price. And, I wasn't disappointed
JT, our pilot, didn't look old enough to fly a plane, but he was brilliant. He kept everyone calm and was full of facts and figures. I particularly liked the visits over the Jurassic Park filming sites.
Choosing Air Ventures was frugal, but I did not feel that I had missed out on a helicopter flight.

Got an awesome overview of the whole island, the pilot was very communicative and eased my mild flight anxiety. :) The scenery was like no other, just like the service! Felt like we were on a road trip with a friend, only in an airplane.

Our Pilot was very nice and knowledgeable also knows how to fly aircraft real smoothly. Our Friend's Brother came and took this tour and really liked it so he suggested us to take this tour and yes we did and glad that we did. We will sure suggest to our family and friends to take this tour when they are coming there. Have a lots of Business and nice holidays.

If you want to a plane tour of one of the islands Kauai is your best bet. Air Ventures give you a sweet deal compared to the helicopter tours and they cover pretty much all of the island. You see the Napali coast, the Jurassic Falls, Waipo Falls, Waimea Canyon and most of the light blue shore. Shout out to JT who makes sure that everyone gets the best views and he will share some pretty interesting trivia about the island and the landmarks. Check in, Check out was a breeze. I would definitely recommend you do a tour with Air Ventures.
It was a beautiful way to see Kauai!  Our pilot was quiet but the views spectacular!  I appreciated that everyone had a window seat and the plane was turned so both sides saw each view.

We flew with Air Ventures late in November.  The scenery was breathtaking. Seeing the island by plane gave us a great view of the canyon, the beaches and many areas we were unable to explore by car.  The pilot was very knowledgeable.

Kevin was our pilot and a wealth of knowledge about the different areas of Kauai. We enjoyed learning some history and seeing some beautiful sites during the trip.  We had a great time!!!  Thank you!!

I called can booked through the phone, I talked to the actual pilot. He answered all my question. We took the private cesna tour. the plane had plenty of room, ac and water on board. we had noise cancelling headphones. the flight was great. there was a few bumpy spot but he fly us enough in to get the important looks and fly out to a more smooth ride. I did get sick but I get easily motion sickness. the provide many cold rags and bags for this situation. I still had an over all great experience.  Even thought I dont plan to go again  I would recommend this to anyone. when we landed they had ginger ale waiting for me. I was even able to attach my gopro to the outside of the plane.

Kevin piloted us over the entire Island--explaining everything as he flew.   He was very knowledgeable, and gracious to all in the plane.  It was a pleasure and very pleasant flight...I would highly recommend this company to anyone who wants to fly over the Island.   You will leave with a wonderful understanding of the island.

Such a neat flying experience in a biplane with an open cockpit.  There's just enough room for two people up front and the pilot sits behind in a separate compartment  You even get to an old timey helmet and goggles.  Flight time in the air was exactly an hour.  Our pilot, Kevin, gave us a little history of the plane that we rode in and the sights of the island.  Waimea Canyon, Na Pali coast, Hanalei Bay, and Wailua Falls are all part of the tour.  You can pay them an additional $25 to have your GoPro mounted to the wing.

I was seated behind the pilot on left side of plane, everyone else on r side of plane, except couple who had both r & left, so majority time the guy was next to wife on r side so he could see. Other than for 4-5x where pilot circled plane so I could see what he was talking about, I couldn't see sights that were on the right side of plane. When we were flying over Napali coast all I could see was the ocean, no coastline.

We have taken helicopter tours in other places, loved it, and when we saw this biplane we thought it would be better. Glad we did it, but we will be going back to the helicopters in the future. This is great for average to smaller size people.
Pilot was great, plane was shiny and new, service and booking experience was excellent. We thought the pictures would be better since there is no window, but the wing is in almost every shot. Also, my husband is a big, broad shouldered man (size XXL shirt) and we technically fit, but definitely not comfortably. 
Again, the plane and service was excellent, we have no complaints. Just not our “size”
Very much  enjoyed our fly overbi Kauai.  Justin was very informative and it was a relaxing adventure.
Great experience from take off to landing. JT showed us everything making sure both sides of the plane saw it all. Landed that little plane like a butterfly on a flower.

We did the bi plane flight with Kevin and it was so wonderful.  The sights and the experience were terrific.  Cannot say how much we enjoyed learning more about the island from Kevin.  And seeing such amazing things.  Flew through a rainbow!

AMAZING from start to finish!  A huge thank you to Rich and Ray and our pilot!  What a wonderful, once in a lifetime experience for Bob and I.  From the time we walked through the door until the time we left there was nothing but kindness.  All employees were upbeat and friendly, answering a "zillion" questions I had.  We bought the video from the flight which also contained 820 photos....WOW! Invest in it if you take a flight with them, well worth it and excellent quality.  Mahalo to all at Air Ventures Hawaii!  Joanne & Bob Brady
Pilot was excellent, very informative, smooth ride and landing. Had a great time with our friends. Well worth it.

review_title: P-E-R-F-E-C-T / Absolute must-do when in Kauai
review_text: We took a ride today with the biplane and it was just fantastic! Brand new airplane (2017), excellent Pilot and great company! I am a Pilot myself so I pre-checked everything before booking and I tell you all: absolut trustworthy, professional and worth each Dollar! The Ride was really fun, learned lots about the island and it’s just awesome to see this beautiful island from above...so my final statement: don’t think about, just do it :-)

Had a great time on the private biplane tour with pilot Kevin, who filled us in on the highlights of the island. The Waco biplane is great - highly prefer vs. helicopters and larger group flights. Jill at front desk was super helpful and friendly. Bring a camera!

I went wild doing all the things that I always wanted to do since I was a teenager as that is when I first saw the island of Kauai on the Discovery channel. So I went on all the basic must do's- the catamaran in Poipu,  the tubing, a classic luau, Atv'ing plus off roading in the jeep I rented. Visited Waimea  Canyon, drove the island, went to the best voted Poke and fish taco spots etc.

 THIS SCENIC AIR TOUR WAS THE HIGHLIGHT OF MY TRIP!  I LOVED IT.  JT was the pilot as was from Ohio so he was still fresh and upbeat.  JT did an excellent job with his knowledge of the island and his smooth flying.  There was very little turbulence as I was personally nervous there would be.  The views literally can take your breath away. They did for me.  

Things to note: Getting to the small airport proved to be trickier than I anticipated.  Google maps glitches out; apparently this is common on the island.  Jill was a trooper listening to my stressed out self trying to just make it in time.  I drove down from the north shore and first  I called the wrong airline first which said the trip was cancelled due to weather.  Jill was so calm and kind.  They held the plane for me.  ALL  they wanted to do was to enhance the experience of Kauai  Their combined service was EXCELLENT!!!   Kauai is already a magical place to visit but the scenic air tour of Kauai was icing on the cake for me.  Highly recommend the trip and Air Ventures Hawaii!
The pilot was very knowledgeable of the plane and the island. One of the best air tours I’ve taken. We were able to wear tanks and shorts in the plane. Great experience.
Unbelievable, jaw-dropping, magnificent island of Kauai from our 6-passenger plane!  An experience of a lifetime; one off our bucket list! Everybody should do this!
Es war super und ist empfehlenswert!! Wir sind mit JT geflogen, er macht absolut einen tollen Job! Die gesamte Organisation war unkompliziert und es hat alles ohne Probleme funktioniert.

Seeing the island of Kauai from a small plane was the ultimate experience. The views are extraordinary.  We flew over the canyon and were able to see the majesty of it. We saw waterfalls, and water caves and areas you cant reach by vehicles. We flew along the coastline and the colors and clarity of the ocean waters were absolutely amazing. Air Ventures planes are comfortable with windows all around so you don't miss anything. Our pilot, Makoa was fantastic. He gave us a smooth flight and lots of information regarding the island. Loved it!

review_title: Excellent tour with view of Grand Canyon
review_text: Enjoyed the entire package of guided tour and ride over Grand Canyon. Lots of different angles and explaining of waterfalls

Our "air adventure" was nothing short of spectacular. Unfortunately, our original flight had to be rescheduled due to weather, but we were so glad it was. The company set up an early flight the following day with JT as our pilot. Our flight was smooth and the views were incredible. JT was very knowledgeable about the culture of Kauai and shared all kinds of knowledge during the flight. This was our first time to Kauai and this trip made our vacation unforgettable. We highly recommend Air Ventures. We would definitely do this again.

review_title: Magnificent Vintage Bi-Plane flight over Kaua’i
review_text:
We had a great experience from our welcoming arrival.  The pilot and on ground team had an unhurried, considered approach in preparing us for the flight. 
 
Kevin, our pilot, provided informative, friendly commentary with just the right amount of detail and space to enjoy the panoramas & full experience of flying in this beautiful bi-plane!
 
The cockpit was cosy but comfortable.  The communication system was professional and the small touches such as the provision of Bose earphones & camera pouches ensured that it was a great experience. 
 
The actual flight, including take-off and landing, was incredibly smooth and covered the entire island with magnificent views of the canyon, waterfalls and coast.
 
We highly recommend this experience and company for anyone who enjoys being in the air and seeing aerial views of Kauai. 
 
Alexis & Ange

review_title: Helicopter ride would have been better
review_text: We saw lots of helicopters way down below us in the valleys and near the waterfalls. I hear doors off helicopter ride is the best.
Pilot very experienced..felt safe at all times. He had good stories and was well informed on the area.

review_title: Awesome way to travel on Kauai!
review_text: Awesome excursion,  loved the fixed wing plane ride, very smooth and very comfortable.  Prefer this excursion over the helicopter tours.

The flight was spectacular, we would do it all over again! You see so many amazing places, that are not necessarily accessible any other way. Our pilot was knowledgeable,funny and thoughtful.you will not regret flying with Air Adventures!
While others took the helicopter rides, I decided to take a plane ride.  I was able to see all the sites promised.  Breath taking views. I felt safe and very comfortable.

These guys provided a great service as well as an amazing flight. Picked us up and drove us back to the ship via a scenic route so we could see more. The flight was amazing and everyone on board had good views from the windows. Highly recommend it, it was an unforgettable experience!

I knew without a doubt that I wanted to take an airplane tour over the island.  We selected Air Ventura after reading reviews.  Found a great coupon on a discount Hawaii website.  
They ask you to arrive  30 minutes prior to departure.  When we made the reservation they asked our weights, then weighed us and any baggage we were carrying upon arrival.  So, don’t lie.  
We were walked out to he plane with a couple who was on our flight. We all took some photos with the pilot and plane. We were then given assigned seats.  Don’t assume that you will be sitting with your party.  I’m assuming they are managing a combination of weight disruption and how comfortable they think people will be in different seats.  There is a co pilot space - which is great for someone older or who has mobility issues.  The next two seats are probably the most squished.  The third row is just one seat. There is a little aisle room to stretch your left leg out. There are two seats in the back. It is a very tight squeeze height wise getting in.  I am not a small person and I fit okay in the sets and was able to buckle without problems.  
They provide a cooler full of water and also cold, wet towels.  Although they try to keep the cabin cool I was definitely a little warm
by the end.  That combined with the banking turns and a few bumps had me
not feeling 100%.  The cool towel on the back of my neck had me feeling better right away.  
Our pilot, TJ, was knowledgeable and personable.  He kept us well informed of the flying conditions we would have as well as what we were seeing.  I like how he doubled back several times to get us some great views.   
The scenery is so varied on the island.  I could have done with a little less of the towns and a few minute shorter flight, but it was fantastic.  I enjoyed flying over the coffee plantation at Kauai Coffee.  Nepali Coast was gorgeous.  The canyons were incredible.  Hands down though, the highlight for me was the Cathedrals.  They were stunning.   
Well run operation. Very clean planes.  You can tell they take a lot of pride in their fleet.  
There are lots of beautiful parts of the island you’ll never see if you don’t do it by air.  Would definitely recommend Air Ventures.  And, don’t forget to tip your pilot!

Kevin Britt, the owner pilot of Air Ventures Hawaii gives a wonderful tour. His 30+ years of experience flying on the island were apparent as he described the beaches and communities on the island. I highly recommend booking when the sky is cloudy to capture the waterfalls at peak flow!

Macht das!!! Wir haben zwar keinen Hubschrauberflug zum Vergleich gemacht, aber der Flug in dem Doppeldecker war ein ganz besonderes Erlebnis. Man hat eine super Aussicht auf die ganze Insel (ohne Fenster) und bekommt tolle Erklärungen vom Piloten, was man so sieht. Die Eindrücke sind atemberaubend! Das Team ist super freundlich und bemüht. Man merkt, dass ihnen die Arbeit Spaß macht! Da wir auf unseren Flitterwochen sind, haben wir auch gleich ein Geschenk bekommen!

Unbedingte Empfehlung!!!

review_title: Another great way to see Napali Coast!
review_text: This was another great way to see Napali and the Island of Kauai.  It was a pretty smooth ride and we really enjoyed the time in the sky.  The window view were amazing for every seat onboard and we even bought the dvd available at the counter just to make sure we got it all...  Thanks for a safe and enjoyable flight.  Its barely warm in the plane so dress light...

Our flight in "Snoopy" was very good. Kevin is a good pilot, gave us great views of Kauai and was very informative. He positioned the plane so our GoPro would capture good video. Will return next year.

Thanks, JT, for a wonderful tour of the beautiful island of Kauai.  Our only regret was that we did it on the last day instead of the first!  We could have saved ourselves a lot of trouble hunting for good snorkel spots!  We felt that this excursion was money well spent and would recommend it to anyone.

review_title: An Experience of a Life Time
review_text: This is the greatest air ride you can take.  Open cockpit up front good for twoo people (very cozy).  T-shirst and shorts is fine, it is not cold at all.  A one hour narated round trip around and over the island.  See places you cannot see drving your car.  We have done helicopter rides in the past too, but his one is amazing. Truly outstanding airplane ride on one of the loveliest places on earth.  I'm a long-time pilot but somehow never managed to ride in a bi-plane, so it was a dream come true for me to finally get to ride in one  (now if only I could have flown it too! ;)  

There are lots of ways you can see Kauai by air.  None are cheap. But every other method has you watching out a window like it's TV screen.  Take this trip and you directly experience the island with all your senses, you're not just a passive viewer.

Our pilot Kevin has been doing this a long time and clearly loves his job.  With so many movies filmed here and so few pilots over the years available, Kevin has had a lot of fun experiences working with film crews and actors over the years and has plenty of fun stories to tell during the flight, in addition to the standard descriptions of the sights,

If you are wondering how safe the trip is, then as a pilot I can tell you that you are in very good hands with this outfit.  The plane is obviously extremely well cared for (and loved!) and in excellent condition, the pilot is very safety-conscious, and he isn't a show-off that puts you in danger.  This is a solid operator that knows how to do it right, you are in good hands here.   

And if you worry about the open-cockpit aspect: you'll have a cloth helmet and goggles, and you are actually not really in the airstream unless you go out of your way to get into it while peering over the side to something down below.  With the wing above you for shade, no worries about getting too much sun, and the air is not cold.  It's actually a really pleasant experience in the open cockpit that you will really like!

Bottom line: truly unique experience for one or two passengers, from a very safe outfit who knows what they are doing.  There simply isn't a better flying experience on the island.

review_title: How to Experience Kauai via Air
review_text:
When you pick an aerial solution to fly over Kauai, you have basically two choices - helicopters or fixed wing aircraft.

Air ventures represents the best solution on Kauai for the fixed wing option.  

We chose to take the 8:30 AM tour, on our first day after we arrived on Kauai.  While it would seem somewhat early in the AM to rally the troops after getting to the island, the 8:30 AM flight worked well, from the time adjustment perspective.  Winds in the early AM are somewhat calmer, and temperatures cooler than later flights.

We were able to grab a light breakfast prior to heading to the airport @ 8AM for our flight. 

This aerial solution offers a great overview perspective of Kauai from a 1000-3000 ft perspective, permitting great photographs, a more stable platform, with more visibility for each person, with oversized window seats, at a reasonable price structure.

Everyone has a full window seat in an “air van” like setting, with noise cancelling headphones to communicate with the others, or the pilot. We chose the 6 passenger option, however, smaller two - three seat aircraft options are available.

Make no mistake, we saw a lot of helicopters flying at lower altitudes, however, the fixed wing perspective offers fuller vistas, and covers similar territory over a longer flight experience.  For our group, this worked best...as weight restrictions are more lenient in a fixed wing aircraft, and air sickness concerns were a consideration in our choice.

We saw a lot of the island from Napali Coast, many of the interior canyons; the vibrant blues of the ocean, sea turtles, and dolphins; several waterfalls, Hanalei and Princeville areas.  From our group, this provided the overall perspective and island layout we were looking for.  

By going with Air Ventures, we saved several hundred dollars from a comparable flight alternative via helicopter.

We highly recommend this alternative to see Kauai by air.  This was our second tour with Air Ventures Hawaii.

Pilot, Erik, was very knowledgeable, professional, experienced in a relaxing manner that permitted  the others he travelled with to also feel more comfortable.

We had a limited amount of time to visit Kauai due to the cruise ship itinerary so decided to take this bi-plane adventure and glad we did. Jill picked us up and delivered us after the flight; she was very welcoming; weather cooperated. Our pilot delivered and surprisingly the bi-plane is only two years old. A warning to avid photo buffs with cellphone camera - try to anchor your cellphone to your body - during an overview of a waterfall my cellphone accidentally went a couple of inches outside the cockpit and was whisked away in the slipstream. A bit of a downer particularly when Jill indicated that the pilot had an accessory we could have used to avoid this.

We did a helicopter tour and then the Bi-Plane... both great but totally different experiences and totally worth it. The views and perspectives (not to mention the lazy speed of the aircraft) gave us a once in a lifetime experience. 
Our pilot Ray was great and helped us have the total experience; the barrel roles and cork-screw were the best ( just kidding but I could imagine them!).
Safe, warm (heated cockpit) and totally smooth and relaxing..just do it, you won't regret it!

review_title: Beautiful Island, Beautiful Airplane, Great Tour!
review_text:
As a pilot, I heard about Air Ventures from another pilot friend and made my plan based on that recommendation.  This was definitely the way to go. Call them direct and make the reservation vs. the web site.  You can get all the details and work out the best time and expected best local conditions (there is always some kind of cloud activity on every island's mountains).
They offer several ways to tour the island but there was no doubt I wanted to go in the Cessna 182 (they may call it luxury tour but for a few bucks extra you get the plane to yourselves and can get personal with your pilot).  I own my own plane and have been flying for 30 years, but this was the nicest Cessna 182 I have ever been in.  Fully equipped with G1000s, Bose noise cancelling A20 headsets(the best there are), and even an air-conditioner.  My pilot was Eric Johnson, a CFI with 8000 hours of flight time.  Really fun guy and exceptional pilot.  I knew right from the start I had picked the right company, plane, & pilot.
We circled the island as well as flew up thru the mountain passes enjoying the scenery and waterfalls. Way better than in a helicopter or the C208 caravan.
My wife is used to flying with me, but Eric went out of his way to make sure she was comfortable and enjoying the view.  I've flown with lots of pilots and CFIs over the years and it is a rare breed that can be fun, informative, highly competent, and safe at all times. 
All in all a really fun and informative flight experience I would recommend to all.
This was a last minute add to our trip and will be the highlight.  Pilot.  Plane.  Seeing all the sites.  Beaches.  Waterfalls. Napoli coast.   Perfect.
Excellent flight in reasonable weather conditions, Ray chose great views and is a very knowledgeable and experienced pilot, great tour commentary

review_title: Grossartige Aussichten aber nichts für schwache Mägen
review_text: Unser Pilot war freundlich und wusste sehr viel über die Insel Kauai und deren Sehenswürdigkeiten. Obwohl das Wetter eigentlich gut war und die Sonne schien, gab es doch erhebliche Turbolenzen, so dass es einigen von uns bereits nach kurzer Zeit nicht so gut ging. Generell fühlten ich mich aber sicher an board und es gab auch spektakuläre Fotos von der Insel und der Napali Coast. Nach einer Stunde landeten wir sicher wieder in Lihue.

review_title: Just amazing, we ran out of words
review_text: I cannot recommend Air Ventures highly enough. We had such a great experience with their biplane tour of the island. Every staff member we interacted with was great, friendly and helpful. Our pilot Eric was excellent; both with the flying and with his commentary on the island and all its features. It's such a great way to experience Kauai and see all the amazing landscapes, we seriously ran out of superlative words about 10mins in.
From check in to flight everything was good.  JT was a very good and informational pilot. Was the first time flying over Kauai in a small plane
My mother and I went on a girls trip this summer and my mom surprised me with a biplane ride. Words can’t describe how incredible this ride was. The view in a amazing!

I can't even express into words to explain how amazing this flight was! Open air bi-plane flying over Jurassic Park sites in a rainstorm was so fantastic, I stopped taking pictures because they cannot convey the enormous rush we got from this trip. So glad we did it. A little scared at takeoff, but decided if it was it time this was the way to go!  Still can't stop smiling! Our pilot  Harry was so chill and handled some serious downpours and headwinds expertly. Because of the rain there were twice as many waterfalls. I highly recommend this adventure!!!

review_title: Flying over the island of Kauai
review_text: This is a perfect way to see the island - from Waimea Canyon to the Napili Coast.  The 6 seater plane offered each of the passengers a window seat with full viewing, and the pilot (J.T.) turned the plane so both sides had equal sharing time of the impressive sites.  Read many reviews on helicopter rides and I believe this little plane gives them a run for their money (but doesn't charge as much).  Well worth the trip !!!! Viewing was amazing ! J.T. was awesome for our pilot (very knowledgeable and sings his pilot lingo a little), but the whole crew was fabulous !!!
We absolutely loved our tour of the island of Kauai with Air Ventures Hawaii.  Our pilot was very informative as we flew over the island.

review_title: Incredible service, even for the nervous and quiet groups
review_text: The staff were absolutely lovely from the minute we stepped into their business. They made us feel comfortable and well looked after, even during the small wait for our plane to be ready to fly. JT was an incredible tour guide, making us laugh frequently and providing some insider information to the beautiful area.
