He picked up that we weren't big talkers and were thoroughly taken by the sights around us, and didn't press for conversation but was happy to continue providing his own insightful conversation. We really appreciated this kindness, and would be happy to travel with him and the entire company again.

review_title: Breathtaking Views, wish I didn’t get motion sickness
review_text:
There are 2 companies side by side that offer this, we went with Air Adventures do to availability (the other co I found first but they were booked .. this co was rated exactly the same ).  The check in was easy and the people were very nice and personable .  Our pilot Eric was very nice, funny, and knowledgeable . He gave a history of certain areas of the island we flew over and kept asking if everyone was ok (especially me) . We hit a bit of turbulence soon after take-off but that stopped after a minute or so and then it was fairly smoothe going .  We were thinking of doing the helicopter tour originally but I read that you would feel more movement and that costs close to $600 for 2 people  While they may get closer to some areas the small plane we took a smoother ride and you got to see everything and it was $270 fir bothering of us plus every person gets a window seat . In the helicopter .. if you sit in the middle .. you can’t see. 
Now the bad.... nothing to do with Air Adventures... about 10 minutes into the flight I had severe motion  sickness . I took a Dramamine before the flight but it didn’t help . I don’t get sick on regular planes , I guess this one was different.  The lady next to me was a nurse and she kept putting cold towels (which they provide) on my neck and legs.  The views were stunning and I managed to take a lot  of pictures regardless. My husband sat on the co-
Pilot seat up front , I sat behind the pilot .  Finally when we landed the person at the front desk gave me ginger ale to drink. I will say it took a few days to get feeling back
To
Normal . I highly recommend this tour and company , but if you get motion sickness, take precaution.

We booked a private plane excursion prior to our trip. The communication was spot on, the plane 
was brand new, and everyone was amazing! 
Our pilot Makoa was awesome! He was friendly & wanted to make sure our experience was perfect!
We couldn’t ask for a better excursion!

Wonderful experience to see so many places we have visited from a new perspective!  The ride was smooth and Makoa, our pilot was friendly and kept us well informed.  We really enjoyed our time in the air!

Great adventure flight on biplane.  Kevin was great pilot, with good flight, interesting history and stories of Kauai, smooth flight and perfect landing.  Biplane flight is better than helicopter flight.

review_title: Over the top determination to make us happy!
review_text: We arrived on Kauai for a rainy week.  Our flight was cancelled and rescheduled the next day.  Cancelled again and set up for the next day. It was still iffy, but we went up and by the time we got up the clouds had descended again so the Napali Coast was out and Waimea Canyon was completely blocked off. Makoa, our pilot radioed for special permission to take us places they don't usually go so we could get a good experience.  It was clearer up north (until another storm rolled in) but again, the effort to give us the best that could be had was impressive and much appreciated. I would definitely recommend Air Ventures as a company that goes (literally) above and beyond!!  Next time we are doing the Biplane!! Thanks for being to thoughtful and dedicated .

We booked with Air Ventures after being unable to fly the previous day due to weather.  The representatives at the counter were forthright and seemed to take great pride in making the trip as great for the customer as possible.  We went up in the AirVan with Eric as our pilot.  He was knowledgeable about the island and imbued the tour with plenty of humour.  My wife tends to get motion sickness and despite the near perfect conditions we had, she started feeling a little queasy.  Eric was excellent at handling the situation.  He had cool towels passed up to her to put on her neck and made sure she ate the ginger chews that the ground crew had provided.  
The scenery was spectacular and in particular the Napali coast and the gorge.  Eric was very good about circling around to make sure that everyone on both sides of the plane got a good view of all the important sites even the large pod of dolphins we saw off the coast.  
I would definitely highly recommend take a tour with Air Ventures.

Had a fantastic flight with JT. The whole hour was great. The view from the plane windows were awesome. My husband and myself thoroughly enjoyed this experience. Highly recommended. Many thanks AirAdventures
I had a wonderful flight with Eric and some other travellers. It was cloudy in spots but that just added to the excitement of the flight. I would highly recommend flying with Air Adventures Hawaii

Ray and Jill did a wonderful job of calming our nerves as soon as we got there. They showed the best customer service to everyone who walk thru the door. Eric was our pilot and he was superb! We got a tour of the entire island and was fortunate enough to see a momma and baby whale!! I highly recommend this company and tour!
It was an amazing experience. Highly recommended for everyone. The staffs were very nice and the pilot was great ( Eric). He gave us great information and lots of fun on the trip.

My husband and I decided to take this tour as part of our bucket list of things to do! It was spectacular! The staff was courteous and very helpful! Our tour guide, Kevin was outstanding. If my husband and I make it back to Kauai, we will be skipping all the other tours and come back here for another biplane ride. The view was breathtaking and the weather was perfect! They will even mount their GoPro camera and film your ride for a nominal fee. This plane ride made our trip to the islands very special,

We really enjoyed the Air Ventures Aerial tour of Kauai.  The pilot was very knowledgeable with regard not only to geography, but also island history.  He made sure that both sides of the plane got a good view of key sites.  I cannot even began to count how many waterfalls we saw.   The Waimea Canyon and the Na Pali coast were beautiful from the air.

With lots of helicopters rides in the area this plane ride is something a bit different. 
Awesome family ran company.
Our pilot Makaua (apologies if spelt incorrectly) was amazing so enthusiastic.
Thank you for a great afternoon it made our day

Had the perfect time with our Pilot/Guide! Made us feel safe and welcome. The tour is essential if you want a good idea of what the total island looks like and where you would like to visit. Would highly recommend! I even attached my gopro on the side wing strut for amazing video!

We had a fantastic experience and we highly recommend this tour. Friendly staff. We were a bit early and could start the tour earlier also. It was safe and beatiful to see the island from above. Easy communication, everyone got a good view. One of our most beautiful experiences at Hawaii! Thanks Airventures!
Our guide was awesome and his background music was the cherry on top of a perfect trip.  The ride was super smooth and comfortable.  Great day!
They were good. We seen a lot. The pilot was very knowledgeable.  Very nice. The people on the ground were very helpful and knowledgeable
We had a great time flying over Kauai and seeing the beautiful scenery.   Also, the entire staff is super friendly!

review_title: Best way to see Kauai Island
review_text: After we took off we flew over Waimea Canyon and Mount Waialeale to enjoy the sights of towering waterfalls and lush valleys. Then we enjoyed the many views of the spectacular Na Pali Coast. This is the best way to see Kauai Island and I would do this again

Harry was the best! The staff were warm and friendly. I felt safe and my daughter was able to do her first flight lesson with Harry. I also flew on the biplane in Oct for my 50th bday and was an experience of a lifetime. I highly recommend Air Ventures and it wasn’t as expensive as most other activities are on the islands so it was worth every penny!!

This plane ride/sightseeing tour of Kauai was impressive.. We saw the entire island and from a very comfortable altitude.  Harry (our pilot) knows the island well.  He answered every question we ask.  Beautiful new Waco with “Jak” radial engine, great Bose headsets and intercom so we could talk easily.  Happy, friendly staff and an exceptionally well run flight operation.  Better than a helicopter and probably less costly.  
As the Nike slogan says, “JUST DO IT!”  You won’t regret it

This was a jaw dropping experience.  I debated doing a plane ride vs a helicopter, then once I decided on a plane ride there were a lot of companies to choose from.  After reading too many horror stories of people stuck in the middle of a helicopter with no clear view, I chose the plane.  Then after reading many strong and positive reviews about Air Ventures, I booked with them.  I chose well!  One of the things that sold me on this company was that there are no middle seats, so everyone gets a window.
The flight did travel in a clockwise direction, so seats on the right hand side were preferable.  The pilot did circle around at some sites so that everyone could get a  clear view, but there was a definite advantage to being on the right hand side of the plane.
The pilot gave great commentary and let us know what sites we were flying over, and he was happy to answer any questions that we had.
The planes can't get as close to some of the sites as a helicopter (such as Jurassic Falls), but this was a non issue based on the amazing experience we had.
Overall, this was one of the highlights of my time on Kauai.  It was a really great way to see the island.  We were there on a clear day with smooth air, so it made it even better!

review_title: Awesome, it was our first airplane tour ever.
review_text:
The view was very beautiful and JT was our pilot. His narration helped us see and enjoy the view of the places we could not visit the day.
Just a suggestion, have a raised seat for seniors with knee issues.
Thank you Jill, she was very friendly and have us a ride to the airport.

We were originally planning to take a boat tour to view the Napali coast but were not permitted to take our 7 month old on the boat. Probably not the best idea anyways given the length of the boat tours. So last minute we booked a scenic flight and it was the best thing ever. We were able to see the entire Nepali coast, Wimea canyon and all the beaches. The plane buzzing put baby to sleep and our pilot successfully kept the plane smooth through the turbulence. 
Even my 70 year old mother who is afraid of heights and small aircraft enjoyed it. Great trip. Highly recommend. Half the cost of a boat tour and you see 5x more.
We had such a great time with Ray. He took us on a great flight in the small plane and he really made the most of the time and weather to give us an amazing experience. Definitely would do it again!

Really enjoyed our tour and the pilot was great and did a wonderful job,
Was  a great pleasure to meet the owner

First class operation, first class equipment, first class people.  I took this excursion not knowing what to expect.  I am hear to tell you I have done 2 helicopter tours and this by far beat them both.  Easy to see out of windows and a high wing made it very easy to see the vast differences in topography Kauai had to show.  I would highly recommend this trip over a helicopter.  5 Stars out of 5!!!

the flight was every thing that we thought it would be plus having Ray as our pilot was the icing on the cake his knowledge of the Island and all the spectacular sights made it a lot of fun to be in the air with him we would fly with this company again five stars

Amazing experience in kauai! Was worth every ar i’ve spent on it! My boyfriend and I appreciated the whole tour! Amazing views, great team with a nice pilote! Thanks JT for your time! I recomment it for everyone- it’s an experience of a lifetime!

Our pilot was great. Too bad I forgot
His name as we have been to so many attractions. Views were so beautiful and it is definitely worth it

Had been debating whether to take a plane or a helicopter for a tour , then saw the biplane option. We booked for the afternoon but ended up flying in the morning (pilot availability). Owner, staff and pilot where super friendly.
Flight was great - a full 60+ mins and saw all the land marks in glorious details. Thanks for the experience !!

We really enjoyed our air tour of Kauai last week with Air Ventures. Eric was an awesome pilot and guide.  He even let my husband fly the plane for a while. The scenery is spectacular and my favorite part of my Hawaii trip. I highly recommend this company for your air tour while visiting Kauai.

This was an outstanding outing and we were glad we did this on our first day (after a day of relaxation) — an aerial overview of all of Kauai. JT was our pilot pointing out all the features and attractions of Kauai such as Jurassic Park filming sites, waterfalls and the gorgeous Nepali Coast. He even spotted a couple of humpbacks breaching and flew out for a closer look. Breathtaking!! Tom, Jill and the other girl at the desk helped us plan this outing plus made our reservations for our catamaran and kayaking trips. Jill gave us lots of insider tips including where to get the best pineapple 😉. Definitely a great Aloha spirit at AirVentures!!!
Wow what a great trip to see everything from the sky , I must trip .... my wife is still talking about it and how smooth the flight was and enjoyable .. would love to do it again .

review_title: The best way to see and feel Kauai from the air.
review_text: My wife and I made a last minute decision to experience seeing Kauai from the open cockpit in a bi-plane. Something we've always wanted to do during our many trips to Kauai. Unfortunately, the weather never cooperated until last Saturday. We picked a beautiful day to fly - ceiling and visibility unlimited. To say we were extremely pleased with our experience is an understatement. We were overjoyed with our experience. We were treated like "friends" the minute we entered the terminal by Jill and Ray. Our pilot, Harry, was an absolute professional and dedicated himself to ensure we enjoyed our flight. We've enjoyed the helicopter flights over each of the Hawaiian islands we've visited previously but this bi-plane flight was by far the absolute best!!

I will definitely recommend to all my friends and readers here not to hesitate even for a second and book a flight with Air Ventures! 
All the team was extremely nice and professional especially Jill, one of the owners who also recommended us a nice restaurant after the flight! 
Thank you guys and continue to be so awesome !
Great experience in a very reasonable price. Flight was 70 minutes and we saw all the hot spots of Kauai. Highly recommend!!
This was a truly amazing experience. Eric not only was a great pilot, he was clearly passionate about his island, a great narrator, and thoughtful that each passenger had amazing views of Kauai.
Smooth ride, seen the whole island pilot was very knowledgeable and had alot of personality.  His name is Kevin.

Very courteous staff.  Easy to find location . Easy check in . excellent pilot very knowledgable about local sights. 
overall very good experience and good value for money too.

We had a fantastic trip with Air Ventures today in Kauai.   Tom at check in and Kevin our pilot made our afternoon spectacular !  Seeing Kauai from the air in a 3 seat Cessna was knowledgeable and the scenery was amazing!!  Kevin has 30 years experience and has lived in Kauai for over 20 years!

Highly recommend you take time out to enjoy this trip and see things you can’t see from the ground. 

Sue & Stan - Kelowna, B.C., Canada
I was in the right seat nex to the pilot TJ. The flight was smooth and comfortable.  What an amazing way to see the Island. This was my second time and I look forward to doing it again.

Small plane scenic tour on  the Hawaii Island of Kauai was one of the highlights of our cruise around the Islands in March 2019. It is definitely the way to see the many site seeing attractions and the  tour operators were both friendly, professional and extremely good value for money. Not to be missed,if you get the chance. Jerry & Gill.

My sons and I had a terrific time--this airplane ride is a must do!  The views of the coast and of several of the famous movie venues added to our understanding of Kauai.  I would definitely do this again.  My sons loved it too!
We had an awesome tour!! We loved our pilot Eric!! We spotted lots of whales. The pictures I took of the Napli coast are worth putting on our wall as at home.

review_title: Don’t miss this on your Hawaiian trip
review_text: If you are traveling to Hawaii, don't miss this amazing experience. I was lucky enough to fly with JT, who pointed out many interesting places across the entire island and was entertaining throughout the whole flight. He also had a very amusing music playlist and looped around many breathtaking locations so everyone in the plane had the same opportunity for an awesome picture. We were able to capture some beautiful pictures from around the island, including many spots that are either extremely difficult of impossible to reach without flying. Defiantly the highlight of my family's trip, I cannot recommend this experience enough!

We were celebrating our anniversary in Hawaii. Last day in Kauai we were able to book a Cessna flight with Ray. From meeting Jill at the pick up to having Ray pilot us, we could not have had a better experience!! The sights are majestic:) the Air Venture company: INCREDIBLE!! They went out of their way to make our trip outstanding.

We were hosting two exchange students from Europe, for a spring break trip. When the weather was not optimal, even though it was disappointing, they canceled our flight to wait for better weather. We were so glad they understood the conditions  and made this recommendation. We had a great flight with a very knowledgeable pilot. We were shown the amazing beauty of the island of Kauai safely and in total comfort. The pilot, J.T.was helpful, answering many questions, friendly and competent. I would do it again in a heartbeat!

Everybody does the helicopter tour. It's something you can do pretty much anywhere in the world.  This is so much more fun, and a pretty rare chance to experience the thrill of flying in an open cockpit plane. From putting on your flying cap and headphones, having the control tower declare  "Snoopy 2 clear for takeoff" till you touch back down this trip is just so cool.  Harry is a highly skilled pilot, the plane is incredible and the tour covers all the sites you get from "those other tours", but,  you are flying in an open cockpit biplane. I mean come on!!   A couple of things worth noting:  pretty much all of your photos will include parts of the plane, which if you take the time to frame your shots adds lots of interest; but a word of warning. If you are using an smartphone to take pictures you need to put it into a plastic pouch with a strap (which they supply).  Any shots you take where you are holding the phone outside the cockpit (in the wind) the plastic pouch shutters so badly every photo or video will have a very strange waviness, and be pretty badly out of focus.

We got so lucky to have Ray take us up in the Cessna. It was an amazing trip. He was so knowledgeable and made sure we saw everything we possibly could. I can say nothing but good things about them. As a travel agent I will send all of my clients there!

This was part of an all day Kauai tour. I had never been on a small airplane, so I was a little nervous at first. It ended up being a great adventure and I would recommend it for anyone who would like to see Kauai from a bird's eye view!

review_title: Hands down best way to see Kauai
review_text: JT was our captain for our air tour of Kauai.  Great host that gave us an amazing tour of the island.  We really preferred the plane over the previous helicopter tour of the island. Nice relaxed pace, great visibility to see all of the remote parts of Kauai and there are lots of them.  Would go again and highly recommend for families up to 6.  Great job! I cannot wait to go again.

Amazing flight! People who own this company are incredible - very friendly and highly experienced. Our pilot Ray did everything to leave us extremely satisfied and in great health condition.
This was the best flight I've ever taken and the price is really competitive comparing to other offers I found on the Internet. We were considering taking a raft and seeing the Napa Coast from the ocean, but luckily we have chosen this flight. We were able to see things that are only possible to see from the air. Don't hesitate to fly with AirVentures Hawaii

review_title: The best tour of my entire vacation!
review_text: I flew with Harry in the Waco biplane and had a great time!  He was a skilled pilot and got us into areas of the island we'd never see otherwise.  The plane is a blast to fly!

I had a very memorable flight with Ray on the stick and sights of a lifetime viewed out the window.  Both Jill & Ray were extremely friendly, informative and accommodating.  With Ray in control, I didn't feel at all apprehensive, which is something, as I was somewhat hesitant when we booked the flight, as I am not a great lover of small aircraft.  But all was well and the sights were fantastic and matched with Ray's abundant knowledge of both aircraft and the story & history of the sights as we flew over and next to them. Unfortunately, despite the best efforts of Jill beforehand, and Ray when in the air, the missus was a little airsick, which is not a surprise as she tends to be a sufferer of motion sickness in general; she'll be queasy just sitting in the back of a car.  I think she would've been even more affected in a chopper, so if you are a little on the queasy side, I suspect the small airplane would be better.

Harry the hairless pilot did a great job pointing out the best local attractions. We did our tour in the open cockpit biplane early in our visit and it was a great help deciding what else we wanted to visit during our stay. In my opinion, there is not a heliride on the island that would compare to this open cockpit experience.
Giv3 these folks a call right Now and book your tour. This is an amazing family owned company (the owner is a  formerly 747 captain) with true Aloha Spirit. Jill and her team rock!

review_title: A Once in a Lifetime Experience........
review_text: I cant say enough about this adventure. There is so much to be said for riding in an open cockpit with the wind in your face. Absolutely one of a kind views of the island. Harry was an excellent pilot in both ways of mastering the aircraft and also allowing us to experience our flight the way we wanted to.SO MUCH FUN. It was the high point of our trip to Kauai.The ground crew was wonderful too. An overall outstanding experience, if you are in Kauai do not pass this up. Thanks to all the staff and Harry!!!
Private pilot from Canada. Flew 182 with Harry,allowed me to do all the flying,great guide and experience.fhanks Harry

From start to finish our experience was excellent!
Our pilot, JT, was the best! Besides being an awesome pilot, he was also a superb tour guide with lots and lots of information about the island sites he was flying us over.  An absolutely wonderful introduction to Kauai - we highly recommend the plane tour to both newcomers and regulars alike!
We had a fabulous tour of Kauai with Air Ventures.  The views were amazing, the flight smooth, and the commentary from the pilot informative and fun.  Highly recommend this excursion.
JT did a great job explaining what we were seeing and answered questions.  Fun to see places from the air and get a different perspective of places we also experienced on land.

What a great experience the people were just wonderful Eric and Jill run a top notch program not to mention the Cessna 182 had all the bells and whistles very up to date I will be going again before the trip is over.

This flight was a thrill, only surpassed by the amazing vistas of the beautiful island of Kauai. Ray provided informative commentary on the geography, physical aspects, and culture of the island - Now we know Kauai is the oldest yet least developed island, still largely unexplored and accessible only as we did, by air. The total experience was truly a Great Fun Flight!
JT did an excellent job of narrating and showing us the island of Kauai. He showed us all the beautiful areas on the island.

This was by far one of the best experiences we have had on Kauai! J.T our pilot was wonderful, very pleasant, knowledgeable,  and accommodating for all of us on the plane. Definitely put this on your list of things to do when visiting Kauai.

Beautiful view of the entire Island!  Great way to see everything....including a Whale siting.
Eric, our pilot, was very informative and entertaining.
The tour is amazing. It is wonderful to view Kauai from the air. Pilot Eric is friendly. If your visit in Kauai is short, air tour is a recommendation.
Our piolt Eric was fun and let our oldest help fly the plane. Good views from every seat. I recommend this if you have the time in Kauai. Best way to see the island
Flight was amazing and beautiful. Our pilot was professional, courteous and informative. Wonderful time was had by us and friends

This team did a wonderful job! We were concerned about the timing of leaving our twin boys at our resort and still being able to make our 10am appointment but the staff offered to watch our children when my wife and I flew, well above and beyond the call of duty in my opinion. (we were able to leave the boys with the resort) Our pilot Harry did a great job showing us Kauai even though the weather wasn't perfect. He was knowledgeable, friendly and proficient. We had a great time.

review_title: Rub your eyes to make sure you're not dreaming
review_text: Excellent pilot and a lovely welcoming team of people to get you on the plane and greet you after the flight. They even give you a bottle of water after the flight! The pilot was so warm. As we flew, he told us different things about the island (as we flew over them) and we felt very safe. My boyfriend is a pilot himself so he asked if we could do some tricks in the air and he said yes!!! overall, it is worth every penny!

As part of our Best of Kauai tour we took a small and ride over Kauai. JT, our pilot, was fantastic.  Knowledgeable and a good pilot. We had such a marvelous flight and seeing Kauai from air was the best.
We had a wonderful plane ride with Pilot JT.  He was very friendly, knowledgeable and showed us a lot of great sights.  The ride took about an hour.  I was glad we went!
Took a spur of the moment flight over Kauai on my last day vvisiting the Hawaiin Islands. Beautiful flight great pilot curious attentive shuttle driver.  Highly recommend this company and excursion.
We were shown very interesting topography even though the tradewinds were blowing pretty hard. Pilot was very good.  I would use them again.
We had a great time on our plane ride! The views were breathtaking. The gals in the terminal we super nice, and our pilot JT was awesome! Definitely recommend!

review_title: Great tour of the island for a great price!
review_text: A fantastic way to see the island. Ray (our pilot) was very both funny and knowledgeable. A definite “must do” activity in this island!

For my husbands birthday we flew tandem in the 2017 Waco. We had great weather and saw the whole island. Even got our pilot to do a few wing overs and stalls. Gorgeous plane! I would recommend this to any flying enthusiast!

review_title: Great Day around the entire Island of Kauai.
review_text: Eric was our pilot.  He was great about explaining where we were at all times.  He took us around the entire island by air while flying into the center areas of the island to allow us to see more areas of the island.  My brother was the co pilot and Eric guided him in the air as he was allowed to handle the aircraft for a few minutes.  It was amazing!  my brother was shocked and thrilled by the experience.
Staff were very friendly. Harry, our pilot, was informative and answered all of our questions. Wonderful tour.

Frank & I enjoyed the air tour of Kauai with JT, our pilot. It was very easy to book online with AirVentures. All the staff were welcoming and available on our arrival. It was a first time event for me in a small plane. I loved it! It was a special experience to see the Na Pali Coast from the air and hear the narrative provided by JT of the history of the First People of the Hawaiian Islands to arrive on the coast of Kauai, the oldest inhabited of the Hawaiian Islands. I say AirVenture is the best way to see the Na Pali Coast.  Thank you.
We choose the private tour in the Cessna 182 and it was Amazing! Our Pilot Ray was the nicest guy that you could ever meet! Highly recommended!
We had a wonderful flight with pilot Harry and the Waco biplane. Smooth ride with great views and a great day in the air! Thanks to the whole team  , this is a do-over!

Would thoroughly recommend this tour of the island of Kauai. Our pilot J.T was excellent, very accommodating ensuring everyone in our party was able to see everything, the highlights were many, including breathtaking waterfalls, the Napali coastline, and 2 graceful and beautiful whales. J.T put everyone at their ease and the landing and take off were very smooth.

Our pilot "JT" (22 years old) was amazing.  Gave us a lot of facts on Kauai and shown us some gorgeous views of the beaches.  The canyon, waterfalls and we got to see a whale breaching and playing in the ocean!

Our pilot was so knowledgeable of the island.  He made sure we were all having a good time.  
It was an amazing flight- highly encourage
Ray was our pilot and did an outstanding job showing us the island, whales, key landmarks. I feel I saw everything there was to see on the island which made for a complete island vacation.

This was absolutely fantastic. Harry, our pilot was excellent. This is much better than the helicopter tour we did years ago. If it wasn’t for a friend of ours recommending this tour we wouldn’t have known about it. PLEASE advertise at the hotels. This was on my bucket list to fly in a biplane. The only way to really see the island. We flew through sun, wind and rain and it was perfect. Saw rainbows, waterfalls and areas you can’t get to by car. Highly, highly recommend. Thank you Harry and Air Ventures.

review_title: First Class Flight Tour of Kauai
review_text: How often do you get a chance to fly in an open cockpit biplane? Our pilot, Harry, was friendly and very experienced. The plane is quite new, and in great shape, the intercom system was Bose, with noise cancellation feature. Biplanes don't offer photo opportunities like other aerial platforms, but I got some good pics, and great memories. This is a very professional outfit. Harry treated us to some mild aerobatics with stalls and wingovers on request. The Napili Coast is beautiful. Our flight was 1 hour & less expensive than a helicopter ride.

We had a beautiful day for our island tour.  Eric was very capable and professional and gave us a great island tour from the air. Our landing was flawless, hardly knew we touched down.   Excellent experience.  Highly recommend.

Our BiPlane tour on Friday afternoon (2/22/19) was absolutely wonderful!  Our pilot Harry was great, an excellent pilot and very knowledgeable about the aircraft and the island of Kauai.  Our one hour flight was smooth, throughly enjoyable and will be one of the top memories of all of the activities we’ve done on our travels.  We were able to see more of Kauai than is possible on land and sea and when seen by the air you can really appreciate why Kauai is The Garden Isle.  Along with our pilot, the staff defined Aloha with their professionalism and friendliness.  My wife and I highly recommend AirVentures Hawaii!

What an adventure.  Beautiful view of the entire island.  One of the most memorable sights was three whales interacting with a pod of about 40 dolphins.  We have seen the Na Pali coast several times over the years from a boat, but although those were awesome views, they did not compare to seeing them from the air.  Cold water along with cold washcloths helped with some motion uneasiness.  Do this!

We took the air tour on Kauai and it was amazing. Everybody at Air Ventures was very nice. Ray, our pilot, has quite the background and knows pretty much everything about Kauai. Very personable and friendly. During the flight we always felt that we were in good hands. The things you will see are not what you will find by just driving around and Ray knew where all the great spots were. We were lucky and had some great weather so we were able to get some good pictures. I would highly recommend Air Ventures if your considering a plane tour of the island. These people were the best.
Thanks Ray and Jill for a great time we will never forget.

The flight was fantastic with truly amazing views of the island. Ray & Jill, the owners, could not have been better hosts. As Ray flew the airplane he explained what we were seeing and answered any questions we had. When the flight was over Jill gave us a ride back to the Marriott even though we had arranged a shuttle. Don’t miss this ride!

review_title: Can’t imagine a better way to see the island
review_text: Amazing experience. Friendly receptionist. Friendly engineer and ground support. Friendly and Fantastic Pilot. Thank you Eric for your hospitality, thoughtfulness, professionalism and humour. Keep up the good work!

Outstanding pilot (Ray) who was very skilled at handling the aircraft and extremely knowledgeable about the island.  He provided a continuous explanation of the sights as well as their backstory in a manner that was like chatting with a friend.  Each passenger is equipped with headset/microphone so can easily chat with the pilot and among each other.  Flight got us into canyons which are inaccessible by any other means, close to dozens of magnificent waterfalls, hidden beaches, and the spectacular Napali Coast, as well as a couple of whales.  Although we’ve been to Kauai several times, we saw much more of it then ever before and learned a great deal about it’s history and infrastructure.  Everyone at AirVentures was welcoming and friendly; we were treated as friends or family by everyone there.  Aircraft was comfortable & spacious.  Each seat was next to a large bubble window which made viewing and photography easy.  Couldn’t have asked for a better flight experience.
This is an amazing way to see all of Kauai, whales, Waimea Canyon, waterfalls, Napali Coast.  Our pilot did not disappoint!
Eric was an amazing pilot and guide. Great way to see a beautiful island. The pilots go all out for their guests.
Excellent time with staff and other riders. Piglet very informative and knowledgeable of area. Beautiful waterfalls and great foliage.

This trip was awesome and reasonably priced. The pilot was energetic and offered tons of information about the island (I am always impressed when people can maintain a high level of energy, even though they probably do the same exact tour every day). This was a great way to orient myself with the layout of the land on Kauai, and the views of Wiamea Canyon and the Napali coast were spectacular. The trip was just the right amount of time at around 60 minutes.

I would recommend Air Ventures Hawaii for your Kauai vacation.
What a ride! The view was amazing. I wish they have better headphones, it was loud and communication was scratchy. Overall very good experience.
We had a great experience. Flight was very smooth and the pilot gave us great information. Must do on kauai.

review_title: Awesome service and so friendly. Recommended !!
review_text: We had weather that postponed then cancelled our flight. But we were taken care of with pictures and friendly conversation and a tour of the operations. Plus a FULL refund..!! We loved it all even though we could not fly. You know we will be back ASAP. Enjoy, It is one the best of Kauai experiences... Aloha...
Re-shuttle after re-shuttle because of the 💨 but in the end it works and it was such a great ending of my vacation, mahalo Air Ventures Hawaii 🤙🏻.

we had the owner of company  for our pilot and him and his wife (the real person who runs the show lol)he laughed and joked with us and was also real knowledgeable  about the areas we were touring he said he loves to fly and told us his history which was fun in its self and our tour lasted longer than it was supposed to because he took time to answer our questions and show us neat things other company's just would not do  this couple that owns this business really cares for there customers and there employees  it was the highlight of our two week trip to the islands we told everyone we ran into to skip the helicopter ride for 300.00-400.00 and go on air ventures for half that it was just awsume  we will do it again our next time on the island for sure

review_title: This is a MUST DO on Kauai!
review_text: My husband and I were only on Kauai for a short time. Flying for a full hour over the entire island really gave us the bird’s eye view! Especially to areas of the island that are not reachable by land and even boat. Truly an incredible experience. Our pilot and guide, JT was so wonderful and considering it was a super windy & cold January day we felt lucky to be in his hands. He gave us a lot of island info and made sure every passenger got to see it all by circling back. We did get a touch of motion sickness near the end but luckily we avoided the aloha bags. Maholo 🌺
Had an awesome experience! Breathtaking views! JT was a great pilot even on a windy day! Definitely a must do!

review_title: Much more exciting then a helicoptor!
review_text: We've done the 'doors off' helicopter tour and wanted something different - the bi plane sure was!  Not as close to the sights as a helicopter and the photos are harder to take.... but just the open cockpit experience makes it worth while!
This was Ana amzing flight!  The pilot made it so much fun and showed us everything.  He even circled over the water so we could see whales playing down below!  Highly recommend!!!

Last Wednesday on a day with a few highish clouds we flew on a tour with Air Ventures of Kaua'i, the most westerly of the tourist-visited Hawaiian islands.  Unlike the standard helicopter tour that last 45 minutes and can be a rushed experience, this trip in a fixed wing aircraft was over an hour in duration, allowing for a more leisured experience, with time for whale watching as well as a more detailed look at the south of the island and the famous Na Pali coast on the North West.  The pilot was experienced and knowledgeable and without the roar from the helicopter rotor blades overhead, sound was much clearer via the headset that was issued to each of us.  Everyone gets a window seat, making for easier photography sith reduced distortion from the curved surfaces typical of helicopter windows.  All-in-all at US165$ each, this experience was excellent value and we will be choosing this option in the future.

I wanted to fly around the island to see where I drive (and can't drive) and see things I can't see from the road, not through the interior as I've done that before. Tom was very accommodating arranging the private flight on the Cessna 182 with Eric, the pilot, and Eric did an excellent job flying around the island and pointing out the sights. It was exactly what I wanted, and fortunately the weather was great, and we saw whales, too!

review_title: This was on my wife an my bucket list...The Waco!
review_text: This is the plane we rode in 80 minutes over Kaui....a 2017 Waco, 300hp 7cyl. radial engine. 1800+ pound plane....the only open-air biplane commercially built today....designed in the late 1920's....it's a dream to fly in with a tail-drager...open cockpit biplane....don't expect a smooth flight, flying over and around mountians with the tradewinds. I talked to the pilot about doing some aero manuvers and he did several wing-overs and a stall which was about like a 152, you knew when it was going to stall by the feel...but didn't tip a wing. The pilot did a perfect 3 point landing with a slight cross wind. The pilot was very knowledgeable about Kaui and told us about what we were flying over. He would do flybys for pictures at different different angles, and tip a wing. Thank you for an unforgetable flight, much more than expected.George and Tina Holder Deland, Fl.
It was the best we did at our hawaii trip👍 Good organized, great view, best way to see the beautiful island..wehave also seen many wales..perfect trip for this price👍

My wife and I love adding a little adventure to our vacations, and this was just the ticket. Nothing like feeling the power of the plane in an open cockpit while dive booming over the island. It was an amazing flight. The pilot Harry, was Awsome,

Eric was the absolute best.  He spotted 3 whales for us.  The ride couldn't have been better.  We saw so many beautiful sights and it's something I'll never forget.  For our first trip to Kauai, it was magical.

On our most recent visit to Kauai, we won a two for one flight package with Air Ventures through the consierge at our condominium. Our pilot, JT was professional and very knowledgeable of the island landmarks and history. While cruising over the south shore, we spotted several whales, which he circled so we could get a better view. He did the same off the Na Pali coast. We were fortunate to have a flight with only four passengers, so we were all able to have the same view. I was able to attach my Gopro camera to the strut, for a fee. I was able to sit in the copilot's seat and use my handheld video camera for some great footage. Thanks again, JT for an enjoyable experience. We will definitely take the tour again soon as we come to Kauai every year.

it was great! and chiper than the helicopter tour.we saw the same spots.the only problem is, you can‘t see the spots like with a helicopter. you see it obly frrom far away!but i would do again the plane tour!
We had a terrific flight all over Kauai today with Eric as our pilot. We even saw quite a few whales. I highly recommend them.
A must do excursion. The views were amazing and something you can only experience by air. Highly recommend for the price.
Everybody was doing helikopter flight i decided to use them. Was an amazing experience. I would for sure advise to use their services.
Thrilling trip! Great views, wonderful pilot. Definitely worth a ride in the "convertible in the sky"!

review_title: Best Experience Ever!!! Best Pilot we met so far :)
review_text: First me an my girlfriend wanted to take a helicopter-flight. But because we didn't book early enough, there haven't been any available seats. While driving away from the helicopter landing pads, we luckily  came across that Air Ventures sign. Actually we didn't want to go around the island on a plane, but on a helicopter, but because there were no free seats, we decided to go by plane and it was the best idea of our trip! First it also seemed like there is no possibility to go with the plane, because it left 5 minutes ago. But the very lovely women on the counter just took a phone call. She called her husband, the boss of the air ventures business and this absolute funny guy went on a flight with just the both of us in a second little plane. It was an absolute amazing adventure for me and my girlfriend. What a wonderful sight!!! Ray - the pilot - knew his job an gives you an absolute good feeling flying a small plane and further more he is an absolute comedian in the sky in his fine little plane. So we not just had a wonderful trip around the island, where your really can see every sights very well, but also a trip full of laughter. The pilot explained everything very well on the island, from the rain-powered waterfalls to the agricultural zones, sights like a little tide-powered geyser, the homes of some celebrities and many things more. Me and my girl had a fabulous time at our trip with and can nothing than really, really recommend to take a trip with that lovely guys Eric, Harry, J.T., Jill, Kaycee, Kevin & Ray from air ventures Hawaii !!! Mahalo Nui Loa, Air Ventures Hawaii!!! Victoria and Paul.

This trip was very good & well managed. We were picked up and taken back to our original location. The flight was spectacular and the pilot during the flight gave us lots of useful information. This was a very special experience thank you

Great pilot, the bi-plane was so much fun, cant wait to do it again. I have taken several helicopter tours which are incredible, but to ride in the bi plane with a really fun pilot and open cockpit was a great new experience.

We did the biplane tour. Harry the pilot was great. Views were amazing and the overall experience of being in a biplane was fantastic. The warmth from the engine made in perfectly comfortable. No need for a jacket. Great company. Great staff.

Well I was a bit nervous booking this tour, but my husband really wanted to do it so I plucked up the courage. The staff were wonderful, our pilot was Kevin and he was very informatibpve and I must say I felt safe the whole time. Quite unusyal sitting in an airplane and getting slightly wet in the clouds. Saw the whole island and it actually saved us a trip to the canyon as I felt I had seen enough. Beautiful island and a unique and wonderful way to see it.

We spent 14 days on 4 islands and did kayaking, snorkeling, whale watching and doors off helicopter tour over volcano.  This was by far our favorite and the most amazing experience.  We were met by the owner both before and after our ride.  Harry was our pilot and was great and gave alot of narration.  He did a few airplane tricks also that felt like we were on a rollercoaster.  After ride he wrote down a few other suggestions of sights to see on Kaua’i.  PAY the money and take this trip, it was worth every cent.

Three of us took the scenic flight earlier in the morning with JT! JT was very informing and explained every bit of the flight, as well as what we were viewing from above. The island is beautiful and the flight was amazing! Highly recommend!

review_title: Verborgen Schat met de beste Kauai ervaring ooit!
review_text:
Omdat wij een Cruise hadden geboekt langs de eilanden van Hawaï en het excursie aanbod vanuit de rederij niet echt aantrekkelijk was, ben ik verder gaan zoeken en kwam ik via TripAdvisor en de touristenpagina van Hawaï beoordelingen tegen van Air Ventures. 
Direct viel me op dat ze prijstechnisch enorm voordelig waren ten opzichte van de overdaad aan andere chartermaatschappijen, wat me in eerste instantie wel deed twijfelen. Het leek immers mooier dan waar te zijn. 
Op de website staan de diverse mogelijkheden die aangeboden worden. Zo kun je een gedeeld vliegtuigje nemen, bieden ze een privé optie aan en hebben ze ook een ouderwets propellervliegtuig met open cockpit voor een nog exclusievere ervaring. 
In tegenstelling tot andere maatschappijen werken ze niet met helicopters, maar met kleine vliegtuigen waar max 6 gasten aan boord kunnen en iedereen een eigen raam heeft om van te genieten. 
Je kunt gemakkelijk online boeken en de agenda inzien. Ook kun je ze vlak van tevoren bellen om te vragen of ze nog beschikbaarheid hebben. 
Betalen kan online of aan de balie ter plaatse. 
De medewerkers zijn zeer vriendelijk en behulpzaam en de reactietijd is fantastisch. 
Ik had vooraf een vraag over hun optie om mijn eigen GoPro aan de buitenzijde van het vliegtuig te laten bevestigen, waar ik snel een reactie op kreeg en ter plaatse overigens ook zeer goed bij geassisteerd ben. 
Eenmaal op de dag van vertrek was het zeer bewolkt en regenachtig. Op de afgesproken ophaallocatie werden we onthaald door een medewerker van Air Ventures die vertelde dat de vlucht niet veilig was en geen doorgang kon vinden. We kregen direct de optie aangeboden om iets later die dag het opnieuw te proberen en indien dat niet mogelijk was wegens weersomstandigheden, we ons geld geretourneerd zouden krijgen. Zij wilden ons immers ook de beste ervaring kunnen bieden. 
Ten tijde van onze tweede poging begon het langzaam beter weer te worden, dus konden we alsnog naar het vliegveld. Daar werd kort een instructie gegeven over wat te verwachten en werd de plaatsindeling door de piloot gedaan, die rekening hield met de fotografen onder de groep. 
Mijn GoPro werd bevestigd aan de buitenzijde van het vliegtuig en werd samen gecontroleerd of de positie goed was en er verbinding gemaakt kon worden via de app. 
Omdat het zo had geregend waren we gezegend met talloze watervallen gedurende de vlucht. 
We zijn vrijwel het hele eiland over geweest en werden gedurende de vlucht van informatie voorzien door onze grappige piloot, die er echt een feestje van maakte. We hebben zelfs nog even kort in formatie gevlogen met een ander vliegtuig van Air Ventures, wat echt een unieke ervaring was. 
Al met al denk ik dat wij het meeste hebben gezien van alle mensen aan boord, gezien de dag ervoor ook alles al volledig betrokken was, terwijl we met deze vlucht zowel de Waimea Canyon als de Napali Coast hebben gezien. 
Mocht je voor korte (of lange) duur op Kauai zijn, is dit ABSOLUUT een aanrader en de nummer 1 tour om te boeken. Maar niet te veel doorvertellen hoor, anders zitten ze voor het hele jaar volgeboekt. ;-)

The young pilot, JT by name was very good. He had good piloting skills and narrating skills. He knew the geography of Kauai well. He showed us all the important places and explained the features. I recommend this trip.

Eric was the man! He flew us in the air with ease and re-assured us through the whole flight on the private Cessna tour. We were worried when we saw clouds and light rain but he said it was the best time to go and man was he right! We saw over 5 rainbows! Eric took us around every part of Kauai and kept us in the air for over 65mins. The Cessna airplane  was also awesome. It was comfortable and I believe the experience is just as amazing as it would be on a helicopter because you get to see everything a lot slower than on a heli. Find him, pick your ride and you will not disappoint!
This is a must do while on Kauai! Staff is fantastic!  So amazing to see this beautiful island from the air.

Our pilot Eric was excellent! This is a great way to start your trip - you get to see the entire island from the air. We went back later to hike some of the trails and explore some of the sites from the ground. This tour shows you the ENTIRE island. Excellent views from the airplane!

review_title: Fly first to see what to visit later
review_text: Excellent flight.  Comfortable. Good narration by the pilot.  In my view fixed wing is safer than helicopter because of the more complicated maintenance requirements of a helicopter.
We did an hour flight around the island on Snoopy 2.  It was fantastic Harry and his crew were great.  We would recommend this to anyone a wonderful way to see the island.

We went on the airplane ride as part of another excursion. I'e done quite a few helicopter rides over the island.   This was my first time seeing Kauai in a small plane.  I'd always wanted to do it and am so glad I did.  It was very enjoyable and the sights were spectacular!!

review_title: Professional, !and fun ride. WELL worth it
review_text: Harry was wonderful. We had a blast on our biplane flight and Harry made it fun and put us completely at ease. He provided great information and was able to answer all of our questions. Highly recommend it!

Our multigenerational group was treated to the best experience possible. We had all ages from 9 months to 81 years! All had a great time, filled with laughter - a memory we shall all not forget. The staff and pilots were awesome. We'll be back with our friends!

Eric our captain was great.  My children were a bit nervous and he helped them make it through the entire flight. My teens had a great time and Eric was very knowledgeable about the island, movie scenes and Zuckerberg’s property. Beautiful views and he helped both sides of the plane to see the features.   Totally recommend this for all!!!!!
It was breath taking JT was a amazing pilot. I was a bit nervous about going up in a small plane, but it wasn’t scary at all.
We had a fantastic flight with our pilot Eric! Funny guy very informative. The wind was less than smooth yet he handled it very well and kept it gliding and soft. Highly recommended!

review_title: Snoopy open cockpit bi-plane is the way to see Kaua’i
review_text:
Pilot Harry was professional, delightful and fun!  We thoroughly enjoyed our front row seats in this open air cockpit bi-plane.  We had amazing aerial views of all the beaches, bays, canyons, interiors, water falls, agricultural fields and more. Harry was knowledgeable about the history and changes to make the visual all the more exciting as we learned and saw more than anyone could from a regular plane or helicopter.
This ride is worth every penny and moment. A not-to-miss adventure!

Had a wonderful flight with pilot, Harry.  Beautiful day for flying. Harry was very knowledgeable about the island and it’s history and pointed out many areas that one can only see from the air.  Great fun to fly in an open cockpit biplane. My friend had taken a helicopter tour in the past, but she said this was much better.  This is the ONLY way to tour the island from the air.
Great tour and staff was awesome! I loved it from start to finish! JT was our pilot and he very knowledgeable and entertaining. I can't wait to do it again on my next visit!
An incredible beautiful tour of Kauai.  Kevin's knowledge of the island gave us greater insight to the island.  Definitely will take this tour again on our next visit.

review_title: A wonderful time in the air
review_text: My 2 sisters and my 89 yr old mother were on the flight. We all had a great time. My mom was in the co-pilot seat. A first for her.  The views and the explanations were something none of us will forget. Our pilot was the best also.

We did the island buy helicopter, boat, road and fixed wing which were all great but our flight over Kauai with Eric and Air Ventures was definitely the best of them all for us. Steve Yorke NSW Australia

Best thing we did on our trip. Well worth the money. The staff was awesome and Harry our pilot was the best. Through in a few tricks to make the experience even more memorable. Thanks for making the this the highlight of our trip to Kauai. The only way to describe it is WOW!!!

We won  two for one  $145.00, 60 minute plane tour of Kauai. The afternoon we were scheduled to fly, it was overcast, rainy and hella windy. So couldn’t see anything, take pics and one bumpy ride. We asked if we could reschedule for a nicer day and Casey said yes.  In reality the company all ready had
 our money and back at the Pono Kai Where we booked the tour was told by Cyrus to bad money gone. And indeed it was. People don’t fall pry to this company. Book with a helicopter company which is easier to work with. Also don’t use or count on the concierge’s desk at the Pono Kai to support you. It’s all about the money- taking yours.  
If I could give this company a zero rating I would.
This flight was fantastic.   It was about $100 less than a helicopter ride.  Everyone had a window seat and the guide gave us a lot of great information.

Top notch operation from start to finish. The front desk staff was informative and helpful when I called asking for advice regarding the weather and best time of day to fly. The pilot couldn’t have been more professional and experienced - he’s been flying in HI for 30 years. The biplane looks old but is actually new and very comfortable to fly in. Passengers are completely enclosed in an “air shield” sitting up front, so it isn’t windy or cold in the air. The views from the open cockpit are amazing. Absolutely worth doing!

We took the airplane tour of Kauai with informative pilot JT. I loved seeing all parts of the coastline and interior of the island. He told us about the history which was very informative. We arrived early for our 10 am tour and 2 additional people, not with our group, had rescheduled so at the last minute we were added to another tour who was about to take off with 4 people. We had to put at the wings and I was on the left side, which are the worst seats, in my opinion. I was dissapointed with sitting on the left as most of the views are on the right for a longer time period and it is difficult to take photos at the wings. I enjoyed the tour, but was dissapointed with the seats and if 2 other people had not rescheduled we probably would not have had to sit at the wings.
The flight was so beautiful! The sights will leave you in awe. I definitely recommend flying with Air Ventures while in Kauai! Our pilot, Desi, was knowledgeable and had a very bubbly personality.

I honestly cannot speak highly enough of the people and the company!They were responsive, helpful and flexible. We felt completly safe and welcome and they were very knowledgable abou the island. They were the highlight of our trip and i consider and absolute MUST for the island

We took the biplane tour over Kauai, and it was awesome. Kevin was our pilot, and he was very personable. There were a lot of showers in the area that day, and he gave us the option to rescheduled should we wish or still take the tour. We went anyway (a big part of the excitement was simply flying in a biplane)  and it actually gave the flight an authentic feel to fly through the showers. But the view of Waimea Canyon in particular was incredible. And Kevin narrated the flight with a lot of great information about the island. It was an amazing flight and the service was great, so I would definitely recommend this trip!

review_title: Wow. One of a kind experience!!
review_text: What an incredible and unique tour!! We took the open cockpit plane tour our first day in Kauai, and it was a great way to get to know the island. Best for the adventurous types as it was very thrilling. We will be back, thanks again!!
Der Flug war wunderschön. Wir empfehlen jeden Urlauber: guckt euch Kaua’i von oben an. Alles war gut organisiert und unkompliziert.
Such a wonderful time!   Beautiful scenery great pilot full of neat information!   Highly highly recommend this trip!

review_title: Fantastic Kauai Island View by Air
review_text: To see Kauai island by air was not an activity my sister and I had planned to go on but we were given an opportunity and we took advantage of it!Our pilot Desi was fantastic at explaining the island terrain and some history while flying a very smooth course, with an occasional “bump” as we approached the clouds although Desi warned us in advance. It was awesome to see the Nepali Coast by air.Thank you, Desi and Air Ventures Hawaii staff!Cheers! Janice & CarolynVancouver Canada
Amazing crew and we found their rates to be more reasonable than their competitors. Would definitely recommend them!
The plane is very small.  If you are not size 30 waist or less and shorter than 510"you will be very uncomfortable.  Pilot was great and views were nice but I would never do it again.
Better than any heli tour!  Plus, you are the envy of the skies.!So reasonably priced, it’s a no-brained.  Mahalo Nui Loa!
Great experience with knowledgeable pilot.  Made everyone feel relaxed and gave us good info about the island

My husband and I are so glad we booked a flight seeing trip with Air Ventures. We have visited many places on the island, but nothing compares to seeing the island from the air.  Our pilot, Eric, kept us entertained (and safe) as we traveled around the island, swooping down by the waterfalls, through the canyons, and past jagged peaks.  If you purchase one tour on the island, make it THIS one!  You will be glad you did.
The fly was so amazing, the view in the air was speculator also employees is very helpful and friendly. We would do this trip over again. Thank you for making our trip so memorable.

So much fun!  We thoroughly enjoyed this wonderful airborne tour of Kauai.  You see things you'd never be able to see from the ground, and at a speed that is easy to take photos.  Our pilot, Kevin, is great and has first-hand knowledge of the island's many movie adventures, and also knows a lot about the geology.  I'm a little afraid of heights, but felt completely safe in the plane, and had confidence in Kevin.  Wonderful!

Eric was the pilot and was so knowledgeable and it was the perfect way to see the island of Kauai He made sure everyone was comfortable and the staff were all so courteous! Thank you Air  Ventures - we will be sure to tell our family and friends

Great aerial tour of the island of Kauai. Open cockpit only holds 2 people. Both have a view to the side and front. No middle seat like on the helicopter tours where you don't see much. Lots of island history and places to see once you are back on terra firma. You also see places where you would not be able to get to from the ground, like the inside of the Waialeale crater and down in the Waimea canyon. Would do it again next trip to Kauai. Kevin the pilot could not have been nicer. Yet another person we met on vacation who was also from NJ.

This was a compromise experience because some in our group had concerns about the helicopter tours.  This was a great compromise!  It was half the price of the helicopter, it was a smooth ride and we still saw wonderful views of the island.  Our young pilot JT did an amazing job!
Desi made a great flight..,,,making sure everyone on the plane saw all the sights. Very confident pilot.

review_title: Get a feel for the island
review_text: It was great way too see the whole island. Our pilot was personable and professional. Would recommend to anyone who is interested in a overview of KAUAI.   We did the fight at the beginning of our vacation which allowed us to make decisions on places to visit

My wife and I went on this tour as part of our honeymoon. Kevin picked us up and shuttled us to the airport, telling us stories of his experiences while living on the island along the way. He is very friendly and knowledgeable of the island. He is also a very good pilot and was able to get us close to all the major sites on the island, including the waterfall highlighted in Jurassic Park and some of the beaches where Pirates of the Caribbean and Six Days Seven Nights were filmed. The plane felt safe and I was able to mount my GoPro to the outside of the plane for an additional $25 which made for some great shots of the island. All in all, great tour and we would recommend it.
This was great, you get to see parts of the Islands that are not accessible.  The views were spectacular and our pilot Desi was wonderful!

What a fabulous way to explore Kauai!  Our pilot, JT, was not only a skilled pilot but he was an excellent tour guide—charming and very knowledgeable.  It was a windy day but JT kept the plane away from the turbulence and we liked the way he rotated the plane around at the major points of interest so the guests on both sides of the plane could have the entire view. The best way to see the island.  Worth every penny! Mahalo for an awesome experience.

We flew with Harry in the biplane during our recent trip to Kaua’i, and it was one of the most memorable experiences of our lives!  There is nothing like seeing this beautiful island from the sky, and the biplane was such a unique way to see it.  Air Ventures was super accommodating when we had to reschedule, and our pilot made us feel very safe and was incredibly knowledgeable.  They suggest booking this excursion during the beginning of your stay so you can see some areas of the island you’d like to explore.  My husband and I, however, went during the middle of our stay and thought it was so amazing to see from above some of the areas we had already visited by land!  Any air tour is an investment, which is why this was the only tour/excursion we did.  But it was so worth it!  Thank you for the adventure!

I really enjoyed the Kauai flight with Air Ventures Hawaii. Desi - though quite young - was a perfect pilot and also a very knowledgeable guide. The views were spectacular and the flight was much cheaper than the helicopter tours.
We were looking forward to the flight & it exceeded our expectations.  Everyone should feel so free.  I will do it again if we are in the island.

The turbine helicopter tours are sexy but they only play pre-recorded tapes on a strictly defined route.  Air Ventures, on the the other hand, flies you around in an air-conditioned plane with a pilot that knows the area and its history.  We fly with Kevin this week and it was perfect.  He spent over an hour flying around the island looking at sites and even spent a few minutes combing part of the ocean to see if there were any whales - there weren't any though.  I highly recommend this tour - it's cheaper and better and that's a super rare combination.

review_title: Best Thing We’ve Done In Kauai
review_text: There’s a reason why blogs and websites say do an air tour. They’re not just blowing smile or trying to promote a company. It is absolutely the best way to actually SEE the island. Air Ventures was worth every penny. Our pilot Eric was super cool and not only gave us great info about the island, but tips on things to do and see during our visit. He made us feel safe and at ease. We boarded a small 6 seater plane, did some safety checks and took off!!! UNBELIEVABLE EXPERIENCE. Please please please if you are considering this activity, just do it. It was the most beautiful thing ever. I’ve never seen so many shades is green and blue. The waterfalls, the cliffs and canyons, the shorelines, they were spectacular! Eric made sure we saw it all. He even helped us look out for whales and other wildlife (goats on the side of a mountain? Who knew?). I can’t recommend this tour enough. I’d give it ten stars if I could.
Everyone must do this. Dezi our pilot was fabulous. She was very knowledgeable, funny and gave us a recommendation for breakfast.

Started with transfer driver advising pick up time and location. At designated time driver picked us up and took the scenic route to the airport. We were processed pre flight in a friendly and efficient manner. The flight was excellent and the pilot was informative and proficient. The views were extraordinary and the flight was smooth and stress free. After landing Harry the pilot drove us back to the cruise ship. All in all an excellent experience.
Fantastic....Desi and Kaycee are the best!!! I could not have been more comfortable flying with anyone else. Desi is an amazing pilot to be so young 😚😊😚

This was awesome, I bit pricey, but better this then a laui,lolThere is no comparrison, this is the way to see the island. Kevin our pilot was very accomadating.Showed us so much.Even taking turns so both sides of plane could get the view.Personable, humorous, he even did I fly over of our cruise ship.Turns out he took lessons at the little airport in my state of Delaware!I recomend this tour for sure.
Everyone was great from start to finish. Our pilot Desi was amazing. We had perfect weather and the views were spectacular.

review_title: Breathtaking Way to View the Island
review_text: The best part of my trip! Beautiful, unforgettable views of the Napali Coast, endless waterfalls, canyons and most of the island. The flight was > 1 hour with Awe-inspiring views from start to end. The local knowledge of the pilot and guide (Desi) was perfect, and greatly enhanced the already brilliant tour. The speed of the plane and having no central seats mean that you glide through the picturesque island's coast and valleys gently - so as to have plenty of time to digest expert local knowledge, admire the beauty and take photos and videos. So happy to have chosen Air Ventures Hawaii. This was spectacular and will stay with me forever. Thank you!!

Very pleased with trip. Pilot Eric very good tour guide. I was seated in the co-pilot's seat. Eric even took pictures for me with my phone. My only complaint was that when Eric turned his head to the left I couldn't hear him. It was like the head phones were cutting out.
We had a very professional and fun pilot who did a great job explaining what we flew over as well as some great island history.

My wife and I had little idea of what a great service Air ventures offer Kevin was very knowledgeable and flies with great confidenceI would fly again with you guys without any doubt Graeme and Christine

review_title: Amazing, one of a kind, experience!
review_text: I had scheduled this flight on the very last minute before my flight to the other island, because of the bad weather of previous days and even though I eventually missed that flight, it was 100% worth it! I was really sad when I found out that Na PalI coast was closed and I couldn't hike it, but this experience made up for that so big Thanks :)

review_title: Six seater plane ride to site see at Kauai
review_text: This was the first time I rode a small plane and expected to be a choppy ride. It was smooth and slow so I can enjoy the scenery of Kauai. I am glad I did this instead of a helicopter.

Best way to see Kauai is from the air. At first my wife was a little nervous, but as we started flying the nerves went away and we all enjoyed the flight. JT was super as our pilot. I would recommend Air Ventures hands down. All the staff was professional and friendly.

This was our first visit to Kauai and flying in a biplane with Harry as our pilot is an experience we will never forget. The entire flight was smooth, adventurous, exciting, informative and in general....AWESOME 😎!! Thank You for the experience of a lifetime!!

Ground tour was very good with the Driver Steve, he was very informative and really a great out going guy who will keep you entertained. The Air Adventure was also a Very Spectacular Plane Ride with Desi as our pilot, for someone who loves Kauai and lives there knows alot for her young age, she also was a very Happy and out going person with lots of info about the island. I would recommend this package if you want a good 7 hour tour with the Two people that I have mentioned.  I give them a multiples of Thumbs Up!

This was an amazing way to start our week long vacation. It allowed us to see all of the major sights in one excursion. Would definitely do this again! JT was very knowledgeable and he made the experience enjoyable.
Excellent both pilot and plane Trip was great pilot was very informative They took pictures before we took off and sent to us #1 company

review_title: Air tour of Kauai by plane
review_text: My husband and I had an enjoyable time viewing Kauai by air. We saw areas of the island we could not have otherwise seen. Eric, our pilot gave us a great tour of  the island. He showed us many points of interest. We were able to take breathtaking photos and videos. We felt safe and recommend this tour. We did the combo, air, land and water tour.
The employees were all so nice. The pilot was super. He told us about the Island and pointed out many points of interest. I only regret that we couldn't get down lower in places to see better.

We were on a cruise but booked this in town ourselves. It was a great price for a small plane tour of the island. We saw views we’d never see from the ground and were amazed at the beauty of this isle from above.

review_title: Amazing from the views to the pilot
review_text: We took this adventure yesterday.  I was amazing.  The ride was great even for one who had not flown much.  Our pilot Eric was great.  He was fun and informative.  He kept the mood light.  The view was amazing.  Definitely a must do!

Our flight with JT was definitely one of the highlights of our trip.  He explained everything as we went along as a couple of people in our party were first time small plane fliers, and a little nervous.  it was a perfect day, we even saw the top of the volcano, which apparently doesn't happen too often.  We saw so much in such a short time, I did not want the flight to end!  Thanks to all of you for making that day a special one for us.

When we booked this tour, my wife was hesitant about the small plane as well as myself but we were both surprised at how smooth the flight was. The ground crew made us feel as comfortable as possible. Our pilot was Eric. He did an amazing job!! He was very informative about the island and lighthearted at the same time. He made us feel comfortable in the air. It was a much smoother ride than I was expecting! If you have the same fears that we did,all I can say is try flying with these folks. We were pleasantly surprised!!

We really enjoyed the trip. It was very personal and the pilot, Kevin, made sure everyone had a chance to view the sights from all the best angles. We went on a helicopter ride several years earlier and this seemed more secure and the views were great.

The tour was beautiful.  However the plane air conditioning was not working well enough and it was a hot trip.  Having water available was great and much needed.  J T was a good pilot, but could have given a few more fun facts and/or history to make it more worthwhile.  Also, my microphone wasn't working, so could not ask questions.
Excellent and friendly staff.  J.T., our pilot was awesome. Scenes were gorgeous. Breathtaking waterfalls as well as beaches.  Highly recommended.

We flew with Harry in the 182. Personal service at a group rate price. Harry was an excellent pilot and did a great job getting into and out of the mountains with low clouds surrounding some of the sites we were to see. His knowledge of the sites and the associated weather made us feel safe and we got tons of pictures. I am a pilot alos and this team is great. Kevin, Kacee and harry took great care to see our adventure was the best part of our trip to the 50 th state.
Has a wonderful flight. Weather was perfect, pilot awesome. Well worth the money. All staff was very friendly & professional.

i am often motion sick but everyone on this flight made me feel at ease, especially the pilot who put me in front with him. highly competent, professional and kind, this company's team is fabulous (especially the pilot. did i mention how much i liked the pilot. i'm sure it was tj or something with a t. he was only 22 but totally confident and fantastic. no shakiness. he knows what he's doing. we saw amazing things!!

An amazing aerial tour of Kauai.  Eric was our pilot and he assured our safety and comfort and provided lots of information about the island.  Worth every penny.  Highly recommend this tour.  Thanks Eric and Kaycee.

Jill does not know how much she made our trip, when she answered the phone, said they could make availability for us and could even pick us up at our accommodation. It was the first thing to go right for us in a few day. Very prompt pick up and sign in. And then before we knew it, we were in the air with our little group of 4 and seeing all the wonderful scenery of Kauai. The pilot was amazing and gave commentary of areas and did his best to show us as much as he could, weather permitting. I would highly recommend using this company for an incredible tour of the whole island by air.

We’ve done plane and helicopter tours on vacation before, but nothing compares to riding in an open cockpit biplane and doing wing overs! What a memorable experience. Our pilot was Harry, who pointed out all the points of interest with a little history of the area. So fun!

This was absolutely amazing!!! We did this trip around Kaua'i in the end of july, when we stayed one week at the island. We wanted to have a relaxed week with snorkeling and swimming but we also wanted to see the island. So we decided to get this trip, because it was not as expensive as the trips by helicopter. The trip lasted about an hour an we had so many awesomes views out of the plane espacially on the napali coast with a very entertaining pilot who told us some facts about what we see. After this flight you are flashed by so many unbelievable views on kauai. We took many pictures on our flight and some videos, so we wont forget about this amazing trip soon. It was definitely woth the money we payed!
Very knowledgeable guides kept us informed and entertained all day. Loved the veiw from the plane very steady flight with a smooth landing.

What a great experience! Eric ( our pilot ) was the MAN! My wife and 2 young boys loved our flight and would highly recommend this to anyone. The pickup and drop off service was great too. A wonderful package and a credit to the team!Cheers, Chris Watson , Wellington, New Zealand

review_title: Flight over canyons, volcanoes, waterfalls, gorges, valleys and coastline of Kauai
review_text: The flight was absolutely superb. Very awe inspiring to say the least.. Couldn't fault the attitude and helpfulness of the staff. High;y recommended. It would be such a shame to leave Kauai without doing this trip. Other than an expensive helicopter trip, it's the only way to see the sheer dramatic beauty of this wonderful island.

review_title: Flight over the island of Kauai
review_text: It was an amazing experience. Very worthwhile as it gave a great overview of the entire island as it circled right around the island. The weather was perfect and the pilot was professional and able to reassure even a passenger that was clearly very apprehensive.

Premier point essentiel: c'est un tour eco-friendly, vous consommez 70 % de carburant en moins en choisissant cette option plutôt qu'un hélicoptère. Compagnie sérieuse et personnel extrêmement agréable. C'est un tour exhaustif des choses à voir sur l'île. Nous vous le recommandons chaudement !
60 minutes of pure awesomeness. For the folks who are scared of heights -the ride is not very bumpy. Our pilot JT was very good and friendly
A great experience we were able to share aloft over the Garden island . Very unfussy and friendly team that managed a special trip for us.
Brilliant viewing from the plane as I was in the front seat. Th pilot was very informative. Weather was perfect.
A great view from the open cockpit on the plane.  What a thrill to ride this plane!!! It was a surprise for my husband.

Had a great experience on this hour long Island air tour with JT.  The weather cooperated and the flight was smooth. I’d never been on a 6 seater plane before but was not nervous at all! I even got to sit in the copilot seat! It’s a good value for the price, highly recommend!

Thoroughly enjoyed this flight and highly recommend it.  Very reasonably priced and the views were amazing.  Staff was friendly and very helpful.  Will definitely do it again the next time I’m in Kauai!!!
Eric the pilot was great. He really knew exactly where to fly to give us the best views. He was personable and engaged with everyone on the plane.
Our Biplane ride was breath taking! It was fantastic to see all of Kauai and all the beautiful scenery! What a fun adventure we had for an hour! Thank you to our pilot for his expert skills!

We loved our flight! Our pilot knew a lot of interesting things about the island and the entire staff was friendly and helpful. We really enjoyed our day.
