If we did it again we would opt for a helicopter, because they get a lot closer to the falls and mountains, but we did love our biplane ride. We initially chose it because we knew it would be just pilot and us, and we were in honeymoon mode, so if you would prefer something more private this is the way to go
Absolute great experience with my great and EXPERIENCED pilot JT! He did a fantastic job at showing the while island! He also cracked some super funny jokes!

review_title: Air Ventures With Justin "What a Life" Turner
review_text: Howdy! This was easily one of the greatest tours I've been on in my 23 years of adventuring. J "What a Life" T was knowledgeable, friendly, and a damn good pilot at only 22 years of age. Well it's time for me to make like an egg and beat it guys. Yeehaw.
It was amazing and well worth the $160 which took just over 1 hour. The pilot made sure everyone in the aircraft could see all the scenery.

To celebrate our 50th wedding anniversary we cruised Hawaii and enjoyed many excursions from port to port. A high light of our tour was flying with Air Ventures. It was exciting, informative and we saw the most beautiful views thru our individual windows. Owners and pilot invoked the utmost confidence and friendliness,

Flying in the Waco Biplane was a once in a lifetime experience. The open cockpit and big radial engine made allowed us to experience a bygone era of barn storming flying. Our pilot was engaging and fun. Just terrific.
The tour was amazing I got the chance to be the co pilot and it wa truly amazing. The staff was really nice and helpful. I would recommend 200% and I’d book again with them
Experienced it all on this trip around the island. Great commentary throughout. We truly enjoyed our flight with Eric. He showed and told us many things in such a short time.

I would highly recommend this adventure to anyone who is looking to see the island in ways that you will not be able to see any other way. I would do it again. The price is cheap compared to other options that are out there. Our piolet was Eric and he provided a great flight and kept everyone entertained the entire time. The tour lasted a little over an hour. You views you see are amazing and can not be put into words.

From the time we put on canvas helmets and plexiglass goggles I knew it was going to be amazing. Pilot Kevin did an outstanding job. It was the highlight of our 50th trip to Hawaii. Do this! Unforgettable.
Had a great flight. Everyone had a window and pilot was careful to make sure everyone got to see the great scenery.

We enjoyed the ride very much, it was very smooth and our pilot PJ was very knowledgeable and nice.The scenic views were amazing, it was our first experience for air tour, and we were glad we did. I took many spectacular photos.
Enjoyable and informative tour provided by professional and friendly hosts, we were made to feel relaxed and safe.

We took advantage of the opportunity to fly in the biplane and it is worth the value ten fold. I have skydived for years and flown in and jumped from just about everything and can say without reservation that  the pilot was the best. A flawless flight, epic views and a history lesson along the way, it is a "must do" while on the island. The staff was also amazing, funny, rescheduled us due to weather with no problems, all in all, a wonderful experience that we will no doubt do again on our next trip, sincerely, Margie n Tim

We were so impressed with Air Ventures Hawaii.

Seeing Kauai up close and personal from the air is a thrilling and memorable way to bond with this incredible, ancient island.

Our pilot Eric was personable, friendly, funny, and extremely knowledgeable. As a skilful and experienced pilot, we knew we were safe and in very good hands.

Jill was so helpful with arranging and then rescheduling our tour, especially because she knew we wanted to see the Jurassic Park Waterfalls, and needed a clear day for the best views. Jill also went above and beyond, giving us extra tips about tourist attractions and ideas to help us with the rest of our Kauai visit.

Thank you so much Air Ventures, we loved everything about our Kauai flying tour.

review_title: The Bi-plane Ride of a Lifetime
review_text: Great thrill of a lifetime! Bi-plane pilot Kevin was an awesome guide. We would do it again in a heartbeat!! Stunning views of Kauai from the air. Worth the price!

Over the years we have taken several aerial tours. The biplane tour has been the best by far. The pilot covered parts of the island we have never seen before and was very knowledgeable of the different areas.
Excellent, Unfortunately the weather was not the best. Still value for money.The pilot was very informative and did a great job.
Brilliant pilot, spectacular scenery, exceptional service from everyone, would recommend this to anyone!

Air Ventures Hawaii were superb in flying me over one of the most beautiful islands in the world. Kevin was a fantastic and incredibly well informed pilot. Great pilot felt safe . Clean plane and super folks on the ground.Want a  great  Hawaiian grand canyon sightseeing trip use this flight service.

We flew with AirVentures on our trip to Kauai. Check in was easy and our pilot JT was amazing. Not only was he a great pilot but he also was a great tour guide. I highly recommend this flight early in your visit to the Garden Isle. Aloha!

Great tripGreat commentaryFun trip and we were amazed at how much we were able to see despite recent rain/clouds

The flight over Kauai island was amazing!  This is the second time we flied with Air Ventures.  J.T. the pilot was great too!  Highly recommended!!

This was an awesome experience! JT was our pilot and he was great. I suggest doing this at the beginning of your trip so then you can see what beaches or hikes you might want to do at the rest of your trip!

Penny and Terry Cannavan, Adelaide, Australia.

review_title: Affordable, Wide View of Kauai Scenery
review_text: My sister and I opted for the Air Ventures tour over a helicopter tour. We were pleased with the value for the money. We were lucky to have a clear day, and enjoyed beautiful views of the island. Pilot JT was friendly. Bottled water & cold cloths were supplied in the plane. The plane was comfortable. We were pleased with our experience with Air Ventures Hawaii. While the airplanes are not able to get a close-up view to the scenery like helicopters do, we were able to enjoy a wide view and took terrific photos.

Air ventures Hawaii was such a great experience, they were flexible in fitting us in around our other planned activities. The tour was absolutely incredible, seeing Kauai from the sky is definitely something you won’t want to miss. Ray was also a great pilot and he kept the tour interesting, Thank you so much for the friendly service and tour of a lifetime!

We booked an one hour flight via Get your Guide started at 10 a.m. After a warm welcome on the counter we meet Lisa and Matthew - our flight companions for this day and Eric our pilot for the next hour. We started with an group photo and an short introduction. Eric flew us over the island and told us everything about the regions. Jurassic Park Film scenes, the Waimea Canyon, a lot of beaches and the great Nā Pali Coast. After a short visit in the volcano we flew to the fantasy island waterfalls. An amazing trip with cool guys!

Flying over and seeing Kauai from the air in a BI-PLANE!  How can anything match that!  The ride was exhilarating and exciting (and not"frightening" in the least)!  Our pilot Kevin had loads of flt experience and gave a great narration of the sites!  Don't miss this once in a lifetime opportunity!!

Get it done, have no doubts, this will be the best hour you will spend. I was going to say on Kauai but you wont actually be, on Kauai will ya. This was not our first time in an open cockpit bi plane so we knew what to expect but what we didn't expect was the pilot and his knowledge. Kevin, super nice guy and very informative.Shares plenty of information about key locations you fly over, all through these marvelous noise canceling headphones. The staff at the airport were also super lovely and so, I don't often leave reviews but this place deserved the recognition. I would do it again in a heartbeat. Thank you guys, awesome experience.

This wasn't our first time in an open cockpit Bi plane but this certainly was the better of the two. Seeing the islands this way is incredible, far better than the helicopter ride we took. Kevins knowledge of the history of the island is amazing. The hour spent was well worth it. I could go on and on but really, all you need to know is that you can expect to get more than you expected, its the open cockpit bi plane thing :-)
Your services was TOP from time of pickup  flight and pilot were excellent and driver that drop us back at Nawiliwili was the best if ever back that way we shell use Air Ventures

I wasn't sure how this excursion was going to go, being in such a small plane. But it was amazing!JT was a great pilot, I recommend him highly. Got such amazing views of such a beautiful island. I miss it already!

It was an extraordinary moment. I have done the helicopter and a little plane before, but this plane is so much better because you feel that you are part of the scenery. Definitely you should do that if you are in kauai!!!!

We had an awesome flight!  Pilot was very professional, knowledgeable, funny, and made sure everyone was comfortable during the entire flight.  It's hard to exaggerate the beauty of the views. they take care of any detail you can have free water and fresh towels .Good safety pilot and he knows the history of Hawaii ,and also explains everything on Hawaii and waterfalls.

The scenery is breathtaking
Very good value for 1 hour flighgrest way to se Kauai 

Highly recommend

Highly recommend Air Ventures Hawaii. They kindly fitted us in when another company cancelled our tour at the last minute. Every team member brilliant. Very comfortable aircraft, caring, funny, expert pilot. Of course Na Pali coast and Waimea canyon are beautiful beyond words. Don't leave Kauai without doing this flight.

Our pilot was very knowledgeable about the island and kept the ride enjoyable for the entirety of the flight. I was lucky enough to be able to sit in the co-pilot seat of the plane which I would also highly recommend if you get a chance. Air Ventures Hawaii gave us a wonderful experience.  Our pilot JT was very professional...and fun at the same time.  He was very knowledgeable about all of the sights we were seeing.  He also did a great job keeping the plane stable even though it was a bit windy out.  One person in our group was generally a little fearful about flying.  JT made sure that all of us had a great, memorable experience.  Our next visit will include a flight with their bi-plane!!
The tour was great, so much better doing a private tour vs. a group. Our pilot was informative and friendly.

I was lucky, for the weather all week was spot rain and sunshine. The day I took tour was one of those rainy mornings so by the time we reached Napali we were fortunate to see hundreds of waterfalls. Amazing trip.

I setup a private flight for my family of 7 and Jill was extremely accommodating and helpful of our requests. The views of the island are unreal, and the pilots are very knowledgeable of the island, discussing parts of the island as you pass by. My sister got sick on the flight, as she tends to experience motion sickness on boats and planes, and Eric, our pilot, helped her through it. She is sill glad that I she went! I can’t reccomend this enough! Do it!

Flew in the biplane.  A unique experience that was so much fun and the sights are amazing.  Unfortunately, my wife got a bit air-sick.  She took a chance knowing she can get motion sickness. After the flight the owner did everything she could to help my wife feel better. Even before the flight the owner and other employees treated us like friends.  This is a great company. I will fly again (without my wife) next time I'm there.  Highly recommend both the flight and the company. Thanks Jill and Harry for taking good care of us!

I called last minute, when our flight with another company was canceled, and everyone was so friendly and helpful. The flight was incredible and our pilot narrated the entire flight with interesting information about the island. The views were absolutely stunning and I could not have asked for a better experience.

review_title: Try the air tour for sure
review_text: Try the air tour for sure. The views were amazing and the tour was done just for our family. It was fun.
Excellent tour with pilot Eric He called us by name and pointed out landmarks and history as we flew  The views were awesome of the Nepali coast, cathedral cliffs and  Waimea Canyon

Such an Amazing trip & We were the first Belgians! Whoohoow

So beautiful to see Kauai from the air, the Jurassic Falls, Napali coast, Hanalei, beautiful beaches, and so on...

Great explanation from our Pilot Eric, he was funny as well!

Very friendly check-in, and easily accessible.

Way cheaper than Helicopter flights!

We strongly recommend this trip, A must do on Kauai!
Gorgeous views, our pilot JT was awesome. We loved our experience! Would definitely recommend to others.
Very informative. I've done helicopter tours through the canyon before and this plane ride was smoother and quieter - enjoyed it tremendously.
The view was so beautiful and amazing, absolutely stunning and the waterfalls were gorgeous . We loved every moment of it
excellent and breath taking experience. U got to do it. Everting is organised well and the Pilot was very professional and explained us a lot about the overflighted zones. Well done Guys!

Eric was a great tour guide and pilot, it was a vey smooth flight overall.  This was my first trip to the island and this tour gives one an excellent reference point to further my experience, would I go again? Absolutely!!!
Ein tolles Erlebnis, sehr sehr nettes Team und einige hilfreiche Informationen. Wir haben den Flug ziemlich am Anfang unseres Aufenthaltes gebucht - ein perfekter Einstieg.

The entire team at AirVentures was amazing. Jill and her husband make you feel like family. And JT was a great pilot tour guide. That’s a pretty amazing task to do at once. The whole team truly wanted you to have a great time and was willing to serve you however possible. We felt safe and had a fantastic time together!
JT did a great job. A few geology comments would enrich the experience.  Flight was smooth. Office staff was friendly and helpful.

review_title: Fun way to see the island by air
review_text: We have done numerous helicopter tours in the past and decided to try something different - we loved it.

This was a great tour if you want to see different perspectives of Kauai in one day.  The land, river and air fit a lot in.  The tour guide was very informative and personable and the air pilot made us feel very comfortable.  The plane was a little cramped but we had a good view of the island.
TJ was a great guide,  very knowledgeable.  It was great to see the island from the sky.  Would definitely recommend this tour!

The whole family had the BEST time ( even the 17yrs old who was a little nervous before takeoff). Pilot Eric was very professional and knowledgeable, made sure we were all ok at all times, and gave us a lot of interesting facts  about the island. We are so happy we chose this flight instead of a helicopter ride — a lot better view for everyone and cheaper too! Don’t hesitate to fly with Air Ventures—memories for life :)

review_title: Even if you are afraid of heights, the biplane is a must!!
review_text: My husband and I went for his birthday and this trip was absolutely awesome.  The owners were super friendly and our pilot Harry was great.  I was nervous at first because I have a fear of heights but the experience was so amazing I forgot to be scared!  Definitely a one-of-a-kind experience.  Worth every penny!

review_title: Biplane Flight with Air Ventures Hawaii
review_text: The Biplane flight was such an amazing experience. I would definitley recommend it to other people. In my opinion it was much better than any helicopter flight we had done previously.

Roy was my husband's and mine pilot. His wife also works there too. She graciously catered to us, and helped us with getting set up and check in. They were very hospitable and charismatic people. The views of the island were spectacular. Roy made the group feel safe while we flew. My husband bonded with Roy over his love of flying with him. We learned many interesting and unknown facts about from a local's perspective. I can't wait to visit them again. Mahalo!!!

review_title: Awesome experience flying with Air Ventures!
review_text: We recently visited Kauai and flew on an airbus with Air Ventures. The pilot, Eric, was great. Very funny, yet professional and made us feel comfortable the whole flight. The views were spectacular and we got so many incredible photos from the plane. The owner was very flexible and helpful when we had to change our date/time last minute due to a change in our cruise itinerary. She called us the day before our flight to ask if we would like to move our flight to a later time slot due to possible rain in the forecast. We were able to take the later slot, and the weather was perfect. Thank you for an unforgettable experience!

This is one adventure not to be missed. The views are incredibly breathtaking. The plane very comfortable and the pilots knowledgeable. Our family of 6 ranging in age from 13 to 75 have memories of a lifetime -- wow.. the mountains, the Waimea Canyon,  the Napali Coast seen from above. Add this trip to your bucket list.

Une équipe chaleureuse et souriante du début à la fin. Bouteilles d eau offertes avant le départ et bonbons à l arrivée. Ayant été mal durant le vol, on m a gentiment offert des chewings gums contre les maux de voyage et une limonade en descendant de l avion, le geste a été très apprécié!
L expérience est vraiment top, la vue sur la Na Pali Coast époustouflante, de même  que le Waimea Canyon. 
Ayant testé le vol en hélicoptère sur Big Island, j avoue avoir eu une préférence pour l avion. Nous avions tous un hublot et donc une visibilité totale durant tout le trajet. L expérience nous a semblée plus conviviale, sans ressentir ce côté commercial où l on fait défiler les clients à la chaîne comme pour le vol en hélicoptère. De plus, les prix défient toute concurrence pour une expérience similaire!
Nous avons énormément apprécié l  équipe et son accueil! On recommande vivement!!

We have visited Kauai many times for extended vacations so we have sampled many of the island’s activities and attractions over the years. After watching the biplane fly over us during many of these trips, we decided it was something we just had to do. We were glad we did.  For us this was considerably more exciting than the helicopter tour we had previously done. The thrill of flying in the open cockpit is intense. Our skilled and experienced pilot and guide, Harry, made sure that we were comfortable and not missing any of the important sights and points of interest. Even though we know the island pretty well, seeing it from the air provides a whole new perspective and appreciation for the diverse beauty of this incredible island.  Don’t skip this activity
Air Ventures Hawaii one hour flight was the highlight of our trip to Kauai. The pilot was knowledgeable, the scenery amazing and the flights itself in such a small plane was excellent.

review_title: Pleasant air tour over the island
review_text: We have done helicopter tours before, but they are not my husband's favorite, so we opted for the plane and enjoyed it very much.  You do not go as fast, so have the opportunity to absorb the view more.

The experience was great! Everyone treated us well. The ride was not only fun but the pilot had lots of good information through out the ride. We took a helicopter ride a couple days earlier. I recommend this ride over the helicopter.

My husband, two teenage daughters, and I had a very pleasant trip with JT. We have done both helicopter and Air Van tours while in the islands. The Air Van is more comfortable in terms of spacing and leg room despite the fact it does not go as deep into valleys as a helicopter would go. JT’s descriptions were both informative and entertaining for our family. The service prior to and post flight were professional and efficient.

Our 60 minute scenic flight over the picturesque island of Kauai was the highlight of our recent stay on the island. With only a few days to sample the attractions of this paradise we found this to be an affordable and efficient way to see as much as we could. JT, our pilot, made sure we enjoyed the spectacular Na Pali coastline and the impressive Waimea Canyon. We can honestly saw that every passenger had a window seat to fully appreciate the amazing scenery.

For a little while, I felt luke a bird as i soared through the skies of Lauai. The world around me was new at this level - a truly delicious banquet for my eyes! Thank you Air Ventures for a his truly amazing experience!

We (me, my wife and 2 kids) took turns going up with our pilot Harry.  He was incredibly professional and a great tour guide.  Honestly, this is an adventure tour you would remember forever.  We flew along the Napali coast and into the canyons in the center of Kauai.  What a view!

review_title: Kauai - the best way to see it !!!
review_text: Awesome service!!! The flight was thrilling and the only way to see the island is from above !!!!!  Fantastic time.
use pilots who are good with working the rudder, as in tailwheel airplanes.  It usually lowers the barf rate.  (I am a retired flight instructor; 22 years)

The ride and airplane were good. The taller person should sit on the outside of the traveled route so that he or she can see despite what the pilot says. My wife was on the outside and couldn't see much. A suitable cushion for short people would be a good idea. The voice activated microphones were very noisy because of the wind and we could not here much of the pilot commentary. A press to talk type might be better.

Thanks Air Venture ohana crew, especially JT the pilot☺it was the best sky adventure ever and both my friend and I had an awesome 1 hour sightseeing flight to experience the spectacular beauty of Waimea canyon, NaPali coast line, waterfalls and a lot more from the sky
Was amazing! Saw all sorts of stuff from Waimea to Na Pali coast, flying low and slow, getting a full view of the beauty

This excursion was one of the highlights of our trip to Hawaii.  We were a group of 8 and Jill, Ray and JT were so accommodating.  They went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable. Their professionalism was outstanding.  We would highly recommend this company. :)

review_title: Great way to see the island
review_text: Go for the private tour if you can swing it (up to three people plus the pilot). A very relaxed way to see the beautiful island of Kauai. They do the same loop as the helicopter tours but it’s much quieter (relatively) and you get your own window. Great group of folks too (owners and pilots). Next time, we have to try their supercool biplane...

We went on the bi-plane open cockpit adventure with Harry! This was my favorite activity from our Kauai trip. What an awesome perspective to experience every part of the island. Harry was an excellent pilot and very knowledgeable about the island and its history. We were able to explore around the island by land and sea prior to our flight. I thought this was great because I could reference all of the places we had been. If you are thinking about it you should book it!
Excellent experience! The pilot was friendly, knowledgeable, and accommodating. Would definitely suggest and recommend to others!
Spectacular experience! Expérience extraordinaire! Paysages incroyables pouvant être vus seulement dans les airs. Pilote super sympathique ainsi que sa femme!

Had a wonderful air tour of Kaua'i thanks to Air Ventures and our expert pilot, Harry. Smooth ride over all the amazing sights of the island with expert commentary. The Na Pali coast was breathtaking!

We had a great flight in "Woodstock", the bright yellow biplane that Kevin flies. First he gave us a little background about the plane, then a cockpit tour, then pictures with the plane, and then we loaded up and took off. Two people sit side by side in the cockpit right behind the motor, with the pilot in the back. Head gear with headphones are provided so you can talk back and forth to the pilot (all you need to complete the outfit is a scarf). Also because you're sitting right behind the motor there's no need for a jacket. Kevin has been on the island for about 30 years, so he can describe all the sites you fly over, and give you a great history and geography lesson at the same time. It's not a great flight to take if you want a ton of pictures because it's hard to get the camera at the right angle because of the placement of the wings, but instead, just ride along and enjoy the view. We had a blast! At the end of the flight we had our picture taken in the plane, so we have something to prove we were real aviators for a day. All the staff were very friendly and Kevin was a very competent pilot. We highly recommend this tour.

We arrived in Kauai on the NCL ship and had booked a flight around the Island with Air Ventures, instead of flying in a cabined plane decided to fly in the WACO biplane just for the fun and experience of an open cabin.
The WACO seat 2 people in the front and the pilot behind, what a great flight it was, Kevin out pilot knew the island like the back of his hand and showed us and explained everything.
We were saw so many great sites, Waimea Canyon, with its beautiful steep and colourful sides, many waterfalls, then along the Na Pali Coast where cliff rise almost vertical into the clouds, Beautiful isolated beaches protected by coral reefs, very fertile areas where coffee is grown, on around past fantastic fine waterfalls, small isolated villages and then across the island past the Mt. Wai ale ale  with more waterfalls, the wettest place in the world so Kevin tells us and part of the major volcano on the island, the flight was approx. 1 hour and it is the only way to see many parts of this beautiful island because of no access o motor vehicles, across past the ship in port before returning to the airport .
If you are going to Kauai and want to do these flight book direct as by the ship it will cost.
They are only too happy to discuss your need, and great people as well.
While we did the flight to younger ones went kayaking.
KenS
It was a blast!  My whole family really enjoyed flying with JT and Eric. It was very informative and showed a lot more of the island than you could see by car.
One of the best things we have done!  The team was awesome and Kevin was super knowledgeable.  Mahalo!

Kevin was a bundle of information!!!! We enjoyed seeing a lot of sights from the air that we saw from the ground. We also saw so much more!!!! We loved every minute. Just wish it could have gone longer!!!!

We were visiting Kauai with cruise ship-I had researched doing a flight over Kauai and it can be a little pricey. We had our kids -17-14 & 7 with us. So for 5 it was a small fortune. I came across Air Ventures and the reviews were excellent and as usual trip advisor reviews were spot on.  We arrived Friday little before 8- we were all weighed in-met Capt. Eric few pics and we were on our way. A little over an hour flight & without repeating other reviews it was as amazing way to see the island-the Napoli Coast was stunning. The waterfalls and the lush landscape-crater -movie spots.... I could go on and on . Our girls thought it was amazing -towards the end the 7 year old became little nauseous but we were getting ready to land so all was ok. Eric was very quick and had cold towels on board & water. It was little warm on plane so wear comfortable clothing and eat a very light breakfast. Eric was a wonderful pilot and really made the flight with all his knowledge. This is a family owned company and they want you enjoy your flight. I didn’t book through them directly wish I had though as they would have picked us up from port-but taxi wasn’t much to the location- and they kindly dropped us back off. You won’t be sorry it was one of the highlights of our trip. I even got to help land the plane-totally awesome experience! Thank you Eric & everyone at Air Ventures for making our trip and time in Kauai so special.

The staff here was so friendly!!! JT was our pilot and he was awesome! He knew my oldest daughter was nervous so he would go around the areas that would cause turbulence and he flew where we could see everything but not be in the middle of them. I highly recommend this if you are in the area!! Thank you JT for an awesome flight!!!!

My wife and I enjoyed this scenic air tour. Really great views of all the beautiful places. I am a pilot and was very impressed with Capt Eric's flying skills and tour guide moderator. The barrel roll was excellent... ONLY Kidding GREAT ride from take off to landing.
Thank you

plane ride was outstanding and our pilot/guide TJ (? or JT (sorry) was very good narrated the area and mountain and valley scenes

My husband & I booked this tour and we had so much fun. Kevin was our pilot and he was an excellent tour guide. The staff there are very knowledgeable and friendly. We would definitely recommend Air Ventures Hawaii to anyone looking for a fun adventure in Kauai Island!! Thanks!!
Best way to see the island! Great friendly staff and pilot / tour guide. So much of the island is inaccessible this is literally the only way to see the island. So many hidden waterfalls!

Our pilot, TJ, was great at giving us a tour of Kauai! Told us important information about the island, and made sure that both sides of the plane got to see important land marks. We got beautiful pictures throughout the tour and even got a few rainbows. There were a couple other passengers on the plane and they said they like the plane tour better than the helicopter tour they had last time. My 8 year old enjoyed the tour too!

review_title: Best aerial tour of Kauai - outstanding in every respect!
review_text: Ditch the helicopters and go for adventure! The 2017 WACO bi-plane (built in Battle Creek, MI) is by far the most amazing way to appreciate the beauty of Kauai from the air. Pilot Harry provides informative narration as you climb out of Lihue airport and head west to see all the sites while experiencing the magic of the open-air cockpit. Two passengers are connected by head set to communicate with Harry, while the cooling ocean breeze adds to the ambience. The spectacular vistas pass beneath -- from the magnificent waterfalls, pristine sandy beaches, ranches, farms and, of course, the Na'Pali coast. We've been coming to Kauai (and own here) for some time, and look forward to our next adventure with AirVentures on their unique bi-plane.

Fabuleux ! Passées les premières angoisses de naviguer dans un biplan à cockpit ouvert, on se prend vite au jeu de la découverte de l'île qui est ans doute une des plus belles de l'archipel d'Hawaï. L'équipe est accueillante et sympathique ce qui vous met tout de suite à l'aise et vous propose gentiment de vous prendre en photo avec vos appareils, devant et dedans l'avion. Oui, il y a deux places pour les passagers devant et le pilote est à l'arrière.
L'avion est une merveille qui vous rappellera les bons vieux biplans du début de l'aviation mais bien entendu, il s'agit d'une réplique et la sécurité est au rendez-vous. Le pilote se transforme en un très bon guide touristique et nous avons survolé toute l'île et profité de tous les différents paysages, y compris ceux qui ne sont pas accessibles en voiture ou en bateau. Contrairement à une idée reçue, nous n'avons pas eu froid du tout, le cockpit nous protégeant très bien ainsi que le casque et lunettes vintage.
Je recommande vivement
The biplane ride was an awesome ride,a ride of a lifetime. They were all so kind and made us feel like family. Personal pickup near the cruise ship. Hats off to our pilot, Kevin

Auch das Team am Boden ist super freundlich und hilfsbereit.
Gerne wieder.

Br,
Corinne and Werner

The biplane was incredible. The pilot Harry was great, professional and extremely informative. The middle of the island leaves you speechless. Highly recommend to anyone wether you are local or visiting. Seeing everything from that perspective is beyond words.

The pilot was great he had a lot of information on the plane tour of Kauai island it was raining at the time I got a little motion sickness but very memorable experience n the views was just breathtaking

Mike Samac

Son un matrimonio que se gestionan su propio negocio, y la verdad que son geniales, nos atendieron de maravilla. Sobrevolar Kauai en una réplica exacta de una avioneta de la segunda guerra mundial es espectacular. Lo recomiendo al 100% sin duda.

Thank you very much for this excursion! Kauai is most beuatyfull hawaiian island!
We like so much this flight!
The plane is comfortable.  The views are special. The people of Air Ventures were friendly and answered all of our questions. Could not ask for a better air tour.
My friend and I took the flight and had an excellent time.  I highly recommend it.  Worth every penny.
Outstanding trip. I am petrified of flying but the pilot explained what to expect at all times. Excellent views and commentary throughout. Would definitely recommend.

review_title: My First Small Airplane Ride - WOW!
review_text: I have flown for business for decades, but never had the opportunity to ride in a six passenger plane before. What an experience. Kevin, our pilot, was the best. I had just taken a helicopter tour of the island the day before and loved it so much I decided to try the small plane. The plane ride proved to be even better than the helicopter. Super way to see the island, and determine if there are sights you’d like to see more of. Although J.T. is relatively new to Kauai, he had good knowledge of the sights we flew over. Really enjoyed it.

From setting the trip up with Jill to flying with JT, this was an awesome experience for my family of four.  Flying through Waimea Canyon, aside the glorious Napali Coast and over waterfalls was magical.

The ride was smooth, the views were outstanding and the entire crew had two things on their mind: your safety and your pleasure.  Both were handled expertly.  Do this and enjoy talking about it later.

Booking was so easy, despite some trouble from my end. Airventures was very patient and helpful. The flight was AWESOME! After reading some reviews, my wife was worried that the seat would be a tight fit, but there was honestly enough room for the both of us. Our pilot made sure we say plenty from both sides of the plane and took plenty of time to circle some of Kauai's greatest sights! I would easily recommend this to anyone interested a beyond-the-normal experience.
It was an epic flight with Tom. The island is very nice but if you are in the clouds the sight is even more fantastic. Thanks for Air Venture for this cool flight!!!

So glad we booked our plane ride with Air Ventures. The staff are so nice and friendly and our pilot Eric was great.  Even though my daughter got motion sick, she even said she is glad we went!  Great way to see the island especially the Napali Coast.  Definitely worth the money.

Had a great adventure.  Eric was an excellent pilot.  He got us as close up as possible to the sights without scaring the crap out of me.  Loved the whole experience.  Everyone was so friendly and nice

I sat in a good seat to see everything but my husband saw a lot of the ocean. I have it all on my gopro  but it's not quite the same. Scenery is AWESOME. A little air-sick but that's on me. TJ is a great pilot and tour guide.
This tour of Kauai was excellent!  Pilot was great and narrated all the key points over our headphones.   Six seater airplane, seats are tight overall.  I got lucky and had the most legroom.

If you don’t have the time to visit the whole Island, this is the way to see it!  You get to see the beaches, ports, canyons, farms, ranches, falls etc.  The colors are absolutely beautiful, blue waters, green fields and trees, red canyons.
The pilot will point out all the areas of interest. Don’t miss it!
This was the highlight of our tour of Kauai. TJ and Harry were great pilots!  Gave all the passengers in the plane the best views for pictures. Great value. Easy to make arrangements over the phone.

Even though we had some cloudy conditions, our pilot, Eric, managed to find us some glorious views of the NaPali coast and numerous waterfalls in the canyons.  The staff on the ground were friendly and helpful as well.  This was a repeat tour for us (previous one 2 years ago) so we were expecting a great tour and got one!
My son and I went up on the biplane ride and we had a brilliant time 5 stars was a memory that neither of us will forget

review_title: Beware of them trying to trap you into flying on a terrible day.
review_text: I booked a private bi-plane tour for myself and my girlfriend several days in advance.  On the morning of my flight it was raining heavily in Princeville, with a 300 foot ceiling. Lihue, our take off airport a few miles away was reporting 1300 broken, 3000 ft. overcast with rain showers in the area.  The real time GOES satellite image showed Kauai completely covered with clouds - even the Napali Coast which typically has better weather - and the real reason you pay for a flight seeing tour in Kauai.  I had NO desire to go flying in an open cockpit plane in the clouds and rain and get soaking wet and potentially hypothermic.  It's unfortunate the weather was NOT VFR (Visual Flight Rules) but that didn't matter to the nasty Jill, who is their operations manager.  When I informed her I was cancelling - 1.5 hours before the flight - she went into an absolute uncontrolled rage, told me they were going to charge my credit card in full, then HUNG UP on me!  Great customer service...  I know their game:  you show up for your flight and they take you on an abbreviated *airplane* ride, instead of the full island circle tour as promised.  Too bad for you... you signed off on it before you get on board.  I guess Jill isn't used to dealing with a highly experienced (34 years and counting) instrument rated pilot - only clueless tourists that she is able to trap into flying with her threats and nasty attitude.  Do yourself a favor and book with another company like I did.  Oh, and Jill:  Get some anger management counseling - you're out of control.

We had an amazing tour.  Just after the huge rain storms, the waterfalls were filled with water, the greenery was lush and bright.  All the photos and views were incredible.  We were on the six seater plane and our pilot was respectful of all passengers and made sure we all saw every site.  She was cheerful and filled with enthusiasm.
We highly recommend Air Ventures. The flight was just amazing with incredible views. Worth every $!!

What an amazing crew, so so accommodating and friendly!! Our pilot Eric was excellent and we felt safe throughout the flight! Jill was amazing with our 2 year old. Will definitely recommend Air Ventures to friends and family!

Ray is really an awesome pilot!He took us right up close to some cliffs,mountains,waterfalls,valleys and beaches without any kind of danger.You feel safe with Ray flying you.He gives detailed explanations of the stories and history of the places you fly over,as well as a very informative overview of Kauai's incredible history!Fly with him,you will be SO GLAD you did!!YOU DON'T WANT TO MISS THIS ONE!!!!
The airplane ride was my favorite part of the trip, and the chance to fly it, even for a moment, was the highlight of my fiances trip. Highly recommend!

i must preface this review by saying all staff at AirVentures are pros, friendly, acomodating, totally focused on you as their customer. our trip was done on a very windy day, causing a very bumpy trip. My friend got sick 15 minutes into our journey, and the last 45 minutes were hell for her. the two seats up front are super tight as far as comfort goes. one other problem was communication. we both had head sets connecting us to the pilot. when pointing out areas of interest it was hard to hear him. and we were never told how to talk to our partners. But this was only the bi-plane experience. I am sure the rest of their excursions are great, as as there reviews show.
great flight some good photos and views of the island, the waterfalls and the landscape the only way to see it all

review_title: The Na Pali high above tour
review_text:
I've  now seen the Na Pali coast 4 ways, by plane,by car, by cruise ship and by tour boat.  All were beautiful and interesting but clearly the most dramatic was by Air Ventures Hawaii.  The smooth flight high above the coast was breathtaking.  The perspective was unlike any of the others and most memorable.  Weather was good. Visibility was excellent to see what was truly an amazing site.
Our pilot/guide, Eric, was interesting, knowledgeable, entertaining and made an effort to inform us ahead of

Took a tour of the island in the vintage design Waco Biplane (though the airplane is brand new).   The cockpit and passenger compartments are “open” to the air, which allow you to take in the warm air and different climates of the island.  It also makes photographs look great without glass in the way.  A one of a kind experience you wont find elsewhere!

review_title: Perfect weather for over an hour's fantastic flight over Kauai!
review_text: Our very competent pilot Ray has a great sense of humor and a talent for explaining the background to the amazing sights of the beautiful island of Kauai.  Of course we were lucky that the weather (not too sunny not too cloudy) made sure we enjoyed the sights on a smooth flight.  We would certainly do it again!

The biplane island tour was the highlight of our weeks vacation!  The service was great and the plane is awesome.  It's a great way to see the whole island.  It rained a little bit but we didn't get wet.  The windshield gave us a lot of protection.  Two thumbs up!!

review_title: Wonderful experience! Amazing views! Smooth as silk...
review_text: So glad we did this (instead of the helicopter)... Quiet, smooth, amazing views of Kauai! Everyone has a window seat... Guided tour with excellent explanations! Loved, loved, loved it!

From my very first call to Air Ventures to schedule our flight Jill was so kind and helpful! We were on a cruise and I called her when we arrived. Due to a mandatory inspection our flight time had to be changed. She tried so hard to reach me to let me know(no free internet or phone on the ship) she held two spots for us on the next flight! She went above and beyond and even offered to pick us up! She gave us a few suggestions of places to see in the area while we waited! Now about the flight...it was FANTISTIC! Our pilot Eric was great at pointing out and describing what we were seeing! We saw from the air what you cannot see any other way! There were numerous waterfalls,Hanakapiai and sites used in Fantacy Island and Jurasic Park, Waimea Canyon,the NapoliCoast! The scenery was absolutely beautiful!I have never been in a helicopter so I cannot compare! What I will say is that the flight is twice as long at half the price!! A must do in Kauai!
Absolutely Fantastic!  Our Pilot was so good and knew his stuff about the island.  We would recommend your company to everyone!  It was a great experience! Well worth the money!

Owners Jill and Ray went out of their way to make my friend and I feel very welcome. We arrived early and on a Sunday. We took the bi plane ride. What an experience !  I highly recommend both Air Ventures and the bi plane on your trip to Kauai.     Stephen, Canada

What a great and enjoyable day! Eric our pilot was personable and knowledgeable regarding Kauai, flying over the dramatic Na Pali coast, the devastation of the storm that affected Hanalei area, the numerous waterfalls, etc was a different perspective from the air - beautiful, dramatic & totally amazing!
Thank you for a wonderful experience 😎
a good time Eric great pilot and personalable, Jill and Kaycee awesome woman.  Seeing the island this way was the best way.

This was an amazing experience, what a fantastic way to see the island.  That said if you are scared of heights, get motion sick easy or are both on the larger side this may not be the excursion for you.  Everyone else should do it, especially if you are into planes.  Its a little more expensive but its private and worth it. The service was excellent and it was super easy to book then catch a connecting flight to another island.

We truly enjoyed this flight, too bad my phone powered off in the middle of it and took forever to come back up so lost out on a lot of great pictures. We took the helicopter ride last time on the island and even though you can get a lot closer to the falls you get a more limited view of the island, I also got motion sick on that trip so this was just so much more enjoyable. Thank you!

review_title: Wonderful biplane tour with Kevin as excellent pilot and insightful guide
review_text: We did a 1-hour tour in the beautiful Waco biplane. It was a wonderful and also funny experience that gave us a different view and perspective of the island. The plane itself is wonderful worth the experience on its own, and with Kevin as knowledgeable and skilled pilot and with very kind Airventures staff at the check-in counter this is a memory we will cherish for long. A wonderful finish to our stay in Kauai.

This was the highlight of our trip to the Hawaiian islands. The team is superb in every way. Kind, professional yet personable, skilled, and made you feel at ease about the experience. Total confidence in the aircraft maintenance, skill of the pilot, and customer service. Well worth the price, in fact with the photos I was able to capture, I consider it a bargain! Make this a priority for your trip to Kauai!

Our pilot Eric was very professional and polite. Provided info on all the local sites and things to do on the island. Very experienced and competent pilot. I would know, I am a pilot myself. Loved the experience and would definitely recommend it!
This was the best experience - breathtaking views, great commentary and excellent value.  We all had a fantastic time.

Great experience with knowledgeable and caring pilot.  Views of Napoli Coast and Waimea Canyon only available by air.  However, I was unable to keep the plane’s wings out of most of the pictures. Having taken a helicopter over the Big Island, I was disappointed in not getting closer to the amazing views.

Desi, our enthusiastic pilot, took full advantage of the wonderful weather at the time of our excursion.  She showed us the beautiful island of Kauai, sharing with us information on the areas of the island including food tips.  We’re glad this was the first thing we did in Kauai.  It gave us an overview of how to spend the rest of our time in the island.  By the way, Desi landed the plane ever so gently.

Ask for Eric.  He knows his stuff, loves the island, and gives everyone a great view.  The plane flight is better than a helicopter and the ride is longer.  We flew in and out of the canyons, craters, and coasts like we were on a TV show.  Very smooth and comfortable flight.
Biplane was awesome! highly recommend it with great customer service!! We felt safe the entire time.
Ray and his wife were super accommodating and very friendly. We got to see sights from the air that we visited on the ground.

review_title: BEST WAY TO SEE THE INTIRE ISLAND OF KAUAI
review_text: It was amazing to see the beautiful Island of Kauai.We almost went on a helicopter tour but decided on the plane and I think it was better. It was actually not as fast so I think we were able to check things out longer if we wanted. Ray was our pilot and he has lived their for almost 20 years so he was very informative. I would highly recommend doing this while in Kauai!

The flight around Kauai with Air Ventures and pilot Eric was incredible. Eric did a great job of telling us all about the Island as he made sure we all had first class views of the wonderful Garden Island. It was a great way to receive an overview of the island and he pointed out places we might want to drive to later. Thank you for a great ride.

review_title: You Need to FLY over Kauai
review_text: Thanks to Air Ventures Hawaii for a terrific experience.  You really MUST see the island from the air.  Our pilot Desi was so upbeat and fun....always smiling from ear to ear.  A wonderful experience...highly recommended.  One of the biggest highlights of our Hawaii vacation!

I couldn't be happier with my choice Air Ventures for our tour of the island in the air van, after flying with two of the three charters on the island here I can definitely vouch for Air Ventures. We had the chance to comment through the headset or even ask for a go-around on the best views! Thank you Air Ventures, we really enjoyed our time this spring!!!

Great experience, very comfortable ride, great views, pilot Eric was great. would highly recommend.In previous years we have done the helicopter tour and if i was doing it the first time i would do the helicopter tour it gets closer to the scenery,

review_title: Part of North Shore Limo Service Land, Boat, & Air Combo tour

Our pilot, Dezi, was awesome and the air tour of the island was spectacular!  A little expensive, but well worth it!!

Desi flew the plane beautifully and we saw waterfalls galore and a humpback whale jumping in the ocean. Spectacular views. Very good deal for what you get. Thank you for the group photo too!

Flight was a fantastic tour, with a professional pilot that made the flight smooth while avoiding the areas where we could see rain and might have caused discomfort. review_title: Awesome views on Air Venture Tours

review_title: A great way to see Kauai!
review_text: Amazing!  Our pilot, Desi, was fantastic, very enthusiastic and made sure she provided everyone with views of each point of interest.  I would highly recommend them!

This was an amazing adventure. Gorgeous views and a very knowledgeable pilot. I will say...take something for nausea just in case because you don't want to miss anything by feeling a little sick. I Would totally recommend this to anyone!!
Great views of the Island - far better value than helicopters and safer.  Kevin our Pilot guide was tremendous
Definitely the highlight of our visit to Kauai. Kevin, our pilot, was so knowledgeable! Flew around entire island to see stunning views. Can’t say enough good things about it.

review_title: Best view of Kauai. A must do!
review_text: An experience of a lifetime! Kevin is a fabulous guide and and the views are spectacular! This is a must do activity in Kauai!

This was our first tour on Kauai.  Our pilot, Kevin, was very knowledgeable of everything he showed us. Lots of waterfalls and even got to see a couple of humpback whales.  Fabulous views of Waimea Canyon!

But, well worth the snuggle.

review_title: Amazing experience with Air Ventures Hawaii
review_text: Must do in Kauai with Air Ventures Hawaii! You will never forget how beautiful Kauai is and pilot from Air Ventures Hawaii did beyond and above!
This was an amazing tour, the staff is extremely friendly and helpful and the tour was very good. No doubt we will take it again.

review_title: I'm 55 and it was the funnest thing I have EVER done
review_text: WOW , the day we were schedule to go it was cloudy so they gave us the option to go or reschedule, so we did, the day we went was so beautiful, and the ride in the Biplane was awesome ..... can't wait to go again.......

Excellent mid-day ride on a nice day.  Great view of the Na Pali coastline, seeing quite a few whales.   Look forward to doing it again.

I was apprehensive but it wasn't long before I was taken in the the breathtaking views. Open air cockpit, the sights and a knowledgeable guide, this makes for a memorable trip. We did a complete loop of the island and the interior too. Thanks Harry!

review_title: Great view of the whole island!
review_text: Enjoyed the higher overview of the island than the helicopters provided. Still able to see whales. Great commentary but not too much!

review_title: A Must Do Adventure in Kauai
review_text:

A very smooth ride that isn't as jerky as the helicopter ride and very comfortable and warm in the open air cockpit. The open views with the nostalgic helmet and goggles was astounding. We covered every part of the Island.
Harry is a tremendous pilot, tour guide and enjoys himself every time out. We would do this every time we are on the Island. Pictures cannot do this ride justice. Awesome.

review_title: Old Alaskan Bush Pilot Takes a Ride Over Kauai
review_text: This was the highlight of our trip.  AirVentures handled all arrangements with no hitches.  I'd highly recommend this trip to anyone who wants to see Kauai from the air. Bucket list experience! My wife and I truly enjoyed the flight. We had no issues getting our 50 something year old bodies in and out of the biplane.

review_title: One of the best things we did on our trip to Kaua!
review_text: The 5 of us totally enjoyed the flights and sights of the trip.  Desi was extremely knowledgeable as well as entertaining as she narrated the sights of Kauai.  I would recommend using Air Ventures without hesitation to anyone.

review_title: This is the best air tour, forget the rest!
review_text:
We had the best customer service I think I have ever experienced. The flight over the island was amazing but made really special by the hospitality we received.

We had the friendliest service ever by really genuine people who seem totally engaged with giving us the best possible experience, which is exactly what we got.

Jill went over and above our expectations and really went the extra mile to make the flight happen for us which we really appreciated.

Kevin was a great pilot, his knowledge of the island is amazing, he really put us at ease and made the flight feel safe, very informative and fun.

If you are planning on doing a Kauai scenic flight forget the rest, Air Ventures are the absolute best, I can't recommend them enough!

What a great adventure riding in bi-plane around Kauai!  Had a beautiful day and the Bi Plane ride was great!  The pilot was very knowledgeable about the whole island.  The staff was very friendly and helpful.  We will probably take this ride again!

Die Tour von Air Ventures Hawaii auf Kauai ist sehr empfehlenswert, denn sie ist eine sehr gute Alternative zu den teuren Helikopterflügen. Max und Ruth, Schweiz
We have been on helicopter tours with doors on and doors off, the bi-plane was a totally different and good experience. Talk about up close and personal.

We took an hour flight to get a birds eye view of Kauai. Our pilot, Harry, was awesome. He provided a great overview of the unique sites. The open cockpit was a real rush. All the staff were welcoming and made sure we were well taken care of. Good job Air Hawaii!
The Air Adventures has been our favorite.  The beauty of the island from the air was spectacular.  Eric was a great pilot.  Thank you for a great experience.

review_title: Great plane ride to see Kauai
review_text: We had a great time seeing Kauai by plane. Our pilot Desi (sp?) made our plane ride fun, informative, and comfortable.

We has the good fortune to have very experienced, Eric, as our pilot guide.  Everyone in the small plane (7 seater) gets a window seat and Eric was very cognizant of making sure both sides of the plane got to see fabulous views.  We saw whales/dolphins, countless waterfalls, dramatic canyons, and stunning coastlines.  The ride was rougher than expected but Eric was well prepared for potential motion sickness.  At the end, none of our kids tossed cookies and we got to see things you can only access by air.  A definite highlight of the Kauai vacation!

review_title: Best value to view the island
review_text: Impressed with the friendliness and professionalism of all the staff.  Our pilot, Harry, gave us a smooth flight,  pointed out the sites, and went out of his way to fly over humpback whales.  Everyone gets a window seat so the viewing is spectacular.
I'm glad I did the airplane tour instead of the helicopter.  It's more comfortable and all 5 of us had a window view.
Great experience. Very competent, friendly and informative pilot. Very organized company. Equipment well maintained

What a great way to see Kauai! It was absolutely stunning, the people who work for the company are very caring and accommodating. The weather hadn’t been on our side during the week and we were still able to go the day we were leaving! Absolutely recommend!

My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed the bi-plane flight.  It's a great way to view the island and the pilot  was very informative.  The ride is slow and steady; not the least bit frightening. The only drawback was the cockpit design.  We are both mature and getting in and out was a challenge.  Also, the seat is low and the view was slightly obstructed.  Overall, I still recommend it for those that are looking for an adventure.

My wife and I flew with Eric our pilot over Kauai and had the most wonderful time, Eric is very knowledgable and has a great sense of humor. All the office girls are wonderful also: (Casey and Jill). I highly recommend going with Air Ventures on your flight over Kauai.

review_title: What an Elegant way to Fly and see Kauai!
review_text: Our pilot, Kevin, was great!  And so was the friendly staff!  His skill, expertise and knowledge of the lay of the land, excellent. I was totally unfamiliar with bi planes, and had to be convinced to fly in one, now, after this experience, I wouldn't do it any other way.  Take off and landing were smooth as silk.  The pilot imparted just the right amount of information and back story to enhance the enjoyment of what we were seeing. We even flew over our house!  What a beautiful plane! Well maintained.  You can tell this company loves what they do!  Great experience over a beautiful island!
We had a great flight. Our pilot, Eric , did a great job of showing the beautiful scenery. I would highly recommend this trip, if you really want to see the real Hawaii.

review_title: Absolutely fantastic tour- best way to experience Kauai!!
review_text: Not only was booking super-simple but the company bent over backwards to reschedule us when our original  tour had to be cancelled due to weather. We were on a cruise ship and we were picked up and delivered back to port right on schedule. All 8 of us who took part agreed it was the highlight of our Hawaiian vacation.  Highly recommended!
We had an amazing tour with knowledgeable staff with great personalities!!! We will definitely be visiting again! Thank you guys so much!
Desie did a wonderful job piloting and pointing out the sights.  Good views for everyone and fun for all,.
Great way to see the island. Flying around, over and in the canyons was smazing. The comentary by the pilot was great. Well worth the price!

Our Pilot, Desi, made our son's day. Our son hasDown Syndrome, and Desi made him, her co-pilot. He still talks about it & says it was his favorite thimg done on our vacation. For us, the tour was very informative, enjoyable, beautiful scenery & just plain fun. Not only would. we fly with Air Ventures again, we would ask for Desi again. Thanks, Desi, for making Bill's day & vacation.
Our pilot was so nice and knowledgeable! We truly enjoyed our flight and the amazing views! I would highly recommend this attraction!

Best way to see the island of Kauai.  Highly recommend this company.  Our pilot was very professional and experienced..  felt quite safe in his hands and he was extremely knowledgeable about Kauai as well.

I was stoked to see the Jurassic Falls and that was the main reason why I went on this tour and of course, to see the beautiful island. Our pilot was super friendly and kind, we liked her.  My husband and I really enjoyed the tour and it was a beautiful sight to see. Totally worth it and the price is great!!

I didn't think I'd ever get my wife up in a biplane (I think she did it to humor me) but that plane ride was the highlight of our Kauai trip.  Thanks to Kevin we enjoyed every moment (though my wife got a little green when we flew up a windy canyon on the north side of the island).  Beautiful views, great flight (though the weather was dreary), and a great guide ... if we ever get back to Kauai we will probably do it again (and will ask for Kevin).

Our tour of Kauai from the air was Fantastic.  Our pilot, Desi, was a true professional and also a great tour guide.  Her enthusiasm and energetic personality made for a very fun time.  Would recommend this tour to everyone visiting Kauai.
Our pilot Harry was the best! Me and my husband came for his 30th and it was just amazing! The flight was beautiful fun and very thrilling.

Ein absolutes Muss. Wir hatten spontan einen "Privat Flight" gebucht und nicht bereut. Unser Pilot Eric hat uns die Insel gezeigt und viel dazu erzählt. Von der Beratung bis zum Flug fühlten wir uns super betreut.

A pristine, and just down right beautiful plane, and a wonderful tour of Kauai provided by Harry.  We definitely could have spent the day in this vintage aircraft as we flew through both sun and rain and ogled many magical waterfalls, deep canyons, azure seas, coral reefs, jagged peaks, pristine beaches, coffee plantations and craters. Definitely a tight fit in the cockpit, but that just gives the adventure all the more charm. Whoo Hoo!

review_title: A beautiful Day- What a way to see the Island!
review_text: Although it was an overcast day - Desi gave a fantastic flight so we could see the beauty of the Garden Isle- She was patient and answered all questions and was a delight the entire tour - Terrific trip - recommend highly

We flew over the island of Kauai with Eric and was highlight of our trip. People at Air Ventures couldn't have been nicer or more accommodating. Would do it again in a heartbeat.  Best way to see the island.

Had a delightful trip yesterday flying over Kaua’i with our new BFF Eric.  Eric’s knowledge of the island and care to make sure everyone had a view of everything really added to our enjoyment.  We saw waves, beaches, canyons, rainbows, waves, mountains, and caves— awesome views!  Highly recommend this trip.

If you only have time for one adventure while on Kauai you must do the biplane tour.  The tour is very personal and the pilot, Kevin in this case, will provide great information about the island the sights you are seeing.  I plan in booking this trip again on our return to Kauai.
If you are looking for an alternative to Kauai helicopter tours I would highly recommend this - the view was fantastic, and the commentary excellent. A highlight of my holiday on the island.

I have flown in many small planes, but nothing compares to flying in an open cockpit biplane.  This is what real flying is all about.

Highlights included Poipu beach, Waimea Canyon and the Princeville area before flying cross country over the jungle back to Lihue Airport.  

The best part of the trip was flying out over the Niipali coast, and watching humpback whales breaching the surface and splashing back down.  The pilot, who was excellent through the whole trip, circled around three or four times to let us watch the whales play.

Everybody should do this trip.
À faire pour avoir une idée de la beauté des canyons,des cascades,des plages et ainsi organiser le reste du séjour en choisissant les lieux à visiter.. pilote sympa malgré la barrière de la langue

We had a beautiful day to fly and our pilot was great.  We also got lots of great pictures of the island.  There was lots of rain the day before and the day after our trip.  I guess we just lucked out and got a sunny day for our flight.  So much fun to be in the sky looking down on beautiful Kauai!

We were on a cruise and decided to schedule this sightseeing flight with only 2 days advance notice.  They were able to work us into the schedule with no problem.  Our pilot Eric was awesome.  He was friendly and funny and genuinely seemed to want us to have a good time.  And the rest of the staff was also friendly and professional.  The AirVan offered incredible views and Eric tried to make sure that both sides of the plane could enjoy the scenery.  He even circled around a couple of times when we spotted some whales playing in the ocean.  Overall this was one of the top highlights from our vacation and we would do it again in a heartbeat.  Cannot recommend enough.

review_title: We Will Remember this for Years!!!
review_text: Such a fantastic experience on a (rare) perfect blue day!!  Lovely pilot (Desi) and very good value for money for a 70 min flight.
Flew around the island and saw waterfalls green call us and even a whale. Our pilot even let me have the feel of flying the plane on our final approach.

This was such a great 1 hour flight around the island.  Our pilot was Harry who did a wonderful job explaining everything about the island as we flew over.
On the ground, our interaction was with Angela who was so friendly and had a great customer service attitude.
Highly recommend.

review_title: Best thing we did in Hawaii!
review_text:
Company was referred to us by another, who could not accommodate plus size. 
These folks picked up up at Anchor Cove Mall (free shuttle from cruise ship), fast ride to airport. 
Eric was our pilot, and he did not disappoint. He was very in tune with the three of us with him in the cabin that day. He saw my friend have a very momentary stomach blip- checked in with him. Saw me wiping eyes, checked in with me. I was just teary from the awe-inspiring views. Extremely responsive. 
Directed each of our attention to views we'd have, but also maneuvered expertly so that we all got the views! Reacted quickly to changing conditions, taking advantage of opportunities to go after sights that unexpectedly came up. Some of the most superlative beauty I have ever beheld. 
Anyone who says you "can't see anything" from a small plane... is trying to sell you a helicopter trip, lol. I'd be back up in a heartbeat. 
Then our driver back responded to unexpected traffic backups by taking the scenic route- and it really was! Nobody on it, either- he knew his back roads. Also liked that they worked as a team- our second driver was also a pilot.
The plane tour was AMAZING and Ari, our pilot had so much information.  We really had a fantastic time and are thankful the weather cleared so we could take the flight!

Our pilot Desi was amazing!! She had so much knowledge of the island 🌴 and shared fun facts & information throughout the flight. The views were spectacular and we felt very comfortable and safe during our flight! It was a Highlight of our trip to Kauai!
What a wonderful day for a flight and we could not have asked for a better pilot, so talented and not to mention a knock out too .!!!!

What an amazing time ! Flying in style in the open air cockpit  with our pilot Kevin over the stunning views of Kauai!  So worth it! A must activity to add to your itinerary.
Mahalo AirVentures and Kevin for this adventure that will be forever remembered.

The only way to fly.  We had a great time and the flight was complete. Kevin is a great host as narrator and pilot. Their planes are excellent viewing platforms for all passengers. Staff in setting it all up was super. Next time we try the biplane. It was a smooth ride, Kevin pays attention to that so all have an enjoyable flight.
We had a beautiful sunny day for our flight which certainly helped as the scenery was absolutely stunning from the air.  Desi was delightful as our pilot and tour guide.

review_title: Yes, you can ride in an open cockpit biplane.
review_text: This was something I always wanted to do but never thought possible. A beautiful ride with my wife.  Quite smooth with good views of the island.

We've done them both, the fixed wing plane experience is way superior. Everyone gets a better view, the plane is way quieter and our pilot Desi was awesome. She's not just a great pilot she's a super tour guide. Very informative and knowledgable. Great experience and saw everything there was to see!

We had a wonderful experience.  Our pilot, Kevin, has 29 years of flying with the company. He has a great fund of knowledge about the island and gave a great tour. Casey at the desk was very friendly--when I called, there were no openings. About 5 minutes after the call, she called me back to tell me she had worked out a way for us to go.  The plane was comfortable, safety instructions were thorough.  I highly recommend Air Ventures--you will have a great time. Mike  2/9/18

The flight was spectacular, our pilot Desi was great. The staff was very friendly and helpful. 
We would definitely recommend Air Ventures.

Our flight over Kaua'i with our charming, skillful pilot was the best experience of our island vacation. She gave a most interesting and helpful account of what we could see below, and smoothly took us over all the promised natural wonders of Kaua'i. I strongly recommend Air Adventures.

I think this is the best way to see the island! We flew around the entire island, saw whales, numerous waterfalls, the beautiful Waimea Canyon. Our pilot Desi was informative and so very fun! I would definitely recommend this company to everyone.
Seeing Kauai by small plane was a delight.  Our beautiful, bright pilot, Desi, was wonderful.  The quiet, large views of the island were inspiring.
Perfect conditions, wonderful views, and interesting commentary.  We couldn't have asked for a better flight.  Different to a helicopter and equally good.
Great pilot, amazing views, and beautiful Kauai.  Would highly recommend this, I know we will be doing this again!

My husband and I loved this flight over Kauai with our pilot Harry. We spent two weeks on the island and had been told to take a helicopter ride, but since we had experience a biplane ride in Key West, we went with the biplane ride on Kauai. It was spectacular and would highly recommend this way to see the island.
Loved the airplane ride. Seeing Hawaii from the sky was an awesome experience.  Highly recommend it! The pilot was very good also!

our pilot was very friendly and knowledgeable..

I do not remember her name, young 24 y/o female pilot.

Great ride,great  clear day, This was my second time taking this flight and it was great again. Thanks Harry for the great and smooth ride. 
      I just wanted to comment that I get very nervous and anxiety sets in when I have to take any plane rides. and this Ride was the best. Harry is a great pilot and keeps you entertained with his great knowledge of the island.  Thanks for the great flight

Had a great time on this flight. The pilot was very knowledgeable and very fun. The flight was a bit bumpy due to weather but the pilot really calmed our nerves. It was cool to see the island from the air and I recommend it.

review_title: Great biplane flight - feel the wind and enjoy the view
review_text:
we had booked a biplane flight. If you do not hide behind the windshield, you can feel the wind and enjoy the flight in a different way a bit closer to nature. 
The flight was sometimes a little bit bumpy. But we enjoyed that very much. It is more the original feeling of flying.
This was an amazing way to see the island and very informative. We also saw whales and a complete circle rainbow (never even heard of a complete circle rainbow).
Harry was super pilot and great tour guide. He showed us the entire island. It was a most wonderful tour.

We had a fun time on this tour.  Would recommend this tour for anyone looking to see the island. This was our first trip to Kauai and we loved the views this service provided.  Thank you for the great time!!
An outstanding trip around Kaua’i.  Desi provided us with an experience that we won’t forget.  She was professional in her performance as a pilot and has a great personality.  Thanks!!

We were very fortunate to choose Air Ventures for our flight over Kauai. Choosing such an early morning flight and being a couple gave us a special surprise when we arrived - we were able to fly in the new 4 seater Cesna! Very comfortable and smooth flight, plus the great headphones made our pilots commentary clear and easy to enjoy.

The flight path sights were brilliant and really gave us a great perspective of the area we had covered earlier the week by car and foot. Our pilot really ensured we saw as much as possible. Of course the Napali Coast line was spectacular. To top the experience off the early morning light rain followed by morning low sunshine meant at the northern tip of the Napali Coast flying over the water with the sun low behind us a full circular rainbow was suspended below us. Our pilot jokingly told us to look below and find the end of the rainbow which of course to our amazement didn't exist. He flew around its huge circumference and I wished there had been an under aircraft mounted camera on the plane to have captured it's breathtaking beauty - my camera just couldn't take it all in!
Our flight was fabulous, the staff friendly and professional and such good value for money. 
If you are looking for an air experience in Kauai I would definitely contact Air Ventures!

Eric was an excellent pilot and kept us well informed of the Island's interesting views as well as being a great conversationalist and humorist.  All of the employees at Air Ventures Hawaii went out of their way to make us sure we enjoyed our time in the air and they were "highly" successful. Would recommend this company to anyone wanting the best value for their vacation dollars and the best scenery ever.

review_title: Sollte man sich nicht entgehen lassen
review_text: Gut organisiert, tolle Ausblicke auf die Insel, das haben wir nicht bereut. Könnte ich jedem uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen - und das, obwohl ich Flugangst habe!

Our flight was so much fun, and we were able to see much more of Kauai, than any previous flight.  Our pilot, Kevin, gave us a wonderful tour with brilliant in depth commentary along the way, with a very gentle landing.  Loved our bi-plane experience and for sure want to do it again.  This is the best way to experience the island of Kauai.

review_title: Great fun and best way to see the island!
review_text: Kevin was terrific and made the ride a lot of fun!  He is very knowledgeable about the island which was great.  We highly recommend this tour over a helicopter tour - you are out in the open which is a better visibility all around.  He also acted as our concierge - made some really good recommendations.

We had the best experience touring with Air Ventures!  We loved flying over Kauai - it gives such a different perspective to everything on the island!  Desi was such a great pilot and guide - we enjoyed that more than anything else we did on our vacation!

The crew was nice and helpful.  Our initial tour was rescheduled due to high winds.  We were offered another time slot the next day or a refund.  The pilot is great.  With the plane you can't get as close to the waterfalls and valleys as if a helicopter.  This excursion was priced reasonably, probably due to the this issue.  I would recommend overall.
We loved Desi's bubbly attitude and she was very informative. We want to bring our family and go again. Thanks!!!

review_title: Excellent !  Must do to see the whole island
review_text: Only way to see the whole island!  Great pilot , Harry.  Very informational and pleasant.  If do the combo land, air and water package.  Would skip the water, just a barge going up the river.

review_title: Great experience and so much fun!
review_text: Great way to see the island and a wonderful experience to be on a buplane. Pilot Kevin was excellent - very knowledgeable, friendly and funny. Staff were excellent - welcoming and making sure we were informed of everything. Plus they take photos of you on and near the plane! The views were somewhat hampered by the struts but not enough to spoil the enjoyment of being in an open-air plane! You got a good sense of the island, what it looks like and where the population is located. Given roads only cover about 15% of the island, air and boat are a must. I've been a visitor to Kauai for many years and have seen the island by airplane, helicopter and boats but this time was with a first timer and so chose this means of transport. It was well worth the effort! And the Snoopy and Woodstock on the plane was just a bonus!

Great tour!! Our pilot/guide was outstanding!! Had a great day to view everything and got a view extra flight minutes in as a bonus!! Highly recommend using them! The plane was perfect to take photos out of!!

review_title: The best air tour in Kauai
review_text: It was fantastic adventure. We saw all island with lovely coments. Our pilot was very profesional. Thank you!
Desi was polite, informative and just made the flight exquisite!!! You should hire more people like her!!!!

My wife and I went on the Big Kahuna tour this past weekend while we were in Kuaui. It was awesome! The staff were welcoming and Desi did a great job, both piloting and giving us ongoing explanation of what we were looking at.

We were a bit concerned as the weather was slightly cloudy and we had some rain during our flight, but Desi made the best of it. The view of Waimea Canyon was perhaps even more majestic, when you added the perspective of the cloud cover. The views along the Na Pali coast were breathtaking and we loved the tidbits of things like "oh that's where Mark Zuckerberg is building a house" or "that's the beach where they filmed Fantasy Island, Gilligan's Island, Pirates of the Caribbean, Jurassic Park and others".

We highly recommend Air Ventures and it was recommended by a friend who lives in Kauai. I'd love to go again when there are fewer clouds and less rain!

It was great we had a young girl pilot from utah, that moved to kauai. She was awesome probably one of the best in tellin g you the history and she is very bubbly. It was a great experience recommend to anyone

Exciting tour of Kauai on a brand new bi plane piloted by Kevin who was a delight!
A great way to see the magnificent scenery all around the island!

I'm so glad I decided to book this tour, it truly was an experience of a lifetime. Kauai is one of the most stunningly beautiful places in the world, and seeing it from above allows you to take it all in and capture some amazing pictures. Everything about it from start to finish was outstanding, including our entertaining pilot. Next time I go back, I'm doing this again!

review_title: The VERY BEST way to see all of Kauai
review_text: TEN times better than a helicopter tour (no offense to them) - this is just SO much better!!!! OMGosh - I'm still on a high from our Biplane tour of Kauai.  Seeing this beautiful island from the open cockpit of this beautiful flying machine was the highlight of our trip. Kevin was so incredible working with me to surprise my husband - and it worked!!!! We arrived and after the surprise was revealed we were given background information about the plane. Safety info of course was given and instructions on entering the plane.
