The two of us sat in the front cockpit while Kevin flew the plane from behind us. We had headphones and microphones for communication.  Kevin told us history and anecdotes about the areas as we flew over them. He would bank the plane to allow better views for both of us. We flew over the shores, into the canyons, by the Nā Pali Coast, buzzed the beachgoers at Anini beach :-), then we went into the volcano - Oh My - the waterfalls and views were crazy good!! Before we knew it our 70 minute - YES - over and hour - tour was over :-(. We loved it and are sure you will also.  Thank you, Kevin!!!!!

We we arrived to check-in, we were immediately greeted with smiling faces. Within just a few minutes, our pilot, a young lady, approached, welcomed us and introduced herself as our pilot. She then proceeded to take us to the plane, helped us board and in no time we were in the air! She provided great detail about the island and took my wife and I on a great trip and gave us good opportunities to take amazing photos. I would recommend this experience to anyone.

We had a fabulous view of Kauia from a fixed wing plane. Kevin, our pilot was very knowledgable about the various areas of Kauia. The views of the Waimea Canyon and several waterfalls were breathtaking. It was a smooth ride and we would highly recommend this way of seeing all the island has to offer in a one hour trip.

Our pilot was Dezi and she was awesome ! We got to see everything, and I mean everything and she was so knowledgeable about the island we couldn't have had a better time. They were all super nice and it was so easy to book and upon arrival it was quick and so welcoming. We loved or time!
Amazing flight, great entertaining and informative pilot. Went at 10 in early January, not too many clouds and only a bit of turbulence.
Hawaii was fantastic,the weather, food,and people were great.All of the islands had something special to offer. Our favorite was Khaui and the Napoli Coast,can’t wait to visit again!
Desi was a great pilot and very knowledgeable guide.  We enjoyed the flight from beginning to end.  We got the best view of every part of the island of Kaua'i.
Our pilot was very skilled and pointed out the many sights. Our ride was smooth and comfortable. We would definitely do it again!
Great experience!!! It was my first time on this type of excursion and I am truly glad that I took the leap into the unknown!

We had the best time ever with Air Ventures. Our pilot Eric was amazing and full of local knowledge. The views are breathtaking and this magnificent island really is best appreciated from the air! We found everybody associated with Air Venture were great to deal with and fully recommend flying with these guys!

Forgot her name but we had a young lady as our pilot.  She was fantastic.  Great attitude and very informative.  She is young but we were never worried about her skills.  She flew like she had been flying 20 years.  We had a really great day to fly so the flight was smooth and the clouds were not bad so we got to see the tops of all of the mountains.  Really stunning.  She was great

Our pilot, Desi, was both a competent pilot and an amazing tour guide. Desi was very entertaining and upbeat. I was a little nervous about flying in a small plane but Desi created a very calming and secure environment for our flight over Kauai. We would highly recommend taking this tour with Air Ventures Hawaii.
If you want to have a great experience, fly with Air Ventures! It was such an amazing experience and the pilot was very knowledgeable!  I would do this again in a heartbeat!
Fantastic experience. It is tre bestay to see Kauai because you can visit als places you can't see in another way because they are private. It is cheaper than helicopter and, for me. less scaring

We had a wonderful flight seeing natures wonders from the air
Our pilot Desi was bubbly and friendly even at the last flight after a long day
I recommend this air adventure to anyone
Would recommend to everyone! The pilot Harry was awesome. Great views and waterfalls. Little rain made for some sweet rainbows. Definitely worth every penny spent.

The pilot was super nice and gave us a lot of information about the history of the place and took us to many areas that have never been visited by people. She showed us the canyons and waterfalls and the secluded beaches. As we took off she showed us a whale too. Overall great experience

Reallllllly enjoyed this air tour! Much more reasonably priced than a helicopter tour and all seats have a window. Eric was a fantastic pilot and tour guide! This was definitely the highlight of our time in Kauai!

It was a great idea to start our trip this way as it got our view of what this incredible island is all about!  Eric was the perfect pilot and guide to show us!  An adventure and absolutely picturesque in every way!  I am only guessing but a helicopter more up close and personal but a plane takes in more with the time factor each have. Highly recommend!!

review_title: Colorful Kauai in a Small Plane!
review_text: Most tourists prefer a helicopter ride to see the island, but the small plane did a good job for a couple in their seventies!  The colors were bright and being at a higher altitude in the helicopter you could view  a bigger swath of scenery.  Wearing the provided earphones were great, as the pilot could have a two way conversation, and there were no noisy rotors.

review_title: Excellent air tour around Kauai island
review_text:
I was interested in doing the first flight of the day but it was full so I booked for the second one of the day.
Anyway, as I took the rental car at the airport passed by to the company and they told me that there was a place in the first flight of the day. So I could do the tour immediately and then going to visit the island.
I was also lucky with the weather because little by little the cloud disapper and we had some sunshine.
Good explications from the pilot and excellent service provided.
And of course seeing the island for the airplane is amazing.

review_title: Awesome flight over Waimea Canyon and Napali Coast
review_text: An adorable young woman came over to greet us as we waited for our flight, saying,  “Hi! I’m Desi, your pilot, and no, I’m not 16!” She was 24 and so friendly and bubbly, clearly loving her job meeting new people and flying over magnificent scenery! She was very knowledgeable and shared lots of info on what we saw, and the noise canceling headphones and 2 way communication were great. We asked her questions the entire time. We discussed the difference between taking a small 6 seater plane like we did, versus a helicopter. Desi said both were great with pluses and minuses. Planes can’t go as low or close as helicopters, but since they’re higher, you get a better overall view. We were very happy with our choice of the plane, though if I had spare money, I’d surely do both! We had a clear sunny day and the views were breathtaking. We highly recommend Air Ventures and Desi as your pilot!

We had an amazing pilot, who’s name is can’t remember but she’s 24 years old. Our pilot literally took around the entire island and we even got to see certain waterfalls that are rarely seen. Great experince overall and I’m definotely booking this in our next trip.
Enjoyed the beautiful scenery. The plan ride was very calm. The guide pointed out things very well. Enjoyed the beautiful morning.

Thoroughly enjoyed our excursion! The sights and views were spectacular and our pilot kept us informed, briefing us on the various sights and providing us  information regarding those sights and areas. Certainly well worth the time and we enjoyed the flight and our pilot!

I was not sure if a slow airplane ride would give us the same views as a helicopter ride with its ability to stop and turn around.  After the trip, I can tell you that it was the same.  The plane was comfortable and roomy with large windows.  We got to see all the attractions.  Our pilot was great.  We enjoyed it and would do it again next time we are in Kauai.
What you see is weather-dependent but good luck graced us. We saw all we’d hoped for: waterfalls galore, canyons, inaccessible gorgeous gorges.

We are a family of 2 adults n 2 kids age 5 n 10.. All of us consider the air van tour as the best part of our vacation.. we did a chopper tour in Maui n thought that was the best we have done until the tour with Air ventures. They have the best pilots n reasonable prices and an amazing tour.

Had a great flight.  Arrived on Pride of America and booked ourselves for our second day.  No problems booking into a shortened day.  Picked us up at a shopping centre short walk from port and dropped us back after an hours flight.  Everyone we dealt were fantastic especially our pilot Desiree ( believe was her name) was fantastic, smooth, competent and informative

Thankyou

review_title: Best thing we did in Kauai!
review_text:
Our family spent Christmas this year in Hawaii.  Several of our family had never been to the islands so I decided to do an introduction flight around Kauai so they could see the magnificant scenery. My mother is 90 years old, has trouble walking and is afraid of flying.  But the staff and Eric our pilot were wonderful helping her into the plane and accommodating her disabilities.  The flight was the highlight 
 of our Entire trip! Eric was fabulous!  My brother in law gets air sick so he made sure that the flight was smooth, and also made sure everyone on the plane saw everything!  Circling areas to maximize our photo ops!  I highly recommend this adventure for people of all ages! Everyone at AirVentures was incredible.  Thanks!,

Wir haben den Flug spontan online gebucht und es hat alles super geklappt.
Die Abwicklung vor Ort war professionel und trotzdem familiär. Wir haben noch auf einer anderen Insel einen Hubschrauberrundflug gemacht, aber der Umgang mit dem Kunden und die Freundlichkeit war bei Air Ventures eindeutig am besten!
Unsere Pilotin hat die Tour sehr gut begleitet, uns die schönsten Ecken gezeigt und viel dazu erzählt. Dank ihrer Tipps habe ich dann abends auch noch Schildkröten am Stand beobachten können. 
Ich würde hier jederzeit wieder buchen - es hat mir und meinem Mann sehr gut gefallen.
looking for the picture you said you were going to email us .great views of the island and the naplia coast. area pilot with a great personality desi she made the trip with good comments
This was the highlight of our trip to Kauai! Pick Highly recommend — it is absolutely the best way to see the island.  Harry, our pilot, was outstanding.
Was a great day. We were able to see Kawaii from air and ground and all very beautiful. Would recommend this venture to anyone.
Front desk staff was awesome. Pilot Desi was really good. She took her time in welcoming us. She is the best. She is the best tour guide with a pilot cap.
First time in a small (6 seats) aircraft in a air tour of Kauai. Fun fun fun. The crew made it a plesant and wonderful adventure.
Best way to see Kauai. Kevin was a great pilot and tour guide, very knowledgeable and entertaining. Jill (the owner) went above and beyond to make our trip memorable.

review_title: this is a must in Kauai
review_text: First I wanted to do this trip on a doors-off helicopter to be able to do better photos, but the two companies I found did not meet my requirements (Jack Harter Helicopters: there is a risk you get the middle seat from which you do not see properly and cannot really take photos, while Mauna Loa Helicopters unfortunately do not accept solo travellers) so I finally chose Air Ventures and it was a good choice, also much cheaper than any helicopter flights :) Our nice pilot, Desi, shared a lot of interesting info about the island and the views were truly amazing. If you are visiting several islands and want to do only one air trip, Kauai is the one. All in all, it was a fantastic experience that I would recommend to anyone. Warning: wear dark clothes, even your hands' reflection might be visible on the photos.
Kevin our pilot and guide and the crew at airventures were awesome. The only way to see Kauai. The guided tour was very knowledgeable and personal

review_title: It's a must when visiting Kauai
review_text: Both my sister and I had a fantastic plane ride with Air Venture. Our pilot was awesome she knew so much about the island. And it was a very smooth flight! Would absolutely do it again with Air Ventures, the next time I'm in Kauai. A definite must do!!

review_title: Must do! Amazing way to see the island
review_text:
We flew with Kevin and what an incredible experience it was. We saw 8 humpback whales, countless waterfalls and flew into a rainbow. 
A must do early in your trip for local information including where to eat, what beaches to visit and where to hike.

We took the Pride of AMERICA Cruise around the islands and this was far and away the best of the five excursions we took.  Our pilot, Kevin, was fantastic.  I would do this again tomorrow if I was still in Hawaii.

This company is owned by a really lovely couple - their prices were much more reasonable than others, and they were kind, friendly and funny people who went out of their way to make us feel comfortable and safe. We ran into some bad weather, which meant we only got to see half of what you normally see, but the pilot (who happened to be the owner) did his very best to go around the storm and give us as much of a tour as he could (and we ended up being in the air for longer than planned, which was great). They say that you can only see 10% of Kauai by foot or car, so you have to do a tour like this to see the rest!
Tboroughly enjoyed my flight Pilot's knowledge  of the whole island A1 this company oodles with professionalism and friendliness wouldn't hesitate to use them again in Hawaii

One hour flight around Kauai, Hawaii seeing all the major sights. This was a spectacular flight tour. Our pilot was superb.  She was very knowledgeable about where we were flying and very in control during those rough windy spots.  I would highly recommend this tour.
Our pilot Eric was excellent.  We had an absolute picture perfect day for flying.  Breathtaking views!
Great adventure - Desi was not only a great pilot but personable, funny and accommodating!  I would highly recommend this trip

We are so glad we picked Air Ventures for our air tour of Kauai.

It was very affordable.  The ride was smooth and enjoyable.  Everyone had a large window to look out - you don't have to pay extra to be by a window, like you do with the helicopters.

The flight is longer than on the helicopters.

They let me mount my GoPro (for a small charge) on the wing of the aircraft - giving us amazing video of the flight.

And the pilot - Eric - was fantastic.  

Can not say enough great things about Air Ventures, and our experience with them.  Highly recommend.

Eric, was a delightful and skilled pilot. He provided us with a wealth of information and the various aspects of the island.   I loved the term he used when the air got a little choppy;  I don't want to say it -- it might be other pilots are wanting to find out.  It was one of those intentional mind provoking words he used when describing various items/experiences.  Loved the experience and Eric made the eye popping sites and time in the air even more exciting.

An amazing time! Desi was our pilot and she was simply fantastic. I was more than nervous to take this flight (I am not a good flyer) and she put me at ease and was so upbeat and proud of what she was going to show us.  I am so thrilled that I did the tour. She knew everything about everything. Her smile was contagious and her knowledge was unbelievable. For someone who looked sooooo young, she was simply amazing. You must do this tour and you must request Desi; it is that simple.  Mahalo.

Owner and team were exceptional!!!
All went out of their way to accommodate our situation.
We heartily recommend this company...you will have a memorable experience!!!

I have enjoyed the thrill of a helicopter tour on Kaua’i but feel that this was a far more relaxing and scenic way to see the island. We did luck out and have the perfect weather. Not a bump and the clouds seemed to part wherever we went. Maybe it was our pilot.

This plane is great. We really debated between this and a helicopter ride. The pilot was great and did some fun tricks in the air near the end of the flight. It made my husband's birthday amazing. I would definitely recommend. It is a tight two seater so you should like the one you are flying next to. :)

This sight seeing flight was truly amazing.  We circled the entire island, overflew the “Grand Canyon of the Pacific” and saw several incredible waterfalls, all with exceptional narration from our wonderful pilot, Kevin.  A not to miss experience when you are on Kauai.  It will be the highlight of your visit!
Easy to get to location, friendly staffb and Desi, our pilot, was fun and knowledgeable. Gave us some great ideas to see places on the ground. Definitely book this!

Took an hour flight with Air Ventures and could not be happier with the experience. Professional and friendly people operating quality equipment while keeping the customers needs in mind. 

Since I am an aircraft owner and pilot so I am very observant of how things are done and was impressed with their operation. 

Pretty much the best way to see the island from what I observed, I highly recommend taking a flight with them, wish I had known about them earlier as I would have gotten some stick time in their biplane!

Care was not taken before taking off to assure that everyone could hear through our headsets. At best I heard very little of what our pilot was saying throughout our nearly one hour flight. When clients pay that amount o f money every effort should be made at the beginning to be sure everything is working properly and that every passenger is able to fully participate. Sure, the sights were terrific but I had no idea what we were seeing. It was obvious to the pilot I was having problems during the flight because I was asked at the end if I could hear. I said d, no I couldn’t hear anything. That should have been addresses before we took off, not after we landed. Refund???  Dckbartels@yahoo.com

Eric was a well informed pilot and kept the flight very interesting and made sure that you were able
To see items no matter where you were on the plane. We have done helicopter tours before and feel this one provides an even better view.
Our pilot was fabulous: young, energetic and very knowledgeable  Her enthusiasm was contagious and put you at ease if you had an fear of flying.

Had a great time.  This was a great way to see the Island and the owners and their staff couldn't have been nicer.  Ray, the owner was great to sit and talk with although I might be biased as he is a retired 777 captain and I am presently a 777 captain. My wife absolutely loved this adventure.  I would most definitely recommend it.

This air tour was incredible 
It covered the whole island with magic views of all of Kauai’s spectacular scenery 
The pilot and ground crew were great

review_title: Great way to see the island!
review_text: The pilot and staff were very friendly and knowledgeable. Great experience. Definitely recommend it.

My husband and I flew with Air Ventures this week on our babymoon and it was a very memorable experience!  Our pilot, Desi, took great care to make sure everyone was comfortable on the flight and she took us all over the island to see the amazing sights!  I highly recommend this tour!

review_title: Beautiful Sights, Great Pilot and fun!
review_text: Desi was our pilot and she was wonderful. She was full of information not on just what we were seeing but also things to do and see once we land. Would definitely recommend taking the flight to see the many beautiful waterfalls.

review_title: I will never forget this day!!!
review_text: I had the time of my life yesterday. Before the tour my morning was going so sour and Pilot Kevin ended just making my whole day! He was so welcoming and warm to me. As for the tour, Pilot Kevin was very  knowledgeable of the island, the ride was very smooth and he is quite the comedian lol, he was just absolutely amazing. All of the staff were smiles,nothing but positive energy. I will definitely be back! Highly recommend this place!

This was a great tour start to my quick trip to Kauai! Desi our pilot and tour guide made this an exceptional and memorable experience. The above views of Waimea Canyon and the Na Pali coastline are worth every penny of this air tour guide! I highly recommend this tour to everyone.

Showing up to the Lihue airport I was greeted by the friendly Air ventures staff. Our pilot Desi introduced her self and I knew that it was going to be an incredible tour! She was extremely knowledgeable and there was literally not a bad seat on the airplane! Her enthusiasm was bar none combined with the landscape it was a 10/10. Highly recommended!

Jill and her team took great care of my wife and I setting up our flight and providing the flight itself.  Harry the pilot gave a great explanation of everything we saw and answered many questions from the passengers.

We had a great time with these guys and I highly recommend taking a tour. Eric was our pilot and he was very knowledgeable. We didn’t have a reservation but just showed up and the team was able to accommodate us immediately.

review_title: SO amazing! Highlight of our trip
review_text: Everyone at air ventures is so sweet and amazing we went on this trip to celebrate my birthday and it was so memorable
I thoroughly enjoyed the aerial tour of Kauai!  There were great views of Waimea Canyon, waterfalls and the Na'Apali coast.  I would highly recommend this tour company!

One of the first things that impressed me about the company was the friendliness of the staff. From my first phone call to walking out the door after our flight each member of the staff was warm and friendly. They were very professional, but made you feel they were happy you were there. 

Our pilot/guide has 29 years of experience flying over Kauai. He shared his knowledge of the island and its history with enthusiasm and humor. It was like going up in a plane with your favorite uncle/brother. We highly recommend this way to see the beauty of Kauai from the air.

review_title: Great Way to see all of Kauai
review_text: We flew with our excellent pilot, Harry, in the C-182 on a very windy day with moderate turbulence coming off the mountains in the middle of Kauai. Even though my wife and I have 1000's of hours flying similar aircraft, we were a little bit nervous because of the high winds. The airplane was air conditioned, with a very good intercom system, and Harry provided a very informative and beautiful tour of the island that we would not have been able to view any other way. The ocean was too rough for cruising up the Na Pali coast (we had tried that earlier in the week), so we enjoyed an incredible view that was just not viewable any other way. The entire staff was friendly and informative, and worked with us to fly the Waco if it had been available. We highly recommend this tour.

review_title: Prelude to an AMAZING Spiritual Experience.
review_text:
The day before my Air Ventures Hi flight, I had an amazing conversation with a helicopter tour across the street. I was the 1st for the next tour which required 6 passengers. No one showed so my tour was canceled. They suggested I might take a drive up the Waimea Canyon and rebook my flight. I did take that drive. On the way back to rebook my flight, I saw the fixed wing flight with Air Ventures and After speaking at length with the bi plane pilot, chose to took that tour instead. Our pilot was amazing with his historical knowledge of the island. And yes as was suggested, I was able to see the places that I had driven the day before. (As we flew around the point at Poipu, i could literally see the sliding glass doors to my room where i was stayjng.) I hope to return to Kawai in 6 months At which time I plan to take the bi plane tour With Air Ventures Hawaii.
My trip to Kauai was my fulfillment of a dream to return to Hawaii after having been in the military in the Hawaiian Island chain 40 plus years ago. My trip began on Veterans day and i enjoyed my 63rd birthday on Kauai. My 10 day trip to Kawaii involved the drive up Wiamea Canyon, The fixed wing flight over and around the island and a 5 hour kayak tour up the Royal river with a one hour hike into the rain forest to The Secret waterfall. I can only hope the reader will experience the island energy AND the island love from both Thee Island And Her prople the way I did. Again, much about my experience began with the fixed wing flight over and around the island with Air Adventures Hawaii. Yes I will do it again...in rhe bi plane next time....
Aloha and mahalo.

Desi, our pilot, was very thorough in describing & showing us the sights of Kauai.
We had a really great 1 hour flight!

review_title: best way to see the island
review_text: Really enjoyed our flight over Kauai and very happy we chose plane over helicopter as this way we got the big picture.  Air Ventures even picked us up from our hotel and dropped us back as we were staying fairly close by but didn't have a car. Friendly, efficient team and pilot and everything went smoothly. Strongly suggest you take their advice and wear a dark top to cut down reflections. Loved the waterfalls, Na Pali coast, farms - everything.  I had a window seat but my husband was near the door and didn't have quite as good a view but we both loved it overall.

review_title: A must DO while on KAUAI
review_text:
I was highly recommended to see this island from the AIR and I admit I was a bit hesitant as I thought I might get airsick.  I bit the bullett and booked the trip with my friends and it was one of the best scenic tours ever!!

Jill on the ground staff was wonderful and suggested, I sit in the front....lucky lucky me. 

Eric the pilot was amazing & a very experienced/handsome pilot.  He made our trip so memorable, taking care that everyone was able to see different waterfalls that he pointed out to us all.

I also comment that everybody gets a window seat on the plane trip, compared to those who choose to fly in a helicopter and end up in a middle seat.

So don't be hesitant, book and you will be like and so glad I did.

Happy memories and the best tour ever, thanks to Eric, Jill and grand staff.

Mahalo.  Regards Wendy

What an amazing experience, getting to see the breathtaking beauty of Kauai from the comfort of a private Cessna, with a wonderful and personable pilot who gave us an awesome narrated tour! Thank you Desi! And thank you to all the staff who give their true aloha!

review_title: Great joy flight with awesome crew
review_text: Kevin was a wonderful pilot and guide made us feel very welcome and safe with a calm easygoing manner. Beautiful flight around Kauai luckily for us it was a good day. Only suggestion ginger tablets.... but other than that loved it. Highly recommend.

Great - Great - Great!  We took a helicopter in Hawaii over the crater - but this was even better. We got to see everything we asked for plus lots of other things we didn't even know about.  Kevin, our pilot, was wonderful and could answer any question we had.  Jill and Rich made the experience even better with over the top customer service, picking up and dropping off at the cruise line port.  They even sent us a picture at no charge (try getting that from the Helicopter tours).  Thanks Kevin, Jill and Rich for a great Kauai experience (and getting us back to the ship in time!)

Born and raised on Kauai, thinking I seen it all. This was my first ever air tour of my beautiful Island! I got the true beauty and feeling of such an amazing Island! The staff and pilot was extremely extraordinary!! Mahalo for my first air adventure!!

Can't say you will be flying in comfort plane's cabin is small, no leg room, noisy, warm and the head gear is hot.  However, the view of the island's many waterfalls, the beauty of the terrain and the skilled, knowledgeable and friendly pilot will make the discomfort of the cabin a small inconvenience. Would recommend to anyone.

review_title: Great way to see the island
review_text: We were fortunate as the weather cooperated and we saw great views of the island of Kauai.  We saw spectacular  rainbows and stunning views of the Na Poli cliffs-  which can only be seen  by air or sea.  Our young pilot was very experienced, and super friendly and informative. It was an amazing tour.

review_title: Fantastic views of Kauai and great staff
review_text:
The pleasantness of the staff and the pilot made the experience even more memorable. And of course no questions about the aerial views. 

Tip: eat nothing/ very lightly before the flight to avoid nausea.
Our pilot, Dez, was excellent and very informative.  She gave everyone on board a great view.  I highly recommend this excursion!
We loved our private flight over Kauai. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and did such a great job showing us the beauty of Kauai from the air.

The entire staff was friendly, professional and very informative!!!  Desi was our pilot and she is a total gem!!!  We were thrilled to ride with a woman pilot that had a personality that was as spectacular has the views.

When you plan a trip around the island, I highly recommend Air Ventures Hawaii, the staff is verily friendly our pilot Desiree was spunky and very informative. This was a first for me and my wife. Ride was smooth and was able to take some awesome pictures. Would do this again.

review_title: Good way to see the island of Kauai
review_text: We had so much fun seeing the island of Kauai flying with Air Ventures Hawaii.  The pilot was very thorough pointing out all the spots and it was definitely worth the time and money.  I got little motion sickness during the ride but tried to stay cool with some water and there was a fan blowing right in front of me and that helped a lot.
Excellent experience. Would totally recommend. Pilot was highly experienced and very knowledgeable about the island. My friend hates to fly and even she was at ease. Good times!

Beautiful.  Knowledgeable pilot/guide.  Saw many of these sights from the ground but seeing them from the air left both of us speechless.  From the air we also saw many sights not accessible from the ground.  At first we were hesitated about doing this but were very pleased that we did take the Air Adventure tour
An awesome view of the whole Island. Our guide and pilot Desi made sure that everyone had a good time and she had a great knowledge of Kauai. Would recommend to anyone visiting Kauai.

My family of 6 immensely enjoyed our trip around Kauai and took many pictures. The pilot was very personable and informative as we soared over the coffee plantations, Napali Coast and Hanalei Bay. I highly recommend the experience.
카우아이에서는 헬기투어도 좋겠지만 경비행기 투어도 좋은거 같아요. 헬기투어보다 저렴하기도 하고 좋았습니다. 빅아일랜드에서 화산보기 헬기투어를 했었는데 한곳을 여러번 볼때는 헬기투어가 좋지만 경치를 쭈욱 둘러보는 거로는 경비행기 투어가 좋은 것같아요. 다만 실내가 좀 더웠어요. 시간대를 잘 선택하세요

What a great excursion!  Our pilot Eric made this experience a great one with his tips and knowledge of the island.  Bonus that he was able to point out 2 whales for us to see!  The plane was very smooth and comfortable with great views from every seat.  I highly recommend this trip!

We decided to sign up for the private tour over the island of Kauai on a air-conditioned brand new plane.  The price was very reasonable and the pilot (Kevin) who has years of experience took us to all places we wanted to see.  It is equipped with top of the line Bose headsets with noise reduction.  It was an incredibly comfortable ride and spectacular at the same time- much better than the helicopter tours!  A must try during your stay on Kauai.
Had a great time up close and personal with your company . I will recommend my friends and family to experience Kauai this way .

This experience was one of the most meaningful and beautiful things we have ever done!  The views were remarkable!  Our pilot, Harry, was personable, engaging, and informative.  The plane was clean, well-maintained, and offered excellent views for every passenger.  Our drivers to and from the airport were delightful to visit with.  Well worth EVERY penny!  We will highly recommend this to others!

I realize that Air Ventures had no control over the weather however a more perfect day could not have been ordered!  Our pilot and guide was PERFECT!  Dezi was personable, outgoing, a smile that warmed you from the moment she greeted us.  She was able to answer all of our questions and made us feel that we were the only people that mattered!  Dezi is truly an asset to Air Ventures Hawaii as well as all those who choose to fly with them.
Great tour, competent female pilot that acted also as tour guide and gave some fab tips at the end of the tour where to spend our last meal, nice staff very helpful

On a recent trip to Hawaii we were after a helicopter flight but they were all fully booked so instead we opted for a fixed wing flight which was fantastic, the pilot/ owner was an ex commercial pilot as well as a Vietnam vet, so we were put at ease right from the off in regard to our nerves etc, he also had a great sense of humour, which also made us feel at ease. We all had a great unrushed experience and it was one of the main highlights of our trip with Ray our pilot showing us some amazing scenery, so to anyone reading this I would fully recommend this company for a casual, unrushed, and safe adventure in the air, and I would certainly book again the next time I am in Hawaii.

This had to be the best way to see the island.  Air Ventures is economically reasonable, we were picked up on time at a pre determined location and had a short tour to the airport.  The Pilot was the best and the day was perfect.  Will never forget it and Highly recommend it to anyone.  .
We absolutely loved the air tour.  Favorite part of the trip.  Eric was great...funny & knowledgeable.  And he is from Kalamazoo Michigan.  Just an hour from where we live.  Small world!

This was an Awesome experience for my husband and I. The plane was better than the helicopter and the pilot 👩‍✈️ was very knowledgeable! We would recommend to anyone that wants to see the Island from above 😊
Highlight of our trip. Really nice people and Desi did a excellent Job. She gave a lot of background information
This was a good experience the driver was knowledgeable and the flight was great. Boat trip was ok. Overall good time

Wonderful to see the island from above and MUCH better than lining up on the ground with millions of tourists all trying to get the best shot.
My stay on Kauai couldn't have started better than with this flight.
From the first contact via mail until the last good-bye: just great!
Highly recommended!!!

Wir wollten einen Rundflug über Kaua‘i machen also stellte sich die Frage wie??

Vorteil von Helikopter ist das man nah an die Attraktionen fliegt, das ist dann aber schon der einzige. 

Vorteile vom Flugzeug, jeder hat seinen eigenen Fensterplatz, Ruhiger als im Heli und natürlich der unschlagbare Preis.

Unsere Entscheidung viel auf Air Ventures wegen der ausgezeichneten Bewertungen auf TripAdvisor. Das auch zurecht:

- Pilotin war Top, gab Tipps für Ausflüge und erklärte während des Flugs alles. Außerdem war sie sehr aufmerksam dass beide Seiten des Flugzeuges alles zu sehen und zu Fotografieren bekamen.

-Das Flugzeug ist klein und Familiär, man hält Kontakt zueinander und mit dem Piloten via Headset. Wir waren nur 5 Passagiere an Board von maximal 6, von den Plätzen sieht man überall perfekt! 

-Kontakt lief reibungslos über E-Mail, die Dame vom Büro war auch sehr nett und zuvorkommend. Man bekommt sogar Getränke und kalte Tücher (falls einem übel wird) 

Wir würden allen die nach Kaua‘i kommen empfehlen diesen Flug zu machen, zumal man einen Überblick über die Insel bekommt und tolle Tipps von der Crew!

🤙🏻🤙🏻

This was truly one of the highlights of our trip!  We were told by several people that we must do the helicopter tour but the price was hard to justify with all the other excursions we were doing.  We saw this plane trip and we are so glad we did.  We got the most amazing pictures of our whole trip from this excursion and we saw lots of beautiful scenery.  This is a MUST DO tour!
The ride and scenery were outstanding. Our pilot Hary was an excellent guide as well as pilot. Bryan was our van driver also a pilot and gave us insight into the island to/ from the airport.
We flew in an air conditioned C182 that was like new!  Very comfortable, great pilot!  Saw all the sights, just the two of us and the pilot.  Would highly recommend Air Ventures Hawaii!

review_title: On a clear day you can see forever
review_text: It was a sunny day and we had a terrific view of the whole island and the narrative was informative.

This is a must do if you can.  Professional, courteous and all of the staff are friendly and informative. If you tour or drive the island first, this will give you a different insight as to what it looks like.  Everyone has a window seat so the views are fantastic!

Ein einmaliges Erlebnis, nur zu empfehlen. Man sieht so sehr viele Punkte der Insel, welche man nicht zu Fuß oder mit dem Auto erreichen würde. Grade bei nur wenigen Tagen Aufenthalt auf Kauai eine richtige Entscheidung. Der Pilot ist super gewesen, er hat viel erzählt und erklärt.
Awesome adventure from the air. Beautiful views! Worth every penny!! Would recommend it to anyone who wants to really see the island! Great part of our Taste of Kaui tour!
The flight was very good and enjoyable. Saw many sights that you cannot see from the ground. Pilot Bryan was very good.

review_title: Air plane ride around the island.
review_text: Our pilot was so great.  We flew on October 4th,2018 and although windy, we had lots of lovely views and great information.

WE took this 70 minute small airplane ride around the island of Kauai and was thrilled with it.  A fantastic way to see the remote parts of the island.  The pilot was excellent showing and explaining all the views. Also was concerned for our comfort and I tend to get sick but didn't with his care - he carried cold towels and water for our use if we felt any bit of discomfort. The best way to see the island!  Everyone had a window seat for great viewing and you also get a DVD of your trip along with a picture in front of the airplane before boarding this 7 passenger plane.  Awesome experience.

Had a wonderful detailed flight over Kauai.  We saw many waterfalls, beaches, mountains, and volcanic formations. We saw the coffee plantation and where "celebrities" live. Pilot very informative and professional.

We absolutely loved this flight. Our pilot was very knowledgeable about what we were seeing and even turned the plane around so both sides were able to view this fabulous island of Kauai. The cost was very reasonable and much less expensive than a helicopter trip. I would do this again in a heart beat. Fantastic experience...

This was absolutely the highlight of our recent trip to Hawaii! Our pilot, Eric, was incredibly friendly and cordial as well as totally professional.  I’ve never been comfortable in small planes…until this time.

We were originally scheduled to take the biplane tour of the island, however the biplane had to have maintenance and would not be available.  We were informed about this a week before the flight and given the opportunity for a private flight in the Cessna.  We were a bit disappointed that we couldn't get the biplane, however the tour was wonderful!  Our son even got to tag along with us!  Our pilot, Harry, did a fantastic job of making us feel comfortable and giving us a grand tour of the island.  Communication with Val and the company was wonderful and we were very well taken care of.  Highly recommend!

Our pilot Eric knows his way around the island and gave us fantastic looks at the notable places.  All the staff, and the entertaining pilot, made this a most pleasant experience.  I haven't been in a helicopter to compare, but this was a smooth flight, and although I have some motion illness in small crafts, it was nothing I couldn't handle.  They are prepared, professional and friendly.

We toured the island of Kauai, Hawaii in a small plane which held six passengers. We covered the island as the pilot pointed out magnificent areas of beachfront, the island's own version of the Grand Canyon called Weimea Canyon, the Wailua River, and the various flora the island grows such as taro, which is what poi is made from. We saw the locations of the films Jurassic Park and World, South Pacific, and Pirates of the Caribbean. Also, the area where Mark Zuckerberg, George Clooney, and Ben Stiller own large homes was pointed out. The time "flew" by. This was a delightful trip, and our pilot was knowledgeable and charming!
This was, by far, the best way to see the island of Kauai! The pilot was very knowledgeable, informative and fun to fly with!

We had an amazing time....would do again, without a doubt!  It was beautiful, relaxing, fun and worth every penny.... If you're debating weather or not to book this...... do it! You won't be disappointed!
Eric, ourt pilot, was able to provide interesting insight to we passengers who had never seen this place.  His familiarity with the topography was obvious and most welcome.

Eric was an excellent pilot!
Fun, Funny and full of knowledge. 
He checked up on each of us during the flight to make sure everyone was ok.
Thanks Air Ventures and Eric for a great tour of the island.

Val was super helpful and polite taking care of my reservation. Even nicer in person.  The pilot was great, providing informative commentary to the spectacular views during our flight. When I come back to Kauai, I’ll repeat this fantastic air tour!
Everyone was was very helpful! The flight was great and we look forward to coming back... thanks! I would recommend this flight to everyone!
Eric was a terrific tour guide and pilot!  The scenes were breath-taking and the circular rainbow topped it all!!

My daughter and I had a great experience flying with Air Ventures.  It was a beautiful day in Kauai and our pilot Harry was fantastic and Val was great as well.  Would definitely recommend this company.

This flight was part of a Best of Kauai tour we booked but couldn’t fly due to the weather.  So we took it the next day which was a picture perfect flying day.  It was awesome!  Our pilot Kevin was exceptional , informative, fun and friendly.  This is absolutely the way to see the island!  We’ve done heli tours before but I would recommend this instead!  An hour flying around the island , up the canyons, over the waterfalls , etc.

Nous avons effectué le tour de Kauai avec l'avion Cessna. 
Notre pilote était Harry. 
Nous avons vraiment beaucoup apprécié cette sortie. 
Les paysages sont magnifiques. Le Canyon de Waimea et les côtes de Napali sont à couper le souffle. 
Notre pilote Harry était très sympathique. Il nous a très bien expliqué les différents paysages. 
Nous recommandons vivement ce tour.
I have a problem with motion sickness,  no problem.  The pilot asked me how I was doing during the flight. So glad we did this, no regrets.
Thank you Eric and Val for such a good time, you really made it quite an expiernce! Thank you for all the information!

review_title: The best way to see the island!
review_text: This was an AMAZING flight. My wife and I flew with Harry in a Cessna 182 plane, just us and him! Harry was knowledgeable and answered every question we had.  I would HIGHLY recommend this way to see the island.  Very intimate and personal.
We had a wonderful tour of the island. Saw such incredible beauty that can only be seen from the air.  Recommend this 100%!

Excellent experience from booking through the post flight.  The flight was smooth, scenery was awesome and our pilot, Harry, was both a great tour guide and a professional aviator.  We'd definitely recommend this trip--the only way to see most of the island's treasures is from the air, and this tour allowed us to do that.

Kevin is an excellent pilot and we thoroughly enjoined the flight. Seeing Kauai from the air was amazing. Kevin's very knowledgeable about the islands geography and history and made the entire  experience very memorable.

review_title: Kauai Big Kahuna Tour with Harry
review_text: Excellent tour. We were lucky to have very clear and sunny skies. Beautiful views of beaches and valleys that are inaccessible by roads.

This was our first flight. The pilot was friendly and very informative. 
He made the flight pleasant. He removed all anxiety we had.

We had flown around the Island on a previous trip by Helicoptor, but flying this time in the Bi-Plane was the ultimate experience.
I cannot priase Val at the front desk, or Kevin the pilot enough for their attention to all the details, information, and making sure that we had a good time.
The Yellow Bi-Plane was like ( and was) new, Kevin gave us a complete rundown on the planes history, its workings, how to get in and out and how to take photos. We chuckled to ourselves with our helments on, and thought of Biggles the pilot or Snoopy LOL.
The take off was smooth, the flight was smooth and the landing even smoother!
Kevins information was  limitless, and kept us entertained thru out the flight. The sights were breath taking, you get a good look at the island from a totally different perspective. Taking photos was a little challengeing, but they have all come out great.!!
Was the high light of our Kauai holiday!
A Special Thank you Val for gifting us a Blue Planet A very special treasure :-)
Mahalo  Val & Kevin

The best way to see all of Kauai! Harry was the pilot for our flight! He did an exceptional job pointing out all the important places as we flew over them. He also made sure they could be seen from both sides of the plane. We would definitely recommend taking this excursion! Great for all ages!

Terrific pilot, very confident and professional individual named Eric. He knew the island inside out. Terrific value when the same helicopter tour is 3 times as much and plane uses 1/3 of the fuel . One word Amazing

I really enjoyed the air tour of the Kauaii island.  Our pilot was good at pointing out things of interest.    He shared his knowledge about the island and was very considerate that both sides of the plane were able to  see the major highlights..

Everyone told us to go to Kauai when we went to Hawaii so we changed our plans and went but for only 1 day so we decided to see all of the island by small plane and we were so glad we did that!   It was amazing and our pilot had something to come up so the owner took us up!  He was so interesting and you could tell he loved doing this and loved this island!  I got the mist beautiful pictures of the lush green mountains, beautiful beaches and breathtaking waterfalls! This is a great way to see the island!

Todays 70 minute flight over the island was an absolute highlight. The company is very professional, everything on time and as promised. The pilot was very helpful and explained a lot. Certainly, a plane cannot go as deep into the canyons like a helikopter, but on the other hand, we got a better overview and a very comfortable and almost bumpless flight. The pricing is also acceptable.

I bought this flight as a birthday present to my husband and I could not even think about a better present. The flight was awesome and I recommend it to everyone in the beginning of a Kauai vacation. The view was absolutely great and the comment of our pilot Bryan very interesting. The whole crew was so nice!!! We could only say  THANK YOU!

Excellent trip, We were able to see most of KAUAI from above. Everyone made sure that we were having a good safe time. Well worth the cost. Eric called us by name and the headsets worked perfectly. Cool towels were available in case you started to feel a little out of sorts. Also bottle water.

When we landed at the airport we went over and were able to get this flight. We were able to catch next flight.

Great pilot with lost of information and not sides got to see as he circled to explain. Not to many winds aloft so plane did not bounce much, great day to fly

Canyon was a little cloudy but we were early enough to see. Understand that canyon gets clouded in latter in day

Pilot was in constant contact with other aircraft in area.

Felt very safe for 1 hour flight and would do this again

On the morning of 3rd Sept 2017 I finally reached Lihue airport in Kauai, 7.5k miles from London. My day was to start with a 70 minute flight over the entire island of Kauai with a company called Air Ventures. My experience of Air Ventures was nothing short of exceptional from the outset. I'm a relatively well travelled 53 year old and I've never felt inclined to post a review online for anything, but the seemingly boundless hospitality of my life loving hosts and the pure majesty of seeing Kauai from the air with Air Ventures demands that I take time out of my ever busy schedule to do so. If you only ever participate in a 'once in a lifetime' activity, you should put this mind blowing trip with Air Ventures at the very, very, top of any bucket list because this is literally as good as it gets! I could go into specifics but go find out for yourself - I guarantee this is a trip you'll NEVER forget. If you're tuning into this review, Ray, Brian and Jill, THANK YOU! Dean :)

We are so glad we took this plane tour!  The pilot was nice and very knowledgeable about the history of the island as we flew over old volcano craters & how they formed Kauai.  We went on the 1:30 flight & the clouds were high so we could see the Na Pali coast & the rest of the island.  We had a small amount of turbulence, but we did fine.  Kevin was our pilot with 28 years of flying experience behind him!
We would do this again, we loved this tour!
We had so much fun. That was my favorite part of the trip. Eric the pilot was full of information and a lot of fun. The plane trip was so much better then the hilicoper

Truly an wonderful experience! Not only are you experiencing the beautiful island of Kauai from the air but you're doing in a beautiful bi-plane with deeply engaging and knowledgeable pilots! Kevin was ours and he guided us through a brief history of the company and the actual b-plane. Then fitted us into our seats in a way that maximized our view and photo opportunities then off we went! 

The bottom line for me is I ask "would I do it again?".

The answer is definitely!

Looking at Kauai from above was a wonderful experience.  One of the highlights of our Hawaiian trip.
My husband was fearful of the helicopter ride, and chose the plane and he was so happy he did this trip. I would recommend this to all.

Fantastic experience! Eric was a wonderful pilot! He was extremely knowledgeable and hilarious. The views were spectacular. Worth every penny. We saw every inch of the island and then some. I would highly recommend this to anyone and will definitely be flying the next time we're on the island! Thank you!!

We  saw stunning views of Waimea Canyon and the NaPali coast, as well as the rest of the beautiful island of Kauai, 74% of which can only be viewed by air, according to our friendly pilot.  We had booked this tour with a competitor well in advance of our cruise to Hawaii, but they cancelled the day before our trip, due to required maintenance.  Air Ventures was able to accommodate our date on very short notice - super service!  After a brief safety review, we were placed into our seats to evenly distribute weight throughout the plan, which seats six plus the pilot.  The flight was very pleasant and the pilot was quite informative.  I had found some of our helicopter tours on other islands to cause slight motion sickness due to the vibration. I had no problem with this flight - the plan ride was smooth and serene.  The only downside is that they did not record the flight for purchase later, which both of our helicopter tours had done.  Still, what a great way to view this gorgeous island paradise and create lifetime memories!  A must do!

review_title: Pretty amazing views of the island in a biplane - Simply Spectacular
review_text: We flew with Capt Kevin who was a great guide and offered lots of great local information!  Capt Kevin made sure that both us in the cockpit were able to see all attractions and provided a great overview of the island.  The biplane ride was amazing and allowed us to see the island more up close and personal (we could touch a cloud).  Different that a helicopter ride in that you are in the open with goggles for viewing the sites - which range from the Na Pali coast, to the beaches on the North and South side, the lush interior and waterfalls, and Waimea Canyon to name a few.  Highly recommend as an alternative to the helicopter options

We experienced a calm, lovely Hawaiian day soaring between puffy clouds and dramatic landscapes 
in a prop plane.  We have toured in a helicopter before and that felt fast of getting to the 'sights'. 
Flying a full hour in a plane was a smooth visually pageantry of Kauai beauty and human impact.

This was by far the best hour flight in my life.  I was able to see most of Kauai by air.  I can't stop taking about how awesome my flight was.  I will most definitely do again.  Thanks Air Ventures Hawaii.
Pilot was very experienced, and calmed my fears of being in a small plane for the first time. The views were magnificent. Well worth adding this activity to your visit to the island.

The views from this air tour were amazing!!! The pilot was very knowledgeable about the history of the Napali Coast and he even checked on me (a couple of times) to make sure I was comfortable (I think he could sense that I'm not a good flyer). The tour was so smooth and comfortable that I was able to take a lot of beautiful pictures. I would definitely recommend this tour to all of my friends!

I recommend this tour to anyone going to Kauai.  The flight takes you to places you would never experience except by air, viewing the beauty of the heart of Kauai.  Just remember don't eat before your flight, you will feel the air turbulents in this small plane.  Definitely worth every penny!!!

We chose Air Ventures to see the island of Kauai and it was wonderful!  The people were friendly and so helpful too! The owners & pilot were so nice & knowledgeable!  This is a one of the best ways to see the island, since most of it you can't reach by car.
It was so much cheaper than a Helicopter too! So glad we took this tour is was amazing!
If you have a gopro bring it!

My friend and I were in Kauai celebrating our 50th birthdays and wanted to do something memorable together. When our commercial plane arrived in Lihue, we saw this yellow bi-plane parked near where we taxied in to our gate. We both said we needed to look into that!!!! So we did and booked a flight with our very experienced pilot Kevin. We were so excited to be doing this flight, but Kevin made it even more exciting for us. He taught us everything we needed to know pre-flight and then even after take off he was able to communicate with us through the headsets we had. He gave a wonderful description of everything we flew over...this included the resort area, up to Waimea Canyon (where we flew right down the middle!), came back over the coastline to the Napoli Coast. To add some excitement to our flight, and because we asked him to, he did a flight maneuver with us! Actually did a loopity loop over the water! All we good was giggle with excitement!!!! The tour continued over Princeville/Hanalei and then turned into the center of the island where we flew around the volcano, saw numerous waterfalls, including Wailua Falls! I cannot say enough about how fun and interesting this flight was to see so much of the island and to get such a detailed commentary from Kevin! I highly recommend this flight!

This was the highlight of our stay in Kauai! It's the only way to see 80 percent of the island, and it's the 80 percent that should not be missed! Our pilot Eric was experienced, knowledgeable and very personable, he even let the me take the yoke briefly during the flight. Highly recommended!

My wife was very apprehensive for her open cockpit biplane ride. She had never flown in a small plane before and was very nervous. Our pilot, Kevin, immediately made her feel at ease and took a lot of time prior to the flight to make her feel comfortable and explain the plane to her. We had an amazing flight and she would definitely do it again as would I. A top-notch business with top-notch  staff to make you feel at home.  The biplane ride is definitely the way to go and provided a very smooth platform to take in the beauty of the island!!

Great trip and a view to die for, the pilot is very knowledgeable in all aspects of the islands.
The view from above is great.

Our Pilate was great.  Very fun and knowledgeable.  My husband even got to ride in the co Pilate seat, and they were nice enough to take a picture of him on his phone!  All the staff was super nice and helpful.
Great information and lots to see. Cabin of the plane was warm but the pilot was prepared which helped. Friendly staff, definitely a repeat.

My husband and I took the open air biplane tour with Kevin as our captain. He was amazing! I was nervous, and he made me feel so comfortable! He shared wonderful information about the island, and we saw gorgeous views. It was an incredible experience!

This was our first time taking an air tour.  This is the best tour we've ever done.  Our pilot Brian made it so much fun.  He's very entertaining and made us feel safe and comfortable.  I would highly recommend this tour with Airventures.  Make sure to ask for Brian as your pilot/tour guide.  I would do this again.  
The views are amazing - unforgettable experience!

Al from Sacto, CA

This tour was spectacular!  Our pilot Brian took us for an amazing tour, providing interesting commentary along the way.  The entire staff was courteous and so much fun.  We had an amazing time and would absolutely recommend.  The views were breathtaking and truly awesome!

review_title: Excellent value for a marvelous experience
review_text: We booked at a local kiosk and within an hour were in the air for a full hour tour all over Kauai.  Much less expensive, twice as long, and much quieter than a helicopter, the views are spectacular.  Strongly recommend this experience.
Great views, and great captain , he explain perfectly the places that we are flying over, The plane was fine although isnt very modern. But of course was safe. Staff was great too . Mahalo!

"They" say that viewing Kauai from a helicopter is the best way to see the island.  Poor planning on our part, meaning all the helicopter tours were booked, meant that we opted for the view of Kauai from a seven seater plane.  It was AWESOME!!!  I'd highly recommend choosing Air Ventures as a first option to see Kauai from the air.  The knowledge of our pilot was wonderful and added to our experience immensely.

My wife and I have taken more than 20 flights over Kauai.  The bi-plane flight was by far the very best.  The pilot (Kevin) provided us with tons of history and took us to all the places that we requested.  The bi-plane is awesome.  The altitude we flew at was perfect for incredible videos and photos.

A must for those who have a Flight Over, around and across the spectacular Island of Kauai, Hawaii. Known as"The Garden Island" for its lush and densemfoolage and rugged backdrops, AirAdventures offers a great way to "get up-close and personal" with nature.

This little operation  at first glance appears a bit small & laid back to play with the big boys" of the "scenic flight operations" but don't let that fool you. They may appear laid back and easy going, but the entire team is 100% on their game and very professional.They just keep it  low key so as not to stress the fainthearted and they work their charm.

I've been in the tourism business for some 40 years and AirAdventures is certainly right up there with the best.

A beautiful and peaceful way to see the Wameia Canyon of Kauai and coastline. Very romantic.  Kevin was an excellent and informative pilot. Would highly recommend this flight for anyone thinking of visiting Kauai

Best flight around Kauai! Air Ventures helped my surprise my boyfriend on a coastline flight around the island. He's lived here 10 years and never seen it from the sky. Harry was our pilot - he's fantastic. EXTREMELY knowledgeable and experienced. I would recommend him any day.

Air Ventures was excellent! From the ease of booking, to the swiftness of their response, I was impressed with the care and thought they put into their business. The air tour itself was perfect. We had the small plan to ourselves (Husband, baby and me). Eric was was an amazing guide and pilot.
Thank you, Air Ventures for the highlight of our Kauai trip!

review_title: Girls trip--traveling with one in a wheelchair!
review_text:
I was assured traveling with one in a wheelchair & enjoying this plane ride would not be a problem.  
Everything was perfect.  She was lifted from her wheelchair up into the seat on the plane,  Eric our pilot was wonderful-very informative --great personality!  Highly recommend this company!

The views are absolutely breathtaking. a Must Do when on Kauai!!
I get motion sick - recommend taking something to help with this if you are too. i did and had no issues at all. 
The tour guide/pilot was very funny and knowledgeable of the island. 
i will for sure be back!

We tried this as an alternative to helicopter rides we'd done previous years.  It was generally pretty enjoyable.  You're flying somewhat higher than the helicopters, and not doing some of the close terrain flying the helicopters do, but you are generally going to the same places.  The windows of the plane are quite large.  The pilot's narration was informative and fun.  One issue I've never seen in a helicopter: a boy with another party was airsick during our tour.  The boy was reading a magazine before this happened, which is a pretty easy way to get carsick -- the pilot told everyone up front that if you started to get queasy to look out the window, and I wish the kid's Mom had made him do so, as it was unpleasant for those of our party next to him.
Our instructor was amazing and the tour was beautiful. Definitely something you go on with your wife or husband.
Ended up doing whole island tour twice.  Eric was by far better at description, history, and keeping the airplane out of pictures.
Had an incredible time and the pilot was very professional and informative. This was a once in a lifetime experience and we are very happy we were able to ride in this airplane.
The pilot was great, the airplane was super cool and the accommodated my request for a flight fairly last minute. Great experience and worth the money!

review_title: best way to enjoy and view kauai
review_text: excellent, the first thing to when in kauai, then go on a ground trip to see all that you saw from above.

I do recommend this flying trip over Kauai, but keep in mind that, even with excelent weather conditions as we had, the plane moves up and down as it approaches Napali Coast. So be prepared!
Not watching directly through the camera helps not getting sick...
Great experience, anyway.
we did the private tour just myself, my husband a the most wonderful friendly knowledgeable pilot Brian who showed us so many beautiful sights. highly recommend this way to see the island

Got the chance to fly with Brian at Air Ventures.  Took the family out for about a 70 minute flight.  We got to see the entire Island from an amazing point of view.  Very comfortable and super informative. Brian was professional and so knowledgeable about the entire island, geography and history.  So many waterfalls that you would never see or know were there.  Definitely a highlight of our trip.  Thanks Brian!
Pilot Harry was awesome, views were insane from the biplane. Just an all around incredible experience, 100% worth it!

Our biplane pilot Kevin was wonderful. He knew I was a bit of a nervous flyer and was very reassuring when there was normal turbulence. We saw the entire island, all theee volcanos and even flew inside the largest. While over the ocean we stuck our hands out and touched a cloud! We would absolutely book and fly with Kevin again.
I took my kids on this air tour.  Eric took us on a beautiful tour of the island of Kauai.  I even got to be co-pilot.
You should work full time here and quit Costco!! Made my sister's first small plane flight injoyable. Mahalo from Wisconsin and Las Vegas!

review_title: Eric was a GREAT pilot and tour guide!
review_text: We had a wonderful tour of the island and will recommend you to everyone we know coming to Kauai! We did a helicopter tour years ago but found the fixed wing airplane so much smoother and more enjoyable!! 😄
Fantastic tour!! The high light of our visit!! To see so much of this beautiful island was breathtaking!!

It was amazing flying with Air Adventures! 
The pilot, Eric, is fantastic and he's the ability to involve all the people who're enjoying the trip.
Great opportunity to see the true diversity of the island.  The entire staff is very professional and courteous.  If you have the time and the extra money  I would highly recommend the tour.

review_title: Bucket List on the Garden Island
review_text:
This was our 4th trip to the island and we had thought we had seen all its wonders.  We had, just not from between 1000-4000 feet from an open cockpit! No helicopter, boat or ATV will ever afford the perspective of a nip
Plane.   My non pilot travel companions reservations concerning air sickness evaporated as soon as we lifted off.  

Ground crew and the pilot were exceptional!

Want a truely memorable experience?  
This is it!

Kauai von oben zu sehen ist ein einmaliges Erlebnis. Man sieht so viel mehr von der Insel als wenn man an die Strassen gebunden ist. Wir haben den Flug an den Beginn des Kauai Aufenthalts gesetzt, was goldrichtig war. So kann man Dinge entdecken die man z.B. Danach noch mit dem Auto und zu Fuss erkunden kann. Preis/ Leistung von Air Ventures war perfekt.

A great tour and a great value. Eric our pilot was very professional, yet also funny and friendly. Very smooth ride; he always warned us if any slight turbulence was expected and checked on each of us periodically.

Kudos to our pilot Dennis for providing us with the highlight of our vacation.  He was very knowledgeable, provided great narrative, made sure everyone got a chance to take pictures and most importantly is an outstanding pilot.  I have taken helicopter tours before that were very scary.  I was so happy that I got great chances to take pictures all through out  the tour.  That was not the case when we took helicopter tours in the past.  This was much more pleasant.  Thank you so much!  I definitely recommend Air Ventures Hawaii and especially their pilot Dennis.
This was amazing.  We flew a little higher than the helicopters and saw fabulous panoramic views.  Eric, our pilot, was a great guide and a lot of fun!

review_title: Amazing Way to see the island
review_text: The Air Ventures staff is very friendly. We had an amazing time and the pilot was filled with knowledge about Kauai and made sure to point out interesting sites as we flew over. It's something you must do!

If you're ever going to do this...Kauai is the place.  Capt Harry was fantastic.  Got weathered out on the day we were suppose to go, but luckily we had one more day and the Air Venture folks worked with us the entire time to ensure we could get our flight in before leaving.  The next day was perfect!  Highly enjoyable...so glad we fit this in.

Excellent service. Very experienced pilot.  It is worth every penny. We flew the Cessna 182 out of Lihue.  The flight took sixty minutes.  This is the best way to see the Island.  As a pilot, I appreciated the opportunity to fly in this location.
Dennis was an excellent pilot and guide. The tour was well planned and on time. You can't get as deep in the canyon as you could with a helicopter,  but the over fly Vistas were specular.

This was a fantastic way to see the islands - our pilot was super about explaining what we were seeing with some history, some humor and a big dose of Aloha spirit.  Don't miss this experience - from the moment I booked the flight until we landed we had fantastic service.  Thanks Val and Eric and everyone involved in our once-in-a-lifetime adventure!

Awesome time . Pilot Eric was great and had some great knowledge of the island . He and the entire staff at Air Ventures are super friendly and nice . Would recommend them to alll . Great work guys . Eric you rock and thanks for letting me be in charge for few mins :).
What a great way to see the island. This was worth every penny! My wife and I had a blast! This was the highlight of our trip to Kauai.

review_title: Amazing views and narration of the entire island! Eric is wonderful!
review_text: My family of five went on a round-the-island tour with Eric. He made us feel comfortable and secure right away. Gave great information about the island, and handled my daughter's nausea at the same time (she has motion sickness). Really nice guy, and made us feel safe on this little plane! He had cold water bottles, cold towels, air sickness bags, and everything you need if you tend to get motion sickness. The tour was amazing. We saw a rainbow, a crater, Jurassic Falls, and more. The entire team was great - brought a ginger ale to my daughter after we landed. The free group photo was a nice touch as well! Thanks for making our first fixed wing single-engine flight truly enjoyable!
this is a great way to see the island and the pilot was very informative. highly recommended for anyone visiting for the first time.

This was a very special highlight of our holiday here in Kauai. And the crew, especially pilot Kevin, made it a fantastic one. We flew in the open cockpit bi-plane which in itself is just breath-taking. The roundtrip around the island was spectacular. We were both so excited and would recommend to everyone
The tour was very informative, the view was excellent, and Harry was a gentleman! The Cessna was very comfortable, and 70 minutes was the perfect time investment.

We had a great time going up with our pilot, Eric. The island is beautiful from the air. The weather had cancelled our snorkel excursion the day before and Air Ventures was able ro give us the chance to see the Napali coast before our flight out of Kauai that evening.
Best way to see the island, by air! Eric,our pilot, took good care of us and gave us plenty of information about the island. We flew by many rainbows that day. We loved this experience 👍

I went at the last minute, I was there for my granddaughter and daughter to go up in the biplane. They said they had a seat open on another flight. I'm not real comfortable flying. My daughter talked me into going. I'm glad I went. It was beautiful, our pilot was great. He told us a lot of interesting information during the flight. I was very comfortable and really enjoyed it.

review_title: Amazing experience with an excellent team!
review_text: It was amazing! We had a lot of fun! We saw many beautiful places we couldn't see otherwise. The team was so kind we didn't want our trip to end :D

Open air cockpit so there's nothing between you and Kauai. So no locked tinbox in the sky feeling, no air sickness, no other tour people.  Hands down the better option to see kauai from above. And u can set ur holiday itinerary from the sky.

It was a very good experciene  , and a very  good pilot, which gave a nice explanation of all sights.
I will do it again wheni vist this island
Excellent flight with airventure, save (thanks to Eric), with a lot of information on all aspects of kauai.

review_title: Awesome way to see the island.
review_text: Great way to see the beauty of Kauai!!   The picture they took in front of the plane and emailed had us with the pilot.  That's all well and good but for the money, I should have asked to have one of just us only.
Our flight was awesome!, and our pilot even better!!, we enjoyed so much the flight and our pilot was very nice, I would definitely recommend it.
Wanted to do something special for our 35th anniversary. We had a great time and got to see the Kauai in a way that we will definitely remember!

Had a fantastic flight over Kauai island with Air Ventures. The plane was quieter than the helicopter flights we have been on and very smooth. Our pilot Brian gave an excellent history and description of the scenery. Worth the price, a good value. Everyone should try this tour.

This flight was unbelievable!  The pilot was knowledgeable and thoughtful.  He not only flew us by the main areas or sites of attraction, but ensured that all passengers had an adequate view of the sites.
Nice ride, would highly recommend.  Our pilot/guide, Brian, was great.  Was longer and less expensive than a helicopter ride.

review_title: Bi-Plane Tour of Na Pali Coast
review_text: Fantastic way to see the Na Pali Coast.  Our pilot, Kevin, was super knowledgeable and super nice!  I felt my son and I were in the best of hands while in flight!  Kevin promised to take us through some "stunt" maneuvers the next time we visit!  Worth the money to see the views from this wonderful plane!

Eric was our pilot and we could not have had a more personable and knowledgeable pilot.
The whole staff were friendly and helpful from start to finish, I have done several helicopter tours on the island but I must say this was the most comfortable and having my wife enjoy it with me made it even better. Thank You Eric and all the staff at Airventures!!  You make Vacations!!!
The pilot was exceptional and very knowledgeable of the area. Much different (better) than a Helicopter and will fly again in the future.

Arrived in town from cruise ship about 11:00 and got shut out for helicopter ride. Contacted Air Ventures instead and we were treated to an hour and half personalized tour of Kauai by Kevin, our pilot. He was very professional and knowledgeable. The price was less than half of what the helicopter guys wanted and is by far a better value!

My daughter and I booked a private plane tour on our last day in Kauai. Our flight was at noon and we did the 8:30 am tour. We were very pleased with the tour. The view from the air was marvelous! Captain Harry was great. The plane was fairly new and it was a very comfortable ride.  I was able to take videos and lots of great pictures. Wear dark clothing so as not to have reflections on your pictures.

After seeing the bi-plane fly over last year, I knew when I returned this year that had to go.  I am a paraplegic and so there was some concern if I could get in the plane, even though I have a strong upper body.  Our pilot Kevin was more than willing to give it a shot and it turned out great!  Don't let a wheelchair stop you from exploring.  Thanks for the memories that will last a lifetime.

We decided on a small plane over a helicopter as it was more easily tolerated by my 10 year old who can get motion sick.  The flight was awesome!  Kevin is a fantastic tour guide and it was comforting to know we flew with the most experienced pilot out there.  Highly recommend this!

best tour we ever had in our multiple hawaiin trips.we traveled  by land and air and sea (actually river) and viewed kawai like never before. learned some history and enjoyed every minute.  THANX for an experience that will be remembered for a lifetime.

Booked two tours for a very special family holiday.  Mom and a friend went up in the Bi-Plane which fulfilled a lifetime dream for her.  The rest of the party went up in the AirVan.  The pilot was excellent, paying attention to every detail from safety to our comfort.  He shared so much knowledge with us about the island and what we were flying over.  Every passenger had a really good view, but please do heed their advice on not wearing light coloured clothes.  Even bare legs can reflect in your photos!  Such an amazing experience and well worth it.  The best way to see the Na'Pali Coast and the stunning canyons.

Seriously, this is the way to go people! Doors off ain't got nothing on the retro biplane ride! Harry was our pilot and he was just awesome! I love you can talk with your pilot and ask questions. To be honest, my new husband & I are "talkers" but were pretty much rendered speechless at the awesome-ness and beauty of our flight!  Plus we got to do some adventurous maneuvers in the plane too! (If you like rollercoasters, which I heart, ask your pilot to do some moves!) #wortheverypenny #wanttodoagain #justmightbookanothertoendourtripright

I met Brian at dinner on Thursday night. Started chatting and next thing you know I'm flying with Eric on Friday morning.  I'd never flown on a prop plane before. It was the smoothest most enjoyable flight I have ever been on. Spectacular views of Kauai and very friendly crew.

review_title: A terrific way to see the Island!
review_text: We were amazed at the sights and the beauty of Kauai from the air.  Our pilot was very knowledgeable of the points of interests and entertaining at the same time.  The flight was smooth and enjoyable.  The view from an airplane gives you more of an overall view of the island and what it has to offer.

Beautiful day, beautiful plane, great pilot. There was a car accident going south and it delayed our arrival. We called ahead and Brian said no problem as he was aware of the accident and would wait. It was a late start but we were able to get going relatively quickly after we arrived. Our pilot Kevin attached our go pro to the wing and we were off. Kevin was awesome, very knowledgeable and showed us some great sights. The flight inside the volcano was spectacular. All in all, I can't imagine a better flight. A special time with my son😎

This was by far my favorite thing we did during our visit to Kauai.  Our trip was piloted by Eric and he was an amazing pilot and a great tour guide.  At no point did any of us feel unsafe.  
As far as cost goes, it is definitely competitive with the other air services on the island.  I highly recommend this company.
An excellent experience! Our tour was on time, hassle free and our pilot, Brian, was very friendly and knowledgable about the island.

review_title: If you have little ones, this is for you!
review_text:
My husband, 1 year old daughter and I went on the small plane tour and luau combo.  On the plane we were with another couple.  The other woman and I are very prone to motion sickness.  Our pilot Eric was so sensitive to this and took the best care of us.  Everyone got a window seat and he gave us lots of tips to reduce motion sickness before we even got in the air.  I am also afraid of heights (I know..why did I do this?).  Our pilot made us feel so relaxed and made jokes.  
       We toured around the whole Island.  We had been on Kauai for a few days, so it is was amazing to see the places we visited from the air.  Eric gave us tips on where to visit after we landed and even recommended a great Pho place for lunch. 
       Most people do helicopter rides in Kauai.  The other couple we were with had previously done the helicopter and said this was much better.  The helicopter didn't see the whole island and they got much more sick.   You also can't bring little ones on the helicopter.   I was so glad we did this and I will never forget it.
