We really enjoyed this tour!  We saw all the parts of Kauai that you cannot see from car or boat.  Such a beautiful island!  Harry our pilot was so knowledgeable and told us a lot about the island.  He was fun to site see with.
This was a wonderful tour. We took our kids and grandkids and had a wonderful time. Our pilot Brian had lots of information to share. Great trip. Expensive but GREAT!

The combination of the bi-plane, pilot/tour guide and spectacular scenery made this a true unique experience.  The speed of the plane, being slower than a chopper, allowed a more leisurely experience, although the open cockpit provided the necessary exhilaration!!

The canvas headgear with goggles and headset were classic!!    The commentary and learnings about landmarks and geology were very insightful.

My wife and I loved the experience!!  Highly recommend.

review_title: Great flight today in the Waco Bi-plane.  Beautiful scenery and an adventure in the plane!
review_text: So first, I'm a private pilot (just two years since licensed).  When sitting on the beach a few days ago, I heard this unusual engine sound and looked up and saw a bright yellow bi-plane flying over and thought "I have to do that!".  A little research led me to Air Ventures and their brand-new (2017) bi-plane.  It's a beautiful airplane - basically a very modern version of a classic bi-plane design.  I had absolutely no concern about the safety of the aircraft - in fact it's maneuverability made it the perfect platform for sightseeing.  Our pilot was great - obviously very experienced and safe but also a great tour guide.  If you're an aviation buff, I would highly recommend this - really a unique experience blended with seeing the natural beauty of Kauai.  There are a few things to be aware of though - it is an open cockpit aircraft that seats two reasonably sized people in the front.  It's noisy, though it's mostly obviated by the headset/cloth helmet you get to wear (and look swanky).  Photos with your phone can be done if you rent a plastic enclosure ($5) from them for safety reasons.  My daughter's phone had a few problems focusing through the case.  So there are certainly more comfortable options for a flight tour (also at Air Ventures), but I can't think of another that is quite the adventure.  Highly recommended if you're into this sort of thing.

Kevin the pilot and his staff were super friendly. The preflight briefing was quick and you get a good walk around of the plane. Once we were up the views were spectacular, the ride was smooth and the commentary from Kevin was incredibly historic and factual while maintaining a great level of humor. We saw parts of the isle not accessible by car or boat and famous movie back drops (including Scaramanga's secret beach in gold finger). The open cockpit gave a sense of classic adventure that you could only get in a biplane. The cool temperatures made the ride very comfortable and the views of volcanoes and waterfalls seemed endless. I highly recommend this tour over a helicopter tour, mainly because of the ambiance and the fact that you sit in front of the pilot so your view is unobscured. Take offs and landings were perfect and short, Kevin is a true and experienced pilot. All in all a great experience! 10/10 would charter "Woodstock" again!

review_title: Great price, but very different experience from than a helicopter.
review_text: The captain and staff at AirVentures was very friendly. My husband and I did the air and luau combo, which was a great deal for what you are suppose to get. I did a lot of research on helicopter flights and planes like the one at AirVentures, and ideally they all show you the same sights around the island, but you will pay an arm and a leg for a helicopter ride. Unfortunately, the day we went was pretty cloudy and rainy, which I had asked if it would affect our route for the trip and I was told "we wouldn't take you on the flight if it wasn't going to be worth your time and money." One of the main sights I was looking forward to seeing was the "Jurassic Falls" and some of the other Falls that are unable to be seen by foot or car. The weather did end up keeping us from seeing some of these sights, which I personally felt made it not worth the money. My husband and I opted to pay the extra $25 to attach our GoPro to the wing of the plane, which captured some great footage, however I think I was able to see more from the GoPro video, than from the actual flight. My husband sat in the front next to the captain, and I sat directly behind the captain. There is no air(just a small fan) in the cabin, and it was very stuffy and uncomfortable. Unfortunately because I was seated behind the captain, I felt as though I was unable to get a great view of the sights, since everything was mostly on the passenger side of the plane. Overall it wasn't a horrible experience, but its definitely not the same experience as a helicopter. I noticed during the flight and during a hike on the NaPali coast later that week, that the helicopters take their passengers much closer into each beautiful valley along the coast, and you get a much more up close experience of some of the falls and beautiful sights that Kauai has to offer. Make sure you do your research and know exactly what you're wanting to see and what kind of experience you want. AirVentures was great, the flight was very smooth, especially the landing, but you certainly get what you pay for since you're only paying 1/3 of the cost of a helicopter ride!

review_title: Had fun, just wish weather would have cooperated!
review_text: Best bang for your buck for seeing kauai by air. Great pilot, easy checkin process, a little warm in the cabin but they had cold towels to offer

This review is for the 1130AM biplane ride with Kevin - the mustachioed pilot. We began by getting an up-close view and detailed overview of the brand new biplane that Air Ventures purchased in 2017. That thing is a beauty! Kevin made sure we safely boarded the two side-by-side seats in the front of the biplane and got us set up with our old-school caps with headphones, mic, and optional goggles. The headset is very comfortable and easy to use - although you need to be careful to speak loudly and to keep your mic out of the wind so you can hear Kevin's narration.

Within 5 minutes of taking off, we already had amazing mountain views and it only got better from there. It was great to be able to take in all the spectacular sights without having to look through a window and to breath in the fresh air and touch the clouds! We were concerned that such a small plane might have a bumpy ride, but it was smooth sailing except for maybe 1 or 2 brief moments when we were turning over Waimea canyon.

If you're staying on the North Shore, being able to see the breathtaking views of the Waimea canyon without having to make the 3-4 hour trip would be enough to justify the cost of admission by itself. The awesome overview of the Na Pali coast and all the highlights around the island just makes the deal even sweeter.

One recommendation - if you're going to bring a DSLR camera like we did, you may have better luck with a telescopic lens, since my wife had some difficulty snapping good pictures with her regular lens because she was trying to reach over my shoulder to snap the pictures. If you have a GoPro camera, you can bring it and mount it on the plane for $25 or so - I would highly recommend that.

Overall, this is a must do attraction that I wish I had done earlier! 5 stars!
The staff were great and Harry our pilot was so professional and insightful. I thoroughly enjoyed this experience and would be happy to recommend it to anyone visiting Kauai!
Wonderful company to do business with.  All employees seemed to like the work they are doing.  It made for an awesome flight.  We will highly recommend this tour.

We had a great time flying over Kauai with Air Ventures. The pilot was entertaining and knew the island well. The entire operation was efficient, punctual, and safety-conscious. The plane is not air-conditioned so heat is a concern. Cold compresses and water were available if needed.  Ladies - do not wear earrings! The head-sets you have to wear will be very uncomfortable if you do, and without the head-sets you won't hear the commentary!  This was a great way to enjoy the beauty of Kauai. You just can't see the Nepali coast from the water or by land nearly as well. And the views of Waimea canyon are amazing. If you're afraid of heights, this is a much better option than a helicopter, you feel much more secure!

Pilot was super knowledgeable and friendly. Saw other reviews that ride was smooth but ours was slightly turbulent which was on the scary side. I am not a  fear of flying person either. Great experience to see Kauai like this but we were scared.

review_title: Biplane tour is the way to go.
review_text: We drove up to see the Napali valleys from the lookout and it was completely cloudy.  Very disappointing.  However, I had already booked a biplane tour before our trip.  I'm so glad I did.  First - I got to cross "fly in a biplane" off my bucket list.  That alone was awesome.  Second - we got to see the entire island in the course of an hour, including the Napali coast.  I've ridden in helicopters and closed prop planes.  The down side is that if you're not on the side facing the attraction it will be difficult for you to see.  In the biplane it's just two of you and you can both see out in all directions.  Kevin narrated the entire trip so we knew what we were looking at and he made sure we got to see everything.  We even stuck our hands out in a cloud so we could say we touched a cloud (nice suggestion, Kevin).  The highlight had to be flying in the crater of Mt. Kawaikini and seeing all of the waterfalls.  Yes - we flew into a volcano crater in a biplane.  This was definitely a major highlight of an amazing trip.  Highly recommend!

We spent two weeks in Hawaii, one as a family of 4 with our young adult offspring, and one including my senior in-laws. We had been scheduled to fly with the other local company when it was just the 4 of us, but the weather didn't cooperate. They couldn't accommodate our schedule when we tried to reschedule, but Air Ventures could. Harry, our pilot, was awesome. The plane was clean, and with noise-canceling headphones, it was awesome. I was given a bottle of water at the beginning of the flight, but was so mesmerized, I forgot to drink it! We flew over the southern part of Kauai, over Poipu and the neighboring coffee plantation, then up the west coast to see Waimea Canyon, following up the canyon to the Na Pali coast before heading inland past waterfalls and rainforest back to Lihue. We were in the air for a full hour. We all enjoyed it very much.

Il nostro obbiettivo era vedere la Na Pali Coast senza affrontare il mare mosso e lo scopo è stato raggiunto. Non è questo però l'unico motivo per raccomandare questo volo, tutta l'isola è molto interessante vista dall'alto, in particolare il Waimea Canyon e le Makaleha Mountains (che dopo la pioggia presentavano un incredibile numero di cascate).
L'aereo è molto stabile per cui il volo è confortevole, anche per merito del pilota. 
Buona la finestratura che permette di fare ottime foto. 
Vale sicuramente la spesa

Our air tour of Kauai was great.  As the advertising says, you can't really appreciate the island until you see it from the air.  Our pilot and tour guide was knowledgeable and an outstanding pilot.  I highly recommend Air Ventures

Air Venture was a perfect way to see the entire island and it met all our expectations. Our pilot was very professional and well knowledge on the island. The scenery was beautiful. I would highly recommend this excursion.

review_title: Nice experience! We did it with a 3 year old, was awesome!
review_text: Nice scenic view of the island, including the canyon and a bunch of waterfalls, and coastlines, with of course the Napali coast as a highlight. Well worth it's time and money!

A must do when you are on Kauai! Most people make a flight in a helicopter, but we had never been in a biplane, and we wanted to experience it once. And it was so nice! We had a very good view over the island, and the fight took long, it was great. Our captain told us a lot of interesting things. We would recommend this!
We loved this excursion.  A must if you want to see all of Kauai.  The pilot was very knowlegable about the history of Kauai and it was a very pleasent flight.

Eric Johnson gave us a fabulous tour of the island circling back on key views so both sides could see and all could take in the incredible natural wonders of Kauai. He was friendly and funny. Check in was easy with plenty of Aloha. I would recommend this over helicopters any day. Quieter and smoother all the way around. We were lucky to get maximum clarity on our day. Took tons of photos with Eric's help pointing out unbelievable things on his side of the plane (I was in co-pilot's seat). Lisa and I visited Oahu, Hawaii, and Kauai and this was definitely one of the highlights. Highly recommend flying with Air Ventures Hawaii.

Pilot Kevin introduced himself and gave a thorough overview of the pending trip and details about the airplane in which we would fly (a gorgeous, brand new, bright yellow plane!) During the flight, Kevin communicated with us through two-way headsets and gave a great narrative of the sights we saw. The scenery was as beautiful as expected, and seeing it from the perspective of the open-cockpit made it an over-the-top experience. The flight was smooth, the takeoff and landing even smoother, and the seating was very comfortable. The cost was very reasonable relative to the experience. Great, great experience!!

My husband(Steven), our daughter (Jessica) and I had a great time flying over Kauai Island. It was a great adventure. Our pilot was very professional and knowledgeable about the island's history. He even allowed my husband to be the co-pilot. A great opportunity to get pictures of the island.  Alisia

review_title: Air Ventures was the best decision we made on our whole trip!!
review_text: We came to Kauai knowing we wanted to do a tour by air but weren't sure if we should choose airplane or helicopter. After looking at the differences there weren't many and the airplane tour was incredibly cheaper. We chose the private airplane tour and we couldn't have been more impressed and happy with it. It was more than we expected and the coolest part is it's very personalized especially with it just being 3 people or less of your own party and then the pilot. We can't wait to come back again and use Air Ventures!
Did this tour with my mother for Mother's Day and we both had a blast! Harry is an awesome pilot and I'd definitely recommend this adventure to anyone who doesn't suffer from severe motion sickness.

Amazing way to learn about the island and see the famous spots. Eric was a great tour guide and pilot. He knows the island inside and out, wonderful sense of humor and a safe pilot. Definitely recommended on your visit to Kauai!

This trip was amazing,the views were breathtaking,you don't appreciate the real beauty of Hawaii until you take a aerial tour of the islands.Truly magnificent,it is a trip of a lifetime.Kevin was awesome,so knowledgeable and detailed every site we flew over.He is the best.

Family of four, sort of concerned about air sickness so chose the flight with Airventures instead of a helicopter. This was a great choice! Flight was extremely smooth (albeit we had lights winds that morning) and the pilot Harry did a terrific job pointing out the key landmarks - all while keeping safety at top of the list.  The tour circled the whole island of Kauai taking off to the west to see Waimea Canyon up close, the Napali coast and the taking us to the center and the tall mountains.  Price pp was less than the helicopter, too.
A truly unreal experience.  I'm terrified of heights and the pilot went gentle.  Such an amazing view of entire island.  Highly highly recommend

review_title: Biplane tour for mother & daughter birthday
review_text: Flew in the Waco today with our pilot Kevin...unbelievable! He made the preflight and flight so much fun and is a great pilot and tour guide!! It was a fantastic experience from beginning to end and flying around Kauai in an open cockpit cannot be beat!!! Would definitely recommend.

Wow. Rainbows and all.
Really enjoyed the comments and tips for further ground adventures, thanks to our pilot, Eric.

We took a plane tour of Kauai and were blown away by the beautiful sights!  Eric was our pilot- he is fun and quite knowledgeable about the island.  If you are prone to motion sickness, I'm not sure I would recommend a plane tour, but otherwise, get your camera ready!

We took an air tour of Kauai and it was absolutely gorgeous!  Eric was our pilot- he is very knowledgeable and fun to listen to.  This was a highlight of the trip with the exception of getting motion sick.  If you are prone to motion sickness, I would not recommend a plane tour.  Otherwise, get your camera ready!

review_title: Blue skies and water even on a rainy day
review_text: On the wettest island on the planet, one might expect some rain delays for a scenic flight...just not so!  The hour-long tour of Kauai, clockwise around the island, hit all the best attractions.  The high-wing air van seating eight or nine folks provided a stable platform for pictures and the cruise speed at about 120 MPH was just right to keep the sights moving by the window.  Pilot Harry was personable, knowledgeable, and capable as he delivered accounts of the land below.  The rain stayed largely around Kauai's highest point of land and the mist never obscured the view downward.  Surprisingly, there was plenty of sun around the Kauai shoreline.  It's trip well worth the time and money.  Pilot Hugh

This was one of the best experiences of my life. Kevin did an exceptional job at pointing out various landmarks and giving the history of the island. If you've never ridden in a biplane and find yourself in Kauai this should be at the top of your to do list! There really isn't a better way to see the island.
We had a delightful experience and a really fun pilot.  Our views were spectacular and easily visible from the airplane.  Our pilot pointed out many interesting aspect of the island of Kauai!

You've got to give this a try. Kevin made sure we had a great time. He is not only a great pilot and tour guide but will also give you any island information you need. Skip the helicopter and give this a try, Kevin will make sure you have a unique experience. A very different view of the island.
These folks are the best - from the initial pickup, the flight, the friendliness of everyone involved. If you're looking for a good tour to see the island, this is it.

review_title: Great way to see the island's beauty
review_text: We had a wonderful flight, saw lots of waterfalls, great narration. It was priced well and we felt safe.

review_title: Put this on your BUCKET LIST
review_text:
The BiPlane flight was truly remarkable.  Flying through the "Grand Canyon of the Pacific"  was amazing.
Our pilot provided excellent narration throughout the hour and 20 minute flight.  This is one thing I would do again....
This was an amazing flight; personal and private. Kevin was an awesome and informative pilot. We highly recommend this flight. Worth every penny and more👍
We did the biplane tour and Kevin did an awesome job! The plane flies low and moves slow enough to really enjoy the tour!

We booked with Air Ventures very last minute after another company had canceled on us. The staff was very friendly and accommodating! We were on the air bus plane with two other couples. Our pilot, Harry, gave a very informative and thorough tour of the island. We had great weather for it. We paid the extra $25 to have our GoPro mounted on the wing during our tour. Unfortunately, Harry forgot to start the camera before we took off. Fortunately we were able to drop the camera off another morning of our trip and they mounted it and took the pictures that time.  We were going to be late getting back to pick up the camera and one of the staff members offered to meet us with the camera. Ultimately we had them lock it up in the safe until the next morning.  Overall, great service and would definitely take this tour again!!

The staff are cordial and warm. They called us in advance to warn us about inclement weather and cancellation of the tour on the day in question. The day of the tour , we arrived to the assigned place with the help of Lisa's directions through the airport. The pilot was a chilled out guy and he took our pics before the journey started and indulged us in many a trivia about the island and the wonders it has to offer. There were 4 of us in the ride meant for 6.Its was comfortable enough and once we rose to the sky , no looking back. We got to see the most breath taking views of the falls, canyon and the beaches. Got a little nauseous along the way but the views made up for the suffering. I am glad this was planned to be done by us in the beginning of the trip. The pilot told us about all the tourist and local attractions. After getting the view from the top, we later decided to get a close peek from the ground level! Helped us plan our trip better as we got to know which places are in proximity and can be visited in close succession. In kuaui, air tour is a must do.

Era una de las cosas que queríamos hacer en nuestra visita a Kauai. Al llegar al aeropuerto y tras alquilar el coche, nos acercamos a las oficinas que están al lado para informarnos. Hacía muy buen día y nos recomendaron hacer el vuelo de las 3pm ya que el tiempo en la isla es muy impredecible y tanto esa hora como el primer vuelo que hacen por la mañana es el que recomiendan. Tienen la opción tanto en avioneta para 6 como en avioneta de doble plano para dos y sin cerrar. Elegimos la primera opción para ver tranquilamente la isla y hacer fotos, aunque nos quedamos con ganas de hacer la otra. Si lo que se quiere es más diversión, esa puede ser la opción ideal. También hay diferencia de precio. A nosotros nos costo 135 USD por persona. Igual por internet o gestionado desde el alojamiento puede ser algo más barato. Destacar la amabilidad del personal.

En nuestro vuelo fuimos 5. Hay cuatro asientos en la derecha y dos en la izquierda. Yo iba en la izquierda y mi mujer en la derecha. Las mejores vistas son desde la derecha, aunque se aprecia bien desde la izquierda, pero si se puede elegir... Antes del vuelo preguntan quien quiere ir delante con el piloto. Este nos estuvo todo el rato contando cosas de la isla. Al hacer tan bueno, pudimos ver todo. Se empieza por la costa hacia Poipu, se va hacia el interior viendo el cañón del Waimea, se recorre la costa de Napali y la costa norte, para volver al interior y al aeropuerto. Una hora en total. No se movió casi y nadie se mareo. Todos nos bajamos encantados. Te llevas una buena idea de la isla.

We should have taken this air tour at the beginning of our stay.  It was fantastic.   We were picked up at the hotel and taken to the airfield by the wife of the owner of the tour company.  She was very gracious and informative.  The staff's attention to detail and friendliness was very comforting.  Brian, our pilot, was friendly, professional, knowledgeable and a great pilot.  He made sure we saw everything from all sides and, most importantly, for me, the ride was incredibly smooth.  We highly recommend this company

Our pilot harry was informative and friendly. I got some really great shots of the island from above. Our plane was comfortable, but make sure to take the proper precautions if you get motion sickness (dramamine)

My boyfriend and I picked-up the private aeroplane tour around Kauai and it was amazing. This island is so beautiful and there is so much thing to see. It was good to see the island from the air and to get another point of view.
The staff when we arrive was really friendly and our pilot, Brian was wonderful. He was really knowledgeable and try is best to show us everything.
We really recommandant this company.
Thanks for all and for the pictures that you took for us and send us. 
Sophie and Adrien

review_title: Lovely views of the whole island
review_text: From the moment I called them, they were helpful, polite and easy to schedule. Once we were in the island, they were very informative about the weather and when it would be better to fly, we had to postpone the flight twice b.c of weather conditions. The day we went, it was great. Plane is a little stuffy, need more air circulating around, but its probably the same with any small aircraft. Plane was in great conditions and they offer cold towels and water on board if needed. A picture was taken at the beginning and was emailed to us to keep.
Excellent way to see the island. Ground staff were very pleasant.  Erin, our pilot, was very knowledgeable , entertaining and enjoyed the flight as much as we did.
What a fantastic experience! Jill the owner is amazing​! We saw more of the island with a longer ride than any copter ride! The plane itself was so smooth! Highly recommend this company and tour!

review_title: Best Biplane Ride in the World!
review_text: This is certainly the most exciting and fun way to see the island from the air!  Kevin, the pilot, couldn't have been more accommodating and informative.  If you are into plane history and design of the old planes, you will find this brand new plane is amazing and very comfortable.  Kevin has lived on Kauai for  25 years, so he knows every spot on the island and provides a detailed tour.  We loved it!    Dave & Kim, Phoenix, AZ

review_title: Best way to see the Island!
review_text: The whole experience was awesome, we were greeted/treeted like Ohana. Liz checked us in and took time to get to know us, where we were from and how our vacation was going. Brian our pilot was as friendly and personable as Liz and he made us feel safe and informed of the process and details of the island as we flew over all the island. Have to say I've done the helicopter tour and by far Air Ventures was the best way to see all the island and the beautiful Napali coastline.

This is a great way to see the island.  Brian, our pilot and guide, was friendly, knowledgeable and fun.  The tour was on time and we were gone about 70 minutes or so.  Saw every part of the island and Brian maneuvered the plane so we could see water falls, canyons and even whales in the ocean!!  Definitely enjoyed this tour!

This was an extremely enjoyable plane tour. The pilot was very entertaining and informative. He was also extremely sensitive to the fact that my younger daughter might become motion sick. The ride was so smooth she didn't have any problems at all. The entire family enjoyed it very much !

Wasn't too sure about going up in such a small plane, but it was awesome! Eric was our pilot and he was great!Couldn't believe all the things we saw - the Waimea Canyon is breathtaking, the Na Pali coast line is beautiful, and the waterfalls - what can I say, to mention a few.  This is a class act tour! There were 5 passengers and Eric.  There was room for one more passenger.

Having taken this tour 4 years ago, we wanted our friends to enjoy as well.  Smooth flight. Pilot's commentary focused on the highlights we were seeing below.  Views were great, especially of Waimea Canyon a.k.a. the Grand Canyon of the Pacific - very different, but equally as intriguing.

review_title: Most fun kauai tour in 4 visits
review_text:
This us a must do! I have been to Kauai 4 times and done most tours.  I love helicopters but the the thought of open cockpit seamed so much more like flying and no need to worry if you will get a window seat.
The flight was slow, smooth and I could see everything.  Kevin was great to fly with and gave a good history of the island. Pointed out the best beached and some dangerous ones to stay away from.

Kevin just got his new plane the day before.  WHAT A BEAUTY.

I AM 6'6" 305 lbs.  My wife and I did manage to fit in the front seat.
The temperature was grest.  The hestsests worked perfect. The small windscreen blocker rain from the few rain spots we flew through.

It was a long fun flight and we got to see the whole island.  Best way to see napali coast.

I will do again next time.

Thanks Kevin for a fun glight.
10 start!..

The biplane ride over Kauai truly is a ride of a lifetime! Imagine stepping on board a brand new yellow biplane (affectionately named "Woodstock") for an open air flight over the most scenic and less accessible areas of this magnificent island! My wife and I only have good things to say about our experience. This was our 25th anniversary, so we wanted to do something special. Chelsea, Liz and the team were fantastic, and Kevin, our pilot, was awesome! He made us feel very comfortable, taking the time to share his passion for Kauai and biplanes. We never felt rushed. I am an avid enthusiast so I had lots of questions and Kevin was happy to respond. Instructions were clear, and off we went. Throughout the spectacular flight, Kevin explained what was below us and told us fascinating stories related to various points of interest. We did this on our last day so we could recognize from the air all the spots we had been to during our vacation. I highly recommend this tour. It's unique and you won't feel like you've done "what everybody else does". Not only will you see Kauai from above in an exhilarating open-air cockpit, but you'll learn lots of interesting facts and stories about Kauai. Thank you, Air Ventures Hawaii! Let's do it again next time!

Recommended to us by a friend who said before you do anything else on the island you should see it by air first. 

On that note, I booked the trip and we arrived and checked in easily. Eric was our pilot. He was funny, laid back and got everyone ready

Being the tallest in the group, I ended up in the copilot seat. The experience was great!

We took off and flew for 60 minutes, saw the entire island, including: Waimea Canyon, Na Pali Coast and so much more! The trip was with 5 others and ice towels were provided to keep us cool as it gets warm in the plane. 

While, I actually love air travel, my anxiety flared up in the smaller plane, but I handled it and was still able to enjoy the trip. The pictures were awesome, the crew was awesome, and I would recommend this to anyone (unless you dislike small planes!)

Our bi-plane tour was the highlight of our visit to Kauai.  We were the lucky customers who got to be the first to go up in Woodstock - the new, bright yellow plane.  The whole team was fabulous but our pilot, Kevin, was amazing.  He knew the  island, told great stories and made sure we had great views.   The bi-plane tour was an experience of a lifetime and far more interesting than any helicopter tour we have ever taken!

Signed up for the 3 in 1 trip, air, water and land. We flew out at 8:00am. Wonderful views deep into the island. Dennis was our pilot and was very informative and very conscious of our safety. Got up close in many spots, a few, it was a little too foggy. Gorgeous sights!! Worth the money!
Eric was a great pilot and very informative and funny. He was also extremely attentive when I temporarily started to feel queasy. It was a great experience. I highly recommend!

Our pilot Eric was awesome.  Very engaging and concerned with his passengers. The view is incredible, stunning and just amazing. He shared facts, took time to circle around for those on the left side of the plane. He also found us whales from way up...just awesome. Sure you may get closer in a helicopter but you have a better chance of getting sick too.

This aerial tour of Kauai was amazing!  Do this first so you can get ideas of what to see & do on the ground.  Our pilot was also a tour guide pointing out popular and out of the way destinations.  The pilot and staff were prepared for upset tummies in the air and everyone was very kind.
It was a breathtaking and safe experience. The pilot was knowledgeable, and the ride was very smooth.

review_title: Fun and amazing views of the whole island
review_text: Have done helicopter tour but liked this airplane ride much better. Kevin, our pilot, was great! Experienced as a pilot, funny and very knowledgeable, he gave us a great tour over Kauai. Not just pointing out  landmarks, he gave us recommendations on snorkeling, history of the island and much more. Highly recommend!!

Eric our pilot was great.  He was knowledgeable, enthusiatic and made the experience
a whole lot of fun.  The plane was comfortable and the views were great.  With everything explained we really got a good overview of Kauai.  It was a much cheaper that a heliocopter and I think we saw more of the island.  The office staff was very nice to pick up and drop us back by our cruise ship. This is definitely the tour to take.

review_title: Excellent tour at half the price of a helicopter!
review_text: This was an outstanding tour, and a great value for the money.  Our pilot, Eric, was extremely personable, knowledgeable, friendly and a very safe pilot. I'm not sure why someone would spend twice the money for helicopter tour? We saw the entire island, all the great scenic views, and it was extremely comfortable! I give this a five star rating!

Expert pilot (Marcus) and very helpful staff (Mary) made our flight a highlight of our trip. We were lucky to have good weather and great visibility so we saw the canyon, coast, and everything in between. Highly recommend!
The tour was amazing. Mike our pilot was knowledgeable and very nice. We would take this tour again when visit next time.

review_title: You Must See Kauai From Above
review_text: Kauai is small enough to get an idea of its grandeur in an hour long flight.  The airvan offered a generally smooth flight, and didn't have the helicopters weight restrictions.  The pilot adjusted his tour to avoid rain, and was very knowledgeable about the island's history and geography.

This was our second adventure to view the island of Kauai, the first being by helicopter.  We were excited by the helicopter experience; however, loved the plane ride more!  It was just so awesome, the pilot/owner was terrific, the ride very comfortable and smooth, and view was unobstructed.  We would highly recommend this trip to anyone!
In all the adventures we had on the Island this was by far the best! Awesome memories we will cherish forever! Thank you Ray and crew!!

Air Ventures was great. Kevin, our pilot/guide, was very knowledgable,  accommodating, and had obviously done this many times as he addressed about every issue that could come up. He gave us a very nice smooth ride and great narration. Would definately  recommend!

With a window for everyone, we were able to get some great shots!  Our pilot provided a wealth of information about the history, movies made on the island, geology, agriculture, landmarks, animals and other information about what makes this island unique!

I wanted to do the bi-plane ride, but it was in the shop for maintenance. This was the next best thing. Harry gave us an excellent tour of the island and even got a whale to jump out of the water just for us!😀

review_title: AMAZING views!  Great pilot! Not to be missed!
review_text: We really enjoyed our flight over Kauai from the 6-seater +pilot small airplane (I want to say Eric(??) was the pilot.  I am one to be sensitive to motion sickness and thought the plane might be a little less bumpy than a helicopter (not sure, never been in a helicopter!), and I took a dramamine prior to the flight.  I started out feeling great and the take off was fine.  I was enjoying the sights of the shores/beaches, coffee plantations, mountains, rivers, waterfalls, and even a couple whale sightings!  Towards the end there was some turbulence, and I started to feel a little icky. The pilot was so helpful and had brought along a cooler of cold wet wash cloths- of which I used three to keep cool and comfortable.  It was such a great way to see the island, really highly recommend!  I am also happy that the planes are more eco-friendly than the helicopters.  The staff back at the airport also gave me a ginger lozenge after the flight to help settle my stomach- every one was so nice.

This was an awesome trip.  Dennis made sure we saw all parts of the island.  We have taken helicopter trips before and this was better.  We got the entire island and loads of waterfalls and the tip of a whale!  Would highly recommend!

review_title: Have so much fun and company was very friendly and considerate
review_text: We had so much fun seeing this beautiful island from the sky! The company/pilot was very friendly and considerate. Would recommend!

Highly recommend! Awesome!!! Ray, the owner was our pilot and was fantastic!!! We had taken a helicopter tour with another company a few days before and this was so much better! We saw more of the island and at better views. The plane ride was smooth and quieter. Ray was informative and very personable. Will use Airventures again on our next trip to Kauai.
Great tour of Kauai. Have wanted to do the biplane tour for several years. Take it for the experience!

We had a most thrilling sightseeing tour with Dennis as our pilot. We were picked up at no additional charge from the cruise pier and returned. Dennis is very knowledgeable and we felt very at ease. I have a fear of looking straight down, but I was taking photos like crazy and felt very very safe. They even took our photo with our pilot and plane!

review_title: Best Way to see ALL of KAUAI
review_text: We met our pilot at the Lihue airport. He was very professional and really knew his Kauai facts. The flight was just the right amount of time (about an hour in the air). I really don't like flying but our pilot was great and made us feel so comfortable that I was able to just relax and enjoy the tour. (I'm sorry I don't remember is name. I think he is a retired Doctor).

Our trip with Air Ventures was exactly what we had hoped for it to be. Our pilot was a real laid back gentleman whom had the best knowledge of the geographical features of Kauai of anyone we met during our trip. 

We went on a day that had some higher than usual trade winds and some storm activity, and our pilot just adjusted his tour minute by minute to make sure that we had the best tour we could have at that particular time.

This gave us some great views of the mountain ranges, including Kong, and a lot of amazing views of the cliffs along the Napali Coast. The pilot was careful to bring the plane in a circle to give everyone on the aircraft a chance to see all the important features of the island, and was a very active narrator.

Our pilot definitely tried hard to get us the best tour he could sliding the plane through a crack in the clouds once he saw an opportunity to get out to the north coast. 

One note, the plane is not pressurized and if you are sensitive to that you should definitely be prepared for your ears to do some crackling.

review_title: Perfect way to see the Island of Kauai from the air
review_text: Wow, what a perfect way to see the island of Kauai including sights that are not accessible by car.  Eric, our pilot, was knowledgeable, humorous and so accommodating.  It was amazing to see the Napoli Coast, Mt. Waialeale (the wettest place on earth), Waimea Canyon, numerous waterfalls and so much more. What a unique experience.

review_title: Biplane Tour is way better than heli!
review_text: We've done a small heli tour of kauai but far preferred our flight tour on the red baron biplane!  Our pilot was very knowledgeable, we circled whales, and got a nice slow view of the beautiful Island.  Unlike the heli, this guarantees one of 2 front seats (I'm the one that always gets the lousy middle seat on a helicopter).
Great views, even got to see whales! The pilot, Henry was awesome. He gave us lots of information about all the sites on the island.

In every way, my wife and I could not have enjoyed more our flight with Air Ventures.  Friendly and efficient ground staff; equipment that provides maximum visibility, and a pilot, Kevin, with 25+ years experience and who was extremely good at dealing with questions from passengers of all ages.  We would certainly highly recommend this experience for anybody visiting Kauai and wanting a first class overview of the Island.

Thule our pilot was great. He would provide us with information over everywhere we flew. Since the weather was good he would divert from the regular tour and fly us off tour. He made the tour that much better. He even took the time to communicate with our 5 year old nephew during the tour. We would definitely recommend this tour to our friends. It showed us a Kauai as as it can only be really be seen, from the sky.

I had a great time!  I would have regretted not taking this flight - sure glad I got to go!
Kevin, my pilot, was great about pointing out sights and explaining mountainous formations.  Quite knowledgeable!
From seeing the plane overhead to actually taking the trip I was excited and not one thing let me down at all.  I loved every minute of the tour and our pilot was amazing!

Kevin is a great pilot and the sights were fantastic, however we discovered the night after our flight (Red Baron) that my fiancé and I could no longer hear crickets out of the ear that was toward the outside of the aircraft.  Staff didn't respond to email inquiring about this happening to other guests.  10 days later, still have hearing loss.  Sights are great, but I would not recommend given potential loss of hearing.

Our pilot was very good, explaining the various of parts of Kauai as we passe over them.  He was lighthearted and pleasant to listen to.  He covered the whole island and there was good view fro both sides of the plane.  They took photos of the group after the flight, and a DVD of the trip could be purchased for those who did not have a camera.  The pilot was able to work with the weather situation to provide the best possible view of the island.  Would recommend this adventure as soon as you arrive in Kauai to get the lay of the island for when you ventured out on a driving tour on your own.

After some research on TripAdvisor and speaking with Chelsea who helped organize our group of 8( 4 adults and 4 kids) we were super excited about the air tour of the Naapali Coast. We were on the cruise ship and Susan picked us up conveniently right near the port. What a nice woman. Her and her staff are professional, friendly and patient. We were treated with such care. Eric was our pilot and he was fantastic. This is the best way to see the coast. You can see from anywhere you sit and Eric provided commentary throughout. We saw humpback whales and amazing views that I can't begin to describe. Highly recommended and thank you to Susan and her staff.

review_title: A Must To See the 90% of the Island You Can;t From The Road
review_text: You can only see 10% of Kauai from the road in a vehicle.  By airplane is the best way to see the rest of the Island.  Captain Roy was great.  We flew a few hundred feet above ridges of the mountains, so close that you could easily see people walking on the trails.  No, they weren't ant size!  The plane was small air conditioned, and everyone had a window seat.  There were also cold towels for people who got overheated by the greenhouse effect of their large window.  Captain Roy talked to everyone as we flew along and we talked back as we saw things for everyone else to look at.  I would suggest that you use the washroom before the flight, as the flight is an hour long especially if you've had a few cups of Kona or Kauai coffer or pints of Kona or Kauai beer.  Photo ops galore:  taking off and landing and of course everywhere on the island below you!

review_title: The only way to see the island and have the ride of a lifetime
review_text: The Snoopy 2 , an open air biplane is a completely different experience than any helicopter or  small airplane. Kevin, our pilot, was extremely knowledgeable not only with the flight commentary but telling us the history of the biplane itself. The views were amazing,  we saw whales so he turned the plane to make sure we saw them from both sides. I would highly recommend this dc flight to anyone.
The biplane tour with Kevin was absolutely AMAZING! A must do. Beautiful views and Kevin narrated the entire flight. It was great to be in an open cockpit and have a private tour!

We did the one hour biplane tour with Kevin and it was amazing!!! He showed us the entire island and his knowledge about the island was phenomenal! Would recommend for anyone who loves to fly and want a more private experience. Would definitely do again!

review_title: What a Thrill!! Take the Red Snoopy II BiPlane!
review_text: Incredible adventure!  We didn't want the norm, so we booked a Bi Plane trip of a lifetime on Snoopy II.  Our very experienced pilot Kevin was entertaining and knowledgeable about the island.  He gave us THE smooothest takeoff and landing we've ever experienced in any plane!  What a hoot!  He talked to us continuously on the headsets telling us what we were looking at.  Such amazing views!  Wear comfy clothes. No need for a jacket, the engine of the plane keeps you warm.  Best deal for your tourist $$ while in Hawaii!! I will go again if I ever get the opportunity!  Thanks Kevin and the friendly staff of Air Adventures for a memorable vacation experience!!  Janice and Jack
Great way to see the island. Open air with a full commentary. Helps to have a nice day when you go into the mountains and over the sea. If you are lucky, you may even see a a whale.

review_title: Plane is the way to go!
review_text: This was a highlight of our trip! Dennis was such a wealth of information and the sites were truly breathtaking. I am pregnant so I was worried about motion sickness and not only did I not feel queasy at all but felt so energized afterwards because of the truly amazing views. HIGHLY recommend this tour! If you're coming from the cruise boat just call them and they will arrange to pick you up at the ABC store near the port.

Our trip to Paradise (Hawaii) was wonderful, and our flight with your company was a big part of that.  Our pilot, Eric, was absolutely first-class in the way he conducted the tour.  His expertise and knowledge of the island were excellent!  I got nervous when we started hitting some turbulence and he was genuinely concerned for me and did everything in his power to alleviate the situation.  The only thing that gave us pause on this trip was the fact that the plane was hard to start, which made me really nervous, but it did start on the fourth try.  Maybe the plane could be started and run for a few minutes  earlier in the day so that this doesn't happen to others.  We will highly recommend your company and Eric!

We went on a trip back in October 2016. We choose this company based on really good reviews and a great price. This was the right decision. We had a great experience. Very friendly staff and you feel safe. The airplane is small, but provides everyone with a window, so you can take nice photos. The pilot knew everything about Kauai and he was a great storyteller. We had pretty rough weather that day, but it was still a great trip and we saw a lot of beautiful sights. The pilot even flew us around for 1½ hour - which was longer than we had paid for - really cool! I would recommend the company to everybody. Just a suggestion - if it is windy on the day of your flight, take some seasick pills.

My husband surprised me for my birthday with a biplane tour of the whole island of Kauai. It was absolutely amazing! The views were incredible, the staff was so accommodating and our pilot, Kevin, was awesome! We highly recommend this tour and our pilot to anyone looking for a beautiful full view of the island and a thrill!

A great way to see the island - more fun than a helicopter and not that much more expensive.  Our pilot Kevin was very knowledgeable about planes and Kauai.  The one hour tour in an open cockpit allows you to see all around, is an experience not normally had, and does make you feel like you could chase after the WWI Red Baron.  Great fun!

review_title: Rundflug um Doppeldecker über die schönste Insel
review_text: Als Geburtstagsgeschenk für meinen Freund gönnten wir uns den Rundflug im 'Biplane', dem roten Doppeldeckerflugzeug. Man sitzt zu zweit dicht nebeneinander in einer offenen Kabine. Ein einmaliges Erlebnis. Die Onlinebuchung ging sehr schnell und unkompliziert. Wir wurden freundlich und mit hawaianischer Gelassenheit begrüßt. Unser Pilot war sehr erfahren und erzählte während des gesamten Fluges viele interessante Dinge über die Insel und ihre Einwohner. Das durchwachsene Wetter mit kleineren Regenschauern wurde bei der Flugplanung berücksichtigt, sodass wir trotzdem viel sehen konnten. Alles in allem war der Flug ein echtes Highlight und sehr empfehlenswert für jeden der Kauai besucht!
This is a really great trip.  The pilot was very informative.  A wonderful was to see the inaccessible parts of the island, especially along the NaPali coast.

review_title: Great way to see the island!
review_text:
We thought the bi-plane tour might be kind of scary! It wasn't at all! Kevin was a superb pilot, very friendly and extremely knowledgeable about that island.

I would HIGHLY recommend this to anyone visiting the island and looking to get a good overview of Kauai.

Thanks again Airventures!!

My husband and I opted to do the biplane tour when we arrived in Kauai a few days ago. It was so awesome!! Our pilot Kevin was a great guide, starting from explaining the history of the plane itself, then sharing his almost 30 years of experience on the island in flight, and then finally culminating in an excellent restaurant recommendation that we took him up on after we left. 

The flight was very smooth which was surprising - for some reason I expected the opposite. The views were beautiful. My favorite part was when we flew into the volcano. Kevin also asked where we were staying and flew over our rental!

Our experience was fantastic and I would recommend it to anyone!!

review_title: A unique adventure you'll never forget!
review_text:
We had an amazing time going up in the "Red Baron" biplane for a soaring journey over most of Kauai.

Our pilot, Kevin, was extremely friendly and full of great facts and information during our journey.  Needless to say, he was an excellent pilot, providing a smooth and comfortable ride.  

What a thrilling journey, with absolutely breath-taking views of the stunning Kauai!  It was a blast seeing so many sights we had already visited from an entirely new point of view.

Highly recommended!

With my over 50 years of flying, I can easily say this was a great flight!  Our pilot, Dennis Erb, was enthusiastic, knowledgeable, and above all, an outstanding and professional aviator...  Thank you Dennis...

I did this flight a few years ago and enjoyed the smooth flight as a way to see the island.  This repeat trip was even more spectacular!  Weather was amazing, Eric was an awesome pilot , host, and tour guide.  

Well worth the time and money. A do over.

Kauai must be seen in this way. The scenery is staggering from the ground, but absolutely breathtaking from the air. We flew with Ray on a Private Airplane Tour, and were well looked after, both with supplies to help with air sickness and with an amazing flight of the island. I would highly recommend this company for a tour; they are a family and we immediately became part of it as soon as we stepped in the door.

We had the 'Red Baron' experience, surely the flight of a lifetime !!
Harry, our pilot, was as professional as kind, very  caring and so  easy-going. He was happy to spend some time to explain us some details about the plane/engine  and  cheerful while giving  us instructions to be safe and  to fully enjoy every moment of the flight. 
Harry and the staff went out of their way and  took photos of us before and after the flight: such  great memories! 
Flying inside an open cockpit is completely different from your usual flying experience on small airplanes or helicopters. WOW !! Unsurpassable !!
We were  at first worried to be cold, but this wasn’t the case :  a simple t-shirt makes you feel comfortable as if you were on ground. And the whole experience is really AWESOME !!
We enjoyed very much the one hour flight and would surely recommend the Red Baron as an excellent experience. We’ll be back !!   Thank you !!

This fell into my lap as it was a gift for someone else who couldn't make it, I was nervous, but once we got into the biplane and got in the air, I knew it was fortuitous that I was able to go. Our pilot, Kevin, was extremely knowledgeable and fun and gave one of the best tours I've had - and, his skill as a pilot really put me at ease. The biplane tour was the highlight of my vacation in Kauai and I can't recommend it enough!
Took bi plane tour, very impressed with the pilot and the plane ! Highly recommend this ! It is a unique experience .

review_title: Amazing views, once in a lifetime experience
review_text: I was absolutely terrified of going in a vintage bi-plane, but Kevin and the owners instantly calmed my fears and said he'd bring me right back if I didn't like it after a few minutes. Well, that wasn't necessary because I loved it! It was the smoothest ride with unbelievable views. We touched the clouds and took in the sights for about an hour. The highlight of our trip. I'd absolutely recommend to anyone who's hesitant to give it a try, it's worth it! :)

We were contacted by the staff promptly 24 hours before our scheduled tour that the minimum number of passengers had not been confirmed and there was a possibility, if we could not change to an earlier time, we might be cancelled. Given our situation we were unable to change HOWEVER pilot Harry and the lovely staff made the sacrifice to take us even at their lost.  You will not be disappointed with this tour operator.
Family of 5 with 3 kids under 10 had a blast. Beautiful scenery, friendly and knowledgeable staff and great experience to appreciate the diverse landscape. A must do for visitors to Kauai.

My wife booked the "Red Baron" air tour for Christmas Eve as a surprise.   Kevin was our pilot and he was outstanding.   From making us feel comfortable with that flight itself to all of his local knowledge, he was great.   I highly recommend this tour.

review_title: The way to see the island
review_text: Very friendly, customer oriented and professional.  Our pilot was not only a very good pilot, he had a wealth of knowledge about the island and brought so much of what we were seeing to life.  What impressed us most was the day of our original scheduled flight was questionable weather and they changed us to a different day and time which worked out well.  This was a special time for us as it was our 50th anniversary and this adventure added a lot to our time in the islands.

Ficamos em dúvida se fazíamos o passeio de helicóptero ou avião. Decidimos avião e não nos arrependemos. Valeu muito a pena!

Como muito da paisagem de Kauai não é vista por terra, nada melhor que sobrevoar essa ilha muito bonita.

O voo foi muito bom, piloto muito divertido e dava informação da ilha toda com explicações muito detalhadas.

Fomos muito bem atendidos e a paisagem de Kauai vista pelo alto é indescritível.

Valeu cada centavo que pagamos no passeio.

Somos muito agradecidos a Air Ventures pelo passeio inesquecível.

review_title: The best part of my trip by far!!!
review_text: We spent 7 days on Kaua'i seeing all of the sights. We took the aerial tour and loved it. Kevin is a great tour guide and pilot. We saw the biplane sitting at the terminal and ask Kevin about it. We came back 2 days later and rode with Kevin again, this time in the biplane. Absolutely the best part of my trip. We were fortunate enough to go over the top of the mountain on a rare clear day. If I ever get to go back, this is what I want to do again.
Views were fantastic. Experience was exceptional & memorable.  Well worth the cost!  Would do it again next trip!

review_title: Favorite part of our Hawaiian vacation
review_text: The aerial tour of Kauai was perfect. The pilot was knowledgeable and courteous, the price was reasonable and the scenery fantastic. I compared Air Venture with other companies and they came out ahead. We loved the trip!

Enjoyed an amazing tour of Kauai in an open cockpit bi-plane.  The views were indescribable.  I can't imagine a better way to see this lush and beautiful island.  Kevin was a very competent pilot who made us feel safe.  He was also an excellent tour guide who was well-versed in the history of the island and an all around fun guy.  I can't recommend this experience any more highly.  We'll never forget it!

Unbelievable weather, calm winds, bright sunshine, and a pilot (Harry) who knows his stuff.  Smooth take off and landing.  Excellent informative narrative.  He pointed out and gave background on as much of the island he could.  Shared his own experiences with hiking, surfing and time on the island.  Highly recommend anyone who wants to know about Kauai before they set out exploring to take this flight.
kevin was a great pilot.  We had an awesome time flying over Kauai. It is different flying in an open cockpit.  Will do again Kudos to Kevin

Our pilot Kevin was absolutely awesome! The bi-plane ride was the best way to get a personalized tour of Kauai from the air. Such a breathtaking flight! We lost count of all the waterfalls, and the Na'Pali Coast was unbelievably beautiful. Thanks for helping to make our honeymoon so much better!

This was the highlight of our trip! This little red biplane was so smooth with the landing and take off due to our pilot Kevin who states he has 10000 hours of flight and over 25 years flying the island!  We enjoyed Kevins narration of the island info.  The views were beyond spectacular! Definitely a must and worth every penny spent.  Thank you Kevin!

Stunning views of the coast. Magnificent views of the mountains and waterfalls. Excellent airman ship. Kevin our Pilot and the check in ladies were so professional and accommodating. We booked the Cessna thinking that there may be rain and the weather cleared up and they were able to send us flying in the biplane which is what we had our hearts set on in the first place!! One of our favorite excursions on our cruise that week. Thank you air ventures!!!

The weather was cloudy at best for the week that we visited Kauai.  After a couple of cancelled flights due to poor weather our pilot Kevin was able to read the weather for an appropriate take off time.  I have done a number of scenic flights but can easily say that doing it in an open cockpit of a biplane complete with cloth helmets and headset was easily the most enjoyable.  Kevin has lived in Kauai for years so not only was his commentary excellent but also restaurant tips!!  Thanks Kevin!
Fantastic trip, great pilot, and smooth flight for my wife and our 3 kids. Just got new dslr camera and got some amazing shots. Highly recommend!

We spent quite a bit of time researching various air options for touring Kauai, with helicopters being the obvious first choice, we thought. There were various issues with the  copters, costs being but one, short flight times, etc.

I stopped by Air Ventures to checkout what they had to offer. My wife and I booked a trip with Ray in a four place Cessna 182. Ray was great about showing us the points of interest, customizing it to making sure we were having a great time, and was not in any hurry to get us back. Our scheduled flight was an hour and ended up being an hour and twenty minutes.

So, unless you are absolutely determined to spend more money for less time so you can land at the base of the waterfall for 15 minutes, I highly recommend that you check out Air Ventures. You will have a great time at a great value.

From the time that we arrived, the staff did everything possible to make us welcome and comfortable. The guide/pilot Kevin was excellent and wanted to make sure that all had a great experience. The flight was smooth and comfortable and we saw awesome sights of Kauai. Would definely recommend this to all.
Comforted to be in the experienced hands of Kevin. Informative and incredible views. Highly recommend to others.

review_title: Amazing views you'll never see anywhere else.
review_text:
I loved this adventure so much last year, I had to come back this year...and brought a friend.  She enjoyed it as much as I did the first time.  Eric is a wonderful guide and a funny guy....sometimes!
I would recommend this tour to anybody (wheelchair, handicapped, or not).

For my husband's surpise 70th birthday I booked the open-air flight.  I was a little nervous about going, too, but after meeting Captain Kevin I knew it would be fine.  It was so much more than that!!!  Absolutely Fantastic!  We both highly recommend this for the fun, beauty and thrill of doing something totally different.  We can't wait to go back and do it again!  Thanks to everyone at Air Ventures Hawaii!
The amount of time in the air was just right. One hour is plenty to see the entire island. Pilot was experienced with his knowledge but didn't have much personality. His name was Harry.

My husband and I booked the private flight (he was to chicken for the biplane), for a special tour of Kauai for our honeymoon.  Kevin and the staff far exceeded our expectations. The service from pick up to drop off was fabulous.  The flight was amazing, beautiful and the best tour of the island.  Kevin was entertaining and informative & he made us comfortable and safe!
We highly recommend this tour!!

It started with the user-friendly booking, it continued with a warm welcome at Lihue airport. Kevin (the pilot on this pilot) was patient enough to explain all about the flight, safety, boarding and taking pictures. Then, the flight lasting 60 minutes took us around the beautiful island of Kaua'i. We received a lot of useful information during the flight, but you have to make the experience by your own. Just book it and enjoy the flight with breathtaking moments..

A wonderful flight in the open cockpit of a Waco biplane!  Our pilot, Kevin, gave us a very informative tour of the beautiful island of Kauai.  He has many hours of tail-dragger pilot experience, and over 25 years giving flights on the island.  The beautiful sound of a radial engine, in an open cockpit aircraft is magic besides!!

review_title: An awesome tour of Kauai from the air!
review_text: Our pilot, Kevin, is an outstanding, seasoned pilot and a fantastic tour guide for Kauai.  He demonstrated an excellent knowledge of Kauai and it's history, and constantly showed concern for the passengers' comfort and safety.  I would highly recommend Air Ventures Hawaii - and Kevin for an introduction to all that Kauai has to offer.  I recommend the flight early in your stay on Kauai.
Our pilot, Kevin, was a great guide and we felt safe and in good hands the whole time. Was an amazing aerial tour of the island. Would highly recommend the biplane tour!

review_title: One of the best things we did in Kauai!
review_text: We loved this plane ride it was absolutely beautiful! Our pilot was so nice and gave a very smooth ride. We took a private tour just my husband and I. I would highly recommend this company and tour. One of my favorite things we did!

review_title: All were very kind and accommodating!
review_text: I am a very large lady with some physical difficulties and had concerns about fitting into the small plane.  The staff were very nice and Kevin, our pilot, was extremely patient and treated me with patience and respect.   His narrative was educational and the flight was amazing.  Now if I could just figure out how to get out of a biplane I would go up for another wonderful adventure.   Bring your GoPro and they will attach it to the plane for just a small fee.

user_name: The Divine O - Food with Benefits
review_text: An absolute must! Take the flight to the north shore you will never be the same again. It will bring you to tears and imprint for the rest of your life. Veteran helicopter pilots take you on a smooth journey around the island filling you with in depth details of the history of this Garden of Eden Isle of Hawaii. Magnificent!

This was by far the highlight of our trip. Captain Kevin did a phenomenal job preparing us for our experience and provided us with a tour of a lifetime. Neither my wife or I had ever been in an open air biplane and was on both our bucket lists with a sky tour of Kauai. Killed two birds with one stone! And this trip was better than a helicopter tour as it's very personalized for the two or one individual involved. Both riders have access to fantastic views and can see all sides of the airplane giving you a full 360 view. Definitely worth the time and money and I will be recommending it to anyone I know going to Kauai!

Outstanding tour! Kevin (pilot) was professional and friendly.  We saw a countless number of waterfalls, the Napili coast and canyons, and flew through clouds and rain.   Kevin narrated with facts and personal experiences.  Like no other plane flight we have ever been on.
Awesome experience. Learned a lot. Check in was easy and the pilot was very knowledgeable and answered many questions.
We made the right choice to take the biplane and had a blast. Though cloudy we had a great view, a pleasant flight and Kevin was great

AWESOME.... open cockpit flight in and around volcanos, napali coastline , everything kauai. With the most AMAZING informative, entertaining, and skilled pilot on the planet - Kevin!!!

thank you guys - that was one of the best experiences of my life :)))))

review_title: Private flight in a biplane. What could be better?
review_text: This was a very unique and affordable way to see the whole island. The guide, Kevin, really knows his way around a plane and the island. And he likes to get to know you as well. Couldn't be happier. Take Dramamine! It can be bumpy.

I have always wanted to ride in a bi-plane and my wife surprised me with this flight. It was amazing! We've done helicopter tours elsewhere, but this was a unique air perspective. It's our last day in Kauai so we have seen the island by land and really enjoyed this. Our pilot Kevin was very experienced and gave great commentary and information about the island. Definitely recommend the trip and would love to do it again!

I really enjoyed my experience with Air Ventures Hawaii. It was super easy to book online, very reasonably priced, and I felt completely safe flying with Kevin. I booked my tour first thing (literally 1 hour after I landed in Kauai), and I'm so glad I did because Kevin was extremely knowledgeable and his input, as well as just being able to see the island as a whole, really helped me to get a good feel for the layout of the island and solidify my plans during my vacation. Kevin was very interesting, made the flight fun, and he offered cold towels and water to make as enjoyable an experience as possible. I would definitely recommend this to anyone interested in experiencing the beauty of Kauai, including places you may not normally get to see - beaches, mountains and valleys, and lots of waterfalls!

Outstanding tour of Kauai with our pilot Kevin!! He explained everything we saw and answered any and all questions. Best part of this airplane tour was that we had mikes on our headset so that we could ask questions during the tour!!

My husband and I were so pumped with our private Cessna adventure with Kevin as our pilot!  The flight was beautiful and informative and a super value - probably our favorite excursion of the whole week!  The entire staff was great to work with, but Kevin and Chelsea went out of their way to accommodate us on our last few hours in Kauai😃

We thought this was the best excursion of our trip to Hawaii.  Kevin the pilot was so knowledgeable and fun.  He made everyone on board at ease.  One of the passengers was nervous and she sat up front with Kevin.  She was very comfortable for the entire trip.  Kevin offers cold towels for the back of your neck if you feel a bit warm or uneasy.  I took him up on the offer.  It was a big help, having the cool towel on my neck was the right choice and made such a difference.  The hour and a bit went by so quickly.  The views are amazing. I agree with others that this should be done early on in your trip because of the great advice given by Kevin of where to go and what to see on the island.  This company is very accommodating, we only had a little time due to ship departure and called them the day before.  They were able to get it to all work out easily.

kevin fliegt seit 28 jahren auf dieser insel und hat immer noch riesigen spass daran. auf unserem flug wusste er zu jeder sehenswürdigkeit was spannendes zu erzählen. es war uns kein moment langweilig, wir lernten sehr viel über geschichte und geographie von kauia. der stündige flug ging viel zu schnell zu ende, wir hätten ihm noch lange zuhören und die fantastische aussicht von oben auf die insel geniessen können. 
danke kevin und jll für den guten service und den unvergesslichen und schönen flug

Took a while to post this, but the family had a tremendous time on this tour.  The plane was filled with 6 of us, and Kevin did not disappoint!  Do not be discouraged by scary looking weather either.  It looked gloomy overhead, and stayed so for part of the day, but it was still a beautiful ride!

We had a great time with Kevin! I felt totally safe in the private plane, and he was a very nice and informative tour guide. We took our trip at 8:00 and there was hardly any turbulence. The views from above are amazing!! Take the tour early in your trip, because the pilots point out places to go on the island. So glad we decided to fly with Air Ventures-I would recommend this trip to everyone!
Incredible view of the beatiful Kauaï Island feeling like the flying ace in a biplane ! The pilot (Kevin) us very friedly and very competent

Beautiful landscapes and views ,We got lots of info about the island. Took air trip beginning of stay here,so now we know where and what to do. Smooth  ride really enjoyed it. Saw places we couldn't have gotten to any other way.
The best way to experience Kauai.  The Bi-plane was awesome and our pilot Kevin was very knowledgeable about the island and its history.  My wife and I would highly recommend Air Ventures.  Aloha!

review_title: A gentle ride by an expert
review_text: I felt very safe throughout the trip.  The pilot explained everything as we went.  The headphones worked well and we were all able to communicate.  We circled the island and circled around a few points of interest, and even went right up to the rims of the two volcanic craters.  The day was cloudy and the ride was smooth and comfortably cool.  Needless to say the views were spectacular!
It's a little noisy and the wings and spars can get in your photos but it's romantic and nostalgic and Kevin is almost as long lived as his plane. It's a perfect fit for some!

My husband Ron and I took the fixed wing flight today (we had done the Snoopy Plane a few years ago) and we truly enjoyed ourselves. Eric was our pilot and he was great at engaging all of us, sharing lots of information and pointing out highlights around the island. We had a gorgeous day! Water and ice cold towels were provided to keep cool. I feel blessed to live Kauai and love seeing it from the air to gain a greater perspective of our beautiful home!

Would I do this again? YES 
Was our pilot Harry awesome? YES
Was it something I should have done a long time ago? YES
Is it better than a helicopter tour? YES
Is it exciting and safe? YES
Thanks for a great tour!

We had an amazing tour of the island with Kevin.  He had 38 years of flying experience.  This plane was a chance for my husband and me to get a private tour with an open cockpit.  We were able to see so much more than we would have if we hadn't taken a tour from the air.  The details Kevin provided were interesting and helped us figure out what else we might want to do while we were in Kauai.  Booking for your first day on Kauai will help you get a lay of the land and think through the rest of your visit.  
Even with the open cockpit we weren't cold as we were seated in the front of the plane behind the engine which put off a good deal of heat.
The two front seats are snug.  My husband and I are both tall (6' and 6'2") and are average sized.  Kevin helped us get in and out and it all worked - just be aware.  He said the tallest person he'd ever had was 6' 7".
There are also weight restrictions so be sure to chat with the company prior to booking if you have any concerns.

We did the Air Ventures tour of Kauai on our second day of vacation. Kevin, our pilot, customized our flight to show dive sites, hiking trails, and beaches. Kevin provided not only a great overall perspective of Kauai but showed us all the towns and offered suggestions for must sees in every area. We had spectacular views of Napoli Coast, lots and lots of waterfalls, and gorgeous scenery. We keep watching our videos over and over. Thank you for an amazing experience!!

What an amazing experience! If you are a first time traveler to Kauai I highly recommend you book this as your first activity. You will know the general layout of the island and have a better idea of where you want to go. Our guide Kevin was amazing. He first educates you on his plane and gives you the history of it. He narrates the whole fight, explaining what you see and giving brief history. He does an excellent job positioning the aircraft to allow the best photographs as well. 5 stars and highly recommended.

review_title: Copter versus Fixed Wing Tours - I've Done Both
review_text:
I've done at least a dozen copter tours on the islands and now this is my 2nd fixed wing tour. I know another reviewer disagrees on some points, but here's my take based on my fixed wing experience today:
Fixed wing over copter:
1.  Price... I paid less than half for a tour that covered much of the same areas as the similar length copter tours. HALF! - 
2.  Comfort - Much roomier than most copters. 
3.  Window - Everyone has a window seat. Not always true on even the 4 seat copters as 2 of you on the small copter may be in the front seat (meaning one of your windows is the front of the windshield.But, sometimes parts of the plane may invade your photos. Least view impairment is with a fixed wing plane with the wing on top.
4. Feeling of being solid - I LOVE copter tours especially as the doors off tours, but there are moments of jerks and vibration that you don't have on the fixed wing plane. 

Copter beats fixed wing tour: 
1.  Copters in Hawaii tend to go up more canyons which allow more ops to see water falls. 
2.  At certain places, the copter may choose to hover and turn to allow you an optimal view or photo op (Jack Harter Tours on Kauai has a tour 30 minutes longer than most that does this a lot)
3.  When all is said and done, I think the view from the 3 outside window seats is slightly better especially when you fly a doors-off copter tour.  

Summary:  I think the fixed wing tour is an excellent way to get the wonders of the islands from the air, yet save enough per couple for 2 or 3 high-end dinners here. If you're a bit timid about air tours, I think the fixed wing is less intimidating. I think the best photo op experiences remains the copters with doors off, but certainly one can get credible photos from the fixed wing.
Personnel and Kevin (pilot) were simply amazing.....the weather was a little rough due to the high winds but Kevin made sure we were comfortable and eased our fears...
My husband and I loved flying with Kevin.  He was a fantastic pilot with a smooth ride.  He was incredibly friendly and knowledgeable. The sights were spectacular.  I would definitely recommend this!

review_title: Kauai by Air Tour--Put this on your bucket list!
review_text: The pilot, Kevin (?), was friendly, fun,  and full of stories and information about Kauai.  He even had wonderful cool towels for our use if we got too warm or felt queasy while in the air.  This 1 hour tour gave us such an amazing view of the island-- now we can say we saw Kauai by land, by sea, and by air. What a treat! We reserved ahead of time, thought the price was very good, and didn't mind having to "publically" get on the scale --safety first, of course. My group of four recommend Air Ventures.

My wife and I really enjoyed our flight with Kevin Britt. He is probably the most experienced air tour pilot on the island and knows everything there is to know about Kauai. 

If you are looking for a safe, comfortable and thoroughly enjoyable experience with an air tour operator on Kauai do yourself a favor and book with Air Ventures Hawaii.

Kauai is a beautiful island from the ground but it is stunning from the air.  Having done the all day canyon tour, this one hour flight on Air Ventures with five other passengers and our pilot, Kevin was breathtaking and completed my visit.  The flight took us up the coast, through the canyon and the plantations.  I would have loved to do it again.  This is the way to see all the places you can't get to or would have to hike days to.  Kevin gave an outstanding travelogue during this time and was most entertaining.  Worth every penny.

Mid March my husband and I had an amazing ride over Kauai in the Red Baron open air biplane. Kevin our pilot had a great sense of humour and provided a lot of information along the way.  I was very nervous about it but Kevin made us feel safe and it was so much smoother and not as scary as we thought it might be.  We have both done helicopter tours over Kauai and other Islands and a float plane tour over Vancouver.  The Red Baron was the best experience and most fun of all. The open air was great, not too windy and the aviation helmet was comfy, kept the noise down and hair out of my eyes. Didn't need the goggles and the warmth from the engine kept us comfortable over the mountains where it was cooler.  The windshield protected us from the rain over the mountains so we barely noticed it.   The whales had left early due to El Niño this year or we would have seen lots of whales. We learned a lot about this beautiful place. Would choose this again over a heli tour any day.  If you go a second time, Kevin said he will do a few maneuvers but he doesn't generally do them on the first trip. We had some good turns and he flew in such a way for our GoPro to catch good shots (mounted on the wing for $25). Amazing and highly recommended!!

review_title: Family trip perfect for all ages.
review_text: Amazing trip! We got there early so Kevin our pilot took us out early. Would recommend to anyone our first small plane flight and it was smooth and perfect! They also had cool towels if you got to hot, or felt sick. Kevin was so informational and had fun facts, you could tell he really loves his job. We went up into the volcanos and saw TONS of waterfalls. Overall one of the best things we did on the island!!!

Kevin was our pilot and I appreciated his attention to safety. An opportunity to see Waimea Canyon from the air should bot be missed if the weather is clear.I had hiked the Napali Cliff trail many years ago but the view from the air of the canyon is a spiritual experience.

review_title: Highlight of our trip! Worth every penny!
