review_text: This was an awesome way to see the whole island of Kauai!  Our Pilot, Eric, was awesome.  Great info about the island as we flew.  Beautiful waterfalls, canyons, beaches.  A great way to get a unique view of it all.  Combine this with some hikes and a water excursion and you'll get to experience Kauai from many viewpoints.  Much recommended.

review_title: Awesome way to see the island
review_text:
Our round island flight was one of the highlights of our trip.  It was the perfect way to see the island and find out more about what we wanted to do and where we wanted to go.  I'd recommend it as a great way to start your Kauai trip.  
The company were professional and safety orientated, but it was done with humour to stop it being a boring lecture or OTT.  Kevin was our pilot and he was a wealth of local info, but wasn't over the top or too touristy.  The view was amazing, with loads of photo ops.  
I'd thoroughly recommend them and we'll be back again......

I chose to ride in the two seater biplane instead of the 6 seater plane because it was open air, cute, red, and had Snoopy painted on the wing.  I love to fly but fear heights so I was afraid to try the helicopters, this was the best of all worlds for me and it was fun and exciting.  The view was amazing and the pilot gave a great overview of the island.  Perfect takeoff, flyover and landing.  Must do!  Love it!

Absolutely awesome! Kevin, our pilot was great. He was informative and really seems to love his job. The ride was smooth and not rushed. Beautiful views you won't see from the ground. 
Be sure to ask for Kevin,  for two reasons: one, he's great, and two... Harry, the other pilot doesn't wash his hand after using the bathroom...... and I don't mean number 1. Worst part is that I followed him out of the bathroom and watched him walk right up to a group and shake their hands......

This flight was fantastic and worth every cent! We thoroughly enjoyed the commentary from our pilot Kevin   and saw some of the most wonderous scenery imaginable... and Pierce Brosnan's beach place! I can recommend this excursion and this friendly, professional company.

Loved this trip!!!! We came to Hawaii to experience each island an this company and their service was the very best out of all the providers that we had the pleasure to work with.  
Our point of pick up for the trip was away from the normal spot so they sent over the owner to pick us up!!! She drove us thru the beautiful setting of local living rather than take the highway. 
Every one we worked with were Happy with high standards and professional performance of their service.

review_title: Awesome views, but I recommend afternoon or early morning (Cessna private tour)
review_text:
You will get very good views, the pilot is nice, everything is smooth. However, what we noticed when on Kauai is that there seem to be sunlight <10am, then 12pm-2pm, and then >6pm mostly, and clouds during the rest of the time. So I would recommend either do a tour before 10am, or one in the afternoon. In our case, we did a 10am-11am flight tour, and we could still see everything (we were lucky, Waimea Canyon was not under the clouds), but we didn't get that much of this nice sunlight-colored cliffs you would want to see on Kauai.

Also, I wish the pilot had talked a bit more about the history / geography of the landscape rather than touristy information. He mostly pointed out beaches and told us about cities. I would have preferred to hear about how the canyon formed, how old is the island, its climate... If you see what I mean :)

We did the 'round the island, 65 minute tour. Probably easiest to book via telephone to get the times available as the website seemed to be behind on the online bookings. Not really an issue though...
Flight itself was wonderful. Proper safety briefing with a bit of humour injected into it to keep everyone's attention. Pilot Kevin was informative but not overbearing and very knowledgable on all things Kauai. Plenty of photo opportunities, admittedly I took none as I enjoyed the view too much. We were lucky with good weather throughout. 
Thoroughly recommended, friendly and safe operation. I'll be back for the Waco flight another time.

We decided on the Bi -plane fly over as we had never ridden in a Bi-plane before. It was a great decision. Not only was the.view fantastic, the open cockpit, gave the fresh air experience, we would not have gotten in a chopper, orenclosed plane.

We flew over many of the sites we had seen from the car but the view from the air have it a whole new feel.

We are able to circle several of the more memorable sites

Well worth it.

This bi-plane tour was honestly one of the coolest things I've ever done.  My wife was a little apprehensive about the trip, but she settled in and thoroughly enjoyed the experience.  Our pilot, Kevin, was very professional, knowledgeable about the area and the plane.  Most importantly, we felt safe the entire trip.  Very highly recommended!  Book it!

Since I was a child, I have always wanted to fly in an open cockpit biplane.  At 66 years old, that dream was on hold for quite awhile.  In June, excellent pilot Harry and the great folks at Air Ventures Hawaii fulfilled that wish.  I, my wife, daughter and granddaughter took the tour in pars, and we were all simply blown away (literally, if you stick your head out past the windshield).  Perfect flying weather and Harry's skill provided an adventure of a lifetime.  I recommend this tour to anyone, who loves flying with the freedom of a bird.  Kind of like riding a Harley in the sky.
A few notes.  If taking photos is your primary goal, you might want to consider a helicopter.  Not that you can't get great shots (see photos attached), but being seated in the front of the gorgeous 1930s style WACO double-winger, you must shoot around the struts and rigging (the right side is best for photography).  Don't forget to turn around toward the back for unobstructed views.
if you are coming from the north, give yourself an extra 20-30 minutes for the daily traffic jam just south of Kapa'a.
Easily, the most fun filled hour or so that I spent on the beautiful island of Kauai.

Our family, including two teenage girls, took this tour with Air Ventures in Kauai.  We LOVED every minute of this tour!! Our pilot, Ray, who happened to be the owner, was amazing. From the moment we arrived, the process was seamless. Seeing Kauai from the air was priceless. I loved listening to the stories about this gorgeous island. The aircraft was clean and very comfortable. Our pilot put us at ease and was very knowledgeable as well as funny.

review_title: Soaring Over the Napali Coast in Style
review_text:
I was too nervous to take a helicopter tour of Kauai because there was so much rain while we visited.  But a small, intimate plane fit the bill very nicely!  We got some spectacular views, even with the uncooperative weather. Our pilot was friendly, fun, and informative. 

My only suggestion is to try and sit on the side of the plane opposite the pilot, as the tour tends much more toward that direction, and if the person in the seat on that side is using their camera, as my husband was the whole time, you won't get to see nearly as much.  :-)

While on Kauai we celebrated our sons birthday. As he is a professional pilot I surprised him (and myself)  with an hour flight around Kauai in this beautiful Waco bi-plane. I have the intrusion of all the helicopters that are constantly flying around so this was a spectacular alternative and I highly recommend it to anyone who likes planes!

The cost of this trip is about half of a helicopter tour. Better yet, everyone has a window seat.  Our pilot Eric was funny, knowledge and calming.  I think we saw 50 waterfalls.  Kauai is a beautiful place and worth seeing by air.

Wow, what a fantastic experience. This biplane is over-the-top cool. I think the best word for the plane is Elegant. It soars with stability and grace. We had a bird's-eye view of this garden paradise this morning and loved every second of it. And Harry, our pilot and guide, provided us with great information about everything below. My wife was not comfortable with the notion of flying in a helicopter, and the airplane tours just didn't seem special enough. So we selected this bright-red biplane tour and it was great. If you feel like doing something exciting, you should consider this. We felt it was quite comfortable and safe and highly recommend it. Thank you Harry, and special thanks to the staff at the Air Ventures Hawaii desk for all of the pointers they gave for us to drive and discover your island as well. You guys are the best! ALOHA!

review_title: So much better than a helicopter
review_text:
Loved this tour. Have done the helicopter and could see so much better. Pilot was very experienced and made sure both sides of the plane saw everything. Great to have a big window and a knowledgeable pilot. Loved that it is so much cheaper and the tour was longer. Highly recommend.
I did do this as part of the Best of Hawaii tour package. Do yourself a favor and just book this and skip that tour.
Pilot Kevin made this trip a memorable tour. Kevin was so respectful of his passengers needs and made every effort to show us every possible landmark.

This was an absolutely wonderful trip! It was a family trip with my sister, my mother and two of my aunt's (our sister trip), Kevin was our pilot. Kevin is an amazing pilot and made each one of us comfortable throughout the flight. Definitely a must do when visiting Kauai.

Nous avions réservé pour le Samedi au départ et comme la météo n'était pas au rendez-vous le pilote nous a proposé de reporter le vol au Lundi, je pense que toutes les compagnies ne le font systématiquement nous avons trouvé ça très professionnel.

Donc nous sommes revenus le Lundi comme prévu avec une météo meilleure, nous avons effectué le vol avec Éric, il est très sympathique et s'occupe très bien de ses passagers et vérifies que tout va bien. Il explique très bien durant le vol les endroits survolés et nous indique les endroits où on doit retourner sur terre voir les attractions. 

Nous avons passé un excellent moment. Mahalo Eric. 

Fabrice et Katia

review_title: The Best Way  to See Kauai
review_text: If you plan to visit Kauai and want to really experience its beauty, you need to fly with Air Ventures!  If you are really lucky (or you ask specifically for him), you may get Ray, the owner, as your pilot. My wife and I were the only passengers booked for our flight. Ray gave us the choice of taking the 6 passenger plane or riding in his 4 passenger Cessna 182, which we took. What an experience!! This was my wife's first experience in a small plane and she LOVED it!  I got to sit in the right seat in the cockpit, a true thrill for a non-pilot. Ray showed us everything that Kauai has to offer: Spouting Horn blowhole, Mt Waialeale (one of the wettest places on earth), Waimea Canyon (a mini-Grand Canyon), the magnificent  Napali Coast, Waimea Lighthouse, and much, much more. You will not find a more skilled pilot (or a more pleasant person) than Ray. This is a definite Do Not Miss event!

As soon as my husband saw that Air Ventures offered a Biplane tour he wanted to do it.  It took a lot of convincing on his part to get me on as I am afraid of flying.  Harry was our pilot and made me feel at ease at once.  This is a unique and awesome way to tour the island.  We had spectacular views and Harry was a great guide!  He made sure to point out key areas and would maneuver the plane to provide us an even better view.  It was well worth the money!  The entire staff was friendly and we would definitely recommend to anyone.

review_title: Harry was our pilot on the BiPlane and the entire experience was awesome!!
review_text: I was a little tense about riding in the Biplane, but Harry explained the entire process, and made me feel very comfortable.  The views were breathtaking and the explanations that Harry provided about Hawaiian history and the related sites was wonderful.  We would do it again when we return to Kauai.  Worth every penny!!

1h de vol au dessus de Kauai au top ! 
Kevin notre pilote était super , nous sommes d abord partis à 08h30 , le temps n était pas au rendez vous , il a fait demi tour au bout de 10/15min et nous a proposé de revenir dans L après midi ,ce que nous avons trouvé très pro ! Les hôtesses à L accueil sont au petit soin ! 
Nous recommandons fortement cette compagnie !
Kevin did an excellent job getting us into where we could see the waterfalls.  I would highly recommend this tour!  Well worth the money spent.

We enjoyed a very comfortable sightseeing flight over Kauai's many wonderful sights.
The pilot was very friendly and informative, and kept the flight very smooth despite the rainy conditions. The extra time spent over the Na Pali coast was particularly welcome. The slow pace of the flight, and large clear windows gave ample opportunity for good viewing and photography. Compared to a helicopter the fixed wing aircraft felt very spacious. Rainy conditions gave us views of many more waterfalls than normal.

Nous avons effectué le vol avec Eric, il est très sympathique et s'occupe très bien de ses passagers et vérifies que tout va bien.
Il explique très bien durant le vol les endroits survolés et nous indique les endroits où on doit retourner sur terre.
Nous avons passé un excellent moment.

Mahalo Eric.

Thanks.

Katia et Fabrice

Wow, this was a fantastic experience! Kevin Britt was our outstanding pilot! He showed us areas on Kauai we would never be able to see without this tour & shared information about each area! We enjoyed up-close views of waterfalls, the Grand Canyon of the Pacific, the beautiful blue water & reef systems, gorgeous beaches and so much more! We flew in the Airvan (6 pax). Can't wait to return to fly this one again, and also want to fly in the Cessna & Bi-plane over Kauai!!

We lucked out with weather.  We'd done Na Pali sea tours in various forms, this is THE best way to see it.  Airplane very comfortable, big windows.  Traffic control conversations throughout flight a bit loud and disturbing, otherwise we had the trip of our life.  We would assume quieter than helicopter in any case.  Pilot Josh was very informative as tour guide, and a fantastic pilot of course.  Highly recommend.

De must do van het eiland Kauai!!
De ultieme ervaring van het vliegen. Met de oude nagebouwde dubbeldekker van "Pearl Harbor" over het eiland Kauai. Vlucht van ruim 1 uur boven de mooie en ontoegankelijke bergen, dalen en kuststroken. Alleen op deze manier kun je de watervallen van "Jurassic Park"  en de Napali Coast zien. Waimea Canyon is onbeschrijfelijk mooi. Omdat ik als solo passagier (komt zelden voor) aan boord was mocht ik van "Red Baron"Harry zelf vliegen!!! Een te gekke ervaring. Als afsluiting hebben we nog wat stunts boven de oceaan gedaan. Dit had ik nooit willen missen. Ik had al veel uitgespookt op vakanties maar dit sloeg alles. Een hartelijk dankjewel aan het Airventures Team en in het bijzonder aan Harry de piloot. 

Mahalo!  Frits Fijen,  Nederland

review_title: Amazing birds eye view of Kaua'i
review_text: We only had 2 days in Kaua'i and choose to do this flight to be able to take in and appreciate the absolutely beautiful scenery of this Island, it was truly amazing how one Island could be so different from side to side.  Would definitely recommend the flight, pilot and Company they couldn't do enough for us.

We took a flight around the island with Air Ventures (Kevin Pilot) on May 16.  I would highly recommend Air Ventures - Kevin.  He has 26 years flying around the island and was very knowledgeable & fun.  The ride was extremely smooth and we all felt safe.  Not only does Kevin provide a bunch of great facts about the island, he takes you over spots you can't get to by car or foot.  HIGHLY RECOMMEND AIR VENTURES if you're going to visit Kauai.

We truly enjoyed this flight. Great views of so many sights on the island. Informative running commentary of sights, history and culture of the island. We went on this tour the first day of our stay, which helped plan out the ground sights we followed up with. Thanks, Air Venture, for a fantastic experience.

review_title: An awesome overview of a beautiful Island!
review_text: After spending 3 days on Kauai, driving around Waimea Canyon, overnighting in Hanalei Bay, walking part of the Na Pali Trail and cruising the Napali Coast on one of the fast catamarans, we went for a scenic flight with Kevin and Air Ventures over the whole island to see the 'bigger picture' and join all the dots in between. We had a fantastic  flight, with great and very informative commentary which told us much of the history  (natural and human) of Kauai.  Great value for money, would recommend

We had a great time with Kevin who took lots of time to show us the island and its beautiful waterfalls.  He was so gracious to the three of us, making certain that I was able to get great pictures.  The view was outstanding.  We had taken a helicopter flight on Kauai a few years back.  The fixed wing plane flight was superior in every way.  We enjoyed this trip and were glad that my sister could be there with us..  Kevin was great - he was very informed about the island.

The tour was excellent with lots of interesting historical tidbits along the way. Kevin is an excellent pilot and extremely safety conscious. I have terrible motion sickness but he had some great ways to combat the problem. The cold cloths he provided did the trick. I was able to enjoy the spectacular sites that I would not have been able to see without his expert piloting. My friend did not intend to go on the plane but changed her mind and was so happy she did. She thought it was so much safer than the helicopters and you can see just as much.Fantastic experience! Highly recommend it to all.

Really cool experience never flown in a craft that small but it was pleasant. Pilot Harry was great and front desk staff as well! We didn't see as many waterfalls as we thought but really enjoyed flying over the reefs and napali coast
The flight was about an hour, the pilot told us everything we were passing along the way. We got to see some amazing views that we wouldn't be able to see from the ground.

review_title: Excellent tour and wonderful staff.  The tour was more than I expected and Eric our pilot was great.  He made sure both
review_text: The tour was more than I expected and Eric our pilot was great.   He did his best to ensure that the flight was as smooth as possible, and both sides of the plane had the same photo ops.  He spotted a late season whale, and turned the plane so we all got a chance to see and take a picture of it. The ladies at the desk are wonderful and recommend we drive down the road to where Dawson's Landing was filmed.  Highly recommend the tour to everyone.

review_title: Highlight of my trip to the Hawaiin Islands
review_text: From start to finish this was an experience of a lifetime.  I am 84 and to sit next to the experienced and charming pilot Josh was a thrill.  I kidded that if he 'nodded' off I would take over the controls. Pua (spelling?) transported me to and from a convenient location close to where the Star Princess docked. I lost an earring on the plane which she later found and mailed back to me. Josh was very informed about the various film locations used in Kauai. I will always treasure my memories.  The company even sent me an email attachment of the picture they took of the passengers.

review_title: I would do this very same tour each time I came back to Kauai!
review_text: Eric was awesome!  He was very accommodating because the weather was not being very cooperative and was very informative.

My wife and I took the spectacular trip with Air Ventures Hawaii in September.  It was very hot and humid that day.  Thank goodness the pilot had a cooler with bottled water and cooling towels!  

The views over Kauai were terrific!  This was our third time to the island.  We have seen the remote locations by boat, helicopter, and plane.  Photo opportunities were everywhere!

The pilot's information and knowledge of the island enhanced the experience.  In fact, 
we wanted to view Waimea Canyon by ground later in the week, which we did (difficult to get good photos by air).

We would go back with Air Ventures Hawaii, hopefully with less heat and humidity!

This is definitely recommended for anyone seeking a different perspective of Kauai!

Photo shows everyone that was on the flight.  My wife and I are on the far left.

Thank you.

We flew across many waterfalls, jungle scenery and amazing beach views! This trip is part of the Best of Kauai tour, which also includes an island tour and river boat cruise. Well worth the price. It's a whole day of Hawaiian history stories and dances. You learn the hula and have a wonderful lunch. The flight is absolutely amazing. Scenes of mountain ranges that are used in many movies including Jurassic Park. I highly recommend it. We got on the tour from the orientation at the Bali Hi Wyndham Vacation Resort. We loved every bit of it.

Not cheap, but necessary if visiting Kauai, as an air tour really is the only way to see the interior of Kauai. Doing it by Bi-plane was for us a unique experience and Harry the pilot, was very knowledgeable and a great guy.

review_title: AWESOME airplane trip and EXCELLENT pilot (Eric)!!!
review_text: The ONLY way to see Kauai is by air. There are so many beautiful water falls and the Waimea "Little Grand Canyon," too. The coastline is just breathtaking and there is no other way to access most of these places. Our pilot, Eric, was FIRST CLASS!!! I highly recommend this tour to EVERYONE.

review_title: The best way to explore KAuai is in in a two hole red biplane called Snoopy 3
review_text:
Being a pilot this was a fantastic way to tour around the island an see everything . It included beaches to numerous to count , where to snorkel the reefs and how to get there . 
The only suggestion I have is update the intercom to include a set of Bose headsets the experience would be 1000 times better .

review_title: Open cockpit Red Baron flight was fantastic!!!!
review_text: This was definitely my favorite part of our Kauai trip.  Kevin was our pilot and did a fantastic job of telling us about the island while we were flying.  The passengers ride in the front seat and the pilot in the back. It is an open cockpit plane and it is a sung but comfortable fit for two people.  You have a little windshield in front of you and you get to wear the head gear and goggles too.  A ride of a life time. We seen breathtaking views of the island, canyons, beaches, ocean and phenomenal waterfalls. You can take pictures as you go but make sure you have it strapped around your neck.  They will take a picture of you also when the flight is finished if you like.  Awesome experience!! Price was $220.00 per person with discount because I booked online.  Staff are very friendly. So happy we did this.

review_title: Hang on Snoopy, Snoopy Hang on for an amazing flight over Kauai!
review_text:
This is by far on of the coolest things I have done on Kauai. I live on island and have been to and seen many of the attractions. This one is by far the best way to see the entire island.

The staff were all very friendly and helpful and our pilot Harry was a funny and great guy to fly with.

If you are looking for something unique to do on Kauai, look no further than taking a flight with the Red Baron of Kauai!

review_title: See Kauai from the air for half the price of a helicopter!
review_text: When visiting Kauai we were told that a helicopter tour was an absolute must-do, but they're awfully expensive. Upon researching available options, we found Air Ventures Hawaii's small plane tours, and decided to give them a try. We took a private tour in the their Cessna 182, and really enjoyed the experience. Our pilot Henry was an excellent guide and gave us a great hour around the island with plenty of information and of course phenomenal views. The operation was very professional and we felt perfectly safe and comfortable in the air. Thanks!

Wanted something different than the ubiquitous helicopter tour. We chose the one hour bi-plane tour of the island. Nothing can compare to seeing the island from the cockpit of a bi-plane. About the same price of a helicopter tour but a whole different experience. I highly recommend this for someone who is looking for something unique. Harry our pilot was very informative during the flight pointing out interesting sights and explaining the history of the island.

We took the Red Baron, open cockpit biplane on a tour around the island. Pua was excellent in helping us to book the tour. She even took some (really good) pictures for us right when we landed! Kevin, our pilot, was awesome. He was friendly, entertaining, and a wealth of knowledge and stories about the island. He quickly figured out that we were adventurous people and played to our thrill seeking side. It was great. I'd do this again tomorrow if I could! Take a GoPro if you have one - you can have it set up on the wing!

We took a flight last week on the Big Island and had so totally enjoyed it that we decided to do it again on the Island of Kauai. We were a bit concerned about the weather (It rained earlier and it was windy) but our pilot, Eric, said that all would be well (This is a guy with an interesting sense of humor!). Thankfully, it was all okay.
Eric assigned me to the co-pilot's seat (right side, next to the pilot) with the wife immediately behind me. He placed the two other passengers behind my wife so all of the passengers were on the right side of the plane (The plane, the plane!). And yes, he flew us past the Fantasy Island Falls, plus the film sites of Elvis's Blue Hawaii, and Harrison Ford's 6 Day, 7 Nights movie. Oh yeah, he flew us around the entire island and also headed inland to see the Grand Canyon of the Pacific. (And the good Lord parted the clouds so we could see it lit up and how perfectly He painted the area!) 
Overall, the flight was smooth. Yes, there were a few bumps along the way (Eric calls them 'texture'), and after one bump, he kiddingly asked me what I touched in the co-pilot's chair. (Of course he had an ear-to-ear smile when he made the crack.)
This is a trip you can take by either airplane, biplane or helicopter, and it is a trip you won't want to miss!
Enjoy...
Aloha!

review_title: Oh, yeah, baby! This is the way to do it!
review_text: Up, up and away, and our pilot, Kevin, took us on a magical and informative tour below and among the clouds. Kauai is an amazing place, and he explained why. It was an hour of topographical inspection and inspiration that surpassed our expectations. And, Pua, at the ground station, facilitated our passage effortlessly.  She instructed our party who served as the co-pilot well. Do this tour. You will not be disappointed.

Really lovely way to see Kauai, even caught sight of a whale breaching. Despite us needing a flight at very short notice the tour organiser was extremely accommodating and managed to get us on a private airplane tour with Eric. The flight was great, it covered all the areas we were interested in seeing and more. Eric was a great pilot and very knowledgeable guide.

I would highly recommend booking with Air Ventures Hawaii.

review_title: The best way to see Kauai!
review_text: This was a great way to see the island of Kauai. It's probably better to become a little familiar with the island before taking the flight though. It could be hard to see some of the points of interest if you don't know what you're looking for and having seen them at ground level first will definitely help. We had a great flight and were able to see 3 whales which was truly amazing!! Make sure to take something before hand if you get sea sick. My husband thought he would be ok because he doesn't have a problem in bigger planes but ended up feeling nauseous in the smaller plane. Our pilot was great in helping him feel better during the ride but I would definitely recommend using a patch or Dramamine before hand if needed. Each member of the crew was very friendly, helpful, and dedicated to a great customer experience which always makes a huge difference and I really appreciate that. Overall I was very pleased with this experience and would do it again in a heart-beat! If it's something you're considering I'd say go for it!!

So before coming to Kauai I was looking at the things I might like to do...rappelling (maybe)...kayaking (I'd rather do a sea kayak trip in the summer)...zip lining upside down (possibly)...helicopter tour (eh...)...Biplane tour (Ohhh yeahhh!) From the moment that Pua graciously booked for the tour until the moment I got off the plane I had a smile on my face from ear to ear. I booked both seats because I was by myself and really wanted to do it. (There is plenty of room for two.) Kevin--my guide and pilot--walked me around the aircraft on the preflight and gave great detail on how the it was constructed.  We took off into the beautiful Kauai skies and I was given 1 fantastic tour--with Kevin answering all my questions and showing me an eagle's eye view of the magnificent  landscape--deep valleys with sharp volcanic sides, the many waterfalls, beautiful beaches, and incredible sea caves.
Upon landing, Pua kindly snapped a couple of pictures which I'll treasure.  I highly recommend this tour without hesitation. Pua & Kevin are the best!

review_title: AMAZING trip with Air Ventures Hawaii
review_text: We were lucky enough to fly with Eric from Air Ventures Hawaii.  There were five adults and one lap infant (who fell fast asleep).  He helped me with my nervous stomach and my cousin as well.  I started to get a little hot and he made sure there was a cool towel to help. He was very funny, informative, and made the flight from great to AMAZING!!  The views were excellent, we saw waterfalls, a rainbow,  the Napali coast, the canyon, tons of beautiful beaches and other sites, and even a mother and baby humpback whale!!

My family totally enjoyed the Air Venture tour over Kauai. We had a great time and saw just how beautiful the island is. We even saw a few rainbows. There was a little rain and a few clouds but that didn't effect the trip. A great way to see Kauai. Eric the pilot was great and made sure we had a great trip.

I had wanted to fly in a biplane most all of my life, I'm 60 years old, but I just had never done so. While researching for a trip to Kauai for my wife and me I came across Air Ventures' “YMF-5 Super” Waco  biplane and knew that was the ride for me. My wife was a bit apprehensive about riding in a small, open-cockpit airplane. I assured her that she would love it, and boy did she!
Our pilot, Harry, briefed about the airplane itself, and about the flight that we were about to leave on. After a few photos we were strapped in; the headphones plugged in and working, and we were off.
The day was a cloudy one, with the clouds clinging to the ridges and mountaintops all the way around the island. It mattered not one bit. The views were still incredible. I knew the plane would not be the best photography platform, but we still got numerous good photos. I would not recommend taking a tele- of any kind. Shoot wide-angle with a long focus. For us, though, this was not a photo trip, photos were an added bonus, but a ride of a lifetime.
The ride in an open-cockpit biplane just can't be beat, and to do it over and around Kauai was even better than my expectations. The roar of the American-made rotary seven-cylinder engine, and the wind ruffling about provided a very tactile experience, such as I have never experienced in small planes or helicopters.
All along, Harry kept us informed as to what we were seeing, and he was able to give us pieces of the histories of the Hawaiian peoples associated with them. 
If you want close up to the waterfalls and cliff faces, or are looking to take the ultimate photograph, then maybe a ride in Air Ventures' “YMF-5 Super” Waco may not be for you. But, if you want to have the biggest grin that will fit on your face when you climb back out of the plane, then this trip fits the bill.
Thanks to all the employees of Ventures for their attention and kindness, and a special "Mahalo" to Harry for the ride. Aloha!!

An airborne tour of Kauai is an essential part of your trip to this island.  You cannot appreciate its beauty from the ground no matter how good the weather is.  Yes, helicopters are more maneuverable but they are more expensive and one had unfortunately crashed into Pearl Harbor during our visit to Oahu which closed the water shuttle to the Arizona memorial during our stay.  AirVentures Cessna fixed wing airplanes are an excellent compromise.  They are surprisingly maneuverable and our pilot, Eric, with over 7000 flying hours, was as safe a "driver" as he was an entertaining narrator.  We saw whales at 1000'; we saw Waimea canyon as you will never see it from the road and Eric's tour of the Na Pali coast was incredible.  The grand finale was a flyby the Wailua falls (Da Plen!, Da Plen!).  Book morning flights- clouds cause more problems in the PM.  Do this trip first for an overview or last to fill in the details but do it! Oh, BTW, sit on the right side of the plane for best views. Aloha!

I thought it would be a nice surprise for my mom on her birthday to have a birdseye view of Kauia. This was our fourth visit to Kauai and we have been able to see the island from car and boat and thought by air would be even better. We were surprised to be able to have the plane to ourselves when the rest of the group did not make an appearance. Our pilot was Ray, and he was fantastic. From take off to landing his flying skills were excellent, the views we were able to see were breathtaking, and his commentary during flight was engaging and it felt like you were flying with a friend. He went well over the flight time and went back over to show us views of Jurassic falls and the Napali coast, and we were fortunate enough to get close enough to see whales breaching. I would absolutely recommend Air Ventures to anyone visiting Kauai, it was an adventure, a treat, an unbelievable way to see the island.  Thank you Ray and your crew for an unforgettable experience!

We thoroughly enjoyed our one hour flight over this beautiful island. Our pilot Kevin was great. Lots of commentary so we knew what we were looking at. He told us a little of the history of the island. The views are just spectacular. We took the 0830 slot and am glad we did as it was a beautiful clear day. I sat up front as co pilot! If you are taking a lot of photos I suggest you sit at the back as the light from the sun hitting the wings casts white blobs on your images. May not happen if you are later in the day but then you have clouds to contend with. Lots of waterfalls to see and the Na Pali coast is breathtaking. We saw two humpbacks frolicking  below.  We booked through Air Venture direct and saved $40! Highlight of our trip to Kauai. Many thanks Kevin for a great tour.

We chose the biplane for a bit of adventure and it was definitely that! Loved feeling the wind and the brief rain shower! Great views and we even saw a whale do a few breaches!!! Well worth it! He can only take 2 passengers at a time so not so good for families unless prepared to wait. Felt totally safe and snug.

Gwen and I are first time Kauai visitors and we are glad we decided to take an AirVentures Hawaii  Kauai air tour.  The cost seemed very reasonable and the description of the tour found on the AirVentures website was very descriptive.  Our amicable pilot Ray greeted all 5 of us passengers in the office and we shared a discussion about our flight itinerary.  Our pilot is a very experienced aviator who has spent considerable time exploring the island and loves each flight he takes.  He was excited explaining how fortunate we were to be taking this particular tour because areas he wanted to share with us he had only seen a few times in his many years of flying as the weather was clear allowing for exceptional viewing.  He was right!  Wow!  Not only was the sightseeing good but he was very knowledgeable of the land areas below us,..landmarks we saw,.. beautiful valleys both arid and lush hues of green..,the waterfalls and river watersheds,..land use and development ... favorite beaches...movie sets...the coastline...plants and gardens...celebrities...and even a whale!!!  We were family aboard this eco-friendly airvan and could communicate with each other and plenty of viewing and picture taking all around. The adventure lasted longer than we had anticipated and the worst part was having to return to our earthbound habitat.  But wait that was not the end of our tour as our pilot reminisced about the company and his planes and his relationship as a friend and mechanic with the late Aloha vet who is one of my wife's favorite animal friendly tv celebrities!  What a small world sometimes.  We slowly ambled back into the office and even the friendly staff gave us tips on where to eat lunch!
Mahalo nui loa...Ahui hou!  
Gwen and Dana
Was absolutely amazing!!!!  Thanks guys for making this a lifetime memorie!!!:):) I would advise everyone to fly with air ventures

I booked this flight through the concierge at our condo after hearing a presentation from one of their reps. It was well worth it! We were lucky to have a calm, cloudless day. Ray, our pilot and the owner of the company, was a great guide, taking us places he usually can't fly because of clouds, and giving lots of information about the island. He made sure people on both sides of the plane saw everything and was very skilled at pointing things out. A great way to see Kauai!
We had a great time on this adventure. The folks were very informative and we would not have found some of the places they take you on our own.
Decided to take my wife on this tour when we took a weekend trip to Kaua'i. Had a blast, she loved the open air cockpit, the trip lasted about 70 minutes, learned so much from Kevin our pilot.
Really enjoyed the aerial tour of the island and the land tour with our guide Domi! Very informative & a great way to see points of interest. Thanks to the pilot also

We had a  great overview of the iland and the fantastisk scenerom with volcanos and waterfalls as well as humpback whales out in the  ocean. The pilot provided a lot of interesting info during the one hour flight. A tour highly recommended, worthwhile.

I emphatically give this tour 5 stars.  Our pilot Ray was informative, knowledgeable, and friendly.  My wife and 2 kids all enjoyed the amazing views and vistas that this tour afforded us.  This is something we will do again when we have another chance to visit Kauai.

We went on the open cockpit biplane and loved every minute of it!  I cannot say enough nice things about our pilot Harry and the wonderful staff. If you ever get this opportunity...seize it!  It was definitely a "Ride of a Lifetime"!!!

I can not recommend air ventures Hawaii highly enough! This was the  highlight of my trip to Kauai. I chose the big kahuna 1 hour scenic plane flight. Eric was our pilot and was knowledgeable , fun, friendly and made everyone feel safe. Jill the manager of air ventures is lovely and went above and beyond her duties, helping me out with a few things, the reception staff were also lovely. This tour is the best way to see the island , it is a lot cheaper than helicopters and you get the most amazing views. They mounted my go pro to the outside of the plane for $25! What a bonus. The Na Pali coast and Waimea canyon are definitely something you need to see from the sky.

review_title: Amazing way to see the whales !!
review_text:
Fantastic experience!!
This was a highlight of our trip! Perfect for our whole family! The staff was kind and so helpful with getting my Pop in and out of the plane. The pilot did more than one pass to see things so everyone could get pics! This was an amazing way to see the whales and not nearly as loud as the helicopter, so no disturbing them ( if they even noticed us:)  Beautiful views of the island and the coastal cliffs hard to get to by foot.
Met the owners while checking in and they were a hoot:)

The Air Ventures plane flight was the absolutely best that we have ever taken. We were thrilled by the sheer beauty offered by this flying kite, as it allowed us to take wonderful pictures at only 75 miles an hour. Our pilot was masterful as he took us into the many canyons of Kauai. This allowed us to get the best views of over 20 waterfalls. This tour was professionally narrated by the captain and he literally pointed out every sight on the island as well as extra pass overs to get us even closer to the magnificence of Kauai.
We would definitely recommend this trip to everyone and we would definitely take it again.

review_title: The big plane  N572TB is awesome and so was the weather
review_text:
Thanks pilot Kevin for a great experience.  
It's such a shame that there was so much cloud and rain yesterday. 
Perfect along the south coast, but next sector was a white out.
The rainbows were nice.
We had to drop some sights.
And then another plane came along side us for some air to air photos for their Web site

Hot photographer!😀

It would have been  nice to be able to see more of the sights explained to us before take off

review_title: Flight on the Air Ventures Biplane
review_text:
This was a trip of a lifetime! What a fabulous way to really see the island of Kauai.  The Biplane provided a unique opportunity to experience aviation the way it used to be. We were so impressed with the  helpfulness of all the staff we encountered.. Our pilot, Kevin, was very competent,  knowledgeable  and fun to be with.  We can highly recommend this tour for all.
Brian and Barb Beary

Recently took their biplane tour while we were in Kauai.   I would have to say it was the highlight of our trip.   It is a really unique and great way to see all of the island.    My GF was a little nervous before getting into the plane but once we were up in the air everything was fine.   Harry our pilot did a great job and made sure we both had a great time.   Would highly recommend to anyone visiting Kauai.

Been to Kauai several times and have never seen the island like this. We visited with our family and a couple of friends and decided to take the flight vs taking a helicopter, SURE GLAD WE DID! The views from this flight were simply amazing! Our pilot, Eric, spotted some whale right after take off and requested approval to circle to give everyone of us a good look at them. This is just something that you can not see at water level. Flying along the south coast gives you views of several beaches that you just can not see any other way. The tour then proceeded to go past Jurassic Falls and then on to the Napali Coast. Everything about this tour was perfect. The staff  at Air Ventures Hawaii is top notch and made sure every one of us was enjoyed our time. 

Do not pass this tour up!

review_title: Flying in the Red Baron Byplane
review_text: My husband wanted to fly in this plane. I kind of got drafted into doing it, because you need 2 people (And the pilot of course). We really enjoyed the flight. The weather was perfect, we got to see the island up close. Eric and the entire staff members were awesome.
This was our second trip with Kevin in the four seater Cessna.   The info that he gave as we flew was wonderful.  Great overview of Kauai for our 87yr age mom.

Definitely recommend pilot and air "guide" Eric. He makes its fun and had us all laughing and big smiles the whole trip. My wife spotted three whales and he quickly completely circled over them so we could get the unique view of them from on top. The canyons and waterfalls were amazing as he just flies so smoothly and slowly that it feels like you are floating. There were incredibly huge waves crashing on north shore and again saw them from great angles. We were on the cruise ship and they come pick you up -no extra cost. Highly recommended company.

review_title: amazing even though it rained earlier that morning
review_text:
My husband and I opted for the private cessna flight to see the island, Napali coast over a 6 person helicopter or boat tour because I don't tolerate people being sick around me, and it was less expensive than the choppers too. We might go again next week because of how great it was...
Our pilot Eric was great, he circled around to get good views of whales breaching, manta rays on reefs, rainbows, waterfalls, and amazing landscape formations.we were worried in the morning rainshowers that visibility would be poor on our 1130 flight. They told us they play it hour by hour and when we got there they said the web cams were looking pretty good. Every flight is going to be different, we knew that from watching the view change while we were standing for 10 minutes at an overlook in Kokee park, but there was only one canyon he didn't take us into because it was still very cloudy and raining in there, but instead we saw and shot photos of a crazy amazing rainbow. While over the north coast area we saw a whale breach, and for awhile it stayed just under the surface, where we could see the whole length of it for awhile, omg, you have no idea how big those guys are until you're on top of one.it was like a glass aquarium show from above or something! Eric kept checking in on how my hubby was in the back, warned us when we'd be getting "texture" from the rain, but really was not as turbulent as is expected, just two or three times of bumps and the take off and landing were gentle.I even got to take the controls for awhile! Even though there were clouds, I think the rain made some of the waterfalls more visible, way more rainbows, and I think kept it cooler than it might have been in midday sun.
If you're on Kauai you have to fly with Air Ventures!

AirVentures was an amazing experience. My husband and I have visited this beautiful island of Kauai 4 times and this trip in the air was by far the best way to see the best of the island. Our pilot/ tour guide, Ray was the best of the best. Don't miss it!

review_title: AMAZING - a highlight of our trip!
review_text: We were on a cruise and found AirVentures independently while in port on Kauai.  Intended to join a group flight but (fortunately) ended up on an private flight on the Cessna with Captain Eric who was very knowledgeable and took great care of us!  What a spectacular way to see the Na Pali coast and Waimea Valley!! Was my husband's favorite part of our trip.  Thanks AirVentures!

Today, I took my 11-year-old grandkid for a ride with pilot Kevin on a one-hour flight over all of Kauai.  I loved it, and she enjoyed it even more.
The airplane, which would be easier to enter if you're a contortionist, is actually quite comfortable once seated, Kevin is a terrific pilot who makes sure his passengers get to see all that Kauai offers from about 1,500 feet, and he keeps up a running commentary that's quite interesting.
He detoured a bit so we could see some whales off the north end of the Napali coast, and watching them breach was a thrill.  The view from up there is exquisite - they don't call Kauai the garden island for nothing.
The flight was smooth and comfortable.  I'd worried about being cold, given air rushing by at 100 mph and us being in an open aircraft, but no worries -- you can wear shorts and flip-flops if you want and you'll be fine.  
Conventional cameras with straps are fine, too, but put away your cell phone once you taxi for takeoff -- too easy for them to tumble from the airplane.   
The ground crew is great -- taking time before and especially after the flight to use your cameras to take your photos with the biplane.
All in all, a great experience.  Was it worth $440 for the two of us?  If you could see the expression on the young girl's face you'd know the answer to that one.
Highly recommended.

Had a wonderful time flying all over the island with Ray. He made the experience feel like he was showing family around instead of tourists. His sense of humor and knowledge of the island enhanced our experience even more. Jill was also extremely helpful and accommodating. Choose Air Ventures for your tour! You will not regret it.

On our second day on Kauai, we used AirVentures to see and get a sense of the island and the varied landscape we would see here.  While my husband and I had been to Kauai many years before, my kids had not.  This was just a magnificent way to see the island as a whole!  The pilot was very informative and helpful.  We had a really great time.  I highly recommend this company.

from air u get the best overview of the island and its beauty.

the team picks u up, flight is smooth and gives an great overview.

Liz and the team is so friendly and love what they do. I enjoyed the fight but also the hospitality.

I have lived on Kauai for over 40 years. I have gone on several helicopter tours through the years but never a small plane tour. I thought my Air Ventures tour was fantastic. The views were completely different than from a helicopter......way more expansive......a greater overview of Kauai. It was a quieter and smoother flight. I saw views I have never seen in my 40 years on Kauai. Our pilot Paul was fun and informative. Pua and the rest of the crew were extremely friendly and helpful. Loved the whole experience. I would recommend visitors and locals alike to take the adventure of seeing our beautiful island of Kauai through an Air Venture tour.

review_title: Lifelong Kauai resident gets first look at island from air -- just amazing!!
review_text: Flew in the Cessna 182 with pilot Eric for my wife's birthday.  In her whole life on the island, she'd never seen it from the air.  Eric was perfect -- polished, professional, reassuring, and very knowledgable.  Even had her put hands on controls late in the flight to get a sense of the beauty of flight.  Priceless experience, and so much better than a helicopter. Love this island anew...

review_title: The BEST way to see Kauai
review_text: We have seen Kauai by driving around the entire island and by catamaran, but this was by far the BEST way to see the island.  We saw whales, sharks, porpoises, waterfalls, canyons that you cannot even hike too, Waimea Canyon, beaches and beaches, the Napoli coast and much, much more.  And on top of that our pilot was awesome and I loved his corny jokes.  The four of us loved it!!!
Well I am not a person who likes flying in general but with Piolt Paul we had a very wonderful smooth ride amazing views I am so glad we did it the whole entire family were so Happy

My wife is terrified of heights and said no way to a helicopter.  Somehow getting all hunkered down in the front of the Biplane strapped in was acceptable.   This was a gabulous way to see all of Kauai.  It was about $450 total for the two of us to have a private tour of the island. Harry our pilot was fantastic.  He took it very easy on us because of my wife's fear of heights.

It was a great thing to do at the start of our trip.  It is like getting an overview of the whole place and the mountains and waterfalls and beaches. 

Go early in the day as clouds tend to come in over the island in the afternoon. Pick a day with nice weather and enjoy the ride of your life. The cockpit is open but the windshield prorects you from the rushing air. Great job Air Ventures. A+!
This was a great way to cover a lot of ground and see the sights from an incomparable vantage point. The staff were very pleasant and professional. Would 100% recommend the package.

This was a highlight during our first visit to Kauai. There were four in our party and Captain Harry was a great pilot and tour guide. The ladies who greeted us for check-in were wonderful, very friendly and welcoming.
We would definitely recommend this tour to anyone looking for a view of the island from the air.

This was a fabulous way to see all the beauty of Kauai! It was a beautiful, mostly clear day. There were waterfalls, beaches, and lots of rainbows. All you need to bring is your camera! 

Everyone at AirVentures was knowledgeable and nice. We felt safe the entire time--from the ride to the airport, during our flight, and the trip back toward the cruise ship where we originated.

They took a picture of the 6 passengers along with the pilot standing next to the plane prior to our flight and then emailed the picture to us. They also had a DVD for purchase (not our specific flight, but with all the sights included) for about $10.

We plan to return to Hawaii in the future and will definitely go through AirVentures for some new experiences!

Our entire experience with Air Ventures was positive.  They really went out of their way to make sure we had an awesome experience.  We received a call from them the day before our scheduled flight asking if we would like to change our time to that day because the weather was going to be really nice. My husband had actually been thinking about calling them because the weather forecast for the next day wasn't going to be so great.  So glad that they called!!  It was a perfectly clear, beautiful day. The views of the island were spectacular.  Our pilot, Harry shared some great info about the island.  They took a picture of the group at the beginning and to my surprise, sent it to us for free through my email.
Had a fantastic flight , the best way to see Kauai . The pilot was a great tour guide pointing out highlights  and telling us the history of various locations around the island . The most fun tour

review_title: Highly Recommended and Would Do Again
review_text: Have no fear!  For those that are slightly apprehensive (as I was), this company is top notch with very experienced pilots.  Our pilot was Ray who completely puts you at ease during the entire flight.  He has many years as a commercial pilot and it is more than obvious that he knows how to maneuver the mountains and valleys of the island.  We saw the most beautiful waterfalls from every angle.  Ray gave us lots of information about the island.  Luckily we picked a beautiful day and could see the entirety of everything.  This was a trip of a lifetime and is difficult to put in writing what a great experience this was.  This is a must-do in my opinion.

We were greeted and treated like old friends from beginning to end.  Our pilot, Eric, had a vast knowledge of the island, a couple funny jokes, and his tour helped orient us for the week.  We had a fantastic time.  When a sight was on the right of the plane, he'd circle around so I could see it from the left too.  Very thoughtful and well run business.  We will recommend to all our friends.

The pilot Eric is great!  He made sure we saw everything that the island had to be seen!  Wonderful and smooth. Thanks Eric. We saw the falls that they filmed fantasy island. The Grand Canyon of the pacific. Coffee plantation and more

The entire day exceeded our expectations of any tour we have even taken.  The flight was phenomenal...Our pilot, Paul, was very knowledgeable of the island.  With the land tour and the boat tour to The Fern Grotto, we will mark this #1 tour of all time....Upon our return, we would definitely do this tour again.Thank you all so much!
Great flying experience, such a beautiful thing to do, great way to orientate yourself around the island, best to do it early in the time you have here.

review_title: Fabulous Tour of the entire island of Kauai
review_text: The plane ride was very smooth and went slow enough to be able to see everything clearly. We toured the entire island and our pilot explained about all each area we toured. It was our favorite tour on our vacation!!
They accommodated us when their competition had to cancel due to weather and were full the next day. Highly recommend for prompt courteous service. Great pilot

You have to see kaui from the air. We tried this trip having taken the helicopter the last time we where on Kauai - 10 years ago. My wife like it better. Not so much quick movements as with a helicopter. Lots of room too with big windows. We were real lucky having an amazing clear day where even the top of the mountain was clear. Such amazing views with a very knowledgeable pilot. He always made sure to circle around the major sights so both sides of the plain can see. Smooth take off and landing...just like floating in a cloud. Go you will not regret it!

My husband and I have been to Kauai twice and on our last trip we decided to try out the bi-plane tour and we are so happy that we did! It was so fantastic. What a great way to see the beautiful island of Kauai. The service was superb and our pilot was amazing. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone.

review_title: One Hour Flight, Memories For A Lifetime
review_text:
Most beautiful air plane tour on earth (and I did 5 of those already: Asia, Europe and South America) and I GOT TO DRIVE THE AIRPLANE MYSELF in this Stunning Avatar Movie Landscape! Will never forget this experience. It is a One Hour Flight and Memories For A Lifetime

P.S. The team is just adorable and super friendly!

review_title: A very professional and fun outfit
review_text: We took a flight with these folks around Kauai, and everything was perfect. The weather, the scenery, the pilot, the plane. Just loved the professionalism, yet fun attitude.

Great way to see island and cheaper than helicopter, no able to hover but slow moving and if want to see something again, pilot will  do 360 around what you want to take more pictures of. Everyone has a window and very comfortable ride. over 1 hr time in air and realize how small island really is from the air. Don't worry, not a rush fly  and some helicopters actually went by us.

Would Highly recommend Air Ventures.  We had a great time and got some awesome photos. Everyone has their own windows.  We put our GoPro on the wing and got awesome video.   It is the best way to see all of the Island. We will be return customers for sure.

Captain Ray is the best and his operation is first rate. I was really nervous about doing this trip but Ray made me feel at ease pretty quickly after getting up in the air.  He was a commercial pilot for years with a large airline and flying overseas is second nature for him. We did a private tour in his Cessna and I would highly recommend this. Better than a helicopter tour because you all have your own window for viewing/picture taking and he can take you where helicopters don't go. He also will customize your tour or go back to a spot you want to see again. He is extremely personable and knowledgeable making this a fantastic experience that we will do again.  We had originally planned for an afternoon tour but changed it to morning and glad we did. Weather over mountains was superb and clouds moved in over them in afternoon so we were able to see things we wouldn't have in the afternoon. I truly can't recommend this company enough. Extremely nice people who do anything to make your experience the best it can be.

Took this flight as part of the Best of Kaua'i tour. Highly recommended, especially if you're not fond of helicopters. "Everyone has a window seat." plus, they frequently reverse direction so everyone can see the same things. Good experience.

review_title: Red Barron through the skies of Kauai
review_text:
We recently spent 10 days in Kauai.  The Red Barron biplane tour was an amazing addition to our trip.  Harry, our pilot was so patient.  First he made time for plenty of photo shoots with us and the plane.  Harry even posed for a picture.  Then he carefully mounted our GoPro to the wing strut.  He made suggestions for settings for the best pictures.  Then after climbing in the front seats of the plane we were amazed with the most gorgeous views of Kauai from the air.  Harry was narrating often, letting us know about the views below.  He would circle areas so we could get a better view or take in all the details.  We were wearing canvas helmets with radio communication with each other and Harry.  This made it easy to ask Harry questions, make comments or ask for clarification.  

We debated between the biplane and helicopter tours.  Both are about the same length of time.  The helicopters do get closer to the falls but I read so many bad reviews about seating and glass glare.  Neither of these can be an issue in an open cockpit and with only 2 seats besides the pilot seat.  Our thoughts were that we could take a helicopter tour anywhere but where else would we ever get this option of a very cool biplane.

The staff and owners of Air Ventures are pretty amazing too.  When I asked for advise on lunch they recommended a great fish & chips restaurant.  Nothing was rushed here.  Everyone took the time to make sure we had a great time there but also on the rest of our trip - Thank you.

I would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Kauai.  Schedule it early in your trip so you can get ideas of where to drive to later in your trip.

We flew with Air Ventures with Harry as our pilot in a Biplane with Snoopy on the tail. The trip was fantastic! We flew around the Kauai coast, up the Waimea Canyon, saw waterfalls, beaches, birds at 3,000 feet, the Princeville area, reefs, blue water and all in the open cockpit of the airplane. Caught it all on my GoPro mounted on a wing strut - fantastic!

review_title: Air Ventures gave us a great flight
review_text: The flight was very good, information given by the pilot was great but we were led to believe we would be in the air for 70 minutes, but it was 55 minutes,best to clarify times before departure.

Fantastic! We talked about doing an air tour all week. Well on our last day we finally made last minute plans with Air Ventures for plane ride over the island. They were great. Jill made us feel so comfortable about planning last minute. Eric was our pilot, he was fantastic! We would highly recommend Air Ventures. They definitely made our trip memorable.

review_title: Air Ventures was the hightlight of our Trip to Hawaii
review_text: It's all about the "experience" and Air Ventures gave us the best customer experience we could every expect. Every interaction with the company was so positive, from having to change the time of our flight because our ship was getting in late to Kauii, to solving a transportation problem getting to the Smith Luau. Our pilot was Eric and gave us the history of the island and even made  swing around to get a better view. I want to give a big shout out to Jill who was FANTASTIC! She is a true example of Customer Care.  Thank you for the great experience.

We did this on our last day in Kauai and we thoroughly enjoyed the airplane tour around the island. Our pilot Harry was awesome and we felt perfectly safe with him and we saw so many beautiful spots around the island! Would recommend to all!! Good prices too!

We have seen the island by car and helicopter and that was fun.  But the open cockpit biplane was the best!  You're right out there.  It's like being on a motorcycle in the air.  Harry's knowledge of the island made the trip not only fun but informative.  
If you have a sense of adventure, this is the ride for you.

We took the first flight of the day on the red biplane. It was one of life's great adventures. My wife and I have taken plane tours and heli tours in the past - and they certainly have their virtues. But this experience was something quite different.

The staff on the ground, as well as Harry (the pilot) in the air; are thoughtful caring and professional. An unexpected joy was that the plane is configured for two people to sit together in the front cockpit. As we were celebrating our anniversary, it was a memory we will together treasure.

Besides seeing the phenomenal beauty of Kauai from the open cockpit of the biplane, the tour left us with a deeper understanding of what all air flight used to be like a hundred years ago.

Amazing. Amazing. Amazing. Worth every thin dime!

You gotta do this.

review_title: See Kauai in an  “Open Cockpit/Bi-Wing” Plane is a “Must Do”…
review_text:
My wife Debbie and I had a great time seeing Kauai with our guide/pilot – Kevin of Air Adventures. He was extremely knowledgeable of the island history and piloted us over some magnificent sites for some incredible pictures…. 

I know some people may be apprehensive about flying in an “open” cockpit bi- wing plane, but there is nothing like it, as the fresh air and your ability to see Kauai’s many outstanding sites/locations, your ability to take pictures without windows affecting clarity is great. We have flown on many helicopter tours and small planes, but there is nothing like flying in an “open cockpit” plane, especially to view and take pictures of such a picturesque island….

On our 70-minute trip around the island of Kauai we were able to view 100+ waterfalls, along with Kauai’s many other outstanding locations…, as this was our 7th trip to Kauai and ranks as one of best ever island excursions. Thanks Kevin and Air-Adventures for an unforgettable trip.  

Debbie & Mark Page – Nashville, Tennessee

After a busy morning exploring the Na Pali coast by small boat we decided seeing it by air would be great too.  Air Ventures Hawaii came to our rescue and we truly had a flight to remember.  The views were beautiful nothing was too much for Ray (our pilot) to show us and his stories about the island were wonderful.  It topped off a wonderful day all round but the truly most amazing thing was that by the time we left we felt as if we had made friends for life with Ray his beautiful wife and the staff.   An exceptional company I can give no greater compliment than thank you for making us feel so welcome.   Please please Air Venture Hawaii is a must.

On our last day in Kauai, my sister and I wanted to do a tour of the island by air. We chose this outfit, based on reviews here, as well as price, and the option of the combo tour w/ the boat trip to the Fern Grotto.We had 9 hours to kill, since we had to check out of our room at 10:00, return the car by noon, and our flight wasn't until 8:55 pm, and we were wondering however we would spend all those hours w/ no transportation , as well as hauling our heavy luggage around!
It was a WISE CHOICE.
Jill, wife of one of the pilots, on her day off, was willing to pick us up at at the airport, drive us to the AirVentures hangar for our flight, keep up our luggage safe in her van, take us afterwards to the boat launch for our Fern Grotto tour, pick us back up after that, and drive us to the Marriott where we could store our luggage, have a leisurely dinner, and shuttle (free) back to the airport for our 9:00 flight. How generous and thoughtful was that?! We were amazed. Thank you again Jill.
As for the flight, it was great, every bit as enjoyable as the more expensive helicopter rides, and very safe - they have a perfect flying record, NO crashes from their 27+ years of doing these tours. 
Kevin, our pilot, was competent, entertaining and knowledgable about the island. 
Pua, at the desk, was thorough and very pleasant and cheerful with the details.
All in all, a VERY pleasant way to spend what would've been a long, grueling day of sitting and waiting for an evening flight! 
Otherwise, I would opt to do the flight on a first day there, if possible, it gives you a great overview of the island, so you can then pick and choose what else you want to see and do.
I highly recommend this company for your flying tour of Kauai!

We ended up booking with Air Ventures for a few reasons. We wanted to fly over the Na Pali coastline since we had our toddler with us, but most helicopter tours were pretty pricey. Also some don't allow toddlers, or charge for them. Air ventures didn't charge for under 24 months and was much cheaper than the helicopter tours. PLUS it lasted longer. We took the 1st morning flight (highly recommended) and it was amazing. Almost 90 mins in the air for $125 an adult?!? YES! Plus we got a free video and amazing gopro footage and pictures. Our pilot pointed out everything to us including spots from different films we didn't even know were filmed on the island. Since we were early for the flight they recommended a short drive down the road to an old pier where we got some great family photo shots as well. The pilot as took family/group photos before the flight with our own cameras for keepsakes. I highly recommend this tour. Budget friendly, great for kids, coupons available on-island or call for specials/check website. Book directly through the company for the best deal and try for the first flight of the day.

After Wings over Kauai couldn't get us up over the Island-(see my review for them) they set up a trip for us with Air Ventures. My wife was a bit apprehensive about flying in a small plane. So while waiting for the pilot to come back in with what supposed to be his last flight of the day, his wife Jill talked with my wife which really helped with her fear of flying in a smaller fixed wing plane. The pilot (Ray) returned who I then found out was the owner. We chatted for awhile then off we went to his plane. After a quick briefing we were off. It was a perfect late afternoon fly over of Kauai. We saw at least 90% of the island from the air and a rare  view of the top of Waialeale mountain and its waterfalls.Ray pointed out spots and the history of those and so many other locations that I wished I had recorded it all. We flew over Na Pali right out to the ocean then up the coast and back down it again. Up and over the canyons and circled the waterfalls. My wife was grinning ear to ear and taking pictures. I told her to put the camera down and enjoy this. Do give great consideration on flying in a smaller fixed wing plane. Especially if you're a couple. It is much more intimate experience seeing the island because you are not sharing the windows with other passengers like in the  helicopters.It is smoother and quieter also. And cheaper! Air Ventures is a great way to see the island, and you must see it from the air to appreciate its splendor and beauty. Ma Halo Ma Halo for an experience my wife and I will not ever forget. Ma halo for making it work for us in such short notice. You are a 5 star company!

The airplane flight was included as part of an island tour.  While we loved the main tour guide and his knowledge, this airplane ride was the best part.  The airline is well run and timely.  The pilot was very knowledgable and showed us all the highlights of the island, many parts of which can only be seen from the air.  The ride is noisy, but they provide full coverage earphones that also serve as the pilot's intercom to talk you through the tour.  Also felt very safe in the small plane.

Kaua'i had so much to do that we were running out of time to see Waimea Canyon and Hanakapi'ai falls.  The beneift of the air tour is it gave us a bird's eye view to see those sights, and so much more.  And indeed, the views were breath-taking.  

Our pilot, while nice enough, seemed a little bored and not especially knowledgable. Hence - 3 stars.

review_title: A Great Job of Showing Us Kauai
review_text: Kevin, the pilot, did a very good job of giving us a great tour of the Island. He and his staff were very good at making us feel welcome and accomodating our needs.

review_title: Best way to see the island
review_text: We wanted to see the whole island and the best way is from the air.  I have never flown in a small plane before and was a little apprehensive . When we arrived Jill was very gracious and informative. Our pilot was extremely knowledgeable and flew around all the sights in both direction so everyone could get pictures of some of the most beautiful scenery I have ever seen. The takeoff and landing were extremely smooth. Totally changed my opinion of small planes!!
We booked this tour for our anniversary,it was money well spent! Jill was very helpful with booking and at check in. This tour offers great views if the island and waterfalls.

review_title: Unbelievable private scenic flight in a Cessna 4 seater plane
review_text:
This is an absolute must do flight.
Kauai is such a magnificent island with such staggering natural beauty that you can truly only appreciate from the Air.
I was travelling to Hawaii from the UK with my 2 sons so the choice of the 4 seater Cessna was perfect as it made it both a private as well as a very personal trip.
Our pilot was Ray ............ exceptional !!!  we all felt he was sharing his island with us.
His enthusiasm was just great and we were soon all totally captivated with all the wonders and his stories about the island.
This trip was on my bucket list and exceeded all my expectations.
Ray has given me a memory for life.
There's nothing else to say.

Tour was great if you can handle the hot temp of the airplane cabin. After the tour we were asked by an employee if we enjoyed it. When we commented on the lack of air conditioning, she responded that she knew about the problem, it's a manufacturer defect! Would have been nice to have been told in advance and maybe offered another time for the plane with working AC! If there really is one as she indicated. Kind of ruined my first time in a small aircraft.

review_title: Vintage biplane tour of the island
review_text: Just loved the personal service from Jill who took our reservation to, Ray who picked us up from the hotel, to Kevin who flew us around the island.  The tour itself was spectacular and definitely the 70 minutes they promised!  We took pictures before and after and during and got some amazing shots thanks to Kevin's maneuvering. Kevin knew the history of the island and told us stories keeping the flight fun and informational.  It was an exciting and awe-inspiring experience - definitely glad we splurged.  I would recommend AirVentures for their outstanding service and it was worth every penny!

review_title: All the Natural Wonders of Kauai in 70 minutes.
review_text: I wanted this experience to be the highlight of my trip and the team at Air Ventures Hawaii in Kauai did not disappoint. Booking online was simple and the check-in process with Pua 30mins before the flight was even simpler. Our pilot, Harry, briefed us on a few dos and don'ts while in the aircraft and then he had us in the air in no time. His commentary of what we were seeing and flying over added a whole lot more to the experience. After having done a couple of helicopter tours, this aircraft tour was far more relaxing due to the spaciousness of the cabin (a window for everyone too) and the smoothness of the flight.

review_title: Great way to see beautiful Kauai
review_text: Really enjoyed one hour scenic flight over beautiful island of Kauai. The pilot was very knowledgeable and showed us all the interesting places on the island. Always turned around several times so people on left/right could see and take pictures.

The best way to see the island, great value for money and very helpful and personable staff.
I highly recommend Air Ventures Hawaii.

So wonderful so great so fantastic.
Just a brilliant way to see the island.  Paul was a great guy the pilot. Reception staff were all friendly and supportive of nerves etc. It is a MUST do wheb on this island. 
Thank you for thr experience

Truly enjoyed our tour of Kauai today!  It was a perfect length of time and we were able to go right up to the crater.  We saw things that we would never be able to see by car or hiking. Eric our pilot was very informative and entertaining.  We have never done a flight like this before and it was awesome!!
Excellent is too poor a word to describe the ride, the service and the staff.  I would highly recommend the Waco ride to anyone.
We had an awesome time on our plane ride over the beautiful Kauai Island. Our pilot was amazing. We also got some breathtaking photos. Thank You Air Ventures for an amazing experience.

We took a Na Pali coast catamaran ride, did the 8 mile hike from Ke'e beach, and then took the flight around the island. It enabled us to see where we are staying, everywhere we have been and a few places we still want to visit.

review_title: Great way to see the Island!
review_text: We booked with Air Ventures after getting canceled at Wings over Kauai due to equipment problems and couldn't be happier. They were easy to work with and were able to take our family of 4 on short notice.   Stunning views of Napalii cost with pilot giving great recommendations for beach trips.  Great way to get an overview of the Island for land based trips and see additional coastline and waterfalls which can only be seen by air.

Our family of 5 took a flight today around Kauai - it was a more economical option than a helicopter tour.  PROs:  we got the plane to ourselves, it only seats 6 passengers, the weather was clear and mostly sunny, we got beautiful views of the island and our pilot Harry did turns on the major sites like Waimea Canyon and Na Pali coast to allow both sides of plane to get good views, and the tour felt very personalized with just our family in there. 
CONs:  you don't get as close to sights as a helicopter.  

As far as seating goes, the best seat for pictures is the co-pilot chair up in front, similar to helicopters.  Anything behind may have some obstruction by the wing but you can still get nice views.  The ride was relatively smooth - we went at 8:30am - but afterwards we all felt a little motion sickness from the ride and went back to hotel to rest. Recommend you check the weather forecast and choose the sunniest day of your trip, and start in the morning. We noticed it often rained in afternoon. 

Final verdict:  I recommend this for getting aerial tour of island, especially if helicopter is too pricey. It was enjoyable with great views.

review_title: Beautiful views over a beautiful island.
review_text: We had a great fun time.   Some folks might want to take a Dramamine before you fly, cause it could get a little bumpy.   All the help was courteous and friendly and prompt.   The views are amazing and the pilot (Paul) was friendly and informative.   Take your go pro and they can bolt it onto the wing (for small up charge)... I set it to time-lapse, at 1 pic/second..... Ended up with 4300+ pics to sort thru.   Thanks for the great trip... Hey Paul, the tube adventure was a blast too!

Danke Paul fuer den tollen Flug, trotz viele Wolken hatten wir auf alles wichtige einen super Ausblick. Sehr gute Erklaerung und auch geschichtliche Information ueber Kauai. Wir kommen gerne wieder zurueck, danke fuer das tolle Geburtstagsgeschenk fuer mein Mann.

We originally booked with 'Wings over Kauai' but EU had a technical problem with their aircraft and we were moved to Air Ventures. Ellen at 'Wings over Kauai' was very helpful and phoned ahead so it wasn't a surprise to us.

Jill at Air Ventures met us and was so friendly and helpful. Our pilot was Kevin, he was brilliant - he gave a very informative running commentary through the flight, lots of facts and info about the island and its sights. We took off and flew round over the south shore over our hotel and up over the Waimea Canyon - this looks amazing from above and you can see so many more waterfalls from the air. We then flew over the Na Pali coastline as this was recommended bay friend, just stunning. Again, Kevin,ads sure we got all the right shots and angles. We finished by rounding the north of the island and flying inland across the beautiful green interior.

Overall fantastic, thanks to Kevin and Jill for a great trip, would highly recommend!
