We had a very nice welcome from the lady at the front desk (sorry can't remember her name). The hospitality was a nice touch! Our pilot was also very nice a welcoming. Safety was first! Which we are always thankful for! He was very informative and gave us lots of history and information we had not heard yet! He did a very nice job giving us a smooth ride, unfortunately we had a couple of us prone to motion sickness. One of us got sick on the flight and he was more prepared then expected! The vanilla bean spray was a WONDERFUL add ;) Then when we were finished they had ginger-ale, soda crackers and peppermints to sooth our upset stomach!! Very kind ;) I would definitely recommend Air Ventures Hawaii!!!!!!

Our pilot was the best!!! The Views we had were breathtaking!!! He made us feels comfortable and his narrations of the different locations were amazing!!!! We were able to get some great pictures. It was well worth the price and so glad we decided to do this tour. Thank You Air Ventures!!!!
Done with 3 kids, very smooth, very friendly staff. Would repeat. Amazing pictures. Very informative. Not as speedy as a helicopter but much cheaper

review_title: Best Thing I've Done in Hawaii
review_text: This is clearly the highlight of any of my 3 trips to Hawaii while visiting 4 of the Islands. If you are trying to decide between a helicopter tour or this, do this first or last, but just book the WACO Bi-Plane tour. Whichever helicopter tour you choose probably doesn't matter, there are hundreds it seems and they are interesting. I've done 7 so far, 3 in Hawaii and others in other parts of the world. This Bi-plane is just another thing altogether. Open cockpit and throaty engine really gives a different experience. Also, consider that in a helicopter the chances are that you will end up in one of the back middle seat in a vibrating bubble. On this flight you get right or left and full front view. Our pilot Paul put us through some thrilling maneuvers at different points during the tour and I could just go back and do this again and again. I have a gopro and used their mount. It was perfect, however I did pull out my phone to record some of those fun turns and drops and climbs. I would recommend that if you can, try to record from your seat, but come prepared to secure your camera to your body. I didn't secure my phone but gripped it until my knuckles were white and certainly kept it behind the windscreen since it was clear that if I stuck it into the wind, it would rip it from my hand. Air Ventures is a professional outfit, from booking through flight. Thanks for a great experience. (I was trying to upload pics, but TripAdvisor kept rotating them upside down)

It was our first ever experience in a small plane and a bi-plane at that.  The staff was very helpful and conscientious in making sure the experience was as pleasant and wondrous as could be.  The pilot was very informative and accommodating and did several exciting maneuvers per our request at the end of the flight that tickled our bell ies.

We took a day trip to Kauai when we visited Honolulu. I would highly recommend six seater airplane over a Helicopter to do a tour of the island. Much cheaper ( paid $100 pp) compared to Helicopter (which was over $200 pp) for an hour ride. They had cold water available on the flight if you need it. The pilot very nice and showed us the whole island.

This was an amazing bird's eye view of the beautiful island of Kauai.  Our pilot Paul was informative and knowledgeable about all the highlights and ensured we had a smooth, safe ride.  It was the softest plane landing I have ever experienced and I felt totally comfortable the whole ride.  I would definitely recommend this company.

There are many helicopter and plane tours you can take on Kauai.   We stumbled upon this one and it was fantastic.   They picked us (6) up near the cruise ship and we took a 1 - 1.5 hour tour of the island.   The Waimea canyon and Napali coast were the highlights of our trip to Hawaii.   Our pilot was very skillful and knowledgeable about the island.   The plane is very comfortable, air conditioned and has rounded windows for great views.   At $125 each it was WELL worth it and I would recommend Air Ventures to anyone.
We went on the plane tour while on our Honeymoon.  It was a fantastic way to see the Kauai landscapes.  Our pilot was wonderful and enjoyable.  The entire staff was great.  Thanks.
Pilot was outstanding and did an excellent job of narrating.  It was such an awesome view and tour of Kauai.  It was far better than the helicopter tour.

review_title: The best way to see Kauai
review_text: The views are simply amazing. Our pilot Paul was great about telling us what we were looking at; we learned a lot about the island while seeing breathtaking views of waterfalls, the canyon, the Na Pali coast... He would fly by and then circle around so that the other side of the plane could get a first hand look. There are only 6 seats so everyone gets a great view. It's a 60-70 minute flight so you really see everything. The only down side is that because it is a small plane if you are prone to air sickness it can get to you. It's not air conditioned, although there is the vent above that is blowing air on you. But it does get warm in there. The pilot does not do any dips or things that are unnecessary, so don't worry about that. The views are totally worth it! Jill was the staff member at the desk who took care of us and she was great too.

We booked the airvan for our family of 5 after reading a recommendation on CruiseCritic. The booking was quick and easy online and Pua was wonderful to interact with. They scheduled a shuttle pickup for us near our ship and after a smooth checkin process we were up in the air with pilot Paul. 
The view is amazing and the experience was incredible. It was far and away the favorite activity of the vacation for our children.

We booked a flight with their small Cesna plane and experieced an exceptional tour allover Kauai. Luckily, we had an early morning flight, not a single cloud allowing us to see everything. Thanks to the whole team and especially our pilot Eric who did an amazing job and a butter smooth landing :).

Incredible views and very entertaining pilot.  Small plane gave intimate feel to flight. Absolutely stunning tour. Plus for only $25 we attached our go pro to the wing of the plane for additional incredible footage.

Io e la mia compagna abbiamo avuto la fortuna di partecipare ad un tour aereo di Kauai in una giornata nitida e senza nuvole. Impressionanti i colori contrastanti del mare, delle montagne e del canyon dall'alto. L'isola è davvero un paradiso naturale. Il pilota Eric è stato eccezionale, premuroso nei nostri confronti, disponibilissimo a raccontare tutto ciò che vedevamo e a rispondere ai nostri quesiti. Consiglierei il tour a chiunque perchè merita davvero apprezzare l'isola dal cielo.

I'm happy I have a wonderful adventurous wife who spotted the Air//Venture sign and we signed up.  Brian was supremely knowledgeable of the Island and made our trip a great learning experience besides a treat for the senses. I couldn't convince him to do a barrel roll.
Great way to see entire island. We choose this on our first day then planed rest of stay after seeing from above.

After a last minute decision and (fortunate for us) a cancellation my husband, brother in law and I were booked with Air Ventures. Pua was sweet and efficient on the phone and sent Jill right after us for pick up. We were pleasantly surprised upon learning Ray, the owner (along with his sweet wife Jill) would be flying us. He was an amazing pilot, took us to the most amazing parts of the island and around the coast line, including the Ma Pali Coast. The sights from the plane were so stunning and so beautiful! The water from above is amazing. Ray, Jill, Pua and all the staff were wonderful. We highly recommend Air Ventures and give it double thumbs up all the way around! This was The Trip of our Hawaii vacations.

I booked the tour with my husband and teenaged daughter. We were the only ones scheduled so we took the smaller Cessna. 
Our pilot Eric was really friendly and knowledgeable about the island and even flew us over our resort! It was a great view from above!

We picked Kauia destination for our honeymoon, but as far as we wanted to make the trip brilliant we came to Kauai un prepared about doing an Air tour ! We were worried we wouldn't have the time to do it since it was just a quick 4 day honeymoon trip. I'm glad though that my AMAZING husband found Air Ventures Hawaii right away . They respond and called us back in less than 20 minutes. Thank you Gil and Kevin! JUST SO EVERYONE KNOWS Kevin was great pilot and great tour guide! He described  all of the history of the island that we wouldn't have known! He's the most experienced pilot in town of Kauai, and Gil OMG ! She hooked us up and got an upgrade . Thank you so much , seeing the beauty of the  whole garden of Kauai was once in a lifetime experienced ! !!

We had a private flight on the Cessna. It was absolutely amazing! The pilot and staff were so friendly and nice. The tour was absolutely breathtaking! If you are visiting Kaui you must take a flight with AirVentures.

My wife and I booked a trip with Air Ventures for our wedding anniversary and what an experience it was. First, booking the trip was simple and the staff was extremely nice and helpful. They informed us of the tour route and took us out to see the beautiful biplane that would be taking is on our tour. We met Kevin, our pilot and tour guide, who explained to us the history of the plane and some of the particulars about the tour. Kevin was a great tour guide. Very knowledgeable and extremely friendly who has been doing this for 20++ years. Once we got in the air it was simply breathtaking. We literally flew through the clouds, two volcano craters, the Grand Canyon of the Pacific and saw over 30 waterfalls. You just can't see Kauai any better than this! It's fun, infomarive, reasonably priced and an experience you will never forget. When we go back to kauai we're definitely taking the tour again! Thanks so much to Air ventures for the experience of a lifetime.

Jason and Amanda

review_title: One of the Best Experiences of My Life!
review_text:
Wow - what an experience! I had the opportunity to take two separate flights - one in their Cessna and one in their incredible cherry red biplane (the only one on the island). 

On both trips to Air Ventures, I was greeted warmly by the staff and owner, who really goes above and beyond to make sure you enjoy your experience.

My pilot, Kevin, has been on the island for 25+ years and, is full of interesting history and tidbits and also makes your flight incredibly fun! You can tell he loves what he does, and it made my experience(s) all the more enjoyable! 

I've always been a fan of flying, and I feel lucky to have experienced not one, but two of their tour offerings. Any of their options will give you a great history and layout of the island (great to do at the beginning of your trip so you can get a best idea of where to spend your time there, and what to do), but I HIGHLY recommend the Biplane flight - it will be worthy every penny!

No matter what, Air Ventures will show you an incredible time and delivers a very unique adventure that really rates as a bucket list item in my book. 

Special thanks to Jill and Kevin. You truly made my weekend, and I'll definitely be sending all travelers to Kaua'i your way.

This was the most breathtaking scenery that I've ever seen. I was travelling solo and they were able to book me online which was great since wings over kauai has a policy not to book singles until day before if there is room! Great bonus to not have to wait last minute to see if I would get a seat. I was able to get the front seat next to the pilot and it was smooth sailing. 

I tend to get a little queasy but I was totally fine on this trip as there were only a few bumps. I remember to look at the horizon also as a precaution! I took the 10am flight which was great except that I forgot not to wear white and so I had reflections in my pics when seeing napali. I still got some great shots for my camera phone but seems like earlier is better or afternoons. Or just don't wear light coloured clothing :) 

Hands down awesome trip. Did this on my first full day and allows you to soak it in and also decide what else you want go focus on  your trip. I ended up going north after my flight and did the kalalau trail to Hanakapai beach. What beauty!!! :)

review_title: FANTASTIC Full-Island Kauai Air Tour w/ GREAT Informative Pilot
review_text:
I had the pleasure of a late afternoon "The Big Kahuna" air tour this week with Air Ventures Hawaii that was a FANTASTIC full tour of Kauai.

The views from the plane were amazing and the pilot Brian was outstanding.  With headsets on he provided me and the 3 others on the plance an amazing historical, geographic, geological and current events explanation that highlighted everything we saw and importantly he did so with great delivery and with good doses of humor too.

On Kauai everyone has multiple options to tour from above by airplane or helicopter and since I grew up in a family where my father flew small private planes as a hobby his whole life and it's how we traveled on vacations on the mainland, I really wanted to experience Kauai from above in a plane and I can tell you that this fixed-wing air tour did NOT disappoint. In fact, I was blown away by how much I saw in Air Venture's roomy GA-8 Airvan with large windows, comfortable seating and air-conditioning I believe.  It was comfortable!

After take-off the plane headed South and this is only some of the things we saw -- the incredible Kipu Kai shoreline, Poipu, Olokele Canyon (I actually saw the famed Robinson family's house!), many different angles & views of the Waimea Canyon which is a MUST for any Kauai visitor and then an outstanding tour or the 
Nā Pali coast.  Brian, our pilot was flawless with his detail and was really entertaining about all these sites and more.  The view of the "cathedrals" along the Nā Pali coast was very amazing!

We then wrapped around the North Shore at Ke'e Beach which is the end of the road on North Shore & start of the 12-mille ea. way Kalalau Trail along the Nā Pali coast. Extending the North Shore we then had amazing views of Tunnels Beach, Ha'ena, Lumaha'i Beach, Hanalei & all Hanalei Bay...and then Princeville.

Brian then flew us inland up the Hanalei River valley & as close as we could get to Mount Waiʻaleʻale at over 5,000 feet, almost always shrouded in clouds as it was for us, on the summit as this is one of the wettest spots in the world with over 600 inches of rain per year.

Just think GREEN & BLUE because this is what you will see.

GREEN because that is what you see on this airplane tour of the many remote places on the land of Kauai and BLUE for all the beautiful water you see and then including beaches, reefs, Hanalei valley & taro fields, the Wailua River and TONS of waterfalls.

After the interior tours both on the West side and the North Shore, we then came into the back side of Kapaa over mountains with even more waterfall views & then beautiful views of East side beaches before landing in Lihue.

Air Ventures and pilot Brian are to be commended for running an outstanding tour, at least the one that I experienced.  I would recommend this to anyone of any age from anywhere.  It was just a fantastic experience.

Mahalo Air Ventures Hawaii... :)

We had a wonderful time with Air Ventures on Kauai. My husband and I flew with Brian around the island and were amazed at the sights and the information that Brian shared with us. He was Extremely knowledgeable about the island and its history and our plane ride really made our visit to Kauai special. 
We highly recommend that anyone who travels to Kauai see its beauty by air and use Air Ventures. 
Chris and Sheryl from KC MO

Our trip around the island of Kauai was a fantastic end to our week on the island!   We saw all the places (Waimea Canyon, Wailua Falls, the Na Pali coastline, Poipu and many other beaches, etc.) we had visited during the week as well as many others that are only accessible by air.   Our guide, Brian, was informative, interesting and personable. Also our landing and take-off were smooth and gentle.  
We enjoyed our (repeat) flight as did our (first time) friends!

Great views of the island with a very knowledgeable pilot. My hubby and I are 6'1" and 6'0", respectively so sitting in the back of the plane was a bit cramped for the one hour flight but we were able to angle a little into the aisle.  The flight does get a little bumpy at times and 5 of the 6 of us did mention almost needing the complimentary sic sacs that were provided (although only one actually did use it in the end). If you are prone to motion sickness I would stay away or plan to take something in advance.  The pilot was very good overall and you really get great pictures of the Waimea Canyon and the Na Pali Coast.  Would definitely recommend.

This plane ride was excellent.  Our pilot was very knowledgable on landmarks, places to see, and Hawaiian history.  We got to see the entire island.  If you are traveling to Kauai, you need to book with Air Ventures, you won't regret it.

After our reservation with another private air plane service was cancelled an hour before, air ventures was able to get us in that same morning. And boy am I glad that happened! They were amazing. Jill and her husband we're extremely friendly. And treated us like family. Our pilot was great, very friendly and knowledgeable about the island. We had an amazing time!!! Would highly recommend

review_title: Fixed wing flight with Helicopter service
review_text: Our pilot was excellent in his enthusiasm for the island as a native and he got us close to the vistas we wanted to see without frightening the passengers.

review_title: Island tour of Kauai just wonderful!
review_text: Our island tour of Kauai with Air Ventures was awesome!  We were in a small plane with one other family.  I can't begin to describe the beauty that we were able to view from the birds' eye look at the island.  We would highly recommend . . . and recommend this company!  The small plane flies higher than the helicopter tours . . . but not much . . . our own (amateur for certain) photos were incredible.  We totally enjoyed the perspective of sights not possible to be seen from the ground on the island . . . excellent, well-informed tour guide/pilot . . . we were given a DVD of the trip and tour information . . . so fun to share at home!

We took the Bi-Plane tour on May 24 and could not recommend it more. The staff was all great, and since I am a  Flight Instructor in California I can say our pilot Harry was outstanding. Informative, safe, and very knowledgeable of his plane and the the tour. Great commentary during the flight about all that you would never see by road. The plane was built in 2002 as a copy of the original ones and is very well cared for. You can tell that Harry loves his job and his plane. Fly with them anytime and enjoy the experience.

My family of five went on a week's vacation to Hawaii, and we toured the islands on the Pride of America cruise ship. We took a plane tour of Kauai with Air Ventures, and it was one of the highlights of our whole trip. The staff were so friendly, and the pilot did a great job of showing us the whole island. The views from the air were breathtaking. The cost of this trip by helicopter would have been prohibitively expensive for us, but by plane it was reasonable, and the five of us could go together.

review_title: Great Experience and worth the money
review_text: The company was awesome in helping us with the Air and Sea Combo.  Air Venture was great the weather wasn't the best and they had to postponed which I would rather do then go up and fly and see nothing.  I really appreciated that they wanted the best experience possible versus just making money.

Most of the Garden Isle is inaccessible by road. The roads (almost) circumnavigate the island, but you cannot drive to see the NaPali Coast. You either go by air or by boat.
Air Ventures is one of the cool ways to see the inaccessible. Much, much less expensive than helicopter equivalents, this is a great tour.I was the alleged co-pilot with Captain Mick and my other five fellow travellers and we had such a fun time with Mick giving us a guided tour of this beautiful Island. I guarantee you will not be disappointed with Air Ventures and their helpful staff..

We had such a phenomenal time with our open cockpit biplane your with Harry! The island is gorgeous from the plane and nothing beats the experience of being in a small plane, let alone having an open cockpit. Harry made us feel super safe and comfortable and have great information about the island. We did this to start the trip as an introduction to Kauai and I'm so glad we did! Now we know exactly where we want to go during the rest of our trip, having gotten a taste from the air!

Had a great time....We had  an early morning trip scheduled,but it was really cloudy when we arrived.The ladies at the counter explained to us that if we went later on in the day it would be better. We checked out the island for a few hours  ,then returned later.It was awesome,the sky had cleared and the views were spectacular...Our pilot Harry was great,very knowledgeable and fun.He also let my daughter wear the Red Baron hat and goggles..

With many parts of Kauai inaccessible by car, this was a great way to see the island. Captain Paul made the experience fun and entertaining by pointing out movie sites, celebrity houses, and other landmarks. The Napali coast, Waimea Canyon and waterfalls were magnificent!

review_title: Even better than the helicopter tours!
review_text: Booked the flight and luau package on the phone (super easy to book), and got a reminder email and phone call the day before the flight. Location is easy to find (right after LIH main terminal) with ample parking. Checked in with Liz (who I booked with on phone), and she was just as pleasant and funny in person during the quick check in process. After ten minutes or so, out pilot Brian came out and led us to the plane (with a pre flight picture). Plane holds max of 6 passengers, but since I'm 6'4" I had to (got to) sit in the "copilot" seat (for let room). Takeoff was as smooth as could be, and we saw all of the sights (and doubled back on most so both sides of the plane could get perfect views/pictures). Brian was extremely knowledgeable, funny, and an even better pilot (warning us before any potential turbulence). Landing was even smoother than takeoff. I was worried that I would see less in the plane than I would in a helicopter, but we in fact saw much more, for much longer (cheapest helicopter tour I found was about $245/person, and I got the 60 minute flight and Smith's Luau for $199/person). In short, I recommend Air Ventures Hawaii/Kauai to anyone looking at a helicopter/air tour!

WOW! So fun! Harry our pilot was so great! What a great way to see the island! He made us feel very comfortable and at ease! Very knowledgeable about the island and he was extremely experienced! We had a blast! Thank you!!

What an awesome trip and awesome people thanks to Pua and Paul. Was a beautiful tour of the island by air. So worth the breathtaking views. Great tour guide by Paul. Enjoyed it better than the helicopter ride

This was the way to go...we 'upgraded' at the airport from the private Cesna trip to the open cockpit Red Baron biplane...thanks Jill! We flight attendants stick together!

Once in a life time experience...must do!

review_title: Biplane Ride We Will AZlways Remember
review_text: Don't even hesitate if you are considering a personal aerial experieince that will create memories to last a lifetime. From the minute we walked up, we were greeted by such warm and welcoming staff. Kevin our pilot was great and piloted us around the Island of Kauai which was spectacular. Why spend your money on a helicopter ride when you can have such a private, exhilerating, and rewarding experience such as riding in a biplane from the era of 1943. With Snoopy painted on the tail, we immediately took on the persona of a WWII figting ace. The open air cockpit was exhilerating. The cloth helmets, and goggles give it that special added touch. Thank you so much for allowing us this opportunity. We enjoyed it and look forward to a return trip.

We saved going onto an aerial tour of Kauai to the last few days of our trip.  Unfortunately, the weather didn't cooperate until our final day.  We had been in touch with some other tour agencies who couldn't seem to accommodate us.  When we called Air Ventures they made it happen and in a Biplane no less!.  The clouds had just cleared and the afternoon sunshine perfectly illuminated the Ne Pali Coast.  Harry was a most excellent pilot.  The owners were present prior to and after our flight and they were very helpful and accommodating.  I would highly recommend this aerial tour to anyone going to Kauai.

Since my hubby carries a little extra weight, we would have to pay for 3 tickets to ride the helicopter tours in Kauai. We discovered this plane tour and combined it with the shore tour and did both excursions for the cost of what friends paid for just a helicopter tour. The staff made you feel like family, everything ran right on schedule. Our pilot, Paul, made sure both sides of the plane had a chance to view the sights and provided a lot of great information as we flew over this beautiful island. We did the tour several days after having been on the island and after we had done the coast tour which really gave us a great perspective when Paul pointed out from the air the places we had already visited! Highly recommend this tour. Outstanding experience for the cost! Especially if you pack a little extra pounds as the weight restrictions are much more accommodating with the Air Ventures planes.

First time to the island and no better way to see it than flying. No better way flying than in a biplane!! Our pilot Harry was great, flew us to the Marriott where we circled a bunch of friends then off to see the island. The staff was great as well. Next time here, treat yourself to this ride of a lifetime. Hint, bring a camera with strap and a GoPro, we're going to 'have to' come back.

Booked a tour on the biplane for my wife's birthday and I'm so glad that I did, because it was the most amazing experience ever!!!!!!!!!
The staff were so friendly and they made us feel right at home. 
Pua was so helpful; she went above and beyond when she didn't have to. 
I would highly recommend booking a tour with air ventures hawaii, I promise you won't regret it!!! I definitely want to do the tour again in the future! :-)

Took a 70 minute flight with my two young daughters, the Gippsland GA8 (airvan) is a comfortable aircraft, each passenger has a bubble window suitable for photography, and cold bottled water is available throughout the flight. Guests were provided with headsets and could interact with the pilot at any time over the intercom. 
As the flight departed Lihue, our pilot Paul was quick to point out features such as Mount Waialeale, Wailua falls (Fantasy Island), the Kilohana Crater, Poipu Beach, along with the Kauai  Coffee plantation.   As we travelled along the black sands of Waimea (with the forbidden island of Nihau visible), we turned north for a spectacular tour of the Waimea Canyon and the many waterfalls along the way. One of the more thrilling moments of the tour is occurs when the jagged cathedral hilltops fall away to reveal the Napali coast, on this flight we were lucky enough to spot a couple of grey whales breaching. Our flight circled the Taro fields and waters of Hanalei Bay, where our pilot pointed out some of the homes of the wealthy and famous. We continued east toward Kilauea lighthouse and wildlife sanctuary prior to continuing south passing features such as the Sleeping Giant, Fern Grotto, and the Wailua River.
Our pilot's narrative was highly informative in terms of local island history, natural history, popular culture, geology, and current events. He also offered up some of his own opinions on great spots for surfing, snorkeling, and meal choices. I would highly recommend this flight as one of your first activities on Kauai as it provides not only a visual feast, but a brief yet thorough education on what sets the Garden Isle apart from the others.
Defiantly worth the experience. Loved seeing the Kauai coast as well as all the corn fields. Steve was a Jem took as all around and even to the lighthouse. Defiantly will return to do this again.

My wife and I loved this tour on 14 Jan 2015.  She had been with me on helicopter tours over Kauai in 1989 and in 1998: while I had a magnificent time on these tours, she battled fierce motion sickness both of those times.  This was the first time we had been back to Kauai since 1998.  We read great reviews of this airplane tour and decided to go for it.  Our pilot was marvelous.  He made both of us, particularly my wife, feel at ease.  He gave excellent insights about Kauai and was so helpful in pointing out numerous features of the island from our wonderful vantage point.  Flying into Waimea Canyon was awesome, and getting to see the Na Pali coast in a different way from what we had seen via helicopter was great.  We were impressed with the professionalism, friendliness and hospitality of everyone, most especially our pilot.

Flight was great-we were able to view the entire island on this flight.Pilot gave a great commentary of the sights Flight was smooth and quiet.Viewing  KAUAI from above let us plan the rest of our stay on the island.
Awesome flight,liked it better than a helicopter.Pilot was very knowledgeable great sights, highly recommend.

This tour allows you the time to savor the island.  Very professional yet friendly staff helps to make the tour comfortable from sign-up to take-off and landing.  This tour allows you to enjoy more of the diversity of the island  because of the slower speed of the prop aircraft.
The pilot was very informed and strove to make our trip enjoyable and informative.  Would definitely recommend this tour.

review_title: Good way to see the island
review_text: We took the flight and I realized that I should have done this the first day of our vacation.  We waited a week for our relatives and they got the benefit of the overview that would have helped us during our first week.  The staff are very helpful and courteous.  The ride was good for a small plane and the views were spectacular.  My only quibble was my window (left rear seat) was slightly crazed and, when the sun struck it, my pictures suffered.
Kauai é tão impressionantemente lindo que sobrevoar é quase obrigatório. Cada paisagem absurdamente bonita. Vale cada centavo.

Having done a couple of helicopter tours before we would take the Red Baron biplane again in a second.  Slower speed makes for much better views of the island of Kauai.  If you love flying, this is a must do!!

Staff was excellent, also!

Our pilot Brian was extremely knowledgeable and had a quick wit. I had some time to kill before the rest of my group flew in to The Islands, so I decided to visit Air Ventures. The tour was gorgeous; however; Brian's charming and fun personality really made the event well worth it! I highly recommend booking a tour with Air Ventures! You will have a great time solo or with family/friends and you'll learn a lot too!

review_title: U have to fly its awesome and safe!!!
review_text: The best way to see the gorgeous island and also the only way to see the most beautiful areas. It is safe not too bumpy and loud like helicopters. I would recommend this tour to anyone who wants to see the entire beautiful island while learning of the culture and history. The pilots are knowledgable, friendly and professional!!

Our Pilot and his staff were very friendly and made us feel very comfortable.  If you want to see Kauai in all it's glory.... you must see it from the sky.   Our pilot was very knowledgeable about Island history and answered our questions well.  I would definitely recommend this company to a friend.

We had a wonderful trip with our knowledgeable pilot Harry.  We were upgraded to a private plane for our trip around and over the island.  Sites were breathtaking!  There is no other way to see Kauai!  The staff and owners were personable, accomodating.

review_title: The quickest and best way to see all of Kauai's beauty!
review_text: We had a great experience with the air tour.  Eric, our pilot, made us feel at ease right away, and we had a lovely trip.  He spent a little extra time circling a couple of whales we saw in the ocean, and we got as close as we dared to go to the beautiful cliffs and scenery.

This was a fun tour and one of the few ways you'll get to experience the Wimean Canyon and Nepali coast since most of it isn't accessible by car.  Our pilot was very knowledgeable and professional.  The only drawback is take precautions if you are prone to motion sickness.  The plane is small (holds 6 passengers) and loud.  It's not like flying on  747!  The staff and owners are very friendly and accommodating.  The views are spectacular and well worth it..

We stayed at the Grand Hyatt, and the first day I saw this Red Bi-Plane fly over. We had planned on touring the island by helicopter.  With the set-up of my wife and I being able to have a private tour....that was the ultimate. My wife was a little tentative at first, but after we took off, we both were totally hooked.  The open cockpit, being able to maneuver the plane to see the best of the island and seeing the giant whales was the highlights of the trip.  Our pilot was awesome and we were even able to fly over his house and wave ALOHA to his wife.  We will do this trip again on day one when we return to Kauai.  And my wife wanted more of the Aerobatics.  Thank You so much to the entire staff at Air Ventures Hawaii.

review_title: CAN'T BEAT HARRY AND THE SNOOPY 3!
review_text: My wife and I went on the Biplane tour with Pilot Harry and it was just awesome! What a perfect flight, beautiful weather, outrageous scenery! This was a nice smooth flight (warm too because you sit right behind engine) and Harry isn't one of those Pilots that feel they need to do a stand-up routine for the entire flight. I would highly recommend this company and flight. We paid twice as much for helicopter tour of Big Island and wasn't half as cool. If you want you can even wear the leather helmet but we opted for just headphones. You think it would be windy but as long as you keep hands and head behind windshield it's not. Don't miss this, highlight of our trip.

A spectacular biplane flight with our pilot.  We had a perfect day with no clouds and light winds so could go anywhere on the island.  The cockpit is a bit tight but manageable.  The only thing to look out for is it is a little difficult to take photos with the airstream rushing by, and your camera will probably focus on the nearby wing struts rather than the ground below.  But if you like tail-draggers it's worth the price.

My family group of 6 was able to crowd into one of the Air Van flights along with the pilot.  We got our own private tour of Kaui.  It was beautiful.

The pilot was very seasoned, and knowledgeable, and it was fun to "co-pilot" the small plane from the Lihue airport.

We'd found a coupon from a free DVD from them, and while they didn't have any that day, we were able to pick one up a couple days later.

The staff was friendly and pilot good, and the scenery breathtaking.  In many cases the pilot would fly up one way, and then turn around and fly back the other, to give passengers on both side of the plane a view.  However, the viewing can be difficult from rear seats, as the pilot was so close to the sights, and the view down can be tricky.

The landing was great and we had an awesome time, and everyone in our party, young and old, loved the views and commentary.

I can recommend this trip, particularly if you're running into the weight limits of helicopter tours.

And, they even took a photo of our group and emailed it to us for free after!
Beautiful way to see the island.  Great customer service by the young lady at the desk.  Plane ride was awesome.
The pilot was great, very friendly. The view was amazing and well worth every penny. I would recommend Air Ventures to anyone looking for a way to see the island from above.

Kauai is incredible from the air!  Harry, our pilot, gave us a spectacular tour of The island. We went down Waimea canyon, wove through the Na'pali coast and circled back around many of the dozens of waterfalls we came upon. Our bonus round of aerobatics was especially fun and it gave us a taste of barnstorming that left us wanting more. Harry's knowledge of the island, including local hideaways and great hiking ideas added to our list of things to do here.  We enjoyed this tour more than the helicopter tour.

I purchased tickets for a biplane ride for my parents' 40th anniversary. I happened to make a HUGE error and booked their trip for May and not March as I intended. Despite us showing up on the wrong day they were able to get a pilot and plane set up for my parents! Everyone was an absolute delight, friendly, funny, and so very accommodating. Despite my terrible mistake, all was worked out to the best of their abilities/resources and my parents had an absolute blast. 
HIGHLY recommend based off of the fabulous customer service!

A must during your visit Kauai. We took the air van and had a fantastic time seeing all of the sights. Lots of room for everyone and great communication and narration from our pilot. We booked at the last minute but I suggest you book well in advance. Be sure to bring a camera because you will be able to take once in a lifetime shots.
The pilot  made us feel very safe before and under the trip. He told  us a lot and managed to fly, so everybody  could see. We really had a great time . Thanks from Denmark.

both victoria and I had an absolute phenomenal ride our pilot Harry was just absolutely amazing with his knowledge for our island and super awesome showing us the sights, even though victoria lost her phone while taking pictures of the spectacular sights! some things are worth more than pictures!

  one thing I would love to add if the company had GoPros to rent that would be an outstanding thing thank God my GoPro didn't rip out of my hands! other than that it was an awesome trip something to cherish for a lifetime thank you very much much mahalos!

Great views at a fraction of the cost of the helicopter. Our pilot was easy going and informative very conversational. the girl who works in the office is the hardest working girl we've ever seen. always smiling, running from task to task, making sure each and every person feel special. you can't go wrong with this tour.
We were very pleased with the commentary (history and attractions) by the pilot and the circling around so both side of the plane could see the attractions:  waterfall, shore, canyons, etc.

Three of us went on the tour on Mar 16. We got there early and were warmly greeted and told we could leave early. Our pilot was very knowledgeable of the air and went to great lengths to make sure we saw all the sights. While up there we saw a shark eating a baby whale and then later saw 4 big whales and one baby whale. I would suggest anyone looking for a great experience at a reasonable cost this is the one to choose. Great company!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Booked air land and river through Bestof Kauai- had issue with  that but pilot  Eric was layed back and assuring during 60+ minute flight. Saw a few whales and the terrrain is s worth every cent.

Hace unos días mi marido, mi hija y yo realizamos un tour en avioneta por la isla de Kauai con Air Ventures (The Big Kahuna), y simplemente nos encantó. Es una manera asequible de poder disfrutar de las maravillas de Kauai desde el aire, y teniendo en cuenta que sólo una pequeña parte de la isla es accesible por carretera, se lo recomiendo a todo el mundo. Creo que es especialmente interesante poder realizar este tour en avioneta después de haber visitado la isla en coche, y poder así reconocer desde el aire los lugares ya visitados, y verlos desde una perspectiva totalmente diferente. 
Air Ventures me pareció una compañía seria. Salimos en el horario previsto y la duración fue la estipulada. La chica que nos atendió a nuestra llegada al aeropuerto era muy simpática, y el piloto también fue muy agradable y divertido, y nos estuvo dando explicaciones sobre la isla durante todo el recorrido.
Además, nos hicimos una foto antes del vuelo los 6 pasajeros (7 con mi hija) con el piloto delante de la avioneta y nos la mandaron enseguida al correo electrónico, y al finalizar el vuelo nos dieron un DVD con el recorrido de la avioneta por la isla (no puedo decir qué tal es porque aún no lo he visto).
Para aquellas personas que estén dudando si realizar este tour en avioneta con niños pequeños, he de decirles que nosotros lo hicimos con una niña de casi 2 años, que a pesar de haberse levantado de la cama poco antes de coger la avioneta, se durmió a los pocos minutos de empezar el vuelo. Y según nos comentó el piloto, es lo normal. 
El espacio en la avioneta es amplio y nosotros estuvimos muy cómodos en todo momento.
Por último, comentar que nosotros nos decidimos por Air Ventures ya que varias personas recomendaban esta compañía en un foro sobre viajes, y no quedamos defraudados. Desde luego, repetiríamos.

My husband and I just finished a private tour with Air Ventures and we both had a great time!

Our pilot Eric was really friendly, had tons of knowledge about the Island and gave us tons of rerecommendations about what we could do during our stay.

The sights and views were stunning! And it allowed us to see things that we wouldn't be able to see otherwise...we even spotted some whales which we're swimming on the surface.

I would highly recommend this to travelers!

Thanks again!!!!

review_title: A must do in Kauai.  Half the price of a helicopter tour!
review_text: What a cool experience!  If you are like me and have sticker shock on the helicopter tour price tag,  then you'll love this.   Very professional operation but fun at the same time.  The tour was the perfect length and the pilot was a wealth of knowledge.  Would highly recommend.  To quote a guide book I was reading,  not doing an air tour "is like visiting the Sistine Chapel and never looking up".

Air Ventures put on an excellent flight this morning. I am highly impressed with the pilot as well as the awesome flight pattern of the island. We were blessed with a clear day and our pilot took advantage of it, showing us everything that is beautiful to Kauai. An A+ tour!

Recommended by friends we decided not to do a helicopter tour but board a plane to see Kauai and get the best overview.
What a decision, we enjoyed every minute of the flight with Air Ventures Hawaii!
The extremely friendly personnel recommended going on an early morning flight and the weather was just great this particular morning. The Napali coast might be brighter in the evening sun, but at that time are more clouds also.
Our pilot Brian was just great, calm, experienced and knowledgeable. He showed us all highlights and the great nature of Kauai, if necessary with a right turn following a left turn of the plain. We were able to see every corner of the island, many well-known beaches, a lot of waterfalls and the impressive mountains and valleys.
We felt safe and comfortable throughout the 70 min flight and we would like to recommend to all interested tourists doing the same and learn so much more about this beautiful Hawaiian island.

Brian was an awesome pilot and guide and covered all major areas of the island with excellent commentary. I ended up going with AirVentures because they were part of the combo tour provided by Best of Hawaii and I wasn't disappointed.  Visibility from inside the plane was great, headphones and music were nice, and my window seat was excellent! I feel airplanes are safer than helicopters if there are certain problems but if you want to get closer into the valleys of The Na Pali coast, helicopters are the way to go as I watched them from much further away as we were over the water.

This trip was truly awesome. Our pilot Paul was very knowledgeable about all places on the Island, he was great. We seen the beautiful NaPali coast and the jagged mountains to Waimea Canyon, Hanalei Bay and we flew through Mt. Waialeale the wettest place on earth!. This is such a beautiful, magical place with so many waterfalls, WOW is all I can say. Everybody gets a window seat, you can't beat that and the price was very reasonable. I would highly recommend this flight. Maholo

BEST ATTRACTION on Kauai.. I highly recommend this flight service if you are really looking to see Kauai. The staff are awesome and the view is unbelievable. If you only take one excursion while on Kauai, I would highly suggest AIR VENTURES. As a pilot for over 40 years, I can say, It may be the BEST hour long trip you will ever find, and will always remember. THANKS guys..

The service is fantastic, greeted by friendly staff upon arrival. The pilot was well versed on the natural history of the island as well as the settlement on the island of Kauai. 

The mountain ranges ore gorgeous and is most definitely a worth while trip. Nothing was rushed and had well over an hour of flight time on a 70 minute tour which is supposed to include boarding, and taxi of the aircraf.  

We would happily go again and recommend Air Ventures to our friends. You will not regret it!!

review_title: The staff was amazing and Brian, the pilot was wonderful.
review_text: I highly recommend this service. The flight was great!!! The pilot, Brian was extremely nice and very knowledgeable of the island.

review_title: Highlight of our trip to Kauai
review_text:
From the moment we taxied down the runway I felt comfortable and safe in the 6 seater fixed wing plane, as I am quite nervous about flying.
The 60 mins just flew by as we soared like a bird over the rugged mountain ranges of Kauai, it was magic. We love Kauai, but this flight added a new dimension to the way we viewed it.
Although we were way above the helicopters, which were able to fly in close to the waterfalls and mountain faces, we had a fantastic view of the escarpment on the Napali coastline, the waterfalls in the Waimea valley and beautiful clear blue water of the ocean. The commentary along the way was so informative, I learned so much about the island.

 I loved it so much, it was reasonably priced, and I would definitely do it again.
Thankyou so much to the staff of Air Ventures for making our trip enjoyable.
Sheila Miller

The Air Ventures plane tour was amazing & the staff was the best! The staff was so friendly & the pilot was funny & made our tour fun & informative. My husband also got motion sickness horribly bad & the pilot & staff were very caring & accommodating to him & our family of 5. I would recommend this tour over the helicopter tours I have been on in the past & recommend this company because of there incredible staff!! A+++

review_title: The best way to see Kauai
review_text: Bryan led us on a once in a lifetime ride over the island. He was extremely thorough and considerate of those sitting on both the left and right side of the plane. I have been to Kauai before but only after this airplane tour do I feel like I know Kauai. I highly recommend it!!

My family and I had an AMAZING flight and overall experience .We took the most breathtaking pictures and saw parts of the island you can only see in a plane. The pilot was very personable and educated us on the history of the island. This is a must see for anyone visiting Kauai, worth every penny. ALOHA

My family and I had a wonderful flight around the island. the captain was really great and personable. This was my husband and my second trip on Air Ventures and it will not be our last. Looking forward to our next one.

Our trip was family of 5 adults but that option isn't available below
Si están pensando visitar Hawai'i les recomiendo la isla de kauai en la que air ventures te da un magnífico vuelo por toda la isla jardín la atención que te dan es la mejor altamente recomendado

My husband and I did the bi-plane tour with Pilot Paul. This is a great tour for people who have been to Kauai many times and would like something different to do as well as for those who are adventurous. It is not, however, for the faint of heart. I love small planes but the open cockpit was rather uncomfortable for me. My husband loved it and would do it again; for me, it was a once-in-a-lifetime experience. It was quite windy the day we went and since the bi-plane is so light, we were bounced around pretty good. The pilot did a couple of hammerhead stalls which were like being on a roller coaster. If you love roller coasters, you'll love this. Unfortunately, I hate them! The highlight of the trip was seeing two whales breach below us. Paul circled several times when he spotted them and we couldn't believe it when two of them came out of the water at the same time. This is not a good trip for taking photos. I wish I had given the camera to my husband because he's much taller and sat up over the side of the plane and could have taken pictures. I was too terrified to sit up and lean over to do that and I couldn't get the camera strap from around my neck (because of the headphones) once we were in the air. 

My husband id 6'5" and had plenty of leg room. It is the width of the plane that could cause problems. Neither of us are overweight but because my husband is a big guy, we were quite snug in the seat. Getting in and out of the plane is a challenge, even more so for the second person in who will also be the first person out. Two large people definitely would not fit in the seat.

Paul's commentary during the tour was very informative. This was our fourth trip to Kauai; we always enjoy learning new facts about the island as well as refreshing our memory about things we learned on previous trips.

If you like adventures, by all means take this tour. Just be aware that it is not for everyone.

Great flight. The pilot was very informative of all the area, saw several waterfalls ,which I enjoyed coffee fields,Waimea canyon( like the grand canyon)beautiful shorelines rain forests a trip I will never forget.

Our party of four booked this excursion after reading glowing reports on tripadvisor.  It was easy to arrange and we met our shuttle at the ABC store at Anchor Cove Shopping mall which took us to the airport.  We then were weighed in and waited a short time for our plane to arrive.  When it was time to board we were given safety instructions and shown how to use the head phones.  Our pilot was "Brian".  We then took off into a beautiful clear blue sky.  The views were magnificent. He took us all over the island (Waimea Canyon, Waita Reservoir, Napali Coast, beautiful coastal golf courses Lumahai Beach, waterfalls, whales in the ocean etc.  It was endless beauty. Brian gave us interesting comentary throughout.  Honestly, I had the best time.  The small aircraft was smooth and quiet and I felt very safe at all times.  I would highly recommend this excursion to everyone. All the people involved were so friendly and welcoming.

review_title: Great views and learned a lot
review_text: Captain Paul rocked! He has a dry sense of humor which made for a fun trip. He took us over all the big sights and was informative, but kept the chatter to a minimum. I appreciated that because sometimes guides tend to ramble on. He did two passes on most sights allowing both sides of the plan great views. I was positioned behind him (pilot) which is the worst seat based on the wings and flight pattern. However, I had a fairly unabscured view and was comfortable enough for an hour flight. My wife had the best seat (3rd row behind co-pilot).

Air Ventures provides an outstanding view of Kauai. We flew in a single-wing plane and felt confidence in the competence of our pilot (Paul). While helicopters get you close to the action, sometimes it is too close. The hour-long flight took us around the entire island as well as across the island to areas inaccessible to all except hikers. Because we booked on-line Air Ventures provided us with a free CD, which was a nice and completely unexpected surprise. The plane used much less fuel than a helicopter and thus was also much cheaper than a helicopter would have been.  Air Ventures was also willing to pick us up at the port and return us at no extra charge.

This being our umpteenth visit to Kauai, I was looking for a little different way to spend part of our day visit. (came in by cruise ship) We have helicoptered, sail planed, driven, kayaked, snorkeled, zip lined etc. the islands but we had not done a biplane tour....well!!....that was it.
Pre-booked before leaving US. Then the fun started. Our ship made several itinerary and time ashore changes after booking this tour and I ended up changing my reservation several times, with the last change the morning of the tour! 
Air venture phone contact each time was truly the Aloha spirit! Made changes, adjusted times and did it all with a smile! An A+ for customer service and then another A+ for the actual biplane flight.
A different perspective of Kauai from an open air cockpit....could've worn leather helmet and goggles but it was too warm, so just took the picture of me wearing them.
Great value....smooth ride.....professional operation. Easy to find at Lihue private interisland terminal. Highly recommend.

Air ventures worked with us wonderfully as we had to change our schedule 3 times!  In additon our boat arrived on Kauai 2 hours late and they waited for us. We then had a great trp with Brian!  We have been on 7 cruises and taken many tours and this was our favotite of all!  Highly recommended!

review_title: Truely a Highlight of da Garden Island...
review_text:
I highly Recommend doing the private tour to see all the hidden & fabulous views of Kauai. Our pilot's name was Harry & he was the the greatest, full of information,sense of humor & felt like we known him for years. The ride was very comfortable & smooth from take off to the return landing. Flying with Air Ventures is truely a remarkable lifetime memory you won't forget. 
I also wanted to thank you Harry for this lifetime memory & we will see U again soon. 
Mahalo,  
Greg & Lisa M

We must have been on the same flight as one of your other reviewers.  We had to wait for a bit to wait for the cruise ship couple and the young lady at the desk told us about a lovely place at the end of the road (about a mile away) where we could enjoy the scenery and ocean.  Not only did we love the view but there were sea turtles swimming right near by.  As for the flight, Brian was a wonderful and informative pilot but he was also excellent in his ability.  It was a smooth ride and for the bumpy places, he warned us ahead of time, we hardly felt the landing!  It was a gorgeous day with high clouds, high enough we could fly under them and see the whole island.  Brian was considerate and turned the plane each time so the right and left side of the plane could see the sights. We were treated with Aloha at all times.  We had a two for one certificate from the Entertainment Book and had no problem what-so-ever using it.

We just returned from Hawaii and this was the hi-lite of our trip.  The people were really great and the flight was awesome.  It was a perfect day and Paul, our pilot, did a fantastic job both flying the plane and narrating.  I am a pilot myself and really appreciated Paul's piloting ability.  I highly recommend!  By the way, my wife and I are 66 years of age and are somewhat limited in mobility.  They did a great job and we could not be more satisfied.  This was far better than the more expensive helicopter rides we have experienced by other vendors in the past.

review_title: In the Air Review of Kauai
review_text: Had a great time with Brian as the pilot.  This is the best way to see the island because so much is inaccessible from the road.  The company really goes out of the way to make your trip special.  The cruise boat was late in docking so they asked if we would mind waiting for 20 minutes to allow the "cruisers" to make it.  Well, they made it & we got more then an hour of air time to make up for being delayed.  Good employees & get event.

Took to the air with Air Ventures for a flight around Kauai. Comfortable modern plane, great pilot and great weather. Managed to see whales off shore , as well as great views of this lovely island. What a backyard to have to show off to visitors. Thanks to the staff at Air Ventures for a great trip.

We opted for this flight in lieu of a helicopter for something different & really enjoyed it. Brian was fantastic, great pilot, personable, knowledgable and a funny! Learned a lot about the island and saw some beautiful sights. Thanks for a great trip!

Wow. I've always wanted to fly in an open cockpit and this didn't disappoint!   Without doubt this is one of the very best things you can do in the islands.  Spectacular scenery and the thrill of a Waco biplane.  It also felt really safe, even going one of Harry's "fun turns".  I'd do it again tomorrow if I could.
Loved the air tour however I did have to use my Aloha bag after a few trips down to see the whales and the turbulence over the mountains. Even though I got a little sick I would do it again.

review_title: A breathtaking, awesome way to see the most beautiful place on earth!
review_text: This was something we finally did and were so pleased we did.  The whole experience was just awesome.  Thank you!
Don't be afraid to do this. This is one of my favourite tours ever. The captain was very professional and gave interesting information while we were on the plane.

review_title: Great way to see the island
review_text: It was a beautiful, clear day and a perfect day for a flight over Kauai.  Our pilot, Harry, was great.  He knew the land, history and trivia of the island.  Harry told us there are only about 15 days of the year to be so clear over whole island.  We had a fun time, great memories and pictures.

review_title: Bird's-Eye View of the Garden Island
review_text: Our pilot, Brian, gave a great narrative to go along with our flight. It was a beautiful day and we were able to see and photograph all the wondrous sites we'd heard and read about.

On the day we took the tour, the weather was perfect for flying in a small airplane. We never experienced any bumps during the flight. It was FANTASTIC! Our pilot was friendly and knowledgeable on the history of the island and very engaging. He took us on a narrated tour to view the whole island. The Waimea canyon view is AMAZING! We got to view a lot of the waterfalls that are inaccessible by foot and can only be seen from above. The view of the Napali coast was breathtaking! Our pilot is playful as well. He did a plane maneuver stunt that kind of felt like we were riding on a roller coaster. That was awesome! Overall, Kauai is the best; what a beautiful island! If we have to go back to this place, I would definitely go on an island tour again with this company. They are very friendly and very accommodating. This was the highlight of our vacation in Kauai. Our pilot was awesome!

The flight around the island was great.  The views were fantastic.  The narration was god but just pointed things out without too much history of things or other facts.  It was definitely worth the ride just for the view

The weather was "off and on rain" - so we weren't sure how it would turn out.  It was AMAZING!  Pilot was really engaging - and he was able to navigate around the weather to make it 10+++ !  The Island was goregous - we saw the outer edges of the island all the way around (the landscape changes dramtatically), plus some of the canyons and famous waterfalls! It is a highlight of our vacation!!!

Air  ventures was a  great  way to see the island  with the whole family. 
easy booking,  friendly  service,  accommodating  schedule.
Our pilot was FANTASTIC! Highlight of our trip. Would recommend doing it at the beginning if vacation. Kauai is so beautiful! Thanks for the great flight!

Pua did a great of getting our flights booked.  Paul did a great job of not only piloting our plane, but he was very knowledgeable when pointing out the native history of the island and areas of interest while narrating the flight.

It was safe and also informative. Pilot Brian was friendly and took good care of us. It is an understatement to call Kauai beautiful because it is much more than that. Thanks to air ventures for giving an aerial view of the place.
These people are excellent at the tour they give do not hesitate to book with them!!!! They show all the areas of Kauai that are impossible to see from the ground. Also very well narrated.

So... we booked out biplane flight two weeks in advance. In the contact info we had a Canadian phone number and the Hotel we stayed in Kauai. When we arrived to the airport the lady in the counter assured they tried to call us, and that the biplane was in maintenance since a couple of weeks ago. They did not call us to say that the biplane was not available, and they did not apologize. Once in Canada we saw one missed call an hour before the flight was supposed to happen. We had stated in the booking information to contact in the hotel during those  day. And really they should have not sent a confirmation email about the flight if the flight was not available.
They do have a policy that if you do not show up for your flight they would reimburse your payment, So.... is this reason why they did not really try to contact us???

review_title: No experience with the tour due to Mother Nature, but the customer service is EXCELLENT!
review_text:
I was referred to this company by another that I had tried to book but they were full. I looked on their website first and found a GREAT deal, and called for more information. I spoke with Pua, and she really is a shining star for that company! She was really helpful, kind, overflowing with aloha, and wonderful to talk to in general. She answered all of my questions (I was concerned about weight limits because my other half and I are bigger folks) and somehow got us even more excited about the trip. When we booked, she asked how much we each weighed and assured us it was only for the pilot’s information to maintain safety and balance on the aircraft. It was not an issue in the least, which was another reason we went with them. Though there was some confusion about a transportation issue, because I saw it on the website she graciously and immediately honored it. Turns out they’d recently changed the special on the website and she hadn’t heard about it yet, but she even called me back after booking to thank me for bringing it to her attention. 

The day before our trip, she called me to confirm. I always appreciate when a company calls me to confirm things. She noted how I sounded less stressed than the last time she’d spoken to me. She was right – when I’d spoken to her to book I was very stressed trying to organize a (long-awaited) vacation and finish things up at home, and when I spoke to her I’d just finished getting a massage after a week aboard a cruise ship. 

The day of the tour, we did have a delay in getting picked up from the meeting spot (an unknown delay with the shuttle driver) but we called Pua and she was on it. It was raining, which we expected since it’s Kauai, but when we did get a ride to the airport, Pua informed us (with an obviously heavy heart) that because of the storm, the flight had just been cancelled prior to our arrival at the airport. The weather conditions made flying not only dangerous but impractical since we wouldn’t be able to see anything anyway. She felt really bad about it and offered alternative activities and offered to find us a rental car, give us a ride to the Fern Grotto, or back to the pickup point, she found a map of the island and showed us where we could find really beautiful, interesting things. On an island where the mountains are the main attraction, we were impressed with her recommendations for finding ground-level attractions.  
She left us to discuss and decide what we wanted to do, and was incredibly sympathetic to our plight. We were on a cruise and only had a few hours on the island. We hadn’t researched anything else because we’d found the tour early on in our planning and gone with it. Should we have had a contingency plan? Probably. But hindsight is 20/20. We decided to make the best of the situation anyway. Pua took pictures of us with the headsets on against the backdrop of the rainy mountain (what you could see of it, which wasn’t much), and all in all made our visit with her well worth our time.

In the end we decided against renting a car or going to the Fern Grotto on our own, and went back to the pickup point, which was a set of shops. We went behind the shops and found a great little bay that we practically had to ourselves. It was very nice.
If we ever find ourselves going to Kauai again, without hesitation we will DEFINITELY book this trip again, if for no other reason than Pua’s customer service was so excellent that it made “return” customers of us!

Great guide/pilot.  We left and toured Kauai for over 1.5 hours with literally birds' eye view of the great sites of Kauai.  Water fall, coast line, historical tid bits and beautiful geography.  Very very smooth plane ride and trip of a life time.  Thank you air ventures!

review_title: Bring a heavy camera for the biplane!
review_text:
I knew there was a lot to see in Kauai and much of it is not accessible by car so I wanted to book a trip to view it all from the air. I stumbled upon the biplane tour and was sold. How cool to get to fly in a biplane! Even better we got to see so much of Kauai from the air and it was just the two of us! Since the plane is so small it just fits 2 passengers and the pilot so no jostling people you don't know for a better view and no chance of getting stuck in the middle or back! The price was reasonable too. 

It rained quite a bit yesterday and my weather app predicted more rain today so I was a bit worried we wouldn't have a good ride but I was wrong! The weather cleared up just before take off and because of all the rain yesterday we were able to see waterfalls that are dry most of the year! The tour started with a view of the southern coast and worked out way around the island counter clockwise. Our pilot was super laid back and wanted to make sure we had a good show. Minutes after take off he spotted some whales off the coast and deviated from his original path to circle around so we could get a better view! I was worried we'd miss the whales while we were here but I saw them! We flew over all of the major sites, the lush green valleys, the canyons, the Na Pali coast and everything in between! We saw the Jurassic water fall (along with about 50 other waterfalls throughout the flight) and plenty of rainbows. The cool thing about rainbows from the air is that they form full circles! 

They offer the option to attach your gopro camera to the plane wing, do it, even though it costs a little extra! I was on the fence about it but ended up paying for the service and I'm glad I did. I would have pooped my pants worrying about filming from the plane, the wind is super powerful and I felt like it was going to rip my little point and shoot from my hands the whole time! If you bring a camera tape it to your hands or bring something with weight! The view from the gopro on the wing is much better too. There are lots of wing parts in the way of you try to take photos from the plane. My husband had a big camera, I haven't seen his photos yet but I know my photos have lots of wing struts in them. 

Overall this is probably the best thing we've done in Hawaii. If you're going to take a plane ride over Kauai take the biplane tour!

My family met on Kauai for two weeks in December (2014)- the weather was quite good and we were able to take a joint trip with Air Venture from Lihue and the sunset dinner cruise out of Port Allen. We scheduled our execursions on two separate days at AV recommendations, in case anyone was sensitive to motion sickness- I would strongly advise the same. Our daughter was sensitive, but still enjoyed the flight. The pilots are knowledgeable and professional and considerate too. I would highly recommend the Air Ventures aerial tour and sunset dinner cruise combination- @ $209 pp it was a better deal than most other helicopter tours and dinner cruises.
This is one of the best experiences Kauai has to offer.  Great staff and wonderful views!!!  Beats helicopter rides all the way!!!

We nailed the weather for our flight over Kauai with our pilot Brian.  We were able to fly over and fully see Mount Waialeale which was very exciting for all of us including Brian.  He was a great tour guide and really wanted to give us the best experience.  We had car toured, hiked and beached it many days prior to our flight so it was really cool to see those same sights from a different vantage point.  Kauai is so beautiful to see from the air and the airplane experienced was very comfortable and met our needs.  We were in the air about an hour.  We also got a DVD about the island because we booked our experience online.  It is a great DVD & memento of our trip.

I took the air van tour and was very impressed.  The price was lower than the helicopter tours (look out for coupons at your hotel for an even better deal) and did not induce air sickness for me!  I have taken a helicopter tour before and though they can get lower to the ground for some neat views, I was nauseous the whole time.  The tour guide was very informative and I received a free DVD that was much longer and informative than I thought it would be... it was actually produced rather than just recording the view during a tour.

review_title: A bucket list trip in Kauai!!!
review_text: We made a last minute descision to do this and the price was right! Called at 8am and flying by 10am, they picked us up and dropped us off at the ABC store with no problems. Brian was our pilot and was extremely thorough and knowledgeable throughout the tour. Definitely want to go back and experience Kauai again based on this tour. Bucket list trip done!

We had a flight that experienced an extreme weather condition and Air Ventures went out of their way to ensure we had the full experience. They booked us for free the next day. Brian, our pilot was amazingly knowledgeable. Customer service is excellent. We saw so many awesomely beautiful sights. Thank you Air Adventures!!! Mahalo.

review_title: One thing to do in Kauai
review_text: We traveled on the biplane tour on December 11 inquiry. The trip was simply outstanding. They company and all its personnel were great to deal with and the views from the biplane were phenomenal.

We really enjoyed the flight around the Island.  We would never have benbeen able to so the island like we did and the weather was perfect.  Brian was very informative and fun to be with.  I had forgotten how close the quarters are in the single props.  I would love to stay up for a long time, so peaceful and beautiful.  Thankyou a lot for the flight and the history, Brian.

The only thing we regret about taking this tour is not taking this tour on our first day in Kauai.  Our pilot/guide Brian gave an outstanding tour full of information only a native would have insight into.  We feel like if we would've taken this tour early on in our stay in Kauai we could have seen exactly the spots to see and have a better understanding of the layout of the land.
For those with fears of small planes/helicopters or weak stomachs, this is a great alternative to see the island from above.  Also, very comfortable flight for those bigger fellas.
Go-Pro users - bring your GoPro along and have them mount it to the wing - the video captured from the outside on the wing goes unmatched to anything else we shot while in Hawaii.  It is well worth the $20 surcharge.

review_title: Very nice but very old plane
review_text: We did the private tour it was amazing but the plane seemed very old and junky. Pilot was knowledgeable and friendly with his guided detailed tour but every time the wind blew we felt the plane was going to crash. They need a new plane!

review_title: Fly over Kauai with the best!
review_text: This flight was amazing and covered all the topics we were interested in.  We saw so many beautiful places.  Before boarding, everyone had a nice fruit snack .  Our pilot, Eric, I think that was it, did a great job narrating and answering questions.  I loved that it was pretty quiet, helicopters are really noisy.  This was a plane and you could see better.  Everyone had a window seat.  I liked seeing famous peoples houses from the air.  Highly recommend this company for pleasre and adventure.  We left the plane smiling!

Our plane trip was the highlight of our week in Kauai. As the island is so mountainous, most of it is inaccessible by land. Even if you hick the side of the island that has no road, you don't get the same perspective as flying over the crater and the canyon. The green canyon, numerous waterfalls and spectacular volcano are stunning. We had gone along the NaPali coast by boat a few days before but this was seeing the valleys and mountains from a far better perspective. Great commentary from a very knowledgable pilot. He circled over key points of interest so it didn't matter where you sat. Great value.

We didn't know we could do anything like this as we were here in Kauai for our 10 yr anniversary and we had our 4 and 1 yr old children with us. We met Bryan a pilot with air ventures. He sent us on a tour and I was a little nervous because its a small plane and I hate heights plus we had our kids too. As soon as we met our pilot Eric I felt comfortable and we hopped in the plane. We took off and began seeing the beauty of Kauai. The canyon was unbelievable. Eric kept making sure each person on our flight was okay throughout the flight. It was so cool seeing places from above that we saw earlier in the week by ground. Like the beach we renewed our vows on! Napali coast was beautiful. I highly recommend doing this tour. Even if you have lil kids. My kids both fell asleep during flight. The landing was perfect. Eric did a fantastic job keeping us informed of what he was doing during flight too. Like slowing down so we could catch photos of certain waterfalls. Not only did we love the tour but we made new friends. Thanks Bryan.

My husband talked me into doing this air tour.  I'm not the most adventurous person, and this seemed pretty adventurous to me.  I'll admit I was nervous, but after five minutes in the air I knew this would be a tour I'd never forget.  It was amazing having the wind in your hair and seeing all of the beautiful island.  How many people can say they've ridden in a biplane?  Our kids were impressed!

We really enjoyed this flight, it was just my husband and I with the pilot. The pilot was so knowledgeable and told us so many interesting things about the island. We felt like we knew so much about the island when we finished the flight! The flight was spectacular, I got so many good photos. I would definitely recommend this to anyone who wants to see the island. All of the spectacular sights are not visible from the road and can only be seen by flight. The helicopters we saw flying were flying so low it would have been hard to see the whole canyon/waterfalls/ Nepali coast line. We got such a good view from the plane. A must do if going to Kauai !!

Great service, really spectacular views. We went up in a rainy cloudy day but the experienced staff made sure that we would have great views and didnt waste our money or time. It's worth going for sure, take your Dramamine though as it can get a little bumpy!

It was very good although I wish I had had the front seat or the one right behind it. Too many of my pictures have either the underside of the wing or the strut in them. Some times I could not see what he was showing us on the right side. I felt bad for the gal on the left. I think she missed a lot not being able to see on the right side. Not sure if the helicopter would have been better or not for viewing or picture taking. But I will enjoy seeing the 100 pictures I did take.
I sat by the only window that was scratched and crystalized.  It affected my enjoyment and my ability to take pictures.  Jh

review_title: If you do nothing else, take this plane tour!
review_text: This was the highlight of our week in Kauai--my cousins, aunt and I brought my mother here to celebrate her 90th birthday, and we all agreed this plane trip was utterly spectacular. We had an overview of the entire island and the pilot narrated for us while we enjoyed the view and took photographs. We were up for 50 minutes, and saw magnificent views and understand why they call it "paradise." Our only complaint is that it was over too soon!

We chose this not wanting to go in a helicopter. For one thing, it's less expensive, and the plane uses much less fuel that a helicopter. We flew over most of the main areas. The pilot flew the areas twice to allow both sides of the plane to see. My only complaint was that my window had scratches that showed up in some pictures. If you have any air sickness concerns, take a dramamine. There will be some bumps.

review_title: Great Tour & Cheaper than helicopter tour
review_text:
When we were in Kauai, we wanted to do an air tour and researched our options beforehand. We looked at the helicopter tours but they were quite expensive. We found Air Ventures website and decided to give them a try. They were about half the price as a helicopter tour and we booked it with a river cruise and DVD. When we arrived in Kauai from the cruise ship, they came and picked us up from the port and dropped us off afterwards.

We had to do the usual check in (sign paperwork, get sighed, etc) and then we went to the plane. There were 4 of us total. I lucked out and got the front passenger seat next to the pilot. I was worried a bit about how rough a small plane ride would be as I am susceptible to a little motion sickness, but the pilot was great and it was smooth for the most part. Kauai is a beautiful and lush green island and it was great to see it from the air. The pilot showed us many waterfalls, showed us where a few films were shot and was very informative. He answered all of our questions and was very pleasant. We took so many pictures as we each had our own cameras. We would definitely recommend this tour as an alternative to a helicopter.

Unfortunately, it had been raining and the river was swollen and flowing extremely fast so that part of the tour was cancelled, but we were refunded that amount. 

Again, it was an amazing tour and I would recommend it. I actually was there in November 2013.

review_title: Left that Omen in the Clouds
review_text:
My husband and I said we would  NEVER fly in a small plane due to safety issues.  Well, there were two ways to see Kauai from the air, helicopter or a small plane which was operated with Air Ventures.  We decided on the plane.
