We set out from Princeville three hours ahead of time, wanted to do some additional sightseeing on the south end of the island.  We arrived at Air Venture around 2:20 for our 3pm flight.  When we arrived the young lady apologized because our flight was delayed an hour due to staffing issues.  The delay did  not pose a problem for us, we had some other things that we could do to fill the time.  The only problem it did cause, it made me think is this an omen?  We returned 10 minute before our schedule time and my husband attempted to check in.  This is where the real problem came into play, the young lady that had greeted us before was having a personal conversation with another worker from another vendor and continued her conversation for about 5-7 minutes while my husband stood there.  Then she turns around and says how over worked she had been that day and she had just cleared her desk.  My husband is not one to hold his tongue and told her she couldn’t have just cleared her desk because he had been standing there waiting while she was having a personal conversation that she had started before he walked in.  Of course by then he was ready to cancel the tour due to the delay and his wait to check in.  After we talked we decide to take the tour. 
 I did inform the pilot, I believe his name was John, of my fear of flying in a small plane.  He did insure me that I would enjoy my tour and he would take care of me.
First, the take off was smooth, beautifully executed.  I did not know we had left the ground, until I looked down.  The narrative was very good,  he pointed out many interesting towns and sites with explanation.  When he went over an area where he knew we would get turbulent winds he would let us know, so that we would be prepared.  I appreciated the preparation and it calmed my fears.  The landed was as smooth as the take off.  You could tell that John loved his job and took pride in what he did.  It was a great tour.  And that omen, I left it up in the clouds.  For our inconvenience (flight delay)  we were given a DVD of what we saw on the tour, it was a prerecorded DVD.  I am rating this tour a 4 and not a 5 because of the office person.  But, the tour and John our pilot were more than a 5.

My wife and I wanted something different than a helicopter flight. The trip was great. There where portions when you enter the clouds and experience rain. There wasn't enough to have made us change our minds. Both people fit in the front seat. It is very tight. I am 6'-2" and 230 lbs and it was tight but not to the point we didn't enjoy it. There isn't any crazy flying such as barrel rolls so there is no need to worry. The entire time we felt safe. Pictures from the air are tough. Once your camera gets outside the area the wind shield covers, the wind wants to take it out of your hands, so no pictures with a cell phone. The view was amazing. You get headsets so you can hear the pilot and talk back to him. Contrary to what the web site says there are no "Leather helmets and goggles" to wear. Would I do it again, Yes! My only suggestion is to make sure the weather is as nice as possible. Weather conditions are one way on the ground and another 2000 feet up so if it is overcast on the ground it will be rain up high.

user_location: Las Cruces, New Mexico, United States
review_text: My husband and I took a tour of Kauai on the biplane.  I have been to the island quite a few times and done many things, but I have to say this has been, by far, my favorite! I am scared of heights and worried that I would get motion sickness, but the plane ride was so smooth, it didn't bother me.  The sights were beautiful and the tour guide was entertaining and informative.  The cockpit where my husband and I sat was very comfortable.  The customer service was also amazing and very helpful.  We had a fantastic time and would strongly recommend!!!

We really enjoyed our aerial view of Kauai by biplane.  We had visited most of the island by car so was quite interesting seeing it by air. Paul was very informative. We felt very safe but also adventurous at the same time. We would highly recommend this tour .

We did a land, river, van and airplane ride tour. It lasted 8 hours, we booed  it through our Condo Timeshare @ Princeville, Wyndham Resorts, Shearwater.  Or tour guides name was Steve, and he was great!! We also went to a State Park and visited a  light house. Lunch was on your own. The Air Ventures Airplane Tour was part of the trip. We flew all over Kauai, and the beautiful Napoli Coastline.  idk the cost, but we saved 30% by booking through our resort. Wonderful trip...

review_title: Scout Your Kauai Agenda with this Breathtaking Trip
review_text:
AirVentures is a spectacular tour of the island.  I highly suggest scheduling it earlier during your visit to scout out all of the beaches, trails and sights you'd like to see during your stay.  Even if you're less active, this flight is a great way to get an intimate, birds eye view of the island. 

These small aircraft are really the way to go.  In case you have reservations about flying on large commercial jets, private planes are smooth, spacious and have vast windows giving you an unencumbered view of the island.  Even turbulence is negligible, and feels more buoyant like a boat --making the trip hugely entertaining. You'll be giggling like I did. 

Ask the receptionist to seat you on the right-side of the aircraft--the route traverses the island counter-clockwise, so most of the sights are best seen from the right-side. 

They're located at LiHue airport in a smaller terminal near the Heliport Landing.  There's ample free parking so you can practically drive up, check in and be in the air in 5 minutes.

Our bi-plane tour with Harry, our pilot, was nothing less than amazing. Being in the open air bi-plane allowed us to enjoy incredible vistas while still truly interacting with the outdoor environment. It was incredible to feel the mist on our faces as we flew through the gorgeous valleys of the Waimea Canyon and to smell the fresh ocean air as we cruised all around this beautiful island. We have thoroughly enjoyed our time in Kauai, but this trip was absolutely the highlight.

This is a must! The views from the plane were incredible! So much of the island is not visible by car or boat. The pilot and crew were extremely friendly. Ride had a few bumps from the weather but overall VERY smooth. Would still recommend motion sickness meds....I have a good stomach and rarely get motion sickness but felt a little nauseous at some points.

review_title: Thank you for the exciting view of the island!!
review_text: Our pilot Brian was very knowledgeable and personable.  We encountered a little weather but he handled it without incident and we had a very smooth take & landing.  The weather afforded a "backdoor" flight thru one of the valleys that led us directly to the ocean.  The affect was SPECTACLAR!!  I would recommend this economical Airbus tour.

So glad I checked trip advisor and found out this was The Number One rated thing to do in Kauai. It certainly was. The views of the scenery were unbelievable, only way to see the coast if by air or water and this was certainly the best option.

review_title: DIDNT BOTHER TO TELL US FLIGHT WAS CANCELLED !!!
review_text: WORST EXPERIENCE EVER !! We booked the Red Baron biplane at least 8 months in advance through a well known tour operator in Hawaii. On the day before we were to take the tour as a courtesy to us (we were on The Pride Of America cruise ship) the tour operator emailed the Red Baron biplane operator only to be informed our tour had already been cancelled but the operator of the biplane never bothered to email our tour operator to be told this. He said the plane was being serviced. Now I don't know about you but I do no that planes go in for service but have scheduled dates in advance for being serviced. Obviously the biplane operator knew this but not once did he bother to contact myself, or the tour operator. If she didn't email the day before, hubby and I would have been stuck in town waiting for a non existent tour. As it was we had to scramble with the cruise ship to get on a shore tour as almost everything was booked out. So we didn't end up seeing Kuaui by any airplane and it was meant to be our anniversary highlight. So thanks for nothing Red Barron and ruining our vist to Kuaui. If you had of emailed us as we booked over 6 months in advance, we could of booked through another company and had the opportunity to see Kuaui from the air. You know when your plane is scheduled for service and yet you didn't bother to contact us or the tour operator. Paying US $425 is a lot of money that took me weeks to save and you just flipped us off. I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS COMPANY AS THEY DON'T CARE WHO'S HOLIDAY THEY RUIN. If you had of emailed us a few weeks before hand, I could forgive you, but to leave us almost stranded is atrocious, shame on you for not caring and ruining your reputation, I will not be recommending you to any of our friends and family D ---------- ......

I had done this tour several years ago in a helicopter which was awesome so I was not expecting the fixed wing tour to be as good. WRONG !  The tour was great from the cold bottle of water prior to the flight, to the really informative narration, to the spotless large windows and the very smooth pilot. I am not exactly tiny Tim, the helicopters charge extra (half a seat extra) if your are over a certain weight which is understandable as they are more weight sensitive. Air Adventures with the Air Van do not as fixed wing aircraft are not as weight restrictive making them very affordable. On the tour the pilot made sure both sides of the aircraft equally shared the views by turning the aircraft several times enroute, nice touch.
I would highly recommend this company for your aerial tour, a very high percentage of Kauai can only be seen from the air.

review_title: Great views of EVERYTHING in Kaua'i
review_text: The Air Ventures team did a very nice job. The pilot was funny, well-informed, and very skilled.  We saw everything interesting along the coasts-- historical landmarks, popular resorts, and beautiful windows into nature.

review_title: Affordable, amazing views, good people, and overall impressed.
review_text: Our pilot Harry was great and we thoroughly enjoyed our air tour of Kauai. We took an afternoon one hour flight over Kauai and saw many of the sights we would have only otherwise heard about. I highly recommend Air Ventures to anyone looking for an affordable and easy way to see the beauties of Kaui from +/- 3,000 feet!

This tour was absolutely amazing!  Brian was our pilot and he made everything better. He made us feel very safe dispite some turbulence. He was extremely entertaining and informative. Overall this was an amazing find and value and we would recomend this to anyone.

This fixed wing circle island tour with Air Ventures was the highlight of our HI trip!  The views were awe inspiring, the narration extremely informative, comfort and safety an utmost concern.  Bryan, our pilot, was funny and a pleasure and Pua in reception was very sweet and helpful.  After six trips to the Kauai, I finally was able to see the interior of the island, along with flying over the wettest spot on earth!  I would highly recommend this activity!

review_title: Great value for price.  Highlight of our stay in Kauai
review_text: Staff was very pleasant and pilot was very informative and easy going.  Sights were unbelievable and views were just like sitting in your car.  Definitely recommend this outfit to any who want to see the island from a different view other than by land or sea.

review_title: Sailing in the sky over Kauai
review_text: You don't even know you are flying, even at 3000 feet.  Single engine plane is quiet and smooth.  You get to see the center of Kauai where cars can not go.  Only six people in the plane, each with their own headset and button to talk to ask questions.  Our pilot was an amusing guy who pointed out all the major sites.  Great thing is that you get to go over the mountains and get low to see the interior and coast real close.

Was initially skeptical about price since one of the least expensive tours, but found a few reviews and they were great. Went to website and was also reassured when I read tour would be on plane not helicopter thus fuel savings could be passed to us! All staff excellent, from shuttle driver Shirley, Pua in reception, to pilot- of course! Very professional, views were awesome, pilot very knowledgeable and made us feel very safe! Pay less and you'll surely get the best!

review_title: Great Tour! Your sure to get some awesome shots!
review_text:
My Husband and I went to the island for our honeymoon. The one thing everyone told us to do was to take a plane or helicopter tour. My hubby being a bit of a nervous flyer couldn't quite handle the helicopter so we opted for a single engine plane instead. He is 6'4 and a bit "bulky" lol, he got to fly co-pilot which was so awesome. Our Pilot Paul was so funny and easy going. He was very knowledgable and included us into conversation. He circled back so that both side of the plane had ample time to get pictures. The flight is just over an hour which allows you to see pretty much everything you want, from the Waita Reservoir, to the impressive red dirt fields of the Kauai Coffee plantation (the largest coffee plantation in the US), you'll see stunning Waimea Canyon, and the breathtaking Napali Coastline lined by the cathedrals of Kauai, to unforgettable Hanalei Valley, and tons of cascading waterfalls, spouting horn, and miles of simply beautiful coastline and beaches. This is a total must! and a great price! 
We actually booked our tour as a combo package with the Smith Family Luau through Veltra. I would not recommend using Veltra however. they were a mess! They messed up our booking, told we fly on friday but were actually scheduled for monday. They had down for the luau on sunday but there are no luau's on sunday! thank goodness for Air Ventures! The gal at the front desk call and straighten it all out for us! We will definitely return, maybe next time will do a helicopter or private tour!

We got a great overview of the island in about 70 minutes. The pilot was very relaxed, and attentive to what the people in his plane were looking at. When he noticed that people saw something special, he never failed to add a tidbit of information for it.

Overall a great experience and a fun way to see the island from above. (Note that if you're worried about flying in a small plane: I found it much nicer to take off and land with a plane like that than with the big passenger planes, almost like leaving your driveway with a car :-) )

Opted for the private tour in the C182.  Grand event.   Pilot Harry was a great "stick" as well as knowledgeable tour guide.  All 3 of us loved it.  Take the opportunity to see the whole island by air to get your bearings for ground explorations.

My husband and I took an Air Ventures trip around part of the island of Kauai.  It was wonderful.  Because it rained recently, there were lots of waterfalls everywhere and, Brian, the pilot made sure we saw many of them.  He was also very knowledgeable about the history and places on the island.  He was terrific.  He made sure we had the trip of the lifetime.  We not only saw the Na' Pali coast, which is breathtaking, but we were able to fly over the Wai'ale'ale' Crater.  There were waterfalls all the way around the edge.  It was unbelievable.  The staff was also terrific.  They were very helpful and friendly.  They even picked us up  & took us back to our hotel, since we didn't have a car.  I would highly recommend Air Ventures.

This was our first visit to Hawaii, and we knew we wanted to do an air tour.  After much research, we settled on Air Ventures, and I would do it all over in a heartbeat.  So much of Kauai is inaccessible except by air, and our trip was overflowing with breathtaking views of this beautiful island.  Everyone was a pleasure to deal with, and our pilot was great at setting us at ease and sharing all the details of the beautiful scenery we were flying over.  If you're debating on whether this trip is worth it, it absolutely is!

review_title: The single most disappointing vacation experience
review_text:
Now I know why the helicopter tours stay in business at twice the price;  you actually get to see stuff,  including the interior of kauai,  in a helicopter.  If you have the misfortune of being seated by the wing (as I did),  get up,  walk out and save your 70 minutes for something,  anything,  else. I literally cried for the last three quarters of the ride I was so disappointed.   Impossible to get pictures without a huge white bar running thru your shot.  The pilot saw me put my camera away in resignation,  and he told me "don't be disappointed,  the bar is good,  it shows you were on a plane."

So just take a few shots as you fly out of lihue,and you'll have had the same experience (and pictures) for free.

Wir hatten erst den Rundflug im Doppeldecker (Red Baron) gebucht, leider fällt dieses Flugzeug auf Grund eines Defekts noch bis im Dezember aus. Durch Air Ventures rechtzeitig informiert konnten wir einen Tag später als geplant zu einer Private Tour in einer Cessna starten. Die Aussicht während des Fluges war super, der Pilot hat sich sehr viel Mühe gegeben und uns viel erzählt. Das Anbringen der eigenen gopro-Kamera kostet 25$ extra, aber auch hier hat der Pilot alles richtig eingestellt, damit super Fotos entstehen konnten. Wir würden den Rundflug jederzeit wieder machen.

Our group had a great time and had a wonderful flight.  Paul as an excellent pilot and knowledgeable of the sites on the island.  He make special turns around things pointed out by one of our party and made sure people on both sides of the aircraft got to see something that might not be visible on their side.  We thoroughly enjoyed the flight and would recommend it to anyone we know who will be visiting Kauai in the future.  Great job!

Fun, friendly, a little less formal than the published brochure. Photography through a window is tough do to glare off glass - you will wind up with a reflection of yourself in most photos. Bring a polarizer if you can.

review_title: Buy one get one free NOT!!!
review_text:
Had a coupon for a buy one get one free ride with them and they would not honor it coupon was from "Entertainment" book that i had purchased before we left for the trip  (via their mobile application).The staff was very understanding and did give me a discount for the tour but would not honer the buy one get one free coupon. make sure your ready to do the trip because once you give your credit card and make reservations you will be charged no refunds.
In regards to the trip it was ok but if you really want to see up close then i would recommend a helicopter tour although they do cost twice the money .

review_title: The only comfortable way to see then island of Kauai.
review_text: Do not look anywhere else for the best way to experience the beautiful island of Kauai. If being comfortable is important to you and being able to be relaxed while experiencing a once in a lifetime adventure, look no further. If you are a party of one or many you will have a memorable experience that will last a lifetime. Do yourself the biggest favor. BOOK THE TOUR. You certainly won't regret it, and most importantly...You deserve it. ED & Shawna from San Diego, CA

What a wonderful operation! Very affordable, as compared to Helicopter tours, and friendly staff. The planes are much more fuel efficient with less noise than the helicopters so it's economical and environmentally friendly.
We had perfect weather (a huge help) and our pilot was accomplished and awesome. It was great to see the island early in our vacation to enjoy points of reference from the ground.

We loved the air tour!  For us, it was a highlight of our trip to Kauai!  It gave us a better perspective of the island.  The pilot pointed out all the important places and circled over  them to enable everyone to get good photo shots.  I would highly recommend this tour

My husband and I just took the airplane tour with air venture Hawaii. It's a 6-passenger very comfortable plane. The pilot was very nice and also the staff who assisted us. The weather was great and it was very clear. Saw all of Kuaui from atop and took a lot of memorable picture. For sure the best way to go by air

This was our first visit to Hawaii, and we knew we wanted to do an air tour.  After much research, we settled on Air Ventures, and I would do it all over in a heartbeat.  So much of Kauai is inaccessible except by air, and our trip was overflowing with breathtaking views of this beautiful island.  Everyone was a pleasure to deal with, and our pilot was great at setting us at ease and sharing all the details of the beautiful scenery we were flying over.  If you're debating on whether this trip is worth it, it absolutely is!  Their competitive rates meant we could splurge on a private air tour with no worries about being squeezed in with strangers or having a bad view.  Highly recommend!

.It was toward the end of our stay and we decided to take an air tour of the Island.  I went on line and booked the tour and shorty there after they called to confirm.  Nicest people you'll ever meet!  So friendly!  And the girl at the hanger was so accommodating and always had a smile.  She does so much and made us feel so comfortable.  The actual tour was terrific and just long enough to not be boring.  Pilot was excellent and very informative.and this turned out to be the highlight of our vacation.  I would very highly recommend Air Ventures to anyone!

We had a great experience. Everything was well organized. The ride was smooth, the skies were clear and the views were spectacular; it is totally worth to see Kauai from the air. The pilot was informative, made jokes; it was fun. At the end they email us a group picture. I thought they were going to charge for it but not. I thought it was a nice touch
This was a great way to see the island.  Had a wonderful time.  Would suggest offering to video the guest experince, and not just give a DVD that they didn't experience.

This is a great way to see Kauai. We decided to take a private tour of the island rather than a helicopter tour as it was much better value. We got to see all of the same sights as a helicopter tour (at a higher altitude) but for half the price and there was only 2 of us so we both had window seats for the duration. Our pilot captain Harry was knowledgeable and kept us entertained for the whole flight. I would highly recommend!

After looking at a bunch of tour companies we decided on this one due to the air/na pali coast combo tour...which saved us a lot of money.  We were also worried about having terrible seats for the helicopter tours, which were also a lot more money.  The trip was great, the perfect length and we really got to see the whole Island.  Our pilot was fantastic.  The only thing that wasn't great was the air sickness. No one really seemed to comment on this in any of the reviews we saw. I don't know if we had a particularly hot/choppy ride, but I felt pretty sick from about 30 minutes on as well as my partner. Another girl on my flight was sick from the beginning....she actually ended up sleeping for most of the ride! If you are prone to any sort of travel sickness I would recommend taking medication beforehand.  Otherwise this was a great excursion and much more affordable than the competitors.
very smooth and nice flight,the view from my window was wonderful.   Enjoyed the whole tour. Thank You

review_title: What A Great Way to See Kauai!
review_text: We decided to do this because it circles the island and is much cheaper than a helicopter (which I did thirty years ago when I first came!)  Plus, everyone gets a window seat which does not always happen in a heli.  The pilot gave us a great narrative and made sure both sides got to see everything.  Of course, we had a beautiful day and that helps for a great tour experience!

We were hesitant to do this due to cost, but it was so worth it to see nature's beauty without another long road trip.  In Kauai, the roads don't even go to some of the places we saw, so you would definitely miss out on a lot by not flying. Easy pickup from ABC store at NCL port.  Middle seat and seat behind the pilot a bit less scenic. More flights for our family, less road trips.

Although I suffer terrible motion sickness this was by far the highlight of the trip, and I had a pretty amazing trip.  Gorgeous scenery, great commentary, friendly professional staff. Highly recommend.

We had a great flight with Paul and Air Ventures.  We got to see the whole island, including water falls and the NaPali coast.  It was beautiful.  Started to get a bit motion sick, but they had cold towels and water onboard which helped.  Paul also gave instructions on how to keep it from getting worse.  The whole staff was friendly and accommodating.  We had a group of four and there was another couple with us.  The only thing I would suggest is to take pictures of the parties separately (they did do this if you had your own camera).  We would definitely do this again!

We just had a great flight at AirVentures this afternoon.  Our pilot Paul did a great job of flying the plane smoothly.  My wife and I brought three of our sons.  We were all a bit nervous but all we got was a great flight that felt safe but got us close to all the natural attractions on Kauai.  Nothing wrong with helicopters I guess but every seat in the plane had a great view and heard that might not always be true in the helicopters.  Also as a former pilot always appreciate that planes can fly with or without the engine working vs a helicopter that sometimes to me feels like a flying rock with lots of moving parts.  Anyway highly recommend this experience.

We enjoyed the flight very much.  We were shown the whole island with the NaPali coast being one of the highlights.   Having done this tour and a helicopter tour, I would choose this one.  The helicopter tour may get closer to the ground but not as friendly for those with motion sickness problems.   The views were spectacular and the pilot was very informative and friendly.   Flight was basically smooth with ample viewing windows for 6 people.
Excellent check in process, staff were friendly and helpful. Awesome coverage of the whole island - scenary was spectacular - definitely highlight of our trip.

This was our first time visiting Hawaii while our friends had been there several times.  To see the Na Pali coastline was a must.   We were there at the time of the hurricane scare and thus our zodiac tour was cancelled early in the morning.  Being our last day we needed to see the beauty of the Na Pali coastline and quickly got a plane spot for the 4 of us with Air Ventures Hawaii and at a great price than others offered.  They were very accommodating with scheduling us in early in the afternoon.  It was a beautiful sunny day and the views were fantastic! Our pilot, Bryan, gave us a lot of facts of the areas as  we flew over them and so it was quite informative.  The other couple did not feel any motion sickness, but my husband and I did.  I took a pill to help me with the motion sickness but probably not in time.  But the whole time, Bryan, gave me instructions on how to be comfortable.  They also have COLD bottles of water on the plane which helped me out a lot by minimizing the motion sickness.  Despite all of my sensitivity, the views were beautiful and glad I did it.  But it will be my last plane ride for a while!  Great experience to try atleast once!  and the company was great!

review_title: Take Bonine to see the Beauty
review_text: Viewing the whole island via airplane was beautiful.  On the day we went, it was warm out, so it was warm in the plane as well.  Motion sickness prevailed.  The sights were unbelievable, and the pilot was great!  He explained the sights below and pointed out many things.  You have an opportunity to ask questions, which my teens were mortified when I did.  :)  We were just newbys at flying in little planes and didn't know what to expect--rises and falls with the wind currents and warmth inside the plane with 7 people and sunshine.  It was gorgeous, the pilot and ground crew were amazingly wonderful, and I would say to take motion sickness pills and you will be fine--even if you don't get motion sick.  On the day we went, we were.

We have been visiting Kauai for 25 years and have never taken a plane ride before. This was definitely a smoother ride than the helicopter tour, and half the price. The pilot, Bryan was amusing and informative. There were 4 of us and we had the plane to ourselves, but they can accommodate 6.  The kid's enjoyed the ride and they let our 15 year old ride co-pilot. We left this companies information in our condo guest book, recommending it to any future visitors.

We took this as part of the air/boat combo. The tour lasted about an hour. The views from the sky are amazing and the staff is very friendly. Our pilot was John and he did a great job narrating the island and the features. The ride was probably a little more bumpy than our family was expecting so it made for a long flight. I guess this is somewhat of a given in a 7 seater plane but a little different than a commercial plane. Fun ride overall. Motion sickness people might want to think twice

Experience was amazing. After reading reviews, we went for the biplane tour as we are a couple and wanted to "feel the air".
This island is just fanstatic with different parts and so many things to see. I would definitely recommend this tour just after your arrival on the island, gives you a great overview.
Our pilot Harry was great, gave us all the info on island spots and to finish made couple of loops and stalls that were so exciting!!!
Don't hesitate, worth all your pennies

review_title: Amazingly beautiful air tour of Kauai!!!
review_text: My experience left me speechless! This tour was the best way to see and appreciate the garden island of Kauai! Our pilot Brian was very knowledgable of the history of each part of the island, he made sure we were comfortable and saw every waterfall. He pointed out all of the unique & special things about Kauai! He was entertaining as well with fun facts! No clouds blocked our view and the flight was pleasant. I would highly recommend this tour and we all gladly gave our pilot a tip because he did such a great job!

What a lovely experience for our first time in such a plane! The view and the lights in the late afternoon were wonderful. It was good to see all the places we went to, from the air. People working there are very nice (be sure to book your tour 24h before...) 
We had a very pleasant time!

This was an amazing experience. The customer service was great and the facility was not hard to find at all. The flight was smooth and it was beautiful day. The pilot was experienced and enjoyed the information he provided. Hope everyone books this tour. We had a great time.

We started our vacation with the tour on the open air biplane for 2, plus the pilot. So cool to be in the open cockpit for the flight. We were able to take in a view of the island that you can't get to by car and boat in some areas. My one tip for anyone with longer hair, tie it back, OMG my hair was in knots but so worth it. Great pictures, b

Nice overview of the island. Very smooth 55 min. ride even with looming clouds and wind.
Good pilot, friendly, with a lots of comments. We were 6 people from the same family, it felt like a
private plane.

We were not going to do this tour but that would have been the biggest mistake of our adventure on the island. the tour was the best part of our 2 week stay. We enjoyed the running commentary by the pilot and the grand vista. the seating was perfect, everyone had the best seat and the best view of what was to be seen. as we talk about what was the best part of our holiday, the first thing  that is brought up is the ride on the plane with your pilot.

Had such an amazing time with Air Ventures Hawaii! The pilot was very friendly and informative and even let me fly shotgun (no experience required)! The views were stunning and even though I'm from Kauai I have never seen it from the air! I definitely recommend flying with them, they made the experience fun and exciting and my love for Kauai has (somehow) grown even more! Air Ventures Hawaii no ka oi!

Airplane vs helicopter.  Plane flies higher and faster.  Covers more area in less time, but spends more time in the air.  Helicopter is more up close and personal.  Plane has big picture view of major portions of the island.  Plane costs about half of helicopter tour.  People at Airventures were great.  Pilot gave a spectacular and informative tour of the amazing island of Kauai.  And he greased the landing.  Awesome!

An excellent tour to see all the beauty the island of Kauai has to offer. Our pilot, Paul, and the entire staff were very professional and personable. I would highly recommend this trip to anyone visiting the island of Kauai. Mahalo Air Ventures Hawaii for an awesome memorable experience.
Flight was awesome, great scenery, good photo-ops...  Staff & Pilot were great... would recommend, as described, seating is tight but comfortable for hour flight.

I would recommend this trip to anyone visiting the island of Kauai.  It's really the only way to see certain parts of the island!  The Na Pali coast is spectacular!  Our pilot, Brian, was informative and funny.  My sister and I really enjoyed him!
This is a great way to see the island. Our pilot  was very knowledgeable about the history of the island. He dealt with 1 airsick passenger very calmly and professionally.

Best way to see and learn the history and information about the island and her people. Paul, our pilot was the best! We had someone who was getting a little airsick, he was very calm and spoke to her often and kept her focus where it should be. He was also very diplomatic with another flier who was difficult and mouthy. So glad we made the trip ;)

This is by far the best way to see the Island, period.  The Staff, Robin our Ground Coordinator and Brian our Pilot were great.  Knowledgable, informative, and funny.  This was our first time to Kauai and they made this perfect for me and my wife.  
Thanks,
MITCH & MARIANNE
It was extremely breath taking. The views were great and the conditions were perfect. Got great pictures!

review_title: Great Value for a Safe and Smooth Ride
review_text: Like other reviewers, I did my share of research.  We debated over the helicopter options as well.  Frankly, the majority of the helicopter options are twice the price of Air Ventures.  Air Ventures is a great value.  If you want the experience of being in a helicopter, then it may be worth it to pay the premium, but note that in a helicopter, it's not a consistent, smooth ride - you're constantly going up and down.  I did notice that helicopters seemed to be able to fly a bit lower and closer to the sites but not by much.  What I liked most about Air Ventures is that it's a very stable ride; there's not a lot of ascending and descending.  Overall, I definitely recommend Air Ventures - best value, and a safe, one hour ride around Kauai.  You can pretty much see the whole island in one hour.    This is also a great tour for the kids.  The Pilot sat the kids down in the captain's chairs and we were able to take pictures of them.  Highly recommended and do the tour in the beginning of your stay in Kauai as others have recommended.

Overall a good trip and worth the money.  the narration was hard to hear above the noise of the plane and the plane is cramped but it is a small plane and you have great visibility from all seats.  Touring by plane does not get you down and close up with waterfalls like touring by helicopter does but the plane gets you higher and gives you a better overall view.

review_title: This plane ride should be done in the sunshine.
review_text: What an amazing adventure this was. I would recommend doing this only in good weather. We had huge cloud cover and lots of the sights couldn't be seen due to weather conditions.  Our pilot was super cool and we had a blast. All 6 of us!!

review_title: Amazing adventure discovering the beauty of our own island, Kauai
review_text: This was a trip of a lifetime! Pilot Harry (Red Baron) was informative and flew us all over the island. Was safe, comfortable and for the most part smooth! "Definitely have to be done"- my husband!

review_title: Good value and experience but could improve
review_text: I was bringing my family of six with kids age 9 to 17 to Kauai on a special trip and did a lot of research on potential flights to see the Napali coast and more. AirAdventures offers a great value as the price is significantly lower than the helicopter options... and as others have noted...everyone gets a window seat. When we arrived, the reception was a bit too laid back in my opinion. We were on time...not early...yet no one was there to engage us and when someone did come out....even with just us there...they didn't welcome us or engage us. My family thought we were in the wrong place. Eventually they checked us in. The flight itself was good....smoother than expected. One of the six felt stomach nausea which is to be expected. But the pilots only comment before boarding was to be sure to use the bags so no one would throw up on him as a girl had recently done. (Not the warmest comment) More notably, there are two aspects that others have noted that others should be prepared for. First off, all the sights are seen from the right side....so the members of my family on the left side were notably disappointed. There didn't seem to be any acknowledgement about that nor any attempt to swing around to allow the left side to see top sites well. The other limitation as noted by others, is how garbled the sound is from the headphone system used. One really has to strain their listening to hear the pilot through the heavy static and that leaves a lot to potentially miss in the experience. I know that all helicopters and planes have limited sound in the headphone system but this seemed harder to hear than usual. All in all... a worthwhile experience...not at all the highlight of our trip as others speak of their flights....in part because the crew didn't seem to treat it like a big choice to go flying. But the beauty is stunning, the extent of the island seen is good, and the price much more affordable than the helicopters.

I am prone to motion sickness, and did feel queezy by the end of the flight, but I don't think the crew or the plane was at fault...just my stomach.  It was a beautiful tour with a great staff and excellent pilot, who was very knowledgeable about Kauai.  You can only see 10% of the island by driving so an air tour is the perfect way to see the island.  It was worth the money and the motion sickness!!

My wife and I were very worried that our flight would be cancelled due to inclement weather but after a few telephone calls from the very helpful staff, the flight was brought forward.  Our pilot was excellent, both knowledgeable and caring.  It was cloudy and at times bumpy, but he did everything possible to bypass the rough areas and still give us great views of the island.  This was the best possible way to see this beautiful island and I would recommend Air Ventures to everyone.

review_title: Nice island tour without the driving
review_text: Took a trip around the island today from the air and had a good time.  Saw nice views of the south coast, the Na Pali coast, Waimea canyon, north coast and central mountains.  The afternoon flight had some limits on the mountains but we also had some weather luck in the maountains elsewhere so I'd guess any time is good.  Brian provided good details about the area we were viewing.  The flight went well, seating was fine.
We had a great time, saw a lot, put everything in proper perspective.  The pilot was very knowledgeable and made this a very favorable experience

Took a private air plane tour around Kauai.  It was awesome.  Great view of the island.
Our guide took us through the canyons, to the highest peak.  Saw tons of beautiful waterfalls.
The plane was smoother than our commercial flight going home.  It was an awesome, older
4 seater plane that looked like a 57 Chevy interior.  Have to do!!!!

We had the perfect day for flying with almost zero turbulence. Very few clouds so we got to fly up through many of the canyons and over mountains that most do not get to. The pilot also provided much information about the history and heritage of the island and its people. A must do on your trip to Kauai

review_title: This tour is a must when visiting kauai!
review_text: You get to see all the island attractions from above. As Kauai is such an spectacular place the trip is awesome. There are canyons and mountain ranges that are unaccessible from the ground and a plane trip is a chance to enjoy these unique views. The view from the Na Pali coast is breathtaking, unforgettable from above. The flight ride was smooth and thorough and the captain was friendly and professional. The check in process was smooth and the girl that handled it was nice and helpful. Overall a great experience. Money well spent.

This hour-long air tour was good.  The pilot was extremely knowledgeable but it was hard to hear through the headphones at times.  I was nervous in the little plane and he was very considerate and would let us know if there was some rough air coming up.  The bumps were minimal, the majority of the time it was pretty smooth.  Be aware that it's warm in small planes in general, and this one was no exception.  Seeing the canyons and waterfalls up close was amazing!

I took the biplane (open cockpit - think Red Baron) tour last weekend with Paul as the pilot and it was amazing! I've been on plane tours, boat tours, bus tours etc etc - NOTHING compares to the experience of flying around the Garden Isle of Kauai in a vintage, open air aircraft with a knowledgeable, competent pilot/guide. Nothing. Please take this tour; you'll be thrilled you did and if enough of us do, then the world will be a better place! It's that good! Wonderful people staffing the place; all of them! Do not miss out on this!!
Sincerely, M Perales

review_title: Friendly, informative, exciting, way to explore Kaua'i.
review_text: Great times, will be a memory of a lifetime for me and my husband on our Anniversary trip. Eric, was very nice and an excellent pilot to explore Kaua'i!  Air Ventures Hawaii is the way to go to explore Hawaii in the air.

We looked at all the helicopter tour and airplane tour companies and decided on this company.  Number one, they are less than half the cost of the helicopter tours.  Number two, the tour was absolutely amazing.  The plane tours fly much higher than the helicopter tours, providing absolutely breath taking views of the entire island.  Well worth the time and money

Don't think twice, this is an awesome tour and at a great price!! We looked into the helicopter tours which do get a bit closer to the mountains, etc., but all in all it was a bit more than we wanted to spend. The price point with Air Ventures was just right - and their tour lasts the longest!  Brian was our guide/pilot and we really enjoyed his commentary!  They even played a little traditional Hawaiian music in the background…perfect!!

Alison and I had a wonderful time on this land, river and air tour of Kauai. We especially loved the commentary that Steve Yoder provided as our tour guide. It was such a pleasure hearing about all the little historical anecdotes that only a true "native" of the island could deliver. Thanks for a ton of fun.

This is one of the most amazing,incredible experiences I have ever had as a traveller. There is no other way to be any closer to the natural beauty of this stunning island than in the seat of the biplane. Our pilot Harry was brilliant.We soared over the mountains and along the Nepali coast , through the canyon and buzzed the cruise ship. We had nearly 90 minutes in the air. For something truly unique and memorable-try the biplane.

review_title: A bird's eye view of Kauai
review_text: We flew in the lovely bi-plane, with the wind in our hair all around the island. It was spectacular scenery and great fun. Our pilot Harry was an excellent aviator taking us down canyons and over waterfalls. We were lucky enough to see a rainbow around the wings. If you are looking for an experience of a lifetime, book a flight on Snoopy!

review_title: Excellent tour of the island, better than a helicopter!
review_text: I've been on a helicopter tour of the island as well and this plane is way better. Each person gets their own window so everyone gets a view of everything. The pilot and staff was super friendly and the pilot was really knowledgeable about the history of the island. Great tour, can't believe its less expensive than helicopter tours!

We arrived on the island early Monday morning and by Tuesday afternoon we had driven up the Waimea Canyon road, out to Princeville and along the coast.  Wednesday morning we arrived for our biplane air tour.  It was great, showing us more of the island than we could ever see by car.  It is better in the open cockpit biplane because you can smell the wonderful aroma of the tropics. Harry our pilot was fantastic and informative.  This is a must do for island visitors.  Remember its open cockpit so keep in mind the weather. The ceiling on this little plane is 14,000 ft. the highest point on the island is 5100 ft.  So we were above the highest peak and turning circles in the canyon flying through the low hanging clouds.  This 300 hp biplane is unique in itself. A real stick & rudder plane.  Having driven around the island prior we could make out land marks of where we had been and where we would like to go and explore further.  Make an effort to visit Air venture tours.  Its worth your time. Thanks Harry

review_title: Air Ventures Hawaii Is First Class
review_text: What can I add to the glowing reports of previous reviewers? AVH picked us up at a prearranged, convenient location on time. Their staff was friendly and informative. Brian, our pilot, provided an excellent narrative, answered all of our questions, and insured that guests on both sides of the plane saw all important sights. Kauai is quite different from above and I encourage everyone to take advantage of Air Ventures' well priced and well conceived program.

My daughter is afraid of heights and she enjoyed this slow-motion flight over beautiful Kauai.  Our pilot Bryan (?) gave us a lot of infos re: the famous spots in Kauai like the Jurassic Falls, the Napali Coast, Celebrities' residences (Pierce Brosnan's and Julia Roberts), the Wailua River, etc.  Overall, it was an experience that one will always cherish.  Above all, it's AFFORDABLE!

Great flight over Maui.  Paul made sure that all the passengers had a clear view of the scenery.  He provided an interesting narrative of the sites, houses and beaches.  A very smooth and enjoyable trip.

THIS IS SIMPLY AMAZING! My boyfriend and I did this airtour--the boyfriend , being a little sketchy of small planes and heights reluctantly went with me, since I booked this. But after taking off and seeing all the wonderful SIGHTS and views, those thoughts went out the window! My boyfriend now wants to be a pilot, haha. We have never been on an airtour and this is definitely a MUST DO. The sights to see are priceless--and our pilot PAUL was hilarious and showed us everything. He even took the time to fly around slowly and back around so both sides of the plane got to see everything as well as for photo ops. We paired this with the holo holo charters sunset cruise and it was the best thing we have done on this vacation!

review_title: Excellent way to see the Island of Kauai
review_text: Very professional.  Much more comfortable than the helicopter tour. Brian is an excellent pilot and tour guide

We thoroughly enjoyed the aerial view of Kauai and the Captain's Description of what we were seeing.  Did this the last day of our visit and it was great to review all the beautiful places we had visited.  Great memories!  Love the DVD too!

My husband and I had an amazing time on our air venture flight!  It was gorgeous and informative. However, I'm a highly sensitive person and passed out about halfway through the flight due to being airsick...was pretty scary and unfortunately ruined the last half of the trip (the most beautiful part, the Napali coast!). Other than that, we loved it!!!

My husband and I were celebrating our 40th wedding anniversary, and wanted to see Kauai from above ( I get motion sick on helicopters) so this was our choice! Great experience-loved it and no sickness!! Very memorable!

We had a wonderful time the views were amazing, the pilot was very informative.  To many surprise it was very smooth.  I recommend viewing Kauai from every angle but the near is from the day with air ventures

We took this biplane tour of Kauai with our family on our recent visit, It was perfect weather, beautiful views Our guide Paul was very knowlegable and funny Our daughter felt a little airsick but still enjoyed the experience Would highly recommend it!

Amazing time out in the bi-plane. Pilot was funny and knew the island well. I would recommend this to anyone. I am not a fan of heights and I even had a great time. Well worth the time and money. Pilot even did a few tight turns and fun moves in the air with us.

This is a great way to see Kauai that is more economical than the helicopter tours, about half the price.  Book online to save, you'll get DVD free, although not of your actual place ride, but done professionally on very good weather days over the same route.  The plane is comfortable and flight was relatively smooth for the day we went.  Of course the weather changes quickly, was sunny leaving Lihue but interior and Na Pali coast was overcast and raining some of the time.  Just shows you how diverse Kauai really is.  As everyone points out, flying gives you a great perspective that you simply can not appreciate from the ground, plus seeing areas you're not going to be able to drive to.  To be fair, we have not done a helicopter ride, so we can not truly compare with a fixed wing flight.  Probably the apples and oranges argument. But from our perspective, we were happy with the experience. Not noisy at all.  You all have the headsets that cancel most of the noise plus can communicate with each other and the pilot. We are a little older and felt that the helicopter a bit much, plus it boiled down to our what our travel budget can handle.  In our opinion, the argument that if you'd made it to Hawaii, then you should be able to afford a helicopter ride is really false, we all have price points.  Air Ventures provides you basically the same flight itinerary and for a lot less money.  For those environmentally conscience, the fuel used by Air Ventures is a fraction of what a helicopter uses.  Just check the fuel surcharges.  Book online with Air Ventures to lock in your savings.  We'd do it again!

The overall experience was good. There is a fuel surcharge of about $16 dollars that you must pay once you arrive so have some cash  or credit card ready. The planes are pretty small so you wouldn't want to fly on them on a windy day or you might get air sick. The views are stunning! The pilot was very knowledgeable and would answer any questions you might have. You are provided with a microphone so you can communicate with the pilot and an aviation headset so that you can hear the pilot. The only recommendation I have for the Air Ventures Hawaii team is to update the in-flight communications system so that passengers don't have to hear air-traffic communications during their flight and also hear less static coming through the headphones. It was a little hard to understand the pilot sometimes. Other than that, I recommend this to anyone wishing to get an up-and-close look at most of the island and its beautiful landmarks. When considering either a helicopter or plane ride, remember that while helicopters can get you much closer to landmarks, Air Ventures Hawaii planes fly very low too (~1,000 ft) and can cover much more of the island. In general, airplane rides are between 5-10 minutes longer than helicopter rides. Also, every passenger gets a window sit so they can take pictures. The plane sits 6 passengers so you are always flying with a small group.

pilot was friendly, made everyone feel at home. we had ear phones and a mike at each row.
we weighed in( no announcements of weights) so he could position us in the plane. a few of the  windows have some scratches, I haven't had time to look at my pics.  a little bumpy at times. the pilot flew us around the island telling us about what we were passing over. he made a circle every time a spot came up that we might want to take a picture. we got to see waterfalls that you
cannot get to otherwise. it was a good clear day except over the tallest mountain. my only sadness was we had to come back to the airport.

review_title: Very good trip on Air Ventres.
review_text:
We really see Kauai by the Air trip. Before the trip we were thinking about that : where is our drinking water come from?( that means : is there any Resevoir?) Then we see over the plane.
And find out about the Agriculture place and more.
But George not satisfy with that the window was not clean and have scratched. And on his seat can not take picture because far from the window.

A great flight that began with a great aircraft with  every passenger having a window view thru clear clean bubble windows. We were blessed with a perfectly clear day that the pilot said was one of the clearest he had seen recently and rewarded us with locations that normaly might have been cloudy such as the peak of the mountain which is the rainiest place on earth (can't remember it name). We over flew the Napali coast and famous spots from the movie Jurrasic park. The flight was smooth and comfortable with plenty of photo opportunities.
The flight was amazing! The pilot was very friendly and a great tour guide. He had tons of info on each part of the island. Awesome with kids.

My wife and I had a fabulous flight with Captain Harry in the Waco biplane. It was a really comfortable flight and a super memorable way to see Kauai with views that few get the chance to experience. The open cockpit biplane is far more interesting for sight seeing and the views without any interfering windows are unique and ideal for photos. Great fun.

review_title: Best and Most Unique Way to See Kauai
review_text: Kauai is one of the most beautiful places on earth, and I didn't fully get to see all of it's beauty until I got up in the air with Air Ventures and had one of the best scenic tours ever. The views were stunning, the photo opps endless and our pilot, Brian, extremely knowledgeable. It was great to hear some history, pop-culture references and even have him take the time to circle back a couple times to ensure we all got the perfect photos. The planes are small, comfortable and leave you feeling adventurous! We were able to get some great ideas of what parts of the island we wanted to visit as well as get insight on what to do. 100% recommend as a must do when visiting Kauai.
We did the Red Baron tour with Harry.  it was absolutely worth the money (and we like to live cheaply)!

I loved the flight. It seemed slow and leisurely and relaxed. We got to see from the air some of the places we had been...just a different view point. We have gone on the helicopter on a previous trip but didn't care for the diving and fast speeds and thrills. This was Ike going out for a Sunday drive. Great pilot. The flights were on time and we were in the air over an hour. Also the fuel surcharge was only $8. They have very efficient planes.
We took a private flight just the two of us. Brian was a good pilot and it was interesting to listen to his descriptions of the island.

Excellent tour! Good people. 

We originally scheduled our tour for a Monday, but were distracted by other events on the island. When we called, after the postponement and reschedule period had ended, the customer rep was kind and understanding. She immediately rescheduled us the next day. We arrived on time and ready to go. The pilot was informative and funny. The island from the air is breathtaking.

I highly recommend this tour and this company.

We took the 1 hour tour of the Island which gave a good overview.  You wear headphones that allow you to listen to the pilot's narrative of the Island.  I would recommend this highly and hearily agree with all that has been said by other recent reviewers.

We took the biplane from Air Ventures.  We were able to wear headsets to hear the pilot.  He was wonderful in telling us all about the island.  Of course, the garden island is one you need to see from the air, and the biplane, to us, was just the way to see it.  With the open cockpit, we could both see excellent and the wind in your hair was wonderful.  For fun seekers, this was an excellent adventure.  I bet we saw 50 waterfalls on the ride around the island. The canyon and the cliffs -  Gorgeous from the sky.  The pilot also pointed out the rainbow that was actually between the plane and the ocean.  What a site, we were above the rainbow.

I would highly recommend AirVentures to anyone wanting to see Kauai "from the sky". We had contemplated a helicopter trip, since it was recommended by many of our friends, but decided on a plane instead. 
REASONS: 1. Though the plane flies higher (1000 ft vs 500 ft), it goes slower and you have more opportunity to see what you are there to see and to capture it on camera.  2. The plane was eco-friendly, using much less fuel  than a copter.
Wonderful tour of the island of Kauai. Informative, beautiful, and entertaining! They allowed us to attach our GoPro to the airplane in order to get hundreds of beautiful picture too!

review_title: Red Biplane tour of Kauai - the best ! !
review_text: This tour of Kauai by open-cockpit biplane was the highlight of our recent trip to Hawaii.  I'm sure that AirVenture's regular air tours of Kauai are great too, but there is just no way to beat this biplane tour for fun, scenery and vivid memories.  Captain Harry was a great host, tour guide and pilot and really added a lot to the overall experience; his knowledge of Kauai geography and culture is impressive.  We will always remember this open biplane ride as the best part of our Hawaii trip.

This was a truly awesome manner in which to see Kauai.  Every person had a window seat and was able to see parts of the beautiful island not accessible by land.  The pilot was extremely nice and did an excellent job describing what we were seeing as well as the history that went with many of the sites.  A must do!

We did the combo tour using best of Kauai website and it was well worth the money.  The flight was awesome.  Paul the pilot did a fabulous job explaining everything and showing all the sights.  He also ensured that both sides of the plane were able to see everything which was extremely considerate.

Fern Grottoes tour was awesome and Smith's did a wonderful job.  Even went back and had our luau there.

Steve our tour guide was amazing.  His friendly nature and jokes kept the tour upbeat and interesting.  He also went over the time limit to ensure we saw everything that was possible to see!

Great time & company!

review_title: Ideal way to see the whole island Kauai
review_text: We really had been excited, to see Kauai this way. Nice people, excellent tour. And the DVD keeps your memories fresh.

Flew with them during a port stop on a Carnival cruise.  Convenient shuttle from a shopping center near the ship was right on time, and they were nice enough to drop us off at the rental car agency after our flight.  It was a great flight and our pilot explained everything well and was able to answer any questions. He also circled around the sights to make sure you could see them no matter which side of the plane you were sitting on.   Cold water was available during the flight, and our pilot checked to make sure we were all doing okay when we hit a minor amount of turbulence.  We would recommend this flight to anyone as a great way to really appreciate the unspoiled beauty of Kauai.
Great tour! Wonderful way to experience the island. Our pilot was fun, well informed, and skilled. Even saw whales!

We certainly enjoyed our tour with you.  Breathtaking views of Kauai was a beautiful ending to our trip to Kauai.  Thanks 
Albert and Barbara

We had a wonderful flight.  The weather was good even when it rained you didn't notice it, you still stayed dry from the windshield and wings.  The sights we saw were amazing and the pilot told us alot about the island.  We would recommend this flight to anyone and everyone!!!

Sincerely,

Cecil & Sherri Sigafoose
Placerville, CA

review_title: A Perfect Way to Experience Kauai
review_text: I was impressed by the fact that the airplane is less expensive and is more eco-friendly than helicopters.  I have done both and the views were fantastic either way.  One drawback is if you are seated on the left side.  The airplane does not do as many turn-arounds, nor can it hover in circles like a helicopter so inevitably those on the left miss out on seeing as much as those on the right do.

review_title: A great SMOOTH way to see Kauai
review_text: This is a great option for aerial viewing of the island. The aircraft they have is a 6 passenger Airvan and it goes slow enough to see things and is incredibly smooth. I have heard that the helicopters are a rougher ride, stands to reason thinking of the basics of flight. The pilot was knowledgable of all aspects of the island, he  also made us feel very safe. The business is well run, easy to find and on time. This was a great day!
Excellent experience seeing Kauai from the air.  Great service and nice narration by pilot Paul.  Nice combo with Kauai land tour.

review_title: Fantastic Experience with Air Ventures Hawaii
review_text: We had an amazing experience over the island of Kaui. Staff were extremely friendly and accomodating. Would recommend to all travellers to Kaui.

This was our first time flying in a 6-seater airplane.  Still bumpy, but not too bad.  My husband called those areas "Island Hopping".  With the trade winds of Kauai, this is expected.  We really enjoyed the experience.  Brian's takeoff was outstanding, but his landing....nothing less than incredibly awesome!  Barely felt the wheels touch the runway and despite strong crosswinds, he held the plane straight and perfect!  

Even though we've flown a 2-seater and a helicopter (twice), this was by far the best and Brian shared bits of info that we've never heard before.

Thanks!!

review_title: Incredible views, but a little bumpy
review_text: Since I had read that 80% of Kauai was inaccessible by car, I decided that air was the way to go.  I had just done a helicopter over the big island, so I thought I'd try a plane.  After doing both, I can say that there are advantages to either.  The airplane was definitely more bumpy than the helicopter (I actually got a little sick to my stomach which I never do, so recommend motion sickness pills) and I was a little jealous to see the helicopters down close up to the waterfalls and other sights.  Less leg room on plane also.  However when I got home and looked at my pictures, I realized that being higher up gives a different perspective and a magnificent overall picture.  I got some really good pictures although many had a little glare in a spot or two.  My husband stayed on the ground and did a tour and was jealous of the great pictures that I got.   We left a half hour late which messed up my plans afterwards, so be forewarned they are not very punctual as I see other comments here mention it too.  Cheaper than helicopters and overall I had a good trip.

This was a great option as it was more affordable than a helicopter, more environmental, AND I was able to bring my toddler who slept through the entire tour with his headphones on.

I must admit, the first few minutes on the plane were a little scary.  The plane is the smallest I've ever been on.  Luckily, the pilot's narration and background Hawaiian music put me at ease.

I was also worried because the sky seemed cloudy over the Waimea Canyon, hence I wondered if we would see any nice views.  Well, the views were amazing, and the Napali coast was completely clear with views of a beautiful blue ocean.

I am so glad this was part of my trip to Kauai!

I had never been to Hawaii/Kuaui so I decided to take an airplane tour of the island.  The resort where I was staying the Pona Kai had connections to AirVentures so I decided to go with them.   It was unbelievable the beauty of all the beaches the lush vegetation and the waterfalls,  it was the best hour I have experienced I highly recommend and Brian who was our pilot very informational very entertaining I can't say enough about it the best hour I spent
We had a great time. Brian our pilot was fun and interesting and had such knowledge of everything we flew over. Do not hesitate to fly with AirAdventures. Thanks Brian
This is a great alternative to the helicopter tours. The price is less than half and you see everything. Great service and great people. Highly recommend it.

This is the best way to see Kauai. The flight was amazing, the pilot was even better. Our pilot Harry was knowledgeable about the island, and gave us a very calm flight. The lady at the desk was very friendly and helpful. I was scared and I would do it again in a minute.
The only thing missing was the inflight glass of wine!!!
If you want to see the island this is the airplane group to take.  Our pilot was Brian he eas very knowledgeble and funny at the same time.

The fact that they offered a flight plus luau package that was a big $ savings was a definite influence for me. Also a factor was that being a big guy at almost 6'4" and 240, the helicopter tour would probably have put me in the middle of the plane versus being assured a window on this air tour....and they accommodated my long legs by putting me in the co-pilot seat where I had more leg room. The pilot knew the island well and shared info throughout the flight, and was receptive to any and all questions from the passengers.

Amazing experience...so lucky the weather improved and it was mostly blue skies...great way to see kauaii in all its glory..pilot was very informative..knew so much... Able to ask questions if needed to.. Blonde lady at reception not so friendly...not a great first impression..also left 35 minutes after booked time and back before the hour was up..would probably try another company on a future trip...

We tossed between the helicopter vs fixed wing (plane); having done neither we didn't have a basis to compare or critique. We decided on the plane option Air Ventures mainly because they offered a reasonably priced combo package with a sea tour; we were very impressed with both companies and enjoyed our experiences.  For the air tour portion Air Ventures was very good. Both my wife and I aren't seasoned fliers, but found Air Ventures to be very good with us. The pilot was very knowledgable on the island geography and history. He also doubled back (turning back) a few times to ensure all passegers got a view of key features.  The air tour provided us a good introduction to the island at the beginning of our vacation, but would also have been good at the end to see all the places we visited during the week.  Overall the air tour was well worth the cost.

review_title: Air part of best in Kauai tour
review_text:
I was the one that got sick today. I am aware I get motion sick but I wanted to do this.
It was worth it and for what I didn't see - I bought the DVD.
While I can't say I loved every minute of the 60 minutes in the air nothing can compare.
Bryan was great pilot. I felt safe. Unforgettable experience really worth it.
Awesome, Beautiful, Exciting.  You cant really see the beauty of Hawaii unless you see it from the air.  And these guys know how to show you everything.  A must for all.
The staff was extremely professional and the flight AMAZING. I got a little air sick but that was totally on me. I would HIGHLY recommend this adventure. It was the highlight of my guy's trip :).

The trip started off with rain (weather can't be helped) but once we got past that, the views were spectacular and our pilot, Harry, did a great job acting as guide while keeping us safely in the air.  We saw so much that we never would have seen otherwise, fabulous.  The Na Pali Coast is truly amazing.  We were in an open cockpit bi-plane so just my husband, me and the pilot, we could ask questions and feel like our tour was very personal.  I highly recommend it and will do it again on our next visit.

review_title: Great way to see the island.
review_text: The planes were very nice. Every seat had great view through large windows. We were lucky to get a day with spectacular weather and un limited visibility. Saw waterfalls galore and even some whale. Pilot did a very nice narration. Only negative and it was small thing, the lady at the counter was a little off putting. Great value too.

Our tour got cancelled after about 20 minutes up because of high winds, but the views were fantastic & the pilot was friendly & knowledgeable. We got a refund since we didn't get the 70 minutes, but trust me, we didn't want to be up in those winds! Would have rescheduled but we had to come home the next day :(

"Ladies, tie your hair back", says my wife!
We had the pleasure of a beautiful warm, sunny day to experience the spectacular views of Kauai with our knowledgable pilot Harry in the biplane. 
Wind blowing our hair, sun in our eyes, and Harry pointing out the many attractions of the island.
Highly recommended adventure!

We had taken the helicopter tour of the big island and decided to try an alternate (and less expensive) way of seeing Kauai.  It's different -- you have to keep moving, so there's no chance to hover in front of a waterfall -- but still gives you the opportunity to see places from a unique viewpoint.  The day we went there was weather in some spots, so our route was probably somewhat different from what they would take under ideal conditions.  The ride can get a little bumpy in spots, and when you're flying up Waimea Canyon and the walls are higher than you are keep in mind that the pilot doesn't have a death wish and will either climb to take you over the top or go back if the conditions don't allow that.  Our pilot was not terribly chatty, perhaps in part because of the flying conditions, but we still heard a good deal about the island, its history and its residents.  They sell a DVD of the tour taken under ideal conditions so you can see what you missed.  Keep in mind that this is a small plane -- there are bathroom facilities in the terminal, but none while you are in the air.

review_title: Sky high trip with low, low prices!
review_text: You really must see the Hawaiian island of Kauai from the air... and this was the ideal choice. Well, there was really no choice. The Star Princess ship's own helicopter trip cost $350 per person. This AirVentures flight was substantially less than half that for a spectacular journey of around 80 minutes. The Waimea canyon alone would have been worth the money but our pilot also showed us the island's stunning waterfalls, plantations, coastal beauties and even made certain we saw whales on the way back. Airport transportation was included, too. Just one other thing ... get that computer fixed, guys!

review_title: It was a great flight I highly recommend it !!!
review_text: It was a great flight our pilot was excellent we saw amazing things I would highly recommend it.yiu see things you could never see from the ground

In the past we took a helicopter ride in Maui.  This trip to Kauai we decided to try something different and opted for a small plane ride over the island instead.  There was the pilot and six passengers.  Each of us had a window seat.  The ride itself was smooth and comfortable.  The pilot made sure to turn the plane and give both sides a good view.  When someone spotted a whale for example he flew by and then turned the plane so the passengers on the other side could see as well.  It was a wonderful way to see the island. The canyon was beautiful from the air and we even saw the top of the highest mountain which is rarely visible.  The colors of the water on the north shore were incredible from the air.  The tour lasted over an hour and we were given a DVD of the tour (not ours but like ours).  The pilot was fairly knowledgeable when I could understand.  But that was the main problem - the sound over the headphones was very distorted and noisy so it was difficult to hear his narration most of the time.  Also my husband saw other planes going closer to the sites and wished we could as well.  But I really enjoyed the views and for the price (half what the helicopter costs) I thought it was well worth it.

We signed up to go on the beautiful air van as seen advertised, but when we arrived, we were told we would be going on a little Cessna four seater.  This plane was ancient, cramped and uncomfortable.  We were not given the option of rescheduling or anything.  I was extremely disappointed.  The pilot seemed knowledgeable enough, but not very friendly.  The scenery was beautiful, can't ruin that but, oh it should have been so much better.  We were also promised a DVD of the trip for booking online but did not receive it.

We enjoyed beautiful views of the entire island and saw whales breaching in the ocean as well....our pilot was friendly and very knowledgeable..do not miss this fantastic experience! Richard and Angela from Ohio

review_title: 4 reschedules but we finally made it on the plane and it was with it.
review_text:
Our flight got weather related rescheduled 4 times. Although it was frustrating to get there and the flight was cancelled again and again. We gave it a last shot on our last day on Kauai. It was worth the wait!
We've seen some places we've been to on the ground and lots of new places you can't get to. The flight was very smooth and safe. One of the highlights of our stay in Kauai .

I was just looking over my pictures from my trip to Hawaii and came across all of my pictures from our flight with Air Ventures. Reminded me how much fun we had with Air Ventures.  The flight with them was a little over a year ago now...and I can't believe that I have not written a review about our experience with them until now!!!!  We had a FANTASTIC time with them!  Very professional, courteous, and safety was obviously #1 in their book. Very personable from start to finish.  We had a fantastic flight over Kauai and even got to enjoy the first parts of the sunset. Great pictures.  I think my favoriate part of the whole trip was that the pilot was willing to pose for pictures with us as a group, and individually....to me, even though he was busy and things to do this was important. Showed he cared enough to take a moment and stop for a picture and talk with us individually. We weren't "just another tourist".  We also enjoyed all the little facts and interesting things he was able to point out to us while we were flying over the island.  Overall a great flight....splendid!

A unique view of place you may see on the ground and a view of places you simply cannot get to on the ground!  So much of this island cannot be accessed any other way!  The canyons, cliffs and beaches are breathtaking!   Nick was our pilot and he did a wonderful job!  So worth the effort and expense!!

review_title: It was a amazing tour, smooth flight and detailed guide.
review_text:
It was a really lucky to see the beautiful island in the air.
Every scenary was so beautiful and There was a another suprise to see the breaching of whale  in the air.

review_title: Awesome views of Kauai from the air!
review_text:
Very nice tour of the whole island,
My suggestion:before you take flight here, tour the island by car;you will be in awe when you see the sights from a different perspective!
We were sitting on opposite sides of the plane,both taking pictures,even at that the pilot Paul even banked back so we both got some awesome shots.

Have done many of the tours on this beautiful island. This was one of the best. Six of us had a delightful time on a very clear day to experience a overview of Kauia. Harry was our pilot and he gave a narrative that was clear and concise. An approximately 70 minute tour that was well worth the price. Equally as good as the helicopter for less money. A must to do along with the Napali cruise on Holo-Holo charters.

I would like to say how much we appreciated our flight tour of your beautiful Island of Kauai.
It was our intention to see the island from the air because of the island being so remote.
Also I wanted our six family members to experience the island together. which would have been impossible by helicopter.  
Our pilot was terrific!!!!!!!
He made us feel very comfortable and safe.
 He also named and pointed out all the waterfalls , towns, canyons, previous native villages, coffee plantations on this incredible island.
If you are planing to visit Kauai I highly recommend taking this extraordinary experience with Air Ventures Hawaii!!!!!
Aloha!!!!!

This excursion was the highlight of our Hawaiian cruise and worth every penny!!!  What an awesome way to see Kauai's beautiful scenery!  I could upload countless photos, but you really need to see it for yourself.

We had perfect weather and a smooth flight. The pilot took special care to make sure both sides got see all sights. He circled a pod of whales...which was spectacular! The flight allowed us to see the inaccessible parts of the island. Highly recommend this charter.

review_title: Great tour of breathtaking landscapes, we even saw whales from the plane!
review_text:
My husband and I took an Air Ventures Kauai tour in the air van, and we loved it!

We chose the air van (6 person plane) because the cost was substantially cheaper than a helicopter tour. We heard from locals that all the planes and helicopters take the same route. We also liked that it uses less fuel than helicopters!

We loved how the plane took us over the Waimea canyon, and we loved the views of the rugged Napali coast. However, our favourite part was when we saw 6-7 humpback whales from the plane. The pilot circled around the whales for a few minutes so we could take it in.

Took the BiPlane tour with Kevin - the views were amazing and Kevin did a great job letting us know what to look for.    It was not cold or windy - we had on some great cloth helmets that were adorable.   Only downside is that you cannot take photos in an open air plane.

So so wonderful! I know that helicopter rides are well-loved (and I have heard great things from my mother-in-law and many friends), but being in an open air cockpit is an amazing experience. The plane is cloth over wood, standard construction for a century. The plane is new (not an antique). The ride was very solid, cozy, and comfortable.
