We saw a large pod of whales, flew through tropical rain forest canyons, saw volcanic craters with multiple waterfalls.  Nick, our pilot, was able to address our questions knowledgeably. If you enjoy the history of flight and want to get an extra experience in addition to seeing Kauai from the air, consider a biplane ride. The only caveat: two in the front seat is cozy. My husband is 6ft 2in and I am 5ft 5in.

What a great experience. We took an early morning flight on the biplane with Harry as our pilot.  Harry showed us all around the island,  pointing out all the beaches and canyons.  We saw at least a dozen rainbows.  A surprisingly smooth flight.

What an "air-venture_ we had being able to see the beautiful "garden isle" from the air.  We had tried to view the waimea canyon driving up through the winding roads but because of the low cloud cove we couldn't see anything from the lookouts.  We also did a water cruise along the napali coast which was awesome but such a better view from above.  The tour also allowed us to see a lot more of the island than we ever would have been able to see any other way.  We would definitly recommend AirVentures to anyone who really wants a gorgeous perspective of Kauai!!!

We were lucky enough, according to Harry, to get one of the only 20 days out of the year that it was so clear, we could see the tops of all the mountains. It was an awesome way to start our week in Kauai! Harry was very informative and answered our questions as well. Thanks for a great ride!!!!

We had an excellent time on this tour, no reason not to rate it 5 stars!  The trip as exciting, safe, and provided unparalleled views of The Garden Island.

I say spend 1/2 the money, and fly by airplane instead of helicopter. You may not get as close to the canyons or waterfalls, but you still get all of the incredible views at varying altitudes.

The thrill of being in a tiny Cessna with my partner and the pilot was a huge adrenaline rush, and we were able to snap a few (~200) photos with our Nikon D3100.

Thanks!

Of course, you MUST include an air tour as part of your Kaua'i experience -- so much of the island is pristine and unaccessible in any other way, and the views are truly awe-inspiring. I chose AirVentures because I wasn't sure if I would be comfortable in a helicopter, and I did not regret the choice. Our pilot (Paul) was competent and charming, and made sure people on each side of the plane got excellent photo-ops of the astonishing landscapes. We also had a bonus view of a mother humpback whale and her calf at the start of our flight. Good price as well. Perhaps naively, I had not realised that tipping the pilot was customary -- didn't mind at all, just hadn't prepared for it, in terms of stocking the right denominatons of cash!

All of the air tours of Kauai are somewhat pricey. So we thought to do something more unusual. Though not for everyone (as a couple, you need to be more of a trim size), this will be something  different to talk about when you get back home. Our pilot Harry was a skilled tour guide over this, the most beautiful of the Hawaiian Islands. We lucked out with beautiful weather, hope you do too! Taking pictures is somewhat difficult as I've haven't had a chance to wind test how my little pocket camera would react against a 120 mph wind. The best pictures  for me, were looking back over the absolutely fabulous scenery. All the views are somewhat restricted, but definitely more fun.

The plane had seats for 6 people, each had their own large bubble window, so taking pictures was great.  The pilot was very informative, we had earphones so the noise was almost entirely eliminated!  Great flight.

review_title: Perfect way to see the island
review_text: The weather looked poor first thing but cleared up in time for our flight.  Our pilot  Nick said it was going to be a smooth trip and he nailed it.  The sites were well explained as he brought the plane around for each side to get a great view and memorable pictures.  Highly reccomend this to be able to see the whole island not just the edge.

Hi Guys 

Me and my Wife took the tour today and it was terrific. Nick was our pilot and he was able to give us a very pleasant flight and awesome guidance on all the spots we pass throw. I didn't do the Helicopter one, but this tour was very cool and smooth. We hit the same spots that the Helicopter would pass and we paid way less. I strong recommend it.

this was a highlight of our recent trip to Kauai we had a great hosts in Nick and Robin they  went out of there way to make sure we had a good time. My brother in law took many pictures of the area so we can now share these wonderful memories thanks again Nick and Robin for an awesome adventure

I had the pleasure of riding in the biplane with our pilot, Harry. It was an incredible experience! Harry was so kind and knowledgable about the island and he made us feel very safe. The Air Ventures Hawaii staff was courteous and helpful. The tour of the island was beautiful! I had contemplated taking a helicopter ride, but after the bi-plane, I would recommend this instead and would definitely do it again. The plane seems more in touch with nature and is a more exciting and personal experience. I will definitely be back and would recommend Air Ventures Hawaii to anyone who travels to Kauai!

We had a great flight - very smooth and comfortable.  My husband took lots of amazing pictures and we learned a lot about Kauai.  We saw many areas we wouldn't have been able to see from the ground.  It was worth every penny!
Up close and personal Airal view of Kauai. Our first time but not our last! Its a slow ride completely around Kauai with excellent views of everything. Great for photo taking. Thank you Air Venture.

review_title: 1 of a kind in my life time that words can not describe!
review_text: My husband and I took this trip at 430 and timing was perfect, not too windy , our pilot was so knowledgable of the history of Kauai it is fascinating. He would fly over some of the special valleys or sites twice so both sides could get their pictures and repeat the history of that site again if you were filming. Very accommodating to the customer. Also before we took off it started to rain a shower they checked with the helicopters next door that just landed as to how weather was flying in addition to the radar and their own pilot that just lAnded as to weather coming in. I felt they had our safety in mind at all times. The airplane was very comfortable and the windows were hugh to take pictures. I liked how you got weighed that only the airlines saw your weight behind the counter and no one else . I can't say enough about the beauty of the flight and a once in a life time experience, one of the top 5 of my life time after my children , grandchildren and marriage!   Philly Patsy

It was really a great flight. Itv covered a lot of area, and was a longer flight than the helicopters.  The cost was lower than the helicopters, and weight was not a concern.  Every seat is a window seat with a great view.  They do pick ups and drop you off, even at the cruise ship dock.  If you are on the Pride of America, the flight is a good way to fill the morning before the ship sails.  I would definatly recomend the flight.

Bought the air and sea combo. Haven't used the sea part yet. Scheduling and checking was easy. Flight was awesome. Nick was our pilot. The weather wasn't all that great, seems to be typical in the winter. We weren't able to go around the island to the west due to low ceilings and showers, a good real time decision.  The flight was well narrated and there wasn't a lot of downtime.  We haven't been on a helicopter tour, but this was more affordable and I don't think there is anything we missed out on. As a pilot, I prefer flying in an airplane vs a helicopter anyway, so may be biased there.  With the narration, they had some background Hawaiian music as well as listening to the air traffic control frequencies.  They took a picture of the group right before the flight and emailed the picture for free. The plane did have air conditioning though I did get a little warm yet my girlfriend was comfortable.  Seats were assigned due to weight and balance.  Landing was smooth and uneventful with a short taxi back to the parking area.  I would certainly do it again.

Air Ventures provided us with an hourlong adventure that gave us a bird's eye view of the beautiful landscape, oceanfront and history of the island of Kauai. 

From the time we checked in until we left everything was handled efficiently and professionally. Our pilot gave us a smooth flight along with an interesting narration describing everything we could see. He made sure to give people on each side of the plane a chance to have a look at all the attractions, but with the plane being only two seats wide, i was able to take pictures out of both sides with no trouble.

Having access to the air traffic control channel through our headsets added an interesting touch.

A perfect chance to see just how rugged the island terrain is. Truely a wonderful trip  Only one small instance of turbulence,  felt very safe.
.

it is really worth doing and it won't cost you a fortune. we did our booking online before we went on our cruise on the "spirit of America". Most people that we spoke to on the boat did not give flying around the island a thought, they only thought of a helicopter ride but were put off by the expense of the flight. Most opted for bus trips. Ther flight around kaurai takes about an hour and you really see plenty...all the attractions..take your camera as you are going to use it a lot..The airfield is very close to the harbour area and take a taxi and that  will cost you about $13 usd...The staff at the airport are very helpfull.    Don't bus it ..fly it   it's great and you will really enjoy it

review_title: The most breathtaking and informative tour of our lives.
review_text: Out pilot, Harry took us on a beautiful adventure showing us the most breathtaking views we have seen out of all the islands.  All of our questions were answered and we were told about all the hot spots.  We will definitely be back soon for another excursion.

My daughter and I chose Air Ventures because it cost less than the helicopter tours.  We were very glad we did.  It was a wonderful tour, the pilot, Paul, pointed out all the sights and was very knowledgeable about the island and the geography and geology, and even restaurants! My daughter thought it might be scary at first, but it wasn't, and she loved it too.

review_title: Awesome once in a lifetime experience.
review_text: The receptionist was pleasant and courteous. Updated us on the time of take- off and encouraged us to use the restrooms. The pilot was very professional and took time to welcome us all and ensured our comfort. The views were awesome and he pointed them all out for us. The info and stories he shared were very local and we appreciate his sense of humor as well.

We signed up for the AirVentures tour as part of a package with HoloHolo … this was an excellent experience. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and skilled at avoiding turbulence while providing us with the best views of the island possible. We have done the helicopter tours before and this was very comparable in quality, but cost less. I would highly recommend this trip to all. The next time we are in Kauai we will look into taking this trip again.

My family and I took a plane ride with Air Ventures in August 2013.  If you are visiting Kauai, I would highly you recommend you see it by air.  Or you will be missing most of the beauty of the island.  We originally picked the plane due to weight restrictions on the helicopters.  The planes do not have any, but afterwards I was glad we choose the plane.  The pilot was excellent and very professional.  He gave a very informative narrative as we flew around the island.  It also included the sea tour with our package, which was also worth it and together, was a well rounded tour of what Kauai has to offer by sea and air.  Go with Air Ventures, you won't be disappointed.

review_title: Great trip, great pilot, beautiful views
review_text: We took the Air Ventures flight as part of the Best of Kauai tour.  We've done the helicopter before and enjoyed this flight much more.  We were a party of 6 which is the same number of seats available on the plane so we had it just for us.  The pilot was exceptional - very professional and gave detailed commentary of what we were seeing.  Waterfalls, Waimea Canyon, and Na Pali Coast were breathtaking.  Weather was good so we got to fly into the crater area which was an extra benefit.  Wouldn't hesitate to take this trip again.  Even my 85 year old Aunt loved it! so it's appropriate for all age groups.  And, as a plus, they provide you with a free photo of your party with the pilot at flight completion.

This was my 3rd trip to Kauai, but to see it from the air was even more breathtaking than i imagined! Nick not only is a skilled pilot, but also did a fine job describing the gorgeous scenery. Robin, manning the phone and front desk, greeted us warmly, and took & emailed photos of us in front of the plane.

We were picked up from Robin on the morning of our flight and found her to be a lovely knowledgeable local. We weighed in and didn't have to wait long before we were heading out to the plane and given our seats,my husband scored the front seat,there was only 6 of us and the pilot,little plane but all good. The views we seen were spectacular and no photo could do it justice,wow.We had a great flight but unfortunately the lady behind me was violently ill the whole flights so it was a little uncomfortable for me but would do it again in a heartbeat.It was the smallest plane I ever went on but it was fine,a little bouncy but felt completely safe at all times.

review_title: Fantastischer Rundflug über eine traumhafte Insel
review_text: Wir hatten einen super Rundflug mit einem fantastischen Blick auf alle Highlights der Insel. Das Personal war super freundlich und sehr kompetent. An den wichtigsten Highlights ist der Pilot gekreist, so dass aus allen Perspektiven Blicke und Fotos erhascht werden konnten. Besonders toll fanden wir auch, das von dem Personal vor dem Rundflug ein Foto von uns vor dem Flugzeug gemacht wurde, welches uns schon während des Rundfluges zugesandt wurde. Auch die überreichte DVD ist ein tolles Erinnerungsgeschenk. Wir sind total von AirVentures begeistert und können den Rundflug nur weiterempfehlen.

review_title: By far better than a helicopter!!!!
review_text:
Everyone gets a window seat....how cool! This is much quieter, smoother and all around a better option. Our pictures were perfect. I do suggest doing this at the start of your stay. Do not hesitate to use Air Adventures!!  Thanks to Reese and Harry for a perfect outing. 
Excellent!!!!!

We were three couples that were visiting Kauai for the first time. We wanted to make the most out of our trip so we signed up for a tour that included air, water and land. We started out with a one hour plane ride that was amazing. We saw all parts of the island ---------amazing views that were spectacular. Then we did a river boat tour and finished up with a wonderful guide that showed us so many wonderful things while riding in a van. It was a long day, but we felt like we really had a great introduction to Kauai.  We were particularly thrilled to be seeing the island by plane. Highly recommend this tour.

Although we had a great pilot, his name was Paul I can't say the same thing about Robin. The woman that GREETS you when you arrive on location where the plane leaves. 
We arrived at 8. The tour started at 8.30. I had booked the air and sea combo a couple of months before. We paid for just the air tour first, robin asked me if i wanted a receipt ( the only receipt they give is via email) I told her no after a couple minutes I went to the desk and asked her if she could send me the receipt so when i go to my sea tour I'll show them the receipt to have proof for the combo price. She rolled her eyes and said I asked you if you wanted the receipt and you said no. I told her my reason why I want it, she huffed but after a while the receipt was sent. I wish i can say that the rudeness from robin stopped there. 
We went for the tour which was amazing. Paul knew what he was doing, he deserves 5 Star for his service. 
When we got back from the tour I  wasn't feeling good so my boyfriend and I decided to cancel the sea tour that we were doing in the afternoon. My boyfriend called holo holo charters and told them our situation. They usually dont cancel if its not 48 hours prior departure time but we couldnt possibly know how I'm going to feel from the plane ride. The lady He spoke to talked to her manager and where able to help us but we had to pay the full price for air ventures.  There was a $30 difference which was fine by us. Since  we were still in air ventures parking lot my boyfriend decided to go and talk to Robin instead of calling her. BIG MISTAKE! He told her what's happening, she started knocking the keyboard around yelling 'no no no thats not possible'. He let her have her tantrum. When she was finished he told her that he had called holo holo charters and they said it was okay. She called them and the lady my boyfriend spoke to before said it was okay. She hanged up started arguing again  that she have to charge me more, have to do more paperwork bla bla bla.... Instead of thanking me for letting her know to charge me more! 

On this vacation i visited all the islands of Hawaii, my boyfriend and i did a lot of tours but by far Robin was the rudest person we met on this trip.  I'm sorry I had to give one star for this review because the air tour was really funny and it was really worth it. you can't see the amazing views we saw from the plane any other way and the pilot was very knowledgable.

We intended to take a helicopter trip around the island and had done all the research to select a good company. At our resort orientation meeting,  we became intrigued by Air Ventures presentation,  changed our mind,  and booked with them. We couldn't be happier with the decision. Nick, our pilot was great, turning the plane around so both sides would able to get good shots.  Everyone had a separate window so no one had to shoot over/around other people. After the flight we told other passengers we had thought about helicopters, but were really happy we made this decision.  One other couple said they had the same thoughts, and they also believed they made a great decision. It was my first flight in a small plane,  and while a little tight (I'm 6'2"), no other problems. Great commentary. I'd recommend Air Ventures in a heartbeat.

review_title: Great trip-best way to see Kauai and Napali coast
review_text: We had a great trip. Paul was great showing us everything on the island. Breath taking views. Great value for our money. So glad we did it.

We really enjoyed the tour because it was not like anything we had done before.  It was a unique entertaining and learning experience while showing us an aerial view of Kauai.  We will highly recommend your tour.

Thank you,

George and Jane Kennedy

Incredible views, and knowledgeable pilot! Plane was clean and very safe.  Rode the "co-pilot seat" and felt like part of the crew!  Big windows allow for easy viewing and photographing in-flight.  Great views over all of the great sights of Kauai.  Try and combine this with the the catamaran trip - the "Air and Sea" combo for some savings.  Air and sea are the two ways to get a glimpse of this beautiful island.  

Highly recommend!

Being a private, I prefer the fixed wing airplane over a helicopter, because everybody has a window seat.  We've taken airplane tours over two of the other islands and knew we needed to take one over Kauai also.  There is just no better way to see the islands!  The scenery on Kauai just can't be beat!  The beauty and diversity is excellent. We felt Air Ventures was the best value over other tour companies.  Taking pictures through the windows came out beautifully.  A must do!

This was one of our highlights of our trip! My girlfriend suffers from motion sickness, so helicopter rides are not an option. Thankfully we found Air Ventures and she and I both had an awesome time - plus she didn't need to use their little white bags. :)

Our pilot was Paul and he was a very nice guy. He seemed quite knowledgeable about the island and certainly experienced as a pilot. The plane was comfortable and looked very new inside. The windows were large and gave us a great view as we flew over Waimea and the Na Poli coast (among other places).

Small tip: try to sit on the right-side of the plane. They do turnarounds to show off the views to both sides of the plane, but it seemed like overall the right-side got a slightly better view.

I strongly recommend this tour for anyone wanting an aerial view of the Garden Island.

review_title: Great way to see all of island.
review_text: Thrilling to see all of island. Safe plane. Knowledgable pilot. Able to take incredible pictures. Had mount for GoPro camera.

My wife and I were on our honeymoon and planned on taking an air tour of Kauai, Hi and found Air Ventures Hawaii while doing a Google search while in Hi. We called them and found the person on the phone extremely friendly and answered all of our questions and offered us times to go that were less turbulent. We booked our flying tour of Kauai with Air Ventures Hawaii as an alternative to a helicopter tour and we loved it. Not only was it about half the cost of a helicopter tour it was more enjoyable as we were able to see everything. It was a wonderful trip and our pilot, Paul, was not only an excellent pilot but he provided a detailed narration of the island of Kauai and pointed out a lot of cool things. We were taken all over the island and saw all of the falls, the beautiful mountains, and the beaches. Pilot Paul also flew us through a few rainbows to take great pictures of as well. The staff was friendly and came across as they wanted to make sure we had the best possible time. We were encouraged from the initial call to bring our cameras so we can get great pics and glad we listened. The plane was roomy and the headsets had the perfect volume to hear everything. The windows on the sides of the plane were fantastic as they were big enough to get a great view of everything. I had the pleasure of sitting it the co-pilot seat which had incredible views of the side and front. Air Venutes Hawaii made sure that the plane went through a walk through during their pre-flight checks and made safety their top priority.The tour lasted about an hour and we got some great pictures. We would highly recommend Air Ventures Hawaii as so glad that we did it.
Had an excellent time with air ventures,  Our pilot, Paul was very informative about the island of Kauai. Also the ground crew was very friendly. I would personally recommend this tour for everybody.

Even though it was a little rainy during our flight, we enjoyed it very much.
I think the overcast skys actually made for better photos. There was no glare from the sun.
Everyone at Air Ventures was friendly and knowledgable. We arrived a little early and had a nice chat with the gal at the front desk before our flight.
The scenery was really spectacular. I can see why Hollywood likes to film there.
If you have never flown in a small plane and are not sure about doing so, rest assured that it is a very easy and comfortable ride.

I've been to Kauai several times and have seen and done most things there. Told my wife I wanted to do something I hadn't done before. I saw the biplane flying one day and decided that would be it. The trip was simply incredible. The seating is a little snug for two, but the trip was smooth and relaxed. Even though I have driven and walked many areas of the island, the aerial view is visually stunning. Picture taking is a challenge due to the open air cockpit, wind, and just hanging on to the camera. But it is really the live views that are the attraction. Harry, our pilot, was friendly and informative. Seeing the things from the air that we had experienced on the ground brought a whole new appreciation and perspective. Next visit, I will be up there again!

review_title: Great Views and Stories of Kauai!
review_text: Our flight over the island of Kauai was fantastic!  We had previously taken a helicopter flight, but we did not see nearly as much as we did on this fixed-wing fllight!  The plane was so quiet (good head sets!) and our pilot was so good.  He told us about what we were seeing, not just what it was.  He was also very, very good about making sure that both sides of the plane had ample opportunity to see things.  He answered all our questions.  We highly recommend this trip to every visitor to the island.  It is the best way to see the overall island and get a good feeling for locations.  This was our sixth visit to the island and we learned a lot and saw many things that we had not seen before.  We also liked that the plane used less fuel and less expensive and polluting fuel than the competition!

Our fixed-wing plane tour will linger in our memories even better than the helicopter ride we enjoyed years earlier!  Our pilot told us the history of the villages, agricultural areas, and coastal scenes as we passed them. He explained how this relates to present conditions, and answered any questions that we had. The flight was smooth and comfortable with great visibility through the ample windows by each seat. Our pilot maneuvered the plane so that passengers on each side could see points of interest. The plane was narrow enough to allow effective picture taking on both sides. 
We were fascinated by the many waterfalls which were slowly cutting the deep valleys deeper. Heavy rain at mountain tops made the rivers brown with sediment that also colored the bays at their exits. Rain and mist in some areas gave us beautiful rainbows!

We chose to fly over Kauai by plane rather than helicopter and we are glad we did. We did not miss out on seeing anything and it put into perspective what we had seen whilst touring around "on the ground" the previous day. Our pilot, Paul, was very informative in his narration pointing out all the spots of interest as well as some history. The coastline of  this island is spectacular - the Na Pali coastline is unbelievable and a spot that you cannot drive to. This flight is value for money when compared to flying by helicopter and the windows enable easy photo taking so don't forget to take your camera with you.  This is a must do tour when you are in Kauai.

This was our first time on a small plane and we would go back in a heartbeat.  We were flabbergast at the incredible scenery: canyons, valleys, waterfalls, beaches and fantastic views of the coastline.  We knew helicopters could bring us closer to take photos of waterfalls, beaches, etc. but the panoramic view from the plane was absolutely amazing.  We have exceptional photos and memories.  Thanks to our pilot Harry who gave us a smooth and entertaining ride with his commentaries.  Thanks for everything!

Harry, our pilot, was knowledgeable, skilled and entertaining. This excursion was the highlight of our trip. Really the best way to see the island and gave us ideas of where we wanted to drive to see things upclose.  We started out with calm sunny skies and saw so many rainbows; towards the end of the tour the weather turned and we had to land earlier than expected but still worth it!

We called Air Ventures after our helicopter tour was cancelled due to rain. Boy, did we luck out! They are half the price of a helicopter and longer tours! The pilot and the staff were great! We were on the cruise ship and they picked us up at the shops a few blocks away. (You can take a free shuttle to the shops). We got to see so much more of Kauai this way since there aren't any roads out on the Na Pali coast!

review_title: Fly Kauai: Experience of a lifetime
review_text: We did this the last day of our honeymoon, and it was spectacular! The views are stunning, and it is really nice to be able to get some perspective on the size of the island, and where things are. I would recommend doing this at least a few days into your trip, or after you have had the chance to explore the outskirts of the island, so that you can orient yourself better. Our tour was $125/person, a great deal in comparison to the helicopter rides, which were upwards of $235/person. The ONLY downside is that on our particular flight, we had a person who got sick and we found out what she had for lunch. :( So - due to possible turbulence, you may want to take some motion sickness medication before you go on this tour. But - the Na Pali coast, Waimea Canyon, Hanapepe Canyon, "Jurassic" Falls and Kalalau Valley are stunning from the air, and you get to see places where 'Pirates of the Caribbean' and other movies were filmed. You get to see places that are only accessible by hiking; so if you are short on time, this is an excellent option. One thing I would mention is that there is NOTHING like seeing Kauai from the air. Nothing. We did a sunset dinner cruise to the Na Pali coast, and - though beautiful - it was a totally different experience from the air.

I have been on two helicopter tours over Kauai and each was good but the ride in the bi-plane was awesome. I would do it again in a heartbeat.  Our pilot, Harry, provided a commentary that was just enough but not overly invasive allowing us to enjoy the beautiful scenery.  Thanks for a great time.

We have never done air tour and it was both beautiful and exciting. Would recomend it to anyone who loves Kauai and has is adventurouse . Our pilot Harry had a great voice and pointed out all the sites beautifly.

Oh my goodness! If you want to get up close to the spires on NaPali coast this will knock you out! Not only that, flying over Waimea Canyon was so awesome with waterfalls everywhere!  I highly recommend this flight to give you a total taste of Kauai!! 
If you have fear of heights think twice though.

What a delightful and exciting adventure to fly over Kauai on a sunny morning.  We have been coming to Kauai for 29 years but we never realized how big and and the breath taking beauty of the island.  It is hard to imagine how many huge water falls the island really has without actually seeing them.  We were amazed at how clear the water was all around the island.  We could see the shallow areas, reefs, caves, and crashing waves. We learned about the vegetation by looking down on the changing areas. The Napali Coast is not really understood until you can see the huge valleys. It was the high lite of our trip. Thank you Air Ventures! Rick & Anne
We took this tour this morning and it was awesome! It's difficult to describe  the beauty of the Na Pali Cost and Waimea Canyon.  Our pilot (Paul) was great.  You must see Kauai by land, air and sea!

review_title: This is the way to see Kauai!
review_text: Our Pilot-Harry was wonderful. The entire day rained and stopped just when it was time for our flight. It was perfect! We saw so many rainbows. It is a must do. My father got to sit up front in the co-pilot's seat and got such great pictures. It was an experience that our entire family will never forget. Thanks for the great memories!

AirVentures offers open cockpit bi-plane rides in addition to enclosed cabin aircraft.  Our pilot was Kevin who expertly piloted his red Waco over Kauai, giving an informative running commentary on the history of the island and the sights below through the provided intercom in our cloth helmets. This was the highlight of our vacation.

After our helicopter tour cancelled on us due to a rainy day, we secured a wonderful excursion with AirVentures. We were able to see the entire island of Kauai as the pilot steered around a couple showers. The view from the plane was absolutely awe-inspiring. Thanks for the great trip!!

I know there are going to be individuals who are reading this review who are considering their options in exploring the island of Kauai. So when you read this please consider this way of flying as the only possible way to get the view of Kauai that you otherwise will not, especially with the expense most of us are currently involved with while visiting the garden island. Kevin was "The Man" when it came to not only the knowledge of the Island but the flying skill set you would want while cruising over this magnificent canvas that the Lord drew for us to view. Some of you might have some hesitation in getting in this plane, but let me put that idea at ease. It's the safest type of plane you would want to take while cruising over Kauai. Please consider this your "only" option in seeing the Island the way it was meant to be seen. To Kevin and his team, it was a blast and we will be back to do all over again soon. 

Until then,

Merlin and Rhonda

review_title: The nearest I've been to heaven
review_text:
Since I was unable to parasail or zip line, I decided to take the plane to see Kaua'i.  It really completed my trip to Maui and Kaua'i.  I wanted to jump right out of the plane - the beauty is like nothing I've ever seen.  The flight and crew were wonderful - we had doubts in the beginning if we would fly that morning but we did!  The Napali coast is truly a wonder of the world.  My seatmate and I kept switching our cameras-we each had pictures of the right and left side of the plane.  I felt like I had seen "it all" after taking this flight - it just went by too quickly.

Mary Statsmann

Six members of our family took an airplane ride with Air Ventures over Kauai on our first day of our week long trip.  What a great way to start our vacation!  All through our trip, we could remember what that area looked like from the air.  It gave us a great overview of this beautiful island.  We were glad we took an airplane rather than a helicopter when we saw and heard all the helicopters around the island.  Air Ventures Hawaii was a wonderful experience!

There was so much to see the hour flight seemed to go by in a few minutes.  We covered the entire island from the coasts to the 4,000 ft water falls.  We had clear views and rainy views very typical of the wettest place on the planet. Paul covered the entire island and answered all our questions, while flying and keep track of all the other aircraft in the area. We had a great flight, Jeff really enjoyed being in the co-pilot seat. Thanks for the memories.

review_title: What a great flight in paradise!
review_text: This was our second flight with Air Ventures Hawaii. Both flights were truly amazing! This time my cousin and his wife joined us. They were truly amazed with the beauty of this island. As were we! The pilot did an outstanding job of telling us about all the different sights. I would highly recommend this tour of the island of paradise.

review_title: A great way to see Kaua'i
review_text:
Yes, there are helicopter rides. Good, I have no doubt, but this is a great trip.
From the young people who check you in to knowledgeable pilots (Paul, in this case).
It an hour of great fun and even better views. /you will not be disappointed.
Sights from the coasts to the NaPali Cliffs, to the North Shore at Hanalei and Princeville, to
the island's interior with stunning waterfalls.
You'll see way more that you can from the car....
Do yourself a favour and travel with Air Ventures.
They even do combo flights with luau or boat rides, if you are interested.
Enjoy.

This was our first trip to Hawaii. We chose Air Ventures for our flight over Kauai. We had a wonderful time. Our flight was with a Cessna, just the Pilot and the two of us. Our pilot made our trip even more enjoyable with his knowledge. This was truly one of our dream vacations and Air Ventures made it special. I would highly recommend Air Ventures to everyone interested in seeing the island by air.

review_title: All parts of a beautiful island
review_text:
I'm certianly not a shopper and Air Ventures gave me a perfect way to spend an afternoon and I am sure my wife thanks you as well.  We visited all four islands but I must say Kauai is by far our favorite.  The staff was more than helpful and knowledgable.  The plane was very comfortable
and you were able to see the sites from any seat.  The pilot was interesting and had a lot of info about the island.  I would certianly reccomend this tour to anyone.  It was well worth the money and time.  My wife says thanks again!

review_title: A flight you will remember for a lifetime
review_text: The adventure was a pleasure from start to finish as we were able to really see the beauty of the island and a staff that was professional and a pleasure to deal with
The views and experience were  awesome. The plane ride was smooth, comfortable and informative. A quick way to grasp all that Kauaii has to offer. So glad we took the tour.

This was our first trip to Hawaii.  We chose Oahu and Kauai as the two islands we wanted to visit.  We had our excursions planned out for us in Oahu, however, in Kauai we were pretty much on our own.  We chose Air Ventures for our tour of Kauai.  We had a wonderful time.  There were four of us and each of us had a window seat.  That was the main reason for choosing to tour the island by plane instead of by helicopter.  Paul was our pilot and he made our trip even more enjoyable with his knowledge.  This was truly one of our dream vacations and Air Ventures made it special.  I would highly recommend Air Ventures to everyone interested in seeing the island by air.

I say it is better than a helicopter because every seat is a window seat with Air Ventures.  In a helicopter, I always seem to be "seated" in the middle of the row and not by a window.  With Air Ventures, bring your camera and start shooting because the views are nothing short of outstanding and your pilot is very knowledgeable of the island and will answer your questions while in flight. If you can only do one thing while you are in Kauai, then make sure Air Ventures is that one thing!

Excellent price, great service and terrific sights to see on this Air Tour.  I am very overweight and Air Ventures answered all of my questions.  They ensured that I felt comfortable and we able to enjoy the sights.  Price included a photo and a free DVD.  I will go again when I come back to Kauai.

What a GREAT experience to finish up my vacation. I have never flown in a small plane before and always wanted to fly in a biplane. I also wanted to do some sort of aerial tour of Kauai during my vacation. So when I read about the biplane tours at Air Ventures I said sign me up. The pilot / tour guide was great. During pre-flight he explained the history of the plane which was very interesting. A pre-flight photo was taken of us with the pilot and plane at no charge as a souvenir which was every nice. They gave us "old-timey" headgear to wear with goggles during the flight which provided communication with the pilot during the flight. The pilot gave a great tour of the Island that included great commentary and history of all the sights that we saw along the way. I must admit the flight was much smoother than I had anticipated and extremely enjoyable. There were a lot of great sights, beaches, hikes, etc. that we experienced while in Kauai , but for me, this was the best. Thanx Air Ventures for a great experience.

This was a first fight for me. Wonderful views of Kauai. Could not  have seen such magnificent canyons.waterfalls even rainbows. The pilot was very knowledgeably. Would recommend Air Adventures to anyone if you want to see the best of Kauai.

this is by far the most recomended experiance we had in kauai which is also the island we liked most amongst the islands of hawaii. the best views and breathtaking beaches you see from above are no comparison to anything i've ever seen in my life.

the bi plane is also a retro experiance and kevin the pilot is awesome. not scary and exciting tour around the island.
Wow this was a great tour! Well worth it! We got some amazing pictures, we will defenetly do it again. We recommend Air Ventures!!

Just returned from an amazing ride on a biplane with Kevin. The views were unbelievable, and the accompanying narration was very informative.  We have taken helicopters before, but the biplane was something really special. Smooth ride and experience.

This was a great way to see Kauai. The views of the remote canyons were magnificent.  The pilot was informative and gave a great tour. Loved the fact that we saw places from the air that you cannot readily get to by land.  Would definitely recommend Air Adventures.
We had seen the coastline from the ocean before.  This however was a wonderful experience.  Very informative.
If you only get to do one thing in Kauai do the airplane view of the island!!!  Is awesome-best ever viewing of the island....the canyon was beautiful

The scenery was spectacular no doubt about it.  Our guide shared lots of great information.  I must admit I was disappointed in the waterfalls.  They were so far away that they looked like little white lines on the mountains.   I guess I expected more.

review_title: Breathtaking, beautiful, factual, adrenaline rush fun packed hour.
review_text: Our piolet was awesome he knew how to fly safley but took us places I never thought he could get too.try it and start living a little...I had fears at first but after 5 minutes.it was so awesome I realized it wasn't risky at all the piolet is so good he could fly a tank with no engine.and land it safley.

The trip was incredible. We saw so much more of the island than we could have seen otherwise. And our pilot, Paul, was very professional and did a great job. Overall we would recommend to any and everyone.

We thoroughly enjoyed our awesome plane ride. We originally had it scheduled on a day that was rainy and overcast and we were so happy that the first flight was rescheduled. The next date was absolutely beautiful and we could all see for miles and miles! We flew everywhere that a helicopter could ride and each person had a window so we could all see very well... actually much better than in a helicopter.
It was a great experience and we would highly recommend it!!

What an experience.  I was very nervous prior to boarding the plane.  The pilot Nick was very understanding, reassuring and gave me the few minutes I needed to be comfortable.  The flight was very smooth and Nick kept me informed when he was turning or hitting any bumps.  The flight was great and the views were amazing. Nick was very informative and knowledgeable about the island. I went from unsure about flying in a small plane to it being the highlight of my trip.  Highly recommend.
From takeoff to landing everything was beautiful. To see the island from above it was even more beautiful.  It gives you a new since of natures beauty.

Had a wonderful flight have been on helicopters before but this was totaly different.our pilot was Great he was very knowlegable about the island, it is such a magical place.We came on a cruise ship to Kauai and found Air Aventures on line,was thrilled we did.A GREAT time was had by all.A flight to remember

The "red baron" bi-plane tour was amazing!  The captain was very informative and knowledgeable about the area.  There is nothing like the view from the air and the thrill of the bi-plane!  We are so glad we took this tour, it was definitely a highlight of our trip!

Our experience on this venture was positive in every aspect. The facility was easy to find. The staff friendly professional and a pleasure to do business with. We thoroughly enjoyed the flight and saw beautiful sights all over the island. Especially enjoyed the personal mikes which applied us to ask questions throughout the flight without having to yell over the sound of the engine. Would do it again in a heartbeat.

Viewing Kauai from the air with Air Ventures is one of  the most amazing experiences I have ever had.  It's a great way to see the entire island.  The otherwise inaccessible areas of this beautiful island, the coastline, the waterfalls etc were all very spectacular from above.  Our knowledgeable pilot provided us with relevant and interesting information while flying at heights and speed that allowed us to capture the amazing sceneries.  A trip I would highly recommend.

What a spectacular flight!  Our captain was a great tour guide, very knowledgeable about the people, culture and history of the island. So much of Kaua'i' beauty can only be seen from the air and it is amazing!  The rugged west coast and variety of rock colours up the valleys was a wonderful surprise.  Well worth the adventure. 
Wendy C.

I have never seen anything more breathtaking than this flight over Kauai.  We have been here twice now and have seen Kauai from the water and the ground.  We were blown away by the awesome view by airplane.  I highly recommend this to anyone interested in seeing the whole island for a better understanding of what Kauai is about.  This sky view helps us with what is here and helped focus in our minds what we have seen and continue to see.  

Will Pullins
pullws@comcast.net

review_title: Most awesome way to see the beauty of Kauai
review_text: From the initial reservation to the time we showed up at Air Ventures Hawaii, everyone has been so nice; we really didn't know what to expect, but the pilot, Paul, made us feel at ease with his handling of the airplane and his knowledge of the island and its history.  There were many breathtaking views and the take-off and landing were flawless.  We would highly recommend anyone coming to Kauai to book a flight with Air Ventures Hawaii!  Because our trip to Kauai was a celebration of our anniversary, we wanted everything to be perfect - Air Ventures did not let us down!
What a wonderful way to experience the beauty of the island!  And Paul, our Pilot, made sure everyone felt comfortable during the flight!  A definite on the TO DO list!!

The captain was well versed, had a dry humor and gave a great tour. The scenery is amazing and both sides of the plane were given opportunities for picture taking. We were awe of the raw beauty of Kauai. You have no idea of the ruggedness of Kauai without seeing it from the air. Highly reccommended.

review_title: Great way to see the Island
review_text: Our flight was very nice. Our pilot, Harry, was friendly and full of good info. The flight itself went smoothly, with the exception of our other passengers being late. We covered all of the major sites and cities on the island, giving us a good idea of where to go. I would recommend doing this tour early in your visit as weather can be an issue but also because the overview can help with you planning. I would have preferred to ride in a helicopter, but my new bride was afraid of small aircraft so this was the lesser of two evils for her.

user_location: North Myrtle Beach, South Carolina, United States
review_title: Fantastics views on a fantastic day
review_text: Air Ventures Hawaii does 70 minute flights over most all of Kauai, and for us it was spectacular. We got to see all the sights from the 6 seater aircraft. Unlike a helicopter, everyone had a window seat. We were all able to see the mostly inaccessible sights Kauai has to offer. Our pilot kept us informed about what we were seeing, and was extremely professional. They picked us up very close to where our cruise ship docked so we had transport to and from the airport. Every person we dealt with was very friendly and helpful. This is a great way to see some of the most beautiful scenery in the world. If you're ever in Kauai, I highly recommend Air Ventures Hawaii.

We signed up for the flight and luau combo and couldn't be more pleased with our experiences! Nothing compares to the views from the sky! Our pilot was very knowledgable about the island but sometimes it was hard to understand him! Overall definitely worth it!

We were on Kauai as part of Cruise of Islands.  Having done helicopter trip many times was very excited to give Air Ventures a shot.  It was great! Plenty of time to take pictures and see the things you can't see when zooming in and out of canyons.  Plenty of space inside and everyone had a great view.Would recommend to all ages.

review_title: Great way to see inaccessible Kauai
review_text: Had a great experience on our flight today. This trip gives you a great way to see the amazing geography of this Hawaiian island. The Pilot Nick was very informative and tried to ensure that we saw as much as possible despite the mist which did in fact did enhance the scenery to some exoect with an ethereal feel.

We were on the island for a friend's wedding and I surprised my wife with the air tour / dinner cruise adventures. The air tour was amazingly beautiful. The only reason I didn't rate a 5 is that there wasn't good leg room...I am not tall. Otherwise the people at the desk and the pilot were very friendly.  Would, and have already, recommend to friends. In fact my neice is on Oahu this week and will be taking the air tour for that island.

Thanks for a great experience, 

Shellie B.

What can I say a biplane painted red with a pilot named Kevin the Red Baron. Did helicopter rides before but nothing is like the open cockpit of a biplane, the wind in your hair with the freedom to look all around in any direction. It is like being in a top down convertible but safer, no traffic. If you have a question I have to believe Kevin will have the answer, he did answer every question that I asked. They will make this an experience you will remember, and possibly do again, I know I will. Aloha Kevin and Ingrid.

review_title: Fantastic Flight Around the Garden Island of Kaua'i
review_text:
We took the Red Barron Bi-Plane out of Lihue's Main airport with Captian Kevin at the Controls, it was the Best Sightseeing I have ever experienced.  We upgraded to a 60-70 Minute Flight which took us the entire circumference of the island and inland into one of the Volcano craters.  I would Highly Suggest this.  We (Myself and my Wife) sat together in the Front of the open Cockpit with Kevin At the Controls Behind us.  With the Noise Canceling Microphones, Quiet Headsets and a Windshield, we were able to ask questions to Kevin the pilot and he was described Lots of History and areas of the Island that you could not always access by car.

Once Again, I would do this again !
Thanks Air Ventures !
Jessica & Sylvia
Seattle, Wa

I gave the biplane ride to my husband as an anniversary gift.  He had done a biplane ride before on Oahu, but this was the first time for me.  Our pilot put us at ease right away explaining the plane and what we would see during the tour.  He was knowledgeable of the island and kept us entertained and informed throughout our 1 hour trip. I would highly recommend the 1 hour trip.  You get to see parts of the island you just can't see any other way.  This company and the biplane ride is a must do for your activities while on the island.

Our flight in the Snoopy two Bi-Plane with Pilot Kevin was the most exhilerated, fabulous time ever!!!!! A dream come true! Beautiful sites and lts of interesting facts about Hawaii. 
This is a must do!
Thanks so much, Kevin and AirVentures!
Elisa
Had a wonderful time on our Kauai overflight.  Pilot was great and plane was in excellent shape.  Good bang for your buck...

My husband and I were thrilled and 100% satisfied!  After booking with Air Ventures we were a bit skeptical because their price is unbeatable!  Other companies charge twice as much. But after the tour we couldn't have been more pleased.  Our tour guide was funny, informative and very knowledgeable! We will take this tour again wteb we return and highly recommend Air Ventures to all who would love to see the island from above without paying a high price!  Thank you!  Dan and Evelyn

We chose the open air biplane instead of the typical helicopter tour of Kauai just for something new and different! We were not disappointed!! Ingrid booked our reservations and was friendly and helpful. Our pilot, Kevin, was terrific. He was knowledgeable about the island, answered any questions we had about flying and the plane, and was so personable. The ride was smooth and we had no issues with motion sickness (and we were both worried we would). It's really hard to describe the views in words....just breathtaking, and Kevin would turn the plane around so we could see things from two different vantage points. It was great to have the three-way headsets so we could all communicate and ask questions as we flew over things. This is a once in a lifetime experience and everyone should do it at least once! Being in the open air was amazing!!!

review_title: Best way to view the whole island!!
review_text: I am terrified of little planes, but I faced my fears and I was glad I did! We picked a gorgeous day to fly and the turbulence was not bad at all! I would totally recommend this to anyone!!

review_title: Great way to end our vacation.
review_text: Air Ventures was everything they advertised. An exciting excursion for a good value and a knowledgeable pilot.we took this flight on our last day of vacation and even after anticipating it for a week, we got what we expected, and were very pleased.

I had 2 friends with me that had never done this trip before and they absolutely LOVED it!   Kay Landry

What a way to view Kauai.  Everybody was helpful and encouraging. This tour was great! The plane circled around so both sides could see the same view. My Wife took a bunch of pictures. The pilot narrative was entertaining.  We highly recommend this tour.

Living on Kauai is exceptional  it's self however the biplane adventure that Air Ventures Hawaii  supplied me with was the best birthday ever. review_title: the highlight of my Kauai trip
review_text: This was the highlight of my trip to Hawaii. If you don't do anything else, take the air combo trip with air ventures and it covers everything else. This was truly an adventure for me and my family.

My wife and I loved our first bi plane experience, so different from sitting in an enclosed helicopter, feeling the wind on our arms, and faces when we looked out of the cockpit was fantastic. The thrill of the engine starting up and take off and landing is not to be missed, awesome job of our pilot to circle around many of the waterfalls and sights so we both had great views. Wish it was longer, we loved it.

wiew from there is something else not from this world tour gay pilot is really nice. much better sight than from the boat  tours pilot explain sights so you got the picture right from the very start .tell us about not just the place hi tell us about history off kauie.really amasing tour

Awesome experience! This was the highlight of our trip to Kauai. My son and I took the 45 minute biplane tour. It was a nice calm clear day, perfect for flying. Our pilot Nick was outstanding! While he was narrating each area we flew over, he added some insight to its significance. For example, he showed us where the original pineapple plantations were located and explained why they have since relocate them to Maui.

I've been on two helicopter tours on Kauai before and this was a better, more personal experience for me (only 2 passengers at a time) with the open cockpit. Yes, the helicopters may get you closer to some of the landmarks and perhaps better photo opps,,,, but at a much higher price, and I've found those pilots' narration to be quite dull.

Nick gave us a lot of information about the island and the two way communication setup allowed us to ask questions. One of the best parts was when he pulled some high G turns
and some "wing overs" for us. The ride was very exhilarating! I would definitely recommend this as a must do for visitors.

First visit to Hawaii. I knew I wanted to view the island via aircraft but was torn between airplane vs helicopter. I'm so glad we went this way. It was a great price  for what we did. Our pilot was extremely professional and informative. I enjoyed it thoroughly!
Enjoyed a lot. A great way to see the island of Kauai. Very professional staff. Definitely recommend this tour. A must-do when in Kauai.

My wife, son and I were visiting from NZ and decided to take this flight after driving around Kuaui and up to the Waimea Canyon - realising that the most scenic coastal portion (Napoli) has no road access. We chose the six passenger fixed wing aircraft option as opposed to a helicopter flight and we are very glad we did this - a much cheaper (but longer) flight which flew slower and higher than the helicopters and thus gave greater views (and everyone had a window seat). Paul was very friendly and a highly professional, superb pilot. We were able to leave our luggage at the Air Ventures depot before checking in for our flight to Honolulu then NZ. As the flight is mostly clockwise around the island we would suggest opting for the right hand side seats if possible. Because we had booked online we were given a DVD of a typical flight which apart from our own pics is an excelllent momento. Overall an awesome experience and great value for money. We would highly recommend Air Ventures Hawaii to others..

My husband planned this for my 50th Birthday. I was a little apprehensive to go up in a small plane, but wow...what an experience!! The staff was very professional and the pilot was very knowledgeable and shared with us the many points of interest along the way. To see Kauai from the air was breathtaking. We would highly recommend this tour.
I would recommend this to anyone wanting to see or not wanting to see Kauai from the air. One of the most beautiful things I have ever seen and been apart of. Excited to do it again.

review_title: Best way to see the island!
review_text:

review_title: Amazing birds eye view of an exceptionally beautiful island
review_text: We loved this tour and recommend taking the opportunity to see Kauai from the air, you get to see the diversity and beauty of the island. The pilot Paul was great, super friendly. review_title: An amazing, beautiful & informative way to see the island of Kauai!
review_text: We really enjoyed our AirVentures private tour over the island of Kauai today. The views were spectacular, and our pilot turned the plane several times so the people on both sides had great views. I would do this flight on every visit to Kauai.

We would do this again in a heartbeat!

We had a fantastic time.  Harry, the pilot, was very knowledgeable about the island and pointed out many interesting features as we flew slowly through the most spectacular scenery. I was able to take extraordinary photographs that I will enjoy for years.

Had an opportunity to take some first-time visitors on a tour of the Island of Kauai with Air Ventures and couldn't have been happier with everything about the flight. review_title: Got to see Kauai with a knowledgeable tour guide/pilot.
review_text: We saw everything we expected to see and more. We saw waterfalls, the Napoli Coast, the bewches and caves, cliffs, everything. We were able to take pics while flying.

review_title: More at one with the island
review_text: We flew in the open cockpit biplane.  Granted some may not relish the thought of flying out in the open, but once you get used to it you feel more at one with the nature of the island than being in a closed cabin.  Total trust we had in our pilot, and the plane is actually new with contemporary safety features.  Think "Blue Max", "The English Patient", "Jurassic Park", it's all there on this trip.

This was a fantastic way to see the entirety of Kauai. The Na Pali Coastline, a seventeen-mile canyon, and the largest coffee plantation in the U.S. are among the highlights. Well worth the money; a great way to orient one's self and get ideas for subsequent adventures.

The staff was very friendly.  The pilot was knowledgeable and very amusing.  We toured the whole island and one thing that struck me was that he would fly over an area and let the right side see then double back and let the left side get the close up look.  My wife and I had a blast, and would recommend this to anyone that enjoys seeing different perspectives of places.

review_title: Fantastic perspective of what we had witnessed from the ground.
review_text: The pilot was knowledgeable and his relaxed manner was appreciated.  A great value and one of our most memorable experiences in Hawaii.

This was a wonderful way to experience the entire Kauai Island.  Our family of 5 were able to view parts of the island we would not have been able to access from a car and the scenery was extraordinary.  Our pilot, Harry, was excellent letting us know what was coming up in the scenery. review_title: Excellent way to see the Garden Isle!
review_text: My husband and I did this tour as part of our Honeymoon vacation to Hawaii. We were on the flight with another family, but we were able to sit together and each had our own window. We did this tour toward the end of our vacation and LOVED it as a review of all the sites we had visited earlier in the week from the land. The pilot surprised us by circling around ensuring that both sides of the plane had a good view of all the sites. We bought the package deal with the boat tour through Holo Holo which was a perfect compliment. We were able to get 2 vantage points of the Napali Coast (from the air and sea) and the plane took us to see parts of island we otherwise wouldn't have been able to see.

Air Ventures provided a fantastic experience for our family to see all aspects of Kauai!  We saw so many landforms and natural beauty that we would not have been able to see on our own!!  Harry provided great information about all that we were seeing along the way.  From the canyon to the beautiful beaches and the NaPali coastline all were spectacular.  Air Ventures provides the best way to see it all on Kauai!  Thanks Harry and staff for providing a favorite part of our 2013 trip!

review_title: Loved Air Adventures Hawaii - Love Kauai by Air!
review_text: Captain Harry & staff were great!  Was very impressed with the flight coordination of our plane and the other craft in the air.  All 5 in our party had a window seat for an awesome and smooth flight over Kauai.

review_title: Breathtaking Views Of Kauai From The Sky
review_text: Grandma, Grandpa, our daughter and her two girls, 10 and 12, wanted to see the beauty of Kauai from the sky.   We were met at Air Ventures by a friendly staff and professional, safety-minded pilot, assuring our expectations were everything we were excited about.  The knowledgeable pilot flew us over the magnificant air views of Kauai enstilling as much pride in us as he himself had in the Hawaiian culture and the natural beauty of this wonder island.  The plane was comfortable with each of us having our own window.  At the end of the tour, even the children were amazed at what we had just seen and commented to the pilot on the speaker, "that was good!".  We will certainly recommend Air Venture to other Kauai vacationers.

Our Air Hawaii flight was totally amazing!  Seeing Kauai by air is a must and our pilot, Harry, was very informative and friendly. We felt very safe and world definitely recommend Air Ventures Hawaii!

Seeing Kauai from the air was amazing. On this tour, you get to see EVERYTHING! Places that we would not be able to get to by land, we were able to see from the plane. We had a party of 6, so we filled the plane and we each got our own window and were all able to take great pictures. The place where I thought that this tour went above and beyond was that the pilot would circle back around so that BOTH sides of the plane could get a perfect view. 2 of our kids did get sick during the flight, but the pilot was very nice giving them instruction to help make it easier (and they had the necessary supplies for containing the sickness-haha!)
Even with that said, the kids were still glad we did the tour and that they got to see so much. The rest of us loved it. Our pilot was obviously very skilled and we had a perfect take off and landing. 
I absolutely recommend this tour if you don't have a super weak stomach!

review_title: We had a great time with Air Ventures
review_text: We were a party of eight, so we had to split up the group. My brother and I flew with one of their pilots in a smaller but faster Cessna 182, which allowed us to get lower into the canyons, and coastlines. It was an interesting flight....wouldn't rush back to do it again, but it was fun to learn facts and figures about the island and Hawaii, that I wouldn't have ordinarily researched myself. Everyone on their team are super friendly, polite, and knowledgeable. The plane was old but immaculate. The great distraction from the hot weather, and beaches

We thoroughly enjoyed our scenic flight with Nick, a true professional,smooth flight,& awesome views. Would highly recommend this trip.We had a nervous flyer amongst us, but this wasn't an issue as it was a spacious aircraft & the amazing views were a distraction! Thanks for a great experience .

Air Ventures was by far the best way to experience the island, I would have not done it any other way. In just over an hour they took you soaring by ridges over the island, up through canyons, over coastlines, and into the hard-to-reach places of the island (like the Na Pali Coastline). It was by far the coolest thing we did on our entire trip and we HIGHLY recommend it to anyone reading this.

I highly recommend flying with Air Adventures. One of the highlights of our trip! It's impossible to see everything in a week, flying gave us the opportunity to see areas of the island we wouldn't have had a chance to see.

We had a mixed experience with our Air Ventures flight around Kauai - Our flight was cut short due to an electrical failure about half-way through the flight when we were over the Na'Pali coast. Since we didn't have time enough to reschedule the following day we were refunded without any drama or delay.  Up to the point where we had to cut our flight short we had a wonderful time with breathtaking views of Kauai with informed commentary by our excellent pilot. I would definitely recommend Air Ventures for their professional and courteous service.

review_title: Great way to see the geography!
review_text: Our Air Ventures flight provided amazing aerial views of Kauai, including the Napali Coast, the Waimea Canyon, several beautiful waterfalls, bays and beaches. This flight was the best time we had on the Island Would do it again. Well worth the time and good rate's. Pilot was very informative. Thank you for a great time.Stan Johnson retired Air Force C-130 Loadmaster

Jared & Gina

review_title: Exciting, detailed & FUN way to see Kaua'i!

Kevin knew every detail when we asked questions! The take off and landing was extremely smooth and the flight in total lasted somewhere between 45 minutes and one hour.  Definitely worth the money to ride in an open cockpit airplane and have the pilot be as knowledgeable as Kevin was. What an unforgettable memory!

This was the highlight of our trip to the island.  Our pilot was super, very informative, fun and so accommodating.  The day way clear and we saw so much of the awesome island. I would love to send my grandson up in the biplane.  I have recommended your services to a group coming over this year.  Thank you for the

Great view of Kauai, good pilot, enjoyed the jokes, and breath taking views.  Safety of the small plane was explained to us thoroughly, we were weighed to ensure cargo restrictions, and all around felt assurred before taking off.  Would recommend doing this excursion again!

We had a great time.  The pilot Harry was very friendly and knowledgeable about the island.  We were not scared and the plane was very smooth.  You can see sights you would not be able to see from the ground or a boat.
Loved the flight.  The staff was great to work with.  Would highly recommend it!  Got to see all the island has to offer.  Plan this for the first day in Kauai.

organisation and help was first class and the pilot interesting and well informed, making for a fun trip

review_title: An adventure you don't want to miss!

rad pilot(even though he wouldn't let me fly)...great communication in order to make sure the trip was on a good day...everyone had a window seat!...you gotta do this at least once!

I recommend doing the tour around Kauai for everyone visiting the Island.  You get to see everything in the air that you can't see by car. The pilot is very informative and tells you places to see in Kauai.

The air travel experience was one that I will never forget!  The scenic viewing was wonderful and the pilot was very informative about Hawaiian history.  I would highly recommended the trip!

We enjoyed our flight very much.  Our pilot, Paul, made sure everyone got to see the beauty of Kaua'i from another vantage point, the air.  He even provided a tip of where to watch the sunset from the north shore.  I'm glad we decided to take this tour.

Had great time on our flight.  Weather was beautiful!  Staff was helpful, friendly and the pilot did a great job informing us throughout the flight.  Trip was smooth and it's a great way to get a bird's eye view of the island

Four of us went on this sightseeing plane ride. My parents, who are 85 years old, my husband and I had a wonderful time. I especially enjoyed viewing Waiamea Canyon,  Never knew there were so many streams and water falls.  Paul, you did a good job of presenting the highlights...even Julia Robert's hale, and your house in the uplands.  Next time I expect directions for that invitation to join you for cocktails. :)

Mahalo!

review_title: An Amazing Once In A Lifetime Experience

review_title: AMAZING -- Great pilot and tour guide
review_text: I would recommend this tour to anyone visiting Kauai.  I am going to give it to my parent's for their next trip here as as gift.  Much better than a helicopter.
good info nice pilot well worth the time and money we enjoyed it very much and reccomend to anyone trying to learn about kauai.

review_title: Views are great so prepare yourself to enjoy it, wven if you have to take Dramamine.
review_text:

review_title: Flying High with Air Ventures Hawaii
review_text: This was the first activity we did in Kauai.  It was the best decision we could have made.  Flying over the entire island gave us a birds eye view of everything and helped us understand the layout of the island. The views were spectacular.  The pilot was awesome.  He gave just enough information without spoiling the trip with constant banter.  It was incredible to fly over and into the canyon.  We viewed waterfalls galore that can be seen no other way.  Flying the Ne Pali Coast is a must - even if you plan to see it by boat.  (We did both and liked the view from the air better!).  We saw whales from the air too!  Flying with Air Ventures Hawaii is a must do when you visit Kauai!!!

review_title: Beautiful, but a hot and bumpy ride
review_text: This tour was gorgeous. We got to see all the big sites on Kauai, and it was absolutely stunning. However, it has more turbulence than a helicopter tour, and it was very hot. There's a fan that blows on you, but if you go in the summer months, just be aware that you'll probably be hot most of the way. By the end, most of us felt queasy (one man threw up). I would not recommend it for pregnant women. I was 7 months pregnant, and wish I had done the helicopter tour.

The best way to see all of Kauai.  From mountains and canyons to beautiful beaches.  Many waterfalls viewed from the air that would be very difficult if not impossible to see.  The coastal views from the air are unbelievable.  Thank you!!
Our trip with Paul was spectacular, we saw waterfalls, whales, a spectacular view if the Na Pali coastline and even a rainbow. Would definitely do it again.

Our flight with Harry and Air Ventures Hawaii was spectacular!  The views were unbelievable and Harry had lots of interesting facts to share with us.  My husband is a commercial pilot and was a little unsure about flying with another pilot but he quickly became comfortable.  Everyone was very helpful and friendly and we totally enjoyed the whole experience!

My husband and I did the trip to Napali Coast and our pilot was Harry.  What  wonderful views of mountains, ocean and waterfalls.  The sun was out with a light wind so you hardly knew you were in the air.  Saw the Pacific Grand Canyon.  Amazing!!!!! 

Highly recommend it.

review_title: Wonderful way to see the island of Kauai
review_text: We had a wonderful time flying over Kauai with Air Ventures!!! Amazing views and wonderful staff. Was well worth the time and money. Highly recommend this for everyone.  ENJOY!!!

There no way to see all beauty of Kauai except from the air. We're so glad we decided fly with Air Ventures, the pilot did a great job showing us the Island and sharing his knowledge. Everyone who takes this trip will be glad they did. Thank you to the staff for an enjoyable trip, the memories are priceless.

review_title: Incredible Way to See the Island
review_text:
I have taken two flights with Air Ventures while in Kauai and this is about the only way that you will see the island in its entirety - in the air. Much of the island is inaccessible and to get a real idea of this incredible paradise, plan to see it by air.

The plane trip is the perfect length as you fly to all parts of the island. You'll see the Napali Costline and the Canyon up close on this venture. In fact, we were able to see hundreds of whales in the ocean below during our last flight. I'm a bit of a fraidy cat when it comes to heights and small planes, but the scenery helps one to overcome that obstacle quickly. One caveat - if there are a lot of clouds and any rain, you WILL experience some bumps on the flight.

The pilot and his staff are all quite friendly and even recognized me on my last trip! I appreciated that as I know that they must see thousands of people in their line of work. My mother was not happy about having to be weighed for the trip, but be prepared as this is part of the experience as they manage each flight by weight. 

I found the cost to be quite reasonable and in line with the other flight companies around the island. I'm not much of a helicopter fan and so I found the small airplane option a bit more comfortable. 

Each passenger is equipped with noise canceling headphones, through which your pilot will guide you through each site and the history of the island. For those new to Kauai, this is really nice and gives you a great overview of this magnificent place. The hanger is very easy to find, just past the main terminal at the Lihue airport. After your flight, be sure to take the drive further down the road, away from the main highway, to visit an old fishing pier and some lovely ocean scenery.

The first time that I took this flight, I was seated behind the pilot on the left side of the plane. NOT a good seat! They arrange passengers by weight, so please take into consideration that you might be the one positioned in the inner seat. Honestly, it is quite difficult to see much of anything from this seat and I found myself to be quite disappointed in the flight the first time that I went (hence the four star rating). Perhaps if they refunded part of the fee for the one who is instructed to sit in this "no view" seat, I might be more understanding. Thankfully, my second time around, I was placed in the seat on the view side.

You can actually get some great pics and video during this trip - and it's quite unique as you'll see some areas of the island not seen by most. Waterfalls, coastlines, mountains, towns, nature... you'll see it all.

If you're wanting a bird's-eye view of the island, this is a great and not-too-expensive way to do it! Just be ready if you get placed in the seat behind the pilot as views are limited.

We really enjoyed the flight ...the weather was perfect! The pilot  ver knowledgeable .we would recommend this flight to our friends! We were able to take great pictures. The pilot made sure that both seating sides of the plane got to see each location. Very enjoyable!

The views on this trip were absolutely amazing! You haven't see the true beauty of Kauai until you take this trip. The staff were all very friendly and informative. The pilot maneuvered the aircraft so  as to enable all passengers to see the beautiful sights of Kauai. We drove most the island prior to our flight which also gave us a better perspective of where everything was. I would highly recomend that you choose to do this tour at some point in your visit to the island. The memories will be forever lasting.

We spent most of the week driving around the island to get the lay of the land, but nothing can compare to seeing Kauai from the air.  Our pilot wanted to know what we were interested in and made a point to show us parts of the island we were most interested in seeing.  It was a very smooth ride.  It was our first small plane trip and we would recommend it for everyone.  Don't leave the island before making this trip on Air Ventures!

This is a very affordable sight seeing option. You will see the entire island and all the main attractions.  

The airplane was clean and appeared well taken care of. The ground facility including the restrooms are clean. The employees were friendly and courteous. The pilot was personable, approachable, professional and very knowledgeable regarding the island. We departed right on time, flew for about an hour, made a nice landing and it was over. Everything was exactly as advertised. 
 I was part of a group of four and all of us give this four stars. We recommend this to everyone.

We have spent two vacations in Kauai and have done all the attractions.  This is the #1 - it puts the island in a beautiful perspective.  The pilot, Harry, was very informative and knowledgible of the history of Kauai.  $$ wise the best bargain of my lifetime.

The views are so awesome and very nice crew with lots of history of all the parts of the island lots of beautiful falls, canyons and beaches to view! The north side is the most beautiful in my opinion, the NaPali coast line a must see if you visit! We saw humpback whales and the captain made sure each person got the views by flying around to make sure each person got to take some great pictures! Thanks so much! Would highly reccomend!

I got incredible pics and had time to enjoy it too.  My 14 year old granddaughter was overwelmed by the beauty of the island and the airplane ride.  I did use a polarizer that helped with the glare of the windows.  Harry, our pilot, was very helpful.  Thanks for the highlight of our trip and it was much cheaper than a helicopter ride.

The pilot allowed me to fly the aircraft the majority of the flight. It was the smoothest handling aircraft that I have ever flown, stable and responsive. It felt like flying in a World War I aircraft. It was an experience of a bygone era in aviation.

We had a great time on our tour.  They were very informative and the Captain was great at circling the sights to share with both sides of the airplane.  My favorite sight on the island is and alway will be the beautiful Napali coast and we were able to get some fabulous shots. We also caught some whales at play and he made a few turns so we could watch. One word of warning if you are nervous about flying in small planes take a motion sickness pill.
