One couple on our trip spent more time with the motion sickness bags than they did enjoying the scenery. All in all it is a perfect way to get acquainted with the beautiful island of Kauai.
Sightseeing at it's very best with a better than bird's eye view of a beautiful island.  Seeing the whales in the water was soooo cool!!!!!  Would totally do this again!!
Air Ventures Hawaii is a great way to see more of Kavai . Seeing waimea canyon and na pailcoast line was awesome! Had a lot of infourmation about the island. I will do it agan !! willard

It was an incredible view of the island.  Gave us an overview of everything.  Really put things in perspective.  Especially enjoyed flying over the ridges and seeing the inaccessible parts of the island.
We saw all the grandeur of the cliffs, forests, mountains and the coastline.
The pilot was excellent.  Enjoyed his narrative, especially the historic parts.
I took a lot of video as well as some still pictures.  The ride is quite smooth except for a few mild wind turbulance which makes picture taking easy.
We feel like we have seen the whole island now.  Those views over the mountain tops will remain most vivid for a long time in my mind.
Mahalo for a great trip!
Denis & Terry Chicoine
Breath taking views of the Ocean and Mountains. We seen more things on this tour than we could see in a lifetime of driving and hiking.

My wife, daughter and I recently took a spring break vacation to Kaua'i Hawaii.  We took the Air Ventures trip on Thursday.  I believe the trip was better because we had already been to the island 4 days and we got to see places we had already been.  K-E beach, Hanalie, Princeville, the lighthouse, we even saw the condo where we were staying.  The pilot gave an excellent narrative that you could hear through headsets, and took extra time to circle key sights ensuring everyone could see.  The highlight of the trip was when we saw whales breaching.

The trip was beyond words. We saw whales, momma and babies! The coastal view was so different from seeing it from a boat...amazing.  Paul talked just enough to give information, he did not overwhelm us with constant talking. It is a MUST DO for everyone!

Jean

The airplane tour of Kauai was incredible!  Our morning flight was cancelled because of storms and cloud coverage.  However, the staff took us up on our "we're flexible" offer and called us for an afternoon flight.  Our pilot, Kevin, was a wealth of information about the island and so many things that have happened on the island (especially movies).  While Kevin was very entertaining, it's important to emphasize his focus on safety.  This was particularly important because none of us have ever been up in such a small plane.  I travel frequently for work and make it a habit to avoid small planes.  I would fly with Kevin any day ... even in his small plane.  (Not sure about the biplane.  Need to work up to that!)  Thanks for the memories!!

~ Carol, Lewis, & Hannah Smith

Air Ventures is by far the best way to see all of Kauai. Because of the lack of road access to large portions of the island the only way to see those parts is by air or water. Forget getting sea sick in 10 foot chop. Take a relaxing ride with Air Ventures.

review_title: A great way to see an amazing island
review_text:
The best way to see Kauai. Our pilot, Harry, provided a running commentary of what we were seeing, which included both current topics (the US base!!) and the early history of human settlement. He even tailored the tour to take us to the area we were staying, giving us a birds eye view of our condo.
The true vastness of the canyon and the mountains can only be observed from the air.
As with whale watching, an Island flight is a must for all those visiting Kauai,

Our group had bad weather (flash flood warning) the day we were supposed to do the plane ride. Fortunately, the rescheduled day worked out and we had an amazing view of the island on the tour. Our pilot, Paul, was fantastic. We loved our experience! It was perfect!

As I watched the helicopters climb the cliffsides, I was grateful I was in this comfortable airplane on a steady plane.  Our pilot did a great job of maneuvering through fog, rain, and clouds to ensure we had memorable views.  Whale watching from the air is incredible and a not to be missed adventure in your lifetime.

review_title: Beautiful scenery and friendly efficient service
review_text: The day of our flying tour the weather was not great so the pilot recommended we reschedule. They made it easy and worked with us and the day of our re-scheduled flight was beautiful. Very little waiting around which I really appreciate.

review_title: A personal tour from pilot Nick
review_text:
Air Ventures, with the personal touch of pilot Nick, gave us a breathtaking view of Kauai and the
many natural features of the island. We were able to view the trail along the Napoli coast that was not visible from the water. We also saw the homes of Hollywood dignataries and in a bay close by, the riding of the waves by some surfers being chased by a sea-doo.
The Cessna 182 was a great ride, the weather was perfect, and being in a smaller plane, we felt that our tour exhibited great perspective of the various aspects of the Kauaian terrain. The pics I have taken from that trip bring back great memories. The cost was very reasonable, considering what we experienced. Thanks, Air Ventures!

review_title: Captain Harry...endless thanks for an amazing tour!
review_text:
We booked a 3:00 flight on April 1st. The experience was excellent from the moment we spoke with Nicole on the phone to schedule. Our Pilot was Harry and he was everything we could have asked for. He was knowledgeable, personable & had a sense of humor. He really cared about making our flight memorable and made sure to warn us to get ready for some great photos. I wish that we could have recorded his narration of terrain, all the falls heights and the elevations. He is knowledgeable about beaches and the locale as well. Harry, on behalf of my husband and myself I want to again say ~Thank you~ it was better than we expected. You definately have chosen a career that you seem to really enjoy sharing with others. We wish you and Air Ventures all the best.

~Mike & Karen Capps, Doty, WA

If you want to see Kaui from the air, at a price that won't break the budget, I recommend Air Ventures. Pilot Harry put us at our ease and gave us views one cann't get from the ground. They also provided transportation back to my hotel.

Air Ventures is the best way  to see Kauai from the Air. Although the clouds were hovering over parts of the Island Capt. Harry guided us around and through the scenic beauty that is the Island of Kauai. Great ride and affordable price.

The ride gives one a bird eyeview of the scenery in Kaui which cannot be done by any other means. It was a thrilling experience from start to finish.Another good service this company provides is that they  fetched you from the cruise port and brings you back without any additional charge. Their pilots ( Paul for us ) are also well verse in explaining the scenery as you pass them. They even  give you a free CD just before the flight. I booked a package tour from them which included this plane rider plus a Fern Grotto River cruise. Nice experience which is  very recommendable.

Our ride provided spectacular views of the Waimea Canyon and Na Pali coast.  We also had a great view of a whale slapping it's tail off the Na Pali coast.  Pilot Harry was very skilled and provided great insight.  A great time was had by all.

We had a wonderful time and the plane allowed for great photos - I took over 250!  The pilot provided interesting information regarding all the things we were seeing and we could ask questions too,  I highly recommend this adventure with AirVentures!!

We were lucky to have a clear day to see how beautiful and varied is the whole island of Kauai. Paul was very knowledgable and gave us a lot of history and information along with some good whale sitings. It was a very nice hour long flight to give you a great overview of a beautiful island. Highly recommended.

review_title: Don't miss this chance to see Kauai from the air
review_text: I am not in love with flying and I've never been in a small plane, so I was more than a little leery when I discovered that one of our party of four had booked us on a Air Ventures tour of Kauai. As it turned out, I loved the flight and had a fantastic time. The pilot, Paul, was very skilled and made sure that everyone had ample opportunity to see all the points of interest. His commentary was informative and quite humorous and the views of Kauai from the air were spectacular. I highly recommend this tour.

As long time Kauai visitors (12th trip?), its still a thrill to see it from the air. We booked a package that included a NaPali coast supper cruise plus the hour-long trip in the air. 
Received driving directions at least a day ahead of time and easily found our way to the Air Ventures counter at the Bradley Aviation building near the Kauai airport. There were six in our party and, after a picture and a short briefing we were on our way. 
The pilot was friendly, informative, and seemed genuinely concerned about our comfort and safety. He narrated the tour and provided information about the various coasts, the canyons, waterfalls, and topography of the island. 
I've taken a helicopter ride on Kauai before, and wasn't sure what to expect with a small airplane. I was surprised how smooth the ride was. The plane travels at a relatively slow speed and its easy to focus on the scenery and take pictures. The only downside, if there is one, is that a plane can't hover in front of waterfalls or cliffs like a helicopter. That said, the pilot will turn the plane around to ensure everyone gets good views of various scenes. He even made an extra loop above the ocean when he spotted a pod of whales.  
Kauai is an absolutely gorgeous island and the combination of the ocean's waters, the NaPali cliffs, the beaches, and the inland canyons and waterfalls, make this trip quite memorable.

review_title: Don't miss this view of Kauai
review_text: We had 6 people in our party, and everyone had a great view of the Island.  This was our second trip to the Island, and this flight gave us a new perspective of places on the Island we hadn't seen on our previous visit.  The pilot (Paul) ensured everyone got a view of the sites we flew over.  Put aside a couple of hours to make the trip, you'll enjoy it!  Don't forget to book ahead!

I was a little scared at first, but Paul made it an amazing trip. We saw some whales so he turned so we could see them better. Kauai is an amazing island and this was an amazing way to see it. Would definitely do it again and recommend it to everyone.

review_title: Plane ride over Kauai.Best experience EVER!
review_text: First time visitors to the island and to view it from the air was amazing.It actually was the best thing we did of all our adventures.Would do it again in a heartbeat.Thanks a lot

AirVentures took us on an amazing plane tour of Kauai.  The pilot was very informative and narrated the whole tour.  He took the time to circle interesting places so all could see .  The flight was smooth and comfortable; I would definitely recommend this awesome adventure!

My father and I had never been on a plane tour of the island. We've been on the helicopter tour a couple times which was fine except if you are in the middle of the back seat, don't like tight spaces, and/or are over 260lb (not allowed on helicopter due to weight restriction). The plane tour, however, gives EVERYONE a window seat, spacious room, and NO WEIGHT RESTRICTION! Moving on to the actual tour part, the flight is absolutely incredible. You fly a different path than the copters which might seem like a bad thing but you still get to see the same locations. You don't get to go in the crevices of moutains and hover but the pilot will tilt the plane to a comfortable angle so you see deep inside the ridges where waterfalls are. Another positive about Air Ventures is you are able to communicate with the pilot and ask questions. You also don't have to pay for your group picture. It's e-mailed to you directly after your flight. My father and I both agree that Air Ventures is better than doing a helicopter ride and it's cheaper too!

My wife and I did this same flight two years ago, so we took it again today.
Harry did a nice job of pointing out areas we asked about.

We went up in a hellicopter on Maui and my husdand and I enjoyed the plane just as much if not more.  Our pilot was great and very informitive he knew alot about the culture and the island and  had  a good sense of humor too. We got very lucky and saw quite a few whales and the pilot circled around them a few times so we could all get to see.  The day was beautiful and clear and we jenjoyed ourselves very much.  Well worth the money.

We had a very nice, personal experience, as we were a party of 5 and the plane only holds 6 passengers (plus the pilot). The views were wonderful and the pilot's commentary and answers to our questions were comprehensive. One of us got a little queasy and it was warm in the plane, so I would recommend taking dramamine if you are the least bit susceptible to motion sickness (and even bringing a small, phone-powered personal fan).

review_title: Best photos we got on our trip to Kauai. Truly wonderful experience.
review_text: We wanted to see Kauai by air and Air Ventures was a reasonable price. The lady who came to the Wyndham  Balj Hai gave a very good description of what the flight would be like.The plane was very comfortable.The pilot inspired confidence and had a great spiel. We learned a lot about the island, its history and geology. I even got some pictures of a whale with its calf off the Napali coast from 1000 feet up. I took over 100 photos with a 200 mm lens. They came out great. We got a very good overall education about Kauai that helped us the rest of the week to find the best snorkling beaches, coffee plantation, tunnel road, waterfalls, canyon road and rivers. Thanks.

review_title: The only way to tour all of Kauai
review_text:
We just got back from a fantastic Flight with Harry of AirVentures.  Before we left for vacation I read many of the reviews and decided to make an online reservation.  I am so glad we did.  Our flight with Harry was informative and interesting.  The rain (a constant I understand this time of year-March) was barely noticeable and we only flew through very light rain for a few minutes here and there.  As a matter of fact the rain produce some spectacular rainbows.  We flew up some canyons which revealed many waterfalls and towering mountains.  Insert here, WOW!! The Napali coast was breathtaking. As mentioned in previous posts, this air tour provides a great reference to plan where and what you want to visit later.  I looked up the G-8 aircraft, specifically its use in Australia, and it has a solid, safe background and is a highly recommended work horse and observation platform. The check in for the flight is 30 min. prior to launch.  You are placed in the plane according to weight I believe as it is a small but comfortable aircraft.  Noise was not a factor in that you are provided a headset both as a noise dampener and to communicate with each other and the polite.  A quick safety orientation not unlike a common airliner was provided and off we went on time.  About the only thing I can complain about is that I did not see any dinosaurs (Jurassic Park was filmed here ;>)
Thank you Harry, Thank you AirVentures!!! 5 stars is not enough.
r/Marty and Jenn

Just finished a wonderfully narrated & scenic tour along the coast & over the mountains and valleys of Kauai!  Pilot was very knowledgeable both about the geography and the history of the island and the traditional Hawaiian way of life in the area.  Saw many beautiful rainbows as we crossed through the rainforest area of the interior...made great photos & videos!  The coastline from the air was spectacular....flew over the Princeville area, where we were staying & took some more great photos of the area from a different vantage point....also saw Queen's Bath, which we had experienced & brought back great memories!  Smooth flight...did this in combination with the catamaran boat cruise by HoloHolo out of Port Allen....great combo deal!  Would highly recommend the two!

review_title: breath taking tour of Kaua'i with propeller plane
review_text: Generally enjoyed the propeller plane tour which takes you roughly clockwise over Kaua'i.  Felt comfortable the first 30 mins or so, then experienced a certain degree of dizziness and at times slight nausea likely caused by choppy gusts and possibly by the altitude (without the O2 compensation common in big jet liners).  Nice views of Po'ipu Beach, Waimea Canyon, and Hanalei Valley.  Saw Kilauea Lighthouse from the distance.  Unfortunately but not unusually, the visibility over the Na Pali Coast was cloudy, yet still breathtaking.  Mt. Wai'ale'ale was completely hidden in clouds, as it is said to be most of the time, but in turn the tour enabled many waterfall sightings.  In summary a fun way to see the island from above, but to the average person it is advisable to board the tour with an empty stomach and perhaps some prophylactic measures against motion sickness.  That said, the dizziness/nausea problem is probably not unique to AirVentures tours as I would anticipate a comparable level with the helicopter tours, and only 1 out of 6 passengers actually vomited.

review_title: It's the flight of a lifetime!
review_text:
At first my wife was a little nervous about taking an open cockpit flight, but on arrival Kevin's friendly manner and professional instructions quickly dispatched her fear. In our leather hats and two way communication system, we headed down the runway for the ride of a lifetime. We did the 45 minute North route that took us along the coast, up to Hanalei and a bit of the rugged Napali coast. Kevin also took us up the Hanalei valley, past several waterfalls, and into a dormant volcano crater! WOW! What a ride! He was great a pointing out all the areas of interest and our two way communication worked great adding a real interactive element to the ride. 
It's a done deal that we'll go back for the full island tour next time! No it's not the cheapest thing you can do, but Kevin made it more than worthwhile!
Wonderful flight.  Pilot made sure that both sides of the plane saw everything including the whales.  Should start your time on Kauai with this flight!

review_title: See all of Kauai in one hour!! BEAUTIFUL.
review_text: The booking processfor the Big Kahuna Air and Land Tour was very professional, done thru the Air Ventures Airplane Tours website.... Billy picked us up near the Cruise ship pier and we were taken to the airport. The flight was awesome. The island is beautiful from the air, you can see the waterfalls, canyons, rivers, beaches and learn the history of the island - all within 60 minutes. After the air tour, Billy picked us up and took us to the Wailua River for a cruise down the river to the beautiful Fern Grotto.  Billy picked us up again and took us back to the cruise ship. It was a wonderful day....the tour included a FREE DVD of Kauai by air!!

It is a propeller driven plane - like in Tintin comics. 1 hr long tour of the island. Thought of a chopper but since during this time of the yr the winds are strong around Na Pali, it is safer to do a plane as it can travel at a higher altitude. We can converse with the pilot via headfones. Was very enjoyable and informative. They give a CD of the various places on the island a complimentary group picture.

review_title: A good way to begin your holiday on Kauai
review_text:
Our main regret was that we didn't start with the flight on our arrival to Kauai. The flight is an excellent way to get an overview of the attractions of this island. Even though we spent two weeks on Kauai we found the flight to be informative and interesting and the view of the whales were a bonus. A different perspective from the air in any case. Also appreciated was the clear instruction to the terminal. Being first time visitors to Kauai we would have appreciated a little more historical information as we flew over certain parts. All in all a great experience and the view of Mt. Kawaikini was awsome!
Horst Schreiber

For our 10th anniversary, we wanted to do something really special and memorable and Tropical Biplanes did not disappoint!  While helicopter tours are all over the island and have their benefits, a trip into the skies in a biplane is like no other.  Snoopy 2 (red Waco plane call sign) is a beautiful machine that provides a one of a kind view...talk about having the best seat in the house, the wind in your face and a really unique tour with an absolutely fantastic guide.  Kevin knows his stuff, is an excellent pilot and tour guide to boot.  He took the time to not only point out the memorable sites but to provide some history and context behind them.   A really cool tour that is great for couples.  I can't recommend him enough!

We chose Air Ventures for our air tour recently based on recommendations on Trip Advisor. We arrived to the airport early for our tour, checked in, weighed in with everything we were planning to take on the tour, and hung out until it was time to go. There are several other companies housed in the same building as Air Ventures. There are restrooms nearby as well. Our pilot, Harry, introduced himself to the four of us taking the tour with him that day. He was very nice and reassured us the strong winds would not be an issue. He said he had four years of experience and thousands of flights under his belt, so we felt at ease. We took a group photo with him and the plane in the background (they e-mailed it to us right away!), then he strategically seated us in the plane, most likely to even out the weight. It was nice having such a small group. The plane is newer looking but had a few small tears in the seats. Otherwise, nice but small. We were each provided head phones so we could hear Harry's narrative tour of the island. I took lots of photos and they turned out great! Make sure you wear a dark color shirt if you're a shutter bug. It was more amazing than we ever dreamed, and we had been on a cruise around the island previously, and driven from one end of the island to the other several times. The air tour really put things in perspective, and it was neat to see things we would have never seen by car. We learned a great deal about the island from Harry, and even though we were pre-warned parts of the ride would be very bumpy (and they were) we would not hesitate to go again, or recommend this trip to anyone!
We were able to see so much more of Kauai than by land. Our pilot was great. Even did some whale watching. A "must" for this island.

Highly recommended especially if you are not familiar with the island.   The pilot did a great job of pointing out places that we could visit more closely later on.   He also took time to look for and found some whales!   Breath-taking views you can't experience anywhere else!

The entire staff was a pleasure to deal with and made this an experience we will never forget.  Harry was very informative and made sure we all had a clear view of the sights below.  It was a very windy day but he made sure we experienced as little turbulence as possible.  I would highly recommend this as a "must do" on the island.  It was a lot of fun!

Excellent pilot, very knowledgeable.  We very much enjoyed this trip.  We saw all of Kauai from air.  It was so cool to see the same sights from the air that we had seen from on the ground. We were also thrilled to get a group picture before the trip.  Nicole had them sent to our e mails by the time we arrived back.  No cost for the picture either which was refreshing considering all the other attractions are charging $20 and up for pictures.  We would recommend this trip to anyone visiting Kauai.

review_title: Great way to see the island!
review_text: We loved our flight over Kauai!  We took our flight early in the week.  We saw a lot of the island that we wouldn't have been able to see any other way, and it gave us a different perspective when we visited some of those sites by car later in the week.  The flight itself was fairly smooth, and we all had a window seat in the 6-passenger plane.  It took off on time and lasted about an hour.  The pilot pointed out all of the features.  The views were fantastic!  We highly recommend it.

We had an amazing time with Air Ventures Hawaii.  The pilot was very knowledgeable and was able to tell us all about the island and the sights we saw.   Not only that, but he insured that we had a smooth, enjoyable ride.  Not only that, but we got a chance to admire the beauty of the island from a perspective we wouldn't otherwise get.  Very enjoyable experience and not only would I recommend it for others, but I'm certain we'd go again if we were to get the chance.

We had an enjoyable time on our flight. The receptionist was friendly. Our pilot was great, very friendly with a good sense of humor! The flight was overall pretty smooth, but there were some bumpy areas (enough for motion sickness for the weak stomached, but not bumpy enough to be scared!) The view was beautiful! Kauai is so beautiful! I hear helicopters are more exhilirating, but this is a good alternative if you want a calm, airconditioned  way to see the island!

This Airplane tour enabled us to see the Beauty of the Island of Kauai, the only way to see so many Beautiful parts of this Gorgeous Island. We were able to see many Waterfalls, the Napoli Coastline, the Grand Canyon of the Pacific, Rainbows, etc. such Beauty I've never seen before. The pilot, Paul, made sure that all of us had a Great View of the Scenery, great photo opportunities, and he gave us much knowledge about the island and its history. I would definitely recommend this tour to All Of My Friends and anyone who gets the opportunity to visit the Island of Kauai, The Garden Island, the best way to view this island is by Air Ventures Airplane Tour. Maholo to the pilot and staff at Air Ventures.

This was a wonderful adventure, getting to see the whole island from above.  The pilot, Paul was very knowledgable and did a wonderful job.  Even though the day was windy and the air was a little unstable.  He kept us pretty stable.  Thank you for adding to our wonderful vacation.

The Rasmussen's
Britt and Brenda

This was the best way to view the entire island of which most is inaccessible. The views are amazing. The flight was great. the pilot and staff were very professional. I would recommend taking this for anyone going to Kauai.

review_title: Best way to see the Island
review_text: I went on a morning flight, after a rain and it was a smooth ride.  The views were great, everyone had a window seat.  We saw whales all along the coast, the canyon, lots of waterfalls, and napolii shore from above.  I would recommend Air Ventures to all my friends as a wonderful way to see this island.

review_title: Wonderful way to see the island
review_text: This was a great tour for the cost. The views were amazing. The west coast of the island is spectacular. The things we would have missed if we hadn't taken this trip--waterfalls, coastline views, the Pacific Grand Canyon, etc. Our pilot, pointed out so many points of interest. Thanks, AirVentures!

review_title: Airventures Tour one of trips highlights!!
review_text: This was an excellent way to see the island. The pilot was friendly, informational, and made sure everyone on the plane had a good view of the spectacular scenery. This is a must for anyone on the island.
The only way to go in order to get a quick view of the entire island.  The pilot was friendly and professional and provided a good narration of the sights visible.  Thank you for a great experience!

We took this sightseeing flight around the island Kauai with Air Ventures. Their website is www.airventureshawaii.com. We paid $125 per person for a 1 hr tour. The tour was in an air van that seats 6 people plus the pilot. It was comfortable. The pilot talked to us through our headphones and we asked questions using a microphone. We saw the whole island, the coffee plantations, Waimea (Grand) Canyon, the famous waterfalls in Jurassic Park, the Na Pali Coast, the beaches and golf courses, Julia Robert's house and even a whale slapping the water with his fluke. The tour itself was great. But the wait was ridiculous. We were picked up near the cruise ship terminal at 9:15 am and arrived at the airport at 9:20 am. The tour was supposed to start at 10:00 am, but it did not start until nearly 11:00 am. Since our time in port was short, every minute counts so we did not like having to hang around the airport when we could have been sitting at the beach or shopping.

The good: smooth ride on a windy day and spectacular views that can only be seen from the air.
Since it has been a rainy week on the island, we got to see tons of rushing waterfalls which was super cool!  
The bad:  The "air conditioned cabin was stuffy with a weak flow of lukewarm air coming from the vents.  The intrusive chatter over the headset was annoying, as was the choice of music.  The flight would be greatly enhanced with some soothing hawaiian instrumental music without the mediocre vocals.  Our pilot/guide, Harry, was an excellent pilot but needs to work on his narrative, which was far from entertaining, barely informative and delivered in a monotone that drove me nuts.  I would have rather he simply flown the plane.
But it is a great value for your dollar on this expensive vacation paradise, especially if you get the Aloha card at your timeshare.  Perhaps my expectations were too high as I had hoped to be regaled with local legend and interesting facts beyond "that is tunnels beach....that is wiamea canyon....those are waterfalls....that is the largest coffee plantation in usa....."  Plus, our 60-70 min tour was more like 55 min.
If you want to see the entire beauty of the Island of Kaua'i you must see by air. The flight was comfortable and educational, the only way to see the beautiful mountains and valleys of the island

When you are on a cruise with 4 days at 4 different Hawaiian Islands, you cannot do everything you would like. At Kauai, my wife and I decided that to get a sense of the Island, an airplane or helicopter ride would give you a good snapshot of the varied topography. We opted for the slower (and cheaper) one-hour airflight. We were not disappointed. We could both see well out of separate windows. We started off by following the south coast with its resorts and beaches and circled to see the famous Spouting Horn blowhole. Even though there was some cloud (to be expected in winter months) the Na Pali cliffs with inland waterfalls were awesome and the rain forest fascinating showing trees with different shades of green. The transformation from rain forest to the desert-like Waimea Canyon with its multicolored layered rocks was dramatic as we flew over it and into the sheer valleys. On the way back we had a bonus of seeing the Sleeping Giant, the Wailua River (with barges leading to the Fern Grotto), the Wailua Falls,  and the cruise ship in Nawiliwili Harbor. Our pilot was most knowledgeable mentioning his preferences on the scenery and pointing out locations where films had been made or houses owned by film stars. As a result of our flight, we would like to revisit the Island and spend more time there.
What a wonderful experience! The pilot and staff were friendly and professional, the ride was smooth and beautiful.  This is a "must do" when visiting Kauai, it exceeded our expectations!

Had a wonderful flight over this beautiful island with my friends the end of January.  Was very informative and took many great pictures.  Would recommend this flight to anyone interested in seeing this lovely island from a bird's eye view.  Thank you for the wonderful experience we all shared.

We went to Kauai on a vacation with my two sisters and their husbands.  Everyone decided that the way to see the part of the island that wasn't accessible by car would be by air.  The view from the plane was wonderful!  It was definitely one of the highlights of our trip.  My youngest sister was in the back of the plane and had a little trouble with motion sickness but I didn't notice it in the front of the plane.

What a terrific way to see Kaua'i! There was one other couple with my wife and I on this flight and Paul was our pilot. Paul has a droll sense of humour, which is something that I appreciate, and combining that with his extensive knowledge of where we were and what we were seeing was indeed a treat. We had terrific weather for the trip and Paul managed to dip around areas of particular interest so that we could get all of the shots we wanted. We wouldn't have missed this for the world! Great information, stunning scenery, skilled flying, and highly, highly recommended!!

It was an amazing experience and a way to see the beautiful island.  I would highly recommend it to those who would like to experience the amazement of the Kauai.  I put my camera up to the window and just clicked and came up with amazing pictures.  Loved every minute.

My husband and I and two other friends flew with Air Ventures Hawaii in late January while visiting the island of Kauai. The flight was very informative and we were able to view the NaPali coast line from the air and see things that we could not have seen by boat or on land.
 Our pilot provided great background information about the island and interesting facts about the area.

I was a little apprehensive about flying in a small plane--but it was great and I felt comfortable the entire time while I was in the air. A great trip to do while visiting Kauai.

I would recommend this to anyone visiting the island.

Joyce R

This flight was the highlight of our Kauai trip. If there is one tour you do while in Kauai, this would be it!

We did the boat tour to see the Napali coast, but the water was way choppy. For our flight, the pilot was amazing and provided very informative information on different parts of the island. We were fortunate to have clear skies on our trip - the waterfalls, the Napali coast, the rainforests, beaches (and some whale watching as a bonus) - make this tour a must-do when visiting Kauai.

I would highly recommend it!

Harry, our pilot, was very well informed about the landmarks of Kauai.  He showed us around the island, the waterfalls, the ranches, etc.  He took his time in explaining any questions we asked, he would loop around so both sides of the plane could get great photos.  I wish we would have took the tour on our first day here instead of waiting for 5 days in.  Thanks for a great experience!

review_title: Best way to see the island
review_text:
In February, taking the boat (even a 65 footer as we did) to see the Na Pili coast may not be the way to go, prticularly if you get sea-sick even with over the counter medicine. We found out a better way: Consider taking the smooth plane ride with Air Ventures.

You already know what you can expect to see, so please allow me to tell what did not come to my mind right way. I did not think I would get to see the whales. The AV pilot is very skilled and he took us close to the whales. It did not come to my mind that the middle of the island could be so beautiful, with so many waterfalls and trees that look like broccoli. 

Take the air trip after you have seen it all from your car and when you know all the locations. This is most fun because you now get to see from the top. The green roof of the Grand Hyatt, for example or the whole coffee plantation you go past on the way to Port Allen. If you love looking at maps, you will really relish the ride with Air Ventures.
Great flight.  The senery was awesome and the pilot was great and very informative and knowledgable of the island.  I would do it again in a heartbeat.
What a great group of people.  The flight was awesome, the pilot was wonderful.  Lots of fun and well worth the money.

review_title: A must to do and see!
review_text:
We were a group of 8 from San Diego and decided to see Kauaii from the air! We chose Air Ventures Hawaii and what an adventure that was! I can not recommended enough to all of you! You will see Kauaii from all angles and views in just few hours with the best opportunities to take the most amazing pictures that will last you a lifetime! An experience you should not overlooked!

The Pilot and the organization are awesome and very professional at all time!

A great experienced pilot that will make you feel safe in the air while enjoying Kauaii's beauty at its best!

we had a great tour of the island of Kauai,, the pilot was very good and also with humor as he would point out different things on the island... we would recommend this tour to any friends of ours who would go to Kauai.

The plane trip over Kauai'i was amazing. Harry was an awesome pilot/tour guide!  He asked if we wanted to see anything specific and pointed out all the sites, making sure both sides of the plane got a gorgeous view.  We were even treated to whales on take off.  The day we drove up the canyon was cloudy, so it was great to see the NaPali coast on a clear day from the air.  We wore dark clothing as recommended, but long sleeves might have helped as my arms still reflected off the windows in a few of the pictures. We did the flight on our last day - it put the whole island into perspective for us and left us wanting to come back again.  The time just went by too fast.

In January of 2013, my husband, son and I took a flight over Kauaii with Air Ventures.  My son is an adult with physical and mental limitiations.  The pilot was very patient helping him in and out of the plane.  The three of us were awed by the vista from the air and were able to see the DaNali coast in all it's majesty.  There are not a lot of things from which my son can derive pleasure, and seeing his thrll and excitement gave his father and I an even greater appreciation of the beauty below us.  NB

Cannot recommend this tour enough!  We spoke via phone and then went to the airport to book our flight with Robin directly. She advised us of a discount coupon offered by the hotel we were staying at saving us money.  Thank you Robin!  Due to poor weather, our first flight was canceled, but they were able to rebook us prior to our island departure.  Paul was very knowledgeable of the island and a great pilot. Very smooth landing Paul!  We have toured Kauai in the past via car and on foot but the views from above are breathtaking. This is a must do if visiting Kauai! Air Ventures Hawaii staff won't do you wrong.
The flight was a great way to see the entire island from the air!!  We took some wonderful pictures including whales, waterfall, Napali Coast and the canyon.

The flight was an excellent way to see all parts of the island, especially the NaPali coast. Our pilot (Paul) made sure everyone could see the sites regardless on which side of the plane you were on.  He was funny and seemed very knowledgeable about the island. The flight was smooth and fun. We liked that it's an eco-friendly way to see the island as well! Would definitely recommend this tour.

Definitely the best way to see Kauai.  We were vacationing with friends and they agreed that it is money well spent.  A must do when visiting Kauai.  Saw 2 whales coming out of the ocean from the plane.
Not being much of a flyer, this trip was amazing.  We saw so much from the air that you just couldn't see on the ground.  Our pilot was great and gave us a new view of the island.

You don't want to miss it!  Harry (Happy Birthday, Harry) was a great narrator and pilot.  Better tour than I had anticipated, and we were lucky enough to hit a clear day.  We all  had great photo ops as Harry looped around so both left and right could see.  And the price it right!Thanks, A.V.  We would definitely go again.

review_title: Great way to see the island!
review_text: The flight was an excellent way to see all parts of the island. The pilot made sure everyone could see the sites regardless on which side of the plane you were on. The flight was smooth and fun.

What a wonderful way to get another view of Kauai.  Our pilot was very professional and so informative about Kauai. It was also so neat to see the part of Kauai where there aren't any roads!  The only thing we didn't see was the pot of gold at the end of the rainbow!!!!    Rating:  10.5 out of 10. Thank you!  J&L Malcolm, Sk. Canada

On our last day in Kauai we took the Air Ventures Air Tour. The friends we were with had previously been on a helicopter ride and were not keen to do another. We felt this would be a different option. It was a great decision. Not only does EVERYONE get a window seat-if the view was on one side of the plane, the pilot circles for the others on the other side to view. Not really heard of on the helicopter tours.And the price is very affordable. Robin -the receptionist was extremely helpful when we booked, and also gave us a good tip for dinner after. Was very impressed to see headsets were wiped down after each trip. Would certainly suggest this tour to visitors in Kauai.

review_title: Absolutely the best thing we did on beautiful Kauai!
review_text: My husband and I are 65 and 66 and have knee and hip problems, so are unable to hike into these amazing places.  From the small plane, with Harry as the pilot and narrator, we were able to experience the sights you can't see from a car.  The plane was very comfortable and the head sets gave us the ability to hear everything Harry was describing.  He would make turns so both sides of the plane got good views of everything.  He even spotted humpback whales and turned the plane so we could get pictures.  We had done some driving around the island, so we had an idea where we were and spotted places we had been.  There is no better way to see and experience Kauai!  My husband says I have been talking about this trip so much, it's as if he has never taken me anywhere.  We travel a lot, but this is at the top of my list of the best things I have ever done.  I love taking pictures and did I get great shots!  Don't hesitate. Do it!

review_title: Great way to see the island
review_text: My wife and I have taken helicopter rides in the past and this was our first time in an airplane to view an island.  We have been stuck in the middle on previous helicopter touring and were not able to have the same view as those in the "outside" seats.  With the airplane we each had our own seat with great viewing.  We were able to take photos without anyone leaning into the camera lens and we got some really neat pics.  I will be suggesting an airplane tour to our friends and family, especially Air Ventures Hawaii if they travel to Kauai.
The flight was great, the views impressive, and the staff was attentive to our group. We actually saw whales, and the rainbows were a bonus!

In an hour you get to view the entire island.  It is very easy to take pictures and they come out fabulous.  The pilot will answer all your questions about what you are flying over.  Everyone gets a great window seat.  This is the best way to see the entire island.
Really Great flight Great veiw's and Great information from Harry. Would recommend this everyone. Thank you Jeff & Arlene North Pole Alaska

review_title: A Great Way to see all of Kauai
review_text: It's not just a plane ride!  It's an experience!  The pilot shakes your hand, and introduces himself.  Group picture with the pilot and everyone is loaded into the plane.  Each passenger has a window seat with their own headset.  Your pilot flies the plane, but also takes on the role of your tour guide.  Not "guide" in the sense of look over here this is whatever.  Guide in the sense they know the land, history, what movie was made where, how to pronounce the Hawaiian words and are even willing to answer our every question.  Our pilot, Paul, made every effort to ensure all passengers saw the views.  He even made the effort to find some humpback whales and flew over them  several times.  It was so awesome to see those beautiful creatures from above.  The island of Kauai has so many incredible views you can't see by car.  Would definitely do this tour again with Air Ventures.  Had 3 kids under seven with us and they thought it was, "so cool!"  So this company is family friendly also-the kids thought the pilot was cool too! All in all highly recommended.

I can't say enough about our "air adventure".  Easy to book online in advance, this aerial tour over-delivered to the enjoyment of everyone in our group.  The pilot was very knowledgeable about Kauai's history, culture, resources...as well as the movies filmed on the island and movie stars who own homes here.  He made sure to provide excellent views to his passengers on both sides of the plane...including 2 sets of whales!  I had never seen them from the air...incredible when they breached.  We originally thought about a helicoptor tour...thank goodness our daughter did not meet the height requirement and we booked this instead.  This is a "must do" activity, whether it's your first day or last day on Kauai.

Airventures tour it one thing you must do!
Entire staff was great to work with! Pilot did amazing job explaining to us what we were seeing from air and was very friendly. Would recommend this company in a heartbeat!

I recommend doing this flight after you have gone to the places by car.  That way you recognize everything and it is like visiting them again!  We opted for the plane over a helicopter mainly because of the price difference--and because everyone would have his/her own window seat. The pilot made turns so people on both sides of the plane could get the view.  Very smooth ride and landing.  It was a great hour-plus minute tour!  I gave it a rating of 5, but wish I could have deducted a half-point for the pilot's deadpan voice (I think his name was Paul.) I am sure he gets tired of telling people the same thing every day over and over, but for us who pay for the tour, it is our first and probably only time....so please a little more info and enthusiasm. Maybe he was just having a bad day.  I fully recommend this company.

We had an amazing time on this air tour that takes you all over the beautiful garden isle. We saw everything from pristine white beaches, the massive red rocks of the waimea canyon, more waterfalls than you can keep track of, and the awesomely rugged and untouched Napali coast. The ride was unbelievably smooth and pleasant. One of my family members had had a terrible experience with a small plane in the past, but she said after the flight with Pilot Harry, that her opinion of small planes has been totally changed. Such an amazing, comfortable ride, and overall a great experience.  And so many outstanding photo ops!  We HIGHLY recommend this experience to fellow Kauai travelers.

All were friendly and helpful.  They went out of their way to make sure that we enjoyed our flight and tour.  Saw wonderful views...smooth flight and landing. We have already recommeded rhis excursion to our friends who are planning a trip to Kauai in March!

wow!  what a great ride harry took us on-- we saw so many beautiful rainbows-a different  view from the plane--also saw fantastic views of the coastline -- harry did a great job and i would recommend the trip for everyne coming to the beautiful island of kauai.

There were 3 of us that went on the plane ride. The sky was clear and we were able to view the top of the summit because of the lack of clouds. I have been on 2 helicopter tours prior, but this was by far a lot better. You are able to stay over the attractions and take lots of pics.
I would recommend this tour to anybody thinking about touring the entire island.

review_title: Worth the trip! A must to consider!
review_text:
My husband and I were fortunate to take the Air Ventures plane trip as part of our visit on the Hawaiian Island of Kauai. Our pilot was very knowledgable and pointed out many locations he knew we would find interesting and/or scenic. He was able to share quite a bit of interesting information during our trip. He was quite considerate and often ensured that both sides of the plane, all passengers, had good views. He was very skilled at up and down, as well as side to side manouvering . I was also impressed with the eco-friendly initiatives of the Air Ventures Tour Company. I am glad we took this trip/tour with Air Ventures!
Patsy
Selkirk, Manitoba Canada

What an exciting adventure we had.  The pilot was friendly and super informative.  The veiws absolutely blew my mind.  We saw about 30 or so humpback whales and countless waterfalls on out plane ride.  There was nothing plain about it.  I could not give a higher reccomendation than the one I'm giving.  It was amazing and cannot be missed.  I loved it!

review_title: What a fantastic experience - I did the best of Kauai combo
review_text:
Tuesday 15th Jan 2013. The day was just perfect, not a cloud in the sky. The whales were there and our pilot was very good at spotting them. The views from a plane are fabulous and you can see places of Kauai that you could never see from the ground. I could do this trip again.
Marguerite P

review_title: Air Ventures Hawaii - Kauai - Loved It!
review_text: Our flight on a sunny Sunday morning was awesome.  It was a great way to see the beauty of the entire island, from a different perspective than we could see by land or sea.   The pilot was great, sharing lots of interesting information as our guide, and giving us a very smooth ride.  The staff was great, reservations were easy to make, and they provided simple directions so we could readily find their site at the airport and we were well prepared for what to bring and what to expect.   We took advantage of the package pricing, doing the Air & Sea combo, and loved our dinner cruise around the Napali coast as well.

We did the 4:30 trip..it was the best, our pilot knew what he was talking about, and so considerate, he made sure that people on both sides of the plane could get pictures of whatever he was talking about, he even went back so we could get pictures of a whale he spotted!  Awesome!  Thanks for a great trip.

review_title: Great way to see the full island
review_text: Air Ventures were truly professional in every way. Our pilot, Harry, took special precautions to make our flight as smooth as possible. No need to be apprehensive about flying in a small plan with this company. Never would have known just driving around the island just how much agriculture there is here.

We like to fly and it was awesome to see Kauai from the air.  Our pilot narrated interesting information and answered our questions.  The rainbows under the plane were beautiful and we were treated to double rainbow at one point of the flight.  We felt safe as we flew from Lihue and around the island.  What a treat!!!
We really enjoyed our small plane view of Kauai.  The pilot was very knowlegable and helpful in explaining the views to us

On the last day of our stay in Kauai, we decided to take the fixed wing aircraft flight.  The morning started off overcast, but cleared up to give us a beautiful blue sky for the flight.  This was a wonderful and smooth trip across the island of Kauai.  We saw areas we would never have seen by any other means, as well as areas where we had driven to.  They looked much better from above.   We could see well out both sides of the plane.  Excellent naration and information by Harry, our pilot.   A few years ago we took the helicopter flight, but enjoyed the fixed wing ride much more.  

Marty
What an experience of a lifetime.  The island is unbelievable from the air.  Such a smoooth ride and very knowledgable pilot/guide.  Well worth the money!!!!

We were undecided as to a fixed wing flight or a helicopter air tour over kaua'i. We are very pleased we chose Air Adventure Flights Tour on a small engine plane. The day had perfect visibility and the air was calm. Harry was our pilot & tour guide. He obviously knew the island and enjoyed the scenery as much as we did. Special bonus was watching the whales from the air. Very cool. Thank you Air Adventures for the amazing memories & the complimentary picture of our group!

What a wonderful way to see the Island of Kauai 360 degrees.  The view from the plane was picture perfect and the pilot was informative.  He even flew around the area that a whale was spotted so we could see and take pictures, but the whale wasn't cooperative.  We now have a great perspective of Kauai and where we would like to drive to when we land.  It is well worth the time and money to do the plane tour.
We really enjoyed the experience.  The views of Kauai were fantastic,  All the crew was very friendly. and I would recommend tthis to my friends

We have been to Kauai several times.  This was the first time we have done any kind of aerial tour.  It was awesome to see the very beautiful island from a different perspective.  Thanks to all at Air Ventures, especially our most capable and informative pilot.  It was a delight!

We would highly recommend going on an air excursion with Air Ventures.  My husband and I were picked up from our resort and brought to the airport and returned after the flight, at no additional cost.  All 6 members of the touring party arrived early so our pilot took us out ahead of schedule.  We went all around Kauai and also inland to see the Canyon and the beautiful waterfalls.  We were also fortunate enough to get a perfect shot of a humpback whale breaching right under us!  Loved it!  No vacation to Kauai is complete until you see it from the air and we are glad we went by Air Ventures!

This was our 1st time on the island and it was a great way to get an overview. Our pilot, Harry, was very informative and knowledgeable of the island. I especially enjoyed seeing the Na Pali coast. It was an amazingly beautiful tour of the island.

I wasn't prepared to take this tour, but boy am I happy I did.  This was the only breathtaking view of Kauai, and Na Pali Coast.  This needs to be a must!  Our pilot was knowledgeable and pointed all the areas, and even circled around when we caught a glimpse of a whale so we could get a good view.  The island is simply magnificient and the Waimea canyon could only be viewed frkm all sides thru an aerial tour. Great Job Air Ventures!

I was determined to see the incredible island of Kauai by air before leaving, and I am so glad that I did. Took the 4:30 PM flight and loved it, with the sun low on the horizon the features of the island were illuminated in a beautiful light, especially the Na Pali coast (breathtaking!) All the sights were incredible, and got to see so much more of the island than we had on our 2-week vacation trip. 
Would definitely recommend!

review_title: You're missing out if you don't book
review_text: My girlfriend and I thought this would be the first thing to do before engaging in any activities on the ground.  This tour was amazing and worth every penny!  Even with some clouds and rain, you are guaranteed for a great adventure.  Having experienced this first once we landed into ITO really put a great perspective on the whole island and what it has to offer.  It made everything we done on the ground more meaningful.  Ask for Harry... He's an awesome tour guide with lots of flight experience and all the professionalism one can ask for.

Simply amazing! Our pilot Paul told us all about each area we were viewing. Waterfalls, coffee fields, celebreties homes, Napali coast and many other beautiful sites that you cannot see by car. We took awesome photos, made video.Everyone at Air Ventures was very friendly.We would recommend this 1h trip to anyone.  Thanks to Air Ventures.

review_title: A Beautiful airel view of Kaui
review_text: The staff was friendly and informative. We took to the air on a beautiful, sunny day. We captured many exhilarating photos. The sites, the Canyon, Nepali Coast, the waterfalls were awesome. The pilot, Harry, was informational and professional. A wonderful experience to see the island from the air.

I had a great time! I have a major fear of heights, but our pilot "Harry," was extremely professional during our flight. We did have rain and wind, but again due to our great navigator our flight was amazing! Thanks again to all the staff! 

Wendy and Bao

It was a cloudy and rainy day and I was in a bad mood.  I didn't think there was a chance we would be able to see anything, but the pilot was confident.  Not only did I loose my bad mood, the views were spectacular and I was in awe.  I was so amazed by the canyons and we even saw Mount Waialeale, since we were above the clouds.

We had a great flight. It was a beautiful sunny day and Harry, our pilot and a very knowledgeable person, gave us lots of information about Kauai and pointed out so many highlights of the island. He even pointed out a couple of whales off the coast of Lihue. The plane was comfortable and everyone had a window. When necessary, Harry circled around special areas so all could see from a different advantage. The ground staff were also very knowledgeable and helpful as we prepared for the flight. I realize that helicopters can get closer to see some things but this plane ride was amazing and I would highly recommend Air Ventures if you want to see beautiful Kauai!

I enjoyed the plane ride with Captain Harry, the ride was amazing, saw everything that we need to see in the island. Capt. Harry was very knowledgeable and had told us all the thing that we need to know while we are up in the air. 

I would recommend Air Ventures Hawaii to friends and family that will visit Kauai and I am encourage all the people reading the reviews about this company, 2 thumbs up for me!!!

review_title: Best way to see all of Kaua'i
review_text: This is by far the best way to see the whole island, from secluded beaches that you may want to check out later to the wild interior jungles.  We saw whales along the Na Pali coast, tons of waterfalls, Waimea Canyon, and according to our pilot Harry, a rare view of the top of Mount Wai'ale'ale.  Don't miss this tour and do it early in your vacation.

Had a wonderful flight over Kauai with out pilot Harry.  He was very knowledgeable about the history of the island, and had lots of recommendations for beaches and other island highlights.  We actually saw a few whales while flying over the ocean outside of Lihue.  The Napoli coast was amazing - secluded beaches and amazing canyons.  Will never forget this adventure!

The pilot Harry was 1st class giving us a super ride, smooth, entertaining, and informative.   I would recommend this trip to anyone looking for a good look at Kuaia from the air. Thanks to Air Ventures.

Today we had a very nice experience with Airventures when we were picked out from our hotel on time, taken on a beautiful boat tour up the river then were toaken on a breath taking plane tour with a very friendly pilot that amazed all my family members. Can't expect any better service.

We had a great experience on our tour of Kauai! The views were beautiful. We couldn't ask for a better pilot - he was experienced, knowledgable and funny, so I felt safe and learned a lot of interesting things about the island. I also got a lot of great photos. This was a great way to wrap up our visit to Hawaii!

An awesome experience.  We happened to have a very windy day, however our pilot Paul guided the plane expertly with only slight turbulence. He told us all about each area we were viewing.  We took awesome photos and were able to see lots and lots of waterfalls.  From beginning to end everyone at Air Ventures was very friendly.  We would highly recommend this to anyone visiting Kauai.

user_location: New York, New York, United States
review_text: This was a terrific aerial experience. The pilot was wonderful and informative and the ride was smooth. Saw all different areas of the island and we were able to get some wonderful photos -- even got to see some whales! Would definitely recommend this as a way to see the whole island of Kauai!

The staff at air ventures Hawaii in Lihue Kauia was very friendly and pleasant. We took fantastic pictures that will help us remember the beautiful island of Kauia!  Our pilot Harry was very knowledgeable and flew the plane with minimal turbulence.

On December 12, 2012 four people from our family got to experience the plane ride over Kuai.  What an awesome experence.  The pilot did an excellent job showing us around the Islands.  He made sure all sides of the plane were able to see the sights, he gave an interesting commentary about the places we were viewing and very capably answered our questions. We truely saw the Island as only a plane could do.  We went places where there are no roads, saw beautiful water falls, lush vegetation, and marveled at the coast with all its ruggedness and beautiful beaches.  This is the trip that any visitor to the Island should definately take. We would do it again in a heartbeat.

review_title: Great Experince - viewing Kauai like never before
review_text:
Flying with Airventures was an excellent experience. The tour itself was over 60 min and covered the most coveted spots of Kauai up close and personal. Our pilot Frank was extremely knowledgeable and provided great insights into the various spots we covered in our flight. 

Most definetely an experience of a lifetime! Not to miss.

user_location: Saint Paul Park, Minnesota, United States
review_title: Air Ventures Kauai in the air!!!!
review_text:
Wow- that is what you will be saying the entire time you are in the air...WOW! 
Paul our Pilot was great! He showed us waterfalls, coffee fields, celebreties homes, Napali coast and many other beautiful sites that you cannot see by car. I would highly recommend this flight to everyone that visits Kauai. The small plane is perfect for those that may not want to do a helicopter. We even saw a whale...looked like a torpedo in the water...awesome! 
Thank you so much Paul and Air Ventures!!! We all loved it. 
December 8, 2012... Dan, Jayne, JoAnn and Jolene (Jolene was our first time flyer, and even she loved it)

We were very pleased with your air tour because with 6 of us in our party and your plane setting just 6 passengers, you personalized the tour to our needs.  You made us feel like the plane was just for us and you were giving us a personal tour.  Your knowledge of the Island was remarkable and you made the tour very interesting for all of us.  Thank you

The west side of the island is very rugged and inaccessible, flying over it is the only way to see it and really appreciate the size and beauty of Waimea Canyon and the Napali coast line.  We had windy/rainy weather in November when we flew but the ride was still smooth and I did not get motion sick which I have trouble with.  The pilot was very informative about the sites we were seeing.  Well worth the money.

My wife and I are from Tampa, FL and did not realize how beautiful the island truly was until we flew with "Air Ventures"! The only way to see what you are missing is to fly the island and "Air Adventures" is the way to go! Best tour of the island! Paul and Luisa Piatt

I was a little nervous about going up in a small plane but this was an awesome experience!   Do it early in your trip so that you can take notes and go visit some of the places later.  The stats were interesting, the Hawaiiana / culture information was very nice to hear and the views were fantastic.  I was impressed with the staff at Air Ventures - they were the perfect combination of both professional and warm/friendly.  I definitely recommend them.

We took the flight on 11.14.12. There was one other couple (friends of ours) and us.  
It was the best thing we did on the island.  Our pilot was friendly & funny too. Sorry we did not take it on our first day there on Kauai Island. It was so beautiful. You could really see so much more than you see on land.  Would recommend to all.

My husband & did a lot of research before choosing Air Ventures vs. Helicopter ride.  It was our 1st visit to Kauai and air ride over any of the islands.  We booked ahead from home.  The process was simple and so was check in. The company is easy to find by Fed Ex building at Lihue Airport since we were driving from Princeville area.  We decided to go with 830 flight figuring it wouldn't be as busy and a great start to day.  

The staff including the pilot introduced himself.  It was a nice day with light winds and a few clouds.  We got weighed in then got seated.  Pleasantly surprised my husband got to sit in copilot seat and I sat on right behind him.  I'm petite and this worked well for me.  It was nice that everyone had their own seat and the staff had cleaned windows while we were there to ensure clear views.  Out of my window you could see support for wings but as you can see I got some decent shots.  

I agree with previous reviewers that right hand side is better for seeing and photo taking.  To be fair, the pilot did fly around certain areas allowing left sided view also. The take off and landing were very smooth. You could hear informative and friendly pilot over headset and ask questions through mic.  We saw helicopters flying in canyons closer to waterfalls but saw plenty of beautiful beaches, canyons, volcanoes, waterfalls etc.  The plane was quiet and comfortable.  As a precaution, I took a Bonine.  But, I do on boats, planes, amusement parks, etc. and did well.  

We are thrilled to have experienced this and would highly recommend this company.

review_title: Great way to see the whole island
review_text: My husband and I have been to Kauai several times and have taken one tour by land and have done numerous hikes, the views from the air are by far the best. I would recommend this to anyone visiting the island for the first time or the 5th time.

Best way to end our vacation. A good way to enjoy the island from above, and a great way to see all the beautiful waterfalls and the gorgest rainbows. 
The pilot was excellent from beginning to end. He was very informative of all the island details. Tried his best to give us a smooth flight and he would let us know in advance were it would be bumpy.

Great pilot and I only wish we had taken this the first day in Kauai. Our pilot was wonderful and turned the plane for all to see. Great view and a good price. Probably the best value on the Island and it is SCENIC.

My wife and I were looking for a way to see all of Kauai without the leg work of hiking a network of trails.  Air Ventures offered us exactly what we wanted and tossed in an added bonus as Paul, our pilot, happened to see a couple of humpback whales shortly after our take-off from Lihue.  He circled the whales giving folks on both sides of the plane a chance to see the wonder of nature.  The trip gave us the opportunity to see the Napali coast, Waimea canyon and all the untouched parts that make up the island of Kauai without having to deal with blisters, muddy clothing and sore muscles.  Thanks Air Ventures for the view of a lifetime; we'll be back to see you again on our next visit!

This trip with Air Ventures was a fantastic way to see all that the beautiful island of Kauai has to offer. You just cant match this view from the ground. The pilot Paul did a great job, not only operating the plane but offering also an informative and comical narrative. We gained a knowledge and appreciation for this beautiful island . This was the best trip we did on Kauai, a must do for all visitors.MAHOLO AIR VENTURES.

I'm overweight for a helo tour, so this was our choice.  A small high wing aircraft.  Good visibility and quite comfortable.  Takes a bit over an hour.  Our pilot Paul was very knowledgeable of the island landmarks.  We would do this again.

My wife,son,daughter-in-law, and daughter had a very enjoyable tour of the island. Our pilot was very knowledgable and accomodating. He spotted a couple of whales a little farther out than would have been his normal route and he took us over them. We would not have seen many of the sights the island has to offer without going on this tour.

Taking this tour was one of the best decisions of our trip--Memories forever!  We saw the Island of Kauai from a most beautiful perspective.  We flew over the Volcano crater--unbelievable sight and feeling. We saw the striking mountains along the Na Pali coastline.
Paul, the pilot,  gave a lot of unexpected information about the Island history and traditions.
It was so enjoyable.

My wife & I really enjoyed the smooth ride with Air Ventures. The pilot was very knowledgeable about the island history & gave us great views of the best sights Kauai has to offer. A great value, would absolutely do it again.

The air tour was a great. It was very informative.
I will say though that our narrator pilot needs to add a little live to his narration. It was as if he was tired of giving the same info over and over. A little flat.
Also want to say that if you do a combo tour, land and air and intend to tip on the combined price, the ground tour does not share with the air tour.
We had so much fun! Our one-year had a blast as well. I wish we had taken this tour the first day we arrived so that we could scout out some places to visit. If you can, this tour is a must!!!!

review_title: Great way to see the island
review_text:
Traveled with some folks who exceeded the helicopter weight limit as well as were easily air sick.  AirVentures was the way to go.  They're conveniently located near the main airport too.  Paul was fun and knowledgeable and tried his best to keep the plane steady as he saw we were wearing our air sick bands.  

Courteous, efficient, knowledgeable and for those of larger and/or sensitive to air sickness it's the way to go over the heli ride.  Allowed us to see the Napali coast and the inner Waimea canyon we wouldn't have otherwise been able to see.

Thanks AirVenture's for making our vacation special and complete!

review_title: Better than a Helicopter Tour - I did BOTH on the same day...
review_text: I highly recommend this on the island of Kauai.  You literally feel suspended in the air on this plane.  Like time has stopped.  You get to enjoy every single second.  You can take great pictures and shoot great video or just sit back and relax and enjoy.  We did the helicopter ride in the morning and you are too close to the ground for pics and are traveling at a very high rate of speed.  The one part I liked about the helicopter tour was the Jurassic Park Waterfalls.  Save yourself the $400 watch it for nothing on my site by just looking up TomKayak and click on the video link. Air Ventures Hawaii allows you to see more from a better vantage point and a bonus -- it's 1/2 the price.  I highly recommend Air Ventures.  I sailed, kayaked, helicoptered and liked the Airplane the best :)

review_title: AirVentures great air tour of Kauai!
review_text: Very good tour!  Quiet and gentle with great visibility and coverage of the island. Good piloting.  Great price, too.  Highly recommended.

review_title: Air Ventures flight tour over Kuaui
review_text: My wife and I flew over Kuaui with Air Ventures today and absolutely loved it.  It was very beautiful and the pilot was great.  Seeing the island from above was more than we expected, the landscape so diverse and wonderful.  We would highly recommend seeing Kuaui this way.

review_title: Kauai from the air via AirVentures
review_text: There is only one way to really see Kauai - from the air, and Air Ventures Hawaii provides the most reasonable and thorough ride over Kauai  you can get.

Thanks Harry for a smooth flight and delightful information about the island.  The sights were spectacular. You can really see the differences of each side of the island.  My only compliant was my setting, near the wing and supports; it was difficult to get some shots with out including them.
But overall, LOVED IT!!!
ellajeff96
If it was not for this flight we would have missed out on so many of the sights of beautiful island of Kauai.

review_title: Airplane vs Helicopter Tour of Kauai
review_text:
Years ago we had taken a helicopter tour over the Big Island and I was very disappointed that the pilot never stopped and hovered over the sites.  I imagined this would be the same in Kauai so I booked the much less expensive airplane tour.  My husband got to be the co-pilot so was very pleased.  We were also both able to be seated on the right side of the plane which is a must if you want to see anything.  What I did notice is that the helicopters were MUCH lower than us and were able to go in and out of the canyons (Blue Hawaiian).  Not sure it was worth $85/pp more, but something to consider.
The other 3 passengers on the plane were over an hour late arriving at the airport.  It is not AirVentures fault, but it was very frustrating to lose that time.  We were still able to do the full one-hour tour.
The sites are beautiful and Paul does a great job explaining what is below you.  Airplane windows are great, but make sure to have a polarizing lens or you will have a lot of reflection.

On a side note: the Air and Ground tour actually charges you $4 MORE than if you do the two events seperate.

review_title: A great way to see Kauai
review_text:
My wife and I flew with Air Ventures over Kauai and had a very enjoyable time.  I was lucky enough to have the co-pilot seat and my wife was right behind me.

Our pilot, Paul, was very funny and knowledgeable and made a great tour guide.  Seeing the island from 3000-5000 ft was really an incredible experience, especially the Napali coast.

I only wish we could have flown a bit closer to some of the water falls and clifts, which I'm sure a helicopter can get to.  But still, very enjoyable and well worth it!

We flew the Air Ventures 6 passengerer plane over Kauai. Fortunately the weather was very good and we could see all the places including the rain forests. Pilot explained all the places and was very accessible to questions. The plane is a little older and that's why I gave 4 star although that shouldn't matter. Receptionist was very cordial, she took the group photo and emailed it to me at no cost before I reached my resort - others charge $$. I strongly recommend flying over Kauai to see the islands waterfalls, rain forest and mountains which are not accessible by roads. Also, you can find coupons to get a better deal.

review_title: Super way to put the island in perspective!
review_text: We did things backwards- we spent several days driving around, scuba diving, seeing the sights THEN we went and took our flight on our last day.  Was a fabulous was to see and photograph the places we'd been to on foot.  If you cannot do this your first day on the island, then by all means take the tour before you leave.  You will not be sorry!

On November 27, 2012 my wife and I flew with awesome pilot Paul and 4 other people.  We have been to the island of Kauai 3 times and have visited several spots and hiked several trails.  Now was the time to see the island by air, since there are several parts of the island you cannot see except by air.
Paul, our pilot sent over island and got to see not only the parts of the island you cannot walk to but also parts we have seen but with a different and quite neat way.  Paul pointed out several spots on the island where there were movies made at and also Hawaian history at.
We enjoyed it and got much more than our monies worth.

I must say we were incredibly impressed with Tropical Biplanes!!  If you have never flown in an open cockpit plane, it is definitely a must.  My wife and I went for our anniversary and it was a time we will never forget. Nick is an absolute professional.  He's laid back and makes you feel right at home in the cockpit.  He tells amazing stories about the history of the land.  The best thing we did in Lihue! Thanks Nick you're awesome bro!!!

review_title: Best way to get an overview of Kauai
review_text:
Our party of four had an unforgettable tour this morning and we have hundreds of great photos for souvenirs. The plane was well maintained, the pilot gave good narration and the trip was long enough to show us all of Kauai's beauty at a leisurely pace and close enough to see details. 
Definitely something to place at the top of the to do list on a visit to beautiful Kauai.

We thought the price was very good value.

Gail from Arizona

While a helicopter tour of the island would be ideal (been there, done that), my ears can't take the pressure changes that come with lightning fast altitude changes. This airplane tour, is a great way to see the island for me. They had a mount on the wing for my GoPro and I ended up with 2000 incredible pics of the island.

Since over 80% of kauai is only seen by air, this tour is a must do on your vacation to this
beautiful island. Our pilot was very informative and we felt safe from the takeoff to the landing. i highly recommend AirVentures!

Our daughter and her husband scheduled this tour for us as our Christmas gift and what a great gift.  The view was beautiful and the pilot was good at letting us know what we were seeing. I had never been in a small airplane and was a little nervous but it was great.  We are so glad we had this experience.

What a delightful experience taking the hour long flight around Kauai to see the many places one can only see from the air. After seeing many places by car or foot, it was great picking out areas from the air and getting some fantastic pictures. I would recommend Air Ventures and Paul as the pilot for a great trip.

We arrived for our flight not knowing what to expect!! We met our pilot Paul as he explained to us
what to expect from this adventure. It was all he said and more!! The beauty of the island is breathtaking
from the air, something you do not see driving the island. The waterfalls from various movies, the Na Pali Coast line, and the view of Waimea Canyon was breathtaking!! This is a must see for anyone visiting Kauai! We would recomend this trip to anyone seeking a truly fantastic experience.

There is so much of Kauai that you can only see from the air - you have to do a plane or helicopter tour.  This one was very good.  It was a 6 passenger plane, but the ride was much smoother than I expected - the landing was the softest ever.  We seemed to stay up quite a bit higher than the helicopters, so maybe they got better views, but ours were nothing to complain about.

While this activity was scheduled as a combo event, surely the air portion of the adventure was the most spectacular and enjoyable.  We did get to see the island with a birds eye view and the commentary by the pilot was excellent, he showed us the variety of the island and it's beauty.  We would highly recommend this trip for anyone who would enjoy the wonders of Hawaii. Because the island has few roads this was the only way to truly see it.   WOW!

review_title: Seeing the Island as never before!
review_text: We have been to Kauai before and love the island, This time we took the air tour with Air Ventures. What a great choice. Harry our pilot was great. The island holds so many magical and majestic beauties. A must for any visitor to the Island of Kauai..

review_title: Our Flight Around Paradise Was Nothing Short of Amazing!
