review_text: We scheduled our flight around paradise through our hotel concierge.  The process worked flawlessly.  Tour staff picked us up on time to begin the journey.  Once at the airport our small group was met by Air Ventures staff who were very courteous and then ushered us to the counter.  The check-in process was quick and efficient and in just minutes we were walking to board for an on time departure.  The equipment was clean and appeared well maintained.  Once on board the pilot went over safely procedures and other important info about the plane and after which we taxied to our runway.  The take off was smooth just as the flight.  What view's!  We covered the entire island taking in all the beautiful sights - gorge, Na Pali Coast, rain forest etc flying up close and personal over these natural wonders.  All the time being described in great detail by our pilot.  My wife and I loved it!  What a way to start the adventure in this magical island.  Thanks Air Ventures for making this possible!  To all those who read this post....don't hesitate for a minute to start your vacation week like ours and take the plunge into these sky's!
The views were aswsom! A very smooth flight and spacticular!!! And the piolt very knowledgable and intertaining.

The air tour was fantastic! Harry, our pilot, made you feel comfortable and shared so much about the island. The views from the airplane were breathe taking. We will never tour in a helicopter again after this. All the staff were friendly and helpful. Don't forget your camera!!!
An amazing experience!
Thanks it was a wonderful experience!!  I saw things that I would not have had the opportunity to see otherwise; it was fantabulous!!  Ellen
This is a great air tour to see the different sights of Kauai.  Our pilot Harry was great.  The island is absolutely beautiful.
Easy to find, comfortable in the sky. Very imformative Pilot and he made you comfortable in the air :)  Enjoyed the flight from begining to end!!!!

It was a beautiful informative flight .  The pilot was great and the flight fun .
I'd do it again!!!the sky's were clear  We did get to fly through some Hawaiian air plane wash, as the mist cleaned the plane.  Kauai from the air is s
Spectacular

My husband and I loved the tour. Our pilot Paul was great; sharing lots of interesting things about movies filmed nearby, as well as history of each area as we passed over.  I was lucky enough to get to sit up front with him! 
It was a great chance to see the island from a different perspective. The island is so beautiful and rugged. A view from the air is a must to really see it all!

Execellent day and views that was an  awesome sight to behold from this flying machine!
We were so mesmerized that we did not run thr video,

Thanks to Bali Hai for their suggestions. 

will like to see a full lenghth video of this experience.

My husband, sister, brother-in-law and I decided to take this plane ride to get a good idea about what Kauai was all about.  Wonderful time, Paul (our pilot) was very thorough and knew plenty about the island.  As Paul said the scenery was awesome. After all the plane trips we went on I really appreciated his smooth takeoff and landing.  Glad we didn't miss this opportunity, will take a ride again on our next trip to Kauai!

review_title: Kauai is far superior by air, land, and water
review_text:
I really enjoyed the flight. It is incredible the scenery and the scale of climate changes. The pilot was informative, polite, and professional. I choose to fly first to get an overall view of the island. The next day was very detailed with multiple examples planned out to view those spectacular sights up close. I like hiking and was extremely pleased by the driver's recommendations. He informed me as well as to excellent  and novel selections for beach experiences. His knowledge and experience left us with great pictures, wonderfull memories and great food. Thank You Air Ventures for making Kauai a total success for my wife and I.
Ernie Barksdale

review_title: the most amazing ride of my life
review_text: My husband and I went with another couple to Kauai and experienced all the island had to offer. We went sight seeing by boat-train-rental car and now flying. We did not miss a single second of any attraction, however this was my favorite. The pilot was professional and funny-the plane was roomy for the 5 of us and the sights were amazing. The ocean with sting rays-sharks were thrilling. The mountains were majstic, you went away with an awed feeling of the whole experience- thank you

review_title: Views were amazing.... Tour Guide Not So Much...
review_text: So we booked this tour to see the mostly the North Shore by air.  I do believe Kauai is the most beautiful Island out of all the islands.  The scenery was A+++++.  Our tour guide Harry was just okay.. He did give us some information about what we were looking at but it was just general information that I had heard already by our tour books and other guides. The plane was a little bumpy but nothing that would reflect this review..... If you ask me take a helicopter, They get right into the canyon and the waterfalls closer then the plane can did.

Wednesday, Oct. 25, 2012 ~ This was fantastic viewing of Kauai island. We saw the Robinson family home perched high up on a mountain top and away from everyone else. What an amazing view and peace they must experience!  Beautiful landscapes, mountains, beaches, coves and valleys.  I wondered what it would be like to hike into these areas that cannot be reached by car and see the waterfalls and the beautiful greenery of this land. The flight was smooth sailing and our pilot flew over key areas several times so we were able to get a good view from every angle. This was an Enjoyable and Comfortable experience.  We were able to take pictures since the ride was smooth and clear.  Thank you Air Venture for a great experience my husband and I will remember for a long time.  Alice Evans

This trip was everything that I expected. At the start, the welcoming " ground crew" was very informative courteous and efficient.  The flight was beautiful.  We saw things so much more clearly than we could have from the ground, especially the Waiimea Canyon.  The pilot eas very informative and entertaining ( flew well too)

review_title: Amazing flight over the island of Kauai
review_text: This was amazing!  Want to bring my family back and take them too.  Only mistake I wore white pants and that affects the pictures too.  Where all dark clothes.  Our pilot was amazing too he told us a lot of information about the island!   Great views!

We had a group of 4 ladies that took a tour of Kauai on Halloween, Oct. 3l, 2012.  Our pilot was in full costume and was very informative as we took the tour.  It was really great, very smooth and we all enjoyed it very much.  It was great seeing the whole island from the air.  I believe we saw every part of the island, which is so different when observing from the sky.  Thanks for all your efforts.  I would recommend you to any other tourists.  Actually, I did on Thursday and they said they were going to go.  Aloha from Northern California.

We loved our trip!!! We did the the tour around Kauaui, and had a wonderful time.  Nicole, the receptionist, was very helpful, and Paul, our pilot, did all he could to make our trip fantastic.  I would reccomend this trip to amyone who would to take in all the views of Kauaui.

My friend and I took the 1-hour flight yesterday.  The views were spectacular!  Our flight was relatively smooth and our pilot, Paul, was great about making sure that everyone got to see all of the sights (no matter which side of the plane you were on).  We've been to Kauai a few times, but this was the first time to see the island by air.  Well worth the trip.

I took my two daughters and my niece to Kauai.  None of us had been to the island before so I asked friends about the best way to see everything.  I was told by several friends about the Air Ventures tour so we booked a trip.  It was amazing!  Our pilot made sure that both sides of the plane were exposed to the scenery and explained what we were seeing to each side.  We were very pleased that we took the tour.

Thank you for the excellent flight over Kauai! It was great, and we got alot of great pictures! Everyone in our group was happy at the end of the tour! I could not believe what all Kauai had to offer when flying over!! Would fly again!!

This was a great way to see the island. Our pilot narrated as we flew around. He made several passes so we could have better views and photos. We were able to see things that would not be possible from the road.

my husband and i were in kauai and thought we couldn't afford to view it by air but we were wrong, this tour is very affordable and the best part is it's a great tour. we definately recommended this tour for very one. The pilot,Paul was very safe with us and made sure we all saw the beautiful island it was the most amazing thing we have every done on vacation and i would do it again.

We recently did the air tour over kauai with Air Ventures Hawaii. We really really enjoyed seeing the island from the air and the prices were great! It is the only way to see alot of the island. We are recommending this tour to everyone.

What an awesome opportunity this company offers to experience spectacular sceneries and the beauty of the Kauai Island.  The ride was very smooth, Paul (the pilot) make us all feel very comfortable and did an excellent job at explaining and pointing out all the sites of interests.   Would highly recommend this company...by the way, thanks for the group picture...

Seeing Kauai by air is an excellent activity.  But if you weigh more than 250 pounds you either can't go by helicopter or you have to pay for two seats.  AirVentures did not have that requirement.  I don't know if they have any weight limitations, but for me (over 250 pounds) and my wife this was the way to see Kauai by air.  The staff (both pilot and ground personnel) were pleasant, competent, and very  knowledgeable.  They had a combination package which included the flight and also a boat trip up the Wailua river to see the fern grotto.  That's what we got.  I would highly recommend this adventure to everyone.

We were in Kauai on our honeymoon and decided to see Kauai from the air.  We chose Air Ventures Hawaii because it was less expensive and I thought that it would be better on my stomach than a helicopter.  It turned out to be the best choice we made.  The ride was comfortable and the view was breathtaking!  If you ever get a chance to visit Kauai you have to try this tour.

To really appreciate Kauai, you must see the whole island by air, and I think a fixed wing aircraft is the way to do it. Paul, our pilot, was very informative with his narration, and took his time to "circle" many attractions so that both side passengers were able to view and had time for photos.

The best way to see the whole island is by air, and the only way to see alot of the island.  The big gray clouds that morning kinda scared me, but Steve got us up and out into sunshine and we had a fun trip.  He pointed out the historical, unusual and cultural sites and I got some good pics.  Glad I did it.  Katha.Snow.16

Our daughter was here 3 weeks ago on her honeymoon and she told us that she had a great time with Air Ventures.  Because of her we booked a tour with Air Ventures.  From the time we were picked up by Billy our shuttle driver, to the check in with Nicole, and our pilot Paul, we had a great experience.  We would highly recommend this company for a tour of Kauai.  Thanks again to all of you, we will not forget this trip!
Barry, Terry & Larry

review_title: Best tour of my whole trip.
review_text: Paul was our pilot and he showed us a great time he circled around so both sides of the plane got great views and pictures. He was full of interesting facts about the island. The boat trip afterwards was great as well the ladies singing and dancing for us at the fern grotto was very cool.I would definitely recommend this tour to anyone visiting the island. Great value for the money.

We took a plane ride over the island of Kauai, Hawaii last October 16th of this year  This was an optional addition to a land and river boat tour called "The Best of Kauai."  The one hour flight took us on a round trip over the southeastern, western and northern coastlines of the island before crossing over the interior section of the island on the way back to Lihue Airport.  The trip was awesome:  we were able to get a birds' eye view of the famous Waimea Canyon which we were unable to see on a previous car trip because of fog and rain.  We also got a fantastic view of the equally famous Na Poli coastline on the western side of the island.  The boarding and disembarking procedures were very professionally handled, and our pilot also served as our very well-informed guide.  The ride was very comfortable, and earphones were provided to eliminate some of the noise of a small propeller plane.  All of us, myself, my wife, and my sister-in-law agreed that this spectacular trip was well worth the extra cost for the total package of our tour.  Bernard McWilliams

user_location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
review_text: This was a great way to see the island, one of the highlights of our trip. Harry was a great pilot- I am very afraid of flying and he made the flight enjoyable and helped calm my nerves. I'd recommend Air Ventures to anyone who visits the island!

An excellent flight, with great views of Kauai and a very informative narration by our pilot Paul.
This was a great way to see this very scenic island and added enormously to our understanding of the island as a whole.  We would highly recommend this activity.

Air Ventures Hawaii is the best way to see all of Kauai.  Paul, our pilot, was very informative and friendly.  Plane was comfortable, it did get a little hot but it was abnormally hot on Kauai the week I was there.  This was part of our land, air and sea package.  Beautiful views and we got to see Pierce Bronson's house. LOL    A little rainbow followed us part of the way.  Too cool!   Would do it again!!  Thanks to all, Tina

review_title: Very comfortable, great way to see the island
review_text: This was my our first trip to kauai and we toured the island by car, boat and plane. Air ventures Hawaii was my favourite way to see the island. The pilot was great ( one of the smoothest landings I've felt) he was informative and friendly. I felt that the fixed wing flight was the best way to view the island as you get a great overview of the whole island, not just the Na Pali coast. Overall good bang for your buck and great experience.

review_title: Great way to see the island!
review_text: Really beautiful views of the island of Kauai!  Pilot was friendly and informative.  Airplane seating was comfortable except the cabin was a little too warm.

Air Venture Hawaii is the only way to see Kauai!  All the beauty, all the breathtaking diversity of land and sea was covered.  The staff couldn't have been more accommodating, from reservations to a souvenir photo waiting in our e-mail when we returned home.  And the price made it the best deal of our vacation!

Pilot was friendly and very informative. Flying over Kauai is a must do and doing it in a plane is so much better than a helicopter. The plane is more comfortable for those pron to air sickness. The plane is also more eco friendly.

What a beautiful view of Kauia. My boyfriend Mark and I were impressed to see the view of this island paradise from the air. Indeed, when I get my tour company together, I will certainly use Air Ventures as a must do during our trip. 

Thanks for a great time...
Jocee
San Anselmo, CA

review_title: Excellent way to see Kauai by air
review_text: This was our second flight over Kauai with Air Ventures.  We returned because of our great experience the first time.  We had a great pilot who was very knowledgeable of the location of points of interest on the island.  Would highly recommend this company for a great air experience!

On our last day in Kauai we toured Kauai by air.  Paul was our pilot and guide, and what a magnificent way to see this beautiful island!  I have been to Kauai many times in the past twenty years, and have toured by boat, helipcopter, and by car.  This was the best.  I wish we had taken this tour on day 1, as I saw beaches that I never discovered, and can hardly wait to return and find.  I saw the inner beauty of the isle as well as the beaches that are the most beautiful of all the islands.  Thanks for a view of a lifetime.

Mary Lou Browning
Awesome views.  Everyone must see the island from an air view.  The staff at Air Ventures were awesome, very friendly. Would definetly use them again.

review_title: Best way to See The Island
review_text: I enjoyed this tour very much. Our guide Harry was great and he pointed out several waterfalls you can't see from the road only by air. I sat next to the pilot which did limit my picture taking capabilities a little. I did feel a little queasy toward the end of the flight but nothing too bad. I would sit near the back of plane if I went again. I used my IPad and I was able to edit several pictures I took into some truly great shots. I will post my favorites shortly.

We enjoyed our ride, it was very smooth and the views were outstanding. I got to sit in the co-pilot seat! The pilot was very informative as well (we know where Julia Roberts and Pierce Brosnan live now). We must have seen 10 rainbows and as many falls.  On occasion you could see the helicopter travelers below us (a little closer to the terrain) but I think we still got a great view of Kauai as well, and yet we used less fuel (greener).  
We went early in the morning, maybe a smoother ride that time of day but some morning showers dotted he area so at times the views were not perfect, but we got the rainbows instead, and they even show up well in picture.
This is something you should do on Kauai, and Air Ventures is a great team to host you.

Loved this adventure!  Was a very smooth ride, our pilot was fun and very informative! I would recommend this for everyone. Especially if you had to choose between this and anything else! Will tell everyone I talk to about Kauai. That if they do nothing else. They have to do this!!

My grandson and I recently flew with Nick in his Kauai based Waco. 

Wonderful experience - great pilot - excellent narration - great value!

And, Nick took the time to go through the features of the Waco with us.

Beautiful airplane!

Highly recommended.

This was such a great tour.  Seeing the island from the air was a beautiful experience.  Paul, our pilot was so informative and had such a great sense of humor we loved everything about the experience.  We will certainly share this with all our friends.

We enjoyed the breath-taking views of the island that can only be seen by air. The commentary was just right - informative, relaxed, and non-intrusive. We have previously taken helicopter flights over Kauai and recommend the 6 passenger AirVentures plane for great views, smoother ride, and no middle seats. The AirVentures flight was the highlight of our vacation!

Could not have asked for a more perfect trip. Skies clear, excellent view of the summit, valleys, canyons and coastlines. Ride was smooth slow for good picture taking. Pilot made it safe and kept us informed as we traveled over the island. The seats were not the most comfortable for manuverabilty to take some of the shots. But the views Breathtaking!  I would recommend Air Venture to friends. I like to support local family business. Thanks for the experience. Monica H.
Loved the views of Kauai!  Great way to get a feel for the island.  Got lots of really good pictures.  Would recommend it highly.

Taking a plane ride with air ventures in Kauai, hawaii was truly a memorable experience. Paul was our pilot and flew all over Kauai to show us the beauty of that island.Paul explained alot of "history" of the island and explained what we were seeing while flying.The Napali coastline and the canyon were unbelievable.I recommend this experience to everyone wanting to see an entire island while visiting for a short time.

Great trip with Paul and our family around and over Kauai! Sowed us the peaks, valleys, canyons and waterfalls of the island. Definitely a highlight experience of our trip. The views of the Napali coast were fantastic and awesome. Smooth flight with just the right amount of adrenaline rush!

Great views of the island!  Felt safe with the pilot and he made every effort to give everyone a good view.  Couldn't hear some of the dialogue but then my hearing is less than desirable.  Overall, a wonderful trip and well worth it.  The office staff was helpful and courteous.  Thanks.

review_title: One of the highlights of my Hawaiian vacation!
review_text:
This was the first time I've seen Kauai from the air, and it was amazing! I would highly recommend this company for anyone looking to see the aerial view of the island. Professional and personable check in staff, the pilot really knew what he was doing and he was funny and informational during the trip. 

Be prepared to take about 200 pictures of the island, and see Kauai is ways most people won't see!

review_title: Naval aviator gives this flight two thumbs up
review_text: I am retired navy and a current Captain for a major airline. The staff was friendly and professional. The aircraft provided the excellent views advertised. However, the flight stands out due to the excellent job by the pilot in providing exceptional views of all the island's major features. He also provided a commentary so everyone knew what each view comprised. I would recommend this service to anyone and will take my family again when next we visit Kauai.

I will highly recommend Air Ventures to my children, grandchildren, and relatives next time they visit Kauai. It is amazing to see the heart of Kauai, the Jurassic Park falls, the undescribable cathedral cliffs of Na Pali coast and of course the incomparable beaches of the island!
Mar S.

This was a trip taken with Steve's Best of Kauai....and Air Tours on Wednesday... September 26, 2012 ...one day before my birthday.... My husband and I enjoyed this  AirVenture ride! ....This was my first time in a small plane and I made it OK!  The scenery was simply beautiful. This will be a most unforgetable experience  on my first trip to Kauai, Hawaii.

Thank you for this one experience that was  on my bucket list,

Arlena Dean
PO Box 1904
Broken Arrow, OK 74012

review_title: beautiful and quick way to see all of Kauai
review_text: This was our first Air trip by air venture to see Hawaii Island, Visited, Big Island, Oahu and Kauai, but did not do so. In Kauai, we took this air trip and really loved it. We saw many hidden places, waterfalls and beaches, that cannot be done by car. The staff was friendly and courteous the pilot was funny, knowldgable  and informative. We would strongly recommend this.

review_title: Great overall view of the island!
review_text:
We really enjoyed the flight and the opportunity to see a birdseye view of the whole island. The scenery from that height was to say the least spectacular! I would not hesitate to recommend this to any one.
Dave L

This was our first trip to Kauai and decided to fly over the island to see some of the amazing scenery, we were not disappointed.  The mountains, waterfalls, and the Na Pali coast were great to view from the plane, windows on all sides. The pilot was very informative pointing out all the attractions.  Well worth doing.

review_title: One of the highlights of our vacation!
review_text: A fantastic experience! The staff was extremely friendly and knowledgeable. To see this island from the air is an experience that my family and I will never forget. Paul did an outstanding job explaining everything about the island to us as well as answering all of our questions. I would highly recommend this attraction to other travelers!

review_title: I recommend this to Hawaii lovers of all ages!
review_text: This was a wonderful trip. So many beautiful views from the sky. you have not seen this island until you see it from the air. We love that this was a plane and not a helicopter. It was a very smooth ride.
Great experience!  The pilot was very informational and the entrie staff was friendly.  I have taken both a herlicopter tour and the airplane and this was a much better overall experience.

My wife and I plus two of our dear Friends visited Kauai recently and chose Air Ventures. It was the right choice for us. The price was right. Ingrid picked us up right on time,Nicole was vrey pleasent to work with and Paul did a wonderful job explaining every aspect of the flight.

This was our family’s first trip to Kauai, and we were glad that we decided to make Air Ventures one of the highlights of our vacation. The staff was friendly and energetic, and the tour was also affordable (half the price of some helicopter rides) and we liked that a nice picture was taken of us before boarding, then quickly sent to our family via email. Our pilot was also very personable, and had a lot of interesting comments over the course of the tour – including references to Jurassic Park and Pirates of the Caribbean filming locations. Overall, there was a personal touch to this tour. With much of Kauai inaccessible by car, we learned to further appreciate the beauty of Kauai from a bird’s eye view.  We hope that others will try this once-in-a-lifetime experience.

My fiance and I visited Kauai for the first time last week and started off our visit with a scenic flight on Air Ventures. We had a wonderful experience and saw so much more of Kauai than we could of from the ground. Our pilot was a great tour guide and the views were amazing!

review_title: The Only Way To See Kauai
review_text:
We were warned off helicopter tours because I'm way north of 250 pounds. AV did not even blink... My new wife and I got the two rear seats and I had the luxury of completely stretching out my legs.

The equipment, check-in process, flight intro, and staff were great.  Flight was entire island with great commentary.

I made the mistake of trying to take too many photos and got myself nauseous.  But most of flight was straight and level.

Took early afternoon flight so sun was high. Pro: everything is illuminated. Con: less interesting colors/shadows.

Absolutely do again, but with a Bonine

J

This was an amazing experience. The pilot was great and very accomadating. He was very informative and told us all of the interesting facts and spots of the island. It was great to see Hawaii from the air!! I would recommend this for sure!
We SO enjoyed the wonderful air tour!! Our pilot was pleasant and very informative. We saw many places that we could never have viewed otherwise. Definitely worth the money and highly recommended!

review_title: Fun Adventure with Air Ventures Hawaii
review_text: I visited Hawaii recently with my niece and her husband.  We decided to take the plane to view the island rather than a helicopter because of recommendations from friends.  They were right!  It was super fun.  We loved the views and the commentary that accompanied our flight.  Wish I could do it all over again right now!
A very enjoyable experience, viewing Kauai from the air.  The trip was informative, views were amazing, personnel were friendly and knowledgeable.  Thanks for the experience.

If you're planning to visit Kauai, you should know that only 20% of the island is accessible by car, as such the only alternative to see the island is from above. We did a lot of research before and based on the reviews we chose Air Ventures and that was a very nice experience, something you should not miss when visiting Kauai. This 60-70 minutes flight was well worth it, you see the Na Pali cost from above, the canion and so on.... and a knowleadgeable pilot will also be important here (and Paul, our pilot, really knew the island and its history, mahalo).

Nick with this company completely wasted both my fiancé and my time while on our trip to the island in August 2012.  We set up a time with him, which he cancelled a few hours prior (not a huge deal, things happen).  He then rescheduled with us for the following day at 5pm.  We drove halfway across the island only to be stood up.  He didn't call or anything.  He didn't call us back when we called two of Tropical Biplanes numbers trying to figure out what was going on as we stood there at their counter with no one to help.  Time is precious when on vacation in Kauai and he wasted a good portion of ours.  He didn't even have the guts to call us back.

This a Kauai must do and the best 60+ minute bang for the buck on the island. We saw sights that you'd never see from the coast or be able to drive to. It was the highlight of our trip and would suggest if you had to do just one adventure that this would be the one to do.

Fantastic way to see Kauai.  It was very educational and the pilots knowledge pointing out different parts of the island really helped us the rest of our vacation.  It was absolutely beautiful and being in the air is the only way to really experience Kauai's beauty.

the plane was very comfortable and smoother riding then a helicopter.
the pilot was very informative pointing out different parts of the island and their history.
we will definately be back

We decided to take AirVentures so we could get a look at the areas of the island not accessable by car. We were not dissapointed! The smooth plane ride and knowledgable pilot gave us a better feel for the beauty and history of the island. We were shown the most spectacular views and for me the waterfalls!! We would highly recomend this tour to our friends.

review_title: Amazing views of the Garden Isle
review_text: This is the best way to see the entire island of Kauai and the amazing sights not available by land or water.  Better value than the helicopters and you get to see the entire island - LIhue, Poipu, Hanapepe Valley, Waimea Canyon, NaPali Coast, Princeville and North Shore, and the mountain valleys.  Truly spectacular and guided by a knowledgable and friendly pilot.  My spouse does not like to fly, but is ready to go again!

Loved this flying experience and the stunning beauty of the island.  The experience of seeing everything up close and from such a different perspective was wonderful.  This was truly the highlight of our trip to Kauai and recommend it to all. Loved hearing all the history associated with the island as we flew over.  It added a lot to the experience.
Julie S.

review_title: Aweaome way to start a honeymoon!
review_text: Aug 8th 2012. Arrived for our honeymoon for our first time on Kauai. We had booked online for the plane tour and the sunset cruise later the same day. Plane ride was spectacular, a great way to see the island, especially the Napali coast, and to give a birds eye view of some of the sights that we later were able to drive to. Pilot was very friendly, we had a great time! A definite yes to anyone thinking of booking with Air Ventures Hawaii!

We decided on a 'last minute' flight over the island.  Air Ventures Hawaii was able to accommodate us by adding another flight mid-day. We had a wonderful flight with a pilot that was very knowledgeable and funny.  The views were just breathtaking as we were lucky enough to fly on a clear, sunny day with very little turbulence.  Would highly recommend this island tour to all.

I researched air tours for Kauai by helicopter and plane and decided on Air Ventures Hawaii. The experience was wonderful. It was the highlight of our trip. We haven't did a helicopter tour but don't believe it could have been any better. We actually booked the plane ride and boat cruise of the Napoli coast together. It was the best money we spent while in Hawaii. This was a trip we will never forget. We would like to thank Paul and the gang for a wonderful time. Hope we get to go again, soon.

                                                                                          Many thanks,
                                                                                        Rodney & Kathy

Our trip was one of the highlights of our fourth trip to Kauai. We liked it better than the helicopter trip we took several years ago! The pilot was knowledgeable and friendly, and we had a superb view of the Na Pali coast.  Two thumbs up, mahalo for a fun morning!

On our honeymoon, my husband really wanted to see Kaua'i from the air.  I am not a good flyer AT ALL but the reviews had been really good, so I figured...hey let's go for it.  I found it easy to make the booking, and everyone I dealt with was really welcoming and nice!
The pilot had lots of experience and was very knowledgeable which made it easier for me, as I'm prone to panic and sickness.  Letting us know that if there is turbulence to not look through the camera lense proved to be invaluable.  Overall great experience and for people who like flying I woiuld definitely recommend AirVentures!

On August 25, 2012 we did an AirAdventure Tour over Kauai. It was a fabulous day for weather...meaning the skies were clear with very few clouds. We were able to see many things that are otherwise not visible because of the weather. The amount of hills and valleys on this small Island are amazing. It didn't appear to be all that small. There are many waterfalls that we were able to see. The coastline and Napali Coast are absolutely beautiful. Everyone gets a window seat and can take many pictures. I took over 200 pictures during the hour which will provide lasting memories of our air tour. The staff at Air Adventures were all very nice and the pilot was constantly pointing out points of interest as we were flying. This was a great tour and was a great value in comparison to other tours.

review_title: Got to see parts of Kauai that I never would have seen otherwise!
review_text: Got almost all the sights I wanted to see in one flight, and from an angel I never would have been able to manage on my own! Thanks Air Ventures!!

My wife and I flew on the 10am flight on Thr. Aug. 30.  We were there on a cruise port stop (from NCL Pride of America).   We were picked up at the Anchor Cove shopping center, to the open air waiting area.  There were 6 of us and we were weighed, for seat assignment.  One lady was sitting as the co-pilot, then there were 3 rows of seats with 2, 1, and 2.  My wife and I were in the last row, together.  Those in the right side can see better as the flight was clockwise of the island most of the time.

The pilot Paul gave very good narration.  We really enjoyed the flight.

Thanks.
Had a great time.  Great views and lots of opportunity to see main sights.  The pilot was very competent (important for nervous flyers).

review_title: Kauai from the air is spectacular!
review_text: Best way to see how unique and spectacular this incredible island really is. Enjoyed our flight immensely.
Staff was very friendly and we both felt completely safe while in the air!  Saw tons of great views and got a better understanding of the island!!

The Air ventures staff met all our requests and then some. This was a flight for our Anniversary and what a special flight it was!!! The pilot was wonderful he spoke just enough and reminded me to look up in between taking my pictures and he was correct!! The views were great overall, and also could see all the details. The weather was perfect and we could see from one coast to the other.

This was my favorite adventure during my week in Kauai, and one that I would highly recommend!  It was a wonderful way to see the island, and the best way to see many of the natural wonders.  I loved the individual bubble windows for taking pictures, and the pilot provided a lot of interesting information throughout the trip.  It gave me many lasting memories of Kauai from the air.  Not to be missed!
Denise

I was somewhat afraid to fly in a small plane.  Our pilot was great!  The take off and landing were really smooth.  Probably smoother than a large plane!

Seeing Kauai from the air was fantastic!  There are so many places that we wouldn't have been able to see if it hadn't been for this trip.  We got some great photos which will last a lifetime.  I absolutely loved this experience!  I would recommend this to others for sure!

This trip was amazing.  I was very apprehensive getting into such a small plane.... but WOW am I glad that I took the trip.  Harry was very knowledgable and I felt safe up there.  The views are something that absolutely has to be experienced.  Thanks Harry

What a wonderful adventure. Took an early morning flight around the island, giving us a great look at the natural wonders of Kauai.  Our pilot was fun and very aware of my sister's fear of the "little plane."  Seeing the island from above gave me a deeper appreciation of the beauty I saw on the ground.  Great trip.
Friendly, knowledgeable staff - good "over-view" of Kauai - the patterns of the land and light are spectacular
Very informative highlight of our trip, will recommend it to everyone. We already liked and tagged you guys on FB....:)

review_title: The Best Part of Our Trip was the biplane ride on the last day! Awesome!
review_text:
We had seen advertisements for air and helicopter tours. But never expected to see a biplane tour. We took both the standard plane tour, which was wonderful also. Then we spotted the biplane sign, I had to do it! We made an appointment and my brother-in-law Joe and I went for the ride with our pilot Nick DuBay. He was fabulous, also a flight instructor as I found out. It was like climbing into the Red Baran's plane to look for Snoopy!
We chose the duration and area we wanted to fly over. 45 minutes seemed enough, but I could have spent the whole afternoon wit Nick. We saw everything we saw from ground level, from an open cockpit, the pictures speak for themselves. Nick asked how daring we wanted to be, and we told him to 'go for it!'. We did several 'wing overs' pulling several 'G's' each time, we flew into the crater as far as Nick deemed to be safe. His flying skills kept any sign of air sickness out of the question. The price was right, it topped off two wonderful weeks in Kauai. If anyone misses the chance to fly in a biplane, they missed one thing that should be on anyone's 'Bucket List'. Great flying with you Nick! Mahalo! If anyone wants a more personal or in depth review, please feel free to contact me, Jack from Chicago, at chgoipa50@aol.com, happy to speak with you!

review_title: I was the co-pilot on a plane over Kauai
review_text:
I don't know how I got so lucky.  I weighed the right amount.  But I got to sit in the co-pilot seat.  My friend asked the pilot to make sure I didn't try to fly.  It looked like I could have if I had known how.  Great views over the most beautiful island in the world.  The views are just enough distant to provide good perspective.  The view I treasured the most was just before we got to Waimea Canyon.  We could see from the west into three waterfalls that fall 3,000 feet from Mt. Waialiali (sp?) the wettest place on earth.  They seemed to spill from the clouds that shroud the top of the mountain.  I had been on a helicopter tour of the island before but don't remember seeing that view.
The pilot, Harry, was wonderful, charming and informative and so helpful.  The take off and landing were soft,  not in the least scary or jarring.  Unfortunately, one of the rear passengers got sick.  It did not affect me, but the persons closer did not like that part of the trip.  Very good experience for the money.

We loved the flight over Kauai and were able to see all of the Island. The mountains and waterfalls were spectacular. Viewing from the plane gives you such an awesome appreciation for the beauty of this wonderful piece of God's creation. Thanks so much we loved it. George & Bonny-Mary.

review_title: Now I've seen Kauai from just about every angle possible....
review_text:
After taking the Air Ventures tour, now I've seen Kauai from underwater, SCUBA Diving in Poipu, from the Sea on a Catamarran Sunset Dinner Cruise on the Ka Napoli Coast, and from land at the Smith Family Luau, then "Tubing the Ditch" on a closed Sugar Plantation, and a Zip Line trip in Princeville.
The air tour was terrific, we flew over everything I had seen from sea and land. Paul, our pilot narrated the tour, and answered many questions even before they were asked. He pointed out waterfalls that we never could have seen in any other tour, also homes of local movie stars.  Paul is an exceptional pilot, and as I found out, also a flight instructor. The plane was comfortable, the ride was smooth and safe.I would highly recommend this tour as a first or last stop on your trip to Kauai.The photo's we were able to take were also exceptional due to the shape of the windows. If anyone has a fear of becoming airsick, on this plane it is very unlikely partially due to the skill of the pilot and also watching the sights keeps your mind off of becoming sick.
If someone would like a 'more personal' review of my trip, please feel free to contact me,Jack, at Chgoipa50@aol.com. We enjoyed Air Ventures so much that tomorrow we will be flying again on "Tropical Biplanes", an open cockpit adventure.

This was my first small airplane trip over Kauai and I really enjoyed it.  Harry is an excellent pilot and did a fabulous job showing us all of the viewpoints of the island.  The photo opportunities are fantastic and I learned a great deal about Kauai.  This is a great value for the 70 minute flight and I appreciated the group photo in front of the plane which they send you for free (rather than charging $10-$20 for it.)  Take this flight on one of your first days on the island so that you can get oriented and decide all the cool places you want to visit on your trip.  Enjoy!!!

My wife and I took the 1 hour flight around Kauai and it was a great experience.  Our pilot/guide was well versed in the terrain and Hawaiian history.  As the owner of a private pilot license, I watched his flying skills with great interest and was very impressed.  It was also a great value for the price.  I highly recommend it.

We did an Air Ventures trip in 2008 and loved it.  However,on this trip in August 2012, where we were excited to take our kids this time, we were disappointed.  I, as the shortest person on the plane, was seated on the opposite side from where most of the views were seen.  When the plane was positioned such that I could see something out that opposite window the passenger across from me would put her camera up to take a picture blocking what view I did have. In addition, it was nearly impossible to understand the pilot's comments on the headphones, and my husband became nauseous shortly after take off so for him he was ill for half the day.  Perhaps some motion sickness medication would be helpful.

review_title: Harry is the bomb!   Plus the views are amazing.
review_text:
Where to start....environmentally sound way to see the island from the sky, wonderful views that you could never see any other way than to get into the sky, really quiet except for Harry's excellent commentary along the way....yes, he does pilot the plane and talk all in his bermunda shorts!

My husband,  who has had problems in small planes before, enjoyed himself with little anxiety. 
A really fine experience.

I am not exactly the adventurous type, so flying over a canyon in a small plane was not at the top of my bucket list. But my travel companions convinced me to go along and I am SO glad that I did. There are really no words to describe the breathtaking views. And honestly the trip wasn't scary at all. Paul, our pilot, made me feel immediately at ease. He was quite knowledgable and kept us all entertained with his commentary. We had a beautiful, clear day. It was an absolutely awesome experience, you will not be disappointed.

We have been traveling to Kauai yearly for the past 23 years.  This was our first Air Venture flight.  It was so quiet and peaceful and we love the fact that this aircraft uses so little fuel compared to helicopters and significantly decreases noise pollution.  We had an excellent air view of the island and were even able to see into Waialeale Crater, as well as the spectacular Napali Coast, waterfalls, Waimea Canyon and much much more.. We highly recommend !!  B,S & G

The plane ride was absolutely wonderful!  Harry was very informative and there was very little turbulence. This was the best excursion that we did on this trip.  We felt comfortable and safe during the entire time.  We also were lucky that we picked a day that was clear and got to see everything clearly....which also enabled us to take great pictures and videos that will bring us a llifetime of memories!

We had a pleasant flight around the perimeter of Kauai and took lots of photos.  Due to the rain that day, there were too many clouds to fly safely into the interior.  Harry, our pilot, gave us interesting, colorful, informative commentary throughout the flight.  His love for the island was clear and added depth and meaning.  Nicole was very helpful and friendly.  We'll be back!  Thank you!

Even though I have had a fear of heights, my husband & I decided this would be a fun thing to do since it was our first trip to Kauai. This trip was simply AMAZING! I had no idea what was in store and after 10 minutes in the air, realized how beautiful this island really is.  Harry was our pilot and was well versed in letting us know where we were and what we were seeing and making sure everyone was doing ok.  The views of the Na Pali coast & Waimea Canyon along with the brilliant colors of the coral reefs were spectacular. After the hour long aerial tour, we felt as though we knew the island and its beauty.  Thank you for an awesome time!!!

Sharing the view of Kauai with six family members will be cherished! From the golf courses, to the beaches, the waterfalls and the Napali Coast, the coffee fields and Waimea Canyon provided a spectacular view of The Garden Isle! Paul's excellent commentary enriched our knowledge of Kauai. A trip with Air Ventures is a MUST when visiting Kauai!

Truely the highlight of our trip. Air Ventures gave us such a unique perspective of the island. The ride was smooth, great commentary, and breathtaking views. Extremely affordable for a family of four. I highly recommend Air Ventures to everyone visiting Kauai.

review_title: Best air tour I've ever been on
review_text:
I'd like to thank the Air ventures team for such an amazing view of Kauai. I'll be definitely recommending this tour to all my friends.
-Bret

Excellent viewing perspective which could not have been possible otherwise. Shot some beautiful photographs. Pilot was very knowledgeable of the island and appeared to be very experienced. Additionally he was very friendly and made the somewhat bumpy ride a little more tolerable.

We had a wonderful experience with Air Ventures Hawaii.  Harry, our pilot, did a great job giving us a great flight even with windy conditions.  His commentary was knowledgeable and informative.  We definitely would do it again and would highly recommend Air Ventures Hawaii.  What a great and beautiful experience! John, Patty and Ryan Forkenbrock

Our adventure with Air Ventures in Kauai was great. The views we witnessed cannot be seen from the ground. It was amazing to be on top of those magnificent mountains and over the "Grand Canyon of the Pacific." Our pilot was so experienced which led to a very smooth ride with great commentary. we would definitely do this again.

Pam and John Street
Houston, Texas

Seeing Kauai from the sky was awesome! We were able to see waterfalls that we would have missed entirely had we not booked the flight.  Our pilot, Paul, gave descriptions/history of everything.  He was very knowledgeable and certainly made the trip "come alive" for us. I'd recommend this venture for everyone!

review_title: This is an amazing way to see the entire island of Kauai!
review_text: We chose the 70 minute AirVentures tour. It was awesome to see the island of Kauai this way! Paul, our pilot, was great! Thanks AirVentures for being part of the memories of our trip!

Had a great experience with Air Ventures Hawaii. Their communication before the tour was fabulous and clear. The pilot was warm, welcoming and informative. The only downside of this trip was that I got off the plane feeling rather queasy. This is not for the faint of stomach. I used to get car sick as a kid and this feeling came back while I was in the little plane. Definitely worth it though for the fabulous scenery.

Our "venture" into the skies of Kaiai was awesome! We thought a small plane would be a little scary, but the ride was smooth and the pilot friendly. The view was one we will never forget. We would definitly recommend this tour to one and all.

Despite a soggy morning, our 8:30 am flight was clear and wonderful.  We enjoyed our pilot's simple narration, and his expert flying.  We also felt good knowing that we were using less fuel than helicopters, but still had amazing views of the island.

Hoy estuvimos en el tour de air ventures, la verdad nos parecio mucho mejor que tomar el tour en el helicoptero ya que se pueden ver las cosas desde mas arriba y con mayor cobertura. El viaje estuvo muy bueno y suave gracias al capitan. Muy recomendado para hacer en kauai

We took off in light rain. The rain cleared and we were able to see the beautiful island. Rain moved in heavier and we were forced to land for a short time at Port Allen. Safety was priority. After a short period, we were able to return. Thanks Paul for a wonderful trip.

review_title: Great air tour with Air Adventures
review_text:
This was our first family vacation to Hawaii and we were lucky enough to be on the beautiful garden island of Kauai. There was no better way to see the island, than by air. The folks at Air Adventure did a wonderful job and were extremely friendly and knowledgeable about the Island. Harry is an awesome pilot and also assisted us after landing, by showing us how to get to some of the beautiful locations we saw while on the tour. Great job Air Adventures... great job!!!

JDM

This was our first trip to Hawaii and there is no better way to see the Garden Island than by plane. Air Ventures picked us up promptly from just outside the cruise terminal, took us to the airport where we had an awesome flight experience. The plane was not nearly as bumpy of a ride as the helicopter tour we took in Maui. Much smoother and just as enjoyable. 

I highly recommend Air Ventures to anyone wanting to tour  Kauai from the air. There were no surprises and everything was exactly as they said it would be. Touring by car or bus just does not give you a sense of they beauty of Kauai. Our pilot was very involved with us, explaining points of interests along the way. You will not be disappointed.

We had a wonderful experience. Our pilot, Harry, did a great job of describing what we were seeing, and keeping us safe.  My sister was very frightened to go, but Harry reasurred her, and she was very glad that she went and had a great time also.

Phil and I took the Best of Kauai tour, and the Air Ventures flight over the Na Pali coast was the best part of the tour.  Our pilot was very knowledgeable and we felt very safe on the flight.  He pointed out celebrity homes, the many waterfalls, crops and the rain forests and majestic mountains.  We also flew over the Waimea Canyon and Mt. Wai'ale'ale Crater.  The pilot was great about answering any questions our group of six had. It was a beautiful, exciting and unforgettable adventure.  We are so glad we took the tour with the flight.  It was truly the best part of the tour and one of the most exciting things we have ever done. Thanks for a great experience, Sharon and Phil from La Quinta, CA.

Had a fantastic trip with the fantastic Capt. Harry. Thank you for the wonderful and informative tour, not to mention the breathtaking, incredible views! I am so glad we opted for Airventures vs. a helicopter tour, as it is the clear winner in terms of views and comfort. Highly recommend!

You get to see the parts of Kauai that cannot be reached by land, and even the parts that you may have seen from the ground will look completely different from above. Certainly worth the money. Make sure you sit on the right side if you can (all but one seat in the air plane was on the right side) because the plane will circle the island clockwise and you will want a land view. The only minus point was that the flight lasted 45-50 mins whereas we were promised at least 60 mins. Still, the flight was long enough to see all the sights. Unforgettable experience.

After falling in love with the sights you can see by car we decided to take the air tour and see more of the island.  I loved the local ownership of the company and family run.  Our pilot was amazing and gave us lots of suggestions on what to go see.  It was beautiful to see Kauai from the air, which is a much different perspective than by car. It was indescribable  to see some areas of Kauai that are inaccessible by road and even by foot. We loved seeing the mountains that feature gushing waterfalls, green flora and many bird species. Flying with Air Ventures was quite a bit more economical than by helicopter and we thoroughly enjoyed. Would strongly recommend Air Ventures!!

Our scores were very good and excellent, I entered excellent as I'm filling it out.  The plane ride was awsome.  Harry did a great job flying, commentating and caring for passengers.  It was amazing to me that he knew someone in the second row was getting air sick while flying,communicating with other pilots, and describing the sights.  His commentary was excellent; described all the sights effectively without some of the fluff that we experienced on other tours. Some can't stand a quiet moment.  He did a great job negotiating some rough air and warning us when necessary. The boat tour was nice, the music and dance were good.  Enjoyed the account from making Blue Hawaii movie. Again the commentary was good.  The shuttle driver also did a great job making us feel welcome and answering questions.  I took dozens of photos, attached a couple favorites.  Your staff were also great to deal with on reservations.

My husband and I had an incredible experience with Air Ventures Hawaii!  The view above Kauai was spectacular!  This is a must for all travelers to Kauai.  Will never forget the waterfalls or the various shades of green on the cathedrals in Kauai. Thanks for the memorable trip!  John and Myra
Great views, smooth ride, and wonderful staff.  Really enjoyed seeing the coastline from the air.
Great trip and tour guide.   I would recommend this tour to others.

We took the Kauai tour of the island by air on Thursday, June 7th.  It was fabulous to see Kauai from the air and to see the various landforms.  Our pilot gave us great information about the island, which we enjoyed very much!  Now, . . . it's your turn!

Could not have asked for a better experience.  From start to finish, this was fun.  The pilot was great, naming and explaining the views we were observing.  The sky was clear, so the visibility was superb.  Loved it.

review_title: I LOVED Seeing Kauai By Air
review_text:
This was the fourth time my husband and I have been to Kauai but only the first time seeing it by air. We have never cared to see it by helicopter and the price was expensive. We found "Air Ventures" on the web and decided to try it. It was a great value too! It was a nice sunny windy day to view the whole Island.

I would recommend Air Ventures to anyone.

Alma Schlader
Swartz Creek, MI

Wonderful views of the island and coast line. The waterfalls were the best part especially since there were so many of them. The only downfall I experienced was that the tour was supposed to be 70 minutes, but it was cut short by almost 15 minutes. I would have loved to have that time since it's not cheap. Other than that, it was great!

After seeing several of the Kauai highlights from land, it was amazing to see them from the air, which is a much different perspective.  It was awe-inspiring to see some areas of Kauai that are inaccessible by road and even by foot.  We loved seeing the mountains that feature gushing waterfalls, green flora and many bird species.  Flying with Air Ventures was quite a bit more economical than by helicopter and we thoroughly enjoyed.  Would strongly recommend Air Ventures!!

review_title: Best Way to See All of Kauai in 70 minutes
review_text:
After visiting Kauai on & off since '92.  I'd done most of the attractions, including a helicopter ride on the first visit. This time we chose Air Ventures because my sister's knee injury prevented her from doing much walking. The flight was the perfect way to see the island come alive in a comfortable, safe way. I highly recommend it.
Patricia Heer

The most comfortable way to see a beautiful island.  The "airvan" is the most comfortable air tour vehicle we have ever been in.  The visibility from the plane is absolutely amazing and the pilot did a fantastic job of making sure that everyone could see the natural beauty of Kauai.  I suggest everyone visiting Kauai check out Air Ventures Hawaii at www.airventureshawaii.com

Kauai is the most beautiful place that I have ever been on vacation to. I would go again in a heartbeat. 

For more information on Air Ventures Hawaii visit
www.airventureshawaii.com

The flight was amazing!!!!  You can't go to Kauai and not see it from the air. It was breathtaking and all for a great price!!!  Everyone had a window seat and the pilot made sure to circle so no one missed a thing. I recommend this to everyone!!!!
This was the best trip of my life! I enjoyed myself and my friends on the most beautiful island I have ever seen, Kauai!

Paul did an excellant job of giving us a historical tour of Kauai as he circled the island and pointed out places of interest. Remarkably smooth flight for such a small aircraft.  I truly enjoyed the trip.

Air Ventures Hawaii is a great way to see the Hawaiian island of Kauai. The pilot Paul was very
friendly and knowledgeable. He made us feel comfortable during the whole trip. The air tour lasted about 70 minutes. We saw beautiful views of Hawaiian beaches and waterfalls.

Its my first trip to Hawaii and it was the best trip ever. This is such a great adventure and our pilot Harry was awesome. The sailing was smooth and I love how he look upon our comfort and he field the trip with lots of great information and you can tell his professionalism. The views from the trip was spectacular and I wanted to do it again soon, thanks Air Ventures for making my vacation so fun and memorable, I can't wait to ride again.
Me and my family used this service and had a blast. The island of Kauai is truly magnificent!

I have done the helicopter tours and they are nice. We could see more by not being so close to things, we got to fly in an area where we could see so much more of the island the land and the water and when it came time to get close we did that too. The flight lasted over an hour and seemed more leisurely and did not seem rushed at all. The pilot talked about everything we saw even what was happening on the airplanes instruments and communication with the tower. Paul was an excellent pilot and a wonderful commentator. Highly recommend this flight tour!
This was the best airplane ride I ever went on! Harry the pilot will make sure anyone who goes on this plane is not bored.

Our Family's Experience With Air Ventures Hawaii, Was Completely "Breathtaking", As Well As "Unforgettable".... My husband and two daughters were completely captivated by all the Beauty that was experienced from the air...  Paul, was an "Amazing" pilot and he took us on quite an Adventure!!!  The Island is so beautiful by land travel, but it's absolutely "Exquisite" by air...  If you get the chance to take this Air Adventure, Take It....!!!!  We'll be back next year as well, and the year after that, and the year after that and........etc.!!!

review_title: Air Ventures Hawaii was an excellent adventure!
review_text: Air Ventures Hawaii was just want I wanted! I was looking for a new and exciting adventure, something that my husband and I never experienced before. We wanted to have a high-flying experience, so we decided to go with Air Ventures Hawaii because they offered scenic views from flying in a plane. The pilot, Paul was very nice and friendly and offered a very unique adventure. He explained the sky tour in a very detailed way and explained what he was going to do next and where he was going to fly. Hawaii was so beautiful and even more breathtaking from a sky's view! I would definitely recommend Air Ventures Hawaii to all my friends and family!

What a great way to view this beautiful island. We had a perfect day and the Air Ventures crew made us feel comfortable right away. Our Pilot, Harry was great, and it was obvious that the safety and comfort of his passengers is number one concern for him. During our week in Kauai we had seen the island by sea and land but the view by air was the best. I would highly recommend Air Ventures as a must do while on the island. You will not be disappointed. Thanks Harry and Air Ventures for a wonderful day.
best package you can get in air ventures, and best experience in hawaii, make me wanna stay in the paradise of hawaii, good thing I choose  airventures
This was an awesome vacation! The island is beautiful and Paul, the pilot, made the trip so much fun! =)

review_title: White Knuckles Transformed to Broad Grins
review_text: Despite all raves and urgings, two of us were fearful of a small plane experience.  Blessed with a beautiful day and Paul, our "put them at ease" pilot we soared easily into the sky and then almost forgot to breathe--as the beauty and majesty of Kauai unfolded before our eyes. We could appreciate the amazing range of terrain all packed in one tiny island and glimpse the remains of the crater of the volcano that sourced it all. This will be one of the most beautiful memories of our entire trip.

My Husband And I Went To Kauai, HI. For Our Honeymoon, And The First Thing On Our List Was To See It From The Air... WOW, All I Can Say Is "Absolute Paradise"!!! I Had Never Been Anywhere Tropical Until Now, And Seeing It From The Air Was A MUST!!! I Never Wanted It To End, But We Are Planning On Coming Back Again Every Year Now Just For This Beautiful Air Venture!!!!

review_title: An Air Adventure with Air Ventures
review_text:
We won a 2 for 1 door prize at our resort for this trip so how could we not do it and it is worth it even if you have to pay for both.  My husband and I took almost 300 pictures during our 70 minute Big Kahuna Air Tour and loved seeing all the sights you would never be able to see from land or sea.  My husband got to sit in the copilot seat and really liked that.  

I think Kauai is so beautiful and this gives you the extended view.  Definitely a plus if you like to take photgraphs.  It was a smooth ride, even when Harry, the pilot, had to go up a little higher to avoid some bumps, I never noticed any and the view was still perfect.  

When we got up that morning the weather forecast said 70% chance of rain.  I thought that was funny because all week it said 0% and it rained every day (we were staying in Princeville) so I was concerned about our flight, but it didn't rain at all.  Who can ever believe the weather??

I was given some good advice when I spoke to someone from Air Ventures a few days before so thought I'd pass it on.  "Wear dark clothes" so you have less of a reflection from the window.

I have to say this was one of the best vacations I have ever taken! Going around and checking things out, the island is just gorgeous! Some of the places were so eye popping that I lost my breath a couple of times! I don't know what to say really, it was just amazing!

review_title: Harry was a great pilot and showed us a great time
review_text: Only negative in th whole trip was the back 2 seats. It was very cramped for me. But the views over whelmed the tight squeeze

My wife and son took the tour of Kauai by air with Air Ventures. It was awesome. We really got a great view of the island. Harry the pilot was excellent and a very smooth pilot. It was way cheaper than a helicopter ride and you see everything that you would in a helicopter.

Its an amazing spot!!! Tour was outstanding..We enjoyed a lot.. Thier service was awesome. Its one of the best place for hoenymoon. Beautiful place.  Our pilots and tour guide were superb!!!  Each place of island was fabulous!! No body can come out of that mood of nature..

My husband and I had the pleasure of using Air Ventures Hawaii while vacationing in hawaii --Oh it was wonderful!!! The view was out of this WORLD the island of Kauai  is sooo beautiful!!!   The ride was smooth the staff was professional and nice i enjoyed every minute of it. I didnt want it to end it was definitly one of the best highlights of our trip .. ..Definitly worth the money!!!

the views of this beautiful island are marvelous.  the weather was  superb.    the staff were very pleasent and accommodating  Our pilot, Paul, gave us a great description  of all the points  of interest.  However I found it difficult to hear it clearly because of occasional interference on the headphones. My wife was very nervous,but by the time we had traveled half the island, she was more relaxed and enjoyed  the remainder of the flight very much.  We would surely recommend this economical tour to one and all!

A much smoother and enjoyable ride than I had anticipated.  The views were breathtaking, and Harry was a skilled and informative pilot.  There is no better way to see beautiful Kauai than with Air Ventures....this was an unforgettable tour.  Thanks to all of you!

This tour was very boring for me and my family....not sure if it was because we went on our last day and had seen and heard everything there was to be said about the history of the island or if it was because the tour guide was dull.  He didn't give a lot of detail...just look left....look right....we already knew some history so it was apparent that he wasn't giving a well rounded tour.  I actually dozed off at one point.  The plane Islas also very hot/stuffy to me so bring a cold drink if you go.  I personally think the helicopter tours could give you a better result because of their ability to go closer to waterfountains and canyons etc.  

All I can say is go on this tour early in your stay or else you will not be impressed

What an AMAZING way to see this Garden Island!  We took (and recommend) the one hour flight.  Agree that the backround music is not necessary - and actually interferred with Paul's wonderful commentary.  There seemed to be a problem with the speaker system (??) as it kept cutting out.  However - the views really were FABULOUS! Met some people who had done a helecopter tour on previous trip - and they say the plane actually gives a much better view of the island - more panoramic.  Don't hesitate....GO!
Angie & Fred, Canada :)

Excellent way to view the island, since most of it is not accessible by car. Amazing views of the coast, the canyon, the mountains, waterfalls, etc. The colors and variance in topography are amazing on Kauai, and there is no better way to see it, than from the all. Thank you Air Ventures for being a class operation, with a quality tour that I will never forget! Don't forget, wear black so your photos wont have a glare from the reflection.

Quieter and smoother than a helicopter and Paul our pilot set just the right tone. Stupendous views and commentary that sounded as fresh as though he had not delivered it a 1000 times. Large and clean windows...take the 1 hour tour. If I have a reservation then along with the rest we would have preferred not to have the distracting background music! I am sure we could have asked for that...thanks to air ventures mahal!,,

I did an air tour with these guys and it was absolutely amazing!! Truly a must do when in Kauai. Harry and his staff were super friendly, helpful and informative. Thanks guys for the amazing views and memories!! :)

Die AirVentures Tour ist eine gute Ausweichmöglichkeit zu den relativ teuren Heliflügen. Wir haben die ganze Insel aus der Vogelperspektive gesehen. Besondern toll war natürlich der Waimea Canyon und die Na'apali Küste.

Very cost effective alternative to helicopter and jsut as good. I was amazed at the abilities of the plane and pilot. That plane seems to turn on a dime and you go slow enough to appreciate the entire view. We went on a cloudy day but still enjoyed it. Everyone should do this at least once.

What a great way to see the island of Kaua'i!  This was our second trip to Kaua'i, but our first flight.  What an experience!  My husband rode up front with our pilot - which he loved.  We were able to see parts of the island - the awesome Na Pali coastline, the "wettest place on the planet," an overview of the lovely Waimea Canyon - that we had only heard about before.  Our pilot was quite knowledgeable, and he maneuvered the plane so all could see each spot we visited.  It was a trip definietly worht taking - one we wish to repeat when we take our children and grandchildren!

Air Ventures was a great way to see the island.  We have never done the plane or helicopter tour on any previous trip.  You can really appreciate the diversity and beauty of the island's terrain from the air.  We had done the Napoli Coast tour by boat and then we took the plane ride.  It gave us great perspective on how islanders used to live and what they had to overcome.  I had a little trouble with an upset stomach but believe it was mostly due to the temperature that day and not enough water prior to the trip.  Our pilot did a great job and was willing to answer any questions we had.

We really enjoyed this trip.  Very comfortable seating with a knowledgable pilot.  But the true wonder was the beauty of Kauai.  Fantastic aerial views of the entire island.  If you are spending time in Kauai, do this trip early in your stay as it will allow you to see other areas of the island and help you decide on other areas to explore/tour.

My friends, my husband and I had the most wonderful "Bird's-eye view" of Kaua'i! Being able to go around the whole Island and seeing the beautiful terrain from the air made our visit here complete! Our pilot was very knowledgeable and informative. We got lots of amazing pictures! I would heartily suggest making plans to include a flight in your vacation. It's an experience you will never forget!

We go to Kauai every May and one of our top priorities is a bi-plane ride with Kevin, which we've done 5 times now.  I have issues with heights and was concerned about the open cockpit before my first flight, but it was no problem at all.  The minute we landed I wanted to do it again.  Kevin is very accommodating and uses any advantageous weather conditions to show you places on Kauai you'd never see otherwise.  It's SO much better than a helicopter and Kevin is a great pilot as well as knowing everything there is to know about Kauai.

review_title: Soaring Above A Garden of Surprises
review_text:
We were amazed by the beauty that unfolded from the moment the wheels lifted from the runway. Instantly the Pacific Ocean below us took on an aqua-marine hue that was captivating!
And that was only the first of so many surprises. Every gentle turn of our plane revealed a new and unexpected wonder. The colors and depths of the canyons, the lush deep green of the treetops and the dozens of majestic waterfalls that seemed to be everywhere were beyond description! I took pictures of everything, but a picture cannnot capture the grandeur of the experience of seeing paradise through avian eyes. Paul, our skilled pilot, was knowledgable and informative but the beauty of the vast garden passing slowly beneath us spoke for itself. What a truly remarkable and memorable day!

This was a great trip.  The plane ride was nice and slow so you could see and photo/video so much.  We did the sunset dinner cruise  of the Napali Coast the day before, hiked part of Waimea Canyon earlier in the week and snorkeled several of the beaches we flew over.  It was a thrill to see all that with the pilot calling them out as we flew over.

Capt. Bob scooted us under the mist-shrouded NaPali folding cliffs to get that "Kodak moment" picture! He skillfully gave all passengers a 360 degree view from both sides of plane including all the famous landmarks with an extremely smooth ride and informative narrative. This helped us plan what we wanted to do on the rest of our Kauai vacation.

AirVentures was the best way to see Kauai.  The weather was perfect and the ride was great.  It gave us an opportunity to see parts of the island we never could have seen and gave us ideas on where we could go by land.

Kauai from the air was fantastic. We were a party of six and couple of us were worried about flying in a small plane and possibility of air sickness.  However, we had a smooth flight because of our capable pilot and great weather and fully enjoyed the experience.   The commentary by the pilot was very helpful in identifying the spectacular views of the coast, canyons and water falls. Overall, it was a once in a life time experience that was fully worth the cost of tour. We highly recommend  the view of paradise island from the air.
Veer and party

This was the best way to see the island before we struck out on our own.  There were six of us on the tour and the pilot was terrific.  Paul made sure we all had good views from each side of the plane.  He was knowledgeable about the island and answered all our questions. We were able to take pictures from both sides of the plane. We were able to see plenty of Waimea Canyon and Na Pali coast. We could see things up there that we would not be able to see from the ground, lots of waterfalls and beaches.

My husband and I took a ride with AirVentures Hawaii in early May. That was the best part of our vacation! We both have done the helicopter on a previous vacation, but this was much much better!!!! It was so smooth. The pilot was excellent as well as the girl who checked us in. It was a over all much better experience. When we return to Kauai, we plan on taking this tour again.

The view of Kauai from the plane was spectacular.  The pilot was very informational during the tour.  My husband had a wonderful time and enjoyed himself as he got to sit up front with the pilot.  I however, got motion sickness, which I have never gotten before.  I would definately take motion sickness medicine if I had the opportunity to take another small plane tour.
What a way to see the beautiful island of Kauai. The view from the open cockpit is amazing. Kevin is a great tour guide and pilot. Don't miss the chance to enjoy Kauai in this unique, fun way.

This was a fantastic experience!  Our pilot was very friendly and knowledgeable made sure both sides of the plane were able to get spectacular views of the Waimea canyon and Na Pali coastline.  This is a great way to see and appreciate Kauai and I would recommend this to all.  The plane is very short take off and landing and is able to come in very ''slowly'' for a smooth touch down.  A word of caution - because of the altitude of the plane, the motion is actuated.  We were advised by our guide to hold back on taking pictures in the air if a person was susceptible to air sickness - this would be doubly true if any turbulence is encountered!  That said, this is the best way to see everything!

Aloha,

It was a very exciting and great way to enjoy the scenery of Kauai. We got to see plenty of rainbows during the flight as it had just stopped raining before we took off. Our pilot with the detailed explanations of the views made it a great experience. It was a great value for money and above all, we had a good time.

Praveen
Pilot was very good at explaining what we saw. Highly recommend this trip as an economical way to get up above it all.
It's a great way to see the topography of the island. Our pilot Bob made sure passengers on both sides of the plane got to see everthing. Very good value.

By taking the Air Ventures tour with you I was able to see spectacular scenery, views that I could only imagine.  I would recommend this beautiful experience to anyone that wanted to see what couldn't be seen any other way, land or sea!!!  Thanks so much.  

Aloha,
Cynthia L. Rec

Paul was our pilot and was a wonderful tour guide as well as excellent pilot.  This was my first trip to Kauai and if I could only choose one of the several activities we did while there - this would be it!  The views were fantastic and the history and local education during the tour was extremely interesting.  This is a fantastic way to see the whole island and the variety of beauty Kauai has to offer.
I will say that if you have never flown in a small plane or are prone to motion sickness that taking something prior to the flight would be a very good idea.  Although I was with friends who have flown on many small planes and they commented that the pilot did an excellent job!
Thanks for helping make our vacation memorable :)
Diane F - Reno NV

Thanks to Capt. Harry & the staff at Air Ventures Hawaii for a spectacular aerial tour of Kauai.  We were first time visitors to the island & received a lot of interesting info.  It was a little bumpy at times, but Capt. Harry put us at ease & showed us some spectacular views.  Take your camera!  Sharon B.
My seven year old and I had a wonderful tour of Kauai.  It's almost like looking down on a different planet.  Fantastic weather and smooth flying.

Our pilot was great - he did a 360 several times so that passengers on right and left got to view all the attractions below.  It was an excellent way to see the whole island and a wonderful experience.  Many attractions were pointed out - beautiful waterfalls, lovely Na Pali coastline, the lush green areas, the hugh canyon, celebrity homes and many more.  Air Ventures Hawaii was a wonderful way to see the Kauai island and a fun adventure.  We highly recommend this attraction - it was our favorite!  Mahalo!

If you're looking for something a little different from your typical helicopter ride over Kauai, then this is it! Kevin is a great pilot and was very accomodating to our needs. The plane flight was very smooth and what a view! We saw the entire island and Kevin was an exceptional tour guide. I was concerned about not being able to see well compaired to a helicoptor because of the wings, but we had no problems at all due to where we sit in relation to the wing set up. Got spectacular pictures and will remember this for the rest of our lives. Thanks Kevin! Super Cool Experience!

We were only spending 3 days on Kauai, so we wanted to see the most we could.
Air Ventures was just a fun, easy experience from start to finish.
We had mentioned some things to the pilot we were interested in, and he pointed them out when we were in the air!

review_title: we would recommend air ventures over a helicopter ride!
