review_text: my husband and I went on an air ventures tour today and just loved it.  the captain sammy was very interesting and informative and flew us over tons of waterfalls.  the views were spectacular and the trip lasted much longer than a helicopter ride at half the price!  we would recommend air ventures to        anybody traveling in kauai! ~ The Pepe's

We enjoyed the flight seen the whole island from the air is beautiful .when there is parts of island you can't see by land .would highly recommend this to anyone.my wife loved it she got to be copilot for the flight and it made her day so thanks to you again .

Great way to see the island.  Beware there are more views from the right side of the plane than the left.  There were a few times that the pilot did a 360 so that the people on the left could see but for a lot of the time the view from the left was just ocean.  The views are definitely worth it!

This flight was absolutely awesome!  Our pilot, Paul, was informative and really great about circling so everyone in the plane had opportunity to see all the views.  And what gorgeous views they were!  We loved seeing the amazing colors of the ocean, the variety of landscapes, and even a couple of celebrity homes.  FUN & beautiful way to see ALL of Kauai!  We fully recommend Air Ventures.  Enjoy!  We certainly did.

This was the best value and awesome way to see this island. Harry wa a great pilot who made sure we were all doing well on our flight. He was good at answering any questions we had. I would very much recommend anyone going here to visit Air Ventures.

review_title: BEST & INEXPENSIVE WAY TO SEE KAUAI.
review_text:
My Wife & I had a great time on our flight.Harry our pilot was very informative & answered all our questions while flying on our tour..The views were  just awesome, never seen so many waterfalls at one time. Thanks for the good time Airventures.
                                                                                  TOM & SHAWN FAULAND
This was the best Kauai experience we have ever had!  It is the base way to see it all.

review_title: Best aerial views of the island! We preferred it to the helicopter rides. Nostalgic as well.
review_text: We flew with Kevin at Tropical Biplanes on our last day on Kauai. What fun! I had flown in an open cockpit biplane in Maine before but my husband had not. My husband is a private pilot and I am a student pilot so it was extra fun to have someone else fly us around in a small plane. Kevin provided us with cloth helmets and goggles (very necessary given the wind) and gave suggestions for aerial photography. He also took photos of us with the plane for our mementos. The aerial views from the plane were spectacular and Kevin's narration was excellent. I have only three suggestions: 1) the person taking the most photos should sit on the right side of the place (against Kevin's advice) because you really don't see as much of the coastline from the left side, 2) while on the ground, the WACO should be parked in such a way that photos don't include the parking lot with FEDEX trucks, etc. and 3) it would not hurt to have a professional grade camera (any Nikon SLR set on auto would do the trick) and person taking photos for purchase at a nominal fee (say, $14 for a 5' x 7") because it is a stunning plane in person and few people will ever have the opportunity to fly in one or even stand beside it. It is a bright, candy-apple red and simply gorgeous. Overall, a great experience. Highly recommended by us!
We enjoyed the plane ride the best of all of our activities on the island. The pilot was very friendly and informative.  We learned a lot and had a great time.  Highly recommend them!!

We had a great time on our flight- our pilot was extremely knowledgeable, and showed us all the cool things you can't see from land or sea.  We brought our children and he was also very nice to them and pointed out things that they might like to see too.  (they did fall asleep about 2/3 of the way through though, so you might want to find a babysitter if they're young- otherwise it's one pricey nap!)  :)

We were on the sapphire princess and they met us on time. Great flight and pilot. He pointed out all of the sights and info about the island. After the flight, they took us on the fern grotto tour. They were waiting for us when we finished to take us back to the ship. My wife left her cell phone on the plane, and they went back to retrieve it and bring it to us. Excellent company and service. I highly recommend them.

Great experience. One of the best activities on our trip to Kauai, There was a sudden rain shower before our flight which only lasted minutes but left beautiful rainbows for us to enjoy from the air. The pilot was excellent and provided commentary on all the sites we were seeing. Beautiful views of the beaches and waterfalls. Waimea canyon was awesome. Highly recommend seeing Kauai from the air with Air Ventures Hawaii. Reasonably priced.

This was the best ! We had the best experience ever. Harrywas so greatto make sure both sides of the plan got great views.  We have hiked ,done the boat tours of the coast but this really topped it off!   Really recommend this company..it's like family.    Thank you for the safe a great time.

We saw the whole island.  Our mouths were hanging open the whole time and we were speechless.  There were whales swimming along the Na Pali Coast and our pilot circled them so we could admire the beauty.  This was truly an awesome adventure.

Excellent view of the Waimea Canyon and the waterfalls. 
A lot cheaper than the helicopters and you get the same or even more. 
Pilot was great and made sure that both sides of the airplane got the views.
Thank you for the nice trip!

We went up early on the 25th of April. Pilot was great...made sure both sides of the plane had chances to see and photograph all the sites. When whales were spotted he circled around to give everyone great views. What a great way to see parts of the island that you just would never see. Great way to plan where you might want to go for some additional exploring. Can't put in words, or even photos, what it looks like through your own eyes. BMoffett

We loved seeing the coast and canyons that we had previously visited on the island.  It is a perfect way to see it all.  Very interesting commentary by Paul.  We thoroughly enjoyed our experience!  Loved seeing parts of the island that can only be seen by plane.  Well worth every minute of it.

Did the Air and Sea tour, enjoyed both! The air tour of the island was great,took lots of photos and it gave me a chance to look the whole island over, making it easier for me to pick locations that my wife and I could further explore (drive to). Would highly recommend!!!

The flight was everything we expected!  We desired to see as much of the island that we could and your professionally guided air tour gave us the overview of the island that we wanted. We can now visit the places that intrigued us by air. Thank you to Paul, a personable pilot! And thanks to Ingrid for pointing us to the pier while we waited to fly. Beautiful spot!

My wife, 20-month old son, and I took a flight in the afternoon with Harry, our pilot.  He definitely provided us with information about the island.  We were able to see views of the island that we would have never seen!  Waimea Canyon looked amazing, the Na Pali Coast was beautiful, each of the major beaches were touched upon, and the waterfalls were definite highlights!

Now, even though our son vomited half-way through the plane ride (turbulence near Na Pali Coast), it was still a worthwhile touristy thing to do in Kauai!
In just one hour you view the entire island and some inaccesibles areas, freindly pilot and very comfortable airplane, good price.  I recommend this good experience. Randolfo Vignali,  Tijuana BC.

review_title: Best way to see the island - by air!
review_text: Decided to see Kauai by air so we booked with Air Adventures.  Paul was the pilot and did a great job.  The flight allowed us to see areas of the island that we would have a difficult time hiking to.  I probably took 120 photos in the hour that we were in the air.  We did the air tour at the end of our week at Kauai and if I had it to do over again, would do it at the beginning of the week instead so that we would be able to plan our time better.

Thanks to Jeff, our pilot, and the booking staff for an amazing tour.  We saw waterfalls, rainforest, Spouting Horn, the NaPali Coast and much more breathtaking scenery.  Our pilot and tour guide made sure we all had wonderful views from both sides of the aircraft.  This was an excellent tour and I highly recommend it as so much of Kauai can only be viewed this way.  Also, I highly recommend doing this early during your vacation so that you can get a perspective on the whole island. Thanks Air Ventures for a family memory we will all treasure forever!

Paul was our pilot and I was seated in the co-pilot's position. The flight was an excellent way to see the island's inaccessible areas and see the contrasting landscape. We were comfortable in the aircraft during a smooth flight. The pilot was always safety conscious about the passengers and other aircraft, while giving in-flight descriptions of our travels. Later, on the ground, I was amazed how much quieter this fixed wing is compared to the noisy helicopters. As a tourist, this is certainly the less intrusive way to explore the island.

This was a very good trip for my wife & me.  Harry was our pilot & was full of information about the island.  Our flight was during the first week of April when the humpback whales begin leaving the islands, but we still had a great view of a female & her calf.  The views of Waimea Canyon & Na Pali coast are spectacular & you realize how rugged these parts of the island really are.  You can take a picture of a waterfall & later when you look at your photo you will find 5 or 6 more that you didn’t even notice at the time.  We will return in the future & bring our daughter who was unable to make this trip with us.

This is so worthwhile! We had a wonderful time viewing this awesome island. I was surprised how close in to the Waimea  Canyon he flew... the flight was smooth, all had window seats, and our pilot was enjoyable and informative.  Well worth the price!

wow what an experience, nice quite ride, great viewing, stunning views of Wimeia and the waterfalls, pilot was very imformative, nice smooth flight, recommend to take early on in a visit to Kaui gives you a perspective of the island, extra bonus we flew out over the ocean and had wales swim under us, fantastic , good value woul;d recommend to anyone, staff were excellent
great experience, the time we paid for was spent in the air.friendly staff and pilot .informative comments, awesome views.great experience and great value...

An excellent way to view the Island of Kauai from the coastlines to the inner valleys. This tour was a really good value, with breathtaking scenery, and a very safe and informative pilot. 
We chose Air Ventures over a helicopter tour for the value and confidence in a very stable aircraft.
Everyone had a window seat and there was no shortage of wonderful things to see- from a humpback whale off the Na Pali Coast to the top of Waialeale.
We will return- and bring friends along, too!
This was the best side trip that we booked on our trip.  We will be back to this island for another flight.

Breathtaking, Beautiful, and Awesome Views. Paul was an excellent pilot and a wonderful commentator.  We all had a wonderful time. The plane ride was very smooth. We debated to take a helicopter ride or go with Air Ventures. We were so happy with our decision to go with Air Ventures instead. The tour is well worth the money. We took the Best of Kaui Combo Tour.

My wife and I had already taken a Helicopter tour of Kauai and it was just ok.  Then we won an air adventure tour.  So we went for our second tour of the island.  Wow, what a difference.  The air venture tour was stable, everyone had window seats, it was eaiser to take photos, better commentary about the island and gave a better over veiw of the island.  The helicopter tour sat four across, thus two in the middle, the copter's bubbled windows made photography difficult and the flight was disorienting.  If I could only take one I would take the air adventure tour for sure.

Had taken helicopter flight before in Hawaii and my wife and i decided to try a plane trip round Kauai.  On first arriving at the airport staff very friendly and informative.  As we had booked a joint trip with Air ventures for the flight and on to Fern Grotto, the staff arranged the times for both trips to suit my wife and I, including transport between both activities and return to our hotel.  The flight was very enjoyable, as the pilot kept us informed of all the sights around us and an additional fly over to view some whales.  Views from the plane were spectecular and we were able to see everything around us.  We would highly recommend this tour and if we return to Kauai, then Air Ventures would be our first choice for an island trip.
Our trip with Air Ventures over Kauai was breathtaking!  And our pilot was awesome in sharing his knowledge of the land.  I could not of asked for a better experience!

review_title: The most beautiful and amazing views I have ever seen on any tour, waterfalls the best.
review_text: Harry was a great pilot. He would show both sides of the plane to a certain view. He tried to find us a whale but they were shy that day. The beaches and waterfalls were so pretty. Waimea Canyon was just as good if not better than The Grand Canyon. Harry was very informative on the sites. A very good value for the money.

review_title: Most beautiful ride of my life!!
review_text: Harry was so upbeat, skilled and informative.  It was a very smooth ride and such awesome scenery.  I saw parts of the island I never saw before.  I would definitely recommend this company to anyone who wants a memorable air adventure.

Outstanding flight and experience for our entire family.  Even our 6 year old enjoyed the flight.  Harry, the pilot, did a great job showing us Kauai from the air in a relaxed and informative way.  We had been on the island for several days when we took the flight and had already seen some of the sights; however, seeing them from the air was a thrill.  We even saw some whales breaching and playing on the ocean surface.  This flight is cheaper than a helicopter ride and I recommend it to anyone.

review_title: What a way to see Hawaii
review_text: My family enjoyed the whole adventure.  We went on the air & luau combo.  The whole package was worth every penny we spent.  The flight was smooth and Harry our pilot was informative and very attentive.  It was the best experience of our trip, and we did several adventures.  The luau was a great end to the flight.  The roasted pork  and the rest of the food was delicious and the show was fun.  Would do it again.  P Rader

It's extremely difficult to see the island by land or sea so why not try it by air?  Air Ventures is an excellent alternative to all the helicopter tours offered on the island.  I thoroughly enjoyed the tour in the airplane and was able to take many excellent photos.  The pilot was experienced and handled the aircraft quite well (the weather wasn't the best), and also acted as a tour guide during the flight.  I highly recommend trying them out.  Note that my wife and small children stayed behind so this recommendation is for adults only.

review_title: Flying high over Kauai was a breathtaking, beautiful birthday adventure!
review_text: My husband and I were amazed by the beauty of Kauai viewed from the airplane.  Our pilot did a great narration of numerous sights.  We were able to see the different landscapes that are not accessible by driving or hiking.  Famous beaches and other movie sights were displayed before our eyes.
Had a very good time. Employees were friendly, The scene was outstanding and would definately recommend this journey. This way if seeing the scenery is much more expanding than from the ground.

The staff at Air Ventures are very professional, helpful, and safety conscious !. We had to change our original booking due to weather because the pilot felt conditions were not  safe to go up (raining).  When we finally did get to go, it was absolutely breathtaking.We saw a mother whale with her calf.  It is truly the best way to see the island!  The DVD they have available is a great way to remember your trip.

review_title: This is a Trip that you will talk about for years!
review_text:
Our group of 6 Friends were given a warm welcome from the staff and were made comfortable right from the start.  As the trip continued we were overwelmed with the sights of Kauai and the professionalism of our Pilot Harry to get us into the best viewing position.
All in all this was the highlight of our visit to the Hawaii Islands.

We rescheduled our flight due to illness--which they thankfully did. Our originally day was beautiful and sunny.  On our rescheduled date we had rain/clouds/sun.  Although we had previously done a sunset dinner cruise of the Napali Coast the air views of this area gave a bit more depth and were much more impressive.  Also, because we had hiked part of the Napali coast the day before it was fun to see where we had been from the air.  We would have preferred to just fly around and around these cliffs.  The Waimea Canyon was very nice.  After flying over it we decided not to drive to the lookouts.  We plan to come back and hike the area--just ran out of time to do it all!  Our pilot wasn't the most friendly fellow (sorry, Harry).  Maybe he was just busy keeping us save.  We did see lots of waterfalls, but without the maneuverability of a helicopter, these were viewed from a distance; however, a zoom lens helped so the pictures turned out well. The price was what we could afford and we were "glad we did this."

This one hour plane ride around Kauai was a great adventure.  I had never been in a small plane before but felt quite at ease during the flight.  The pilot was very informative and friendly.  The scenery was breathtaking.  I would recommend this trip to anyone.  It's the fastest and easiest way to take in all of the Garden Island.

You get what is advertised, great views, reasonably stable plane, friendly receptionists & on time service. On time means be there 30 minutes prior to flight time. With the max of six passengers it should not (and didn’t) take that long to process everyone. In my opinion if you are late then you miss da plane. Recommend you shorten the wait time. I know it is not for everyone as my wife and mother-in-law had a hard time with the flight. But they made it. If you have a gopro and a suction cup ask about putting it on the outside of the plane. You pay to see the island and that is what you get, you see the island from above.

My first trip in a small plane was awesome! I was sitting in the middle part of the plane and had a great view.  Kauai is such a beautiful place.   My husband was in the front and the ride seemed overwhelming due to visibility of other aircraft. It was a bit too warm and my husband was uncomfortable. We were also asked to pay a fuel charge that we were not told about beforehand.  I would have enjoyed being able to see more but it was a bit cloudy. The pilot did a great job informing us about the sites.

this is the very best way to see kauai ,wow what views ,harry was the best pilot ever ,lots of information and very funny ,book your trip now ,would recommend to everyone!! .. ,very cool ,still cant believe we did it   mahalo to airventures xxx

Air Ventures flies a small, fixed wing plane over Kauai. These planes fly low and slow  and are able to get close into the valleys and over all the beautiful sights in Kauai.   Each guest has a window seat for great viewing.  The pilots and staff have always been warm, friendly, and very professional and ensure the guests have a great sightseeing experience seeing the best of Kauai.  The price of these flights is an excellent value.

We booked the combo air/sea package in Kauai through Air Ventures.  The 6-seater plane + pilot took off from the Lihue airport and gave us spectacular views of the Napoli coast, the forbidden island, Waimea Canyon, Hanalei area, Princeville, Fern Grotto and numerous waterfalls that you can only see by air.  The pilot circled around so all could see when a school of humpback whales was spotted.  The booking staff was very helpful straightening out our reservation which was messed up by the hotel concierge; so book directly with Air Ventures.  I have already recommended this tour to a friend who is traveling with her family to Kauai in June.

An awesome way to see the parts of Kaua'i that you can't see by car.  Friendly staff. Maximum 6 people on the tour. Our pilot, Paul, did a great job telling us about all the landmarks we were flying over. We saw the Na Pali Coast, the Little Grand Canyon, all the beaches, where certain shows were filmed, and where some of the stars live. The highlight was the pod of Humpback Whales just below us!!! 

Do this trip early in your visit to get a good overall perspective on the whole island.

review_title: The BEST Way To See The Island!
review_text: It was a really nice ride.  The pilot (Harry) talked to us the whole way, pointing out the varioius sites.  Shortly after we got up in the air, I asked him to see if he could find us any whales to see....and in less than 3 minutes, we saw a group of 4 whales!  Saw alot of things I never would have seen by car.  Very professional company!  Thanks for the ride!  Tammy from Ohio
Harry is an outstanding pilot. Great time and fantastic views

The 1 hour tour with Air Ventures was a delightful way to view Kauai. The ride was smooth and covered practically the whole island. Special emphasis was on Waimea Canyon and the Na Poli Coast. The sound through the earphones was a bit scratchy so the narrative was a little hard to hear. Definitely sit on the right side of the plane to get the best view.
It was the best thing we did on our trip, it was wonderfull!!! Something everyone should do.

review_title: A smooth, scenic, and beautiful way of seeing Kaua'i.
review_text:
Sunglasses and camera are absolutely necessary.

My wife gets motion sickness very easily so she took dramamine pills and then found the ride very pleasant.  The pilot seemed to be very knowledgeable and certainly took all necessary safety precautions such as equalizing weight distribution and avoidance of turbulence even though it was a somewhat windy day. We would highly recommend this excursion in order to get an overview of the island early in your holidays so that you can then visit the sites on the ground.

We really enjoyed our flight with Airventures in Kauai, Hawaii. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and friendly.  We saw all the major sites like Waimea Canyon, Wailua falls, and Napali coastline. We got a big bonus and saw a humpback whale with her calf. That was a amazing to see them from the air. We ended up with great pictures of the whale and the island too.  Thank you for the wonderful time and we will be back.  :-))
Kayla and Bob
This one hour flight was great!  Harry is an excellent pilot.  It was a comfortable flight and he provided interesting commentary.  I highly recommend this flight service.

review_title: Excellent ground tour and airplane ride over Kauai.
review_text: This is an excellent value, well worth the cost.  Air ride over the island revealed the dramatic Na Pali coast, which we would not have seen otherwise.  My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed the experience.     G. M. Alprin, Washington, DC

On my trip to kauai my wife and I booked the air sea package and couldn't have been happier with the results. The flight portion was beautiful, we got to see the whole island with waterfalls, beaches and even found some whales to circle. The sea portion took us up the coast to scenery you would see on postcards and up close sightings of whales and beaches that are not accessible by land. Both guides were very informative on the island and the stories which made the whole experience wonderful. I recommend this adventure if you visit this beautiful island but warn if you get motion sick to take precautions before you go to make for a more pleasant trip.

review_title: View Hawaii with the air and sea combon - Delightful!
review_text:
I have to admit, I was a little nervous to board a small airplane and tour the isalnd, but it ended up being one of the highlights of my trip! The staff made me feel welcome and at ease instantly. The pilot did a great job sharing tips about the island while we were flying above and seeing so many beautiful sites that you just can't experience from the ground. We enjoyed beautiful mountains and waterfalls along with a few whales in the ocean below. The trip time was perfect as well! 

Later that evening we enjoyed another perspective and enjoyed the sunset dinner cruise! We enjoyed more whale watching and an enjoyable ride on the water with a close up view of sites seen earlier in the day. 

(if you are prone to motion sickness, I would recommend taking something before going as a precaution -- you don't want to miss out on this experience or be distracted!)

review_title: A very exciting and enlightening experience
review_text:
This was part a tour and we were very happy to have had this as part of our tour.  We very much enjoyed the flight and the descriptions of the pilot.  He kept of informed of all the different parts of Kauai and the many different terrains.   We had the experience of seeing many humpback whales off the west coast.  Flying over the canyon was also quite nice as our own trip up the canyon was not as good because we got clouded in before we got to the top.  We took some pictures and hope they turn out well.  
Dave & Judy

review_title: It was a very memorable one hour trip.
review_text:
The full 60 minutes trip was awesome. We saw the whole island from the air , hovered over the canyon, saw the waterfalls filmed in the JP and the best moment was seeing WHALES . 
The ride was very comfortable and we thoroughly enjoyed it. 
I would recommend this trip to all.

We took this flight on our first day here, and so glad we did.Excellent flight with wonderful information.You get an idea of this beautiful island, and what you want to go out and explore.We did the air and sea combo, and went on the sunset cruise with Holo Holo the next day, again another great trip. Fun captain and crew, saw lots of whales. From my first phone call with Ingrid to our flight with Paul and Nicole, we were treated so well. Very awesome company !!!! Thank you guys !!!!

review_title: Great staff. Wonderful tour. Good price!
review_text:
We had a great time. The bus tour of the north-west coast, the airplane tour of the rest of the island, the fern grotto, the boat ride ... All in one package. The staff made it special.
A heliocapter tour would get you closer to the scenery, but would cost so much more.

Loved it.

I've lived on Kaua'i my whole life, and this was the first time I've gone up in a plane.  It was absolutely stunning.  We saw waterfalls and whales, dry mountains and canyons on the south/west side, lush rainforests on the north side.  I absolutely loved the flight and would go again in a heartbeat.
Fantastic, informative and beautiful views of Kauai.
Very scenic and beautiful. I would highly recommend this tour compared to the helicopter tour.

This has been the highlight of our trip--I highly recommend it to any and all visitors to Kauai.The flight was like sitting in your own living room in a comfotable chair ( no turbulance) viewing this beautiful Island.  Mahalo--Mahalo

We loved the tour ,we could never have seen half of the island if wouldn't have taken the Air Adventures tour that day. The waterfalls were breathtaking the landscape was fantastic. I never thought riding in a small plane could be so comfortable .We would do it again.

review_title: Awesome views of an awesome island.
review_text: My wife and I have done a couple helicopter tours of the other islands and this was as good if not better. Definitely better than I expected. For about half the price we saw the entire island and our pilot was very informative. Thanks for a great flight Paul.

review_title: Fantastic view of the island that can not be missed.
review_text: I was able to get amazing photos with my telephoto lens of places we had been before. My favorite was the Napali Coast and Kalalau which we had hiked a number of years ago. It was wonderful to see it from the air. I recommend this flight to everyone  - smooth, comfortable a ble to see everything.

What a fantastic outing! I stand in awe of my Lord's artistry and the glorious beauty He made in the island of Kauai.  Mt. Waialeale is clear only 13 days a year and the day we flew was one of those few!  Spectacular views including a few whales, informative pleasant pilot.  Don't miss out on this if you go to Kauai.

review_title: An incredible way to experience the beauty of the island
review_text: The Air Ventures Hawaii tour was totally awesome and a highlight for all the members of our family.  The tour took about an hour and we were treated to a different view of the island's beauty. The staff at Air Ventures were terrific and our pilot passed on his island knowledge as we flew over the various parts.  You really can't appreciate the diversity of the island unless you see it from the air!  Make sure that your camera is fully charged before you take the trip, because you don't want the batteries to die before the trip ends.  We totally recommend this activity if you are visiting Kauai.

My wife and I were a bit apprehensive on flight day due to high winds on the north shore of the island but we were assured it would be fine and the pilot would not go if it was not safe.  We were pleasently surprised, felt very safe and really enjoyed the flight.  The flight was on our last day of vacation on the island and it made it possible to see parts of the island such as the Napoli coast and the Waimea Canyon, that we were were not able to see during our entire visit.  The pilot did a very good narration of the various points on interest and was very informative.  The only regret I had was that I chose the wrong zoom lens to bring with my SLR camera, so if you are bringing a SLR camera, I suggest you a shorter lens such as an 18-70mm zoom for those great panaramoic shots.

review_title: The only way to see the whole island of Kauai!
review_text:
Having never been on a small plane before, I was, to say the least, a bit nervous.  However, the pilot was fabulous.  The plane was very comfortable, and the takeoff/landing superb!  Overall - the flight, even for a newbee, was a wonderful experience.

The scenery was fabulous, and the pilot did a great job explaining what we were seeing, and providing some Hawaiian history and background as well.   

I would highly recommend Air Ventures Hawaii for anyone visiting Kauai.  What a wonderful way to see the highlights of the island, that you just can't see any other way.

Cheers and happy flying!

Kathy

review_title: An awesome experience showing all the highlights of Kuaui!
review_text:
The weather was iffy and our trip was cancelled 3 times before we actually got to take it. AirVentures worked with us repeatedly to fit us in before we left Kuaui. This was the only air tour we could find that did not charge extra for overweight passengers-that was refreshing.
The pilot was very knowlegeable about Kuaui and the sights he showed us. He was also very entertaining! Well worth the money. A highlight of our trip.

What a way to see the Island!!  Paul, our pilot, did a wonderful job making sure we all had opportunity to see everything, including the whales.  The Napali Coastline and Waiamea Canyon views were incredible.  Highly recomend and would definitely do it again!

Glenda
Georgia

review_title: The PRIMO aerial view of Kauai
review_text: Air Ventures delivers on their promise of a quality experience!  Our pilot, Paul, did an exceptional job of providing awesome views of the Garden Island from the coast, to the canyons, to the NaPali coastline, including a closeup of whales swimming offshore.  He obviously cared about each passenger having a comfortable, informative and exciting adventure as he exhibited excellent piloting skills and communication of information.  I found this trip just as exciting and effective a tour as our helicopter trip 2 years ago and I loved that each of us had our own window for viewing.  Many thanks to Paul and Air Ventures for an awesome ending to 2 weeks on our favorite island.  It served as a great way to get a birdseye view of all the beauty we had visited throughout the vacation and a great reminder of why we love the island of Kauai so much!!  (We loved the complimentary group photo that was emailed to each of us before we left the airpcort!  A nice touch of class!)

The views were fantastic,  The weather was great, so visibility was great.  Saw several whales.  Our trip was most  was enjoyable, our pilot's professionalism, informative narrative & pleasant manner added to that enjoyment.  My first trip on a fixed wing plane for sight seeing.  So much quieter than a helicopter.  Would definitely reccomend.

review_title: Wonderful experience! A must do on the island
review_text: Air Venture Kauai was definitely a great experience. I got to go up with a close friend of mine and we couldn't of asked for a better time. Our pilot Justin was really friendly, professionable, and knowledgeable. I've lived on the island for a while and have never got to tour over it in a plane.  It was a little cloudy when we first arrived so we were a little worried, but sure enough after we took off it cleared up perfectly. We saw so many whales and waterfalls it was almost too good to be true. For anyone who might be on a budget this is the way to go! I've flown in a few helicopters on the island and this was just as great... if not better cause it wasn't so loud, cramped, and scary. I am definitely highly recommending this tour, and I can't wait to go again!

review_title: We enjoyed a wonderful and spectacular tour by air of Kauai.
review_text: The flight was very enjoyable, smooth and comfortable.  The pilot was personable and did a fine job describing island sights with good humor and knowledge.  He flew at altitudes that gave us exceptional views.  We had a great time.

I did the "Best of Kauai" tour which included a plane tour by AirAdventures.  The experience was awesome.  Our pilot, Harry, was not only a skillful pilot, but also a great guide in pointing out places from the air.  The plane was clean and comfortable and every passenger had a great view from their seat window.  The ride was smooth as well as the take-off and landing.  We saw a whale while on the tour, and Harry circled the plane at a lower elevation so we got a fantastic view.  All in all, the trip was a fantastic experience I would recommend to anyone!

review_title: This was a truly awesome experience!
review_text: This was my 4th or 5th time visiting Kauai but my very first time from the air.  I had always wanted to see it from the air and was not disappointed.  One must honestly see it from this view in order to truly experience Kauai's beauty.  We even saw a few whales - what an extra treat!

review_title: Outstanding and inspiring views of entire Kauai island.
review_text: We enjoyed this experience beyond any expectations. Views were breathtaking. Pilot was so competent and so relaxed. We will never forget this unique view of Kauai. Much better than a helicopter.  Thanks to everyone at Air Ventures for giving us lifetime memories of this beautiful island.

review_title: Fantastic and the pilot's narrative added to the whole experience!
review_text: Seeing the island from the air is something I am so glad we did not miss. I was surprized that some of the island looked like the Grand Canyon. The pilot told us about the areas we were looking at. Besides the beauty, knowing what we were looking at made the whole experience much more memorable. I will definately take air tours again when I travel and will be back to Air Adventures if I should be so fortunate to return to Kauai.

review_title: It was a wonderful experience, especially to be able to see so many whales.
review_text: We enjoyed the trip around Kauai flying in the GA-8 Airvan (fixed wing airplane).  It all started with the viewing of several whales. We were lucky enough to have excellent weather and got to fly over parts of Waimea Canyon. The scenery is beautiful so bring your camera. The only negative remark is that the Airvan cannot get as close to things as a helicopter. However, the view is still spectacular. For those on a budget, the price is difficult to beat. The flight lasts about 70 minutes, as advertised.

The plane and facilities  were top notch and Harry the pilot was very informative professional  and safety  conscious. We picked what turned out to be a blue bird day with a smooth ride. I got many great photos of the entire island. Harry got in low to view the coast and mountian tops make sure to bring your camera and allow a couple of hours.
I really enjoyed the flight around the island.  I got a killer deal that was over half of the helicopters and probably saw the same things.  As a pilot myself, I would recommend this ride

Everything went smoothly, from the pickup, boarding, the earphones worked, the sights were incredible.  I would recommend this for everyone going to Kauai!  Very affordable!
Jane Parenteau, South Carolia
We very much enjoyed our flight.  The weather cleared just in time for us to get a great view.  It was a very windy day, but our pilot did a great job of keeping our flight smooth.

The trip with air ventures was the high light of our vacation. We saw sites we could not access with a vehicle.

Weather was fine and the pilot very professional.
We would recommend the tour to our friends.
We were able to use a coupon which made the flight very reasonable.

review_title: Well worth the money, better than expected....
review_text: We were very  surprised at the tour. We had a very bright, knowledgeable and funny pilot who gave us a great tour. It was one of the highlights of our trip.

review_title: The most beautiful views of Kauai from the air!
review_text: Air ventures is probably the best way to see the Islands. Paul, our pilot was very informative about Kauai.We had a birds eye view of the beautiful beaches,breathtaking mountian scenery with majestic waterfalls, we also saw hump back whales under the surface of the crystal clear ocean. All for a reasonable cost!
Started our honeymoon in Kauai by seeing it from the sky. It was awesome the way the pilot went around the island so smoothly. He was great.What a beautiful island. Our pilot was very informative.

review_title: The best way to see this beautiful island
review_text: I have been here in Kaui for 8 days and drove all over to see the sights  Going up this morning in the plane with air ventures was a highlight for my vacat ion. We were able to see  the breath taking views of the waterfalls,cliffs,the high green mountains, and the beautiful beaches, and we even saw whales!  We are so glad that we went on this tour,we saw and learned so much more than we could on our own.   Mahalo

Our trip was orchestrated perfect from the minute we came to the airport to the time we departed.  Our pilot was knowledgeable and professional and the airplane was clean and comfortable.  I would recommend it to any family desiring a wonderful bird's eye view of the most beautiful spot on earth...Kauai!

review_title: great experience. They even offered whale watching.
review_text: In general, this is a great deal. It is cheaper than the helicopters, but has a comparable view. The right side has better view than the left. The captain will watch for whales and point them out for you. Their big window offers great view, but the wings are sometimes an obstacle for taking pictures.

Awesome tour: I found the parking to be plentiful and in close proximity to their office. The office facilities were clean and organized with provided restrooms. The person working at the check-in desk was very friendly, polite and knowledgable. The pilot was very professional and extremely knowledgeable about the island. I think we had one of the best days to fly because the flight was very smooth. I expected a little rougher ride for a smaller plane. None of the passengers, myself included, asked any questions because we were wearing headphones and that can take a while to get used to. But, fortunately, I didn't need to ask questions because the pilot was already providing more info than I would have thought to ask for. Very awesome. The take off and landing were very smooth which was well appreciated by me. If that tour company were to ask for ways to improve, I would say that I can't think of any. Dancing Hawaiian Girls maybe?

Great views from the airplane, I strongly suggest it. I took tons of pictures. We were asked who wanted to sit at the pilot seat and I immediately raised my arm so I was happy about that. The stuff is super friendly and nice. they also picked us up from Walmart (we would have missed the air tour had we waited for the bus), then they took us from the air tour to the river tour, and, which I found particularly nice of them, after the river tour they took us to the nearest bus stop to continue our traveling in the island. I recommend this company.

review_title: Spectacular views in comfort and safety
review_text: My husband and I very much enjoyed our 70 minute flight today with AirVentures! The views were amazing -- one bonus was of the migrating humpbacked whales. It was great to see them blow and jump from above -- the air and water were so clear! Our pilot, Paul, was great about ensuring that people on both sides of the craft (the airplane held 6 passengers beside the pilot, each with their own window) got a chance  to see everything. The plane was quite stable, and I liked its relative quiet -- good for us, and good for those on the ground. We flew over uninhabited Waimea Canyon, and over the ocean looking at the stunning Napali coast, beautiful beaches, and amazing waterfalls. And, to finish off, a very smooth landing. Sure was glad I brought my camera!
Great views from the plane! Loved the pilot and staff! Must see tour!!! Do Air Ventures tour instead of helicopter! More affordable and better picture opportunities!

To see Kauai, this is the best way to go !  Our pilot , Rob, was very informative!  From the minute we got there , we knew we were in good hands with professional staff.  If you want
to have the ultimate and safe experience, book with AIRVENTURESHAWAII!
The plane ride was the highlight of our trip.  It allowed us to see so much more than we would have been able to see.  We would recommend it to anyone visiting the island.
We had a great ride with Harry and saw the entire island. We went at the end of our week so we got to see aerial views of all the places we had been. Great to support a fellow Lion!

review_title: I will never forget this ride! Absolutely fantastic!
review_text: My husband and I took the Air Ventures tour in December 2011. I have never been on a small plane, but the pilot made it all a wonderful experience. We saw everything we hoped we would be able to see and more. I would highly recommend them. Be sure to book on a day early in your vacation time so you can note what you may want to visit. Thanks, Air Venture, for a most memorable experience!
I thought this was so much better than the helicopter tour.  Our pilot was awesome.  And the sights seemed to last a lot longer than in the helicopter.  Thanks for the experience.

After reviewing many tour companies, we decided to go with Air Ventures and couldn't have been happier.  The pilot was wonderful explaining what we were seeing.  The seating was great, as everyone had a large window to view out.  They only take six customers.  I would absolutely recommend Air Ventures, as they are the best priced air tour with great customer service!

review_title: Great views, worth it, only way to see the Island beauty
review_text: Paul and Ingrid are great.  Every seat is a window to view the scenery from.  We took some great pictures from the plane.

review_title: Don't let the clouds deter you!! Great experience!
review_text:
We went up on a relatively cloudy day with a lot of wind, so we were expecting a 
diminished experience... However, we found the entire experience to be very
satisfying... from the friendly check-in, to Harry's (the pilot) nice sense of humor!
Got a little bit of lots of different weather... from full sun to misty clouds, and wonderful
rainbows! The thrill of seeing the Na Pali coast from the air is a once-in-a-lifetime
treat... You could tell that Harry loves this place, and it made the experience all the
more authentic! And for me, the thrill of sitting in the front seat was an added bonus
 Couldn't believe how fast we were in the air! Would do it again in a heartbeat...

My wife and I took a 50 minute air tour with AirVentures and were flown around the island by Captain Harry in one of their two Gippsland GA-8 AirVan single engine fixed wing aircraft.  The plane holds about 8 people and has high wings (over the plane) and large slightly curved windows which allow for good viewing.  Do wear dark clothing without patterns to reduce glare off the windows when taking photos.  I got to sit in the co-pilot's seat which was an added treat.

Captain Harry provided a good running commentary on the surroundings.  We flew southwest from Lihue just north of the southern coast, over the Waimea Canyon area, and then up the Na Pali coast.  On the north side we flew around the Hanalei Bay area and then cut across the island back towards Lihue.  We saw a gorgeous ground rainbow as we were coming in for a landing.

If you are prone to air sickness, it is highly recommended that you take some medication prior to boarding the plane.  My wife struggled with air sickness during the flight.  Also, if you are looking for up close views of the waterfalls on the island, the helicopter tours are probably the way to go.  We saw several helicopters that were providing their occupants with very close views of waterfalls while we were several thousand feet above them.

All in all, this was an excellent trip and good value.  AirVentures provides a good overview of the island and allows you to locate areas that you might want to see from ground level.  Do try to schedule this trip early on in your visit.

Bring your camera to capture stunning views you won't see in the populated areas of Kauai. Full rainbows, rain forest, strange rock formations, was well as the NaPali coastline were just some of things you'll see. Captain Harry is a knowledgeable tour guide as well as an extremely skilled pilot and we felt safe flying with him.  Would recommend!

review_title: A bird's eye view of the whole island splashed with multiple rainbows
review_text: This was probably the most rainbows I have even seen in my whole life.  The air ride gave an up close look at all the best spots of the island.  The mixture of rain and sun brought out rainbows time and time again, including a circular rainbow which was so neat and unique.  Harry also gave a very informative commentary of much of the history and the interesting background to Kauai.  Thanks for a great experience.

review_title: It was awesome and out of this world.
review_text: We had made arrangements to do this before we left home. The picked us up at the port and took us to the airport and brought us back afterwards. It was awesome. The pilot (Joel) was very knowledgeable and helped make the experience awesome. The staff at the airport were were beyond belief. Able to answer all of our concerns and questions with ease. Thank you for a experience beyond belief. I would highly recommend this. All seats on the plane are window seats and Joel was very good at making sure both sides of the plane got to see everything.

review_title: Rainbows and views you'll remember for a lifetime
review_text: Every minute of the flight is awesome! Our pilot (Harry) knows the island and you'll learn and see more about the island in 70 minutes than you'll learn in a week. Recommend doing this tour on the first day of your visit so you can organize your top areas of interest. This will help the "I wish I'd have this sooner on our trip!"
This was the first time I did a tour by Airplane. It was so fun and I was able to take some amazing pictures from the plane. I would definitely recommend taking this tour.

review_title: great birds eye view of the island
review_text: The day was a bit more cloudy than we would have liked but the rainbows made up for it.  It was delightful to see the canyon lands from the air after we had driven up there the day before.
I was sitting on the left side of the plane - as was my husband. Saw very little as most of the scenery was on the right side of the plane.

I am glad that my friends and I went in December so that the water falls were fuller and the green was greener.  Harry was very informative about what we were viewing and Air Ventures very responsive to the needs of our party  (crutches).

review_title: Amazing views of one of the most scenic places
review_text: 70 minutes encircling the island plus going inland into the canyon and rain forest.

review_title: The best way to see the whole island
review_text: We thoroughly enjoyed the tour and would recommend it to anyone going to Lihue.

review_title: Best way to see the island of Kauai! Beautiful!
review_text: The Air Ventures Hawaii trip was the best way to see all the hidden places of Kauai. We were a tour of four adult family members in ages ranging from 50 to 72 and we all were thrilled with the experience. The pilot shared his knowledgeable about the island in a personable manner which made the flight very interesting, and his flight skills made the ride smooth and comfortable. I would definitely take the trip again!

Fantastic views of the whole island!  The hour long flight gave great views of all that Kauai has to offer.  This aerial tour is a great way to see the Waimea canyon, Na pali Coast and other areas that are harder to reach on land.  Plenty of great views of mountains, waterfalls and rainbows combined with an amusing and informative running commentary by the pilot make this a tour that shouldn't be missed!
We saw much more than I expected. The pilot was friendly and knowledgeable and even made a detour to view a particular waterfall we were interested in seeing. Smooth operation and smooth flight.

review_title: Best way to see ALL of Kauai!
review_text: An excellent way to tour the Island........Captain was very knowledgeable and explained clearly much of the history..........Two way communication in the aircraft allowed for questions...........Aircraft was great for sightseeing and a smooth ride.........Highly recommended.........An Aloha Privileges Card will save you a bit of money on this trip.

review_title: Awesome!! Best way to see Kauai!!
review_text: This was part of a van tour and plane ride. We did the plane first which was nice as the turbulence was minimal. The pilot did a great job. He turned the plane to better see a whale that was breeching. Well worth the money!!!

Even when the weather is cloudy, the scenery was fantastic. The flight was smooth and the visibility was excellent even from the third seat back. Also plenty of leg room. The plane actually seemed to fly slower than the helicopters giving us plenty of time to take pictures.
Great flight!

review_title: To Say The Least, It Was The Most!
review_text: My nephew and I went up with pilot Harry and from take off to landing the experience was great.  Harry did a great job informing all six of us on our tour of many main attractions that are available to undergo while on the ground as well as historical facts about the island paradise.  Parts of the ride was a little bumpy, but we were forewarned before takeoff.  Seeing the island from an aerial perspective is a fantastic  way to go!

I can't speak for the helicopter tours, but this tour was in a small plane. While I noticed the other helicopters seem to get much closer to the sights, I didn't feel like I missed out on anything. I definately think that the right side of the plane sees more than the left but the seats are assigned for weight and balance purposes. I booked this tour as part of a package with holo holo boat tour and I think the value is incredible. This was the ONLY way for me to view the na Pali coast because the boats weren't able to make it out there during the winter months. My favorite parts were the jurassic park waterfalls and the cathedral cliffs. Joel was my pilot and he was very friendly and informative. This tour is highly recommended!!

My husband and I took an hour long flight over the beautiful island of Kauai on 23 November 2011.  The scenery is breathtaking and our pilot gave us a very informative and interesting commentary of all the places we were seeing.
We had already viewed the Waimea Canyon from the lookout in 2006 but this flight was an excellent way to discover more of this incredible "Grand Canyon of the Pacific" as Mark Twain described it.   The colours were vivid and we were more able to appreciate the huge size of the canyon from this bird's eye view.  
As we cruised along the coastline of the spectacular Napali Coast the scenery literally takes your breath away.  The height of the cathedral cliffs are mind blowing and to see these beautiful mountain cliffs so close up was breathtaking.  Each corner we turned brought another wonderful vista into view, with gorgeous blue and white coves and magnificent waterfalls everywhere we looked.  And we were blessed to not have any rain during our entire flight - which is amazing when you think we flew over the wettest place on earth!
The views of the entire coastline were also spectacular as we circumnavigated the island.  Even though we had seen it by road it was a great perspective to see the whole island from above.
I would recommend anyone take this once in a lifetime flight who wants to see a part of this amazing world God has created in the only way possible to really enjoy the full extent of its beauty.

My wife and I went up with AirVentures over Thanksgiving week. It was our first time in Kauai, and man was it worth it! We got to see the whole island... sights we never would have seen by land. It gave us a great grasp of what Kauai's geography was and helped us decide where we wanted to spend the rest of our vacation.

More importantly, this trip was HALF the cost of equivalent helicopter rides! And the views were not compromised at all. I'd definitely recommend this trip to anyone who wants to see Kauai as the birds do.

One quick caution: If you are prone to motion sickness, this or any other flight tour might not jive well with you.

review_title: It was a beautiful flight and the pilot was great
review_text: Our trip was beautiful.  I was visiting the island with my brother and mother for Thanksgiving.  The only thing about the trip that wasn't as I would have liked was that my seat was next to my mother, not next to the window, so when I wanted to take pictures I had to lean over my mother to take the picture.  Be prepared for reflections of yourself in your pictures unless you are able to put the lens of the camera right on the glass.

review_title: Wanted it to last all day!!
review_text: Absolutely Fabulous!!!!  Everyone at Air Ventures Hawaii was very helpful - friendly. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and informative.  It was everything their website described and more.  We could have flown and looked at the island all day.  Best airplane landing ever!!!  It was all great - you got a good view, knowledge, and FUN! - of the island.  We would go again without any hesitation!!  Thanks for making our stay in Kauai the best!

review_title: The most bang for your buck.
review_text:
Very enjoyable and extremely informative and well worth the price.
I saw more of Kauai in one air tour than I could possibly see in all the other ways combined.

review_title: Try it, you will love it.
review_text: Very enjoyable flight over Kauai with a pilot take knew the island very well.  I  was able to take some great photos without hiking for miles.  Highly reccommend Air Ventures.

My wife and I flew around Kauai with Air Ventures on a nice day in late November 2011. The flight was a great experience and a good way to see the island from above.  You can recognize the towns and natural features in a different way than a car. Although the Hawaiian winds can make it a little bumpy, it felt safe and the pilot provided good comments and knew the island well. Great fun.

review_title: Great views and a great time!
review_text:
This was a great trip around the island.  Our pilot was knowledgeable about both the sights and the history of the island, and also was great about offering a smooth ride and answering all of our questions about the airplane.

Would highly recommend!
Headed up with Harry for a great bird's-eye view of beautiful Kauai. He was professional, friendly and provided tons of information. We'd do it again.

We were in Kauai 11/4 /11 to 11/18/11  and did many things but one of our favorites was the Plane ride over the Island with Air Ventures, our pilot Jim was fantastic and very informative.. Would definitely recommend this to any friends or family that were going to Kauai. Well worth the price...

review_title: The best way to see Kauai
review_text: I was on Vacation with friends for two weeks in Hawaii. This tour was the best one we did on Kauai. The Pilot was excellent and the plane was well kept and clean. I was chosen to ride co-pilot so I got a little better view from the front windshield. The tour lasted a full hour and the pilot even tried to spot whales when we were over the water. He was able to avoid rain showers to ensure we had the best views of the magnificent waterfalls on the island. He provided some historical information and insightful information about the Island. Great Job.

great Trip and Flight, we saw things we could have not seen from the road, very informative and safe. we highly recommend this to any visitor to the island. Thanks to Harry and all for making our first trip to Kauii memorable
Plenty of sites and a fantastic journey!!! Make sure you bring your camera, because you will definetly beig using it!

Taking the air tour was like a putting a bow tie on tux; it was simply the most memorable experience we ever had in Hawaiian island. Took a couple of helicopter tours in the past but all were bumpy flght. This flight was smooth and the pilot was friendly and informative while he was very confident on the flight control.  This was the smoothest flight experience we ever had despite the small size airplane (usually these small ones are seldom bumpy, too). Thank you for providing us the life time experience over the island of Kauai. We have never seen any one of the island so thoroughly as we did with Air Ventures Hawaii. Thank you once again!   :)

review_title: Best way to see the beauty of Kauai
review_text: We did this trip the day we were leaving the island....as some of the other reviews say, I recommend taking this flight early in your stay on Kauai.  The island is spectacular and this flight gives you an amazing view of all Kauai has to offer.  Our Captain was very informative and spoke about the history of the different parts of the island as we flew over.  Air Ventures is about 1/2 the price of other air tours and the best part is that there are no middle seats.  Everyone has a fabulous view!

review_title: The best way to see beautiful Kauai!
review_text: I was apprehensive about flying because of the size of the plane, but Captain Harry was expert at keeping the flight smooth and interesting.  He also circled the plane intermittently to allow views from both sides of the plane, which was much appreciated by those sitting on the pilot's side.  Kauai is so beautiful and it was a real treat to see it from the air.  Great value, too.

review_title: Do it early during your stay...
review_text: Harry, our pilot was very personable, and Air Ventures was the perfect way to begin our week in Kauai.  From take-off to landing, Harry presented us with a grand view of all that Kauai has to offer. For first timers it was a stable and comfortable flight, gentle turns, skillful flying to avoid turbulence, detailed narration, and great viewing from both sides of the aircraft.We saw waterfalls, beautiful beaches, Hanalei Bay, resort areas, Port Allen, coffee plantations, Waimea Canyon, Na Pali Coast and Princeville area.  This great overview made it easy to plan the rest of our  week. Mahalo to Air Ventures.

review_title: Spectacular, stunning air tour taking in all the beauty of Kauai !!!
review_text: Harry, our pilot, and the Air Ventures staff made our air tour the centerpiece of our week in Kauai.  From take-off to landing, Harry presented us with a grand view of all that Kauai has to offer.  Waterfall, waterfalls, waterfalls, beautiful beaches, Hanalei Bay, resort areas, Port Allen, coffee plantations, Waimea Canyon, Na Pali Coast and Princeville area.  Genle turns, skillful flying to avoid turbulence, detail narration, and great viewing from both sides of the aircraft made this one of those WOW Trips!  Mahalo to the Air Ventures [:-)

review_title: WOW--Too Cool to be True--But It Was
review_text:
After a cancellation due to thunderstorms (SAFETY comes first) We had the ride and vistas of a lifetime.  Capt Harry is a great pilot and so thouroughly knowledgeable of the area that we had a wonderful explaination of everything.  So many waterfalls we lost count.
I would recommend this tour for everybody!!!
I've done the Helicopters over Kauai before but -- hands down--this IS THE BEST!!!  
Mahalo to Air Ventures
Thoroughly enjoyed the experience.  Pilot very knowledgeable and the scenery unbelievable.

review_title: THE 3rd WAY -- see KAUAI from the AIR!
review_text: We had been able to see the gardens and the reefs...and now were able to get that unique perspective from the air.  Since Kauai is near impossible to traverse via hiking inland -- this is the way to go!  It is amazing to see the wettest place on earth in all its green glory!  It would be a shame to come to Kauai and not see this...the variations of the blues of the ocean and the greens of the volcanic mountains are unsurpassed from this vantage point.

review_title: Fabulous way to see Kauaii with a smooth and quiet ride
review_text: My husband and I took the Air Ventures tour the last day of our 11 day stay. From the receiptionist to the pilot everyone made us feel welcome and safe. There is no bad seat in these planes and they do a complete tour around and through the island. It was great to see all the places we'd visited by land during our stay from the air. We could even see the zip line towers and the overlook at the top of the Waimea Canyon. Rob, the pilot, pointed out the sites and gave a very good description of the locations. Great way to see the waterfalls.

We took the air and sea combo while on our honeymoon in Kaua'i.  Great value and a wonderful way to see the exquisite Na Pali coast from different vantages.  Rob, our pilot for the plane trip, was friendly, professional and extremely welcoming of all our questions.  Lots of opportunity for great photos, but mostly just to soak up the breathtaking views.  Thank you so much for this unforgettable trip !

review_title: Awsome way to see the island
review_text: Great experience.  Well worth the cost.  The pilot was very informative.  Learned a lot about the island.

Air Ventures one hour tour was an awesome way to see parts of Kauai that you wouldn't get to see unless you do it by air.  What a different perspecive to fly over Waimea canyon, the Napi Coast, Hanalei, and the waterfalls too many to count.  Our pilot did a good job of keeping us informed of what we were seeing.  Would highly recommend to add to your Kauai experience!  Don't forget your camera!

We really enjoyed our Air Ventures flight.  Everyone at the company was so nice!  Our hotel booked the flight and told us the wrong day, but Air Ventures decided to send up another plane so we could go.  Once in the air, the views were absolutely breath-taking and worth every penny.  Captain Harry was a great pilot and told us a lot of great information about the island.  The only caution I would add would be to take some Dramamine before flying.  I usually don't have any problems with air or motion sickness and I was feeling quite woozy by the end of the flight.  
Thank you Air Ventures for a great experience!

review_title: Incredible way to see the entire island of Kauai.
review_text: Our pilot Harry was great keeping us informed about what we were seeing.  The sights of the canyon and the waterfalls will last a life time. Could not have asked for a better flight.

review_title: Great way to view the entire island with knowledgeable pilot
review_text: We were lucky as we had a remarkably clear day to see the sights, it was not bumpy and the pilot knew the history of the island.  Having the 2-way microphone on the noise-reducing headsets allowed us to ask questions and have a two-way conversation wit the pilot.  For the airplane buffs, you also here him talking to air traffic control, too.  Needless to say, the tour of Hawaii's most tropical island was one of our most memorable activities of our visit.  It was part of a combo air-river fern grotto)-land tour, and everyone in our party thought the air tour was the best part.  Tip: charge up your camera and wear a dark shirt to reduce reflections as you'll want to take a lot of photos.

First time on Kauai, great way to see the island before going out on your own.  Harry did a great job in pointing out the sites and and places to see while on Kauai. Flying is so close to the sites was amazing. Keep your eye on the scenery and not on your camera. The view is fantastic.

review_title: A wonderful way to see the island of Kauai!
review_text: When we first booked this tour, we were a bit apprehensive about flying in a small craft like this, as we had never done anything like this before.  The airvan is spacious and has oversized windows which are great for taking photographs.  Unlike some helicopter tours, each and every passenger has a window seat in this tour which was a real plus for us.  Harry was a WONDERFUL pilot and tour guide.  He flew us over some of the most beautiful scenery the island has to offer.  We mentioned that we were interested in going to the Queen's Bath while we were on the island.  He went out of his way to make sure he flew over it and pointed out where it was at and how to get to it. His friendliness and knowledge of the island made for a wonderful tour.  We would highly recommend this experience to others.

Rob and the entire staff provided us with an unforgettable experience.  Their professionalism was only outdone by the beauty and majesty of the island itself.  Rob's knowledge of the geography truly enhanced our tour. Photographs can not really reflect the valleys, mountains and cliffs.  They must be seen first hand and Air Ventures made this happen.  Our thanks for a wonderful journey.  We plan to return to Kauai and a return flight definitely be on our schedule.  Gail &Gil

This was not our first air tour, but it was for sure the best! Very roomy, great visibility,comfortable ride, and very knowledgeable pilot. Best ever way to see Kauai! The one tour we will be sure to advise our friends about! Thanks to the staff! Jim and Kathy ,  Troutdale, OR

review_title: Start your vacation with Air Ventures Hawaii!
review_text: What a wonderful way to start a week in Kauai with a flight over the island in a stable, roomyAir Ventures Hawaii Airvan plane with a super pilot who provided a wonderful, informative commentary!  Additionally, he had a great personality!  We learned so much about the Island's history and culture.  The stability of the plane was wonderful not only for possibly queasy stomachs but also for ease of photography!  It was a super experience!!  Thanks, Air Ventures!

review_title: Wonderful Experience of air, land and river of Kauai
review_text: We made a day of this trip.  We had a package deal, plane ride around the Island where we saw an overview of Kauai including a 360 degree rainbow. Awesome!!  From the air, we did the Smith Riverboat ride which was very scenic, then onto the Kauai Island tour van for the in depth part of Kauai.  Steve Yoder took was to places you wouldn't know where to look if driving yourself.

My wife and I are in our sixties and were a little nervous about a tour in a small plane.  we were pleasantly surprised how big the plane was.  Harry was our pilot and he made our tour very enjoyable.  He not only took us to the most beautiful places in Kauai, but even his jokes were funny. We also combine our plane tour with the dinner cruise to the Na'Pali coast.  It also was first rate and very enjoyable.  We also liked the discount by booking both tours with Air Ventures.  Lee &  Caron New Jersey 10/16/11
Our young great pilot showed us the fantastic island from above, which we discovered by car before.  Gorgeous impressions! To me no difference to a helicopter flight but much cheaper!

review_title: Great Experience, Fantastic Flight, memorable views
review_text:
Some companies just want to take your money and run, not Air Ventures Hawaii.  At the time of our scheduled flight the main areas were shrouded in cloud and rather than take us and see what little was possible to see we were offered the opportunity to re-book, so we did!!
The flight was amazing, our pilot Joel entertained us with local knowledge and took us to all the amazing sights.  
It is an amazing way to see Kauai and really should be included on everyones tour itinerary.   Thanks for a great flight and for the memories of your fantastic island.
What an awesome adventure and great way to see the island!  Captain Harry was knowledgeable and fun to fly with. I highly recommend this tour!

Easy to find at the airport.  Friendly employees.  Aircraft has large windows suitable for taking lots of pictures.  Have never taken the helicopter tour, so I couldn't compare the two, but am very satisfied in terms of value for the price.

review_title: Spectacular aerial tour of the Garden Island
review_text: We wanted to see the Na Pali Coast and it was a toss up between air and sea.  We also wanted to tour the island by bus.  Best of Kaua'i  Tours offered a combination tour with Air Ventures that seemed to fit our wishes.  While the bus tour was pleasant, relaxing, informative and enjoyable, Air Ventures was the highlight of the day.  Our pilot flew us over some of the most spectacular views that we've ever seen on earth, the Na Pali coast and more, and they will be permanently etched in our memories.  Thank you everyone at Air Ventures and Best of Kaua'i Tours.

review_title: Amazing aerial views of Kauai's hidden beauty
review_text: Enjoyed the full Air Ventures experience!  Capt Harry shared local experiences and Hawaiian history.  We were fortunate to see some amazing waves along the Princeville coastline and surfers in tow.  Air Ventures took us to all the sights plus more ... from the Napali Coast, all the way through the Waimea Canyon and the local towns and beaches.  We would definitely recommend this tour as part of your vacation plans.
The air tour is a must do in Kauai.  Using Air Adventures was a great experiance.  The pilot went our of his way to explain and answer our questions, offering a very colorful tour.

Our experience with Air Ventures Hawaii was wonderful. When our flight was rained out on Tuesday, they went the extra mile to accommodate us - they brought on an extra pilot to take us up in the middle of a busy schedule on Wednesday. They can't take credit for the perfect flying and picture taking weather, but they did allow us to be able to fly in it when it came along. Our pilot was skilled, knowlegeable, and very personable; and the support staff was excellent.

Enjoyed the view, but cabin was a little warm for me (wasn't able to get enough air flow from the vent).  Overall, I was able to view the island and see some spectacular sights.  Thank you for this affordable trip!

review_title: The best air tour We've ever been on
review_text: The entire trip was easy and very memorable.  The sign-up went in just a couple minutes over the phone.  The staff was very friendly and helpful.  The pilot was very friendly and knowledgable about the island.  Doing the trip by plane was an excellent way to view Kauai and next time we are there we will do it again.

The experience we had with Air Ventures was super. Although the weather was not the best (low clouds and minor turbulance) Rob did a great job to make our trip around the island, all we could hope for. I would highly recommend AVH to make your Hawaiian visit complete!
Seems like the helicopters get much closer, but for people that want an aerial view of the island this is very satisfying at approximately half the cost! I would regret NOT doing it!

Our flight with Cptn Harry was the greatest flight ever.  Harry know just which parts of the island of Kauai are of interest to his passengers, and his piloting skills are exceptional.  Way to go Harry!

review_title: Fantastic way to view the island of Kauai at a great price!
review_text: We are a family with 4 children ages 12 to 19 and spent a week on Kauai.  We really wanted to do an air tour with our kids but the cost of a helicopter flight would have been well over $1,000.00.  We saw a brief introduction to Air Ventures and it seemed interesting so we decided to look into it some more.  A few people discouraged us from doing the plane trip as opposed to the helicopter because the planes "do not get as close" to the features as the helicopters do.  Well, we decided to roll the dice and go with the plane tour which was less than half the cost!!!  For a family of 6, cost is a very important factor.  I was concerned we would spend the money and be disappointed.  Boy was I wrong.  This trip was phenomenal.  My wife and I had been on a helicopter tour in the past so we definitely know the difference.  What we found is actually the opposite of conventional wisdom.  By not going quite as close to the features we were able to get a much bigger picture of the landscape and actually enjoyed the tour more than the helicopter trip we had done a few years ago.  The plane got surprising close to the features and the landscape and it went slow enough we were able to get great photos and take in the views.  If we had it to do over again, we would definitely go this route.  It was a fantastic time for everyone and the cost made it much more bearable on my wallet.  Highly recommended.

review_title: Was a great way to view the island
review_text:
Can't say that I thoroughly enjoyed the flight (through no fault of Air Adventures though)!  
I had a bit of queasiness, not a lot but just enough to make things less enjoyable. 
I think that sitting on the left side behind the pilot was a bad seat for viewing as it seemed everything of interest was on the right side  :(
I did truly appreciate the promptness of the crew, who called ahead to Holo Holo Charters where we were taking the catamaran tour later that afternoon to let me know I had left my cell phone on the plane!
The combo of the flight and catamaran tour was a GREAT DEAL!  Much less expensive doing it that way then other companies on the island offer and you do not have to do both in one day either!

review_title: Great pilot, great views, the best experience.
review_text: A wonderful flight viewing the island of Kauai.  Great views of the canyon and Napoli coast.

The island is beautiful and this is the only way that anyone can see it all. It was a little bumpy because it was quite windy but otherwise it was wonderful.  No rain and lots of sun.  I think this is a great experience early on our visit because we now know where we want to visit sometime during our vacation. Thank you for a great time.

review_title: Kauai takes the Hawai'i experience up a level or two, AirVentures lets you experience Kauai in a way that a car can't!
review_text:
My wife and I have wanted to visit Hawai'i for a long time, but weren't able to until recently, when I started working in Honolulu. Everyone I work with heaps accolades and superlatives on just about everything - rightfully so!  After a few weeks of living in Waikiki, we finally got a chance to see another island, and came to Kauai - the Garden Island.  What does one do to describe Kauai when you've tried to use every maximum superlative you can muster to describe O'ahu and then come to Kauai - and find it to be everything you've found over there - and so much more!!!?  It's quieter, more beautiful, not crowded, and has attractions that do not exist on O'ahu.  The majesty of Waimea Canyon does bring to mind, immediately, the sweeping vistas of Arizona's Grand Canyon, but with different colors.  When finished with the Grand Canyon, though, you just can't drive a little further up the road and see something like the fantastic view of the Napali Coast that lies a few minutes north of the Wiamea Canyon.
Then there are the number of small towns dotting Kauai's coastline, each with it's own suite of local shops, places to eat - and beaches!
It's all almost overwhelming!
Then you meet the people at AirVentures and take an aerial tour of the island, and see all those places you've driven to, and some that you wished you could have - and you see everything from the perspective you can only get from the air! The Napali coast, the plantations living and abandoned, the houses of those we've seen on the screen, the impossible greenery that's everywhere, the sereneness permeates you! With all of that, one thing continues to becon - the Canyon, the Canyon, don't forget the Canyon.

There is nothing to compare seeing Kauai by Air!  The trip was smooth due to the good piloting of Harry.  My friend and I took many pictures!  She was a bit afraid at first but after we took off she was so happy that I had convinced her to go.  The scenery was unbelievably beautiful!

Una experiencia que merece la pena hacer. La atención en todo momento fué muy buena, tanto en la oficina como el piloto. Además esta todo el rato explicandote lo que vas viendo. el recorrido es muy completo y solo tiene que acompañarte el tiempo un poco para que sea alucinante. Por sacarle alguna pega, ´la avioneta quizas no sea lo mejor para gente alta ya que el espacio es bastante reducido en los asientos, pero a cambio tienes ventanilla siempre para poder hacer fotos. Eso si,es mejor el lado derecho del avión!

I had a blast! The staff was awesome, very friendly and helpful. 
Nicole is a sweetheart and Rob is very knowledgeable and you will leave with a few tidbits of information regarding Kauai. 
As for the ride. Nice and Smooth and the views will leave you breathless. Definitely a must do!

After2 other tries (due to bad weather) we finally were able to take the most exciting tour of Kauai.
We simply glided over the most breathtaking scenery imaginable. The flight was so smooth it felt as though we were suspended in mid air.
