The pilot and the rest of the staff were awesome they made the experience unforgetable. 
Colin

Seeing Kauai from the sky is spectacular.  The mountains are breath taking.  there is no other way you could appreciate its beauty so completely.
Air Ventures was prompt, courteous and knowledgeable at a fair price. Our pilot and guide was friendly and knowledgeable.
All in all it was a great attraction.

Great flight with a good, knowlegeble pilot, very smooth with very little bumps.  I would advise anyone who is going on a small airplane to not eat anything in the morning, or several hours before flying as the passenger in the front seat found out when he got airsick, and that was a relatively smooth flight.

review_title: BIG KAHUNA TOUR: Awesome view, fantastic pilot, great experience!
review_text: We were told that the best way to see Kauai was by air, so we did some research and decided on the Big Kahuna Tour by Air Ventures Hawaii.  It didn't disappoint!  It was cost-effective and it had big windows for us to look out of.    Our pilot Rob was so friendly and knowledgeable, and as for the view, well, it was spectacular.  All round it was an awesome experience!

The flight was really good and Jerry knows his stuff.  AC is an amazing driver who knows the area very well and can pin point the lookouts on the ground very well for the amazing views.  Above and beyond our expecetations was the whole experience. Thanx for the great time guys and again AC thanx for everything.  Great Job
We thoroughly enjoyed our flight tour of Kauai. Pilot Harry was very informative and helpful.  Very smooth take off and landing.

review_title: Clearly The Best Thing To Do on Kauai!
review_text: The AirVentures "Big Kahuna" tour of Kauai is just tremendous. I toured the island by helicopter several years ago and, by comparison, the fixed-wing 6-passenger is luxurious, sedate and great for photography from all seats. I am an experienced private pilot and appreciated the care and attention our pilot gave to his passengers and flight safety. Now that the FAA has regulated a very standard island tour route, the advantage of a helicopter is mostly removed, and of course they are more cramped and far more costly. Go with AirVenture...they are no fuss, high-service, and very cost-effective. A great experience!

Tropical Biplanes gave us a wonderful aerial view of the island of Kauai.  We were not able to go up into the biplane so opted to take the Cessna.  The pilot was outstanding in his knowledge of the island and its attractions and history.  He was super friendly and even tipped us on the best places to snorkel on the island!  We got awesome pics from this trip!  My husband is a pilot and really appreciated the pilots knowledge and experience.  Tropical Biplanes is highly recommended from us!  
A+++++

My husband, my sister and her fiance went with me on this adventure. The day started out rainy and we thought we were either not going to go up or they would insist on keeping there schedule. We were pleasantly surprised when the hostess informed us the pilot would not go up until it was safe and we could see all the sites. The clouds opened up and we got the most amazing flight. The pilot was very informative and showed us all the sights. Everybody had a window seat and I was able to film the whole trip. I would highly recommend it for price and wonderful staff. Definately one of my favorite excursions!

After weather scuttled our scheduled afternoon air tour, we took an early morning flight the next day and even the pilot mentioned how clear it was. Well run, congenial organization. Contact & reservations easy. The flight: speactacular. We have already explored most of the island, including the Na'Pali Coast cruise, but to recap our visit by air, to see the places we'd been was an extra special treat. I was lucky enough to sit in front next to the pilot, an exceptionally personable young man with admirable knowled of the island.

Some of you may want the "thrill" of the helicopter tours. I don't want to say been there done that, but the 'copter tours held little interest for me - plus they are noisy. The fixed wing aircraft isn't and with this group you have headphones and a two way connection to the pilot, can hear air traffice controllers etc. A bonus - the plane ride like your grandmother's Buick - nice and smooth. But for thrillseekers, the pilot will make sure you get your wahoo moments as he flies toward a mountain then turns at the last minute.

This trip was just plain fun. And as a side benefit you get to experience taking off and landing at Lihue in something other than a jet airliner.

review_title: wonderful views for an affordable price.
review_text: There were 4 in our group. Everyone had a window seat. The pilot  gave information and pointed out landmarks. He circled over the waterfalls so eveyone could see.It was very comfortable in the plane , small but not cramped. Highlight of our trip!

The personnel at Air Ventures cordial, helpful and polite.  I would recommend their services to anyone wanting to get a great aerial view of the Island of Kawaii.

Our pilot, rob, was most professional and handled the aircraft with tender care.  Smooth take-off and very smooth landing!  His explanation of the different areas of Kawaii were most enlightening.  Thanks, Rob!

We would definitely use their services again if the occasion would ever arise and recommend it to anyone interested in such and adventure.

Sincerely, Bill, Ann and Jordan

review_title: A really great way to experience Kauai in the air and at a good price
review_text:
When on Kauai you must absolutely take a helicoptor tour or an airplane tour.  It is a must.  It should be a law.  Helicoptor tours are more expensive and Air Adventures was a good deal cheaper.  You see the whole island and the Helicopter Pilott Harry was great.   Be warned however if you get motion sickness, you may get sick on this tour becuase the plane ride can get choppy.

You will not regret this tour.

My husband and parents and I did the airventures tour last September. This is something I highly recommend to anyone, it was amazing! The views from the air are just breathtaking! We choose the plane tour over a helicopter tour because it was about half the price, and honestly I dont know how it could be any better! Our pilot was wonderful he explained everything to us as we flew over.The pictures and momories we have from this experience are amazing and this is an activity I would do again! Just a side note if you get motion sickness I would absolutely take bonine or something to that effect. My mom and I were both feeling horrible when we left and she had to use the bag provided :( We didn't think about it beforehand unfortunately but learned our lesson the hard way because we are both prone to motion sickness. I would still do the tour again however!

review_title: A wonderful way to see Kauai
review_text: My wife and I went on AIr ventures the 2nd day of our cruise time in Kauai. We had wanted to do a helicopter ride, but the price of air ventures made the decision for us. It was a great way to see beautiful Kauai. The pilot was very knowledgeable. The flight was a little bumpy but well worth it. It gave you a look at a lot of the area that you can't get to by car. We loved this trip and would recommend it to anyone.

This review is long overdue, but wanted to get it out there (we actually went 3/10). We went on the Air Ventures plane tour at the end of our 7 day cruise on our Kauai day. I must say-It was the best part of our trip! We debated between this tour or a helicopter tour and we were glad we chose this one. It was much quieter and more enjoyable than the other would have been. We saw the most magnificent scenery from the air: numerous waterfalls, rainbows, magnificent cliffs, whales,etc. It just boggles the mind how beautiful everything was. There were 4 of us and the pilot on the plane. It was spacious and comfortable. We had headphones on, so were able to hear the pilot talk about the things we were passing. At the end of the trip, we were given dvd's of everything we saw from above so we could enjoy the trip over and over! I would definitely do this tour again if I was ever back in Kauai!

review_title: If you want to see paradise from the air and save money, this is the trip for you!
review_text: We had always thought that seeing Kauai, the garden isle, from the air would be prohibitively expensive.  You can imagine how surprised we were to discover that we were wrong.  Air Ventures is the perfect answer for those who want to see hidden waterfalls, remote vallies, majestic coastlines and all the beauty of this paradise on earth. On top of that, we felt much more environmentally friendly taking a plane flight that used much less gasoline and made much less noise than the traditional helicopter ride would.  The pilot was very informative and the trip was fantastic...something we will always remember.

review_title: A great way to take in the overall beauty of the island
review_text: On my recent honeymoon, my husband surprised me with this airplane tour. I had been too nervous to try the helicopter tour and the airplane was a great alternative. The plane was comfortable and the pilot was professional and friendly. I appreciated how he asked us to pose with the plane to take a photo before the trip started. Throughout the flight  we had beautiful views of the diverse Kauai landscape and the pilot pointed out waterfalls, mountain ranges, and the stunning Napali coastline. Even though we took photographs through the glass windows, I was impressed with how well they came out. I certainly recommend this trip to all island visitors!

review_title: Great way to quickly see the entire island
review_text: Went on this tour with my wife while on our honeymoon.  This was a very easy and economical way to see the island. Our tour was cancelled twice due to weather, but the women in the office were very accommodating and professional in making sure they could fit us in during our vacation.  When our time came, I actually got to sit in the front of the plane with the pilot!  Although it was a very windy day, our pilot kept it col and all the guests comfortable.   He was quiet but very knowleddgeable about the island.  We got some of our best photos and memories of our entire trip from this tour.

review_title: Pilot/Narrator needs to be more dynamic, less laid back.
review_text: Pilot was boring in his delivery; didn't seem into interacting with passengers.  Was more concerned about changing music, although music didn't seem to be purposely choreographed to the sights.  After previous helicopter tour of island, this was nothing special.

review_title: great time in the sky over Kauai
review_text: We really enjoyed the flight and the pilot was a lot of fun. Awesome way to get a feel for the entire island. we had the previlage of seeing the top of the mountain unobscured by the clouds.

review_title: The only way to see Kauai.
review_text: This was an awesome trip.  This is the only way to see the whole island, my whole family loved it.  Harry is a great pilot  and travel guide.

review_title: Rainbows, waterfalls, scenic views, and entertainment in one flight
review_text: This was a 6 passenger aircraft that took off from the Lihue airport, and traveled a clockwise flight around the island.   Our pilot,Harry, was very entertaining and provided a high quality view of Kauai.   Somehow he even provided a double rainbow on our flight!    An experience of a lifetime.   Recommended for a great airial tour.   Bring your cameras, but be prepared for pictures with a glare in them (or maybe you're better than I).    60-minute drive from Princeville.   70-minute flight.

review_title: Absolutely the Best Way to Experience Kaui
review_text:
Just got back from a cruise in Hawaii. The highlight of our trip was the "Big Kahuna" sightseeing flight around Kaui with Air Ventures Hawaii. We were picked up near our cruise ship port in Nawiliwili, Kaui and shuttled to nearby Lihue Airport for our flight.  From the start, you could see that this is a top-notch operation.  My daughter and I checked in with the staff and the pilot, Harry, quickly introduced himself to us and the two other gentlemen going on the flight.
     We had contemplated going on one of the many helicopter tours availailable in Kaui, but instead decided to go on one of Air Ventures airplanes. They are very comfortable GA- 8 high wing airplanes with excellent visibility. They are quieter than helicopters,  can fly very slowly so you don't miss anything (our whole flight was done at 90 -110 knots and we varied our touring altitude from 500 ft to 4000 ft) , and everyone on board gets a window seat. Most importantly, the aircraft are much more economical to operate, which makes the fares much lower than with a helicopter trip.
     Harry did a great job of narrating the flight via headphones. We flew clockwise around the coastline, flew directly over our docked cruise ship, then descended into Waimea Canyon for great pictures. We then ascended over the top of the canyon and down along the Na'pali Coast for unbelievable views. Finally, we came around the other side of Kaui and into the Hanelei Valley. The trip took about 70 minutes and we got the most comprehensive tour of  Kaui one can possibly imagine. Back on the ground, they were nice enough to give us a ride to the rental car facility.Finished the day off with a high speed catamaran ride back to the Na'pali Coast with their Air and Sea Combo. An excellent end to an excellent day.

review_title: Comfortable, informative and well worth the money!
review_text: My husband and I were on our honeymoon and like many other reviewers have said, were discouraged by the high priced helicopter tour. We found a package deal with Air Ventures and a local sunset cruise company and booked both for half the price. We didn't expect a whole lot with the air tour, but we were both very pleasantly surprised. We each had a great view out our windows and really enjoyed the commentary from the pilot. They gave us water and snacks which was a nice touch. The ride was extremely comfortable and smooth and we were able to see most of the island on the tour. We couldn't have asked for a better day with no clouds in the sky. If you're considering a cheaper alternative to a helicopter ride in Kauai, I would definitely recommend Air Ventures!

On our recent trip to Kauai I really wanted to take an aerial tour of the island, but was discouraged by the helicopter companies policy of gouging big people for a ride. I'm 6'6" and just shy of 300 lbs, and the helicopter operators charge you for an extra seat. 
I discovered AirVentures online, and for just a little over a hundred dollars had a GREAT air tour. 
The staff was super friendly....very Aloha!! I got the seat in back right by the door, with no seat in front of it, and was able to stretch my legs fully out on the ride, and was able to easily see out of both sides of the plane. Our pilot was really cool, and talked with us a lot during the trip.
The ride itself was awesome!! The headphones made the noise minimal, and communications were easy. The takeoff was smooth as can be, and the flight very comfortable. There were a few bumpy parts here and there, but really nothing major. We saw all of the sights from Poipu, up Waimea Canyon, all along Napali, the North Shore beaches, Hanalei Valley, and inland to Waileilei, then over the East Shore before landing back in Lihue. 
While we didn't dive into the canyons like the helicopters do (although watching the helicopters below us, I thought they got a bit too close for comfort) we flew low enough to see everything in great detail. And there was no "wasted" time flying over the water as somebody had previously posted. 
AirVentures Kauai is an excellent value....if you dont want to pay the exorbinant charges the helicopter companies charge, book this flight....you WILL NOT be disappointed!!
One last thing, if it is the only splurge you take on your trip....do not miss flying over Kauai. It is honestly the most beautiful sight I have ever seen.

review_title: Take dramamine and go when the weather is good!
review_text:
On the positive side: Our pilot was very informative and friendly, we got to see a lot that we wouldn't have otherwise seen (partially because our boat trip was cancelled 3 times due to weather, so this was our only chance to see the Napali coast). Beautiful views, lots of rainbows and waterfalls. Every seat had a window, so it was great for photography. 

Negative side: I have never been so motion sick in my life. I really don't mean to whine, I've never had trouble with this before, and neither has my husband, but both of us were absolutely miserable for about 3/4 of the trip. The weather was bad, so I'm sure that didn't help, and we were in the back of the plane (I have no idea if that makes a difference or not). I've been on a helicopter tour before this one, and relatively small planes, and have never had this problem, so I'm not sure what caused it, but the tour was not nearly as enjoyable as it could have been. The other negative (which might have also been because of the weather) was that we didn't get to see Jurassic Falls at all, or any waterfalls close up, and we also didn't get a DVD at the end, so I did feel a little bit cheated despite the great price because of what I knew others had seen on the same tour. 

Overall, I would recommend this company to a friend, it was a memorable experience and, since it was storming every other day of our trip, this was our only good view of the island. I originally wanted to give it fewer stars because I felt so miserable and we didn't get to see several of the things I thought we would, but I realize that most of that is not the company's or pilot's fault. It's a great company and a beautiful tour, I just really wish we could have enjoyed it more :(  Take dramamine or something if you have even the tiniest inclination towards motion sickness, at least if the weather is bad!

We went all around the island, including spending a good amount of time along the beautiful Na'Pali coast, looking at the beautiful falls areas, and the various canyons.

I was sitting on the right side, which had better views most of the time than the left side had because we flew roughly clockwise around the island.

The pilot appeared to have some decent time logged (I did hear the stall horn sound for a couple seconds a couple times, though, which isn't horrible but not optimal) and the plane is an Airvan, which are used for things like search and rescue, civil air patrol, etc. so the plane is a good size and very durable when well-maintained.

If we do another air tour somewhere else, we'll probably spring for one by helicopter; plane rides are less expensive (1/3 to 1/4 less, if I recall correctly) and are generally safer, but they can't get up-close-and-personal like helicopters can.

review_title: Fantastic - a real highlight of our trip
review_text: Great views of astonishing Kauai, knowledgeable pilot and great value when compared with a helicopter flight. Would highly recommend.

review_title: Seeing Kauai by air is the way to go !
review_text:
Our pilot Harry made our air tour a memorable experience. He showed us things we would not have been able to get to  by car. Kauai is one of the most beautiful places on Earth. We will definitely be back. Thanks Harry.

Jeff and Nancy Mount
Ventura, CA

review_title: 5 Stars Airplane Sightseeing Tour w/ our pilot, Joel!
review_text: We booked a 1-hour flight with Air Ventures after finding their listing in an Entertainment book. We met at the meeting point (a 5 minute walk from the cruise ship terminal, at a little mall). Somebody from Air Ventures picked us up promptly, and took us the short distance to the Lihue airport to the Air Ventures check in desk. We met our pilot, Joel, for our 8:30am flight. Great pilot - excellent commentary during the tour. Only the "co-pilot" passenger had a headpiece that would automatically communicate with the pilot, but the other 4 (including myself) didn't mind because we were completely in awe with the fantastic tour we were on. On the north side of Kauai, Joel was mentioning that it was the end of the Humpback season, and he hadn't seen whales in weeks... no sooner had he said that did we see a pod of about 10 whales. So, Joel circled the plane around to take a better look at the whales - simply breathtaking! This tour is of superior value as EVERY passenger has a comfortable WINDOW seat - and is about half the price of any helicopter tour offered from the cruise ship! It's a MUST DO - and I recommend early morning as we had clear skies with all sun! Thanks for a fantastic tour - if we ever return to Kauai, we'll be sure to return to Air Ventures!!

This was the best part of our trip.  The views from the air were Amazing.  We had considered the helicopter but opted for the AirVentures instead due to seating and price.  We were so glad we did.  This is one thing you can not miss while on Kauai.   Our Pilot was so fun and knowledgeable and pointed out many things we would have missed on our own.   Besides the many things you will only see  by air.   I love re-living it by watching our DVD they gave us at the end.   I would highly recommend this adveture to all.

review_title: Very pleasant aerial tour of Kauai
review_text: We couldn't decide between a helicopter or fixed wing tour of Kauai ... since we have done chopper tours elsewhere, we decided to try Air Ventures Kauai.  We had a wonderful flight and were able to see well out the windows.  When we were walking out to the aircraft, several navy fighter jets were in the pattern doing "touch and go"s" so we were able to watch them for a few minutes ... very cool!  Although I do prefer helicopter flight, especially in Hawaii, I would recommend Air Ventures for a less expensive, positive alternative.

review_title: A comfortable first class sightseeing ride!
review_text:
We were treated to a combination  of sightseeing, history, question and answering through good equipment in both the plane and the communication equipment.  The entire staff was very friendly.  The plane was very plush. We had a great adventure!

Chuck and Suzanne 
Orange,California

review_title: What a way to see the island of Kauai
review_text:
We booked with Air Ventures to take a 6 person plane to tour the island of Kauai.  They are located near the Lihue airport, easy to find .  It was a 60 - 70 minute flight and the pilot was very informative of what we were seeing, pointing out the different features of the island.  There were times he turned the plane around so the others on the left side of plane could see the feature.  Kauai has lots of waterfalls, lots of movies have been filmed here, we spotted whales from the plane , we flew over the canyons and the na pali coast line with its many beaches - some secluded and can only get there my boat. 
It was well worth the money.

The concierge recommended Air Ventures as part of our trip and we are so glad that she did.  We had done a helicopter ride in Maui and wanted to give this a try.  The biggest advantage to the plane over a helicopter is that everyone has a window seat, so you don't have to lean over anyone to see the scenery.
The plane was very comfortable and for someone who can get a little motion sickness I found the ride to be a better fit for me that the helicopter.
We saw such beautiful scenery and Captain Harry was a great tour guide giving us so many highlights and so much history of what we were seeing below.
This is a great way to see Kauai and the majesty of the island!

review_title: One of the must-dos, totally worth the money
review_text:
I was originally planning for a boat tour to the Na Pali coast and only changed my mind in the last minute.  Na Pali is one of the most beautiful areas of Kauai, and it's inaccessible by car, so you'll really have to plan to sail, fly or walk the 11-mi trail to see the coast line.  I was so lucky to be able to get a seat on the busy Christmas eve.  It was a beautiful day, and the ride was just so perfect.  The staff at Air Ventures were extremely friendly, and I was very impressed that Captain Harry took everyone like a family tour, as opposed to a paid guided tour.  He explained every place we flew by, detoured to the water and pointed out whales--I never knew it's so amazing to see the whales from the air.  You can actually see them under the water, and we were even luckier to see a whale doing a flip, making a huge splash of water.  Then we flew down the famous Kalalau Valley, spent 15-20min in the Na Pali coast area, and then continued to Hanalei valley, and before we returned to the airport, Captain Harry flow around the beautiful Wailua falls so everyone got a close-up views of the falls (much larger than what you'd see from the road).

I've taken flightseeings in Alaska and Hawaii, and my personal experience is when the weather is good, it's absolutely worth every penny--even if you found the price may be enough for you to fly a round trip across the continental US :)  But I'd always give it a second thought if the weather isn't good.  And finally, Air Ventures operates an air van (or more), which flights higher than helicopters, so you won't get a chance to fly by the water falls, but you don't really miss anything, and considering that the price is probably 50% lower, it's an unbeatable deal.  BTW, everyone has a window seat on the air van, and Air Ventures keep their windows spotless; while on a 6-passenger helicopter, only 3 people get window seats.

We paid around $110 as part of a cruise combo package ($80) with Holo Holo Charters for this 60-minute Air tour of Kauai. The captain was really knowledgeable, showed us every important point in the island including the Na Pali coast, the North Shore, Coffee Plantations, Waimea Canyon and countless waterfalls.
Everyone in the plane had a seat next to the window. We were given headphones to listen to the captain's commentary. We caught some of the most spectacular views of Kauai. This was the cheapest Air tour we found anywhere in Hawaii. It is truly worth every single penny you spend.

review_title: Maybe we chose the wrong day...
review_text: We reserved the airplane tour in combination with a river cruise to the Fern Grotto about a month before coming to Kauai and have been eagerly anticipating it.  The company called to confirm our date and time the day before of our trip, which we appreciated.  We found it at the airport without any problems and were greeted in a friendly manner when we arrived a few minutes early.  We watched another family come in for a landing and depart by van for the next part of their trip adventure. Then after refueling the plane, we went up with another small family. The pilot was very friendly and informative about points of interest. The beginning of the trip, around the south, was very beautiful and we saw lots of rainbows.However, there were rain showers on the west coast and to the north of the island, so the pilot took us way out over the water, which felt like he was just making the trip come out  to our alloted air time although we didn't  get to see anything but water.  Then when we got past the rain, it was time to go in for our landing. The landing was very smooth and after deplaning, the staff came to us with our dvd and a voucher for the boat cruise to the Fern Grotto. We were told that because it was winter, the boat cruise hours were changed and she gave us directions to get there ourselves. So, even though we were given an open ended ticket for the boat cruise, we were disappointed that they weren't taken us there immediately...............so I must say, we left feeling kind of cheated.  We didn't get to see Jurrasic Falls and lots of other interesting views because of the weather.

Don't leave Kauai without seeing the island from the eyes of a bird by flying Air Ventures. We did on Tuesday December 7, 2010 at 1:30 pm. WOW! Words cannot explain the beauty and pictures do no justice! This was the highlight of our trip. We left Lihu'e Airport flying southwest, then along the south shores, over the coffee fields, over the "Grand Canyon of the Pacific", Then to the Na Pali Coast. There we saw several Whales from the plane and what looked to be a sail fish jumping out of the water. What a nice surprise this was. From there our knowledgeable pilot took us to the northern shores, past Princeville and onto the Wailua Falls. (This isn't an all inclusive list of where we went. I just don't remember them all.) The trip took about an hour. My Wife sat in the front because she is very claustrophobic and had a great time.

In September of this year my wife and I traveled to Hawaii where we spent 2 weeks on the Big Island, 1 week on Oahu, and our last week on Kauai.  While in Kauai we too the Air Ventures flight and it was worth every penny we paid and compared to the helicopter tours it was much cheaper and we were able to spend more time near the various points that we flew over. Great for taking photos and video.  
Gary and Dian

My family and I took the air tour of Kauai with Air Ventures.  They were so accommodating.  I have a slight claustrophobia and needed to sit in the front of the airplane.  They were so nice to adjust their schedules and have my family fly at a time when I could be in the front.  They were patient and really worked with us.  The staff was so personable.  The flight was amazing and the scenery spectacular.  I highly recommend Air Ventures to anyone.  It's the best way to see Kauai!!

When on Kauai, treat yourself to Air  Venture's one hour flight tour of this island paradise.    The one hour flight offers you perhaps the best way to appreciate this Island's rugged coasts and amazing semi-tropical interior.   And much of the Island is inaccessible to visitors otherwise.  Even better, the staff are friendly and helpful, while our pilot, Joel, made the trip memorable with his relaxed and informative commentary delivered with his quiet sense of humor.  All in all, take the time, no, make the time to explore the Island via Air Ventures.  Too all the staff, Mahalo!

review_title: A must see at least once in a lifetime!
review_text:
We loved this "little" trip. Nothing like seeing it all from above. Looking at the Na Pali coast and Waimea canyon was breathtaking. 
Air Ventures has organized, friendly, and very helpful staff. We felt well taken care of from the first phone call we made to reserve the spot on the plane. Pilot was very informative while flying us above the paradise in flawless fashion.

review_title: Experience the beauty of Kaua'i with an Air Ventures Hawaii Tour!
review_text: We took the 70 minute Air Ventures Hawaii tour with our 12-year old daughter and her best friend.  It was an excellent tour...well narrated, providing cultural and geographical insights of the island...very educational.  The girls' favorite sites were the waterfalls that appeared in the movie "Jurassic Park" and the television show "Fantasy Island".  The aerial view of the Na Pali Coast was breathtaking.  It provided a whole new dimension when compared to seeing it from the water.  We would highly recommend  taking a camera on the tour for those special interest sites you will encounter.  This was one of the best tours that we experienced during our vacation on Kaua'i.  Well worth the money!

My daughter, granddaughter and I had a spectacular flight over the island of Kauai. The scenery was unbelievable, and our pilot was so friendly and gave us such an interesting commentary of the landscape below. I have not taken any other flights, helicopter or airplane, so don't have anything to compare it with, but we all three thought it was wonderful. The one-hour flight was perfect.

This island has so much to see but a land tour would not do it justice as time would be against you paricularly if you are from a cruise.This air tour wraps at least three/four ships tours into one with views that land access would not allow.
Pick up can be agreed, when booking, at the shopping area having been dropped off by the ships free shuttle service. The pre-flight chat is brief and you are introduced to your pilot, photos taken by the plane and given your seat in the six seater aircraft. Each person will get a great view of all on offer with pilot commentry.A DVD of your trip is given out at the end.If you can splash out on one tour this is it.

Our group of 4 could not decide between a helicopter tour or airplane tour and based on the fact that one of us refused to go on a helicopter we opted for Air Ventures with pilot Harry!!  We are so glad we did.  We had a wonderful time and saw parts of the island we would not have seen had it not been for Harry!  The girls at the reception desk were very personable and did not say your weight out loud!!  We were a bit leary as the weather had been quite rainy but once in the air the sun shone and birghtened our trip even more.  We saw hundreds of waterfalls.  Thank you Harry and staff, great value for our dollars.  We will do it again.

review_title: best money we spent on any tour
review_text: Equipment was first rate. Kevin was very knowlegable. .The scenery was awesome.No long lines.Easy access to aircraft.The best money we spent on any tour.Thanks for a great ride.    Jerry & Reba  Stockburger 10/05 2010

If you are trying to decide helicopter or airplane tour. I have to express the Air Ventures flight we recently took in Kauai was amazing. The views from the plane were undescrible. I was amazed that the air ride was very smooth and I would not have ever thought that we were sitting in a 6 passanger plane. The pilot was very informative and gave a great narrative along the way. The seat were comfortable and large windwos for everyone to view. They actually picked us not far from the ship docking and rode us to the airport area. The ride was an hour long and you will never take your eyes from the views for a minute. I am so happy we decide on the airplane vs helicopter. 
Thank you Air Ventures for making our 25th anniversary more memorable with an amazing flight in Kauai. 
Mahalo,
The Michel's
Guy & Monica
St. Amant, La

review_title: The Only Way to See Kauai - Get the most value for your money!
review_text:
Air Ventures your one hour airplane ride literally made my Hawaii vacation perfect.  I was so pleased that I selected the Big Kahuna Air Tour.  In this tour you get an up close look at the beautiful splendor of Kauai.

The staff at Air Ventures were top rate, they ensured that we were comfortable before our take off.  Our pilot Joel, was outstanding!  His take off and landing was enough to convince me that I wanted him as my commercial pilot to take me back to Tennessee.

As a cruise tourist, I was disappointed at what my cruise shore excursion offered.  I decided to venture out on my own and found Air Ventures and all the wonderful reviews they have received.  The cost was a fraction of what I would pay for a cruise shore excursion, and in comparing notes with other cruise travelers my flight with Air Ventures delivered so much more than what they received.

For anyone who is looking to get the best value for their money write down the name Air Ventures.  Be sure to ask for Joel, I'm sure that you will agree he is one of the best pilots that you will find in the business.  

Air Ventures thank you for making my first trip to Kauai such a memorable one.  You truly were a highlight of my Hawaiian vacation!

We were a bit skeptical that this excursion would live up to our expectations but it
did and more.  The sights were fantastic, the pilot was fun and knew his "stuff" and
the driver that took us from place to place was very nice, always on time and was a 
major part of the company.  The trip to the Fern Grotto was very scenic and the entertainment was fun.  Well worth our time and money!

review_title: Great way to see Kauai by Air
review_text: The flight was great, had a good view and went completely around Kauai.  There is no weight limit like Helicopters and each passenger has a window seat too.  Pilot was good at explaining what you were seeing and turned the plane at places where someone on the other side might not have as good of a view so all could see.  The ride was very smooth and the checkin was very smooth.  Really good deal since quite a bit less expensive than a helicopter flight.

We recently took a cruise out of Honolulu that included ports in Kauai, Hi where we took an air tour of the island with Air Ventures.  It was in a word AMAZING!!!  We went everywhere that the more expensive helicopters go and saw all the same sights.  The staff at Air Ventures were very nice and our pilot was very informative.   Everyone had there own window seat and fantastic views of all the sights.  I highly recommend that if you are going to visit the island of Kauai that you take the time to tour with Air Ventures, you wont regret it!!!

We also did the combo tour with Air Ventures which included a river trip to the Fern Grotto, it was a very pleasant trip and well worth the cost.

My husband and myself had the privilege of flying with Air Ventures.  Our pilot was very informative and a great pilot.  We were able to see some very beautiful country during our flight that we would not have seen other wise.  We would highly recommend  to see the island from the air.

Susan

review_title: Best Air Tour Bang for the Buck!
review_text: Had the pleasure of flying with Air Venture Hawaii in June of 2010.  My wife, son, and myself spent a wonderful hour in the air seeing all that Kauai had to offer.  The Grand Canyon of the Pacific, the rugged Kauai coast line, beautiful beaches, waterfalls, mountains, cliffs....all laid out below us to view!  Large windows and a wing-over aircraft made everything easy to see, photograph, and video.  Our pilot was eager to make multiple passes of various areas so that folks on both sides of the aircraft were able to get maximum visibility for all passengers.  Keep in mind that this is a small aircraft, although very spacious inside. Kauai's trade winds may make this flight somewhat uncomfortable for those used to the "I'm sitting at home in my living room" feeling in today's larger modern jet aircraft.  For the rest of us, the flight is a true "air venture"!

review_title: The Best way to see the island of Kauai!
review_text: As first time visitors to Kauai, my wife and I wanted to see as much of the island as we could. The staff and crew with Air Ventures made our experience so comfortable and relaxed, and at the same time so exciting. Our pilot effortlessly flew all of the sites from multiple approach directions to provide everyone on board the best views. The large windows in the plane allowed us to capture some fantastic pictures. I highly recommend this Air Tour and Air Ventures to anyone that visits Kauai.
Very Nice Pilot!  Good service and gorgeous scenery from the air in Hawaii.  Thanks Air Ventures!

review_title: great way to learn about and see the whole island, very informative and enjoyable
review_text:
The staff was pleasant and informative.   We took the flight our first day on Kauai, this helped make decisions on what we wanted to do the rest of our stay on the island.
   You get to see parts of the island that you would not get to enjoy any other way,  The waterfalls and rainbows, not to mention the landscapes, are amazing from the air.  By using the plane, you seem to be floating over the island, at times you could not even tell that you were moving!

We went on the 1 hour Big Kahuna tour of the island. The ride was very smooth. The plane is really small - it can hold 6 people plus the pilot. My husband got to ride in the cock-pit  (co-pilot seat). Take-off and landing were very smooth and the flight itself was not that bumpy. We got to see just about all of the island and it was beautiful. We got some great pictures of some places you just can't get to by car or by foot. We have never done the helicopter tour so I can't compare. From our experience this was a fantastic tour and not too expensive (we booked a combo tour along with Holo Holo charters and got a special rate for doing both the air tour and the sunset boat cruise to Napali coast).

We decided to use Air Ventures as they were much more inexpensive then the helicoptor tours. You get what you pay for - you can tell the helicoptors are able to get much closer to the beaches and waterfalls then the Air Venture plane can. It was also a little bumpy the day we flew up so that made me feel a little uneasy.  I'd say if you want a nice air tour over the island at a low price this is the way to go. But if you're looking for something that gets a little more up close and personal and don't mind spending the extra money then the helicoptor tour would be a better bet.

We were lucky enough to pick one of the best days to go.  The weather was perfect.  We saw the whole island from above.  We saw places we would never known were on the island.  The plane ride was so smooth and calm.  We had a great time.

review_title: Flying over Kuaui is the best way to get an awesome view of the island.
review_text: We flew with Air Ventures on our first full day in Kuaui and loved it.  Our pilot pointed out all of the beaches we wanted to visit, along with talking about the farming - past and current.  Flying over the ocean on the NaPali coast was spectacular to say the least.  The weather did not permit us seeing Jurrassic Falls, but everthing else was covered. The Waimea canyon was gorgeous even with some cloud cover.  The plane flew slow enough that we were able to get some great pictures.

review_title: It was the best and I would do it all over again given the opportunity.
review_text: It was as promised to be quiet and beautiful. The sights just can't be seen any other way. I loved the fact that the seats in the plane gave each individual a window seat.

We have done the helicopter rides, and they are fun, but the tour of Kauai in the WACO Biplane was Fantastic!!!

My wife and I flew with pilot Kevin Britt on a 1 hour flight from Lihue, Kauai, Hawaii. Two people sit in the front seat. You have cloth helmet, earphones, mic, and goggles (if you want to use them).  It is not cold at all so wear shorts. It is not noisy with the earphones on. Bring a camera with a wrist strap. No strap, can't use camera. I almost lost mine when I put the camera in the slipstream.

We wanted to do an air tour, but didn't feel like spending the big bucks on a helicopter ride.
We decided on Air Ventures, not only for price, but liked the idea of an airplane that uses less fuel, so less carbon footprint. The pilot was great and we saw most everything a helicopter would. We probably didn't get as close to mountain sides as a helicopter would but that didn't bother us.
Jerry
Kenosha, WI

My husband and I wanted to do an air tour of Kauai and since we are bigger people we didn't want to pay the extra fees that a helicopter tour would charge.  I looked into other options and found  Air Ventures and saw they didn't have a weight charge and it was cheaper than a regular helicopter ride.  Plus the reviews were very promising.  Anyway, the tour was wonderful!   There was another couple and their child on our tour and they were in front and hubby and I were towards the back and everyone got a window.  And the windows were washed before our tour.  The pilot gave a great tour giving information but not totally yapping in our ear, the flight was for the most part smooth, we got a few clouds on the Na Pali coast.  The views were great and I got a lot of great photos.  This tour was a highlight of our trip to Kauai and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this to anyone.

review_title: Great air tour--not to be missed
review_text: Went to Kauai in mid May 2010 on our honeymoon.  AV came highly recommended by our resort, and we were not disappointed.  The plane was new, roomy by small plane standards and everyone has a window view.  This is really important.  Our pilot was great and very informed, and this French airplane can fly really slow-- a real plus on a tour, and we avoided the noise and middle-seat seating of a helicopter. Very reasonable, and you see all the sights you can't see by land.  Staff was great; all-in-all, A++ experience.

This was one of the highlights of our vacation in Kaua and was a wonderful way for us to tour the island by air. The pilot, Harry, was very helpful and knowledgeable and explained many interesting facts about what we were seeing.  There are great views from every window.  The plane flies at low speed and is very stable and comfortable.  The tour took one hour and covered all of the major sites on the island including the Na Pali Coast, the Waimea Canyon and many beautiful waterfalls.  If you are nervous about flying,as I was,  this is a perfect way to see the island by air.

review_title: Birds Eye view of Kauai - well worth seeing
review_text: While 3 of the 6 of us did get motion sickness it was the # 1 attraction for those who didn't. While a little surprised at the noise level, I was awed at the majestic view. Everything looked like a painting. The island is just God's artwork and beauty. You get a new perspective from the air and I am glad we did it.

review_title: Great way to see the island
review_text: We took the early p.m. flight.  Very easy access at the airport.  Big Kahuna flight takes you on hour-long clockwise tour of island.  Sit upfront and on the right side of plane.  Other seats do not have as good views.  Headphones allow pilot to give information, and you have microphone to ask the pilot questions.  There is no background music, and you will hear other ground to plane and plane to plane chatter on your headphones.  Of course, the plane does not hover or land anywhere like some helicopter trips, but here is the payback--it costs $100 less per person than the helicopters.  The weather was good for our flight, which made things more enjoyable.  Very good, safe operation.

review_title: Air Ventures, Lihue,  HI is great!
review_text: Fabulous tour.  Ingrid checked us through and she was just oozing with genuine Aloha spirit.  Couldn't have been nicer!  The tour was out-of-this world - much better than a helicopter tour.  I could go on and on but let it suffice to say that the pilot, Joel, and the entire trip was the best !!

Air Ventures is definitely a plus for the air tour industry. This aerial operation is very professionally run and operated, from the check-in procedure at the airport, to the careful preparation  of the aircraft and, most importantly, to the professional job of the pilot. I am a retired airline captain with many years of flying experience and can verify the captain of this sight-seeing flight operated the aircraft with the utmost diligence and safety. Being able to listen in on all air traffic control radio communications between Lihue tower and other aircraft and helicopters within the busy airspace while away from the airport gave me a up and close and personal view of how he operated.  "Thumbs up" all around for this operation.
Great views of all island areas with excellent commentary. We have made seven visits to Kauai and this is the first time we have availed ourselves of this great adventure. Will do it again on next visit.

Six passenger plane ride that provided breathtaking views of the entire island of Kuaui. The views of the NaPali coastline and the interior of the island can't be duplicated by other means.  Bring a camera, sit back and listen to the commentary provided by the pilot and enjoy the view.  This ride was definitely worth the price.

we were in Kauai this month and took an hour ride with an small airplane . We were scare at the beginning but after we met the pilot we felt secure and well taken care of ! The ride was very confortable and enjoyable 1We were able to take many pictures and followed the explanations well ! Go if you have the opportunity !

We did the package of Air Ventures and the Holo-Holo Catamaran Sun Set Dinner Cruise.  What a beautiful trip in a small airplane over Kauai.  We had an awesome time and took many photos from our own window.  Very comfortable.  We had done the helicopter rides previous years and this was even better!  Breathtaking views.  We would recommend this trip !

Had a Maui helicopter tour which can't compare with the quiet, slow moving Kauai AirVentures airplane tour!  Was pleased with the package of AirVentures and the Holo-Holo Catamaran Sun Set Dinner Cruise.  A GREAT way to see the island from sky and sea!!

review_title: Air Ventures tour of Kauai was breathtakingly awesome
review_text: Amazing Aircraft, wonderful and knowledgeable pilot and of course seeing kauai from the air was fabulous.  i would recommend seeing Kauai from the air to get an overall view of the island.  Our trip was absolutely amazing.  The new aircraft allowed us to fly at slower speeds and really take in the sites.  We flew right into one of the volcanic craters and back out (or course).  The Na Pali coast was WOW!!!.  There are parts of the island tht you can only see by air or from the water.  Again, I recommend the air tour.

Just got back from a fixed wing flight over Kauai and couldn't say enough about it.  The staff and pilot were great, the flight was very stable and the pilot told us about places we flew over.  Saw a whole rainbow.  The Na Pali coast was spectacular, even more so than by boat.  Can highly recommend of Air Ventures which flies out of Lihue.  Margot

Very nice flight - very capable pilot who knew the area well.

I got some great pictures on the flight

The air van is roomy and the big windows make piture taking easy.  The views are awesome only takes an hour but no other way to see the entire island.   The canyon and the waterfalls are spectacular.  My favorite was the coffee plantation.  A litle turbulance- so be prepared.  Hghlight of my trip!

review_title: This was a wonderful view of Kauai.
review_text: I was really excited to have been able to see Kauai from the sky.  I learned a lot of info from the guided road tour.  This helped to put all in perspective.  Thank you for the experience.

This was a wonderful tour of Kauai with Air Ventures. The Air Ventures staff was great; Donna was just great - such a great sense of humor and a wonderful laugh!!! The pilot was great - very knowledgable and he made you feel comfortable and secure. We saw all of the beautiful sites: the Waimea Canyon, waterfalls, Napi Coast line, beaches, etc. It was just beautiful!! I would highly recommend Air Ventures.

review_title: We saw the most amazing views of Kauai from an Air Ventures plane.
review_text: Our group of four thoroughly enjoyed our Air Ventures experience on June 1, 2010. A representative of the company came to our friends' timeshare excursion orientation and booked us for the same day. The plane seats up to six passengers, but as we were the only people signed up for our time slot, we had a private tour! There's no middle row, so all of us had window seats. Our pilot Joel was easygoing and informative, and took us smoothly around the periphery of Kauai (spectacular coastline, including the majestic Napali), and over the interior (Waimea Canyon, Wailua Falls). Donna at the airport office oozed warmth and enthusiasm. One of our friends said she enjoyed this experience much more than a helicopter ride over Maui several years ago that had made her sick. The spectacular sights from the air are unforgettable.

review_title: Air Ventures Recreated the island of Kauai for me!
review_text: After approximately 3 years of living on Kauai, I finally had the opportunity to take an air tour of the island and I was blown away. I had no idea the image of this island in my head was so far off from what it really looks like from the air. The pilot, Harry, was perfect! He knew what he was talking about and made it seem like we were out with a friend who happened to be a pilot. He was great. I highly recommend Air Ventures!
this was an amazing experience that im glad i was able to do

review_title: The best way to fully appreciate the splendour of Kauai
review_text: Great trip. Possibility of turbulence, so if you are nervous or prone to motion sickness, take a pill before taking off. Our trip went clockwise around the island, so the best views were on the right hand side of the plane. However, where you sit is not under your control. All seats are window seats and give great views. Plane takes max. 6 people.
I had no idea how beautiful Kauai was until we went on this tour. The staff was very friendly and helpful.

I don't know why this tour is #2 on activities. Not sure who is writing these reviews. Do yourself a favor and spend the extra money on a helicopter tour. Air Ventures  gave us headphones and we couldn't hear what the pilot was saying because he was cutting out and you can hear other people talking at the same time. When you take this plane you are FAR FAR above the helicopters and hardly can see the water falls. Both me and my husband felt sick the entire tour because of the motion (which might be the same with a helicopter tour). Extremely disappointed with this tour, I was led to believe from all the stellar reviews that this tour would be good.

I recently booked and experienced  the 1 hour  Big Kahuna Tour  with Air Ventures. Which was an aerial tour which went around the island of Kauai.  Upon my arrival to Air Ventures I found the check in to be very smooth and efficient. The check in staff were very friendly and and helpful. Next it was off to boarding the aircraft.  As I entered the aircraft I was first very impressed with the cleanliness of its cabin. For a 7 passenger aircraft I found it to be very spacious and accomodating.  I also really liked that there isnt a bad seat in the house with its multiple windows on board.  The Captain of our aircraft was also really friendly and very knowledgeable of the different sights and areas of Kauai.  In my own personal opinion the highlight of my tour was the breath taking aerial views of the Napali Coast.  If booking this tour be sure to have lots of film, there are  some views that are definitely worth saving.  I still look back at pictures I had taken on my Air Venture tour and still cant believe that I actually saw it with my own eyes.  I really enjoyed myself on this activity and would highly recommend this tour to anyone and everyone who would love to see the beauty of Kauai from a whole new perspective.  I also took notice of families that had booked this tour, and saw how excited the children were to be able to fly in what almost seemed to be their own personal airplane. Aloha!

What a gorgeous tour of Kauai by air!  We enjoyed seeing the beautiful ocean, beaches and numerous waterfalls by air...breathtaking views!  Although the small plane was a little turbulent at times the pilot narration during the trip made your mind wander into the scenery.  Definetely worth the cost of the one hour flight as we wouldnt have wanted to see beautiful Kauai any other way..thank you Air Ventures!
Small plane with great visability for picture takiing. They fly the entire Island and narrate the sites. Discounts on their web site www.airadventureshawaii.com and from your hotel

We decided to fly with Air Ventures instead of a helicopter trip.  We were glad we did.  The staff was very personable.  The plane was very comfortable and each of us could see on each side of the plane.  Each of us had a window seat.  The pilot gave us just enough info to inform us about the island and was not too chatty. He was a good pilot too.  The day was perfect to fly.  Several rainbows were seen.  We were glad we took this flight the first day of our vacation so that we could appreciate the island better and see the 80% that most people do not see when then stay on the island highways. It was well worth the cost. Don't hesitate.  Go for it!

The Air Ventures Experience was great.  You can not go to Hawaii without taking an aerial view of this beautiful island.   The Air venture staff was professional and courtesy.  The ride was great and each passenger had a window view of the mountains, waterfalls and beaches of picturesque Kauai. I highly recommend this company and this activity.

We did the package for air and sea for $189 and it was Amazing!!!  I don't think there is a better deal out there.  The tour guides on both of the tours were very informative.  I felt that the hour up in the air was more than enough time to see just about all of Kauai and you can snap some wonderful pictures.  They advise you to not wear bright clothes.  Take heed to their advise.  Your pictures won't come out the way you want them to if you do.  I would definately recommend  these tours to friends and family.  As a matter of fact, I already have.  Thanks again Air Ventures!!!!!!

We were impressed with the friendly service and great experience.  The aircraft was satble and very photo friendly.  Every seat had a view.  We combined the air with the holo-holo dinner cruise and saved even more.  Both are winners and we highly recommend BOTH of these companies!

Mahalo!

Air Ventures conducts a one hour flight in superb fixed wing aircraft well designed for providing the best view of Kaua'is outstanding natural beauty from the air.  The tour is ably narrated by the plane's pilots and is the perfect complement to boat and overland tours.  I would recommend it to everyone.
Great experience, Knowledgeable and skilled pilot. A must. Do first thing when you get to Kauai. You will have a better idea to how to maximize your trip.

My boyfriend and I traveled to Kauai in April 2010 for a week long vacation.  A trip there wouldn't have been complete without an aerial tour of the island (best way to see the island as a large majority is inaccessible by foot/car).  We looked into helicopter tours first (the popular way to go).  But there were expensive $(250-300), you aren't guaranteed a window seat (why even go??) and some companies I talked to weren't even guaranteed departure if they didn't have enough people to sign up.   I also had received a flyer for Air Ventures so I decided to check it out.  The price was great and it was easy to book so we decided to go with them.  The tour was amazing!  We were able to see much of the island and the highlighted features by air including Wailua Falls, Na Pail Coast, Waimea Canyon, valleys, rivers and waterfalls.  The tour was about an hour long.

The plane was clean, comfortable and not too loud.  We were given headphones to block the noise and to communicate/ask questions to the pilot.  The plane doesn't get as close to all the sites like a helicopter can but we were OK with that (especially after hearing about helicopter crashes there in the past).  We still were able to take great pics and still be amazed by the beauty of Kauai.  An aerial tour is a must when you go to Kauai and I recommend going through Air Ventures!!

review_title: I'll fly with Air Ventures ANYTIME!!!
review_text: From the beginning the professionalism and friendliness of the staff was indicative of a great service to come.  The team was very proactive and the tour was a blast, though I'm afraid of heights, this was a very comfortable and smooth flight.....it was the highlight of our trip....thanks Air Ventures...
