Beautiful sights to behold!

review_title: The most amazing airial experience and views in my life
review_text: The plane was very comfortable and all seats could see really well. I have been on other trips in my life and because of my size I get stuck in the middle seat with no view. All these seats are WINDOW seats. Absolutely fantastic. The air got rough, but the pilot handled the plane in expert fashion. I would do this again in a heartbeat and recommend this company and the pilots.

review_title: Great Day over Kauai - Very entertaining and service was perfect
review_text: Well Worth the cost.  - Wear Dark colors so your reflections will not effect your pictures.

review_title: Great way of seeing the Island
review_text: My husband and I had a great time seeing the island.  The weather is great, a little hazey today but still a great way to see the Island.  Our pilot Harry was excellent.

We were very happy with our Airvan tour with Air Vantures on Kaua'i.  The wind was high on the day of our flight and we were so happy to be in a plane and not a helicopter.  OUr pilot was very knowledgeable and did a great job keeping the ride as smooth as possible, as well as providing a good tour.  This is the best way to see the beautiful Garden Isle.

My family and I had the pleasure of flying around the Island of Kauai with AirVentures Hawaii!  With Harry as our tour guide we saw the Island, from a birds eye view, on the first day of our Hawaiian Vacation.  It helped in determining the rest of our itinerary for the week.
Thanks AirVentures!
The scenery of Kauai was great seen up close from an airplane. The staff was friendly and helpful. Many thanks for the experience.

Great  views, vistas, spectacular  cliffs, shoreline, caves, waterfalls, canyons, whales (some were spotted while on our flight), very informative narrative from the pilot, very smooth comfortable ride.

review_title: Greatest way to see the island of Kauai
review_text: The heart of any business is the people.  The folks at Air Ventures on Kauai were great, extremely friendly, and made you feel good about being with them.  The flight was great but we knew it would be because we were repeat customers.  Their aircraft is a wonderful way to see the island.  It is very stable, comfortable, and has very large windows for all passengers.

review_title: A perfect tour even in less-than-perfect weather!
review_text: We took the "Big Kahuna" 1 hour tour in April 2010 and enjoyed it tremendously.  The weather was overcast that day and I was worried that we wouldn't be able to see much, but the clouds only made the sights more dramatic.  The plane was very comfortable and everyone has their own window.  I was able to take some great pictures.  Our pilot, Joel, was very knowledgeable about Kauai and made a point of flying around the major sights so that we could all see from both sides of the plane.  The volcano formations can only really be appreciated from the air -- well worth the price!

review_title: Good Value,Wonderful View,We would go again
review_text:
Beautiful new aircraft. Large windows for good photos and view. Sound system excellent.
We could communicate directly with the pilot. Comfortable and clear earphones. Plane flew nice and slow and pilot was good about making sure passengers on each side got a good view. Naration was good. I have taken other senic flights and this was the best so far. Thank you Air Ventures.

My wife and I took the Air Ventures one hour flight over Kauai yesterday and it was fantastic.  The pilot was very pleasant and knowledgable about the islands and was open to questions and comments from the passengers.    I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS EXPERIENCE.

Took a 1 hr flight around island of Kauai around noon with 4 other family members during our stay on 4/14/2010. So glad we decided to do this as a family. Saw so many waterfalls and,of course, the "Grand Canyon of the Pacific", plus other areas that are not accessible by car. Staff was friendly, courteous and enthusiastic. Donna was born and raised in Kauai and you could see she was definitely proud of her little island. Plane was quieter than expected, and we were all able to converse with each other during the flight! Landing was sooooo smooth. I would do this again!!

review_title: Fantastic scenery that few others will ever see.
review_text:
With a party of four, it is hard to find a helicopter that will take everyone.  Even if you could find one, someone is getting stuck in the middle.  On Air Ventures, everyone gets a window seat.  The video footage and pictures that I got were amazing.  The plane flies slow and at a lower altitude which means that you can see everything really well.  

Another reason that I loved Air Ventures is that I am a retired Rugby Player.  As one of those guys that you may have seen in the scrum, I am a big guy.  The helicopter companies want you to buy an extra seat if you weigh over 250lbs and I weigh over 250lbs.  With the airplanes that Air Ventures fly, that's no problem at all.  

Our pilot was Captain Joel.  Joel provided us with a great experience as he narrated the adventure. He was informative, good natured and right down funny at times.  The hospitality that we enjoyed was top drawer as was the experience.  

I highly recommend the experience - IT WAS FANTASTIC!

review_title: Air Ventures gave us a wonderful, professional, informative and safe air tour of the island of Kauai.
review_text:
Check for bad weather before leaving for the airport.  We booked this in combination with Best of Kauai Tours. This resulted in significant savings. We really enjoyed a full day of activities with lots of variety.
It was very exciting to be able to see the hanging valleys and crater up close.

review_title: well worth the cost   $ 140.00 person 60 minute flight
review_text: we did the helicopter tour over the big island and it was great fun. we looked into the helicopter tours on kauai  but decided they were all too expensive (200-400 dollars). for something different we decided to try to air tour. VERY VERY happy with our tour/flight. compared to the copter, the plane was much roomier and quiet. we were a bit worried because of the clouds and rain (kauai duhh) but once we took off it didnt seem to matter. we had amazing views of the island, the na pali coastline and cliffs, whales in the water and more waterfalls then we could count.  the pilot was friendly and informative without being overbearing.  feel free to youtube search for my (and others Im sure) videos of this fun flight.

review_title: Just the right fit for a flight
review_text:
The up side to using Air Ventures is the fact that we could take the whole family, I tried to book a helicopter flight but they would only take 4 people and with our family of 5 we would have had to leave some one home. 
Upside: Our pilot was great and being that I did my home work, he was very nice to show us the places I had asked about. He had lots of interesting facts about the island. The best part of the flight was the views. In the one hour flight, we saw 40 or more waterfalls. The best perk is booking on line. We got a free calendar and a DVD of our flight, we couldn’t have asked for a nicer staff they addressed everyone by first name, it was very personal. 

Downside: It was the most expensive nap we've every paid for, for the kids. Both of them fell asleep 20 minutes into the flight.

Kauai is a gorgeous Island to see! The customer service here, was a one of a kind experience. Donna was the best customer service rep I have ever dealt with in all my traveling experience. She definately knows the meaning of Aloha. I recommend this a must do activity. Not to mention there were amongst the cheapest.

review_title: An absolute must for anyone visiting Kaua'i
review_text:
Booked this trip spontaneously via our resort and WOW!!  From the moment we arrived we had A+ service from the reception right through to the plane.  Our pilot was very friendly and knowledgeable and took the time to explain the sights and allow us all time for photos.

The plane itself was very spacious and the ride was smooth.  This was the best experience I had in my ten days visiting the island.  There is no better was to see all the sites.

Money well spent!!

review_title: My favorite place on earth is Kauai, Hawaii
review_text: I took a trip on AriVentures in Kauai on Jan 13/10 and it was so awesome to see the island from the sky. It took my breath away. The views and sights from the the sky were just so wonderful. The pilot was very informative as we flew and take off was just a breeze. Everyone on board even had their own window! My pictures turned out great!!! We flew for almost a whole hour. We went all the way around and over the island of Kauai!!! Landing was also a breeze. The staff there are very helpful and kind. Thank-you to all the staff at AirVentures Hawaii !!!

review_title: Air Ventures is an amazing hour of great views
review_text:
My wife and I enjoyed Air Ventures. It was fantastic with an amazing view. The plane goes all around the Island in a flight space just above the helicopters. A couple of helicopters passed below us.
You get a headphone and you can communicate with others easily while in flight. I took a lot of great pictures. 
There aren't many words that can tell you about the Air Ventures experience. Beautiful, Fun, exciting, are a few of the words to describe this attraction. 
Everyone was nice and customer oriented.
I recommend Air Ventures to any one going to Hawaii. You won't be disappointed.

The most beautiful flight ever! Got to see some of the sights never seen or accessible from the ground or on most helicopter tours. Pilot was very informative and really knew the island. Couldn't have  had a better day for sightseeing; we even got to see Mt. Waialeale clearly. In 17 years of coming to Kauai, this the first time to actually observe the mountain and the Alakai swamps. And the Napali coast was just spectacular; one gets a different perspective from the air - stupendous!!!

review_title: If you haven't seen the island of Kauai from the air, you haven't seen it and will never know the awesome beauty you mty
review_text: My Mother & I went on the airvan adventure tour of Kauai island and it was spectacular. We each had our own window seat from which we had an excellent and clear view of the awesome scenery below. Our pilot made sure the windows were sparkling clean before departure, and proved to be a professional, friendly, and skilled pilot, as well as, a great tour guide! He pointed out and talked about all the important valleys, canyons, rivers, and falls. It reminded me of the Grand Canyon, except a lot greener! We even saw a mother whale and her baby down in the ocean! The sheer magnitude of the ancient hills cannot be conceived by simply driving around the island in a car. The Air Venture flight was quiet and smooth, except for some minor turbulance, which the pilot explained and handled extremely well. Bottom line: Go on this flight, you will be so glad that you did!

review_title: A Great Way to See Kauai
review_text: We took a great flight over the island of Kauai in an Air Ventures small single prop plane.  The plane was comfortable with big seats, easy visibility out of both sides and the flight was slow enough that we were able to see everything and pick out many of the well-known landmarks.  Our pilot, Joel, did a wonderful job explaining the sights as well as flying a smooth, relaxing trip around the island.  We definitely recommend touring the skies of Kauai on an Air Ventures’ flight.

My friend and I took an aerial tour of Kauai, HI with Air Ventures Hawaii. It was a new 6 seater plane with individual windows for each passenger. We got stunning views of the island and waimea canyons, and lots of great photos and videos! 

I would recommend this over a helicopter tour since this fixed plane tour does not have the vibrations associated with a helicopter tour- which affects your photographs and videos. Its also considerably less expensive than a helicopter tour. Its a smooth flight and you have your own headset and microphone to communicate with the pilot, who provides an informative commentary of the sights he's taking you across.

review_title: Awesome flight - incredible views of paradise
review_text:
We took advantage of a web deal at www.AirVenturesHawaii.com that enabled us to take a 1 hour plane ride that was amazing and spectacular, then a 4 1/2 hour sunset boat tour along the Napali Coast with HoloHolo charters, that was incredible.  What a way to see the island.  If the deal is still happening, we'd highly recommend it.  

The plane was clean and quiet and everyone had a great view.  Our pilot was great and shared a lot of info that we all enjoyed.  So glad we did this and would do it again.

We went on the one hour tour on Kauai.  Very nice and the staff was wonderful.  Although if you tend to get motion sickness take something bigger than those tiny bags like on the airlines =)  We would reccommend it to anyone wanting to see more of the island.  It was awesome.

review_title: One hour plane trip over Kauai.
review_text: We took a one hour plane trip that circled the island of Kauai in Hawaii.  The weather was clear and the views were very nice.  The view of the coastline was very nice, especially the Napali coastline.  We saw some dolphins and whales while we were over the northern part of Kauai.  Each passenger had a  window seat, so everyone had a good view from the plane.  I think the plane trip is nicer than the helicopter ride we had taken when we last visited Kauai.

Air Ventures' tour of Kauai was spectacular and well worth the price.  The staff was courteous and friendly, which made the tour even more enjoyable.  Kauai really is the "Garden Isle" on the ground and in the air.  Enjoy!!

Just finish a great air tour over beautiful Kauai today with Air Ventures Kauai. The flight lasted an hour and during that hour, Harry the pilot showed us every canyon, waterfall, field, and beach that could be seen from the air. The flight was smooth, quiet, and just at the right pace to get pictures and video of just about the whole island. I highly recommend this tour for anyone that wants to see areas of Kauai that can't be seen by car but for a lot less than a helocopter ride.

first of all it was evident by the conference between the pilot and ground personal concerning where passengers sat that safety was prime.  the full overview of the island can only be appreciated from the view above.  the pilot was informative and all areas of island formation (seashore, the volcano crater and mountains) were viewed.  it was a very worthwhile experience

Excellent tour!!  After calling for info the owner picked us up at our cruise ship and took us to the airport, only a few minutes from dock.  The pilot was friendly and knowledgeable and provided an excellent tour in the clean, comfortable, quiet plane.  there was excellent visability and good photo opportunities.  Definitely the highlight of our Hawaii adventure.

review_title: A great way to see the island of Kauai
review_text: My wife and I and another couple recently returned from a week on Kauai, Hawaii. We took a flight with Air Ventures and enjoyed it very much. It is a great way to see the entire island and its beautiful scenery. We saw everything from waterfalls to a whale and mountains to remote beaches. The ride was smooth, visibility was good and we could communicate directly with our knowledgeable pilot, Harry.

we took the Air Ventures tour in Kauai on Saturday, December 12, '09.  It was superb! The plane has large windows for every seat and the viewing is fantastic.  The pilot was very accomodating and quite knowledgeabe.  I enjoyed every minute of it and it was certainly worth the money.

review_title: Great trip with Air Ventures of Kauai
review_text:
This was one of the highlights of my trip to Kauai, the flight was smooth and the view was fantistic.   Bring camera/video recorder...but don't miss out by just looking through the lense...get the video...then you have it all.
Can't wait to do it again.

My wife and another couple just came back from visiting Kauai, Hawaii and had a wonderful time.  We took the flight over the island on board the six passenger airplane conducted by Air Ventures at the airport in Lihue.  It was a great experience and I would recommend those who want to see the island take this method of flying.  The flight was smooth and slow enough to see everything. The people at Air Ventures are so friendly and accommodating from the moment we arrived until we left them, and no one got sick on the flight.  Our plot Joel Christofferson was informative and very helpful, as was the young woman helping us prepare for the flight and making sure we were secure and able to communicate while in the air.  We had planned to take the helicopter flight but this experience as presented by the  young lady at our time share convinced us to try the airplane and all of us were glad we did, not to mention the great savings we enjoyed.  Bob Bennett

My wife and I love Hawaii.  We usually spend 2 -3 weeks on two islands.  We know all of the islands now and have our favorite places to visit and things to do.  We have taken the plane and helicopter rides which are nice, but for real fun and excitement the biplane is way to see Kauai!  My wife has a fear of heights.  She will not go higher than the third step of a ladder, yet she showed interest in the biplane, so we went on this fantastic tour of the island. I thought she might back out when we got aboard, but she said it was cozy.  The tour was very personalized with the pilot giving excellent dialog during the entire flight.  It was similar to chartering your own boat and crew, except this was our very own biplane and pilot.  The view from the biplane was excellent!  The island of Kauai is a wonderful, diverse island from the flat and arid south, then up the west coast cliffs and the gorgeous Waimea Canyon (Hawaii's Grand Canyon).  If the trip was over it would be a great trip, but we then flew on over the dense jungle and the north and the mountainous volcano region.  This is the wettest area on earth, but was dry in our biplane.  The down the east coast back to the airport.  The pilot then took our photographs in and next to the plane.  I don't recall the particulars about the plane and helicopter rides, but I think we will always remember the biplane trip of Kauai.  I would certainly recommend the biplane trip of Kauai if it was the only thing you did while there.  When I think of Kauai, I think of the jungle chickens and the biplane ride.

Karen and Karl

review_title: The staff at Air Ventures were friendly, professional and very accommodating.
review_text: Eric was a very good pilot as well as very knowledgable guide.  He took our pictures and even gave us ginger chews to help with any motion sickness. The gal that checked us in was very helpful and gave us good tips.  Very enjoyable experience.

I was scared to death to fly - especially in a little plane!!  Our pilot Harry was so kind and he gave us candy!!!  Seriously, his dedication to us having a good flight went far and above (pun intended!) what I was expecting.  He continuously pointed out special spots, which were awesome to see from the air but it also made me forget how scared I was! And what really impressed me was - the whole time he kept looking for whales and/or dolphins.  I'm sure he was looking for himself - first sighting of the year, but I could tell that it would have made him very happy to be able to give us that special gift as well.  The young lady who also helped us was great as well (sorry I didn't get her name).  Go People Go - You Will Be Thrilled!!!

review_title: A Highlight of our vacation,  incredible views.
review_text: My wife and I flew the 1 hour tour today at 11:30. We booked online with no problem. The location was easy to find onsite at Lihue Airport. The staff was very friendly. The plane was comfortable, the flight stable and controlled, and the narrative was wonderful and passengers can converse directly with the pilot via head/microphones. The photo ops alone are worth the price of admission.

review_title: The only way to see the real Kauai!
review_text:
This was our second visit to Kauai, and had not planned on taking any special tours. However, after hearing about Air Ventures and seeing the brochure, we changed our minds, and had some friends join us.  It was incredible!  The pilot was super -- starting the trip by taking our photo in front of the plane (with our own cameras!).   He was very informative, yet didn't talk so much as to distract from the flight.   

Our only negative comment:  that we didn't do this earlier in our trip! If we had, then we'd have known about the 9-hole golf course that only costs $9/day to play! 

We took a helicopter tour the first time we came to Kauai, and can honestly say this was better -- and cheaper!   

Thanks for a memorable trip!!

review_title: Awesome sites in a very smooth ride...
review_text: Awesome sites in a very smooth ride!  Extremely friendly service!  Breathtaking views, especially, the na poli coast!!!  Highly recommend this tour!!!!
We took the Island tour and it was wonderful, informitive and  we got some GREAT pictures. Would recomend this way to see the Island.  The ride was smooth, and comfortable.

Our group was scheduled to see the coast on a boat but we opted to try the plane ride because of the long travel time to the boat dock.  I am so glad we did!  we saw more from the plane than we ever would have on the boat and the pilot was awesome and pointed out all the points of interest.  Great Experience.

review_title: the only way to see the whole island
review_text: We were visiting Kauai with another couple and decided to take the airplane tour.  It was great.  We were the only passengers and we had excellent views from both sides of the plane. Kauai is beautiful and to get a sense of its various vegetation types it is best seen from the air

Last month my husband and I went for our honeymoon to Hawaii and we opted to see beautiful island Kauai by Air. We really got a good deal from Air ventures and Holo Holo (sunset cruise).
Air Ride is a beautiful experience and you get to see Entire Island in one hour. It is a great way to see all corners of Kauai which includes napali coast, Waimen canyon, Hanalei valley waterfalls (Jurassic  park) and miles of coastline.
Beauty of Kauai is soo breathtaking that you want to live there forever.

review_title: Great value and an amazing way to see Kauai
review_text:
Originally, my family and I were going to go on a helicopter tour. We decided to go with Air Ventures for a couple of reasons: 1. It was a lot less expensive and 2. The way the plane is configured, everyone has a great window seat. It also helps that it is a family run operation and the plan is both quiet (loud helicopters really intrude on the locals) and economical on fuel and thus not so hard on the environment.

We found the pilot very friendly and knowledgeable. He answered all of our questions on the flight and took us to places you can't see by car. Despite some poor weather, I really feel like we got our money's worth. The pilot went out of his way to make it a great experience for us.

Für jeden Besucher auf Kauai ist ein Rundflug ein absolutes Muss! Die Insel ist vom Boden aus schon spektakulär, von der Luft aus einfach gigantisch. Insbesondere die Napali Coast ist wahrscheinlich die atemberaubendste Landschaftsformation der Welt. 

Wir haben den großen Rundflug über die gesamte Insel gemacht. Der Pilot war sehr nett und konnte viel über die Insel erzählen. In der Maschine haben 7 Personen (inkl Pilot) Platz und man hat von überall einen herrlichen Ausblick. 

Nachteil eines so kleinen Flugzeugs ist, dass es nichts für Menschen mit einem schwachen Magen ist. Mir war so schlecht wie selten in meinem Leben. Aus diesem Grund würde ich beim nächsten Mal einen Helikopter ausprobieren. Diese Entscheidung, muss aber jeder nach seinen individuellen Einschätzungen vornehmen.

Great experience from friendly booking agent to professional extremely knowledgable pilot.  We have two young girls (4 & 6) and we all got great large window seats with  noise cancelling communications to allow us to talk to each other in comfort in an airconditioned (very welcome in August) spacious cabin.  The ride and view was fantastic and I would recommend this to anyone.  This was significantly cheaper than comparable but shorter helicopter flight I have been on with better viewing (my opinion) and more relaxed atmosphere.

We just landed from our Air Ventures one hour tour of Kauai. My husband and I (both retired professional pilots) have been to Kauai 4 times previously but have never taken the airborne tour. We took four of our family with us today and it was awesome. Our pilot, Joel, was extremely pleasant and well-versed in the geology, folklore, and other features of the island. We saw areas that are inaccessible by car and only visible from the air.  We thought we would be blase, considering our backgrounds, but came away just as awestruck as the first time flyers with us. This is the first day of our vacation and a perfect beginning to the week. It aso helped in getting the lie of the land and, for our son-in-law, picking perfect surfing spots. We definitely recommend this trip to all. The visibility from the G8Airvan is great, we had a very smooth flight, and even saw Mt Waialeale in sunshine. Airventures run a professional operation. They have a perfect safety record, which was very important to us.

review_title: A must for those serious about touring Kauai
review_text:
Many thanks to an excellent flight crew for making this an unforgettable experience. Our skilled pilot ( Harry ), was also great at describing all the sites and their historical background. Michelle, was professional and friendly, taking care of all the preliminary tasks to prepare for the flight.
This flight was very special to me as I am a commercial pilot/aircraft owner/ aerial photographer. I would like to point out some of the advantages of this fixed wing aircraft over helicopters. Most significant is the lower cost to operate the aircraft, sipping only 13 gallons of fuel per hour. Maintenance costs are much lower than helicopters. These reduced costs result in a lower cost to the passengers. That’s not all, this GA-8 Airvan delivers a silky smooth ride with little vibration, as opposed to constant vibration in helicopters, very important for sharp photographs. Every passenger gets a clean bubble window to view through, and these are always kept clean.
This type of aerial tour is the only way to view many of the sites around the island, as many are inaccessible by car, trail, or even boat. 
This aerial tour was a highlight of my stay in Kauai.

review_title: Knowledgeable Pilot, this slow flying plan was fantastic for viewing and picture taking.
review_text: It was awusome ! It was our first time taking an air tour and it was everything we thought it would be! the pictures were great , the plan was comfortable. it was an absolutly beautiful day and the pilot was very knowledgeable! The combination of land and air tour was perfect! We enjoyed seeing the whole island, every seat had great viewing, and the Gentleman that picked us up at our timeshare in Princeville went above and beyond the call of duty,he  knew alot about the island and his stories were enjoyable. We would fly again with this outfit they did a super dupper job!

review_title: Seeing all of Kauai in one hour!!
review_text: We only had 10 hours on Kauai. We took the morning flight in from Honolulu and the evening flight back. Needless to say, we were strapped for time. Like most tourists to Kauai, we drove to Waimea Canyon, Kokee State park, the spouting horn, and a few waterfalls. But, after all the driving and hiking we only had a few hours to spare on the island. What would be the best way to use those last few hours? Kauai Air Ventures tour. The best. We saw the Na Pali Coast (a place only accessible by boat or airplane), DOZENS of waterfalls, the famous rock arch on the beach, and we flew in and out of canyons and as close to the mountains as possible. Basically the tour flew us around the whole island. PLUS, the cost is almost half of what the helicopter tours charge. We felt very safe. And our pilot, who was very knowledgeable, was able to answer nearly all of our questions. He even pinpointed the exact locations of where movies such as 6 Days/7 Nights and Jurassic Park III were filmed! All in all, we felt our money was well spent! We would definitely do the tour again if we had the time.

An amazing experience, I had spent a fews days on the island and it was a perfect end to be able to put everything into perspective! The staff are extremely friendly and professional and provide an amazing unforgettable experience. It was definitely the highlight of my trip to Hawaii and I would love to come back and do it all again!

review_title: Amazing, all encompassing view of Kauai
review_text: In January, my husband and I took an Air Venture airplane ride in Kauai.  We thought it was totally amazing.  We could see clearly from the plane as the pilot turned all directions so we could all see.  The waterfalls, canyons, rugged terrain, trees, etc. were all things we couldn't see any other way except from the air.  It was breathtakingly beautiful.  The trip was well-worth the cost.  Make sure you have disc space/film - mine ran out!

review_title: Got a great overview of the Garden Island
review_text: Just got back from our timeshare vacation on Kauai. Had never done the helicopter thing and wasn't real anxious to be in one either but we love Kauai and had done the cat sunset tour of Napali coast and seen it from the outlooks at Kokee. When I heard about the plane ride I knew it was for me. It was smooth, slow and very relaxing and I felt very safe. It was a wonderfully clear day and not much of the trade winds to be found. Since I was alone I got the co-pilot seat but I think any seat would be good as the windows are BIG and the noise low. Another added value was that it's eco-friendly and I appreciate that. I had a great hour taking pictures and videos of my fantasy island that I can relive any time I want.

My Girlfriend convinced me to go on Air Ventures flight tour,  which I was so freaked out about. It was overcast & I didn't think that would be a good day to go. The Pilot totally decreased my anxiety & made me comfortable. And, I was able to get some gorgeous photos of the water falls & valley, through the overcast & all.  Air Ventures  in Kauai, " You Rock  & thanks for making my 1st private tour enjoyable!"  We were there the 1st week of March - 2009.  Out of the 3 islands we visited, Kauai appeared to be the cleanest too.

review_title: Know the Island immediately on your arrival
review_text: Our first full day in Kauai we booked a one hour flight with Air Ventures air tours to see the island. After a lengthy flight  from Boston, we wanted an easy, but exciting first day . The plane could take 6 passengers so we could all go together. The two way intercom system allowed the pilot to narrate and answer questions as we flew. The plane was  comfortable and everyone had a window seat. We were able to take photos from the air,  get a good perspective of where everything was on the island and spot places we definitely wanted to go see. We saw areas you cannot see by hiking or driving. The only downside is that you might be on the wrong side of the plane to see certain things. If there are two of you sit on opposite sides so you can always get a photo or movie! The island is incredibly beautiful! The views of the canyon and  Napali Coast are breathtaking.

I was skeptical about taking this AirVenture flight because I loved the 2 helicopter flights I had taken on prior trips to Kauai. AirKauai helicopters was no longer in business in May 2009, so my 2 nieces, my wife and I decided to try a plane flight. I can't tell you what a great decision that was! Harry (the pilot) and Donna (the receptionist, window cleaner, and weighmaster) are the absolute most welcoming people you'll ever want to meet. Donna won't call out your weight unless you ask her. Needless to say, only the 2 beautiful lightweight nieces asked (116lbs,112lbs- no wonder they asked. Not bad for a 36 yr old and a 20 year old) I myself (250 something /54 year old) didn't want to know. I do know it was more for all of us before vacation was over. And no, I didn't forget my wife's description but I have to live with her. No internet stats. 
The flight was wonderful. We saw just as much, if not more, from this plane as we did from the helicopter. And my wife wasn't afraid of the plane. She had her eyes closed most of the time on her 1st and only heli ride. Each seat on the plane has a wonderful view as there are no middle seats. I actually got to sit next to the pilot but was well warned not to touch anything. Harry was knowledgeable, funny, and an excellent pilot. No barrel rolls here. I was very relaxed and very impressed with the smoothness of the flight. At 120 mph, you feel as though you're floating. The headsets allow conversation with Harry and the other passengers as well. Because the price is so much cheaper than helicopters, I even tipped them $20.(That's alot from me) Maybe they could buy an expensive overpriced Bubba Burger.
The flight around island was absolutely awesome!  The mountains and coastline are  beautiful.  It is hard to describe.  You just have to go see it for yourself.

review_title: Great flight seeing the Island of Kauai
review_text: Had a great trip seeing the Island of Kauai.  The views were stunning, plane was smooth and very comfortable.  Pilot did a great job identifying key locations and making sure all had a good view of all the great sites.

Our air tour around the Island was great.  Our pilot, Joel pointed out so many points of interest on the island.  Since this was our 5th day, many of the places were places that we had driven to and seen from the ground.  It made everything come together in perspective.  Joel did a wonderful job keeping the plane ride smooth.  (we had a nervous flyer in our group)  This is a tour that I would recommend to everyone.

review_title: Awesome fway to see the Garden Island any day of the year
review_text:
Take one of those rainy, cloudy, & windy March days on Kauai and add Air Ventures Hawaii and you have a wonderful view of the island.  We used a haze filter on our camera and saw some amazing pictures taken through the mists.  We see things our eyes missed.

Your informative and expert pilot covered all the key points on the island and covered some extra areas as well. The whales were hiding among the choppy waves but the rivers & natural ruggedness and beauty of the island won out.  We missed getting your DVD.

We just wanted to thank you for a great trip. 

Mahalo,

review_title: One of the best choices we made on our vacation...
review_text:
While on our vacation is Kauai, we decided to take in a few of the activities offered around the island.  We will never regret our decision to take a flight with Air Ventures.  When they say you have not seen Kauai unless you've seen it by air, they are %100 correct.
It was awesome!  The staff was very polite and very knowledgeable of the history of the island.  I'm glad that we decided on this trip rather than 3-4 seperate outings as we saw it all!  We will be taking this one again when we return to Kauai!  Not to mention the incredible pictures...

the plane was perfect for viewing everyone had a window seat the pilot was terrific.it met and exceeded our expectations and we will recommend it to everyone visiting Kauai.THANKS FOR A GREAT TOUR...........steve&judy partridge

air ventures kauai

we spent a week in kauai, but did not take an air tour until the last day.  WOW!!  we saw more in that hour than we did the whole week.  air ventures is the only way to see the island.

We had a great flight. The pilot was very well informed and knew what he was doing . Everyone involved was wonderful and it was an experience I will never forget.  The pilot even saw a whale and tried to circle it so all could see it.  I really liked that everyone had a window seat.

review_title: Must see: Air Ventures' Big Kahuna Tour in Kauai is a Major Treat!
review_text: We had the immense pleasure of experiencing the Big Kahuna Air Tour in Kauai in January 2009 with Air Venture Hawaii Lihue. Nicest pilot ever, and ideal day made for a fantastic trip with our family of five. The airplane is neat and quiet, and the ride was very smooth. The flight was about as comprehensive as you'll ever get for Kauai: perimeter tour with Na Pali Coast and Waimea Canyon; then a nice cut across the interior mountains and Mt. Waialeale/Wailua Falls. Kauai is the most amazing island we've ever scene in terms of diversity and beauty.  Air Ventures did an outstanding job of capturing the highlights for us -- all we had to was sit back and be amazed. Our kids were enraptured with the aerial view of the whales, which the pilot took the time to circle back over and bank for the best view possible. Tour was intimate, thoughtful and well guided by our pilot. The staff was courteous and thorough at check in and out. If you do one thing only in Kauai, this tour is it. Much calmer than the helicoptor tours and a heck of a lot more inexpensive. These guys are a class act! Don't wait another minute: get there, get booked, and get dazzled! Do it NOW! Great job, Air Ventures Kauai!!!

I wanted to see ALL of Kauai as there are places you can only go to by boat and then you cannot see the interior of the island.  The Air Venture plane was very comfortable and I was able to see everything very clearly.  The pilot was knowledgeable  and we were able to ask him any question we had during the flight. It is a worthwhile adventure to take.

All that everyone says is true.  A wonderful way to view Kauai.  It was a nice small group, and everyone had a view.  There are so many things on this island that are not viewable by car.  Many places are too dangerous to hike to also.  This is a spectacular way to view and get a different perspective of the island. It is nice because it goes at a slower pace for taking great photos.  I have some great waterfall and shoreline photos. From what I understand they have a perfect safety record.  We come every year, and there always seems to be a helicopter crash. Maybe not fatal, but still a crash.  It is something you don't want to think about, but it definitely makes me feel better flying in a plane.  Great service was provided, so who could ask for more! Thank you Air Ventures Kauai!

review_title: Air Ventures Kauai - Fun and Beautiful!!!!!
review_text: I have been on a lot of excursions in my travels but this one was truly a great experience.  Th employees were friendly and accommodating and genuinely concerned about making this a positive experience from the minute you walked in the door.  It was one of the best hours I have ever spent.  It was a relaxing, fun and beautiful experience.  Kauai is beautiful and I was able to see it first hand by air!!  Well worth the money paid for the trip!!!  One of the smoothest flights I have ever been on.  I felt like I was floating on a cloud the whole time!!  I would go again in a heartbeat!

Hawaii: Air Adventures, Kauai, was a wonderful experience and must do attraction for all, young or old.
Date: December 30, 2008
Reviewer: A trip Advisor Member, Norfolk, Virginia
A friend of mine, who is an avid photographer, and my mom, who turned 75 while on vacation in Hawaii, and I decided to book an Air Adventures flight to see the other 80 percent of the island you are not able to see by car. The flight was very tranquil and spectacular. Our Pilot narrated the entire hour we were airborne. We had two way communications with the pilot, other passengers could hear, in case we had any questions. My friend was able to take a lot of scenic pictures while in the air.  The pictures turned out beautiful, even through the windows in the airplane, which everyone had their own window. Once on the ground, I looked at my mom, as she smiled and gave me a thumbs up, and said, "Let's do it again."  I would recommend Air Adventures to anyone traveling to Kauai, an affordable must do. Thank you Air Adventures, for a wonderful flight. Monica

Our flight was butter smooth in their 6-passenger, fixed wing airplane.  Everyone had a clear view, since the seats are only two wide, and the wing is above the cabin.  Sound deadening headphones allowed us to clearly hear he pilot's narration.  We flew over Nallwilliwilli harbor where the cruise ships dock, over the eastern sugarcane fields, and up over the Waimea canyon, which is called the grandcanyon of Hawaii.  The canyon is spectacular with waterfalls and deep, colorful gorges.  We then flew over to the Napali coast and saw the magnificent, near vertical, cliffs and deep, heavily folliaged valleys carved by the rain and wind.  We saw and circled over whales breaching in the ocean below.  The flight returned down the north coast over beautiful Hanalei bay, the resort town of Princeville, and over the impressive Wailua Falls.

review_title: A great way to see Kauai
review_text: This is a wonderful way to see the entire island of Kauai.  The fixed wing aircraft seems to be the way to go.  It was very stable and traveled quite slowly, enabling us to see much.  We saw some whales, which the pilot was accomodating enough to circle so we could get a better look.  I think my favorite part was going over the center of the island.  At one time I think we could see about 15 waterfalls at once.  It was thrilling to think that some of these areas may never have been traversed by foot.  The flight was so relaxing; sometimes I even forgot that we were in an airplane.  Great pilot!  Great job!

review_title: An Awesome in the Sky Experience
review_text: Today we had an awesome experience on the Air Ventures flight out of Kauai. It all started with Katie giving a great presentation at our resort and ended with Harry the pilot providing an awesome on flight experience. He gave great explanations and the flight was smooth and of the sites all awe inspiring.

review_title: The Best Sightseeing Activity on Kauai !!
review_text:
If you want to see Kauai from the air... the Air Ventures hour tour  is the way to do it.  This is way better than a helicopter tour (which we have done)... quieter, more comfortable, you see way more and you get the opportunity to take great pictures.  This was our favorite activity in 2 weeks of sightseeing on Maui and Kauai.  

Our pilot, Joel, was wonderful.  They have headphones and mikes so the pilot can point out the various sites, as well as allowing you to ask questions and share things you see.  Our trip started at the Lihue airport.  Our take off was quick and you felt like you were floating when airborne.  The plane is made in Australia and can hold up to 6 people and the pilot.  There is lots of space in the plane, the seats are comfy even for big people and we didn't feel cramped at all. There were only 4 of us and the pilot when we took our trip.  Everyone gets a large window to look out of and it's easy to look out both sides of the plane.  The plane flys slowly at altitutes of 500-3000 ft above the island depending on where you are.

Our tour took us over the Nawiliwili harbor, down along the coast to Poipu, on to Waimea with views over Port Allen and Barking Sands Beach.  We then went over the Waimea canyon and saw many waterfalls and the awesome views of the canyon itself.  We then continued on to the  Na Pali Coast...Incredible from the air!!  As we rounded the point to Ke'e Beach (also known as Bali Hai Beach), it was fun to see the wonderful beaches we had visited earlier in the week.  We continued on past Kileauea Lighthouse and down the beach studded coast.  Just prior to landing, we flew over the Wailua River and saw Wailua Falls from the air (an awesome waterfall which I included in my pictures).  

Too soon we were landing and saying Thank You for a wonderful trip.  We took over 300 pictures during our flight and we said to each other as we got out "You wouldn't have to twist my arm to get me to do it again!"

This is an A+++ tour, great people, great plane, great scenery.  What more can I say.... Just do it !!
Had a great flight. Wonderful way to see 100's of waterfalls. This air tour is a must while on Kauai!

review_title: Fantastic View Over NaPala Coast and Kauai
review_text:
We wnt on a fantastic flight yesterday aboard the Air Ventures Kauai!!!  We had an hour flight to the NaPala Coast and saw incredible sights that almost take your breath away.  We were here before and took a helicopter ride to do the same thing and this little plane was far better.  We each had a window view of everything.  You didn't have to look around someone to see the sights.  Also the flight was very smooth and slow so that we could take in the sights.  
The pilot was knowledgable and personable and seemed very capable.  The price was right and the experience was one that we will remember always.  
When we spotted whales down below jumping, the pilot took the time to go closer to the whales so that we could see them nd take pictures.  He also answered all our questions. 
We were not able to go to the wettest spot where it rains because it was raining and a very cloudy morning, but he took us up by the North Coast and all over. I appreaciate that because it wasnt safe to go there, we didn't go!
It was a wonderful experience and well worth our time and money. I feel like I have seen Kauai and the wonderful island. 
Bill and karen Grant

We went on the Air Venture Hawaii plane tour of Kauai in January 2009. The receptionist/staff was courteous and professional. The cost is significantly less than the helicopter tours. The pilot was wonderful, knowledgeable, and an excellent pilot. No one got sick on the flight! The GA-8 Airvan plane is excellent for viewing the beautiful landscape. Visibility is great for all passengers. Even though it was a little overcast in some areas, we got a wonderful view of the Napali coast, the coast line, Waimea canyon, and waterfalls. It was a smooth ride, and we both enjoyed it very much.

I totally recommend using Air Ventures, for about half the price you get all the experience. Very friendly staff!. The views were absolutely spectacular! The Flight was wonderful, the pilot even took us out to view the whales. If there is only thing you do while your on the island, make time and hit Air Ventures!

I have been on helecopter & other plane rides and these folks know their terratory.

The Plane was very stable for the size.  The ride was better than any helecopter I have been in & much quiter.

The pilot was very knowledgeable about the area and presented the views in teh best ways.  We say a number of rainbows that will take your breath away!

Worth every penny! (less than a helecopter too!)

A wonderful flightaround Kuaui, seeing many of the sights that you can see in no other way!

Very friendly and informative staff!

Highly recommended!

review_title: My favorite way to see Kauai
review_text: Air Ventures Kauai provided us with the most  spectacular view of Kauai possible.  The trip was incredibly smooth and we were able to view all the scenery from the large bubble windows.  We flew over parts of Kauai that are not visible from land nor sea.  It was fantastic!!

review_title: The best island tour on Kaua'i
review_text: The AirVenture trip was great.  I saw more on the airplane tour than the boat trip.  The view from the ground is beautiful...but from the air it is stunning.  The staff was very helpful, especially due to my physical limitations.  The noise-cancelling headsets made the trip enjoyable - they played relaxing Hawaiian music  - and we were able to talk to the pilot during the flight and listen to air traffic control, etc.  I highly recommend AirVentures Hawaii!  Mahalo!

AirVentures on Kaua'i was an excellent way to view the entire island and decide what attraction/places we'd like to see/do.  The staff was hospitable and friendly.  Our safety was their first and foremost concern.  They made us feel very comfortable.  The fixed wings of the airvan plane was a smoother ride than the helicopter tour we took on Maui...and the price was more affordable.  We all had great views.  Our pictures turned out great from the plane.  The pilot was knowledgeable about island landmarks.  What a great tour!  Mahalo to Donna and Harry (like in Potter - that's for you Harry!).

review_title: My favorite tour on Kaua'i Island
review_text: A must do activity during your trip to Kaua'i!  I recommend taking the flight within the first couple of days during your trip so that you can see the entire island and plan your stay.  The staff was super friendly and full of Aloha!  Donna coordinated all pre-flight registration info and Harry was our pilot.  They were both very professional and knowledgeable.  The flight was awesome and Harry was a very experienced pilot!  We all felt very safe.  The plane allowed great visibility of the sights in any seat.  Mahalo for a great trip Air Ventures!

review_title: I'm So Glad I Took This Tour.......
review_text:
It was our third trip to Kauai but our first airplane tour - my husband had experienced helicopter tours before and agreed this was the only way to go.  It lets you enjoy the scenic view of the entire Island in a  much more relaxed atmosphere.  The pilot and the employess are very friendly and customer oriented.

I would recommend this to everyone and would do it again myself.

The Staff was great from begining to end. They treated us like "friends". Everyone was knowlegeable and pleasant. The flight was awsome. we got to see all the cool places to go on the island. The pilot knew what he was talking about and shared some great stories with us. It was one of the highlights of our trip!

We had the pleasure of taking one of Air Ventures tours over Kaua’i on our recent trip to that island.  The airvan was spacious and comfortable and passengers had a huge window of their own to look at the views below.  The wings of the plane are above the cabin so no one’s view was ever obstructed by the plane itself.  The leisurely air speed was perfect for photo ops as well as just gawking at the scenery.  Our pilot was entertaining as well as very well informed about the island and the ground crew was courteous and friendly.  

My husband and I had such a great time that we recommended this air tour to just about everyone we talked to throughout the remainder of our stay on the island.  The price is cheaper than any other air tour line (plane or copter) for the length of the tour offered and the pace is very relaxed and pleasurable.  We most definitely will be booking this activity again on our next trip to Kaua’i!

Air Ventures Lihue, Kauai, Hawaii tour

October 17,08

Would like to share an experience that I have never experienced before...touring by air plane. As an avid traveler I have toured by water, motor coach, private vehicle and train but never an Airvan. This slower plane made it possible to capture magnificant photos and view the parts of Kauai that otherwise would not be feasable with the amount vacation time that we had...one week.

We all had our own window seat and the guide/pilot spoke about the history, points of interest, and everything inbetween on a two-way headset with mic. All passangers could communicate with the pilot at any time asking questions or whatever.

Because tour groups usually are comprised of 7 people or less the pilot can cator the tour a bit. My step-dad missed a photo op and the pilot circled around and dropped in for a better picture of the Kalalau Valley. Not only was the guide very knowledgable but he made sure that everyone got perfect vantage point for photo opportunities by flying slowly at different angles and circling around sites.

I felt safe and comfortable on our journey. Would also recommend this type of touring for children. This value added ride is the most economical way to see most of the beautiful island of Kauai in its entirety. When your visit is short or you want to see inaccessable island beauty, flying with Air Ventures is the way to go.

Terri Peruski
Ubly, Michigan

Outstanding --- We have done many helicopter triptsand this tops them all.  The pilot and receptionist were both super friendly.
They were helpfuland and very knowledgeable about the island.
The flight was smooth, nformativeand absolutely beautiful.  Highly recommend Air Ventures to all

Mike and Evanice
Michigan

Air Ventures Kauai provided one of the highlights of our trip.  The plane was quiet and smooth.  We had great Bose headsets to commuicate back and forth with the pilot to hear his commentary and ask questions. My video camera worked great through the bubble windows. And what a view we had of the island!  The coastline of Kauai has to be one of the most beautiful spots on earth.  Our pilot manuevered the plane so that passengers on both sides could see the beauty below.  We will always remember the beautiful beaches, the coffee plantations, the grand canyon of Hawaii, the water falls, and finally Na Pali coast.  This attraction is a must if you are planning a trip to Kauai.

On November 26th we enjoyed the awesome experience of seeing the island of Kauai on Air Ventures Hawaii.  This is the only way to see the entire island.  The pilot did an excellent job keeping the plane smooth and narrating about all the sites we flew over.  We flew over mountain tops viewing several magnificent waterfalls, valleys, beaches, coffee fields, golf courses, and the cliffs.  There are 25 miles of coastline that is only accessible by boat or air.  At this time of year the ocean waves are quite high.  This is the only way to see the cliffs in their full spectrum, they were spectacular.  This is a must do activity on Kauai.

My wife, 1-year-old daughter and I took the 1-hour Kauai island tour in mid-October 2008.  The weather was excellent--great visibility and smooth flying.  I appreciated the fact that they don't fly when visibility is poor since they want the customer to have a positive experience.  I took some great pictures of the island.

We brought our daughter on the flight because we didn't have any babysitting options.  We were a little hesitant but the Air Ventures crew was very accommodating.  They found ear protection that fit her and she sat in my wife's lap.  The pilot took care to constantly make sure everyone was doing okay.  My daughter got through it without too much fuss and allowed my wife and I to see Kauai from above.

review_title: Awesome Way to See the Entire Island of Kauai!
review_text:
Air Ventures Kauai is a great aerial tour of the island!  Book this tour on your first day so that you can determine where you want to go during the remainder of your stay.  Skip photos that result in glass glare and purchase a DVD or aerial photo book instead.  This allows you to just sit back and enjoy the incredible views. 

Our party of six booked this six-seat AirVan tour rather than a helicopter tour for two reasons:  (1) each person had a window seat; and (2) the cost was considerably less than helicopter tours, which had unwanted middle low-visibility seats for two in our party.

It was an amazing tour.  It had comfortable seating, provided a quiet ride and each passenger had a huge bubble window.  With headsets, the pilot narrated the views and answered our questions along the way. 

Mary Safko
Columbia, SC
This was a great tour in Kaua'i.  It was a fantastic way to see the island since so much of the island is inaccessible via car.  It was a nice ride.  The pilot was helpful and knowledgeable.

There are not enough words to tell you what a wonderful time we had, each of us had a window seat, and head set to the piolet, he told us to enjoy the truly untouched and breathtaking beauty of Kauai. We did just that and can say that it was the best air tour we have ever taken (We have traveled the world many time). 
They pick us up at hour hotel, gave us a grand tour and returned us 8 hours latter with a fun lunch and more information about the island than I can remember.
Thank you
Jennie & Rich

review_title: Astonishing Air Tour of Kauai - thanks for the memories!
review_text:
I just returned from a 2-week vacation in Kauai, Hawaii and it was fabulous! It was my first time visiting this beautiful area and I'll be back some day.  

I went on a lot of tours, but the most incredible one was with the Air Ventures Luxurious Air Tour. I got to see the whole island of Kauai from above which to me was the best way to capture the magnificent splendor of this beautiful place.

Joel, the pilot, was very knowledgeable and circled the area we were viewing for optimal picture taking from both sides of the plane.

I would recommend the Air Ventures Air Tour to anyone going to Kauai.  They are reasonably priced and they fly slow enough to allow excellent picture taking. You will not be disappointed!

I would like to give my impression of our wonderful adventure on this tour. 
 
This day Caroline Walsworth and I enjoyed our airplane tour with this company. 
Below is the excerpt from our Journal for the day of our tour--- 
 
This was our last day on Kauai and most exciting. We ate early and drove down to 
airport in Lihue for our “Big Kahuna Tour” with AirVentures of Hawaii. We were 
weighed in order to ensure balanced loading of the airplane. It was a slow 
flying, stable and spacious GA-8 Airvan. Seating was comfortable with good 
visibility for all six (6) passengers. The pilot spoke to us through comfortable 
headsets. The pilot took our picture before we boarded the aircraft. Our flight 
was scheduled to be one hour. 
 
From the air we were able to view Kalapaki Bay, Memehune Fish Pond, Spouting 
Horn, Waialeale Crater, Anaholo Mountains, Waimea Valley, Na Pali Cliffs, 
Hanalei River, Kilauea Lighthouse, and numerous waterfalls. This was all pointed 
out to us by the pilot as we passed by each point of interest. This was the high 
point of our trip thus far. 
 
Leslie R. Abbott, Jr. 
40 Rader St.  Apt 210 
Norfolk, VA 23510

The company was also very attentive to safety.
The flight was great!  The plane was smooth providing plenty of photo ops.  Every seat allows unobscured views.

review_title: Best way to see the island
review_text: We have just returned from a week in Kauai, Hawaii.  We went on the Air Ventures flight a day before we left and it was great.  The weather was wonderful.  I sat in the co-pilot seat in the front and the view was great.  The pilot was very knowledgeable of the island and the flight was really smooth.  I would recommend Air Ventures to anyone that is going to Kauai, Hawaii. I would recommend you go on Air Ventures early in your vacation.  Thanks Air Ventures.

review_title: An Aerial View of Kauai, Hiwaii
review_text: On September 24, 2008, our party of six boarded an Air Ventures Hawaii Airvan fixed-wing aircraft for a one-hour tour of the island of Kauai.  The flight provided us with some of the most dramatic scenery one can imagine!  Taking off from the Lihue Airport on the southeastern shore of the island, our pilot flew to the south shore, taking in the small towns along the rugged coast line.  The pilot provided plenty of narration without being overly talkative.  The noise reduction headsets had individual microphones, so each of us could ask questions or comment on the scenery below.  Turning to the west, our flight took us over the Waimea Canyon area known as the "Grand Canyon of Hawaii."  It lived up to its name, as the rugged mountains plunged into vast canyons, lined with waterfalls and variegated formations of lava, weathered by several million years of rain and wind.  The northwest shore provided stunning views of the NaPali Coast.  These 4,000 foot mountains look like ribbons of green as they drop directly to the sea.  This was the most spectacular sight of the flight!  We continued up the valleys around Princeville, ending up near Mount Waialeale, the wettest spot on earth with 450 inches of annual rainfall.  The flight was smooth, with only minor bounces from the mountain wind currents.  Visibility from the large windows was excellent, and all six of us were able to capture some outstanding photos.  The flight was slow enough to have a great view of the island, yet fast enough to get us completely around the island in exactly one hour.  We would recommend this flight as an excellent way to see the beautiful garden island of Kauai.

review_text:

It starts with you boarding a  cherry red, double cockpit biplane.  My wife and I sat in the front cockpit, the pilot in the back cockpit.  We were supplied with cloth helmets, goggles, and radio set (reminding me of the old Battle of Midway movie).  These were needed as the cockpit was open air (you do have a windscreen to protect you)!

The flight was awesome!  Being an open cockpit, you had an almost unobstructed view in every direction.  I loved sticking my head over the side and looking straight down at the ocean.  One disadvantage of the plane versus a helicopter, was that we were not able to get close to many of the falls or anything.

Our pilot was great.  He was very professional and friendly.  He provided us plenty of information about the sites without being overbearing or cheesy.  When he found out what beach we were married on, he banked the plane so we could get some great pictures from the air!

If you are looking for a flight a bit more adventurous than the usual airplane/helicopter tour (and want to feel the wind in your face!), I would highly recommend Tropical Biplanes.

review_title: Highlight of a 14 day trip to Alaska - and there were many highlights!
review_text:
We cruised into Alaska, spent 7 more days driving around.  This was our first stop and probably the family highlight because we had never done a flightseeing trip before.

Upon arrival, we were told that the cloud ceiling was pretty low, so our trip would likely be cut short, but we would be refunded for the difference or we could try to reschedule for another day, but there weren't any promises it would get better....our day was the first "good" flying day in a few days.

Being on a bit of a timeline, we opted to go ahead with it and were not disappointed.  our pilot, Ace, was amazing.  He talked to us along the way, gave all kinds of information about the area, pointed out rivers, glaciers, cabins, mountains whose names escape me.  He was genuinely bummed that it wasn't clear enough for a glacier landing, he wanted us to experience that.  Flying around, and probably through communicating with others, he "found a hole in the clouds..." and there we were, looking at the summit of Denali!  Absolutely breathtaking.

Additionally, he pointed out part of a glacier that must have just calved and did an extra circle around.

By day's end, I had a credit back on my card - which was far more than anticipated, and I was glad I had tipped him (what I thought) well.  We didn't start a stop watch on take off, so I really don't know how much time was missed.   The fact that TAT took care of us so well ensures that we will certainly consider them first the next time we are in Talkeetna.

I never felt unsafe in the plane.  Ace's expert flying skills were evident from take off to landing.  Truly, I've felt much harder landings on much bigger planes.  I only wish I had taken the time to ask how he got into flying, if he has favorite routes, learned a bit more about the hiker and skier drop offs - all things he would have told me if I hadn't left the plane with my family in complete awe of the experience.

Seats are tight.  I'm a tall guy (6'7") and was glad for the space right by the door.  It does get a little drafty on board, so if you are cold-sensitive, layer up.

Truly a lifetime highlight - and I can't wait to do it again.

My husband and I took the Mountain Voyager with Glacier landing. Daniel, pilot, was extremely knowledgeable about the area, identifying the various mountains and geography.  We were there on a perfect blue bird day and were able to clearly see Mount Denali. Adding the glacier landing made this an exceptional experience. We had a limited amount of time so we wouldn't have gotten to Denali National Park without the  glacier landing. We got so close to the mountain and were able to check the box on another National Park. Highly recommend!

review_title: Don’t miss this once in a lifetime experience!
review_text:
Amazing! I’ve been lucky to have many extraordinary experiences in my travels over the years and this is up there among the best! 

Seeing the Denali Ranges from the air and landing on the glacier is an experience my daughter and I will never forget. 

Don’t miss this once in a lifetime experience. Highly recommended!

review_title: I would highly recommend this tour and this company!
review_text: We were able to get so close to the mountains. It was an amazing experience! Walking on the glacier surreal! The pilot was very entertaining and knowledgeable. The staff were very friendly and accommodating.

This was the trip of a lifetime! Very professional, accommodating, friendly staff. We were blessed with excellent viewing weather. Landing, then walking on Ruth Glacier looking up at Denali was breathtaking. 
Our pilot/guide, Liam from New Zealand was awesome!
Amazing trip, well worth it. Once in a lifetime opportunity to fly above the clouds and see the mountains up close. Would recommend, pictures do not do it justice!
Absolutely amazing flight with close up views of those magnificent mountains. Smooth flight with very good commentary from the pilot

All the staff at Talkeetna Air were super wonderful. Flight was smooth with incredible views. We were blessed with rare clear skies as far as the eye could see. Able to see entire range of mountains. Thank you.

An ABSOLUTE MUST if the weather is good.  Denali and the larger mountain range were simply majestic.  It was a once-in-a-lifetime indulgence that we'll never forget, and the height of our 2-week Alaska adventure.  And, the staff -- Iris, Chase, were accommodating, helpful and experienced.

The company/guide were simply amazing! The views were gorgeous, and they went above and beyond to make it a memorable experience for us! We would highly recommend this company, and it is worth every bit of the money! A special shoutout to our pilot Cade whose thoroughness and narrative helped define our experience. Will definitely be returning in the future.
The staff were so kind and helpful.  Our pilot was amazing.  The views gave us a unique perspective of the glaciers and height.  The experience is unforgettable.
We had a great great time during this tour. Weather was fantastic. Pilot's soundtrack was awesome coupled with Unparalleled views of mountain. Complete ZEN experience. Highly recommended.

Amazing bucket list experience! They picked us up where Princess dropped us off, took us downtown and came back to get us 45 minutes before our ride. Took us back to Princess busses after. Easy to reserve. Clay was an amazing pilot. There were 10 of us on the plane. We took a long scenic flight to the glacier, landed and spent about 15 minutes on the glacier. The trip back was faster, total time about 2 hours.

We booked this same day since the weather had been iffy all week.  Had been in contact with the other popular company but went here bc they were rated #1, and also recommended by our helicopter tour pilot out of Palmer.  Liam was our pilot-super safe, friendly & personable.   He did a great job explaining things and taking us to see the vastness of the Alaska Range.  Denali was visible from Talkeetna part of the day and during our entire flight! What a treat.  Highly recommend this company.  (However, if you’re choosing between helicopter or plane flight tour for your vacation-I personally am in love with helicopters.)

review_title: Amazing views deep in the canyons with the glacier landing.
review_text: This was an awesome flight from our New Zealander pilot Liam.  This dude was a great pilot as well as knowing the land.  Very knowledgeable guy.  He was always pointing out little history of the AK land.  He was very interesting to listen to.  For the flight it was awesome landing in the snow and taking off in a short distance was pretty cool.  They gave us little over shoes for everyone so we didn’t get our feet wet in the wet high mountain snow. I will never for get it as Liam took some epic pics of my wife and I at our landing spot up on the mountain.  Can’t thanks them enough for the awesome flight.
Chris our pilot was great . Fantastic experience mind blowing views of the Denali range and the glacier. Insane landing on the glacier. Just brilliant.

We did the Mountain Voyager with Glacier Landing on June 19.  We chose Talkeetna Air Taxi because Trip Advisor calls them  "#1 of 35 Tours & Activities in Talkeetna".  I called in March and spoke with Amy to discuss our flight options.  Amy was great in taking the time to understand our situation and address our concerns.  I told her my wife was a supplemental oxygen user and asked if there would be any issues. She told me we could not do the summit tour due to the height the plane flew, the need to user flight oxygen, and concerns about my wife's ability to quickly change from her oxygen concentrator to their air.  Amy said we could do either Grand Denali or Mountain Voyager and recommended the glacier landing.  I thanked her for her help and said i would be back to book in a couple weeks after we planned all our excursions for our stay in Talkeetna.  We ultimately decided to fly Monday afternoon.  When I returned to book I learned that many of their planes were reserved for summit landings that day and only the Mountain Voyager with Glacier Landing would be going out that afternoon.  We booked that and are so happy we did.

Everyone was great from the time we arrived.  The ladies there fitted us in landing suits with boots and helped put the boots on over our shoes.  We flew with Liam.  He gave is a safety briefing before we took off.  The views we had early on were amazing.  He did a soft touch down for the Glacier landing, and we spend about a half hour walking the glacier, watching another plane land.  it started raining whine we were on the glacier.  After we took off  we flew a little more when Liam said because of weather he would have to cut the flight short and we would get refunds for the time we missed.  I calculated that from the time we boarded the plane to touch down we were short 5 minutes, from take off to touch down we were short 10 minutes.  Without our asking they refunded 15 minutes flight time.  They couldn't have been more generous.  

After landing, we asked for recommendations for something to eat.  Not only did they give us a couple recommendations, but they gave us a ride to the one we chose.  Thank you all at TAT.

Only issue - they sell t-shirts that are rolled-up in their office.  When we got home my wife found her ladies medium was too snug and wished she bought a large.
LOVED this company. They were organized and very professional. Our pilot was so interesting and informative.

Talkeetna Air Taxi was the highlight of our trip to Alaska!  Our pilot was Dan and he took his time explaining the geography. We also had plenty of time on the glacier landing for photos and checking it out.  We went above the clouds to see the peaks and it was breathtaking!  We felt safe and the customer service on the ground was also top notch.  I highly recommend doing this...worth every penny!!

Alaska is absolute beauty and there is no better place to see that than with Talkeetna Air Taxi’s flightseeing Denali with glacier landing.  Words don’t describe the majestic beauty. Everyone at Talkeetna Air Taxi was efficient, safety conscious and so helpful. Liam was a wonderful pilot!

 If you are trying to talk yourself out of doing this tour, re-think the decision.  You truly don’t want to miss what Talkeetna Air Taxi
can show you of Denali’s beauty!!

GREAT CUSTOMER SERVICE -  This was my second trip with Talkeetna Air Taxi, the first being 15 years ago.  They were incredibly accommodating in trying to make sure the experience was as perfect as the weather would allow.  We had three days of rain in Talkeetna, but the staff kept working with us to re-schedule our Denali Trip. We were finally rewarded with a perfect day. Not many trip providers are willing to keep re-scheduling to make everything is as great as it can be.

review_title: This place is number 1 for a reason!
review_text: Absolutely phenomenal flight. Our pilot was Chris and he was great. The photos we took are beautiful but do no justice to the breathtaking views throughout the entire flight. Friendly, super professional, awesome and top notch in every way.

Because of all the fantastic reviews, we tried 4 times (due to weather) to get our flight in while we were in Alaska.  We were finally able to get off the ground on our last day - and it was def worth it!  TAT communicated the delays and worked diligently to keep rescheduling us.  It was amazing and more than worth it!  Our pilot was great (wish I remembered his name to give him kudos (flew Aug 2 at 11 am)).  The mountains were spectacular!  Highly, highly recommend!!

I was a little concerned in a small plane which are old and had a little gasoline smell in the beginning before takeoff.  But the pilot was wonderful and guided us around Denali mountains and glaciers with amazing confidence and knowledge that I forgot about the smell which was also gone. 

The best part of the trip was landing and taking off from the glacier and then seeing the scenery all around us.  Breathtaking beauty!! 

 Some of the glaciers are receding according to the pilot and I wondered when we will not be able to see these wonders of nature.

This was one of the highlights of my trip to Alaska! We had a beautiful day in September. The glacier landing was definitely a must do and I was definitely in awe. Our pilot and tour guide was amazing. She took care of us and was super knowledgeable about everything about Denali. I would do this tour again!

Did the Mountain Voyager with Glacier Landing.  We went in the afternoon at 1.30. It was questionable if we were going to get to go because of weather.  Luckily it cleared enough to go.  Need to be flexible or understand that the weather can change and your trip will be canceled.  Our plane had our family of 7 and 3 others. The Mountains were amazing and it looked like were were very close but were not. Took about 30 minutes to get to the glacier and landed.  We were there about 15 minutes and then flew back. Tour was about 1 3/4 hour.  We all had headsets and the pilot explained what we ere seeing. This was one of my families  favorite tours.  If I had to pick taking the bus tour of Denali or doing this tour,  I would pick this right away.

a truly awe inspiring once in a lifetime experience flying between massive rocks peaks and glaciers. 
then landing in a stunning 35 acre Amphitheatre with mountains in all directions
worth every penny
If you’re debating, DO IT! One of my most memorable experiences while I was in Alaska. Incredible views.

Of the 18 days we spent in Alaska, this Flightseeing Tour was one of two top exceptional experiences! Safety is number one for these folks, our pilot was experienced, everything was well organized, and we were well taken care of. 

The pilot's narrative enhanced the experience, in that we knew what we were looking at. The views were amazing, seriously some of the most beautiful scenery ever!

The glacier landing was flawless, thrilling, and once in a lifetime!

The plane was comfortable as were the headsets.

We had signed up for the Grand Denali Tour, but at the pilot's discretion, we did not circumvent the mountain due to weather. However, the pilot made sure that the experience was exceptional. He flew the plane in such a way that the passengers on both sides of the plane got to see all of the views.

We got a refund for the difference between the flight we booked and the flight we took. We felt appreciated as customers, and the pilot expressed thanks for all of us (9) flying with them. Do this!

We had hoped to do the Denali glacier landing tour but were unable to due to weather. However, the experience was still magnificent. Our pilot was kind and very knowledgeable. The views of the lower glaciers and fall colors were still spectacular. We will definitely be back to try for the Denali flight sometime in the future (weather permitting of course)

From the very beginning the flight was unbelievable. The sun was shining and the views were beyond spectacular!  A chance of a life time and well worth the price.
Paul made us feel at ease while flying because he was so competent in all aspects of the flight. He was very knowledgeable and informative as well as making us feel comfortable throughout.
We took the Mountain Voyager with glacier landing tour. It was absolutely fabulous. ATA is very organized and employees were very friendly. This tour was the highlight of our trip to Alaska.

Great experience.  Out pilot, Sean, was fantastic.  he worked hard to show use three big peaks as well as glaciers.  We could not do the glacier landing due to the conditions on the ground, something we were warned about prior to boarding the flight.  But that did not stop this from being a memorable trip.  Thank you!

review_title: Would give it 10 stars if I could!
review_text: Our family took this flight with a glacier landing. I wrestled with whether to do the landing or not and decided to go ahead and book it knowing that many times they get cancelled. The day of our flight was cloudy but had no rain. When we arrived they told us that the earlier flight had been cancelled due to visibility, but ours would be able to fly. Since there was a lot of cloud cover in the lower elevations we would not be able to land though. We were given the choice to cancel or reschedule, but it would have been difficult to fit it into our schedule on another day. Besides, the next time might be worse. We decided to go ahead and go and were assured that we would still have good views once we got above the clouds.  We seemed to be flying in complete clouds for a few minutes and I thought it was going to be a bust and then we broke through the clouds and wow! As we flew around up there the clouds seemed to dissipate and the next thing we knew the pilot said it had cleared so much that we were going to be able to land!  It was a very smooth landing on snow and we landed at base camp where the hikers start their journey to climb Denali. It was absolutely amazing to stand there among those majestic mountains. Words cannot even describe it. We had plenty of time to take photos and walk around. You could go pretty far if you wanted and there were cones set up that you were not to go past. Then back on the plane and were heading down the hill and rather than the plane lifting up it was like the ground just falls away from the plane. You feel so close to the huge mountains, but they said we were still 10 miles away at least! The pilot was very experienced, the flight and landing very smooth, and pilot communicated with us through headsets. Facemasks are requred due to covid.
