It was an amazing experience for our family and in my opinion a must-do in Alaska if you have the funds.

This was definitely a highlight of our trip. There were 10 of us so we had our own plane! It was a beautiful sunny day and the views were spectacular!  The landing on the glacier was fun and our group had a competitive snowball fight. Thank you for the memories.

Fantastic experience. Had signed up for the summit tour w glacier landing but visibility prevented flying over the summit.  So the pilot changed the itinerary to the mountain voyager with glacier landing and the trip was unforgettable. 

I highly recommend taking the flightseeing trip with glacier landing. Breath taking views, knowledgeable and experienced pilots, responsive company.

They are very customer friendly, accommodative and professional. Definitely worth the experience. The view over the Denali will blow you away. This was one of the highlights of our trip. We could not do glacier landing due to bad weather, but they refunded the difference in price without even me asking for it. They also take the safety of flight seriously. We had an experienced IFR pilot. I was picked up and dropped off without any wait time.

My travel mate said this was the most memorable thing she had done on a previous trip to Alaska so of course, we had to book this adventure. Very smooth check-in process, helpful staff, great pilot! The opportunity to see Denali up close was spectacular!! And just flying around the other mountains, formations and above the glaciers was breathtaking! We chose not to do the glacier landing since we were hiking atop Root Glacier in Wrangell-St Elias. If you have the time and money to do this flightseeing adventure, be sure not to miss this!

review_title: A once in a lifetime viewing of Denali including a glacier landing
review_text: Fabulous experience!! With glacier landing. The views were unbelievable! Our pilot was friendly and experienced. Enjoyed learning about the Denali and the surrounding glaciers

We did the Mountain Voyager tour last week, and I am not sure we will ever be able to top this flight.

First off, the weather was absolutely perfect.  Not a cloud in the sky all the way to Denali.  Our pilot, Mike, told us that we were probably at the top 1% of the bell curve for weather this summer.

The flight was so smooth, and Mike pointed out all the sights along the way.  Landing on the glacier was definitely the highlight of the trip for my kids.  We were the only plan in the area that we landed at, and it was awesome being out there with just 10 other people.

For possibly a once in a lifetime experience, definitely consider taking one of these flightseeing tours.
Awesome tour on a spectacular day by Talkeetna Air Taxi. The landing on the glacier was unforgettable.

We went on Mtn  Voyager flight with glacier landing  It was a fantastic experience.  The pilot was great and informative.  Walking on the glacier was great.  I highly recommend this company and this flight.

review_title: Beautiful view of the most beautiful state.
review_text: Our weather wasn't perfect for a glacier landing but our pilot made up for this with a tour of absolutely amazing views.  And what a pilot!  Such a smooth ride.  We would recommend this company for anyone considering a flight from Talkeetna.  Very professional.

The customer service is exceptional! We received a call about and hour and a half before our flight letting us know that weather wasn’t permitting the Grand Denali tour we had booked and options to either fly a shortened one, or postpone. We ended up postponing twice and then our last day in Talkeetna opted for a shorter flight without the landing so that we could at least get up there before leaving. SO worth it! We got an hour 15 of flight time, amazing views, and they refunded us fully for the portion of the trip we didn’t get from our original booking. 

I would recommend not locking yourself into one time slot when booking…give yourself at least a day for flexibility! There was a couple in line behind us banking on the 8:30am flight and had left anchorage at 7am only to be disappointed that their flight was shifted. Alaska weather is always unpredictable…plan ahead to make it worth it!

If you visit Alaska, this is a must do!   Everything was well organized from the check-in process to the flight.   The pilot pointed out all of the features and answered all of our questions with expertise.    Furthermore, the flight was very smooth and we were impressed on how smooth the landing and take off from the glacier was.    Visiting Denali was like being transported to another world.     The glacier landing was well worth it!

review_title: This is the BEST thing I did in Alaska!
review_text:
This was one of the most amazing things my family has ever done (and this is coming from a family that travels extensively and does "adventure" type activities all over the world). From beginning to end - spectacular.  Highly recommend the glacier landing if you can make that work out!

Also want to give a shout out to this company, Talkeetna Air Taxi! We were actually booked on a competitor company (who shall not be named), with the glacier landing option. They told us if it wasn't going for whatever reason, we could rebook as long as we were in the area.   We purposely stayed in town for 2 days knowing that these flights cancel often. Well, the glacier landing wasn't happening during our scheduled time, but when we tried to rebook, the competitor company said they had no availability left. This is not what they had told me on the phone. They told me the would "make every effort" to reschedule my booking.  But they made no effort whatsoever, and instead cancelled my trip (but refunded me, luckily!)

I called Talkeetna Air Taxi immediately to ask if they had any availability to take us up to see the mountain, at any time, over the two days I was in town.  They were extremely nice and accommodating on the phone. They said they would make it happen, and they did! In fact, they really went out of their way to get us on a flight - they ended up booking us on a plane that was going up to pick up some mountaineers hiking near Denali. And that was fine by us, and a very cool experience for us to be a part of!

So THANK YOU to Talkeetna Air Taxi for going above and beyond in making this once-in-a-lifetime experience happen for us!!

Everything about this experience was fantastic!  The booking process was simple,  the check-in smooth and professional and the actual flight itself was beyond incredible!  Our pilot was very knowledgeable and pointed out many things along the way.  The landing on the glacier was a special highlight!! Highly, highly  recommend!  It is a little extra but well worth it!  Our experience was definitely over the top!

My husband and I did this June 21, 2021. Chris was our pilot. He did an awesome job pointing out landmarks and telling us about the area. It was cloudy in Talkeetna but bright and sunny on the mountain. We did a glacier landing...its hard to put into words really, but if you are on the fence about spending the money, just do it! Totally worth every penny!

Absolutely epic in every way for my family (wife + two teen boys). A life highlight weaving throughout the Denali range, seeing Denali, landing at base camp glacier, sitting copilot, and just overall a magical experience. Weather was sketchy down low but once above the cloud layer and around Denali - epic. Would highly recommend!

WOW! We are so glad we signed up for the glacier landing. We actually signed up for the Southside tour and the tour company upgraded us to the Mountainside tour! Beautiful views of Denali and surrounding mountains. Smooth flight and landings.

review_title: Father and Son enjoyed flight and sights!
review_text: We had a fantastic flight on and it also included a glacier landing. The weather that day happened to be spectacular. My son and I had a great time!

We had an amazing time!! I had seen previous reviews that mentioned the steep cost but eventually decided it was a once in a lifetime opportunity. I booked for Father’s Day and oh my gosh, the day was so clear with perfect weather. The flight was amazing and landing on a glacier…when else would you ever have that?! Our pilot was wonderful, made us feel comfortable and safe and his knowledgeable narration made the trip extra enjoyable.

This was the best thing so far on our vacation trip from Fairbanks to anchorage and Seward, mountains where clear we pick a great day to go out, we had a glacier landing, The staff was very informative about the weather it was rainy and cloudy, so we picked the next day at 11 am instead oh boy was that a good choice.

This was a surreal experience! You have to do the Glacier Landing portion as words can't even describe how amazing that felt. Walking on a glacier in the middle of mountains was so calming. The flight is very comfortable too and the views are second to none. Highly recommend this to anyone visiting Alaska

In a nutshell, every aspect of my experience was amazing with Talkeetna Air Taxi. Their office personnel greeted me as soon as I stepped in the door and answered all my questions with a smile. The plane we flew in was well taken care of and the pilot filled us with so much knowledge of the landscape throughout the flight. Denali is so magical seen in the air. Spend the extra money on the glacier landing, and when you land be sure to try the snow...one of the most delicious things I've ever eaten. If I ever return to Alaska, I will definitely fly with Talkeetna Air again!

Oh my gosh this was seriously breath taking. Dress warm! The plane is chilly. The views are incredible. We did the glacier landing - HIGHLY recommend. There is nothing like it. The pilot was friendly and fun!

Amazing experience & glorious views.can’t put into words the beauty beheld. The landing on the glacier was awe-inspiring. Watching the other planes land & take off was unique. We felt like we were suspended in time watching all that God has created through time. The crew was well versed, polite & professional. Safety was never our concern.

review_title: We had the experience of a lifetime!
review_text: We were incredibly lucky. The weather conditions on the mountain were perfect for viewing. We were assigned a flight that was dropping climbers at the 7200 ft base camp. Our pilot Andy was awesome, an experienced pilot who knows and loves the mountain. After we landed on the glacier  and dropped off the climbers with their gear, we continued to get a private personalized tour of all the many features of Denali and her sister mountains, and the glaciers and rock features between them. Andy continually shared his knowledge of everything we were seeing and positioned the plane so we could see it all. An amazing once in a lifetime experience. All the office and ground crew were very friendly and extremely helpful. We give it a 20 star recommendation.
Landing on the glacier was amazing!   Views throughout the flight were spectacular and spending time on the glacier was awe inspiring.

The people in the office were professional, friendly, and helpful. The pilot provided a lot of great insight to what we were seeing and the views were incredible! The glacier landing is worth the extra money. I would do it again in a heartbeat!

I would absolutely recommend this tour and this company to my family and friends. 

Definitely take some anti motion sickness pills! The pilot did a wonderful job of keeping us smooth, but it’s a little plane and you’ll be taking a ton of pictures. Dramamine kept me from being sick.

An absolutely AMAZING experience. You cannot leave Alaska without this flight seeing tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi. Out pilot Andy was fantastic, he went through all the safety steps first to make sure we were all comfortable before taking flight, answered all  our questions and was a great guide while we were in the air. The flight was so smooth and the views were unlike anything I could have imagined. Went through two camera memory cards! Highly recommend the glacier landing! It was 10/10 worth it. Could not recommended this experience more!

This experience was amazing.  By far my favorite thing we did in Alaska!  Everything was great!  I felt very safe with our pilot, and he was kind and professional.  We had a clear day and could see so many mountains and glaciers!  It was so amazing I was almost crying.

We added the glacier landing and it was 1000% worth it!  I wanted to save some money but my husband convinced me to add it on and I am so glad we did!  

Seriously- book this.  You won't regret it!

We did the mountain explorer with glacier landing. It was worth every penny. Our pilot was wonderful- great narration with a focus on safety.  Her flying skills allowed us to be up close to some of the most jaw dropping scenery in the world. Peak fall colors topped it off. 
Pilot, scheduler and ramp agent were all delightful. Talkeetna Air Taxi has the customer experience down pat. Already looking forward to our next trip.

This flightseeing tour is a must-do if you're in the Denali area.  The pilot was an expert flyer circling all the highest peaks and then actually landing on a glacier.  We were allowed to walk around the glacier for a while then back to more peak circling.  The day was perfectly clear and the views of Denali and the surrounding peaks was incredible.  Don't miss this opportunity.

review_title: Once in a lifetime experience, a must do experience with Talkeetna Air!
review_text: Talkeetna Air came highly recommneded from a friend and they did not disappoint as the Mountain Air Tour with Glacier Landing is an experience I will never forget. It's a "must do experience" when in Alaska and Talkeetna Air made it exceptional. Andy our pilot, through to Annie and Heidi in the office made it all happen. I could not have thought of a better way to spend my 50th birthday.

My husband and I booked this trip the day before, we were really concerned with weather and being able to see. Booking by phone was very easy and the front desk was very helpful - We booked the 10am Full Tour with Glacier Landing. Our trip was absolutely perfect, incredible views and clear conditions. Landing on a pristine glacier with new snow was an experience we will never forget, even though temps dropped out there to 18deg F - We were glad we were bundled! 

Highly recommend this activity, book with Pilot Paul if you can!

It was a 2-hour drive from Anchorage and all worth it. All of the staff and flight crew were very nice and provided lots of information. They also provided masks if you didn't have one. The views from the plane were Jaw-dropping and the pilot provided tons of info on the landscape. If you're a photographer, you won't be disappointed.

Wow, what an awesome experience! We did the Mountain Voyager tour with the glacier landing. We don't typically do things this pricey, and I was worried about regretting the price tag, but I can say it was worth every penny.

Every minute in the air was mesmerizing! Our pilot handled the plain beautifully, he was a great tour guide providing us with mind blowing facts every step of the way, and best of all, the windows and seating provided for better, wider views than I would have thought.

We agonized a bit about paying for the glacier landing. It seemed like a lot of money for a little amount of time, but in the end we decided it was probably our only chance to say we landed on glacier in our lives, and again, it was worth every penny! It felt like we were outside on the glacier for a long time! I did not feel at all rushed back onto the plane.

review_title: Spectacular mountains and glaciers everywhere you look
review_text: Had an unbelievably spectacular flightseeing trip around Denali, Moose's Tooth, and the Ruth Amphitheater!  Pilot Andy was super knowledgeable about the mountains and glaciers, and kept us entertained with nifty chatter about everything there was to see.  Andy's glacier landing was an extra special treat.  If you want to see Denali National Park and the Alaska Range, Talkeetna Air Taxi has the trip for you!
What an amazing experience! I can't recommend this enough. Friendly staff, awesome pilot and just an awe-inspiring landscape. Don't miss it.

review_title: A bucket list item for Alaska
review_text: As an Alaskan, I tell all of my friends and family to do this when visiting the state. I sent my parents with Talkeetna Air Taxi because they are the BEST company to go with. This is an unforgettable experience for anyone and is a must do when coming up to Alaska.
Seeing the Ruth Glacier and the peaks of Denali was a lifetime experience. Our pilot was confidence inspiring and did a great job narrating our flight. I would highly recommend flying with TAT!

My wife and I were fortunate enough to have booked a tour on a beautiful Talkeetna day. The flight and the glacier landing was beyond incredible and our pilot, Leighan, was a fantastic pilot and guide! We will be reliving the memories for the rest of our lives. Thank you for a great tour!

review_title: Wonderful Denali and surrounding area flight seeing experience
review_text: Our family took a  Denali flight seeing tour on July 22nd With Talkeetna Air Service.  LeAnn was our pilot.  She was very personable and professional.  She did an excellent job not only flying but explaining Alaska and what we were seeing.  It felt like it was much more than here is our standard route we fly and some standard information. She provided facts, details, stories not only about Denali but Alaska in general. We would highly recommend Talkeetna Air Service and LeAnn.

We had a fantastic experience with Talkeetna Air Taxi! These tours are extremely weather dependent, so don't schedule this for your last day in the the area, just in case you need to reschedule! We chose the Mountain Voyager tour with a glacier landing, and although we had some clouds, we were able to land on the Don Sheldon Amphitheater section of the Ruth Glacier, next to the Sheldon Chalet. It was so much fun to land on the glacier, and the subsequent take off was very cool! As an aside, we were happy to see that Leighan was our pilot, because we love showing our teenage daughter what women can do! Our daughter sat in the copilot seat on the way out, and although she has Asperger's and has a lot of social anxiety, it did not matter to Leighan in the least. :-) Thank you to TAT for a great morning!

review_title: Best part of my Alaska trip - worth the price tag!
review_text: I know this has a hefty price tag, but I swear it was worth every penny. By far my highlight of my trip to Alaska! Staff was super friendly, the flight was easy and smooth, and the views were unbelievable - in the air and on the glacier. I called around different companies, and TAT was the easiest to talk to. Thank you Andy and TAT!!

Amazing experience! We’re a family of five, the youngest is 8 y/o, we all enjoyed it. Extremely fascinating and felt like we had traveled to another planet in 30 minutes. The peaks and glaciers are breathtaking especially when standing on a glacier. You can hear the sounds of the glaciers as they shift and move, a little unsettling when you are standing on them! Would definitely recommend this excursion if you have the opportunity, a highlight!

I can't put into words how fantastic this was. We were gasping with wonder and delight pretty much the whole time. Pretty sure that if I could have opened the plane's window, I could have reached out & touched Denali. The glacier landing was a special thrill. This tour should be a must on your Alaska to-do list. We live here and it was still breathtaking and spellbinding.

My girlfriend and I had an absolutely fantastic experience with TAT and the Mountain Voyager tour. The weather was perfect and our pilot, Lee Ann, was really great. Yes, it was a splurge but well worth it.

I have always had a fear of small planes and avoided them at all costs. Until now. Just could not pass up chance to land on a glacier. I am so very happy I did it! Did it for my grandson, but really for me. The flight was beyond expectations. First off the pilot was very professional and put me so at ease. It was a slightly cloudy day which made it more interesting. And he worked around the clouds, smoothly, no bumps! The landing on the glacier was soft. Playing on it was so much fun. So many pictures, all beautiful. Back in the air we felt we could reach out and touch the mountains tho we never got closer than a quarter mile. This was the most exciting excursion we did in all of Alaska. It was not cheap but it was priceless in my mind. Do it. And this company was great all around.

review_title: Favorite thing we did in 18 days in Alaska...and I hate flying
review_text: I gathered my nerves to do this and am so glad I did. Add landing on the glacier...it is the best! Incredible experience! Tell them if over 60 and get a discount.

Our pilot took us around the peaks and glaciers of Denali. Visibility was wonderful so capturing outstanding scenes was exhilarating. This was a once in a lifetime experience and the company was excellent!  Highly recommend them.

review_title: Once in a lifetime experience: worth every dollar. you won't regret it!
review_text:
I was told by a native Alaskan  that when visiting Alaska if you do nothing else,  you must  do a flightseeing tour, because it's the only way to begin to  grasp the enormous scale of the place. I can't imagine a better flightseeing experience, or a better company to do it with. Talkeetna Air Taxi  has got to be  the BEST choice I think.
 From the start they were easy  to work with- I  had 6 people in our party, 3 of whom were uncertain, and they were ok with me reserving for 6 and cancelling  some later.
 Also check out their cancellation policies: if you decide on the day of the flight that you aren't comfortable with the weather,  even if they plan to fly they will still refund your deposit. 
Clay was our pilot. Very competent, and confident, and very friendly. The flight was smooth, great takeoffs and landings. 
and DO THE GLACIER LANDING! We had hiked on a glacier in New Zealand, so we thought it would be  a similar experience. WRONG--DO IT. It's the only way you can fully grasp just how huge and awe-inspiring these glaciers are. 

Initially we gulped  a bit at the price, but now we are so glad we did it. 
This was hands-down the best day of my Alaskan vacation.
 I even bought the T-shirt.
Thanks Talkeetna Air Taxi for a once-in-lifetime experience!

A fantastic experience. I was curious if it could possibly live up to the overwhelmingly positive reviews here, but it was indeed really special stuff. I was impressed with how cool and competent our pilot was - he put everyone at ease from the start, and his passion for the area came through loud and clear.

Go for the glacier landing!

Kris Peterson was our pilot.  We were in a DeHaviland Beaver seating 10 or so.  Kris warned that the plane had an identity crisis and thought it really was a helicopter.  Kris's handling of that plane was amazing.  The ride was smooth start to finish. Every now and again he would circle around so everyone on the plane got an amazing view. He even channeled Henry David Thoreau marvelling at the beauty of Alaska.  Best tour I have ever been on!

Don’t miss the glacier landing. It is an amazing experience.  We had originally booked a different tour but due to weather issues, they called in advance and moved us to a trip later in the day.  The pilot was excellent and worked hard to provide an incredible tour when there were clouds at the mountain.  Our glacier landing was incredibly smooth and not to be missed.   Everyone on their team was friendly, helpful and created a once in a lifetime experience.

Finally had nice weather in Talkeetna and decided last minute to do a flightseeing tour. We went on the Mountain Voyager tour with a glacier landing and the views were incredible. You don’t realize how big Denali National Park is (and how little you are) until seeing it from above. It’s expensive but the views and the experience is worth it!
Estive com amigos neste vôo incrível e imperdível até o ponto alto dos Estados Unidos. Vale a pena pousar nas geleiras e agradecer a Deus pela bela naturrleza que ELE nos deixou. Visual incrível...

review_title: Its all about pleasing the customer!
review_text:
I'm so impressed with their service and willingness to accommodate the needs of their clients. This is so rare and a great value.  Read on!

This company was recommended by the pilot with Stellar Aviation in Homer. He said a lot of excellent Pilots have gone over to this company. We also chatted with an air traffic controller who told us that the larger, flashier companies have a higher turnover of Pilots.

They have multiple planes including a four seater and 10 seater. They are flexible on their pricing. They will adjust their pricing based on what you are to see of Denali. This is amazing. They also let you cancel if it looks like the mountain is not going to be visible and you decide you don't want to go. Special boots are provided for the people who go on flights that have a glacier landing. And if you're lucky, you might be added onto one of those flights even though you were paying for just a fly by. Again, amazing! I also learned that even if it's only one person who wants to fly,  they would take you out and would not increase the cost to offset the fact that you're the only person. But honestly, I think they do such a great job it is likely a rare event when there's only one person to go.

The flight was wonderful.  The pilot made sure that everyone  on the plane had equal opportunity to see everything. We appreciated his narration which was more than adequate. It was relaxed and informative. He gave some historic background about the first hikers, the naming of Denali, Etc.

They were so efficient, helpful, and accommodating. It's rare to see a business so willing to work with the needs of the client  and be affordable at the same time. I wouldn't consider going with any other company after this experience.

A side note:  we talked on the phone about the pricing. This is where we learned that based on how much of the mountain we would see, the price would be adjusted. We also learned there was a 10% discount if you book online.

My friends (4 total) and I took the flight because I wanted to see Denali from above.  The staff was so friendly and accommodating.  We postponed our flight one day due to weather and it was no problem.  The day we got to Talkeetna Air Taxi it was raining on the ground but when our pilot Michael got us going we suddenly were in full sunshine.  We had a beautiful and informative tour and our landing on the glacier was perfect.  The time on the Glacier was just enough.  Overall the experience was unforgettable, and was my favorite part of our time in Alaska.  Thank you to all especially Michael.

We had an amazing  flight with Andy. Lucky to have completely clear view of Denali, beautiful vision all the way around the mountain, and an amazing walk in the snow  once we had landed. Once in a lifetime trip, highly recommended

Our experience started with the super cool sales guy in their Talkeetna Main Street office who gave us a very accurate non-pushy picture of what we would be getting during our flight.  He was knowledgeable about the routes and conditions.  Super friendly.  Gave us a discount for same day booking and arranged for their shuttle guy to stop by the train depot with us to pick up our luggage that was being held there for us since we would get back after they closed.  Seth picked us up in the shuttle, helped us pick up our luggage at the train station and then offered to drive our luggage to our lodge for us 5 Miles out of town, while we flew.  The ladies at the front desk were super friendly.  And then came our pilot, Matt.  He gave us the ride of our lives.  I grew up in a small plane with my dad and this guy could fly!  Very safe and competent.  We got up close and personal with Denali and the surrounding cliffs.  We only did the 1 hr basic flight and it was amazing.  It helped that we got the one clear day in 10!  But what a ride!!!  So impressed with this company and it’s top service!  Seth drove us back to town.  He had delivered all our luggage as promised and filled the inn keeper in on our plans and schedule.  And he refused our tip!  Said he was just doing his job.  But please don’t let that stop you from trying.  Absolutely go with this company!

Talkeetna Air Taxi came highly recommended by our Knik Glacier Tour guide Randy. I am glad we listened and added this to our itinerary. 

Yes, it is expensive, but the stunning views are worth every dollar. 

JUST DO IT!

review_title: Yes it's expensive, but yes it's worth it.
review_text: Before booking this flight, i googled "is a flightseeing tour of Denali REALLY worth it?" because i had major sticker shock.  It just so happened that the day my friends planned to fly, it was sunny and calm, and i called up to see if they had 1 more spot for me, and they did (literally ,the last seat on the plane!). If you're going to do a flight tour, you MUST do the glacier landing - yes it's more expensive but it's SO worth it.  The views are majestic, and landing and running around on a glacier surrounded by 3 of our nation's highest mountains is SO peaceful and stunning.  We did the Mountain Voyager tour with the glacier landing and it was 100% phenomenal.  One person even gets to sit up in the cockpit - i recommend trying to get up to that spot for amazing views.  I love that the pilot tells you whats going on through individual headsets.  And the whole ride was so smooth - an even better flight than the large commercial airline we flew into alaska on.  So in summary, YES, it is worth it.  If you're only going to go once, pony up for this tour. (And yes, we got to see the summit of Denali which was also AMAZING)

We took the Mountain Voyager Flight with Glacier Landing, a flight of a lifetime!  Weather was not great on the day of our flight, but as advised on Talkeetna Air Taxi website, we booked early in our Talkeetna stay and had plenty of time to wait for clear weather.  After a 5 hour delay, our flight took off!  The snow covered mountain views and glaciers were breathtaking.  Landing on the glacier at Denali climbers base camp was amazing!  There were still a lot of clouds, but they somehow enhanced the moment and created a mystical experience.  Our pilot, Richard, was able to find a break in the clouds to give us a view of Denali peak.  Don't miss out on this flying adventure, and spend the extra money to land on the glacier.  The glacier landing was incredible!  A highlight of our Alaska trip!

Wow - I'm still thinking about this flightseeing tour weeks later. Absolutely incredible and some of the most stunning, majestic scenery you'll ever see. Of course, that's assuming you have a crystal clear, calm day like we did. Our pilot, Clay, was easy going, confident and extremely knowledgable. He provide a great running (flying?) commentary. We had the camera snapping away virtually non-stop.  Landing on the glacier at basecamp was a treat. The whole experience was wonderful!

We had a wonderful experience with our pilot Chris, who was very experienced and informative on our flight. He made us feel very comfortable and showed us some amazing scenery on a beautiful day! We felt very lucky to go on the flight. It was smooth and just a little cold for a while at the highest point, but otherwise very worthwhile! If the day is clear, it is a must to do! Amanda at the front desk and all the other employees were very nice and helpful also!

review_title: The Glacier Walk was the Icing on a Great Cake
review_text: The whole experience was wonderful, from check in to returning the glacier boots. The staff were very friendly and knowledgeable (gave excellent restaurant recommendation) but focused on safety. Our pilot, Richard, has been flying here for 23 years, but is still passionate about what he does, again with an emphasis on safety. The scenery is spectacular and flying close to the mountains gives you a remarkable experience only surpassed by the glacier walk at 7000 feet. Not just a highlight of our Alaskan vacation but  a highlight of our 50 state quest which reached its successful conclusion here in Alaska.

I am an instrument-rated pilot from Texas.  My first concern is safety.  The TAT planes and equipment and first class, maintain like new, and in excellent condition.  Our pilot, Michael, a skilled commercial-rated pilot, is equally skilled and safe.  He knows how to maneuver the plane for optimum comfort of the passengers, alerting us to what he is doing (turns, ascent, descent) before he executes.  He is an equally good tour guide in the air but his cockpit situation awareness never waivers.  We had a beautiful clear day and the air tour exceeded all expectations.  I don't weep easily but these views of Creation being awe and delight.   The staff on the phone and at check in have a wonderful service culture.   You immediately feel welcome and appreciated.  This service is definitely a choice for experience and safety.

Everyone at TAT was friendly and helpful.  God provided a beautiful, sunny day and our pilot, Chris,  did the rest.  Never having flown in a small plane before we weren't sure what to expect.  The flight was smooth and stable.  Chris narrated from beginning to end with background that only a local person could supply.  He seemed to be genuinely excited that we were all enjoying it so much.  The glacier landing was awesome and we had plenty of time to take pictures.  You MUST take this flightseeing trip when in Talkeetna.  It will make your whole vacation!

All I can say is wow! What an awesome experience. The staff at Talkeetna Air Taxi was so nice and accommodating. We had perfect weather and our pilot was so knowledgeable about the area. Truly an awe inspiring experience to feel the enormity of the mountains yet feel like you could reach out and touch them. Highly recommend this!

Great experience flying from Miami to Bimini. One way was a water landing with a seaplane, and the return flight was on a regular charter to Opa Executive Airport.
From the reservation (excellent communication with Janos) to the day of departure, both flights were fantastic. Both pilots were great, and we had a wonderful time and a lot of fun. We will definitely use this service again!

The reservation and check in process was a bit sketchy, but it is worth the hassle. We opted for the 30-minute North Biscayne tour.  After figuring out the parking situation, we waited in what appeared to be hotel lobby. Our flight time came and went, we were nervous. Then the tour guide arrived. He apologized for the wait. He led us out to the marina and asked us to sit in a waiting area for a few minutes while he shuttled a couple ahead of us. Upon his return, he led us to a mid-sized boat and ferried us out to the middle of the bay. It was really cool to see the seaplane come in for a landing and then meet up with the boat in the middle of the bay. The boat ride in the bay was added value. The people in the plane jumped in the boat and then we loaded into the plane. It was a Cessna 172 Skyhawk Seaplane. A little older but very well maintained. Our pilot was friendly and very professional. He explained everything he was doing and all the safety features. Our take off was exciting. Our flight was at the end of the day, and we were able to see an absolutely amazing sunset behind the Miami skyline. We flew over the Biscayne National Park. Our pilot narrated the trip the whole way. We flew over the big cruise ships as we approached our landing. The pilot landed the plane in the middle of the bay with a perfect landing. We then met our boat and ferried back to the marina. Our experience was fun, exciting, and well worth the price. The team was very professional. My wife and I felt very safe with the whole flight operation.  If anyone else decides to book with this company, do not worry about the check in process, it will be ok. Hang in there, it is worth it. We met the owner during this tour. He is wonderful person. This is a small company that provides a great experience.  We highly recommend this trip.

We did the 1 hour Miami tour. It was a great trip and experience we saw a lot of Miami from the air. Tony was our pilot and he could tell us everything we flew over.Nice and funny guy, thank you Tony from the family Jansen from Holland

I took a chartered flight on Miami Seaplane Tours to Kamalame Cay in the Bahamas with my family, including my infant. Miami Seaplane Tour's operation was unsafe and unprofessional and put me and my family in danger.

The transfer to Kamalame Cay was -- and still is -- advertised on their website. The Sales team promised to “be in touch with the resort about bringing you and picking you up.”

It became clear upon nearing the hotel that this operator is not familiar with transferring hotel guests to Kamalame Cay and has never been in touch with the hotel. The pilot circled and seemed unsure of where to land. He did not fly with a radio so could not contact the hotel. He ultimately decided to touch down in a shallow area where planes are not meant to land. The situation was unsafe and the plane became beached. The hotel staff and my spouse had to get in the water and tow the plan to a safe, deeper water where a boat could pick us up (while my baby cried).

Naturally, I contacted Miami Seaplane Tours to cancel our return flight and request a partial refund. They refused to issue the refund. In fact, they wouldn't even acknowledge the circumstances and sent bizarre emails in response to my requests ("Glad to hear from you Lauren! 😃 We'll see you at 14:00 tomorrow. Weather is supposed to be outstanding. ☀️").

This operator falsely advertised a service and put our family at risk.

review_title: Brilliant driver, unforgettable experience. To do and redo urgently!
review_text: The views were magnificent, the guide friendly, the pilot very comfortable and competent! Passengers just need to be able to interact with the pilot using a microphone placed on the helmet. Magnificent experience!

review_title: Incredible tour of Miami area and Biscayne Bay
review_text: Our pilot (Alejandro) was as pro as they come. Top notch pilot and tour guide carrying on a family tradition of aviation in a wonderful way. Super knowledgeable about the area and history, he loves to show his passengers a new perspective and tell the story.  As a pilot myself, I’m telling you these guys are top notch, and they provided us so much more of South Florida in an hour than we could have gotten any other way.  Hope to return soon and do a bigger trip with them as there are many incredible options!

review_title: The best thing to do in Miami.
review_text:
Amazing experience. 

The booking and meeting is a little iffy. We booked online and met them at their 'office'. This is not a giant corporate operation, if you want a private trip, this is it. But understand you need to work with them a little. Just call them when you are heading over and talk to the guy, he will find you.

We met a guy in the lobby of a hotel, he took us on his boat into the bay.  Boat guy was great. very friendly and professional. 

At that point the plane landed on the water next to us and we hopped from the boat to the plane. Tony is the pilot and he was also very friendly and professional.

Plane ride was amazing. We were in the air about 45-50 min. Saw so much in such a short time. Pilot is 100% legit; I was very comfortable with him flying.

its a little expensive, but you get what you pay for and this was great. Will go again. Will recommend to anyone going to Miami.

for the meeting stop- go to the address listed. The lobby is where the cars go in next to the street. There will be a "V" on the doors. Take the elevator to the 2nd floor. Their office may be locked, just sit on the lobby couches and call the guy.

To our pilot and captain: thank you so much for having us. We enjoyed this so much.

This was amazing, start to finish I would have paid 2x-3x for this, it was that good. The experience was amazing, the take off the flight the landing - spectacular. I would recommend this for anyone and everyone going to Miami - one tip, you will take a boat from the shore to the plane, don't forget sunscreen - its HOT! But on the plane, the window is opening, its perfect!!

If you're going to Miami, make time for this experience.  It's mandatory Miami!

I had a lot of questions before booking and Nicole helped me through several phone calls.  Thanks Nicole!  Julio was our boat captain and took some awesome pictures of us with the skyline on the short ride to the plane, and kept us laughing the whole time.  Great job Julio!  Adriel was our pilot.  I've flown a lot and he's one of the best.  Super friendly, and having grown up in the area and as a flight instructor, knew every inch of Miami.  Pointed out all the scenes from movies, current and historical events, and TONS of eagle rays, sharks, turtles, and manatees.  Also explained a good deal about the DeHavilland Beaver we flew, which was comfortable, safe, spotless and obviously well maintained.  Thank you Adriel for an amazing flight!

I can't recommend this experience enough and outstanding job by everyone at Miami Seaplane.  You truly made our visit to Miami very special and a day we will always remember.

TIP: Get the tail number of the aircraft and search a flight tracker like FlightRadar24 for a map of your flight.

Fantastic passionate pilot (forget his name but he grew up in North Miami  Beach). He knew a lot about nature, and city development and you can tell he really enjoys his work. He also mad us feel very safe!

Wonderful experience! The pilot, Tony, was very nice and flew very smooth. I am afraid of flying but the tour was amazing. It’s only 30 minutes but it’s worth it. Aniel, the boat pilot that took us to the seaplane is also very charismatic and gentle. I definitely recommend and I will tour again next time with them.
Fantastic experience, highly recommend. Pilot was friendly, knowledgeable and fun. I wish I had done it sooner. I will definitely book again next time I'm in Sobe.
Would never recommend to deal with this company. The manager Nicolle over booking process was very rude and arrogant. Was trying to book a flight after my wedding in Miami.
The pilot was nice. The views were gorgeous. Definitely a great way to see more of Miami. I would totally recommend.
Family owned.  Very friendly and knowledgeable!  Beautiful views and amazing experience.  Unforgettable experience!
The experience was great right from the start... the pilot Aldo was awesome and very knowledgeable of the area... great tour.. don’t miss this one..

It was a perfect experience flying over Miami. Very nice staff, well organized. Very friendly pilot, he explained each places we pass by the seaplane! I highly recommend to do this activity if you go to Miami.

Great  flight adventure over Miami Beach and harbour in 4 seat seaplane . The arrangements were well planned and executed. The friendly pilot gave us a splendid commentary during the flight. We planned the trip en route to the airport after a cruise. The company kindly stored our luggage whilst we took our flight. A taxi rank is only 200 metres from their offices so you can easily make your own travel arrangements. We took the 30 minute sight seeing tour. I think that was just right.

This was a fantastic experience and very well organised.  The views were spectacular and the Pilot was very informative.  If you travel to Miami this is a must and you won't be disappointed, we loved it.

Thank you

We wanted to experience Biscayne National Park and this was an amazing way to do it. Our tour guide, Little Tony, grew up in the area and his love for it was evident in his guiding. His knowledge and experience was incredible and not only did we get spectacular views of the city, we saw sharks, whales, pelicans and manta rays.  Our start time got pushed out 30 minutes (they did email a heads up) and we had to wait on another plane before the short boat trip back to the starting point, but everything was first class. Would definitely recommend this outfit!

One boat took us from the Marine and in the middle of the islands we were transfered to the seaplane.
It was wonderful. 
I am local and I have experimented several tours in the area. This is very good. We took the tour around Downtown and Miami Beach and it was amazing. Really nice views and very smoothly flight, even when our pilot said it was a little windy.
Jorge and Aldo were our captains for the boat and for the seaplane. 
I am very pleased with the experience.
Advice: check weather before booking. Clear sky makes the experience even better.

review_title: A must for your visit to Miami
review_text: Great company, great pilot, and amazing experience.  You simply cannot go wrong!  Did the Stiltsville tour.
The two man crew on the boat to meet seaplane and then the pilot was very friendly and gracious. It was well worth the price. Very polite and enthusiastic about what they do👍👍👍👍
Great people, great service, great experience, can’t rate highly enough. Seaplane pilot gave great commentary, airboat guy was great. Showed us tons of stuff. Captain of boat was also great

review_title: survol de Miami beach avec TONY, un régal, une superbe expérience
review_text: Cela était une surprise pour mon Mari et on a adoré . Survolé l’île de Miami Beach est vraiment superbe. On a pu apercevoir des lamantins, Voir Miami de cette façon est fantastique. Tony, nous a tout expliqué on voit qu'il adore ce job. A faire sans hésiter vous ne le regretterai pas

100% recomendable, impresionantes vistas de toda la ciudad, trato inmejorable y servicio perfecto!
Sin duda, una experiencia inolvidable. Julio, Aldo y Tony, GRACIAS!

review_title: greatst views of miami and key biscayne
review_text: courteous service, nice plane, safe, spectacular views! Key biscayne looks amazing, so does downtown miami. it is not the best experience if you experience motion sickness. Otherwise is safe, not scary and worth the money.
It was really a treat to fly for my birthday. 30 minutes it's short, but really enjoyable tour in the miami area. Definitely I'd recommend it to anyone visiting or local

What a great trip! We’ve been to Miami many times and seen the Seaplanes taking off and landing on Biscayne Bay but didn’t appreciate you could go up in one. Our Captain/Pilot was great. Very knowledgeable and entertaining. Definitely recommended.

Der Rundflug war einfach Atemberaubend und ist in unseren Augen ein MUST-HAVE für den ersten Miami-Besuch. Da man nicht jeden Tag mit einem Seaplane unterwegs ist, ist selbst das schon der Wahnsinn. Dazu der super liebe und kompetente Pilot, der seine Stadt nicht nur wie seine eigene Westentasche kennt und zu allem etwas sagen kann. Ein super großes Dankeschön an einen freundlichen, emphatischen Piloten!

We had a short trip to southern Florida, and this excursion was truly the best way to experience both Miami and the Everglades in a matter of hours. 

Our pilot, Adriel, was a super cool guy, and the type of guide that you'd remember as equally as the experience itself. He was friendly, easy-going, and very knowledgeable about the region, the aircraft, and low-altitude flights. 

Our take-offs and landings were seamless on both ends of tour. The flight along the Miami skyline and beaches was super fun, and the airboat portion of the trip was equally as educational and entertaining as everything else. 

One note worth throwing in.... This excursion was literally the last thing we were doing before heading to the airport to catch our flights home, so we arrived at our "meeting spot" (random parking lot near the water), via an UBER with our luggage in hand. There was not a company office available to store our luggage in while we were on the tour. Thankfully, our pilot was able to accommodate our two carry-on suitcases and two backpacks in the very small space behind our seats on the plane, otherwise I don't know where we would have left it for the duration of the tour.

Wow! Why didn’t we do this sooner? What a great experience flying over the city, the bay and the ocean. Our pilot and tour guide was a native Miamian (who knew there were any) who brought his own special knowledge and passion for the city to life for us. From take off to touch down we were engaged by his stories and history lessons and blown away by the views of the skyline, the islands, the mansions and the stiltsville shacks. The most memorable part of the trip may well have been flying over Biscayne Bay National Park and seeing sharks, stingrays and schools of fish just a few miles from downtown. The trip really did give us a whole new perspective on the city and the environment. 
We can’t wait to plan our next flight!
What a fun trip! the flight to the Everglades was visually stunning. Our pilot was extremely friendly and informative. The airboat ride was amazing. The captain was very knowledgeable.

The initial contact by email was very professional and friendly. The flight had amazing views of the city surroundings and south beach, we felt very comfortable with the pilot and seaplane. 
Great time, great experience, we would do it anytime again. Thanks !

I've been wanting to fly on a seaplane for ages, and when my parents came to visit it seemed like a perfect time to check it off the list.
We took our tour on a DeHavilland Beaver, and from the very start, our guide was great- he even carried me out to the plane so I wouldn't get my shoes wet! He gave us a history of the plane itself as we prepared for take off on the water, and continued to trickle in facts about the sights we were flying over. There was enough info to be interesting without being overbearing, so we could still enjoy the experience. The scenery was beautiful and covered a lot of ground (and sea, ha!)- we even saw manatees from the plane!
Definitely recommend and would love to take another sea plane outing!

review_title: Miami Seaplane and Everglades Airboat Tour.. A.M.A.Z.I.N.G.
review_text: Wow where to begin ...This was one of the Best Ever Tours we’ve ever done. Our Seaplane Capt Anderson was Brilliant, I’ve been on a bigger Seaplane before but never one so small this 1969 Cessna 101 packs a big punch, Truly was an  incredible experience. Capt Anderson Talked us through the whole flight. The views over the Miami skyline to the Everglades were pretty incredible...Stunning in fact...Once we landed on the Everglades our Airboat Tour Guides were  waiting to greet us, Wow what another fabulous experience this was our first time on an Airboat and our Guide was so knowledgeable of the area and introduced us to many different sizes of Alligators we managed to get close up and personal with them while our Guide fed them bread allowing us to touch the skin on their  backs and leg pretty awesome experience. After our Everglades tour which lasted about 45mins to 1hr we linked back up with Capt Anderson for our Seaplane flight back to Miami on our return journey Capt Anderson gave us a nice tour of the Miami skyline with more great  commentary.. This really was a Birthday Treat of a lifetime, absolutely Loved it..This is the best way to see the  Everglades do it in style...Highly Recommend... Thank You Capt Anderson for being a terrific Pilot...

This was one of the most amazing tours we have done. Reservations were made easily online and a followup with Mr Jack was impressive. He is helpful, courteous and very sweet. He answered all of our questions and left us messages confirming.

Tony the pilot is a true professional!  But not only good but so warm and personable as only a Miami pilot could be.  His commentary was just right. You can tell that he loves what he does.

The airboat tour was great - on time, fun, safe - and we saw alligators, turtles, fish, egrets and more.

We will book another tour next year!
Thanks,
Heidi & Herta not only good but so warm and personable as only a Miami pilot could be.  His commentary was just right. You can tell that he loves what he does.

The airboat tour was great - on time, fun, safe - and we saw alligators, turtles, fish, egrets and more. Nice to contribute to and learn about the Miccosukee Indian Tribe.

We will book another tour next year!
Thanks,
Heidi & Herta
Such a great experience to take off and land on water,   Bimini beaches are beautiful, Tony our pilot was wonderful and went beyond our expectations. Just  do it !

Incredible and unforgettable - we did the Ultimare Miami & Beaches tour lasting one hour. 

Our pilot Adriel was a South Floridian and shared loads of fascinating facts and stories throughout the flight. 

Highly recommend this to anyone! Amazing way to see the Miami area in a new way.

Tony was a fantastic pilot. The views were out of this world and he explained the sights to us, was so helpful getting us on the plane, and just all around great to fly with. Very much recommend this and we are already talking about going again. We took off and landed in Islamorada, flew down to marathon and back, tour of the lighthouses, reefs.... loved seeing the sea turtles from the air, that Tony pointed out. I wish I could go every day.

review_title: Fantastic experience -- a great way to see the Miami skyline and beaches
review_text: We did the hour long Miami City and Beaches tour -- it was great fun, and Tony was an excellent pilot and guide. Definitely recommended.

Nous avons été très bien accueilli, l’horaire est respecté! Un personnel sympa!
Super vol en sécurité! De magnifique vues à couper le souffle!
Rien à redire! Mais à refaire sans hésiter!

Hele leuke ervaring, zeker een aanrader om te doen als je in Miami bent. 30 minuten ook precies genoeg om goede indruk te krijgen. Piloot was een leuke onderhoudende man, die ook tijdens de vlucht alle vragen beantwoordt.

**DONT WASTE YOUR TIME OR MONEY!** Very lousy customer service. Response time was well over a month, almost 2! Multiple phone calls went unanswered, it is very difficult to speak with anyone there. I couldn’t imagine trying to book from a different time zone which is very odd for a travel site. My last attempt was to send a message on 10/08. It was finally answered on 11/27. 7 WEEKS! And to top it off all their response said was to contact them on a different portal!! WHAT?! I don’t think so. Their explanation is that they’re just to busy to respond? Very disappointed as we are planning quite the trip and we’re really looking forward to the seaplane. Fortunately there are a few different tours to choose from in FL and the islands. I highly suggest exploring your options before even attempting to book with this lousy company. I also suggest that Miami Seaplane take some time to adapt a better way of booking and learn a few customer service skills. It’s almost 2019. Time to get with it and step up to take care of your customers. Or soon you won’t have any.

Great experience, the pilot was personable and very knowledgeable about the area.  He pointed out many areas of interest, and knew a lot of the history of the various areas.  Highly recommend this tour!.  Don't arrive too early though - there waiting area is unattended and minimal.  Wear shoes/clothes that can get wet, and if you have mobility issues let them know before booking the tour. The boarding facilities are minimal also, and it is a seaplane!

Would defitnetly recommend this to locals and visitors alike 
Michael was great and shared an incredible tour with us 
GO and book this NOW!
You won't regret it

We took the 1-hour flight with my family and it was a truly amazing experience. The pilot was very friendly and made ourselves confortable from our arrival to the end. He provided clear and interesting comments throughout the flight, pointing out remarkable building, houses, islands and... wildlife (we saw tens of manatees, one shark and a few eagle rays). The flight was smooth, acceptably noisy, and the windows were clean enough to take good pictures. 

It does cost a few bucks but it is definitely worth if you are looking for an original experience around Miami !
We went on the skyline tour and had a great time with Michael. Saw some wildlife from high up in the air and the stunning Miami skyline and Miami Beach scenery.

Excellente visite de Miami! L’on y découvre tout Miami Beach, Virgina Key, Key Byscane, les îles aux villas luxueuses (star Island et d’autres).
Décollage et amerrissage sont impressionnants, mais ne secouent pas trop.
Très bien organisé, horaire respecté ! Le site de départ se trouve facilement. Nous avons trouvé le pilote (Michael) très sympa, pro et très accueillant ! Il nous a proposé spontanément et gratuitement de nous prendre en photos avec nos smartphones (contrairement à d’autres visites de ce genre, dont le tour en hélico àNY!)
Le tour a duré près de 40 minutes, contre 30 sur le papier.
On recommande fortement

review_title: Beste Möglichkeit Miami Beach von oben zu erkunden!
review_text: Geniale Tour, einfache Buchung, tolle Abwicklung und ein einmaliges Erlebnis! Jederzeit wieder würde ich ein ein Wasserflugzeug von Miami Seaplanes steigen! TOP TOP TOP!

I met my husband in Miami at the end of his business trip and he surprised me with this excursion! The meet up for the Sea Plane is at the end of a gravel road near a marina, since the plane was late I had no idea even though there’s a large sign. What a surprise when the plane arrived! Adriel, our pilot could not have been a more phenomenal person or tour guide/pilot! Personal stories interspersed with the history of the area made the tour fascinating. The trip back from the Everglades was a special treat as my husband was able to sit in the co-pilot seat! We flew in between two thunderstorms and had a bird eye’s view of the Miami coastline and the Everglades! So spectacular. The Miccosukee Tribe of Indians Everglades tour was wonderful as well. Guided by Fabian, he took us to points of interest and personally called out several alligators who swam up to the boat. A small island topped off the tour where he shared his tribes’ history and way of life. It was a Magnificent trip!!

Very professional Company! I searched many ideas online, as I was planning for a special marriage proposal to my girlfriend. I was looking for something out-of-the-ordinary, adventurous, but yet romantic. Miami Seaplane Tours popped up in my search and ideas started swimming in my head. From my first email inquiry, to planning the trip (months in advance), Miami Seaplane Tours was an absolute pleasure to work with. Their customer service was bar none! I had many questions and requests. Nicolle assisted in every way possible; she made me feel very comfortable, and if there was a question that she didn’t have an answer to (trust me, I threw a few curve balls at her), she promptly got the answer or offered a suggestion. 

Operation Bimini Twist begins. The trip was from Miami to Bimini, Bahamas, and had to be surprise; I mean I was proposing. Miami Seaplane Tours played along with my plan, which was to pretend I won this trip through a raffle. The day before the trip was planned for, Nicolle got me in touch with the Pilot Tony. This was my chance to introduce myself to Tony prior to meeting and prepare a game plan for the day, and make sure we were on the same page. Tony flew a flawless trip over-and-back. He put the plane down in the multiple shades of blue/green water parallel to the coastline better than any professional airliner pilot could put a plane down on a stationary runway. We ended up flying over together (side-by-side) with another plane from Miami Seaplane Tours piloted by Adriel (we were cool!). 

Tony ended up being our tour guide for the day when we got to the island. The one thing Miami Seaplane Tours has no control over, is “Island Time”, you just roll with it. We couldn’t have asked for a more perfect day. Tony knew all the right places to take us to in the short time we had planned for (again, I was on a mission more than anything). Later in the afternoon, Tony brought us to a “Slice of Paradise” where I got down on one knee and asked those famous words. I want to note, not only is Tony an awesome pilot, he’s a pretty damn good photographer also. Unbeknownst to us, we accomplished getting our engagement photos out of the trip as well. With about one hour till we had to depart, it gave us just enough time for a quick dip into the amazing salt water, then we were on our way back to Miami after a quick rinse in the showers at the Marina. 

She Said YES!

We didn't know much about seaplanes before, however I could tell you now the experience is worth the money and you will definitely come away with an experience never to forget!

I also have to mention the pilot we had was awesome! His name was Michael. He did an awesome job telling us about the area. We took the hour tour and we didn't feel bored for a second! He was very entertaining and definitely reccomend him!

Thank You Michael!!!
You gave us the tour of our lifetime!!

This was a 18th birthday present for my son. Definitely a must if time is short and you want to visit the Everglades. The pilot was incredibly Knowledgeable, helpful and friendly. He constantly gave us information in a way that only someone who has lived there all his life could.

We took the Miami Skyline tour for 30 minutes - it's only $25 more than the South Beach tour and it gives you 15 minutes more so it makes sense!

It was the best thing which we did over 10 days in Miami - absolutely breathtaking and very 'Miami' rather than taking the helicopter option! 

Our pilot was really friendly and kept us updated with information on the local area throughout the tour. Any reservations you had flying in such a small plane were put the rest. I think the pilots name was Michael O'something (I can't remember the second part) but he was great! 

It may seem like a pretty pricey trip to do however it is SO worth it and you get exactly what you pay for. Absolutely once in a lifetime experience.

review_title: MUST DO once in your lifetime.
review_text:
This was a birthday present for my husband who loves aviation. Adrien was our pilot & he was phenomenal in fact phenomenal just doesn't do him justice. He is EXTREMELY knowledgeable with the area & peppers you with information the ENTIRE way through. What an amazing learning experience & what a blessing to fly with some one born & raised in the area who is so passionate about flying and the surrounding Everglades. As if flying over the city wasn't enough we saw the Everglades & landed to catch a spectacular airboat ride with another expert, Junior by name who also encompassed a wealth of knowledge about the "grass river".

We live in Miami and highly recommend to our fellow Miamians to tour your own city/surrounding area & do it with Miami Seaplane.

Bin durch Zufall auf Miami Seaplane Tours gestoßen und nicht enttäuscht worden. Super cooles Erlebnis auf dem Wasser starten und zu landen. Unser Pilot war sehr sehr freundlich. Kleiner Tipp: Bucht den Flug über Groupon. Ist um einiges günstiger.

This was my son's 30th birthday surprise! I wanted something unique and unforgettable; Through the years ussually you will forget where did you eat, what did you eat or if you got a belt, a shirt or something like that... but you will never forget an experience like this one! I scheduled a 1 hour tour for my husband, my son and I, It was an amazing experience, Tony, our pilot was very nice, friendly and explained every single step and guided our tour pointing out landmarks. Always felt safe and comfortable. My next trip will be the romantic getaway for keywest. Thank you Tony for making my son's birthday this special!

Best experience, last minute booking and very very fair price. We we're looling for a last minute birthday gift and we found sea plane through trip advisor. We booked and flew to Bimmini for the day and took also tje private tour through the island. Best experience ever !!! Thank you tripadvisor and big thank you to Toni !!!
Es war ein wunderschönes Erlebnis. Sehr netter Pilot, wunderschöne Aussicht mit interessanten Erklärungen des Piloten!

Coordinating a weekend getaway was so simple with Nicolle and team. Nicolle responding quickly with every question and found the best possible place for us to stay. Our pilot was prompt picking us up and gave us first class treatment in Bimini. An incredible high touch personal experience with this team. I would 100% recommend anyone to plan a trip with Miami Seaplanes :) You will love it!

Une découverte complète de la ville en remontant la plage de Miami vers le nord et retour par la skyline d’immeuble. 
Ensuite tour complet de Key Biscayne. 
Mike notre pilote était très cool, et explique pas mal de chose durant le vol. 
Décollage et atterrissage super doux, le Cessna n’est pas de première jeunesse mais c’est l’outil parfait pour ce type de vol car la visibilité depuis le cockpit est parfaite. 
La réservation c’est faite le jour même par téléphone et sans problème. Ensuite vous recevez par mail un voucher avec les explications. 
Indiquer Whisky Joe Bar a l’entrée de la Marina pour venir en Uber. Ensuite 100m à pied sur le parking en gravier le long du causeway. 
N’hésitez pas le tarif est raisonnable.

review_title: Personnel sympathique mais vieil avion dangereux
review_text:
Nous y sommes allés le 09 mai a 14h30 via une un premier contact par mail et une personne qui nous a proposé une offre tarifaire : 406$ les 2 adultes et 2 enfants

Endroit de départ très compliqué à trouver même avec notre GPS et il fut très difficile pour moi de me faire guider en Anglais au téléphone.

Pilote d'avion qui vous accueille et vous donne les consignes de sécurité très sympathique cependant l'avion est vieillissant à tel point que la porte n’arrêtait pas de s'ouvrir pendant tout le vol elle ne tenait pas fermé.

Fort heureusement l'avion n'est pas pressurisé mais je ne vous dis pas la panique à bord à tenir avec sa main la porte pendant tout le vol afin que elle ne s'ouvre pas !

Absolument pas rassurant surtout avec des enfants qui vous demande pourquoi la porte est ouverte !!

Je n'y retournerai pas avec cette compagnie même si la vue du ciel est magnifique : j'irai mais avec une autre compagnie ou je serai plus attentif avant le décollage sur l'état général de l'appareil ...

A must to do on your vacation to Miami.
Our pilot Adrian, was the best! Very friendly and made you very welcome, also very informative with loads of interesting facts about miami .
You won't be disappointed,  the best way to see miami. Thankyou Adrian and the team.

We took the hour flight. Our pilot did a safety talk first and helped us onto the plane. He explained what was happening when we took off from the water and fully briefed us about the things we were flying over and pointing out the hotels. It was so exciting. He asked if we were ok. He took photos of us. He helped us off at the end and offered my husband a towel to dry his feet. So pleased we did the hour flight. Great views.

Wir gingen direkt vor Ort vorbei, um die Buchung zu tätigen, da es telefonisch für uns etwas kompliziert war. Die Betreuung vor Ort durch den Piloten war jedoch perfekt. Schon das besteigen des Flugzeuges war ein Erlebnis. Starten und landen auf dem Wasser einfach cool! Eine tolle Sicht über Miami Beach, Star- und Fisher-Island, usw. Ein aussergewöhnlich tolles Erlebnis, absolut empfehlenswert!

Aufgrund der Wetterbedingungen muss man etwas flexibel sein, was die Uhrzeit betrifft. Haben für 4 Uhr gebucht und mussten letztlich um 3 da sein.
Der Pilot Mike hat uns herzlich empfangen und der Flug selbst war ein Traum. Er hat uns alle wichtigen und schönen Plätze gezeigt und spannende Infos dazu gegeben. Dabei nimmt er auch auf aktuelle Besonderheiten Rücksicht. Wir sind zB über eine Bucht geflogen, wo gerade ein paar Manatees geschwommen sind.
Würde ich immer wieder machen.

Absolutely fantastic experience and Michael did a superb job to show us Miami from a completely different perspective. I was at first considering a helicopter flight but found some reviews telling that some people have been seated in the back-middle which led to seeing less and uncomfortable flight. Definitely recommend this one!

Awesome trip with Tony and Miami seaplane. I have always wanted to do a seaplane trip to Bimini and snorkel. Tony and the crew made it happen, even to the point of finding me a snorkel guide and loaning me cash once we got there (FYI always bring plenty of cash to The Bahamas) 
First class trip. First class guy. First class operation.

Un pilote très chaleureux et avenant nous reçoit avec beaucoup d explications sur la prestation. Vol tres agreable de trente minutes pour decouvrir un autre aspect de Miami, de ses plages et iles voisines. Vue superbe des plages et des constructions mais aussi un tour pour l observation des Manatee (Lamantins) que nous avons bien vus et de quelques raies par chance. Promenade dans le ciel qui laisse de superbes souvenirs d autant que le pilotage est tout en douceur et sécurité. A refaire !! Un tres bon rapport qualité / plaisirs / prix !!

From the first moment Tony put us in a relaxed mood 
After introduction and seating in the plane we took off across the water for a very visible and knowledgeable journey to Everglades park . Seeing Miami from the air on both journeys with a running cometary.
Everglades park was stunningly remote with a local guide from Native stock our Airboat trip was full of thrills and wildlife.

While on vacation we scheduled a flight around Miami Beach and Biscayne Key.  I explained that I was a student pilot flying Cessna 172s and Michael was very through in explaining the differences in flying a seaplane version.  He was also detailed in pointing out landmarks and operation of the plane.  I would recommend this tour and Michael to anyone that enjoys flying and the views from above.

review_title: Excelentes vistas de la ciudad y animales marinos
review_text: La mejor manera de ver Miami. Realizamos el tour de 30minutos, el piloto va explicando todo lo que ves y un poco de la historia de la ciudad, super profesional y amable. A demás pudimos apreciar la reserva de manatíes y vimos delfines nadando. Vale la pena el precio, lo volvería a hacer.

My wife and I took this tour in December. The weather was perfect and the view was amazing from the top. Our pilot, Michael, was very friendly. He gave us a nice tour of all the buildings, manatees etc. The whole experience of taking off from, and landing on, the sea is pretty amazing. The plane itself is small but cozy and feels pretty safe.

This was a wonderful tour, that allowed us to enjoy not only the sea plane ride but also the amazing views of Miami and it's surroundings.  Mike, the Pilot was extremely professional, competent and put us completely at ease. Nicole, who managed our booking, was very warm and accommodating when we had to reschedule. 
In general we would recommend this activity, as a very romantic and exciting adventure. Don't be afraid to get your feet a bit wet :-)

Our pilot Michael took us on amazing tour through the Miami skies. My girlfriend invited me on this trip for my birthday... ohhh what a perfect present!!
Even though I’ve flown this route before, during my private pilot lessons, it was lots of fun to do it as a passenger and even more fun during takeoff and the landing in water.
Highly recommended!!
My husband and I had a wonderful experience. Michael was so outgoing and so nice! It's a great way to see the city from above.
Thanks to Michael for a great tour of SoBe! I was nervous but he made us feel right at ease even with the windy conditions! Would definitely book again and recommend to friends!

We recently went on the this tour and our gps for Uber sent us completely in the wrong way so important in Miami to put every detail of the address! so we arrived about and hour and half late. The pilot was so nice to accommodate us and still take us up. The flight was lovely and the pilot was so good at telling us lots about various places and building. Very nice trip would do the day time one nice time I’m over. Really so so helpful

If you are undecided whether to do this trip or not - DO IT - you will not regret it. 

We booked the 30 minute flight via viator (worked out about £197 for two people)  and met Michael at the Miami Seaplane tour location. We hired a car and had a sat nav which made it easy to find but it was signposted well enough nearby. 

It was fantastic as the plane only first 4 people including the pilot, so if you are a couple, unless someone books alone, it is as good as a private tour. 

Our pilot, Michael, was absolutely excellent, very Jolly, on time, and extremely knowledgable of the surrounding area. We felt safe and in good hands with him from the pre-flight checks to getting off the seaplane. He was also happy to take photos of us and we couldn’t have asked for better service. 

The aerial view of Miami is incredible, and we were also able to see Manatees  which was fantastic. 

I can not recommend this trip enough - the feeling of taking off and landing on water was incredible. 

BOOK THIS ASAP!

My husband and I took a seaplane tour for his birthday. It was absolutely incredible! The views were breathtaking and such an amazing way to see Miami. Our pilot, Michael, was knowledgeable, professional, and so much fun. He was a such a joy to have as a pilot; he really brought the experience to the next level. He even went out of his way to make sure we saw manatees in the bay. Would book again in a heartbeat.

WOW! What an amazing flight! My husband and I booked the "Ultimate Miami & Beaches Tour" for our staycation honeymoon, and had the most incredible experience. Adriel warmly greeted us upon arrival, and let us watch and ask questions as he prepped the plane. Captain Tony is beyond awesome, and gave us the most magical tour of our hometown city. The view was spectacular - words can't do it justice. We had the privilege of seeing tons of manatee warming up in the canals during our Miami "winter" and even took our kayak out the next day to visit some of the beautiful spots that we could never had discovered without that glorious bird's-eye view provided by Captain Tony. A million thanks to Seaplane Tour of Miami for gifting us with the most amazing honeymoon excursion a couple could ask for. We can't wait to take another trip with this wonderful father/son duo!

review_title: Great flight over SoBe with Michael!
review_text: Our pilot, Michael, gave us a wonderful flight tour over South Beach. I got the flight as a Christmas gift for my husband and we weren't disappointed! The pilot was knowledgeable, and incredibly personable/friendly. Amazing views (especially Fisher Island and flying over the Seaquarium), smooth flight, and a gorgeous morning on the water. Also kudos to Nicole for handling my multiple phone calls for information and confirmation professionally and competently. Thanks again!

review_title: Sehr schöner Flug! Aus der Luft sieht man mehr!
review_text: Toller Flug über Key Biscanyne, Miami Beach und Miami. Seekühe beim Grasen, Kite-Surfer, Sandbänke, Wolkenkratzer, Villenviertel, Strand und Meer: Alles was Miami und Miami Beach ausmacht. Sehr freundlicher Pilot und ein in positivem Sinn einfaches Flugzeug mit hervorragenden Sichtverhältnissen.

Magique, extraordinaire

Le pilote que nous avons eu (parmi 3) n’est pas commercial pour un sou, il est passionné tant par Miami que par la faune et la flore.  
Il nous a fait voir des lamantins, des requins et des raies. !!! Si si. Et il est revenu plusieurs fois à leur recherche en tournant. Pour nous permettre dès les voir 
Enfin. L’hydravion est vraiment  charmant.

Bestens betreut und informiert durch unseren Piloten Michael erlebten wir einen   unvergesslichen,  phantastischen Rundflug um Miami und Miami Beach bei optimalem Fotowetter. Absolut empfehlenswert.
Tipps: Bei Anfahrt genaue Adresse ins Navi eingeben und Strandsandalen anziehen (Wasserflugzeug!)

review_title: Miami Seaplane Roundtrip to Bimini, Bahamas
review_text:
OUTSTANDING SERVICE! 

Nicole was very patient and worked with us on every question and concerns we had regarding our round trip seaplane ride to Bimini, Bahamas. We left from Miami Seaplane Base in Key Biscayne and landed at Resort World Bimini within 40 minutes. The flight was very pleasant and Tony made sure we were all comfortable. Tony is a not only a great pilot but also very caring. I had my 70 year old mother with me and he was very nice in assisting her in and out of the plane. 

Thanks Tony and Nicole. We will be back!

Superbe expérience! Nous avons combiné un vol en hydravion avec un tour en bateau dans les Everglades au milieu des alligators.
Toute l'équipe était vraiment sympathique.  L'accueil dans les 2 sites était parfait et chaleureux. Tout au long du vol, le commandant donne des infos sur les paysages.  Très intéressant. L'avion est confortable et sécurisant.
A faire lors de votre visite de Miami!

It was amazing, booked by phone and in the air only two hours later. We had booked an one hour flight over Miami and it was unforgettable. Fantastic views, best weather and a perfect pilot. We definitly will come back again.

One of the highlights of my stay in Miami. Incredible views. You really get to see the beauty of Miami:  the beaches, the skylines, the turquoise blue sea and the homes of the stars. Tony the pilot is a legend. So friendly and clearly loves his job and Miami. I have already recommended Miami Seaplanes to a few people. It's a treat, and great value for what you get.

Découvrir KEY Biscayne, Coral Gables, South Beach par les airs est une expérience inoubliable. Notre pilote Tony connaît parfaitement les domaines survolé.
Attention, l’accès à l’avion n’est pas des plus aisé pour quelqu’un qui a un problème de mobilité. Mettre de tongs et des shorts.

review_title: A great adventure for both locals and tourists!
review_text: As a Miami native, I can't believe it took my husband and I so long to try this. You get a totally different perspective of Miami. You realize how beautiful it really is and how lucky you are to live in such a vibrant city. Loved the ride!

Wir haben einen Rundflug über Miami mit Tony und seinem historischen Wasserflugzeug ( De Havilland Bj: 1952 ) gemacht. Ich habe den Flug von meiner Frau zum Geburtstag geschenkt bekommen und wir waren voll begeistert!!
Tony fliegt diese Maschiene schon seit 20 Jahren und er erzählt immer gerade etwas davon wo er drüber fliegt. Es hat riesig Spass gemacht und wir werden wieder mitfliegen, gerne auch mal länger bis Key West. Das Wasser war so klar Übrigens, dass wir von oben Stingrays und Seekühe sahen.
Sascha und Elisabeth

Une expérience inoubliable ! L'équipe est très accueillante et sympathique. Le pilote donne diverses informations tout au long du vol et toujours avec le sourir ! Nous recommandons fortement cette activité que ce soit en famille ou entre amis!

Nous avons choisi la sortie en hydravion, et nous n'avons pas regretter notre choix.
Le spectacle est magnifique et Toni est un guide excellent, je recommande vivement cette sortie pour les plages vue du ciel,Miami Beach, et une partie de Miami.
Les 30 minutes ont été superbe.
Malgré nos quelques minutes de retard Toni nous a attendu sans problème, en plus il nous a donné des adresses pour les Everglades.

Merci Toni
