My wife and I enjoyed pleasant moments that made us return to the time of child. Very interesting also by the contact with several marine animals that inhabit this park

This trip was amazing. We booked the Ultimate Miami SeaPlane Tour prior to arriving in Miami and on the day called (as advised) to check that the flight was still going ahead and not affected by the weather. We got a taxi to the location and waited for our pilot to arrive in style. Tony was our pilot and he did just that, landing on the water and then greeting us at the gate. 
Tony gave us a great impression and happily took photos of us with the plane before helping us aboard. You do step in the water so flip flops or water shoes are required. 
The take off was extremely smooth and we were quickly in the air flying over Miami. It was absolutely beautiful. Tony was brilliant, pointing out loads of interests and giving us information on the area and how it has changed over the years. 
I couldn't recommend this tour enough, Miami is beautiful and seeing it from the sky really makes your trip. 

The only improvement that we felt was needed was the meeting location, it was at the end of a lane and fenced off, although other reviews had said the same thing it did leave us feeling nervous about whether they were going to turn up. Don't let this put you off though, as it is well worth it once you are in the air. 

Thanks for our amazing experience.

review_title: Trip Miami - Key West - Everglades - Miami
review_text: Once in a lifetime experience!! We've had an amazing time with our pilot and tour guide Antonio, it felt like a two week holiday on a single day!

We did the Ultimate Seaplane Tour on Saturday afternoon and thoroughly enjoyed it from start to finish.

The location is at the end of a gravel track in a little portacabin, but it was easy enough for us to find.  

Our pilot (Mike) was great - he was super friendly and very knowledgeable!  He talked through the whole hour flight with lots of interesting facts.  He also asked us what types of things we wanted to see (massive houses vs. marine wildlife) to tailor the tour accordingly.  

You get to see a lot on the one hour tour and it's definitely worth doing if you can afford it - it really is an experience that you wont forget for a long time!

You need to cross a bit of shallow water to board the plane so you will need either water-proof shoes or the ability to take off your shoes and roll-up your trousers!

Highly recommended!

Expérience inoubliable !  Même en se promenant longtemps dans la ville on n'imagine pas ce qu'on loupe. L'hydravion permet de ne rien manquer et de découvrir une nouvelle perspective de l'ensemble de la ville: Biscayne, Virginia, Little Havana, Downtown, South Beach, les riches demeures,les canaux, l'océan....
De plus le pilote était très très chaleureux et nous indiquait les choses à voir. Possibilité de monter en copilote ou à l'arrière (grandes fenêtres).
Pour y accéder: première sortie à gauche sur Rickenbacker et suivez le chemin en terre sur la gauche pour trouver une cabane de bois.

We flew to Key West for the weekend, and it took us a little over an hour to arrive. Beats the 4-hour drive! The view is spectacular, and Tony was a fantastic pilot. He was informative and very funny. I'm a chicken when it comes to flying, but this took my breath away. I would do it again in a heartbeat. Highly recommend Miami Seaplane Tours!!

My wife, daughter and I were on our way to Andros Island in the Bahamas and we thought booking a charter through Miami Seaplane to get us there might be a neat experience.   It was fantastic!

Nicolle was amazing as she helped us with our reservation details.  She was very patient with my endless list of questions and she always responded to my inquiries right away.  She helped us with a few luggage issues and worked hard to accommodate all of our needs.

Tony was our pilot.  What a great guy!  He's also a great pilot.  I've been on many float planes before, but I've never seen a pilot land one as smoothly as Tony did on this trip.  His ability to thread the (cloud) needle was also very impressive.  He helped us successfully navigate the Customs/Immigration office in Bimini and he even waited in the Customs office for us so that we could grab a quick bite to eat while the officers arrived.  

The flight was indescribably beautiful.  The Caribbean Sea is gorgeous from the shore in my opinion, but the view from 2000 feet was more than breathtaking.  Tony made sure to point out all the landmarks we passed on the way as well as letting us know when we were about to pass over a ray or shark on the flats.  The flight has forever left my family with many great memories.

Unfortunately when it was time for us to return Tropical Storm Emily showed up and we had to, for safety reasons, make other arrangements to get home.  One would expect the folks at Miami Seaplane Tours to simply say "see ya next time" but that is not what happened.  Nicolle kept me updated on the situation hourly.  It worked best for me to make arrangements for my wife and daughter to fly home via New York so they could avoid the storm.  I needed to get to Miami to collect some of our luggage (We were in North Carolina the week before our trip to Andros and we had more "stuff" packed than we could safely take on the Seaplane) so I flew to Miami via Atlanta just as the storm subsided.  Miami was a bit of a mess after the storm.  In some parts of the city people were actually kayaking instead of driving.  Despite this Tony went and collected our bags from the storage area and delivered them to me personally.  That was over and above the call of duty in my opinion, but the Miami Seaplane Tours folks take their customer service seriously!

My wife and I are small business owners and it's always fun for us to see how other people run their small businesses.  Some (more than a few to be honest) small businesses have lousy service and terrible people working for them.  Miami Seaplane Tours is just the opposite..................their customers receive great service from simply wonderful people.

I can't wait to fly with them again!

review_title: One of a Kind SoFlo experience!
review_text:
My 11 year old son and myself rode in the Cessna 172 pictured on this page. We booked a 1 hour "Ultimate Tour" and had picture perfect weather.  Initially, I was a little concerned because the location on Rickenbacker Causeway seemed like a backup or satellite location (Better signage would help), and when no one was there 15 minutes after our appt timed, I called.  No sooner than this, Capt Adrian appeared with the plane.

Once on shore, he immediately apologized and took ownership, stating the cause of the delay (Honesty and responsibility? +10 points!)  We then loaded quickly, had a quick safety review, then the engine started. We started gliding across the water, and quicker than I thought, we were airborne!

We were airborne in no time and headed out over the main beach.  For anyone not used to low level flying, prepare to be amazed and what you can see, and the overall experience!  Amazing detail, and you experience Miami and the earth in a whole new way.  Being overhead also gives a new dimension to the water, which you can now see through to the bottom in most places.

But nowhere is this better than flying over Biscayne National Park, which is entirely underwater.  Our pilot/instructor Adrian narrated the entire flight, explaining sites, significance, history, and even one illegal lobster trap!  

The water here spans the full pallet of blue to green, with an emphasis on unbelievable glowing light blue that my camera sadly couldn't duplicate.  Depths of water here ranged from 10" to 8 feet, and you can easily spot lots of rays and sharks, especially when we dipped low, and slowed a bit.

Yes, this is a bit more expensive, but any type of aviation is not cheap. But the dividends are well worth it, and formed memories for my son that will last a lifetime!

Great Job Miami Seaplanes! We will be back!

My husband and I did the Ultimate tour for 1 hour - worth every dollar! The ocean was beautiful and all the buildings & islands. We loved taking off and landing in the water. Really cool - should definitely try this if you get a chance.

Geweldig om het watervliegtuig te nemen. Prachtige uitzicht op Miami, de eilanden, stiltville, de vuurtoren en de stranden. Grote, echt grote nurse sharks gezien! Superaardige piloot die de geboekte Ultimate tour helemaal waarmaakte! Ben je in de gelegenheid, doe deze. Bij mij kan deze van de bucketlist😀

Wow! A must do when you are even near the Miami area. I moved to Miami in 1984 and I now live about 90 miles north of Miami. This is a must do and do yourself a favor and take the one hour tour. It is totally worth the money and you will see so much more. No wonder I fell in love with this town way back then. The tour was phenomenal. Tony was outstanding, fun and informative. And so SAFE!!!! Better than flying commercial for sure! If I could give Tony and Miami Seaplane more than Excellent, I would. What a fun, adventurous experience! Do not miss it. It is worth every single penny! I love Miami and Miami Seaplane rides. Will do it again and charter a flight with them as well! AWESOME!

Tony, our pilot, is just awesome! We had a blast! We took the 1 hour "Ultimate" tour and it was well worth it. Nicole was very helpful making reservations and you will never forget the views! Do yourself a favor and take a tour on a Miami Seaplane with Tony! You will be glad you did.

review_title: Great idea for Little Palm Island
review_text: Definitely the best way to get to the keys, and specifically to Little Palm Island. Pilots are super kind! and Winston and Nicole in the office helped me with the booking. Best price as well! Thank you!

review_title: Unmissable if you are in Miami!
review_text: Miami seaplane tour was the best experience ever. That view is just spectacular breathtaking... To take off and land on the water makes it even more unique. The pilot ( I think his name is Adriel if I remember well, not sure, I was over excited and unfortunately the 2 pilots name are not mentioned on their web site ...but should be) Anyway he was very informative and extra cool because he literally took me to the plane in hands just not to get my shoes wet. Just had the most incredible seaplane tour over Miami & South Florida including the beautiful Biscayne Key national park (which is mostly under the clearest water). A
huge thank you to our fantastic pilot & guide: Adrialle (sorry if I spelt this wrong!). Would highly recommend you do this!
The feel of things when looked from different angle is something beyond thoughts.  It's not Miami while you fly this seaplane. Very beautiful city landscape and view of sea animals.

Great trip out to the everglades where i proposed to my girlfriend the guys where fantastic can't thank them enough for the fantastic day they gave us. Highly recommended one for the bucket list especially if you like vintage aircraft amazing how they keep them flying.
 Oh and she said yes by the way :-).

Un vol de 30 mn avec des vues époustouflantes sur Key Biscayne, Miami Beach, le port et ses bateaux de croisières avec un sympathique pilote aussi professionnel en pilotage que comme guide. 
Facile d'accès en transports en commun depuis l'aéroport : la ligne de métro orange jusqu'à la station Brickell et la ligne de bus B pour Key Biscayne. Le plus difficile reste à traverser la route (pas de passage piétons à moins d'un mile).

My husband, daughter and I thoroughly enjoyed this experience. A totally different perspective of Miami, South Beach and adjoining areas. Beautiful views and a must do activity if you can fit it in!! Pilot was excellent and very informative.

review_title: Top notch pilots. Very cool tour of Miami area
review_text:
We took the full tour. Very nice to see the Miami area by air.

After a short delay the DH Beaver came in from its homebase. We boarded together with a Aussie couple on honeymoon (who happened to be professional pilots as well).

Very docile and stable flight. Flying low and slow gives a good view of everything around Miami.

Dank Miami Seaplane konnten wir Key West in einem Tagesausflug geniessen.
Unser Pilot Tony hat uns bestens betreut und auch der Transfer ins Zentrum von Key West war bestens organisiert.
Wir würden das jederzeit wiederholen.
Un moment génial passé au dessus de Miami. Un pilote adorable et des vues incroyables sur Miami. L'hydravion est une activité incontournable lors d'un séjour à Miami.
Amazing way to see Miami! Our pilot was funny, knowledgeable and ensured we had a great experience. You have to do this 1 hour flight when you visit Miami!

Wir sind mit Tony für einen Tagesauflug nach Bimini geflogen. Er und auch alle anderen Mitarbeiter waren supernett, Tony hat uns persönlich die Insel gezeigt und alles erklärt. Auch ein Besuch des Dolphin Hauses war dabei und ist unbedingt zu empfehlen. Die Flugzeuge sind in sehr gutem Zustand und er ist ein sehr guter Pilot. Tolle Firma, jederzeit gerne wieder!

Words can't express how amazing this trip was! Our pilot was fantastic he was funny ,he gave us a tour , he was just awesome. This was such a highlight on our trip in Miami I would recommend it to anybody and everybody. We definitely would like to do it again.  From  start to finish it was incredible- the  views on the plane , the atmosphere , and the island were absolutely breathtaking.

Our pilot was AWESOME!!!! He was a local and had great stories about the area as we flew by different locales! He was even able to point our sharks and stingrays..... His name started with and A and he was superb! We also flew by the Miami OPen tennis tournament..... Very cool!.
Loved the ultimate tour of Miami and Miami Beach. Great narration by the guide. Cool restored vintage plane. Smooth ride with no bumps and very soft landing.
This is a MUST do when you visit Miami. I have lived in Miami my entire life and it was still one of the most amazing experiences! Seeing Miami from a different angle was incredible!

review_title: Best thing to do in Miami
review_text: We did the trip with Captain Tony from Key Biscayne to the Everglades, where we did an airboat tour and met the alligators. It's an exciting and thrilling adventure with breathtaking views. Tony knew everything about what we were passing over: we got not only a geography lesson but also an economics lesson. Tony is so knowledgable about how Miami works! This escapade is a MUST DO, especially if you're tired of the same old scene on South Beach.

My wife & I will recommend this tour to any of our friends visiting south Florida!  The pilot/guide was very knowledgeable and friendly - and always put the safety and comfort of the passengers first.  A history of Miami from the air - for certain.  We loved gaining the prospective of how downtown Miami fit in with Miami Beach, the golf course, the Miami Open stadium, the cruise terminal, etc.  Definately, a prospective that you can not get from the ground.  Loved the tour!!!!

We took the 30 minute seaplane tour with Captain Adriel. He was professional, friendly and knowledgeable. Adriel talked us through the take-off and landing so we had a sense for what he was doing. We felt 100% percent safe at all times. During the flight, Adriel explained what we were looking at and pointed out various places of interest. One thing that amazed me was how absolutely clear the water is. We could see manatees and sting rays so easily. I initially thought a 30 minute flight would feel short but it actually felt about right. I'm really glad we did it. It was worth the money. I highly recommend it!

review_title: Best Scenic Flight ever, sweetened by AC DC tunes ;-)
review_text: We had a great fight, the pilot was the blast, showed us around and we had good music on our head-sets! Thumbs up! Will do again!
Had a fantastic tour of Miami. The staff are excellent and the experience is one we will never forget. A must do if visiting Miami Beach.

review_title: What a fantastic experience - thoroughly recommend it
review_text: We took the Ultimate Miami and Beaches Tour.  Everything was perfect from the reception, through to the end.  We loved the route the tour takes, seeing so many things we had seen from the ground and now had a completely new perspective with lots of photo opportunities.  Tony was an excellent and informative pilot providing insights and entertaining too.  Good value for money in our opinion and a memorable experience.  Additional hint - go to the Rusty Pelican afterwards to get some good photos of the seaplane departing for the next flight and, if you are really lucky, landing on the water outside too.
Truly an unforgettable experience, thank to Adriel Anderson and his team. His knowledge and passion are the reason for us wanting to come back soon!

My wife and I did the 3-hour flight to the Keys for lunch, and the trip was fantastic. I considered (and have done) jet skis, boat tours, etc. - but the seaplane tour perspective, which is to say view and informative point of view of our pilot, lacks parallel. In large part this was owing to Adriel Anderson, our pilot. He is a gentleman, innate tour guide, and teacher. We felt safe and, indeed, instructed as to the reasons for why the plane was being flown in the manner he did, how to take off and land, and ways that seaplane flying is unique from anything else, perhaps even commercial flying. Sprinkle in a natural, homegrown love for the area, its history, and its ecology, well, you have an exceptional trip. I read many reviews on trip advisor, and leave far fewer, but this is one occasion that deserves a commendation. And Adriel was so gracious that he ought to be recognized personally, and if you are lucky, selected as pilot for your trip as well.

Amazing experience all around.  Tony, our pilot, was a great guy and went out of his way to make sure everyone had a fun trip.  The next time I get a chance, I will basically go out of my way to take another trip with them.  Thanks again!!

review_title: Really genuniely nice outfit and great experience
review_text: Tony the pilot was just great .... loads of bits of knowledge and trivia ... but most importantly warm and friendly.  The trip itself (I did the 1 hour one) was awesome and so much fun taking off from and landing on water.

Really friendly people, we had drinks on arrival. Then we met our pilot who was the loveliest guy. This was a gift for my wife's 30th birthday and she totally loved it. He talked through everything we were seeing below, it was amazing. We saw all the mansions with their pools, the famous purple tennis courts of the US open, then he took us out to sea and we saw some houses on stilts. Really great experience and I would do it again if I could.

Grund für unseren Flug war unser Strandaufenthalt auf Andros Island, Bahamas. Es gibt keinen besseren Transport als im Wasserflugzeug auf die einsame Insel zu fliegen! Man spart immens Zeit und hat dazu noch einen grossartiges Erlebnis. Sowohl Hinflug wie auch Rückflug waren sehr angenehm mit speditiver Einreise auf den Bahamas und dann wieder in den USA. Der Flug über das Meer und die bahamesischen Inseln ist traumhaft. Wir haben Manatees, Mantas und Delfine gesehen. Toni ist ein phantastischer Pilot.

The only thing in our planning that didn't go well was this plane ride but it was our mistake. We checked the time to reach there from our Hotel was 30 mins that morning but our tour was at 5pm (sunset time) the time shown was 1 hour. So we were caught up in traffic due to some accident and they called us and said that they have to charge additional $45 for the delay. So I think one should be early for this tour (multiply the usual time taken to reach there by 2). 
The Tour was great with champagne and all the information and view we saw but at night it wasn't that amazing. Rather go at day time.

review_title: Seaplane charter to Little Palm Island
review_text: We had originally booked a round trip charter flight with Key West Seaplanes, but they cancelled our trip with two days notice due to "legal problems" and did not offer any help with re-booking.  Thankfully we found Miami Seaplanes and they were great to deal with.  We flew with Capt. Tony both ways - Tony is an old salt, experienced seaplane pilot and also a great tour guide on the side.  I'd definitely recommend flying with him if possible.  We took a Cessna Seahawk on the way down and an old classic de Havilland Beaver back.  Incredible experience.
captain Tony is the ultimate aviation professional.  service & safety are number 1.  felt very safe and comfortable with him flying the seaplane.  his local knowledge and history added to the trip.
C'était vraiment un super moment ! Je le recommande à tout le monde. Ca restera un de mes meilleurs souvenir de Miami.

Das ganze ging damit los, dass  (550 Dollar pro Person(x2) für south beach bis key west) wir von der Auskunft gesagt bekamen, dass wir um 10 Uhr losfliegen und gegen 16:30 zurückfliegen würden.
Flugdauer etwa 1,5 Stunden.
also hatte ich erstmal im Kopf 4,5 Stunden um in Key west herumzulaufen.
Da eh schon immer mal Wasserflugzeug fliegen wollte, war das für mich ok.

als wir dort ankamen - an eine Stelle, wo man sich zig mal fragt ob man da richtig ist, weil es so abgelegen, unbewohnt und verschlossen ist- wurden wir erstmal vertröstet, weil noch 2 Leute vor uns einen kurzen Rundflug über Miami machen sollen.

das ganze zog sich auf eine 3/4 Stunde. wir sind also erst gegen 10:45 gestartet.
bleiben also 3,75 Stunden in key west.

der Flug war ganz nett. nur die Maschine selbst macht einen Eindruck, als wäre sie ausm 2 Weltkrieg.
offenliegende Kabel, zu großer Brustgurt (konnt nicht ausreichend gekürzt werden, um überhaupt einen Nutzen zu haben) und hinten nur Hüftgurte.
Interessant fand ich, dass diese Maschine eigentlich noch eine weitere Person befördern wollen könnte?
wehe, wenn da mal ein paar Pfund zuviel im Spiel sind - viel Spass auf der Rückbank...

als wir dann dort kurz nach 12:00 ankamen - ich wunderte mich schon, warum wir soweit entfernt vom angepeilten Punkt auf dem "Flugzeug-Navi" landeten - stellte sich heraus, dass wir erst noch fast 30 Minuten mit einem Auto ins Zentrum fahren müssen.(ein Mann hat uns mit seinem Wagen erwartet)

dort haben die uns dann auf dem Weg zum Zentrum ein paar Lokale zum Essen gezeigt/empfohlen, wo ich mich nach dem Abladen gefragt habe, wo wir die Zeit hernehmen sollen. (zumal einige davon schon an die 30 Minuten benötigt hätten um zu Fuss hinzukommen + dann noch den Rückweg)
Essen vs was von key west sehen...

schließlich blieben uns insgesamt satte 2 Stunden und 56 Minuten um uns in Key West umzukucken....
zumal die uns schon wieder um 3:30 vom Treffpunkt, wo die uns abgeladen hatten, wieder einsammeln wollten.

tja - und dann wieder zurück. 

fühl mich tierisch abgezockt, indem man einfach noch einen kurzen Rundflug dazwischengeschoben hat und das auf unsere Kosten ging.
die also für diese Zeit doppelt abkassiert haben.

sowas geht für mich gar nicht.

review_title: A Once in a Lifetime Journey
review_text: I scheduled this excursion for my boyfriend's 49th Birthday.  We were picked up in a marina in Miami and flown to the Loreli Keys for lunch.  The pilot was fabulous.  He provided us with a beautiful tour of Miami and the Keys and was very kind and personable.  The lunch was very appetizing and we had plenty of time to relax and enjoy an island cocktail. This is a must do for all!  Put in on your bucket list and just do it!!!

review_title: Excellent!!!.. the highlight of our vacation
review_text: Great tour... we fully recommend it... Adriel was an excellent guide and pilot!!!.. fully enjoyed our hour flight around miami downtown and beaches... do not miss it you will love it. We will come back for other flights to the keys!!!
Voamos de hidroavião durante 45 minutos sobre a Great Miami. Recomendamos. É sensacional e o piloto explica muitos lugares . Vc tem outra dimensão da cidade,vista do alto!!! Nota 10 !!!

We had some rescheduleds due to the wheater and mandotory pilot trainings, but we had the luck to be a little bit flexible. And it was good to wait and we had the small chesner seaplane with the amazing "firemann" pilot. He explained the complete area of  miami and it was an awesome tour over Downtown, beach, key biscayne, the ocean, everything. We enjoyed the flight and had wildlife dolphings while starting next to our plane. Absolutley recommandable attraction.
Awesome experience. So much fun! This was our first experience on a seaplane and can't wait to go again to a new location.

Un embarcadère au bout d'un parking cabossé, un appareil qui n'a plus d'âge, mais alors, quelle expérience !
1 heure au dessus de Miami du sud au nord et retour avec toute la côte en CinémaScope et jusqu'au bout de Biscayne National Park avec les requins et les raies mantas.
Avec toutes les explications nécessaires de la part de notre pilote, ce fut vraiment un grand moment.

Loved this! The concierge at our hotel recommended this tour, the planes launched 7 mins from our hotel so we gave it a go. Certainly not something I do every day-highly recommend! Pilots were super nice and fun.  Very safe, go for it!

We took a trip on our very first seaplane in July with Miami Seaplane.  What an amazing experience!!  Kids had a blast, the pilot was amazing, very friendly and a true expert.  I'm not a huge fan of flying, but this was the smoothest trip I have ever taken, you can see everything below you and landing is a breeze.  I would highly recommend using Miami Seaplane, I wish I could take a seaplane to every place we travel.

Had a fantastic time with Capt Tony of Miami Seaplane.   Chartered his cool retro plane for a special Birthday flight to Bimini for me and my wife.  He has extensive local knowledge and was a really fun guy to speak with.  Great pilot ! Takeoffs and landings were pillow soft. On the ground in Bimini he took some time to show us around and get familiar with the island.  There may be cheaper options, but flying with him was worth every penny.

This was so cool. We took the 1 hour tour and had a blast. The guide was ver knowledgable as he flew us over all the buildings and hotels. I was worried that the ride would be rough but even the takeoff and landing was smooth. We took an uber from south beach and the driver got lost. Just remember to go down the dirt road.
Amazing flight, to see Miami from the air was worth every penny. Tony was such a gentleman, would recommend this tour to all ages.

Me and my girlfriend booked a day trip to Bimini with Miami Seaplane Tours. Tony picked us up in a wonderful seaplane. We then flew to Bimini and Tony kindly offered us to show us the Island. With a rented golfcart Tony drove us to all the nice places on the Island while we were making pictures. He also showed us the Dolphin house and the builder of it, a very impressive artist. Tony made this day unforgettable and I can't thank him enough for making this day so unique. We already plan the next holidays in Bahamas and we will ask Tony again to fly us to Bimini.

I surprised my love with a birthday lunch in the Keys via Miami Seaplane Tours and have to say best birthday gift I have ever given! We had such a wonderful time and Tony made the day extra special with his knowledge of the area and exceptional flying skills! Landings were so smooth! Highly recommended and cannot wait for our next trip!
Un vieux coucou digne des séries que l'on regardait quand on était jeune. Un pilote ( Tony ) aux petits soins . Une ville fabuleuse qui nous est contée pendant le vol .... Que demander de plus ??

My sister and my mom and I flew to Bimini with Tony on Sunday morning for a mini beach day...what an excellent experience we had going and coming.  Tony, the pilot, was FANTASTIC--made you feel just like family from the moment he greets you.  His flying skills are superb...the landing was flawless-- both times....What a great experience, if you are ever in Miami and want to do a quick tour or a mini get-a-way, this is by far the way to go!

review_title: Un rêve : partir déjeuner sur une plage en hydravion.....!!!!
review_text: Parfait! Notre pilote était absolument charmant et sympathique, la vue sur les keys est à couper le souffle et il est vrai qu'arriver sur une plage en hydravion pour... déjeuner.. c'est plus qu'extraordinaire!!!! Nous avons adoré.
This was a fantastic trip Tony our pilot was attentive and informative.  We had a good hour on the Sea Plane take off and landing were really smooth.  Fabulous experience highly recommended.

The plane was schedule for 3:15 PM. At 4:00 it was still not there. We had other things to do than just wait. It is incredible how they believe that we just are there for them making money without giving a dam for the customers we are.
Our pilot made this a great experience for all.  He new all about the area and made sure we saw everything.
very good tour, the pilot very nice and kind. the weather was really good, so the view was espetacular.

My mom and I took the seaplane to Bimini for a quick two day getaway.  It was an amazing experience!  Tony was great and took us and another couple that was on the plane around the island to a few interesting spots.  I highly recommend!
Esperienza unica ed elettrizzante con tutta la famiglia . Bellissimo tour a Bimini con Antonio ottimo pilota , disponibile e servizio 5 stelle ..da consigliare almeno una volta nella vita

My wife and 2 of my kids jumped into the plane with Winston. He was very personable and the kids loved him. He talked about the history of the plane (an old Beaver) and then we took off from the water. We did the hour tour of Miami. A great way to understand the history of Miami. Showed us Sly Stallones house, where Nixon hung out, flew down south beach, and saw lots of yachts. It was a highlight of our week. 

My wife had nice Sandles on so Winston carried her 10 feet in water to the plane. I recommend that you wear shoes that can get wet for the 10 feet of water. 

Great time!!

review_title: Miami from the air is the best.
review_text:
With a tour of south beach and the Miami skyline, this was a great way to see Miami. 

Our pilot pointed out the famous landmarks, famous houses, and some great sea life. 

I suggest booking at least the 30 minute tour.

review_title: Surprise-- They do not honor reservations for their shorter tours- nor tell you!
review_text: We drove over from West Coast (147 miles one way) and  showed up early  for our tour that had been reserved and paid for on their website.   They were "No Shows" ...no one was there.  No Sign. Not even any Seaplanes.  Fence was locked up.  Extremely disappointing as :  1. They had our phone number but never called.  2. They had our email address but never e-mailed.   3.  They had received the credit card funds.  5 minutes after the tour was supposed to leave, we called the number on the receipt and were given a 15 minute run-around, including  demanding information that was not on our printed  receipt that they had provided and we brought with us..  Finally were told that we could go on a tour at 5 PM ... .then when we expressed interest in it,  they changed it to later.  Turns out it was a shorter tour than we paid for anyway.    They also blamed the computer .... but they knew we had paid. It appears that the shorter tours only happen if longer ones don't  get booked ( why give up a charter for a 15 minute or 30 minute tour?)... even after your reservation.  This might work for you if you live nearby.   We understand that things happen, planes get grounded or can't fly in fog etc ..... but we do not understand the terrible customer support and service.               We finally realized  that there was nothing that they were telling us on the phone that we could rely on, and decided to start our drive back to the west coast rather than also incurring the cost of a night at a hotel.  We did have a nice drink on the  nearby outdoor marina bar.,,, called 'Joe's .........'

We spent 4 hours in Bimini with our guide. He went out of his way to take us around the island explaining the history, and recommend eating and beach venues. Tony is clearly very competent and a long time pilot. Never did we worry. it was breathtaking viewing Miami and the island from above (and privately). Bring your suit and towel. You will want to dip into the emerald green water. The locals, though poor, are very kind and welcoming. We were glad to tour and buy some small souvenirs to contribute.
Fantastic day out. Great way to see Miami and a bit of an adventure. The pilot's commentary was excellent. Worth every cent. Highly recommended.

You simply have to do this when you are in Miami. The beauty of the city is in the islands and beaches. No better way to see it than from above! Very nice aircraft and an amazing pilot. Did it for valentines day! Would do it again.

What can I say... Simply an amazing experience.  Our pilot Tony made us feel like family. This was an extremely romantic trip down to the Florida Keys, lunch on a beach, champagne and live music.  My girlfriend was blown away by this experience and we are already talking about doing the Bimini run.

We had a really great experience on this tour. We showed up early and enjoyed the water view filled with beautiful boats and yachts. Our pilot was super nice and very professional. We took the 30 tour and got to see South Beach, Key Biscayne and all of the mega cruise ships. I would recommend this to anyone.

Everything was perfect - a nice relaxed commentary as we went out over the Everglades and back via the Keys with a great chance to look at those amazing properties.

Our transfer into 'downtown' Key West was friendly and helpful.

The best time - thank you !
Thoroughly highly recommend this tour.  We took our family of 5 on the tour and have the most amazing memories and pictures of the day.  Imergen Brar 18th Birthday Photography trip

This was an awesome tour!  I was a bit nervous about the small plane but it was ultra smooth!  Our pilot was extremely knowledgable and made me feel very safe. We learned so much about Miami, the beaches, the islands, ecosystem, and much more. It was a beautiful view that you are totally miss on the ground. Very cool!  Worth every penny!

fly tour over Miami Bay, description and details about the place by the pilot, very friendly.
easy access

Great trip, really informative pilot, he took us all over Miami including the port and beaches, great fun taking off and landing on the water, very enjoyable view of Miami, highly recommended and not expensive either.
Eine wirklich wundervolle Erfahrung. Ein sehr netter Pilot, klasse Maschine, toller Flug über Miami Beach und Key Biscayne

Nuestro viaje ha sido maravilloso en compañía de "Tony" el mejor piloto de Miami !
Recuerdos y momentos inolvidables

Nous avons pris notre avion à Key Biscayne ". Là, le pilote nous attend assis sur une chaise en bois sous un palmier, la chemise ouverte. On se croirait dans une série américaine et on est loin de la photo du pilote en uniforme blanc vue le site de la compagnie. On signe une décharge en cas d'accident (...) et mon mari et ma fille embarquent les 1ers car il n'y a que 2 vraies places dans l'hydravion, la 3ème à l'arrière étant ridicule. Pendant ce temps ma 2ème fille et moi faisons des photos car le site est très joli avec Miami en arrière plan, la mer et les yachts. Ils reviennent au bout de 30 mn ravis de leur survol (110€/pers.). Sans perdre de temps, c'est à notre tour. Nous marchons sur le flotteur pour monter à bord, le pilote nous donne des casques munis d'écouteurs ce qui lui permet de nous donner des infos sur ce que l'on survole. Au début, on passe au dessus de Miami, on aperçoit ses grattes ciels, puis au dessus de l'océan où l'on voit les différentes couleurs de l'eau, les bateaux de plaisance, on survole Star Island puis on revient par South Beach où l'on passe au dessus des plages et des grands hôtels.  On a même survolé un groupe de lamantins en train de nager. C'était magique et le pilote était vraiment sympa. Extrait du blog :
http://blacenfloride.eklablog.com/

review_title: Miami Seaplane is the way to go!
review_text: To celebrate my 30th birthday, my girlfriend and I decided to head out to Bimini just for a quick getaway and taking a seaplane was by far the best choice we made. Our departure time was at noon and our pilot Tony had us in the air at exactly noon.  Even before the flight, Tony offered to take pictures of my girlfriend and I next to the plane just so we can have for memories which I thought was pretty cool.  The flight was actually smooth.  Honestly I was expecting a bumpy ride since it’s a small plane but it wasn’t.  During the flight we were taking pictures of ourselves with the ocean in the background. My girlfriend was ecstatic.  As we got closer to Bimini you could see the ocean color change to a light blue/greenish color.  It was really nice and making the seaplane trip even that much better.  When we got to Bimini, Tony flew us around the Island to point out different restaurants and local places that we could go to.  We even spotted sharks in the water so Tony brought the plane closer to the water so we could take videos and pictures.  The only thing that wasn’t pleasant was once we landed in Bimini we had to wait for Immigration and Customs officers to show up.  Even though Tony called them ahead of time and flew over their office to let them know that we’re about to land, they still took over a half hour to show up.  No fault of Tony’s of course.  After we cleared both Customs and Immigration, Tony called a local cab driver to pick us up and take us to the Hotel.  On the day of departures, again Tony was on time and ready to go but of course, we had to wait for Immigration and Customs again since they have to clear the plane coming from the U.S. and Tony as well.  But once in the air, we were back in Miami in no time.  I’m glad that we chose Miami Seaplane Tours as our transportation to Bimini.  It just made the trip that more special and something that I highly recommend to anyone.  IF YOU’RE GOING TO BIMINI, TAKE MIAMI SEAPLANE TOURS!!!!

review_title: Miami is even prettier from the air!!!
review_text:

Tengo 28 años en el medio turístico, manejando Eventos,  Grupos y Convenciones de todos tamaños al rededor de todo el mundo y la experiencia vivida el pasado 7 de Abril, es una de mis mejores experiencias vividas.
Llegamos 9:30 AM, media hora antes de la hora pactada, y nos sorprendió que aún estaba cerrado, pero al 10 para las 10:00 AM, escuchamos y vimos descender un hermoso Hidroavión Cessna impecable y descender de el un hombre muy agradable y relajado, el famoso Tony, quien nos dio una cordial bienvenida a lo que sería una experiencia inolvidable!!!... Nos explico los procedimientos muy sencillos y "Abróchense los cinturones".... A Volar!!... Nuestro rumbo Key West, pero antes un recorrido a 1,500 pies de altura por toda la punta de Miami, en un tour descriptivo sensacional, para adentrarnos a los diferentes cayos donde se aprecia a esa altura, toda las especies marinas imaginables e inimaginables, así como las fastuosas mansiones e historias muy peculiares, incluyendo la base de misiles deshabitada del famoso conflicto con Cuba/ Rusia y EUA, en los años 60's con J.F Keneddy.
El aterrizaje en Key West, es perfecto y lo agradable de este pueblito junto al mar inolvidable disfrutando de Mile 0, la casa de Ernest Heminway, la Duval street, etc, el regreso del mismo modo fue fascinante, ahora a 3,500 pies de altura con una perspectiva del puente 7 Mails que conecta a Key West, para continuar nuestra ruta rumbo a Miami y ver desde el aire Everglades y toda la parte de Coral Gable y las suntuosas casas de los famosos en diferentes ángulos piloteado por Tony, experto piloto/instructor  y propietario de este magnifico tour....un imperdible en Miami y Key West!!!....Gracias Tony, sigue creciendo !!!!

review_title: My husband couldn't have been more pleased!
review_text:
I took my husband on the "Ultimate Miami and Beaches Seaplane Tour" as a surprise for his 45th birthday, and boy did this gift deliver!  I set up our reservation via the phone.  Armando was friendly and helpful, delivering customer service throughout the experience that was top notch (in a city just aching for good customer service).  The promised confirmation emails arrived promptly and provided clear information and instructions.  And when we arrived for our tour a week later, we were greeted by a very nice and experienced pilot, Adriel Anderson, who is a Miami native and clearly passionate about flying.  At the start of our tour, he put safety first, giving us a valued briefing on what to do in case of emergency, and then he proceeded to give us an hour of adventure in his comfortable and clean Cessna 172.  My husband sat in front next to Adriel, and I sat in back with so much room to look in both directions.  My favorite parts of the Tour were seeing the marine life in the water below (Manta, Tarpons, birds, etc.) and touring Stiltsville in Biscayne National Park.  So, so beautiful.  And the weather was superb.  Couldn't have asked for better!  My husband says he'll never forget.  Thank you, Miami Seaplane Tours!

Tips: 

- Pick one of the morning flights if you can.  It tends to rain here in the afternoons.

- Don't arrive to your tour early.  Five minutes before is sufficient.  They don't staff the office since they fly on a reservation basis, and the parking lot isn't right in front of the business, so you can get very hot standing in the sun (not to mention mosquito-bitten).

- Wear light clothes (it can get warm in the plane's cabin) and shoes that you don't mind getting wet.  

- Bring a camera.

review_title: SHOULD TRY IT AT LEAST ONCE IN LIFE!!!
review_text: I am 24 years old, have been flying my whole life (commercial planes), and I am terrified of flying. My best friend surprised me on my b-day with the seaplane tour. I was a little nervous before the flight, but all I can say is WOW!!! It's nothing like flying on a regular plane, and by that I mean it's 100000 times better in every sense of this word:) This feather light plane gets up so easily of the water that you don't even feel it, doesn't flight as high, you can see every single detail out the window:) If it gets bumpy, the pilot warns you ahead of time, so that you don't get scared and expect it, but on my flight, I had only a few little bumps:) The pilot is very educated, super nice, and from the first minute you meet and talk to him, he earns your trust, by that making you feel comfortable and relaxed. It's a definite YES to anyone who is scared of flying bc you will love it! When you get up there, there is so many things to look at, that you simply get carried away, and the time flies by… It's a little pricey without groupon, but it's definitely worth buying it as a gift to your loved one or a friend, they will be under impression for the rest of their lives:) I hope I can do it again sometime in my life!!!

We took this tour on a recent trip to Miami and I can't recommend them highly enough. Very friendly pilot and a great flight. We booked a 90 min flight and we got more than our moneys worth. When we arrived we were able to choose what we wanted to see and the pilot got it done for us. There were two of us and we had the plane to ourselves.

We were the last flight of the day and so had great lighting. Photos had to be taken out of the windows, so a polarising filter would be recommended to keep reflections to a minimum. Although you are not going high enough to cause an oxygen problem you wouldn't want 100s of mile an hour winds in the cab :)

The only thing I can say against the trip is the site is a little difficult to find. It's just at the end of the causeway bridge, when heading towards Miami. You need to leave the causeway road and then turn right down a dirt path. Dodging the pot holes adds to the fun, but if you go right to the end you will find the office.

review_title: Miami sob um outro ponto de vista
review_text: No dia 29 de abril fizemos um passeio de aproximadamente 2 horas com o piloto Antonio. A princípio ficamos um pouco apreensivos porque chegamos uns 30 minutos antes do horário do vôo (que seria às 15h20) e nos deparamos com os portões fechados, mas o Antonio chegou com o avião poucos minutos antes da hora marcada. Na verdade, a empresa havia me mandado um email avisando que o piloto poderia se atrasar um pouco devido a outro serviço que estava fazendo antes; mas, como passei o dia todo fora, só vi o email a noite quando retornei ao hotel. A viagem começou com algum atraso, pois foi necessário abastecer a aeronave. Fora isso, foi um passeio muito interessante. A vista é deslumbrante e o Antonio é muito paciente em mostrar as coisas e em responder às perguntas mais diversas possíveis. Sem dúvida pretendo entrar em contato com a Miami Seaplane Tours numa outra oportunidade para uma ida a Key West ou até às Bahamas.

I work in tourism in Chicago and everyime I travel I try to experience every unique option for vehicle excurisions for a given city.  I've been on helicoptors over and outside of Vegas, rode dune buggies in the desert outside of Vegas, an airboat in the Everglades, a catamaran, submarie and a 10 person plane in Hawaii, parasailed in the Bahamas and on and on, but honestly the seaplane was one of the coolest experiences ever bringing together water and sky. I got in touch with Miami Seaplane to inquire about their island escape adventure.  Nicole & Aileen helped me plan everything.  They are both great.  I arrived at the location and met with Tony our pilot. Signed a few forms and went out to the plane. Took a few pictures and I got into the seaplane.  My girlfriend got the special treatment when Tony whisked her up and into the seaplane so she didn't have to get her feet wet.  The doors were left open and Tony turned on the engine. We had a great breeze while floating in the plane.  We then took off and began our tour of Miami. The views were spectacular and we saw quite a few sights.  All of a sudden Tony told us that he was experiencing "trouble" and had to land to see what the problem was.  We landed and my girlfriend said she felt nauseous. All of a sudden we came up to this island to find a beautiful picnic setup for the two of us.  We deplaned &  Aileen was on the private island to greet us.  On the island they setup a picnic with a iPod dock, champagne, shrimp, crackers, hummus, dessert...  It was all delicious.  Tony and Aileen left us on the island for an hour to enjoy the time by ourselves.  I prepared a playlist and on the fourth song in I proposed.  We enjoyed the rest of the time together. After an hour Tony and Aileen returned to the island via seaplane and picked us up.  Aileen remained to cleanup whilst Tony flew us back.  This was the perfect proposal and everything worked out just as planned.  Thanks Miami Seaplane!!! (Tony, Aileen & Nicole)

review_title: A great way to get to Bimini and small islands
review_text:
We found by accident that Miami Seaplanes is the best way to fly to Bimini, particularly couples or a family for with typical 'beach trip' luggage.  See: www.MiamiSeaplanes.com  You can fly into the Miami airport on any airline, and book a flight with Miami Seaplanes to / from Bimini or other small islands and resorts. The transfer to/ from Miami airport is easy -- less time than we spent, by far, in the overcrowded Ft. Lauderdale airport. 

We stumbled on this option when my wife was called back for a Board of Directors meeting, in the middle of our vacation. She found Miami Seaplanes on the web, and loved it. The pilot, a great guy, also took our son and his friend up for a short flight around Bimini -- a real adventure.

The seaplane lands on Bimini in the small inlet between the North and South islands, and pulls up on the sand on the North island, down the street from the ferries.  You step off onto the beach -- no terminal and no lines!  A Bimini Customs official will meet you there.  

The other option is United, which now offers once-a-day scheduled flights to Bimini from Ft. Lauderdale airport, with twin-engine Saab turboprops via an alliance with Silver Airlines -- a Carribbean charter service. If you have a larger group or a bunch of luggage, e.g. for scuba or underwater photography, this is the way to go. The dual engine Saab turboprops were very comfortable, like a commuter flight.  

The Ft. Lauderdale airport is an overcrowded mess, however, and we were there in February during the 'low' season. I can't imagine what it must be like during Spring Break or the high season. 

How to get around when you are there:  the place that Miami Seaplanes lands is a short walk from the dock where the little ferries will take you across to South Island, if you are staying at Bimini Sands.  If you take the United flight, you will arrive at Bimini's small airport on the South island. A minibus shuttle meets every United flight and will take you to Bimini Sands, or the ferry dock to the North Island -- a 3 to 5 minute drive. Two small ferry boats run back and forth across the shallow inlet between the South and North island -- another 5 minute trip. One ferry is free for residents, but a tip of $2 per visitor is a good idea. The other is run by a local guy, and he charged $2 per person. 

You do not need to make a reservation -- the ferries run back and forth all day, from the early 
morning into the night. A couple of vendors rent golf carts to get around on the North and South 
islands, but we simply walked from the Miami Seaplane beach to the ferry, and from there to Bimini Sands. You could also walk to / from the seaplane to the Big Game Club.  Bimini is a very 
small place!  Taxis are also available, if needed.

In summary, we will definitely book a flight with Miami Seaplanes for our next trip to Bimini.  It is quite an experience, and more convenient.

Mark Hays

review_title: The flight was excellent but they charged 15% tipping on full price without authorisation
review_text:
So I bought 4 Groupons at $75 for our family (a total of $300) when we visited Miami in June 2012. The booking process was very easy. They answered the phone promptly, had our Groupon codes down and sent us a boarding pass for  2 flights as we split into two parties as we take turn to look after a young baby. They told us that tax and gratuity were not included and if we want to pay by credit card we should call one day before or we will need to pay by cash to the pilot. I called the day before our flights and said I want to pay the tax by credit card and will give the pilot tip in cash. Knowing Floridan tax is about 7% that would be roughly $20 so I didn't ask them to confirm the total amount charged. 
The flight was very enjoyable. The pilot has a lot of local knowledge and was very pleasant. He told us that he owns this company and two planes and he is going to buy a new bigger plane.
My husband said that the pilot shouldn't expect any tip as he would make a lot of money from this business. However, I decided to tip him because I enjoyed his talk about the area.
We received an invoice of $110 in my email stating "GT for flights". I called them up to clarify. The same lady who took my credit card confirmed the tax was $20 and the rest was for gratuity I said I only authorised the tax charge and I already tipped the pilot and that I never authorised them to do that on my credit card. She told me I need to talk to Tony. The first thing he asked me "How much did you tip the pilot?" When I told him, he said bluntly "That is not customary. It should be 15% on the full price of the flights which is $600 if you didn't buy from Groupon". Thats why they charged me $90. He asked or "offered" me if I want to get a refund of $40 for the tip that I already gave the pilot.
I believe in tipping but it is for service people who earn $8.50/ hour at restaurants/ hotels who rely on tipping for their living. However, for a pilot who earns a high wage or owns his own company, tipping should be at customer's discretion, not by forced tipping which is the case here.
What I also found that their attitude was defiant about the charge when it was clear that I did't authorise it. What was not transparent was they didn't itemise the tax charge of $20 in my $110 invoice but indicated it all as GT for gratuity.
I wondered if they did that to avoid the tax and try to capture the discount they offered on Groupon. I have written to them to request the full refund. I hope to hear from other people's experiences.

review_title: Fun way to see the skyline of Miami from the sky
review_text:
Normally, the only way you get to see Miami from the sky is by watching the opening sequence of an old episode of Miami Vice or the new (now-canceled) Charlie's Angels.  Miami Seaplane Tours is a nice alternative.  It's a bit pricey, but if you check carefully, you might find a Groupon for half-off (like I did).  The plane seats 3 passengers maximum, so don't plan on doing this in a large group.
The pilot was about 15 minutes late for our scheduled departure, but he did give us the full half-hour flight that we paid for.  We flew over Downtown Miami, the man-made islands in Biscayne Bay, and South Beach.  The pilot pointed out some of the multi-million dollar homes owned by famous people and some of the other well-known landmarks.  Unfortunately, the mikes are only one-way (you can hear the pilot, but you can't talk to him), so we couldn't ask any questions.  The pilot also played a soundtrack of current pop hits to fill the gaps when he wasn't narrating.

Here are some tips:
Most taxi drivers will have no clue where this place is, so you have to tell them to go west on Rickenbacker Causeway and turn left at the road for the Rickenbacker Fish Company (and make a QUICK LEFT onto the dirt road just before you get to the Rickenbacker Fish Company).
Wear flipflops or Tevas, because you may have to wade through ankle-deep water to board the plane.
The Rickenbacker Fish Company is a decent restaurant a short walk from the Miami Seaplane Tours dock.  It opens for lunch at noon.  I had the blackened mahi mahi sandwich and fries, which were very tasty.  The Rusty Pelican restaurant is a bit farther away, and it was closed for renovation when we were there.
The staff at the Rickenbacker Fish Company are very friendly and will call you a taxi while you're finishing your meal (you won't have much luck flagging one down on the causeway).
Go with the half-hour seaplane tour.  One hour would probably get a bit boring.
If you use a Groupon, be sure to call for reservations and bring the confirmation number with you (either as a printout or on your cell phone).
friendly captain, brilliant trip. A very good way to see downtown miami, miami beach and south florida.

I really hate flying - especially in such a small plane - But this was the best choice ever!!!!
It was super cool, not to mention the pilot - He was very calm and made the ride super comfortable!  We were VERY Happy & Would Highly recommend it!!!!

review_title: Breathtaking unusual Miami....an extraordinary viewpoint, images you won't forget!
review_text: Take your camera on board of this little bird and you won't regret the trip. Leaving Key Biscayne and up you go, around Miami, the city, the beaches, the islands, the ocean...you will be charmed by the overview of this spectacular city that seems to arise from the ocean. A perfect way to discover the area and, if you haven't yet,  fall in love with Miami.

purchased this with groupon. It was easy to reserve and very professional. they sent me an email of confirmation. I would suggest though to really pay attention to the road, and look for the turn for Rusty Pelican or Fish Market. Don't show up too early. there is nothing to do, and when we got there the gate was locked and we had to sit in our car. The pilot was great and very informative. I would recommend this for locals or tourists.

Amazing flight above the slyline of Miami
!! Pilot was nice and provided us a lot of information during the flight. 

This was the best experiance of visiting Miami!!

review_title: Miami Seaplane Tour was awesome. Great weather, great sites
review_text:
My son and daughter gave me the 30 minute ride for Father's Day.  My son and I flew on a Saturday morning.  The weather was great, as was the views.  The venue was easy to find.  Be careful on the dirt portion, as the road is very rough.  The attendant on site was knowledgeable and friendly, as was the pilot.  The headset allows the pilot and passengers to communicate throughout the flight.  
We flew over south beach, Miami bay front, Key Biscayne and numerous islands.  Be sure to take your camera as the views are spectacular.
I will definetly do this again!!

I initially thought a helicopter flight would be a great way to see the city and beaches, but there's no helicopter tour anywhere close to Miami as far as i could tell, but there was the Seaplane which goes from Key Biscayne, about 10 mins from downtown. We booked by phone easily and quickly, got instant email confirmation, and arrived the next afternoon. We took the one hour trip, and the pilot asked us where we wanted to go with our hour, when we told him he immediately made arrangements to fly that way. It was a fantastic hour, the sight seeing is unbelievable, flying high and low over South Beach and all the way up to Ft Lauderdale, right over the airport as planes took off beneath us, and out over the sea to check out Manta Rays, and Manatees. Through the headsets we could hear the pilot, but not speak to him as he was also negotiating with Air Traffic Control to ensure we could go where we wanted. He was extremely friendly, helpful and pointed out all of the sights as we went by them. The only (very minor) negative point was the unneccessary music played over the headset which was quite loud and really didn't add anything to the experience. Apart from that, it was a great experience and highly recommended as a fabulous way of seeing the city and whole area from a new perspective. The take off and landing is pretty cool too.

It the only place in Miami, I didnt felt diddled....
A great job with a SMILE ...
Its priceless...
Thanks again ..
Patricia
Belgium

review_title: You haven't seen Miami until you've done this
review_text: Yes, it was a bit pricey but this was icing on the cake for our vacation to Miami.  We were luckily enough to go on a sunny day and boy was it spectacular!  We did the 30 minute tour of South Beach, downtown, and Key Biscayne.  The pilot showed us everything from the roof pools of the Ritz to the the homes of famous actors.  We even saw sea turtles and dolphins from the air.  The pilot was definitely a professional.  Our takeoff and landings on the water we as smooth as silk.  Aside from the clubs, shopping, and bars on South Beach, this should also be at the top of your to-do list.

We enjoyed one of the best early morning flights of our life. We were greeted by some of the friendliest staff that you will encounter in Miami. Once in the air we were able to see manatee, sharks and the lush homes that many cannot get close to on land! The history of the sights was also wonderful as it did not consume the flight allowing you to learn and enjoy every moment.

review_title: Surprised my Girlfriend for her Birthday and it was a perfect gift for the both of us!
review_text: From the customer service to driving away from the parking lot......A++ service and the experience was wonderful! I initially couldn't find the place and the individual on the phone was extremely helpful along with the gentleman who checked us in along with the pilot. Our pilot was not only very friendly, courteous and an exceptional pilot. He did a great job of narrating and piloting the plane. Gorgeous views of the ocean, beach and city. We saw manatees, sharks and dolphins. My girlfriend and I both drove away calling our friends and family to tell them about how great of a time we both had. Definitely one of the best experiences we have ever had!  Thank you Miami Sea Planes! Next time we will hopefully do the 2hr flight.
This flight took my breath away And the pilot was very knowledgeable. Would do it again in a heartbeat!!

My wife and i did the 30 minute plane ride and this was way too short.  We should have done the hour or two hour as time went by so quickly.  You really do appreciate things when you see them from a different perspective.  Ariel (Tony's son) was a great pilot/guide, really showing us how much he enjoys flying and the area.  Our trip was delayed a bit due to the weather, but we still have great views regardless of the overcast skies.  This was the highlight of our trip.

Tips: Dock wasn't the easiest to find; GPS didn't direct us right and we had to call for instructions.  Also, make sure to wear sandals or flip/flops since you need to walk into 5 or 6 inches of water of get to the plane and there's jagged rocks below water.

I took my two sons on the one hour tour last week, and it was an experience of a lifetime!  We all couldn't believe how beautiful the views were...breathtaking at times.  The boys especially enjoyed seeing the bull/nurse sharks, sea turtles and sting rays surrounded by the sparkling blue water.  We were able to see so many of the beautiful homes, the Vizcaya gardens, South Beach, Key Biscayne, downtown Miami, etc...  Our tour guide was quite knowledgeable and had an amazing appreciation for the sights he was showing us.  It's an experience we will never forget.  Thanks so much!

We took the 2 hour flight over Miami and the Everglades. Our pilot was very friendly and showed us some beautiful houses and wonderful beaches. But the best part of the tour was the flight out to the Everglades. Way up high you could see the enormity of this National Park. We also flew up close and saw alligators in the water. Time flew by while we were up there.

I bought the tour for my husband as a Father's Day gift and I must say that it was quite an amazing gift for both. 
I do suggest to dress light (shorts, tanks, water shoes) because it gets a little warm inside the plane once you take off. You must bring a camera to capture beautiful shots of the city. Will definitely fly again!!!!!

I'm already crazy about planes, my wife is the opposite but anyways, we both loved the tour !!! The Pilot (Tony) was very nice to us... It was a 1 hour tour, miami beaches (Fort Lauderdalle to Key Biscayne)... DO RECOMEND !!!

review_title: Really fun adventure & Great way to see the natural and man-made beauty of Miami
review_text: My husband and I took the 30 minute seaplane ride around Miami departing off the Rickenbacker Fathers Day weekend.  The plane seats the pilot plus 3.  They were right on time and you only needed to arrive 10 minutes early do no waiting around. The woman who greeted us and the pilot were sweet and friendly.  The views were beatiful of Miami Beach, downtown, Key Biscayne etc.  we could see the (sting?)rays swimming in the shallows.  I've lived in Miami since '94 and loved this new perspective on our beautful city!  Really cool for visitors and kids and I plan to take my 4 and 8 year old boys up soon.

review_title: Fantastic experience even for a local!
review_text: We had never thought about doing anything like this, especially because we live on Miami Beach and generally avoid  "touristy" things.  However, when the groupon came out, I thought it might be an unusual experience to try for a Father's Day gift.  It was totally worth it.  The staff was great (especially the pilot -- he knew everything about the area, the wildlife, etc), and the entire experience was fun and hassle free.  And what a way to see Miami Beach!   The pilot gladly flew us over our house and other places we wanted to see.  Taking off and landing was not at all scary, and the plane gets a lot of attention from passing boaters.  You feel like a celebrity in there.  Once we were airborne, we saw stingrays, schools of tarpon, and even a lone shark.  Flying over the rooftops of some of the popular south beach hotels was a lot of fun -- who gets to see that view very often?  Fisher Island, Star Island, the cruise ships, all things that we've already seen from the road or from the water a bazillion times.  But to see them from the air gives you a totally different (and really wonderful) perspective.  I would recommend this activity for anyone who wants to try something totally different and be pleasantly suprised by how fun it is!

review_title: One of the best experiences of my life!
review_text: I originally booked this thinking of my husband as an anniversary/father's day gift.  I am not a fan of flying and was ALWAYS against flying a sea plane - for sure! However, this experience was not only exhilerating but relaxing at the same time.  It was a magnficent surprise for my husband and a pleasant one for me as well.  The staff was professional, the pilot was welcoming and knowledgeable.  He definitely made me feel at ease the entire flight.    I have a new found appreciation for the beauty of my hometown - Miami is simply divine! I would do this again in a heart beat and would recommend Miami Sea Plane to anyone :)

review_title: Romantic flight and Spectacular views of Miami and Miami Beach
review_text:

We were celebrating my husband's Birthday and as he said "One awesome Birthday to remember"!!!!!!!!!  Jeremy Fisher & Isis Morales Fisher

Thanks Miami Seaplane Team - that was something really special

Thumbs up !!!!!

review_title: Absolutely worth every penny...I will do it again!!
review_text:
I went up on April 6th, 2011.
I was a little concerned that the ride might be a little bumpy, but as a person with severe vertigo, I was wondering if the ride would be OK for me. It was smooth as glass. The pilot said that because we were over water, there wasn't any thermals (uplifts in air/turbulence). I had an absolute blast. We circled South Beach, and then circled Key Biscayne. We saw some dolphins, a Manta Ray, and som Manatee. I have to mention that the pilot was VERY FRIENDLY.  He was like giung up with a friend. I mentioned to him that he was friendly, and that it made the experience more fun. I told him that if the pilot was a grump it wouldn't be as fun.

The plane looked new, inside and out. When I got there, I waited for him to arrive with the plane. He said they keep it hangared at a local airport. You can tell they take very good care of it.

On a side note, this is the same plane that the Kardashian sisters went up in on their TV show.

I thought this would be a one time deal, but I will go up again, and again.....
It surpassed what I expected......

Being an aviation enthusiast, a South florida resident and a private pilot aprentice the Miami Seaplane adventures constitutes an unforgetable experience. The plane condition is excellent, the flying route breath taking and pilot experience just great. Thanks Antonio for the super adventure.

review_title: Glass bottomed boat tour- from the sky!!!!

This is a must for anyone who wants to see a view of miami not possible by any other means. I live here and I wow what a great discovery. The pilot's skill makes the experience easy to enjoy. Worth doing again. Thanks Adriel.

review_title: EXCELLENT & UNIQUE EXPERIENCE FOR OUT-OF-TOWNERS & LOCALS ALIKE !
review_text: Experiencing Miami from the sky, on a typically beautiful day, is a must for anyone staying in the city ! Soaring around Virginia Key, Fisher Island, South  Beach, and downtown gives you a completely new perspective on this very aesthetically pleasing city. You may even catch sight of a manatee hanging out in turquoise waters, like I did on my trip - but dolphins, sharks, and schools of fish can be sighted as well ! The company is family owned and operated, and all the staff were nothing short of warm and hospitable throughout. Adriel, our pilot, was extremely professional, obviously passionate about his job, knowledgeable, & friendly.  Take the opportunity and see Miami from the skies, it will really take your breathe away !

I've been living in Miami for 5 years now and have done a couple regular Cessna flights myself over the Miami Beach Shoreline etc.  But the Seaplane experience tops that. Taking off and landing in the water practically anywhere makes flying so much more fun. Plus, you dont have to drive far to get to the airport, is right there 2 minutes from Brickell just over the first bridge of Rickenbacher Causeway. And you're not just flying your route A to B as you wouldbe under regular ATC conditions, but you are circling around, flying very low and all over the place! I recommend FRI-SUN afternoon for all the cruise line action.

I surprised my boyfriend with this tour. We are Floridians and we had never experienced Miami this way. It was so amazed and surprised. The crew was wonderful and the view was breath taking. Thank you for helping create an amazing memory in our hearts!

review_title: The Best MIAMI tour We hade---AWASOME RIDE worth every penny
review_text: The People are Very Very friendly ( we are late by Half hour but they are Ok ) The pilot is really cool guy spend time with us explaining every thing

My wife bought us a trip for a 30 min ride around downtown miami and the waters of south beach. We live here and loved the flight. We saw sharks, dolphins, sea rays, and manatees. We both enjoyed it. The pilot was so nice to us and gave us a great tour of Miami Beach, the surrounding islands, Brickell and Miami. It was a great experience and would recommend to anybody.

review_title: Miami as it should be seen!
review_text:
Miami - I've been a resident all my life and had forgotten what the hell I was doing here.  Between the nasty traffic, real estate crash, overpriced drinks, and banana republic status, my favorite city had lost a lot of luster over the years.   

Having gone on this tour reminded me that we truly live in one of the most spectacular cities on the planet.  Being able to see Miami in all her splendor from above really is a sight to behold.  From all of the new additions to the downtown/brickell skyline to South Beach, to the pristine untouched nature by lightouse point, it really gave me a new appreciation for this town.  Our pilot Adriel was a bad-a$$ and he provided some awesome narrative go go along with the sights.  We all really need to get out and see the sights more instead of just getting caught up spending the weekend doing errands.  

We went on a SeaPlane tour one Saturday thanks to a Goupon promotion for 50% off.   I can honestly say it was one of the best things I have ever done in Miami.

It was truly a great experience started the new year with excitement fun scenery and great people. I would highly recommend this adventure. I look forward to doing it again in the very near future!!! Looking forward to booking my tour soon :)

I bought the 30 min tour of miami as one of my husband's 30th birthday presents.  It was an amazing experience!  the plane was very comfortable, visibility perfect, the pilot was friendly and expunged lots of environmental, aquatic, and historic information regarding the sites.  we saw a pod of manatees, a huge bull shark, sea turtles, and stingrays!  the views of south beach and the miami sky line were superb.  there was also pleasant music played in the background while the pilot filled in all the details of the sights.  the landing was smooth and all in all a wonderful and very memorable experience from start to finish.  i would go again and highly recommend it.

In our last holidays in Miami we decided to make a sightseeing of Miami city, the election could not be better, do it in a seaplane.
Our Pilot, Adriel, made of this flight an amazing experience to all of us, we enjoy every second of the trip.
We highly recommend this tour to everyone looking for a new point of view of this beautiful city.

Thank you Tony for the trip.  You were a wonderful host and narrator.  The trip was enjoyable and comfortable. You showed us Miami's beautiful coastline.  We saw landmarks and the vast variety of things to do in our paradise.  Thank you again for the birdeye's view of Miami and for our pic!  Mike and Sylvia

It was more than what was expected.  One of my friends was a bit nervous, but the second she stepped into the plane she was fine.  Although it isn't big plane it is was very roomy and comfortable inside.  The captain was great and explained our flight path. Once in the air, WOW!  The flight was as smooth as could be.  We flew by the buildings of Downtown Miami, over to Key Biscayne,  over South Beach, then to the North end of town, then back to Downtown, landing back in.  We had such a great time.
I not only recommend this to tourists, but to us locals that have lived here a long time.  It really made me appreciate what a beautiful city we live in and how great it is to live here.

We did a sunset tour and we were very lucky to have a perfect sky that day. The whole flight was fantastic and the views are spectacular, definitely worth doing. You get to see Miami in a different light. Our pilot was also fantastic and told us quite a view new things about Miami. I can only say, go see for yourself.

I did the 1 hour Ultimate Miami and Beaches Tour, and it was absolutely amazing. We got the opportunity to fly over Key Biscayne National Park and see wildlife such as manatees, fish, and more. I have lived in Florida all of my life and never had a clue how amazing the city of Miami really was until this wonderful experience. Not only was Tony Anderson a great pilot, he did a fantastic job filling us in with information on everything we flew by. This flight was one I will never forget.

My husband & I decided to do the 1/2hr city tour with Miami Seaplanes. We had a great experience from start to finish! The take off & landing were very smooth. The views were amazing! The customer service was excellent! We saw a manatee, flew around south beach, by the city skyscrapers & around many of the rich & famous peoples houses!

Took the Miami and beaches one hour tour. The views are simply stunning - from the crystal clear waters of Biscayne Bay to the high-rises of downtown Miami, this tour provides a new perspective on places familiar only from the ground. Our pilot, Tony, was a wealth of knowledge. He appears to know every building and landmark within Miami-Dade and Broward counties, and seems to genuinely enjoy his work. Best of all, he's a really nice guy and ensures the whole experience is enjoyable. He's also a great wildlife spotter and pointed out manatees, sea turtles and rays. The flight was smooth and felt completely safe. This has to be the best way to take in Miami and surroundings. Thanks Tony for making our day. Ian/Betty, West Palm Beach

I am terrified of flying, but not this time. It was so beautiful flying above Miami. I reserved a half hour flight and I wish I would of done at least an hour. 
It a whole other way of seeing Miami. The best way. We loved everything about it and we will be going back next time we go to Miami or Fort Lauderdale.

I called this place once with a crazy and amazing idea and I had the pleasure to talk to Genny, she was awesome and help me a lot become my wish true.. It was an amazing experience I will recommend this to everyone. The hour tour was awesome, beautiful view, the pilot was super nice, gentle, funny and caring. I loved I made this choice for my boyfriend's birthday and I thanks Genny for making it possible..
Every penny that I spend was worth it and I would do it again and again. An amazing experience!!

The Miami Seaplane is amazing. It is a must do. I was a little weary of it at first but when they say that safety is their number 1 priority you can definantly tell. Not one time did I actually feel scared. The landing is a little shakey but you are landing in water so that is expected. Tony our pilot was great. He showed us manatees, sharks, and different sea animals from the air. Then we went over different areas where he was VERY knowledgable about stars houses. I would recommend this in a heart beat even if you have lived in MIAMI for your whole life. There is no veiw like a seaplane.

review_title: Well worth the time and money!
review_text: I was in Miami for conference and wanted to do something non-business before I left so I called for the 30 minute tour.  I rented a car (their shuttle van was out of service) and drove there which is about a 15 minute drive from Fountainbleu Hotel.  I was greeted by our friendly pilot and we boarded the cessna 172.  Just an amazing flight.  The best part is I got to fly the plane for 10 minutes in the air (I do carry a private pilot license). FUN FUN FUN!

I did the Everglades trip with Miami Sea Plane. The sparkling blue aircraft was waiting for me on the water. The Pilot was very friendly helped me climb on the plane. The seating is comfortable just beside the Pilot!!! It was a clear bright day. The take off and landing of the aircraft was amazingly smooth. We spent a lot of time looking at Key Biscayne, Slitsville, Fingers, Kay Islands and then Everglades. We even flew through a sea shower for a plane wash!. It was a 100% guided tour, music was played in between when we are not talking.  I clicked some amazing pictures to last me a lifetime.

review_title: Definitely a highlight of a trip.

Enjoy this fantastic experience !

Ciao

Severino
Milan, Italy

review_title: Excellent gift for someone who has everything
review_text:
I can't say enough great things about the Miami Seaplane Tour. Our pilot was so knowledgeable and had fascinating stories to share as he is a Miami native. 
This was a surprise birthday gift for my boyfriend who has everything. We are living in Miami for 4 years and I thought we better do something “touristy” while living here. We can’t wait to go on the Everglades tour.

review_title: What an awesome way to see miami!
review_text: Out of shear luck, the  concierge in our hotel told us about the miami seaplanes tours. And we immediately booked a tour that afternoon! It was awesome! They picked us up at our hotel, their staff was super friendly and the views of Miami were phenomenal. I highly recommend!

review_title: AMAZING!!! THE REAL FEELING OF FLIGHT!!!

 -Conny and Beat Wiederkehr

review_title: Fabulous for locals and visitors alike
review_text: The seaplane tour is such a special and unique experience, and one I'd recommend for locals as well as visitors. If you live in the Bay Area you will see many familiar sights from a totally new vantage point. The views are incredible (bring a camera) and the pilot is knowledgeable and experienced. Great experience, John the pilot was superb and his knowledge during the tour was exceptional. This didn't distract that the experience was brilliant but it is just the little things that let it down
Our Seaplane Adventures trip was great! The staff was friendly and helpful. The views from our plane were spectacular, giving us a whole new and exciting perspective on the San Francisco Bay Area.
What a fantastic tour. Incredible views, very fun and exciting. Staff was great, pilot was great! We did the one hour flight. It was perfect. Well worth every penny. I highly recommend.
We did the Golden Gate flight, the pilot and the team were really nice, the flight were beautiful, we saw the whole San Francisco Bay, we recommand this unforgettable activity !
