The greater bay area Seaplane tour enables its passengers to get a spectacular view from the air, to see the scale and beauty of San Francisco. My family members and I thoroughly enjoyed it! well worth the price in my humble opinion. I would highly recommend.
Our pilot was very nice and did a great flight, around San Francisco, Sausalito , golden Gate Bridge and Alkatraz…. Thank you so much

Omg this was our best trip!! We loved it. After checking in and a short but necessary safety briefing we were given Wellington boots to walk to the plane. The tide was in a little so they saved our shoes getting wet. The pilot was very friendly and informative. We shared our flight with another couple. There are 6 seats including the pilot. You get a headset with microphone each. The flight was very smooth considering its a small aircraft. The views were amazing. The bay, city, woods, sea, coast, bridge. Lasted 45 mins as described. It was so exciting. I would definitely recommend doing it.

Absolutely amazing the views were incredible.
Pilot shared amazing history of the city.
Would do it again in a heartbeat

The experience was very nice, exciting and exciting!!! Definitely special also because the agency team and the driver are very prepared, kind, welcoming and nice)))
Above all it is an event to try at least once in a lifetime 
Highly Recommendation to try

review_title: SF Bay Area view from above
review_text: I would HIGHLY recommend taking this tour if you can. It is a wonderful experience seeing the bay area highlights - Alcatraz, Oracle Park and Golden Gate bridge to name a few - from a helicopter! Our pilot and the staff were fabulous, friendly and very helpful.

review_title: Immortal impressions of San Francisco from the air
review_text:
We were lucky enough to take off by helicopter in sunshine. The pilot John flew us safely to the Golden Gate Bridge, which we could see almost completely, only a few clouds were in front of it.
Then we continued over Alcatraz and then over the city. He told us a lot of insiders and we were just impressed. On request John also stopped again or turned the helicopter so that we could take the perfect pictures.
We felt very well looked after and safe with him.
All in all a great experience!

Our son had promised us this for our last Christmas present, but we were only just able to collect.

What a lovely experience with an interesting and amusing commentary from our pilot.  A great way to see the sights of SF from, literally, a different angle.
Epic flight with epic views and such a wonderfully different perspective of the Bay Area. Highly recommend a flight with sea plane adventures and the pilots and the staff were very cool and helpful.

The staff were pleasant and the pilot good.  The 20 minute trip around the bay was sufficient for us.  We had the least expensive tour (which was still very expensive) and I would expect that most people would not need more time in the air.

Flight was a little bumpy (turbulence in flight), and the takeoff and landing nice and smooth.  My son felt a little queazy near the end, but never needed an airbag.

Highly recommended. Unforgettable experience. It's really worth the money.
We had Fisherman’s Wharf pick us up by shuttle. Prior confirmation via WhatsApp. Everything worked out perfectly.

I was really nervous at the beginning it was my first seaplane ride and let me say it was beyond everything. Very professional highly motivated crew and groundstaff with a very experienced and funny pilot. It was definitly worth every doller.

Had a wonderful flight around the bay and up the north coast of California our pilot was excellent at pointing the land marks along the way
A definite must do if you can afford it
Really enjoyed our experience on the seaplane so much more we could see by air totally amazing experience and would definitely recommend this to friends and family who visit
Simple fast, uncomplicated communication. Flexible rebooking is even possible. Dear Lauren also arrived on time and picked us up and drove us back again.
This is gift for my birthday to myself! And i love it, city looks so georgous! Thanks a lot our pilot!
It was a wonderful day and a memorable experience in a seaplane flying over SF Bay.  The pilot John was nice and professional, we enjoyed this one very much and we highly recommend it to you.

review_title: The only and best way to see San Francisco
review_text: What a great experience from the moment we arrived they couldn't have done more for us , really knowledgeable,  friendly
It was an absolutely amazing experience. Saw so much in a short space of time ..The views were spectacular. Well worth the money.

Super friendly and professional team on site, very well-maintained aircraft and a unique experience! We enjoyed every single minute of the 45-minute Great Bay tour. The route was very well chosen, you fly over the Golden Gate, past Alcatraz and further along the coast. The pilot also played tour guide and explained a few things. We had a great time and I would recommend these sightseeing flights to anyone!

Best Birthday Flight!    So happy I decided to celebrate my Birthday with Aero Adventures!  Thank you Marylee, Anna, John and Ren for making the day so special.   Nothing can compare to flying over SF and the Golden Gate.  I have sailed under the Golden Gate but there is something truly special SOARING over the Golden Gate!  Floating along the Bay preparing to take-off (engine ROARING) is magical.  I can't wait for my next Flight!     -E.A.H.-Lockhart a.k.a jumpjet

Aaron is a terrific pilot, host.  I've lived in Marin for most of my life, yet learned so much from him about history.  The views were, of course, dramatic, but Aaron's voiceover and piloting skills were the magical glue.  Highly recommend.

Unique and unforgettable experience!
I did it 20 years ago and wanted to make my teenage daughters experience it.
It's still so magnificent, the San Francisco Bay site is so worth flying over and doing it in a seaplane is great.
The team is fantastic: the super professional pilot, the reception staff. They are very friendly and accommodating.
We remember it all our lives, don't hesitate!

review_title: Beautiful tour in a classic seaplane
review_text: Staff were all very friendly and helpful.  Pilot was kind and professional and made the tour interesting.  The plane was beautiful!
Beautiful flight in a beautiful Beaver.  It was windy when we flew and the pilot did an outstanding job.   I highly recommend it to anyone.   We did the North Coast tour a d even saw some whales.
The route is wonderful, the attention is spectacular and the historical data made everything seem like a movie.

2nd trip and as 1st it didn’t disappoint.

Very professional & friendly company, which made for a very pleasurable experience.

review_title: An amazing Seaplane Adventure...over the top!!
review_text:
This was so much better than I had expected.  From booking the flight to the actual experience.  Everyone was so friendly and helpful!  Mary Lee welcomed us as if we were family.  I took my dad for his 80th birthday.   He forgot his coat (if you go, you should bring a jacket), so Mary Lee immediately helped us get a sweatshirt with no delays.  
There were six of us total and what a great day!  My 79 year old mom almost didn't go because she was nervous about climbing into the plane but Aaron the pilot along with Renato (Ren) made her feel safe and secure as she boarded and de-boarded.  They were awesome!
Up in the air, the views were incredible, Aaron shared the history of the Bay with us over the headsets that we were available for us on the flight.  I've lived in the area for over 40 years and I was surprised at the tidbits that I didn't know.  
If you've ever thought about riding in a SeaPlane, don't delay!  It was seriously a blast and a lifelong memory!  
Thank you Mary Lee, Aaron and Renato - we had an amazing tour and thank you to Ann (for all the helpful email correspondence)!

My flight on Sunday was awesome. As a native of San Francisco, I was very impressed with Aaron's local knowledge. Also, being a commercially rated seaplane pilot myself, I was thoroughly impressed with the quality of the operation. Aaron's piloting skills are extremely impressive. Overall, Seaplane Adventures was "over the top" in terms of fun and safety!

My husband received this as a birthday gift from us. From front desk to pilot he had the best experience. Stuff was kind, patient and super knowledgeable. The helicopter ride was exceptional and truly once in a lifetime experience. Worth every penny. We will definitely plan another trip as a family.
We had the most amazing flight in the helicopter.  It was a unique experience and is highly recommended it.  Well run, friendly and a must do for any tourist
Such a cool experience. We did an hour tour and I would highly recommend the hour. Seeing the coast of Northern California and the city were incredible.
It was convenient to make reservations. The staff was very professional. The pick and drop service comes real handy. Above all, this was one of the best ride we had.
Very knowledgeable helicopter pilot! I got some great photos and learned a lot about the area.  I would highly recommend this group for a seaplane or helicopter tour.

review_title: Best gift you can give in the city!
review_text:
Bought a 2 pack for me and my SO for a valentines day gift and it was an absolutely stellar experience. Aaron was a fantastic pilot and tour guide, knew lots of things that wowed both of us, even as locals! I strongly suggest the full sunset tour since the lighting is phenomenal and you'll get to explore the northern bay a bit as well, which is absolutely beautiful. The fly around Mt. Tam, Stinson, Muir Beach, Sunset, Golden Gate, Marina, Downtown, TI, The Rock, Angel Island, and back was absolutely breathtaking.
No part of it felt rushed or anything. Aaron was very personable and an incredible pilot.

Perfect Bay Area sightseeing trip.  I’m a pilot, so a plane tour is right up my alley.  Took my fiancée, who is a bit nervous about flying, and she LOVED it too.  Excellent way to spend a offload a good chunk of money, ha.
This has to be the best way to see SF - informative and entertaining tour, whales and seals as well as fantastic scenery and overflying the Golden Gate, City and Alcatraz - (very smooth flight!)

We had the most beautiful, smooth, educational, and very fun ride on Seaplane Adventures!  Even the pilot I brought along on the trip with me was fascinated... the entire time.  It's always good to see things from a different angle, and this brought this to life, flying low(ish) over the Golden Gate Bridge, the City, along the Coast, and more.  There is always something new to learn about this area, and our pilot certainly filled us in.  Highly recommended!

The flight was really nice. We ended up seeing much more than we expected. We were able to cover a lot of ground in the ~30 minute session. I think it even went 5 minutes over (I'm not complaining!).

The water take off and landing were unique and felt distinct from a normal plane on a runway.

Loved this tour! Booked for myself and husband for his 40th birthday. Kind of wish we'd done it at the start of the week as it actually provided us with better orientation of how the city was laid out! From being greeted by 'Debit' the old pooch on arrival, sitting in sunshine with drinks waiting for the plane to be ready - overlooking all the beautiful house boots, flying through Golden Gate bridge and circling Alcatraz as the sunset, and the softest of landings (better than British Airways)! Peaceful, beautiful and exhilarating!

review_title: A Must Do for Locals AND Visitors!
review_text: Amazing experience! Such a great and fun way to see San Francisco and the areas beyond. Amazing team and crew. Highly recommend!!
Born and raised in the Bay and a pilot myself. Never did this and while visiting did the sunset tour. Beautiful perspective flying low and seeing the whole bay at sunset!

Great views over San Francisco and the Golden Gate Bridge.
I like old planes so that was just as exciting

review_title: A must for anyone looking for a unique experience
review_text: Seaplane Adventures is a wonderful team that offers the raddest experiences. I am a wedding elopement photographer and reached out to them to create a unique elopement experience and to showcase a fun beautiful proposal for my couples. Their team is so friendly and helpful and customized a wonderful day/flight for us. They are a true gem in the San Francisco area and offer such a cool way to see the sites from above. Both of my couples were head over heals for the experience. One of my couples have lived in the city their whole live's and just loved seeing all of their favorite places from the sky. It was true romantic adventure at it's best. It's location is perfect for blending it into a fun day or weekend endeavor. I can't recommend this business and team enough. Looking forward to more seaplane adventures!

review_title: Special birds eye view of San Francisco
review_text: What an incredible experience to fly over and around the coast of San Francisco. My husband and I took our 1 year old daughter who smiled the whole time and loved looking out the window. The plane ride was so smooth and we actually felt safer than flying in regular commercial planes. The team at Seaplane Adventures are very helpful and want to make sure you have the best experience - we had booked for October, but the weather was not in our favor so they rescheduled our tour with no issues. Would gladly do this again!

Maybe the coolest thing to do in the Bay Area, and that is saying something. We LOVED it. Saw several whales — one was right on the surface so we could see its entire body! Spectacular views and really friendly pilot. Totally worth the price of admission!!!

We absolutely loved this experience! Upon arrival the staff were all friendly and good chat. The flying experience was amazing, it was great to see the Bay Area from a different angle. The plane journey was fun and much smoother than I was expecting. We are so glad we made the decision to book this!!
A must do activity in the bay!! The team and pilot very courteous, and jehanc, I was outstanding. I would highly recommend it.
Very good experience, incredible pilot and very efficient service. Without a doubt I would do it again.

We are a local family that has been watching the seaplanes fly by our home for years, and we wanted the chance to see the Bay Area from above.  This was an amazing experience and great for both locals and tourists!

I would say without hesitation its the best tourist attraction in the bay area, you can get a grasp of the whole San Francisco Bay Area in 30 minutes, along with some very interesting historical facts.

From start to finish, a great experience.  Excellent staff, excellent pilot.  Our flight up to Sonoma and Napa was exciting and fascinating.  Very cool to see the wine country from above!  A final spin around the SF Bay was breathtaking. We began taking these flights several years ago on our anniversary. Can't wait for next year...!

This experience was definitely one for a lifetime. The pilot/guide John was very fun and informative, while giving everyone the experience of a lifetime. The views were unbelievable and something I will remember forever. Only downside, we were never given and champagne and when I asked after the tour, I was told the champagne had to be purchased separately. Little disappointed by that has it says in the description it was included.
Absolutely amazing, fun and entertaining. Pilot was informati8ve and funny. We really enjoyed the experience as my wife was co-pilot.!

review_title: Seaplane Flight over San Fran Bay
review_text: Brilliant! Great experience, fantastic views of San Fran, Alcatraz, Golden Gate and Bay bridges. Excellent, friendly service from being picked up by the shuttle bus in Fisherman’s Wharf to being dropped off again. The 1955 De Havilland seaplane is fantastic. Highly recommended afternoon out!
We were supposed to go on a helicopter trip but at the last minute we had to go on the sea plane trip. It was very short like 15 minutes.it was not what I expected.

We had a great time. The weather cleared just in time for our flight. The golden gate was a little clouded but mostly clear. We opted for the shuttle service from downtown and they picked us up and delivered us efficiently.
What an amazing experience! Seeing all the sights of San Francisco from the air. Highly reommnended!

review_title: Stunning bird's eye views of SF
review_text: The helicopter tour with Seaplane adventures was absolutely amazing: a friendly, kind and helpful staff and the breathtaking views of San Francisco and the Bay are the reasons why I'd certainly recommend opting for this tour.
The best adventure you can do in the San Francisco Area. You see the piers, alcatraz, Golden Gate, Baybridge... and the beautyful landscape 😁

I took my son for his 10th birthday. He said his favorite part was the view of the SF bridge, Alcatraz, Oracle park. Professional and friendly staff. Overall a great experience and worth every penny. Bucket list experience:)

review_title: Fantastic flight over SF and Marin!
review_text: It was so much fun to fly low over the Bay Bridge and SF and the GG Bridge and the hills of Marin County. My teenage son absolutely loved it as a birthday gift. The staff and pilot were top notch. It's not cheap but worth every penny!
We had an absolutely wonderful time on the seaplane for my daughter's 18th birthday. It really helped that the staff was very pleasant, detailed and accommodating.

review_title: Scenic Rollercoaster Ride Above the Bay!
review_text: What an experience that was! The flight was an incredible adventure. Seaplane tours are the perfect way to celebrate the birthday of a loved one. We had such a great time. Thank you!
Pilot never introduced himself and never engaged the passengers.  He did point out a few areas around the bay and flew the sea plane very well. He answered my questions though brief.

We expected it to be a good tour but it was a great tour!  Such good views of so many interesting places in the Bay Area.  Great views of the bridges and downtown.  Such a good way to get to the know the area.  Our pilot was excellent - both his interesting narration and flying skills.

It wasn’t until we were in the air that the pilot let us know we wouldn’t go where we wanted to go because of weather. I would have canceled and chosen another day.  $600+ is too much to pay to miss what you want to see. Phone calls to management were not returned. Seaplanes Adventures has an integrity and courtesy problem.  
.

review_title: Every visitor to San Francisco should see it from the air!
review_text: An absolute must when visiting San Francisco! This floatplane tour far exceeded our expectations, giving us spectacular views of San Francisco landmarks and the surrounding gorgeous coastline/natural areas, narrated through 2-way headsets by our knowledgeable pilot. We have amazing memories and photos and a geographical/topographical understanding of the area you can't get by seeing San Francisco any other way. 100% recommend!!

review_title: Great combined flying and sightseeing experience!
review_text: Great directions provided beforehand, the place was easy to find and provided a good impression. Our pilot Aaron took us on a marvellous flying experience along the Bay, the Golden Gate, the coastline and the city. Flying a seaplane is quite a unique experience, and we definitely recommend it to everyone who wants to remember this as the experience of a lifetime - "the fun way is no runway"!
Overall great experience.  staff very kind and professional. lot of information given during flight.  cute dog in their office.  we easily found parking available.  all smooth.

Wow!  This experience was way better than I was expecting.  To see the Bay Area from above gave me a brand new appreciation for the beauty and majesty of Marin County and San Francisco.  I can't recommend this enough.  The pilot was personable and gave a brief history of some of the famous landmarks.  Go for it!!!

review_title: Smiles ear to ear. A few beautiful views.
review_text: it was a great evening flight. Weather and landing were perfect. Arron, our pilot, was a great guide full of knowledge about so many landmarks I never knew.

Vol en hydravion au dessus de la baie et de la ville de SF, commente par le pilote (qui parle un peu français). Un seul mot : fantastique.
Pour les initiés à la réglementation aéronautique, un vol (au dessus de la ville, du GGB …), impossible à imaginer en France.
Je conseille vivement.
Le tout avec un accueil très sympathique.

Einzigartiges Erlebnis mit der Familie - Tolle Aussicht auf San Francisco und Umgebung . Sehr freundliches Personal . Flug wurde wegen schlechtem Wetter schnell und einfach umgebucht . Toller Pilot - Werden wir nicht vergessen - vielen Dank noch mal an das Team!

Call this a seaplane if you want, but it's more of a cool, retro magic carpet that provides an unbelievable Bay Area experience. The office is incredibly friendly and efficient, and Aaron, our pilot, was beyond professional. We floated over the city's iconic scenery and landmarks, feeling 100 percent snug and safe in the roaring, reliable Dehaviland Beaver.  You owe it to yourself to see the full breadth of the Bay Area from the air, and Seaplane Adventures is the outfit to trust.

Phenomenal experience! Fantastic team! We were lucky with the weather (after we had to reschedule due to heavy winds) with blue skies and clear views. Aaron Singer was an absolute trustworthy pilot with a great sense of humor who showed us everything around the greater S.F. Area.
Thank you so much for this awesome experience!!

review_title: Amazing Views of the City and North Coast
review_text: We had some friends in town and wanted to do something special with them.  The flight with Seaplane Adventures did not disappoint.  We did the Norcal Coastal Tour and flew up the coast to Point Reyes before returning to the Bay and flying over the city.  The flight ws fun, safe and professionally run.  Booking was easy and pleasant.  I'd recommend this company to anyone.

This is the best way to see San Francisco. The seaplane flight was a real highlight of my trip, especially flying over the Golden Gate Bridge.
The pilot was brilliant and had loads of knowledge about all the sights we flew over, and I’d recommend this to anyone wanting to see San Francisco from the air. Was great value too 👌

This was the BEST experience of my life. Super awesome employees and pilot.  We paid for a 3rd person, just to have the flight for ourselves and it was worth it. It was so cool to take off and land on the water. So much information given to us during our flight, about all the stuff we flew by. It was great. Take the opportunity to do this trip.

Absolutely unforgettable experience! Booking was easy, the pilote was nice, explaining the sights  and answering questions, the take off and landing on water was smouth and views of Golden Gate, San Francisco and Alcatraz just incredible!
Worth every penny.  The trip was fabulous and everyone was so helpful, knowledgeable and friendly.  It won’t disappoint.

My husband and I spent the weekend in San Francisco and took the seaplane ride. It did not disappoint. We were worried because it was a cloudy day we might not have the best views, but we did and it was breathtaking.
Wonderful trip and knowledgeable and friendly staff! I wish we had taken this trip before and look forward to coming back for their other excursions!

This experience definitely made an impact to CJ. Robert and I surprised him together with our 4 yr old daughter Jeanna who is super brave and super cute! Our pilot, Daniel which is super funny but is really really good made this flight enjoyable and memorable! He gave CJ the opportunity to fly the plane above the Golden gate bridge! The weather was perfect at that time but for some reason my eyes started flooding! We will definitely treasure this for the rest of our lives!
The aircraft was really nice! Seats were comfortable and we can hear each other clearly through the headsets provided! The view of the bay is spectacular! We flew around downtown sf, bay bridge, alcatraz and of course the golden gate bridge. It was a smooth take off and even smoother landing! It was awesome! We didn’t even feel that we landed already!
Ashley is super helpful and gave us information and resources in order for CJ to become a pilot plus the souvenir for our kids!
Thank you so much! We will definitely come back!

When you travel from Europe you plan and dream about your trip. This is one of the arrangement I absolutely did not want to miss. With all the storms that have hit California beginning of January 2023, after a few cancellations because of the weather, we were able to have an amazing experience taking a tour with sea plane adventures for an our over San Francisco and the coast.
Strongly recommend !

review_title: The best view of the Golden Gate Bridge possible
review_text: A really good way to see the bay area, and a very professional and friendly service. Cannot recommend highly enough!

Great overview of where we live and work all at 1200 ft !!!!
 Real fun on a seaplane.....a new adventure!!

The weather was stunning so we were lucky enough to get San Francisco & the harbour in all its glory. I'm not normally a confident flyer, unlike my wife, but I found the whole experience to be amazing. We would thoroughly recommend this for a special trip.

I took my family from Canada for a SF tour.   

The pilot was funny, informative, and would modify his flight to show us areas we were interested in.

The highlights include the fly overs of both bridges, Alcatraz, and an amazing shot up Market street with the Ferry Building in front.    

He pointed out various landmarks along the way and issued antidotes that were great for the teens and adults alike.

My guests called it a highlight of their visit.    Would definitely do it again next time I have guests from out of the area.

review_title: Seaplane Adventure as a birthday gift.
review_text: The staff was great. The flight was great.  Google needs to update location data because we were sent to wrong location using GPS.
The day started with a little hiccup, but Seaplane sorted us out. What a fabulous flight it was!! Great day out, would highly recommend it!!!!!✈️✈️✈️✈️✈️✈️✈️

review_title: My Amazing Birthday Present to Me!
review_text: I had a BIG birthday on a weekday, and knew I needed a special experience on the actual day. Arranging a ride with Seaplane Adventures was the best decision I could have made. As local who's lived nearby for decades, I'm glad I finally did it. I chose the one-hour Pt. Reyes + Marin Coast trip, which includes flying by San Francisco. The trip took us over the familiar towns and landscapes of beautiful Marin County, then to the dramatic cliffs and beaches of the coast, where we saw several pods of whales out at sea, and finally over the Golden Gate, past downtown SF, over Alcatraz, with a landing in Richardson Bay offering amazing views of Sausalito, Tiburon and Belvedere. The weather was clear as a bell with unlimited visibility. The pilot and staff at Seaplane Adventures were totally professional, knowledgeable and friendly. It's clearly a very well run operation. I highly recommend them for anyone -- visitor or local -- who wants to enjoy our beautiful area from a whole new perspective. I fully intend to fly with them again.
Super fun for our anniversary. Our captain told us funny jokes and we got to see some unforgettable views.

I chose to fly with Seaplane Adventures on a trip over San Francisco Bay. Absolutely fantastic trip, professional and friendly staff, and an experience I will remember for years to come! Highly recommended for aviation enthusiasts and more!

Surprised my husband got his bier throat and he loved it!  It was so fun! Clear weather and the views were beautiful!  Flew over SF, Mt Tam, Stinson Beach, Golden Gate Bridge, even saw some whales breaching.  Highly recommend this adventure.

This adventure was the highlight of our trip!  Everything was perfect from start to end.  The weather was nice so the views were excellent.  Soaring over the Golden Gate, Alcatraz & Marin County was breathtaking.  The staff were so nice and accommodating.  I highly recommend this activity if you are visiting the San Francisco Bay Area.

Great 30 minute trip with our pilot Daniel, didn’t stop smiling from start to finish. Great views over SF and to fly between the uprights of the Golden Gate Bridge was amazing! All the staff were great.
Daniel was our captain, we really enjoyed our tour. The weather was not great but it did not effect the visibility

I highly recommend Seaplane Adventures! We had a wonderful time and got to fly right over the Golden Gate bridge, San Francisco, and more. The flight was smooth and the views were excellent. I would do this again!

review_title: Most magnificent joy ride over the bay
review_text: We had a hilarious, informative tour guide and the most accommodating staff. We got to see the gorgeous sights around the city and Marin. I would most definitely recommend!

We took the shuttle from fisherman’s wharf which was exactly on time.
The check in process was quick and hassle free. Daniel the captain was a star-extremely knowledgeable with a great wit. 
The whole flight was amazing, we didn’t really know what to expect but the experience is phenomenal and will never be forgotten.
We found the whole experience worth every cent, and would repeat the trip without hesitation. Thank you and well done to all concerned
Great experience with cool and friendly pilot; totally new perspectives of San Francisco; complete family enjoyed the trip

I surprised my husband with a Bay area tour by Seaplane Adventures.  We have been to San Francisco many times but have never done this before.  It was an absolute Awesome time.  Quite the surprise and the adventure was more fun than we could have even imagined.  The tour was great - throughout Marin county, over/thru the Golden Gate bridge spires and up and down the city coast line.  Highly recommend this adventure to anyone - whether it's your first visit to the wonderful city, you visit often or live there.  This is a must and worth all 5 Stars.

I have lived in the Bay Area for 15 years and it is by far my favorite local adventure.  I took my 3.5 year old daughter up with me and it blew her mind.  The staff was so friendly and fun and the views from the plane were breathtaking!  I can't want to take friends and family when they come to visit!
The flight was unexpectedly smooth and the views breathtaking. The sensation was as if floating from a hot air ballon at a Disney Theme Park. Outstanding!
This is the vest way to get to know San Francisco coast,this experience eas amazing,the views were breathtaking,worth the spend.

review_title: Fantastic tour of the San Francisco Bay
review_text: Took my younger son on this tour and picked the 1 hour option; we had a fantastic time. We were lucky to have Aaron, the owner of Seaplanes Adventures, as our pilot and guide. He is very knowledgeable about the Bay, Napa, the history around Angel Island and much more. I definitely highly recommend even for locals!

We were lucky to have a sunny, clear morning for this experience and we loved it.  The pilot was very knowledgeable and the views were great.  If you have time do this when you are in San Francisco and then spend some time in Sausalito which is well worth a visit.

This company uses DeHavilland Beaver planes which in spite of being an old model have an awesome reputation of a reliable plane with great short take off and landing. That being said, it would be expected that a plane is upkept and modernized with all the new avionics technology available. Their planes have no modern technology, they are just the original from the 50's; headliner was falling apart, headsets were not working in the back seats, having to rely on yelling. The only reason why I'm not rating them terrible is because the pilot had good skills and pleasant personality. But if I wanted to see a piece of history, I would have gone to a museum.
seaplane adventures offered a great flight and breathtaking views, we loved every minute of it! will absolutely fly again upon our next visit to marin.
Can't recommend doing this trip enough! The whole team and flight was amazing. A real unique life experience.

I wished for this flight for my 50th birthday and I couldn't have asked for anything better.
The communication beforehand was very friendly and helpful.
The pilot was super nice and told us a lot about the features of the area during the flight.
It was an exciting adventure that I can only recommend to everyone.
We did the Nor Cal tour and it was terrific.Our pilot was knowledgeable and very personable. It was money well spent. I highly encourage this trip.

A sea plane was one of my last air adventures on my bucket list. I have lived in the Bay Area for 68 years and this was one of the best tours showing me the sights of the San Francisco area. It has gotten me interested in another of their longer tours of the area. The complete crew running the outfit was very friendly and informative. 
Thanks Capt'n Dan!!
Celebrated my boyfriend’s birthday with a Seaplane Adventures tour. Had a great time. Loved our pilot’s humor and the views were amazing. Worth the 60 minute tour.

Expérience unique !
Tout était parfait: la prise en charge, le décollage, le survol de la ville, du Golden Gate Bridge et d'une partie de la région, avec un pilote souriant, qui donne les bonnes explications. Le parcours choisi (45 minutes) permet de prendre son temps pour bien voir (de près) les principaux sites de San Francisco.
it was an exciting and very funny experience, first time starting and landing on the water! great views and interesting informations given! highly recommended!

review_title: Great ride and historical tour of SF
review_text: Absolutely loved riding on the 1955 Beaver (haha). Fantastic plane with great pilot who gave us a historical tour of bay area. Book a later flight so the clouds burn off

review_title: Super vol au dessus de San Francisco
review_text: Le vol s'est très bien déroulé. tout le monde était très sympa. la vue est magnifique sur le golden gate et sur San Francisco malgré la présence de brumes. Merci pour ces merveilleux souvenirs
Survol à faire de la baie de San Francisco un jour de beau temps. Sensation très agréables. Pilote très sympa et très précis dans ses explications. A faire sans hésiter

review_title: Excellent Way to see The San Fransisco Bay Area
review_text:
I booked a 45 minute sightseeing flight with Seaplane Adventures, as a birthday surprise for my wife and to round off our Californian vacation with a lasting memory.
The team were warm and friendly and the whole experience was excellent.
I particularly wanted to fly in one of these radial engined Beavers and I wasn't disappointed.
My wife loved the whole flight.
It's a memory we will keep as one of the highlights of our Vacation.
Thank You to all at Seaplane Adventures.

Amazing! What a wonderful experience! From Ana to the pilots, it's a DREAM TEAM who is going to welcome you! They are very professional and even kinder. They took very good care of us and make this flight unforgettable.

review_title: AMAZING DAY! Incredible and memorable for a 60th birthday!
review_text: We went to celebrate my husbands 60th and I was really scared and afraid to join him and our 13 year old daughter (fear of heights). Well, the champagne before the flight helped calm my nerves (highly recommend) and it was a totally smooth and comfortable ride. Our pilot was awesome! I loved his commentary and all the great stories he shared. It was a truly incredible once in a lifetime experience!!! The helicopter tour looked cool too :)

Took this trip as a surprise for my son who is interested in aviation.   It was a great tour with views that can't be equaled in any other way.    Our pilot was great and we had the best time.  Highly recommend!

This was our first sea plane tour and what a tour this was! Well organised and informative. We were flown alongside the Golden Gate Bridge and around the Bay. It was magical seeing SF from the air. Thank you to everyone that made our day

Such an amazing experience for our family. Our teen was the "co-pilot" and said it was his favorite part of our trip! The employees are so nice and friendly! The pilot was funny and sooo knowledgable on the history of the areas toured. Is a must do for any family trip!

Booknwe booked the 30 minute Golden Gate tour which I'd highly recommend. The price is very reasonable and the tour itself was great. We booked transfers to the seaplane which worked perfectly and without any hassle - the company kept in touch to make sure we knew where and then to be collected.

The seaplane tour itself was amazing. The different perspective seeing the city from the air is amazing and the pilot was informative and totally relaxed. The views were excellent and although I was concerned about feeling claustrophobic - it wasn't an issue at all. I thoroughly enjoyed every second!
It was really breathtaking to fly over the Bay Area in a small six seater plane. The pilot and employees were very hospitable and kind every step of the way.

This was a Fathers’ Day gift from my wife…I’m an adrenaline freak, she’s not. Turns out, no adrenaline required. Our pilot was exceptional as he flew the plane and played tour guide simultaneously…clearly a multitasking expert. So much fun!
I expected the water landing to be rough…WRONG! It was easily the smoothest, most imperceptible touchdown in my experience,
Do this. It’ll be worth every penny, worth every second.

review_title: I’ll give you all the stars! It was a very good experience special because it was in day of my birthday!
review_text: It was a so beautiful experience! All team was kind of sweet really really like thank you so much it was a great gift for my birthday! Thank you guys
We had so much fun on my bachelorette sunset cruise!  A great option to get out on the sea in MV!!!!!

This was definitely worth the price paid and will be a memorable experience that me and my girlfriends will remember fondly in the years ahead. There was a minor issue with our scheduling because of the cloud coverage, but Ed was incredibly accommodating and was able to fit us in on a 5pm trip. Words can't express how beautiful the views were and Bruce our pilot was a pro and excellent tour guide. Thank you Bruce and team for such a fantastic experience! Definitely Recommend!
A fantastic experience with excellent views of all the highlights of San Francisco. Would recommend to anyone looking to see the City by the Bay from above.

One of the highlights of our visit to SF! Take off and landing were really smooth and the aerial views were amazing. Pilot was really knowledgeable and professional. My only complaint is that it was over too soon!
Everything was great everyone was super nice to us including ti my little ones. We had an emergency and they where able to help us. We highly recommend this tour if you are a SF lover.

Vraiment magnifique de survoler la baie de San Francisco passer au dessus du Golden gate et de la prison d.Alcatraz. L.équipe est super sympathique si vous en avez l’occasion n’hésitez pas ce sera un souvenir inoubliable sensation garantie.

Wow this was amazing you get to see the whole of San Francisco from high above, obviously helps when you have a clear day as we did so that was good. Seeing the Golden Gate Bridge from above was absolutely amazing. A very good trip to do pilot was great and spoke to us through the head sets. It’s not a cheap trip to do but it is actually worth doing if you like that sort of thing. Does get a bit bumpy and moves around but that adds to all the fun of the trip.

review_title: Should be on the list of must do while in San Francisco
review_text: I didn’t realize what I was missing until I took my  seaplane trip.  The friendly and knowledgeable staff helped us select the trip that was best for us.   The pilot pointed out and answered our questions about the many places and land marks we have visited over the years we have  lived in this area we call home.  We look forward to recommending this to all my friends and family
Was an amazing tour!! We live in the city and it was such a fun way to see it from another angle!! The captain was great and informative and the plane was so so cool. Would definitely recommend this!

our guests was very happy to get this flight. Weather was great and it was an experience to flight with
Seaplane
Fabuleux! Un voyage inoubliable de 45 minutes au dessus de San Francisco.  Gardez les yeux ouverts. C'est magique!

Our seaplane adventure was amazing and had Spectacular and breath taking views! The pilot was amazing and had a lot of experience including military flight training; that’s a plus! Check in was so easy. Nice and friendly staff. It was my children's first flight and they loved it. I think they are inspired to be pilots, especially my 12 year old daughter. She wants to be a fighter pilot now! We are definitely going again!

Exceptionnel ! 45 minutes suspendus dans le ciel avec une vue splendide. Un pilote très sympathique et rassurant.
Activité à ne manquer sous aucun prétexte si vous visitez San Francisco.
Taking off and landing on water is definitely a unique and worthwhile experience. To then tour the San Francisco surroundings was simply magical. Go do it!
As a bay area native, it was amazing seeing it from a different perspective. The views were amazing, and the flight was very smooth.

No better way to view the City, country around SF.  Professional, safe, thrilling experience,
Reviewed by another Pilot!

This is an awesome trip over the headlands the Golden Gate bridge and San Francisco flying at a low elevation basically floating over a city and region that as a local you know well and enjoy seeing its beauty from the sky. The pilot and tour guide is fantastic and his description and ability to show you things throughout the trip.

We felt very safe with our pilot. The tour was location-wise very well chosen - we have seen all the highlights and the pilot provided us with lots of interesting facts. He was also really funny. :-) The communication with their manager Anna was very professional. I will recommend the Seaplane tour to everyone!
It was soo incredible, didn’t expect to see so much of the bay and our pilot was very knowledgeable, not only for tourists, we are local and loved it

A+ experience. This tour provides the perspective of the expansive Bay Area that’s very difficult to get from the ground. The guide has a knack for banter and communication.

Bottom line, while pricey it is DEFINITELY worth every penny.
It was really fun, and the pilot was very kind and knowledgeable. I went with two friends and we all want to do it again!  May choose the longer flight next time.

Pilot was very friendly and flight was awesome! This was a gift for my son's 20th Birthday and my son said it was the best time ever ..He loved every minute and could not stop smiling from ear to ear... my son got to sit in front and fly co pilot ..it was AWESOME!!

review_title: Amazing aerial tour of the bay area!
review_text: We had so much fun on the seaplane, we can't wait to do it again when we have visitors! It is an incredible perspective on the city and surrounding area and our pilot, Bruce, had great information to share throughout the trip. Can't recommend this enough!

review_title: Fantastic  birthday gift from our daughter and son-in-law.
review_text: After all these years of living in Marin, I can’t believe what we’ve been missing by not having done a seaplane tour until now. The highlight of the flight was being able to see from above towns and landmarks you’re so familiar with. We enjoyed every minute of the flight and can’t wait to do it again!
Super friendly staff and great experience. Best views! Pilot shared a lot of Information about the area.

I surprised my brother and my husband with a 30min seaplane ride above San Francisco. This was the highlight of our trip! The staff is super friendly, the pilot was really funny and professional. 
Being able to see Marin and SF from the sky is priceless. I will recommend this to everyone that comes to visit San Francisco!

review_title: one the must do in life!-Seaplane of Golden Gate
review_text: This is my 2nd visit and will do many times after by bringing different friends ! Other than the grand view of the entire 40min route in sunset,  Bruce the pilot has done an outstanding job in explaining histories/stories/meaning along the way!

Our family took the NorCal coastal tour on February 12th of this year.  The whole experience was outstanding!  The Seaplane Adventures crew was outgoing and friendly and we all enjoyed ourselves immensely.  The day was beautiful.  It was a real pleasure to fly in the DeHaviland Beaver!  Truly a classic aircraft.
Had a wonderful experience. Got an aerial view of San Francisco downtown. Will definitely refer to my friends and family to visit this

I've lived in San Francisco for 20 years, and every time I see one of these planes fly overhead I think, "Why not me?"

Today it finally was me! Absolutely awesome tour. Seeing them from the air has already inspired me to do more hikes of Mt. Tam and the Point Reyes National Seashore.

The plane was very comfortable. I'm 6'6" and very wide, and it was more comfortable than sitting in coach.

We waited until the day-of to book because the weather can be so fickle around here. We had great weather and no fog, which obviously made it fantastic.
Great overview of the area. Loved flying over and around Golden Gate Bridge and views of SF. Fun perspective from the air.

Made for a fabulous Valentine's Day surprise for my fiancée. He got to sit in the co-pilot seat & talked about how much he enjoyed the flight for the rest of the day. 

It was SO worth it! I loved it too. The pilot & staff was great. We loved learning about the history of SF during the flight.

Thank you for helping us to check off a bucket list item & providing us a forever memorable Valentine's Day memory. It is appreciated!

Thanks very much for the pilot for his services was perfect. Safe and fun. Thanks to Ed for his communication even though our family was late about 15-30minute from the time that we suppose to be in the plane

review_title: Wonderful experience I will never forget.
review_text: Highly recommended for the views that are without equal. The affable pilot narrates the voyage so you will learn and appreciate the Bat even more than you already do. I will cherish the memory.
Such a unique experience to do in the Bay Area. Highly recommend, best views you will ever get of the bay and the city

review_title: A beautiful day over the San Francisco Bay!
review_text:
We had an amazing flight over the Golden Gate Bridge, coastline, San Francisco and the bay and took fabulous pictures.  The flight was very smooth and our experienced retired United pilot Bruce kept us informed of what we saw below with wit and knowledge.  We live in San Francisco but still picked up on a few things we didn't know about the area's history and points of interest.  
The ground crew Ed, Anna, and deck hand Max were fantastic as well and made the whole experience perfect.  We will be back with friends!

Unforgettable! 

A unique experience. We enjoyed both the stunning views of SF Bay and Northern coast and the smooth flight in a classic and beautiful seaplane.

Possibly one of the best experiences to enjoy this city and surroundings.
What a spectacular view and very knowledgeable pilot. enjoyed every minute of it and even learned a few things.

I booked this activity through the BucketlistersSF Instagram page and boy was it the best decision ever!  Not only was it a fun surprise for my partner's 35th birthday, but it was an awesome way to spend midday New Year's Eve 2021.  Everyone there was friendly and our pilot was cool and funny.  We're actually locals, BUT the views of Marin and SF are amazing from up top...something we rarely get to see and enjoy.  I might just book this again and try the full hour flight just because!
The service matched the great weather - Awesome tour. Very pleasant and informative pilot. What a way to see Marin and San Francisco!!!
Our pilot, Aaron, was terrific! I felt completely safe & welcomed. He also provided interesting historical trivia without talking too much. The photo oops were terrific too. So fun! And I’m a local!
Incredible tour and views of San Francisco! The staff couldn’t be kinder or more professional. I absolutely recommend to anyone in the Bay Area!

review_title: Fantastic Way to see San Francisco
review_text: We had beautiful weather and a fantastic flight! What a wonderful way to see our beautiful city and incredible Golden Gate Bridge. Bruce, our pilot was a fabulous tour guide! Would highly recommend this company and these flights.

Excellent and fantastically smooth flight! Aaron was a super smooth pilot and very cordial and friendly. Having lived in the Bay Area our entire lives we experienced a world which gave us a new perspective on where we live. Ground crew and all staff were super friendly. Cannot wait to do it again!!!

review_title: Great activity to see the city
review_text: I took my fiancé as a surprise for his birthday. We both loved it and got to see the city from a new perspective. Our pilot and all of the staff were friendly and safety oriented.

review_title: Awesome Sea Plane Golden Gate Tour!
review_text: Awesome experience! The pilot was super nice and informative. Me and the wife sat in the wing seats, and my mother in law even got to sit shotgun, next to the pilot :) Great birthday. Might go again!

Bruce our pilot made this the most amazing experience! Anna was extremely helpful with arranging our private flight for two. The views were breath taking & the detailed information about all our beautiful sights were so very interesting, thank you Bruce! Highly recommend this company & sunset flight, everyone was very friendly, really lovely people to deal with.
What an amazing experience! Highly recommend this tour! Seeing the city from the air is so beautiful. The pilot was also very good and shared a lot of knowledge of the area.

I would highly recommend this trip at least once for everyone-locals and visitors alike. The views were spectacular! The pilot was entertaining and informative and the office staff very friendly. This is a great value for the price..

Seaplane Adventures exceeded my expectations! My husband booked a private hour long tour for our group with our pilot Bruce. Not only was the weather perfect for sightseeing, but Bruce narrated the entire flight with history of Sausalito, Belvedere, Tiburon, Muir Woods, Bolinas, SF and so much more. Bruce was incredible flying over landmarks and allowing us to get the money shots of the Golden Gate Bridge, and Alcatraz. This had been on my bucket list forever and I got to share the experience with my family and friends. It was an amazing day! A huge thanks to Ed for making sure our group got safely to the seaplane as we waded through the king tide that had rolled in and for his herculan strength tethering us as we landed. You both made my birthday celebration extremely memorable! Thank you

The pilot was fun and experienced. Just the right amount of history, facts, current info and photo opportunities. 
We had a great time. No doubt we will go again.
Great trip, fantastic pilot. So much fun. Could not habe been happier and will sure come back with my whole family. Definitely recommended!
A must do.  Amazing experience.  Everyone is so nice and the pilot gives you a lot of history and  fun facts about San Francisco. We had a spectacular time!!! Highly recommended.
Seaplane Adventures is simply amazing.  Our family enjoyed our trip and it is such a unique San Francisco experience.  I think it is a must for anyone visiting the bay.  Brian
The entire trip was wonderful but we didn't use the Shuttle Transport.  My daughter accompanied me.  She is not a teen

We all really enjoyed our Seaplane Adventure today!  It was such fun to take off from the seabase by Sausalito and fly over the Golden Gate Bridge!  We had great views of the Marin Headlands, the beautiful coast of Marin County, the Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz, Angel Island, Treasure Island, and San Francisco. It was really fun to see so many iconic San Francisco landmarks from above.  Our pilot was great, too. I highly recommend Seaplane Adventures and I look forward to another visit in the future.

Superb experience in a 1950s sea plane from start to finish- for us parents and our two young boys. Will was a great pilot and guide, guiding us with the history of the landscape as we soared above it. Ed from head office organised the flight was extremely helpful and all the centre could not have been more down to earth and friendly. Highly recommend!

Beautiful experience to see the Bay Area from the air. Taking off from Mill Valley/Sausalito, soon after Tiburon-Belvedere, Ángel Island, Alcatraz, Treasure Island, Bay, San Francisco Financial district, over the Golden Bridge, Stinson Beach, Bolinas, Point Reys light house, Inverness, Nicasio, Lagunitas, Woodacre, Fairfax, San Anselmo, San Rafael, Corte Madera, landing back in Sausalito. Total time, 1 hour of incredible views.

Joe & Miriam
Wonderful ride and incredible views. An hour plus in the air took us from the Bay Area all the way to Point Reyes.

My First visit to SFO. I was driving to Muir Woods when I saw the sign for sea plane rides. We stopped  and took the 30 min ride.  Our pilot was terrific.  Saw everything we wanted to, Golden Gate Bridge, baseball stadium, Alcatraz,  it was amazing

Just do it what are you waiting for.  Check this one off your bucket list.
Once in a lifetime experience. Best way to see San Francisco and the Golden Gate Bridge.
Fly over Alcatraz. Take off from the water and see the uniqueness of Sausalito and the many houseboats. Our pilot was very interesting during the trip. We learned much about the history of the Bay Area.
Very professionally managed.  Smooth process and safety precautions.  Good commentary by pilot overlooking each side of the aircraft, takin his time as we flew over the bay area.  We loved it.

review_title: A view of the bay like none other
review_text: We had such a great experience. Well worth it. Amazing views. Our pilot was so knowledgeable. Overall a fantastic experience. Definitely would recommend trying it

I experienced a great flight. I have lived in the Bay Area my entire life and have saw places I never knew were in and around San Francisco and the Bay Area.  From the time I arrived at the sea plane office until I left to return home I had a great time.
I highly recommend this tour for a unique experience!  The plane was incredible and the pilot was very knowledgeable.  I would definitely go again!

review_title: Absolutely breathtaking views and lovely staff and pilot! Highly recommend!
review_text: This adventure was absolutely amazing! The staff and pilot were friendly, kind, warm and so knowledgeable! The views were breathtaking and my husband just said “I’m still buzzing from our trip today! “ just a fun memory we will never forget!
This was an awesome, spur of the moment adventure!  Excellent views and narration of the sights! Great!

I had booked tge Seaplane door as a surprise birthday gift for my son. He had taken some flying lessons I was very excited to fly to sea plane. The staff was very friendly the pilot was very knowledgeable and overall it was a great experience.

This was the second time I had taken this tour. The first was three years ago and a great experience.
Not so much this time! This was a birthday gift for our adult son and there were three of us on the tour.  The major problem was that some of the headsets and microphones for communicating with the pilot did not work! The pilot's commentary was thus hard to hear. I know the planes are old, but modern working headsets should be a given....for communicating and SAFETY reasons. 
In addition, this was not a cheap tour. (For example I could have bought 5 commercial round trip tickets from San Francisco to New York for the price we paid this company for a one hour tour!)

We had such a wonderful trip seeing our city from a seaplane - thank you Seaplane Adventures for this unforgettable experience.  Pilot & staff were extremely professional and knowledgable.  My husband and I had a wonderful time
This was such a wonderful experience!  Totally worth it especially if you’re local - it’s very special to get a bird’s eye view of this beautiful city.

Great people, great pilot. Excellent tour!
We had to reschedule the next day due to weather. Everything went smooth.

Bought a flight for my dad. The city and the bay from the air is just stunning. It couldn’t have been easier to set up. Everyone we came in contact with was professional and kind. A great experience, overall.

review_title: Exciting way to see the Bay Area
review_text: 45Minutes with breathtaking views, going over the GoldenGate-Bridge at 120mph and a exciting flight. We recommend this!

review_title: Excellent and Very Resourceful Aerial Tour Guide
review_text: Thank you for the recent tour-it was an excellent trip and will remain a great memory for many years to come. Thank you!

Everyone was super friendly.  The pilot was a wealth of information and terrific.  It was amazing to see the coast and golden gate/city for the plane.  Definitely will do it again with my other daughter!

88 year old Mom loves to fly and these wonderful gentlemen made her the co-pilot for the trip. The history lessons and birds-eye view were amazing. She saw parts of the Bay Area she's never seen before - and never knew were there. She let out a huge "Woo Hoo" when she hit the ground and couldn't stop talking about the trip all day. Thank you to Seaplane Adventures for a memorable trip.

The staff we’re all great and extremely friendly! Pick up was prompt and on time from pier39 and got us to the city quickly. The pilot was very nice and knowledgeable of San Francisco’s history. Weather was perfect and view was amazing! Definitely recommend this tour to everyone! Thank you staff at Seaplane Adventures, you guys were all great and went above and beyond to make sure we had the best experience!

My son turned 10 and wanted to take a seaplane tour. It was well worth the money. It was timed perfectly also. Any longer than 30 minutes may been too long for us. We saw all the sites we wanted to see. The pilot was professional and safe. He also gave lots of Bay/Marin history while flying.
I would highly recommend it!
It was a fascinating flight over Marin County and parts of the East Bay Area.  It was a big hit for my wife's birthday.  She still talks highly of this trip.

Everyone needs to do it. A Spectacular tour and Unforgettable. A must if you really want to see the Beauty of the San Francisco City and Bay Area. Thanks for a Great 61st Birthday. 

Stephen Tucker

Every part of the experience was special - the wonderful ambience and memorabilia of the actual office/ terminal, full of mementos harkening back to the golden age of small-plane flight ... the welcoming tone of the staff, and the great, seamless commentary of our steady pilot who made  a point of narrating the entire journey with great 3-dimensional historical and geographical commentary. Could NOT have been happier than we were with this experience!

Muito bom e vale muito a pena. 

Ja tinhamos feito o passeio em 2013 e tinhamos marcado para 2020 com nossos filhos agora, por causa da pandemia tivemos que remarcar duas vezes e a empresa sempre foi muito prestativa. 

O voo como sempre foi espetacular, passando por sausalito, golden gate, san francisco e por cima de alcatraz, com certeza vou querer fazer mais uma vez ainda.

We have seen the seaplanes flying over San Francisco, and for my wife’s birthday we jumped in. We were amazed at the smooth takeoff, then went around the Bay. Our pilot pointed out many sights and we thoroughly enjoyed the flight! The landing on the water was the smoothest ever! Very nice people, you will enjoy this trip.
We would do it again!  Such an awesome view of the Bay.  The staff was amazing and friendly.  They kept us well informed and safe.

Absolutely loved it! Lived in the Bay Area my entire life and finally toured over it! My boyfriend and I did the “Sunset and Champagne” package which was nothing short of amazing. Champagne was DELICIOUS, plus 40 minutes in the sky admiring the beautiful Bay Area and listening to the pilot’s short history stories. Will definitely come back to do this again! Thank you Seaplane Adventures!
Once in a lifetime experience! Beautiful views and very pleasant flight! Its worth it and will definatelly do it again!
Most amazing adventure. So beautiful and so well narrated. Smiling for the full tour.  Thank you again !
Incredible views. Safe pilot with lots of fun facts. William at the front desk was helpful and friendly

review_title: Flying over the Bay with some bubbly and good times
review_text: My husband and I brought my parents on this flight while they were in visiting and we all had a blast! It was on my bucket list since I moved into the city and I'm so glad we finally did it. Even with semi-foggy conditions, our pilot Will expertly navigated around the bay to take us over great views of the GG bridge, city, Bay Bridge, Tiburon, and Muir Woods. We got to go above the clouds and then swoop underneath. He had lots of great information to share and made us all feel comfortable. The staff at SA is super kind and accommodating. And the champagne was a fun touch! Thanks for the great time!

Lived in Marin all my life. Always loved seeing the Dehavilland Beaver flying overhead. I finally snapped out of it and scheduled a ride for my wife and me for our 17 year anniversary. WOW, what a blast. Our pilot Will, was very experienced and really interesting.  You haven't seen Marin and the Bay Area unless you've seen it from 2,000 feet above on one of these aircraft. Magnificent! This will be an annual event for us in the future...

review_title: Great; from Anna in the home office to pilot Fred during and after the experience!
review_text: I always knew San Francisco and Marin County were incredible places, but Seaplane Adventures gave me a whole new appreciation of the spectacular wild, scenic, and even urban highlights of this area!

review_title: Wish I could do this every weekend!
review_text: Great and friendly service, the pilot was a true pro and you can tell he loves what he does. Amazing views, you won’t regret it!
I did this seaplane trip for my 16th birthday with a couple friends. It was super fun and made my birthday. The pilot was really nice and informative as well.

This hour-long Seaplane Tour has been on my bucket list for year! So happy I finally did it and I highly recommend it to everyone! The tour was so exciting and enjoyable! All safety precautions were observed. All five passengers on my flight were comfortable and safe. Excellent views! Informative and congenial pilot who kept us entertained throughout the flight. Get a group together and go! You won't regret it!

review_title: Would recommend to anyone as the premier tour experience in SF!
review_text: Awesome tour of SF and surrounding area.   Great pilot and tour guide.   Would recommend to anyone as the premier tour experience in SF!

Our scenic air tour experience was perfect! Ed who welcome us and Fred our pilot was very kind. It's a very beautiful experience in a very safe plane. Everything was Perfect and we really recommend this company for this tour!! Thanks a lot

I think sometimes an experience like this is left for a "special occasion' or with a "special person".  I'm here to tell you life happens and those "special occasions and people" most often happen when you aren't planning them.  If you're thinking maybe, just do it.  You won't be disappointed.  Loved the pilot and how he shared his knowledge of the Bay Area with both its history and his personal experience intertwined.  I'd do it again in a heartbeat.

This adventure was a surprise for my wife on our 3rd wedding anniversary.  Visibility wasn't great along the coast so we did a loop over the north bay, then back to the  the ball park coming back by the golden gate and over Alcatraz.  Pilot/owner had a great local knowledge of the history and development of the area.  Wish we had one more lap to pick his brains and get another perspective on an area we both grew up in and thought we knew so well.  We chased the flight with an amazing dinner right down the street on the waterfront people watching.  Couldn't have been a better evening.

I surprised my girlfriend with a tour for her birthday. Amazing views and a incredibly knowledgeable pilot.

The flight was great, but sadly both of us had serious nausea. We don’t usually get motion sick. So if that sounds like you, just make sure to take some Dramamine.

review_title: The BEST way to see SF!
review_text: I'm a local and have always wanted to see the city from the sky. My Mom's birthday was a great excuse to book a sunset flight for the family. We all went in with high expectations, only to have them far exceeded by the experience! The views were incredible and it was worth every penny. The staff and pilot, Aaron, were amazing and made it a truly unforgettable experience. If you have been considering booking a flight, don't wait any longer because you won't regret it!
This was by far one of the best experiences I have ever had, to be able to see the city from above and contemplate beautiful views was wonderful.

Amazing experience overall and fantastic view of the city and surrounding areas! Wish we were able to drink the champagne in the plane, but totally understand that this *wish* was unattainable due to mask-wearing protocols. Highly recommend!

The flight was wonderful. The pilot was very nice and very knowledgeable. He explained many of the sights we flew over. The staff was very courteous and helpful. Overall there was nothing negative and I would recommend the flight to anyone.

So the positives were that the views of the city were great and the tour lasted longer than expected - very informative guide.  
The downer was our microphones in the back were not working so could not interract.  
Nearly completely missed out on the champagne.... had to ask for it.... but it was Joseph Perrier - so that was good call.

It was especially exciting because it was my girlfriend's first time flying n any kind of plane. The flight was everything we had hoped for and more. The flight was great and so was the pilot. His narration of the trip and knowledge of the area was very enjoyable. Five stars all the way. Hope to do it again.
Super cool experience.  No better way to see the Bay.  Unbelievable views and alot if fun facts to learn. Definitely recommend

Incredible smooth flight around the Bay Area. Unbelieved views, have your camera ready. Also our pilot did an excellent job informing you about the history of the area and attractions you were flying over.

review_title: Seaplane over the best part of America
review_text:
Booking was easy
Special time accommodation 
Military discount
Price -More affordable than i thought

Great Pilot

Interesting history tour guide during the trip

A nice family time

AnthonyG
We had a great time flying over Golden Gate and Marine County. Flight went smooth, pilot was telling some interesting facts about the scenery and weather was beautiful for flying.
Excellent, we had the most wonderful experience, the trip was smooth, the weather and views incredible, we'll try again in our next trip.

We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves on the 60 minute tour over Nor Cal! The pilot was exceptional! Great tour guide! Weather was great! Highly recommend! Best way to see Point Reyes, Alcatraz, GG Bridge, San Quentin and so much more! The untouched beauty of the California coast made this a lifetime memory

review_title: Seaplane Adventure much more than we expected
review_text: Our recent Seaplane Adventure was fabulous! Aside from the novelty of taking off an landing on water we were treated to a sightseeing adventure along the Marin County coastline, past the Golden Gate Bridge, along the San Francisco waterfront, over the Bay Bridge, over Giant's stadium, and over Alcatraz. I've lived in the Bay Area all my life and this was perhaps the most spectacular viewing I've had of San Francisco and the bay. Our pilot kept pointing out interesting points and never made it sound like he had seen it all before and was just going through the script. Highly recommended!

After a year of waiting (pandemic) Seaplane’s friendly staff kindly updated our gift certificate. The flight was every bit worth the wait...great views, delightful commentary by pilot Fred. We are Bay Area locals ...got a thrilling new look at our own backyard. For tourists, can not imagine a better way to go!

We took off from the water and floated north up the coast to see Mount Tam, Stinson Beach and Point Reyes before circling back en route to San Francisco. I have been living in the city off and on since 2008 so I know San Francisco is beautiful but seeing it from above was something else. It was like seeing a whole other side! I will definitely surprise my parents with that, as soon as they are able to visit us.

review_title: The *custom tour* you’ve been looking for.
review_text:
If you can afford it, do it. If you can’t afford it - do it anyways and make cuts to other things (eating out, shopping, etc)

My husband and I wanted to celebrate our 1st anniversary and be just a little bit extra. We have always had a fascination with the Farallon Islands (about 20-30 miles west off the Bay Area coast) but the only way to get there was by plane or seriously-rough-boat ride (for whale spotting).

I called and spoke with *Anna* who was very patient and explained for a private tour I would have to more-or-less buy out the whole plane. And there was no guarantee I would see the Farallons.. we may just get close.  I talked it over with my husband and decided, even though the price point was far out of our budget, we would not be so extravagant in future anniversaries/events, and to make this one special.

Anna called the day-of and explained the weather to be too rocky for us to get a clear view. No problem, we are from SF, I’m a student pilot, and we understand how temperamental the weather can be up here. We rebooked for the following day.

TODAY we drove up, met Anna, who is absolutely lovely, and wait for the plane to return for us to depart. You dont realize it but Anna has to literally ‘catch’ the plane from the dock and both of them jump off and pull the plane in to secure. I saw Anna carefully sanitize all areas of the plane, and our pilot, Fred, did a preflight inspection (checked propellor, gas, etc.) even though they had just landed. We felt very safe boarding the flight.

Not only was Fred knowledgeable and experienced he was great to speak with about general aviation. We didn’t expect to get very close to the Farallons but Fred managed to fly us over them, around them (not once but three times at varying banks!) and made sure we got all the photos we needed. Watching the Farallons from the air was magical. Though a little dizzy, and having spent all our time to fly out and back, we were ecstatic and had an absolute blast.

Fred took our photos upon landing (one of the smoothest landings EVER), and even shook my hand and told me to come back after I got my private so I could learn how to handle a seaplane (they fly beavers).

This was an absolutely AMAZING experience, especially because we were able to achieve our custom flight path. Fred and Anna went above and beyond. 

You BET I’m coming back after I get my private to get my seaplane rating. Thank you again for an experience AND anniversary we won’t soon forget!!
It was a wonderful outing around the bay area and the pilot was very kind, informative and lots of fun. I highly recommend this for anyone who is visiting San Francisco.

This was a surprise birthday present for a friend and she loved it! It was so gorgeous, the pilot was amazing, and the company was so understanding that we were traveling from South Bay to let us know about potential issues with the weather well in advance. We saw whales too! I would do this again in a heartbeat with this company

It was an awesome experience. Beautiful clear day. The lady at the front desk was great and made us all feel safe. The pilot was very kind and his knowledge of the city was on point. It felt super safe and comfortable, we would do it again in a heartbeat.

If your visiting the San Francisco Area this tour is an experience you should not miss.  I live in the area and love to take visiting friends for the tour or take someone up for a special birthday.  

Fred was our pilot with 32 years old experience flying, also he gave a knowledgeable overview of the history of the sites as we flew over them.  We flew over the Golden Gate Bridge, the Richmond-San Rafael Bridge and the Oakland Bay Bridge, the view was stunning.  Also, we flew over San Francisco’s famous skyscrapers, Mount Tamalpais, Angel Island, Alcatraz, and along the coastal towns by the Pacific ocean.

A must in the the bay.
Usually a gift our community is doing to people returning to their home country so they get a last glimpse of the bay beauty.
We just thought that one day we may have to leave in a hurry as everything is becoming crazy. So we just did it.
A wonderful experience.

review_title: Astounding views of San Francisco and Point Reyes.
review_text: Really beautiful 1958 seaplane. Really fun and knowledgeable pilot. We got super lucky and flew right over a pod of 5 Humpback whales! Got a bird's eye view of the fire damage up north along Pt. Reyes, cool ride over the mansions of Tiburon, and totally unique view of the Golden Gate bridge. Will cherish this memory forever. review_title: Hey locals, DO THE SEAPLANE tour!
review_text:
You know when you live somewhere famous, and there are certain activities that only tourists do? Think Paris, and the Eiffel Tower, or NY, Statue of Lib. 
Well, we live in Marin, just over the GG bridge from SF, and that's what we thought about SEAPLANE rides. Boy were we wrong! Seaplane Adventures is so much fun!  I wanted a fun way to celebrate our daughter's HS Graduation, since we couldn't travel far. Seaplane Adventures was the answer! We live in a beautiful corner of the world, and we run, cycle and hike the mountain trails all the time, as well as go to the beach and the city. But wow , seeing it all from the air, floating underneath our famous fog layer, looping around the skyline, crossing the same mountain trail we had run across that very morning to the beach, or buzzing by the bridge in an 8 seater was So. Much. Fun. Our pilot was a hoot! Loved it all... I highly recommend it for locals and tourists alike.

review_text: We had a great trip, we saw way more than we expected and it was really great for our 3 year old who loved it! We appreciated all the knowledge the pilot shared and the extended trip around the bay, it was great way to celebrate my 40th birthday, thank you!

review_title: The Only Way To See San Francisco
review_text: We had a great time! Everyone had a window seat and we soared above the San Francisco coast, Golden Gate Bridge and the city itself.  I could not help myself and took about dozens of pictures as we flew over one attraction after another.  We will definitely do this again.

The staff was wonderful to work with - our enjoyment of the experience and wellbeing were their top priorities. 
We highly recommend booking a flight!

review_title: Do it! Otherwise you'll regret it.
review_text:
This. Was. Amazing! We had an incredible time. It is not cheap, but it's worth every penny! We were welcomed by the super friendly staff and waited in the shop for our ride around the bay.
For me as an Airline pilot it was the most professional scenic flight i've ever taken. The beautiful Beaver plane is up to date with all necessary equipment and state-of-the-art technology, such as ADS-B, GPS moving map and so on. Our Pilot is extremely experienced on the type and has a lot to teach everyone on board. When reading this it may seem like they've paid me to advertise their business, rest assured, they didn't. I still have a smile on my face when I think about the flight, the view, the unique rumbling of the engine. They don't play around when it comes to safety, all seats are equipped with harnesses, life vests and good headphones.
You get there easily with an UBER or their shuttle from downtown. You'll never experience the bay view better than from above in that beatiful aircraft.

We were a little apprehensive about the weather but the contrast between dark clouds and sunlight peeking through was beautiful.  Our flight was perfectly smooth and our pilot knowledgeable and friendly.  As well traveled locals we still spotted areas along the Marin Headlands we had not explored.  Wonderful views of the coast and the city.  A must do for locals as well as visitors.

The experience seeing the Bay from a Dehavilland Beaver floatplane was exceptional. Our pilot Fred was supremely knowledgeable in everything we saw and gave us the best day ever. I highly recommend this experience for locals and visitors.

review_title: 6 out of 5 possible stars for me

Upon arrival we were greeted right away, made to feel welcome and comfortable and then taken out to the dock to meet our pilot who was also so friendly, easy going and informative. He was a great pilot as well as an engaging guide! Super flight experience! When we went back to San Francisco, we did a little shopping and grabbed some lunch on the wharf and then went on our Alcatraz tour. Super convenient to have your tour voucher already for the ferry to the island and this really interesting audio tour. The Alcatraz tour is very well done and so interesting to hear the story and see this prison!! 
This San Francisco Seaplane Flight and Alcatraz tour is totally the way to go!! 
Highly recommended!!!
