review_title: A great way to see San Francisco!
review_text: Our seaplane trip was awesome and was a great way to experience San Francisco in a different way. Flying over the Golden Gate Bridge and the SF skyline gives you a different perspective of this wonderful area. It was such a smooth take off and landing. When we got there for our 10:45am flight, the bridge was still fogged in so we were able to get to delay our trip to 1pm after the fog had lifted to see the spectacular views.

review_title: Best views of the San Francisco
review_text: Fred flew us around for an hour.  It was the best time!  Such beautiful sites to see.  Very cool to take off and land on the water.
They were very courteous and professional in making the experience as comfortable and fun as possible.

Ce vol en hydravion a été une expérience magique! Une très bonne façon de découvrir San Francisco et ses environs de manières pratiques. 
La prise en charge est parfaite.
Merci au pilote très professionnel qui en plus de ces nombreuses explications et anecdotes parle français. 
Je ne peux que recommander. Merci à eux. 
All was perfect! Thank to all the team of seaplane adventures

review_title: Best thing I've done in San Francisco
review_text: My wife and I went on a seaplane tour for our anniversary and couldn't imagine it being better. Super friendly staff, cool planes and breathtaking views. A must do!

review_title: Magnificent mini tour of SF Bay via SeaPlane
review_text: I was really impressed with the excitement of flying in a small plane while receiving loads of interesting information about the San Francisc Bay and environs. I am looking forward to taking another longer tour with SeaPlane Adventures
Our group had an awesome time at Seaplane Adventures. It was a magnificent day and the view was amazing. Cannot say enough wonderful things about it! Worth every penny! We'll do this again.
Fred our pilot was a really nice guy. Loads of information all through the flight. Totally worth every cent very memorable.

I treated my step daughter for her birthday to the ride. She got to be in the right seat and had a ball.  I've lived here 50 years, see the planes all the time. it was perfect day.  We recognized so much from the air but the four Germans also just seemed to enjoy.
Had a great time,the pilot was very friendly let me fly the plane for a while, he was very knowledgeable of the area.
Memorable experience and learned so much about San Francisco! Very beautiful and historic city! A must do in Sf!

Both greeting staff and plane pilot (Fred) were great.
Flight was awesome.
Once in a liftetime experience !

Do yourself a favor and book this now. Great for both tourists and locals! Although we lucked out with amazing weather which provided stellar views what made the experience great was our pilot Fred. He provided a wealth of information even though we are locals we walked away we some new fun facts about this amazing place we call home. Additionally, the booking process was seamless and the email confirmations were detailed and clear. Thank you Seaplane Adventures!

My husband and I took the seaplane to celebrate his birthday.  We especially enjoyed the take off and water landings, the views of the Golden Gate Bridge and views over our house on the skirts of Mt. Tam, the Tiburon Peninsula, the ocean and San Francisco from the air.  The pilot had good humorous patter and told lots of interesting facts about the area.  We were very pleased with the trip.
Lost for words, thank you for an amazing trip Fred & Co! It was truly life changing to go with you guys!

I only bought the shortest flight they offered, then thought it might be too short to enjoy it. It definitely wasn’t. We had a great time, got to see so much. The pilot was awesome. It was a little windy during  the flight, but he kept it smooth and it was the softest landing I’ve ever experienced.
It was an awesome day to fly.   The View was amazing and the friendly people made this the best. Pilot was entertaining.  A must do trip.

Truly fantastic! Best birthday gift I ever got for my husband! What a way to tour the city. We're from the bay area and yet learned things we never knew. The pilot was very informative. Can't wait to ride the seaplane again!

review_title: Bird’s Eye View of the World
review_text:
The entire experience was great!  From the greeting at the front desk to the fond “goodbyes” it was all perfect.  We arrived early to surprise our birthday-friend.  The Fred and Daniel (pilot and dockhand) could not have been more gracious and arranged for us to board the plane 30 minutes before the birthday girl.  The surprise was huge but the views were even bigger.  Fred knows the territory and shares his knowledge in a friendly way.  Best of all there’s no test at the end.

I grew up in the Bay Area and thought I knew all there is to know but I was sorely wrong.  Fred’s an interesting guy with a happy and energetic view of the world, his job and his life.  Just do it!  You’ll be glad you did.  I promise.

The seaplane tour was absolutely amazing. It was gift to my boyfriend for his birthday and we had a blast. We did the 30 minute Golden Gate tour and felt like we saw so much. It was the perfect amount of time for the two of us. There were 2 other couples on the tour with us, total of 6 plus the pilot. Our pilot/guide was interactive, very funny and informative. We’ve lived in SF for years and weren’t aware of any of the facts he shared with us. My stomach got a little uneasy about half way through, I looked at the horizon though and was fine. Didn’t stop me from enjoying the views! I highly recommend this tour and company whether you’re visiting or living in SF!

Great experience! Got to see a lot of the Bay Area like I never thought I would see before. Amazing pilot and a great crew. They definitely make you feel comfortable. Safe and knowledgeable pilot and staff.

I brought my 4 year old son for his birthday (he had been requesting for months). We had the best experience imaginable. The pilot, Fred, was fantastic - he even let my son sit up front with him for part of the flight. I got a great history lesson on the Bay Area. The visibility was perfect and it was stunning seeing home from above! I would recommend this experience to everyone and anyone!

review_title: Most excellent excursion anywhere in the Bay Area or possibly California
review_text: What an Exhilarating experience! The ride gave me a whole new perspective and feel for the Bay Area. Seeing iconic sights such as the Golden Gate Bridge, the city Skyline, Mount Tamalpais, Alcatraz and so many other places from the Seaplane was so incredibly unique. The pilot was great at pointing out interesting facts about different places. I can’t recommend this enough for both visitors and locals.

Activité extraordinaire !!! 
En fin de journée avec un temps dégagé et du soleil c est magique. Pilote au top, français (c était amusant), j ai eu la chance d aller devant et c est extra, on voit super bien comme si on pilotait 😁
Tour extra adapté en fonction de ce qu on veut voir. C était au top je recommande
Great flight even if you live in this city. Bob’s am excellent pilot and guide! Highly recommend this adventure.

review_title: A wonderful time in the sky...
review_text: We were quite hesitant before booking this seaplane adventure… and it was fantastic ! we first enjoyed to take off from the see. The plane is narrow and it was fun to share this flight with the pilote, nearly as a co-driver. This man was highly experienced and gave us confidence. The flight over the bay, SF, Golden Gate, around Alcatraz (visited later with the same ticket) and so many nice villas was very impressive ! to be tested without any hesitation and -I'm sure- highly appreciated !

Great aerial sightseeing ride around the S.F. Bay area! 
It was a birthday present. We live close by, had seen the planes going to and fro, and had promised ourselves a ride sometime. 
Huge fun ... and very instructive.

Ne passez pas à côté de cette expérience : dès  la prise en charge par la navette à San Fransisco jusqu'au retour du vol, grande gentillesse et disponibilité des employés Seaplane. Avion et pilote exceptionnels et superbe point de vue sur la baie, le pont et la ville.
Survol magique de la baie de San Francisco... le pilote était top et nous a commenté la visite avec plein d'humour ... à faire absolument!

Highly, highly recommend this activity! Super easy to book. Staff is great. Check in process simple with minimal hassles and the flight was top notch. Pilot was funny, knowledgeable and knew when to just let us take in the amazing sights. Great company and experience! Do this even if you've lived in the Bay Area for a long time. Amazing to see the bay, city, beaches from the air!

review_title: The right way to see San Francisco
review_text: This was one of the highlights of our trip. We really enjoyed the ride and the views. Our pilot was a great guy that gave us many information on the area.

We booked this tour as something different to do while in SF. We were very impressed with the experience. We got picked up from Pier 39 and were driven to their office outside of Sausalito. The plane is really cool - from the 50s I believe. All of the staff were super nice and the pilot was very interesting. We were with another group of 2 so there were 6 of us in the plane (including the pilot). Our best views of the GG bridge were from the seaplane. We got to see all of SF from the air. After the flight we wanted to get dropped back in Sausalito on the way back to SF. While this wasn't part of the tour, the office worker volunteered to drive us in her personal car to town! Great customer service!! Also, this package included tickets to Alcatraz. They were easy to redeem and we were able to book up a tour when no other tickets were available. This was also a great experience. Definitely book with this team - Top Notch!
An amazing experience with a really great pilot. The only way to see San Francisco and I challenge you to be able to tell when the pilot touches down !

Shuttle and driver were awesome. When I called for the shuttle the evening before after 5pm they said it was no problem. The whole experience was easy cheesy. The pilot was hilarious. The flight was great.

It was a very very pleasant experience with a flight above Mill Valley, Sausalito and Muirwoods forest for beginning and then a flight above the Golden Gate, SF Down Town, the Bay Bridge and Alcatraz.for ending.
The pilot was friendly and professionnal.
It was the great moment of our hollidays

Moment magique, magnifique vue sur la ville de San Francisco et ses alentours !
J’ai réservé un tour de 30min, le pilote nous a fait volé 1 heure. 

Personnel au top !

Survoler l'emblème de San Francisco, c'est un cadeau. Alors, certes, c'est un peu onéreux mais nous sommes dans un hydravion et là encore c'est une expérience ! Nous avons eu la chance d'avoir Jérôme, un français vivant sur place, pour pilote. Il a été absolument génial, drôle et instruit, il nous a expliqué les zones survolées et leur histoire. Il a été d'une grande maîtrise professionnelle, notamment en traversant le fameux brouillard du Golden Gate Bridge. On a toujours été en sécurité. Il nous a laissé tout le temps nécessaire pour faire de belles photos du pont. Bref, c'était fabuleux ! On était émerveillé. Je vous encourage vivement à vivre ce moment. Et , entre nous soit dit, le survol a duré bien plus d'une demi-heure sans surcoût, que du bonheur !
Amazing trip across the Golden Gate Bridge ans SF. Fred the pilot was helpful in explaining everything in and around the lane

My husband and I had the flight of a lifetime on our recent trip to San Francisco. We chose the 45 minute flight and it was every bit of that long or even longer and worth every penny! To see the Bay Area by air is a view like no other. Our pilot was super awesome both in skill, personality, and narration. We had a great shuttle ride from Pier 39 and back that was included in the price as well! The seaplane ride itself was super smooth and again provided the most spectacular views! I can’t recommend this trip and company enough! It was the highlight of our vacation!!

This was a very special experience. Jerome our pilot was a great host and gave so much interesting information as we flew over San Francisco. Also our driver Mike gave the best clam chowder recommendation, a little place in Pismo Beach called Splash. Thanks to all SeaPlane Adventures it really was one of the highlights of our holiday

Highly recommend. 
Surprise for my sons 10th birthday 
Great pilot, great views of everything. 
Thanks very much!!
You will never see San Francisco like this in your life-from 1000ft. Took my visiting cousin and she said it was the coolest thing she has ever done.

Activité à faire sans problème 
Personnel agréable
Visite de San Francisco vu du ciel à ne pas manquer

Vol en hydravion fantastique à San Francisco.
Très bon pilote francophone, un must aux US car très rare.

We had a fantastic time with seaplane adventures. Everything was perfect from being transferred from Pier 39 to a wonderful,flight over than Francisco and the bay. In the Morning a guided flight in a seaplane with breathtaking views of the bay. Very friendly staff at seaplane adventures. In the  afternoon the visit to  Alcatraz made it a perfect day. Worth every Cent. If you plan a trip to,San Francisco, then do the Kombi-Tour..

Wonderful combination of both the seaplane and trip to Alcatraz. Professional company with friendly,  knowledgeable and experienced staff. Regular email contact following booking, clear instructions where to meet. Warm and knowledgeable welcome by Michael the shuttle  driver and excellent commentary by Jerome the pilot. This trip is not cheap but is a must do if you're in San Francisco, The aerial view of the Golden gate bridge, Alcatraz and San Francisco city was amazing. Had a clear sunny day with great views. Fabulous experience!

review_title: Spectacular Seaplane Serendipity Soaring Surrounding San Francico
review_text: A phenomenal experience.  My son and I are locals, so it's not just the out-of-towners who love it.  Although they did too.

review_title: bird's-eye view of the Golden Gate Bridge
review_text: the seaplane flight was outstanding.  our pilot was very entertaining and friendly.  We enjoyed the incredible view of San Francisco and the surrounding area.  A bird's-eye view of the Golden Gate Bridge was sensational.  The flight is an experience, even though I had to vomit during the flight.  But that was already clear to me. Still highly recommended!  Thumbs up!

Absolute Joy!!!
Great views 
Professional crew
Great Family Adventure
Well organized
And very convenient

Welcoming staff ease to check in. Great experience if you want to see the Bay area. I travel with my teen daughter and she loved the experience. Learned great history of the Bay area, flew over San Francisco's main attractions.
A great experience for the whole family. They offer pickup and drop off service which makes it very convenient. Our pilot, Aaron was very friendly and professional.
Friendly atmosphere, profession pilot! You won't want to miss it if you want to really see San Francisco!

Phantastischer Blick auf San Francisco und das Umland. Der Pilot ist ein lustiger cooler Typ, der einiges zu erzählen weiß. Ebenso der Shuttleservice-Fahrer. Alles perfekt organisiert. Und wann fliegt man schon einmal mit einem Wasserflugzeug? Vielen Dank

Ein absolut lohnenswerter Rundflug über San Francisco. Der Pilot war ein lustiger cooler Typ der einiges zu erzählen wusste. Ebenso der Fahrer vom Shuttle Service. Alles perfekt organisiert. Vielen Dank👍

review_title: Best way to see the SF Bay Area
review_text: Pilot / Guide provided the highest quality tour, informing us a many of the landmarks and history of the area we would have never even thought to go look at. Ground crew was friendly, attentive and went out of their way to ensure we would have a great time. Shuttle Driver, a bonus we didn't expect to be included gave us a ride down town after the flight. Would fly with them again if I ever may it back to the area.

review_title: Wonderful way to see the bay
review_text: Really well organised right from being collected at Pier 39 to being dropped off again. Very professional and friendly staff. Had a fantastic time.

What an unforgettable experience to see SF from the air! My son even flew the seaplane for a while. The pilot was great ! We took a combo tour with Alcatraz and all was well organized with the shuttle and the friendly driver. We recommend deeply!
Great views: mount Tamalpais, Point Reyes, San Francisco, ... Fun pilot, lots of good anecdotes.. Loved it
Such a great experience. I can only recommend it. The view of Alcatraz and the city was amazing. Must do!

Nous recommandons sans réserve cette activité.
Accueil et services excellents avec une équipe super sympa.

review_title: Amazing experience with a great pilot
review_text: 30-minute flight on the San Francisco Bay, very interesting explanations from the pilot (Dutch pilot who speaks French perfectly). My son has got the opportunity to pilot during a few seconds! Thank you

review_title: Seaplane tour + Alcatraz ferry/tour = great experience!
review_text: My 14-year-old son and I got the morning seaplane tour + afternoon Alcatraz ferry/tour combo package and really enjoyed both of them. The Seaplane Adventures staff was great, and the seaplane tour of the Bay was spectacular. We wouldn't have done the seaplane tour if we hadn't tried to book our Alcatraz trip on such short notice that the only way we could get ferry tickets to The Rock was by also buying the seaplane tour as part of a combo -- but we're very glad we did, because seeing San Francisco and the Golden Gate from above was a unique and thrilling experience.

great experience the greater bay area seaplane tour. Perfect pilot, perfect views, very friendly. smooth flight with the experienced old Lady DeHavilland Beaver
felt every second secured. An absolute MUST DO when visiting San Francisco.
Easy to book, seamless transportation, and a no-fuss adventure! Would definitely recommend to small groups of friends / couples / families with older children!

Did a 30 minute seaplane around SF area and then a visit to Alcatraz. Alcatraz was cool but the seaplane experience was fabulous. Great pilot/ guide and the most amazing view. Make sure this is on your list of must dos when in SF ...
If someone in the same pack, includes fly and one of the most beautiful cities of the world. The resoult is excellent. Everything was perfect. Thanks again.
Une expérience inoubliable et originale. Nous avons eu la chance de découvrir San Francisco et sa baie par les airs avec un pilote français résidant aux E-U depuis de nombreuses années. À faire.
A faire sans hésiter. Pilote très sympathique qui offre d’interessantes Explications. Une vue de San Francisco et du Golden Gate merveilleuse

I took my son for he’s 12 birthday . He totally loved it , he was afraid at first but the people there were so nice that they make him feel so comfortable and relax . The view was one in the life time experience and I would highly recommend

review_title: Kids first time in San Francisco
review_text: We did the hop on/hop off by land, then SF  by air on day 2.  The kids as well as my wife and I loved it.  A bit pricey but worth every penny.

Nous avons découvert San Francisco par les airs grâce à Seaplane. Le pilote était juste génial car plein d’humour et très sympathique. En plus il parle français, un luxe aux US ! Il m’a permis de piloter moi-même et a fait qq looping pour amuser les enfants (et achever mon mari qui a le mal des transports). TOP 👍🏼.

An hour's flight in a supremely charming de Havilland Beaver floatplane! Up to Point Reyes overland, back down skimming the water looking for whales, a magnificent Golden Gate flyover and seeing the city in three dimensions as you've never seen it before. Friendly and informative commentary all the way. Fascinating, brilliant. I defintely recommend it.
I am very happy that I did this flight and can only recommend it. You will see San Francisco and Golden Gate Bridge from the sky. It is unforgettable. Thank you, Seaplane Adventures.
This adventure was very enjoyable.  Got to get great views of all the sites and learn a lot in the process.
I would recommend this- once in a life time experience. You see things in the bay area you would never see otherwise. Great!
Fantastic and smooth ride.  Fog was not an issue.  Friendly staff. Knowledgeable pilot.  Would highly recommend.
Great view over the Bay Area, the best way to take breathtaking pictures. I even had the honor to be co-pilot.

C’était la première fois que nous prenions l’hydravion ce fut une très belle expérience
Le pilote ainsi que tout le personnel Était très agréable
Je conseille vivement

Pick up at San Fran Pier 39 and just a quick drive over Golden Gate Bridge while seeing some of the city and Golden Gate park. Onto the plane and with excellent pilot who makes you feel so relaxed and comfortable. The views are great over all of the bay and San Fran. Highly recommended as a must do if you visit!
The best and only way to see the bay, I fly for a living and cannot recommend this highly enough. An experienced and engaging pilot, a very special experience.
This a family owned business was absolutely amazing. I’ve lived in SF 8 years now and have no idea why it took so long to sign up. Would do again in an instant!

review_title: AMAZING !!!! My kids had SO MUCH FUN!!!!!!
review_text: Literally the most magical experience in all of SF... my kids are still talking about the day a month later...

You haven’t seen the Golden Gate until you’ve seen it by seaplane!  My husband and I took this exciting adventure and had a great time.  We chose the optional pick up and return shuttle. The pick up and drop off was at Pier 39 and it was a great service to get us to the seaplane and back.  We had nice weather and the views were spectacular.  We could see the bridges, islands, city, bay, and surrounding areas.  Our pilot let us know what we were flying over and both sides of the plane had good views. The pilot was very good and we felt safe.   Really a unique experience that we loved and will never forget...

This was a great adventure and would highly recommended it to anyone. We got amazing close up views of things that nobody else gets to see. My 9 year old and 13 year old loved it! Our pilot Bob was very informative and gave us some great information about the city. And he made the flight so much fun with his amazing flying skills. The landing was so smooth which was very unexpected.
Tour de la baie de SF complet, commentaires pertinents et fournis, temps de vol nettement supérieur aux 30’ prévues, le tout sous un soleil radieux. A ne pas manquer....

This experience was incredible. We went for my best friends birthday and we had so much fun! The views we saw from our sea plane were breathtaking and unlike anything we could see on our own. Our pilot Jerone was THE BEST, he was hilarious and so knowledgeable about all of the sights! So many fun facts!
Kind and knowledage pilots, amazing views, cultural history, and adrenaline rush. Afternoon flight so a bit bumpy as the wind picked up, but still totally worth it

Quelle expérience fantastique ! Merci Jérôme pour ce vol. Vous m'avez fait découvrir les merveilles de SFO mais surtout vous m'avez permis de remonter à bord d'un petit avion sans plus aucune crainte.
Merci pour cette fabuleuse excursion

This was an anniversary gift and an expensive risk if it didnt meet expectations. It was amazing. 40 minutes and it took in the surrounding islands as well as the bay, city, alcatraz and bridges. The pilot was informative and entertaining. The weather was glorious. Perfectly clear. Allow for heavy traffic if you are coming from the city. Before the expdrience I thought it was expensive. After, I thought it was great value. Happy to recommend.
Great adventure, went in foe the second time! Awesome, just make sure to sit on the right, my wife was coming for the first time and she didn't see the golden gate from her left side as I did.

Flew over the surrounding forest area, San Francisco, Golden Gate & Bay bridges, Alcatraz.

Jerome (Pilot) was bi- lingual speaking, friendly & knowledgeable!

Overall excellent, one of the highlights of our trip!!

This was a truly special experience on a day when the weather was just about perfect. The check in was straight forward and the pilot was excellent, good fun and informative.  The views are awesome and we saw so much more of The Bay than i was expecting. This was definetely the highlight of our trip and id highly recommend this trip!!
So much fun and the best way to celebrate our 1st year of marriage. The guys are really awesome to hang out with and the couples sunset tour is the way to go.

review_title: Missed the highlight of the flight - too bad !
review_text: The pilot was good but the weather not good. So it was bumpy. the big frustration is that we could not see the Golden Gate Bridge at all. The company knew there was no visibility over the bridge and should have cancelled the flight. No refund or replacement flight proposed by Seaplane Adventure. Too bad !

review_title: Survol de la baie par beau temps
review_text:
Nous avions réservé notre survol de la baie sur les conseils de notre agence de voyage. Nous n’avons pas été déçus !
Les panoramas sont superbes. Et le pilote est français ! Pour une fois, nous avons tout compris !!!
Merci ! Merci ! Merci ! C’était magnifique. Nous recommanderons à nos amis qui préparent leur voyage pour 2020-2021.

review_title: survol hydravion baie de san francisco
review_text: Une tres bonne experience qui donne une vue d'ensemble de toute la baie de san francisco. Le directeur de sea plane a été trés arrangeant en le prevenant au dernier moment( 1 heure avant le vol prevu ) car j'ai du changer ma voiture de location et cela a pris du temps, il m'a tout de suite propose de remettre au lendemain; je l'en remercie. Le pilote est vraiment tres competent, il fait toujours des passages au dessus des point de vue dans les deux sens , ce qui permet a tous les occupants de l'hydravion des deux côtés de bien voir les choses sous le meilleur angle.Dommage que la brume ne nous ai pas permis de voir le pont du Golden Gate; mais cela n'est pas prévisible. Merci encore pour tout;

review_title: Fantastic views over San Francisco Harbour
review_text: Very easy to book online, though when I booked I didn't realise that the flight was from Sausalito. A very friendly organisation - I messed up the booking and they rearranged without a murmur. Though a transfer was available from Pier 39 San Francisco, we caught the Ferry to Sausaliti earlier in the day, had a wander and lunch before catching an Uber to the Seaplane base (around $6). The flight was at 3.15 and lasted over 1/2 hour, the pilot was a character and the views brilliant. We were on a small de Havilland Canada plane in pretty much empty air space. Great photos, great day (though the Golden Gate Bridge was partly covered in cloud).

Der gesamte Ausflug war hervorragend. Der Shuttleservice zum Pier 39 hin sowie zurück funktionierte tadellos und ersparte uns eine Menge Mühen. Der Flug war eine super Erfahrung. Das Starten wie Landen mit einem Wasserflugzeug ist schon was Besonderes. Der Pilot machte einen super Job und als Pilot sowie als Guide und die Eindrücke von „oben“ sind total toll. Jederzeit wieder! Danke für den tollen Service 👍

review_title: Fabulous Adventure of Bay Area Sightseeing
review_text:
From the start, the ease and friendliness of making a reservation is as good or better than I’ve experienced in a life of traveling.
The planes and equipment are top notch.
Quality aircraft, taken extremely good care of.
The pilot was very knowledgeable and wanted to know what we wanted, not give us an off the shelf trip.
Hi end knowledge of the Bay Area and it’s history made our trip really a great one.
We felt like we had new friends that we will come back to and take another trip with because it was so fun!

Our seaplane tour was fantastic!  Our pilot was funny and knowledgable and the views of the city and Marin were spectacular.  We are locals and this far exceeded our expectations -- it gave us such a unique perspective of the place we call home.

Wow! What an experience, to fondly remember for a lifetime. The seaplane ride over San Francisco and points north was wonderful. The route was great and the commentary right on. You see all of the tourist attractions, like Alcatraz and Fisherman's Warf, at a safe but  low altitude. And there is nothing like a thrilling sea plane ride. Well worth the fare.

My daughter and I had a 1pm flight. We were impressed with every aspect of our adventure. We loved the plane. The pilot was courteous, skilled and knowledgeable about the area we flew over.  I've lived here all of my life and have never experienced San Francisco, Marin and the Bay like this before. To any one who has thought about taking a seaplane ride I say...what are you waiting for? You won't regret it. It was a magic carpet ride over a beautiful place. Imagine soaring over the Golden Gate Bridge.
A brilliant trip my son and I loved every minute of the flight - we went round the bay and over the city - Jerome was very knowledgable and a brilliant pilot

review_title: What a once in a lifetime adventure. So Grateful to have been able to do this!
review_text: What an awesome adventure! It was raining, no scratch that, it was pouring rain the Saturday before our booking on Sunday. We were worried that our trip would be cancelled. We arrived Sunday morning to blue skies and friendly staff. My daughter and I had the adventure of a lifetime. If you are fortunate enough to be able to take this tour it is fabulous! The pilot even took our picture standing on the airplane! What a great day. Sherri Barker, Reno, NV
Beautiful trip and great crew with a cool sense of humor!!! I’m taking this adventure second time and I loved it again 😍  Thank you! Highly recommend this trip!
Thank you Jerome and the team for a great ride. It exceeded my expectations. I'd recommend it to anyone who likes to fly.

Booking was easy and so was check in. Greeted when we walked in & boarded right away. Quick instructions & safety tips then we were off! Pilot pointed out all the sights & would fly over most places twice so each side of plane could see sights. Luckily we had nice weather.
It was a great adventure definitely recommend it to anybody great views and see new things you didn’t even know about
Easy to book, friendly staff, and incredible experience.  We've lived in the Bay Area for decades and driven by the seaplanes but never tried it.  Would highly recommend!

In occasione del mio compleanno lontano dai miei cari, ho deciso di regalarmi questa emozione. 
Il servizio di prenotazione via web è decisamente semplice : pochi click e il volo è prenotato. Personale molto gentile. Ho volato con John, molto simpatico e disponibile.
Vedere dall'alto San Francisco, il Golden Gate, Alcatraz e la baia di San Francisco è stato molto piacevole. Proprio un bel regalo. Lo rifarei subito con i miei cari. 
e li vicino c'è anche un servizio di noleggio bici automatizzato per tornare a Sausalito. Splendida esperienza!
A fantastic flight over San Francisco and ifs bay. Very friendly and professional organization. A real must !

review_title: SFO bis Point Race von Oben - Einzigartig
review_text: Wir hatten am 2.Mai bestes Wetter - war ein super Flug die Coastline entlang zu Point Race und zurück über SFO nach Sausalitho. Das erste Mal mit einem Wasserflugzeug - Die Beaver mit ihrem 9 Zylinder Pratt & Whitney started, landet butterweich und liegt ruhig in der Luft  - es war sehr schön!
Superbe expérience   Malgré le plafond qui était bas survol du Golden Gate arrivé sur le Pacifique et retour par Golden Gate Garden  et la magnifique skyline de San Francisco

Took my two grandkids who are 10 and 5, and we had a great trip.  It was quite noisy so the headphones were necessary.  My little one was too small for the headphones, so the pilot got her some small pink ones! It was a 30 minute trip but was actually closer to 45 from takeoff to landing.  The landing was the smoothest I've every experienced on a plane and lots of fun.  Would totally recommend this trip.
Everything was perfect. The bus driver was incredible and the pilot was amazing. An awesome must do in the Bay. Thank you

review_title: You HAVE TO see San Francisco from the air
review_text: Seaplane Adventures offers a great flight over the San Francisco area.  If you like all things aviation, you have to add a sea plane flight to your list.  The location is easy to get to if you're staying in San Francisco and they even can arrange a pick up in the city.  We've done several flight adventures but this one is definitely one of the best.  It is so totally cool to fly over the Golden Gate bridge and you get to do it TWICE!  IT's a great contrast to fly up the coast and see the natural northern California of Marin and then circle around and fly over San Francisco and Golden Gate Park.  We even got to see the Giants practicing from above.  The pilot was very friendly and both take off and landing were super smooth even with a bit of wind.  The other employees were super friendly too.  Booking the flight was super easy too.  Also don't worry about sharing the flight with 5 other folks.  No matter where you sit you can see all the sights and the pilot is great about circling around so everyone get a view.  Just book a flight.  You will really enjoy it.

I booked this flight for my boyfriend and it was absolutely fantastic. He was beyond thrilled with the experience and so was I. Everyone there was incredibly courteous and the view was great from above.
Seaplanes is a must!!  My family enjoyed our flight viewing the city.  This was well worth the money!!!!!!

A once-in-a-lifetime experience offering the best aerial views of San Francisco where our pilot showed us the entirety of the city along with its local landmarks including Sausalito, Muir Woods (in the distance), the Golden Gate Bridge*, Alcatraz, Crissy Field, Fisherman's Wharf etc etc. Not only was the pilot exceptionally knowledgeable of San Fran but the entire experience represented excellent value for money where we were able to see the city from above over a 30 minute period (which is more than enough time).

Einfache und unkomplizierte Buchung von Deutschland aus, perfekte Organisation, sehr nettes Personal (deutschsprachig!) und sehr netten Piloten. Wir fühlten uns sehr wohl. Die Eindrücke "von oben" auf San Francisco und die Bucht sind einfach durch nichts zu übertreffen! Können wir nur jedem wärmstens empfehlen! Das Preis war es uns wert, so etwas macht man ja auch nur einmal im Leben!

It was wonderful experience for me and my wife! Staff were very kind, accurate, caring and professional. Was cloudy on Golden Gate, at it had such a dramatic effect! Plus,you get Alcatraz ferry tickets, which are kind of impossible to get on short notice. All together - unforgettable time flying around bay, islands and SFO, thanks a lot again!
Wir hatten traumhaftes Wetter! Freier Blick auf die Golden Gate Bridge, die Stadt und die Bay. Wer fliegen liebt - go for it!

It's a must see if you're in San Fran, especially if it's your first time in the City. I've been here many times and it's still awe-inspiring from the air. We had a great pilot, and the booking process was easy with Ana. Don't miss out!

I gave this amazing experience to my boyfriend for his birthday. They treated us perfectly. He could sit next to the pilot who was an excellent guide of the SF Bay!!
We both loved this experience, highly recommend it!

Took my grandson, Jesse, on this flight. I'm not sure who was smiling more, he or I. Our pilot, Jerome, was superb. Obviously skillful and confidence inspiring. Good tour guide on top of his pilot abilities. This makes it 5 Seaplane Adventure flights for me, going back about 40 years. It won't be my last. Better value and more fun than the rival helicopter tour. Highly recommend it.
What a wonderful experience and great hosts and pilot. Very entertaining and safe; we can’t recommend this highly enough. Go on; spoil yourself!!

Micheal went that extra mile to help get us to the flight on time, thank you Michael!
The flight was amazing, brilliant views of San Francisco and the Golden Gate Bridge. I felt total confidence in John the pilot, I would totally recommend this trip when visiting San Francisco, it gives you a beautiful view of the city.

Perfect day flying over the Bays beauty! My absolute favorite part was flying over the jaw dropping Golden Gate Bridge! We had the privilege of going on a super clear day, the weather and experience could not have been any better. I highly recommend this outing!
Nice!! The best view of San Francisco.  Excellent service... and the pilot give you a good information.

review_title: Fantastic! The most fun way to see SF.
review_text:
The tour runs out of Sausalito but they picked us up in Fisherman’s Wharf. Our driver was very friendly and chatty as we made our way across the Golden Gate Bridge. At the office, we had to sign a waiver but that’s standard. We were the only 2 on the plane that day. The drizzle worried me a little but in the end, everything was fine. Visibility was clear. 

The tour was great - 30 min or so taking in the main sites along the bay including Alcatraz and several views of the Golden Gate. The pilot was friendly and knowledgeable, the ride was incredibly smooth and overall a great experience for my 7 year old son and I. 

I would definitely recommend this!

review_title: SF big tour in Sea Plane
review_text:
Hi,
We did the Sea Plane 45 minutes tour and it was a perfect start of the day !!!
Nice viewings and perfect host.
Thanks ;-)

review_title: The Best Way to See the Bay Area
review_text: Even though I lived in the Bay Area for 12 years and watched those seaplanes take off and land many times, I never took the flight myself until our family went back for a visit last month...and it was amazing. We took the hour-long North Coast package and we flew over the Marin Headlands, the Marin sea coast, the Golden Gate Bridge, the city of SF, the Oakland port and then back over Southern and Mid-Marin county...wow, wow, wow...beyond breathtaking. I highly recommend this activity to everyone who wants a bird's eye view of the prettiest city in the U.S....I wish we had done it earlier, but it was worth the wait! I'll sure I'll do it many more times and take some friends.

Another experience off of my bucket list. The plane was clean and I had no concerns as far as safety. The takeoff of and landings were smooth. After takeoff we headed out over the Pacific, turned and flew above the Golden Gate Bridge flying east over the bay turning south fling past the Giants stadium. From there we flew over the city and the landed. Points of interest were pointed out over the provided headsets. I would definitely do this again.

I was born and raised here (SF/Marin) and I remember seeing the planes on the water every time we drove by on the freeway.  I always thought it would be fun to go up in one of the planes one day.  Well, I am over 50 and my husband and I went for a seaplane tour.  This was so incredible.  It was fun taking off from the bay and landing again in the water.  And our pilot pointed out everything along the way.  I knew most of what he was pointing out as I am a local, but it was so awesome to see everything from the air and looking for things and places that you know.  This is not just for tourists.  This is a fun tour for locals too.  And it was so easy to do.  What a great way to spend some time in the afternoon.  The trip was totally worth it.  I can't recommend it enough.  I may even do it again someday, but I won't wait another 50 years.  It is totally worth it.
I highly recommend this place. My husband and sons first time on a plane. It was not only comfortable for them but educational as well. Will definitely do again soon.

review_title: Exceeded all expectations, this is a must do!
review_text: This is the perfect way to see the San Francisco area. Really friendly pilot and team, and a beautiful aircraft. If you get the opportunity to go for a flight with Seaplane Adventures jump at it!
Fantastic experience with a knowledgeable  pilot on a perfect day. going with the hour flight gave us a full adventure

review_title: Highlight of our trip to San Francisco
review_text: This is a must do if you are visiting San Francisco. The whole experience was great with a very informative and friendly pilot and supporting team. In view of the time of flight and what we saw, it is great value for money. If you are planning a flight over SF, use Seaplane Adventures!

Expérience inoubliable, merci au pilote de l’hydravion qui parlait français et a pu nous raconter toutes l’histoire de San Francisco.
Notre meilleur moment du voyage!

I had a great time touring the San Francisco Bay area in a smooth cool float plane hosted by a very friendly, skilled, and knowledgeable pilot.  No problem when I asked him if I could get a sharp bank on video.  Smooth take-off on the bay just north of Sausalito; over the local landscape of Marin County; back across Marin past the hills to the Pacific Ocean; down the coast to the Golden Gate; down farther to the Twin Peaks; back up to Golden gate (and bridge, of course); over to the bay down the coast of the San Francisco peninsula past Fisherman's Wharf, the Port of San Francisco, baseball Giants stadium(Oracle Park); and then back up across the financial district(i.e. tall buildings); over the bay past Treasure Island and Alcatraz; north past the Bay Bridge (i.e. up the bay); then back over towards Marine County over Angel Island; and then landing back on Richardson Bay.  45 min. tour was more like 1hr.

Really great scenic flights above San Francisco, Alcatraz, Golden Gate, Sausalito, Muir Woods and surrounding areas, in fantastic vintage Beaver seaplanes, flown by extremely nice pilots while also acting as very good guides.
It could not have been better. Pilot was a super guy. Thank you soooooo much...My wife, my 30 year old grandson & I were super impressed with the sea plane & the flying around the San Francisco area.

I am generally afraid of flying and can get sick easily, but this flight was smooth and pleasant. It was very scenic. The pilot was cool and very considerate.  I had really good time and recommend this experience!

It was the most experience ever, professionalism was amazing i highly recommend it to anyone. The pilot, the seaplane driver that picked us up from pier 39 was amazing has so much knowledge of the city and flying.

We took seaplane adventures this past Saturday February 23rd. It was the best experience ever in aviation. The pilot was awesome one could not even feel that they were flying. It was a smooth ride, it was about 30 to 45 minutes long and will recommend anyone to try this awesome experience. I will definitely do that again Seaplane Adventures has 5 stars from me

We had an extremly great experience from the pick up at Pier 39 with a great and pleasant driver, good conversations. The Pilot was very attentive, explain a lot. The flight was absolutaly pleasant and even longer then booked. Thank you to the German guy as well! Great service
We chose the seaplane over taking tge ferry to Ft. Jefferson. It was fantastic. The view was great. The pilot and staff were awesome.
Awesome experience, great views, and very friendly staff! Pilot and copilot took the time to point out all the different areas. Definitely recommend.

Everything was great. Our guide, John, was very amicable and knowledgable. The flight was very smooth, and it was amazing to see all the sights we are used to seeing regularly from the ground, but from the air. I'd recommend the services of Seaplane Tours in a heartbeat.

We took the Golden Gate tour for 30 mins, as I got it as a Christmas gift. There was a slight delay as the couple we were meant to be travelling with had took a wrong turn, but the staff were very apologetic, and we ended up getting the plane to ourselves! The pilot was very friendly and we felt safe throughout the journey. The trip was great and the views were amazing of the Golden Gate Bridge and San Francisco itself, will definitely recommend and return if we get the chance!

review_title: Great and funny tour of the bay area
review_text:
We took the 45 minute tour around the bay area. The weather and visibility were excellent an contributed to a memorable experience, but the main contributor to the excellent tour was the pilot himself. He was very friendly and explained many things as we were flying around the area.
The plane is awesome, very stable and fun to fly in.
I'll certainly be repeating whenever I have some relatives or friends visiting the area.

review_title: Phenomenal views and good amount of time
review_text: The views were just amazing! Their pilot has 51 years of experience so no need to be concerned with lack of flight experience. The views were good from any seat in the plane. I do wish they had a barf bag though. My wife and I started feeling nauseous halfway through the flight but we kept it cool and made it through. I would've felt very bad for the other passengers if we had lost it and not had a barf bag.

review_title: Andra de hidroavião. Um sonho de criança
review_text: Profissionais muito competentes e simpáticos tornando a experiência ainda mais agradávelVale cada dólar poder ver a baia de Sao Francisco, as pontes, a prisão de Alcatraz.Como a velocidade é baixa, é muito fácil fazer fotografia.Ainda aprendemos alguma historia sobre a zona durante o voo, super suave, incluindo uma amaragem perfeita.

This experience was on my husband's bucket list, and I must admit I was a little nervous about doing it.  I needn't have been as Jerome our pilot was all about safety first but I have to say such fun! His knowledge was fantastic and we learnt so much about San Francisco and the areas. We were due to go in the afternoon but because of bad weather they called to say were pulling forward so we could do the flight. We're from England so were thrilled they could do that for us,  especially as the weather was going to be awful all weekend and they wouldn't be flying.
To make the whole experience great they even picked us up and dropped us off at Pier 39. Michael who collected us what very knowledgeable and also extremely friendly.
Thankyou guys for a flight we will never forget, my husband was absolutely in are Of The trip and I loved it too!! 
Thanks for the most awesome flight, take off and landing, especially coming in over the Freeway!! Fab-u-lous!!!
Amazing ride, amazing views! My wife bought this trip for my birthday.  The pilot was knowledgeable of the area and covered all the best spots of the Bay Area.

review_title: San Franciso Seaplane tour with Seaplane Adventures
review_text:
Wow! Considering I was not really looking forward to this trip due to the plane being small, I completely loved it! I could not stop talking about what a wonderful experience this was. The team at Seaplane Adventures were so accommodating, not only did they pick us up from Pier 39 to drive us to the location of the plane, they also drove us back, they even offered to drop us at a local shopping mall then take us back to the departure location later in the day. What amazing service!

The flight was fantastic, the whirl, and the roar of the engine as it accelerated across the water was so memorable. When we took to the air, we flew over Alcatraz then over the Golden Gate bridge, and out to the Pacific before flying back over San Francisco. We were so lucky that the day was very clear, and have some stunning photos, and memories that will last a life time. Our pilot, who looked like Michael Keaton was great fun, and full of knowledge when explaining locations we could see from above.

I loved it, we loved it. I have recommended this trip to absolutely everyone who asked what the best part of the San Francisco trip was. Don't miss out, overcome any fear of small airplanes, and take this trip - you won't regret it!!

booked this trip mainly to get an alcatraz tour because all other tour companies were booked. I have to say it was the HIGHLIGHT of our ENTIRE vacation in SFO. The staff is AWESOME. definitely worth it.

The seaplane flight was an incredible experience! The pilot was friendly, with a great sense of humor and he gave us a lot of interesting information during the flight. We felt absolutely safe! 

Thank you so much for this amazing adventure! 

Highly recommended!
awesome time, trip lasted longer then expected amazing experience definitely recommend it! well worth it!
Thank you so much for great service and lifelong memories! My son is so happy it was more than a week ago, and he can't stop talking about it.

If you are visiting San Francisco then this is a must, it is a beautiful city looking from the harbour, getting a birds eye view is even better.
Fog delayed our flight for 3 days but finally we got on and well worth it.
Smooth take off and landing, great city view flight.

Voir San Francisco d en haut est une autre dimension 
Merci Jeroem pour ce vol
Merci à l’équipe de l’accueil 
Merci au temps un peu de brume matinale et une dose de soleil
Magique

Loved this adventure! Great pilot, tour information, flight locations. We are recommending it to all our friends. We toasted with champagne over the Golden Gate!! Perfect birthday celebration. Thank you!
This was my favorite thing we did while visiting San Francisco!  The pilot was awesome! The entire experience was absolutely fantastic!!!

Made a reservation for 2 as a surprise for my boyfriends birthday—it was great! There were 3 other passengers on our seaplane tour, 2 small children and their father. Our pilot, John, was very experienced and made everything look so simple! He called out landmarks and geological information about the area we were flying over. The tour itself was amazing! I’ve lived in San Francisco for 2 and a half years, and it was so cool to see an aerial view of the places I’ve been. Would definitely recommend!

My boyfriend Dana and I are both Sausalito locals, and for my birthday last May he bought us a champagne sunset tour in a seaplane - something we both always wanted to do! Dana recently passed away from brain cancer (glioblastoma multi form), but the SA staff they didn't know about his medical condition prior to our arrival. He was using a cane at that point as he had some weakness on his left side, but Jerome was incredibly accommodating getting in and out of the plane! Throughout the tour he was funny, positive, and flexible in offering us the best experience possible. I'm also a bit scared of small planes and they made me feel really at ease, even spilled my champagne as I was so worried about Dana at moments and they were really cool about everything. Thank you for the beautiful memory guys, I think of that day every time I see your yellow girl take off over the waterfront!

I asked my fiancé  to marry me at Cavallo point and planned this flight for afterwards. I actually used the flight as a decoy to keep the proposal a surprise and make sure she knew we had something fun planned. The flight was perfect. Low stress, remarkable views and great customer service.  There was another family on the plane (a couple with a young child), and the two of us. You will be on the plane with 2-3 other people potentially but that doesn't detract from the magic of the fight at all. You scoop over the city, the bay, the golden gate bridge and Alcatraz. I've lived here in Marin & SF for 7 years and can't believe I haven't been up in a plane! It really gives you a dramatic perspective of the beauty of the Bay Area. Afterwards you could easily pop over to Sausalito and grab a bite to eat or hop a ferry back to the city. I would highly recommend this to anyone looking for a fun adventure, tourists and locals alike!

We are bay area local, I book the trip as a surprise for my husband and 2 boys, it was a blast! My 2 boys kept talking about the trip, and my husband really enjoyed it too! I have being to different sight seeing trips here in SF, but seaplane is by far the best! Our pilot is great too!! Highly recommend!

review_title: Surprise birthday present for my husband - seaplane tour of SF!
review_text: What an amazing way to experience SF! A whole new perspective. We absolutely loved our ride! Thank you!

My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed the experience. We were greeted with a friendly shuttle driver when we were picked up at pier 39. The office was clean and well decorated. The plane was clean and appeared very well maintained. Pilot was friendly, skilled and well informed, offering us an overview of the sights as we flew overhead. Will be back to enjoy again!

review_title: Don’t miss SF from the air!!!
review_text: Amazing flight over SF and yes, the city is even more beautiful from the air!!!! Our French speaking pilot was amazing, he had a lot of little stories to tell and was great with the kids on board. Everyone had a great time, I would definitely recommend this flight...

review_title: Phenomenal experience with a truly professional company
review_text:
The sunset champagne seaplane tour is by far the best thing I have ever done!
This is a brilliant company to do it with, we arrived 30 minutes early but that was no bother for them, and we were soon up in the air.  We also had the plane to ourselves which was a real treat!
Our pilot was very knowledgeable and great at telling us about the scenery below.  The views were simply stunning, check out my pics!  
P.s. this was my first seaplane ride so i was a little apprehensive, to any first timers, there is absolutely nothing to be worried about, we had the smoothest ride ever, I can't wait to do it again.

review_title: Best view of San Francisco by far
review_text: We thoroughly enjoyed our seaplane adventure flight this week.Our pilot was full of fun and made us all feel at ease. His commentary during the flight was excellent.We flew down the coastline with stunning vistas then back up to the bay passing over the Golden Gate Bridge with everyone getting a chance to take plenty of photos. We flew over Alcatraz and the city getting some amazing views. He didn’t rush back and after landing took some photos of us next to the plane. Certainly a wow experience!

Flew over Angel Island, Golden Gate Bridge, San Francisco, Tiburon, Mount Tam, Stinson Beach, Bolinas, Tennessee Valley. I thought I knew the Bay Area after decades living here but this flight flooded my senses with a 3-D view of all of this!
This tour was an amazing view of the city from above. The pilot was great and we got to see whales in the water too. Would highly recommend this tour.

review_title: Amazing air tour of San Francisco
review_text: What a very nice and pleasant flight, done in a DeHavilland Beaver, with a funny pilot (who also speaks french for the frenchies... I’m. !!!)Golden Gate, Alcatraz, downtown and many other places with live comments :-)A great experience to absolutely do when visiting SF

I have been to San Francisco many times but the plane ride with Seaplane Adventures provided a delightful new perspective.  From the coastline to the city we enjoyed a complete view.  Thank you so much!

I treated my wife to a NorCal Seaplane Excursion for her bday, and it did not disappoint. Admittedly, neither of us had every been in a seaplane before; so we didn't exactly have many benchmarks to compare against. Nevertheless, the experience was truly epic, and we'll remember it for a long time. Taking off, we flew around the headlands of Marin, cruising past Mt. Tam en route to a fly by of Golden Gate. I had never seen the bridge from that vantage point before...it's was truly awesome. Thereafter, we spent some time flying over the main sites of sf: Golden Gate Park, The Haight, Dolores Park, Downtown, North Beach / Coit Tower, the Wharf, etc. Having lived in many of those spots, it was cool to check them out from the sky!

review_title: Great way to see the Bay!
review_text: I live in San Francisco and was looking to do something special for my husband’s birthday.  The flight was so easy to book!  We left right on time and had the most perfect weather.  The pilot was very professional and accurately pointed out the sights.  When we saw a few whales spouting off Stinson’s beach, he was kind enough to circle around so we could get a closer look.  It was amazing to see the City from the plane and I would absolutely recommend it.  I will definitely do it again.

review_title: Only way to see the bay!
review_text: We were fortunate to have a picture perfect day for our flight. Everything was perfect. Wonderful pilot with a great sense of humor.
Hands down.. awesome experience in a Pratt and Whitney dependable plane engine. The ride was smooth and the pilot knew his stuff 🤙

review_title: So amazing!! Do this when you come to San Francisco!!
review_text: Wonderful customer service, fantastic pilot, gorgeous airplane - just the perfect air tour experience!!

This was the best treat we gave ourselves all year long. We'd been putting off this adventure cause the price was a little steep, but since we see this plane flying over us almost every day, decided to finally just do it. Worth every dollar and more. It was such a fun adventure for our little 5 year old - she loved every second, even when we hit a little wind patch. Highly recommend.
This was a fantastic experience, an excellent tour with a fantastic pilot who gave a great commentary. My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed it.

review_title: Excelente paseo en hidroavión por San Francisco y el Sausalito
review_text: Excelente atención. Me comuniqué con ellos a través de su pagina web. Me contestaron rápidamente, y contestaron todas mis dudas. El paseo es excelente igual que el piloto.  Maniobra de manera que los puntos interesantes se puedan ver de ambos lados del avión. El despegue, vuelo y amerizaje fueron sorprendentemente suaves. Mas suave que un vuelo de linea. Completamente satisfecho. Muchas gracias por todo.
Sunset tour of San Francisco and the surrounding area was awesome. Outstanding and friendly service. We will be back to do it again.
great flight.great service!! Would definitely fly again with them. Smooth safe and romantic sunset flight.
Great pilot. Got lots of info on what we were seeing & even found some humpbacks to watch for a bit. Beautiful scenery

My husband and I really enjoyed the take off, landing and all the beautiful sights.  Well worth the investment, plus the pilot is very knowledgeable & enjoys interacting.  Thursday October 4th at 1045.

Pretty good. Excellent and knowledgeable pilot and some good views of the obvious famous landmarks (Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz, downtown, ballpark) and areas you might not have thought of (Mt Tamalpais, Tiburon). However... the rear seats are not particularly comfortable.

This was an amazing experience and one I will remember forever. All of our group agreed this was a lifetime experience and would highly recommend it.Before we arrived the staff were very good at communicating, the pick up was perfectly arranged and the driver Paul is such a nice guy and gave us lots of information about the route we were taking, almost like a private tour :-). The flight was amazing with some stunning views and again the pilot was very knowledgeable about the areas we were flying over.Some amazing pics to be had.I would highly recommend doing the seaplane tour and recommend Seaplane Adventures even more. Excellent tour and a big thanks to the team for making this a memorable experience for our group of 4.

review_title: Amazing experience! A must in San Francisco!
review_text: The staff at Seaplane Adventures is so lovely! The communication was really fast and we received a complimentary transfer from Pier 39. The tour was also an amazing experience, we really enjoyed it. I highly recommend this to everyone visiting San Francisco, for us it was a highlight! A big thank you to the team for making this experience even nicer!

My wife had always wanted to take off in a seaplane, so this trip to SF we decided to knock this one off her bucket list and boy was it fun. We were the only passengers on a 30-minute flight including flying over the GG bridge. Our pilot John was charming and a great guide, pointing out all the key landmarks. He also flew us near to our cousins’ home in Tiburon for a great aerial photo. Worth every cent.
Wonderful trip, dispite a few clouds over the golden gate bridge, we had a magnificent few of San Francisco and Sausalito
This was a fantastic start to our holiday. Great service, pickup, flight and especially the pilot. Loved the experience and all the people involved were great too. I would definitely recommend.
Beautiful trip of Marin County and SF.  Super skilled and friendly pilot made the trip even more fun!

Total überrascht von den Höhepunkten rund um die San Francisco Bucht waren wir bei diesem Wasserflugzeug-Abenteuer! Nicht nur die Golden Gate Brücke, sondern auch Alcatraz und Downtown San Francisco waren herrlich zu entdecken! Preis-/Leistung absolut OK - super Service mit Shuttle-Transfers - einfach unvergesslich.

Super équipe, très bon accueil et super pilote, très agréable.A faire les yeux fermés.De très bonnes sensations, nous n'étions jamais monté dans un hydravion, ce fût une première.El la vue de San Francisco tout simplement magnifique.

This was definitely a great experience. Flying over they Bay Area and seeing all the amazing views from up above was amazing! The pilot was great and really funny. It was a great experience overall. The entire staff was very polit and customer service oriented. I would definitely recommend this to others.

review_title: the Best way to see this amazing city
review_text: I have been to San Francisco 5 times now and seen all the great attractions here.But this time did this awesome floatplane trip with my dad.Wow, a whole new amazing perspective on the sights, and a ton of new things that you just can’t see from the ground.The company were great, organised, friendly and informative.The aircraft are well maintained and in great condition.You need this experience
First time on a seaplane it was an awesome experience the pilot really seemed like he loved his job my gf really enjoyed it and was absolutely fun and different will definitely return
Un très bon moment passé à bord, pilote sympathique et vue unique de la baie. A recommander sans hésitation !

My wife booked a surprise trip to San Francisco for my 30th birthday and this was the first part of our trip. What an amazing way to see the bay area! We were picked up at Fisherman's Wharf and driven to the takeoff spot in nearby Saulsalito (on the other side of the Golden Gate Bridge). We then did about a half hour tour of the bay area in the plane. Got to see the pacific coast, the bridges, downtown SF, Alcatraz, Angel Island...etc. Really sunny day so visibility was great. The tour guide was fantastic and provided a lot of fun conversation and great information/facts about what we were seeing. He also made a few recommendations for other things to do in the area which was really nice. Overall I couldnt have been happier with the experience!

Loved the whole experience. Beautiful views of the city. The flight was really lovely with water take-off and landing. I really appreciated the the audio commentary. I've lived in the Bay area for over 40 years, but I managed to learn new things about San Francisco.
We had an amazing time very memorable staff were very hospitable kind and very friendly pilot was great and the man that drove us to the event can’t speak more highly of them

review_title: Voyage exceptionnel en hydravion au-dessus de San Francisco et de la Baie
review_text: Je ne peux recommander vivement ce trip en hydravion.L’acceuil est convivial et excellent, de même que tout le vol.Pour la petite histoire, les bureaux de la société ont servi de salle de répétition pour le Grateful Dead fin des années 60 et durant les 70.Vous survolerez SF, la Baie....Moment inoubliable et unique.Le pilote nous a commenté les différents sites, ce qui permet de bien comprendre leur localisation.Bref, à faire si vous êtes sur place.

Un régal ! Je connais bien San Francisco et ses environs et de découvrir la Bay, la ville et quelques côtes (dommage, il y avait du brouillard sur le Pacific) a été vraiment fantastique. Le pilote (français) est un guide formidable qui aime expliquer sa ville et ses environs et raconter des anecdotes toujours intéressantes. Pour ma part, c'était une première sur un "seaplane" et j'ai adoré. Merci pour cette "adventure".

review_title: Simply the best way of seeing San Francisco. A dream realised.
review_text:
Near the top of my bucket list, a seaplane flight is just amazing. Seaplane Adventures were really accommodating when I made a booking error and nothing ever seemed too much for them.

The flight was just stunning and the pilot really engaging, giving us more of a flight than I was expecting. Flying over the middle of the Golden Gate Bridge was pretty cool. To see whales playing below was an added bonus.

It may look like a lot of money, but worth every cent. Thanks for a great experience!

review_title: Vintage de Havilland Flyover of San Francisco
review_text: In spite of the seasonal fog bank over Labor Day, we had an amazing time flying over the San Francisco Bay sights in the second row seats of a spacious vintage de Havilland Beaver floatplane. We originally reserved the one hour flight over the Bolinas  coast and back over the Bay. At the 1:00 pm take-off time the fog was still spilling over the coastal mountains, so John, our pilot, circled Mount Tam , crossed over the Golden Gate Bridge and down the north bayfront of the City to the Bay Bridge and Treasure Island. Seaplane Adventures credited back the difference between the one hour and the  half hour tour to my credit card even as we were in the air. Great response to the vagaries of San Francisco weather.

My husband and I booked an evening adventure that was more than we imagined it would be. John, our pilot, was wonderful. He provided the perfect amount of information, while allowing us to soak it all in. The views were beautiful and we enjoyed every single moment! We highly recommend splurging for this adventure.

My wife and I enjoyed our 'seaplane adventure' & Alcatraz tour and would highly recommend it (for both tourists and residents). The website was easy to navigate and the different choices of tours were clearly listed. We received confirmation promptly after our reservation, and all the details were sent to us. We arranged for a shuttle pick-up from Pier 39 (highly recommended if you don't have a car) and a short 20 mins later we were at the facility. John (our pilot) welcomed us on-board and highlighted all the points of interest. The 45 minute flight was awesome...you see the Golden Gate Bridge & Park, Alcatraz, the bay, downtown San Fran, and a lot more. We asked to be dropped back on the north side of the Golden Gate Bridge (so we could walk across), and then walked to Pier 33 (2+ hours, but the views and sites along the way were great), where we picked up our tickets and took the boat over to Alcatraz. The island itself was fascinating...great views and lots of history (the audio tour recorded by former guards and inmates was very interesting). All in all, a day neither of us will forget.

The pilot make us seat on the back where the”seat” was a fabric of leather connected with a metal bar under your legs, really uncomfortable and painful for the back of my legs. Our windows compare to the ones in front were tiny, they were about 6x6 inches, when the ones in front were huge, I have to be constantly stretching my neck to actually see something or going forward to record from the other passenger window. It was a terrible experience specially when you pay to see SF from the sky! I never saw those types of seats before they look completely improvise ( they even had a base) completely different from the ones in front. And the window was so disappointing, the worst part! If you take this tour take the front seats for sure!

I would highly recommend this tour to anyone.

I was sad when the flight was over.  The flight itself was a lot smoother than I was expecting, and I felt safe and secure the whole time.  The flight over the bridge itself was amazing.  Highly recommended.  Also the taxi driver was really nice and chatty

review_title: Seaplane Tour + Alcatraz Tour in afternoon
review_text:
We booked this trip because it also provided us with two tickets to Alcatraz once the Seaplane Tour had ended.  We were picked up in front of the Hard Rock Cafe at 9:00 am. The van was on time. 
We then drove to the Seaplane base in Sausalito, signed the necessary forms and boarded with two other couples. Each person has a window seat. We flew over the Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz prison, AT&T stadium, Muir Woods and SanFrancisco city itself. Our pilot, John , has been flying for over 50 years. He was great and all of us felt comfortable with him at the controls.  I only have one suggestion that the company write a two or three sentence description of each place John points out.  Otherwise he really does not have the time to elaborate on each point of interest we were flying over. 
      Each person wears earphones to keep engine noise to a minimum and provide a communication link between the pilot and passengers.  If you ask a question speak loudly into the microphone provided. It’s voice activated and needs a strong voice to activate it . 
     Management worked very hard with the Hotel Zoe Concierge, Aiyaz Ali, to confirm our flight and the two Alcatraz tickets.  Everything worked out fine. The flight lasted a half hour and John flew us over most areas twice so passengers on both sides of the plane had the same quality view and the ability to take photos with their cameras or smart phones. Once the trip was over , the pilot borrowed our cameras and took pictures of each couple standing on one of the pontoons. We were then driven back across the Golden Gate Bridge again and dropped off at the Hard Rock Cafe. We then walked down to the Alcatraz pier and exchanged our vouchers for afternoon tickets to The Alcatraz prison. You will need to show a photo ID to pick up the Alcatraz tickets and show that ID again twice when you board the afternoon ferry.

review_title: Amazing! A 'must do' on bucket list for visit to San Francisco
review_text:
If you're on a visit to San Francisco then a Seaplane Adventure is a definite must do. 
Situated about 30' minutes from central San Francisco (pre-booked Seaplane taxi pick-ups available from Pier 39) the company operate various pleasure trips affording customers fantastic views over San Francisco Bay and beyond.
Easy to book on-line and operated by very friendly staff.
My trip was last Sunday (6 May) and chose morning 10.45 30' minute flight with the added pick-up from Pier 39. Pilot (John I think his name) was very friendly and provided informative commentary throughout the flight. I was lucky enough to have front seat next to pilot on the plane but everybody on a trip will get window seats.
My 30' minute trip covered the whole of San Francisco Bay including all the famous sights such as Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz Island, down San Francisco etc. 
Ensure to take smartphone or other camera/video gear to capture the views.
Small, but excellent, range of gifts available from check-in office including t-shirts, caps etc.

Brilliant, value-for-money experience and well worth doing on a San Francisco trip.

review_text: It was a really great experience! The staff was really kind and gave a great service! It’s a different way to get to know San Francisco and definitely a must!

The Seaplane Adventure was a magical ride. We did the Golden Gate tour and I highly reccomend it!!
The ride covered much of Marin, the coast up by Muir the Headlands the city ,The Golden Gate, much of SF,  Bay Bridge, part of the harbor in Oakland and Angel island. Worth every penny!!

Our family of five signed up for a Seaplane Adventures tour for my wife's birthday. I chose the 45 minute Greater Bay Area tour and I'm glad I did! It was fun, my kids had a blast and we have a great memory to share! Mom was admittedly a little worried but ended up loving it!

review_title: A different perspective on the Bay
review_text: It was awesome to see the Bay Area from above after living here my whole life! From the coastal views to watching the Bay Bridge toll traffic, there was so much to see and every detail seemed photo-worthy from a bird's eye view. Awesome weekend activity!

Great experience! Staff was a bit rude to any two year old son while waiting for our flight. Repeatingly asking us to keep him quiet......he is an excited two year old....have some patience and understanding. Otherwise, on the flight experience, it was amazing! Best way to view the Bay Area!

review_title: Excellent experience.  A must in San Fran.
review_text: The adventure you are looking for!  Do it when you first arrive and get a bird’s eye view of SF and the places you can visit.  Michael was great, and helped us reschedule our flight due to unexpected rain.  The pilot was a great adventurer and we really were impressed with the incredible views.   And yoi get to enjoy a seaplane!!!

I have been living in San Francisco for over 7 years now but this was the first time I have done the Seaplane ride. I can't believe I have never done it before! It's the best experience and truly a dream flying over the Golden Gate Bridge!!

review_title: Absolutely a MUST when in San Francisco
review_text: Extraordinary experience!! A+ service during the whole process, including picking up at Pier 39, punctuality and amazing flight experience with their pilot. Professional and very friendly.

review_title: Beautiful way to see the city. Can’t be beaten...
review_text: A bike ride over the Golden Gate Bridge, lunch on the waterfront in Sausalito, and a 30 min ride in a vintage aircraft on floats to see the city. This has to be the perfect way to see the city and finish the day. The pilot was a bit crusty round the edges, weary of doing the same thing 4 times a day and not interested in small-talk, while the office staff were snoozing in the corner but that sort of added to the charm. Expect no frills and enjoy the thrill of the seaplane and a beautiful city.

We were picked up in front of Pier 39 in a courtesy van and shuttled over Golden Gate Bridge to Sausalito.  Check in was pretty easy with one disclaimer form to fill out.  We booked the 30 minute seaplane tour that flew over Muir woods, Golden Gate Bridge, Fisherman's Wharf, AT&T Park, and Alcatraz.  The seaplane was a 6-7 seat plane with every seat having a window view. Pilot was excellent! talked to us through headphones and circled around each venue twice so both sides of the plane got the full view.  Spectacular to see all of the sites from the air!

There is nothing quite like taking off and landing on water. The tour, heading out to the coast and over Mt Tamalpais, is like no other. Lucked out and had a perfect blue sky. We went out to and down the coast and spent what seemed like forever over SF and the Golden Gate Bridge, where the fog was just starting to creep in. Up close and personal! I took tons of photos from a unique perspective. The whole thing was so much fun. The plane was nice, the pilot very knowledgeable and gave a great tour.
Awesome, Awesome, Awesome. Pilot was terrific. Views spectacular. Ready to do it again! Worth every penny!
Take of an landing were smooth and we had more than enough time to see everything this the Bay Area had to offer!

review_title: Excellent View of the Bay Area
review_text: It is an exciting adventure to take off & land on the water - the flight covered the entire Bay area w/closeup views of downtown San Francisco, the Golden Gate & Bay bridges, the magnificent Pacific coast, & all around the tegion!!
This was the top fun activity of my 10 day stay in California, with no doubt. John was an excellent guide and pilot, and me been a pilot myself loved the DHC-2, simply amazing.

This was an absolutely amazing trip for my boyfriend and I! We were the only ones on the flight and had an amazing time laughing at jokes from the funny pilot and also getting an aerial view of the city. The pilot also allowed us to take lots of pictures and really made it a wonderful experience. We highly recommend, you won't regret it!

i was a but uncertain if i was going to do this joy flight or not as I didn't have much time in San Fran, but i am glad that i did.  It was such a good way of seeing the city, the bay and surrounding areas.  great flybys of the golden Gate Bridge and Alcatraz.  Pilot and tour guide was great and keep it interesting with lots of trivia.  Saw some wales as well for those who are interested in that kind of thing.
Fantastic trip.  The champagne was a great touch! We were able to see so many great sights, and also pause a bit to look at whales in the bay!  Magical :)

This is a must do for anyone ! we were collected on time from pier 39 then driven across the golden gate bridge to Sausalito ,which is the other side of the bay & totally beautiful ! ,all the staff are brilliant the pilot was excellent and full of information ,the water was calm with no clouds in sky the flight was perfect ,we asked to be dropped  at the mariner then got ferry back after lunch for our tour of Alcatraz which was excellently run like clock work , the audio tour inside is a must ,there are plenty of ferrys running to the island so you spend as much time as you wish here , if you are doing both of these tours fly in the morning then do Alcatraz late afternoon otherwise you may be pushed for time , we had a excellent time & rate this as a must do

Do it. Do it now. Book this activity. This was the best activity my wife & I did together in the USA. The plane is awesome & the pilot, exceptional. Over peak season when we did it many people used this activity to get tickets to Alcatraz. Forget Alcatraz. Just do this. The whole trip was as smooth as silk flying over the bay area, Golden Gate (yes it came out of the mist for us), Alcatraz and downtown. The commentary, jokes, cajolling & interaction between pilot & passengers was excellent. 
They also picked us up & dropped as at the pier area in SF so we did not have to drive.
Will definitely do this again.

had a brilliant experience. the views from the seaplane were absolutely fantastic and was great to also get commentary from the pilot. i took some fantastic pictures.
highly recommend
we also had a pick up from pier 39 and drop off too

Our experience began with a very personable driver on the shuttle from Pier 39 to the dock.  

The welcome at the office was excellent and the pilot was very attentive in boarding us onto the plane.  

The flight experience was excellent.  The pilot was entertaining and knowledgable.  

The whole flight was fantastic.

I took the 30 minute San Francisco Bay tour on August 28th at 3:15.  It was a spectacular day with some fog around the Golden Gate Bridge.  We flew around and over every major tourist site and the view was just spellbinding.
