The pilot was very informative and did a great job maneuvering above and around the Golden Gate Bridge, Bay Bridge, all the SF sites, Mt. Tamalpais, Stinson Beach, Muir Woods, Timuron, Alcatraz, and more.  There are not enough adjectives in the English language to say how fabulous and thrilling this was.  5 stars is an understatement!

review_title: Voler au dessus de monuments mytiques avec un avion de légende
review_text: Si vous pouvez (200 dollars par personnes, mini 2 personnes), c'est à faire absolument. D'abord pour l'avion, un bon vieux Beaver (hydravion canadien), ensuite pour les lieux survolés (à condition d'une météo dégagée, et là, c'est la loterie).Nous avons eu la chance d'avoir un pilote pralant parfaitement le français et c'était génial. Un service de navette vous récupère sur le quai 39 de San Francisco. L'hydrobase étant au Nord de Sausalito. Durée du vol 30 min.

review_title: Brilliant experience and first class customer service
review_text:
Brilliant experience - highlight of our visit to San Francisco!
Customer service was brilliant to resolve a mix up with our Alcatraz tickets (we booked a combo package) - thank you Michael!

We did not plan our day to do this but came across the sea plane and called and booked. It was one of the best experiences either of us have had. We saw a totally different perspective of the city and coastline and the Golden Gate Bridge too. Our pilot who also owned the plane was a brilliant guide who also told us both funny and historical facts about the city below. It would be helpful to go on a clear weather day, ours was magnificent. We think this was worth every cent we paid and would highly recommend to anyone considering.

review_title: something else  that makes the Bay area Unique!
review_text:
Wonderful time, easy to get to from SF or Marin. Family owned, responsible pilot AND a great time when you take the tour.
For people who LIVE in Marin, it gives you a whole new perspective on the county we
love, the amazing expanse of green space and the proximity to the Pacific. A must do
for tourists as well as locals!!
A

Wanted to see Dry Tourtogas and can't handle the boat ride because of motion sickness. A quick 30-40 flight takes you to the island where you can spend a half day. They provide you with the snorkeling equipment and a cooler of side or water. Great half day adventure and very much worth the cost! I'd definitely do it again!

We recommend to fly with this company.
We are very enjoyed by this large tour. It's was an amazing tour, wonderful views and very good comments of Jeroen. 
Congratulations for this exceptional experience to Jeroen our pilot (he speaks french), very friendly and enthusiastic person, sharing his experience and his historical comments.
Also a thank you to Michael for his very good and warm welcome at our arrival.
We hope to have a new opportunity for flying with you next time !
An ambition achieved!  Fantastic experience and worth every penny.  Wife and two sons didn't stop grinning for hours!

review_title: Wish I could do it again!
review_text: This is just AWESOME! Well worth the money but take 45 minutes minimum. The pilot was very skilled and the commentary was very informative.An amazing experience and a brilliant way to see the whole of San Francisco Bay.

review_title: Little too laid back pickup, but very cool flght
review_text:
We realized too late that we wanted Alcatraz tickets, so we booked the combo package with Seaplane Adventures.  We waited over an hour in the sun for our pickup, without any notification from the company.  That started us off in an irritable frame of mind.  The pickup driver didn't apologize, he just kept "explaining" that traffic was really bad because of an event.  Letting us know so we could stroll around or do other things would have helped that a lot.

Once we got there, check in was smooth and the pilot, John, was pleasant and low key.  The ride itself was terrific.  John went to the places we could see (there were lots of clouds and fog) and had some interesting comments about the sights.  He tilted the plane to the left and right to give us better views of some places of interest.  The landing was very neat, and the return drive was ok.  

We had to ask like five or six questions for the driver to tell us we just needed photo ID to pick up our Alcatraz tickets.  Had we known this when we were waiting for pickup, we could have saved time and frustration.  

The cool factor of the seaplane ride itself outweighed these silly problems, but they could have been avoided.

review_title: What a Kick in the Pants!
review_text:
The hour long flight is a blast. I thought we'd just tool around the Bay, but we headed up the Marin headlands past Mt. Tam to Tomales Bay & Pt. Reyes. The trip back south took in Pt. Bonita and the old batteries. You get a good view of both lighthouses without the long trek down the bluff. On a clear day (which we had) you can see out to the Farallons, and you'll get to do some whale and pinniped watching if you're lucky.
Aaron, the pilot, points out the sights and gives a bit of history and context along the way. I can vouch for his familiarity with the area and its history. You're likely to learn a bit, even if you grew up in Northern California and made it through fourth grade CA history.

We chartered this flight for our sons birthday. Four adults, not teenagers. The weather was good, the pilot knowledgeable and we saw a blue whale near Drakes Bay!

Recommended.

review_title: Wonderful Sea-Plane Flight Tour over Beautiful Bay Area
review_text: My Dad and I had a wonderful time with the Sea-Plane flight tour over the famous Golden Gate bridge, AT&T park, the whole vivid view of the entire San Francisco city, Sausalito view + Angel Island + Alcatraz Island, Nice Bay bridge & beautiful City of Oakland view, and more more!!! wow, it was breath-taking!!!  My Dad was in the South Republic of Vietnam military forces and he was in the Bay Area more than 45 years ago and he mentioned that all nice places brought back great memories.  Thank you to our awesome pilot (Steve/Bob/Mike or something else...we are a little embarassed for forgetting his name!!!) for excellent story telling skills & flying techniques & skills were incredible with the smooth take-off & soft landing.  We wish to to it again with longer tour like 1 hour or something like that.  Cheers and thank you so much to Sea Plan Tours.

I was in town for 3 days, I booked this last minute and I'm so glad I did. Amazing views, great friendly informative pilot. I got to see much more than I expected, the hump back whales were a bonus. Flown in many types of aircraft, flying in the vintage seaplane was a first. This is a lifetime memory make sure you do it
Vol de 1h dans la région de San Francisco. Survol magique du Golden Gate bridge, de Alcatraz et de downtown. Pilote et staff super sympa. Une expérience à recommander à tous.

I was only in town for 48hrs on business so wanted some big-hitting tours to see as much as possible during my stay in the city. I love flying anyway and when I found that I could fly in a seaplane and the legendary Dehavilland Beaver at that, I knew it was the best option. 

I did the coastal tour which is an hour duration and also arranged the taxi collection from Pier 39 - all of which went smoothly. Graced by some great weather, the tour was fantastic from start to finish. I actually went on my own but confirmed beforehand that this would be okay - two other tourists were on the flight.

The pilot deserves special praise as a fantastic tour guide who was informative and very entertaining despite the fact he must do the tours hundreds of times every year. He also thought nothing of deviating from the tour a little or circling landmarks just so we could get a better view.

The aerial views of the miles of coastline, the bridge, city and Alcatraz are exceptional and you simply can't see everything we saw in less than three or four days, yet we did it all in an hour. For me, it's an essential trip if you're in town, even if you're staying for longer. Just make sure the weather forecast is good.

Flying over the Headlands, the Golden Gate and San Francisco provides a unique experience and a new dimension to the Bay Area.  Adding to the fun is taking off and landing on the water.  Our pilot was extremely well versed on the area's history and geography and provided a running dialog about what we were seeing.  He is a very experienced pilot who put all of us at ease, even one who is prone to air sickness.  He was also accommodating for those of us who wanted to take pictures, etc.  Our only regret was that the flight was too short!

review_title: The best thing to do in San Francisco
review_text: I have been to San Francisco over a dozen times and I'm mad at myself for not doing this before. Everything else has mostly been said by previous reviewers but I regret only doing the 30 minute trip, which was still absolutely memorable and brilliant. The time just went so quickly, it was amazing. I would recommend and will be doing myself next time, the 40 or 45 minute one. I don't think that I would see anything else on the 60 minute one where I could justify the cost to myself, but with the 30 minute one, I definitely regret not paying a little bit more for the 40 or 45 minute trip.  I normally don't like guide commentaries but the pilot, which we had, didn't stop talking much for the entire flight and it was really interesting. Shamefully I can’t remember his name but thanks whoever you are. I was expecting a rough landing (I actually like that kind of thing which was one of the reasons for doing it) but I couldn't even tell when the plane had landed, what a pilot. As well as a camera, of course, I would recommend a pair of binoculars to zoom in on things which interest you. After over a dozen visits to San Francisco, this was also the first time that I had visited Sausalito which is nearby. It’s a really nice town and there are many excellent places to eat.

Es war ein Geschenk für meine Frau das voll und ganz ins Schwarze getroffen hat. Die gesamte Crew vom Shuttle Fahrer bis zu den Piloten ist wirklich super freundlich. Wir hatten 2 Piloten die wirklich alles erklärt haben. Vielen Dank Aaron und Collin. Der Flug über die Golden Gate Bridge und Alcatraz war einzigartig. Vielen Dank wir kommen auf jeden Fall wieder. Es war jeden Cent wert. Thanks you very much

One of the highlights of SF trip! Recommended!
Easy to book, on time, wonderful views!
30-45' tours, up to 6 people.

This was one of the highlights of my recent 16-day tour of Arizona, Nevada and California.  What an experience!! I booked this seaplane ahead of my trip, on which I was accompanied by three of my other travel companions.

The views over San Francisco were amazing and there was no fog. We flew over Alcatraz and skirted the Golden Gate Bridge.  My phone videos are brilliant, from which I can re-live the experience any time.  At a price of approximately £139, this was well worth doing. I can strongly recommend it to anyone visiting San Francisco.  Also, the pilot had a great sense of humour and appeared to really enjoy his job.

I booked the tour through Viator and come to find out that there was a problem. Staff (Ana) notified me early before we travelled to San Fran and worked everything out and gave us several options. The pilot was great and made sure we had an incredible time. The views were awesome I feel its the best way to take in the incredible scenic beauty of the Bay area. It was the highlight of our trip.
Booked this for my husbands birthday. The staff was very friendly and the pilots were great. The views were amazing!! Overall, totally worth it. Highly recommend!
Took our son and grandchildren on this seaplane adventure for our sons 40th bday. What a trip. Aaron was our pilot and he was excellent with sights, knowledge and professionalism

On behalf of our group of 4 I'd like to say that the seaplane flight exceeded all our expectations. It was such a great experience to see the sights around San Francisco. Our pilot gave a great running commentary and the flight gave us great views of the Golden Gate Bridge, the city, Alcatraz and lots of the surrounding areas. Thankyou very much for a great way to be introduced to San Francisco.

Es war der perfekte Tag. Es war ein unvergessliches Erlebnis für uns. Muss mach gemacht haben. Es war ein riesen Spaß, cooler Pilot mit tollen Informationen über die Stadt. Viele Grüße an unsren Hamburger Jung :-).

review_title: Best way to see the sights - ever!
review_text: Simply a most memorable experience flying north up the coast and then back over the city of San Francisco and the Bay before landing back in Sausalito. Aaron, pilot, gave a commentary which was just right in terms of information. The old aircraft was a joy to fly in. My wife, who does not enjoy flying normally, was completely at ease throughout. Highly recommended.

In 30-45 Min. sieht man die SF-Bayarea aus einem ganz anderen Blickwinkel. Der Captain unterhielt uns informativ und humorvoll. Der Start und die Landung auf dem Wasser sind schon ein Erlebnis für sich.

Wir wurden freundlich empfangen und hatten das Glück nur zu dritt im Flieger zu sein. Der Pilot erzählte uns während des kompletten Flugs nette Geschichten und strahlte pure Sicherheit aus :) 
Man hat eine traumhafte Aussicht und bekommt einen herrlichen Überblick auf San Francisco und Umgebung.

We loved every minute of this tour. We took the 30 min bay tour and honestly can say the views we had were spectacular. Our pilot was knowledgeable with a great sense of humor and even dressed the part with his Hawaiian shirt. Views of the whole bay were incredible and could never have been seen by any other means of transportation.

Seaplane Adventure is a must for the novice or experienced SF traveler. It is a safe and exciting experience which will leave you with impressions and photos of The City you can't get any other way. 

Our pilot was friendly, knowledgeable and very competent. He was a big part of the value for money, which by the way, was excellent. I now recommend a seaplane ride to any friends or family who visit San Francisco. Please note, it is important to book in advance, and the earlier the better.

What an excellent trip this was. The pick up driver was great with his knowledge and very informative. On arrival everything was quick and soon on the plane. The take off was so smooth. The pilot was also very good at pointing out nearly everything. This is a must do trip.

I am not one that jumps at flying but I wanted to surprise my husband with a once in a lifetime adventure and that is what we both recieved. Upon arrival to Seaplane adventures we met the very nice pilot who showed us the plane and history behind flying. After getting all geared up it was ready to take off, it was the smoothest ride ever and what views that are so amazing pictures just don't do the city of San Francisco justice. Along the flight we learned more about the history of the buildings, bridges, local scenes and just random things that you as a visitor would never find out. Its simply breathtaking and such an experience you must try! The pricing is really reasonable and it's about 45 min tour worth going back to do again!
Good to see the city, great pilot and staff. We loved how it takes off and lands on the water. You cant miss it!

This is an experience. A sea plane ride overlooking the gorgeous Pacific Ocean, the Golden Gate Bridge is something that you have to do while you are here. 
Just get on one of those sea planes and get ready for some stunning views. Blue oceans, the Alcatraz and shores everything is spectacular. 
I was super lucky to be in the co-pilot seat. 
The staff is super accommodating too. They got my back when I was almost missing my scheduled flight because of heavy traffic on Golden Gate.

Heute waren wir mal wieder mit Seaplane unterwegs.
Da wir im Oktober mit dem Heli unterwegs waren haben wir uns diesmal für das Wasserflugzeug entschieden. Was eine toller Erfahrung. Fink beim Check in an wo wir auf Deutsch empfangen wurden.
Der holländische Pilot war von Anfang an witzig unterwegs und hat den Flug spaßig unterhalten. Tolle Action, super Event , atemberaubende Sicht und Gegend. Ein Must have ! 
Wir kommen wieder ganz bestimmt ;-)

Vielen Dank für den tollen Trip.

review_title: San Francisco with a birds eye view!
review_text: We booked the morning flight around the SF bay. The morning started out foggy and overcast but by the time we arrived and prepared for take off, the fog lifted and we were up getting some great photos of the bay area. Keep in mind the seaplane is like an old truck - tough and reliable but it's no Cadillac. You might want some Dramamine if you get motion sickness easily. We had a blast!
Our family loved the overhead view from the seaplane when they visited from Scotland. Excellent and knowledgeable pilot.

review_title: Great fun and a real standout day
review_text:
Initially we booked this because we were too late booking a direct Alcatraz visit, but so glad we did as this became one of our best days in SA.

Seaplane Adventures were excellent from start to end. 

Pickup was in a clean car from Fishermans Wharf with a friendly driver who dropped us off at the airfield. 

The airfield is pretty basic but the people are  very friendly and got as away as soon as the fog lifted (always a risk on the early flights). 

Pilot was brilliant. Funny, informative and always keeping an eye on the customers. My daughter it turns out isn't a great flyer, so he kept a close eye on her.

Flight around SA bay was great and got a chance to do some really nice Alcatraz pictures.

Whole flight was brilliant  and then we got an extra small car tour on our return of a few key SA sights on route back to Fishermans Wharf. 

We then had 3 hours before our Alcatraz tour to grab lunch and wander.

It's worth knowing that you get your tickets for Alcatraz from the Tour Desk not the Pre Booked desk, as we wasted a bit of time in the wrong queue !

Alcatraz is an absolute must on a SA visit. Fantastic tour of a part of American history. 

My teenagers were fine and enjoyed the audio tour and got a real insight into the prison.

I'd been 20+ years ago but still enjoyed the trip, nothing much was different though 😀

review_title: This is a MUST for seeing bay area!!
review_text: We took the Golden Gate Tour and it lived up to the adventure name!! The views/scenery you get with this tour cant be beat. Its unbelievable all that you will get to see in a 30 minute flight. The pilot, Aaron, makes you feel very comfortable and narrates the whole trip without it feeling "scripted". The whole staff, from the front desk to the pilot are very welcoming and answer all your question. I have some balance issues from nerve damage and appreciated the help onto and off the plane. Although we didn't need it, they also provide shuttle service(for a nominal fee) from downtown San Francisco. After viewing so many sights in the bay area during our stay here, this was, by far, the highlight.  In my opinion, the whole experience is A++!! LOVED it!

review_title: Le plaisir de voler en hydravion et de voir la baie de la haut ! Super !
review_text:
Deuxième fois (à 18 ans d'intervalle) que je me paie le plaisir d'un décollage en hydravion. Le patron est charmant et son assistant Jérôme parle le français parait-il....

Maintenant, si vous préférez le vélo, ça grouille de cyclo touristes qui encombrent le ferry de SF....
We went on the 45 minute tour and it was incredible!!! Highly recommended tour!!!! Well worth the price.  The pilot was charming and was very informative.  Can't wait to do again!!!

review_title: The best experience - a must do
review_text: We booked this as part of a Viator package to see Alcatraz and it completely blew us away.  We were a party of 4 - two adults, a ten year old and a 4 year old.  Despite a total fear of small aircraft, we couldn't have felt safer.  Jerome, our pilot, was hilarious and kept us entertained.  He was also very knowledgeable.  I would book this experience again in a heartbeat.  Thanks for a truly brilliant time!

My whole family (including three teenagers ages 13,16 and 19) really enjoyed the seaplane ride. It was the highlight of our trip. The pilot was funny and informative. They took us right on time and were helpful with directions when I called to confirm. Must do while in San Francisco

What a great way to see San Francisco!  I have lived here for over 20 years and this was the first time I went on this tour. We took our friends who were visiting from out of town and hands down, this was the highlight of their trip.  

I must admit, I was a little skeptical at first, flying over the city in a plane straight out of an Indiana Jones movie.  However, I fell in love with the adventure the minute we started moving.  

We opted for the 30 something minute tour which takes you over the Marin Headlands, the Golden Gate Bridge, the north west tip of San Francisco, skims along the Embarcadero, over Alcatraz, Tiburon and back to the Sausalito starting point.  

You will see some of the most breath taking views of San Francisco and the surrounding areas you won't get anywhere else.

THIS TOUR WAS WORTH EVERY PENNY SPENT!  Don't miss out.  I would do it again in a heartbeat!!

While looking for Alcatraz tickets which were sold out i came across a seaplane flight with alcatraz tour combo. (Viatours). I must say well worth it. Picked up by Dave on time from fishermans wharf 30 mins guided drive over golden gate bridge through quaint towns to the Seaplane office. Got into a DeHaviland seaplane and got a brilliant guided tour of the whole bay area including a roller coaster negative g drop (once all passengers agreed) my 13 yr loved it dropped bk to Fishermans afterward. Well recommended!!

review_title: Incomparable Way to See San Francisco
review_text: I prevailed on my wife to try a seaplane tour of the San Francisco area, and both of us were really glad we did. Seaplane Adventures takes off from Mill Valley, and the pilot flew us all over San Francisco and several areas of Marin County.  The pilot paid close attention to and pointed out various sights that he wanted us to see, and altered course when he thought we could get a better angle to see and take photos.  We'd recommend Seaplane Adventures to San Francisco tourists as an incomparable experience.

Here's something that's not on offer everyday in big tourist cities. 
What a treat. 
You have a choice of three trips from 30 minutes to an hour and get a guided tour of the city, from the air. 
Our pilot/guide was brilliant and it was really good to see the city from the air. 
We've travelled a fair bit and have learned the best way to really enjoy a city, is to do some sort of guided tour when you arrive. 
If you can afford it, I'd recommend this one. 
You get collected from Pier 39, so you should get there early and wander around a bit, if you haven't seen it, as it's less crowded. A 20 minute drive over The Golden Gate Bridge to the plane gives you a quick tour of some of the suburbs. 
We combined our trip with Alcatraz as we then had guaranteed tickets. 
This was a highlight of our time in San Francisco.

This was the highlight of our trip to San Francisco. The sea plane was incredible; what a great view of San Francisco from so many perspectives. Jerome was an absolutely amazing and engaging pilot. The whole family enjoyed all aspects of the plane. The Alcatraz tour was also great. The audio tour allows you to enjoy Alcatraz while hearing the story behind everything that you are seeing. A WOINDERFUL day from start to finish!!!!
This was one of the greatest tours we have been on. Smooth, informative, polite, all round great experience. A exceptional value for the price.  Book it or you will regret it.

We booked the Greater Bay Area Tour. You get a great view of the key sites, including the Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz, AT&T Park, Downtown and the surrounding Sausalito Area. We did NOT see the California Coast Line beyond the Golden Gate as advertised in the description; this may have been due to weather or other circumstance, but if you are looking specifically for those views, I would suggest you mention it at departure time.
The tour lasted exactly 45 minutes. The plane fit 5 passengers comfortably, each with our own window to enjoy the sites. The pilot was fabulous in giving us information about what we were seeing, the history and answering questions. He kept it fun!
If you are a fan of flying, want to see the city from a different vantage point, and have a sense of adventure, I would definitely recommend it. The tour was a highlight of our entire trip to San Francisco. 
Tip: Book the shuttle service from Pier 39 at least one way. We made our way to Sausalito on the Ferry to enjoy the town before our flight, but there are not many taxis or Uber drivers available to take you to Mill Valley. It's a long walk! They did provide us complimentary shuttle service back, which was greatly appreciated.

This was money well spent, what a great way to see San Fransisco. Our pilot Aaron was great and gave us the trip of our lives. This was by far my favourite thing to do in San Fransisco - yes even better than the Alcatraz tour, which I loved. I can't rave  about Seaplane Adventures enough, they picked us up and dropped us back, and made everything easy. Great views and commentary. I have told everyone I know who is heading to this part of the world that it is a must do! Thanks for helping this Kiwi fly!

A great experience to see how beautiful the San Francisco Bay and Coastline is.  Wonderful folks operate this business.  The pilot, Aaaron, was an awesome tour guide.  Can say enough about how fun the experience was.  Best bang for your buck for sightseeing.

review_title: Great birthday gift for that special someone
review_text: I bought this for my husband's 68th b'day.  We had driven by this place so many times and he would say I'd love to do that someday.  I surprised him with this gift and he loved it.  It is a novel way to show someone you pay attention to what they say and you want to make your loved one happy.  What fun!

Taking the seaplane tour was the best decision we made while visiting San Francisco! I would highly recommend doing it on your last full day so you are aware of your surroundings a little better. Both sides of the plane have good views because the pilot swings around the major attractions.  We were picked up from pier 39 and the driver who took us to the place and back was wonderful and funny.

review_title: Put this trip on your BUCKET LIST !!
review_text: A great Christmas gift from our son & his wife. It was a rainy week, but we kept checking the weather on line to make sure that we would have a sunny & clear day. We booked an early flight and were lucky to be the only two passengers and it was spectacular.

This was a last minute addition to our road trip but proved to be the highlight of the entire holiday. We were picked up from a pier in San Francisco and taken to the take off point in Sausolito. The staff were really friendly and welcoming and we met another couple from Switzerland who were flying with us. I lost the toss for the copilot seat but it didn't reduce the experience in any way. We were soon taking off from stretch of water near the base and we turned north before coming down over the Golden Gate and onward over the city. The pilot was pointing out interesting buildings etc throughout the flight and turned back over the bay overflying Angel Island and Alcatraz before landing back on the water and returning to base. We were then transferred back to Fishermans Wharf stilling buzzing. This is a must do if you are visiting San Francisco although we were blessed with lovely weather. The cost was 194 dollars each and was worth every penny

I just got back from our tour a few hours ago. I took my sister on the sunset seaplane tour for her birthday and it was amazing! These guys were super accommodating as we had to reschedule not once, but twice. They whole time they were incredibly gracious about it and made it very easy for me to organize (thank you so much Ana, you angel!)

The tour itself was breathtaking. This is absolutely the number one way to experience the Bay area. We saw all the major sites, learned some interesting history and really got to see the bay in a new way. We are locals and it was still incredibly interesting and unique. What a gorgeous place we live in! The seaplane was the ideal way to experience it. 

Our trip came with a champagne toast and our guide was funny, friendly and very knowledgable. He warned us when there would be a few bumps and really everyone did there best there to make this experience special for my sisters bday which I really appreciated. I would absolutely recommend this activity to anyone visiting or even living here in the bay area.

from the moment i started email talk about my flight i knew these were a good company,You can just tell cant you
They were there at the exact time on pick up and the driver was brilliant and talked to us all and got us more excited!
once we arrived at the base we met the staff who were equally friendly then we went to the plane,the pilot was great and had a very witty sense of humour so we got on great.
the flight was truly amazing,The pilot was as well.
the views on offer were jaw droppingly good.it was a 30min flight but it felt much longer,the pilot also had a lot of info on the city.
It was just amazing and i cant recomend this company highly enough,YOU MUST get in touch with this place to create a memory of a lifetime.
Just to add....i asked the driver on the way back to drop me off at the golden gate bridge,Because we were all talking he missed the stop,No problem he just turned round and drove back over it to drop me off!! perfect customer relations.
Go book it.

review_title: La mejor vista de la ciudad
review_text:
Encontré este Tour por casualidad y me dejé convencer por mi amor hacia los aviones y la posibilidad de aterrizar sobre el agua.
La verdad que cumplió todas mis expectativas. El personal muy amable y disponen de traslado desde el Pier 39 hasta su base en Milli Valey.
El viaje dura aproximadamente 35 minutos y el piloto es muy simpático y va narrando datos interesantes.
La vista aérea de la ciudad es increíble y sólo con eso el Tour se vende sólo.
No pierdan la oportunidad.

I'm a local who had a guest visiting from France so I splurged and went on this trip.  We did the 45 minute tour.  It was amazing.  Communications were great even when I asked them to change the date and time of the trip and add another person.  The pilot was excellent and the ride was smooth.  The views were spectacular.  I've seen the plane go overhead 100 times and now I'm happy to say I've experienced it for myself.  If you can afford the indulgence it's a wonderful experience, even for locals!

Book this directly through the company. Do not use an intermediary.   The website is not always up to date with other websites so you think you have a confirmed reservation, and then find out from the company the flight was sold out. We only found this out after calling the company for directions.

When we actually took the trip it was simply amazing. A great view on a beautiful day. An amazing way to see San Fran, golden gate, San Quentin, and more. Pilot was friendly and helpful.  Would highly recommend it!  Drive over on your way to wine country or for lunch in saulsolito!

review_title: Amazing Aerial tour to see the San Francisco Sites
review_text: We took this tour while staying in San Francisco in Fisherman's Wharf.  We opted to get picked up for $15 a person to be driven there and back (it was about 30 minutes to get over to the Sausalito area) This was a great option, and an added bonus getting a ride over the bridge narrated by the animated driver, Paul.  We took the 10:45am flight, we are a family of three and were joined by another group of two.  It was a 6 person plane (pilot and 5 passengers - our 14 year old got to be co-pilot), so everyone got a window seat, great for viewing the sites.  Our pilot was funny and informative, pointing out a lot of sites and providing history and facts, while keeping us laughing.  The flight lasted for about 40 minutes and was well worth the cost. The flight started off over Sausolito, Tiburon, and Belvedere.  We went over Muir woods, and then we then headed out to sea, checking out the beach and the dutch windmills. We had a great view of Alcatraz and Angel Island, and got a great view over the Golden Gate Bridge. We saw the military forts, learned all kinds of facts, and the over AT&T park.  All were beautiful views of the city, that you would never otherwise experience... say yes to the rollercoaster!

review_title: dont tell you anything but keep you waiting , where do they hire this front desk guy?
review_text: I decided to do a 2nd seaplane tour for my  son today on a drop-in and told the guy with glasses at the counter.  he nodded but didn't say athing. waiting for 20 mins later after he retrieved a sea plane and served 2 more reserved customers. then I asked him again for a tour.  at this point he said they are all booked and have to wait till afternoon.  What an smot! NO CUSTOMER SERVICE SKILL  AT ALLl!!!!  he could have say this early on or say something like let me get back to you.   I have a pilot license myself and will not pay $300 tour + humiliation dealing with this type of person again. so looks like I will fly on my own.

review_title: Highlight of our Visit to San Francisco
review_text:
Amazing way to see San Francisco!  My family of 5 took a more 30 minute flight - we were lucky to have a clear day and got a fabulous tour.  Seeing the area from the air gave us a new perspective on the city.  Although it is a bit pricey, the trip is well worth it.  

We flew in a yellow, 6 person plane - 3 rows of 2 - with my youngest daughter flying as the co-pilot.  We all had great views.  We wore headsets that allowed us to hear/speak to each other.  Unfortunately, my headset (3rd row left side) went in and out and I had to fiddle with the plug quite a bit.  Although I missed some of the info from the pilot, I focused on the view and enjoyed the tour.

Highly recommend!

review_title: The best way to see everything
review_text:
My wife and I booked the Seaplane Tour + Alcatraz Tour and we loved it!!!

This is such a fun and amazing way to see the Golden Gate Bridge, the Bay Area, San Fran City, the Pacific coastline...!

The pilot was great, pointed out all the sights for us and explained some of the sights too.

Pick up was easy and simple from Pier 39 and was dropped off there too which was really convenient for us for a bite to eat before catching the boat at Pier 33 for Alcatraz.

The Seaplane is a must do for unbelievable views and for such an amazing experience! I can't recommend this highly enough!

I was definitely nervous about flying in such a small plane, but after several minutes in the sea plane all my worries went out the window. It was SO smooth and wonderful! The pilot was hilarious and very knowledgeable. If you're scared, don't be!! Do it!

review_title: Fabulous way to see the Bay Area
review_text: We were lucky to have a clear sunny day for our seaplane trip and it was wonderful. The tour itself covers the major sights in the Bay Area with many views of the bridges, city and surrounding countryside. The pilot was interesting and helpful and all the staff were lovely. The views of the bird life from the air were particularly striking. It really is a worthwhile trip and ended with a great landing.

I planned this as a surprise for my husbands birthday. Booked it in advance. We came here and had a smooth check in. Our pilot then came and boarded us in. We were 6 people in the tiny plane. Our pilot was knowledgable and funny and showed us a lot do places. It took off and landed on water which was so amazing. Once we were up, it was such a beautiful view. The golden gate looked beautiful from up there. It was a good 30 to 40 minute ride and the weather was perfect.

review_title: Incredible panoramic views of San Francisco
review_text: This was an amazing experience. Our pilot was friendly, funny and knowledgeable, and put my partner (who isn't a keen flyer) at ease straight away. The weather was quite foggy and cloudy, and though I imagine it would have been even better on a clear day, our pilot flew lower so that our views were unimpaired. We got some excellent photos and memories of alcatraz with the cityscape behind it, and of course of the Golden Gate bridge. Lots of fun, and highly recommended.

A great trip in so many ways. For a few extra dollars you can get picked up by vehicle at Fishermans Wharf and driven across the Bridge . We had a beautiful clear weather day, difficult to believe the stories about the fog. 
The plane is an old lady of the skies, 1959 ( I think ) but serves the purpose beautifully.
For the first time in my life weighing 16 stone was a bonus - as heaviest passenger I got to sit in the co-pilot seat but everyone had a decent view. Taxi past Salsalito and then up and away. We chose 45 minute flight which on a clear day was definitely right decision. It takes a few minutes to really relax and it gave me time to enjoy taking in the instruments and mechanics of flying this old plane as well as the views - and what views. Pilot was informative and funny and was happy to answer questions  ( goegraphical and aeronautical) . Having been up and down the coast at sea you then fly right over the Bridge and along  the city frontage before turning right over the City and heading back over Alcatraz. Always just a hint of nerves as you land but smooth and safely down. Back on the mooring pontoon a chance to pose for pictures standing on the float of "your" seaplane! The whole thing is a real treat for boys ( and girls) from 6 to 66!

review_title: Great flight to familiarize yourself with the bay area
review_text: Took my 15 year old son on the flight from Sausalito . It was a great way to get oriented to the Bay Area, including bay bridge, golden gate , city of SF , Marin coastline, mill Valley, Sausalito, tiburon, etc.. Well worth it.  And the planes , though older , are reliable workhorses.

review_title: 30 min bezahlt und upgrade auf 60 min Tour bekommen
review_text: Schon der Start war einfach atemberaubend. Wir wollten diesen Flug nicht missen. Meine Frau und ich wurden am Pier 39 abgeholt und selbstverständlich auch wieder dort abgesetzt. Wir hatten auch noch das Glück, dass das Wetter sehr gut war mit guter bis sehr guter Fernsicht. Wir überflogen die markanten Punkte teilweise mehrfach und während des ganzen Flugs gab es dazu sehr gute Erläuterungen des Piloten. Es war einfach gigantisch Alcatraz, die Sandwich Brücke in Richtung Oakland und die ganze Bucht mit ihren vielen kleinen Inseln aus dieser Perspektive zu sehen. Jederzeit wieder.

My sister booked us for the one hour (approximate) fly over San Francisco Bay and area.  SO MUCH FUN!!! Weather was perfect and we had a riot.  John our pilot was wonderful - perfect landing!  Could not even feel touch down.

The tour started off on a high note when Aaron introduced himself and it got better as the minutes flew by.  His skill as a pilot was outstanding, equaled by his conversation and knowledge of the bay area.  The weather was perfect, which completed the experience all around, unsurpassed by anything that we did during our stay in the San Francisco area. If you are looking for an unforgettable time, be sure and book a seaplane tour.

review_title: " Fantastic Services, friendly and just awesome"
review_text: Me and my friend were picked up at Pier 39 and driven to the location to takepart . The gentlemen driver was great giving us commentary as we drove along,"he didn't have to do this "  The ride was fantastic alone. The flight was breathtaking, i cant explain in words....We were in the air what felt along time,not up in air and land soon after. The pilot was very Informative and also you could tell he enjoyed doing this !!! "fantastic " Also we were given a ride back to pier 39.

Great friendly and knowledgable pilot. Incredible views, interesting facts, amazing take off and landing, and my 13 year old got to hold the controls for a brief photo opportunity. Best trip in San Fran, do it!!!

We were picked up at Pier 39, on time, by the very friendly driver.  
The pilot met us at the plane and went through the safety procedures and then we were off.   The flight was wonderful and covered much more than I was expecting – Muir Woods, the fantastic beach scenery, Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz, the financial district, Giants ground, Angel Island then we were given the choice of which route back we wanted to take – we chose to go over the bridge again.  The pilot was funny, engaging and very knowledgeable and made the trip very personal, especially as we were the only two passengers on the 1pm flight.  
The whole process was very smooth and professional and I cannot recommend this trip highly enough.  I will be booking again when I return to California in March.

This is our third time with this company.  We have done the helicopter tour and this is the second seaplane ride we took.  First one for our daughter.  We all had a fabulous time! Well worth the money for a different type of excursion!

Easily the most fun my family and I had on our trip to SF. An incredibly friendly and professional staff made this the highlight of the week. This has to be a part of your trip, especially for any aviation lovers in the family. I would schedule another flight again in a heartbeat. Seaplane Adventures is awesome!

review_title: Add to your Must Do list for San Francisco!
review_text:
Aaron & crew were great!  They helped our family (even with some that needed "extra" assistance) to have a great time.  Much more in a blog...
http://fountnhead.blogspot.com/2015/06/sea-plane-tour-of-san-francisco-add-to.html

review_title: Best way to see San Francisco!
review_text: This family owned business is the best place to go to see the sights from above. Friendly and considerate! They provide transportation to their business and the flight was AWESOME. We celebrated our 25th anniversary with a memory we'll never forget!

This must be the best way to see the bay area! Taking off from the bay was awesome, then seeing the Marin Headlands, Muir beach, over the GG Bridge, across the skyline, over the bay bridge, across Alcatraz then back through the GG Bridge. What a thrilling way to see the most beautiful area of the country. The pilot was very nice, and informative. Being in such a small plane is sketchy but we felt safe the whole time. Would definitely recommend!

I have rowed from Sausalito in the bay, sailed on the bay, cycled to the top of the Marin Headlands, hiked in West Marin, but this is the only flight that I have taken that almost touched the top of the Golden Gate Bridge and gave me a different view of the water. Wow!  That's all I can say.  Spectacular!  A sheer joy!  I loved every minute of our excursion for two.  The take off and landing on the water was an added bonus.  A must do....even for locals like me.  What a perspective you get of the most beautiful place to be.
Loved the flight. Transportation from Pier 39 was great. Everything was on time.  Spectacular views from the plane.  Pilot was very knowledgable and pointed out the landmarks.
Une magnifique visite de San Francisco. Voir les différents sites déjà visités depuis les airs a enchantés tant les parents que nos 3 ados. Les explications de Paul étaient parfaites. A conseiller.

review_title: Very poor and indifferent customer service.
review_text:
Visited San Francisco for 5 nights in early Feb 2015. Phoned Seaplane Adventures from my hotel, and spoke to a man. I asked if there were any flights tomorrow ?  Man said there might be a weather front coming in, phone back tomorrow morning.  The next day, I phoned several times to be told, " all our agents are busy, or it's after hours, and ring back or leave a message".  I left a message, and gave my name , hotel and room number. No reply.  The next day, I phoned again, and the phone just kept ringing and ringing, no answering machine kicked in. The next day, we decided to drive out to the Mill Valley office, saw the sea planes parked up, in the mud, but the office was closed. I enquired at an adjacent office, and was told that " there's usually someone there by 10 'ish".  At around 10.15am, a red pick up arrives with Seaplane Adventures written on the side.  We go into the office only to be told that they're not flying today.  In fact, due to low customer demand, they rarely fly from December through March !  
So San Francisco doesn't get tourists from December through March ? I asked the owner?, Why don't you mention this on your advertising material ? Why don't you reply to messages left on your answering machine ? We have wasted time in attempting to contact you, and wasted time and fuel driving to your base, and for what ? The man didn't really have much to say, so we left.
Exiting the seaplane office.  I saw a helicopter land alongside, so I thought, what about a helicopter trip instead of a seaplane trip. The passengers got out of the helicopter and walked to a tour bus.  I asked the driver, " how much are the helicopter flights ?".  He didn't have a clue.  The helicopter had shut its engine down, so I walked towards the helicopter when the pilot motioned me to halt, whilst he was speaking on his mobile phone.  I waited nearly TEN MINUTES for him to finish his call, he got out, and I asked " when's the next flight ?".  He said, "about 2.00pm 'ish ". He asked how many passengers there would be, I explained two. He said, in that case he would have to charge me for FOUR persons. Excuse me, you want to charge me almost one thousand US dollars for a 30 minute flight around San Francisco ? Needless to say, we left.  In fact, we left so fast, I didn't have time to note the name of the helicopter company, but they're situated next door to Seaplane Adventures, 242 Redwood Highway, Mill Valley, SFO.

I love flying and after trying seaplane in different part of the world I definitely wanted to try it in SFO...
A pick up was offered for 15 USD per pax at the Pier 39... Car was on time but was dirty, driver had no grooming and even stopped at a gas station to refill his glass of Coke!!! 
The terminal is old and dirty, as is the plane who is a stronger concern.
Smooth take off, beautiful view with a perfect weather, small engine problem ( a few sec ) over the city and perfect landing after flying over Alcatraz.
If the management was taking it more seriously it would make the perfect experience as the value for money for 30 min flight was very good and cheaper than in most of other part of the world 
On the way back I asked the driver to drop us at a different location as there was no other person.. He declined and did a drop 10 min walking distance from the hotel!!!

We come to SF at least once a year for a quick vacation and flying with Seaplane Adventures has to be the most fun thing I've ever done in SF.  The views are spectacular.....and I say that as someone who isn't the biggest fan of flying.  Rick, the pilot, was so much fun.  He explained some of the things he was doing as well as giving a great history of various landmarks around SF.

We loved it so much, we're planning on giving it as a gift to my mother and sister-in-law when they join in SF in April!

One of the highlights of my visit to SanFrancisco.

It's a superb way to see the SF sights - Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz, San Francisco city centre and the bay.

I was lucky enough to sit next to the pilot so had great views front and side.

An entertaining commentary and a smooth take off and landing completed a great trip.

review_title: The only way to see SFO
review_text: Great tour, great pilot and amazing landing :) a must do while in San Fran... enjoy you wont regret, (unless your landing was not as good as ours :) )

My wife and I were in San Francisco visiting family over the Christmas holidays and were given a seaplane tour by our kids for our 35th wedding anniversary. Seaplane Adventures helped our kids pull this surprise off. It was am amazing experience. Their shuttle driver was prompt and courteous. The tour was expertly organized. And the flight over SF was a once in a life time experience. The weather cooperated that day, so we have some memorable pictures. 

We would highly recommend Seaplane Adventures for a magnificently organized, professional and uniquely memorable experience.

it was fantastic way to see SF from another perspective.. stuff is friendly, the pilot is professional..
they have pick-up servis on Pier 39.. it is a bit expensive but it worts!

review_title: Fantastic way to see San Francisco and wonderful experience
review_text:
Having visited SF 2 years ago and seen everywhere from ground level we wanted to do something that was that little bit more special and something we had never done before.

In one word it was AWESOME. The weather that day was brilliant with unexpected unrestricted views (no haze) and the sea was like a mill pond. Getting in a plane that is parked on water is an experience in itself and once the safety brief was carried out the taxi to the take off point and the take off itself was a wonderful visual and emotional experience. It is difficult to describe what it is like as the aircraft accelerated to take off speed, skimming across the sea as it did so.
 
Once airborne our decision to take the flight was rewarded a thousand times and more. Words can not describe the excitement  of looking down on San Francisco, The Golden Gate, Alcatraz, The Piers and all the other areas and attractions we flew over. Our pilot made this a very personal experience despite the number of flights he had already made and he provided us with a good description and information on all the parts of our flight.
As with all experiences the 45 minutes were soon gone and it was back to base and a landing experience that was all as good if not better than the take off.
I had done a few hundred flights when I did skydiving as a hobby so I was used to being in a small plane but that did not dull the experience of taking off and landing on water it really is one for the bucket list. If you haven't done it yet trust me you MUST.

My wife on the other hand has little or no experience of small planes and was a little nervous prior to the flight BUT she loved every minute and would have gone back to do it again. She said she always felt safe and trusted both the aircraft and pilot!

Thanks to everyone at Seaplane Adventures, this was a special birthday experience for me and you made it a stunning one.

What an amazing experience! Flying low over San Francisco Bay was exhilarating, and the aerial views were phenomenal. We saw the Golden Gate Bridge, downtown San Francisco, Alcatraz, and everything in between. The plane was intimate and every seat had a window, which was awesome. I'm a local and have lived in the Bay Area all my life, but haven't done anything like this. I couldn't put my camera down!

review_title: seaplane tour around San Fransisco Bay
review_text: I took the hour tour around the San fran Bay area with my father and my 2 kids(ages 12 and 14). We flew over the sonoma vineyards, Alcatraz and the Golden Gate Bridge.  The pilot gave us great info about what we were flying over. it was an amazing experience. We felt very safe.

j'avais essayé de reserver de Paris , mais cela semblait compliqué pour confirmer en anglais , alors lors de notre ballade en vélo sur Sausalito , nous nous sommes arretes et nous avons
rencontré un compatriote qui nous a tout expliqué en francais , il m a meme permis de me 
mettre à la place du pilote , nous avons reservé pour le lundi apres midi. le matin du lundi le
golden etait sous la brume , grrrrrrrr , lors de notre arrivée et apres un petite attente la brume
s est levée et nous avons décollé , Paul le pilote à fait le job , super tour d avion , explication et
surtout il ma laissé le manche pendant la moitie du parcours , le pied total , piloter un avion au 
dessus de San Francisco et du Golden Gate ; inoubliable. ( précision , je suis pilote en France )

encore un grand merci à notre hote francais ( John ) et notre pilote Paul.

Let's forget the weather which was typical SF in summer. All the rest was amazing. Started with the cable car in direction of Fisherman's Warf. Rented the bikes at Blazing Saddle. Crossed the Golden Gate and stopped in Sausalito for lunch. Went to Seaplane in the afternoon. Used the ferry back and had dinner at The Waterbar to close a wonderfull day. And Seaplane was definitely  one of the better activities in our 4 weeks US travel. We took the SF bay tour, which gives a great overview of the environment. Start and landing on the water is special. Explanation given by the pilot was great and there was more than enough time to address all the questions we had. Our son had a chance to command the plane for a while which is something he still remembers. In brief, absolutely recommended to make a visit to San Francisco complete. One side-note : because scheduling can be impacted by external factors, make sure you allow sufficient time (a window of 3-4 hours) before/after our visit (especially if you are using the ferry back).

C'est une expérience chère mais qui rend un voyage inoubliable. 
Seaplane est une petite agence, gérée par un couple : le mari est le pilote de l'hydravion, tandis que la femme s'occupe du bureau et de la manutention de l'appareil. Un couple vraiment sympa qui connait très bien son boulot. Très simple d'accès par la route, voir même par le ferry. 
Ils sont très attentifs à la météo et savent adapter leur tour pour ne pas gâcher la visite. 
Vraiment fantastique

Saw a Beaver flying around the bay the day before and had to look these guys up - was glad I did, this was probably THE highlight of the trip.

Thanks for playing pilot / aerial tour guide for us, Aaron!

We went to San Francisco for a weekend break and by far this was the highlight of our trip.  We were picked up and driven to the plane and spent a wonderful time taking photos and seeing all the sights including the bridge and Alcatraz.  We were also driven back.  My husband was in heaven and he was grinning from ear to ear.  Loved the take off and landing from the water.  Definitely book this trip, well worth the money and only very small number of people in the plane, only holds up to 5 people besides the pilot.  Would recommend that you sit in the back because there are unobstructed views for photo taking purposes.  Pilot was very knowledgeable and friendly.

review_title: Fantastic experience, great views and very informative
review_text: Brilliant way to see all of San Francisco Bay and the surrounding islands. Great views of the bridges and Alcatraz, the pilot was really good with information during the whole trip. Well worth it especially seeing the Giants stadium.

We spent a weekend in San Francisco and wanted to do something out of the ordinary.  We took the 60 minute Norcal Coastal Tour and highly recommend it.  Spent the morning in Sausalito and met our pilot after lunch.  It's kind of fun to take off and land on the water.  Very smooth ride and great commentary from the pilot along the way.  It was just my wife and I with the pilot so she got to ride co-pilot.  The first half of the tour is up the coast with views of several light houses, it would be fun to do this during whale season and spot them from the air, no such luck on this day.  The second half of the tour is over Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz, and San Francisco.  Not something you would do every day but the 60 minute tour was just right, not too long and not too short.

We took this seaplane trip on the final day of our holiday and it was just amazing. The ride was smooth and exciting and we circled the whole of the bay with great commentary on the views all the way round. I managed to get great photos of the golden gate bridge, the bay area, Alcatraz and the surrounding area. Thank you for a wonderful end to the holiday.

I've lived in the Bay Area for over 30 years but had never taken a ride with Seaplane Adventures. Now I wonder why it took me so long?!   I saw the familiar from a whole new perspective as well as some things I'd never seen before. I was reminded agAin about what a special place this is and the Seaplane Adventures staff were so professional and informative. A "Don't Miss" experience and a fabulous birthday gift from my daughter to my husband!

This HAS to be the only way to see San Francisco... from the skies!
My friends and I had a great time with our pilot Aaron who is a fountain of knowledge when it comes to the Bay Area! His amusing commentary guided us across the Golden Gate Bridge, Marin Headlands, Alcatraz and San Francisco itself.
If you're debating between a helicopter tour or a seaplane tour then look at it like this... How often will you get a chance to fly on a seaplane compared to a chopper? Taking off and landing in Richardson Bay is an experience we'll never forget. Just awesome!
Grate Plane, Great Pilot, Great tour.  would reccomend this as the FIRST thing to do in the bay area.

Planned this surprise trip for my Son's 30th birthday.  The flight was absolutely beautiful, weather was perfect and sky was clear.  I would recommend seeing the Bay Area from above.  We took the 1/2 hour ride which was perfect.  Jerone was an awesome.  He gave us a lot of history and information but we couldn't hear him.  The only reason I didn't give it a 5 is because we couldn't hear the pilot at all.  The head phones are either really old or the whole speaker system is old probably due to the age of the seaplane.  We adjusted the sound but it didn't help, too much static.    I've been on a tour in a helicopter and could hear via headphones clear as a  bell.  I suggest they update their system.

review_title: Great way to see the Bay Area!
review_text:
We were driving past and happened to see the Beaver tied up and thought we'd have a quick look and ended up booking a flight then and there, and airborne within 20 minutes!
What a great flight! Saw all of the big attractions around San Francisco and with some good commentary letting us know some good information about what we were looking at.
A very professional organisation and a must do if you want a great view over the sights of the San Francisco Bay!

I booked this for my brother and I as a surprise for him while we visited San Francisco. I saw the vintage Sea Otter plane in the ad and knew that was the ride we wanted. My brother, a pilot, really appreciated the plane and the great ride and tour given by the pilot. We now have really neat pictures of the Golden Gate Bridge and Alcatraz from above. The plane seats six so if you have more people to bring along they can accommodate you. The shuttle driver was very personable, the staff and pilot very friendly. My brother and I will remember the tour as a high point in our visit.

We took the Seaplane tour last week on our visit to the Bay Area and all I can say is, this is a MUST DO! The pilot and staff are very friendly and accessible, the location is convenient and easy to find, and the views are stunning. The flight offers a perspective of the one of the most striking and beautiful areas in the world that you just simply can not get any other way. This is truly up close and personal. 

Keep in mind that this is a small aircraft and subject to bumps, turns, and sensations you do not get in a commercial airliner. If you are prone to motion sickness like my wife, have a full stomach and take Dramamine. You'll be fine! There is absolutely no cooler way to see this beautiful area.

Wir haben es Mitte Juli 2014 gemacht und es war ein tolles Erlebnis - unbedingt empfehlenswert!
Bitte auf die Wetterlage achten, morgens und am Abend ziehen oft Wolken vom Meer herein.
Die beste Zeit scheint der frühe Nachmittag zu sein.

we just had to leave feedback for everyone thinking of doing this trip, Dont think just book it,we had an amazing expierience,breathtaking views from take off to landing gently back on the water, we booked our trip through Viator who arranged a shuttle bus to pick us up and take us the four miles accross the Golden Gate bridge , down into the little quaint town of Sausalito,this was a lovely startt to the trip, we then borded the seaplane with another couple, we all had excellent views, starting with the Muir woods, Muir Beach, Point Bonita, of Course the Golden Gate Bridge & Alcatraz. plus the Harbour & City ,plus Bay Bridge , pier 39 ,infact everything giving wonderful photo oppertunaties every turn. If you are visiting San Francisco make this trip a must , well worth every penny & definately not over priced .

review_title: Great way to see San Francisco
review_text: This was a great way to see the SF bay and the perfect end to our holiday.  Fun, accommodating (they were able to wait until the mist had cleared from the bridge), and very informative.  And if you are a plane enthusiast you get to see what flying a seaplane is all about.  Well worth doing.

review_title: The best way to see San Francisco
review_text: What an amazing experience! I will recommend this for anyone I know visiting SF. I have pictures of the city and Golden Gate Bridge that are nothing like I have ever seen before. Amazing is the only word I can think of to describe this fabulous experience.

Die Leute von Seaplane Adventures sind sehr spontan. Bin vorbeigefahren und wollte nur mal Informationen und sie hätten sofort einen Platz für mich gehabt. 
Am Tag  des Fluges war es sogar möglich den Copilot-Seat zu bekommen. Super!!
Einziger kleiner negativpunkt war dass der Abflug sich um 30 min. verschob, weil zuletzt noch Gäste kamen. Aber das ist zu ertragen.

review_title: Great Time: Took the Champagne tour last night and it was outstanding. Paul was a great pilot and gave a great tour.
review_text: We are locals that would not normally take a Bay Area seaplane ride but really glad we did. Our pilot, Paul was outstanding and the ride was the best. It was a great way to get a unique perspective on the Bay. Staff was really friendly and did a great job as well. Highly recommend!

I booked a Seaplane trip in October 2013 for a flight in April 2014. The day of flight flight arrived (my last day in San Francisco) and I spent the morning heading to Pier 39 for pick up. 

The collection never arrived. When I called the office I was advised no flights were operating that day and although apologetic the staff couldn't understand how the online reservation system let me book for a day when no flights were operating. I "slipped" through the system. I was promised a refund would happen immediately. 

After 12 days I still hadn't received my refund and I emailed 3 times with no response. I finally called (8 hours time difference) and was advised that my refund had "failed". No effort had been made to check or resolve this in those 12 days. I do now finally have my refund. 

I'd recommend being 100% sure your flight is going to happen before wasting precious holiday time getting to an agreed pick up point (at cost) only to be let down. Thoroughly disappointed.

We did it with Paul on 7 April.  Loved it! It was such a highlight of our stay in San Francisco.  Everything from pick up point to drop off and whole organization were great. And the flying over city of course!

Thank you for great mood!

review_title: What a treat !! - great way to see SF and Marin Co.
review_text: I highly recommend taking a plane tour, not only are the guys at Seaplane friendly and courteous, but the tour it self its much better than a helicopter ride, we took the tour around the city including the AT&T ballpark to Mt Tamalpais, a great fly over the Golden gate bridge, alcatraz, angel island, etc. I highly recommend this tour.

If you want to see the Bay area like no other, do a seaplane tour!!!

The plane itself is comfortable and our pilot made it a really nice smooth ride. You see everything from Mount Tam to Stinson Beach to the AT&T ballpark and Alcatraz. He swoops over the Golden gate a few times, allowing you to get some amazing aerial pictures. See beautiful homes, sweeping hills, the vast pacific ocean, the majestic bay bridges and the wonderful San Francisco all from one place. Definitely worth it more than other paid tours!

We did the 30 minute flight in the 1955 beaver. Perfect day and we only 2, so my son ( aspiring pilot) got to sit next to the pilot. The pilot Aaron knew a ton about SF ( I've lived here 20 years  and even learned a few things) The views , the perfect weather , the cool plane the great pilot was more than we could have hoped for. Great job guys! I have been singing your praises to anyone who will listen.

Despite assurances that the trip went over the ball park we were told in flight by the pilot that there was a hold because of a ball game happening there. In fact we knew to the contrary and were even able to show him on a smart phone that the giants were playing in St Louis. But no dice and no explanation or apology. The rest of the tour was OK but the pilot didn't really know all the facts and was flat out incorrect on some stuff!

review_title: What a wonderful way to see wine country in autumn!
review_text: Aaron was top notch! Great, safe pilot and excellent narrator of history of the region. Our seaplane ride was a highlight for my husband and me. We toured the wine country and the grape leaves were in full, peak color. So enjoyable. Highly recommend.

My family purchased this as the morning part of my birthday celebration - total surprise.

We were picked up promptly at Fishermans Wharf and quickly transported to their base in comfort. Have to say the morning started with a dense SF fog but a quick phone call advised us not to worry as it would lift - and it did.

Aaron, the pilot, was superb with a running commentary all the time, pointing out interesting sights as we came towards them. Occasionally he would fly around so people on both sides could view items. We covered the Mill Valley/Marin towns on the way to the lower Wine Valleys the traversed the Bay to cover SF, Alcatraz and GG Bridge.

This was a superb way to see the area from a different perspective and in an old seaplane. We were speedily transported back to Pier 39 afterwards. A very professional outfit with nice people. No hesitation in recommending.

We did this trip on the 17th of October.  We were picked up at Pier 39 on time and driven straight to Sausilito where the seaplane took off.  It was pretty foggy as we drove over the Golden Gate Bridge so I wasn't really sure what we would see when we were up there.  Anyway, we were taken straight away and we did the hour tour and shared with another couple of people.  The pilot was very engaging and entertaining and we totally enjoyed our flight.  We felt very safe the whole time, which was especially important for my husband who isn't too keen on heights!  We flew over the vineyards, surrounding towns and the views over the Golden Gate were absolutely mesmerising.We managed to get some amazing photos, some with the fog, some without.  Once the flight was over we were driven back to Pier 39, no hanging around whatsover.  Would not hesitate to recommend this company, they are first class.

My partner and I took this trip, booked through Viator, in September, during our 3 day stay in San Francisco, while travelling California. We were picked up efficiently and on time from Pier 39, by a friendly and engaging driver, who happily pointed out local sights for us both on the way to Mill Valley, where the seaplane is based and back again. This guy was so informative and helpful, he even stopped twice on the way back so we could take photos of Landmark sights.
The flight itself was great! Our pilot Aaron, was clearly very skilled, confident and experienced in flying the plane. He made sure that everyone (there were four passengers in total, maximum would be five) could ask any questions they had, using the headphones with mikes and gave a really good commentary of the areas we were flying over, throughout the roughly 40 minute flight. I was really lucky in being 'co-pilot', sat at the front. This meant that I was able to lower the window beside me from time to time, to take photos without glass between the camera and the outside world. Having said that, the glass was very clear, so other than possible reflections, pictures would have come out really well anyway. We happened to be flying on the last day of the Americas Cup race and being one of only three airborne vehicles (the other two being media helicopters) made the experience even more special, our pilot making the most of this occasion for his fortunate passengers.
Overall, a very highly recommended trip and very good value for money!

We managed to pick a beautiful sunny afternoon for our Greater Bay Area tour which included a very convenient pick up and drop back at Fisherman's Wharf.  There were five adults and one child and we were seated comfortably inside the DHC2 Beaver aircraft with headsets to listen to Aaron's expert commentary. We had an incredible view of all the major sights and would not hesitate to recommend doing one of these trips - it's worth every penny!

Fantastic way to see the Golden Gate Bridge and Alcatraz from the air in a seaplane especially sat next to the pilot. A 20 minute journey was just enough . Conditions were very calm so the ride was serene and the pilot was very informative. Well worth the money.

What a Ride!
We took our son who loves flying for his birthday and it was a completely awesome experience.  Loved the vintage plane. Captain Aaron flew us around the bay with all of the breathtaking sights.  Surprised there is not a line out the door for this !  Simply a must do

We were met by Paul on time who was a helpful character. We arrived and were quickly on board the DeHavilland Beaver Seaplane our young pilot was very confident and kept us all informed of the sights of the Bay area.
Take off and landing was very very smooth and even my wife, who was very apprehensive was calm and enjoyed the experience. The time did seem to go quick but we had the full time promised.
Paul had listened to me talking and had a little surprise on the return journey, he took us to a view point and stopped to allow me to take photos of the Golden Gate and San Francisco city skyline. Very impressed and in my option worth the price we paid.

Cher (500€ pour un adulte et 3 enfants) mais magique.
Il ne faut pas être claustrophobe ni trop grand ( au dessus de 1,80m, négocier la place à côté du pilote) mais le vol est magnifique et passe très vite (30 min)
Outre le Golden Gate et Alcatraz, j'ai adoré le virage au dessus du stade des Giants avec les buildings du centre de SF à côté de l'hydravion...
Ce jour là, il y avait aussi les bateaux de l'America's cup ...
Accueil très sympa, bref, foncez!

review_title: Totally awesome, thank you for memories which will last a lifetime.
review_text: This was the finale to our month long trip to the west coast and what a finale it was.  Everything was stunning, the plane, staff, pilot and of course the views.  I have started saving again!!!

review_title: Fantastic experience and great way to see this beautiful city
review_text:
Aaron picked us up from Pier 39 for our seaplane flight, he was very punctual and there exactly on time. As he drove us to the seaplane, he pointed out all the interesting things to look at on the way,and gave us information about the all the things we saw. He knows the area very well and is very happy to share his knowledge. 

When we arrived we saw the beautiful seaplane and Aaron explained to us how to get on safely and was happy to take a photo of us in front of the plane before take off. Once in the plane he told us what to look at as we were taking off, and once airborne he gave us great information on all we saw, and pointed out where to look. 

The day we flew was magnificent and we had a birds eye view of the bridge, the city, the stadium, Alcatraz, the house boats, Sausalito and some of the magnificent homes on the foreshore. Aaron's personal commentary let us know where to look, and when to get the camera ready, and provided us with interesting facts and history about what we saw.

At all times we felt very safe, and thoroughly enjoyed our flight. 

On the drive back Aaron dropped us off at Sausalito and showed us where to catch the ferry back. He also suggested many good places to have lunch. We took his advice and enjoyed a lovely Mexican meal at one of the restaurants.

This is truly a great way to see this beautiful city, and I would highly recommend this tour, it was a very memorable experience and Aaron was an excellent pilot and guide.

As a seaplane enthusiast of long standing, I took the opportunity of my 68th birthday to fly in one for the first time.  Our pilot handled the DeHavilland Beaver smoothly and pointed out the sights carefully as we flew over Muir Woods and the Golden Gate.  The flight over the downtown area, Alcatraz, and Treasure Island was a marvel.  And the sharp, descending left leading to a downwind landing gave us a feel for what real flying is like.  Two Thumbs Up for Seaplane Adventures!

I had a great opportunity to join up with some good friends of mine who used to live in Mexico.  I wanted to do something unusual and suggested flying.  My friends needed aerial footage for a documentary they are working on so it was a perfect plan. 

With cameras attached to the struts we flew over the beach, the city, the golden gate.  It was low tide so it was an interesting experience landing and taking off through the mud.

Dave our pilot rocked!  He shared all sorts of interesting facts about the Bay area.   I will certainly consider flying with these guys again.  They have a Northern Cal flight and even a flight to wine country which I would think would be great fun. 

I definitely recommend Seaplane Adventures.

Fantastic way to celebrate the special day, for both myself and my partner, we both enoyed the awesome experience, the scenery and our friendly, knowledgeable pilot... Hopefully the weather will be just as perfect when we fly with Seaplane Adventures again in the future, thank you so much guys

review_title: Awesome! You've got to do this.
review_text:
It was our first time in a seaplane and thoroughly enjoyed the experience.  Recommend paying the $15. per person to get picked up in front of Pier 39 as it was much easier than trying to find our own way to Mill Hill.  The flight was so smooth, comfortable and peaceful and we got to see some great parts of California.

All the staff were not only welcoming, cheerful and polite they were also very attentive and fully explained everything.

We've both caught the seaplane bug and can't wait to do it again!

A massive thank you to everybody at seaplanes.com for the perfect morning.

My sister and I booked the flight over Bay area for my 40th birthday. It is an amazing experience. Professional and friendly service from Michael and Dave at Seaplane. The flight was smooth and offer magnificent view of the bay. Commentary of details was perfect. 
We received a call at our hotel the night before scheduled day to confirm that tomorrow we will be picked at Pier 39. Even on the ground when drove from Pier to the plane we were given detail commentary of the area we passed. The plane was 1955 model but perfectly maintained. We were explained some safety feature and even if something wrong, the plane can still glide and float on the water (assuring!).
After the flight, instead dropped back to Pier 39, we were offered if we want to be dropped in Sausalito to enjoy the area and can go back to SF by ferry, which we took and made the day even better. 
Highly recommended!

review_title: If you do nothing else on your trip to San Fran, do this !!!
review_text: We had never been in a seaplane before and now cant wait to do it again. What a buzz. We were picked up from Pier 39 by the driver who was gave us the best commentary on the local areas as we drove through them on our way to the seaplane area. The pilot of our plane was friendly and very informative on our flight. the plane is fantastic (not that we know much about planes) Taking off from water and landing is outstanding. The tour of the city and surrounding areas is brilliant. Even though we have done it once, we will most definitely be re-booking again on our next trip.

review_title: It was the BEST experience of my trip.
review_text: The flight with the seaplane was the highlight of a fabulous trip. It was spectacular and the guys running the trips were great fun. Thanks, and I'll be back! Jan F-D

Just came back from a fantastic trip with Seaplane Adventures. Despite a little fog around the bridge and coast we were treated to fantastic views of the bridge, the city skyline and bay area, the surrounding hills and coast. We took the 1hr tour as this took in the coast as well as the city. Due to a slight mix up between the receptionist and pilot we came in 15 minutes early from the 1hr trip but were up in the air again in no time for another 45 minutes so got 1.5 hrs instead of the scheduled  hour. And two take-off's and landings on water! Would thoroughly recommend this trip and doing it with Seaplane Adventures. Without doubt the highlight of the holiday so far!

This is a must do in San Francisco. The views are spectacular and incredible. Riding in seaplane is lot of fun.
The address on their web site is not accurate and our GPS took us to a wrong place. We called their number several times even before we left for the tour but no one answered. We thought we were ripped off and not many people are aware of this place in the neighborhood. We had to ask some stranger to find this place. They didn't even care to say sorry or being considerate. This is a family owned place and there is only one old lady to take care of all so she doesn't seem to care that much. 
Anyway take Mill Valley-Stinson exit on 101 North and you will see the Seaplanes on your right , make a right at Pohono St and make right again on Bolinas St. GPS co-ordinates to Pohono St  [37.87953, -122.51497]. 
Regardless it's a great tour and I recommend this place as it is not crowded and there is plenty of parking space.
We took the 30-min $170 golden gate tour. We flew in a 6-seater seaplane over Marin Headlands,  turned & flew over golden gate bridge (an awesome view), fly close to city skyline and then headed back to Sausalito. It felt really short but it was lot of fun esp. landing and takeoff, which was very smooth.

review_title: indispensable si vous visitez San Francisco
review_text: un accueil très chaleureux ,Greg le pilote de l'hydravion très gentil et sympathique le vol à été  superbe on a découvert la baie et san Francisco vus de haut magique ! Survol de Sausalito,Alcatraz,Golden Gate etc .Tres facile à trouvé le seaplane tour se voit de la highway 1 on ne peut pas les rater !de plus à quelques mètres se trouvent quelques maisons sur l'eau typiques de Sausalito !

What a fantastic time we had provided by fantastic people. We enjoyed the trip so much and the information provided during the flight was excellent.
