The gentleman who picked us up was so friendly and helpful and after the flight went out of his way to drive us back to Sausilito even giving us a tour of the local area. If you are ever considering a trip don't hesitate to book it,we could not praise it enough. My husband sat besides the pilot making the experience even more enjoyable.

review_title: All I can say is WOW!
review_text:
Just got back from a really unique experience - wow! - very impressed! Quite the ride -  from Richardson's Bay to fly around Marin headlands, city, and the Bay bridge. We had quite a windy and gusty but clear day, taking off at 5pm - the wind made the ride particularly exciting! The impressive de-Havilland and our pilot pilot rode a path with spectacular views from Sausalito to Muir Beach, down to the lighthouse and across Golden Gate park, over to the Giants gamepark, over the city and back over Tiburon - all the while the pilot mixing a few local facts with cheeky jokes. You simply can't get a better view of the city, the bridges, and the bay like this - and 30 minutes is the perfect length of time to take it all in and still come away with amazing and unique photos. 

Highly recommended.

Nothing like the feeling of floating above Northern Cal.
This  is must for everyone to do at least once...
It is a smooth comfortable ride and landing..
Jeff our pilot was amazing.. Treat yourself and rise above the traffic!

only negative thing was the late pick up. there was a delay of about forty minutes.
other than that the experience was great.
the seaplane was great, something we havent done before. we flew out over the golden gate and then back over the city. the views were superb and the city looked fantastic from the plane.
reccomend this over helicopter trips as the experience is unique.

I  Wanted to surprise my husband for our 25th wedding Anniversary with something to remember.He loves seaplanes!
I researched this from Australia but I couldn't find any one to oblige on the day, except for Aaron Singer of Seaplane Adventures, who went  out of  his way to accommodate  us. Normally they are closed on Tuesdays. Aaron found us a pilot Charlie,who is experienced and very knowledgeable. Aaron collected us from Pier 39, and took us to his office pointing out sights of interest on the way. The seaplane tour was absolutely fantastic. This was our third trip to San Francisco, but viewing it from above put the city in a totally different perspective.
We were so excited we couldn't open the champagne, which was part of the deal. However, we enjoyed it when we landed. 
Aaron then drove us  back to Sausalito, where we had lunch and took the ferry back.
I wanted  to  share this, because Seaplane Adventures made it happen for us. 
Thank you Aaron and your team. See you next time!
Maryann & Stephen

review_title: Amazing excursion and view of the bay!
review_text: This is a MUST do for any visitor and/or resident to the SF Bay Area.  You will not get a better view of all that SF has to offer. The staff of Seaplane Adventures was amazing and the experience was incredible.  I will most definitely plan to take all visitors to the bay on a seaplane adventure as biking over the bridge is one thing but flying over the bay is a whole different experience one should not miss.

review_title: A new, beautiful view of my home...
review_text: I have lived in SF and Marin since 1998 and have always noticed Seaplane Adventures on my 101N drive.  I finally had the opportunity to take a tour with Seaplane Adventures a couple of weeks ago and it blew my mind.  Seeing my home from this bird's eye view was really amazing.  Everyone, locals and visitors, should do this at least once.  It gives you a new perspective to Marin and San Franicsco.  The crew at Seaplane Adventures are incredibly friendly.  They did everything they could to ensure that I had a great flight.  Thank you Seaplane Adventures!  I will be back!

review_title: A Native Resident Sees the Bay Area from Thousands of Feet Above
review_text: I'm so grateful to have had this experience. If you've ever wondered why it costs so much to live in the Bay Area, take this flight and you'll quickly understand the reasons. It's breathtaking. Highly recommended!
We booked this before travelling to San Francisco ,having had a fantastic time there this trip on the seaplane was truly the highlight and an experience that will stay with us for a long time.

Last Friday, Feb 17, three of us had the most fantastic experience with Seaplane Adventures.  Very professional team, extremelly friendly, fun to be with.
It was a gorgeous day. Brian the pilot did a fantastic job taking us all over the Bay Area including a couple of times right on top of the Golden Gate bridge.
Diana, the office manager, even picked us up at Tiburon and dropped us back to get our bikes (we had been biking for 20 miles that day, we were too tired to add another 7 to get to their office).
We highly recommend to anyone. It is certainly not a cheap treat but absolutely worth every single penny.
Bravo Seaplane Adventures team!
Rubens , Michael and Tomaz.

Si vos finances le permettent, un survol de la baie en hydravion est une chance unique de voir les monuments, le golden gate bridge et la baie comme vous n'auriez jamais imaginé !

Voler en hydravion est une expérience rare, et notre pilote a été charmante : elle a fait le maximum pour tout nous montrer malgré le mauvais temps. Le personnel à l'accueil est très chaleureux et on a passé un excellent moment. L'avion est un De Havilland Beaver, confortable et très sûr. Prenez de la hauteur, cela vaut le coup !
Very knowledgeable pilot an asset to your team, friendly front office folk too! Your minimum character requirement is silly for the review!
Dan was a great pilot and very knowledgeable about the Canyonlands area we flew over. Great experience to see the landscape from above that we love.

Sucked. After the front desk lady told us our pilot would never showed up. We sat there for 40 minutes and called the number on our confirmation booking and there was no answer or anyone who came through to help us. Never coming back. We paid nearly $500 for something we didn’t even get to do because the communication sucked and no one showed up to help us when we arrived.

review_title: Must do experience while in Moab!!
review_text:
I can without a doubt say this was the highlight of our Moab trip! 
Checking in at the airport was a breeze, and our captain was so friendly. He gave us a ton of informational narration during our flight and made us feel so safe the whole time. Moab is definitely something that needs to be seen from above, as it's unique landscape made for amazing photographs and memories that I will cherish for the rest of my life. If you are in the area, I can not recommend a scenic flight with Redtail Air Adventures enough.

review_title: Flight from Moab to Salt Lake City
review_text: Super fantastic flight from Moab to Salt Lake City!  Clear skies, great pilot, smooth ride, awesome scenery, just gorgeous!
Our pilot was Michael and he was very informative! Showed us through the canyons and pointed out many arches. We really enjoyed this experience! Highly recommend.

review_title: 3-hr tour over Canyonlands and Lake Powell
review_text: Maybe the best tourist decision I've ever made.  Phenomenal experience, aided by our professional, friendly pilot, Dallon.
The most amazing adventure ever! This is a do not miss opportunity to see things no one else gets to see. Absolutely special.

Excellent flight and right on time, easy check in being no TSA out of Signature Aviation in SLC. The views were amazing along the way and the pilot was super nice and knowledgeable of the area. Definitely recommend this service and would hands down fly it again. Go give Redtail Air a try from SLC to Vernal or Moab

We had a great time and saw a bunch of things we never could have imagined seeing. Highly recommend taking going on this ride as you will see things that many others never get to see. Michael was informative, professional, and a great pilot. Thanks!

review_title: Amazing way to end the day
review_text: Our pilot was great and made the tour that much better, very knowledgeable and very friendly. We will be back to fly with them again

I've seen A LOT of this planet and this park is tops. I can not say enough. Just go see it. Period. You will not be disappointed. Every view is unique. Every hike is worthwhile. Every part is the park is worthwhile. The colors will blow your mind. For those of you that have been to Australia.... you know what I mean.

review_title: Nice view of key spots from above
review_text:
This operator was fantastic and very accommodating with some issues we had with our booking. We appreciated their understanding very much. 

Michael was our pilot and we felt very comfortable during our flight. He knew the area well and was fun. Recommend!

I used redtails twice to do the shuttle between SLC and Vernal. Pilots (Jared on one and Arthur on the other) were friendly and professional. No complaints whatsoever. Would definitely use redtails again
Fantastic. The only way to experience the full scope and variety of this amazing landscape. Well worth the money. Headphones allowed me to hear and understand the pilot's observation and commentary.

Amazing! Great company, fantastic pilot, and a spectacular ride! The weather forced a postponement to the next day. Thankfully, the pilot erred on the side of safety, and the winds were subsided in time for our flight.

This was THE BEST way to get to know Moab!  Michael provided some incredible flyovers AND great detail about the lay of the land here.  The helicopter was air conditioned (phew) and had plenty of leg room in all seats (we are tall).  Customer Service from booking to landing was superb!

review_title: Incredible view of Moab from above… Thx, Michael!!!
review_text: I can’t think of a better way to take in all of Nature’s beauty in Moab than by helicopter!!  Michael was so warm and informative. His chill and kind demeanor put our granddaughter right at ease for her first chopper ride.  The A/C cabin was greatly appreciated, too!  Overall Customer Service from booking to follow-up exceeded all expectations.
Michael was a great tour guide, very informative and overall a great pilot. Would definitely recommend and would do it again.

So NOT what was advertised. We did NOT see Arches National park! We flew over Canyonlands and Dead Horse State Park. We saw one TINY arch in Canyonlands. Really messed up that it is advertised as Arches best tour. Arthur, our pilot was sweet and gave us a smooth ride, not his fault I am sure. EXTREMELY disappointed. Save your money and do another air tour.

Happy accident finding out about this ride over the red rocks on our way into Moab! So amazing we got to experience this most beautiful part of the country this way. Thank you Redtail for taking great care of us as we oohed and aahed our way through the entire trip. "HIGHLY" recommend!
We had a great 45 min scenic flight. Instructor was ax excellent pilot and very knowledgeable about the landmarks.
Great adventure! Spectacular views of mountain snow caps & vast valleys. Highly recommend to take this flight

Many thanks to Michael our pilot. An absolutely fantastic experience. Astonishing scenery and great commentary. Have done the Grand Canyon helicopter from Las Vegas before  but this one much better as got a lot closer. Money very well spent. Once again, can‘t thank Michael enough.

Excellent experience with Michael our helicopter Pilot. It was just the two of us so we had a little 4 seater helicopter that afforded us great views across the canyons. Michael made us feel very at ease, not that we are nervous fliers. Great commentary throughout and a comfortable flight. It has to be one of the best ways to see the areas around and between Canyonlands and Estes park. Highly Recommended.

user_name: Bob taken by a corrupt Cancun cop again
review_title: I didn’t know what to expect
review_text: I would take that flight again in a heartbeat. I had no idea the Canyonlands are so remote and inaccessible. You really couldn’t see much of it at all driving so I’m so happy that I took the flight. Thanks Arthur your narrative was interesting and your piloting skills were spot on.
Super duper interesting and fun helicopter rides for our family of 4! Kids (6&9) loved it, and Michael (pilot) was very chill & informative. Highly recommended.

Professional, flexible, high-value, and talented. Redtail's entire team was wonderful and easy to work with from start to finish. Would highly recommend, and cannot wait to fly with them again. They're pilots are skilled, knowledgeable about the area, and very professional. They're shuttle and two are options are diverse and they are happy to be flexible to meet your travel needs. There is no better way to see Utah than from a redtail plane!
Helicopter Rides! Michael was great, so was Amanda!  Two great trips, both with teenagers!  Highly recommended!

Amazingly beautiful scenery. Mike, our pilot, was very friendly and knowledgeable.  I would definitely recommend.

review_title: Fantastic ride over Arches and Canyonlands

review_title: Easy and scenic way to fly

Worth the experience to see this vast wonderful landscape!!

Go…great experience!!

review_title: Fun, beautiful, highlight of our trip!
review_text: This was the highlight of our trip to Moab! Our pilot, Barb, was fun and took great care of us. My spouse was a little apprehensive about his first experience in a small plane and she put him at ease with the trip right away. Highly recommend!

I would have never paid what I did if I had been informed of this issue. I made the company aware of how disappointed and advised they inform future customers of this issue and all I received "sorry".
A unique landscape to see once in a lifetime and a great experience for the whole family! Our pilot was also a very talented guide ;-)

review_title: Great way to see Canyonlands and Arches
review_text: Our pilot was very friendly and knowledgeable. She pointed out so many interesting places. Many of the places we had heard of before but were not able to visit.
The sunset fly over was a great choice! The contrasting colors was cool to see! This flight alone has made my 6 hour trip to Moab Utah so worth it!

Having visited the Moab, Utah area many times on vacations this was a surprise for a special Birthday. I decided to surprise my wife with the Canyonlands and Arches airplane tour from Redtail Air. Not only was she surprised so was I. Unbelievable tour and a perspective that left us speechless. Great operation with top notch equipment and staff. A must!

The pilot did a great job!!!!! We were amazed at the beautiful views from above the canyons…….absolutely a must do in order to see a lot of the arches that are not visible by walking to them.A little pricey but well worth the money to see.

This pilot, Dereck, was so informative.  Made us all feel safe and easy to get adjusted in plane with headsets and seatbelts.  Views were picturesque and exciting to see where I have hiked from the top down.  Dereck showed us points of interest but then gave us time to look and enjoy the view in the moment without extra talk.  So serene.  I felt very safe and will be going on planes now at other national parks since I have now  experienced the ride.
It was the first time I had flown in a small aeroplane. I found the trip exhilarating and had great fun.  I felt up in the skies and the views were stunning.

review_title: Thanks for getting us down safely, Payton
review_text:
After seeing Arches and Canyonlands from ground level, we had an air tour to see the parks from the sky with Redtail today. Taking off from Canyonlands Field Airport north of Moab, we were able to appreciate the true extent and wonder of Canyonlands, most of which is inaccessible and you can see why from the rugged terrain seen from the air. Our pilot Payton was great at pointing out features, flying the aircraft in a way that you could see things whichever side of the aircraft you were sitting on.

It was towards the end of the flight though when she truly turned into a hero. The aircraft developed a fuel pressure issue and she had to declare a mayday. With the engine not running properly, she couldn’t make it back to the airport and we were going to have to land on one of the roads beneath us. She was professional and calm, ran through emergency checklists and managed to get the fuel pressure back up and the engine started running again. The tour was cut short by a few minutes but all onboard totally understood why and Payton got us all back safely on the ground back at Canyonlands. Thanks for getting us back down safely, Payton!

Amazing trip. Had booked this trip as a surprise for my husband's birthday.  Our pilot,  Ethan, was very knowledgeable,  highlighting various parts of the parks, dipping and turning so we could each get a view.  We also had a view of Moab on our return,  which is where we we're staying  for this trip. Highly recommend if you are in the area.

review_title: Amazing bird's-eye view of Canyonlands and Arches National Park
review_text: We made an incredibly cool flight over the Canyon area with the Arches from Moab-Utah. The pilot was very nice and told a lot about the origins of this unique area dating from the Jurrasic era. Because you fly slowly and are agile in a helicopter, we were able to see all the beautiful phenomena from the air. Very cool experience.

Highly recommend adding this to your visit to Moab.  The scenery they fly over you will never see from this angle, and some you will never see at all unless you're up for a good and long hike.  Their team is exceptional and informative along with very friendly

My son and I were traveling through Moab on our way for him to report to college. Made a last minute booking for a sunset flight, and it was absolutely amazing. Definitely an experience and memory my son won’t forget. Tracy was absolutely awesome with his piloting skills and knowledge sharing across the Moab scenery as we flew. If we ever go back will be taking another flight. The price was also perfect!! Definitely a highlight on our road trip to Nebraska!!

Spectacular trip, nice helicopter, great scenery. Michael our pilot was fantastic & had excellent knowledge of the area, flying over and pointing out all of the key landmarks.We would highly recommend the 45minute trip. Redtail  were very professional and provided excellent communication & customer service.

review_title: Amazing arches tour with the best pilot we could have asked for
review_text: Great tour, we learned so much about the arches from the pilot, got the best view, felt safe throughout the whole tour, got to take as many pictures as we wanted - just entirely a perfect experience! We could have not imagined it any better! Thank you!

What an amazing experience. Michael was personable, knowledgeable, and professional. He provided a helicopter tour that you hoped wouldn’t end. Incredible views of arches and the changing terrain while he expertly handled our chopper. The real takeaway is the perspective. You aren’t getting that from the ground. Soaring above the cliffs and arches was awe inspiring and left us with a feeling of how great and different this great land is. Truly enjoyed God’s creation.  Michael was a knowledgeable and enjoyable pilot. Thanks for a great time!!

Our sunset air tour with Barb from Redtail Air Adventures was definitely a vacation highlight!  Barb is an excellent pilot and the entire flight was smooth, from takeoff to landing.  Barb was an excellent tour guide and pointed out different landmarks during out flight and gave us the history and backstory of each as well. Worth every penny!

Service was great. Staff works with you for any questions. The pilot was great with showing us the highlights and even made sure we could see the arches. We did the canyonlands and Arches trip we were lucky enough to have the trip to ourselves

Totally incredible! Breathtaking views!!! Our pilot was personable and knowledgeable about the history of the area as well as other interesting facts.  The process was very easy.  Highly Highly recommend.

We were in Moab for only a short time and decided that doing a fly over might be the best way to see Arches National Park. Wow! Our pilot provided us with great views and information, as well as a safe and smooth flight. Well done Redtail! Rob & Becky Lovett

My wife’s first helicopter ride was a great delight for her. Michael gave us a smooth ride, and was very informative. Being in a helicopter we were able to get lower, and closer to the formations. Only regret it was only 20 minutes, but it was worth every penny.
Seeing the Utah mountains and arches from a helicopter is unbearable.  Our pilot, Michael, made us feel safe and was informative and a great guy.  Highly recommend.

We had an awesome flight around in a helicopter for an arches area tour. Michael was an awesome tour guide, he talked about all the areas of interest along our flight. Got to see a few of the awesome arches around Moab.  Thank You Michael for a great flight for our Anniversary!

Michael was a great pilot! The entire experience was breathtaking! I’ve had a helicopter tour on my bucket list for a while. So thankful this was how I checked this box! I’d recommend this to anybody! Thank you for such a lovely experience!!!
First class all the way! Outstanding staff who really strived to make our flight the memorable experience that it was!

What a great experience!  The pilot had great knowledge of the area and was so pleasant and helpful.  We had a fantastic flight, enjoyed it so much.  I would recommend Redtail helicopter tours to anyone who wants a birds eye view of the canyons and arches.  Thumbs UP!  Great flight.
This is the only way to see the park. Peyton is an awesome pilot and the views were spectacular. Don’t miss it! Worth every penny and more!
Awesome views. Flight was much calmer than expected due to the skill of our pilot. Barbara. Unforgettable
Fantastic flight low over an in the canyons. A wonderful pilot in Michael, made the trip very knowledgable as well as thrilling

We booked the Canyonland and arches plane tour with red tail. They were very professional, very friendly and gave ample photo opportunities. I would highly recommend this service for a bird's eye view of the Canyonland park which you can never get on the land!!!
Great tour, worth every penny. Such a cool view point and Michael our pilot was so nice and had great info. So glad we booked.

Such a great tour over Arches National Park.  It was great to have a bird's eye view of the hikes we did and the arches we had seen from the ground.  My niece and I were the only ones booked on this particular day so it was a private tour.  Our pilot Dan was so nice and gave us so much insight into the area.  Highly recommend!

If you are planning a trip to Moab to see the National Parks, you absolutely HAVE TO take a flight tour with Redtail. Sure the beauty of the red rocks in person are breathtaking but seeing them from above gives it all a whole new perspective! Jenny, in sales got us booked on a 30 minute flight over Arches for my daughters birthday. We showed up and checked in, staff was amazing, and friendly, made check in super easy. They gave my daughter a cute birthday bag of delicious cookies! We didnt wait long, and the Pilot, Dan, came and introduced himself, gave us some history of the airplanes and a wonderful tour. Shanna was wonderful, made our first aerial tour the best experience possible, she calmed our nerves, the pilot was very knowledgeable about the plane and scenery, gave a nice history lesson on the area, we left with smiles on our faces, we will be back. Thank you!

It was such a nice experience flying through Moab canyon lands and seeing hidden arches that are hard to see if hiking, Our pilot Dan was so amazing we loved it, 100 % recommend to do this while in Moab, is such an amazing experience

We had an amazingly wonderful time with Tracy as our pilot and Amanda as our Guest Relations guru! Make time to do a helicopter tour of the back country of canyons outside of Moab, UT. I’d say it’s a once-in-a-lifetime experience but I’m sure we’ll be back to  do another flight!
Enjoyed canyonlands emensely. From my experience with Helicopter rides this would have been preferred. The Airplane ride in June 2022 did not do the job I expected in the Arches park.

Excellent aerial tour over Canyonlands and Arches NP. Pilot was great handling plane and as tour guide. Great way to get perspectives on the parks and to see things you wouldn’t otherwise unless you hiked for several days.

review_title: Amazing escarpments and a great place to see
review_text: What an amazing way to see so much! The landscape was spectacular, and our pilot Dan was both entertaining and informative. The staff on the ground were brilliant! One of the best activities we have ever done.
Totally worth it! We had an amazing tour of Canyonlands via helicopter with pilot, Tracy. Thank you so much for an awesome tour and spectacular views! We hope to come back someday!
Lovely flight, our pilot was great, amazing scenery. Was really glad we did it and had a blue sky day
Great experience, truly one of a kind! Out Pilot Jon was friendly, skilled, enthusiastic and very professional… with a great sense of humor. Sensational part of out travels, and highly recommended!
great tour.   Amazing pictures of the area.  Easy process no waiting and we were in the air in no time.

We booked on a very short notice and the nice Redtail lady was able to get us on a heli the very next day! John our pilot was fantastic in flying and showing us all the sights. Highly recommended. Great experience

This was a spectacular trip with great narrative and photo-friendly flying by Parker.  Most tourists only get to see the beautiful "Island in the Sky" section of Canyonlands. But on this trip, we got to see the virtually inaccessible "Maze" section and the difficult to reach "Needles" section.  It is hard to believe that these three sections, separated only by the Colorado and Green rivers, could be so spectacular yet so different from each other.  We also got to see the enormous Natural Bridges that are also very difficult to reach on the ground and two arches that were big enough for the plane to fly through (but didn't).  Monument Valley from the air provides a different perspective and was also amazing.  This trip is highly recommended, and we would do it again.
Captain John was great pilot and very informative during the canyonlands helicopter tour. we highly recommend this helicopter tour and Captain John.
Tracy was a fantastic pilot. He took us on a wonderful ride over the canyon area in Moab. Very knowledgeable of the area and made sure we got good pictures.

Our Pilot of the Australian built Airplane was extremely professional, perfectly knowledgeble and very enthusiastic about her job.

Highly recomended for hikers and physically challenged alike.

review_title: Fantastic Air Tour of both Arches & Canyonlands

Highly recommend this tour! Spectacular scenery and our pilot was great - very knowledgeable and fun. This is a gorgeous area to see from the air.

review_title: An awe-inspiring way to see the parks!
review_text: This combo-flight over Canyonlands and Arches National Parks was absolutely awesome.  The view from above was fantastic and our pilot, Chris, did a great job pointing out landmarks and telling us the history and geography of the area.

review_title: Fantastic way to see the parks!

review_title: Awesome flight and tour by Chris at Redtail

What a blast...after hikiing the parks for four days, we got an entirely different perspective from the air.  Our pilot was engaging and informative.  Just super!

Highly recommend Redtail and Chris--you won't be disappointed!

review_title: We all were just stunned at the vistas that we seen and the experience of seeing the park this way loved every minute it
review_text: Seeing the park from the air like this gives you a whole different perspective of what there is and the massiveness of the park I am just so glad that we took the tour

Our pilot, Barbara, did an amazing job on our flight. She pointed out so many things we would have never seen from the ground. This was one of the coolest things we have ever done!

review_title: Flyover of parks and recreation area near Moab, Utah
review_text: My first flight in this area. The ground crew were friendly and efficient.  The pilot was exceptional and the tour was fabulous.  Would recommend this flight as a must do in Moab

Although we had to reschedule the tour to a morning due to high wind, this tour exceeds all my expectations. Canyonlands is notoriously inaccessible due to the lack of paved roads and connections between three major districts of the park. The flightseeing tour gave me the ability to see parts of the park that requires either high clearance 4x4 vehicle or hours of strenuous hiking. The view was so unique that I burnt through 100GB of storage on my camera in just 1 hour.

Today my wife and I chartered a helicopter tour through Redtail Air Adventures. Our helicopter was piloted by a young man by the name of Jon, who was exceptionally talented in his profession!! Jon, took us to so many of the areas in the Canyonland park that we were obviously unable to access by vehicle.  He explained what each site was and gave many fun facts throughout the tour. If you are in the area and are interested,  I highly recommend taking this tour with Redtail Air Adventures. Jon made our last day here in Moab most memorable!! Thank you all at Redtail!!
Cheers,
Arthur

Jon is a great pilot.   We will never forget taking off and touching down.  Such a unique experience!  We enjoyed seeing everything from a bird’s eye view.  You can’t beat seeing the arches and the winding Colorado river from up high. Such an awesome tour. We would do it again!

We really enjoyed or flight !
