We really recommand this activity

review_title: Great flight over Canyonland and arches
review_text: Although it was a cloudy, breezy day we really enjoyed our flight with Peyton today. We’d never been on such a small plane but she was confident and informative and it was amazing to see the canyons and arches from the air. Highly recommend it -

My wife and I absolutely loved our aerial tour even more than we expected. Chris, our pilot for the day did an outstanding job of managing the flight and at the same time teaching us about the geology of the area. We were totally comfortable, confident, and in awe of the views of the surroundings. I love to fly and will probably go again when we return. to Moab. Than you Jenny Gleason for bringing us to the skies over Moab

Did the Canyonlands and arches air tour today. Was fantastic. Chris, our pilot, made the tour incredible with his knowledge of the history and landmarks. It was a memorable tour and one we will do again!

I'm a Moab resident and took a tour with my out-of-state family…it was INCREDIBLE.  I highly recommend the National Parks tour, especially over Canyonlands, as you’ll see geologic features from the plane that you might never see otherwise.  Our pilot, Chris, was exceptionally knowledgeable.  We had requested the front seat for one of our party and Redtail was only too happy to accommodate (first come or ask/first served).  Thank you, Redtail!

review_title: A great way to see the parks
review_text: Our flight was great from beginning to end. Tracy was an excellent pilot with a smooth take off and landing. His commentary was also excellent as we saw many of the landmarks in Canyonlands and Arches from above.

review_title: We recommend the tour to those who want a general "vision" of Canyonlands NP
review_text: A most enjoyable way to get some grasp of the massive & impressive Canyonlands NP (as well as a quick overview of Arches NP).  Our pilot (Chris) did a pretty good job of describing what we were flying over.  As noted in other comments, he reviews a large map in the terminal with the customers before the flight; a very good idea!  Handing the customers a much smaller, but more detailed version of that map with key items shown "by the numbers" on the map, might allow customers a better idea of what is flown over.  We had taken a land tour the day before (& had driven into Moab from the south), so we had some idea about a portion of which was flown over.  On the whole, we recommend the tour to those who want a general "vision" of Canyonlands NP.  BTW: we commend Redtail for cancelling our flight May 3 (due to winds) & shifting it to May 4; safety is paramount, which Redtail staff explained fully.  NICE JOB!

review_title: SPECTACULAR VIEWS from above the Arches and Canyons.
review_text:
This was a spectacular experience. We have seen the area from  every angle and every level.  We have Kayaked and canoed down the Green River, we have driven the 4 WD White Rim Road, We have spent time hiking the Island in the Sky. Now we have seen it all from the air. We flew over Canyonlands, Natl. Park, and Arches Natl. park. The views cant be described... but it certainly puts everything into perspective.
We went on a windy day so thought it might be bumpy, it wasn’t.  Our pilot was professional and knew his plane. He knew the area, and pointed out many landmarks using the plane wingtips. We had a pretty smooth ride, and a very smooth landing for such a windy day. Highly rated experience.
Great flight, great views. the pilot was very informative and tried to get evryone a good view of the area

Flying over Canyonlands and Arches is a totally different perspective to seeing them from the ground. In particular The Mazes were amazing and something we wouldn’t have seen. Tracy our pilot made sure we saw everything we needed to see, even when we couldn’t see them first time! Couldn’t recommend Tracy and Redtail more highly.
Chris took us out for a great tour over the national parks.  He made sure we all saw the features and explained the history as well. I would highly recommend for anyone visiting Moab.

Truly the best way to see it all in a short amount of time. We had a great time. Tracey (the pilot) did am amazing job. He was extremely knowledgeable and a very capable pilot. The aircraft was clean and well maintained. I would absolutely recommend Redtail! I am also a pilot, as such please understand my trust in Tracey and Redtail’s plane come with an experienced eye.
Our pilot was fantastic.   Worth the cost !  This flight gave us a totally different view of what we saw the day before by foot.
We had an amazing flight with Ethan.  The sites we saw were incomparable!  There was no way we would have been able to see and experience the vastness of Canyonlands any other way.
We had an amazing flight with a wonderful pilot. Our pilot was very nice and very informative. The flight was beautiful filed with one in a lifetime views.

review_title: Great Scenic Tour with a Great Pilot/Guide
review_text: I liked that Chris, our pilot, showed us on a map where we would go on our plane trip before we took off. We had visited Canyonlands the day before, but we saw so much more on this  flight: many wilderness areas that were inaccessible to us any other way. It is amazing the beautiful scenery -- so many shapes and colors of rocks. Our pilot gave a good narration and pointed out things to photograph. As we flew over Arches, he also pointed out arches and gave us the chance to take pictures. Loved this tour and would highly recommend it.

review_title: Amazing Views and Very Knowledgeable Pilot/Guide
review_text: Our pilot/guide was Tracey and he was great. He provided a very detailed account of the history and geography of each area of the parks. The views were absolutely amazing. Once we got back to the airport, Tracey was happy to take multiple photos of us with the plane as well. I recommend this to anyone visiting Moab and will likely try to book the helicopter tour in the future.

My wife and I booked the sunset tour of canyon lands. The flight was approx 1hr in length. Ethan was our pilot. Our flight was aboard a Cessna 172. From the time we arrived at the small local airport, we were warmly greeted and our expectations were clearly set. We were introduced to our pilot, Ethan, who was not only more than happy any questions we had before and during our flight, but also was extremely knowledgeable of the park area, as well as Moab in general. While even the weatherman is unable to get the predictions right all the time, the weather was perfect and technically speaking, Ethan handled the plane beautifully. He clearly was extremely competent and calming. If you've never flown in a small plane before, it helps to have a pilot with a calming nature, and Ethan did a fantastic job! Even down to the smooth landing and exiting the plane, Ethan was great and even was happy to oblige with taking photos of us afterward. This was the perfect gift from my wife for our anniversary. Fantastic company, great pilot, perfect flight!

review_title: Absolutely the best value tour in all of Moab.
review_text: Redtail's tour is different than many other flight tours in other destinations because you see landmarks the moment of take off to the moment of landing.  There is so much to see in Moab and Canyon valley.  Geologic fans will have the experience of a lifetime.  And for those who toured any of the areas before or after on land, it will help put the entire region into context from an areal point of view.  Though I'd just met Tracy (sp), our pilot, that day, I felt like I was flying with someone I'd already known.  He was affable, knowledgeable and a skilled pilot.  The only drama during our flight was on the ground. I plan to recommend Redtail to anyone I know traveling to Moab.  Absolutely the best value tour in all of Moab.

We hiked the parks two days and then took the tour! The air tour was the best part of the parks. The parks took on whole new perspective! The best part of our national park vacation was Redtail! If you can't hike I highly recommend the flight!

Had an incredible flight with Redtail Air Adventures. Tracy was our pilot and he flew me and my husband from Moab to Glenwood Springs as part of an arrangement with the Rocky Mountaineer Railway. The air tour was just a fantastic experience and Tracy's enthusiasm and passion for the area was infectious. Highly recommend if you are in the area!

The weather was great and our pilot was outstanding.  This flight was a highlight of our vacation.  Our morning flight offered clear views of the canyonlands and our pilot pointed shared lots of info about the park as well as pointing out specific sights for us to see along the way. We did not  realize how many arches there were in Canyonlands. We had previously driven into the park and hiked some. But the flight gave us a unique prospective of this vast national park thanks to our terrific pilot!

What a treat! We had an amazing tour of Monument Valley & Canyonlands. Beautiful scenery and our pilot, Connor was excellent.

When we arrived we found out we were the only two for the tour that morning so we were put in a 4 seat Cessna. I thought I would be terrified of being in such a small plane but Connor made the trip very smooth. He pointed out sights and we were lucky to have little to no turbulence. I would totally recommend RedTail Air to anyone wanting to do an air tour of the area.

review_title: 90 minutes of beauty in a comfortable plane with a great pilot
review_text:
We didn't have time to tour the parks on our own, and this was a great way to see the scenery. It was fun, everyone has a window seat. You can get great photos and our guide/pilot was fun, informative and safe. 

It was well worth the price for 90 minutes of amazing scenery and views of the parks we couldn't have gotten even if we had weeks to explore! I definitely want to go back someday and explore on our own, but this was a terrific experience. 

The airport is just north of town, easy free parking, easy check in, clean restrooms.

We only had one day in Moab.  I decided to do this tour so we could see as much as possible.  Boy was that the way to go.  Our pilot, Tracy, was great.  He showed us all we expected and more.  This was such a great experience that we plan to return to the area and tour this way again!

Our pilot Tracy picked our group up on 9/11 following a rafting trip in Cataract Canyon, to take us back to Moab. The flight was beautiful and Tracy did a great job of narrating what we were seeing. As we approached Moab Airport, the crosswinds were quite significant, and Tracy did a masterful job of scoping out the possibility of landing there three different times before taking us over to an alternate airport. My husband and I are both pilots and were very impressed by Tracy's flying skills, calm communication with his passengers, and most importantly, his very wise decision not to land at Moab with the extreme crosswinds. We would fly again with him anytime - thank you, Tracy!
Loved this tour! Amazing views complimented by a hospitable staff and easy booking process. The guide was knowledgable and kept us laughing the whole time.

review_title: Put this on your Must Do list!!!
review_text: Our pilot Chris was fun and informative!!  This is a must do when visiting the Moab area!!!  It was an awesome experience!!
James was our pilot and guide, he was great. Being able to see the vastness and beauty of both Park's from the air with no long lines was incredible. I highly recommend this for adults and teens.
Absolutely incredible. The red tail tour was the best part of our trip. Our guide was knowledgeable and entertaining. This made our ground tour afterwards much richer.

I've been to Arches before, but I really SAW it for the first time today. Chris, our pilot, was informative, comfortable to be with, and made Arches and Canyonlands a whole new, incredible experience. Almost didn't do it. But it will be the story I tell for years about this trip.

review_title: Alternate way to see the Arches
review_text: It was unbearably hot the day we visited Moab (112) and we decided we didn't want to home in the Arches National Park. We found this too be a great alternative! Our pilot was an excellent resource and was able to provide us clear descriptions on what we were viewing from the sky.  We really enjoyed our flight, thanks Jackson!

If you do one air tour in your life, Arches/Canyonlands is top of the list. The scenery is stunning and the amount of flight time is perfect. If you had to design the perfect pilot for your tour, you couldn't do better than Craig. He's an A+ pilot and human being, and was a wealth of great info about the parks. The adults and teens in our family had a blast and got a whole new perspective of the arches and land we'd hiked the day before.

What a sweet treat on my birthday for my girlfriend and I to go up in the sky over Arches and Canyonlands national parks, and to learn all about the history and geology of both parks from our most excellent pilot Tracy, I certainly appreciate his attention to detail and good nature and of course his professionalism,  thank you Redtail and Tracy for the experience of a life time!

review_title: Best way to see the national park in a short time
review_text: Best way to see everything from the air especially during the twilight hour. The sun made everything more beautiful than you can image it. It was an awesome experience.
We had an amazing time!  Chris, our pilot, was great- made us feel comfortable, safe and answered all our questions.  He provided great info about the parks. Highly recommend this tour!

review_title: One of my favorite experiences in 20 years of Moab
review_text:
I'm from Utah and have been visiting Moab for over 20 years, but always from the ground. Flying over the landscape for the first time brought a life's worth of experiences into one grand image. Our pilot explained the geologic history of the landscape in a very detailed and cohesive way. The employees all seem happy and proud of their work, I even got the chance to meet the grandson of Tim Martin, a.k.a. The Arch Flying Cowboy of the Canyonlands.

Overall 6 out of 5 experience, perfect for any Moab explorer.

Fantastic views of both Arches and Canyonlands.  Our pilot, James, was wonderful and gave us lots of information about both parks during the whole flight.  We had great weather.  Great way to start our trip too.

Beautiful clear day for the 11:00 flight of 80 minutes over Canyonlands, Deadhorse Canyon and Arches with our friendly informative pilot/guide Tracey.  A quick briefing on the ground of our route and safety procedures before heading out.   We had done a helicopter tour 6 years earlier but this was longer and allowed flight  over the parks.  Glad we did it!   Suggest doing after you had seen the parks on the ground, helps understand what you are seeing from this perspective.   Loved seeing the Maze, Needles, and various arches.   Learned a lot of history, geology and exploration.   Absolutely beautiful, a splurge but well worth it and a great memory.

I had an amazing experience on my flight tour over Arches and Canyonlands. James, the pilot, was funny and knowledgable. He pointed out all of the geological features using the airplane wing to be sure we didn't miss them! 

I have visited Moab many times, but experiencing the geological formations from the air was a truly unique and memorable experience that I will never forget. The views are amazing! Thank you Redtail Air Adventures!

Highly recommend an air tour with Redtail! James, the pilot, was very knowledgable about the geography and geology of southeast Utah. Getting an overhead perspective answered many of my questions about the awesome weirdness of this area. Monument Valley by air was incredible! It definitely left an impression. 2 1/2 hours was a little long for me and would recommend the Canyonlands and Arches tour at 1 1/2 hours.

review_title: Hightlight of the trip to Moab!
review_text: I am so happy that I went with Redtail Air Adventures for my unforgettable experience in Moab! The pilot pointed out the popular places at each National Park and we found out some great local information about the area. Moab has so much history and is breathtaking! I definitely recommend choosing Redtail Air, it’s an experience I will never forget!

I was born and raised in Moab, I thought I had seen everything, until I took this flight. I have never seen beauty quite like this!!! This was life changing for me, it was my first flight I have ever taken so I was a bit nervous at first. It was an amazing experience. Craig was our pilot, he was knowledgeable, fun and explained everything in full detail. He helped make this an experience I will always remember. I definitely recommend this 👌

This experience was amazing. I have a slight fear of heights, but felt safe the entire time. Our pilot Craig was great at pointing out the different formations and giving background on the area. He even showed us where several movies were filmed! This is a way to see it all. Can't wait to do it again!

Last weekend I experienced Moab in a completely unique way. We took a private flight with Redtail Air Adventures over canyonlands and arches National parks. It’s hard to put into the words the beauty and unique way to experience moab from the air vs just hiking down below. It was truly a special experience. 
This is not your typical airport. It’s very laid back and felt safe and chill. Very easy to book and friendly staff. 

Thanks to our amazing pilot and tour guide Craig for an unforgettable experience. He was so knowledgeable and fun. We had personal headsets that we could listen to him and talk and ask questions.

This is Definitly a must do on your  bucket list in moab and shockingly affordable too!

Epic adventure! We did the Canyonlands and Arches Tour and highly recommend it. Super smooth ride and unbelievable views. Our pilot Craig was awesome. If you only have time to do one thing in Moab, do this!!t

Spectacular!!!!!! I was terrified of getting on that plane but I am so glad I did - this is one of the best things I have ever done. Seeing Moab from above was unbelievable. Our pilot, Craig, was so knowledgeable and we learned so much about this beautiful area. Recommending this trip to every person I know!

Our guide/pilot Craig was an expert on so many levels.  Never a dull moment.   It was definitely a great way to see Moab and get an overview of the vastness of the landscape and come up with future adventures. 
It was unforgettable experience.  

I wouldn't not eat a heavy meal prior.  Maybe bring some motion sickness medicine.

WOW! Today, my daughter and I took a flight to see CanyonLands and the Arches. Our pilot, Craig, was PHENOMENAL! NOT ONLY was he charming, he was incredibly knowledgeable about all aspects of the parks and sights. Our 1.5 hours was BY FAR the highlight of the week! HIGHLY RECOMMEND the entire RedTail Aviation team and ESPECIALLY CRAIG !!!

review_title: a great way to see the incredible scenery
review_text:
a great way to view a unique landscape
you will see things from a very different perspective
remember to take lots of photos
This was a great trip, beautiful scenery. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and pointed out beautiful arches and canyons. Definitely things we couldn’t have seen on our own (by foot or by Jeep).

We saved this for our last day and so happy we did.
Great way to cap off our vacation.  
Absolutely stunning views and pictures we have to last a lifetime
Tracey was our pilot and we had the plane to ourselves.
Husband was able to get great photos and I enjoyed the narrative
Was worth the price of admission!    lol

Absolutely loved this airvtourcabove Canyonlands and Arches National Parks! Everything was on time, no confusion,  and well organized.  Craig was our pilot and tour guide, and I'd definitely fly with him again.  He kept us informed every minute of the trip, and had interesting and funny back-stories that only improved the experience.  Hope one day to do the Monument Valley tour, and will absolutely go with Redtail!

To witness the magnificence of the two parks by air was truly a once lifetime experience!!  The 1 hour and 20 minute flight quite literally flew by.  One thing to see Canyonlands and Arches by foot but seeing them from this perspective was simply amazing.   Many thanks to our pilot who made this the highlight of the trip.

Amazing experience!! We ended up getting the plane to ourselves with Pilot Craig so my husband was able to sit in back and take pictures all around! I got to sit up front to get the (don't touch anything! Haha!) copilot view! I highly recommend the joint tour that includes Canyonlands as you see SO much including most things you'll never be able to drive/hike to (like you can with Arches). Lots of cool sites and arches in the Caynonlands section to photograph and view as well. Craig was nothing short of amazing! Super fun and knowledgeable. Smooth flying and just a cool, laid back guy that makes you feel comfortable. He talked through the headset throughout the trip so you didn't miss a thing and would tip the wing to point things out! It was so great! We learned so much and saw so much. We hiked a good portion of the Arches and also the Corona Arch on foot a few days prior to our air tour, so it was awesome to see those things from air. If you plan to do both (hike & air tour), I suggest you hike it first so you have that feeling of "we've been there/sat there/hiked there!" feeling from the air. I'm so glad we had the time to do this unforgettable experience! Thank you, Craig for being an amazing guide and pilot and thanks to Amanda for being so helpful in booking and organizing our trip!!

Amazing views of places in the parks you wouldn't normally see otherwise. The pilot was knowledgeable, knowing what the best sights are, their names, and some places that people can't get to without a long hike. Incredible perspectives of the Confluence between the Green and Colorado rivers, arches, canyons, and more!

review_title: RedTail, Craig and Jackie- all 5 stars
review_text:
Within 24 hours of calling we got an aerial tour of Monument Valley that also included Canyonlands and Arches and a bit of everything in-between. Our pilot, Craig, was a blast- great personality, informative, bright and never rushed. You see sites from the air that you would never see from the ground, including an arch that takes 17 hours each way to hike to. 
Craig added some extra views of Arches that weren't bargained for because... he's Craig the GREAT pilot. Jackie, who took our reservation, was also funny and charming and witty. 
It was an adventure my family will never forget.

user_name: Sharon and Mark H, West Chester Ohio
review_text: We decided to 'see' Arches & Canyonlands from above first, then explore each on foot.  Best decision ever.  There were things we couldn't get to on foot, and, seeing the vast expanse of the parks was breath - taking.  Dan, our pilot, was the best.  Smooth takeoff and landing, great knowledge of what we were looking at, and fun personality.  Highly recommend this flight!

Took this flight 9.00 today and the views were incredible, so different to seeing from the ground. The landscape can really only be fully appreciated from the air. Took in Arches, Dead Horse Point State Park, Canyonlands and highlight for me the Confluence of the Colorado and Green rivers which can only be truly seen from the air. Josh the pilot was very knowledgeable and made sure that everyone got to see all the that we were expecting and more, including Delicate Arch and many more Arches not accessible by road. Definitely one to add to anybody’s itinerary. Thanks Redtail.

Really excellent for seniors - we saw much more than we'd have seen hiking.  Unforgettable scenery. The flyover was smooth all the way and the pilot was expert, friendly, and highly knowledgeable on the history and geology of the area.

review_title: Spectacular flight for "flightseeing" over Capital Reef and Canyonlands Natl Parks
review_text:
We flew RedTail Air from Moab Utah to Bryce, about 1.5 hours in flight, four passenger plane: spectacular.  SO well worth the time to fly at five to seven thousand feet and see the canyons change literally under our feet.  Very accomplished pilot, very little turbulence, wonderful views of the Canyons.  Totally recommend with no reservations.  We had a group of slightly over twenty people so we split up into four/five planes, all from RedTail.  All pilots stayed in close communication and all did stunningly well.
For a special treat on your vacation, highly recommend this special way to view the Canyons!

Had a great guide, Frank, was very knowledgeable and took us to the many places
in the valley that I have always wanted to visit and firsthand due to seeing them on
movies, mostly westerns.   Would recommend a trip there for all.  I plan on going back soon.

It was an amazing trip with amazing views. Our pilot Larry was a joy! He was informative and professional and friendly...you are in good hands with Larry flying. Do not hesitate to book this, it is so worth it.

review_title: Great way to see the BIG picture!
review_text: After a week of every activity imaginable in Canyonlands, Arches, Deadhorse, as well as the surrounding areas, this was a great way to get a visual summary of the areas we visited and we were able to identify most sites from above!  Additionally, you can really get an idea of how truly special this particular area of the earth really is.  The geology lessons from all of our guides really came together seeing the landscape from up above, but not at commercial airliner altitude.  I highly recommend seeing the area this way.  It was fantastic.

When its 110 degrees on the ground, you can see it all from the air from 8000 ft and enjoy the cool breeze flowing through the cabin. Many views are better from the air. Plus you can see Moab, or fly out and see Castle Valley and Fisher Towers, all within a matter of minutes. So whether you're short on time, or don't want to sweat your butt off, hop in and lets go!

review_title: The best way to see Canyonlands
review_text: This was an amazing experience. Lucked out since family of 4 signed up on same day so flight didn't get cancelled. Truly incredble views and pilot was good about explaining what we were seeing. Best way to see Canyonlands since it is so vast. Not as great for Arches since you are able to get good views just by driving and arches are small from above. Also get to see Dead Horse park from above.

We were treated to a wonderful  flight back down the Colorado river, following a fantastic rafting trip with Navtec - seeing the rapids and amazing scenery that we had experienced in the boat from above was just wonderful. Modern planes and a fantastic pilot (Derek) meant we finished our trip in style.

We did an awesome 2 1/2 hour tour with pilot, Derrick, and had an awesome time. Derrick shared so much information and pointed out new sightings. We would do this again and highly recommend this tour. With all of the information shared and  Derrick’s fun personality, the time went by quickly.
Thank you Derrick!

review_title: Amazing pilot -- we flew with James
review_text: James made the whole experience amazing.  For a nervous flier, he made the flight easy to handle.  I would fly with them again for sure.

We had a wonderful experience on our Monument Valley flight! We moved to Moab last year and have driven through Canyonlands and Monument Valley by car but seeing it from the air was such a thrill!

Our pilot, James, was both professional and personable - he pointed out the confluence of the Green and Colorado Rivers, the different mountain ranges, natural bridges, arches, and rock formations down below. 

Everyone had a window seat with large viewing windows and plenty of leg room. There was also a 30 minute stop in Monument Valley to walk around and learn about the area! This tour exceeded our expectations and I would absolutely take a tour with Red Tail again.
Great and efficient tour of Arches. Craig was first rate.  He was smooth flying and kept a running dialog of interesting commentary. Highly recommend.
Matthew was an amazing pilot. We saw all the places I've been wanting to see since I was a kid, and all within a couple of hours. Would definitely recommend!
Our Pilot Matthew, was the best. Hands down.  It was such an amazing experience. #LiveLifeElevated🛸🛸

The absolute best way to see Canyonlands and Arches. There were so many things we could have never seen touring a different way. Matt, our pilot, was fantastic and knowledgeable about the area which elevated the experience.

We - a german couple (36,33) - did the scenic flight today. With three elderly US-citizens, still it felt like a private tour. Our pilot Jackson was fantastic, knew much to tell us about geology and History of the parks and sights. And he joked - made us feel very comfortable from second 1 to the end (almost 1,5 hours in the air; smooth Flight with little bumps). 
Everyone has a guaranteed window seat, left/right/front/back doesnt really matter in terms of what you see and how good you see it. Even the arches in Arches NP are easily visible because the aircraft isnt going that high (about 650/700 meters). Same for Canyonlands, the most remote spots of it: just stunning.
Jackson even showed us Fishers Tower a little outside Arches NP and Dead Horse Point near Canyonlands. So cool! 

Yeah, the trip costs quite some money (200 Euro per person). But: You will do that, you will enjoy this perspective once in a lifetime - and not just because of that fact it is worth the money.

Absolute must do. Two days ago we were lucky enough to book a trip with Redtail Air. Craig was our pilot. Extremely knowledgeable. He learned to fly in this area. His knowledge both of the region in the geology of  the region helped with the enjoyment.  And absolutely wonderful experience that you should take it vantage of.

Even though we really travel a lot, this was one of the most memorable tours we ever made. 
We booked the flight on very short notice with great support from Aimee. The flight itself was just amazing thanks to our awesome pilot Craig who shared lots of interesting information, ensured that we got the best angles to take great photographs and made sure we did not only have a good but the best possible time - it was really unforgettable and absolutely amazing. Thank you very, very much!!!

We called the day before and booked our tour to Monument Valley with Baylee.  This am we arrived and Baylee asked my wife if she would like some wrist bands to help prevent air sickness.  My wife said yes.  We then had a short wait til we met our Pilots Tom and Derrick.  After a safety briefing we were on our way over Canyonlands, Natural Bridges and other fascinating areas.  The highlight of the tour was viewing Monument Valley and then lining up the aircraft for a landing at Monument Valley Airport.  We were able to stretch our legs and visit the movie set of the cabin of John Wayne from "She wore a yellow ribbon."   The views from the airport, overlooking the Valley are etched in my mind from watching dozens of Western movies.  On the way back we visited the sights where Tom Cruise defied death at Dead Horse State Park in Mission Impossible II; and where Thelma and Louise drove their car into the Colorado River.  Tom and Derrick are true professionals.  We would enjoy flying with them again.

My dad and I went on a river trip through Cataract Canyon and our bus ride back to Moab, Utah was late and an accommodation was easily made with Redtail Air Adventures as there was a runway near where our trip ended. Matt, our pilot, was fantastic! We flew over Canyonlands National Park and Matt talked about the scenery and some of the history of the land. He expertly flew the plane even though there was quite a bit of turbulence, and was very reassuring to one of the people on board the plane as he gets motion sick easily. This is a great way to see the breathtaking scenery, and the enthusiastic and positive pilots only add to the experience.

review_title: Short on time, best way to see the sights!
review_text: My husband and I were on our way to Colorado for a wedding and had never been to Moab.  Only had part of a day to see the sights.  What a way to go!!! Excellent price, excellent service.  Craig, our pilot, gave us the best tour of the entire area. Couldn't have asked for a better way to go. Anyone wanting to see it all, book this trip.  We will go back.
everything about our experience was great or Pilot was very informative good flying great weather. We saw things we could never see in one day. I recommend this tour...

review_title: Fantastic Tour of all the must see places in one half day
review_text: My wife and I booked this tour in advance since we only had one day in the Moab area.  We were excited to discover that it is possible to see all of the biggies from the air without waiting in line to enter the Parks and driving from one to the next.  The adventure was so worth every penny we paid.  We had our own Cessna aircraft with Derrick Peterson as our pilot and guide.  He was extremely knowledgable about everything we saw (and it was a lot).  He skillfully piloted the plane to maximize our viewing opportunities at every site.  Since returning to our hotel, we are still excited about our adventure and are happy to share our memories with everyone.  We highly recommend this tour to everyone.

We had James as our pilot for an 11AM flight. My wife was particularly nervous from claustrophobia and a fear of heights. But James had a very calming personality and was an excellent pilot during take-off, the whole flight, and landing. We got great views of Arches, Canyonlands, La Salle Mountains and Colorado River. Amazing experience, and would absolutely recommend.
Craig gave us a wonderful flight over Arches National Park. He did a great job of telling/showing us the area.

review_title: Great way to see the parks
review_text: Travis was our pilot and did an awesome job of showing us the aerial view of the parks, describing what we we looking at and giving us great information about the area.  I would recommend this aerial trip to everyone.

Seeing delicate Arch from the sky was something else! We saw Landscape arch and even some rock climbers on top of these massive towers! Craig was a great blend of informative and entertaining, a fantastic guide and pilot.
It was a lot of fun, but I started to feel a bit motion sick towards the end. Very memorable though and loved seeing all the landscapes. Craig knew his stuff and was entertaining. Good activity!

review_title: Return Flight from canyonlands rafting expedition was the perfect ending
review_text: James was our pilot who flew us back to Moab after a four day camping trip with Western River Expeditions.  Great flight.  James was informative telling us what we were looking at.  A great way to end an already awesome trip.

We rafted down Cataract Canyon on a 1-day trip and took the air flight back to Moab.  Matt, our pilot took us on a memorable flight back.  He truly cared about showing us the sights from the air, letting folks on each side of the plane see, tilting the wings, planning the route, and explaining things.  These touches made our already breath-taking trip back to Moab even more memorable.  This is definitely a tour to do, as you cannot see anything close to these typeS of scenery (yes, it is quite variable during this one flight) from the air anywhere else on our planet!

review_title: Rafting trip pickup out of Hite
review_text: Excellent pilot. Had great tour over the Colorado River on our way back to Moab from a 5 day rafting trip. Joshua was a polite and informative pilot! Thanks for the amazing experience!
Visited the store today. It has a quaint atmosphere and the ladies were wonderful. The big screen tv has a running video of the helicopter ride!! Taking a ride tomorrow!!! I’m thrilled!
The retail store is so cute and the clerk was so super friendly that I bought a jacket and we’re booking a tour!!

My boyfriend & I took a flight over Arches National Park & Canyonlands.  The view was spectacular! Our pilot, Derek, was great and tried to point out the most notable sites (Thelma & Louise Point). It was a small craft that carried 3 passengers & pilot. We used the earphones to talk back & forth to the pilot. If you do anything in Utah, take the air tour!
Exceptional opportunity-very organized and very safe! Highlight of my trip to Moab. Pilot was very accommodating and images were spectacular! I’d like a return trip!

I had a great experience when I purchased a dress online from Redtail Air Adventures. There were a few hiccups to my purchase, but the level of customer service and kindness I received from working with the store manager more than made up for the hiccups. After I ordered the dress the manager quickly let me know the style of the dress had changed slightly and asked if i wanted the new style. I was too slow to respond yes, so the dress sold out. The manager emailed me about a week later to let me know the dress came back in stock! She was very kind to me when I called to reorder the dress. She made sure the dress was mailed in timely manner. The dress is so beautiful and fits well! I am very satisfied with my experience and purchase from Redtail Air Adventures.

review_title: Great way to see the parks
review_text: We took the morning flight to see Canyonland and Arches National Parks.  It was great    We we’re saying “wow” the whole trip.   Our pilot was James and he was courteous and even with a windy day kept the flight very smooth.  He showed us great views of Needles, Maze, and the river confluence.  He would tip the wings so we would get a perfect view. I would highly recommend and ask for James to be your pilot.

James our pilot was a star. Super informed on the area, it’s history and especially any matters related to geology. Highly recommend his company for an unforgettable flight after having made the trek on ground totally different perspective which should not be missed.

After an umpteenth morning visit of Dead Horse Point, I decided to go to Canyonlands field to show up at the Redtail desk. Once there there were no visitors at all and so no planned tour. The kind lady at the reception asked me if I would accept to wait 30 mn for a private flight in a Cessna 172, just my daughter and I. Of course I did. 
And Larry, our pilot and guide showed up. A experienced and very friendly person.
The flight under beautiful weather conditions was just spectacular. Seeing those landscapes I’ve been visiting from the ground so many times just worth it. We flew Arches and Castle Valley.
The ride with Larry’s commentaries was just perfect. He knows the area like his pocket.
It was a wonderful moment with great people.
The flight was smooth, safe and unforgettable.
I will do it again till Monument Valley next time!

I went on a flight tour of the Canyonlands Park  with some friends for my birthday. James was an amazing pilot and very knowledgeable about the the area. The flight was very smooth despite it being a windy day. James was great at pointing out  the geological features and landmarks. I would definitely recommend this tour for friends and families.

I signed up for the Monument Valley tour before driving to Moab from Montana. Aimee contacted me and arranged a different day which made it cheaper for me as I was traveling solo and would have had to shell out for two seats since no one else was signed up on my first choice day. That is Perfect Customer Service (and I never use the word perfect).
Larry piloted the plane I was on and was not only an excellent pilot but is extremely knowledgeable in the geology and the history of the parks and monuments of the region. He would be a good chap to talk with over a beer for the stories he can tell.
Overall, I was extremely pleased with the tour and the service I received and would not hesitate to recommend Redtail aviation to anyone visiting Moab.
Pilot had a flight to do and was not very interested in us as a costumer. Look out the window and have a great time. I would recommend the Helicopter ride next door. A much better experience.

This is a beautiful store that reminds me of Banana Republic before it became a chain. Misty, the attendant in the store was charming, knowledgable, and very helpful. Do not miss this wonderful venue in Moab!
I recently had a knee replacement and found there were trails that were very accessible for someone with health restrictions.  Beautiful is an understatement for this park.  I hope to visit again.
It was a wonderful short flight (30 min). A very different perspective. the pilot was friendly and knowledgeable. We got to see some animals fro the sky as well, which was fun.

Wow!  Had a such a fantastic flight over Arches National Park and Canyonlands that I had to take a second flight a couple weeks later!  Very professional and informative pilots - the scenery is absolutely spectacular!  Wonderful staff and beautiful unique landscape makes this the flight of a lifetime!  Do not miss this when visiting Moab!
Thanks to all of you at Red Tail Aviation!
Katherine

review_title: Fly over Canyonlands and Arches National Parks
review_text: We had a thrilling adventure flying over the Canyonlands and Arches National Park.  Not being hikers, we got to see areas of the parks that we would not have had a chance to see from just driving on the scenic roads.  Most of the 80-minute flight was in Canyonlands and included the Maze.  Our pilot, Desi, was wonderful about pointing out many geologic features, such as several arches, and flying around them so that everyone got to see them.  The plane was very comfortable and equipped with head sets.  We easily booked our tour at the Moab Airport and were able to make a reservation for early the next day which fit perfectly into our schedule.  It was well worth the money spent and a great way to see more of these beautiful parks.

review_title: Dirty windows and a RUDE pilot, made for a bad experience
review_text: 15 minute late start, pilot was rude and windows were dirty. The windows had a greasy film on them which made photography nearly impossible out the Eastside of the plane on this early morning flight.  My camera would only focus on the greasy film, see attached photo.  I had a napkin and cleaned the inside and that helped a little, but it was also on the outside and I could do nothing about that.  If you must take this flight make sure you sit on the side of the plane without the sun, as you will get better pictures through the greasy, dirty scratched windows.  Take a day raft trip down the Colorado, save yourself some money and you will enjoy it more.

review_title: Canyon Lands & Arch’s National Park Flying Tour
review_text:
Wonderful experience! 
Great pilot, service was too!
Highly recommend doing this especially for first time visitors to Moab!

review_title: Airplane tour of Canyonlands national park
review_text: THIS IS A MUST!!! A little pricey but this was our HIGHLIGHT OF OUR TRIP!!!  a stunning morning with the best pilot (Desi) who told us so much about this massive, surprisingly diverse and unimaginable terrain. The next day we drove through Dead Horse State Park and everything is put into perspective. This amazing land in the United States.  Take the time to visit, and treat yourself to this smooth birds eye view of our Canyonlands National Park.

Flying over this area is the ONLY way to truly see all the geologic formations and get a sense of the beauty and expanse of Arches, Canyonland and Dead Horse Point.  The plane was comfortable, and our pilot Andy did a great job.  He was knowledgeable about the various geologic features and provided a great tour.  He periodially checked to make sure all passengers were okay.  Landing was smooth.  That's an important feature!

Nick was my pilot. Great flight. Cool plane. Everyone was nice. I highly recommend Redtail Adventures.

-Kerry Bock

Took the Airtour over Canyonlands and Arches May 7th with Andy our Pilot. This flight is so amazing to see the Landscape from above is spectacular!Andy was so great, extremely knowledgeable and entertaining! I highly recommend anyone to treat them self to this awesome flight.Ask for Andy!He made it even better!

We so enjoyed doing some Christmas shopping in downtown Moab! And want to give a BIG shout out to Allysa Keogh for staying late and helping us pick out gifts jewelry, bags and coffee mugs.  Our family loves them! 
#shoplocal #moab #redtailair #christmas

review_title: A High Point of Our Visit to Moab
review_text: We flew with Larry who is extremely knowledgeable about the areas surrounding Moab.  Our flight went over Canyonlands and Arches National Parks, but we could see far beyond those areas.  A great way to gain perspective and to take in many of the highlights of touring Moab and the areas around Moab, especially if you are trying to take as much in as possible in a short period of time.  It was an outstanding experience - one that we will long remember.

review_title: “Great example of what a great Moab Area Tour is”
review_text: My Flight to Needles and Canyonland's was second to none. The pilot was very friendly and knowledgable. The friendly lady in the gift shop was very knowledgeable also and has answers to all of our questions.The scenery was beyond what I can put into words. The Kodiak plane was very roomy and comfortable and there was not a bad seat anywhere. Every seat has a window. I was able to see certain arches that many people never get to see as they are in some cases a 25 mile hike. The Colorado river was also beautiful as is winds through the canyon. I can't say enough about the service that Red Tail provided. You will not be sorry with Red Tail Air tours.

review_title: Perfect wrap for our Arches vacation
review_text: 3 of 5 older siblings (65-72) had a wonderful half hour in the air with Shawn... informative, funny, and a great pilot. Worth every dollar!

Wer glaubt, vom Boden aus ist das Gebiet um Moab ausreichend zu entdecken, sollte diesen Flug nicht verpassen.

Wir sind gleich morgens den ersten Flug angegangen und haben es nicht bereut. Vom Flugplatz ging es über Canyonlnds, the Maze, den Green River und Colorado und die Needles und dann über den Arches NP zurück zum Flugplatz. Die Eindrücke kann man nicht beschreiben, nicht mal die Bilder geben es ausreichend wieder...

Das Personal ist sehr freundlich und geduldig. Nach kurzem Gespräch wurde uns dieser Flug empfohlen, obwohl es nicht der teuerste ist :-)
Wir waren pünktlich da, mussten aber noch etwas warten, da man 2 Flüge angesetzt hatte und wir auf dem zweiten gebucht waren. Alles kein Problem, hier geht es gemütlich zu. Wer diesen Flug machen möchte sollte versuchen ganz nch hinten zu kommen, von dort hat man den besten Blick (ohne Streben und Auspuffschlieren).

Having come to Moab on and off for 40 years we finally tried an aerial tour last year as a great for my 79 year old dad.  It was a spectacular trip then.  So much so that dad paid for it this year.  Not that it is NOT cheap, but definitely worth doing once.

Thus year our pilot detoured out to Castle Valley and that extra 15 minutes made me feel so much better about the trip.  The left side of the plane is the best place, though you can crane over and see most of the tour from the right side.

review_title: A must do specially after visiting the parks
review_text: We did the Canyonlands and Arches flight. Larry was our pilot and his knowledge and love for the parks shows as he tells you stories and gives you information about what you see. The flight gives you a different perspective from what you see on land, plus you see many things you will not see any other way

review_title: Great way to end a visit to Moab
review_text: we visited Moab for three days, first day was spent touring Canyonlands second day Arches and the third day a flight with Redtail to see the places we had missed as well as the ones we visited, What a way to end the perfect visit !!!!!! Our pilot Josh was brilliant, gave us great commentary the whole way with a touch of humor, If you are sitting on the fence....do it you won't be sorry, these guys are great!

review_title: THE WACO Bi-Plane, Teenagers Loved This
review_text:
In an attempt to impress upon teens to consider pilots licenses in addition to driver's license, got teens out in the bi-plane with RedTail Air Adventures. The perspective from the flight amazed these kids as they flew over familiar landmarks like Gemini Bridges.

They unloaded disheveled by the wind, the girl didn't care, the tour was that fantastic.

review_title: Great overview of Arches National Park by Air
review_text: We were so lucky to get Larry, a natural born pilot and expert on all the National Parks in the area.  My husband and I toured Arches along with a Dad and his two sons.  We were made comfortable from the initial phone call to line up our flight all the way through the flight itself.  Larry even posed for a picture with us when we landed.  Larry pointed out all the points of interest in the park, the numerous arches and even named some of the movies that were filmed on some of the locations.  There is also a small gift shop with memorabilia items.

My wife and I were in Moab for several days on vacation. I had seen on Trip Advisor the Redtail Air Adventures as something to do. Our hotel in Moab helped us book our flight which was a one hour air tour for two. It is only a 15 minute drive North of Moab to the airport. We were greeted by a very friendly staff. Dan, our pilot showed us to our very comfy seats. Each seat had head phones and Dan gave us a great tour of several parks. It was amazing how much you can see from the air. No crowds, everyone has a window, and big comfy seats. It was a wonderful experience!!

09:30 du matin. Nous sortons de Jailhouse café en nous demandant "comment" visiter cette région extraordinaire qu'est MOAB. Nous passons devant une boutique de vêtement, intrigué par les ours en peluche en costume de pilote. Nous levons les yeux et nous voyons "visitez Canyonland, et les environs en avion". 378 USD. Cher mais après tout, pourquoi pas ? Nous ne reviendrons plus dans la région avant quelques années. 

1 heure de vol, de pur bonheur. Une occasion unique d'avoir une vue globale sur tout le Colorado : Cayonland, The Needle, The Maze, Island In the Sky...bref, en 1 heure, vous en verrez bien plus qu'en un mois. 

EXTRA ORDINAIRE ! 

Pas prévu au budget, aucun regret : nous ferons l'impasse sur la limousine dans Las Vegas :)

Prix final : 322,91 euros. Franchement, pourquoi se priver ???

Prachtige vlucht gemaakt met een Piper over de Cayon.
Prijs 99 dollar en daar kun het absoluut niet voor laten.
Jonge vrouwelijke pilote van 24 jaar met 7 jaar vliegervaring !!!
Zij geeft veel uitleg en het enthousiastme straalt er van af ?
We hebben genoten en het is een absolute " must do "

Awesome ride. We toured Canyonlands, Monument Valley. It was great. We rode in the 4 seater Cessna 172 with Veteran Pilot Tim, He pointed out so many things we would have never seen, arches, roads, trails, etc. We feel so lucky to have had this experience. Keep up the good work RedTail!

Nous avons réservé par interner le vol Canyonsland et Arches. USD 189.- en comparaison aux vols en hélicoptère à Grand Canyon, c'est raisonnable...
Le pilote était très sympa et a bien pris le temps de nous expliquer plein d'histoires sur les différents parcs. Le tour a pris une bonne heure. Même si vous prenez plusieurs jours en 4*4 vous n'arriverez pas à voir autant.... Le spectacle est merveilleux et si varié...
Je recommande fortement cette activité...

We went up in the air for about an hour on the Canyonlands Tour, and I'm not sure we've ever done anything as memorable. We saw the Canyonlands, Arches, and Dead Horse Point, and the view of these incredible beautiful lands from up above was so unique and beautiful, two weeks later it is still on our minds. The staff at Redtail was very polite for our booking, questions, and check-in, and our pilot was knowledgable, exciting, and really nice to us. We can't recommend Redtail enough!

Very friendly staff. Excellent, knowledgeable and friendly pilot. The 2 hour flight to Canyonlands and Monument Valley was an unforgettable experience. Far better than we expected. Good value for money!

On August 24 we had the Monument Valley tour. During a smooth and save flight we were surprised by an amazing variety of spectacular landscapes. Our pilot commented on what we saw, and she took into account that we wanted to bring back a lot of stunning photos. Full success!

We stopped into the downtown store and the store representative was fantastic!!   She helped us with merchandise and helped get us a ride to where we were going.  They have unique gifts and quality merchandise.  Would highly recommend!

Con solo qualche ora a Moab e millemila posti da vedere non c'erano molte alternative che dare un'occhiata dall'alto. L'aeroplanino su cui ci hanno imbarcato era piccolo piccolo ma la sensazione non era affatto di precarietà. Ho fatto il giro di un'ora e garantisco che è impossibile annoiarsi. Il pilota spiegava e indicava le cose più interessanti con una gioia e uno spirito e un entusiasmo indicibili. Mi ha trasmesso la voglia, se non di venire a vivere anch'io qui, almeno di trascorrervi qualche settimana lontano dal mondo. Grazie!

Nous avons pris le survol de Canyonland eT Arches (45min) réservation à la boutique sur Main Street a Moab (189€/passager)avec un accueil ultra sympathique et surprise auprès de Solange ,originaire de Rouen mais vivant depuis 40 ans aux États Unis,qui nous a bien expliqué Comment Ca se passait 
Réservation prise pour le lendemain matin avec prise en charge à Moab devant la boutique par leur service navette gratuite (chauffeur super sympa et très joyeuse),arrivée sur place avec accueil impeccable ,pilote hyper gentil très disponible,explications de sécurité puis décollage tt en douceur et la:on reste scotché tellement c magique!!!
On ne voit pas les 45 min passer avec bcp d'explications (en anglais) retour eT atterrissage tt aussi en douceur...
Si vous avez une activité à faire c à coup sûr celle ci!!! C un budget c vrai mais ça vaut vraiment le coup et vous n'aurez aucun regret!!!!alors ..décollage immédiat !!

Excellent flight, felt very safe with our pilot. 6 seater plane looked a bit scary but was fine.  Everybody had a good view. Good way to see views of Canyonlands National Park, although seeing the Arches from the ground first was good because we could spot where we had been.  Also the flight increased our interest in exploring further in an off road vehicle, if only we had the time on this trip.  We now realise that there would be plenty to see and do to fill a lifetime using Moab as a centre.

I organised this trip as a surprise for my wife (and I)

She was certainly surprised and loved it, as did I

Booking was very easy online. We arrived in good time and met Larry, our pilot and guide.

What a great guy and human being Larry is. His knowledge was vast and his passion for what he does was so apparent. Larry used to be head park ranger at Canyonlands and it shows.

The sights were mind blowing for me. Places I've seen on the TV or in magazines or on old Westerns or films

So diverse between the different locations

I'd recommend in investing in this. You will not be disappointed 

Seeing Delicate Arch from the Sky after hiking to it yesterday was fantastic too

Such a fantastic thrilling opportunity for my 13 yr old son.  The pilot was incredible, such a nice guy.  Everyone with Redtail was friendly and helpful. My son flew in the bi-plane and can't stop talking about it.   They offer regular flights and helicopter tours but the bi-plane is so unique.  Great value for such an awesome experience,  a must do in Moab!

I would really recommend this tour in Moab. I wasn't sure if 15min ride would be long enough so we booked the 30 min flight and that was just right. Seemed longer once your in the air. My son is getting his pilot license and really wanted to experience a tail-wheel plane. The pilot really showed us some sights and talked with my son about his flying experience and technical aspects of the flight. They provide good headsets to cut out the noise and being in the open cockpit is awesome. The pilot compared the engine to a harley the way it sounded when first started.

Both my son and I work in aviation. I just happened to stop in the store in Moab.  I fell in love with the amazing pictures of pilot, Tim Martin, flying through the arches. I was disappointed when the photo I wanted was not available.  The staff was super helpful in sending the photo to my home. They went above and beyond to make sure my photo arrived safe and in excellent condition.
I had a great time with Joshua, my pilot, and the others on our flight over Arches/ Canyonlands.  Ride was smooth and so interesting to see the national parks from high above.  Great time!

Amazing views of spectacular scenery. Best way to see the Maze District and the confluence of the Colorado and Green Rivers in Canyonlands National Park. Very friendly and knowledgeable pilots and staff. And experience our kids will never forget.
Excellent flight with a great pilot. Joshua was very polite and informative. We were very pleased with this experience.

I encouraged my husband to take the biplane flight/tour. I had no intention of going. My husband and the pilot Mark encouraged me to go along. The front seat holds two. I decided to share the experience and I'm so glad I did. Mark was such a great pilot and enthusiastic guide. He showed us such beautiful views of the canyons, rock spires and formations, explained special sights or industrial locations like potash ponds. He is such a good pilot I felt completely at ease after feeling this was not for me. Mark was as big a part of the special adventure as the cool plane and views were. The ground staff were really friendly and seemed as pleased about our happiness when we landed as we were. Thank you, Mark and Redtail Air Adventures.

After driving around the parks and hiking to numerous locations it was perfect to see Arches NP and Canyonlands NP from the sky. We had a great time with Desi our pilot and Preston our Co-Pilot. They were very friendly and knowledgeable of the parks. We loved that our tour took us over both parks. There were great views of the Green and Colorado Rivers, and the landscape is just awe inspiring from the air. It was just the two of us with Desi and Preston so we enjoyed a more personal tour. The plane was a bit tight for us, not a lot of wiggle room, but we did ok for the 45 minute ride. Doug had his Go-Pro videoing out his window and I had my camera pointed out my window, clicking pictures like crazy! It was fun! The tour is well worth it!

We had a great time on this adventure! Flew with another couple, and the four of us fit well into a small 7 seater plane. Tim was our pilot and guide, a great guy with tons of experience and stories, and a great host. We flew over Arches and Canyonlands and loved every  minute of it. Would recommend this highly, especially if you want to see a lot more than you could hiking.

We had an amazing time seeing Canyonlands and Arches from the sky with our fabulous tour guide and pilot, Tim Martin.  He is a very accomplished pilot and an interesting man.  Tim is the epitome of a gentleman.  It was a great way to end our vacation time in Moab.

Visited on our way to Moab. When we arrived they had finished their days scheduled flights. We did ask if it was possible to do a private flight just for two of us. The lady at reception said she would go and find a pilot and ask. Happy days, she came back with a yes. For just $26 each more than a regular flight. It was great. We had a full hours flight wit a pilot & narrator over the Canyonlands & Arches parks. Saw far more than we could have ever seen on the ground in a week. Highly recommended.

review_title: Incredible views but update your headsets
review_text:
We wanted to do the biplane, but it was unavailable so we chose the small plane instead which was perfect for our family. Very informative and fun. We got to hike the parks the day before, then view them from above. 

Dress warmly, can be cold up there. 

My only suggestion is to have headsets for the folks in the back that have mikes so can ask questions. Most other planes have those but this didn't and it made asking questions of the pilot impossible. Also the quality of the headsets was not great (some static, hard to hear). But with views like these, who need to hear anything?

I wanted to gift my boyfriend with something out of the ordinary for his 29th birthday. Collectively, we both dabble in photography and an aerial shoot has been on our list for quite some time, so I thought why not check it out. We did the canyonlands and arches tour and has the best time! Our pilot, Dan, was extremely insightful and shared tons of stories as we flew over the landscape. We could genuinely tell that Dan had a passion for flying and sharing that passion with others.

Loved the experience and would recommend to others!

review_title: Great end to an amazing day!
review_text: Used Redtail to get us from Hite Marina at Lake Powell back to Moab UT.  What a great flight over some of the most impressive views found anywhere in the world! l Loved seeing the mighty Colorado below!  The pilot had a great knowledge of all the monuments and pointed out some things I hadn't known before about the area.  Thanks RedTail !!!

Amazing plane ride!  We were a bit cautious arriving at the small local airport.  When we met our pilot, Larry, all fears were put at ease.   He was amazing!   Great tour guide and even better pilot!   Loved every minute in the air!  Highly recommend this tour!

review_title: Perfect start to an amazing vacay
review_text: Can't say enough great things about our flight with Bronson and Steve, our pilot and guide who soared us over Canyonland and Arches with precision, information and wonderful personalities. We did happen to have the perfect morning making it all that more spectacular. Many thanks and worth every penny.

Thank you Red Tail and pilot Nick for the a memorable flight in the Waco! My son, 21 years old, and I took this flight in the morning after we had spent the day before hiking Arches NP. This was a bucket list adventure for us. Great views, outstanding & friendly people, safe, and breathtaking views. Don't think twice about booking a flight on the Waco.

We had flight over Arches, Canyonlands, the Henry's and a lot more. Trip lasted about 2.5 hrs but it went so quick as we were thoroughly enjoying it. Our pilot was Dan and he was excellent with the history and information. We would recommend this with a big, big thumbs up. Easy to book with helpful staff. Well worth the money.

We chose the 2.5 hour tour and are so glad we did. Dan our pilot was a wealth of information and even took a personal request to fly over our resort (Red Cliff's Lodge and the "Thelma and Louise" cliff jump area) It was great seeing so very much from UT to NV to AZ and even a quick stop mid way. Who knew there was an airport strip in the middle of nowhere. LUVED it - worth the price and then some!

Fantastic beautiful flight over 2 of Utah's excellent parks. Pilot was great- friendly, knowledgeable, experienced. The trip was everything we hoped full. Red tail should bring back their flight over all 5 parks in Utah with lunch in the Grand Canyons area. I would come back to Moab for this trip.

review_title: Smooth flight, new plane, nice pilot
review_text: Larry, our pilot, was very nice and a good story-teller. While flying around in Canyonlands & Arches NP, he told us very interesting facts and commented the landscape. I could only recommend Redtail air adventures if you want to get a glance of the National Parks from above.

review_title: Superb air tour of Canyonlands and Arches National Parks
review_text: The three major factors in an air tour are the airplane, the pilot and the scenery. Redtail Air Adventures tour of the Canyonlands and Arches National Parks as well as the confluence of the Green and Colorado Rivers was absolutely top notch in all three respects.  Because there were 9 passengers, we flew in a new looking Quest Kodiak which is  a turbine powered high wing monoplane offering great visibility to all seats.  Jerry, our pilot, was a retired Park Ranger from the area and not only knew the best sites but, more importantly, how to guide viewers eyes to them.  The scenery was spectacular,  three vastly different topographies created by different geological phenomena.  The tour went very quickly; we were always looking at a new feature until it was time to land.  I'd do it again in a heartbeat.

Nous avons réservé le vol d'une heure et nous sommes rentrés même plus tard tellement le pilote était passionné et avec le désir de nous montrer le plus de chose possible.
Ca a été une expérience inoubliable car sans le vol nous n'avions pas le temps de voir Maze et Needles, tellement beaux mais difficilement accessibles. En plus, de revoir les Arches et le Canyonlands mais cette fois d'en haut vous donne vraiment la vision globale de ces paysages magnifiques et tellement étendus.

Une merveille à faire sans hésiter.

Um einen Eindruck zu erhalten buchten wir an Ort einen Rundflug über die Parks. Dan war nicht nur ein sehr guter Pilot sondern auch ein hervorragender Guide, der den Flug mit fundierten Informationen zu einem unvergesslichen Erlebnis machte.
Great way to see the parks.  The pilot was personable and knowledgeable.  We were able to fly through the clouds.

This flight was amazing. Arches and Canyonlands is amazing on the ground, but from the air it is crazy wild! I highly recommend this flight; it was just the right amount of time-50 minutes. My husband and I were very impressed. The pilot, sorry forgot your name, was very informative. I'd do it again in a heart beat. Thanks for the great adventure! Colleen S./Custer, WI

review_title: An unsurpassed opportunity to see Canyonlands and Arches National Parks!
review_text:
The breathtaking sights of Canyonlands and Arches are revealed from the air in a manner not possible from the ground. The 50-minute (actually one hour) flight was smooth (the 9:00 AM flight - before the land heats the air causing turbulence) and expertly narrated in a low-key manner by our pilot - an extremely knowledgable fellow who is a wealth of hiking, biking, off-road lore, in addition of course to his extensive knowledge of the geologic history, rock formations and the causes of the paths of the Colorado and Green Rivers.

I rate this a must-see as its cost is reasonable and the experience exceptional.

This company is very well organized and its employees are professional and customer-focused. We took the 9:00 Arches-Canyonlands air tour, 50 minutes, in a beautiful Kodiak turbo-prop seating 8-9, all window seats for great viewing. Our pilot Dave was exceptional in both his flying skills and as a guide describing features, geology, and human history of the area. Our flight was the high point of our visit to the area and we highly recommend seeing these parks by air with Redtail.  With high visitor volumes at Arches and Canyonlands, and resulting traffic congestion challenges, we found seeing the parks by air a serene, stress-free and beautiful experience.

This 30 minute flight over Arches National Park exceeded our expectations! 
Knowledgeable & experienced pilot, beautiful scenery and a wish come true.
Perfect day, perfect location and perfect price.

With Larry we had an excellent guide and pilot for our flight around the Canyonlands and the Arches National Park. It was impressive and comfortable at the same time to see the previously visited places again from the air. And finally the Redtail Air had a great surprise for us (we were on our honeymoon). Thanks Larry and thank you to the team :)

Highly recommended !!!!!!!!!!!  The flight was very pleasant with an awesome view of Canyonland and Arches National Parks.  The pilot pointed out the areas of interest while flying.  He was constantly making sure the guest were comfortable and could see the scenery.

review_title: Great way to see it all!
review_text: Highly enjoyed this excursion! I took the Canyonlands/Arches hour tour at 9am, I was solo. Several planes go out and typically the planes take 4 or 5 total. We had a wonderful pilot Kim who enjoys what he does and it shows. The cabin was comfortable and everyone gets a window seat. Views were fantastic and I enjoyed the overview and stories that the pilot discussed in detail. I think the price was spot on for this one of a kind experience. Also, I happened to book my flight on the opening day of their retail store on Main Street, it had very neat items that are unique and a ton aviation related. So I recommend the flight and retail store, it was an all around memorable trip!

review_title: A great way to see this beautiful part of the country by air before you see it by land
review_text: This is a well organized group that provides a great excursion by air to see all the wonderful places you are seeing on the ground.  Their staff are courteous and well informed and their aircraft are safe, well maintained and expertly piloted.

review_title: Well worth the price! Excellent way to become oriented to the area!
review_text: We flew on the Arches/Canyonlands scenic tour our first day in Moab in order to get oriented with all the sights the Moab area had to offer. The flight was an excellent way to get this done, as opposed to driving which would have taken much longer. Our pilot was friendly and very knowledgeable with the area. Well worth the price and a unique experience for our kids.

Organisation parfaite et vol à couper le souffle. Notre pilote, Dave, est un excellent cicérone!
À faire absolument!

Extremely happy with our trip. The pilot was very personable and intimately knowledgable about the geology of the area. His enthusiasm and love for the place and  job was obvious and made it all the more enjoyable. Best to get the photographer in your family on the correct side of the plane ( in our case the Left) to make sure you catch the 'must see' features.
We had a excellent flight over Canyonlands and arces national park. Everything was great. We planed the trip a view months ago and the organization was great.

We flew from our adventure in Maze District back to Moab and oh my...what an awesome experience!! The plane picked us up at a landing strip in the middle of nowhere (Angel Point). The pilot was VERY kind and described the terrain the whole way back. This was my first flight in a small plane like that and I was thrilled!! The ride was smooth and the scenery beyond belief!! I was completely impressed!!

Dan was a very knowledgeable guide of the canyon lands and arches area.  Would recommend the hour flight as it takes you to more varied terrain. Dan was an skilled pilot especially taking off and landing in the cross winds

Well worth the money spent. We took the Arches Canyonland combo, and it was a breathtaking experience. Our pilot was friendly, informative, and very personable. We were traveling by motorcylce, and most of Canyonlands is not accessible unless on foot or 4x4, so the aerial tour let us see things the majority of travelers never get to see. If you are travelling on a budget, splurge just a bit, you will not be disappointed!

Been to Moab several times, Canyon lands and arches are spectacular from the ground, just wait till you see them from the air. Not knowing if we will do this again we went for the three hour flight to see it all .
Our pilot is an expert on all the geology and history, so many facts.

We enjoyed a terrific morning tour over the Moab area. When we arrived at the airport the morning of the flight, the gentleman at the desk was very accommodating and friendly while answering our questions while we decided to take the flight. Our pilot was very personable and knowledgable as he spoke about the beautiful land as we flew over it. A plane ride is invaluable over this area as it is impossible to see all there is to see and learn about it all unless one has a four wheel drive, boat, fees for all the parks, and an HUGE amount of time to get to all of the places we went in just an hour!

After driving, hiking & cycling Arches, Canyonlands & Deadhorse Point parks, we then flew over the area with Redtail Aviation.  What an incredible aerial tour of the parks, with amazing views.  Our pilot was very knowledgeable of all of the areas.  From the staff checking us in at the airport right up until we left, everyone was super friendly & helpful.

review_title: Fantastic View of Arches National Park
review_text: My son and I took the air tour on the last day of our vacation in Moab, the day after we had been hiking in the national park.  We both agreed that the air tour was an excellent way to end the vacation.  Our pilot/tour guide was retired from the National Park Service, so he was very knowledgeable.  He was also friendly and provided a great deal of information on the park, the community and the area.  We took our cameras on the tour and got some great aerial pictures of the arches and the other features in the park.  The plane ride itself was very smooth, considering the plane was a four passenger model.  I would really recommend taking this tour if you want a bird's-eye view of the park.

The best part of our whole trip! Must get Matt as your pilot. He was an amazing pilot with an amazing personality. The ride was smooth and he was full of knowledge. Took us to beautiful places. I was with my 76 yr old dad and 8 yr old daughter. They had the best time. My 8 yr old keeps talking about her experience and how she wants to do it again. I feel the same way!!

We loved our scenic flight over Arches National Park.  Tim is a great pilot and pointed out many highlights and shared background info.  We took the driving tour of Arches in the afternoon and it was neat to see from the ground after having the aerial perspective.  It was a lot of fun and Tim did a great job!
We had an amazing flight. The pilot, was very professional and informative. Thanks for an unforgettable experience.

This tour was fantastic. Our pilot, Dave, was exceptional. He was very knowledgeable about all aspects of the parks and surrounding areas. My wife and I agree that this tour exceeded our expectations many times over. The office staff was very friendly and helpful. It is a must do for anyone wanting to see southeastern Utah from a totally different perspective. Thanks Dave for an unforgettable experience.

review_title: Flight over Canyonlands National Park and Arches National Park
review_text: We had an excellent flying experience.  Our pilot, Bronson, was very professional and informative.  We enjoyed our flight very much.

We were so lucky to walk on Main Street and find the store where you could reserve a ride.  We were amazed by the cost and jumped at the chance to go on this once in a lifetime trip.  Dan was a great pilot and provided us all the information  that we needed.  I would recommend this to anyone who wants to get an air view of the Canyon Land National Park.  I think it is the best way to understand the geology.

Wow, seeing the National Parks from the air is a must! It was breath-taking. 
Redtail staff were very friendly and informative.  Our pilot was very experienced.  
Great flight.

review_title: Totally different and amazing way to see Canyonlands
review_text: We went on the 50m Canyonlands/Arches flight on a pefect clear morning. Words cant describe the view. Gives you a whole new appreciation for the parks. Our pilots were great and gave a very thorough briefing and description of the flight, plus a very informative commentary throughout. We have done lots of hiking in the parks, but this flight really completed the visit. Perfect.

review_title: See Arches and Canyonlands National Parks in 90 minutes
review_text: How clearly we "got the picture" of both Parks in a 90 minute flight piloted by Larry, of Red Tail Aviation.  He explained the various parts of the Parks in a most engaging way with a sense of humor in the Kodiak aircraft.  From this flight we had more of a concept of what we wanted to visit during our stay at Moab, Utah. After spending time hiking the Moab National Parks and jet boating the Colorado River, we had the ultimate experience with Redtail Aviation.

From the time we entered the terminal we dealt with professional, friendly, and caring people.  Our pilot was able to relate the human as well as the geological history of the areas we saw.  His local experience  on the ground as well as in the air made the trip special as he related his and his families history in the area.

The trip took us over the areas of Canyonlands NP not available for easy viewing from the ground.  Much of the CNP we saw is only available by air or long treks by foot or OHV's.  The perspective from the air was especially dramatic through "The Maze" area and "The Needles" area.  

The flight took us over areas of rugged country with history of ancient Indian civilizations, outlaws and modern day movies.  More importantly was the natural history dating back millions of years.

I took a couple of hundred photos with Tim (our pilot) pointing out the highlights as we approached them.  Tim was great for positioning the plane for the best chance of getting photos of the arches, canyons, buttes, and other wonders we saw on the flight.

The trip to Monument Valley added miles and miles of canyon and river country as well as the Valley seen in so many famous movies.

review_title: Air tour over Canyonlands and Monument Valley, Utah and Arizona
review_text:

We circled Anasazi ruins he has explored, numerous natural arches, canyons and high desert, as well as the spectacular buttes in Monument Valley, providing an intimate look at this 
remarkable area.  We flew for 2.5 Hours in a comfortable Cessna with another couple, thoroughly entertained and educated by Matt, who knows the history, geology and anthropology of this very diverse wonderland. Redtail Aviation gave us a world class experience at a very fair price. Thanks
