review_title: Well worth your time, Amazing Views
review_text: My father and I took the one hour Canyonlands flight. WE ABSOLUTLY LOVED IT!! If you are ever in Moab, I HIGHLY RECCOMMEND you splurge on a scenic flight from Redtail Avation. Our pilot today was Jim, Arch Enemy #1. Jim took the time to learn everyone's name and made appoint of using our names throughout the flight to draw our attention to the amazing rock features. he made us feel like it was a personal tour of the park. The flight was bumpy due to high winds but Jim had great control of the plane. spectacular views! He took us all over the park, including the parts nor assessable by car which are rarely seen. Jim shared great stories about flying a tiny plane through some of the larger rock arches in the area and knew the names of everything. I will definitely do this again!!!!

I have no idea why Redtail Aviation is rated only #24 out of 51 activities in Moab!!  It should be rated higher than that.  This was one of the best outings that I have done in this area, and one of the best outings that I have done anywhere!  Their prices are competitive and they have fliers everywhere so it can't be the advertising.  Regardless, I did the Monument Valley tour in late August 2015 and it was absolutely incredible.  I lived and worked in northeast Arizona in the Four Corners area for years and traveled the area extensively, so it was fantastic to be able to see it from the air, in an entirely different perspective.  I've done jeep tours in Monument Valley, plus hiked the Wildcat Trail around the left mitten.  The aerial view was great!  We also went over Canyonlands National Park (Island in the Sky, the Maze, and Needles), Dark Canyon, Cedar Mesa, Natural Bridges National Monument, the Goosenecks, Valley of the Gods, the Moqui Dugway.  I've been to all of these areas as well, except for Dark Canyon.  The day was great, except a little hazy, but considering that a storm front had gone through just the day before when I was in Arches National Park, the weather was wonderful!  Plus there was little to no turbulence.  My pilot was Kim and he was excellent!  He was very safety conscious, very knowledgeable and just plain pleasant during the trip.  Since I had lived in the area for so many years I was actually able to teach and show him a few things!  All in all, it was a fantastic trip and I would not hesitate to recommend it to anyone!  I plan to do this again in the future!

We took the tour when staying in Moab because we were interested in seeing Canyonlands, which is not easily accessible by car (and certainly not easily traversable). We were very please we did it because the views were superb. We took the extended tour, which included Arches and although we had explored this at ground level in some detail it was nevertheless interesting to experience the aerial views as well. The pilot was knowledgeable and added interesting stories and was very good at pointing things out. A couple of points though: the planes are small (ours was a five seater) so expect a bumpy ride - there are sick bags to hand; there is very limited leg room - if you are tall it could be uncomfortable; and the headphones are a bit crackly and need adjustment - so best to do this before the commentary starts. In terms of taking pictures, some seats are better than others because of obstruction by the wings. MY wife was OK, despite the turbulence but I was feeling a little queasy - but would not have missed the experience. I would have put this down as a must do when in Moab. The airport is around 16 miles north of Moab so one needs to allow time to get there - some of the flights start fairly early e.g. 08:30. We had a slight wait for a passenger who failed to turn up - just as well as we are not sure where he would have sat! As space is very limited it is best to leave all that you can in the car - camera and water only for the plane!

review_title: THE way to see Canyonlands National Park
review_text: My wife and I did a short 2 night, 3 day stay in Moab, primarily to see Arches National Park.  On our last day before heading to Salt Lake, we decided to take a quick peek at one or two outlooks in Canyonlands National Park before heading out.  Almost on a whim, my wife called Redtail to see if they were flying that morning (the day before, they told us they would not be due to weather, but the weather was actually beautiful that morning).  They said they would take us out at 9:30 (we would have missed the standard 9:00 scheduled flight, so it was perfect).  We checked in and shortly met Kim, our pilot and guide.  He gave us a quick overview of what we would be seeing, went over the standard safety items, and off we went in a tiny, 4 seat, single-engine plane.  We were provided headphones to allow us to talk to each other and hear Kim's narrative.  My wife sat next to Kim and I had the back seat to myself.  If one of you is the photographer, be sure and get the back seat if you can have it to yourself.   I was able to slide from side to side to shoot out of both sides.  The seat is only about 3 1/2 feet wide.  The views were spectacular!  Kim added fascinating facts about the geology and the history of what we were seeing, such as pointing our where Butch Cassidy used to hide out between robberies and the point where Thelma and Louise launched their famous last flight in the movie of the same name.  The only caution I would offer is that the small plane is naturally a bit bumpy, so if anyone is prone to motion sickness, take something beforehand.  My wife actually is, and didn't take anything, but made it through without incident.  Both of us felt a slight twinge of queasiness post flight.  That said, we would highly recommend Redtail and Kim.  The flight we took lasted about an hour, and we STILL had time to take in a couple of outlooks from the ground, which offered a great contrast in the two views.

Working with Redtail Aviation was fantastic. Period.  Their service is impeccable!  I was planning a trip for my boss (he needed to charter a flight from Salt Lake City to Moab) and Cindi at Redtail saved my life!  Everything was super easy, and they were very accommodating. I'd recommend to anyone.

review_text: I called the number at 7:30 Saturday night, 2/21. I received the call-waiting beep and left a message with "Iris" of my need for a chartered flight to Provo and my mobile phone number. I immediately called back, and heard call-waiting beep again. I showered and called again 10 minutes later - guess what? Ya, call-waiting beep. 2 hours later I called Iris back and asked "What kind of business are you running here?" She said she had tried to call me back and it went immediately to voicemail; however, I never received one. When I drove through Moab (55 miles later), she told me she had no planes or pilots available. Horrible possible customer service!

review_title: The pilot learned about flight merely 30 min before the take-off time
review_text:
Just before Christmas I booked a Canyonlands tour for December 31, 2014 flying out of Moab. On the day of the tour, I arrived in the Moab airport promptly at 8:45am, 15 minutes before the schedulled time as told by Jessica (staff member based in Price, UT). I found no one at the Redtail counter. There was a couple already waiting for the flight as well. 

We waited for 25 minutes before the pilot showed up at 9:10. He apologized for being late and told us that he had just been notified about the scheduled flight (’30 minutes ago’ - his words). Of course, he needed time to get the plane out of the hangar and get it ready for the flight, which took another 30 minutes. Finally, we took off at 9:50am, nearly an hour behind the schedule.
While the other couple seemed to be OK with that delay and didn’t care, it made a big difference for me. I am a landscape photographer. December 31 started with a beautiful sunrise. I commenced my morning at the field taking advantage of perfect light after three days of overcast. Although I had to end my photo session very soon and rush to the airport, I was excited in my anticipation to start shooting the bird-eye views at 9am when the light was still good for landscape photography.

In reality, I had to stay in the airport for about an hour desperately watching precious light fading off and giving its way to a huge cloud stretching through the sky and covering more than a half of it. As a result, about one-half of our flight time was not suitable for taking professional pictures. 

Had the pilot been promptly notified about the scheduled flight, the tour would have started at 9am when the weather was great.

I don’t know whose responsibility was to inform the pilot about the tour and why that staff member failed to do that.

Despite this experience, I want to give credit to Larry, the pilot, who was very friendly, knowledgeable about the area and passionate about his job. The low rating I am giving to the company is not about Larry's service (he performed his job at a high standard) but rather about Redtail's logistics and responsibility.

After finishing our three day rafting trip through Cataract canyon we had arranged to fly back to Moab instead of driving. What a flight ! All three of us have flown many times in bigger airplanes but never in a four seater. Our pilot, Kim, immediately put us at ease with his relaxed, competent, knowledgable and professional style. All along the way back he pointed out the various and amazing landmarks and made the flight a truly memoriable experience.

review_title: Wonderful tour of Canyonlands and adjacent area
review_text: We totally enjoyed our two-hour flight over Canyonlands and immediate areas.  Our pilot, George, was very informative about the areas we were viewing, history and geological information about them, special sites, the altitudes at which we were flying and general information about the plane (A Cessna 210).

review_title: Enjoyed a great flight over Canyonlands
review_text:
A short drive to Moab airport from town and we climbed into a Cessna 210 with our pilot and another couple from Ohio. My husband Bob, a pilot, was able to sit right seat. 
We enjoyed the amazing views that were available during our 1+hr flight over Canyonlands, seeing the Green and Colorado Rivers, Dead Horse Point, many arches that would have been totally inaccessible from a car or any of the roads down below us. We flew at about 1500 feet about the terrain making viewing just awesome!  The pilot was good enough to give us some history, geological info and circle us around for better photographic shots.
We were SO glad that we booked this air tour! Worth every penny!

review_title: Terrific flight over Bryce, Zion, Kolob and Coral Sands
review_text:
Shane flew over from Moab and picked 3 of us up in Kanab for a 1 hour flight over the Grand Staircase (Bryce, Zion, Kolob, Coral Sands).  It was a fabulous start to my 11 days in the area.  Shane chose a great route, and we got terrific views of the area.  I think it only is possible to realize the scale of this landscape from the air.
Note:  I connected with another couple to share the flight because they left their name at the Visitor's Center in Kanab.  So if you would like to share a flight, be sure to tell a visitor's center in the area!

review_title: Survol du parc national Canyonlands avec Kim
review_text:
Réalisé dans le cadre d'un circuit dans le sud-ouest des Etats-Unis, ce survol de Canyonlands était formidable, le paysage est à couper le souffle, et pour ne rien gâcher, le personnel est très sympathique. Kim nous a donné plein d'informations durant le vol, qui était particulièrement limpide, dans un Cessna 207.
Merci à Kim pour cette super expérience !

While waiting for our plane, we left a cell phone on the rocks by Lake Powell.  After an incredible airplane ride with a great guide over the Canyonlands we arrived in Moab and discovered the phone missing.  Kim, one of the pilots, went back to the site later in the day and retrieved the phone!!!  We had all our pictures from our 5 day trip in Canyonlands on there and of course all the other contacts and personal information!  Thank you Redtail Avaiation and Kim!!

review_title: Unique perspective of a unique area
review_text:
Between all the hiking and driving we were doing in the area, plus the fact I've happened to fly (very high) over this area in a commercial airliner, I wasn't sure how necessary a cost this was.  But I fully recommend it.

We did the Canyonlands + Arches trip.  The Canyonlands portion was the main course, with great views over all three areas of the park.  The plane is low & slow enough to give lots of time to take it all in.  Being in a four-seat Cessna (including the pilot) was a new experience.  The Arches portion was not nearly as spectacular, but it doesn't add very much cost or time if you're doing Canyonlands.

My husband and I took a 2 hour scenic flight from Moab to Lake Powell and back in early October.  We were the only 2 people on the tour in the 4 seater plane.  We were outfitted with headphones and mic's (due to the engine noise of this little airplane) and then off we went.  Our Pilot, George, made the trip very memorable.  What a different vantage point of Canyonlands, the La Sals, Lake Powell and Capital Reef!  Absolutely breathtaking!  George pointed out indian ruins, gave geologic history, and we followed the Colorado River just above the canyon rim on the way back!

Redtail Aviation is the only company permitted to fly over and into Canyonlands and Arches NP.
  It is an expensive excursion, but if you've visited Moab many times, this is a must.  You will not be disappointed.

On a recent mountain bike vacation I took a day off from biking to get a  lesson in mountain flying. I walked into Redtail Aviation and was able to get a lesson with George. As a low-time pilot, I was able to do all of the flying from the left seat. We flew down the Green River and did a practice approach on a dirt strip by the river. This experience was very different from the flying I've done on the East Coast. George was a great tour guide, giving me the historical highlights of the area. Aside from my first solo flight, this was definitely the coolest flying I've ever done! Thanks George!

review_title: The only way to see Canyonlands!
review_text: This was an awesome tour! Canyonlands National Park is very large and diverse, so the best way to see it is by air. The plane we were in held 6 passengers which was a perfect size. Also, everyone gets a window seat to ensure you get to see all the wonders if the park. Our pilot, Kim, was a very skilled pilot and knew the area well. We saw many amazing arches, many different landscapes, and learned more about the area. We would recommend this tour to everyone coming to Canyonlands!

We had a great day with our pilot Kim for this 2 hour roundflight.
We saw all the things we have seen before at ground level.
And Kim was an absolutly nice guy.

If you don't do a roundflight like this, you have missed something.

review_title: No Place on Earth Better to Learn to Fly
review_text:
Southeast Utah (Moab) is a gateway to some of the most spectacular Canyons, Riverways, & High Country in the World.  

I took my first flight instruction on June 25th and passed my check ride on the 26th of September.  RedTail Aviation employs several instructor pilots each with their own unique approach to instruction.  Kim Ruble was my main instructor during this time with a good measure of George Martell.  Each instructor has their own unique way of teaching the art of flying.  Beyond these two gentleman the entire staff of RedTail was in my corner sharing tidbits and insights from thousands of hours of flying.  The training went well beyond the maneuvers for an FAA check ride, it included emergency landings on soft fields and other skills that provide me confidence in the event of emergencies.

I learned to fly over a land so beautiful and inspiring that I will forever feel an inner peace when I recall the sights.  Life is very good.  RedTail operates with this philosophy.  I have made friends for life and highly recommend them to anyone.

Redtail Aviation helped me complete training for my Private Pilot certificate. My Redtail flight instructor, Kim, took great care in teaching me to be a safe pilot, in addition to helping me prepare for my FAA check ride. Kim teaches "real world flying", and I had the opportunity to learn back-country airstrip operations and mountain flying from him. Not only is Kim an excellent instructor, he is also very knowledgeable about the Moab back-country and gives an excellent tour. Our cross-country training flights were peppered with little tidbits about the country we were flying and the training experience was made that much more memorable because of it.

I can't end this review without mentioning the rest of the Redtail pilots and staff. As a whole they are courteous and friendly and they worked hard to accommodate me when needed. I recommend Redtail if you're coming to Moab to sightsee, need air transport into the back-country, or want some mountain flight instruction.

review_title: Fabulous plane tour by Redtail Aviation
review_text: Our plane tour of Arches and Canyonlands with Redtail Aviation was unbelievablle! Kim, our pilot, was the best.  He clearly loves what he does, and loves to share the joy and beauty of the area. We could see parts of Canyonlands (unavailable by car or vista points) that were out of this world! It was such a worthwhile trip!  I can't recommend Kim and his plane tours highly enough!

As a 650 hr private pilot (UK)
I booked a two hour flight in a Cessna 172 with Redtail and flew (in the left hand seat) with CFI Kim as safety pilot/guide/navigator/radio operator and had a great experience from arrival to departure. My girlfriend and I were given a warm greeting by Misty on reception and introduced to 3,500 hour CFI Kim who guided me through the most amazing scenery I have ever flown over and, bravely talked me through landings at Angel Point (dirt strip) and Hite airfields (landings I would not have attempted single handed). 
My girlfriend acted as ariel photographer in the back of the a/c and we both had a fabulous experience. Many thanks Kim, for your guidance, humour and confidence you placed in me. This flight exceeded any and all expectations.
Congratulations to Redtail Aviation, you helped make a great vacation totally excellent.
Richard and Paulene

In early September this year we booked a "grand tour" with REDTAIL AVIATION which took us via Capitol Reef, Lake Powell and Canyonlands for a wonderful 2-hour airtour. It was worth every cent we spent on it, and we would like to mention especially our pilot KIM, who proved to be a true expert on the areas we covered. He took care we had a wonderful afternoon getting to know Canyonlands from the air. Thank you Kim!
Karin Bitz & Fred Klinge from Germany.

We took a flight with George in May.  His knowledge of the area made the trip even more enjoyable.  We saw The Needles, Island in the Sky, Dead Horse Point and the confluence of the rivers.  Seeing all this beauty from the sky is spectacular.  George is awesome.  Thanks for your fabulous customer service and the awesome trip. I would recommend this scenic trip to anyone wanting a different perspective of this beautiful country.  Thanks again!   Steve & Dianne

review_title: Great flight, great explanations, great pilot!
review_text:
Many thanks Jim Collins for a wonderful sunset flight. Both Bernard and I really enjoyed it and you gave us a real thrill visiting all those beautiful sights.
best regards to all and has the other pilot found any patches to sew on a jacket?

Nous avons effectué un survol de Canyonlands
Nos étions 2 dans l'avion
Super expérience avec George! Il nous a donné beaucoup d'explications sur canyonlands
Personnel très accueillant
Merci pour cette superbe expérience!!

We had a beautiful morning for a scenic flight over the Canyonlands NP.
Jim @Red Tail Aviation took great care of us and did a great job showing us the sites in the Cessna .  He also did a good job narrating the tour, which made it even more interesting.  I would highly recommend this tour.  Talented experienced pilot, well maintained aircraft and they treat customers well.  The scenery is outstanding.

My daughter and I went flying for my annual birthday flight. I went to school for aviation and haven't flown in years so we took an instructor with us. Kim was fantastic. He has a great personality and showed us around the Maze and Needles districts of Canyonlands National Park as well as Arches National park. It was incredible to see all the sights from above. Thanks Kim and Redtail Aviation for a great birthday flight!

We´re just back from the canyonlands-tour early this morning. Although we´ve already seen islands in the sky and the needles on a previous road-trip it´s a different and very intense experience to see this area from the sky. Especially as you can see the landscape changing several times during the flight.

Kim, our pilot, is a very friendly guy and very supportive, showing flight route upfront on a map and explaining the landscape during flight. 

Even on a day like today with mostly overcast sky this is a once-in-a-lifetime experience. Be sure not to miss it !
Kim was an excellent entertaining pilot and made the flight from the end of Cataract Canyon to Moab fantastic.  Would recommend to anyone.

review_title: Survol de Canyonlands avec Jim Collins, que du bonheur !
review_text: J'étais à Moab pour 3 jours avec mon mari et nos 2 ados. C'était notre premier vol en sesna ! Nous avons eu la chance de l'avoir pour nous 4 et grâce à notre pilote, Jim Collins, nous avons eu le plaisir de découvrir le parc national de Canyonlands vu du ciel.  A nous les Mesa et les Needles que nous n'aurions jamais pu voir sans cela tellement ce parc est vaste. Jim a été tout simplement extra ! Plein d'humour quand je stressais un peu. La qualité de son pilotage (un décollage et un atterrissage hors pair), de ses explications et de son élocution (anglais bien articulé, sans accent et pas trop rapide) nous ont permis de tout saisir et surtout de savourer un maximum ce merveilleux moment. Que du bonheur !

Après contact le lundi 18 août dans l'après-midi, le rendez-vous est pris pour le mardi 19 a 8h30. Bravo pour la reactivite. Après une présentation sur une carte du vol que nous allons faire, nous décollons avec Jim Collins aux commandes. Pilotage tout en douceur, et les explications de ce que nous survolons sont courtes mais vraiment précises. Nous avons profité de ce décor merveilleux. Quant à l'atterrissage nous ne nous sommes même pas rendu compte que nous roulions déjà sur la piste. Très bon souvenir.
Perfect flint with Chip, who made sure we saw all the sights, it really is a different experience from the air. Great pilot, great trip.

review_title: The only way to see the scale of this beautiful landscape.
review_text:
Sightseeing trip in a single engine Cessner. An 8 seater plane, but our party of four was on our own on the day with Chip the pilot. An amazing journey, which puts into much better context the sheer scale of the sights you see on the ground in this part of Utah. We flew over Canyonlands, Dead Horse Point and the Needles.  However, visiting the Needles Overlook a couple of days later made us realise just how little you see of it all from the road and view points, compared to this aerial trip. Fascinating to see the confluence of the Green and Colorado Rivers and the different colour shades of the two rivers as they converge.

Visibility from the plane was very good, and the ride was very smooth, on the day. Chip, the pilot, explained everything and the plane is also equipped to take a video, which he is sending us, to save us the trouble of taking photos constantly, although the sheer beauty of the sights meant the camera was still much in use.

A trip not to be missed if possible.

Flights go from the Moab airfield which is only about a half an hour or so from Moab itself

After 4 days on the Colorado River with Moab Adventure Center (which was amazing), we returned from Lake Powell to Moab in a 7 seat plane and George as our pilot.  It was the perfect end to a great trip.  We flew over the Colorado and George pointed out all the highlights of the area, as well as let us know everything that was going on with the flight.  We landed in Moab 45 minutes later and enjoyed every aspect of it.  Thanks George!

review_title: The best moment of our road-trip !!!
review_text:
We've been flying with Chip and we've chosen the 1h Canyonland flight in the morning. It was GORGEOUS !!!
Chip was very helpful during the flight with many explanations on the landscape creation.
My familly and I will always remember this amazing view !!!
Laurent

Das was ein ausgezeichneter Rundflug über Maze, Needels und Highlands in the Sky (Canyonlands) mit dem Piloten Chip. Wir hatten immer ein sicheres Gefühl. Es wurde viel erklärt und wir haben noch mehr gesehn.

review_title: Excellent Flight with Kim from Redtail
review_text: I just did a return flight with pilot Kim of Redtail, flying from Lake Powell to Moab. It was a great flight, professionally handled by Kim, who also served as a wonderful tour guide as we flew over the incredible Canyonlands and surrounding landscape. I felt totally safe and thoroughly enjoyed the trip.

Great flight, great pilot.  The aircraft was comfortable and we had some nice conditions.  Our group was very happy and took lots of photos.  Smiles all around. Staff was accommodating and friendly.  Thanks to our pilot, Chip, who pointed out the various landmarks and took the time to answer all questions. Will be back again for sure.  Blue skies and red rocks...  A fine experience.

    A hui ho...

We flew withRedtail Aviation from their airport in Price, UT into Tavaputs Ranch for breakfast. The view were amazing, Pilot Kim is a very experienced pilot and very personable. This was a perfect trip. Tavaputs Ranch has cabins and sleeping arrangements for up to 30 visitors. The combination of flying into this Ranch along with the exceptional hospitality at Tavaputs should be on everyone's bucket list!  It is Hawaii in Utah! This is also great for a couple get away, girls weekend, men's getaway, family getaway.

review_title: Flight from Lake Powell to Moab after Rafting
review_text: After a fun-filled, tiring day on the Colorado through Cataract Canyon, the flight back to the Moab airport with Chip was the icing on the cake! Chip was very professional, providing preflight details and setting expectations our group, to include two teens. Once safely in the air, he was very informative regarding the local terrain as we passed over many of the sights we rafted by earlier in the day. Highly recommend the flight back to Moab from Lake Powell!

Took our return trip back to Moab from Lake Powell after 4 days of rafting on the Colorado through Cataract Canyon. George was our pilot and was very friendly, professional, and knowledgeable about the area! Awesome views from above after experiencing it from the River!!!

An excellent flight to Monument Valley with our pilot Chip. Good orientation briefing before the flight. Chip was very good with a nervous flyer in our party. He ensured all passengers saw the major landscape features on both sides of the plane. On our flight the air was very clear which meant taking even more photographs and video than anticipated. We were keen on landscape features and Chip provided very good detailed commentary as well as giving us time to photograph / video features.
A superb experience.

review_title: Flight up river for a rafting trip
review_text: We flew with Kim from Redtail up to the launch point for our Green river rafting trip. This particular morning was quite challenging in terms of the weather conditions and the extreme crosswinds made it impossible to land and made for quite a bumpy ride. I appreciated Kim's extensive experience in flying that helped keep us safe, and he exercised the appropriate amount of caution and decided that it was best to turn back and not to try and force ourselves into a dangerous situation. We turned back to Canyonlands airport, and after the weather had cleared we flew back up there and had a perfectly smooth landing. Kim is a great pilot and made sure that we stayed safe even when Mother Nature wasn't being agreeable. Thanks!

Great way to see the area. We did the 1hr Canyonlands trip which was fantastic. Our pilot Chip was very good pointing out specific sights and features.
Redtail are very obliging and will tailor a flight to suit your requirements.
As well as taking loads of pictures we purchased a SD video of the flight which was very reasonable and a great keepsake.
Thanks again redtail and particularly Chip.

Took the Monument Valley tour, with Matt the pilot and George along for the ride.

I seldom use the word 'awesome', but really there is no other word to describe the experience (and even that does not cover it!).

The outward and inward flights cover Canyonlands so that tour is not needed. There is so much more to see as you travel to Monument Valley, my camera did not rest and my jaw remained firmly dropped. We took in two of the Natural Bridges and many canyons As the conditions were favourable we landed in Monument Valley - we did not expect that! Here we looked around a hogan, where Lucy showed us how she spun wool for the blanket she was making. There was even an air conditioned restroom. The flight around the buttes was incredible, seeing them from all angles.

On the return we flew over the San Juan Goosenecks and the Colorado meanders. We paid a little extra and took in Arches NP on the way back to the airfield. Saying that we saw many other arches in the area that are normally difficult to reach overland.

I cannot praise Matt highly enough; he genuinely enjoys his job (mind you who wouldn't!) and his knowledge of the area is encyclopaedic. He took us in for close views of many Anasazi settlements tucked away in the canyons and knew the names of them all!

I completely recommend Redtail Aviation the most professional and friendly run outfit you could hope to meet.

We took the one hour trip over the Canyonlands and it is a wondrous and spectacular way to see this glorious landscape. So grateful that Redtail Aviation went out of their way to book a flight for us. It was a spur of the moment last minute idea and can't imagine if we hadn't been able to see it. Because it was so last-minute we were unable to make the reservation through a local outfitter. But calling them directly they responded and were very accommodating. Kim, our pilot, was not only an excellent aviator but also an excellent guide continuously pointing out features, canyons, rivers... Fantastic!

review_title: Amazing way to see canyon lands!
review_text: Canyonlands by air over the 4th of July?! AMAZING. Chip is the coolest pilot ever! We flew with a family from France and the couples daughter was in a wheelchair. They made her feel right and home and she had a blast flying! We purchased an hd video of the flight and that was worth every penny. I can't say enough good things about the way we were treated and the experience. Thanks Chip and Redtail Aviation for making our stay one of the most memorable trips ever!!!

review_title: The Only Way to See Arches and Canyonlands
review_text: If you're at all nervous about flying in small aircraft, my advice would be to just get over it, or you're going to miss an an unbelievable experience. We took the Arches and Canyonlands combination flight a little over a week ago, and I'm still coming to grips with the views. PIctures just don't do it justice. Our pilot, Kim, was great, and the descriptions and overview flight were a great way to plan out what you might want to spend more time seeing from the ground. This was  a great thing to do at the start of visit to the Moab area. Redtail was full of nice people, and made the whole experience memorable from start to finish.

review_title: A Great Conclusion to Our Time in Moab
review_text: After traveling to Gemini Bridges, Cable Arch, Pucker Pass, up and down the Colorado River, Arches NP and Canyon Lands with the family, we spent the last morning on a one hour flight over every place we had visited.  As it was the summer, we took off a 8am to avoid the turbulence.  After the flight, we hit the road for Zion.  It was a great way to say goodbye.
Chip, our pilot, was very knowledgable and gave us an excellent tour! We loved seeing the area around Moab by air.

Chip did a marvelous job of giving us a tour of Canyonlands from the air.  Everyone at Redtail were very cordial and did all they could to serve us.  This is the best way to preview all the features of Canyonlands.

Today one of my bucket list items became a reality. Thanks to the people at Redtail Aviation and particularly Kim Ruble I was able to for fill a dream of mine to fly to Mexican Mountain airstrip and landed there. Thanks to the great instructions from Kim I was able to land there by myself and do the take off again. I am a student pilot and learned a lot today. I will definitely come back when I am in the area again and do something similar. It was awesome. Thanks Stefan Schoeman
Beautiful flight from Lake Powell to Moab.  Our pilot, Chip was great, pointing out interesting landmarks. Thanks!

I just received great service from Gary and Mike at Redtail Aviation.  While flying my P210 from Salt Lake City (KSLC) to Canyonlands Field (KCNY) the pilot's door latch let go and would not allow the door to latch.  Within minutes of landing my plane was in the shop and repaired.  Now when I leave for a return to CA I can fly in comfort pressurized.  Great guys and great service!

Thank you,

Joe Graziano

There is absolutly no better way to see the Canyonlands. It is such an awesome sight from the air. If you want to see the CanyonLands you have to do it from the air. Our pilot "Chip" was knowledgeable, helpful and friendly. I would recommend the flight to anybody.
Fred L. Minker

Redtail Aviation does various tours, we booked the 1 hour Bryce canyon tour from the UK before traveling to USA on a hectic sightseeing holiday. Three of us were going together & our agenda was continually changing but Jennifer at Redtail Aviation could not have been more helpful and understanding. We eventually decided on 9:00 am tour, from Kanab airfield on Saturday, May 17th and were given full, easy instructions on where to go etc & were informed that their pilots were "awesome"!
We were in Kanab the previous day so went to the airfield to familiarize ourselves with the layout - Kanab airfield is small so no problems. We saw a guy at the "terminal building" and he introduced himself as Mark Francis, said that he would be our pilot next day & explained to us what to expect.
We arrived at the airfield early next morning. The plane can take 5 passengers but there was just the 3 of us so after safety instructions etc off we went! The take off, flight & landing were smooth (my wife & brother-in-law were both nervous but soon relaxed), the scenery was amazing and Mark, the pilot, was cheerful & informative and made the tour so much more memorable!
This was a "once in a lifetime" experience for us & we really enjoyed it so thanks to Redtail Aviation, particularly Jennifer & Mark. Highly recommended!

review_title: Flight over Bryce and Zion Parks
review_text: We booked the Combo tour over Bryce Canyon and Zion Park. Although we had visited both parks on the ground we wanted to see them from the air.  Shane took us from the airfield at Kanab on a fabulous tour of both areas. The early evening flight made the most of the light and Shane made sure we all had excellent views of everything including the Coral Dunes between the two sites.  We had no idea how extensive the vast systems of cliffs, plateaux and river valleys were. This was truly eye-opening (and jaw-dropping) as an experience, and I would love to do it again.

We took the scenic flight from Moab to Monument Valley and return.  The weather was perfect.  Jim was our pilot and on this trip he had another pilot that he was training as to what route to take on this tour.  They both knew the area well.  They wee very good at pointing out the many scenic places in Canyonlands, Goosenecks S.P., and other places.  I feel that both pilots should go to Monument Valley and spend a day there so that they know what Monument Valley is all about, other than great scenery.  Other than that, it was a very good trip.

Netter Pilot, guter Flug - leider wegen den extremen Winden etwas holprig.
Das Flugzeug selbst ist etwas in die Jahre gekommen. Eine Scheibe, leider gerade unsere, wurde irgendwann ausgetauscht und trübe, die Fotos daher nicht so gut.

There is no way to experience Canyonlands National Park that is more comprehensive, picturesque, or outright thrilling than a scenic flight. From take off to landing, I was completely absorbed in the experience, like watching an incredible movie, the rest of the world melted away as we flew over the 3 districts of Canyonlands. It was fun spotting familier landmarks like Corona Arch and various points of interests through Island in the Sky as well as flying over (personally) uncharted territory. It was a great way to see the Maze, which is the least visited and most difficult section of Canyonlands to explore. Our pilot, Nick, was everything you could ask for in a guide. He was personable yet professional, humorous yet informative, easy-going yet experienced, and most of all, fun. We had a great flight!

review_title: My 17 year old son loved it
review_text: I visited Zion and Arches national parks with my son, and while in Zion, I decided to schedule a flight for him over Canyonlands park. He took over 200 pictures out of the copilot seat in the Cessna 172 he flew in. The pilot, Dave, knew a lot about the area and told a lot about the American history and the formation of the different structures. The hour long flight was paced very well.
This is a rad way to get a real understanding of the land surrounding Moab.  Also, Dave, our pilot, was competent, knowledgeable, and entertaining.

review_title: Best view of geologic wonders! Ask for pilot Dave.
review_text: Amazing view of geologic wonders. To get an idea of the scope and variety of this unique area you must see it from the air. Pilot Dave was wonderful explaining the vistas, pointing out famous locations and answering questions. Smooth low flying flight. Stunning!

review_title: Great early morning flight for photographers
review_text:
My friend Joe and I booked a sunrise flight for some early light aerial photography.  We had a clear morning and our pilot, Kim, was very responsive to our needs.  Being very familiar with the area, I was able to direct him on a very specific itinerary but he also knows the area like the back of his hand and made many valuable suggestions along the way.  We spent 2.2 hours in the air and I came back with 3,061 RAW images.  Granted, I shot a lot on high continuous but still....

We flew from Canyonlands Field over the Maze section of the National Park, down the Green River to the confluence with the Colorado and then to the Needles area of the park.  We circled many  iconic shots, like Angel Arch in order to get the perfect vantage point and light.  Then back up the river, past Dead Horse Point, the potash mines, over "Behind the Rocks" area, across Moab Valley  to Castle Valley, Fisher Tower, Arches NP and back to the airfield.  Kim would fly as high or low as desired with a few Park restrictions.

I would highly recommend this for anybody interested in an aerial view of the very unique geology of the area and especially for photographers.  But for photographers, nothing beats the sunrise flight.  And of course, the flight can be customized to your liking for time and destinations.

This is the second time I have taken a flight with Redtail Aviation. The first time almost five years ago, they were really accommodating taking us out at 6:30 AM, as we had to leave the area that morning.  The flight over Canyonlands was amazing and the pilot was great - knowledgeable, funny and eager to have us see everything. We came back in May this year with my son. We decided to add Arches to the trip. Again it was great, although the portion over Arches was not nearly as spectacular as Canyonlands and a bit of an anticlimax. It was nice, but not essential and I would recommend saving your money. In fairness, they actually warned me about this, but I figured "What the heck. My son will never be with me again. So let's go all out." Make no mistake, flights are expensive, wherever they are, particularly when four people are on the flight. However, they have produced some of the memorable experiences of all the many trips we have taken and I don't regret a single one of them. Canyonlands, especially Canyonlands, is one of the places where a flight will really add to you appreciation of how wondrous nature can be and it is also, like many places, the only way to see many parts of it, except through hiking where almost no one but the most fanatical would attempt. So if you can afford it, by all means, do it and I have absolutely no hesitation to recommend Redtail. They will treat you right.

review_title: Every visitor to Canyonlands should do it this way
review_text: When we decided to visit this area, and after reviewing park maps- we chose to pay the price for an airplane tour over Canyon lands.  There is just too much park and too few roads to really get a good look any other way. Made reservations a few days before-easy peasy- showed up at the appointed time. Our pilot and guide, Nick, was very personable, professional, and easy to be around. Made the writer(me) comfortable about my first ever flight on a small plane. showed us the route he would be flying on a topo map so we would have some idea of where we were. Plane was comfortable- Nicks take off and landing were smoother than any commercial flight I've been on. The trip was incredible- showed us all the major tourist attractions- the day was clear, and calm and wonderful. Well worth every dollar we paid to take this flight. Highly recommend this way of seeing the Canyon lands.

If you want to really see the great canyon lands, I strongly recommend taking a scenic plane ride with Redtail Aviation.  It is jaw dropping scenery in a low flying plane - you have to see it to believe it.  Our pilot, Larry was very knowledgable about the geography and history of Utah.  Our one hour flight was an absolute thrill!

La question que l'on s'est posée : hélicoptère ou avion ? Et au départ de : Las Vegas, Phenix, Page, Moab ? Bref, notre choix se porte sur un tour en avion au départ de Moab, pour un survol de Monument Valley en avion. Pourtant partis en plein été, on s'attendait à la foule des grands jours. Mais arrivés à l'aéroport (distant d'une vingtaine de km de notre motel à Moab), nous constatons que tout semble calme. L'aéroport (très petit) permet de s'y retrouver très rapidement, et nous n'avons que quelques mètres a faire pour trouver l'enseigne de Redtail. Nous prenons rdv pour le lendemain matin (avec un départ avancé d'une heure à cause de la chaleur). Le lendemain matin, à l'heure, notre pilote Jim nous accueille et nous montre sur la carte notre itinéraire. Le pilote est très sympa, il tentera de nous donner toutes les explications durant le vol. L'avion est un petit coucou et nous ne sommes que 3 à l'intérieur (pilote compris). Peu confortable (mais est ce là le principal), nous avons bénéficié d'un temps exceptionnel pour nos 2 heures de vol. Jim n'a pas hésiter à faire un petit survol supplémentaire d'une zone que l'on voulait photographier. Durant le vol, JIM a ouvert une fenetre pour que l'on puisse photographié sans etre gené par le reflet de la vitre. Bref, pas tres confortable, mais la vue était exceptionnelle ! Peut etre un peu cher, mais 2 heures d'avion ça coute quand meme... Globalement, on très content de cette expérience.

This was the most special part of our trip to Canyonlands, Arches,and Dead Horse Point!!! Such a great experience! Shane was a great pilot, and tour guide!!! The views were spectacular!!! Though we drove and hiked to many sights...this, by far, was tops!

review_title: Fly to Monument Valley from Moab
review_text:
We arranged a scenic air tour from Canyonland Air Field, Moab, to Monument Valley. The round trip flight took two hours, the flight and panorama were awesome.   We flew over Canyonlands on our way to Monument Valley, we saw the junction of the Colorado and Green River.  The colours and sheer size of this place is incredible. The topography slowly changes as you fly south from canyons to buttes.  The colour changes are also incredible.  We flew at about 1000 - 1200 feet between the buttes when we got to Monument Valley.  We did not land at Gouldings Trading Post as we thought we would,  we were advised by the Pilot that our schedule would not allow for this to happen.  We booked and paid for our air fares through one of the companies in Moab that arranges a lot of different tours.  The reason we booked through a third party company was because their website stated that their trip to Monument Valley included a landing at Goulding's Trading Post. I was a little put out when we found out that we would not be landing at Gouldings from the Redtail Pilot.  I do not blame Redail Aviation for this, however I do blame the tour company who advertises that a landing a Gouldings Trading Post forms part of the scenic air tour.  If you are thinking or flying to Monument  Valley I would deal  direct with Retail Aviation.  

Make sure you take  an early flight say 9am, as it is a smoother flight in the morning than the afternoon.
