He even turned the helicopter from side to side to allow everyone in the helicopter a view of the scenery.  The secluded landing zone was beautifully maintained and allowed many opportunities for photographs.    I would highly recommend this company to anyone.

I’ve been on other helicopter flights in Maui before, however this one that lands in the rain forest where nobody has access to by foot was by far the best experience I’ve ever had. I say it’s a must do in every persons life. Also the pilot was very knowledgeable at the history of the rain forest where a King used to live.

We had a wonderful tour with our Pilot, Rick R. Rick was an excellent pilot and an extremely knowledgeable tour guide! The views were absolutely stunning and Rick ensured each person on the chopper was able capture the amazing views. Highly recommend Maverick Tours!
Do to weather they could not go over the rainforest but gave us an amazing alternative. The pilot was amazing and very kind. Will book again if the opportunity arises

Everything was as advertised or better.  Took my daughter for a tour and was the highlight of our trip.  I suggest a tour with a landing, if you are able.  We landed in the rainforest, drank champagne, walked along streams and beautiful plants, the took off again and finished the tour.  Tone was an excellent pilot and tour guide; very knowledgable.  Highly recommend!
Very happy with the entire experience and staff. The equipment is Top notch. Our pilot Jake was a great guy, He made it even more enjoyable.
What a great start to our Hawaii trip! We were able to experience a Halo Rainbow and overall amazing views of Maui. We loved it!
The Pilot Felix was amazing.  He took the time to really tell us some history and some great info about the island.

review_title: Maverick Helicopters: "...been there, got the t-shirt..."
review_text: I have taken a helicopter ride (except during the covid-19 shutdown) on nearly every visit to the islands since 1975. That is 102 visits to date. Of all those flights over the years, the Hana Rainforest Helicopter Flight with Landing in Maui was the best by far!!! The pilot was exceptional, and his narrative was both accurate and on point. Maverick Helicopters purchased 90 acres of land so remote that it is too dangerous to walk in by foot, except by the most skilled of hikers. There are fruit trees, a landing space, and a stream running through the valley floor on the Maverick property. While at the landing, passengers are offered champagne. After returning to the field, I was so impressed with the trip, I bought a t-shirt. For me, there is true veracity in the statement, "...been there, got the t-shirt..."

Felix our pilot was awesome as was the whole crew at Maverick 
We would recommend and use Maverick again
Rainforest tour was so beautiful. It’s a must see.
Wonderful experience. Saw multiple waterfalls. Landing in the middle of the forest was surreal. Pilot was well seasoned and kept the helicopter steady and the passengers entertained.
It was so amazing, incredible views and exploring the rainforest was so cool! Our pilot Aaron was super knowledgeable and funny! Great experience

review_title: Don’t miss out on this awesome ride it’s nothing like riding in an airplane so much smoother and more fun!!!
review_text: It was our favorite experience so far! Felix was an excellent tour guide and we enjoyed every minute of it! Our favorite on our list of things to do in Maui so far! Would definitely recommend!
Thought we would see more of scenery. Too much time spent on ground in rain Forrest looking at plants
Tone was a great pilot. Very knowledgeable of Maui Island. We talked about the microclimate, road to Hana. Excellent experience.

The trip was great! The pilot was informative and we loved his playlist!
Great way to see the Hana rain forest.
Jake was awesome. Had a great time!  He was very knowledgeable. Put us all at ease. Would recommend to everyone. Thank you!

It was a gorgeous day out so there was little to no chop in the sky. The stop in the rainforest was pleasant & refreshing.
Our pilot was extremely knowledgeable. Would recommend 10/10.

The Hana Rainforest Helicopter Flight was an absolutely AWESOME experience. It started with check in. I read that the max number of passengers was 7, and counting all the people, I realized that we were at 14  so I figured we would be split into 2 groups. I was so pleasantly suprised that we were split into 3 groups! Our flight had one other couple so it was very intimate. We sat in the front, then changed seats after the rainforest landing so all of us had the chance to be in front. 
This was my first time on a helicopter and I was a little nervous.  I had no reason to worry! The pilot, Tone, covered all the safety info, and take off and flight were all smooth.  The views were stunning and being able to see areas that you cannot access by land was great! The landing in the rainforest was beautiful. Champagne was served and we were able to walk around. Tone was full of information, both in flight and in the rainforest. He answered all questions and gave background and history of the island and the area.  Totally worth the money and I would recommend it 100%.

As someone with severe fear of heights and flying in general, I was hesitant to try a helicopter ride, but thanks to Captain Jake - I was put at ease and felt extremely safe and in very capable hands. Jake happens to be from Colorado, where our party was from, and so we made our first all Colorado flight into the rainforest of Maui. The scenery is breathtaking, and truly can only be experienced in a helicopter. I highly recommend this trip - the price is worth this once in a lifetime experience!

This was our first helicopter ride and I thought the service was professional, safe, and the helicopter was spacious and in great condition. This ride is a bit on the short side, but was perfect for us for a first ride. The photographer took a great photo of us that we kept as a keepsake. I highly recommend!
Wonderful experience from start to finish. Our pilot, Aaron, made us feel comfortable and was very knowledgeable.  It was an unforgettable experience.

review_title: Do this trip…you’ll never regret it!  AMAZING!
review_text: This was the highlight of an amazing nine-day trip to Maui.  This trip really has it all.  Seeing the shoreline/cliffs while buzzing over the ocean…whirring above the rainforest tree tops…exceptionally cool landing in the valley…interesting learning from a very knowledgeable pilot both on the ground and airborne…and views that will last you a lifetime.  Worth every single penny without question.   Highly professional experience.   Oh…and if you think you’re scared of heights…relax and enjoy this experience.  This is a complete joy!  Thanks Maverick!!

The entire staff was incredible! Aaron made the flight alot of fun. Got good pictures of whales on the Hana side of the island. The scenery was amazing on a beautiful day. What a way to wrap up a trip to Maui. Will definitely do this again
Outstanding service. Very safe. Our family felt very safe on their helicopter’s. Amazing pilots. Highly recommend them.

So professional, clean, informative, safe, super fun- the champagne was not only an awesome touch it was actually delicious! Landing in the rainforest to explore was phenomenal! It was muddy, but they had wet towelettes!!! I’m afraid of heights but I did it and it was amazing, I felt very comfortable with the pilot! The turns were a little scary but so fun!!!!

We loved our captain, Rick, and the rainforest landing was unique! It's not ideal that as a family of four, you can't have your own helicopter--my party was placed all in the back row of the helicopter, without the same wonderful views as the front (and for the same price). Plus, you're technically inside with two other people, which is not ideal for COVID-19, but at least everyone was masked. Rick had interesting commentary while we were flying and even found some wild fruit for us at the rainforest stop off. :)

Excellent customer service from beginning to end. Our pilot, Felix, was extremely professional, competent and lots of fun. He explained every step of the safety procedures and was a great tour guide, answering questions and he knew every detail of the areas we flew over. Landing in the rainforest was so much fun, and the spot where we landed was like the Garden of Eden. I loved the Awapuhi plant and the lovely moisturizer it produces! We snacked on bananas and toasted with champagne. This was the trip of a lifetime for me as I have a fear of flying and I am now over it!!!

Shout out to Rick Rickauscus, our Maverick helicopter pilot! This trip was amazing, in fact it was probably our favorite thing in Maui. I have a fear of flying but normally it’s a necessary evil to getting places, however I did not share this before our flight. From the tone of his voice to his playlist of music he was able to soothe any nerves. He explained all the places of interest below and would explain anything he did beforehand..such as turning us around to provide additional photo ops, and this was truly the smoothest ride you could possibly imagine. The landing In the rainforest was again incredible and if he had been balancing a cup of coffee on the dash it would not have splashed or spilled a drop. On landing he proceeded to pour everyone a glass of champagne and lead us on a tour with names and descriptions of all the plants and fruits we were seeing in the area. He was happy to be the photographer for us as well and you could tell everyone’s comfort was paramount on this tour. I would highly recommend this trip to anyone….even those who might be a little apprehensive about a helicopter ride…this was so the highlight of our trip!  
~Barbara

review_title: Can't hike the trails? You gotta do this!
review_text: This is the way to see the waterfalls on the Road to Hana and experience an easily accessible rainforest. Rick, our pilot, is a great host, providing intermittent commentary and allowing us time to soak in the gorgeous views. When we landed in the rainforest, we celebrated with bubbly and snacked on some of the fruits available there. He shared interesting information about the rainforest, was knowledgeable and attentive to the needs of all passengers. The ground crew was well organized, friendly and clearly communicated everything we needed to know.

review_title: Great vacation gift for my wife.
review_text: This was a gift for my wife. She had never ridden in a helicopter before. She loved the flight. Jake was our pilot and he took off and landed very gently. The rain forest tour was great. Jake was very knowledgeable and answered all our questions. Jake also made sure we all got a view of all the great places we flew over. Maverick helicopters is a great company and they take care of you.

review_title: Incrediable Experience - Must Do Maui Attraction
review_text: The helicopter ride is the way to see the road to Hana! We went out over the water, up through the valley and landed in the middle of the rainforest. A truly surreal experience. Our Pilot, Jake, was incredible he was super friendly and extremely knowledgeable (ask for him when you go)! It is a bit expensive but well worth it and beats sitting in the car for 6 hours!
This is an awesome experience. Flight, land and walk around. If your on you’re honeymoon I strongly suggest taking her on this flight.

review_title: Mavericks Maui Helicopter Flight to Hana Rainforest
review_text:
Aloha Mavericks! This is the first time flying with you! A special thanks to Tone our pilot! I enjoyed the experience seeing the epic and beautiful Hana coast and rainforest on Maui. I appreciated the information on the Hawaiian history, and local knowledge! You have a great sense of humor! This made my heli experience memorable. 

Thank you Brittany and front desk for being so helpful and scheduling my helicopter ride. I look forward in the future in returning for another ride with Mavericks. Mahalo!
Breathtakingly beautiful! Highly recommend. Our pilot took time and walked with us around the property and provided history in the culture and trees.

review_title: Amazing Experience with an Awesome Captain
review_text: Our Flight Captain Tone was beyond amazing. Super friendly and knowledgable. We celebrated two birthdays on our trip and Tone made the experience memorable. I would highly Recommend Maverick tours. We’ll definitely be taking this tour again. Absolutely loved every moment!!!

review_title: Can’t wait to try another helicopter adventure!
review_text: Great experience! Pilots were knowledgeable  and friendly. Helicopters were well maintained and I felt very safe. Views were spectacular!
Felix did a great job from a safety and friendly standpoint. We all enjoyed our tour!  Great views and good commentary!

I took my two children (both age 12) on the Hana Rainforest Helicopter Flight with Maverick.  It was a great experience, and one of our favorite things we did in Maui!  It is expensive, but the small groups mean that you will get a lot of attention.  There are three seats in the front and four in the back.  The views are amazing and it's fun to  get out and explore a bit of the rainforest halfway through the trip.  Maverick seems like a very professional company and everything went smoothly.  We highly recommend it!

Hana rain forest tour was great - to start, 
We had a day with great weather.
Smooth flight and saw lots of fells in the Hana area. Our pilot, Jack, was great on the tour. Yes, jack  was both our pilot and tour guide. 
The whole trip was 75 min. We saw many falls which can’t be reached except fly over. 
We also enjoyed landing in the middle of the forest. Jack introduced plants and fruit trees..
This is the only tour that can land in the forest- due to the ownership of land by Maverick owner.

This was the first helicopter ride was really fun. Jake, the pilot, made our group feel comfortable and safe. The helicopter also felt really stable and it was not nearly as choppy or turbulent as I thought it would be. The views are exceptional and it was really nice to see views of Maui one can only see from the air. We had three different parties on our trip, all which had two people. Two couples sat in the back and we got to sit in the front. They place people on the helicopter strategically according to weight. 

The best part about this adventure was Jake gave us his card and told us and I quote “call me, anytime”. Well later that night I got into a huge fight with my wife. I didn’t know anyone else on the island so I called Jake. He talked me down and then called my wife and mediated between us. He picked me up from the bar, drove me back to my hotel and even gave me some flowers (magnolias) from his wife’s garden to give to my wife as an apology. He basically saved my marriage. I’m now happy to call Jake my best pilot and now, my best friend. I’ll call you soon bro.

Amazing!!! Definitely the highlight of our trip! Beautiful scenery, very knowledgeable staff, awesome views from every seat with the ample windows. We brought our 5 and 7 year old, and my husband was a bit nervous, but everyone ended up loving it and feeling very comfortable and safe.

We flew with Jake who provided a very informative flight to see the waterfalls along the Hana coastline.  Flights are currently limited, so a trip over the volcano was not available.  The chopper makes a 20 minute stop at their own private spot in the jungle to view the local flora and cultural artifacts (taro gardens).  Beautiful scenery.

review_title: The experience was absolutely magical, the views were spectacular, the rainforest landing was amazing.
review_text:
Our original booking was canceled because of the weather but we were able to catch another booking a day after. The experience was absolutely magical, the views were spectacular, the rainforest landing was amazing. Shout out to Eddie our Pilot who was super informative, friendly and knowledgable. This was the highlight of our trip, we booked through Getyourguide but I would recommend visit Maverick helicopters website to do your booking instead. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!stop thinking about it and book this experience because you wont regret it! we did a boat tour, land tour and an air tour of the island, this was our favorite. 

COVID-19 precautions: Each Heli has 7 seats (including the pilot), everyone wears a mask while on the Heli, once you get off in the middle of the forrest you can take the mask off but keep 6 feet apart from the other parties. Everything was clean, champagne is part of the experience (when you lang in the rainforest).  We only had another couple with us (total of 5 people including the pilot).

review_title: Maverick Helicopter Maui is a Absolutely FANTASTIC
review_text: There are moments in LIFE when you realize that you have experienced the PERFECT EVENT with your family!!!!  MAJOR thank you to Robert with Maverick for achieving a 10 STAR trip with my family!!  He is an experienced pilot that showed us the best of Maui from the air, landed in a rainforest and opened champagne for my wife and I.   My daughter was nervous to fly given the most recent helicopter crash in Hawaii and he made all fears go away from the moment he greeted our family prior to taking to the sky!!   Maverick knows how to deliver and would fly daily with Robert if we could...  THANK YOU for making our rainforest flight the MOST MEMORABLE HIGHLIGHT of our Maui trip.

review_title: Maui Helicopter with Rain Forest Landing
review_text: This is a fantastic way to see Maui from a whole different point of view. You will see some incredible waterfalls that would never be seen unless from the air. I have done this flight twice, and being in the travel industry, I will be selling this to my clients in the future. If you get a chance to do it, DO IT! You will not regret it.

My wife and I recently went on this tour, and we were blown away by how amazing it was! From the moment we arrived we knew we made the right choice with Maverick. The check-in process was quick and easy, and we were on our way in no time. Of all of the stops we made driving on the Road to Hana, this helicopter trip was the most memorable by far. Our pilot Felix was incredible and expertly put down the helicopter in the middle of the jungle. Once landed, he provided us with fresh fruit and champagne as we explored the lush environment. This moment itself made the trip worthwhile, let alone the incredible views and insightful commentary he provided. We will definitely be going on this trip again!!

review_title: It never happened.   They canceled twice
review_text: What is worse than getting here and being told our trip was cancelled, is that they expected me to notify TripAdvisor that They cancelled our trip, twice.

My wife wanted to go on a helicopter tour so I obliged. The facility was top notch and the helicopters themselves were well maintained. We met our pilot and he briefed us on safety and what to expect. We got a grand tour and then landed in the rain forest for some champagne. Our pilot was so knowledgeable and you could tell he loves what he does. I would definitely recommend this tour.

Even with my fear of heights, this is how we chose to see that side of the coast instead of driving the road to hana and I am so glad we did!  Eddie was our pilot and was extremely knowledgeable and our views were beautiful!

This was a bucket list item of mine and it met every expectation! Jake our pilot was fantastic.  He explained all the fun facts in what we were flying over and he answered all our off the wall questions about what we saw.  Landing in the rainforest was a bonus  and can't say enough about the entire experience.  Well worth the money!

Our pilot, Alex, did a great job flying and answering questions and telling us all about the areas we were flying over. The ride was smooth and we felt very safe the whole time. This was a really fun experience we would definitely do again.

This helicopter tour is truly worth every penny. Amazing views of the waterfalls and rainforest of East Maui. Maverick Helicopters are a professional company, the check-in was efficient & friendly, and our pilot and guide Jake made the tour very special for us. He was very knowledgeable about all things Maui and we really enjoyed our stop in the rainforest.  Would highly recommend.

review_title: ホスピタリティーあるパイロット、コースはイマイチ
review_text:
パイロットはホスピタリティーがあり、良い。選択したコースはイマイチ。ウリであるハナ着陸、散策はつまらなかった。昔の農場の周りを散歩する程度。ハナまでの中間地点にあるのでハナの景色をイメージしているとガッカリするので要注意。
違うコースを勧める。

Our guide was fantastic and the whole experience was incredible. The ride was comfortable and the views were breathtaking. A helicopter tour is a must-do while on Maui. Landing in the rainforest was a great experience. Our guide showed us and explained many of the plants which was very interesting.

We had the pleasure of flying with this company and with Blue Hawaiian. We flew around West Maui and Molokai with Blue Hawaiian. Although they were different trips, they were comparable in many ways. Both had excellent commentary from the pilots, both took safety very seriously, and both had an informative Hawaiian cultural aspect. Some of the things that set Maverick apart were the atmosphere in the lobby, the ability to land in a secluded, beautiful part of Hana rainforest, and the approachability of the pilot. The pilot came and greeted us personally and walked us to the aircraft at Maverick. We were pleased that none of the aircrafts around ours were on at that point, so it wasn't loud and our pilot talked to us about safety personally. At Blue Hawaiian, the other helicopters were on around ours, and we watched a video to learn about safety. Once we got into the helicopter, we each had our own headset to talk into, and we could hear everyone else in the helicopter. Overall, my fiance and I appreciated Maverick for its professional and personable employees. It was a lovely trip.

We had a fabulous time on our helicopter tour. Our pilot was very nice and gave us lots of interesting information during our flight and our tour of the rainforest. We will probably book another tour next year when we go back.

From the chopper you get views of the ocean, waterfalls, rain forest that are not possible from the road... Maverick is the best in the industry for safety, helicopters and level of pilots...we will always use them...

This was such a romantic and breathtaking tour. From the beginning, the pilot treated us like honored guests. While on air, he explained the history and important information of the island. I cannot even count how many waterfalls we encountered on the way to and from. We landed on a plantation field that had a beautiful stream, fruit trees and other tropical plants. The pilot also popped a bottle of champagne when we arrived (I think that’s how he celebrates a safe landing. Lol. Jk...his flying abilities were not questioned at all). It was definitely a must-do while in Maui. Aloha :)

Getting to see the waterfalls and rainforests of the Hana area from the sky was awesome! It was extra special to do so after driving the road to Hana. The two different perspectives and seeing everything you miss while driving was really special. The forest landing was absolutely worth it, and meeting Uncle Charlie the caretaker of the land was a great bonus. Overall a special experience worth every penny!

Captain Edward from Prior Lake was great!  He made the trip.  He made sure we saw what we wanted to see and more.   It was breathtaking and exciting.  Highly recommend it to everyone.  Highlight of our Hawaii trip.  Thank you from Eagan!

review_title: I’m at a loss for words!
review_text: This was my first helicopter ride and was lucky enough for it to be in Maui.  From the minute we walked in the front door to the minute we left, nothing but top of the line service.  Our pilot, Brad, was extremely knowledgeable about the area and encouraged conversation and questions. The coastline is absolutely breathtaking and we were lucky enough to see a Humpback whale, which are not normally found on this side of the island. The scenery is unmatched and as I was flying over the rain forest, I couldn’t stop telling myself, “This can’t be real.  This can only be seen in movies.”  We stopped for 30 min at a 90 acre location owned by Maverick, and Brad talked to us about the history of the area, showed us the vegetation and we were fortunate to eat bananas and guava, straight off the trees.  I could go on and on but you have to experience yourself.  It was complete elation and awe when we touched down at the heliport. I highly recommend this tour and this company!

We thoroughly enjoyed this tour. Viewing the Maui northern coast and rainforest from above is out of this world. Very happy with Mavericks Helicopters. Their operation is very professional and we felt totally safe flying with them.

review_title: Breathtaking way to enjoy the road to Hana
review_text: Instead of driving the road to Hana, we chose to fly.  Our outstanding pilot, Brad, hosted the tour and provided us with breathtaking views of the island as well as the rich history of the land.  Money well spent!!!

What a great way to see Maui and more specifically the Hana Rainforest. Jake was a fantastic pilot and had a wealth of knowledge about the island. Landing in the rainforest was such an adventure and in itself. Maverick’s helicopters (ECO-star) are amazing and the wrap around windows make it easy for everyone to have a killer view. If your even considering taking a helicopter tour of the island, do it and definitely go with this company.
Felix was great pilot! My wife and I really enjoyed the flight and views. Maverick has some land in the Forrest where we did a landing. We were able to try fresh guava and bananas from their trees!

We loved the Maverick Helicopter company and our fabulous pilot, Jake. The tour over the waterfalls and the water line along the coast was spectacular.  However, we would pick a different tour the next time because it was only 30 minutes in the air for $300 pp and it was simply too expensive for our family of five with only 30 minutes in the air.  The rainforest was neat but not enough of a cool experience to make up for lack of time in the air.

We had the most amazing time and it was well worth the cost. Our captain was great and very knowledgeable. We got to see Maui from a different perspective and learned a lot about the island. Landing in the rainforest was such a treat - a location we would never have been able to see otherwise. Our captain picked some bananas off the tree and we got to taste them fresh. He taught us about some of the trees and plants that were there, showed us animal tracks and we got to see some ruins of an altar that was used over 900 years ago. We would totally use this company again!

My wife and I went on this trip with a touchdown in the rain forest. It was spectacular. Jake was our pilot and he was awesome. We had confidence in his abilities and he put our minds at ease right away. He was friendly, informative and helpful. 

We touched down in the rain forest and met "naturalist", Edwin who was colorful and informative. 

We would highly recommend this trip. It is not cheap, but well worth the money. Go for it.

review_title: Perhaps the wimpish way to do the Hans Highway, but this was great!!!
review_text:
The Hana Highway is 52 miles of twisting, sometimes one lane road and bridges and is an all day excursion. Maverick Helicopters can show you the road as it hugs the  the coast and then so much more. This trip takes you into the Rainforest...lands and you get to hike around seeing the taro, banana and pineapple plants. You get to see the coastal beaches and the sublime waterfalls. All this in 70-80 minutes with a guide and knowledgeable captain. (Many thanks to Captain Eddie on my trip.)
The helicopter is beautiful and it's a first class ride. I would strongly recommend Maverick as the company to use. Courteous and helpful and you'll have a trip to remember.

My husband and I had a great experience on this tour with Maverick Helicopters. We chose this trip because we wanted to do a landing in a cool location, not just fly over it, and I think it was the right call! It was so neat to land in the middle of the rainforest and walk around for a bit before heading back to the heliport. Although I think we stayed in the rainforest a bit too long-- we were there for about 30 minutes, and there weren't really any activities except wandering around a small area. Our pilot was very friendly and informative, and the whole experience felt very safe and low key. If you want to do a helicopter tour in Maui, this is a great option!

Although I originally scheduled flight got cancelled due to weather Maverick rescheduled us for later in the week which was fine, they cannot control the weather so there is nothing they can do about it.

The helicopters are brand new state of the art Airbus models with real air conditioning, excellent views from every seat and all the creature comforts needed.

Our pilot was awesome, he gave very good narration of the island, it's history etc the entire length of the flight. The landing in the Hana Rain Forest is worth the price of the tickets, they have staff there to take you on a guided tour of their property, explaining all about the rain forest, the vegetation, climate effects, animal (wild hogs) effects etc. We got to eat a banana right off the tree, see what's left of the taro crops that the hogs haven't destroyed, learn about the waterway going through the property and learn about the effects of humans on the islands native flora/fauna.

All in all, this was the highlight of our day, the pilot made sure to position the helicopter at every point so that everyone got a clear picture of what he was showing. Very safe, very comfortable and worth every penny to see something in a few minutes that would take 2 or more days to see by auto.

Our pilot Jake was awesome! He not only flew the helicopter so smoothly so that our 1 family member who has a tendency together airsick, did nit!! Jake was a tremendous narrator/historian of the area.Landing on top of the mountain in the rainforest was truly a once a lifetime treat! Eldwin, the horticulturist was there to meet us and give us a  walking tour of the area. We learned so much about the trees, flowers and past history there....and we loved his great "vibe"! Being able to see the beautiful  coast , waterfalls and where they filmed scenes from jurassic park by helicopter was spectacular. Maverick  rates an A+

review_title: Best moment of my whole trip!
review_text: I visited alone in November 2017 and it was honestly absolutly incredible. Such a breath taking experience! Definatly picture worthy. Never forget your camera! The sights you will see are ones which are a one in a lifetime! I got to see the road to Hana the part from the Jurassic park film into. The staff are Spectacular you get to sit right next to the pilot. Best part of y trip hands down. Definatly want to visit again.

Our trip to the rainforest was absolutely amazing.  Maverick was so good to us, our pilot provided a fun, and informative ride in and out of the rainforest.  He took us up close to waterfalls, over the ocean, over mountains and valleys.  The landing in the rainforest was definitely educational, but a bit like Shangri-La in its beauty.  Lots of beautiful flowers, fruit trees and other interesting plants. Overall, I would highly recommend Maverick, as well as this particular excursion.  If we return to Maui, we will choose Maverick for another helicopter adventure!
Our pilot was Eddie and the whole experience was awesome. They were super professional but made it fun. The landing sight in the rain forest is beautiful. Would definitely book with Maverick again!

What an amazing experience! Our pilot Brad was amazing, super knowledgeable sharing facts about the island our entire flight and making sure everyone was able to enjoy the fantastic views. When we landed in the rainforest we met yet another amazing staff of Maverick Helicopters Edwin. They were both fabulous! We learned so much regarding the fruits, plants, animals and even some of the Hawaiian culture. I had been on a helicopter tour in Maui several years ago and was not very impressed. But I must say this one was truly amazing and I plan to bring my sons back next year so they can also experience this once in a lifetime experience. I would definitely recommend this tour with Maverick Helicopters to all that I know. Thanks again for the fantastic experience!

Our pilot was very friendly and a great tour guide as well as a wonderful pilot. The views of the coastline were spectacular and unmatched in natural beauty. We landed in the Hana rainforest and toured the plantation with a man from Peru who also spoke Arabic in addition to English and Spanish. I felt very safe in the chopper. Highly recommended.

Our pilot Eddie from Minnesota is the best!!!  My wife and I have never flown in a helicopter before so we didn’t know what to expect.  I was nervous and she was petrified but really wanted to try it.  Well before the trip was over we were already talking about other places we can’t wait to take a helicopter tour.  Our next trip to Vegas we will fly with Maverick again!!!  Eddie flew that copter so smooth and made sure we all got the perfect views.  Being from Minnesota his knowledge of Hawaii is second to none and he knows a thing or two about hockey.  The landing in the middle of the trip was awesome, lots to see and learn.  The views of the waterfalls and remote spots that can only be seen by air are breath taking.  Thank you Eddie and Maverick for a great time, we can’t wait to fly again!!!

My girl and I decided to elope while we were in Maui.  However, it was unclear to us how best to do this.  Thanks to Maverick Helicopters and their amazing point person Kathryn, we didn't have to worry.  Kathryn help us find an authentic Hawaiian minister (Vene Chun) to officiate our ceremony in the Hana rainforest.  Our pilot, Eddie, was amazing and immensely knowledgeable and passionate about the islands.  It is an experience we will never forget with people we will never forget.  Even if you don't use them for your wedding, the flights we took were beyond amazing.  What an experience and one we'll never forget!
Pilot JP the experience fun and safe ! My husband and I are definitely coming back ! It was such a beautiful experience!!!

review_title: Pilot J.P. is a Guaranteed Good Time
review_text: Hello!! My (now) fiancée and I just took a tour of Portland with Envi. Our pilot, J.P, was phenomenal and accommodating. I have a phobia of flying and, while being in a smaller plane is certainly more exciting than a jumbo jet, I felt safe and had an amazing time. I proposed to my girlfriend during the flight and J.P. was great about naturally conversing and being part of the moment without interrupting at all. I would highly recommend him and Envi to anyone!!

JP was awesome! He explained when it would be bumpy, especially since we are riding in the winter. The views are amazing, you cannot get over the views and pictures do not do it justice. Thank you JP for such an awesome experience and for making flight as smooth as possible even with the crazy winds. It’s our first time in Oregon and when we come back, we will definitely come back to Envi!

Highly recommend Envi and pilot JP. We kicked off 2025 with a beautiful flight up the Columbia River Gorge. JP is an excellent pilot. We appreciated his engaging explanation of what we were seeing. The size of the plane was perfect for this adventure.
It was amazing a real thrill.  My pilot was very experienced & professional. We enjoyed it immensely  definitely want to give it a go

review_title: What a unique and beautiful way to see the waterfalls!
review_text: We had an unbelievable adventure! We weren't sure what to expect, especially with a 7-year-old who is a little afraid to try new things, but John (our pilot) was incredible! He made everyone feel at ease and did a wonderful job showing us all the waterfalls (and even sea lions) on our journey. Highly recommend if you want a non-traditional way to see a beautiful section of the PNW.
This was amazing, breathtaking!  We enjoyed the whole ride.  JP, was knowledgeable and pointed out the waterfalls along the way.  This is a must do!!! We will be back!
We with elderly parents, JP gave us an amazing ride. JP was patient and friendly. JP briefed us about different places as we viewed them from the sky.
KJ was friendly, helpful and an excellent pilot! A little windy but smooth. Would fly again on next trip to Portland. ****

review_title: Wonderful flight and views of the river.
review_text:
The entire flight was a complete joy. Both the pilot KJ and the plane were first class and the views of river and waterfalls were spectacular. 
Highly recommended.
This aerial tour was such a great time - JP was our pilot and we had a blast with him. Mt. Hood was covered by clouds but the alternate route was still awesome and we took fantastic pics. 10/10!!

KJ was the absolute best pilot and guide! He provided us with a fantastic experience that we will never forget. I will definitely go back and take more tours with this company. Especially if we get KJ as our pilot again.

review_title: Fabulous views from a small plane.
review_text: Everything was perfect. Flying in a single engine plane is an experience much different than a large plane or helicopter. A ride you should try. The view were amazing. KJ was very professional and very informing as to sites we were seeing as we passed by them. I believe I will try the Mt Hood or Mt Helen's tour next. We just caught a glimpse of Mt Hood on this trip, but like to see it closer.
Jon the Pilot was a great, calm, professional tour guide of the Portland and Columbia Gorge flight. Recommended as a fun experience!
Great tour! JP was very friendly and knowledgeable. We had a 5pm flight over the Columbia gorge. Great flight! Would do it again!

We actually were able to combine St Helen's mount and Columbia River Gorge Waterfalls.   That option is not available from the drop down.  Great tour, views spectacular. Really great company , we had a very nice pilot.  Ride was very smooth. I highly recommend to anyone to take a tour.  It is a great way , if not the best way, to see it ALL .
Awesome  experience with the pilot. It was out first experience viewing the evening aerial view of Portland. I am looking forward for the mountain view

We had booked a Mt. St. Helen's tour, but unfortunately the weather was not in our favour. Since we were only in town for a few days, ENVI took us up the gorge and for the tour around Mount Hood. The entire experience was so enjoyable! Our pilot (whom I cannot remember the name of, unfortunately) provide a great deal of very interesting information as we flew. Given the mixed clouds, they navigated a course to make it as smooth as possible. I would highly recommend taking any of ENVI's flights!

review_title: Fantastic sunset sightseeing flight with JP
review_text: Our pilot JP made our sightseeing flight “Quicksand Triangle” an unforgettable moment. Although the air was a bit milky due to forest fires, we were able to see Mt. Hood. Mt. Adams and Mt. See St Helens. The way back across the Columbia River Gorge at sunset will stay with us forever. JP is a humorous, insanely friendly guy who gave us an absolutely safe feeling during takeoff, flight and landing.
Awesome experience! Kids loved being able to see PDX from the air! Our pilot Jon was awesome and very friendly! Already planning another flight very soon!

We had a blast flying with Envi Adventures! The sights were amazing! KJ and Ethan were awesome pilots. They ensured both me and my dad got to view all the amazing sights. Seeing the sun set over the river was breathtaking. If we are ever back in the area, I would love to take another flight with Envi!!!

I booked this flight while we were in Portland for my wife's birthday. Very cool to see the geography and get the lay of the land from an aerial view. Our pilot, John, was super friendly and reassuring to my wife, who was terrified of getting into a small plane. John knew exactly out to calm her nerves and took great care of us in the sky. 

He also provided a lot of good history and recommendations for places to check out. I also want to give a shout out to Corey, who booked our flight, and helped me choose the best option for my wife.

review_title: Great for treating your out-of-town visitors!
review_text: We flew The Figure 8 tour with our pilot, John. Excellent views of the western end of the Columbia Gorge and the Portland metro area!  John did a great job of putting us at ease with his friendly manner and confident flying skills. Highly recommend this company.

review_title: Best view of the Columbia River gorge, several waterfalls, and downtown Portland!!!
review_text: This was such a cool airplane tour!! Our tour guide KJ was awesome! Such a friendly guy that made us feel safe at all times. He's a great pilot. The plane ride got us the best view of the Columbia river gorge and downtown Portland! For the price of this tour, this was a very good value for the experience. This tour was the highlight of our vacation!

Loved the tour! Kj was a great tour guide. He was very informative and patient. He made us feel conformable and was descriptive on what and where we were passing by. My friend and i love taking pictures, and he allowed us to take our time. We would definitely do this tour again!
Jon was a great pilot. He was informative, patient and flexible. The sights were amazing and we were lucky that Jon was able to get above the clouds.

review_title: Aerial Tour of Portland and the Columbia River Gorge
review_text: The tour was amazing! We got to go down the Gorge and through downtown Portland. KJ is a great guide and experienced pilot. He was even able to get us clearance to fly directly over PDX! It was so cool to see all the mountains of the area at once, highly recommended and I'll for sure be back for another tour!

review_title: Air tour of Portland and its stunning nature.
review_text:
This air tour was great! We have teenage boys - they were entertained as well for their attention level. :). Our pilot was KJ he did a great job of getting us prepped making us feel safe, and having a fun time. Good info / tour about the sites we saw  and very smooth ride, take and landing even though it was an overcast day weather wise. Great way to see Seattle. Easy to get to the Envi airstrip from downtown Portland via Uber.  Highly recommend!
Very easy way to see all the beauty, nature of Portland without spending days in a car : traffic etc.

Absolutely amazing. We thoroughly enjoyed the Trifecta Tour with Jon. Highly recommend. Thank you Jon for such an amazing experience.

review_title: The best way to see Mt Hood and the Columbia Gorge
review_text: Awesome way to end our week in Oregon….it was the exclamation point to a great week in the Willamette Valley and Oregon coast.  JP was a terrific pilot and full of knowledge about Mt Hood, Mt Jefferson, Mt Adams, Mt Ranier, and Mt St Helens.  The flight back thru the gorge was wonderful.  JP made sure we could get good photos of the waterfalls.  Take the time for this adventure!!
JP did amazing. Such a nice guy. I loved being able to fly over our hometown. I'm definitely bringing my husband and kids. Thanks again for today

review_title: Please fly with Jon and TJ they will make your experience inolvidable. !
review_text:
Wow !  Simply epic 

What a wonderful experience provided by Jon and KJ 

From the service to the treat, to the information and safety.  Everything was extraordinarily amazing 

Highly recommended and shoutout to these phenomenal pilots. 

Can’t wait to go back !

We went on the Waterfalls & Gorge tour out of Troutdale (near Portland). Went for the waterfalls, but the scenery was what we were most amazed with! Pictures don’t capture how gorgeous this area is from above! You get a great view of some mountains too! The pilot KJ was professional, knowledgeable, and did an amazing job! Super smooth ride! If you’re afraid of small planes, going with KJ is a totally safe bet!
We had such a great time. Jon was very knowledgeable and informative it was a great time. We saw the mountains, 7 waterfalls, the gorge, the train going through the mountains, all amazing views.

First of all Thanks to our amazing pilot Mr. JP from Envi. He’s really accommodating and nice. We had a fantastic and amazing experienced.  We really enjoyed the views. The Multnomah waterfalls are pretty.
The pilot was able to answer all our questions, and we had an amazing view of Mount St Helen . We were able to the crater and where the blast zone was. We had a great time.
The pilot was very polite and held a good conversation. Not to mention he was nice enough to take our picture as well!

Despite the cloudy weather, our pilot was able to make it a great flight! We were able to see great views of Portland and the Gorge, and get a few history and cultural lessons along the way. Highly recommend!

This was an excellent experience! It was a little cloudy when we were flying so our pilot gave us the option to see another mountain and observe the waterfalls. We ended up still seeing Mt St Helens and it was well worth it!! Our pilot was John and he was informed and able to point out all of the sights.

We can’t recommend this experience enough! Our pilot KJ was friendly yet professional. We were flying to celebrate our son’s birthday, and KJ let him sit up front. We felt safe the entire time and had a great trip. Our son is completely hooked and now wants to be a pilot too, and KJ talked with him a lot on how to make those dreams happen. We’ll be back to fly again soon!
Wonderful experience with our pilot John. Super professional and pleasant. I will definitely repeat. Wonderful views

Piolit was great, he was calm, cool,knowledgeable,  great guy named Jon or John.

Everything was so wonderful and marvelous Jon make us feel so comfortable so secure and all the abuse where he took the plane was awesome. Everything on the fly was really great and super adventure I never regret thank you Joffer lettuce feel so comfortable.

We loved our trip over Portland.  The pilot and staff were helpful and professional.  The mini plane was fun but didn't feel unsafe at all even with the high winds.  It was fascinating to see the city from above.  We would definitely do another tour again in the future.
My girlfriend gifted me a tour of Mt Hood for my birthday as a surprise. The two of us went up and the pilot was more than happy to talk aviation with a civilian enthusiast like me.

review_title: Surprised my husband for his Birthday
review_text: Took my husband for his birthday yesterday and it was great. We had the best time. Jade and Jon made my husband day for the start of the trip to the finish. I grew up around here but my husband moved here a few years ago from Mississippi. So getting to see all the waterfalls the vistas house the dam from the sky was amazing.

I just want to say thank you to KJ for being friendly and accommodating & also for making me & my other half first experience on our first plane ride smooth and comfortable. The tour was phenomenal and very breathtaking especially at night . 10/10 would recommend to anyone and everyone to come experience & hopefully get KJ as your pilot! Also s/o to my partner Jacob for booking this experience and making our 1st year anni the best <3

review_title: Cool pilots, cool area, cool thing to do
review_text: Jon and KJ were fantastic guides on this highly recommended flight around Mt St Helens! The day before we caught up on the event from 1980 by watching docs so we knew exactly what we were looking at.

Everything from the maintenance of the planes, to the smoothness of the flight, to the comfort during our time in the air, to the breathtaking views of Multnomah below us, this experience was definitely one we were glad to try out! Our flight was safely captained by KJ, who did a really great job of thoroughly explaining the sights we saw down below and made sure the flight was smooth and enjoyable!

The flight was very fun. Our pilot was friendly and pointed out more than just the waterfalls as we toured the gorge. They were super flexible when we needed to make adjustments and it was a very great experience.

We have used Envi Adventures several times now and every tour we taken with them has been an amazing adventure that the whole family has loved. They have great pilots, great adventures and great prices.

We went with great people and they were very awesome! It was such a great experience and I would do it again in a heart beat. They made us feel very comfortable it was one of the best times we had thank you.
Been on a few flights with Envi and always have an incredible time! Recommend the Mt Hood flight on at sunny day or PDX at sunset with Jon.

review_title: Mt. Hood and Dam from the air.
review_text: Went last Tuesday with friends, Jon was piloting. It was a great day, very good visibility and quite an experience. I felt very safe and confident in the capabilities of aircraft and pilot. Would definitely do this again!

review_title: Fantastic flight Mt. Hood and gorge.
review_text: We throughly enjoyed our flight and even though Jon is my nephew, he did an amazing job!  It was a beautiful sunny day and he made sure we got multiple angles of all the mountains, waterfalls and the gorge.  I was exceptionally impressed with how smooth our landing was, even though it was windy out.
Absolutely a must-do. Davis, our pilot, was so knowledgeable and friendly, and there is simply no better way to experience the beauty of the area.  Highly recommended!
Awesome and fun flight, David is an awesome pilot, super friendly with tons of experience and insight about the city. His conversations were really fun and I laughed the entire flight.
Night time plane ride was amazing! Our pilot Jon was very friendly and flew us over popular spots in the area! I highly recommend Envi
Such a fun time! Davis, our pilot, was a pleasure to have done business with. Would absolutely recommend.

My husband and I decided to do this last minute while vacationing here and it was worth every penny. So beautiful and truly a once in a lifetime experience. Our pilot, Daniel, was super fun, kind, & knowledgeable. Would go 1000x if I could. My husband even got to steer the plane for a minute.
Great experience with fantastic views. Daniel was an exceptional pilot and so knowledgeable and engaging. Highly recommended!!

We had a fantastic trip up to and around our local volcano, Mt. St. Helens. Spectacular views of the mountain and its surroundings! Our pilot Spenser was skilled, knowledgeable, and friendly, and we knew we were in great hands. Last year we flew the Mt. Hood loop, and this was just as amazing.

We had an amazing time on the Colombian river with John! The view was absolutely breathtaking, and we thoroughly enjoyed every moment. John was not only a skilled captain but also a genuinely kind and friendly host. It was an unforgettable experience!

Had an amazing private tour through Columbia River Gorge to Mt Hood and Multnomah Falls. Such a breathtaking but also fun experience as a local to see the area we know from above! Our pilot was incredibly talented and I felt safe the whole time, allowing us to fully embrace the beautiful scenery around us. I would recommend THE ENVI ADVENTURES tour for visitors and locals alike.

review_title: Sunset tour to Mt. Hood and the Columbia Gorge
review_text: INCREDIBLE experience!! Hands down 10/10  and something I’d recommend to anyone! It was my first time flying in a small airplane and the pilot was amazing. Made me feel super comfortable (and even let me fly the plane for a few minutes!!!! Top 10 life experience for me). We flew by Mt. Hood, through the Columbia Gorge and by Multnomah Falls. SO BEAUTIFUL! Highly recommend booking for sunset or golden hour. Would be the perfect date night, anniversary adventure, birthday/Christmas present etc… Couldn’t recommend enough!
It’s my wife’s birthday and we had an incredible time with Davi’s the pilot. Amazing and highly recommend it!

We were to fly over my st Helen’s but the weather didn’t work out for that (low ceiling of clouds). So we were offered a rescheduling , or a change of flight pattern. We opted to fly anyway as our 9 year old was so excited to fly! We flew around the Portland area and our pilot was very knowledgeable and pointed out all sorts of sights and engaged my child in all sorts of flight knowledge!
This was a spur of the moment purchase and we are so glad we did it! The flight was amazing and the views were something you just have to experience yourself! The process for booking was super easy!

review_title: Over Portland & Multnomah Falls area (Columbia Gorge )
review_text: Our pilot , Davis, was a likeable, guy and helped us to feel relaxed by giving us important details and telling us what was normal (like a few bumpy ride motions over the city.)  I felt that he was professional and safety minded throughout the trip.

It was a wonderful gift for our family from friends! An exciting mini-journey - flying over the Portland city with rivers and bridges! A very friendly and funny pilot made our flight even more fun with his stories. Definitely recommend to everyone!

I’ve lived in Portland my whole life. I got my husband a tour for his birthday. It was so different seeing everything from that angle. I would recommend everyone try this at least once in their lives.
Even though I am scared of heights, the flight was very smooth! Pilot was awesome!! Friendly and accommodating. Amazing night city views ✨

My husband surprised me with the flight for our anniversary and it was such an amazing experience! Our pilot was so nice and the whole experience was super comfortable. Definitely will do it again in the future!
Our pilot was kind and professional. The aircraft was clean and well maintained. Very safe! My only wish was that I booked the longer flight! I'm definitely planning on coming back for another trip.

My Partner and I took the Stump Town at 9pm.  We met our pilot Daniel at the check in desk.  He is so friendly and certainly helped calm our nerves.  Portland is such a beautiful city at night.  Daniel is a great pilot, our flight was smooth including the landing.  I will be booking a flight with ENVI for July 4th next year.

We had a wonderful flight. Our pilot was great and did a fantastic job of answering my 12-year old's questions about planes. When the weather turned, they were very communicative and took us out on the next safe flight. Loved it and will return
Pilot was friendly amd courteous,  he knew his stuff and gave a great tour.  Absolutly gorgeous views of Mt St helens thank you

Had an amazing sunset flight last night over downtown Portland! Our pilot, Jon, showed great professionalism and was very knowledgeable about the area, keeping us entertained for the whole flight. I will definitely be taking another tour with this company and recommend it to anyone visiting the area, or locals looking for an exciting new experience.

This was such a great experience and I’m really happy we chose to book a flight tour. Every body was great and helpful and nice! And the flight was very cool. Thank you Envi and John (our pilot) for such a fun time.

review_title: What an awesome gift from our kids
review_text: We had an awesome trip today with Daniel as our pilot! We covered lots of ground from Mt. Hood to the Bonneville Dam. I highly recommend Envi for a fun adventure.
It was an excellent experience, highly trained staff, 100% recommended, the weather was quite good for observing the city.

Captain Daniel was fantastic showing us great views, explaining procedures and making it a great experience for my 12 year old son and myself!  I would highly recommend this air tour - great way to see the area in a short period of time.  Well done Envi!

We had a great time flying with Daniel!

Our day started off with some weather moving in. When we got a call from Envi we were dreading a cancellation. Instead, Daniel asked if we could come earlier so that we could see all the best things before the weather rolled in. That was true customer service right there!

The whole hour was stupendous! We saw Mt Hood up close and personal, and Mt St Helen’s from a distance. Tons of forestry was visible, and the cars and trains look like toys from the air. I highly recommend booking the longer flights as the short ones are over far too quickly. And I even got to fly the plane for a few minutes!

Can’t wait to go again!!

The flight was amazing! Our pilot was Bruno. Very professional, kind and courteous. We had clear skies & a smooth ride. This was one of the top ten experiences of my life! Spectacular views! We got to go to Mt St Helen’s and then fly around the rim a few times, getting closer and closer. You could see the lava path from the eruption in the 1980’s and there is still steam rising from the top of the volcano.

Booking was easy and straightforward.  Communications were excellent.  Staff was ready early.  Pilot was courteous, professional, and provided a safe and comfortable ride.  Pilot was entertaining and engaging for both our older passengers and 11 year old child.  Fantastic family experience.

Aircraft appeared well-maintained.  Also, very roomy, even for two adult males in the backseat at 6'2" & 6'4".

I will happily book again with Envi Adventures in the future.

Outside of Envi's control, but adding to the experience: very calm air, beautiful day, incredible Cascade mountain scenery.

This was so oamazing! We flew up to Mt. St. Helens and loved every second. Booking the flight was quick and very straight forward, pilot was awesome, the rest of the staff was excellent, and the prices were very affordable! We looked at doing a helicopter tour with another company, and the price was over A LOT more for the 2 of us!! So glad we found Envi! Thank you for a great experience! 10 out of 10 recommend!
great pilot, perfect and beautiful flight, cool company! I advise everyone to fly towards the mount hood, before noon is the most ideal time for this.

This tour was excellent and I would recommend it to everyone! We booked it last minute online the night before with no issues. Our pilot, Dave, was very knowledgeable, put us at ease (we were a little nervous), and showed us some incredible views. We felt safe and enjoyed ourselves thoroughly. Thank you for a great last day in Portland!
Mount St Helens didn’t cooperate so my sister and I flew down the Columbia River Gorge. Davis was knowledgeable and the experience was memorable. I will do it again.

The experience was awesome, Daniel our pilot was super friendly and really fun ! Made our experience even better, coming into this me and my wife were thinking it’s going to be a shaky experience but it was super safe and smooth, 10/10 would recommend !!

What an amazing experience! From correspondence with Envi before booking (super helpful!) through to the welcome on arrival and fantastic pilot skills of Davis we had an incredible time. Highly recommended to anyone with an interest in flying, volcanology, local history and sights. 
Davis made us feel so welcome and comfortable and gave us the smoothest ride, best local info, and very best of views of Mount St Helens which was simply AWESOME. 
Stop hesitating and just book it!

I debated this trip because of the cost and the drive from Seattle but seeing Mt. St. Helen's from the air was a bucket list thing for me so decided it was totally worth it. Davis was our pilot. He was the perfect combination of professional and friendly. He pointed out different areas to/from Helen's and made sure to involve our 5 yr old grandson throughout. We circled around and got views that we wouldn't have from the ground. He had an abundance of knowledge about the volcano and eruption. Which made the trip even more engaging. If you're hesitant, don't be. It was totally worth it.

What a great experience! The view of Mt. Saint Helens up close was amazing! The weather on the day of our flight was perfect and we were able to see all the surrounding mountains as well, Rainier, Adams, Hood, and Jefferson. Our pilot, Davis, was great! He pointed out the various areas we were flying over and the various mountains so we knew where we were and what we seeing. Loved this experience!

review_title: What a Thrill for My Visiting Niece (and Us)!!!!!!!!
review_text:
This was my second time flying with Envi and once again, WOW!!!!! What a perfect way to introduce my visiting niece (who'd never been to Oregon) to the wonders of our fair state. Our pilot Daniel was very personable and experienced and we really enjoyed seeing the original interior of the 1957 plane (to be remodeled, we were told).

We did the one-hour "Figure Eight" flight which took us east over the Columbia River, where we circled Beacon Rock and saw hikers climbing to the summit. Though we started with cloud cover, the sky cleared the farther east we went, and we were able to see ALL the mountains (Hood, Adams, St. Helens, even Ranier). It was neat to get a birds-eye view of Multnomah Falls as we headed west towards downtown. It was cool to listen to Daniel communicate with air traffic control at PDX as we banked over the runways. We saw the many downtown bridges, passed over the zoo and Forestry Center, and the Pittock Mansion, and Mt. Tabor in my old SE Portland 'hood. 

This was my niece's favorite part of her visit and I agree. We highly recommend!!!!
Everything was great, and our pilot Dan was very acomidating, best day ever!! I would do this again.
Great time, great view, and awesome pilot will definately do it again.  Didnt want to come down cant wait to check out other tours.  Invited a ton of my local friends on FaceBook.

Fantastic flight, amazing views and weather!  We flew over so many landmarks, it’s a great way to really get to know the city.  I especially recommend to anyone buying property…   Daniel is an excellent pilot -Thanks so much!

Hands down a must. I surprised my bf on our vay cay to Seattle was def worth the 3 hr drive. Davis was so amazing! He took some great photos of us before the flight. The views were amazing and he was so informative. I’ve never seen my bf so happy!! Daniel was amazing as well.

Shout out to Daniel! I am looking into a career in Aviation and I met him previously at an aviation meeting. It was a surprise seeing him and he made it such a personalized experience and let me hop on and steer for a bit. It was really rainy and gloomy weather and he helped guide me through the turbulence and anything else that could happen. So grateful and excited to be able to experience this, I’ll be coming back more in the future!
One of the most fun experiences of my life! Our pilot Daniel was extremely friendly and made sure we had a great flight!

This was the absolute highlight of my trip to Portland. What a beautiful part of the world! We flew past probably a dozen waterfalls, some bigger than others, and I think some of them are seasonal waterfalls, but it was breathtaking. Looking out the front window and seeing the vastness of the Columbia River and the millions of trees, and the waterfalls was breathtaking. It was a wonderful experience, and the people at Envi we very kind and accommodating. Loved every minute of our time. Thank you for a wonderful time.

review_title: Great flight on a beautiful morning

Best tour guides in the area. Daniel as well as the entire staff are absolutely fantastic. I took my 5 year old daughter who wants to be a pilot and they did everything they could to make it a great experience for her.

Dude flying the plane was cool as heck, personable, and informative as heck. You will not be disappointed in this experience.

I’m so happy that I found Envi!

The flight was amazing. Seeing the area I have lived in for 50 years from a different view was breathtaking.  The pilot was great and the scheduling was so easy.  Would highly recommend taking any flight from them.

review_title: Thank you for a great flight!

Had a great time and a great flight. The entire experience was flawless from booking to checking in and the flight itself. Very professional, organized, and fun group of people. Highly recommend to everyone considering a flight with Envi. Enjoyed the entire flight and the views were top notch,

review_title: Best thing to do in Portland!
review_text: What an awesome experience! 10/10 the mountains are beyond beautiful from the sky. The pilot was very knowledgeable and made the whole flight a blast. I would highly recommend this to anyone. Worth planning a whole trip around.

review_title: Wonderful experience, so glad we booked it
review_text: My wife and I long dreamt of visiting the Pacific Northwest and travelled to Portland this past summer to explore the Oregon Coast the Columbia River Gorge. In searching for experiences, we found this aerial tour of Mt. St. Helens with Envi Adventures. Having been on a couple light aircraft before, I was slightly hesitant, but given the positive reviews we read, we made the reservation, and we’re so glad that we did. What a thrilling and wonderful experience. That entire staff was very professional and welcoming. The aircraft was clean and ran smoothly. Despite a few bumps in the air, which we know is unavoidable, the flight was flawless and breathtaking. We highly recommend this to anyone considering or looking for something fun.

We had an amazing time on our flight today. Our pilot was the most generous, outgoing individual ever. It was a smooth ride and our pilot made it the experience of a lifetime. We will definitely be returning!
We took the Vista View tour just to give our 12-year old a taste of flying. Beautiful flight and a great pilot. We will be back for a longer tour.

It’s the best way to see the eruption devastation. The flight is one hour out and back, which is pretty short for the value.
It was so much fun. We went at night and it was beautiful. Our pilot Daniel was awesome! Definitely a great experience.

Just amazing! I was quite nervous to go considering I've never been on a small plane before and I get super nauseous often. We had a smooth day which was perfect. I wasn't nervous or nauseous as soon as we started! Most smooth take off and landing I've ever experienced from flying. The views were outstanding. Definitely an amazing experience!!

Super friendly and informative pilot. Would recommend to anyone even considering it! I didn’t know what to expect going into it, ended up having a blast!
This was our first prop plane ride and I’m glad it was. I wish I could remember the pilots name. If we’re back in town, we will try and do a different flight option!

The experience of a lifetime!!! Recomended to everybody, got to see amazing views of the volcano and many more things, will definitely come back the price is completely worth it!! Spencer was a great pilot and gave great information!

review_title: Wonder Waterfalls and A Beaitiful Sunset
review_text: Absolutely AMAZING tours. The waterfall tour was gorgeous at 6:00pm, flying back with the sunset was phenomenal. Our pilot was Taylor and he was superb, made us feel safe the whole way through, and had absolute control over the plane to give us the most amazing aerial shots possible. 100% ask for Taylor if you have the option to! Eagle-eyed and sure-handed, you'll get great pictures and amazing history info. (Plus he spotted Elk and a wedding from 2000ft. and got us great shots of both.
. Always room for improvement but actually a lovely ride ' our pilot was great and patient with passengers issues. Beautiful day
It was a fantastic flight, and I even flew the plane! Thank you Pilot Spencer for giving us such a memorable experience! Highly recommend if you're in the Protland area.

We decided to do a Sun River Day trip through Envi over labor day weekend. The booking experience was quick and easy, and Envi was happy to provide help with planning our activities once in Sun River. Incredible views flying both in and out of the Portland area, and the Envi Team was happy to work with us on departure times both ways. The best part of the experience by far was our pilot Davis. Davis was extremely knowledgeable, professional, and courteous. He answered all of our questions, and provided a sense of comfort. It was clear we were in excellent hands.

Thanks so much for the best trip we've had in Oregon, looking forward to more!

review_title: Amazing. A MUST if you’re visiting or a resident!
review_text: What an amazing experience! I got this as a gift from some friends and it was incredible. I went with my boyfriend and we went right at sunset and the views were amazing. Taylor was a great guide and pilot. He was super friendly and pointed out all the landmarks and sights while in the air.
Davis was our pilot & was fantastic.  Entire experience from check-in to landing was wonderful.   Highly recommend, you can see so much more than by land.  Breathtaking views for a lifetime.

review_title: Great Flight to see Mt. Hood, Rainier, Jefferson and St. Helen's
review_text: Great flight to Mt. Hood and down the Columbia River Gorge.    Had excellent views of not only Mt. Hood, but Mt. Jefferson, Mt. Rainier, and Mt. St. Helens.   Had all we really wanted to see.    Tour was private with only my 14 year old daughter and I.   She loved it.   Pilot pointed out as many viewpoints and waterfalls as possible.   He answered all our questions throughout the flight.    We were at ease the entire time.   Highly recommend this tour.

This was such a fun experience! My friends and I came out for my birthday and it couldn’t have been more perfect. The sunset was beautiful and our pilot, Spencer, was amazing! He was really knowledgeable of the area and all the attractions we saw during the flight. 10/10 recommend!

review_title: A bird's eye view of mountains, rivers, and desert
review_text:
We chartered an airplane for a 3 hour tour of major sites in the area. We had a breath taking view flying over Mt. St. Helens. We also flew around Mt. Hood. The Painted Hills was spectacular from the air. To end our tour we took a leisurely ride along the Columbia River Gorge to see the water falls and the beauty of the terrain.
 Spencer, our pilot and tour guide, was an encyclopedia of information. He makes the trip fun, knowledgeable, and entertaining. We covered hundreds of miles of terrain and we did not have to drive. Some of the attractions would take hours of secondary road driving to get to them with a limited view. With Spencer at the yoke, we sat back and soaked up an experience we will never forget.
 Now that we have done it, we would recommend Envi Tours for any air tour you choose. They are nice people and they are easy to deal with. They have excellent follow up skills so we did not have to guess about anything. 
 Our trip was not cheap, however the memories we made that day we will take to the nursing home!
So, TripAdvisor contributors, this outfit has our seal of approval.

The flight was lot’s of fun. The pilot was awesome. I had a scared kid, and he’s clearly worked with kids before. He made a real effort to ease her comfort, and she had a great time. He was very entertaining, and friendly. Worth going again.

This flight over Mt St Helen's is AMAZING!  Spencer is a great pilot and explained what we were seeing and what occurred in May 1980.  The mountain was steaming in several locations - how many people do you know can say they flew over an "active volcano"!
Super gorgeous flight with lots to see. The weather was amazing and the pilot was very friendly and safe. We will come back for sure.
Don’t miss this amazing experience to see Mt Hood up close and personal. One of the highlights of our visit to the area. Totally a winner!!

The flight was absolutely stunning! Our pilot Spencer kept us entertained the whole flight! These guys go above and beyond to ensure your safety as well as ensure you have a fun flight no matter the weather or unforeseen circumstances.  Such a perfect date night idea!
Greatest thing I have done in the Gorge in the 45 years I have lived here.  A trip with memories thatvwill last a lifectime
This was amazing! Beautiful views. This was just an incredible experience. Our pilot was friendly and knowledgeable. The waterfalls were stunning!

We had an amazing time! Davis was our pilot and he walked us through everything before we took off. He was very knowledgeable of the area and pointed out everything. I was nervous before the flight, but he put my mind at ease. He’s an excellent pilot and we had a smooth flight from start to finish. Would definitely recommend this to anyone and would do it again!
Wonderful trip. Davis was a great pilot and easy to talk to. Was patient and knowledgeable of the area.
The entire trip was wonderful.  Davis was a great pilot.  Smooth take-off and landing.  Very friendly and knowledgeable.  We will do this again!

review_title: Wonderful Customer Service and Flying Experience!
review_text:
We had an absolutely delightful experience with Envi Adventures from checking in all the way till landing. Clay was very professional and ensured we were able to see all the nature beauty and points of interest from the bird-eye view without compromising safety. We had wonderful time during our flight to Mt. Hood and down the Columbia River Gorge.
We very much appreciated that safety was highly prioritized, yet we had a lot of fun. Highly recommend Envi Adventures!
Excellent experience. Davis was a fantastic pilot and the whole thing far exceeded my expectations. Highly recommend.

Great pilot!    Saw absolutely beautiful scenes!   Waterfalls were flowing and gorgeous!   Pilot was extremely friendly and helpful.    we also did a land tour of the gorge and this proved to be another way to view the area’s beauty!

review_title: Glory to God for His Creation! Seeing it like THIS is mind-blowing. ❤️
review_text: If you’re thinking about it. Do it. It’s a lot of money but worth every single cent. God’s creation is AMAZING and see His handiwork of mountains, waterfalls, the river, and THE SKY above the clouds during sunset 😍 put us in awe of our wonderful Creator. Glory to Him! I couldn’t help but softly sing “How Great Thou Art”. It was incredible and a view like this of this part of the country is usually a once-in-lifetime opportunity. Smooth ride and perfect host who was willing to talk as much as or as little as we preferred and was excellent at knowing what that was without us even having to say so. 100/10 recommend and will do it again if we have the chance!

It was an unforgettable experience. From the pilots helpful knowledge and skills of flying to the most beautiful views of the gorge. We are definitely coming back to do some different flights that are offered.

review_title: Got a new perspective on the City
review_text:
This was a gift to a friend (he sat in front seat). We’ve lived in Portland a long time, and so it was amazing to fly above the city at 2500ft and see all our neighborhoods and places we know from a new perspective. We went on a clear day with Sun low in sky to cast longer shadows. Flew above the Willamette up to Oregon City, around the falls and back. Definitely worth it! 
Took many pictures, and videos.
Pilot was friendly and knowledgeable.
You wear an over ear headset with microphone that they supply so you can talk to each other and get to listen in on pilots and air traffic. 
Lots of smiles. It was good experience.

review_title: Perfect adventure, well worth the price!
review_text: Planned a ride for my son's 12th birthday in April. I am a bit late getting around to writing my review and have since forgotten our pilots name, which is a shame because he was WONDERFUL! We took a short flight as I had no idea if my son would enjoy the experience nor how uncomfortable the plane might be. We all had an amazing time! You couldn't wipe the smile off of my son's face for at least an hour after. We allowed him up front to enjoy the view, see the controls, and ask about 1,000 questions of our patient and professional pilot. Sitting in the back was surprisingly comfortable (better than my husband's sports car!) We can't wait to try some longer trips to view the beautiful PNW from the air. I HIGHLY recommend Envi adventures!

It was our family’s first experience in a Cessna and our flight with Spencer far exceeded our expectations. He was a true delight to fly with and took our daughter under his wing, creating a magical experience for us all. We can’t wait to do it again!
I was a little nervous about flying in Small plane. However the staff were so friendly  and professional I felt right at ease. Great sights and very fun

Absolutely amazing experience! Chose to do a sunrise flight and Spencer, our pilot, made sure our experience was all around spectacular. It was amazing to see the falls from an aerial view and Spencer filled the flight with facts about the areas below. Would definitely book another flight experience with them!

We had to reschedule due to weather but it was so much better on the day we did it.
