This was amazing. Thankfully it was a perfect day to fly which made it that much more memorable. The entire experience was easy, professional but chill. I recommend 10/10.

My brother and I flew with Envi today. It was an exciting experience.
Corey and Davis made our adventure possible and one of a kind. Starting from customized flying time according to our free time to an amazing experience in the sky.

Highly recommended!

My boyfriend and I had an amazing time flying with Envi. Seeing the city lights at night was one of the highlights of my year and Clay was a great pilot and splendid tour guide! Would highly recommend!!!

Excellent flight and views. Spencer was a great pilot and guide. We got really lucky witht the light and weather so even though it was a late flight, we got to see lots of mountains and waterfalls. Highly recommend for anyone looking to do something unconventional and short over a weekend.
Great time. Professional pilot. Highly recommended. We had a short flight but got to see and experience a lot.

Absolutely incredible experience!! An absolute MUST DO whether you live in the area or are visiting. We’re from the Beaverton, Or area and it was so fun to see the greater Portland area from that vantage point. Our pilot, Clay, was so personable, professional, and knowledgeable! Such a great experience all around! We will absolutely be back for more flights with Envi!

review_title: Great way to start your day
review_text: Enjoyed an excellent first of the morning tour over downtown Portland/Gorge area. We have lived in Portland for over 30 years but have never experienced a flight over the area on a small private plane. Very enjoyable time with our pilot and tour guide, Clay. Would highly recommend.

review_title: 1 hour Mt Hood and Columbia Gorge tour
review_text: Had an amazing time getting a closer look at Mount Hood and seeing the Columbia River Gorge from a birds eye view. I’m a travel nurse working in the Portland Oregon/Vancouver Washington area so this was a great way to see all the beautiful landscape and changing of the leaves. My parents came out to visit from Pennsylvania and loved that we got to see so much in so little time with this tour. Had some slight turbulence along the way but our experienced pilot handled it like a champ. Couldn’t recommend this more! Very fun ☺️

What a wonderful travel experience!! 
I remember when Mount St. Helens erupted.  I was 5 years old.  
Flying around it was like a surrealistic dream.  Our pilot, Adam, was knowledgeable, funny & a great pilot.

review_title: Highly recommend the city scape at night
review_text: My friends and I had a great time getting a full planes eye view of the city scape at night. I thought I had flown above the city before because of other travels on larger airlines. This experience was so much more because it’s all about home. Oaks bottom park, my old building; the fox tower, and my favorite site: the bridges over a moonlit Willamette river. You should see it for yourself 😉

Incredible experience and great staff. We really enjoyed our flight with Envi and hope to be able to go on another flight the next time we visit Portland. We flew in the gorge past the waterfalls and saw Multnomah Falls and a glimpse of Mt. Hood near the end. Very beautiful and a great way to experience it. Thanks Envi.

review_title: This made me so happy! You should do it too!!
review_text: Ok, so the flight was so cool. We flew over Mt. St. Helens and just kinda freaked out because it was so amazing! The pictures on the website of the tour are incredible, but seeing it in person is even more amazing. I don't know what else to say except that it was the experience of a lifetime and can't believe I got to experience it!!! Our pilot clay was amazing and informative. Beautiful sight!!! Would highly recommend. Best time to go is at 8pm with the sunset.
wonderful safe and fun flight very highly reccomended for locals or out of towners- great experience- thank you!

Clyde was our pilot in the sky, when flying with Clyde the atmosphere and enthusiasm heightens the experience!  He pointed out hidden treasures and gave us a new perspective of the landscape we love, from 1,500 feet above.

Envi Adventures delivered beyond what we expected, the price was fair, the plane was extremely smooth and the professionalism was greatly appreciated.
My wife and I had a blast on our 3rd wedding anniversary.
Clyde, thank you very much!!! 
We will see you for the October flight to Mt Hood.

What a cool experience!  Took my 2 children on a flight with Spencer - amazing!  Not only was the scenery spectacular, but Spencer was a great host, guide, and pilot!  I'll always remember listening to the excitement of my kids as we taxied down the runway and took off for an unforgettable flight!!  Thanks for helping me make memories!!

Honestly one of the best experiences I have ever had!! The pilot was super informative and fun and we got to learn a lot about flying and saw an amazing view! Totally worth the price! We do it again in a heart beat!

review_title: Great value; a fun way to see Portland & Columbia River Gorge
review_text: Our family of four (two adults and two teenagers) greatly enjoyed our 75 minute Figure 8 tour on a Tuesday evening. When booking, we asked several questions via email, all of which were answered promptly and thoroughly. Though we had booked for the 5 passenger plane, we were informed the morning of our flight that that plane was out of service for maintenance and instead we would be going up in two 2 passenger planes. Our teenagers had a blast with Clay and the parents went up with Adam. Everyone was very friendly, took pictures of us with the planes and explained everything about our trip. We had good weather, hardly any turbulence, and nice visibility. We did a big loop over Portland, Oregon City, Vancouver and Milwaukie. And, also went up the Columbia River Gorge as far as the Bonneville Dam and back including seeing all the waterfalls along the way. Tour started from the small craft Airport in Troutdale, which was easy to find (35 minutes by car from downtown Portland during rush hour). There are bathrooms at the office and they offered us Capri Suns and Envi stickers. Checkin was fast with and online waiver that you complete at the office with a QR code. During the flight, sights were pointed out to us and we could ask questions and take lots of pictures. We thought this tour was a great value for the money. A fabulous way to sightsee and the perfect end to our time in Portland.
The views were incredible and Russell made sure that we felt safe and comfortable the entire time. It was an incredible experience and I can’t wait to go up again!

Got this as a Father’s Day gift for my partner and his daughter (14) I hate flying so wasn’t planning on joining them.  We needed up having to delay our trip, they were very accommodating! I ended up going with them an so glad our did - it was fantastic!

Our pilot, Spencer, was amazing.  He took the time to explain everything to us. and to point out all the sites. Our 14 year old wants to be a pilot.  He was so knowledgeable and really encouraged her and gave great tips for what path to follow.

We couldn’t have been happier with the experience. Would recommend to anyone even those who don’t like flying!

First I'd like to say thank you to our pilot Adam, who made the trip a great experience. We took our granddaughter on her first flight for her 9th birthday. She sat in the front seat and took hundreds of pictures. All the time Adam was providing details about the area and Mt. St. Helens. The looks on her face before, during and after are priceless.

This was well worth the price and we would do it again... we have 2 more grandkids for future flights.

review_title: A beautiful experience for my daughter and I
review_text: First off, what a great group of people. Everyone was extremely friendly and helpful. We really appreciate it. My daughter and I flew up to Mt. St. Helens on a tour and had the most wonderful time. Our flight was smooth and the pilot did an amazing job at communicating with us and sharing with us his knowledge of the area that we were flying over. I can’t recommend Envi Adventures enough and thank you to them for such a beautiful experience.

review_title: Can’t wait to go back! Great flight and great company.
review_text: Went on a flight up to Mt Hood with my daughter and loved it. Flight was smooth and the view of the mountain was unbeatable. The crew at Envi was incredibly friendly, smart, and thorough. A very well run operation which left me very impressed. No hesitation to recommend this company. Make this a must do on your list.
Spencer was great! very polite and informative! 10/10 would recommend taking this version of a tour.

What an incredible experience! We thank Kyle Young, our professional pilot/Eagle Eyes.  We appreciated his humor, patience, skills, and gracious time up there. We saw way more than expected. Yay, marking this grand event off my bucket list.
Our pilot was very knowledgeable and kind. The flight was smooth and fun! I would recommend the evening flight because the sunset and the lights are so beautiful.

review_title: Great experience and service, but not properly advertised
review_text:
I first want to state that our pilot Spencer was wonderful in every way. He was very invested in our experience from start to finish, and my rating would be "excellent" if it only pertained to him. I'm being generous by saying "average," simply because I hate to reflect badly on him in any way.

I'm not sure if my complaint should be directed to TripAdvisor (who does not appear to have a way for me to contact them directly) or with the provider company Envi. The writer of this booking description did not prioritize the customer experience by providing accurate information. 

My brother and I booked this tour as a Father's Day gift for our dad - planning that all 3 of us would enjoy the experience together. We were specifically seeking a helicopter ride, and booked this trip only because it was advertised as such. Although we were asked to give the weight of one person at booking, I couldn't find any information that stated a maximum weight for the group. When we arrived, our first surprise was that we could not all 3 be included in the ride. Spencer was great, and he figured out a way to allow us to book a second trip so we could still all participate, though this doubled our cost. The second surprise was that this was a plane tour instead of a helicopter tour.

Spencer did everything in his power to make this a fun outing for us, but he couldn't turn his plane into a helicopter and he had to charge us for the second trip. We made the best of a pretty disappointing and unexpectedly expensive situation, but we will not be trusting TripAdvisor descriptions in the future.

The view was so breath taking and I loved seeing Multnomah Falls from a new perspective. My boyfriend and I were a little nervous, but our guide clay, was so wonderful. He eased our nerves, answered our question, was so friendly and sweet and fun. He really made the experience fun! It was a terrific experience, I highly recommend!

It was a very great experience to have a very competent and pleasant pilot at the controls Spencer was very  very good at his job and I felt very comfortable at all times. As a long retired private pilot with more than 1000 hous of flying I know that I was with a firsr class pilot The gift from my family for this trip was topped  by meeting a wonderful professional pilot.  Fred Schiller
Kale was an amazing pilot and host of the experience! We went for our anniversary and has a great time!

So incredible.  My wife and I loved every minute of the flight, the views were amazing, everyone at Envi was very nice, and we will definitely be coming back. Thank you for such a memorable experience.

Finally got to check something else off my list of accomplishments thanks to a smooth cruise in the air with Clay. Clay was super sweet and genuine with our flight! We loved every bit of it. 

Thank you!
We took the 20 minute downtown Portland tour with Clay. Clay was very knowledgeable and interacted with us thought the flight. We had a very smooth flight and enjoyed a romantic birthday weekend.
They are amazing there!! I highly recommend going on a tour!! The pilot is so awesome!! So much fun!!
Hands down, one of the best things ever! It was an incredible experience! It was so cool to see it from a different perspective!
Our airplane tour was amazing. We will definitely coming back to do the night city tour. We enjoyed every second of it. Our tour guide and pilot was extremely nice and made us feel safe.

review_title: THIS IS A MUST-DO IN PORTLAND!!! Such amazing views!
review_text:
I had booked with Envi Adventures when the snowstorm hit back in February cancelling everything and it was no problem to get a refund. The communication with the company was spot on. We rescheduled our Portand trip for mid April and the weather was PERFECT. We even opted to book a longer aerial tour with Envi. Everything was extremely professional. The booking process and follow up emails were perfect and even let us know that if nobody is at the counterwhen we arrive, just get comfortable because they are probably prepping the plane. There was also a sign inside letting us know the same information. Would have been confusing otherwise if we arrived to an empty business. 

Spencer met us at the counter and happily (maybe?! Lol!) entertained our five year old as she followed him around outside chattering to him while he put fuel in the plane and prepped it for us. She got to sit in the front seat and "fly the plane" which she was super excited about and now says she is a pilot. 

We felt very safe and being somewhat familiar with aircraft, knew we were in good hands. The Cessna is not a luxury private jet. It's a simple aircraft, yet very safe. For people not familiar, it can look a little rickety but it's well maintained, comfortable. 

Spencer gave us a great and informative tour of the gorge pointing out waterfalls, mountains, and landmarks with some interesting history of the area.....for us out of staters. It is well worth the price....if fact, it's a bargain and if we are ever in the Portland area again, we would gladly book another tour. I highly recommend this!!
This was an  awesome way to see the falls and the Columbia River. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and personable. The view from 1000 feet was exceptional.
This was my first time doing this. It was a fun experience for me. Awesome views! We got to see alot of dope water falls.
We had an amazing experience. The sunset flight was stunning. I loved how our pilot explained everything so we wouldn't worry about air bumps, etc. Absolutely recommend it!
What an amazing tour! Our pilot was so knowledgeable, confident and friendly. And the view... simply breathtaking. A must do when in the Portland area. 👍🏼
Had an amazing time today with my bf and his family. Would definitely recommend😁 The pilot did a great job making the flight as comforting as possible. Loved the dad jokes😂

Ask for Clay! Beautiful, short, thrilling way to see the city. We will be coming back. Clay was hilarious, attentive, and very sweet. Made our experience 100x better. The view was insane and the experience was so so worth it for the price.
It was awesome 😃 we really enjoyed it my sons was his first time and he really loved all the views and smooth ride

review_title: Great view, great pilot, and great experience
review_text: We were visited from out of town, and decided  to try something new. Best decision. We got Spencer as a pilot, and he was awesome. During the ride, he explained every super well, and made sure we were comfortable. The view was incredible. After the ride, he took some great pictures. Who knew he was also a photographer haha. This exceeded our expectations. Will definitely do this again when visiting. 10/10 would recommend to everyone.

We had an absolutely amazing experience. Spencer was an incredible pilot and was very eager to share his knowledge and passion for flying with our son. We are truly grateful for this family experience and cannot wait to book another future flight.
Very fun and got some great views. The pilot was cool and professional. Definitely would do again with one of the other tours they offer

Very satisfied with this tour! Spencer was amazing and very informative during the plane ride. Pointed out highlights of the town and historic sites. We felt very safe during the entire tour. Highly recommend this adventure.

5-stars well deserved. We had a wonderful time flying with Envi Adventures and highly recommend to everyone. My wife and I took the "Portlandia" tour right before sunset and had the greatest experience. It was beautiful. Thank you to the Envi team!
It was a great experience! We would definitely return for a different view. We totally recommend this 😃

review_title: Had a lot of fun on our fligh
review_text: I really liked it and had a lot of fun on our flight over Portland. My gf and I loved it. Will be coming back again. Deserves 10 star

review_title: So much fun! We loved it!
review_text: So much fun! We loved every minute of it. This was a great experience and very affordable. Would give more stars if I could!! Thanks Envi!

My wife and I went on a tour to Multnomah Falls and loved it. Great job to the pilot. Airplane looked great, pilot did great, and the views were great. Couldn't ask for anything better. Really fun company.

review_title: If you haven't done this, you should...now!
review_text: This was ABSOLUTELY INCREDIBLE! First of all it was super affordable, way more affordable than the helicopter tour business in Portland. Second, everyone we dealt with was super laid back, very helpful, and made us feel welcome, comfortable, and safe. The flight itself was amazing. Beautiful views, even when raining, and so memorable. Lot's of pictures for the gram! lol We will be coming back. It was so cool, and I highly recommend it to everyone!

review_title: Great aerial tour of downtown Portland(Bonus views of major mountains on the way)
review_text: This is literally the best thing you can do in Portland. There are others who also provide similar services, but the value for every dollar that you get here is simply great and others pale in comparison. Spencer is very knowledgeable, experiences and fun pilot. We saw breathtaking views of all the major mountains on the way to downtown and top view of downtown was only more breathtaking. We clicked some life time memorable pictures. I intend to repeat this activity when my parents are in the town, probably Multnomah and Gorge river tour next time.
Excellent Pilot!  Little windy and a little bumpy, but he explained exactly where and when we would experience turbulence.  Beautiful views up the Columbia River Gorge.

My friend Katie and I went on a flight the other day with Envi and I was a little scared at first but had so much fun! It was really so much fun and our flight over the Gorge was so beautiful. I have lived in Portland for most of my life and it was so neat to see the waterfalls from the airplane and it was so pretty. We had a great time. Thank you for the wonderful time Envi! I’ll never forget it.

review_title: Go flying! You won't regret it
review_text: Really fun and really nice people. We went when on our flight and in spite of the winds, our pilot did a really good job flying safely and making us feel comfortable. We will definitely be coming back, and if you haven't gone a flight, what are you waiting for!? Completely worth it.

review_title: Better than Vegas and the Grand Canyon
review_text: I don't know how this company doesn't have thousands of reviews. My wife and I had been on helicopter tours in Vegas and went on an airplane tour over the Grand Canyon a couple of years ago. They were all fun and the views were cool, but it wasn't cheap. My wife and I visited Portland and thought it would be fun to do something similar, shopped around a bit and found Envi. I can honestly say that the experience is not just worth every penny, but we got way more out of this flight than we did in Vegas and the Grand Canyon. It was such a good time and the price was completely reasonable. We highly recommend Envi if you're visiting Portland, or even if you live here. Book a flight if you haven't already.
This was an absolute highlight of our trip to Oregon. We would definitely recommend to anyone visiting to check out Envi. Worth the time and the money.
Great flight over the beautiful Columbia Gorge.  Thanks, Corey for sharing your local knowledge along the way.

Adam was great! He made us feel comfortable, safe, and he is super knowledgeable. We were nervous as soon as we got to the airport, but Adam was professional and a great pilot! What a smooth take off, ride, and landing! It was great to see Oregon and Washington from the skies!

Whenever I hear of a new business, I'm always a little skeptical of it. I never know what to expect, and even with reviews "how great can they actually be?" Envi was incredible. Flat out. The professionalism and amount of enthusiasm they have is refreshing. It's not forced and they genuinely seem to love what they do. The prices were great, the flight was great, and everything was perfect. I wish these guys the absolute best in their growth. They deserve it. This is a must do for everyone visiting Portland or living here.

review_title: WOW! This is a MUST do!
review_text: When you visit Oregon... this is a MUST do experience!  First, Cory was great getting us all set up and answering all our questions since we were in Florida and unsure about the trip.  Then when we arrived, our Pilot Adam put us right at ease.  Wow!  Very smooth take off and flight!  It was a bit cloudy to see all of Mt Hood but the rest of the trip was well worth it.  The Columbia Gorge was just beautiful and all the waterfalls were amazing. Loved this adventure!
Absolutely love these guys! Always a great time with friends. Highly recommend staff and pilots with excellent service all around. Very affordable and tons of fun!!!

I had planned an Envi Adventure for my boyfriend and I with the intention on doing something spontaneous. To my surprise, the experience that Envi Adventures had to offer completely exceeded my expectations. Prior to our scheduled flight, the team was receptive, communicative, and detailed about instructions for our flight. Adam was the pilot on our flight and he was warm, welcoming, and a total expert. Adam was awesome as he pointed out and explained the beautiful scenes. We highly recommend him and the Envi Adventures team for your next experience!

review_title: The best experience in Portland, hands down
review_text: Great service and great people. The level of professionalism was fantastic and compared to other air tours in Portland, by far the best value. We’ve flown on helicopter tours with another company in Portland before, and this was a much better price, it was a longer flight, and a lot more fun. Highly, recommend 10 times over. Will be back.

We loved our flight to see waterfalls along the Columbia River Gorge.  Spencer, our pilot, was really cool and professional.  He gave us few interesting insights about the area.    It was really cool activity that I recommend to anyone visiting this area.
Outstanding 18th birthday, very professional and personable. Very great air experience for first timers

Had a great nighttime flight over the Portland metro area! We were able to see all the city lights, bridges, buildings, and river. Spencer did awesome job flying & telling us a bit of history. Definitely recommend this trip!!

We have been waiting for over a year to fly with Envi Adventures, and they delivered! Our trip was expertly piloted, and very professional. The scenery was incredible; much easier to appreciate the close up views from a small aircraft than from a giant passenger plane. Would definitely fly again!
Flying over the Columbia in a private plane was an awesome experience. On top of that, we had the coolest pilot. Super professional and down to earth.

Spencer Engwall was amazing!! He was fun and very informative. It is much more affordable and a longer ride (20min) compared to others.  I would recommend Envi Adventures to anyone who is interested.  Envi Adventures we loved It. Thank you for the unforgettable experience. We will be back!

review_title: You have to book a tour! So much fun!
review_text: This was so special. At first, we thought the price was too good to be true, and we were beyond wrong. From the moment we arrived, our pilot made us feel comfortable and safe. We took the Figure 8 flight tour in the Columbia Gorge and Portland and loved every minute of it. The views were amazing and it was so much fun. We’ve gone on a helicopter tour in downtown Portland last time we visited, and that was fun but really expensive. We felt that we got way more out of this tour than that one. Highly recommend Envi to everyone. Fantastic.

review_title: Definitely the best deal, and totally worth it
review_text: I looked at doing a helicopter ride first with another place for me and my girlfriend, but the price was way too much money for the same thing that envi does. And honestly I think that the flight Envi gives is probably better anyway. Everyone was super chill, really professional, and the whole thing just seemed way better. They do a really really good job. Really recommend to everyone looking for a fun time.

review_title: An adverture that we will remember for a life time
review_text:
We diid the Quicksand Triangle Tour with Spencer, I don't know what else I can say about him, but will just echo what others have said. We had a great flight with awesome views, a great adventure indeed. I highly recomend Envi Adventures and will be back to do some of the other tours.

We all went as familly, no teens, but no other options to choose from : )

review_title: Photos do not do these views justice!
review_text: This was such an amazing adventure to share with my family (Side note: there is no option to select “Family [adults],” in this TripAdvisor review, so I’ll note that here. It was myself and my parents, no kids nor teens.) We had a nice clear day to fly over the gorge. I’ve lived in Oregon my whole life, and didn’t realize how many little ponds are hiding in the gorge that a lot of people can’t get to even via hiking. It was a bit windy but we didn’t mind. Spencer was our pilot and he was professional, knowledgeable, and friendly. We look forward to doing another scenic flight in the future.
We had an absolutely fantastic time! Pilot was friendly and super knowledgeable. I can't wait to plan my next flight! Sooooo much fun.

This is a must do if you’re alive and breathing. Absolutely breathtaking views, anything you pay is 100% worth it and don’t doubt it. Personally a must do if you’re a local or if you’re visiting. I would LOVE to make and emphasis on the pilot we had Spencer. An absolutely hilarious, knowledgeable, accommodating, cautious, kind person and more. Definitely will be flying with Envi Tours again every time I visit! Thank you Spencer for a ride i’ll always remember :)

Flight was smooth and the scenery breathtaking!
Pilot was awesome! So glad I booked this trip, worth every penny!

First of all, I want to really thank Corey for being superbly flexible. I purchased my tour 2 years ago and wasn't able to get time to utilize my ticket due to either the weather or other events. 

Corey not only made it possible that I could still attend my tour years later but provided such friendly, personable service! 

Next I want to thank our pilot, Spencer. His personality and education of the aircraft and the geography took what could have been a regular flight and made it an absolute joy. I was very nervous as it was my first small plane ride and he went out of his way to make my tour as comfortable as possible. 

Overall, I rate my experience with Envi Adventures a 10/10! It was super fun and an experience of a lifetime. You won't be disappointed with Envi, especially if it's your first time. 

Thank you!

review_title: A fun sky tour of the Portland and Gorge areas.
review_text: Just simply awesome!!!  Our pilot, Spencer, is knowledgeable, efficient, friendly and caring.  Safety comes first!  We did the Figure 8 private flight over Portland and the Gorge.  Learned a LOT from Spencer about the area - he is a book of knowledge on the Portland area.  This is the second such flight for my wife and I.  This time we took our daughter and grandson.  They will remember the adventure forever.  Awesome!

Weather changed our flight plans a bit, but our pilot Corey was really cool and still gave an awesome experience! Got to see things from a unique perspective that is highly recommended to all, even locals!

This business is awesome!  We took a sightseeing flight down the Columbia Gorge. Spencer the pilot was very knowledgeable and responsive to our needs during the flight.  I highly recommend this company! It was totally worth the money!  Thank you for a great experience.... it was a birthday gift to my wife!

review_title: Excellent views, must do for Locals & tourists
review_text:
Took my family on the wonderful waterfalls flight through the Columbia gorge. Our Pilot, Spencer, was instructive, kind and made us feel completely safe on the ground and in air. The ride was so smooth, my son fell asleep on the return and didnt even wake up during landing. Excellent flying skills, kudos to Spencer for the landing. 
It's beautiful to see the waterfalls from this view 1000 feet above the sky. A very unique experience that everyone should have if you're in Portland. I plan to return for another tour someday!
Super easy to book online. All your releases can also be signed online too to make the check in process smooth. 
Waiting area was clean, with a small refrigerator of complimentary drinks while you wait for your pilot to return from another trip. Restroom is available and also clean in the hanger area.
Easy location at the troutdale airport, parking right out front. You can't miss it. 
Our plane seated 6 total, including pilot. Very comfortable for all of us. The heaviest passengers sit in the back, but every seat offers a great view. We were all provided sanitized headsets, to hear and talk to each other during the flight. 
Highly recommend flying with Envi! If you haven't booked it yet, what are you waiting for??? This is an unforgettable experience for locals and tourists alike.

Due to the weather we were not able to make it up to Mt. Hood, but our pilot accommodated us and took us on an amazing tour!
Our pilot also shared interesting historical facts about the area as we flew over the gorge.

Had an excellent trip with our pilot Spencer. He was professional, engaging, and a great host to explore the Gorge together. We went with a friend who was a local, and he also thought the tour was fully worth it. Highly advise seeing Portland and the Gorge from above! Thanks again.

Fantastic ! This was such a special way to experience PNW. Our Pilot, Spencer, was a treat. Very accommodating with the perfect amount of commentary. He made the trip extra special. I'm just sorry it took me five years of living here to make it happen. I Will defiantly be returning, it's the perfect way to show out of town visitors what living in Portland is all about. Great service and incredible value!

review_title: Amazing Father’s Day with my son.
review_text: For the price, this might be one of the best experiences of my life. My 11 year old son and I had a great time. Our pilot made the whole thing so much fun and he made my son feel so cool by letting him sit up front and talking to him the whole time. I wouldn’t think twice to schedule another flight with them.

Spencer, our pilot was very down to earth and made us feel at home, He was very knowledgeable about the local customs , history and landmarks, which made the trip a lot of fun.
What I really appreciated was that he wanted us to have fun but safety was always first.
The scenery was amazing and if you've driven the Columbia Gorge even a handful of times, this will add a whole perspective to the drive.

review_title: Such an amazing view of downtown Portland.
review_text: Our pilot Corey to be honest. He was super polite and delivered an outstanding tour and brief history of Portland

What a wonderful experience!  Spence is top notch!  Not only a great pilot, but incredibly humble, personable and down to earth. He made us feel like we’d known him for years. We will definitely be back!  Thank you Spence for being so laid back and answering our questions, and being so knowledgeable!

review_title: You're missing out if you don't do this.
review_text: We had a great time! This was so much fun and we will definitely be back. My girlfriend and I booked a flight during a sale they were having and we'd pay 5x as much as we did! So worth it. So fun. And they were all so nice. Please do this. You won't be disappointed.

review_title: My first time flying in a small-engine airplane!
review_text: I bought a Groupon with Envi Adventures for a  private flight as a birthday gift for two of my sisters.  We had a fantastic time. The pilot, I believe his name was Spencer, was amazing, friendly, easy going, and made the flight a fun and laid back experience.  One of my sisters brought her Nikon, and Spencer would even guide the airplane in such a way as to allow her the best angle to photograph!  If you're a photographer, you might want to open the window for several shots, otherwise your photos will be a little fuzzy.
I had such an amazing experience! Professional crew with skills and I’m impressed with Envi overall! Get a tour! It’s more then worth it, these guys treat you with excellence!!!

review_title: If you want the flight of a lifetime, book Envi Adventures!
review_text:
As an Oregon native I thought I had seen it all, but boy was I wrong! People looking for something epic and outside of the box to do in our beautiful PNW will find exactly that on a flight with Envi Adventures. 

My friend invited me on a surprise sunset flight through the Columbia Gorge and Mt. Hood and I was BLOWN AWAY by the views of: 

- The Colombia Gorge 
- Mt. Adams 
- Mt. St Helens
- Mt. Reineer
- Sisters 
- INSANE CLOSE UP of MT HOOD!

The aerial perspective that you get of COLORs and shapes of the landscape are incomparable to anything we see at the ground level. 

And to top it off our pilot even offered for me to steer the plane! 

Whether your an Oregon native or tourist, if you want an adventure that doesn’t disappoint , I highly recommend booking a flight with Envi.

I bought a private flight as a birthday gift for my husband and we had a fantastic time. We had a friend who came along for the flight as well. The pilot was awesome, friendly, easy going, and made the flight a fun and laid back experience. We will definitely book another trip with them for another beautiful look at Oregon from above. We got to see stunning views of many of the surrounding mountains and rivers, can’t wait to do it again!! Thanks for the amazing adventure!!
Amazing experience! Would highly recommend! The views of the waterfalls, rivers, dams, and mountains were amazing! Our pilot was great as well!

I grew up here in Portland and went to the gorge every weekend basically. I’m as Oregonian as you can get, my blood is green, stumptown coffee infused and mixed with rain. I thought I knew my Gorge, but now seeing it from above, in a slight drizzle, cloudy, afternoon day, seeing the Gorge, I was speechless. It was all green, the water was blue, everything was perfect. I highly recommend taking a flight from Envi. It was perfect. Absolutely beautiful. Take the flight. Bring your friends, make some awesome memories and take some beautiful photos. Absolutely worth every penny I worked for to fly!

This was a very special thing to do! My partner and I went on a flight tour with Envi Adventures through the Columbia River Gorge, and we had an amazing time. Thank you to Envi Adventures and crew for the wonderful hospitality and wonderful experience.

review_title: Amazing!! Amazing!! Amazing!! Oh, and it was amazing!!
review_text: Terrific experience all the way through. Corey was so friendly when guiding us through the options and the booking process, and he even gave us an extra discount because “we were patient”! Lol How cool is that? The flight was amazing, and we only paid $23 per person. That’s insane! We flew over Portland and loved every minute of it. Wish it was longer and will definitely be back for other flights. Compared to the other air tours we looked at in Portland, I don’t know why anyone would choose more expensive options for less of an experience.

review_title: Fabulous experience all the way through
review_text: We were highly impressed with Envi Adventures.  For such a small company and small team, you can tell they take great pride in their business. The flight was amazing, with great views of waterfalls like famous Multnomah Falls and the rest of the Columbia River Gorge. To me, it just seemed like they put a lot of thought into every aspect of the experience. Beyond just the flight, they make you feel welcome and excited from start to finish. Great company that should have people lining out the door. Wonderful.

review_title: Portland is beautiful from an airplane!!
review_text: Wonderful time flying with Envi. This was so beautiful and fun. My friends and I flew over Portland at night and we loved it. I'm really excited to come fly again. Very special experience.

Have you ever wanted to see portland and the Columbia river gorge from a whole new point of view? This is the company to fly with. Meticulously maintained equipment, friendly, engaging pilots and the best views in town! 10/10 would recommend. Even for new/ first time fliers.
Had a great time with my friend. We enjoyed the flight and beautiful views. It was an amazing experience and lots of fun. Honestly breathtaking getaway!
My  friend and I had such a great time and enjoyed every moment of it! Great customer service and beautiful scenary.

review_title: By far the best option in Portland
review_text: Envi was a breath of fresh air. My husband and I were originally looking at going on a helicopter tour from downtown Portland from another company but after bad experiences with customer service we found Envi and decided to see if it would be any different and it was amazing. They were beyond helpful the prices were way more affordable and the experience was longer. Much better value for your money! Our pilot was so nice and really good at what he did. We can’t recommend Envi more. 10/10 all the way and so much fun.
We had the best time, would definitely recommend! Beautiful views, awesome pilot! All around amazing experience!

review_title: One of the best moments of my life
review_text: Great customer service, very professional company. Spencer was our pilot and he was amazing! 10/10 would recommend over and over again. The views are amazing!

I heard rumors about these magical flights that take you on tours of Oregon 🌲✨
I’m always down for an adventure, so naturally, I decided that ONE DAY, I would check that bucket list wish off and take a private airplane tour at Envi Adventures 🛫
Today was nothing short of a miracle as I was able to go on not one, but two flights — once to catch the sun setting around the glorious Mt. Hood 🌄 and the second to see Portland’s nightlife brag the city lights 🌃 Not only were the views breath-taking and inspiring, but I felt safe and comfortable the entire time.
Both of my adventure flights were piloted by Spencer — 10/10 great guy!

This was an experience to remember. Can’t wait to go on another adventure with Envi ✈️

A couple of my friends and I decided VERY last minute to go on a late night flight over Portland. BEST. DECISION. EVER. I cannot stress enough how awesome our pilot Spencer was! He was really nice and down to earth. He made us feel at ease the entire time. I will definitely be booking another flight very soon!

review_title: You need to do this! INCREDIBLE!
review_text: What an incredible experience! Spencer was not only friendly and welcoming, he was also very informative and knowledgeable. The sights were breathtaking and it was a very surreal and relaxed experience. And absolutely BEAUTIFUL! This is affordable and worth every single dollar. We planned it as a spur of the moment activity and it turned out to be one of the best spontaneous adventures we have ever done. We will be back in the summer for another tour. If you’re looking for something to do, please do this!! It will be worth it!!

We did the wonderful waterfalls scenic flight in early February and could not recommend it more. Was an absolute amazing experience, with an exceptional staff. If you are in the Portland area it’s worth the short drive to Troutdale. Envi Adventures truly has something special going on. Could not recommend more.

Spencer was incredible, very accommodating and super knowledgeable about the area. And the cherry on the sundae, seeing the gorge and beyond from bird's eye view. Not something that you get to experience everyday, unless you're the Envi crew!

Thank you, thank you!!

review_title: Thanks for a great flight and tour!
review_text: We bought a tour for my son, a lover of all things aeronautical. We lucked out that the skies opened up for the first time in a couple of weeks, giving us some nice clear conditions. Unfortunately, the wind picked up, so we were told that it wouldn't be safe to take the Waterfalls tour. Rather than coming back for safer conditions, my son decided that he'd be happy doing a Portland tour. The pilot, Spencer, was extraordinarily considerate in suggesting that the wind might cause some air sickness and gave my son a garbage bag in case. Fortunately, it was not needed - the flight was pretty smooth flying to downtown Portland. It was great to see a lot of familiar landmarks from overhead. Spencer was a great guide and pilot. Afterwards, he and my son were able to geek out a bit about planes and he gave us a couple of suggestions for good airplane museums that we hadn't been to. I would recommend and might go ahead and do the Gorge tour when the conditions are more favorable.

Gosh, this was so cool!! Me and 3 of my friends went on a flight over Portland and it was so much fun. Pilot was really nice, the airplane ride was really smooth, and flying over city was so cool! Will be back in the summer.
Really fun Portland activity and very affordable. We drove by the waterfalls before we did our tour and then seeing them from the airplane was cool. Would defintiely do this again.

This was a great experience for me and my family. We took the tour of the Columbia Gorge and saw all of the waterfalls. My kids who are 5 and 9 loved flying in the airplane and looking out the windows. The customer service here was top notch and everybody we interacted with was very friendly and helpful. We saw other tours in Portland but the price was significantly more for the same thing, and I can’t imagine it being better than what Envi offers. From the moment you walk in the door, they have put a lot of thought into the entire experience making you feel very comfortable and excited to go flying. Highly recommend for anyone. This was great.
the reservation of this trip was a breeze. Getting there was even easier. The very intimate nature of this experience was the stand out feature of this place. I highly recommend to anyone!

Learned about Envi Adventures from a friend. They had an event with s'mores and $15 airplane rides around the airport. The s'more were really, really good and the flight was a lot of fun! Fun company with a lot of really nice people. Hope they have more events!

The family LOVED our waterfall tour with Envi! My son turned 5 the day before and this was his first flight. The pilot was so friendly and accommodating to my son (and my girlfriend & me) that the whole ride was a very relaxing and memorable 1st airplane ride for him. His narrations, descriptions, and assurances went a long way toward my son’s positive association with airplanes. Since my son is 46”, he couldn’t easily see out the side windows of the plane. Without any of us asking, he banked the plane so he could see below. Very thoughtful! Love these guys and would definitely go here again. Also, it was the best price by far that I could find anywhere for a 3-person, 40 minute tour!
Our flight was canceled due to thunder and lightning. Grateful they were cautious.  We have not received our refund as of yet. Waiting for response.
Everything was great about this. The employees at Envi were terrific, the flight was super cool, and the price was way better than I expected. Highly recommend and will be back to do other flights.

review_title: You HAVE to do this! So much fun!
review_text: Wow...just wow! I don't usually leave reviews, but this was so much fun! We're from Austin, Texas and this was our first time in Portland, so we were absolutely stunned by how lush and beautiful the Columbia Gorge was. Envi was incredible and we loved every single minute of it.

Had a great trip to Mt. Hood and back through the Columbia gorge.  I had my nine year old son got to sit in the front seat and help pilot the plane.  Guide was great.  seeing Mt. Hood up close was amazing.  Would definitely recommend using Envi Adventures.

Three of us - all native Portlanders - took the Figure 8 tour of Portland and the Gorge and absolutely loved it. I think we were all a little concerned getting into such a small plane, but as soon as took off and got settled, all we thought about was the view. Really great experience.

Envi Adventures was a great host to the Travel Massive PDX group. Offering short introductory flights around the Troutdale Airport, they showed us how to create a unique sightseeing experience. If you’ve done it all and seen it all on the ground, don’t miss this opportunity to get a bird’s-eye view. It’s like no other!

We LOVED seeing the gorge from above. Such a beautiful & unique experience being able to fly with Envi! We've been visiting the gorge for over 12 years but this was a breathtaking new perspective. Don't let the fall + winter weather keep you away! We're already planning our next trip once the leaves start to turn. The Envi crew is knowledgable and we felt totally safe. CANNOT wait to get up in the air again!

review_title: Real talk. This is an experience you can’t miss!
review_text: We had an amazing time at Envi Adventures. Corey is phenomenal to work with and he will make sure you’re taken care of! The experience of seeing the Columbia River Gorge at sunset was one of the best experiences I’ve ever had in Portland... and I’m a local! This is a great gift (they do gift certificates!) or for special occasions. If you’re visiting Portland, take the 15min drive to Envi Adventures and do it for the gram!!!

This was our first time in Oregon and we loved our time with Envi Adventures. We didn't want the flight to end. It was a cloudy and raining, and we weren't sure it would be as fun, but we were happy to be wrong! Absolutely wonderful time.
The tour was really beautiful and everybody at Envi was very nice and helpful. We really enjoyed out time here

So much fun! Went with a few friends and had a blast. Cory was so nice and helpful in getting this booked for us, and our pilot was really laid back and fun to fly with. Flying over Portland was really pretty too lol

review_title: The Gorge is beautiful from the air!
review_text: I was worried about flying, but the pilot had many years of experience and education, and the flight went so smoothly.  He was very personable and pointed out all the things we were flying over, and one hour seemed like a few minutes!  The Gorge is beautiful, this is a flight not to be missed!

I’ve flown with them twice so far and both times it was an incredible experience! The pilots were awesome and very knowledgeable. They take the time to answer all your questions and make you feel safe. Both tours were incredibly beautiful too! All in all, highly recommend flying with them! They’re an awesome team!

review_title: Great family adventure; will definitely go again.
review_text: Fun and friendly pilot, I felt safe and relaxed. A great time! We went over Vista House and Multnomah Falls. Well worth it!
I went of my first tour and it was everything I expected and more. Will definitely be going back for the rest of the tours.
My sister, father and I thoroughly enjoyed our trip. It was so fun to see everything from a new perspective, and we always felt safe and taken care of. 10/10 would do again.

Had a great experience!
Would definitely recommend to friends and family. Thanks for making our birthdays special.
The pilot was very pleasant and made the flight over the gorge awesome.   Made my birthday an awesome day

Such a great experience with my family. My boys loved wearing the cool headphones and getting such a cool view over Portland and Mt. Hood. This was a gift from my family for my birthday and what an amazing experience this was with them. Would definitely recommend to others.

The plane was really old, the engine wasn't starting the first time, there was holes in the seats, there was trouble closing the doors, and it was overall very uncomfortable ride and the view wasn't good either. The model of this plane was 1973 with a very bad engine, I'm surprised how this plane is allowed to fly in this plane. The plane had rust inside and out, we are just happy to land safely on the ground.Waste of money and I don't recommend this to anyone!

While weather conditions made us take a different route, the pilot had a backup plan that was just as good as the mountain view route! Was a great way to kick off a wedding weekend for a bunch of buddies all coming together in Portland, definitely recommend it for a small group, or if you just want a different perspective of the city!

We had a fun time doing wonderful waterfalls. I would be coming back for a quicksand tour. I had some questions on the tour and communication was quick and professional. I recommend everyone to try flying with envy
We had a great time!  Beautiful scenery and nice pilot to guide us!  Would definitely go again, one of the longer trips next time!

Spencer took us up for our flight. He was very personable and knowledgeable about the area telling us all kinds of neat facts about the sights. He seemed like a great pilot and a great guy and if we are ever in the area again will be sure to request him so we can get that downtown tour.

We arrived early, they took us up early. They reassured us of the safety. They were friendly and sociable but respectful of enjoying the peacefulness of the flight at the same time. Reasonable rates, it was such a great experience.

My two daughters and I have all seen the Columbia River Gorge from ground level, but it's even more beautiful from the air.  Not only was he a great pilot, but Spencer had lots of interesting tidbits about the many water and rock features we saw today.  Next time, Mt. Hood!

I was nervous about flying in a small plane, but the pilot was really capable, and the entire trip was delightful.  I could see the homes and fields and then the mountains, Mt. Hood, Lost Lake, the Bridge of the Gods -- awesome!  It was really something to see where the big fire from a couple of years ago burnt.  However, it was pointed out that it has come back a lot, even since spring, so that was good to hear.  The entire trip seemed like it was a second instead of an hour!
This was an excellent way to see Oregon - the trails, waterfalls, gorge etc.  The plane ride was also a lot of fun.  Our pilot was “Kale” and he was fantastic and knowledgeable.

It was such an amazing flight. Didn't catch the name of our instructor but he did a great job of flying us by all the views. Only thing is I wish it was longer! Would definitely gladly go back and recommend booking a private flight.

We flew with Devyn in June and absolutely loved it! Unfortunately, we weren't able to go out to Mt. Hood due to the weather but we did get a peak at her while we were in the gorge! Such a stunning flight. Portland is a beautiful city and has so much beauty surrounding it. I'm an Oregon native and would recommend to anyone that's new to the city, visiting or locals!

We did the Portlandia and Wonderful Waterfalls tours.   Spencer, our pilot was a very awesome pilot.  We felt very comfortable flying with him.  Seeing all the bridges on the Willamette on the Portlandia tour made for an awesome picture. We also saw Mt Hood, Adams, Helens and Jefferson.  Sisters and Mt Rainer is possibility but we had a few clouds on the fringe.  This is a great way to see Portland!!!
Spencer was fantastic. We really enjoyed our adventure!! Very informative and made sure we knew all about the are. We will be back.
Epic time flying over Portland. We went at sunset and the views were incredible, the pilot was great, and the flight was amazing. Totally will be going again. Envi is awesome!

Ever since we went, I have been telling everyone what a great idea this is for a gift. Very friendly, safe and entertaining pilot. If you have never been a plane this small, it really is not anything to be afraid of. It actually feels safer than a huge passenger jet in a way as you can see more of what is going on with the plane and it's movement through space. Anyway, excellent little afternoon adventure!
Excellent tour! Was nervous about being in a small plane but Garrett the pilot made it such an enjoyable flight. Would take another tour next time I'm in Portland.(:

review_title: Great host and even greater experience
review_text: Flying over the Columbia Gorge is a must-do in itself which Spencer, our host and pilot, made even more enjoyable. A truly memorable experience!
Amazing birthday present! The pilot- Spencer- was friendly and knowledgeable and flying was soo fun!! Breathtaking view!
Great experience and an amazing way to see the Gorge. Our pilot was friendly and engaging, asked to make sure we weren't nervous or uncomfortable, and led a great tour through the area.

review_title: Amazing from start to finish! What a great company!
review_text: Found these guys on Trip Advisor when planning our trip to Portland. They had great reviews and now I see why! Amazing service before, during, and after the tour. Seriously awesome. These guys do it right and can't believe people aren't lining out the door to fly with them. The prices are amazingly affordable and the flights they offer are stunning.

Un survol inoubliable. Départ de la banlieue de Portland, direction le Mount Hood. Vue sur le Mount St Helens, Le Mount Baker, la Columbia River Georges, les cascades.
Tout simplement magnifique et inoubliable.

Totally worth it. My pilot was fantastic. I had a blast and would definitely do it again...Just keep in mind that the plane is tiny. Not sure how 3 people (plus the pilot) could fit in there comfortably.
Gave this to our daughter for her birthday. She LOVED it!  Garrett was a great pilot!! Thank you Envi Adventures!
Had a wonderful time going up the Columbia! Our pilot was very friendly and explained everything we were seeing as well as answered all our questions about the sweet little plane we were in.

I enjoyed every second of my trip with Envi. The team, the location, and the overall experience is amazing. I have done many of these plane flights as a professional photographer and this was one of my favorites! Thanks again guys!

review_title: Great, but small plane !  Worth doing !
review_text: The plane is small and hard to get into if you on the heavy side. Hard to get a good photo without the wing struts getting into the way. Feel safe in the plane ! The pilot was friendly ! Would do again if they had a longer flight that went around the mountains ( Mt. Hood or Adams ). Teens and small kids I think would like it !
Enjoyed our flight over the waterfalls a lot! We ll do I again but this time over the Portland city.
Great flight with smooth take off and landing. Awesome pilot. Amazing price. We plan on returning for a longer flight in the future.

amazing time thank you corey and our awesome pilot spencer! even for this fearful flyer felt very safe and so glad I did this! give this small loca
business a chance!!!
Perfect flight great weather and a very helpful pilot made for a great birthday sightseeing experience

review_title: Wish it was longer! So amazing
review_text: Loved every minute of it. Wish it was longer! Multnomah Falls was so cool to see from the airplane. Pilot did a fantastic job, made for a very smooth flight, and helped us enjoy the flight even more by pointing out cool stuff we would have otherwise missed. Easy booking online, great prices, and everyone we talked to at Envi was so nice and helpful.
Oh my gosh, this was so cool! I grew up in Oregon and seeing Portland from an airplane was so amazing. Can't wait to go again!

We took a flight in the gorge with Envi to Multnomah Falls, and it was absolutely stunning. We looked at a few other scenic flight businesses in the area, but for the price and the experience, Envi was the best option. Very friendly staff too.

review_title: Great prices and an amazing experience
review_text: Absolutely wonderful from start to finish. Booking was very straight forward and easy, prices are very reasonable. We loved that the flight was private and we knew we would have the airplane to ourselves. We did a sunset flight over Portland and it was breathtaking. We would love to do a flight in the Gorge and up to Mt. Hood next! It's a great activity for locals and for people from out of town.

To everyone looking for a memory to last a life time,

I will never forget the tour we had of the gorge the other day! 

I surprised my boyfriend with the best birthday present ever 🤗

Not only were we celebrating his birthday, half way into the tour, I revealed to him that we are going to be expecting our first baby!

I will never forget Cory and Spencer for their awesomeness and ability to deliver such an amazing experience for people!

Thank you 😉

This was SO MUCH FUN! The gorge is such a beautiful area and this was a wonderful way to see it. Spencer and Cory were so friendly and the flight was so smooth! I would recommend this company to anyone looking for a unique way to see Portland’s nature spots.
My wife and I did tube figure 8 loop and it was one of our favorite experiences.  We will be doing more flights in the future.

I was scheduled for the Waterfall flight but it was too windy and so the flight was over Portland. It was a great experience, I felt comfortable and safe! It was easy to find and visiting with Cory and Garrett was easy and enjoyable.

review_title: very beautiful views and amazing customer service
review_text: I absolutely loved everything about the experience. Pilot was super friendly and made us feel safe. Communication between the company and us before flight for signing of waivers and other material was very efficient and made the whole process super easy nd convenient. Pillot was very informative about sights throughout the flight which was very nice. Would definitely fly with them again and recommend to anyone looking for a fun, safe and calming experience. Perfect for families, and planes were very spacious making for a very comfortable flight. :")

My wife and I took the Figure 8 flight that takes you on a tour into the Columbia River Gorge and then tracks back over the city of Portland. We were able to fly close by the Vista House, Multnomah Falls (as well as a bunch of others) and over Bonneville Dam. The view of all the mountains in the region was spectacular. We then circled back to Portland where we flew directly over the control tower at PDX and then over the the bridges and skyscrapers downtown. This is a fantastic tour of the area that you really need to do at least once! Our pilot, Garrett, was exceptional and helped make our trip very enjoyable.

Unless you've taken flight lessons, this is a sure-fire way to spend a unique hour anticipating, admiring and getting an unparalleled view over the Columbia River Gorge and I-84. The Envi lobby presented with class on a cozy scale, quickly followed by the first sight of our wee plane and the photo-op moments. With two teenagers on board and an amiable pilot, our flight was smooth and memorable and the perfect gift it was meant to be. Completing online waivers ahead of the flight was efficient and easy. It's easy to recommend this for families and teens, local and visiting, as a special outing over land and river in this special place.

This was definitely a highlight of my trip to Portland! Garrett was super nice and relaxing to be around, I felt very safe and the plane was super cool! I highly recommend this to anyone who decides to visit the city!
Loved it! Trip up the gorge was beautiful. I felt super safe. Our pilot was friendly and competent. Can't wait to go on another trip!

Had an incredible flight! Seeing the Gorge from this perspective gives a whole new respect to how beautiful and vast it is, especially all the waterfalls! (There were more than expected) You can even see far off into both Washington and Oregon. The Pilot was professional, knowledgeable, funny, and overall made the trip exciting. Originally, the flight was supposed to be a day before, but Envi knows their stuff, and due to weather, recommended we fly the next day; I'm glad we did, the weather was perfect! I will definitely be flying with Envi again, next time the Figure 8 flight path, so that I can see the beautiful gorge again, but also to get some great shots of Portland!
My first flight in a Cessna and it was more than great. Our pilot was very friendly and full of information and the flight itself was awesome!!!!

I had a great treat flying with Envi Adventures on my birthday. The small plane seat 4, so my group of 3 was a perfect fit. I was able to sit in the co-pilot's seat. Our pilot Rick was friendly, knowledgeable, and provided a great ride. We were able to see the Columbia River Gorge and multiple waterfalls, as well as beautiful fall foliage. Such a unique and fun experience.
Had to wait out a storm passing by but it was completely worth it. The vista view flight was breathtaking. Thank you thank you thank you!!!

review_title: A unique perspective of the Gorge
review_text: I've driven through the Gorge and also have hiked the trails, but I haven't seen it from a small plane at lower altitude before.  Definitely an interesting and different view.

review_title: Wonderful Waterfalls in the Columbia Gorge
review_text: We really enjoyed our flight over the Columbia river gorge and the numerous waterfalls. The view was spectacular and our pilot Rick pointed and positioned the plane for capturing the best views. Amazing experience!

review_title: A new perspective on our own backyard!
review_text: My wife purchased this flight as a gift for my birthday this year and it was an absolutely amazing experience! We chose the Gorge and Waterfalls flight, which lasted about 45 minutes total. We took off out of Troutdale, flew up the Gorge past Vista House, Multnomah Falls, the burn from the last years big fire. We turned around at Cascade Locks, flow over Skamania Lodge, and circled around Beacon Rock on the way back. I've driven through the Gorge plenty of times, but this was so cool to see it from the air. Our pilot was great (Devin I think? Sorry, I've spaced on your name!) was great and informative and totally competent. This was my first time flying in a smaller Cessna, and I felt at ease during the flight. Awesome experience, whether you are here vacationing, or as a local looking for a new view of your backyard. Highly recommended!
Booked the day before. Pilot was super cool and knew a lot about the area we were flying over. 10/10 would recommend!

I had an incredible experience! The pilot made me feel very safe and explained everything clearly. He also asked if there was anything in particular that I wanted to see so I could get everything I wanted out of the experience. The views were beautiful!! This was the first time I have ever been in a small plane and I would definitely do it again. Highly recommend!
Excellent flight and very polite. Deven was super friendly and on time. Also very knowledgeable about the area
I surprised my husband with a waterfall flight, we ABSOLUTELY loved it!! The pilot was fantastic. It was very exciting for us to see The Gorge from a different perspective!

We are locals and know many of the sights we flew over quite well, but it was fascinating to see them from the air and discover features (lakes, buildings, geological features, sand bars) one can't see from the road, the water, or on a hike. It was also very interesting to see the extent of damage and recovery from last summer's Eagle Creek fire. Anyone interested in the geology of the area (lava flows and floods) will be fascinated by the aerial views. The pilot pointed out a number of things and kept up a running commentary throughout the flight, though as a relatively new transplant to the area he generally wasn't as familiar with the sights as we were. The weather was rather hazy so unfortunately we had no mountain views and it wasn't great for photography, but it was still a very enjoyable experience and we wished the flight duration had been longer. We would like to do the same flight again in the spring when there is more water in the waterfalls and hopefully clearer skies, as well as the Mt. Hood flight. This is definitely a memorable experience which we would recommend to others - and already have done so!
Informative.  Everyone enjoyed.  Great take-off and landing.  Smooth flight.  Even the one nervous passenger enjoyed it!
This was a great experience!  Multnomah Falls from the air looks so different!!!  Weather cooperated.  Pilot was great.  Highly recommend the experience.

Unfortunately the cloud ceiling in the Gorge prevented us from doing most of the trip. However, the pilot, David, made a big fuss showing my 5 year old grandson the plane, let him touch the instruments and talking with hm on takeoff and landing.  He dubbed himhis copilot and helped fill out a pilot log that thrilled my grandson.  So the rating reflects all of David’s great work and the crappy weather conditions.

We had the greatest flight over the Gorge/Vista House! My husband & I surprised my best friend for her birthday and we experienced the most beautiful sunset! The views were absolutely incredible; witnessing the Vista House from above was breathtaking. We had such an amazing time & our pilot, Devyn, was a blast! We are definitely planning on flying again soon!!

David was an excellent pilot and from the moment I got into the plane I felt comfortable and at ease!  The views were spectacular and the weather cooperated and I loved every minute of it.  My friend lived in Cascade Locks many  years ago and was so excited to fly over her old neighborhood.  My family are into TNE's (totally new experiences) and this is one birthday present I won't forget!

It was a very memorable experience. You can’t go wrong with a smooth flight and a breathtaking view. It was the perfect thing to do on a date with my husband. The pilot was did an awesome job at explaining and making sure we were comfortable. We are like ok’ing forward to the other rides and places they offer! Definitely will be back . Thank you envi adventures!!!

review_title: Great views of Mt Hood and the Columbia River Valley
review_text: Tour should be called 'Mountains and Rivers'.  Great views of Mt Hood and the multiple peaks of the Cascades, as well the river and Bonneville Dam.  Able to see so much in a short period of time and felt very safe through the entire experience

review_title: A perfect flight, must to do in Portland
review_text: We made Quick sand triangle at 8 pm. We had beautiful light. Flight was very nice. The pilote is very good. We landed with wind, but He made a very smooth landing !!!

We took an 8pm flight in late July hoping to catch a nice sunset in addition to the falls and we were not disappointed (I’m sure it’s getting even better as the days get shorter)! Our pilot, David, was very funny, full of interesting information, accommodating, and made us feel at ease. We even left something behind and one of their staff met us at about 9:30pm to give it back to us — wow!! Too sweet! Definitely recommend the tour and the company!
My husband and I celebrated our anniversary with Envi Adventures. It was an amazing experience! We will definitely be flying with Envi again!

The views were incredible and our pilot was awesome. What was also really appreciated was that he knew the history and kinda science stuff about the Columbia gorge. I can't wait to go back and do the other locations!

It has been a week since our “Quicksand Triangle” flight and we are still thinking about the views.  We had such a great time and a memory that will last a lifetime!  

Can’t wait to take the “Portlandia” flight next.

review_title: Do it!  Do it!  Do it!
review_text:
I purchased the waterfall tour as a gift to my husband for Father's Day with the idea of him sharing the experience with his 2 daughter's- after all it was for Father's Day ;)  After being together 34 years, there isn't much to give someone anymore that isn't just going through the motions. 

My hairdresser had been telling me about purchasing a plane tour for her husband's birthday and the conversation came back to me while pondering what I could do for my husband that was not the same old thing.  I asked her about it and she sent me a link. From there the process was all online, straightforward, and easy.

My girls were nervous about the small, 4 seal plane, but all 3 agreed it was an amazing experience and that I should not hesitate to purchase another package for them for another occasion. There are several to choose from so you just never know. It is actually good to know there is a gift option out there that actually gets the family excited again.

I should mention as well that the pilot was fantastic and we all enjoyed him.  He was personable and very willing to take the time to answer any questions we had. We didn't feel rushed to wind it up at all.

Last minute plan and so worth it. Had 17 year old with me and we all had fun. Great service and beautiful scenic flight. First flight in our life on Cessna, it was GREAT. Would recommend it to anyone. We both don't like flying and now we are hooked 💖😁👍👍👍Great pilot 👍
We flew with this company for the first time this week, and we’re definitely coming back! Devyn was kind and friendly, and very knowledgeable about local scenery. A very pleasant surprise!

review_title: So much fun, we never wanted it to end!
review_text: Full disclosure we found a deal on travelzoo for this flight and I was a bit skeptical at first, and even after we first saw the plane roll up. However, our pilot whose name I cannot remember (maybe David or something with a D) was so relaxed and friendly that we didn’t hesitate to jump in and go for our flight. Although it only lasted 20 minutes it was AMAZING! Such gorgeous scenery and we could see out all the windows, almost a 360 degree view! My cousin got a tad bit queasy for a second but it really only lasted a little bit. The rest of us were fine, a very smooth take off, flight, and landing! We absolutely LOVED IT! Our only regret was not extending it to include the waterfalls when he offered. It would have been at a considerable discount and doubled our flight time. Totally worth it! 👍
Pilot was very knowledgeable and friendly. Flight was smooth and overall simply great! Will definitely fly with them again.
That was a beautiful flight and the captain made a perfect landing. I can’t wait to fly again!! Thank you for the fun experience.

We had a great time!  Flight was on time, pilot was helpful & pilot.  We took the short 20 minute flight, but would have enjoyed staying up longer.
This is a great adventure for visitors to Oregon.

My husband and I always try and do something outside the norm when we travel new places. When we told everyone we were taking a plane ride over the Columbia river, they were shocked but I think secretly jealous. I mean how often can you say oh ya I saw the water falls from birds eye view! David, our pilot flew in and was ready to take flight. (Note to self we took the 10am flight, but would recommend the later ride Hereford you don’t have as much cloud coverage, none the less we still saw remarkable views) I am not the best with flights, but David was so nice and always making sure I was good. He recommend I sat in front not only for the front views but also bc it’s a lil smoother of a ride. The views, history and just peacefulness were amazing. I highly recommend to #flyenvi if you want to get a different point of view of the waterfalls! 
Thank you guys for an amazing experience :)

The flight was awesome.  The pilot was great.  A wonderful experience!  Would recommend to anyone either visiting and wanting to see the Columbia River Gorge or someone who has lived here all their life and wants to see the Gorge from a different perspective.

Me and a friend went for an event that they hosted called Free Flight Friday. Although we were a little apprehensive about flying in such a smaller plane than what you would fly in commercially - there was absolutely nothing to be worried about! Both the takeoff and landing were completely smooth, and we were lucky to have absolutely no bumps while in the air. The pilot was extremely knowledgeable about the area and made sure to point out things to keep our eyes out for. I am so thankful for this introductory flight and we're already planning on another one later on in the summer. Thank you guys for an awesome flight!

We had a great time seeing the beautiful waterfalls and surrounding area from the air.
Smooth ride and literally time did fly by so fast. Had a great time.

Joined the Free Flight Friday event today in Troutdale, Oregon. It was an awesome flight. The guy, Cory, who owns this business is super friendly and professional. The pilot, Devon, did a great job with a smooth and awesome flight. Excited to grab some friends and try a longer flight out to the Columbia Gorge this summer! A definite must for anyone who is visiting Portland! Thanks guys for offering this event!

review_title: Among the best tours in Portland!
review_text: This tour went above and beyond our expectations. Our pilot was professional, informative and above all, fun to fly with. We were able to get much closer to Hood than we ever imagined and saw some spots in the Columbia River Gorge we didn't know even existed. Definitely a great tour for photographers, families.... ANYONE.
It was the perfect day. Our pilot Brian was amazing. You should do it, you will NOT be disappointed!!
So much fun! Great views and great insight. My girlfriend called it the best gift she has ever received.

We had a wonderful time seeing the waterfalls of the gorge from a completely unique point of view! As native Oregonians and Portland residents, we found this trip to be fantastic. We got some beautiful views and had a great pilot navigating us through our first time on a private plane. I'd definitely recommend this trip!

I was blessed to be able to send my husband, and my boys, on a flight that they never would have treated themselves to. The pilot arrived on time, let me snap some pictures, and answered all the usual mom/wife questions (how long you’ve flown, you’ll bring them back to me) silly questions like that. They then taxied, and flew off. Out on a flight, that I’ve heard about for days. Growing up in a small town, thinking life is small, makes you think your world is small. This flight, as they saw all the waterfalls, the mountains, the ground from above, and listening as the pilot knowledgeably explained the area, began to fill my 3 guys, full of gratitude for life, amazement that such beauty is taken for granite, and excitement to do other adventures. One of my guys, had never flown before, one wants to be a pilot, and my husband celebrated (he has health issues) that he got to mark something off his bucket list. So, thank you Envi, for giving my 3 guys the memories of a lifetime! I can’t thank you enough. We will be referring you to all of our friends, and family!
Coupled with the late pilot and extended time waiting to take off, half of our flight time vanished...yet we finished the tour on time. Simply the best disappearing act.
We had such a great time! Our pilot Devon was very cool and made the whole experience comfortable and easy. And the view was amazing!
Absolutely wonderful! An experienced guide who was knowledgeable about the Gorge and its notable landmarks, combined with a very nice loop up to Bridge of the Gods made this a very enjoyable trip.

review_title: Amazing Birthday Present - Scenic View, Perfect Weather, Nice Pilot
review_text: We went on the waterfalls tour, and it was gorgeous. They canceled due to weather during our original date, and we were so glad they did, because we ended up coming in on a day with perfect weather instead. Devyn was our pilot and he was great at his pilot-ing as well as informing us of sites to keep in mind and where they would be, as well as personable and friendly in general. The takeoff and landing were smoother than a regular plane, and the whole ride was bump-free, shockingly. It was extremely beautiful and wonderful. I will go on more tours with Envi. 5 stars, well-earned.
Such an amazing experience! Would definitely recommend it! Our pilot was very knowledgeable and made the experience fun!
The flight was great and Devin was a great and cereful pilot vwe enjoyed the lunch scenery and would recommend Envi to our friends.

The service was great! The vista view from the plane was magnificent, a total dream come true! Our pilot was Devyn very friendly and knowledgeable! Definitely an unforgettable memory, and one that for sure we will repeat once our toddler gets a little bit older.

I booked the quicksand triangle tour at the end of September for my boyfriend’s birthday. I was pretty nervous the weeks leading up to our flight due to the smoke from the gorge fire – I wasn’t sure how the views would be but this flight did not disappoint! Our pilot did have flight restrictions due to the smoke but we got extremely lucky in that it was a clear day and the burned spots did not detract from the incredible views. It was actually quite fascinating to see the ways in which the fire moved. Our pilot was so knowledgeable and friendly - he even took pictures for us, standing beside the plane. I plan on gifting another ride to my grandmother who will visit next summer, I can not wait. If you are on the fence about this, go for it! I can't recommend Envi Adventures enough.
The flight and explanation of what I was seeing by the pilot was outstanding.  The day was bright and beautiful with many photo opportunities.

review_title: A different perspective of our backyard
review_text: Great pilot and beautiful views! The weather was perfect. It was incredible to be in a small plane for the first time. We weee close to Hood and flew over the Eagle Creek after burn.
Trully an amazing exerperince. Even if you have lived in the aportland area your entire life or you are just visiting. I would highly recommend!!
