We had a little problem when we arrived and no one was at the address given.  Found out they had cancelled flight due to smoke from Eagle Creek fire but we were not contacted.  Did not want to disappoint my great grandson so we were able to finally get a pilot to take him on a different tour and he was very happy.  That is the important part.

review_title: If you have limited time for a tour, make it this one!
review_text: Stand up guys, knowledgeable about the area, a great way to see a lot of things in a very short period of time, and a ton of fun!
Ryan was great he went out of his way to do a special request as a birthday present to for my boyfriend.  The overall flight was fantastic

My husband and I wanted to do something special for our daughter's 5th birthday. she had been asking us for some time if we could go on a plane. My husband found this and we decided this would be what we were going to do. From the start it was the best experience! Our pilot was willing to help us by even making sure we all were able to get a family picture before we boarded. My daughter was so excited and just kept asking questions. He answered and there were times she even asked him to tilt the plane a little so she could see out her window better and he did. He made sure to point out all the places he thought she would really like and explained everything as we went. 
When we first got there we had planned on doing a different tour but he had just got back from that one and let us know there was a lot of stuff going on because of the fires. He explained that we would not be able to have the real experience we had hoped for and offered for us to do the tour we did. I was very grateful he gave us that option and let us know what was going on. He really was concerned about us having the best experience. 
I don't think any of us will forget this anytime soon. and we have already planned on going back when we have company come visit so they can have the same experience we had. 
I recommend this for EVERYONE!!

Great flight, interesting info from our pilot. My wife had injured her knee a few days before and he was very patient and helpful when she got on and off the aircraft. I would highly recommend this tour.

I've lived in Portland for 17 years, so I feel like I know it pretty well. But flying over the city gave me a whole new perspective, and I saw many details I never knew were there. So i highly recommend this adventure for locals as well as tourists. The pilot was very personable and I felt totally safe. No barf bag required. The pricing structure -- since it's per flight rather than per person -- makes this extremely affordable for flightseeing. A really cool thing to do with visitors.
Bryan, the pilot was super. Friendly and genuine. Lots of great commentary. This was well worth the charge.

Sign in and set up, all online then followed by polite e-reminder, were flawless. Our pilot was warm and professional. He clearly loved his job, revered our River Columbia's sacred gorge, knew how to talk to my breathless granddaughter. Even after her tummy went flippity-flop. Terima kasih (I offer our love to you, Envi)

When we got to the Troutdale airport, (the last hangar to the left) we were greeted and shown around the plane. Staff is very knowledgable, flexible, and supportive. Email them or text them if you have questions! The flight itself was an amazing experience. Yes it feels squished if all 3 passages and pilot fly but trust me there was enough leg room in the back. Will definitely fly with them again!

This flight was my first time in a small plane and I loved it! I would say if you are considering flying with Envi Adventures, just do it! You will not regret it! 
We choose the Vista View and will definitely be back for a longer tour, probably the waterfall one.

review_title: What a FUN Excursion - Even My Dog Says So!
review_text: My brother and his dog were in Portland during a cross-country road trip, so I booked two flights for our group. (The plane seats four, including the pilot.) We all really enjoyed the scenic tour of the Gorge, and it was fun taking the pups up. The airport location is at the western end of the "Scenic Columbia Gorge" corridor, so it's a nice intro to the waterfalls, locks, dams, etc.
Thank you Ryan for a great and safe flight. The commentary also mafe it entertaining! We will definitely recommend Envi to others.
The whole experience was just amazing short but breath taking. It was a very smooth ride and definitely planning on returning for a much longer flight!

I booked a flight through Instagram to feature on my travel/adventure blog. I loved seeing Oregon from the air! The Envi plane took me back to my childhood, flying in my grandpas plane! Overall great experience and loved how knowledable the pilot was of all he showed us! Thanks Envi!

This was an excellent experience! I'm terrified of flying but really wanted to see the view. The pilot with Envi did an excellent job flying and making me feel safe! And the view was amazing! Great experience!
Thank you so much for the beautiful trip around the gorge. My boyfriend loved the surprise. We will be back again to book another trip!
Surprised my boyfriend with a scenic flight tour and our pilot Ryan was really awesome! Had a great time and we were not disappointed. Will surely be back if we visit portland again.

review_title: Wonderful flight even for people who haves lived here forever
review_text: My husband and I were given the Quicksand triangle flight for mothers and Father's Day. What a wonderful gift.  Even though we have lived in Troutdale and Corbett for most of our lives, the sights were awesome. It's one thing to travel through or hike in the Columbia River Gorge and another to see it from the air. There are so many lakes, ponds, rivers and just plain beauty that you can't really experience from the ground. I would recommend this adventure for people who are familiar with the area as well as for tourists. We have already told many of our friends. Hopefully, they'll make reservations and have an unforgettable experience too.

We had an incredible flight last week before sunset with Ryan. He was an excellent communicator and told us everything we could expect before it happened. We had such a great time that we decided to extend our flight to include the waterfalls and Portland - the views were breathtaking. I highly recommend this place and am looking forward to taking more flights with Envi!

The flight was beautiful. My friends and I hiked all weekend in the Columbia River Gorge and decided to end the trip with a scenic flight. We flew over all the trails we hikes which was amazing to see the landscape we trekked. Our pilot was an excellent host/pilot, it was an educational flight. I wished I asked more questions about the Columbia river gorge but I was in awe the entire time snapping shots with my camera of the beautiful scenery. Thank you Envi Adventures for a trip to remember!
My Mom and my Dad had a great time! The Pilot was friendly and professional. Booking was easy. I was even able to reschedule the day of the flight to another open time slot.
The flight was amazing, pilot was extremely competent and showed us a great time. Saw a lot of waterfalls!

review_title: Can't wait to take another flight!
review_text: My husband and I, along with our 17-mo old daughter, took the waterfalls tour yesterday with Ryan as our pilot and I can't say enough good things! He was incredibly accommodating from start to finish. We set off for the short (20-min) tour b/c we weren't sure how our daughter would handle it. Since she fell asleep 10 minutes in, he asked if we wanted to stay up longer and we definitely did! We got to see amazing views of waterfalls, the gorge and all the area has to offer. Ryan was a wealth of knowledge on where we should head next, where we should eat, etc. The flight was incredibly smooth and Ryan communicated even the smallest details just to make sure we felt comfortable. Really, it was amazing! I highly recommend Envi Adventures as a way of seeing the Gorge. Next time we visit we hope to do the Mt Hood tour but weather didn't allow that today. I guess we'll save it for next time! Thanks Ryan!

I surprised my boyfriend for our anniversary with the Triangle flight and I've never seen him more excited! Our flight was absolutely incredible, perfectly timed during sunset over Mt Hood and back through the Gorge. We were able to capture amazing photos and memories. Ryan was an awesome pilot and gave us some random facts and pointed out every waterfall. Would 100% fly Envi again, and we plan to soon!
I was so nervous to take this tour but our pilot was knowledgeable and put me at ease. It was the best experience and I will be taking another tour with envi adventure.

What an excellent way to spend a Saturday afternoon (or any day for that matter!). Our flight touring the Columbia River Gorge and the beautiful waterfalls was absolutely breathtaking.  We'll definitely be doing this again....thank you Corey and Envi Adventures!

review_title: Envy Adventures - Columbia Gorge Site seeing
review_text: I received a Groupon gift certificate for this trip. My wife and I used it this past Saturday. We had a great time.  Our pilot, Ryan, was friendly, personable, and professional. He met us on time and exactly where he said he would be. He explained everything about the tour before we boarded the plane, helped us into our seats, and made sure we were buckled in. We took off from Troutdale airport and flew east up the gorge. Ryan pointed out points of interest along the way. This was a short excursion, about 40 minutes, so we just went up a ways beyond Crown Point, circled back and returned on the Washington side of the gorge. The scenery was great. My wife and I definitely want to do this again, maybe take the longer waterfall viewing trip. Take a camera with you. After the flight,we had lunch in Troutdale, and went shopping at the outlet mall, about a mile from the airport. It was a great day!

We had an amazing time on our Flights! Grew up out here but haven't been able to take in the gorge scenery fully until not. Professional and personable pilot. Definitely will be back. Never flown before, and he was happy to explain what to expect any why. I can't say enough good things about this company. Good job guys!

I had Envi Adventures help me with an amazing proposal. The owner got the plane set up in a perfect spot, and worked with my photographer to set up this special day. The tour was great as we went and checked out all the falls going up the gorge. I highly recommend taking an aerial tour over the gorge or Mt. Hood in the summer.

This was my first time in a private plane, and first time coming to Oregon. With only one day left I was able to squeeze into a flight time and was up in the air without any hassle! The staff was friendly and super informative!

Excellent trip. Snacks and drinks before takeoff. Used a Cessna to fly up. 2 hour narrated flight and went right over the valley! Tour company was waiting. Had a nice lunch at the local restaurant and then a van tour of the valley. Epic once in a lifetime trip. Less than 2 hour flight back. Learned a lot, souvenir photo, and memories to last a lifetime. Thank you for an amazing experience!

Although a premium price, the service was beyond anything you could imagine.  Booking was simple and easy.
On arrival, we were welcomed personally by Lindsay and offered coffee and treats.  Homemade brownies were excellent.  She introduced our pilot Brandon and he went to ready the plane.
We were escorted to the plane, given safety instructions and on our way.  The flight over Sedona and then over the canyon was amazing and Brandon was great with telling us a few things about what we were seeing.
After returning in the allotted 3 hours Lindsay asked questions about us and our stay.  It came out that I have stage 4 kidney cancer in my bones and she hugged me and my wife and shared her victory over cancer over 30 years ago.  Then in the parking lot, Brandon came to us.  We thought we forgot something, but he said Lindsay had shared our story and he had just lost his mom and previously his dad to cancer.  He is now working limited hours to care for his brother battling stage 4 cancer.  We all cried a little and Brandon commented he was meant to take us up today.
The people at this company truly cared.  They were not just kind and doing their job.  I know I have two more people praying for me in my battle.  I could not say more about these people.
Please know this is a business with a quality product that you should support.  You will not regret it.
Thank you Westwind.

AMAZING ABSOLUTELY AWESOME

Cool experience but the Grand Canyon hummer tour was really short. That really disappointed us. Would have been better if the Grand Canyon tour part was longer. Also plane was a little old and worn out.

review_title: There are alternatives, don't let hotel lock you into flying Westwind
review_text:
As an earlier reviewer mentioned, one of the Westwind planes (not the "Executive") has a "bench" at the back- with only a waist belt and no padding- which I was unfortunately assigned to (when the pilot planned the seating for weight distribution, as is always done, but could have been differently., but I was the last to board). The top of the window was below my chin when sitting on that bench, it's much higher than the seats. I am 71 and have spine degeneration, so I'd  phoned in advance specifically to confirm that the padded seats and window type shown on their website is what we'd all have (the bench is Not shown). 

Instead, I was crouched over on a hard bench to see out of the scratched windows, and it was miserable. They now deny I called, and say they routinely put elders and even handicapped guests on the "bench." So, beware, they're either lying about this to me or they're regularly putting guests in that painful position, for hours. 

They blamed the hotel concierge, and fabricated other excuses. The 3-hour flight was supposed to include, as Lindsay explained in person right before the flight, a glide down into the canyon, a memorable experience only a plane could provide. But we did not do it. The conditions were good. There is other misrepresentation in their website, for instance, the seats and the planes are no longer in that condition, but show a lot of wear. 

My family is in aviation, and I had confidence in Josh, the young pilot, to fly but not in his decision on the seating, and no confidence in the manager, Brad, who bullied me for complaining and requesting a refund. I regret trusting Hilton's Boulders Resort to arrange the canyon flight using Westwind. They have given me a 50% refund, but still blame me for having the "wrong expectations", and my spine is still painful.

Westward made every a wonderful experience.  Booking the trip and communications were exceptional.  Everyone was so helpful.  The plane was on time.  The pilot, Brandon was very helpful and a great pilot.  He was very competent and safe.  We were 100% happy with the trip.  We will definitely fly Westward again.

Our trip was great; easy booking, clear follow-up and professional check in. Our pilot was Carla who was clearly experienced and fun to interact with!  Stopped to pick up passengers in Flagstaff and we’re on to the south rim, with a “welcome to the Grand Canyon “ over the headphones. Informative narrative over the headphones about scenic views and history of the region. Land tour in the Hummer was also good, on time and nice stops for pictures. So glad we got to experience the Grand Canyon!

We stayed at Hilton Sedona Resort at Bell Rock . The lady who works at our hotel advised that we take a trip to the Grand Canyon by plane. It was the best decision we could have made .West Wind Air Service did a very good job. It was a very good experience. The pilot showed professionalism and  he was very friendly . The whole trip around the Grand Canyon was very interesting. Besides, we could see the entire Grand Canyon  something we couldn't do by car. Thank you to the pilot and West Wind Air Service for a great experience. We recommend this service to others. Jan & Hanna Kucharczyk

Phenomenal experience, from booking with ease with Lindsey to a breathtaking, unbelievable experience with Carla, I was blown away by all of it.  Lindsey is awesome at what she does, great communication and incredibly welcoming when we finally got on site.  Then we met Carla for our ANT tour, immediately felt confident with her as our pilot and guide, she was with us the entire tour which I never expected and was fun, knowledgeable, and clearly very skilled and experienced as a pilot.  The sites were just jaw dropping, you forget what you are seeing is not man made, it’s almost fake, then you remember it’s not and have this incredible feeling of appreciation and admiration for what you’ve just seen and experienced.  I am so very glad we chose Westwind, I thought this would be a once and a lifetime experience, but they were so awesome I can’t wait to get back and do another tour!!

This is an experience of a lifetime. In fact, this flight tour was a 55th birthday present from my sister. Because I once translated the introduction of famous tourist attractions in Arizona into beautiful Chinese for Westwind Airlines, my sister specially arranged this flight for me, allowing me to truly experience the magnificent beauty of Arizona that I once translated. Exciting birthday！It also made me deeply understand every detail of Westwind Air's service, which is an unparalleled wonderful feeling. In the afternoon, taste the unique Navajo cuisine at a panoramic restaurant overlooking Monument Valley...  This is an unforgettable trip．Air travel with Westwind is indeed an excellent option for a short trip to Arizona.   Dong Chen
There were awesome views and an amazing staff who had excellent insights into all the sights and landmarks.

review_title: You have to take this tour
review_text: This was an unforgettable experience. Our pilot and guide Hunter was knowledgeable, pleasant and a great photographer! The views of the canyon are exceptional and the boat ride on the Colorado River was a surprise. This excursion was worth every penny and I highly recommend it.

We took the Phoenix to Antelope Canyon and Monument Valley (ACM) and picked up another two in Sedona on the way to Page, AZ. The flight was utterly fantastic. Seeing the Arizona and Utah countryside, including a portion of the Grand Canyon, from 10,000 feet and less was beyond description. There was still snow in the distant mountains and on the northward-facing slopes in central Arizona. Antelope Canyon was awe-inspiring at Canyon X, which is in between the lower and upper sections. Although several groups were in our vicinity, they did a great job of keeping a gap for person-less views and photographs.  We then flew over Lake Powell and the Rainbow Bridge on the way to Monument Valley. The simple Navajo tacos and Goulding's were simple though extremely tasty. The jeep/truck tour at MV was informative and breathtaking. On the way home, many in the group slept after a truly luscious experience. It was worth every penny.

review_title: Waiting, waiting, more waiting - not worth the money; will be asking for partial refund
review_text: Our family of four did the Adventure Tour - GC West Rim w/Skywalk package through WestWind during spring break in April 2023. While one would expect the the Grand Canyon to be a finely-tuned, well-oiled tourist machine, it definitely is not. While Westwind did their part in getting us safely from Sedona to the Grand Canyon and back - and we loved our pilot Brandon - what they don't emphasize is it that they are are the mercy of the Grand Canyon vendors - in our case Papillon Helicopters and whoever runs the Skywalk. For this cost, some VIP treatment is expected, but there is none. The first stop at the Skywalk and Eagle Point was so crowded that, because of the time limit we had in order to make our 1 pm helicopter ride, we had to choose between eating lunch or standing in the 2-3 hour Skywalk line. Since we had kids, we opted to eat, and still had to wait about 20 min for a table for burgers and chicken sandwiches. Then hopped back on the bus, were told we had to skip the Guano Point stop to make it to our 1 pm helicopter ride. Upon arriving at the Papillon Helicopters terminal, we were told it would be about 45 more min, which they kept telling us. Eventually, we made it on the helicopter at 3 pm, 2 hours past our assigned time that we rushed back for, skipping Guano Point and the Skywalk. The reasoning for the delay was that it was cold and 7 of their 8 helicopters were down for the day because of overnight freezing. Who in their right mind allows a $10M aircraft to freeze overnight? Is there no protocol in place to provide shelter for the $10M helicopters during freezing temperatures? Who is accountable for this? None of these questions were really answered. Once we did get on the helicopter, it was about a 5-min ride to the pontoon boat ride, which was pretty cool, but nowhere in the package description did it say anything about a pontoon boat ride and I would have rather had a longer helicopter ride. When they dropped us off for the pontoon boat ride, the now two functioning helicopters were taking turns dropping groups off, however we still had to wait about 45 min to get picked up after the boat tour was over. Waiting and being stuck somewhere for a ride were the themes of the day. This package is not worth the money. Overall, the GC does not have the infrastructure or processes in place to handle any kind of overwhelming number of spring break or holiday tourists. My hindsight advice would be: figure out a lesser traveled time to visit to GC; arrange your own travel so you're not stuck somewhere at the mercy of someone else; skip the Skywalk - it's little, not worth the wait, and you can't even take your own photos; do more research than I did, especially if traveling with kids; bring your own food; if you really want to do a helicopter tour, do not use Papillon, try the place next door - Maverick's Helicopters. As of this post, I have not received any refunds, but will be calling on Monday morning.

The whole experience was touristy and underwhelming.   We had visited the south side of the canyon Years before and found it more inspiring and beautiful.  DO NOT waste $ on the Skywalk....you can't take photos and must rely on the site photographers.   Disappointed.

review_title: Stunning Views - easy trip from Phoenix
review_text: Our family did the West Rim tour - it was incredible! We flew with Noah from Phoenix to the West Rim and felt comfortable in his capable hands. Once there, Westwind made arrangements for us to enjoy one of the tours on site: we walked on the glass overhang, had lunch, stopped at an incredible spot with better views, and then flew on a helicopter to Colorado River and took a short boat ride. The views were incredible. I noticed a reviewer below complaining that they were waiting at the bottom in the canyon for a helicopter. We waited, too, as one of the helicopters was getting maintenance. And we enjoyed every breathtaking moment at the bottom of the canyon. It was a once-in-a-lifetime day...and we loved every second!

Amazing. We had Nick as our pilot and he was awesome. Can not believe how much we enjoyed this. Everything was just so beautiful I didn’t even want to take pictures because I couldn’t stop looking with my own eyes.

review_title: If you see the Grand Canyon one way—this is the way
review_text: Our flight with Aaron was absolutely incredible. We saw the Grand Canyon and Sedona mountains in a way that was awe inspiring.  It made our trip!

review_title: Monument Valley, Rainbow Bridge and Grand Canyon Tour
review_text: Absolutely loved this tour. My adult son researched for a flight to include Rainbow Bridge, and he discovered this one. We flew from Page, AZ on Saturday morning. We were fortunate to be the only passengers on the tour. Women at the front office were very helpful. Pilot was great. He pointed out interesting landmarks during the flight. Navaho guide was very good. Lunch at the restaurant was nice.  I would recommend this company to everyone.

review_title: Scattering of ashes over Four Peaks
review_text: I hired Westwind Air Services to scatter my mom’s ashes over Four Peaks. Lindsay was an absolute pleasure to work and talk with. I was able to fly along with two of the most amazing pilots, Lindsay and Carla. The flight was smooth and the view was spectacular!  Lindsay made a couple of passes for me to be sure of where I wanted to scatter the ashes. I couldn’t have asked for anyone better in my quest to lay my mom to rest!  Thank you, Lindsay, Carly and Lindsay!

review_title: READ BEFORE BOOKING - 99% standing around cooking the heat
review_text:
A logistical nightmare. 99% of this tour was sitting around waiting.  Once we arrived at the hanger near the canyon, we sat and waited for over 1 hour without any update on what was going on.  When we finally made it into the helicopter and Into the canyon, we did a 10 minute boat ride followed by 1 more hour of waiting in the 107 degree heat for the return ride.  We were told that maintenance personnel needed our helicopter and therefore there would be a long delay.  When we finally got back to the hanger, we stood around for another 45 minutes waiting for the equivalent of a NYC public bus.  I’m writing this mid tour, but knowing what I know now I WOULD NOT BOOK THIS TOUR. 

Terribly frustrating waste of time.

Unfortunately our tour was cancelled night before due to a  no fly zone having been issued by FAA.  Obviously unavoidable and hope whatever situation that caused NFZ was resolved without a catastrophic loss.  I was just disappointed in 0 effort made by tour company to at least offer us an alternate tour of any kind.  I managed to book another tour at 4:50 pm for the following morning with Detours thankfully and made great use of my last day in Phoenix.

We were there when told, the polit was running late, we waited till 10:10 am, then told the polit had forgotten a package and had to go back and was going to be an hour late returning.   

This was booked months ago, we were paying over 800.00 and the polit forgot a package and had to turn around after already being late leaving to get the package.   Very disappointing. Would not recommend this business.
We had a fabulous day at the Grand Canyon. Nick, our pilot, was friendly, knowledgeable and got us there safely. Thanks for a great day, kia ora.

Nous avons adoré ce vol
Un super pilote de plus très sympathique, un avions pour nous tout seuls
et, bien sur, le clou du spectacle, le Lac Powell

I honestly cannot think of a better way to tour the Grand Canyon. Pilot/Tour Guide/Photographer Karla was amazing. She knew where to be and when to be there in order to avoid lines. 

The flight up was pleasant. The recording playing through the headset, along with Karla’s tidbits, was a nice touch and was very informative. 

The Skywalk, Guano Point, and the helicopter ride each provided a unique view of the Canyon. 

I really think one could go back every day and never see this marvel the same. There’s so much to see, and Westwind did an amazing job giving us different ways to to see it. I can’t say enough about how awesome this tour was.

The trip was amazing.  The pilot was extremely courteous and knowledgeable... spending time with each of our groups, taking pictures and pointing our the sites and history.  Of course, the sites were beyond breathtaking.  I don't know how to better plan a tour of the Canyon within a day than this. 
Westwind's staff were very friendly and accommodating from the time we checked in through the time we left.  There was a misunderstanding with the booking agent we used (not Westwind) re: one aspect of the tour, but Westwind took care of it at their own expense.  Highly recommended!!

Not what was advertised.  The pilot was great!  We were expecting a boat ride at the floor of the canyon.  This was no longer included and we did not even get down to the river.  The helicopter ride was very short.  Would love flying over more territory.

My family did the Antelope tour and Grand Canyon flyover from Sedona. We had a great time. It was an efficient way to see the Grand Canyon and get all the way over to Page to tour Antelope Canyon. We felt safe the entire time and would recommend. Max was our pilot and he was awesome. I would say to book it if you are considering. We would have been exhausted trying to do a tour that drove us to both places in one day.

Our entire trip was amazing---highly recommend this tour service!  We enjoyed a smooth morning flight, beat the crowds, had plenty of time at each stop to explore, enjoy, and inhale the wonder of the Grand Canyon.

Carla was our pilot and she was fantastic.  This was definitely well worth the money.  Breathtaking scenery and she was very knowledgeable and shared so much history with us.  This is definitely a “bucket list” tour everyone should take!!!

The trip was great and our pilot was equally as great!  There was a small issue where we were not able to do the boat part of the trip due to lack of employees BUT they were quick to offer us a refund for that portion of the trip.  We would absolutely do this again and would highly recommend!

The entire trip was amazing from start to finish!  Enjoyed the flight time up and back, taking in all the scenery, leaving more time in the day for the fun stuff!  No doubt seeing the Grand Canyon from the air, the Skywalk experience, visiting Guano Point and then getting the incredible feeling of the Grand Canyon and it's beauty from a boat trip on the Colorado River.  Such a great combined tour!!

The trip was excellent. Our pilot was great, he guided us through the day and helped plan so that we beat the crowds.(went on Holiday weekend)
Plane trip was great, we could see all the sights on the way from Phoenix. If you go, take the lunch at Guano Point, the view is incredible, with plenty of spots for viewing the canyon in relative privacy.
I look forward to taking other tours with them in the future .

We went on an all day tour starting with a flight from Sedona to Page Arizona for an Antelope canyon tour. After landing in Page, our pilot drove us in a van to the antelope canyon where another company took us on a one and a half hour tour of the amazing canyon. After that tour we were picked up by our pilot who drove us back to the plane and we flew over The Grand canyon. It was spectacular. We then landed at the Grand canyon national airport and went on a ground tour of the Grand Canyon, taking in views from Mather point. After that we boarded the plane for the third time and headed back to sedona. It was an all day affair and it was awesome. They fed us a box lunch around 2:00 p.m. it was good that we took some snacks to munch on in the late morning cause we were really hungry by 2! 

We got lucky with great weather and even though the airplane was really small (6 passenger including pilot) and bumpy and at times a little scary, the pilot was very good and calm at all times. We were never in any real danger, I just never had been in an airplane that small. 

There was only one other couple with us on this trip and it was fun getting to know them as well. All in all it was a spectacular day where we did a lot and saw a lot and had a great time. Highly recommend this tour.
Great experience! Our pilot, Max, was awesome!! The entire day was perfect. Thanks to everyone at Westwind and especially Max- what a memory for our family!

Dan was an incredible pilot who made me feel so secure when I was terrified.  It was not scary AT ALL in the end and the views were BREATHTAKING.  This is a MUST do for anyone who wants to see the Grand Canyon.  Incomparable and amazing.

Our pilot Dan was amazing.  The trip was quite unbelievable and worth every penny.  I will recommend this tour to everyone.
Thanks for a great tour!!

Last week, during our stop in Page AZ, we went on the Lake Powell aerial tour which took us past the Glen Canyon Dam and  Horseshoe bend, and then up to the Rainbow Bridge.  Our pilot Caleb flew 1000 feet above ground, providing us with breathtaking views through the plane 's large clean windows. Caleb's relaxed commentary on the sights we passed by was enjoyable as well.  We were aso fortunate to have perfect weather (clear blue skies and no turbulence).  I filled an entire SD card with the non-stop pictures I took with my camera, and was sorry to see the trip end 45 minutes later.  This was our first  'air tour' ever, and we will definitely do  more in the future!

Our tour included a helicopter ride in the canyon. The info did not tell us it was only 5 minutes! It also included a pontoon boat ride on the grand canyon river. Yeah! But the ride was 1 mile and back! Really??
Not worth the $649 per person!

Top notch service. Incredible tour, I would highly recommend this. We actually had some really bad weather in Sedona on Sat and Sun. Eileen rebooked us for Monday and made it work. They are easy to work with, maintain an excellent level of safety and have incredibly comfortable aircraft. Can’t say enough amazing things about this company. 

Planning to use them for my moms 70th bday. 

Halina

review_title: Greatest Once in a Lifetime Experience
review_text: Awesome, wonderful pilots and modes of transportaion. If you only do one thing at the Grand Canyon. If you do two things also go to the South Rim.

review_title: Lake Powell and Grand Canyon Trip
review_text: Took a trip out of Page. Sherry who checked us in is fabulous. Brandon our pilot was awesome. An amazing 90 min flight, well narrated. So glad we took the trip.
We had a great experience.  A little nervous about a little plane, but our pilot put us at ease.  The scenery was fantastic.  It was a great way to see the Grand Canyon.

We had a great trip!! We are a family of 4. Our kids are 15 and 12. The staff at west wind was excellent with communication, making sure we knew exactly what was going on and when. They confirmed a few days before. Bruce was our pilot and led us around and was full of great information. Overall, we had a blast and would use west wind again.

I was traveling alone with my 3 kids all age 9, we were greeted kindly by Lindsey the sales person/manager and things "seemed" to be running smoothly and ethically. We boarded our small 4 seater plane with our young pilot and amazing hiking guide Craig from Aria, but halfway through the flight the pilot said we had to go back to the airport as we have a mechanical malfunction, which as a mom with her babies on board  this small plane with a very young pilot I was beyond anxious we were all going down.We got back and waited a while till they put us on another plane as the one that we were on could not be repaired, that was smooth and the pilot was experienced but the aerial tour that we paid for  to do over the grand canyon was "postponed" so we could get back on  their schedule.... After landing we were then put into a hummer to take us to the grand canyon to hike this company who owned the hummer was Buck Wild Adventures, the woman driver dropped us off on the side of the road as she said she could not get us to the trail head and to make sure we were there by 2pm (approx 3 hours later). We got back to the meeting place after an amazing hike (again the hiking guide was top notch) 10 minutes early and we waited and waited there is no cell service up there so we had no way to call for help. After waiting on the side of the road for an hour we finally had to walk more than an hour on a busy street with no sidewalk (with 3 kids!!!) until we could get phone reception, our hiking guide was so helpful and called his boss who quickly got in touch with Westwind and someone finally came and picked us up hours later than the 2pm meeting time. My kids had done a huge hike were exhausted and starving at this point.... when I mentioned the aerial tour the pilot said oh we'll do that now but at this point my kids were so tired they were asleep before the tour even began missing ALL of the sights! When we landed finally back at the Deer Valley Airport Lindsey had already left for the day with no call to check in or anything that evening... it was after 6pm when we landed and 7pm before finally getting a ride back to our hotel when we were supposed to be back between 1-2. I called the next morning to voice my disappointment and Lindsey did answer but unknowing to her she kept muting herself to talk to other people and every time she did it as music would blare (she had no idea this was happening)  so she wasn't listening to me at all. She blamed everything on other people and "promised" to make things right with some type of refund. It has been two weeks and I've yet to hear anything back from her even after emailing several times. Just can't believe businesses really run like this it's sad.

We had such a great experience doing the flight & hike up the the Grand Canyon. Booking w/ Westwind was easy and the people at the office were very helpful when we were trying to select the right package for us.  We hiked for about 1.5 hours on the Angel Bright Trail. It was great to see the canyon from below the rim. 

The tour was great! The flight up to the canyon via Sedona was so cool. Our guide for the hike was awesome as well. He was so helpful - had a backpack full of supplies and a wealth of knowledge about the canyon. It was 100+ degrees the day of our excursion and we really appreciated the guides preparedness. The pilot was also great!

For anyone considering this, flying up to the canyon is a treat. The scenery is awesome and it's a huge time saver. We felt like we really got to see the highlights of the canyon and we were able to do it from a 1 day trip from Phoenix. Way better than driving up and staying at a hotel we were not excited about. I'd definitely consider this company for a different tour.
wonderful family trip  of 4 adults....everything went perfect, pilot/host was excellent....minimal lines......everything taken care of for us...i would certainly recommend !

My less younger friends got to see Sedona and the Grand Canyon is style and comfort. Fantastic! The smooth Jeep Tour was a GREAT Addition so they could see GC in a way most never get to.  THANK YOU, WESTWIND Air!
**  HIGHLY RECOMMENDED **

review_text: OMG! Arizona is beautiful from the ground, but to see Sedona, Flagstaff, all the cities and villages between North Phoenix and the Grand Canyon is a mind-blowing experience. review_text:

Because of this tour, we were able to experience one of the 7 natural wonders of the world.

review_title: Grand Canyon experience to the Max!
review_text: Our pilot Mike was so kind and made the entire experience totally enjoyable. We also included a helicopter ride down into the canyon with a boat ride on the Colorado River. This combo package was the highlight of our trip! We really feel like we did the Grand Canyon experience to the Max!!

review_title: Best One-day Grand Canyon Adventure from Phoenix
review_text: This was a fantastic way to see the Grand Canyon by air, from the top of the West Rim, and then at the base. Westwind provided the pilot for the fight from Phoenix to the Grand Canyon and back. Brandon was an excellent pilot and took great care of us throughout the entire day. Papillon provided the helicopter transport and tour down to the canyon base and back up again and the boat ride down the Colorado river. Everything and everyone were very professional and well-organized. Great lunch at Eagle Point restaurant which was included with window-side table overlooking the canyon and Skywalk. Seamless customer service from beginning to end.  Everything was included. Well-worth the price.

review_title: Excellent service and great air tour!
review_text:
Crazy lines during spring break at the Grand Canyon and the Westwind team pivoted to make sure we had a great time and didn’t wait in line to get in. Pilot was great and ground team was amazing! Highly recommend! 

Air tour from Phoenix was amazing, family of all ages really enjoyed!

My husband and I took our 15 year old son to Sedona and booked this full day Grand Canyon experience. It was an awesome experience to see the terrain from above! Our pilot Max was a part of what made it so fun! From the flight to the west rim, the skywalk and lunch (yummy options), the two stops to see some breathtaking views and have some picture opportunities, and last but not least the helicopter ride down into the canyon where we got to spend 20 min or so on the Colorado River. The perspective looking up had us all in awe. A full day so spring water and a couple of snacks. You won’t be disappointed!

Mike, our pilot, was a great source of information both during the flight and on location at the Canyon. The flight to the Canyon was amazing. The helicopter ride down was interesting, but brief. The boating part of the experience was not available due to water levels. Once back up top, the lines began. An hour to get to Sky Bridge. Over an hour to get into the restaurant. The saving grace was the view once we were seated.

This was an incredible experience and thanks to our wonderful pilot Dan he made it very comfortable and organized! He is an incredible pilot, very knowledgeable about the area and all parts of the Grand Canyon! This tour beats the crowds, it is really worth it! My family of 4 and especially the kids really enjoyed this day, thank you!!

Our pilot and tour guide Dan was awesome! We had the most incredible day! Dan was on top of everything and ensured that we beat the long lines while still having ample time at our Grand Canyon stops. Having someone who is knowledgeable about how everything works and able to execute the timing is invaluable. He also had extensive knowledge of the history of the Canyon and pointed out some extraordinary things along the way. The short plane ride to the Canyon was narrated and filled with lots of interesting information to go along with the incredible views. The helicopter down to the base and the boat ride was the icing on the cake. Can’t recommend this company enough! Call and book directly. Not only will you save on the booking fee the agent was very knowledgeable and answered all of our questions. A top notch company. Will definitely use them again!

review_title: Amazing!  you will Not be disappointed!
review_text: Flight over the Grand Caynon, you can notsee this anywhere else!  Woth every penny.  Wonderful staff and great, smooth flight.

review_title: Most memorable Grand Canyon Aerial Tour.
review_text: Did a 2-hour Grand Canyon Aerial-only tour from Sedona. Absolutely fantastic. Highlight of our fantastic trip. Westwind helped me when Sedona Air Tours cancelled our 2-month long reservation (only days before our trip and only when I called to confirm). Pilot Tom was very nice and sensitive to our moderate fear of heights and flight turbulence. Was so memorable - once in a lifetime experience. Worth the cost. The right company and right tour! Highly recommend.

So much fun! We took our family on the aerial tour then ground tour and we all loved it! I would absolutely recommend this company. Max, our pilot, was very knowledgeable and professional. Thank you for the great experience:)!

The flight was fine but the tour was deceptive. Does not include a boat ride because west wind booked us with a helicopter company that doesn’t offer it. The tour was poorly timed and we spent 2.5 hours in waiting around and had to rush through the sights. LOTS of exposure to people on crowded busses. Poor mask compliance. Our pilot was good.

We had an amazing day with everything taking care of. I loved not having to worry about any detail of the trip. Our pilot Josh was absolutely wonderful and took care of us from start to finish. A once in a lifetime experience!

From start to finish this was by far the best tour I've ever had!  Our pilot was incredibly kind and informative.  We had no long lines, not rushed , nor crowded,experience was perfect! He timed everything perfectly. I enjoyed the flights, the hikes, the boat...absolutely everything ❤

review_title: Bucket list experience for sure! Do this at least once!!
review_text:
Wow; what an adventure! Put this on your bucket list and just do it!!

We went with three adults, one 18YO and one 15YO. Everyone had an AMAZING day. I had been waiting three years wanting to do this with my family and it was even better than anticipated.

Lindsay at Westwind Air Service was fantastic about accommodating us on a day the tour doesn't normally run, and Max our pilot was really the star of the day. My 18YO asked Max about 1,000 questions about the airplane, the scenery and everything else he could think of. Max answered every one and made it a fantastic experience for all of us. 

We recommend going early in the day. It felt like we had the Skywalk and much of the tour to ourself. The helicopter tour to the bottom of the canyon was breathtaking!! My husband and I had both been in helicopters before so we insisted the others take a turn sitting in front and they all agreed it was an experience better than they could have imagined.

This was the highlight of our trip and something we will never forget. I can't recommend it enough.

The trip was incredible and I'm glad that we booked.  Everyone wore masks (8) and felt safe the whole time.  

The sights from plane and helicopter was worth every penny.  I would recommend this trip to anyone.  I booked with Travel Advisior and they give automatically give you a 24 hour cancellation which was assuring.

This trip was amazing!  Both kids and adults had an amazing day.  See the canyon from so many perspective in a matter of hours was amazing.  Our guide Dan was great and shared a ton of interesting history/information.

Awesome experience!  Lindsey was very helpful in working with us for booking.  Max was a great pilot to and from GC.  Helo, boat cruise, skywalk.  Can't tell you what was best because it all was amazing.

review_title: This is a must do! With this crew! With this company! Please read and add to your bucket list!
review_text:
Pilot Max and copilot Josh were incredibly charismatic and welcoming individuals.  This experience taking the longer grabd tour over Monument Valley, page, Rainbow Bridge and Horse Shoe and lakes was breath taking. 

Max maintain a steady flight ✈️  while he provided comfort to my friend Tyler who is fearful of heights. Max is very intuitive and goes above abd beyond to assure confidence with his guest fliers. 

There was no point on this windy day where we were not calm and focused on the breathtaking views. Viewing of the Grand Cayon is a bucket list for everyone. You must experience this in your life time. I have helicopter toured over the Grand Canyon well aware of this being one of those exceptional experiences in life. 

I opted for the extended tour to assure it would be more epic than my helicopter experience; otherwise why bother...right? I was 100% right and was blown away by how much more magnificentit would be.  The investment was peanuts compared to the memories, photos and videos. 

As far as bonding experience,  I do not find (psychologist) there are more experiences for bonding as this. In fact I met my guest yesterday in line at a store and we hiked the Canyon. Stayed at best hotel separately,  had a decent steak dinner and booked the flight for 9 am following day. 

We both feel from this experience we consider one another great friends who aim to travel together soon. Platonic, as we usually travel alone and rarely want anyone to slow us down.

Josh has the most contagious smile and both pilots have an obvious jovial friendship which adds to the calmness on deck. Both work seamlessly for a smooth flight. 

Lastly, our landing was perfect. My friend Tyler barely woke from a nap. Yes, we both fell asleep on the way back from sight seeing. That is how safe we felt. It was epic. 

After our flight pilot assured we captured great photo to demonstrate the energy on deck. It was friends, positive vibes, adventure & wanderlust. 

Unlike my helicopter tour of Grand Canyon, I will take this Grand tour with this crew each time I want to gift this experience to someone. It is the best gift to give. 

Thank you Max and Josh! I will be sure to book again! 

Kind regards,  

KL

review_title: Amazing Day trip to Grand Canyon by Plane
review_text: Seeing the Sedona red rock buttes and then the Grand Canyon from the air is amazing. We had a great trip— Daniel, our pilot, was great. The tour on the ground at the southern rim of the Grand Canyon was really insightful as we had the pleasure of being guided by Jeffrey, a Navajo Native American, who took the time to share with us about his culture and traditions in relation to the Grand Canyon and the other Nations that call the Grand Canyon home.

Our Lake Powell/Glen Canyon/Rainbow Bridge/Grand Canyon/Horseshoe Bend tour started in Page, AZ. Our pilot, Max, was fantastic - very pleasant, informative, and professional. It was out daughter's 17th birthday, and she was able to briefly take controls and fly the plane - what a birthday to remember!

review_title: Great way to se the Grand Canyon and Lake Powell
review_text: We took this one from Page AZ. Our pilot was Max and he was awesome.  We felt safe and really enjoyed ourselves.  My husband had not seen the Grand Canyon or Lake Powell and it was a great way to see them both.  Thanks Westwind Air.

I am with Adventure Caravan and I had a group of people and we booked a last minute trip over Lake Powell, the Glenn Adam, Horseshoe Bend, and Rainbow Bridge. This company was amazing to work with, very accommodating and professional. The pilots were fabulous guides and pilots. We felt safe in their care and LOVED the trip! Thank you!!

We booked that flight and were already pretty excited. That flight was topping our expectations and we were speechless. Already the booking was very fast and always so friendly. Re-bookings we could make uncomplicated. 
Arriving at the airport was fairly easy and we got a warm welcome. Our pilot always took care for us before, during and after the flight. 
While flying we got a guided tour over the headphones. 
Definitely recommendable!!!

We thoroughly enjoyed our Grand Canyon Aerial Tour with our pilot Carla. 
The plane was comfortable and air conditioned! I highly recommend this company for your tour! They are timely and communicated well prior to our tour!!

My son and I visited the Grand Canyon for a once-in-a-lifetime trip. We scheduled a Rim to Rim tour on Westwind Air Service and it was an experience we will never forget. 

Check-in at the airport was super easy and we were out on the tarmac within 5 minutes of arriving. My son was a little nervous, but our pilot, Max, was wonderful and took us through every step of the flight. 

The views were amazing and the commentary by our pilot made the entire experience fantastic. This was definitely worth the price and I would highly recommend it to anyone.

I could not be happier with the services provided by Westwind Air Service. Gathering tour details, options, and pricing was a breeze through their texting service, and once I submitted the web booking, the Westwind team was quick to confirm the reservation. "Check-in" at the Page, AZ airport was quick, and we were on the tarmac in fewer than 2 minutes upon our arrival in the terminal. The professional, yet friendly pilot provided a great pre-flight experience, and also offered lots of good information while in-flight. I also enjoyed the professionally produced audio tour that was available through the noise-blocking headsets. The group took hundreds of great photos throughout the trip, and we learned a ton from the Navajo guide while visiting Monument Valley. I highly recommend booking a tour with Westwind Air Service - it will be a trip you will cherish and never forget.

review_title: Great way to see so many Arizona highlights in a short amount of time!
review_text: Seeing the Grand canyon from the air was an amazing, breathtaking way to appreciate the beauty of this work of art!  Karla was a great pilot and we felt safe and confident in her abilities.  Lindsay was super helpful to make sure we were able to fly within our scheduled time.

review_title: An epic way of seeing the Grand Canyon.
review_text: This tour was definitely the highlight of our trip. Originally we had problems with Expedia’s booking, but Lindsey at Westwind stayed on top of the booking to make sure it went through. Max, our pilot, also was a great pilot and guide during our tour. He even helped the bus driver wipe down the foggy windshield during the monsoon that crept up on what was a sunny day. He may have literally saved all on board! The helicopter pilot was also very friendly and flew us inside the canyon for amazing views. Great crew, great company, and a definite great way to see the Grand Canyon.

The staff with Westwind were first class. The flight was absolutely breathtaking. We were very confident with the pilot,Carla and Bill.  This flight was worth every penny and the ground tour with Wild Bill was excellent.

review_title: You have to take the flight
review_text:
The entire event was terrific I could not put out any specific thing. However our pilot, Max’s, made the whole flight incredibly interesting. His demeanor, personality and flight experience/technical know-how were superb!  My wife and I were quite fortunate to have been the only two aboard this spacious airplane.

Initially, upon approaching the West Wing counter, Daneen, the receptionist/tour coordinator made us feel very, very welcome. I have a few problems with claustrophobia so she called the pilot in and he graciously took us out to the airplane so that I could get a feel for it. Feeling positive about the aircraft spaciousness with it we found ourselves flying out the next morning at 9:30. We had a great time

We would normally not spend that much money on a tour but we are definitely blessed having done so, the Grand Canyon, From the air, is a vastly different place. You definitely get caught up in its beauty and immenseness.

Excellent Day......Reservations with Lindsay were easy to make.....Lindsay was so helpful and pleasant.....Our flight with pilot Seth was wonderful.....smooth and gorgeous....THANK YOU WESTWIND AIR SERVICE..... a fabulous day

This is a class act from planning stages to landing back in Phoenix, and it was an awesome adventure! Staff at Westwind answered my numerous calls and emails with friendly, informative patience. They helped me choose the perfect trip. We were greeted warmly at the airport and introduced to our pilot, Seth, a young, professional flight instructor, who immediately inspired confidence. The flight was so smooth, relaxing, and stunningly beautiful! The narration on our headsets was fascinating, but I often forgot to listen, as I was lost in the view. Passing over the Verde River and Sedona were incredible, but approaching and then flying over the canyon was beyond words. 
We boarded Pink Jeeps after landing and spent the next few hours with two adorable, knowledgeable guides, who challenged us to stump them with our questions. They took us to several lookouts and to Grand Canyon National Park. So we got another perspective of the awesome Canyon from the ground. Even got to do a little shopping in Hopi House, a high quality artsy Native American shop. And we saw a large elk cow browsing along the roadside!
The return flight was again narrated via our headsets, with more cool info, or we could talk to our fellow passengers with whom we had just spent the afternoon. 
We returned to pick up a nice souvenir picture of myself and my husband, taken before departure. 
I highly recommend this trip. We were staying in Scottsdale, and it was a short drive to the Deer Valley Airport. I had initially looked at trips with 3 1/2 hour drives to the canyon, then plane or helicopter tours over it. For myself and my husband, this was a much better way to go. We had the view from above on the way, plus the much shorter travel time. 
I can’t think of anything I would do to change this tour. In a word - fabulous!

We were visiting in Scottsdale and wanted to see the grand canyon- who knows if i wold be out there ever again.  This well organized trip run by knowledgeable and confident operators who prioritized safety was well worth the cost. I was glad to support the Hualapai tribe who recently opened this west rim site on the canyon to visitors.

review_title: Antelope Canyon & Monument Valley Tour - Incredible experience!
review_text: My husband and I did the Antelope Canyon and Monument Valley tour, and it was amazing! Our pilot, Gary, was very knowledgeable and kind. 10/10 would do it again! Thanks Westwind!!

One of the best trips ever. It included flight over the Grand Canyon, helicopter to the Colorado river in the canyon and a boat ride on the river. John was our pilot and was personable , professional and knowledgeable. I highly recommend Westwind air and their tours. You won’t be disappointed and I wish I were in Phoenix longer to take another tour with them

Our family of five flew Westwind on an amazing adventure. First we flew from Phoenix to Page to visit the incredible Antelope Canyon. We then flew to the Grand Canyon including an unbelievable overflight of the Canyon. We followed that with a visit to the South rim. Then back to Phoenix making it an epic ten hour day. Our pilot Brandon was professional and experienced. He gave us confidence we’d be safe even flying in a plane that was only a five seater. The whole tour was run professionally and everyone was very friendly and nice. If you are looking for a highly adventurous and amazing family day, fly with Westwind and take this tour.

review_title: An Amazing Experience from Start to Finish
review_text: Our trip was recommended by the concierge at the Phoenician Shannon B and she was great at going thru the different options. Not knowing if my son (13) or myself would make it back here, I wanted to really do it right. West wind took such good care of us! Val confirmed all of our details and welcomed us like royalty. John our pilot and tour guide took the time to engage us in conversation, point out things not to be missed and gladly took pictures of the majestic landscape behind us. The helicopter ride to the bottom was a totally new experience and we lived our boat guide’s history lesson while in the river. We were thrilled by every portion of the tour—Don our driver was great too. Thank you WestWind and everyone involved for a day we will NEVER forget!

We spent the day with Brandon our pilot who was amazing.  He knew just when to keep the conversation going with interesting facts about the landscape and knew when we just wanted to take in the beauty of the canyon during our flights.  The team at Westwind Air was spectacular and treated us like family from the moment we walked through the door. I highly recommend Westwind and Brandon.

My husband and had been to the Grand Canyon once before, but sadly it was not to be it was the heaviest snow storm in years we saw absolutely nothing.
This year we were blessed with another opportunity, and the Canyon we thought was going to be unseeable due to heavy rain  and mist. But low and behold the heavens opened up and we were blessed with an amazing sighting of the canyon. So worth the wait. An amazing spectacle when one realized that the Grand Canyon is 17 million years old.

review_title: Grand Canyon, Monument Valley, & Lake Powell air tour
review_text: We had an amazing time flying with Westwind. Max was our pilot and he clearly has tons of experience helping people see and photograph the sights, as well as giving a smooth ride. My partner and I chose to fly over Grand Canyon, Monument Valley, & Lake Powell, roughly a 3 hour ride. Seeing Monument Valley from the sky was truly amazing and I can't recommend it enough. We got very close to many of the structures and the photos I took even with my iphone (my partner is the photographer of the two of us) were amazing. There is a narrated guide in the headphones but both my partner and I appreciated Max's insights more. Seeing the AZ landscape in the winter was amazing.

review_title: Horseshoe Bend and Lake Powell Air Tour
review_text: This was a great trip. We stopped by the Page airport after out tour of Secret Slot Canyon to see what was available, and an hour later we were flying over the area. The flight was smooth and we were able to take some great photos.

John C made our 30th feel as special as the magnificent wonder of the world we were going to visit 

Obviously a great pilot, it’s the softer skills of charm, humor and simply caring that made us feel compelled to right this review

If we came back we would insist on having John but the highest praise I can give is that if one of our daughters brought him home we would welcome into our home
Thanks to John , Gail and team

review_title: Awesome!  Best way to see and appreciate the grandeur of the Grand Canyon!
review_text: My family and I thoroughly enjoyed our aerial and jeep tour of the South Rim of the Grand Canyon.  This was our first time to the Grand Canyon, and this tour made it truly memorable.  It is a well-run and friendly organization.  We highly recommend this tour.

Only realised two days before that it was possible to get to the Canyon from Phoenix in a day. This is where their flexible schedules really work well. 
We had a fantastic day. Got very lucky with weather and lack of crowds. 
It is all very well organised logistically. Yes, you are a little processed through the experiences - but that is the best way to get to experience and see so much in such a short space of time. 
Bryan our pilot and host is relatively new: but we felt hyper safe in his care and he navigated is through the stages of the trip like an old pro. I am sure he will build his banter as his experience grows. 
Overall we are absolutely delighted with the day. Thank you.
I definitely recommend seeing the Grand Canyon by air on your first visit. We did this first when we arrived. Incredible views and well-priced for a 45 minute rim to rim your. Great value!

review_title: Monument Valley and Grand Canyon Fly Over
review_text: My husband and I and our two friends from Australia thoroughly enjoyed the trip and it was so worth it -- this was our second "tour" with Westwind Air Service, and even though our first one at the Grand Canyon was fantastic, this one at Monument Valley, and flying over Lake Powell, and another flyover view of the Grand Canyon was amazing!  Everyone was professional, friendly, and very competent.  We look forward to our next trip.

We booked a custom charter for our family of 4. We used the service to transfer us from Phoenix to Sedona, but after doing tours of Monument Valley and the Grand Canyon. I dealt with Gayle, via their chat option and made the arrangements. We were at the airport at 7:30 and greeted by friendly staff. Used the restroom, given an over view of our day, offered snacks, then boarded. Had a great tour at Monument Valley, then lunch, then a fly over of the Grand Canyon, then landed and went into the park. All the guides were set up and waiting for us and everything just perfect. The kids and adults enjoyed the entire day. Thanks to everyone for a great experience.

review_title: Flight over Grand Canyon, Glen Canyon Dam and Monument Valley from Page
review_text: I cannont recommend this trip more highly.  The Grand Canyon was spectacular, but the Glen Canyon dam and Monument Valley was such a suprise.  Do the full trip, spend the money the scenery, geography and flight are MORE THAN WELL WORTH IT.  DO IT!

My husband and I totally enjoyed this trip.  The fly over the canyon was something you just have to experience, words can't describe it.  If you're taking a trip to the canyon you must fly over the canyon.  The only confusing thing for us was Westwind subcontracts the Jeep part of the tour, so we got a little confused with the tipping protocol.  We planned on tipping at the end for the whole trip, but once we figured out that Westwind subcontracted the Jeep we hadn't tipped the pilot for the fly over trip.  I don't think we were the only ones confused because no one in our party tipped him.  Fortunately, the pilot on the way back was his friend, so we gave him the tip for both him and the other pilot.  Perhaps that may be something you could make clear to the customers.  Other than that it was a great afternoon.

review_title: Excellent tour of the horseshoe bend and rainbow bridge
review_text: We loved every minute of this flight. The horseshoe bend looks fantastic from the sky. The rainbow bridge also looks nice but we couldn’t get a perspective of how large it actually is. Lake Powell looks amazing from the plane. Our pilot Brian was top-notch. Overall, a much better experience than spending 6-7 hours on a boat from Page.
Money well spent. Wyatt was our pilot and he could not have done a better job of communicating, engaging and keeping us safe.   A once in a lifetime bucket list trip worth every penny.

We did the Grand canyon to monument valley with ground tour trip.  Very good, scenic flight over the Grand canyon was breathtaking, trip in MV was OK, saw all the main sights, would definitely recommend as a treat.
l'esperienza di volo su un piccolo aereo è fantastica, su un luogo meraviglioso, ed incantevole durante un viaggio da molto tempo desiderato.

i had guests in from NYC, with limited time, we booked the flight from Phoenix, then Helicopter to floor of Grand Canyon, then a pontoon ride on the Colorodo River. Toured the West Rim. Great Trip.  Our Pilot/Guide Daniel was with us the entire day. He was awesome!!

Nous sommes à PAGE et pensons qu’il serait juste génial de survoler des sites que nous n’aurons pas le temps de visiter pendant notre séjour. Rdv pris avec cette compagnie qui a des avions sur PAGE. Notre pilote sera Burton. Jeune, sympa. Avec lui, nous ne serons que tous deux dans ce petit avion. 1h40 de vol. PAGE, Horseshoe bend, le Grand Canyon, Rainbow Bridge, Lake Powell. 1h40 à écarquiller les yeux. C’est juste extraordinaire de voir toutes ces merveilles du haut.

Boat ride was disappointingly short, especially considering the trek down to the dock.  Should have been at least 30 minutes.  We also spent A LOT of time standing in lines.  There should be constant shuttle buses available.  It would have been nice to have a brief break to sit for a bit rather than go from one site to another.  All activities were done before we got to lunch which was not very tasty.  We don't feel we the cost was worth the adventure.

review_title: Amazing!!! This is a must and this tour is the best!
review_text:
I booked my tour from home directly from their webpage. I had exchanged with the responsible which is absolutely lovely and very attentive person.
Reaching the airport was quite easy with their instructions. I had the most warm welcome from the staff.
Pilot and Co pilot were very professional. Seeing Sedona from up and afterwards the Grand Canyon was amazing and I deeply think that it is one of a lifetime experience not to be missed.

This trip was everything we could have hoped for and more!  The entire staff was professional, courteous, and most importantly very good at what they do!  Our pilot flew us up, took us around to the various scheduled activities, and made everything go smoothly.  The flight back was a little bumpier due to the rising daytime temperatures, but he handled the aircraft masterfully and made the trip an absolute pleasure.  We could not recommend this company and tour enough!!
Loved every minute of this tour. Very friendly staff. Lunch was a hot meal of fair value but who cares. The rest of the tour was awesome!

Westwind gave me everything I had hoped for...An overall informative/view of the Grand Canyon. We could never have visited the Canyon in one day like Westwind provided for us both on the ground and in the air. Excellent customer service too. Hope we can bring the rest of the family in the future.

review_title: Wonderful way to visit the Grand Canyon in a day
review_text: We had only one day, coming from Phoenix, in which to visit the Grand Canyon. This was expensive, but worthwhile - all the arrangements and connections worked well, at no stage were we asked for any extra payments and everyone with whom we dealt was efficient, enthusiastic, helpful and charming. And Gail was best of all!

We had done this trip before but were back in the area with a foreign exchange student. She had obviously never seen the canyon so we went again. The trip was seamless just as before. The people at checkin ensured smooth loading and we were off. The true value of the tour is the ability of the pilot / guide to get you around while at the canyon. They get you in front of the lines and have all the tickets in hand to ensure smooth passage through the many different activities. 

Overall great experience and easily one of the top 3 excursions we’ve ever done.

We took the West rim tour with the helicopter and boat rides.  The whole experience, from booking to end of tour, was easy.  The ladies in the office (Val and Gayle) are friendly and enthusiastic.   Snacks and water were provided for our trip.  Steven was our pilot and helped make the day perfect.  We were fortunate to pick up more passengers in Sedona so we were able to see some magnificent views in addition to the Canyon.  Nothing about this tour was below par.

What a delight.  The flight form Phoenix to the Grand Canyon via Sedona was fascinating.  Having spent a few days at south rim it was great to get a different perspective.  Then on the the marvels of Monument Valley - Hard to describe and do justice.  A Navajo tac lunch and then a flight back rounded out a great day.  

The staff and pilots were great.  All in all well worth the money.

The whole experience was great. From the reservation all the way to the trip. From the office personnel to the airport personnel. Experience the canyon from the air. Seeing it from the rim does not compare

We did a tour of the grand canyon via plane, then took a helicopter down into the canyon, did a boat ride on the river then skywalk and had lunch. Our pilot Wyatt was wonderful. Once in a life time visit and it was wonderful.  Highly recommend Westwind .

Our pilot, Burt C., was excellent, professional, and quite knowledgeable about our trip to Monument Valley.  We were excited to stop in Sedona to pick up another couple to head over the gorgeous Grand Canyon, Lake Powell, Painted Desert, and land in Monument Valley to take the ground tour.  OMG!!!  The views were awesome!!!!!!  Pictures didn't do the landscape justice....you have to experience this trip once in a lifetime. :<)  
Arizona is quite beautiful and thank you West wind employees, tour guides & great pilot for the well planned opportunity to experience such a successful trip!  Deb R.

Apart from the last 10 minutes of yesterday we had an awesome day...my son and I both had to use sick bags just as we were coming back into Sedona! Lol
I found the tour on trip adviser and after a couple of emails back and forward between Australia and Arizona we knew that this was the trip of a lifetime. 
It’s hard to pick a favourite bit of the tour as the scenery was awesome from start to finish, our Pilot/ tour guide Henry was fantastic and we loved his sense of humour.
I think we were a little spoilt because it was just the four of us and apart from the queue for lunch and the queue for photos on the airwalk we were straight into everything. 
The food for lunch was probably my least favourite part, but who could argue with the view while eating it. 
Definitely lived up to, and even surpassed our expectations, even with a little air sickness.

review_title: 10 Star Service from phone call to End of experience
review_text:
I cannot recommend this company and ots beyond accomadationing services enough! To start,  I am not a huge planner because my life is so uncertain and unpredictable in my line of business.  I messaged Westwind Air and IMMEDIATELY recieved a phone call back from Val.   She had fantastic news for me… they still had 2 available openings for the time amd date I preferred, with less then 18 hours motice I had given her regarding the Grand Canyon West Rim tour.  Where do I begin?  Let's start with my arrival to Deer Valley Airport where we depart.   I was greeted by Val herself, with snacks refreshments and a phone charger ( which is standard for anyone waiting at the lounge)
 I arrived an hour early expecting things to be a little busy,  but I was checked in-and-out within one minute! Wow! Delightful! 
 Soon after we were given about 5 minute notification for departure anyone who needs to use the bathroom now's your chance even the bathroom was amazing!  If there is anything you forgot to do or bring before you came to West wind air service they had already thought of it!
 Now, on to the amazing adventure. Henry would be our pilot for the day and accompanying us on the tour.   Considering this was the 1st time I had ever flown on a 10 passenger plane I requested to sit next to the pilot, permission granted! Thanks Val again!  Perhaps a once in a lifetime experience? And off we flew with a guided tour via headsets from Phoenix to the West rim of the Grand Canyon.   Once we arrived at the Grand Canyon airport we were immediately escorted over to of the helicopters.  Again, no wait, quick effecient we were off in a helicopter escorting us down to The Colorado River Pontoon Boat excusion.  Off the heli, now we hop on a boat.  Id say we waited a total of 1 minute?
 We were then greeted by our pontoon boat captain who drove us on a little tour down the river, with insight and information about the wonderous Canyon.  Terrible that I cannot remember his name, I think Leo. Super friendly and took pictures of everyone on the boat.  
 After our boat ride we ran backup to the helicopter and requested once again to sit front row with the pilot.. Permission granted!  I video the entire flights backup the Canyon including views and the Colorado River.   Helicopter brings us back where the bus is waiting.. to take us to The West Rim GLASS skywalk!  I can't emagine if I had tried to experience this on my own,  As the lines were tremendous but Henry and westwind air had an alternate plan .. there would be no waiting for our party of 8! What? Impressive! 
 After our walk on glass over the Grand Canyon we would hop back on the bus to enjoy lunch overlooking yet another part of the Canyon.
 Surprising lane the ones that was included was probably one of the better meals I've had on this entire trip and the scenery was outrageous after launch we had time to hike the Canyon take some pictures taken the view just an overall amazing experience!  It does not end there! 
 Back on the plane to which I gave up my piloting position to another member of the party and a quick flight back to Deer Valley West when air service were Valerie is awaiting us, with PHOTOS she had taken before take off next to the plane! 

 This was the most well organized planned out thoughtful accommodating service oriented company and trip Ive done to date.   You can not imagine, that in 7 hours, one could do all of this and be back for dinner! Take off at 11 am, back by 615
 I am looking for an opportunity to come back out to Arizona again and would hands down absolutely do this day again! 

Thank you so much to West Wind amd its associates for making my first trip to the Grand Canyon unforgettable!
Wonderful day trip from Phoenix so we could fit in the Grand Canyon.  Excellent service, they worked us in last minute. Great tours and an amazing way to see the Grand Canyon.

review_title: Hassle free way to fly over the Grand Canyon
review_text: Easy to book, efficient process at Tussayan airport and professional flight even though local climatic conditions meant we had quite a bumpy ride. Very smooth landing.
The entire flight from Phoenix to the Grand Canyon was amazing! Fabulous views of the Grand Canyon! Highly recommend!

We went all out with the flight to Grand Canyon west rim. Helicopter to bottom, boat ride on the river in the canyon, then Skywalk and lunch. Trip was very well done and our pilot was our guide as well. He was great and we felt safe and had a lot of fun. There wasn’t really much to the boat ride, very short and could have left that out I think. My daughter said the day felt like an Adult Field Trip! Lol
Staff was extremely professional, views of the Grand Canyon were magnificent, both areal and from the southern rim... a truly memorable experience...

review_title: Fabulous tour by air and by jeep
review_text:
Worth. Every. Penny. 
We were going to drive from Phoenix to Grand Canyon and visit for a day and thought it would be way more fun to go by air and land. Googled this place and they did not disappoint. At $549 per person, 8 of us got into a very comfy tiny plane and flew over Sedona, flagstaff and the Grand Canyon. Spent 30 min over Grand Canyon alone. Landed and took a pink Jeep tour (included in the piece). Our guide was Lucy and she was absolutely awesome. Spent about 2-3 hrs on land with her. She provided us with lunch (sandwich, chips, cookie, apple and water). Flew back to Phoenix in same plane. Cannot remember the pilot, but he just had twins, so congrats and thanks for a terrific day and experience! We will never forget this day!

review_title: Couldn’t Have Asked For A Better Experience!
review_text: Everything about our experience with Westwind from checking in at the desk to the moment we stepped out of the plane was awesome! The ride was for our anniversary and it’s a special memory we won’t soon forget!

review_title: Fantastic trip to Monument Vallety and Grand Canyon.
review_text: Fantastic trip and highlight of USA visit. A great way to see this locality and value for money. Would recommend.
Our family had a great time on this tour. My boys are ages 9 and 11 and loved flying in the plane. The flyover of the canyon was fantastic.

review_title: West Rim Tour w/plane, helicopter, boat & bus tours
review_text: The whole experience was truly amazing and well worth the cost.  From booking to flying and completing the tour with a souvenir photo, it was top notch service all around.

review_title: BOB and CHEF CHRIS GO TO THE CANYON
review_text: Very professional staff, pilots, and attendants. Enjoyable flights and on time all the way and the package includes all ticketing. Wyatt was a great and knowledgeable guide with outstanding piloting skills
excellent and well organized. trip went smoothly and we were well attended to. My only comment would be a longer boat ride to see more of the canyon from below.

Nice flight from Sedona. Met Pink Jeep at GC airport for tour of south rim. Returned to GC airport for flight back to Sedona. Great day out. Pilot was friendly and courteous and kept us informed of flight progress and landmarks.

Awesome trip to the Grand Canyon. We felt very safe flying to and from the Canyon. We spent a good bit of time flying over and around the Canyon...warning the flight can be a little bumpy in the canyon but it was a great experience.
