From check in to check out the service was top notch. The tour around the canyon in the jeep tour was very fun but very windy in March....wear layers bc it is 20 degrees cooler in the Canyon. Highly recommend West Wing.

We flew from Sedona to west Grand Canyon on Westwind air.  We had a great flight.  Once we arrived we boarded a helicopter and flew down into the canyon!  What an amazing experience.  Then we floated down the Colorado river.  The canyon is beautiful.   We finished with a visit to the skywalk.   This trip is fantastic and a must do for anyone with one day at the canyon.  I highly recommend this tour!

My wife and myself we picked up by plane in Sedona.We flew to the Grand Canyon.We were helicoptered to the canyon floor and then rode the Colorado River.We went out on the Sky Walk and had a very nice lunch on the edge of the canyon. The pilot guided us the whole day.I would rate this trip a ten.

review_title: An Awesome Grand Canyon Day Trip
review_text: Great trip, great pilot, awesome views.  Westwind handled everything for us.  The guide they hired to take us on our Grand Canyon hike really knew his stuff and was easy to talk to.  He packed in a lunch for us and took us down into the canyon all while giving us history and answering our questions.

Easy to book and very organized.  Great communication before the trip on what to expect.  The flight over the Grand Canyon was breathtaking.  So was landing and take off in Sedona.
Really good value versus a 5  hour drive each way and the cost of overnight hotel.  The guide on the jeep tour was very engaging, knowledgeable and funny.  We loved the whole thing and will do it again with out of town guests.
Westwind went above and beyond! From the booking, to the day of, to the tour - every step was first class treatment. The flight over the Canyon was breathtaking.

Trip was enjoyable on one hand we had a private plane in a private tour and all that was nice. However you advertise a much larger plane and that is the one I was expecting to go on larger windows more stable ride.

review_title: Great once in a lifetime experience if you want to knock out the canyon in a day!
review_text: Plane was great, very roomy seats.   Incredible views all around.    The Pink jeep was a nice vehicle to get you around in but just keep in mind it just drops you off at the spots for the views, no additional off roading....
The whole tour package was wonderful, and the entire staff was marvelous!  Highly recommended.  May take another tour with Westwind.

Wonderful day trip from Phoenix to the Grand Canyon with family for daughters birthday.   Great friendly folks in the office, free candy bars and snacks while we waited and confidence inspiring pilot.

review_title: This was a once in a lifetime experience!
review_text: The view and experience were superb. The helicopter and boat ride add a dimension to the Grand Canyon that are beyond expectation.  Rob, our pilot was fantastic.  This day trip was Great!

review_title: Bucket list but don't kick the bucket here
review_text: The Skywalk is an engineering feat well documented in ASCE's Civil engineering magazine when it was built. But seeing it and standing on it is another experience. Just go there and enjoy the view because you can't take any pictures of yourself on the Skywalk - they do it for you at a price. Just as any other tourist trap, you could spend $80 on pictures only you can enjoy. The Skywalk is located at Eagle Point, which is an unprotected edge of the canyon. Don't be tempted to take a picture at the edge of a 4,000 feet drop. People die here trying to take pictures with their $2,000 Nikon. Be careful, stay off the edge. The only way to see all the attractions at Grand Canyon West is to park at the Airport and take a bus route run by the Havasupai Tribe. Buy the Legacy Gold ticket ($79.00) and you can visit three attractions - Skywalk, Eagle point (right there) and Guano Point  and get a lunch included. Just keep off the edge and enjoy the view. The bus route runs only in one direction so you cannot go back and forth. You can also catch a helicopter ride to the bottom of the canyon from the airport for $130 pp. The gift shop has some of the tribal handicrafts and all the other souvenirs and T-shirts made in China, all priced to help you remember the quality soon after you bought it. Having said all that - this is a must do trip, the views are exhilarating, the drive from Kingman is beautiful and if you pick a nice Spring day, you will love it and remember it for a life time.

We went on the Grand Canyon Skywalk Adventure Tour at the beginning of March with an 8 year old. The tour was as described and a wonderful day, but this company's service was outstanding. We had a tight schedule and originally planned on doing the tour on a Saturday, but the weather made the trip impossible and we rescheduled to Sunday. Val and her team were wonderful with communication with the change. I spoke to her by email and by phone a few days beforehand when the weather started looking questionable, and again the day before to confirm. I really appreciated the helpful communication and would absolutely book another tour with Westwind next time we are in Arizona.

review_title: Would highly recommend if your looking for an awesome trip up to the Canyon!
review_text: I took a tour of the Grand Canyon with Westwind Air Service and it was one of the most incredible trips i have ever taken!  Our Pilot was incredible at pointing out different landmarks on the way there and the flight was as smooth as could be. We even got to land at Sedona which I absolutely loved! I saw so much of the state and would highly recommend Westwind if you want to see the Canyon in the most spectacular fashion.

review_title: This was the best trip EVER to see the Grand Canyon
review_text:
My family and I (total of 3 adults) went on this trip December 24, 2017.  It was the highlight to our vacation trip to Scottsdale, even though we loved Scottsdale.  Our helicopter pilot, tour guide was excellent.  He was friendly and very knowledgeable of the area.  We felt very comfortable with him and he was more than glad to take pictures for us.  
The helicopter ride down to the bottom of the Grand Canyon was also good and well worth it.  This also included the pontoon ride which was also fun!
The Glass Skywalk was terrifying for some of us, but I LOVED IT!  The views were incredible.  It was nice that the lunch was included at Guano Point and we enjoyed the food and the sightseeing from that location.  
I would highly recommend this trip.  It was unforgettable and something that we did not regret spending the money on.

Westwind was recommended to me by the Four Seasons Scottsdale.  The hotel made all of our arrangements and they did not disappoint.  Lindsey at Westwind welcomed my party to the terminal bright and early on the morning of December 29th.  This was after being picked up by their shuttle at our hotel.  Every aspect of the trip was covered.  We never lifted a finger.  On top of this we were originally scheduled to travel to the South Rim; however, due to snow they changed our itinerary to the West Rim.  They wanted to ensure we had a wonderful day.  We did have a wonderful day.  In fact it was an amazing day.  Words cannot describe the views we saw of the Grand Canyon.  We covered all forms of transportation from plane, helicopter, boat and bus.  This tour cannot be recommended enough if you are staying in the Phoenix area.  Make sure to ask for Lindsey and she will take great care of you and your party!

We booked a last minute tour to the Grand Canyon. Excellent service by Lindsay to arrange a flight for us the night before. Val was so kind helping us plan activities while in town. Lowell flew us over, great smooth flight. Fun, informative Pink Jeep tour with Sam. Then a beautiful sunset flight back. Well spent day and excellent service.

review_title: What a way to see the Grand Canyon!!
review_text: The family and I are just returning from a Phoenix New Year’s trip, the highlight of which was our Grand Canyon tour.  I booked the tour with Westwind after reading about them online.  It was an absolute home run.  A bit of background:  I had convinced my kids that we were doing a driving tour to the Grand Canyon from Phoenix and to prepare for 10 hours in a car with a tour guide.  The Westwind folks were so wonderful and played along; the bellyaching from the kids was phenomenal.  It wasn’t until we were ready to board a small plane that the kids realized the surprise.   Everything thereafter was one surprise after another.  Private plane to the Grand Canyon; helicopter to the base; boat ride down the Colorado; excursions throughout the day—all led by our pilot!  The professionalism by all was top notch.  The hospitality, unrivaled.  And for the top-notch, hands-on service we received every minute of the day, the trip was a bargain.  Easily would have paid twice as much on the east coast for half the kindness and competence.

Our family of 6 took the tour to Grand Canyon West. Bruce was our pilot and tour guide and he was terrific. Very friendly and extremely patient with us as we kept stopping for more photos (he is also a good photographer).  We were blown away by the cruise on the Colorado River and the jaw dropping helicopter ride to the base of the canyon.  This was our second trip with Westwind and I would highly recommend them!

review_title: le meilleur panorama du lac Powell, en vert et ocre !
review_text: Nous avions réservé le tour du lake Powell, avec la compagnie Westwind Air Service, « Lake Powell Flight including Rainbow Bridge and Horseshoe Bend ». Décollage de bonne heure pour avoir un air pas trop chargé en évaporation, et… pour avoir le temps d’enchaîner sur le tour d’Antelope Canyon à midi. Nous sommes enchantés de ce tour en avion : en choisissant 8 h comme heure de décollage, nous n’étions que deux passagers dans le caravan : vues remarquables, pilotage impeccable de Rick K. On est subjugué par l’immensité de ce lac artificiel (cadre du film « la planète des singes » (1968)), quand on le survole ainsi à basse altitude. On passe au-dessus du barrage, puis de la marina, des formations rocheuses dont notre préférée, le sous marin, puis rainbow bridge avant une boucle pour le retour sur la planète. Very good trip !

We booked this trip to be the highlight of our week in Sedona: private flight from Sedona to the Canyon, Jet Helicopter tour, boat ride, Skywalk, the whole bit. Expensive but we expected a lifetime experience. Our pilot, Lloyd, was wonderful, and his plane ride over the canyon was probably the best part of the day, viewing the Canyon from above. The helicopter ride was a bust: a short trip down to the bottom of the Canyon, 4 adults  squeezed into the back seat of a Chopper and the two in the center could not see a damn thing. I know as I was one of those people. My husband, at 6'4" was also jammed into the back seat while two "normal size" people were put in front where there was the most space. We have flown private helicopters in multiple vacation resorts in addition to using them for business travel and this equipment was nothing like the caliber of what we had expected.  Being so jammed into it was a terrible experience.  The good news was it was such a short trip, it didnt really provide a tour of the Canyon as we had expected - but we wouldnt have seen anything anyhow. the "boat ride" was a ten minute float upstream and down: nice but nothing spectacular, a paucity of narration by the captain. The Skywalk was beautiful and worthwhile, overlooking the canyon - and lunch was adequate. Lloyd took us on a short hike and really gave interesting info about the canyon, the history, etc.  He was truly a gift for the day.  All in all, this tour was extremely expensive and less than fulfilling.

We flew to Monument Valley with the pilot Benjamin. The trip was excellent and Benjamin was the perfect guide and pilot. He made such an effort to look after us and entertain us. He was so well informed about the geography and history of all the places we flew over. I was a bit worried about flying in such a small plane but he was very professional and reassuring. 

Monument Valley is well worth a visit. It’s a once in a life time trip!

review_title: West Rim Adventure tour Exceeds expectations
review_text: We took this tour on Fri Oct 26 at 11 am from Phoenix.  We were 4 adults and Ben was our pilot and guide.  The trip was amazing!  The end of October had perfect weather and only small crowds so we did not experience the log jam issues raised by other reviewers.  The plane was comfortable and had great views. I sat in the back and was very comfortable. I am not small.  Ben was an excellent pilot and pointed out several landmarks beyond what was provided in the audio narration.  The helicopter to the Colorado river was smooth and the river boat ride had great views.  We expected the Glass Skywalk to be a highlight but were disappointed that the venue is disrupted by being chaperoned by photographers which prevents everyone from admiring the views. Their photos have the skywalk railings in them which caused us not to be interested in buying them. Viewing and personal photos on the Skywalk property were amazing however. Guano Point views were also wonderful. During the entire trip our pilot Ben acted as our personal tour guide which was a great addition to this trip.  The return flight was at Sunset and also had amazing views. The only thing we would have changed for this trip would have been bypassing the photographer line at the skywalk to avoid the interruption and delays.  Re: the value it was well worth it.  Our experience took 7.5 hours, had a round trip plane ride, a helicopter down to the Colorado river and back, a boat ride on the river, a bus ride to and from the Skywalk, access to the Skywalk, and a buffet lunch.  It was a wonderful experience!

review_title: Amazing Aerial Tour of Grand Canyon
review_text: Having made prior visits to the Grand Canyon and always feeling awestruck standing there, the Westwind Air tour we were privileged to take Saturday, October 20, 2018, will be remembered as the best visit ever. Only way to describe it...AMAZING. Our pilot, Ryan, was wonderful. Although the pre-recorded descriptions throughout the journey were very informative, it would have been nicer to hear Ryan more, and not over the recording when he did speak.

review_title: The BEST and most time-efficient way to see all of these landmarks!
review_text:
My wife and I were recently driving across the country, and we had only a handful of hours to take in places like the Grand Caynon, Bryce Canyon, and Arches National Park. On a whim I looked up flights over Monument Valley, and found the Westwind Air Service tour options. Boy am I glad that I did - yes, it's a splurge, but you get SO much for your money. We had a prop plane to ourselves and got to see the Grand Canyon, Navajo Mountain, Lake Powell, Rainbow Arch, Black Mesa, and best of all Monument Valley, where we were flying in and around the buttes. Our pilot Jordan was professional yet laid back, and offered additional information about the area not normally included on the audio guides. We took so many pictures of this incredible part of the country, and I feel like we were able to see so much more than if we'd been driving.

If we had had a week or more to explore the area, we might have foregone the money (and probably spent it on lodging) - but with a time crunch, this was an incredible way to see some of the most beautiful places on earth. I wouldn't hesitate to fly with Westwind Air again! Thank you!!

review_title: Understand What You Are Getting With The $700 Grand Canyon Plane, Helicopter and Boat Tour
review_text:
This is not a direct slam against Westwind Air Service but rather a realistic view of the tour they offer and the control they do not have.  Westwind flies you to the west rim Hualapai reservation and back, they book a helicopter ride through one of the services there and book the boat ride through a business owned by the Hualapai.  There is a bus service that runs to 3 stops; a western town mock-up that we were not allowed to get off at, the sky-bridge area and an area we refer to as Guano Point where you get a lunch.
We paid $2800 for the four of us which we thought it was going to be an amazing first class adventure but unfortunately it turned out to be the equivalent of herding cattle.
We were most excited about the helicopter and boat ride but these turned out to be the worst part.  We were told by Westwind that we would be the only ones in the helicopter which has 2 nice view seats in front and 4 very small seats across the back.  When we got there, they crammed all of us into the back seats which were so tight that we could not even take pictures.  When we got into the small tour boat it had engine and steering problems.  By the time we got going the driver only went a couple of minutes up the river then turned off the engine.  She was beyond rude when questioned about what was going on and kept sniping at people when they moved around to try and get better pictures.  On top of that, this area was less than inspiring and did not make for good pictures which is not what we expected.
After the so-called boat ride we sat and waited, and waited, and waited for the unpleasant helicopter ride back.  This significant delay compressed our time frame for everything else.  
We next went to the Skywalk which is all about selling you the professional pictures since they do no allow you to take any.  We could not appreciate the Skywalk because it was crazy busy and packed with people which was compounded by the photographers holding everybody back whenever they took pictures.  The best pictures there are off to the side with the Skywalk in the background.
Next we were hustled off to Guano Point where we got a little cafeteria lunch.  Guano Point is the best place to take photos as it extends well into the canyon and has great vistas on either side.  We were enjoying exploring a little of this area when the pilot came up behind us and said it was time to go.
SUMMARY:
1. The plane ride is hot, loud, the tour information in the headphones is pretty much worthless and the person in the very back seat is only comfortable if you are a munchkin.
2. We did not receive the helicopter ride we were promised and it totally failed expectations - would not do again.
3. The boat ride was a joke with less than impressive vistas - would not do again.
4. The Skywalk was insanely busy and is not the best viewpoint - would not do again.
5. Guano Point was the best place for photos but we were not allowed enough time to appreciate it.
6. We did not see any "shows" as stated in the advertisement.
All in all we were expecting awe and grandeur but what we got was a crush of humanity in a get 'em in/get 'em out environment.   
Like many things, being convenient to get to does not make it the best place to go.

review_title: Air Tour Page to Grand Canyon Tour with Westwind
review_text: To say that this splurge exceeded our expectations would be a huge understatement.  IT WAS WORTH EVERY PENNY!  Our pilot, Jordan, was professional, knowledgeable, and a great pilot.  There is no way we have ever seen so much splendor in such a short time if we had not taken this tour.  We got to see so much in a comfortable plane.  No crowds. No extreme heat (it was August). No lines.  Just a chance to absorb the beauty of this magical place.  We can’t recommend this enough.  You won’t be sorry.

Having had our already paid for aerial tour of the Grand Canyon with another tour guide cancelled with no notice, we (a family of five) phoned Westwind Air Services at 8.30 am desperately seeking an aerial tour that day.  Westwind could not have been more friendly and helpful.  They offered us a flight that lunchtime.

We met Sebastian, our pilot, at Sedona airport.  We had our own plane and each of us had our own window offering great unrestricted views.  We flew in low over the Canyon and had the joy of some great panoramas.  The flight was smooth and we had one of our great days a family.

Thank you so much to Westwind Air Service!

Our annual family vacation this year was to the Grand Canyon.  I had been as a child and can still remember how awestruck I was at seeing it despite seeing pictures before.  I decided to provide a surprise viewing of the canyon form multiple different perspectives via Westwind Air tours.  It was kept a surprise till the minute we arrived at the airport and was a huge success. Most liked the helicopter ride into the Canyon the most.  Our family of eleven had to take 2 planes and helicopters, but we were kept together the entire trip by our delightful and informative pilot/guides, Lowell and Carl. Despite the inevitable family drama, they maintained equanimity. The only drawback was the length of the whole event...we were exhausted!

As a youth, I walked to the river and back by moonlight.  This flight held my view in the faces of my guests.  I was pleased.

NOTE: Word of advice, This is not the occasion to test ones tolerance to small planes.

this was a surprise for the family & everyone had a blast..on the beautiful scenic plane ride, then a helicopter taking you through the Grand Canyon and finally a boat to get really in the beauty. Thankyou so much what an incredible journey.
We had the best time ever!  Nicest friendliest people you could ever meet. The views were spectacular. A memory for all time. Thanks a million

Dad and daughter get away in May included Grand Canyon tour (plane ride to West Rim, helicopter tour and boat ride on CO River. Followed by skywalk and lunch. 

Bill was an excellent guide and our pilot. Very enjoyable!!  Worth every penny!

One of the best experiences of my life was flying from Sedona to the Grand Canyon! The views were simply spectacular! The on the ground tour was also terrific at the Grand Canyon. The pilots were very knowledgeable and made the trips very enjoyable! I'd highly recommend this tour!

Our trip was fantastic! Our pilot and escort for the day was terrific! Sorry but not remembering his name  (Kipp?). He was great though and very pleasant to talk with . Smooth flight to the west rim and back from the Sedona Airport, cool helicopter ride down into the canyon and and a brief but enjoyable ride up and back down the Colorado river. The lunch served on the reservation was actually pretty good - hot chicken, mashed potatoes, and salad. Bring your own water  as the only water provided was at the lunch. The Skywalk was amazing and looking down, I was sure it was going to collapse under us, but obviously it didn't. A great day and a great value! There were only 4 of us on this tour which I liked. Another company offering similar outing was booked into the next two months and I''m sure the 9 seater passenger plane would have been full and it wouldn't have been as intimate and personal experience that we had with Westwind. Highly recommend!

review_title: Stunning Grand Canyon and Monument Valley
review_text: My wife and i recently did a flight over GC to Monument Valley landed had a tour around Valley then flew back to GC via Powell Lake and a quick stop at Page to refuel  absolutely spectacular pilot was great plane was comfortable. A highlight of a 5week trip. Brought wife to tears of happiness a one stsge

review_title: Wow! The Grand Canyon Skywalk Adventure Tour - West Rim
review_text: Wow! That’s all I could say each step of the way on this amazing Grand Canyon Skywalk Adventure Tour - West Rim! It was so fantastic! My boyfriend is the best for surprising me with this wonderful adventure while we were in Sedona!
The trip was awesome.  Bjorn was our pilot/guide and made it a truly great experience for me and my 12 year old son!

If you are looking for an experience that will blow you away, this is it! The flight was great, for those of you nervous about small planes, have no fear, the flight was smooth. We went on the day trip to Sedona, the scenery on the flight there and back was amazing, and the wine was just as good! The staff at Westwind were so nice and hospital, truly could not recommend this more!

We joined the tour 'Lake Powell Flight including Rainbow Bridge and Horseshoe Bend' on 6/18. I went primarily to see Rainbow Bridge and Horseshoe Bend from the air but ended up upset and disappointed. The passengers sitting on the left side of the plane couldn't see Horseshoe Bend. I was very upset. My husband sat on the right side but he said he could only see part of the Bend because the plane passed it so fast. We didn't get any audio description either. When the plane flew over Rainbow Bridge, it was very far away below us. It was so tiny and difficult to find. Regardless, the view of Lake Powell is breathtaking. So if you want to take a flight from Page, don't expect it to be the best view of Rainbow Bridge and Horseshoe Bend. Don't waste your money.
The flight was great. I would have liked to have been a little closer to the ground for better visabilaty.

review_title: Best way to see Grand Canyon!
review_text: What a luxurious,  hassle free and awesome way to see the Grand Canyon for the first time!!  Don't bother with those 12 hour bus rides to see this site.  Do it with (affordable). Style and treat yourself!  Awesome plane and pilot.  Super comfy ride. Awesome views. Loved this experience!!!

Went for a late afternoon tour of the Grand Canyon, and it was great! We had limited availability with our schedule as we were in Arizona on business, and the company was quick to respond to my email inquiry about a flight tour and worked with our time frame, same day. We arrived a bit early, had a place to grab some food beforehand and watch many planes come and go. Friendly staff, excellent pilot. Would definitely go again.

I loved this tour, it was a great way to see the Grand Canyon from Phoenix when short on time. At the same time, it didn't feel rushed at all. Our pilot/tour guide Tommy was very knowledgeable, enthusiastic about his subject and polite.
This was a big check on a bucket list item. Soooo much better than standing on the edge of the Grand Canyon and looking in. To fly all over and to see inside the Canyon was wonderful!!
Touring the Grand Canyon from the Cessna was amazing.  We’d all do it again in a heart beat.   After that the pink Jeep paled to the plane.  Everyone should see the amazing Grand Canyon from the air.
It was my second trip with Westwind to both rims of the Grand Canyon. Pilotes and guides are very friendly and absolutely know their stuff. Next time I'll do it again..

I must come back again to take pictures 
Muny things i can find in the sky
As a photographer, I would love to visit again! Thanks

review_title: Great experience with my 7 & 9 year old boys!
review_text: I was a little nervous doing the tour with 7 and 9-year-old boys, but it was wonderful and not stressful at all! The Pilot/Tour Guides are key to having a great experience on an endeavor like this. Our pilot, Lowell, did a wonderful job with the children in the group and knowing who may need an extra hand. Importantly, when a large group suddenly arrived at the West Rim at the same time as us for 2 portions of the expedition (meaning unusually long lines), he was flexible and allowed our tour to go longer without skipping any portions. He had already checked with everyone in the group on whether they had plans at a certain time restricting their day- and no one did. My children and I would have had a very different experience if Lowell had not allowed our group to explore at our own pace. The helicopter ride to the base and then pontoon boat ride through the Colorado River was well worth it. The Skywalk is so-so but worth doing once. By the time we got to Guano Point, and climbed up to the high point, we were all ready for a rest and enjoyed being rewarded with the beautiful view. Because my sons and I were flying out of Phoenix, and the others were out of Sedona, we got to see a bit of beautiful Sedona and had extra flight time with Lowell. On the way back to Phoenix, he made that time very special for the boys and he may have recruited 2 future pilots.

I read a lot of reviews before commiting.
All of them were amazing and they all were 100% true. The experiences is top notch! Amazing company, service and experience.
I ABSOLUTELY recomend it! Hands down.

There are many tour options but the Antelope Canyon tour is a no brainer!

Thank you Westwind Air Service! 
Kuddos to you all!!
👍🏻👍🏻
We only had a half-day opening to see the Grand Canyon. The ariel tour was breath taking, and our pilot was excellent.
Took a tour of the Grand Canyon. Everyone was so accommodating, they squeezed us in at the last minute. Tour from the air was fantastic. Ben, the pilot was great. Definitely take their tour!

Si vous passez par le Grand canyon, je vous recommande vivement de le voir depuis les airs. Le spectacle est merveilleux.
La compagnie westwind est très accueillante et beaucoup plus sympathique que la concurrence. De plus vous aurez l' assurance d'avoir un siège avec pare-brise. Si vous prenez un vol avec la compagnie concurrente vous devrez débourser 15 dollars pour avoir la certitude d'avoirune vitre...

review_title: Best Way to Experience the Grand Canyon in a Day!
review_text: We took the Grand Canyon West Rim Adventure and Skywalk tour from Sedona.  Bruce was our pilot and promptly greeted us in the Sedona Airport Lounge.  He then escorted us to a small plane that was very comfortable.  He flew us over Sedona, the Arizona desert, and to the Grand Canyon airport.  We then boarded our helicopter to take us down into the canyon. I was a little apprehensive about the helicopter ride, but the safety briefings held before we boarded calmed my fears.  The helicopter crew was also efficient in checking that all seat belts were properly secured.  My daughter and I were lucky enough to get the front seats of the helicopter -- pure glass in front.  It was an amazing experience to fly right by the walls of the canyon.  We landed in the bottom of the canyon to board our pontoon boat.  Summer was our tour guide on the pontoon boat.  She was pleasant and informative.  She took pictures of all the groups on board -- very nice touch to get our picture on the mighty Colorado river.  After the boat tour, we re-boarded the helicopter for our trip back to the airport.  We then boarded shuttle buses that took us to the Skywalk and Guano Point.  Guano Point was a magnificent 360 degree view of the canyon.  The lunch was OK, but not great.  The cookie was the best part!  We then headed back to the airport at the Grand Canyon to board our plane back to Sedona.  Bruce was great in keeping track of the group and making sure we knew exactly where to be and by what time.  Westwind does an awesome job of scheduling the tour early.  It really helped keep us ahead of the afternoon crowds.  Overall, it was a great day and we got to see a lot of sights in the Grand Canyon area.  I would highly recommend this tour if you can afford it.  It is pricey, but worth every penny.

review_title: Beautiful views over Lake Powell, flexible with our schedule
review_text: We arrived in Page, Arizona, with some extra time, and decided to look into an impromptu flight tour over Lake Powell.  Westwind Air was able to accommodate us, and our flight left about 30 minutes after we contacted them!  This is one of the great advantages of going with a smaller local company -- they are much more flexible.  All the larger companies had fixed schedules, and weren't willing to do an extra flight for just 2 people, but Westwind Air has some smaller aircraft and a more flexible, customer focused attitude.  Another advantage is that in the Westwind Air planes, every seat has a window; some of the larger companies have center seats that are not up against a window.  We really enjoyed our flight tour over Lake Powell to Rainbow Bridge; with its dark blue waters and twisting canyons heading off every which way, Lake Powell from above is a fascinating sight.  The pilot and other staff at Westwind Air were very friendly, and we were really happy that they could accommodate us on such short notice.  Highly recommended!

review_title: A whole new look at the canyon!!
review_text: From start to finish a wonderful experience. Val was a wonderful greeter. Snacks and coffee/water prior to take off. Very well organized. Our Pilot Tom Bruce was very professional and kept everyone at ease. Plane was very comfortable, and everybody had a window. Picked up 2 additional passengers in Sedona which was a treat flying into there. Flight time over the canyon was excellent and educational and 1 of only 3 air service companies allow to do it. Landed at the GC airport and got on a Pink Jeep tour and lunch which was also excellent. flight back to Phoenix via a different route was again scenic and informative. A Great way to see the Canyon from Phoenix without all the windshield time.

review_title: Bucket list trip to see Grand Canyon
review_text: From start to finish, this was an awesome efficient way to experience the Grand Canyon. Our pilot, Kip, was personable and focused on our having a great experience. Smooth flight there and back. Helicopter trip to boat ride was awesome!  Kip made sure we had great pictures of the day. Highly recommend!!

The service was very good. We were early, so was the pilot Bryce. Therefore we started right away.
The flight was rather shaky due to heavy winds, but Bryce was an excellent pilot.
Beautiful views of Lake Powell etc.

Having this on the 'must do List' for many years, to finally see the Grand Canyon, in all its splendor, was very awe inspiring to be very honest.  The Skywalk info center was more informative than the Skywalk attraction to me; the glass walk was less impressive than the hype.  The actual standing on the West Rim or the jutting rock formation was definitely the MOST exciting part of the tour.  Thousands of feet above the Colorado River!  Truly Spectacular!

This trip was amazing start to finish. Upon arrival at the airport we were greeted and given an overview of our day by a vibrant and friendly staff member. We were given free snacks (choices of Rice Krispie treats, pop tarts, granola bars, peanuts, trail mix, crackers etc.)and water to pack and take with us for the day. Got our pic taken in front of the plane and 5x7 prints given to us when we got back (ours came out a little blurry so you may wanna take some on your cell or personal camera too just in case).  Bill our pilot was exceptional. He was friendly and informative and guided us throughout the day. The flight from Phoenix to the Grand Canyon was smooth and the plane was roomy. We had one stop in Sedona to pick up another family joining us on our tour and getting to see the red rocks of Sedona was an unexpected treat...the air strip was on top of a rock/mountain so quite the experience landing and taking off. Upon arrival at the canyon we went to the helicopter ride first. Exhilarating!  First time on a helicopter and it was great. Ride was short to the base of the canyon then we got on a boat to ride in the Colorado for a bit. Our boat driver Jared was GREAT. He took the best pics of our group and did a 360 with the boat to get killer panoramic pics. After the boat ride it was back to the helicopter for another short ride back to the top of the canyon. From there we went to the Skywalk via a bus ride. Got suckered into buying all the pics since you can’t take your own camera but the pics are great—got all 14 on a jump drive for around 68 dollars. They do have lockers to put your stuff in free of charge since you can’t take them with you on the attraction.  The skywalk was great but not as big as we expected. There is also a great ledge out front when you get off the bus to get some good pics. From there off to lunch...only disappointing part of trip. Was cafeteria type lunch with choice of meat, corn on cob that was dry and instant mashed potatoes with gravy. Salad, roll, and cookie included. Personally I would rather pack a lunch but it was included so really can’t complain. After lunch you can climb on the rock formations or hike for a bit at Guana point. Cool opportunity to take pics where it looks like you are hanging off the cliff. From there back to the bus and then the flight home. Left around 7:15 am and back around 2:45 pm....again had the extra stop in Sedona to drop off the other family. Got our pics given to us from the AM upon arrival and had a fresh brownie that was in the lobby while we waited for our Uber ride back to hotel. Overall great experience and I highly recommend. 

Tips—
1.  Bring a small bag that fits on your shoulder to carry water/snacks—we did small drawstring ones and it was perfect. 
2. Load up on a few snacks and water provided upon arrival at Westwind so you don’t have to pay for them while at the canyon 
3. Check weather. Parts of tour were cold so a light jacket was perfect.
4. Wear tennis shoes. Terrain is rocky/gravel and we saw way too many people in sandals or heels. 
5. Wear sunscreen...especially on face, bring a hat if you like. 
6. Sunglasses are a must.

Toured the western portion of the Grand Canyon through a Westwind Air tour. We flew from the Phoenix area up to the canyon, boarded a helicopter and flew down to the CO river where we boarded a river boat and boated up and down the river with the river guide telling us all about the area, helicoptered back to the top, boarded a bus and drove to several scenic areas, had a leisurely lunch at a restaurant overlooking the canyon, stopped at the Skywalk at Grand Canyon West and walked out on a sheet of glass with nothing below us but air and the canyon floor some 4000 feet below which was thrilling although it took a few minutes to get used to the feeling of being suspended in air, bused back to the plane and flew back to Phoenix. Our pilot was Bjorn and he was so much fun. He interacted with us as much as we wanted. He told some great stories and he never hurried us at any stop, in fact, he encouraged us to take our time and enjoy the scenery. We were greeted when we got back, had photos taken and enjoyed the company of those we spent the day with before we went on our way. I would recommend this tour although it is a little pricey but how many times will you go back? It was worth the cost IMO.

We very much enjoyed our Monument Valley tour with Westwind Air.  We would not have been able to experience the region and see so much of the Grand Canyon if it wasnt for this tour as it would have been way too far for us to drive and they put together a wonderful, convenient day that allowed us to see the majesty of the Grand Canyon that you cannot hike and Horseshoe Bend and Lake Powell and flew us right to the entrance of Monument Valley  where we were met by a tour guide and taken privately around the park and treated to a delicious lunch and dropped right back to our plane and flown back to Sedona.  It was comprehensive and efficient and we got so much accomplished in a very comfortable way.  I was very grateful this existed!  Everything ran on time and I would recommend this company and their tours.
Excellent excursion.  We got to see all that Grand Canyon has to offer in a short amount of time.  Worth it!

Our family of 5 thoroughly enjoyed the Adventure trip.  The trip itself is amazing and spectacular, something to truly be seen in person; pictures don't capture the scale of the canyon (4,000 ft to the bottom!). Westwind service was excellent, with particular emphasis on our pilot, Mark.  Mark made the trip very enjoyable.  Professional, engaging, humorous and patient.  However, the highlight was the helicopter tour to the bottom of the canyon.  (The helicopter tour is booked through a separate company that Westwind hires.) Also, the staff at the Canyon is mostly local tribe people and they were also very friendly and offered very good service.

A few suggestions:  Westwind offers water and snacks at the departure airport.  Take plenty as there was only a fixed lunch offered.  We had a back-pack to stuff items in and it came in handy.  I would have taken more as we didn't stop for water except at lunch. Arrive early/or at least on time.  The area up at the Canyon gets very busy with tourists (primarily Chinese) from Vegas.  Westwind has planned the trip to get there a few hours before the tour groups descend on the area.  Our group was delayed (we were put with another family) about an hour and we saw how things could really get busy.  It worked out OK, but something to keep in mind.

Had a smooth flight and great pilot to take us to the West Rim.  Then an AMAZING helicopter ride down to the bottom of the canyon and boat ride which gave a wonderful perspective of its beauty.  'Captain Kip' stayed with us all day and kept us entertained, informed and satisfied.  This was a trip that was well worth the money.  I can't imaging spending basically 8 hours on the road in a day trip from Scottsdale to the canyon.  Our memories and pictures will be endless!

The thing that sets Westwind apart from other air service providers is the staff. I planned an engagement at their facility after a tour flight. The staff there could not have been more accommodating to my requests and questions. They truly made that day special, and it was all above and beyond what was expected of them as a business. If you are looking around for someone to host an aerial tour, a grand canyon trip or any other options they have, please use Westwind as I firmly believe they deserve your business.

review_title: Amazing trip to the Grand Canyon!
review_text: Highly recommend this trip!  Mark our pilot was great..very conscientious with a great sense of humor!  He made us all feel comfortable..especially those of us in the group who were a bit nervous about flying in a smaller plane.  We had a pretty smooth ride over Sedona on the way to the Grand Canyon...breathtaking to see the red rocks from the air.  The highlight was flying over the Grand Canyon!   The pink Jeep tour portion was also great..our guide Hailee was fun and knowledgeable!   Highly recommend!  Take your Dramamine if you are susceptible to motion sickness though!

Excellent day trip from Phoenix. See the Grand Canyon from the air, land, and water. Really immersive. Didn't need to worry about anything throughout the trip! Limited lunch options on the West Rim -bring food with you if you have dietary requirements (e.g. vegetarian etc.).

We had a wonderful experience with the Westwind Air Tour of the Grand Canyon.  Our pilot Duncan was nice,  everything ran on time,  we got a little fly by over Sedona on the way to the Grand Canyon and a nice 1/2 tour of the Grand Canyon before landing and getting a 3 hour Pink Jeep Tour on land..

We were limited in time while we were in Phoenix.  Westwind allowed us to fit a lot in one day without over exhausting ourselves.  We started in the morning.  Drove to the airport and filled out a couple of papers.  From there, we jumped on the plane and flew to Page, AZ.  Along the way, we flew over Sedona and enjoyed the aerial tour.  Once in Page, we jumped into a van and drove to the start of Antelope Canyon (10-12min).  We spent about 1.5hr walking through a beautiful section of the canyon.  Amazing!  After that, we got back on the van and headed to the airport.  Flying over lake,Dam,marble canyon,north rim Grand Canyon, then landing on the south rim.  They had the Pink Jeep company pick us up and take us in for a tour.  Picnic lunch looking over the South Rim.  Then a flight back to Phoenix around 4-5pm.  Perfect Day!

Myself, wife and 8 yr old daughter did the Tour to celebrate my birthday.  We had some hesitations prior regarding safety as we had our little one with us.  We were reassured prior by the company and soon after meeting our pilot/guide Mark we felt very comfortable.  The day was AMAZING.  Long yes, and you will be tired at the end but even our daughter did fine due to a good night sleep the night before.  Mark was terrific at keeping her involved and she told us at the end it was one of the coolest things she has done.  The cost was fair, not cheap but personally I would be cautious of discount tour companies.  The were informative, professional, and safety was a priority.  If you want to see the West Rim from Phoenix this is the only way I would recommend to do it and you will be so happy you did.

review_title: Planes, no trains (helicopter, boat) no automobile but a bus
review_text: Plane ride from PHX to West Rim was great even with a short stop in Sedona. Boat ride on Colorado River was short and smooth and visually pleasing, different perspective. The Helicopter ride to Canyon floor was breathtaking. Can't even describe it, unlike anything I've ever done. Skywalk blew me away. Afraid of heights but I still was able to do it by walking on opaque parts and holding onto railing. Get your picture taken and buy it! Supplied lunch was very good, ribs and beans. It's a long day and not for the faint of heart...but a great value for a couple. May be overwhelming for small children. Need good walking shoes. Ask for Tommy the pilot as your guide. Really nice guy, personable and he'll let you ride shotgun...for real!!

review_title: Brilliant day out to the Grand Canyon from Phoenix
review_text: We had a fantastic day out with Westwind on the Skywalk Adventure tour.  Everyone we dealt with were great.  Sebastian, our pilot and guide was excellent.  We flew in a small plane 4 passengers) to the Grand Canyon and then with a helicopter down to the base of the canyon for a short river trip on the Colorado river.  We also visited the skywalk and Guano Point.  Spectacular views throughout - highly recommended.

review_title: Wonderful experience (Valley of the Sun tour)
review_text:
Amazing team, amazing journey!

Don't think twice before booking. Pilots are wonderful guides and will explain everything along the way. Office team were very warm and welcoming.

We recently took a trip to the Arizona and used the Westwind Air Service for a flight from Phoenix to the Grand Canyon and back. All aspects of the trip from planning to execution were top notch. The team at Westwind was able to accommodate not only our short time frame but also one of our travelers who gets motion sick easily. The pilot, Jameson, was excellent and shared the history of the region in addition to the narration. For anyone visiting the Grand Canyon, this is a must see!

review_title: Touring the Grand Canyon from Phoenix
review_text: My wife and I had plans to travel to Phoenix.  Never having been to Arizona, we were loathe to visit without making a trip to the Grand Canyon.  The only problem was were had a limited number of days available.  We discovered the Westwind package - fly from Phoenix to Grand Canyon, hop on Pink Jeep tour, and fly back.  We opted to use the hotel pickup and drop off as well.  It could not have been easier.  The staff at Westwind were great.  The pilot was fantastic, and the Pink Jeep tour guide was the best.  If you have the money, this is the way to do the Grand Canyon from Phoenix.

Easy to book with great help and advice from the WAS team. I was contacted the day before to ensure I had no questions and everything was in place. The day was fantastic, our route was explained well and of course the sights were amazing. Great company and information from our pilot too. Could not recommend highly enough.

We thoroughly enjoyed our 7hr round trip from Phoenix to the Grand Canyon comprising of pick up from hotel, flight in an executive jet to the west rim of the canyon, a helicopter ride to the bottom of the Canyon, a boat trip on the river, ride back up on helicopter, followed by lunch and flight back to Phoenix. There was empty of to.e to walk around the canyon and the group has a maximum number of eight. Well organised with friendly staff; well worth the money of you only have a short time to visit the Canyon. Highly recommended.

We didn't have time to do the land and air tour of the Grand Canyon so we opted for Westwind's Grand Canyon Aerial Tour. The overall experience was spectacular as were the views. Our pilot was both personable and knowledgeable.

The experience was world class in every way. Given the time of year and the cooler temps, we had the Canyon practically to ourselves. The Adventure Package with Westwinds was top notch and one NONE of us will forget. Our pilot was exceptional.

review_title: Flight from Sedona to the Grand Canyon
review_text: My son (30) and I flew Westwind and it was an amazing flight. Our pilot was amazing and added to the flight with his knowledge an information about the area. Appreciated his tips and the education was fun, too! Highly recommend this to anyone and would do it again!

review_title: Great way ti see the Grand Canyon
review_text: This company is A+++++.  Very professional, friendly aand fly well maintained equipment.  If you dont have alot of time this is the way to do it.  You leave at 8:00am and are back by 3:00pm with over a 2 hr stay of the Grand Canyon.

review_title: Best way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: Everything about this experience was terrific. The plane was clean and comfortable. Our pilot, Ryan, was knowledgeable and friendly. And the views were breath-taking!!!

After we tryed to book a flight in advance without success, we visited the airport as we arrived at Tusayon. It was great that the Service of Westwind offers us a flight for the next morning. It was one of the great experieces of our lifes. If you ever come to Grand Canyon, don't miss to take a flight. Birgit and Jens from Germany

Westwind had all the bases covered.  They took care of our needs, all the details are ironed out.  The staff is friendly, knowledgeable, qualified, made you feel safe, and were very personable.  We enjoyed our excursion very much and it definitely felt like the best way to see the Grand Canyon!

review_title: Grand Canyon by air and jeep.
review_text: Our day was very good, we left Scottsdale about 11AM and headed north. The scenery was enjoyed very much from the air, both going there and returning. The visit to the Canyon was also very enjoyable, a place everyone should visit while in Arizona. Westwind Air served us with box lunches while we were enjoying the sights from the south rim. The office and flight crews were all very helpful with out needs.

review_title: Best way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: Great service! Convenient,  hospitable  staff, clean amenities at airport. Worth the money! Includes transportation to and from airport, boxed lunch and jeep tour. Worth every penny! Spectacular!!!
Westwind managed to pack a great visit to the Grand Canyon into a day!  The pilots, tour by Pink jeep of the South rim were all very professional.

review_title: Best Way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: We had one day to visit the Grand Canyon with our young children (ages 4, 6, and 8).  The Adventure tour was well worth the money and was better than expected.  The plane ride, helicopter ride, boat ride, lunch and SkyBridge were all perfect.  Things moved quickly enough that the children never got bored, but slow enough that everyone could keep up and not be completely worn out.  We were back to Deer Valley Airport by 3pm, which gave us plenty of time to take our tired kids back to the hotel, get them fed and in bed at a decent hour.  My husband and I are both professional pilots and can say the aviation portions were very safe and well done.  Good job Westwind!  The employees of Westwind were very informative, kind, and helpful.  Great customer service all around.

Would highly reccommend this tour! The only way to truly see the best parts of the Grand Canyon in a day. I loved every minute and guide was super educated and made our whole day so special!! A must do tour!
We absolutely loved our sunset trip. I was overwhelmed with how much the lady was willing to help me set up our trip. I had lots of scheduling issues and they saved the day!

review_title: Great way to see Rainbow Bridge
review_text: We had a fantastic flight touring Glen Canyon, Rainbow Bridge and the surrounding area. Such a fantastic way to see the area and so different from on the water. Cannot recommend this enough!

This is a terrific way to see one of the 7 natural wonders of the world.  We made the trip during the "slow" season so we had the helicopter and boat all to ourselves.  The Skywalk itself is "ok" (you'll need to put your camera, phone etc into a locker before you can go onto it and pay one of the "professional" photographers to take your pics) but the area around it is free to explore and spectacular.   Our pilot Cody and the rest of the Westwind team are professional, helpful and accommodating.  Highly recommend.

review_title: BREATHTAKING GRAND CANYON VIEWS WITH AARON
review_text: We took the 1 hour flight over the Grand Canyon in mid October with Aaron.  It was an amazing experience and we enjoyed every minute.  The plane was small, 6 seats including the pilot, but we felt safe with Aaron's safety briefing and the smooth flight. The views over the Canyon are unbelievable, only seen from above, and unlike seeing it from the rim.  We will fly with Westwind again and ask Aaron to be our pilot!

review_title: A day up in the air
review_text: This was the highlight of our trip. We jumped on the plane from Scottsdale and took the 90 minute flight to the Grand Canyon. Our party included myself, my fiance and both our parents. My future father in law is well into his 70's and didn't have any trouble. Our Pilot was very knowledgable and made us feel safe and comfortable. The Grand Canyon tour included a helicopter ride and a boat cruise. Talk about checking off the Bucket List! I would recommend this tour to anyone visit Arizona. Thanks for a special day, Westwind!
Excellent trip.  Never thought I would have the opportunity to fulfil a dream at my age. From a grateful pensioner.
Thank you for a fantastic adventure!! My husband,  three boys and I had an amazing day- It was a perfect trip for our entire family!
My family and I took a Westwind flight from Phoenix to the Grand Canyon. We had a great flight and tour on the ground. The staff was professional, friendly and eager to help. We all had a great time.

review_title: Great way to experience the Grand Canyon
review_text: We never had to wait in any lines, had great service and tour guide by our pilot, and got to see every part of the Grand Canyon and back by 3:00. An amazing day for all of us.

My daughter had a trip to the Grand Canyon on her Bucket List. After much research we found Westwind through our resort. Flew on a Cessna small plane out of Scottsdale. Beautiful flight over Sedona, past Flagstaff and over to the Grand Canyon where we flew around the canyon for 30 to 45 minutes. After landing at the Grand Canyon airport we proceeded to be loaded into a Pink Jeep tour. This tour took us around Scenic Parts on the rim to take photos and have a nice box lunch. We then flew back out over Jerome and back into Scottsdale Airport. It truly was the perfect experience to see the Grand Canyon. I highly recommend taking this experience with Westwind. What a memory.

review_title: Amazing way to experience the Grand Canyon
review_text:
We were staying in Phoenix and wanted to see the Grand Canyon. We didn’t want the long drive! We had a limited amount of time. This tour was the perfect solution.

This is a top-notch company. Our pilot Bruce has been leading these tours for 20+ years. Our 6-seater plane offered a smooth ride. It took about and hour and a half to get to the West Rim. There was a narrated tour through our headsets. Our family was the only one on board and Bruce was our personal guide for the day.

The helicopter ride down into the canyon was spectacular even though it’s a short trip— “a two million dollar elevator” to the bottom. The pontoon ride was quick, too, but it offers you the chance to get a feel for the bottom of the canyon. 

The skywalk was fun and not as scary as I was dreading. No cameras allowed. They want you to use their photographers and buy a package from them.

Some of the best views are from Guano Point where you will eat lunch. Walk out to the abandoned tram rail. Spectacular!

This tour is pricey but it’s the perfect way to see the Grand Canyon quickly without having to drive into the park and fight the crowds. The staff is super friendly and knowledgeable. Highly recommend!

review_title: Amazing day trip GC West Rim from Phoenix!!!
review_text:
We booked this GC day trip from Phoenix as a surprise for our high school and college age kids for Christmas while on vacation in Scottsdale. (Book well in advance as this is one of their busiest times of the year.) Definitely a splurge, but with limited time and never having visited GC as a family, it was so worth it!! Karla, our pilot and guide for the day, was wonderful. Personable, professional and knowledgeable, she was everything you could want for a 7 hour trip to GC. Everything flowed along smoothly and we never felt rushed. Plenty of time to enjoy each aspect of the trip (see other reviews for full descriptions of the day). We departed just in time for a spectacular sunrise and enjoyed the mesmerizing views during our flight to GC. December was a great time to visit, warm enough with layers on and little to no crowds. (Actually, the crowded busses were arriving from Vegas around 12:30, just as we were walking back to the tarmac to hop in our little plane to head back to Phoenix. West Wind 
Air's timing was perfect.) The helicopter rides were fantastic! None of us had ever been in one and the flight to the bottom and then back to the top of the GC did not disappoint. Overall, a superior experience and perfect for any nervous small plane/helicopter travelers because everything was conducted in such a professional manner. Shout out to Lindsey, the WWA's welcome wagon, who called 2 days in advance to confirm, answer any questions and was at the airport with a big smile and warm greeting to help get our day started. This was definitely an awesome experience that we will all remember and would highly recommend.

Our pilot Bill was the best! I would highly recommend this tour for anyone who is short on time or wants to see the Grand Canyon while staying in Sedona, but doesn't want to deal with the drive, a tour bus, or the crowds. We boarded a small plane from the Sedona airport and flew to the West Rim, landed in the Hualapai Indian Reservation and took a helicopter down to the floor of the canyon. We had took a short boat ride on the River and visited the Skywalk. We left at 8am and were back in Sedona by 3pm. There's no other way to see the Grand Canyon in my opinion!

review_title: One of the most amazing days of my life
review_text: I am an outdoors, adventure and travel journalist and I have seen some amazing places and enjoyed the most fantastic trips but this day will be a highlight for a very long time. The trip was very well organised and professional. What we saw in just one day including the small plane ride, helicopter trip, boat trip and Skywalk was absolutely ideal. I would have loved to stay for longer at the Grand Canyon but my schedule did not allow for this. I highly recommend this company and this trip. You can see further details on my blog Fiona Outdoors .co . uk

Our pilot, Jameson, is a skilled and knowledgeable aviator who ensured that we were comfortable throughout our tour. He pointed out many interesting landmarks, and he was very friendly and thoughtful. Also, Gayle, who booked our tour, was very helpful and she quickly followed up whenever we emailed her with questions. The plane was clean and the scenery was amazing! We have been to the Grand Canyon before, but seeing it from above is a “must do.” Also, we will never forget Monument Valley...WOW! Seeing MV by land and air was spectacular and allowed us to complete one more item on our bucket list! Plus, flying to MV saved us hours in the car! We recommend Westwinds!

I surprised my sisters with a West Rim Grand Canyon trip in mid October. This was by far, one of the best guided tours we've taken. Each part of the trip, from the guided plane ride from Phoenix to the Grand Canyon, to the helicopter ride down to the Colorado River, was both breathtaking and informative. No detail was left out. The office staff, as well as our pilots were professional, friendly, and very knowledgeable about the area. While the scenery is amazingly beautiful, I know that we got the most out of our tour given the great guides and pilot who shuttled us. I would highly recommend using this team, it is well worth the fee. I hope to return with my husband. Many thanks Westwind Air! Suzie G.

Fantastic!!!
We decided to NOT go to Antelope Canyon but go on this flight instead. We saw the crowds at Antelope from above and knew we made the right decision.
Pilot Ben flew us over Lake Powell and Rainbow Bridge and loved every minute of it.
What a fantastic experience. So glad we did this.

This was my fourth trip from the Deer Valley Airport in Phoenix to the Grand Canyon with Westwind tours.  We have taken children, grandchildren, parents and friends.  We have experienced a variety of trips to the Grand Canyon with this company.  The service and the staff are exceptional and all of our interactions have been positive.  They are friendly, knowledgeable, professional and fun.  I highly recommend this company for touring the Grand Canyon!

I have 2 young children, and this day trip to the Grand Canyon was the highlight of our week in Scottsdale. The ease of travel, shortened travel time, condensed trip that included all of the Canyon highlights, and yes, we were back in Scottsdale with enough time to get the kids to dinner and even a night swim.

From start to finish this was an awesome experience. Booking was simple with Val, day of with Gayle and Lindsay was great so professional and informative. Mark, our pilot was professional and informative! The tour of the Canyon is a must on an airplane best way to see it in its totality. Thanks for a great trip experience!
Flight for my son, Grandson and myself. Great service. Good commentary. A great way to start a vacation in Arizona.

review_title: Air and land tour of Grand Canyon - fantastic
review_text: We had always wanted to visit the Grand Canyon and decided to book our tour via Viator with Westwind Air Services.  We were so glad we did - they were fantastic and the tour was spectacular.  Our pilot, Bob, was amazing and well experienced and flew us around some choppy weather conditions on the return flight. They were so efficient - I had requested transportation from our hotel in Downtown Phoenix to the airport and this was confirmed within a day of asking.  Val Jones was lovely and made us feel so welcome - she had even phoned our hotel the day before to confirm we were still going.  We were lucky enough to have a private tour for the four of us and when we landed, Brandon escorted us on our ground tour, he was extremely knowledgeable and happy to make the tour as long or short as we wanted.  Really glad we did this trip by air and land, as it was fantastic to view the canyon from the air and ground (best way to do it!).  We also had lunch included - which was so much more than just a sandwich, which is what we had expected.  We can't recommend Westwind enough and would suggest them to anyone who is thinking of visiting the Canyon.  Thank you so much for such an amazing day!!

If you're going to Phoenix AZ and have 1 day to spare I strongly recommend the all inclusive trip to the Grand Canyon.  Our Pilot, Colby G. was funny, knowledgeable and entertaining.  We took a private 9 passenger plane from Phoenix to the West Rim of the Grand Canyon, took a helicopter ride (5 passenger) from top of the Canyon to the base, a short boat ride on the Colorado River, helicopter back to the top, entrance to the Sky Bridge you know that glass walk way that juts out over 50 feet from the Canyon wall.  Lunch was included then a mini trip of an "Indian village".  I'm putting that in quotations here as I was fabricated, not original manufacture, but to give you the idea of how they lived in various tribes.  Our guide, Colby, offered educational info throughout such as some Hollywood filming stories, why this ridge was called eagle point, why that ride was called Guano point and such.  He gave us his expertise in the best photo ops, where to buy souvenirs and what not to waste our money on.   I was traveling with family including a 9 year old.  He loved the helicopter ride, was nervous.   If you get motion sickness please take Dramamine at least 30 min before taking off to fly down or back.  There can be some turbulence due to updrafts over the Canyon and the mountains especially in hot weather.  My sister was sick as a dog.  The rest of my family didn't experience any problems but we're all thrill seekers roller coasters and the like.  One more FYI please bring $ to tip your guide(s) and to purchase souvenirs from the native Americans at the end of the tour.  I ran out of cash. 😜

review_text: We have taken this air plane tour during first week of July 2017. The tour duration was around 45 mins. Our pilot, Mike was very welcoming and great guy!!! Later Mike explained about the history of the area, names of the formations(mountains) etc., very useful if you want to know about the lake Powell and the rocky mountains. Then, after about~25 mins of flight we flew over the rainbow bridge, we could see the awesome view of the naturally formed rainbow bridge. But because of the flight elevation the bridge looked small. Then we took a U turn so that the bridge can be seen by the persons sitting on the pilot side clearly. After that we flew back to the page airport. Overall the tour was very good. Westwind flew us from Phoenix to the Grand Canyon in a single-engine cessna, where we spent 30 minutes flying back and forth across the canyon before setting down at the local airport. From there, a van brought us to the canyon (10 minute ride), where we hiked down into the canyon with our guide. Finally, we had a provided box lunch on the canyon rim before flying back. In all, it was a magical experience. The plane was comfortable (noise-cancelling headphones provided), and offered a great view for everyone. Our guide was super friendly and extremely well qualified (how often do you get a geology grad student to give you a tour of the canyon).

Other tips: You can't hike from the top to the bottom of the canyon- I recall you get about 2 hours of hiking, and a full down/up hike would take over a day for an experienced hiker. Just hike until you're either tired or the guide suggests it's time to head back. The path itself serpentines down along the wall of the canyon, and has incredible views at every point. It has some steep drop-offs at the edges, but general it's around 10 feet wide and very safe. It might not be the best option for people afraid of heights, although my wife falls into that category, and while she was nervous she still made it down. We saw lots of people with kids, hikers with toddlers strapped into backpacks, and even some joggers! You should be in reasonably good physical shape though, and remember to save some stamina for the hike back up.

review_text: For our tour of the Grand Canyon, every aspect of the 8 hour excursion was amazing. The pilot was personable and genuine. The service exceeded our high expectations.

If you're looking for a great way to experience the Grand Canyon but you only have a day...and you're not really within driving distance...and you don't mind paying for what you get, then this is for you. We were staying at the Boulders Spa and our adventure started with shuttle to a local airport followed by an awesome 75 minute flight in a 9 passenger, single turbo prop plane to the West Rim. Next up, a helicopter flight dropping off the rim down to the Colorado river where we boarded a pontoon boat for a powered ride upstream followed by a drift back to the dock. Helicopter back up, followed by lunch in a wild-west style town. Lunch was good and the town's a little silly but fine for an hour. A bus then took us to Skywalk which is at once, terrifying, awesome and anticlimactic. Be prepared to pay for pictures as they do not allow personal cameras out on the glass bridge. As a stand alone feature, it is okay, but as a part of the day it's perfect. Another bus ride to Guano Rock, which is breathtaking and another fabulous opportunity for pictures (you'll be doing this all day anyway). Back to the plane and back to Phoenix. If you get the chance to sit co-pilot, absolutely do. Our pilot and tour guide for the day, I'm embarrassed to say I'm not certain his name was Jim, was a fountain of knowledge about the area and just a genuinely nice guy. Just ask for the pilot who lived in Alaska and used to fly reconnaissance for the police and fire department in the greater Phoenix area. I would go out of my way to request him again. Total time was around 10 hours. As I mentioned up front, the trip's not cheap but worth every penny. All of the staff at Westwind were personable, professional and helpful.

I highly recommend Westwind Air for a great time and great service ! They accommodated us last minute and were wonderful to deal with !

review_title: A grand tour of the Grand Canyon
review_text: We enjoy a flight along the southern side of the canyon. We had land and foot traveled this area 50 years ago as a courting couple with friends . Same great experiences were relived and enjoyed. We appreciate the effort to not overly develop the west area , less is more in this area.

While in Phoenix for the Final 4, we had a day to fill.  This entire trip was a bucket list trip and our Grand Canyon tour could not have been more perfect. Everyone was friendly, professional and we got to see it all. I highly recommend Westwind.
Everyone was great to work with as we planned it. Such a magical day!  Worth every penny! Hard to say what my favorite part was between plane, helicopter or boat on the Colorado.

We took the Grand Canyon Skywalk Adventure Tour-West Rim and cannot say enough good things about Westwind Air and their staff.  The tour is exactly as described.  We took off from Deer Valley Airport and flew to Sedona where 2 passengers were picked up.  We then flew to the Canyon West airport where we boarded a helicopter and toured the Canyon below the rim.  We landed on a little ways above the Colorado River and hiked down the the river's edge where we boarded a pontoon boat.  Once we finished the river tour, we helicoptered back up to the top, boarded a bus, and went to the Skywalk.  The entire day was wonderful.  Our pilot was with us the whole day (minus the helicopter & pontoon boat).  He was very knowledgeable about the Canyon and shared many interesting facts and stories.  The guide on the Pontoon Boat was also extremely knowledgeable about the Canyon, the Colorado River, the various trails and places to visit at the Canyon, and Hualapai tribal culture.  The views from the plane were stunning.  And to be able to fly under the rim, so close to the Canyon walls was amazing.  This was an experience of a lifetime.

review_title: Page AZ departure for lake Powell and Grand Canyon
review_text:
We booked by phone and boarded at Page airport while visiting lake Powell. We did not want to drive all the way to the Grand Canyon so we flew a scenic tour. Well worth it! At first the price thru me off, seemed steep at $270 a person for a 1.5 hour tour but it was 2 hours and included the canyon and Lake Powell flyover. 

The views of the canyon were amazing and the time saved from driving was worth every penny. The first 20 minutes of flight are getting to the canyon, but it was worth the wait. The Grand Canyon tour does not claim to include lake Powell but we spent as much time over the lake as we did over the GC and it was as impressive maybe better. 

Highly recommend this company and this tour. There is a longer one that also includes monument valley that may be worth consideration. They do not fly every hour every day so look at weather and book according. We were in the executive plane, nice captains chairs that hold 9 passengers and only good seats. The best seats are the row righ in front of the back bench. Most legroom and best window placement and size. Next best is right behind the pilot. Worst seats are still good, but the small windows offset form the seats make it hard to do uninterrupted video. Make sure to clean the window before you shoot or you get ugly smudge on the video. Also, take time to watch the view live, put the camera down once in a while.

review_title: Our West Rim visit was an incredible experience
review_text:
My friends and I -(4) were picked up at the Sedona airport by Colby, our pilot.
He stayed with us throughout the whole experience and we couldn´t have hoped for a more pleasant, good humoured and polite pilot/guide.
The views from the plane were fantastic and the helicopter ride, although brief was amazing. Their organization works like clockwork. Great lunch at a fantastic view point.
Turbulence was an issue on returning to Sedona but Colby did his best to try and make it less rough. Great views, great lunch, great service!! 
Will recommend to all our Mexican friends!!

We booked the Grand Canyon and Monument valley ground tour and were not disappointed. Weather was perfect and James was excellent pilot. We had at least 2:30 over Gran Canyon and 90 min at monument valley. We went from South Rim airport as far as lake Powell and Rainbow bridge (great fly-by by James).
Not cheap but was worth it as trip of a lifetime with family.
The views were amazing.

review_title: Westwind Air Tour of the Grand Canyon
review_text: Absolutely great day!! Flight from Phoenix to the Grand Canyon was amazing. We had a bonus stop in Sedona to pick up 2 more passengers. The view of the Red Rocks was stunning. Our pilot, Karla, was superb. Gave us history and notable information throughout the trip. This was definitely a trip to always remember. Highly recommend this service.

Westwind Air accommodated our last minute request for a tour making an unscheduled trip to pick us up in Sedona. We flew to the West Rim, helicoptered down to a Pontoon boat, took a brief excursion on the water and back up to the airport. From the airport we traveled to the Skywalk and on to another lookout point, eating lunch at the rim. What a way to see what is truly a wonder of the world; the GC is simply spectacular - neither words nor pictures  convey the grandeur of this wonder. Our pilot and tour guide, Karla, was wonderful. A thoroughly excellent pilot who provided enormous insight making our tour a great memory.

From my first phone call with Lindsey to our landing with our pilot Jim, customer service was spot on.  I had only a day in Phoenix and wanted to see the Grand Canyon but today exceeded my expectations.  I did not just seethe Grand Canyon-I DID the Grand Canyon.  The Deer Valley airport was located about 20 minutes outside Phoenix. Then the adventure began! We flew OVER the Grand Canyon in a Cessna, then INTO the canyon by helicopter and THRU it by boat  and learned a lot about the canyon and its people along the way.  After lunch (provided) we them ventured onto the Sky Walk!  What an exhilarating way to end the day before flying back.  We began at 7:00 am and we done by 3:30.  What an experience with a great company with great people.  Thank you Westwind for the adventure of a lifetime.

My husband and I booked a last minute plane and jeep tour of South Rim Grand Canyon on March 29th. The trip began with a short plane ride from Phoenix to Sedona to pick up a few passengers and then on to the Grand Canyon Airport at the South Rim. About 10 minutes before we landed at Grand Canyon (50 minutes into the flight) I got motion sickness. I felt pretty sick when we landed and it was clear that I would not be able to take the jeep tour to the viewpoints. I was so disappointed. I have set foot on the West entrance of the Canyon before but this was my husbands first time. He stayed at the airport with me. I sat in the airport hoping to get better for the flight home and I did start feeling better. The Captain, Bruce Grubbs, came to me and asked if I felt well enough to take a short ride to Yavapai viewpoint which I did. He drove my husband and I into the park. Captain Grubbs happens to be a professional photographer and writer of many travel guides including the Grand Canyon. He was the best!! He SAVED our vacation and we will NEVER forget him. It was amazing to see it by air but it's a whole different experience on the ground. We are still trying to process the beauty and magnitude of this natural wonder. We would not have had this experience without him. Thank you Captain Grubbs.

The service we received from the moment we entered Westwind's office until we walked out the door to go back home was exceptional. Everything turned out perfect.

Really a wonderful way to take a trip to Grand Canyon if you are in the Phoenix area and don't have a lot of time.  Lindsay in the office answered all of our goofy pre trip questions.   We were picked up from the hotel early in the morning in Scottsdale.
We took a 90 minute flight up to the West rim of the canyon. We helicoptered down into then canyon to do a short jaunt on the Colorado river.  Super aerial photo oops and in the canyon.  Then thenbus takes you to the Skywalk and a some scenic overlooks.  The timing of the trip is impeccable because we bypassed all the crowds that were flooding in after us.  The pilot Ryan was with us the entire day and was great with our kids.

Unforgettable views and we were back poolside before dinner.  With a family less comfortable with full blown hiking and all day treks this was the way to go.   

Temps:  cooler up at top of canyon rim and warm in the canyon in late March.  Totally counter to what one would guess.  Wear layers.

review_title: Grand Canyon tour by small plane, helicopter, boat on Colorado River
review_text: Great trip by small plane, helicopter ride to bottom of canyon, then boat ride. Back up to the Glass walk, it still is tough to do. Grand kids were laughing the whole time. These folks know how to make it fun. It is our second time, this time with grandkids.

Great flight, helicopter ride and boat ride to west rim. Karla our pilot and host was terrific. Also did the Sky Walk and had a yummy big lunch overlooking the canyon. SkyWalk isn't really worth the cost of admission but it was part of our tour, so that was fine. March was a perfect time to go. Amazing weather and not crazy busy.

review_title: Amazing Tour and Service with Once in a Lifetime Views
review_text: Our tour was from Phoenix Deer Valley airport from about 8am to 2. Accommodations booked with Lindsey.  We arrived at west wind air service in the Cutter building and everyone was very happy to see us, greeted with hugs, extremely pleasant, friendly, and attentive.  We flew with Karla, a great and friendly pilot, an hour to the Grand Canyon then a half hour fly over of the north and south rim, then landed near the south rim and did a 3 hour ground tour with Edwardo to a couple look out points and had lunch included.
