An hour flight back. Spacious plane. The views from the plane were spectacular and it was certainly something we'd recommend for a once in a lifetime experience. I'm glad we saw it the way we did. We were very happy to get on the ground and look out as well, though nothing quite compared to the air! The entire plane ride was picturesque too going from the desert to rocky to snow capped mountains and other landscapes. Great photos the entire way. We were pretty whooped by the end - so worth it. We received a photo of our family group by the plane at the end of our trip. Great time and great service.

We had a great time! Gail welcomed us warmly and Cliff was super friendly on the trip. We had only one day and managed to see everything we wanted in the Grand Canyon. Eduardo had some great jokes. Highly recommend this day trip.

My daughter and I had an amazing trip to the South rim of the Grand Canyon thanks to all the great people at Westwind.  They made sure everything was perfect, even though the weather was not cooperating 100%.   What a memorable experience that we will treasure forever.  It was worth every penny and more!  Sights from the plane ride were spectacular and the tour through the Grand cayon was beyond words!

Thank you Westwind!

We had the privilege of doing the Grand Canyon West Rim Adventure Tours.  We will never forget this AMAZING experience!!!  From the welcoming staff to  the incredible views, this is worth every single penny.  I am so glad that I decided to invest in this experience!  Our pilot/tour  guide, Colby, absolutely made the trip the best that it could be.  He was friendly, funny, knowledgeable - what more could you ask for???  We loved this guy!!!  If you are debating about whether or not to book, JUST DO IT!  You will be so glad you did!!!

We loved every minute of our tour.  Efficient and well run - scenery speaks for itself.  Brett our pilot was great and very friendly.  It was an extremely busy period so our time to depart ended up getting switched 3 times.  Also, Brett was supposed to be with us the whole time but he had to fly back to PHX to drop off passengers.   We had Dave as our tour guide.  Dave was super nice, but by his own admission, did not know a whole lot about the canyon(he is the Sales Manager pinch hitting for the regular tour guide).  Gayle in the office was great on
 follow up and follow through addressing a small problem we had with the helicopter.

All in all - the best activity in Sedona.  If you can afford it (and even if you can't), take the tour.   The memories you are left with are indelible.

Fabulous day trip to the Grand Canyon
So recommend this charter flight service out of Phoenix. We had the best day. Including the pink jeep tour at the canyon.

Worth every single penny. We flew to the Grand Canyon, and I'll never forget this experience as long as I live. I feel like Westwind Air Service is my family...that's how amazing everybody is. See you guys soon!

Excellent service right from the check in. 

Special thanks to Cliff, our pilot and to Gayle in marketing for their fantastic support. 

The views from the plane were simply amazing and the trip was unforgettable. 

This is a very well run and organized firm.  
I would give more stars if they were available. This company gets it! 

Thanks again for a very memorable trip.  

Gene

review_title: Great company, and a great trip to the Grand Canyon
review_text: From the beginning to the end this is a great trip. The check in went very smoothly with friendly people, and in just a few minutes we were up in the air flying to the Grand Canyon. I would recommend this trip and company to anyone. Our pilot Chris was extremely experienced, and also very friendly. We felt very safe the entire time. We left at 7 AM and seemed to have missed all the lines. We saw busses arriving as we were leaving and I would recommend to go early to miss the crowds.

Our adventure started with flying over the whole, beautiful state of Arizona. On the flight be sure to look below at Sedona. The tour guide was very professional and knowledgable about the canyon as well as Arizona itself. At the canyon you get to see all the way down to the bottom, interact with wild animals, and purchase souvenirs from the gift shop. It was a trip to remember. Be sure to order the apple pie from the restaurant you eat. The adventure awaits for you to try it yourself.
I loved each and every minute of our day. I loved working with Lynsey, Anna and Edwardo. I learned so much and it was an amazing day. A great day was had by all!!!
Super hospitable every step of the way. Anna was great!  It was a wonderful experience. Would totally recommend!

This was one of the most amazing excursions we've ever taken. We wanted to see Grand Canyon but the drive was 4-5 hours..We were picked up at our resort, boarded the plane with 2 other couples, stopped at Sedona to pick up another couple and off to the canyon..Entire trip was narrated..and the views were breathtaking. Once we landed, we boarded a helicopter which brought us to the base of the canyon... these views were amazing... then we were led to pontoon boats which brought us on a short ride along the Colorado river.. We felt like we were part of a movie scene...then back on the helicopter to bring us back to West rim..We then boarded a bus which brought us to the glass Skywalk and then onto Eagle Point for lunch!  All of this was so well organized...Westwind air is topnotch..We thank Karla (our pilot and tour guide) and the others at Westwind Air for making this the most amazing trip in our lives.

Unsurpassed professionals guiding you to a "once in a lifetime opportunity" to see both Sedona and The Grand Canyon from the comfort of an airplane.  Fire up the GoPro for this adventure, you will want to share it with family and friends. 

See more than you can possibly see from any ground tour.  The 2+ hour round trip had a fabulous - experienced military veteran flight captain, an audio tour and plenty of tunes to entertain on the return flight.

We were fortunate enough to have a private tour from Sedona to the Grand Canyon and back.  The views are SPECTACULAR...the flight originated and returned to Sedona where we were staying.  We covered the same amount of terrain that would have taken days to achieve on our own - without the crowds and mileage spent on the road.

The flight completes a figure 8 around the Grand Canyon, providing for epic views that you could never see on your own.  Then you circle around Sedona's famed canyons and Red Rocks before a picturesque landing on to the Airport Mesa. Then sadly the tour ends and you still can't believe all that you have seen. The peace, serenity and unsurpassed beauty and wonder will remain with us for a lifetime. 

Not cheap, however, do the math between your time, mileage, food, lodging, navigation issues and crowd interference...not to mention the remote sites...and you truly come out ahead.  Especially, if time is limited - this maximizes your site seeing ability.

1st time to see the Grand Canyon. Friends treated us to this amazing adventure. west wind took great care of us,stayed with us the whole day,got us up to the Canyon,onto our helicopter ride,down to our boat tour with another great guide full of history and then onto the sky deck. Tim,our pilot made sure we got onto every tour,that everything was taken care of,and we had a fabulous time! It is a full day and they really take care of everything,just bring water!

Great to do business with!  Beginning with Gayle who greeted us in the morning to Karla who was an awesome pilot and tour guide!!  The views are amazing.  Highlight of our two week trek across the US!!!!

We took the Adventure Tour West Rim.  It was a truly memorable day and worth every penny!  Our pilot and guide, Bill, was a wonderful guide who took excellent care of us.  The flight to the canyon and over the canyon was amazing!  Then the helicopter ride into the canyon was breath taking!  Most people may not realize that for most of the canyon, flight below the rim is not allowed but the Hualipai Indians do allow it on their land.  The boat ride was a nice touch to let you get a feel for what it would be like to raft on the Colorado.  The helicopter ride back up was just as exciting!  Then, of course, there is the sky walk!  Every bit as exciting / scary as you can imagine.  Mind blowing to walk on glass that high in the air (higher than the world's tallest building in Abu Dahbai)!  Then lunch on Guano Point followed by the flight home.  A super great day!

This trip was loved by my eight year old, myself and my 73 year old father!  A trip for the whole family to love!

Thank you Lindsey for setting this up!
Patty

Great experience. Awe-inspiring to see Arizona and the Grand Canyon from this perspective. My one complaint is that the audio could use updating and wasn't played in sync with what we saw. However, this excursion was incredible overall.
Enjoyed the ride and the sites. Maybe need to update the recording about the area. Enjoyed the pilot more than the recording.

Our family of four took the Skywalk Adventure tour with James as our pilot. We flew from Phoenix to the canyon, then helicopter ride down to catch boat ride on the Colorado River,. The skywalk was closed due to lightning, so we had lunch at Guano point, then came back to skywalk. It was open but the line was now long. James talked to the person on duty and got us moved through to the front. He stayed with us through the whole tour. The day was one we will remembe for a lifetime. Thanks west wind air for the great memories!

review_title: Highlight of our Trip to Phoenix
review_text: Wow - we had high expectations and they were exceeded.  Seeing the canyon by air (cessna and helicopter), water (raft) and foot (lookouts and sky bridge) was incredible.  Everyone back home was incredibly jealous.  Our guide Karla was phenomenal.  If you have only one day to "do" the Grand Canyon, this is THE way to do it right.  Well worth the money.

review_title: Do the Monument Valley tour option!
review_text: If you only have one day in Arizona, this is the way to see it. We flew over Sedona, the Grand Canyon, Horseshoe Bend, Lake Powell, Rainbow Bridge, and Monument Valley. Once you land in Monument Valley you get a three hour jeep tour into the park and get to indulge in some yummy Navajo fry bread tacos! Then you board the airplane again and as you fly back to Phoenix you'll be able to see the meteor crater. Really is a great option to see so much in such a short amount of time.

review_title: What a bad service and unreliable company
review_text: Had the worst experience with Westwind Air service location Page AirPort. I booked a scenic flight tour one month in advance from Europe, as I would be only the afternoon in Page. One the day itself got a call from the Phoenix booking office that due to bad weather the flight at 3 pm was cancelled, and rescheduled to noon. As I was in Page and the weather was totally fine, more planes were up in the air, I decided to take a look myself at the Page AirPort. Turned out they just lied to me and the plane was for maintence out of order. The desk of Westwind at Page AirPort confirmed this. So I got really pissed of, called the Westwind booking office in Phoenix, and just no appologies of Lindsey, just the reaction "I was told the weather was bad". What a bad and unreliable service and a memorable flight for me as a customer was gone......DO NOT BOOK THERE, use the alternatives at Page AirPort.

review_title: Excellent day trip to Grand Canyon
review_text:
If you want to see the Grand Canyon and avoid the drive up from Phoenix (and crowds visiting the park), then the Westwind tour is the only way to go. 
Great flight up, with audio narration as well as tips and commentary from our pilot. Spectacular flight through the canyon and then a quick landing at Grand Canyon airport. We then took the Pink Jeep tour which was equally amazing. Our guide was extremely knowledgable about the Canyon history, geology, native tribes, flora, fauna and animal life. 
Part of our group went hiking, but as soon as everyone was back at the airport, we tok off for the hour flight down to Deer Valley. 
All in all an 8am-4pm day which was perfect and saved us several hours driving as well as potential hotel at the Canyon. 
Highly recommend this service.

Wow what a great way to see the Grand Canyon. We did the Adventure Tour of the West Rim. The staff made the trip. This was my first time to the Grand Canyon and I hope to get back to take the South Rim Tour. Worth every penny.

We did the Grand Canyon tour.  We picked up some additional passengers in Sedona so we had an extra view of that area.  The flight over the Canyon is absolutely beautiful and the Canyon is spectacular.  The linkup with the Jeep tour went smoothly.  Probably the only hitch was a choppy flight back to Phoenix on a windy day.

Took a super trip to the canyon with Eric as our pilot. Full day with spectacular canyon views, helicopter drive to the bottom of the canyon and short boat trip. Best way to maximize activities and experiences on a short vacation. Thank you Meg and Eric.

Looking for an adventure?  Well, look no further.  My wife, daughter and I chartered a flight to the Canyon and we were absolutely blown away by the awesome views!  Our pilot, Tim, provided a smooth and comfortable ride as we passed over Tonto National Forest, Sedona, Flagstaff and the Colorado Plateau on our way to the Grand Canyon.  The views are spectacular.  A must addition to anyone's Bucket List.

Looking for a phenomenal experience surrounding the grandeur of the Grand Canyon and Sedona?  They not only have a great staff that will work with your specific needs but they truly care that your flight experience and tour is one of the very best!  A five star all they way!

Is a bit pricey but worth every penny.  They ran a great tour.  Office was friendly in the beginning and Curtiss was an excellent pilot who was helpful throughout in a fun flight in a Cessna grand Caravan.  The helicopter to the bottom is the bomb.  Unforgettable.!!!

We flew from Phoenix to Sedona and, then, Sedona to the Grand Canyon and back.  Westwind Air was great.  From the people in the office to the pilot, everything was top notch.  At the Grand Canyon we transferred to a Pink Jeep Tour.  The Tour took us to many amazing viewing points.  The whole trip went smoothly and was run professionally.  Even a fearful flyer would enjoy this trip!!!  It is a must do!

review_title: An amazing once in a lifetime experience! Highly recommend!
review_text: Our air tour to Sedona and the Grand Canyon was everything they said it would be and more! Best money I ever spent and I would do it again! Absolutely fantastic from beginning to end. Meg at Westwind Air Service handled our reservations and was professional, kind and answered my many questions. We were met with an enthusiastic staff who treated us better than family, making sure we had an "over the top" experience. Sights from the air and breathtaking and cannot be experienced any other way. I highly recommend the ground tour package as well. It was a memory making fun filled day that did not even feel rushed. The pink jeep tour and guide was awesome and provided many unique detailed facts that kept us wanting more. We left from Phoenix in the morning and returned in the early afternoon having experienced two natural wonders in a unique, fantastic and beautiful way. Trust me when I say, it is a once in a lifetime experience everyone should take!

Words cannot describe our gratitude to our pilot Randy and the amazing staff at Westwind Air.
My husband & I had limited time on our trip to AZ and Westwind made it all happen. First Class experience all the way around. Words cannot describe our emotional state upon cresting the Grand Canyon and looking down into one of the seven natural wonder's of the world! This was one of our "bucket list" items and it was met beyond our expectations. 
Thank you Randy and the incredible group of ladies at Westwind that made this possible. Anyone reading this should go forward without reservation....the experience will become part of a life-long memory.

review_title: FANTASTIC - DO IT IF YOU CAN!
review_text: WOW WOW WOW! this has to be one of the best days ever.  If you can possibly manage to save enough money to do this I would 100% totally recommend the tour and the company.  The pilot and guide were fantastic. There was the 3 of us and we had the plane an subsequent monument valley tour all to ourselves!  We flew from Grand Canyon airport. spectacular flight over the Grand Canyon and monument valley, landed in monument valley for a 90 min tour which was wonderful.  We wanted to visit monument valley but without the 5-6 hour drive from Flagstaff and wow this was DEFINATLEY the way to do it if you can. Its not cheap - but if you compare going up in a helicopter to a fixed wing you get MUCH MUCH better value for money, and in our opinion better views as on previous helicopter trips when you are in the back the view is not as good as this plane.  After the tour of monument valley we flew back towards the Grand Canyon taking in flying over rainbow bridge and horshoe bend. We had a wonderful 4 1/2 hours.  Thanks very much Westwind for answering all my various emails with questions before the trip and thanks to the pilot and navigator/guide for the most amazing experience.  Kerry, Colin and Josh x

Lindsey picked me up from the Boulders.  She was enthusiastic with a wealth of information.  Meg one of the staff at Westwind was enthusiastic and accommodating.  

Brett was my pilot. The reason I say "my" pilot was I was solo ~ for a while.  They asked if I minded if we made a stop in Sedona to pick up a small family of three, which was a nice extra.

The family was from England, Gilford on Thames in Surrey to be exact, and they were a pleasure. The red rock formations were spectacular.

The narration was excellent, and choreographed perfectly for the flight.  Although the Cessna looked small in photos, it was very comfortable for the four of us.  Brett took us over the South rim, then the East and North rims of the spectacular Grand Canyon.  This was definitely the ideal introduction to this natural wonder.

The return flight was smooth because he took us above the turbulence.  I was impressed by the skill and professionalism of everyone I came in contact with at Westwind., and would strongly recommend this rather than an arduous drive from Scottsdale.

My family and I (2 kids, 14 and 12), spent yesterday with Westwinds and took the Grand Canyon Skywalk Adventure tour (Fly to Grand Canyon, Helicopter into canyon, quick boat ride on the Colorado, tour of the Skywalk, and lunch at Guano Point before flying back to Scottsdale).  It was my daughter's 12th birthday, and was AWESOME!  The staff at Westwind was fantastic, and our pilot Ron was great.  If you only have a day and want to get to the West Rim, this is a great way to do it.  Our plane seated 9 folks (plus the pilot), and it was really an adventure of a lifetime!

review_title: BEST way to see the Grand Canyon!
review_text: The BEST way to truly see the Grand Canyon!  Short flight from Phoenix, fly over Sedona and all around canyon.  Lands at small airport near Grand Canyon and hits all the best spots to view the canyon.  A remarkable and unforgettable experience.  Customer service was impeccable!  Flight out was smooth but a little bumpy on the way back due to warmer climate.  Best part was that we were back at our hotel by 3pm rather than making a 3 hr drive up, spending the day there then driving 3 hrs back.  THANK YOU to all the staff at Westwind for making this such an incredible experience!

Pick us up at hotel, fly to Grand Canyon, helicopter ride to the bottom of the canyon, then boat ride down the Colorado River, then back on helicopter ride to top of canyon. Get on a bus to ride to Glass Sky Walk. This is breath taking. Great way to see the Grand Canyon.

If you want to experience the Grand Canyon, but have a limited amount of time, take the Grand Canyon Aerial Tour from Phoenix!!  You get to see all aspects of the Arizona landscape - mountains, dessert, forest, rock formations, and of course the Grand Canyon.  Pictures just don't do it justice.  Thank you Westwind for crossing off a bucket list item!  First rate operation!

One note - if you've never been in a small plane, 3 hours can be a bit of a test.

review_title: The Best Way to See the Grand Canyon
review_text: The staff and pilot were great. This was a great way to see the Grand Canyon. Fly over Sedona and the Canyon and Sedona were impressive. Paired it with a PInk Jeep Tour booked through Westwind--Highly Recommend both of these together, as it is a very effecient and fun way to experience the Grand Canyon in a short period of time. Just went on 3/18 in the morning and was back at the hotel mid afternoon. A really fun and quite scenic experience overall!

review_title: The Only Way to Tour the Grand Canyon
review_text:
We did a day tour through Westwind.  We flew on a small plane from Phoenix.  We flew over Sedona, Flagstaff and then toured the Canyon from above.  This part of the trip took about 1 hour and 45 minutes.  During the trip we had a guided and historical tour of all areas we flew above, very informative.  The pilot also interjected with interesting additions.  Then we landed at the Grand Canyon airport and our pilot directed us to a van where he then drove us to one area of the Grand Canyon to tour and take pictures and shop.  We were there for about an hour and a half.  Then they took us to lunch (this was included in the trip).  After lunch, they took us to another overlook.  We then went back to the airport and flew back to Phoenix.  This flight took about 1 hour.

All in all very cost effective and a fabulous way to see it all in a timely manner.  We left Phoenix at 8:00am and returned at 3:00pm.

Our pilot Randy was amazing.  Very experienced and knowledgable about the area.  Great to get his insight as a local.  Made me feel comfortable considering I was not sure about doing this type of plane ride.  He was also great with the kids and took them for ice cream after lunch, nice touch.

Highly recommend this tour.  Definitely do the tour through Westwind all the way.  Some places offer flight and then a land tour through another outfit, much more efficient and you get more through Westwind.

review_title: Rigtig Amerikansk, på den gode måde
review_text:
Med Westwind som pakkeleverandør fik vi en pakke med, først en flyvetur i et lille fastvinge fly, fra Phoenix til Grand Canyon lufthavn. Dernæst med sikker hånd ført igennem registrerings systemet ud til den ventende helikopter som bragte os ned i bunden af Grand Canyon hvor der så ventede en båd tur op og ned af Colorado river. Tilbage på land igen, op i helikopteren videre rundt imellem bjergene og sluttende oppe ved lufthavnen. Op i en bus og afsted det gik, vi skulle lige nå at komme foran i køen til Skywalk, glasbroen som går ud over klippen, så man kan se de 1200 meter ned. Så blev det frokost, ingen kolonialist oplevelse, men det opfyldte formålet, alle blev mætte.
Tilbage til fastvinge flyet og retur til Phoenix.
Alt i alt et gennemarbejdet koncept, det virker, og på bedste Amerikanske vis dejligt ukompliceret.
Bestemt en tur jeg kan anbefale, og jeg gør den gerne om en anden gang.

Lang getwijfeld of ik de triangle flight zo nemen, het kost aardig wat, maar het was echt een geweldige ervaring. Je vliegt over prachtige landschappen, ziet indrukwekkende rotsformaties en komt ook nog langs de grand canyon. Erg bijzonder om mee te maken.

My husband and I chose this tour to view the Grand Canyon for the aerial view, and to reduce driving time. The flight and aerial view were spectacular! The plane was well-equipped and the pilot was professional, though 15 minutes later for pick up than the 8:30 am time. We had headsets on the plane portion  trip which dictated a  RECORDED  history  of the canyon and points of interest on our way there.  After this, I would have to say I was disappointed in the land portion of the tour. This part was supposed to be approximately three hours on land. We had exactly 55 minutes on land.  The brochure indicated that we would be making several stops at the most  scenic views of the canyon. However, there were only two stops for viewing.  Those parts of the tour were self-guided. It would have been better to have an experienced tour guide pointing out specific areas interest. We had a lunch in a cafeteria instead of the box lunch on the rim as advertised. The lunch took up 45 minutes of the ground time. The rest of the time was spent in a van to the Canyon and then back to the airport. While our tour guide in the van was exceptionally nice, I don't believe he was adequately trained to be a tour guide in regards to the Canyon  history itself.  We felt hurried on the ground tour and was told that they had a sunset plane tour and needed to get us back to pick up those other people. My thoughts are that you should focus on the customers that you have at the present time and not talk about future customers when you're with those people.  Instead of 5.5 hours for the tour as stated in the brochure, the tour instead from wheels up to wheels down was 4 3/4 hours long. These comments are meant to help improve the tour experience for future guests.

The helicopter ride is 4 minutes down to the river and 4 minutes back to the top. The boat rise is 5 minutes up river and 5 minutes back. The staff is great but this was a total disappointment as far as the length of the helicopter ride. This is a very expensive tour with very little value.

review_title: Flight and tour of the Grand Canyon
review_text: What a perfect excursion. The pilot was wonderful, very nice plane and the tour was great.  I would highly recommend this trip!

Westwind is great to deal with and made everything so easy.  After we showed up, we never had to do anything but enjoy ourselves and the excursion was exactly as described... Except better!  A full day of adventure at the Grand Canyon and back in time for dinner.  Note that the west rim isn't the part with the national park, it is about 100 miles to the west on an Indian reservation.  Because it is on tribal land, not all the same safety rules apply, but use common sense and hang on to your family members, and you will be fine.  Highly recommend, you will walk away thinking you should have paid them more, and at least with me that never happens!

We booked our Flight and Hike trip through Arizona Outdoor Adventures. Our guide was Denny. He was fantastic. We have 3 kids (ages 13, 10, and 8). Flight was fantastic and very easy and informative. We hiked Kaibab Trail to Cedar Ridge. The hike was strenuous, but well worth the effort. Kids made it fine. We were not dressed warmly enough. It was COLD. Better layering and we would have been fine. The trip was expensive, but worth every penny. No better way to do the Grand Canyon in a day from Phoenix.

If you are visiting the Grand Canyon and think about a scienic flight these guys are the one's your are looking for. Stop at the Grand Canyon Airport, stay away from the crowded operators where buses drop off tons of tourists and look for the westwind counter.
We did and had a private air tour for just us 2 in a small plane instead of being sqeezed in a Helicopter or a bigger plane with a big group of others. We had no reservation just walked up to the counter and everything was organized within 30 minutes. The price was lower than expected and lower than any other offer we have seen there. The pilot was just great and they had a electronic device which allows to choose the language of the explanations.
Later on our tour we requested another tour from page airport. They had no availability on this day but explained that it would probably better to do this by car and quickly get us in touch with the rental car guy there. They were right it was better by car and saved us a lot of money, so great service again.

I highly recommend Westwind Air Service for a flight from Sedona to the Grand Canyon.  Our family wanted to experience a different vantage point of the Canyon instead of ground.  It was super exciting for kids to travel by air over Sedona, Flagstaff and the Southern Rim of the Canyon.  Our pilot was great. The trip one way is about 1 hr to 1.5 hours and then we took a 3 hr Pink Jeep Tour and flew back to Sedona.  We saved so much of our valuable time flying instead of driving for our first trip to the Canyon.  If we are able to return, I would do a ground trip and have that experience with a camp out at the park for instance.
Hoewel duur, ontzettend gaaf. Prima materiaal, goede ontvangst, aardige piloot die er de hele tijd bij bleef, foto bij terugkomst. Prima! Erg van genoten!

Private, Excellent service, Extremely friendly, Knowledgeable And very efficient The aerial view Is excellent They went all around the canyon covering all the interesting points. The pink jeep tour was also excellent  and gave us a chance to be up close and personal to the edges of the canyon. Bit pricy but worth every penny.

This was the trip of a lifetime.  A fascinating flight from Phoenix via Sedona to The Grand Canyon with a good 30 minutes flying across and around the Canyon.  The views through the whole journey were incredible but the actual flight across from the South Rim to the North Rim was awesome.  Randy, our pilot was great -very informative and did a great job calming the nerves of those of us who were nervous flyers.  We cannot recommend this trip enough.  If you have the cash then don't miss it.

review_title: Randy was a great host/pilot!  I highly recommend the Adventure Tour of the Grand Canyon!
review_text: What a great day experiencing the Grand Canyon Adventure Tour through Westwind Tours.  It was my wife and I's first trip in a small plane.  Our host/pilot, Randy, was very knowledgeable, professional, and helpful.  I was glad he chaperoned us for the day because his suggestions were very worthwhile and made our day much more enjoyable.  The small plane ride was an experience all itself, having never been in one before.  What a joy, and it was fun all by itself.  The views from the plane of the Grand Canyon are breathtaking, and I highly recommend it.  It is a great way to see the majesty of that great wonder, and so much more revealing than any other vantage point.  Randy also took care of all of the details regarding our lunch (very good), bus ride to the Horseshoe Overlook on the west rim, and the helicopter rides to the bottom of the canyon and back up.  Those were great experiences also, as was the short boat ride to experience the canyon from the bottom view.  What a great day!  Even though the flight back was a bit bumpy, I was confident in Randy (23 yrs experience piloting), and it didn't dampen our great day.  I highly recommend the Westwind Adventure tour for anyone who wishes to see the Grand Canyon.  Ray & Penni.

My husband and I visited Scottsdale a few weeks ago on our honeymoon from Scotland and we wanted to take a trip to the Grand Canyon. Westwind offered a few really good packages and in the end we chose the south rim signature plane and jeep tour. To say it was a day we'll never forget is a huge understatement; it was absolutely amazing from start to finish. From being picked up by Julie in the morning with whom we had a great trip to the airport, to the flying with Randy who was so friendly and made sure we missed nothing and then the pink jeep tour into the national park where you gain a whole other perspective as you take in the jaw dropping scenes around you, we loved every second. It was just the perfect day, one we'll never forget on such a special trip, and it was all thanks to Randy and the team. We would absolutely recommend this to anyone wanting to see the Grand Canyon when visiting Scottsdale/Sedona. Thank you Westwind.

This is by far the most spectacular way to experience the Grand Canynon! It's not often that you get inclement weather in this area, however when we did The folks at Westwind couldn't have been friendlier or more willing to help accommodate us. We did the South Rim tour which flew us over beautiful landscape, amazing Sedona views and the crown jewel, approaching the rim of the 7th wonder of the world and flying over and around it seeing this amazing spectacular in a way you never otherwise would. After landing at the Grand Canynon airport we were picked up by Sarah from Pink Jeep Tours where she proceeded to ask us what we most wanted to see and then customed our tour just for us showing us many amazing vista views sharing her depth of knowledge about the area. Thanks Westwind for organizing this memorable day! This is a place where when you leave you exchange a hug instead of a handshake !!

review_title: First Time Flyer in Small Plane - Wow!!!
review_text: My wonderful friend treated me to the trip starting in Phoenix to Sedona then over Grand Canyon- many views then pink jeep trip on land from airport in Grand Canyon takes you to several wonderful vantage points which you get history and great pictures from both pilots and do pilots.  We had few hours of jeep tour, which includes yummy lunch, then back on flights for more wonderful views of the canyon and history and tales of the area.  As history buff, I was amazed and the views are spectacular-more than spectacular. we even stopped at the famous El Tovar Hotel and were treated to Hopi Indian dances featuring a darling 3-4 year old  I'll never be able to repay my friend for her generosity as this was truly a day I'll always remember ✈️

review_title: Grandest View of the South Rim - Grand Canyon-
review_text: Surreal.......Unbelievable.........Majestic!  This is the best way to view the Grand Canyon.  And it should be trusted to Westwind Air Service.  They are an absolutely incredible service. What a economical way for our family to privately experience this adventure! Our pilot, Eric was so professional.  He flew the plane with such ease.    This was a once in a lifetime experience for our family and I am so grateful we went with those folks.

Today was the most amazing day! We traveled to the West Rim of the Grand Canyon from the Deer Valley Airport in Scottsdale. Carla was our pilot/tour guide for the day. She was knowledgeable, caring & a great pilot! She had everything ready for us & we never really had to wait in line. She was also really great with the kids! I would recommend this trip to anyone who loves adventure!

Wow, you just can't describe the aerial views of the majestic grand canyon in words or really one photograph either. Westwind did an absolute marvelous job with our flight from start to finish. Kyle, our pilot, did a great job of safely ensuring our flight was enjoyable and educational. We thoroughly enjoyed our experience and definitely recommend using Westwind if you want a once-in-a-lifetime experience of a canyon overflight. You cannot achieve this magnificent perspective from the ground. Awesome!

review_title: Westwind Left Me Speechless - but in a good way!
review_text: Very rarely am I rendered speechless. But when I was recently surprised with a Westwind adventure to the Grand Canyon, that’s exactly what happened. From the moment we arrived and were greeted by Gayle Lurenz, we felt like VIPs and our excitement began to build. As Gayle described our itinerary for the day, I could hardly believe how much we would experience in just 8 hours. We departed Phoenix on our private 9-passenger plane with our expert guide and pilot, Captain Ron. The views became more and more stunning as we landed on the mesa in Sedona. Then it was off to the West Rim of the Grand Canyon where we rode in our helicopter over the rim and down to the bottom of the Canyon for a boat ride along the Colorado River. As if that weren’t enough, we ended our adventure with lunch and even more stunning views from the Skywalk Bridge. By the end of this very special day, I couldn’t believe the dent I had put in my Bucket List. If you've ever wanted to enjoy a truly unique way to enjoy the magnificence of the Grand Canyon, Westwind is the way to go!

review_title: Most amazing thing I have ever done in my life...
review_text:
I know there are a lot of different options and packages available.  We did the one where it was a plane ride to the top of the grand canyon, a helicopter ride down to the bottom and then a boat ride down the Colorado river.

Everything about this was well put together.  They had someone pick us up at our resort and bring us to their hangar.  They had free water, coffee and snacks available.  We boarded a small Cessna plane and took about an hour and fifteen minute flight to the Grand Canyon.  The view is breathtaking as some of the flight is over the GC.  Our pilot got off the plane with us and guided us the rest of the day.  He took us to the helicopter place and we jumped on a chopper that took us down to the bottom of the canyon. I cannot describe how magnificent the Grand Canyon is and you can't beat viewing it from a helicopter.

Once we were at the base of the Canyon, we boarded a pontoon boat and made about a half mile ride down the Colorado River and then floated back to where we started.  We then took the helicopter back "up top" and hopped on a bus that took us to the SkyWalk.  Our original pilot from the plane was always there to point us to our next stop or tell us to meet back somewhere at a particular time.

The SkyWalk was awesome and a little freaky.  It's an engineering marvel and yeah it's a little scary.  There were a couple of drama queens out there just freaking out.  One little thing to note about the SkyWalk, they don't let you take your phone or camera out there so you have to buy their pictures.  They have camera guys out there that will take your picture, and you can chose what pics you want to buy for a horrendous price (you are not obligated to buy anything).  The problem was they were short staffed on camera guys and the ones that were there had some attitude problems.  I didn't buy any pictures out of spite.  You can get just as good of pictures from the area right next to the SkyWalk.

Next they took us to Guano Cafe to eat lunch.  Our guide said it best that it was more like a metal building that served food than a cafe.  The food was not good, seemed like a freezer meal that was only half way warmed up.  I think they would've been better off telling you to just pack your own lunch or eat at some of the concession stands at the SkyWalk.  However, there were a bunch of tables outside and you got to eat lunch overlooking the Grand Canyon which was pretty cool.

Guano Cafe was located at Guano Point.  There's a lot of room to walk around and see the Canyon from a bunch of different places here.  You can climb to the top of Guano Point and see a great 360 view.  If you didn't already know, Guano is bat feces.  This place is called that because there used to be a mining operation from this location that would mine bat droppings out of caves across the canyon.  Apparently, it is a rich fertilizer and used in a lot of consumer products like makeup, etc.  Anyway, you can see the old abandoned mining equipment and just marvel at the Canyon some more.

We headed back to plane and had a narrated flight back (about 1.5 hours).  Although, I don't believe it to be the fault of the pilot, I would be remiss not to mention that the flight back was really, really turbulent (the flight there was not).  My wife got sick and there were no vomit bags.  Luckily, we had some coffee cups still in there from the morning that she used.  I recommend taking some motion sickness meds before the flight back if you are affected by this type of thing as based on other reviews, this is common for the flight back.

In summary, this was a great trip and I would highly recommend it.  Everything from the Skywalk tickets to meal vouchers were included in the total price ($1,300 for two).  We will be going back and taking my parents at some point because this is really bucket list material.

review_title: Excellent Grand Canyon Day Trip from Phoenix
review_text:
Even though I graduated from Arizona State University and lived in Phoenix for several years, I had never visited the Grand Canyon.  Shocking oversight, I know.  So on my vacation to Phoenix, I decided to correct this by making a day trip with Westwind Air Service.  They are based at Deer Valley Airport in north Phoenix, and their aircraft only seat a few folks, so you won't be part of a huge crowd.  

If you are not a morning person, you may struggle to make departure time: they ask that you be at the airport by 7:30 AM for check-in for your flight.  But trust me, its worth it.  After a briefing about the journey you're about to take, you are escorted to the plane, and departure happens immediately.  An audio program provides you with interesting facts about the history of areas you are flying over, as you proceed over the desert through scenic vistas, rolling valleys and plateaus, and past nearby mountains.  My trip also included a stop at the Sedona airport to pick up a few more passengers, and Sedona has a fascinating air field atop a mesa.

Within ten minutes of landing in Sedona, we were airborne once again, this time heading for the Grand Canyon itself.  The Grand Canyon Signature Tour, which was what I took, will actually take you over the south rim, and you will be treated to some truly spectacular views of one of the seven natural wonders of the world. Turn after turn, the awesome spectacle impresses you with its astonishing scale.  If you can look at it, and not be stunned, that says far more about you than it says about the Grand Canyon or Westwind Air.  There is no better way to take in the Grand Canyon than by air, and Westwind has perfected that experience.

But the tour doesn't there.  Upon landing at the Grand Canyon airfield, you are met by Westwind's partners on this trip, Pink Jeep Tours.  What follows is great half day expedition into the Grand Canyon park, a box lunch, a short hike through park itself with more spectacular vistas, and concludes with an IMAX theater experience about the history of the park itself.  Then its back to the airport for your return journey to Phoenix.

Yes, the tour is not cheap.  But if your staying in Phoenix and want to make a side trip to the Grand Canyon, bear in mind that driving up there will take the better part of four hours.  Westwind can give you a full day of stunning vistas, and you'll back in Phoenix in time for dinner.  So I consider it great value, and can't recommend it highly enough.

review_title: Great flight-see of the Grand Canyon!
review_text: This was an amazing trip -- expensive, but definitely worth it. We met the flight-see in Sedona and joined other passengers from the Phoenix starting point. The Cessna was comfortable, even though a little bumpy. All passengers have a window seat for the incredible views. The pilot expertly made several passes over the Grand Canyon, and all passengers got great photos. When we landed at the Grand Canyon Village airport, we were met by a covered, comfortable Pink Jeep and a very knowledgeable guide and driver Frank. He was a fountain of information on all things related to the canyon. The group stopped at many overlooks and Frank was happy to take photos of all of us at the rim. The boxed lunch was healthy and really good. On the flight back to Sedona, the pilot did a flight-see over many of Sedona's iconic red rock formations. It was a day to remember and an amazing experience!

From the minute we made our reservation through to the flying over Sedona and Grand Canyon, this was an amazing experience.  The Staff was extremely friendly and and professional.  Their bus picked up and dropped off 6 of us from a North Scottsdale hotel.  Going to the Grand Canyon, the ride was smooth and lovely.  The scenery was spectacular and definitely worth doing over just taking a car there. Once we were there we hopped on a pink jeep tour that was coordinated with the Westwind company.  Coming home, the ride was very turbulent but the pilot handled the plane fine.  They took pictures of everyone by the plane and gave it to us upon our return.

This was my first trip to the Grand Canyon and wow what a doozy it was!  We took our tour from the Sedona airport.  This was an experience that my husband has wanted to do for a long time.  Our two boys (10 & 13) were also with us.  Let me just say that I do not like to fly and I definitely do not like to fly in small airplanes!  I was a nervous wreck boarding the plane.  There were already 5 other guests on board who had come from Phoenix.  Our flight to the Grand Canyon and over part of it was extremely bumpy and even though I was not enjoying the ride, I did enjoy the views.  I was thankful for the big headphones that we wore to help drown out the noise and to give us a commentary about what we were seeing.  I can't tell you a word they said because I was just focused on the background music that was helping to relax me!!  I was glad when we arrived at the airport by the Grand Canyon.  The Pink Jeep came and picked us up.  It was extremely cold and windy when we arrived!!  The Pink Jeep had a plastic covering around the back and blankets to keep us warm.  We drove into the park and went to 3 different locations to see portions of the canyon.  They provided us with a boxed lunch and water.  Then it was back to the airport and back into the plane.  Our ride back was slightly shorter (30 min) but just as bumpy.  My boys did admit that they did not really care for the plane ride because of all the turbulence but my husband who has taken flying lessons in the past had the time of his life!!  This was my once in a lifetime tour of the Grand Canyon and I don't regret a moment of it.

Amazing flight to Sedonna and on to the Grand Canyon.  It was bumpy, very bumpy but
the pilot was excellent and the trip well worth it.  We were suppose to take the Helicopter
down to the Colorado River but it was cancelled due to maintenance .  This made me
very unhappy since the Jeep tour through the park is ok but compared to the sky
not very exciting!! Beautiful but the sky is the way to go.  The company picks you up
at your hotel early in the morning to the airfield and everyone at the airfield is extremely
warm and friendly.  Bathroom facilities great!  Would do it again but must do the helicopter!!

review_title: Best day ever! Grand Canyon West Rim Skywalk Adventure Tour
review_text: This trip was booked by us to mark our daughter's 21st birthday and turned out to be a remarkable way to be an unforgettable experience. We were picked up directly from our hotel at a very early hour and taken to Deer Valley where we took a flight to the Canyon. The reason for the early hour became apparent later in the day when we began to see the crowds arrive! We missed them all and had the most fantastic personal service at each part of the tour. Our pilot Brian was wonderful and was there to answer any questions we might have. Although expensive this tour is, in my opinion, absolutely the best way to see the Canyon and this company certainly know what they are doing! Thank you to everyone at Westwind for making a special day even more special!

review_title: Grand Canyon West Rim Skywalk Adventure Tour
review_text:
Had a relatively short trip to Sedona for Spring Break with family and wanted to be able to see the Grand Canyon without doing a great deal of driving.  This tour offered by Westwind Air Service was exactly what we were looking for.  

The tour from Sedona departs from the Sedona airport nestled atop a small butte just south of town.  A Cessna took my family and another family (9 passengers total---5 children 12 and under) on a narrated 75 minute flight to the Grand Canyon West airport.  The views from the air of Sedona, Flagstaff, and the approach to the Grand Canyon were amazing---details you would miss in a larger plane or ground travel.  Once at Grand Canyon West, we checked in for a helicopter ride into the canyon from Sundance Helicopters.  The chopper takes you across the West Rim of the Canyon and down to a small landing area near the Colorado River.  From there, you will board a pontoon boat to ride around on the Colorado for about 15-20 minutes before returning to the helicopter landing area.  The helicopters operate like a shuttle service bringing parties into the canyon and taking groups out, running on a fairly perpetual basis.  Once back at Grand Canyon West airport, we boarded a bus and traveled to the Hualapai Skywalk and then on to Guano Point where we had lunch which was included in our tour package.  

The timing was pretty open-ended and we never felt rushed at all.  Our pilot was very professional and knowledgeable.  We felt safe the entire tour and felt that we really got our $ worth!  Would definitely recommend for those wishing to see the Grand Canyon who do not mind spending a little more money to get there quickly and with views unmatched by any other means.

review_title: Great way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text:
We stayed in Phoenix for a week and spent 2 days in Sedona.  On the 2nd day, we decided to take the Grand Canyon air tour from Sedona.  What an efficient use of time!  The flight from Sedona is about 30 minutes - then you spend roughly 45 minutes flying over the GC - seeing it in ways that you simply cannot see from the rim!  Pink Jeep picked us up at the GC airport and took us on a 3 hour tour of the rim.  Back to the airport then a quick flight back to Sedona.

Weather was very windy -- so our flights were pretty bumpy.  For those of us who dont love to fly.... take some dramamine and GET ON THE PLANE!  Its a once in a lifetime trip and Westwind does a fantastic job of coordinating and delivering 100% as promised.

Really liked our pilot Bill -- he made everyone feel comfortable while keeping us safe in the sky!

Thanks, Westwind -- will highly recommend your tours.

Découvrir le grand canyon par les airs  est un must .
Au grand canyon airport , les petits avions cesna  8 places vous font un tour de 40 minutes au dessus de cette merveille naturelle pour 175 dollars .
C"est un peu cher , mais difficile de passer à coté de cette attraction qui offre des vues spectaculaires , chaque passager dispose d'écouteur audio réglable en français et d"un hublot personnel pour pouvoir filmer ou faire des photos à souhait .
notre pilote Carla était très professionnelle et à l'écoute .
A faire donc , si vous disposez d'un budget supplémentaire

This is an expensive tour, however if the tour followed the itinerary advertised it would be a 5 star tour despite the cost.  Sadly it failed on providing what was advertised.   The tour states 90 min tour into the national park in a 4 x 4 vehicle, giving the impression of a jeep type off road vehicle.  Plus lunch after this and museum and gift shop.  I cannot fault the flight part of the tour but on arriving at Monument valley it turned sour.  We were collected in a normal mini van, the type you see for hotel transfers.  Ours had a cracked windshield and only two functioning seat belts to add to the experience.  I assumed this would transfer us to our 4 x 4.  We were kindly offered lunch first and allocated 30 mins to eat.  No problems there, we were also allowed a short time at the museum all good.  We were then from leaving the lodgings to returning to the aircraft about 40 mins.  So we had about 20 mins in the park, which was the whole purpose of the trip.  We were still in the mini van and had two stops but didn't get to John Ford point.  The absence of s 4x4 and the less than half the Arial time in the park ruined the day for me, especially considering the cost nearly 800 dollars each.  Such a shame as the flight and pilot were wonderful.  Someone needs to send a rocket to Gouldings tours and sort out that element.  Sadly due to this I would nor recommend this trip to others, such a shame as the flight was fantastic.

review_title: Do it - best tour - you won't be disappointed
review_text: Our deluxe Grand Canyon air tour on 3/10/2015 was fabulous. Every personal interaction was extremely professional, courteous and helpful.  The pickup at the hotel, greeting at the airport, conduct during the flight and tour all were great experiences.  The views from the air are indescribable and the pink jeep land tour on the south rim was wonderful, with a passionate tour guide named Frankopedia.  Randy, our pilot, did a great job explaining our route, the sights and the history, and went above and beyond what was required to have a great day. I've been on many tours all over the world, and this one ranks among the best. You won't be disappointed.

review_title: Great way to see the GC in a one day trip from Phoenix
review_text: You have one day in Phoenix to see the Grand Canyon?  This is a great way to do it.  If you enjoy the fun of flying in a small plane, this can't be beat.  Don't worry, it is very professional and safe.  They offer many trips, but the most popular leaves Phoenix at 8am and is back by 245pm.  The flight up is terrific in and of itself, going up the Verde River valley, past Sedona and the highest mountain in Arizona.  The flight over the canyon lasts about a half hour, and it mind blowing.  In fact, it is so great that the ground portion of the trip pales in comparison.  You land at the local strip, then take a Pink Jeep tour around the southern rim.  This part is pretty good, but you have been ruined by the view from the air!  All in all, I can't say enough about this trip.  To do it by car would be a long, long day, and would not include the aerial views.  Highly recommended.

review_title: Grand Canyon Deluxe South Rim Tour was amaaaaazing!!
review_text:
Short review: 
DO IT!!!!  Westwind Air Service ROCKS!

Long review:
Why did we take this tour - We opted to do this tour because we were staying in Phoenix, and didn't want to spend 8 hours alone just driving to/from the Canyon.  So chose to cut our travel time down by 75% and fly!  We also wanted the experience of walking in the Canyon, as well as flying over it and getting in some other sights along the way.

Transport - We were picked up and dropped off at our hotel in downtown Phoenix in a timely manner.  Vehicle was a big and roomy Yukon.

Airport office - Westwind makes sure you're good to go on snacks.  Pretty much anything you could want they have.  And even their bathroom is fully stocked for the ladies.  

Staff - Pleasant, knowledgable, and incredibly friendly!!  

Plane - Roomy, safe, well appointed.  I believe we were in one of their Cessna 207's.  Prior to boarding, each of the couples (there were 3 of us, so a group of 6 total) were able to take our own photos in front of the plane.  The tour company takes a pic, and also took cell phone pics for us too.

Departure Flight - Flight comes with a pre-recorded (but nice!) narrated tour you listen to both to/from the Canyon.  Every now and then the pilot would voiceover and ask how we all were doing.

Tour - Landed in Grand Canyon Airport and were transported by Pink Jeep Tours.  Made three photo stops throughout the Canyon.  Driver was very knowledgeable and friendly as well.  The views were breathtaking and well worth the trip.  We stopped at a hotel/cottage that had another viewpoint of the Canyon and ate our box lunches. Sandwiches, chips, cookies, granola bar, apple, water.  Could have got other nibbles and visited gift shops but opted to eat box lunch and relax.  A surprise, we got a Grand Canyon DVD from Pink Jeep, wasn't expecting that!

Return flight - We took an aerial tour of the Canyon (note, I think this would have happened on the departure, but was a bit cloudy so we did it on the return).  The aerial tour was the money shot in my opinion. Once in a lifetime, truly.  How many ppl do you know that have gone to the Canyon?  Now...how many do you know that have flown over it for  20+min?  

Like I said DO IT!!! :-)

review_title: Amazing way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: My son and I went on the Westwind Air tour of the grand canyon.  It was such a great and efficient way to see the Grand Canyon.  We left from Phoenix around 7:30 a.m. and were back at our hotel by 3:00 p.m.  We saw amazing views of the grand canyon from the air and even took a helicopter down to the bottom of the basin where we went on a boat tour on the Colorado River.  The pilot/guide was very helpful and explained some great background information about how Phoenix came about and information about the Grand Canyon.  My son is only 8 and had no problem with the tour.  Highly recommend for adults or children around 7 and up.

Took this optional excursion on our tour through National Parks with Archers Cosmos (excellent tour).   Paid $269 p.p. for the 90 minute Rainbow Bridge flight.   Comfortable flight with excellent view as everyone is afforded a window seat.  Informative commentary from start to finish. Our pilot was very professional as on landing she seemed to disappear and didn't do the usual 'stand about waiting for a tip', we tried to find her but she was off greeting her next group and we were escorted off the tarmac in the other direction. We loved this trip so much I felt guilty we did not get to thank her properly.  BTW:  you can only take a small bag/camera on board which will sit in your lap, and don't fib when they ask for your weight!  LOL

The flight with Westwind to the Grand Canyon turned out to be e highlight of our trip to Scottsdale. Our pilot Jim had not only tons of experience, but also a very pleasant personality which made the trip even more special. Our two teenagers, who had not been to the Grand Canyon before, loved it, and even for someone who has been a few times before, the flight over the canyon was truly spectacular. We had a few hours at the Canyon, being well taken care of, including lunch of our choice, great narratives, and plenty of time to look around. It was a fantastic day from beginning to end, and we highly recommend it!

Fantastic experience!  Wonderful, professional, friendly staff.  Took Deluxe tour of Grand Canyon which includes 30 minute flight over canyon and ground tour.  Do not miss this opportunity to see the Grand Canyon in its grandeur!!!! My husband and I are still talking about what a fantastic experience we had 2 days ago.

"What an awesome adventure," is the best way to describe the scenic Aerial Tour taken by my husband and I today.  The professionalism, friendliness of the office coupled with our pilot, Rose's navigational skills made our trip to Arizona complete!

Nous avons fait le tour du lac Powel depuis Page.

Horaire respecté, bon accueil et pilote sympa (une jeune femme). Le lac vue d'avion est magnifique ! Cela permet d'apprécier tout le panorama mais aussi de voir Rainbow Bridge, Horseshoe Bend et le barrage vu du ciel en une heure !

Nous referions avec joie !

South Rim "Signature" tour.    
From the moment Ron picked us up for our memorable Grand Canyon day trip we knew we were in the hands of a warm, friendly super efficient team.  And so this came to pass.  Upon arrival at the small terminal we became "first class" passengers all the way starting with a welcome inviting us to refreshments whilst the very quick processes for boarding were taken care of.  This included our meeting all the team members, each with a very special part to play in making us feel very special.

We were shown where we would be flying to by one of the directors (super knowledgeable) and an outline of the day offered with any questions answered. We were introduced to our pilot, in our case a duo Brian and Bill. Was super impressed by their credentials but especially Bill as we spent all day with him and were very confident to sit back and let ourselves be ferried with every confidence. Having been a military pilot and air traffic controller - and a lot of that time in England - how could we not totally relax!?

The tour was everything it advertised and more and though on first take it may seem an expensive day out when you analyse what you get and how it is delivered with highest safety levels, hospitality and warmth I am of the opinion we had exceptional value.   We felt we were being taken out by friends - and the financial transaction just a minor inconvenience at the outset!

I cannot recommend Westwind Air Services highly enough.  Don't even hesitate book it NOW!  Thankyou to a great "family style" team.  And thankyou for the final warm touch - a folder with a photo of our day presented to us - no cost - of our posing by our plane prior to take off some 7 hours earlier.

review_title: Grand Canyon West Rim Adventure - awesome!
review_text: We had an amazing trip today! Brian, our pilot and tour guide, was wonderful - thank you for everything!  It was incredible to see the canyon from the plane, the Sky Walk, the helicopter and the boat!  The photographer on the Sky Walk took great pictures as did our boat driver and of course Brian throughout the trip and the Westwind photo to start the day was great!  Great memories captured of what was likely a once in a lifetime trip. Getting to do all of that and be back in Phoenix at 3pm was great too - especially in the July heat!  We would definitely recommend this tour - expensive but worth it!

review_title: The only way to see the canyon!
review_text: We scheduled our day tour with Westwind up to the canyon. We had been to the canyon before by train and by private car. The air tour is the best way to see it because they fly directly over the canyon, both north and south rims. Everyone at Westwind was professional, extremely friendly...from the office staff to the pilots and tour guides. We had Carla for our guide and she was wonderful. This was a great tour overall with the flight up, the landing at the airport, the 3 hour stay at the canyon, including lunch...and more touring, then back to the airport for our return trip to Phoenix. I would highly recommend this tour! Absolutely the best way to see the canyon! Thank you Jim and Dave for safe flights to and from! Loved, loved, loved your service!

review_title: Grand Canyon West Rim Adventure - Excellent!
review_text: Professional, friendly, and accommodating. We recently had the pleasure of taking Westwind Air Service’s Grand Canyon West Rim Adventure Tour. We were extremely impressed with the entire operation and all involved were exceedingly helpful from the moment we inquired about taking this tour, until we returned from seeing the West Rim of the Grand Canyon. The tour itself was a great experience with excellent pilots and a tour that was delivered as promised.  The views on the flight to and from the Grand Canyon were spectacular and were accompanied by great audio in both directions that discussed the history and geography of the area. The Skywalk was a unique experience and the helicopter ride to the Colorado was amazing. A nice boat ride on the Colorado River completed the trip. Based upon our experience, I would highly recommend using Westwind Air Service on any of their offered tours.

This was a great excursion with the teenagers. The flight to Grand Canyon from north Phoenix was super fun. The helicopter ride to the bottom of the canyon was pretty short but still fun for a family who had not ever been on one. Overall the trip was popular in our household an we were back in phoenix by 3pm in the pool. Great service and much appreciated.

The excellent service began when we were picked up at our hotel. Originally, our flight was cancelled due to high winds, so we rescheduled for a morning flight on another day. (FYI: Apparently, the morning is less windy.) Our flight was smooth, and the scenery was amazing. Our pilots were Rose and Bill. We took the three-hour flight over the valley, Sedona, and of course, the Grand Canyon. Everyone loved it, incl. the kids. I highly recommend Westwind!
Loved every minute of it.  Flight and narration was great.  This is the way to see the Grand Canyon.   We were picked up and dropped off at our resort in Phoenix.  The people were all very nice.

review_title: West Rim Canyon - fun in a day
review_text: We opted for this tour as a last minute replacement for a white water trip that was cancelled. We chose the West Rim because it would be warmer than the South Rim in March. This was the best way to see the some of the Grand Canyon in one day from Phoenix! The Cessna took us up to the rim area in just over an hour and the approach to the Grand Canyon is truly spectacular. After landing we did the helicopter ride to the floor of the canyon. This was by far what we enjoyed the most. The boat ride is quite short but dipping toes in the Colorado and looking up the canyon walls makes this enjoyable. The Skywalk is the most commercial part of the West Rim and we felt photographed as if part of a wedding group but you could easily say no thanks after a few photos or opt out all together (no personal cameras allowed). The photo price is steep ($60 per photo or $80 for USB), however; I will treasure the excellent photo I purchased of my son and I. Guano Point is the last stop for a lunch that we thought was decent and the scenery is beautiful. To do the Grand Canyon justice you need more than a day but if you only have the day from Phoenix - this is the way to go. The staff of Westwind was first rate. We loved traveling in a small group. Lastly if you can go off season (before the end of April) you find great weather at the West Rim and no crowds!

flew from deer valley airport up past sedona and out over the arizona plateau and on the grand canyon.  the views from the plane were first class . the red rock canyons were unbelievable. w3hat can you say about the grand canyon. until you stand at the railing and look in you havent experienced the canyon. thisd trip is highly recommended.

review_title: Monument Valley trip from Page, AZ
review_text: Our family of four had an amazing trip from Page, AZ to Monument Valley and then a flight over the North Rim of the Grand Canyon.  The views were spectacular!!  Brad, our pilot, was wonderful and put us at ease even during a windy landing at Page.  Thank you for taking such good care of us!

review_title: The Grand Canyon, "Up, Up, in the Air!
review_text:
Deciding NOT to drive 4 hours from Phoenix, to the Grand Canyon, was a wonderful move.  Getting the helpful and professionals at Westwind  to fly us was a wonderful experience.  

Leaving at 8 AM and returning at 2:30 PM, save us a lot of time, trouble and money.  We flew out of Deer Valley Airport, North of Phoenix, parked for free, and were treated, "Royally"!

We flew over lovely Sedona, Flagstaff, and then went on a wonderful experience over the Grand Canyon before landing.  From the airport, their comfortable van took us to interesting and spectacular sights of the GC.  Our guide/pilot, Karla, and the other pilots Ben and Bill, were most friendly and professional.  They have over 30, 000 hours of flying time and know how to let you relax, without being "Behind the wheel"!

Will be back soon to have them take us to other historic places in Arizona, but all I can say is "Thank-you" to wonderful people at Westwind!

review_title: A "must do" in the Phoenix/Scottsdale area
review_text:
We took the south rim tour on December 29th,2013. Westwind Air is a first class operation all of the way. The hangar and lounge area were very comfortable and complimentary coffee and snacks were offered. the check in process was fast and efficient, and then we met our pilot Chris. Chris is a great guy and wonderful pilot.  he was very happy having our kids sit in the co-pilot seat and explaining how airplanes fly. He was also a great tour guide in the air and on the ground and alsways so willing to share his knowledge and great stories.
The tour left Deer valley airport around 8:00am, we flew north over Sedona and then spent 30 minutes flying over the Grand canyon. Hard to explain the feeling you get when you first see the Grand canyon from the air for the first time, but lets just say it is breathtaking. We  landed at Grand canyon airport and quickly boarded a comfortable shuttle bus for a quick ride to Grand Canyon national park.
 We spent a few hours at three different locations exploring the canyon and facilities. After a short ride back to the airport  we boarde the plane again, and within an hour landed back in Scottsdale.
Aeesome trip, great pilot, excellent company.

Our group of 5 booked the Grand Canyon Deluxe tour.  The Deer Valley airport on the north side of Phoenix was easy to find.  On arrival, we were greeted by a professional staff that was very safety concious.  We flew on a single engine Cessna that sat 9 passengers plus the pilot.  While I am not a fan of small planes, I felt very safe. The trip to the east side of the Grand Canyon took about an hour.  We flew over the eastern portion of the canyon for 20-30 minutes, and our pilot/guide, Bill, provided an outstanding narration.  We then landed at the airport by the south rim and took a van to the south rim.  Again, Bill provided us with a lot of information at the various stops. For those who have never seen the Grand Canyon, this is an experence not to be missed.

What an amazing day!  My dad, husband and I booked the South Rim Deluxe package. We were lucky in that we were the only ones on the trip, so it was just us and Bill, our pilot. Bill was great - super friendly and very knowledgeable. We had a cool day - just below the freezing mark at the rim!!  But, as Canadians, still warmer than home. The day was bright and clear and we could see for miles!  
Walking around the rim and the State Park, there were few tourists - pretty much had the place to ourselves. Even saw a 12-point buck and his doe on the path near the museum. 
Flying over the Canyon, seeing Sedona and Tonto Forest was just breathtaking   This is something you should really do

Can't say enough about the staff at Westwind. From booking, to arriving to the end of the day, we all had a fantastic time!!

review_title: Monument Valley and Grand Canyon flight
review_text:
GRAND CANYON & MONUMENT VALLEY FLIGHT
With Westwind

This has to be one of the world’s best scenic flights.
Although it is not cheap, it is well worth every dollar.
After flying over the Grand Canyon the flight proceeds to Monument Valley and lands for passengers to do a tour of the fantastic iconic rock formations.  By the time we reboarded our aircraft we even then thought it had been very worthwhile, but more was to come: we flew over Lake Powell.  What a magnificent sight.  I just can’t stop raving about the whole tour.  It was wonderful.

Margaret,
Western Australia

I searched the internet for a company that did a South Rim tour of the Grand Canyon.  

I was looking for a tour that:
•	did the fly over as well as on a portion on the ground
•	had newer aircraft
•	had lots of window seats
•	had consistently good tour reviews
Westwind had all of this.  We arrived at the Deer Valley airport location ½ hour prior to the tour start time as directed.  As we didn’t rent a car it was a $70 cab ride from Old Town Scottsdale where we stayed.  We found out later that they do in fact pick you up, but this option wasn’t mentioned on booking.  

There were 8 of us in the tour group and everyone had a window seat  and earphones that played a pre-recorded commentary on what we were flying over.  I found it interesting, as was the different landscapes we flew over on the way to the Grand Canyon (dry desert, pine forest, gentle hills, craggy monolithic rocks).   And then we saw the Grand Canyon!  WOW!!! What an amazing thing to experience....going from flat landscape to suddenly dropping off into cliffs of layered colour.   I believe we flew over different portions of it for about 1/2hr before landing at a small airfield.  Our pilot then turned into van driver and took us to 3 different locations where we could walk around outside by the edge (I stuck to the railing.....I did see some that were on the edge!!).  The first spot was very cold and windy and had an information center with shop, we then carried on to the 2nd stop that housed the oldest resort NAME???  on the South Rim.  There was a shop inside of it as well as one outside in another building (this one was full of art, books, trinkets etc).  Our final stop was for lunch which was a good variety of cafeteria style food.  Our pilot/guide was friendly and I think everyone felt comfortable and safe 
Additional:
•	onsite office is bright, clean, has complimentary newspapers, snacks & beverages offered, I took extra time in the ladies washroom looking at all the stuff they had: mouthwash, hair care products, lotions & potions (a little more “fun” than the usual public restroom haha), large outdoor fountain
•	EVERYONE that worked there was amazingly nice and I feel horrid I can't remember a single name!! 
•	After the tour we asked the office if there was a shuttle we could catch back to Old Town Scottsdale (or at least closer in so we didn’t have to pay a large cab fee again).  We were put onto the company shuttle and the driver apologized for not picking us up that morning as she wasn’t aware of us.  She gave us front door service and was a very friendly and informative lady (sorry, I can’t remember your name).
Maybe this service should be put out there a bit more visibly...unless we slipped thru the cracks the one time. 

Do I recommend this company and this particular tour?  Yes.  Did I enjoy myself? Yes!  A flight over the Grand Canyon was on my Bucket List so it was important to find the right tour company—and I did.  

Tip: wear layers as it was very windy and cold at the first viewpoint we stopped at.  Not so bad at any of the others.

Everything about the trip was fabulous! The service from the hotel to the airport was great.  The van was new and very clean and comfortable.  The driver was very polite and friendly.  At the airport,  our pilot Brian was great. The plane ride was smooth, and enjoyable, and Brian was an excellent pilot.  The total  experience of seeing the Grand Canyon was phenomenal! West Wind Tours is the way to go! It is worth every penny!

Tour of Grand Canyon
Truly a wonderful experience - this was the best way to go!
Likes-the staff prepare you well for the tour - our tour guide Jim was very pleasant and accommodating 10 out of 10 for this tour!

review_title: Best way to see the canyon!
review_text:
Westwind is the only air service to offer 'every seat is a window seat' planes. Both my husband and myself love to take pictures so this was the reason we booked with them. 

We flew this past Monday morning with Jonathan, our pilot, for a 45 minute tour of the Grand Canyon. The morning sun was brilliant, wind calm and we were ready! From the moment we reached the rim, we knew that this was a wonderful way to see the majesty and immensity of the canyon. The flight was especially smooth which was the icing on the cake for me. 

This trip will be remembered for a lifetime! Thank you Westwind!

Due to all the closures of the National Parks we had to do some last minute re-arranging and planning. Westwind was very helpful and assisted us in getting our trip back on track. We did the adventure tour and it was worth every penny spent. We really enjoyed the helicopter ride into the Canyon. It was a great way to see all the different perspectives of this magnificent natural wonder in one short visit. The company is very professional and from the moment you enter through the doors you are in great hands.

A fantastic way to see the Canyon.  This was a first time for me in a small plane and helicopter but thoroughly enjoyed the experience.  I would recommend this tour to anyone !  The crew was wonderful and also met some fantastic people in our group.

This trip was amazing. The scenic flight to the Grand Canyon was spectacular. The audio tour during the flight was a thoughtful mix of information and beautiful music that really let you relax and enjoy the scenery. The deluxe tour included all the main ground stops and a generous lunch of your own choosing was provided so it was easy to feed the kids aged 9,11 and 13.

parliamoci chiari : se avete paura di volare ( come me ) questa NON è la migliore delle vostre trovate .... però quello che vedrete è AFFASCINANTE , coinvolgente , mozzafiato e unico ... noi eravamo sei quindi ci han messo su un cesna da 8 posti assieme a due francesi ... la prima parte è sul bosco e si balla parecchio ( quando s'è volato noi NON c'era vento ) e la paura a me è montata proprio li ... quando è arrivato il canyon mi è letteralmente mancato il fiato e il panico ha lasciato posto allo stupore ... il giro dura 45 minuti ... una vita per me e pochi per i miei amici ... senza dubbio posso affermare che chi a differenza mia non ha paura dell'aereo era ESTASIATO ... io sinceramente non lo rifarei però quello che ho visto non lo potrò mai scordare . BELLISSIMO

What a day and a brilliant tour this experience was a first for us in so many ways first time in a small plane, first time in a helicopter and first time to the canyon. Fantastic day well organised and breathtaking experience would definitely go on a similar trip with this group again

Very impressed by this company, organizing air tours to the Grand Canyon from several places, including Phoenix. The service is highly personalised, I was picked-up at my hotel nearby the local airport, offered food and drinks at their office and explained the program of the day. A 70-minutes flight brought me to the Grand Canyon, which allowed me to be there very early, and to enjoy the visits before most buses arrived from Las Vegas. 
The company has many planes, so the tour can take place even if there are only 3 guests or as much as 10.
The activities at Grand Canyon are not organized directly by Westwind Air Service (and usually are a rather mass tourist experience), but the pilot will usually join you during most activities, which is very pleasant as he will act as a (very) knowledgeable guy.

review_title: A wonderful addition to a great trip
review_text:
I recently planned a very last-minute trip to the Grand Canyon and decided to include a Rim to Rim view flight. I called Westwind Air Service in the Phoenix area and scheduled a flight with Terry, who was most helpful and informative. 

Due to a severe wind advisory at the Canyon for my scheduled flight day I decided to reschedule and once again spoke with Terry, who promptly moved my flight back one day.

On Wednesday 4/17 I drove to Grand Canyon Airport in Tusayan (a short drive from my hotel) and met with Jason, a very courteous employee who works at the counter checking passengers in for their flights.

Our pilot Brad (who has a great sense of humor) took us out to the Cessna 207 aircraft and as there were only three passengers, two people sat in the back and I sat up front. There was still some wind and we encountered a little bumpiness on the way to the canyon, but this was the bumpiest part of the flight.

Due to the interesting weather day there were cloud formations low over the canyon which provided additional striking views, and I found myself watching the sky as much as the canyon itself. I enjoyed the recording that played over headsets along the way, and also enjoyed talking with the pilot prior to and briefly following the flight.
