Note: In the front seat you will not have an unobstructed view out of the side window as there is a wing strut that comes down and attaches to the body of the plane. However, you can see everything beneath you and if you bring your camera you can zoom past this for photos.

My goal was to see the grand canyon at different times of day and night and from different vantage points; flying over the canyon certainly helped fulfill that goal and added to the overall enjoyment of my trip.

I definitely recommend Westwind Air Service for anyone looking to take a view flight over the Grand Canyon.

review_title: The best way to see the Grand Canyon!
review_text: Everything about this service was great! A wonderful pilot named Cheryl picked me up at my hotel at 7 AM. We went to the Scottsdale Airport for a light breakfast snack, got into a 10 seater Cessna at 8, flew over Sedona and the Grand Canyon, learned a lot of recorded history on our earphones, landed, then we were driven to Bright Angels Trailhead where we could walk for an hour or so. After all this there was lunch, a visit to the wonderful Geologic Museum and lookout and then an equally spectacular return flight home. The views of the canyon and the friendships made will be unforgettable. When Cheryl dropped me off at my hotel she gave me a small gift...a thrift shop treasure of things to do with a family in Arizona. Thank you Cheryl! Thank you Westwind!

review_title: An excellent way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: We took the full day trip from Phoenix to the Grand Canyon on Jan 5, 2013.  We were very pleased with Westwind Air Service.  It was very easy to make reservations, the plane left on time, the pilot was very friendly and professional, and we had a nice ground tour of the South Rim.  We also thought that the cost was very reasonable and they even paid for our lunch.  With our time restraints, if it had not been for Westwind, we would have had a difficult time seeing the Grand Canyon.  I would give this company an A.

Liked the professionalism of the company.  Our pilot Jeff was very good and helpful during our flight pointing out places of interest to see.  Took some awesome photos of the Red Rock of Sedona and the landing and takeoff from Sedona airport was thrilling.  Small downside maybe the flight was slightly expensive.  Its a shame the company do not do discount for returning customers!!

We called to see if there was any way to get a Grand Canyon tour same day as the rim roads are closed due to icy conditions. Not only were we able to get a Grand Canyon air tour, we got an air/ground combination including Monument Valley! We had a wonderful afternoon and got a Sunset view of the Grand Canyon to boot! I can't say enough good about Westwind and you really can't get the full appreciation for the area without flying over it!

Nous avons réservé depuis Genève notre survol sur le Grand Canyon. 
J'ai parlé à Gayle qui m'a beaucoup aidé à prendre la bonne décision le moment de choisir le tour; et on a fait le Grand Canyon Deluxe (Sud du Grand Canyon).
Tout est vraiment très bien organisé. A 7 AM, une dame est passée à l'hôtel pour nous chercher; mais il faut savoir que le retour à l'hôtel n'est pas avant 3PM.
L'avion que Westwind utilise c'est un Cessna, et nous étions au total 8 personnes.
Le vol jusqu'au Grand Canyon dure 1h30, et pendant tout le parcours le pilot nous explique ce qu'on est en train de survoler. Quand il finissait  ses explications, il y avait une audio. Malheureusement le mien n'était pas top,il y avait trop de bruit,  mais le visuelle était a couper le souffle. 
Vraiment la nature est extraordinaire. Parfois je me sentais comme en dehors de la réalité, comme si tout ce que je voyais ce n' était pas du vrai. Les couleurs, les formes de roches, le dessin de chaque montagne.......
En arrivant au Park National nous avons eu le temps de prendre des photos, d'aller au Musée Yavapai, acheter des petits souvenirs faits par les différents groupes d'indiens.
Après on fait une jolie balade jusqu'à l'hôtel Tovar car notre voiture nous attendait là.  
Le tour inclus aussi:
- survol de Sedona, San Francisco Peaks et Navayo Reservation
- 1/2 heure de survol du Grand Canyon
- Transfert aéroport Grand Canyon dans une van jusqu'au Park National et villages
- déjeuner inclus

review_title: Excellent experience from Scottsdale to GC however
review_text:
Really my only complaint was watching no one tip the pilot of WW, who is essentially your tour guide all day.  At least our guy offered a LOT of information and background along the way, was able to get us in an out of lines faster etc.  I understand that some countries are non tipping countries but I think that spelling it out at the desk at WW would be helpful.  If you feel like it wasn't worth it then by all means let them know but a gratuity line item wouldn't be at all out of line IMO.  You have the opportunity to buy your photo in front of the plane as the last thing you do at WW, perhaps when you are paying there could be a "would you like to add an additional gratuity to the pilot of your plane?" type question?  

Actual Tour - I don't like cessnas but this was a larger one.  Flight there was fine and very little turbulence.  Flight back was very bumpy and while I wasn't nauseous, I was uneasy!   The canned audio on the way in was slow but informative.  A little too long IMO but I"m sure others found it very informational.  I preferred the pilot's own views and sight information.  The best thing is that the headphones drown out the plane's noise.

GC - Hopped out of plane, got in line for helicopter.  Heli ride is very organized and professional and feels "safe."  Short drop into the canyon.  Steep rocky hike down (5 minutes) to the base where you hop on the pontoon boat.  If you have knee or mobility problems then that little walk down will pose a bit of a problem.  Plenty of older people being assisted as it's steeper grade and not even footing.  Reasonably fit people should just watch their step and ankles!  Great photo ops though if you turn around because the GC forms the base wall going up and the helicopters are flying back up to pick up more people.

Pontoon - short ride but fun.  it was warmer here at the bottom than the windy top so it was nice to get out of the wind and have a short ride and relax.  Beautiful and makes you want it to last a lot longer.  No you do not get wet so no worries there...although we heard that occasionally people will jump in for no apparent reason!   Out of the boat back at the dock and back up the rocky steps.  Time to take some photos till you wait for your helicopter to pick you back up.

Back to the top where you get in line for Skywalk.  If you don't know what this is, google it.  I have a fear of heights and was cautiously fine.  I also did not look down right away and did a lot of deep breathing.  it's pretty scary!   You can't take cell phones or cameras there but they have photogs of course so you can buy the pics after.  Those range from 30 bucks i think to 120 maybe?  that gets you your pics on a flash drive to do with what you please when you get home although they print off 4 for your right there, which i think is smart just in case your drive doesn't work later!!  at least you have those 4 prints!   You end up in the gift shop there until you leave.

Time for picnic style lunch - bbq chicken, cole slaw, brownies, corn, mashed potato and gravy.  That type food.  Looked fine to me...not sure what people complain about.  It's included in the price.  I have dietary restrictions so I didn't eat it but it looked fresh and tasty and everyone in my group finished their plates.  Watch out for those pesky oversized ravens!!  OH and plenty of opportunities for bathroom stops all day so in hindsight I would have drank a lot more water!   There is time for a short hike after lunch and then some pics near the edge.   Back on plane and back to phoenix.

All in all a very enjoyable trip and very well organized.  Would do another trip with WW in a heartbeat and i faced my dislikes of small planes, helicopters and heights, all in one shot!  if i can do it, so can you!

I went with my grown daughter (no appropriate option above to choose from) to do the west grand canyon, sky walk 7.5 hour experience. This operation is 5* from beginning to end. Our trip was confirmed the day before. As instructed, we met Chick (in a white Nissan) outside our hotel lobby and were taken to the airfield where we met our pilot Chris. My daughter and I were the only passengers today.  Chris informed us that the grand canyon tour catered to the Asians and not to think him rude if he "bullied" his way through the throngs of people. We were informed that busloads of Asians are brought here daily from Las Vegas and that they push and do not understand the concept of waiting in line. True to his word, the place was mostly Asian (95+%) all pushing and moving in herds. It was so bad, that trying to exit the stall in the bathroom was almost impossible! Once outside of the restroom, Chris and another pilot arranged for the 2 groups to go ahead of the masses. We did our helicopter ride and pontoon boat down the Colorado river, then another helicopter ride back to the starting point. From there, we met up with Chris who whisked us off to a bus to do the skywalk. Very impressive, but expect long lines. Afterwards, we went to Guano Point for lunch. Be prepared to wait in line and be pushed and jostled. The food, I must admit, was poor at best- overcooked beans, corn, and then either pulled pork or bland chicken. There was also Cole slaw, mashed potatoes, a roll and chocolate cake, plus a bottle of water. My advice, pass on lunch or better yet, bring your own. I realize I went to see the sights and they were great... Lunch is just part of the package. After lunch, Chris took us on a hike and showed us the remains of the guano mining and lots of neat trivia. After this, back on the bus to a gift shop ( what else) and then back to the plane for the 1.5 hour return flight. This is a class operation and the experience would not have been as wonderful without a caring, knowledgeable pilot/ guide. I highly recommend this trip.

Hi, I took the deluxe grand canyon trip from Phoenix. All was very well organized, friendly people at westwind and on our tour. Highly recommended. Jeff the pilot was knowledgable, flexible and a great pilot.thankyou
absolutely first class service and worth every cent.Ely our pilot was a very good host and guide

Nous avions réservé depuis Paris le survol du Lake Page et de Bryce Canyon depuis Page. Lors de notre arrivée à Page avec 1 heure d'avance, le pilote nous attendait pour nous dire que malheureusement les conditions météo défavorables ( tempête de neige sur Bryce canyon) ne permettaient pas le survol de Bryce canyon. Il nous a donc proposé soit de tout annuler soit de partir uniquement sur le lac Powell, ce que nous avons accepté. Nous avons donc embarqué dans notre petit avion seuls avec le pilote qui fut tout au long du voyage souriant et aimable. Ce vol effectué en milieu et fin d'après midi reste inoubliable, la lumière du soleil sur le lac .....A faire absolument
Accueil, organisation, securité, gentllesse, disponibilité : parfait

Me and my wife went with them to the grand canyon, was the most amazing thing ever, the whole flight is narrated, they give you headphones, everyone gets a window seat and the sights are just breathtaking. Words cannot describe! We flew over the canyon, then landed and a van took us to a scenic viewpoint, we took amazing pictures, they the van brought us to lunch, there are a couple of restaurants there and you get whatever you want, everything is paid for. (They also give some small breakfast snacks before the trip begins). Pilot Jeff was amazing, answered all our questions, was patient,  funny, etc. Then we went to another viewpoint and you can also go on a small hike there if you want, then we headed back to Phoenix. The trip is a bit pricey, but totally worth it, hands down.

review_title: Fantastic trip, if you have a free day well worth going!
review_text:
Travelled with Westwind early February as part of 60th birthday treat whilst staying at Four Seasons, Scottsdale. 
Early pick up from hotel, travelled to airport picking p 2 more passengers so just 4 of s on trip.
Pilot Jeff flew  90 minutes in Cessna to Grand Canyon, spectacular views as you near the Grand Canyon.  Into helicopter on landing to be taken down to river for boat trip. We were really lucky as just the 4 of us on big boat with 'skipper' Nate who was very informative about the surrounding area. 
Back up onto rim in helicopter and then onto Skywalk which was truly amazing! Just the 4 of us on as the coaches had not yet arrived, although I understand that it can get very busy in the high season. 
Lunch on the rim of the canyon and then flight back to Phoenix. 
Lots of opportunity for photos and Jeff took plenty for us to savour when we got home. 
Cannot praise this company more, very professional and the tour was a delight, please try if you ave a free day, you will not be disappointed!

The two of us thought our flight was smooth and love the fact your 1000 ft of the ground so visibility was excellent throught the terain and spoiled as I was in the front seat however everyone had their own window seat better that a helicopter 1 hour flight plus 25 min through south rim in canyon then land at the canyon airport then a 10 min ride into the park . From there you go to the main lodge for about 45 min then to a different observation point for about an hour paid lunch at the lodge then a straight flight back scenery from view points is overwelming and pictures to last a lifetime will be doing this again. If you don't want a 12 hour day leave a 8 and back by 3 from phoenix . From Barry Bowden Vancouver island bc Canada.

Went to Grand Canyon and all was on time, friendly and helpful. Mike, our pilot and guide did an admirable job at both; personable, but not too intrusive. It is the kind of thing where you want the pilot concentrating on flying the plane and not jabbering too much. Costly, but worth it as it was a memorable family day. 

The boat ride on the Colorado River was too short (they take you upstream and you float back to the dock in 20 mins), but that is no fault of Westwind.

Not a cheap day trip, but if you do not have the time for an overnight visit, or don't want to pack everything into a 14 hour day, this is the perfect alternative. You arrive at their airstrip and depart before 8AM. They provide breakfast snacks and drinks to start your day, take a picture before you depart, and off you go. 

Look to be well maintained planes, nine seater we had for a group of six plus pilot, every seat a window seat. It was cool but brilliantly clear on take off. You get a good perspective of the valley and the elevation changes as you make your way northward. Sedona and the Red Rock are an incredible formation. I was surprised by the amount of development at the Grand Canyon. The flyover gives you a perspective you won't get anywhere else. 

Small airport at the GC, smooth landing, and a short van ride to the lookout points. Pictures do not do this place justice. Two or three vantage points, a nice lunch included in the package, and another stop for gift shopping and you're back to the airport for the ride home. You have an opportunity to buy the picture that was taken in the morning for $10. 

Back to our rental in south Phoenix by 4 in the afternoon. A long day, but well worth it. I am glad we took this tour. Shout out to Jeff our pilot for an informative and smooth flight. 

A quality outing in the greater Phoenix area.

review_title: The best thing I ever did!!!!
review_text: We did not want to drive from Phoenix to Grand Canyon so we decided to book a flight.  It was the best thing we did.  We were picked up at the hotel, had some snacks for breakfast, took off promptly and flew over the most breath taking sights, then circled the grand canyon, landed and our pilot took us on a tour of the park then treated us to lunch and wrapped up with some more sights before heading back to Phoenix.  It was great!!!!  Ask for Mike.

Flying from Phoenix to the Canyon via a Cessna, and then flying into the Canyon via chopper was an awesome experience.  The boat ride (more like a float) down the Colorado river was informative and gave a totally different perspective to the Canyon (i.e. looking up). The glass Skywalk  and lunch were included in the trip. Our pilot (and "guide" for the day) Elijah was excellent.  His goal was to keep us ahead of any crowds so we didn't waste any time in line-ups.  This experience was money well spent.

I can't say enough about the wonderful trip we had with Westwind. We took the Grand Canyon tour from Phoenix that landed and toured the park. The staff was very friendly and professional. Our pilot/tour guide kept us entertained all day with so many interesting facts about the area.  This is the best way to see the Grand Canyon and well worth the cost!

review_title: The Only Way to See the Grand Canyon!
review_text:
We booked a 7 hour flight with Westwind Air Service to see the Grand Canyon, primarily as we were staying in Scottsdale and driving 4+ hours to get there wasn't an option - especially with two children!  What a smart service - their Strapline "Every passenger gets a window seat" is accurate - the seat configuration in the small aircraft ( a Cessna Caravan) was such that the pilot plus all 9 pasengers all had a window seat - what you want on a scenic flight!  The flight left from Deer Valley Airport and flew over the most magnificent desert terraine I have ever seen in my life.  Tonto National Forest, Sedona, Navajo Indian Reservation (amongst others) to the Grand Canyon South Rim, for a 30 minute over flight. The flight was narrated providing insights into the history and geology of the region, but mainly the flight carried  a group of 6 adults and 2 children who sat gaping mouthed and wide-eyed at the impossible to take in views below!  The flight was incredibly smooth - allowing the 4 year old to snuggle up for a quick nap (albeit as we few over the Grand Canyon!!!!)
From Grand Canyon Airport we were driven by the pilot in a spacious, air-conditioned mini-bus to the park were we first ate lunch (included in the price) and then explored various points on the rim on foot!!!
Our guide was happy to provide plenty of information and even managed to show us an elk hiding in the park before making our way back to Grand Canyon Airport for a fast peaceful flight home!  It was the RIGHT WAY to see this magnificent Wonder of the World! The pilot was warm, knowledgeable and clearly qualified, and the aeroplane was clean and in good condition!  Everything ran on time and the entire expedition lasted approximately 6 and a half hours!  The tour group was limited to 8 passengers - nice and small! We drove ourselves to Deer Valley Airport but the other passengers had used Westwind Air's pickup service. WHen our boys are a little older we will use this company again to take one of their flights into the Canyon for a hike!!!!! I was an Amazing Unforgettable experience!

I recently spent $400 on a 3 hours scenic flight over the Grand Canyon, Monument Valley and Lake Powell. While definitely scenic, I was suprised at how underwhelmed I was with the experience. The staff were certainly courteous and the slightly drab recorded audio informative, but the experience left me feeling that it was a little under valued for the price. The land tour in Monument Valley was probably the highlight, as you go to go around the massive forms that make this place so famous.... and the following day, I got to sit with my legs dangling into the Grand Canyon at sunrise ... and that was an ahhhhhh experience. 

So this review is not specifically about failings in the Westwind experience, I just felt that the structures involved were best scene from ground level to accentuate the experience.

review_title: Touring Flight to the Grand Canyon
review_text:
Despite the fact that we've flown over the Grand Canyon many times on our way out to the West Coast,  my wife and I never actually visited it. On a recent trip to Scottsdale, we had one extra day to do some sightseeing. We decided to take a one-day trip to the Grand Canyon. This review is not about the Grand Canyon per se as there is little bad you can say about this magnificent natural wonder of the world. But I did want to give kudos to the tour service that provided the flight. The name of the company was Westwind Air Service tours. This company specializes on flights to the Grand Canyon from Deer Valley Airport in Phoenix. 

My wife and I have been on our fair share of tours over the years, but this one-day tour was very special. Like many tour companies, this one comes to your hotel early in the morning and takes you (and other passengers) to the airport for the flight to the Grand Canyon. The people are extremely friendly, courteous, and do not skimp on anything. The plane is roomy and the pilot/tour guide is well trained. If you are lucky like I was, you can even get to sit in the right hand side in the cockpit next to the pilot. Our tour guide, who also flew the plane of  8 people, was a history buff and very knowledgeable about the Grand Canyon and surroundings. Going out to the Canyon you fly over Sedona, which is breathtaking from the air; you also fly over Tonto National Forest, and the famous "painted desert."  The commentary is worth the price alone, but the scenery from plane is outrageous.  The trip includes lunch at a cafeteria at the Grand Canyon with no limits on how much you eat. This was a very generous tour and we had a great time. I heartily recommend it to anyone wanting to see the Grand Canyon in a day. The price for our trip, including lunch was $399/person.

review_title: Best way to see the Canyon!
review_text:
My husband and I went to Scottdale for business and we decided to splurge ($600.00pp) to go see the Grand Canyon.  This is hands down the best way to go.  The staff was very nice and pleasant and our pilot was very knowledgeable.  He answered all our questions, despite not being an "official" tour guide.  We took the tour to the West area of the Canyon, including the skywalk, a helicopter ride, and a short boating tour od the Colorado river.  It is the experience of a lifetime.  
I would recommend everyone to go to Guano point and climb the rock; the view is majestic.  Nobody else did it in our tour and they definitely missed a wonderful view. 
The only bad thing is the lunch the Hualapai's offer (native American tribe that owns that land); I wouldntserve that to my dog.  It's horrible.  But, everything else compensates. 
I would do it again; with the same company, the same place or even to the Sedona area perhaps.  Happy travels!!!

We took the Page to Monument Valley, with Ground Tour in October. It was a lovely sunny day. Started from Page airport, which is very small, easy to find, and very informal. There was only the two of us, and a nice old chap for the pilot, in a Cesna. All very informative and professional. Took us to see the sights - Lake Powell, Navaho Mountain, Horseshoe Bend, Rainbow Bridge. Flight took about 45 minutes. When we landed at Monument Valley we were met by our Navaho Guide and his 4X4 (no waiting around). Again there was only the two of us, which was fortunate, because it was a bit cool outside and normally everyone would be in open seats on the back, but because there wa only the two of us, we asked to sit in with the guide, which was worth it because he was able to talk to us, keep us informed, and answer our questions about the Navaho culture. The Monument Valley wasbeautiful as expected - took lots of photos. Then back to the plane and back to Page. The pilot was very accommodating, and agreed to take a shorter route back to ease my wife's air sickness. We were doing a driving tour from Garnd Canyon, to Lake Powell, to Bryce, then Zion and Vegas, so this was a good way to take in Monument Valley without a long and uninteresting drive.

review_title: Grand Canyon West Rim Adventure Tour
review_text: My wife, our grand daughter and I spent a glorious day with our pilot Mike and another couple on this tour.  I would highly recommend this tour and Westwind Air Service.  The professionalism, courtesy and over all polished feel of these people made this a stress free and very enjoyable day.    We weren't rushed and were escorted to or accompanied through every event.  Mike told us which side of the buses to sit on for the best photo ops and knew all the little tricks to getting through the crowds.   Can't say enough how great the whole experience was.  Do this ASAP!

I visited Scottsdale the week after Christmas and had the great pleasure to take two trips with Westwind Air Service. The first was the Grand Canyon West Rim Adventure Tour - this is the trip to take to get a focused tour of the Grand Canyon. The helicopter flight to the bottom of the canyon is very cool - don't be afraid if this is your first helicopter experience - it's worth the flight. The pontoon ride is also neat - floating smoothly through the Grand Canyon with great views for pictures.The other stops during the tour are all excellent and offer more great sites for photographs.
The second tour was the Grand Circle Tour - flying through the Red Rock formations of Sedona offers wonderful views, more great perspectives on the Grand Canyon, and then the highlight of Monument Valley. Though you've seen all of these places in pictures and on TV, nothing can compare with seeing these locations first hand.
All of the management and staff of this company provide friendly, first class service to their customers. The pilots were all very professional, and the planes very comfortable. Make this number one on your list of things to do when visiting Phoenix/Scottsdale.

We were visiting Scottsdale and decided to do the full day Grand Canyon Adventure,air and ground tour.This 7 hour excursion included, plane,helicopter flight, pontoon ride on the Colorado River and entrance to the Skywalk which was all incredible.Westwind are a very professional team from being collected at our hotel, briefed at the airport and then flown and escorted by the pilot,Mike. Whilst the day is fairly long it past effortlessly and enjoyably due to the trip being well structured and managed.
Mike was particularly knowledgeable and helpful throughout the excursion.
From the spectacular views during the plane journey,the helicopter ride to the base of the canyon, the short pontoon ride and finally the scary walk on the Skywalk it was superb.

Was a wonderful view, totally recommend, all the flight was amazing, you can see the rivers, the mountains, and the magnificent Denali. 

All the employees are very polite and professional.

When visiting Talkeetna going on a flightseeing tour is a must, and having selected Talkeetna Air Taxi was an excellent choice. The weather could have not been better. This absolutely magic day yielded grand views of the range, and of course in particular Denali. I travel through Alaska since 2010, and I go on a flightsee every time I visit, and I visit twice a year. It's simply magic, and Talkeetna Air Taxi ensures that every trip is special. Just awesome!!!!!

We had an amazing experience after the weather cleared. The pilot was very informative and the trip was safe and soooo beautiful. Worth every penny and worth the wait! It was breathtaking and we were so happy we took this tour. Thank you so much.

review_title: Can’t Leave Alaska without This Experience!
review_text: Words cannot fully express, but here’s to trying…The views are enormous and unlike any I’ve ever witnessed. The pilot was extremely knowledgeable. The experience of being in a plane landing and taking off in the snow is indescribable. We had previously booked the flight a day later, but the wonderful staff was able to change our date because of the clear weather and availability. Seeing the evening sun (4 pm flight) in our photos was simply gorgeous. I can’t give this crew enough stars! (Our flight was the Grand Denali with Glacier Landing.)

Best activity in Talkeetna!
The staff were great to work with from the first call, rescheduling at our request. Everyone was cheerful, professional and truly hospitable!

This was a 3 week retirement vacation in August for my husband and Talkeetna Air was one of our excursions and it was our favorite thing we did! We did the tour over and around Denali and our pilot was extremely kind and explained all details of the beautiful mountain! We will do this again when we return hopefully next year! Great tour and worth the money!
I was amazed and shocked how beautiful and awe-inspiring this was from the air. This flight is the number one experience of our Alaskan adventure.  Put this on your bucket must do list!

We watched the weather and when the forecast showed clear weather for the next afternoon, we booked a flightseeing tour that included a glacier landing. They were almost completely booked and they will refund if the flight is cancelled due to weather so you may not want to wait to book.

The information shows that you shouldn't bring a backpack or purse on board. I think that's due to a lack of secure storage space. My sister and I were both able to take our purses which we wore with cross-body straps and were small enough to sit in our laps during the flight. Upon arrival we were told to get everything we intended to take on the flight then we were each weighed with our gear. Long pants and closed toed shoes are required for a glacier landing and you should also have a jacket, hat, gloves and sunglasses. After we were checked in and weighed, we were given boots that slipped on over our shoes. They are easy to put on with velcro straps and a clip. My sister was wearing ankle height waterproof hiking boots and she was allowed to just wear those but the boots they provided were comfortable. We put those on before we got on the plane.

The pilot was friendly and knowledgeable. Our trip actually left a little early since the pilot and all of us (6) were ready to go. We flew through the clouds and also had fantastic views throughout the flight. Don't forget your camera. If you are prone to motion sickness, you might want to take something beforehand. Our flight was a little bumpy and swoopy. Every person has their own window.

Landing on the glacier was mostly smooth and we got out and walked around for about 20 minutes. You can't explore too far for safety reasons, but you can see a lot while you're there. Our entire trip took the exact amount of time advertised and it was great. If the weather cooperates, this is something to do. I was scared before we left but got over that quickly and really enjoyed it.

Incredible. Tough to capture in words. It was a magnificent experience: the views/landscapes/Denali & the Alaska Range; plus Talkeetna Air Taxi was top-tier at accommodating our interest, even w/ weather delays. We’re very thankful all aligned to make this experience so special. Highly recommend!
It was such an awesome experience. My husband wanted to do this so we did the glacier landing and it was wonderful. He got to sit up with the pilot and so enjoyed that. I would highly recommend this.

In August 2024, we booked the Southside Explorer with a glacier landing for my family of 4.  Unfortunately, the morning of our tour it was rainy with low clouds.  Talkeetna Air Taxi was extremely communicative with us that morning and offered us a variety of options for rebooking.  We chose to fly that evening based on their recommendation and it did not disappoint!  

My 13 year old son loves all things flying and our pilot, Tim, let him sit up front with him on the way to Denali.  It was a dream come true for him.  The entire flight was smooth and the pilot was full of information both on the way to the glacier and coming back.  It was clear he loved his job!  He told facts about the park as well as interesting historical facts.  

This is really the best way to see both Denali the mountain as well as the park.  We couldn't recommend this tour enough.  The company was fantastic to deal with and the actual flight was wonderful!

Incredible experience seeing majestic mountains and landing on the glacier. Cannot say enough about our pilot, Andy Young. Impressive skills. I didn't even notice the landing!
 Thank you Talkeetna Air Taxi for the wonderful time! Highly recommend.

review_title: Amazing flight with incredible views, and a great pilot.
review_text: This flightseeing tour was incredible. First, super easy to book, and only a 2 minute drive from Talkeetna, where we stayed the night before. Everything was easy and the people are great. The flight itself was incredible. Our pilot made sure to get all of the views on both sides of the plane, and he was very knowledgeable about the glaciers and how they are formed and shift. The views are incredible, of course. Great trip - 100% worth the time and money.

Oh MY Goodness what an AMAZING experience.  I would do this flight everyday if I had the ability to.  It was an experience of a lifetime.  The staff were all so professional and caring. Our Pilot was a wealth of information and made sure we all got a view from the lest and right side of the plane. I can not saw enough positive things about this experience.  Truly one of the most spectacular things I have ever done in my lifetime.

review_title: Amazing views and perfect day over Denali
review_text:
Going into the our trip to Alaska, this adventure was what concerned me most.  Thinking of a trip to Alaska as a once in a lifetime trip, we figured we'd pay for the best and get the Summit Tour with glacier landing.  I was debating a lower tour or skipping the landing, but if we only come once we should do the best, and it did not disappoint.  

The day we were scheduled to fly, it was forecasted to be rainy all day and I called to rebook for the next day, I highly recommend flexibility in your schedule in case you run into the same thing.  Th e morning of our flight, it was foggy and rainy and we were concerned again, but while spending time in Talkeetna the sun began to peek out and  we were hopeful.

The plane had seats for 10 and we put on oxygen masks over 12000 feet.  Our pilot (Dave/Dan?  sorry!) was awesome!  He pointed out landmarks, told history of the area.  Flight was smooth, he turned the plane so both sides could always see the views.  Denali was beautiful.  He smoothly landed on fresh snow on the glacier, and offered to take several pictures of our family (and did an excellent job of that too).

If you go to Denali, spend the money and do this trip, it will be a favorite family memory for a lifetime!

There are no words to describe the experience we had on the summit tour. IT WAS BREATHTAKING! We would highly recommend this flight. It is worth it. Our pilot, Dan, did an excellent job flying us to 20,000 feet. This is an experience we will never forget. The whole staff at Talkeetna Air Taxi, from booking to check-in to our pilot, were helpful, kind, and knowledgeable.

review_title: If in Denali area… won’t disappoint!
review_text: Definitely a “must do” experience. Opted for glacier landing as well… worth it! Our pilot has flown in the area for 30 years and provided interesting narration throughout our flight. Work every penny!

The views were amazing. They are ever cooperative. We had to reschedule twice due to bad weather but they accommodative. Unfortunately, we were not able to get the tour we booked due to weather (we booked Grand Denali and ended up doing south side) but, they refunded the difference. 
Staff is very friendly, views are amazing and breathtaking. I seriously recommend to do it. 
Only reason i have 1 star less is because the headsets for my wife was not working during the flight. And she was not able to listen to any narration/music. 
Tip: book early in the day so even if the weather is bad, you can reschedule. 

If you want to sit on co-pilot seat, you can. Ask your pilot, 🤓. (We did not do it)

First let me say that TAT is the best. I booked a flight via a 3rd party while enroute from Anchorage (I strongly suggest that you call Talkeetna Air Taxi directly for booking). That being said, when we arrived, we asked about adding the glacier landing. The staff was incredible and made it happen! Secondly, wow! This was the most awe inspiring thing I have ever done! We took the summit tour and flew over the top of Denali. I got to sit in the copilot seat for the first part of the tour. 12 year old me was geeking out(I'm 58)! Then we landed on Ruth Glacier. Our pilot, Liam, was awesome. He answered all of my questions which were mostly about the aircraft. I would do it again!

This was an experience of a lifetime.  We chose the summit tour with glacier landing. This tour brought us up close and personal with Mt. Denali, as well as many of the other peaks of the Alaskan range. Our pilot, Clay, was knowledgeable and funny, while making us comfortable on our first small plane flight.  We took hundreds of photos on the flight and glacier landing.  The glacier landing was a highlight of the trip. Words aren't sufficient to describe this trip.
It was a super great experience with insanely beautiful views...calm flight in the best weather and super pilot who explained everything to our satisfaction...is definitely worth every penny

Excellent tour; the pilot was very knowledgeable about the peaks, glaciers, and entire area.  Pilot did a great job flying and the instructions were clear; got a great view of the Denali peaks at about the same elevation as the south peak (20,300 feet); and the tour included a glacial landing, which was spectacular, with an opportunity to get out of the plane and walk on the glacier!  I would highly recommend this tour!
We went with our 6 year old twin boys. We all loved it. The staff was so nice and knowledgeable and you really can't beat the views. It was such a cool experience landing on a glacier

There are so few words to describe the experience and feelings. I felt like a grain of sand on a huge beach. I was simply a humbling experience. Our pilot was so skilled navigating the peaks and landing on Ruth glacier

Our pilot, Dan was fantastic. He knew everything about every glacier, mountain, river and the history of the area. He also climbed Denali 6 times so he had the perspective also. I would highly recommend this company.
This was the most amazing experience both myself and my husband have ever experienced! Thanks so much to our pilot guide Tim ! I would definitely recommend this trip for your bucket list check off !

This was my first time in a small plane.  The pilot was great and I wasn't nervous at all.  We were lucky enough to have a clear day.  We flew very close to the mountains and glaciers.  The views were stunning.  My photos didn't do them justice.

I’m always a bit hesitant to schedule flightseeing tours (due to an experience many, many years ago) but decided to give it a try again on this trip. I’m so very glad I did!!  The views were amazing!! Our pilot was great and I’d fly with him again anytime.  He was very conscientious of our wellbeing throughout flight. He pointed out specific areas of interest and details about the glaciers and mountains.  Unfortunately, we weren’t able to complete the glacier landing as originally planned. I appreciate the agency’s communication regarding the safety concerns which were communicated with us prior to the flight. It was was a great experience from check-in to chevk-out. Would love to fly with them again if I’m able to return to Alaska.  Thanks Talkeetna Air for a great experience!!

review_title: DENALI SUMMIT with GLACIER LANDING WORTH EVERY PENNY!
review_text: The most amazing thing we have done so far in Alaska. We took the summit flight tour with glacier Landing and we were able to see all of Denali with a few clouds. Then we landed on the glacier and oh my it was beautiful and breathtaking.  Captain Liam was great with sharing stories with us and keeping us safe 10 out of 10 for him.  Everyone at Talkeetna air taxi were great. Because they were able to move our flight one day earlier because the weather was better. Thank you so much!  Highly recommend you use Talkeetna air taxi to go and see in Denali.  It’s well worth the money spent a lifetime of memories.

My brother-in-law and I were originally booked on the early morning Grand Denali tour with glacier landing. That tour was cancelled due to the weather, so we were rebooked for later that day.  The weather also caused that tour to be cancelled, but we were offered the Southside tour with glacier landing while being cautioned that the chance of landing was low.  Although we were disappointed, we accepted the offer. Were we ever happy we did!  Although clouds prevented us from seeing Denali, the views we did see were amazing.  Before boarding, our pilot (Asa) asked if anyone wanted to sit in the co-pilot’s seat, and I got lucky - so my view was especially incredible. We travelled up Ruth Glacier, and down Tokositna Glacier, and Asa turned the airplane so that everyone could see the sights regardless of the side they were sitting on.  We were unable to make a glacier landing, but in the end it didn’t matter - both of us were very happy with the tour we received.  Also, we received a refund for the difference between the cost of the original tour and the tour we took immediately. Highly recommended!

review_title: This tour should be on your bucket list!
review_text: What ab incredible experience!  This was the highlight of my trip to Alaska.  Words cannot describe how beautiful it is up there.  It is difficult to see Mt Denali from the ground. Before this I saw the mountain peaking through the cloud cover. However when you get up in a plane,the views are breathtaking.  Definitely include the glacier landing.

Despite the moderate weather, it was a very successful sightseeing flight with a glacier landing (actually a MUST).
It is very impressive to immerse yourself in this sometimes bizarre world of rock, snow and glaciers.
You are connected to the pilot at all times via headphones, who also provides interesting information about this mountain world.
As the weather conditions were rather bad, Talkeetna Air Taxi offered a price reduction on its own.
This excursion is highly recommended!

review_title: Beautiful - This is the tour you want to choose
review_text: I have mixed feelings and personal opinions about this tour. I did the Summit Tour with Glacier Landing. The tour itself was fantastic! I had waited 14 yrs to do this tour and landing and walking around on the glacier was beautiful. My only disappointment was the training we had gotten on how to use the oxygen. ½ of us used it one way and ½ of us used it another way. I felt like I missed 10 minutes of the best part of the flight over the peak of Denali messing with my oxygen because it wasn't sitting on my face correctly. I actually didn't even get to see the peak. I wished they had actually demonstrated how to put the oxygen on and maybe had us practice on land at the airport first. As once you are in the air the pilot cannot look back at us to know we are ok nor can we talk to the pilot, as you are not given a microphone to ask questions. Otherwise the tour was fantastic. I did actually speak with the office about this this and hope it will be changed for future travelers to make their experience perfect. The assured me this doesn't happen and so maybe it was just my own personal experience that flight. Otherwise I would definitely say this is the tour to chose from because Denali is so beautiful.

Words can't even begin to describe this experience of a lifetime! I had high expectations and they were surpassed! Our family of 9 felt very safe the whole time... except for the moments when we were so close to the mountains that we thought for sure that the pilot wasn't looking... but nope... we were supposed to be that close!

We lucked out on a beautiful, sunny day, so we got to see so much. The pilot was great about pointing out different things about the mountains and ice fields and plains and trees and glaciers and water and even the residence ON the mountain range! It was gorgeous!

I typically get motion-sickness so I took a dramamine before the ride and I did fine. It wasn't bumpy or anything - very smooth ride!

Words can’t describe how amazing this trip was. The plane takes you to places that not many get to see. Denali is so far from everything that plane is the only easy way to see it. You fly directly over and around the summit with breathtaking views. The glacier landing was amazing. You get great photo opportunities with Denali in the background. This is an absolute must in Alaska.

review_text:

The flight seeing tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi was truly the best part of our trip to Alaska!  We chose the flight with the glacier landing and it was totally worth the little bit of extra cost.  We landed on Ruth Glacier and saw Denali up close.  It was a beautiful scenic flight, our pilot was wonderful, and we had a great time on the glacier!  Highly, highly recommend!
The highlight of our trip!  Friendly, helpful staff.  Great flight and plenty of time on the glacier.  Every person had a window and the pilot made sure each side of the plane got the same view.

Best part of my Alaska trip!  Talkeetna Air acuminated us for a trip with just one day notice. Our pilot was friendly and so knowledgeable! review_title: Beautiful flight, Clay was a great pilot and guide!
review_text: Everything from the check-in process to the flight was incredibly smooth. Our pilot was as amazing as the sights!

The flight and glacier landing were incredible. Truly a unique and awesome experience seeing one of God's wonderful creations! Making reservations was simple. Our pilot Tim provided information and history about the mountain and climbing expeditions during the flight.

It was amazing to see the mountain at all, but it was a life changing experience to see it so close. Our pilot was very knowledgeable, and fun. The front staff was easy to work with. We tried to go for three days, but the weather wasn't cooperating until day three. The entire staff made sure we got the best experience.
What a treat!  We flew in the early morning on a cloudless day to view up close the snow-topped mountains surrounding the amazing Denali mountain!  Then we landed on a 35 mile-long glacier!

review_title: Nice adventure but spoiled by weather
review_text: We tried for three days to go on the Denali Grand Tour with the glacier landing.  They keep cancelling because of the weather.  Not blaming them at all.  The weather just wasn't cooperative.  We finally got airborne but the flight was cut short and there was no glacier landing.  Again, not their fault.  We did get a prompt refund.  What we did see was beautiful.

They were able to take me last minute and the flight was spectacular as was the weather.   Very competent and obviously experience pilot (and I am one) took us safely very near the peaks and valleys of Denali.    Weather at Denali is very iffy - but if you get a good day go for it!

Took a tour around Mount Denali. This was my second time doing it, and I would go again if I had the chance. It is absolutely a fantastic experience. 
Always felt 100% safe.

This experience was the highlight of our Alaskan vacation!  The views were spectacular and while the pilot wasn't super chatty, he took effort to make sure that no matter where you were seated on the plane you had the chance to see the stunning mountains and other landscape.  The landing was beyond amazing!

review_title: Amazing experience. Great to Work With
review_text: We had reserved a flight for 4 family members months in advance of our vacation to Alaska.  When the day came, two of the 4 were sick and couldn't go.  T.A.T. happily refunded 2 of our tickets in full.  The two who did go said it was the best part of our 9 day vacation.
A close contact with Alaskan range and Denali. The view was breathtaking. The glacier landing was such a fun! The pilot is very knowledgeable and kind. The ride was smooth and all felt safe.
One of the highlights of our Alaska Trip 2022. Awesome impressions and excellent pilot. Very recommendable. Would always repeat!!!

The Glacier Landing tour was amazing, a lifetime experience with great visuals. Andy, our pilot was excellent. Even though the weather was rough that day, TAT folks were pretty good in keeping us posted of the updates and in suggesting the alternate slots.

review_title: A great experience!  So glad we did this!
review_text: Excellent pilot and experience!  I would highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi!  Smooth flight, great commentary, pilot turned the plane to both sides so all could get a good view.  Really enjoyed it!
This was an incredible experience that was safe, well organized, attentive staff, safe equipment and an excellent and thoughtful pilot. Highly recommend. Was the highlight of our two week trip to AK.
Flying around Mt. Delanly with a Glacier Landing is an experience you'll never forget. Talkeetna Air Taxi did a great job.

So happy Tim (Denali Outlook) recommended Air Taxi for flight up to the glaciers. What an experience. Pilot was GREAT. Process at the desk was seemless. Highly recommend this flight if you are ever in Talkeetna.

This was the highlight of our Alaska trip.  The weather was superb and our pilot, Tim did an awesome job of giving us great photo opportunities and describing the Alaska range and Denali and other features during the flight.  The landing on Ruth Glacier was most excellent.  The views were outstanding and an exhilarating experience.  I would highly recommend this excursion.
Conditions were perfect. Could see for miles.  Incredible flight and views.  Glacier landing is awesome.  Alex (pilot) did great job pointing things out and narrating.  Would definitely recommend.

Not doubt, there is considerable cost associated with this trip. However, you WILL NOT be disappointed. My wife and I celebrated our 25th in Alaska. We had high expectations for the Denali flight, and they were exceeded by a great deal. We opted for the glacier landing, and I would really encourage anyone considering this flight to spring for the added cost. I don't have words to describe just how awesome this entire experience was, but suffice it to say that this was truly an experience of a lifetime. The staff (and our pilot Chris) was the best. Thank you so much!

What a wonderful experience to kick off our visit to Alaska!! It was absolutely amazing to get to see Denali up close and the glacier landing was phenomenal! We were worried about what we would get to see because it was partly to mostly cloudy when we took off, but our pilot, Chris, was an expert at knowing where to take us for the best viewing with the given conditions. He was also great at telling the story of the area while we travelled. Besides the flight experience itself, the booking, check-in, gearing up, etc. was super smooth. We originally had booked an afternoon trip, but because of weather moving in, we called that morning and asked if we could bump to an earlier trip. The person we worked with was very friendly and accommodating and facilitated our request with ease. All around A+ operation!!

We went on a flight with Leighan including a glacier landing. The views are spectacular and it was so much fun throwing snowballs in the middle of summer on the glacier. Leighan is a fabulous pilot with lots of knowledge and she was great with our children.

Great summit trip....with base camp glacier landing.  Visibility was amazing.  Most amazing experience and activity we did in Alaska.  Chris was our pilot, extremely knowledgeable and bvery generous making sure everyone got great views....this was not a quick up and down where you felt like you didn't get your moneys worth.....totally amazing
It was a breathtaking experience… I’m glad we decided to do this last minute, it was the best part of the trip! Our pilot Alex is very experienced, and knowledgeable!

We took the Grand Denali tour with Glacier Landing with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  We were lucky enough to have a beautiful day for our flight. Great views of Denali and the surrounding mountains. We landed on the glacier and had probably about 20 minutes to walk around and take photos. An awesome experience! A very smooth trip. Our pilot was very knowledgeable in explaining what we were seeing, including the route the climbers take to summit Denali. Really a once in a lifetime experience! Would definitely recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi.

review_title: Words Can’t Explain How Amazing It was
review_text: This was the best activity we did while in Alaska for 3 weeks. The staff was very helpful. Our pilot was great. The flight was very smooth and enjoyable. The views were beyond amazing. Words cannot explain the beauty of the Denali and other mountains and glaciers. We highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi Denali Flightseeing with Glacier Landing. You won’t regret it.
Everything about our plane adventure was great. From check-in, Meeting the pilot, etc. When they say a 2 to 2 1/2 hour ride that’s what it is.

This tour was absolutely phenomenal! I watched the weather for a clear day and Denali was stunning in all her glory! Tim our pilot was excellent, making sure people on all sides got great views while providing some education on the area and what we were looking at. You could tell he really loves what he does! The flight was incredibly smooth and I was just in awe the entire time! Highly recommend! It was worth every penny and more!

This couldn’t have been better!  The flight was amazing, staff went above and beyond.  They were so friendly and well organized.   The landing on the glacier was beyond amazing.  Liam - pilot was great

review_title: A dream come true and an adventure of a life time
review_text: My wife and I recently had the chance to ride with Tim to do a summit tour with glacier landing. The pilot Tim’s narration and warm personality and professionalism as well as how well run the business was as a whole with everyone being kind and helpful made this a memory I’ll never forget. The views and just the sheer standing on the glacier were breathtaking. The flight was smooth and the plane was comfy and large. I cannot recommend this highly enough!!!

review_title: Denali air tour with glacier landing.
review_text: We flew with TAT, with pilot Chris at the controls of their ski equipped de Havilland Otter, on a tour of the Alaskan Range, Denali area.  While clouds prevented us from seeing Denali herself, Chris still was able to land us on Ruth Glacier for about a 20 minute visit to the glacier, in front of the famous Sheldon Chalet.  This was one of the best travel adventures my family has ever been on.  The scenery was incomparable, Chris' knowledge of the terrain and history were superb, and landing on a glacier in late July in a mild snow storm was a once in a lifetime experience.  If you are in Alaska and looking for something different  to do, make the trek out to Talkeetna--a very cool Alaskan village in itself, and fly with TAT.  Many thanks to Sandy (Go Vols!) and all to working us in last minute due to the weather and making this happen for us.
If the weather is good take the grand tour.  don't miss it. it was the highlight of our Alaska adventure. the aircraft are venerable but solid.

The trip was fabulous!  Our pilot, Alex, was great about pointing out glaciers, mountains, and other point s of interest.  The glacier landing was the experience of a lifetime!  While we didn't get to complete the full tour or see Denali's peak, they refunded a portion of our fees accordingly.  I highly recommend this group!!
This was one of the most awesome moments of my life. I am so happy that we made the decision to do the air taxi.

Talkeetna Air Taxi is highly recommended - i have flow the Denali trip with Glacier landing several times and my confidence in TAT improves with each trip - - they very professional, personal and extremely knowledgeable about the area in which they fly.

It is really hard to describe how amazing the views, glacier landing, and entire experience was.  It's is truly one of those things you have to just experience to know how great it is.
Of course all of this was made even better by the folks at TAT.  Liam, our pilot, was great - just enough tour guide information without being annoying and ruining the views.  All the staff on the ground are super friendly and determine to make sure you have a good time.

review_title: A splurge, but so worth it!
review_text: Definitely the highlight of our trip to Alaska. A splurge, but so worth it! I would highly recommend adding the glacier landing, it was incredible. It was amazing to see Denali up close and the pilot was so professional and engaging the whole time. I don't love flying and have never been in a small plane before, but glad I overcame my anxiety. Unparalleled views and so fun. I would recommend this company to anyone! They were professional, helpful, and very kind. Also, flying out of Talkeetna puts you closer to the mountains, so you have more time flying over them rather than getting to and from over flat land. If you're on the fence, do it!

A really great experience, both the sights and the scheduling.  We wanted to take the Summit tour, but because of a 4-person minimum, it was canceled.  We did the Grand Denali instead and didn't feel like we were missing out at all.  They were very accommodating to scheduling changes, as our cruise tour transportation was late.  Our pilot was very experienced and knowledgeable, which made it even more enjoyable.  I would highly recommend them!

This has got to be the highlight of any Alaska adventure. We chose the Summit tour with glacier landing and it surpassed all our expectations. The majesty and beauty is indescribable and the pictures can not capture the grandeur. From the warm welcome and very clear instructions, the staff was so friendly, fun, and professional. Our pilot gave us so much history about Denali. Landing on the glacier is something we will never forget. The vastness of it all. Talkeetna Air taxi provided us with the trip of a lifetime..

We love to travel and have been fortunate to do and see many exciting things all over the world. This was the number one experience of our Alaska vacation and honestly one of the best things we have ever done as a family. We were lucky to have a beautiful sunny day and had the clearest views of Denali possible!
My wife and I had a great time and beautiful views - even though we did not see the top of Denali. It was still worth the trip! Our pilot and staff were great!

review_title: Best thing to do to see Denali
review_text: This was by far the best experience we had in Alaska.  The pilot was awesome: very experienced and on top of everything.  We were able to get amazing pictures of the mountains and glaciers.  Landing on the glacier was very exciting and watching other planes take off was super cool.

The pilot was competent, interested in our comfort and safety, and also joyously shared the beauty of Denali, answering questions with grace.  I loved the flight, the sights, the sounds, and standing on Ruth Glacier is one of the great experiences of my 72 years of life.  I high recommend!
The Views seen are absolutely breath taking, and our pilot was full of knowledge that she share while flying up to the summit and the glacier landing was a blast!!
Before I went to Alaska, I did a lot of research about this tour and a lot of comments were very positive and its real! If you have the chance do it, worth every penny.

review_title: Breathtaking experience with an awesome pilot
review_text: This was our first Alaska trip and the last adventure we had booked at the last minute.  What an experience! Nothing even comes close. Talkeetna Air Taxi was the most professional company. Everything was easy to do from the simple website, to the clear instructions on what to bring and, most importantly, the focus on safety. We did the Southside explorer with Glacier landing. The best choice ever as the North side was all smoked out and we were told you could maybe view the top of the mountain at some angle.  Our pilot, Melissa was so much fun and she went into enormous details about each mountain and the glacier and a lot of fun facts. She even allowed my son to sit with her next to the pilot's seat. He was simply blown away by the experience. The landing, which I was a little wary of, was smooth as butter. And what a view when you get out. The mighty Denali just right there in front of you looking regal glistening in the sun. We got a lot of time hanging around the glacial amphitheater admiring the pools of blue water and even tried to build a snowman. This is the best company you can choose for the Denali view and landing. The return was perfect too and everything was done so well.

We did the Mountain Voyager flight with glacier landing as a family in June.  It was a once in a lifetime trip...or so I thought until after we'd done it...if I am lucky enough to ever get back to Alaska I will definitely try and do this flight again! Tim our pilot was amazing and the whole trip was really well organised with friendly ground crew too! The views and flying experience and the glacier landing were unreal. Tim gave us heaps of interesting information and answered everyones' questions but also gave us space to enjoy our own experience and never made us feel rushed. There's only one way to sum it up...WOW!

Flight was well worth the cost.  I would highly recommend this company.  Our pilot, Melissa was the most awesome pilot we could of gotten. Gave a ton of info during the flight and was so personable,  it was a pleasure flying with her.
First time I  boarded a small aircraft. Pilot and staff in the office were very nice and calmed my nervousness. Best part of trip was landing on Mt. Denali glacier. Entire staff were A+.

We took the Denali "fightseeing" trip with a Glacier landing.  Our pilot was Tim and we could not have had a better experience.  Between the fabulous view of the mountain and the interesting facts and stories that Tim shared with us, we were enthralled.  We would take this trip again in a heartbeat!

Tim was a wonderful pilot, and he answered all of our questions, circled back to show us a moose in a lake and a bear on a mountain.  His sense of humor added to our journey, and his knowledge and experience helped make for a smooth trip.

The crew at Talkeetna Air Taxi were first class from booking clear to our exit.  The Denali flight was breathtaking and landing on the glacier was a once in a lifetime experience.  We appreciate the whole crew that helped make this adventure possible.

Not only was the trip one of the most spectacular things we have ever done, we learned so much about the area from our amazing pilot! Landing on the glacier is a must if you can. The staff are some of the nicest people, they made check in a breeze.

This was my fourth time taking friends up to Talkeetna for the flight. The airplanes are beautiful and very well maintained. Flying through the mountains and landing on the glacier is magical. I highly recommend this amazing experience.
Amazing flight to Denali w glacier landing. loved it. smooth. wife loved it too. great experience.  highly recommend.

review_title: Grand Denali tour with glacier landing - must do
review_text:

Definitely recommend.
Absolutely amazing. My wife says she couldn’t stop smiling. This makes no sense to do a hundred characters

Thank you for a truly once in a lifetime flight.  Strongly suggest this activity.  Just make sure your camera is charged and you have a back-up battery.

We had a two day visit to Denali and after having limited peak viewing at the park, we decided to book the air tour with glacier landing.  It became the highlight of our trip. The views of Denali were amazing

Couldn't be happier with my flight.  Was a bit nervous flying in a small plane through rugged mountain passes.  The team did a great job of being very professional and guiding throughout.  One of the best things we did on our first trip to Alaska.  Highly recommend this capable team.

Our flightseeing trip was spectacular! Of course the scenery was beautiful and standing on a glacier was a once in a lifetime experience! Liam, our pilot, provided lots of great information as we went and took great care of us the whole time.
We had the perfect weather for this experience. Pilot was very knowledgeable and the glacier stop is a must!
This was a fantastic experience!  Booking, check-in and actual tour were all handled very smoothly.  The flight was phenomenal!!

We did Denali summit flight tour with glacier landing in June 2022. It was the highlight of our 1-week Alaska trip! Such a memorable experience! We lucked out with great weather and were able to see the summit so clear and close! 

We also did a helicopter glacier landing tour which costed almost the same, but in my opinion this tour was just next level!

A really professional and friendly organisation from checking in to saying goodbye! All the staff involved were polite, helpful and knowledgeable. Our pilot Liam was smooth, professional and very informative. Unhesitatingly recommend the trip.
Great flight, Courtney and Melissa were fantastic.  Well run professional air flight company in a small town

Overall great experience from booking (in my case also modifying) to check in, to the actual flight.       Believe they are sincere in their efforts to ensure customers have as good an experience as possible.  

The flight itself was worth every cent.   Some of the best vacation dollars I’ve ever spent.

If I could give more stars I would. There is no other way to see Mt. Denali, the surrounding mountain ranges and the glaciers in all their glory. Landing on the glacier topped off a perfect flight piloted by an expert aviator and tour guide. This is a must do on anyone’s Alaska to do list!

review_title: A bit terrifying, but so worth it!!
review_text:

The scenery was incredible, and how many people can say they had a snowball fight with a glacier!

review_title: Grand Denali Tour w Glacier Landing
review_text: Definitely the highlight of our Alaskan trip! We would 100% do this again it was so memorable! We also added on the glacier landing which was so cool so it was worth adding on

The highlight of our trip! Our pilot Leann was amazing and we had gorgeous weather. This is the ideal way to see Denali!!! I planned the flight as a birthday surprise for my husband and they were so accomodating to help me keep everything a secret! They even suggested bringing a cake up to the glacier which was a fun treat. Our kids loved it too - ages 4, 10, and 14. Definitely recommend - 5 stars!!

This was my second flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  My first flight was in 2017.  And, just like in 2017, this flight was great.  The pilot was a good pilot. He was safe, knowledgeable and informative. Both times I took the Grand Denali tour.  I definitely recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi.

I have flown before with TAT in 2018, while attempting a Denali summit climb. I was impressed with the professionalism of the staff and pilots. Since then, I have tried twice to take a flightseeing trip to see the parts of the climb and summit we were unable to reach due to inclement weather, and also to share the experience with my wife. Unfortunately, the first time we booked the trip was in 2020, so it was cancelled. We tried again this year (2022) and booked our Summit Tour in January. A minimum of 4 must be registered for this trip to “fly”. As luck would have it, the threat of clouds at the summit caused the other couple to back out of the flight, leaving us “grounded”. At this point, the staff, and especially Sandy, went to work to see what options and accommodations were available for us. We were offered several possibilities, but the weather and not being unable to meet the minimum number of clients worked against our goal of seeing the top part of the mountain. We much appreciated the efforts put forth by Sandy (and others) to get us in the air, but our goal was very specific and it was just not going to happen this time. If/when we try again, it will be with Talkeetna Air Taxi.

The tallest Mountain in North America has been on my bucket list for many years. Talkeetna Air Taxi allowed me to see it from every angle & it was breath taking. The pilot (Chase) was outstanding, pointing out terrain and land marks. The entire staff were very helpful, polite, knowledgeable. I would recommend paying the little extra for the summit tour and glacier landing you will not be disappointed. Thank you TAT!!!!

review_title: Grande Denali flight and glacier landing - Life Changing
review_text: If you don't have the capacity for a 3 week grueling expedition, flightseeing and a glacier landing is the only way to get intimate with this giant.  Being a mountain gal living in Colorado/Wyoming I'm familiar with big peaks, this place is incomprehensible.  I was overwhelmed with emotions and brought to tears by this adventure, it changed my perspective on remote, rugged, wild, peaks.  I booked with TAT because of their flexible cancellation/rebooking policy as many days just aren't right for this trip.  I am already plotting how I can return and have another Denali experience with TAT.  Thank you!
Excellent experience. We will never forget this! Breath taking views. Great customer service. Do the glacier landing flight!

review_title: The best thing to do in Alaska
review_text: If you only do 1 thing in Alaska, this is it!  Tale it from someone who lived in Alaska for 3+ years that this is the adventure of a lifetime!

If you are debating booking a Denali flight seeing tour, take this as your warning to not miss out! If you are second-guessing spending the extra money on a glacier landing- you will not regret it! It was an incredible experience that we will never forget!

If you don't do anything else in Alaska---do THIS!!!!  The views of Denali and the Alaska Range were unbelievable!  The  glacier landing was magical!  We felt safe and comfortable and our pilot talked to use through headsets the entire trip.  We enjoyed flying with three other couples.  Lovely, beautiful day and would do this again in a heartbeat. WORTH the EXPENSE!!!

Pilot was fantastic AND a great tour guide which I didn’t expect. I sat up front which I highly recommend if you get the chance. The views are breath taking. The glacier landing was exciting, smooth, and completely worth it.

review_title: An amazing flight to the summit
review_text: My daughter and I enjoyed the spectacular flight to Denali and landed at Base Camp. There aren’t enough adjectives to describe or photograph accurate enough to depict the grandeur or majesty that we witnessed. The trip of a lifetime!!

review_title: Highlight of our 2 weeks in Alaska
review_text: Amazing views of Denali- we were fortunate to have a clear day. Leighan, our pilot, was amazing. The flight was smooth, landing on the glacier was awe-inspiring, and her commentary was interesting and tailored to the group. She eased the young guest who was anxious, was personable and professional. This is a don’t miss experience.
Disponibilissimi, sono venuti a prendermi e mi hanno riportato al lodge, servizio cassaforte e magazzino nei 15 giorni in cui sono stato sul ghiacciaio. Super consigliatissimi. Grazie.

Unfortunately the weather was not cooperative and we were not able to land on the glacier.  However, we still were able to fly and were given the opportunity to actually fly to a higher elevation in order to still get a fantastic view.  The company refunded us for the added cost of landing immediately upon our return to the airstrip.  Pilot was great and very knowledgeable.  We had a ride along guest pilot who had actually hiked Denali and gave us added information.  Well worth the time and money.  Views were incredible even with some clouds.

Once in a lifetime experience! We took the Grand Denali tour with glacier landing yesterday and it was perfect from start to finish. The team at Talkeetna Air Taxi made the checkin and boarding experience so easy and the flight was perfect. Liam got us phenomenal views of Denali and other mountains in the Alaska Range. Landing on Ruth Glacier was the icing on top of a perfect flight. We were the only plane there and had about 20ish minutes to explore. The cost of the flight tour was similar to other companies in the area offering a similar flight, about $450/person, and the additional fee to add on the glacier landing was 100% worth it.
Absolutely loved this trip, it was the best excursion of my vacation, you get so close to Denali and the landing on the glacier is a once in a lifetime opportunity. Just do it!

I was impressed by the amazing sheer size of the mountains once we were down in the Alaska range. It just seemed so surreal to see straight Cliffs a mile high And glaciers that spend for Miles they were several miles wide. 

Our guide was very detailed and helpful in orienting us.

Beautiful Alaska adventure!
We booked the mountain voyager tour through Talkeetna Air taxi on our recent trip and it was a great experience! The pilot was really nice and it was a smooth ride.
One of the most awe inspiring experiences ever!  Would highly recommend it and would love to do it again sometime. Incredible!
We had a wonderful time on our two hour helicopter tour out to Denali. Our pilot was delightful and so willing to answer all our questions. It was an amazing end to our trip.
The best thing I've ever done. What an amazing and breathtaking experience. Definietly worth adding on the glacier landing. Clay was a great pilot!
Wonderful service. The staff was efficient, welcoming and informative. Views were incredible. We flew more than I expected.
Outstanding staff and pilot. Well narrated by pilot Chris and the views were breathtaking. Landing on the glacier was out of this world! Spectacular trip!

The summit tour was excellent. We were scheduled for the glacier Landing but Summit tour was alll we could do due to low Clouds. The summit was in full view an awesome Sight. While
My wife commented that she would have liked more mountain outside her side of plane she did think the summit tour was excellent. We will attempt future tour with TAT for glacier landing! Pilot, copilot snd staff were excellent as well.

This place is clean and professionally run.  The plane was nearly new and very nice.  The headphones worked well and the pilot was very experienced; I felt very comfortable flying with him.  Not sure why we needed to get there 45 minutes early, but it wasn't really a problem; I just hate getting up early.  Unfortunately Denali's peak was hiding in clouds, but we got to see base camp which was busy that day.

Amazing experience! Pilot and staff are all great. We did the grand denali tour with glacier landing. This is the best part of our Alaska vacation. Try to get the copilot seat in the plane. Experience was once in a lifetime.
You won't be disappointed!  The staff was both professional and fun.  Worth the cost to get out on the glacier.
The best day of my time in Alaska.  Visiting Alaska must include a glacier landing with Talkeetna Air Taxi.

review_title: Love it! Staff super friendly and great service!
review_text: I was comparing the 2 companies in town and decided to go with this one because the staff were friendlier and really helped us out. I called multiple times and had many questions both Noah and Sandy were very helpful and answered a lot of my questions. My family decided to extend our stay to get on this tour because the weather was bad the first day. God was gracious enough to clear the sky the next day and there we went. They surprised us by upgrading the tour for us. If you are looking to do a plane tour to Denali, I highly recommend TAT. Thank you TAT again for this wonderful tour for my family!

We did the glacial landing tour. What an amazing experience! Would definitely recommend booking a flight while in Talkeetna. The views are simply indescribable. The pilot and staff were super friendly too.

Clay, (the pilot) was very professional and a most excellent pilot as well as tour guide. Highlight of my stay, and I will be telling all my friends that this is a must do on their trip to Alaska! Pictures never do this tour justice! You have to experience it!  Russ H.
My family really enjoyed flying over Denali and landing on the glacier was a super cool experience. I highly recommend it!
We don’t normally splurge on something like this but it was soooo worth it! We live in Alaska and these views were the best we’ve ever seen.

review_title: Got to see the royal Mt. Denali in full sun!!
review_text: Family owned business, while it was cloudy on the ground a pilot went up to see if there were any views. And there were and we went up with 8 other folks, it was one of my nicest trips by plane. Ground Services nice and down to earth, can recommend

review_title: Talkeetna Air Taxi trip is a PROFOUND EXPERIENCE
review_text:
This flight is something one should do at least once in a lifetime.  It is life-affirming, life changing in a way.  Highly recommended and my son and I so appreciated Pilot Paul's mastery of both flying and storytelling.  Can't wait to go again, soon!

Mark in Montpelier, Vermont
We booked this after a local recommended we tour the mountains by plane. What good luck. The pilot was excellent. Very knowledgeable and helpful. If you want to see Denali, this is the way to go!

We booked this for a few friends. While the price seemed high, it was definitely worth it. The flight was maybe a little over an hour. The views were beautiful and we got some great pictures. The pilot was very friendly and even helped us take pictures afterwards. The flight was comfortable and overall an amazing experience. Would highly recommend.
This was truly one of the most amazing experiences we have ever had. Our pilot, Leah, was amazing, and it was a truly unforgettable experience.

We did a winter explorer tour, the only one available in winter. Since it is just my husband and I, we upgraded our ride to a helicopter. Paul, our pilot is experienced and very knowledge about the area. We did hit a bit of turbulence so be aware if you have motion sickness.
Staff is very friendly and the drive to the location is actually en route to the drive from Anchorage to Fairbanks. So if you are planning to drive from Anchorage to Fairbanks, you can squeeze the trip along the way!
The staff were terrific and the scenery gorgeous. Felt like I was "in" the mountains. Its a rare and unique experience to be close up in such a breathtaking landscape
Best glacier landing experience during the fall season. Visited during October for northern flights but got to know the winter explorer is open. This was once in a life time exp for us

So smooth. Plane and pilot made us feel safe. 
The views of the mountains were what you would expect from National Geographic documentary. 
Spectacular! If I had only one activity to do during my vacation, this would be it.

Ok, ladies and gentlemen… this tour is an ABSOLUTE YES during your visit to Alaska. I am not much of a plane trips lover and I was doing this one mainly for my hubby… and I can’t stop thinking about it!!
