It was one of the most incredible things that I have experienced… We flew in between layers of clouds, we flew into a valley between vertical cliffs and made an incredible U-turn at the end of the valley, we witnessed amazing views during the whole flight…
« Wow » is the best description of this experience! Don’t miss it!!

Words cannot describe this experience.  Absolutely breathtaking and worth every penny.  The staff and pilots at TAT are friendly, professional, and incredibly knowledgable.  Would 100% recommend this trip to visitors and locals alike!
If you are in Alaska you have to take his chance to fly and see the mountains face to face. Awesome experience landing and enjoying the glacier for some minutes.

review_title: Great trip and will do it again!
review_text: Spent time with my 14yo son in Alaska for his birthday. I decided to use Talkeetna Air Taxi on a friends recommendation. We were not disappointed! The staff was friendly and knowledgeable and just overall great. The pilot Andrew let my son sit in the co pilot chair. We/He won’t forget it anytime soon.

TAT proved to be a very professional organization with safety as their top priority. We felt very comfortable. All employees were enthusiastic and knowledgeable.  So refreshing to see people that do not seem to have "job burnout". You would never know our pilot does same flights several times a day for several years. Wonderful experience,  it topped off our vacation to beautiful Alaska.

I was leary of the glacial landing-It was wonderful-so smooth. I highly recommend it.  The views are spectacular! everyone had their own window. Fresh snow the day we went. We were given rubber covers for our boots. The takeoff was so fast. Our Pilot was very informative. One of the highlights of any travel experiences.

review_title: flight around Mt Denali with glacier landing
review_text: We had a crystal clear day, with 2 feet of fresh snowfall on the peaks, and the trip was spectacular. Our pilot was a great source of information and details.  I loved every minute of the trip.

I had taken my identical twin sons to Alaska for their 30th birthdays, and booked a fight with Talkeetna Air Taxi for a flight into Denali National Park. The pilot was simply superb and very prudent in showing us so many of the natural wonders of Denali's landscape. We flew around Mt. McKinley and actually landed in the Ruth Glacier, where the air is the purest you will ever experience. With headphones on so we could his description of numerous formations and landmarks, the quality of the 1.5 hour flight was positively a trip of a lifetime.
Tom H.-Birmingham AL
TAT provided excellent service,  The pilot was an experienced  professional. The glacier landing was exceptional!

review_title: Amazing, once in a lifetime flightseeing trip!
review_text: This flightseeing tour with subsequent glacier landing was one of the coolest things I have ever done in my life, and one of the few activities where the views and experience is worth every single penny. Captain Andy was both professional and jovial, and had nothing but wonderful things to say about Talkeetna Air Taxi - you could definitely tell he loves his job! On this flight alone I took nearly 500 photos, so that alone should tell what a phenomenal trip we had. Cannot recommend this flightseeing tour highly enough; there was literally no negative element of the trip, from start to finish.

Excellent communication and organization.  Had to fly the "low show" on our glacier landing flight due to low clouds.  Did an excellent job of showing all that could be shown, much of which we wouldn't have seen on the higher trip, and we were able to sneak in and land on the glacier.  We got a partial refund because it was the "low show" without even asking.
The whole crew at TAT is amazing! They go out of their way to make an amazing experience for all their guests!

Thank you Talkeetna Air Taxi for taking us on such a memorable trip. Their professionalism and prioritization of safety and experience above money was evident in every interaction we had with them. They pushed back our takeoff multiple days in a row due to inclement weather. And I couldn't be more grateful that they did! Once the sky was clear enough we had epic views on our flight, punctuated by a surreal glacier landing (highly recommended). I would advise that anyone interested in flying into Denali provide themselves with enough flexibility to stay in or around Talkeetna for a few days to make it more likely that the weather will cooperate - you won't regret it! We felt safe as could be with our pilot, who winters as a university professor in Florida, at the controls. What a day!!!

review_title: We are coming back for another flight !!!
review_text: This was our first trip to Alaska, won't be the last.  We flew into Anchorage then drove to Talkeetna the next day to meet some friends staying there.  We fell in love and stayed there the rest of our ten day trip.  One of the highlights of Talkeetna was our flight tour around the magnificent Denali mountain and the glacier landing!!  Not to be missed !!!  Words just don't describe the feeling walking around on a glacier between the mountain caps. We'll be back next summer for another trip !  Thank you!

yes, it's expensive; just do it!   As everyone else said, it was THE highlight of an awesome trip to Alaska!  Quick and efficient booking and check in (Call in to book for AAA savings!)  upclose views of Denali and several other peaks, topped off with a glacier landing!

review_title: An amazing experience worth every penny
review_text: This flightseeing excursion was INCREDIBLE. We had great weather to see Denali and do the glacier landing, and it is absolutely worth the extra money to do the glacier landing instead of just flying. The employees were efficient, helpful, and professional, our pilot friendly and capable, and the experience start to finish was 10/10. I would, without hesitation, book this again.

We (wife and two young kids) had a fantastic time using the Talkeetna Air Taxi service. They were courteous, professional and helpful. The pilot was knowledgable about the area and went to good lengths to ensure our comfort and making the visit memorable. They were flexible about the payment for the glacier landing as the weather was Iffy during most part of the morning. We were delighted however at being able to land and enjoy the breathtaking views of the glaciers in the Denali National Park.
Absolutely recommended. The best. Got to see the mountains up close and personal. Landed to fresh snow!

The stars all aligned when we booked our flightseeing tour over Denali with Talkeetna Air Taxi. The weather was beautiful with clear blue skies. The staff were all friendly and helpful and our pilot Sean was exceptional!! This was definitely a once in a lifetime experience and highlight of our Alaska trip!

The flightseeing tour with glacier landing was a definite highlight. Our initial flight was canceled due to weather but TAT was great to work with to find an alternate date. It is wise to schedule your flight date early in your trip to allow for cancellations.  Leanne, our pilot, was the best!!! An unforgettable experience for sure.

We went on two flights. The first was a low altitude flight due to the cloud cover on Denali. A few days later, we were able to take the Grand Denali Tour. Both flights were outstanding. The scenery was spectacular and combined with a Glacier Landing, it doesn't get much better than that. Thank you Talkeetna Air Taxi.

This was our second year in a row to see the mountains with Talkeetna Air Taxi- service is stellar.  They are super well organized.  When our trip was cancelled due to the weather, they quickly made arrangements for a different day.  We were glad to have the flexibility and even more glad to be on this trip.  It was great.

review_title: Very friendly crew and cool scenery
review_text: The entire crew at Talkeetna Air are extremely friendly and professional.  Had a great tour of some glaciers in the mountains.  Only wish we could have seen Denali on that day!

We took the flight mid day in September and had Tim as our pilot. He was very informative in his descriptions of sights and handled the takeoff and landings, tarmac or glacier, of the plane very well. Next time we’re in Alaska we are considering a helicopter ride!
Just an amazing experience! Leeann was an awesome pilot and guide. Vistas were other worldly. Landing on the Glacier was absolutely incredible. Well worth the money.

If you want to see Mt McKinley like it should be seen this is a must do! Mother Nature blessed us with clear skies and a sunny day. Andy was our pilot and he was awesome. He was very informative the whole trip. Do yourself a favor and book a trip today!

This was expensive and worth every penny.  A friend recommended that we splurge on this activity and I wouldn't trade it for the world. The safety and customer service were excellent.  We never felt rushed, got great views, and the entire experience was thrilling.  Don't hesitate... do this.

Wow. Wow. Wow. Viewing Denali and other majestic peaks, with a glacier landing to the south…words are inadequate, you just have to experience it. Our pilot Chris gave us an unforgettable perspective and also really impressed us with his knowledge of glaciers and mountains and the forces that shape them.
We had a gorgeous ride to Ruth glacier. We were able to land and see so many glacial features of denali. It is expensive, but worth every penny. You won't regret going.
This was the best part of my Alaskan trip.  Amazing people who provide an experience you will never ever forget!

Recommend booking early in your trip in case of needing rescheduled. We stayed in Talkeetna on a Saturday night for a Sunday morning flight. Our flight was canceled due to weather and rescheduled to the next day. So we had to drive back from anchorage Monday morning as there were no rooms in Talkeetna Sunday night. 

It was so worth the 2nd drive up to Talkeetna. We had good weather and awesome views! An experience of a lifetime.

Everything about this glacier tour and landing was absolutely perfect. We were thrilled to ride in the de Haviland Otter with pilot Sean. What a day!  One of the pilots was overheard saying they wait all year for a day like that.  Clear, no wind and the Alaska Range showing off in all its glory - chief among them  Denali. Great service and flight.

Awesome tour, all should take this tour. We were lucky to see Denali up close. We were worried due to rain perhaps clouds will cover the summit. But we were able to...
The Pilot was very nice and he let me take a picture with him

review_title: Amazing flying next to the mountains
review_text:
The flight seeing tour was one of the highlights of our Alaska trip. The pilot was great, he navigated very well. He flew very close to all the peaks and more than the glacier landing it was flying next to the ice clad mountains that was exhilarating. 

The pilot landed us at a nice spot and we spent about 30 mins on the glacier. The overall tour was very well managed. We had an 18 month old with us and they were kind enough to give ear covers for her as well. 

Since it gets quite noisy in the flight, our child didn’t enjoy the flight too much but she had fun on the glacier.

review_title: Beautiful Denali view and great service
review_text: What a great experience! My friend was hesitant and we ended up talking with one of the employees on the phone for quite a while before booking our flight—a shout out to Amy who eased my friend’s fears and gave us such personal attention! We took the 90-minute tour with a glacier landing, seeing both sides of Denali. It was a fabulous sunny day with an astounding view of Denali. Love that we had a female pilot with 18 years of experience! The takeoffs and landings were incredibly smooth, including the glacier landing. All around a fabulous experience, would highly recommend!

It was amazing in every way possible!! We booked at a kiosk in town with an employee that was very knowledgeable and super friendly. When we arrived at the airport the team was ready for us. Every seat in the plane was a window seat. The views were amazing. The pilot was super friendly and informative. Loved every minute!

review_title: Awesome flight and landing on glacier
review_text:
We had an outstanding afternoon spent flying around Denali in this beauty of a plane!
Our pilot was fantastic!  We were given lots of information about the area and the glaciers before landing on one!  The teens loved it and took tons of photos.  The pilot let my husband sit up in the co pilot seat when he realized that he is a pilot also!
Great day!  Would highly recommend!

Beautiful, smooth flight to see the Great One, Denali!  Loved the flight and expert descriptions of what we were seeing, the climbing base camp and routes to the summit.  Very cool to land on a glacier and take off!!!  Very well worth its!

review_title: Once in a lifetime experience- do it!
review_text: Awesome and COOL!!  I can't remember the James Bond movie where he lands on a glacier or mountain and then they had a shoot-out on the way down the mountain.  That's what I kept thinking about when we landed on the glacier.  You take a plane up and tour the mountain top then you land and walk around on a glacier.  The rock structure and views are amazing.  If you can afford it, do the tour and land on the glacier for some great photo opps.
The Denali flight seeing and glacier landing w/ pilot Alan was superb! I had an incredible experience veiwing all closely by air!

I took this flight seeing tour/glacier landing in July 2021.  We saw and did many wonderful things while in Alaska, but this tour is over the top and worth every cent.  We were one of the 30% that could not see Mt. Denali  while on land because of the cloud cover, however, once we were up above the clouds there she was in all her glory with not a cloud to be seen, only bright blue skies.  The sight was breath taking. Our pilot (I believe he was the owner of TAT) never rushed us while we were on the glacier as all the passengers  took hundreds of pictures and just basically walked around on the glacier in awe. I have gushed about this tour to anyone in Michigan that will listen. I would not hesitate to book with Talkeetna Air Taxi again!

Amazing experience.  It was our first trip to Alaska and the flight was the highlight of our week.  We were able to land on the south base camp glacier.  We had plenty of time there to take in the surroundings.

This was the best of a two week trip packed full of activities in 5 different areas of Alaska.  This was the best, top of the tours! We were luck to get a clear day and a great pilot guide!  Will was our pilot. He told us what we were looking at along the way and flew that little plane like a well seasoned pro.  The views from the plane were amazing!  We felt like we were right next to these high peaks. I don't usually leave 5 stars because face it there is always room for improvement.  I was amazed and very happy with the service!

Worth every penny! 

My husband and I brought our 3 children aged 13, 16, and 20 on a flight which was supposed to take us sightseeing through Denali and land on a glacier.  The weather was sketchy, so the pilot decided to cut it a little.  We were able to go up and see the Denali peak and land on a glacier! 

It was a magical moment in life! Every one had a great time.

I recommend this company wholeheartedly, every member of the staff was professional and friendly.  Our pilot was fantastic and let my pilot husband sit as copilot for our return.

The flightseeing tour was great! We had planned to do the Grand Denali tour with glacier landing, but due to weather conditions we could only do the Southside Explorer tour without the glacier landing. Talkeetna Air Taxi had great customer service. They gave us the option to cancel with a full refund or reschedule for another day. I appreciated their flexibility. We decided to go for the 1hr tour anyways. The views were breathtaking! We got to see the mountains and Ruth glacier up close and personal. It was definitely worth it! If you get the chance, weather permitting, I would recommend going for the glacier landing and Grand Denali Tour. That's what we'll try to do again next time.

This was the most awesome experience of a lifetime actually seeing stuff from the top of the world the glacier landing and walking was outstanding I would do it again in a heartbeat.  If we would not have done this we never would’ve been able to see Denali as we’ve seen it. I highly recommend it

review_title: One of the highlights of our trip to Alaska was the Summit tour with glacier landing with Talkeetna air taxi
review_text:
Our time spent with the folks from Talkeetna air taxi was the highlight of our trip to Alaska. I would strongly recommend to anyone out there planning a trip  to this great land to include this in their memories. From the young lady that checked us in. To the pilot that personally narrated our tour and gave us some views of Denali and the surrounding area, that we will remember for a lifetime, 
One thing I would recommend though is if you have flexibility in planning your trip watch the weather a few days before hand and contact them and maybe try to reschedule for a different day or different time. The day that we were scheduled to go was supposed to be cloudy I contacted them and they were able to move us up one day. It worked out perfectly!
Remember, only 20% of the people that visit Mount McKinley a.k.a. Denali, actually will be able to view it, so pick your day and plan your trip around this great excursion!

Breathtaking!  If you get a chance, do it.  The views are amazing.  The pilot was awesome and full of knowledge.  I would recommend Talkeetna Air for this trip.  I can't say enough about this trip from everyone from the desk to the pilot.

review_title: Soaring through the clouds was spectacular!
review_text: This was the most exceptional experience my family had while in Alaska.  There are not enough adjectives to describe the trip.  The pilots are all IFR certified and are extremely safe.  Leeann was our pilot and she was personable and simply wonderful in every way in addition to being a fantastic pilot.

Due to cloud cover we could not land on the glacier the day we flew.  However, the flight was amazing, our pilot was fantastic and the staff very friendly and professional.  Unbelievable views, a once in a lifetime experience!

We had the most amazing flight with views of Denali. The pilot was very informative and kept us safe and explained everything that was going to happen. We landed on the glacier and was it was an extremely emotional feeling. I got some amazing pictures and will do it again on another visit to Alaska. We were lucky because the nexf flight out was not going to see the summit of Denali.
It was the best activity we have done ever. We can see the denali summit from the plane. Glacier landing was the highlight.

Flew around many rugged mountains and did a perfect landing and takeoof on glacier. Our pilot was Alex who pointed out many points of interest and added some history. Recommend this for families. Great time with Alex!

Our tour was an incredible experience and I highly recommend the summit tour with Glacier landing. It was by far the best way to see the mountain peaks and the vast beauty of Denali. 
Our pilot, LeAnn was professional and knowledgeable. She made the experience memorable by sharing information about what we were seeing along the way. It was the highlight of our time in Alaska.

Though TAT doesn't *need* more praise, my experience with them was simply so phenomenal that I have to give them yet another Excellent review. This is a top-notch company with some of the best pilots in Alaska flying the best aircraft for this kind of excursion. They are safe, prepared, and professional. I am a pilot myself and had the opportunity to sit in the right seat during the flight up - our pilot, Chris, was kind enough to talk me through his checklist as he fired up the turbine Otter for our flight. Plus, Alaska's weather cooperated and we had an absolutely STUNNING, gorgeous day for mountain flying. This experience was worth every penny.

We flew on the Grand Denali Tour with Glacier Landing on July 10 and it was spectacular!  The glacier landing really adds to this experience and is well worth the extra money.  
Our original flight was scheduled for July 9 but the flight was cancelled due to weather.  Be aware that this may happen (and after a 2 hour drive from Anchorage, wasn't fun but we went on an awesome hike to Reed Lakes instead on the drive back).  Talkeenta Air Taxi was very accommodating on trying to reschedule us and gave us a partial refund as some in our group couldn't make the next day. 
If you are in Alaska don't miss this experience!

Wow, what a breathtaking experience to be able to see DeNali up close from the air. Our pilot Chris did a great job flying above the smoke and haze that obscured the mountain from view from the ground. He was also able to land at the Ruth Amphitheater for more magnificent views. Highly recommend!

review_title: Flight around Denali and landing on a glacier.
review_text:
This was the highlight of our trip to Alaska.  The scenery is breathtaking and the glacier landing is really fun too.  Our pilot (Alex) had tons of experience (thousands of hours flying these types of flights) and made us feel safe.  He also shared lots of interesting facts about Denali and the glacier.  While this is a bit expensive, it is definitely worth the cost.

BTW, the funky little town of Talkeetna is a lot of fun too.  Sort of like a ski town from the 1950s.

If you drove up to Talkeetna from Anchorage, take the Hatcher Pass on the way back.  It will add about 45 minutes to the trip, but it is totally worth it.   Don't worry when you get to the part that is unpaved, it is very smooth, safe and well travelled.

Fantastic flight! Everyone from start to finish was great. Beautiful views and amazing flight. Pilot adjusted the flight so it was as smooth as possible while still getting close to the summit, seeing everything, and landing on the glacier. Great experience and great team!

review_title: Up close and personal with Denali summit
review_text: Are you thinking about spending the extra money for the summit tour with glacier landing? Do it! Otherwise, you may come to AK and never see the summit of Denali, due to cloudy weather and other flight seeing tours not going as high! Plus, it’s an opportunity to get up close with the summit. Our pilot, Alex, did a fabulous job of flying us around the mountains and the glacier. I highly recommend you use Talkeetna Air Taxi for a flight seeing tour.

Definitely a unique experience to land on a glacier.  Pilot experienced but down to earth and pleasant.  Awesome is a word that fits when you are flying over Denali and landing on a glacier.  Efficient and pleasant staff who seem happy to be busy again after covid shutdown business last year in Alaska.  Doing the glacier landing was definitely worth the extra money.

review_title: Felt like a scene from an action movie!
review_text: Totally worth it! We were concerned about the price since we were already spending so much money in Alaska - but we were so glad we did it to see Denali and the surrounding range from a unique vantage point.

We took this flight before visiting Denali National Park and are so glad we did! We were fortunate to have a clear enough day and a skilled pilot to get us great, close-up views as well as a glacier landing! There is no better way (besides possibly climbing it) to gain an appreciation of this mountain! It was an excellent experience!

We were staying in Palmer and started the drive to Denali. Got as far as Talkeetna and decided we just didn’t have it in us to continue the drive. Stopped at Talkeetna Air to see if by some chance there was an opportunity to see the mountain Denali. Weather was iffy but we scheduled a flight for 4:00. God blessed us with enough clearing to get the go. This journey became one of the highlights of our vacation. The views are breathtaking and awe inspiring. This is the best way to see Alaska. Our pilot was knowledgeable and thoughtful and told us all about what we were seeing, a little history and backstories as well. He answered questions and you could tell he loves his job.  The summit of Denali peeked through the clouds for us so the goal was met.  We did the glacier landing which is just another world altogether. Beautiful doesn’t begin to cover it. Would do it again in a heartbeat.

review_title: Mountain explorer with glacier landing July 2021
review_text: I booked this trip at the last minute as we were driving up from Anchorage and were not sure if we could make it. I got a discount and the whole experience was very smooth.  The place is easy to find. lots of parking and bathroom facilities on site. The pilot was young but experienced for over 10 years. Pointed out several peaks and glaciers on the way, made loops so that both sides of the plane were exposed to what he was showing. The glacier landing was amazing. Got plenty of time to take pictures. I definitely think that the landing is worth the extra cost.
This trip was awesome, we got great pictures. Denali was breathtaking. We loved walking around on the glacier. Our pilot did a great job

We were blessed with a clear day for our flight.  Alex was our pilot and I was able to sit in the co-pilot seat.  The views we had were amazing because it was so sunny and clear.  Alex described what we were seeing as we flew over the rivers and by Mt Denali.  We circled the mountain but he took care to make sure both side of the plane were able to see by circling back several times.  We had a very smooth flight and our landing on Ruth Glacier was very smooth.  I was in awe of the beauty we had from the air.  I would highly recommend flying to Denali and the glacier landing.

review_title: Amazing "Bucket List" flight and landing on Ruth Glacier
review_text: My wife and I checked off a "bucket list" item by flying with pilot Andy Young and Talkeetna Air Taxi and landing on Ruth Glacier in Denali National Park.  Although the day was overcast and prevented us from seeing the summit of Mount Denali, we were able to land on Ruth Glacier.  The snow was pristine as we were the first flight to land on the snow that fell the night below.  Andy flew the de Havilland DHC-3 Otter with great skill, banking both ways to permit all passengers to get stunning views of the glacier and surrounding mountains.  It was an experience we will never forget.  I encourage everyone who travels to Alaska to make this a MUST DO activity!  You will not regret it!

There is a reason every review is 5 stars. I have done quite a bit of exciting and amazing things and this was easily a top 5 all time. The views and experience are unreal. You MUST do the optional glacier landing. You will learn a great deal and see Alaska from a different perspective.

This experience was beyond anything I could have imagined. Our tour was shortened and altered due to weather, but they still made it unforgettable and satisfying (as well as refunding the difference). The pilot pointed out the features below and gave us some good info as well. The mountains are gorgeous and awe-inspiring beyond anything I've seen in my wide travels. Seeing Denali was mind-blowing and almost sacred.
Couldn't recommend them more. You get pullover boots for walking on the glacier to keep from soaking shoes, and it wasn't cold on the glacier, and just a bit chilly in the plane. A light jacket or sweatshirt should be good enough on a sunny day.

What a wonderful experience not to be missed. Our pilot was amazing and we learned so much about the mountain and the surrounding area.
Add this adventure to your Alaskan trip!

We had an amazing time with Talkeetna Air Taxi. All 10 of us fit on one plane, and our wonderful pilot Chris even let someone sit in the co-pilot’s seat. We were in the air for about half an hour until we landed on Ruth Glacier. We were up close and personal with Mount McKinley. It was the most incredible experience, and while it was very expensive, I do believe it to be worth the money. Chris was a wonderful captain and made us feel very safe.

review_title: A once in a lifetime experience! Splurge on a BIG tour!
review_text:
If you are looking for a once in a lifetime experience, you've found it! I went on the Grand Denali 2-hour Grand Denali tour and have not stopped thinking about the journey. My friends and I saw all aspects of Denali, guided by the steady, calm, cool, and collected hand of our pilot Paul. He narrated our sights and knew every nook and cranny of the Alaska Range. Just the flight was worth every penny, but then YOU LAND ON A GLACIER!  Just incredible!  Think of every superlative, wrap them in a bow, and you start to get the idea of what it's like to be on a glacier surrounded by the Alaska Range mountains. This memory is forever written on my heart. I can't recommend it enough!
Tips: Wear sunglasses - it's bright!  Wear bright clothing so that you pop in pictures (don't wear white or black). Pack lightly - all you need is a water bottle and a camera (you and your things are weighed before getting on the plane). Bring a mask - required for the flight, but not outdoors.

We were planning our 2nd trip to Anchorage and this time our plans were to go North.  I found Talkeetna Air Taxi and decided the South Side Glacier Landing flight was for us.  The team was spectacular from scheduling and providing information and the day of the flight.  The flight itself was beyond amazing.  Breathtaking views, walking on a glacier and seeing Denali from a one of a kind perspective.  I STRONGLY recommend this adventure and this specific team if your travels bring you to the Denali region.
Alex was an outstanding pilot when we  circumnavigated Denali at  12,000 feet. Landing uphill on the glacier at base camp was exciting. This made my trip to Alaska more memorable than I expected.

This is an incredible experience. We were blessed with 3 days of the mountain being "out" and took full advantage of the fact with a great flight. We saw some of the most beautiful mountains and glaciers in the world for sure. TAT is simply the best at what they do. Thanks to Annie and the rest of the staff for an awesome experience. Our pilot was Chris and he was great. Plenty of information and communication an when we will turn the plane so everyone can get pictures etc...

review_title: Worth it at twice the cost
review_text: Everyone we dealt with was phenomenal, the flight was comfortable, and the views were unsurpassed. Cannot recommend this enough.

From the check-in with weighing (with no smirk from agent), to fitting on the complementary booties, to the safety briefing by Captain Chris, to the smooth flight with knowledgeable comments by the Captain, to the perfect landing on the Great Gorge of the Ruth Glacier, to the on glacier experience and smooth return to the airfield, they were all part of a great experience.  As a former Airline Captain I think I know a smooth safe operation when I experience it.  I  recommend this trip highly.

I was fortunate and was able to occupy the right seat in the cockpit.  If any pilots sign up for this trip, beg, borrow or steal to get this seat!

We did not get the experience we booked. The cloud cover and fog prevented us from seeing Denali and landing on the glacier. Those were the top 2 things we booked the trip for. BUT...they did take us up on a shorter trip that was still amazing AND refunded the difference promptly. I believe they did the best they could do considering circumstances beyond their control.  What more can you ask for? I recommend this company 100%. They are organized, care about the experience and the safety of their guests. The operation was well run and worth the cost.

What an incredible flight. Lucked out with blue skies and a few small clouds to help the pictures. Pilot was very informative and made sure everyone had a good view no matter which side of the plane you were on.Highly recommend the glacier landing to have the complete experience.

Glacier landing was amazing.  I was terrified of this adventure I am not one for small planes or heights.  Our  pilot was so great (Stan).  From take off to landing it was the smoothest ride ever.  Landing on the Ruth  Glacier was by far one of the most beautiful things I have ever seen.

review_title: Chance of a lifetime....Do Not Miss This
review_text: Weather was a factor in being able to take the extended tour to fly over the summit or to land on the glacier.  Obviously we were pleased they cared for our safety not to attempt something that would put us in danger.  Since our stay was limited we were please with the offer to show us what they could at a significant discount.  It truly wasn't a disappointment with what we did see.  It is stunning.  Well worth the going out of your way to get to Talkeetna. When we landed to my surprise, my Fiancée shed tears of joy about the trip and I received an email with the credit already refunded.  We will do this again some day.  Great customer service and awesome experience. Thank you for the experience.
Great service. We got lucky with weather. Friendly staff and pilots. Also close to downtown Talkeetna.

Hubby and I debated spending money on this, esp including glacier landing. SOOO GLAD we did!!!  we only had 2 nights in Talkeetna so scheduled 11 am 1st day to give us a 2nd day possible reschedule buffer if weather not good.  on our drive up to talkeetna they called to tell us 11 am was cancelled, but wondered if we would be open to a 6 pm as they thought weather might open up ... and it did!!!  they normally do not stay open that late but they sent out 3 planes at that time.  Our pilot was amazing & I was lucky to sit in cockpit on the way out and watch him brilliantly fly it.  Ride was smooth and views unforgettable (glaciers, hikers at basecamp and on the mountain, and, of course, Denali and all of it's beauty).  Got to see another plane land after us on the glacier, and witnessed small avalance while we were out on the glacier.  We have travelled many places and done many adventurous things, but personally this ranked at, if not the top, of things we have done.  If you are blessed with the weather to allow this, just do it.
Once in a lifetime! The trip was amazing and we got to see the climber summiting. Landing on Ruth Glacier was like another world. The pilot was really nice and I felt safe in this hands.

This was by far the highlight of my Alaska vacation. It was spectacular, and our pilot Tim was fantastic. Make sure to bring cash to tip your pilot!

The glacier landing was definitely worth the extra $$$.

I'd the say the most important thing about this flight (aside from safety) is the weather.   The weather on my flight was perfect which made our experience perfect. I spoke with someone else who said their flight (through another company) was disappointing because they couldn't really see anything due to poor weather conditions.

Mike, our pilot, was very knowledgeable and friendly. We felt safe flying with him. He provided explanations along the flight and while on the glacier. Landing and taking off from the glacier was an unforgettable experience. If needed, boots are provided for walking on the glacier. The check-in experience was efficient.
From online scheduling to in person service our family could not have asked for a better experience.  It was outstanding!

My family is so thankful and excited to have gone on the Denali flight and glacier landing with Talkeetna Air. They are a very oiled machine (literally) and have thought of everything. The pilot was skilled, experienced and super friendly. We had a 10/10 weather day so the views were amazing. Definitely do the glacier landing if you have the time.

The view was spectacular!   Our pilot did a good job telling us what we were seeing and landed us on the glacier where we had plenty of room to explore! We were allowed time to get plenty of pictures and walk around. Definitely worth our time!

review_title: Whatever you do - DON"T MISS THIS!!!
review_text: If I had to choose only one thing from our trip to Alaska to tell friends that they must do - this is it!  PAUL is an amazing pilot.  We landed on a glacier and it was so stunning to get out and walk around.  Words will never express how amazing this trip was.  We did the Denali and glacier landing trip. From the moment you enter the Talkeetna Air Taxi you know that everything is done well.  I felt safe every moment.  This is an adventure of a lifetime and I am so glad I trusted Talkeetna Air Taxi with this.  We would 100% do this again.  WOW! and THANK YOU!

This was such an amazing experience and one we will remember for a life time. No need to check out any other company reviews, just book this now. The flight from the landing on the glacier was amazing and I’d highly recommend this trip.

Every aspect of the trip from booking to the experience was amazing!  Flying between the mountains where you feel like you can reach out and touch them is an exhilarating experience.  Actually landing on a glacier and being able to get out and walk on it was unbelievable!  Our pilot, Mark, did an excellent job.  I felt safe the entire time and would highly recommend this tour!

What an amazing experience! My husband was terrified to go on this tour, but our pilot, Leighan, made him feel totally comfortable. She was super friendly, knowledgeable, and knew what she was doing. The views were absolutely incredible! This was the highlight of our  Alaska vacation and highly recommended to all.

We were blessed by perfect weather and the flight was bucket list material.

We were able to seen the mountain clearly and the walk on the glacier was great

Our pilot was informative and approachable. This cost a lot but was worth it.

review_title: Amazing 2 hours at close range with Denali
review_text: We did the Summit Tour on June 5, 2021 on the most clearest of days at the Summit, and what an amazing day.  Truly a trip highlight.  Our pilot did an awesome job of ensuring us the best views.  We were blessed to see climbers about to summit Denali - something I will never forget.  The glacier landing was terrific - in a new spot that I had not been to before.  This was truly one of the best parts of our trip to Alaska during our 3 week visit.  To see Denali this close up with incredible.  Kudos to Talkeetna Air Taxi and our amazing pilot.

My family and I chose the Grand Denali flightseeing tour with the glacier landing and our experience was spectacular! Their customer service was stellar.

We originally scheduled a flight in 2020, but covid travel restrictions kept us from visiting. TAT was very kind and flexible in issuing us a full refund and allowed us to later reschedule the flight for 1:30pm on June 5, 2021. 

Weather reports were showing threats of thunderstorms in the afternoon on June 5, so I contacted TAT to see if they would be able to bump our flight to earlier in the day. They were more than happy to reschedule our trip for 8:30am to avoid the weather at no additional charge. Because of that, we had amazing views of Denali and the surrounding area. Highlight of our trip to AK.

Overall, these people are so kind, professional, and accommodating. They went the extra mile when they could. Highly recommend them.

Great pilot and the glacier landing was incredible. Couldn't ask for a better experience. They were very helpful in giving us advice on how to dress, and for anyone who wasn't prepared, they provided anything needed.

review_title: Once in a lifetime view of Denali National Park!!
review_text: Very exciting and once in a lifetime experience! Our pilot was amazing! He circled around the peaks allowing both sides of the plane to see. This plane ride provides stunning views of the Denali Mountain and adjacent peaks! The glacier landing was really neat, we were surrounded by mountains, and even saw a small avalanche!! This is great if you want to see mountains up close!
Very well run operation and they were extremely accommodating.  Regardless of the flight option you select, the glacier landing is an absolute must- wow!

We had booked the summit Tour with glacier landing but unfortunately due to bad weather, the plan was cancelled and we instead did the south side explorer. The experience was great overall. The views of the mountains and the glaciers is next to none. We were disappointed not to do the glacier landing. However, we got refunded promptly from TAK. Definitely recommend the flight-seeing tour.

Exceptional service. Staff considerate, safety conscious and professional. Flight was a cloudy day but our pilot Chris did his best to show us the valley and the mountains and Denali. Would highly recommend this trip.

review_title: Amazing trip with sights and scenery you cannot find anywhere else!
review_text: 43 years ago I climbed Denali and had not seen it since. Took the summit tour to see it all again and so glad we did. Incredible views and such a compete perspective that you can only get by air.  Absolutely stunning scenery of this amazing mountain and so good to see it from all sides.  The Muldrow is surging in 2021, something it's not done in 64 years! Our pilot was great, very smooth flight, glacier landing, good explanation thoughout.  Very, very pleased with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Good hint: volunteer to sit up front in the copilot seat - best view and fun!

We came here to see Denali via air taxi. We came prepared to be wowed and WOW! we’re we ever! Our pilot, LeAnn, was awesome and explained what we were seeing through the intercom. The flight was smooth and uneventful. The views were stunning. We highly recommend this trip!

Went up with my dad over Spring Break and had the chance to do the Glacier landing which was absolutely incredible!  Our pilot Paul was very friendly and told us all about Denali and the glacier as we flew overhead. Really appreciated all the scenery and the day we went up was incredible!

Definitely worth the trip and the glacier landing, we were thinking about skipping it but it was definitely worth it!

This was my third time using TAT for climbing/skiing support in the Alaska Range and, like the previous experiences, they did not disappoint. Their knowledge of the range and current conditions are always reliable. I will continue to fly with them on future trips!

AWESOME TRIP!

Very professional and commitment to safety!

Neat landing on the glacier and seeing the scale of the mountains up close !!

Definitely worth the $$ and memories!!

This was an absolutely amazing experience I would recommend to anyone visiting Talkeetna in the winter. It is truly unforgettable. The Alaska range is indescribably beautiful, and this tour takes you right into the heart of it. The staff at Talkeetna Air Taxi were very welcoming and helpful in ensuring the tour would run as smooth as possible.

Friendly and accommodating staff and all star pilot made for a Denali flight I’ll never forget. Talkeetna Air Taxi have an impeccable safety record and it shows. The pricing as absolutely fair for this kind of once in a lifetime experience. Highly recommend!

We are VERY glad we went with Talkeetna Air Taxi. Yes, the mountains and the landscape are amazing, but our enjoyment would not have been the same if not for this company. First, they had the best price we could find. However, we found that to simply be a bonus, because we had an friendly & intimate tour that was all made possible by Leigh Ann. Her love of the landscape was infectious, and we really couldn't have dreamt of more. No doubt, this is the company to use.

It would be hard to overstate how incredible this trip was. My boyfriend (visiting from Massachusetts) and I (living in Kenai, Alaska) keep saying it was the coolest thing we've ever done. Pilot Clay was kind and enthusiastic, and the views were out of this world. Best part was we got to land on the glacier, which we hadn't even signed up for, since the weather was so good. An experience so wonderful it was truly out-of-body. Would pay twice the price ($250) for how good it was. And I definitely recommending going when we did — in the off-season, cold but not too cold, lots of snow on the mountains. 10/10!

We had an amazing experience on our flightseeing tour! We called frequently in the days leading up to our tour to make sure we selected a time with weather as good as possible. They were very communicative and helpful, and even moved our flight time from 3p to 12:30p on the day of (luckily we were there during the off season, so there was some availability still!) Our guide, Leanne, was so nice and informative, describing exactly what we were seeing and where we were going. She also has been a pilot for many many years, which was very comforting.  Also, our guide wore a mask on the plane and all passengers are required to do so as well.
We had originally signed up to do the glacier landing, but unfortunately, it was too windy and landing was not safe. The company automatically issued a refund for the glacier landing portion of our flight, no work on our part. 
I 100% recommend this tour to anyone visiting Talkeetna. This was our first time in Alaska, and the flightseeing was the highlight of our trip.

You cannot go wrong snagging a flight to the Alaska Mountain Range and Denali up close. While it seems like a scary thing to do, I felt safe 100% of the time. The reward was the closest views of the mountains you'll ever have. spectacular. Andy and Clay were great pilots. Cannot wait to return!

Eric, my son, Tina his wife, and I were happy that we had added a Talkeetna Air Taxi flight that included a glacier landing to our itinerary. That flight was awesome to Mt. Denali, the tallest mountain in North America. I felt as though we had landed one level shy of Heaven -- total silence, pure white snow with diamond crystals, the bluest of skies, white fluffy clouds. The only words I could utter were "Thank You, God".
Top thing our teens did. Professional and thorough. Highly recommended. We were lucky to get an upgrade but no matter what you book you’ll love it.

What an amazing day!  All I can say is wow, wow, wow.  It was a windy day and a glacier landing was cancelled but the pilots called an audible and found a location for us to land and it was simply incredible.  I can’t say enough about the experience.  The views of the mountains were amazing and the pilot was very informative.  If you’re considering this company I highly recommend!

I've been to Alaska many times, my mom is even from there, but had never been able to take a tour like this! I took a trip with my best girlfriends and decided to treat them to the best AK has to offer (which isn't difficult), so we chose Southside explorer with a glacier landing. Long story short, this tour is the most incredible experience I have ever had in my entire life, HANDS DOWN. Not only were we lucky enough to get a full view of Denali in the early morning, but we had an incredible flight, and wicked cool pilot (Lianne), and an absolutely breathtaking time on the glacier. We couldn't be more ecstatic about this tour and have kept talking about it ever since! Will be HIGHLY recommending to anyone and everyone who wants to see the most beautiful state the way it's meant to be seen- by air! Thank you so much TAT!

My Dad and I spent 10 days in Alaska in July 2020.  We rented and RV and headed to Denali National Park from Anchorage.  We took the bus tour into the park.  Unfortunately, the weather was overcast and we never got a view of the mountain.  The remainder of our trip was to be spent on the Kenai Peninsula.  We stopped off in Talkeetna on the way back and we pulled into the Woodpecker RV park there.  The owner was excellent and recommended Talkeetna Air Taxi for an air trip.  We scheduled the next day.  This company was amazing.  The plane and the pilot where top notch and this was the highlight of our 10-day Alaska trip.  We had amazing views of Denali and landed on a glacier.  I've travelled extensively, and this was one of the most beautiful sites and adventures that I have ever done.  I strongly recommend scheduling with Talkeetna Air Taxi.
Amazing! Fling through the peaks around Denali and topping it off with the glacier landing was incredible. A memory i'll have with my family forever.

The third week of July 2020 we scheduled a flight with a glacier landing. I called prior to our trip with questions and the front office was patient, helpful, and assured us if either because of Covid or weather we had to cancel it would be no problem. The day of our flight it was cloudy in the valley but beautiful up on mountain and we had a spectacular flight. The flight and the people were excellent.
Our group of 8 booked a glacier landing on Denali. Awesome experience with a knowledgeable pilot. If you want to truly experience Denali, you have to do this flight!
Was in Talkeetna on the fourth of July, took the flight onto the glacier.  The entire experience was absolutely wonderful.  Fully recommend to everyone!

Everyone was wonderful especially our pilot. If you are going to spend the money make sure to do the flight with the glacier landing. This was an experience of a lifetime.  Our pilot went above and beyond, no pun intended, She was determined to have us see the summit if at all possible in spite of the clouds rolling in. Well she did it, although it wasn’t a lot or for long, we saw it and what a treat to have extra time on the glacier, maybe because we were the last flight of the day but I say because she is awesome and loves what she does and you can see that she love sharing her time and knowledge.  I highly recommend and I would definitely do it again!!!!

This is a "must do" event in Talkeetna. Everyone at Talkeetna Air was great to deal with - friendly and very informative. The views of Denali and surrounding mountains were spectacular! Just incredible to be that close to the mountains. The glacier landing is a wonderful addition, being able to land on the glacier and experience the climber's base camp area.
Beautiful scenery and the glacier landing was worth it. Great pilot. My family and I loved everything about it!

When we got to the airport, the weather was "iffy", and we were told that we might not see the top of Denali, or might not be able to land on the glacier.  We decided to take the chance.  Well, as we flew, the pilot let us know that the clouds were cooperating.  We saw stunning views of the mountaintops, and were also able to fly low and even land on the Ruth Glacier next to the Sheldon Chalet.  Our pilot was very knowledgeable about the area, and the plane was awesome.  I would fly with these guys anytime.  The experience was just phenomenal.
An Alaska must see. Our pilot was very knowledgeable, was patience and made the sight seeing a once in a lifetime experience.
The trip to the glacier was spectacular as were the views of Denali. Great being out on the glacier, too!  I strongly recommend this trip and this provider.
Our trip was the best thing we did on our 14 day stay in Alaska.  The pilot was very knowledgeable and the flight was majestic.  You MUST do this if you are visiting.

I have traveled with TAT in many capacities: planes landed on the Ruth for a personal ski trip; fly-overs with guests for flight-seeing; landing on the Kahiltna for both work and for personal climbing; and helicopter drop-off for work. In all capacities they are friendly, professional, safe, and easy-going. Their COVID precautions are appreciated. These long-time Alaskans are the real deal. There's no one I'd rather fly with!

Wow.  The Mountain Voyager Flight with Glacier Landing was a 10/10.  It was nice having the extra 30 minutes to spend in the glacier, take photos and for the kids to play in the snow.  The pilot was a cool dude.  Amazing Experience flying over the Alaskan Range and seeing Denali up close, can’t think of a better way to see Denali NP

Because of clouds, we knew we would have the only chance of seeing Denali was by airplane.  Our pilot was so informative and did an amazing job of making sure all of us passengers got to see everything he was pointing out;  It was incredible to see all of these huge mountains and then see Denali.  oh WOW!  Thank you for a wonderful experience!

review_title: Must-do if you are visiting Alaska!
review_text: The flight was amazing. Leighan was absolutely incredible. Between the wonderful staff, perfect setting of beautiful Talkeetna, and the Denali wildnerness, this flight was one of the best experiences of my life. Highly recommend!
Wrangell SE is massive and flying over  it for 70 minutes only covers a small but incredible area. Great pilot and a lovely day.

My girlfriend and I spent two weeks traveling throughout Alaska, and this was the highlight of our trip (it was even better than catching a 60lb halibut in Prince William Sound). We lucked out with amazing weather, and very clear views of Denali. We're from Colorado, and we've experienced great views atop 14'er peaks, but everything is bigger in Alaska! Denali dwarfs the surrounding 14'er peaks, and it makes for a very humbling experience flying from 300' above sea level to the base of Denali in roughly 25 minutes. My girlfriend is a nervous flier, and our pilot made her feel extremely safe. She explained that she is a mother and she had been flying since she was a kid. It instilled a soothing sense of anxiety relief. The plane seated 10 persons total, and it was a very smooth flight. The plane had modern avionics, and it was very clean. Both these factors lead us to believe the plane was well maintained and safe. The glacier landing was well worth the upgrade cost. It made for a great photo opportunity. The shear rock faces double those of Yosemite, and the deep blues on the glaciers cannot be replicated through photos. Our pilot was knowledgeable of the geography in the area, and the flight path enables great views for passengers on both sides of the plane. 10 out of 10 would recommend!

The staff and pilot were so kind and attentive to us. We had the most amazing flight that words cannot express, simply stunning views. I had been working with one particular staff member who kept me updated with adjusted schedules due to COVID. We made this trip with friends and family and I was planning on a second flight with another son arriving the following day, working with the staff to make this trip as wonderful for him. Heavy rain prevented us from doing the trip but we will do it again. Thank you Talkeetna Air staff...you made a memory for our family and friends we will never forget.  Nor the kindness you extended to us!

This flightseeing tour is a must-do! I am an Alaskan and have flown a lot around the state in small planes. I was blown away by how beautiful this was! Our pilot was skilled, chill, competent, knowledgeable, and easy-going. The plane was larger than I expected and the ride was sooooooo smooth! I highly recommend TAT.

review_title: Excellent air taxi. The tour guide was enthusiastic and entertaining. I would recommend to others. Coach Rumley
review_text: The experience was excellent. It was my first time in Alaska. The tour guide was great. Coach Rumley

This was the absolute highlight of our trip.....the inside booking staff was incredibly friendly and the trip itself was fantastic. The only area of improvement I would look at would have been the pilots service. He was very safe and a fantastic pilot but he wasnt overly friendly and we felt very rushed when we got to the glacier...even though we were the only plane there...we just felt rushed. We undserstand that we traveled during the fake COVID pandemic timeframe but we had masks and headsets on during the plan ride and there was no way to have a conversation and ask questions so the ride was awkward as pilot really didnt give much information. I think if it had been under normal circumstances I would have easily given 5 stars.

During these uncertain times, Talkeetna Air Taxi was spot on about carrying out the COVID-19 mandates but still providing a life changing experience. The staff was exceptional and our pilot was the owner and thee best. Our take off was so smooth that we didn’t even realize we lifted off. Paul was informative about pointing out highlights along our trip. I have never taken a flight sight seeing tour and if I could make you understand how worth it this was.. this is my plea. It took my breath away. It’s definitely bucket list material. I didn’t know it’s what I always wanted. 😆🏔❤️
our third flight to denali. it was truly special today. talkeetna air ALWAYS makes this special. wonderful service and friendly personnel.

We recently took a flight seeing tour over Denali National Park and it was definitely a highlight of our trip! The views were incredible and we got to see not only Denali in all its glory, but also so many other views that were equally as stunning!  The tour was just the right amount of time to enjoy the park at just over an hour!  Our pilot, Leeann, was so friendly and knowledgeable of all the different parts of the range. If you have to opportunity to take this tour, you must!

The entire flight experience was superb from the wait to my flight and landing!! The office staff was fun and inviting! Hung out with them and the chillest cat around. Their random break out in song and dance and friendly conversation really helps calm the nerves!! The pilot was great as well!! It was a little windy and bumpy but with a stable voice he guided us through the mountain ranges. Dropped knowledge about the local frontier life and land marks. They made the call to push back our take off time due to winds, but it let the mountain open up to spectacular views. Trust their calls. It will be totally worth it.

review_title: Denali is spectacular.  Pilot was superb.
review_text: Talkeetna is unique and as much a part of the visit as flying around Denali.  Walk and see every part of the town.  Stay in a B&B.
Even though we had white out conditions and couldn't land on the glacier the flight was still amazing going though several granite canyons.  We will definitely be back to do it again.
The pilot was so accommodating to my wife.  She made sure she had a great view when we landed  on the glacier.   This flight was the highlight of our Alaskan trip!!
I’m an outdoorsman, I’ve done some hang gliding, caving, rock climbing, rafting and kayaking. This was better than all of that especially landing on the glacier

review_title: Best part of our Alaska Trip!!!
review_text:
Wow! That’s what this entire experience was.

Our tiny female bush pilot could land a plane on a dime on a glacier with 6 feet of snow on it... having never landed on it before. That’s piloting!!!

This was an experience of a lifetime. To land on a glacier in a small plane on skiis was epic. The main landing spot on Denali mountain was not available due to weather, so they offered to take us to an alternate mountain glacier. There was absolutely no lack of amazement because of the change in plans! Even our service dog came along and ran around on the glacier. 

If you do nothing else on your Alaska trip, do this one thing. The glaciers are disappearing, and being on top of one first hand is an ethereal experience.

Pre-planning excursions conditional on weather is a risk. Accepting this allowed the experience w/Talkeetna Air Taxi to go so much smoother. Yes, our original glacier flight was cancelled. Highly recommend to leave room in itinerary to reschedule. Because we had room in our travel itinerary, we flew next day.  Due to first snow... we were unable to land on Denali, but our pilot gave us an awesome flight and beautiful visual show! The customer service provided was priceless. Providing all information up front regarding options. We flew not knowing what we'd see, but knew pricing would adjust accordingly. When I return... I will fly Talkeetna again for that glacier landing!
Intimate view of the Denali Mountain range. One of the most fantastic experiences & worth every cent.

review_title: Excellent flight, could not land due to conditions.
review_text: We had a wonderful flight around the beautiful mountain, day was excellent and so was the time we spent during the flight.  Missed being able to land but certainly out of anyone's control, they were taking care of safety.  Thank you so much
This was the highlight of our Alaskan vacation. Amazing views and perfect landings. Bring your sunglasses. They provide covers for your shoes to walk on the snow. Worth the money.

It's a memorable ride. I really appreciate the pilot, he was managed very well. I was amazed with scenic views.

Thank you.
This was one of the coolest experiences I’ve ever had. Flying through snowing mountain peeks and cliffs was mind blowing. This is a must do when in Alaska!

a once in a lifetime experience!!!
waaaaaauwwwwww!!!!
i would recommend this to everyone who wants to see Denali up close!!!
go go go !!!!

review_title: Review of Talkeetna Grand Denali tour
review_text: A magnificent tour of the Denali peaks! The staff was informative, friendly, and accommodating. I loved the flyovers around the peaks and glaciers and the glacier landing was spectacular!! A very memorable experience!

review_title: Best thing to do in Alaska
review_text: amazing staff and just all around an amazing experience. Must do the landing on Mt. Denali. It is a great way to spend the day.

What an incredible experience.  The entire tour looked like things you only see in magazines.  Matt was our pilot- he was super knowledgeable, friendly and safe.  It was breathtakingly beautiful to see those huge mountains up close.  Hard to imagine people rock climb and hike those mountains.

Flying around and landing on Denali was incredible.  My daughter enjoyed frolicking in the snow on the mountain.  The colors in early September are gorgeous.  Takeetna Air Taxi was fast and efficient getting us ready for the flight.  The pilot was very well seasoned and used to the terrain.  Would go again!

review_title: Incredible Denali flightseeing and glacier landing
review_text: Our party if 6 booked a Mountain Voyager flightseeing and glacier landing tour on our last day of an Alaskan vacation. We definitely ended on a high note. Clay did an outstanding job as pilot and narrator on our flight. We had great views of the 3 major peaks and many glaciers. But the best park was the glacier landing. We were very lucky with the weather because the next three days were forecasted rain. If you get the chance to go, I highly recommend taking this tour.

review_title: Great views of Denali and its glaciers
review_text: Lots of fun and way too many pictures flying with Rick in the Cessna.  Great angles of the peaks and the wonderful glaciers.  Great experience

review_title: Denali Flight See and Glacier Landing
review_text: I did the the Mountain Voyager with Glacier Landing with Talkeetna Air Taxi on September 7. It was the most amazing flight see I have ever taken. The scenery was spectacular - Glaciers, Mountains and Fall Colors in the foothills. The flight was smooth and the pilot superb and very knowledgeable and truly loved what he was doing., This trip is not to be missed and I will do it again the next time I am in Talkeetna.
We got an upgrade for free. I totally recommend it. One of the best experiences I ever had. Absolutely fantastic.

We were in Alaska from Aug-31st to September 8th and we were hoping to have clear sky for doing a Glacier landing. We told the same to Talkeetna Air Taxi on day-2 of our arrival and they made it in giving us the best experience of Alaska in the best weather conditions. Must do activity in Alaska!!

PS: you will be disappointed if you are hoping to see Glaciers while you are in Denali National Park.

review_title: Awe-inspiring flightseeing with glacier landing, and heli-hiking
review_text:
Alaska is awe-inspiring no matter which way you turn, but our flightseeing trip with a glacier landing with TAT in Denali National Park was a once-in-a-lifetime experience. The group included our family of 3 plus 3 other passengers. Our pilot provided information about the aircraft as well as the geography, and pointed out specific rivers, glaciers and mountains as we flew among them. He also pointed out several of the camps for the climbers and rangers on Denali. The vantage point of flying through mountain passes and around peaks was breathtaking. It seemed as if you could reach out and touch the rock faces despite the fact that they were miles away. Landing on the glacier at over 5000' elev. was incredible. Amazing to think we were standing on many feet of snow and a couple thousand feet of ice. It was so quiet and peaceful in the bowl where we landed and we felt so small among the towering peaks.
We also took a TAT helicopter for a heli-hiking trip into the Talkeetna Mountains. It was amazing hovering over the rivers and lakes and the tundra, spotting a moose, and landing in the high country for a guided hike. Everyone at TAT was welcoming and professional. We highly recommend them.
just amazing with glacier Landing at the basecamp, nice weather, perfect Crew, stunning views of mt mc kinley

review_title: Most exhilarating experience of my life
review_text: We flew around the tallest mountain in North America and landed on a glacier! It felt like we were on another planet. We walked around and took lots of pictures-surreal. It was a little scary flying so close to the mountains but what an adventure.
Excellent flight - brilliant view despite the weather - again anytime - was worth every Penny - smooth landing

Wonderfull experience!! Landscapes we never saw before. Moneye is whorth and the stuff was yery helpfull. tolle Erfahrung und unverhessliche eindrücke - sehr zu empfehlen- auch bei etwas wolgigem Wetter - im Gegenteil, der Eindruck ist noch besser. Man muss nicht ängstlich sein. Alles ist sicher

We booked Mountain Voyager Glacier Landing tour, but unfortunately on the day of our tour they said they cannot land on glacier due to weather conditions. However, they were happy to reschedule us for next day (weather forecast showed sunny for next day so better chances of landing) flight. The staff is super friendly, our pilot Andrew was awesome and very knowledgeable about the area and glaciers. Highly recommend TAT for flight seeing/glacier landing tours.

Tip: If you really want to do Glacier Landing, check for weather forecast before booking and keep your schedule flexible for +/-3 days so that you have much better chances.

What a fabulous trip of a lifetime! Our pilot Alex was top notch!  The trip was very smooth & the views were unbelievable. Take the glacier landing tour, there’s nothing like it. This company is the best.

review_title: These folks go the extra mile
review_text: We were in Talkeetna specifically to go on a flightseeing tour, and of course, the weather wasn't co-operating.  We tried to go 5 different times over three days.  These folks called us and said they were probably going to be able to get up on the third day.  We went and it was fabulous!  Alex, the pilot, was great, with his descriptions of everything and it was a fairly smooth flight (I am not a great small plane passenger).  The office staff was attentive and helpful.  All in all, it was a fantastic experience and we would go on another flight-seeing with them..

The pilot really made the viewing of Denali even better as he planned the route around clouds to give us the best possible views, explained not only the different peaks, but pointed out the various glaciers, rivers, trees and vegetation. He answered questions and was wonderfully informative.
I was initially doubtful about doing this thinking whether it might be up to the hype. Just do it cause it was. 5 starts from me.

Possibly the most epic experience of my life to date.... really words cannot even describe this experience.   If you do Alaska without flying around Denali and landing on a glacier,  then you haven't done Alaska.

review_title: Landing in the Glacier was the coolest
review_text: Had a really good time flying with Alex and we got to land on the glacier which was a treat. Recommended for anyone visiting Talkeetna or Denali and got some time (and money) to spare.
Check one off of my bucket list!  It was spectacular - the flight, the landing, and walking around on the glacier.  Definitely a must-do!
If you get the opportunity to take this flight and glacier landing you will not be disappointed. Unforgettable!

Wir hatten 3 Tage auf die Grand Tour gewartet bis endlich das Wetter gepasst hat…. es hat sich auf jeden Fall gelohnt. Da bleibt einem wirklich der Atem weg. Leider war eine Gletscherlandung nicht möglich, da nicht genug Schnee liegt.

Our flight around the Denali mountain was awesome.  We were supposed to be able to land on the glacier but was not able to do that at no fault of Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Well worth the expense & the trip.
Thank you to our pilot.

I was impressed with the enthusiasm, communication, and problem solving of all of the women who worked the desk. My Summit flight was cancelled because not enough people booked it, but they explained what other options I had, given the rainy weather.  I decided to wait until the next morning, and they were going to get me to the train on time, but then that flight had to be pushed back and I would miss the train to Denali Park. I asked if they knew of any other ways to get to Denali and they put together a van service for me so that I could do it all.  Chris, the pilot was very relaxed; comforting as we flew so close to the peaks, and had the occasional bumps.  His narrative was wonderfully informative.  The views were overwhelming and stunning.  I have climbed many peaks, internationally, and was blown away by the views of this trip.  So good.  Yes it is expensive, but don't worry.  It is very much worth it.

review_title: Flight Seeing Adventure - not to be missed
review_text:
Our family of 7 had an excellent time.  With our pilot (I believe his name was Mike) giving us a detailed description of everything we were flying over - his expert knowledge and skillful flying we had an awesome adventure seeing Denali and the surrounding mountains.   The views were breathtaking.    I recommend this company to everyone.    Everything was very professional - from the booking to the entire flight.    
An experience of a lifetime.
It was sad we could not land on Ruby Glacier, but it is One of the best things I have done in my life. Just to fly around the mountains with all the Breath taking views.
We had a wonderful time on our air tour around Denali.  Our pilot was very informative.  The views were breathtaking on a super clear day.

What an amazing experience! 
We had an easy check in
Such an amazing pilot - flying and guiding the tour
ultra 5 stars all and all

review_title: 1 Hour Southside Explorer flight seeing tour
review_text: We felt fortunate to have excellent weather and an experienced, informative and fun pilot. The flight exceeded our expectations.

With Clay as our pilot our family of 5 had an amazing tour of the Alaska Range!  Even got to see Denali! Felt very safe during flight. Clay was very knowledgeable!  Couldn’t land on glacier (which we hadn’t been told until checking in), but that turned out to be all right.

We were very satisfied with this excursion.. I think people should know up front when booking this that you do not land on glaciers in August.. We should not have been sold a flight that landed on the glacier when it was evident in August that was not possible..
We had a wonderful trip to view Denali. The pilot was very informative and accommodating making sure everyone got great views!

We booked Circle, Dinali and land on glacier. The day we scheduled is the only day we could go. Due to weather conditions we are unable to circle Denali or land on the glacier. We were offered the best they could offer - to fly toward Denali.  We went with their offer.  We flew out under the clouds and then above the clouds to see the top of Denali.  We’re often asked what’s the best thing we did on our Alaska trip.  My wife and I both agree their flight seeing tour was the best. We had a fantastic trip.  You will see so much more from the air and I highly encourage you to take a flight seeing tour.
A fabulous experience. 1 hour flying around Denali and the surrounding glaciers and mountains. Wonderfull.

A flight to the highest peak in North America will change your life. Professional. No pressure. Knowledgable pilots. Even on a cloudy day, we landed on a glacier in the snow and felt entirely safe. Beautiful. Do. It.

review_title: Amazing once-in-lifetime bucket list quality experience with a friendly, experienced and professional company
review_text:
Three families with kids - teens as well as younger ones, were eager to see Denali peak. We had 2 cancellations on a chopper landing in glaciers due to bad weather so we were really skeptical about this.
Not only did Talkeetna Taxi have a very fair price, but the pilots were so amazing - they explained all of the little details of the Denali mountain range, including the various glaciers, history and spots of the climbers, base camps, sheldon’s Chalet, etc.. 
the view of Denali mountain from the plane was scintillating. 
The pilot even warned us of air pockets so we could adjust - 2+ hours of wilderness at its best👍👍👍
The plane ride was very smooth and the view was breathtaking! I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi for your Mount Denali exploration.

I was extremely lucky due to the excellent weather and visibility.  Although the plane could not land, the pilot was extremely cooperative and showed us a great time on air.  We made rounds so each side of the plane could enjoy all the great views. Everywhere I looked was a picture perfect frame.

A colleague said it was worth the money to do a flight-seeing tour around Denali and he was right. Staff was friendly and knowledgeable. Beautiful views of the mountain that you cannot get from the ground.

We were amazed by the vast expanse of the Alaska range.  It is something one cannot effectively describe with words and pictures.  We wish we would have been able to land on a glacier and look up at the mountains from the base.

My wife and I drove to Talkeetna and heard there was a flight adventure trip over Denali offered by Talkeetna Air Taxi. We booked our time and when we got there the staff was friendly and check in was easy. We boarded a new Otter bush plane and took off on a flight around Denali and back. It was EPIC and the views were insane. If you are debating taking this flight, do it, we are stoked we did.
Matt our pilot did a great job this was the highlight of my trip would recommend them as a must do did several figure eights around the mountain narration was good knowledgeable of the trip

Didn’t really want to do this but turned out to be the hi light of the entire Alaska vacation. It was like being in an imax movie except live. Great pilot. Nice staff. Left my glasses on the Plante and someone ran out to find them👍👍👍

Nous avons fait le tour Denali Grand, au lieu de Summit dû aux nuages au sommet du mont. Vraiment impressionnant! Malheureusement, nous n'avons pu atterrir sur le glacier. La saison étant bien avancée, la qualité du glacier n'était pas optimal pour un atterissage sans danger. Nous avons volé durant un bon 2h et si près des parois! Notre pilote, Andy, nous donnait beaucoup d'informations et était d'agréable compagnie.
Amazing, once in a lifetime way to experience Denali. Pilot was great and provided insights about the region.
Our flight see was our favorite tour in Alaska. Our pilot LeeAnn (sp?) was outstanding - her flying expertise & as tour guide.

This was the second time I have used TAT. These folks are the best in the business. Friendly, extremely knowledgeable, highly professional, and worth every penny. The office staff was the best.  The pilot/narrator clearly had a vast knowledge of the terrain, the history, and the best viewing areas in and around Denali. Very smooth and safe flight. Can’t wait to go again someday soon.

Talkeetna Air Taxi provides a great service at a reasonable price. The staff are friendly and very knowledgeable. They were honest about the conditions and what we would be able to see. The pilot was great and went straight to the view of Denali before the clouds covered the peak. At the time I didn’t realize how amazing the flight was, but the next day when I was reviewing my pictures I realized how amazing that trip was. 
If you are looking to see Denali and the glaciers throughout the mountains then choose this company. They will do everything in their power to show you all that Denali and surrounding mountains have to offer.

This was our first Alaska vacation. Talkeetna air taxi scenic tour of denali mt. Mckinley was superb experience. We were late and they waited for us. We are so thankful. We made it to flight before too late. The pilot described all key details while flying the plane over the might 20000ft glacier mountains. 100% recommended.
Great service and wonderful flight. Friendly and professional. Incredible views of Denali. Not to be missed.
Great Tour at a great price. They were very accommodating to make sure we saw Denali. Our pilot went above and beyond to ensure our trip was amazing!

The Willow area was going through severe wildfires which fortunately were under control. People lost homes so I cannot complain that the smoke haze was still in air.  Matt got us above the smoke level at 7000 feet and we had a great view and amazing trip.  Talkeetna cannot guarantee your view but will make sure you have the best possible and safest experience.
What an amazing experience.  I HIGHLY recommend these guys.  It’s worth every dime!   Great customer service.  Shuttle pick up.  Amazingly talented pilot.

Plane, pilot, ground crew were all amazing! Wanted to do a glacier landing but was unable to due to drought. We never regret doing the summit tour in place of that as it is an amazing view!  Highly recommend!!
Trip was beyond words.  Pilot was excellent.  Landed and took off from a glacier with ease.  It’s the best way to see Denali.

I had gotten a recommendation to take a Talkeetna Air Taxi flight on my trip to Alaska just before I headed on my trip, and I'm so glad I did!  What a wonderful experience!  From the friendly staff to the competent & engaging pilot, and the INCREDIBLE views!   Thoroughly enjoyed every bit of the flight- Stunning mountain views and our pilot, Andy, was a wealth of information on the areas we were flying in.

Picture perfect day to take a flight around Mt. Denali and experience a glacier landing and takeoff. The experience is tremendous and the mountains phenomenal. Our guide, Leanne, was awesome and a really skillful aviator. You’ll remember this excursion forevermore.

review_title: Volo sul Denali e atterraggio sul ghiacciaio
review_text: Al ritorno dal Katmai, ci aspettava una giornata con un sole splendido, e perchè non fare un giro attorno ai ghiacciai del Denali, visto che all'andata il tempo era pessimo. Così siamo partiti per questo volo fantastico, con viste mozzafiato ed infine atterraggio sul ghiacciaio con sosta sulla neve. Il volo si è completato girando attorno al Denali, cosa non sempre possibile.
