Starting with the booking of the flight until the farewell, we felt like a member of the Talkeetna Air family. Very friendly and professional staff. During the Flight we get a lot (not too much) of interesting information’s about the region and the mountains. Always in best memories and a Must to do with Talkeetna Air.
The views from the plane were great and the pilot was super friendly.  Highly recommend the glacier landing, its breath taking!

review_title: A 16-day trip to Alaska and Yukon
review_text:
A 16-day trip to Alaska and Yukon.
The flight over the mountains in Denali Park was wonderful.
The weather was nice actually.

Great experience flying from Talkeetna to view several glaciers, and snow peaks, carefully noting clouds and finding opportunity among them for a brief, safe landing on Glacier, followed by takeoff.  Expert 'questions and answers' commentary by pilot Andy, all passengers with window views.  Lots of room on the glacier, yet shortest takeoff we've experienced.  An accomplished outfit.
it was an experience!!!  the 2 hour tour was fantastic and the place where we jumped out on the plane was monumental!!

Friendly , helpful staff that is anxious to please!...Great Trip!  
I recommend this for everyone visiting the 49th State.

After spending 2 weeks on a land tour/ cruise combination in Alaska, I can say that the best excursion we chose was the Talkeetna Air Taxi trip around Denali with glacier landing. We did not plan to do it originally, but decided at the last minute. The experience was way beyond expectations. Our pilot was in constant contact with the office and other pilots to help find the smoothest airspace. The landing was flawless. The views from the plane were spectacular and walking the glacier was magical. We were picked up at our restaurant to take the flight and driven to the bus depot after the trip. It may be a bit pricier than other things you can choose to do, but this one is totally worth it.
Had a great trip, should have been Danali park, but due to weather, we went South, which was just as great.
Talkeetna Air is the best, first class all the way!  A must do trip for anyone visiting Alaska!! It is an awesome experience for all ages!
If you're in the area, don't miss this, it's well worth the price! Go for the glacier landing package, you won't regret it!

We used Talkeetna Air Taxi for a Grand Denali Tour.  We arrived and the staff was great to make us feel welcome and comfortable.  A camera and sunglasses are a must.  Our pilot Andy did a wonderful job making sure that all sides of the plane got to see the views and explained things as we flew.  We got to see a rarity - an avalanche.  I couldn’t take pictures fast enough.  Andy allowed us to enjoy the beauty of the mountains, but provided a climbers perspective as well.  A bucket list trip!  So very glad we did it!

I can’t say enough great things about the TAT Team. Their friendly professional style was consistent from the time we scheduled our flight to the time we left with our souvenirs. The flight itself was awesome. I was most impressed with our pilot who negotiated an overcast to give us the very best views of the lady and her neighborhood. Landing on the glacier was spectacular, a peak life experience and one that I’ll never forget. Even though the Otter is large enough to hold 10 passengers plus the pilot, the aircraft seemed so small in our surroundings. Thank you for everything!
Circumventing Denali by plane was fantastic!  Loved the glacier landing.  Our pilot offered great info and insights.  Highly recommend.

review_title: Most spectacular scenery, and fantastic people!!!
review_text: We looked forward to this experience for a long time , so when the day arrived and the Alaska Range was closed to flights we were heartbroken. However the great people at Talkeetna air taxi allowed us to reschedule not only once but twice till finally it cleared enough to fly in. We were able to see the the most beautiful scenery in the world and having the experience of landing on a glacier in the midst of those otherwise inaccessible peaks was a highlight of our trip to Alaska.
Professional start to finish.  The staff was friendly and the pilot was knowledgeable. Flight was smooth - felt 100% safe at all times.
Everything was perfect. The weather cooperated, so the views of Denali were spectacular. A must have experience for all.

Incredible flight and trip.  Recommend scheduling with a fall back day later in the week.  Original day flight was cancelled.   Returned three days later and had absolute perfect weather, blue skies.   Worth the effort.   Company was first rate with us
We had such a great experience with Talkeetna Air Taxi. Highly recommend. Our pilot,Chris, was top notch!

Seeing Denali from the air really give a sense of the gigantic scale of these mountains.  Landing on the glacier was an incredible experience.  Large windows in the plane gave every passenger excellent views, and our pilot was friendly, knowledgable, and clearly loves his job.  I would recommend this trip to anyone.

review_title: Once in a left time experience!
review_text: The flight through the snow covered mountains at Denali was the most amazing experience and the one thing that stands out among all our Alaska travels. The glacier landing was also spectacular.. we enjoyed the commentary from the pilot and felt reassured by TAT flight safety record. Awesome!

We had the luck of landing next to Denali on a beautiful clear day. It was the experience of a lifetime. The staff was very helpful and kind and our pilot was awesome. Thank you so much for the experience.
Whatever you do, fly Talkeetna Air!!!  Great service, great flight, great pilot, amazing views of Denali and more.  Well worth the money!
The flight was the highlight of our trip. Everyone with Talkeetna Air Taxi made the experience super enjoyable. I highly recommend them!

review_title: Great service from beginning to end with beautiful scenery.
review_text: From the moment we walked in the door to after we left our flight, the staff was awesome. Everyone smiled and answered questions. My son and I took the Mountain Voyager flight with the glacier landing.  The skies were clear so we had spectacular views of Denali and the surrounding mountain range. Flight was easy and the glacier landing was smooth. Great time...thanks to this professional staff who understands customer service. Highly recommend them

We were in awe the entire time.  Mounts Denali, Foraker and Hunter rose above the clouds.  Saw the Ruth Glacier at the source 5 miles across and almost 4000 feet deep from the source to the glacier melt streams and rivers.  Very experienced pilot and very knowledgeable.  Well worth the price.

On a scale of 1 to 5, this is worth a 25!!! Words cannot describe how majestic and gorgeous Denali is! And, if you’re lucky enough to get the “sports plane” of the fleet, you’re in for an incredible treat! Small, agile, with a terrific Pilot, Nick, you can thoroughly explore all the nooks and crannies, mountains and valleys, and be completely surrounded with indescribable majesty!!!! ...A great company with a truly remarkable flight tour!

review_title: Great Flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi
review_text: Booked a flight up to Denali for the Family. First class service from the get-go with booking online all the way to the end of the flight. If you are thinking of taking an air taxi tour, look no farther than Talkeetna Air Taxi! We will definitely be back!

This was incredible, amazing views of the mountain. It was raining during our original scheduled time, but we were fortunate that we were going to be in town for a couple of days so we’re able to reschedule, and they were great about that. It was windy the day we went, so there were some concerns about turbulence causing motion sickness (I’m really susceptible), but the pilot was great about staying out of super bumpy pockets of air. He also talked us through everything we were seeing, we learned a lot. Highly recommended.

We had been to Alaska 3 other times and have never seen Denali . . . So this time we guaranteed we would.  It did not look promising as smoke from the McKinley fire filled the air, but the employees felt certain it would be a good day to fly. 

Andy, our pilot, was quite knowledgeable about the area, and it was obvious that he is a skilled pilot.  He made sure to let us know when bumps were coming (when he could) or explaining what may have caused them.  I am not a courageous flier, so his reassurance helped.  I appreciated his commentary and his serious approach to the job.

We certainly felt like we got much more than we paid for on this flight.  I highly recommend this tour, this firm, and Andy.

Alex, our pilot, was excellent.  A smooth flight with amazing views!  The company was very helpful in determining a day & time when the flight would allow for good visibility considering the smoke in the area. Highly recommend.

We booked the 1.5 hour Southside Explorer w/Glacier Landing tour for 6 adults. We called Talkeetna Air when we arrived in Talkeetna. Because our train did not let us out at the train station there was some confusion as to where to pick us up. After a few phone calls we were picked up and taken to their office at the airport. When we went inside we were told the owner was checking the weather. They told us it would be too windy for the glacier landing. We could cancel the flight and get a 100% refund or get a 30 minute longer flight to the North Range. We decided to take the longer flight. Although we were disappointed that we did not land on a glacier safety is their main concern and we understood that. After paying the final payment we went outside to get our glacier boots, just in case. We walked to the plane and met our pilot. He gave us a safety talk and told us some things about the plane. We all boarded and biu on our headsets and seatbelts. The headsets did not have a microphone so we could not communicate with each other. We had a very smooth takeoff. The flight was very smooth except when we went over a mountain. Nothing to worry about. Flying over the glaciers and snow cover peaks is just amazing. It looks like you can reach out and touch them but the pilot said we were at least a mile away. After flying over the North Range the pilot swung around and took us over College Fjord. The cool thing about this was the day before we were in the fjord on the Golden Princess cruise ship. What a beautiful way to see everything!

review_title: A great way to photograph the glaciers and mountains.
review_text: We had a wonderful time on this ride.  Our pilot handled the plane expertly, smoothly ascending, flowing around the gorges and rock faces, and finally returning back to Talkeetna.
Well run operation with a great pilot, and a smooth flight. The views were spectacular and landing on the glacier was a unique experience. Our group really enjoyed this excursion.

review_title: Do the summit tour, its so worth it!
review_text: I had my doubts with the price point of this tour, but it is so worth it! Its unlike anything you've ever seen! It doesn't matter which side of the plane you sit on, the pilot zig zags through the air so both sides get awesome views of Denali and the neighboring peaks.  They won't fly on poor weather days so leave some flexibility in your days so you can do it on a good weather day.  Don't skimp, do the whole Summit Tour, its so cool!

We were unable to fly to Denali, after cancelling twice due to weather, and were offered a flight south over the Knik glacier and Prince William Sound.  Our pilot put us at ease, and gave us an incredible and smooth flight.  We got to see the mountains and glaciers from a new perspective, it was an awesome experience of beautiful terrain and water.  Even thought we didn't get to Denali, this was SO worth it!

review_title: Denali Glacier Tour with Glacier Lansing
review_text: I appreciated the time Talkeetna Air spent walking us through where we would be flying vs Kantishna Air flight we had scheduled for the next day.  The flight after taking both was so much more comprehensive than Kay Air. We were able to land on a glacier on Denali. What a fantastic experience.   Great experience. Highly recommend if you would like to get an up lose view of Denali.

This was a once in a lifetime experience and was worth every cent. The views were breathtaking and the pilot made us feel so safe. She told us everything she could about the area and even landed us in a unique spot on the Ruth Glacier that is only accessible for a few months of the year. After doing this once, I had to take other visitors so that they could enjoy the beauty!

We were due to arrive in Talkeetna in the afternoon, but knew it was a possibility that our flight would need to be changed or canceled due to weather.  Sure enough, we got a call that we needed to reschedule for the next day due to weather.  We were given a morning option or an afternoon option.  Thinking it plausible that morning cloud cover would burn off by the afternoon, we took the afternoon option.  The office called us the next morning and asked if we could bump things up and arrive about 1.5 hours earlier than planned.  We knew this was kind of the deal with flight seeing trips, so we rolled with it.  Very well run operation, in our experience.  Got super up close to Mount Foraker and Hunter and did the glacier landing.  Great views, with very good narration from our pilot (forget his name).  Family is still talking about it.  We did ATVs in Denali, rafting outside of Hope, a cruise of Prince William Sound and this flight seeing trip for our big days out, along with a bunch of hiking.  This was a big highlight of the trip.

This is an incredible way to see Denali!  We flew so close to the mountains that you felt you could almost reach out and touch them.  The sight of the glaciers took your breath away.  With our headphones, we could always hear the education we were receiving from our pilot.  This is a must see experience.
The pilot that we had was excellent. He gave us a really good tour of the mountain and the park. He flew us everywhere and seemed to know everything we were looking at down below.

I had such a great flight, a very skilled pilot (Chris)
thoroughly enjoyed every minute.. I never felt so safe...
the views were amazing.....Staff was outstanding..
A great ending to my Summer working in Denali, won't be able to top this!!

Lifetime experience,  it was not planned in our agenda but we were elated that we made it work. Everyone from arranging the telephone reservation to destinations to fly out we’re all very helpful and friendly

review_title: Stunning views of Denali glaciers, warm friendly professional staff.
review_text: Our trio were scheduled on another service the day before but bad weather cancelled the trip. We felt very lucky that Talkeetna Air Taxi could get us on a morning flight the next day: scheduling, pick up from our hotel, everything was super easy. They offered to upgrade us without charge, but as we didn’t have enough time to accept the offer they cheerfully gave us our shorter booked flight with a charming pilot, Will. He was happy to answer any questions and also to let us marvel at the view in joyful silence. We couldn’t have been more satisfied with how our Denali viewing flight w this team worked out.
Took the grand Denali tour with glacier landing. I highly recommend!  Michael did a fantastic job. Have us great information and amazing views of the mountains!  👍👍👍👍👍

LeeAnn (sp?), our pilot, was born (?) and raised in Alaska - she comes from a flying family - she has climbed the mountain twice plus taught survival classes - is very knowledgeable about the entire concept of Mt. Denali from it's beginning to it's current status as a marvel of mother nature - fortunately, we had flown with her before two years ago in the winter and were obviously impressed as we requested her again - and as before - we were not disappointed in the mountain knowledge and her piloting skills - the Talkeetna Air Denali tour has several options or tours to select from - personally flying the entire mtn. from top to bottom PLUS the Glacier landing is highly recommended - if cost is an issue, just remember - you're here to see the mountain and experience the wonder AND chances are you may not be able to return - think about it as a once in lifetime opportunity ............
Paul our pilot took us on an amazing flight.  We are so happy that we chose TAT for our glacier flight adventure.
GREAT.  Worth the trip to Alaska just for the flight.  Our pilot was over the top. Flying the canyons and along the glaciers and the sight of the old mountain was fantastic.
This was the best excursion of our vacation. It was truly awe inspiring! Every few seconds there was a new and unique sight. We took 100 pictures just on the flight.

Flight was fantastic.  Got up close & personal with the mountains.  Pilot was super.  He explained a lot.  Landing near climber base camp was a thrill.  Entire trip was a great experience.  Cruising speed was ideal for taking photos and observing. We highly recommend this experience.

Flight and Glacier landing was breathtaking, in a good sense. The staff were all super friendly and helpful. We loved every minute of it. Took the 2 hour flight. I felt like I would have preferred about 20 minutes less time in the air and 20 more minutes on the glacier. But It was the highlight of our Alaskan trip, no doubt. What an adventure!
This was our favorite experience, hands down!  Seeing the mountains that close was extraordinary and beautiful. A profound experience!
The best flight ride ever . The pilot was super nice and explained everything . He did amazing landing on the glacier .

Our recent flight to Denali was truly an event of a lifetime. Even though the upper mountain was in the clouds that day the scenery was incredible in every direction. This is an experience that everyone in our group felt was well worth the cost and not to be missed. Our pilot was informative, friendly and professional in every sense. This was a highlight of a 2 week trip to Alaska.

My husband and I were on the Mountain Voyager with a Glacier Landing tour, it was an experience we will not soon forget! From the ease of check in to the knowledge of the pilot Talkeetna Air Taxi was stellar.

Awesome--amazing.......flight was the best ever.  We were so close to the mountains and I was  taken aback at the beauty and power of those high hills.  Andy, the pilot was knowledgeable and shared immense information with us while flying.  Landing on the glacier was icing on the cake.  The smoothest flight I have ever taken.  Fun.....fun....fun!  I highly recommend this trip!

This was the first stop on my Alaskan vacation and it was by far the most memorable.  A Talkeetna Air driver picked me up in this picturesque town (think Northern Exposure) and dropped me off at the airport a mile away.  There I was greeted by a friendly representative who cautioned that the questionable weather could impact the views of Denali and the possibility of a glacier landing.  Lucky for me, Leanne (the pilot) assured me that we were going in the opposite direction of the the thunder and lightning.  Having donned the headphones hanging on the strap, Leann explained what we were seeing and the gave us an unforgettable tour. We flew around the Denali summit and came in for a smooth landing on a glacier where we took lots of pictures and videos.  I highly recommend doing this if you are anywhere near Denali.

Everything about Talkeetna Air Taxi oozes experience and professionalism.  From the initial decision process on which flight to take, to the actual flight itself, I could not have had a better experience.  Employees were knowledgeable, friendly, and helpful.  The pilot of our plane, Kris, provided a safe but incredible experience flying around Denali, and of course had a ton of interesting tidbits to add for everything we were seeing.  Upon asking out of my own curiosity, I also found out the plane was basically brand new.  If you have ever had any reservations with flying on a small plane, this outfit will inspire confidence.

We were fortunate to go up on a clear day - where the mountains were visible from the ground.  But there is still something totally awesome about being right there in the sky looking at the side of the mountain right out the window! If it is a cloudy day, you absolutely have to go up above the clouds to see the mountains - and the only way to do that is in a plane. The glacier landing is an extra fee, but it is worth it - you actually get to STAND ON the glacier and create a snowball from the glacier snow.  No worries - they provide over-boots so your feet stay dry and it is not frigid cold (we went in July) because of the nearness to the sun.  This was the highlight of our trip to Alaska!
Best view of Denali-ever! It just kept bigger and bigger until you are in the passes. Perfectly sunny day.
By far the best way to see Denali. Glacier landing is a must. Incredibly smooth flight and well-run outfit. Had a fantastic time and cant recommend them enough.
You cannot describe it, you have to experience it!!! Spectacular views, wild nature and landing on the glacier which is a must!
Wonderful - the highlight of our two-week trip to Alaska was landing on the glacier (basecamp) with Andy, who gave excellent commentary throughout.  An unexpectedly transcendent experience.
Amazing experience! We appreciate that our trip was rescheduled for the next day because of weather.
We took the grand tour which took us to view the summit. The aircraft was well maintained and the pilot was very good. He answered all our questions and gave us a good tour of Denali mountain range.
Amazing scenery and first rate personal service! Pilot was knowledgeable , experienced and attentive to all passengers. I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi!

Our pilot Nick took us on the trip of a lifetime!  He slipped past granite cliffs taller than Yosemite and over frozen rivers of ice grander than all of Glacier National Park. Our trip to land on the glacier was otherworldly and we ended with a flight out through a hall of mountains greater than the Grand Canyon.

My family and I had an amazing time watching the beautiful views from the plane and landing and walking around on a glacier. Our pilot was friendly and knowledgeable. The pricing was better than than other outfits I considered. I’d recommend Talkneeta Air Taxi to anyone and everyone.

We did this on July 22nd evening and had Andy as our pilot. The pilot is your 1-man crew. Good landing & nice sights. Just when we were ready to leave, it started to rain & thunder, so we got lucky with timings.
The ski plane tour with a glacier landing was amazing and I would highly recommend using Talkeetna Air Taxi. The entire staff was great and very helpful .

We stopped by on our way down from Denali.   TAT was wonderful to deal with, and had a short notice flight ready for our entire family.  Even though we dealt with fog, our pilot made the experience very memorable.  Seeing the mountain up close was an experience that we will never forget.

review_title: Don’t miss this if you are in Alaska and near Talkeetna
review_text: This was the highlight of our trip. A smooth ride and stunning views; all thanks to our amazing pilot: Clay. We were amazed how quickly and smoothly we took off and landed. The glacier landing was incredible. Outstanding!
Took our granddaughter on a 9 day trip to Alaska, and this one of her Great experiences, along with a 2 mile dog mushing ride and playing with the dogs.  Loved our overall time in the 49th state.

Fantastic Trip! Must thing to do in Alaska, Flightseeing.  No other way to appreciate magnitude of Denali and Talkeetna Air Taxi was great company to take us to see the summit.  Friend of mine recommended company and they delivered. Very accommodating and provided the highlight to our Alaska trip.

review_title: Awesome view of Denali with glacier landing
review_text: We reserved a Grand Tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi, and they allow us to change this couple days before our trip to include a glacier landing.  I’m so glad we added the glacier landing.  It’s totally worth it, an experience you’ll never forget.  The fog was coming in during our flight, so we have a very small window to fly to the north side of the mountain and back.  But our pilot is totally awesome, and we were able to get up close, extremely close to the mountain, so we can have a clear look.  He also maneuvered the plane such that passengers from both sides of the plane were able to get a good look of the mountain.  The landing on the Don Sheldon Amphitheater was very smooth.  We took lots of pictures on the glacier.  My kid even managed to build a tiny snowman.  For those of you with motion sickness, I suggest you take your meds before the flight.  The scenery and view is breathtaking and unforgettable.  A must do for your trip to Denali!

review_title: Super fun splendid view of mount Denali and other peaks
review_text:
it was very easy to go ride on small plane to view Denali and other mountains.
Due to weather, it started 15 mins later than it was scheduled. The pilot was very nice and gave us an experience of smooth ride.
He also made sure passengers on both sides of the plane can view the major points.
Only small issue that seats in middle have the obstacle of plane's body part, this was only problem for photography not for seeing the beautiful snow peaks or glaciers.
Again due to bad weather we could not land on Glacier. It would have a hell of a experience.
But TAT has refunded the amount for Glacier landing.
Overall service is very satisfactory and highly recommended for adventurous people
Booked the tour for 9 people from Australia and no problem. Turned up on the morning with all bookings done and ready
Thanks to our pilot Michael we had an unforgettable experience.  Flying up from Talkeetna you get to see the entire geography of a glacier. And, of course, the views were stunning.
Great views of Denali, the Ruth Gorge and much of the surrounding country. Wish we could do this every day.

review_title: Fabulous experience and guess who flew us...
review_text: Anyone visiting Alaska always hear about doing their once in a life time flightseeing Denali tour including glacier landing that most of these tours do. I came across this recommendation all along on my web search as well as in all the conversations with friends who’ve visited Alaska. I took a chance by not booking the tour in advance and started my search right after we checked in to Talkeetna. I inquired with a couple of flightseeing tour operators including K2 which seems to be quite popular on the web. My web search greatly influenced me to go with K2 (superb marketing) and I decided to go with them. I stepped into their office and checked for availability, unfortunately they didn’t have any tours with glacier landing that day and I felt so bad for not booking in advance. I had spotted a small corner office of Talkeetna Air Taxi on the way so I went there but bad luck again, it was locked. I decided to call them on the number listed on their office window and that’s when things started to change, for better. Within a few minutes of my call they booked us with Glacier landing and surprisingly with a better price (than K2), thanks to children discounts, now we’ve to rush to their base office as our appointment was just about 30 mins away. We quickly changed clothes and reached the base office on time, everything went perfect from that point onwards, the sweet lady at the counter took some info, weighed us on scale, handed a colored ticket and asked us to step out and wait for our plane. We were given snow shoe covers and within a few minutes we were greeted by a gentlemen called “Paul”. Paul was our pilot and we quickly mingled with him as he seemed to be quite an international traveler with varied experiences from across continents. Paul was super nice with us, sharing lot of meaningful information throughout the plane ride and helped us took pictures on the glacier. We all were very much impressed with Paul’s service and loved the flight experience from beginning to end. Paul safely got us back on ground and we were still awestruck with the beauty of Denali and our flightseeing experience. While returning the snow shoe covers I told the shoe staff that Paul was such an amazing pilot and he quickly responded, yeah he’s an amazing person and he’s the owner of Talkeetna Air Taxi, wow, now we’re even more thrilled knowing who flew us to Denali and our memories suddenly became even more precious. Thank you Paul and Talkeetna Air Taxi, you guys rock and I’ll recommend each and every Alaska tourist to add you guys to their Alaska memories. You’ll not be disappointed, if the owner is so friendly and professional then you can imagine how professional other staff would be. As many other reviewers said this was indeed THE highlight of our 3 weeks Alaska adventure.

We were very pleased with all aspects of our flight with Talkeetna Air Service.  We chose the trip around Denali with a glacier landing and it was extraordinary.  We drew the Chief pilot for the tour and although he looked much younger than his 40 years, he demonstrated clearly his 20 plus years flying the bush.  As a retired Air Force flyer myself, I knew right away he was highly skilled.  moreover, his dialogue mad the trip extra interesting. It is not inexpensive but this is a Highly recommend this service.

review_title: Denali Tour with a Glacier landing
review_text:
Definitely the highlight of our trip to Alaska.  Talkeetna Air Taxi staff were excellent.  Helpful and professional.  They were so relaxed and friendly.

Loved the Glacier landing.  We weren't going to do this tour at all, as it seemed expensive, but we managed to get a good deal and was even picked up from our campsite!  

Lovely experience.  Recommend doing this if you have the funds... because, even with a deal, it's not cheap.

review_title: amazing views. highlight of our trip. our pilot was not  very interactive but we still enjoyed it a lot
review_text:
all 3 air taxi companies in the area are located close by and they make a similar trip with a landing on ruth glacier or other glacier. this flightseeing trip was absolutely worth signing up for. the views are phenomenal. the vista on the glacier is amazing. 
I strongly recommend a glacier landing even if it costs  100$ more (whichever company you go with). 
we went with talkeetna as they seemed the most popular but the reviews of all 3 companies looked good. prices are similar. the route they fly is also similar
the signing up process/check in /equipment they offer etc was excellent. no concerns there. the only mild downer was that the pilot who was with us seemed most uninterested in being where he was. said hello. pointed at a couple of things while speaking in a hurry. got in,took off, sat in the plane checking his phone while at cruising altitude (we were not worried about safety), landed, called us back in when done with landing and got us off the plane at the airport again. 
did not show any interest in pointing anything out. once again. I am sure there are other pilots who are more interactive. it does not diminish the trip as the views are incredible.
Bei schönstem Wetter hatte ich die Gelegenheit für einen Rundflug und wurde nicht enttäuscht. Andrew war ein toller Pilot und die Sicht war einfach nur atenberaubend!

This was once in a life time experience. We were not sure about this due to the cost. But, I think it was totally worth it. Glacier landing in midst of the mountains was unbelievable! The staff was very pleasant. Our pilot Clay was informative and friendly. Highly recommend this tour.

My husband and I took the Grand Denali with Glacier Landing Tour on July 16.    Talkeetna Air Taxi Employees do an amazing job.   The tour was absolutely beautiful and amazing!   Words can’t describe the landing and being on a glacier.   What an experience!   Highly recommend!

I was not going to take a Denali Scenic Flight because of the cost. But, my husband said that I should really see the scale of the park from the air. I am so glad he insisted! It was one of the highlights of our trip! We did the Mountain Voyager Flight. Our pilot was Nick, whom we actually knew from business back in Utah (small world!). The flight was spectacular, flying over Ruth’s Glacier, past the Moose’s Tooth and by Mt. Hunter. The views of Denali itself were breathtaking. I was in awe and silent most of the flight!
TAKE THIS TOUR if you are in Talkeetna!

Great trip and great pilot very knowledable about the area and Alaska Saw everything we came to see
Free pickup at the campground and return if you wanted

It was so impressing to see these wonderful mountains and the different landscapes!
When we started we didn't know, wether we could land on the glacier or not because of the weather. And then the pilot said: "Yes, we can!" Wow - that was an experience the three ouf us will never forget!

We went on the Denali Grand Tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi. This flight flew up to and circled Denali Mountain and then landed on Ruth Glacier. We got up close and personal with the mountains of the Alaska Range as you can see from the picture as we circled to land on the glacier. Andy the experienced pilot was was very professional, informative, and answered our questions as we flew around. This two hour trip was a trip of a lifetime. The operation at Air Taxi was very organized and professional. We highly recommend them. They fly the majority of the hikers up to base cam in May and June also. Do it!!
Fabulous flight on a perfect day with blues skies. Standing on Ruth Glacier was thrilling. Highly recommend trip of a lifetime.

This is the only best thing to do in Alaska. Awesome experience. They land in glacier in all3 trips i think the smallest trip should be fine as they land in glacier in almost the same place for all the 3 trips, so this saves money.
The sights you saw on this trip was definitely worth the cost. It definitely made our short trip to Denali worth it and we did not regret the decision to fly with Talkeetna Air Taxi.

review_title: Bucket List Trip to Ruth Glacier
review_text: Chatty and excellent pilot.  Smooth ride.  Gorgeous mountains and glaciers.  Smooth and safe landing on Ruth Glacier.  We loved walking on the glacier and viewing Denali Mountain up close.   Wonderful

We have viewed Denali from afar (in Anchorage) and a few trips near the base, but nothing is like being on Ruth Glacier at the foot of Denali.  Our pilot was witty and informative.  The landing and walking on the glacier was surreal.  Must do trip for Alaska.

Everyone was very nice and knowledgeable.  I was surprised how smooth our glacier landing was.  It is bumpier on a commercial landing.   Mountains were breathtaking!!   Checked off our bucket list.  !!!!!!!   Thankyou!!

review_title: Denali Flightseeing Tour with Glacier Landing
review_text: Oh my goodness - what a treat! Our pilot, Leighan, was INCREDIBLE! Safety was foremost in her mind as she kept abreast of the current conditions in and around the mountains. She assured us that it didn't matter which side of the plane you sat on as she would be flying in such a manner that you'd all see the same beautiful scenery from either side. And the scenery was MAJESTIC! Our group got an extra special treat as there were 3 hikers in need of being picked up at Denali Base Camp and we were going to be the plane to do it. The glacier landing was smooth and the view of the surrounding mountains from Base Camp was stunning. I was in Alaska during a heat wave so the cold temps in the mountains were refreshing! I highly recommend adding the glacier landing to your flight - you won't regret it!!
We lucked out with a perfect blue sky day. It was a smooth and very interesting flight. A peak experience, bucket list adventure. We will never forget it.

Our pilot, Andrew, was fabulous. Knowledgeable, confident, professional. The time in the plane as well as on the glacier was worth every penny spent. It was an amazing, awe inspiring, spectacular trip!

Wow!! We were a party of 8 so the plane was all ours - with one of us in the cockpit. From take-off to landing, the entire trip was fascinating. It was a bit cloudy, but we went about the clouds and Denali and her friends were popping majestically above them. The glaciers were amazing (we didn't land on one, but seeing them from above and learning about them was great). And the glacier lakes were spectacular. Flying next to and around the jagged peaks was breathtaking. Our pilot explained everything very well and taught us a lot about glaciers. It was also really interesting hearing the other pilots talking in the background as they all tried to find the best routes through the clouds for the tours. These guys, from check in to walking out the door, work hard to make this experience perfect. Do this trip!

The flight around Denali and landing on the glacier was one of the most awesome things I've ever done.  I recommend to literally every one I know - not something I typically do.  It was not only awe inspiring beautiful but the people who work at Talkeetna are amazing and our pilot was nice, knowledgeable and made the trip even more memorable.
I highly recommend Talkeenta Air for your Alaska trip! Amazing guide, easy booking, reasonable price for the incredible experience.
An amazing experience and excellent pilot and incredible amazing scenery we love to do again I hope son
Talkeetna Air Taxi was very accommodating and helped us find a window of opportunity with the weather.  Our pilot was super and the flight was the highlight of our vacation.
This was the best part of our trip!!! Best company to use, best piolets best tour. Thank you for the experience!

Used these folks for climbing support with friends and then again for a scenic flight on my honeymoon and couldn’t be happier.  Such a friendly and welcoming staff, very accommodating, and smiles all around. No other way to see the true vastness of the incomparable Alaska Range!
The entire experience was great from booking to flight. The view on Ruth Glacier was remarkable as was the view from the air. Excellent!

Talkeetna Air Taxi treated us professionally and very well, the pilot (Leighan) was exceptional, and the experience (Denali flight see with glacier landing) was out of this world - truly a top 10% experience of our trip.
We had wonderful weather, an excellent flight and a warm an special stay on the glacier. Boarding was easy. I could make beautiful Pictures. All was better than expected.
Highly recommend this tour. Talkeetna Air fit us in while booking the day of. Great pilot, wonderful staff and a once in a lifetime experience.

review_title: Best Way to Appreciate the size of Denali
review_text: Everyone was friendly, the pilot was skilled and knowledgeable, and the plane, while necessarily noisy was very clean and well maintained.  I thoroughly enjoyed the trip.  While expensive, it was totally worth it to get the perspective on Denali that it deserves.

The day planned for this tour turned out to be very hazy and smoky due to the fires in the area. We couldn't see any mountain ranges from the ground and really didn't know what to expect once in the air. Visibility was really low until we flew above the smoke line, and then Denali with the surrounding peaks came into our view in all its glory. Our pilot's confidence kept us worry free as we flew through thick layers of smoke. Landing on a glacier just below Denali peak was one of the best days we had in Alaska, thank you guys!

review_title: Denali - door to door - brilliant service
review_text:
Our Denali climbing group used Talkeetna Air Taxi to fly into and back out of the Denali Base Camp.  The flight in and out was spectacular - an unbelievable lifetime highlight.

Who we got back to Talkeetna at 8.30pm, the crew from Talkeetna Air Taxi went above and beyond with their service as they hung around to help pull together our mountain of gear and then drive us down to our accommodation  - brilliant after hours service and greatly appreciated by a tired crew!

This trip to Alaska we decided to fly Denali with a glacier landing instead of dealing with the drive, the crowds and the school bus ride at the park. The weather was perfect and the view of Hunter, Foraker & Denali  was spectacular. We flew in a 10 passenger Otter. The glacier landing at 5500 feet was smooth and the time on the glacier went by too fast. The whole 2 hour trip went on time and as advertised. Highly recommend TAT for this excursion.

I was visiting Alaska with a tour beginning of June 2019 and one of the last optional trip was taking a plane to see the glacier at the base of Denali Mountain. When we arrived the people at Talkeetna Air Taxi were very friendly, competent and soon we were boarding a small plane. I was very surprised seeing that our pilot would be a young and beautiful woman(!). It turned out that Leighan (this was her name) was an excellent pilot. She was explaining us in very calmly voice where we are flying, what we are seeing and other interesting facts. The weather was a dream, sunny, almost no clouds, light wind. We landed on the glacier and when we stepped out it felt like euphoria for all of us :) We were taking the pictures, running around, sharing our thoughts. I can tell you that this place is special! Visiting Alaska and not taking Talkeetna Air Taxi to glacier is like missing the essential part of exploration. I highly recommend this activity. The unforgettable experience!

My husband and I did the Grand Denali tour with the glacier landing and it was the experience of a lifetime! Our pilot Alex was the best! Honestly, I was frightened to do this and I am prone to motion sickness. I had the best time- no fear and no motion sickness. The scenery cannot be described with words. The whole trip was breath taking! You will never regret doing this!!

I can’t say enough about this experience. It was absolutely one of the highlights of our vacation. I was apprehensive about taking a small plane anywhere,but landing on a glacier was so worth the concern. Everyone was professional from the staff at the office to the pilot. I was brave enough to sit in the co-pilots seat  on the way back and enjoyed every second. The pilot was amazing showing us as much as possible of the area. We considered ourselves lucky to have such a spectacular trip.

review_title: Incredible close up on Alaska range
review_text:
This was a great excursion for family fun. I cannot fathom my way to get as close up reviews and experience with the mountains. 

Fun facts - Time spent on the glacier is pretty limited… We were asked to stay roughly within the wingspan of the plan when we landed.

Also, as a 6’ 4” guy I would say that there are truly only two seats that you fit in. Had my daughter not sat in the “bulkhead”, and I could switch with her, my knees would’ve made the person in front of me very very uncomfortable.
We did the summit tour with glacier landing, it was amazing.  Better than we imagined. We had our 12 year old son with us.  Definitely the best memory from Alaska!!

Amazing experience. It was recommended by friends and was definitely an experience of a lifetime.  How many people can say they landed on a Denali glacier.  Very cool!   Very accomodating when I had to make a time change to the flight.  Everyone was so nice, professional, and helpful.   I was a little aprehensive being in a very small plane, but it was extremely smooth.  Weather was outstanding & I made a very small snowman on the glacier and took a funny picture with it and our pilot.  Pilot was very knowledgeable and fun.  Overall great experience.

My wife and I did the flight seeing with the glacier landing experience and it was awesome. Even though clouds obscured our view of Denali, I would not have missed this for the world. It was a very very memorable excursion.

review_title: One of the best decisions we made - Priceless
review_text: At first we were concerned about the price as well as the air quality from a fire close by. We are so glad we took the leap and took a flight around Denali and landed on the glacier! It was one of the most memorable part of our 6 week trip and cost doesn't even come close the value of the flight - priceless!

This was an amazing experience - truly breathtaking. Michael was a great pilot who narrated the trip with lots of great info. Courtney in the office is also great - she was super informative and had great tips for Talkneetna and Alaska in general!

The trip was fantastic! The pilot and guide was very friendly, kept us entertained on the plane ride over explaining each of the glacier. We had perfect weather and landed on the glacier with no jackets on!! Truly memorable experience and I'd recommend the Glacier landing and Talkeetna Air Taxi to everyone.

review_title: One of the Highlights of our Trip to Alaska!
review_text: An experience not to be missed, especially the outstanding skill, knowledge and engagement of the pilot.
The air tour was great.  The staff was very friendly and helpful.  The pilot was informative and provided a very safe and enjoyable tour of Denali with a glacier landing.

Older couple, late June, record high temperatures in Talkeetna. Tour company booked reservations. Staff and pilot professional and engaging. About a 45 minute flight to and from with 15 minutes on glacier. Company provided boots over shoes as glacier was slushy. Pilot made sure each side of plane had equal spectacular views of Denali. Flew in valleys not just straight to mountain. Great commentary and one client could ride copilot seat. 
Best view of Denali during whole trip.

On our way up to Denali after a 7-day cruise with extended family, I took my mother on a flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi. This was one of, if not the best tour of the trip! Sign up was easy and service was excellent! Views and glacier landing were memories of a lifetime!

I did the Grand Denali with Glacier Landing, and the whole experience was perfect. Professional staff, well-organized process, and a magical (and smooth!) flight seeing experience. Very highly recommended.

We were very lucky with the weather: clear skies, smooth air and T-shirt warm. Our pilot, Andrew, gave us a smooth and confidence inspiring ride with just enough commentary. He answered all our questions and flew closer when someone had a particular area of interest. The glacier landing at the Sheldon Amphitheater was the highlight and well worth the extra fee.
Highly recommended.  Very impressed with the staff. And word is that this is the safer of the two flight companies operating in Talkeetna.
Friendly staff, on the phone and in person. Great flight with Adam, beautiful views :) I would recommend to everyone.

All 10 of us squeezed into the perfectly sized DHC-3 Turbo Otter for a fantastic 2 hours flightseeing trip of a lifetime. Immediately after take off from Talkeetna airstrip we climb towards the Denali range and we soon get the first views of the Glaciers that we weave their way down through the mountain valleys. Our pilot is a local and extremely knowledgeable of all the geology of the area and with almost perfect weather we fly quite close to some of the near vertical edges. We cannot fully see the top of Denali itself due to small pockets of cloud but we make our way towards Ruth Glacier to set down gently, we all get out to take in the awe and natural splendour of our surroundings, we are advised that the snow / ice beneath our feet is approximately 4,000ft thick, quite reassuring ! Our land time is soon over and we take off for our descent back to Talkeetna - an amazing adventure which I truly was looking forward to.

Our air taxi trip with a glacier landing was the absolute best part of our Alaskan vacation! My family of four ranked it as the number 1 thing we did on our trip. Booking went smoothly and the day of the trip was top notch. Everyone was happy and eager to make it a great experience. Leighan was a super pilot that kept us informed on the sights and shared so much knowledge with us about the mountain. This excursion was worth every penny.

review_title: One of the Alaska trip highlights
review_text: I had booked this trip months before we arrived. I had been in contact with Talkeetna Air on which would be the best flight with glacier landing and it turned out super.  It’s one of those one of things most people don’t do but  only know what they would have missed if they actually do it.  Great pilot and commentary and ample time on the glacier with him taking pictures for anyone that wanted one.

Awesome experience of flying with Talkeetna Air Taxi. All the representatives were very helpful, warm and welcoming. Pilot was very friendly, explained everything about the trip, Denali mountains etc., also, patiently answered all the questions that we had. They picked us from our hotel and also dropped us to the area of our choice, hence it was very convenient for us as we didn't have any car and quite a bit of luggage. Overall, we feel that we made the right choice to fly with Talkeetna Air Taxi, would love to visit again.

review_title: The highlight of a trip to Alaska
review_text: Riding with Talkeetna Air I felt like I was a bird gently soaring among the mountains and gliding over the glaciers.  It was perfectly calm.  The views are spectacular, especially being able to see Mt. Denali in the distance.  We gently set down on a glacier to allow us to make "snow angels" in the snow.

We couldn’t have asked for better weather or a better pilot! He was professional as well as friendly! We were able to land on Ruth Glacier, walk around the glacier, take photos and phone videos during the entire excursion! I got to sit in the co-pilot seat and had a first hand view of everything from take off to two landings( on and off the glacier)   The pilot pointed out different climbers base camps, climbing route, facts about the mountain and so much more! This was by far the most memorable part of my 12 day trip

Our pilot was LeeAnn and she was very personable, professional and thoroughly enjoys being on the glacier. The views are very different than you have by driving and it is well worth  it as it was the highlight of my 8 day Alaskan trip. The beauty of the glacier is so breathtaking, you should try to experience this tour and glacier landing.
Highly recommend flying with them. Closeup views of Denali and landing in the glacier. Highly skilled and experienced pilot.

Our pilot was exceptional, he took us up and set us down smoothly and I was lucky enough to ride co-pilot and was truly impressed with his ability to control the plane and interact with the passengers.
The weather cooperated and the views were spectacular. My second time flying with Talkeetna Air and would recommend them to everyone seeking a Denali experience.

Fiz o passeio Grand Denali com pouso no glaciar. Foi uma experiência única é incrível! As imagens e as sensações são mágicas. Além disso, o staff da Talkeetna Air é bastante simpático e solícito. Agradecimentos especiais ao Andrew, piloto do voo em que estive. Além de muito simpático, deu muitas informações sobre tudo o que víamos pelas janelas do avião.
An extremely professional and personable pilot gave us a guided tour around Denali and then landed on a glacier. It was an incredible experience, which I would highly recommend.

review_title: great flight  with a great pilot
review_text: Talkeetna air provided a wonderful scenic flight around Denali. If you have the time to do the glacier landing it is well worth it. The entire operation was professional, the pilot very skillful. It is a different angle on the mountain.
An amazing experience! Great pilot! Very informative spectacular views! Unbelievable trip our family favorite in Alaska!!!

We decided on the spur of the moment to take a flight instead of driving the two and a half hours from Talkeetna to Denali National Park. An hour's flight with landing on a glacier. Totally worth the money! I would do it again in a heartbeat.

Our glacier landing flight was the highlight of our Alaskan adventure… The entire team at this facility, including our pilot, is top notch. Very friendly, accommodating, and passionate about the beauty of Alaska. Our pilot was awesome and gave us an extremely memorable experience. Worth every penny of the price.

It was a perfect morning without many cloud so the view of the mountains was perfect. The two hour trip allowed us to see some of the most beautiful scenery anywhere in the world. The glacier landing was a exiting bonus.  The Talkeetna Air Taxi staff was friendly, very helpful and Mike our pilot was great.

Our flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi (TAT) was the Grand Denali with Glacier Landing Tour.
Our pilot (Andy) was superb at flying and describing what we were seeing and experiencing.
The weather was great and the scenery was awe inspiring.
Our glacier landing and walking on the glacier is an unforgettable memory. 
This was a "Bucket List" trip of a lifetime with many thanks to Andy and the staff at TAT.
We will definitely book this "Five Star" trip again on our next visit to Talkeetna.
This was my best part of my 12-day vacation in Alaska. The pilot had an excellent control on the plane, including his snow landing. He gave us detailed explanations on what we see.

This was a true highlight of my trip to Alaska, pay extra for the glacier landing, and bring your wide angle lens. My photos and video from my iPhone were excellent 
Enjoy!

This is not to be missed. The entire Talkeetna Air Taxi team is awesome! Our pilot Clay took us on an amazing ride around Denali and we landed on the glacier, got out, took pictures and played in the snow and then headed back. Clay was full of interesting information, we learned a lot and were 100% awed by the incredibly beautiful scenery. This is a pricey adventure, no doubt about it. But I'm really glad we did it. So many beautiful places to visit in this country and this was a fantastic way to see Denali. We went in April so the park wasn't open for us to visit and the flightseeing tour was the only way for us to experience Denali.
OMG , No trip to Alaska is complete without taking this flight. The pilot was great flying the plane but also a great tour guide explaining everything we were seeing. Worth every dollar and more.
The staff was knowledgable, courteous and friendly. The person who passed out the boots was funny and fun. The pilot was smooth. Good time.

We had no idea Talkeetna was as awesome or charming (or really even existed) before last Wednesday... and now we can’t imagine not adding this stop to our family vacation because of Talkeetna air taxi. Landing on the glacier was a once-in-a-lifetime experience... between our pilot and the views we were beyond thrilled. We don’t usually write reviews but HAD to for this.

review_title: Glacier landing with top notch staff!!
review_text: Flew with Michael in the Cessna 180.  He was loaded with information and enthusiasm.  He mentioned how he had one of the best jobs in the world saying “I get to see everyone at their best”.  Check in was easy!  All around fabulous experience provided by top notch staff!!
Our 1 1/2 hour flight tour with the glacier landing was the highlight of our trip to Alaska. I recommend it highly to one and all.

We took the Mountain Voyager with Glacier Landing Tour" through the peaks to Mt. Denali.  The entire experience was wonderful,,, from the customer service and preparation before the flight to the landing on the glacier and the landing back. Our pilot was Mike Gold.  He did an outstanding with the flight pointing out all the sights and history.  We HIGHLY recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi and the glacier landing.  If you get Mike as the pilot, then that makes it even better.  Go for it and enjoy!
Wow! We had wonderful service and thoroughly enjoyed our flight through Denali and landing on a glacier. Don’t miss this. If you do nothing, do this, and bring your camera!

Highly recommend using Talkeetna Air Taxi for trips to Denali.  This is a first class operation that clearly puts safety first, communicates extremely well, and truly wants to make sure you have a fantastic experience.  I was especially impressed with Leslie as our pilot - it is clear that this is her passion.

review_title: Awe Inspiring Chance of a Lifetime Trip!
review_text:
If you are wavering about taking a flight seeing tour because of the price, just do it! It was so amazing. Talkeetna Air Taxi is a great company. We booked the basic Denali tour and Glacier landing trip directly through them, not the cruise ship. Their customer service is awesome and the offer the same kind of guarantees the cruise lines do.

We asked about a discount and they gave us one for having 4 or more in our group. We were scheduled for 6 pm on the day we got to our lodge. But we got in to Talkeetna earlier. We called and they had no problem moving us up to an earlier tour. 

Then when we got there, they "upgraded" us to a longer flight, because the plane needed to take some supplies up to base camp!

The views are spectacular. It gives a totally different perspective on the mountains. The pilot was very skilled and informative

I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi. By far the best money we spent on an excursion!

review_title: This is a must in Talkeetna
review_text: We went on a cloudy day in Talkeetna but Andy made it the high point of our vacation. Had to land at Base Camp (oh darn) as other options were not good. They went out of there way to make the trip a memory even when mother nature wasn't helping.
Lovely flight, great commentary from pilot. Wish we could have seen all sides of the mountain, but wind prohibited it and no reduction in fee was offered.

Well worth the money – and the best money spent was the $50 fee for the glacier landing. If you are going to pay nearly $400 for the ride, pay the extra $50 and land on the glacier.    The planes have headsets and the pilot talks about what you are seeing explaining glaciers, receding glaciers, areas that look like there is no glacier as they are completely gray but under that is glacier, etc.   It is very noisy without the headsets.   Our pilot, Clay, explains what mountain, glacier, etc. you are seeing.  He even made sure both sides of the plane got to see Mt. McKinley.  All the seats faced forward, and the wing was overhead.  It added to the pictures having a little wing in the picture to give perspective.   I took our GoPro and suction cupped it to the wall of the airplane, so it pivoted out over the window and let it run on its own. The videos are awesome!  If you don’t have a GoPro and are going on this flight, this flight alone is worth buying one!   I also rented a 400mm lens to go on our camera.  I used it, but, since you are so close to most things, the 200mm and even the 55mm lens was good. Actually, as close as we were to Mt. McKinley my cell phone took a great picture.  We didn’t have great views of Denali as it was covered in clouds, but, did get a pretty good view and picture.   The flight was very safe/smooth, and our pilot was very diligent in explaining the safety precautions involved in the flight.

Our Talkeetna Air Taxi pilot Michael was a great pilot who narrated our flight and our glacier landing, took pictures, and answered questions in a very professional manner. We felt safe and in good hands throughout our 2-hour flight. I would highly recommend this company to anyone who wants to take an unbelievable flight around Mt. Denali.

I arranged for seven of us to go on a mountain view flight with glacier landing.  From the moment we arrived all throughout the process we had such a tremendous experience. Our pilot was knowledgeable, an excellent flight engineer, and had beautiful take-offs and landings. His narration and knowledge of the local area was superior. We had beautiful skies and were able to see all of the base camps for the climbers on Denali.  We were able to view several different approaches and see climbers on the side of Denali on the day we went. Our Glazier landing was absolutely superb. The very inviting individuals that work there offered to shuttle us to a local restaurant when we were done.  That level of service Is not something seen frequently in my travel experience.  Each of us thought it was one of the greatest travel experiences we have ever had. We would recommend this company to anyone who wanted a glacier landing and intimate experience with the mountains.

review_title: Absolutely astonishing! Most beautiful flight I can remember.
review_text: We did the Denali National Park air tour with a glacier landing. I talked with TAT staff members 6 months before our visit after researching all the air tour operators in the area. Everyone I talked with was great; helpful and friendly. I'm a retired pilot so I wanted to make sure I selected a safe and professional operator. I was very pleased with TAT on several levels. Emily greeted us and gave us an overview of the flight and told us what we could expect. She was wonderful and answered all of our questions. Our pilot was  Matt. He was not only a great tour guide, but also a very seasoned and professional pilot. He demonstrated a high level of proficiency and conducted the flight in a very safe manner. His landing on the glacier was most impressive. I'm not sure where you will ever find a more beautiful setting for an air tour. We plan to go back to Talkeetna in the future and will definately select TAT again for our flying experiences!

We had a fabulous tour with our pilot Andy.  Actually landed at base camp.  Flight was smooth, pilot was great with the information he shared.  Loved seeing the land and the mountains and especially Denali from the air!

review_title: Glacier landing with a lot of great information from the pilot
review_text: We did the glacier landing tour, which was pretty cool and a good length of time. The pilot was very informative while we flew and answered all of our questions while we hung out on the glacier. He made a point to let each side of the plane see the views he was pointing out and allowed plenty of time for us to take it all in. We unfortunately did not get to see Mt Denali because of the cloud coverage, but I hear that is quite common.

review_title: You will never forget this experience!
review_text: The only downside to this experience is its cost.  If you can fit it into your budget, it is a beautiful and memorable journey through some of the most beautiful and unspoiled scenery on the planet.
We loved our sight-seeing flight over Denali and the glaciers. Our pilot was wonderful - she loved Alaska and had such great stories.  She also made us feel so safe.

The pilot was great and the ladies at the front desk were nice. However, if you're taking the flight tour of Denali with the glacier landing be sure to ask if Denali is visible or not. The glacier landing is several miles away from Denali so the weather might be clear for one but non visible for the other. They know what the weather looks like throughout the day from other pilots going around the mountain but they will only give part of the information so they can get you in the air. Be sure to ask about the weather conditions for both the mountain and landing! If you’re just looking to do a glacier landing there are a lot of other cheaper options. Kind of disappointed they only tell you what you want to hear and not the full report.

We had the most wonderful flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi. Absolutely a trip of a lifetime and a must do for anyones bucket list. Mike our pilot was very safety conscious and a great narrator the entire trip! The scenery was just out of this world beautiful! I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi and definitely do the glacier landing!

My family and I took this trip and it was the highlight of our time in Alaska.  The staff and pilot were all friendly and helpful.  The things we saw took our breath away. We had a perfectly clear flight.
Ok so the PPL in me may influence my view but flying in a 1954 de Havilland Otter and landing on the glacier is just about as good as it gets. Not a cheap trip but worth every single penny.

Talkeetna Air Taxi was the highlight of our trip. AMAZING experience! Someone told us to not miss a flightsee. I tried to visualize what we would experience, and I completely missed the mark. This experience was like entering a different universe. Magnificently gorgeous doesn't quite describe it. 

Our pilot, Chris Peterson, was WONDERFUL! He made sure that everyone had a nice view, excellent narration, and a smooth flight. He even gave a heads-up for the couple of times it was a touch bumpy, so no nerves.

We got to land at base camp, and that was a treat. It was so pretty and really cool. It was also warm there...quite surprised by that. 

DO NOT MISS THIS EXPERIENCE! 

NOTE: Be patient. Your trip may be delayed by weather. Roll with it and make yourself available. We were scheduled for 3:15 p.m. one day and flew out around noon the following day, but they made sure we had the best experience possible.

TIP: Sit in the second row seat (or as co-pilot) for the best views.
We had a fabulous air trip with the glacier landing.  Everything went smoothly and the staff is professional and attentive.

The flight to the Glacier was one of the life moments that I will never forget.  From the ground crew to the pilot, the expertise was amazing and I would like to thank Talkeetna Air Taxi for the memory of a life time.

Our daughter gave us an air tour over Denali for Christmas!  The people here were very friendly and easygoing.  Our pilot was very capable and knowledgeable. AMAZING up close views of No. America’s highest peak.  My husband and I were a little uneasy about the small plane ( ?185, 2 seater + pilot and copilot, smaller than the one pictured) but our pilot, Chris, was awesome!  Smoothest flight we’ve ever experienced!  An expensive excursion but well worth it!  If you are going to visit Alaska, save your pennies and do this, it’s well worth it!!
Excellent flight seeing, superb  service and facilities. Our pilot LeeAnn was both an excellent pilot  and interesting narrator. Would highly recommend her and your company.
Unbelievable adventure to fly around Denali! Pilot gave great narrative of the mountains, glaciers, etc. Wish I could do it every day!

We did the full around Mt. Denali flight with glacier landing. Our pilot was highly skilled, super friendly and very informative. This has been the highlight of our Alaskan vacation so far! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!

Anyone considering coming to Alaska and to Talkeetna simply MUST go on a Denali small plane flight with a glacier landing !  Nick, our pilot, was superb ! Not only did he do a great job flying the coolest small plane, he provided tons of information about the sights along the way and he was as friendly as can be. The folks at the Talkeetna Air Taxi office treated us so wonderfully from the time we walked in, through prepping us for the flight & glacier landing and follow up after the flight.  These folks do this right ! Look, I don't care who you are, you spend a lot of money getting to Alaska for a once-in-a-lifetime vacation so spend a bit more and have one of THE most memorable vacations of your life by flying around Denali and landing on a glacier via Talkeetna Air Taxi - the views are stunning and the memories will be priceless !

Stunning view of Denali that you can’t see any other way. Our pilot was awesome and told us what we were looking at and why we were feeling bumps (there weren’t too many). We landed on a glacier at the base camp and it was fantastic. We would totally do it again!

Alaska is a wonderous place but key things make a trip and flying with Chris at Talkeetna Air and landing on a glacier was definitely the highlight of our trip. Weather is also unpredictable and Adam asked if we could wait until later and the views would be clearer. He explained very well what is going on and so many times people schedule something and expect to go on time. With Denali it makes it''s own weather so we had allowed a day and a half in case there was any weather issues. The whole trip was first class . . . will always remember it.
Andrew did a great job on a partially cloudy skies showing Denali and all the glaciers. Awesome trip!!

This was a great flight. The folks in the office were helpful in working to get us a worthwhile flight with clouds moving in and out and it turned out great. The pilot, Michael, was great before and during the flight to point out features and get us the best viewing advantages. Great group!

review_title: Talkeetna Air Taxi glacier landing and Denali Flight.  The absolute best part of our Alaska trip
review_text: We did the fly around Denali and landing on the Ruth Glacier.  We had been on a 7 day cruise on Holland America and were spending 5 days in the interior of Alaska.  This tour was the highlight of the of the trip.  Talkeetna Air was so professional and I felt completely safe in their plane and with the pilot.  If you have clear weather it is a MUST do!

| Leighan Falley, 
It was a beautiful day to fly around Denali. Our pilot was Leighan Falley. She is an excellent pilot and was very informative about the history of the area.  I would request to fly with her as she is known as “Denali’s Raven”! The views were spectacular! It was a great day to fly with minimal cloud cover.

If you find yourself in Alaska then a tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi is a must! The staff are amazing, the pilots are knowledgeable, safe and courteous. The landing on the glacier in the park was both smooth and fun!  Yes it is a bit pricey...but so very worth it! You will never regret this amazing, up close experience with Denali!

Wow. If I could give more stars I would. We were warmly greeted at reception and then met our pilot Nick who guided us to our little plane for our flight to Mt Denali . Even though a nervous flyer I had complete confidence in Nick from the start and though nervous it was an experience I will never forget and so happy myself and my wife experienced. The flight up approaching the mountains was incredible where at one stage you could almost touch the mountain. The glacier landing and bEing in that pristine environment is indescribable. 
All I can say is hang the expense and just do it!
Thanks Nick again and to all the staff at Talkeetna Air Taxi

review_title: Pay to land on a glacier!
review_text:
Great company. Pilot was very informative and its obvious he loves this place.
The glacier landing was the best. Pay the extra because its worth it.

Very worthwhile
Great way to see Denali. Received lots of great information during the flight .
Very memorable

I flew onto Khalhitna Glacier and off with TA Air, Paul was our pilot on both trips. Excellent is all I can say. I was immediately put at ease with the pilot’s confidence and knowledge. Flying over Alaska Range is an absolute must do in life. It’s magnificence is unparalleled. TA Air is professional, gracious, and battle tested. I would not fly into the range with anyone else!
This was a fantastic experience! The views were incredible, and the glacier landing was well-worth it. One of the highlights of our trip!

We took the flightseeing tour and landed on the glacier in Denali. It was a sunny day with just enough clouds to add good contrast to the sky. Smooth flight. The pilot explained what we were flying over. Landing on the glacier and walking on the snow-covered surface defies words. It is well-worth the money to have this once-in-a-lifetime experience.
Michael was and awsome pilot. words fail to express the wonder and beauty of this experience! For many of us a once in a lifetime experience and will not be forgotten.

We did one of the glacier landing trips and it was awesome.  Definitely one of the best things we did on our 1.5 week trip in Alaska.  It was worth the extra money to land on the glacier for sure.  We had a mostly clear day and got to see Denali, too.  Our pilot, Clay, was great.  He gave a nice commentary of the area.  We learned a lot and had fun, too!

We (mom & dad) went up with our 11yr old and 3.5 yr old. The youngest is tall for her age but had a bit of trouble seeing down out of the windows (no booster seat like in a car), but we wanted to bring her along and she did enjoy what she saw, and enjoyed the glacier. The rest of us had nothing but glowing reviews for our trip. Our pilot was a woman whose father had also been a bush pilot, and she was great and gave us great info about what we were seeing. We got some gorgeous photos out the windows, but mostly we were just in awe of the landscape, from the unbelievably steep mountain slopes to the gorgeous swamplands. We thought we had enough layers on when we stepped onto the glacier, but the littlest needed an extra. Definitely don't forget your polarized sunglasses.
Professional, experienced, caring, customer-service oriented, top conditioned planes. I have flown with them several times over the years.
This was our second year and again the highlight of our vacation. The staff is very knowledgeable and friendly.  Service was fantastic!
Everything went great, everybody was professional, but super friendly! Our pilot was personable but obviously experienced and capable. It was an awesome time I'll remember forever!
The whole trip was great, but the glacier landing was the very best part.   We almost didn’t do it, but we  decided to add it, and we are glad we did. It is well worth the extra money.

Breath taking and amazing experience. It’s expensive but worth every penny. Glacier landing and the time spent on top of the glacier were unimaginable. They were very flexible and adjusted the timing to get the best experience due to rain and cloudy weather. But by the time we started the clouds were gone and got a unforgettable experience.

A must do, over the top experience! If you only have time for one big activity while in Alaska, this is it. Worth every penny!

Talkeetna Air Taxi is the way to go. Friendly and knowledgeable service. A smooth ride all the way!

I booked at last minute since the weather was clear that day. No hassle at all. I am a pilot myself and the flying skills exhibited by the pilot were amazing. We were always safe and got to see the peaks and different sides. They even upgraded me to North side viewing. The glacier landing and the one at airport where flawless. What an experience !!! My wife was speechless for some time after the flight, she had the best experience for her life. Good job guys and your pilots are best and safe all the time. I will definitely visit you again.
Wonderful sightseeing plane ride. Matt was great pilot and host. Boys said it was the best activity on the trip.
The flight was what we hoped for. The staff were friendly and helpful. Our pilot Alex was very good.

review_title: If there’s only one thing you do in Alaska, do this.
review_text: Though expensive.m, this trip is worth every penny. The mountains and glaciers are truly breathtaking and pilots are phenomenal. There’s nothing like it!
Staff i friendly. They helped us move our appointment as per our convenience when the weather conditions were not in our favor. Flying exp was amazing. Had a great time.

review_title: Grand Denali Tour with Glacier Landing
review_text: An awesome experience. Leann is an excellent pilot and guide and made us feel very safe. Gives you a real perspective on how large Denali is.

review_title: Soaring the skies to land on Glaciers
review_text: We thoroughly enjoyed our ride with Alex from Talkeetna Air Taxi to the Ruth Glacier.  The ride upto the glacier was fun and beautiful.  We had a great landing and then played on the glacier.  Wish we had more time on the glacier...it seemed a little rushed there. On our way back, it would have been to rotate the co-pilot seat so someone else would get the larger window to look out of.....the plane windows are tiny and the wings come in the way.

I would take this flight again, the views were majestic and the feeling serene!
I felt safe as a passenger with Andy Young as the pilot!   One of my Best Days Ever!!!!
Great experience!  Chris, our pilot, was very knowledgable and did a great job!  Phenomenal views and the glacier landing was well worth the price!
We enjoyed our flight so much.  At no time did we feel fear.  Our son, visiting from Chicago, joined us!

review_title: One of the best experience in my life !!
review_text: We did the south side explorer with glacier landing . Glacier landing was the best part of the trip . Enjoyed every bit of it .The people at Talkeetna Air Taxi was very courteous and helpful.

Rates among the top 2 experiences of my life! Landing on a glacier at 7000 ft is a dream come true. Captain Andy was particular in ensuring that passengers seated on either side of the plane got the same experience and no one missed anything based on where they were seated in the plane. Awesome!!
Amazing experience. Amazing staff. What an adventure. Pilot was knowledgable and fun. Scenery could not have been better.

We really enjoyed our Talkeetna air flight to the mountains of Denali NP. We were able to see so many beautiful sights as we flew thru the mountains and made a landing on a glacier. We had plenty of time for pictures and questions as we walked on the glacier. Our pilot was so helpful with what ever we needed. We look forward to doing this again in the future. Mike & Cindy

review_title: A must do trip while in Denali
review_text: What an amazing afternoon. Flight into the mountains was great .... glacier landing was spectacular. We would highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi and Alex as your pilot.... the best !!!

My experience with Talkeetna Air Taxi was more than I expected. The service was great with lots of communication and flexibility to work around the weather. We felt safe at every moment with our experienced and calm pilot and she gave us quite a show of Denali National Park. On landing in the glacier gorge, she showed us around and we experienced the blissful quiet of being surrounded by gorgeous mountains. She was just as passionate about the views as we were! It was a great moment for us all and will be visiting Talkeetna Air Taxi for all the visitors that come to Alaska.

review_title: Life changing event/ Bucket list item
review_text: Staff and pilot treated us like family and made sure we had an awesome trip. The staff really helped make sure that my 5 year old daughter was prepared for the flight. The pilot showed us around the mountain ranges and shared some interesting information about the mountains and local area. If I ever return to Alaska I’ll be sure to take the full tour around Denali instead of touring the south side of the mountain.

This review is a half a year overdue, but I absolutely had to make sure to leave an excellent review for Talkeetna Air Taxi from an October 2018 trip. 

Myself along with another colleague (photographers) had been planning a trip to the Sheldon Mountain House for what ended up being years after an initial planned trip had to be canceled due to the Sheldon family needing the Mountain House for other uses while building the now completed and amazing Sheldon Chalet.
