We knew the mountain weather would rule the day (and all days) for this trip and planned with buffer days in case the weather had other things in mind for us, which it did with a big storm that blew in right as we had hoped to get up to the Mountain House for the first day.

Talkeetna Air Taxi still got us up there and back once weather conditions were properly waited out to do so safely. We were in great hands with Paul.

Talkeetna Air Taxi also worked with us to return two bags back to us that were left on the mountain from our haste to get to the aircraft due to a tight window of weather conditions that opened up just enough for us to get off the mountain.

Their office and people and service are all top notch and you can tell they know what they are doing.

Thanks Talkeetna Air Taxi!
This was without a doubt, the coolest thing I’ve ever done. I will be returning quite often this Summer! I plan on landing on every glacier there is available before Summer is over!

review_title: Spectacular!  View of a lifetime!  A must-see! Pilot was so friendly and knowledgeable! So glad I went on the flight!
review_text: Take the Talkeetna Air Taxi.  They're all local and know so much about what you're seeing!  Very friendly, answering questions, taking our picture for us.  I definitely recommend them.
It was lovely. To have a flight in the Denali area to recover memories from climbing Denali years back was just magic.
Amazing experience!!!! So worth it. Breathtaking and majestic. Do the glacier landing and go on a clear sunny day.
Something we are so glad we decided to do! It was a breathtaking flight. Pilot was awesome. A totally different way to see the mountains. Landing on a glacier. 😮

This was our 2nd trip with TAT and it was even more memorable than than the 1st.  TAT runs an efficient and professional business and they always make you feel welcome!  The pilots have a wealth of information and happily share their knowledge of the area with their guests.  We can't wait to come back to Talkeetna and take another one of their excursions!
Jeff and Sarah
Colorado
Amazing experience. My husband was very nervous and wasn't sure if he was going. The staff were understanding and help alleviate his fears enough for him to give it a try and he loved it!

review_title: A great day at Rainy Pass checkpoint!
review_text: My wife and I brought our 3 (now-adult) kids and my 80-year old mom. The kids, they’re in their 30s. There were six of us all together and we all had a fantastic experience! The flight to Rainy Pass was very smooth and comfortable and with the pilot and guide from Talkeetna Air Taxi we were in the hands of experts. We know that T.A.T. takes safety seriously, from the briefings and quick discussions and gatherings throughout the day, and then with our day at Rainy Pass the family thoroughly enjoyed the Iditarod and mushing experiences there. My mom was very comfortable and loved the experience. This was our first time with Talkeetna Air Taxi and we highly recommend them. Truly a top-notch outfit. Thank you, T.A.T., for this great day.
Incredible flight! Would recommend to anyone! The views from both the landing area and on the flight were beautiful. Ride was very smooth.

review_title: JL and Linda's trip to the iditarod
review_text: Excellent experience. The Talkeetna team was very friendly and attentive. This was our second experience with Talkeetna. we had flown them to the Glacier on Denali last summer and had an equally fun and enjoyable experience. Very safe flying. experienced pilots and very knowledgeable about the area. would strongly recommend Talkeetna

review_title: Excellent customer service when Mother Nature disrupts your plans.
review_text: I just have to say how impressed we were with the customer service. Our flightseeing tour got cancelled due to weather, and the folks here were so wonderful rebooking us three days in a row. Ultimately, Mother Nature had other plans, and we didn’t get to do the tour. That’s okay. The rule in Alaska is to be flexible since the weather is always changing. :) I just wanted to mention their customer service. Maybe next time TAT! Cheers from Tennessee!

review_title: Alaska is amazing to see from the air!
review_text:
Leighan, our pilot, was awesome.  She's from Fairbanks and has a lot of knowledge about the area and wildlife.   The views were fantastic.  I've posted some pictures but they don't do justice to the real views.   We've gone on multiple trips in the summer with Talkeetna Air, including glacier landings which were equally awesome but our destination to an Iditarod Checkpoint during the race was something we'll never forget.  Talkeetna Air didn't an outstanding job from the 1st time we came to south central Alaska and we've loved every trip.   

We booked the tour in advance so we showed up 30 minutes early as requested and we were quickly checked in.  You have to be weighed with everything you're taking with you but no one sees the weight except the person behind the counter.   Once everyone was ready we were taken out to an Otter plane and could pick out the seats we wanted.  I asked if I could sit in the copilot's seat (because we'd done this before) and got an awesome view!   It was about an hour to the Rainy Pass checkpoint but Leighan told us all kinds of interesting facts about the Alaskan range, the various mountains, rivers and wildlife.   She found the Iditarod trail and from about 2000' feet followed it and pointed out teams as we went by.  It was really cool.   It got better after we landed in Rainy Pass.  If you're interested in seeing how the Iditarod really works this is absolutely the best thing you can do outside of volunteering and being part of the race yourself.  Leighan was helpful in where to go and had us check in at 12:30 to make sure everyone was OK.  Seeing the teams come into the Rainy Pass, check in, take care of their dogs, talk to the vets and answer our questions was unbelievably nice.  The only thing that could have made the excursion better is if we could have stayed longer.  I highly recommend this trip (and the glacier landing tours)!

review_title: You will not regret this, experience of a lifetime
review_text: From the beginning, Amanda and Heidi were impeccable with their customer service.  It was unclear if flights were going to take off the day that we booked due to weather, but they kept in touch with our group both via text and phone, and even accommodated our group timing during the Iditarod season.  Our pilot, Mike was young and quite professional, answering any and all questions we had.  And the glacier landing...there are no words for this experience.  If you go with any group, go with this crew.  They are top notch with such a hospitable touch.  Our Everest base camp crew thanks them, and can't wait to return again!  We will be referring all our business to friends and family there.

Excellent flight to Rainy Pass. 
Great service, beautiful scenery, excellent pilot. 
I would highly recommend this air service.

went on a small plane to land on a glacier - you won't be disappointed.  Felt safe and in capable hands the entire time - the pilot was exceptional.  About 6 of us on board - and we landed safely on a glacier - was able to stay for about 30 minutes while we walked around and took amazing photos.  A beautiful once in a lifetime sight to see.

It’s hard to explain how incredible this experience really is. You fly all through the Alaska range getting up close to Denali. Our pilot was so friendly and knowledgeable. This was the kind of experience you see in movies but never imagine you’ll actually have yourself. I would do this a million times.

What a memorable Valentine's Day (early) outing we had today!  Our pilot, Leighan, and the whole Talkeetna Air Taxi staff made our excursion to Yentna Roadhouse so wonderful with their professional and gracious service. They were able to keep a secret, so this was a lovely surprise from my husband for our anniversary! The weather was near perfect, even with a bit of wind, but all was handled smoothly.  Thank you, T.A.T. and Leighan, for the wonderful day : ))

A perfect weather day for a flight to Denali and surrounding breathtaking mountains. The pilot, Leighann made it truly soecial. We felt looked after right from the first phone call.
Words can’t describe the experience. Alaska at its best. Thank you Talkeetna Air Taxi.
One of the friendliest staffs in any line of work, and the glacier landing is incredible. Don’t miss!

I'm fortunate to have taken this tour twice, including the glacier landing, both in the summer and in the winter.  I can't say that one was better than the other.  Both were breathtaking, but on the winter tour there were fewer tourists and I got to sit up next to the pilot in a smaller plane.  I am especially thankful that, on my last trip, they diplomatically put up with my fearful, hysterical sister, who initially refused to board the plane.  I was so embarassed, but they took it all in stride.  There was a little audio problem with one of the traveler's headset on my first flight, but I never had any audio issues myself.  The pilot's running commentary, while nice, is really not all that necessary anyway to enjoying the tour.  The views are so incredibly breathtaking that who care's what the name of this or that mountain is. A once (or in my case twice) in a lifetime adventure well worth the expense!

review_title: Winter adventure in a comfy flight
review_text: We did the winter adventure around Thanksgiving 2018. The weather on the day we had intended to travel was horrible. Totally not flight worthy but TAT was on top of this. I immediately was able to work out an alternate date for the flight trip. Their communication was spot on and they were the nicest people to talk to and even kept me updated on the weather to find the perfect opportunity to fly out. Really shows how much they care about their customers. The icing on the cake was our pilot. She knew the terrain like the back of her hand and navigated through some intense storms but yet giving us great views of Denali. I definitely look forward to visiting then again in the summer.

This was hands-down the best decision we made during our whole trip! From start to finish, the women at TAT were friendly, knowledge, and extremely hospitable. We did the 1-1.5 hour Winter Adventurer tour and it was absolutely spectacular. Totally worth the price for this once in a lifetime trip!

This was by far the best part of our four-month trip around the Yukon and Alaska. If you get a chance to get on one of these planes, especially on a really clear day, your trip to Alaska will be a success!

review_title: Couldn’t do the tour but they were transparent
review_text: We booked the tour around Denali with the glacier landing. We weren’t lucky enough with the weather so our tour was cancelled. The company called us the day before and on the day we were flying and offered either to reschedule or refund us but we had to take the refund as we were going to Seward later that day.

My wife and I went on a small 4 seater plane with just the pilot on a chilly October morning and it is an experience we will never forget.  We had signed up to land on a glacier, but there had been 5 feet of snow overnight and were unable to.  That's' just life and it didn't damper our experience at all.  There is no better way to see this majestic range than by air.  Book it, do a longer flight and have a memory you will never forget.  Thanks!

I've done some cool things in my young life..like dive with sharks, ride on the backs of sea- turtles, jumped out of planes, sailed the Caribbean, jumped from planes, jumped from buildings....THIS BY FAR beats anything I've ever done. The price is worth. Our small crew of 3 got lucky and had Paul as our pilot. Super humble, personal guy that acted like he was "just" 1 of 12 pilots employed at Talkeetna Air. Ran into a local from Talkeetna at the Denver airport on my way home and found out that Paul actually owns the entire establishment. Long-story short, that's just how cool they all are up there : )

We were so impressed from start to finish with the quality, care and personal attention received at Talkeetna Air Taxi!   General Manager, Annie was a gem and took really good care of us. The staff treated us like family.  Thank you Heather, Yvonne, Amy, Amanda and "Gretchen" (haha)  Yvonne is my favorite.  We were astounded by the views and sheer magnificence of the mountain ranges and glaciers. Our pilot, Clayton, was great!  And made sure we experienced all that the flight had to offer. From pointing out rock formations, knowledge of the history of the people and the overall area, to sharing details about the science of the glaciers and their development.  The views were breathtaking!!  I can't say enough... Thank you, Thank you TAT!  You made our day!

This was the highlight of our Alaska trip. Luckily had a sunny day and was able to land on the glacier. It was incredible. Our 3 yr old was so excited. We could spend longer than usual on the glacier as the runway track was covered in ice and had to be cleared before taking off. Don't miss out this amazing experience.

Amazing experience. Weather was not perfect. We were given choices with detailed explanation of weather, adjusted route and charge. We still decided to go and it turned out the trip worth every penny.

This was amazing. The entire staff was right on the money. The pilot made this a very comfortable experience with his sense of humor and keeping us aware of what was going on around us. The kangaroo on the side of the plane should be, a Glacier Hopping Experience.

This for sure was a once in a lifetime bucket-list experience! For starters, working with the office was so extremely easy as they had to move our tour 2 different times, and they eventually upgraded us to the Grand Denali tour with glacier landing for no additional charge! The tour itself - words cannot describe how amazing it was! We must have hit the jackpot because there was not a single cloud in the sky that day, and to be able to circle Denali and the surrounding mountains with unobstructed views is something I will never forget. Landing on the glacier was such a memorable experience that words simply cannot explain it! Our pilot was so great and so very knowledgeable, it was just the cherry on top of an already amazing tour. If anyone is visiting Alaska this is a MUST DO with this company!

We flew at 9am on September 4th. It was lovely seeing Denali from air. We later saw Denali through out the day on our shuttle trip at DNP on Sep 5. So guess we are one of the lucky few, 

Guys if you are reading this review what was the first glacier we saw before Ruth glacier and flying thru the grand canyon? was it the Kahitna glacier?

any way awesome value for money. we had a full hour in the air for $200, in Hawaii it's a 15 min heli flight for same amount!

i've uploaded 3 videos on our noncommercial site

review_title: Late season, Pilot was burned out, just a job for him
review_text: Nice flight, Richard is a very experienced safe pilot. We also had perfect sunny weather, not a cloud in the sky and very smooth. You could just tell Richard has flown all summer. He was tired of tourists and the same route around the mountain. He had no enthusiasm left for his ten passengers that day. I guess he doesn't care for tips or reviews. It was very informative narration though out the flight but had a very board monotone. The ladies in the office were pleasant and friendly. Someone even helped us with the boots after the flight. The Turbine Otter we flew in had a lot of power but had a nauseating jet fuel and jet exhaust smell the whole flight. It may have some leaks that need attention. Overall, I think it's the best way to see Denali. Getting out and walking on the Glacier was the best part.

We took the Grand Denali tour with glacier landing. The views we saw were stunning the experience itself was speechless. It was very calm the day we flew to Denali and the sky was crystal clear. It may look a bit expensive but with the experience we got, it well worth the money spent. Definitely go for it esp if it is a great day for flying! Comparing the pics that our friends took(who went for their Southside Explorer tour), our trip took us to the snow capped peaks. So I would say spend the extra hundred of dollar and did the Grand Denali tour, worth it! The glacier landing was so cool, we ran jumped and even lied on the glaciet with Denali at our back. It was incredible!
touring Denali and especially landing on the glacier was absolutely wonderful.  TAT staff were wonderful to work with.  Would recommend to anyone to fly TAT.

But I will try.....Fortunate to get a reservation due to a last minute cancellation.  Additionally fortunate, to do the flight and a glacier landing in perfectly clear weather.  Professional, helpful staff that made this a once in a lifetime experience. (Until our next visit!)

The company is awesome, super friendly employees who really seemed to enjoy their job. We showed up and they had upgraded our flight for free because of numbers. We got to be up close to Denali Mountain and the pilot was professional and a great flyer. Would definitely recommend the company and the Denali tour!
Should have done the longer flight. So well done from preparation to landing. The mountain spoke for itself! Do not miss this opportunity!!

What a fun experience this was. We thoroughly enjoyed our flyover and glacial landing.  An experience we’re truly glad we did while in Alaska. The only down side to the experience was the smell of gas in the plane. Was a little nauseating. Would have given it a five if it wasn’t for that.

This was an impulse last minute buy, but we are glad that we did it.
The pilot was very meticulous and informative.  Clouds prevented us from doing the circumnavigation of Mt Denali, but we had breathtaking views of glaciers and the mountain top.
When we returned, we were given a partial refund because of the shortened trip.
 Highly recommended!

This was our second time flying with Talkeetna Air taxi. It was an amazing experience again. This time we were able to do a glacier landing which we loved. We were fortunate to have fabulous weather and the views were breathtaking. The pilots and the staff at the base have all been so friendly and helpful. I would recommend this to anyone visiting Alaska.

We were fortunate in two ways during our recent trip with Talkeetna Air Taxi. We had perfect weather and the privilege to have Danielle as our pilot. Danielle's knowledge of Alaska made the trip interesting and enjoyable. We couldn't have had a better time.

This was the most amazing experience.  We had a picture perfect day.  Our pilot was great and the flight was wonderful.  Landing on Ruth Glacier was a once in a lifetime experience.  We used a coupon from the Northern Lights coupon book.  Buy 3 get one free.
The flight was amazing, we had a clear day and the ride was great, the pilot very fun and informative on the surrounds and the landing amazing, wel lworth it fi weather is good

What a great time we had!!  The flight around the glaciers and Mt.Denali on the unbelievable clear day was thrilling!  Our pilot Steve was so informative and had so much knowledge about the mountain, glaciers and the different mountains surrounding Denali.  We landed so easily on the glacier and watched others land too.  He took our pictures, told us more about glaciers and named the peaks around us.  On our return trip he continued telling us about the 35 miles of glacial "runoff" and that it will be there for our lifetime and more to come.  It was interesting to see the different colors and even large pools and ponds of water in the runoff as well.  Landing again was perfect and we all said that it was the best part of our trip!!  Don't miss this!!

The weather was perfect!  The staff was very friendly and the pilot was excellent.  The views were spectacular! Landing on the glacier was amazing.  We had a group of 6 for this tour and we all had excellent views since the pilot backtracked the flight.  I would say this is a must thing to do if you go to Denali to really experience the beauty and magnitude of this majestic mountain!

We booked a Denali flightseeing tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi and had an excellent experience!  The pilot talked to us on our headsets about mountaineering on Denali, geology, the glaciers, and local climbing history.  We were lucky to have a clear day, so the photo opportunities and the galcier landing were spectacular.  The staff is very flexible and helpful.  This was one of the best travel experiences I've ever had, and I've had a few.  Highly recommended!
Safe, spectacular, great information! Landing on the glacier was a highlight!! Alaska turned on a sunny day and we were so very lucky to have this opportunity!!
We enjoyed the flightseeing trip very much and the landing on the glacier was just so awesome. I was able to get some wonderful pictures of the mountain.

review_title: Perfect Flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi
review_text: Thank you to all the staff for a wonderful experience, from Mike the pilot to the lady who helped us with the shoes and gave us a sample of her rose petal jelly. A PERFECT afternoon for us flying around Denali and getting to land on the glacier.

We did the Mountain Voyager Tour on Sep 4th and it was just fabulous! Great value for money! We did this with our 4 year old son and 14 months old daughter. Our son loved it and wants to go back on the glacier 😊. Our pilot was great; very empathetic and knowledgeable! Strongly recommend Talkeeetna Air Taxi!

What to say?It was a day full of emotions, with amazing views all the time and the Glacier landing is simply a must, if weather conditions permit.We booked the Denali tour with glacier landing last 31st of August. Michael was our pilot who looked after us and explained everything. I was was lucky to sit next to him in the cockpit, and although I am an airline pilot, this experience was unforgettable, the views of Denali were spectacular, I think it was the only chance we had to see the top during our stay.The landing on the glacier was smoooooth, good job!!Cheers from Spain Michael!My suggestion is the glacier landing tour, and to be flexible with dates and time as weather is a factor. Call to Talkeetna Air Taxi and their helpful and friendly staff will give you extra information about how the weather is at Denali and Glacier landing conditions.

This flightseeing tour was definitely the highlight of our trip! I called around and spoke to a lot of different tour companies, but TAT by far had the best customer service and the most competitive prices. Talkeetna is an awesome funky little town - I recommend spending a night and taking a flight in the morning. Highly recommend the glacier landing if you can swing it; it was a once in a lifetime experience. Denali was absolutely amazing and is a must-see from the sky!
Great and must do this. I recommend this to everyone visiting alaska. Highly recommend Talkeetna air taxi.

review_title: Best part of my trip to Alaska
review_text: I was lucky enough to have fantastic weather for my trip to Talkeetna and Denali. The flight was wonderful and the views spectacular. The best money I spent on any excursion the whole trip. Would definitely do again.

Weather was less than perfect and we couldn't complete the Summit with glacier landing Flight.  However, pilot got us a lot a great views and a great glacier experience. Very professional and well done.

The weather cleared on our last day in Talkeetna, so we were able to take the flight around Denali with a glacier landing.  WOW!  It was an awe inspiring, breath taking, spiritual experience. Don't miss it if you have the chance.  Talkeetna Air Taxi did an outstanding job.  Thanks to all.

From my initial contact by phone to the perfect smooth landing back at the Talkteena airstrip, everyone was super nice and competent.  Matt, our pilot did a wonderful job flying and pointing out interesting points on our tour.  The landing on Ruth Glacier was incredible. Would highly recommend TAT and would advise everyone to take a flight seeing tour if at all possible.

Incredible staff and procedures at all points: booking, reception, explanations, pilot. We had high expectations and were still blown away. 100% worth it to land o the glacier. Great views from every window - and it doesn't matter which side of the plane you sit on.Thanks TAT!
Matt, our pilot, did a great job. Our flight was over Denali and the entire South facing range. The base operations were efficient and staff well trained.
The owner, Paul, was our pilot.   We had a great flight and landed on a glacier in a place called Little Switzerland.   The views were breath-taking.   This is a must do for any Alaskan trip.
From the check-in to the flight, everything was professional and friendly.  We absolutely recommend this trip.
We did the glacier landing tour. Everything was great. Nice plane, great pilot, good clear headsets, the pilot told us what we were seeing and explained things clearly. Highly recommended!
Great job!  We had a wonderful flight to Denali and landed on a glacier. The pilot was great, professional, and the weather was perfect!

This was an awesome flight tour. I've taken other flight tours in other parts of the world, but I think that this might have actually been my favorite. The weather was absolutely perfect and the scenery was just stunning.

The folks at Talkeetna Air Taxi were really nice and because they have larger planes, I was easy for me to get a seat even though I was a solo traveler (trying to get a flight out of Anchorage was hard because the planes are smaller and I had to try to find groups to tack onto). Everything was super easy, my pilot was awesome and a really great narrator for our trip, pointing out all of the peaks and glaciers and all that jazz.

This made my entire trip worth it. Also made everyone who didn't come with me super angry that they didn't!

review_title: The only way to see Denali
review_text: Excellent flightseeing experience by a very well run organization. The pilot was highly informative and professional.  Had paid for the flight around the mountain but weather came in and the pilot recommended we cut the trip back to the one that goes just to the front of the mountain due to the fact that we would not see much and would experience high turbulence.  We took his advice and the TAT refunded the difference.

The flight seeing and glacier landing is an experience not to be missed.  The company policy of full refund when the weather doesn't cooperate is also real and straight forward.  Very positive and friendly service.
This spectacular and magical journey transports you into another time and place. A tribute to our beautiful Mother Earth.I highly recommend you take this flight of wonder.
Amazing experience. Captain was great. Plane went around Denali and other peaks very close and then landed on a glacier. It was a perfect day and we enjoyed breath taking views.

review_title: Better the weather, better the experience.
review_text: We had a clear day. Rare, I'm told. The experience was amazing. To float above, among, between and land on the Denali mountain range with a photo to be had every 20 seconds makes you go 'should I not just be looking and soakin' it all in?' or 'shouldn't I be taking every photo I can?'For those who choose looking and soaking, then bring your polaroid glasses, it gets bright up there with all that snow, not to mention clouds. If you are landing on the glacier then sunburn cream is a good idea to wear, and take gloves and hat to keep your ears warm (it'll be 5-10 degrees colder than at the airport).For those who choose taking every photo you can, then a polaroid filter will bring out the best shots. Also if you can sit up the front this is definitely the time to use your panorama photo feature on your phone as you'll get front and side views that can only be captured this way, unless you have really wide angle lense. The advantage of not sitting up the front is that your windows are not curved and your camera can focus a whole lot easier on your subject. If there are two of you going on this trip make sure you sit on either side of the aisle so you can get different shots, you can share them later.Generally the air is smooth, its not the tropics with air rising and getting turbulent, this is cold air not doing much. But if you are airsick prone, looking through a camera eyepiece looking at land in motion, with the airplane turning will only make you more airsick sensitive. My advice (being a pilot)   in that regard is to a) take your motion sickness tablet at least half hour before take off b) have something in your stomach already ie breakfast or lunch b) take a piece of candy you can suck on the first time you get a hint of sickness c) take pictures angled forward rather than directly out the side (sense of motion is less) d) don't take pictures when the plane banks. e) look at the horizon after every photo to get your sense of up or down reset in your mind.Last suggestion, for those who put their pictures into photo books, you might want to take a few pictures of the video being played in the snow shoe fitting area. The shots I took were of the aircraft flying and landing on the glacier. These are going to be difficult to get in real life and will be handy for your photo story. This trip on a clear day is a must do for those who appreciate Gods handiwork, for those who love geography, for those who love flying and mostly for those who love photography.

Reasonably priced. Awesome experience landing on the Ruth Glacier - definitely recommend. Our pilot Clay was super professional, approachable and knowledgeable. Staff at the front desk are also super friendly and helpful. Very professional and safe. Definitely recommend. Thank you 👏

review_title: Fantastic time with a stunning view of the Denali peak
review_text: We couldn't have gotten any closer to Denali and the entire mountain range unless we were climbing it!  Our pilot gave a wonderful narration of the area which made it even more meaningful.  Soaring through the peaks is something we will never forget. Great experience from start to finish with this well organized and friendly operation.  Such nice people!  I highly recommend Talkeetna Air to anyone

review_title: High point of our Alaska trip
review_text: Literally and figuratively, the flightseeing and glacier landing were at the top of our trip. Less than ideal conditions prevented a full tour around Denali at our scheduled time and Talkeetna Air Taxi was very accommodating about offering alternatives. But due to our tight itinerary, we went ahead with the shorter flight option. Even with some mist and slight drizzle, the mountains were spectacular and the glacier landing thrilling. Staff and pilots are all super friendly and work hard to satisfy all needs and concerns.  After our flight we had a couple of hours before our train. They stored our bags while we had lunch and shuttled us to town and then to the train. Highly recommended.

We loved our flight. We had bright sun and clear skies on top but clouds at the landing zone and were unable to land, it didn't matter it was still beautiful. Our pilot was knowledgeable and everyone at Talkeetna Air Taxi was friendly and helpful.

review_title: Flight into the gorge - beautiful views
review_text: Our group went in a 10 passenger plane up to Denali and flew into the gorge to view the glaciers - it was an experience to not miss. Clay was our pilot, and he made sure everyone was comfortable and did a great job explaining our scenery and how the rivers and such came about.  A few days prior to this adventure, there was a different plane company that crashed and killed everyone aboard in the area where we would be heading.  This naturally made all of us nervous, but a call to the company assured us that their pilots at Talkeetna Air Taxi were very experienced with years of flying under their belts.  The person answering the phone did say there would be two pilots, but the copilot was one of the kids in our group in that seat, so that part was misinformation. Due to poor visibility, we did not get to do a glacier landing.  We did overhear the staff telling people that if a glacier landing was not possible, there would be a partial refund; that did not occur for our group - not sure why. I recommend taking some Bonine prior to the flight, and I don't get airsick but there is some swaying, etc. in that small plane.Our group had a wonderful time.

Thrilled to have taken this flight with my son. We had to postpone twice prior to our Denali visit due to the weather. Came back through Talkeetna on the low chance that we could go. Staff was super friendly and accommodating.

Real professionals.  Felt safe all the time.  Staff and pilot knowledgeable and friendly.They rescheduled us due to weather and got us the flight of a lifetime over Denali.Highly recommend.  Best part of our Alaska tour.

Very nice people, perfect and friendly service, wonderful flight, competent pilot, felt always safe, nice little airplane. We were lucky to have a perfect day and could see Mt. Denali in all its beauty. All in all: perfect.

This was the best part of our Alaska trip. Our pilot Clay did an awesome job giving an overview about the area and different Mountain View’s. The glacier landing was icing on the cake! It’s one experience no one should miss out.. I would recommend anyone going out to Denali to stop at Talkeetna to do this.

Dodging the raindrops was the story of our 9 day adventures in Alaska. Fortunately, we were able to move our glacier flight forward a day. The skies were sunny and bright throughout the trip and with Leighann as our pilot, we were safe and learned a lot about Denali. Although the peak was in the clouds, we saw plenty of magnificent peaks and valleys. On our way back to Talkeetna the rains began again. But we had experienced more than we ever thought possible. Thank you to the entire crew at Talkeetna Air Taxi. You are a class act!

We were scheduled for a glacier landing, but was told beforehand that, because of weather, we may or may not be able to land on it, depending on what the pilot determines. The pilot made no effort to let us know that we would no be landing on it. He rarely spoke a word on the trip so it wasn’t as pleasurable or informative as we expected it to be. Especially for if the ticket prices.
Great service and fantastic views. Well worth the price. Weather was great and aircraft comfortable.
The flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi to Denali was a wonderful and thoroughly enjoyable experience. The staff and pilot were all excellent and made the trip very worthwhile.

review_title: Great way to see the Alaska Range and Denali up close. Highly recommend!
review_text: Overall a great experience. Check in was smooth and efficient. The flight was awesome! Including the glacier landing - highly recommend. It’s a great way to see the mountains up close and is a stunning scene- beyond words. Worth the cost. We were very lucky that the weather cleared up for us to be able to see the mountain.

review_title: Fantastic experience but pick your day!
review_text: Took their Denali viewing flight. Because the weather wasn’t great we couldn’t do the whole trip around Denali but took the option of landing on the Glacier -worth the extra cost.Best to try to wait for good weather to get the best experience. Talkeetna Air Taxis were very helpful & flexible & our pilot was great.
We had an excellent trip from check in to finish. Very friendly staff and professional. Very accommodatiing to our group of six as we had to change schedules due to weather. Trip of a lifetime

Though trip and views limited by clouds and rain, it still was an amazing trip. Pilot was informative and clearly skilled. Will definitely take another flight when we come back in different weather conditions.

We recently went flight seeing and landed on a glacier with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  We got a beautiful day with blue skies and just a few clouds.  Seeing Denali and landing on a glacier was one of the best things I have ever done.  The staff at Talkeetna are so friendly, good at what they do, and reassuring!  Highly recommend this experience and Talkeetna Air Taxi!

We are so glad we chose to take a flightseeing tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi! The service was truly top notch and it was the trip of a lifetime. Our pilot was great at explaining what we were seeing and made for a smoother flight than even most commercial airlines! Would highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi to anyone who wants an unforgettable experience.
great flight.  got to see some great views of the peaks and glaciers.  then topped off by the glacier landing.  really great experience.

this was an awesome ride.  so beautiful in the air and on the glacier.  the staff was great, most helpful.  the weather did not cooperate at first but they kept an eye a the weather and i had a great flight.
This tour was greatest experience in Alaska trip.If I will go Alaska again, I'd like to join in this tour.

今天天氣很好，飛行員Mike技術高超，讓我們近距離飽覽麥金利山及其附近山逢及冰河的景色。還有降落到冰川。真是我看過最狀觀的風景。
用Tour saver的coupon,免費升級降落冰川，挺值得的。

Took a flight around Denali with K2. The pilot was very experienced and had a wealth of information to share. The sights were spectacular. Ground crew were efficient and readily refunded the glacier landing portion of the cost when weather prevented a glacier landing.

We took the glacier landing Grand Denali tour on 7/4/2018 with TAT. It was an experience that we will never forget. Clouds were covering the summit of Denali at the time of our tour, but our pilot took us around many different faces of Denali, Hunter, Sultana etc. so that our experience was still beyond worth the price. Landing on the glacier is a must do - just do it. It's like landing on a different planet. Would recommend this experience to everyone.

First I must say that the weather was wonderful on the flight and as such I am sure my experience was made that much better as a result. When I checked in I was discreetly told my tour would be a bit longer than expected.....bring it on! No extra cost of course, just logistics of that morning....I guess more demand for the longer tour. I was already super happy before we even took off! Felt I was in the midst of true professionals from the minute the check in process started. Overshoes provided for the glacier landing....do the glacier landing....totally worth it! Next upgrade was the co-pilot seat....great view from the front, just have to take photos from the side window to avoid the propeller but it was awesome. Pilot had 30 plus years of flying experience and knows the mountains very well. We saw Denali from every angle and the clouds kept at bay for the most part. Don’t hesitate booking your flight - you will not regret it!!

This place was awesome. They did everything to get us up in the sky. Mother Nature just wasn’t having it. Leighan our pilot was the best .. I would definitely recommend them to anyone going to the area. If I’m lucky enough to go back I will definitely fly with them.

Our flight seeing trip was amazing! Incredible views of Denali and the Alaskan Range. Pilot was excellent, great narration and skill. The glacier landing was really cool too, no pun intended. You have to do this if you want the best view of the mountains. No comparison to seeing them from the ground.

We got to see Denali!  The weather was perfect.  Our pilot was fantastic giving us great information during the flight.  The glacier landing is an experience none of us will ever forget.  My teens were nervous before we started but once we were in the air they were mesmerized.  So glad we decided to do this tour.
I have done this trip twice now. It's an absolutely stunning experience. Try to give yourself a couple of backup days, because the weather can be pretty unpredictable.

review_title: Friendly, competent staff make for a fun trip!
review_text: My husband and I took one of Talkeetna Air's flightseeing trips around Denali when we were in Alaska in 2001, so we were delighted when our son and daughter decided to do the same this summer.  Even though they were a bit nervous before they took off, their anxiety soon vanished with the competency of their pilot, and as they took in all the sights and then landed on a glacier on Denali.  It is a once in a lifetime opportunity!  Don't miss out!
The flight was wonderful, the pilot very nice, the whole operation very well organized. We'll never forget this experience.

review_title: BEST excursion of our 13-day Alaska trip!
review_text: This was our best excursion during our recent vacation.  The pilot was personable and professional and the equipment (plane and headsets) worked fine.  I would HIGHLY recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi to future travelers.
No words to describe!!! Just go do this. You won’t be disappointed. They take great care of you. Our pilot Jonathan was so knowledgeable.

It was our last of our stay and it had been raining everyday! I prayed the night before that we could see a glimpse! The view was breath taking and I could check it off my bucket list!  Alex did such a great job too!
Top notch operation and we would definately fly with them again...The pilot was very knowledgable about the area.

Our family took the tour with glacier landing and its an amazing experience. We had awesome views of  Mt. Denali. Landing on glacier was a memorable experience. We booked the tour in the last minute and Talkeetna Air Taxi was very professional and helpful in accommodating us. Highly recommend the tour.

review_title: HIGHLIGHT OF  THE ENTIRE TRIP FOR THE SECOND TIME
review_text: this was our second time to fly  talkeetna air,   first time we took a flight seeing, this time we landed on the glacier, it was the most amazing feeling i could imagine, there were two planes  of us in a family, and  we were together on the glacier for  quite a while,the beauty of the mountains as you fly through them as they tower over you is impossible to explain, YOU HAVE TO BE THERE, it is as if you can reach out and touch them, and the  skill and confidence of the pilots left  each of us feeling very comfortable and safe,  for two trips in a row  we had PETE as our pilot,  and  Shiloh  piloted  the other half of our family  on this trip, you not only get to see the mountains close up and  mt. Denali  as you could never do from  on the ground,  but from the time you take off  it is a running narrative of the region,  the mountain range, history of everything  you see and fly over or around, for us it is a MUST DO EXPERIENCE when we are in alaska, and if you only go one time,  be sure and take the glacier flight, it is worth the small extra it costs for the experience you will have.   the entire staff of talkeetna air is part of what made this trip special,  and by the time you land you will not only  have had the experience of your life that you will  want to tell everyone back home about,  but you will have made new  friends with your pilots,  it was truly a great time and when i get back to alaska, our third flight with talkeetna air will be at the top of our list,  we covered  alaska from HOMER down south, to DENALI NATIONAL PARK to the north, and the glacier landing and flight was without a doubt,  THE HIGHLIGHT OF OUR TRIP., SPECIAL THANKS TO PETE AND SHILOH, our pilots,  we will be back.   barry payne
Summit with Glacier Landing is completely breathtaking!   This is an experience like no other. Loved it!

Talkeetna Air Taxi was recommended to us by our local host, who is a retired park ranger and well versed in the weather and terrain challenges posed by this type of flight, so we felt reassured. Everyone at TAT was friendly, knowledgeable and competent. Our pilot, Andy Young, was a gem—he was kind and extremely skilled and comfortable in the cockpit and tirelessly provided us with information about what we were seeing and experiencing. He went the extra mile to make sure that everyone felt safe and comfortable. And experience of a lifetime—worth every single penny.
It was an awesome experience. Everyone we worked with was very friendly. They were very accommodating

Flying over the peaks of Denali on a beautiful day was one of the highlights of our Alaskan vacation!! Absolutely stunning views with an awesome landing on a glacier. Pilot Leighan was wonderful. Thank you TAT for the memories!
This was a bucket list excursion for us, and it didn't disappoint.  The only way to truly capture the magnificence of Denali!  The glacier landing was definitely a highlight for all.
Great trip I felt super safe and due to the experience of our pilot it was determined landing would be unsafe. I would recommend this trip and carrier to anyone. My son and I had a blast. Thank you.

We did the Grand Denali tour with the glacier landing and to say it was once of the most amazing experiences of our lives is an understatement.  The weather was with us for the most part, so the views were incredible.  Our pilot, Paul, was very knowledgeable about the area and put his nervous passengers immediately at ease.  Everyone we interacted with was genuinely excited about their work and the opportunity to share what they love with us.  I had been tempted to skip the glacier landing, but I am so glad we didn't.  Don't miss this!!!

So, not the normal review, but I felt I wanted to provide feedback on this company. We haven’t flown with this company, but I had booked with another company, that recently underwent a tragic event, and I was advised all their flights had been canceled. With two days notice I emailed Talkeetna Air Taxi, to see if they could fit us in, it took them 7 minutes to respond, to confirm they could take our booking (this was at 9pm at night!). A day later I was advised our original flight was going ahead, so again, I e mailed Talkeetna Air Taxi, to apologise and ask if I could cancel their flight, fully expecting to lose my deposit. They responded immediately, saying it wasn’t a problem, and I would be refunded in full immediately. So, so impressed with their service and how helpful they were, can’t recommend them enough. Thank you

I flew Talkeetna Air Taxi to Denali Basecamp as part of my Denali expedition.  This is the most amazing flight I have ever taken!  The small (and old, 1952) planes just danced among the clouds and darted between the peaks surrounding Denali before landing on the glacier.  Simply breathtaking!  They fly on sight only, so the weather must be clear - and that means that you will also see the incredible beauty of the mountains! Amazing!

review_title: Wow! Amazing trip and awesome staff
review_text: Booking was simple and the staff was very friendly. When we finally arrived a few months after we made the reservation, the staff treated us so well. Emily and the rest of the ladies at the check-in desk were fantastic. The flight was easy and smooth. Our pilot was very professional and made me feel confident in the ride, even though I was nervous about the flight. We did a glacier landing (strongly recommended) and it was unbelievable! Wear boots or they provide booties to keep your feet dry on the glacier. The only thing I would change would be to do a longer trip or do it again!

review_title: Amazing flight to Denali with glacier landing
review_text: This is a very reliable and friendly company.  If there are any weather doubts, their pilots opt not to fly.  We felt very safe on this trip and had an amazing adventure.

We were super impressed.  They weren't going to just take our money unless they could deliver a super experience.  We were scheduled to fly to Denali on Tuesday but it was too cloudy to see anything and they matter-of-factly informed us that it was not worth going and that we should reschedule if our schedule allowed.  It did and the next day was clear and the views were amazing.  The glacier landing was always worth the extra bucks.  We were treated so well and everybody was very professional.  Highly recommend them but have a flexible schedule if possible.

I was skeptical about Flightseeing as a concept, but after taking a trip with Talkeetna Air Taxi and our pilot Shiloh, I am convinced this is the best way to see Denali, and grasp the magnitude of the mountain, the range, and all of the glaciers and ice fields. I would absolutely recommend this to anyone visiting Alaska.

A co-worker recommended your company to us and you did not disappoint - and having a gorgeous day didn't hurt!  What an awesome experience, probably a once in a lifetime experience.  The experience went smoothly from start to finish and everyone at Talkeetna Air Taxi was courteous and friendly.  If we are fortunate enough to travel to Alaska again we would certainly consider taking another flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi!

I've used them alone as my transportation for week long expeditions, tackling Denali summit, and sightseeing with friends and family.  Smooth operation that runs on time.  For expeditions, they run a detailed and accommodating schedule.  During one expedition on the Ruth Glacier, they picked us up a day earlier than planned so that we could beat the incoming inclement weather.  Bathroom on sight.
这是一次令人难忘的旅程，从空中观览广袤的阿拉斯加。飞行过程平稳，我们一行有近70岁的老人和3岁的孩子。我们还选择了在冰川着陆，太美了，不容错过。
Well organized. On time. Everyone have seat next to window. Worth every penny although vistas will depend much on weather which is unpredictable in high mountains.

Talkeetna Air Taxi provided an amazing flight seeing trip of Denali.  The glacier landing was especially exciting.  One of the smoothest landings and take offs I have ever experienced.  Our pilot was informative and very enjoyable to talk to.....and a tremendous pilot.  I felt very safe.  Our original tour was cancelled and they tried very hard to reschedule us on a different flight.  It all worked out great!
The flight was wonderful! Our pilot did an excellent job of describing the landscape as well as our flight plan. I recommend this trip to everyone.

This was the highlight of our Alaska trip. The plane ride was incredible. The pilot was very competent and friendly. He made it a point that all on the plane had the same opportunity to see the amazing views. The walk on the glacier was absolutely amazing.
This was a great experience and a great company to work with. Very helpful and professional and try to make it the best adventure you can possibly have. Highly recommend!

We booked well in advance to ensure a spot with TAT for our climbing trip up to Denali. All staff and pilot were super friendly and helpful.  We were off just a few hours after our arrival to Talkeetna.  Both flights in and out of the glacier were spectacular.

Our trip with Talkeetna Air was unforgettable.  Everyone at Talkeetna Air was extremely friendly.  We were not able to land on the glacier due to the weather, but we were able to see Denali above the clouds.  It was beautiful.  The glaciers were an amazing site as we flew over.  The only negative was the trip was too trip.  We recommend this to everyone.  It was a highlight of our trip.

Taking off from Talkeetna, and landing on the mountain glacier was a highlight. Such beauty , and the folks are all friendly and great . Whenever someone mentions Alaska, it brings me back to this wonderful day.
Michael, our pilot, was awesome!  The scenery was out of this world amazing and landing on a glacier was smooth as silk. This was the highlight of our Alaskan trip.  Thanks so much!

Weather has made us cancel twice and sickness one other time.  Even with all of this the people are wonderful to work with.  We have scheduled for one more try and hope we can get to fly third time.  Weather was preventing us from landing on a glacier but most of the other trips were still able to fly.  Even though not able>>so far, have to give this business a 5 star for being great to work with.  So do not hesitate to sign up and scared of not flying, they will work with you and have promised to refund the money if unable to complete the flight.  Excellent business to associate with.
This trip was the highlight of our two week trip to Alaska. The entire crew and especially our pilot Alec were wonderful. Recommend this trip to anyone in the Talkeetna area.
Great flight and glacier landing around Denali. Very professional and welcoming. Had a wonderful time

Our flight around Denali was the highlight of a wonderful trip.  The views we spectacular!  Talkeetna Air Taxi worked with us to make sure we flew when the mountain was visible.

Fantastic

Our pilot was very experienced (a mother of two,had been flying the small plane for 15 years) and flew the plane smoothly. My friends plane was flown by an less experience pilot, good but not as great as ours.
Great adventure.  Pilot was friendly and knowledgeable.   Flight was exactly as promoted and did not disappoint.
I  really enjoyed going to the glacier and walking around.  The guide was informative and kept the flight interesting.

TAS was a great experience. The girls at the desk were very nice and informative. While waiting for the flight several exchanged pleasant conservation. The pilot was like one of your friends. Felt very welcome from everyone at TAS. Great service!!
Better than I imagined and worth the cost. The pilot was outstanding and the day magnificent. A great memory!

Our flight around Denali was fabulous! We took the gage and Denali trip and it was the best! I highly recommend choosing this to experience the glacier landing and to view Denali from every side. It was a thrilling,majestic mountain top experience!!

We took the Grand Denali w/Glacier Landing tour. Well worth it!! I am claustrophobic and had no problems with the plane ride. Every passenger gets a window and the most amazing view.  Any picture I took does not do the view justice.  Was so pleased with our pilot and the entire experience. Highly recommended.

Flying up through partial clouds to see the mountains up close was thrilling. Actually landing on the glacier was breathtaking. I could hardly believe it was actually happening. Our pilot was very cool and explained where he was taking us and what we were seeing. I'm so glad that someone convinced me it would be worth the $.

The eight of us were apprehensive (huge fear factor) but trusted reviews and recommendations that this would be the trip of a lifetime. SO true!! And the ladies at the counter calmed us down right away, reassuring us that it would be a peaceful flight with a magnificent view of the peaks once we got above the clouds. We appreciated their reassurance before we left as well as their excitement to hear how much we loved it when we returned. Our pilot, Richard, gave us great commentary as he took us up close and personal to Denali and the other peaks and then, what we think may have even been better, followed the paths of glaciers. It was truly a magnificent trip with stunning, breathtaking views at every turn. And absolutely no turbulence. It truly was peaceful. (We did the Southside view, not a glacier walk - plenty of time to see the grandeur of Denali and the beauty of the glaciers, valleys, etc.) Don't miss this trip! Everyone - from the ladies at the counter to the guys who drove us the short shuttle to the plane to our pilot - was fantastic to meet and excited for our excitement.
This was at the beginning of our 2 week vacation - everything was so so because this was so awesome!

We did the Mountain Voyager with Glacier Landing trip with our family of 9 including 3 grandchildren.  The reservations were handled efficiently and the check in and pre flight was great.  We were given waterproof booties to wear over our shoes for the glacier landing.  Our daughter had flown with Clay before and had called in several days before and asked to go with him again.  Our request was noted and Clay was available to do our flight.  He was very informative and offered a lot of information about the the area and the mountain.  The day we went was very cloudy and when we left, it seemed unlikely we would be able to see Denali.  Clay was persistent though and kept looking for breaks in the clouds while showing us the mountain and glaciers below.  He was finally able to find a hole through the clouds where we could see the top 1/3 of Denali and make out both the North and South peaks.  After that, he attempted to land at the top of a remote glacier but conditions did not allow that safely.  So instead we landed on the Glacier at the Mountain House  (It appeared that the Mountain House landing area was the

The staff was friendly and informative when I called before our trip. The day before our scheduled flight was rainy and the weather was supposed to be the same the day of our scheduled flight. Staff was very accommodating in switching our flight to the following day instead, which was in the 70's and sunny. Our pilot, Andy, narrated as he flew us from one beautiful sight to the next. Seeing my 87 year-old mother's face as she stepped on to the glacier was definitely the highlight of our Alaskan trip!

This flight was the highlight for us on the trip.  I could write for hours about how great it was.  I would also like to say that the woman who handed out the booties was really awesome.  She gave me lots of great information about Talkeetna.

review_title: Highlight of our trip to Alaska
review_text: The flight to view Mt McKinley and landing on the glacier was the most amazing thing we did in Alaska!  Talkeetna Air Taxi and pilot were very professional and I would highly recommend this company for the any flight around the National Park or Alaska for that matter.   I would do again.

We had a great experience with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  They were very professional, focused on safety, and their aircraft are top of the line.  Our pilot was a young woman with tons of flight experience.  She was also a great tour guide, providing us with lots of information about the area we were viewing from the plane.  The glacier landing was awesome.  A must do.  I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi.
The flight around Denali was great and landing on the glacier was awesome. Great pilot and staff. Would do this again and highly recommend it.

review_title: Wonderful finale to an amazing trip!
review_text: A glacier landing was the last excursion of our Alaskan adventure and all of us were so glad we did it.  The staff and plane were great.  They say everything is big in Alaska, this up close and personal view of Denali and surrounding range helped us realize how true that is.  We would definitely recommend this adventure!

Our flight over Denali with a landing on Ruth Glacier was nothing short of SPECTACULAR!  We waited out some weather but the wait was absolutely worth a “bucket-list” excursion.  
Many thanks to Talkeetna Air Taxi . . . you’re the “BEST”!
A must do on your trip to Alaska.  Spectacular views of Denali and Glacier landing was the icing on the cake.  Pilot narrated and explained what we were seeing.
Wow!!! What an amazing experience. The glacier landing was definitely worth it. Incredible views you can’t get anywhere else.
This was the highlight of our AK trip.  The glacier landing was magical.  I can't recommend it enough.  If you can afford only one AK tour, do this one!

Taking the Talkeetna Air Taxi was definitely the highlight of our trip to Alaska.  Jonathan was our pilot and did a fantastic job. Such a smooth flight and landing. Great commentary also. I definitely recommend taking this flight and landing on a glacier.  We landed on Ruth glacier.
I surprised my husband with a glacier landing. The trip was amazing! Everyone that worked there was very friendly and helpful 🙂
Awesome pilot, scenery and overall experience.  Love the customer service and welcoming atmosphere when we checked in.  It was an amazing day!

review_title: Spettacolare. L'unico modo per apprezzare veramente lo scenario del Denali.
review_text:
Andare in Alaska e non poter vedere il Denali è come andare in piazza Duomo a Milano e non vedere il Duomo !
Venti anni fa ho visitato il parco del Denali ne non ho potuto vedere il McKinley e le montagne circostanti per le condizioni meteo.
Quest'anno ho optato per l'aerotaxi ed è stata una scelta vincente. Talkeetna air taxi si trova a Talkeetna, circa 50 miglia prima di entrare nel parco Denali. Quindi anche risparmio di tempo.
Che dire? Una esperienza unica poter atterrare sul ghiacciaio con l'aereo e vedere paesaggi mozzafiato. (E lo dico per le mie esperienze escursionistiche sul Monte Bianco).
Altissima professionalità dei piloti e  aeromobili estremamente affidabili.
Il costo è sicuramente adeguato al servizio. Se vai in Alaska non lasciarti sfuggire questa opportunità !

I always wanted to fly to a glacier but never expected to land on one. The view from the plane which was a ten seater was awesome. Everyone had their own window. We landed on Ruth Glacier, the view was phenomenal. I don't remember the pilot's name but he was very knowledgeable and was just enthuse as we were. Do the trip and you'll never regret it.

This was truly a flight of a lifetime. The staff were all friendly & helpful. Andy was our pilot and took really good care of us. He warned us if there were "bumps" coming up & made slight corrections when needed to ensure the smoothest ride with the very best views. He knew about the history of the area, the mountains, & climbers. Denali Peak is a treasure & I am so thankful to have seen it up close & personal! You won't regret this one!

review_title: Super nice staff and awesome experience
review_text:
We had a great time with Talkeetna Air Taxi and would recommend it to everyone. The staff there was very nice and helpfull and our pilot seemed experienced and trustworthy from the beginning to the end.
We did a flight with glacierlanding - We loved it :)

Definitely recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi. The flight was smooth and the experience was like no other. Spend a little more and land on a glacier, you will not be disappointed. Our pilot was the best! It was a great adventure !

What an incredible experience!  We took the Grand Denali flight including the glacier landing.  The weather was kind so we were able to see Denali in all her glory.  The scenery was mind blowing, snow capped mountains, glaciers, picture postcard views as far as the eye could see.  This was a once in a lifetime trip that we will never forget so if you get the chance, hang the expense and just do it.

My wife and I arrived in Talkeetna around 2pm and found the visibility in the surrounding area of Denali to be very clear. although we had reservations for a flightsee the following day, the staff at Talkeetna Air Taxi were very accommodating and rebooked us for a 6pm flightsee with glacier landing the same day. It was an amazing experience and our pilot made every effort to ensure that people seated on both sides of the aircraft were able to view the same majestic peaks!

My family of four booked the Grand Denali with Glacier Landing Tour — it was incredibly breathtaking! The weather was perfect and the Glacier Landing was flawless! It was worth every penny and one of the highlights from our trip to Alaska! I highly recommend including this activity on your itinerary.

Loved everything about flying with Talkeetna Air Taxi when we flew in to Kahiltna glacier for an expedition on Denali. Great pilots, great great ground crew and they are so nice about driving you in to town for anything you may need to do before or after your flight. Thanks!!
Remarkable experience, solitude of the skies juxtaposed with the mountains. Highly recommended! Glacier was beautiful.

My family and I recently flew on the 1.25 hour Denali flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi flight when the weather in Anchorage prevented flying from there. We went to Talkeetna on the last day my family was visiting and the mountain was wide open. My mom really wanted to fly the mountain while here, and so we called and asked if they might have availability for a large group of 6 on short notice. TAT accommodated us and 3 hours after calling, we were boarding the aircraft. 

I have an interesting perspective of this flight because I fly commercial seaplanes off of Lake Hood  in Anchorage and my company does our own Denali tours, so it was actually about my 15th flight of the mountain. The flight really helped familiarize me with the mountain and offered new and unknown routes that I had not previously flown. We also learned a lot of history and information about the mountain that I can share with passengers of my own. The day right after flying with TAT I found myself giving a Denali on the mountain retracing our steps. I learned a lot from Matt, our pilot, and am very grateful for his insights about flying the mountain. 

Matt was happy to answer questions from both myself and my family, and they really enjoyed their experience. I can not thank him enough for helping me better chart and conduct my own tours of the mountain. Beautiful airplanes, beautiful scenery, and engaging pilots (I flew with these guys last year as well).  If you want to start your Denali tour while in Talkeetna, these guys are awesome.

A great experience.  One of the prettiest places on the planet. Our pilot, Dave, was skilled, knowledgeable about the terrain, friendly, and polite.  He added a lot to the trip.

Air was pretty clear and the landing at Ruth Glacier was terrific.  2 hours total.

No reason not to do this while you are in Alaska!!  One of several highlights of our trip.

If this review is helpful then please indicate so below.

review_title: Service is as outstanding as the activity
review_text: As one would expect, landing on Ruth glacier was magnificent, austere and gorgeous: The tour was just as billed. What was surprising was the level of service: we were picked up from the train, stowed our luggage in their office, were offered an earlier flight than our reservation, ate a picnic lunch on one of their three picnic tables after, and then they drove us into town to walk around, and then picked us up to get our luggage, and then drove us to our b and b outside of town. So they made our whole day in Talkeetna easy as pie. And this was AFTER we’d already had our flightseeing tour, their bread and butter.
稀にないような素晴らしい天候に恵まれて、一番小さな飛行機でも揺れることなく、また、パイロットの腕が良かったのか、ランディングもスムーズでした。機内からの眺めも最高で、氷河に降り、マッキンリー山を間近で見られる感動も感じられます。ランディング有りと無しの飛行があり、有りの方が100ドル高いけど、絶対有りの方がいいです！飛行中ヘッドホンで日本語の説明が聴けます。
We got cancelled out of a trip in Juneau and rebooked with Talkeetna Air, Our CC was charged for the trip, but once again the weather was not good. Received a full refund immediately. Great Service!

My husband and I took the Helicopter tour with the wilderness landing.  This was a cone in a lifetime experience and it ended up being the absolute highlight of our two week Alaska vacation. It was awesome! Danial was our pilot and she took us into the mountains, stopping on one of the surrounding hill tops in the midst of the mountains.  The view was spectacular. It was stunning.  Worth every dollar!! I'd highly recommend it!

review_title: Excursion was highlight of my trip
review_text: Glacier landing is a "must-do" in Alaska. Highly recommend Talkeetna Air - we have chosen this company twice - they will not disappoint with their service!

We saw a movie from the Banff Film Festival called Denali’s Raven that followed one of the TAT pilots and showed some of the scenery and booked based on that.  We did the middle price tour with a glacier landing, lasting about 1:45h.  You need to arrive about 45min prior to flight time to get checked in.  There were 10 people on our plane.  You are given glacier landing boots, you are walking around in snow.  Bring sunglasses and warm clothes.  The pilot narrates things for you through headphones while you fly.  He often circled around so both sides of the plane could see things.  While it was raining in Talkeetna, it was blue skies above.  We saw Denali—and the glacier landing was well worth the extra price.  We spent 10-15min on the glacier and got to watch other planes land on the glacier.  The views were incredible and I have so many amazing pictures.  Highly recommend this way to see the amazing beauty this state has to offer.
Fantastic flight around Mt Denali and a glacier landing at base camp.  Beautiful blue sky day and very informative pilot. A once in a lifetime experience.

This was one of the biggest highlights of our Alaskan vacation!  The glacier landing is a MUST!  The views from the air were breathtaking and the glacier landing was phenomenal!  From check-in, to the actual plane flight, to the very end, we were treated with great courtesy and care!  A

The flight-seeing tour of Denali was the highlight of our trip to Alaska --- and that's saying a lot!  We were originally scheduled for an afternoon flight on the day after our arrival in AK; when we arrived in Talkeetna, the view of Denali was obscured by clouds, and we began to worry about whether visibility would be good enough for the flight (not from the safety perspective but from a viewing/picture-taking perspective).  The check-in staff offered us an opportunity to speak with the pilot who was due back from the tour we were about to take to get first-hand information about current weather conditions on the mountain.  The pilot said that the peaks were obscured by clouds, and indicated that the weather for the following day was expected to be clearer (but of course, no one really knows what the weather will be from one day --- or even one hour --- to the next).  We decided to postpone our flight until the following morning, and as advertised, the staff was fully supportive of our decision and did not make us feel bad about backing out at the last moment.

Our decision to wait until the following morning was richly rewarded.  The weather was beautiful and the visibility was fantastic!  Our pilot, Shiloh, was excellent.  He provided great information on everything we were seeing and the flight was flawless --- very smooth and designed to give us an opportunity to get great views/great pictures.  It couldn't have been better!  I highly recommend this experience to anyone visiting Alaska (and those who live there!).  Five star experience!

We had the most amazing experience from the minute we walked in the door the staff was friendly and kind and They offered us sunglasses and boot covers. We were taking our 8 and 9 year olds with us in the Grand Denali with Glacier Landing. Our pilot Shilo took us up in a 5 person. Plane called Foxy and it was a breathtaking say. The pilot narrated as we flew pointing out all kinds of geography and geology. When we landed there was no-one on the glacier and we spent about 20 mins playing in the snow and taking pictures. We were encouraged to ask questions the entire trip and the kids were so excited to use the headsets! 
This was a once in a lifetime bucket list thing that was worth the investment! 
Also they have a van service if you need a ride.

Beautiful view of Mt McKinley and the surrounding range. Low flight through the mountain canyons with a glacier landing. Our guide Mike was very knowledgeable in his commentary on the tour and a very skilled pilot.
I took the summit flight and it was fantastic.  Great views and great pilot.  We landed on the glacier.

To start with, I would say TAT people are considerate. We were stuck in traffic and were running late for our tour. TAT waited approx half n hour for us to reach at pick up location. We did Denali summit with glacier landing tour. Tour was amazing, with breath taking glacier views.

This was the most amazing experience. Weather was gorgeous. Denali was completely visible! Matt was our pilot and he was very professional. Narrated and explained what we saw as we flew to glacier. Do glacier landing! It's so worth it. I'll never forget it.  It's expensive but worth every penny.

review_title: Wonderful Flight and Service to Denali Mountains!
review_text: We just came from Alaska Trip for 4th of July Holiday.   Talkeetna Air Taxi trip was the most wonderful trip out of our entire Alaska Trip.  They were so well prepared and entire flight was incredible.   Landing on glacier was such a wonderful experience to us like from LA and so smooth.   The scenery was magnificent and especially weather was incredible.  Talkeetna Air is the Best and you don't want to miss this wonderful trip to Beautiful Denali Mountains when you visit Alaska.  This is a MUST trip.   Thank you, Talkeetna Air.
This was the most amazing things we have ever done!  The flight and landing were spectacular!  This is something that everyone should do.

We extended our Alaskan vacation  in order to do this final experience and as expected, it turned into the highlight of an amazing trip. The beautiful flight to the gargoyle glacier at Denali and the landing were both magnificent. Our guide was amazing and so knowledgeable, making this excursion the perfect ending to a fabulous vacation. Thank y’all so much!!!
Great trip - very professional with emphasis on safety. The pilot was professional and informative. Would recommend to anyone!
Very good pilot, felt very safe. We were able to see both sides of Denali, the weather was perfect for our flight.
The Summit Tour was beautiful and the glacier landing was amazing. I gave 4 stars because the pilot was kind of rude.
Glacier viewing was great, recommend it to everyone. Staff was very courteous and we'll informed about the area . Would do this instead of going into park

Mountains are king of Alaska scenery, and Denali is the king of the mountains. This was a bucket list trip for us, and Talkeetna Air Taxi did not disappoint us. We traveled by the Alaska Railroad from Fairbanks on a Sunday, flew to Denali on a Monday and took the train back to Fairbanks on a Tuesday. From the earliest planning stages through the actual flight, the people at Talkeetna Air Taxi were superb. Without exception, their only interest was to see that we enjoyed our flight. They do it many times each day, but know that their passengers will likely have the opportunity to do it only once. Our deepest gratitude goes to Talkeetna Air Taxi for an experience beyond words.
The whole experience and glacier landing were outstanding but I do feel it is bit overpriced. The crew and the company is great and professional.

We really did have a great time in Alaska and enjoyed some beautiful views of Mt. Denali. However, a bit of advise for the flightseers. If you have the option to reschedule your flight because of bad or cloudy weather conditions, please don't depend on the front office staff for updates even though they are kept up on the constantly changing weather conditions by the constant radio chatter by the pilots that are flying around the mountain all the time. After listening to all the radio talk between the planes while on our trip, I asked the pilot about the day's condition in regards to all the radio conversations and he admitted that the day was getting worst by the trip. Long and short of this lessen was that we should have asked about specific mountain conditions and have postponed our trip until the next day which was forecasted to be a beautiful day and it was. Get a goof look at the mountain before your trip and ask the pilots about current conditions.

Our flight to Denali was very smooth and the scenery was awe-stricken! We would
recommend this flight company.

We booked the 2 hour flight with the glacier landing. The views were amazing, one of the most incredible things I have ever done. Once we landed on the glacier we were only able to stay for less then give minutes because a storm was coming but safety first!

review_title: Best flight ever!  Smooth and unbelievable scenery
review_text: This was the smoothest plane ride we’ve ever had.  Everything from check in to flight was very professional. We were lucky to land on the glacier before an ice rain.  What a beautiful sight!  My husband wanted to go again the next day.  Highly recommend.
This exceeded our expectations. Landed on Pika Glacier. Pilot did a great job as tour guide. Would definitely recommend this to anyone touring Alaska.

We got a great day with beautiful views of Denali and a smooth glacier landing. We had a great pilot, both experienced and very personable. Try to go in the morning. There is better visibility and the air is
Pretty humbling experience to see Denali up close from the air.    Amazing when we flew between some of the peeks!   Thanks for a great trip.

It seems everything aligned perfectly for us. We booked a great flight and chance to enjoy Denali Mountain up close and personal. The pilot was professional and friendly. The views were spectacular. The glacier landing was wonderful, and provided a memorable photo op! She made sure everyone on the plane could enjoy the special views of the flight regardless of which seat you had. We were fortunate the weather cooperated and Denali could be seen in all its glory. I wish everyone could experience our day. Thanks, Talkeetna Air Taxi, for a ride of a lifetime!

review_title: Fabulous views of Alaska Range and Denali
review_text: Expensive but well worth while flight from Talkeetna with glacier landing . We were surprised how despite the clouds around Talkeetna, we had almost prefect blue sky above the mountains. Excellent pilot - Thank you Matt.

Great experience from beginning to end.  They were all professionals from the email responses to the office personnel st the airstrip to the pilot!  The airplane was great and we loved all of the Mountain View’s but the glacier landing was the pinnacle of the trip.  We all loved it and would highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi.

Advance communication was fast and helpful, we had to postpone to another day due to bad weather, which was also hassle free. The trip itself was magical. We received a free upgrade and Matt, our pilot, gave the necessary information about Denali and happily answer any questions beyond that. Matt is also a great pilot, as my son confirmed (who flies flight simulators and got to be his co-pilot :-)). Thank you Talkeetna Air Taxi, you made our trip a once-in-a-lifetime experience!!!
Talkeetna Air worked with us to assure we flew on a day that we would have a great experience. The trip was nothing short of amazing!

review_title: Add Talkeetna Air Taxi Glacier Landing Company to Your Vacation Itinerary
review_text:
The Southside Explorer flight was an experience my husband and I will never forget.  We can’t give enough kudos to the entire staff of The Talkeetna Air Taxi Glacier Landing Company.  From purchasing the tickets, being sized for cleats over our hiking boots, loading us into a 6-7 passenger plane, and giving clear instructions prior to flight - this group worked as a precise machine - with personality.
Our pilot/flight guide Michael, was wonderful, knowledgeable about the Glacier/rock formations and very helpful (was always watching out for us, answering our questions and taking our pictures while on the Glacier).  One extra - an introduction to the Don Sheldon Ampitheater/Lodge.  Google it.  It is amazing to see this building among the mountains!

The flight back to the air strip continued to be just as interesting as the first half of the trip.  Be sure to look for houses / homesteads tucked away in the trees far from roads (families who live in the bush).  The Talkeetna Air Taxi is a great way to gain a very interesting/ different perspective of Alaska.
