Highlight of the Alaskan vacation!  Flew under perfect conditions. The pilot was very skilled, and pointed out all of the locations as we passed by.  The views are breathtaking.

review_title: Cloudy day , but went out of their way to make it special
review_text: Be flexible in your plans so if it is cloudy you can reschedule. The morning we were supposed to fly it was cloudy and raining. They asked us if we could go again that afternoon as it was to clear up and we could. they made sure we got on a flight and the pilot put forth his best effort to make sure we saw Denali! Even flying over and around clouds.

review_title: Fantastic day to see Mt Denali
review_text:
Flew with Talkeetna Air Taxi - nice plane, good pilot and nice perfect weather to see the mountain and land on Ruth glacier.
Best $300 , I spent!

Northern Light coupon book has a buy 3 get 1 free coupon for this trip, which can save >$300 if book 4 tickets in advance.  
Originally planned to take the flight on our way from Anchorage to Denali. It was very foggy on that day, plane can not land on glacier. The staff was very transparent, explained all options to us, and helped us to reschedule to a different day. 
On our way back, we took the flight with glacier landing. The view was incredible as described by other reviewers. Glacier landing was the highlight for the tour. I like the feeling to stand in deep snow, surrounded by mountains and watching other planes landing on glaciers.
TAT gave us a smooth flight with beautiful scenery, and had organized, efficient office operations.  Throwing snowballs in the middle of summer on a Denali glacier was a fantastic experience!!

The staff was great.  We booked our flight same day at their location in downtown Talkeetna.  They were super accommodating and were able to shuttle us to the air field that afternoon.  We choose to take the flight that circles Denali, lands on a glacier and then flies over Ruth Glacier on the way back.

Our captain was shy and not very narrative during the trip but the views and experience can't be beat.  I was the last one on the plane and ended up in the co-captain's seat in the cockpit.  

We had an incredible day for viewing the mountains.  It was 75 and sunny.  They provided us overboots for walking around the glacier.  The plane is heated and we just needed a light coat for the glacier stop.  Bring your sunglasses!  During our time on the glacier, a couple on our flight got engaged.  What a fantastic place to propose.

We missed seeing base camp or any of the climbers since the season was already over when we visited.  As a side note, we did also stop at the ranger station in Talkeetna to watch a 20 minute video on climbing Denali.  We aren't climbers but it was interested to learn how Talkeetna serves as the leaving point to climbers looking to summit Denali.

Thumbs up all the way.

Booked and paid in full for 4 adults for a flight over Denali- day in question turned out to be  fog so couldn't fly/land on Denali but were offering the alternative of flying in the lower area's. Transparent with the options available and also offered the option of an alternative flight and/or a refund. Opted on a refund as were on a time restriction and refunded in full without any issues- that is good business practice and deserves  recognition.

This was probably the highlight of the trip!  The plane took us in and around Denali National Park where obviously we saw Denali and the other mountains around it. Absolutely beautiful! We landed on a glacier and got out (brrrrr!). We were given about 15 minutes to look around and take pictures.  We then got back on the plane and headed back.  The trip was about 3 hours+.  The staff and pilot we're super friendly and nice!  Great company, great experience!!!

review_title: If You do nothing else in Alaska, DO This!!
review_text:
Landing on a glacier at 5000 feet is something else! We had a great view of the South Peak of Denali. Our pilot Leanne was knowledgeable and pleasant. But the hero of this trip is the plane itself which can take off quickly and get you up close to the mountain peaks. Expensive but truly breathtaking. Go late in the afternoon or early morning for best results. 
Note of caution: not every day yields the results we had. Often the peaks are
shrouded in clouds but there is still much to see and this is the way to do it.

We reserved the Grand Denali tour with glacier landing at 5pm. I was concerned about this because of low cloud cover during the day.  Our shuttle from the Princess lodge dropped us off at the shuttle stop and Talkeetna Air Taxi picked us up as we requested.  When we checked in we were advised that due to low clouds we would no be able to fly around the north of Denali, so we downgraded to the flight to the south of the mountain.  We were also told they hadn't been able to do any glacier landings yet that day but conditions were improving so we would put on goretex overboots just in case.  We met our pilot, Clay, and he took us to our plane.  He gave us instructions and we boarded.  My 14 year old struck up a great rapport with Clay as his co-pilot.  Clay did a great job getting us some great views of several glaciers and fantastic views of Denali and surrounding mountains. Words cannot describe the beauty of this.  At this point we knew we'd be able to land on Pika Glacier.  We landed and got out an were in complete awe.  Clay took some great family photos for us and other passengers and answered a bunch of questions from his passengers.  After about 20 minutes we took off from the glacier which was soooo smooth.  We continued to view more great scenery on our way back to the airport.  After the flight, instead of just dropping us off at the shuttle stop they dropped us off in town so we could get some dinner.  This is a Class A operation all the way around.  I highly recommend doing the glacier landing with Talkeetna Air Taxi.

review_title: Southside Explorer with a glacier landing (Ruth Glacier)
review_text: What an AMAZING experience.  Leighan, our pilot, was knowledgeable and really awesome.  My boys (twin 7 year olds) loved their snowball fight up there. We lucked out and had one of the top 10% clear days for our flight (according to our pilot).  It was breathtaking up there being so close to the peaks.  Cannot recommend this enough!

We had a group of 7 who all wanted to do the glacier tour. We added the landing on the glacier. This is a must do!! WHAT AN INCREDIBLE FLIGHT AND LANDING! it was awe inspiring. Granted it was expensive but what isn't in Alaska.  It is a must do and see.

A friend and I flew with Talkeetna Air Taxi in June and LOVED it.  A flightseeing tour of Denali had come highly recommended by someone who had visited Alaska before, so we splurged on the activity. 

We chose the Southside Explorer + Glacier Landing tour... Our guess was that the views we'd see from any of the other tours would be marginally the same but that adding the glacier landing would greatly add to the experience.  So by saving $ by choosing the cheaper tour, we felt more justified in paying extra for the glacier landing.  

It was worth it!!!!  The glacier landing was the coolest part of the trip.  Keep in mind that the planes might not always be able to land on the glaciers depending on weather.  When we checked in before our flight, they warned us that we might not be able to land because weather near the glacier had not allowed them to land all day.  They said that if we weren't able to land, they would reimburse us for the additional glacier landing cost.  We were so lucky that the weather actually DID allow us to land, and I am so glad they did.  The boots that they give you kept our shoes and socks dry (they easily fit over your shoes and have gaiters that cinch up on your calves.)

We were also lucky that day that we were able to see the mountain.  A layer of cloud over was chopping off the top of Denali from the ground, but our pilot was able to climb above the cloud cover to give us a view of Denali and its neighboring peaks from above the clouds. Mesmerizing!!  I speculated that the pilot was able to get the plane that high because our tour only had 5 people including the pilot so the plane weighed less.  I wonder if a more crowded tour would have been able to do that?  Might be worth asking them that, and if that is true, then I would recommend taking a less popular trip to maximize your chances that you'd be in a plane that could climb high enough to see the peak.

Worth the splurge!
You can sum up this experience in one word.  INCREDIBLE!!!  Well worth the price.  Would highly recommend them.

review_title: You just cannot fathom the scale!
review_text: Spent a month in AK- was the hi-lite of the trip! All the staff are extraordinary-very customer service oriented, great crews and grounds ops. Aircraft was top notch.  Narration was very good, and the scenery spectacular! You cannot imagine! Landing at base camp was silky smooth on new snow. Dave was great pilot. He made sure everyone got views and shots. Hard to keep your jaw from dropping!

review_title: Aerial view of a pristine landscape
review_text: Getting to see the pristine Alaska range and Mt. Denali on a day with wonderful weather was the highlight of our Alaska visit. We (two adults and two small kids) did the Mountain voyager with glacier landing. The people at  the Talkeetna Air Taxi were very friendly and did a good job answering our questions before the trip. We used the toursaver coupon and called in ahead to confirm they will accept it for the time we wanted to fly. Special thanks to the pilot Chris for a smooth ride and a good commentary of the peaks, glaciers and the rivers as we flew. I will leave it to other gifted writers to describe the beauty of the majestic landscape. My kids thoroughly enjoyed the time on the glacier. I only wish we could have spent more time on the glacier.

We (my husband and I) decided to do the Helicopter tour after a recommendation from a friend. This company was very accommodating as we had a lot of rainy weather during our trip and they were flexible to make our flight happen on a nice day. It was worth every penny. Favorite part of our Alaska trip. Very intimate experience and able to see closer to the ground compared to a plane tour. A few things to consider when choosing a helicopter tour are; you are not able to land on a glacier compared to the plane, but we were able to land on a mountainside and it was breath-taking and there is a weight restriction of 280 lbs per person.

review_title: Spectacular views, comfortable flight, and great customer service
review_text: You have a much better chance of seeing Denali from a south-side flight-seeing trip, than from the bus in the National Park.  But, in addition, these flights fly low through the valley and over the glaciers leading up to Denali, and this is really the amazing part.  These flights are comfortable and very 'safe' feeling.  The take off and landing, even on the glacier, are almost unnoticeable.  Great view for everyone in the plane, although getting a turn in the co-pilot seat is a real treat.

The flightseeing tour of the Alaska Range through Talkeetna Air Taxi was the highlight of my visit to see my son this year.  It was exciting to see the range up close and to land on Pika Glacier was a thrill.  We enjoyed seeing the range at 6,000 feet and 10,000 feet.  Totally different perspectives.  Our pilot was a lot of fun.  This trip is surely worth the time to get there.  Be sure to call in advance to confirm the weather.
What a thrill to ride in this old style plane , see the peaks and land on the glacier.  Hard to describe in words how overwhelming it was to stand on that glacier and be in that place.  Tremendous.

review_title: Glacier Landing! Engaged on Mt. Denali!
review_text: Yes! (For more than just one reason!) My boyfriend and I were planning our trip to Alaska and this came up as one of the top rated attractions - for good reason. We knew we wanted to do the plane tour but the glacier landing was one we were debating on. Although it's not that much more money, Alaska is already expensive and we didn't know that it would be worth it. Well, it was! Little did I know that my boyfriend had called TAT ahead of time to mention that he was going to propose on the glacier. Upon arrival, I had no idea! The entire crew knew and treated us just like everyone else, which was kind and helpful. The takeoff and plane tour itself was great. There was never a concern for safety. The pilot kept us informed throughout the trip on where we were flying over and facts about the mountain. Landing on the glacier was really cool, as was walking around in a couple of feet of snow on the most quiet and serene place I've ever been. Nothing compares. The pilot took a

No words to really describe this experience.  Breathtaking!!  I have now been to all 50 states and to Europe several times, and hands down this is my all time favorite adventure!! Our pilot Andy was great!!  Will never forget this experience!!

The flightseeig tour was incredible! I didn’t know we’d get that close to the summits of the mountains. It was just stunning. A must-do if you’re in the area. You get to see far more or the Park and surrounding areas, glaciers (and how windex-blue the glacier water is!), and Denali itself.

review_title: Glacier snowballs, surreal views, & ice therapy
review_text: I had a blast trudging through glacier snow, falling down in it and letting the snow give my fatigued hiking muscles the perfect all enveloping ice pack treatment!   My husband and I enjoyed snowball fights while inhaling the clean mountain air and taking in the pristine scenery.  Lie in the snow.  It feels great!
Mind blowing experience seeing the mountains up close and then landing on a glacier. A bit expensive but I would say well worth the money.
Mid june trip with teens.  Safe and nice sights even that airplane can not land on the glacier.  Pilot climb and nice view of denali peak
Took the flight to Denali. Landed on the glacier. Amazing! Our pilot Lee was fantastic and very knowledgeable. Would do it again.
I had the most amazing flight tour with this company. I recommend this once in a lifetime experience to anyone.

review_title: Great tour but are at the mercy of the weather.
review_text:
They were very accommodating of our changing plans and I emailed them with a request to change the time and they did that immediately.

We were booked on the mountain voyager with glacier landing (which is a must in my opinion). Due to the weather, they offered other options on the day of travel including canceling at no charge.

We went ahead anyways and our pilot Paul was fantastic with tons of travel and flying experience. The views are spectacular and the glacier landing was special. We got to meet mountaineers at their base camp as well when we landed on the glacier.

Must do in my opinion. I hope you have better luck with weather when you do.

We have enjoyed Glacier Landing.

Flight attendant manage to get the airplane landed, and he is excellent.

AWESOME trip. While we couldn't land on the glacier or do the trip we had originally booked because of low clouds - it was still terrific! I'd recommend that you do it even if you won't see Mt McKinley.

Our pilot was as much a kid for what he was seeing as we were.  He took the time to twist and turn so everyone could get the best view.  The glacier landing  was mind-blowing... pay the extra!  The entire staff seemed to get great enjoyment out of making flyers happy and comfortable.  A month in Alaska and this is our #1 memory!

Wow! Amazing! Gorgeous! What an experience! We were thrilled to take this adventure through the Alaska Range and fly around Denali. Our plane held 10 people so it's not a small 4 seater so we felt very comfortable and safe. Our pilot made sure that everyone got to see everything from both sides of the plane. We initially were to fly the next day. I called in the morning the day before to check on weather conditions for the following day The office staff asked if we could fly that day as the conditions were really good. They changed us to an afternoon flight so we could have the best experience possible. We greatly appreciated their concern and efforts for us. If the weather was better the next couple of days we would have flown again. Definitely doing this again when we come back to Alaska!!

review_title: great safe flights and good glacier landing.
review_text: I think they do a great job being safe and supplying boots etc.  I thought our plane would be smaller like a cesna and a smaller group.      I wish the pilot was interactive with headsets instead of 1 way communication but it was a beautiful safe landing in the ruth glacier.

review_title: The best way to see Alaska
review_text: I was hesitant at first because of the cost but It was the best part of our trip. The flight was smooth the views where amazing. Go for the glacier landing. You only live once!  Johnmeisterrealtor.com

This is my favorite experience of our Alaska trip! Sit up front next to the Pilot!
Fabulous views and the glacier landing is gorgeous and I want come back and repeat! Our Pilot was fabulous!

We had reserved a flight on June 11th, but we were unable to do the flight we had reserved because of the weather.  The staff were really helpful in trying to make sure we got a flight we were happy with and they gave us a private flight including a glacier landing, which was absolutely fantastic! Our pilot, Jonathan was superb, very professional and knowledgeable.  We would recommend this company to anyone who wants a flight in the Denali area.

An EXCELLENT adventure! Great people that work there. Dave (our pilot/guide) is retiring soon, but I think the others are probably great too. The folks in the office were all VERY friendly, answered all questions, and just did an all around great job. I did the 'Grand Denali' tour. Not cheap, but for a once-in-a-lifetime experience, absolutely worth doing. I can't say enough good things about TAT

review_title: Worth the money. A bucket list item.
review_text: It was a little tough to spend $400 on flight from Talkeetna to Denali when it costs about that much to fly from Los Angeles to Anchorage. However, we were so glad we did. It has been a bucket list item of ours for many years. The equipment and pilot were top notch. If you are going to make the trip, you need to spend the extra for the glacier landing. It was a highlight. The views are breath taking. Every picture we took does not do justice to what we witnessed first hand. We were lucky to see Denali on a clear day. The communication with Talkeetna air taxi and customer service was top of the line. I called and emailed a couple different places when we were booking our trip. Talkeetna had the best and fastest responses.

review_title: Great flight. Courteous and helpful staff.
review_text: Great flight. Enjoyed close up and personal views of the mountain. Glacier landing is worth the price. Very good pilot and solid safe flight. The company does a great job of organizing flights and offers several packages with different experiences to meet guests expectations. Treats every customer well!  Great experience!

The glacier landing flight was one of the highlights of our trip to Alaska.  our pilot Dave was amazing and very informative on the flight.  spending time walking around on Ruth glacier was an experience we will all remember.
I’ve never met a friendlier or more competent staff in all my travels.   Easiest and most enjoyable part of the trip!

Talkeetna Air Taxi picked us up in downtown Talkeetna and took us to their location.  Everyone gets a window seat and headset to wear to hear the pilot.  Pilot was awesome!  Felt very safe. review_title: Amazing flight and glacier landing in the Alaska Range (near Denali)
review_text:
This is my second time flying with Talkeetna Air Taxi and both were fantastic experiences.  We flew in a retrofitted DeHavilland Otter which handles wonderfully in the unpredictable conditions of the Alaska range.  With perfect, cloud-free weather, we flew around for about 45 minutes seeing many of the ranges more spectacular spires before landing in a glacial bowl surrounded by 10,000+ foot peaks.  Our pilot was very familiar with the area and offered a detailed narration during the flight.  During our landing, he was able to elaborate in as much more detail.  

Talkeetna Air Taxi has been doing this for a long time and it shows in their efficiency and professionalism.  Everyone we interacted with from booking the reservation to getting off the plane were very friendly, down-to-earth and professional.  They all had great energy, which added to our excitement for the trip.  Two members of my group got to sit in the co-pilot's seat (one going out and one coming back) which made their trip all the more memorable.  

TAT very generously offered our active duty military group a discount, which they certainly didn't have to do, especially at the height of the flying season.  They entire operation has a very relaxed, community atmosphere, which is how things are supposed to be in that part of Alaska.  They generously share that attitude and experience with their customers in every aspect of thrip.   I hope to go up with them again when my kids get old enough in a couple years.

Grand Denali okruh letadlem s přistáním na ledovci je naprostá PECKA!!!
Sice to není levná záležitost, ale pokud Vám vyjde počasí, nebudete litovat!
Úžasné pohledy z letadla a k tomu cca 20min na ledovci mezi přistávajícími a odlétajícími malými letadly je nezapomenutelný zážitek!

talkeetna air is very professional and pilot chris was no execption. this is a must must must do. glacier landings on a beautiful day is jaw droping. no words can explain. this was our second time and if we come back it will be on our agenda.

review_title: trip with son with glacier landing

Almost didn't get to do this tour because of the weather but we waited around in town for about an hour and the weather cleared up. Great experience with a great pilot. Landing on the glacier was the highlight!

We were supposed to fly out around 8 a.m.but the weather on Denali was poor.So when we got to the airfield they told us they would try to get us up to see Denali if there was a break in the clouds  but also said we could wait to see if it cleared later. We decided to wait and while waiting and seeing other sites they kept in contact about what was happening weather wise. At 1 p.m. we decided to go anyway.We were told we would not be able to see the summit but we could see some of the lower peaks and glaciers. The pilot, Matt, was awesome! He flew us up and down the glaciers and although we didn't see the mountain tops he really made the trip memorable, maybe as good as seeing the actual mountain.

Had a SAFE flight on this airline! I was incredibly nervous prior to flying. However, our pilot, Andy, made me feel at ease and provided a wonderful, smooth flight. He really knew his stuff, and gave great commentary, eager to take questions. He provided incredible views, making sure to show both sides of the plane the stunning scenery. When the glacier we were supposed to land on didn’t have conducive weather, he found an alternative site for us to land - we also saw two avalanches! We would recommend upgrading to the glacier landing - definitely made the experience unforgettable. When my dad left his phone on the plane, Talkeetna Air Taxi searched the next flight ASAP upon its return and gave us a call right away letting us know they found it. Everybody was so friendly and they truly went above and beyond!

Talkeetna Air was wonderful from beginning to end. Easy to work with and very accommodating, we could not get there in time for our original flight time but they helped with arranging another one without hassle. The trip itself was a once in a lifetime adventure, worth every penny. The people at the glacier were knowledgeable and kind. I would highly recommend going on a dog sledding trip when in Alaska and very highly recommended Talkeetna Air.

Mirka and Jozef from Slovakia :)

It's our first time visit Alaska. And also first time experience for my parents to take small airplane. The pilot is awesome and the whole flight is nice and smooth. Also, of course, the view is really amazing!

review_title: Tremendous Experience - Even with a Major Disappointment
review_text:
Our flight-seeing experience started in downtown Talkeetna at the cozy information/reservation office. There the representative used a cool 3D map of the mountain range to show us exactly where each of the tour options went and what was included in each. He was exceptionally helpful in describing all aspects of the tours, comparing and contrasting them and offering insights regarding the day’s weather and its possible impact on the flights. We ultimately chose the Grand Denali Tour and received directions to the Air Taxi airfield.

When we arrived to check in, we filled out the paperwork, were weighed in (the planes have a weight limit), and were directed to the storage area for the glacier boots. We told the desk person that we did not reserve a glacier landing tour. She whisked us outside and explained in hushed tones that we were being upgraded – no extra charge. They had a glacier flight that was not full; we would complete the seating (if we didn’t mind). We didn’t! 

So far, so good. We got our boots and relaxed on the large deck overlooking the airstrip. We waited and watched a constant parade of planes take off and land. And we waited. And we waited. For more than an hour we waited our turn while clouds gathered around the mountains in the distance. By the time we boarded our plane, the gorgeous day with wide-open blue skies had turned gray and the “seeing” part of our flight-seeing tour was in jeopardy.  

Sure enough, by the time our plane arrived near Denali, the pilot told us the visibility was too bad for us to make a close approach and fly-around of the mountain. I could not help but think, “There’s a thousand bucks down the toilet.” 

Nonetheless, we veered off and made our way to Mt. Foraker, the second largest of the mountains, as well as Mt. Hunter, the third largest. We flew close in to both and along the way traversed mountain valleys, zoomed over other peaks and followed glacial paths, viewing the brilliant colors, the deep crevasses and the sparkling open waters that dotted the tops. Each bank around a mountain’s edge brought more awe-inspiring scenery. As we dove down into another pass, our pilot announced our descent toward the glacier. As one side of the mountain pass opened below us, we could see a makeshift airfield at the far end of a second valley. We turned toward the site and were soon skimming over the snow and ice, taxiing in next to several other tourist planes.

I’m from Michigan. I’ve seen my share of snow. I’ve wandered wilderness areas in the winter. This, however, was other-worldly (think Hoth from Star Wars). We were surrounded by towering cliffs on three sides, with added rivers of snow flowing down between edges, adding to the mass we were on. We walked about the glacier for about a half hour, taking photos, watching other planes take off and land and learning glacier facts from our pilot. Before leaving, our pilot took photos of everyone and gave us the itinerary for the remainder of our flight.     

Taking off from the glacier was an experience. First, we were heading downhill, as the glacier was flowing downward into the large valley we turned from originally. The glacier’s edge dropped off precipitously into the valley, so we had only a limited amount of “runway” – kind of like flying off an aircraft carrier. Lastly, the air currents were dramatically different inside the valley, and they would hit the plane perpendicularly as we flew off the edge of our glacier and into the larger chasm. Fun.  

Believe it or not, it was! How often do you get to experience something like that? Our pilot lifted off and arced into the valley and quickly ascended above the valley walls. Before we knew it, the entire range was again below us and the green flatlands surrounding Talkeetna beckoned us back to the airfield. As an extra on the way back, we saw a large brown bear walking along the shoreline of one of the many lakes below. 

Once back on the ground, our pilot told us that we would be compensated for the disappointment of not viewing Denali – we’d all be getting a partial refund. In our case, this was pretty sweet, as we’d already received a free upgrade. The refund was substantial, too, so it made the overall experience all the better, knowing that the company treated their customers that fairly.

Even without seeing the star of the show, the Talkeetna Air Taxi flight-seeing experience was one I’ll never forget. They have to get a demotion for the long delay between check-in and take-off, which ultimately caused us to miss the view of the summit; however, everything else was absolutely first class. The sales staff and airfield personnel were friendly and professional. Our pilot was excellent and a fine tour guide, too, and Mother Nature set an incredible table for us to enjoy. I felt completely safe and comfortable in the plane, and the headphones worked very well to both reduce engine noise and provide the pilot’s commentary. 

As alluded to earlier, this is not an inexpensive experience. Unless you have a sizeable disposable income, this will likely be a once-in-a-lifetime kind of thing, but it is certainly one to consider, and I think well worth the price – especially if you have a camera with a ton of memory. Anecdotally, I’ve heard that Talkeetna Air Taxi is considered the better of the flight-seeing tours available, and I found nothing that might argue the point. If you get the chance, open the wallet and fly off into the wild blue yonder. You will not regret it (unless you forget that camera).

review_title: An Incredible Air Tour of Denali
review_text: This was our first trip to Alaska (my wife, five year old grandson, and I) to take our grandson to visit his father who is stationed in Alaska.  We originally planned for the Grand Denali air tour but the north side was not cooperating.  The Mountain Voyager air tour and landing on the glacier was simply incredible i.e., it was not a disappointment.  We did not originally want the glacier landing but landing on the glacier is an awesome experience.  To be on the glacier, standing near the sheer upslope of the mountainside and the brilliant blue sky, white snow, and the granite scenery is a humbling experience.  The excitement of our five year old grandson on the takeoff from the runway, landing on the glacier, running on the glacier, throwing snowballs, and taking off the glacier was worth the price of admission and a priceless memory we will never forget.  When we returned back to the airstrip and returned our boots/overshoes, we literally had to wring our grandson's socks from all of his snow related activities on the glacier.  Each employee at Talkeetna Air Taxi was very nice and professional.  Our pilot shared his wealth of knowledge as we all took in the beauty that was around us and provided us with a very pleasant flight.  We definitely recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi if you are able to visit Alaska.
An amazing experience and definitely a highlight during our 2 week trip to Alaska. Highly recommend!

We did decide last minute to take the flight seeing tour of Denali since it was absolutely gorgeous on the drive up to Denali Park and it was brilliantly showing off its beauty today.  Talkeetna Air and Taxi was wonderful and able to fit us in so last minute. Our pilot Leanne was fabulous. The views were breathtaking and so amazing to be inside the canyons and glaciers and getting a perfect view of Denali (Mt. McKinley).  The vibrant blue waters were so brilliant they reminded me of sparkling jewels, perhaps what blue diamonds look like.  I guess you get just a handful of days like this day and we felt so blessed to have had this opportunity to see it. We opted not to do the glacier land mainly due to extra expense of 5 of us and just a short time on the glacier.

My husband and I spent years taking care of my mother who suffered with Alzheimer's Disease.  It's such a cruel disease and wrapped it's claws around the three of us.  After my mother passed, we needed a spiritual reset.  We were in Vermont caring for my mother but live in Maine.  Exploring Alaska was a dream that we decided to fulfill.  There were moments that took our breath away during our adventure.  Our flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi provided one of those moments.  Everyone that we encountered was so helpful, friendly, and considerate.  Our pilot, Shiloh, was awesome!  He was very informative, caring, and light hearted.  His love of his plane and the mountains was evident.  My mother's death provided her with a release from her disease but my husband and I were left with sorrow and exhaustion.  Thank you all for the experience that allowed us to be a little closer to heaven.  It was just what we needed.
Amazing flight, service and overall experience.  Thanks so much!  We have already recommended you to our family.

review_title: Denali flight and glacier landing, spectacular scenery and excellent pilot
review_text: We so enjoyed this flight and tour, it is remarkable and we were so lucky with our weather, all the scenery was crisp and clearly visible and the pilot landed on the glacier with great skill.  There were a couple of mild bumps during the flight but the pilot explained what would happen and when, so no drama and very mild.  We highly recommend to all.

Our party of four booked the Southside Explorer (one hour flight plus glacier landing). When we arrived that morning we received a weather briefing and learned the glacier landing would not be possible if we departed at the scheduled time.  We were presented with options i.e. flight only (glacier landing component of booking to be refunded), wait 45 minutes to see if weather would permit a landing, get a complete refund, or rebook for later in the day.  We decided to wait after which time we learned the glacier landing would be highly unlikely but the low cloud would not impact views of the mountains.  We decided to go ahead and were fitted with the glacier landing gear just in case.

The flight was smooth and the views of the mountains were fantastic.  It felt like we were extremely close to the mountains but the pilot assured us we would never be less than 1/4 mile from the face of the mountains.  Our pilot was excellent ensuring each side of the plane enjoyed the views.  We flew to the glacier landing area and could see it wasn't possible to land.  Honestly, the flight was so good we were happy not to land (and receive a refund for that portion).

We highly recommend Talkeetna for their professionalism and for ensuring we had the best possible experience.

una experiencia unica, despegar con el hidroavión del puerto de juneau, la vista de las montañas y la ciudad se pagan con el pasaje, la computadora visual no deja de registrar ni un segundo las hermosuras que se aprecian en el lugar

I would certainly recommend using Talkeetna Air to anyone interested in such a trip.  If I find myself in Alaska again I will certainly try to put them on my schedule one more time.

My husband has been a pilot of small planes for many years.  As soon as I knew that we'd be coming to Alaska, I knew that he would want to take the flight around Denali.  Family members flew with you years ago so we picked your company.  Although we didn't have a cloudless sky,  the trip was fabulous.  I had been reading a book about climbers on Denali and imagined how they must have climbed.  May we be so lucky as to be able to fly around Denali with you again.  Clyde and Kirsty R.

I booked the Mountain Voyager tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi over Labor Day.   I got into town earlier the day before than originally planned so I stopped in to see if they had anything later that day.   I found out that there was an opening in a tour later that afternoon so I rescheduled.  They knew that they were going to be able to do that tour, but the next day could have been an issue.   The weather changes all the time so you never know for sure, but TAT does their best to get their tours to be able to go but not risk anyone's safety.

The tour with the glacial landing was scheduled to be about 1 3/4 hours, but they don't hurry things and we took a little more than 2 hours.   While heading out to a glacier to do the landing you get to see some excellent views of the Talkeetna area and the area up to the Alaska Range.   We had eight people in the plane which I believe is one of the larger planes.   Everyone gets to have a window seat since they are single seats with an aisle.   You may even be lucky enough to get a chance to ride in the co-pilots seat.   I have to say that I've never seen such beautiful views on the flight.  The pilot attempts to provide everyone a great view and gives some great information as you get to the landing site.

The glacier landing was fantastic.   You get to leave then exit the plane and walk around the glacial area.  There were several other TAT planes there also enjoying the views.   You spend about 15 minutes or so on the glacier so you have plenty of time for pics and videos, along with snowball fight if you are there with a group (there was fresh snow the day we were there).   They provide you with boots you put over your shoes for walking around the glacier.   

When we took off from the glacier that was even amazing.   Even on our flight back the pilot gave us information on things we were passing over.

I would recommend this tour to anyone that wants to do something different and get to see great sites.   The staff at TAT was excellent to work with always keeping your informed.

My now hubby...has never been on a plane!! And all he ever wants to do is fly...so Talkeetna Air Taxi and i did just that, we surprised him!! I have never seen him so excited, full of love and laughter as he was up there in the air. Our pilot was great and taught us a lot about glaciers and the landscape of Alaska. Most definitely take the flight if you can! We couldn't land on the glacier due to new snow fall, but it was still breath-taking.

Word of advice to my fellow motion sickness pals...Bonine! I used to use Dramamine but got turned on to Bonine, take it the night before and the morning of and good to go! A couple times while flying over the mountains and taking turns so all aboard can see the magnificent scenery almost had me evacuate my breakfast. But Bonine and me kept it under control (even went halibut fishing later in the trip and 3 people on board threw up...but not me!!! I still had to focus on keeping nausea at bay, but I did it!)

user_location: Hyde Park, New York, United States
review_text: My wife and I had booked a flight several months ago and the crew at talkeetna air taxi could not have been better. We scheduled an AM flight with a glacier landing but the weather was not agreeable. Luckily we were able to be flexible and the staff did a great job of keeping us posted on updates and got us up in the air by late morning. Our pilot was professional and informative. The flight was very smooth and the views were amazing. Unfortunately we could not land on the glacier due to fog but our pilot took the extra time to show us some better mountain views. Personally I enjoyed the air time so I wasn't disappointed at all. When we got back TAT was more than happy to refund us for the glacier landing. Overall we had a great experience and our flightseeing tour was one of the best moments of our Alaska trip. We absolutely loved our tour with the glacier landing. 

We lucked out and after two days of clouds, it was clear and sunny the day of our trip. The views were incredible and it was such a unique experience to land on the glacier.  

Was definitely a highlight of our trip. My husband even got to sit in the cockpit on the return flight.

Our flight to see Denali was fantastic.  Andy was a great pilot and did a great job sharing info with us.    Due to possible incoming weather conditions, he adjusted the schedule so we would be able to land on the glacier.  Thanks for a breath-taking experience.
Your flight was the hi-light of our Alaskan trip. The pilot was very informative and did a great job of getting us to where the views were breathtaking.

Best trip ever. You don't want to miss this. To be able to fly so close to the mountains and land on a glazier is just amazing. Pilot is very knowledgeable. The employees are great and so helpful. Excellent flight, the team was very accommodating of our little one .The check in and all related process were done at said time without any hiccups.

They allowed us to rebook later in the day hoping for the clouds to disipate.  When they did not, we rebooked again at a cheaper trip price for a smaller tour.  The staff treated us more than fairly throughout the whole process and our flight was absolutely incredible clouds and all.  The sights were breathtaking even for an Alaskan resident who sees the mountains everyday.  Seeing them at eye level and from above was really incredible.  Our pilot was fantastic and the flight was very smooth.

Fabulous flight around Denali with a landing on Ruth Glacier! Instead we waited a day, had the fortune of clear skies, and were able to get on a mid-morning flight. Courtney was kind, understanding and went out of her way to accomate us. Our pilot clay was fun. AMAZING experience!!!

review_text: A sunny clear fantastic day with a perfect glacier landing.   Pilot was exceptional and ground staff so friendly and helpful.

All went smoothly, getting our boots(some people are just plain  discourteous before\ during flight) but you can't choose your co-flight people.   luckily some outstanding people also joined who overshadowed the discourteous  people,  plus our pilot was a great host, , gave tidbits of info, gv her positive  perspective,    had the perfect clear day for a fly around n landing. It was a fantastic experience to ride on a small plane over Alaskan range and land on a glacier. The office staff was very helpful and courteous. Our pilot gave lot of information and made our journey enjoyable. Highly recommended.

review_title: Boy did I have a great day for the flight!
review_text: I'm glad I did not hesitate about taking this trip, it was the highlight of my time in Alaska.  The pilot was the best even kept us out longer than the normal time and the day was perfect for viewing Danali . We went all around the entire mountain with exceptional viewing. review_title: Could not have asked for more!
review_text: We were very fortunate to fly on a beautiful day.  Felt very safe with the team and pilot.  Professional, well organized, and worth every penny!
ceiling was about 8000 feet....should not have gone...highly overrated. expensive and disappointing..if visability is poor don't go.

review_title: Don't pass up- worth the $ for the experience to fly around Denali!
review_text: Yes it costs some money but where else can you say you flew around the mountain itself- Denali- with a bush pilot? Spectacular views of the mountain and terrain on the way there will make you think you are on a PBS or National Geographic team... cough up the $ for this rather than touristy stuff like local brews and ice cream ....

The staff at Talkeetna Air Taxi is wonderful! First they answered all my questions in regard to the flight, & then, even after we had signed up for a glacier landing, kindly refunded the glacier part when fog prevented the event.
The rest of the experience was a visual high. Our pilot Bruce was like a skilled seamstress threading a needle as he guided our plane in & out of the mountain's peaks providing sensory overload to both sides of the plane. I have 50 million (slight exaggeration) photos of Denali's beauty & majesty, truly one of God's great creations.
While this experience may be a bit pricey, it is truly worth it.

Our trip to Alaska was plagued with bad weather--the price you pay for going at the end of the season.  We had booked our flight months ahead of time, but the day before, the weather was rainy and cloudy.  When we arrived for our flight, clouds were lifting and the friendly and knowledgeable staff gave us our alternatives.  Although we were scheduled for a glacier landing, they thought it would not happen, but gave us boots, just in case.  Our experienced pilot did an excellent job of maneuvering through the openings in the clouds to get great views of Denali, the Ruth glacier and many more mountains in the range.  We weren't able to land, but it was a highlight of the trip.

Very well organized flightsee over Denali. We were originally scheduled to fly the next day, but we arrived in town earlier than we expected and the weather was great , but to turn worse the next day. So we called to see if they could fit us in that day yet, which they did. All went very smooth, the pilot was great (Gary, I think), and it was a beautiful flight. The pilot turned the plane back and forth so everyone could see things he was pointing out. Well worth the money.

review_title: Talkeetna Air Taxi Flight seeing Denali South Side
review_text: Talkeetna Air Taxi is excellent. They are highly organized, give you honest advice, and go above and beyond any expectations for safety and service.
I would highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi!  The views were AMAZING!!!  Our pilot was so informative.  Truly one of the top highlights of our trip.

The staff was friendly. Our pilot Chris was very knowledgeable about the area and provided some great insight on the Denali area. Although some freshly fallen snow had prevented us from landing on the glacier, we were grateful that they were aware of the weather conditions on the glacier and didn't want to risk our safety. Thank you for an amazing trip!

We originally booked the Grand Denali tour with glacier landing. When we arrived at Talkeetna Air an employee took the time to show us a raised map of the park and explain that they would not be able to take us to the south side of the park due to weather. They would instead include us in the Mountain Voyager tour and still complete the glacier landing. The flight itself was an incredible experience. Our pilot, Clay, was informative and humorous. Running around and throwing snowballs at my sister on a glacier is something I'll never forget. Thank you Talkeetna Air!

AMAZING experience flight seeing over Denali.
The staff and pilot were Professional and friendly.

I highly recommend Talkeetna Airtaxi and this experience!

I can not say enough great things about Talkeetna Air.   Every staff member including our pilot ,Chris, were polite, professional, and very knowledgeable. This I would expect from a business. What I did not expect, was how everyone at Talkeetna Air went above and beyond what they needed to do in order to make our "special occasion" happen.
     We were scheduled for the "Grand Denali with Glacier Landing".  My son planned on proposing to his girlfriend when we landed on the glacier. Talkeetna Air was aware of this surprise.  However, the weather did not cooperate.  Talkeetna Air postponed our flight five times in order to accommodate us. We decided on the fifth flight attempt that we were going regardless of mother nature's plans. Talkeetna Air told us if we were unable to land on the glacier they would be able to helicopter us to a beautiful location in Denali State Park so my son could propose. This brought tears to my eyes.

My son proposed to his girlfriend in a beautiful location on a perfect day.  She said yes.  Thank you Chris for video taping the event. Also, thank you to the passenger who helped me take pictures.

             Thank you again to everyone !!!!!!  Cristina G.

The views were outstanding, the pilot was very informative and extremely patient in answering the huge amount of questions asked by our youngest "flyer" and in dealing with a very frightened young "flyer."

One of the most amazing experiences of my life!! Beautiful views of this majestic mountain and up close and personal when we landed on Ruth Glacier! The look on my grandson's faces is something I will always remember!

Our pilot was excellent! He provided all kinds of information and views of Denali on a overcast-not so clear day, and we saw everything and more than we had hoped for! We got up close and personal to many peaks, glacier fields, and flows. What a thrill to see the peak from several directions, none of which could be seen from the base or viewing areas. Well worth every cent!
The staff went above and beyond to accomodate our large wedding party. It made a great day even better. Thank you!

review_title: Talkeetna Air Tours - A must experience activity

"Job Well Done"

I enjoyed my trip.

Great flight with Mike flying over the Ruth Glacier.  He was very informative and a safe driver that appeared to be well in control.  We wanted to land on the Glacier but the weather clouded in and we were unable to

Love every minute!!
We found Talkeetna Air Taxi to be a real class act. The pilot did a excellent job of showing us the breathtaking views of the Denali range  and it's many glaciers

So IMPRESSIVE!!

review_title: Amazing experience of Denali land flying onto a glacier!

review_title: Great flight, I would highly recommend it.

We really enjoyed the flight around the Talkeetna area.  We originally booked it for the glacier landing but when there's not enough snow to land safely, there's not much you can do.

Thank you for a great memory for our family.

Our flight around the Alaskan mountains including Denali was awe inspiring. The pilot, Chris, was very informative and a lot of fun. We were fortunate enough to be able to land on the Glacier and to see Denali in all it's glory. It's an adventure we will never forget.

review_title: One of the Best Parts of Our Vacation!
review_text: On a rainy, cloudy day, taking to the air and seeing the majestic Denali above the clouds was breathtaking.  I really cannot say enough about what an amazing time I had.  The trip is expensive and you get very close to terrain, but if you have a little nerve and the budget for it you should do it.  The staff was great about explaining the weather and visibility status and giving everyone options.  Unfortunately, the weather was too warm (and conditions too dangerous) to make a glacier landing.  Everyone on my flight thought the trip was amazing.  Our pilot was courteous and informative.

We were unlucky enough to fly on a day when the cloud ceiling was really low. The flight people were awesome in their response. They offered a full refund (which we declined), they gave us an extended flight to try to find the best glacier views, and offered a partial refund to those people who had booked a glacier landing.

review_title: Professional pilot and staff , worth the $ !
review_text: We checked in on the day, staff welcome us with friendly smile and good attitude.Then the staff explain us the weather condition whether our journey can still go on ! They couldn't guarantee if we can do the glacier landing but they said the pilot will try his best to fulfill our wants ! Finally , we couldn't land on the glacier , but still can approach Denali mountains , summit ... it's awesome and spectacular !!! OMG !!! I highly recommend this tour to all of you who are still thinking to take this or not , mostly it's just because of the price . But I can tell you that it's definitely worth !!!!!
Great company, beautiful day, we were able to summit Denali and land on the glacier- never to be forgotten!
Had a crystal clear day and the views were outstanding. Pilot was first rate, giving detailed info on peaks, glaciers, and some history.

review_title: One of the BEST things we did in Alaska
review_text:
Highly recommend taking a flight to see Denali, the glaciers, and other mountain ranges.
Talkeetna Air employees are honest with you about the weather conditions and what to expect.
Spend some extra time in Talkeetna for lunch or dinner a neat little town.

We had the most awesome tour of Denali, the canyons, glaciers and even a perfect glacier landing. The pilot was so informative and we had a 3 hr. tour in sunshine and blue skies. WOW!  What an awesome experience with your company. Thank you so much.

We flew over Mt. Denali and landed on a nearby glacier.  It was a crystal clear day and we made memories and saw sights that we will remember always.  Arranging the trip was easy by phone, check in was great, getting boots was easy; would highly recommend this adventure. i traveled with my grown daughter and sister-in-law.  Had to check one of the following boxes but none applied to me.
We surprised our three college age kids with a sightseeing flight and were thrilled with our experience!  Worth every penny!  The best way to see the beauty of Denali!

The flight was one of the highlights of our trip to Alaska. Definitely worth the price and time.  Highly recommend.
The only reason I gave 4 stars was because the guy working the booth in Talkeetna on Aug 21 at about  12 noon was a complete rude jerk.

Probably the coolest thing we've ever done. Beautiful day to fly, the views are simply amazing! Dan was amazing as our pilot and tour guide.  To see Denali, Hunter, Foraker and the other peaks from this view can't be described any other way than WOW.  Landing on Ruth glacier is an experience not to be forgotten--absolutely amazing.This is a phenomenal company with outstanding personnel , who were great to deal with from the time we booked the trip until the time we landed back in Talkeetna. Highly recommend this trip!! My wife who is somewhat of a nervous flyer, thoroughly enjoyed the trip and was amazed at the "smoothness of the flight"

I can't say enough about how wonderful the staff treated our 15 year old that had aspirations of being a pilot.  They gave us a great tour of a couple planes and allow her to fly in the co-pilot seat.  Thank you for a memory of a life-time for us and our daughter.

We had a wonderful ride across Denali Mountains. The weather was getting bad and the office team has put us on safest route available and the pilot was very experienced to drive very safely covering all possible glacier.

We booked our flight a few weeks in advance and on the day of our trip the weather was not great so we unfortunately had to cancel the flight. Having previous plans for the next day we didn't think we would be able to re book, the company immediately refunded our deposit and was so kind.
When I woke up the following morning on our last day in Alaska we had the first clear blue sky day in four days of our trip. I immediately called Talkeetna Air to see if they had anything available before our departure back to Anchorage, well luck has it they did and we we were put on a flight with only two seats remaining.
When we arrived to the airport in Talkeetna the ladies at the front desk were so helpful and sweet. Almost as sweet as the unbelievable upgrade to a glacier landing flight we hadn't expected. As if the day couldn't get any better the pilot greeted all the passengers to ready us for the flight and told us that the tallest person in the group was asked to sit in the cock pit with him, well at 6' tall that was me and WAHOO I got to sit in the cockpit for our impossibly perfect flight over Denali and our Glacier landing. The entire experience was seamless and breathtaking. The pilot was so informative and flew us over every inch of the mountain range explaining everything in detail.
Nothing beats landing a plane on a glacier in perfect weather. This is an experience I will never ever forget and am so thankful for mother nature and Talkeetna Air for making our trip to Alaska an unforgettable one!!!
Great staff, smooth flight, and awesome views! Staff were wonderful in easing my (not my husband) fears. Glad we did it!

I had a great time flying Denali with TAT; the flight was smooth and comfortable, the pilot (Richard) was experienced, friendly, and knowledgeable, and the views were jaw-dropping. If you're on the fence about the glacier landing, I'd recommend going for it; it definitely enhanced the experience by giving us some time to absorb the views, and the landing and takeoff were straightforward and smooth, on a large snow-field.

This trip was awesome. Our pilot was so sweet and went out of his way to make sure everyone got a good view. Landing on a Glacier was icing on the cake. The whole experience was the best thing we've ever done except for the births of our children. We will definitely come back again and again. Well worth the $!

Things started off well with booking. It was simple and they had plenty of open times. When we arrived the weather was bad and they worked with our schedule and managed to get us on a flight the next morning before we had to catch a train. The flight itself was AMAZING. We had clear skies and a great guide. They were even able to complete a glacier landing for the first time in weeks. I would highly recommend this as a bucket list item.

review_title: Amazing views and landing on a glacier!
review_text: This was a great way to see Denali National Park and all of the mountain peaks and glaciers as well as the terrain between Talkeetna and Denali!!  We landed on a glacier in a ski plane and walked the glacier!  We flew in between peaks and felt so close to the mountains, but as our pilot explained, mountainsides are further than they look and he pointed out other planes on a glacier that looked like toy planes!!!  Our pilot's knowledge of the terrain and history of the area added to the enjoyment.    A once in a lifetime experience!!!

Walked in on Labor Day weekend, immediately assisted by Renee.  She discussed the option for a partially overcast day.  We agreed to the south slope flight.  A few minutes later met our pilot Andy,  after the safety briefing we board the Beaver and headed down the run way.  Andy was great from the moment he was introduced to the end, educating each passenger on the sites we were envisioning.  After seeing several peaks and almost the peak of Denali we turned to head back.  I noticed a black bear in the tundra.  Andy turned the plane around and everyone was able to view the big boar.  As Andy made another pass we were able to see a sow and her two cubs!  Life memories were made today thanks to Talkeetna Air Taxi!  PS Andy even left his lunch to go back and retrieve my wife's lens cap she left on the plane!

Wow!  Just Wow!  We got to see Denali up close and personal between the cloud layers, and it was just breathtaking!  Our pilot was awesome, and we spent a lot of time flying around the peaks of Denali seeing all the angles and cliffs, and he explained all the areas that the climbers use to conquer the mountain!   Getting up high enough to see the peaks requires oxygen, but everything is clean, well-maintained, and you never feel unsafe.  Landing on a glacier was the icing on the cake-what a magnificent view, and we got to spend plenty of time up there before heading back!  We were happy we were able to go since bad weather had cancelled most of our other air excursions, and they were little iffy on landing since it depends on how much snow there is, but it all worked out for us. 
Really professional operation, very friendly and the sight are just magic!  Definitely a Must-Do!

Went for the Glacier landing.  Was fantastic!  can be best summed up from the fact that a couple on the flight with us had flown the tour the previous day - was unable to land on the glacier - so decided to drive back the next day from Anchorage to do so -& they were happy they did!  Highly recommended for all ages

Wir wollten ursprünglich eine große Tour machen mit Gletscherlandung und Denali - leider hat das Wetter nicht mitgespielt und es war nicht möglich +++ als 2te Variante haben wir dann die Southside gewählt und wurden mit faszinierenden Gletscherbildern belohnt +++ ein MUSS +++ es gibt viele Anbieter - Talkeetna Air Taxi kann ich empfehlen - easy Check In - kompetente Piloten mit viel Erfahrung - Talkeetna als Stadt hat nach dem Flug auch seinen Reiz... +++ Preis/Leistungsverhältnis ist OK +++ es geht hier ja auch um persönliche Sicherheit!

We did the mountain voyager trip and we were able to see awesome views. I wanted to do glacier landing but found out the glaciers were not safe for landing that time.  It was 1.5 hour trip, the pilot was great. He took us in the mountains and showed some awesome glacier. They were very professional and the experience was great. We were also travelling with almost 2 year old, she slept in the plane so we had a quite trip.

review_title: A life-changing experience – worth every penny!
review_text:
My fiancé and I celebrated our birthdays together on the Southside Explorer flight, a gift for my upcoming 30th birthday on the day of his 31st birthday. What an incredible way to celebrate! Our pilot Andy was very knowledgeable and even as geologists we learned a ton about glaciers and the Denali park. Andy took us further than he normally goes for a Southside tour because the weather ended up being better than expected. But even if Denali hadn't poked out of the clouds for us, it would have been more than worth it. The views are simply mind-blowing. Landing on the glacier was a breathtaking experience, even for us western Albertans, who are accustomed to snow and glaciers. This is simply something you cannot miss if you are in Alaska.

The customer service at Talkeetna Air Taxi is stellar – everyone at the office was helpful and friendly. I even got a free t-shirt because it was a birthday celebration! All in all, it was excellent value for the money (Talkeetna Air Taxi was also the most affordable of all the companies we researched).

Bring warm layers and sunglasses! If you have outdoorsy boots, or hiking boots plus gaiters, wear those. They have sunglasses and glacier booties on site if needed.

This adventure was the highlight of our time in Alaska.  We flew around Mt Denali and landed on a glacier.  Fortunately we had an amazing day for the flight with blue skies.  Mt Denali up close was awesome.  Chris, our pilot, was great and gave us all kinds of opportunity for great photos as well as information about the mountains and glaciers we saw.

We were a little skeptical about landing on a glacier.. after years of shuffling around on snow and ice in the midwest it just didn't sound too interesting. But wow was the whole experience amazing! Even though it was raining when we took off, our pilot was fantastic in finding holes in the clouds. We had a long incredible view of most of Denali sparkling in the sunshine. Flying in around the mountains, canyons and glaciers was indescribable. But landing on the glacier was the highlight with stunning views of high mountains all around highlighted in bright sunshine. Could have stayed up there forever. In addition, the entire staff are extremely helpful and accomodating. You can not go wrong with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  This will be an experience of a lifetime  -  guaranteed.
Talkeetna Air was so professional and accommodating   The flight around Denali and the opportunity to land and walk on a glacier at 5500' elevation was a once in a lifetime experience!!!!!

Our Pilot Dave was great! We lucked out with a clear, double summit view and a glacier landing. Dave was a great guide. He was super informative, safe and also made everyone feel at ease on an adventure of a lifetime! 
I would highly recommend Dave & Talkeetna Air Taxi!

review_title: Outstanding flight over the south side of Denali!
review_text: Oh my goodness, you MUST take this flight if you go to Talkeetna! It was fantastic, and the pilot, Michael, was wonderful. I had never been in a 6-seater plane, and I sat up front. It was magical. A storm had passed to the north, and so we had dramatic clouds and views - and rainbows! It was breathtaking to see the glaciers, the mountains, the clouds, and the top of Denali! The mountain was just visible for a few moments and we were all excited to see it as it can be very elusive. The flight was smooth, Michael educated us and answered all our questions so kindly and thoughtfully. It was a magnificent flight and I would do it again in a heart beat.
This was our second time up with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  The wildlife viewing was great and the glacier landing on Denali was truly memorable.

El pueblo de Takleetna es una maravilla. Está lleno de tiendas de souvenirs y zonas de parques mirando a un lago. Imprensicible en una ruta hacia Denali. El Air Taxi está bien pero si vais a ir a Denali de todas formas solo merece la pena si queréis ver las vistas desde arriba!.

We lucked out and had really great weather for our flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi. The staff were all very professional and extremely helpful. We did the flight with glacier landing and it is well worth it. 

The reason I gave it four stars is that after we left the glacier, the exhaust from the plane got into the cabin and made some of us nauseous. Not severely, but it was a bit uncomfortable. I am unsure if there's anything that can be done about this as it is a small plane that you will be flying in.
I ended up canceling my tour because they were unable to do the Glacier landing, due to snow.  I wrote this review because I am impressed by the professionalism of the employees.

Oh my goodness what a treat! We were scheduled for the Southside Explorer flight but the weather wasn't super cooperative so they gave us the option of whether to fly or not...well of course we weren't gonna say no as long as there were no safety issues! Our pilot, Michael, was a pure delight! We could tell he loves what he does! I don't even know what we were supposed to see and weren't able due to weather because he absolutely showed us some breathtaking views of Mt. Denali and stunning glaciers! We were literally in awe! It almost felt like we were close enough to reach out and touch them! We seriously weren't ready for it to be over!! Great service, even the gal that shuttled us from our hotel and then to downtown Talkeetna when the flight was over was a peach! ;-)

Our pilot was courteous, professional and informative.  The company makes every effort to be certain passengers will have a positive experience and are flexible as much as possible given weather fluctuations.

Company was so accommodating. They put us in a smaller plane with big windows to help keep my three-year old entertained for the trip. They rescheduled us to accomodate our schedule and got us up with the best weather they had that week. The pilot was very good and friendly... and quirky like you'd expect from an Alaska bush pilot. He was very entertaining. The views and glacier landing were exciting and breath-taking. All in all, a wonderful experience.

review_title: Book  it, you will not be sorry!
review_text: My parents and I took the Mountain Voyager flight with a glacier landing. It was an unbelievable experience. Due to weather, Dave, our pilot Dave, took us up earlier and it started rainy minutes after we landed back at base. The flight was smooth, the views breathtaking, and overall pictures does not do the trip justice.

review_title: The best flight tour I could have ever asked for
review_text:
TAT is very accommodating with the weather and they want you to have the best weather possible so book earliest in your travel. And be ready to drive there whenever the weather clears. Because it will be worth it. They were really kind to upgrade us to glacier landing which is also worth the money. If you are on the fence about adding glacier landing, don't be. Because it's well worth $90 extra. 
Everyone, especially our pilot of whom I wish I knew the name, was very friendly and down to earth.
Thanks for the best memory of Denali mountain!!

Wasn't able to see Denali from the ground over a 3 d period so I flew over the 11 k' clouds with Talkeetna Air Taxi. Beautiful sight with Denali (20k'), Foraker (17k') and Hunter (14k'). Some mountains visible below the clouds and some barely through. Flew amongst the peaks. Snow too soft to land on the glacier. Fantastic experience.

review_title: Best air flights around Denali? This is the company!!
review_text:
My wife and I just spent two weeks traveling around Alaska. While in Talkeetna, we decided to try to get a flight to view the peaks of the Denali Range from the air. 
At first we tried the first company visible to us (K2 Aviation) but they said they were booked for several days. I then learned that K2 also caters to cruise lines and I guess those companies come first.  We next tried Talkeetna Air Taxi. We were instructed on the different levels of flights they offered  in a very businesslike but friendly manner, and, were told we could go up that very day. We chose our flight, scheduled it and had a marvelous trip which included a glacier landing. Our pilot (Chris) gave us an enjoyable and safe trip in a DeHavilland Beaver.  If you plan on a trip to Alaska, do not hesitate to fly Talkeetna Air Taxi for a gorgeous view of those magnificent mountains.  You will never regret your decision!

One of the best decisions of our trip was to take this flight. We took the flight that went all the way around Mt. Denali and landed on the glacier on the side. The plane was in excellent shape and the pilot was great. Incredible views, even saw some mountain climbers working their way up the mountain. One thing to keep in mind, a friend told us he went in August and they were unable to make the landing on the glacier because the snow was a little melted. So you may want to try going some other month if possible.

Words just cannot even start to describe the experience!  The thrill of viewing glaciers from up above, landing on the pristine ice, it was just awesome.  A very knowledgeable and friendly pilot adds to this unforgettable experience.

We lucked into a blue bird day on Denali and had a great flight and landing. Our pilot was wonderful and spent a lot of time describing the geology as well as flight operation to our inquisitive daughter. 

This is a large operation with a  number of planes and I felt quite confident about the safety when I visited their location.

Travelling with my three children, I felt safe and the trip was beautiful.  Landing on the glacier was totally worth it!  The pilot was experienced, the plane provided great views of the Alaskan Range that you could not get any other way.  Do it!

Dave (pilot) and Vicki were simply the best- just really nice people! They went above and beyond to help make my experience of landing on a glacier and viewing Denali possible. The weather was perfect and the pilot (Alex) was super informative and confident. I also owe a huge thanks to K. Zerkel for making the trip up to Talkeetna with me. If ever given a choice, Talkeetna Air Taxi is the way to go.
-E. Dietz
Took this glacier landing with son and his family including two teens. Words can't do it justice! Worth every penny

This company was recommended by the owners of Earthsong a lodge near Denail.   They recommended we book a biplane not a helicopter for better views.   Richard our pilot had 22 years of experience.   Their was 5 passengers plus Richard the pilot we all had our own window.   We landed on Ruth Glacier with Mt. Denali right near us.   We walked around about 30 minutes then Richard just flew the plane right between the peaks of the mountains into the sky above.   An unforgettable experience.   I had flown Budda Air in Kathmandu to see Mt. Everest so my anticipation was high and they didn't let me down.  It is well worth the expense.  We booked several months in advance.

My husband and I toured the glacier on July 29th 2017 at 8:30 AM.  The pilot-sorry I forgot his name was excellent.  He made the trip awesome.  We were in Alaska for nine days, but this was our favorite.  The pilot was so informative and made this a great experience and I hope he is recognized for this.  My daughter did this tour one year ago and recommended this place and I am so happy we did this. Everyone was so helpful and professional. Will always recommend this.

review_title: AWESOME TRIP TO DENALI & GLACIER LANDING!
review_text: I have taken numerous helo trips in many places including Hawaii, Grand Canyon, Alaska & others...also took a fixed wing flight in Grand Canyon...Ive even landed & hiked on a glacier before.  NONE of them compare to this trip!  The views of Denali and sister peaks are spectacular and the most breath-taking Ive ever seen!  A definite MUST DO!  Its pricey, but if you can swing it, DO IT!

We took the Mountain Voyager trip with a glacier landing. The day we reserved was perfect - sunny and warm (great snowball weather on the glacier). The pilot (Chris) took us on a trip between the mountain peaks above the clouds, which were patchy below us. We were amazed at the glacier landing and take-off --- very cool. Chis provided interesting information about area throughout the trip, including information about climbing expeditions.

The only improvement I'd suggest would be in the check-in office, to clearly separate large tour groups from the rest of the people checking in.

review_title: So glad I changed my mind and took this
review_text:
I admit I was uncomfortable at the prospect of doing this. But walking down the drag at Talkeetna, I saw their little office and went in to inquire. The flight is leaving in half an hour, two seats remaining, and we will give you a discount. I thought, so you came all the way to Alaska and you are not going to do this? I said to my wife, "we're doing it."

As for the discomfort, the truth is, you are either going to get killed or you are going to have the ride of a lifetime, and the odds of getting killed are very very low. So, do it.

As it turned out, our pilot was Dave, who has over fifty years experience flying all kinds of aircraft, including 737s, and his colorful narration during the flight was an added treat. Our aircraft was the DHC-3 Turbo Otter.

There was not a moment's concern for our safety, only the wonder of the spectacle we were seeing and Dave's narration of the history and geography of Denali. Landing on Ruth glacier was thrilling and walking around on the glacier was awesome.

Don't pass this up!

Booked a glacier landing on Tuesday but it was cloudy. And no guarantee of a landing. We were given the option of choosing another day. One of the attendants recommended we wait and do the fight on our return from Denali on Thursday. Turns out she was our pilot on Thursday and it was the right call. 

The key point here is that they do not force you to keep to your reservation. Very flexible and it worked for us. 

Flight itself was great, with the pilot constantly doing S turns so that both sides of the plane got great views. Take all your pics on the way up to the mountain as the return is a straight shot and not really a sightseeing ride.

Unfortunately because of the weather we could not land on the glacier but the flight was the most amazing thing I have ever done,I was able to sit in  the cock out and out pilot was awesome! Felt so comfortable sitting up front and 1/4 of a mile away from the mountains! Beautiful sight to be seen!
Talkeetna air was more then willing to accommodate us when our first flight had to be cancelled!

Was advised that they had space on an upcoming flight that evening but it conflicted with my dinner reservation so they suggested I change the dinner and call right back. Changed the reservation and called back in 3 minutes to get another person who said there was no possibility to get on the very flight that I was promised 3 minutes earlier.  Called their competition and had a wonderful tour same evening.

Their are no words to describe this experience! I found tears of joy rolling down my face from the sheer magnificence of the whole thing. I will be honest, when planning our trip I did some heavy debating on spending the money for this activity . I will tell you now, that it is WORTH EVERY PENNY!  The office staff warm and friendly. The pilot very informative and got us close enough to get stunning photos but, not too close that you felt unsafe. My advise, spend the money on this activity. It does not disappoint.

You get to see all the highlights of the park in 1 and 1/2 hours tour. Great views of Mt. Denali, the tiny emerald lakes, the silt filled rivers; the tiny blue rivers, plains, snow packs. If you don't flightsee Denali then you can't really see the park in a day. 

1.5 hours is enough any longer may be repetitive. 

Glacier landing was fun and it was a comfortable landing and takeoff. 

Entire flight was smooth. 

Good places to eat around this place. Make sure you eat before you drive to Denali or Anchorage as there aren't many places to eat once you leave this town. 

Don't expect to see a lot of snow on the flight after July as most of the snow melts in June. 

Beautiful weather, no need for any winter clothes in July.

Talkeetna Air Taxi took us to the summit of Denali and it was awesome! Thorough, safe, and most informative! We couldn't see Denali from inside the park so we really enjoyed seeing it from the air. We couldn't land on it because of clouds but the views were enough. Ask for Chris, he knew so much about Denali and was really great to listen to. Felt safe in his hands.

Can't say enough good things about this. We had a beautiful clear day to see Denali. It's unforgettable. The only thing I would change is that I wouldn't lose Rock, paper, scissors, this losing my opportunity to sit in copilot seat on the way back! Unbelievable fun!!

Upon arrival, I was greeted by the ladies in the office,  They were pleasant and very helpful.  I did the Mountain Voyager tour with the glacier landing.  The pilot was knowledgeable about the area and environment.  He made sure everyone in the plane was able to get the same great views.  The glacier landing was fantastic and probably the highlight of my trip.  I would recommend this to anyone.

Landing on a glacier near Mt. Denali was the highlight of our trip to Alaska.  Our pilot was wonderful making turns to accommodate all passengers of our six seater to take pictures of this beautiful mountain.  There was never a concern for safety as the preflight briefing was comprehensive and reassuring.  These guys know the mountain like the back of their hand. A must for anybody traveling through Alaska

My first trip with Talkeetna air was in 2011. We did a glacier landing and the trip, Pilots, staff and Equipment were all outstanding. I came back for another trip to see Denali and it was too rainy to fly. The staff in town was honest about the conditions and we're helpful about the forecast. I will definitely come back and try again.

Shiloh was our pilot and took us to land on the glacier and assisted by taking photos of the amazing experience. He was so informative and helpful throughout. The glacier walk was awe-inspiring despite the fact I was the only one from 3 planes that landed to be dressed in shorts and a polo shirt (yes, it was a bit cold). I asked if I was a glacial first dressed as I was but Shiloh said no; just a glacial rarity! Smooth takeoff, smooth flight, smooth landing. Great pilot....Great staff...Great job TAT!

If you are in Talkeetna and the weather permits this is a must do event. There is no better way to experience the mountain and Glaciers than by air.
