The staff was extremely helpful and the price was less than the other companies we checked. 
Our first pilot was having a slight issue with static on the headsets and rather than continue on he turned back and they put us in a different plane. I think a lot of operations would have just apologized and carried on. It he wanted us to have pleasant experience. 
Our next pilot Eric was fantastic. He gave a great flight and lots of information. The first pilot may have also but did not get the chance to rate this only his desire to be sure the static did not interrupt the flight. 
Landing on a glacier was a real highlight. I have taken many flight seeing trips but this is definitely in the top two only rivaled by the flight to Milford Sound in New Zealand. Both are absolutely amazing. 
I would most highly recommend both the flight and this company.

This trip was so fun, landing on a Ruth Glacier and flying through the mtns was amazing.  We walked around on the glacier, everybody has an excellent view out of the plane.  The staff is awesome, of course they can't guarantee athe weather will cooroperate for a landing but Jan was great to deal with and our pilot was super.
The plane was ready when we arrived at the airport, nice and competent pilot, everything efficient and on time. The plane was good looking and clean. I would use them again

My husband and I had a great trip with Talkeetna Air Taxi. We booked over the phone and were given the tip that sometimes they have to cancel flights due to weather so to be flexible. We booked for a 3:15, with plans to stay overnight in Talkeetna just in case we needed to delay to later that night or to possibly the next morning. When we arrived they had to cancel a lot of their morning flights and weren't doing the Mountain Voyager (which is the one we signed up for). They also hadn't been able to land on a glacier yet that day and weren't sure if our tour would be able to. They offered us to switch to a 6:30 tour if we wanted to wait. We did decide to wait and wandered around town for a few hours. When we came back for our 6:30 tour they still weren't doing the Mountain Voyager but they had just had some planes land on the glacier, we decided to take that one instead of waiting for the 8:30 the next morning which was also offered to us.  They gave us a refund for the additional cost of the longer tour since we took the shorter one just on the south side, and it was a very easy experience.

The scenery is stunning, worth every penny. We did get to land on a glacier and it was great. On our way out, Denali had started to clear so I'm pretty sure our pilot took some extra time to turn the plane back and forth so we could all get pictures of Denali.  He had mentioned that it hadn't been out of the clouds all day.  

The tour itself is great, but to be honest the most impressive thing to me was the customer service here. The women behind the desk we dealt with were so nice, especially considering they have to tell people everyday that their tour has been cancelled, shortened, no glacier landings etc. I can't imagine it is easy for them, but their friendly attitude is probably the only reason I took the time to write a review! Everyone else can tell you how awesome the flight and glacier are, but the staff makes this company worth spending your money.

This was a splurge, but ultimately worth every penny. Getting a bird's eye view of the Alaska range and landing on the glacier was certainly a highlight of our trip to Alaska. We were lucky to have a gorgeous day, and our pilot Leighan Chenoweth was fantastic--so knowledgable, safety focused and fun to travel with. I would recommend this to anyone.

Yes, it is expensive, and yes, I believe it worth every penny. At least it was for us. Those flights are very weather dependent, the flight could be cancelled, the flight plan could be shortened (ours was, we've got the Mountain Voyager instead of booked Grand Denali, because of the weather conditions north of the Denali peak). The glacier landing could also be cancelled (ours wasn't). If it happens to you, don't blame the company. Your safety is a paramount for them. Personally I was impressed with high professionalism of the company staff and especially the pilot (we had Richard with us). The reservation was easy, the cancellation policy is reasonable and refunds if needed are quick and easy. Everything they told us was right on the mark. Glacier landing is well worth extra 95 bucks. We felt very safe during the flight, motion sickness was not an issue and the scenery was out of this world. Alaska Range is unlike any other mountain ranges I have seen before. The glaciers are enormous and the whole area is as wild as it gets. Besides if you are visiting Alaska and your time is limited this is your best chance to see Denali peak. Actually this is the only chance to see it up close unless you are actually climbing a mountain in Alaska Range. But even in that case you probably will be taking Talkeetna Air Taxi flight anyway to save a week of walking to the base camp. We actually saw the Denali base camp while flying over the glacier (just a few tents left as it was the end of the climbing season). Regarding the views and seating I think all seats have good views, but if you are a couple and both are planning to take pictures, seat on the opposite sides as the views are a bit different. By the way you don't need/want to have completely clear skies for your flight. Some clouds make the scenery even more beautiful. If you want to get some feeling on how it looks up there or just check the views and the weather/visibility conditions before your flight, there is an FAA webcam site for Alaska. The bottom line: I do recommend the flight and the company to do it with. This is not your average helicopter flight with glacier landing. This is a very special flight you cannot take anywhere in the world. We really enjoyed our tour, took a ton of pictures and video as the scenery was superb.
A truly awe inspiring experience. This you must experience, not hear about second hand. The pilot took good care of us and though my stomach was in knots from nerves, it was so worth it!

We did the Grand Denali, with a glacier landing, and we loved every minute! It was an incredible experience that we will never forget. Talkeetna Air Taxi did a great job. Check in was smooth. They provided glacier boots to cover your shoes and sunglasses if you didn't have any. Our pilot made sure everyone had a great view on approach to the glacier and gave us enough time, once we had landed, to take photos and enjoy the mountain views. 
      I felt safe on this trip and never felt rushed. This was a once in a lifetime experience for us and one we will never forget. We had a beautiful clear day on the day of our flight, so we were very fortunate. I highly recommend this trip as a most memorable excursion.

review_title: Highlight of our visit to Alaska.
review_text: Wonderful trip while landing on a glacier and viewing Denali Mountain. We did the South trip with a glacier landing and it is definitely a once in a lifetime experience. Our pilot Lee Ann did a great job of narrating the trip and making a lifetime memory. Worth the trip to Talkeetna just to do this. Make sure to be flexible as weather changes often and you might have to move your flight to ensure the best view, but not a problem with this company.

My wife and I took the Grand Denali with Glacier landing flightseeing trip with TAT and loved it!  We had a great pilot, Chris. He was very friendly and informative guide pilot and flew the Otter we were on with great skill. Great ride and landings. We had awesome up close views of Denali and others on a perfect day. I climbed Denali 15 years ago and TAT was the service that flew us in and out of basecamp, so I knew the quality of their pilots, equipment and operation. Chris pointed out several of the now abandoned (out of the climbing season) camps and routes and explained a lot about the climb. He was right on all accounts from my personal knowledge having been there and done that. He took us through the always exciting one shot pass at my request. Awesome!  He landed us on the Eldridge Glacier where we deplaned and everyone had a great time taking photos. He explained many things about the Glacier systems, etc.. I have now flown on all three types of planes that TAT has, the 185, Beaver and Otter. Great equipment with a very well run operation!  I cannot recommend TAT highly enough!
We didn't get to do the Grand Denali due to clouds but Our pilot, Coy, did a great job giving us a memorable flight.

We had an awesome flight and glacier landing. Our trip was named the Grand Denali w/Glacier Landing. Our number one, do not miss, thing to do in Alaska and worth every dime to go higher and to include the landing. Absolutely breath-taking! The whole staff was welcoming and knowledgeable. Our pilot was awesome. We could tell he had a lot of experience and added a lot to the experience.

review_title: Absolute best part of our Alaskan vacation!!
review_text: We took the Grand Denali Tour and landed on a glacier!  It was absolutely wonderful.  Not enough adjectives to describe.  There were 10 passengers - the pilot was great - he said what he needed to but wasn't too chatty - those gorgeous mountains didn't need a lot of words.  I would suggest asking to be the co-pilot - it's a great view, but I switched places after we landed on the glacier and the side seat was just as good.  If you are with someone else, sit on both sides of the plane (not behind each other) - you will each get different pics.  We were so blessed to have beautiful blue skies and very few clouds over the mountain. The landing and take off on the glacier was easy breezy, not scary at all.  The glacier itself was more snow than ice - it wasn't super slick - we walked around and took great pics.  We stayed there about 15 min. It wasn't that cold - they say it's because of the sun reflectivity.  It was so pretty up there flying around that I wanted to cry (and I'm not emotional) - that's the best way I can tell people what I was feeling. It was definitely worth the price and we would HIGHLY recommend!

Had a great time with Talkeetna Air Taxi! Took the glacier landing tour and it was really worth it. You can see everything and it's very awe-inspiring to see the breadth of the glaciers and crevasses from up in the plane. They talk about everything you see, so you get some education on the area too and you can ask questions. Good service and good people.

We took a scenic flight up to, and landed on the Ruth Glacier with Talkeetna Air Taxi. This was absolutely the highlight of our trip to Alaska. I have done many exciting things in my life and this stands out among the most spectacular things I have ever done.

I have been a pilot myself for 35 years and am currently a captain for a major airline. I was very impressed with the skill and professionalism of our pilot along with the quality of the aircraft we flew in.

I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi's scenic flights.

I can't begin to express the awe and wonder of this experience. the check in process was a breeze. Our pilot was practiced and handled the plane smoothly. Walking on the glacier while taking in the view was something I will never forget. Don't be satisfied with oohing and aahing at photographs. This excursion should be #1 on the "to do" list while in Alaska.

I strongly suggest you plan a flight tour of McKinley at the very beginning of your trip in case you have to reschedule because of weather. Evidently only 30% of the visitors actually could see the mountain because of cloud cover we were fortunate enough to have a spectacular day and good weather for Glacier Landing. This is an absolute bucket list item everyone was awesome.

We stayed in Talkeetna for two nights, planning on a flight seeing on our first day there. We were scheduled for the first morning flight. The morning was very overcast and the flight would have had a low ceiling. We canceled with the hopes of an afternoon flight, still a low ceiling but improving. We signed on for the following morning and were rewarded with almost perfect conditions! Talkeetna Air Taxi worked with us to afford us the best experience of seeing Denali and glacier landing. Our pilot, Chris was excellent and my husband had the opportunity to ride in the co-pilot seat for part of the flight.
Our trip was wonderful.  An amazing experience for all of us including our kids. We are very happy and satisfied.  Thanks once again for them

Our family of six flew around Denali yesterday. Our pilot was wonderfully informative about the history of glaciers, Denali climbing, and more. Talkeetna air taxi is run very professionally. They were organized and quick with check-in, and we had no trouble at all. We would definitely recommend this company.
We took the Mountain Voyager tour with glacier landing. The flight through the mountain ranges and the glacier landing was a once in a lifetime experience for us.

review_title: Amazing experience and great customer service.
review_text: They were so accommodating to all changes due to weather conditions. A good company to work with to do a flight seeing tour.

review_title: Landing on a glacier-an unforgettable experience!
review_text: This was the entire family's highlight of our time spent in Alaska.  Initially, we talked about which tour we should take.  We decided to see less mountain and do the landing.  Best decision we made!  The site of the Sheldon property was fantastic and you won't see that on any other trip! (Apparently they land on other glaciers at different times; so you may miss it, but that's a minor point).  You won't believe the vastness & size of the mountains! You feel you can reach out and touch them! You lose all ability to gauge size.  It's just unbelievable.  We'll definitely do this again when we return.
We were very happy with the flight, the information, and the scenery!  What a great experience.  I would definitely recommend it and we would do it again!

review_title: Fantastic flight and friendly staff.  Did not try to switch me to a lower glacier tour; let me decide and reschedule
review_text: Every time I have visitors, I send them with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Always a great experience. This is a once-in-a-lifetime trip.

This is a great tour and recommend you book with them but be aware that the weather changes and your reservation changes every 15 minutes so be prepared.  People all very friendly and accommodating.  Just wished they would wait until the last minute to cancel a flight instead of 45 minutes before the flight as the weather cleared up 10 minutes after they canceled.  Heard mornings were more likely to fly than later in the day.

We went on the Mountain Voyager w/ Glacier Landing tour.   This was an incredible experience and we were very fortunate as we had a beautiful day.   We arrived at Talkeetna Air and were warmly welcomed by the staff.   We met our bubbly, outgoing and adventurous bush pilot, Leeann - and we immediately knew the journey we were about to take with Leeann was going to be fabulous!  Leeann made everyone in our group feel comfortable when flying in her plane and she shared all her knowledge of her 'beloved backyard', Denali!    The glacier landing was incredibly smooth - thank you, Leeann - and the sites and surroundings on the glacier were magnificent!   I know this tour is a little pricey but it is well worth it and an experience everyone in my group of 4 all said - we will never forget the experience!  I would strongly recommend, when you visit Alaska, you do this tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi - and Leeann!   You will not be disappointed.

We flew over Denali two days in a row, with two incredible pilots.  Meanwhile our son & girlfriend were climbing to the summit.  The flights were simply fantastic, each different due to weather conditions.  Everyone at Talkeetna Air Taxi was excellent, customer service could not have been better!  We had so much fun!  Flights were smooth, landings could not have been better.  Both of our sons have flown with this company many times, and highly recommended TAT.  We had a reach out and touch experience, not to be exceeded in our lifetime.  We recommend TAT highly!

Our flight around Mt. Denali and landing on a glacier was the highlight of our Alaskan adventure.  Talkeetna Air Taxi was so friendly and easy to work with from first contact through the flight and afterward.  Our pilot was friendly, informative, and certainly didn't make us feel rushed to leave the glacier.  Standing there was like being on top of the world; I'll never forget it.  We felt the price was great for the length of time we were in the air.  This is the way to fly.  Be part of the 30% who get to see the peak.

I had the privilege of riding with our pilot LeeAnne to view the mountains and land on the glacier! I was amazed by her knowledge of the terrain and details she shared with us. It's more breathtaking than words can describe. Took many photos and will remember this experience forever. I felt as though I'd died and gone to heaven! Don't pass up this opportunity if you're in Talkeetna. It's been the highlight of my stay  to date.

review_title: flight over glacier with glacier landing on 6/24/17
review_text:
Amazing!
The highlight of our trip!  We would highly recommend this special adventure!
Excellent service by the ground crew & a great pilot!
Smooth ride & majestic sights!

Our experience with Talkeetna Air Taxi was excellent. The staff was professional and welcoming. We felt safe and in competent hands from the moment we arrived. Our pilot was simply amazing. He took us on a thrilling adventure, masterfully navigating the plane into a tight bowl surrounded by rock and snow. Spring for the glacier landing. We live in the snowy Northeast, but this was a novel, and beautiful experience. The views were phenomenal. You are in for a ride of a lifetime.

My wife and I found the event to be very well organized and were greeted professionally and with smiles by all.  The flight was smooth and informative and the pilot was very helpful.  Views were beyond description.  We were just glad our cameras batteries held out we took so many pictures!!  Great time and highly recommend it to anyone traveling the areal

review_title: Amazing summit tour with glacier landing !
review_text: This flight was the best event on our trip. The weather was bad in the morning of our booking but TAT offered to postpone in the afternoon and see if the weather was improving. In the end, they decided last minute to give it a try and we had an amazing sunset flight over the Denali. Tremendous !

review_title: One of the highlights of our trip!
review_text:
The tour was absolutely unbelievable.  My husband, 13-month old son, and I did the mountain voyager with glacier landing and were blown away.  The glacier landing is definitely worth the extra cost! 

I was also extremely impressed with this company's honesty and customer service.  We were called on the day of our tour to inform us that the planes were having to fly high above the cloud line and the altitude would be too much for our son.  They were quick to reschedule us to a tour the following day.  When we arrived the next day, it was still really overcast and the employees were up-front about what to expect from the weather.  We opted to continue and we are so glad that we did.  Overall, I just think that it's great that you have the option of choosing on the same day whether or not you want to take the tour.  With the weather being as unpredictable as it is in this area, I'm sure business can take a hit when the clouds are out.  I think it's great that this company is more concerned about their clients having a great experience than making money even if the weather isn't cooperating.

review_title: The absolute best part of our trip!
review_text: This was a once in a life time plane ride to Ruth Glacier. The pilot and staff were excellent. We had the best views and it truly was breath taking. My husband got to sit next to the pilot on the trip back.
I was given the very back of the plain and it wasn't as enjoyable. The scenery was amazing as well as commentary was great!

Our group took a flight seeing with glacier landing on July 6th. It was by far the greatest experience my wife and I have he in many years. We were blessed with clear sky's that only made the experience even better. We will never forget that day. Thanks so much.

My wife and I signed up somewhat on a whim the day before we ended up taking the flight, and are beyond-words-happy we did. We chose Talkeetna for their price/value of the various trip options, and decided we wanted a good view of Denali, which we certainly got! Our pilot gave us a great view of the various mountains, Denali base camp landing area, glacial scars, and other landmarks, and also provided a smooth and easy flight. He also expertly landed on a glacier! 

Overall, our flightseeing tour was an unforgettable experience that we would gladly return and take again. Major kudos for the whole crew that made a wonderful day so easy for us!

Beautiful flight views seemingly just feet from mountain walls. Loved, loved, loved the glacier landing and playing in 4 ft of snow in short sleeves and 70 degree temps with Denali In our photo ops. This was an easy drive from our home base of Anchorage but gave us a beautiful view and landing on Denali. Perfect complement to our trip!
We loved our tour around the south side of Denali.  The views were breath taking and the glacier landing was a wonderful experience.

Our Alaskan friend highly recommended Talkeetna Air Taxi, and we're so glad we did the tour with glacier landing.  It's an unforgettable and such an amazing experience.  They're professionals who love what they do.  Our pilot did a great job telling us everything what was around us - and he would turn around so that both sides get the same amazing view.  His glacier landing was so sooth.  I'm slightly sensitive to motion sickness, but it was so comfortable with hardly any turbulence during our flight.  It's not cheap, and it shouldn't be when you want the topnotch experts to fly you and show you the amazing mountains. The 3 of us thoroughly loved every minute.  Thank you!

The most incredible experience!  Take-offs and landings were as smooth as could be.  We loved landing on Ruth Glacier.  Michael, our pilot in the 5-seater explained geographical and historical facts about the region, the rivers and the Alaskan Range.  It was an awesome afternoon!

review_title: Talkeetna Air taxi is worth every cent!
review_text:
it was a trip of a lifetime. Expensive, and worth every cent. it was approx. 3-1/2 hours of amazing scenery. at times it looked as though we would crash into the mountains, it seemed we were that close. in reality, the air is crystal clear, and the scale of Alaska is hard to capture. it took three days before we could get up into the air, this company is tightly managed and very safe. 
  I would advise allowing several days, as the weather around Denali is unpredictable and picking one day to fly could easily lead to a disappointment. we allowed three days, and went on the last day. 
  we will do the summit tour when we return to Alaska, but will allow for weather delays. 
fantastic way to view summit views  usually reserved for only climbers.
Great experience from front office to the end of trip. Professional and safe operation all around and it was truly the trip of a lifetime...

review_title: Amazing must-do activity on your trip to Alaska.
review_text: Our group of 6 had a phenomenal trip to Alaska. All 6 of us agreed that the TAT trip was the highlight! Mind blowing beauty. We loved it
This trip is a must do for anyone wanting to see Denali! The mountain and Talkeetna Air were STELLAR!  Knowledgeable and friendly team at Talkeetna Air.

Não há adjetivos para descrever o quanto gostamos desse passeio. Já estávamos há cerca de 10 dias no Alaska, mas, sem duvida, esse foi o melhor de todos. Pegamos um avião com um piloto super gente boa MICHAEL. Educado, atencioso e sempre nos informando sobre as paisagens que víamos. Ver o DENALI de perto ( essa era a sensação), é inesquecível. Mas, o pouso no glaciar é fantástico. Se você pensa que vai balançar ou que o avião é aparentemente antigo e perigoso, esqueça! Pegue logo os primeiros voos da manha(fomos no primeiro horário 8:30). A companhia pega no hotel. As crianças adoraram. NÃO DEIXE DE FAZER O PASSEIO se estiver passando por talkeetna.

It was a nice experience seeing the mountains from the air. Daughter also had fun Cosplaying on top of the Denali. We went to both glacier landing and day cruise and we all agree that glacier landing was much better time/ money spent. The flight was smooth and the pilot was nice and friendly. I suggest making the appointment in early time/day of your trip so you can rearrange another flight in case weather condition not allowed. 
Recommended camera lens: Any focal length between 35mm to 70mm should work well, from the sky or on the Glacier. I brought 24-105mm on my full frame DSLR but I would just bring 50mm if I come again.
Will, our pilot, provided us with a fantastic view of the mountains and glaciers. Totally worth the price of the trip.

Flew with Talkeetna Air Taxis yesterday. Wonderful trip! Great pilot, very experienced and gave a running commentary over the headphones. We landed on a glacier which was incredible. Stunning views of Denali and the mountain range. Would highly recommend this trip to all ages.

If I have to describe my experience with TAT, the only word comes into my mind is Breathtaking. It was an amazing experience. We had to reschedule the tour because of weather but the day we did the actual tour the weather was awesome we could see the Denali from all around. The flight was very stable with a very little turbulence. The pilot was very informative and describing everything that was coming to our way. We landed on the glacier that was also smooth and great. I would highly recommend to the people visiting Alaska to try the TAT. Great Job TAT.

Breathtaking views of Denali.. It was a beautiful day and our pilot Dave not only did a smooth and nice glacier landing, he also took great photos for us...We loved it...! Thanks to the whole Talkeetna air taxi team...it was a wonderful experience...!

My wife and I took the flight that landed on a glacier.  The views were awesome.  We lucked out with the weather, it was a clear day.  They handled us very well but didn't give us our 10% discount, being in a group of 5 I thought we were eligible for one.  Definitely get there 45 minutes ahead of time.  I definitely recommend this trip, but stick up more for your discount!

My wife and I took a Mountain Voyager w/ Glacier Landing trip for her birthday. The whole trip was incredible; the views were amazing throughout, the glacier landing allows you to get a real sense of the immense scale and the pilot/guide was friendly and gave very interesting commentary. The flight was smooth and we felt completely safe throughout.
Pilot Michael did a great job answering all of our questions and touring the plane over the mountain on a sunny day.
Even with overcast weather, the views and experience were incredible!  I'd highly recommend doing this.

Family of 4 with two teen daughters booked flight in early July. Weather was amazing so that made the flight even better! We thoroughly enjoyed a magnificent flight and glacier landing. Our Texas-born kids could have played on the glacier for hours. Scenery was spectacular and this excursion--while pricey--is a 'must-do' when staying in Talkeetna!

We did not get to see the high peaks due to a 9000' ceiling, but the flight and Ruth Glacier landing were still spectacular. The staff was friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable. And the views breathtaking. Well worth the investment!
Staff extremely friendly & helpfull - pilot very experienced & informative- everyone went that extra mile to assure we had an an unforgettable experience

This was best experience of my life landing on a glacier. The Lady pilot was awesome and was descriptive all along. Couldn't get better deal than this. Best views would be in mar to may when there is more snow on the mountains. However there is nothing Talkeetna air taxi can do about this otherwise go for it any time of the year.

review_title: Once in a lifetime to see Denali up close.
review_text: Great flight, profressional service with Talkeetna Air taxi.  My only reccommendation would be that if you are doing the grand denali tour with glacier landing the right hand side of the plane had more views of the mountain.  I was in the back left and we only looped a few times to see it out the window on my side.  The guy across from me was taking selfies of himself and it was hard to view out the window across from you.

Took the Grand Denali tour with Glacier landing. It was easy to book and easy to correspond with Talkeetna Air prior to the trip. The registration process when you arrive was easy and the trip itself was AMAZING! I even got to sit on the co-pilot's seat on the return trip. Highly recommend!

TAT has the ability/instruments to fly safely through clouds for a safe  Denali Summit flight/Ruth glacier landing. We even got to see a summiting team right at the summit. Our pilot was highly experienced and provided a grand tour of the myriad glaciers and peaks surrounding the grand Denali. Once in a life-time experience!
This tour is well worth the money! It was breath taking to be that close to the mountains and glaciers. Absolutely gorgeous views. Tour guides and staff were phenomenal!

We did the flightseeing tour with Glacier landing. We made last minute appointment and the staff were very helpful and courteous. Our pilot, Andy, was very experienced and prepared us well and made the flight so comfortable. It was the highlight of our trip. Must do!

This trip far exceeded my expectations.  The beauty brought me to tears.  The staff were friendly and knowledgeable.  The pilot (Jonathan?) was patient and full of information.  This is a must-do experience with a top-notch outfit.  P.S.  Do a glacier landing.  You won't regret it!

review_title: Glad that we decided to do the glacier landing last minute.  A once in lifetime experience
review_text:
our group of ten was on way to Denali and decided to stop by and book the glacier landing tour last minute.  Fortunately they were able to accommodate us.  It's expensive but well worth the money.  Everybody in the group were thrilled. Spectacular views on plane and there is enough time allowed on glacier for snowball fight and lots of photos.
Highly recommended.  An incredible experience.  Our pilot Leanne did a wonderful job giving us a bit of history on Denali and in pointing out sights while enroute.  I am recommending this to my friends.  A month later our group is still talking about the wonderful experience.

Based on TripAdvisor recommendation we booked it in advance with Talkeetna Air Taxi. But we learned  that price remained same at last moment. There is another company K-2 aviation, it shares same compound for operation and have many planes and their car parking was also full. 

We took Alaskan tour bus from Denali for our return journey to Anchorage. We had break journey at Talkeetna. They picked us from  Talkeetna Alaska lodge and dropped. We had enough time on hand and he allowed us to take break in downtown for Lunch and in return for dinner. 

Cabins are non pressurised. So I felt a little ear popping which was manageable by moving jaws and mint. It is advisable to keep mint handy. We were given booties for glacier landing.

 It was clear day. The views from plane was great. Landing on the glacier was a breathe taking experience and being on the glacier (15min) was one of the coolest parts.Once in a lifetime must do. Pilot narrated things on the way making the trip as enjoyable by explaining what we see and taking pictures for everyone on landing on Pika glacier.  If you're on the fence about this trip because of the price, don't be--it's worth every penny.

Overall, I am glad we did it.

An amazing experience! We were advised by the locals to take the flight landing on the glacier and were incredibly glad we did! Our pilot, Alex, was cool, calm, and collected. He was very experienced and the flights and landing were flawless. He provided information about the sights we were flying over, but also gave silence for us to just enjoy the scenery.

review_title: A must do if you want to see Denali!
review_text: An epic day we had. Our experience was amazing. The views are amazing and landing on the glacier was unreal. This tour is a must do if you have time. Thank for an unreal experience.

review_title: Spectacular views, once in a lifetime experience
review_text: We were lucky enough to be in Talkeetna on a bluebird day and went flightseeing.  It was unreal how huge the mountain is and seeing it close up gives you a whole new appreciation of the scale and majesty of the place.  Of course the glaciers and cliffs were beautiful, but the pilots knowledge of the different places really made it a great tour.  I've flown in lots of bush planes and helicopters in Alaska but this was my favorite trip.  Highly recommended if you even have a little curiosity about Denali.
The scheduled date was raining and they allowed us to postpone 2 days. We enjoyed a lot with a fine weather. Wonderfull, we Could see the summit and all the glaciers around, landing on one of them.
We flew with Talkeetna Air Taxi on three consecutive days:  twice heli-hiking & once flight-seeing.  Customer service is exceptional.  Our pilots were incredible.

We knew we wanted to see Denali from the air.  On the day of our flight the weather wasnt cooperating and grounded everyone.  The staff was great about getting us rebooked.  The next day was clear and we had a wonderful time.

This was definitely the highlight of our trip. Pilot Alex was fantastic. We had a great experience landing on Ruth glacier and getting some fantastic inflight views of Denali. You'll get to see 360 views of Denali. I highly recommend the glacier landing as it's a truly unique experience
This trip was worth every penny.  The pilot was experienced, informative and entertaining.  A must do!

We checked out 3 or 4 air taxi services before selecting Talkeetna Air. My spouse was a private pilot and knows about airplanes...based on our desire to land on a Denali glacier he wanted to fly in either a Beaver or an Otter....both which TA uses for their flights. We booked a reservation and the rest was just magical. Customer Service was superb. We were given an option based on the weather conditions on the day of our flight, which was totally our decision. No pressure to pursue the higher priced, slightly longer flight as the weather had changed. We were provided with snow booties to wear over our shoes, headsets, and an informed pilot. He even took our photos, once we had landed on the glacier, and on returning to base found us a small herd of moose from the air. It was WONDERFUL.

After 16 years living in Alaska I finally took a flight seeing trip with Talkeetna Air! Not only was it the highlight of my sisters trip; it was by far the coolest adventure for the locals, too! Clay, our pilot was informative and friendly ... you could tell he loved his job! The Eldridge glacier landing was SPECTACULAR! Don't just flight see - do the landing!

review_title: Chunilna (Clear Creek) Drop off Heli Flight - Excellent Trip
review_text: Had an excellent drop off Helicopter trip early July.  Weather was not helpful though Daniel (Heli Pilot) kept us informed during the day and then got us to the creek in the afternoon.  We were able to stay with our 3-day plan to fish and float back to Talkeetna.  Thank you for making it work safely and efficiently.  This was a Father adult Daughter trip.  Memories are forever.

This was easily the highlight of our 12 day Alaska trip. We initially booked a flight seeing tour w/o a landing but when we showed up the airport they gave us a free upgrade! We landed on the glacier at base camp to pick up two hikers that had completed their summit and were on their way back down -- such a cool experience to see base camp first hand and meet the two climbers!

Our pilot was cool, calm and collected the entire trip making everyone feel very safe. She was exceptionally knowledgable and friendly the entire trip. I would highly recommend including Talkeetna Air Taxi as part of your Alaska Vacation.

Loved the glacier landing flightseeing trip with Talkeetna Air Taxi. Our pilot, Leighan Falley, was outstanding - a great pilot with a great personality, who took us all around Mount Denali so everyone had great views. The landing on Ruth glacier was awesome. We were fortunate to have excellent visibility for our morning flight so we got to see Denali and all the surrounding mountains and glaciers in all their full glory. This was truly a highlight of our trip. Thanks to Leighan and Talkeetna Air Taxi for an amazing adventure.

review_title: South side Denali with glacier landing
review_text: Great flight with astonishing scenery.  Our pilot was quite knowledgeable about the geology of the area and more than willing to answer questions.  The flight, glacier landing and take-off were all smooth and well done.  Would repeat the trip, or do a longer one, with no hesitation.  TAT desk employees were very helpful changing our flight so that it included a glacier landing.  TAT was recommended by a friend who had flown with them before.  Highly recommend the air service.

Thoroughly enjoyed trip. Unbelievable sites and the ride was smoother than my flight to Anchorage.
So happy I went with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  This was #1 on my Bucket List and everything I hoped for turned out.  Glacier landing was interesting because climbers were on the glacier waiting to be picked up.  I went with my adult son who was sent to Anchorage for the week and he was just as 
mesmerized as I was.  Thank You Talkeetna

review_title: Great Flight. Something you have to do.
review_text: This was the best adventure of our entire 11 days in Alaska. Great company to deal with. Awesome Pilot Jonathan.

Our flight was in the evening on an overcast day. Our party of six was combined with another party of four. Once in the air, we cleared the clouds and had wonderful views of Denali and the surrounding mountains.  Our landing on Eldridge Glacier was an experience beyond our expectations. I was walking on a glacier in the sun surrounded by the quiet beauty of nature. Reservations and payment were handled well and communication was swift and helpful. Highly recommend this for all ages.

review_title: Once in a life time experience
review_text:
Words fail to describe the amazing experience we had on the Denali flightseeing tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi. It is a must do for anyone visiting Anchorage or Denali. While many other companies offer flightseeing tours, we highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi for their outstanding customer service. 
Our original tour was scheduled for July 2nd. The day turned out to be cloudy and rainy, so our tour did not happen. That's when Anne and Lisa patiently worked around our rest of the Alaska itinerary to reschedule us. They went above and beyond to ensure our trip was as minimally disrupted to the unpredictable weather (which happens often in Denali)
Thanks to them and Talkeetna Air Taxi, my wife and I take back happy memories to be cherished forever!

Outstanding outing, Jonathan, our pilot, had extensive knowledge of the area, was easy to talk with, helped with pictures and made the ride in a single engine airplane pleasant.  Checking with Renee and her crew simple and easy.

This is an absolute must experience if visiting Alaska. Great service and a very professional staff and pilot. Planes are well maintained and the flights are incredibly smooth. Highly recommend to anyone who wants to see Denali and glaciers from the very best view.

review_title: Skip the Glacier Landing & Only Go On A Clear Day
review_text: We were fortunate enough to book the flight on a clear day and took the Grand Denali with the Glacier Landing.  I would advise not to spend the money on a rainy cloudy day because visibility would be very limited,  I would also skip the glacier landing because you simply land on a snow covered strip.

review_title: Once in a life time experience
review_text:
It was an amazing flight and view.  Landed on a glacier and it was phenomenal!!!!Worth every penny.
Pilot was very knowledgeable and entire staff was so friendly.

We LOVED our flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi. Our pilot and everyone involved was wonderful. Seeing Denali from the air was more beautiful than I could have imagined. I was a little worried that I would be scared but we felt very very safe. It was an amazing trip. Far exceeded our expectations. Thank you! If we return to Alaska, we will definitely be back for another flight!

review_title: Tremendously wonderful way to see Alaska
review_text: We treated our son-in-law to a Mountain Voyager with a glacier landing and he remains excited about it.  It was a superb adventure for him. Then, my son and I booked a helicopter flight into the backcountry to seek wildlife. What a fabulous and remarkable flight made all the more enjoyable by Paul's commentary and efforts to get us close to animals. In visit Talkeetna, we inquired at a local restaurant about flight-seeing and without hesitation the recommendation was Talkeetna Air Taxi. We can see why. The staff members were exceptional. All quite personable and informative. They wanted us to have a good experience and that made a major difference. Vivian and Emily were delightful. Thanks to all of you for giving us a wonderful treat of seeing your part of Alaska from the air. God bless you.

review_title: One of the best experiences in our Alaska trip.!
review_text:
We took the Denali Grand tour... Glacier landing was awesome...
I would definitely recommend this... Also Talkeetna is a small nice place to spend some time with some great restaurants...

What an absolutely amazing experience. We flew in a single engine plane to the top of Mount Denali. North American's tallest mountain. With air masks and all!! Loved every minute of it. Highly recommended!! Our pilots name was Alex, great pilot!! Thanks for a once in a lifetime experience!!!!

We took the Grand Denali tour today, the weather was perfect. Chris, our pilot, was extremely professional, knowledgeable, and friendly. Unless you've taken this flight, it would be difficult to describe in words how amazing it actually is. My hike to the bottom and back of the Grand Canyon, is now second on my life list. Our flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi is now #1. You have to take this trip, you will not regret it. Every staff member we had contact with were above top notch, THANK YOU ALL!

review_title: Magnificent Denali Flight-seeing Trip with Glacier Landing
review_text:
My wife and I with two friends to a Talkeetna Air Taxi plane ride around the mountains and glaciers near Denali.  The weather wasn't the best, but the pilot gave us all a wonderful scenic flight with great commentary and a glacier landing on Pika Glacier.  What an experience!!

Definitely well worth a stop when in Talkeetna.  We would absolutely do this trip again.

review_title: Amazing views and a unique experience
review_text: This was one of the highlights of our trips and we did lots of activities. The views were just gorgeous and our pilot, Dave, was super friendly. We did the landing on Kantishna glacier near the camping grounds, and it had spectacular views. We also got to see a snow avalanche while we were at the glacier which was amazing.

review_title: Awesome experience, a bit pricey though
review_text: You really can't find this anywhere else (that I am aware of), which makes it worth it to do it once in your lifetime. It is expensive though, but again, if you're only going to do it once, then do it! Also, our pilot was awesome. He was an older guy that has been doing this for over 30 years so we felt comfortable with him. I will say, they made us get there 45 mins early and then took off 45 mins late, we were not happy about that....
Excellent pilot, great views, personal treatment, knowledgeable explanations about the area, would recommend to friends

Wonderful adventure.  This was one of the highlights of our trip.  It is so well worth it.  TAT is so well run.  Everything went smoothly.  The trip was so exciting and the landing and take-off on the glacier was amazing.  Our pilot, Trent, was informative and friendly as well as a great pilot.  If you go to Alaska, this is a must-do adventure!
Flight over mountains and Glaciers--excellent Pilot. FABULOUS TOUR !!!   This was the Best tour of the trip and we come often -- have done them all😊

If you are in the Denali area, do not miss the glacier landing tour offered by Talkeetna Air Taxi. It was an experience of a life time. The kids loved the snowball fights they had on top of the glacier. The views of the glacier was breathtaking.

review_title: OMG!!!! you must do this.. it is incredible!
review_text:
From my trip to Alaska and all the tours, this is the best one!

Everything went ok, views as spectacular and landing on the snow is a great experience.

Thank you Air Taxi, now I completed one of my items from my bucket list.

btw... also recommended is to spend a night at Princess Mt Mckinley lodge for a perfect vacation.

review_title: Totally surreal !! Insanely good trip !!!! But a little expensive :P
review_text:
Unbeatable location, Unbeatable views
Very nice guide and was astoundingly knowledgeable too.
Felt like I was on a different planet
We had a beautiful day to fly up to Denali.  Enjoyed the trip.  We had several ages in our group from children to 50. The pilot was very knowledgeable.  Everyone enjoyed the trip.

review_title: Awesome... in the real meaning of the word
review_text: If you really want to see the mountains, and you are not a climber, this is the way.  A 1-1/2 hour flight including a stop on Ruth glacier is a wonderful thing to do. Flying over and through the mountains, clouds and glaciers is a phenomenal way to see the area. Landing on the glacier is unforgettable. Dave, our pilot and guide is extremely knowledgeable of the geology and geography and seemed excited to share it with the passengers. A trip you shouldn't miss.

review_title: Glacier landing with Talkeetna Air Taxi - Pure Magic
review_text:
My daughter and I recently flew with Talkeetna Air Taxi for what can only be described as a flight of a lifetime adventure.  Flying towards Denali, we weren't too sure how easy it would be to see the mountain as there were various layers of cloud, but ultimately they only served to enhance the sheer scale and majesty of Denali and surrounding peaks.  We were treated to unparalleled views of "mini Switzerland", the west buttress of Denali and finally the Sheldon Amphitheater and upper Ruth Gorge where we landed and spent a glorious,  30 mins playing in the snow, enjoying bright sunshine and soaking in the sheer beauty of this place.
One special commendation to Talkeetna Air Taxi for being such a safe and thoughful operator - we were given snow boots to cover our sneakers and a great check in briefing. Richard, our pilot, provided everyone on the plane with great photo angles by adjusting the flight route to capture vistas from both sides of the aircraft - there really were no bad views on the plane and his commentary was spot on! We have no hesitation recommending this trip - it really is a must do activity for your "bucket list", even if you live in Alaska!
Well worth the money and time! The best way to see the mountains and glaciers. Our pilot was extremely knowledgeable of the geography and history.

If you are visiting Talkeetna and have some extra time consider taking a flight seeing your with Talkeetna air taxi. They are located walking distance from town, but they will come get you if you don't, or can't, walk. The planes are well kept and the pilots are excellently trained. 
The flight we took was magnificent! We even saw the tip of Denali. 
I would definitely recommend this company and tour!
This was definitely one of the high lights of our trip to Alaska. Everyone should experience this. The service, people, organization, and safety was impeccable.

We took our 6 & 8 yr old boys on an evening flight with a glacier landing (Ruth Glacier). Flying between the mountains and taking in the various glaciers etc was great. 45 min flight to the landing, 15 mins on the ground and then a shorter ride back as your descending. I would highly recommend it for everyone including families with little ones! They loved the snowball fight on July 4th.

Our scenic flight was the highlight of our Alaska trip. Our pilot Leighann was knowledgeable, safe, and fun to be around- she clearly knew her way around the mountains and was able to transfer her passion for the Alaska Range to her guests. The entire process—booking, check in, pre flight briefing, and being airborne—was a breeze. Our flight included a glacier landing, and I’d highly recommend the same to anyone. It’s great to see the peaks from the air, but to be immersed in them for a little while and admire the enormity of them from the glacier was breathtaking. Both of the takeoffs and landings were smooth, and we were safely escorted back across the runway in Talkeetna at the end. I’d suggest this trip to anyone traveling through the area, families too!

review_title: WOW, This is a must if you really want to see Mt Denali
review_text: After researching the Mt Denali National park and nearby attractions we were concerned that we might not even get a glimpse of the shy cloud cloaked mountain. We found Talkeetna Air Taxi on tripadvisor and read through other’s reviews. We booked our group of 7 for the Southside Explorer with the glacier landing (A MUST). We could not have been happier with our experience!   OMG the views were THE best we got in all of our Alaska trip. Granted we were blessed with extremely good weather on the mountain, but still, WOW. If you want great pictures of The Mountain, the glaciers and the range, this is the perfect adventure.  The plane was no bumpier than a commercial flight and every seat had a great view. There were single rows and everyone had their own window.  The pilot did a great job making sure both sides of the plane had good views and was well narrated. Do be sure to add on the glacier landing. The view, the snow, the experience is once in a lifetime. Again, we had good weather, but it was odd being in short sleeves while playing in the snow.

We booked this excursion independently!  Price was reasonable, and became more so with a Thanksgiving Day Sale!  We were met in Talkeetna and taken to the airport.  Our belongings were safely stored during the flight.  The pilot was younger but very informative!  As certain landmarks were indicated, there was then time allotted for pictures.  The flight lasted approximately two hours.  It was well worth the time and the price.

review_title: Most memorable day of our trip
review_text: Highly recommend this excursion and this provider. Top notch outfit. Professional without being stuffy. Fun & engaging pilot with lots of great info for his passengers. Totally amazing once-in-a-lifetime experience. Worth every penny (and this from a penny-pincher).

This is one of the most amazing flights I have ever taken! We had a beautiful day, knowledgeable (and competent) pilot. He pointed out so many features, glaciers, and mountains, and was able to answer all of our questions. We were lucky enough to have the right conditions to be able to land on the glacier, which was awesome. The customer service is also exceptional. I would recommend this activity and this company to anyone!

We took the Grand Denali tour with a glacier landing.  Although I thought it was a little more money than I thought we should be spending. It was worth the cost. We came very close to the mountain which was awesome. The glacier landing was also great landing on a glacier lake!

The trip of a lifetime!   We have been wanting to do the flight to Denali on this trip but the weather was not cooperating.  On our way thru Talkeetna, we stopped by Talkeetna Air Taxi and booked a flight that afternoon.  Incredible!   Shilo, our pilot was great.  Very informative and very very safety conscious.   Landing on a glacier was on the bucket list; check that off!   We would do this over any bus trip in Denali any day.  We did the bus, forget it, take the plane!   Wonderful trip.
Terrific flight, exceptional "up close" views.  Big shout out for our pilot LeeAnn.  She provided great commentary throughout the flight.  Wish we had time to do it again before we leave.

I booked a flight-seeing trip and was surprised after paying to be told that we were upgraded to a glacier landing and theGrand Denali Tour.  I was leary of this as I had thought a crevasse might open under the plane and swallow us into a bottomless pit.  I was assured this would not happen and I am here to tell you I make it safely off the glacier.  The pilot (Richard) was great and provided us with great information about what we were looking at and details on where to look for mouton climbers.  Solid trip.

We had a great experience with Talkeetna air taxi. They helped me arrange my husband's birthday celebration on the glacier. Staff were very courteous and everything went seamless. Thank you Talkeetna air taxi for the wonderful experience which we are gonna cherish forever!!

The Talkeetna Air Taxi flightseeing trip around Denali with a glacier landing was INCREDIBLE. I went with my friend who lives in Anchorage, and he said it was the coolest thing he has ever done in Alaska. We went on a clear, beautiful day, and I'm so glad we did it. It is pricey, but not outrageous, and totally worth it. This was a definite highlight. We have already been recommending the experience to friends. I was very comfortable flying with this company.

We recently enjoyed a flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi that included a glacier landing.  It's hard to describe how much fun and how exciting the entire flight was.  Of course the scenery was spectacular.  The view of the peaks of Denali, Foraker and Hunter, white with snow and protruding from a solid layer of clouds was breathtaking.  It is a toss up whether the views of Denali or the glacier landing was the most exciting - both provided memories for years to come. Our flight was in the afternoon and the office building at the airport was very busy with travelers awaiting flights as well as those who had just returned.  Although busy, the entire process was well organized and simple.  There was noticeable positive energy and excitement in both groups.  All the staff we met were knowledgeable, friendly, and eager to make our experience memorable.  Our pilot, Dave, was highly experienced, confident, thorough, and really fun.  His description of what we were seeing as well as what maneuvers he was going to do, gave us, the passengers, a high degree of comfort.  Plus he provided a lot of good information on glaciers and the geography of Alaska.  We flew in a turboprop, De Havilland Otter that seated eight-or-so passengers plus the pilot.  The glacier landing was so exciting as the pilot didn't have to descend to land...he just flew until the skis of the aircraft landed on the snowy upward slope which served to slow the aircraft down to taxi speed very quickly...and, it was so quiet as we landed - a truly unique experience. 
 After about 15 or 20 minutes in the snow outside the aircraft, taking photos and watching two other aircraft land on the glacier, we re-boarded  and the pilot pointed the nose down the snowy slop and we glided downhill until we were once again airborne.  Our flight was capped by the fact that upon returning to the Talkeetna area, we had to circle the airfield until a moose that had wandered onto the runway decided to move back into the woods.  I venture to guess that most of us had never before had a landing delayed by a wandering moose.  A bit expensive, yes...worth the cost, most definitely!  Flying with Talkeetna Air Taxi was, without a doubt, one of the highlights of our visit to Alaska.  This company and its people have earned our highest recommendation.  Just do it...you'll be very glad that you did!

What an amazing trip! I lived in Alaska for three years and didn't take this trip until I went back to visit almost 20 years later.  The glacier landing was the icing on the cake! I would urge anyone who is considering this option to spend the extra money to enjoy this awesome experience.  The weather on the day of our flight posed some challenges due to aircraft restrictions but the folks at Talkeetna Air Taxi worked with our group to ensure we all got on a flight.  Once we got above the clouds the views were incredible! Truly a first class operation and something that all visitors to Alaska should put on their "must do" list!
This wascthe most awesome thing I've ever done!! Would love to do it again!! I have a lot of great pictures.

The Majesty and beauty of  Denali is Spectacular. Words cannot do this scenery justice.The pilots are very experienced and handle the planes, and weather around the mountains with ease. We also did a glacier landing which was fabulous.The experience is something you'll never forget.
One of the highlights or our trip!! Our pilot was very friendly and knowledgeable regarding Mt. Denali and the surrounding areas. Could not ask for a better guide.

review_title: Awesome flight with an awesome pilot!
review_text: Very professional, organized, fun and safe. We landed on the glacier, flew around the peaks, and saw the Alaskan countryside.
This was phenomenal!!  What a gorgeous day and landing on the glacier was such a bonus !!  Thanks to our pilot Richard too !!

our flight around Denali was the highlight of our Alaska trip! The safety of their passengers is of primary importance. Their talented pilot flew us around various mountains and safely landed us on a glacier. The views were absolutely spectacular. A must  do for everyone !
Flight was fantastic. The glacier landing was incredible. Pilot was very knowledgeable and he is a great pilot. Couldn't feel the landings at all.

This is the absolute best view of Alaska that you are ever going to get. In a word- majestic! I have been to Alaska over two dozen times (I work there) and this was by far the most breathtaking experience I've ever had. I truly have a much greater appreciation for this state- and I was already a huge fan! You might feel a little woozy on the ascent and descent but it should NOT keep you from going! We were even running late and felt terrible- we were totally prepared for them to cancel us but they magically accommodated us, even though it was totally our fault for not getting there on time. I can't tell you how much I appreciated that.
We had a great time, especially the landing on the glacier.  Our pilot was fantastic, and did a good job of getting us some excellent views.  It was a once in a lifetime experience!

We waited until the day before to actually book our flight; we wanted to be certain we would have good weather. Well, we were advised nearly 75% of folks visiting Denali never get to see the mountain peaks due to cloud cover. Well, we were unbelievably fortunate as we had a cloud free sky. Our 90 minute flight was calm, quiet, and spectacular. Our pilot provided a narration as we left the airfield and approached the mountains and glaciers below. Beautiful sights, majestic views; a truly once in a lifetime moment.

Prior to being in the area we had looked into a flight seeing trip.  We decided not to book it because you never know what the weather will be. On our way back from Denali National Park and Preserve we had a picture perfect day. We stopped at the office in town, Talkeetna,  and found they still had available flights for the day. We decided to do the Grand Denali trip with a landing.
We were floored by the experience, better than we could have imagined. The pilot,  LeeAnn was great. We landed at Base Camp 1 which was WOW.
So glad we did the trip it was one of the best parts of our Alaska trips.
Additionally all the staff we dealt with were very professional.
Beautiful day,pilot was very helpful,landed on Ruth glacier, scenery was awesome!! Two weeks later and I still picture it in mind daily.

My son and I took a trip to AK for a graduation gift. We had made a reservation for a flight with a glacier landing. When we got to town the day prior to our reservation, we checked in at the office to see how things were going and for any last minute details. It was a clear day and they encouraged us to be flexible and go that afternoon. It was awesome! It was a perfectly sunny  afternoon and Shilo the pilot was a wealth of great information, in addition to being an expert pilot. Great team of friendly people behind the counter and a great pilot!  Loved it! It was the trip of a lifetime.

Excellent experience. Beforehand, they were very upfront about the possibility of not landing due to weather and gave us opportunity for refund. However, we decided to go for it and were able to land on the glacier! Gorgeous views of greenery and snowy ice. Our pilot was so confident and comfortable we all felt very at ease. Spacious tour with only 5 other people in the plane. Highlight for sure!
The trip was everything we could have wanted.  Beautiful weather, personable pilot, spectacular scenery.  Top notch operation.   Easily worth the time and cost.

review_title: Fun in the Sky with Talkeetna Air
review_text: Flying with Talkeetna Air was the highlight of our Father/Daughter trip to Alaska! We were in a small 6 seater prop plane with an experienced pilot who flew us through beautiful granite canyons, over magnificent glaciers and near majestic mountains. It was so fun to land on Pika Glacier and play in the snow as a family. This has been on my 80-year-old father's bucket list for many years, and we were so happy to be with him during this happy occasion. The ladies at the front desk were so kind, helping us with check-in and purchasing t-shirts. They even gave my dad a t-shirt on our way out. Thank you for such wonderful memories Talkeetna Air Taxi!

Everything about this trip was awesome.  The flight, the views, the customer service, it was well worth the drive up from Anchorage.  The pilot was very informative, the take off and landing all smooth.  He even took extra time to, circle around and show us two large moose feeding in a small lake and two brown bears in a field.  The Glacier landing was the best part!! Don't leave Alaska without doing this!

The air tour over the Denali Range was indeed awesome.  The grandeur and beauty of the mountains and the glaciers were beyond our expectations.  Our pilot, LeeAnn was the perfect host with her commentary of the the area surrounding Talkeetna and Denali.  Her commentary enabled us to learn about the mountains and lakes and to visualize how difficult travel to the area was before air travel.  What took us minutes in the air, took men and women weeks or months on the ground.  She made us feel thankful to see what many would take years to see.  We were fortunate to have clear weather although a cloud layer prevented us from viewing the entirety of Mt. McKinley however, we got a clear view of the mountain above 18,000 feet which was above the cloud cover.

In all, a trip to remember and a wish to visit Talkeetna again to fly with TAT.

We did the Southside tour with the glacier landing and it's by far the best trip! What an amazing experience and wonderful views during the trip. Our guide was great at explaining history and what features we were flying over throughout the trip.

review_title: The highlight of our Alaskan trip!
review_text: We had a free day on the last day of our trip to Alaska.  The weather gods were smiling that day and provided us with partly cloudy skies.  An early morning phone call to TAT from our hotel in Healy got us a reservation for later in the afternoon.  We took the "Mountain Voyager" flight and WOW!!! we were not disappointed.  The entire experience was first class all the way.  The staff of Talkeetna Air Taxi was friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful.  The flight itself was phenomenal with jaw-dropping views of the Alaskan mountain range and glaciers.  A very well run operation.  Two thumbs up, five stars, highly recommended - what more can we say?

review_title: Highlight of our trip to Alaska!
review_text: We took the Grand Denali trip with a glacier landing and it was spectacular! This was the highlight of our trip.

wear multiple layer of clothes so you are comfortable to play around on the glacier. snow boots given by talkeetna air is a savior with out which we would have not been able to move an inch on it. 

very friendly pilot and kept assuring us while talking about our surroundings and history. 
once in a lifetime and totally worth the money. 

FYI: I went with my parents who are over 50 & Indian but they loved it.

We took the Mountain Voyager w/glacier landing  at the recommendation of a friend who is a Coast Guard Pilot. The aircraft was confidence inspiring and our pilot, Chris, was truly knowledgeable and reassuring. The weather is always the "x" factor, but our trip was magnificent, sunny and clear. We circumnavigated the Denali area and made a smooth landing on the glacier near base camp. Awe inspiring is the only thing that describes this trip. Absolutely include the landing if you are thinking about going. Be prepared for some bumps on the ascent, but surprisingly smooth sailing once you are at altitude. Highly recommend this for all comfort levels!

review_title: best part of our Alaska vacation!
review_text: This was hands-down the best part of our recent trip to Alaska! Talkeetna Air Taxi was absolutely amazing to work with and they even upgraded our flight for free! Obviously they can't control the weather, but we had perfect flying conditions and the views were simply stunning. Our pilot, Leanna, was super nice and very knowledgeable, and we felt completely safe with her at the helm. Definitely go for the glacier landing—a once in a lifetime experience. Can't recommend these guys enough!

I was a little worried to ride in a small plane for a few reasons, but I could not be happier with my decision to do the Grand Denali with Glacier landing. The views from the plane will not be forgotten and the landing was by far one of the most adventurous things that I have ever done. The pilot was wonderful and the experience was excellent from start to finish. I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi!

We booked the Grand Denali tour with Glacier landing, June 3. We were very fortunate that the weather was so good. It was a beautiful sunny day, and not a cloud in the sky. There were 11 on board, pilot and 10 passengers. They provided each passenger with special boots for walking on the glacier. Our pilot was amazing, so competent, and made us feel very comfortable. It did not matter how which side of the plane we sat on; the pilot made sure passengers on each side of the plane saw Mt. Denali. She also described and named the various peaks and rivers and glaciers that we flew over. We landed on the glacier next to Base Camp 1 where the Mountain climbers were preparing for their ascent of Mt. Denali. Standing on the glacier, circled by snow capped mountains was amazing! Because of the sun it was actually quite warm on the glacier, and we did not need jackets. And I will also add that the cost of the flight was less than the cost of flights booked from the village outside of Denali National Park.

review_title: First time, but not the last.
review_text: Service was excellent.  Pilot was terrific.  Very engaging.  Weather was not ideal, but still the Air Taxi made it worth the money.  Would love to do it again sometime.
Excellent experience, memories that will last forever! TAT has the best service bar none. Friendly, professional pilots and staff!!

I booked the Mountain Voyager with Glacier Landing flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi. While traveling from Wasilla to Talkeetna, I spotted Denali in the distance -- this was an exciting start to the day. After checking in at the office, I put some booties on over my shoes and boarded the aircraft.  The craft seated ten passengers, and we all had windows. Headsets helped to muffle the engine noise and hear from our pilot (the microphones were not activated). The weather was clear as we headed into the Alaska range, but we encountered some clouds/mist as we first entered the mountains. It was hard to see, and I had to remind myself that these pilots fly these routes every day and weren't going to fly the plane into the side of a mountain! Thankfully, the clouds cleared soon. The views of the snow, ice, and glaciers below were stunning. Now and then, we'd get a glimpse of bright blue ice below. Then we spotted the peaks of Denali -- the the highest mountain peak in North America. One of the main reasons I took this flight was to increase my chances of seeing it, and fate was on my side this day. It was breathtaking to see the crisp white snow against a brilliant blue sky, with its own little cloud on top.  I had lots of time to snap some photos and video as we slowly moved from north to east peaks.
We landed on Ruth Glacier, where we all stepped out on to the snowy surface (thank goodness for the booties)! We had ample time to walk around a bit and take photos. There were maybe a half dozen other planes around, and it was interesting to watch them take off and land.  I had a moment that literally took my breath away when I took a step and my foot sunk down about 18" beneath the snow!  But I laughed as I was startled, and was not hurt in any way. We were also able to get a few more glimpses of Denali as the clouds just beneath the mountain top shifted in the light breeze.
I could not have asked for a better experience -- well worth the price and a memory that will be a highlight of my first time in Alaska!!

Our family of 6, including my 81 yo father-in-law and his wife all did the Denali flight with glacier landing on our recent 10 day trip to Alaska.  It was the highlight of our trip. Really beautiful views, and our pilot (who has been doing this flight/landing several times a day for 14 years!) was top notch.  We were never nervous.  Worth every penny!
As suggested in other reviews, we scheduled an early flight.  When we arrived we were told we could fly, but the landing area on the mountain was too foggy for landing and that portion of our cost would be refunded.  We were offered the chance to reschedule for the afternoon, which we took.  By then the landing site was clear so we got to land!  As we were preparing to take off from the glacier, which was really cool, the fog and snow started to return.  A real window of opportunity and luck!
Fantastic trip and our pilot was excellent. We landed on the glacier which was one of the best experiences; an absolute must if you go to Alaska.

review_title: Absolutely stunning and the best thing that we did in Alaska!
review_text: WOW! Do not miss this! We flew in a DeHavilland Beaver (one of the original mainstays in bush planes) with our family of four and two other guests. Shilo, our pilot, was very safety conscious while being a perfect tour guide as well. Take off was smooth as can be and Denali was out in all its majestic glory! We had a sunny and clear day to fly over and tour the river, glaciers and mountains. We booked the glacier landing and landed at upper base camp (just a couple of little landing bounces and we were down on the glacier). To stand on that glacier and see Denali was the experience of a lifetime. We were so grateful and happy to have this fantastic experience. We had time to take photos, build a tiny snowman, throw a few snowballs at each other and stare in awe at the scenery. Then back on the plane for even more amazing scenery. Flying over the glaciers gave us new appreciation for the spectacular rivers of ice. We landed back at the Talkeetna airport just as gently as we took off.

We made reservations with Talkeetna Air Taxi in October 2016 for our "Great Alaska Vacation" in June 2017. The flight around Denali with a glacier landing was one of the most anticipated items on our itinerary. We knew there was a risk of weather causing a problem and sadly it did. We arrived for our morning flight with scattered showers and overcast skies. TAT showed how they monitored a web cam and communicated with climbers to assess the conditions. Denali was not flyable, but they gave us three afternoon times. When we came back TAT was "straight as an arrow" with us. With eight pilots waiting around, they really wanted to fly. Our experience was most important to them however, and they said we would not see much on the flight. Alas, no Denali this time, but we hope to come back. If we make it back we will absolutely schedule Talkeetna Air Taxi. We'll probably add a "Plan B" day in case of weather! Good, TRUSTWORTHY folks!!

review_title: The highlight of our Alaska vactaion!
review_text:
If there is one must-do activity in Alaska, you must undertake this breathtaking flight to the Alaskan mountain range and the Ruth's glacier. Yes, the weather may play foul and ruin your plans but it's worth the risk to reserve a day for this once-in-a lifetime experience. Our pilot LeeAnn, a resident of Talkeetna, was very experienced and amicable. She gave a running commentary of the regional landscape while flying safely. We have never seen (and doubt if we shall ever see again) mountains, glaciers, walls of granite, the great Wickersham wall from such close proximity. With the sun shining brightly upon us, it was unusually warm on the glacier. Talkeetna Air Taxi crew provide the necessary footgear to walk on the glacier. It was pure and pristine, to the extent, that we could just pick up snow from the glacier to quench our thirst! The 360 degree landscape is mindblowingly beautiful and it will always be the most beautiful Alaskan memory for us to cherish!
- Rupa and Anirban.

We flew with Talkeetna Air Taxi around Mr. Denali. Alex was our pilot. The flight was so smooth and the views, out of this world. Definately one of the highlights of our trip to Alaska. It is a MUST DO!

My husband and I opted for the Southside explorer trip with glacier landing. All I can say is that the term 'awesome' was probably coined for such an experience. Special call out for Melissa our pilot and Emily who is a part of the ground staff. Do not miss this one!

We made trip in Alaska for 11 days. It was unforgettable and unique but this activity was, in my opinion, what made the difference. 
We did a flight around Denali for about 1 hour 30 min. The view is wonderful and we were lucky with the pilot that explained us all about Denali and the mountains. 
Totally worth the cost (it's a bit expensive). If you can, don't miss this.

The weather was good so we walked up and were able to schedule a flight for several hours later.  As a group of six we received a small discount. Check-in was easy - they weighed all of us plus whatever we were taking on the plane.  Bring a jacket - it's cool up there. Since we were landing on the glacier we were all fitted with a snow boot that went over our shoes.  Our pilot, Michael, was very competent and made a few who were nervous feel very reassured that we were in good hands.   In addition to flying the plane he was an excellent guide who told us about what we were seeing, history, etc. The flight was very smooth, and the scenery was breathtaking!  The glacier landing was fun - the actual landing was not nearly as thrilling as you might think. We all rank this as our favorite experience of our Alaska trip - and we did a lot of things.  If I'm ever back in Talkeetna I will be doing this again!

Absolutely freaking awesome!! Our pilot, Clay, was just spectacular! We felt safe and in good hands. The glacier landing was the best part. Clay was knowledgeable and took us around the peaks, pointing out different key points the whole way. We did the 1.5 hour tour, and it was perfect. Loved it. Highlight of our trip. Don't even hesitate. (If you book in town at the little office with Steve next to Nagley's, he can give you a bit of a discount.)

Special tour with Lieghan (sp) in four passenger plane to see the route our son was climbing.  Weather and clouds cooperated and we got to see more than we thought we would.  Lieghan was a great pilot and guide.  Views were spectacular.  Ride and landing were smooth.  Everyone at Talkeetna Air Taxi was friendly and helpful.

Such excellent customer service. I'm local and have gone through TAT a few times on flightseeing tours - it NEVER gets old. The parents were visiting me this time and they were also blown away by the overall customer service, the friendliness and skill of the pilot, and of course by the beautiful Alaska Range!
Clay was an expert guide.  knew a lot about the glaciers we were flying over.  Very skilled at flying through the mountains and very pleasant

My husband and I did a heli-hike this morning. The pilot, Will, flew us out and dropped us off in the Talkeetna Range. Will was very nice! On the way back, he helped us spot moose and caribou, as well as views of Denali.

review_title: Spectacular Denali flight and glacier landing
review_text:
Very efficient check in process but weather looked sketchy.  Met our pilot, Leighanne, who looks 19 but assured us she was 37, a mom and a a very safe pilot.  It also turned out that she had summited and guided to the top of Denali 7 times.  We took off with clear weather reported from base camp (it was overcast when we departed).  Leighanne found a route that took us far to the west but assured us that we would be refunded our money if she could not get us up into the mountain.  
The mountain was clear from the south western approach and the views were spectacular from both sides of the plane.  Flew over Denali base camp and then Leighanne spotted an opening to land on Pika (?) glacier.  
Spent 20 minutes on glacier and then returned.  Very smooth flying with no airsickness for anyone.
Top compliments to TAT and to Leighanne - super enthusiastic, poised, confident and very knowledgeable.
This was our number one event of our 29 days in Alaska.

Even though we ended up not getting to see Denali or land on the Glacier, our pilot, and the staff of Talkeetna Air Taxi were professional and we appreciated that they put safety first. We flew a little ways to see if we could get around the thick clouds, but were unsuccessful at making it around them.  They ended up not charging us anything and refunding our deposit, which I thought was very nice.

Without a doubt, as all in our group agree, this was our best experience of our cruise tour to Alaska. Our pilot Clay, was funny, but more important, an excellent navigator through some interesting weather conditions. Clay made the decision to change the schedule and land on the Glacier first, before the weather made it impossible. Flightseeing with Talkeetna Air Taxi is a must, when visiting Alaska. The pictures say it all!!

THIS IS A MUST!!!! If you're worried about the cost or anything else, I promise you that you won't be disappointed! If you're worried about flying in a smaller plane, you won't feel a thing, it's a breeze!
