The pilots are exceptional at what they do, and will give you great information about areas you're flying over or near. We chose to do this at the start of our trip and couldn't stop thinking about it the entire trip. The views are indescribable, and I promise you it will be one of the most memorable and exciting things you've done in a while, or ever...

review_title: Best Activity to do in Talkeetna
review_text: Awesome views and the glacier landing was terrific.  A definite must do!  Had a blast!!!  They also provide local transportation.

I cannot say enough good things about our flightseeing tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi! We had a group of 4, and had the pleasure of flying with Michelle. She gave us a great tour with lots of interesting facts and history. I'm generally pretty nervous in small aircraft, but she put my mind right at ease! If you want a great view of Denali and the surrounding mountains, definitely book this! It is worth EVERY penny!!

I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi! Friends and I recently completed a Denali Climbing expedition, and I highly recommend TAT for your expedition needs. They cater to the climbers during the climbing season, with a focus on getting you onto and off of the glacier in a timely fashion. Their Basecamp personnel welcome the plane, and make getting fuel and getting going easy. She also did an outstanding job of coordinating basecamp departure, allowing us to keep our tent up as long as possible, while giving us plenty of warning before our flight out to get the tent down and get our gear assembled. The pilots were outstanding, efficient, yet friendly and informative.

During our "Talkeetna Hang" (waiting for flying weather), the staff at TAT was helpful, friendly and accommodating. They willingly gave us rides to/from Talkeetna, they let us have coffee, relax in/around the office, and happily explained what was happening with the glacier weather. Tom was exceptionally helpful in getting our gear weighed and prepped for the flight as well as giving/arranging rides to/from Talkeetna when we needed them.

Also, having the bunk-house for climbers was fantastic. You never know when you are going to get stuck doing the Talkeetna Hang, and having a place to crash was great (not 5 star accommodations, but for a climber it was great).

Although I didn't participate in a tourist flight, hanging around TAT, I observed that they take great pride in making sure that their flight-seeing tours are excellent, everyone getting on and off the planes had smiles on their faces, and while we were hanging around bugging the office staff, they continued to efficiently go about taking reservations and seeing to the needs of their flight-seeing customers.

Talkeetna Air Taxi is awesome!
1961 aircraft, amazing scenery, big su, talkeetna, smoothest landings, gigantic glaciers, Ruth glacier, clear skies, hello Mt. Denali, close view, 20,000 feet, top of North America... Woo hoo!

It was our last day in Talkeetna and we were surprised to see clear weather. When we checked out Denali Overlook Inn, the owner suggested we check out flightseeing as it was a good day for flying. He gave us $25 discount vouchers to Talkeetna Air. We called around 930am and they booked us for a 1 pm flight. Check in was easy and fast. Pilot gave us a brief instruction on safety and expectations and off we went. Flight was smooth going to the Alaskan range. Pilot gave us info while we went around the vast range of snow, glaciers and rock. It was a sight to behold! My sister actually said that it's overwhelmingly beautiful that no amount of photos can capture the grandeur of the mountain ranges. We were able to see Mt Denali's peak; the pilot did turns so both sides of the plane can take in the sight. Overall it took about an hour of flying. We felt safe and enjoyed it immensely. Many times, people we met tell us only a percentage of tourists see Denali's peak when they visit because of the weather; so if you have chance to see it, grab that opportunity!

We paid for a ride but were upgraded to a glacier landing for free and were very pleased. The pilot was excellent and very helpful in helping us load and unload and assisted us getting out on a glacier.  Our pilot, Will, made us very comfortable and was very helpful in assisting us.

review_title: weather didn't cooperate but company was A+
review_text: We booked the flightseeing around Denali with glacier landing. Unfortunately for us, we had excellent weather for the entire trip except the afternoon we planned to do this excursion. It had been cloudy and a little rainy earlier but when we checked in to fly it was improving. We were told that the mountains were clear but there was a lot of clouds in the valley between us and the mountains. We were given the option of trying to find a way through the clouds but were warned that a glacier landing probably wouldn't happen unless conditions improved before we got there. Otherwise we could cancel or reschedule. Since we had to leave early in the morning and couldn't reschedule, we decided to try. Our pilot was Alex and he tried to break through the clouds in 3 different places, but ultimately we had to turn back. I was very disappointed that it didn't work out but was very impressed with the professionalism and commitment on the part of TAT to both keep us safe and accommodate us. In the end, they refunded the deposit which I wasn't expecting. Definitely give these guys your business if you plan to see Denali by air!
Lee Ann was our pilot, and she shared lots of great info about the area, including climbing to the summit of Denali.  The ride was safe and absolutely amazing!

I used this company fifteen years ago for a Mount McKinley flight and they were wonderful.  So, I decided to use them again.  I phoned them to make the reservation, and they were very helpful.  We were going in to Talkeetna by train and I was concerned about the time frame.  After securing the date and time I immediately received an email with details and instructions.  They offered to pick us up at the station; I declined because I thought we would have plenty of time to explore the town and walk to the terminal.  Well, the train was late, and they had a van waiting!  After checking in at the terminal they drive us into town to get  a quick lunch, picked us up, and then took us back after the flight.  That is going the extra mile for sure in customer service!  
The flight itself was amazing.  Our landing on the glacier and spending some time there absorbing God's handiwork can't be put into words. 
No question as to whether I would use them a third time.  They are not only professional; they are thoughtful and and considerate of their customers.

Sure, it's insanely expensive (2 seniors cost $650+) but it is even more amazing than we thought it would be. Flying through - as it, way close -  snow covered, mountains is fantastic.  You'll see things you never thought you'd see, - the sheer cliffs, the vista, the glacier.  And a very smooth and (reasonably, it's a small plane, after all) quiet ride. Everyone is next to a window, so looking out, and down, is no problem.  The glacier itself, well, you're standing on snow, and snow is snow; The surroundings though are the thing.  Highly recommended.
We spent 12 days exploring Alaska, and our flight around Denali Mountain and landing on the Glacier at the climber's base camp was the absolute highlight!

We did the mountain voyager with glacier landing and it was unbelievable.  I definitely recommend doing the glacier landing - it's a once in a lifetime experience to land in the Alaska Range and be among the tallest mountains in North America.
We did the Glacier landing tour. Life does not get must better than that! Our pilot was the best giving us non stop narrative plus the perfect views.

Unbelievable day thanks to our pilot. The smooth flight was punctuated with an informative dialog and majestic views he delivered during the entire tour. The ground crew was accommodating, friendly and most helpful. The entire team made this the best flight of this type we have taken.
If you doing only one thing while in Talkeetna it should be a flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi.
Bert England & Chanawan Khantanod

It was just fantastic.   A MUST DO activity.   We enjoyed the plane, crew and especially Denali.  If you haven't done this before, pay the extra to land on the glacier.  Just extraordinary.

We shoe our photos to everyone and they are amazed -- but pictures don't do the trip justice!!

review_title: Awesome flight in the Denali area
review_text: On my first trip to Alaska I had an amazing flightseeing trip with the folks at Talkeetna Air.  The flight and glacier landing were 2 of the coolest things I have ever done!

review_title: Breathtaking views of Denali and surrounding mountains
review_text: The plane ride we took around Denali and landing on a glacier was the highlight of our 2 week vacation in Alaska.  The views out every window were amazing.  Our pilot, Richard was very knowledgable and shared interesting facts all along the flight.  I highly recommend the Grand Denali tour with glacier landing from Talkeetna Air Taxi.
Go ahead and shell out for the glacier landing when it's in season. You will thank me... Experience of a lifetime....

Our pilot Michael was amazing. This was a trip of a lifetime and he made it well worth the money! I took my 74 year old mom, my 22 year old daughter and 19 year old son to Alaska and this was definitely the highlight! Landed on the glacier!  I highly recommend Talkeetna Air and will be back! Such a great bunch of folks!

Talkeetna Air Taxi sight seeing flight and glacier landing was by far the best thing I did on my Alaska trip. The ladies at the front desk where exceptional in answering all my questions and were very friendly. The flight and glacier landing was just amazing, incredible experience to fly with TAT, pilots know all about this mountains and their great amount of experience shows on the smooth glacier landing and takeoff, incredible! Our pilot was Leighann and her depth of knowledge about the mountains as a previous mountain guide was an extra treat. Safe, fun and exciting!
I recommended this to everyone!

During our drive from Anchorage to Denali, we stopped in Talkeetna for our 11 am reserved flight.  It was cloudy out and I assumed that flights would be canceled, but I was wrong and they said visibility at Denali was excellent.  So we loaded on the 10 passenger plane and next thing I knew we were in the air.  We flew under the clouds for about 20 minutes then followed a glacier upwards.  We flew right through a hole in the clouds and the landscape changed dramatically.  In front of us were rugged mountains covered in snow and ice.  The clouds were beneath us and the skies were crystal blue.  We flew right up to the side of Denali and the pilot made some leisurely turns so that both sides of the plane could see everything around us.  Then the pilot said we would be landing and the next thing I knew we were touching down on a flat snow covered plain (glacier) in the middle of soaring mountain peaks.  My family and I stepped out of the plane into a winter wonderland with approximately 2 feet of fresh snow.  We took in the sights and took pictures for the next 20 or so minutes.  We witnessed a small avalanche on one of the mountains nearby.  We all got back on the plane, took off, and headed back to Talkeetna. The whole experience was about 1 hour and 45 minutes.  The flying was perfectly smooth the whole time. We did the Mountain Voyager With Landing.  My adult daughter-in-law said it was the most amazing experience of her life (she hasn't had children yet!). It's expensive but if you can afford it, an experience worth doing once in your life. Tip - the pilot may offer the front seat (next to pilot) to anyone who is interested.  On the way up one of the other passengers rode up front.  I asked to switch positions with him on the way down and he agreed.  Might be better on way down as I was kind of distracted watching the pilot do his thing. The plane windows are quite large and all my pictures came out really clearly with no reflection.

review_title: The tip top of our trip (pun intended)
review_text:
My mother lives in Talkeetna and she has always raved about her trip to the glacier on the top of Denali.  When I brought my adult sons to visit, she encouraged me to go.  We booked through the Alaskan Lodge we were staying in and they chose TAT although I have heard that K2 aviation was also very good.
The airplane held 12 passengers and we all wore headsets to hear the pilot.  Our pilot gave us lots of interesting information about the mountain, glaciers, the climbers we saw on the mountain, climbing the mountain facts, etc. and kept us entertained during the flight.
One lucky passenger was able to ride in the front seat next to the pilot. The windows in the back were adequate to take short video clips from my phone that showed how close the steep mountain sides were to us.  A still photo did not give enough scale because these rocks and ice walls are immense. 
Landing on the glacier on a sunny summer day was exciting.  The snow was slushy and luckily they provided waterproof booties to cover our shoes and pants.
This is a must-see experience for anyone who wants to get up close and personal with Denali.
Helpful friendly staff. Exciting adventure. Fun competent crew. A truly unique way to see the mountain.10/10!

The only proper way to enjoy Denali up close and personal "without" doing the 3 week climb to summit.  I have used this company twice now for flightseeing.  Both times were very different weather wise, yet equally mind blowing.  I have felt like I was in very safe hands both times.  The pilots are very knowledgeable and will not put you in danger so if you have a fear of flying, know that.  The views you get from any of these outings will really blow your mind.  I fully intend to go back for a third flight in fall.  You will absolutely no regret the decision to do this.

review_title: One of the top 10 most exciting things I have done!
review_text: Imagine flying right next to Denali! You are so close that you feel like you can reach out and touch it. Then winding your way through and past lesser, but still very impressive peaks to land on a glacier right beside Denali. Amaizing!

review_title: Landing at Denali Glacier with Talkeetna Air Taxi
review_text: Landing at Denali base on a Glacier and taking a walk around at that place, remains the ultimate high of my life long travel around the world. Though, at $300 a pop, ride is not exactly cheap for budget travelers, it would be very unwise to let this, once a life time opportunity for most of us, slip by. Do book in advance to ensure a seat. There are many places to stay in Talkeetna to suit all pockets, but Alaskan Lodge(little on steep side) is highly recommended.

review_title: Very exciting ride, recommend to all
review_text:
Our Pilot was Melissa Andrzejewski. She was excellent. This flight was worth every penny and the sights are just amazing. We had such wonderful views and Melissa explained all the sights during our tour. 
I would highly recommend this company Talkeetna Air Taxi. Ask for Melissa.

We took grand denali tour with glacier landing. The entire experience was outstanding.This tour was one of the highlights of our trip, the glacier landing experience is surreal.. I highly recommend this tour!
Trip of a lifetime. Professional, safe time. LeAnne was an excellent pilot and great tour guide. Highly recommend this if you are taking a trip in the Talkeetna/Denali area.

We had a Grand Denali flight scheduled but weather did not permit it. They gave us the choice to do the southside tour, so we took it. We had been in the park two days and had not seen the mountain and this trip allowed us to see the majority of it, above the low lying clouds.
Once we got in the air, the pilot got a report that we could land on the glacier.  He had not expected it and no one had picked up their glacier boots.  We didn't sign up for the glacier, but we are so glad that we did it. What an awesome experience!  I expected ice, but they landed on the upper parts where there is snow cover. There had been 3-5 feet of recent snow, so it was not a problem walking in the packed down areas.  There was a climbing party eagerly awaiting a pickup, since they had been out two days longer than they scheduled.  Our two planes were able to pick most of them up.
Make room in your vacation budget for this, we'll be talking about this for a long time.

Our third trip with TAT.. Never disappoints. Shiloh was our pilot this trip and was very knowledgeable, concerned for how we were doing and what we wanted to see. Had a Denali climber with us and he made sure to show points of the climb. Very capable pilot... Great landings! Office staff is also very nice.

review_title: REALLY WORTH IT AND DONT FORGET THE FREE POSTCARDS AND STICKERS!
review_text:
worth every penny! Richard is very friendly and experienced. four seat aircraft, about one hour and a quarter fly through the mt. Denali. the front row and the last row have the best seat to take pictures.  the most important things is they provide the free postcard and stickers, dont forget to take them!  
talkeetna air taxt share the same airport with k2 air company .

Took my father as a 70th birthday present.  We both had a incredible time. An easy day trip from Anchorage. Took the 8:30am flight and had amazing views of the North side of Denali.  They seem to adjust the flight to get the most out of the weather.  Extremely capable, friendly and informed pilot (thanks Clay).  Glacier landing is a must.  Staff at reception were great.  Had us checked in and ready in no time.  Would definitely recommend TAT for this.

You can walk a week or fly an hour! 

These guys got us in and off the Pika Glacier safe and sound and smooth sailing the whole way! 
The pilots were fun, experienced and interactive.

Took a tour with TAT on05-25-2017. When we checked in the weather was looking decent and the great folks at the counter gave us a briefing about what to expect and were very clear that there was a slim chance at best of being able to land on a glacier during our flight as there was a storm front approaching.  After discussion, 3 of us, we decided to take the chance. We took off with no problems and the flight was going well but as we approached the mountains the clouds got much thicker and we even flew through some rain and snow.  The pilot tried several different routes but was unable to find a safe route up Denali far enough to a safe glacier landing site.  Even though we did not get to land on a glacier the flight was fantastic and the pilot provided a lot of information about the mountains and glaciers and surrounding area.  When we landed back at the airport, one of the counter folks came out to meet us and said that due to the bad weather and our not being able to land they had reduced the charge for the flight.  The next flight tour I take will be with TAT!  They are GREAT!

Did the glacier landing with TAT yesterday. The staff is super organized and dedicated to making your flightseeing the best it can be. Our pilot Alex was skilled and confident and clearly experienced. We loved every minute. A special thank you to the team who arranged for my 94-yr old dad to sit upfront in the co-pilots seat.  It was a special thrill for him.

We had booked a flight-seeing tour of Grand Denali months prior to our adventure. The day before we received a phone call asking if we could change our time and come earlier. We were staying 2 1/2 hours away and still wanted to do a drive through Denali NP that morning. We told them we would try and we did. (Still doing the drive at a good pace) Once we got to Talkeetna Air Taxi to check in, they had a family of 4 also checking in (which they were going to do the Glacier Landing & We were not) But because we were asked to change our time they included us in that plane. We were pleasantly surprised. THANK YOU! 
The pilot was very knowledgeable and answered questions on the flight. The take off and landings were very gentle. Talkeetna Air Taxi provided the water proofs boots for the Glacier Landing. All the staff members were very kind and helpful! I would fly Talkeena Air Taxi again and highly recommend them!
The flight is in a remote location, but the facility is very easy to find.

We tried for glacier landing at 10 am. Due to weather constraints, we were unable to land. The pilot tried his best. Got amazing views of the glaciers. The billing for the tour was reduced. Good glacier shoes were provided and glasses were also offered

Very friendly, accommodating staff!     Cloud cover was sketchy (can't control the weather) so they gave us options to fly, reschedule, or cancel for refund.  We are glad we chose to fly. Our pilot, Shiloh was great. He provided an inspiring glacier & area tour.  His skill, knowledge, & persistence ultimately resulted in being in the right place just as the clouds parted & Denali appeared.  A bucket list flight!

I totally recommend. It was amazing.  We did the Mount Voyager tour with glacier landing. We were scheduled originally for the May 18th, but due to terrible weather conditions we had to postpone it. The office people were very helpful offering alternatives dates and times. We went two days later (our choice) and it was wonderful. The flight was so nice and our pilot Trent did great specially when landing and taking off from the glacier.

The flight was excellent great views of Denali , except for a small amount of cloud . The political leanne was great and gave an informative commentary all through the flight.
She was passionate about the area and the mountains.
We were advised to take the Air Taxi by our son who flew last year, as the pilot was so good and were please when we had the same pilot.
Christine and Scott NSW, Australia
From the shuttle driver the book..In procedure to the professionalism of the pilot and the beautiful scenery and the exhilaration of landing on the glacier this is a must do tour

What an amazing flight with a great pilot. Shiloh knows the mountains like the back of his hand. He is both informative and entertaining. He made is feel safe the entire flight.

Courney, Vicky, and the rest of the office staff made us welcome the moment we walked through the door, breezing us through the registration process and making sure we were comfortable until boarding time.

The flight was amazing and the landing on the glacier was just a cherry on the cake! The staff was very professional and helpful. We really enjoyed it including our 4 year old son who was super happy to build a snowman on the glacier.
It was exceptional experience!! 
Thank you team TAT 
Lucy, Wojtek & Bruno
It was awesome! The scenery was breathtaking, and our pilot was fantastic. The glacier landing was unbelievable. So warm up there with the sun shining, I left my coat in the plane.

Not only was this a breath taking ride around Denali, Martha was such a pleasure to work with. What a sweetie! She spent a lot of time making sure our trip to Talkeetna was incredible. She must know EVERYONE in Alaska, because she had contacts name for everything we needed for our visit from Anchorage to Fairbanks. Thanks to her, we took the Winter Train on Alaska Railroad. Do not miss the flight around Denali and be sure to get on the train to Fairbanks! Send another big hug to Martha and and warm wishes to the entire team at Talkeetna Air Taxi!! THANK YOU!!!
The staff at Talkeetna Air was fantastic!  Our pilot was very informative and very safety oriented.  Our landing on the glacier was smooth, and was beautiful!  We would recommend this trip to anyone!
Pilot is very experienced. Landing on glacier was smooth and great. Breathe taking view. I highly recommend Talkeetna Air taxi !!
Took the Cessna 185 flight. Landed on a glacier. Spectacular views. Great pilot. Highly recommend it.

review_title: Amazing, like visiting a whole other world....
review_text: I was in Alaska for a whole week, and on my last day some friends suggested I take a taxi flight around Denali. So glad I did! I was a little worried at first because I sometimes get a little nauseous on small planes. This flight was so smooth, I had no problem. The pilot was very informative and the flight provided me the opportunity to get some spectacular photos! What a way to end a wonderful Alaskan trip.

I did not imagine we'd fly so close to the peaks, the views were spectacular! The glacier landing was amazing, our pilot was very professional and knowledgeable, and it was overall a highly recommended experience!
Our trip over Denali was beautiful, very nice, knowledgeable pilot, and an amazing office staff who even helped me track down pastured eggs for our trip!

We have been only living in Talkeetna for about 2 weeks and this was on the top of our list to do. The office staff were nice & helpful and the our pilot, Leanne, was amazing. The tour last about 2 hours and goes through the Denali range including close-up views of Denali, climbing camps and a landing on a glacier. The pilot provides an excellent tour with information about the range, peaks, climbing and history of the area. If you only do one thing while in Talkeetna, this is it!

We went on a day trip from palmer to talkeetna and then back to anchorage ..As we really wanted to see Denali from top ..We had booked a long tour here but due to clouds on top of denali , our tour length was shortened and money refunded ...but still the tour covered a lot of Denali national park and it was just out of world experience to see so many glaciers ...they were looking like some car has moved over on them ...Roads of glaciers all around and then the landing was awesome ...One can never forget such a beautiful experience ..A must do attraction while you are in alaska...
这家公司服务很好，驾驶员技术高超。我们选择的grand Denali，期间飞机落地15分钟。推荐大家选择这种，降落在北美最高峰，近距离看雪山很震撼，我们还见到了雪崩，好在夏季雪少，没有危险。

This attraction is indescribable.  The views you see from the plane are nothing short of breathtaking.  You absolutely must chose the glacier landing...well worth the extra money.  The staff was VERY friendly and courteous...The pilot was extremely knowledgeable and professional.  Highly recommend!

Fantastic, well worth every penny.
We travelled 5,000 miles to get to Talkeetna and it was everything we'd hoped it might be.
Gerard from Nottingham

review_title: Safety conscious, enjoyable and eye opening flight
review_text: Although this was a fair chunk of money, we decided to do this flight and also paid for a glacier landing. We did the  Mountain Voyage with Glacier landing. The pilot was very upfront and said for our safety they were not doing glacier landings, so that part was refunded to us.  It was really awesome to see Denali from this perspective as well as the surrounding areas.  We were very lucky as the previous few days they could not go up or they could not see the full mountain (I forgot which).  We all got to take photos from all angles.  Well worth doing.

We contract with this Air Taxi for our flights into the Alaska Range and throughout the State for both mountaineering and film production work. Their pilots are experienced and friendly, and their office staff is well organized and has superior customer service.  I'd reccommend this family owned company to anyone wanting to access the Alaska Range or other Alaska backcountry location. TOP NOTCH!

review_title: Wow!! Great Service and Amazing Views!!
review_text: We took a flight on March 15th and it was incredible!! Dress for cold weather and bring a camera! We had a fantastic time walking on the glacier and seeing the mountains up close!! Highly Recommended!

We made the last minute decision to "flightsee" Denali. I am so glad we did! They accommodated us even though we had not reserved a trip. I would recommend making a reservation! You do not want to miss this trip! The pilot was informative and not over talkative! Views you can't get any other way!
Loved it!  Didn't think I would really like the glacier landing, but it was great and well worth the extra price.  While we didn't see Denali, that didn't mar the experience.

Perfect day, perfect flight, perfect take offs and landings....very engaging pilot/guide and the most breath taking views of Denali.  If you are saving your $$$ to do something that will absolutely rank near the top of your list of the best things you've ever done....go for a walk on a glacier at 12,000 feet! Awesome inspiring!

review_title: Best thing we did while on our trip in the Fall!
review_text:
Our decision to spend the money for the flight over and around Denali was the best part of our trip!  The fall colors (just after Labor Day) were stunning purples, pinks, yellows, oranges, and red, on the lower part of Denali.  Seeing Denali from the snow capped peaks to the glaciers at her feet was much more memorable than when we saw her from a distance in the Denali Park (on the bus tour).  We highly recommend this service.  
Our female pilot was great.  We wore headphones to communicate and were told that if our ears got painful from the air pressure that we should tell her.  We were seated in the back of the small plane enjoying the views so much that when our ears hurt we never took the time to try to communicate, our fault.

We did the Scenic Flight with Glacier Landing however due to the weather we were unable to do the Glacier Landing which was absolutely devastating.
we did still manage to do the scenic flight which was lovely and the scenery over the mountains was just beautiful however we were really upset we didnt get to land. 
I think i was a little more annoyed as the pilot just announced to us in such a casual manner "yeah so it doesn't look like we'll be landing today sorry folks" so blaze. 
There was no heartfelt emotion behind that which really annoyed me. He gets to do this trip every single day where as for the people on board this is a once in a lifetime opportunity. 
We were offerred a partial refund for not getting to land on the glacier which was very appreciated. We were just very disappointed. However the views from the plane were amazing and if you do get to land then you should feel very lucky! 
The flight before and after ours both managed to land on the glacier.
Simply put, ONE, AMAZING, FLIGHT! This was the best flight I have ever taken. Definitely a must do in Talkeetna. Once in

This was the highlight of our Alaska trip. We took a little plane to the top of Denali, landed on a glacier and walked around on it...exhilarating. Getting to see all of the mountains from the air with the tour guide coming through our headphones was great. This is definitely something everyone should do. Very pricey though.

We drove from Anchorage to Denali, and the weather was perfect:  Blue sky, barely any clouds, Denali easily visible from the road.  So, we spontaneously stopped in Talkeetna and booked a flight-seeing tour and boy was that a good decision!  
I hadn't booked a flight-seeing tour in advance because all research indicated that the weather is unpredictable.  So, we were extremely lucky!

The little airport is easily found, it's not like Talkeetna is that big :-)
They weigh you in and you can even leave your purse with the staff, if you don't want to leave it in the car.
They give you glacier shoes, and then you go up in a propeller plane (a Cessna in my case) and have stunning views of Denali National Park!
Remember, there is really only one road, Parks Hwy.  And there is only one road in the park, and it's not very long.
From the air you begin to realize the vastness of the place!  You see the tree line, little lakes with cabins and no roads leading to them.  You see glaciers and where glaciers used to be (hello, global warming).  You see the pure granite mountains and snow and glacier ponds and so so much more!

We landed on Ruth Glacier and it was so beautiful.  Quiet. Pristine untouched slow, clear blue sky, the freshest air you can imagine.  Just ... peaceful. 

It was an amazing experience worth every penny.  If you can afford it and if it seems right, do it!  You won't regret it!

TAT is always a joy to fly with! The pilots are wonderful in the air, both flying and passing on their knowledge of the Alaska Range and it's numerous climbs. All staff are beyond hospitable. Would fly with TAT again and again!
My 2 teen daughters and I drove up on a whim. We were accommodated on short notice and had a awe inspiring flight. Thaks

review_title: Mt. Denali Experience of a Lifetime
review_text: Originally we had booked the Grand Denali tour with a glacier landing, but unfortunately weather did not permit the landing or the extended flight around the backside of the mountain. At first I was disappointed, thinking the experience would somehow be "lesser", but as soon as our four seater plane took off, I was in pure awe for the next hour. We had a very small window of clear weather, and we hit it perfectly, allowing the light to play on the mountain faces so uniquely and extravagantly. Our pilot was full of knowledge and very enjoyable to talk with. He took us within what felt like arms length from the mountain sides multiple times, and we circled in and out of various pockets of clear space surrounded on all sides by vertical walls of granite and ice. The experience was truly one of a kind, and I couldn't have asked for a better journey to glorious Mt. Denali. Thank you so much Talkeetna Air Taxi!

The flight to Denali with glacier landing was one of the main things I wanted to do while in Talkeetna. Unfortunately it looked like mother nature wasn't going to let it happen. TAT worked with us to keep rescheduling and we finally got wheels up on our last day. It was an amazing flight and I felt extremely safe in the hands of the pilot. We also lucked out and only had to share with 1 other couple, who happened to be visiting from our hometown of DC! Hint: book early in your trip so there's time to reschedule if needed.

How do you describe something nearly indescribable? We went up on a very clear day and saw amazing vistas. It felt like we flew nearly close enough to touch the mountains. Honestly, after about 30 minutes, the views seemed like maybe we were watching a movie, not something real--it was that incredible. We didn't get to land on the glacier because of the season, which was a bummer, but otherwise, a definite wow experience. The staff and pilot all treated us well and were very friendly.

If you get the opportunity to do this, don't miss it. The scenery is unreal - it has to be seen. In our case, the clouds covered the lower half of the mountains, so the landing on the ice was not an option. Instead, we were offered either a refund or to be taken above the clouds to a higher altitude to fly around the top where it was reported to be clearing up. We went for it and didn't regret it at all. We appreciated the advice of the experienced team at Talkeetna Air Taxi - you could feel they really love what they are doing and are not there to make a quick buck. So if you are in Talkeetna or on the way to Denali - definitely make a stop here for couple of hours and make sure you see the highest mountain in North America. By the way, we only saw the top of Denali from the Talkeetna Air Taxi plane - for the three days we spent at Denali, the mountain was nowhere to be seen :).

We were treated to a young and pretty lady pilot who was keen to share her experience of flying these planes in the mountains of Alaska. This made our trip to the glacier really unique.

The skills required for such landings on glacier and weather flying are definitely impressive.

Good service, safe experience.

review_title: Well worth the drive and the price!
review_text: We had a beautiful drive from Anchorage (could see Denali on the drive!) and were so NOT disappointed with the flight!....it was just my husband and me and the very knowlagable pilot (owner of the company) in a tiny single engine plane....we felt we were up close and personal with that beautiful Alaska mountain range!

Alaska is a beautiful yet magical state that captivates visitors with a spell second to none. However, a journey through the last frontier is not complete without a scenic flight around Denali, and the "Range". And for this particular occasion I have chosen Talkeetna Air Taxi service to show me the grand vistas around Talkeetna. The pilot was knowledgeable, and conveyed important information pertinent to the area, and this day in particular could have not been better to undertake a scenic flight. It was a crisp November day with a some fresh fallen snow, which transformed the landscape into winter wonderland. I certainly would choose fly again around Denali in any of the four seasons just to be mesmerized by stunning vistas.
Excellent service- the pilot was very knowledgeable (and patient with tons of questions from our 10 year old). We'd definitely recommend this trip!

Thinking about how we almost didn't do this prompted me to write this review.  I remember that we just didn't want to spend the extra money, since this Alaska Land and Sea vacation was already costing a pretty penny.  But our traveling companions decided to plunge ahead, so we gave in and followed suite.  What a mistake it would have been to miss this flight!!!

Let me just say that although I had MANY stellar photos from Alaska, the view of the snow-covered mountains taken from the window of this small airplane -- with my iPhone -- became the cover photo for my Alaska photo album!  Words cannot describe the breath-taking beauty from the air above Mt. McKinley.  The excursion we purchased also included a glacier landing, but we were fortunate enough to actually land at the base camp for climbers to pick up a lone climber finishing up his trek, which was fascinating in itself.  

There really are no words to describe this adventure, and the staff and pilots from Talkeetna Air Taxi were no less exceptional. If there's any way you can afford the money for this adventure, I HIGHLY recommend you spend it here!
Es war ein tolles Erlebnis bei gutem Wetter auf einem Schneefeld im Denali National Park zu landen. Das Preis-/Leistungsverhältnis war in Ordnung.

review_title: Amazing flight over the mountains this afternoon.
review_text:
Thanks for an outstanding flight this afternoon over the Denali national Park. What spectacular views, breathtaking. 

We went up in a Cessna with pilot Paul.  Smooth take off and landing.  Very informative as we traveled over the different areas.  

The plane was very comfortable with nice windows to easily see everything around us. 

Kimberly was wonderful to deal with when we booked our flight.  Offering many different options to suit our needs.  

Would recommend Talkeetna taxi air to anyone looking to do an aerial tour of the area.  

Thanks for a great flight.

It isn't often that the fact you did NOT do an attraction results in a five star rating but in this case it is true.  We had booked a flight over Denali with a glacier landing but the weather on the day we were to go was miserable.  The conditions were safe for a flight but with the overcast/rainy skies we would have seen very little.   The Air Taxi representative contacted us with options we could do at a reduced fare but gave us the option to cancel if our hearts were set on Denali.  They were and we did, money was refunded promptly.  We already have plans to come back in the summer and you can bet we will be contacting Talkeetna Air Taxi when we do.   First rate customer service coupled with a first rate safety rating make for any easy choice!

We used this company in August and had the best sightseeing flight of our life!  The sky was so blue and the glaciers on Denali were enormous! I would recommend these guys for your flight seeing tour!

We did the Grand Denali tour in August 2016. The day we were scheduled to go was cloudy and rainy so the office was able to reschedule us for a few days later when we came back through town. I am a nervous flyer and was very nervous going into this tour but it was actually very easy and I was never afraid. There is no other way to get a sense of the vast and dramatically different landscape. The views were incredible and we were able to see Denali. It's a must do if you are in the area.
It was the highlight of our trip. Landing on the glacier was one of the most incredible things my wife and I have ever done. The pilot was very informative the entire flight. It is a must do.
Well worth the money, was absolutely amazing. Glacier Landing was so cool & once in a life time experience. Our pilot was awesome.
It was a very good and unforgettable flight we took to see the mountains and the lands. Glacier landing is strongly recommended! Excited to touch and be surrounded with great mountains!
2nd time flying with Talkeetna Air, sure hope it not the last.... Hands down the best, courteous, great staff all the way around, and excellent pilots!!!

took a great flight to Denali!  Could not do the glacier landing as it had just snowed 5 feet, but it was a great flight.  Everyone has a window seat, the pilot flies so that both sides get to see everything.  Really beautiful!

The staff at Talkeetna air taxi went out of their way to make a memorable experience, from the moment we were collected from our accommodation to the counter staff and the pilot, it all ran smoothly and pleasantly. The weather wasn't great and visibility was low, however we still managed a glimpse of Denali and marvelled at the miles of glaciers. If you can, choose to land on the glacier, walking around amongst the soaring peaks and soaking up the solitude is well worth it, a highly recommended trip.
Maybe our best experience! We loved it, especially glacier landing and vastness. We have enjoyedevery moment

This is one of THE highlight of our Alaska trip. The glacier landing was a heavenly experience and the flight path cutting through the glacier valleys were like from a movie.
Talkeetna air taxi team were awesome, esp the office staff were very very friendly and accommodate well. We kept our luggage for long hours and they didn't mind. Also moved our dates to suit the weather, since the day we booked first had bad weather. It was worth the wait and excellent customer experience. Thank you! TAT.

Una experiencia que creo que no debes perderte y ellos tienen muchos años de experiencia.Amables y profesionales.Recomendamos coger la opción de aterrizar en glaciar, no lo olvidaras.El piloto muy amable, profesional , con explicaciones por radio, y aunque hubo algunos baches , para el viento que hacía antes de despegar no se movió casi nada.Abrigarse y ellos te dan protectores zapatos para andar por la nieve en el glaciar , donde para unos 15-20 min , estás a unos 800 metros de altitud con la pared del Denali en frente de 6.194 metros.

It's always my absolute pleasure to fly with TAT towards mighty Denali - the High One. TAT will take you there softly and gently. If the weather seems to be perfect - no clouds - but the wind Is too strong - they say: sorry - safty first! If there are dense clouds and the High One Is above - they say - come next time, maybe will be better. So they dont want you to pay for seeing clouds from inside :)
Good combination of standard, service and money. And attitude on altitude :) 
My full recommendation (as a guide) :)

As you navigate through life there are a handful of experiences that make an everlasting impression that will change you in many way for the good. Our Talkeetna Air Taxi trip around Denali which included a landing on a glacier was a game changer. It was exciting, adventurous and humbling.  There is nothing like watching a good pilot (Richard) in action but to watch a good pilot take pride in sharing his talent was an extra touch thrown into the package. We were treated with courtesy, made to feel valued in our decision to fulfill our adventure and were acknowledge for the feelings of what we experienced. If you want a game changer in your life try this adventure with Talkeetna Air Taxi.

We booked a Denali flight, and when we arrived in Talkeetna by Alaska Rail from Anchorage, the weather was so bad that they canceled it.  They were very professional and apologetic, but safety first.  Disappointed, we wandered Talkeetna, when we got a call from the Air Taxi and said that the weather was breaking and they were going up to take their chances if we wanted to go.  Of course we did.  Barely glimpsed Denali through the clouds, but had a fabulous flight anyway, followed the Ruth glacier, and saw some amazing views.  Sit towards the rear of the plane for best views.  Under the wing you don't get the majesty of the height of the mountains.  Our pilot was very informative, but we had some stretches where Iwish our pilot had talked more about what we were seeing.  Or given us more Alaskan lore.  Overall great trip.
特别的享受--进行一次空中飞行，或者在冰川上面降落，是一项非常有意义的项目。因为天气原因，需要在此地预留足够时间。

At first glance, it seems very expensive for two hours in the air...but don't even think about it. It was SO worth it!  Dave, our pilot was so knowledgable and nice. The flight as smooth and the glacier landing a once-in-a-lifetime experience!  The gals at the check-in were super friendly and helpful. The views of flying so close to Denali and the glaciers were awesome!  Thank you for a grand adventure!

We have been all over the world, and I have to say this is at the top ! Over the top !! Put it on your bucket list today ! They were great, Andy our pilot was informative, knowledgable, and just a cool guy ! Thx again for the life long memories!

You may think the price is very high.
However, considering the professional of the whole team and the pilot, it's very worthy to spend $300+ flying with Talkeetna Air Taxi.
The best scenery I have ever seen.
We had a great time and your pilot was very informative. Thank you and see you next year  I can't think of anything I would change.
The host was considerate to prepare the boots for us. So no need to wear your own boots. The captain was professional enough to show us the wonderful scenery of Mount Denali. Thanks for your service.

The pilot was amazing and made our trip so much better. He made sure everyone got a good view of the glaciers. The service was great. I forgot my coat at the hotel and they were kind enough to let me borrow one.

Yes, its a lot of money but well worth it. The scenery is outstanding, the flight exhilarating and the glacier landing a once in a lifetime memory. Dave, our pilot, was determined to get on the glacier even though the weather was not idea. We weaved through the canyons and clouds to get to blue sky. After viewing many of the peaks Dave maneuvered the plane in for a spectacular landing. We were the second plane on the glacier that day. It had previously snowed so there was about 3 ft of powder. The mountains surrounding you as you look around are enormous. It certainly puts your place in the world into perspective. Take photos but spend most of your time just absorbing your surrounding!

review_title: Never took the taxi but still would go here
review_text: We never took the air taxi because of bad weather but this company tried their best to accommodate us. Very polite, friendly, and full refund was given.

We not only had the flight of our lives, we got to see all of Denali free of cloud cover, and land on on a glacier and walk around.  Truly the most exciting part of our trip to Alaska, and worth every dollar.  Thank you for an unforgettable experience!

Our Grand Denali flight with glacial landing was everything and more than we expected.  Plus the clear blue skies and almost unlimited visibility made it even better.  While you can look at videos of such flights there is no comparison to  actually being in the plane and looking out the window.

This is a wonderful experience we will never forget. We did the Glacier landing tour and it was amazing! Landing at the top of the mountain surrounded by snow/glacier mountains is an unbelievable feeling.  
The staff are really nice.
Will do it again if I get the chance! 
I definetly recommend this tour to everyone!

We were very lucky to arrive in Talkeetna on a very clear day ... Talkeetna Air Taxi kindly rescheduled our flight from the following day so we could take advantage of the superb weather (the next day would have been hopeless ...it turned out to be very cloudy). An experience not to be missed... flying with a bush pilot in a small aircraft through terric mountain and glacial scenery. Expensive but worth every penny.

This was such an experience!  The staff at Talkeetna Air Taxi were friendly and helpful, and the flight itself was breathtaking.  The pilot made sure both sides of the plane had access to all the various views, and he was great about explaining what we were seeing.  They were also very upfront with us before leaving that the glacier landing may not be possible due to snow on the mountain.  We ended up not being able to do the glacier landing, but they processed our refunds very quickly upon our return.  I highly recommend taking a flight with them!

Since I was paying for three people instead of just two I was unable to do the glacier landing like I had wanted. We did the hour flight but it was amazing and felt like it was a good amount of time. Was able to see Denali which I guess is not always so. Our guide was great, but I can not remember her name since I waited to review this until now. I would say do not hesitate to spend the money and if you can only afford the hour trip it is still amazing!

We booked a flight-seeing tour while staying in Talkeetna for a few days.  The weather did not cooperate (hail, clouds and turbulence) so we were unable to fly, but at no cost to us.  The TAT team was very friendly and tried reschedule our flight, hoping the weather would improve.  I got the impression that they want every flight to be a safe and unforgettable one.  I appreciated that, and hope to fly with them next time!

review_title: Mt McKinley at it's most sectacular
review_text: Oh so lucky! We went to the airfield directly from the train.  The weather was clear and calm.  Our very capable pilot flew us into the Denali National Park, around three sides of Denali and the auditorium.  Spectacular views, departing along the great glacier and back to Talkeetna.

review_title: Patience pays off.  The highlight of my Alaska vacation.
review_text: We stayed in Talkeetna four nights and saw nothing but rain every day.    No flightseeing planes were departing the airport all week.  I was disappointed since a primary goal on this trip was to fly up and a glacier landing.  Then merely one hour before our checkout time our last day TAT called and said "We are flying today.  Are you still interested?" we took off in the rain but once airborne the sky broke clear and the flight to the mountain range was spectacular.  We landed on the glacier in about a foot of fresh snow. TAT's level of service, focus on safety and customer satisfaction are all excellent.  A special thank you to Steve in the downtown "office" for keeping us abreast of the improving weather conditions.

This was the second time I flew with them. I do believe it was even better than the first. The scenery is unbelievably beautiful and the glacier landing is an experience I will never forget. I highly recommend this trip to anyone.

Despite the chance of rain, we lucked out w great weather for the flight. Amazing views, great staff, outstanding experience. If you have the chance, ABSOLUTELY do the glacier landing! It's definitely worth it!!
Check in was easy!  Staff is friendly and helpful!  Our pilot was fabulous!  I am so glad we flew with you guys.  Our experience was perfect, start to finish.  Thanks TAT !!!!!!

I was just reviewing some photos that we took of our flightsee over Denali in July 2016 and decided it was time to write a review.  After 4 days at Denali and a week on a Princess cruise with other excursions this was by far the highlight of our trip. I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi.  We had plenty of time to walk on the glacier and our pilot was very knowledgeable about the area.

This was the highlight of our 2 weeks in Alaska. We were fortunate to fly on a crystal clear day and our pilot was able to give us amazing views of Denali and surrounding mountains. Felt like you could reach out and touch them. Absolutely spectacular. Landing on the glacier was a great experience. Always felt safe and learned a lot.. This is a not to be missed experience.

With no reservation in hand, and relatively cloudy weather, this professional team made us feel we were in secure hands.  Steve patiently explained our tour options, and the cautious company policies regarding weather, and followed up by calling us and getting us in an open flight on the only day we had.  At the flight check-in, the TAT team explained all parameters of the flight with a view towards safety and our enjoyment. Paul Roderick was our pilot, in a high altitude capable Otter.  We felt we were in superbly capable hands for this ultimate flightseeing tour.  We thought we had a fair idea what to expect from the many utube videos we had watched, but on the flight, experience leapt above expectations like Denali leaps above the cloud deck!  Truly an unforgettable, marvelous experience!  Thank you, TAT Team!

Flew with another air service last year, they were o.k. however, we didn't realize what we missed until we flew with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Our pilot Andy was great!!  He took us so close around the mountains, it was surreal!  I highly recommend you choose this operation for your aviation adventure!!!

If you are blessed to be in Talkeetna on a clear day take this trip! It might take a chunk out of your souvenir budget but the memories will beat that hands down. Steve hooked us up with the flight and was happy to answer all of our questions. The pilot was wonderful and flew around so everyone could get a view. We got to get out on the glacier and it was breathtaking. Take this trip you won't be sorry.

Very friendly and accommodating staff.  The day of our original reservation was overcast with drizzle.  They changed our booking to the following day with no hesitation or charge.  The pilot reassured my daughter-in-law about taking my 2-1/2 month old granddaughter on the flight. He was right - she slept  almost the entire time and we got to experience the spectacular scenery all together!

We cruised up the inland passage, stopped at all the normal stops and did  lots of  side trips, high speed boat sight  seeing, zip lining, the tram and glaciers. We also did a four day inland tour to Copper River Lodge and Denali Lodge with sighting and river rafting. BUT.... nothing compared to the flight we took with Talkeetna Air to MT. Denali. To experience the mountain up close and land on a glacier was the high light of the entire trip. If you don't do anything else, DO THIS.

This trip is worth every cent. Landing on the glacier is beyond words. When you step out, it's so quiet and beautiful you feel like you're on top of the world. Our pilot was so friendly and knowledgeable. 
I would recommend this for everyone.
Outstanding|  One of the coolest (no pun intended) things I've ever done.  Scenery was breathtaking.  Great pilot provided an excellent tour.  Well worth the cost.

review_title: Flight with glacier landing, a fairytale
review_text: Will never regret we took this flight with landing on the glacier. It was nicely narrated  by the pilot with lots of details.

The Denali view and glacier landing was a great experience, our pilot was friendly and informative, and the management went out of their way - and beyond our expectations - to ensure that we had the best experience possible. Great company & people!

We have lived in Alaska for 25 years.  This was the first time we took a flight seeing trip and it was wonderful.  We had a perfect day and the pilot was very knowledgeable.  It was clear it was more than a job and he gave us a great narrative and a great flight.  The glacier landing was wonderful and a awesome part of the trip.  I would recommend the trip.

This flight/tour was just as good as advertised.  The plane held ten passengers including the pilot.  Everyone had a window seat and the pilot did his best to make sure that everyone saw everything and he would teach about the all of the sights that we came across.  This is a great way to experience the awesome magnificence of Mount Denali and its glaciers.

review_title: Talkeetna Air Taxi flight with a glacier landing
review_text: Leanne the pilot was exceedingly professional and knowledgeable.  She obviously knew the area very well and was an excellent pilot.  We had no worries or concerns and could enjoy our adventure to the fullest.

review_title: great trip for the Austin group
review_text:
our pilot was great!!
the attractive "seasoned" lady behind the counter who seemed to be running the young ladies there was excellent.  She was warm, friendly and efficient.

user_location: New York, New York, United States
review_text:
I originally found Talkeetna Air Taxi via Trip Advisor. There was a big debate because we drove from Fairbanks to get there. I actually would recommend it if you have time to drive through Denali National Park but most people do the 2+ hour drive from Anchorage. I had called a few times and the people were extremely helpful and honest bc these trips require good weather. We lucked out and had bluebird day. We spent 30 mins flying out on a puddle jumper seeing Alaska in a way I never would have imagined! Tom, our pilot, was extremely informative about what we were viewing! Landing on the glacier was a breathe taking experience. Once in a lifetime must do. We wore a Patagonia and leggings. They prove you with boot covers so it was okay that I wore sneakers.

Its a MUST do part of Alaska. The Staff is 100% informative and so nice :)
Outstanding trip - weather was great.  Pilot did an excellent job of providing views from every angle for every passenger - fantastic landing on the glacier.  Excellent trip.  Would recommend highly.

We had a wonderful flight over Denali National Park and to the glacier.  Our weather was perfect, few clouds and no fog.  We landed on the glacier and 2 members of our flight had a wedding ceremony officiated by our pilot.  I highly recommend this excursion!  I was in awe of the beautiful mountains, glacier, and the sights of Talkeetna and the rivers from the plane.

Not cheap, but something my young daughter and I will talk about forever.  TaT takes excellent care of us passengers, and take all the pressure off so that it's like being a movie star. Great ride (we did glacier landing which we're glad we did).
Amazing views, wonderful pilot, very informative narrative as we flew near Deanaliband landed on a glacier. Lifetime experience!
everything about this flight was magical. My wife and I loved every second of it. It was truly at the top of our Alaskan adventure !!

It was absolutely great experience. Very experienced and informative pilot, smooth flight and terrific scene.

If there is any chance you may land on the icefield, take it. We did not book one with glacier landing, but got promoted due to schedule change by the company. I was extremely grateful, because the view was just so stunning on the glacier!

A little tip: wear you sun glasses at all time and definitely apply sun cream on your face. Also you should prepare to take a lot of pictures.

review_title: We took the trip around Mt Denali and two peaks
review_text: On either side. Pilot was excellent and very considerate. Highlight of our Alaska trip. It was breathtaking.

We spent 3 weeks in the great Northwest. Everyday was absolutely amazing and wonderful. Would not change a moment it was so good.  
The last day before we head out to the lower 48 was to book this Denali sumit with Glacier landing. It was the best thing we did the whole trip and that includes a trip into (Glacier Bay NP☆☆☆☆☆)(Watching humpbacks bubble feed in Juno☆☆☆☆☆)(Alaska rail white pass trip in Skagway☆☆☆☆☆)(from Seward Kenai fjord 8.5 hour trip☆☆☆☆☆)......and many other 5 star trips....but this one deserved at least one or more additional stars☆☆☆☆☆☆!!!!!
Inspirational, educational, awe inspiring and absolutely beautiful. Being that close to something as majestic as Denaili is a once in a lifetime event....you must go if you can. 
A piece of that flight will be in my heart and mind for as long as I live.

INCREDIBLE flight to view the peak of Denali and then land on a glacier!! All I can say is WOW. Exceeded our expectations in every way - would definitely recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi. Tour of a lifetime!
We did the Southern Denali exploration with Glacier landing. It was one of the most amazing experience I had during our entire Alaska trip. According to me, it is a must do activity.
What a fabulous experience.  My 17-year old son & I enjoyed our flight.  The staff was professional and our pilot was awesome.  We were in good hands while having the experience of a lifetime.

Talkeetna Air Taxi gave an excellent service from the initial enquiry through follow up questions to booking to pick up at our accommodation to the counter staff at the airport. Then the most competent and informative and reassuring pilot - (?)Papa Bravo - took us on the flight of a lifetime from Talkeetna across the tundra to the nearby Alaska Range and its glaciers, the spectacular flight around Denali and the Glacier Landing. An unforgettable experience. Thank you TAT

Denali can be socked in, but Talkeetna Air Taxi knows how to manage the weather and they were able to get us above 11,000 feet to see the top of Denali under fabulous blue skies, as well as landing on the glacier for a short while.  Great experience.
What a wonderful experience.  The glacial landing is not to be missed.  A great operation.  First Class.

review_title: Great experience landing at the Glacier. Wonderful flight with nice pilot, explaning everything. Very organized.
review_text: They offer hotel pick up and the take off was on time as scheduled. Their powerful airplane use short distance to land and take off. The Northen Ligths at Talkeetna Resort was winderful.

We were lucky as it was a cloudless day and Goddess Denali revealed herself in all her glory!!! The pilot was super and the flight including glacier landing was smooth and perfect. Highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi.
Great service, first good weather in weeks and still managed to accomdate us. Kids still talking about it

Were on a Princess cruise-land tour but found that this reputable company was less expensive to book on our own plus their tours were more encompassing of Denali than the other company that Princess offers with their flight excursions.They also offer a 10% discount for seniors or AAA members. Was a little nervous but the capable pilot made me feel at ease. Unfortunately, the weather prohibited us from landing on the glacier. A free shuttle will take you from the center of town to the airport and back to the center of town. Left my raincoat at the facility but the staff mailed it back promptly (at my expense, of course). Was an awesome experience that I would definitely recommend.

We went on the summit trip. It was a perfectly clear day. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and friendly. He made sure both sides of the plane could see everything. Gave us plenty of time on the glacier. I would definitely do this again!

My husband and I took the 6pm Denali Summit Tour with Glacier landing. Incredible experience! Felt very safe - excellent pilot. 
Best experience in Alaska!
The tour was very good and highlight of our Alaska trip. We could not do glacier landing  due to weather but they were very flexible to accommodate our timing.

We visited Alaska during a rainy week. 5 days of our trip was very cloudy with no visibility. These guys were very accommodating and flexible and moved around our reservation on request numerous times patiently and finally we did a wonderful glacier landing that was worth the wait :) I would say this is a must see if anyone visits Talkeetna

We took the air taxi from Talkeetna Lodge to the Denali Park entrance on our departure day.  We thought it would just be a straight shot out, but they actually take you on a great flight-see around Mt. Denali on the way.  The pilot, Dave, was super competent, knowledgeable, pleasant to be with, very tuned in to our needs and interests.  It turned out to be a highlight of our trip.

Clear blue skies gave us the perfect conditions to fly and land on the glacier!  Perfect way to see Denali!  Every person gets a window seat, the pilot gave us the history and all the info needed about Denali and the glaciers.  Landing, walking and taking pictures on the glacier is amazing!

We were extremely lucky to have a very sunny day for our tour of the Denali mountain. The pilot was so good and guided us through the mountains while describing everything we were seeing and the altitude height as we climbed. We went to 15,100 feet! The glacier landing was a once in a life time experience. A must do!

Though we coudn't take flight due to bad weather ..but I thought I should review them for their honesty and thourughly professional behavior ..they informed us that they were not sure if they could fly due to worst weather ..they returned our money ( as we booked one month advance ) and said us to come back if climate changed ...it was our bad luck we couldn't get a good day that time ..but they were concerned about our safety more than money ,they could easily fly half and come back ...but they didn't ..I appreciated that ..

We did the Grand Denali tour on August 30th. The weather was beautiful, sunny with no clouds in the sky. The check-in was located in a wooden house tugged in trees that have turned yellow, and with early Fall breeze, it just felt so relaxing and wonderful. The view of Denali, and its surrounding mountain range was beyond description, it was a once in a lifetime experience. We landed on a glacier next to Mount Hunter, where we could see snow getting blown off the mountain top. 

So glad I did this tour, well worth the money. The only two complaints I had were 1) I felt the view on the left side of the plane was better than the right side when flying towards Denali, as the left side faces Denali most of the time, and the right side only gets to see it when the pilot does a 360 degree turnaround. 2) The window right next to my seat had some scratches on them or maybe was just dirty, which caused some noticeable blurry spots on my photos. I switched to a different seat on my return trip which didn't have the issue anymore.
Such a great experience landing on a glacier.  Life altering.  Chris was the pilot and was informative and enjoyable to listen to. Highly recommend.

After having to delay our flightseeing because of poor weather, we were delighted that the team at Talkeetna Air Taxi worked with us to reschedule our tour for what turned out to be a picture perfect postcard day. We did the Southside Explorer with a glacier landing with Dave. It was AMAZING and we were so glad we went out of our way to return back from Denali to try again. Dave was filled with interesting information and landed us on a sunny glacier (Eldridge) with such expertise that we felt totally comfortable in his capable hands. We almost missed this YOLO moment and was so glad we didn't.

It's hard to not sound overly-enthusiastic about the glacier-landing trip my wife and I took with Talkeetna Air Taxi but it was nothing short of astounding. Our guide recommended this outfit and they did not disappoint. 
The weather had cleared as we were driving into Talkeetna and the full mountain range was free of clouds and brightly lit against a blue sky.  We had been scheduled for a trip the following day but T.A.T. rearranged our schedule to accommodate us while the weather was at a peak for flying. They were busy because of the optimal weather and we had a brief wait during which we were outfitted with ice booties (?) and watched the planes buzzing in and out of the airstrip. 
Our pilot was very friendly and informative, pointing out major sights along the way to the glacier and answering questions. The time on the glacier itself was magical and the place seemed almost fake because of the scale, grandeur and beauty of the stone and ice against the blue sky. We were even fortunate enough to witness an avalanche a few minutes after landing - something I understand to be unusual on a large scale. 
There are multiple air taxi companies that make this trip and I can't speak to the experiences that any of the others offer, but I can say that our visit with T.A.T. was nothing short of excellent.

review_title: One of the most amazing taxi rides you can take. Once in lifetime! Amazing!
review_text: We took the talkeetna air taxi adventure to about 14,000 feet on one of the largest glaciers in the world deeper then the Grand Canyon well over made wide. We landed at the base camp and had the opportunity to get out wonder around in very fresh snow on the glacier. Their were many hikers staying at the base camp getting used to the altitude and practice hiking so they could hike to the next camp level. On this particular day we crossed paths with the first small group to reach the summit of Denali and return back to take the taxi down. I have done 3 of the most amazing adventures in Alaska. The plane ride up with the plane driver talking to us about the different glaciers and how high we were going was exciting and amazing. I hope I get one more time to go up and wonder around perhaps stay over night on the glacier it was incredible and I wish everyone could take this trip once. It changes the way you think when you realize how big that glacier is 45 miles long, deeper then Grand Canyon and at least mile or more wide. Hiker look like ants on the glacier from the small plane. Adventure of a life time.

There are not many experiences like flight seeing around Denali.  Everyone gets an amazing view no matter your seat on the plane.  Our pilot gave us a good mix of narration on the mountain, it's geology and some climbing history.  This is a must do!!!!

@ 12 seater designed to soar through the clouds to try and glimpse Denali's peak, which is rare. But the other peaks, glaciers and runoffs are well worth it. Each seat has a window and the pilot provides commentary and answers questions that are hard t pose as the mikes on the headsets don't work. Well worth it and the flight was even and calm, important for queasy fliers.

review_title: Highlight of our Alaska Trip! for the 2nd time!!!!
review_text: This was my 2nd time in Alaska and my 2nd time using Talkeetna Air Taxi!  On both of my trips this flight was deemed as everyone's favorite thing they did on the trip!  The ages of my family (for both trips) ranged from 15 to 88.  This is a once-in-a-lifetime kind of thing to do.  Yes, it's a little pricey but worth every penny!!! I cannot recommend it highly enough.  FYI, I was very concerned that we would be cancelled because the forecast called for rain.  They told me that even if it is raining in Talkeetna it doesn't mean that it will be raining over Denali and we won't necessarily be cancelled.  They were right and the flight took off under a mild rain.  We landed on the base-camp for the hikers going up Denali and a glacier landing is definitely worth the extra $$.

The highlight of our two week vacation to Alaska was the Talkeetna flight to Denali, and to land on the glacier.  We were lucky to spend three cloudless days in Denali. Sobering to see the rapidly receding glaciers.  Smooth flight; very informative pilot.  I couldn't stop taking pictures.  Make sure you have plenty of camera memory before taking off.

The flight went off without a hitch.  Spent about two hours flying over the Alaska Mountain Range and circling Denali.  Such breathtaking views!  The glacier landing was well worth the extra money.  We sat amount the mountains for about 30 minuets and it was amazing.

What a great trip.  We did have the best weather ever and the smoothest ride of the year so I suspect we were spoiled.  Clear day, no wind and a great pilot.  Definitely do the glacier landing as that is a highlight in nice weather.  Also book a little ahead of the weather is looking fine.  They can get a flurry of guests in nice weather.  This is a must do and TAT pilot guides are great.
Tienen varios tamaños de aviones! Aunque precios elevados merece la pena la experiencia! Y posarse sobre el glaciar! Muy bueno el piloto!

Very professional and helpful guys. We arrived at this facility with no prior booking and requested for a space for 10 of us for the Glacier landing experience to Denali National Park. They not only accommodated us but gave us a very good offer and experience. Definitely recommend them.

WOW!!! Staff was incredible in assisting me with my plans to propose during our flight seeing tour of Mount Denali.  We were able to land at the basecamp at Mount Denali where I proposed.  Chris, the pilot was amazing.  He loved sharing the wonders of Mount Denali and was very knowledgable.  The ground crew and office staff were friendly, attentive and a great help.

My husband and I, along with another couple booked the Grand Denali Tour with glacier landing on a recent trip to Alaska. My husband and I have been to Alaska 7 times and this Grand Denali Tour with the glacier landing is by far the most phenomenal of anything we have done on any of our trips. We have been on a float plane tour, Alaska railroad, fishing charters, etc. But this exceeded everything.  Everyone we dealt with at Talkeetna air was very nice and went out of their way to make this a great adventure. Our pilot, Richard was the best. One of the smoothest takeoff and landings ever! This trip was worth every penny and I would definitely do this again on my next trip.

What else is there to say about TAT that hasn't been said before?  They are by far the premiere "flightseeing" attraction in Talkeetna, AK.  The entire staff could not have been more pleasant and helpful.  They pointed me in the direction of which tour I should take, as I was unsure/nervous about the trip ahead.  They eased any fear I had, and for that I could not be more thankful.  I bombarded them with questions, and they were able (and happy) to answer any and all of them. 
The flight itself was perfect.  Our pilot (shout out Clay) was professional and informational.  He knew when to point out attractions down below and when to just let the passengers enjoy the scenery.  The flight was smooth and the landing on the glacier even better.  He made sure everyone was comfortable at all times, leading to a truly once in a lifetime experience.  Cannot recommend this company enough.

review_title: Glacier tour and landing with Talkeetna Air Taxi
review_text: We were booked to fly around the summit of Denali but unfortunately there was no visibility to allow the tour to continue. Talkeetna Air Taxi offered a refund on our deposit or take another tour which included a glacier landing. It was amazing to see the glaciers from the air but the landing on the glacier was a memory we will never forget. Our pilot was awesome as well. I would highly recommend this to anyone in the area. It is an experience of a life time!
Although the flight was booked for another day, the transfer has to an earlier time is working fine. Staff at the airport and our pilot were projecting. The weather was also great.

review_title: Great tour if the weather permits.
review_text: We booked the Grand Denali tour with glacier landing for 1 pm. When we checked in we were told that the weather was not good and we could check back in at 3:30 and maybe the weather would clear and we could go. So we did and war were told then that we could not do the landing because of weather. So we decided to go ahead and take the tour. The clouds were so low that it covered up 3/4 of the mountain and we could only see parts of the other mountains, We were able to fly down below the clouds and view the glacier on our way back. In all the tour was good but I would not pay that much again unless the weather was clear so you could get your moneys worth. I would have rated this a 5 if the weather would have been better.

I think the flight seeing was probably the highlight of our Alaska vacation! Our pilot was great. Take offs & landings were as smooth as butter. And actually landing on tge glacier was fantastic! I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi.

My wife and I took the south side explorer at 8 AM. We thoroughly enjoyed the glacier landing and flight journey. Our guide was very knowledgeable and taking the talkeetna air tax was certainly the highlight of our Alaska trip.

Lo super recomiendo, parar en un glaciar es único y todo fue excelente. Destaco el servicio prestado, sacamos los boletos una tarde para ir al otro día y te dan garantias que si no se puede ir porque esta todo nublado (y no se ve nada) te devuelven el dinero. Esto da tranquilidad. En nuestro caso fuimos igual y como una parte no se hizo porque estaba nublado nos devolvieron la parte proporcional del viaje. Muy honestos

Booking was a breeze and front staff is very helpful right up to the day of flight with informing about weather and any changes to flight bookings because of the weather. 
Our pilot Mike was top notch. He was very friendly and a had a plethora of knowledge. We got to see the top of Denali which was awesome - but we couldn't do our glacier landing which obviously is a let down....but I felt safe the whole time with Mike and wouldn't complain at all about it. Refunds are issued for non landings. I am not sure if the company does less expensive stand by flights for those who didn't land, but if they did I would hop on that opportunity if they did. 
My advice is book flight you can afford and book the glacier landing and consider yourself lucky if you get to land!! This is a great company and I recommend to all!

I was worried that I was wasting $300 when I looked at the clouds obscuring Denali from Talkeetna, but I was so wrong.  This experience was worth every penny and more.  Flying along the glaciers and mountains and then landing on the glacier were the highlight of my trip.  It is something that has to be experienced to appreciate.  Words cannot adequately describe the beauty and majesty of the scenes.  Our pilot, Dave, was an excellent tour guide and aviator.

Temps couvert, ciel bas. Nous avions réservé un atterrissage sur le glacier mais cela n'a pu se faire. Pas beaucoup d'explication de la part du personnel, mais on nous a proposé une alternative d'un survol du glacier vers Palmer. Intéressant!
Le pilote était très sympa.

Had a 1 hour flight over the Denali mountains and a close up look at Mount McKinley. The pilot really knew his stuff as he flew very close to the mountain so we could get the very best photos. He was knowledgable about the area and that really helped make the flight enjoyable. Highly recommend this company as one to give you an enjoyable flight.

review_title: They've Done It Again! LOVED MY TRIP!
review_text:
This was my 2nd time back to Talkeetna Air Taxi. I went on a glacier flight last September while visiting a friend, but I had so much fun, when I returned this July with my wife and friend, I had to take them on this experience again.
