If you think it would be boring to fly around the Alaskan Range and land on a glacier for second time...you are sorely mistaken. I really enjoyed my second trip back in the range with TAT. The first time I went it was nothing but blue skies and there was a lot more snow in the range. It was a great experience having that much visibility, but I have to say this time there were a lot more clouds mixed in the range and it made for some unbelievable sights. The mountains looked almost if they were steaming, so cool!

This time around our pilot was Clay. He is a really cool guy and knows his stuff. Not only did he fly us smoothly through the range and land on Pica Glacier but he also gave us lots of information about the range and Denali National Park. We learned a lot up there.

I can't thank the people at TAT enough for not only creating an amazing for me twice, but also allowing me to share the same great experience with my wife the second time around!

Next time I'm back in Alaska, I may just have to go up a third time. Highly recommend.

We did the early morning Summit flight. It was absolutely breathtaking and I highly recommend. 
The staff at TAT is kind, helpful and willing to give you advice about the rest of your stay in Alaska. The pilot was knowledgeable and had a great sense of humor. 
The sights you see you will not see or be able to see anywhere or with any other service. 
Loved it!

My Dad and I took a flight which completed a glacier landing at the location of Denali Base Camp. It was awesome! The pilot did a great job of narrating the flight's sites, and was very safe at all times. It was definitely worth the cost. My Dad talked about it for quite some time afterward. We both immensely enjoyed the experience. The staff labored to make a flight happen during a day of cloudy weather. At 7 p it cleared up enough to make the flight, after waiting for several hours of uncertainty. Shout out to the staff for working late to make this happen. We drove for 3.5 hours each way to take this flight, and it was certainly worth the effort!

Expérience inoubliable. Personnel adorable et plus qu'arrangeant. Superbes avions. Un must à réaliser en Alaska si la météo est avec vous.
Prenez impérativement le glacier Landing incroyable !
Absolute highlight of an amazing week spent traveling from Fairbanks to Seward.The guides are great.

We made a specific stop in Talkeetna so we could take the flight tour by Denali. It was a very busy day for them as all of their flights from the day before had been cancelled due to weather. They masterfully worked everyone in.

We ended up on a plane with 10 others.  We flew up to the summit of Denali on a cloud covered day. At one point we broke through the clouds and there she was!  What a beautiful site..Denali peak with the sun on it.  Breathtaking. 

After flying past the mountain, we landed on a glacier and all of us got out to walk around.  My only regret was not building a snowman.  This is just a cool thing to do and well worth the price.  I highly recommend this tour.

We booked the 10:30am glacier landing on Saturday morning. All the girls working at the office were super friendly and helpful. They will kit you out with boot covers so you don't get your shoes wet if you land on the glacier. Our pilot was Andy. Great pilot with knowledge of the airspace and surroundings. However  could use a little work on his tour guide skills as we left still asking questions and which mountain was actually Denali! Maybe even a little sympathy from Andy as not all of us land there everyday. We were really disappointed to not be able to land on the glacier due to fog and unfortunately this was a huge downer for the rest of the flight. The scenery is amazing! We did get a refund for the landing part of the trip from the girls who again were so helpful and this was clearly out of their control. This is a big bucketlist item for me to land on the glacier so I hope to get another shot one day. Consider yourself lucky if you get the chance to land.
Great trip.  Pricey but worth it because you cannot really get close to the peaks and glaciers.   Very safe and professional.

review_title: Great tour but trust your gut regarding the weather
review_text: We actually had a flight booked with another company for the same day, but they were not flying to Denali due to the overcast weather. I ended up calling Talkeetna Air Taxi because I really want to get up to the mountain and they said they were flying and were able to get us on the last flight of the day (at full price). They were honest - they said the ceiling was around 9,000 ft. and there were clouds, but that we would still see awesome topography and views. We had a good flight and the pilot was very nice and professional - felt super safe, and he provided a great narrative of the area and the mountains/valleys/glaciers. We were able to see 2 glaciers, but it was really cloudy and we never got above 6,000 ft. I know they cant control the weather, but I wish I would have stuck to my gut a little bit more and tried for another day, or at least gotten a discount given the weather.

Wow! An unbelievable experience which will be a memory forever. We didn't see Denali but were able to do the glacier landing. It was magical. The scenery was indescribable. Our pilot was friendly and very knowledgeable. The staff at the office was the same-very friendly.

review_title: Helicoptor Ride to Dog Sled And Glacier walk
review_text:
ride was super awesome. The folks were very helpful and all went well.

The dog sled was cool and we definitely recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi. Next time I am in Seward, I will make it again

review_title: Beautiful flight experience with a great company
review_text: My sister and I took a flight tour to the Ruth Glacier with Talkeetna Air Taxi during our recent trip to Alaska. We had booked in advance but the day of our flight was rained out. Talkeetna Air Taxi gave us the option of rescheduling for our next available date (they were totally flexible with our itinerary) or completely refunding our deposit. We chose to reschedule and were glad we did! We did the southside tour with glacier landing. I would highly recommend adding a glacier landing to your flight if it's in your budget. Total tour took about 90 minutes from start to finish. Our pilot was experienced, informative, and friendly. He pointed out wildlife along the way and afterwards showed us our flight path on a map in the office. Talkeetna Air Taxi is a professional and well-run operation with great customer service. Definitely check them out!

We took a small plane for the "Southside Explorer with Glacier Landing". The plane had the pilot, my husband and myself, and a family of 4 with 2 small children. The views were great, and it was nice to visit "inside the park" from Talkeetna. We spent 30-40 minutes on the glacier. The company was great about allowing us to change our booking time (moved up earlier) when we saw clear skies and sunny weather. Our pilot wasn't too talkative (long day?). Overall, we enjoyed ourselves, and felt this experience was worth our time and travel dollars.

Cordiali e cortesi sia quelli della reception sia il pilota che racconta cio che si vede durante il volo.
L'esperienza in se è molto bella e vale la pena provare.

A once in a lifetime experience. 
We were fortunate that Denali Mountain peak was visable on the day of our flightseeing tour and glacier landing.  
I was impressed with the professionalism and expertise of the staff and pilots.  We received a warm greeting from Beaver, the businesses cat. Our pilot, (Clay), was very helpful and shared history of the area and facts on the formation of the park during our flight. We made a glacier landing at base camp for climbers use to assend Denali Peak. The views, vistas, glaciers, valleys, ridges, colors, patterns and textures were breathtaking.  It was a photographers dream trip.  A must do trip if at all possible.

review_title: Despite crappy weather, a great experience!
review_text:
We never made it to the 30% club. Denali was elusive from land and sky. However, Talkeetna Air Taxi, still provided an exciting and fun trip. They are very fair and provided 15 extra mins of flight time and a discount simply due to the weather which they have no control over.

We still got to see some great glacier views along the way and were able to make an exciting glacier landing. My daughter and I got to have a little snowball fight.  :-)  That alone made the trip worthwhile. My daughter also got to sit in the co-pilot seat on the way back from the glacier landing - a real highlight for her. 

One last note - my daughter had taken off a headband while "co-piloting" and forgot it on the plane. TAT called us the next day and let us know they had it and would ship it back to our home. This was great customer service and appreciated by our entire family.

review_title: Great views of the Alaskan Wilderness
review_text: We took a flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi on 6/1/16. Our primary desire was to fly up to the glaciers and tour around Mt. Denali. Be forewarned that weather can change in an instant and while we were up there, our views of the main peaks quickly became obstructed. Not to worry though because our guide was knowledgeable about the area and very friendly and eager to point out the various sites. Our glacier landing was spectacular. I'd highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi for your next tour!
This tour not only helped me achieve one of my bucket list, but it helped me create a memory that shall last a lifetime!  Thanks Talkeetna Air Tour!!

review_title: Amazing views of the most beautiful place!
review_text: Everybody there made my wife and I feel welcome and our pilot was able to answer every single question we had a about the area! Totally worth it!

Предложение полета к горе Денали было поводом посещения Талкитны. Не многие могут похвастать полетом вокруг одной из самых высоких гор, хотя бы и отдельного материка. А еще и возможностью пройти по горному леднику под этой вершиной. Бесподобные впечатления.

review_title: Amazing glacier landing tour was the highlight of our vacation
review_text:
We booked our tour online and made a few phone calls to the operator and they were very helpful in giving us information about not only the flight but the Talkeetna area.
THE FLIGHT AND LANDING WAS AMAZING. You have to do this - the view is incredible, the pilot was very nice and informative. We learned that only about 30% of the people who travel to Denali get to see the whole mountain because clouds usually cover the upper or lower part on any given day. We were part of the lucky 30%. This is not an inexpensive activity. But you should pay the money - you will not regret it.

Fantastic flight through the Alaska Range, through multiple high passes, along countless glaciers, close ups of key peaks including Denali, capped off by landing on a glacier. Lots of great pics. I'm not easily impressed - I've logged 8+ million miles in airplanes (including Himalaya flights), but Talkeetna Air Taxi ranks with the best. This was my wife's first flight in a small plane, and she had a grand time.  TAT does excellent job of orientation and safety briefing preparing passengers for everything.  The Turbine Otter was in top rig, and pilot preflights meticulous. I had opportunity to sit in jump seat and observe pilot throughout. Pilot is superbly skilled, great narrator, smooth as silk takeoffs and landings.  Underpinning a fantastic experience for passengers is a very apparent focus on safety.  Hope to fly with them again on next trip to Alaska.

The flights gave us a really  nice experience. The glacier landing was breathtaking and awesome.  The only negative was the the price of the trip. Its just too much as it was higher what I paid for my round trip per person from Long Beach, CA  to Anchorage.
We took the glacier landing flight and have to say it was the highlight of our trip!   Great pilot, very accommodating to get pictures, felt very safe.

Our early morning departure was canceled due to weather but we stayed near the airport in case there was an improvement. Lucky us - we got a call as we finished lunch went though a smooth checkin at the airport. I was impressed with the ability to take off and climb above the clouds on instruments to clear weather around Denali. The landing was outstanding. Return flight smooth in clear weather.

We were very lucky that the evening we booked our flight was cloudless with low wind.  Thus, the pilot was able to take us on one of the most memorable experiences of our lives, and the highlight of our 17-day vacation in Alaska.  The immense scale of Denali and the national park is almost impossible to fathom, but a flightseeing tour over and around the summit, with a glacier landing, gets you about as close as you can be to understanding the natural wonders of this inhospitable environment, without actually doing the complex preparations for a dangerous climb or glacier packing.  The Talkeetna pilot was friendly, approachable (as much as he could be while piloting a plane where everyone was strapped in and using supplied air), and knowledgeable of every awesome sight that we saw.   The administrative staff were also very friendly, and in every way we couldn't have asked for anything more from the experience.  Bravo to Talkeetna Air Taxi!

review_title: Best Part of Our Alaska Adventure!
review_text: We truly enjoyed this once in a lifetime experience! Buy the glacier lading- it is amazing! The pilot was wonderful- could not enough about Talkeetna Air Taxi!

I took a Denali flight-seeing tour with glacier landing on a clear morning and it was just perfect and definitely worth the price. The tour takes you in the heart of the mountains surrounding Denali.
Jonathan our pilot provided a lot of information during the tour.

review_title: View of Denali and Glacier Landing - Doesn't Get Much Better than That.
review_text: We did the Grand Denali Tour with Glacier Landing and it was one of the incredible experiences of a lifetime. Our pilot was able to get through the clouds and give us a view of the top of Mt. Denali, which was incredible. Then the only other thing that matched the amazing views of side glaciers off Ruth Glacier as we flew down, just above it, was the landing on the upper Ruth Glacier. It was so much fun to step out onto the glacier and walk around and see the surrounding mountains all unobstructed. Well worth the cost of the tour.

We did the Denali tour with the glacier landing, it's was spectacular. Our flight was scheduled early morning but it was cloudy so they offer us to postpone the flight. We took off once it was sunny and we were able to enjoy the view of the summit and land on the glacier. It's was pretty cool!

Our flight to see Mt. McKinley was wonderful and quite thrilling.  We enjoyed the close-up view of the mountain and landing on the glacier.   We highly recommend this tour to anyone looking for both an adventure and a spectacular view of the mountain.

review_title: Flight and glacier landing by Denali
review_text: Beautiful trip. Fantastic views. Super pilot, he was friendly and knowledgeable about the area. Worth every penny.
Highlight of our Alaska trip.  Wonderful views, recommend for all ages!  (I will be 80 in Dec).  Very nice folks too.

It was fantastic we had a beautiful clear day.  The pilot was amazing, I was some what freaked out flying in a small plane but he flew with grace!   Landing on the glacier was the most amazing experience I have had.

review_title: Denali Up Close and Personal on The Glacier
review_text:
Had a beautiful day for flying , so no need to call them to check the weather.  We (3 senior adults) drove down from Fairbanks for the day.  Flight check-in was quick, we departed and returned on time.

We didn't bring much with us on the plane, but be sure to take sunglasses, camera and appropriate clothing.  They provide light-weight, waterproof boots that fit our your boots or shoes.  Note that you will sink several inches into the glacier snow.  We brought one hiking pole for the unsteady member of our party.

Flight was pretty smooth but a lot of vertical climbing of the plane to fly around Denali and gain altitude to see things up close.  Everyone gets a window, but It's hard to tell what mountain or side of Denali you are looking at.

Highly recommend the glacier landing (on Ruth).  We had the best view of Denali after we landed and stayed quit a while.  There were two other planes on the glacier, but it is large and they were quite far rom us.

Beautiful and peaceful!

What a wonderful flight!  It is difficult to find the correct words to describe the beauty of all the snowcapped mountains that you'll see on this flight.  With everyone having a window seat, wonderful sights are available for everyone to behold.  The glacier landing and takeoff were the 'icing on the cake' experience.  A very professional and well done job by Talkeetna Air Taxi!
We couldn't have been more pleased with the friendly staff who managed to make this the highlight of our Alaska trip!! Thank you for the amazing memory!

My family and I booked this adventure the morning after arriving in Alaska.  We took a small plane around the mountains to include Mt. Denali and then landed on a glacier.  We were able to get out of the plane and walk around for some photos.  It was a nice clear day so we had the opportunity to see the peak of Mt. Denali.  Wear boots as the glacier is very snowy.  It was an amazing trip and highly recommend for everyone!

review_title: Denali Flight Tour and Glacier Landing
review_text:
As usual, Talkeetna Air Taxi not only kept in contact with any weather issues and time changes, but provided the very best tour. We purchased the 2 1/2 hour tour all the way around Denali with a glacier stop for our 27 year old and guest. It was the BEST Alaskan experience for our guest!
Thank you! You never disappoint and we will continue to promote this Adventure of a Lifetime for guests (and of course enjoy ourselves)! We've used Talkeena Air many times! Top choice, by far.

As a travel agent based in the USA, I have been binging clients to Alaska for many years, and I always recommend Talkeetna Air taxi to my clients who want to flightsee Denali. The staff is excellent, equipment top-notch and they go out of their way to make your trip a success. I will continue to recommend this excellent company to my clients in the future.

Flightseeing is expensive but gives an amazing perspective of the mountains and glaciers. The pilot was friendly, narrated the trip and assured that people seated on either side of the plane were able to get each view. I had never flown in a small plane and felt safe and comfortable. The glacier landing was worth the extra cost as it allowed us to experience the feel of the snow, and the sounds and scale of the place. Talkeetna Air Taxi was very good about allowing us to decide whether or not we wanted to fly because the tour we initially planned was not available due to weather conditions. We opted for a tour of the south side of the glaciers. Weather conditions changed and the pilot rewarded us with some bonus flying that took us to a brief view of Denali and a rainbow.

Talkeetna Air Taxi and tours are outstanding.  The tours and customer service were a wonderful assist to our Alaska Adventure.  The planes are well maintained and are in great condition, (I am a private pilot)  I felt very safe and comfortable in their planes.  The pilot/guide was very knowledgeable and gave an excellent overview of the Denali Experience.  I do highly reccommend them and will be using them for my clients! This is a soft adventure outing, but an outstanding way to really see Denali, take a camera and be prepared for some awesome scenery!
Regenesis Travel
this is a 10 of 10 rating!

Talkeetna Air Taxi is absolutely incredible!  Our pilot, Clay, was amazing, flying above the clouds to capture incredible views of Denali, flying through the gorge and landing smoothly on the glacier.  My two sons are pilots, and they were so impressed with the tour.  This is a must do excursion!

review_title: A Highlight of our Trip to Alaske
review_text: Thanks to Paul, for a wonderful flight!  My daughter and seven year old grandson loved it as much as I did!  In addition to seeing the majesty of Mt. Denali, up close, we learned a lot about the glaciers and the history of the area.  We were so impressed with Paul, and later found out he was the owner.  Lol. As a side note, he was very helpful in getting me in the plane.  I am older and recently had a total knee replacement so high steps are difficult.  He gently helped me maneuver my healing leg into the plane.  Such a nice guy!  We booked in Talkeetna and were taken over to the air strip by van.  Super service!  Well worth every cent!

I'm going to keep it short... If you made it to Alaska and you're in Talkeetna.... the flight tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi is, without a doubt, a must-do. And yes, do spend a bit more for the landing on the glacier. You will not regret it!

Money tip: Go to the main office at the airport to purchase your tour. There are signs all around town, at many businesses where you can also purchase the tour, but you will pay more that way, as the vendors will add their commission to the cost.

If you're lucky enough to have a clear day the way I did, you will have an experience of a lifetime.

review_title: Flight to Denali with Glacier Landing
review_text: We took a flight to Denali wit a glacier landing and it was the best excursion of our trip. Clay was our pilot and due to the clouds around the mountain he worked his flying magic to get us a view of the peak. The glacier landing was unbelievable and an experience you should have on your bucket list. Also viewing the glacier rivers were exquisite. TAT was an excellent company and I highly suggest them for your flight-seeing excursion. Definitely worth the money.

review_title: Talkeetna Air Taxi - Mountain voyager tour
review_text: Very nice tours. Saw a lot of beautiful stuff. Mountains are spectacular with snow caps and glaciers.

Absolutely stunning scenery! Our pilot, Andy, was very informative. This is a once-in-a-lifetime experience. Each passenger had a window seat, and the pilot was able to make turns to allow both sides of the airplane to see all the sights.

Awe inspiring views of the vast Alaska landscape.  The weather/visibility was not ideal but we still saw plenty.  The pilot and staff are top-notch professionals and very friendly.  We did the glacier landing and that was great. They shuttled us to downtown so we could have dinner and offered to pick us up and return us to our hotel if we missed the hotel shuttle.  A must-do excursion if you come to Alaska.

Prior to coming to Alaska, we were on the fence as to whether to spend the money on a Glacier flight. As a consequence, it wasn't until we were in Talkeetna, having a homestyle breakfast with other travelers, that we heard so many people raving about this experience, we decided to take a last minute trip. Luckily, there was just enough space on the plane for 2 more and less than an hour after breakfast, we were at the Talkeetna Air Taxi depot. This was one of the most incredible experiences we have ever had. It is nearly impossible to describe how it feels to see some of the beautiful vast wilderness, coupled with excellent descriptions from our tour guide/pilot. This is a must do!

Clay was our guide and did a fantastic job of maneuvering through the mountains to get the best views of Denali.  As we took off in the clouds that morning we didn't think we would see much but Clay took us to the north side of Denali where the sun happened to be shining and it was just exhilarating!  We landed on a glacier which was a highlight of our trip!

The flight around Mt. Denali with the Glacier landing was the highlight of or two week motorcycle tour of Alaska. They say that only 30% of the visitors end up seeing the mountain, I wonder how many see every nook and cranny. Even with many large white clouds we were able to get great views of the mountain. Don't skip the Glacier landing.

review_title: The best way to see the vastness of Alaska!
review_text: The flight was great, our pilot Kris was awesome - very knowledgeable and did a great job showing us the Alaska range. The views are just unbelievable! What an unforgettable trip, thanks for the wonderful experience!
We lucked out with great weather and the views were simply stunning. Talkeetna Air Taxi was efficient and did a great job checking us in and getting us ready for our flight. Highly recommend.

One day, I was sweltering in 112 degree temps in Phoenix. A week later, I'm standing on a glacier.  All thanks to the folks at TAT.  The weather had been cruddy the weeks preceding our arrival, and I was afraid our flight would be cancelled.  But the nice folks at TAT called and asked if we could come in early, as there was a break in the weather. We were just minutes away, so we happily came in early.  

Our pilot, Will, was amazing.  He flew myself, my husband, and our travel-buddy in a Cessna 150 to the most amazing sight I'd ever seen.  The flight was smooth, he answered all of our questions, and even took some amazing pictures of our happy little group.   

Is it pricey?  Yup.  But most people spend more on 3 months of cable than they'd pay for this experience.  So break up with cable if you have to, but take this trip!

review_title: Flight Seeing Trip Around Mt. Denali plus Gracier Landing
review_text: Excellent trip. Great views & a fun experience! Weather was outstanding! Also a great group of people including the pilot.
We have beautiful weather , blue sky very experienced pilot...what else to ask for😀It is not cheap trip BUT worth it every penny

We had a great experience with TAT!  The staff is SUPER organized and very friendly.  They got us there by shuttle and checked in and on the plane in no time. We had two adults, two teens and a toddler.   We got the plane to ourselves just by luck.  Michael was our pilot and we really enjoyed the tour.   He taught us so much about glaciers and the mountains and people that climb.   We all had a good time. The plane was very comfortable!   Had a great time in the air for our one hour tour.   Would highly recommend this company.

review_title: Terrible costumer service ruined first day of our trip..
review_text:
We dedicated one day of our 3 days trip to try flight seeing tour from Talkeetna Air Tax.
We were suppose to fly at 4:15 and, so we left Anchorage around 1 pm. Once we got there, they told us because of cloudy whether, they can't fly, and offered a much less interesting package instead of what we booked for the same price which we obviously declined. 
We are not experts in flight seeing, but could see the weather was cloudy since morning, they could at least call and warn us ahead of time before we drive for 2.5 hours...

review_title: One of the highlights of our Alaskan trip
review_text:
We really debated whether to do this or not - it's expensive.  But after having gone, I have to say it's well worth it.  You get views you just can't get any other way - including the summit of all three major mountains which most people never get to see from the ground because they're obscured by clouds.  Our pilot - Dave - found a hole in the clouds, popped up on top for an outstanding view.  And make sure you include the glacier landing in your trip.  The whole experience was awesome.  

While there are other air services in Talkeetna, we really liked Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Excellent service, loved the pilot (very experienced and flew the plane very well), great narration along the whole trip.  The planes were clean and looked to be well maintained.  We felt extremely safe the whole time.  

If you can possibly work this into your vacation - do it.  Well worth every dollar!

My husband and i were totally amazed by the beauty of the view from the plane. 
I highly recommend to everybody to choose a tour with a landing on the Mc Kinley mountain. 
The pilot explained a lot of things in mid flight and was very pleasant with us. 
The day was little bit cloudy but the landscape was still amazing and it was super sunny.

review_title: Poor air quality in the plane
review_text: Smell too much gasoline in the airplane while we flew. It was hard to breathe the air with my children. We asked the pilot open more valve or windows to get some more air,but it didnt work. We felt asleep and almost vomiting while we flew back.
My boyfriend, one of our close friends, and I went on a flight seeing tour and glacier landing, and it was spectacular!! I would highly recommend it!! :)

Richard was a friendly, professional, knowledgeable pilot.  One family member was scouting routes for a future Denali summit. Enjoyed the 360 views and glacier landing. Richard made sure passengers on both sides of the plane could see the landmarks. Expensive but memorable.

I have previously flown with Talkeetna Air Taxi when climbing Denali in 2010, and they did a great job supporting our expedition. This past summer (July 2016) my wife and I traveled to Alaska for a vacation. We flew with Talkeetna Air on the Grand Denali tour.  My wife commented that it was the "flight of her life".  Our pilot Andy did a fantastic job of highlighting various aspects of Denali and the surrounding peaks.  I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Steve Van Meter

We took the Grand Tour and it couldn't have been any more awe-inspiring.  Our group included an older man that had difficulties walking.  The staff saw that he was helped onto the plane and made comfortable before the rest of us boarded.  It was a beautiful day and although Denali refused to show itself, it was a glorious flight.  It was the highlight of our 2-week self-driven tour of Alaska!
Auf unsere Alaska Reise machten wir auch eine Rundflug zum McKinley  der atemberaubende Ausblick wird uns immer in Erinnerung bleiben. Hier sahen wir die Auswirkungen der Erderwärmung.

review_title: Denali Air Tour and glacier landing
review_text: This was definitely the highlight of my trip to Alaska.  We were very fortunate to have an incredibly beautiful clear day.  The glacial landing is a must!  It's hard to put the awesomeness of Denali into words!  It was well worth the money spent.

I highly recommend TAT.  Believe me, it's worth EVERY penny for a flight with a glacier landing.  We also were lucky enough to see the summit of Denali on our flight.  Leann was our pilot and she did a great job.  As a former commercial pilot myself I have to say the professionalism is top notch.  Feel safe knowing their standards are high and safety is valued tremendously.  

TAT has a quaint and clean facility and provides shoes to cover your shoes if you go to the glacier.  The aircraft was very clean and appeared to be well-maintained.  

If you are concerned about the cost, find a way to pay because you won't find a more interesting place to fly than this.
We took the Grand Tour and couldn' have had more furn. We auto toured the interior for 12 days and our air tour was by far the high lite of the trip.

review_title: What a great experience for me and my son!!
review_text: We can fish in Texas. We can even go white water rafting in Texas. But land on a glacier wearing shorts and glacier booties...well that's just freakin' AWESOME!!! Hey Boston...thank you and your staff for your outstanding service, safety and experience. My son and I had a blast! For those of you who just aren't sure...just go for it and enjoy playing in the snow on a glacier 5600ft up in the mountains.
We ordered the Denali summit flight plus glacier landing however due to weather condition we could not do either of them. So they returned full money to us!! We still had a great flight!

My husband, my 10 year old grand daughter , 15 year old granson and i booked this tour after reading all the positive reviews.  I wanted  my grandkids to enjoy this incredible adventure.  We had a fantastic trip flying over Alaska and landing on the glacier.  There were 10 on the plane and my grandson was especially thrilled to be riding next to our informative pilot.  We had ample time to enjoy the glacier and took tons of exciting photos.  I would definitely recommend this great tour!

5,4,3,2,1. Blast off! The experience was breathtaking. The kids loved it and so did we. We flew on an 11 passenger plane with an excellent pilot, Chris. The kids were nervous in the beginning, but were soon to find that there was nothing to worry about. The views were my favorite part. All of the mountains, trees, and lakes were fascinating. Who knew how many trees could fit in one small area? As we elevated, the sights got better and better. Make sure you bring your camera with you! Landing on the glacier was very special. Slippery, but fun! I could go on for hours explaining how beautiful this adventure was, but I'm sure you would enjoy it better to take a trip yourself. Sit back, relax, and enjoy your flight.

Gorgeous views. The pilot went within 1 mile of the mountains & we got amazing pictures. The pilot narrates as he flies & everyone has head phones. During the flight we were unable to land where they normally land due to weather, so we went back to the base camp area & landed there. We flew 12,500 feet high & landed 7,500 feet at base camp. The pilot really worked hard to make sure we had wonderful views & a good time. Try not to sit behind the wings because there is a partial obstruction. Senior citizens get a discount. At the end of the flight we all received a post card showing where we had flown & stickers. Nice touch.

user_location: Denali National Park and Preserve, Alaska
review_text:
This flight was amazing!  It was worth every penny.  It was a beautiful day and Denali was beautiful.  We landed on Ruth Glacier.  I loved it.  Our pilot was Andy, he was the greatest!
If possible I would like to buy a video of that trip.

What a truly fantastic flight and landing. We were very lucky with the weather and saw the mountain in nearly all of its glory. The scenery was incredible and though it is hard to explain why, the glacier landing was the most exciting, interesting and beautiful of the various ones that we have done around the world on our travels. The flight was very smooth indeed, though we were fully briefed as to when it might be a little rough. Whilst the scenery and the glacier were the real stars of the trip, we could not fault the organisation, the company, the equipment and the pilot, all performed admirably and enhanced the scenery. The trip was one of the highlights of our time in Alaska and you should never not do it as being just another scenic flight and landing. It is the best one that we have done anywhere. If we were to find any fault at all then it would just be a minor one that the sound system might just be a little clearer, though we could hear and follow the pilot's comments nearly all the flight. It certainly did not spoil the trip which significantly exceeded expectation.

I took the Mountain Voyager w/Glacier Landing trip with my family, it is one of the most exiting experiences I had in Alaska. We flew over the swamp, glacier, and flew between snow mountains, and we had glacier landing. We saw the view that I can never see anywhere else. Price is high, but worth it.

If you have any doubts about whether or not to go flying around Denali with Talkeetna Air Taxi, read this.
I had read the reviews and talked to friends about what to do in Alaska in preparation to our summer vacation and one of the things that kept coming up was whether or not an air tour would be part of our trip.  Without a doubt, this was the best single experience of my trip!
Our pilot's name was Jonathan and from the safety briefing, through the narration while flying, the landing on the glacier, and return to the airport, his skills and knowledge of the area were top notch. 
Was landing on a glacier worth it? Absolutely! Don't miss out on that experience.  We had clear views of the mountain and couldn't have been more excited to see the awesome scenery.  Flying between the peaks and ridges was incredible. 
There were 7 adults and one child on our flight and everyone was ecstatic the entire time. We logged almost 1700 miles in the RV and visited Anchorage, Denali NP, Fairbanks, Chena Hot Springs, Seward, Homer, Portage, and Whittier during our two week trip.
Take the time to make this part of your Alaskan experience. You won't regret it!

This was the highlight of our Alaska trip -- we lucked out and got a nice sunny day for our flight. The view of the mountains were gorgeous and the plane captain provided humorous and knowledgeable commentary throughout the trip. Definitely a must-do for anyone passing through the area.

WE did the Grand Denali Tour with Talkeetna Air taxi on Friday July 15.  It was one of the highlights of our trip.  Views of Denali were incredible.  The pilot was very polite and professional.  I highly recommend this experience - it is worth every dollar!!!!

review_title: Delayed flight, cramped seating on smallest plane
review_text:
Our flight got delayed by over 30 minutes because the pilot was not made aware that he had a scheduled flight.  All other flights took off on schedule.  The mountain was out early morning but the clouds were rolling in so any delay limited our ability to fully see the mountain.  We had planned to spend some time in town after our flight, which we couldn't because of the delay.

We flew the Cessna 185, which is the smallest aircraft in their fleet.  The middle row was tolerable but the back row was extremely tight with a vertical backrest.  Not only that, the pilot's dirty snow boots go with you on the seat.  This is their blue/white aircraft, unlike the red, white, and blue shown on their website.

The flight was smooth and flight seeing itself and glacier landing was amazing.
Shiloh did a great job showing us Denali.  The weather was good (except that the north side was obscured).  Thanks for a wonderful time.
This was definitely one of those once in a lifetime experiences.  The staff at the hangar was awesome, our pilot was awesome, the glacier landing was awesome.

We were booked for the following day but were worried the trip would be cancelled for weather so we hoped on a flight in the morning the day before.  Was a great experience and they were very professional

a great day, weather-wise. The flight was calm, the pilot gave great information as to what we were seeing. Hard to choose between taking photos and just looking. The 1 1/2 hour trip seemed too short. Can't say enough positive about this trip.

great pilot, sense of humor, knowledge of mountains, helpfull  great views of all but Denali
helpful office staff and phone response

review_title: On a clear day, you can see forever!
review_text:
We were blessed with good weather for our flight around Denali. We really appreciate the professionalism that Telkeetna Air extended to us for our flight. We had booked a "Grand" tour of Denali, but the weather was not favorable to see anything. The office staff was very easy to work with offering a lesser flight, a full refund, or they would get us out on the "Grand" tour the next day. Mother Nature was not about to give us a break, and we went through the same scenario the next night with us receiving a full refund. We were departing the next day, but when I went to bed at midnight, (the sun never sets in June, I had no idea it was that late)  I realized that the clouds had lifted, and after driving up to the lookout point to catch a glimpse of The Great One, Denali. I contacted Talkeetna Air first thing that morning, and they got us out on one of the most amazing flight tours we have ever experienced. We requested a late checkout, at the RV park we were staying at, and were able to make our destination that evening. 

On a clear day, you can see forever! We had a clear day, and Denali is something that you really need to be up close to really grasp the majestic magnitude of the mountain. The Great One is very appropriate. Landing on a glacier was really the icing on the cake, for the flight.

Thank you Talkeetna Air, you really helped make our trip to Alaska, the "Trip of A Lifetime".

The staff was very friendly, knowledgeable,  and professional. The plane was clean, and comfortable to be in. The pilot was very informative with stories about Denali, and kept you glued (okay, I did have my seatbelt on) to my seat with the shear beauty of the mountains surrounding Denali.

Our flight was great. The best part was our pilot Kris.  I know he loves his job because it shows loud and clear,  He was very knowledgeable about the area, he was so pleasant, and he made the flight so interesting,   The office staff was so special because our friends from Australia wanted to be on our flight and it worked out beautifully.  ALASKA WAS SIMLPY BEAUTIFUL,  IT TAKES PEOPLE LIKE YALL TO MAKE THE DIFFERENCE,    JANICE  AND GLENN TISDALE  MS

review_title: A Great Time Was Had By All
review_text:
We had a group of eight in our party.  Everyone had a wonderful experience.  Our pilot was terrific.  Everyone especially enjoyed playing in the snow on Mt. Denali in June.
We've flown with other companies to Mt Denali.  This was the best experience of them all!

review_title: Glacier Landing Flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi
review_text: A must do if you are in Alaska and it is worth the cost. The booking process was seamless, they do offer an AAA discount if you call vs. booking online.  Various flights are offered, however if you can do a glacier landing flight it is highly recommended.      The staff and pilot (Andy) were remarkable, definitely a class act and one of the best companies in Talkeetna to use.  We were first out on a clear day, the views were spectacular, the glacier landing unforgettable and the flight was one of the most memorable parts of our trip.

We had a wonderful trip. Our pilot was very helpful and very informative. The scenery was incredible and being able to walk on the glacier unforgettable.  Of course the clear weather day was awesome. We were able to see the peak of Denali from the glacier.

Probably the single greatest thing I have ever experienced in my life. Very knowledgeable and professional staff.  I highly recommend taking this trip and landing on the glacier(weather permitting of course) it is still a surreal experience for me and my family that we will never forget.

Talkeetna is a serious company !! They cancelled the flight when weather conditions were not good . The pilot is friendly and is focused to show the best spots around MacKinley peak . Unforgettable landing in the ice .

This was a bucket list item for me. We visited Alaska 10 years ago and didn't fly over Denali and I regretted it so when we decided to go back I knew this would be at the top of the list of things I wanted to see/do. We had a great experience with Talkeetna Air Taxi. Everyone was very friendly and our pilot really seemed to love what he was doing. He gave us info about the area and different peaks as we flew but didn't talk non-stop so you could just sit back ad enjoy the view. We landed on the glacier and I was amazed at how smooth the landing was! Definitely the high point (pun intended!) of our trip to Alaska. Don't hesitate to book with Talkeetna Air Taxi.
This trip was amazing! My husband and I loved seeing everything from a different perspective. I felt like we could touch the mountains. This trip is well worth it!
What a great experience! The ride was smooth, safe, and unique. Landing on a glacier is a thrill. An adventure beyond description!
Feel warmth and welcomed on arrival. Fantastic views of mountains and glaciers. The plane turns to show the views to passengers on both sides. Glacier landing is interesting.

review_title: Soar like an Eagle with Talkeetna Air Taxi
review_text:
We were recommended to fly with Talkeetna Air Taxi by the B&B Garden Gate at Palmer. We did not regret this choice. There are many flight operators flying from Talkeetna. Talkeetna Air Taxi (TAT) was excellent with their bookings and communications. They had a policy in regards to bad weather and no fly, luckily this did not apply to us. We were blessed by the weather gods and managed to do the Grand Denali flight path and see the absolute splendor of Mt Denali and the many other mountains and glaciers and everything else.
THIS IS A MUST DO EXPERIENCE AND ITS WORTH EVERY DOLLAR. Stretch that budget and do it!!.
The TAT facility at the airport is very picturesque and welcoming. The very busy staff are friendly and accommodating and efficient. They have a large waiting balcony for you to wait for your flight. They have different aircraft ours was a Dehavilland Beaver and there was 6 of us incl pilot. The planes, pilots and staff were very professional and relaxed and friendly. Our young pilot (Michael from California) was very knowledgeable and experienced and made sure we all saw the magnificent natural wonders of Mt Denali and the surrounds.
TAT and the weather has provided us with the most memorable tour of our 6 week holiday and I can only say to you Trippies and readers to experience this flight from Talkeetna with TAT.

Words can not express this incredible experience!
Pilot has soft flying hands!
Highlight of our visit....hard to beat this experience for world travelers!

The day was perfect.  The scenery was the sort of scenery that makes you reflect on life.  I took my friend who has advanced ALS.  TAT gave us a discount so that I could afford to take him.  Alaska was on his Bucket List and I really wanted to make it special.  TAT helped make that possible.  The crew and the staff were wonderful.  It was a great experience.  We cried.

We had a spectacular flight with our pilot, Chris.  We felt like we could of reached out and touched the granite walls of the mountains.  Had a great glacier landing and experience.  One of the real hi lights of our Alaska experience.

This was a super experience. We were up for a long time and even landed on a glacier near a base camp where climbers were preparing to climb. Everyone has a window seat and the pictures are fantastic.

Talkeetna Air Taxi is the best flightseeing tour around.  The pilot was excellent and the ride was wonderful.  The girls behind the counter were awesome and so friendly and the reservation  clerk was so helpful.  This was my second time flying with them and will not be my last!

this was the most amazing sightseeing trip and our guide/pilot  was so much fun! This is something my family and I will do again when we come back! We were able to see the top of Denali which I'm told only about 30% of the people do! So worth the money and time!

We had an outstanding trip.  We weren't sure if the glacier landing was going to be worth it but it was definitely one of the highlights of our trip.  The pilot was extremely helpful and informative as well as professional.  I would highly recommend this trip.

Three brothers and wives flew south Denali. It was a magnificent view! Our pilot shared this was the best weather in a month! The young pilot's expertise started with the safety talk and just never let up!
He was terrific as a geology narrator and a historian. He was polite and answered  our many questions.
We got such great photos. It was a wonderful highlight of a great ten day vacation in Alaska.
Perfect weather gave us a perfect experience.  Smooth flight, good commentary by pilot, a little extra time on glacier gave us a great time.  Hope to do this again soon.

Kudos to Talkeetna Air Taxi for providing us with a beautiful day to fly! It was an incredible flight around Denali with outstanding views, superseded only by landing on the glacier at base camp. I don't know why, but the "kid" in all of us came out as we stepped foot onto the glacier. Once one pressed one's foot into the glacial snow and gazed upon the surrounding peaks an immediate joy sprung forth in the form of smiles and laughter -- a wonderful experience in an extraordinary environment. Thanks for the wonderful experience!
Unbelievable experience. Landing on a glacier on Denali is amazing. Small groups and everyone gets a window seat. The flight through the mountains was magical the snow looks like whip cream.

Had an absolutely awesome flight, with wonderful weather! Very professional company, organized check-in, and friendly pilot. Landing on the glacier was a wonderful experience....you can't put a price on an experience like this. But if you want a discount, purchase a Northern Lights book (online) and get 25% off of a party of 4.

but bad booking help.
I had call to do a present to some friends, left a deposit and my credit card to pay for the flight. The person who left all the information was very nice, but the other person who dealt with my friends, did not. She accepted the credit card of my friend who finally paid the all trip for 4 people.
We were lucky and it was a beautiful sunny day. Adding glacier landing was totally worth it. Absolutely gorgeous views.

I had originally reserved a Grand Denali tour with a glacier landing; however, it looked like the weather wasn't going to cooperate with my plan.  Talkeetna Air Taxi staff did what they could to make some type of flight happen safely, so my party and I were finally able to make a Southside tour of Denali.  While in the air, the weather broke and quite at the last minute were able to make a glacier landing.  TAT did everything they possibly could to provide the best possible experience and to have a satisfied customer.  I highly recommend them.

It was such a great experience to have the flight seeing with Talkeetna Air Taxi. The pilot is nice, experienced and full of knowledge. I can feel the passion on him. Would definately recommend any people to have the flight seeing tour in Talkeetna!

review_title: Talkeetna Air Taxi Trip to Denali
review_text: We had a fabulous time.  The flight was wonderful and the views fabulous.  So much fun to land on a glacier - felt like we were the only people in the world.  Gorgeous day - one we  won't forget.

To be honest, we found that there was nothing better in Alaska than this flight trip. It took us around Denali Mountain and landed on a Glacier. Views were spectacular. I highly recommend it for anyone visiting Alaska. You might find that this is probably the only good thing in the entire Alaska trip. Atleast we felt that way.

Word of caution: Never assume that you will be able to go on the day you have booked the flight. We waited for 3 days and the third day was sunny with clear sky. They would not fly if it is too cloudy etc. So make sure that you have enough buffer in your trip to shift the flying schedule by 3 to 4 days. Chances of being able to go on this flight are poor (30% probability of being able to go).

Talkeetna Air Taxi was great! We had a wonderful pilot who was very knowledgeable about the area- geographically and historically. His tour and glacier landing went smoothly and he made sure we saw all of the features of the mountain. We were lucky to have a clear day! The trip was well worth the money. Every aspect was great- from the initial contact on the computer, to registering the day we went, to the flight!

review_title: Amazing flight, great views, cool glacier landing
review_text: This was the highlight of our Alaska vacation! Great flight to the amazing Mount Denali, clouds in the morning and then the sky opened up with picturesque clouds and blue sky and an exciting and cool glacier landing... We were awed and amazed by the majestic mountain and its glaciers! We will never forget and will always be grateful for the experience! A must do!!!

From making the reservation, through the pick-up, and the smooth organization at the airport and into the plane, this was just an easy and pleasant trip.  But the plane, the pilot, the views, the explanations of what we were seeing, and then landing and walking on the glacier, was well beyond what anyone might expect..  Kudos to everyone at Talkeetna Air Taxi!
Talkeetna Air Taxi provided a very professional and enjoyable experience, one that I will never forget. It was well worth the cost.

My brother and his granddaughter (age 73- 20) told me that this was the highlight of their Alaskan visit..  Keyana had never flown in a small aircraft, so that in itself was exciting. They appreciated the pilots information as they tripped around Denali and landed on Ruth Glacier.

From the front reception area to preparing for take off to our amazing pilot from the Arctic, this tour was astonishing. We were blessed with a beautiful sunny day with big white puffy clouds as we were escorted around "The Big One" and the surrounding ranges. Our pilot was so informative and skillful as he gently landed us on one of the many glaciers (couldn't even tell if we were down?). Definitely a trip of a lifetime! I'd recommend this to anyone. #33daystoalaska

The flightsee trip to Denali was fantastic!  The glacier landing was something we will never ever forget.  Talkeetna Air Taxi made sure everyone enjoyed the trip and we would definitely book another trip with them.  Well worth the money

We booked an early morning flight with a glacier landing a few weeks before the trip. Watching the weather conditions and forecast, we weren't sure if the weather would hold or not, but it did, and the flight was just splendid! I was able to sit in the co-pilot seat, which made for great photography. Kris was an excellent pilot who told us about various sights as we passed by. He was friendly and eager to take photos of us once on the glacier.

I think the glacier we landed on (Pika) was not the one originally scheduled for our flight, but we needed to pick up a climber who was scheduled to go out. The landing and take-off was smooth as silk.

Although this experience seems pricey, we thought it was well worth the money, and can't recommend it highly enough!

... that my mother and I would take a plane ride over an amazing mountain range and land on a glacier in Alaska!  The staff was so friendly and helpful and the ride itself was amazing.  I kind of gulped at the price at first, but it was so worth it. You can't put a dollar value on this once in a lifetime experience!
TAT was excellent! Very professional, we landed on the glacier and took photos. It was definitely one of the highlights of our trip!

This was our second flight with glacier landing.  We did the same tour in 2013 and had just as much fun and our pilot was just as safe and professional.  TAT obviously has a consistent level of quality and safety.  Highly recommended!

The staff and pilot are very friendly. We were worried about the small plane but the pilot did a great job in making us feel safe. The pilot did an excellent commentary about the mountains and glaciers. The glacier landing was the highlight of the trip and is once in lifetime experience. Taking off and landing was so smooth much better than larger commercial aircraft.
One of the coolest things I've ever done in my life! We rode in a small single engine Cessna 4 seater, which added to the fun factor!
The flight  and landing on the glacier were the highlight of my trip to Alaska from New Hampshire. The pilot was great, the office ladies were great.

review_title: Best views my entire trip to Alaska
review_text: Highly recommend this flightseeing tour. Definitely worth the money. Our pilot Michael was extremely knowledgable and friendly and we got the best photos of the whole trip to AK. Overall very cool and unique experience.

Chris, our pilot was the best. Friendly, and experienced. He was very good with the kids on our flight. 
The tour was everything the brochure described. Make sure to pick the glacier landing option. Landing on glacier is a once in a lifetime experience. The scenery from where we landed was spectacular. On a clear day, the majestic Mt Denali can be seen.
IMO, this flight tour is the best way to see the beauty of Mt. Denali. 
Also, I picked Talkertna air over its competitor because of their promptness and professionalism in replying to my questions. I have no regrets picking them at all.
Great experience overall!!

I was very lucky on this trip!  The mountain was clear and I was matched up with a family who were really having a great time.  We landed on a glacier and that was amazing!  I was able to really see and have a better understanding of the area.  The staff  and pilot were great, very friendly and easy to work with.  I would encourage you to go on a flight.

This was most definitely the highlight of our Alaska Adventure!  Our pilot Andy's knowledge of Denali and the surrounding area was incredible.  The tour was not only exhilarating but also educational.  Landing on the glacier was exciting and so much fun.  Being able to actually walk on the glacier and experience the beauty and majesty of Denali was beyond anything we have ever experienced.  Thanks so much Andy and Talkeetna Air Taxi for the great tour!

On the day my sister and I were initially supposed to do our flightseeing tour, the weather was awful and the flight was cancelled. Luckily, we had a free day later in the week, so we rescheduled and prayed for clear skies. It ended up being beautiful! The weather was perfect and the views were extraordinary. We took a lot of pictures and have received many compliments. This was the most costly part of our vacation, but I would advise everyone to do it. Just be sure to pick a day with clear skies!

Our group did both the bear viewing and salmon fishing trip and also the heli-hiking. The pilots, equipment, and guides were all first class. Would highly recommend. The highlight of our Alaska vacation.
We had a wonderful flight around Denali coupled with a landing on Ruth Glacier.  Our pilot, Rusty?, was informative, professional, and a great guide.  One of the high lights of our Alaskan trip!
Out pilot was awesome! Saw Denali perfectly when the odds were not in our favor. Our pilot was great and finding an opening to view! The glacier landing was spectacular!!

review_title: Fly to Denali Mountain and landed at Base Camp on glacier.
review_text: Great flight by the owner of the company and very nice to land at Base Camp for climbing Denali. Very well organized and structured and nice aircraft.
Spectacular view, smooth ride. Pilot is very friendly.  A must see if you visit Alaska. We will do it agin if we have a chance to visti Alaska again.
Had a clear day to enjoy the great views of Denali including a glacier landing.  Very memorable plus great people at Talkeetna Air!

review_title: Amazing Views, Once in a lifetime experience
review_text: Friendly and very helpful staff. The pilot was also very friendly and explained in detail of what we were seeing during flight. The views are amazing. We took the Grand Denali tour and highly recommend it along with glacier landing.
This tour was amazing and I highly recommend it. The landing is well worth the extra time and money, and was the main reason we did this flight.
The views are breathtaking! Once in a lifetime experience and a must do if in the area! Best way to see Denali! Our pilot was so friendly and was such a great guide as well! Thank you!

We had our original trip booked on the day we were driving from Anchorage to Denali - unfortunately the weather prevented us from flying that day but luckily we were able to reschedule for a few days later without any problems at all. Annie was wonderful to work with over the phone and our pilot was great, too. The experience was once in a lifetime and I would do it again in a heartbeat if I had the chance. Stunning views, and the glacier landing was incomparable - SO BEAUTIFUL!
One of the best day trips we did in Alaska.  Worth the $$.  The views where phenomenal and we loved the glacier landing.
Highlight of the trip!! Wonder weather, great pilot and surreal location. It is expensive and you will surely be able to justify over time :)

We were supposed to fly with them on Monday but because of not so good weather we had to reschedule to fly on Wednesday on our way back from Denali. They were more than accommodating with the rescheduling and gave us all the information we need to make a good decision on whether to reschedule or not. Our pilot was great and the flight was extremely smooth. They give waterproof covers to put over the shoes such that you can really enjoy the glacier landing. We got extremely lucky with the perfect view of Mt Mckinley. The day was so clear, we could actually see the tiny hikers trying to summit Denali. Would highly recommend doing this activity and with Talkeetna Air Taxi! If you are a big group, make sure to check with them about discounts.

review_title: Denali Grand Tour with glacier landing
review_text:
Had many second thoughts about spending this amount of money.   Was worth every cent.   Highlight of our Alaskan vacation.  Definitely go for the glacier landing.  My family fly frequently in a private aircraft and were amazed with safety protocols, condition of the aircraft, and the smooth flight including takeoff/landing.  Suitable for all ages.

Pilot was not overly friendly, but showed respect for safety over conversation.

Like a lot of other people have said this was Top Class, have done a lot of things around the world but this was as they say in the states "Awesome", one off, standing on that glacier in the sunshine with a photo to prove it, priceless, its a must do!!

Keith & Gina from Exmouth,  UK 2016
The plane ride was great. Pilot gave a nice introduction of what we were seeing. The landing area is sorta like a ski field. The price is a bit high so that's primarily why I'm giving it 4 stars.

Our family flew Talkeetna Air Taxi around Denali during our recent trip to Alaska. We choose the flight with a glacier landing and one that went all around the mountain. So glad we did that! The view of Denali and the Wickersham Wall is something I will never forget! Mind blowing!
Amazing experience, probably the highlight of my Alaska trip. Our pilot made sure we had an experience of a lifetime. Will definitely recommend to do the glacier landing .

The  absolute highlight of this year's trip to Alaska was our flight among the mountains of Denali and the glacier landing. Clouds over "the great one" prevented a clear view of Denali the day of our flight.  This disappointment was offset by the incredible beauty of the surrounding mountains and glaciers. ( You should know that clouds obscure part or all of Denali more than half the time. So plan accordingly. ). The glacier landing was a thrill of a lifetime. Walking about on a thousands feet deep sheet of snow and ice was mind bending and the views were spectacular.  I used up the batteries on two cameras before we landed back at Talkeetna. 

I have never felt safer on a plane of any size ( 7 seats in this case ) than I did on this flight, despite flying through narrow passes with towering granite peaks on each side. Our pilot was friendly, professional, experienced and highly skilled. He narrated the entire flight with interesting information and described the technical aspects of the flight ( flying through passes, glacier landing, etc ) in a way that was both fascinating and reassuring. Despite the planes small size, the flight was smoother and more stable than most commercial airline flights. It was as solid as sitting on your living room sofa. 

The staff at Talkeetna Air were extremely courteous and helpful. From the reservation process to pre-flight orientation to post flight, they could not have been nicer. I would definitely do this again and I would highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi.

We booked this trip at the last minute and are so glad that we did. Although it is expensive, it was so worth the cost. Due to rain, our trip was originally cancelled, however, we were lucky enough to be able to reschedule a few days later. The weather was much better and we were able to land on the glacier. Our pilot did everything he could to make sure we had a view of Denali above and below the clouds that were out. We landed at the Base Camp of Denali and it was amazing. He took pictures for us and answered questions about the different mountains and their names. We truly enjoyed this experience - what a bucket list item!!

The pilots and office staff are friendly and very helpful. Excellent flights!
The office is in a gorgeous location, and even offers loaner sunglasses for guests to protect their vision on the ice.

review_title: Don't go if it's cloudy. Read other 'poor/average' for similar comments.
review_text:
This activity was a huge let down after reading the glowing reviews on here and numerous travel books stating this as a 'must-do' activity.  Then again not all must-do activities I've experienced were all great either.  

Weather plays a HUGE role in the type of experience you will get.  Not only does it dictate what you see, but also your mood as well (we all love that blue sky).  We had originally booked the Grand Denali tour but due to the cloudy weather it was cancelled and was rescheduled for the Mountain Voyager tour (that should have been my cue to bail with this activity! 

You do get some great views from the plane but it does fly quite high and the window is not super big.  We did see Mount Denali and some other mountains but only partial views due to clouds, which I understand is typical for high mountains.  But it was cloudy all over and the light level wasn't the best for taking photos.  We also landed on a glacier but there were several other planes and people all around taking photos.  It was hard to enjoy the surroundings with people talking and asking you to take their photo.  Because of the cloud cover on the glacier we had limited views of our surroundings as well.

I would NOT recommend this activity if it's cloudy.  Think about the amount of money you pay.  I do recommend going on a helicopter tour instead.  I did that in Valdez and WOW that was so much better.  You have much better views and you fly very close to the mountains and glaciers.  We also did a glacier landing and had glacier water.  In my opinion going via helicopter was a much better experience than going on an airplane. And besides we've all been on planes but being in a helicopter was an amazing experience.

Save your money and do a helicopter landing instead!

review_title: Great Flight, Glacier Landing and Denali
review_text: We made our reservations with a person in Talkeetna.  .They picked us up at our campground.   Now remember folks this is a small town with a small airport.  The people in charge were very efficient.  Even gave us booties for our shoes.  Oh, did I forget to mention....we were doing a glacier landing!!!   At the base camp where the climbers get ready to climb Denali, it was approx. 7,200 feet. and  we had 10 passengers. It was a bit cloudy, but our pilot endeavored to get us up to see Denali which is 20,310 feet.  Then landed on a Glacier.  It was wonderful..GO, GO. if you visit Alaska.

What an incredible day 
The Grand Tour by TAT was over the top beautiful stunning bucket list worthy
The people that work here are all awesome
Annie- what can I say but you are so terrific
Our pilot was great and took as to all sides of Denali
Landed us beautifully near their in Little Switzerland on a glacier
Gorgeous day fabulous 2 hour flight
Highly recommend this excellent company

Had a great experience with the Talkeetna Air Taxi.  We were originally scheduled for Friday and the weather wasn't looking to great.  Showed up and asked if it would be possible to change the date.  The front staff were more than willing to allow us to change the date at make it at the end of our trip when the weather appeared to be clearing up.  During our stay we were never able to see Mt. Denali due to clouds and rain UNTIl we took flight with Andy.  This was a huge highlight to our trip!! I have two teenage boys (15,17) and my husband and I (45,43).  Expensive yes, but worth the experience.  We also paid for the glacier landing which is another must do.  The clouds were still around Denali but Andy flew us to a spot that he had heard they were able to catch a glimpse. We then landed on the glacier and spent 15" taking it all in.  If you are quiet you can actually here the water flowing from the glacier. Andy explains things into your headset all the way there and back of all the things you are seeing.  I would definitely recommend this experience.

review_title: Unforgettable Flight Tour of “The Great One!”
review_text:
My husband and I recently took a Grand Denali with Glacier Landing flight tour with Talkeetna Air. You must add this flight tour to the top of your bucket list. It was without a doubt, the most incredible flight tour we have ever taken! Our pilot Richard provided us with a wonderfully smooth flight, gave excellent narrative and pointed out areas of interest and landed us right on Ruth Glacier.  What an adrenaline rush!  

This was the priciest tour we booked for our Alaska vacation, and it was worth every cent and then some.  Some experiences are just so incredible, they leave a lifetime impression.  This was one of those experiences.  A flight tour of Denali gives you a taste of the sheer enormity of the mountain and the surrounding peaks.  Majestic, staggering, astonishing, stunning, breathtaking…I think you get the idea!  Words fall short in trying to describe the magnificent scenery.  Denali is the highest mountain peak in North America, and we flew by the Wickersham Wall, which is the highest vertical drop in the world, even higher than Everest.  No wonder Denali translates as “The Great One!”

Take our advice, if you do a Denali flight tour, spend the extra money and do a glacial landing.  It will blow you away!  It gives you an idea of what the mountain climbers see and feel.  We were 5500 feet up and it was a gorgeous sunny day.  It didn’t even feel very cold. They give you boots to place over your shoes, and some layered fleece works just fine. Just imagine throwing Denali snowballs at each other! We were very fortunate to have unusually clear weather.  This is a flight tour that sometimes gets cancelled due to weather, so try and book it early in your trip to leave room to reschedule.  That’s why you only put down a small deposit, with the majority due on the flight day.  And if you’ve heard of the “30% Club,” which is the percentage of Alaska travelers who actually see Denali, taking a flight tour increases your chances you’ll see it.

We chose to fly out of Talkeetna because it is the closest distance to the mountain. The majority of your flight is spent viewing Denali, rather than flying to it. That’s why a flight out of Denali National Park or Anchorage costs more than from Talkeetna, since more of the flight time is spent just getting there.  You also will not find a helicopter glacial landing tour for Denali, only flight planes.  The only reason there aren’t helicopter landings on Denali is because the tour companies that are currently operating these flights were grandfathered in when Denali was made a National Park, and were only doing plane landings.  That’s also why there are a limited number of companies that have permits to do a Denali glacier landing. Some claim to have a Denali helicopter landing, but look closely and you will see it lands elsewhere, not on Denali.  If you’re going to spend that kind of money, make sure you see the real McCoy!

We chose Talkeetna Air for its superb safety record and quality pilots.  Richard, our pilot was a wealth of interesting facts and stories. As he tells it, doing these flight tours never get old.  He enjoys every minute and it shows in his enthusiasm!  Booking with Talkeetna Air was a breeze, and they even offered a senior discount.  Everyone was very friendly, efficient and helpful.  Their pricing is competitive, and their service is outstanding.

If you are going to tour Alaska, a flight tour of Denali with a glacier landing should be placed at the top of your excursion list.  Book with the folks who do it best, Talkeetna Air, and marvel at the experience of a lifetime!

We did the Denali tour and glacier landing, which was worth the price. An amazing experience to land on a glacier and we were lucky to see the top of Denali. Smooth flight and our pilot communicated well about what to expect. The views were incredible. Office staff was friendly and helpful when we had to reschedule due to weather. I highly recommend this experience.
Incredible plane flight out with these guys can't remember the Pilot's name but very knowledgeable... what an experience! Very highly recommended.

Did the Denali tour with glacier landing.  Can see why they grt such consistently.good ratings......well deserved.  Everything from booking to cbeck in to the tour are 1st rate.   Pilot was great at communiating what to expect and narrating the tour and providing history.  Only disappointment was weather did not cooperate and did not see Denali.   But even still it was a great experience and definitely spring for the glacier landing.

What an incredible experience! We took the south side tour which is about 2 hours. The views are breath taking! The landing on Ruth glacier was an amazing experience as well, highly recommend! Our pilot was very knowledgable about the Alaskan range and he is a very experienced pilot so the flight was extremely smooth. This is a must do in talkeetna!

review_title: Walking on a Glacier at 7300 feet!  Breathtaking!
review_text: This flight was top-notch!  The service was great; the airplane was comfortable, well maintained, and large windows gave spectacular views; the pilot was pleasant, obliging, very experienced, and gave a wonderful flight up and around Denai.  We landed on the glacier at 7300 feet and were able to get out and walk on the glacier with the peak of Denai towering above us. This is how one really gets to experience the grandeur of Denai!

My 8 year old son and I did a fly over of Denali with Talkeetna Air and it was truly a once in a lifetime experience. We were incredibly lucky to get an completely clear day and the views were spectacular. My son was a bit nervous flying on such a small plane (ours was a 4 seater and it was just us to and our pilot Leann), however Leann was wonderful with him in telling him what she was doing. On the way back, he was completely relaxed. Highly professional group - we felt safe the whole time. What an experience - I can't recommend it enough if you can afford the cost.

review_title: Good Golly...over one thousand reviews...How Often ???
review_text:
So, with only three folks complaining I'm hoping that you're adventurous enough to recognize this group is the real deal.  Operating since 1947, you have to like that.  Pilots that come out of Commercial aviation, solid, expensive fleet of planes, all that and Great T Shirts...
Seriously, my wife and I enjoyed the entire month of June up in Alaska.  We started with an eleven day small boat cruise out of Sitka, segued up to Homer where we had gorgous weather, made out way further north to Denali where we stayed at the end of the road there in the Park at a Camp, the only way to enjoy that wonderful place.  From there we went to Talkeetna, if just to enjoy this Summit Flight.  Honestly, while all those other things were really superb, the flihgt was the highlight of my trip.  While it was raining on takeoff by the time Dave got the DeHavilland over to Denali the sky was a bright blue with only wispy clouds in the air.  We flew around trying to get a handle on just how large that mountain is, no way, we would have long run out of fuel before I would be able to comprehend that.  One time it seemed like we were going to scrape the wing only to find out we were several miles off from the face.  Honest.
We then did a glacier landing, which was really fun, it allowed us to further examine the magnitude of this place.
The pilot was a serious professional with a gifted sense of conversation, the whole enchillada was spot on.
Thanks so much, it was really quite a good time.
Cheers, Salida1048
Hey, don't worry about costs, this is something you really need to do.

Yeah a glacier landing at 400 bucks is an expensive way to spend two hours.
But the experience was beyond description and our pilot was highly skilled.  Ask for the military discount.  Make sure to bring your National Park pass to save a few dollars as well.
Wonderful plane ride and excellent views of the mountains and the glaciers.  Would recommend that everyone see this view.  Amazing how the glaciers look like super highways.

review_title: The highlight of our Alaska trip!
review_text: From the reservation and front desk crew, to our pilot Richard, this was a great experience.  They were very up front about our first two weather delays and our third try the following morning proved that their experience and our patience paid off.  Richard provided a great flight with up in your face views of the summit and a awesome landing on the glacier. Huge kudos to Talkeenta Air Taxi for a great Alaskan experience!!!

We did the Mountain Voyager with Glacier Landing on July 13.   Couldn't have picked a better day.   The whole experience was amazing and indescribable.   All the staff was great.  Our pilot Kris was very informative and gave detailed descriptions and facts about what we were seeing.  The flight had barely noticeable turbulence.   It's a must do if in the area

This was an amazing experience.  We flew in an Otter that seats about 10 people.  We went around Denali and the pilot pointed out various landmarks.  He was helpful and insightful and obviously loved his job.  We even landed on a glacier... it was incredible.  This was a once in a lifetime experience.

I was a little leery about riding in a small plane, but this was so awesome that after a few minutes I forgot all about being concerned.  This was one of the most memorable experiences I have ever had.  It felt like being on a different planet.  Highly recommended.

We went on a flight with them on 2nd July. We wanted to do the summit tour but were unable to as the minimum was 6 and we were just two. So we agreed on Grand denali trip. As it was very cloudy they were not sure if we would be able to land on a glacier but our pilot ( Paul - turns out he was the owner of the company) did his very best to make sure we landed on the glacier safely! He waited for an opening in the clouds and landed at the right moment so that we could get our best experience! This company is the best to fly with for the once in a life time experince!

review_title: Amazing,  once in a lifetime experience!!  Must do !
review_text: We visited Talkeetna just before the July 4th weekend and selected the Grand Denali tour plus Glacial landing with Talkeetna Air Taxi. Luckily, the weather was good and we were treated to awe-inspiring views of mt Denali from every direction. The Wickersham wall was absolutely stunning. All along the tour we were treated to breathtaking views of rivers, mountains and forests. Our pilot (Chris) was very knowledgeable and friendly. The flight was very smooth. The Glacial landing is an absolute must!! I would highly recommend spending the extra $$ for the glacial landing experience.  You will have more time digesting the incredible views and appreciate the enormity of the towering peaks. I would also recommend flying with Talkeetna Air Taxi.
