The staff are very friendly and go beyond their duty to ensure passengers have a wonderful experience. Special shout out to Jen and the team of mechanics who helped me retrieve my car keys. I had accidentally locked them in the car while parking and it looked as though our entire day would be ruined (low signal, rental car company wouldn't answer). However the staff came to our rescue and provided timely help thereby ensuring our experience was untarnished. I would highly recommend flying with Talkeetna Air Taxi for their hospitality and top notch service.

review_title: Well maintained aircraft, superior pilots, fairly priced
review_text: Talkeena Air picked us up and returned us to our Cabins. They supplied our family of 19 with two 10 seater aircraft. Each of us had a window seat with clear visability. The pilot was an excellent tour guide. We were provided with good quality headphones and everything he said was clear. We were also provided with sunglasses if ours were not strong enough and special booties which allowed us to hike a bit on the Ruth glacier were we landed.  We saw both the south and north side of Mt. Denali as well as the climbers and their basecamp. Quite an exciting adventure! Awesome trip, awesome airline.

review_title: AMAZING!!! A new way to experience the mountains
review_text:
Wow what can I say. Words do not describe how awesome this fight was. My wife and I went on the southside tour and added the glacier landing. It was simply amazing. Our pilot Andy was excellent! For those who might be a bit scared of small planes, don't be. The pilots here are absolute professionals and will make your experience excellent! This is a must do item for those wanting to not only see but experience the mountains! I highly recommend this company and tour!!

For transportation to the site they have a shuttle that will pick you up. Just call ahead and let them know where to get you.

review_title: Must do!! A highlight to our trip!
review_text: We experienced one of the most beautiful and amazing events flying over the denali peaks. Our pilot, whom I apologize for not remembering his name, was terrific. It was such a smooth and crazy unbelievable trip. He was so interesting with his facts and stories.  The glacier landing was incredible. I could have stayed and felt like I was in heaven all day! Threw a few snowballs and heard our echos in the mountain.  We will never forget this magnificent day.  Sooo worth it!!!

review_title: Denali Grand Tour with glacier landing
review_text: Fantastic - well worth the price!!Once in a lifetime experience and our pilot Jonathan was so informative...  Thank you 👍🏻

There is only one road in/out of Denali...on a bus..a school bus type bus.  The round trip ride was going to be 13+ hrs and I figured I would see all the same stuff twice..going and coming.  Talkeetna Air Taxi was a great alternative.  Wake up late, grab breakfast at McKinley Creek Lodge and jump on the plane around noon.  Unreal sites of the North side flying in.  Pilot lived in the area his whole life and provided great overview.  They have a cute lodge in Talkeetna and we ate lunch there with the pilots before jumping on the Park bus for the ride out.  Long ride out, but we saw a lot of wildlife.  Great trip for family.  Seeing Denali up close from the air is unreal.

We were unable to fly with TAT on our scheduled day due to poor weather conditions. They were very accommodating to allow us to re-schedule and also very informative every time we called to get updates on the weather / flights. We finally managed to fly on our 3rd attempt..just 7 hours before our flight out from Alaska!! 

The staff was very kind and helped calm our 3 year olds down before the flight (cookies can fix every problem!). The pilot was very well informed and flew and landed very smoothly. We did the South Side explorer Tour with the glacier landing. The views were spectacular and the pilot went out of his way to go through the clouds to give us a view of the Mt. McKinley peak. We loved our time out on the glacier..with great views and beautiful weather. In fact it was warm enough for me to be out in my T-Shirt!!

Having spent 8 days before this in Alaska, we were in half a mind to cancel this tour thinking that we'd seen it all. Am I glad we did not!! I would definitely recommend this to everyone if your schedule and budget allows. The glacier landing is well worth the extra $$.

I called the company directly and booked a flight for the same day. I had not done it in advance because the weather in the area can be very fickle.
Everyone I talked to or had any interaction with at Talkeetna Air Taxi was very courteous and accommodating, very willing to answer all my questions.
They even had someone pick me up from the Princess shuttle drop-off bus lot in Talkeetna, and return me there after my flight, even though I was the only person who needed that service. Their office and airstrip are a nice little hike outside town.
Once at their office, it was a very simple, efficient process of getting checked in and getting “glacier boots”, even though I had not booked a flight that included a glacier landing. 
Our pilot, Tom Falley, a consummate pro with a sense of humor, explained all the safety procedures we needed to know prior to boarding, and before gently helping us climb in.
Once aloft, is was one continuous experience of jaw dropping, spectacular scenery, from the braided rivers, plains, and foothills to the drama of glaciers, and rocky spires that reached to the sky, sometimes disappearing in clouds, and the occasional soft streak of sunshine on an alpine snow field, or a serene glacial lake.
Throughout the flight, pilot Falley enriched his passengers with pertinent facts and anecdotes about what lay below us, and sometimes remained silent, allowing us to appreciate it all in our own souls.
It did not surprise me to learn later from the company website that our pilot, Tom Falley, in addition to his impressive set of piloting skills and experience, has a Masters in geology. I certainly learned a lot from him on my flight. Who knew that algae grow on glaciers, and their effect on those glaciers and on global climate changes? Thanks, Tom.
Thanks also for your obvious commitment to safety. I think we might have gotten some extra flight time as pilot Falley tried every safe way he could to get us to a higher elevation to see more, but ultimately, the clouds and safety won out.
I would strongly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi to anyone looking for a superlative experience.

A crystal clear day so we could see all of Mt. McKinley (Denali)!  Great views!
We landed about 7,000 feet up on a glacier and were able to walk around for a while.  
A fun trip all around.

review_title: Best Flight seeing Tour of Denali!
review_text: If you want to see the majestic mountains of Alaska, have an excellent pilot and meet friendly people then go to Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Everyone was friendly and the service was excellent!  Thank you to our pilot, Jonathan, for the smooth ride and knowledge.  Thank you to all the friendly people at the reception desk!
Super awesome early morning trip to Denali in a Cessna 185.  Leanne, our pilot was outstanding.  Saw everything and more. Highly recommend taking this trip.

A must do flight-seeing tour. The pilot was outstanding getting multiple views of Denali through the clouds turning often so each side of the plane could see. Well worth the price to see the mountain which we couldn't see any other day due to cloud coverage. Landing on the glacier is spectacular. This was an outstanding tour.

Once in a life time experience! The pilot is experienced and super nice. He landed us on the upper base camp of Denali and the views over there is simply stunning. I now begin to understand why there are so many people risking their lives to attempt those summits.

review_title: Highlight of the Alaska trip - cannot miss the grandeur of the mountains
review_text:
We are a family of four, and the price was a holding me back from booking the flightseeing tour.  I called them at 7am ( before boarding the Denali shuttle) to book for the next day. TAT staff was courteous and took my call and completed the reservation!  Even got 10% AAA discount.  We took the Mountain voyager tour. Did not include glacier landing, as we had already trekked the Matanuska Glacier. 

I wasn't expecting much, considering that we had already seen glaciers and been to Denali park.  But the trip summed up our entire experience. The tour was mind blowing.  You just cannot see the grandeur of the Alaskan range, the glaciers and the majestic Denali , until you see it from the air. We were lucky - it was a nice sunny day.  We could actually see the mountain, as well as the glacier valleys. Our pilot pointed out every details along the way.  One of the most cherished memory of our trip !

We were supposed to fly in the morning but the weather wasn't cooperating. So we flew in the evening to the glacier. The staff was very helpful getting us rebooked on the glacier tour. The weather at Denali was still not safe. Dave was the best pilot. He made sure everyone got to see the glaciers and glacier pools at their best. He announced all the turns and kept checking to see everyone was doing ok. He knew a lot about the area and the history and science of the glaciers. This was the highlight of our trip to Alaska. You really get how big the state is from the air. Would definitely recommend to a friend.
Don't let your fear of flying stop you from taking a Glacier landing flight - smoothest flight I have ever been on!

This was an amazing event! We were a group of 7 family members. It was my sons 12th birthday and he was able to sit as co-pilot. The views are spectacular. We paid the extra to land on the Ruth Glacier. It was well worth it. You feel as if you are on top of the world. Our pilot Chris was extremely friendly and knowledgable. He answered our questions about the region and the plane. The ground crew and staff at check in we very friendly and helpful.  If you are going to go, all I can say is go the extra mile and get the glacier landing. You'll be happy you did.

I've never done a flight seeing tour before, but I can't think that there could possibly be a better one than this tour. We did the Grand Denali Tour with a glacier landing and had an incredible tour. Although Denali was not out in all of her splendor, we saw the major landmarks of the mountain and even saw the Summit!! Chris was a phenomenal pilot and tour guide!! Would highly recommend this experience of a lifetime!!!

I was on a tour of Alaska, mostly by bus and train.  I discovered the true way to view Alaska's sights are by air.  I'm not a seasoned flier but I felt completely comfortable flying in the small deHavilland aircraft.  The pilot was very good at telling the passengers what to look for on the ground and I had full confidence in his flying ability.  This was the most thrilling and exhilarating experience on my 10 day visit to Alaska.  If I ever visit Alaska again , it will be by airplane, because you can see so much more and experience it more upclose than by bus, car, boat, or train.

review_title: TAT knows how to fly and land!
review_text: My friend and I signed up for the glacier landing and were told at the desk that no landings had occurred for a few days, so they asked if we still wanted to go.  We chose to go at a lesser price, and Clay, our pilot, was the first to land on a glacier on the mountain-- he was soon followed by at least five planes.  The safety measures and the customer service of Talkeetna Air Taxi staff is among the best I've experienced.

We were visiting Talkeetna at the end of our Alaska vacation. Flying into the Alaska Range and landing on a glacier quickly became of one the high points of the trip.
The office staff was very helpful and courteous in every way.
I had only been in a small aircraft once previously and that was many years ago so I had some apprehension. When we were introduced to our pilot she told us about her flight experience and removed any apprehension that we might have felt. She also was very clear about the safety protocols and her priorities for the flight, which were safety first. The weather, as is frequently the case around Mt McKinley, was cloudy so unfortunately we were not able to see THE mountain.
Our pilot also, in keeping with safety first, landed on the glacier earlier  in the flight than planned because the weather was changing and landing later in the flight might not have been possible. She also made sure that both sides of the plane were able to see the same sites by the way she oriented the aircraft.
In summary our flight was a great experience with great views which was enhanced by a great staff and a great pilot.

I am fortunate. I have been to a lot of places, done a lot of things. BUT - landing on a glacier in Denali - tops all. The weather was perfect (only 30% of tourist see Denali because of the weather). We flew around the park sightseeing many glaciers and north and south peak of Denali. Our pilot was great. He has worked 11 years with the company and has many ratings. He prefers to stay right-where-he-is because of Denali.
The glacier landing was smooth. All of the passengers get out of the plane and walk on the glacier for the excitement and photo ops. After 15 minutes we got back on the plane and with a short roll (ski) we were airborne and headed back to Talkeetna base.
Our pilot was great!  Safe, interesting trip.  The views were amazing!  This was the highlight of our trip!

review_title: A Highlight of Any Alaska Trip
review_text:
This will be one of the most unique experiences you will have anywhere.  The flight though the Alaska range cannot be adequately described with words. TAT takes you trough the passes and along the paths of glaciers that provide a sense of the size and uniqueness of the landscape leaving you in awe.  The glacier landing is really exciting and puts you on the snow in the middle of multiple jagged ridges and peaks - including Denali.

Our pilot Leighan was great.  She not only piloted the plane through very beautiful areas of the Alaska range, she provided great information about the area and the geology - and made the whole experience a lot of fun.

The people at TAT were very friendly and made every aspect of the trip easy. Don't hesitate in making a flight with TAT part of your Alaska adventure!

En Talkeetna hay dos principales empresas que se dedican a los paseos aéreos. Hay otras pero más pequeñas que no tienen el servicio y frecuencia de éstas. 
Esta empresa lo tiene todo muy bien organizado y cumplen con lo que anuncian. Los precios son idénticos, parece que los tienen pactados, pues baratos no son.
El viaje merece la pena pues las vistas son espectaculares y si eliges el aterrizaje en el glaciar además es impresionante.
Asegurarse de que la meteorología sea buena, ya que en caso contrario no puedes disfrutar de las vistas, principal objetivo del vuelo.

La gente de TAT realmente se ocupó de todos los detalles posibles y nos hizo sentir muy cómodos, seguros y tranquilos todo el tiempo. Nos llevaron hasta nuestro hotel, cuidaron el equipaje, al regreso de la expedición nos ayudaron a conseguir donde quedarnos. El vuelo tanto de ida como de regreso fue INCREIBLE! Paul, quien resultó ser el dueño de la compañía es un excelente piloto! Todo perfecto. GRACIAS!

review_title: The only way to get the "wow" of Alaska
review_text: Our family of 10 booked the flightseeing tour with glacier landing for our stay in Talkeetna. We were all very excited about this adventure, and it still blew us away! We went up on a day with questionable weather and the potential of seeing nothing. Our pilot Andy found us a hole in the clouds and a safe landing spot so we could see Denali and have a snowball fight on a glacier! Another bucket list item fulfilled! Andy was highly professional and knowledgeable. Our safety was his first concern but our enjoyment was a close second. He even found a way to give our 84 year old mother, Ruth, a glimpse of her namesake glacier. And our dad was finally convinced that the trip all the way to Alaska was worth it when he got the chance to sit in the copilot's seat for the flight. If you are not a mountain climber, this is your best way to see Denali anger be a part of the 30%.

You will be awe struck with the massiveness of the mountains and glaciers! You sit in a small 8 seater plane, everyone gets a window seat and the pilot takes you around the glaciers. The history and geography of the formation of lakes, trees around the glaciers is interesting. You will love it if you haven't seen snow ever!
Highly recommend the glacier landing.
This was an experience to remember! Great ground crew, a wonderful pilot and guide, and a memorable flight! Thanks to you all.

review_title: Totally Awesome views from the plane. The best thing you will do in ALaska.
review_text:
My friend and I took the Grand Denali tour. Do not short change yourself on something this spectacular. This is the best thing you can do in Alaska. Just one great view after another. In two hours I shot 400 pictures. Landed on a glacier. Awesome. Pray for clear weather. I took me two visits to get this in, as Denali is in the 30% club. In clouds most of the time. The people at Talkeetna Air Taxi are very helpful and kind.
I would recommend this to anyone to wants a long lasting memory of a lifetime. It was for me on June 22 2016. Words just can't describe the beauty of the wilderness.
Thanks again.
Denny

I echo what it has been repeatedly said in this forum: this is an exhilarating, amazing and fantastic experience. We end up doing the glacier landing at Denali's base camp, and enjoyed every minute of it. Thankfully we had great weather and we were able to enjoy the magnificent vistas from the sky and the glacier. Thanks to everyone at the check-in desk and to Paul our pilot and owner, for a great time. Also thanks to the young lady staying at base camp for 10 weeks helping climbers and coordinating comms. She was very informative and helpful to us. I can't say enough good things about these people.

There are several choices of small plane tours in Alaska and over/around Mount Denali so I threw the dice and chose Talkeetna Air Taxi - best gamble of my trip! Yes, it is a tad pricey but the worth every penny. The planes are well maintained and I felt perfectly safe. The pilot was capable, calm, knowledgeable and offered commentary that, even if he has to say the same thing every trip, didn't sound canned or rehearsed. Everyone gets a window seat! You wear headphones so you can hear the captain and air traffic conversations. The ground crew, especially check in desk staff, were friendly and efficient, handling several late arrivals (myself included) with kindness. If you do the glacier landing - which, even though it boosts the price, is totally worth it - they loan you knee-high boot covers to keep you dry. We lucked out on weather and had a cloudless day to see the mountain range, an utterly spectacular sight - best seen with the pros at Talkeetna Air Taxi.

This trip was absolutely amazing, the views of Denali and surrounding peaks were stunning, and quite unlike anything you can experience from the ground.  Landing on the Ruth Glacier was a truly amazing experience.  We have some nervous fliers in our group, but the pilot and company made us very comfortable and safe.

The biggest piece of advice I can offer is to try to be flexible with trying to do a flight seeing tour of Denali.  The weather around the mountains is just about impossible to predict and heavy cloud cover around the mountains is common.

This is our second tour with TAT.  We flew with them about 16 years ago when it was just my wife and I.  This time it was a three generation group of six of us.  We had planned to to the "Grand Denali" tour and had it booked for our first full day in Talkeetna.  However, the clouds were not cooperating that day and they had actually not gone up for any flights.  Over the course of the next couple of days, we rescheduled a few times and juggled some of the other activities that we had planned.  Finally, on our last morning before heading to Anchorage to fly home, the weather cleared enough to allow a flying tour of the glaciers and lower peaks.  Denali itself was initially not visible, but we dressed for the potential for the glacier.

The tour itself was excellent.  Our pilot/guide was very familiar with the area, the landmarks on the ground, and the geological characteristics of the area we toured.  His communication to us was excellent, and I was even more impressed with his communication with the other flights operating.  Ours was the first flight of the morning, so he was also acting as a scout to pass back to others how conditions were looking.

He made several looks at potential glacier landing spots, but all were too cloudy to bother with.  Finally, near the end of our time, the glacier area that serves as base camp for those who set out to climb Denali was clear.  We were able to make the glacier landing.  Mt. Foraker had the best visibility and we took most of our group pictures in front of it.  However, the peak of Denali was also visible for a while during our stop and we got to appreciate just how big of a rock it is from about 15 miles from the peak.  Our pilot took lots of great pictures with our phones and my camera of our group and helped make an incredible memory that we will all carry forever.

I highly recommend flying with these folks.

The weather was cloudy iny 1st day. The staff say there were no flight today and arrange me the following morning flight. The weather is better then yesterday, how they recommend the shortest flight since other flight weren't see anything due to the clouds. I accepted. 
During our flight, we did see the Grand Denali, which is marvelous. And also, we see the glaciers, which were gorgerous, too. 

We can't do glacier landing due the weather is not permitted and they give me the refund. Anyway, they treat their guest very well. I really enjoy the flight and the satff.

We had a few hours left to either walk around Talkeetna or go back to our cabin. We decided to inquire about a possible glacier landing flight. They were happy to accommodate us and before we knew it we were up in the air with our awesome pilot Leighan Falley. She was extremely knowledgable in the surrounding area and what to look at and explaining what things are and why. Oh, she's an excellent pilot as well!!! After landing on the glacier we all exited the aircraft and had photo ops. Then it was a quick snow/ice all fight and a snow angel was thrown in as well. We were on the glacier for about 20 minutes. We left with a bunch of awe inspiring photos and memories and can honestly say that the glacier landing flight was by far THE BEST part of this years Alaska trip! We received a 20% discount because of my nephew being active military which was a nice bonus. All of the staff were great and I would highly recommend to anyone! If you're going on a Denali flight, please support TAT! You won't be disappointed!

This was one of the most amazing things I've done,  even after traveling all over the world! Well worth it! Stunning scenery and sights of mountains. We even took our 22 month old.  He did just fine and even slept for part of the flight.  Jonathan was a wonderful guide!

I would highly recommend taking a flight with this company. We decided to at the last minute and would do it again in a heartbeat. We decided on the Southside Explorer with a glacier landing. It was so incredible. A very smooth plane ride and fantastic pilot.
Amazing! Highlight of the trip landing on a glacier! Allow a weather date in case of rain or fog for rescheduling. Staff is very helpful in working around your schedule.

review_title: The highlight of our trip to Alaska!
review_text: We lucked out with a gorgeous day and excellent visibility.  Our pilot, Jonathan took us on a magical tour of the magnificent peaks surrounding the tallest mountain in North America, Denali.  He knew the name of every summit, talked about the effort of climbing in the range, and eventually landed on the Ruth Glacier where we took in the glorious landscape.  What an awesome experience!  Can't recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi enough!!!! We LOVED it!

review_title: What a way to see Denali!
review_text: Christy of Talkeetna Travel made the reservation for us to take a Talkeetna Air Taxi flight sighting tour of Denali.  Once we arrived in Talkeetna, we contacted the Air Taxi and they asked if we wanted to go earlier. The weather was great and there were very few clouds so we agreed.  When we arrived they upgraded our reservation to land on the glacier at no extra cost.  We joined another family on the plane.  Andy the pilot was great and very knowledgeable about the Denali and the glaciers.  The staff at Talkeetna Air Taxi was also very helpful.  First class operation!

This is the BEST place to take a flight around Denali. Everyone who works there is awesome! From the time you check in, they are all about making sure your visit/trip us everything you want. The first question off the plane "did you have fun" is exactly what this business is about. Lots of options, but Talkeetna Air Taxi is your best choice!

review_title: Outstanding Flight and Excellent Customer Service
review_text:
This was a wonderful once in a lifetime flight! Our pilot, Jonathon, continuously gave us interesting information about the mountain, climbers, and his personal experiences of when he tried to climb the mountain. When we got back into the office, the ladies were very accommodating, especially Emily.

I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi!!

I was extremely nervous for this once-in-a-lifetime activity.  I felt sick the entire drive from Anchorage to Talkeetna just thinking about it, as I had never been on a small plane before and was extremely worried.  When we arrived at the office, we asked if they had any recommendations on what to wear in terms of layers, hats/gloves, etc and they were not very helpful.  The person working the desk just looked up on the board what the temperature was but did not have advice on how to dress appropriately for the glacier landing.

We ended up leaving ahead of schedule because everyone was there (which included myself and husband, another party of 2, and 3 hikers).  My husband told the pilot how nervous I was and if he had any words of advice to help calm me down.  He didn't say anything particularly helpful (such as later in the day when he told us he's been flying that route daily for about 20 years, which is what I would've wanted to hear!).  

The day in Talkeetna was cloudy and gray and it made me nervous going through the clouds.  It was reassuring to be wearing the headset and hearing the pilot communicating with other pilots.  Once we got above the clouds, it was sunny and we had much clearer views of Denali and the other mountains.  The pilot did a good job pointing out the summits and adding facts.  

Our glacier landing was at "base camp" which is 7000 ft up and where hikers congregate before beginning or after ending their hike up Denali.  The landing on the glacier was pretty smooth.  Being on the glacier was one of the coolest parts and I would recommend it if it can fit into your schedule and budget.  It was also pretty neat to see the hikers and hear some of their stories.  

The flight back to the office was pretty similar to the way there - full of incredible, breathtaking views.  When we got back it was a little disorganized.  We went to say thank you but the pilot was busy with the plane and no one from the office greeted us back.  We went into the office after a couple of minutes and they gave us a few postcards.  I kind of expected them to be more upbeat and ask how our flight was, etc.

Overall, I am glad we did it.  The experience did feel more like the "taxi" service part of their name than the welcoming, small-town tourist experience I was imagining.  We got to and from the glacier safely, which was my main concern, and saw some amazing views.

We had an awesome experience. Entire staff was extremely helpful. Dave ,the pilot, was very professional and informative. 
We did the Mountain Voyager  with a Glacier landing on Ruth Glacier in the Sheldon Amphitheater by the Mountain House. The only thing better would have been staying @the Mountain House and I'm sure they would have helped us pull that off if we could have.
Flightseeing at Denali is a MUST DO and these people make it happen!!!!!!
We had a beautiful mostly sunny day and the view was amazing. We got much closer to Denali than I expected. Excellent pilot Tom!

I have never flown in a 6 seater plane, was very nervous but knew if the weather was clear that I must do it. The sun was out, our pilot Leeann is a 3rd generation woman pilot and was the perfect guide for us. She had previously lead climbers up Denali so her experience and knowledge of the area and terrain was invaluable. It was a very humbling, moving experience to be in a tiny plane at 12,000 ft and look up at the 20,000+ ft stunning Denali right in front of us, to fly over the glacier and granite landscapes. We saw things I will never see again from the air. Flying over the base camp for the climbers was also very moving, to visualize the feat of their efforts. It made it very real for me. We landed on Ruth Glacier, 4000 ft thick at the 5000 ft elevation level. We got out and spent 30 minutes there. Blue skies, sun on "the mountain", walking in the snow. What a once in a life time experience!! Leeann always made sure we were informed, safety was her 1st priority. The entire staff from pilot to all staff made sure we were comfortable in every way. I am so glad I pushed myself to do this. They give you glacier boots to keep your shoes dry. All seats are window seats and the headsets were perfect for the narration and noise. AMAZING!!  Do it!!

Thank you to the wonderful crew and people at TAT!! This was the best experience I have had since my children were born!! Landing on a glacier was absolutely beautiful!!!! I felt safe and enjoyed the fun from start to finish!! 

I highly recommend this company and this experience for all!!

The hosts at Talkeetna Basecamp wilderness cabin recommended we use TAT for our flight tour.  After our experience I see why!  Very professional outfit, keyed in on safety, and we each got our own window.  We did a glacier landing and were allowed a good amount of time to enjoy the experience.  I truly appreciated that as I suspect I will never have such an opportunity again.  I highly recommend this trip - worth every bit of the price!
This was such an amazing experience. Pilot Chris was awesome! We went for an 8:30am Grand Denali tour with Glacier Landing. The entire journey was spectacular.
The flight was amazing and the scenery was breath taking . I would highly recommend this tour if you have the money
Our entire experience was excellent. The flight, the service, the VIEW, there are no words to explain the experience. It is worth the trip and the money for the experience.

We were able to enjoy the unparalleled views of the Alaskan range provided by the Otter and the excellent running commentary of our pilot.  Our glacier landing spot turned out to by at Denali Base Camp and we had a slightly cloud obscured view of Mt Denali, but otherwise perfect day and memorable experience.
Best experience! Great for whole family. Went with kids ages 10 & 12 - a day we will never forget. Space for RV parking & easy walk into town for lunch afterwards

There's really very little to say about this operation other than true "excellence."

We took a flight to see the peak of Denali (known as Mt. McKinley) and land for a few minutes.    

We arrived by bus from the Princess Lodge (we booked independently- not through Princess).    A rep was very good with explaining "how" to make all of this work.   A Talkeetna Air shuttle van met our bus and took us to the airport.    After the flight, the Talkeetna shuttle was willing to drive us wherever we wanted, but we walked to the town.
Checkin at the airport was flawless, plenty of friendly staff who knew what they were doing.    

As for the flight--  My wife and I were seated on opposite sides of the plane.   The pilot did a great job of circling around so that both sides could see everything.    My wife's face was plastered to the window...  she didn't move except to turnaround quickly a few times and order me to "take a picture."    It just so happened that every time she looked, I had put the camera down.    I was worried that I was taking TOO MANY!      Every shot was like a post card.    

I should note that the peak was not visible from the ground.    This flight allowed us to see the majesty of the mountain range and peaks above the clouds.     

It got even better when we landed on the snow!   After we landed the pilot showed us how he can convert from wheels to skis.    

My only complaint was that it didn't last long enough!!!         

We flew in helicopters and sea planes while in Alaska... this was the tops.

review_title: Incredible service - above and beyond - from all employees
review_text: My climbing team, the Colorado Buffs, flew into and out of the Alaskan Range with TAT. We had to have 2.5 days for the weather to fly in and their team let us hang out with them in their office, drink coffee, eat treats, etc and fed us tons of great information. They drove us into town and let us crash at their facilities for the nights we had to wait. They did the same for us after we flew out - after all services were rendered, they still gave us incredible service and freebies. To a person - the office staff, pilots, and ground team - were the nicest, most accommodating people I've ever dealt with. I'd like to give them six stars!

A must do in Alaska! The weather was not in our favor, but our pilot did a wonderful job of really maximizing our experience and giving us spectacular views! The pilot, Kris, was awesome - really knowledgable of the area and definitely made the tour entertaining. The entire staff was extremely kind and welcoming. One of the highlights of our trip!

This was probably the best thing we did in our week long trip in Alaska. We had a wonderful and personable pilot who was obviously well trained. The views were breath-taking. I have never seen something so awe-inspiring. Well worth your money.

review_title: Stop reading reviews and book your flight!
review_text: The uniform accolades in all the reviews tell the tale. Just do it! This will be an adventure you'll never forget. Safe and comfortable, the staff were friendly, helpful and flexible (we changed our flight time with no problem.)

We were blessed with 70 degree weather and blue skies when we decided to do the glacier flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  All I can say is WOW !  Do not miss because 
this is a once in life time experience.  Again, we were blessed with crazy great weather.
4 of us in Cessna 185 and we landed at glacier at base of Denali.  Our pilot was one of the owner's Paul.  So cool and what pictures . They will pick you up in downtown Talkeetna and bring you back.

If you want to actually see Denali/Mt. McKinley, this is the absolute best way to do so!
We booked this tour on our own, not as part of our cruise ship offering, and could not have been more pleased. The flight seeing tour and landing on Ruth Glacier were incredible. Our pilot, Chris, was awesome, and all of the staff was great. This is truly an adventure we will never forget! When we visited Denali National Park several days later, the mountain was not visible, and we were told the weather is rarely clear enough to see it. If you don't want to be disappointed, this tour is a must!

review_title: South Facing Tour with Glacier Landing--AMAZING!
review_text: This tour was AMAZING. I originally was only going because someone else wanted to go, but am SO glad I did it! We did the south face tour with the glacier landing. Our trip was at capacity (11 people) so I got to be co-pilot on the return flight. Chris was such a fantastic guide, making the trip as enjoyable as possible, taking pictures for everyone, and explaining everything that we were seeing. If you're on the fence about this trip because of the price, don't be--it's worth every penny.

My husband and I took a flight seeing and glacier landing trip with Shiloh in mid-June 2016 -- the folks at TAT were so warm and appreciative of our business and made us feel special. The tour was well organized -- we took the Grand Denali tour w/glacier landing-- the weather was amazingly bright, warm and beautiful and the skies deep blue so the whole experience was enhanced-- we had amazing views of Denali and the mountain range -- Shiloh got in close so both sides of the plane had good views for photos. We landed for about 20 minutes and got to take amazing photos -- it was cool but not cold - we wore booties given to us by TAT and just light jackets over a couple of layers of shirts - and light gloves... Totally recommend this company and the tour.!!! you won't be disappointed.

This tour was amazing! Richard is an awesome pilot. This tour was a part of our 20th anniversary celebration. Words cannot begin to describe how beautiful this trip was!  We were blessed with perfect weather for this mountain top experience!  AMAZING!

We took the flight on a crystal clear day, so that has a lot to do with my review. It was WONDERFUL!  Staff was great. Our pilot was knowledgable and professional. Would recommend TAT to others for their glacier landing flight.

This was a great way to see the biggest mountain in North America.    The staff was great, the plane was a perfect way to  view the mountain and surrounding area.  We landed on the glacier and got great pictures.

We flew to a glacier and landed on our first day in Alaska.  The company was very safety oriented .  Our pilot was Michael and he was excellent.  Told us all about the area and made it look so simple.  Landing on the glacier was crazy exciting.

Take your camera and make sure you have a head for heights. A really wonderful flight from people who know their business.  Landing on a glacier surrounded by peaks with a blue sky,  what more could you want? Flying over Denali was a once in a lifetime chance as far as I was concerned.  Strongly recommend the flightseeng trip.

review_title: One of the highlights of trip to Alaska
review_text: I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi (TAT). Staff were very friendly and helpful. Shuttle picked us up and returned us to our hotel. The pilot was very experienced and informative. We went on a clear day and the view of the mountains including Denali was amazing. The glacier landing was "awesome" according to our kids! Thanks for a great day!

If you are in talkeetna , you must do flight with glacier landing. You are surrounded by snow mountains all around. The view is out of this world. The pilot is skillful and definitely enjoy what he is doing. We landed at a based camp 7000 ft high. It was sunny with beautiful view but the weather up there can change in a couple of minutes. The snow shower came suddenly and it gave us a lot of time high up there. We were there more than 1.5 hour instead of the usual half an hour. No extra charge and we count yourself blessed. It is advised to check out the hotel before you take the flight because snow storm can come suddenly. The manager in the based camp was very kind to make hot chocolate drink for the visitors while waiting for the shower to pass. A very wonderful experience and a heart warming one.

Flew on a two hour flight over Denali and it was beautiful beyond words.  Wally was our pilot and he was excellent. The glacier landing was perfect approach and gently touched down, he was one of best pilots I have ever flown with.  Personable, fun, skilled, and really a great pilot.  Landed on the Pika Glacier and thoroughly enjoyed this amazing flight and glacier landing.  We will definitely do this again!

The flight was 2 hours long and we flew over much of the park. Up close to Denali and the other mountain peak. We landed on Ruth Glacier. That was an experience I will never forget. Denali from the air is absolutely spectacular. We had a clear sunny day so visibility was excellent. HIGHLY recommend this if your budget can handle it.

I was traveling with my family, and everyone had such a wonderful time with talkeetna air taxi! The staff was so cheery, helpful and professional, a real pleasure to talk to. We were exceptionally lucky with the weather and got some amazing views of Denali, Mt Hunter and Mt Foraster. 

We flew in a 10 passenger plane, and although I was a little nervous in the beginning to fly in a small plane over the mountains, I hardly felt the take off and landing. The flight was so smooth!! The pilot was really experienced too, and that made us feel much more comfortable as well. My dad chose to ride in the cockpit next to the pilot, and had a great time. Oh and the headphones were pretty cool, because the pilot was able to point out the names of the mountains as we rode over them and we got to hear some live radio communication.

Everyone got a window seat, and flying over the mountains and looking at the suspended clouds and little blue pools of water was surreal.

We chose to do a glacier landing, which I would really recommend!!! It was absolutely exhilarating to walk on the glacier and also be surrounded by beautiful ice walls. We got around 20 minutes to walk around, and got plenty of time to take pictures. 

I would highly recommend this company!! They also gave us a pretty great discount ;)

This is my first flight in a small plane and I almost didn't agree to go with my dad. Once we got up in the air, however, the scenery was so breathtaking and my confidence in our pilot so complete that I abandoned all possible nervousness. This was a once-in-a-lifetime experience which we highly recommend!

I have done two flight seeing tours with these guys , the Summit flight in 2013  that was amazing to fly over the summit of Denali ( they only do this tour if there is enough people to fill the plane) , I came back this year , was hoping to go over the sumit again  but  this tour was not available on the date i was there , the staff recommended the Grand Denali Tour  which  was amazing  , we got to see the summits of the Mountain  close up, from a different angle to the other tour and also the climbers on the Mountain and the different base camps , the pilot gave us a good close up view of the Wickersham Wall , The Glacier Landing was  great  , just seeing the vastness of the wilderness  good , Got the Front seat next to the pilot on the way out down the Great Gorge back to Talkeetna

If Alaska is on your bucket list, DO NOT miss seeing Denali from the air. Talkeetna Air Taxi is a great company to work with. The staff was very professional, friendly and extremely helpful.  Dave did an awesome job flying us over the park and a great glacier landing.  He provided much information on Denali, adjoining mountains and the glaciers.  He's also a great photogpher. 2 incredible hours on a cloudless beautiful day!!!

Jonathan was our pilot and tour guide on a De havilland Otter. We were originally scheduled for an 8:30 am tour, but due to weather were delayed until after lunch. This trip and tour was worth the wait.  We were a little uncertain at the time of take off if weather would permit  landing on the glacier, but fortunately everything aligned. The views were beautiful and not a bad seat on the plane. Landing on the glacier was great fun.  We were able to spend 20-30 min on on the glacier to take photos and play in the snow.  Another plus, Denali was seen peaking above the clouds as a backdrop for photos.  This was our first adventure upon arriving in Alaska and after we were finished, none of us believed anything would be able to top this tour.

review_title: One of the best flights we've had
review_text: This is our fifth time to Alaska and we have flown around Denali multiple times. Chris was our pilot, and this was the best flight yet. He was a great narrator and the fact it was a beautiful day made it better. I would highly recommend the extra $ for a glacier landing.

We were fortunate to have spectacular weather for our flight--sunny and warm with not a cloud in the sky. Our pilot Leanne said days like that are few and far between, so we really lucked out. Speaking of Leanne, she was friendly, knowledgeable, and would have made it a great experience even in less perfect weather conditions. Landing on the glacier was definitely a highlight and is highly recommended as an add-on. We are from Florida and our kids have rarely seen snow--a family snowball fight on the glacier, surrounded by the incredible backdrop of the mountains, was great fun for them (and us!). The folks at TAT were all professional and accommodating, we would definitely book with them again and recommend them to others.

We had perfect weather for our flight with Leanne! She was as delighted with the experience as the passengers because the day was perfect for viewing all Denali has to offer. Having seen the landscape in 3D suddenly all those hours spent in my Geography class made sense. Anyone who travels to Talkeetna should take this flight. It's simply marvellous!!!!
Good people. Safe and fun. I highly recommend this excursion.Not cold in June. Landed on the glacier.

We did not get to do our Flightseeing and Glacier landing with Talkeetna Air Because of bad weather. This was a huge disappointment to us but it had nothing to do with Talkeetna Air. We had two days to get this done and the weather would just not cooperate.  We were in contact with Talkeetna Air every couple of hours getting weather updates and they were very honest about our chances of landing on a Glacier or even seeing much of the Mountain. They left the decision to go or not to go Completely up to us with no pressure. They quickly refunded our deposit when we decided it didn't seem possible to see anything.

review_title: Best thing i've ever done with a plane
review_text: We had the luck of seeing mt.denali and landed on the ruth glacier. Richard was a great pilot and told us everything about the region. I wanna do that again. Just amazing.

review_title: TAT - AWESOME. Do not miss this...
review_text:
We took the "summit tour", clouds were in the sky and it rained on us as we prepared for the flight.  I thought sure signs of a bad decision to do this crazy flight.
Turned out to be a trip of a lifetime.  As we got close the mountain was pretty clear, as much of the Alaskan Range; just enough clouds for accents in the photos.  There is only window seating; Dave, the pilot; took good care to turn the plane for all to have a great photo chances and view.  We saw climbers ON the summit; did a glacier landing at climber base camp and did it all in comfort.  Passengers get to listen to radio traffic and Dave narrated the trip through the same headsets.

The is one thing you want to do when you are planning your trip to Alaska. When we went there the weather was not the great so they couldn't do the glacier landing but just flying over the glacier is just worth it. The pilot was really warm and welcoming . I'm nit sure of her name but I guess it was Gwen. Passing through the green forest and seeing the white glacier and frozen water falls is amazing. And the best part is you get to be a CO-Pilot.

We treated ourselves to the Denali Flyover with a glacier landing and we are so glad we did. Spectacular views of Denali! Incredible to actually be standing on a glacier. Everyone was so polite and professional throughout our whole experience. Our pilot was so knowledgable and went out of his way to make sure everyone was enjoying themselves.  He even made a slight detour in order to show us moose as we were returning to the airstrip. We felt safe and secure throughout the flight. Highly, highly recommend it.

Fantastic business. Excellent customer service. Our original appt got cancelled due to weather and they were able to work with our schedule and time in AK to get our flight in. We are repeat customers and would go again at our next visit to the area. 

Our pilot was Chris and he was I'm formative and excellent with the kids.

We did the Grand Denali flightseeing tour and opted to include a glacier landing. OK, so it was expensive, but it was worth every penny. Our pilot and tour guide Johnathan was the best. He made sure that everyone seated on the right side and the left got to see everything. He was very informative, very cheerful, and didn't rush us once on the glacier. Everyone at Talkeetna was very pleasant. If you want to see Denali, this is the way to go!

We woke up to blue skies and a clear view of Denali. What a day to take a flight…the weather was perfect. The flight was amazing and the mountains were majestic. We both agreed it was the highlight of our Alaskan trip. Our pilot, Clay, did an awesome job of narrating. The landing on the glacier was an incredible experience that we will never forget. We would highly recommend this company!

review_title: Most memorable tour we took in Alaska
review_text: What can I say other than this tour was the best we took in Alaska. We went for the two hour flightseeing tour that included the glacier landing. It was absolutely a magnificent and in some ways, a very spiritual experience. The weather really cooperated - skies were bright and sunny and it wasn't particularly cold although you do need to have layers when you're walking on the glacier.  The views were spectacular. While it's expensive, it was worth every penny.

review_title: Golden Experience!!!!  #1 Best part of the vacation!
review_text:
Michael Gold our pilot definitely made this a Golden experience.  We had to take a picture of him, so we can share him with our family and friends!  The views, the commentary was way more than we expected.  The landing on the glacier was incredible, I guarantee you won't be disappointed.  

We heard about Talkeetna Air Taxi while we were visiting a park, a couple we met said it was an awesome experience.  When we got back into town we called and made the reservation.  Kimberly took the reservation and she was fantastic, answered all are questions and followed through with everything she explained.  This was definitely worth it and I highly recommend it!  Thanks Talkeetna Air you defiantly made our vacation!  A+ service 

FYI after your done make sure to clip your snow boots together!

My husband and I, along with our three children ages 11, 13 and 15, took a Mountain View with glacier landing tour. We were taken out on a Beaver, with Shiloh. It was beyond description. We were fairly nervous initially. I will say that our nerves dissipated quickly. He kept the plane steady, advised us and reassured us when there was turbulence, and his landing on the glacier as well as take off, and again landing on return were flawless. Much of the time he was teaching us about the geology of the region. We all agreed this was a highlight of our trip to Alaska and flying with Shiloh was a fantastic experience! Would highly recommend!

review_title: Best flight experience you can get!
review_text: We took the 830am grand Denali trip. It lasted till about 11:00am. We went around the mountain and did the glacier landing. I definitely recommend the glacier landing and it should be on your bucket list for sure! Our pilot Dave was informative and he let me be co pilot on our way out which gave me the best view possible! Would recommend this if you are visiting the park as no view beats the aerial view!

My family traveled to Alaska so that I could visit my last National Park- Lake Clark. We also wanted to visit as many parks along the way as we possibly could in just 10 days. Our flight to the glacier in Denali National Park was a highlight on our trip. Our pilot, Chris, took my family of 9- including a 7 month old baby boy- on a flight we will remember the rest of our lives. Landing on the glacier in the Otter ski plane, seeing Denali close up and getting to stay and play on the glacier was absolutely awesome- and I do not use that phrase lightly. Thank  you Talkeetna Air Taxi for adding to the best trip my family will ever take!!!

What an amazing experience! The office staff were friendly and efficient and even remembered us when we came back to give us a refund. Apparently we did not get to see all of what we were supposed to have seen and they knew that and refunded the difference. The pilot was nice but not very informative.  But again who wants someone babbling on when the views were breath taking!  Great adventure!

I booked this as a surprise for my husband based on all the positive reviews I read. Didn't tell hubby the plan until the night before since he hates to fly. 

Our late morning tour wound up being bumped back to 2:00 because of the weather. Staff was extremely accommodating, calling with updates, providing transportation when needed, and offering alternative options.

The flight was excellent. Our pilot kept the plane very steady as he provided details about what we were flying over.

We landed on a glacier with the most beautiful fresh bluish white snow you will ever see in your life. We spent about a half an hour here taking everything in.

This was both my husband and my own Alaskan highlight. This expedition is not cheap but is completely worth it. If you can make it work, take this adventure-you will not regret it!

I can't thank Annie and Paul,  and everyone at Talkeetna Air Taxi,  for making our Summit Flight and Glacier Landing the highlight of our Alaskan vacation.   I highly recommend this for anyone visiting Alaska!

review_title: Talkeetna: If you go you must land on the snow!
review_text: My wife and I recently did the Denali flight - seeing and Glacier landing with Talkeetna Air and consider the experience one of the highlights not only of our Alaska cruise and DIY land tour but one of our favorite excursions ever! I spent 39 years flying myself so I know good planes and pilots when I see them and these guys are good! Flew in a turbine Otter with Jonathan, he was professional and personable in every way. It's simply breathtaking to see those mountains and glaciers from the air but what a thrill to land on that snow covering the ice. Priceless.

As it is typical in Alaska the weather was iffy...  This said they could take us up and would need to see if could land on the Glacier...  So off we went in the rain.  After 10 minutes the pilot found the perfect window and we saw the world! The weather was perfect for 40 minutes and we landed and played on the Glacier...  We saw so much... The pilot was a Pro and we felt safe and secure at all times. Flying in a Beaver is very cool... He explained everything and showed us how the place was formed...  WOW... WOW  do not mis it!

review_title: Most amazing scenic flight of Denali
review_text: We chose the Grand Denali tour with glacier landing.  This was such an amazing experience.  We got so lucky with a beautiful sunny day and the landscape with so majestic.  Our flight tour guide was very informative! Highly recommend choosing this company!

This was not in my plan when traveling to Denali via talkeetna. I had a free afternoon and decided to check it out and was very glad that I did! I did the flight seeing tour with a Glacier lading. The views were so magnificent and spectacular all over..  The glacier landing (on Ruth glacier) was very exciting and we spent about 20 mins on the glacier.  I spent the entire time just sitting on the snow and staring at the pristine beauty. The experience was surreal , in the next possible way, and would definitely recommend adding a glacier landing to your alaskan adventure itinerary.

Our pilot was fantastic,  very informative and we had a great landing and sightseeing tour!

The only thing I would recommend is doing the trip on a clear day and they are really good about letting you know about the weather before you head out.

Memorable flightseeing trip around Denali with landing on Ruth glacier. We took the grande denali tour. The views were breathtaking. Best part was the feeling when we were standing on the glacier. We were lucky to have a clear day and a clear view of the peak.

Increíble vuelo con Paul sobre el Dernali. Hicimos landing (aterrizaje sobre el glaciar). Estuvimos 15' sacando fotos y jugando con la nieve. Hacen descuento, es incomparable la excursión. Super vale la pena los 320 UDS que vale por 1hs45' Recomendado 100 por ciento en excursiones de alaska, lo mejor

I've flown with 3 flight services out of Talkeetna, into the Alaska Range and Talkeetna Air Taxi is the best! They have the best pilots, the sexiest planes and really understand the needs of climbers. Plus their office staff is fantastic and always willing to help, they'll gladly give you rides around town and help with lugging around your heavy duffels. All their pilots carry Inreach devices, so they are well equipped for communicating with climber's via Inreach, which in my opinion is the way to go in the Alaska Range. If you're a climber who has ever dreamed of landing within a 10 minute walk of huge alpine routes (aka no approach) then TAT is who you need to call. -WA Boyz

review_title: What an anniversary gift, with #1 outfit
review_text:
What an experience, now this is a bucket list item if there was one.  The Denali mountain top was breath taking.  At every turn was another spectacular picture of ecstasy. Our guide Dave was top notch and made me feel totally at ease as this was my maiden voyage on such a plane.  If your scared do this trip anyway.  I was second guessing myself the whole three days that we put a deposit down on our flight.  Well push yourself out of your comfort zone and get on the plane, your wont be sorry..  They are a highly professional group with a lot of experience right from the beginning when people were flown into Denali before the road was established.  

Go for it , this will truly be a memorable anniversary for us.  Thanks again to talkeetna air taxi.    Carol and randy

review_title: Grand Denali and Glacier Landing... HIghlight of Alaska Trip!
review_text: There is no better way (short of climbing Denali) to experience the Alaska Range than with Talkeetna Air Taxi! We did the Grand Denali flight which included a landing on the Ruth Glacier. The views were exceptional; the pilot professional; and the whole experience entirely surreal. This was the highlight of our two week trip in Alaska. We could not be more pleased with our experience. Highly recommended!!!!

Our first experience with small aircraft in Alaska was fantastic. The flight was so magnificent and the views defy description. Shiloh was our southern dream. From Jacksonville, he was very welcoming host and although new to flying in Alaska, we would have thought he was local and had flown the area for years. Both self assured & confident as well as reassuring to his passengers, he was a delight! He encoraged questions and answered all expertly. We would certainly fly with Talkeetna Air & especially, Shiloh again.

We had been to Talkeetna on our way to Denali national park from anchorage . having read reviews we booked glacier landing with this company. 
Check in was smooth and our pilot John was very welcoming in introducing about the basics .

Our plane was 6 seater , and after we took off we had astonishing views of the glacier . after about 45 mins we landed on a glacier and spent around 30/mins playing and taking great snaps , john did take some great pictures :)

Its a must do if you visit Talkeetna , and I recommend doing this activity with TAT only !

We had signed up for the tour w/ glacier landing, but the weather wasn't cooperating.  The staff wanted us to enjoy the experience and were more than happy to take us up anyway, reschedule us for a different flight, or cancel our booking all together.  We ended up not being able to land on a glacier, but the flight was totally worth it.

Phenomenal flight seeing up the Ruth Glacier below Mt. Denali with a stunning landing in the Amphitheater. Highly recommend adding on the landing on the glacier, it was awesome and really lets you get a sense of how big everything is near Denali.

The best flight I have ever had, the folks that set up the flight were top notch.  The pilot shared his knowledge of Denali and the geologic history of the mountains and glaciers. I would highly recommend anyone anywhere near Talkeetna to experience this awe inspiring adventure!
We had a great experience, the views were amazing.  At time during the flight, I felt that I could reach out and touch the mountain.  Our pilot was excellent.
Took the flight into Denali base camp and landed on the glacier.  It was an amazing, unforgettable experience.  The pilot was very knowledgeable and friendly.

Seven years and 14 trips into the Alaska Range later, and I've flown with every air service in Talkeetna. But the one I keep coming back to is TAT. Whether you're looking to go into an unexplored zone, or just want a reliable flight to your base camp, these are the folks to trust. There's a reason they're used by the serious climbers of the Alaska Range time after time.

Just back from my 8th climbing trip to the central alaska range, and once again, Paul and his crew impressed.  They are consistantly the first service into denali base camp after weather and if your objectives are more remote (the Ruth, Kitchatnas, etc), they are the people to get you there and back safely.

Just got back from a glacier drop off into the Talkeetna mountains with a group of 5 friends. 

Could not have been treated better by everyone involved with TAT. The front desk staff was helpful and courteous and expedited our short time window with efficiency.

Big hats off to our pilot Paul who took a little extra time flying around the glaciers to help us pick an ideal spot to base camp out of. His expertise and willingness to help us decide on some terrain in unfamiliar territory made for a tremendous experience for our group.

Can't say how much we appreciated every aspect of our trip!

review_title: Wonderful flight in Denali National Park
review_text: My wife and I showed up about 20 minutes before a scheduled flight, and the excellent and efficient staff was able to put us on the flight.  The pilot, Richard, was wonderful, showing us all around the park and even taking time after the flight to show us where we'd gone and what we'd seen on the Aeronautical chart after we'd landed.  Can't recommend them enough!!  Expensive, but extremely high value experience.  You'll never find something like this anywhere in the world.

Living in the alps I often travel by ski touring and even heli there. But the Denali with Talkeetna Air Taxi has been one of my most impressive mountain flight and glacier landing experience. A beautiful blue sky day with his majesty The Denali. Whaou!

I have lived in Alaska all my life and always admired Denali from afar. My husband surprised me with a birthday trip to Denali; I always thought it was a tourist thing but was really excited since I've never done a flight seeing tour in Alaska. We were lucky the weather was blue-bird perfect as I know that is an issue with small planes. What an incredible, amazing experience. The staff was super nice, the pilot was very knowledgable (the best landing ever!) and Alaska's mountains and glaciers did not disappoint. We would highly recommend to not only tourists but all Alaskans!

Welcoming, Professional, Safety Conscious, Fun and Educational. Talkeetna Air Taxi's staff creates that kind of environment for every customer.  I couldn't be happier with the experience they provided for my flight along with the ease of our pilot landing on the Glacier. I hope to be able to fly with Talkeetna Air Taxi during my next visit to Alaska. THANK YOU TAT......

review_title: Just Amazing you have to do it
review_text: Its was just Amazing. Flying over Mt Denali and Landing on a Glacier. You get out and play in the snow. You have to do it. It was worth the money. Just do it

Was lucky enough for perfect weather. Great customer service and pilots. Unbelievable beauty flying around Denali and landing on Ruth Glacier. As we were flying through the mountains, it almost seemed you could reach out and touch them. Landing on the glacier, getting out of the plane seemed like standing on top of the world.

review_title: Simply the Best Chartered Air Service
review_text:
We flew into a remote spot of the Hayes Range with Paul from TAT to so some climbing. Not much was known about the conditions of the Black Rapids glacier for landing that time of year but we were told that if anyone can get you there, it will be Paul. The flight was smooth and the landing perfect, even in the deep snow!  Paul is passionate about Alaska, knowledgeable and pointed out a great many facts and history as we flew to the range. Customer service at TAT is amazing. They were helpful from start to finish and entirely accommodating of my daily calls for extended weather forecasts. 

We will certainly be back to TAT for next year's climbing season.  Thank you to everyone at the TAT office for making it such a wonderful experience.

We had planned Alaska tour all the way from India and therefore I wanted everything to be perfect !! One of my friend recommended TAT for glacier landing .. I was little sceptical because of the costs but the experience was out of this world . Paul accompanied us in this flight.  It was a small 6 seater plane . 

As soon as the flight took off , the views were outstanding ! We were spellbound ! Originally we were supposed to land on some glacier but due to last minute weather changes , we landed at some other glacier ( don't remember the name ). We had 30 mins time during which we clicked innumerable outstanding photographs ! 

All in all , it was a terrific experience and I would recommend doing with TAT !!

Unfortunately due to weather conditions we opted out of our scheduled flight around Denali. I was impressed with their cancelation policy. The morning of our scheduled flight we called to see what viability would be like, because we could see how cloudy it was, and they told us to stop by at our scheduled check-in time to see how things were at that point. When we got there they showed us a 3D map of the area we would be flying in and showed us what would actually be visible to us. At that point we were given the option to continue as planned or to opt out of the flight and receive our deposit back. We were disappointed that the weather didn't cooperate, since we didn't have time to reschedule, but were incredibly grateful that they allowed us to decide without a financial penalty.

This is an experience of a lifetime! We flew in a small plane with one other couple and the pilot. Seeing the glacier from above was spectacular. We landed at the base camp due to too much fog but it was magnificent, walking on the ice and enjoying the beauty. The pilot was knowledgeable and flew us through canyons while explaining the landscape.  The people at Talkeetna Air prepared us for the trip and made it completely worry free. I would go back to them over and over again if I were in Alaska more often.

In short, probably the coolest thing to do in/around Denali with an ace provider.

We (three of us) took the "Mountain Voyager" (package #2) + Glacier landing and would redo in a second. I ("trip Dad") was sold after meeting Paul, our pilot and guide, in the morning to coordinate weather, time, etc. (do this beforehand so you get a good window of opportunity and don't feel rushed).

On our flight we saw a lone climber who radioed us (was familiar with Paul and T.A.S.) and had been on the mountain 63 days! We continued on through mile high walls and landed on a glacier apparently in Denali basecamp. Only we couldn't believe our eyes when the sun rose "again" over a peak (previously shading us). 

A must do.

-Eric

p.s. - To the climber in this picture, please let us know the results. :) Our flight was 3/23/16 and we circled you a few times in the Cessna 185.

My mom turned 70 and we flew around Denali to celebrate.  The owner was our pilot and it was great hearing his stories of flying climbers to the mountain over the years.  I've taken several flight tours of Denali and this one literally took my breath away.  Thanks for making the day so special.

review_title: First trip and already feel part of the TAT family!
review_text: Flew in with Paul to the Tokositna for a winter attempt on Mt Huntington, the TAT family was extremely professional, fun, and welcoming, as well as extremely efficient. Paul was ready to go before we had gotten back from breakfast! Annie and the house crew did a great job getting all of our paperwork and weights taken care of and we were off to the glacier very quickly. Flying in with Paul is a treat, his skill with the airplane is obvious and on our way out he gave us a quick flyby of the Phantom wall and some of the routes we were watching in the Ruth. To put it simply go with TAT or don't go at all, they are simply the best!

review_title: Grand views with an experienced team
review_text: I did the Grand Denali tour with TAT. Ground staff was very friendly and always helpful with coordinating the flight and making sure I'm well equipped for the glacier landing (provided goretex shoes). The pilot was fun and knowledgeable and let me sit next to him - this way I had an even more amazing view of the mountains.

review_title: Beautiful Adventure flying into Rainy Pass on a ski-plane
review_text: On an incredible tour with Planet Earth Adventures, we flew a ski-plane with a engaging and lovely pilot into the Iditarod Rainy Pass Checkpoint on a gorgeous day.  On the way and back, our pilot pointed out the sights and we could see the dog teams racing below.  It was an idyllic day.

Gorgeous flight! If you really want to see Alaska, Talkeetna Air Taxi is the way to go.  Flew up to Rainy Pass and saw wonderful scenery.  Pilot Paul did an excellent job, and the plane was clean and comfortable.

Paul overflew the trail in an Otter that flew like a Mercedes, smoothly winding from side to side of the trail we saw 30+ teams competing. A smooth landing and 3.5 hours was the experience of a lifetime with teams arriving at Rainy Pass - the most beautiful checkpoint - some staying, some blowing thru after vet check. This was the "Best Ever" in 23 Iditarods. The safety of flight is foremost and TAT delivers with superior planes and superior pilots. I recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi highly and you will miss the trip of a lifetime if you skip flightseeing Denali.

Our flight to Denali with a glacier landing with Paul (owner and pilot) created a memory never to be forgotten! Staff in the office checked us in, weighed in and chatted until departure time. Flying in the DeHavilland Beaver (circa 1950's) was an excellent adventure into the Alaska Range. Take your camera!

It totally worth every cent, you must go, if you are planning to go to Alaska you should put this tour in your list, and save money for it like you save the money for the plane to get to alaska or the hotels, you can't make a trip without that. I will never forget this tour in my whole life. It's very secure, the plane is very stable, you have no reason to be afraid of.

Initially a bit of a challenge getting boot covers that would fit but after a few returning flights it was all good.  Great organisation getting to the plane, onto the plane and into the air.  Awesome views and very informative pilot.

Safety appeared paramount which puts you at ease so as to enjoy the scenery.

Smooth landing and the best weather had us in the best shape to soak in the majestic peaks, make snow angels, throw snow balls, and just marvel at nature.

review_title: Incredible: One of the highlights of our Alaska Trip!
review_text:
We did the Glacier Landing Tour with TAT in July 2015 during our Alaska Vacation.  Though we were delayed slightly due to weather related reasons,  TAT team were continuously updating us with the latest weather information and also ensured that the flight promptly took off as soon as the skies cleared up. 

The flight itself was simply amazing. We first viewed Denali from different directions and also saw the amphitheater and other interesting attractions such as Ruth Glacier before landing on the Glaciers. 

Important notes to consider: 
1) One must definitely take advantage of Northern Light coupon for TAT - this will provide 25% savings on all TAT tours
2) TAT can accommodate groups of up to 10 people in the same flight.  Based on the enquiries I did, other competitors could not do the same. This certainly is a plus for TAT

Conclusion: 
I would strongly recommend TAT to anyone considering a glacier landing flight in Alaska and also viewing Denali from close quarters.

review_title: ランディング出来なかったけど　レインボーがたくさん見えて素敵でした
review_text: タルキートナーからの飛行でした。はじめ人数がそろわないので、そろうまで時間待ち　なんとかラストで飛べることになって、乗ることができました。天候の関係でランディングができなかったので残念でしたが、かわりにレインボーがたくさん　2重に見えたときもあり、　とってもきれいな景色でした。ここにこないと絶対に見られない景色で、本当に夢のように素敵でした。ホテルまでの送迎もきっちりとあり、親切でした。

Our Glacier flight with TAT was the highlight of our trip. The flight to the glacier was breathtaking. Once we landed on the glacier we felt like we were in another world. I can't begin to describe how it felt, standing on the glacier surrounded by mountains. My husband and I can't stop talking about how incredible that moment was. I would highly recommend Talkeenta Air Taxi to anyone looking for a glacier flight. The staff is very friendly and helpful. They are extremely safety conscious and make you feel completely comfortable before boarding the plane. We can't wait to go back and visit again!

review_title: The Glacier Landing is a Must!
review_text: I started planning for our trip months in advance and was able to find a discount on their website.  I was nervous about booking so far in advance, but it turned out great. The people that work there are very patient and want you to have the best trip.  We were scheduled to go up in the early evening on a cloudy, somewhat rainy day.  We were able to talk to people who had just come back and see some of their photos.  We decided to take a chance and re-book for a few days later and see if we could get better weather.  It was a gamble, but it paid off.  The best part, they still charged us the same rate as if we had gone at our originally scheduled time.  This is a very expensive activity, but I'm glad we decided to do it...it was thrilling!  We had better weather the day we flew and Denali was out for a bit.  I was able to sit in the seat next to the door, which was great for taking pictures.  At first, I panicked because everything our pilot was narrating was on the other side of the plane, but he started turning the plane so that both sides got a turn to see what he was talking about.  The closer we got to the glacier and into the mountains, the bumpier the ride got.  We hit one air pocket that made everyone gasp.  I won't lie, it scared us a little!  But, our pilot was calm and navigated to smoother air.  We were able to land on a glacier and that was just awesome!  The views from the air are spectacular, but I cannot imagine doing this trip without the glacier landing.  Dress in layers, as it was actually pretty warm on the glacier (it was chilly in the plane, or I thought so sitting next to the door...it was a little drafty in that seat!).  If you don't have boots, they give you slip on booties to keep your shoes dry.  The only thing I would have wished for is a pilot with a little more interaction...he was probably our least favorite "guide" on our trip, but he got us there and back in one piece and that is the most important thing!  Definitely recommend this activity and see if you can find discounts if you are worried about the price.

I thought this would be a fun activity, but it was so much better than expected. Before boarding the 9-passenger plan, we were outfitted with glacier boots. It was an overcast day and the first 10 minutes were fairly unremarkable. Then we got above the cloud cover and within minutes we were flying between and above mountain peaks with breathtaking views of the glaciers below. It was a bit of a rush because at times we flew very close to the mountains, which added to the excitement, but nothing compared to experience of landing on a glacier. 
When we exited the plane, it was as if we were on another planet. The silence alone was an awesome experience. We had the opportunity to walk around and our party engaged in a snowball fight. Just standing on the glacier so high up was unbelievable, but the actual landing and takeoff was a bit of an adrenaline rush. 
During the flight passengers wear head phones because it's really loud up there, and this is the only way you can hear the pilot. I believe there are less expensive trips available that don't include a glacier landing, but this is not the place to be frugal. Definitely do the glacier landing because you'll never forget get.  It truly is an experience of a lifetime.
There are so many great things in Alaska that I can't say this is the best, but it is certainly close.  Landing on a glacier is incredible, but the flight was just as good.

review_title: Most impressive flight I've been on
review_text: The Grand Denali Flight-seeing tour remains to be one of the most amazing experiences I've had. Seeing glaciers from the road or ground is one thing, but from above is something completely out of this world, not to mention Denali itself. Their pilots are skilled and professional. The office staff are fun and cheerful to talk to. I highly recommend flying with TAT if you're in Talkeetna.

It has been my dream to visit Talkeetna for years and to live In Alaska. My husband and children made the plunge and moved to Delta Junction, AK 4 months ago. So my husband planned a fantastic trip to Talkeetna for our 14 year Anniversary and booked a flight seeing tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi on Dec. 1st. 

I am still so amazed at the beauty , the snow covered mountains and wild lands. This was absolutely the highlight of our stay! Our pilot and owner of Talkeetna Air Taxi, Paul, took us up on a beautiful clear bright day. Paul was very knowledgeable with the surrounding area and described what we were seeing in detail. He made sure to make plenty of turns so both of us can see the sites out our windows and get excellent pictures. 

Right when we walked in we were warmly greeted by the awesome staff and made sure we were well taken care of. 

This flight tour made my whole year! And I'll be back this summer :)

review_title: The Highlight of our Alaska Trip
review_text: We cruised from Vancouver through the inside passage, kayaked in Seward, flew to Seldovia and more...but nothing was more amazing and indelibly memorable than our glacier landing with Talkeetna Air Taxi. It felt like some otherworldly privilege. We had the good fortune of having a mostly sunny early July day, with clear views of Mt. Denali, so that definitely contributed. But, regardless, I'd highly recommend this trip to anyone. Landing on a glacier under the looming peaks of Denali is a once in a lifetime experience.
Took off on time. Flight was smooth. Pilot very knowledgeable about the range. Denali must be experienced from above

Having read so many excellent reviews about this experience, we decided to give it a go.
