The team at Talkeetna Air Taxi was extremely helpful and even managed to get us exactly on the aircraft we wanted to, despite it being a very busy day. The flight over Mt. Denali, the landing and the experience on the glacier was fantastic. On top we were lucky since there was not a cloud in the sky and we even gathered a seat in the cockpit on the way back.

My friend and I arrived in Alaska to hike Kesugi Ridge and Denali. We booked our flight the year prior for the discount. We also decided to do it at the beginning of our trip in case of bad weather and the opportunity to reschedule if need be.

I am not sure how it happened. Maybe they wanted to fill the last two seats on the flight but somehow unbeknownst to us, our flight package was upgraded at no additional cost. Thank you, TAT!

The views of the passes, mountain tops, glaciers was absolutely amazing. Our pilot was very knowledgeable. He told us the history, taught us geology and made sure everyone got the view no mattter what side of the plane they sat on. He pointed out the landmarks and answered our questions. The landing was smooth. Walking on the glacier up to your knees in snow quickly made us warm.

Our flight made us appreciate the views and have a better understanding of what we saw when hiking Kesugi Ridge. Our flight greatly enhanced our hike.

Hint: If you want to ride in the copilot's seat

review_title: Flight from Talkeetna to Kahiltna Glacier for a Denali Climb
review_text:
For my Denali climb in June 2015, I took a flight from Talkeetna, AK to Kahiltna Glacier on Denali with TAT. This is specifically for climbers who are trying to climb Denali, not the sight seeing tours. There are only a few companies that provide this service in Talkeetna, 3 if I remember correctly. I heard good things about all of them. Our operator has a good long standing relationship with TAT, and that's why we used them for this purpose.

The pilot was courteous, the flight was smooth and the view was just spectacular! Check out the my video and photos. See for yourself.

Lastly, I had to store my gear bags for a couple of days. The people at TAT were so nice and they let me store them at their facility for free. I really appreciate their kindness and trust. I had a fascinating conversation with Tom, a staff member there, who is from Minnesota. He grew up with Lonnie Dupre, the first person who solo summited Denali in January,2015!!! It is a tremendous accomplishment! 

Overall, great people, smooth flight, and stunning view!

review_title: Loved every second of the trip.
review_text: We read that this was a "must do" and it certainly was. We were lucky that the sun came out in the afternoon. I could have stayed up there all day (I took a Bonine beforehand just in case). This is a very well organized operation. The pilots are skilled and the views are just stunning.

review_title: A MUST-DO for Denali National Park
review_text: A great way to view Denali! Flying among these snow-crested peaks was absolutely breathtaking. I felt like I was watching a National Geographic documentary, because we were right there! We landed on Pika glacier, which was another incredible experience. Our pilot was funny and provided an informative and extensive tour of the area. Thanks for an experience we will never forget!

review_title: Stunning views, amazing flight and glacier landing!
review_text:
We had high hopes for this flight and they were met superbly. Check-in was well organised. We were asked if we could come in for a slightly earlier flight than booked on the day which was fine. Shoes were provided to give extra grip on the glacier. There was 8 passengers which filled up the plane and there were a few flights going at similar times. The flight was amazing, particularly as we got to the snow covered mountains. The wing perhaps slightly obstructs the view but not much, it was great. The pilot also gave us a little information about what we were passing by. I was spellbound by the scenery. It was a beautiful, cloudless day though the pilot did say that it is only that clear about 20% of days. Not long before landing there was some currents making it a bit bumpy so I think the 1 and a quarter hour return flight plus 30 minutes at the glacier was plenty. Landing on the snow covered glacier and getting out for a little walk near the plane was fun, and we enjoyed seeing other planes flying in and out. If you just take the bus trip through Denali (which is still good) you will not get views to match this.
I believe this company in Talkeetna is also slightly cheaper than getting a flight tour from Denali. Recommended!

Enjoyed a wonderful couple of hours flying all the way around Denali with family. Flew with 10 others. Every seat was by a window. Plane was cool but not uncomfortably cold. Headphones made it easy to hear pilot's directions and flight-seeing explanations. Took lots of photos. Glad we took our sunglasses but noticed that pairs were available to borrow if need be. Didn't get to make glacier landing due to newly fallen snow but flight was excellent. Pilot made sure to make at least two passes for most points of interest so that both sides of the plane had front row seats. Would fly with these folks again.

review_title: Absolutely stunning sight seeing flight around Mt Danali in a The high lightt of our Alaska vacation.
review_text: Absolutely stunning sight seeing flight around Mt Danali on a cloudless and unlimited visability day. This was the highlight of our Alaska Vacation.

review_title: The Most Incredible Activity I've Ever Experienced!
review_text:
BLOWN AWAY!

This was probably the coolest thing I have every done in my life. I can't thank Talkeetna Air Taxi enough.

The people in the office were such a big help in the booking process. Not only was getting all of the information I needed for the flight a breeze, they were also extremely helpful and forthcoming with information. While awaiting my flight, I heard other customers asking all sorts of questions... some relating to the flight, others just about Alaska in general. This being my first time in Alaska, I soaked all of this information in like a sponge and before I even boarded the plane I had already learned a lot about the Alaskan range.

Next was the flight. My pilot was Jonathan and he made me feel extremely informed and safe before boarding. I like to consider myself quite the outdoors-man/thrill seeker, but I had never been in a small plane before, nor one going into one of the tallest mountain ranges out there. I felt at ease and completely safe during my flight. Not only were the views literally INDESCRIBABLY incredible, but Jonathan narrated the whole flight. I was like a sponge again, gaining so much fascinating information about the Alaskan range and the area in general.

The weather was perfect for our flight so Jonathan informed us that we would be making the Glacier landing. I never have my heart race so much before. Before I knew it, we landed smoothly in the fresh powder and I was standing on a glacier on Denali. There have been few things I've experienced in my life that literally took my breath away. You can never truly understand how small you are until you are standing with these mountains towering around you.

While on the glacier Jonathan was quick to answer any questions about the glacier or anything relating to Alaska. He also took some pictures of me and my friend while on the glacier. One thing that I'd like to point out about this is as a hobby, I really enjoy photography. I can really appreciate when someone using my camera can frame and focus my camera correctly. Jonathan took some great pictures of both me and my friend. It's pretty cool when you pilot also is a great photographer, --bonus points there.

After our time on the glacier we finally got back to Talkeetna, and I was able to drool over all of the pictures I was able to take on this trip. This was truly one of greatest experiences of my life and I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi. Not only did they safely land me on a glacier in one of the most awe-inspiring places in the world, but the whole time they were always there to answer any questions I had. From the pilot to the office staff, everyone seemed to click like one big family. I plan to go back to Alaska with my wife next year, and I am totally doing this flight again with her!

5 Stars!

This is the best excursion we have ever taken!  The day was crystal clear and the mountain was beyond description - The white snow looked like whipped cream in places and cross-hatched with crevasses in others.  I make photo books of our travels, and this flight was so awesome that I made a book entirely of the photos of Mt. McKinley/Mt. Denali.  I recommending skipping something else if you need to in order to take this amazing flight.  Of course, if the weather is horrible and the mountain can't be seen on a particular day, allow time to try again the next day.  We were impressed with the people who work at the Taxi Service office - very friendly, organized and accommodating.  They seemed to enjoy their jobs and were excited for us to have the experience of the flight.  A fantastic experience!  Loved our pilot, Bob, who also clearly was happy to give us this amazing experience.

I've taken two trips to view Denali, both were awesome.  The Pilot was safety-minded and very knowledgable of the area.  On the first trip we landed on Ruth Glacier, on the second we landed at base camp, both were terrific.  They provided all the gear you need, boots etc.  It was the highlight of our trip.

review_title: NO better way to get there
review_text: We had the opportunity to land on a glacier on Denali with Talkeetna Air - fantastic from start to finish - a first class outfit and we had the time of our lives - thank you

Truly one of the best experiences.  A must do!!!   Definitely do the glacier landing it is well worth the money. Outstanding views you cannot get anywhere else.  Professional outfit and they even picked us up and dropped us off at our hotel.  Exceptional!!!!
we took an 1 1/2 hour trip around Mt. Denali with a glacier landing. Absolutely incredible! I highly recommend doing this. It is an experience you will never forget.

review_title: One of the most beautiful sights in my life
review_text: The trip to Denali on plane is not cheap. But if you have the money....DO IT!!! I also highly recommend doing a glacier landing! I got lucky and chose a day and time when there weren't too many clouds and the sun was out the entire time! Pictures and words do it no justice! You need to see it for yourself!

We had weather issues during our visit to Denali. Talkeetna Air Taxi worked with us to reschedule until later in the week. Even though we were not able to do our original tour that included a glacier land (again due to weather) we still had a great tour! The flight tour helped us to get "up close and personal" with the mountain. Our pilot, Alex, also pointed out places that were used by climbers. We also learned a lot about the around around Denali. It was a great trip!

Bingo! We came on perfect day for Mt. Denali viewing!  Martha was wonderful to deal with by text and was very patient & prompt in responding to our questions and giving us all the info we needed about the weather & flight. Everything was better than expected. The weather was rainy in Anchorage and Wassali, so we were worried, but in Talkeetna it was partly cloudy and perfect for viewing the mountain! Paul was a fantastic pilot, very expert, making sure each side of the plane got a commanding view of the Mt. Denali and surrounding mountains.  Highly recommend!

Our host Annie Duquette (base camp Annie ) was most accommodating on this excursion. If you desire a flight and landing on Denali ( formally Mt McKinley ) this is the way to go. They fly on the best days and their aircraft are the safest in the skies.. My two sons are still talking about this flight to the base camp level of Denali. Put it on your bucket list if it's not there already

The company is very good and professionally run. The weather played spoilsport when we visited but we were still able to get on a plane for flight seeing. The views of Ruth Glacier and Denali was breathtaking. We couldn't land on the glacier due to fog, which was a bummer. But even before we landed, the ladies at the front desk had spoken to Viator (our travel agent) to refund us part of the trip for not having the glacier landing. Overall, a great experience.

review_title: One of those Bucket List things
review_text:
I asked our son, who lives in Anchorage, what he would like to do, where he would like to go, while we visited him.  Maybe something he could not afford to do on his own.  After he thought about it for awhile - he's a thinker - he asked about maybe taking a "flightseeing" trio to view Denali.  Now, our whole family had taken the 8 hr bus trip into Denali more than 10 years ago.  But, we'd never done anything quite like this.  (Well, I had been in Honolulu once, by myself, just a long layover, and took a helicopter tour of Oahu.  :-))  I said Ok, I'd look into it.
I checked out the several companies, and decided on TAT because it just looked more established or settled.  And I liked the reviews given for it.
Well, flightsee we did, on a day that heavily veiled that big old mountain, but we had a MARVELOUS, UNFORGETTABLE time.  Landed on a glacier, the whole bit.  
Wonderful pilot Leigh!
I recommend for everyone!  YOLO!

Best thing yet. Beautiful clear day and first flight of the day. Flight was smooth and pilot very informative. The flight to Denali was amazing, words can't describe the majesty. Well worth the cost. Wish I had landed on the glacier. Next time a must.

Fabulous adventure, and so worth the price! TAT folks were incredibly generous with us, offering a free second flight on another day, since weather prevented the glacier landing on the first flight. It turned out to be a spectacular morning, so off we flew in a 5 passenger plane for a flight with clear views of the Denali summit and a landing on Three Points glacier. This is our second experience with TAT and we wouldnt fly with anyone else.

Eu e meu marido fizemos a viagem de avião de Talkeetna ate geleiras e o Monte McKinley. Nunca vi nada tão deslumbrante! Reservei pela internet e tudo funcionou perfeitamente! O piloto era otimo. Recomendo

Two buddies and I flew with TAT on a cloudy day when McKinley was hidden from view.  TAT, because they are IFR rated, were able to find the safe route to Ruth glacier and land; allowing us to walk on the glacier for about 20 minutes.  What a great experience.  
However, when we got back to Talkeetna and were to pay for the flight, I experienced some discomfort because the clerk made several mistakes in calculating the charges.  She had forgotten to clear a previous credit card charge.  So, if I had not checked the receipt, I would have paid 2X for the flight.  It got corrected, but only because I was a careful consumer.

review_title: READ THIS REVIEW BEFORE PLANNING YOUR TRIP!!!
review_text:
I had always thought these trips were too expensive, and probably not worth it - thus passing on several opportunities.  This trip we went ahead and booked one, and then tried over several days to actually make the trip, as the weather was preventing flying - pushing the trip back further and further.  We almost cancelled rather than drive two hours (one way) to make a final attempt, but things looked good - so we went for it, and got in the air.

Once in a lifetime is an over-used phrase.  In this case, it is absolutely spot on!  I won't spoil it by giving you details of things that can't adequately be described with words, and instead will give advice...

Weather can be particularly uncooperative for these trips, so it's best to schedule your overall trip to allow many attempts at getting in the air.  The staff is amazingly capable and willing to work with you to get you into the air when you can, but you want to give them lots of chances if your scheduled attempt fails.

Make sure your camera and phone batteries are charged.

Layer your clothing so that you can be wrapped up like the kid in A Christmas Story, or shirtless like the crazy kid on our trip.  You can never be sure what will be best.

Wear waterproof shoes, but they don't need to be perfect.  They have shoe covers if you need them.  Bring good sunglasses.

Pee before you get on the plane

Be prepared to spend time in Talkeetna waiting for your flight if the weather is bad.  There's lots to see and do.

We got excellent weather after days of rain and snow, absolutely worth the price. TAT employees were great to deal with on the phone and in person.  I'd waited 11 years to come back to AK and see Denali from the air.

Мне все понравилось! Летали в составе: 1 -пилот и 3 пассажира. Сидели очень плотно - плечо к плечу, но так мне было даже спокойнее. Облетали вокруг МакКинли на достаточно приличной высоте. Делали фото. Потом приземлились на ледник, прогулялись и в обратный путь. Советую попробовать, все безопасно, кто не знает- такие маленькие винтовые самолетики безопаснее "больших птиц", потому как на них можно в аварийном случае планировать)

We did the grand Denali unfortunately couldn't do the glacier landing due to weather. 
We flew for 90 minutes and it was absolutely fantastic I would say it had to be the highlight of our trip. 
The plane ride was very smooth and the views were outstanding.

review_title: Great company but weather did not cooerate
review_text: We arranged the Grand Denali tour with the Glacier landing  with Talkeetna air taxi. Unfortunately, the weather did not cooperate.  Instead we ended up with a 1 hour tour of a glacier and a portion of the Denali mountain range which was not in the clouds.  Our pilot, Mike, took us through very clear set of safety instructions.  He did an excellent job of taking us into the mountain range with great views, and we never felt in danger.  the flight was smooth. We would have liked a longer flight and closer view of Mt. McKinley, but the pilot exercised solid judgment and caution in limiting us to areas that were safe to fly. Take off, the flight and landing were all smooth.  Views, even under the windy circumstances, were excellent.  I have no hesitation in recommending this company for a tour of the Mt. McKinley range.

The whole experience was wonderful from pick-up, flight, accommodating a large group of 12, exciting views and professionalism.  Leigh was most accommodating and made everyone in the plane feel very comfortable with flying in a small plane among the glaciers, sheer cliffs and mountains.  The landing on the glacier was perfect!  The weather was perfect!  The landings were smooth and Leigh was a gracious tour guide.  Thanks!  Would recommend this to anyone in the area wanting a fun experience from the air and ground.

Our group of ten had an outstanding 2 hour flight this morning.  We did the Grand Denali tour with a glacier landing.  The entire flight was extremelu enjoyable and fascinating.  Craig was our pilot and did a fabulous job.  He was very knowledgeable about the area and the Denali park.  The flight was extremely smooth - yes we were blessed by some of the best weather of the year, but still Craig's skill contributed to the smooth flight.  I highly recommend this tour if you are anywhere close to the Talkeentna area.

We flew with Talkeetna Air on Aug. 31st. The plane was great, the scenery was awesome, but the pilot made it all worthwhile. He was exceptionally knowledgable and was an awesome pilot making sure everyone on the plane had a great view. The landing on the glacier was fantastic. I would highly recommend the company to fly with.

We had perfect weather and a perfect flightseeing tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi. Our pilot, Jonathan, was very informative and checked with the passengers frequently to make sure we were all comfortable. The landing on Tokositna glacier was so smooth it was like landing on feathers. Linda, Margaret, and all the front desk people were extremely pleasant and helpful. What an amazing experience! Thank you.

When weather permits, Talkeetna Air Taxi offers flights around Denali and glacier landings in a single engine plane. That allows you to get a close up view of the Alaska Range, nearby glaciers, and, of course, Denali.  The glacier landing is optional, but you should take this option.  The pilot lowers skis for the landing and takeoff on the glacier, and you can walk around for about 15 minutes to look at the surrounding mountains.  The scenery is great, and the trip lasts for about 90 minutes.

review_title: Great way to end our Alaska trip
review_text: We did the Glacier landing trip with Talkeetna Taxi. It is probably the best part of our Alaska trip. I changed our flight time, multiple times while I was planning the trip and the staff worked with me patiently. The day we did took our tour was pefect, bright and sunny. My 5 year old was scared initially when he had to sit by himself. But he did fine later on and slept until we landed. The 15 mins on the Glacier was fabulous and we saw another flight land there while we were there. Now that we are back home, my son asks us to play some Alaska National Geographic type videos on Amazon Prime and it feels great when he is reminded of our trip when he sees the aerial shots of Alaska. Our pilot was not a chatty one, but I guess that is ok. Overall even though the tour s expensive, I highly recommend it. As some other reviewer had mentioned, you wont remember the money you spent for the tour, but the memories you made will last for a lifetime
We had to wait for the skies to clear, but we had a great flight all around Denali and a super landing on a huge glacier, a highlight of our trip.

Le jour de ma réservation il faisait très mauvais. Nous sommes passé à l'agence et il m'ont tout de suite remboursé les 100$ que j'avais versé en acompte, sans poser de questions.Je regrette de ne pas l'avoir fait (le survol du Denali et glacierlanding), ça valait certainement le coup.

This was the highlight of our trip to Alaska! The flight to the glacier had amazing views and the pilot was very knowledgeable. Landing on the glacier was like no other experience I have ever had. The area is remote and beautiful. You've never been anywhere like it. Definitely do this if you are anywhere near Talkeetna on your trip! Well worth it.
Great service, friendly pilots, riding a seaplane iS a must do experience.   Strong recommendation to sTop and take in the scenery

We are a family of four with two teenagers and were quite nervous about doing this on a small plane, however it was the highlight of our alaskan adventure. The weather was just fantastic and we didnt feel any bumps whatsoever, the pilot also was relaxed and knew exactly what he was doing, we had about 20 mins whilst on the galcier and my daughter got to ride back in the cockpit on the way back which was a thrilling experience for her. The glacier landing experience is just unforgettable and from someone who flies around the world for a living, i would say this is on the top of my list.

review_title: Highlight of any trip to Alaska!
review_text: On a pristine sunny day, this trip is not to be missed!  Even on a cloudy day I am sure this trip would be a highlight!  Yes, it is expensive but there are sometimes discounts for the Glacier Landing component online, and the trip is worth every penny as it is so beautiful. Try to be the one to volunteer to be the co-pilot!

review_title: One of the highlights of our trip!
review_text:
This Past July, my wife and I took our first trip to South-central Alaska with our sixteen-year-old son and ten-year-old daughter. It was a dream vacation & possibly a once-in-a-lifetime trip. We had only two weeks in Alaska, but were determined to cram a lot of adventure into that time via RV (Great Alaskan Holiday). We fished with Alaska Saltwater Charters in Seward to start, spent a few days in Denali National Park (at Teklanika_River Campground = awesome), landed on a glacier in Denali National Park (with Talkeetna Air Taxi = really cool), hiked a glacier (the Ice Fall Trek on Matanuska Glacier with MICA Guides = top 3 adventures on this trip), drove through Wrangell St. Elias National Park & toured Kenecott Mines, and kayaked among icebergs with Pangaea out of Valdez, AK (top 3 adventures on this trip).

It was an unforgettable vacation, and a definite high point was our Grand Denali w/ glacier landing trip with Talkeetna Air Taxi. The weather wasn't cooperating the day that we originally booked our trip for, but Talkeetna Air Taxi was very accomodating and rebooked us for another day that fit in our very busy itinerary (and we're very grateful that they did). The views of the mountains, glacial rivers and the up close and personal view of the glacier that we landed on was an absolutely incredible experience.

We highly recommend this Alaskan adventure!

review_title: Expensive trip, good view, bad weather
review_text:
We took the flight tour to Denali / McKinley, and it was a good experience. At first, we were a little worried that we won't be able to see anything because the weather was very smokey and cloudy, but Talkeetna Air Taxi told us that we were good to go. The pilot was knowledgeable, the flight there was pleasant, and we saw many great views. Around McKinley, however, it was very cloudy. We can see it up close, but a bit further, a lot of the views were blocked, which was very disappointing.

We had a glacier landing, where we got off the plane, wandered around in the snow, and took many awesome pictures for 20-30 minutes. One visitor is designated the copilot on the way there, sitting next to the pilot up front. After the stopping point, another visitor got a chance to be copilot, so that part was fun. Coming back, the views are pretty much the same.

Overall, we paid $300-400 per person for the flight. Did we see great things? Yes, it was fantastic. Was it worth $400? I'm not too sure. Maybe if the weather was better...I appreciate Talkeetna Air Taxi's policy of a full refund if the weather was bad, but I think we caught the worst weather that's still flyable, so it was still a good experience, but for that price, I wish it was better.

Well this was a luxury for us as it is pricey. However, great service, great tour, great view and nice staff. If you ate coming to Alaska this is a must! Amazing. Bring your own throw up bag and a great camera.

This is a great excursion if you want a birds eye view of Denali.  There were some concerns about whether we would be able to land on a glacier due to weather but they made it happen!  They work with your schedule as much as possible which was really nice.  

On a separate note, if you are prone to air sickness or ear popping, be prepared to feel a little off- at least I did.  I don't know that I could do this tour again just because of my own issues but I'm glad I did it once!  The views and being up in the mountains among the glaciers was really surreal and so peaceful.  Kids enjoyed and husband got to sit in the cockpit with pilot.

If there is one part of Alaska you should not miss, it is an air trip around Mt. McKinley and all the amazing peaks surrounding.  I cannot even explain in words how majestic this was.  These are views you wont get anywhere else.  Honestly, it looks like a different planet in those mountains!

Stating the obvious is the scenery & experience is fabulous! But to help my fellow traveler decide what company to use or is it worth the $, I offer this: FLY with TAT! From the bookings via online to confirm flight tour to rescheduling for 4 days due to poor weather their staff & customer service is awesome! We booked the grand denali tour & ended up doing the least expensive tour w/glacier landing (because of weather) and was not disappointed. We didnt fly around Denali but we got to see it from the air (and only time we did see it during our trip). We left feeling like staff at TAT were new friends!

The weather cooperated for my trip and Mt McKinley (Denali) was visible and beautiful.  I felt very safe with our pilot, and even got a ride in the cockpit on the way back.  There are no words to describe the incredible feeling when you first step out of the plane!

I took the MT McKinley tour with glacier landing and it was one of the highlights of Alaska trip. Out pilot was very skilled and kept us at ease. The landing was smooth and we loved the time at the glacier. Awesome views and I took tons of photos to savor. I will try Grand Denali tour or McKinley peak tour next time.
This is a first class operation. Easy to book and easy to work with.  We were hampered by cloudy, rainy weather.  They re-scheduled our flight and kept us up to date about the weather delays.

This is a once in a lifetime activity you need to do.  I was actually terrified to do this but, it was great.  We were on  a plane that was full with 10 people including the pilot.  Beautiful views of the mountains and landing on the glacier.  The hour and half was enough time but it goes by quickly.

Paul was out pilot and he did a fantastic job of showing off Mt McKinley!  I was a little hesitant to do this flight as I thought it would be much rougher and bumpy.  It was very smooth!  It seemed like Paul maneuvered are plane so close to the mountains that you felt as though you could touch them.  Wonderful trip, so glad we did this as it was one of the highlights of our trip! Highly recommended!

We initially debated between landing on the glacier or just taking a tour.Finally we decided to do the landing on the glacier ...it was "awesome".Its a MUST DO thing if you are around talkeetna. The experience of walking on the glacier and spending time on the glacier is a life time experience(atleast for us).It was so beautiful -you have to see it !! 
Our pilot made our trip even more fun!!!!.She knew the place well-explained everyone about denali, the mountains..... the flight even though was small-was not all bumpy,the landing on the glacier was awesome..kudos to her flying skills.
The sparkling blue water ,mountains and forest were spectacular.

review_title: Grand Denali Tour with glacier landing
review_text: On all the reviews of this type of tour, in all the brochures I picked up about Denali at different places, it said "on a clear day, drop everything you're doing, spend the money, and go on this tour". I wavered between skipping it because it's expensive, skipping the glacier landing to save nearly $200, or just going for it. Well, we decided we were just going to go for it. This was one of the best decisions we've made. This tour was 100% once in a lifetime incredible. We weaved in and out of all the mountain peaks and the summit of Mount Mckinley. I didn't know how much I'd love landing on a glacier until we actually did it. Afterall, we'd already driven all the way from Seward where we had seen multiple glaciers on a day cruise, hiked up to exit glacier, and saw even more glaciers on the drive up. What's another glacier? It's completely different when you are up in these incredible mountains near the summit of Mt. Mckinley. This tour made this trip, the trip of a lifetime. Believe the reviews. If you make it that far all the way to Talkeetna, Alaska from wherever you traveled from (for us thousands of miles), don't cheap out now! Bite the bullet, eat granola bars and pbjs the rest of your trip if you have to, and do this tour!!!!!!
This was a wonderful experience and we felt quite safe flying to the glacier where we set down and walked around in the snow. The views are excellent and beautiful.
You can take air taxi to look around the Denali National Park. Must take it. It is very comfortable, no need to worry about motion sickness

My husband and I took the Grand Denali tour early August during our wedding anniversary trip to Alaska. We were really lucky as it was a sunny, beautiful day which is a little rare in August. We had a pleasant experience right from check-in till the end of the trip. A special mention to our pilot Richard - the glacier landing was pretty smooth! Also, he did not rush us while we were on the glacier clicking some beautiful pictures. And yes this was indeed the highlight of our trip as they promised! Thank you guys for this wonderful experience.
What an adventure! Seeing Mt McKinley up close & personal was the highlight of our Alaskan experience. We highly recommend this flight.

WOW!!  De Haviland Beaver flight with glacier landing was phenomenal  experience.  Our pilot was a seasoned professional (also flew with doctors without borders) who had a great touch with this classic plane.  Landing on a glacier and being able to walk around where few people had been before was a superb time. Was much more fun than the bus ride into Denali.

Nine of us went up with Richard and we had such a great time!  The views were awesome and the glacier landing was amazing.  The people are definitely the best.  From the minute they picked us up from the hotel until they dropped us off at our next adventure we felt like we were among good friends.  Go....you won't be disappointed!

This company is amazing.  The weather in August is not great and they changed our reservation three times so we could fly on a sunny day and always made it clear we could opt out for a full refund. We didn't make it to the north side of Denali but the views and the glacier landing were amazing!  An experience of a lifetime!!!

review_title: Highlight of a magnificent trip to Alaska
review_text: I really wanted to see Denali. I didn't want to endure a long bus ride to do it. We opted to take a flight-see with a glacier landing on the Routh Glacier. We circled the mountain before landing --- 3 of the 4 mountain faces were visible. Our pilot explained several of the glacier formations and pointed out interesting sites on the way up to the mountain. We were flying in a DeHaviland Otter with the original engine --- it took awhile to gain altitude. Landing on the glacier was worth the additional cost --- it gave us the ability to really enjoy looking at the grandeur and scale that is Alaska. This was our favorite excursion of our trip.

Must do glacier landing. All the sights you see are amazing. Alex was great. All the staff were great. Smooth process moved right along. Great parking. Amazing awesome inspiring can't say enough good about this company and the experience of a lifetime!!  THANK YOU!!!

I am not a fan of small closed spaces and the price was definitely more than what we were expecting when we initially planned to go for a glacier landing, But apart from that I felt the trip was worth the price. 
We did have to wait for a while after we showed up for a plane to become available . 
The ride was a bit bumpy , but the pilot kept talking to us throughout and kept reassuring us. 
The views and the scenery were fantastic. After the plane lands and the pilot turns of the engine, there is only you and the mountains. I felt overwhelmed by the sheer size of the  mountains and the beautiful scenery around us.

review_title: Spectacular Scenery and Glacier Landing Adventure
review_text: My husband and I booked the flight with a landing on a glacier. We drove 2.5 hours down from Denali in terrible weather and were concerned that the flight would be canceled. The staff couldn't have been nicer and assured us that the flight would go as scheduled and explained how and where the weather was improving. The flight was incredible and our pilot, Chris, was fantastic. The flight was worth every penny. I highly recommend the glacier landing. It's an adventure we will never forget.

Top Notch!  Did the McKinley Tour.  Views were beyond incredible.  Pilot Chris was engaging and interesting; let each of our kids ride shotgun during each trip.  Landing on the glacier with skis was awesome.  Very expensive, but glad we did it.

We were very lucky to have great weather allowing for amazing views of Denali.  I am not a fan of small planes and we did not land on a glacier and I am glad as I was scared.  But the flight and views were truly amazing and worth the view.  The bush pilots were in constant communication with each other sharing info and such (you could here it) and you knew these folks were experienced and safe.  Use a coupon from teh Alaska Tour book (we bought at the supermarket) and saved 100$

This was a great experience and one we are really glad we did, even though expensive.  Would definitely recommend it.  The sights are so amazing that it is hard to believe they are real!  Pilot extremely knowledgeable and staff very helpful.

review_title: This was wonderful. The trip was exactly as advertised.  We flew taround the Alaskan Range, Mt Mckinley  (Denali) and la
review_text: Awesome! The pilot made certain each side of the plane saw everything. Landing on a glacier was exciting. Beauty surrounded us. Cannot use enough superlatives to describe this trip.

Once you decide to fly around Mt McKinley - you have several choices around Talkeetna - K2, Sheldon and others. We flew K2 on the first day. We were so enamored by the mountains that we decided to pay another visit in a couple of days and fly these folks. What an amazing experience. The service staff was super accommodating and friendly. The pilot was simply amazing. She answered every silly question of our two kids with unwavering zeal and sincerity. It was one of the best experiences of our Alaska trip. The mountain is great and the glacier landing was fun - we all know that. But i think the TAT folks made the experience way more special compared to other folks in town.

review_title: Thank you for accommodating our last minute plans!
review_text:
Our family of 3 was driving from Denali to Anchorage for an evening flight back to Texas. Mt. McKinley was at its incredible best without a cloud in sight. I had researched Talkeetna Taxi before, read the great TA reviews but decided we did not need to add anything more to our already ambitious itinerary. BUT McKinley looked too good to pass up. I called the Talkeetna office about 30 minutes out of Talkeetna. Their only space was too late in the afternoon for us to make our flight plans. Put us on hold, called Paul ( hope I remember his name correctly) who was spending the day with his family, and he flew us out about an hour and half later! 

So, my review is that this is an incredible company, top notch pilots and an experience that will be the highlight of our trip. Thank you Talkeetna Air Taxi!

We had a great experience with Talkeetna Air Taxi, from the scheduling phone call, the pickup service, the front desk ladies, the pilot. Trip up and landed on the glacier. Yea we know its alot of $$$, but if your here and the weather permits, DO IT!!! It is well worth it, Just WOW !

I need to give this trip and our pilot a 10, it was amazing view, the weather was so good, pilot go around the Mt. Mackincly make sure we can view all the glacier and surrounding mountain, you are on top of the world, when we land at glacier, it feel like a dream, hard to describe it unless you experience it, this is a must do tour, our pilot is so professional, we really had a great time.

We did the tour with a glacier landing. The weather wasn't very good so we were delayed a couple hours, but we are fine with pilots delaying because of weather!!  No need to take chances. The experience was so awesome!  We did this on our first day in Alaska and it was a great start. My only complaint would be that the pilot or the front office or somebody should make sure that the copilots seat does not get occupied by 2 people from the same group. There were 9 passengers on our plane. There were 2 guys who were together and they each got the front seat. One out to the glacier, the other on the way back.  My husband would have loved to have sat there, as perhaps would someone from the other group with us. It was really rude of those 2 to take it both ways and they clearly had it planned. The pilot did say, at the outset "whoever would like the copilot seat, get on first".  I just know that we did a helicopter flight in Hawaii and since the helicopter sat 4 passengers and there were only 3 window seats, whoever got the (great) co pilot seat, the other member of their party got the no window seat. We're all paying lots of money, don't be a tool and hog the best spot both ways.  
Other than those jerks, landing and standing on a glacier was truly awesome. 
On more thing, we were in Denali for 3 days and never got even a glimpse of Mt. McKinley. And apparently that's not uncommon. But we had fun with all of our outings regardless.  Just don't get your hopes up!

We used TAT for a Denali trip this past June, but we have used them in the past for flight seeing as well. There are other pilots and companies, but Paul at TAT is the best. Their new Otter is wonderful. Make this a must see for your Alaska vacation. It will be the best part of your trip.

Me and my husband did the base camp tour with glacier landing. We flew in a small plan which had a capacity for 6 people (every one had a window seat) and we enjoyed the majestic views of the mountains including Mt. McKinley and then the pilot landed us on the Ruth glacier. This tour is an expensive one but it is worth it. This is once in a life time experience so do not miss it.
Incomparable experiencia la de sobrevolar el monte McKinley añadida al aterrizaje sobre el inmenso glaciar Ruth. Inolvidable, un recuerdo para toda la vida.
Flying with TAT gave us the most wonderful way to experience the mountain up close and personal.  Have wonderful photos which I shall treasure.  Thanks TAT

This was the highlight of our Alaska trip. We flew a DeHavilland Otter which has room for 9 and everyone gets a window seat. This flight takes us really close to McKinley and gives us fantastic views of the mountain including all the glaciers that start from it. When we went the weather was fantastic and we got to land on the glacier as well. I highly recommend the glacier landing as part of the package. It is totally worth it. The pilot (Craig) was fairly chatty throughout the flight and described most of the scenery for us including a few tidbits on the history of the park. Overall it was a great experience and I highly recommend it for anyone travelling to Alaska.

review_title: Spectacular Way To See Mt McKinley
review_text: We took the helicoptor tour which was absolutely the best tour I have ever taken. It is pricey, but you get an up close and personal view of the mountain as well as the glaciers. It is like going to a different planet. You just cannot really see Mt McKinley from a distance and appreciate what it is like at the top. Do the tour by plane or helicoptor, you will be glad you did. You can choose a plane tour that lands on a glacier or one that does not land on a glacier. The helicoptor's cannot land on the glaciers because of government regulations but I have stood on ice and snow before. The advantage to the helicoptor tour is that you can hover over special areas whereas a plane has to keep moving. The helcoptor can also fly much lower and closer to the ground and mountains.

review_title: we always send our visitors here
review_text: As Alaska residents, we rely on TAT to provide the best customer service and a safe and enjoyable flight.  We base this on personal experience over years of flying.  We were able to accompany our most recent guests on their scenic flight.  The desk staff are cheerful and get everyone organized in an efficient and helpful way. The pilot was excellent and knew about geology, history, current climbing activities and provided photo opportunities for everyone on the plane.  It was a once in a lifetime experience for our visitors and they said they will never forget it.

I called Talkeetna air the morning of me deciding that I would like to fly around Mt. McKinley and Martha was so nice and accommodating. She got me the flight that I wanted and it was the highlight of my trip.  Nikko, who picked me up was friendly and helpful too.  All the employees were all nice and professional.  Just a "feel good" environment from everyone.  I took the Grand Denali tour with glacier landing and I cannot recommend this enough, simply jaw dropping.

Nice and friendly staff. Our pilot tho wasn't really talkative. Views were amazing and plane really goes close to the mountains! We had the luck to be able to land on top the the tallest glaciers of Denali National Park. (Prior planes couldn't land due to lack of visibility...)

I really recommend it!

We have experienced a number of scheduled trips with this organization and find them to be above and beyond.  They are so willing to work with you if the weather isn't "just right" for Denali viewing or glacier walks.  We would recommend them to anyone visiting the area

review_title: A once-in-a-lifetime must-do! Thanks Talkeetna Air Taxi
review_text: This tour was recommended by the folks we rented a cabin from and it turned out to be exceptional. The staff was super friendly; the pilot was friendly and very knowledgeable. The flight itself was amazing. I knew we'd get fairly close to Denali but not THAT close. Super cool. We took a family of six ranging from 12-55 and all enjoyed it. We took the 75 minute tour without a glacier landing and it was plenty long enough that we felt like we got our money's worth. We felt like we were in good hands from the moment we arrived. Highly recommend.

We did the Grand Denali + Glacier landing tour. This is a MUST DO if you want to see Mt. Denali. The staff is knowledgeable and friendly. Our pilot was super sweet and did a great job of explaining things during the flight and giving ample opportunities for photos in the air. We also did the glacier landing, which was well worth the extra cost. This was a highlight of our trip to Alaska! Highly recommended!
This is a must if you are in the area. Amazing sights I will never forget. A professional company who are friendly, safety conscious and experienced - brilliant!

Was treated to a flightseeing experience by Talkeetna Air Taxi that shattered my expectations.  Landing on a glacier after mountain pass flying through the Alaskan Range was a once-in-a-lifetime experience.  Pilot Michael expertly navigated the peaks and made a smooth landing on a tributary of Ruth Glacier.  Save this for your last Alaskan excursion; the bar will be set extremely high!
The view was amazing and our pilot made the ride very enjoyable. We were not originally scheduled to land on the glacier but I'm glad we did.  It was a very surreal experience.

Did a flightseeing tour which included a glacier landing in Ruth Glacier and had a fantastic time. Yes, it's not cheap, but trips like this never are (I've done a similar one to Grand Canyon) and it's a "once in a lifetime" opportunity to see Mount Denali up close. The flight+landing took 2 hours - we left on time and the staff member-pilot was great at giving us information about what we were seeing. The glacier landing was fantastic - such a stunning location! Had a great time and would recommend to anyone passing through Talkeetna.
great service. always ready to fly. of course there are a limited number of options, but they take good care of you

review_title: View Mt McKinley and glaciers from an airplane
review_text: First of all, the views you get from an airplane will take your breath away.  When you land on the glacier and get out and walk on the glacier, it is otherworldly.  Do not hesitate to walk into the little building at the airport and book this trip.. Everyone I dealt with was kind, courteous and helpful.

It was cloudy and rainy in Talkeetna but once we got to the mountain it was beautiful. Although we got to see the majority of the range and had a great landing, we were unable to see the summit. Highly recommended!
If you go to see Glaciers, this is a must do. Our pilot, Danielle, was experienced and put our minds at ease with a perfect landing on the glacier. The views are breathtaking.

review_title: You need to drive past K2 for the best flight
review_text: I cannot think any part of the flight for our family of 5 to view Mt McKinley and to land on and walk on the Glacier that did not equal or exceed my expectations. The vistas were breathtaking. The flight and landings were smooth and the pilot, Andy, was engaging and reassuring as to our safety. I highly recommend.
Best trip we ever took. Great service, awesome pilot. Very smooth flight and landings. Awesome scenery. All over all best trip ever!

review_title: Gorgeous and unique. Dont let motion sickness stop you.
review_text: great trip. expensive but worth it; absolutely stunning view!! Buy some ginger gum there if you get motion sick. It works

Foi o ponto alto do nosso passeio no Alaska. Simplesmente magnífico. Fomos em um dia bastante limpo, pois quando está com neblina não deve ser tão bonito. Foi perfeito, avião estável, quase não balança. É bem caro, mas vale cada doleta.
Amazing flight over the great gorge of Ruth glacier and the whole McKinley montain. Beatiful views, safe plane and kind and confidence pilt.

My husband & I took the Grand Denali with a Glacier Landing flight this morning. Quite a way to celebrate my husbands 45th birthday. Not sure how to top this experience. It was nothing short of a perfect day. Our pilot Dave was AWESOME, the flight & his knowledge were amazing. Wish I had a recording of all of the info he provided. If you only do one thing in Alaska, this has to that one thing. Worth every penny :) Thank you TAT!!
Walked on and wrote my name on a glacier!  Great trip!  Pilot was friendly.  Recommend taking this trip.

Nachdem das Wetter überraschend gegen Abend aufklarte und "der Berg" aus den Wolken kam, haben wir kurzfristig einen Rundflug gebucht. Personal war sehr kooperativ und speditiv. Wundervolles Erlebnis:

We don't usually spend this kind of money (about $550 for 2) on an hour and an half activity, but this was well worth it.  My husband and I were in a tiny plane with just the pilot to fly over the south face of Mt. McKinley.  We paid extra for the landing on the glacier, which was so cool, very soft landing and neat to walk around there.  It was the highlight of our trip.  Our pilot, Will, was great.

We had an amazing flight with TAT yesterday. If you don't do this while in Alaska, you are not truly seeing the scale, beauty and majesty of these mountain ranges and Mt McKinley.  To be in a plane, flying in among the peaks, through valleys and over glaciers and then landing on a glacier is a breathtaking and overwhelming experience that you will not forget!

review_title: Glacier Landing is worth every Penny!
review_text:
My entire family did the 8:30AM South Face McKinley tour with the glacier landing. It was the highlight of our Alaskan vacation and the landing was worth it. You don't get the complete perspective for how giant McKinley is until you land. Also, if you want great photos, the glacier landing was the way to get those!  Our pilot was great and the place seems well run.

A few tips: Plan the flightseeing tour earlier in your trip in case weather doesn't cooperate. And if the weather is going to be good, first thing in the morning might actually be the best option. The weather was perfect the day we went (very rare), and even by 10AM, more clouds were forming around the mountain. As they told us, the mountain generates its own weather.

We chose the shortest trip length since we have a 5 year old who wasn't too interested in the airplane flight. But kids going into 1st grade will appreciate the flight. Little ones were more interested in throwing snowballs.

The people at Talkeetna Air Taxi were wonderful. The experience was awesome. We took the plane ride on the south of Mt. McKinley/Denali and landed on a glacier. Craig, the pilot, was great. He did a great job of narrating the trip. The landings and takeoffs were smooth. Thanks Craig. My wife and I really appreciate the great experience.

review_title: One of the most amazing things I have done
review_text: I had an awesome trip with Talkeetna Air Taxi. I was the only non-climber on the plane. Landed at the Base camp and circled Danali. The day was spectacular - not a loud in the sky. Everyone was friendly and the 1959 Beaver airplane worth the trip.  If you are lucky enough to get clear weather this is an amazing trip. Well worth the money.  Don't miss this opportunity.

I had the privilege to go on a Base Camp flight including Glacier landing on 20th July with an amazing pilot Leigh.  It was definitely the highlight of my 6 week holiday.  Denali shone for us.   The weather was stunning, views beyond belief, but what made the trip was Leigh - her friendliness, knowledge, and obvious delight in flying along with her fun attitude was infectious. I would thoroughly recommend TAT to anyone - their communication from booking to end of flight was exemplary.  Definitely a must do!
great guide. Views of McKinley and surrounding glaciers were breath taking   Guide very knowledgable of geology of area and  history of the area. Worth every penny and minute

review_title: Our TAT trip was a highlight
review_text:
When I researched TA about our AK trip, many people said that Denali flightseeing and glacier landing was a highlight of their trip.  I agree 100%.  I am very happy with our Talkeetna Air Taxi flight. I felt pretty safe, the tour was well done, and they had a friendly staff.  
We had booked the Grand Denali tour, but they determined that you could not see Denali, so we opted for a tour of the southern peaks.  It was still spectacular!  The glacier landing was amazing too.  
If you come ALL THE WAY to Alaska and just splurge and do it - you won't regret it!
P.S. - I was a little apprehensive about flying on the small plane, but the excitement of the adventure quickly outweighed any fear!  Of course, I still do wish there was a copilot on every flight (for safety reasons) but I think that is not economically feasible...

review_title: amazing flight to Mount McKinley in Delani National park
review_text:
We had an awesome and very scenic flight to Denali National park with stunning views on the Alaskan range. Although it was cloudy and rainy in Talkeetna we could see McKinley and the surrounding mountains very well. 
It was an overwhelming and very rewarding experience, and a privilege to see parts of the park you could never hike to!

This was AMAZING! First of all the people were wonderful: the bus driver who picked us up at our lodge, the staff when we arrived, and our pilot. They were honest about what we may or may not see based on the conditions that day and we're extremely informative. The pilot was humorous and considerate. The views were beautiful and landing on the glacier was indescribable. It was fun, exciting, and the experience of a lifetime.

Talkeeta Air Taxi flight-seeing and glacier landing was, probably, the highlight of our trip.  They picked us up right on time at Talkeetna Camper Park and transported us just a few short minutes to their business and airstrip.  Mike, our pilot, was a wonderful tour guide, offering lots of interesting fact and tidbits about what we were seeing.  We were very fortunate in that it was a beautiful sunny day, and Mt. McKinley was in full view the entire time.  Snow had fallen overnight at the higher elevations, and the glacer was beautiful.  We got some great pics of us on the glacier with Mt. McKinley in the background.  Very professional service from Talkeetna Air Taxi, and I would highly recommend them

review_title: Plane tour of Denali, Mt McKenley and landing on Mt Ruth Glacier.
review_text: Beyond excellent. Great communications, education and flight by our pilot, Clay. Beautiful views and very safe!  I highly recommend them.

Incredible experience in Alaska! Got to fly around the mountain range and even land on the Gargoyle Glacier. Definitely something that is a once in a lifetime opportunity, and I can't recommend it enough.

review_title: Our pilot Will did an excellent job flying to and around the various peaks!
review_text: Great flight! One of our highlights on our two and a half week trip to Alaska! Will did a great job flying and explaining the mountains! Nice and close and safe and smooth!We did the trip in the Cessna, but it was perfect and safe for my wife and myself! We would highly recommend them for this worthwhile adventure! Spectacular, Reasonable and fun! Do it!!

The flight was amazing.  Pricey (cost more than our airfare from San Jose to Fairbanks-round trip), but the best part of our vacation!  The most memorable thing we did!  We would do it again!!!  Awesome pilot!

7 of us went flight seeing with this company. We explained that our Florida grandchildren had never seen snow. We landed on a glacier and had a snowball fight! The pilot said the weather was beginning to look ominous and he cut the trip short. No one could tell. They refunded $700. If you want to flight see pick this company. No second choice

We had the most amazing flightseeing tour while in Talkeetna!  Richard was our pilot and was very nice and very focused on his flying.  We were one of the lucky ones and had a crystal clear afternoon to fly.  We had amazing views of the summit and all around the entire area.  Landing on Ruth Glacier was just spectacular - what a feeling!  It was awe-inspiring being there!  We are from Florida, so we loved playing in the snow!!  Richard was great about taking plenty of pictures for everyone.  He was telling us that although he has been flying up there for 20 years, never gets tired of flying up there and seeing those amazing mountains!  It was the highlight of our trip!  The ladies at check in were very helpful and friendly.  We got checked in, got our overboots on that they provide and we were ready to go.  Richard told us information as we were flying and was very professional - felt safe.  Would definitely recommend!

As a nervous flyer I wasn't sure if I would enjoy it but I LOVED my experience flightseeing and landing on a glacier with Talkeetna Air Taxi. The pilot Alex was informative and helpful and we had lots of time going back and forth and around Denali to see different vantage points. I did the Grand Denali tour and couldn't recommend it enough

review_title: No flight for us, but still great service
review_text:
Unfortunately, we couldn't fly because of the weather. However, I could not have been happier with the customer service we received. 
Very kind and helpful from the first phone call. 
The encouraged us not to waste the whole day waiting on the weather. 

I received by deposit back in less than two hours. 

So sorry I didn't get to meet them and enjoy a flight. I'm sure it would have been as good as their customer service.

If you do nothing else while visiting Alaska, make sure you do this. We did the 2.5 hour Grand Denali with Glacier Landing. It is absolutely worth every penny. We have been visiting Alaska for a month and this was the best thing we have done. Make sure you do this out of Talkeetna because if you fly out of Anchorage you will not see as much. A good part of your flying time is just getting there. We had a perfectly beautiful day and the time spent on the glacier taking pictures and playing in the snow was priceless. The plane is small (10 passengers),but it is not cramped and everyone has a window. We will remember this forever. Tnank you Talkeetna Air Taxi.

We flew in a DeHavilland Otter From Talkeetna to a glacier at the base of Denali (Mt. McKinley). Spectacular views of the peaks and glaciers- definitely a check off on the Bucket List. Alex, our pilot, was cordial and informative. Very friendly staff at the airport as well.

Talkeetna Air Taxi is a terrific company to book with for your two hour trip around Denali and for their glacier landing. We had a wonderful time, had a knowledgable Guide/Pilot and our photos are stunning since we were so close to the Summit.  This was certainly THE absolute highlight of our trip to Alaska!
Amazing - we had a great clear day. Landed on the glacier.  John was our guide - he was excellent. You only live once - you need to do this!

Family of five flew to South face of Denali and landed on glacier. Pilot and plane were extremely safe. 

We were fortunate enough to fly out on a beautiful sunny day. Landing on the glacier was amazing and so much fun. Seeing the mountains & glaciers up close is magical.

We spent almost 2 weeks in Alaska and Canada, a week on a cruise and the other week on a land tour through the cruise company. Knowing we would be arriving in Talkeetna in the afternoon, and staying the night I booked through TAT directly. It's interesting to note we could have booked it through our cruise company, but for $130 more per person. 
When we arrived they let us know that the cloud cover was pretty low and that there was a good chance we wouldn't be able to see much, and that we probably wouldn't be able to do the glacier landing. They gave us the options of canceling or choosing to fly. We chose to fly. Once we got to the mountain we learned that the weather had improved and that we were able to see most of Mt McKinley and the other mountains. We were also able to land on the glacier. I cannot even describe to you the flight or glacier landing. All I can say is that for both my husband and I it was the single most amazing experience of our entire lives. I would highly recommend it if you have the chance.

review_title: Sensationeller Pilot und fern ab von den anderen Flugzeugen
review_text:
Wir sind bei strahlend blauen Himmel geflogen und die Berge waren frei. Wir hatten eine Gletscherlandung gebucht. Wir dachten, dass es egal ist, mit wem man fliegt. Aber nein, als wir die Gletscherlandung gemacht haben, waren auf einem Gletscher 5 Flugzeuge parallel und unser Pilot sagte, dass er da nicht landen wird, weil immer so viele Flugzeuge da landen würden. Wir sind ganz einsam auf einem Gletscher gelandet und waren wirklich froh. Der Pilot, Dave, hat sehr viel während des Fluges erklärt und ist alles so geflogen, dass beide Seiten im Flieger jeweils alles sehen konnten. Auf dem Gletscher hat er die Fotos für uns gemacht und war sehr kompetent. Super Pilot und vor allem super Service. Der Check-Inn easy.
Sonnenbrillen sind total wichtig. Es gab Überzieh-Schuhe, damit man keine nassen Schuhe bekommt. Perfekt.

Like others, we enjoyed this experience immensely. TAT is a professional outfit that treats its customers very well and gives them the experience of a lifetime. We were blessed with clear blue skies and unlimited visibility, and our pilot Jonathan took full advantage. As a pilot myself, I appreciated both his professionalism and his competence. He narrated a wonderful tour and also let the scenery do the talking. Our time on the glacier was unhurried and spectacular. If we had unlimited resources we'd do this again in a heartbeat. Worth every penny and more!

We did the base camp flight with the glacier landing. Even though it looked cloudy around Talkeetna, We were told it was clear up at the mountain. We checked in quickly and efficiently, and were met by our pilot who took us to the plane in a golf cart. We loaded in the plane - I was able to sit in the co-pilot seat which gave me a fantastic view. Within 10 minutes of take off, the skies cleared and we were treated to a spectacular display of beauty. The glacier landing at base camp was the high point of the trip. A park service helicopter was busy hauling out gear form the base camp which was being broken down for the end of the season. This trip was the highlight of our 10 day vacation in Alaska. I would 100% recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi - they were efficient, professional, safe, and provided us with incredible memories that will last a lifetime!

review_title: Great Experience, Glacier Landing a Must
review_text: We had a crystal clear day to do our flight seeing tour with Talkeetna air taxi.  Dave our pilot was very informative and was very accomodating after we did the glacier landing.  The views are spectacular and the everyone has a seat by a window so that your views were never blocked.  We have been to Alaska several times and this was definately one of the highlights of our many trips.  Also the town of Talkeetna is a really funky fun place.

Flying around Denali and, best of all, landing on a glacier was a major highlight of our trip to Alaska.  Even though conditions were not ideal and we were unable to see most of Denali, we had great views of glaciers and landed at Denali base camp.  Our pilot, Craig, was extremely professional and the flight (and landings) were smooth and without any excitement (other than the beauty of the surroundings).  I highly, highly recommend doing a glacier landing; save money, if you want, on a shorter flight, but spend it on the landing.  (Note, this is not a cheap venture, but it is less expensive flying out of Talkeetna than out of the Denali entrance area.

review_title: Glorious views of Mt. McKinley from air and after landing
review_text:
Important tips: (1) It is all about the weather! Take a look at the weather predictions and if your schedule is flexible, do ask them to reschedule. We were camping in Denali park so our schedule was pretty flexible. There was an overcast/rain prediction on the day of our original appointment and the staff was extremely helpful in giving us an alternate booking.
(2): There is one seat next to the pilot. It is better if someone tall site over there as it would be convenient for him to see the front view. The other seats are equally awesome so don't spoil your mind if you didn't get a seat next to the pilot :)
(3) There is plenty of photo opportunity and you'd want to take vidoes. So make sure you have enough storage in your devices.

Views: Mesmerizing views of Mt. McKinley and several other mountains in the Alaska range. The pilot carefully maneuvers across the mountains and ensures everyone gets a great view. When you land on the glacier, you can see the south peak of Mt. McKinley right in front of you - it is surreal. 

Staff: They were extremely friendly and helpful. Our pilot was very nice and patiently answered all our questions as we kiddishly jumped around on the glacier.

review_title: An absolute requirement for every Alaska trip
review_text: Located in the terrific little town of Talkeetna, with many options for lunch or dinner and local beers.  Very efficient check-in process, taking maybe 15 minutes before boarding the plane.  Dave, our pilot, provided us with an epic flight through the peaks of the mountains, over the wide variety of glaciers, and many incredible views and perspectives of Mt. McKinley.  Landing on the glacier offers another perspective of the magnitude of the glaciers and mountains.  Dave was very informative, but thankfully kept the discussion focused upon what we were seeing and experiencing, without the non-stop chatter of other tour guides we encountered on our trip.  Do this McKinley flightseeing trip with the glacier landing.  It will be your top experience of your Alaska trip.

Talkeetna Air Taxi was more like a Limo.  Great service, very experienced pilot and overall concern for the guests.  We were scheduled to go up and weather forced us to reschedule for the following morning.  The next day we actually were the first to go up and thus we went up not knowing if we were going to be able to see Mt. McKinley or land on the glacier.  Therefore, they were not going to charge us until we got back from our flight and they knew we landed or not.  Our pilot Richard was very professional, friendly and safe.  As we cut through the clouds the great Mt. McKinley appeared and he immediately began surveying the surroundings and relaying it back to headquarters for the next groupings that were flying out.  We flew all around the mountains and he told us about each one and then we swooped down and landed smoothly on Ruth Glacier.   Richard's landing was so incredibly smooth it felt as if we floated on to the Glacier. First ones to land on the glacier that day and had the whole place to ourselves.  It was fabulous!   Overall, this once in a lifetime opportunity was definitely worth every penny and one that you should definitely do if your are considering.  Enjoy and make it a great day!

This was an awesome tour! It was a cloudy afternoon when we went up. We got to see the top of Mt McKinley through the clouds.  We landed at a base camp because of the weather but it was still amazing.  The views were breathe taking!

Seeing Mt McKinley from the air was an unforgettable experience.  Our Talkeetna Air Taxi pilot explained what we were seeing and pointed out different features.  We opted for the landing on the glacier, a must do!  Talkeetna Air Taxi also provided shoe covers for walking and playing on the glacier.  I highly recommended this experience with this group.

We were headed to Denali and saw an ad for Talkeetna air taxi tours.  We called to see if they had any openings and we are glad we did.  We did a glacier landing on Mt.McKinley.  The entire experience was awesome.  One of the best things we did while visiting Alaska.  Amazing views of Mt. McKinley and our guide was great.  This one is an easy 5 Star event.

This was an awesome and professional company to do your flight with, recommended by the National Parks Service. The flight was filled with breath taking views, but the stunner was landing on the glacier, do not miss out on that! It's life changing.

review_title: Most of it has been said already, but...
review_text:
to put my two cents worth in, this is a large, very professional sky-bus (large  10-passenger aircraft) tour operator that specializes in providing tourists a close up and personal look at America's most famous mountain. 
The staff works hard to accommodate the constant flow of tourists, and cope with the ever-changing weather conditions the mountain creates... which plays havoc with any kind of regularly scheduled flights.
We ended up taking the 900 HP IFR-rated turbine Otter up the Ruth Glacier, and after an extensive flight to view the Mountain from every possible angle, out pilot Richard skillfully maneuvered the big bird into the Don Sheldon Ampitheater of the glacier for a short and soft landing.  We were able to get out and enjoy a brief walkaround, throw a few snowballs and admire the scenery before jumping back aboard for the flight down through the mouth of the glacier and back to Talkeetna.
This was a great highlight of our trip, and should be on the 'bucket list' of anyone planning a trip to Alaska. The IFR capability translates to a better chance of getting you up to the mountain when the weather at lower altitudes is cloudy, and that proved to be a real plus.

review_title: Glacier Landing was well worth it
review_text: The pilot was friendly, informative, and patient with my 3 kids.  The flight was smooth and scenery beautiful.  We did the base camp glacier landing, and I thought it was worth the price.  One of the highlights of our trip and I will always remember it.

Our pilot, Jonathan, was great! He gave us a thorough safety briefing before flight. His flying was great and he gave us an awesome tour around Mt Mckinley and landed on a glacier. We could get out and walk on the glacier. He told us all about the area, the mountain, the glaciers and its history. Very personable guy! It was our favorite parts of our trip! So glad we decided to go!

We booked the Glacier landing tour at 8:30 A.M. because they offered a discount.On July 4th the sun was out and we were able to enjoy the views.We were surprised that we are the only family gone privately on this trip.Our pilot Chris  is very  good narrator and informative .He took great photos of us.On the return trip he made us  look for wild life but we did not see any .We had fantastic trip and the scenery was very very beautiful .I cannot describe in words.My only thought was that we should have taken this trip after we finished the Denali Park visit because my son got bored a little bit in the park.But the bus rides are awesome  up to wonder lake though.I highly recommend this Glacier landing.

review_title: Talkeetna Air Taxi Grand Denali Tour
review_text: My wife and I took a twelve day Alaskan vacation this summer.  All the attractions we saw by land or sea were superb.  With that being said the highlight of our vacation by far was the plane ride around Mount McKinley .  We took the Grand Denali tour with a glacier landing.  It was simply wonderful.  The aerial photos that I took don't do it justice.  The scenery was so incredibly beautiful it would make an atheist believe in God.

Unbelievable! Every set of company that comes to AK, we bring to Talkeetna and Talkeetna Air Taxi has consistently given our friends and family great flights. This time we went along and the pilot was fabulous. He created a route through the clouds to fabulous views and a great landing. Staff at check on we're great. And the booties that we borrowed, a great added touch! Thanks again! We'll be back.

review_title: The highlight of an awesome trip
review_text: This wasn't planned but we went to the K2 office & was able to find a flight out to the glacier near Mt Mckinley. This was incredible! The sight was breathtaking & beautiful. I highly recommend this experience.

review_title: A MUST! Trip of a lifetime....
review_text: From the booking call to check in to the fantastic and expert pilot and the convivial and gregarious staff, I would highly recommend talkeetna air taxi to all!!  A once in a lifetime experience made even better by the staff efficiency and friendliness and the expert qualifications of the pilots.

After realizing that Fly Denali would be an additional two-hour trek back to Denali National Park, we booked a flight on a nine-passenger airplane from Talkeetna.  TAT builds confidence from the moment you arrive.  They base out of a real airport (versus the yahoos that flew over our head onto a grass strip) while eating at the pub in Talkeetna.  Check in and restroom accommodations were structured and clean.  Clay was our pilot and I enjoyed his easygoing but all business manners.   I enjoyed how he and the other pilots worked together to provide the best tour possible in the dynamic and changing conditions.  Although we didn’t see much of Denali, but Mount Hunter and the other peaks are really cool too.  They refunded some of our money upfront knowing that we were not going to see Denali due to cloud coverage.  We landed at base camp, which was a thrill.

A flight over the Alaska Mountains is breathtaking and an experience you'll never forget. The planes are 60 years old Dehavilland Beavers, but they stil fly reliable. Over as there were clouds over the mountains, the views are fantastic. You'll see high peaks, glaciers, lakes. Don't forget your camera.
It's is not a cheap activity, but worth every dollar.

I had reserved a flight with TAT on Saturday morning. Friday we were in the area and the weather looked good so I decided to stop by and see if they were up to taking me that day rather than Sat. They checked their schedule and said to come on back around 3 and they would have a flight available. Everyone was very  friendly and helpful. When I returned in the afternoon they not only had a seat for me but they upgraded me to a longer flight and glacier landing for no extra cost. Very much appreciated. The flight was amazing...too beautiful to describe! Our pilot Clay did a great job of showing us the mountains and glaciers, and smooth landings all the way. If you can afford to do this activity I would recommend it highly and Talkeetna Air Taxi is the way to go. Thank you.

Magical experience ! I don't have words to describe how spectacular the views were. The pictures will not do any justice either.
The glacier landing was sooo magical. It was like a dream sequence. Truly the best experience so far.

Worth every penny spent !

Our flight around Denali was probably one of the best experiences on our trip to Alaska.  The flight was beautiful and comfortable.  The pilot was very knowledgeable and continuously gave us information about the what we were seeing and some history of the area.  When landing on the glacier they supplied us with boots which cover your shoes to keep them dry while walking through the snow.  For what we got to see and experience it was well worth the cost of the trip.

Spending time on the glacier is truly a breathtaking experience. I now understand why there are so many 5-star reviews here. The reason I'm giving Talkeetna Air Taxi 4-stars is because the Otter plane we were assigned for our flightseeing tour was an older model with small windows, as opposed to the group that went up just before us in a newer plane with wide 'HDTV' size windows, just like the plane on the company's website--so it was a frustrating to go up in a different plane with no mention made of why. Also, we paid for the Base Camp tour, but never saw a base camp, nor heard our pilot mention a base camp or why we weren't seeing it. Overall, the communication wasn't as clear as it was with other companies we used throughout Alaska on our trip. Besides all that, the pilot flew a flawless, safe flight, and Talkeetna is definitely a cool little town.
This was the excursion highlight of our 3 week Alaskan Vac. Seeing Mt. Denali and landing on Ruth Glacier... words do not describe.

review_title: One of the best moments of my Alaska trip
review_text:
Just landing on a glacier made me feel like a school boy.
I was all excited and the fact that I flew there made it so much more amazing
The folks here are friendly, what they had to offer was fun. I like the old style planes and the pilot had a lot of good facts and stories to share...plus spotting moose from that high: impressive :)

We had a group of 5 in Talkeetna/Denali for just a few days. We pre-booked the 2 hour flight with glacier landing via Talkeetna Air Taxi and then anxiously watched the weather. Talkeetna Air Taxi was so awesome in letting us move our flight around & wait for a good time to fly. We ended up being the first flight our day (at 1:30pm) to be able to land on a glacier, and that was spectacular! We actually landed at Denali base camp & talked to climbers who had just made the descent. So cool. We loved our pilot Paul! 

I would highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi. They go out of their way to ensure everyone has an exceptional experience. This was a highlight of our trip. Do it!!

review_title: By all means, land on the glacier
review_text: For those of us who'll never climb McKinley ( or even find our way to the base camp!) this is a tremendous way to explore this jaw-dropping work of nature. You can get to Talkeetna in a bit of 2 hours from Anchorage, and then with 90 minutes in a plane you can fly over snow-covered peaks, take in the breadth of glaciers, and even land on one just so you can feel extraordinarily puny (and lucky). Bonus: our pilot flies in the African bush when it's not tourist season in AK. Not only does that make him a world-class pilot, it turned out we'd been to many of the same places over there!

review_title: FANTASTIC flight over, around and through the ice fields of Mt McKinley.
review_text:
We made our reservation directly with Talkeetna Air Taxi.. for a flight that promised up-close views of the area around Mt McKinley (Denali). 

Our expectations were exceeded from the get-go!  Our pilot, a young lady who was a 2nd generation bush pilot, was also a terrific guide to the sights below.  Her expertise in handling the de Havilland Beaver aircraft was phenomenal!
