review_title: A "must do" if you can but you don't need to go longer than one hour.
review_text: After reading several reviews on trip advisor about the different flight seeing companies I decided on Talkeetna Air Taxi. Since you will certainly see the same views of Mt. McKinley, Foraker and Hunter and price is a concern, look for a company who has a coupon going on. All of the companies have good ratings.  If you are also visiting Denali, make sure you do not pay the additional $10 entrance fee to the park (yes they will add it to the bill) Lastly, I agree that the flight seeing excursion is a "must do" if you can.  We did the hour and a half with the glacier landing and in truth, the one hour flight  is MORE than enough.  Your experience will be just as memorable, with the same breathtaking views.

review_title: Airplane ride best part of Alaskan Vacation!
review_text: Our "splurge" on our trip was an Alaskan airplane ride with glacier stop....and everyone in the family thought it was the best thing they'd done in their lifetime!  Talkeetna Air Taxi gave us the most competitive price and the service and ride were amazing.  Our pilot, Chris, provided a safe, smooth ride and explained everything about our journey.  We never felt rushed and had plenty of time for photos.  The office staff was very helpful, too.  Talkeetna Air Taxi also provided boot coverings for the glacier and sun glasses.  Best trip ever!
Highlight of our 14 day Alaska vacation. Jonathan ( our pilot ) did an excellent job on our tour. Amazing views of Mt. McKinley, experience of lifetime.

Took a flightseeing trip with TAT in mid-June, and we were treated to a glacier landing at base camp on Denali. It was an amazing experience to see the climbers at base camp getting ready to climb North America's tallest peak. An unbelievable trip.

My wife and I took a flight-seeing tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi to see Mt. McKinley (Denali) and chose to do the glacier landing as well.  It was an unbelievable experience, totally professional from start to finish, and it's clear that these guys know how to treat their customers.  Our pilot Dave answered all our questions, kept us informed of what we were seeing, and really made it a very enjoyable time for us.  He made sure to swing the plane around points of interest on both sides for long enough for everyone to get a great view.  We love seeing the unique things about the places we travel, and Denali and Alaska's many glaciers definitely qualify as unique!

To me the best thing about this trip was actually the biggest challenge.  TAT makes it very clear if the weather is not ideal for viewing the mountain, you can back out with no issues.  But for me, I didn't have another day to wait for perfect conditions!  So barring total cloud cover, we were going on the trip.  We got a warm greeting at the office, some helpful instruction and safety info from our pilot Dave, and he let my wife ride co-pilot and take in the amazing views.  We could see some clouds around the mountain, but Dave was in constant communication with the other TAT pilots about what they were seeing and the best places to get the best views.  So even though people say sometimes it's hard to even see the mountain with the fickle weather, we got amazing views, incredible pictures and just a wonderful experience.  Thanks to Dave and all his colleagues for doing things right - understanding that sharing their information was going to make sightseeing better for everyone.  

The whole team at TA is first-rate.  Can't say enough good things.  There is no better way to see Denali, and I highly recommend the glacier landing.  I doubt I will ever experience anything quite like it.  Thanks again to Dave for taking us on a truly memorable trip and hopefully we'll be back again soon to do it again!

We were fortunate to have some great views of the mountains even though it was cloudy and overcast in Talkeetna. Landing on the Glacier was definitely a highlight of the trip. We got some amazing pictures from on the glacier. The cost is high but a little more reasonable with the Northern Lights discount. Certainly one of the highlights of our trip to Alaska. I only wish there was a way to be better oriented to where you are in the air and what you are seeing, in relation to the map of the planned flight.

Great time, flight was informative and landing on the glacier was quite exciting. At first I was hesitant about the price, but thought "you only live once" and threw caution to the wind.  So glad I did.  Truly breathtaking views and scenery.
It was amazing. Getting to see MT McKinley from the air and not having clouds around the peak and landing on a glacier wow. The best time

We were seeing Alaska with our 3 kids (ages 16, 14 and 11) and wanted to do something adventurous.  We highly recommend the glacier landing - really awesome and unique!  We were lucky enough to have a sunny day and views were outstanding.  We felt very safe - the office staff was very friendly and our pilot was happy to explain what were seeing and answer all our questions.  A GREAT Alaskan experience.

we booked 9 months in advance and.... bad weather. They refunded immediately the deposit. A few days later it was excellent weather and we made a detour to go back to Talkeetna. It's something you do once in your life. All nice people at the desk...  thanks

Our pilot Jonathan was so nice and informative.  We took an 1 1/2 flight tour with a 1/2 hour glacier landing on Ruth's Glacier.  Weather was great and we even got to see McKinley.  I even made a snow angel, did a cartwheel and made a snowball on the glacier.  Words cannot express what an amazing experience it was.  Definitely worth the money and will have to come back to do it again.  This was the best adventure my husband I did during our Alaskan vacation.

review_title: An Absolute Must When Traveling to Alaska
review_text: This is the best way to experience the Alaska Range of mountains and get a feel for what its like to be a mountaineer hiking around peaks 20,000 feet above sea level.  We flew around Mt. McKinley and did the glacier landing which is not to be missed!  A truly unique experience that should be on everyone's bucket list.

review_title: Best part of out trip to Alaska-June 2015
review_text:
Our pilot, Richard, flew us 10,000 feet up to Mt McKinley and landed us on a glacier inside the mountain.  For about half an hour we walked around, took pictures, had snowball fights..........and the temperature was in the 70s!

Recommend all not to miss this excursion..................it was spectacular!

Well, I was fortunate enough to be able to take a flight with this company for the second time.  I had originally booked a 6pm flight for my husband and I, but hearing there could be weather moving in that evening, we arrived in Talkeetna late morning and asked the office if we could join an earlier flight.  There was space on a 1pm, and the lady at the front desk explained the differences between the two flights, leaving the final decision up to us, even though the earlier flight was cheaper for us.  We ended up going on the 1pm with Richard as our pilot.  He made everyone feel comfortable and gave us so much interesting information as we flew toward Denali.  The flight was smooth and Richard did a great job maneuvering the plane so that everyone could see.  Once we landed on Pika Glacier, he took pictures of us enjoying the scenery.  For the second time, I had an amazing experience with this company.  Everyone is very professional with safety in mind.  I would love to go with them for a third time.

Recently did a a Grand Denali tour with glacier landing, and it was amazing.  The weather, while rainy in Talkeetna, opened up as we approached Denali and provided some of the most stunning views you will ever see.  The glacier landing was well worth the extra cost, and our pilot (who did a really pretty good job as a photographer) helped with a family photo that is really fantastic.

We were on a land portion of a cruise, but booked directly with TAT.  Had no trouble getting into town or back in time for our transport to the next destination.  The aircraft were clean and well maintained, as was the building the operation is run out of.  It was an easy 10 minute walk from the tour bus drop off point (although pretty much anywhere to anywhere in Talkeetna is a pretty easy walk, it's tiny.)

Finally, It's expensive, but it's worth it. Find a way to save/scrounge/borrow the money, you won't regret it.

I recently took a flight up into the Alaska Range with TAT and, while it's was too cloudy to see Denali, being up above the park really puts into perspective how vast and beautiful it all is. When traveling Alaska one hears constantly about the size of various glaciers or the amount of acreage in a park but until one gets up and sees it all for themselves, it's hard to truly understand. Flying with TAT was without a doubt the highlight of my trip. I'm tempted to go back just to have them drop me on a glacier so I can spend the day up there...

10/10 Highly Recommended.

We went on a 3 hour aerial tour of the the glaciers and mountains near Mount McKinley/Denali. The pilot provided lots of stories and facts about the mountains, glaciers and other unique features of the Alaskan wilderness areas. The flight ended with a low pass over the bogs and lakes and the mountain range in the background. We took tons of photographs. TIP: if the copilot seat is offered, take it. It has the best vantage point for photos.
Wow!  We had a perfect flight to the Kahiltna Glacier near Mt. McKinley.  Friendly and professional staff.  It was the highlight of our trip, without doubt!

We took the glacier landing with Talkeetna Air. Our B&B owner gave us a $25 coupon and they charge less for children. We had an excellent pilot and I am so glad that we decided to take the flight. We booked it on the same day. This was the highlight of the trip and makes you realize how small we are. The size of the mountains, the snow and the views were amazing. There was smoke in the air from nearby wildfires so we were concerned about visibility. Once we flew above the clouds the smoke wasn't an issue. The office staff was very friendly and they provide shoe covers for the snow and sunglasses. We had plenty of time on the glacier to play in the snow and take photos. This is a trip of lifetime. There are other companies in Talkeetna. From what we heard Talkeetna Air is the best.

We were initially disappointed when we arrived for our flight because the clouds were too bad to allow for the glacier landing. We were given the option to fly anyway with a different flight plan... We are so glad we chose to still go.  Our pilot was great and the flight was beautiful from start to finish. Felt very safe and we all had a wonderful time.

Cloudy in Talkeetna, but was assured it was clearer in the park.  They still gave us the choice.  The pilot was very safe and accomodating.  He landed us on the glacier and we got home safe and sound.  Lots of fun.  Worth the money!

We booked the Grand Denali with Glacier Landing flight and it was fantastic! The folks at Talkeetna Air provided a pick-up transfer for our morning departure and check-in was smooth. I highly recommend wearing the overboots, even if you have waterproof shoes as the snow may be deep and the overboots will protect your pants legs from getting wet. We were fortunate that the weather was amazingly clear and we saw Mt. McKinley. We landed on Ruth Glacier and had an amazing time.

I booked our flightseeing trip with glacier landing months in advance, and when the days were finally getting close, I started to really worry about the weather. Our first couple days in Alaska were hounded by overcast skies and bad weather, but after arriving in Talkeetna, the skies cleared and we woke up to a crystal clear morning for our flight!  
We walked from our lodging to TAT, and the front desk staff were friendly and gave us a day-of discount from our cabins. We waited outside for the rest of the passengers on our flight to arrive, and while waiting, played with the tarmac cat named Beaver, who was awesome.
Our pilot greeted us on time, gave us a good safety briefing, and allowed our one single passenger to sit in the co-pilot's seat. He provided good commentary as we took off and soared over the Susitna on our way to the Alaska Range.  The views!  You really cannot beat them, it was unbelievable how clear and crisp the mountains were.  We had up close views of everything, and the pilot made sure that both sides of the plane had panoramic shots.
We opted for the glacier landing, and that was SO COOL. Throwing snowballs at your new husband on a glacier?  Priceless.  

If you go to Alaska and can afford it, go on a flightseeing tour.  You won't regret it!

Wow! This is literally the trip of a lifetime. The flight was a little bumpy but the views are absolutely incredible. The pilot was very knowledgeable and very friendly and very helpful. We landed on a glacier, had a snowball fight, made snow angels, and picked up some mountain climbers then came back. It literally was the trip of a lifetime our children will remember this for the rest of their lives. Amazing.

Mrs B and I had not been to Alaska and we'd got a lot of advice from people who had.  Every single one said "if you get a clear day, take the Air Taxi to Denali."  They were SO right and the Denali Grand Tour provided by Talkeetna Air Taxi was wonderful.  We were in the 10-seat Otter which was smooth and, with the headsets, quiet.  We got a pretty clear and warm day and McKinley was magnificent.  We can't add anything to the reviews below, but can state that this was the highlight of our 10-day Alaska trip.  After the flight we stopped into the park and took one of the 8-hour bus tours too.  If we had to choose between the flight and a pricey bus tour, we would take the flight.  One tip: while all the seats on the plane are good and the pilot moves the plane around so everyone gets good views, take a seat on the right hand side (or volunteer for the co-pilot's chair).  Yo will probably be circling clockwise around McKinley and will have longer views.

The folks at Talkeetna Air Taxi are fantastic. From Check-in to the pilot, everyone is friendly and knowledgeable.  They are experienced and are safety minded. After the flight they drove us into town for lunch and even picked us back up and dropped us off at the train station. The person driving the van wouldn't even take a tip. Look at our photos and make your own decision.

Took a tour of Mt Denali with Talkeetna Air Taxi which was amazing.  It was a perfectly clear day and Mt Denali in all it's glory was displayed.  Also landed on a glacier which was a once in a lifetime experience.  Talkeetna Air Taxi service was very professional.  I would highly recommend them for one of the best experiences you will ever have.

review_title: Landing on Denali Glacier - Well worth it
review_text:
The people at Talkeetna Air Taxi were very accommodating and personable from the moment we made arrangements. We were on the land portion of cruise/land vacation with Princess and didn't know the logistics of getting to the town of Talkeetna from the lodge. They were very understanding and made sure we understood that it would take an hour plus to get there and they would have someone waiting for us to get us to the plane for our glacier landing. 
We arrived at Talkeetna a little late due to road work on the only road to get there, were met at the bus from the lodge and were reassured that the plane wouldn't leave without us. The 10 passenger plane waited for our late arrival and off we went.
The day was crystal clear and the pilot gave a steady stream of interesting information as we flew over mountains, glaciers and rock formations. Everyone was taking pictures and the views were mesmerizing. About 20 minutes later, we were landing on the glacier and couldn't believe what we were looking at. The views were breathtaking, the temperature was actually warm with the sun radiating off the snow and it is true - we only needed a small jacket. In fact, that day, short sleeves were almost comfortable. They gave us boots to go over our shoes so the soft snow wasn't a problem and we could walk around admiring the views. 
Although the ride isn't cheap, we thought this excursion was the best one of our trip. To think, we viewed Mt McKinley/Denali from a distance several times during our trip and admired it's beauty and now we were actually on it! We followed Ruth Glacier on the ride back with a great commentary. 
We would recommend the glacier landing and particularly Talkeetna Air Taxi due to their professionalism and very personable people both while making arrangements before our trip and when we arrived at their desk. 
(BTW -while in Talkeetna, you have to have lunch at the "Spinach Bread" food truck on main street.)

We took the glacier landing trip and it was awesome! The staff worked us in a day earlier than our reservations due to "cloudy" forecast. Andy our pilot was personable and informative and the flight was smoother than some commercial flights.  Being able to see the huge glaciers and the top of the mountain up close make it worth every penny.

Been in Alaska two weeks  this was the best we have experienced  the grand Denali tour was awesome landing on a glacier   Cool as it gets mike are pilot was great and had great answers for questions and explaining things would recommend pictures don't do it justice must do to see Denali

My wife and I  experienced the absolutely awesome and mind-blowing experience of a glacier flight with Talkeetna Air taxi back on June 7. We were the first flight out that morning and we gather for a number of days following bad weather, however, we were fortunate that the weather was calm, sunny with only broken cloud. Our aircraft was a De Havilland Beaver which we simply loved flying in. We landed not once but three times on Ruth’s glacier as our pilot Mike prepared a landing and take off zone in the fresh snow that had accumulated during the previous days bad weather. We would like to make a special mention about our pilot Mike. He was incredibly helpful, informative and personable guy and clearly loves his flying – thanks Mike, you really were the perfect pilot and guide up there that morning!  It’s difficult to find the superlatives to describe our glacier flight trip with Talkeetna Air Taxi and pilot Mike on June 7 it was worth every cent and definitely the highlight of our trip to Alaska.
Anybody visiting alaska, please do this trip. Completely worth it ! Fantastic views of mt mckinley and the sister mountains. Glacier landing was a surreal experience. Would do it again !

review_title: Amazing experience of Denali and Ruth Glacier
review_text:
My boyfriend and I took the $350 Base Camp Tour with Glacier Landing flightseeing trip and it was worth every cent. We were very lucky to have clear weather and were in a plane with 10 passengers. We flew up to Denali and went around about 270 degrees and back, including over the Denali climbing base camp, which was really interesting. The pilot made sure to go back and forth so that everyone could take pictures, no matter what side of the plane they were on. We landed on Ruth Glacier and stayed for about 20 minutes, but couldn't go very far from the plane unfortunately. In the future, I would look into doing a longer trip with some trekking around the glacier. Nevertheless, it was beautiful and awe-inspiring. The scale of the mountains and glaciers is just unbelievable. 

The only complaint I would have is about the smell of diesel in the plane. It wasn't overwhelming, but if you're sensitive to it, you wouldn't enjoy it very much.

Overall, it was an amazing trip that I would recommend to anyone. We didn't go up to Denali NP for the bus trip, so this was a great way to see it anyway. If you're staying in Talkeetna, or are active US military, ask about their discounts. We ended up saving over $100 total off the $700 bill.

My husband & I splurged on the summit tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  It was well worth the $, especially after reading negative reviews about venturing into the Park by car.   Staff at Talkeetna Air Taxi were competent and friendly when we made reservations.  It was a bonus to have CAA/AAA rather than the coupon provided at campground.  The tour started at 6:30 pm, Jonathon (our pilot) was very knowledgable, narrating for us as our flight progressed through Denali Park and neared Mt. McKinley.  Both sides of plane had opportunities to take photos, and then we went to Ruth Glacier.  Very cool!! We were surrounded by all the mountains we had heard about, and standing around on crystally snow was beautiful!!

review_title: Excellent air service & climber expedition support
review_text: Flew with Talkeetna Air Taxi to the Kahiltna Glacier to climb Denali (Mt McKinley) in May. This was my second expedition with TAT, and I have no doubt I will fly with them again. Highly efficient service. Friendly, interested and helpful staff. Expert pilots and excellent equipment allow them to consistently fly more reliably than other services - they are usually the last flight out of the mountains before bad weather, and the first in when the weather begins to improve again. Paul Roderick is a modern legend in the Alaska Range, and runs a great operation.

review_title: Worth Every Penny!  Don't Miss This!
review_text:
Talkeetna was the last stop on our week long visit to Alaska, with a flightseeing trip being the main reason for the visit.  We had reserved a flight in the afternoon of our last full day in Alaska but unfortunately the planes couldn't fly due to the weather.  We were told to try back the following morning. 

The next morning we went to breakfast at The Roadhouse (don't miss that if you come to Talkeetna!), and called Talkeetna Air Taxi at 8am when they opened to see if they'd be flying.  They said things were clear so we should come asap!  We were so happy!  

We did the Mount McKinley trip with glacier landing.  At check-in we signed waivers, got weighed (only the folks behind the desk see the results) and picked out some "boots" to put over our hiking shoes since there was snow on the glacier.  The shoe covers are lightweight but they help keep the powdery snow out of your shoes so I'd recommend using them (they are free).

We had about 10 people on our plane.  The pilot did a nice job of pointing out things as we were flying and was very personable.  Everyone has a headset to wear so you can hear the pilot easily.  We felt very safe the whole time.

There are no words that could do justice to this experience!  We are people that live frugally and we really struggled with whether to pay so much for three of us to take this flight but it was worth every single penny!  It was hands down the most incredible thing we did during our Alaska trip, so please don't hold back.  You will not regret it!  

The views of the mountain range are spectacular and give you a feel for the immensity of the range.  It was breathtaking.  The best part though, was the glacier landing.  To land in two feet of powdery snow, see the tents of the folks who will be attempting to climb McKinley, look up at those vast mountains-it was the event of a lifetime.  Truly.  Yes, it costs more to land on the glacier, but that is what totally pushed the trip to being the highlight of our Alaska vacation.

We are SO happy that we took the Mt. McKinley flight and did the glacier landing.  You will be too!

review_title: Displaced due to fire in Willow
review_text: A big thank you to Mrs Ann and the entire staff. While we're not able to fly to retrieve our personal belongings, everyone stopped what they were doing and made a plane and pilot, along with duffle bags available. They also went above and beyond to find us lodging..

1979/81 was a distant time, but thought it would be good to share. The Fairview Bar was open then, from eight in the morning till five the next morning. Three hours for cleaning! An 'All you can eat family breakfast' at the cafe down the road, plus planes taking off down the main road from time to time. Catch the train from Anchorage. TA ask for date of visit and it's not possible to go back to 1979!

Everyone at Talkeetna Air worked as a team.  Getting us set up and on board efficiently.  We flew with Le Ann, a third generation bush pilot, who loves her job.  She was knowledgeable, informative and answered all our questions.  We had a great flight; she tilted plane so both sides could see well and get plenty of pictures.  It was a perfect day with a clear view of Mt McKinley and entire range.  We have some mobility needs and they handled this well.

We did the McKinley Base Camp flight seeing tour with glacier landing (1 3/4 hours in total, and $350 each). It was totally worth every cent!

Check-in was very easy.  They weigh each person, along with their backpacks, etc. but only the person behind the counter can see the weight.  Then you put boots on over top of your shoes.  There were five of us in the plane, plus our pilot Mike.  We all had great window seats, and my friend got to sit in the co-pilot seat.

On our way to Mt McKinley we saw unbelievable beautiful scenery.  But when we reached the mountain, it just took my breath away.  Nobody asked many questions because our mouths were just open in awe.  Mike was a fantastic pilot, and constantly turned left and right so that everyone sitting on both sides could get a great view of whatever he showed us.

We lucked out and had a beautiful blue sky sunny day, and could see the entire peak.  Landing on the glacier was priceless.  Everyone was so excited when we got out of the plane.  It was like Christmas morning.  It was actually quite warm up there, and very bright.  Definitely take your sunglasses.  We didn't need all the warm clothing we took with us.  There were a few other planes on the glacier too, and people were throwing snow balls, and just enjoying the whole scene.

The flight back was just as beautiful, and Mike took us along a different route than on the way there.  There was zero turbulence on the entire trip.

It was truly a highlight of the trip, and a once in a lifetime experience!

This was an amazing experience, we all loved it!  Our 10 year old son, Roman, got to be the "Co-Pilot" and he has told everyone that since our return to PA.  The sites were amazing including Ruth Glacier, the Great Gorge, Denali, Moose's Tooth, etc. etc.  The views were breathtaking and we lucked out with a beautiful day.  Dave, the pilot, was great!  So knowledgable and nice!  Thank you Talkeetna Air Taxi and Dave for a great family experience!

The day was cloudy but we were assured it was clear above the clouds. We're so glad we did. Only saw Mt McKinley from a distance, but we flew above Ruth Glacier and I think that surpassed seeing the famous mountain. I had no idea there is so much variety on a glacier - it's own mountain ranges, rivers and lakes. Seeing the mountain faces so close was also truly awe inspiring

review_title: You just have to do this if you are in the area, trip of a lifetime!!!
review_text: Words cannot describe what a great experience our family of 4 had!!  Leigh our female pilot was amazingly patient and friendly with our 8yo twin girls, and put us all at ease quickly.  Our entire trip was smooth and our landing on Ruth Glacier was worth every penny. Unbelievable short range and long range 360 views, and Denali was breathtaking! I highly encourage you to book this tour. Yes it's lot of money, but it was the absolute highlight of our trip! The staff and even Beaver the cat was super friendly, professional, and very knowledgeable.

Highly recommend!

My wife and I are passionate about the outdoors, mountains, and hiking but are not mountaineers. Rather than booking through the cruiseline, we booked directly with Talkeetna Air Taxi. Not only did we save a few hundred dollars, but we got a summit flight with a glacier landing. It felt like being in a BBC nature documentary. The staff was friendly and competent and the pilot was great (we lived to write the review). They also had us back in time for the last shuttle from town to our hotel.

If you are on the fence: give it a shot. I'll zero balance the credit card next month, but we will remember this experience for the rest of our lives.

review_title: A small plane fright around Denali  mountain, landingand walking on a glacier
review_text: More than two months before our visit to Alaska we researched Denali mountain flights and scheduled a flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi. Major considerations were their generous rescheduling policy reputation. The day we arrived for our flight, the weather was clear and as soon as we took off  the view of the mountain was amazing. Our pilot, Alex, was wonderful and was full of very interesting and knowledgeable information about the mountain and the area. We flew all the way around Denali mountain, between many of the peaks, down through several glacier filled valleys, and spent about a half hour playing in the snow on a glacier nestled among giant peaks all around us. We saw groups of mountain climbers just beginning their arduous trek up the mountain from their base camp. The Talkeetna Air Taxi flight around Denali was one of the true highlights of our 24 days in Alaska and recommend them most highly.

review_title: Even Kings, Queens and Emperors of Long Ago Couldn't Experience This
review_text: The people booking us were as great as our tour guide/pilot. After booking the flight, the winds changed and we were unable to fly behind the mountain as planned, so they immediately refunded the amount for the flight to the amount of the new flight pattern. Clouds moved in, so we never really even saw Denali, but the views of all the other mountains were spectacular. We were up about 10,000 feet and even flew above a base camp, and saw four people skiing from there. We also saw where a river began by gushing up out of a glacier. I have been up flying in little planes many times, as my ex had his license, but I never before had the pleasure of flying in mountains, let alone this spectacular range! Don't miss this if weather permits. As my ex used to say, you will be experiencing what even the richest Kings, Queens, and Emperors of years past couldn't! We live in great times.

review_title: High point in Granddaughters Alaska vacation
review_text: We have used Talkeetna Air Taxi 4 times and have not been disappointed. We took our 9 year old granddaughter on a glacier landing flight and she was able to sit in the co-pilot seat , she was thrilled and excited. we had a snowball fight on Mt. Mckinley.

review_title: Fun for all of the family!
review_text: Chris was our guide for our flight. He was great. Very informative.  We landed on the glacier. Had time did lots of pics and snowball fights. Beautiful, breath taking scenary!

We took one up to the mountain to walk on a glacier. We had a wonderful pilot and tour guide. We were so fortunate to have fantastic weather that we could see Denali for 3 days.So the scenery was absolutely amazing.  Great trip

We had made a reservation a few months before out vacation. Couldn't get out at our scheduled time as the planes were not flying due to weather conditions. Rescheduled for later in day, no luck, tried next day, still not clear enough to fly. Made another reservation for 2 days later. They kept rescheduling us hoping to take us flying. Finally got to go flying... Well worth the wait... Amazing beauty & the glacier landing was so great!!  This company is great... They really tried to get us to fly, but safety was their main concern. If we had been unable to fly, our entire deposit would have been refunded. The people in the office are great & our pilot, Clay was very personable.

Five + rating! Our two hour trip was spectacular! Our pilot, Paul, made sure that his 9 passengers saw everything whether you were sitting on the left or right hand side of his plane. I was in the second row and got great photos. With that said, the first row would have been better. Paul described what we saw through the headphones. The trip included a glacier landing which was just as thrilling!  Another opportunity for photos of which I took a total of 364!!!! 
We rented a car in Anchorage to drive a little over two hours for this adventure and are so happy that we did. Highlight of our vacation . . .  so far!  👍👍👍👍👍+

Thanks to our pilot, Will, we arrived at out starting camp site on Clear Creek for a 3 day float/fish trip with Dave Fish Alaska. Will was watchful and pointed out wildlife as we traveled, even in the rain. He even turned around so my son could get a good look at the moose near our landing area.

review_title: Glacier landing after glacier mountains air tour
review_text:
Strongly strongly recommend.
1.5 hr of flight + 0.5 hr of glacier landing.
The aviator was Tom. Very comfortable all thru the flight.
We toured three highest glacier mountains at Denali. Valley creeks and base camp too.
When landed on the glacier surrounded with rocky mountains, the ice under the snow is 200meter thick. The snow was very deep but we could nearly walk on it. It was never forgettable fun and memory.

My husband and I flew with Andy in a single engine Cessna. It was tiny but what a ride.  We did the South Face McKinley trip but McKinley, whilst pretty impressive, was not the main attraction for us.  We were blessed with great weather and the mountains and scenery was gob smackingly gorgeous.  Andy gave a narrative along the way and made sure we experienced the majesty of this mountain range.  We saw the glacier tour on the glacier and they were ant size which gave us a good perspective of how big these mountains are.  We flew within 25 yards down the side of a gully where you felt you could reach out and touch the snow.  If we had more time I would have loved to have gone again.  Well worth the time and money to do.  Thanks Andy, we had a great time.
Great service, were very accommodating and nice staff at the office. The pilot was also very knowledgeable. Great experience!

review_title: Great way to see Mt. McKinley!
review_text: This was such a bucket list experience!  Take off is smooth and so was our ride over to, around, and landing on the glacier at Mt. McKinley.  I am prone to motion sickness, and I had no issues ascending or descending on this type plane.  I took no medication as well.  We were blessed with a blue sky the day we chose to fly.  Our original day was rainy and overcast, but the friendly staff at Talkeetna Air Taxi worked with us to choose a better day.  The views are unbelievable!  Thank you for such an awesome experience!

Rainy day and a break in the clouds. They called our hotel and picked us up. We took off in drizzle and flew into full sunshine on the peaks of Denali. it doesn't matter which peak. the whole town is great and the flight was the high point. Sorry, I couldn't resist.

This place is professional and my sons had the flight of their lives!  We did the basic flight(no glacier landing) on a really clear day.  They saw Mount McKinley and enjoyed the whole experience,  Staff was wonderful!
If you visit this, do take glacier landing. It is worth the experience. Just the ride won't do the justice to the beauty of Mt Mckinley.

This was the highlight of my trip in Talkeetna. The service was incredible and the views were breathtaking. Everything about our tip was perfect. We flew in to Denali National Park, got views of the the park as we flew over, and then landed in Ruth Glacier. Stunning and a bucket list item checked off.

Alaska estuvo mas caliente de lo que pensamos y esta fue nuestra oportunidad de vivir el frío y el hielo que esperábamos .... Pero volando. 

La vista es increíble y aunque es muy costoso la  experiencia lo vale. Recomendaciones, reservar una vez se está en Alaska para tener mayor certeza del clima, aunque puede tener pocos cupos, nosotros pudimos hacerlo el mismo día que llamamos y en muy ven horario, sin afectar nuestro itinerario de viaje.  Aunque en Alaska hay varias lugares para él sobrevuelo talkeetna es una de las mejores opciones no sólo por la variedad de oferta que da la opción de mejores precios, sino también por la variedad de paisaje, verde, nevado, ríos, lagos.... 

Tuve el hace de ser copiloto y estuvo genial. Si tienes poco dinero puedes tomar la opción de menos horas, nosotros hicimos 2.5 horas, con landing, esta última es la mejor parte, así que no hay que ahorrar con esto.

This sight seeing trip is by far the most incredible experience we have had as a family. Richard our pilot was excellent in explaining the sights around us The sights were breath taking as he brought us around for a visual of the north and south peak of McKinley. He then landed on  Ruth Glacier where we were able to enjoy the sights while outside standing on the glacier for about a half hour. Standing in the magesty of these mountains was surreal. It was a beautiful day for this trip as there was no cloud cover. Highly recommend this trip for an adventure you will not soon forget!

I flew with TAT to Denali and that was a very good experience. However me and my wide were disappointed on the way back. My wife was staying in Talkeetna while I was on the mountain and she wanted to surprise me by coming on the plane to base camp to welcome me there. Everything was set when she showed up at TAT office early in the morning. But because of winds flights were delayed so she was told not to wait there but come back after 11am. To her great disappointment when she got back the plane had already taken off! So she missed the opportunity... It looks that communication from TAT might have been a bit more precise...

review_title: Wonderful service for the excursion of a lifetime......
review_text: My husband and I used TAT for a flight to the Mt. McKinley base camp and I can't say enough about their service.  While the actual trip and views were so wonderful, they would bias any review, the service provided by TAT was indeed second to none.  Our pilot, Will made us feel very at ease and was so eager to share his expertise.  I highly recommend them to others,

We were so fortunate to have a cloudless day to take our flight to Denali.  Staff are easy to work with and Don our pilot was fantastic.  Words can't describe the beauty to fly up close but stepping out on the glacier was something we will treasure.  I highly recommend that you spend the money for the glacier landing at Ruth Glacier.  Plan ahead as they do fill up due to their great reputation.
Caught the 4pm flight yesterday. Loved the experience, loved the knowledgeable pilot, loved the way you guys organized the beautiful weather for our glacial landing. We love Talkeetna Air Taxi.

Amazing experience, we didn't book a flight but bought one right away. Since we were in a group, we got a 15% discount (plus taxes), better than we would get online. The flight took 2 hours and we stood for 30min in the glacier nearby Mt. Mckinley, where we could walk around. Thanks to our wonderful pilot, Chris, we landed on a beautiful site where there was no one else. Super recommend it!

Flew with TAT both times. Glacier landing first time and over mountain tops, glaciers and deeeeeeep valleys second time. You owe it to yourself and your family to view Denali up close and become aware of the immense size. 
A true thrill of a lifetime!

We took off from Talkeetna on the most incredible flight. The weather was perfect and the views spectacular. Our pilot was wonderful enjoying every moment himself. He made sure that both sides of the plane had equal opportunity to see the mountains and glaciers. We landed on a glacier and the pilot was happy to take a group photo. A wonderful experience I will always treasure.

I live in Alaska and see Denali from a distance frequently, but you don't realize how big it is until flying there.
The coolest thing for me was how close we flew to the mountains.
It was a beautiful day and view.
I did the glacier landing - you land in a really scenic spot - another plane had sleds and that looked like fun sliding down the hill.  Our group just wandered in the snow.  If you live in a snowy climate, this might not be as 'exotic' as for those who aren't used to snow.

review_title: Amazing view of Mt McKinley & glaciers
review_text: Took the air taxi to check out Mt McKinley from up close. It was an amazing experience flying by the tall mountain (also known as Denali). We landed on a glacier nearby. Pictures taken in absolute white snow there made the pictures look unreal. Surprisingly, it was kind of warm when we landed on glacier.
Super Piloten, nette Leute und ein unglaubliches Erlebnis! Preise sind natürlich wie zu erwarten relativ hoch, aber absolut ein MUSS (am besten mit Gletscherlandung)...

Our pilot, Dave, flew us to Denali.  The weather had been iffy for most of the day, but it cleared up late in the afternoon and we had a great flight.  The flight was smooth and offered many opportunities for pictures.  Dave told us about the mountain features and the some of the history of the area.  The glacier landing was the most memorable experience.  Dave was happy to take pictures of us on the glacier.  I felt very comfortable during the flight.  I am so glad we were able to see Denali by air.

The Soutface and Glacier landing tour was incredible.  The company provided vann pick up from the town to the near by airport which was extremely convenient.  The chef in process was fairly simple. The staff was very helpful and friendly.  The scenery during the flight was out of this world, beautiful mountain peaks, glaciers, and valleys.  We flew so close to the amazing Denali.  The plane landed smoothly on the glacier giving us the short opportunity to walk around and play in snow.  We made this booking independently from the cruise/tour excursion at a substantial saving.  This is one of THE highlight of the trip!!  Highly recommended especially with the Talkeetna Air Taxi!!

review_title: Pricey - didn't live up to expectations
review_text:
Unless the day is crystal clear, you will likely be disappointed in what you see.  On the day we went, the sky was clear, so I was hopeful for some good photographs.  However, by the time we got to the mountain (11:15am or so), the clouds had started to roll in and visibility was somewhat limited.  The light was "flat" - so photo's were just so-so.  If I had it to do over again, I'd book the first flight in the morning - the light would have been much better and perhaps much clearer views.

This outfit is well run - the planes seem in good shape and they operated safely.  However,  in the words of one of the other passengers - the trip was OK, but it wasn't great.  My thinking exactly.  If you decide to spend your money anyway, here are some tips:
1) Ask the pilot which side of the plane is best to sit on.  The "other" side of the plane got most of the views, which was irritating as all get out to me.
2) One of the passengers on the plane was a bit heavy - 200 lbs? and had a bad knee.  She was extremely uncomfortable and had to literally "unfold" herself to exit the plane.  Seats are narrow and very limited leg room.  You will also experience some bumpy air.  I fly alot, so a non-issue for me - and it was brief - but you will likely experience a few bumps.
3) I thought we were going to land at base camp - we did not.  We landed on a glacier somewhere in the area.  You couldnt' see Mt McKinley from the landing, and photograph opportunities were pretty unremarkable.   Save your money and bypass the glacier landing.  You're basically just landing in the snow and walking around for a few minutes.
4) One of the women on our plane indicated that she had done this same flight 3 years ago, and had found it ho hum - and didn't find it much better the second time with her daughter.  Again, it was OK - but not worth the $$$'s IMO.  
The staff were nice and did not complain when I had to change the date of my visit to Talkeetna a couple of times - that was appreciated!
5) Our pilot had ear length, straight gray hair.  He was okay - but wasn't great.  He checked all the boxes is the best way to describe the experience.
6) Ask the pilot to "parallel" the peak so that you can see it.  The pilot tended to fly headfirst towards the peak, so I'm sure he had a fabulous view of Mt. McKinley from his windshield.  But passengers can only see out the side of the plane.  So in essence, the only view you get of the peak is when he flies alongside the mountain.  And you better be on the "right" side of the plane when he does.  And the % of time you are viewing the actual peak will be very small - disappointingly so.

review_title: Best Thing to do in Alaska
review_text:
We had the trip of a lifetime. We choose such a good day, no wind or clouds. The pilot was very friendly and helpful. The plane was large enough to comfortably fit all of us. 

Denali was absolutely fantastic. We saw so many snow covered peaks and valleys. Awesome glaciers all around us. Wage landing on the glacier was so fun. Soft and smooth. 

The pilot took his time and turned the plane so both sides of the plane could see everything. 

Great tour, great tour company!

Awesome tour, they managed to change my reservation due to bad weather.
Dave (pilot) was great, very nice and attentive.
The best experience we had in Alaska.
Totally recommend it, it´s worth the price.

Beautiful weather; knowledgeable and very capable pilot; great company on the plane -- all combining to make our flight and glacier landing an amazing experience.  One of the best adventures we have had in Alaska!

We love adventure. This was the Coolest thing we have ever done. Alex was our pilot and we flew through the mountain peaks like a bird!!! The sun was out. Denali was stunning. THEN we landed on a glacier field.  So worth it.

We flew with TAT during our 1986 attempt on Denali. What a flight. The Denali range gets bigger and bigger as you approach. We flew through 'One Shot Pass' and the pilot dived down towards the glacier making a perfect landing on the glacier at base camp.
At the end of our trip, base camp had been 'socked in' (bad weather) but as I reached the bottom of Heartbreak Hill the planes started to come in. As I rounded the crest of the hill, base camp Annie thrust a drink in my hand (VERY welcome) and pushed me towards a plane. I was the only passenger and we had an amazing flight down the Kahiltna and out via 'Second Shot Pass'.
Amazing pilots, superb planes and a great flight.
No hassles whatsoever with getting a refund - Denali's weather didn't play ball today (low cloud and rain), but that's not Talkeetna's fault!
Everyone, at check in and the pilot, was terrific and knowlegeable.  We landed on a glacier, and it was very much worth the extra cost!  Amazing experience!!

The only way to really see Denali... unless you're going to take 3 weeks to hike it.  The ride was a bit bump and somwhat scary at times, but the pilot landed smoothly on the glacier, the view were second to none.
Originally, I thought it would be cool to land on a glacier, but I should of had this on my Bucket List. It was awesome, fantastic and yes, cool!

We booked our flight last minute, and the staff at Talkeetna Air Taxi  were accommodating and provided exceptional service.  We took the Base Camp Tour with a glacier landing.  It was absolutely incredible!  Our pilot, Dave, was outstanding.  He went out of his way to make sure we were able to get great views of McKinley.  There are no words to describe the scenery we experienced.  We can't wait to come back and take a different flight tour, the Summit Tour, where you fly over the summits of McKinley, Foraker and Hunter.

Excelente vuelo hacia el monte mckindley, una preciosa vista a los distintos glaciares y montañas de la zona. Ademas el piloto se molesto en explicar lo que veiamos, el desarrollo geologico de la zona y otros. Ademas puedes ver los campamentos de quienes pretenden subir el mckindley. Si bien yo no tome el tour en el que se aterriza en el glaciar, se puede hacer por un precio razonable

review_title: Grand Denali Tour w/ glacier landing
review_text: My husband and I decided to go on the Grand Denali flight tour that takes you all the way around McKinley but not above it because I didn't want to have to use oxygen. The staff at Talkeetna Air Taxi was very helpful and friendly. We lucked out and had a beautiful cloudless day. We did the 8:30am tour and it was incredible. I am not a fan of flying but the flight was very smooth, there were a few bumps when we went between mountains, but I felt very confident in our pilot. The views were absolutely breathtaking. I couldn't take pictures fast enough with all the beauty. Each window had spectacular views and I couldn't tear my eyes away. We opted for the glacier landing package and I am very glad we did. It was hard to comprehend that we were thousands of miles up in the air on a glacier. It was beautiful and also cold, so make sure to bring hats and gloves and also sunglasses because the snow is so bright. The trip was definitely worth the price and we would do it again. It really is the best way to see Denali up close without having to hike to it. If you have the money, do it, you won't regret it!

My cell phone photos look like I work for national geographic.   Most impressive, unbelievable.  Captain Steve was excellent with the geography lessons, too.   When they offer the chance to sit co-pilot,  take it!

TAT exceeded our expectations in every category, amazing customer service, highly skilled, and top notch pilots, just and amazing outfit that will allow you to experience the Alaska Range and Denali with all the amazing splendor that it has...  I recommend them

Pocas veces me subo a una avioneta 
Esta vez me senti muy a gusto y seguro en un vuelo maravilloso por las cumbres mas altas de Norteamérica.  hicimos un aterrizaje en un glaciar donde el aterrizaje y despegue fueron muy suaves. Una experiencia única de una belleza increíble. Si tiene oportunidad no la deje pasar.

While everyone else did something boring, I did a flight to Mt. Mackinley. .As a 73 year old Aussie lady, this was an experience to cherish. 
The pilot was so familiar with his "back yard" that we flew through a short whiteout among sheer granite formations. I was totally confident while being extremely excited. Our landing on the glacier was marvellous & the surroundings magnificent.  Anyone can go on a mountain train or a dog sled but everyone should fly to the glacier with this great professional & considerate company to have something to tell the grand kids & recall in the coming years.

Las condiciones del tiempo no permitieron hacerlo ese dia. La experiencia la hicimos en Denali, donde comprobamos que es mas caro. Incluir aterrizaje en montaña o glaciar. Y hacerlo aqui que es mas barato
Amazing and unforgettable flight over Denali National Park. Furthermore, the nicest and most professional people ever who took their time to solve even those problems that did not concern them.

Flew with TAT in early March and couldn't have written a better experience. Two hours of flying with a landing in Little Switzerland. Richard was our pilot and we were more than impressed with his skill, knowledge and friendliness. You can tell safety is a priority as pilots are top notch and equipment is regularly maintained and well kept.  This is not just a trip around the mountains but rather through the mountains, couloirs, and glacier valleys with classic, up-close views of Mt. McKinley, Hunter, Foraker, the Moose's Tooth and others. Everyone at TAT is super enthusiastic about sharing with you their genuine love of flying and Denali. Really a great atmosphere and a great group of people. TAT is a world class company connecting you with world class mountains. I would absolutely return to Denali with TAT.

review_title: Must do for your bucket list
review_text: The town is one you want to stop at, we were lucky to have such a beautiful day for a flight the staff is so friendly and the ride is amazing

Late March has often very good weather in the Talkeetna area and we were fortunate to have a perfect day for our flight with Ruth Gorge landing. TAT people are very competent and the business has been around awhile. Their planes are well kept and pilots are excellent. For a great flight without pressure, go before the climbers arrive in mid-April.

We got everything we expected and more out of our trip with TAT.  The views were amazing, our pilot (and everyone) was extremely friendly, and all the equipment appeared to be in good shape... important given the lack of places to put down safely if you had to.  They were great guides.

Totally worth it! That was one of the best experiences we have ever had. Our pilot Trent was amazing and explained everything. He gave us plenty of time on the glacier and took his time flying us around and showing us all the breathtaking views including Mt. McKinley.
Luckily we had a clear day with beautiful sunshine. Thank you Talkeetna Air Taxi! You guys are great!!!

Beautiful flight over the glaciers and mountain ranges. The landing on the glacier was smooth and the short time on the glacier was a neat experience. We could see and hear avalanches on the nearby mountains which was a little haunting but cool. Not cheap, but we felt it was worth it.

Wow! just WOW! we had Such a wonderful experience taking this flight-seeing tour with Talkeetna Air! We really lucked out and had perfect weather conditions- the flight was smooth and clear. at first i thought the prices were a little steep but after reading some tripadvisor reviews i have to agree with what everyone has said- it was so worth every penny and absolutely the highlight of our Alaskan vacation. I am not a religious person but flying up through the peaks of the mountains-it felt like I was seeing God. The views of Denali from the air are just indescribable. The Snow on the glacier was too deep to be able to land, but it really didn't matter -the flight was just amazing- and they adjusted the price when we returned so we didn't have to pay for a landing. The Tour guide was very knowledgeable and pointed out key landmarks over the headset as we flew. All the folks working at the front desk and in the waiting area were super nice and professional. I would highly recommend this company and this experience to ANYONE planning a trip to Alaska. SO WORTH IT! (and the couple sitting behind us in our plane got engaged mid flight- which was so fun and special to witness!!)

My wife and I just returned from our Northern Lights tour which included a Mt Mckinley flight with landing- what an experience! The whole company does an awesome job this was by far the best part of the trip.

Wir hatten eigentlich die große Runde um den Mount McKinley gebucht. Leider spielte das Wetter nicht mit. Die Berge waren wolkenverhangen und somit konnten wir nur eine kleine Tour fliegen ohne Gipfelsicht aber trotzdem mit grandioser Aussicht. Ausgestattet mit warmen Überziehstiefeln sind wir auf einem Gletscher gelandet und ausgestiegen. Ein ganz besonderes Erlebnis.
Ein solcher Rundflug ist absolut empfehlenswert.

review_title: Air Taxi view of Denali up close
review_text: We had a perfectly clear day and it is hard to describe the scale and the beauty.  Paul was great pilot and great guide.  Very knowledgeable with a terrific way of sharing info without overdoing it.  We were thrilled with our tour.

we felt very safe on our flight and the company takes safety very seriously. Our pilot was nice and knowledgeable. Unfortunately it was too cloudy to see Mt McKinley on the day of our flight but the other sights were amazing.

It was Saturday afternoon, we went for a walk and we saw those little aircraft flying in close by, so there was an idea something to do, everyone was so nice and with 20 minutes we were taking off , Mt McKinley was awesome, these attraction end up being one the best thing we did in Talkeetna. Love it!!

We booked the Talkeetna Air Taxi before we got to Talkeetna.  We were on a Princess Cruise and chose to do activities away from the tour.  Soooooo glad we did!  These guys are so fun and knowledgeable. we landed on the mountain!  We had a chance to play...snowball fight, snow angels, photo opportunity, etc.  Just to get so up close to Denali was the height of our trip...no pun intended!  I'd recommend to book the trip ahead of time.  Weather, of course, plays a factor in your flight, but it's so worth it!

The is singularly the most beautiful thing I have ever seen. Absolutely breathtaking. We were fortunate that we woke to a cloudless sky. The pilot said that it was one of the top 10 days of the year. Well worth the money...it was beyond beautiful.

review_title: Wow, A great suprise & wonderful time!
review_text:
We traveled to Alaska on a Cruise. We were reserved on booking this adventure due to the expense. It was hard to part with this much money per ticket thinking of all the other things we could possibly do with that same amount. After hashing it around, we decided to book the flight around Mt. McKinley but to skip landing on the glacier so the ticket would be more affordable. 
Upon arriving at Talkeetna Air, we checked in and were told to wait in their outside waiting area for our names to be called. We waited for over 15 minutes and finally one of the employees came to us (there were 4 of us in our party) and asked if we would mind sharing a plane that was going up and landing on the glacier instead of the flight we had booked. They would not charge us the difference. It would save them money to just add us to that flight than have to take another plane up for just our party. We said of course! We were lucky to have that offer!
I cannot say enough good about that flight and experience! After the fact, knowing now what we would have missed not landing on the glacier - I would highly recommend paying the extra to have that experience. It was outstanding and the flight would not have been nearly as enjoyable if we had just taken the plane up for sightseeing and not gotten to land, stop & walk around and experience stepping on the beauty of that mountain! It is hard to put into words how beautiful and exciting it is to land up there & get to step out & walk around (They supply snow boots that fit over your shoes so you can walk around up there). Our pilot was informative, gracious, and very helpful. Our flight could not have been better. It's a small plane, be prepared for a bumpy ride. It's a bit noisy but they supply earphones to buffer that, and you can hear the pilot narration. 
This was definitely a highlight of our Alaskan vacation. Although we originally made the decision to save money by choosing the flight that did not land on the glacier, and got to experience it anyway, our advice is now to spend that extra money and experience the entire thing. It's a once in a lifetime adventure (for us anyway) and landing definitely made the entire excursion worth doing. 
I would choose Talkeetna Air again; they were courteous, professional & made the entire experience one we will never forget!

Great customer service - they worked with us on discounts and answering all our questions on the helicopter tour we booked.  The tour was the highlight of our trip to Alaska.  Terrific pilot - who ended up being from our hometown - and we had total confidence in her piloting.

Great experience! Everyone in this organization was friendly, laid back and genuinely helpful. 
We reserved our flights in advance of our trip (saves you money). Our reservation was mixed up when we arrived, they had it showing for a later time. In order to get us up for a tour earlier, they gave us the option to fly up and land at base camp! This was so amazing. We flew up with some climbers and then landed at base camp, met some of the climbers and just had an awesome time. Very cool!

I was very fortunate to take a glacier landing flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi - the premier Air Taxi service in Alaska.  The people are friendly and very knowledgeable about Denali and the mountain ranges. It was a beautiful experience and I highly recommend that anyone take a flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi. This is a no brainer.
Worth every penny.This was the highlight of our Alaskan trip and that's saying quite a bit considering that the whole trip was awesome! TAT was great , pilot was friendly and very informative.

Absolutely do it! It was the highlight of our alaskan trip and our three months travel. Professional, great pilot, informative and safe. We were lucky to arrive from anchorage and take the flight that day it was clear and we saw mt minkley! Highly recommend as it is expensive but well worth it. Beautiful and jaw dropping thats us on the glaciers, the pilot takes your photo, its surreal!, love it and loved alaska! lindsay and matt melbourne australia

My husband and I recently visited Talkeetna, AK and chose Talkeetna Air Taxi for a flight seeing tour.  Every aspect from reservationst, Heather, to our pilot and tour guide, Chris.  Chris explained all the sites including the history of the same.  The glacier landing was great as was the scenery.  You won't be disappointed with Talkeetna Air Taxi and its first class service.

review_title: Highlight of our Alaska Trip ...........Paradise Views
review_text:
One of the high points of our three week Alaska adventure. We drove to Talkeetna from Anchorage and had our flight on Mt McKinley scheduled at 3:00 PM, the weather was pretty clear and we reached an hour early and they schedule us in an early slot ( it was an off-shoulder season). The pilot was very friendly and his experiences of flying small jets in Alaska was top notch, 

We opted for the the glacier landing on the Ruth Amphitheater and it was magical , we spent around 20-25 minutes in middle of the glacier just admiring the beauty and majesty of the snow capped mountains.

 Don't let the price keep you from experiencing! You won't believe how the pilot weaves in and around so everyone on the airplane can soak up the fabulous views. We opted for a glacial landing and didn't regret spending the extra bucks. 

Must do for everyone on Alaska Adventures..................

One of two high points of our three week Alaska adventure.  Don't let the price keep you from experiencing!  You won't believe how the pilot weaves in and around so everyone on the airplane can soak up the fabulous views.  We opted for a glacial landing and didn't regret spending the extra bucks.  Must have taken 100 photos as everywhere we looked was breathtaking.  One cannot begin to comprehend the massiveness of the Alaska Range and Denali until you've flown into it.   Truly a surreal experience and TAT did an excellent job!  The staff was friendly and accommodating. Our pilot was experienced and professional.  Thank you TAT !

I have been on the flights twice now and both trips werre amazing in every way.  Even the fantastic photos I was able to shoot in the air (the plane windows facilitate some gorgeous views that develop well) and the glacier landing is spectacular - the second time I had the opportunity to be put down at the Denali climbers base camp, and the experience is in comparable.  The pilots and planes made our group very comfortable

After taking the train to Talkeetna we joined 5 other passengers for an incredible flight over the Alaskan Range, to include Denali.  Blessed with perfect weather, we enjoyed an amazing panorama of mountains and glaciers.  Landing on the glacier was a once in a lifetime experience.  Thanks to the Talkeetna Air Taxi pilot and staff for an unforgettable day!

I am a student from Albany, New York visiting Alaska for 6 weeks. My friend and I wanted to do something that was once in a lifetime. We looked up many other flight companies and spoke with them, and Talkeetna Air Taxi seemed to be the best choice. We spoke to Annie  and she gave us a great deal. The pilot was very professional and knowledgeable. I am not a fan of flying and I get very anxious on planes, this was something very different. The take off was the smoothest I've ever had and we were up in the air in minutes. Paul (our pilot) brought us around each peak so both sides of the plane could see the amazing views. He told us about each peak and talked to us about the different sites we were flying over. There was little to no turbulence. The landing was very smooth. Overall we had a once in a lifetime, amazing experience. Talkeetna air taxi is an amazing choice for those who want a once in a lifetime experience! Thanks again Paul and Annie!

We took a flightseeing tour of Mt. McKinley/Denali with Talkeetna Air on our trip to Alaska two weeks ago.  It was a once in a lifetime experience that we can't stop talking about.  There are a few different planes depending on the number of people going, but we were in the Otter.  The pilot made us feel very calm and relaxed, and he kept us updated through the whole flight on what we were seeing and the history of the mountain through headsets we were all wearing.  I'm not one for small planes, but this was comfortable and relaxing.  A huge highlight was the stop on a glacier -- the beauty is breathtaking.  We couldn't have asked for a better experience starting with the staff at check-in until the moment we left.  Thank you Talkeetna Air for one of the most memorable events in our lives!

breathtaking flightseeing experience ... Great pilot, stunning scenery, worth every penny   The pilot was so knowledgeable about every aspect of the flight.  Very nice staff at check in. Talkeetna has unending charm and unparalleled natural beauty.   I was never scared or concerned.   Glacier landing was so awesome.  Superb landing.

This was our first trip to Alaska.  The whole trip was great but the flight around Mt. Mckinley in the Otter was wonderful.  We landed andd walked on the glacier which is a must.  Originally we thought we didn't need to do the landing but are so glad we did. The beauty of the mountain can only be seen from a plane.  Our pilot was super.  The takeoffs and landings were very smoothe.  We flew so close to the mountains you felt like you reach out and touch them.  We were very fortunate to have a beautiful sunny day.  It was expensive but worth every penny.  The staff at Talkeetna Air Taxi are very knowledgeable.  We had several phone conversations prior to the flight and they answered all our questions.  This flight should be part of any trip to Alaska.  We came home with poster quality pictures.

Tomamos una avioneta en Talkeetna y nos llevo a los glaciares, el paisaje era espectacular, pudimos ver la  montaña Denali "la más alta de USA desde el aire.
Aterrizamos en un glaciar, que experiencia tan linda, tomamos muchas fotos del paisaje y regresamos a Talkeetna . El tour duro más o menos tres horas.
Lo recomiendo.

review_title: once in a lifetime views and glacier landing
review_text: We booked our flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi after arriving in Talkeetna from Anchorage.  The weather was fantastic and McKinley was breathtaking in all its glory.  We landed on the glacier and celebrated our good fortune with a beer.  The mountain vistas were stunning, and our landing on the glacier was smooth.  Our pilot was a perfect tour guide, and made sure that passengers on both side of the plane got to see everything.  We lucked out with good weather and clear visibility, but Talkeetna Air Taxi did the rest.  It could not have been a better experience.  We highly recommend the Glacier Landing to anyone.

user_location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
review_text: We had booked our flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi as an extra event (non-cruise package) on our cruise and land package in Alaska. They were extremely helpful when booking the  glacier trip because my husband has a special requirement....he has a service dog.  The other air companies we talked to in Talkeetna were going to charge for the service dog on board which is against ADA rulings. Talkeetna Air Taxi made no such requirement other than getting his weight but not charging. The day we arrived was overcast and the taxi company said they might not be able to take us on the trip we had planned (landing on a glacier).  If we wanted to cancel, they said that was ok.  If we wanted to just fly out to the glaciers and weren't happy with the trip, we wouldn't have to pay.  Or we could wait and see if the clouds lifted enough to land on the glacier.  We decided to take the flight and to see what the clouds would do. The glaciers and mountains from the air are a spectacular view even in the clouds. As it worked out, there was a thirty minute period when the clouds lifted and we got to land on the glacier!!!! It was thrilling and scary at the same time. We only got to stay for fifteen minutes but it was the highlight of our trip.  Thank you, thank you to your great pilot. We would highly recommend this company not only for their service but their honesty.  We will definitely use them on our next land trip to Alaska.

review_title: Glacier landing and views from small plane were AWESOME
review_text: Best experience of our Alaska mainland week.  We took the 8-seater Otter trip to the South Face with a landing on Ruth Glacier.  Absolutely breathtaking.  And our young pilot was from the Atlanta area, where we live.  We had excellent weather, so the views were spectacular.  And getting out on the glacier was just wonderful.  Snow was soft, and our pilot had to wait until we got off before he could turn the plane around to head downhill for the takeoff.  The plane was so smooth we didn't realize we were taking off and landing.  Do not miss this.  We were there the last week in July, and that is close to the end of the season for glacier landings.  The mountain climbing season is March-June; that's when Talkeetna is at its busiest.

The Grand Denali package was my favorite experience in Alaska. As you leave Talkeetna, Denali goes from a small bump in the horizon to a behemoth filling your field of vision. There's no way to see it like from the air; the Grand Denali tour lets you see the many different faces of Denali and the glacier landing is outstanding, too. Worth a splurge!

This place was recommended by our B & B owner and it was the best!  We had the bigger plane and landed on and walked on a glacier.
This was the highlight of my Alaskan trip.  If you can afford it, do it.  It is the most amazing ride over the Alaskan mountain range, seeing some of Mt Mckinley ( the clouds hid the top) and actually walking on a glacier.

We booked the Grand Denali for Monday morning 8/18/14.  As we were driving up to Talkeetna on Sunday a TAT staff member called and told us the weather was good up on the mountain that day and if we could get there in the next few hours they would put us on a flight. She suggested that it would be better than risking the weather the next morning. We listened to the experts and got to TAT before 3pm Sunday. By 3;15 my wife and I were weighed in, picked out our glacier boots and joined our pilot and 8 others people for our flight around Denali with glacier landing. This flightseeing trip was at the top of our list for our Alaska vacation and WOW!!! It was all we had hoped for and more...and more!!! I don't have the words to describe the emotions we felt as we flew straight at Denali. You MUST experience it for yourself. The glacier landing and walk around was worth every penny. We felt completely safe with our expert pilot, Chris.  And he was very happy to snap photos for everyone on our flight while we were on the glacier. It was all so exciting that when we landed we just wanted to do it all over again. But that will be another time. And this company is so top notch customer service professional they told us when we landed that Chris had decided to not fly around the other side of Denali because of weather so they only charged us for the flight we took. I think it was a $45pp savings. Honestly, I was so excited with the flight we had, I didn't know we hadn't flown around. TAT could have kept quiet and I wouldn't have known. As it turned out the weather on Monday morning was heavy fog and rain. We would have been cancelled and would have had to reschedule later in the week. I can't say enough good things about this company.

We booked on the Grand Denali Tour with the Glacier landing, and it was worth every cent! We hesitated about the glacier landing because of the cost, but it is definitely worth doing if you can. To be able to stop in amongst it all, and take it all in, is an awesome experience. TAT are a very professional company. From the moment you book the flight till the moment you return, you know you are in good hands. We booked with TAT because of all the positive reviews - if you are doing the same at the moment, the best advice I can give is to trust what has already been written, and just book it! You won't be disappointed with your choice.

Danielle was our helicopter pilot for heli-hiking and Chris was our pilot in the Dehavilland Otter for flightseeing Denali and glacier landing.  We had a great experience with both pilots and aircraft.  No better way to see the vastness of Alaska than by air.

We did the flight over Mt. McKinley along with the glacier landing.  This was definitely our favorite part of our trip to Alaska!  It is really the only way to fully appreciate the beauty of this state.  Do not hesitate to pay the extra amount to land on the glacier.  It was incredible!!  Our pilot was top-notch...such a smooth flight!

Can't express how amazing this flightseeing was!! We did Mt. McKinley base camp with glacier landing. During the flight, I was just screaming (nobody could hear me as everyone wore headsets), the view was stunning and we were able to see Mt. McKinley so clearly! The glacier landing was also awesome and we had so much fun. The customer service was very informative and kind as well. One the best experience ever. This is definitely the best way to see Mt. McKinley!

This was a most rewarding experience, of course, the weather was perfect. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and pointed out the sights we were seeing as well as informative on the Alaskan weather, the climate, the rights of the people on settling there and etc. A great flight, smooth on takeoff and landing. The plane performed wonderfully. I would recommend this adventure to anyone visiting the Talkeetna area.

review_title: No excuse not to do this
review_text: This is an expensive splurge, especially if you are a family, but if you are going all the way to Alaska you cannot miss this; cut back on something else.  We did the Grand Denali tour with glacier landing.  For those with a fear of flying, I am afraid of flying on a jet (I take meds for this), let along going on a small plane.  However, I forced myself to do it, and boy am I glad I did.  We had an amazing crystal clear, sunny day and smooth ride; the pilot told us to go out and buy lotto tickets.  Our flight was the first of the morning because I wanted to make sure we could reschedule in case of weather.  The three of us were just rendered speechless; it is breathtaking beyond words.  We all had window seats and headphones and the pilot did a great job narrating.  You look back at the incredible photos you take and you confirm that this was just one of life's most exhilarating experiences.  Regarding cost, I suggest you keep checking their website for discounts.  I was debating whether to do the glacier landing in order to cut down on costs and was able to find a discount which basically made our glacier landing free.  I'm glad it was "free" because I felt this was the only part of the trip I could have skipped.  We landed on Ruth Glacier and while it was pretty and we got some great pictures, I felt it was underwhelming.  Because it's between the mountain peaks, I did not feel like I was "on top of the world" but only like we landed on snow.  So bottom line, do not miss this trip.  If you are going to cut back because of funds, just omit the glacier landing but find a way to do this.  You will not regret it.

review_title: Highlight of our time in Denali
review_text:
Can't say enough about how amazing this experience was. No words can really describe how surreal it was flying to the North side of Denali and seeing the Wickersham Wall and landing on a glacier. Truly an amazing experience - especially for our 11 & 7 year olds who both got to be co-pilot! 

Our pilot, Mike (from FL) was wonderful. Full of information and cool facts. Highly recommend splurging on this!

Would I have given Talkeetna Air Taxi a 5 star rating if I had not seen Mt. McKinley?  Probably.  We were able to book an impromptu flight on a beautiful sunny, blue sky day.  Pilot was very professional and friendly.  We hung out on the glacier and laughed when another pilot (from another airline) needed our help because his rudder was stuck.  We have photos of Denali that could be in National Geographic.

The schedule was a bit backed up after a few days of bad weather, but these folks handled things with professionalism, courtesy and good humor. We never felt out of the loop while waiting or rushed when the weather finally cleared.  First-rate equipment and pilots (I'm a pilot, too, so I'm picky about such things).  You can book a flight here with confidence that your safety, comfort and enjoyment are paramount.  Spendy, yes; but you'll have absolutely no regrets -- only great memories of a phenomenal flight into stupendous scenery. Go for it!

The glacier landing was the highlight of our Alaskan vacation. Clear, sunny skies made for an exceptional flight. Our pilot was very experienced and his commentary was so informative.  We felt safe at all times. If you're skeptical about doing this just go for it!  You will not regret it.

review_title: Beautiful Day for a Glacier Landing and Viewing Mount McKinley
review_text: The experience was once in a lifetime for my son and me. It just so happen to be a clear and sunny day. We landed on the Ruth glacier and had spectacular views of Mount McKinley. The staff (Vikki, Trent, and Beverly) was very friendly and accommodating.

I booked the South face McKinley tour with glacier landing for my parents' first visit to Alaska. I'm an Alaska resident and have seen a good bit of the state, most of it from bush planes. That said, this was still a thrill and a half for my parents and for me, too! Many other reviewers have said the same, but this truly was, without a doubt, the highlight of the trip. Our pilot (Trent), made the tour safe, exciting, and informative. We were given great views from both sides of the plane (including a brief glimpse of a black bear!!) and the glacier landing was just amazing. Trent also went above and beyond by helping my 80 year-old father, who has limited mobility, into and out of the plane both at the airport and on the glacier. If you are dithering because of the price, don't worry, you will in no way regret the money spent on this tour.

review_title: A Must Activity while in Alaska
review_text: This tour was prearranged for me through Alaska Adventure Tours (which also deserves 5 of 5!)  The flight was amazing!  The pilot spoke continually to ensure his passengers knew what we were seeing.  He made certain both sides of the plane faced Denali and the other mountains nearby.
