He made a skillful glacier landing, proceeded to play photographer for his passengers.  After a rather lengthy visit on the glacier, he flew us out of the glacier valley.  On our trip back to the airport, he flew safely over areas of the range that black bears frequented.  He made certain the each passenger saw the bear(s) then flew us back over the amazing scenery.  I went on this fantastic adventure in September 2014, and highly recommend this time of year PLUS Talkeetna Air Taxi to give you memories of your lifetime.

We booked with Talkeetna Air Taxi 90 days prior to our Cruise to Alaska in late August 2014.  We did not know what to expect.  This excursion was the highlight of our two week Alaskan adventure.  The staff was incredible.  Warm and endearing.  The Pilot showed his love of flying as well as his love of Alaska with the passion that he spoke with.  The weather was perfect and Mt. McKinley was majestic.  Anyone going to Alaska should book with Talkeetna Air Taxi!  You won't be disappointed.

The best time of my life. Amazing day with beautiful vista's and best of all the Glacier landing. It looked like a picture from a fantasy movie. Fantastic pilot and aircraft that made us feel safe and secure. We would highly recommend this trip for anyone traveling to the area. Simply the best.

Adoramos o passeio, e imperdível.
O local e um pouco tosco e nos deixou apreensivos, assim como o aviao que é bem antigo, mas a vontade de ir era grande.
Não nos arrependemos, o passeio é maravilhoso, vale cada minuto e cada centavo pago.
A parada no glacial vale a pena, é o ponto alto do passeio.
As paisagens sao deslumbrantes e as fotos e filmagens ficaram maravilhosas.
Fizemos o passeio intermediario e como estavamos em 4 pessoas nos deram 10% de desconto sobre o preço de tabela.
Recomendo muito fazer apesar de ser um pouco caro vale muito a pena.

We had a perfect day for the trip. Sunny, no wind and the mountains were clear of any clouds. Flying between the mountains and seeing the snow, glaciers and ice formations is impoosible to describe. Pay the extra money for the glacier landing it is worth it. Did the grand denali tour our pilot was very knowledgeable

Lucked out- no reservation-perfect day- flew to base of Denali and landed on a glacier-pilot totally nonchalant- said he's done it 100's of times-did admit it was a rare day-totally clear - they upgraded me from the basic trip-don't know why-maybe overbooked it-unforgettable experience

Nancy and I took a flight with Talkeetna air around Mt. McKinley on 8-19-14.  Absolutely fantastic.
The weather was perfect and our pilot was excellent ( I am a licensed pilot and know a good pilot when I witness one).  The office staff was also very welcoming and helpful.  Excellent value for the buck.  Something you really need to do- a definite "bucket lister."

Look at the reviews.  Look at the pictures.  They are all understatements of the amazing, fabulous, exciting and thrilling time you will have on this trip.  It is really expensive.  Do It Anyway!!!  We spent two weeks in Alaska and took over 6,000 pictures on some truly amazing side trips.  But this one was the best of them all as voted on by the people that matter (my family).  Do the glacier landing.  Bring as many cameras and video cameras as you can carry.  It was like living in a National Geographic documentary for two hours.  Just close your eyes and hand them your credit card, and when you land you will think you paid too little.

review_title: Fantastic customer service and awesome tour
review_text:
It rained the first day we had the trip scheduled and had to therefore cancel it. The staff moved us to the next day. It continued raining and we were placed on a floating waitlist and refunded our deposit. The best part was that, inspite of this, they have graciously offered us a ride to our B&B from the train station and again to the alaska lodge the next morning. Very very nice of them. The taxi service in Talkeetna, aparantly runs only after 7:00 PM and without a car we were worried of making our way to catch the motorcoach. Their help is really appreciated. 

After the weather cleared up, we came back a couple of days later to take the grand denali tour with glacier landing. The views were majestic. If one can afford, this is a must do in the Denali area.

Wonderful and beautiful trip!  Our pilot Mark took us on a very smooth and beautiful flight to Ruth Glacier.  This was the highlight of our trip.  We landed on the glacier after about a half hour flight from Talkeetna.  The scenery was just so beautiful.  We even got to play in the snow and do our ALS challenge for Facebook with snow being poured over us.  This Air Taxi service is very professional and also gave us a military discount as my husband is retired Navy.  You must do this if you are in this area!  Can't say enough good things about it!

The trip that I booked was rained out. The people at TALKEETNA AIR TAXI let my reservation slide until the following Saturday. I showed up early and they put me on the next flight. Jonathan was our pilot. Great guy. Extremely knowledgeable about the mountains, glaciers, rivers and Alaska. The trip from take off to landing was awesome! Denali is beautiful! And huge!  Jonathan told us about glacial movement and how big they really are. Perspective from a plane is different
Landing on the glacier is a rush. Walking in a foot of snow in August was fun.
There are no bad seats on the plane. The pilot flies by twice so both sides of the plane can see. Of course the view is spectacular out of either side. I am ready to do it again!

This flight was the highlight of our 9 days in Alaska.  We were originally signed up for a one hour flightseeing, but when we arrived they asked if we "would mind" a complimentary glacial landing - Um, no I don't think so!  Apparently another couple had signed up for the same time and instead of taking 2 flights they combined ours.  I am so glad we had the experience to land on the glacier.  It would have been an amazing flight without it, but honestly landing on it and walking around made it extra special. Spend the extra money and do the landing!  If you are hesitant about flying in a small plane, I would say there was nothing to be afraid of.  It was not the least bit scary and was so beautiful being up close to the mountains.  This should definitely be added to your itinerary when you visit Alaska!

Upon hearing that our scheduled plane was stuck on the Glacier, All-Star Annie from Talkeetna Air Taxi called a quick audible and upgraded our flight with another local service so we could seize this incredibly blue sky day during our brief but adventurous time in the Last Frontier, Alaska.

We had planned on a flight around the summit of Mt McKinley.  We were called 60 mins before our scheduled time, informed that storms were coming and that if we could get there right away we could still go. So we went.  They informed us that we needed to take a different plane and our flight plan would be different, we would get a free glacier landing instead. My wife took a little bit of convincing ( nervous about landing on a glacier) 
It was absolutely the highlight of a 17 day trip, 7 day cruise, and 8 days in AK. plus travel. The weather cleared as predicted by the staff, and was beautiful at the top. Boy did we see McKinley. It was 60 degrees felt like 75 degrees. 360 panoramic view. Walked around on a snow covered slope for 20 ,mins to 1/2 hr. Best money I ever spent. The Pilot was superb, friendly, informative. He explained about all the scenery, Mts, glaciers etc we were seeing, turned the plane back and forth so we could all get the views, No air sickness for me, and I get sick in the back seat of a car.
Would highly suggest a glacier landing if you can make the time. And would recommend Talkeetna Air.

What a fantastic tour of the glaciers, and Mt. McKinley was in its awesome majesty.  It was a  perfectly clear and beautiful day.  David, our pilot, is an excellent tour guide with so much information about the mountains and glaciers, and I believe he was having as much fun as we were seeing the mountains and glaciers on such a clear day!  Walking on the glacier was an experience to behold.  It definitely was a highlight of our trip!  I heartily recommend the glacier air experience!!!  The staff is very friendly and accommodating!

I wish I remembered the name of the pilot just to tell him how amazing he is!!! This guy will take you so close to the mountain that you won't believe it! Land on the glacier as well is worth it the trip! That's pilot for this once in a life experience! Must do definitely!
This man literally made my trip to Alaska. He flew so close to the mountain but you never felt in danger. He made sure everyone was safe and the view was spectacular.

It was absolutely amazing!!!!  Mike, our pilot, was awesome!   He was very knowledgeable and very personal!  What a wonderful young man!  The experience of flying around the mountains and landing on the Root Glacier at the base of Denali was magnificent!!!! Its hard to explain in words of how fantastic this trip was.  This trip will truly be a very special memory for me and my husband for the rest of our lives.

review_title: Denali area flight seeing with glacier landing
review_text: We scheduled this trip in Talkeetna, and drove a short distance to the airport, and boarded the plane with 3 add'l

review_title: Up in the sky and it felt great
review_text:
We celebrated our 35 anniversary with a flight and landing on the glacier. It passes all our expectations, from the moment we arrived, the nice people that welcomed us, the lovely pilot, the nice airplane and..... What a view... No words to explain. We felt like we can touch the glacier through the window of the plane.
The landing was great, it was a shiny day, the glacier was magnificent and it felt great walking on it.

Very very recommended

review_title: How many 5-star reviews do you need?
review_text: My second time with TAT. I brought my family this time. Absolutely incredible experience flying around the Alaska Range and landing on the Root Glacier at the base of Denali. Friendly courteous staff and a knowledgeable pilot (Alex). An epic family experience!

We were so thrilled with young Chris as our pilot. We felt that he personalized our tour for the overall group. What an amazing young man. I was so excited that we got a chance to fly on the otter. Such a cool airplane. I am an aviation enthusiast and I think he felt a special need to show me around the plane and explain every intricate detail of how special the otter is to him. I thought my questions where a little annoying, but he answered everything with genuine enthusiasm. Thanks young Chris!

The day couldn't have been better.  The flight and the narration by our well-versed pilot Jonathan were exceptional.  This was a trip-of-a-lifetime and the experience that my sister, her husband and I shared on Saturday was amazing, beautiful, fun, etc.  From the time we made the reservation until we left to go home, we were treated so well by the staff. Landing on the glacier was so exciting and then walking around, staring at Mt. McKinley, and just breathing that fresh air; words escape me.  I will definitely recommend this trip to anyone traveling to Alaska.  It's a winner!

Our first trip was canceled due to weather but we were able to come back before the end of our visit.  Staff was great....pilot was very good and gave us a great tour.  Make sure you do the glacier landing, well worth the extra $$$!!!   We took about 275 pictures during the flight....everything looked like a postcard.   

Remember that weather is your biggest problem...try to have an extra day available to do the things you might not have been able to hit on the first try.

It was a real once in lifetime experience. So pristine that you could feel nature talking to you . I'm thankful to God for the favorable weather  and the pilot was amazing . I'm glad that I did this trip.

This was an once in a lifetime kind of experience! Jonathan, our pilot and guide, was super.  He was a wealth of information and named off the peaks like they were names of his buddies. He also told us some fun stories about different folks climbs and a lot of history of the area as we flew over. We weren't sure we were going to be able to land on a glacier due to the weather but it happened. My husband and I couldn't stop talking about our experience for the next two days. If you have the opportunity to fly with Talkeetna Air Taxi, you must experience the wonder and amazement!

This is a real must do!  we were so lucky with the weather which made an amazing trip even more awesome.  All very well organised and our take off and landing couldn't have been any smoother.  Wonderful flight around the mountain.  Pilot commentary excellent.  Lots of great photo opportunities.  Was great to be able to get out on glacier and spend time just looking around.  Would highly recommend.

We hoped to land on a glacier but the weather was just too bad.  They hoped that it would be good enough to land but it just didn't happen.  We were in the air for about 45 minutes seeing some beautiful scenery but because we  didn't land --- they didn't charge us ANYTHING!  
I'd recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi anytime!  Great people!

review_title: Talkeetna Air Taxi to Mt McKinley and Ruth Glazier
review_text:
Go to be the highlight of our twelve day stay in Alaska.  To see the beauty of Mt McKinley from the air was so much better than viewing it from the ground up.  We had a wonderful time on our Southface Mt McKinley Flightsee that also included the optional landing on Ruth Glazier.   The staff was very easy to work with to reserve our flight in advance a few weeks earlier.  Can do this via internet or toll free 800 number. 

The flight was very smooth on our six passenger plane plus the pilot.  All of us received headphones so we could talk to and hear our pilot narrate our flight.   We were fortunate to have a very clear day, not a cloud in the sky.  After take off, we made the short flight to Mt Mckinley circle the south face and then headed for our smooth snow landing on Ruth Glacier.  The total flight was just under two hours with one half hour of this walking around Ruth Glacier after we landed.  

Talkeenta Air Taxi offers a 10% AAA discount and also will reduce the price $10 per person if you already have a National Park Pass ($10 one time cost for a lifetime pass if over age 62 from US National Park Service.)

 As tours go this is a little pricing but if you came to Alaska to see it, pay them the money for a lifetime of great memories and photos.   Would do it again in a heartbeat. 

 Before or after your flight be sure to spend some time in the town of Talkeetna.  A great little town with several good restaurants and shops to explore.   Town was the settling for old TV series, Northern Exposure.  Still very nice place to visit and view Mt McKinley from a distance.

We we treated to a exciting , beautiful trip on a plane ride around Mt Mckinley and glacier landing. Pilot was extremely friendly and skillful. Company did everything in their power to help change reservations for us and make our adventure successful. Highly recommend this company for your vacation.

Great experience for our family of four.  My wife was a little nervous about the safety but the pilot (Alex) was very calm and reassuring. My son got to ride in the cockpit. As you are flying above and between the peaks, over rivers and glaciers, through clouds then out to open sun, you are wondering where the heck is he going to land but then they set down very smoothly and it is neat to walk around (they give you waterproof boots to cover your shoes) in snow in the middle of summer. 
If you are a group of four be sure to order the "northern lights" coupon book as there is a buy three, get one free coupon that far exceeds the cost of the book.

Put this on your Bucket List of must things to do. Hard to describe just how "Beautiful" the Denali National Park really is. It was an absolute thrill to land on a Glacier at 5,500 feet. If you are in the area spend some money with these fine people. It is worth every penny!

review_title: Excited to join "the 30% club" after all!
review_text:
We were in the Denali area for 4 days without any luck to actually see Mt. McKinley, and were counting on this flight to finally see it. It was a clear day in Talkeetna, but still hard to see Denali from town. Our pilot and the people at the office told us not to worry, that we should be able to see it once we are up in the air, and boy they were right!! I was sooooooooo happy to finally see Mt. McKinley as we got closer.  Finally I joined the club!!   As I've heard a million times before, the mountain itself creates its own climate, so once you get closer, the weather changes! Finally I got to experience what everyone had been telling us all along and understand the true meaning of it. I guess it is one of the charms of Denali. 

So for me, just being able to see Mt. McKinley itself before we left town was worth every penny. We did the Grand Denali tour with the Glacier landing. Landing on the glacier and standing on it yourself not only gives you an oppurtunity to take great pictures of Mt. McKinley, but also gives you a better understanding of this unique mountain range area. I was glad that we made the right decision to add the landing after all. Without it, this experience would not be complete. So if you are like me and thinking about the extra bucks you can save without, I urge you to consider skipping a fancy dinner or two instead to fit your budget.  Also, if you are a AAA member, be sure to mention it for a 10% discount!

Once in a lifetime airplane ride.  We went on the Base Camp trip with the glacier option.  The flight was pretty smooth and our pilot was great.  We had a clear day and were able to see Mt. McKinley numerous times.  The glacier landing was pretty cool and I would not pass that option up.  We were on the glacier for about 20 minutes and our pilot took pictures for us.  There seems to be a lot of competitors out there but the price we paid was the lowest I could find and we had no regrets.  I would highly recommend this company.

My family stated this was the best thing we did on our trip to Alaska, We booked the Grand Denali tour with glacier landing. This trip was to provide various views of Mt. McKinley. There were some times when those of us sitting in the third and fourth rows could not see what our pilot was talking about. (There were 4 of us and I purchased a Northern Lights coupon book that gave us 1 person free.)  We boarded a plane with 2 other tourists and our guide. The flight was smooth, the day clear. Mt. McKinley could be seen throughout the trip. The glacier landing was amazing. After 15 mins we boarded the plane again. This was the worst part of the trip. The step was quite high and several of us had difficulty making it back into the cabin. There really should be some type of small step stool provided to assist guests. I wacked my leg on the way up, very painful. Aside from this, the trip was worth every penny as this is a once in a lifetime opportunity. As my husband said, most people don't ever get to see a glacier let alone land on one!
This is a great once-in-a-lifetime experience. Chris was a excellent pilot and landings were smooth. Had a spectacular view of Denali from the glacier on a beautiful day.

review_title: Unforgetable plane ride and landing on glacier
review_text: This was a once-in-a-lifetime ride in a small airplane to see Mt. McKinley and land on a glacier.  The views were spectacular and landing on a glacier was icing on the cake!!

Tremendous  flight on a prefect day!!  This is the second time in several years that we have done this flight seeing trip with TAT since we live in Alaska.  This time with our grandsons who enjoyed the trip especially landing on the glacier where they enjoyed make snowballs.  This is definitely a must do for a trip to Alaska.  The scenery and the views from the plane were exceptional, many glaciers close up and shear mountain peaks.  Some of the planes are a little tricky to get in an out of with my bad knee but it worked.  We had a group of 7 and we filled the whole plane.   The TAT staff and pilots are all very friendly and helpful. They do provide boots to where for the snow on the glacier. A camera with a zoom lens is a must but you don't have room for camera bags or backpacks on the planes.
  I think flying from Talkeetna is the best option, it is the closet to Denali Mt.  If you are short on time you could fly with an other companies from Anchorage but cost is higher and time near Denali would be limited.  Since weather is always a factor I always try to schedule my flight seeing on the way up to Denali park in case weather cancels the flight then maybe I can reschedule on the way back

Awesome...spectacular.....amazing....beautiful.....awesome.....DON'T MISS THIS !!!!  See nature at its most awesome. Travel to almost 12000 feet to climb over these fantastic mountains and glaciers, fly with 100 feet of them and then LAND ON A GLACIER !!! TOTALLY AWESOME to see earth's mountainous wonders and the erosion and break down of these monsters of beauty....and then ride shotgun home.....Talkeetna Taxi has made my trip.  We didn't get to see a lot of the peaks because of cloud cover but what we did see was to me, jaw dropping. The crew and customer service are superb....don't fly with anyone else

review_title: Better price than Princess excursions AND the highlight of our trip!!
review_text: This is a must do trip!!!  Charge it and pay it off slowly. skip dinner, wear the same clothes a little longer, eat pasta for a year, this is worth EVERY PENNY!!!  During our 24 hours in the area, the clouds parted and we sprung into action trying to book a flight and glacier landing.  The Princess excursions were all booked, but they recommended calling Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Their prices were better and they were extremely accommodating working with our schedule and 9 people to make sure we had an incredible experience!   The staff was friendly, the pilot was extremely knowledgeable of the area and highly qualified to fly!  The view was UNBELIEVABLE, BREATHTAKING and something we will all (aged 10 to 76) NEVER forget!  There are no words or pictures to describe the beauty!

I recently traveled with 6 of my friends and the day we had planned the flights was almost a wash. There was no visibility on the road and it was raining pretty hard. Since we were driving to Denali that day we stopped by the Talkeetna taxi to see if they could reschedule it for us or give us our money back... 

Folks at Talkeetna Air Taxi were very very accommodating and helpful and rearranged a few tours for us so that we could fly 2 days later as well..  Eventually when we flew.. there was not a single cloud in the sky!! and we had the best sightseeing one could hope for of Mt Mckinley!!  Really appreciate the effort folks at Talkeetna air taxi took to help us out and giving us an amazing Mckinley tour!!

Un très bon service à la clientèle avec un pilote très gentil. La vue est vraiment incroyable et on peut même atterrir sur un glacier! Faites attention, la température peut jouer un peu sur l'horaire mais ils sont très accomodants et si le tour d'avion n'est pas possible, il n'y a pas de problème à reporter si vous avez un peu de plexibilité dans votre horaire et même annuler si cela est impossible pour vous. Dans tous les cas, ça vaut vraiment la peine, c'était vraiment incroyable!

Talkeetna Air Taxi was excellence pure. From the friendly and efficient first contact right through to the flightseeing tour of Denali, Mount MacKinley and glacier landing. I felt totally in safe hands and the scenery was so beautiful I nearly cried. If you have a budget try and incorporate this tour into it, it will give you memories that will last a life time.

We took the plane ride around McKinley.  It was awesome.  The flight was a bit pricey, but it was well worth it.  Landing on the glacier was quite an experience.  IT seemed like we could reach out and touch the peaks as we flew over and around them.  We'd spend this money again!  Things were well organized and ran on time.

review_title: The highlight of our Alaska trip
review_text: The flightseeing tour we took with Talkeetna Air Taxi was the best part of our trip. The landscape we saw was incredible to say the least. The weather was perfect and our pilot (Bruce) was very personable and narated the whole trip. He even took pics for us on the glacier. I recomend "Don,t skip the flightseeing". Its well worth the cost!!

Our fly over Denali with a glacier landing was the high light to our Alaskan adventure. We booked their 8:30 am flight which offers a discount. Take advantage of the discount if you don't mind the early morning!  We could not have picked a more perfect day. Sunny and clear. While just the day before it was rainy and foggy and our initial flight was cancelled.  This experience is well worth the $$$.

"Steve in town was great, offering to book us earlier given weather conditions. Great guy.
At the office, young blonde girl could not have been more accommodating, actually encouraging us to ask people who had just returned before deciding.
Brian the pilot was very informative, and personable.
You must do the glacier landing so book online and get a deal.
Yes its pricey. But its REAL and its Spectacular!

This was for sure the highlight of our trip.  I had originally not scheduled to do the glacier landing, but because of the scheduling with others on the same flight we ended up doing that as well.  FOR SURE do the glacier landing.  It was amazing.   

The planes are very well maintained, and our flight was very smooth, except landing on a glacier is a little bumpy.  no big deal though.

The operators of this were most accommodating,  because of weather conditions, low clouds, and light drizzle we were told they could not guarantee how much we could do or see, and we could re-schedule.  If we decided to go, and our trip changed or was cut short, they would refund the difference.   Ours was cut short, but not by much, and we go a refund for a portion of the trip.

Even with the weather the way it was, it was awesome.   You do not need perfect sunny weather to do this trip.  We had a great tour, and I think we were out for over an hour the way it was.  The 60 mile flight over to the Denali range was really impressive as well.

This was a spectacular trip.  You need deep pockets to take this tour, especially, if you have a large family or party, but everyone will remember this for a lifetime.  The pilots are very skilled at flying this route and plane, knowledgeable and friendly, explaining everything along the way.  I suggest skipping something else and putting your money down on this excursion.  Go ahead and splurge with a glacier landing.  Whether or not you are ever going to return to Alaska you must do this at least once.  Too, I need to give a shout out to the management.  Initially there was a mix up in the charges for the trip.  The management immediately called me back and straightened it out. This was a great customer service as I would most likely not have noticed.  Make sure that you book the trip for the beginning of your stay, just in case the weather is bad and you have to push to another day.

review_title: A once in a lifetime experience
review_text: The flight over Denali National Park was wonderful, and the highlight of our trip to Alaska. Since I tend to suffer from motion sickness, I was worried about stability/turbulence. Absolutely no problem! Be sure to do the glacier landing; you will not believe his warm it is on the glacier.

review_title: Highlight of our 16 day Alaska trip!
review_text: We booked with Talkeetna Air Taxi based on the recommendation of our tour agent Colette of Rainbow Mountain Adventures and we were amazed.  This experience was not only the highlight of our trip, it was one of my greatest experiences of all time!  We were on the last flight of the day and the weather had been iffy.  Most of the flights were not able to land on the glacier that day and we almost rebooked for the next morning.  The wonderful staffed talked us in to taking the flight and WOW, what an experience!  The flight up to and around Denali was awe-inspiring, we saw all of the glaciers and Chris, our pilot, pointed out the trail that the climbers use and much more.  I assumed we would have to return to the airport, but instead we landed on Thunder glacier, miles of virgin snow, not one track or footprint.  As we all stood and absorbed the gorgeous sights and listened to the glaciers sounding in the distance, all was right with the world!  Everyone on board including Chris was ecstatic!  This very professional company goes out of their way to satisfy customers while still being safe.  As anyone who has traveled around Alaska knows (and we quickly learned) you can always predict that the weather will be unpredictable.  If you ever get a chance take this once in a lifetime flight, it is a must do!

we were not able to do the landing on a glacier, due to fog and low cloud cover.  The views and experience was still Fantastic!  We did get above the clouds and got to see Denali, below the clouds we saw glaciers, and Mtn sides.. beautiful.  The pilot was very good, he tried to find spots for us to get our glacier landing in, but the weather wasn't with us...

First of all, I believe this would be an amazing tour if the weather was good. If the weather has the mountains socked in, it would be an OK tour if you have never been on or seen a glacier. I have both hiked on and flown over a glacier before, so this tour was pretty average and not worth the full price (there's no weather discount, even though you only see a smaller portion of the scenery). If there is weather, all you see are glaciers and small mountains (the 7k-9k kind). Really the only reason why I came here was to see Denali, I was hoping for just a glimpse- maybe the bottom half, or bottom third, or middle third, or top 1/8, or even middle 1/10- saw nothing at all....On another note the pilot was nice. The guy he let sit co-pilot was cursing over the microphone, I couldn't stand it so I had to take off my headset- I probably missed some good narration. TAT, please spare me the cookie cutter weather notice reply, I've seen them on the other reviews, thanks.

review_title: Best excursion of our Alaska trip!
review_text: My parents, husband and 7-year-old daughter enjoyed the McKinley Base Camp tour with Glacier landing on July 18, 2014 and it was by far our favorite excursion of our 2-week Alaska vacation.  The weather was cloudy that day and the office staff was upfront with us and said we may not be able to land on a glacier.  Once we boarded the plane we could tell that our pilot, Chris, was going to do everything possible to ensure a safe glacier landing.  He was in constant contact with the other pilots to evaluate the current conditions.  Sure enough we were able to land on a glacier and had an amazing time.  The views of Mt. McKinley up close were unforgettable.  Would highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi.  I should also mention that we were on a Princess Cruise trip and I was able to save about $100 a ticket by booking directly through Talkeetna over the pricing for the Princess tour.  Be sure to check the "Specials" tab on the web site.

Booked a flight due to their webcam on Denali.Had Alex for a pilot. Smooth & graceful flying.Unbelievable views of Denali. Was close & clear. If I get back in the area. Will be on top of list to do this again

review_title: Do it!  Grand Denali Tour was incredible!
review_text: Our pilot Chris said we had one of the best days he'd ever seen to experience the Grand Denali Tour.  Simply stunning views, flew through all sorts of incredible spaces and the glacier landing was a once in a lifetime experience.  On the way back, Chris let my 5 year old be the co-pilot, which he LOVED.  Not inexpensive but totally, totally worth it.

We were so blessed to have the wonderful experience of seeing Mt. McKinley up close and personal.  We had a beautiful clear day and the mountain was exquisite.  We had an 8 a.m. flight and actualy saw McKinley on our way to the airport in Talkeetna.   Paul was our pilot and he was very professional, informative and friendly.  The 4 of us in our group each had their own headphone and could ask questions.  Paul told us all about the mountains, glaciers, lakes etc.  This might be the only way you will see "the big one".  If you buy a Milepost guide book there is a note for $20 off per person on a flight.  That saved our group $80.  What a wonderful way to spend our 41st anniversary - looking at God's creation from above!

This was so brilliant that you won't believe what you saw after you see the photos you've captured! Even if you drop your camera, the photo will definitely be gorgeous! It's that pretty! I was quite wary of the flight since the plane was quite small and I hadn't traveled in such planes prior to this one but the flight was really smooth and frankly, once you're looking out the window, you'd normally forget your peeves! The landing on the glacier was smooth and cool too! They provided us with boots to walk on the glacier! Brilliant photos were taken here! Major highlight of our trip! One must do this in Alaska for this is possible nowhere else!

Be sure to plan to make this part of your visit to Alaska! Seeing this beautiful land from the air is a once-in-a-lifetime experience! I must admit that I am a nervous flyer, but I did not want to miss the trip. Talkeetna Air Taxi staff provided helpful information about the trip and even booties to keep our feet dry on the glacier landing! The pilot was skilled and professional and provided a nice tour without being overly chatty. He took photos for us with Mt. McKinley in the background. It was the highlight of our trip! We were able to book a trip the same day (got there first thing in the morning) but from what I understand if they don't fly, you don't pay.

This was really difficult to rate.  The experience itself (flying around Denali and landing on a glacier) is a full 5 star experience.  If there was no other operator in Talkeetna, I would have rated this company higher, just based on how cool the experience is.  (If you are wondering whether or not to splurge on a flight around Denali - do it, it's AMAZING).  But this is a review of Talkeetna Air Taxi - the tour operator, not just a review of the scenic flight, and honestly, I wasn't that impressed with TAT.

After reading all the positive reviews, I chose to book with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  I completed the online booking form and entered my credit card info.  When I received my confirmation a few days later, I noted I had been scheduled for a different day than requested.  Not the end of the world - I contacted the company, they apologized and rescheduled me for the correct day - but if I hadn't read my confirmation carefully, I'm sure it would been a much bigger deal to fix the day I was supposed to fly.  Then about a week later, I received a voicemail letting me know they had needed to change the time of my flight - but the time they told me it was changed to was the time they had told me in the first place.  Again, no big deal, but it did make me wonder how organized they were.

When my family arrived at the office on the day of our flight it was quite chaotic.  People were landing and trying to buy t-shirts, people were checking in and needing to fill out forms and get weighed.  When my turn to check in arrived, I asked how the weather was expected to be.  I received a curt - "your flight will be fine" in response.  I was asking, because we had planned to be in Talkeetna for a couple of days and had booked our flight right at the start so that we could postpone/reschedule if weather dictated.  I got the feeling they were just too busy to talk to me.

Our flight was delayed by about 10 minutes, again - not a big deal, but we were waiting outside in the cold rain for those 10 minutes and no one from the company provided us with any information.

There was heavy cloud cover when we took off.  During the first portion of our flight, the clouds completely enveloped the plane - nothing but white-out conditions outside my window.  I have to tell you - I was nervous!  Denali and the mountains around it stuck up out of the cloud cover and so the main portion of our flight was still amazing.  The return was also completely clouded in.  I do wish I had the opportunity to talk about the weather before the flight.  Maybe they would have convinced me this was still the best chance, given how changeable the weather is, but since I never got to discuss it with them, I just don't know.

My other big complaint was that the pilot provided almost no commentary during the flight.  He seemed a competent pilot, but he wasn't at all personable.  There were many points during the flight where I really didn't know what I was looking at.  I would have preferred an audio recording to the silence we mostly got.  It also would have been nice for him to give a reassuring "don't worry about the clouds around Talkeetna, you'll see Denali just fine," during the first portion of the flight.  I am particularly contrasting this experience to the wonder commentary provided by the pilot during my Misty Fjords scenic flight.

I know this review sounds fairly negative.  I wasn't really that bad, I'm just balancing it against how much the trip cost and how many other operators there are that offer the same service.  If you are anywhere near Talkeetna, you should definitely do a scenic flight around Denali and spend the extra to land on a glacier - it truly is an amazing experience.  My experience with Talkeetna Air Taxi was perfectly adequate, but that's all.

Great hospitality! ! Had reservations for a flight seeing trip, but needed transportation from our B &B.  They graciously offered to pick us up, along with our luggage.   If you are looking for a flight seeing tour, this is the company to use.  True professionals! 
Dan E. Feasterville,  PA

I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi for a trip of a lifetime.  The views are stunning and Dave, our pilot, made sure we got to see them all.  Annie and the crew in the office were fun too not to mention efficient both when setting up our flight but also at check-in!  Well done and thanks for a wonderful day!!!  We will be back!

My wife and I flew on a siteseeing flight during the last week of May,2014. The flight was very smooth, no clouds, and a great view. Our pilot was great, professional and informed us of all the sights of the mountain range. Oh, Yes, we did land on a glacier at the foot of Mt. McKinley.
The office staff was wonderful and informative. Talkeetna Air Taxi is the place to go. The price is worth the trip.

review_title: The Highlight of our 2 weeks in Alaska
review_text:
All the reviews here are right - our flight, glacial landing and overall experience here was without question the highlight of our 2 weeks in Alaska.

Brilliant blue skies and warm temperatures helped our experience, but while expensive, if you do visit Alaska / Talkeetna / Denali area - this is a must do - an experience you will never forget.

TAT took great care of us.  Our reserved day and flight was rained out, and they did everything possible to get us up in the air.  We were rescheduled for another day and did get to see Denali.  Unfortunately the weather didn't allow us the glacier landing, but our pilot tried VERY hard to find a place to land.  I agree with all the other great reviews.  Everyone at TAT was professional and over-the-top with helping to make this a great experience for our family of 5.  The trip was a highlight of our vacation, and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a flight seeing tour.  You will NOT regret it.

review_title: TAT was there the weather wasn't
review_text:
Tried twice, in early July, to fly with TAT on the Grand Denali tour with a glacier landing, but weather conditions both days were not the best. On both occasions the staff at TAT told us what to expect and worked with us to re-book the first flight and finally, needing to be elsewhere in AK, cancel the second flight.

Although, I can't comment on their flying abilities I can easily report that their ground/reservation staff was very customer friendly and provided great service. Next time I'm up in Talkeetna I'll try again to fly around Denali and won't hesitate booking with Talkeetna Air Taxi..

A 5-circle rating of TAT doesn't do justice to the quality of my experience with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  My wife and I went on the Grand Denali Tour with Glacier Landing.  Flying around Denali and landing on Ruth Glacier were the highlights of our two weeks in Alaska. Nothing but superlatives apply to the desk staff, ground crew, pilot and aircraft.  This is a group of professionals who believe in safety first, then giving their clients a truly memorable adventure.

When planning our trip to Alaska I didn't include any helicopter or plane rides, prices seemed so high.  After hearing someone talk about their experience with Talkeetna Air Taxi, we had to do it!  It was sooo worth the money, breathtaking views of the glaciers and mountains all around us while flying there and back, got to see Mt. McKinley up close, land and take off on a glacier.  I can honestly say this was the highlight of our trip!  A must do!
We saw such wonderful sights around Mt Denali. Our pilot Alex was so informative and knowlegable about the area. The staff in the office were friendly and enthusiastic. Best part of our trip!!!!!

This tour was taken by my daughter and son in law this time.  My wife and I had taken it before,and watched our 11 month old grandson so they could do it this time.  We told them if they did nothing else on their week long trip to Alaska, they should fly around Mt McKinley and land on the Ruth Glacier.  They completely agreed after seeing it for themselves.  It may be somewhat expensive, but it is really worth all it costs.  Standing on top of the Ruth Glacier is almost out of this world.  We would definitely suggest spending the extra money to do the glacier landing.  Lunch at the Talkeetna Roadhouse was a great place to watch our grandson.

Oh my gosh!  Highlight of our trip.  We did the McKinley base camp flight and it was breathtaking, inspirational, beautiful flight.  We kep going back and forth over whether we should pay the extra for the glacier landing.  SO GLAD WE DID!  Best part of the flight! Landed at a location with magnificent views of McKinley.  We lucked out and had a beautiful, clear day.  Couldn't have been better!

Quite possibly the highlight of our week.  Our  glacier landing was flawless.  A very smooth ride, along with the relevant information about the history of this region of Alaska,  Our pilot was extremely friendly and professional.

This was to be the highlight of my our two Alaskan adventure, and I can say it was! When we got to Talkeetna on a beautiful sunny afternoon, we stopped into their shop to see where we caught our flight the next morning. The gentleman behind the desk gave us directions to the airport, but then suggested that if we were flexible, we try to fly that day, since the weather was so nice. We took his advice, and got our trip moved to that afternoon. The sky clouded over a bit during the hour between that conversation and our actual flight, but it was still an experience of a lifetime. Our pilot, Chris, was informative, funny and highly skilled. I was amazed and never once felt unsettled or nervous. He gave us a great tour of Mr. Foraker, Mt. Hunter, and Denali before settling us down on the Pika glacier for our glacier landing. On the flight back to town, he went down through the lush valley, looking for moose. Truly an amazing experience, and I am so, so glad that we did it!

We were scheduled for the afternoon flight but they advised us that there had been no landing on the Glaciers for two days. So, we postponed to the next morning.  We took off shortly after 8:30AM with Pilot Jonathan Kincaid.  After some great sightseeing of the mountains and the Base Camp, we landed on Pika Glacier.  Smooth landing with four other planes already there and 2-3 behind us.

It was Awesome!

We came back below 2,000 feet due to the low cloud ceiling but the landing was again super smooth.

Highly recommended!

The staff at Talkeetna Air Taxi from front office to our pilot (the owner, Paul) provided exemplary service! 

Our flight was supposed to be with a glacier landing, but when I saw Denali in all her beauty and glory, landing on a glacier became secondary. We were unable to do the glacier landing due to the cloud cover, but Denali herself rose out of the clouds and provided absolutely breathtaking beauty for us all to enjoy. 

To compensate for no glacier landing, our plane went on the grand tour which meant we got to see around the whole mountain. You cannot envision the grandeur until you go on this flight!

If you plan on going to Talkeetna, don't miss the opportunity of a lifetime - FLY DENALI!!!

And make sure it's with Talkeetna Air Taxi!
Thank you, Paul, for a beautiful flight!

Due to the weather, we had to push back our flight 2 times.  But the third try went smoothly.  The staff was very accommodating to help shift our booking to new times that worked with our schedule, so that was helpful.  Safety is clearly their biggest concern.  Even though we were unable to fly around Denali (due to weather), we were still able to do the glacier landing (incredible) and had tremendous views.  Our pilot ("Zero Pop Rodeo") pointed out wildlife, and glaciers, and other landmarks along the way.  But he was not overly chatty, so you had time/peace (except for the engine noise) to really get into the views.  I am usually VERY nervous on planes, and I was dreading the flight, but rallied my courage so my kids wouldn't be scared.  And it was awesome!  This was our "splurge" on the trip, and worth it.  Recommended without hesitation.

We did the 1 hour south facing tour and it was amazing! Dave was our tour guide and he was so great. We even brought our 14 month old on the flight. This was definitely the highlight of our trip. If you are coming to Alaska for vacation, this is the trip you don't want to miss out on. Well worth the cost.

The folks at Talkeetna Air Taxi made this easy and enjoyable and the landing on the Ruth Glacier was awesome.  Our pilot Chris did a great job to negotiate the clouds, describe what we were seeing, and give us great views of Denali, its glaciers, and surrounding mountains.  It was truly a spectacular flight and experience.

review_title: Talkeetna Air Taxi well worth the cost!
review_text: We were in Alaska for a family vacation. We spent our last few days in Talkeetna, a charming town 60 miles from Mt. McKinley. We wanted to take a flight to see Denali and land on a glacier. However, the weather was not cooperating. The staff at Talkeetna was very helpful and friendly and they wanted to ensure we got the most out of our experience. They talked us out of going for the first day or so b/c we would have paid a lot of money to see very little. On our last day, the weather cleared up just enough and we had a great flight, saw the summit and landed on a glacier all to ourselves. Our pilot was polite and informative and accommodated all our requests. We never felt rushed. They provide glacier boots which definitely came in handy, but good to know so you don't have to worry about wearing special footwear. The temps on the glacier were cool, but not cold (light jacket was adequate). We even had time for a small snowball fight with our eight year old. One request for Talkeetna - on the way back we seemed to take a very straight path (this may be due to safety requirements). However, it would have been nice if possible to have taken a couple slight turns because the summit was still visible and we could have captured a few final photos on our way back to Talkeetna. If you're wondering if the fee is worth it...if you see what we saw, it definitely is!

The trip to Ruth Glacier with Talkeetna Air Taxi was the highlight of three weeks in Alaska.  It was one of a kind trip.  The pilot, Paul, was excellent and the trip through the mountains was beautiful.  I am so glad we chose this company.  Everyone was friendly and informative.  We felt like valued customers.  The trip was definitely a memorable experience.

Had a spectacular flight (and landing) recently with Chris as our pilot. The weather was absolutely clear, and the skies calm. We landed on the glacier and got to walk around in that beautiful place and take some gorgeous photos. Mount McKinley was perfectly framed by blue sky. Chris pointed out the terrain, and even a moose in a pond. He made the ride a pleasure.

We recently went to Alaska for 2 weeks and had a great flight on this air taxi service to see Mt McKinley and also land on the glacier. The service was great at the desk and the pilot was great on the flight , explaining a lot about the mountain and giving us lots of opportunities for pictures and a lot of time on the glacier as well. Overall very safe, friendly service. I would definitely use them again if in town.

review_title: The Alaska range and MT. McKinley
review_text: Did the flight around denali with a landing on the Ruth glacier. We were lucky that it was a cloudless day. But their policy of not charging you if you decide not to fly because of weather is priceless.

We signed up early for the Grand Denali flight with glacier landing, so got a good discount, but worried about: 1) whether it would be worth the cost (still $600) and 2) whether my wife would tolerate mountain flying in a small plane.  Overwhelmingly Yes!! to both.  We were delayed two hours by weather and there was still a high haze when we took off, so we did not get the breathtaking views of Denali's summits, but even without those we both loved the experience.  Our pilot Chris did a great job pointing out features and emphasizing how enormous the mountain, glaciers, and gorge are (didn't hurt that I got to sit up front on the ride back from the glacier.)  At one point he identified climbers working up the side of the mountain.  When we saw the spectacular views from the highway and Denali park, it made the experience seem very personal to know that we had been much, much closer.  The ride and all the maneuvers were smooth and my wife and her generally sensitive stomach agreed that the trip was amazing.  Do it again?  In a heartbeat.

7 Sterne Erlebnis, alles passte, sehr flexibel bei der Wahl der Bflugzeit, Man bezahlt erst, wenn man wieder gelandet ist, d. h., kann man wetterbedingt nicht auf drm Gletscher landen: keine Berechnung. Sehr nettes Bodenpetsonal, gute Anweisungen vor Abflug, erfahrener und sehr freundl Pilot. Das Erlebnis kann man nur selbst nachempfinden, es zeigt die Grösse des Denaliparkes. Unbedingt am Anfang der Reise machen. Es ist jeden $ wert!

We loved our Base Camp Tour with a Glacier Landing $350.00 pp. Alex was our pilot and did a great job giving us views of Mt McKinley from all sides of the mountain. Landing on The Ruth Glacier and walking was also a neat experience. We were very blessed to have an evening of beautiful weather and Alex ranked our flying conditions as a 10. We took a 6:00 flight which lasted two hours which was the perfect time of day and amount of time. Trip is well worth your money.

Our Talkeetna flightseeing trip was incredible! The staff worked us in one day when our appointment time was rained out. They had not been able to go up once in two days they said due to weather delays. But they thought there was a chance for the weather to clear slightly. Sure enough, we made it in time to catch the flight at the end of the day. Amazing! The skies cleared and the scenery was stunning for the time it took us to tour Mt. McKinley and the base camp. What an awesome sight! My husband and I agreed this was the highlight of our trip. We took so many pictures... the mountains are so up close. Landing on the glacier we could see the freshly fallen powder snow. Amazing memories! The staff here is so professional and our pilot was fabulous in naming many of the peaks and glaciers throughout the Alaskan range.

What a ride and view!  It was a beautiful day up there in July.The sky was clear and the views were beautiful. We had  a very clear view of Mt McKinley. Landing on the glacier was such a thrill. It is absolutely fantastic!

Flying around Denali was incredible! The mountains are so close and send chills down your spine! The glacier landing was so cool as well! Unlike anything I've ever done. I recommend doing this if looking for adventure

My husband WANTED to take this flight around base camp, landing on the glacier again and he was not disappointed!!! It was a beautiful day up there and is bound to be the highlight of most trips to Alaska (seeing the bears is pretty exciting too).  They have a 25% off coupon in the Northern Lights coupon book also which helps a great deal on the cost. It helps if you are going to be in the area for a couple of days because weather interferes with your plans. The staff is helpful trying to accommodate your plans.

review_title: A "Must Do" For Any Alaska Visit!
review_text:
I have flown with Talkeetna Air Taxi (TAT) many times, using their service to access the climbing treasures of the Alaska Range and also for some truly amazing flight seeing excursions.  The staff and pilots at TAT have been an absolute pleasure to work with each time.  

In a state where tourism is "big business," the folks at TAT seem to seek out way in which they can take that extra step to make every experience highly personal.  They are knowledgeable about the Alaska Range, courteous, and down to earth.  I cannot recommend them highly enough!

If you go to Alaska, you should really take a glacier flight.  If you take a glacier flight, why wouldn't you do so in the vicinity of North America's highest peak, Denali?  The stunning Ruth Gorge's mile high granite walls is another area that is not to be missed, and I think most tours will give you the opportunity to experience both.  This is a "MUST DO!"

I can't say enough about this company!  You can tell they love what they're doing from the moment you arrive for the big adventure.  Our pilot was exceptional with the knowledge he shared with us and he made sure we all had opportunities to get the perfect photos.  Of course we were blessed with an absolute blue bird day and he made the most of it!  You can tell de Havilland Beaver we flew in is very pampered by the crew who tends them as are the Otters also in their fleet.  This is an all out bucket list must do trip if you get to this part of the state!

We took the 2 hour "Grand Denali" tour and what brought us to Talkeetna Air Taxi (TAT) was that they are very community focused and had a killer coupon in the local high school by giving a 25% discount on all flight for ALL people in the group which equated to HUNDREDS of $$$'s OFF on our trip all to support their high school?...WOW...All flights between the multiple air taxi's are essentially the same in price but for TAT to give this discount to support their high school says a lot.  The discount book cost minimal when compared to what we saved so that tells you the kind of business this is.

The flight around the mountains and landing on Ruth Glacier were amazing and a once in a lifetime experience that we'll always remember!

We took the Base Camp flight out of Talkeetna with a stop off on Ruth Glacier for a short stroll on the ice, in Denali Nat. Park. It was a beautiful day for the flight with great views of Mt. McKinley and surrounding mountains/glaciers. The highlight, I think, is the stop off on the glacier with its amazing views. It was well worth the price for the views and memories that we will have to share with friends and family. This is a well run operation with first rate pilots, service and beautiful aircraft.
This is a awesome place! Don't miss it or you will regret it.. Trent was our pilot n did a GREAT job... Love love love it ... Thanks from your co pilot

We chose Talkeetna Air Taxi because they offered heli tours, which was on my Mom's bucket list. The office staff were friendly, knowledgeable and quick. Daniele, our pilot, was outstanding! She obviously loves what she does (how couldn't you with an office view like that?!) and it shone through during our tour. The weather was quite cooperative and we even got a few great views of the summit of Denali above the skirt of clouds. I'm sure all the flightseeing companies are great but I'll be sure to recommend TAT from now on!

review_title: Danali/Mount McKinley:??Wow, fantastic experience, incredible views- a must!!
review_text:
We came to Talkeetna as part of an Alaska tour and really we're not planning on taking this ride around Denali (aka. Mount McKinley) and am delighted we did.

We were able to book our flight, South. Face of Denali and Glacier landing and were ready to go within an hour. After a safety briefing by our pilot, 6 of us were airborne on a "Beaver" aircraft- the ride was smooth and exciting. The views are spectacular and landing on the glacier was just plain thrilling.

The ride lasted a bit under 2 hours and think it was one of the best experiences ever.

Our flight to the South face of Mt. McKinley with a landing on Ruth Glacier was the highlight of our two-week Alaskan trip. Due to rainy weather, we had to cancel our original flight and we were quite disappointed. However, the following morning I called and they worked us into their schedule and we had a beautiful flight with a glacier landing.  Jonathan, our pilot, was personable, knowledgeable, and a very skilled pilot.

We would highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi and would do it again tomorrow if we could.

review_title: Wonderful view of Mount Denali (aka Mt. McKinley)
review_text: Growing up in India - I saw a beautiful picture of Mt. McKinley when I was just 6 years old. All my life I wanted to see this grand mountain first hand. When I heard that the chances of seeing Mt. Denali is just 20% even if you are right at the Denali national park, I did not take a chance and took this wonderful plane ride to the mountain and I am glad that I did it. What a wonderful experience. This is an experience of a life time that you can talk about to your grand kids.

High marks for this tour. The mountain was open ( no clouds ) we booked on the spot and where in the air within a half hour.  One of the best tours we went on. The price was 60% YES 60% lower than a air tour we booked through our cruise line. Call direct and book this one ,or stop by there booth in " Down town" Talkeetna.

This trip was FIRST CLASS!  Worth every cent.  Alex is a highly qualified and personable pilot and we all felt comfortable and having our breath taken away nearly every minute.  The office staff is also friendly, efficient, and ensure that all your questions are answered and that you had the "trip of a lifetime"

The best tour by any standards in Alaska but be sure you cater the time to go up on clear weather. Any thing less would not do justice to the views the McKinley range has to offer, as well as the $350 per person ticket price. We did a glacier landing on the Ruth glacier. It was a fantastic experience but that landing area is serve by so many aircraft that most can't stay very long on the ice.

review_title: Spectacular Finale to a Great Vacation!
review_text:
If you're a believer that "things happen for a reason", as I am, you'll appreciate our running too late on Thursday to make our evening flight reservation.  We called to reschedule for the following evening & due to some miscommunication, they thought we wanted the AM while we requested the PM & as it was, due to weather no flights left the ground that Friday.  Out only chance was to go Saturday AM, our day to fly home from Anchorage that evening.  So we had some cocktails & comforted ourselves from our disappointment with "things happen for a reason".

The next morning we woke to perfect skies & headed back to the airport.  

The Talkeetna Air Taxi people were lovely.  They provided overshoes to go over our hiking boots.  We needed sunscreen & sunglasses more than coats.  Our fleece jackets were enough, no gloves required either.  We sat & waited for our names to be called.  As there's room for 6 on these planes, we just had one couple of strangers traveling with us on the flight.

Our pilot, Mike, was such a nice guy.  He does aerial stunts off season in Florida.  Fascinating to talk to & gave us a wonderful explanation of the spectacular views during our Flightseeing to the south face of Mount McKinley.  We were able to easily land on the glacier & experience the vast spance of snow & sky in the mountains. unforgettable & highly recommended!

review_title: A trip of a life Time
review_text: We had made reservations but the day was cloudy.  The staff was very understanding and very helpful in giving a level of expectation.  They explained that the top of the mountain would be visible but we may not be able to land on the glacier.  We were able to see if all.  The pilot Richard was extremely knowledgeable and shared all his knowledge like it was his first flight.  The views were sensational.  Since they were not certain if we could land they said not to pay and we would just settle up depending on what level of trip we were able to see.  That was totally unexpected but professional and accommodating.  A company you want to do business with!

Our scheduled flight time was 11am. When we got there they told us skies were cloudy and if we still want flight with glacier landing return at 3:30, Fine, we went for a hike, toured town and were back at 3:30. At that time they were sending up planes and the plane before us was great. All passengers loved it and they had glacier landing. So off we go at 4pm and wouldn't you know it, clouds rolled in again  and we had limited views of Mt Kinnely and no glacier landing. Everyone was bummed out on flight back.People at Talkeetna air were great.They only charged us 25% of the agreed on price due to our limited trip. They are really top flight honest people that were a pleasure to deal with, Would use them again if ever in area

We had a great flight. Denali was in the clouds, but the flight was awesome. Landed on the Pica glacier.  Good thing for the boots, there was a lot of snow.
They are very accommodating, we showed up early, and they called the other 2 clients to see if they wanted to fly earlier.
Alex was great.
TAT flies the clients and guides for Alaska Mountaineering School, so I trust them completely.

My husband and I and the pilot took a small plane up to view Mt McKinley and even though I thought I would be afraid, it was such a beautiful flight that I was not a bit fearful. The pilot was excellent. We cancelled the flight the previous day because of the weather & they worked us in once the weather improved. They were very helpful & professional. We landed on the glacier & it was unbelievable. So beautiful!!

TAT is clearly one of the leaders in glacier landings from Talkeetna. We took them in and out of base camp for our Denali expedition, and they were superb. One passenger gets to sit inthe co-pilot seat, and that was a very cool perspective. They are also the company that runs the schedule at "Kahiltna International" on the glacier. I trusted them with my life, and would do it again.

What an amazing adventure!  After a day of rain, the sky was clear and the views were spectacular. Mike, our pilot, was excellent and gave us a very smooth ride.  Landing on the glacier was such a thrill. We felt very lucky to have this clear view of Mt McKinley

I came up in March from Texas to visit my boyfriend who had just gotten back from being deployed for nine months. I had done some research and heard that doing a flight tour is the best way to go! Well the problem was it seemed that no one was open during march except TALKEETNA AIR TAXI! I was so thrilled my boyfriend found them and booked a tour! 

When we got up to the place we were greeted by friendly workers who helped us right away. We were both so excited. 
We met our pilot and we were on our way! I'm a nervous flyer but the pilot made me feel so at ease. He also was very knowledgable about the land and history and I definitely learned a lot! About an hour or so of flying we ended up LANDING on glacier! I had no idea we would! We landed on Ruth Glacier! We got out and walk around and took pictures. The pilot was nice enough to take a picture of the two of us! Well next thing I know my boyfriend is proposing and the pilot took the pictures as he did!! I was in such shock! 
When we got back to the office I was greeted with all the workers asking if I said yes, and of course I did! They were so nice there!! They all knew what was gonna happen and kept it a secret for my now husband! They are great and would defiantly recommend them to anybody! This is a must do!!

We booked the Grande Denali tour with glacier landing.  The weather threatened to abridge our tour but, gratefully, the clouds cleared and it was fabulous.  We saw an avalanche in real time, and rainbows made an appearance on our way back to the airstrip.  The flight, glacier landing, and 2nd takeoff were fantastic beyond words.  It was THE highlight of our Alaska trip, worth every penny.  The people were very nice.  We can't more highly recommend it.

Went flight seeing on June 16, 2014. Booked the Grand Denali with glacier landing. Unfortunately, due to weather, we could not do the glacier landing. We were not charged the entire fee due to this changing. Flight was still breathtakingly beautiful and well worth it!!! If you are in Talkeetna/Denali area, this is a must!

review_title: Excellent service; friendly, helpful, talented staff
review_text: TAT recently flew us into the Pika Glacier for a ski mountaineering trip. From the first email we exchanged with Paul and the rest of the TAT staff, I was nothing short of amazed with their helpfulness and their patience as we went through numerous changes of plans and alterations to our trip itinerary. As first-timers in the AK range, they helped us develop some appropriate skiing objectives and remained flexible as we waited to see what happened with the snowpack in the late spring. When we arrived in Talkeetna, TAT picked us up from the bus from Anchorage and helped us through the paperwork. Never felt anything but extremely comfortable during my entire experience. Paul flew a scenic trip near our initial destination on the day of our flight and determined that wind would prevent us from landing that day, so we made a last minute adjustment and headed toward the Pika. TAT's flexibility is to thank for the ability to make this quick change.

review_title: The best thing I have seen on earth
review_text: We were lucky to have flipped out your which we were supposed to take tomorrow. It was a perfect day and with a clear sky , our pilot landed on the Ruth glacier and made this a life time experience for us. We are extremely happy with the service received and a big thanks to the entire team for making this experience truly a life time memory for us. I would rate this experience 10 out of 5

review_title: Grand Denali Tour with glacier landing
review_text: This is the one thing you have to do before you die. It is absolutely fantastic! Words cannot describe it and photos are inadequate.
Took my fifth trip into the mountains with TAT.  They are always friendly, professional, knowledgeable and I wouldn't use anyone else.  Cheers!

review_title: Grand Denali Air Tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi
review_text:
Catching a perfect view of Denali / Mt. McKinley mountain is a roll of the dice, but who my sign up with for an aerial view can make a huge difference.
After checking with all the vendors that offer this service we (8 of us) went with Talkeetna Air Taxi (TAK) because they were the most flexible relative to us making the final decision on whether we go or don't go due the weather.
We were scheduled to fly at 11:15 on June 14th.  We arrive only to find out there was a weather hold due to low clouds.  So TAK moved us to a 4 PM flight.  When we arrived for this flight and hear the comments from the vacationers that just got off the previous flight, were all very excited about the experience and sights they saw, so of course we said "lets go".  
Once we got in the air, the clouds started to roll in.  The pilot has a heck of a time finding holes in the clouds to work our way to the mountain.  Once we got there, the clouds were so thick we probably saw only a bit of the mountain and we definitely couldn't land on the glacier due to the fog, so we headed back after a two hour flight.
When then disappointingly reported back to the office to settle up final payment, the front desk also felt our disappointment and before we said anything they offered to reduce our fare by near 60%, which was very generous.
in conclusion, if you are considering signing up for a flight over Denali, I would highly recommend contracting with Talkeetna Air Taxi.

The pilot, Michael,was fantastic. Very skilled and informative and made you feel very safe. The view of the glaciers and Mt McKinley were unbelievable. It really gave you a feeling of seeing Alaska. Landing on and taking off from the glacier was such a thrill. Well worth the cost and time.
I highly recommend this excursion.Bring your camera!

Highly recommend the flight to Mt McKinley & the landing on the Ruth Glacier. This is just an incredible experience and the best way to see this vast beautiful area. The glacier landing and then standing on almost 4000 feet on glacier ice and viewing Mt McKinley up close and personal is almost a spiritual experience. Talkeetna Air Taxi is professional and makes the experience the trip of your vacation.

Wow!  We just returned from a 2 hour flight, including a glacier landing, with Captain Brian. We couldn't have asked for a better experience. 

We booked a 6:30 flight at 5 and they quickly made arrangements for a shuttle to pick us up at 6 from our hotel. From the minute we arrived to the facilities we were greeted with friendly faces and a warm welcome.  It was a last minute trip and we were worried about keeping staff late, but they couldn't have been more courteous to us. 

The flight was incredibly smooth (lucky!) and Brian was able to share some of the history about the area. 

We came into town with a cruise ship company, through which another flightseeing company was recommended, but I'm really glad that my boyfriend and I checked TripAdvisor and decided to go with Talkeetna Air Taxi. 

Service, Price, and Quality of Air Craft = A+ !!

We three of our family took 1.30 PM glacier landing tour on 12th june 14 and it was a really a life time experience. Unfortunately it became a lot of  torture for me for one and half hours of one way flying and landing because of second row of seating a highly cramped one with the knees closer to the chest, which was not suitable for  a six feet taller and the pilot ( Mr Richards) who was supposed to take care of these things did not care. I took the front seat on request  for the short return journey which was a real comfort seating for any any tall  person.  He put a short person  in the pilots adjacent seat  which is a high seater for most part of the journey. I appreciate his care otherwise for  my co passenger son who is  a junior.  The pilot's carelessness has spoiled my journey which i did not expect from a company having no 1 ranking in this site.  They  compensated me without asking for but the  unpleasantness still ranks. The ground staff are really genuine and the pilot is also otherwise good but for the lack of professionalism. The fact is that the final location is beyond comparison but the journey,  any of their competitors could have done it in a better way in my case, i feel.  The service provider is not much of importance  for this kind of out of the world experience. 
 
I highly  recommend  Mt Mc kinley  with glacier landing tour (glacier landing a must)  for the surreal life time experience with any of the tour operators and it makes very little difference in choosing the airliner. It is my personal opinion. 
I suggest  one has to be assertive in getting  equivalence in services otherwise will have to regret for the treatment meted out as in my case.

We spent the day wondering if our flight would take place due to weather and snow.  God answered my prayers and our flight took off at 6:00pm with Trent as our pilot.

Oh my stars, this was the most incredible scenery you will ever experience!  Trent gave us a turbulence-free flight that included seeing all the snow-capped mountains, witnessing an active avalanche, landing on a glacier at base camp where mountain climbers are starting their ascent to the summit and finally ending with a rainbow as we land.

This company would receive 10 stars if I could give it!!!

This company was so cooperative and friendly!  The pilot was very knowledgeable with pointing out the sights. Do not miss the glacier landing! It is a must! They went over and above to insure a wonderful experience.

We took the flight goes to Denali and lands on a glacier. It was so worth it!!! It's a little bit more expensive than the one that flights around providing mountain viewing but it's a lot better. We highly recommend the landing on the glacier. The experience was priceless. 

Tony Quinones
6/6/2014

Our trip was wonderful.  Being physically handicapped, I found the company very accommodating. They helped me off and on the plane at the airport and at the glacier landing. They also allowed my service dog to go on the plane.  The flight was wonderful and the glacier was the highlight of the trip.  Thanks for a great time!

review_title: A real adventure you can't miss
review_text: This will get you more Likes on Instagram than anything you've ever done. Our group was excited about the idea of a glacier landing and we waited an extra day for a better chance of good weather so we could land. The landing was more fun than I even imagined and the views and pictures you can take up there are unlike anywhere else I've seen. But even without the landing, the flight would not have been a dissapointment at all. The view as you fly between mountain peaks and over glaciers is one I will never forget. The crew were incrediby nice and professional and our pilot Chris was great. I'll be talking about this adventure for years!

We arrived with the smoke from the fires on the Alaskan Kenai peninsula.   The visibility was impossible to see Mt. McKinley from the ground. 
The flight was a highlight of our 2 week visit.   The Talkeetna Air Taxi's entire operation was so helpful and our pilot was great.  One of our group is 80 years old and never flown in a prop plane.  She had a wonderful time and loved walking on the glacier. 
I would highly recommend the flight.
My flight around Mt. McKinley was wonderful.  Other-worldly.  And the glacier landing fantastic. I was confident in my pilot and learned a great deal. Thank you!

Took a flightseeing tour of Mt. McKinley area. We even booked the special offer that included a free glacier landing. Absolutely beautiful views of mountains and our pilot was very imformative. We liked the fact that if the weather had not been good, we would have gotten a refund. The weather was superb for us, and we totally loved it and would highly recommend experiencing this. The plane was attractive and well maintained; we were not afraid at all.

Great staff, knowledgable pilots.  Due to weather conditions, we couldn't do the full Grand Denali tour, so we stopped by Pika Glacier and still saw some incredible things.  Very professional and friendly staff, enjoyed every moment of it.

Took a flightseeing tour of Mt. McKinley with a glacier landing while staying in Talkeetna.  It was an amazing experience.  There is no better way to see Mt. McKinley and the surrounding peaks and glaciers.  The pilot was friendly and informative - providing narrative while flying over the mountains and glaciers.  It was a beautiful morning with smooth flying and barely a bump.  The glacier landing was also smooth and not at all unnerving.   Standing on the glacier was an awesome experience.  The pilot even took pictures for the passengers to evidence this once in a lifetime experience.  The staff at the office was friendly and helpful as well.  It was a wonderful experience and a highlight of our Alaska trip.

Did the basecamp tour with glacier landing. Please do not book without glacier landing, that is the best part. Also keep one day backup, our evening tour was canceled but they accommodated us for the first tour the next day. They actually called me early to let me know the weather isnt good as I had mentioned I would be driving from Anchorage. Everything was very professional and I felt safe throughout the flight.

review_title: Wonderful flightseeing tour of Mount McKinley!
review_text:
My children gave me a flightseeing tour of Mt. McKinley through Talkeetna Air Taxi that included landing on a glacier and getting out for a half hour.  This 2-1/2 hour long trip had been on my bucket list for a long time, and it was spectacular!  The flight was smooth, the pilot was very professional and knowledgeable..it was all I could have ever asked for.  He flew close to the mountain on all sides, so we could see more of the mountain than just it's south face.  There are not enough adjectives to describe this mountain's grandeur or beauty!  

Passengers are charged $10 each by the Park Service to land on the glacier, unless they have a senior national park pass or other park pass, which I had.  Folks should give themselves the time to drive there from Anchorage or Fairbanks, and add time to have lunch or dinner in Talkeetna, a town with several excellent local restaurants (no national chains, thank goodness).

I had been recommended this company by my best friend, who waxed lyrical about it for ages after!  We (my wife and I) were not disappointed as we took the Base Camp Tour with glacier landing.   Our pilot was informative throughout the flight and seamlessly weaved his way through gaps in the mountains that felt as though they were so close you could almost touch them. The glacier landing seemed like an out of body experience, as the group gazed around them to view the splendour of the mountains and Mount McKinley in particular on a beautiful day.  The views were completely awesome and will live in the memory for ever thanks to this wonderful experience.  Utterly professional and well organised, with very friendly staff.

review_title: Awsome...Highlight of our Vacation to Alaska
review_text: We did the flightseeing and glacier landing just yesterday.  Complimentary transportation from our resort was prompt and very courteous driver.  Our pilot was the best, he described the areas we were flying over and when we landed on the glacier...WOW!!! there are no words to describe the awesome views.  Actually walking on the glacier can not even come close to any other vacation attraction anywhere.

We decided to splurge and take a flightseeing trip and it was the best decision ever.  The staff at Talkeetna Air Taxi was great and our pilot was fantastic.
