He landed at Denali Base Camp even though it was not on the agenda because the day was so perfect.  I can't say enough about this experience!

As close to heaven we can get on earth! A trip of a lifetime. Put this on your bucket list! The pilot was a pro. The landing on the glacier was priceless. This company is the best. Do not go to Denali snd not do this!

Again due to clouds Mt. McKinley was hidden but that didn't hinder an unbelievable flight!  The Talkeetna Air Taxi is a must if you can fit it in.  Although not a cruise tour it is a must and will be your best tour while in Alaska!

This base camp trip and glacier landing just blew us away. From the moment we arrived the staff were super helpful and just lovely when they found out it was our honeymoon. Our pilot was brilliant, informative, funny and changed landing site to ensure we got a spot in the sun! Surely the best operator in town? We will never ever forget this trip. Perfect, thank you.

If you have the chance to do this it's well worth it.  On a beautiful day we could see the climbers at Base Camp and others around the mountain.  We flew by 5000 foot cliffs, looked straight down onto glaciers, crevasses, and snow fields, followed valleys up to 8000 feet, over ridges and landed on the Ruth Glacier.  Spectacular!  I live in Alaska and am so glad that I finally did this.

TAT was professional, courteous, helpful, safe, and our pilot was not only a good pilot, but also knowledgable and friendly.

This was a once in a lifetime experience and I'm so glad we went with Talkeetna Air. The staff checking us in for our flight was friendly and helpful.The pilot was very knowledgeable, confident. You could tell he loved what he was doing. Landing on the glacier was breathtaking. The pilot did a great job with keeping us informed of all the sights. I would highly recommend Talkeetna Air !

My wife and I did a glacier landing with Talkeetna Air Taxi. I must say this was one of the most fun vacation experiences- and I've had some good ones- that we've ever had. Our pilot- I believe his name is Trent- was excellent. We took the 11 AM flight and it appears that was the best option as there was fog - from Chinese air pollution-earlier in the day. I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi.

We were all thrilled to take this flight up to Denali and land on Ruth's Glacier.  We were so fortunate to have perfect weather - clear, blue skies with temps in high 60's and a great pilot, Will, who made our trip safe and fun. TAT was very accommodating with our last minute trip request. This was definitely a highlight of our trip to Alaska. I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi and would use them again.

review_title: Alaska Range views can't be beat!!
review_text: I booked a trip with TAT when I was visiting Talkeetna. There were a number of flightseeing tours there but I went with a proven company. It was one of my highlights here in Alaska as the views of Denali and the Alaska Range were stunning. I will always remember this adventure and want to travel again with this company.

My husband surprised me on my birthday and we flew to Mt McKinley and landed on Ruth Glacier. We live here in Alaska and this was truly a highlight and unforgettable experience "awesome!"  Talkettna Air Taxi is professional in every way. We had John for a pilot and he was great and very informative. Thank you!

I'm former owner of a air charter company in the Denver area, and have done decades of mountain flying in the Rocky Mountain area.  This air tour of the Denali massif was the most spectacular mountain I've ever experienced! Our flight on April 4, 2014 was done professionally and efficiently from the information call I made to the undertaking itself by the pilot and office staff.  Well done!

While visiting relatives in Eagle River, AK, (near Anchorage), we took Talkeetna Air Taxi's Grand Denali Tour with a glacier landing.  It was fantastic!  The people at TAT were beyond helpful when making our reservations and answering our questions in preparation for our trip.  Our pilot was professional and knowledgeable as to what we were seeing from the air making it all the more interesting for us.  If you have the opportunity, do this!  Standing on a glacier in complete silence is an experience I will never forget.

Talkeetna Air Taxi is the very best in service and value. Friendly and reassuring pilot, tons of information on the flight about Denali and the surrounding area. Of course the landing on Ruth Glacier was the highlight of an amazing trip. If you go bring sunglasses and lots of space on your camera!

review_title: Flight seeing and glacier landing with Talkeetna Air Taxi
review_text:
Heard this is the best year in a decade to see the northern lights so my hubby and I booked a trip to Alaska with Salmon Berry Tours.  This was an after thought but honestly, one of the highlights of the trip.  After waivers and slipping on the boot covers they provided we boarded an Otter and flew over Denali.  It was incredible, the view but then we headed for the glacier in the mountains to land and OMG!  At first I thought, how is this going to work?  It's deceiving the space, it's actually very vast but landing there...  And just as I thought we are going too fast to stop and approaching a drop off with the glacier, he turns the plane.  When we got out, it was obvious that he has done this many times, today, by the tracks in the snow. 
It was cold but sunny and just beautiful.  Sort of makes you feel small in it all.  
The flight out was just as spectacular as was the take off.  
I highly recommend this if you travel to Talkeetna, which in it's self is a charming little off the beaten path town.   With a sister in Anchorage for the last 30 years, I have been to Alaska many times and this is my top 10 things to have done there.
Oh, and we saw the lights.

review_title: The most amazing thing I've ever done in my entire life
review_text: This flight seeing gives you a perspective of the mountain range that is breathtakingly spectacular! The view of large glaciers, deep crevasses, and majestic, snow caped mountain peaks, will leave you with an appreciation of out beautiful Earth and the most amazing pictures of your day!

We did the Grand Denali tour and had an absolutely incredible time.   It didn't look like we'd be able to do the glacier landing, but fortunately the weather cleared and we were able to do that.   What an amazing ride - flying right at the mountain for several minutes was amazing!   The office staff was very friendly and helpful, and they picked us up at the train station where we arrived from the ship.  

This wasn't an inexpensive activity, but of all the excursions we did on our Alaskan trip, we'd do this one again in a heartbeat!

My grandson & I spent 2 weeks in AK in an RV & we took the Grand Denali tour w the glacier landing.  Although the entire 2 weeks were awesome, we both agreed that this tour was the highlight of our trip.  The weather was excellent for our flight and the views were just incredible.  The clouds lifted off the summits & we took some simply stunning photos of the summits.  Our pilot (Trent) did an outstanding job of maneuvering the aircraft so that everyone got excellent views.  Trent also provided excellent commentary during the entire flight & during the time spent on the glacier.  Being up there & experiencing the vastness & beauty of our Gods' creation was truly a religious experience for me.  Talkeetna Air Taxi runs a first-class operation & I would recommend their Denali tours to anyone. If I ever get back to AK, I will definitely fly to the top of Denali again w Talkeetna Air.  Once just is not enough for me !!!

Everyone in my group was gung-ho about flightseeing while we were in Alaska...me, not so much.  I hoped everyone would forget, but instead they researched and found the most recommended: Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Still not reassured and felt like I was going to toss my cookies even as we walked into the office.  But from there on out, it was a different story.  Everyone was so professional...friendly but also very professional.  And the flight itself--well, I'm so glad I didn't let my fears stop me from going up.  Great pilot.  INCREDIBLE scenery.  You felt like you could reach out and touch the mountainsides as you circled around.  The intense blue glacier pools were amazing and oh yeah, then we landed on a glacier.   Got some pictures of us throwing snowballs ON A FREAKIN' GLACIER!!   Would do it again in a heartbeat--definitely a highlight of our trip!!

review_title: Amazing aircraft, pilots and facilities.  Unbelievable views.
review_text: This operation is first class.  Being a commercial pilot and turbine aircraft operator myself, I was keenly aware of the equipment and operational aspects of Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Everything exceeded expectations.  From the check-in process, boarding, the flight itself, the expertise of our pilot (Trent), the glacier landing - everything about this was outstanding.  You will not regret taking this tour!

Talkeetna: Around the Denali
A few hours by car north of Anchorage towards the Mountain range lies the small Alaskan town of Talkeetna.  A right turn from the main road will bring you to the airfield. There several companies offer sightseeing flights to and around the Mount McKinley (Denali). We selected the Talkeetna Air Taxi which operates a number of venerable Beavers and Otters besides a Cessna 182, all of them on skies. One can book several different routes. For us the tour around Mount McKinley with a landing on the glacier was the most appealing. On the flight to the mountains of the Alaska range the different colors of the tundra was beautiful to watch. We flew over many little lakes. The pilot acted also as tour guide and explained everything we could see. We followed a long glacier tongue crossed over a pass to come to the impressive north face of the Denali Mountain.  Although we flew at about 10 000 feet we still remained well below the top of this snow covered giant of about 20 000 ft. A little further the pilot headed to a snow plateau where he put down the airplane softly on the snow covered glacier. We all stepped on the snow (it is advisable to wear firm shoes instead of sneakers) and enjoyed the sight of the surrounding 15 000 feet high mountains. Our pilot explained that we must not stay to long because the aircraft engine would cool down too much. Taking off downhill with the ground dropping away is always a great experience. The flight back to the airfield showed again the picturesque scenery of the tundra. This flight was definitely a highpoint of our Alaska trip. We highly can recommend it especially in the not so common case of picking a nearly cloudless day on both sides of the Alaskan range. One should add that there are many other activities to choose from, fishing, hiking kayaking to name just a few, while spending time in Talkeetna.
Ulrich Lanz, Munich Germany

We had been looking forward to this excursion ever since we booked our trip to Alaska, and it did not disappoint. This was one of the best things we did in Alaska...I HIGHLY recommend it! We took the Grand Denali tour with a glacier landing, which offered breathtaking views of Denali and an incredibly peaceful landing on a glacier. Everything about the tour exceeded our expectations. One recommendation I have is to allow some flexibility in your schedule in case the weather requires your tour to be rescheduled. The great thing about Talkeetna Air is that they are honest about the weather conditions and how that will impact the tour, and they will work with you to reschedule. You can tell this company really cares about their customers and want to give you the best experience possible.

review_title: Option of Refund If Weather Not Perfect
review_text: We booked the early departure for the free glacier landing.  The weather was bad upon our arrival in Talkeetna the night before.  The morning of our flight the weather was still bad.  We arrived at Talkeetna Air Taxi and they briefed us of the weather conditions.  They were still flying because the mountain was viewable from the other side but they would not be able to do the glacier landing.  They gave us the option of canceling which we decided to do since we wouldn't get the full experience.  They promptly refunded our deposit.  That is good customer service.  If we get back to Alaska, we wouldn't hesitate to book with Talkeetna Air Taxi again.
The scenery was breathtaking and the plane ride was a value for the money. Talkeetna Air was recommended to me by a co-worker and I will recommended them too.

The folks at Talkeetna Air Taxi made our entire experience very enjoyable.  The weather had been overcast for days prior to our flight and the staff was very patient and understanding about my hesitancy to spend a nice chunk of change on our flight when we might not be able to see the peaks of Mt. McKinley or do a glacier landing.  I appreciated the fact that they do not penalize you in any way for weather related cancellations made at the customer's discretion.  They explained the probabilities of seeing McKinley (60% due to clouds) and doing a glacier landing (50% that day due to new snow) to us and left it our decision whether to go or not.  In the end, we decided to risk it and I am so glad we did.  We saw everything and the glacier landing was an overwhelmingly beautiful experience.  The beauty of this area cannot be fully appreciated in pictures or even flying above it.  Our pilot, Jonathan, was an awesome bush pilot and was extremely knowledgeable about the geography, geology and history of Denali. This will be one of the more expensive things you may do (minute for minute) but it is totally worth it!!!

review_title: All of the views of mountain climbing, without all of the work!!
review_text:
My husband and I took an a 10-day Alaskan cruise that ended with a 3-day land tour around Denali. Of our whole trip, our flight seeing tours around Misty Fjords and Mt. McKinley were the highlights of our trip.

The views of Alaskan landscape are amazing enough from the ground, but it's a whole different level from the air. Being able to see McKinley so close and from different angles as we circled it was amazing. Our flight was also dropping off 3 climbers so we ended up landing at the base camp around 7 feet up on what ended up being a glacier (although we didn't realize it at the time).

Talkeetna Air Taxi had great customer service and we had an amazing time with them. I would highly recommend this company.

Thanks to the planning of our host at Alaskan Tour Guides, we were fortunate enough to enjoy a truly spectacular flight and glacier landing performed by Talkeetna Air Taxi in the Denali range.  I can only compare it to what it must be like to fly in an IMAX movie!  The weather cleared for a few hours the day of our flight and we were able to clearly see the entire mountain with surrounding range and glaciers....WOW!!!!  As a former military pilot, I was impressed with the skill and professionalism of our pilot.  He really knew what he was doing in the sometimes tricky air currents of mountain flying. I highly recommend this as a "do not miss" activity when anyone visits Alaska.

Gary W. - Chicago

Now this was completely amazing - a flight around Denali!  We had 3 days of heavy, awful rains while in Talkeetna.  But, one late afternoon, the clouds parts and we called Talkeetna Air Taxi for a next-day flight.  It was perfect!  We got the times we wanted and we were overwhelmed with spectacular views and a great flight.  HIGHLY recommend it!

review_title: Great way to see the area
review_text: We were two of 8 passengers to fly out of Talkeetna to see the area.  It was cloudy and drizzly so we were unsure if it would be worth it.  Even with the bad weather we are glad we went.  Though we could not see Mt. Denali we were able to safely fly under the cloud ceiling and see much of the glaciers and valley area.  The ride was smooth and we felt safe.  The DeHavilland Turbine Otters are safe aircraft and very roomy for the ride.  They provided head sets to hear the pilot talk about the area and they quite the engine noise.  The seat layout is so that everyone has a window seat and unobstructed view.  I also overhead the staff setting up a custom trip for someone who wanted to see wildlife more so than mountains and glaciers (they had done that before), so if you need a custom tour, then this might be a good place to start.

review_title: Great experience flying with Talkeetna Air Taxi
review_text:
What a wonderful experience to explore Denali from the above. I took the Great Denali tour with glacier landing and it beats my expectations as a tourist. The pilot was very professional and was very informative throughout the flightseeing tour. The views from the air was priceless and stunning. 

This was my highlight of my Alaskan trip. It is a bit pricey, but it is worth your money. I hope to do this again the next time I visit Alaska.

Flight seeing Denali along with the Kenai Fjords tours were the highlight of my Alaskan adventure.  We chose the Talkeetna Air Taxi out of Talkeetna because they had a variety of flights and provided options.  The trip was sensational and worth every cent.  The photos taken from the air are pricelss and stunning.  The pilot was very gracious and informative.  Suggestions:  try and keep a couple of dates for flight seeing because the weather pattern around Denali is unpredictable and cancelled flights seem to be common due to bad weather.  If you are going to take pictures, check the internet for do's and don'ts so you can get the best shot possible.

review_title: The absolute highlight of our trip, if you come to Alaska, come here!
review_text: What an amazing experience. Seeing the mountains from the ground is beautiful but seeing them from the air is incredible. Flying out over the Denali national park was lovely especially as all of the fall colours are out. Then flying up into the mountains was just spectacular. It didn't seem to matter where you sat on the plane the views were stunning. It is definitely worth paying the extra to land on the glacier, I think we would have been gutted if we hadn't. Landing was exciting and then stepping out into thigh high fresh snow was magical. Snow angels at 5000 feet are so much fun. We were very lucky that the summit of Mt McKinley cleared just after we landed and we were able to take great photos. On the way back we saw a bear and our pilot was kind enough to circle round so that we could all get a closer look. The staff were really friendly and made us feel so welcome. This really was the perfect end to our holiday.

My wife and I booked a flight seeing trip after reading all of the glowing reviews on FlyerTalk and Tripadvisor.  

This is a must-do item if you visit Alaska and the Talkeetna / Denali area.  The staff is very friendly and helpful.  Our pilot (Richard) was fun and relaxed and talked about the sights we were seeing.  The mountain was out when we visited so we felt very fortunate to have a full view of Denali and the glaciers surrounding it.  We had plenty of time to do whatever we wanted when we landed on the Eldridge Glacier.  

Bring appropriate eye wear (sunglasses) and outerwear.  

It is a pretty pricy adventure, but it was well worth it in my opinion.

review_title: Amazing flight & landing on Mount McKinley
review_text: We had the joy of flying on Talkeetna Air on September 14th to see Mount McKinley.  The weather was clear and the views were amazing.  Our pilot was great and made sure that all passengers had a great view of all facets of the great mountain...  We landed on the glacier and enjoyed the striking views.  It was the highlight of our trip to Alaska and would highly recommend this tour.

An adventure of a lifetime!!!!

After waiting a day for the weather to clear, we took the trip of a lifetime with Talkeetna Air Taxi. There are single seats next to a window so everyone was a great view. There are headphones for each passenger so you can hear the pilot describing the mountains and glaciers. For glacier landings, they provide boots for snow. They even provide sun glasses for use during the flight.

We took the most complete flight and felt that the tour around Denali was so much better than if we had just seen the south face. The glacier landing was just beyond belief as we glided across pristine snow and stood open- mouthed at the beauty of the place.  If at all possible, do the glacier landing.

Our flight was pretty smooth and we felt very safe with our pilot who was cautious.

review_title: Amazing trip well done thanks to TAT
review_text: We landed at Anchorage early morning and drove to TAT for our 8:30am flight hoping that it would be clear skies after the cloudy and rainy weather that weekend. The TAT folks greeted us with a smile and said "Yes, you are going up" cos the skies were all clear. The air pilot was really good and took some amazing photos of us when we landed on the glacier. We took the cheapest tour but then they offered us an upgrade for free. We were so happy. Definitely recommend TAT. Please have a look at some of the amazing photos

If you're thinking of taking a flightseeing tour stop thinking and start doing! Best part of our trip so far. You'll be absolutely amazed by what you see. Literally took my breath away a few times! Definitely worth the money!

Absolutely the best thing we did in Alaska.  Wife and I took the grand Denali tour with the optional glacier landing.  Nothing short of spectacular.  The mountain looked awesome and being able to walk around and play on the glacier was a memory will never forget.  Great operation with trained pilot and attentive staff.  Town of Talkeetna where we flew from is a great place to visit too.  Very quaint with many interesting shops.  A must see!!

This helicopter tour, though not being able to view Denali or Mount McKinley due to weather, certainly was worth taking to viewing wildlife.
They also offer airplane and float plane excursions which, 
should the weather cooperate, would allow the use of Mount McKinley.
Talkeetna is a quaint little town 
to spend an afternoon.
This is a must do if you can catch it on a good weather day.  We were very pleased with Talkeetna Air Taxi and our knowledgable pilot Jonathan.

These guys are awesome.  Booked in January 2013, called them the day before our flight and asked if we could move it up a day?  Perfect weather Tuesday PM in route to Mt. McKinley (w/ Princess), Weds weather forecast was BAD.  Talkeetna Air Taxi was very happy to move us up.  No problem getting picked up in Talkeetna to the plane (a minute van ride).  Our pilot was very professional and informative.  He did a great job guiding the plane up and explaining what we were looking at.  I took a couple hundred photos w/ my Kindle Fire HD.  Wife got a ton of pictures with our "real" camera.  Glacier landing was amazing.  Bad weather was rolling in, sunny, then cloudy, then sunny again.  Our pilot thought our flight was likely going to be the last of the afternoon due to the impending weather.  We had a great experience that we'll never forget.  Got back to the airport and headed toward the van - front desk stops us - "We're so sorry you couldn't fly around to the North side of McKinley so we already processed a $80 refund."  Seriously?  The trip lasted the full time and the views were spectacular.  No complaints from us.  I'll take the refund, but we never, ever expected it.  They run an honest, high standard business.  If you are going to Talkeetna - BOOK THESE GUYS!

review_title: A memory that last a lifetime
review_text: We flew around Mt McKinley, landed on a glacier and threw snowballs.  It was a dream flight to see the mountains so close.  Landing on the glacier was on of the smoothest landing I have ever experienced.  We threw snow balls and made angels in the snow, something people from Atlanta, GA rarely ever get to do.  We  only regretted that we could only make the flit one time.  I would have love to go again as soon as we landed back in Talkeetna.

Did the Mt. McKinley tour with Glacier landing with Alek as our pilot.  We had a once in a lifetime experience with a cloudless sky, bright sunshine and visibility that did not stop.  The ground staff were friendly and accommodating to our needs and Alek was knowledgeable about the mountain and everything around.  We will always remember stepping off the plane at 11,000 ft to see a sight that usually only mountain climbers are privileged to see.  It is expensive but worth it.

We booked the flight on the spur of the moment, glad we did!  What a fun ride! Had crystal clear weather, no clouds to block our view. Took the hour long flight, no glacier landing as we had done it a few years ago in Skagway. Hubby got the front seat and I got the back. Thought I'd not like the back but I had both window sides open to me so I could look out both sides, very nice! Beautiful views of McKinley and the glaciers.  Liked seeing all the houses that you never see from the roads, way out in the forest.  Next time we'll take a longer flight!

review_title: Beware of the importance of weather
review_text: My trip was cancelled because the visibility was low. It was a valid reason. But I came to talkeetna only to do this activity. If not, I would have been in Fairbanks on that day watching aurora. TAT had cancelled all flights in the past two days. Weather was gloomy and drizzling for two days and weather prediction wasn't any different. TAT had my phone number and mail I'd. Still they didn't inform me until I reached their office. They were very sure that they wouldn't fly until the end of the day. If they had informed me earlier that they are so much dependent on weather, I would have made better plans for my limited time in Alaska. I understand that they cannot predict the weather completely and weather changes often. But they should let people know how much they are dependent on weather so that the customers can decide whether to risk their vacation time or not.

We decided at the last minute to add a flightseeing trip around Mt McKinley and surrounding peaks. We were not disappointed. Had a fantastic weather day. There is no way to explain the immense beauty we saw on our flight. Talkeetna Air staff are great and, especially our pilot. He made sure everyone on the plane got an opportunity to see all the amazing sites and take photos. His narration throughout the flight was spot-on. Definitely the highlight of our Alaska trip. Take the glacier landing tour, if you can. It is a one-in-a-lifetime experience.
Great way to see Denali and landing on the glacier is awesome.   I will do this every time I come to alaska!!!!

The staff was very helpful and accommodating. The pilot was great and we had just enough clear weather to see the top of Mt. McKinley. This was the highlight of this portion of our trip to the Denali National Park. The #1 ranking for this place on tripadvisor is well deserved. Highly recommend. We took the Summit Tour with the Glacier landing. Loved landing on the Glacier it was definitely a once in a lifetime experience.

Denali weather can be a bit unpredictable, so we planned an extra day in Talkeetna to allow time for this flightseeing tour - and it was well worth it! The pilot was knowledgeable, careful, and the glacier landing was awesome!  Spend the extra $$, highly recommended!!!
I had a great time but the reason I give four out of five is because the pilot who is supposed to double as a guide didn't give very much information

We went on a day flight and the weather was fantastic. The pilot was extremely knowledgeable on the mountain range and answered all the questions we had. We took the 1.5 hour flight without the glacier landing and it was worth every penny. We could see Mt. McKinley from top to bottom and all the glaciers well. Words can't explain the awesomeness of this flight. My smile never left my face. It was also my first flight on a non commercial plane and I felt safe the whole time. If we go back I think we will do the glacier landing.

We tried to arrange a glacier landing while we were visiting Haily but the weather prevented us from flying there.  So on our way back to Anchorage, we stopped by Talkeetna Air Taxi to see if they were doing glacier landings.  They said that they were and that we should sign up for the 3:45 flight, which we did.  

First of all, Talkeetna Air Taxi did not require a down payment.  The other service that we tried to fly with wanted a credit card deposit and would not let us cancel in the event they were not doing glacier landings.  Talkeetna Air Taxi, on the other hand, was very clear, if no glacier landing was possible before we took off, we could cancel with no penalty.  That sealed the deal because the glacier landing was what we really wanted to do.

Our pilot, Tyler, was great.  He gave commentary of the area during our flight and made us feel safe.  The takeoffs and landings were smooth as silk.  

I would highly recommend the glacier landing.  It was well worth it.

We stopped by Talkeetna on the way to Denali National Park and made reservation for flightseeing of Mt. McKinley and surrounding mountains of the Alaska range. We also included a landing on the Ruth Glacier amphitheater. It wasn't very cloudy so the sights were spectacular! The pilot, Richard, was the guide and was quite good. The landing on the glacier was definitely a unique and cool experience. Not necessary, but worth it if you can budget the extra expense!

Our pilot Trent was outstanding !!
I got lucky with fantastic weather to fly and land on a glacier.
I rescheduled 4 times due to bad weather and the staff at TAT was really cool to keep working with me and be patient. Finally the weather improved and they set me up with a fantastic flight. I give high marks to the staff and pilots at TAT. ( I work in the tour industry and I know a good operation when I meet one !)

We were originally scheduled for a 6pm flight but the weather was turning.  We arrived early and they put us on the 5:30 flight. McKinnely was visible top to bottom. Our pilot was excellent: knowledgable about the terrain, gave both sides of the plane opporltunities to photograph key views, landed on the glacier, gave us plenty of time to take loads of pictures, then on the way out spotted bears on the ground.  An amazing experience.
Talkeetna Air Taxi could not have been more accomodating in every way.  The customer service was exceptional as was the entire experience.  Would highly recommend.  Don't miss this!

It was the most amazing experience ! to our luck the weather was great, blue sky,the take off and landing was super smooth, the pilot was great. It's hard to describe the experience and the views, I have seen nothing like this and probably will not in the future. This is a must do in Alaska.
I have to say I was not a fan of getting in a small plane and flying up to a mountain...but it was AWESOME! I would so do it again. The glacier landing was amazing...truly a religious experience.

First of all, my review maybe a little biased because we didn't get to go to the best mountains. The weather was rainy, foggy, and depressing. Instead of reschedule/cancelling our trip, the Talkeetna Taxi decided to fly us out. After trying really hard to find a good mountain to land on, we landed onto an underwhelming glacier, which looked like a skiing slope wit some mountains around it. It was nothing like the pictures we were shown.

If you are considering TAT, make sure you ask about the weather, and change the schedule/cancel it if the weather isn't sunny and clear. Not worth spending $$$ for a lame plane ride.

The flight and glacier landing were terrific fun.  Great photo ops on the glacier.  The landings were very smooth.  The radio headset had a lot of static so we couldn't hear the pilot well.  That was the only drawback.

review_title: The highlight of our Alaskan Adventure
review_text: The crew and office staff are amazing, friendly and helpful.  Bent over backwards to make our flight include a glacier landing since the weather was iffy.  Just can say enough about everyone we met.

This is an exceptional activity, so worth every penny it cost. Our pilot was very smooth, and very knowledgeable. The office told us that the weather was unpredictable and that we might not be able to actually land on the glacier that day. We were told if we took the flight and could not land, we would not be charged for that part of the flight. It was a win-win so we took the flight. Incredible, breath-taking views of the land approaching the mountains, and then once in the mountains, the glaciers!  We did land on a glacier, which was just magnificent. The sun came out just after we landed. After leaving the glacier and flying out of the mountains, we flew into a rainbow. Perfect day, very safe flight. So glad we chose to do this.

review_title: Grand Denali w/ landing - magical. Make sure to use coupon.
review_text:
Took Grand Denali tour with glacier landing - absolutely stunning. All 11 people in our party - parents with teenage kids - were totally blown away. The flyover of Mt. McKinley is phenomenal by itself; but the glacier landing provides a very impressive climax and I would strongly suggest to do it as well.
Having flown in small planes before, I was pleasantly surprised by the general smoothness of their ride in Alaska. I probably need to read up on why it is, but my gut feeling is that there is probably less turbulence in the air.
Would like to express gratitude to our pilot, Paul - very professional, personable, generally good to be around.
First important tip: at least this year Talkeetna Air Taxi had their coupon in Northern Lights coupon book; and it knocked about 20-25% off the grand total.
Secondly: I wish we realized ahead of time how cool of a destination the city of Talkeetna is, we might have spent a night there. Turns out it is a departure base for I believe all the climbers heading for Mt. McKinley, and the city has got quite a vibe.

Having been in North and Southamerica, Africa, Europe, and Asia, there are a few experiences in my traveling life I will remember as highest points. This is one of them.

The flight to the highest peak of North America (more than 6.000 meters) and the landing on its glacier could sound risky or not for the faint of heart. Nothing more far from reality. And I can tell I fly a lot in commercial flights and experience in those big planes much more turbulences and discomforts than with this flight!!

All the flight (take-offs, movements among the peaks, landings) was executed smoothly, with perfect technique by the young pilot, whose name I cannot remember (only that he was from Arizona). Not only was he the pilot you feel perfectly safe with, but also he commented profusely all the trip about all kind of things we were seeing. Among them, a sublime avalanche in one of the surrounding peaks (far enough from us) minutes after we landed in the glacier. God-fearing awesome experience!!!

And worth every penny!!
(Not to talk of some of the most amazing photos I have ever taken)

We had the most special experience... landscapes and views were awesome and the landing at the glacier was incredibly smooth!!!! The pilot was very professional and explained us every place we saw. We were lucky with weather codition, neverthelessI really recomend it!!! It's not cheap but if you can afford it, do it!

review_title: Amazingly wonderful glacier landing plane ride
review_text: Worth EVERY dollar!  This is a most incredible experience. The views are unforgettable. The feelings you get are phenomenal! These guys are the best!! If you do nothing else in Alaska and only this ride, you will have had the experience of a lifetime. Go early and pay the extra for landing on a glacier. Book this ahead of time, it fills up fast.

My favorite activity on 10 day Alaska land trip! Worth the price tag. Drove from Anchorage (2.5 hours) AM for a 1:30 flight. Called ahead & requested earlier if possible to beat poor weather moving in, able to catch an 11:30 flight. 7 passengers. Incredible views of glacier valleys! Weather was partly cloudy so only saw about 2/3 of mountain. Very bumpy ride once we got near mountain. Pilot asked all aboard level of comfort & continued to Wick. Wall, then back to a nice wind protected glacier. This can be a very bumpy ride, but I'd do it again (not my wife!). Bring extra warm clothes, 30 minutes standing on glacier can be very cold! Felt like I could reach out and touch rock walls!

My husband and I booked a glacier landing flight.  Talkeetna Air Taxi was very professional and helpful when we called to make the reservation.  It was one of the most amazing trips we have ever taken.  Our pilot Trent was friendly and knowledgable.  I was nervous but the take offsand landings we smooth.  I am glad I went.

Our glacier landing family excursion was one the highlights of our Alaska vacation. And when I say family, I mean 2 adults and 3 kids (9, 8 and 1 year old). We all went and what an amazing experience it was! When planning our trip, we debated for weeks about having either each adult fly solo while the other one watch the kids or splitting 2 by 2 and taking the older ones. We decided on the 2 by 2 option and called Talkeetna Air to make the reservation. When we told the lady on the phone about our infant, she right away said "If you want, you can take the baby too". I have to say, I was a little nervous and had to think it over. Well, I am glad we took our little guy! We got to experience something really incredible as a family. Now taking kids on excursions like that requires some pre-planning. Our kids were all used to flying... but on commercial flights. I really wanted to make sure the older kids would be fine in a small plane. So a few weeks before the trip, I registered them for the EAA Young Eagles Program where volunteers take kids flying for free to make them discover the joy of flying (www.youngeagles.org). They both loved it and we knew we could take them on Denali! Now for the baby, the more I thought about it, I knew he would be fine as well. He is well traveled and a pretty laid back little fellow. Daniele was our pilot. She was great. She took the kids around the plane and showed them the inspection process and off we went! The baby was indeed fine... he actually fell asleep on the way there. Landing was breathtaking (literally!). The 2 older kids played in the snow, we took pictures and just enjoyed being at 5,000 feet in front of the Great One. It was a beautiful clear day. We were prepared with hats, gloves and heavy fleece. We did not need them. It was about 50-55 degrees on the glacier. Just perfect! Now It is true that it is far from cheap. We got a discount on the two older kids and the baby was free, but it was still a pretty penny. I guess for us, we don't buy the kids a lot of "stuff" even at Christmas. We just love going on pretty cool adventures!

My wife and I spent 3 days in Palmer, Ak B&B after 7 day cruise. Driving 100 miles to Talkeetna and flying around Mt McKinley was one of the best decisions we made. There were other folks offering flights. But, I can't imagine that they could be better than TAT. We booked our reservation by phone several months before we traveled. Very friendly staff and answered all my questions. We booked an 8:30 AM flight which came with a free glacier landing. They let me know that there was a certain amount of flexibility regarding time depending upon the weather. But, if "weathered out" of our 8:30 flight, the glacier landing would still be free. As it turns out, we had a beautiful sunny morning with no clouds. The pilot was very friendly, knowledgeable and an excellent "tour guide". My wife and I will probably not make it back to Alaska. But, I would highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi and see Mt McKinley by air.

Flight seeing in Alaska is a major investment, and this one is so worth the cost!  Will, our pilot, was experienced and friendly... he made the trip even more worthwhile.  You will never experience on a screen the reality of incredible views of Alaska, Denali, the majestic mountains, and endless vistas of Denali National Park. The glacier landing is a must if this is a one-time only visit.  If you go on an early or late flight you get the glacier landing as a freebie.  A must do, in my opinion.

Take non-drowsy Dramamine ahead of time if you tend toward motion sickness.

Trevor, our pilot, was great, giving us information all along the way.  The company ADDED the glacier landing, saying WE were doing THEM a favor by letting them give it to us.  So kind and professional!  The day was PERFECT and that glacier landing allowed us to play in the snow!  Coming from 106 in Austin, TX, that was a blessing!   We will go back again.  Love love this company!  HIGHLY recommend them!

Wow.  What can I say? The pictures that others have posted don’t lie.  I woke at 7:00 a.m. on flight day and found thick, low-hanging clouds throughout the Talkeetna and area.  I expected that the flight would be cancelled or I would be waiting for hours, but no.  In fact, weather near the summit was crystal-clear with deep blue skies.  I guess that’s just how variable weather can be in Alaska.  

I went on the Grand Denali Tour by myself, and I was glad that they would accommodate me as a solo passenger.  I picked the first flight of the day since that seems to be the best time of day for the weather.  The flight was very smooth, even smoother than the flight to Anchorage on a 757.  The pilot was very professional showing lots of sights and providing commentary.  I could hear him and air traffic control through my headset, and I even enjoyed (LOL) hearing the Stall Warning as we descended for the glacier landing.  

I spent about $315 total (somehow got the glacier landing for free) and I feel that it was well worth the price for me.  But, I do only recommend this for adults and kids who truly appreciate the sights.
Booked a late afternoon flight and glacier landing.  Great staff to work with and pilot.  The scale of the area is only appreciated when you are in the air and seeing it.

Our flight with Talkeetna Air was the highlight of our Alaska trip.  Our pilot, Don, was experienced and shared info about the mountains, glaciers, etc.  The flight was smooth, the view was priceless, the experience I could repeat daily.  A must do!!

We debated about taking a flight, but we're sure glad we did.  The staff is friendly and helpful - our pilot was friendly and very informative.   The glacier landing was breath-taking.  We had lovely weather and clear blue skies.   Denali was magical.   We get to check something off our "Bucket List" and we haven't even started to make one!

My only concerns about this trip initially was the cost of the flights, but after doing it I can assure you, spend the money on it.  Especially the glacier landing, which was easily my favorite part.  Our group was originally going to be 7 people, but 3 were delayed so TAT switched planes and took us as a 4 person group, instead of making us wait.  Because of the change we ended up in a small plane with the owner of TAT as our pilot, who presumably does not give tours often.  He was a great pilot with a relaxed attitude that made my nervous girlfriend feel better about the small plane.  

Short version of my review: Spend the money if you want to have a great time, and don't forget to do the landing.

review_title: I am walking on a glacier!
review_text:
Usha, my wife, kept saying "I am walking on a glacier!" after we stepped out of our craft on Ruth Glacier on Mt. McKinley.  It was a bright and sunny day, we saw the Denali peak very clearly.  Our pilot, Doug, had more than thirty years of experience flying small craft near the peaks of the Alaskan range.

We got many views of the peaks and it was a fully satisfying experience!  I guess we were lucky because the weather was great!

We booked the 8:30 flight with TAT well in advance, with an early bird discount. On the day of the flight, the weather was questionable. "Not a problem - you can go, or reschedule if your schedule permits, or we'll fully refund you". We decided to wait a few hours and see. A couple of hours later, I called them again. TAT, very cheerfully, "the weather is still not clear. Let us know". We decided not to take a chance, and cancelled. an hour later we meet a couple that returned from the 8:30 flight (which we did not take). According to them, the weather over the mountain is OK. We went to TAT again and asked when can we do the flight. TAT: "Now!".
40 minutes later we were over the mountain. What an experience. Truly out of this world. Something you have to experience. 

Our pilot (Tyler) was just as professional and nice as the receptionists. he made sure we all felt comfortable and safe, shared his experience and knowledge without yapping at us the whole flight. On the way back, he took advantage of the weather (light rain and sun) to show us a full-circle rainbow. What a cool dude.

Bottom line: they are professional, welcoming, and interested in you, not only your wallet. The flight and glacier landing are amazing. Take the landing option.

I had planned our Talkeetna Air Taxi excursion in advance and the weather was looking cloudy and showery on the day of the reservation.  TAT was wonderful in allowing me to rebook a couple of days earlier to catch a patch of great weather.  I am older person not quite yet at AARP age, but getting close.  I was a little concerned climbing in and out of these things.  I had no problems (it may not have been the most graceful :).  For anyone concerned about the "weigh in"...it is discreet....you get on a scale, but no one but the person behind the desk sees the number.  Check in was quick and efficient.  I used a Northern Lights coupon which saved us 25% off a party of four.  Do this if you can....definitely a highlight of the trip.

Thank you to all those at Talkeetna Air Taxi! I had a remarkable time. I felt very safe. I was co pilot in the landing on Mt. McKinley when we went. Great energy from the pilot. Friendly staff. Everything went very well. This is one of my favorite memories of all time, so thank you!!

On Wednesday, August 7th, we arrived at TAT at 4:00 pm for a 4:30 reservation for our party of four. As soon as we got to the desk we were shown a relief map of the area surrounding Mt. McKinley (Denali) and we were told that the cloud cover would prevent us from seeing the peaks. However, they had been making glacier landings all day. I discussed it with my party and told the staff that we'd go ahead as long as they were making landings. They again said they've been making landings all day. 
We put on the supplied over boots and boarded the plane. Just before we taxied away someone spoke to our pilot and I'm pretty sure he said something to the effect that the air had become choppy and a landing would not be possible but that he should fly around a little more. 
The flight was amazing but when we approached the glacier where he would have landed he told us the air was too choppy for a landing. When we returned to the hangar the pilot said that if we had paid for a glacier landing there would be an adjustment made.
I went back to the counter where another party was just instructed to put on their over boots.
I informed the staff at the counter that we didn't land on the glacier and that I was annoyed that they let us fly knowing that we had discussed it at the beginning and that we were going ahead with the flight with limited visibility because they had been making landings all day. 
One of the women said that they never guarantee a glacier landing because the weather is so changeable. I said but the pilot was told before we taxied away that there wouldn't be a landing and that we could have just as easily waited for the next day. She said, "We'll, you can try again tomorrow if you like." I'm not sure, but I don't think she was offering us a free flight, so, yeah for another $1100.00 we could try agin tomorrow. Thanks.
They refunded us $85.00 per person plus the $10.00 per person Denali park fee. 
Here's the thing. The flight was incredible. Not the issue. The people are really nice. Not the issue. The pilot was incredibly knowledgeable and gave us fantastic views. Not the issue. 
The issue is we were only going ahead because of the landing and before we left they knew we wouldn't be able to. Not only that, as far as I know, they didn't inform he people after us either.
We rented a car and drove from Anchorage, booked a bed and breakfast, spent a day in Talkeetna after a cruise from Vancouver and the highlight of our time in Alaska was going to be landing on a glacier. Yes, there was no guarantee that if we waited until Thursday we would have made a landing. No guarantee. But, it was a sure bet that before we took off they knew we weren't making a landing. Guaranteed.

When we visited Denali National Park, the clouds obscured Mt. McKinley, as it does frequently. We made a last minute decision to take a flight over the mountains and glaciers. Several people we met in the park highly recommended Talkeetna Air Taxi so we booked a flight which included landing on a glacier. Our excellent pilot  maneuvered around mountain peaks and glaciers giving us a spectacular view of Mt. McKinley.  Landing on the glacier was icing on the cake. We enjoyed it so much we were tempted to book another flight!  Even if you see Mt. McKinley, it is very worthwhile to do this flight.  Definitely the highlight of our trip.

Booked our glacier landing on a whim as we walked through town. If you do the first flight (8:00am) or the last one out (6:00pm) they give you the landing for the price of the fly over. Dud the last flight at 6pm and  I think we paid $199 each to land in the glacier and capture the most gorgeous photos on film and in our memories! Pilot was outstanding.  Very knowledgeable, patient and professional.  They also give you a last minute chance to change your mind before you go up if the clouds are obstructing the summit and fully refund your money. No tricks or gimmicks, they want you to enjoy your flight and get your money's worth.

We took the South Face McKinley Tour with glacier landing and it was an unforgettable experience. The views of the mountains, including Mount McKinley (peeping out above the clouds), and several glaciers are amazing. The glacier landing was fun, especially being able to take photos with the plane on the snow. The company is very professional: the booking process was smooth, they answered all of our questions in no time, and also in explaining the safety issues they gave us the impression they clearly knew what they were doing.

We took the 2 hour Grand Denali Tour with a glacier landing on August 2nd.  There is no question this was the highlight of our time in Alaska.  The majesty of the mountains and the beauty of the daunting wilderness are made intimate, real, and inspiring on this flight.  Nothing can prepare you for the power of the mountains up close, or for their enormity as experienced when you land, not just on A glacier, but a glacier surrounded by the peaks of the tallest mountains on the continent.  This was very,  very special and worth every penny.   In addition, we were very impressed with the care, security, focus, and knowledge of our pilot, and with our aircraft.  We flew in a 10 passenger Otter that had plenty of room for everyone, was equipped with bubble windows which made photography from the plane possible, and provided a smooth turbulence free ride.  Our pilot (whose name I am sorry to say I did not get) was extremely knowledgeable of not only the mountains, but the history of efforts to climb Denali and the geologic process that forms and transforms glaciers.  He even spotted a Moose swimming in a lake below us on the flight!   On the ground, the staff provided first class service.  We arrived in Talkeetna early on the day before we were scheduled to fly and checked in to make sure we knew the lay of the land.  It was a perfect day and Denali was crystal clear in the distance.  The staff asked us if we would like to fly in that afternoon since they had room on a late afternoon flight, and the weather report for the next day was for overcast skies and a shower or two.  We readily agreed, and while the weather the next day was fine for a flight, it wasn’t as good as that afternoon and so they helped make a great experience a spectacular one.  Talkeetna Air Taxi personnel were just top notch, A-one, the best.

review_title: Nice flight tour...not a perfect day
review_text:
We could not do a Glacier Landing...and from talking with folks, I don't think these happen very often (although they are advertised as a big part of the experience).  The flight was good...pilot was young, but did a great job.  We did get nice shots of Denali...but it was still fairly cloudy.  

They do (as advertised) talk about the conditions and let you make the choice on whether or not you want to fly (or refund)...I am glad we flew.
We had a great glacier landing. Ths s a must do in Alaska. They even picked us up from our hotel. They have free glacier landing with flight seeing tours in the late afternoon.

This was a last minute decision to do. We booked the night before especially since the weather was predicted to be clear (which it was). From the beginning, it was obvious that the pilot and whole team were focused on safety as well as sharing what they could to add to this experience. I had a big smile on my face from the time we took off until we returned. We were able to do the glacier landing and this was huge! I know the impact of this excursion would not have been as strong without the landing (which was sooo smooth!). When we returned, I had tears in my eyes...it touched me that much. The incredibly clear and sunny weather definitely added to this experience and I would highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi as the service to use to see Denali up close.

I took the flight that landed on a glacier. The trip was everything I had hoped it would be and more. Both the office staff and pilot were helpful, kind and fun. The views were absolutely amazing. I would do it again in a heartbeat!!

Took the McKinley base camp/land on the glacier tour.  It was fantastic!  It was a clear day with smooth flying and spectacular viewing.  Our pilot was outstanding and went out of his way to make our trip enjoyable (and safe).  This has been the highlight of our Alaskan trip thus far.  I am glad we spent the money and would highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi.

I think there are at least 3 air services in Talkeetna that provide flightseeing trips to Mt. McKinley,  Talkeetna Air Taxi is definitely the class act of the group.  Check in personnel are over the top friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable.  Pilot was a great guy with tons of knowledge and facts about what we were seeing and landing on the Mica Glacier was awesome!  There is no better way to see Mt. McKinley up close and personal and to stand on a glacier at 3000' surrounded by magnificent snow covered mountains was stunning.  At Talkeetna Air Taxi we found that the people, the planes, the gear and the experience were all first rate.

Mom and I booked a half day trip.  She's 70 so this trip is doable for everyone! Pilot was knowledgeable and answered all questions without frustration - of course, that was when I was able to talk! The views we got were breathtaking and I sat in awe most of the trip.  Well worth the time and money.

Our trip with TAT was amazing.  Our pilot, Brad, was very informative and friendly, and the views were spectacular!  We did the trip to see Denali and land on Ruth Glacier.  Spendy, but well worth it.  We did get a nice military discount since one member of our group is military.  I thought it was great that we all (4 of us) got the discount.  We were lucky to have a clear, hot day in June. I would definitely recommend stopping on the glacier and make sure you have a lot of space on your camera's memory card.  This was a highlight of our Talkeetna trip.

The employees of Talkeetna Air Taxi are courteous, helpful, professional people.  Our flight was a great sight-seeing adventure.  Landing on the glacier was AMAZING!  To stand on a glacier and look up at Denali so close is truly amazing.  This is a great experience that should not be missed on any trip to Alaska.

The Talkeetna Air Taxi is definitely worth the ride, despite the price. We flew on a clear day in the morning, at about 10am. The sun and cloudless sky made the view incredible. Our pilot talked to us along the way, pointing out various spots along the mountains, as well as the McKinley base camp. We got to take amazing photographs during our land. Make sure to wear the booties- they keep you from slipping on the ice. Definitely worth it!

review_title: Must-do flight-seeing over McKinley and its glorious glaciers
review_text: Although this was a pricey flight, it is a definite must-do. Try getting some local coupon books to save some money on the flights. The 10-seater plane itself was clean and well-maintained. The ride over the mountains and the Denali NP was spectacular. The pilot was friendly and very helpful. He gave us ample time on the glaciers to walk around and take pictures; we didn't feel rushed.

This flightseeing trip was the pinnacle of 2 weeks of amazing experiences.  Words and pictures fail to convey what a flight around McKinley is like. I thought that upon landing my girlfriend and I would be babbling about the flight, but we were both so awestruck that we didn't actually say much at all, nor did we need to. It was like being in your own Discovery Channel documentary. I can tell you that it was very smooth and even though we were flying between, around or over mountains, we always felt extremely safe and comfortable. I was expecting the plane to be bouncing around while in the mountains but the flight was as smooth as glass. Later in the week we had talked to some people who described themselves as nervous fliers but on their flightseeing trip they had no nervousness or fear. The flights are not cheap but they are so incredible that a flight and glacier landing are an absolute must do. Save money by not doing all the silly touristy activities and have a genuine Alaskan experience.

We chose the South face Tour with Glacier Landing. The check in was fast and easy. The staff was super nice. You have to weigh yourself and your belongings and they determine how to distribute the passengers, even where to sit so the plane is balanced. Several groups leave at the same time, but it is orderly. John, our Pilot was very nice and knowledgeable. It is evident that all the staff enjoy what they do. The scenery was incredible, and landing on the glacier was really cool. You are surrounded by mountains with McKinley towering above. Lots of photo ops. Don't let the cost scare you off, it was the best thing we did all trip. We would regret not doing it, had we not.

Our flight over Denali with a glacier landing was fantastic. The ride was the smoothest I have ever experienced on a plane and the glacier landing was breathtaking. It was beyond beautiful. I would highly recommend this trip to anyone in the area.

We did a flight-see over Denali and actually landed on a glacier! Wow!   Our flight was originally scheduled for the third day of our trip, but due to bad weather had to be re-scheduled (two times actually) so that we took the trip on our last day.  Staff was very helpful in getting this accomplished for us.  Our pilot was very steady and knowledgeable.  We appreciated his expertise as he flew us in for some fantastic, indescribable scenery.  We had a beautiful day for flying and are so glad we drove the extra 6 hours it took to make it work for us on the last day of our tightly scheduled vacation.  We loved it!

review_title: THE Experts in flying in the AK Range
review_text:
TAT is the best air service in one of the most beautiful places that the United States has to offer. They run scenic flights on both airplanes and helicopters flying amongst the high peaks of the Alaska Range, the sights are unbelievably impressive. 

Also they are the best folks to fly with when accessing the ranges for mountains climbing or skiing. They're knowledge and expertise is second to none. 

I've been flying with these guys for half a decade of climbing in the range and am consistently impressed with they're knowledge skill and kindness.

Go to Talkeetna and see for yourself!

Don't miss this adventure! The flight was the highlight to our vacation that took us all over the state of Alaska. We flew on July 21st in perfect, sunny, cloud free skies. Our pilot Doug was very friendly, knowledgable, and experienced and showed us the most beautiful scenery in Alaska. The staff was over the top helpful as well. When we ran into some transportation issues they got us where we needed to go. Thank you Talkeetna Air for a vacation I'll never forget.

review_title: Wonderful doesn't begin to describe this experience
review_text: We did the base camp with glacier landing tour.  This company has one thing in mind, accommodating the customer.  We had a flight planned for Saturday afternoon following our cruise.  We were going to be driving 2 1/2 hours from Anchorage to do the flight and then another 5 hours south to Seward.  When we arrived in Anchorage the weather wasn't very good.  I called and asked if we could reschedule to Monday and they said absolutely.  There was no questioning us and they even told me we could get a refund of our deposit if the weather wasn't good on Monday.  The weather was fantastic for flying.  Jonathan was our pilot and he was fantastic.  Very knowledgeable and did a great job in general.  One person in our group was terrified of the going but she did it and said she was very happy she did.  We were able to see the top of McKinley.  The two hours went by so fast.  We learned a lot about the area and of course the views were spectacular.  I highly recommend adding the glacier landing to your flight - it was well worth the money.  It truly felt like you were on top of the world.  Jonathan made sure that both sides of the plane had the opportunity to see all the wonderful sights.  For those who are looking to take pictures do not sit in the first row of seats, the wing may be in your way, sit in the back of the plane.  Also, you do not want your zoom lens on.  If you have a choice sit on the right hand side of the plane.  Ask if they have any specials - they were offering deals for the first and last flights of the day.

I echo most of the other reviewers, and might add something I overheard one person ask our pilot as we were all standing out on the bowl of Ruth glacier. They asked him if he ever got tired of doing his job. He said even after all these years, he still gets a thrill every time. We had the benefit on July 11 of gorgeous blue skies, a week that let us see the summit every day 4 days in a row. Thanks again, and I encourage anyone to give this serious thought when planning an Alaska visit. Truly a highlight.

Took a "round the mountain" flightseeing tour of Denali (formerly Mt McKinley) with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Excellent, well maintained aircraft, flown by experienced, knowledgable pilot who described in detail what we were viewing on the hour and a half flight.  Planes were equipped with photo friendly windows to record much of the scenery.  The hanging glaciers, glacier moraines, and rugged geology of this highest North American Mountain and its sister peaks is awesome.

We ended our Alaska cruise with a flightseeing trip around Denali. What a finish! Talkeetna Air Taxi is by far the company to use. Two reasons: IFR and pilots. Denali is frequently obscured by clouds and VFR pilots cannot get above them. TAT is IFR and we went above both layers. Our flight was 2 hours with great views all around Denali and a landing on Peter's Glacier at the foot of the Wickersham Wall. Incredible. Tyler, our pilot, was great. Focused on safety and providing the best possible experience. He positioned the plane so all passengers got equally great views.

review_title: Fabulous experience from ground to glacier and back!
review_text: We enjoyed the service provided by every employee from check in at TAT to talking to the pilot at 8,000 feet while standing on the Eldridge glacier! Thank you for the wonderful Alaska experience!

review_title: Do this even if it means you don't do anything else.
review_text: We booked this directly with Bev at TAT and got a great deal on the best flight. Jonathan, was beyond outstanding and the plane was just as sound. There are not enough words to adequately describe the views of the mountains and the experience of landing on the glacier. Jonathan's, knowledge and narration throughout the flight also added to this unbelievable experience.

We booked the least expensive flight and took advantage of the "special" which gave us a free glacier landing. We were fortunate that when we called from the McKinley Lodge we were told that if we could get there for the 5 pm flight, we would have the upgraded one. How fantastic. 
Johnathan is a wonderful pilot who is so knowledgeable about the area.We were so fortunate to have a good day for the flight. We saw so much and seeing the glory of the mountain was incredible. Our glacier landing was special. 
Note to others, make sure that you have adequate battery life in your camera. Ours bailed on me shortly before the glacier landing. We have all of the lifetime memories stored in our heads though. 
Thanks again to Talkeetna AIr taxi. We would recommend you to everyone.

As we planned our Alaskan trip someone told us that if we did anything, we needed to fly around Mt. McKinley.  After some research on various providers we selected Talkeetna Air Taxi (TAT).  We were impressed.  The office staff were very helpful and friendly. Our pilot, Trent, was an excellent pilot and tour guide, pointing out various points of interest.  He took us as close as he could to Mt. McKinley.  The landing on the glacier was beyond words.  I stood in awe of our surroundings. It was beautiful.  We had 15 minutes to play on the glacier then took off.  AsTrent flew back over the glacier as we left so we could see where we had been we were amazed at how we had been "little dots" on the glacier. Very definitely worth the time and money. TAT is a class organization.

We took the Grand Circle Tour which included landing on a glacier.  It was a beautiful, clear day, and everything was sharp and crisp.  A fresh snowfall (this was July) blanketed the upper slopes with clean whiteness.  The pilot took the plane past main features so that each side could see - everyone had a good window seat on this ten seater, but the front window on each side had the best view for photos - no struts in the way.  Although Mt McKinley/Denali was the highlight, the other mountains and razor sharp ridges, glaciers, and vistas were magnificent.

We had originally planned an earlier trip, but weather predictions were not good (one plane was stranded by weather on the glacier for three days in early July - no problem; they had food, water and warm sleeping bags).  So we scheduled randomly for a week and a half later.  But when we heard an updated forecast of clear weather, we were able to move up - and since we had not asked for a glacier landing, we were not charged for the landing made to pick up climbers.  The Talkeetna Air Taxi was very willing to work with us to get a trip with as good weather as reasonable, and ours was unreasonably good (only 30% of summer visitors get to see the mountain from the ground).

We decided that we were going to do a 'once in a lifetime' thing in Alaska for our vacation so we chose a flight around Mt. McKinley with a glacier landing. We did not have great weather and we were allowed to move our trip six (yes six!!!) times so that we could get the glacier landing. We waited around in the town of Talkeetna for the weather to clear for almost two days - I'm really glad the weather improved. 

The folks at Talkeetna Air Taxi were super helpful and it was an absolutely amazing experience. 

Very expensive but very much worth it.

Will, our pilot, treated us to amazing views of the mountain and the gorge. The highlight of our trip was the glacier landing. The day was perfect and exactly what I expected!  What an amazing way to see God's creation!

I've gone zip-lining in the Costa Rican rainforest, snorkeled with sea turtles in the Barbados and crewed on an America's Cup yacht in St Martin, but my recent sightseeing flight into Denali National Park with Talkeetna Air Taxi just may have been the coolest thing I've ever done!  From the time my wife and I started planning our recent two week trip to Alaska, at the top of my to-do list was a sightseeing flight into Denali National Park!  I reserved a morning flight with a free glacier landing on the Saturday of the July 4th weekend, but woke up that morning to overcast, drizzly skies.  Arriving at the TAT office, I was informed my flight had been canceled due to the weather.  I was given the option of getting my deposit refunded or rescheduling for later that day or the next.  As we were leaving Talkeetna for the Kenai peninsula the next morning, later that day was the only choice if I was to fly.  I opted for a 6:30 pm flight, hoping the weather would clear by then.  I arrived back at TAT that evening to find that planes were flying, although foggy and warm conditions up in Denali would most likely prevent a glacier landing and keep Mt McKinley mostly shrouded.  I was once again given the choice of a refund due to the conditions, but I wanted to fly!  As there was only one other couple going up with me, we were to fly in a Dehaviland Beaver, a great classic aircraft!  Our friendly pilot explained the safety regulations and pointed out the location of all safety gear in case of emergency prior to boarding.  Then we were up, up and away!  En route our pilot told us if at all possible, we'd land on the glacier, but it was unlikely due to fog at the various landing sites and sticky snow, due to the warmer weather.  He told us how just a week earlier a flight had been forced to land on the glacier due to a sudden storm and were stranded there for 4 days, unable to take off due to the snow conditions.  Point taken- not worth risking the landing unless conditions were prime!  If the scenery approaching Denali was amazing, the views once we entered the mountain range were just flat out  breathtaking!  Our pilot pointed out the various mountains and glaciers as he guided us expertly thru the passes, walls of rock and snow seemingly close enough to touch at times!  As expected, the upper half of Mt McKinley was shrouded in fog, but he took us around the lower flanks pointing out various points of interest.  Since we couldn't land on the glacier, he gave us an extra long time touring the peaks, before turning back to Talkeetna.  Upon arriving back at the TAT office, I was informed they were discounting my flight 10% due to the conditions preventing the glacier landing. Was I disappointed we didn't land on the glacier or get to see Mt McKinley in all it's glory?  Of course, but that doesn't mean it wasn't an absolutely awesome, jaw-dropping experience!  If your trip to Alaska brings you anywhere near the Talkeetna area, be sure to put a sightseeing flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi at the top of your list!

Paul, our pilot, treated us to a stunning flight with turns and views that amazed us.  He was clearly having a blast and very confident, and earned our trust.  The glacier landing was a highlight.  We were blessed with amazing weather and Paul loved it too.

review_title: Summit flight was the highlight of our trip
review_text:
We spent two weeks in Alaska and did a lot of excursions. Without question, the summit flight with glaier landing was our favorite activity.  Don't worry about the oxygen masks. Every one did fine with them. You are most interested in looking out the window and forget you have them on.
Pilot was great and informative and we lucked out by having a perfect day.  We even saw a small avalanche while on the glacier...didn't get charged extra either.  We were surprised to see that many guests did not tip the pilot.  They don't bring up the topic, but I know they appreciated it.

We took the flight to Mount McKinley early June during a record hot spell and included the glacier landing. The check in and seating was quick and efficient and the people very friendly. The flight and the scenery were simply amazing. The plot was well informed and skilled. Couldn't recommend this higher. Go take a stroll on a mountain glacier. Highlite of Alaska. Thanks Talkeetna air taxi!

It was a smooth takeoff, flight and glacier landing. It was an awe-inspiring experience beyond words. Our pilot, Tyler, was educational and accommodating with our group with ages ranging from 4 and including 3 teenagers. The snow on the glacier was tasty and fun for all to play in.
It is a must trip for all.
Recently went on the flight/landing on Glacier tour with them and loved it.  Pilot was very informative and friendly.  Trip into the glacier was awesome.  Clear day beautiful scenery.

When we arrived in Talkeetna, we were fully expecting to have to cancel our flight tour due to the bad weather.  We were cheerfully assured that, if we chose to cancel our flight, we would get a full refund.  If we chose to take the flight, and could not do the glacier landing, that portion would be refunded.  Even though the weather was iffy, we decided to head out to see glaciers, even though Denali had not been visible for days from that side.  Luckily, the great one seemed to love us and began showing itself just after take off.  Our pilot gave us an amazing flight.  He made sure that views were visible from both sides of the plane.  The flight over the glaciers and through the gorges was awesome.  I thought I had learned about all there was to know about glaciers earlier on my trip, but I was mistaken.  Lots in interesting information.  Well worth the money.  And the missed glacier landing?  Refunded immediately and cheerfully.

Our recent trip to Alaska was fantastic. And, our most exciting and beautiful trip was our
Flightseeing with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Our friends who participated in this adventure were
in awe of the sights before landing on the Glacier.  I can't tell you which glacier it was.  A trip all of us will never forget.  The best $$$ spent for this trip. Thanks Talkeetna!!!!
DSloat

We took the flighseeing tour and glacier landing over Denali at 6:30pm one night and it was incredible. The company is well organized and the plane was clean had great visibility. Luckily it was in the 80s  and clear the day we flew so we were able to see everything! Our pilot was excellent and provided us with a detailed history of the area as well as information about hiking the mountain and glaciers. I highly recommend this company!

review_title: A vacation highlight without a doubt.
review_text:
I had checked the web site for Talkeetna Air Taxi well over two years ago and I knew we had to do this trip, even before reading all the information. The flight booking for the four of us was no problem and we knew we would be safe in one of their famous “DeHavilland Otters”. When the big day finally arrived, and all the preliminaries dealt with, we were introduced to our pilot, a terrific young man, who also proved to be an excellent photographer as well. His expertise in the "Otter" was reassuring, as was his commentary about the area. Upon approaching Mt. McKinley through the cloud it looked like our views of the mighty mountain were going to be brief, but after crossing to the other side, it was as if a curtain had been lifted and as we looked to our right, there it was in all of it’s glory. We were in clear blue sky and what a magical sight the mountain presented. This was a photographers dream and I managed to capture some amazing images, both still and moving. The pilot decided to land on Buckskin Glacier, just to the side of Moose’s Tooth, a jagged peak seemingly not to far from McKinley, yet 23 kilometers away. The landing was like landing on a cushion, the snow soft and pure. The eight passengers onboard then spent a wondrous time experiencing the isolation and the sheer majesty of this pristine location. This was a life changing experience for most of us, and that included all four of our party. The take off and departure from the head of the valley and the subsequent flight over the very tip of Moose’s Tooth was another highlight. We then glided over and then down the other side, following other glaciers that appeared to be everywhere. Small planes flew underneath us, thousands of feet below, all going in different directions to unknown destinations. The remainder of the trip was just a blur of snow, big mountains and the ever present, yet spectacular glaciers.
I would love to do it all again and I strongly urge anyone with thoughts of doing this flight to go for it. The weather will be your only obstacle.

It was a great experience. The staff was really friendly and helpful. Best part is they provide you snow boots and sun glasses if you are landing on the glacier. 

Landing on the glacier was an amazing experience.  Its a little pricey but totally worth the money.
The pilot takes you pretty close to Mt Mckinley and it was just amazing.

Four of us went on the flight seeing tour and glacier landing!  What a wonderful experience.  We all had great views of everything, and our pilot/guide was able to answer all of our questions through the headphones that we all wore.  This area is so huge and makes you feel so insignificant!  It was truly amazing, and we did get to see glimpses of Mt. McKinley during our trip.
Excellent experience. Unbelievable scenery. This was our first time flying on a small plane and it was fantastic. This was the highlight of our vacation.

I was born and raised in Alaska, but now live in Seattle, WA with my family.  I don't get home much, but when I do, I love to be a tourist in my home state.  My husband and I wanted to have a once in a lifetime experience, and after TONS of research, we decided to go flying.  We made the right choice!!  We had sooooo much fun flying around Denali National Park, learning about it's history, and finally....landing on the glacier!  This is an experience I will NEVER forget!  I will now recommend it to all my family and friends, both local and visiting.  Please don't pass this up!  It's totally worth it!!!

OK this was the plane ride and glacier landing experience. This is one of those thing you do and it is a once in a life time experiences. AMAZING. So how is Talkeetna Air Taxi involved? Well they fly you around the Mountains, most notably Denali AKA Mt. McKinley and land you on a glacier. I would guess that if the weather is not good it could be disappointing. Here is how Talkeetna Air Taxi helped us out. On our way to Talkeetna, my husband was concerned that the weather would not be good for our plane ride/viewing and glacier landing so he called and asked if they could get us in that evening. They called  us back and scheduled us for an evening flight that day. Once we arrived in Talkeetna and the day went on, thunderstorms (yep it was so hot there they actually got a thunderstorm, which is very rare). Knowing it would blow over we went to our scheduled appointment time. It had gotten windy.
