My husband spoke with the employees and a pilot, who said we could still go up, but he thought the next day would be better. So they rescheduled us again. The next day, the day we were originally supposed to go was perfect.  So I am grateful they allowed us to change and then change again our flight seeing and glacier landing.

We used the NorthernLights Coupon Book (Like the entertainment book) to save some money. I believe the coupon was save on a group booking (four or more), so we saved several hundred dollars.

Our pilot and the other passengers (11 total on board the place) had great views of the terrain below and the mountains. The pilot was extremely knowledgeable about the history of the land, geology ect. He made many passes around Denali so each side of the plane could get good views and pictures (place was one seaters each side). Smooth landing on the glacier and we stayed about 30 minutes. We asked the  pilot lots of questions about the glacier, the indigenous peoples of Alaska etc and he answered them all. he also took lots of peoples pictures. The ride home was just as cool as we went along the Ruth glacier and he educated us on the glacier and about glaciers.

If you have the opportunity, this is a MUST DO!!!!!! I couldn't help but feel after this experience that we were blessed to have people who use their gift of flying to bring something like Denali and glaciers so close to us and to share it with us up close and personal.

We took a flightseeing tour around Denali (Mt. McKinley) and landed on a glacier. This is spectacular and shouldn't be missed if weather cooperates. The Talkeetna Air Taxi company flies many climbers to the mountain as well and they are terrific.

In our week-long family vacation filled with activities, the flight-seeing tour was our favorite. The views of Denali and surrounding peaks are breathtaking. And if you're going on a flightseeing tour I can't recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi enough. I used them to and from the Kahiltna when climbing Denali and liked them so much I came back with my family. Not only was the trip amazing, but it was about $800 cheaper for a family of four than competitors up near Denali National Park.

We took the flight the day before our cruise departed from Whittier. The views were fantastic, the weather was perfect, the landing at the Sheldon Amphitheater amazing, and John our pilot was very friendly, helpful, and professional. Yes, it is expensive but was the highlight of our visit to Alaska. Just do it!!!

review_title: Highlight of our trip to AK
review_text: This is the first time I have flown in a small airplane so was a little hesitant.  I should not have been as the flight was excellent and I never once felt scared.  I thought the flight might be turbulent but it wasn't.  Our pilot was Alex and he was calm, cool and collect during our 1 1/2 hour flight with glacier landing.  He advised us what we were seeing every step of the way and his landing were terrific. My husband and I were so glad we took this flight and chose Talkeetna Air Taxi...Outstanding.

review_title: even on a cloudy day: it's well worth it!
review_text:
When we made our booking for july 7th 2012, I was sure that we would have the same perfect weatherconditions like a lot of other guests had (don't ask me why I was so sure about it). Well, that was wrong. We were scheduled on an early morning flight with glacier landing. We woke up at 5 o'clock in the morning by the sound of the pouring rain = not the very best start. Our flight was cancelled and we asked if we could reschedule on a later flight the same day (we had to continue to Denali NP the same evening). => next try: late afternoon (what gave us the possibilty to go on a Jet Boat Tour (Mahay's Jet Adventure) which turned out to be interesting) When we came back to Talkeetna Air Taxi they finally decided to start the flight. I'm sure it would have been beautiful with sunshine. But: we had the clouds, and it was different, but very interesting: it's amazing how many different colours of gray and blue and white the glaciertongues have. Our pilot (Tylor) was "climbing" up through the clouds, looking for "wholes" in the clouds (getting close to the mountains) and doing a perfect landing on the glacier. Even if we know glaciers (we're from Switzerland): a glacier landing is very special, also to us. 

Special: Due to the weatherconditions, Tylor could not do the whole flight we had booked, and I was surprised that we got the difference paid back

What we also appreciated: Talkeetna Air Taxi prefers to cancel or shorten a flight instead of taking too many risks - the friendlyness of the people
If we ever make our way back to Alaska: we'll try it again: hopefully with sunshine
Thank you!

We were more that thrilled with this event. The company was a pleasure to deal with and bent over backward to be helpful and accommodating.Glacier boots were provided. I was especially pleased to see all the safety precautions that they observed - safety seemed to be of the highest priority and a natural part of their procedures.Their equipment looked current and in good condition. The pilot was enthusiastic and knowledgeable. He did not rush us on the glacier and kindly took photos of our party. We had 2 seven-year-olds with us and the pilot kept the commentary interesting to them also. I would highly recommend this company to any one looking for an unforgettable encounter with Alaska's wilderness beauty.

Our Summit flight and glacier landing was definitely one of the highlights of our trip to Alaska.  Our guide was very knowledgeable, the glacier landing was awesome, the view of McKinley was spectacular.  We would recommend this activity to anyone going to Talkeetna.

Talkeetna Air Taxi put the thrill into our recent flight round Mt. McKinley and landing on the Ruth Glacier. The day was clear and the flight smooth, but once into the Ruth Gorge and surrounding peaks the flying got interesting...fun and exciting beyond words. The pilot was very knowledgeable on glaciers and terrain, but did not do the non-stop tourista babble all too common on other attractions. Even mother nature added some avalances to quicken the pulse. I would do this flight every day if I could. That good.

This truly left me speechless today...  
First of all, the views were outstanding...
Our pilot, John was awesome & did a great job 'narrating' everything we saw!
Would do again in an instant!

review_title: Amazing experience- would absolutely do again
review_text:
This was one of the highlights of our trip. The location was easy to get to, as they provide free transport from your hotel. The check in process was efficient. We had a group of seven and had the plane (? nine passenger seats) to ourselves. Everyone had a window seat. We took the shortest flight with glacier landing. Views were amazing. I appreciated that there were no other planes flying near us. They do allow someone to sit up front next to the pilot- I heard the view from there is different but partially blocked by the propeller.

The glacier landing was the best part-I thought there would be other tourists around but there was no once else there. it was also surprisingly easy to walk on. While it looks breathtaking in pictures, it is so much better in person. I have walked on other glaciers before but this is the first one that looked untouched. I greatly appreciated that even though our trip was to be 90 minutes the pilot gave us about two hours- I think the extra time was spent on him taking pictures of us on the glacier. 

We had a sunny, clear day and that definitely made it better but the service was excellent. I cannot think of anything that could have made it better.

review_title: Must in Alaska ..... Do the glacier landing!
review_text: It was great!! Our pilot Alex was a great! We flew with 2 kids. He did a great job in flying and landing at glacier. He took nice family pics too. We are glad we did as a family.

review_title: Talkeetna Air Taxi - #1 Customer Service; #1 Great Experience
review_text: Talkeetna Air Taxi puts customers first.  We had a beautiful day - beautiful trip.  People in the office were fantastic.  Pilot was fantastic.  Worth every penny.  Best part of our two week trip to Alaska.

One of the highlights of my 2 week trip to Alaska the views from the plane were among the best views of my life. I am soooooooo glad that I did it as when I drove up to Denali the weather was cloudy and I could not even see  Mt Mckinley. The pilot was great both as a pilot and full of interesting information.Worth every penny !!!!!!!

what an awesome flight. 11500 feet to cross ridge at the back of mt McKinley and then down around finishing up by landing on the glacier. great trip with great pilot and major weather. it is a must do.

I used TAT with a couple friends to get into the Ruth Gorge and then to the Kahiltna for some climbing. TAT has the best reputation for glacier landings out of all the services and they definitely lived up to this. Extremely helpful people, great pilots, free bunk house, what else could you ask for? They dropped us off in the West Fork of the Ruth and bumped us to the Kahiltna when we called them. I would recommend them over any other company hands down.

I wanted to make the most of my Alaska trip, so a flightseeing tour was required. As a solo passenger, it was sometimes difficult finding a tour service, but Talkeetna Air Taxi took my solo reservation without any difficulty on their website. I put in for the full tour with glacier landing. On the drive in from Anchorage, they called me on my cellphone to adjust the departure time, which gave me a little more time to see the town of Talkeetna. On the day of the tour, the weather couldn't be any more perfect, warm, with high visibility of Denali and clear blue skies. The flight was smooth and our group of 10 passengers took many photos & videos of this huge snowy mountain range and big, sweeping glaciers. Landing at Don Sheldon Amphitheater glacier was short and smooth. Playing in the snow was fun. I got to ride in the copilot seat on the trip back from the glacier landing. Pilot was informative.

What a great experience! These folks are so accommodating. Easy to talk to when booking. They made the whole trip so enjoyable. Perfect weather and a perfect glacier landing. Hats off to our pilot Tyler. An incredible experience!  We highly recommend it! Thanks, TAT!

Called on June 1st , which was a sunny day.  My husband and I decided we wanted to wait until the next day to make this trip as our camera battery was dead, I was talking to Annie and she said not to wait as the weather changes and tomorrow might not be as nice.  When I explained to her that we did not want to go because our camera was dead, she offered us a camera to use.  Well we went and what a wonderful time we had.  When we arrived in their office after being picked up we were greeted by Beverly, who was delightful, very knowledgeable and helpful.  Trent was our pilot who was great also excellent at pointing out different things on our flight as well as a photographer once we arrived on the glacier.  After we returned Beverly drve us to town.  My thanks to Annie, Trent and Beverly for making this a very special trip.  I would highly recommend using Talkeetna Air Taxi.

We had really nice weather, quite warm actually, and we took the 1 3/4 hour tour with glacier landing.  A once in a lifetime experience.  We were a small group - 4 of us in a 5 seater plane.  The views were beautiful, thrilling, slightly scary, unlike anything we had ever seen!  Our pilot Alex did a great job pointing out the sights, keeping the ride fairly smooth, and making the takeoffs and landings seem easy.  The staff at the front desk and the shuttle drivers were friendly and helpful.  You can tell that all of the staff really get a kick out of doing this amazing thing for people. 

If you have a chance to do the flight, spend the money and do the full tour & glacier landing.  Totally worth it!

I love this place.. They offer the best flights around with wonderful staff. I highly recommend this flight of a lifetime.. Words, video or photos can not describe the true beauty of the Denali. You have to experience it on one of these flights.

review_title: Flight to land on glacier at Denali National Park
review_text:
Although rather expensive, it was the most memorable and beautiful experience ever.  They even let me borrow a jacket for the 17 degree temp on the glacier.
It is so beautiful flying over the mountain and landing on the glacier.  I highly recommend this trip.

We took a sightseeing flight near Mt. McKinley, Denali. They adjusted the flight slightly to fit the weather and it was great. I did not know if I wanted to take the trip but now am very glad we did. We saw the major peaks and lots of glaciers and other mountains. Even the flight from Talkeetna to the mountains over the river is interesting.

I was hesitant due to the cost, but I really wanted to get up and close to Mt. McKinley and to land on a glacier was the deciding "cool" factor. Wife is sensitive to motion sickness, so we were hesitant. The pilot was very sensitive to this and took easy maneuvers for her. As a side note, book an early morning flight to minimize turbulence. The planes are well designed to make photo taking easy, and trust me, you will take a lot of pictures. We got very close to the summit of Mt. McKinley with awesome pictures. Landing on the glacier was something I will never forget and the landing was smooth as butter. If you only do one thing in Alaska, this should be it. My wife even survived and had a great time!

Very professional group of people, had the pleasure of flying with 3 gentlemen from New Zealand, the weather was perfect and the pilot friendly and knowledgeable. I would highly recommend this amazing trip. Thank you Steve (at the sales desk).

Weather didn't cooperate, so we couldn't get the full tour we initially wanted.
They gave us an honest weather update, what we should expect sightseeing-wise, and then let us decide if we wanted to go on the flight any ways.
Staff were very friendly.

Pilot did a great job of picking his way through cloudy conditions (yet staying out of the clouds), and then put us down for a glacier landing. Wow. Just Wow.

Oh yeah, I'm also a pilot, so I know they were being honest with the weather and our expectations.

Only downside was the somewhat poorly performing intercom system. Some stations were not working, others working only in one ear.

Since the intercom is key to a successful flight for the customers, they really need to make sure it's fully functional.

Otherwise an all around excellent experience.

review_title: Very nice, worth all your money and friendly employees!
review_text: The pilot and his co-workers were very friendly and the price was very good! definitely the highlight of our trip!

review_title: Denali Flight with Base Camp Glacier Landing
review_text: Talkeetna Air Taxi ROCKS!! Amazing flight with narrative. Breathtaking views. You will not be disappointed with Rick Olmstead as your pilot. I am sure the other pilots are outstanding as well. Rick flew our plane. Trip of a lifetime! You will be talking about it for years to come.

review_title: A Must that You'll Never Regret!
review_text: If you have never been in a 5-6 person plane that will not only spend an hour or longer flying around the incredibly beautiful mountains and landing on a glacier, this is an absolute Must! You have your own window and can talk to the pilot throughout. And when it's over, you can grab a bite and brew in the nearby cute town (at your own expensive)-----and listen to each other's amazing impressions!

Heard about this company from people we ate breakfast with at the Roadhouse in Talkeetna.  They didn't disappoint. We decided since conditions were near perfect we would do the Mckinley flight with the glacier landing.  I wasn't o sure about the small plane - 11 with the pilot - but all was good and would do it again in a heartbeat if it wasn't so expensive.   We even flew over a bunch of hikers at the 11,000 ft base camp. Pretty neat. 
Highly recommend it if conditions are good.

Hats-off to all the pilots who fly the aircraft's in those challenging conditions. They are the real super heroes. The entire trip was fantastic and it really was a magical experience for us. We took the McKinley Glacier Landing tour and it was absolutely brilliant. You don't get this opportunity anywhere else in the world to fly between deep gorges, massive snow capped peaks, and breathtaking glaciers. The scale of mountains in Alaska is so deceptive that you will feel so close to the mountains while flying but then you realize the peaks are far away from you. TAT is the best in business and our pilot Doug was amazing. He flew us safely and flying is like a piece of cake for him. The take-off and landing was really smooth and the TAT ensures full safety before flying. The weather was absolutely gorgeous and it was really warm on the glacier. This is a must do for all the ones who visit Alaska. 

Thanks TAT

review_title: Hightlight of my trip to Alaska!
review_text:
I highly recommend taking this flightseeing tour with glacier landing and I can't imagine getting better service than from Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Although I had to wait for 3 days because of the weather, it was well worth it and the highlight of many highlights of my first trip to Alaska.  

I ended up taking the Grand Denali with Glacier landing and it was some of the most beautiful sights my eyes have ever seen.  I've taken an open-door helicopter over the volcanoes in Hawaii and landed in the Grand Canyon - I'd have to say this is right up there with all of that (if not on top!).  I felt very comfortable with our pilot and his experience - very smooth flight, he was very informative, professional, and made sure we were comfortable.  Landing on the glacier was incredibly smooth, I'd really have to say it was smoother than any landing I've had at an airport (this was my first flight on a private plane btw).  

Overall, one of the most amazing experiences of my life.  I cannot recommend this flightseeing tour and Talkeetna Air Taxi enough - they are top notch!

We were among the fortunate today who got to take a breathtaking trip to Denali on a picture perfect clear day.  This was an amazing, unforgettable trip and words fail to really adequately describe the immense scale and beauty of this experience.  You simply must do the glacier landing if you're going to do this.  It was incredible.  We took the whole family on the McKinley Base Camp tour.  This flight flies through the mountain passes and gives a spectacular up close view of the mountain and various glaciers. We're never going to forget it.  We felt very well taken care of and I wouldn't hesitate to fly with Talkeetna Air Taxi again.  I highly recommend them.  On a side note...  Try to stay for lunch or dinner in Talkeetna.  This is a cute town with a lot of local flavor.  All in all, an unforgettable experience. FYI - We were traveling with our adult children and toddler granddaughter.

The pilot was very professional gave a detailed description of what we were seeing the view was breathtaking the glacier landing was something to put on your bucket list and walking around o the glacier was a once in a lifetime experience when other visitors come to alaska this will be on the to do list

review_title: The best glacier landing experience in Alaska.
review_text:
WOW. This was our best experience of flying over the mount McKinley range, watching glaciers, snow capped mountains tops and slopes  and finally landing on Ruth glacier. The pilot constantly informed on the area below and after landing gave us about 20 minutes to roam on snow and take pics.
Excellent is the only word to sum up.

review_title: A Most Amazing Experience - Flight and Glacier Landing
review_text:
I booked a flightseeing trip with the Talkeetna Air Taxi through the Alaska Railroad reservation services in mid-April. It was the most wonderful experience! I had checked the 7-day weather forecast and saw that the weather on that Saturday would be perfect, no cloud cover. The TAT provides complimentary hotel pick-up, and a very nice young gentleman picked me up, along with others I had met on the train who were staying at another hotel.

We arrived at the TAT office at the flightline, and we all lined up to be weighed and outfitted with shoe covers for those without snowboots. I looked around and noted that Adam Richman (of Man vs. Food fame) had been a celebrity customer. He had left an autographed photo for the TAT staff to hang on their wall.

The flight started out with a safety briefing and we all boarded with great anticipation. The airplane was a De Havilland Canada DHC-3 Otter. We were provided headphones to listen to the flightseeing narrative by the pilot. It wasn't until I returned home to discover the call-sign "Zero Papa Romeo" referred to the last three letters/numbers on the aircraft (0PR). 

We flew around the peaks of Denali, and then for the highlight, landed very smoothly on the Sheldon Amphitheater on Ruth Glacier. It was so nice chatting with the other passengers all in excitement of what we were experiencing. We hopped out and started snapping photos of each other, of the terrain, of the Sheldon Mountain House (and yes, the outhouse with a lady exiting). When someone asked the pilot which peak was Denali, he pointed up to a peak way up high and so tiny above us and to the left. It was difficult to fathom exactly how high Denali actually was. The takeoff was amazing! It was as if we were in a helicopter! It took very little distance to lift off of the glacier snow. It was explained the turboprop made all the difference compared to the days of the old Cessna planes.

I cannot do any more than to recommend that this should be added to everyone's "bucket list." It was so wonderful!

Perfect experience! I phoned the day before and asked for a glacier landing flight for me alone. A few hours later I had the OK and they had other people for the flight, so it could be done.
Perfect organisation and flight. I really enjoyed!!!
We flew with TAT before (2010) to Kahiltna basecamp and this time to the Ruth Gorge. Great service (two nights in Talkeetna for free, taxi, etc.) and very kind staff!

review_title: Definitely worth the money - just do it!
review_text:
My friend and I did the "Grand Denali" tour yesterday at 2pm.  As expected, it was an amazing tour. The weather cooperated also -it was a beautiful, sunny day. Our pilot, Richard, was a wonderful tour guide. We stopped on Ruth Glacier for about 15 mins. There were some campers/hikers settled in there. Knowing that we would fly out - not climb, was a very good feeling. The tour was 2 hours which was a perfect amount of time. We were starting to get a little cold. 
We looked at K2 Aviation as well - it looks like they also have a good set-up. We received a little bit of a discount from the lodge where we were staying (Denali Overlook - outstanding). All the prices were pretty comparable - not cheap, but once in a lifetime event.

After poor weather cancelled our flight the first day, we were pleasantly surprised to get to fly the following morning.  Weather on the mountain was stunning, especially compared to the rainy gloom in Talkeetna.  We landed at base camp to pick up climbers - absolutely the best part of an already amazing experience.  Without a doubt, the best adventure of our entire week in Alaska!

I have never met people like the folks at Talkeetna Air Taxi. I swear, they will bend backwards to help you out, reschedule, work with your schedule to get you on a flight and their overall customer service and staff are AWESOME!!!  They were extremely helpful, they all asked if I was being helped or needed anything. I didn't want for anything. As far as the flight itself, I could not have gotten anything better for my money. It was spectacular!! They take you right in to the range with mountains on either side of the plane just seamingly within touching distance. The pilots were great at telling you what you were flying through and over and any questions you had, they had an answer. It was an awesome experience and I would love to do it again some time... It was the most beautiful thing I've ever seen.. If you have the chance to do it, go flightseeing with Talkeetna Air Taxi and their team. You will not be disappointed.

My husband and I took a Talkeetna Air Taxi flight seeing tour around Mt. McKinley on April 19, 2013.  It was so much fun.  Definitely a once in a lifetime trip!  Landing on top of the glacier was spectacular and as close to Mt. McKinley as I'll ever get.  It was unforgetable.  We were lucky the weather was spectacular but I imagine it would be beautiful no matter what the weather.  Our pilot did a great job making sure everyone was comfortable and relaxed.  There was a little bit of turbulance but he warned us ahead of time and I had every confidence in his flying ability.  The landings were flawless.  Thank you so much!

My son (late 20's) and I took the flightseeing tour on April 4, 2013.  We were in Anchorage and called to make a reservation. The staff was very friendly and worked to schedule a time that was both convenient for us ~ allowing us plenty of time to get there - 2.5 hrs from Anchorage ~ and not be rushed. It also allowed us to get a bite to eat in Talkeetna, since our flight was going to be shortly after lunch. Though the weather may seem warm outside, take a jacket and gloves, the glacier air is cold.  Sunglasses are a must because of the glare from the snow. If you forget them, you can get a set upon registering at the check in desk. 'Over boots' are provided for your shoes, and they cover your leg to approx mid calf. Though I had ankle top hiking boots on, the rubber boots fit easily over them. My son was in tennis shoes and he was fine with the overboots. His feet did not get wet.  The plane is small, so you will have a tight fit, but it is well worth it, once you see what is in store for you. The beauty and majesty of the mountains fills you with awe. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and pointed out interesting features of not only the mountains, terrain, and surrounding area, but the glacier itself. Landing on the glacier was a thrill. The beauty and quiet has such a sense of peace. You feel as if you're in another world. There is plenty of opportunity for picture taking and strolling around.  I took a lot of pics on the flight to the glacier and was beginning to think my camera battery would die, but it didn't. I would encourage you to take your pics on the flight TO the glacier because that is where the bulk of your trip is going to take place. You fly through many areas of the mountains before you reach the glacier. The trip back to Talkeetna airport was picturesque for the first 15 min or so, but I didn't take as many pics as on the way up. There were only 2 drawbacks for me: I have difficulty getting into the small planes ~ so it's not graceful ~ there's no easy way to get in them. Secondly, I was sitting up front, so maybe the noise was louder from the propeller, but I had to strain at times to hear the pilot's narrative on our flight. It could be also that he may not have been speaking loud enough. My son is a private pilot and after our trip, he commented to me on how well the pilot flew the plane. In previous flights on small planes we've experienced slight nausea, but neither of us did this time.  I felt very relaxed, safe and secure on this flight and would highly recommend this flightseeing tour. If you're in Ak for a short time, this is a must if the weather is in your favor on your trip.  Enjoy it!   ( Waiting for our flight we learned that this air taxi is also a shuttle for mountaineers preparing to hike the mountains or ascend Denali. So this company has a lot of experience flying into the mountains and landing on the glaciers.)  This is a very professional team and safety is a priority.  I would definitely use this company again.  The Lees - Culpeper, VA

My husband and I did a flightseeing tour on April 6 and it really was one of the highlights of our short trip. The views were amazing and it was exciting to fly so close to the snowy jagged peaks. We landed on the Ruth Glacier and it was absolutely beautiful! My feet and hands were turning into popsicles even with several layers on, but it was still worth it. It's an experience you'll never forget! I would highly recommend this!

This past March my roommate was kind enough to invite myself, and another roommate, to stay with his family up in Talkeetna. We had a blast exploring the terrain on snow-machines and the town by car. What we had yet to see, however, was the majesty of the Talkeetna and Alaska Ranges. Luckily for us,  my roommate's dad was an old friend of Annie, and she was able to fit us in for a mid afternoon flight to the Ruth Glacier. Our pilot was an experienced aviator and we enjoyed listening to him discuss the history of the Alsaka Range The flight itself could not have gone smoother, and our pilot was kind enough to take dozens of pictures of the group once we landed on the glacier. We were also able to see Mt. McKinley by air, which was hands down one of the most extraordinary sights I, personally, have ever been privileged to witness. I would rate this company 5 stars out of 5 any day of the week. Thank you Annie and the crew for truly an adventure of a lifetime!!!

Definitely worth the money. Spectacular landing in the Don Sheldon Amphitheater and walk to the ice cave of a Japanese photographer. Views of Mt McKinley and surroundings were great. Everyone had their own headphones and the pilot gave a very interesting tour. Would do it again.
Love Alaska in the winter.

I don't generally use initials to describe an experience, but this was all I could think of to express my feelings about this trip to Ruth Glacier.  Getting in and out of the plane is all part of the total experience. We got a close-up view of the mountains, landed on a glacier (my mother had been on another of these glacier trips during the summer, she said this trip was WAY better), and visited an ice cave where a Japanese photographer had lived for 2 months.  The pilot made sure people on both sides of the plane could see the important scenic points.  A little pricey- BUT WORTH EVERY PENNY!

Had a great experience flying in to the Pika Glacier (a.k.a. "Little Switzerland") with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Paul is the best pilot I've flown with and put us down right where we wanted to be.  He picked us up again 5 days later and even gave us a scenic detour on the way back to Talkeetna.  All of this after he participated in a 25k XC ski race in the morning!

My wife and I experienced the 2 hour Denali with Glacier landing tour here during our holiday of Alaska in Feb / March 2013.

We were both blown away. The views are probably some of the best that I have ever seen and the glacier landing was spectacular.

We were also lucky enough to have excellent, clear weather which helped with the viewing.

The ride was smooth and our pilot Danielle was both friendly and knowledgable.

review_title: Amazing flight!  Should be on your bucket list
review_text: We did the McKinley Base Camp flight with glacier landing on Talkeetna Air Taxi. This was an amazing flight.  We landed on a glacier - not a footprint or tire track to be seen.  Everything was so clear and fresh!  You could look up and see the mountain tops and look out to see the mountain range.  Do this and check it off your bucket list (even if it's not on your bucket list)

review_title: Once in a lifetime experience - landing on Mt. Denali
review_text:
We took a flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi to fly around Denali National Park and Mt. McKinley and then land on the Ruth glacier on Mt. McKinley (about 6,000 ft).  It was a calm and crystal clear day so it was a breathtaking experience.  

Talkeetna Air and our pilot were very professional and friendly.  

When we review out pictures and videos of that day it brings back the excitement and grandeur of the experience.

It was one of the best experiences of our life.  

I highly recommend this activity when in Alaska and new Denali National Park.

We booked this flightseeing tour in advance of our Alaska trip based on tripadvisor reviews and we were not disappointed! When we first arrived in Talkeetna it was overcast and rainy so our flight was postponed. The staff at TAT were very friendly and helpful with rescheduling our flight. We arrived early and checked back throughout the day but with no break in the weather we were forced to reschedule. I would stress that you should try to plan an alternate date in your trip in case you have to cancel due to weather. Luckily our flightseeing trip was scheduled before our trip to Denali National Park and we were able to reschedule for the day we left Denali which turned out to be gorgeous! We arrived early as instructed, were checked in quickly and found out we were being upgraded from the basic south face tour w/ glacier landing to the full grand summit tour! We boarded a small plane with only two other people and set out almost immediately. The scenery is spectacular. If you're coming to Alaska with a goal of seeing Denali this is the only way to truly "see" it. Our tiny Cessna flew up and down glacial gorges, made a 360 degree circuit of the summit, and made a perfect ski landing on the snow-covered Ruth Glacier. This was one of the best experiences we had in Alaska and money well-spent. If you splurge on one big excursion in your Alaska vacation, make it this one.

review_title: viewing Denali by air and landing on a glacier the most amazing experience
review_text: My husband and I were one of the last flights of the day and we flew in the tiniest Cessna and I felt like I was knee-to-knee with our pilot. The Cessnas are specially modified to land on glaciers and fly at these altitudes and in Alaskan weather so it was all very safe and our pilot experienced and professional. Talkeetna Air Taxi have other larger planes but we were the last ones for the day and we were pleased to experience a 'private' Grand Denali tour with glacier landing. If there is inclimate weather, see if you can wait another day or try to be flexible in your travel itinerary because it's worth it to do the glacier landing and get views of Denali. The weather was iffy on our day so we chose to wait around and then were in luck to be able to land on one of the smaller glaciers. You see so many glaciers that it really didn't matter to us which glacier we landed on as there are so many to view. I'm glad we chose to go with Talkeetna Air Taxi as it was nice to do the flightseeing from Talkeetna itself. And we did get intermittent views of Denali despite the not-so-perfect day. Well worth the money.

Last May I took a 14 day trip from Denali all the way to Ketchikan.  We had beautiful weather throughout and saw glorious sights every day.  However, even though we had beautiful weather in Denali, Glacier Bay, Skagway, Ketchikan, and Juneau the aerial tour that we took with Talkeetna Air Taxi was easily the highlight of the trip!  You cannot even comprehend the scale of the topography until you see this for yourself.  If you only splurge on one major excursion during your entire Alaska vacation then may it be a Denali Aerial tour with Talkeetna Air.

review_title: Was the highlight if our vacation.
review_text: Whe booking anything in AK, always try to have a back up date/ plan, when it comes to weather related plans. While heading to Denali our plan was to take a glacier flight/ landing around Mt. Mc Kinley. We arrived as planned but learned due yo the wildfires a flight was impossible. They were very apologetic and helped us come up with a plan. Luckily we would be passing Talkeenta on our way to Seward and we would try again. Luckily it was a picture perfect/ smoke free day so there definitely be a flight. Unfortunately because so many flights were rebooked like ours, our flight was booked solid. Our pilot came out looked us straight in the eye( holding all our info) and said because this is a booked solid flight, it is important that none of us fudged our weight#'s and if he thought we did he would have no problem bringing out a scale. Although if this was at any other place I may have been upset or insulted. Instead I appreciated the safety measures that they think is necessary. Our flight was amazing and the mountain was out the whole time. Lots of photo ops. The glacier landing was by far one of the coolest things I have ever had a chance to do.  I highly recommend that if u are willing to do the flight, go ahead and pay extra for the landing. You may never have an opportunity like this again. Once we landed we took pictures for what seemed like 15 minutes and gawked at the mountains surrounding us. On our flight back we saw a few moose and a beaver damn. During the flight the pilot provided us with info on geology and wildlife in the area. The best part was I found a coupon for this in a magazine that I got at the airport. So be on the look out.... I believe it was a 10% off!!! If I ever drive up towards Talkeenta again this will definitely be on my yo do list .... Coupon or not!!!

review_title: On the wings of an Eagle
review_text:
Annie at Receptionist, Thanks for collecting me.
The service was professional, for an outback village,even with delays the staff were good. They go the extra mile, to nshow you more, specially if the weather does not allow you to land, Mike the pilot, flew low so we could get decent pictures and flew round Mt McKinley for us. Usually one only gets what you pay for,, they know people want to see glaciers and wow..those mountains..they are unforgetable, but also keep the safely of their clients in hand at all times.
Thanks guys, it was an awesome sight.

This was a once in a lifetime experience.  Our pilot Jim was great - he even helped my 75 year old dad in and out of the plane and offered him the only seat up front first out of our group - it was worth the price

Since 2009 I have been traveling north to Alaska to visit some of the most spectacular scenery in North America: the Alaska Range! The Ruth Gorge, Mt Huntington and of course Denali all a bird's view thanks to the excellent staff and pilots at Talkeetna Air Taxi. I have flown all over the state of Alaska (SE Alaska, Wrangell St Elias) with different flight companies and I can confidently say Talkeetna Air Taxi is the best hands down.

Very professional group. Awesome flight see tour with landing on glacier. Our guide and pilot was very informative and knowledgable of everything we saw. Would definitely recommend their service. Thanks for the great family memories.

I took my Dad in June, we both thought it was really neat. He has never seen much snow before and being on the mountain in the snow, seeing the glacier ice and all the beautiful scenery was breath taking! Very impressed with the staff they were constantly checking the weather situations and making sure it was safe. The pilot knew the history and pointed out a lot of stuff to us. He was also great about taking pictures for all of us. Next time I will take binoculars as I did not see the animals or the climbers when pointed out, but several others did.... so take binoculars!

review_title: Mt. McKinley south face flight with glacier landing
review_text:
Wonderful!!  Talkeetna Air Taxi was great to work with and safety is their top priority.  They only fly when conditions are safe.   The staff was friendly and very helpful.  The boots were provided for the glacier landing.  Highly recommend for anyone who can get into the airplane.

The sights were breath-taking.  Definitely one of the highlights of my vacation.  The weather in Talkeetna was overcast and I assumed that the flight would be canceled.  Once in the air and above the cloud cover, the sky was clear and the sights were amazing.

I was glad that my fear of flying and hesitation (because of the cost) didn't stand in the way.  This was an experience I'll always remember.  This is a trip that I would take again if I'm ever in this area again.

review_title: the feeling of breath with the Mt McKinley
review_text: we booked for Aug 19 but cancelled for weather but we were lucky to get it on Aug 21. It was so amazing we were so close to Mt Mckinley. Richard, our captain, was very professional and brought us different angles to see the mountain. And the glacier landing, the pure snow and calm atmasphere while Mt McKinley was there with sunlight on it. 2 children were very excited. Air Taxi really gave us one of the best memories in Alaska.

From my initial emails to book the flight in April to my actual flight in September, everything was perfect. Super nice, friendly people. They answered all my questions, picked me up at the train and drove me to the Roadhouse to drop my luggage, then drove me to the airstrip. I lucked out with perfect weather. Using a coupon offer from their web site, I got a great deal on the Grand Denali flight with a glacier landing and it was one of the highlights of my trip. Highly recommended!

We were in Wasilla Alaska for a couple of weeks.  We wanted to take the Talkeetna Air Taxi to Mt McKinley and land on a glacier.  We had to wait almost a week for the weather to clear for our trip.  I used their web cam and waited until I could see the mountain before calling and booking our flight.  What a great flight, landing and adventure.  Our pilot narrated the trip telling us all about the mountain and life in Alaska.  The view are breathtaking and landing on the glacier was super.  So majestic up close and personal up on the mountain.  It was just a great tour.  Our plane was a de Havilland that had been totally rebuilt, very modern.  It held about 8 people or so.  I would highly recommend this tour.

It was three days before the weather cleared for our trip, but TAT fit us on their first flight the morning of our departure.   It was amazing.  Both of us enjoyed the views and the brief stop on the glacier.
The flight into Denali and landing on a glacier was the most memorable moment of my life, save for when I delivered my babies.  Breathtaking!  These are top notch pilots...spend the $ and go.

review_title: Best thing we did in Alaska
review_text: We flew the "red route" (on the website map) around Denali with Bill and got very lucky in regard to weather.  We were able to circumnavigate Denali and land on Ruth Glacier even though other flights had not been able to do so.  The views were breathtaking (truly stunning!).  Our pilot, Bill, was not only extremely competent and professional and safety-conscious, but he was also a great tour guide.  He knew the terrain very well and pointed out many different glaciers and rock formations on the mountain and the land between Denali and the Talkeetna Airport.  It wasn't cheap, but it was worth every penny.  We had lamented that a trip two years earlier had never yielded a good view of the mighty mountain, but Bill gave us an unparalleled treat in a spectacular view of it on that day.  Thank you, Bill, and thank you, everyone at TAT!

This was the highlight of our 2 week trip in Alaska. Crystal clear morning with a complete view of all of Denali. We landed on Ruth glacier and ran around like kids playing in the snow. My husband and I stopped several times taking in the beauty..we were overwhelmed by our surroundings! Our pilot was as good as they can possibly get and even though he does that a few times a day for nearly 20 years..he said the weather for our trip was very rare! He even took several pics with his own camera. Highly recommend this company and make sure and do a glacier landing!

We had a great flight!  Seeing the glaciers from the air is fascinating.  Our pilot narrated the flight nicely...maybe a little more info would have been nice.  We did a glacier landing, too.  Overall, the flight and landing were very worthwhile!

I found them on Groupon and took the opportunity knowing I would be traveling to Alaska for a couple of weeks from New Hampshire. This was the best aerial tour so far out of all the ones I've done as a photographer. The weather is ALWAYS a determining factor especially since you're flying over mountains so the weather is always a toss up. I also decided to do the glacier landing which was by far the coolest experience in my life. The pilot was fantastic, the commentary, answering questions etc. He was incredibly friendly as well as the staff and I can honestly say it was money well spent. You cannot pass up such a wonderful experience. Bring a camera and click away. You will not be disappointed, but when scheduling it do make sure you check weather.

We asked locals for their opinion of the flightseeing companies and the consensus was that K2 was the largest but TAT was the friendliest.  We were very pleased with TAT and our pilot, Tyler.  Of course, it helped that we had a gorgeous day, the mountain was 'out', and the wind was down.  Tyler made the smoothest possible glacier landing and take-off, and gave us a  fingertip-touching flight close to the mountain side.  Our one regret was we couldn't share our 'wow' moments with each other because we had on (very comfortable) earphones.  Loved it!

it's on general, not a very good experience.
First, the weather is not ok. So our flights have been pushed off till afternoon. But it's not on them.
But finally we got boots on and ready and getting excited, the 10-people plane got some mechanic issue so we were off the plane and waiting. Then after some prep, the plane was still not working probably. So we were offered the options to take smaller plane which flies  and acends slower. And it needs pilots' eye to check for routes, so no device help. 
We four got on a plane, and the view is great. And we failed to land on glacier bc of the weather still.

So I like the tour generally, and should have prayed more on the weather. Complaints is their maintenence of the planes.

This was one of the highlights of our trip.  The staff and pilots were overly helpful in preparing for your flight.  They were honest about the wind conditions and that it may be a bumpy ride, you could have canceled with a full refund.   They advised on what to where for the glacier landing.  
Our pilot was great - informative of what we were seeing - great info related to the hikers climbing McKinley & base camp.   We had a great group & we had a lot of fun.  Landing on Ruth Glacier was absolutely amazing -  beyond words.  We are so glad we saved for this.

We had a great trip despite inclement weather, and only getting to the first 2 glaciers.  The commentary provided by the pilot was both helpful and entertaining and we got some wonderful photographs and memories.

The air trip with glacier landing was the highlight of a wonderful two weeks we spent in Alaska.  This company and our pilot were personable and professional.  Just go and do this if you possibly can while in Talkeetna.  It is truly the experience of a lifetime.

review_title: Do NOT Miss This Amazing Opportunity!
review_text:
We arrived in Talkeetna on a sunny afternoon and took a chance on getting a flight out with TAT.  They say only 30% of travelers actually see Mount McKinley, well we not only saw it... we saw it from "close up" because of the great team at Talkeetna Air Taxi.

My wife was chosen to fly co-pilot and enjoyed the best views, although everyone gets a chance to see evrything as the pilots turn frequently.  The plane was a DeHavilland Otter and was in excellent shape and obviously very well maintained.  Our pilot (Will) was informative and answered all of my wife's nervous questions with ease and skill.

The landing on the Ruth Glacier was smooth and when we got out and walked around... it was life changing.  The beauty and shear size of the mountain peaks and the glacier was breathtaking.  I wish we could have stayed longer.

This was clearly the highlight of our Alaska trip and the first thing we talk about when friends ask about our vacation.  Do NOT miss this amazing opportunity if you visit Alaska.  And give TAT your business, they are the best!

My wife and I took the flight around Mt McKinley and landed on the Ruth Glacier. Our pilot was great and the scenery was spectacular. I was initially reluctant to spend the money, but after reading the reviews on Tripadvisor decided to make a reservations. The weather turned out to be great and the Talkeetna Air Taxi staff were great. Being a pilot myself I was very impressed with their safety and flight procedures and the aircraft they fly.

This is a first class operation.  Sea Otter airplanes are well taken care of.  Starts out with outfitting of "glacier boots" and before loading, a safety talk and a briefing on the flight.  Everybody gets on.  I ended up in the copilot seat (no controls) going up.  Coming back someone else asked to be there, so no problem.  Everybody has a window, and the pilot turns the plane constantly so everybody gets a good view.  Our pilot would point out many interesting features of the mountain, as well as some history and a little "Glacier 1A."  The landing on the glacier is of course the highlight.  Don't miss this!  Oh, yeah, everyone gets headphones so you can hear the chatter on the radio.  In addition to landing and take-off communications, the pilots up there talk to each other about visibility and mountain conditions.  Really interesting.  Our ten year old granddaughter was too afraid to look out of the plane, but really loved it out on the glacier where she was dancing around and laughing.

Our family of 6 including a 9 and 11 year old flew to the Ruth Glacier with our Pilot Bill.  
It was and incredible experience.  We were scheduled for early in the morning but there was heavy cloud cover.  They arranged for us to go later in the morning and  we then experienced bright sunshine as we landed on the glacier.  We felt as if we were in an IMAX movie.
We booked this trip ourselves instead of going with our  tour excursions  and we were extremely pleased.  We would highly recommend this company.

Good communication via phone.  $270 bought us a plane ride + glacier landing.  The airport was super busy on a beautiful day.  They have a deck out back where you can watch all the planes.  They gave us sunglasses and boots for the glacier.  Pilot (tom?) was excellent, and gave a great tour as he flew.  Plane ride was smooth.  The return had a few bumps, I did have mild nausea in the back, which I'm prone to.  Sitting in front was better and very cool.  

DO NOT EAT THE GLACIER SNOW.  They always land there (3 planes were on the glacier while we were there).  I'm sure some kids/people must have urinated there before.  It's always cold, so waste is not going anywhere.  Just Sayin'

Overall, decide first if you think it's worth so much money for such a short experience.  Before going, I was very ambivalent about the value.  In retrospect, there is no other way to see the mountains/Denali so closely.  

The safety issue is also important to me.  I do *think* they are very conservative, because they won't sell the longer tours with marginal weather.  The pilot had many years experience.

Talkeetna is a cool place.

I've flown with Talkeetna Air Taxi several times and their service is absolutely exceptional.  Incredibly friendly staff to work with and great pilots to fly with.  If you want to fly with the best, go with Talkeetna Air Taxi.

We had signed up for the “Grand Denali” tour with a glacier landing.  The glacier landing was free due to an early reservation that we made online.  Check in was simple – step on a scale so they can verify your weight and then head out back to grab some light boots to cover our shoes for the glacier landing.  The pilot gives a quick rundown of the plane and what to expect on the trip.  We were scheduled to fly on their newly renovated DeHavilland Otter and there were nine people, including the pilot, on our flight.

We take off and fly north towards Denali and can see forever because of the clear skies - the pilot shared plenty of information about the area via our headphones.  We follow the Tokositna and Ruth Glaciers and end up circling Denali until the pilot brings the plane down for the glacier landing.  Step off the plane surrounded by mountains in such a remote spot – totally worth it.  I would say the flight to/from the glacier landing was about 45 minutes each way and we spent about 30 minutes on the glacier (2-hours total).  I would highly recommend this tour with TAT and recommend the glacier landing, even if you have to pay the additional cost.

We just came back from 2 weeks in Alaska and had several excursions planned during that time period. Talkeetna Air Taxi was recommended to us by the owners of the Dome Home Bed & Breakfast in Healy. We took the South Face McKinley Tour This as a last minute addition to our excursion list and it was more than worth it. Our pilot, Brad, was very knowledgable and spent quite a bit of time on the glacier with us taking the perfect pictures. We would recommend this trip to anyone.

I took a flightseeing tour through TAT and it was completely amazing. I signed up for the glacier landing, but the weather prevented us from being able to land. It was still totally worth it, though - and the company was great. They didn't charge us until after the flight because it wasn't clear whether or not we'd be able to land and they were hoping for the best. The fact that we didn't get to land was only a little disappointing. The flight was so stunning that I didn't really care at all. It was absolutely beautiful. Our pilot Will was great and we saw everything up close and personal. If you have the means to do it, don't miss out. I was a little nervous, but the flight was actually very smooth, I didn't get motion sick at all, and the landing was smoother than I've ever had on a jet.

My wife and I did the Grand Denali tour and loved it.  The views around the mountain are unlike anything else.  The pilot, as well as the staff on the ground, were friendly and helpful.  
The best views are from the front seat, but all views are awesome and the back seats have fewer obstructions for better pictures.

We took a flight as part of our package tour and this company was selected for us. The flight and the equipment was the best. They use a Dehavilland Otter which appears to be like new. We landed on the Ruth glacier and the Great Gorge. One owrd describes this, UN-REAL. For sure a must do if in Talkeetna. Our pilot was awesome and the landing was very smooth.
This was one of the highlights of our trip to Alaska.  Everyone at Talkeetna air was super...Anjel, and the entire crew ---great experience.  Our pilot Bill, was super!!!

We were scheduled for a flight on Sunday but had sometime the prior Friday, called ahead to see if they had space, and they encouraged us to get there if at all possible because the weather was good.  And was is it ever.  Completely blue sky and clear views from top to bottom on Mt. McKinley.  We took the Grand Denali tour with glacier landing.  What an awesome trip.  This was our first day in Alaska and what an introduction.  Will, our pilot, was great and made every effort to make sure both sides of the plane saw everything.  The flight was very smooth.  The views were spectacular. And the glacier landing was great. It was nice to get out at the climbers base camp experience just a little of what they do.  I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi.

Just had a fabulous flight with the TAT folks. We booked with out expecting much, weather was "iffy" and we weren't scheduled to late in the day. When we showed up weather was clear enough for the flight, but still unclear if there would be a glacier landing opportunity. We ended up with a great flight, a brief glimpse of Denali, a GREAT pilot who knew the geography and the history, and friendly fellow passengers. We landed, it was awesome!  When the plane starts the landing, my instinct was to say, "no, never mind, the view has been great"!   But pilot landed anyway, just a very cool experience, climbers were there at Don Sheldons cabin....I got a real sense of the enormity of these mountains and glaciers! My husband and I thought this experience was the highlight of our trip.  Recommendation: got to be flexible, go with the flow, and hope the best for the weather. TAT wants everyone to have a great trip, but short of the having planes and an airport, they don't have a lot more in their control.  THANKS TAT!

review_title: If it's a beautiful day, don't think twice do the flight seeing!
review_text:
At first, we were suppose to do the flight seeing with another company but after we waited and they couldn't find two more people to join us to the flight they sent us to Talkeetna Air Taxi. They were very proffisonal, checked the airplane, explaine us all the safety things ext. the view was AMAZING, the pilot explain us what we see and answered every question. It's not cheap, and it is important to know u share the plane with five more people.
Also do it only if it's a beautiful day, otherwise you won't see anything..
Great company; reliable, trustworthy and will pick up in their shuttle (free) from Talkeetna Alaskan Lodge

We were scheduled to fly at 1:30 pm,the weather was not good for viewing then. They suggested we try later, and we flew at 6:30pm. The weather was still not the best but we did do a landing, that was great! Everyone bent over backwards to ensure our experience was good.

The flightseeing tour we took of Mount McKinley was absolutely amazing.  While it was cold (March 2012) the views were well worth the minor discomfort.  My wife is normally nervous when it comes to small planes but our flight was absolutely smooth.  Our pilot Richard was excellent.  The most amazing part was landing on a glacier.  It appears as if you are flying directly into the mountain before you touch down.  WOW!
I was initially concerned about the cost but I was glad we took the trip within minutes of reaching Denali.  It was definitely one of the high points of our Alaskan vacation.

II think this was the highlight of our whole Alaska trip. That is a hard statement to make as our whole trip to Alaska was unbelievable. We took the trip that landed at base camp on the glacier and it was worth every penny! We were almost socked in on the ground and I was sure that we wouldn't take off. But our pilot radioed to base camp and found out that it was clear once we got high enough. So we took off and were IFR through the clouds. When we broke out of the clouds it was awesome!

Our flight around Mt. McKinley and our glacier landing was truly an amazing, once-in-a lifetime experience.  We were blessed with beautiful weather on the morning of our flight with clear views of the mountains, glaciers and lakes, and our pilot Paul provided a truly amazing tour.  Seeing God's beautiful creation up close and in person was truly a spiritual experience.  Highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi!!!

review_title: Talkneetna Air Taxi, professionals who know their stuff
review_text:
Safety is their first priority. The flight was great, we could not fly round the back of Mt McKinley due to weather conditions but safety comes first. We did land on the glacier and the pilot was ever watchful of wether conditions and fog. 
We took off in good time and the views of the glaciers were brilliant. Spotted two black bears on the way out.

My friend was visiting from out of town and wanted to experience some of Alaska's glaciers up close and personal.  She booked up a flight on Sunday night and as luck would have it Denali showed up in full force.  The incredible views and knowledge we gained from Bill's narrative of the ride were priceless.  The entire staff from Paris, the ladies at the front desk, and Bill, were friendly, courteous, professional and a joy to be around.  I live here in Alaska and sometimes I experience a certain gruffness from certain businesses but I found none of that with TAT.  They are an awesome outfit and I will most certainly send others their way.  Thank you all for showing us how it should be done!

One of the best ways to see Alaska is from the air! Our pilot flew us across the beautiful plains straight toward Mt. Whitney and after flying us over and through the mountains we landed on a glacier. You pay a little more for this experience, but it is worth every single penny.  This is truly the Alaskan experience! Our pilot was knowledgeable, friendly and even aloud a passenger to sit in the co-pilot seat in each direction. Customer service was fantastic, flight left on time and they provided boot covers for your shoes for the glacier landing. This was simply perfection.

review_title: A professional outfit with a modern fleet of aircraft and informative pilot/guides.
review_text: We were blessed with amazing weather during our stay in Talkeetna so decided to book a flightsee last minute.  Our host at our lodging gave us a few to choose from and we settled on TAT.  We called them up and they told us that if we got to the airport within 15 minutes we could get on the next flight on the best flying day they'd had in weeks.  Of course we high-tailed it down there and joined our pilot Tyler with a group of boy scouts & their leaders for our trip to the "Top of the USA"  This is the most photos we took anywhere in Alaska and the experience is indescribable until you have done it as nothing can describe the size, scope, power and scale of Denali up close.  All I can say is that if you get the opportunity to do this on a clear day - JUST DO IT and the cost will be irrelevant by the time you land.  Truly amazing experience and THE highlight of our Alaska trip.  Thank you to all previous posters on TA who gave the same advice I am giving here - I listened and we have now joined the group of people who have experienced this.  Also to TAT for flying us safely and landing us on the Ruth Glacier.

review_title: WOW! The trip of a life time
review_text: Three of us arrived at Talkeetna Air Taxi around ten in the morning we had not set up a prearranged fight. The staff was very helpful and got us a flight in about 45 minutes. It was clear blue sky day we were really blessed, the views of Denali and the other nearby peaks breathe taking. The grandeur of Denali cannot be put into word it has to be seen. Our Pilot was great gave us lots of time on the glacier for questions and pictures, he was very professional. This was a once in a life time experience life does not get much better. I highly recommend that you give Talkeetna Air Taxi the chance to make it your once in a life time experience.

I was able to fly with Talkeetna Air Taxi on a sunny day and had excellent views of Denali and the other nearby high peaks.  Pilot Tyler Westhoff was excellent.  He pointed out various details and made observations and comments about what we were seeing out the windows without being overly talkative or pedantic.  Our landing on the glacier was as smooth as glass.  We were able to stay there for 30 or so minutes to take pictures, and Tyler regaled us with stories of previous landings and was very knowledgable about the glaciers and the general environment.  What a fantastic trip.

review_title: Excellent experience with Talkeetna Air Taxi!
review_text: We highly recommend this company & the aventure! Landing on the glacier was a once in a lifetime experience & the knowledge from the pilot of the area was wonderful. Very professional!
These guys have great prices compared to Denali. They are very nice about bad weather, we were rescheduled once for our glacier landing, everything was nice.

Even though the day started out with far less than perfect weather, we were finally off on our flight at 3:30 pm.  Tyler was our pilot and was exceptional!! He shared lots of information and did an exceptional job overall! The plane was outstanding and was in great condition! Tyler got us some GREAT views of McKinley and other peaks and then the glacier landing was the highlight of a fantastic flight! Who has done that? We live in Fairbanks, Alaska and don't know anyone that has! All of the employees at TAT are very friendly and really want you to have a great time! We have decided that we will go back next summer for the Summit flight. If you come here to Alaska, you have to visit Talkeetna Air Taxi and take a flight with a glacier landing!!!

Mt. McKinley and glacier landing--was one of the highlights of our trip and gave us a great Alaska experience.  Our pilot, Tim, was very professional and we felt very confident in his skills.  He was very knowledgeable and provided great information on what we were seeing out the window along with facts about the geography. My wife doesn't like small planes and she felt so comfortable and at ease.  I haven't seen her smile like that in years.  Again, kudos to Tim, and TAT, I have already recommended you to 4 friends that are going to be visiting AK in the future and I will post a positive review on tripadvisor.  WOW!!First class operation--Best money spent in a long time!!

review_title: It is worth every dollar! The best way to see Mount McKinley and the surrounding area.
review_text: This trip made tears come out as the plane lifted and I was taken to paradise. At times you get the feeling you are in another planet as the white becomes the predominant color covering all the mountains. The pilot [a 29 year old man] told us in advance if we might get any slight turbulence. DONT WORRY....if they think is bad they change the route. If you have one excursion to pick...pick this one above the rest. Get the one with the glacier landing!!!!

A last-minute turn for good weather prompted us to take the flight and go for gold (spend the extra $$ for glacier landing). It was fantastic from start to finish, with our pilot Richard making everyone feel comfortable and safe at all times. His interesting repartee about the surrounding area, the glaciers, the mountains made the flight educational as well as exciting. Landing on the glacier— an unforgettable experience no visitor should miss—  we were treated to the proposal, on bended knee, of a young man to his lovely lady. (She said yes :) Our photos will be lifelong mementos of a fabulous few hours over Alaska.

Excellent service and a wonderful experience. We flew on an older aircraft but it appeared to be meticulously maintained. Our pilot was clearly very familiar with the mountain and delivered terrific views and executed a very smooth glacier landing. The glacier landing is an option which can be added to most flights and we highly recommend it.

We landed on a glacier!!! What a great experience, smooth flight, perfect day, unbelievable. Our pilot was awesome, very informative throughout the flight. He made sure to turn the plane so both sides got great views and pictures of Denali and the glaciers. We got some fantastic pictures and were able to make a “Glacier angel” in the snow. One of the highlights of our Alaska trip. 

Highly Recommended!!

The experience itself is hard to put in to words, save for the fact that this was probably the highlight of our time in Alaska.  To see the mountains, glaciers, lakes and forests from above is truly extraordinary.  Yes, it is expensive, but it's like nothing else, and the only way of getting so close to the peaks other than climbing them.  If you can afford it then definitely add it to your Alaska itinerary.

When I saw TAT's website I was hooked.  Would I be able to convince the other 5 people in my party, two of whom live in Anchorage?  I gave my best shot, "We  traveled many hours to get to Alaska, this was an expensive adventure, but we were actually flying round North America's magestic Mt. McKinley, but you only live once."  They all agreed without a hard sell.  Not what I expected.  

We spent 9 days in Alaska and this is everyone's highlight.  Would we do it again?  In a heartbeat. We even have our Anchorage relative's neighbors now planning to take the trip.  Our pilot was Tyler and not only did he make us feel comfortable and safe, he turned out to be a fabulous photographer of group shots on the glacier. You've got one life, you've traveled all the way up to Alaska, add this to your itinerary!

Great experience - it won't be forgotten.  Excellent organization and service; they did their very best.  Expensive.

I booked several months in advance so I could get an early-morning flight in late June, 2012.  There was a certain deposit with that - perhaps $150.  When we showed up the morning of the flight, the HQ crew did a good job keep expectations where they belonged, because clouds / fog can come in over Denali at any time.  Due to TAT's size, they had an early plane already on the way up to the mountain - probably with hiker supplies - and they were able to get a firsthand weather report from that plane.  My daughter had dressed for weather in Talkeetna and one of the front desk ladies loaned her a coverup / light jacket because the glacier landing isn't exactly warm.  After the weather report, we met our pilot (who was young, handsome, and turned my wife into a babbling mess because of it - but no worries), then boarded the plane, and took off.  There were just three of us as passengers, plus the pilot - it was really a private flight.  We quickly arrived at the mountains and it's remarkable how close you can fly to them on a calm day - being right next to the snowy cliffs in the clear air was amazing.  If you have questions about something the pilot was able to tip the plane to get a better look, or circle around to a better example . . . you can also hear other planes over the headphone, and spot them flying around.  We did the glacier landing and it was smooth - not scary at all.  Getting out at base camp and having the high walls of the mountain above you is just fantastic, and my daughter and I enjoyed running around on the snow.  Flying back was a breeze; the whole thing was great and a touch otherworldly.  Highly recommended if you can afford it - it's not cheap.  Save up.

Despite a weather cancellation on day 1 and a plane stuck on the glacier on day 2 the folks at TAT went out of their way to get us up in the air for our flight see and glacier landing.  Our flight to the Alaskan Range was unbelievable and the highlight of our trip to Alaska!  My family was blown away by our pilot Tim. He went out of his way to ensure everyone on the trip had a once in a lifetime experience.  My son Jack counts Tim among the coolest people on earth and among his best friends despite their relatively short time together.  The snowball fight was epic!  I can't thank Tim and the entire TAT team enough for the work they do.  They are truly awesome!!

We took the Grand Denali flight with glacier landing.  The entire staff in the office was friendly and helpful.  I was nervous, having never flown in such a small plane.  A nice lady behind the desk reassured me and eased my fears.  We flew in a 5 seater plane, and Tim was our pilot.  Like the people in the office, Tim was professional, informative, and friendly.  He helped us into our seats, made sure we were buckled properly, and had our headsets working.  I couldn't believe the flight was so smooth!  Tim was an excellent pilot and tour guide - he answered all of our questions, and maneuvered the plane so that everyone could see everything out of their own window.  The views were stunning!  We had a sunny day, with a few clouds near Denali, but could clearly see the mountain and surrounding areas.  I took well over 100 pictures.  We landed on Ruth Glacier.  If you are able to add a glacier landing to your flight, do it!  Walking on a glacier and seeing the mountains towering over us was just incredible!  Bring sunglasses though, since there is glare from the snow.  Flying with TAT was the highlight of my Alaska vacation, and if I ever make it back, I will definitely fly with them again.

My friend & I just spent 10 glorious days in Alaska. Although everything we did was wonderful, the flight into the mountains surrounding Denali was by far the best of the trip! We landed on a glacier & got out of the plane. We were surrounded by magnificent peaks & the beauty is beyond description. Our pilot, Tim handled the plane & his passengers with professionalism. I felt the flight is a once in a lifetime experience that I will never forget!

This is the second time my husband and I have flown with Talkeetna Air Taxi and there are no words to describe how wonderful the experience is!! Their safety record is excellent, their pilots are great, and the entire operation is professional and customer service oriented!  Seeing Denali and the Alaska Range with a Talkeetna Air Taxi flight and glacier landing is an amazing experience!  We have lived in Alaska for 25 years, and although we have had many amazing experiences, our flights with TAT are right at the top of the "do-it-again" list!

review_title: All I can say is WOW!
review_text:
Heidi, the young lady who booked our reservation was incredibly helpful and informative. She was honest and forthcoming. When we arrived, the location was close to the town center of Talkeetna. A great little place to visit. Ate at Mexican Moose and Payos's Thai. Both are thumbs up. Anyway, waited in a comfortable area with their cat, Beaver they gave us glacier boots so our shoes would stay dry and about 10 minutes after checking our pilot, Tyler, called us up and we were ready! He gave us a briefing and off we went!  The views were spectacular. Close up views of Denali, Hunter and Moose's tooth. Landed on a glacier which was surreal. We were able to see Ruth glacier. It was awesome! The weather was perfect, blue skies, 75 degrees and bright! Didn't need a jacket but take sunglasses! The plane was comfortable and roomy. 

Would do it again. Loved Tyler! Best pilot ever!

We could not have asked for a better day, weather wise. We flew on the de havilland otter - an aircraft that had been recently retrofitted and remodeled. Everyone gets a great view out their own large window. Our pilot Tyler was knowledgeable about the area and was not only an excellent pilot but an excellent tour guide. He exceeded our expectations making sure everyone had a great time. We highly recommend using talkeetna air taxi and Tyler for your mt. McKinley glacier landing tour. All the staff went out of their way- even providing pick up and drop off!

My girlfriend and I pulled into Talkeetna around 2:30 pm, on a Tuesday in early July.  We had a reservation to take a flight tour around Mt. McKinley/Denali for 5:30.  Talkeetna Air Taxi(TAT) told us to come in when we got to town to check in with them.  When we got there, they told us the mountain had been clear all day so far, despite contrary weather reports(which are useless here anyways).  We asked about going out the next day, due to more promising forecasts.  But, they suggested going out right then.  So, within 15 minutes we were on our way up in a plane.  The plan was that we were to do the Base Camp Tour(yellow line).  From the time we got up in the air, it was pretty clear that Mt. McKinley was in complete cloud cover.  Once we were up in the mountains, we could see VERY little.  Some decent views of glaciers, which were pretty spectacular, but no mountain peaks.  At all.  We did land on the glacier at base camp for about 5 minutes.  Same visibility story on the way down, except that we didn't finish our route, we just came back the way we had already come.  All in all a disappointing experience.  I don't blame TAT for that.  The weather is quite unpredictable, there is no denying that.   

HOWEVER.. The next morning, I called them as soon as they opened and talked to Annie, the office manager. After expressing my disappointment from the previous days experience, she offered to let us take another flight that morning for a significant discount if we could be there in ten minutes.  With clear blue skies(a rarity) above, I said yes and abruptly shook my girlfriend awake so we could get from the Talkeetna Hostel, just a few blocks away to the office.  We got there and checked in and again, within just a few minutes we were working our way into a much smaller craft.  What we had awaiting us was a COMPLETELY different experience.  We immediately had clear views of Denali in the distance and a beautiful day in general.  The tour that Annie put us on, must have been the best tour they offered, because we were given an informed and intimate introduction to not only the summit of Denali, but many other peaks around.  The other passengers were a father and son, the elder of which, summited Denali and several other major peaks throughout the Alaska Range.  As such, our pilot Tyler took us pretty much everywhere that you could get to.  He was a knowledgeable, excellent and thoughtful pilot and tour guide.  We could not have imagined such a fantastic experience, but it was a highlight of our two week visit.

Thanks to Annie, Tyler and everyone else at TAT.  Great company that clearly cares about their customers, their business and their reputation.  I appreciate that sort of integrity and commitment, and would have no problems telling anyone to choose them for their flight tours.

We were a party of 4 (2 adults, 2 kids, 8 & 9) and we booked the South face Tour with Glacier Landing. However, the 1st day when we were supposed to go up was a rainy day and TAT rescheduled our flight on a later date, the day we would be driving back from Denali to Anchorage. The weather was not the best even on the second time, however, it was not raining and we decided to go ahead with the flight. At first, my wife was a little apprehensive of flying in a small plane (an 8-seater DeHavilland Beaver). There was 10-20 miles/hr wind and I was a little concerned too. However, the flight was very smooth. As the plane started to climb higher, the landscape beneath started to change from forest to rivers with sandbars to glacier. Soon the excitement took over any fear we had at the beginning. Finally the landing on Kahiltna glacier was the climax of the entire flight. We went crazy taking pictures. We were on the glacier for almost half hour but it seemed very short. Even though everyone has a window seat, the best viewpoint, I think, is from the 2nd row passenger seating where my wife was seated. This flightseeing tour was certainly at the top of all other highlights of our great Alaskan trip. I would do it again in a heartbeat.

I booked this excursion on line after learning about TAT in a travel section article in the Washington Post.  The admin staff got us registered on line and when we arrived at the airstrip we were prepped for the flight in a short amount of time.  The aircraft was a 10- 12 passenger DeHavilland Turboprop that had plenty of juice to handle the type of flying for this trip.  Our pilot and guide seemed rather young, but after just several minutes in the air it was obvious he was extremely capable of handling the aircraft and he provided excellent narration about the terrain we were flying over.  Although there were a lot of clouds in the area our pilot threaded his way through them and within 30 minutes had us circling the two summits of Mt McKinley.  Then he circled around several glaciers and landed in the Ruth Glacier in a magical area known as the "Amphitheater".  It was almost a religious experience to walk on a snow -packed glacier surrounded by 10K peaks all around us.
