We spent 20-25 minutes in this "Cathedral in the Alaska Range" before heading back to Talkeetna.  Oh yes, I got to sit in the co-pilot seat on the return flight to get a real bird's eye view of the amazing Alaskan lanscape.  I can not say enough good things about our experience with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Yes, it seems expensive at first glance but I can tell you it was worth every penny.  I would do it again in a heartbeat.

review_title: Put it on your bucket list!
review_text: My husband and two of our traveling companions recently experienced landing on a glacier with TAT.  I am the more timid flier of our group so I started out with a lump in my throat and a knot in my stomach.  We were loaded into the Otter and our pilot Bill? sounded so encouraging and confident I couldn't help but start to calm down.  The day began overcast but warm.  Our pilot flew us in to the only open patch of blue sky and low and behold we got our first glimpse of the mountain known as Denali.  We landed on the ice and were surprised by the warm temperature.  We had our layers which we removed and were down to our Hawaiian shirt layer in no time!  I made a snow angel on a glacier what fun!  We would highly recommend this trip to anyone.  The flight was smoother than most commercial flights I have experienced!

You want to see Mt. McKinley?  Do it properly, OK it's a but expensive but the experience is once in a lifetime.  You really do fly close to the mountains with knowledgeable commentary from a highly skilled, extremely competent pilot.  

The weather conditions were too rough to do the flight (around McKinley( we originally booked and as a result the pilot flew a different route giving us amazing views of mountain in less turbulent air.  This showed  good consideration as my mum gets airsick easier than most and a choice of a sensible turbulent free route made sure her breakfast stayed inside her!  In addition to this skillful flying we were given a partial refund without prompting as the revised flight used less fuel than the original request. 

As a wheelchair user they were very helpful and let me direct the assistance,  There is a real "can do " attitude with the office and ground crew staff.

I am an active wheelchair user and a high level transfer is required to get into the back of the aircraft so was able to sit in the front seat.  However, weaker wheelchair users may struggle to get in the aircraft.

I had an incredible trip with Talkeetna Air Taxi and when I make it back up to that area, I would be more than happy to use them again even for the same trip, it was that amazing! The office staff was extremely friendly and helpful, and the pilot had an answer to any question you could think of about that area during your flight.  The flight was smooth, and they had everything dialed and you don't have to worry about a thing besides packing the right clothes.  However, they do provide glacier boots that fit over your shoes to ensure your feet stay warm.  If you are in the area, make sure to stop by and take the flight, well worth the experience!

The trip is not inexpensive but it was worth it. It was the highlight of our month in Alaska and I would do it again if we return. We were within sight of Mt McKinley for at least six days on the trip but never saw it from the ground due to typical weather conditions in that area. The flight was the only time we saw it. We landed on the glacier, an incredibly beautiful location, and I will say that it certainly was worth doing. It was one of those experiences that I will long remember. My wife was considering not doing the trip due to her concern about riding in small planes but she loved it.  We were impressed with the pilots and the support people on the ground and felt comfortable with the entire trip. In fact we went out on a relatively large 6 passenger plane and came back from the glacier on a smaller 3 passenger plane (due to conditions on the glacier). My wife was comfortable even in the smaller plane.

Coming from the UK we dont get many chances to see, never mind land on a glacier so this was an opportunity that we couldnt pass up. great drive up from anchorage made the anticipation even better. We were lucky that the weather was so good so that the summit was visible but even without this the overall the views and scenery and the experience is one we wont ever forget. Great firm to go with so heartily recommended.
Expensive, but worth it. The perspective is unbelievable. Nice folks , competent pilot. ( I am an airline pilot -before you say anything )
I have travelled the world but after landing on the glacier I was simply speechless  ! Put it together with total professionalism of TAT and you will have an experience of the lifetime !
OMG!   THE best experience!   Bill was awesome as our pilot and incredibly knowledgable about the sights.   Definitely worth the trip and the money!!!
if you're a climber, don't bother looking anywhere else. they are worth the extra couple of bucks. if you're a tourist, they are the most skilled pilot's in the state.

Our scheduled flight was delayed due to weather. The staff gave us the option to go later in the day or wait until the AM. We went up the following morning. Well worth the wait. The sky was perfectly clear. Our pilot Tom was very knowledgable about the mountains and the glaciers in addition to Alaskan history. We landed on Ruth Glacier in 8 inches of fresh snow! The smoothest landing I've ever experienced!!! What an incredible view! Overall an amazing experience.

After a tough start to the day ( due to the weather), the skies cleared up and we were able to fly. Took the Grand Denali flight and got up close and personal with the mountains. Close fly bys to many different mountains. Landed at "base camp" to pick up a climber. Great scenery and views of glaciers also. Very serene and peaceful, it really shows you the vastness, size and scope of the surrounds. 

Much better than the Stella and concrete mountains we have here in Chicago

Highly recommendated.

I have travelled to many parts of the world but this 2 hour flight with TAT is THEE BEST experience I can ever recall. They are seasoned professionals that will greatly exceed your expectations. Make sure you have a clear day when you visit "the great one,"  McKinley! There are no words that describe the experience of walking on the glaciers our pilot landed on or seeing/touching the awesome peaks of this range of mountains. The photo opportunity is unbelievable. 

It cannot be improved on!!!!!!!!!!!

Worth every penny. Alaska is fortunate to have these wonderful folks with such a great mission - to share the beauty of Mt McKinley!!

review_title: Everyone is not exaggerating... You've GOT to do this!
review_text: If you go to Alaska and don't do the flightseeing tour, you are truly missing out on one of the highlights of your trip.  It was one of the highlights of my life!  I was leery of going in a small plane flying through the mountains and landing on a glacier, and told my husband I'd stay back while he went alone.  I didn't want him to miss out on something he really wanted to do, so I went reluctantly.  The staff were very friendly and knowledgeable, and if the weather is bad, they will postpone your trip until it's clear enough to go.  You can trust them if they tell you the weather is clear above the clouds, they know their stuff and have a great safety record.  They are the ones who take the mountain climbers up to climb Mt. McKinley to the base camp.  First, they give you glacier boots so your feet aren't cold, and will have good traction walking on the glacier when you land.  The views are mind blowing, and there are really no words to describe them, other than you will feel like you are watching an IMAX movie.  Your pictures from the plane will be amazing, and the ride is as smooth as can be.  It's great to see the Talkeetna area from the plane, flying over the vast green Alaskan wilderness.  Once you get to the mountains,  it's will take your breath away, and seeing such beauty brought tears to my eyes.  Our pilot was friendly and professional, and did a super job flying the plane.  He told us he had been flying with them for over five years.  All I can say is it's worth every penny, and I'd do it again in a heartbeat. I wish I could  share all of my pictures because every one is a masterpiece!  Don't hesitate, it's the best!!!

review_title: Must do in Alaska! Friendly staffs!
review_text:
This is a great tour and must do when you go to Alaska. The staffs are great and very helpful.
I showed up very early for my flight and requested if any earlier flight available. A sweet staff not only booked me on a earlier flight but also upgraded to a better one with no charge as there was space available. She could have asked me to wait or asked to pay the difference but she gladly upgraded with a friendly smile.
Like most of Alaska, this tour is totally weather dependent. Rainy & cloudy weather are very common in Alaska so be prepared. I visited during the first week of July. Its been pretty much cloudy all day when I was there and not lucky enough to see Mt.Denali from the ground. But I was fortunate enough to view all the peaks including Denali above the clouds from the flight. Our pilot is very friendly, knowledgeable and did a great job flying through the peaks. The views are incredible, breathtaking and possibly the best thing happened in my whole week-long Alaska trip. The cost is pretty much comparable to any flight tours in lower 48 so do not miss this because it's expensive, you may regret not doing this later because this could be an once in a lifetime experience.

We did the Grand Denali Tour with Glacier Landing. We had a picture perfect morning. Our pilot, Will, excecuted perfect take-offs and landings and the flight was so smooth I hardly felt I was in an airplane until I looked out the windows and saw the incredible mountains, glaciers, cliffs and snow-covered valleys and passes. I was a bit anxious because I can get dizzy at higher altitudes and get motion sickness, but this flight was so smooth I was completely comfortable. I am not talented enough to describe the views and exhilaration of this experience. It is an amazing experience that I cannot recommend highly enough. I want to thank Will (and Anjel, who greeted us upon our departure and also served us the night before at the Wildflower, lol) and all the people at TAT for this amazing experience.

The folks at Talkeetna Air Taxi exceeded our expectations.  This is a professionally run operation that really knows Denali.  We landed on base camp and were able to talk with mountain climbers who had been there for five weeks. This is by far the most thrilling way to experience the big mountain.  Do it!
This is a must do for anyone going to Denali.  You see Mt. McKinley from so close, and see so many glaciers.  The views are breathtaking.  The glacier landing is definitely worth it!
The flight and glacier landing are not cheap, but it's an experience you will not forget. Amazing views of Denali. Do not pass up an opportunity to take this flight.

On June 20, 2012, we had the amazing experience of flying to the peak of Mt. McKinley.  It felt like we were suspended in mid-air and created the impression of being able to reach out and touch the mountains.  It was a wonderful, memorable experience; a tru highlight of our trip to Alaska.

A must do when visiting Alaska.  We took the Grand Denali tour, and it was the most amazing experience to fly over Mt McKinley and land on a glacier.  The staff treated you like family, and couldn’t do enough for you.  It is pricy, but the experience was breathtaking and something my wife and I will never forget.  We had perfect weather, which is had sometimes hard to get in Alaska around Mt McKinley.  It is best if you can be flexible with your date to give you the best chance to get a good day to see the mountain.  When I booked the trip I planned on doing it on my way back to Anchorage from Denali National Park.  The woman at Talkeetna Air Taxi suggested that it the weather looked good to call on my way up and they would fit me it.  It turned out the weather was bad, and she suggested I stick to my original date.  It could not have been better, the weather was perfect.

We had gone to Denali National Park the day before and got a glimpse of this spectacular mountain. But we had also booked a flight seeing tour with TAT to get a closer look. This was my first small plane experience, and I was a little nervous about getting into a 5-seater Cessna. But our pilot, Will, made me feel very comfortable, answering all our safety questions, letting us know whenever we were going to feel a bump mid-flight, and checking in to make sure we were ok. The ride was very smooth and incredibly peaceful.

I agree with all the rest, the glacier landing is a must do! The entire 1.5 hour experience - getting a glimpse of peaks and mountains not many people get to see, landing on glacier 11,000 feet high, and being surrounded by wondrous beauty - truly changed me. If you want to be inspired, in awe, and have an experience you'll remember forever, book this trip!

We have done this flight before 13 years ago and decide to do this incredible adventure again. Our pilot, Brad Adams, was outstanding-smooth flight and landings. Safety briefing and knowledge of the area was great. We did a glacier landing which I would recommend for this once or twice in a lifetime adventure. Landing on Ruth Glacier and looking over the Don Sheldon Amphitheater was amazing! We did wait for a clear day and we were lucky. Denali only peaked out briefly but enough to appreciate the enormity of the mountain and the amazing mountain range and glaciers. Highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi. ~ Mary N. Chicago-area

Let me start by saying I hate to fly and reluctantly did this because I was on a girlfriends trip to Alaska. Looking back on our trip this was a highlight and I'm so thankful that I didn't wimp out. The views are amazing. The flight was smooth-better than many of the commercial flights I have been on. The pilot Papa Romeo was wonderful providing lots of information about Alaska, the mountains, etc. The eight of us agree that this was a bucket list item that really surpassed our expectations.

After first scheduled flight was cancelled due to weather, we changed itinerary to swing back through Talkeetna after visiting the National Park and it was well worth it. Small plane with just our family of 4 went with our pilot Will all around Mount McKinley including landing at base camp. Awesome views, just enough commentary to inform without annoying, and super nice service. Expensive sure, but one not to miss.

review_title: OMG!  Wow!  Mt Denali South Face Flght with glacial landing.
review_text: This trip was simply amazing. The flight was beautiful and the views of the mountain and the glacier were incredible. It was hard to believe we were really standing on a glacier playing around and seeing what was in front of us. Our pilot, Tyler, was a great guide, an excellent photographer and a graceful pilot. Simply awesome!

We were very lucky to have pretty good weather, but the company does not go up if you won't have a great experience. It is best to book when you get to Talkeetna in order to have a little leeway for the weather. The staff will work with you. It is expensive, but wotprth it. There is a coupon in the Northern Lights coupon book for 25% off for 4 people.

review_title: Trip was pretty good considering the weather
review_text:
We were there three weeks ago, and unfortunately the skies weren't clear.  Most  people we were with rescheduled for the next day, but we didn't have that option since we were leaving the next morning.  So after waiting a couple of hours we got the go-ahead.  In hindsight, we wish we hadn't gone that day since we didn't get to see much of the mountains and couldn't do a glacier landing.   Brad was OK.  I guess we were expecting more commentary during the flight.  
So…. if the weather is really clear, go for it.  If it's not, pass on the trip and save your money.

June 22nd:  Eight of us [two families] took the Grand Denali flight tour with a glacier landing. Our pilot was Tyler and we had a spectacular trip. The weather that day couldn't have been better and the trip around Denali was breath taking...cliche yes...but true.

The flight alone was great...but if you take this trip you MUST do the glacier landing; there is nothing like it.

June 21 8:30am Grand Denali flight was amazing, awesome, beautiful.....! Brad was our pilot and did an outstanding job. It was a beautiful clear day so the summit was in full view. Amazing seeing the base camp and trails of the climbers. Glacier landing was pretty cool. Flight was very smooth. Highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi. It was the highlight of our entire trip.

This is an experience you can not pass up! It's sooooo worth the fee.  We arrived at TAT about 8am on June 21st. A beautiful sunny day,couldn't have been better.  We were greeted by a warm and friendly staff, that got our boots and prepared us for take-off.  After going over safety rules and explaining all areas of our plane we were ready for an incredible flight.  We had a smooth take-off and  it felt like we were in a glider amongest the mountains.  We saw climbers and basecamps for the climbers...We were so close to the mountains it felt as though we could have reached out and touched them.. We landed smoothly on a glacier area, got out and walked around.  Brad was our wonderful pilot, he was very informative and made sure everyone got their picture made, and all the pictures we wanted before takeoff.   This was so incredible ..you can't miss this!  TAT was the best!!

review_title: A very safe and enjoyable tour
review_text: We took the TAT 1.5 hours flight tour with glacier landing on June 21st 2012. This was the best part of our vacation! We had 2 kids aged 9 & 6. We were worried that our younger one may feel dizzy and sick if the ride was too bumpy. Our pilot, Brad, was extremely experienced and flew the aircraft very smoothly. The weather was sunny when we started off but did saw rains and thunderstorm on the way. Luckily the weather cleared up as we approached Mt Mckinley. The glacier landing  was smooth too and we were rewarded with an awesome view of the mountains and the blue glacier ice. We will highly recommend TAT for such a wonderful trip. Also they offered me coffee before the trip and went through all the hassles of making me a cup of coffee even though the coffee machine broke down. Now that is what I call friendly service! Highly recommended.

review_title: A very safety oriented tour operator.
review_text: When I started researching Denali tour operators last fall I narrowed it down to two.  Talkeetna Air was my first choice, having lived in Alaska, both my choices have been operating in the state for many years.  Over the winter I spoke to many locals who confirmed my initial thoughts.  Our pilot was very patient with the preflight briefing making sure all our questions were satisfactorily answered before we boarded.  The trip over to the mountian range we had a very smooth flight.  The pilot's commentary across and working up the glacier was well balanced with geology, history and a little bit of lore.  We had a good landing at upper base camp.  Spent our fifteen minutes on the glacier.  He had to go to plan B and was very good about explaining what we would need to do and what he was going to need to do to get us back to the hanger.  Do not believe anyone in the group had any cause to question the pilot's decission and concern for our safty and that of the equipment.

My son and I flew the 1.5 hour south side tour with the glacier landing.  The best part of our vacation.  The aircraft are well maintained and our pilot, Will, was very profesional.  Highly recommend the glacier landing.  The weather in Talkeetna was cloudy most of our stay.  The glacier landing, being at 7200 feet, provided the best views of the mountains and the sun.
Highly recommended and definitely the worth price.

review_title: Bubble windows on TAT are great for viewing/photography.
review_text: My wife and I did Grand Denali tour with TAT and it was wonderful.  This was our 2nd tour with TAT.  We did the same tour last year, but the weather was not as good.  Our flight was cancelled due to weather, and we hung around Talkeetna during the day and did eventually get to go out.  It was great, but not as great as this recent trip (because of the better weather).  For this visit, I did not book anything in advance.  I figured I would just wait, and if the weather was good, I would try to book something last minute, and if not, we would just enjoy food and drink in Talkeetna. Our first morning in Talkeenta was very clear with Mckinley in full view, so I called TAT was able to get 2 seats on an 8:30 am departure (if you have a larger party, it might be tough to do this, but for only 2 passengers, I had no trouble). The TAT planes are great for photos (at least the one we were on, and other TAT planes looked similar).  TAT planes have the windows bubbled outward a few inches so you can get a good view in multiple directions.  Also, the wings were above the fuselage so the wings did not obstruct viewing much.  In contrast, I also did a summit tour with Talkeetna Aero and the plane was not great for flight seeing since the wings were below the fuselage plus the engine cowling block a lot of the view.  In addition the Talkeetna Aero windows were flat and not as clear/new (adequate, but inferior to TAT's plane)  On Talkeetna Aero,  the pilot had to bank the wing down our your side to get photos (which they did).  But on TAT, I could get great photos anytime (which I did - too many).  If you have never done a Mckinley flight seeing tour before, you will probably enjoy any off them.  But for best experience I would recommend TAT.

review_title: Views to remember for a lifetime.
review_text: Had a great experience with TAT. Took the Grand Denali Tour and it was terrific.  Glacier landing on Ruth Glacier was incredible.  Brad was a great pilot and guide.  Definitely a highlight of our trip.

review_title: A MUST if you like mountains
review_text: We had a outstanding time with TAT.  We called ahead making a reservation.  They met and picked us up from the Princess bus drop off.  The staff was courteous and walked us through registration.  Our pilot Brad was outstanding.  The glacier landing was amazing and a must if you are just considering the fly over.  We had a perfect day for flying.  Suggest booking morning flight in case weather cancels and you can reschedule in afternoon.  Highly recommended adventure in a way to see Denali  mountain range in a completely unique way.

review_title: TAT is the way to do glassier landing
review_text: What an amazing experience we had during the flight. It was 4 of us, 2 couples. We had so much fun. The flight was perfect, the pilot was fun and outgoing, and the view was absolutely stunning. I got to ride in the 2nd pilot seat and even “helped” during the landing and takeoff  I would definitely recommend this tour and the company. It’s once in the lifetime experience.

One of the best views of Denali, Hunter, and Foraker! We bought the Groupon and took our parents (they are visiting from the lower 48) with us. We have seen the Alaska range from different angles and this is one of the best! Richard was our pilot and he definitely knew what he was doing. We'll do it again in a heartbeat.

June 19, 2012.  Flight over Denali and Alaska Range.  We took our first flightseeing flight ever over the mountains of Denali National Park, and it was spectacular.  We flew in a 6-passenger Beaver aircraft, which made my wife a bit apprehensive.  But the flight was a real mind-changer: no turbulence, blue skies and fluffy white clouds, awesome views of the mountains and glaciers from close range, interesting and informative naration by the pilot, smooth take-off and landing. Polished, professional, and very pleasant.  This experience is not-to-be-missed.  DO NOT cheat yourself out of this one.

First of all, in prearranging this trip I was so happy with the friendliness of the staff. The day of our scheduled tour, May 30, 2012,  the weather turned a bit cloudy as it got close to our flight time and the visibility was a concern.  We tried to communicate early with the staff about our concerns of possibly not being able to do our glacier landing or seeing Mt. McKinley because of clouds.  They understood completely and were willing to do whatever was in their realm of control to try to make our experience a good one.  They don't sugar coat things only to have you disappointed.  We got the report from them as to what they expected our flight to be like and they allowed us to make whatever decision we were comfortable with.  We talked with them and they arranged for a later flight time with the idea of reevaluating at that time.  They told us that the weather can dramatically change either way in a short time.  We left but returned shortly thinking we better just cancel because we didn't want to risk not getting out of the experience the things that were important to us.  They pleasantly refunded our money without hesitation. We hung around town just a bit and noticed the weather seemed different so we went back to the office and inquired what they thought and yes, it was just like they said..dramatic change.  So up we went and it was AMAZING!!!!  Visibility was great and we did the glacier landing which is a MUST if you go!!!  What a spectacular view that allows you to experience the immensity of the mountains all around you.  It's a trip that you just have to experience to appreciate it and you will be so glad you did it.  They equip you with boots that fit over your shoes for the glacier landing so don't worry about that.  Just wear a good coat, hat, gloves and sunglasses for optimum comfort.  Take your camer and make a short video if you can so you can relive the moment and share with others.  Our pilot was very nice and shared information as we flew and took questions.  I get motion sickness easily so I took Bonine and also had a patch behind my ear but I will say that I felt the flight was smooth except when you get close to landing and there is some bumping around.  I wasn't sick and never afraid but if you have motion sickness just prepare yourself as I did and you won't have an issue.  This is a super nice company with a great customer satisfaction and I reallly like how they operate.  I highly recommend them.  My only sad point is that we didn't have an extra day in Talkeetna just to hang around and enjoy the cool feeling in that town.  By the way, my husband and I had the privilege of making this trip with our 3 grown children and what a joy to experience this beauty as a family experience we will never forget!!! Thank you Talkeetna Air Taxi!!!

We were ambivalent about booking this flight, having taken small plane tours on other holidays in the past, but the reviews convinced us to commit.  Wow, wow, wow!!! It was so beyond our expectations.  Our pilot, Bill, gave us so many photo opportunities and was so interesting to listen to. We were blessed with a hot, sunny day, so our experience was really amazing, and much of it surprising, gifting us with new knowledge and an appreciation of how the glaciers and the landscape is changing in Alaska. Our glacier landing helped us to have a better perspective of the vastness of the area we were flying over and Bill took excellent photos of everyone in our group.
On our return flight, an unexpected thunderstorm blew in quickly and all of us were very impressed with the professionalism of the Talkeetna Air staff and our staff in getting us back down on the ground safely.  We will be talking about this trip for years to come.  If you are in Talkeetna, don't miss it!

The staff is really helpful, they really go the extra mile even if not asked. My experience has been great also thanks to them, I strongly recommend them. They also offer the bunk house, it is helpful if you are tired and cannot find any location!

Just had the most amazing flight of my life!!  If a glacier landing and the Grand Denali tour are in your budget - DON'T MISS IT!  We spent 3 days at Denali National Park and had a couple of views of the big mountain - but NOTHING compares to flying around the high peaks of the Alaska Range.  This flight circles Denali and gives amazing views of glaciers, multiple peaks, climber's base camp, and the Wickersham wall.  My father is disabled and has a bit of trouble walking.   The pilot, Jonathan, couldn't have been more helpful!  With some assistance - he had no problem getting out of the plane and onto the glacier.  A huge thank you to Talkeetna Air Taxi - this was an experience we will never forget.

review_title: Flight and Glacier Landing in Denali
review_text:
I have been on a lot of trips and have experienced a lot of cool things
Thanks to our Pilot Tim for making it a trip of a lifetime.
This is by far one of the coolest things I’ve ever done and I would do it again in a heartbeat.

We were in Alaska for 8 days and had 7 days of bad weather. It didn't stop us from doing everything we wanted to do. We made 2 attempts to make our flyover with the weather stopping us ,so we made our way to another destination. Two days later we drove back to Talkeetna to try again. As they say, the third time is a charm! and what a charm it was.This was the highlight of our trip. We saw the west face of Denali (McKinley) dodging clouds all the time. Then the highlight of all highlights........the sky cleared and we landed on Ruth glacier. A great landing, thanks Richard, with quiet, great beauty around us.
The people at TAT are helpful, understanding and make every effort to do their jobs. Mother Nature is the boss there and she is tough at times. Thanks to all who made out flight absolutely FANTASTIC. Everyone should experience a flyover with TAT. Thanks guys.

The staff from the folks at check in to the pilot are all great. Dad & I took a flight yesterday & landed in Ruth Glacier. It was awesome. You truly can't grasp how enormous McKinley is until you take a flight from Talkeetna Air Taxi. The views just blow you away. The pilots are all very knowledgable & point out many points of
Interest & do a great job of explaining how glaciers "work". They do this all while keeping your safety a priority. Although they do have flights don't land on the glacier I highly recommend paying the little bit extra to do it, you won't regret it. You can land on the glacier & get out & walk around & see the most breathtaking 360 degree views. You feel so close to heaven its amazing. I'm so glad I got to share this experience with my dad.

Our glacier landing and flight around Mt McKinley was fantastic. It was the highlight of our vacation. We received excellent service from the time we made our reservations until after the flight.  Our pilot was not only an excellent aviator but also a great photographer--he took several  memorable photos of me and my wife on the glacier. If you come to Alaska, this is a must do thing and Talkeetna Air Taxi is the company to use.

review_title: Awesome Ride and Birthday for my husband
review_text: I had planned a trip on my husband's bday with TAT. They were such an amazing bunch of people , that not only did we enjoy our glacier landing trip but all the surprises that I had planned for my husband they helped me execute it. I had ordered a cake from downtown, Talkeetna Air Taxi staff not only picked it up for me , but they even carried it to glacier landing as it was a surprise thing for my husband. Then, the pilot took out the cake in a plate (it was not a plastic plate)a glass plate and a fork. The glacier landing was smooth and the views awesome. Not only this they even gifted my husband a t-shirt. They made everything so special. The whole team fo Talkeetna Air Taxi is amazing. I would highly recommend them.

My family and I took a glacier landing flightseeing tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  It was the experience of a lifetime.  We had a snowball fight on top of a glacier...  How cool is that!  We even got to see another plane land on the glacier while we were up there.
The staff was professional and courteous.  The scenery was absolutely gorgeous.  I highly recommend this trip.

I used TAT to fly into both the Ruth Gorge and Kahiltna Base Camp Spring 2012.  The free use of the bunkhouse is great, and they drive you to and from town when needed with all your climbing gear.  Sign up early in the season and get a $100 discount!  Everyone is super friendly and helpful, such a great experience!

Had the opportunity to take a trip with TAT a couple of weeks ago, our original trip was canceled but was offered a trip very close to the one we had. They were very friendly and was happy to do what ever it took to make us happy. I think they went about what most companies would have done. I would highly recommend they for a trip around Mt Mckinnley or area to anyone.
Absolutely magnificent tour.  Wonderful staff.  Helpful pilots.  When you have a snowball fight on a glacier, what's not to like?

We did the McKinley tour with glacier landing.  This was the first excursion we did in Alaska.  We had a wonder time.  Our pilot was great. He shared a lot of helpful information and facts about the area. The flight was very smooth.  The other staff was very friendly and helped with reservations.  We took our 9 and 11 year olds with us.  They had a great time. Must add glacier landing.  Worth the extra money.

Everyone has to make time to do a flight with TAT.  We were very fortunate to have a landing added to our tour.  It is amazing how these planes slip down onto the glacier, nothing gives you the scale of the plane to the mountain.  Glaciers were amazing, but the shear mountains were fantastic.   Paul was our pilot and stared us around some weather moving through the area, the clouds were great.  Thanks Paul, your company is all great.  Really like the boots!

This was my third try at climbing Denali and each time used TAT.  Every one of the employees were so helpful and made me feel very welcome.  They went out of their way to assist in a variety of ways.  They really came through when my climbing partner had a medical situation and needed to go into Palmer to the Emergency Room and helped by providing a personal vehicle to go the 60+ miles then back again!  I've never seen this with any company before!  I just can't say enough about the quality of customer service and the people at TAT!  THANK YOU!
Dan

Our children surprised us with a flight seeing tour while we were on our Alaskan vacation.  The day started out a little iffy, but turned out to be perfect.  Everyone at Talkeetna Taxi was professional and had our best interest in mind at all times.  We got to see Denali and the glacier pools were amazingly blue.  Landing on the glacier was an experience.  While we were wondering around it started to snow lightly.  By the time we took off, the flakes were huge.  Definitely worth the money, skimp some place else if you need to make a decision.

Our McKinley tour with a glacier landing with Talkeetna Air Taxi was the highlight of all the many things that we did on our visit to Alaska.  We chose TAT because of the reviews we had read and because they work with you on letting you choose to go up if the conditions are less than favorable and rescheduling if necessary.  We were fortunate that our weather was perfect the day of our flight so off we went.  All the TAT team were friendly and welcoming and our pilot, Tyler, took very good care of us and made sure we were all comfortable.  The flight was smooth and we felt very confident that we were in good hands. And what we saw!!!! WOW! The flight allowed us to see so much up close and we were amazed at the beauty and magnitude of the mountain range. Mt. McKinley was amazing!  Tyler shared many interesting facts with us and pointed out different highlights that we went by. You must add the glacier landing to your tour!  There is nothing like being able to get out on the glacier and walk and look around and get pictures while high up in the mountains.The glacier landing and take off was smooth and we never had a worry about anything.  Sadly, we had to return but the memories will last us a lifetime.  This is a must do if you visit Alaska, well worth every penny.  (look for deals if you have a group of four or more).

We went with Talkeetna Air Taxi for our glacier flight and were not disappointed. We flew in a 6 passenger DeHavellin to the base camp for the climbers in Denali National Park. The views were fantastic and landing on the glacier and seeing base camp was really interesting. The flight is not cheap but most people only visit Alaska one time so you owe it to yourself to take the flight. Just be a little flexable with your flight times because they can be pushed forward if the front is to bad.

I took the flight which included a glacier landing on Denali. Everything about this trip was first-rate. The office staff was friendly, helpful, and informative. The pilot was professional and informative. But, my goodness, the sight of these amazing mountains from the air was an experience I will remember and treasure forever.
We took the early morning Grand Denali flight and had great views of the mountains.  The guide was fantastic with lots of interesting information.  And, the glacier landing was worth the extra money.

Bereits im Jahr vor unserer Reise nach Alaska habe ich bei Talkeetna Air Taxi die Tour "South Face with Glacier Landing" gebucht und erhielt einen wirklich guten Frühbucherbonus. Das finanzielle Risiko im Hinblick auf die frühe Buchung war gering. Geflogen wird, wenn es die Wetterbedingungen zulassen. Negativenfalls wird der Flug verschoben bzw. das Geld rückerstattet.

Wir hatten enormes Glück: Sonnenschein! Der Check-in fand morgens um 08:00 Uhr statt; abgeflogen wurde um 08:30 Uhr mit einer kleinen Cessna - 4 Passagiere und der Pilot! 
Der Flug war ruhig; der Pilot erfahren - er hatte alles im Griff! 
Die Aussicht: einfach gigantisch und unbeschreiblich! Freie Sicht auf den Mt. Mc Kinley in seiner vollen Pracht! Wälder, Flüsse, Teiche, die Tundra sowie eine kolossale Gletscher- und Felslandschaft zogen an uns vorbei bis wir am Ruth-Glacier landeten, wo wir uns ca. 20 Minuten aufhielten. Der Rückflug war genauso spektakulär wie der Hinflug.
Dieser Ausflug wird mir ewig in Erinnerung bleiben!

review_title: What an awesome thing to do in Alaska
review_text: My sister and I surprised my 75 year old father with a flight and glacier landing. Althought Mt Mckinley didnt totally cooperate, i didnt even care. Landing on the glaciers was awesome. Our pilot Tim was so great with helping my dad in and out of the plane, giving us a history of the area and other funny ancedotes. Everyone with company couldnt have been nicer. Another interesting fact i leaned after our flight was that TAT is a locally owned business versus one of there competitors that is owned by a big coorporation..so i was happy to support the locals.  Fly TAT!!!  oh and how could i forget they had better prices then the competition.

My husband and I had an amazing time on the Grand Denali Tour. The scenery was absolutely beautiful and the flight was calm and comfortable. We had a great time hanging out and taking pictures during the glacier landing. The weather was perfect and our pilot, Jonathon, was extremely knowledgeable.  It was definitely an experience of a lifetime!

review_title: Over the top from Down Under-AWESOME
review_text:
We went on the Base camp flight 2nd of June 2012, our pilot was Tyler. Firstly to you Tyler....AWESOME Mate never felt so safe in a small plane before, your expierience was evident and your knowledge and commentary was great, right from the safety briefing and offer to ride up front as (Co-Pilot) with yourself. The plane felt extremely well maintained and solid. From the time we arrived ALL of you guy's were very welcoming and friendly and nothing seemed to much trouble, your counter staff we met on arrival took the time to show us a map of were we would fly, told us of features we should keep an eye out for and so MUCH more. In reccommending TAT to all who may venture into your beautiful little town all we can say is that your people are as spectacular as the views we were so lucky to share the Glacier landing will be with us always and we can't wait to share our photos and video with the Family back in Austalia !!!!!

Again thanks and much gratitude from two very impressed Aussie's
Steve & Lynda
Sydney, Australia

Our tour was May 14 and my wife was about 10 weeks pregnant. That particular day she was experiencing some effects of being pregnant and while I did not want to leave her she insisted that I not miss this excursion. The folks at TAT noticing that she was in distress allowed her to lay on their couch and coddled her while I was away on the most exciting tour of our trip. Thank you TAT I am forever grateful for your service to my wife and for an epic flight and glacier landing. Thank you thank you thank you!

Took the Grand Denali flight with a glacier landing and it was worth the money. The whole experience was exceptional. The personal from counter staff to the pilot at TAT were great. Jonathan, the pilot was very professional and knowledgable on the geography of our flight. If I make it back, I will do it again?

review_title: TAT - Great experience with great people!
review_text: We had a great flight over (and onto) Denali! TAT provided a knowlegable and capable pilot (Brad) and a super support staff - thanks to all for a wonderful experience!

review_title: Talkeetna air taxi were safe, efficient and ultimately, just really cool!
review_text:
TAT got out expedition off to a great start by flying us on to the Ruth Gorge exactly when we needed. They accommodated all of our requests and were very efficient in getting us to where we needed to be. 

We maintained satphone contact with TAT during our expedition using them for weather forcasts.

They picked us up from the Ruth when we requested and did some really cool fly bys, just for fun! 

Paul - you are a great pilot. Thanks a lot.

review_title: Denali Flight Seeing is affordable from Talkeetna.
review_text: I sent visitors on the Talkeetna Air Taxi flight seeing tour and they came back with rave reviews.  The rates were exceptionally reasonable especially compared to those I saw in Denali park.  So don't assume that a flight seeing tour is out of your price range.  Check this out.

review_title: Fantastic flight and a great experience
review_text:
What can I say - our pilot was great we picked an excellent day an the flight was so smooth - the glacier landing which is an option was quite a memorable - our pilot, Tyler, was great - very laid back but still very professional. A coulpe of tips:
1: TAT does not charge you until you show up to fly - so make sure that the mountain is clear when you fly - that reservation is more like just a hold that you get on the plane
2: Remember how huge the area is - the glaciers are 2.5 miles wide! That means that when you think you are too close to the mountain you are still really far away!

Talkeetna Air Taxi does a great job.  Pilots are the best, very safe, knowledgeable, and friendly.  Ground staff is always friendly and helpful.  Everyone does a great job to provide for a relaxing and amazing experience.  And the views are tremendous.  Would not fly with anyone else up there.

I thought I had already had my peak adventure experiences, but TAT proved me wrong.  This is a groups of experienced, dedicated, caring professionals.  I marvelled at the pilot's knowledge of the history, geology, and on and on.  I was in awe for the entire trip.  I wholehaeartedly recommend these folks, and can't wait to get back...Tony V.

I have just returned from my first visit to Alaska, and while there were many wonderful things about it, the flight and glacier landing on Denali with Talkeetna Air Taxi was far and away the highlight of the trip. The entire staff was friendly, helpful, and our pilot (Richard) did an excellent job not only getting us there and back safely (of course!), but narrating along the way, mentioning points of interest and answering questions from the passengers. If you have the time (sometimes the weather prevents flights, so you may need to stay a day or so) and the means, do not miss the experience - so many people come to Alaska and never get to see Denali, let alone land on it.  Incredibly beautiful.
glaciers, mountains, forests and roads form different kinds of views. Natural beauties and imagination are combined to the amazing feeling that I've never had!!! Such a good place to go!

Everyone, the entire staff, was so helpful and pleasant from emails, to phone calls, and in person. We had the best time of our lives seeing Denali from above. Our pilot, Jonathan, was very knowledgeable, passionate, and calmly mannered. Landing on a glacier, and taking off from one, was not only breath taking but seemed effortless. Our time spent on the glacier was peace and will be a lasting memory. Travel was kept as low impact as possible, meaning concern and attention is giving to protect the nature that we are seeing. Denali is a special place and I would recommend that all visits to this wilderness include a personal plane ride.

TAT is an outstanding flight service based in Talkeetna, AK.   Whether you are sight seeing or are a climber looking to be dropped off somewhere in the Alaska Range, TAT will surpass your expectations.  The planes and pilots are top notch, even pioneering some of the now common glacier landings.  The office and support staff are professional, helpful and know this business well.  TAT is a very professional and well respected service, and will go the extra mile to make sure your trip is exceptional.  There is even a climbers bunkhouse for those waiting to depart from Talkeetna.  I have flown with TAT multiple times and have repeatedly been impressed.  Look no further that TAT!

We just experienced Mt Mckinley up close and personal. The plane was small, the view was huge! It was a perfect day and you could see Mt McKinley. I was thinking that we wouln't need to go in a plane to see it as we could see it so clearly as we drove thoward Talkeetna.  Wrong! It is a a whole different experience to see Mt McKinley up close from the plane. You see climber's camps, trails of climbers, glaciers and of course, very close to Mt McKinley.  It was just a one hour trip but jam packed with views. We could talk with the pilot and ask questions the whole time.  The staff is very friendly and helpful.

Though it was touch and go whether or not we would be able to complete a flight tour, it was well worth the wait. We were initially scheduled to fly on Saturday, but for weather reasons, the flights were grounded. Luckily we had hotel reservations for the night so we could reschedule for Sunday. We opted to do the glacier landing, and this was a huge hit with our kids. If doing a flight-tour is a must on your trip, then I suggest you book a night in Talkeetna. That way if your flight is cancelled, you have another shot at flying the next day. The staff was great in accommodating us the next day. And, Talkeetna is a fun, quirky town to spend the night in. Last caveat for families with young kids - our teen loved the whole experience, but our 8 year old fell asleep on the way back.

We visited in July 2011.  Talkeetna Air Taxi was professional from our first phone call to them and after we got off the plane.  It was fabulous.  Our Pilot, Rick, was very knowledgable and the flight went very smooth - including the landing and taking off from Eldridge Glacier.   If (when) we go back to Alaska, we will definitely use Talkeetna Air Taxi again and would definitely recommend this flight to others.

Steve and Jan Richards
New Mexico
It's a great fly. Mount Mckenley is so beautiful. And the glacier landing is spectacular.

review_title: Bucket list experience from takeoff to landing!
review_text: My family and I did the Grand Denali tour with a Ruth Glacier landing in the middle of March during Alaska's winter (the best time to see Denali because there are the most clear days).  It was an incredible experience from beginning to end.  It is definitely worth it to do the glacier landing.  There is nothing like landing on snow in the middle of a glacier.  Also, the staff was very friendly and the pilot was very experienced and knowledgable.

review_title: When you fly, fly with the BEST equipment and pilots!
review_text: As a retired Air Force pilot, the quality of equipment and skill of the pilot is a much higher consideration than the cost. My guests safely flew the Iditarod Trail and visited the Finger Lake Checkpoint. It was imperative to me that the plane have de-icing capability and IFR qualification. Everyone had a great trip, returned safely and have memories of Iditarod 40 that will last a lifetime. TAT is the BEST!

What a great experience!! We had a coupon, so were limited to our choice of flights, so book early. We booked late due to travel uncertainties but were able to get a spot at the last minute so don't give up. I am so glad I called them because this is something I would not have wanted to miss! We had a great flight. We went early in the morning and could not upgrade to a glacier landing due to the weather. We were able to fly around Denali which was amazing. It was wonderful. The views were breathtaking to say the least. Even without a discount it is a must do!
the flight over the alaskan range was informative and grand.  the glaciet landing was also fun.  great service and wonderful views.  highly recommend this if you are in talkteena.

review_title: If you don't go on Talkeetna Air Taxi, you wasted your trip to Alaska!
review_text:
My wife and I came to Anchorage, Alaska from South Carolina.  We spent hours on trains, planes and automobiles for the sole purpose of taking the Talkeetna Air Taxi.  This is the most spectacular experience that one person can have.  Absolutely amazing.  Worth every penny to get to Alaska, and certainly worth every penny of the tour itself.  

I was bummed out about one thing.  We came to Talkeetna at the end of the tourist season.  Snow had started to fall on the mountain the day before we arrived.  We were unable to do the landing.  It simply wasn't safe to do so.  I trust these pilots with my life, so... YES, I was bummed out.  But the pilot's professionalism and explanation of the manner in which a landing & takeoff occurs on the glacier made me fully understand the situation.

Mother nature decided that we wouldn't set foot on the glacier, but guess what...  I would pay to do it again in an instant!  Maybe next time we can go a bit earlier in the season.

We were in Talkeetna during a beautiful clear day and decided to take advantage of it by taking a flight to Denali. For us, it's a once in a lifetime opportunity so it was important to get it right. Everyone at Talkeetna Air Taxi took great care of us and most of all, made sure we were safe. We flew right to Denali (Mt McKinley) and landed on the glacier. It was incredible. The pilot did a great job of pointing out all the great point of interest. But again, more than anything, we felt safe.

We wanted to get out on the Iditarod Trail to visit a couple of musher friends in the race. TAT was very helpful in making it happen for us. Flexible scheduling--going to two checkpoints--, friendly people, wonderful and knowledgable pilot, Jonathan, made this a great trip.  Highly recommend this flight service. I know I'll be flying with them again to land at Denali base camp.

We had no clue, but the guy on the corner seemed nice enough. He didn't lie when he said that Talkeetna Air Taxi was the way to experience the mountain. He took us ap and showed us amazing views from every angle. The landing on the mountain was as calm as could be, His knowledge and demeanor was excellent. We had a great time and never felt rushed or crowded. When we saw what the other companies were doing, and how many people per plane, and length of stay on the mountain, we definitely made the  right choice.

review_title: Awesome Experience with very flexible staff
review_text:
The plane ride itself was beyond belief. The scenery was spectacular. The pilot offered tidbits of information and was quite personable. He even let us sit in the copilot seat!
Upon our arrival, the staff informed us that the weather was too bad to fly. We could cancel, or wait until the next day. We waited, and were able to call first, to check on weather. The next day's weather was bad on the ground, but good up at Denali. The staff encouraged us to wait it out, until the fog lifted. They had a nice area with coffee and couches, a deck and restroom facilities. The wait was not too long, and off we went for the ride of our lives. Highly recommend!!!!

Weather: Exceptional, Equipment: Magnificent, Ground-Staff: Above & Beyond, Pilot / Guide: Top-Tier Professional, Views: Breathtaking,  Glacier Landing: A Majestic Sanctuary, the Wickersham Wall: A Deeply Astonishing Panorama.   This was easily the high-point of our 13-day Cruisetour trip.
   
A Dream Come True / Once In A Lifetime Experience.

review_title: Just do it!  Glacier landing - YES!
review_text: This is the trip of a lifetime!  If you wonder whether the ride is worth the fee, the answer is a very definite YES!  When or where else will you be able to land on a glacier and get out and walk around?  Just do it!  If you don't get to land, the trip costs a little bit less.  I don't recommend this for folks with motion sickness, but for everyone else, go for it.  They will provide overshoes for you so your shoes and pants don't get wet.  Wear long pants and long sleeves - bring a jacket and gloves.  Bring your camera.  Just come on and do it.

review_title: Thoughtful and trustworthy company who made the trip perfect!
review_text: We did lots of research for a fly-over with glacier landing for our anniversary trip. When we called TAT we learned that they were equipped for this and would attempt a landing early, if safe. They advised us beforehand that they would adjust our date due to weather and give us a discount if someone else showed up to ride the same day, that was not part of our party. When we arrived to Alaska, we only had two days available for our flight. When we called the day of our flight, they advised us to re-schedule to the next day for better clarity and viewing. We were impressed that they wanted our experience to be the best possible! When we arrived the next day for our trip, they surprised us by refunding some of our costs, because an additional passenger had showed up, We were very impressed with the honesty they had, instead of using that as bait for us to book with them. We were so excited for our flight to begin. It was perfect weather and we were in fact able to be their first glacier landing of the season. It was amazing!! We were thrilled to view God's creation in such a new and big way to us. As we were leaving the glacier, our pilot was called to possibly help a stranded plane. We appreciated the kindness the pilot and company were willing to share with other pilots and companies in need. From our experience, TAT was most reasonably priced, honest, customer-friendly, and kind. We would love to go again! Like right now. :)

Talkeetna is a charming little town surrounded by breathtaking views and vistas. Denali (Mt. McKinley) graced us with her beauty during our visit. It is rare to see the mountain in all of her splendor without clouds obscuring her view. On that day Denali was picture perfect not only from the Susitna River but from the Talkeetna Air Taxi. Our air trip circled the north and south faces of the mountain and its surroundings. We saw incredible glaciers and opted for a Glacier Landing...it was exhilarating!

Our pilot looked too young to drive a car, much less fly a plane, but once we were airborne it was obvious that he knew exactly what he was doing.  He was in constant communication with ground crews and had a really good sense of where the other planes were at all times.  I felt completely safe the entire trip.  The plane was in good condition - not particularly comfortable, but who cared?  We took off and headed to Denali.  Flying in the mountains and clouds was so amazingly beautiful that I don't have words to describe it.  Once we got to Denali we were rewarded with clear skies and a fantastic view of the summit.  It was so beautiful it almost brought tears to your eyes.  Truly spectacular and something that you cannot describe to someone else.  You need to experience it for yourself.  I know that some people are disappointed because it is too cloudy to see Denali, but the flight is still a wonderful experience.  If the weather looks promising don't miss this trip.  It is something that you will always remember.

The staff are super friendly and nice and the flight was breathtaking! I sometimes get nervous on small planes, but I had no problems when flying. The flight was smooth and when it came time to land, I couldn't even tell we were already on the ground. During flight the pilot talks to you (you're wearing headphones) and kept us updated with what we were seeing and what side of the plane to look out of. They fit 10 people on a plane and each seat is next to a window! 
You experience Denali National Park, Mt. McKinley, and Alaska in a whole new way that I will never forget. The views were great and if there was something on the right side of the plane, the pilot would eventually turn the plan so the left side of the plane would be able to view it as well. 
They charge you at the end of your trip to make sure that you pay for what you were able to do. We had scheduled a glacier landing, but due to snow, we were unable to accomplish that portion of the trip. My husband and I are definitely going again next summer to try again for the glacier landing, but I definitely recommend this to anyone!

TAT (Talkeetna Air Taxi) was amazing. The service was super friendly and helpful and our pilot was knowledgeable and up front. We couldn't do the glacier landing because of the snow, however we were discounted the price, so that was fair. The trip itself was amazing. Fantastic views and gorgeous scenery. Allons-y!

Die Firma Talkeetna Air Taxi bietet Mount McKinley Scenic Flights vom Ort Talkeetna aus an. Diese Flüge sind absolut empfehlenswert und Highlight eines Alaska-Urlaubs. Insbesondere die Flüge mit Gletscherlandung (per Ski Plane) sind atemberaubend. Die Blicke auf Ruth Glacier, Sheldon Amphitheatre und den 6.200 Meter hohen Mount McKinley suchen ihres Gleichen. Die Flugzeuge von TAT machen einen guten Eindruck, die Piloten sind professionelle und erfahrene Alaska Bush-Piloten.

review_title: See Mt. McKinley / Denali as God Sees His Creation
review_text: Flying to see Mt. McKinley / Denali is a must. If you have gone through all of trouble and expense to get to Alaska, Don't pass up the chance to view God's creation from above. Talkeetna Air Taxi is A #1 to provide this opportunity. Customer Service and Safety is their #1 Concern. Thank you again Talkeetna Air Taxi for this opportunity!

My wife and I took our Honeymoon to Alaska in mid September and TAT was on our list.  Everything about the place is top notch: from customer service, the pilot, and especially our experience in the air.  The ride was smooth and the views were unbelievable.  Well worth the cost and I would do it again next time Im up there.  Plus landing on the glacier was unreal, truly spectacular.

TAT did a great job getting us up in the air early (we were scheduled for 9:00AM, but everyone arrived and was ready to go by 8:30AM) as the weather was closing in and we didn't want to miss seeing the mountain.  The flight was smooth and awesome.  Amazing scenery.  On our flight the best (longer) views of McKinley seemed to be on the right side of the plane, but the pilot makes turns to ensure each side sees good stuff.  

Don't freak when you hear alarms go off in your headset, it's just an indication they are coming in for the glacier landing. Landing was silky smooth...stayed on the glacier for 10 minutes - it started to snow so we boogeyed out.  Our morning flight was the only one to land that day, so not sure if going early helps.  

Worth the $.  Tip your pilot.

review_title: Fly over glaciers to really appreciate them
review_text:
Talkeetna Air was very accommodating when we wanted to postpone the reserved trip to wait for better weather. Two days later, we knew we'd made the right choice. It was a very rare cloudless day. We were fortunate to spend almost 2 extra hours on the ice of Kahiltna Glacier while our pilot helped another pilot try to get his plane back up the deteriorating icefield for another try at take-off. We were standing on snow in our shirtsleeves, soaking in sunshine and listening to the glacier crack and rumble. `so glad we opted not to return with a larger plane sent to pick up the disabled plane's passengers.

Very knowledgeable pilot who had great stories; we felt absolutely safe in his hands. Ground and office personnel were both efficient and laid back. It was apparent that safety comes first for everyone there.

The whole deal seems quite pricey but once you are over the glaciers with Denali in view it is worth every cent and more. This was our 4th Alaskan trip and Talkeetna Air was the icing on the cake.

we had an amazing time - and the weather was perfect for a glacier landing near mt. mckinley.  however, the staff at talkeetna air taxi was great - informative, helpful, and our pilot was extemely well versed in the surroundings (which made for an educational ride).  great company.

review_title: The highlight of our Alaska visit was the flight seeing tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi
review_text: The best part of our Alaska visit was the flight seeing tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi (TAT) with a Glacier Landing. Friends that had been to Alaska told us not to miss a flight seeing tour of Denali because it was the highlight of their trip. Our original tour was cancelled due to weather but TAT fit us in the next morning. Denali was breathtaking and landing on the glacier was so much fun. We had fresh snow that morning. Bring a camera with LOTS of memory, wear boots (although TAT will supply boot covers), sunglasses, and gloves. It's a half day adventure. The gals signing us in told us they had great pilots and they weren't exaggerating. Can't say enough good things and couldn't stop smiling after. Thanks TAT!

Go in the morning to get the best chance for good weather.  If you're the first flight, you get a free glacier landing.  Worth it.  Very memorable.

If you're the last person in the aircraft, you get to sit up front with the pilot.
We were reluctant to spend the money. It was worth every penny. We will never forget our glacier landing.

review_title: absolutely stunning view, highlight of my trip
review_text:
Me and my parents did the Grand Denali tour on 8-29 first thing in the morning. The flight was absolutely beautiful. We saw so much great views that's hard to describe on paper. We also landed on the Elledridge Glacier. That was fun too. I would actually recommend that if anyone want to do Denali flights, a glacier landing is something that you must do. 

I will definetly do this again next time I come to Denali.
The staff was extremely pleasant and helpful. The young pilot was very skilled and the scenary was spectacular. The trip to Danali and the glacier was the highpoint of our Alaska vacation.

Das Gefühl mit einem Flugzeug auf einem Gletscher zu landen kann man mit Wörter nicht wirklich beschreiben. Es ist magisch, wunderschön und beim schönen Wetter mit blauem Himmel und strahlender Sonne ist es noch besser. Wir hatten Glueck mit dem Wetter, aber der Pilot hat der Rest gemacht - er hat sich die Zeit und die Mühe gegeben uns ausfühlrich ueber die Region zu informieren.

review_title: If you can't climb Mt. McKinley, let Talkeetna Air Taxi take you there!
review_text:
Safety was my primary concern when scheduling a 2 1/2 hour flight around McKinley with glacier landing.  Talkeetna Air Taxi's record was good, but talking to the staff reconfirmed that safety is their main concern as well.  I would rank the experience among the top ten of my lifetime.  It was breathtaking.  I felt comfortable at all times including when we took off from the glacier, 7000 feet up.  Talkeetna Air Taxi was very accomodating by rescheduling the flight when weather would cut our flight short.  They also picked us up at an in town location and returned us.

Wear warm socks and a light jacket.  I was overdressed for the trip.  They provide boots which were needed as we stepped into knee-deep fresh snow on the glacier.  Also take chewing gum to keep your ears from popping.

We did the Base Camp McKinley tour with a landing on Eldridge Glacier on 8/16/11, and it was incredible! It was the highlight of our trip, and a highlight of a lifetime. The day we went it was extremely clear, so the views were breathtaking! My wife and I both agreed that because the power and the beauty were so intense, there were times when it was very emotional and even spiritual.

Was it expensive? Yes. Was it worth it? Absolutely! It was worth every penny! We found a discount coupon in the Bear Foot magazine that helped, but even without it, it would have been worth it. Also, if you decide to do this, I hope you get Bill (forgot to get his last name) as your pilot. He was a wealth of knowledge, and his commentary added so much to the experience.  

Friends look at our pictures and are amazed (as we were)! I know I sound like a commercial, but this was a fantastic experience in a place loaded with fantastic experiences. I strongly recommend it and Talkeetna Air Taxi; they were great!

review_title: Could not ask for a better air adventure
review_text:
As part of our planned drive from Anchorage to Denali Park, my 13 year old son and I decided to schedule a flight-seeing tour of Denali National Park and Mt. McKinley with Talkeetna Air Taxi based in Talkeetna, AK.  The tour turned out to be everything we had hoped for.

First - let's talk pricing.  Clearly this is not an inexpensive attraction -- it has to be planned and budgeted for, because, for all the obvious reasons, taking a two hour flight around Mt. McKinley, including a landing on a glacier, is not an inexpensive proposition.  Having said this, we believe it was clearly worth the cost, and we believe we received good value in return.  Additionally, we asked ourselves the following -- when again will we return to Alaska, and when again will we ever get a chance to see Mt. McKinley this close and from this perspective?  

Second - we got extremely lucky with the weather the day we took the tour -- the weather was warm, sunny, and the mountain views were crystal clear -- a picture-perfect day for a flight all around Mt. McKinley and Denali National Park, and landing on a real glacier.  This allowed wonderful photography, and even now, reviewing my pictures, it doesn't look like they were taken through a plane window.

For my 13 year old son, landing on the glacier and playing in the snow had to be the highlight of the vacation for him -- he's still talking about all the cool parts of flying around the mountain, seeing the park from the air, and the glacier landing.

Our Talkeetna Air Taxi pilot (Richard, I believe) was extremely knowledgeable, professional, and gracious -- he answered all our questions and really helped make the experience a real enjoyable adventure for us and all the other passengers on the plane.  Plus, we had about 40 minutes on the glacier, and that also made it a real grand time, playing in the snow, taking pictures, etc.

I would strongly advise anyone visiting the Anchorage / Denali National Park area to definitely include Talkeetna Air Taxi in their plans.  Again, flight-seeing is a bit more expensive than the usual attractions, but it's a once-in-a-lifetime experience that can't be beat.  And the folks at TNT really made the experience easy and enjoyable.

One other thing -- the staff at TNT worked with us to reschedule our flight time because we were running a bit late, and, additionally, TNT told me in advance that if the weather were a bit iffy (which it was not, as I mentioned earlier), we could cancel our reservations with no charge at all.  This policy is just "good business", and it helped us to decide to go flight-seeing and use TNT.

review_title: TAT has left its permanent ink on my soul
review_text: TAT made our 1-hour flight circumnavigating Mt. McKinley so awe-inspiring that there's no way I'm NOT going to do it again.  Literally and non-hyperbolically one of the most amazing experiences of my life.  Our pilot, Will, landed on a snow-packed glacier with no discernible markings indicating length, depth or pitch.  It was so smooth, we didn't even know we'd landed.  Every staff member we encountered was a standard bearer of professionalism.  I am by no means wealthy enough to frivolously spend money on vacations, but this was one of the best $280 I ever spent.  Ever.  If you take the first flight of the morning, you get a free glacier landing.  Maybe this kind of service is common in Alaska, but I can't imagine anyone doing it better.  Highest rating.  5 stars.  Do this.  Before the glaciers are gone.  And before TAT raises their prices when they realize how awesome they are.

review_title: A treat for eyes and soul ! You have to do it !
review_text:
On a beautiful and sunny day, our pilot Paul, provided us with equally perfect service. We took home memories and pictures of unmatched beauty and they will stay with us for a lifetime. You MUST take the glacier landing option or you will miss a wonderful experience. Thank you Talkeetna Air Taxi, thank you Paul and happy upcoming birthday, 
Ziggy from New York

Our flight last month (August 11) with Talkeetna Air Taxi was spectacular.

Starting with our making the reservation back in March, their friendly service made everything easy.  We really appreciated that they worked with our schedule to meet us when our train arrived and scheduled our flight shortly thereafter (the competitors I contacted didn't offer that flexibility).  After discussing the various options with T.A.T. staff, we chose the McKinley Base Camp flight with a glacier landing (1 3/4 hours).  By booking early we had already saved $50 per person and since our flight was after 4 PM, they accepted a Northern Lights discount coupon which dropped the price for our group of 4 by 25%.

The flight was smooth and the weather was perfect!!!!  Brad, our pilot, was very knowledgeable about Denali and all the nearby mountains and glaciers, was able to answer all of our questions, and altered the route slightly from time to time to assist our picture taking.  Our views of Denali, Mt. Foraker, Mt. Hunter, other nearby peaks and numerous glaciers were magnificent and our landing on one of the glaciers was awesome!  If you are going to take the flight, make sure you add the glacier landing.

I can't recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi highly enough for a wonderful flightseeing experience.

review_title: One of the best parts of our trip
review_text: We had originally booked a day that turned out to be bad weather-wise, so we rebooked. The day before our rebooked date turned out to be gorgeous, and they were most happy to let us change again. The flight was in a DeHavilland Turbine Otter, a little noisy, but everyone gets headsets so that was OK. The pilot was good at narrating as we went. Certainly the highlight was landing on the glacier. If you go, do NOT miss that. It was so cool. And the weird part is where you land is still only around 10,000'. Not even halfway up. This was kinda pricey - but don't miss it. Hint: There is no copilot. That right-hand seat is fair game. TAKE IT!!!

If your planning a trip to Alaska, doing a glacier landing with TAT is a Awesome Must Do activity. The entire operation is friendly and dedicated to making your experience. We did the evening flight after getting off train from Denali. McKinley was not visible from the ground due to clouds but TAT assured us the views were still fantastic as they turned out to be. I quickly volunteered to sit up front, co-pilot, to video and was amazed at at the views. We eventually broke through the clouds to see amazing snow capped peaks. Eventually we navigated down into the Base Camp glacier and climbed out into knee deep snow.  Back at the airfield, my wife, who co-piloted back, admitted to pilot that this had been the best of our four Alaska flights. The glacier landing was the PEAK of her Alaska experience.

I never really thought of flight sightseeing as an attraction. Our guides suggested TAT so we decided to do the green route and land on the Tokositna Glacier. We flew in a Twin Otter and our pilot was great. There were amazing views of Denali, the rivers, and glaciers. We flew around the summit and got closeup views of the surrounding mountains. I have never seen anything so beautiful. When we landed on the glacier there was sparking snow, and we romped around for about half an hour. The landing is really worth it. This is definitely one of my favorite activities in Alaska. DON'T MISS IT!

We had booked the glacier landing trip with the special for free glacier landing on the 8:30am flight. Weather was bad that day so the flight got cancelled, but they readily rescheduled us for a couple days later when we were coming back down from Denali, and honored the special for any time of day for the reschedule. Everyone there was friendly, pilot was informative, views were simply AMAZING!!! I would definitely recommend the glacier landing to everyone, it added so much to the trip. I get motion sick and the flight there was fine for me, but there was a bit more turbulance on the way back and I was feeling pretty queasy - should have taken my bonine!

This was really tricking in planing, as we arrived in Talkeetna early in the evening and we were scheduled to fly the next morning. But the weather had been forecast as being iffy for next morning. So we called TAT and they explained that if we could be there by 6:30 in the evening we could make a decision to fly or not that night, since the weather is constantly changing in the mountain range. We decided to go that night, looking out at Mount McKinley top one third was in the clouds, the rest of the mountain as well as the rest of the range was partially covered in clouds coming and going. We were suppose to do the grand tour which includes flying the backside of McKinley and a glacier landing at Base Camp.  I asked if it was possible to ride in the co-pilot seat of the air plane and  the service person said she would ask the pilot. As we boarded the plane I was able to fly in the co-pilot seat which gave me the best views for taking pictures.  As we flew out to the range we went though some rain shower in which, if you ever seen a rainbow from a plane it is a circle that goes around the plane, I got some really good pictures.  As flew closer to different mountains in the range I got more great pictures, as the sun was starting to hang low in the horizon. We couldn't fly around the backside of McKinley due to the low cloud cover, but we did land on the glacier which was really cool, it had snowed about 3 feet of snow a few days ago, as we walked on the glacier we would sink to up to over our knees in the soft snow. We stayed on the glacier for about 30 minutes before taking off and heading back to airport.  We were given a discount when we went to pay for the ride, since we didn't do the whole tour. Folks working there are very considerate and I didn't feel at all that they took any advantage of us. Customer service was top notch.

I highly recommend doing a flightseeing trip out of Talkeetna, and definitely include a glacier landing.  We had opted to do this, instead of making the trip to Denali, and we were glad we did.  The only thing I would suggest is...if you have a reservation, say later in the day, if the weather is clear in the morning, and you don't have other firm plans, call their office and see if you can get on a flight ASAP.  We were under the impression our 6pm reservation time was firm.  The day was beautiful in the morning and 1st half of the afternoon, but then clouded up and started raining.  We had stopped to talk to one of their reps. in town who was selling flights, and expressed our concern about the weather changing later in the day, but he made no suggestion of going earlier.  The office seemed surprised by this when we checked in.  They did try to call us 2 hours before our scheduled flight, but as with most folks visiting, cell phone service is very spotty up there.  We didn't get the message until it was too late.  We were really disappointed that we were only able to do the shortest flight, and were not able to do the glacier landing.  It still was a great experience, but just keep in mind....call them, and GO when the weather is clear, as it can change very quickly!  Their schedules and reservations definitely seemed flexible to accomodate this.   Maybe not any day, but it was a weekday, and just two of us flying.   Ditto, for asking for deals.  We could have gotten the same deal that day, as I got when I booked months in advance.

review_title: Awesome views with landing at Base Camp Denali
review_text: Our original reservation fell during a cloudy evening, so the company advised delaying (without any fees) until the next morning.  It turned out to be the clearest day in weeks.  Our pilot checked ahead & found there were some clouds on the glacier we supposed to land on, so he took us to Base Camp (for the climbers) which was mostly shut down.  For the 2 climbers in our group, it was a dream come true & the views were incredible.  The glacier landings are free on certain flights (early am & late pm) and completely worth the experience.  Stay in Talkeetna (cute town) & give yourself a range of days to attempt the flight to get the best weather window.

I recently went to Alaska with a friend on a trip that we have been planning for years!  We made many stops and had many adventures, but our flight with TAT was by far the most amazing experience of our lives.  From the moment we walked in the door the staff was excellent, accommodating and friendly.  Our pilot was extremely knowledgeable and put us both at ease within the first minutes.  We could not speak the entire trip to the glacier as our jaws were on the plane floor.  This trip was majestical and beautiful and our pilot made us want to the do same thing all over again the next day.  I would tell anybody planning a trip to Alaska that this is an absolute MUST.  Thank you TAT!

review_title: The best part of our trip to AK
review_text: The day was crystal clear, which is unusual for this part of Alaska, and the air taxi trip around Mt McKinley was wonderful.  The pilot was our tour guide and did an excellent job.  We landed on a glacier and spent about 30 minutes there.  It was an amazing sight and one I don't think the view would ever become boring.  I felt that the professionalism of the personel was outstanding and again, this was the highlight of our trip.

review_title: not to be missed while in Alaska
