review_text: We had the great joy of having Brad fly our family up to see Denali up close and personal.  Viewing the mountain and glaciers from a Cessna was truly the highlight of our Alaskan adventure. Upon arrival off the train we quickly made an evening booking while the sky was brilliantly sunny. We were fortunate to have a pretty unobstructed view (few to no clouds) of the range and glaciers. The flight was a bit pricy but compared to other flight tours in SW Alaska, with perhaps lesser grandeur, I thought TAT was good value for what we saw.   My wife was more nervous that the kids but quickly settled in once we were airborne. No turbulence, felt fully comfortable with our pilot. Highly recommend!

TAT is a professionally run operation with a long history--that delivers.  I reserved many months in advance and gave them a back-up date in case weather didn't cooperate.  Payment was made in full AFTER we completed the flight (no deposit was needed when I made the reservation).  I've flown quite a bit in small planes and there is NOTHING like flying up to Mt. McKinley and landing and taking off on a glacier!  The pilot was extremely skilled and was knowledgeable; safety was paramount. We enjoyed spectacular weather.  This experience was the highlight of a fabulous trip and was more than I ever could have imagined.  TAT's offices and facilities were clean & organized and the staff was courteous and professional.

My wife and i took Talkeetna Air Taxi for a flightseeing tour of Denali.  This included a glacier landing.  It was the second time we used TAT for a flight, the first in 2007.

Their prices are very competitive and they have deals - ask.  Everyone there is very friendly and helpful.  The pilots are first class and really make the trip fun.  They also know more than you'll ever want to know about the area and flying.

The planes are in great shape and I know the maintenance routine here is top rate.

Don't come anywhere near Denali without treating yourself to a flight over the mountain.  You'll never forget it.  I'd fly with these guys again in a minute.

review_title: Talkeetna Air Taxi took us up for a peek into heaven.
review_text: We had a perfect evening flight, all conditions were great to see the mountains and we were able to land on a glacier.  Jonathon was a super pilot, warm and friendly and full of fascinating information.  He welcomed our questions, made a flawless landing on the glacier and made is feel safe.  Flying up above the clouds was truly like having a peek into heaven.  We took loads of pictures and videos and love to show them off.  We had to talk our niece who lives into Anchorage into joining us for this ride.  Luckily we were successful and had the trip of a lifetime with her.  Life is couldn't be sweeter!

review_title: Most fascinating experience of my life!
review_text:
What a great experience!  Highly recommend a "flightseeing" tour of Denali/Mt McKinley.

The last two times I was in a small plane were miserable and I was motion sick.  I dreaded this flight even tho' I was sure I wanted to try it.

Talkeetna Air Taxi was professional top to bottom.  Friendly, efficient, respectful, fun.  Our pilot was Danielle.  She has been flying for 22 years and she handled the Beaver like it was a limo.  I did not have one moment of motion sickness.  Her landing and take-off were nearly undetectable.  Her comments during the flight were so interesting.

We decided NOT to do the glacier landing because I was afraid of becoming more sick from the landing and take-off.  However, after seeing how effortless it was, I wish we had paid extra to do it.  We did the Grand Denali and saw all sides.  Absolutely amazing.  There are no words to describe how majestic it is.
This was the highlight of our trip to Alaska  Words cannot describe it !!!!

review_title: A must when vacationing in Alaska
review_text: The entire experience was amazing!   Skip the Denali Park all day bus tour and book the flight with the glacier landing.   Talkeetna was one of our favorite stops although I wish we would have spent the night there!  Our Talkeetna Air Taxi experience was great with an experienced pilot!

This trip was one of the highlights of our Alaska trip. The flight is right out to Talkeetna, a small town on the way between Anchorage and Denali. The town itself is not much to look at, though you can get some coffee or grab a lunch from there. We took the trip that was about two hours long and included landing on the glacier. The scenery was out of this world! We were 5 in the cesna aircraft( including the pilot) and the pilot was talking to us about the geology of the region all throughout. We went close to McKinley and hunter and lots of glaciers and moraines. The flight itself was mostly smooth. The return trip was a litle bumpy but considering the size of the plane it was not wholly unexpected. It is not inexpensive but totally worth it. I highly recommend this trip and Talkeetna air taxi.

Talkeentna Air Taxi  provided great, friendly service.  There were four of us and we had  our own plane- much nicer that going up in the larger planes.  The glacier landing is a must!  They also offer discounts to Aramark employees

Went on two hour flight, with a glacier landing!  It was totally worth it!  The staff was incredible, and the views of Denali were breathtaking!  One of the coolest things that I have ever done! The pilots were great, too!  They were informative, professional, and very experienced.  Overall, it was a once in a lifetime experience, that I will never forget!

I was very nervous about flying in a small plane, but the pilot was very professional and kept us updated throughout the flight.  This is a very professional organization, and I felt very safe.  The views were incredible and totally worth the money.  I would definitely go again!

A great flight in a DeHavilland Otter!!  We did the glacier landing package, which was the cherry on top.  Take the evening flight at 630pm and the glacier landing is free.  We departed about 30 mins late, but our pilot was there to make our trip awesome.  Highly recommend.

Our family of four went on a tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi this month. It was absolutely amazing and was the highlight of our trip. Everyone was incredibly accommodating and friendly and everything went perfectly.  The sights were amazing; the most memorable we have ever seen.  A "must do" if you are lucky enough to visit Alaska!

review_title: Don't miss it - best way to see Mt. McKinley!
review_text: My husband and I did the Grand Denali flightseeting trip 10 years ago with TAT, and knew it had to be part of this year's trip with our two younger children and my in-laws.  We were as lucky this time as we were 10 years ago to be part of the "30% club" that had crystal clear views of Mt. McKinley (they say that only 30% of the visitors to Mt. McKinley ever get to see the peak - it's usually cloud-covered).  We took the late afternoon Grand Denali trip - a 2 hour flightseeing tour all around Mt. McKinley, including a glacier landing.  The tour is awesome, and the glacier landing a real experience and not to be missed!  Headsets allow all passengers the ability to hear the pilot provide narration, and everyone has their own window seat.  Talkeenta Air Taxi provides top notch services!

review_title: A must for your bucket list
review_text: The scenic flight of Mount Mckinley on Talkeetna Air taxi was the absolute highlight of our Alaskan Cruise Vacation.  The staff at the Air Taxi servce were kind, friendly and professional.  The pilot was very informative and pointed out great landmarks and provided interesting stories about the landmarks.  The scenery was absolutely breathtaking.  I also recommend landing on the glacier, it was a once in a lifetime experience.

We took the flightseeing trip over Mt McKinley (Denali).  Our pilot and guide, Will, was the best!  Friendly and knowledgable!  We had a great time and to top it all off, we were able to land on an active glacier!  The best trip ever!!!

Please- do yourself a favor and do not book with TAT.  Earlier this month  I had a 7pm flight booked with TAT which was supposed to land on a glacier and return in time to make the last shuttle to the Princess Lodge.  I was assured that there would be no problem on timing since it was important to make this shuttle.  I showed up at about 6pm and checked in.  I waited while several other flights left and was continually assured that everything was fine.  At 7pm no plane for our flight had arrived at the airport.  Again, “everything was OK.” At about 7:30 pm, I overheard the clerk tell someone on the phone “he’s not going to make it, I guess I’ll give a tee shirt and send him on his way.”  It did not take long for me to find out she was talking about me.  The plane had still not arrived and after waiting for almost two hours, I had to walk back to town to catch the shuttle.  No tee shirt was offered, nor would I have accepted it.  I want nothing that would remind me of this disaster.  It was my last night in Talkeetna and I missed what would have been one of the highlights of my visit to Alaska.  I do not know when the plane arrived or any reason for its delay.  Again, book your flight with a more reliable firm such as K2 and avoid my experience.

My husband and I (from United Kingdom), stayed in Talkeetna 8 years ago when we travelled Alaska via rail, but did not have enough time to do this trip and always said we would go back and do it.  So in June this year we did and certainly were not disappointed.  The first member of staff we met happened to drop into the hotel we were staying in and the reception staff mentioned to her we wanted a trip and she asked if she could  book it for us “or please use my cellphone to book it”, very helpful.  All staff we came across at the office were very nice and friendly. They had to postpone the first trip due to heavy cloud but rebooked for the following afternoon and they said to call in the morning in case they could fit us in earlier if we preferred.   We even got a call from the office asking us if we needed someone to pick us up from our hotel to take us to the airstrip, very efficient. The trip itself and the landing on the glacier was absolutely amazing, just cannot describe how it made us feel, can certainly now understand why people want to climb mountains! If you get the chance just do it, take the longest route they offer and pay the extra for the glacier landing you will not be disappointed.

We heard of several flightseeing companies from McKinley and Talkeetna and we unsure of where to go. A friend of a friend recommended Talkeetna and boy, are we grateful! Even though we had to drive a distance from McKinley to Talkeetna, we would do it again. We had signed up for a regular 1 hour flight (check their website for online specials before booking). They upgraded us since they had seats on a nicer flight. It's a 10 passenger plane and I would recommend sitting on the last two seats if you get a chance. Every seat has a window and a great view but the front ones have the wings in the way for a small part. The last two seats are virtually unobstructed. 

Also, PLEASE CHOOSE to do the Glacier Landing. Can't describe in words what an experience that was. The staff, their pilot and the overall company was extremely helpful, very friendly and not at all pushy or trying to sell us anything. Special thanks to Heidi at Talkeetna Air Taxi!

review_title: Don't even consider another Denali flightseeing company!
review_text: Another couple was staying at the same B&B and had booked with another company for the same trip. Weather was "iffy" (cloudy). We got the go-ahead and enjoyed an excellent excursion on board an "Otter" aircraft with our pilot, Will Boardman. When we got back to the B&B, the other couple was still sitting waiting for their company to call w/ the OK! TAT had the right equipment and the experienced pilot to make this experience one of the highlights of our Alaska vacation.

review_title: Coolest thing I've done in Alaska to date!
review_text: I've been privileged to have had many adventures in Alaska. This, by far, has been absolutely the best yet!!!! Jonathan was not only a capable pilot, he clearly loves his job and was very informative. We got to see the most magnificent mountain in all of North America and landing on the glacier was unparalleled. I took so many pictures, I exhausted the battery=) I recommend this adventure to EVERY one that comes to Alaska.
one of the most amazing adventures I have ever had..........flew with my son and we could not believe how gorgeous the scenery was.....I've gotta go back

Was one of the best parts of our trip to Alaska.  We were so surprised by the ease of the flight.  And the views were spectacular.  Everyone at Talkeetna Air was great.  We love it and would do it again in a heartbeat.  Amazing...still brag about it today.

Spend the money, you won't regret it!!!

We were booked for a 1:30pm flight but the weather was iffy so we were offered a 3:00pm instead which was our only other option as we had to move onto our next destination. We went downtown and got a surprise call at 2:00 to come back... weather was looking good!  Jonathan did a wonderful job as both pilot and tour guide. We also took the glacier landing which, as long as you are taking the flight, is a definite must-do.  Remember to use your AAA discount!
The McKinely flying tour (the longer one with the glacier landing) was absolutely the high point of a very-good Alaska trip.  Planes are nice, the tour is breathtaking.  This is a must-do.
The plane ride was excellent. The pilot always put our safety first- landing at base camp was breathtaking. The views are unbelievable. This is a must do while in talkeetna.

My wife and I wanted to do something special on our trip to Alaska, and this was perfect.  The flight around Denali with glacier landing was thrilling yet comfortable, adventurous yet safe, filled with gorgeous, jaw dropping sights, and worth every dollar.  Staff were very friendly, too.  Highly recommended!

After waiting 3 days for the weather clear weather we were able to make our glacial landing flight.  The company was excellent to work with helping us reschedule our flight and was very honest and up front regarding their estimate of success.  In the end we only got a glimpse of Mt. McKinley on our way to the mountains and the clouds came back in.  We flew through many deep canyons and were unable to make a landing on a glacier due to weather conditions.  Finally we had a break and our pilot, Bill, was able to make a very smooth landing.  Because weather conditions prevented the tour we had signed up for the company adjusted the cost.  1st rate and very honest company.  Our pilot was excellent and provided much information of the mountain and glaciers.  First rate company and great pilot.  Can not ask for more and are looking forward to our next trip.

review_title: This was an experience of a life time!
review_text: This tour was on our "to do" list of things we wanted to be sure to include while in Alaska.  To our amazement, this flight-seeing trip which included the glacier landing was the highlight of our trip.  Not only was our pilot, Trevor, very professional but he made our trip very informative.  The base staff was pleasant and professional as well.  We would highly recommend this beautiful trip.  Be sure to bring your camera and extra batteries, you'll be taking lots of pictures!

review_title: The crown jewel of our Alaskan Vacation
review_text:
We saved a little bit of $ by booking the 8am flight. Richard was our pilot and I gotta say, our flight probably went smoother than most commercial flights I've been on. He's not a particularly excitable guy but then again, I didn't want a crazy guy flying us in a tiny airplane over North America's tallest mountain. Takeoff was smooth and Richard gave us the low down on what we were seeing down below. When entering the mountains, he pointed out the names of most of the mountains and glaciers and was more than willing to answer any questions. The scenery was absolutely breathtaking. It was as if God said, "Check this out" when making these mountains. Then we landed on a glacier around 5500 feet in elevation. The view was incredible. The whole time we felt completely safe and comfortable. Like I said, I think this was the crown jewel of our vacation.

Tips: Be sure to wear sunglasses and a light jacket for the glacier. You also have to wear silly booty things over your shoes if you're walking on a glacier. If it's cloudy, take heart! The airport was cloudy but the mountains were not the day we went.

Bottom line: Would I go again? The price was steep but this is definitely a once in a life time. I'll probably never see anything like it again. I would go again if I could afford it.
We have done many things in Alaska but this is the best. Our pilot "Wild Bill" was fantastic and anything but wild. Would recommend TAK air as the best. If you do nothing else here this is a must

We booked with Talkeetna Air Taxi months ago. The weather was not cooperative, but they worked with us until there was an opening. The wait was well worth it. While it was raining in Talkeetna, it was sunny at the top. We even got to have a unique landing at base camp to pick up some exhausted climbers at no extra charge! Would highly recommend this company - they bent over backwards to give us the opportunity to see Denali.

Talkeetna Air Taxi was about 35% cheaper then McKinley Flight seeing. It was one of the top three, maybe two, most amazing experiences of my life. We thought we would be nervous but there was no turbulence and no fear..only stunning, breath-taking, indescribable views. Have you ever seen anything so beautiful, it moved you to tears? This will. Go for the extra few bucks and land on the glacier, what a feeling!
Pricey for a family, yeah, but worth every dollar. I would do it again in a heartbeat. The rating is way beyond excellent.

review_title: Great trip, and more than worth the price
review_text: We had a fantastic sightseeing flight and glacier landing at Mt McKinley.  Our flight was delayed for about a half hour, but this was to allow some of the fog to clear on the mountain and they could provide a better experience.  Our pilot/guide Tyler gave excellent commentary on the flight and the ride was very smooth.  He patiently answered all our questions and allowed us plenty of time on the glacier for pictures.  All the people at TAT were very helpful and couteous. I definitely would recommend their tour and service to anyone considering a Mt McKinley filght.

This was the highlight of our trip which included a boat tour of Kenai Fjords NP and a Bear Viewing trip from Homer. Our original time of 8am was pushed back to 11am due to weather, but we were upgraded to Grand Denali at no charge. Our 18 year old daughter got to ride in the co-pilot's seat and enjoyed the best view on the plane.

The flight was very smooth and safe. We each had our own seat and window. We kept flying past bigger and bigger mountains until we saw Mt McKinley. He made sure to turn the plane so we all got a good view. This was the only time on the trip we were able to see it. We landed on a glacier a mile from the base camp the climbers use. We spent about 20 minutes on the glacier before heading back. Total trip time was 2 hours.

review_title: Awesome Flight with Once in a Lifetime views!!
review_text: We took the Grand Denali Flightseeing tour WITH the glacier landing (a must). 2 hours of exhilaration. If you do nothing else in Alaska this is it!! We landed on the Ruth Glacier during our tour of  Denali National Park which was spectacular and so peaceful. The weather was warm and sunny when we went (May 25) and everything was in full view. We had a great pilot (Tyler) who informed us all during the flight what we were seeing. Any seat on the plane had the same great views as the path that was flown seemed to accommodate everyone. The staff was very friendly and helpful with any of our questions or concerns. Highly recommended and would use them again. Do not forget your camera!

We had no reservations and arrived in Talkeetna at about 3 pm.  The "downtown" storefront person for Talkeetna Air Taxi, listened carefully to what we were looking for and clearly explained the flight options, but not until she had called the airport to see exactly what was still available.  That way we got not runaround or mis-information.  Also, when we told her we needed lodging for the night she called numerous local places and found us an ideal room for the night.  When we got to the airport, it was the same straightforward, professional approach.  There was very little waiting until the pilot strolled up to us and double checked that we were the ones on the scheduled flight.  He took us to the classic plane of the Alaska backcountry, a DeHavilland Beaver aircraft and gave us a no nonsense explanation of what we should do and expect.  The flight??  It was like a living PBS documentary over the Alaska Range and around Mt. McKinley/Denali with a landing on Ruth Glacier.  Two and a half hours.  The pilot was excellent at explaining everything we saw, just enough facts, not overwhelming non-stop talking
Don't even hesitate going with these folks if you're looking to do some flightseeing at Denali.

We found our flight from Talkeetna Air Taxi to be wonderful. The company was very flexible with us every step of the way. They communicated with us through emails very promptly. We had to add an extra passenger and it was no problem. We arrived in Talkeetna in the early evening and even though our reservation was for the next morning, we asked if they could take us as the weather was very good and we did not know what tomorrow would bring. They took us no problem. Our pilot/guide, Jonathan K., was great! He was extremely informative about the area's geography and history. He was also very skilled at flying the plane. We had such a smooth ride. It was one of the smoothest airplane rides I have ever had! Scenery was wonderful. Jonathan pointed out many footprints/tracks far below where climbers had been. He showed us tents on ridges that we could hardly see. We flew over the base camp and could see the tiny tents on the snow. There were some clouds that blocked our vision a little but we could still see the top of Mt. McKinley and the scenery was stunning. Landing on the glacier was an experience. We felt like we were on another planet. Only our plane and its passengers was on the glacier. I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi if you are at all interested in this adventure.

review_title: Incredible views of Denali and mountain glaciers
review_text:
My wife and i loved our visit to Alaska. We happily chose to fly over Mount McKinley/Denali using Talkeetna Air Taxi.  A first class outfit, we flew in a Dehaviland Otter with Tyler,  a superb young pilot who inspired confidence and was helpful as a guide. We experienced once in a lifetime views of Denali and the Alaskan Mountain range and actually landed on a glacier!
I was very impressed by the integrity of the administrative staff, also. Service oriented, safety-conscious and attentive to our needs, we received an unexpected partial refund when cloud cover did not permit the airplane to circumnavigate the whole of Denali.

review_title: Best thing we did in Alaska
review_text: May 25, 2011-Great flight, great pilot, beautiful views, and landed on a glacier...what a trip. I would use Talkkeetna Air Taxi again.

We had a group of 6 that wanted to go flightseeing over Denali and we picked the right place to go.  Talkeetna Air Taxi went out of their way to schedule us a time that worked for us after we had to move the time to later in that day because of our conflicting schedule.  We booked it with Anna, thery were very flexiable, very professional and they made sure we were able to get our Northern Lights discount coupon applied to our trip.  Tyler was our pilot and he took us all over Denali.  It of course helped that it was a beautiful clear sunny day too.  We landed at base camp and took some amazing pictures.  I would recomend Talkeetna Air Taxi to anyone who is interested in a great flightseeing tour.

We flew with Talkeetna air taxi on wednesday May25th,2011. We had great weather- sunny and 100% clear. Views of the mountain were outstanding! On our time on the mountain, we met some hikers from England that wanted to come down with us instead of waiting till the next day. Our pilot was Tyler and he was not only a great pilot, he also had all the answers to our questions and made sure that both sides of the plane had equal time  to see all that  he was describing. Would Highly recommend this company to anyone and everyone! Thanks T.A.T for such a wonderful experience!!

review_title: Breathtaking scenery, makes me wonder why I didn't do this sooner
review_text: On my fourth visit to Alaska, I finally went flightseeing around Denali; and it will be one of my most memorable vacation experiences anywhere, ever.  A pilot with over 20 years of experience flying here took us up to and around Denali with a useful narration of the landscape.  Landing on Ruth Glacier at 8000 feet for photos of the glacial basin and poses featuring Denali was the highlight.

Glacier landing, Denali up close and personal, what more can one ask of a flight service. Incredible views, amazing views, fantastic views. Get the idea!  Breathtaking and speechless are just two adjectives to describe the flight.

We took a flightseeing tour around Denali National Park, then landed on the Ruth Glacier.  It was a clear day with no wind-just perfect.  What an unbelievable experience.  This was definitely one of those "bucket list" trips.  If you have time and some money, this is a do not miss excursion.  I cannot recommend this highly enough.

Had a wonderful experience with Talkeetna Air, they were very helpful, and informative. Although we were not able to do the Grand Denali tour due to weather, the Base Camp tour was I'm sure just as impressive. The Pilot was amazing, very knowledgeable and friendly. 
It just so happened we were there on the perfect day, clear skies, and it was even snowing when we landed on the glacier, but still so warm from the sun. Such an amazing experience, would love to come back and do it again!

review_title: If you do nothing else in Alaska, DO THIS!
review_text: Flying with TAT was a great experience from start to finish.  We did the Base Camp flight with the added glacier landing.  The staff was friendly and accommodating and our pilot/guide was both an excellent pilot and an extremely knowledgeable, personable guide (Tyler).  We were further spoiled by beautiful weather.  Spend the extra money and ADD THE GLACIER LANDING TO YOUR TOUR - it was definitely the highlight of my Alaska vacation!!!  =)

review_title: Aweinspiring flight with glacier landing - don't miss it!
review_text:
We flew with Talkeetna Air Taxi July 2010. Our pilot was extremely friendly and very knowledgeable. We were fortunate to have a clear, sunny trip with McKinley out in full splendor.
We had booked using a tour saving coupon which saved us one ticket price which was a big help. This was the #1 highlight of my husband and son from our Alaska journey. Incredible, breathtaking, everything you can imagine. This is one of the must dos for Alaska if you can! Definitely add on the glacier landing!!!

review_title: Amazing time with some amazing folks!!
review_text:
I would recommend these guys in a heartbeat!!

I was there in the 3rd week of March and never before have I taken such a plane ride......

The staff were extremely friendly and they honored the online discounts advertised on their website....the pilot was very knowledgeable and super friendly too....

He allowed us to take how much ever time we wanted on the glacier and never once hurried us...

Fantastic!!

review_title: A Must for your Bucket List
review_text: Fly, walk a glacier, go onto the largest mountain in the Northern Hemisphere, this is the experience of a lifetime.  Don't forget to take a trip with Talkeetna Air Taxi if you're in the area.

review_title: とても親切なセスナ機
review_text: マッキンリー登山でカヒルトナ氷河までタルキートナエアタクシーを使いました。スタッフの方はみんな親切でフレンドリーです。鉄道駅にも迎えに来てくれました。9人乗りほどのセスナ機でしたが、操縦が最高に上手い！氷河やマッキンリーなどの景色も最高で、タルキートナに来たら絶対TATがお勧めです。

review_title: I walked on a glacier...simply amazing.
review_text: How do you thank a company for giving me a once in a lifetime experience. I was lucky enough to take one of your flight seeing tours this past August. In spite of road construction and being late everyone was absolutely gracious. The flight its self was beyond expectations and words. Our Pilot (I am so sorry that I don't remember his name) was fantastic and shared wonderful information during the tour. I still have trouble realizing that we actually landed on a glacier! I walked on a glacier...simply amazing. I have shared my flight experience in my personal blog and readers worldwide have heard about you and the amazing experience you create for your customers. Thank you Talkeetna Air Taxi. Sincerely, Helen Rice

The weather was not good for flightseeing and glacier landing, but Talkeetna Air Taxi made the best effort by attempting a "try-out" flight. 

The pilot was very nice and my family were happy even with out seeing Mountain McKinley.

Keep up the good work, Talkeetna Air Taxi.  We will come back for another flight tour when we visit Alaska again.

No need to read any further -- just book a flightseeing trip with Talkeetna Air Taxi and if you can, make sure you do the glacier landing by Mt. McKinley. My family and I went up on one of the first clear days of August -- the views of the mountain, glaciers and valleys below were beyond description. It was the most incredible experience of our lives. 
Our pilot was fantastic and provided running commentary so we never had to wonder what we were looking at. He circled around all the sights so everyone could get a good look at all the amazing peaks too!
Landing on the glacier was one of the most incredible things I've ever done. The small plane skidded to a stop on Ruth Glacier. It's a surprisingly massive glacier surrounded by rocky granite peaks with an amazing view to a different glacier below. Being in the glacier and tossing snowballs with my 7-year old and then hiking up a bit to take in the quiet and serenity of our location were moments that are burned in my memory and will remain with me forever. How could you regret a moment of an experience like this? It's worth it. Check out some of my photos and book your trip!

review_title: Highlight of the Trip and worth the wait!
review_text:
Prior to heading to Alaska I booked the Base Camp Tour with Glacier Landing for July 4.  Unfortunately, July 4 was cloudy, rainy, and not at all amenable to flightseeing.  The staff was very helpful in getting us rescheduled for a few days later when we were headed to Seward from Denali. Fortunately, our weather was GREAT that day -  we were able to see Mt McKinley quite well even from Talkeetna!  This was the highlight of our trip and well worth the wait!  We had a very competent pilot who oriented us to our scenery as we flew. We were on a plane that held about 10  people - one in the cockpit - if this is something you are interested in ask early!  The glacier landing was FANTASTIC and well worth the extra money - it turned a great experience into a once in a lifetime one.  We had at least a half hour on the glacier for pictures, snow man building, etc.

I recommend making a reservation early on in your time in the area, so if, like for us, the weather does no cooperate for you, you can then reschedule for another convenient time.   Also, stop at the West Rib Pub when you get back for a great meal and be sure to check out the little town of Talkeetna!

I did use the Alaskan Tour Saver booklet and they did honor the coupon, but they only will give the full buy one get another tour free for a certain number of patrons in a day.  So, instead we got 20% off which was still a very good value.

Awe inspiring flight around Mt McKinley and landing on one of it's glaciers.  I've been to some beautiful places but I teared up on this one and thought of my dad who so loved the mountains.

John is a cautious - the kind of guy you want piloting a single engine

The trip to the glacier was so exciting.  Our pilot Richard pointed out so many sites to us.
He was very polite and made the trip enjoyable.
We were unable to take the Grand Denali Tour due to the weather but we were able to land on a glacier and we did get to see Mt. McKinley

I had one slight problem.  I booked the tour at the first of the year and received a 10% discount for "early booking".  The person I spoke with, at that time, said when we arrived ask also for the Senior Discount and we would receive it.  They would not honor the Senior Discount when we arrived. If they were not going to honor this discount also, why did the girl tell me to ask for it when we arrived.  We were figuring this in our vacation budget.

Did a ten day land/sea cruise with a group of about 20 people on Princess which was phenominal, but the best part of the whole trip was t he scenic flight we took to see Mt Mc Kinley from Talkeetna Air Taxi. Upon our arrival, we were treated like royalty from begining to end, starting with the front offce who took our reservations, the receptionist who checked us in, and the pilots who gave us a wonderful, smooth flight and glacier landing,  with informative narration the whole time. My only suggestion to anyone thinking of doing this would be to do it at the end of your vacation, because surely anything you do after will pale by comparision. Some of our group actually came back in tears because it was such an awe inspiring moment on the top of the glacier. It was absolutely the experience of a lifetime!
2 thumbs up-would highly recommend!!!!

They are very rude to their customers, also they are liars. 
We had a Alaska TourSaver coupon book and they pushed us to the last flight of the day (7pm). Because of our planned trip and weather, basically they did not give us any flexibility to deal with. Also they did not give you the flight they promised. I did not know where we flew to, and I did not even see the snow, only few ugly / dark glaciers.
Very bad experience and not recommended to anyone!

review_title: Great views but mediocre flight experience.
review_text: While the weather wasn't great, so we couldn't get a good view of McKinley, I was sitting right at the back of the 5 seater plane and I couldn't even hear the pilot pointing out the mountain. I only found out that the base of the mountain had been pointed out when I watched the video that my spouse had shot sitting up in front with the pilot.  My headset only had one side that was working, and I missed most of what the pilot was saying either because he had the music blaring at the same time(he apologized for not turning it off, he really was a great guy), or because the headset quality was mediocre. While the views were incredibly beautiful, I was rather disappointed with the quality of the flight itself. I think for the amount that they charge for the flight they ought to have better equipment and offer the customer better quality of service. I don't know if a good view of McKinley would have negated the mediocre flight experience.

Our flight was great even though it was quite cloudy.  After we got above the clouds we say McKinley and it was so fabulous.  The flight was very smooth even though we went through cloud layers.  This was truly an adventure.

review_title: The best experience ever!! You really need to do this!!
review_text:
We were suppose to fly on Saturday but Mother Nature didn't get the memo so we postponed our flight to Monday since Sunday we would be in the Park all day. On our drive from Denali to Talkeetna we were finally able to see Mt.McKinley for the first time and we couldn't wait to get up close and personal. 
We arrived about an hour and a half early for our flight, they were ready and could send us up early. Our pilot was John who at the moment of introduction calmed some of my anxiety about flying in such a small plane. He was very professional and carried himself with a lot of confidence...and he kind of sounds like Mike Rowe from Dirty Jobs?! lol. There were 6 of us on board including John and I sat "co-pilot" (again small plane=anxiety) so this made me feel better and it was interesting to see everything it takes to keep us up in the air. As we made our way to the mountain John pointed out rivers and other points of interest, gave us background on the area and of the native people including the meaning of the names they gave some of the mountians. We were able to fly all around the mountain and it was such a smooth flight. We landed on a glacier at base camp because where we were suppose to land was all fogged in with clouds. Base camp was pretty cool to see, he let us hang out there for about 20 minutes and it was fun watching planes come in and take off.  He noticed the weather changing so we got back in and took off, the landings and take offs are so cool! As we headed out we could see the clouds had really moved in and we weren't able to see the mountains anymore. We headed back and once again a great landing! I would do it again in a heartbeat it was such a great experience! The weather has a mind of its own but they will really work with you.  If your going to AK this is a MUST!

review_title: An extraordinary ride through the mountains
review_text: definitely take the flight and do a glacier landing -- it was incredible.  our pilot was great and we felt quite safe in her capable hands.

review_title: Awesome - in the true definition of the word. Best vacation day Ever!!
review_text:
We chose Talkeetna because we liked what we had read. The day was beautiful, the weather was clear (oddly) and the flight up and around was smooth. Everything wasa so smoothly run. Talkeetna pilot was knowledgeble and smooth. Our views of the countryside and the mountain were breathtaking. Landing on the glacier put the capper on our day. This was a perfect experience.

Talkeetna is a quaint little town with a lot of artsy kind of shops. Can keep you busy for about 2 hours.

We had a helicopter flight and glacier landing from Denali scheduled, but the weather on the way up from Anchorage was perfect, and the rule of thumb is don't miss a chance for clear weather...so we stopped at TAT on our way to Denali.  Our Tour Saver Coupon was only good for the 7pm flight, but they offered a 20% discount.  Then asked if we'd "mind" stopping on the glacier to deliver supplies for another group!  When that plan fell through, they still gave us the glacier stop.  It was fantastic!!!  Our pilot, John, was great at pointing out all of the sights, and we came away with a whole new appreciation for the vastness of The Mountain, and the park.  We left something on the plane, and before we realized it and called back to check with them, they had contacted our emergency contact to ask them to let us know they had the item secured.
Great operation, highly recommend.

This was the highlight of our Alaska trip....one of my most memorable adventures.  We tried on the way up to Denali but the weather didn't permit it.  So, tried again on the way back to Anchorage ~ luckily the weather cooperated and we were able to go.  What an adventure, gorgeous views, great pilot, lovely day, breathtaking, it was fun, fun, fun!  I didn't want to leave.  Expensive, but worth every penny!

Talkeetna Air Taxi was wonderful to work with from the time that we booked until our flight touched down after visiting the glacier!  We used Talkeetna Air Taxi following a 7-night Princess cruise for the Mt. McKinley flightseeing and glacier landing combination.  We originally planned to use a BOGOF coupon in the Alaskan Tour Saver coupon book, however our dates of travel made the coupon obsolete.  As a courtesy, Talkeetna Air offered a 20% discount on flights for our dates.  Boy, was it worth the money! 

Our pilot's name was Will.  Not only was he patient in pointing out various landmarks and other points of interest (Mt. McKinley, Ruth Glacier, etc.), but also courteous enough to take photos of those in our group. The beautiful scenery seen on this flight compares to nothing else.  The plane ride was exciting and everyone has a window seat and a headset.  The glacier landing was very smooth, and not nearly as cold as I would have imagined. Our flight departed at 4 PM and when we landed, the sun was was still bright and shining.  The view from atop the glacier is absolutely amazing!!!!! This is a must do, and much preferred over fllightseeing in Juneau, AK. 

If you visit Talkeetna, flightseeing is a must-do and Talkeetna would be my recommendation. They are the best at what they do.

My son and I were scheduled to fly on a certain day. We were called one day earlier and asked if we could change our plans and fly that day-the reason was they saw that the weather was changing and couldn't guarantee a glacier landing. How awesome that a company tries to get the best for their customers! Our pilot was great with his knowledge and had a sense of humor too. We were able to make the glacier landing and was the flight of a lifetime.
I suggest this to anyone who wants to make the time since the drive from Anchorage is about 2 hours.

review_title: May all of your flights and adventures be Blessed!!!
review_text:
I just want to say, that my first ever, and most feared, flight experience in a small plane was, by far, "THE MOST WONDERFUL EXPERIENCE" I have ever had in my life.  
    My pilot "Bill" flew me to Denali Mt. and shared with me a very dear moment when I released my dad and mom's ashes over the same mountain that my grand father (mom's dad) "Grant H. Pearson" had climbed more then once, wrote about his life, his work as a Park Ranger there, his passion about "Denali" and a bit about my mother "Shirley" in his book "My Life of High Adventure, My climb to the top of the mountain".
       
          Wed. Sept. 23, 2009 was the most Glorious day for the flight. 
   
     All the staff there at "T.A.T.", from the first phone call to them about chartering a flight, to setting the date, to changing the date due to weather,  to the flight, and beyond, were not only professional, but were also kind, considerate,  and showed compassion towards me during my experience with them.
    I cannot thank Talkeetna Air Taxi enough for being a part of helping me to fulfill my parents last request of taking them to the mountain, and for the experience, and joy of the flight. 
    Thank you Bill, Saundra, and Annie.  May you all there at T.A.T. be Blessed.  I'll never forget you folks and I will tell others about you.                 
                                                        Mr. Joseph E. Sullivan, Jr.

Went on the Mckinley South Summit trip with glacier landing. The scenery is stunning. The beauty of these mountains is awe inspiring. The landing on the glacier is the highlight. On walking out of the plane on the glacier, I was stunned by the enormity of the surroundings. A must on any itinerary in Alaska.

review_title: Wonderful service from front desk to pilot
review_text:
This was a phenomenal experience. Of course the scenery was breathtaking. This activity is WELL worth the money. It is an expensive outing, but such a wonderful experience.

There are several companies in the area offering similar service, but TAT was fantastic. We were scheduled for one day but had bad weather. They were very flexible to reschedule us for another day (and so friendly about it). When we arrive for our flight, they still were not sure if we could land on the glacier so they did not take our payment before we left. All the front desk staff was friendly and helpful. The pilot did a great job of flying and narrating the trip. Don't be scared of the small planes - the ride was very smooth. Turbulence isn't a huge problem in Alaska because there isn't enough heat to make the air unstable. My husband and I took motion sickness meds just in case. The glacier landing was well worth the additional money. It was such a unique experience.

Bottom line - spend the money for this experience and go with TAT! They are great!

Since we didn't go into Denali, we decided to book a flightseeing trip and glacier landing to see McKinley.  The whole experience was fantastic.  We were lucky enough to have an exceptionally clear day- we didn't see one cloud.  Our pilot, Danille, was knowlegablle and made us all feel comfortable.  During the two hour flight and landing, we took over 300 magnificent pictures.  What a way to expereince the majesty of Alaska- a must!

I was recently up in Alaska for a wedding in Anchorage. We stayed in Palmer about 1 1/2 hours away from Talkeetna. My wife and I had some reservations driving up to Talkeetna because of busy long weekend.  Taking this trip was so worth it. The views were spectacular. The glacier landing is a must. It seems expensive, but when you do it, you realize that its worth every penny.

review_title: THE highlight of our Alaska vacation!
review_text: We booked the glacier landing which was incredible.  After flying up towards Mt. McKinley, the pilot did a great job of maneuvering so that people on both sides of the plane could take great photos.  We went places I thought we'd never go in a plane -- between the mountains and circling to land on Ruth Glacier.  With the engine shut down, what a superb site and the silence was stunning.  The pilot was excellent at briefly explaining the sites and the "push to talk" feature allowed the passengers to ask questions during the flight.  This trip is an absolute must!

We have done a lot of sightseeing flights around the World, but this has got to be the best ever. It was a small plane - only 4 seats, and it was quite tight. On the back seat you have to sit crosslegged - but then you have a view to both sides.

The flight took us very low over the mountains around Mount McKinley. The pilot - a young lady - was very informative, sweet and a lot of fun! 

We included a glacier landing for an extra price, and that was money very very well spent! It was a fantastic experience landing amidst the mountains and walking out on the glacier. We were, however, also very lucky with the weather.

review_title: Don't leave Denali without doing this!
review_text:
We visited Alaska and Denali in Aug 2008. 
We hadn't planned to take the air taxi, but made a last minute reservation (just 2 days in advance) when we realized what we might be missing. We were a little apprehensive of going in a little plane, but it was very exciting and probably our best experience in Alaska. 
It was just my wife, me, and the pilot (Bob) on the little plane - Bob was very knowledgeable and explained everything there is to know about the rivers, glaciers, moraines, and the mountains. We wree lucky to have clear weather. We flew past the peaks and landed on the little Pica glacier - we spent almost 20 minutes on the glacier, and there are no words to explain how we felt about it.

The flight itself was smooth and we took plenty of pictures. Hats off to Bob and Talkeetna Air Taxi for a great experience!

Probably one of the most spectacular things I have ever seen, our flightseeing tour of Denali (Mt Mckinley) in Alaska on Talkeetna Air Taxi was an unforgettable experience. We got the best deal of any of the many local flyers, our pilot Paul was great and everyone was so friendly. We felt safe and reasonably warm for our December flight around the summit. I researched all of the Air Taxis from Anchorage to Talkeetna and chose Talkeetna Air after talking with the locals and they did not disappoint. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for an unforgettable experience.

review_title: A once in a lifetime experience...dont miss this!
review_text:
We had booked our reservation months in advance for a Mt. McKinley (Denali) flightseeing tour with glacier landing.  Unfortunately, the day before our tour we realized that the weather predictions for the following day were not going to be condusive to seeing "the high one".  TAT was awesome and reschuled us for that day at 4:00 pm.

I must say that this was one of the most amazing experiences of my life!  The weather was perfect. We landed on the Ruth Glacier and had some awesome views of Denali.

Alaska was everything we hoped and we will be back!  

PS-TAT has some really cool T-shirts and hats too!

review_title: Talkeetna Air Taxi and K2 Aviation
review_text:
Both K2 and Talkeetna Air Taxi (TAT) get my highest recommendation. Follow along with the bouncing ball, kids, as our tale unfolds:

Pre-booked directly with TAT about a month before leaving for Alaska. Our tour train arrived in Talkeetna about noon and we were scheduled to fly with them at 3pm. Walked over to their shop in town at about 1pm and spoke with Chris, who explained  that the weather on the mountain was less than optimum for flightseeing so far that day, and showed us a current computer graphic of the weather system to illustrate the point. We explained that we had only that afternoon available since we were scheduled to leave Talkeetna 11am the following morning. Chris suggested that we kill a few hours in town, cross our fingers, and pray that the weather gods cleared things up enough by early evening to give it a shot. Touched base with him on the hour until 6pm, but the mountain remained fogged in. Sensing our desperation to go up anyway, Chris explained that he'd be happy to fly us around the lower part of the Ruth Glacier on a less extensive tour, but strongly urged us to call it a day since we were likely to be unhappy with the view. Look. When a pilot tells you to cancel...you cancel. We told Chris we'd try him again early the next morning if the weather cleared, and TAT refunded our deposit no questions asked. I have to commend Chris and TAT for their helpfulness and honesty.  

Fast forward to the following morning. We take a look out the back deck of the Talkeetna Alaskan Lodge at 7:45am. The sky is clear and the mountains are in plain view. I call TAT back, but their entire morning schedule is committed to taking up climbers that they were unable to get up the day before, and they can't possibly get us up and back before we have to leave. TAT made their bones depositing climbers on Denali, and understandably they're priority #1. We're out of luck and about out of time.

It's a horrible sight to see a grown man cry. It really is. In a last dicth effort at salvaging the most anticipated part of our trip, I run over to the concierge desk at the lodge and BEG the woman to put us on something...anything...a hot air baloon if necessary... some Wright Brothers pedal-powered contraption...that can get us up to Denali and back by 11am. 

Angels exist. Trust me. I found one. Within 10 minutes, the concierge (who is now a viable candidate for sainthood if she performs just TWO more miracles) called us and set to get ready...she got seats for 4 of us with K2 Aviation at 8:30, and we'd be back in time to make our bus. Take note, my countrymen. I  do solemnly swear that I shall willingly fall upon my sword for this woman should the need ever arise.

Mike at K2 took us up in a 5-seat Cessna for the ride of our lives on their Denali Grand Tour. Nothing compares with the sight of seeing the biggest rock on the North American continent up close and personal. Loss for words. Fill in your favorite superlatives. There's a dreamlike quality to the entire landscape, as if it were some massive painted backdrop for a Cecil B. DeMille film. Mike gave us the 4-1-1 on the geologic environs as we flew around Denali, Foraker, Hunter, the Ruth Glacier and the Talkeetna Mountain range. Absolutely the highlight of our trip to Alaska. It'll be yours, too. 

The flyguys of Talkeetna are a cooperative and close-knit band of brothers who are constantly in radio contact with each other about flying conditions in the area.  You won't find a friendlier, more informative bunch of "Right Stuff"-ers anywhere this side of NASA. Hats off, and sincere thanks to the crews at both K2 AND TAT. 

And, of course, to my guardan angel at the Talkeetna Alaskan concierge desk. Who loves ya, baby?

Strongly suggest that you make arrangements well before you leave for Alaska if you're planning on going on a Denali flight. Space fills up quick (and we got damn lucky). And be prepared on any given day for the mountain to do what the mountain is wont to do. Anything big enough to create its own weather system ain't arranging its day around YOUR schedule. Denali is like a box of chocolates, Forrest...

.

review_title: Talkeetna Air Taxi - GOTTA DO IT!
review_text: Our top priority in Talkeetna was flightseeing over Mt. McKinley (Denali). We booked with Talkeetna Air Taxi for the Grand Denali tour with Glacier Landing. We had 2 Toursaver books so my family of 4 saved $440. It was cloudy (as usual) so we were thinking that our trip might be a bummer, but boy were we wrong! We had the time of our lives! My hat's off to those pilots, they really know their stuff! The pilot did a great job of stay below the clouds so that we could see the sharp cliffs and massive glaciers. Many times we were so close that the proximity warning would enunciate "500" warning us that we were within 500 feet of the terrain. But I never felt scared. My 12-year old daughter was petrified to board the plane, but soon she began to enjoy herself and now she'll tell you that flightseeing was one of her favorite activities in Alaska. Our glacier landing was as smooth as silk. What an awesome feeling to stand in such a majestic place! After we took-off again, the pilot found a hole in the clouds and after a steep assent we popped out above the clouds for a perfectly clear view of Denali's summit. WOW! If you have any chance to take this trip - DO IT!
